title: [Moonglae Inn, Atrium]
description: A skylight two stories above allows natural light to flood this room, giving it the feel of an outdoor cafe.  Set into the grey marble pillars surrounding the atrium are metal planters filled with a variety of flowers, plants, and hanging vines.  A burbling fountain in the center of the room makes the illusion complete.  Overhead, a row of black granite pillars surrounds the upper cloister, with a gallery of stained glass windows hanging between them.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cat's Paw Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with eleven white starstones in the shape of a cat's paw and claws.

title: [Hammer Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with five white starstones in the shape of a "T."

title: [Guardian Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with ten white starstones loosely suggesting the form of a man.

title: [Zul Logoth, Winding Tunnels]
description: Thin veins of mica snake through the surrounding rock.  Shadowy recesses mark the entrances to other tunnels.  A faint odor of salt lingers in the air.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Moonglae Inn, North Lobby]
description: The north end of the spacious lobby is flanked by the front desk on one side and a wide spiral staircase on the other.  Between them, a lunar mobile spins slowly against a sky of black spidersilk stitched with gleaming white starstones.  A tall, dignified elf stands behind the front desk, ready to attend to your every need.

title: [Moonglae Inn, South Lobby]
description: Heavy oak doors open into the expansive lobby of the Moonglae Inn.  Greystone walls rise high overhead, where polished ironwood beams reinforce the sharply sloping roof.  Bustling porters usher new guests toward the front desk, while other visitors mingle in small groups, discussing the news of the day.  The room is dominated by a large eahnor planter circled by a round sofa that sits atop a plush red carpet in the center of the room.

title: [Ta'Illistim, BriarStone Court]
description: The stonework tracery rosette windows of the Moonglae Inn sparkle in the light, casting tiny rainbows of shimmering hues across the puddles of water accumulated amongst the cobblestones of the court.  The building's mica-flecked granite exterior, worn smooth with age and elements, stands testament to the city's rich and storied history.
The stonework tracery rosette windows of the Moonglae Inn sparkle in the starlight, casting tiny rainbows of shimmering hues from off their stained glass panes.

The stonework tracery rosette windows of the Moonglae Inn sparkle in the light, casting tiny rainbows of shimmering hues from off their stained glass panes.  Surrounding the colorful windows, the building's silvery blue granite exterior is worn smooth from age and the elements.  Against the clean, new looking marbles of the structures nearby, the Inn shows its years.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, northwest

description: The facade of the United Bank of City-States looms in the shadows, presenting an immoveable front to the forces of time and weather.  Tall stonework columns brace gracefully arching stonework embrasures, each of which frames an octagonal glaesine tracery window glowing from within.  Low granite steps lead upwards into the bank.

The facade of the United Bank of City-States looms skyward, presenting an immoveable front to the forces of time and weather.  Tall stonework columns brace gracefully arching stonework embrasures, each of which frames an octagonal glaesine tracery window.  Low granite steps lead upwards into the bank.

Beneath a dome of sapphire tiling, the United Bank of City-States looms, presenting an immovable front to the forces of time and weather.  Though the rest of the building is a silvery blue granite, the tall columns that frame the windows are white marble, as are its four peacock shaped gargoyles.  A small flight of steps leads upwards and inside.  Beyond the edge of the var stretches the expanse of Ta'Illistim Green.

title: [Bank of Ta'Illistim, Lobby]
description: The stained glaes rosette windows, capturing just enough moonlight from the night sky, cast a rainbow of shimmering color across the bank's pure white marble floors.  A richly hued Loenthran carpet, vibrant in shades of wine, sapphire and emerald, rests in front of the bank's entrance.

The stained glaes rosette windows cast a rainbow of shimmering color across the bank's pure white marble floors.  A richly hued Loenthran carpet, vibrant in shades of wine, sapphire and emerald, rests in front of the bank's entrance.

The establishment's patrons wander through a corbelled stone arch.  Fashioned of the same mica-flecked granite that graces the Sapphire Gate, the arch towers above, nearly reaching the peak of the bank's vaulted ceiling.  The arch is carved with a pattern of sinuous dahcres.

title: [Ta'Illistim, BriarStone Court]
description: Set well back from the court stands a small stonework building, its marble doorpost and window embrasures heavily carved with fan-tailed peacocks.  A tarnished mithglin plaque swings from a rod mounted beside the building's thick door.  A single lantern mounted on a nearby post casts a diffuse blue glow across the area.

title: [United Bank of City-States]
description: Rich wine-hued brocade draperies cover the walls of the small teller's room, leaving one to wonder who might be watching from behind.  The rich blue carpeting underfoot muffles the sound of movement as patrons conduct their business in hushed tones and move back out into the lobby.  The teller sits behind a tall counter, flanked by two elven guards.

title: [Bank of Ta'Illistim, Lobby]
description: The glimmer of moonlight that shines through the stained glaesine rosette windows dances across the polished white marble floors.  Several of the city guard patrol the bank's lobby, seemingly at ease, but ever watchful for any sign of impending trouble.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Erissian Var]
description: The glowing sapphire-tiled roof of the United Bank of City-States sparkles in the moonlight reflected like tiny spangled stars.  The tall stonework columns framing the windows are intricately carved with gargoyles, which vary in expression from the amusing to the horrifying.  A small flight of stone steps leads upward into the building.

A small flight of stone steps leads upward into the building.

Past the boundary of a low silver fence, the expanse of Ta'Illistim Green fills the heart of the city.  The var runs parallel to the fence for a spell, bordering the cobblestones with manicured green lawn.  The open space affords a distant view of Ta'Illistim Keep with its distinctive mosaic domes.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Erissian Var]
description: A small blue slate-clad manor house sits back from the var, apparently enjoying a second life as a shop judging from the small mithglin sign posted on the front steps.  Sweet-smelling fruit trees frame the manor's rough-hewn slate facade.  Tiny glaesine globes mounted on small iron stakes cast a gentle glow across the area.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Erissian Var]
description: Owls nesting in the library's courtyard trees send their soft hoots floating over the stonework wall and across the cobbled var.  To the south, the bustle of Fraendel Court awaits the intrepid adventurer.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Erissian Var]
description: The facade of the courtyard of the Library Aies towers above, clad in grey-blue granite.  Brightly burning torches on either side of the doors illuminate heavy bas-relief murals carved into the walls surrounding the doors, each depicting scenes of scholars in study and discussion.  Formal garden plantings march in neat rows along the path leading to the ironwork front gates, nodding in the slight breeze like tiny drunken soldiers.  The sound of water tumbling in the fountain echoes softly off the massive stone wall.

A colonnade of silvery blue stone columns forms the front of the enclosure surrounding the courtyard of the Library Aies, which is set back from the var.  Heavy bas-relief murals are carved into the frieze within the colonnade's entablature, their combined scenes depicting a long progression of elven scholars in study and discussion.  Prominently placed between the street and the columns is a huge cast bronze book.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Erissian Var]
description: The large stone walls surrounding the Library Aies stand directly against the cobblestoned var, covered in strands of clinging dark green ivy.  Above the top of the granite wall, the crenellated facade of the library is barely visible in the moonlight.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Erissian Var]
description: The var passes between two large buildings, the Ta'Illistim Theatre to the south and the Public Library to the northwest.  To either side of the grand structures, you see a number of small but comfortable cottages that seem to be home to a community of young scholars and artists.  In the doorway of one cottage, two black-robed young elves engage in a heated debate over what is likely some obscure point of philosophy.

The var passes between two large buildings, the Ta'Illistim Theatre to the south and the Library Aies to the northwest.  To either side of the grand structures are a number of small but comfortable domiciles that seem to be home to a community of scholars and artists, if the piles of books and the random bits of unfinished sculpture on the doorsteps are any kind of indication.  A small shop, converted from an older home, fits right in on the street.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Sylvar Wey]
description: At either side of this intersection, two mansions compete for the eye's attention.  To the west, a slate-grey granite manor sits in an immaculately manicured lawn.  Its tall columns support a two-story portico that shelters tall windows framed with silvery curtains.  The mansion to the east is built on a grander plan, with high greystone walls supported by flying buttresses and magnificent stained glass windows.  Through meticulous care, a lush flower garden appears perfectly wild.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Glamesine Var]
description: The cobblestoned street circles around a large fountain carved of sparkling mica-flecked granite.  A large blue-grey dragon, his teeth bared to the starry sky, rears his stone head from his perch in the center of the fountain.  Fiery torches set at the crosspoints of the fountain reflect upon the water.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Glamesine Var]
description: The theatre to the south towers above the tops of the cottages lining this part of the var.  The stone and slate-clad homes' diamond-paned glaesine windows glow in the night with a pale yellow shimmer.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Glamesine Var]
description: The Ta'Illistim Theatre dominates the var.  The stone cladding on the structure has been sectioned off into panels, each of which is carved with a different scene of players on a stage. description: The ornate facade of a guild hall stands back from the var, clad in blue-grey granite and carved in heavy relief. title: [Ta'Illistim, Glaendier Wey]
description: The occasional strain of music drifts in from the northwest, floating gently on the air.  Beyond a small grove of trees, a stone-clad building is barely visible.

A plinth, topped with a sculptural bronze, sits in the middle of the road, leaving any traffic merging between Glaendier Wey and Var to wend around it.  The lantern-lit roundabout is framed by a series of identical residential structures, each one faced with white marble.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Glaendier Wey]
description: The few pedestrians about begin to disperse to the east and west, hurrying towards their destinations.  A lone wagon sits abandoned for the night.
The crowds begin to disperse to the east and west, pedestrians hurrying towards their destinations.  As merchants drive their wagons along, they call their wares loudly above the din.

The imposing bulk of a series of conjoined residences takes up the real estate alongside the road.  Little separates the homes, which share interior walls, but each has their own modest dome.  Despite the close quarters, the structure is well-maintained, with white marble cladding and not a sapphire tile out of place on the roofs.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Glaendier Wey]
description: The cobblestoned wey widens abruptly as it meets Shimmarglin Court.  The hue and cry from the denizens of the huge plaza echoes off the stone buildings lining the wey.  A trickle of patrons flows to and from a nearby well-kept cottage.

The cobblestoned wey widens abruptly as it meets the edge of Shimmarglin Court.  Perched at the juncture between the road and the open space is a elevated shop, raised up three steps and set with tapered marble columns.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: The Shimmarglin Court, surrounded by shops, provides a home for the city's famed floating garden.  Throngs of townspeople and travellers move through the court, shopping at the various merchants and socializing in small groups.  Torches placed at regular intervals illuminate the walkways threading through the area.

The Shimmarglin Court, surrounded by shops, provides a home for the city's famed floating garden.  Throngs of townspeople and travellers move through the court, shopping at the various merchants and socializing in small groups.

In the darkness cast by the floating dais overhead, a few tables and shop stalls remain open through the night, lit by unflickering blue lanterns.  The detritus of a day's commerce still litters the cobblestones.  Around the edges of the courtyard, the porticos of the more permanent buildings have already been swept clean.

In the lee of the floating dais overhead, small shops and temporary stalls are set out to catch potential customers passing by on their way to the gardens.  The cobblestones are nearly obscured under the mass of commerce waiting to happen.  Around the edges of the courtyard, more permanent buildings fight for the space around their own arched doorways and porticos.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: A low grey stone wall provides a backdrop for several flowering trees, each sending a small shower of petals tumbling towards the ground with each stir of the night breeze.  The court is relatively quiet, as a few shoppers visit merchants and a single group of travellers chat amongst themselves.  Warm amber light shines from the northeast and the glowing glaesine windows of the imposing Shimmarglin Inn.

A low grey stone wall provides a backdrop for several flowering trees, each sending a small shower of petals tumbling towards the ground with each stir of the day's breeze.  The court is bustling with activity as shoppers visit merchants and groups of travellers chat amongst themselves.  Much of the pedestrian traffic flows to the northeast towards the imposing Shimmarglin Inn.

A colonnade frames this section of the Court, attached to the portico of a low-slung white marble building.  Access to the porch is blocked, however, by a pair of tables, each covered for the night with a white tarpaulin.  Overhead, the slowly spinning bulk of the dais looms.

A colonnade frames this section of the Court, attached to the portico of a low-slung white marble building. Overhead, the slowly spinning bulk of the dais casts a shadow below.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Var]
description: The var widens as it meets the bustling Shimmarglin Court, its cobblestones worn smooth by ages of traffic.  Lanterns hung from ironwork posts light the way with a gentle amber glow.  On either side of the var, groupings of flowering trees and hydrangea bushes bursting with delicate blue and lavender blooms nod gently at the passersby.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Stearriza Var]
description: The pitched roof of a nearby cottage slopes gently towards its stonework support, the roof tiles carefully laid atop one another in neat rows.  A large bougainvillea, its slender boughs laden with deep pink blossoms, drapes itself gently over one end of the cottage.

The domed roof of a nearby house is a shiny sapphire blue, its tiles carefully laid against one another in neat rows.  A large cluster of climbing vines, laden with tightly closed white roses, drapes itself gently over one end of the building.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Wey]
description: The wey opens onto a larger cobblestoned var, as the few passersby move off towards their separate destinations.  Several city guardsmen, casually watching the passersby and talking quietly amongst themselves, stand at the corner of the wey.

The wey opens onto a larger cobblestoned var, the congestion easing somewhat as the throngs move off towards their separate destinations.  Several city guardsmen, casually watching the passersby and talking quietly amongst themselves, stand at the corner of the wey.

At the juncture of wey and var, the cobblestones of the two streets merge together.  The former, much smaller than the latter, opens up at the intersection, forming a fan pattern on the ground.  The bluish-grey stones are joined with a mica-flecked mortar, which under the veil of night appears darker than it probably really is.  A gate peeks out from behind a stand of climbing roses.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Wey]
description: Several fruit trees are clustered in a bed at the corner where granite wall meets granite wall, an efficiency of space that affords beauty as well.  The dark granite cobblestones of the wey are polished to a dull sheen by many years of use.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Wey]
description: A tall stonework wall stands on the west side of the wey, tiny chinks between the massive stone blocks barely visible to the eye.  Fragrant white climbing roses, their clusters of blooms drifting in the night breeze, climb portions of the wall and hang gracefully from the top of the granite edifice.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Wey]
description: The buttressed stonework of the Sapphire Gate looms high above, casting shadows across the cobblestoned street beyond.  Rows of flaming torches line the wey as it wends southwesterly deeper into the city.  A few travellers and townsfolk scurry up and down the wey, each industriously about their business at this late hour.

The buttressed stonework of the Sapphire Gate looms high above, casting shadows across the cobblestoned street beyond.  Carrying the smells and noise of the throngs along them in waves, the crowds push further into the city.

The ogee arch of the Sapphire Gate looms high above, overlooking the cobblestoned street beyond.  In its shadow, the cobblestones are turned from silver into black, though a few lanterns give off a bright blue glow, forming pockets of light amidst the pooled darkness of night.

The ogee arch of the Sapphire Gate looms high above, overlooking the cobblestoned street beyond.  In its shadow, the cobblestones are turned from silver into grey, though a few lanterns give off a dim blue glow, dispelling some of the pooled darkness.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Sapphire Gate]
description: The few people entering and exiting the city at this hour are forced down a narrow path as the gateyard terminates at the Sapphire Gate.  Crafted of glittering mica-flecked blue granite, the gate arches high overhead, buttressed on either side by equally imposing carved granite gargoyles.  Sandblasted into the granite just above the gate's open archway, the crest of House Illistim is outlined with silver tracery.

Sandblasted into the granite just above the gate's open archway, the crest of House Illistim is outlined with silver tracery.

The gateyard terminates at the Sapphire Gate, through which Ta'Illistim proper and the open night sky can be seen.  Above the keystone of the gate itself are two enameled peacocks pavonated, facing inwards towards one another to just barely brush beaks.  Their brightly colored plumage stands out against the mica-flecked silvery blue stonework of the city.

Their brightly colored plumage stands out against the mica-flecked silvery blue stonework of the city.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Gateyard]
description: The gateyard begins to narrow as it funnels its occupants towards the northeast.  The stone walls close in a bit, flaming iron-sconced torches spaced evenly along the stoneworks just above reach for even the tallest giantman.  Two guardsmen stand atop a wooden platform, inspecting the hubbub of the gateyard.

title: [Ta'Illistim, City Gate]
description: Quiet in the night air, the inner gateyard is home to only a few at this late hour.  The city guards converse amongst themselves, stopping occasionally to inspect the few travellers who journey into the city through the inner portcullis.  A lone wagon rests near one wall, apparently abandoned for the night by its owner.

Filled with raucous noise, the inner gateyard teems with activity.  The city guards converse amongst themselves or stand warily by, watching the populace as they pour into and out of the inner portcullis.  Wagons and carts are lined up to one side of the gateyard, as a trio of guards inspect their contents before allowing their owners to proceed into the city proper.

The inner gateyard is a circular chamber of silvery blue stone, its walls rising to a domed ceiling above.  The cobblestones are worn smooth, more so in the center of the chamber than around the walls.  A portcullis, raised halfway into a hidden compartment, reveals its teeth and a few feet of its gridded metal screen.

The inner gateyard is one in a series of circular chambers of silvery blue stone, its walls rising to a domed ceiling above.  The cobblestones are worn smooth, more so in the center of the chamber than around the walls.  A portcullis, raised upwards into a hidden compartment, reveals only its teeth.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Inner Portcullis]
description: The inner portcullis hangs above, raised to its highest limit.  A large enamelled sculpture depicting the House Illistim coat of arms is mounted to the ironwork above the portcullis, attached with intertwining vines and dully gleaming metalworked glyphs.  Two city guards stand rigidly at attention on either side of the tunnel's mouth.

The inner portcullis hangs above, raised to its highest limit.  A large enameled sculpture depicting the House Illistim coat of arms is mounted to the metalwork above the inner portcullis, its bright sapphire blue standing out against the paler silver of the surrounding stonework.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Portcullis Tunnel]
description: Carved on either side of the tunnel with the crest of House Illistim, the tunnel walls otherwise appear impossibly smooth, the dark grey-blue granite ground to a velvet-like finish.  Several city guards stand to the side, casually observing passersby in the dim light of the tunnel's amber lanterns.

Carved on either side of the tunnel with the crest of Ta'Illistim, the tunnel walls otherwise appear impossibly smooth, the silvery blue granite ground to a velvet-like finish.  Lanterns, spaced out evenly in a lattice pattern, put out a bright, unflickering blue light.

Carved on either side of the tunnel with the crest of Ta'Illistim, the tunnel walls otherwise appear impossibly smooth, the silvery blue granite ground to a velvet-like finish.  Lanterns, spaced out evenly in a lattice pattern, put out a dim, unflickering blue light.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Portcullis Tunnel]
description: The stone walls vault endlessly upwards, lined with glowing amber lanterns and hung high above with the banner of House Illistim.  Hawk-eyed guards stand at the ready just inside the stony gate, watching travellers as they pass beneath the portcullis at the tunnel's mouth.

The stone walls vault endlessly upwards, lined with brightly glowing silver lanterns and hung high above with the banner of Ta'Illistim.  A polished portcullis, its heavy bulk a grid of argent metalwork, is raised above the stony ground, marking the entrance and exit to the tunnel leading into the city.

The stone walls vault endlessly upwards, lined with dimly glowing silver lanterns and hung high above with the banner of Ta'Illistim.  A polished portcullis, its heavy bulk a grid of argent metalwork, is raised above the stony ground, marking the entrance and exit to the tunnel leading into the city.

title: [Ta'Illistim, City Gate]
description: A cavernous opening in the cliff's steep face dominates the crest of the hillside, serving as the nearly impenetrable entrance to the great city built by House Illistim.  A raised portcullis is barely visible at the top of the stony maw.  Intricately carved columns flank the entrance, their crowns adorned with delicate silvered glyphs and toothily grinning gargoyles.  Staked torches nearby cast an amber glow across the glyphs, highlighting their curves and contours with an eerie grace.

A cavernous opening in the cliff's steep face dominates the crest of the hillside, serving as the nearly impenetrable entrance to the great city built by House Illistim.  A raised gate is barely visible at the top of the stony maw.  Intricately carved columns flank the entrance, their crowns adorned with delicate silvered glyphs and toothily grinning gargoyles.  Staked torches nearby cast an amber glow across the glyphs, highlighting their curves and contours with an eerie grace.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Road]
description: The hillside climbs steeply northward, as sheer cliffs tower overhead to a dizzying height.  The well-worn cobblestoned road winds its way towards the cliffs from the valley floor.  To one side of the road, a small guard tower houses two elven guards, each of whom is diligently observing the few travelling this road at night.  A lone torch burns at the base of the tower, casting a dim glow across the features of those who pass.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Road]
description: The walls of the pass open up and fade into the sides of the hills.  The road continues its ascent through the darkness towards what appears to be a large gate.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Road]
description: The road levels out briefly before continuing on.  The grey cobblestones begin to create a more complicated pattern as the road travels up the hill.  Silence falls across the road with the coming of the night.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Road]
description: The road changes to cobblestone steps as the road ascends the steepest part of the hill.  Burning torches stand on either side of the steps.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Road]
description: The road heads up the steep hillside to the northeast.  Ancient runes can barely be seen in the stones.  A pattern of small shrubs line the cobblestone border at regular intervals.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Road]
description: A cobblestone road begins here as a great circle.  The road heads to the northeast as it climbs up a large hill.  Fireflies flicker through the darkness around the road.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Trail]
description: A large carving of a stylized drake adorns the western pass wall.  The walls of the pass begin to fan outward from each other into the night.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Trail]
description: The hills of the pass drop drastically in height as the pass continues to the northeast.  A wind blows through the area, occasionally creating a tornado of fallen leaves.  Nightly moonglow fills the pass.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Trail]
description: Shrubs of various sizes line the trail, while others dot the low hills on either side of the trail.  Small birds spend the night darting in and out of the outlying shrubs.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Trail]
description: The grass gradually shortens as the trail travels to the north.  Finger-like slivers of mist push in among the dark grass.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Meadow]
description: The heavy mist seems to rise off the the land, ascending upwards to rejoin the darkened clouds above.  Surrounded by mountains, the tall blades of grass of the meadow seem dwarfed in comparison.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Meadow]
description: Tall, ancient trees give way to younger, shorter ones as the forest thins out.  At the dark wood's edge a meadow fans out under the hovering mist.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Forest]
description: As yet another corner on the winding trail is passed, far in the distance the mist seems to thin.  Soon the mist thins enough to allow you to see almost clearly through the mist to the edge of the forest.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Forest]
description: A cool night breeze whispers through the trees, carrying the scent of moist wood.  Mist curls and creeps along the trail now, enveloping the feet of travellers in the area.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Forest]
description: As the wood continues on, tall evergreens and oaks stand proudly in vigilance over the winding trail.  A thin blanket of mist rises up from the dense forest floor, lingering in the night air.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Hills]
description: The forest slowly continues to creep closer, threatening to envelop both the trail and those who trek upon it during the night.  Soon the light is but tiny slivers that shine through cracks in the canopy of foliage above.

description: The rolling hills leave off for a more level plane.  A faint trail begins, parting the emerald sea of grass in the black night, leading you on through the pass.

description: In the distance the hills, thick with lush green forests, are blanketed in a gentle nighttime mist.  Nearby a lone hawk cries out, echoing through the pass.

description: Large rocks have sunk into the spongy soil, creating stepping stones across the difficult terrain.  Puddles surround the stones with muddy water.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Marsh]
description: Each step causes water to seep to the surface of the spongy soil.  Bullfrogs leap through the darkness.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Bridge]

title: [Whistler's Pass, Iron Bridge]
description: A wrought-iron statue of a drake spreads its wings out wide, its neck extended towards the heavens.  A torch burns in the drake's mouth.  At the south end of the bridge a series of steps lead up to a hill.  To the north, the bridge ends at another hilltop.

description: Two bridges fan out from this hilltop.  The iron bridge to the northeast curves slightly to reach a hill to the north while the cobblestone bridge to the southwest is as straight as an arrow.  Some iron steps lead to the iron bridge.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Stone Bridge]
description: Peering over the short walls that form the sides of the bridge, a number of small animals can be seen in the space between the two hills.  Small grooves are cut into the walls near the bridge bottom for drainage.  A pair of stone pillars hold iron sconces with burning torches.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Bridge]

title: [Whistler's Pass, Hills]

title: [Whistler's Pass, Hills]
description: Spread around the hilltop is a sea of thick fog, hidden in the darkness of the night.  Hills barely peak above the upper reaches of the fog, while mist tendrils reach out to caress the neighboring hilltops.

description: Dozens of large rocks to the north provide a way up the steep slope of the hill.  The slick grass makes straying from the rocks a risky adventure, especially in the night.

description: The silvery mist hangs thick in the valley catching the moonlight between the hills, the moisture making navigation difficult among the twisting hills.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Hills]
description: Matted grass marks the trail down the hill.  The everpresent mist thickens in the night-shrouded valleys between the hills.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Hills]
description: Cool grass and a steep slope create the perfect hill for rolling down, leaving the cares of the world at the top of the darkened hill.  A bank of mist spreads out among the hills.

description: Yellow and purple wildflowers crown the tops of the nearby hills.  Above, large-winged birds glide gracefully along on air currents, their dark forms shadows in the night.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Hills]
description: Gently rolling hills expand to the north.  Few trees grow here, but a few of the hills are capped with a lone maoral.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Clearing]
description: A small clearing forms as the pass widens.  Wildflowers, with short stems and a bulb of green leaves surrounding a purple flower, grow throughout the moonlit meadow.  The trail dips slightly to the east.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Trail]
description: A series of dark purple vines with green leaves twist along the darkened rock walls.  New shoots of growth can be seen reaching towards the heights of the pass.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Trail]
description: The trail dips slightly into a small canyon.  Green, broad-leafed plants line the walls as the pass narrows.  Cool mist blows through the area, leaving a fine layer of moisture on everything.  The plants glisten with the continuous moisture in the moonlight.

title: [Emerald Forest, Beech Grove]
description: Leaves flutter down like confetti from the thick settlement of beech trees which hems in the path on either side.  A scrawny bush, barren except for a scattering of tiny pale green blossoms, peeks out from behind a mossy pile of boulders.

title: [Emerald Forest, Peat Bog]
description: The bog is more water than land here, the dark pools stained a rich brown with tannins from the forest.  Long strands of moss drape curtainlike from branches stretched out over a pile of logs that form a crude bridge.  An owl hoots from its hidden perch.

title: [Emerald Forest, Peat Bog]
description: A row of willow trees hung with dry moss beards lines the trail, their roots exposed and intertwined.  The green, brackish surface of the marsh is broken by one oily bubble, then another.

title: [Emerald Forest, Peat Bog]
description: This peaty walkway wanders past a labyrinth of roots and waterlogged tunnels.  A wrybill picks its way along the soggy ground, searching for food.  Two willows lean against one another, drooping wearily.

title: [Emerald Forest, Stream]
description: A gentle, rushing roar announces the presence of a waterfall leaping over a ledge of rock on the hillside above your head.  The pool which forms at the bottom is small, but still deep enough to preserve a blue-green radiance.  From his perch atop a hummock of moss, a glistening toad serenades the forest.

title: [Emerald Forest, Stream]
description: Narrowed by rock walls on either side, the stream moves quickly, frothing as it turns a corner.  A berry-laden branch dips low, playing tag with the current.  The air is damp with spray and droplets cling to every leaf and stem.

title: [Emerald Forest, Stream]
description: Glowing like liquid emerald, the stream drifts over smooth algae-covered rocks and deep hollows.  A twig is carried along by the current, spinning and dipping in a mesmerizing dance.  The trail runs right up against the water, allowing a glimpse of the hidden life within.

title: [Emerald Forest, Stream]
description: Mottled with lichens in multiple shades of green, a large flat rock straddles a trickling creek.  An old tree stump refuses to relinquish its ground, though a feathery fern sprouts from its very center.  The trail is soggy here and several strange prints are visible in the soft mud.

title: [Emerald Forest, Bracken]
description: A jumble of pale green bracken thickens to the east, strangling all other vegetation.  Shade is provided by a small stand of silver beech trees, the ground below carpeted by their fallen leaves.  Hidden by the thick foliage, a bird sings out in a series of ascending notes.

title: [Emerald Forest, Junction]
description: Two paths cross, and the forest opens slightly to allow for a small clearing.  Moonlight floods the space, and a few wildflowers have made a stand in the very center.  A firefly bobs and weaves through the perfumed air like a drunken lamplighter.

paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, up

title: [Gorget Trails, Foothills]
description: A scattering of black oak trees provides intermittent shade while bushes and shrubs elbow one another for room in between.  You can see a path leading through the undergrowth and down into the forest.  At the base of a small rockpile is a dark hole in the ground.

title: [Gorget Trails, Foothills]
description: A dense, thorny row of bushes separates the trail from a precipitous drop off to the southwest.  Sprouting bravely from a rocky crevice is a small heliotrope bush, toothmarks puncturing its foliage.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Switchback]
description: The slope here is sufficiently acute to prevent any large trees from prospering, though plenty of low-lying bushes have taken hold.  Overhead, a hawk soars in an updraft, describing effortless circles in the starry sky.

The slope here is sufficiently acute to prevent any large trees from prospering, though plenty of low-lying bushes have taken hold.  Overhead, a hawk soars in an updraft, describing effortless circles in the sky.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Switchback]
description: There is a barely perceptible line of moisture meandering down the stony wall, discoloring the rock where it seeps through.  The trail changes direction, but remains dangerously steep.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Switchback]
description: The trail makes a hairpin turn here, pivoting around a stunted cedar.  A cliff of fractured quartz looms above your head.  Portions of it have already fallen, leaving white tracks through the scrub further down the mountain.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Switchback]
description: Below the footpath, the slope is severely undercut from erosion and appears unstable.  A flowering brittlebush perfumes the night air, though its bulging form crowds the trail uncomfortably.
Below the footpath, the slope is severely undercut from erosion and appears unstable.  A flowering brittlebush perfumes the air, though its bulging form crowds the trail uncomfortably.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Cliff Face]
description: Fine showers of dirt and gravel periodically fall from this crumbling cliff face and pile up in shifting mounds at its base.  With insulting ease a whiptail lizard skitters straight across the rock wall.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Cliff Face]
description: Almost any movement sends dirt and pebbles tumbling down the vertiginous slope, and one section has already been torn away by a recent rockslide.  Digging into the loose gravel, next to a pale green lichen-covered boulder, is a hairy-legged beetle.  A hopefully stable protrusion is visible just below the trail.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Cliff Face]
description: Nothing grows on these broad, bare rocks save a few varieties of lichen.  Even the insects appear to have forsaken this perilous outcropping.  To the northeast is a barely visible footpath twisting further up the mountain.

title: [Masked Hills, Hairline Ridge]
description: The ridge widens out here just enough to accomodate a firepit, as the scattered collection of soot-marked rocks verifies.  A mere whisper of a footpath winds down the slope to the southwest.

title: [Masked Hills, Hairline Ridge]
description: Far above and to the north you see an unusual mountain peak silhouetted against the sky.  It is divided into four nearly equal prongs, each one perilously steep and doused in snow.  This ridge trail curves around toward it and looks like the only navigable path, at least until you sprout wings and learn to fly.

title: [Masked Hills, Hairline Ridge]
description: The wind kicks up a little more, blowing dirt and rocks across your path.  A time-polished rock embedded deep in the trail shows beautiful striations of grey, black, and white, swirled together like clouds in a storm-troubled sky.

title: [Masked Hills, Hairline Ridge]
description: Still heading upwards, the ridge makes a slight turn here as it approaches the peak.  A rock becomes dislodged and begins to fall, bouncing down the precipitous slope with increasing speed.  It tumbles out of sight, until even the sound of its endless descent is lost to your ears.

title: [Masked Hills, Hairline Ridge]
description: A deep depression has been worn into the bare rock of the trail.  Dirt, dried leaves, pebbles, and other detritus have filled it in for the most part.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The perforated floor in this hidden chamber serves to separate the sand from anything else that may have fallen through the trap above.  The light is dim and the air is choked with slowly settling dust.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Crumpled on the floor is a dusty skeleton surrounded by scraps of clothing and rusted fragments of metal.  No weapons, jewelry, or other items of value remain, having been looted long ago.  To the west you notice a series of depressions in the wall.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Although the tunnel is a bit straighter here, it all still looks remarkably similar.  It is difficult to tell how far you've come and how long you've been down here.  Perhaps this is all just some elaborate trap, and not a gateway to vast hordes of treasure.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The stench from years of accumulating bat guano has almost taken on physical form.  The floor is slippery and uneven.  Wider and taller than most of the tunnel, this section probably hosts an enormous bat colony.  The squeaks and squeals you hear overhead reinforce that assumption.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Dark streaks run down the wall like crooked fingers.  A shallow groove has been worn into the center of the floor by years of shuffling feet, and even the dust seems to prefer settling to one side or another.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: A series of shallow markings carved into the cool stone wall invite closer inspection.  The prospect of wandering these tunnels forever is not a pleasant one, to say the least.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: This section would be just like all the others if it were not for a deep chasm running straight across it.  The bottom is cloaked in darkness and looks like it may have been a handy place to dispose of the excess rock created by the carving of these tunnels.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: An astonishingly beautiful relief carving covers the entire eastern wall.  Though stained by leaching minerals and the occasional passing bat, there is no mistaking the passion and skill which brought this artwork into being.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The passageway is partially obstructed by a crumbling pile of rocks, shaken loose by some earthen calamity.  It is still possible to get through, but the damage proves that even in a structure as solid as this, time will take its toll.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: No light reaches the soaring ceiling in this section of the cavern.  High-pitched squeaks and soft rustlings filter down through the chilly air, leaving you to guess at the size of the colony dangling overhead.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Cut through the center of the chamber floor is a steep-sided channel which barely contains a rushing stream.  The swiftly moving water flows to the south, disappearing under the stone wall.  In this hard, enclosed space the roar is nearly deafening.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The unexpected touch of a soft breeze on your face draws your attention to a crack in the granite wall.  As you watch, a bat wings through the narrow opening and flits away down the dark tunnel.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The shadowed ceiling ripples strangely, then squeaks.  A second glance reveals it to be a solid mass of bats, most of them juveniles.  A trio of the winged rodents swoops past you with shrill, piercing cries, defending their nest.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: A large alcove catches your eye, and even in this faint light you can see the harsh yellow of a sulfur deposit standing out against the grey stone.  It looks as though a great deal of mining took place here once, carving out a significant section of the tunnel.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Streaks of yellow sulfur run down the dark grey stone in jagged bands.  A rough hollow remains where someone has been digging into one of the larger deposits.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Still more stone walls surround you, tunnelling endlessly within this mountain of marble and granite.  For all the danger, there seems to be little reward as yet.  The featureless rock offers up no clue, no guidance.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Scores of small holes perforate the stone walls and, although dusty, they do not appear clogged.  Without knowing exactly what might set off one of these ancient traps, all you can do is proceed with great caution.  The tiniest crack in the floor could bring your life to a premature end.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: A skeleton slumps against the far wall, its clothing little more than rotting scraps laid on dry bones.  Small metal arrows are scattered across the floor and imbedded in the wall, each one furry with dust.  Has the trap been neutralized by this unfortunate soul, or will your next step trigger a deadly rain of metal?

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Huge blocks of stone must have been removed from the walls here to create so vast an opening.  Undoubtedly years of work went into this construction, which is now host to nothing but slumbering colonies of bats.  You cannot help but appreciate the defensive value of these dark tunnels and wonder what dangers still remain.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Tiny openings dot the walls here in an irregular and artificial-looking manner.  This could be part of a complex defense system set up to repel intruders.  That, or the neverending darkness has you seeing traps at every turn.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The fresh air whistling into the room from some hidden source makes you realize just how stifling the atmosphere has been in these tomblike caverns.  This might also be how the bats escape at night to hunt.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: It is impossible to avoid the bat guano entirely, as it covers every inch of the floor.  However, the greatest density appears to be in the center of the room, so you do what you can to keep to the edges.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Ingeniously sculpted from the mountain itself, this cavern makes use of a very hard substrate layer to form the ceiling and hold back the countless tons of rock resting over your head.  The designers of this tunnel clearly knew the strengths and weaknesses of rock, and used that knowledge to their advantage.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The dark grey of the carved granite which surrounds you is upstaged by a chalky intrusion.  The pale white substance, perhaps a stranded deposit of limestone, brightens the area considerably.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: It would appear that some sort of carving was begun on the walls here, but never finished.  The rock has been gouged in vague forms, still too crude to decipher.  Chips of stone rest at the base of the wall, undisturbed in the eternal stillness of these tunnels.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Although no bats are visible in this chamber, evidence of their habitation coats the floor.  There must be some way for them to travel in and out of this cave and to a nearby lake, bog, or swamp.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Surely there must be more to this stark tunnel than meets the eye.  Somewhere in the chiseled rock a secret panel or doorway hides, awaiting your clever touch.  In every shadow you see the glint of gold, though when you turn there is nothing but cold, damp stone.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: A fluttering at the edge of your vision draws your eye upward, where it hits upon a swaying canopy of bats clinging to the ceiling as they rest.  It would probably be prudent to let them sleep, rather than risk the disease even a single bite might inflict.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Some unusual markings appear in bas-relief upon the wall.  The lack of light makes them difficult to read, and you must decipher them by touch as well as sight.  Although cryptic, the words may form some kind of clue.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: You cannot help but suspect that there must be something truly magnificent here, so well hidden is it from the outside world.  Many tales are told of secret temples piled with riches, yet deadly to explore.  Could this be such a place?  The stone walls around you are silent and devoid of detail.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Hewn from the living rock, this tunnel seems to be the work of an ancient culture.  Long since deserted by its creators, this mysterious structure now attracts adventurous travelers such as yourself searching after wonders like those described by the old story-tellers.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: A gust of sweet, fresh air stirs the dusty currents and reminds you that there is a world beyond these tomblike tunnels.  A large rock now rests against the north wall, effectively blocking any access to the hidden breach.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Bats swoop down from the ceiling, passing so close you can feel the caress of their leathery wings.  Mindful of their disease-ridden bites, you do what you can to avoid contact.  After a few circuits they return to their roosts up above and settle back into cocooned sleep.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: The rocky walls are hard and utterly bereft of life, unable to nurture even the tiniest scrap of moss or lichen.  Even the air is dead, trapped underground and unwilling to stir.  All you can hear is the sound of your own heart pounding in your ears.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Large roots have forced their way through the ceiling and now trail down the wall, questing for buried water.  Several of the root tips appear slightly gnawed.  Somewhere outside and far above your head is a sturdy tree spreading its leafy branches against a boundless sky.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Calvaria]
description: Several small holes mar the surface of the east wall.  A closer examination reveals a thin metal shaft stuck inside one of them.  The rest could still be quite functional, however, and might be set off at any time.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Kitchen]
description: A carved oak service bar separates the customers from the workspace in this large kitchen.  A small host of cooks and their helpers bustle about their chores in an efficient, if poorly choreographed, ballet.  Open firepits line the far wall, with spacious ovens built into the brick above.  Several large tables in the center of the room are covered with ingredients in the process of being chopped, sliced, diced, and minced in preparation of one dish or another.

title: [Jastev's Crystal Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with eight white starstones in two clusters, one suggesting a scrying crystal and the other the base on which it rests.

title: [Mistress of Adoration Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with nine white starstones that form the leaf, stalk, and petals of a spring flower.

title: [Solhaven, Triton Road]
description: A well-worn path leads into the fenced yard surrounding the local school.  The low stone building sits well back from the street, the schoolyard bustling with children.  A young mother kneels on the path, conversing with her tearful child.
A well-worn path leads into the fenced yard surrounding the local school.  The low stone building sits well back from the street, the schoolyard empty and quiet.

title: [Solhaven, Bayside Road]
description: You can barely hear the roar of the Cairnfang falling into Solhaven Bay from here.  The Bay stretches out before you, sunlight glinting on the deep blue waters.  Dwarves, elves, half-elves, and humans push southward, headed into the city.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: A hole in the canopy of trees above allows a single ray of moonlight to poke through this dark place.  The moon reflecting on the fog gives an eerie glow to the area, in contrast to the surrounding valley.  The fog does not relent from the moonlight, but instead seems to swirl about the ray madly.

A hole in the canopy of trees above allows a single beam of sunlight to poke through this dark place.  The sun reflecting on the fog is almost blinding, in contrast to the surrounding valley.  The fog does not relent from the sunlight, but instead seems to swirl about the beam madly.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Garden]
description: Greenery around a charming manor provides a backdrop for a colorful array of flowers taking shelter under a grove of assorted fruit trees.  Burbling brightly, a multi-tiered riverstone fountain with crystal clear water cascading down its surface is surrounded by three carved benches, and a path of round, grey stones meanders up a small hill to the steps of a gazebo, then down to a stunningly azure pond.  Serving as the ever-moving focal center of the garden, a muster of regal, vibrantly plumed peacocks struts amongst the verdure.

Bathed in soft moonlight, a large riverstone manor is surrounded by verdant greenery and a fragrant array of flowers and fruit trees. Moonbeams bounce off of a burbling stone fountain surrounded by three carved benches, and a path of round, grey stones meanders up a small hill to the gazebo steps, then down to a dark azure pond. Occupying the ever-moving focal center of the garden, a muster of regal peacocks struts amongst the verdure, their colors eye-catching beneath the stars.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: A small freshwater stream approaches the path from the south here.  The stream is small and shallow, but the banks show signs of it swelling tremendously in heavy rain.  Trickling water and the occasional hoot of an owl can be heard here, providing a change to the stark silence of the pine woods.

A small freshwater stream approaches the path from the south here, and many small animals gather near the bank to drink.  The stream is small and shallow, but the banks show signs of it swelling tremendously in heavy rain.  Trickling water and the occasional call of a bird can be heard here, providing a change to the stark silence of the pine woods.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Gazebo]
description: Ivory marble inlaid with splinters of green and gold extends to the high, domed roof, contributing to an uncluttered, open cathedral feel.  Hanging from the rounded roof, a multitude of pots overflow with flowery growth, the tendrils draping down to mingle with morning glory vines twining up the gazebo's supporting colonnade.  Surrounded by verdant life and soft fragrance, several wicker chairs accommodate striking views of the entire garden and the pond below.

title: [Ta'Illistim, BriarStone Court]
description: A mordant odor descends from the smoking chimney of a sturdy little building on the east side of the court.  From the deeply recessed windows, it appears that the walls of the building have been constructed out of a double layer of heavy granite blocks, though for what purpose you cannot imagine.  A tarnished brass sign is set into the iron-banded thanot doors leading into the establishment.

The chimney of a sturdy building on the east side of the court belches a mordant plume of smoke, tinging the air above it an acrid green.  Judging from the deeply recessed windows and the inset door, the silvery blue walls of the building appear to be constructed out of a double layer of heavy granite blocks.  A tarnished brass sign is set into the iron-banded blue thanot doors leading into the establishment.

title: [Ta'Illistim, BriarStone Court]
description: This corner of the court is dominated by a round marble fountain.  A few solitary elves sit on the wide edge of the fountain, occasionally tossing a coin inside and murmuring a wish, as they steal shy glances around them.  The water descends from a tall center column, producing a musical burble that softens the noise of the city's daily traffic.

The water descends from a tall center column, producing a musical burble that obscures the lovers' words.

The cobblestoned court gives way for a circular fountain, whose edges are repurposed into a wide ledge of tiled seating.  Nearby, the marble facades of several shops look on, forming a ring around the open plaza.

description: Deep blue slate clads the nearby shop, a dull contrast to the brighter blue tiles that form the building's sturdy roof.  Windowboxes planted with bright red begonias bring cheer to the stately structure.  A brass plaque is mounted to the shop's front door.

title: [Ta'Illistim, BriarStone Wey]
description: The cobblestone wey passes between identical rows of town homes.  Built of sturdy greystone, they feature tall staircases with cast iron railings leading up to grey-pillared entryways.  On the ground floor, tall windows draped with turquoise and silver curtains reach from floor to ceiling, while the upper stories feature smaller windows, many of which are open to catch the gentle breeze that wanders through the city.

Several leafy green roltons appear to trim the lawn, while a large cat stalks them from the shadows beside the manor house.

description: The privet hedge on the south side of the wey has been trimmed to the height of an elven knee, providing a full view of the white granite mansion behind.  The facade has been designed to resemble a snow-capped mountain peak, and the garden below features exclusively white plants in immitation of a winter landscape.  Above a carpet of baby's breath and white clover stand clusters of white lilies, iris, and gardenias, which dazzle the eye with reflected sunlight.

Three-story town homes, constructed of enormous greystone blocks flashed with mica-flecked granite, stand in a stately row amidst carefully tended formal gardens.

Multistory villas, constructed of enormous silvery blue blocks flashed with mica, stand in a stately row amidst carefully tended formal gardens.  Each is domed and tiled atop. title: [Ta'Illistim, Vaeshean Wey]
description: The deep grey slate roof of the local clerical shop is lined with shallow grooves from years of wind and weather.  Thick beds of acantha intermingled with blaestonberry bushes surround the building, the fragrance of the blossoms permeating the air.  An engraved silver sign is tacked to the blue front door.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Vaeshean Wey]
description: The entrance to the Hall of Patrons is flanked by twin fluted columns carved of pure white marble.  Atop each column, a solemn gargoyle stands sentinel, head bowed in homage to the symbol of servitude carved into the pediment above the entry doors.  Massive stone steps lead into the Hall's outer courtyard.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Vaeshean Wey]
description: This intersection teems with movement, though the atmosphere is quiet--even contemplative.  The bulk of the traffic consists of serious-looking elves in clerical robes who move in a business-like manner between the various professional establishments in the neighborhood and the Hall of Patrons, visible just a short distance to the north.

A few elves in clerical robes wander through the intersection, their weary looks suggesting that they are heading home after a long day's service to their patron.  A few younger elves congregate in small groups, making dinner plans or discussing some finer point of theology.  A light scent of incense wafts down the wey from the Hall of Patrons, visible just a short distance to the north.

Stone slabs and bronze sculptures wall in the wey, their faces the memorials to elven families lost to time.  Nearly all have at least one crest and most are marked as well with the seal of Ta'Illistim.  One white marble obelisk is set apart, piercing the sky from atop a raised pedestal of purple porphyry.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Kaerinar Wey]
description: Several young elves move through the crowd, hawking the flowers they carry in large, woven baskets.  Others sit in small groups at the side of the way, playing soft tunes on tambor and flute and swaying in time with the music.  Many of the passersby glance over with suspicion or distaste as they hurry on their way.

The wey is all but deserted at night.  A few wilting flower petals lie scattered on the ground, their perfume mingling with a faint hint of incense in the cool night air.  Overhead, the stars bathe the quiet city in a pale silver light and the moons look down with solemn indifference.

The wey is lined with memorials, tall and short, stone and marble and bronze.  Each is marked with a different crest, some worn almost to the point of illegibility.  They crowd up against the cobblestones, forming walls of history and memory.  Amongst the commemorations, lit candles are scattered.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Kaerinar Wey]
description: A low, long stone building sits nestled amongst a grove of flowering trees.  Above the entrance, a relief depicting a healer ministering to the wounded is carved into the mica-flecked grey granite.  Neatly planted rows of herbs line the cobbled walk leading to the front door.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Kaerinar Wey]

title: [Wehnimer's, North Ring Rd.]

title: [Wehnimer's, Taarna Rd.]

title: [Wehnimer's, Stormarm St.]
description: This street cuts a wide path north and south between the north wall and the center of the Landing.  Low, grey stone buildings and nondescript sheds loom to the south and east, and towards the central square the view is more pleasant and varied.

title: [Wehnimer's, Stormarm St.]

title: [Wehnimer's, Stormarm St.]

title: [Wehnimer's, Lyon Way]

title: [Wehnimer's, Shanty Town]
description: Time and tide have not been kind to the dilapidated shacks along this dreary stretch of riverfront beach.  The rotted and weatherbeaten planks, the patched roofs and the mud lanes cast a melancholy pall of neglect here, in contrast to the lively sounds of the river, drifting over from the dark shore that lies directly to the east.  To the north, occasional sounds of sawing and banging emanate from the boatyard.

title: [Wehnimer's, Boatyard]
description: This promontory, formed of rocks and sand partially covered by weathered wooden docks, extends a short distance into the river.  A few workmen hustle to complete their nighttime tasks, repairing and refurbishing the sailing vessels that are moored here.  A refurbished frigate lies at anchor just offshore, awaiting a new cargo as well as a new lease on life.  The sand-covered riverbank beach stretches to the south.

Workmen hustle from task to task, repairing and refurbishing the sailing vessels that are moored here.  One crew mans a dinghy moving to and from a refurbished frigate which lies at anchor just offshore, awaiting a new cargo as well as a new lease on life.  The sand-covered riverbank beach stretches to the south.

title: [Wehnimer's, Shanty Town]
description: No bright lamps light the unpaved road here, and the layer of mud that passes for streets in Shanty Town is treacherous and slippery with seepage from the nearby river.  A few sorry shacks stand cluttered together in this southeast corner, their doors and windows dark with tattered and drawn curtains, holding untold tales of suffering or malice.
