title: [Wehnimer's, Shanty Town]
description: The tracks of wagon wheels rut the path through here, forming tiny rivulets that connect the puddles.  A few sparse bushes and a tiny garden outside one of the shanties do little to relieve the monotony of the otherwise indistinguishable dwellings to the north and east.  The western path leads back to town.

title: [Wehnimer's, Boatyard]
description: Half-completed shipping vessels, sections of wooden supports, canvas, and vessels in need of repair are strewn along this strand of riverfront beach, separated from the town proper by the wooden boatyard fence.  The hulking framework of a ship under construction rises against the starlit sky like a giant skeleton belonging to some forgotten sea creature.

Half-completed shipping vessels, sections of wooden supports, canvas, and vessels in need of repair are strewn along this strand of riverfront beach, separated from the town proper by the wooden boatyard fence.  The hulking framework of a ship under construction rises above the sand like a giant skeleton belonging to some forgotten sea creature.

title: [Wehnimer's, Beolost Rd.]
description: Townswomen and loiterers cluster around a local well, which is constructed of stone with a slate overhang that provides a spot for rest and conversation.  The oft-swept, cobbled square also contains the baker's shop and its adjoining tea room, and several other small merchants.

Townswomen and loiterers cluster around a local well, which is constructed of stone with a slate overhang that provides a spot of shade and rest.  The oft-swept, cobbled square also contains the baker's shop and its adjoining tea room, and several other small merchants.

title: [Town Square, Garden Niche]
description: This small niche between two buildings has been neatly landscaped into a tiny moonlit garden, its careful mosaic of flagstones interspersed with patches of trimmed grass.  A low stone bench rests along one vine-covered wall, and a patch of colorful violets surrounds a painted wooden barrel in one corner.

This small niche between two buildings has been neatly landscaped into a tiny garden, its careful mosaic of flagstones interspersed with patches of trimmed grass.  A low stone bench rests along one vine-covered wall, and a patch of colorful violets surrounds a painted wooden barrel in one corner.

title: [Wehnimer's, Stormarm St.]
description: The simple yet well built wooden structures in this small residential section of town are more functional than decorative, and little separates the style of one from another.  A few scraggly trees, planted long ago in patches of dirt between the buildings, add spots of deeper shadow to the cobblestones.

The simple yet well built wooden structures in this small residential section of town are more functional than decorative, and little separates the style of one from another.  A few scraggly trees, planted long ago in patches of dirt between the buildings, add spots of shade to the cobblestones.

title: [Wehnimer's, Stormarm St.]
description: Along this neighborhood byway, wagons loaded with sacks of grain, kegs of beer, and firewood stand at the wide door of a local warehouse.  Merchants, tradesmen and other night workers of the surrounding streets busily load and unload stored supplies here.

Along this neighborhood byway, wagons loaded with sacks of grain, kegs of beer, and firewood stand at the wide door of a local warehouse.  Merchants, innkeepers and tradesmen of the surrounding streets busily load and unload stored supplies here.

title: [Wehnimer's, Taarna Rd.]
description: A small house is set back from the curve in the road, in the midst of a carefully tended garden of strange plants.  A twisting path leading to the door is lined with carved wooden pots in which grow many species of pungent herbs.  Two modwir saplings entwine over the door, forming a leafy arch.

title: [Wehnimer's, Taarna Rd.]
description: What traffic flows here at night mostly heads north towards the palisade along the bay and east to the riverfront.  A decrepit single-story pawnshop, its paint peeling and dimly lit window panes broken, stands here alongside the shadowy lane.

Traffic flows past briskly, headed north towards the palisade along the bay, south to the market and shops of the Landing, and east to the riverfront.  A decrepit single-story pawnshop, its paint peeling and window panes broken, stands here alongside the busy lane.

title: [Wehnimer's, Lanthar Rd.]
description: Lanthar Road leads east and west here, serving as a passage between the local inns and warehouses bordering the riverfront district and the center of Wehnimer's Landing.  A stray jarlik sniffs at a patch of grass growing between cracks in the cobbled pavement to one side of the road.

title: [Wehnimer's, Cul-de-Sac]
description: Broken bottles, discarded rubbish, and uneasy feelings pervade this dank, ill-lit dead end.  Several unsavory-looking citizens seem to be lurking here and there in the shadows for want of anything better to do, and the scratching of rats can be heard from within the nearby walls.  A pile of old crates is stacked against the back wall of the alley.

title: [Herbalist's, Dispensary]
description: Redolent with a sweet, almost cinnamony fragrance, the herbalist's shop is dominated by a glass counter.  It contains small pouches of bark, leaves, berries and stems.  Syiah Kintaru, master herbalist, stands behind it, grinding herbs with a porcelain mortar and pestle.

title: [Wehnimer's, Bridge]
description: The heavy wood-planked bridge is old, but stands steady against the deep, dark river waters on massive stone pilings below.  Rope railings attached to weathered wooden posts are the only guard against a cold plunge in the Locksmehr, but the span is wide enough to bear the traffic without mishap.  The shadowy profiles of wooden buildings dot the east bank, and to the west lies the more heavily populated main part of town.

The heavy wood-planked bridge is old, but stands steady against the deep river waters on massive stone pilings below.  Rope railings attached to weathered wooden posts are the only guard against a cold plunge in the Locksmehr, but the span is wide enough to bear the traffic without mishap.  The low profiles of wooden buildings dot the east bank, and to the west lies the more heavily populated main part of town.

title: [Wehnimer's, East Crossing]
description: A wide bridge spans the dark waters of the Locksmehr River to the west, groaning beneath the wheels of the occasional passing wagon or oxcart.  The shouts of drivers to move aside and the clicking noises they make to urge their weary animals along echo through the damp night air.  A gravel footpath leads north, and the outlines of a few buildings loom farther to the east.

A wide bridge spans the Locksmehr River to the west, groaning beneath the wheels of overloaded oxcarts and pedestrian traffic.  The shouts of drivers to move aside and the clicking noises they make to urge their weary animals along echo through the damp coastal air.  A gravel footpath leads north, and the outlines of a few buildings loom farther to the east.

title: [Wehnimer's, River Ramble]
description: The path bends slightly here to follow the natural flow of the river.  To the west, the sounds of wheels clamoring on the cobblestones indicate that a main thoroughfare is near.  An old warehouse, seemingly abandoned yet somehow sinister-looking, casts a shadow over the dirt-paved road.

The path bends slightly here to follow the natural flow of the river.  To the west, a flurry of dust and clamor indicate that a main thoroughfare is near.  An old warehouse, seemingly abandoned yet somehow sinister-looking, casts a shadow over the dirt-paved road.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Wehnimer's, River Ramble]
description: The unpaved path that passes for a road here runs between the riverbank and the backs of several old buildings.  The slick, rocky surface makes for uneven footing, forcing wayfarers to keep close to the supporting walls of the wooden structures to avoid a slip down the bank into the dark river waters.

The unpaved path that passes for a road here runs between the riverbank and the backs of several old buildings.  The slick, rocky surface makes for uneven footing, forcing wayfarers to keep close to the supporting walls of the wooden structures to avoid a slip down the muddy riverbank.

title: [Wehnimer's, River Ramble]
description: Several wooden planks form shaky makeshift bridges over gaps in the path where it has collapsed into the swirling river currents.  A sturdy length of timber shores up the rear wall of the building to the east, staving off its imminent slide down the riverbank along with the remaining sections of the crumbling walkway.

title: [Wehnimer's, Ilstar Lane]
description: This alley spans the short distance between the eastern wall and the riverbank.  The blank back walls of the alchemist's house and the cooper's shop provide an unremarkable view.  Wharf rats scurry among at the debris in the lane, scampering into the shadows only when it becomes clear to them that their tails are in imminent danger of being trampled.

This alley spans the short distance between the eastern wall and the riverbank.  The blank back walls of the alchemist's house and the cooper's shop provide an unremarkable view.  Several gulls peck at the debris in the lane, taking flight only when it becomes clear to them that their tailfeathers are in imminent danger of being trampled.

title: [Wehnimer's, East Ring Rd.]
description: There are few buildings in this far corner of the Landing, and the eastern wall of the palisade that separates the streets from the wilderness beyond is so near that it casts a shadow over nearly the entire road.  Clinging precariously to the wide north wall of the sprawling brewery is the more diminutive square form of the cooper's shop.

title: [Wehnimer's, Vesitsa Place]
description: From here, the greying base of the northeastern river guardtower dominates the landscape.  The massive structure overshadows the plain house by the side of the path, as it looks out, brooding and purposeful, over the town's river gates and the bay to the north.  A handpainted sign hangs in front of the smaller dwelling.

title: [Wehnimer's, East Ring Rd.]
description: The broad, red brick bulk of a local brewery dominates the street.  A few night workers clad in drab smocks and leather aprons loiter around the structure, taking a break for a pipe and a mug of ale.  The old oaken sign that hangs above the brewery gate squeaks back and forth on iron hinges in the night wind that blows in from the waters to the north and west.

The broad, red brick bulk of a local brewery dominates the street, and all activity on this block seems to center around it.  Workers clad in drab smocks and leather aprons wander in and out of the structure, and grim-faced militiamen brush past them.  The old oaken sign that hangs above the brewery gate squeaks back and forth on iron hinges in the wind that blows in from the waters to the north and west.

title: [Wehnimer's, East Ring Rd.]
description: East Ring Road rejoins the Landing's palisades here and continues on inside it to its northernmost conclusion.  An occasional wagon laden with goods passes by, its metal-rimmed wheels echoing in the night as they strike rough spots in the pavement.  The merest hint of the scent of flowers and fragrant herbs drifts over from the south.

East Ring Road rejoins the Landing's palisades here and continues on inside it to its northernmost conclusion.  Wagons laden with empty barrels, heavy kegs, cords of firewood and sacks ply the road, creating a loud din as their metal-rimmed wheels strike rough spots in the pavement.  The merest hint of the scent of flowers and fragrant herbs drifts over from the south.

title: [East Row, Courtyard]
description: Built up against the south wall of the brewery compound is a nondescript warehouse.  The courtyard has spotty, neatly trimmed grass, though a fairly straight patch of dirt bisects the area to the north and south.

title: [East Row, Ebonwood Way]
description: Passing beyond a tall brick brewery to the northwest, a row of scraggly new ebonwood trees line the pathway heading east, while a broad fel tree marks the road to the north.

Passing beyond a tall brick brewery to the northwest, a heavy shadow casts the area in a neutral light.  A row of scraggly new ebonwood trees line the pathway heading east, while a broad fel tree marks the road to the north.

title: [East Row, Fel Road]
description: A squat fel tree stands at the southwest corner of the intersection.  Twin rows of small white stones mark the passage east.

title: [East Row, Modwir Way]
description: A pair of modwirs stand sentinel for the roadway heading east.  A cooing morning dove lends a rhythmic pace to the surroundings, causing merchant and townsfolk alike to walk slowly along the dusty paths in measured time.

wayto.24768: ;e query = "ivy-covered grey stone building with a sturdy cross-gabled roof";shop = GameObj.loot.find { |i| i.name.eql?(query) };shop or fail "could not locate: #{query}";fput "go ##{shop.id}"

title: [East Row, Monir Road]
description: A pair of monir line the road, one to the west and the other to the southeast.  Some holly bushes are visible to the north, though they seem scraggly even from here.  The way east is wide and paved with cobblestones, a drastic improvement in comparison to the other roads of the area.

title: [East Row, Holly Road]
description: A massive monir tree to the southwest blocks any major construction of large shops, though some smaller ones managed to squeeze in.  The intersection is haphazardly lined with holly bushes, whose rich green leaves lack fruit and flower adornment.

title: [East Row, Spinewood Way]
description: Despite the road's namesake, there isn't a single growth of spinewood to be seen.  Instead, the roadway is lined by hulking monir barrels filled with miniature stylized spinewood trees, complete with artificial pale pink flowers.

title: [East Row, Tanik Road]
description: Newly planted tanik trees line the row, while a thick stand of pines grow to the north.  The road is part rubble and dirt here, stretching eastward toward the town's protective wall.

title: [East Row, Pine Point]
description: The backside of cottages on the rocky cliffs of Bay's Watch neighborhood is barely visible beyond the dense stand of aged pine trees to the north.  There are mere clumps of grass to the side of the dirt and rock-strewn road.

title: [East Row, Pine Point]
description: The road dips down here, following the natural curvature of the land.  As a result, the pines growing in the area are tilted somewhat askew.

title: [East Row, Pine Point]
description: Beyond the shops to the south, newly planted tanik trees mingle with a well-established growth of old pines.  The rocky roadway goes on, though to the west, it dips down slightly.

title: [East Row, Pine Point]
description: The aged pines to the north do little to inhibit the sea's salty breeze from wafting over the area.  The ground here is rough and the roadway is littered with broken bits of red and blue-grey rock.

title: [East Row, Pine Point]
description: The lazy sound of a distant bay echos against the backdrop of the simple plank shops lining the southern side of the road.

title: [East Row, Tanik Road]
description: A few tanik trees are set far off the beaten path of the roadway, conveniently planted to allow for growth of new buildings.  Unlike most portions of East Row, this part is not covered by shade of trees.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [East Row, Tanik Road]
description: Dwarfed in comparison to their adult form, the new growth of tanik trees sport long, droopy branches.  Covered in needles, the tanik branches arc upward just barely missing the rooftops of the nearby shops.

title: [East Row, Tanik Road]
description: Some of the tanik in this area are decorated with small ornaments and colorful strings of yarn.  A few of the shops in the area are similarily adorned, giving the area a fancifully themed appearance.

title: [East Row, Tanik Road]
description: A single, large tanik grows diagonally, leaning precariously against the log fortification wall.  The droopy branches begin about a third of the way up the tree's length, with the ends jutting upward to narrowly avoid the heads of tall passersby.

title: [East Row, Spinewood Way]
description: The ceramic planters lining the roadway are stark white, though the stylized spinewood trees within them are painted in a vivid chromatic rendition of the typical sort.  The southern portion of the intersection is cobbled with plain stones, contrasting greatly from the roadway to the east and west.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [East Row, Spinewood Way]
description: A profusion of decorative grasses fills the area between the shops, while to the south, a line of monir trees is visible beyond the rooftops.  Lining the way east and west, fake carved spinewood trees sprout out with stylized vigor from yellow ceramic pots.

title: [East Row, Spinewood Way]
description: Garish orange planters of ceramic line the dirty roadway, each one spaced evenly from the next.  Each pot houses a single fake spinewood tree, carved of some shoddy wood, then painted accordingly.  The shops of the area are painted in similar hues of orange, yellow and green.

title: [East Row, Spinewood Way]
description: Unlike the other roads of East Row, this one does not end in a profusion of foliage or plantlife.  Spinewood Way ends at the town's fortification walls, which are composed of log and post construction.  No attempt is made to beautify the area, save for the neatly trimmed lawns near each shop.

title: [East Row, Holly Road]
description: The profusion of holly hedges to the east and west come to an abrupt halt, held at bay by four gaudy, miniature spinewood tree replicas in ceramic pots.  Uncharacteristically, the intersection is paved in cobblestones, creating a courtyard effect out of the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [East Row, Holly Road]
description: Twin rows of holly bushes define the dusty roadway, which is barely wide enough to clear a pair of wagons.  Coming and going from local shops, children and their mothers dart between the shrubbery, one clearly in the tow of the other.

title: [East Row, Holly Road]
description: Indicating a portion of the area less frequenty traveled, spotty grass dots the roadway.  A pair of crooked pine trees bow over the area, creating a natural canopy overhead, while newly-trimmed holly bushes and whitewashed shops invite visitors off the beaten path.

title: [East Row, Holly Road]
description: As if trying to hide the log fortifications to the east, a thick patch of mature holly bushes grow unattended in wild and splaying directions.  Their scraggly branches reach the ground and almost over the wall, clearly accomplishing the intended purpose.

title: [East Row, Monir Road]
description: Some new monir trees create a semicircular courtyard out of the area, while some holly trees to the north and a massive modwir to the south make completing the round difficult.  The cobblestones here are neatly swept, their placement and positioning systematic and maintained.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [East Row, Monir Road]
description: A trio of stunted monir trees grow here, one to the south and two to the north.  The road to the east and west is paved with simple brown cobblestones, and not a one is missing.  The way is easy and clean, indicating recent renovations of the area.

title: [East Row, Monir Road]
description: A massive monir tree makes a roundabout of the roadway, slicing the avenue of perfectly placed paving stones in two.  Small clumps of grass grow about the hulking tree trunk, but just like everything else on this road, the grass is neatly trimmed.

title: [East Row, Monir Road]
description: The massive, hulking posts of the fortifications to the east are reinforced with large stakes of monir, as if the wall here was once a weak point.  To the west, a variety smaller monir trees line the roadway, their boughs braced upon one another in a natural, arching motion.

title: [East Row, Modwir Way]
description: A single large modwir stands in the center of the intersection, forcing the traffic into a bowed diversion.  High above, the tree's clumpy branches are dotted with moderately sized cones, though a few are also scattered across the roadway below.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [East Row, Modwir Way]
description: The almost fuzzy look of the modwir's foliage above casts bland and diffuse shadows on the ground.  Far from impressive, a twin row of plain cobblestones lines the road heading toward the fortifcations to the east.

title: [East Row, Modwir Way]
description: High above, the clumpy foliage of scarcely planted modwirs only partially blots out view of the sky.  Heading east and west, the roadway is marked by a curb of plain cobblestone.

title: [East Row, Modwir Way]
description: Built almost up to the trunk of a tall modwir, a post and log fortification wall separates the town from the dull hum of the wilds to the east.  Occasionally, the sound of a lone coyote's yipping can be heard beyond.

title: [East Row, Fel Road]
description: The southern portion of the intersection is lined with ebonwood trees, while the northern half is dotted with modwir.  To the east and west, hulking fel trees create a hefty canopy overhead.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [East Row, Fel Road]
description: Fel trees are planted widely apart, though their massive tops overlap to create natural cover from above.  Small white stones mark the edge of the road, distinguishing the dirt of the walkway from the entryway to the shops scattered throughout

title: [East Row, Fel Road]
description: Squat fel trees are disbursed evenly throughout the area, planted deliberately to the sides of the white stone-lined roadway.  Far to the east, the growth of trees becomes more densely packed.

title: [East Row, Fel Road]
description: Entering from the west, small white stones lining the road end in a small semicircle before the large trees to the east.  A trio of massive fel trees dwarf the fortification wall, their heavy boughs draping over its top.

title: [East Row, Ebonwood Way]
description: Dwarfed by fel trees to the north, small and scraggly ebonwood trees stand guard at each corner of the intersection.  The wide pathway cuts directly through the melee of shops, ending far to the east at the town's fortified walls.

title: [East Row, Ebonwood Way]
description: Creating a natural end to the roadway, young ebonwood trees are packed more densely here.  Visible beyond the new growth to the east, the town's wooden fortifications loom overhead.

title: [East Row, Ebonwood Way]
description: Twin rows of ebonwood trees continue east and west, evenly spaced to accommodate for growth of new storefronts.  The dusty road is wide enough to allow passage for a wagon, though no deep ruts are present.

title: [Wehnimer's, Garden]
description: A small, well-tended garden surrounds a little shack here.  Clipped traesharm berry bushes serve as a low fence, enclosing the herbs and flowers of the plot.  A garden bower, made of modwir twigs twisted together and covered with flowering vines, shelters a bench of finely polished onyx.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [Wehnimer's, Garden Close]
description: A winding path leads to a small house with a pleasant garden.  The sheltering curve of the town wall and the gently invigorating breeze off the river make this a restful spot to linger.

title: [House Aspis, Outside the Gate]
description: At the end of the quiet lane you come upon a high stone wall.  Set into the midst of the wall is an elaborate wrought-iron gate.  Next to the gate, a polished silver plaque is inset into the stonework.

At the end of the quiet lane you come upon a high stone wall.  Set into the midst of the wall is an elaborate wrought iron gate.  Next to the gate, a polished silver plaque is inset into the stonework.

title: [Wehnimer's, Garden]
description: This small, shady end of the garden forms a little moonlit glade tucked up against the curve of the palisade as it cradles the Landing at the southeast corner.  Night-blooming flowers and shrubs surround a quiet patch of cool grass, a few steps away from the hustle and bustle of town.

This small, shady end of the garden forms a little glade tucked up against the curve of the palisade as it cradles the Landing at the southeast corner.  Bright flowers and shrubs surround a quiet patch of cool grass, a few steps away from the hustle and bustle of town.

title: [Wehnimer's, Garden Copse]
description: The bushes and shrubs grow a bit wilder here, in the shadow of the town wall.  A thick clump of trees of moderate height seem to huddle together as if concealing something.  A narrow footpath through them leads south.

The bushes and shrubs grow a bit wilder here, in the shadow of the town wall.  A thick clump of trees of moderate height seem to huddle together as if concealing something.  A mithril gate leads south.

title: [Wehnimer's, Bay's Watch East]
description: This remote northeast end of Wehnimer's Landing, swept by the fresh breeze from the bay, seems far removed from the commerce and activity of the town to the west.  A few guards and militiamen patrol here, the intense look on their faces as the watches come and go bespeaking of the importance of the round-the-clock vigil they keep.

title: [Empath Guild, Entrance]
description: Deep gravel crunches loudly underfoot.  A tall, well-constructed wall of yellow brick bends away to the east and west as if enclosing an area the size of a small house.  In the center the wall is interrupted by a pair of open gates flanked by wall mounted torches.  Ivy clambers out of two large red clay pots and up the gates, holding fast to them and preventing them from closing.  A silver plaque is mounted on the wall.

title: [Cooper's Shop, Front Room]
description: This busy cooper's shop does a thriving business in barrels and casks, selling most to the brewery next door.  The sound of scraping and planing comes from the southeast.  You see the cooper and several apprentices intently inspecting staves of oak and modwir wood for the next batch of barrels.

title: [Cooper's Shop, Workshop]
description: The crunch of wood shavings underfoot and the tangy scent of newly cut lumber indicate barrels are fitted and joined in this open workshop.  Mallets, chisels and hammers are neatly arranged in a tool chest on the floor.  Kegs in various states of completion surround you.

title: [Landing Hall, Courtyard]
description: A large domed structure of solid granite rests in the middle of a grass clearing, seemingly out of place from the bustling streets outside.  The dome of gold rises grandly from the roof of the building, providing a shining beacon in the moonlight.  Brilliant stained glass is set along the bottom circumference of the dome, adding a touch of color to the gold.  A narrow cobblestone path leads to the massive oak doors that provide entry into the building.

A large domed structure of solid granite rests in the middle of a grass clearing, seemingly out of place from the bustling streets outside.  The dome of gold rises grandly from the roof of the building, providing a shining beacon in the sunlight.  Brilliant stained glass is set along the bottom circumference of the dome, adding a touch of color to the gold.  A narrow cobblestone path leads to the massive oak doors that provide entry into the building.

title: [Krythussa's Confectionary Shop]
description: A barrage of sweet-smelling chocolate, candy, and other goodies assaults the senses as their scents fill the air of the quaint but simple confectionary.  Crystal shelves stacked with glass jars in a variety of shapes and colors line the walls.  The pale light of the moon, accompanied by several multicolored handblown globed lanterns, creates a dazzling array of colors across the floor.  A glass counter stands to the left of a small alcove.

A barrage of sweet-smelling chocolate, candy, and other goodies assaults the senses as their scents fill the air of the quaint but simple candy shop.  Crystal shelves stacked with glass jars in a variety of shapes and colors line the walls.  Sunlight streams through the windows, and creates a rainbow of colors upon the floor as it strikes the glass jars.  A glass counter stands to the left of a small alcove.

title: [Moot Hall, Great Lobby]
description: This is the great lobby of the Moot Hall.  Hushed voices discussing urgent town matters echo off the high ceiling.  The walls are draped in rich tapestries framing niches that hold marble busts of local dignitaries.  Ahead of you is a double door, and to your left, a mahogany door bearing a silver plaque.

The great lobby is quite spacious, with an oak bannister wrapping around a staircase leading to the second story of Moot Hall.  The wall are draped in rich tapestries framing niches that hold marble busts of local dignitaries.  To the north is a double door, and to the west, a mahogany door bearing a silver plaque.  A carpeted pathway leads toward the Debt Collector's Office.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, out

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Facility]
description: You are in the anteroom of the public storage locker facility.  This area is busy with clerks going over paperwork.  A hallway leads east to the locker booths.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which travels east and west.  On the north wall is a curtained opening.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which travels east and west.  On the north wall is a curtained opening.
You are in a darkly lit hallway which travels east-west.  To the east you can see an intersection leading to more lockers, and a curtained opening on the north wall.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which intersects another running north-south.  The east wall of the hallway contains a curtained opening, as do most of the walls along the corridor.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which runs north-south.  On the east wall is a curtained opening, and to the north you can see what looks like an intersection leading out of the storage area.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which ends here at a curtained opening along its east wall.  To the north you can see what looks like an intersection leading out of the storage area.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which ends here at the north wall.  On the east wall is a curtained opening and to the south you can see what looks like an intersection leading out of the storage area.

title: [Moot Hall, Landing]
description: You are on the landing of the second story of the Moot Hall.  The dust on the bannister and the cobwebs in the corner of the room indicate this part of the building does not see many visitors, in spite of what the sign on the varnished modwir door here says.

Sunlight filters in through several windows throughout the landing of the second story of Moot Hall.  The bannisters are a polished oak that run the length of the upstairs, and sweep down the staircase leading to the lobby.  A sign is displayed on a varnished modwir door.

Moonlight filters in through several windows throughout the landing of the second story of Moot Hall.  The bannisters are a polished oak that run the length of the upstairs, and sweep down the staircase leading to the lobby.  A sign is displayed on a varnished modwir door.

Sunlight filters in through several windows throughout the landing of the second story of Moot Hall.  The bannisters are a polished oak that run the length of the upstairs, and sweep down the staircase leading to the lobby.  A sign is displayed on a varnished modwir door with a large vertebral bone-framed blackboard hanging next to it.

title: [Moot Hall, Upstairs Corridor]
description: This part of the upstairs corridor is fairly busy.  Several benches line the walls alongside the sturdy oak door at the far end.  Citizens of various ranks and classes mill about, grasping scrolls and bundles of documents in their hands and talking in serious whispers.
Several benches line the walls alongside the sturdy oak door at the far end of the corridor.  Several paintings are hung depicting various landmarks around Wehnimer's Landing.

title: [Moot Hall, Upstairs Corridor]
description: This end of the hallway is quieter, its hardwood floor muffled by a large burgundy-colored rug.  Potted plants, well-watered but looking a bit starved for sun in their dark corners, stand on two elaborate brass tables on either side of a richly carved mahogany door at the end of the hall.

The end of the hallway is enclosed by large burgundy rugs.  Potted plants are displayed on brass stands resting between a polished maoral door and a richly carved mahogany door.  The dark corridor doesn't offer much in terms of natural lighting.

title: [Citizenship Office]
description: Soft chimes emanate from a delicate crystal chandelier that hangs overhead.  As the chandelier rotates slowly on its axis, the crystal prisms refract the light from the candles' flames and lengthen the shadows over the walls and floor.  Twin filing cabinets, roughly the height of a halfling, occupy opposite corners of the office.  Swaying gently above and behind the intricately carved desk hangs a royal-blue silken banner with the words, "Welcome One And All," embroidered in gold thread.

title: [First Elanith Bank, Lobby]
description: An ancient gnoll keeps a watchful, though nervous, eye over the people visiting Wehnimer's Landing's main bank, the First Elanith Secure Stronghold.  Large, dirty windows allow little air to disturb the layers of dust on the threadbare carpet.  The few flickering candles around the room add virtually no light.  A broken gate from a teller's window sits in the corner.

title: [First Elanith Bank, Teller]
description: Most of the teller windows that line this room are missing the gates and gratings that once secured them.  Impatient clients stand at one of the two intact windows, waiting to get the attention of the tellers on the other side.

title: [Aznell's Armory, Forge]
description: Bits and pieces of armor adorn the walls, leather on one, and metal on the facing wall.  Scraps of leather and metal are littered across the floor, thickest near the iron anvil where apprentices are working on a misshapen lump of metal.  The heat and the closeness of the forge press in around you.

title: [Tykel's Arms, Showroom]
description: Glancing about the interior of the shop reveals all manner of bladed weapons, from daggers to twohanded swords.  Most of the weaponry is wrought in bronze, although finer specimens reflect the glint of steel.  All seem to share an air about them that says, "This weapon is meant to be used".  Tykel the Weaponsmith stands ready to sing the praises of his handiwork.

title: [Tykel's Arms, Backroom]
description: This is the quiet backroom of the weaponsmith's shop.  Here are stored prized pieces of exquisite armor and weapons, most either ancient heirlooms or crafted by famous armorers from throughout the land.

title: [Catacombs, Musty Basement]
description: Large crates, rusted tools, and broken weapons of every description fill most of the space in this dank cellar.  Cobwebs hang from the raftered ceiling, apparently undisturbed for ages.  On the far wall, you notice a rectangular depression.

title: [Dakris's Furs, Front Room]
description: This is the large front room of the furrier's shop.  Roughly hewn planks, supported by wooden barrels, span the space and serve as a counter.  Behind it presides Dakris the Furrier, purveyor of rare furs and hides.  A few simple chairs are randomly scattered along the dirt floor.  Across the room, to the southeast, you see a doorway covered only by a draped velnalin hide.

This is the large front room of the furrier's shop.  Roughly hewn planks, supported by wooden barrels, span the space and serve as a counter.  A few simple chairs are randomly scattered along the dirt floor.  Across the room, to the southeast, you see a doorway covered only by a draped velnalin hide.

title: [Dakris's Furs, Rugs and Bedding]
description: Several varieties of animal skin rugs compete for floor space with piles of hides, mats and pillows.  The overall effect gives the room a rugged, yet cozy, feel.  With floor space so limited, some of the finer rugs have been mounted on the walls for ease of display and to add room for more samples.

title: [Dakris's Furs, Showroom]
description: The hides and heads of various violent beasts have been stuffed, preserved then mounted on the unfinished walls of the showroom.  Sawdust has covered the counter and accumulated in small piles on the floor about its edges.  The faint smell of preserving chemicals leaves a rather unpleasant aroma in the air.

title: [Kilron's Pawnshop, Front Room]
description: This little pawnshop is somewhat cheerier than you would expect, presided over by its well-dressed and well-heeled owner, Kilron.  A polished white marble counter is set off by freshly whitewashed walls and a highly varnished wood floor.  An antique cabinet on the far wall holds several impressive and equally ancient weapons, some precious trinkets, and several items that you cannot identify, except that they seem to glow in different shades of colored light with different intensities.

title: [Pawn Shop, Backroom]
description: This backroom is where many of the items pawned are offered for resale.  On one wall a prominent sign reads, "Warning:  All items that are sold here are used merchandise and sold on an "as-is" basis with no guarantees and no refunds. -- Kilron".  A sales clerk stands nearby, ready to offer help with any purchases.

title: [Hearthstone, Courtyard]
description: Before you stands a grand old manor, framed by huge willows to the east and west.  The elegant trees sway gently in the moonlight, dappling the cobblestone courtyard with ever-shifting patterns of light and dark.  Snippets of conversation drift away from the long porch stretching along the full width of the great old house, as several guests enjoy the hospitality and ambience of this fine hideaway.

Before you stands a grand old manor, framed by huge willows to the east and west.  The elegant trees sway gently, dappling the cobblestone courtyard with ever-shifting patterns of light and dark.  Snippets of conversation drift away from the long porch stretching along the full width of the great old house, as several guests enjoy the hospitality and ambience of this fine hideaway.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You can hear the noisy bustle around the land gates to the west.  Over the din, you can just barely hear the sound of the surf from the northeast.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: The jagged shoreline of the bay becomes more evident here along the path as the cool waters of the Bay rush up almost to your feet.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: Recreational fishermen have beached their vessels on this sandy stretch of beach.  To the south, you can see the wooden palisade that surrounds the Landing.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: The shore extends into a small, sandy promontory that juts into Darkstone Bay.  The Landing's great river gate lies southeast of here, guarded on either side by tall twin towers.  To the west, this path continues on between Wehnimer's wooden palisade and the sandy beaches along the bay.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You can no longer see the land gates of Wehnimer's from this dirt path, although you can still hear the din of the town on the other side of the wooden palisades.  To the west and southwest lies the untamed land that surrounds Wehnimer's Landing.  To the west, the large wooden fence in front of the Wehnimer's Jousting Arena fills your view.

title: [Wehnimer's Exterior]
description: Tall oaks and modwir pines have grown up along the outer edge of the western palisade surrounding Wehnimer's Landing.  To the north you hear the sound of horses stamping impatiently against the wooden walls of their stables as they await their turn in the Jousting Arena.  The wind whispers softly through the trees, bringing you a sense of peace as you wander.  A shady path leads off to the southwest, sheltered by a thick stand of modwirs.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You have reached the intersection of a small path, which heads off to the south and the Merchant's Road, which follows the coast as it winds northwest and ends at the entrance to Wehnimer's Landing to the east.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You are on the merchant road that leads to and from Wehnimer's Landing.  The path continues there to the southeast.  The merchant road continues along the coast, leading to other parts of Elanthia.  To go that way is to trust to luck and your own skills.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: As you progress on this north-south path, the dark forest to the west catches your eye.  A little forbidding in its primeval appearance, it is sure to offer a good source of small-game hunting.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: The muted sounds of loud bartering from within Wehnimer's Landing, and the lonely calls of a pair of mated fenvaoks high up in the air vie for your attention as you march along the outer western edge of the town.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: Modwir trees predominate this section of forest, as though the oak, satisfied with its allotted space, has made room for the tall pines.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: You come across a burnt-out fire pit, evidence that others have travelled through this deep forest.  The charred remains of a large log hold no lingering warmth, but do provide a certain security with their assurance that others have passed the night here safely.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: The ground shifts from flat forest to jagged hillside, the trees thinning out as the ground gets rougher and rockier.  The oaks disappear farther up the slope, leaving the modwirs to dominate the hill.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: Clumps of modwirs obscure your vision up the hill, but also act as a windbreak.  The strong pine scent of the trees fills the area, making your eyes water.  Strange chitterings and cracklings make you very aware that you're not alone here.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: The narrow trail curls around the side of the hill, swerving to avoid clumps of trees.  The wind is coming up the hill now, and the trees offer little protection to your chilled limbs.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: The modwirs grow thick here on the south side of the hill, their scent so strong you can almost taste it.  Rustles and crackles echo from the underbrush around you.  It looks like part of the hill has collapsed, taking a trail with it.  There's a narrow path running parallel to the old trail, but it looks treacherous.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: Peering downslope between the modwirs, you get a panoramic view of the next valley over to the west, and a glimpse of the Darkstone Bay to the north.  The rocky slope is treacherous here though, so you pull your attention away from the land miles away and back to what's under your feet, as you continue along the path.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: This face of the hill is completely bare of trees, and doesn't even have many bushes.  You notice that even the bird and insect noises are gone, leaving you with an eerie silence, broken only by the wind.  Off the side of the trail, you notice a depression in the hillside, with a dark pit at the bottom.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: The forest floor slopes noticeably downhill here, thinning out somewhat at the bottom, where modwir, thick pine and fir trees predominate.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: Pine cones are scattered about the ground here, knocked down by the movement of small animals through the trees and the wind that buffets this outlying section of the forest.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: You realize that you have been climbing steadily, if gradually, as the vegetation changes to the rugged pines and firs that thrive in the higher elevations.  The subtle herbal scent of the lower forest has been replaced by the pungent aroma of pine.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: There are small boulders scattered amidst the trees, firmly imbedded in the ground and covered by a light coating of lichen.  The air is brisk and cool, a pleasant spot to rest and enjoy the forest.

There are small boulders scattered amidst the trees, firmly imbedded in the ground and covered by a light coating of lichen.  The air is brisk and cool, a pleasant spot to rest and enjoy the forest.  A barely discernible path winds through the rocks, ending at a haphazardly built wooden gate.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: There is a break in the trees here, several charred trunks bearing witness to a past forest fire or act of nature.  A modwir lies across the ground, the scars of a lightning strike etched into its blackened trunk.  Just near the remaining tree stump, you notice a dirt footpath leading south.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: The evidence of a lightning strike is more pronounced here, and even massive trees have been felled and charred.  One impressive ruin is the huge trunk of a fallen modwir, which lies upon the ground.  Just barely the height of a man, a hole in the trunk shows it to be hollow.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: To the west, the landscape is gradually changing from a thick dark forest to an open, green grassy plain.

To the west, the landscape has grown dark and broken, where a once thick forest has withered into a wasteland of dead trees and brown foliage.  Pale wisps of fog slowly snake through the gnarled trees.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: Clear grassland stretches far to the southwest, a futile lesson in the immensity of Elanith.  To the northwest, the grassy plain gives way to a smattering of pines that dot the landscape.  Immediately east of you looms the high wooden wall of the Landing which provides you with a sense of security against all the unknown things that may lurk in plain and forest alike.

To the southwest, the immense grasslands have begun to fade, replaced by twisted brown weeds and rotting undergrowth.  To the northwest, once mighty pine trees have become bent with decomposition, their skeletal branches barren and gnarled.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: As you stand next to the southwest corner of the Landing, you have an unobstructed view of the plain.  Some distance away you can make out the vague figures of shepherdesses tending their flocks of Rolton -- sheep indigenous to the region.  Further south the grassy expanse turns hilly, eventually terminating in stark mountains that line the horizon.

A backdrop of rot and death expand to the south, where lush grasslands have been replaced by cracked grey rock, emaciated plant life and thick smog.  Scattered about the dead lands are the putrid remains of roltons, flies swarming around their bodies.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: The dirt path bends around the southwest corner of the landing.  Far to the east, you can see a thin blue line that must be the river.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: Through a crack in the wooden palisade to the north, you can see the bustling traffic of Wehnimer.  It is a stark contrast to the open path that you walk.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You are standing on the western shore of the Locksmehr river.  From here you can see the southern water entrance to the town of Wehnimer's Landing.  It is through this entrance that the boats returning from their upstream sojourns to the south have access to the town.  A rough trail descends a rocky slope toward a stand of willow trees.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: Leaving the path behind you enter the grasslands.  The wind blowing across the knee high grass stretching out before you has a hypnotic effect.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: Far to the north can be seen the trading post of Wehnimer's Landing.  From this distance, the town appears a miniature and the hustle and bustle within the walls is but a faint whisper.  The scent of wildflowers and grass tells you that you are indeed far from the city.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: The ground slopes slightly here, giving you pause to look up at the thick, puffy cumulus clouds and their shapes, which are continuously altered by the four winds.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: Bright multi-hued patches of wildflowers fill the grassy plain to the south as far as you can see.  The simple beauty afforded by the vibrant colors astounds you.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: Growing among the warm grasses are a few scattered trees.  It is hard to tell if the forest you can see to the west is encroaching upon the grasslands or if it is slowly being harvested and replaced for grazing.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: You are in a makeshift clearing bisected by a well-trampled path running north and south.  The close-cropped and trodden vegetation suggests frequent visits by grazing flocks of rolton.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: The waving grasses beneath your feet grow taller, the bright green mingling with the darker hues of the sky.  Hearing a sharp cry far above, you raise your eyes to see a blue-banded hawk spiraling overhead in search of prey.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: You sense the weight of many years as you pass beneath the branches of the grassland's sole guardian, a giant cottonwood tree.  Its leaves rustle loudly in the breeze, as if regaling you with grand tales out of a distant past.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: You are wandering through the grasslands of Lower Dragonsclaw.  This area is hilly, but not enough to justify the mountain which juts out from the ground to the east.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, The Shadow]
description: You are in a grassy area which is presently darkened by the shadow of a peculiar mountain jutting from the ground.  It is unusual in the fact that no other mountains exist in this area, and you can remember a time when there certainly wasn't one here.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lake Eonak]
description: You are on the bank of a beautiful mountain lake that is fed by a waterfall gushing from the mountain side.  There is a path which seems to actually lead up the side of the mountain.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You are standing at the northern edge of a hilly and deeply forested region known as the Upper Trollfang.  A wide and well used trail cuts through the deep underbrush to the south and appears to be the only visible entrance to the forest.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail winds along the bottom of a series of low hills.  A wall of thick underbrush lines the trail, effectively preventing you from wandering far from the worn track.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The scurrying of unseen creatures occassionally cause the snapping of a tiny twig and you oft times catch the glimpse of brown fur or black feather.  The dense and low-lying flora of the area quickly conceal anything that is not directly on the path however and you are feeling a bit apprehensive about moving further.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A high, steep hill lies directly to the south and the trail splits as it makes its way around.  The wider, and obviously more used trail, runs off to the southwest while a smaller trail heads off to the southeast.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Three large modwir trees stand in a north-south line and split the trail as it passes from west to east.  The northeast branch runs up the side of a long winding ridge while the southeast branch disappears in the brush that grows along the base of the ridge.  The two trails come together and form a wider trail that runs off to the northwest.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The hoof and paw marks of countless creatures are clearly evident along this part of the trail.  A row of fallen trees allows the wind to blow through, keeping the leaves off the trail.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This part of the ridge is open and exposed.  The usual stands of trees give way to the smaller undergrowth that has established itself on this rocky outcropping.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A dead elm tree lies across the trail here.  The passing of countless hooves has nearly severed the decaying log, therefore its presence does not hinder your passage.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Fragrant evergreens cover the side of the ridge here.  Years of battling the elements have stunted and twisted their growth as they cling to the rocks and rubble that clutter the side of the hill.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Stumbling along the trail, you dislodge several small stones which tumble down the side of the ridge.  The resulting tumult raises as much dust as din.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This part of the ridge is dominated by a huge tree, now quite dead.  It stands like a blackened spire, towering far above the surrounding trees and bushes.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You pass along a wide trail, overgrown on both sides with weeds and thorny bushes.  Farther back from the trail are thick clumps of bushes and stands of modwir trees.  The growth seems to thin out toward the southeast.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This is the western end of a badly overgrown and neglected road.  Small piles of paving stones can be seen nearby, but the large amount of weeds that cover them indicate to you that they have not been moved in quite some time.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The road disappears for a time beneath islands of thick grasses only to reappear as you move on.  Though the road appears to get little use, a path parallels the road and appears to be used quite frequently.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The road curves gently as it moves from the northeast to the west.  Apparently the individuals responsible for the location of the road did not wish to disturb the stand of magnificent willow trees that grows to the east.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This part of the road is not nearly as rough as the rest, but it makes for slow travelling nonetheless.  You have been on worse roads, though right now you can't remember when.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You are standing at a broad T-intersection.  The main road appears to run east to west while a smaller street runs off to the north.  To the south can be seen a grove of large willow trees.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This narrow lane has been marvelously constructed to weave in and out of the large trees that line the sides.  The shadows cast by the thick canopy of leaves overhead create fascinating mosaics on the aging cobbles that pave this way.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Winding through a narrow canyon, the road seems oddly out of place.  It is a small touch of civilization in a very wild tract of land.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The walls of the canyon swing in quite close to one another here.  In fact, the narrow opening between them is just wide enough to allow the road to pass through.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The narrow road ends here in the courtyard of a rambling structure that appears to be a prosperous inn.  The thanot door keeps the guests safe from the dangers of weather and creature.  The footprints that mark the dirt don't look like they were made by anyone you'd care to meet on a moonlit stroll, making the inn a welcome haven.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A rotting wooden cart stands off to the side of the road, the thick grasses and lush moss nearly covering the once sturdy vehicle.  Thick brambles line the sides of the road which thins to a narrow trail as it moves further east.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This shaded intersection marks the beginning, or end, of a wide cobbled road that heads off to the west.  To the east, this road becomes a deeply rutted trail that dives through the thick underbrush and disappears.  A smaller path leads up a hill to the northeast.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail is flat and the going is easy through this part of the forest.  The high branches of the hardwood trees creating a cooling canopy of leaves.  The shadows prevent much of the smaller plant life from establishing themselves and you can see most of the surrounding hillsides quite clearly.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Shrubs and bushes swallow a small trail leading to the east.  To the south, the forest slopes down, exposing a large, rocky pasture.  Scattered roltons and gaks can be seen grazing on the hilly field, seemingly oblivious to their surroundings.

title: [Hearthstone, Front Porch]
description: Airy and open, the porch is enclosed by smooth, freshly painted white modwir up to a height of about four feet.  As you ponder the sky-blue color of the ceiling and a lacework of deep green ivy that crisscrosses the open space between posts, the hubbub of the world beyond quickly fades away.  Rocking chairs of various sizes are an inviting sight, and an elegant green marble arch provides a tantalizing view of the splendors inside the old manor.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: A brisk wind from the Bay lashes against your skin as you move along the coastal cliffs overlooking the deep blue of the Darkstone to the north.  Scraggly tree roots dangle from the rock face and provide a crude shelter for nesting fenvaoks.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: A few hardy trees cling to the barren, grey cliff's edge, their trunks bowed and their branches twisted by the whipping winds high above the Bay.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: A sparse stand of trees partially blocks your view to the south and west.  Gnarled branches bend inland, yet seem to defy the coastal winds with their endurance.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: The worn path follows the contours of the cliffs, curving slightly inland, weaving its way through the scattering of ancient trees.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Quiet Path]
description: Here along this quiet, narrow path through the woods, you are sheltered from the bracing winds that buffet the cliffs to the north.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: Gravel from boulders ground down by time and harsh elements crunches beneath your feet.  Tiny saplings thrive in the shelter of old growth as the forest seems to close in around you.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: A soft carpeting of grass encroaches upon the crumbling rock at the cliffs' edge, cushioning your steps.  An occasional rustling high in the branches of an old, weatherbeaten modwir sets your nerves on edge.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: To the north, the sea stretches endlessly blue, dotted by tiny breakers and the occasional sleek line of a merchant ship as it slices through the chill waters to the bustling docks of Wehnimer's Landing.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: The cliffs narrow and you catch a glimpse of the jagged, rocky wasteland that lies eighty or so feet below you.  A few small rocks tumble out over the edge,  and it is breathless moments later before you hear them smash against the boulders below.

The cliffs narrow and you catch a glimpse of the jagged, rocky wasteland that lies eighty or so feet below you.  A few small rocks tumble out over the edge, and it is breathless moments later before you hear them smash against the boulders below.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: You are forced to move inland a bit as the cliffs grow treacherous.  Here, in the shelter of gnarled modwirs, the wind is but a gentle breeze.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: Faint moonlight flits through the dark green canopy of leaves as they dance in the wind, stippling the ground with an ever-changing mosaic of light and shadow.
Faint light flits through the dark green canopy of leaves as they dance in the wind, stippling the ground with an ever-changing mosaic of light and shadow.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: Your nose tingles, not unpleasantly, as the briny smell of the Darkstone mixes with the green, mossy aroma of the forest.  The rough, cracked bark of the tree trunks, dampened by the salty breeze, give off a pungent, woody scent.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: A deep sense of solitude washes over you as you stand between the dark, silent forest to the south, and the vast, churning waters to the north.  The distinct feeling that you are being watched disturbs the illusion, however.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wet Ravine]
description: The ground slopes sharply and you find it hard to keep from slipping on the slurry of mud and fungus underfoot.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: The crushed stone and grass underfoot are stained in splotches of an odd shade of brownish crimson.  A ragged bit of cloth clings to the claw-like branches of a dead tree, fluttering like a flag in the wind.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: The trees are sparse here, and you are perilously close to the cliffs' edge.  Now and then a shrill cry from below startles you, but your eyes can discern nothing but rocks and the violence of the sea as it flings itself tirelessly upon the cliff face.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: The sea breeze is cool and salty, and it dampens your face as you look out over the breathtaking expanse of moonlit water below.  The sound of the waves crashing against the rocks roars in your ears.

The sea breeze is cool and salty, and it dampens your face as you look out over the breathtaking expanse of blue-green water below.  The sound of the waves crashing against the rocks roars in your ears.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: Deep crevices have split the solid rock beneath your feet, and you catch a glimpse of what must surely be the center of Elanthia as you carefully step over and around them.  The sound of the sea echoes up through some of the crevices, indicating the presence of underground water flows.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: As the wind picks up speed it wails through the chasms in the cliff rock, sounding eerily like the cry of a woman in distress.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: Bits of damp seaweed lay strewn across the ground.  The crushed tendrils of a red anemone lay dried and withered, the last vestiges of life long since past.  Eighty feet below, the sea crashes against the rocks, and the spray is but a fine mist on your face.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Small Hillock]
description: From here you can see the white-capped moonlit waves of the Darkstone far below and to the north, and the hazy, blue-grey mountains' rising peaks to the south.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: A large tree clings tenaciously to the edge of the cliff, its roots dug deep into the face of the rock.  Branches like skeletal fingers form an arch overhead, and only a sparse scattering of yellowish-green leaves attests to the fact that it still lives.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: A low, flat rock rests beside the path.  A seedy patch of fragrant wildflowers grows beside it.  The wind seems gentler, and it is slightly warmer here.  Moonlight illuminates the area with a soft glow.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: The mountains rise up majestically to the south, silhouetted against the evening sky where the forest tries to carve life out of the barren rock.  You feel very small, caught between these breathtaking summits and the seemingly infinite sea to the north.  To the west, the terrain is a jumble of broken rock and steep inclines, making further travel in that direction impractical.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Small Hillock]
description: The long grass here atop the hillock undulates in the breeze like gentle, ocean waves.  The slope is covered with a colorful patchwork of wildflowers.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Small Hillock]
description: The grassy hillock levels out gradually to a smooth, flower-dotted plateau.  Fireflies hover on the ocean breeze, soaring and dipping in a playful, airy dance.
The grassy hillock levels out gradually to a smooth, flower-dotted plateau.  Dragonflies hover on the ocean breeze, soaring and dipping in a playful, airy dance.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Small Hillock]
description: A gentle, grassy slope rises out of the darkness of the surrounding forest.  To the southeast, the gloom of the dim woods seems distant, yet too close for comfort.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wet Ravine]
description: Cold, damp, rock forms the walls of this narrow ravine.  Prickly vines dangle from crevices in the rock, catching at your clothing and scraping your skin as you move.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wet Ravine]
description: Moss and fungus coat the rocks at either side of this deep, wet ravine.  The ground is slippery with mud and leaves.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: Dappled leaves shiver in the cool, moist air.  In a state of perpetual twilight, odd, mottled mushrooms thrive near the roots of trees.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: Lush, untamed vegetation has all but reclaimed this path as its own.  Now and then the shrill cry of a bird pierces the forest, and your heart races.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: Now and then the breeze stirs the foliage to either side of the path, and your imagination plays tricks on you.  You feel as if you are being followed.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: A break in the stone wall is too smooth to be the product of erosion.  Trees encroach upon it, and vines creep over the ground beneath your feet, but this is almost certainly an overgrown, man-made path.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: Stringy, twisted vines underfoot conspire to trip you.  A few young trees have shot up through the ground ahead in search of light, but a footpath is still discernable here.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: A large tree has taken root in the middle of the thoroughfare.  From its limbs drip strands of moss and creeping vines that spill out over the dirt road.  Nature is gradually reclaiming the land as traces of the fishing village disappear.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: A tangle of vines devours the remains of a few tiny stone cottages.  Only the crumbling walls still stand--thatched roofs have long since turned to dust.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: Several small cottages stand back from the main road, their stone walls broken down and their meager interiors exposed to the elements.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: A few rotting boards propped against the one remaining rock wall of a pitiful stone hovel appear to have been a boat of some kind.  Broken bits of several rusted tools lay scattered about.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: Several meager stone huts huddle together at the side of the road.  A white fungus eats at the mortar, hastening their decay.  It is hard to imagine that a thriving fishing village once stood on this spot.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: Soft pillows of Delphinuris coat the rocks and rises underneath the shade of arching branches.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: Insects drone hypnotically in the underbrush, their chorus silenced momentarily with each step you take.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: Wiry vines with shrivelled black leaves creep over the exposed roots of some of the larger trees.  Looking closer, you see the bloated carcass of a deer entangled as if the vine were devouring its flesh.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: The soft, melancholy keening of the Sirenflower rises and falls as the breeze whispers erratically through the trees, turning your thoughts momentarily introspective.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: A circle of broken rock surrounds the opening of a deep cistern, presumably long dry and overgrown with moss and mold and a few greyish brown mushrooms.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: This small, moonlit clearing is surrounded on three sides by forlorn-looking trees and a tangle of thorny bushes.  The grass underfoot is a dark, healthy green, but it is tough and coarse.
This small, shady clearing is surrounded on three sides by forlorn-looking trees and a tangle of thorny bushes.  The grass underfoot is a dark, healthy green, but it is tough and coarse.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: Grass has grown over the earthen floor of a nearby building, and moss clings to the crumbling stone, eroding it further.  A large firepit dominating the center of the main chamber indicates that this may have been a smokehouse of sorts.  A scattering of fish bones tends to support that conclusion.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wrecked Village]
description: Here at the southwestern end of the abandoned fishing village, you find a secluded, spot beneath the lush boughs of a great oak tree.  A corroded brass shrine is still intact, though the wall in which it was mounted has eroded to a pile of rubble.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Quiet Path]
description: A low, crumbling stone wall runs north and south on either side of the dirt footpath.  In some places, it is a few feet high, in others, only the stone surface peeks out from the ground to mark its existence.

title: [Moonshine Manor, Courtyard]
description: Towering above the courtyard is a massive conifer, its branches spread wide to cast shadows over a pair of small stained oak tables surrounded by matching chairs.  Carved stone steps meld fluidly with the slate walkway as they wind their way through the courtyard to the polished ebony double doors set into the face of a simple, yet elegant manor.  Moonbeams dance off of the twisted mithril bars that form the high fence which extends around the courtyard.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Fraendel Court]
description: Multi-leveled residences line either side of the street, each containing etched glaesine windows adorned with bright window coverings.  The neighbors appear to be trying to best each other in some sort of competition for attention.  As you gaze at each dwelling, something different catches your eye with each glance.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: Townsfolk meander into and out of the city's weaponry shop, carrying fat purses on the way in and large packages on the way out.  Three of the city guardsmen stand near the establishment's door, keeping a watchful eye on the comings and goings.

A square stone shop, ringed with columns on all four faces, stands at the edge of the courtyard.  To either of side of it are buildings of white marble, though the square building is, instead, silvery blue granite.  A floating dais hovers over the center of the open space.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shimmarglin Court]
description: The imposing facade of the Shimmarglin Inn dominates this corner of the court.  Flanking the inn's doorposts and hanging above each glaesine-paned window, grinning gargoyles stand in stony defense of the lair within.  A trickle of patrons flows through the inn's wide front doors, allowing a short-lived flood of light into the court with each swing of the doors.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]
description: Only a few thorny vines wrap around the rocks here.  A leafy green vine has entwined itself with the thornvines like two serpents in a duel.  A night breeze blows through the pass, cooling the area off even more.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]
description: Brambles mix with green bushes, creating a hidden hazard to the unwary traveller in the night.  Red berries in the bushes tempt birds to swoop in for a quick meal, but the unlucky ones have become impaled on the long thorns.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]
description: A sea of thorns fills the pass.  Older broken brambles carpet the trail, while newer growth threatens to take over.  At odd times the brambles rustle ominously.  The intertwined vines create a web of shadows in the moonlight.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]
description: A narrow pit hugs the west wall of the pass.  Brambles fill the bottom of the dark pit and creep up the wall like tentacles.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]
description: Brambles cover the trail, making walking a dangerous activity.  Leafy vines mix with the thorny vines on the walls of the pass.  Stars twinkle in the night sky above.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]
description: The brambles form an archway across the pass.  Stray vines hang down above the trail.  The arch reduces in size to form a short tunnel disapearing into the darkness to the southwest.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]
description: The brambles thicken to form a short tunnel to the northeast.  The elongated thorns here resemble spears rathar than normal thorns.  The distant cry of a hawk pierces the calm of the night.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]
description: Thorny vines sweep across the walls of the pass, creating a menacing tunnel for travellers in the dark night.  Patches of cloth litter the edges of the brambles, remnants of the clothing worn by careless adventurers.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Brambles]

title: [Whistler's Pass, Grassy Field]
description: A thin blanket of moonglow-mist lies just above the green grass, shying away from any tall objects.  Breezes stir the mist, sending tiny droplets of water in a wild dance.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Grassy Field]
description: The fog is noticeably absent in this section of the pass.  A dew-covered maoral sparkles in the moonlight while birds chirp the night away.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Grassy Field]
description: A dense bank of fog has settled into the area, hiding all but the closest section of the trail from view.  A dark fog fills the area to the northeast.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Grassy Field]
description: The trail heads down a hill to the northeast, looping around an ancient maoral.  A gap in a line of bushes provides a moonlit path to the southwest.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Grassy Field]
description: A thick screen of bushes line the edge of the dark field, forming a semicircle in the pass.  A gap in the bushes leads to the northeast.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Grassy Field]
description: The trail becomes less defined here, the grass from the field has invaded the edges of the trail, blurring the line between the two.  A gentle night breeze blows through the pass.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Grassy Field]
description: The haon trees yield to a field of green grass illuminated by moon and starlight.  Birds work at gathering grass for nests in the field while others search for food.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Copse]
description: Little grass fills the space between the trees due to the darkness that pervades the area.  Low hanging branches force taller adventurers to stoop low as they pass through the dense wood.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Copse]
description: Little light makes it through the treetops, except for the stray beams of light that pierce the darkness like flaming arrows in the night.  An owl hoots from within the trees.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Copse]
description: The trail disappears into a dark copse of trees to the north.  Several bushes hug the night-darkened walls of the pass near the copse.  Songbirds fill the air with their melody.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Bend]
description: A gentle wind blows through the pass, creating a mournful echo off the rock walls.  Leaves in the trees rustle in the windy darkness, creating a myriad of sounds.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Bend]
description: A large haon tree shades this bend in the pass.  A bird nest sits prominently near the top of the tree.  Cool, wet grass blankets the pass with a coat of green, now dark in the night.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Pond Edge]
description: A calm pond stretches towards a waterfall to the southwest.  A rope bridge divides the dark pond in half.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Bridge]
description: The rope bridge sways gently with traveller's steps.  Moonlight illuminates fish that can be seen jumping out of the water through the gaps between the logs of the bridge bottom.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Pond Edge]
description: The water from the falls above spills into a large pond.  A turtle pokes its head above the water then submerges into the dark water again leaving only a ripple to mark its passing.  A rope bridge stretches across the pond to the northeast.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Falls Landing]
description: Curtained by a steady flow of water from the falls, this landing provides a tranquil resting place.  Small lizards skitter across the rock occasionally.  Stray drops of water plop down onto the landing.  Moonlight filters through the falls.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Falls]
description: Beautifully weathered grey granite channels the creek water over a ledge to the north.  Looking out over the ledge, the base of the waterfall can be seen twenty feet below.  A series of stone steps wind their way down the falls, while a cobblestone pathway leads up, illuminated by moonlight.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Creek]
description: Dense clusters of reeds nearly choke the flow of the creek.  The western bank has been entirely taken over by a broad-leafed vine.  The sea of green continues until it reaches the dark water of the creek.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Creek]
description: A pair of weeping willows droop across the creek from opposite banks, their limbs forming a curtain across the creek.  Fireflies flit in and out of the willow trees, their nighttime homes disturbed by your passing.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Creek]
description: The flow of the creek has cut its path in the sandstone that lines this section of the creek bed.  Fireflies flutter through the area, the braver ones inspecting trespassers to their nighttime resting spot.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Bog]
description: The marshy terrain seeps up an incline as if crawling hand-by-hand, the way confiscated with thick cattails and reeds.  Shadowy trees begin to make solitary appearances, standing back from the willows as if they were second-class citizens.  However, these oak trees have a sinister air, with their black leaves and scabbed boles.

title: [Thick Rushes]
description: A thick stand of rushes guards a forbidding wall of trees with foliage so dark it looks black.  The rushes are both thick and tall.  They stand their sentry, hoisting an armament of brown cattails over them, which wave slowly at the touch of the breeze.  A multitude of frogs croak loudly in the darkness, unseen but filling the night with their song.
