title: [Field of Rushes]
description: A field of rushes fringe the edge of a forest, clinging to the foot of the trees with no visible break between the snarled grasses and the tree trunks.  From the verdure, the croak of frogs maintains a constant din, punctuated with the occasional booming outburst of a bullfrog.  Overhead, the boughs of the dark trees block out the moon with their thick foliage.

title: [Field of Rushes, Bridge]
description: The thick growth of rushes finally stops at the edge of a swiftly running stream, straggling out into the current in a ragged fringe.  A derelict bridge crosses the confluence, its timbers a haphazard shamble spanning the arched support beams.  The handrails of the bridge must have long ago given up a battle against the elements, for only a couple of splintered posts still cling to their original mooring on the bridge's sides.

title: [Blighted Forest, Bridge]
description: From the foot of a beautiful, old arched bridge, the trail disappears into the darkness of the forest.  The trees have grown closely together, with formidable undergrowth prohibiting casual entry at any point other than the path.  Beneath the bridge, the stream courses swiftly with an accompanying roar, its roiling surface glistening in the moonlight.

title: [Blighted Forest, Trail]
description: Twisting and turning at the insistence of large tree trunks, the path winds its way through dense patches of rhododendron bushes and ferns.  Past seasons' leaves lie in shadowy drifts, creating a hazardous promenade by masking the presence of rocks and roots beneath.

title: [Blighted Forest, Junction]
description: The trail divides into three branches, one looking no different than the next.  Enormous black-barked trunks crowd closely on all sides, supporting a seamless canopy that blocks most of the moonlight from above.

title: [Blighted Forest, Trail]
description: The tortuous twists and turns of the trail seem to wind endlessly through a never-changing tunnel of dark tree trunks.  Shadows move within the gloom between the boles, products of the shifting boughs overhead.  However, an occasional low-pitched huff or growl betrays other, more menacing, sources of shadows within the ancient forest.

title: [Blighted Forest, Leviathan]
description: The trail makes a pronounced dog-leg around the bole of a mammoth-sized oak.  The tree's base could accommodate a small hamlet were it hollowed out, and huge clumps of rhododendron bushes growing at its foot look tiny in comparison to the tree's behemoth proportions.

Ferns grow out of the deep crevices in the oak's bark, garlanding its sides with their emerald color.

title: [Blighted Forest, Trail]
description: Skirting through underbrush and around impassible stands of tree trunks, the trail is made more torturous by a continuous assault of stones and roots invading its passageway.  In some places, any obvious signs of the path seem to disappear before finally offering a few, faint clues to mark its course.

title: [Blighted Forest, Dogleg]
description: The path is forced to double back on itself where trees have grown so closely together that light cannot be glimpsed between their hulking boles.  Overhead, the canopy is dense, creating a shadowy gloom that harbors the ghostly whisper of rustling leaves.

title: [Blighted Forest, Junction]
description: A junction of three paths is bordered by thick mounds of rhododendron bushes.  The broad leaves of the shrubbery are dark green, almost as black as the leaves of the oaks surrounding them.  Large buds on the ends of the branches signal the bounty of next season's blossoms.

title: [Blighted Forest, Bald Ridge]
description: Along the ridge of a hill, the trees give way to an open expanse of sky, a rare commodity within the brooding black forest.  Rocky outcrops recline in jumbled piles, forcing the trail to thread its way between them.  Thick stands of trees rise on either side, as if silently plotting to overtake the moonlit breach.

title: [Blighted Forest, Bald Ridge]
description: The trail winds between large stone formations, outcroppings of the hill's rocky skeleton.  From the high elevation, the vastness of the forest is visible in the moonlight. title: [Blighted Forest, Rocky Hillside]
description: After threading its way down a hillside, the trail abruptly disappears in a jumble of large boulders.  Small thistle bushes grow between the rocks, their impressive thorns discouraging further attempts to search for the path's continuation.

title: [Blighted Forest, Dead End]
description: A jumble of large boulders covers the path, blocking any further progress to the southeast.  Trees have grown up between the stones, their boles large enough to reveal the passage of many years since the rockslide occurred.

title: [Blighted Forest, Stream Bank]
description: At the shore of a swift river, the path emerges from its cocoon of trees.  Serenaded by the rush of the water, the ambiance is serene, a welcome relief from the oppressive shadows within the forest's enclosure.  The trail continues for a short way to the southwest, following the stream's edge and zigzagging between large boulders.

At the shore of a swift river, the path emerges from its cocoon of trees.  Serenaded by the rush of the water, the ambiance is serene, a welcome relief from the oppressive gloom within the forest's enclosure.  The trail continues for a short way to the southwest, following the stream's edge and zigzagging between large boulders.

title: [Blighted Forest, Stream Bank]
description: Blocked by a thick field of cattails, the trail disappears.   Beyond the cattails lies a clear, moonlit lake.  The path's vantage point offers an excellent view of the merger of river current into the peaceful embrace of the lake's expanse.

Blocked by a thick field of cattails, the trail disappears.   Beyond the cattails lies a clear, crystal blue lake.  The path's vantage point offers an excellent view of the merger of river current into the peaceful embrace of the lake's expanse.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: Dense forest encloses the trail, obscuring the ground with thick banks of discarded leaves and blocking vision in any direction with a tangle of black branches and foliage.  Cinnamon ferns grow between the trees, creating lush mounds of arching fronds that wave languidly in the slightest breeze.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: A low ground fog drifts between the thick boles of trees, cloaking the trunks with silvery haze.  Little undergrowth has penetrated this part of the wood.  A few large boulders sit between the oaks, and as the fog eddies around them, they momentarily take on the appearance of living creatures lurking in the shadows.

A low ground fog drifts between the thick boles of trees, cloaking the trunks with silvery haze.  Little undergrowth has penetrated this part of the wood.  A few large boulders sit between the oaks, and as the fog eddies around them, they momentarily take on the appearance of living creatures lurking in the gloom.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: The trail passes through a grove of trees with little undergrowth.  Nettles and rhododendrons cloaking other parts of the wood have all but deserted the area, leaving the stark, black tree trunks standing in an austere congregation, like sentries at watch.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: As the path threads its way through the trees, the sound of a creek can be heard nearby.  Ferns stand taller than a halfling on all sides, their thick fronds blocking any glimpse of the source of the water's song.  Rocks emerge from the carpet of leaves here and there, like bald-headed earth elementals peeking up from the verdure to see who is passing.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: Rounding a bend created by a lichen-covered outcrop of granite, the trail crosses a small creek running through a fern-bordered streambed.  The sound of the water is a peaceful background to the melody of frogs and crickets hidden in the shadows.  Following the gentle incline of the forest floor, the creek disappears into the undergrowth of ferns and piles of rock that escort it on its way.

Rounding a bend created by a lichen-covered outcrop of granite, the trail crosses a small creek running through a fern-bordered streambed.  The sound of the water is a peaceful background to the melody of birds singing in the shelter of the trees.  Following the gentle incline of the forest floor, the creek disappears into the undergrowth of ferns and piles of rock that escort it on its way.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: Escorted by the faint sound of a stream, the path climbs through a cascade of large boulders.  The trees still maintain a full coverage of foliage overhead, growing resolutely up out of the rocky jumble.  Silvery green lichens create a lacy pattern on the fieldstones, which glows slightly in the faint moonlight.

Escorted by the faint sound of a stream, the path climbs through a cascade of large boulders.  The trees still maintain a full coverage of foliage overhead, growing resolutely up out of the rocky jumble.  Silvery green lichens create a lacy pattern on the fieldstones, contrasted by the subtle striations within the stone.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: The trail crosses a small stream coursing through its mossy bed and gurgling as it rushes past boulders in its path.  Silvery painted ferns grow around the rocks lining the stream's banks, their mottled leaves coated with spray from the creek's assault on the offending rocks.  Frogs sing in abandon, hidden in night's shadows.

The trail crosses a small stream coursing through its mossy bed and throwing up sparkling drops of water as it rushes past boulders in its path.  Silvery painted ferns grow around the rocks lining the stream's banks, their mottled leaves coated with droplets from the spray.  A few animal tracks are visible in patches of silt and mud between the stones.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: The trail winds through the dense forest, throwing off divergent branches that disappear in the darkness with the first turn.  Shadows lurk on all sides, sheltered within the green-tinged gloom.
The trail winds through the dense forest, throwing off divergent branches that disappear in the verdure with the first turn.  Shadows lurk on all sides, sheltered within the green-tinged gloom.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: A stand of hemlock trees punctuates the black foliage of the oaks growing on all sides with green.  Thistle and rhododendron grow nestled at the foot of the larger trees.  A light wind rustles its way through the trees' branches, singing a whispery melody with its caress of the canopy.

title: [Blighted Forest, Grotto]
description: A grotto harbors a junction of paths crisscrossing its mossy green sward with fingers leading away in three directions.  In the clearing's center stands a stela, tall and thin, its northern face darkened by moss.

A grotto harbors a junction of paths crisscrossing its mossy green sward with fingers leading away in three directions.  In the clearing's center stands a stela, tall and thin, its northern face covered with moss.  A fine tracery of carving is barely visible on its other sides, the complex designs weathered to near obscurity by time.

title: [Blighted Forest, Nettles]
description: The trail disappears into a thick growth of nettle bushes, which only a rabbit could comfortably navigate.  Long thorns peek from clumps of leaves along the tangle of branches.  On some of the thorns, carcasses of birds are impaled.  The small bodies hang limply from the barbs like grisly ornaments on the vicious shrubs.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: The trail widens as it branches into a 'Y'.  Both branches to the west disappear quickly from sight within the thick trees.  To the east, the forest opens up somewhat with dogwood and redbud trees growing between the black boles of the oaks here and there.  A large, flat stone marks the intersection, its edges framed by the eerie light of iridescent mushrooms glowing in the moonlight.

The trail widens as it branches into a 'Y'.  Both branches to the west disappear quickly from sight within the thick trees.  To the east, the forest opens up somewhat with dogwood and redbud trees growing between the black boles of the oaks here and there.  A large, flat stone marks the intersection, its edges framed by lush moss and delicate violets.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: Threading its way between a particularly thick stand of trees, the path shifts to and fro like a snake's trail.  Ferns and bushes make the going even more difficult.  A branch to the east is almost obscured by low branches and deep drifts of leaves.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: Skirting the edge of a cliff, the trail picks its way between scree and rocks, the shale creating an obstacle course that is hazardous at best.  The trees stand at the edge of the overlook, as if waiting for an unwary passerby to fall.

title: [Blighted Forest, Glade]
description: As the trail winds back into dense forest, it grows more rocky underfoot.  In some places, it is necessary to traverse jumbles of boulders, as well as navigate through patches of nettles.  Some modwirs are mixed in with the hardwoods in this section of the woods, and their distinctive piney smell perfumes the crisp air.

title: [Blighted Forest, Meadow]
description: The forest draws back, leaving a moonlit meadow surrounded by its ominous ranks.  Devoid of rocks or other obstructions, the tall carpet of grass seems to extend a benevolent welcome, in marked contrast to the endless gloom of the wood.  A glance to the south evaporates any illusions of light, however.  There, a monstrous tree spreads its branches across the horizon, the boughs contorted and crooked and its foliage a pitch-black cloud.

The forest draws back, leaving a grassy meadow surrounded by its ominous ranks.  Devoid of rocks or other obstructions, the tall carpet of grass seems to extend a benevolent welcome, in marked contrast to the endless gloom of the wood.  A glance to the south evaporates any illusions of light, however.  There, a monstrous tree spreads its branches across the horizon, the boughs contorted and crooked and its foliage pitch-black.

title: [Blighted Forest, Cliff]
description: The path dead-ends, blocked by the sheer drop-off of a cliff.  Hundreds of spans below, the forest continues, stretching to the horizon in a seemingly endless expanse of black-leafed trees.  Bats wheel overhead in the moonlight, using their high-pitched squeaks to navigate.

The path dead-ends, blocked by the sheer drop-off of a cliff.  Hundreds of spans below, the forest continues, stretching to the horizon in a seemingly endless expanse of black-leafed trees.  Eagles wheel overhead, sending their mournful echoes into the heavens.

title: [Solhaven, Abandoned Dock]
[Solhaven, Carillon Dock]
description: This rickety old dock creaks as the waves splash against the pilings.  Out in the bay, fishing boats trawl the waters dragging their nets.
This rickety old dock creaks as the waves splash against the pilings.  Out in the bay, fishing boats rock gently on their moorings.

Shrouded in what seems a perpetual mist, this reinforced old dock creaks as the waves splash against its pilings.  Out in the bay, fishing boats trawl the waters dragging their nets.  A sleek brigantine flying a sapphire crested black flag sits at the end of the dock, a long wooden gangplank leading to it from the back of a varnished teak boathouse.

Shrouded in what seems a perpetual mist, this rickety old dock creaks as the waves splash against its pilings.  Out in the bay, fishing boats trawl the waters dragging their nets.  Just far enough from the dock so that swimming would be difficult, a dilapidated sailless brigantine flying a tattered grey flag sits off of the harbor, its creaks and groans sounding like the last gasps of a dying man.
Shrouded in what seems a perpetual mist, this reinforced old dock creaks as the waves splash against its pilings.  Out in the bay, fishing boats trawl the waters dragging their nets.

title: [Gryphon Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with seven white starstones in the shape of a gryphon--with one star indicating each leg, the tail, the beak, and one glimmering eye.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Lobby]
description: Imbued with a sense of great age, the interior of the Shimmarglin Inn is both dim and chill.  A thick crimson rug flows across the stone floor, its bright rectangular expanse contrasting against the dark marble flagstones.  A pair of lancet-shaped windows frame the silver-inlaid oak doors leading to the outside, their segmented panes casting a pale, filtered light across the scarlet floor.  The entire room feels calm and serene, sensations more akin to a library than a public inn.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Front Desk]
description: A contoured counter of polished black oak curves along one side of the room, its high sheen reflecting light from a pair of glowing crystalline orbs which flank it.  Behind the counter, a wall-mounted shelf contains a complex of honeycombed cubicles.  A shallow niche on one wall contains the miniature carving of a leafless tree, the ends of its gnarled branches tipped with tiny luminous nodules.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Anteroom]
description: The marble flagstones in this small chamber have been inlaid with thin lines of silver, forming a complex circular pattern on the floor.  Suspended from the ceiling, a tripod-shaped lamp provides steady illumination.  The comforting gurgle of flowing water echoes from an open doorway on the eastern wall, while an elaborate archway leads into the quiet din of the tavern room to the south.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Tavern]
description: Three shallow steps lead down into a broad depression in the central hall of the inn.  Dominated by a cluster of circular tables and high-backed chairs, the tavern room is alive with the omnipresent sounds of murmuring voices, clanking tankards, and creaking furniture.  The sweet odors of honey mead and berry wine mingle in the air.  Toward the rear of the vast hall, a highly polished wooden staircase ascends to the second floor.

title: [Golden Sunburst Table]
description: The circular black oak table is polished to a high sheen, its surface glimmering with reflected light.  A set of high-backed chairs surrounds the table, each padded with deep red velvet upholstery.  The rounded edge of the table is bordered with inlaid gold, forming a pattern of sunbursts.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Fountain Room]
description: A cool, slightly dank air pervades this round room, its source a gently gurgling fountain surrounded by a curving border of black oak benches.  Crafted in the form of a dancing wood sprite, the dark rock of the fountain provides a tiered descent for the flowing water as it winds its way to a circular pool at the base of the sculpture.  An arched, stained glass window stands behind the fountain, shedding pale light across the softly undulating surface of the pool.

title: [Ta'Illistim Weaponry]
description: Nearly dark and extremely warm, the weaponry resonates with the rythmic sound of a hammer on anvil coming from a back room.  An iron brazier casts a dim reddish light across the shop, glinting off the weapons displayed on various racks.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Fraendel Court]
description: This part of the court contains gaily displayed awnings and window dressings apparently in rich color, now muted by night's dark embrace.  A few residents wander here but seem to keep mostly to the eastern side of this section.

Gaudy hues of rich blues and greens color the bright marble facades of the buildings here.  This section of the court appears to be having some sort of competition for the residents.  Perhaps the one who calls the most attention to his or her abode will win some sort of prize.  The townsfolk wandering through the court gaze about and chuckle softly to themselves before walking onward.

A multi-storied gatehouse of silvery blue stonework towers over the smaller residential structures on either side of it.  Twin banners of sapphire silk are unfurled down the building's front, flanking a single tall arched opening.  Atop the building, a domed cupola inset with round stained glass windows looks down over the entire Court.  Lanterns illuminate the area.

A multi-storied gatehouse of silvery blue stonework towers over the smaller residential structures on either side of it.  Twin banners of sapphire silk are unfurled down the building's front, flanking a single tall arched opening.  Atop the building, a domed cupola inset with round stained glass windows looks down over the entire Court.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Glimaer Wey]
description: The wey curves around a tall statue, which stands upon a raised granite platform.  Carved of mica-flecked granite and standing nearly half as high as the city walls, the statue is of an elven archer, his arrow nocked and pointed towards an unseen quarry.  Moonlight sparkles across the mica embedded within the statue's granite form.

The wey curves around a tall statue, which stands upon a raised granite platform.  Carved of mica-flecked granite and standing nearly half as high as the city walls, the statue is of an elven archer, his arrow nocked and pointed towards an unseen quarry.

The wey curves around a tall statue, which stands upon a raised granite platform.  Cast from bronze and standing nearly half as high as the city walls, the statue is of an elven archer and her veercat companion, her arrow nocked and pointed towards an unseen quarry.  Behind her is a small ivory-hued establishment.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Glimaer Wey]
description: The cobblestoned wey continues to curve in snake-like fashion, winding its way among the almost gardenlike setting.  A birdbath stands beneath a small grove of nearby trees, the moonlight reflecting a silvery sheen upon the watery surface of the bowl.

The cobblestoned wey continues to curve in snake-like fashion, winding its way among the almost gardenlike setting.  A birdbath stands beneath a small grove of nearby trees, its denizens alternatively splashing and chasing one another away from the water-filled bowl.

The cobblestoned wey continues to curve in a snake-like fashion, winding its way among an almost garden-like setting.  A birdbath stands beneath a small grove of nearby trees, its water-filled bowl a tarnished copper.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Glamesine Var]
description: The low garden wall of a nearby home abuts the cobbled var, clematis and ivy trailing over the top of the stacked fieldstone barrier to nearly tumble across the walkway.  Moonlight splashes silvery light across the home and its garden.
The low garden wall of a nearby home abuts the cobbled var, clematis and ivy trailing over the top of the stacked fieldstone barrier to nearly tumble across the walkway.

The low garden wall of a nearby home abuts the cobbled var, roses and ivy trailing over the top of the silvery blue barrier to nearly tumble across the walkway and spill out into the street.  Arching over the street is a marble bridge whose basal course makes a gentle curve.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Caeruil Arch]
description: Bouncing over Sylvar Wey and its surrounding blue-tiled residences, the bridge's glaesine abutments disappear in the darkness below.  Mica-flecked blue granite blocks build the arching expanse and at the crown, a pair of crystal peacocks with tails fanned beautifully twinkle under the nighttime celestial lights.  The hexagonal granite keystone and its nearest neighbors are carved in intricate detail.

Bouncing over Sylvar Wey and its surrounding blue-tiled residences, the bridge's glaesine abutments float above the ground on seemingly invisible bases.  Seethe Naedal is barely visible beyond the fortress spires to the west.  Mica-flecked blue granite blocks build the arching expanse and at the crown, a pair of crystal peacocks perch with tails fanned beautifully.  The hexagonal granite keystone and its nearest neighbors are carved in intricate detail.

Arching over Sylvar Wey and its surrounding blue-tiled residences, the white marble span is anchored to the ground with carved silvery blue stone braces.  Each column along the bridge is carefully fluted, while overhead is a pure silver mosaic.  Staggered lanterns set between the columns light the area with a pale blue glow.

Arching over Sylvar Wey and its surrounding blue-tiled residences, the white marble span is anchored to the ground with carved silvery blue stone braces.  Each column along the bridge is carefully fluted, while overhead is a pure silver mosaic.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Caear Var]
description: Glimmering blue tiles clad the rooftops of the nearby cottages, each one as neatly kept as the last.  One of the homeowners, apparently eager to show off his artistic side, has trimmed his hedges into fanciful animal shapes.  The remaining homes, while a bit more mundane, sport lavish displays of flowering trees and beautifully planted flowerbeds.

Glimmering panes of glass form the facade of a nearby building, its architecture notable for also possessing a framework of verdigris copper.  The var passes between the structure and an open expanse of green, which occupies the center of the city.  Arching over a nearby street is a marble bridge, whose basal course rises in a gentle span.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Caear Var]
description: Crowds of patrons flock towards a large stone building.  The structure's central rotunda, covered with deep blue tiles, glitters brightly in the sunlight.  Heavily carved columns inlaid with glimmering multi-colored stones flank the structure's wide front doors.

Set close to the var is a large stone building with a central rotunda.  The building's dome, covered with deep blue tiles, contrasts with its heavily carved white marble columns, though the colorful hue is echoed in its mosaicked pediment.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Caear Var]
description: The few elves passing through this quiet neighborhood carry home parcels from late night purchases at the various shops and warehouses that line the darkened var.  On the southeast corner of this intersection, a low building with mica-flecked granite pillars beckons shoppers through wide double doors.  Through large bay windows, you can see a variety of home furnishings illuminated by glowing oil lamps.

Many of the elves passing through this neighborhood are carrying parcels from the various shops and warehouses that line the busy var.  On the southeast corner of this intersection, a low building with mica-flecked granite pillars beckons shoppers through wide double doors.  Through the large bay windows, you can see a variety of home furnishings on display.

Shops and warehouses line the busy var.  On the southeast corner of the intersection, a low building, with mica-flecked granite columns, has thrown open its wide double doors.  Through the large tracery windows that frame the doorway, a variety of home furnishings are available on display.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Caear Var]
description: Most of the var is deserted at this hour, only the occasional passerby hurrying through on the way to his or her destination.  A large ornate granite building stands back from the var, its stone pillars engraved with elegant dahcres.  Small fierce gargoyles hover above door and window embrasures, guarding the structure with gleaming sapphire eyes and toothy grins.  Several torches light the walk leading to the massive structure.

Elves hurry up and down the var, each intent upon his or her own destination.  Here and there, a few groups have stopped to chat with one another, and still others wave and shout cheerfully to friends as they rush onward.  A large ornate granite building stands back from the var, its stone pillars engraved with elegant dahcres.  Small fierce gargoyles hover above door and window embrasures, guarding the structure with gleaming sapphire eyes and toothy grins.

The intersection of wey and var is also an intersection of two neighborhoods -- a rough and tumble area surrounding the airship docks, with its influx of foreigners and foreign cultures, and a humble but distinctly elven residential neighborhood.  The buildings here, at the juncture of the disparate areas, are a mix of the two groups.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Aerie Wey]
description: Several large warehouses stand nearby, constructed of sturdy granite blocks and boasting the city's trademark blue tiled roofs.  The blue-painted doors of the buildings are thrown open and workers hurry about moving boxes and crates of goods.

Several large warehouses stand nearby, constructed of sturdy granite blocks and boasting the city's trademark blue tiled roofs.  The blue-painted doors of the buildings are thrown open, though their high clerestory windows are barred.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Aerie Wey]
description: The noise from the docks to the east swirls in on the breeze, the shouts and jests of the sailors creating a merry, if businesslike, atmosphere.  A small stone cottage stands back from the wey, a maoral sign tacked to its door.

The character of the neighborhood around the Ta'Illistim airship docks could best be described as colorful.  The houses are small, with few windows, most of them barred, and the shops cater to a clientele more interested in instant gratification than the delayed pleasures of elven society.  One tavern is larger than the others, its roof less leaky, its windows unbroken, but its facade still grimy.  The cobblestones near it are scattered with the gravel that covers its small patch of hardscrabble yard.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Aerie Wey]
description: The airship dock, an open-aired, multi-platform construction of wood and stone, is nestled next to the city wall in a curved alcove.  At its lowest tier is the airship terminus, while above, connected by means of a wooden lift, is the cargo entrance and exit.  Placed in front of the structure is a carved marble monument.

The Ta'Illistim Docks, a tremendous wooden platform used for anchoring the great elven airships, lie directly to the east.  Even at this late hour, the shouts and calls of sailors and travellers echoes down the wey.  Pallets of cargo are loaded onto ships by means of a wooden lift.  Large glowing lanterns ring the docks, providing sufficient light to work by.

The Ta'Illistim Docks, a tremendous wooden platform used for anchoring the great elven airships, lie directly to the east.  The shouts and calls of sailors and travellers echoes down the wey.  Pallets of cargo are loaded onto ships by means of a wooden lift.

The airshop dock, an open-aired, multi-platform construction of wood and stone, is nestled next to the city wall in a curved alcove.  At its lowest tier is the airship terminus, while above, connected by means of a wooden lift, is the cargo entrance and exit.  Placed in front of the structure is a carved marble monument.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Aerie Wey]
description: Clients flow through the front door of the Ta'Illistim Exchange, most clutching promissory notes in their hands, a few even mumbling under their breath about the fees.  Three city guardsmen stand outside the stone building, scanning the crowds for signs of trouble.

Close to the airship docks, the distinctly elven flavor of Ta'Illistim is muddied by the presence of foreign import and export businesses, as well as an influx of their styles of architecture.  Mixed in with the typical white marble and blue tile are thatched roofs, hide tents and plain stone blocks, each group clustered together in mini neighborhoods of expatriates.  The wey is lit with smoky torches, set atop caged metal poles.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Aerie Wey]
description: The docks are relatively quiet at this hour of the night, with only the occasional shout emanating from the nearby area.  Several city guardsmen stand night watch, keeping an eye on passersby.

The bustle of the docks swirls around you, eddying around small groups of people and flowing around wagons and other obstacles as crowds move to and from the nearby airship docks.  Nearby, a line of wagons awaits inspection by the city guardsmen.

The road dips around a high tower, set flush against the exterior city wall.  The tower, raised as it is above the crenelations of the wall, looks down over both the interior of Ta'Illistim and the cliffside upon which the Shining City rests.  Atop its spire, a dome of sapphire tiles stands out against the night sky, a spot of blue in a star-dappled black tableau.

Atop its spire, a dome of sapphire tiles stands out against the sky, brighter and more blue.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Moonglae Var]
[Ta'Illistim, Weyr Var]
description: The var is nearly deserted as it passes beneath the shelter of the high city wall to the north.  A gentle breeze coursing over the top of the wall sets some windchimes to ringing in the doorway of a darkened cottage.  A tiny kitten, roused from its nap on a bench in the yard, mews in protest at the disturbance.

Several elves in traveling cloaks burdened with satchels and portmanteaux lumber in the direction of the airship docks visible to the east.  An elderly couple relaxing on a bench in their front yard looks on the travelers with an expression of mild pity as they nestle against each other in comfortable contentment.  A light wind courses over the top of the city wall to the north, setting the windchime hanging in the cottage doorway to ringing.

The high city wall overlooks the var, restricting any viewshed to down the road in one direction or the other.  Near this barricade, several small houses are clustered together, making a modest neighborhood.  The road is wide and well-worn, residential neighborhood or not, here in proximity to the Ta'Illistim airship docks.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Moonglae Var]
description: An imposing grey building huddles in the shelter of the city wall.  An engraved mithglin sign has been set into the dark granite beside a rounded archway that leads inside.  Above the archway, a large panel of granite has been embedded with an enormous mosaic formed of various gemstones.  Four round towers, each topped with a sapphire blue and silver pennant, mark the corners of the square building.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Moonglae Var]
description: The var passes to the east of the Ta'Illistim Amphitheatre, approaching the city walls that close off any view to the north.  Atop the amphitheatre's high wall, dark pennants snap in the sharp breeze that speeds some whispy white clouds across the starlit sky.  From a nearby cottage, you hear the sound of several clear voices raised in a gentle hymn.

The var passes to the east of the Ta'Illistim Amphitheatre, approaching the city walls that close off any view to the north.  Atop the amphitheatre's high wall, sapphire and silver pennants snap in the sharp breeze that speeds some billowy white clouds across the clear blue sky.  From the direction of a nearby cottage, the wonderful aroma of baking bread rises with the smoke from a greystone chimney.

The var passes to the east of the Ta'Illistim Amphitheater, approaching the city walls that close off any view to the north.  Atop the amphitheater's high wall, sapphire and silver pennants snap in the sharp cliff-top breeze.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Moonglae Var]
description: A sleepy songbird chirps from within the safety of some thick holly bushes that obscure a greystone cottage alongside the var.  An elderly elf peers out of a lighted window, with a distinctly unwelcoming look on his face.  Noticing your attention, he scowls and pulls the dark curtains closed.

An elderly elf sweeps the cobblestones that pave the var in front of his home.  Muttering something about snoops and strangers, he glares at every passerby.  His humble greystone cottage is partially hidden by a hedge of thick holly bushes, whose sharp-edged needles threaten to tear the fabric of your clothing if you pass too near.

Two pieces of crumbly silvery blue stonework cross over the var, forming a near complete arch.  The broken gap in the masonry is jagged, but with edges gone soft with age and the elements.  A respectful space surrounds the base of the structure on both sides of the road, separating it from the houses that sit nearby.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Moonglae Var]
description: A distinctive manor stands well back from the var, set off by a low greystone wall.  Constructed of polished, dark grey granite, the circular structure has dozens of round windows at various heights along the wall.  A palisade of black granite pillars circles the building, holding aloft a gently sloping slate roof.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Moonglae Var]
description: A few stray notes of flute music drift along through the cool night air, perhaps coming from one of the lighted windows of the cottages that line the var.  The silvery grey cobblestones give off a subtle glow as the soft moonlight reflects off flecks of quartz crystal embedded within the rock.

A small crowd has gathered around a street performer, who sits in the center of the var playing a flute.  His repertoire includes a seemingly infinite variety of styles and moods, which he weaves together in a subtle tapestry of song.  A little dog wearing a silver conical hat moves in concert with the music, marching in time to martial strains or swaying in place to more sentimental airs.

The back of Ta'Illistim Keep casts a metaphorical shadow over the tiny gardens and blue-tiled roofs of the homes that line the var.  Next to it, even the largest of the villas in the affluent neighborhood appears small, dwarfed by the Keep's multiple domes and sweeping mosaics.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Moonglae Var]
description: The var bends to the north and west as it passes the entrance to Ta'Illistim Keep.  Pure white granite accents the doorway arches and windows, providing a pleasant contrast to the blue-grey granite of the keep's high, buttressed walls.  The rectangular building is flanked on either end by a lofty entryway tower.  Wide, slate steps lead up to carved oak doors, while overhead hangs a sapphire and silver banner embroidered with the Illistim coat-of-arms.

The var bends to the north and west, winding its way around the multi-domed bulk of Ta'Illistim Keep.  Leading into the building is a wide staircase, its grey stone treads and risers flecked with inclusions of hematite.  The peacock of the House Illistim crest is picked out in a silver-on-sapphire mosaic that covers most of the front of the Keep.
The var bends, winding its way between the multi-domed bulk of Ta'Illistim Keep and an open expanse of green that stretches through the middle of the city.

title: [Delicacies Chocolatier]
description: Frothy pale yellow curtains frame the glaesine windows, each one hung with glittering pieces of stained glaes art that refracts the sunlight across the room.  A long glaes-topped counter lines two walls, stuffed with decadent treats neatly displayed on lacy white doilies.  The air is filled with the sweet scent of chocolate.

title: [Dark Forest, Trees]
description: A meager trail winds through the huge boles of black-barked trees.  Some of the giants have a circumference so large, they would dwarf a mammoth.  However, such a beast could never penetrate the impossibly thick growth.  The trees stand side to side with trunks almost touching, while overhead the boughs intertwine in an impenetrable ceiling of black foliage.

title: [Emerald Sprite Table]
description: The circular black oak table is polished to a high sheen, its surface glimmering with reflected light.  A set of high-backed chairs surrounds the table, each padded with deep red velvet upholstery.  The rounded edge of the table is bordered with inlaid emeralds, forming a pattern of dancing sprites.

title: [East Woods, Tunnel]
description: The scent of damp earth, dark and musty, fills the hole.  Broken tree roots protrude from the dirt walls and there are signs of claw marks scored deep within the packed soil.  Near the bottom of the hole is a large, rounded burrow extending deeper into the ground.

title: [East Woods, Tunnel]
description: The narrow burrow opens up into a wider tunnel that curves in two directions around a submerged chunk of rock.  There is a distinct odor of rodent, mingled with the scent of rotting vegetation, pervading the tunnel.  It is not a particularly pleasant fragrance.  A rounded opening leads out of the burrow.

title: [Spirits of the Delta]
description: Overcrowded with barrels, hogsheads and casks of varying sizes, the dim interior of this shop could almost be a cooper's showroom, but for the almost medicinal aroma of strong spirits.  With no room for a counter, Lem Skinker rests patiently on a barrel, a basket of blown glaes bottles and flasks on one side and a sack of corks on the other.

title: [Marshtown, Green Ell]
description: The wood used for the planks and the buildings in this section of town have been covered with a green fungus.  At the waterline, where the wood is still wet, the structures are a bright green.  Closer to the top of the structures the fungus has died and turned black.  The coloring here gives the area the illusion of being painted green and black by a group of halfling and giantman painters where the halflings had only green paint, and the giantmen had only black.

The planks that make up the walkway are completely supported by barrels at this point.  The boardwalk is flanked by rows of ramshackle sheds and houses, all of them also supported by massive rafts of barrels.  The whole town creaks and sways in the waters of the marsh.  A stretch of newer planking joins the walkway to a high-fenced platform to the northeast.

The wood used for the planks and the buildings in this section of town have been covered with a grey fungus.  At the waterline, where the wood is still wet, the structures are a dark grey.  Closer to the top of the structures the fungus has died and turned black.  The coloring here gives the area the illusion of being painted grey and black by a group of halfling and giantman painters where the halflings had only grey paint, and the giantmen had only black.

title: [Rat Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with seven white starstones that suggest the sinewy tail of a rat.

title: [Jackal Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with seven white starstones in the shape of a jackal's head.

title: [Lady of the Green Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with six golden moonstones in the shape of a stalk of wheat--two gems forming the main stalk and two on each side representing the grain.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Tower of Shadows]
description: An ivory-hued pool ripples quietly within an upraised platform -- its edges swept with a runic pattern that intertwines in a thin circular border.  The peaked ceiling is also inscribed with a series of sigils, their pale sapphire hue resonating with a faint light every few moments.  Polished white marble walls gleam faintly with the pulsating light, and several elven guards stand at the threshold of a set of ivory spiral stairs leading further up.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Aelis Var]
description: The tree-lined cobblestone widens considerably as it meets Erissian Var.  The ancient and imposing facade of the city's bank stands to the north, awash in moonlight as it has been for nights untold, and testament to the lasting nature of the elven culture.
The tree-lined cobblestone widens considerably as it meets Erissian Var.  The ancient and imposing facade of the city's bank stands to the north, testament to the lasting nature of the elven culture.

The tree-lined cobblestoned road widens considerably as it meets Erissian Var.  The ancient and imposing facade of the city's bank stands to the north across Ta'Illistim Green, testament to the lasting nature of the elven culture and the continued importance of elven commerce.

title: [Ta'Illistim Alchemy Supply]
description: The stone walls are hung with simple tapestries.  A small bronze brazier, its glowing coals emanating a gentle warmth, rests in one corner.  Gracefully carved modwir bookcases line the walls of the shop, laden with wands, rods, and supplies for crafting amulets.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Shorchar Wey]
description: The wey passes behind the towering edifice of the Hall of Justice, its massive wall an unbroken plane of blue-grey granite.  Almost invisible against the night sky, some dark pennants flutter from the crenelated rooftop.  As if defying the dour atmosphere, some yellow daffodils perfume the night air with a gentle, pleasant scent.

The wey passes behind the towering edifice of the Hall of Justice, its massive wall an unbroken plane of blue-grey granite.  High overhead, sapphire and silver pennants flutter from the crenelated rooftop.  As if defying the dour atmosphere, a cheerful patch of bright yellow daffodils grows in the shelter of the wall.

The wey passes behind the towering edifice of the Hall of Justice, its massive wall an unbroken plane of silvery blue granite.  Almost invisible against the night sky, some dark pennants flutter from the crenelated rooftop.

title: [Ta'Illistim, BriarStone Court]
description: The court is relatively quiet save for the patrons entering and exiting the shop on the corner.  Blue slate tiles cladding the low stone building's roof glimmer dully, seeming to nearly absorb the daylight.  A silver sign is posted on the shop's door.

Along this stretch of the courtyard's circular boundary, several shops specializing in gems, gemcutting and jewelry have clustered together.  One building, with a freshly tiled blue roof, has a larger silver sign than the others.  Its marble facade is illuminated brightly with several jewel-tone lanterns, turning the stone from white to blue, green, and red.

Along this stretch of the courtyard's circular boundary, several shops specializing in gems, gemcutting and jewelry have clustered together.  One building, with a freshly tiled blue roof, has a larger silver sign than the others.

title: [The BriarStone GemShop]
description: Dark ruby velvet curtains frame the shop's diamond-paned glaesine windows.  The richly panelled maoral walls are carved with fanciful scenes depicting sprites and pixies dancing in a forest glade.  A lone counter rests in the center of the room, behind which the shop's clerk waits patiently for clients to exchange their gems.

title: [Valina's Herbs and Tinctures]
description: Row upon row of tiny glaesine bottles line wooden shelves, which in turn crowd every bit of wall space in this tiny shop.  Baskets of herbs rest at the foot of a large thanot worktable.  An open doorway leads further into the building's interior, the occasional murmur of conversation drifting from within.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: A wide stonework archway separates the bazaar from the main wey, though the Sapphire Gate and its crowds are clearly visible beyond the granite structure.  Along the cobblestone route, fragrant honeysuckle vines cling to ornamental trellises, attracting florid butterflies and pollinating bees.

A wide stonework archway separates the bazaar from the main wey, though the Sapphire Gate and its crowds are clearly visible beyond the granite structure in the moonlight.  Along the cobblestone route, the closed buds of honeysuckle vines cling to ornamental trellises, while moths flit towards several lanterns.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: Drawing attention from passersby with their blazing hues, incarnadine blossoms of anemones and roses are interrupted by the pale petals of stargazer lilies.  A pair of grey-blue cottages with crimson silk awnings lie beyond the extravagant flower garden.  Standing between the entryways is a pristine marble statue clutching a gold-inked sign.

Cast in silvery moonlight, very few people pass through this portion of the bazaar at night.  A pair of grey-blue cottages with crimson silk awnings lie beyond an extravagant flower garden.  Standing between the entryways is a pristine marble statue clutching a gold-inked sign.

title: [Tamarkk's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a stained mahogany ceiling, a snarling war griffin painting hangs on one of the patterned white walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and a long mahogany rack sit in opposite corners while a life-sized granite maiden statue rests on a buffed cherrywood floor.

title: [Old News Pawnshop]
description: The many racks, shelves and display cases of this shop are brimming with assorted merchandise.  Torchlight glistens on several blades carefully displayed in a glass case by the window, strategically placed to catch the eye of passersby.  Two elven lads chatter between themselves as they busily polish some armor.  The west wall of the shop is handsomely decorated with an array of shields.  An intricately carved cabinet in the center of the shop appears to be heavily padlocked.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Branching off to the southeast, the cobblestoned road shows signs of wear that indicate frequent use.  A copse of trees stands nearby, birds atwitter in the tree branches.  A tall stone marker stands in front of the copse.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The road widens slightly, as trees begin to press closer to the edges of the cobblestones.  Twin grooves have been worn in the stones, evidence that wagons travel frequently on the road.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Above the treetops to the northwest, the shimmering blue spires of the Ta'Illistim belltowers can be seen.  The wind whistles through the trees, creating a hollow humming sound.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A large granite boulder, apparently fallen from the mountain's craggy cliffs in some distant age, lies beside the cobblestoned road.  Surrounded by a thick stand of monir trees, the boulder provides a convenient resting place for travellers, and a brief respite from the rigors of the journey.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Evidence of frequent travel along the cobblestone road manifests itself all around.  Twin grooves in its surface cut the road into three distinct parts, each roughly equal to the other.  Passersby talk with each other in hushed yet excited tones, as they wander toward and away from the city of Ta'Illistim.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A guard post has been erected here at a bend in the road.  The guard stands his post, eyeing the travellers and caravans as they move at a determined pace to their destinations.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Loose stones rattle underneath the feet of passing travellers as they continue their journey along this busy road.  The relatively close proximity of Ta'Illistim and its city guardsmen makes this as safe a passage as any in the city-states.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The cobblestone road narrows somewhat as it continues its long winding trek through the heart of the forest.  Off to the northeast a ruined cottage, nestled in a grove of trees, sits silently unused for an untold number of years.  The underbrush of the grove now grows up along the structure itself, making it difficult to identify as a building at all.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: This section of the roadway has fallen into a bit of disrepair.  The stones are cracked and worn, with some of them missing entirely, and the wagon grooves are deeper than what you've seen in other sections, as if their drivers tried to pass through this part of the road as quickly as possible.  The brush has grown tall along the northeast side of the road, but not enough to entirely conceal a narrow path leading northward.  The pathway is barely visible and doesn't seem to have been used much.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The road bends slightly here without much fanfaire as it winds along its course between the two great cities.  The cobblestones, each looking like the last, provide for an easy passage for travellers to continue on their way.

A small number of birds fly about overhead as you top a small hill where the cobblestone road bends slightly.  The birds seem to be engaging in some sort of dizzying dance in the air as they swoop amongst themselves in ever tightening circles.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A long section of road stretches before you in either direction with no apparent turn in sight.  The ever-present signs of constant travel along the roadway are as evident here as they are in other sections.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Fields of what appears to be wheat flank either side of the roadway.  Golden stalks sway slowly in the breeze providing a mesmerizing effect.  Each field is bordered by a dirt track that leads off into the distance, perhaps to some distant farm.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A slight bend in the road reveals a long section of farmland to the west.  The fields flank the road on the north and south, with crops ranging from wheat, to corn, to a mix of unrecognizable vegetables.  The land here appears rich and vibrant.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A small path reveals a rather unkempt stone building sitting far back from the road, its roof in a state of disrepair.  The building is a rather stark contrast to the otherwise rich farmland that surrounds it.  One window appears to have been broken at some distant time past, and has been patched with a piece of dirty oilcloth.  A metal sign hangs beside the front door, through which a few patrons wander.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The trees break toward the northwest, revealing rich fields of gold and green.  To the southeast the trees thicken, and the road seems to cut through them like a knife.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The winding cobblestone road crosses through a dense section of forest.  The thickness of the trees drowns out any moon or starlight from above, rendering it near impossible to mark loose stones or deep grooves along the road.

The winding cobblestone road crosses through a dense section of forest.  Whatever ambient light filtering in from above is muted, causing long shadows to play over the road making it difficult to mark loose stones or deep grooves.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A small wash crosses the road here, currently dry.  The years of seasonal change, with the evident rains and infrequent flooding, have made the stones of the road extremely smooth and nearly white from abrasion.  The road dips slightly at the wash, only to slope steadily upward on either side.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: An abandoned guard shack sits near a bend in the road.  Dark green moss covers the south side of the shack, and threatens to take over the whole of the stone structure.  It is not apparent how long the shack has sat empty, but it must be a long time, given the lack of upkeep evident.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Someone went to great lengths to add some color to the ordinarily drab cobblestone road.  A series of colored stones have been placed in a complex knotwork pattern, creating a striking effect.  The stones appear to be much newer than the original, yet the craftsmanship apparent in their laying shows the same high level of skill as the original construction.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The winding hills give way to an advancing forest off to the northwest, with the road cutting through the middle like a carving knife.  Small game trails crisscross the fields nearby, entering and exiting the road itself only to appear again on the other side.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The cobblestone road undulates up and down as it wanders along the low hillsides.  The roadway shows a remarkable resilience to weather and terrain, showing very little signs of wear or disrepair.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The road forks in odd directions here at the top of a low hill.  At the apex of the hill, three sections split northeast, northwest, and eastward down the hill.  Low rolling hills are visible on all sides, and a faint breeze shifts the underbrush and tall grass in rhythmic motion.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The road bends through a patch of woods, sloping upward toward the top of a low hillside.  Toward the southeast, white plumes of smoke can be seen rising up between the trees, marking what might be a settlement or small town.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The rolling hills to the northwest begin to fade and flatten toward the southeast.  As the landscape flattens out, rich fields containing crops of all sorts are visible along the roadside.  Each farm appears to be rotating between wheat and corn along this part of the road.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The farmhouses and fields are closer together here as the road nears the village of Sylvarraend.  One of the farmers has left a plow nearby, apparently in preparation to till one of the fields for a new crop.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Rolled hay lies in the fields on either side of the road, waiting for a farmer to come haul the hay back to the barn.  The rich fields stretch for miles on end, indicating that the community of Sylvarraend might account for a very large portion of the base foodstuffs for both Ta'Illistim and Ta'Vaalor alike.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Small plumes of white smoke dot the hillsides on either side of the road, indicating a small community of farmhouses among the fields.  The landscape nearby is cultivated and ready for planting, and the roadway appears well worn and used.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Small beds of profusely blooming flowers have been planted alongside this section of the road, testament to the nearby hamlet of Sylvarraend.  The night breeze ruffles the nodding buds and petals, sending a deliciously relaxing fragrance across the road.

Small beds of profusely blooming flowers have been planted alongside this section of the road, testament to the nearby hamlet of Sylvarraend.  The day's breeze ruffles the nodding buds and petals, sending a deliciously relaxing fragrance across the road.

title: [Sylvarraend, Wooded Trail]
description: Although thickly carpeted with grass, the trail is indented with two long dirt grooves, indicating that small wagons pass this way with some regularity.  An abandoned wooden wheelbarrow rests to one side of the trail, thoughtfully planted with multicolored peonies and snapdragons.  The night breeze wafts the flowers' fragrance gently through the air.

Although thickly carpeted with grass, the trail is indented in two long dirt grooves, indicating that small wagons pass this way with some regularity.  An abandoned wooden wheelbarrow rests to one side of the trail, thoughtfully planted with multicolored peonies and snapdragons.  Shafts of sunlight filter through the trees.

title: [Sylvarraend, Wooded Trail]
description: Two large oaks stand sentinel on either side of the widening trail, gentle keepers and old warriors.  Several dark red rosebushes grow around the bases of the trees, their tenacious arms winding around the trunks, cascading garnet-hued blooms overhead in drifting masses.

A sturdy treehouse has been built between the two oaks, spanning across the path.  A knotted rope dangles a few feet from the ground to the side of the path.

title: [Sylvarraend, Wooded Trail]
description: A small wooden sign stands to one side of the trail, surrounded by a low slate-walled flowerbed.  Beneath the sign, roses, blaeston, lace, and anemones grow in wild profusion, spilling over the short surrounding stone wall in their eagerness to profligate.

title: [Sylvarraend, Small Glade]
description: A small cottage lies to one side of the widening trail, surrounded by a wooden fence and spacious yard.  The glaes-paned windows glow pale amber in the dark night, reflecting warmth from the firelight inside.  The heady scent of geraniums thickens the night air.  Off to one side of the yard is a large wooden shed.  Uncut logs are piled about an old stump.

A small cottage lies to one side of the widening trail.  From its neatly thatched roof to the impeccably stacked stone walls, the cottage appears to be well loved.  Bright red geraniums flower in small wooden boxes beneath each glaes-paned window.

title: [Sylvarraend, Wooded Trail]
description: The trail winds around a small pond overhung with moss-draped oaks.  Resting quietly on the moonlit surface of the pond, several ducks have tucked heads beneath wings for the night.
