Raised murals depict various scenes of brave adventurers battling foes with their ladies fair in the background cheering them onward.  Overhead, the sunlight projecting through the stained-glass skylight sprays the room with a rainbow of colors.  Scattered around the area are chairs which provide a little respite for the weary.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, out

title: [Gemcutter's, Front Room]
description: Inside the Gemcutter's shop, you see two glass showcases holding jewelry and precious stones.  Directly ahead of you is a low desk with several racks holding tools of the Gemcutter's trade.

title: [Crimson Crocus Table]
description: Three bright blue bowls on the table contrast sharply with the crimson crocuses blooming in them.  The combination of the thick, light green leaves and red blossoms against the ceramic pottery is very eye-catching.

title: [Masked Hills, Hairline Ridge]
description: The trail continues at a cruel angle along the ridge.  The air is noticeably thinner here, causing your heart to struggle to supply your muscles with much-needed oxygen.

title: [Hall of Justice, Courtroom]
description: Rows of benches occupy most of the stately courtroom.  High above, the silver-edged sapphire banner of House Illistim hangs from the wooden rafters.  On the far wall, you see a large oaken desk occupied by the Court Justice.  Guardsmen flank either side of the desk, glaring out into the crowd as if their stares could pacify them.  Here, all come to be judged.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Hall of Justice]
description: The high stone walled room is rather featureless, save for a towering statue which dominates the center of the room.  The statue appears to be that of a heavily armored swordsman, his sword pointed downward as if judging all who enter.  Opposite the Hall's entrance, you can see another set of double doors leading to the courtroom.

title: [Hall of Justice, Clerk's Office]
description: Stacks of files and papers occupy most of the available space in this small square room.  Behind a long wooden desk, the court clerk sits quietly pouring over some paperwork, occasionally pausing to mark a document with the seal of the court.  The only other permanent fixture in the office seems to be the two city guardsmen that flank the clerk on either side of the desk.

title: [Ghost Town, Town Center]
description: A wooden sign swings crookedly from the remains of a doorframe nearby.  Bits of broken glass and bottles litter the ground, scattered amongst splinters of burned and rotted wood.  Scraggly tufts of grass struggle for purchase amid the wreckage of the structure.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Wraithenmist, Ghost Town]
description: The remains of a wooden building have long since toppled to the ground, the bits of scorched wood rotting and disintegrating into the earth beneath.  Whatever destroyed this place, it left little to mark the former inhabitants' presence.

title: [Wraithenmist, Ghost Town]
description: A single stone wall remains of what was once a structure of unknown purpose.  Glimmering lichen coats the ancient stones, casting a dim sickly glow across the ground.  Several stands of pale white mushrooms hug the base of the wall.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The spindly limbs of long-dead maoral trees reach blindly into the misty air, searching for sunlight that exists no more in this shadowed place.  Despite the lack of stirring air, the mist swirls about the trees as if it has a will of its own.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: A huge maoral has fallen across the trail, its leafless limbs crushed against the sodden ground.  A host of fungi, competing with the elements to see which force can devour the rotting wood more quickly, have colonized the tree's pulpy trunk.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: Glimmering droplets of moisture coat the moss-covered trees and rocks, occasionally dripping to the sodden ground with a soft *plunk*.  A pile of massive boulders blocks the view to the east, the encroaching mist slamming harmlessly against the stone.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The trail wends its way up a steep hillside dotted with small trees which, at some point in their long-ago lives, found purchase in the rocky soil.  A pile of boulders blocks progress westward.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The trail moves along the edge of the ridgeline, skirting the bases of the massive trees dotting the cliffside.  Large granite boulders, many covered in glowing lichen, jut raggedly from the ground.

title: [Wraithenmist, Whisper Hollow]
description: The mist thins somewhat in this small clearing.  A lone hollow tree occupies the center of the area, its dark grey bark nearly covered in silvery moss.  The hollow is so quiet it seems even a whisper could be carried far away.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The dead trees thin somewhat, the rocky ground having made it difficult for them to colonize more ground in their days of life.  A pile of large rocks blocks the trail.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: A fallen maoral obscures the trail.  Various forms of fungi and moss have attached themselves to the rotting wood, competing for purchase on the sodden pulpy mass.

title: [Wraithenmist, Ghost Town]
description: A stone chimney, built of small mica-flecked granite blocks, juts out of the ground at a drunken angle.  Piles of debris are mounded before the opening of the chimney's firebox.  The wooden walls of the original structure, burned to the ground from the looks of things, have nearly rotted away completely.

title: [Wraithenmist, Ghost Town]
description: The lone stone structure in the village still stands, its wooden door and windowframes long since gone.  The building's granite stonework is blanketed with tarry black soot, a clear indication that the building was burned at some point.  Whatever roof the structure might have had has also vanished, likely consumed in the blaze.

title: [Wraithenmist, Ghost Town]
description: The remains of a dock jut over the lake to the north, most of the boards long since gone.  Bits of broken pottery dot the landscape, some lying flat and others protruding from the sodden ground at odd angles.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeshore]
description: Glittering droplets of moisture fall intermittently from the barren tree limbs above, each one dropping with a small *plunk* into the lake.  Ripples form briefly with each drop, but the lake too quickly returns to its glassy calm.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeshore]
description: The mist rolls atop the glassy water, writhing and turning in unexpected directions before rolling back on itself.  Dully gleaming stones, somewhat damp with condensation, lie scattered about the bank of the lake.

title: [Wraithenmist, Ruined Dock]
description: Most of the wooden dock has broken and fallen into the water below, just enough of the boards remaining to allow passage across the dock if one is careful with where one steps.  The glassy black water of the Lake of Shadowed Sorrows glints malevolently through the holes in the dock.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeshore Trail]
description: The black lake stretches into the distance, as far as the thick mist will permit one to see.  The leafless boughs of the forest's ancient trees lean above, reaching their bony arms over the water.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lake View]
description: The murky black waters of the lake pool at the edges of the trail, opaque even at what must surely be a depth of only a few inches.  Not a single ripple disturbs the surface of the lake.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lake View]
description: The forest suddenly ends at the edge of the Lake of Shadowed Sorrows.  Mist roils off the lake's surface in writhing silvery clouds, almost as if the lake is warmer than the surrounding air.

title: [Wraithenmist, Misty Trail]
description: Silvery moss hangs from the trees in damp tendrils.  Their foliage long since gone, the dead trees wear the shimmering moss as their only clothing, the undulating tufts dangling from starkly jutting limbs.

title: [Wraithenmist, Misty Trail]
description: A shimmering patch of lichen grows upon a nearby tree, having covered the tree's bark so thoroughly that it's impossible to discern the tree's species.  The lichen, oddly luminescent, casts a sickly glow across the trail.

title: [Wraithenmist, Misty Trail]
description: The mist rolling in from the lake thickens considerably, making it nearly impossible to see more than a few feet in any direction.  Only the sound of dripping water breaks the utter silence of the forest.

title: [Wraithenmist, Misty Trail]
description: A thin sheen of moisture coats the trunks of the nearby trees.  Occasionally, enough of the condensation forms in one area to pool and dribble down the lifeless vegetation to the sodden ground.

title: [Wraithenmist, Misty Trail]
description: The trail forks three ways, each path disappearing into the mist only a few feet distant.  Thickly crowded tree trunks, most devoid of leafy vegetation, encroach upon the trail like menacing skeletons.

title: [Wraithenmist, Misty Trail]
description: The trail threads its way through the thickening forest, barely visible in the eerie light filtering through the mist.  Droplets of condensation fall to the ground with a soft *plop*, their incessant noise the only sound to be heard.

title: [Wraithenmist, Misty Trail]
description: Glimmering bits of fungus cling to the trunks of the nearby trees, shining like silvery jewels through the thickening mist.  The trail, barely visible, skirts the edges of a stand of leafless monir trees.

title: [Wraithenmist, Maze of Mist]
description: The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible to even see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible even to see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Wraithenmist, Maze of Mist]
description: The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible to even see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible even to see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

title: [Wraithenmist, Boughs of Shadow]
description: Three sections of trail converge in this small clearing.  No grass grows underfoot, only a greyish mossy substance that apparently needs little light to thrive.  The mist rolling in from the lake thickens as it finds the pocket of air between the trees.

title: [Wraithenmist, Boughs of Shadow]
description: An old haon tree has fallen beside the path, crushing a number of smaller trees beneath its bulk.  Faintly luminescent lichen, emitting an eerie glow into the misty air, covers the dead tree's trunk in large patches.

title: [Wraithenmist, Boughs of Shadow]
description: Haon trees crowd the path, their silvery bark shimmering slightly with the condensation from the ever-present mist.  A small patch of pale white mushrooms grow near the base of one gnarled old tree, the fungus yet one more predator in this forest of many.

title: [Wraithenmist, Boughs of Shadow]
description: The mist thins somewhat as the trees grow more closely together.  Thick bushes press close to the trail, making progress through the area difficult.  An old metal trap lies to one side of the trail, barely visible beneath the bushes, and rusted nearly beyond recognition.

title: [Wraithenmist, Forest Trail]
description: The trail winds through a thick stand of haon, the silvery blue tree trunks barely visible in the thick grey fog blanketing the area.  An oddly glowing lichen coats a nearby boulder, illuminating the area with an odd greenish cast.

title: [Wraithenmist, Forest Trail]
description: The mist thickens, becoming ever more oppressive.  Tendrils of moss hang low from the ancient monir tree standing beside the trail, leaking the occasional droplet of condensation to the ground with a soft *plop*.

title: [Wraithenmist, Shrouded Trail]
description: The trail splits in three directions, each disappearing into the mist a few feet away.  The weighty limbs of an ancient tree hang low over the trail, forcing passersby to duck beneath.  Moss drips from the limbs in silvery clumps.

title: [Wraithenmist, Shrouded Trail]
description: The ever-present silvery mist clings, creating a thin, damp coating on everything from the ground to the foliage on the surrounding trees and underbrush.  Patches of luminescent moss coat the gnarled roots of a nearby tree.

title: [Wraithenmist, Shrouded Trail]
description: The mist rolling in from the lake penetrates the thick forest, combining with the encroaching bushes and leafy boughs to create a suffocating atmosphere.  Glowing lichen, peering from the gloom as if it were tiny eyes, grows in small spots upon many of the trees.

title: [Wraithenmist, Crooked Fork]
description: The faint trail branches off in three directions, each leading back into the thick forest, from this small clearing.  A single spot of sky is visible through a break in the trees directly above, allowing a narrow shaft of moonlight to penetrate the clearing.

The faint trail branches off in three directions, each leading back into the thick forest, from this small clearing.  A single spot of sky is visible through a break in the trees directly above, allowing a narrow shaft of daylight to penetrate the clearing.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeside Trail]
description: The trail winds its way towards the edge of the Lake of Shadowed Sorrows.  Pale silver mist rolls off the lake, penetrating the thickly growing trees and limiting visibility to only a dozen feet or so.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeside Trail]
description: The water of the lake laps at the edge of the trail.  Calm as glass, the surface of the lake is so black that the depths are completely impenetrable to the eye.  Tendrils of mist rise from the water, as if it is warmer than the air above its surface.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeside Trail]
description: A few random shafts of moonlight pierce the thick fog rolling off the lake, making the tendrils of mist appear as if they are writhing endlessly.  The trail nearly disappears beneath the edge of the opaque black water, lapping about the ankles of any who care to tread through the area.

A few random shafts of light pierce the thick fog rolling off the lake, making the tendrils of mist appear as if they are writhing endlessly.  The trail nearly disappears beneath the edge of the opaque black water, lapping about the ankles of any who care to tread through the area.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeside Trail]
description: The mist thickens to the point that it seems almost suffocating.  The ancient trees press ever closer to the edge of the lake, leaving scant room for passage between their gnarled roots and the murky water.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeside Trail]
description: Wisps of mist drift off the lake's gloomy surface, twisting and turning as if living beings.  An ancient gnarled maoral tree grows near the lake's edge, the thick twisted roots disappearing beneath the black waters.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeside Trail]
description: The path disappears completely beneath the edge of the lake, wherever it once led apparently submerged in the black depths forever.  The thick fog grows ever more oppressive, making it difficult to breathe freely.

title: [Wraithenmist, Fishing Hut]
description: An abandoned hut lies near the water's edge.  Remnants of fishing nets, the rope in tattered and rotten shreds, hang from metal hooks imbedded in the hut's stone walls.

title: [Wraithenmist, Fishing Hut]
description: The roof of the hut has long since rotted away, but bits and pieces of the thatch cling to the tops of the stone walls.  An overturned table lies in the center of the packed earthen floor.  Little moonlight manages to penetrate the canopy of trees overhead, leaving the room gloomy despite its lack of a roof.

The roof of the hut has long since rotted away, but bits and pieces of the thatch cling to the tops of the stone walls.  An overturned table lies in the center of the packed earthen floor.  Little daylight manages to penetrate the canopy of trees overhead, leaving the room gloomy despite its lack of a roof.

title: [Wraithenmist, Fishing Hut]
description: Bits and pieces of fishing tackle, including several large barbed hooks, are actually embedded in the rear wall of the hut, as if they were placed there by the force of some extreme blast of energy.  The remnants of a wooden chair, fractured into splinters and half rotted away, lie scattered across the floor.

title: [Wraithenmist, Fishing Dock]
description: Half the dock has rotted away and fallen into the murky black depths of the Lake of Shadowed Sorrows, leaving only a scant few feet of board upon which to gain footing.  The water below, although perfectly still, glimmers as if alive.  A doorway leads back into the fishing hut.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Trail]
description: The trail wends its way among the towering trees, the worn groove of its delineation barely visible beneath the thick underbrush.  No light penetrates the canopy of boughs above, making it difficult to tell if it is day or night.  Rocks covered with the strange glowing lichen litter the ground beneath the trees.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Trail]
description: The occasional call of a bird is the only sound that disturbs the eerie silence of the forest.  An oddly luminescent moss grows on the tree trunks, covering the bark in areas as large as the span of a hand.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Trail]
description: An ancient tree lies across the path, the wood half-rotted and infested with insects.  Several small boulders, apparently overturned and moved aside at some time long past, lie alongside the path.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Trail]
description: The trail winds its way into the edge of the forest, twisting around enormous tree trunks and bushes so tall and thick they stand higher than a giantman.  Odd vines climb the trees, twisting in a sinuous pattern around the trunks and draping themselves across limbs with a snake-like grace.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Trail]
description: The path leads further northward into a forest so thick with trees that little light is able to penetrate the canopy above.  The area is strangely quiet, completely absent of the sounds one would expect to hear within a forest.

title: [Sylvarraend Road, Boulder]
description: From the top of the smooth boulder, the view of Ta'Illistim's famed spires is breathtaking.  Reaching towards the sky as if they were attempting to pluck the stars from the heavens, the lapis tiles glitter in the moonlight.

From the top of the smooth boulder, the view of Ta'Illistim's famed spires is breathtaking.  Reaching towards the sky as if they were attempting to pluck the stars from the heavens, the lapis tiles glitter in the day's light.

title: [Dragonspine and Rolaren]
description: Dragonspine Avenue is the main street of Kharam-Dzu.  Most of the people you see are well-to-do dwarves, nattily dressed and apparently in a rush.  The buildings all look new.  Even the cobblestone streets are immaculately clean.  A sturdy set of glaes-banded mithril doors leads into a low stone structure.  The two guards outside clench their pikes tightly, peering closely at all who approach.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [The Bank of Kharam-Dzu]
description: Surly dwarves grumble in line, clutching their coin-purses to their chests.  Opposite the doors is a high, black steel counter.  A spectacled dwarf is perched behind it, squinting at you from atop his tall chair.  All around him, bald heads and flailing hands bob up and down frantically.  The clinking of coins mixes with giggles of glee from the back.

title: [Rolaren Street, River Crossing]
description: A cobblestone road leads east into the commercial center of the town.  Leaning against a stone guardpost, a uniformed dwarf appraises those who pass.  You hear angry shouts from inside the building.  Streams of people cross the stone bridge to the west, which spans the River Muagh.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Plaza Northeast]
description: The burbling of the river and the buzz of the crowd blend together, and you can hear little else for the din.  A stout stone bridge spans the river Muagh, crossing east toward the commercial district.  Down by the river's edge squats a fat old dwarf.  He sits and stares into the water, mumbling to no one in particular.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Plaza Northwest]
description: You elbow your way through a throng of people headed to and from the western bridge.  Most are dwarves, but you also see giantmen, humans and even the odd elf or halfling.  Before you stands the Golden Helm Inn, a prosperous-looking establishment with a uniformed dwarf at the door.

The area is fairly quiet.  Only the occasional dwarf passes by, with the occasional giantman, elf, or halfling moving through as well.  The Inn, a prosperous-looking establishment, stands proudly with  at the door.

The area is fairly quiet.  Only the occasional dwarf passes by, with the occasional giantman, elf, or halfling moving through as well.  The Inn, a prosperous-looking establishment, stands proudly with a uniformed dwarf at the door.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, down

title: [Golden Helm, Lobby]
description: The thick stone walls are hung with rich tapestries in velvet and silk.  A variety of battle-worn weapons are also displayed, some so old you have never seen their like.  An open guest registry book lies on the ornately-carved rosewood front desk, which faces the front doors.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Plaza Southwest]
description: A stout marble tower dominates this corner of the plaza, standing nearly fifty feet high.  Members of various races wander about, some lingering on the marble benches flanking the plaza.  On the far western shore of the river, the ramshackle buildings of the poor quarter are covered by a constant haze.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Tower]
description: The view from the tower is spectacular.  The city is spread out before you, huddled in a valley beneath the great mountain Stormbrow.  Far to the northeast, beyond the walls, the sky is lit with a dim, red glow.  To the northwest, you see only mist.  A white glaes statue of a dwarf stands tall on a podium, gazing over the town.
The view from the tower is spectacular.  The city is huddled in a valley beneath the great mountain Stormbrow.  A white glaes statue of a dwarf stands tall on a podium, gazing over the town.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Plaza Southeast]
description: Stone benches flank a white marble fountain, and the pleasant burblings nearly drown out the sounds of the city.  A stand of modwir trees is home to a flock of pigeons, cooing softly to one another.  On the far eastern shore of the river, you see the bustling commercial center of Kharam-Dzu.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Under The Bridge]
description: It is cool and dark under the bridge, and the rushing river drowns out the sounds of the city above.  Something twitches in the darkness, where the bare earth meets the stone.  Off to one side, a small group of grimy, shabbily-dressed dwarves sits in a circle, mumbling quietly at one another.

It is cool and dark under the bridge, and the rushing river drowns out the sounds of the city above.  Something twitches in the shadows, where the bare earth meets the stone.  Off to one side, a small group of grimy, shabbily-dressed dwarves sits in a circle, mumbling quietly at one another.

title: [Garnet Street, River Crossing]
description: Throngs of people stream over the stone bridge, half bound for the residential west side, the rest for the dwarven quarter on the river's opposite shore.  Through the mob, you notice a gnarled old woman sitting alone, out of the traffic, a brilliant, fascinated smile spreading across her wrinkled face.

title: [Silver and Garnet]
description: Lines of slender dwellings built edge-to-edge stretch along the cobbles, their cantilevered balconies providing shelter to pedestrians who stroll casually along beneath them.  Long wooden troughs fixed atop the railings overflow with plantlife.

Lines of slender dwellings built edge-to-edge stretch along the cobbles, their cantilevered balconies giving shade to pedestrians who stroll casually along beneath them.  Long wooden troughs fixed atop the railings overflow with infinite palettes of color.  Rainbow swathes of pink, blue, yellow, red, violet and cream flow in awnings over your head.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Silver and Emerald]
description: Immense trees and tall, gaunt houses crowd the cobbles, hovering in like suspicious sentinels guarding the road.  Wood-slatted gates bar entry to steps which lead up to the dwellings.

Immense trees and tall, gaunt houses crowd the cobbles, hovering in like suspicious sentinels guarding the road.  Wood-slatted gates bar entry to steps which lead up to the dwellings, their shadows falling faintly into the street.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Emerald Street, River's Edge]
description: The street widens sharply to the east in a delta of smoother stone, giving way at its end to a lawn of low-cut green grass.  Several dwarven warriors rest on the turf, leaning lazily against the taut canvas side of a tent.

The street widens sharply to the east in a delta of smoother stone, giving way at its end to a lawn of low-cut green grass.  Several dwarven warriors rest on the turf, leaning lazily against the taut canvas side of a red and white tent.

title: [The Healer's Tent]
description: Rough leather cots line the circular wall, separated by small tripods spaced evenly between each pair.  A brusque dwarf eyes you with a steady glare, his lip curled into a snarl of deepening impatience.

title: [Empath Guild, Entrance]
description: A perfectly level pathway of smoothed white marble stones runs between the exit to the north and the polished silver gates to the south.  On either side of the path crushed and tinted limestone creates a pebbly carpet of green.  A thick white limestone wall extending east and west supports the gates as well as a host of lit torches.  Two statues poised atop the walls, one on each side of the gate, stretch a banner between them, and a polished silver sign on the gate announces ownership of this area.

A perfectly level pathway of smoothed white marble stones runs between the exit to the north and the polished silver gates to the south.  On either side of the path crushed and tinted limestone creates a pebbly carpet of green.  A thick white limestone wall extending east and west supports the gates as well as a host of unlit torches.  Two statues poised atop the walls, one on each side of the gate, stretch a banner between them, and a polished silver sign on the gate announces ownership of this area.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Bazaar SW]
description: A pair of streets meet the Bazaar here in a sprawling confluence of worn cobble.  Crowds of people bustle in and out, some pausing to mill amongst friends and neighbors, others hustling busily on their ways.  Several stone figurines stand at the fringe, watching the drama of town life as it whooshes by.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Bazaar SE]
description: A canvas awning stands above the open archway of The Mother Lode, as anonymous figures stroll into and out of the Inn.  Standing nonchalantly to one side of the arch, a group of well-dressed giants banters amiably back and forth.

A green canvas awning shades the open archway of The Mother Lode, casting its shadow over anonymous figures as they stroll into and out of the Inn.  Standing nonchalantly to one side of the arch, a group of well-dressed giants banters amiably back and forth.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Bazaar NE]
description: Vertical sandalwood boards panel the front of a tall building wedged snugly into the town wall's northeastern corner.  Arrows of various types dangle from the outcropping roofline, swaying lazily with the commotion of bodies rushing by.  Hanging above a narrow door, a tremendous greatbow draws your eye.

title: [Big Snorri's Bows]
description: The smell of fresh shaved wood drifts through the air in this large shop.  Barrels of arrows line the walls while just over them, shelves holding bows and crossbows of various types stretch from wall to wall.  Like thick spider webs, bowstrings of different lengths hang from the ceiling.  Standing in the middle of the room is a giant counter.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Bazaar NW]
description: The broad edifice of the Kharam-Dzu library dominates this corner of the bazaar, its beams and pillars of thick timber supporting massive granite blocks mortared seamlessly top-to-bottom and end-to-end.  Wooden benches flank an arched entryway, extending to the structure's corners in either direction.  Sitting cross-legged on the cobbles, a young elven academian rests his back against the building as he peers attentively into his book.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Citrine and Gold]
description: High, pruned shrubs run in from the east and west, and bend south to form a brushy barrier between the street and the western wall.  A painted door presses through the foliage to the inside, giving notice of a small bungalow to which it offers entry.  Sounds of conversation and laughter waft out from the shop, accompanied by the sweet, earthy smell of fresh tobacco.

High, pruned shrubs run in from the east and west, and bend south to form a brushy barrier between the street and the western wall.  A brightly-painted red door presses through the foliage to the inside, giving notice of a small bungalow to which it offers entry.  Sounds of conversation and laughter waft out from the shop, accompanied by the sweet, earthy smell of fresh tobacco.

title: [Citrine Street]
description: Angular boxwood hedge walls loom to the north and south, bringing the street to an abrupt terminus at its western end.  A knobby pebble path leads away from a thin gap in the hedge.

Angular boxwood hedge walls loom to the north and south, bringing the street to an abrupt terminus at its western end.  A knobby pebble path leads away from a thin gap in the hedge into the cool shade beyond.

title: [Citrine Street, In the Hedge]
description: The boxwood surrounds a small clearing, making it seem protected even though a bit stuffy in the island heat.  Birdsong serenades the enclosure, its performers well hidden within the hedge.

title: [Diamond and Gold]
description: Sculpted boxwood hedges proceed unbroken on either side of you, giving this narrow stretch of road a comforting feeling of confinement.  The air is cool as it filters over the tops of the hedges, caressing your face and bringing a refreshing woodsy aroma to your nose.

title: [Emerald and Gold]
description: The street's shrubbery border ends on the western side, bumping to a halt against the corner of a low building jutting into its path.  Thick gray rocks, chipped into vaguely rectangular shapes, form a stout foundation, their robustly rough surfaces giving the structure an appearance of stability and strength.  Mortared solidly on top, smaller slabs taper slightly to a tarnished tin roof.  A squat stone chimney is perched haughtily at its peak.

title: [Terasian Seating Emporium]
description: Wooden shutters have been propped open, a balmy breeze slipping in and carrying the heady fragrance of native flowers.  The greenery against the outer walls almost encroaches on the windows, lending an exotic air to the setting.  Comfortable chairs are arranged in small groupings, a neatly-lettered sign perched upon each, describing the variety of colors they can be made in.  A length of woven fiber is draped over a door leading into a back workroom.

title: [Terasian Seating Emporium]
description: The rectangular-shaped space has chairs of all imaginable sizes and shapes arranged in tiny rows off a central aisle.  Looking more like an eclectic meeting room than a shop, the only clue is a piece of parchment scrawled with numbers that represent a suggested price placed on the seat of each chair.  A rattan counter sits at the far back of the room, forcing potential customers to walk past the items on display.

title: [Silver and Sapphire]
description: Empty of people and void of buildings, this quiet stretch of road seems a perfect place to stop for a moment and forget the hectic bustle of life.  Supple canver trees bend inward, their crowns twining together in a lush green arch over the street.  Clumps of flowers gaze down from among the branches.

Empty of people and void of buildings, this quiet stretch of road seems a perfect place to stop for a moment and forget the hectic bustle of life.  Supple canver trees bend inward, their crowns twining together in a lush green arch over the street.  Clumps of flowers gaze cheerfully down from among the branches, smiling brightly as you walk by.

title: [Sapphire and Copper]
description: The town wall blends to a corner against the ivy-covered stone of a large dwelling, funneling the street off to the south and east.  A rusting wrought-iron gate rests between two slabs of crumbling rock wall, feebly guarding a cracked walkway which leads up to the house.

title: [Ruby and Copper]
description: The street narrows here between clumps of overgrown bushes, their gnarled branches groping toward you like the hairy tentacles of a hungry beast.  Several copper roofs peak above, thrusting their chimneys into the sky in defiant gesture against the unkempt state of their surroundings.

The street narrows here between clumps of overgrown bushes, their gnarled branches groping toward you like the hairy tentacles of a hungry beast.  Several copper roofs peak above, thrusting their bright red chimneys into the sky in defiant gesture against the unkempt state of their surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Copper Avenue]
description: A row of drab buildings borders the eastern side of the street, the grey faces staring, expressionless, across the way into a line of thin trees straggling along the town wall.  Pushed by a slight-but-steady breeze, pieces of twig chatter along the cobbles, as if in answer to the low whisper rustling incessantly through the leaves.  A line of grimy dwarves in miner's gear tramps south, each one glancing at you as he passes.

title: [Copper Avenue]
description: A low cloud of soot covers everything in a dark, sulphurous haze.  A large stone building belches smoke.  Hooves clattering against the cobbles, a line of burros pull small wooden carts from the south.  The carts are piled high with lumps of glaes ore.  Scowling and cursing, the drovers urge their charges onward with the heavy load.  The burros glare right back at the dwarves.

title: [Copper Avenue, West Docks]
description: Clanging bells, steam whistles and hoarse dwarven shouts crowd the air of this busy port.  Squat ferryboats wallow in from a gaping hole in the mountain just to the south.  They are piled high with lumps of raw ore and pick-bearing dwarves.  A large building to the northwest belches forth great clouds of black soot, and everything here has a layer of grime.

title: [Teras Travel Office]
description: This ticket office appears to be nothing more than a remodelled fishing shack.  A small display case contains a detailed model of the Glaesen Star.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Poor Quarter]
description: Weathered clapboards, dulled to an ashen grey, pull away from the sides of the old warehouse.  Even the cobblestone street veers away from the dilapidated building.  Bare windows in the upper story gaze sightlessly to the broken pavement below.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Poor Quarter]
description: A pall of soot hangs in the air like a greasy black cloud.  The ramshackle housing is ill-kept, the windows boarded up or broken.  Dwarves clad in rags shuffle along without looking up.  From under a pile of rotting planks, a mangy cat stares out at you with dull red eyes.

A pall of soot hangs in the air like a greasy black cloud.  The ramshackle housing is ill-kept, the windows boarded up or broken.  Dwarves clad in rags shuffle along without looking up.  From the shadows under a pile of rotting planks, a mangy cat stares out at you with dull red eyes.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Poor Quarter]
description: Clouds of ash choke the air, and the buildings here are covered with soot.  Broken windows, peeling paint and rotting wooden timbers all mark the general decay.  Shabbily-dressed dwarves filter through the creaking double doors of a seedy tavern.  To the southwest, a dilapidated pile of planks serves as a makeshift gate into Pig Puddle Lane.

Clouds of ash choke the air, and the buildings here are covered with soot.  Broken windows, peeling paint and rotting wooden timbers all mark the general decay.  Shabbily-dressed dwarves filter through the creaking double doors of a seedy tavern, tucked back into the shadows.  To the southwest, a dilapidated pile of planks serves as a makeshift gate into Pig Puddle Lane.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Poor Quarter]
description: Abandoned homes huddle against the cliff face.  Their windows and doors are boarded up, but many have gaping holes in the walls.  Few people wander by. The quiet is broken only by a distant string of rants and curses, which echo off the canyon walls.  One old dwarf, clad in soiled rags, sleeps in the street.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Poor Quarter]
description: The road ends here in the shadow of a burnt-out manor.  The residents of Kharam-Dzu never set foot here, speaking of it only in whispers, and gazing up at the ruins you shudder a moment.  The charred shell was once a grand and elegant home, leaving you wondering what brought its downfall.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Poor Quarter]
description: Tumble-down houses lean against one another like tired old drunks.  On the north side of the street, an abandoned warehouse squats in a haze of soot.  A shabby-looking group of dwarves, humans and others huddles before it, muttering quietly to one another.  One of the dwarves seems to be staring at you from beneath the hood of his grimy cloak.

title: [Silver and Ruby]
description: Well off the beaten path, a rock cottage peers out at the street from behind a barricade of large trees and bushy foliage.  Although you can't quite put your finger on it, something definitely strikes you as very odd about the little house.

title: [Garnet Street]
description: Garnet comes to a dead end here, flanked on its sides by rough brick buildings and terminated to the west by a segment of the town's wall extended to match the height of the surrounding structure.  An alley leads off to the south.

Garnet comes to a dead end here, flanked on its sides by rough brick buildings and terminated to the west by a segment of the town's wall extended to match the height of the surrounding structure.  An alley leads off to the south, into darkness.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Dark Alley]
description: The narrow street lies dormant with gray sights, scents and sounds of a place ever untouched by light.  Nothing speaks.  Nothing moves.  Nothing seems to recognize your existence except for small puffs of dust which settle at your feet.  A sense of unease builds in your gut, prodding you to move onward.

title: [Locks Picked & Lockpicks]
description: Darkness seems to be the theme for this room as it has no lighting save for what washes in from the entrance.  Before you is a short wooden counter with an odd-looking tree of keys resting on it.  You notice a small note just under the tree.  Behind the counter, a slit-eyed halfling watches you with a practice-wary gaze.

Darkness seems to be the theme for this room as it has no lighting save for what washes in from the entrance.  Before you is a short wooden counter with an odd-looking tree of keys resting on it, beneath which is a small note.  A dusty wooden crate sits in a shadowed corner.  Behind the counter, a slit-eyed halfling watches you with a practice-wary gaze.

title: [Dragonspine and Ora]
description: Preoccupied folk make their way along this wide and busy avenue.  A crew of broom-wielding dwarves sweeps the street clean of rubbish, working quickly under their supervisor's glare.  To the west is the Company Store, which draws a steady flow of traffic to and fro.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Ora Street]
description: The Borthuum Company Store towers over you, a massive block of solid stone.  Its windowless bulk is broken only by a wide set of mithril double-doors.  Dwarves and other folk crowd through, many carrying sacks or bags.  Beyond the store to the west, a heavily laden cog sits low in the water of the River Muagh.

title: [The Company Store, Lobby]
description: Lanterns burn brightly here, compensating for the lack of windows.  Voices drift down the eastern hallway, as people wait their turn for the public lockers.  A group of dwarves cradling exotic weapons jostles past you toward the stairs.

title: [Company Store, Pawnbroker]
description: This pawnshop seems fairly prosperous and upscale.  It is clean, though somewhat cluttered, and brightly lit.  The counter is made of a local hardwood and is polished to a bright luster.  Despite the obvious efforts to protect the counter top, a few scars tell of heavy usage.  A small pile of weapons is neatly stacked to one side while one of the assistants busily records their receipt.

title: [Company Store, Pelts & Mandible]
[Company Store, Pelt & Mandible]
description: Pelts and skins from several creatures are tacked to the walls.  Several creatures have been stuffed and mounted.  Looking behind you, you see over the red archway a huge bone that looks like a giant rib.  It spans from the floor, over the archway and back to the floor again.  The counter before you is haphazardly covered with several hides, as the proprietor has yet to remove them from the counter.

Several creatures have been stuffed and mounted around the room, while the pelts and skins of others are tacked to the walls.  Spanning the red archway is a huge bone that looks like a giant rib.  The counter before you is haphazardly covered with several hides, apparently awaiting proper storage.  A rickety staircase leads down toward the source of some very powerful odors.

title: [Clerical Supply]
description: The room is surprisingly empty.  A marble counter stands near the rear of the shop, leaving little space behind it.  A scroll rack lines the back wall while a large hanging sign blocks much of the area from view.

title: [Company Store, Armory]
description: Large display cases line the room and provide customers with examples of local wares.  Shields of varying size and description, and of several different materials, are mounted high up on the walls.  Armor mounted upon stands fill the floor of the armory and provide an example of the quality of their workmanship.

title: [Company Store, Weaponry]
description: The sharp smell of oil greets your senses while the wide selection of weaponry displayed around you seems enough to appease the desires of even the most jaded warrior.  Racks of weapons line the walls while the center of the room is dominated by a large grindstone.  The weapons seem to be of uncommonly high quality for a mining town.

title: [Company Store, Jeweler]
description: Everything in the room shines and sparkles in the light.  Even the simple counter manages a fine reflection in its polished glass face.  Your only hint of an actual workplace is a small desk near the back that has a few carefully placed jeweler's tools upon it.

title: [Company Store, Jewelry Sales]
description: This room delights the eye.  The golden trinkets sparkle in the light, highlighted and complimented by the golden modwir walls.  Jewels twinkle from cases and ring trees, just begging to be worn.

title: [Company Store, Corridor]
description: From the open doors at the east and west ends of the corridor come quite audible and creatively worded outbursts.  You realize that the words are not directed at you, but beyond you, from one room to the next.

title: [Company Store, Debt Office]
description: A glaes candy dish perches at the edge of a large mistwood countertop.  On a small table near the doorway, a potted fern shrivels.  Thick leather-bound ledgers are stacked on the bookshelves behind the clerk.  Some of the book spines are so worn that the letters on them are scarcely legible.

title: [Company Store, Registrar]
description: File cabinets line the walls, making the cramped room appear even smaller.  Sheaves of paper tied with coarse string are stacked on the tops of the cabinets, on the floors, and on either side of the clerk.

title: [Ashorien Brothers Movers]
description: Rough and undyed wooden crates of all sizes have been assembled and arranged, each one sporting a fire-branded number for ease of selection.  A few crates standing next to the doors bear the same address and tufts of dried fibers used for packing peek out around the seams.  A sign with rates hangs on the wall, next to a parchment calendar circled with today's date.

title: [Company Store, House Clerk]
description: The battered wooden desk in the room's center is nearly buried under tottering mounds of paper that appear poised to collapse in an avalanche of parchment.  Nearly lost amid the piles, a scraggly bearded dwarf fusses over a thick tome, spluttering something about annexes.

title: [Muagh River Realty]
description: Ornate rugs cover the polished beech floors.  Six large and glossy wooden desks with luxurious leather consultation chairs stand within individual partitions.  The desks are covered with books listing empty lots as well as completed houses; the individual descriptions sound like promises of the blissful hereafter, with numerous uses of the words "exclusive," "secluded" and "quiet."

title: [Dragonspine and Mithril]
description: The flow of the crowd parts around a large hole in the middle of the road.  A dwarven work crew stands around the hole, doing very little work.  From the many shops and vendors' stalls along the street, you hear the cries of hawkers, the lamentations of hagglers and the occasional clink of a coin.

title: [Mithril Street]
description: Brays, bleats and whinnies from the large wooden structure before you identify it as the town stable.  The familiarly sweet, earthy smell leaves no doubt.  An old wooden cart is parked just outside.  Both the drover and burros are dozing.

title: [Uxbri's Imported Firewood]
description: A massive pile of split logs dominates the back of the small tent, and the pleasant smell of freshly chopped wood fills the air. Sawdust and chips of wood cover the sandy floor, and small footprints lead out of the tent.

title: [Mithril and Dragonswing]
description: The walls of the canyon tower over your head, reaching hundreds of feet toward the sky.  The street does not stop at the rock, but continues right on inside.  Dwarves bustle in and out of the tunnel.  One fat old fellow, obviously fond of his ale, bellows out an old song.  The crowd gives him a wide berth.

title: [Mud Baths, Marble Way]
description: Mining equipment sits at the end of the tunnel, waiting for the next major digging effort.  Teeth biting into the wall, a huge bore remains where it was left after the construction of the mud baths was complete.  Although it is set off by barricades, children climb all over the machine, turning it into a makeshift playground.
