tags: meta:mapname:Neighborhoods of Teras Isle and River's Rest

title: [Mud Baths, Marble Way]
description: A series of stalagmites linked by thick black iron chains mark the outer edges of properties in the massive cavern.  Each yard has a gate of reinforced wrought iron forged by the island's famed blacksmiths decorating the entry.  Several homeowners share rock gardens built between the buildings.

title: [Mud Baths, Marble Way]
description: A pile of rocks anchors a street sign marking the intersection of Marble Way and Stone Circle.  Carefully chiseled homefronts sit back off the thoroughfare, each building bearing all sorts of colorful decorations to brighten the grey walls of the wide tunnel.

title: [Mud Baths, Stone Circle]
description: In the middle of Stone Circle, amid the swarming traffic, stands the neighborhood mud baths.  A steady stream of people flows into and out of the low structure built to house the hydrothermal pits.  Intricate statuary graces the eaves of the building, further highlighted by the thick ionic columns holding up the roof.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Mud Baths, Rock Basin]
description: An expansive rock basin sits in this partially walled structure, home to the local mudbaths.  Heat rises off the thick, dark, bubbling mud, the bursting air pockets splattering ooze in large arcs.  A set of steps on the east side leads down into the therapeutic liquid.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Mud Baths, Stone Circle]
description: The south side of Stone Circle is the busiest intersection in the neighborhood, a traffic officer taking post during the busiest hours to help with directions to and from the baths.  Merchants, although unwelcome in this otherwise unassuming neighborhood, hawk every imaginable impossible cure from the marble steps on the north side of the street.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: Branching out to the east and west, Sandstone Avenue provides a refuge from the busy surroundings of the mudbaths.  Signs of dwarven craftsmanship appear everywhere, from the heavy chains strung between stalagmites as fencing to the strong metal fastenings and stays on doors throughout the neighborhood.  Sharp barks echo off the walls of the houses and tunnel, originating from a rather small dog in one of the nearby yards.

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: Long thin stalactites hang low over the neighborhood with brillant lamps strapped to them near the point with a wide iron band.  A steady glow emanates from the wicks, bringing a bit of warmth to the cold mountain heart.  Drafts swirl around in fits, kicking up miniature whirlwinds of dust.

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: Tinkling a cheerful melody, a spring bubbles up in a fountain, creating a small stream that heads off to the northwest, burbling happily.  Strung between a pair of sturdy stalactites, a windchime rings as a breeze blows through the wide tunnel.  A low, decorative fence splits the divide between the tiny channel and the street it parallels.

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: The avenue skirts a shallow pond, the water a translucent milky white.  A loud splash adds to the background din when blind cave fish leap into the air and then re-enter the water in an elegant arc.  A sign posted next to the pool warns off would-be fisherman.

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: At the northwest end of Sandstone Avenue, a local sculptor donated his time and carved four busts into the wall at the end of the passage.  Four kobold faces peer out at passersby, one of the heads wearing a set of spectacles, another sporting a bit of a hooked nose, the third with a regal look on his face, and the last with a long lion's mane of hair.  Small children climb in and out of the hollowed out ear of one of the middle carvings.

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: A couple brooms and rakes sit in a community rack, waiting for homeowners to pick up some tools to clean their yard.  Stonemasons pored over the construction of low walls, carving in wild scenes of fantastic battles, heroic figures, and beautiful love stories.  Some kind soul left a pile of stones in a large hole just off the center of the road to prevent draft animals and travellers from injuring themselves.

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: A wide plaza opens up on the east side, the roadway working around to the north.  A stone court is marked out on the ground, several colored, highly polished stone spheres waiting for a game to begin.  Families use the makeshift park for picnics and group gatherings on the weekends.

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: Wagons lumber down the avenue, kicking up a choking dust in their wake.  The warmth that surrounds the neighborhood mud baths doesn't reach this far into the mountainside, so the inhabitants rely on fireplaces and pipes to carry heat inside their homes.  Additional ductwork carries the unwanted smoke out to the surface.

title: [Mud Baths, Sandstone Avenue]
description: Water seeps through the tunnel, slowly dripping down the walls and into a grate placed to pick up the extra runoff.  A dark green trail marks the route the water takes on the way down, several kinds of moss and lichen thriving in the moist environment.  A large overhang protects mining equipment stored for future use at the end of the cavern.

title: [Mud Baths, Stone Circle]
description: A series of marble steps wrap around the neighborhood baths, leading up to a colonnade of ionic columns that are in turn capped by a polished granite low pitched roof.  The construction of the baths at the thermal mud baths was quite an event, a gigantic boulder carved out by hand and dedicated by a throng of locals and visitors.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Mud Baths, Micah Lane]
description: A wooden wagon with a smashed right wheel sits askew along the side of the roadway.  Its contents, extremely rich soil, have been left there by the wagonmaster who walked off with his draft animals in a huff.  Judging from the footprints and shovel marks in the heap, local gardeners and children have made off with some of the haul.

title: [Mud Baths, Micah Lane]
description: Window box gardens hang off of almost every building, with growing mushrooms and glowing moss the predominant plant types used.  A few merchants have made good use of the tall stalagmites poking up out of the ground, stretching gaily colored tarps across the points and setting up shop underneath.

title: [Mud Baths, Micah Lane]
description: The end of Micah Lane is perfectly squared off, the vertical stone wall rising all the way up to the almost invisible ceiling high overhead.  Several artists have used the surface as a way to show off their wares, covering every inch of the lower part of it with drawings and paintings.  Some of the artwork is obviously done by eager children while others were completed by master painters.

title: [Mithril Way]
description: The tunnel is vast, perhaps fifty feet high.  The dim green-yellow light emanates from barrel-sized glaes orbs which hang on the walls.  Comfortable-looking stone homes line the street, all done in the same practical and sturdy style.

title: [Meeting Hall, Atrium]
description: Carved from granite, the entire building seems more like a fortress than a peaceful meeting hall.  Heavy iron sconces set into the walls hold thick torches that shed flickering light across the room.  Dwarves stream in and out of the hall, grumbling and conversing about any number of topics.

title: [Meeting Hall, Trophy Room]
description: Empty trophy cases line both sides of the corridor.  Dust-covered glass encloses the front of the cases while elaborate iron hardware allows for the cases to be opened.  Lanterns toss little light into the cases.

title: [Meeting Hall, Construction]
description: Heavy pieces of canvas stretch from floor to ceiling here, blocking any further passage to the east.  The tarps do little to contain huge puffs of dust that occasionally emanate from the other side.  The steady sound of metal against stone echoes from the other side night and day, slowing rarely.  Boards and tools lie scattered around the floor, each a potential hazard to those passing through.

title: [Meeting Hall, Clan Corridor]
description: This part of the building is built simply.  The only interruption in the smooth rock walls is a single iron door, heavily reinforced around its edges with iron banding.  Simple torches set into the walls illuminate the room...barely.  A simple sign hangs above the door.

title: [Meeting Hall, Clan Corridor]
description: The room ends to the west at a down-sloping ramp.  Two statues flank the entrance to the ramp while a brass plaque resides just above.  The floor dips slightly towards a small drain in the center of the room.

title: [Mithril and Dragonstail]
description: This is a quiet neighborhood of large, well-built dwellings.  Many of Kharam-Dzu's more prosperous dwarves call it home.  Uniformed militia glance at you as they meander about on patrol, their footsteps echoing in the large cavern.  A group of small children plays in the street.

title: [Krodera Street]
description: The tunnel is wider and higher in here, big enough for a small castle.  The homes are simple and stout, intermixed with small shops selling various wares.  The dwarves wandering out of one large, low structure are all smiles and good cheer.  Some pause to stretch, or to take a deep breath.

title: [Krodera Street]
description: The walls of the canyon loom overhead.  The street continues inside them to the east, entering a vast, dimly-lit tunnel.  Dwarves and other folk wander in and out, some stopping at a small, bright-blue wooden shop here outside.  A thick plume of black smoke puffs silently out of the shop's chimney and the faint smell of burning bread wafts throughout the street.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: A flight of steps has been carved into the face of the cliff, winding up its face in a dizzy ascent.  A handrail follows its progress, with torches stuck into the cliff wall lighting the way.  Nearby, a finger of rock sprouts from the canyon floor and lifts toward the sky like an igneous flower following the moon's beckoning.  High above, on top of the column where it flares amid low clouds, the outline of a large structure can barely be glimpsed.

A flight of steps has been carved into the face of the cliff, winding up its face in a dizzy ascent.  A handrail follows its progress, growing more faint and tenuous as it climbs.  Nearby, a finger of rock sprouts from the canyon floor and lifts toward the sky like an igneous flower following the sun's beckoning.  High above, on top of the column where it flares amid low clouds, the outline of a large structure can be glimpsed.

title: [Krodera Street]
description: There is an enormous hole in the middle of this cobblestone street, wide enough to swallow a small hill and deep enough that you can't see the bottom.  The dwarves who wander by ignore it, walking around the edges on their way.  A small wooden booth sits near the edge of the crater.

title: [Dragonspine and Krodera]
description: The street widens into a circular plaza several hundred feet across.  Dwarves and giantmen lounge on stone benches by a massive granite fountain in the center.  The burbling of the waters, the low mumblings of the dwarves and the booming laughter of the giants somehow blend together into a vibrant harmony.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Krodera and Dragonseye]
description: A pleasant breeze rustles the modwir trees which line this cobblestone street.  A magnificent establishment of pearl-grey granite inlaid with gold and crimson glaes dwarfs the other structures here.  This is Bentock's Adventurers' Rest, a second home for travellers in search of fortune and fame.  Just beyond the elegant structure, the River Muagh courses northward on its long journey to the sea.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Foyer]
description: As the heavy doors close behind you, the bustle of the street fades away.  Banners from the various Wehnimer's Landing Houses are mixed with other, unfamiliar banners hanging along the walls.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Long Hall]
description: Gusts of hot air blow into the cavern, occasionally picking up ash and carrying it off to another part of the passage.  The walls are crystallized and appear to have been exposed to some great heat recently.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Long Hall]
description: The crystallized walls sparkle in the moonlight filtering into this part of the passage.
The crystallized walls sparkle in the light filtering into this part of the passage.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Long Hall]
description: Your footsteps echo sharply off the gleaming stone walls of this long hall.

title: [Adventurers Rest, Long Hall]
description: Bits of ash swirl in tiny eddies here at a turn in the passage.

title: [Adventurers Rest, Long Hall]
description: The sharp turn of the passageway seems newly carved, with bits of rough granite having escaped the polisher's touch.

title: [Adventurers Rest, Long Hall]
description: A long, crystalized seam in the wall glints beneath torches set in elaborate, wrought iron sconces.

title: [Adventurers Rest, Long Hall]
description: The hallway comes to an abrupt end, the final wall rough and unpolished.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Bar]
description: Gleaming mistwood stools are grouped against the long sturdy bar.  The stools, and even sections of the bar itself, vary in height to accommodate everyone from giantman to halfling comfortably.
Gleaming mistwood stools are grouped against the long bar.  The stools, and even sections of the bar itself, vary in height to accomodate everyone from Giantman to Halfling comfortably.

title: [Imflass and Dragonseye]
description: It is peaceful here by the River Muagh.  Small birds hop and skitter on the mud banks, their chirps blending with the bazaar's distant hum from the opposite shore.  On the south side of the street is the burned-out shell of a small wood and stone building.  It looks out of place, surrounded by verdant grass, flowers and trees on all sides.  Few dwarves wander by here, and those that do seem strangely hushed.

title: [Dragonspine and Imflass]
description: Dragonspine broadens into a wide plaza, a bazaar paved with grey and white granite flagstones.  The foot traffic, mostly preoccupied dwarves, mingles with ox carts, pack horses, and burros laden with goods.  Vendors have set up wooden booths to peddle their assorted wares.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Imflass Street]
description: The clangs, bangs and cursing from this construction site drown out the din from the rest of the town.  You can't yet tell what the dwarves are building.  For now, it's just a huge hole in the ground surrounded by big piles of rocks.  One massive boulder is tied up with stout ropes, extending to a pulley on a beam erected overhead.  Two dwarves stand on each side of the rock, yelling, stamping their feet, and waving sheafs of parchment over their heads.

title: [Imflass Street]
description: The street is drilled into the canyon wall here.  The dwarves wandering out of the tunnel blink in the moonlight.  Some children are playing by some bushes planted just south of the road.  They run about frantically, searching for something.

The street is drilled into the canyon wall here.  The dwarves wandering out of the tunnel blink and squint in the light.  Some children are playing by some bushes planted just south of the road.  They run about frantically, searching for something.

title: [Imflass Street]
description: The air in the tunnel is comfortably cool and clammy.  The stout little stone homes lining the street are bathed in a dim yellow glow.  Many folks are headed to or from a large wood and stone shop.  Its wares are displayed in the windows, cuts of meat, potatoes and other hearty foodstuffs.

title: [Imflass and Dragonstail]
description: Most of the homes here are shuttered, their doors and windows closed tight.  Though most are sized for dwarves, a few of the homes are far larger, with doorways fit for a giant.

title: [Golvern and Dragonstail]
description: A massive drilling rig is set against the tunnel's east wall, placed to excavate further into the rock.  The rig looks a bit like a huge metal mole, with a conical screw for a snout.  It is idle just now, as are the dwarves who operate it.  They lean on their picks and grumble.  One kneels to look under the mole and scratches his head.

title: [Glaes and Dragonstail]
description: The tunnel turns here, as Glaes and Dragonstail meet.  One building stands out, a large, black granite structure.  A staircase of grey and white marble leads up to the mithril gates, which are flanked by a pair of stone manticores.  The dwarves who amble in and out look to be prosperous sorts.

title: [Glaes Street]
description: The rough-hewn walls of the tunnel are lit by a yellow-green glow.  Sturdy stone homes with low but wide doors are carved into the rock.  The distant barking of a dog echoes off the walls, mixing with the sounds of your footsteps as you wander the cobblestone street.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Entrance]
description: Six glowing orbs light a concave wall of pure white drakar speckled with red that encompasses this well-lit antechamber.  The floor is crafted from hardened lava, leveled and polished smooth.  A thick bronze seal is set deeply into the floor, facing an obsidian archway that leads to the tunnels of Kharam Dzu.  Opposing the archway, a flagstone stairway curves in wide, angular sections as it descends.

title: [Northbound Tunnel]
description: Climbing gradually to the north, the tunnel bends to the east.  A shallow crosshatch pattern gives the floor a safe footing and melds with the stone block carving of the tunnel walls.  The faint echoes of rhythmic hammerfalls can be heard from upslope to the north.

title: [Teras Isle Forging Supply Shop]
description: Resembling an hourglass laid on its side, this chamber appears to have been naturally formed, then embellished and made functional by dwarven design and labor.  The choke-point in the center of the cavern is almost entirely filled by a steel-topped counter and display case, and beyond it, hammerfalls echo from a dozen or so tunnels that pierce the curving walls.  A dwarven attendant stands behind the counter, patiently waiting to provide whatever assistance might be needed.

title: [Glaes Street]
description: The street enters the wall of the canyon, into an arch perhaps fifty feet high.  Just outside the tunnel is a sturdy, three-story stone tower.  This is the headquarters for the local militia.  Uniformed dwarves bearing axes and hammers swagger in and out of its steel double doors.

title: [Dragonspine and Glaes]
description: The town walls lie perhaps one hundred feet to the north, with dwarven militiamen pacing back and forth atop them.  A rock garden to the west displays a wide variety of fascinating boulders.  Beyond the garden, a barge makes its way south down the River Muagh, its decks piled high with freshly-cut logs.  To the east Glaes Street, lined with small wood and stone homes, continues a few hundred feet to the walls of the canyon.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Town Gates]
description: A sturdy wooden gate is set into the massive stone walls surrounding Kharam-Dzu.  Mail-clad guards with pikes and heavy crossbows pace back and forth atop the walls.  Dwarves, burros and the odd giantman or human travel the broad cobblestone street which leads south into town.  A squad of dwarven militia drills on the small, rocky parade ground to the east.  A cloud of dust surrounds them as they march to and fro, and the gruff barks of their sergeant blend with the din of the crowd at the gate.

A sturdy wooden gate is set into the massive stone walls surrounding Kharam-Dzu.  Mail-clad guards with pikes and heavy crossbows pace back and forth atop the walls.  Dwarves, burros and the odd giantman or human travel the broad cobblestone street which leads south into town.  A squad of dwarven militia drills on the small, rocky parade ground to the east.  A cloud of dust surrounds them as they march to and fro, the sound of their marching barely audible over the din of the crowd at the gate.

title: [Militia Headquarters, Lobby]
description: Rushes are strewn over the floor, muffling the sound of dwarves stomping in and out as they go about their various duties.  A small etching hangs on the wall beside the stairs which lead to the upper floor of the tower.

title: [Deputy Commander's Office]
description: The weapons rack contains a collection of highly polished axes and knives.  Papers are scattered over the top of the large desk.  A lantern gives off an oily smoke, but lights the room surprisingly well.

title: [Commander's Office]
description: Kiramon mandibles, troll hides and the pelt of a great, grey ape are mounted on the stone walls of this circular chamber.  A battered mistwood desk sits below a small, square window.  The fat dwarf perched behind the desk glares at you with his one good eye.

title: [Militia Armory]
description: Lockers line the walls, each held closed by a massive chain wrapped around its handles several times.  The sputtering candles create eerie shadows on the walls.  Muffled noises from beyond the steel door cause you to shiver involuntarily.

wayto.23927: ;e fput 'pull bin'; fput 'open trapdoor'; move 'go trapdoor'

title: [Dragonspine and Vaalin]
description: The broad cobblestone avenue heads north and south, and there is little traffic upon it.  Stone dwellings line the street.  Though small, they are sturdy and well-kept.  A flagstone street heads off to the east.  Several of the dwarves headed that way are dressed in clerical robes.

title: [Dragonspine and Vultite]
description: Dragonspine Avenue ends here, and the canyon walls close in to the east and to the south.  A smaller street heads west, and several of those travelling it have the look of sailors.  A rough path wends its way east, sloping upward toward the canyon wall.

Dragonspine Avenue ends here, and the canyon walls close in to the east and to the south.  A smaller street heads west, and several of those travelling it have the look of sailors.  A rough path winds its way east, sloping upward toward the canyon wall.

title: [Vultite Street]
description: The street bends southwest, toward the eastern docks.  Dwarven sailors with sacks slung over their shoulders trudge along, ignoring you as they pass.  Wood and stone houses, most of them small, but well-maintained, line the way.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, East Docks]
description: A lone wooden dock sways and creaks, awaiting ferryboats traveling the short distance to the mine tunnel.  Upstream, the river widens as it begins its journey to the sea.  At the northeast end of the riverfront, a small street leads away from the dock and back towards town.

A lone wooden dock sways and creaks, awaiting a ferryboat traveling the short distance to the mine tunnel.  Upstream, the river widens as it begins its journey to the sea, the color of the water shifting to a lighter hue.  At the northeast end of the riverfront, a small street leads away from the dock and back towards town.

wayto.2260: ;e unless move 'go departing ferryboat'; echo 'Waiting for ferryboat...'; waitfor 'Some dockworkers prepare a ferryboat for departure into the mine.'; move 'go departing ferryboat'; end

title: [Kharam-Dzu Exchange, Inside]
description: The floors are a bit stained and there are visible signs of rot along the corners.  Apparently, this place has been flooded more than once.  Yet despite the signs of wear business continues.  Several young dwarves walk back and forth delivering or removing large piles of papers from the clerk's desks.  The clerks simply nod, remaining engrossed in their job.

title: [Wizard Guild, Court]
description: Light dances along the sheer rock wall from torches set in roughly carved red-veined marble sconces that flank a pair of massive iron doors.  In the dark the ruddy glow coming from behind the doors is obvious.  The sharp scent of sulphur from somewhere beyond stings your nose.

A pair of massive iron doors are set in the sheer rock wall.  The sharp scent of sulphur from somewhere beyond stings your nose.  Torches in roughly carved red-veined marble sconces flank the entrance, their bright flames almost obscuring the ruddy glow showing from somewhere behind the doors.

title: [Wizard Guild, Foyer]
description: A bright river of flowing lava runs through the middle of the circular chamber, dividing it in two.  A stone bridge spans the channel, connecting the two sides.  Vivid tapestries line the rock walls, their patterns echoed in the highly polished inlaid marble floor.  Despite the searing lava that illuminates the room in a bright reddish glow, the chamber is suprisingly cool.  On this side of the lava there are passages easily accessible to the east and the west.

title: [Wizard Guild, West Hallway]
description: The smell of brimstone is stronger to the west.  It is noticably brighter in this hallway, even though the channel along the hall where the lava flows is no wider here.

The smell of brimstone is stronger to the west.  It is noticably brighter in this hallway, even though the channel along the hall where the lava flows is no wider here.  A strip of narrow, smooth stone spans the lava, providing access to a shadowed ingress in the northern wall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: Mephitic vapors emanate from a collection of retorts and alembics which occupy most of the dark ash wood table in the center of the workshop, despite the flue carved in the raw stone ceiling high above.  A narrow channel directs lava from a cleft in the rocky floor to the east hallway.  The room glows from the ruddy illumination cast by the magma through the thin veil of translucent glaes walls.

title: [Wizard Guild, East Hallway]
description: Lava flows dangerously close in a channel along the hallway just a few feet from where you pass.  Unconcerned apprentice wizards hurry to and fro down the hallway without giving the lava any more heed than they might a cool mountain stream.  The corridor widens further to the east.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: Collections of candles set in wrought iron sconces cast a warm amber glow across the towering bookshelves and impart an inviting atmosphere despite the absence of windows.  Wizards quietly study and confer around large, polished ash wood tables cluttered with all manner of books and scrolls.  The everpresent tang of brimstone seems fainter here, or perhaps it's simply less noticeable amidst the smells of aged parchment and mead.

title: [Canyon Alley, Khazar Way]
description: At this end of the narrow alleyway, the mouth of the slot canyon opens onto a main thoroughfare, now mostly dark except for the oil lamps that light the way.  Sitting in a niche carved into the canyon wall is a small iron bell, a miniature memorial to Khazi Khazar.

At this end of the narrow alleyway, the mouth of the slot canyon opens onto a main thoroughfare, creating a busy junction for both merchants and customers.  Sitting in a niche carved into the canyon wall is a small iron bell, a miniature memorial to Khazi Khazar.  Occasionally, a young child pauses to ring the tintinnabulum, only to be guided back to the business at hand by an earnest parent.

title: [Canyon Alley, Khazar Way]
description: The eastern wall tilts back sharply, one segment breaking away from the main section, to create a crude obelisk.  Wider here than anyplace else along the alley, and more open to the sky above, the residents have created a circular garden area where they can relax away from the bustle of more populated streets.  The soft gurgle of a small fountain lends a soothing hush to the surroundings.

The eastern wall tilts back sharply, one segment breaking away from the main section, to create a crude obelisk.  Wider here than anyplace else along the alley, and more open to the sun above, the residents have created a small circular garden area where they can relax away from the bustle of more populated streets.

title: [Canyon Alley, Khazar Way]
description: Canyon walls, smooth from rain and faded from the light, feature striated bands of color ranging from a deep rust to a pale sandstone.  The matching stripes on parallel sides of the alleyway clearly indicate this stone was once whole, though it's now separated by several lengths.  Twin rows of torches illuminate the pass, their golden light casting dancing shadows.

Canyon walls, smooth from rain and faded from the sun, feature striated bands of color ranging from a deep rust to a pale sandstone.  The matching stripes on parallel sides of the alleyway clearly indicate this stone was once whole, though it's now separated by several lengths.

title: [Canyon Alley, Khazar Way]
description: Buffered from much of the sounds from the surrounding city, only noise local to the area fills the air.  The scent of freshly sawn wood lingers and the silent night is punctuated by the occasional clang of metal.  A small natural spring emerges from a tiny split in the canyon wall, captured by an elaborate wooden chute and trough, for consumption by the locals.

Buffered from much of the sounds from the surrounding city, only noise local to the area fills the air.  Wood being sawn and hammered clacks and clatters all around, punctuated by the occasional clang of metal.  A small natural spring emerges from a tiny split in the canyon wall, captured by an elaborate wooden chute and trough, for consumption by the locals.

title: [Canyon Alley, Khazar Way]
description: Once a narrow slot canyon created by tectonic thrust and eons of exposure to the elements, this narrow alley is now just wide enough to support foot traffic and small carts.  Colorful silk banners span the overhead gap and flutter in the night breeze as flickering torchlight brightens the passageway, illuminating their brilliant colors.

Once a narrow slot canyon created by tectonic thrust and eons of exposure to the elements, this narrow alley is now just wide enough to support foot traffic and small carts.  Colorful silk banners span the overhead gap, fluttering in the breeze and sending a wash of hues down the walls, as sunlight shines through them.

title: [Vaalin Street, Temple District]
description: This quiet street ends at a gate set into the canyon wall.  The gate is carved of white marble, polished and gleaming with reflected moonlight.  Dwarves in clerical garb wander in and out, and the low, rhythmic sounds of chanting carry to you from inside.

This quiet street ends at a gate set into the canyon wall.  The gate is carved of white marble, polished and gleaming with reflected light.  Dwarves in clerical garb wander in and out, and the low, rhythmic sounds of chanting carry to you from inside.

title: [Temple, Hall of Gods]
description: Elaborate tapestries line this looming hall, depicting the gods in all their glory.  Highly polished marble forms the walls and floors, and elegant hand woven rugs stretch the length of the hall.  Solemn travelers shuffle past to enter the chapels of their various chosen gods, incense and offerings in hand.

Elaborate tapestries line this looming hall, depicting the gods in all their glory. Highly polished marble forms the walls and floors, and elegant hand woven rugs stretch the length of the hall.  Solemn travelers shuffle past to enter the chapels of their various chosen gods, incense and offerings in hand.

title: [Temple, Corridor]
description: An ethereal silence looms along this corridor of stone. Residents of Kharam-Dzu move solemnly about their business, as a pensive elven acolyte maintains a respectful watch.  To one side, an elaborate white marble arch decked with garlands leads to the wedding chapel.  A black marble arch solemnly ushers passing travelers to the altar of Lorminstra.

title: [Temple, Cleric Room]
description: The most noticeable feature of the room is the massive dome overhead.  The tall domed ceiling apexes at a grey crystal set into the roof.  Two pillars help to support the dome while a band of silver, interrupted by raised rune designs, encircles the base of the dome.  A small window allows a view of the nocturnal world outside while the light from the crystal tints the room to a light shade of grey.  A simple blue rug rings the perimeter of the room.

The most noticeable feature of the room is the massive dome overhead.  The tall domed ceiling apexes at a grey crystal set into the roof.  Two pillars help to support the dome while a band of silver, interrupted by raised rune designs, encircles the base of the dome.  A small window allows a little light in while the light from the crystal tints the room to a light shade of grey.  A simple blue rug rings the perimeter of the room.

title: [Temple, Eonak's Chapel]
description: A brilliant golden glaes altar dominates this great chapel, shining brightly beneath several flickering torches.  A low murmur of prayer and quiet conversation flows throughout the room.  Dwarves of all classes file past the altar, leaving gifts and offerings to Eonak.  A flowing gold silk tapestry decorates the wall behind the altar.

title: [Temple, Meditation Sanctum]
description: The silent simplicity of this small room brings contemplative thoughts to mind.  Several small mats cover the polished wood floors and two worn oak benches sit empty along the wall.  A modest rosewood altar stands at one end of the room, topped with two white candles.  A gentle breeze wafts from a hallway of gleaming white marble leading to the east.

title: [Silver and Aquamarine]
description: Low stone walls along the street's edges break intermittently, giving way to the pebble paths which sprawl among thatched bungalows and earthy wooden cottages on either side of you.  Beds of sweetgrass and herbs spread between wall and path, their pungent scents wafting away on lazy puffs of air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Aquamarine Street, River's Edge]
description: The facade of Burlitok's Brewery eclipses the street, rising grandly from the river and into the sky to your east.  Along its front, a set of double doors arches from the cobbles and nearly to the gabled roofline far above, gaping widely, as if to invite you inside.  The aromas of ale, brandy and sweet mead hang heavily in the air, and you find the invitation increasingly difficult to resist.

title: [Warrior Guild, Main Entrance]
description: The tall granite walls frame large, ornately carved doors bound with krodera and mithril.  Upon their center is a large seal bearing the regal emblem of the Warrior Guild.  Beyond the walls, the domed roof of the white marbled guild complex can be seen looming over the guild proper.  In the soft light of the moon, the surface of the dome glows dimly as if it were made of solid gold.

The tall granite walls frame large, ornately carved doors bound with krodera and mithril.  Upon their center is a large seal bearing the regal emblem of the Warrior Guild.  Beyond the walls, the domed roof of the white marbled guild complex can be seen looming over the guild proper.  In the light of day, the surface of the dome glints as if it were made of solid gold.

title: [Silver Avenue, Dead End]
description: The street dead-ends at the town wall.  The homes here are new ones, freshly painted in various colors.  Many are still being constructed.  In front of one cottage, an elven man and child kneel about a small modwir tree.

The street dead-ends at the town wall.  The homes here are new ones, freshly painted in various bright colors.  Many are still being constructed.  In front of one green and yellow cottage, an elven man and child kneel about a small modwir tree.

title: [Aquamarine, Cul-de-sac]
description: Swales of green turf rise against the town's rock walls to the north and west, forming a cozy bowl-shaped enclosure about the street.  Carved oaken benches line the cobbles, separated by the sharply-sculpted shapes of boxwood hedges into individual conversation nooks of their own.  An elven couple lounges in the grass, whispering and giggling.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Entrance]
description: Seamlessly fitted white marble cobblestones lead up to a silver gate.  Tall, white marble walls shot with silver veins enclose the compound.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Bazaar Central]
description: The cobblestones give way here to the kinder spring of wood--wide, smooth planks fashioned into a large square and sealed with amber resin.  Benches and jute-seated sling-backs scatter across the area, most occupied by adventurers and townspeople who have stopped to rest their weary bones.  Sounds of laughter and mirth roll in from the east, pulling your gaze toward a canopied bar.  You notice right away that there are a few empty stools.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Outside the Gate]
description: The wood-and-stone walls of a sizeable town rise before you.  Mail-clad dwarves pace atop them, looking over your head up the canyon.  The road enters the wide-open gates.  Dwarves, giantmen, and burro-drawn carts pass through them into the bustle of the town.  The river flows north through a gap in the walls to the west.  Several squat barge wallow their way upon it.

Dwarves, giantmen, and burro-drawn carts pass through them into the bustle of the town.  The river flows north through a gap in the walls to the west.  Several squat barges wallow their way upon it.

title: [Cobblestone Road, Canyon]
description: The road follows the river into a canyon, which narrows to the south.  The craggy, reddish-brown rock towers hundreds of feet overhead.  At the southern end of the canyon, a walled town sits at the base of the peak.  The clang of a bell and the distant bustle of the crowd drift along the canyon.  A squat barge plies the river toward the town, its deck piled high with fresh-cut timber and dozing dwarves.

title: [Cobblestone Road, Bridge]
description: A tall stone bridge spans the river, which rushes toward the northeast.  Hooves clip-clopping on the cobblestones, burros pull wooden carts piled high with fresh-cut timber.  The drovers are all dwarves and giantmen.  They ignore you as they head south, toward the canyon.  Over the burblings of the water, you hear the faint echoes of a busy town in the distance.

title: [Cobblestone Road]
description: The road is lined with tree stumps, shrubs and weeds.  It runs toward the base of a canyon, which opens to the south.  A great mountain dominates the horizon beyond the canyon.  The peak is ringed with dark storm clouds.  The outer walls of a good-sized town are barely visible within the canyon.

title: [Teras Isle, Logging Road]
description: Grass, shrubs, and even small hills have been flattened by a logging road many yards wide stretching between the forest to the west and the settlement to the east.  Carts trundle by frequently, and it appears that at times the traffic has been heavy enough to carve two separate sets of ruts into the mud.  A small peak rises to the south, and the low stone buildings of a sizeable town dot its slopes.  A cobblestone road heads south, towards the town.

title: [Teras Isle, Logging Road]
description: Saplings push up through the wreckage of logging slash piled to either side of the road.  The decaying hulk of a massive fallen tree provides a counterpoint to the vibrant new growth.  Saws and axes have turned it into a pair of great bookends on either side of the road.

title: [Teras Isle, Logging Road]
description: What once was thick forest is now a barren expanse of stumps and broken trees.  To the west, the road pierces the seemingly impenetrable leafy vastness of Greymist Wood.  Even in the mud, so recently trodden by logger's boots, life flourishes.  A family of oddly colorful toads croaks happily in a small pond formed by rain collected in a dip in the road.

title: [Greymist Wood, Eaves]
description: A forest of great tropical trees stands between the volcano to the north and the ocean to the west and south.  The trees are mistwoods, with massive roots, smooth, wide trunks, and an interwoven network of branches that form an almost solid roof above.  A thick blanket of hot mist rolls down from the volcano, swirling over the moonlit ground as it meanders through the trees.

A forest of great tropical trees stands between the volcano to the north and the ocean to the west and south. A thick blanket of hot mist rolls down from the volcano, swirling over the ground as it meanders through the trees.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: The wood is easily passable despite thick vines and lush undergrowth.  Still, the natural buttresses of the mistwood roots impart the sensation of a rat's maze.  No sooner is the end of one natural wall reached, than another from a neighboring tree turns the path back upon itself.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: Some persistent logger has ventured deep into the wood and hewn down the lower trunk of a tree.  The upper part of the trunk still remains, suspended in the air by the supporting arms of the neighboring vines and branches.  The wide stump squats in the gloom, smooth and flat.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: A low hill ushers the thickest of the fog to lower ground, and for once visibility extends more than a few feet.  Great mistwoods crowd the forest, always in constant contact through their crossing limbs and the vines that drape from them.  Huge leafy ferns grow in the darkness beneath the trees, their fronds, while not quite so wide as the largest of the mistwoods' leaves, are often a few feet across.

A low hill leaves the thickest of the mist below, and for once one can see more than a few hundred feet.  Great mistwoods crowd the slopes, always in constant contact through their crossing limbs and the vines that drape from them.  Huge leafy ferns grow in the shade of the trees, their fronds, while not quite so wide as the biggest rubbery leaves of the mistwoods, are often a few feet across.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: The massive trees of Greymist begin to give way to willows, as solid ground yields to a muddy black silt that threatens to snatch boots off with every step.  Through the dangling branches of the willows, one can barely see a spit extending out into the moonlit sea to the west.  To the south, the inviting water of a large lagoon is visible.

Through the dangling branches of the willows, one can see a spit extending out into the sea to the west.  To the south, the inviting water of a large lagoon is visible.

title: [Greymist Wood, The Shroud]
description: The forest is almost as silent as it is dark.  A fog bank rolls in from the distant shore, mingling with the misty carpet of the wood.  Even the chorus of frogs in the undergrowth seems distant and dreamlike.
The forest is almost as silent as it is dark.  A fog bank rolls in from the distant shore, mingling with the misty carpet of the wood.  Even the calls of birds in the canopy above seem dreamlike.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south

title: [Greymist Wood, Grandfather]
description: In the deep darkness of Greymist, the idea of dawn seems nonexistent.  The leafy canopy above hangs almost to the ground in places and thick twisted limbs reach across the path toward each other as if seeking a lover's embrace.  Cradled here in the arms of the forest is a great, gnarled mistwood tree.  Hundreds of clumps of withered lichen hang from its branches like an old man's beard.

They say the night is darkest before the dawn, but dawn seems never to have come here to the dark heart of Greymist. Cradled here in the arms of the forest is a great, gnarled mistwood tree.  Hundreds of clumps of withered lichen hang from its branches like an old man's beard.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: Underfoot, the ground is springy and yielding.  Down beneath the heavy fog, a carpet of mushrooms grows between the trees, shining with a faint luminescence in the night's shadows.  The thick mass of branches and vines all but obscures the moons, and from every direction, the sonnets of tree frogs fill the air.  The dark moss covering the trees gives them a regal air, like the velvet lining of a noble's cloak.

Underfoot, the ground is springy and yielding.  Down beneath the heavy mist, a carpet of mushrooms grows between the trees and in every direction, moss covers the trunks of the majestic mistwoods.  The thick mass of branches and vines all but obscures the sun, and the warm fog forms glistening droplets of dew on every surface.  The glossy moss covering the trees gives them a regal air, like the velvet lining of a noble's cloak.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Greymist Wood, The Shroud]
description: Cold fog rolling in off the sea and the hot mist of the volcano mingle together so thickly, one can barely see more than a few yards.  At times the murky curtain gathers so tightly it obscures all the surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: The ground slopes downward toward the sound of waves breaking gently in the distance.  The air is tangy with salt even in the preternatural stillness of the mysterious and ancient wood.  Somewhere far above, a shrill cry echoes into the endless sky.  Closer by, muffled grunts and a crash of breaking wood mark the passing of large beasts.

The ground slopes downward toward the sound of waves breaking gently in the distance.  The air is tangy with salt even in the preternatural stillness of the mysterious and ancient wood.  Somewhere far above, a seabird cries out into the endless sky.  Closer by, muffled grunts and a crash of breaking wood mark the passing of large beasts.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: A little brook flows down from the heights and wanders off to the west.  Although the bed is shallow, the brook widens as it passes beneath some willows encroaching to the west.  The water rushes quickly over the mossy stones, dampening the feet of weary travelers with a gentle caress.  The ever-present fog dances over the water's rippling surface, coalescing into swirling shapes in the murky darkness.

paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west

title: [Greymist Wood, Volcanic Slope]
description: Shadowy trees stretch away up the lower slopes of the great volcano, above a deep fissure barring the way.  Curling down the mountainside like an old knife wound, it cuts as far as the eye can see to the west.  Steam rises out of the fissure and rolls along the ground to the south, lit from beneath by an angry red glow.  Surprisingly, the mistwoods thrive even at the very edge of the precipice.

title: [Greymist Wood, Volcanic Slope]
description: As the trail makes its way up the steep slope of the volcano, the ground becomes rocky and choked with brambles and scrub brush.  Further on up the hillside, a wide expanse of basalt signals the presence of volcanic formations, and all evidence of the living forest dwindles away.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, west

title: [Basalt Flats]
description: Rough scree makes footing on the basalt flat risky, with the jumble of rock and gravel mixed with gnarled, exposed roots of long-dead scrub brush.  Volcanic slopes tower in the moonlight to the northeast, while to the east, mist can be glimpsed rising over the terrain.  Overhead, bats dart by occasionally, leaving the soft whisper of their wings behind them.

Rough scree makes footing on the basalt flat risky, with the jumble of rock and gravel mixed with gnarled, exposed roots of long-dead scrub brush.  Volcanic slopes loom through patchy fog to the northeast, while to the east, mist can be seen rising over the terrain.  In places across the bleak terrain, small mounds of prickly pear cactus sport bright yellow blooms above the plants' spiked foliage.

title: [Basalt Flats, Volcanic Rock]
description: The terrain transforms into craggy volcanic rock spotted with lichens.  Trickling through a recessed bed, a small stream makes its way south.  Moonlight glints faintly here and there on the water's surface, deflected in most places by the dark, pocked rock.

The terrain transforms into craggy volcanic rock spotted with lichens.  Trickling through a recessed bed, a small stream makes its way south.  Moss grows on the basalt edges of the water's channel, the bright green a marked contrast against the blackish red rocks with their pocked surfaces.

title: [Basalt Flats, Crevasse]
description: The trail dead-ends at the edge of a steep crevasse.  At the bottom of the drop, a fast stream cuts its way through the perilous volcanic boulders.  Fed by spray from the white water, dense patches of dark moss coat the rocks near the water.  Hundreds of tiny raised stalks stand up from the green verdure like a miniature forest.  The chorus of an army of frogs rises from the darkness of the chasm.

Fed by spray from the white water, dense patches of dark green moss coat the rocks near the water.  Hundreds of tiny raised stalks stand up from the green verdure like a miniature forest.  The chorus of an army of frogs rises from their hiding places among the rocks of the chasm.

title: [Basalt Flats, Bridge]
description: A rickety bridge spans a surging stream, its construction little more than a few rotten boards strung together with rope as frayed as it is discolored with rot.  In the shadows beneath it, the stream boasts a rapid current that could be hazardous if underestimated.  To the northeast, the head of the stream can be glimpsed where it branches off from the surging darkness of a much swifter tributary.

A rickety bridge spans a surging stream, its construction little more than a few rotten boards strung together with rope as frayed as it is discolored with rot.  Beneath it, the stream doesn't appear to be very deep, but it boasts a rapid current that could be hazardous if underestimated.  To the northeast, the head of the stream can be glimpsed where it branches off from a much swifter tributary.

title: [Basalt Flats, Bridge]
description: The trail branches to the east and to the southwest, feebly winding through rough outcrops of volcanic rock.  Moonlight bathes the dark stone with its soft illumination, casting all the crags and pocks in deep shadow.
The trail branches to the east and to the southwest, feebly winding through rough outcrops of volcanic rock.  Tiny flowers bloom in pockets in the boulders, their blooms jaunty in the severe terrain.

title: [Basalt Flats, Three Old Men]
description: A few stunted cypress and fir trees edge the trail as it winds up the mountain slope.  Thankfully, the hazardous basalt ruling the landscape to the southwest looks to be giving way to smoother rock underfoot as the elevation rises.  A composition of three large boulders creates a lichen-patterned tableau in the moonlight on the path's northern edge, their arrangement and cant suggesting a group of old men passing time in conversation.

title: [Basalt Flats, Stone Bridge]
description: The trail nears the edge of a swift dark river, which runs down from a series of majestic, moonlit falls to the northeast.  A narrow stone bridge crosses the torrent, offering access to another trail leading up the steep incline of the mountainside.  To the southeast, the land stretches away in gentle rolls of smooth rock with striated bands of color visible even in the semi-darkness of the night.

The trail nears the edge of a swift river, which runs down from a series of majestic falls to the northeast.  A narrow stone bridge crosses the torrent, offering access to another trail leading up the steep incline.  To the southeast, a landscape of brilliant white, gold and sienna stretches away in languid bands of color surrounding still pools of water as blue as the sky above.

title: [Basalt Flats, Colossal Boulder]
description: A huge boulder sits next to the trail, towering overhead in the moonlight like a hulking giant watching any who traverses the path.  Its granite composition is foreign to the surrounding basalt, as though the stone was dropped here by something so monumental that hefting such a boulder would pose no difficulty.  Beneath its considerable overhang, the darkness is dense and visibility, nonexistent.

Beneath its considerable overhang, mosses thrive in the perpetual shade.

title: [Basalt Flats, Wall of Boulders]
description: The trail ends at the foot of a large, impassable jumble of basalt boulders.  To the east, beyond the rocky obstacle, one can glimpse a smoother landscape marked by striated bands of colored rock pierced by irregular openings and moonlit pools.

The trail ends at the foot of a large, impassable jumble of basalt boulders. Contrasting the dark volcanic rock surrounding the area, there the palette is warm ivory white, yellow and sienna red.

title: [Basalt Flats, Top of the Rock]
description: The panoramic vista stretches away from the granite boulder on all sides like a fantastic, moonlit tapestry.  To the east, spray from geysers hovers in the air like fog, while to the northeast, an immense series of waterfalls crash down the mountainside like plumed ribbons.  On the western horizon, the dark surface of the sea glimmers in the moonlight.

The panoramic vista stretches away from the granite boulder on all sides like a fantastic tapestry.  To the east, spray from geysers shoots into the air like fountains, while to the northeast, an immense series of waterfalls crash down the mountainside like plumed ribbons.  On the western horizon, the deep blue surface of the sea shimmers in the distance.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: Several thin saplings quiver in the shadows, thrilling to some breeze too faint for any but their papery leaves, and their whisper creeps between the roots of their ancestors.  There are no words to this mysterious language, only hope and promise.  From the north, the sound of running water echoes in reply.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: The trail doglegs back on itself, forced to turn where Greymist's trees grow so closely they are impenetrable.  Clouds of night fog move slowly through the buttress roots, cloaking them in an eerie, moonlit twilight.  Here and there, a few large palm leaves arc up through the fog, spreading knife-like fingers out from their central stems.  An overgrown trail snakes away from the main path, leading into the darkness.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: As the path passes beneath an arch created by an immense fig root, the darkness crowds in and the atmosphere is heavy with the smell of organic debris.  In a shadowed crevice, mushrooms grow, their spotted caps luminescent in the moonlight.  They stand jauntily, like a small army of soldiers dressed in brightly-colored heraldic garb.

In a shadowed crevice, mushrooms grow, their caps spotted and tinted a bright vermilion red.  They stand jauntily, like a small army of soldiers dressed in brightly-colored heraldic garb.

title: [Beach]
description: Large trees arch their heavy branches over a moonlit beach, which stretches from a dark tangle of gargantuan roots at the foot of the forest to the brink of parallel rows of breakers edging a bay.  Night birds wheel overhead, their dark wings whispering in the gloom.  A sultry breeze blows in off the water, carrying the smell of the ocean like a perfume.

Large trees arch their heavy branches over a white sand beach, which stretches from a tangle of gargantuan roots at the foot of the forest to the brink of parallel rows of breakers edging a turquoise bay.  Long-legged sea birds quip and trot along the foamy, packed sand, picking at bits of shells and kelp.  A sultry breeze blows in off the water, carrying the smell of the ocean like a perfume.

title: [Beach]
description: On the moonlit beach, breakers rush in, rising into huge walls of water before yielding to the backwash of the previous wave.  The beach stretches away in a lazy crescent, the dark tangle of roots along its inland side like a complex froth of lace.  At the northern edge, the sand is halted by the impervious stand of Greymist's shadowy vegetation.

Gulls wheel overhead, casting fleet shadows down on the sand beach below.  Breakers rush in, rising into huge walls of water before yielding to the backwash of the previous wave.  The beach stretches away in a lazy crescent, the tangle of roots along its inland side like a complex froth of lace.  At the northern edge, the sand is halted by the impervious stand of Greymist's dense vegetation.

title: [Beach]
description: The beach slopes gently down to the sea, its moonlit sand broken here and there with dark splotches created by piles of kelp washed up at high tide.  A stretch pocked by broken shells marks the edge of the more closely packed sand still awash from cascading waves.  The roar of the surf is a constant background melody, its song timeless and languid.

The beach slopes gently down to the sea, its glaring white broken here and there with the deep green and sienna brown tones of piles of kelp washed up at high tide.  A spattering of broken shells marks the edge of the more closely packed sand still awash from cascading waves.  The roar of the surf is a constant background melody, its song timeless and languid.

title: [Beach]
description: Where a cliff emerges from the forest, moonlit beach sand sweeps around the base of large boulders in wind-sculpted dunes.  A dark log, beached by the surf, is half-buried in the drifts.  One gnarled branch still clings to the log, its dark silhouette resembling a contorted hand.  It points toward the cliff with its knotty fingers, as if trying to reach a handhold there to escape the ocean's clutch.

Where a cliff emerges from the forest, silvery beach sand sweeps around the base of large boulders in wind-sculpted dunes.  A log, bleached grey by sun and surf, is half-buried in the drifts, its color little different than the sand that holds it.  One gnarled branch still clings to the log, its silhouette casting a ragged shadow across the beach that resembles a contorted hand.  It points toward the cliff with its knotty fingers, as if trying to reach a handhold there to escape the ocean's clutch.

title: [Beach]
description: The beach encircles a small tide-pool left in a depression by the waves.  Hermit crabs scamper around the small body of water, patrolling for delicacies.  Beyond the dunes blocking the pool's reunion with the depths, the foamy remains of breakers recede down the beach with a soft hiss.  Moonlight reflects off of the sand and water, bathing the outcrop of rock in a silvery haze.

The beach encircles a small tide-pool left in a depression by the waves.  Gulls dip and swoop over the small body of water, patrolling for crabs and other delicacies.  Beyond the dunes blocking the pool's reunion with the depths, the foamy remains of breakers recede down the beach with a soft hiss.  Light reflects off of the sand and water, bathing the small drama of the diving birds in a silvery haze.

title: [Beach]
description: Within the lee of a large dune stands a stone statue held in the sand's embrace.  The stone is pocked and encrusted with old barnacles and blemishes, and it is carved in the primitive shape of a torso and head.  It faces out to sea, its wide staring eyes endlessly searching the far horizon.  The sand encases the artifact around its shoulders, concealing how much, or little, of the figure lies beneath the surface of the beach.

title: [Cave]
description: The moonlit oval of the cave's entrance is silhouetted by the dark, stone walls of a natural cavern, hewn from the rock of the cliff by tides.  Its walls are heavily striated, and large fingers of rock reach up from the cave's floor in crooked protrusions.  On the southeast wall, a passageway leads away into darkness, the floor rough with a jumble of boulders and sand.

title: [Cave]
description: The narrow tunnel halts at the foot of an incline descending down into the murk, its grade strewn with boulders, driftwood and debris.  Overhead, the ceiling follows the slope down, lowering to hover only a few feet above the rocks at its furthest point.  The sound of the surf outside is still audible, like an amplified version of the roar one hears within a shell.

title: [Cave]
description: At the rocky foot of an incline, two tunnels form a 'V' as they head away into darkness following their divergent routes.  The ceiling, both within the corridors and in this antechamber is irregular and low, with protrusions that threaten anything taller than a dwarf.  The dank odor peculiar to caves rides heavily on the air, carrying with it the pungent overtones of a crypt.

title: [Cave]
description: The tunnel twists and turns, its passageway cloaked with shadows and clouds of low-lying fog, which float along the floor like a ghostly river.  Outcroppings of stone emerge from the rounded walls like contorted creatures seeking to escape their imprisonment within the rock.  No drafts of air are evident, although the fog roils into eddies and curls at the urging of some undetectable force.

title: [Cave]
description: The maws of a number of tunnels open into a large, central chamber, its ceiling high above the jumble of boulders crowding its floor.  Large rib bones extend up out of the mist covering the debris, like ragged and curved picket fences.  The bleached white tones of skulls and bits of other bones occasionally peek through the blanket of fog as it shifts and eddies in the gloom.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Cave]
description: The tunnel drops as it makes a turn, and there, puddles collect into a shallow, slippery pool of water across the passageway's floor.  Steam rises off the surface of the water, mixing with fog crowding the pool's edge.  Complex patterns of lichens cover the southern wall, which glows with eerie phosphorescent light.

title: [Cave]
description: The tunnel crooks sharply around an outcrop of stone, its diameter narrowing considerably due to the 'teeth' of rock jutting out from the wall.  Fog creeps around the obstacle, threading back and forth through the protrusions like surf crashing against a rocky shore.  The odor of decay is especially pungent within the cramped turn, where crevices and cracks in the walls could conceal menace or the by-product of mortality.

title: [Cave]
description: The tunnel widens to the north, where the opening into a larger chamber can be glimpsed.  The stone walls are fraught with cracks and cubbyholes, and in some of them, small skulls and bone fragments have been wedged.  Squeaks and rustlings that sound like rats punctuate the silence from the shadows of the rough floor and lower crevices where the fog provides a thick cover in which to hide.

title: [Cave]
description: As the tunnel angles from northwest to southwest, it slopes downhill and the passageway becomes more rocky and difficult.  The soupy fog rises as the way descends, as if the floor is the bottom of a pool plunging down into the depths.  Moisture has collected in this branch and creates a steady drip from the rough ceiling, collecting in pools within the rocks that are hidden until one chances to step into a slippery puddle.

title: [Cave]
description: A natural alcove sits in the crook of a sharp dog-leg in the tunnel, its ceiling rising up into a high cone.  Ribs run up the sloped walls, and converge at the apex where they branch into a web of veiny stone tendrils.  The fog turns, floating first one direction then the other, while wisps separate from the cloud to follow the ridges on the walls up a short distance before folding back into the mass.

title: [Cave]
description: The corridor splits into three passages, all similar in appearance.  The murk makes directions seem non-existent, and the low-lying fog creates a slowly revolving vortex in the center of the tangents.  Every so often, the stone of the walls, floor and ceiling emits a low rumble, as though complaining of trespassers within its arteries.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: Tall branzila nut trees mingle with fig and mahogany trees, stretching a vast canopy of foliage overhead.  High in the upper branches, an occasional growl or screech betrays the night's predators at work.  A couple of cocoa trees, whose branches fill the forest's understory, grow with boughs full of large fruit.  A few mature pods, betraying an orange hue in the moonlight, lie along the path where animals have dropped them.

High in the upper branches, monkeys and brightly-feathered macaws cavort and screech, adding color, movement and sound to the emerald panorama. A few mature pods, now turned a dull orange, lie along the path where animals have dropped them.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: A dense tangle of forest cucumbers grows in the space left where a large fig tree once stood.  The giant now lies in decay amid the vines, though a few of its pieces still offer evidence of the decades through which the tree stood tall and proud.  Around the circular area, a growth of young fig and branzila trees push their leaves upward toward the sky in a desperate, though silent struggle for the vacated column of light.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: A stand of parkia trees grows alongside the trail as it meanders between the tall trunks of Greymist and the swamp neighboring it to the north.  The parkias are covered with bright red globular flowers, which cascade down the long stalks and give off a heady perfume.  Heavy odors from the marsh mingle with the sweet scent of the blossoms, creating an eloquent atmospheric statement of growth and death within the jungle.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: The trail winds through a dense patch of heliconia flourishing in the moonlight at the forest's edge.  The plants raise large, elongated leaves like paddles plying the greenish luminescence.  Swarms of bats circle and dive overhead, feeding on an abundance of flying insects crowding the air above the heliconias' blooms.

The trail winds through a dense patch of heliconia flourishing in the abundant light at the forest's edge.  The plants raise large, elongated leaves like paddles plying the luminescence.  Swarms of hummingbirds continually circle the heliconias' brightly-colored flowers, their own iridescence rivaling that of the blooms.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: A faint glimpse of moonlight peeks around the huge tree-trunks to the northwest, while darkness stalks in the opposite direction like an immense predator waiting for prey.  The tangle of vines and creepers loop between the trunks, their intricate leaves and clumps of roots and trailers silhouetted against the faint greenish-glow.  A large root snakes alongside the trail, throwing up a row of iridescent flowers on delicate stems that follow its meandering route.

The tangle of vines and creepers loop between the trunks, their intricate leaves and clumps of roots and trailers silhouetted against the hazy glare.  A large root snakes alongside the trail, throwing up a row of bright yellow flowers on delicate stems that follow its meandering route.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: Soft shafts of moonlight create a striking pattern, which knifes through the jungle darkness on all sides.  The trail curves around the monstrous bole of a yintosh tree, its thick buttress root system offering a veritable maze of shadowed crevices and cubbyholes.  A carpet of the yintosh's broad leaves lie around the tree's perimeter, their curled edges cradling puddles of water where the moonbeams are reflected here and there.

A carpet of the yintosh's broad leaves lie around the tree's perimeter, their curled edges cradling puddles of water where tadpoles and mosquito larva dwell.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: Boles of trees loom up into a thick jungle canopy like smooth-skinned towers on all sides.  At places on the trunks, epiphytes cling with loopy, tangled root systems, their gaudy flowers displaying color that even manages to penetrate the darkness.  A cacophony of sound rises from frogs and other invisible creatures prowling in the dank heart of the foliage.  East of the trail, a huge strangling fig tree lifts its branches toward the moons, their leaves covered with a lacework of vines and mosses.

At places on the trunks, epiphytes cling with loopy, tangled root systems, their broad leaves and gaudy flowers creating a riot of color in the green twilight.  A cacophony of sound rises from birds, insects and invisible creatures prowling in the dank heart of the foliage.  East of the trail, a huge strangling fig tree lifts its branches toward the sky, their leaves covered with a lacework of vines and mosses.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: The jungle crowds the trail so closely it almost completely obscures it.  A large rhohara plant arches over the path like a greenish-black canopy decorated with the plant's deadly ruby-tipped thorns.  At the base of the rhohara, a bank of large monkey-tail ferns creates a lush carpet that stands as high as a halfling's chest.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: A narrow trail threads through the dark jungle growth, skirting plants the size of houses and trees that tower into the shadows above, their tops lost in moonlit fog.  Long vines hang down from branches, carrying a thick, stringy moss that beards the foliage around it.  Visibility is restricted to mere steps away in any direction.

Long vines hang down from branches, carrying a thick, stringy moss of a grey color that blends with the shadowed tones of foliage.  Visibility is restricted to mere steps away in any direction.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: At the top of a ridge, the jungle stands as an almost impenetrable guard against intrusion.  Vines loop around the huge trunks of trees and wind up into the darkness of the upper canopy like a living veil.  What little breeze is able to find the embankment is so heavy with fumes from the swamp below, it is more a menace than a relief.  A trail winds into the verdure, disguised by mammoth-sized leaves and roots.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: A high bank climbs out of black pools choked with mud, dank water and clinging water plants.  Roots clamber down the incline, knotted with tendrils, broad leaves and runners.  Moonlight reflects off of the swampy water illuminating drifting patches of fog, which aids the darkness in hiding pitfalls and other hazards.  The air is heavy, carrying the odors of decay and growth like a mantle.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: The trail wanders through an area devoid of undergrowth, meandering around and through a maze of thick buttress roots at the base of the trees.  The roots create a fanciful landscape in the darkness, gnarled and tangled into formations that adhere to flights of fancy more fitting to illusion than logic.  Here and there, orchids cling to the trees, their ostentatious blooms swaying in the moonlight on reed-like stems.

title: [Teras Isle, Crossroads]
description: A few ramshackle structures have been thrown up here, most little more than leather tents pitched by fishermen to protect their skiffs and nets during the winter.  The Hog's Pen Tavern with its walls of stacked tanik logs is the sturdiest structure in sight.  At the rear of the tavern, there is a pile of refuse and a trough that overflows with left-over meals and rain water.  The sounds of a bustling town echo down the best-kept of the various roads and paths that meet here.

title: [Teras Isle, River's Edge]
description: A strong river surges down from the southern mountain and away northeast toward the sea.  Across its width are strung a hundred sturdy ropes, intertwined through pulleys, anchored at both ends, and supporting an almost fluid wooden tunnel that bobs above the water as though likely to fall at any moment.  But the carved runes of countless dwarven craftsmen mark the entrance to the suspension bridge, and it is unlikely to fall before you grow old and grey.

title: [Teras Isle, Suspension Bridge]
description: Within the wooden tunnel of the bridge, you can see nothing of the river outside.  Still, there can be no doubt of where this tunnel is.  The sounds of rushing water, the creak of rope on wood, and the unending sway, all tell you this is no mine shaft.

title: [Teras Isle, Grasslands]
description: Low sloping hills stretch away from the river in all directions, rampant with tall clumps of grass.  Given the slightest excuse, flocks of birds break from hidden nests and wheel across the night sky, settling again like gently falling snow.  To the north, the land slopes quickly upward to the lower slopes of V'Tull.

Low sloping hills stretch away from the river in all directions, rampant with tall yellow and green clumps of grass.  Given the slightest excuse, flocks of pure white birds break from hidden nests and wheel across the sky, settling again like gently falling snow.  To the north, the land slopes quickly upward to the lower slopes of V'Tull.
