Given the slightest excuse, flocks of birds break from hidden nests and wheel across the night sky, settling again like gently falling snow.  To the north, the land slopes quickly upward to the lower slopes of V'tull.

title: [Teras Isle, Grasslands]
description: Thick reedy blades of grass grow higher than most of the dwarves whose booted tracks crisscross the ground.  Gentle hills rise and fall, blocking your view of all but the inland peaks and the sky.

title: [Teras Isle, Old Road]
description: An ancient cobblestone road runs down a raised embankment toward the south end of the island.  The stones were once perfectly set so that a wagon must have passed over as if on a single sheet of stone.  But time unmakes all mortal labor, and no backs have toiled here for many seasons.

title: [Teras Isle, Old Road]
description: The road runs straight and true.  As you look in either direction, the cobblestones make a perfect compass line south and north, marred in places where the path has crumbled away, but always resuming in perfect precision.  Only a "road" now by a generous conceit, the stones still speak of the skill of the mason whose children's children surely died long before you were born.

title: [Teras Isle, Old Road]
description: The road sinks into a morass to the south.  To the west rise low hills, growing larger to the north and the small peak south of the volcano.  The road to the north splits the grasslands into two armies, waving at each other in silent bravado.

title: [Teras Isle, Morass]
description: The river flowing between the road and the hills to the west has overflowed its banks, leaving the ground a muddy bog and obscuring any trace of the road.  Long-legged birds pick their way through the reeds and the din of frogs and fist-sized mosquitos is almost deafening.

title: [Teras Isle, Morass]
description: Every sinking step gives the distinct impression that either the road lies elsewhere, or it has sunk well below the mud and standing brackish water swirling lazily about.  The mud quivers every now and then as some vague serpentine form slips over the path, if it can be called that.

title: [Teras Isle, Old Road]
description: Mossy paving stones climb out of the muck and slime to the north, resuming their trek to the south.  The gallant travellers are quickly stymied again by thick undergrowth thriving at the edge of the bog.  To the south, the brambles and low trees become as thick as a wall.  The road may continue farther, but it looks as though you won't.  The river flows by lazily on the west side of the road.

title: [Teras Isle, Washed-out Road]
description: A road once meandered along the river.  Unfortunately the river has done some meandering of its own, with the result that not much is left of the road.  Here and there bits of the road remain, but the rest is little more than a flat sandy expanse beside the river, fine for walking, but useless for wagons and other civilized traffic.

title: [Teras Isle, Washed-out Road]
description: Water laps at the crumbling edges of what were once flagstones, echoing across the deserted hills.  From somewhere not too far off, the calls of seabirds answer.  Tumbling water vines clog the river's edge and the roots of trees reach out into the refreshing water even where all dirt has been washed away.

title: [Teras Isle, River Road]
description: The broad road following the bend of the river to the east, ends abruptly here, washed away by floods long since forgotten.

title: [Teras Isle, River Road]
description: A broad road leaves the village here to follow the course of the narrow river upstream.  The river along the southeast side of the road, and the dense forest to the north prevent travel in those directions.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: All sound is muffled by the thick carpet of ash and weed that threatens to overtake this once thriving village.  However, even amid all the rubble and ruin a few structures remain intact.  A footbridge, which spans the river and cleaves the village into two halves, has seen better days -- but is probably functional.  The dark columns of the temple looming to the west are eerily reflected in the river below which lazily feeds a small cove to the south.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The singed planks and rotted pilings of this small dock barely support your weight as you look out over the cove.  A fishing boat is moored at the far end and even from here you can tell that its decrepit remains have outlived any usefulness -- even if the aft end was not fully submerged.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The dock here again attaches itself to the shore as an anchor point, giving it more reinforcement against the constant wash of the waves.  You welcome the thought of again walking on dry land as another board breaks under your feet, its condition no longer stable and solid as in times long past.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: A large dock juts out into the cove from the shore here.  At the far end of the dock you can see a small sailing sloop.  It's obvious even from here that the ship has been badly burned, and that the ship's masts have been broken into pieces.

wayto.12662: go incline

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: Here at the southernmost end of the village is a frightening panorama of destruction. Though the foundation stones of many buildings remain, all are scorched and blackened by fire.  The few structures that still stand appear to be deserted.  Even though the area around the hamlet is heavily forested, not a single tree stands within the village boundaries.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The twisted mass of vines and small bushes that have nearly overtaken the village make travel difficult, but not impossible.  Nothing has escaped their insidious, creeping onslaught.  Nearby, the walls of the guild hall and jail show signs of being gradually overtaken, as tendrils push their way through even the tiniest cracks in the outer walls.

The twisted mass of vines and small bushes that have nearly overtaken the village make travel difficult, but not impossible.  Nothing has escaped their insidious, creeping onslaught.  Nearby, the walls of the guild hall and jail show signs of being gradually overtaken, as bright tendrils of green push their way through even the tiniest cracks in the outer walls.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: As you wander through the ruins of what was once a thriving village, you are suddenly stricken by the overpowering silence.  There are no crickets singing, no squirrels chittering, not even any mice scurrying into the darkness.  Even though enough time has passed since the fire to allow vines and small bushes to choke the paths between the burned out buildings, all other life appears to have vanished without a trace.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: This must have been the main square of the village.  The charred remains of a large fountain occupy the center of the area, rising up from a rectangular pool brimming with stagnant, soot-filled water.  A statue that once rose gracefully from the center of the fountain is now a twisted, blackened mockery of its former beauty.  Large stone buildings border the square, but even though they are still standing, they did not escape the fire unscathed.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The charred remains of what was once a huge tree lie across the path here. The branches have all been burned away, and fire has eaten enough of the trunk to cause the tree to fall to the ground.  Even after all of that, the huge log that remains is over twelve feet long and several feet in diameter.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: An odd outcropping of rock stands tall here at the western edge of the village, shaped something like a huge hand.  It seems to be holding back the oppressive tide of the dense forest to the west, or perhaps it is a warning to those in the village to proceed no further.  A certain irony looms here, near this now dead village, in the form of a cold grey mausoleum, which seems to offer vague, frightening promises as you pass.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: As you struggle to make your way through the thick undergrowth, you realize that the tangle of vines and bushes makes you feel almost as if you're in a massive living maze.

title: [Teras Isle, Forest]
description: Here at the edge of the ruined village, the dense tangle of prickly vines choke off almost every path between the trees which make up this thick forest.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The road comes to a complete stop here as the vines have blocked any chance of you going further north, their heavy thorns barring your way.  Only a small opening allows you to move in any other direction without tearing the flesh from your bones.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The ominous, dark forest that surrounds the village looms close here. Towering trees twist and writhe in deformed agony, seemingly poised to invade the now desolate village.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: Looking into the darkness of the dense forest that surrounds the village, it is easy to imagine that you can sense small, malicious eyes peering back at you.  Or is that just imagination?

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The paths that once led between the buildings of the village have been strangled by the teeming mass of thorny vines and small bushes that have already engulfed nearly everything within sight.  Nearby, the meeting hall is nearly hidden amid the tangle of vines, and the temple door is barely passable due to the great clumps of feeders hanging down from its high arch.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: An oppressive pall of quiet cloaks the abandoned village, giving everything an eerie, unnatural feel.  Not even the whisper of a stray breeze rustles the vines now congesting every path between the few remaining buildings.

title: [Teras Isle, Sumendar Road]
description: A broad road, deeply cut from the passage of heavily laden carts and wagons, makes its way through the overgrown forest to the northeast.  The dense foliage allows no moonlight to pass, leaving the forest in total darkness.

A broad road, deeply cut from the passage of heavily laden carts and wagons, makes its way through the overgrown forest to the northeast.  The dense foliage allows no light to pass, leaving the forest in total darkness.

title: [Teras Isle, Sumendar Road]
description: A massive landslide has completely engulfed this road, which at one time continued to the northeast.  Pools of mud have settled into the cracks between gigantic boulders, creating a jagged wall of stone that leaves you with little choice but to turn back.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The eastern annex of the village is much smaller than the main part of the community across the river.  A dozen or so buildings once stood here, but like nearly everything else in this gloomy place, the rest have been destroyed by fire.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: A broken water wheel, half submerged in the middle of the river rushing past to the north, along with the burned remains of a building on the riverbank, suggest that some sort of mill once stood here.  However, you have seen no farmland, or suggestion of agriculture anywhere nearby that would possibly call for the need of a mill.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: A horrible stench pervades the air here.  The pungent odor overcomes even the strong smell of cinders and burnt wood that has been pervalent throughout the rest of the village.  There is no obvious source for the smell, but whatever it is must be nearby.

A horrible stench pervades the air here.  The pungent odor overcomes even the strong smell of cinders and burnt wood that has been prevalent throughout the rest of the village.  There is no obvious source for the smell, but whatever it is must be nearby.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The rancid smell of rot and decay is almost overwhelming here.  A huge compost heap, piled high with unidentifiable refuse and debris is the source of the disgusting odor.  There has been no sign of any agriculture in or around the village that would make use of the fertilizer provided by the huge compost heap, so this may simply have been a trash dump for the village.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: A slight breeze brings the putrid odor of something rotting.  It overpowers even the smoky smell to which you have become accustomed since entering the village.  The assault on your sense of smell quickly sends you reeling, gasping for relief.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: The trees at the edge of the forest are singed, but still living.  Though their limbs were blackened by the fire, tiny shoots lend a sense of rejuvenation to these otherwise dreary surroundings.  Peering further into the woods, you can see that the swath of destruction cut by the flames was mercifully stopped just south of here, leaving vast numbers of trees unharmed.

The trees at the edge of the forest are singed, but still living.  Though their limbs were blackened by the fire, tiny bursts of bright green shoots lend a sense of rejuvenation to these otherwise dreary surroundings.  Peering further into the woods, you can see that the swath of destruction cut by the flames was mercifully stopped just south of here, leaving vast numbers of trees unharmed.

title: [Fhorian Village]
description: The line of trees to the south cuts off any other access to the outside world.  The town is totally surrounded by the heavy growth.  The smell of decay is still heavy in the air, but mixed somewhat with the smell of the lake you see off to the west.

title: [Fish Plant, Sorting Room]
description: This plant was once a large fish processing plant.  You can see a number of large vats designed to hold the catch.  This room is where the fresh fish would be brought for sorting and processing.  A chute in the north wall would have allowed the fish to slide into this room from a ship moored just outside the building.

title: [Fish Plant, Smoker Room]
description: This room is where the catch would have been smoked.  Large smokers that are now dormant have left a layer of soot about the room.  There are still stacks of split logs in the corner that would have been used in the smoking process.  Now they are only homes for termites.

title: [Fish Plant, Pickling Room]
description: This is the room where the fish would have been pickled.  Large vats fill the room, with catwalks hanging above them.  The air is pungent with the odor of decay and the smell of rotten pickling juices.  The odor fills the room, and you are almost too repulsed by it to seek out the source.

title: [Fish Plant, Shipping Entrance]
description: This must have been the shipping entrance.  You see ruts worn in the dirt where heavy wagon loads of fish must have left the plant on numerous occasions.  Now there is nothing here but a few barrels of decayed matter.  You are not sure if it could have even been edible at any time in the past, but it sure is not now.

title: [Fish Plant, Office]
description: This room must have been the plant manager's office, from the looks of all the papers scattered about the floor.  The desk has been ransacked and the chairs overturned.  Even the pictures are missing from the wall, leaving squares of clean plaster where they once were.

title: [Fish Plant, Pickling Room]
description: As you traverse the catwalk that hangs suspended over the vats, you are very careful not to break the planking under your feet.  You can now see inside most of the vats and what you see disgusts you.  Where you thought you would see pickled fish, you only see small dead creatures.  It would seem that some came to drink from the vats, falling in and drowning.  Or perhaps some effect of the now putrid fluid caused their almost instant death so that their bodies slipped into the thick fluids in the vats.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: Large bushes slap at your face and hands as you move slowly on these overgrown paths.  The dense tangle of vines on the ground obscures nearly every trace of the once well-tended walkways leading through the village, and makes travel extremely difficult.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: From this vantage point, the small cove which centers the village looks like a shimmering jewel in the midst of all this destruction.  Sparkling waters lap peacefully at the boulders surrounding the tiny inlet.

From this vantage point, the small cove which centers the village looks like a shimmering jewel in the midst of all this destruction.  Crystal clear waters lap peacefully at the boulders surrounding the tiny inlet, and even though the vegetation nearby is untended, the contrast between the dark shades of the cove floor, and the lush green of the vines is extraordinarily beautiful.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: A stray breeze from the west brings with it a rancid scent of decay that is strong enough to mask even the smell of burned wood and cinders so prevalent in this ghost town.

title: [Fhorian Village, Warehouse]
description: Row after row of heavy wooden shelves have been knocked over and now lie in ruins on the dirt floor.  In one corner, the last few shreds of flesh that remain on a vaguely humanoid skeleton now serve as food for a massive trail of ants that winds across the room.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, out

title: [Fhorian Village, Warehouse]
description: Except for a few dried leaves that scuttle in front of a small gust of wind, this room is completely empty.
paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, west, out

title: [Fhorian Village, Warehouse]
description: There is nothing of value left in this warehouse.  Every container has been turned over and emptied before being discarded.  The piles on the floor tell you nothing about what was in them as the decay is almost total.  They might have been food stores at some time, but now they are just smears on the wooden floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, west, northwest, out

title: [Fhorian Village, Warehouse]
description: This small office has been completely dismantled in a very thorough, if not destructive, fashion.  The drawers from a large desk have been pulled out, and their contents strewn about the room.  Yellowed ledgers, books, and old receipts flutter with each gust of wind that wafts through the building.  A dark stain in the middle of the room appears to be dried ink at first glance, but a vaguely gruesome sense of curiosity makes you look again.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, out

title: [Manor House, Kitchen]
description: A great heap of mud, soot and debris pours in from an enormous crack in one wall.  Beneath the sticky hill of mud, you can barely make out the rough edges of the huge boulder that nearly destroyed the outer wall of this room.

title: [Manor House, Entry Hall]
description: Pale marble peeks through the thick layer of soot on the floor, hinting at an elegant past for this house.  Graceful stone pedestals line the walls, empty now, but for a few broken shards of crockery that might have once been fine ceramic urns.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Manor House, Sitting Room]
description: A deep green glow blankets this room and it takes only a moment to recognize its source -- the window on one wall has been covered with a heavy layer of vines.  Their only support is a thin lace curtain which strains under the immense weight.  Long thin tendrils of green reach out across the paneled walls, disappearing down into the cushions of an easy chair sitting near the fireplace.  A small table has been overturned, but beyond that, and the vines, there are few signs of anything amiss here.

title: [Manor House, Drawing Room]
description: Though much of the house is still in good repair, this room has been nearly demolished.  Pale grey cushions have been pulled from the furniture and ripped to shreds.  Mahogany tables are now little more than kindling, smashed almost beyond recognition.  Paintings have been pulled from the walls, and ribbons of canvas litter the floor.  In some places, even the heavy paneling has been pried away to reveal the plaster beneath.

title: [Manor House, Dining Room]
description: The delicate sound of dozens of crystal teardrops bumping against each other draws your attention to the center of this room.  There, suspended from the high ceiling, is a brass chandelier with seven ornate fittings for candles amid the lacework of cut glass.  A large dining table and chairs appear untouched by fire, their once gleaming surfaces now dry and covered with dust after years of neglect.

title: [Manor House, Porch]
description: An uncharacteristically cool breeze stirs the hundreds of honeysuckle blossoms which border this shady porch.  Slender columns of marble stand silent sentinel to the house beyond, marred only by great ribbons of vines which have wrapped firmly around their bases and gradually work their way upward.  One day, perhaps in the near future, this porch will be engulfed by the ravenous vegetation -- but for now, they provide a refreshing respite from the sultry temperatures outside.

An uncharacteristically cool breeze stirs the hundreds of honeysuckle blossoms which border this shady porch.  Slender columns of white marble stand silent sentinel to the house beyond, marred only by great ribbons of vines which have wrapped firmly around their bases and gradually work their way upward.  One day, perhaps in the near future, this porch will be engulfed by the ravenous vegetation -- but for now, they provide a refreshing respite from the sultry temperatures outside.

title: [Teras Isle, High Road]
description: The ground rises rapidly on the northern side of the valley between the two peaks.  Up the slope marches a narrow but well maintained causeway.  Only Dwarves would build such a fine road with such a steep grade.

title: [Teras Isle, High Road]
description: The view from the slope is spectacular.  Banks of thick fog swirl down the mountain, obscuring all for a few moments, then rushing down toward the dense Greymist Wood below.  To the southeast roll fields of grass and the dark eastern cliffs hold back the powerful ocean beyond.  Around you, the earth has taken on a darker hue, and jagged rocks pierce it more often than vegetation.  From the side of the road a trail leads up slope.

The view from the slope is spectacular.  Banks of thick yellow fog swirl down the mountain, obscuring all for a few moments, then rushing down toward the dense Greymist Wood below.  To the southeast roll fields of grass and the dark eastern cliffs hold back the powerful blue ocean beyond.  Around you, the earth has taken on a darker hue, and jagged rocks pierce it more often than vegetation.  From the side of the road a trail leads up slope.

title: [Teras Isle, High Road]
description: As the causeway makes the main slope of V'tull, you notice that much of its construction is glaes, cut with vents and channels.  The black residue striping the road and the wafting odor of brimstone suggest these channels guide lava safely across or under the path.  Steaming lines of red liquid stone etch the higher slopes, making you glad for Dwarven foresight.

title: [Teras Isle, High Road]
description: A particularly fearsome lava flow has obliterated a section of the causeway's upper lip, leaving a clear view of the volcanic slope above.  Far above, the truncated cone of the volcano issues great clouds of steam into the air, and even at this distance an angry grumble rattles bone, stone, and soul.

title: [Teras Isle, Volcanic Slope]
description: No plant grows on the windy face of V'tull.  If ever there was soil here, wind, rain, and fire cast it down to the rich loam of the grasslands long ago.  A few lizards scuttle about the rocks.

No plant grows on the windy face of V'tull.  If ever there was soil here, wind, rain, and fire cast it down to the rich loam of the grasslands long ago.  A few red lizards alternate between sunning themselves and scuttling about wildly.

title: [Teras Isle, Volcanic Slope]
description: Rough rock claws like an angry beast and the slope quickly steepens.  The island stands out below you like a map upon a table: the dark jumble of the Greymist, the lighter tones of the grasslands, and the blue of the surrounding sea.

Rough rock claws like an angry beast and the slope quickly steepens.  The island stands out below you like a map upon a table: the dark green jumble of the Greymist, the lighter tones of the grasslands, and the deep blue of the surrounding sea.

title: [Teras Isle, High Road]
description: The way narrows along the ocean face of V'tull.  It winds across the great curve of the burning mountain in a spindly ribbon, disappearing into a sulfurous mist that even the harsh winds of the eastern shore cannot disperse.  A thick river of lava pours across the road, overflowing one of its many channels.  It will cool soon, no doubt, but for the time being the road ends here.

title: [Teras Isle, Rocky Trail]
description: From here the trail leads down to the dwarven high road, or weaves through the stunted trees and rock outcroppings as it climbs the ridge to the north.

title: [Teras Isle, Lava Flows]
description: Flames and incandescent splatterings of lava leap above the treetops to the north.  All along the ridgeline, flashes of red and bright orange peek through the silhouetted foliage and lend an air of impending destruction to the scene.

Flames and incandescent splatterings of lava leap above the treetops to the north.  All along the ridgeline, flashes of red and dull orange peek through the greenery and lend an air of impending destruction to the scene.

title: [Lava Flows, Fiery Gap]
description: Fountains of flame and lava light up the night sky all along the ridgeline to the east and west.  The land to the south is cloaked in darkness, but downslope to the north the blackened land is lit by glowing ribbons of orange lava.

Fountains of flame and lava form a solid wall of fire that stretches to the east and west.  The erupting fissure is just north of the ridge so the land to the south has been spared, but downslope to the north is a wasteland of charred devastation.  The blackened landscape is a nightmare of criss-crossed lava channels, cooling basalt, and vegetation burned to ash.

title: [Lava Flows, Black Rocks]
description: Black rock, as far as the eye can see, is yet unsoftened by wind or rain, with edges that snag clothing and tear flesh.  It seems to have thrust up from the island's gut, offering no purpose other than that.  Yet the marks are plain that something dwells in this wasteland.

Black rock, as far as the eye can see, is yet unsoftened by wind or rain, with edges that snag clothing and tear flesh.  It seems to have thrust up from the island's gut and left to smoulder in the sunshine, offering no purpose other than that.  Yet the marks are plain that something dwells in this wasteland.

title: [Lava Flows, Basalt Arch]
description: A narrow span of basalt arcs over the lava channel to the north.  This single arch of black rock is all that remains of a massive lava pipe that must have once filled the center of the valley.

title: [Lava Flows, Ashy Crust]
description: A layer of crusted ash tops the basalt here, a handbreadth thick and pale grey, lending a softness to the ragged stone beneath.  The only basalt clear of ash is the newest rock, still cooling.

title: [Lava Flows, Molten Stream]
description: A constant stream of lava, shades of infernal red and orange glowing beneath a shifting crust of black, flows downslope from the south.  Cutting through this area, where sheer basalt formations try to hide beneath cinders and ash, the stream of lava blocks any further progress to the west.

title: [Lava Flows, East-West Channel]
description: Just to the north the main lava channel, several man-heights deep, cuts the valley from west to east.  From a vent in the volcano's side that is now shrouded in ash, the mountain's fire burned itself a trench.  The vagaries of nature have shifted the flow of molten rock to higher ground, and the lavabed now lies dark, its last contents frozen in an ebon mimicry of motion.

Just to the north the main lava channel, several man-heights deep, cuts the valley from west to east.  From a vent in the volcano's side that is now shrouded in ash, the mountain's fire burned itself a trench toward the rising sun.  The vagaries of nature have shifted theflow of molten rock to higher ground, and the lavabed now lies dark, its last contents frozen in an ebon mimicry of motion.

Just to the north the main lava channel, several man-heights deep, cuts the valley from west to east.  From a vent in the volcano's side that is now shrouded in ash, the mountain's fire burned itself a trench toward the rising sun.  The vagaries of nature have shifted the flow of molten rock to higher ground, and the lavabed now lies dark, its last contents frozen in an ebon mimicry of motion.

title: [Lava Flows, Sinkholes]
description: Streams of molten lava from the southern ridgeline vanish into sinkholes here, the liquid stone returning to subterranean realms through holes burned in the older basalt.  With molten lava vanishing almost underfoot the ground here is uncomfortable to even walk on, and the heated air feels like an oven.

title: [Lava Flows, Cinder Cone]
description: Steam rises from a dormant cinder cone that protrudes from the base of the volcano here.  Much smaller than its parent, the cinder cone still stands a good six or seven man-heights above the surrounding slope.

title: [Lava Flows, Quiet Hollow]
description: A quiet cul-de-sac in this land of flames and ash, this area is bracketed by the volcano's cone on the west, the lava fountains flaring along the ridge to the south, and the streams of lava flowing from them to the east.  Even in this area of relative peace the blanket of ash makes footing unsure.

title: [Lava Flows, Volcano Approach]
description: A sloping wall of mixed cinders and ash rises sharply to the west.  Beyond its top, some one hundred or more man-heights above, a constant spire of smoke the color of dead men's teeth leaks into the night sky.  Too steep to climb easily, and too loose and treacherous to climb even with care and preparation, the giant cone marks the unassailable domain of the volcano's heart.

A sloping wall of mixed cinders and ash rises sharply to the west.  Beyond its top, some one hundred or more man-heights above, a constant spire of smoke the color of dead men's teeth leaks into the sky.  Too steep to climb easily, and too loose and treacherous to climb even with care and preparation, the giant cone marks the unassailable domain of the volcano's heart.

title: [Lava Flows, Cinder Path]
description: The passage of many feet has packed the ash and cinders along here into a firm path, which is the only distinguishable feature in the area.

title: [Lava Flows, Smoke Falls]
description: A wall of basalt forms the face of a vapor-and-smoke falls to the north, forcing any movement through here against the brink of the valley's main lava channel.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Lava Flows, Fumaroles]
description: Fumaroles along the northern ridge emit a constant cloud of noxious vapors and smoke.  Short of suicide, you can't think of a single reason to continue in that direction.

Fumaroles along the northern ridge emit a constant cloud of noxious, yellow vapors and opaque white smoke.  Even the layer of ash in that direction has been stained an unhealthy yellow, and, short of suicide, you can't think of a single reason to continue in that direction.

title: [Lava Flows, Dark Gash]
description: Just south of here the main lava channel, several man-heights deep, cuts the valley from east to west.  No longer alive with the heat and glow of molten lava, it forms a dark gash down the center of the valley.

title: [Lava Flows, Sulfurous Path]
description: A curtain of pale vapor rolls downhill from the valley's northern ridge.  The odor of rotten eggs is overpowering, and mingling tendrils of smoke leave throats raw and eyes burning.
A curtain of pale yellow vapor rolls downhill from the valley's northern ridge.  The odor of rotten eggs is overpowering, and mingling tendrils of grey smoke leave throats raw and eyes burning.

title: [Lava Flows, Windy Turn]
description: Winds sweeping around the northern face of the volcano shred the smoke and fumes here.  A plain of ash is barely visible through the wisps and tatters of the volcano's exhalations.
Winds sweeping around the northern face of the volcano shred the smoke and fumes here.  An unnatural plain of pale yellow ash is visible through the wisps and tatters of the volcano's exhalations.

title: [Lava Flows, Narrow Span]
description: A narrow span of black rock arcs over the valley's main lava channel to the southern side.

title: [Lava Flows, Barren Flats]
description: The layer of ash is much thinner here, the wind and rain having erased it completely in some places, leaving the land a barren nightmare of jumbled black rock and cinders.

title: [Lava Flows, Old Channel]
description: An old lava channel forms a ready path through the basalt outcroppings and boulders that the volcano has thrown this far.  To the north, a hillock rises out of the litter of stones, its shoulders strewn with rubble and its top a flat expanse.  A trail zigzags up the incline, punctuated with pockets of lava that decorate the hillock with their flickering red light.

title: [Lava Flows, Basalt Fans]
description: Several old lava channels shallow out and widen here where the land rises.  The area resembles a disarray of giant, black basalt fans, each overlaying its predecessors as it spreads out toward the east.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Lava Flows, Sulfurous Billows]
description: Ground-hugging clouds of vile smoke drift downhill from the north and west.  The area is devoid of life.
Ground-hugging clouds of vile, yellow smoke drift downhill from the north and west.  The rock and cinders here have taken on an unhealthy yellowish tinge, and the area is devoid of life.

title: [Lava Flows, Rivers of Stone]
description: Cold, lifeless lava flows wind their way between scattered ash and cinder-covered hillocks:  debris from the volcano's cataclysmic awakening forming obstacles to the rivers of fire that followed, and wearing the dustings of the smaller eruptions that came after.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Lava Flows, Hummocks]
description: Ringed by a seemingly endless procession of hummocks, formed from huge chunks of the mountain that were thrown aloft in the first massive eruption and worn down over the decades.  The volcano's wasteland stretches eastward toward the sea.

title: [Lava Flows, Greening]
description: Tufts of savannah grass poke through the cracked layers of black rock.  No new lava has flowed here in years, and life has begun to reclaim some of the wasteland.
Bright green tufts of savannah grass poke through the cracked layers of black rock.  No new lava has flowed here in years, and life has begun to reclaim some of the wasteland.

title: [Lava Flows, Ribbon of Lava]
description: A bright ribbon of orange through the blackened landscape, the river of molten rock from the southwest turns east in its journey to the sea.

title: [Lava Flows, Lava Feeds]
description: Fed by nearby outpourings from the lava fountains along the southern ridge, the stream of lava from the southwest widens into a river of flame as it flows to the northeast.

title: [Lava Flows, Battered Column]
description: A tall, basalt formation dominates this area, remarkable in its battered and cracked condition.  Someone, or something, has spent time and effort smashing every handspan of its surface from about head-level up to several man-heights above the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Lava Flows, Bubbling Pool]
description: A pool of lava bubbles and seethes, fed by the resurfacing flows from further west.  Overflowing from the fresh lava pushing up from beneath, the pool feeds a stream of molten rock that has cut its own channel toward the east.

title: [Lava Flows, Crossing Gullies]
description: Scarred and re-scarred by past eruptions, this area is criss-crossed by gullies carved by molten lava.  Massive, ash-topped blocks of basalt mark the patches of ground where the river of fire was turned aside and hulking formations left by earlier flows remain intact.

title: [Lava Flows, Odd Tracks]
description: Several undisturbed prints in the ash along the edge of the path appear humanoid, but much larger than even those of giantmen.  Others look reptilian, four-footed, and bisected by the line of a tail.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Lava Flows, Blasting Winds]
description: Breezes laden with volcanic heat sweep across the uneven layers of cracked and weathered basalt.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Lava Flows, Stone Forest]
description: Tall formations of black rock form a small forest of stone here.  Some among them are scarred and battered well above the ground, as if they have been attacked.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Bluff]
description: A steep trail winds between stark formations of glaes, frozen into grotesqueries of shapes that populate the narrow butte like strange, contorted wanderers.  Hot spits of wind push drifting clouds of steam and smoke about, carrying an undertone of salty sea-air mixed with the sulfurous stench of lava.

A steep trail winds between stark formations of glaes, frozen into grotesqueries of shapes that populate the narrow butte like strange, contorted wanderers.  Hot spits of wind push drifting clouds of steam and smoke about, carrying an undertone of salty sea-air mixed with the sulfurous stench of lava.  To the south is spread a panoramic view of basalt, lava and, here and there, the ferocious beasts that thrive in such surroundings.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Bluff]
description: The trail winds around the western side of a particularly large glaes formation.  Its opposite side is blocked by a bubbling pool of magma.  Steam mixed with smoke drifts up from the pool, enveloping the rock form in a shifting mantle.  In the haze, it takes on the appearance of an old, stooped giant clutching its cloak as the wind whips the garment about.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Plateau]
description: To the north, the hilltop levels into a plateau.  Bubbling lava pools dot the landscape, sending curling ribbons of smoke aloft like a skyline of belching chimneys over the rooftops of a town.  A large glaes formation on the south blocks the view in that direction.

To the north, the hilltop levels into an expansive plateau.  Bubbling lava pools dot the landscape, sending curling ribbons of smoke aloft like a skyline of belching chimneys over the rooftops of a town.  In the distance, the blue of open sea can be seen, with its shimmering reflections and low-riding clouds.  A large glaes formation on the south blocks the view in that direction.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Basalt Hillock, Narrow Gulch]
description: The trail winds and twists as basalt walls rise on either side of it.  The floor is broken with a jumble of rocks, and high on the walls, large wasp nests cling, safe from the reach of land-bound creatures.  Wasps buzz industriously around the huge nests, mere pin-pricks against the moonlit sky.

The trail winds and twists as basalt walls rise on either side of it.  The floor is broken with a jumble of rocks, and high on the walls, large wasp nests cling, safe from the reach of land-bound creatures.  Wasps buzz industriously around the huge nests, mere pin-pricks against the sky.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Narrow Gulch]
description: A basalt wall forces the trail to curve to the northwest, blocking the way with its pitted shoulder.  Crevices are numerous within the volcanic rock, and lizards dart in and out of them in rapid sprints that defy the eye to follow.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Overhang]
description: The trail comes to a halt beneath a large rock overhang, creating a cave-like shelter open on three sides.  Beneath the overhang, the air is noticeably cooler, and rank with the smell of damp earth mixed with sulfur.  The face of the rock wall is heavily striated, however faint and ancient designs are still noticeable despite the ravages of time, heat and harsh elements.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Plateau]
description: Lava pools and jumbles of sharp basalt and glaes rock combine for a hazardous passage across the plateau.  Smoke drifts and swirls, giving the landscape a dream-like appearance.  Faint trails wind through the magma pools in several directions, betraying the presence of wildlife tough enough to eke out an existence on such relentless terrain.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Plateau]
description: A dangerous precipice borders the northeastern edge of the plateau, falling onto rocks far below.  In places, molten lava cascades over the edge in remarkable ribbons, sending trailers of steam and fire shooting out over the abyss.  The broken skeleton of a large beast can be seen, cradled in an outcropping of glaes which projects from the cliff's face halfway down its descent.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Plateau]
description: Lava pools grow more prevalent, confining the trail to narrow walkways across the smoking vista.  Steam hisses from the gaping, magma-filled wounds in the landscape like a chorus of angry snakes.  As bubbles pop on the surface of the pools, they add a deeper-toned syncopation to the cacophony.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Basalt Hillock, Plateau]
description: The trail meanders between pools of lava and a precipice that falls away to the northwest.  Around the magma pits, ridges of cooled lava create striated parallel rings.  An excretion of still-cooling molten rock has collected in spots within the ridges, like smoking discharge around the eyes of some great lizard.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Glaes Megalith]
description: Trails radiate from the base of a large megalith of glaes.  Its surface is pitted and scarred from the assault of lava eruptions, and its shape is irregular.  Stunted shoots protrude from its column, reaching in all directions like misshapen limbs.  The confluence of trails stops abruptly at the formation's foot, as if designating it the destination of all journeys upon the plateau.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west

title: [Basalt Hillock, Overlook]
description: The trail dead-ends at the foot of a precipice, which slopes steeply down to a lower level of the butte.  Magma pools surround the narrow aisle of the path, with hissing lava as the consequence of any misstep.  Over the edge of the drop-off, the faint beginnings of more winding trails can be seen under the pale light of the moon, circumnavigating conflagrant pits and basalt and glaes formations.

The trail dead-ends at the foot of a precipice, which slopes steeply down to a lower level of the butte.  Magma pools surround the narrow aisle of the path, with hissing lava as the consequence of any misstep.  Over the edge of the drop-off, more winding trails can be seen, circumnavigating conflagrant pits and basalt and glaes formations.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Precipice]
description: On the northwest, the trail skitters and dodges over the boulders choking a steep slope.  Below is a lower section of the plateau, dotted with lava pits and bordered by a sheer cliff wall on the east.  To the northwest, a huge stela of glaes towers high over the floor of the mesa.

On the northwest, the trail skitters and dodges over the boulders choking a steep slope.  Below is a lower section of the plateau, dotted with lava pits and bordered by a sheer cliff wall on the east.  To the northwest, a huge stela of glaes towers high over the floor of the mesa, casting an irregular shadow over the bubbling magma pits and rutted terrain.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Second Tier]
description: The flat tier mirrors its sister above, dotted with bubbling pools of liquid death, like some malevolent garden made by the god of brimstone and fire.  Stark basalt fingers jut out of the landscape, casting crooked shadows.  The odor of sulfur is near to overpowering, hemmed in by the cliff walls on the eastern side of the plateau.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Second Tier]
description: The trail crooks between lava pools and piles of sharp, broken rock, its track unsure and torturous.  It follows the slope to the tier above closely, skirting boulders and the entrances to small caves.  A massive boulder forces it to dog-leg to the north, winding around the stone's base in a narrow defile.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Bottleneck]
description: A pile of boulders, detritus of a rock-slide or eruption, halts the trail in a narrow bottle-neck.  Immense wasp nests dot the higher rocks like bulbous blemishes.  Swarms of venomous insects circle many of them, erratic pinpoints that produce an ominous, underlying hum.  A few nests on lower rocks show evidence of vandalism, their interiors gutted and spouting filmy material that waves in the gusts of hot wind.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Second Tier]
description: The track circles an immense pillar of glaes, towering over the trail on its western shoulder like a colossal sentry watching the approach.  A smaller track winds its way to the east, as if fleeing the monolith to find refuge against the cliff face bordering the plain.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Cliff Face]
description: At the foot of a cliff wall, the trail circles, doubling back on itself and looping around some boulders grouped at the bluff's base.  The rock face is striated, with bands of color that resemble gently waving ribbons.  Over the pattern created by the sediments, a panorama of primitive beasts is painted.  Depicted there are pyrothags, skayl and other animals that are unrecognizable, but elegant in form and posture.

At the foot of a cliff wall, the trail circles, doubling back on itself and looping around some boulders grouped at the bluff's base.  The rock face is striated, with bands of color that resemble gently waving ribbons.  Over the pattern created by the sediments, a panorama of primitive beasts is painted, rendered in beautiful earth tones that complement the colors of the rock.  Depicted there are pyrothags, skayl and other animals that are unrecognizable, but elegant in form and posture.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Overlook]
description: The trail curves around the huge glaes formation, its path zigzagging around lava and rock.  At the edge of a steep embankment on the north, an offshoot of the trail weaves down the incline between a scrub of boulders and strange, stunted bushes with withered-looking, grey leaves.  A few of the shrubs are perched at the edge of small fissures full of lava, their gnarled roots submerged in the liquid rock.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Glaes Stella]
description: The trail skirts the perimeter of the huge glaes pillar.  To the north, a steep slope cants down to a third tier, which is little more than a crescent-shaped shoulder of sharp-edged scree.  Beyond, another cliff falls into a deep ravine, its bottom too deep to be visible.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Deadend]
description: A large embankment of rock prevents further travel around the glaes pillar to the south for anything that can't rely on wings to carry it.  Sound is muffled, leaving only the omnipresent hum of wasps and the low hiss of magma pools.  The huge glaes stella blocks most wind movement, leaving its lee occluded with smoke from the bubbling lava.

title: [Ta'Illistim Realtor]
description: White-washed haon walls give the room an airy feel, bounded along the ceiling and floor with bands of pink and green marble.  A round window imbedded with shards of rainbow quartz and cabochons of lavender shimmarglin sapphire looks out on the street below.  One large central maple desk fronts this charming office, framed by twin bookcases against the wall behind it.  A loomed rug depicts the Ta'Illistim Masters of Lore, some teaching, some practicing their craft, in intricate detail.

title: [Lava Flows, Lava Lake Chamber]
description: Molten lava bubbles and explodes at the center of the lake of liquid rock that fills this chamber.  Large enough to hold a couple of good-sized manor houses, the heat trapped in here begins to sear exposed flesh within seconds.  The level of the lake must have been higher in the past since a ledge of black basalt circles the room and extends into the lava pipe to the west.  Part way up the chamber's dome a patch of sky is visible through a gaping hole in the basalt.

Molten lava bubbles and explodes at the center of the lake of liquid rock that fills this chamber.  Large enough to hold a couple of good-sized manor houses, the heat trapped in here begins to sear exposed flesh within seconds.  The level of the lake must have been higher in the past since a ledge of black basalt circles the room and extends into the lava pipe to the west.  Part way up the chamber's dome a patch of night sky is visible through a gaping hole in the basalt.

title: [Lava Flows, Lava Pipe]
description: The ledge of basalt continues along the side of this subterranean tube, lit by the infernal glow of the river of lava that flows down its center.  Oddly enough, the flow seems to be away from the lake and towards the volcano.

title: [Lava Flows, Lava Pipe]
description: The river continues to flow westward through this subterranean tube.

title: [Lava Flows, Lava Pipe]
description: The molten lava drops through a fissure in the floor of this chamber, but the heat seems less intense here.  A narrow gap high in the west wall might be the reason, since part of a distant crater wall is visible through it.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Entrance]
description: Sparkles of charcoal grey ash slowly drift to the ground where they add to the several inches already resting there.  Wafts of steam and hot air, rising from a dark hole in the rock face, cause the ash to swirl and dance tirelessly while incessant vibrations from deep within the mountain send rocks skittering downward and make the footing unsure.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: Heavy ash covers the cavern floor and absorbs much of the sound and light here while hot sulfurous air, rushing in from the southwest, accumulates ash and steam as it passes before continuing on towards the southeast.  Dull vibrations shake the walls and occasionally jar loose small stones that thud into the thick ash.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: Whistling loudly as it passes, hot air, heavy with ash, scours the floor and walls clean as it is funneled upwards by the narrowing passage.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Chamber of Wind]
description: Hot air, rushing in from the northwest, forms a violent vortex that ascends a smooth walled, circular chimney.  Laden with ash, the vortex limits visibility while creating a roaring growl that could drown out all but the loudest of sounds.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: Spires of crystal rise through the thick ash covering the floor and cast off an eerie blue light.  Blanketing the walls and ceiling, stress cracks spew forth a thick sulfurous gas while a deep fissure cuts the floor like a wound.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: Pillars of crystal stretch to the ceiling, providing an eerie blue light throughout.  Piles of fresh igneous rock protrude from beneath the cloak of ash revealing recent activity while thunderous groans and crashes can be heard deeper into the heart of V'Tull.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Lava River]
description: Swiftly diving below a crystal ledge in the northwest wall an almost white hot river of lava thrashes within the confines of the rock.  Along the far shore piles of shattered crystal and stone mark a recent cave in caused by the violent forces shaking the mountain.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: Dark shadows dance along the walls and ceiling caused by super heated air passing over luminous crystal stalactites.  Cracks in the wall show recent growth as forces behind push forward.  Ripples form in the floor's ash covering as it is disturbed by the constant tremors.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: The cavern narrows here while puddles of liquid sulfur gurgle and splatter, releasing an intolerable aroma that permeates the area.  Growling loudly, V'Tull protests the massive forces that are reshaping it from the inside out.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: Extremely narrow here, the cavern forces escaping heat into a howling wind that scours the floor clear of ash.  Erosion has smoothed the walls and ceiling here to a mirror-like finish, dulled the edges of even recent stress cracks and rounded the tops of the freshest igneous formations.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: The cavern turns tightly here as it descends towards the south.  Fresh igneous protrusions show signs of recent growth while cracks extend the length of the walls and ceiling.  Tremors shake loose rocks and crystal shards that thud into the thick ash covering the floor and slowly roll down towards the south.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Outer Caverns]
description: The cavern slopes deeply to the southeast where a soft orange glow casts long black shadows from fresh igneous formations.  Heat wafts off the walls and floor, forming small whirlwinds of ash that dance chaotically for several moments before dispersing.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Crystal Chamber]
description: The cavern opens into a large chamber full of luminous blue crystal stalactites and pools of bubbling orange lava.  Nearby several pillars of igneous rock guard a plume of super heated steam jetting out of several cracks in the floor.  The steam has formed the ceiling here into a mirror polished dome over thirty feet at its peak.
paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Crystal Chamber]
description: Low steady vibrations shake the area violently as V'Tull protests the forces reshaping it.  The vibrations have shattered many of the crystal stalactites leaving the floor with a mixed cover of shards and ash while whiffs of steam and sulferous gasses dance in the small whirlwinds on the currents of hot air.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Crystal Chamber]
description: Steam slowly settles among several igneous rock formations in a sheet of mist causing shadows as it drifts over the luminous blue crystal stalagtites.  Light and dark dance along the walls in an eerie rhythm to the violent incessant tremors that permeate the area.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Crystal Chamber]
description: The rumbling of the ground is drowned out by the roar of the lava river to the southeast.  All around, crystal stalactites crash to the ground, losing their glow as they are pulverized on impact.  Amidst this the plume of super heated steam sends shimmering wave after shimmering wave of light as it blasts the remaining stalactites clean.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Lava River]
description: Glowing nearly white hot, a river of molten rock splashes lava upon its shores.  A natural bridge of black igneous rock stretches to the far side where a pair of carved arches can be seen cut into the wall.  Tremors cause crystal stalactites to break free and splash into the river only to sink in the lava's eternal grip.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Molten lava once used this chamber to make its way to the surface, but the chamber and the passageways beyond are empty now, the lava having found a different path to travel.  The walls of the cavern have given up little of their heat and they still flow red and white in some locations.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Ash drifts heavily in the air, and the continued formation of crystals causes the glowing rock to intensify the light as it bounces and compounds itself off the walls.  The thick layer of soot on the floor does little to insulate the heat that rises from beneath its surface.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Walls cracked from enormous pressure of earth and element allow steam to fill the room, causing it to mix with the heavy ash and become sticky on your flesh.  Were you fully exposed you would certainly suffer major burns to the exposed skin.  Even the walls are plastered heavily with the coating, causing this room to be much dimmer than others you have been in.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Only a thick layer of ash on the floor insulates your feet against the intense heat of the cavern, as smoke and steam still seeps up through it.  A small cracking noise comes from the floor beneath you, the soot covering the ground keeps you from being able to see where it might have cooled unevenly or where it might be thin from the heat.  You can only hope that your weight allows you to traverse the area without incident.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: A strange whirlwind of heated air picks up some ash from the floor only to rain it back down again as it passes you, covering you from head to toe in black soot.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: The main passage heads north here, while a smaller one winds around a large pillar of rock to the northeast.  The walls are covered with small crystals that reflect a little light through the ash filled air.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Huge stalactites and stalagmites choke the passage slightly here, and steam is forced from some small fissures in the floor, carrying dust and ash with it as it rises into the air.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Gusts of hot air blow into the cavern, occasionally picking up ash and carrying it off to another part of the passage.  The walls are crystallized and appear to have been exposed to some great heat recently.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: A few bones lie here, apparently carelessly discarded by someone who no longer cared for or needed them.  A thick layer of ash covers the floor, but is constantly being smoothed over by strong gusts of heated air.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: A sudden burst of steam blows from a nearby fissure, and you take a few cautious steps around it to avoid the scorching heat.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: A large river of molten lava flows through the area, the extreme heat making it harder to breathe, and your face feels like it might burst into flames just by looking at the slow moving river.  Small flames jump out of the river to consume rocks and other things that were careless and fell into the deadly stream.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: This small alcove provides a little protection from the hot air and steam that constantly plague the area below.  Beads of sweat roll down your face and hands as you try and decide if you want to again venture downward back into the chaos.

wayto.2209:
;e empty_hands
begin
result = dothistimeout 'climb fissure', 2, /Round time|Roundtime|find yourself|Crawlway/
waitrt?
end until result.to_s !~ /round/i
fill_hands

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: You see a sharply descending cylindrical crawlway leading down into the depths of the volcano.  The air here is so hot it's painful to breathe.  This passageway is cramped, and the lava-scorched glassine walls seem somewhat unstable as they squeeze in from either side.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: The crawlway angles sharply here, making climbing treacherous.  Razor-sharp pieces of crystallized volcanic glass protrude from the ash-covered surface.  The walls of this pipe-like tunnel close in tightly around you, making passage slow going.  Smoky hot silt and soot swirl upward from below.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: Slanting sharply at a near-vertical pitch, the crawlway cuts deeper into the volcano.  This narrow tube seem to be widening ever so slightly through an opening below.  The soot smudged walls tremor around you as magma shifts from beyond the rock.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Composed of living rock, the area around you seems to be in a constant state of flux.  You can see molten lava moving freely behind the semi-transparent surface.  It seems to pulse with a malevolent sentience.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: The walls here are a little smoother and smudged with soot.  The air seems very thick, and it shimmers from the heat.  Sulfurous gasses vent from gaps in the wall, spouting out molten rock.  Flickering flames dance across the floor, as the liquefied rock ignites the porous surface.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Rivulets of lava flow down a jagged crack in the wall, burning channels into the heated earthen floor.  Tiny bits of superheated dirt are spit up into the air as the lava burns through whatever it touches.  The lava burbles southward.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: The path narrows here, dropping sharply to either side into a fiery hell below.  Falling would only hurt for a second.  As you look over the edges beneath you, gouts of flame shoot up, illuminating the walls in shades of yellow and orange.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: A steep-sided fissure cuts through the path here.  Walls of fire formed from rows of viscous lava rise up along the rift, making further passage look nearly impossible.  A turbulent mixture of corrosive gasses and angular chunks of molten rock vents violently outwards from the impenetrable flames.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Accreted globules of lava have hardened on the browned andesite walls.  Thin veins of pure iron run from floor to ceiling.  Fine particles of pulverized rock dust the floor underfoot.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Glassy particles of coalescing rock dot the carbonized walls.  Fossilized bones protrude out of the ash-covered floor, all that remains of a long-forgotten spelunker.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Streams of fragmented magma and magmatic gasses vent upwards at high velocity from a cylindrical cone in the ground.  The heated fragments form a column, which roils upwards and out through a huge crack in the ceiling.  The path curves around the cone in either direction.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Small, hardened obsidian droplets have formed on the ceiling overhead.  Spherical, tear-shaped lava formations cascade down the walls on either side of you.  If the floor were the roof here, it would almost seem as if the eyes were crying stone tears.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Spidery, elongated cracks and fractures run deep through the walls and ceilings here.  Light colored mineral deposits speckle the white-streaked alkalic floor.  Steamy, water-saturated sediment oozes from the stressed roof, which looks as if it could collapse at any moment.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Thickening volcanic debris litters the ground here.  Translucent shards of natural glass jut out from the rubble.  The walls and topside are flecked with spiny horn-like projections of hardened basalt.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Dark, fine-grained igneous walls curve around you.  They seem to be the sole support for the massive pillars of sedimentary rock which arch overhead, forming a cone-like domed ceiling.  Incandescent angular rock fragments stick out from the floor.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Deep-seated blobs of magma have broken through the surface here forming a white-hot sinkhole.  The walls of this chamber have been carbonized a deep black and are covered with a gritty coat of ash.  Intense heat radiates from the hot liquid rock bubbling up from the cavity in the floor.  Brilliant arcs of lava plume into the air, crackling loudly, before dropping downward back into the molten hole and spattering the surface around it.  The path skirts around the hole in either direction.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Opaque glassine walls surround you here.  Their steamy, porous surface is marred with tiny bubble holes.  Bilious clouds of escaping steam vent from the holes.  The moist air blowing out feels hot enough to burn unprotected skin to the bone.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Flame-blackened walls arch over you.  Somewhat hardened lava shifts underfoot, its cracked surface looking as if it could give way at any moment, dropping the unwary into the molten rock underneath.  The sulfur-tinged air is so hot it seems as if it could ignite.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Hypnotic orange-red flames blaze across the surface here.  The fires feed off a steady, slow moving stream of molten rock.  They burn continuously, cutting ever deeper into the heated rock floor.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: Scattered debris and mud-mixed ash cover the surface.  Dirty water and steam rise upward from it, staining the walls and ceiling.  The heavy, moisture-laden air provides little relief from the intense heat.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: The river of molten lava flows past the narrow ledge of rock like a living thing roiling with suppressed fury.  A rock cliff edges the perilous overhang, and large boulders stand to either side blocking further progress.  Loud pops and hissing from the magma punctuate the tenuous nature of this perch, as if the molten lava is deriding any attempt to find purchase on such a thin projection of safety over the river of death rampaging beneath.

title: [Glaes Fissure]
description: Violent volcanic upheaval has left a chamber within the black heart of the mountainside.  The shadowy cavern is deep but narrow, and its walls are pocked with crevices and veined with minerals caught in the glaes long ago.  A few beams of light have found their way down into the gloom from a jagged fissure above.  They create a stark spotlight on the rough stone floor.

Violent volcanic upheaval has left a chamber within the black heart of the mountainside.  The shadowy cavern is deep but narrow, and its walls are pocked with crevices and veined with minerals caught in the glaes long ago.  A few beams of moonlight have found their way down into the gloom from a jagged fissure above.  They create a stark spotlight on the rough stone floor.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: The narrow tunnel winds through the solid glaes into gloom, its circuitous route leaving visibility at almost nil.  Heavy with the thick, sulfurous stink of molten lava, the air is stifling and still.  The vision of a river of the stuff pouring through these tunnels like fire down a drake's gullet is too plausible to be easily disregarded.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: The tunnel doglegs around a sharp wedge of glaes protruding from the wall and takes a serious downward cant.  To the northeast, the route plunges down into deeper shadow, and an air current heavy with sulfur wafts up from within the mountain.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: An intersection breaks up the incline with its resulting landing.  Tunnels plunge into the walls in four directions like crooked fingers stabbing through the black glaes.  To the southwest, the trail takes on a steep incline, matched by the northern tunnels plunging down into darkness.  A narrower, though level passageway heads east.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: The passageway comes to an abrupt halt at the foot of a steep falloff.  Below, the floor is barely visible, dimly lit by a flickering red glow.  The tunnel continues on the far side of the hole, however there appears no way to reach its opposite side other than flying across the chasm.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: A small chamber at the end of the tunnel is completely filled with jumbled glaes and pieces of bone.  The ivory color of the bones glows in the low light.  The air is perfectly still here, and in the quiet, a low throb can barely be heard emanating from the scarred glaes walls.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: After winding and turning for a bit, the tunnel suddenly plunges over an embankment of tumbled boulders.  Their edges are jagged and dangerous, and numerous crevices are created beneath and around the stones where anything could be hiding.  Carried on the humid air moving listlessly from beneath the barrier is the acrid smell of sulfur, strong enough to burn the eyes and parch the throat of any who venture here.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: At the foot of a barrier of jagged glaes boulders, the passageway curves quickly out of sight around an immense outcropping of blood-red glaes.  The rare stone glistens in the low light, embraced by black glaes, which surrounds it and accents it with the contrast in color.  Within the stone, a dim reflection of light flickers and pulses, as though the huge formation is a beating heart with convoluted striations for veins.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: As the passageway circumnavigates a huge outcropping of blood-red glaes it rises and falls in a hazardous pitch, like storm-tossed ocean waves.  Reflections from inside the mineral cast a low reddish glow over the tunnel's progress.  The smell of sulfur is mixed with another odor so strong and noxious, it makes the sulfur seem palatable.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: The tunnel twists like a drake's tail, its glaes walls scarred and pocked with fissures.  Little spouts of steam burst from the openings at intervals, then wisp away to nothing leaving a scent of sulfur.  To the northeast, the passageway twists away from the formation of red glaes, the ruby glow from the rock chasing it away through the blackness like a trail of fire.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: The tunnel splits into a trio of passages, their progress hidden by convolutions and gloom.  A stark plunge down marks the southern finger, while a red glow bathes the southwestern one.  To the southeast, the route turns down, but does so in a gentle decline.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: Rent by twists that turn back on themselves relentlessly, the tunnel plunges steadily down into the mountain's bowels.  The air grows more fetid and heavy with smoke as its altitude drops.  Behind a contorted outcrop of glaes, a smaller tunnel takes a severe cant down, making the larger passage's progress seem almost gentle.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: The tunnel doglegs, turning back on itself around a sharp protuberance of crystalline glaes.  The dark crystals jut from their sparkling bed of crusted mineral like a multifaceted forest.  Each one is different, and the largest are particularly beautiful.  They reach out from the wall halfway across the corridor, and if time had given them a chance to grow longer, they would effectively block the passageway.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: Just around a sharp turn in the passageway, the glaes smooths into a polished face that is as clear as it is regular.  It reveals a view into the glaes, like looking through the window of a dwelling.  Inside flows a vein of molten lava, its progress a raging current of fury that sends heat radiating through the very rock itself.  The warmth emanates off the glaes wall in a daunting curtain.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: Tunnels veer off in three directions.  Air currents have quickened, carrying the stink of sulfur and fire.  To the south, the passageway widens, and a cavern is just visible around a bend of the walls.  Opposite that, a tunnel to the north leads into deep shadow, in which no landmarks are visible other than a churned up pile of stone at its mouth to lend hazard to the darkness.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: The bottom of a wide chamber is strewn with both jagged crags of glaes and splinters of bleached bones, which pepper the tumbled floor like broken teeth.  The detritus fairly gleams in the shadows, its light color offset dramatically by the black rock.  Far overhead, the black maw of an opening is visible near the cavern's ceiling, where a higher tunnel leads away through smoke and gloom.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: At the edge of a steep precipice, the passageway halts with no signal of warning.  Within the abyss, nothing can be seen through the darkness.  Rank currents of smoke drift up from below, carrying their cargo of putrescence on warm shoulders of lava-heated air.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: At the end of a severe twist of the corridor, the footing grows dangerously uncertain.  Fraught with ankle-breaking crevices and canted at an almost impassable decline, the way would discourage the most sure-footed of beasts or dwarves.  Within the walls to either side, the whisper of molten lava can be heard, rushing through its hidden course.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: At the foot of the precipice, the floor is a dangerous jumble of sharp glaes rocks.  In the dense shadows, lumps can be seen here and there, the silhouettes giving away the fact that they are of softer origin than the formidable mountain.  More common in the mess are the arched outline of rib-cages and jutting bones where the flesh of the tunnels' victims has yielded to time and heat.

title: [Glaes Vein]
description: The corridor ends.  Abruptly, it simply melts away at the foot of a huge wall of metal so dark, the thing seems to absorb what little light exists in the gloom.  The metal is banded with rows of studs, each one incised with a strange device, and it is embraced on all sides by solid glaes, as though the mountain was forged to support it.

title: [Glaes Tunnel]
description: A massive iron wall to the south dominates this gloomy tunnel.  Underfoot, the floor is a vicious track of glaes spikes and pitfalls.  Here and there, pools of molten glaes lie sheathed in steam, which drifts up from the surface of each in a languid, curling dance.

title: [Glaes Tunnel]
description: As the tunnel bends around an outcropping, the flickering light from a blazing pocket of lava illuminates the opposite wall.  There, scrawled in archaic dwarven script, words have been hewn into the black glaes wall.  Clouds of steam shift and roil, casting menacing-looking shadows on the walls of the passageway.

title: [Glaes Caverns]
description: A vast chamber, full of steam and smoke, is rendered hazardous with pools of molten glaes dotting the floor.  Noxious clouds drift across the hellish vista, floating across the bubbling puddles like ships sailing a blood-red sea.  Other caverns are visible through circular exits, the passages half-blocked with long, black protrusions of crystalline glaes.

title: [Glaes Caverns]
description: The cavern curves around an immense outcrop of rare blood-red glaes, filling the western wall with its veiny magnificence.  The striations are irregular, taking on the appearance of mottled flesh.  Liquid glaes bubbles out from beneath it and zigzags across the floor in a smoking rivulet, crossing the chamber like a writhing serpent of fire.

title: [Glaes Caverns]
description: The thin trail snakes through pools of molten glaes on the floor, clambering over large bumps and through crevices formed by hardened outbursts of the liquid rock.  Larger obstructions hide other parts of the cave.  Strange shadows flicker across them in crimson hues, thrown by bursts of fire erupting from the bubbling puddles of magma.

title: [Glaes Caverns]
description: Across the scarred walls of the kidney-shaped cavern, shadows jerk and dance, leaping up suddenly as a flare of fire arcs through the air, then dying back into the gloom.  To one side, huge fangs of crystalline glaes arch over a large vat of magma.  Smoke drifts around the frightening silhouette, as if it is emerging from the gullet of a beast.

title: [Glaes Caverns]
description: A river of molten glaes rolls bubbling and spitting across most of the chamber's floor.  Black pillars rise up out of the magma, their silhouettes crooked and forbidding.  Rockets of fiery shards are sent ricocheting off the cavern's walls, launched by explosions from the river's depths.  They leave smoking trailers hanging in the air in their wake.

title: [Head of the Beast]
description: The cavern is immense, yet it seems almost dwarfed by the monstrous head of a beast rendered in a strange scaled substance that defies analysis.  Emerging from the surrounding walls, its visage is contorted in an eternal grimace of fury and pain.  Beneath it sits a large glaes anvil.  A steady drip of bubbling black liquid leaks from the glittering eyes and snakes down the sides of the monstrosity's face, falling down upon the anvil's top where it pools just before hissing into a vapor of steam.

title: [Glaes Caverns]
description: The vast chamber is starkly uncluttered, save for a strange formation of glaes that extends from the center of a pool of magma.  With its grotesque appendages, it seems to reach from the heart of the hissing magma like a misshapen claw clenched in agony.  From the 'palm' of the thing, a slow rivulet of viscous black liquid pulses out, dripping down over the gnarled surface of the outcropping and pooling on the roiling face of the bubbling glaes.

title: [Glaes Caverns]
description: Smoke almost obscures visibility within an immense cavern, where knobby formations of glaes hulk like sleeping behemoths in the gloom.  Sparks shoot up periodically from pools of glaes at the feet of the outcroppings, lighting the chamber for a moment with their fiery arcs.  Breathing is made painful by the sulfur and heat hanging in the atmosphere.

title: [On A Ferryboat]
description: Were it not for the thick chain holding this squat ferryboat back, the current would certainly sweep it along the river and eventually out to sea.  The boat heaves and sways dangerously now and again, but seems safe enough for the moment.

wayto.1965: ;e waitfor 'The boat arrives at the dock with a soft thunk.'; move 'out'
wayto.2261: ;e waitfor 'You arrive at the stone dock with a soft thunk.'; move 'out'

title: [Stormbrow, Abandoned Mine Dock]
description: The river rushes by a wide granite ledge jutting out from a small stone dock, here in the damp, dark chill of Stormbrow's depths.  Yellow-green moss, glowing with some unearthly light, covers the walls and edges toward a stout iron gate, just visible among the shadows.

wayto.2260: ;e unless move 'go ferryboat'; echo 'Waiting for ferryboat...'; waitfor 'The squat ferryboat arrives at the dock with a hollow thunk.'; move 'go ferryboat'; end

title: [Abandoned Mine]
