description: Barely visible beneath the grime on the eastern wall is a narrow sliver of color that runs the length of the chamber and down into the darkness.  The gritty floor slopes slightly to the west and curves around a massive boulder near the bottom of the cave.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: Pale yellow eyes peer out from jagged rocks overhead, blinking silently in the darkness.  The tiny rock lizards, obviously comfortable here in the dark, stare impassively at all who pass.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: The colorful vein along the eastern wall widens to the south and narrows almost to a point at the north.  Several moths dart and weave around a single torch that flickers weakly near the southwestern edge of the chamber.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: This chamber is fairly large, with ceilings that soar to nearly sixty feet in some places.  The ground is fairly smooth, though littered with a large assortment of jagged rocks and rusted mining tools.  To the southeast, the unmistakable signs of a wide rainbow glaes vein are evident.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: Much of the rock has been chipped away here, creating a cavern that is as large as any you can recall seeing.  The floor is covered with a thick layer of dust, though it sparkles oddly in the light cast by a torch set set into one wall.  Every so often, a few crumbled bits of rock cascade down the western wall, rolling down the steep incline that angles so sharply to the southeast.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Switchback]
description: Deep gouges in the eastern wall indicate that this section of the shaft was mined quite successfully for a time.  Loose rocks and pebbles occasionally tumble down the steep slope to the northwest and disappear into the darkness at the back of the mine.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: The spluttering glow of torchlight illuminates a marbled black stone and rainbow glaes wall blocking further travel to the south.  A few deep niches carved into the rockface look as if the miners who worked this strike might have been planning further excavation to the south, though it was obviously abandoned for some reason.

The spluttering glow of torchlight illuminates a marbled black stone and rainbow glaes a cracked stone and glaes wall blocking further travel to the south.  A few deep niches carved into the rockface look as if the miners who worked this strike might have been planning further excavation to the south, though it was obviously abandoned for some reason.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: In an apparent attempt to keep the weight of the noble Stormbrow from collapsing the shaft, several logs have been driven into the walls, with a few placed upright to support the ceiling.  Considering the piles of rocks and debris scattered about, this was probably the only thing that kept the tunnel from closing off completely years ago.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: Though the ceiling is somewhat low, enough rock has been chipped away on either side of this connecting tunnel to provide reasonably easy passage.  Though it is too dark to see much, the clicking and skittering noises coming from other areas of the mine assure you that you are not alone, although that may not be a comforting thought.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: An old mining cart leans precariously against the western wall, three of its wooden wheels long-since rotted away.  Though the floors show signs of wear and a few deep ruts, only spiders occupy themselves here now.  The vein of precious glaes is not quite so obvious here, though closer inspection of the area around the eastern path provides a glimpse of the riches that might be found in this area.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: Thick clouds of dust swirl up from the ground as a draft blasts through from the north, carrying with it a faint, musky odor.  Odd clicking and skittering sounds echo off the rocky ceiling, vibrating the jagged walls enough to loosen a small avalanche of dusty pebbles.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Deep Shaft]
description: The air here is cold, and breathing difficult.  Very little light filters in from a crevice in the western wall, its weak luminescence quickly being devoured by the ever-present dark in this narrow tunnel.  To the east, a heavy iron railing leads deeper into the mine.

The air here is cold, and breathing difficult.  Very little moonlight filters in from a crevice in the western wall, its weak luminescence quickly being devoured by the ever-present dark in this narrow tunnel.  To the east, a heavy iron railing leads deeper into the mine.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: Vaguely defined veins of rainbow glaes peek through the rocky tunnel walls to reflect the fading light from the west.  Given that so much of the precious metal remains, this area must have been newly discovered when the mine abandoned.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: A lone mining lamp illuminates this musty cavern, though not enough to see well.  What little can be made out in the murky shadows would indicate this to be a storage area.  Iron railings enter from the northeast, southeast and west to intersect in the middle of the room.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: The tunnel curves here, the railing at its center quickly disappearing around bends to the northwest and northeast.  Now and then, a heavy clacking can be heard from somewhere nearby, though the confusing echoes peculiar to the mine prevent any judgment of its direction.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: Rocks and splintered wood lie scattered across the gritty floor, apparently the remains of a failed blockade to the east.  A gentle draft blows through the gloomy shaft from that direction, a faint odor carried upon its cool touch.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Ruined Cavern]
description: It would appear that a catastrophe once occurred in this foul smelling chamber.  The eastern wall has been caved in, burrowed through by something large enough to leave the floor strewn with glaesan boulders in its wake.  Despite the destruction, several wooden beams still rise up to support the ceiling above, and the iron scaffolding erected along the other walls looks unscathed.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: A rock lizard sits atop a shelf in the northern wall in the northern wall, its softly kindled eyes blinking in the gloomy dark.  Iron railings descend from a slope to the west, only to be buried under a blockade of rubble that nearly seals the eastern passage completely.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: A torch has been set into the southern wall, its sputtering flames intensifying the shadows.  Scattered footprints can be made out in the gloomy sphere of light spilling upon the floor, as if someone or something had moved hastily through the area.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: Condensation coats the walls of this short tunnel.  The larger drops glitter in the darkness, acting as tiny prisms as they reflect the glow of torchlight from the south.  Roughly hewn stones litter the floor, and the ceiling hangs dangerously low.  A natural wall to the north blocks further travel in that direction.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: The passage here is narrow, and care must be taken to avoid the sharp outcroppings jutting from the abrasive walls.  Despite the cramped space, the cargo railway continues on in both directions unimpeded.  To the east, a faintly flickering light can be seen further along the tunnel.

title: [Mausoleum, Outer Chamber]
description: This is one of the few buildings in the area that remains relatively unscathed by fire.  The cold grey stone is accented in spots by scorch marks, where flames leapt through an open doorway but quickly extinguished themselves due to a lack of fuel.  Small cracks in the foundation, left unattended for so many years, have widened considerably, pushed apart by the dark green vines which invade even this dark stronghold.

This is one of the few buildings in the area that remains relatively unscathed by fire.  The cold grey stone is accented in spots by scorch marks, where flames leapt through an open doorway but quickly extinguished themselves due to a lack of fuel.  Small cracks in the foundation, left unattended for so many years, have widened considerably, pushed apart by the vines which invade even this dark stronghold.

title: [Mausoleum, Tomb]
description: This room was spared the destruction so evident in the other chambers, possibly because it was in the process of renovation.  Row after row of gleaming black marble pedestals await stone coffins that will never be placed.  Snaking up from small fissures in the stone floor, thorned vines spiral up tall pewter candlesticks and threaten to crush the heavy ceramic urns that line the walls.

title: [Mausoleum, Tomb]
description: Greenish tinted bones are strewn all over this large room, a stark contrast to the huge blocks of black marble lying in ruins at your feet.  The scent of death is strong here, as scant bits of flesh that still cling to these skeletons moulder with age.  At first you wonder about the strange color of the remains you see, but the sight of the thorny vines wrapped around the bodies holds a clue you'd rather not consider.

title: [Mausoleum, Tomb]
description: A chill races up your spine as you see that even the dead were not spared the foul ransacking that most of the village was subjected to.  Stone coffins were ripped open, probably in search of treasure.  No mercy was shown, nor respect of any kind, as even the mummified remains of these bodies were ripped asunder and hacked to bits in order to obtain the jewelry they must have been wearing.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: Your feet stir clouds of dust, which hang like pale ghosts in the still, musty air.  Ruined coffins line the walls of dark stone, each closed up tight for the ages.  High on one wall, a gaping hole leads back out.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: A chill gust of wind blows through here, stirring the ragged tapestries hung on the wall.  Low moaning noises echo through the chamber, full of sorrow and pain.  The shadows ahead seem to writhe.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: The cloying, sweet smell of ancient decay curls your nostrils.  Piles of refuse litter the floor.  A squirming, pale mass of maggots covers one wall, and faint gibberings echo through the gloom.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: Splintered bones, ash and wood cover the floor throughout this wrecked chamber, crunching under your feet as you pass.  Two great wooden oars are mounted on one wall.  A dark purple fungus spreads over the stones behind them, stinking of sulphur.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: This large chamber is bare, but for a massive stone slab in the center.  A ramp slopes down to the southwest.  Deep grooves have been etched into the stone, and dark stains mar the dusty floor beneath the slab.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: Dust-covered stone urns are stacked against the walls.  The splintered remains of a wood cabinet rot in a corner, just under a tattered old tapestry.  This room seems unusually dry, compared to the moisture and seepage in other, nearby chambers.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: Dry dust clogs your throat as you stumble farther along the ramp.  Your breathing becomes labored as clouds of dust rise with every step.  Even when you stand perfectly still to let the dust settle, something else seems to be continuously stirring up the powdery substance on the floor.  At the bottom, the ramp ends in a solid stone wall.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: Pools of grey slime cover the stone floor.  A rancid, oily wind whistles from some small holes in the wall.  The air is damp, with the distinct, coppery smell of blood.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: The stench is overwhelming, a cloud of putrid corruption.  The walls glisten with a luminescent, jelly-like substance.  Beneath it, you can just make out the faint lines of claw marks, scratched right into the stone.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: The flagstones have been shattered here, pushed up in a mound by some force which burst from below.  The walls are scorched black, the very rock fused together.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: The walls of this corridor have been lined with stone drawers, each bearing a tarnished plaque.  Many of the drawers have been shattered, the shards of their remains spread out on the floor.  The rank, corrupt stink floating up from these makes your eyes water.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: A stone fountain sits in the center of this circular chamber.  In the basin is a statue, arms raised high.  The basin itself is filled with a foamy brown sludge.  The stone walls are covered with a fetid purple fungus, and you gag at the sulphurous smell.  A narrow corridor leads off to the north.

title: [Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: The air in this long, low corridor is dead still and uncomfortably moist.  Pale fungi cover the stone walls, obscuring whatever lies beneath.  The dead husks of thousands of tiny beetles litter the floor.  They crunch under your feet as you pass.

title: [Icemule Trace, Town Center]
description: A bustling square dusted with snow sprawls beneath a sturdy mule statue standing placidly atop a tall plinth of silver-veined black stone.  The sun filters through the ice of the statue, showering the throng with a kaleidoscope of rainbowed shards.  Some denizens, mostly halflings but with a scattering of other folk mixed in, chatter by a roaring bonfire, lazing on a smooth dark stone bench or reclining on colorful cloaks spread out on the ground.  Others mill around a burled pine message board standing close to a colorful silver-bound barrel.

The bustling town comes together in this square.  Halflings dressed in varying fashions stand about, some chattering happily, others reclining on cloaks laid on the ground.  One ancient halfling leans against the base of the large ice statue of a mule, snoring blissfully.  A feeling of community pervades the area, putting you immediately at ease.

The center of the bustling frontier town is overseen by the large ice statue of a mule, which rises from the surrounding snow on a plinth of cold dark stone.  The sun's radiance filters through the ice, casting prismatic rays of light over a swirling throng of halflings.  Some chatter loudly by a colorful silver-bound barrel emblazoned with a row of tiny grey penguins, while others recline on colorful cloaks spread out across the hard ground.  Over by a smooth dark stone bench, a roaring bonfire crackles merrily, lending its warmth to the surroundings.

The center of the slumbering frontier town is overseen by the large ice statue of a mule, which rises from the surrounding snow on a plinth of cold dark stone.  The stars' brilliance winks through the ice, casting prismatic glints of light over a scattering of halflings.  Some chatter quietly by a colorful silver-bound barrel emblazoned with a row of tiny grey penguins, while others stargaze on colorful cloaks spread out across the hard ground.  Near the comfort of a smooth dark stone bench, a roaring bonfire crackles merrily, lending its warmth and illumination to the surroundings.

A tranquil square dusted with snow sprawls beneath a sturdy mule statue standing placidly atop a tall plinth of silver-veined black stone.  The brilliance of the stars refracts through the statue, casting prismatic glints over the townsfolk nearby.  Some denizens, mostly halflings but with a scattering of other folk mixed in, chatter by a roaring bonfire, lazing on a smooth dark stone bench or stargazing on colorful cloaks spread out on the ground.  Others mill around a burled pine message board standing close to a colorful silver-bound barrel.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west
Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Icemule Trace, North Road]
description: Crowds bustle along the cobblestone road, swirling past the entrance of an ornate stone edifice with stained glass windows, where several half-krolvin and giantkin loiter to await a merchant's arrival.  Several mages in colorful robes, all of them wearing scarves and mufflers, make their way westward, while a few priests in more muted cassocks congregate on their way to the temple, making signs of blessing at expectant women and small children.  Tall lamp posts, unlit during the day, proceed down the roadside in an alternating pattern.

Crowds of people bustle up this road, on their way to one place or another.  Several groups of warriors stride to the north, clad in warm furs and mufflers, while others in cassocks and robes walk more slowly, making signs of blessing at expectant women and small children.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Icemule Trace, South Road]
description: The silvery sheen of a statue to the north glints merrily over the heads of most passersby.  Halflings and sylvankind in the deep blue elk hide livery of the Silvermule Gaming Hall rush past, messenger bags thumping against their sides as they race off to deliver letters and missives.  Most of the houses and businesses to either side of the street are built from grey stone, but their doors are brightly painted with a hodgepodge of colors.  An incongruous stone doorframe stands off to the side of the street.

A silvery sheen from something up north catches your eye over the heads of the crowds.  No matter the time of day or night, this stretch of road always seems busy.  A young halfling girl, dressed in the livery of the Silvermule Gaming Hall, rushes past you to deliver a message.

title: [Temple Burrow, Oleani Way]
description: Homes line the road, their doors painted in a riot of colors.  The dwellings follow no set plan, ranging from stately pine lodges to round-doored burrows tucked into the sides of nearby hillocks.  One grey stone manse is secured by a black wrought iron gate.  Residents wander the road, waving to one another and stopping to converse.  A half-krolvin denizen stands on a ladder, carefully touching up the paint on a neighbor's roof while a gaggle of halflings shouts suggestions from below.

Small houses line the road, painted in a riot of bright colors.  The dwellings follow no set plan, some with one story, others with two.  Halflings wander down the road, waving to each other and stopping to converse.  One halfling stands on a ladder, carefully touching up the paint on his roof while his wife looks on, giving orders.

Small houses line the road.  The dwellings follow no set plan, some with one story and others with two.  The street is almost deserted at this time of day, with only an occasional halfling passing by with home and hot food clearly on their mind.

title: [Temple Burrow, Oleani Way]
description: Chunks of broken ice litter the cobblestone street near its intersection with a snow-covered stone path.  They glint like daggers in the chill sunlight.  Northward looms the glacier, its pale bulk rising above the rooftops of dwellings, the sun awakening ripples of vivid teal and murky green in its depths.  The same hues are repeated in the lacquer twining over the surface of a wrought iron gate, beyond which sprawls a splendid ice garden.

Pieces of ice dot the street and one yard sports a small, carrot-nosed snowman.  To the north looms the glacier, above the dwellings on the streets, with the Temple sitting atop it.  Carved from the ice, the Temple gleams in the sun, giving those who live here an impressive view.

Pieces of ice dot the street and one yard sports a small, carrot-nosed snowman.  To the north looms the glacier, above the dwellings on the streets, with the Temple sitting atop it.  Carved from the ice, the Temple gleams in the moonlight, giving those who live here an impressive view.

title: [Temple Burrow, Oleani Way]
description: Children dash down the street, filling the chilly air with high-pitched laughter.  Although many are halflings, there are just as many giantkin and half-krolvin among them.  They weave in spritely chases through the traffic before a snow-covered wooden lodge while a small coterie of sylvankind youths follows at a more sedate pace.  Several would-be merchants near to the lodge hawk rings and other tokens of affection.

You are nearly bowled over by a large group of children dashing by on the cottage-lined street.  They seem to be chasing an impish lad who is carrying a small shoe and, as one of the pursuers has a single bare foot, you can see how the chase started.  Given the situation, you aren't certain who to root for.
A cold wind bears the promise of a coming storm down the street.  Most of the cottages are quiet and dark, but here and there a candle burns in a window to light the way home.

title: [Temple Burrow, Oleani Way]
description: Trees dot the edge of the lane near the Empath Guild, pine and spruce clad in needles that are vividly verdant despite the cold.  The happy trilling of snow birds beckons from their snow-bent boughs.  One bird with bright golden and turquoise plumage sings loudly from atop a juniper laden with dark blue beries, noisily proclaiming his territory to all other avians in the vicinity.

Trees dot the edge of the lane and the happy trill of songbirds fills the air.  Looking for the source of the song, you spot a brightly plumaged bird perched on a branch, singing loudly, proclaiming his territory to all other avians in the vicinity.

Trees dot the edge of the lane and a soft series of hoots fills the air.  Looking for the source of the song, you spot a large, white, snowy owl perched on a branch, proclaiming his territory to all other avians in the vicinity.

title: [Temple Burrow, Oleani Way]
description: Near to the entrance to Hope Alley, three small cottages sit at a bend in the way.  Two occupy the south side of the lane, residing behind a wall carved with roses and stylized hearts.  The third, it appears, is being slowly overrun by the glacier.  An outcropping of solid ice jabs out over the rooftop, jutting from the glacier proper.  The owners seem little deterred by the intrusion, having dug a small upper story into the ice.

Three small cottages sit here, two on the south side of the lane.  The third, it appears, is being slowly overrun by the glacier.  A thick slab of ice rests atop it, extending from the glacier proper.  The owners do not seem put off by this, as they have built a small upper story in the ice.

title: [Temple Burrow, Oleani Way]
description: The street ends in an ivy-covered building.  Restorative herbs grow in the window boxes, perfuming the icy air with their pungent aromas.  A polished modwir sign hangs from the roof of the building, suspended by bright gold chains twined with creeping vines.  Geckos no longer than a halfling's finger cling to the vines, catching insects happily.  At the side of the shop, some empty wooden buckets are filled with dirt.  Several varieties of coldleaf tobacco flourish in the makeshift planters.

The street ends in an ivy-covered building.  Small herb gardens grow in the window boxes, tickling your nose with pungent aromas.  A small wooden sign hangs from the roof of the building, suspended by bright gold chains twined with creeping vines.  Geckos no bigger than your little toe crawl through the vines, catching insects happily.  At the side of the shop, some empty paint buckets have been filled with dirt, and several varieties of hardy young plant grow within.

title: [Icemule, Hope Alley]
description: Hope Alley is an out-of-the-way district of small shops running between the eastern city wall and the streets of Temple Burrow.  Bright white and black granite pavers set into the icy landscape create a tony atmosphere in the narrow thoroughfare, and the citizens who visit its shops maintain a respectful silence in the presence of temple functionaries and members of the clergy.

title: [Icemule, Hope Alley]
description: A strange heat comes from the back of the building to the west, melting the snow around the black and white granite pavers into a fluid slush.  An enormous granite statue has been arranged so that the figure seems to be crossing the sunlit cul-de-sac from the frozen wall to the warmth of the city.

An unnatural heat emerges from the back of the building to the west, melting the snow around the black and white granite pavers into a fluid slush.  An enormous granite statue has been arranged so that the figure seems to be crossing the darkened cul-de-sac from the frozen wall to the warmth of the candlelit city.

title: [Icemule, Hope Alley]
description: An enormous stretch of city wall has been lightly scored and filled with a variety of local stones to form a mosaic of eye-catching color and wondrous detail.  Citizens and visitors alike stop to admire the piece, which elevates its surroundings from a forgettable backstreet to a key site of pilgrimage and meditation.
Very few visitors disturb the shrine-like stillness of this stretch of Hope Alley.  Even by the light of moon and stars, the mosaic set into the granite defensive wall is worthy of notice.

title: [Icemule, Hope Alley]
description: The wind whistles through the granite pavers that line this narrow path between the city wall and the far end of Lumnis Street.  The faint whistle masks the low muttering of people who pass swiftly down the alley, voices which utter quiet prayers or subtly compare the best prices of the shops in the area...who can tell?

title: [Icemule, Hope and Fear]
description: The intersection of Hope Alley and Fear Alley creates a small esplanade in front of a square defensive tower in the northeast corner of Icemule Trace.  A few buildings dot the tiny square, and its black and white granite pavers ring out with the military cadence of halfling militia guards who periodically march from the corner towers to the gate barbicans along these narrow back roads.

title: [Icemule, Fear Alley]
description: A few low buildings mix with the odd tall kiosk in this quiet yet bustling back alley.  Along the wall, some local wag has scratched the image of a giant rat chasing a young halfling adventurer out of the well into the ice covering the wall.

A few low buildings mix with the odd tall kiosk in this funereal back alley.  Along the wall, some local wag has scratched the image of a giant rat chasing a young halfling adventurer out of the well into the ice covering the wall.

title: [Icemule, Fear Alley]
description: A few persons, cloaks turned up against the wind, pass anonymously down the winding path of Fear Alley, their footfalls rising from granite pavement to ice-covered wall and ricocheting among the smaller buildings in between.  From a rise to the south, the great temple dominates the district to which it lends its name.

title: [Icemule, Fear Alley]
description: The icy north wall towers over the stands and kiosks of Fear Alley as a reminder of Nature's cruel indifference.  Carved into the grey stone in bas-relief is a vast mural depicting the long migration of the Paradis tribe of halflings.

title: [Icemule, Fear Alley]
description: The black and white paving stones veer into the shadow of the frozen north wall, and a preternaturally cold shadow covers this remote cul-de-sac.  A few demonic figures scratched into the stone wall by amateur hands seem hidden on their own plane of existence beneath the ice.

The black and white paving stones veer into the shadow of the frozen north wall, and a preternaturally cold darkness permeates this remote cul-de-sac.  A few demonic figures scratched into the stone wall by amateur hands seem hidden on their own plane of existence beneath the ice.

title: [Temple Burrow, Cholen Lane]
description: A glassy sheet of ice slicks half of the cobblestone street.  On the north side of the encroaching glacier, a wide porch joins several homes carved into the ice, lights from within making the surrounding slope glow with golden hues.  Carvings decorate the lintels of the doors, and several houses display small ice statues on their roofs.  One yard sports a small snowman with a crooked carrot for a nose.

A glassy sheet of ice slicks half of the cobblestone street.  Several homes on the north side are dug into the ice of the encroaching glacier, lights from within making the surrounding slope glow with golden hues.  Carvings decorate the lintels of the doors, and several houses display small ice statues on their roofs.  One yard sports a small snowman with a crooked carrot for a nose.

Ice covers half of this street.  Several houses on the north side are carved from the glacier, lights from within making the whole building glow with golden ambiance.  Carvings decorate the lintels of the doors, and several houses display small ice statues on their roofs.

title: [Temple Burrow, Koar and Cholen]
description: Koar Street ends in an ice-slicked hill that rises to merge with the town's outer wall.  The glacier stretches out over the road, blocking view of the sky, though street lamps with bases fashioned in the shapes of dancing figures illuminate the shrouded span.  Priests wearing the symbols of several orders come and go through an iron-gated tunnel in the ice, though some fill the cavernous space with their murmurs as they stand talking quietly with one another.  At the road's end, a frosted silver gate leads into a walled courtyard.

Koar Street ends in a huge hill of ice that serves as part of the town wall.  Priests representing several orders come and go through a tunnel in the ice, or stand talking quietly, carefully polishing symbols of their deities.

Koar Street ends in a huge hill of ice that serves as part of the town wall.  The only light in the area flows through an unobtrusive tunnel in the ice.  The sound of chanting can be heard from somewhere deep within the hill.

title: [Temple Burrow, Koar Street]
description: The well-traveled road is flanked by an orderly procession of street lamps, their bases carved with thunderbolts and bearded figures with severe countenances.  Priests in blue robes wander up and down a staircase carved from the side of the glacier.  It and the ice of the road are rough enough to easily traverse without falling.  A few small burrows are carved into the ice, round doors facing the street and painted with all of the hues of the dawn.

This area seems well-travelled.  Priests in blue robes wander up and down a staircase carved from the glacier, and the ice you walk on is rough enough to stand on without falling.  A few small cottages have been built from the ice, and one seems to have been encased in it, with holes drilled out for the door and windows.

title: [Temple Burrow, Cholen Lane]
description: Temple guards with cowled heads dot the scattered crowd of blue-robed monks meandering up and down a broad path over one of the glacier's lesser slopes.  Houses with walls of heavy stone face the glacier's rise.   Some trail sweet-smelling woodsmoke from their chimneys, while others favor earthy peat for their cookfires.  The two fuel sources linger on the whipping winds in a potent melange.
A small group of blue-robed monks walks through this area, heading north up a path in the glacier.  Thick-walled houses face the glacier, sweet smelling wood smoke pluming from their chimneys.
A temple guard walks, bending his cowled head into the wind, north up a path in the glacier.  Thick-walled houses face the glacier, earthy smoke from peat fires pluming from their chimneys.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [Temple Burrow, Lumnis Street]
description: Several initiates from the abbey pass by a large hill of snow and ice on their way deeper into town.  A small path climbs toward a natural hollow at the top of the hill.  Lamp posts flank the cobblestone road, proceeding eastward, where excited shrieks and giggles ring out over the driven snows.

Several people pass you by on their way about their business.  A large hill of snow and ice stands to the north, a small path running up it.  The most used way seems to be to the east, where you can hear excited shrieking and giggling.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, up

title: [Temple Burrow, Lumnis Street]
description: War engulfs the end of the street as halflings and giantkin of all ages fling packed snowballs at one another.  Battle lines have been drawn in abutting yards, where several forts of snow have been erected to provide respite for some of the sodden combatants.  One entrepreneurial halfling lingers at the sidelines, selling towels to both sides, but his wares seem to be only marginally dry.

You duck just in time to avoid a flying ball of snow.  A large battle is in progress here, with halflings of all ages flinging wet snowballs in all directions, occasionally managing to hit each other.  Several forts have been erected in nearby yards, where the combatants can briefly escape the war.  One entrepreneurial halfling seems to be selling towels for each side to dry off with, although his wares seem to be only marginally dry.

title: [Temple Burrow, Ice Cave]
description: The air within the cave is very still, as if the glacier is holding its frosty breath.  Icicles dip from the ceiling, refracting the radiance of the sun from outside into kaleidoscopic patterns that suffuse the walls with rainbowed light.  The cave seems far from the bustle of town, offering a pristine spot to sit a moment and ponder.

The air within the cave is very still, almost as if the glacier is holding its breath.  Icicles drip from the walls, refracting the sunlight from outside into tiny rainbows.  Your thoughts grow deeper, making you wish to sit a moment and simply ponder.

title: [Temple Burrow, Lumnis Street]
description: Serene silence blankets the roadway, broken only by the gentle babbling of ice water dripping from a runnel in the glacier to splash the base of one of the accompanying street lamps.  Most of the hustle and bustle is confined to the nearby temple, leaving the roadway lightly peopled.  A subtle pattern of interlocking rings, lightly rimed with icy filigree, is picked out in the cobblestones.

This area is very quiet except for the serene sounds of a tiny runnel of icy water tripping down the edge of the street.  Most of the hustle and bustle seems to be in front of the Temple, leaving this place devoid of activity.  A subtle pattern of interlocking rings is picked out in the cobblestones, lightly rimed with ice.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: A thin spire of pure ice ascends toward the heavens, its narrow spiked peak glittering with reflected sunlight.  Two tall modwir trees flank the enormous structure, their needle-covered branches dusted with a heavy coating of snow.  Small grey rocks peek out from the layer of white upon the ground, marking two paths that lead to the large tower and off to a smaller building situated near the southeastern wall.

A thin spire of pure ice ascends toward the heavens, its narrow spiked peak glittering with pale moonlight.  Two tall modwir trees flank the enormous structure, their needle-covered branches dusted with a heavy coating of snow.  Small grey rocks peek out from the layer of white upon the ground, marking two paths that lead to the large tower and off to a smaller building situated near the southeastern wall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: Several large bushes grow against the walls of a small low-roofed shrine, their snow-covered forms displaying delicate icy blue rose blossoms.  The structure appears to be nearly frozen, its soft dappled pink and white walls visible underneath a glistening coat of thin ice.  Rounded doors of the same speckled hue lead into the small building, their surfaces engraved with whimsical designs.

Several large bushes grow against the walls of a small low-roofed shrine, their snow-covered forms displaying delicate icy blue rose blossoms.  The structure appears to be nearly frozen, its soft dappled pink and white walls visible underneath a coat of thin ice that shines softly in the moonlight.  Rounded doors of the same speckled hue lead into the small building, their surfaces engraved with whimsical designs.

title: [Brother Stumbleskink's Emporium]
[Stumbleskink's, Emporium]
description: The walls glow with a luminous blue light, reflecting off the various religious symbols hanging from the walls. Brother Stumbleskink bustles about, polishing, dusting and generally fussing over his wares.  Despite his busybody attitude, the shop is very peaceful, and you are loathe to speak above a whisper for fear of disturbing the calm.

Frosted glass lanterns along the ceiling glow with a pale blue light, reflecting off of various religious symbols hanging from the walls.  Brother Stumbleskink bustles about, polishing, dusting and generally fussing over his wares.  Despite his busybody attitude, the shop is very peaceful, and you are loathe to speak above a whisper for fear of disturbing the calm.

title: [Temple Burrow, Cholen Lane]
description: An unlit street light casts its shadow down the drive of a freshly built house, the construction new enough that boards and buckets of nails clutter the street before it.  Several weary-looking krolvin and halflings sit together near the entrance, their hair dusted with wood shavings and their clothing spotted with paint.  Lamp posts follow the winding lane, their wrought iron bases detailed with fanciful sculptings of musicians and dancers.

A crew of halflings is building a house off to the side of the road, filling the air with banging and cheerful banter.  You are forced to step over the boards and buckets of nails that line the street and you must constantly shake wood shavings from your hair.  Examining the chaos the building has created, you briefly wonder how anything gets done here.

Evidence that a crew is building a house off to the side of the road lies strewn about.  You are forced to step over the boards and buckets of nails that line the street and the smell of wood shavings fills the air.  Examining the chaos the building has created, you briefly wonder how anything gets done here.

title: [Temple Burrow, Cholen Lane]
description: A small, red brick schoolhouse brightens the area, its roof topped with a whimsical, slightly off-kilter steeple housing a brass bell.  Despite the chill in the air, the flowers in the schoolyard are small and hardy.  Numerous mounds of snow have been pushed and rolled into an assortment of gelid creations, ranging from penguins to burly giants with goal for eyes; a wide light grey signboard sits in front of the display.  A snow-lined pathway leads to a ring-shaped building off one side of the lane.

A small red brick schoolhouse brightens the area, the pealing of the bell filling the wintry air.  Near the door, an old halfling schoolmistress corrals children, her face weary but her eyes bright.  The air is brisk, made chilly by the glacier to the north, and the flowers in the schoolyard are small and hardy.  Youngsters, or perhaps those merely young at heart, have pushed and rolled mounds of snow into an assortment of gelid creations ranging from penguins to burly giants with coal for eyes.

A small red schoolhouse brightens the area, the pealing of the bell filling your ears.  An old halfling schoolmistress stands at the door, calling the children in from play.  The air is brisk, made chilly by the glacier to the north, and the flowers in the schoolyard are small and hearty.

A small red schoolhouse is illuminated by moonlight, its bell silently waiting to call the children in from play.  The air is brisk, made chilly by the glacier to the north, and the flowers in the schoolyard are small and hearty.

title: [Temple Burrow, Koar Street]
description: Cobbled road gives way to solid ice as the pathway scales the edge of one of the glacier's lesser slopes.  The ground is slippery, but halflings and the occasional sylvankind pedestrian seem unhindered as they make their way.  Dwellings and shops dug out of the ice are fronted by round doors with fresh coats of brightly colored paint, though there seems to be no clear consensus on which colors go together well and which clash.  An ice ramp of packed, grated ice leads up and to the east toward the temple.

You are on the edge of the glacier.  The ground here is hard-packed ice, slippery beneath your feet, but the halflings seem not to notice as they make their way about their business.  Houses have been carved from the ice, as have a few small shops.  A ramp of packed, grated ice leads up and to the east, likely to the Temple.

title: [Temple Burrow, Koar and Lumnis]
description: The edge of the glacier offers a marvelous view of the walled town below, a mix of burrows in the ice and cold earth and shingled rooftops of aboveground dwellings.  The roads are slightly haphazard in layout, but they join eventually with four main streets sprouting from the town center.  Above towers the temple, carved from pure ice and radiant in the sunlight.  An ice ramp descends westward, while an ice staircase leads down to the east and some carved steps plunge to the northwest around an oddly shaped ice flow.

On the edge of the glacier, you have a marvelous view of the city to the south.  Your eyes follow the slightly haphazard streets around Icemule Trace until they meet the four roads and eventually the gates in the walls.  Above you towers the great temple, carved from the purest ice and shining with a nearly divine light in the sun.  A ramp of ice leads down to the west, while an ice staircase leads down to the east and a set of carved ice steps lead down to the northwest around an oddly shaped ice flow.

On the edge of the glacier, you have a marvelous view of the city to the south.  Above you towers the temple, carved from the purest ice and shining with a nearly divine aura in the moonlight.  A ramp of ice leads down to the west, while an ice staircase leads down to the east and a set of carved ice steps lead down to the northwest around an oddly shaped ice flow.

title: [House of Serenity]
description: Widening from the walkway into a large rectangular area, the paved courtyard is flanked on the east and west by low palisades of traceried stonework at a comfortable height for sitting.  To the north stands a sturdy, grey granite building with a banner of lavender silk draped above its double doors.  In the center of the court, a glass bubble protects a patch of bright red-purple flowers surrounding a scroll-shaped reflecting pool.  Wintry sunlight refracts in prisms off of the glass and water.

title: [Icemule Temple, Foyer]
description: Carved into the blue-white ice of the glacier, the temple reflects the best of halfling craftsmanship and design.  Nineteen columns line each side of the foyer, creating a sense of vast distance between the entrance and the nave to the east.  A central ambulatory paved with grey slate leads between the columns past the thirty-six bays, each of which is marked with the symbol of a god or goddess.  Some of the bays contain small kiosks where merchants hawk religious wares.

title: [Icemule Temple, Nave]
description: High overhead, an enormous dome has been carved into the encasing glacier.  Sunlight filters through the thin layer of ice, bathing the circular nave in soft white light.  Several dozen pews crafted of dark-stained oak stand in two rows atop a plush red carpet.  One row faces north toward a black marble arch, while the other faces south toward a pair of wide mithril doors.

High overhead, an enormous dome has been carved into the encasing glacier.  Starlight filters through the thin layer of ice, bathing the circular nave in pale, silvery light.  Several dozen pews crafted of dark-stained oak stand in two rows atop a plush red carpet.  One row faces north toward a black marble arch, while the other faces south toward a pair of wide mithril doors.

title: [Icemule Temple, Chancel Nexus]
description: No light of sun or star reaches this chamber deep within the heart of the glacier.  Three oil lamps hang from the ceiling, lighting a room clad in various colors of granite.  Radiating out from the center of the floor in a pattern reminiscent of the nautilus shell are widening bands of white, black, and silvery-grey stone.  The white granite leads up a well-lit stairway to the north, while the black stone descends a dark stairway to the south.  The grey leads through the east wall into the shadows beyond.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down

title: [Hall of Madness]
description: The chamber is so shadowy, its spatial limits are uncertain.  Its walls are covered in carved symbols.  Strobes of light play across the walls, creating a disturbing, disorienting fog in the mind of anyone occupying the chamber for any length of time.  The flaring lights emanating from shadowy, concealed corners of the chamber briefly illuminate an altar standing in the room's center.

title: [Hall of the Lovers]
description: Twin wooden altars stand at the base of this triangular room, and large panels of colorful stained glass run along each side.  Sunlight streaming into the room through shafts cut deep into the ice strike the panes and bathe the room in a warm glow, casting furtive shadows all around.

Twin wooden altars stand at the base of this triangular room, and large panels of dark stained glass run along each side.  Moonlight streaming into the room through shafts cut deep into the ice strike the panes and bathe the room in a cool, silvery glow, casting faint shadows all around.

title: [Hall of Nature's Balance]
description: The glacial ice has been carved to form two intersecting circles which overlap at the hallway running southeast and southwest.  The area to the north is lined with silken banners that shimmer as they dance in the slight breezes that constantly circle the room.  To the south, the walls are circled with wooden planters that hold a variety of local plants.

title: [Hall of the End]
description: Fine fingers of ice creep across the arched dome of the chamber like threads of dark algae overcoming the impervious nature of the stone.  The chamber is dark, and somehow it seems obvious that it remains so at any time of day or season.  On the far wall, shadows almost hide an expanse of bas-relief statuary.  A disturbing sensation that the room is occupied brings the carving to notice, and imbues it with an undeniable presence.

title: [Hall of the Holy Struggle]
description: Blackness stains the ice of the eastern wall, causing any light filtering in to play upon the floor in fragmented, dark shades.  The western wall sparkles brightly in contrast, its color an almost pure white to cloak its side of the floor in a dazzling glow.  The borders upon which the opposing illumination meet constantly waver back and forth violently, as if in battle.  Faint serpentine designs flow across a black apse upon the eastern wall, while rows of white shields adorn the apse facing it.

Blackness stains the ice of the eastern wall, causing any light filtering in to play upon the floor in fragmented, dark shades.  The western wall sparkles brightly in contrast, its color a pure white to cloak its side of the floor with the pallid glow of the moons.  The borders upon which the opposing illumination meet waver back and forth violently, as if in battle.  Faint serpentine designs flow across a black apse upon the eastern wall, while rows of white shields adorn the apse facing it.

title: [Hall of the Rivals]
description: The octagonal chamber is completely dominated by two colossal statues of women standing at opposite sides of the room.  Only their indomitable beauty rivals their size.  Frescoed scenes, each one bordered in a color, stretch around the walls.  The tableaux tell a story that begins with the scene framed with purple.  On each side of the hall, an apse leads into shadow, one framed with red marble and the other, with black.

title: [Hall of the Seasons]
description: In a loose square at the center of the hall stand four altars clad with jade in the seasonal colors of green, yellow, brown and white.  The wall opposite each altar has been lined in a matching wood: supple young hazel at the east, yellow pine to the south, auburn maoral at the west, and white monir to the north.  Paintings depicting winter, spring, summer, and autumn hang on the four walls, framed in elaborately carved grey monir.

title: [Hall of the Seas]
description: This room is perfectly spherical, like the inside of a crystal ball, except for the circular, sandstone-paved floor.  Rather than the depthless blue of glacial ice, these walls reveal a seascape of sand, coral, and waving beds of kelp surrounding you on each side.  A small school of herring can be seen swimming here and there, not only behind the walls but overhead as well.

title: [Hall of the Crafts]
description: The icy walls of this octagonal hall are elaborately carved with scenes of halflings at work.  In the center of the room are two large statues of men in attitudes of watchful repose, as if supervising the work going on around around them.  Between each statue and the surrounding walls stands a sturdy altar, one wrought of oak and the other carved from blue tanik.

title: [Hall of the Arts]
description: Deep shafts cut into the glacial walls bring sunlight streaming into this open gallery.  Bright and colorful banners hang from the ceiling, dancing in the gentle swirls of wind that carry down the center of the hall.  A harp and voice, unseen, blend melody and harmony in a gentle, joyful song.  In the middle of the hall, at the intersection of color, form, and sound, stand three wooden altars in hues of blue, gold, and grey.

title: [Hall of the Body]
description: Solid walls and towering pillars of ice imbue this room with an aura of dignity and strength.  The south wall is inlaid with two side-by-side symbols, and the walls to the east and west provide a backdrop for an altar and a large tapestry.  A woven rug threaded with hues of crimson, silver, azure and ivory covers most of the frozen floor, its intricate sigils forming an interwoven pattern of great beauty.  An ivory statue of a steed and an owl stands before the two wall symbols.

title: [Hall of the Mind]
description: The two halves of this room have been covered--ceiling, walls, and floor--with black granite and grey marble.  Meeting seamlessly in the middle, the two kinds of stone have been carved into gently sloping, crenulated curves.  Set against the backdrop of a bas-relief carving in the grey northern wall is an altar of misty white vaalin, while an altar of snowflake obsidian lies at the foot of the granite southern wall.

title: [Hall of the King]
description: The wide staircase comes to an end at an enormous round room.  A flat walkway extends from the stairs to a pure white altar in the center of the room, while elsewhere the floor has been carved to resemble the surface of the planet, complete with oceans and forests and high mountain ranges.  The thin ice of the cavernous domed ceiling not only permits sunlight to bathe the room, but opens up a breathtaking view of the heavens above.

The wide staircase comes to an end at an enormous round room.  A flat walkway extends from the stairs to a pure white altar in the center of the room, while elsewhere the floor has been carved to resemble the surface of the planet, complete with oceans and forests and high mountain ranges.  The thin ice of the cavernous domed ceiling not only permits starlight and moonlight to bathe the room, but opens up a breathtaking view of the heavens above.

title: [Hall of Those Beyond]
description: Narrow stairs descend from the glacial ice deep into the bedrock below.  A stencil-cut metal lantern hanging from the ceiling of this chamber turns slowly, sending figures of light into a macabre dance with the shadows.  Murals fill the east and west walls, their images rendered in stark colors and bold, discordant compositions.  The room's sparse aestheticism is broken only by the two altars standing opposite each other, dark gold to the east and grey granite to the west.

title: [Hall of Those Outside]
description: The chamber is huge with dense, carved stone vines curling across its walls and ceiling as if they have grown there.  On the west wall, the vines retreat, faced with the imposing portrait of a man.  Rendered in vivid colors, the man's posture is quietly intimidating.  Overhead, the bas-relief fauna almost conceals a mural that spreads across the ceiling.  From its shadows, golden eyes stare vehemently down.  A grey altar sits before the west wall, and a red altar rests in the center of the room.

title: [Hall of the Wounded Heart]
description: The chamber's light is diffused, giving it an illusionary quality.  Sand, tinted a vivid crimson, covers the floor.  On one half of the room, fingers of green sand invade the red, while on the other, the scarlet is offset with stark white.  Two altars sit opposite each other, one white and the other red.  Statuary stands beside both altars, towering up into the shadowy heights of the chamber, while murals decorate the walls behind the sculpture.

title: [Hall of the Deathbringers]
description: The expansive chamber is stark in both lighting and adornment.  A floor of pale sand offsets black walls.  Beams of light ricochet off the walls, although the source of the light isn't evident.  In the room's center, two altars sit opposite one another.  Behind them, carvings adorn the walls with scenes that are so old, their imagery is just ridges, gouges and basic shapes.  Frost rimes the edges of the carvings, adding a sense of antiquity to all.

title: [Hall of the Dark]
description: This chamber is a contradiction at its very core.  It is called dark, and yet the room is bathed in golden light.  A multitude of candles burn in sconces around the chamber, their incandescence augmented by the flickering of fireflies held within a splendid crystal globe hanging from the ceiling.  The walls are vibrant with color where frescos are painted in a marvelous panorama of line and color.  And yet, despite all the trappings and luminous illumination, the chamber is as cold as a tomb.

A golden column of flame reaches up from a centrally placed obsidian altar.  The twisting fire casts the only light in the dark space, causing the shadows to continuously shift and change.  The chamber is round, the charcoal and ebon-washed walls rising to a domed ceiling studded with hundreds of tiny black diamonds that flash in the ambient light.  Rising from the black marble floor is a flame mosaic that runs the perimeter of the room.

title: [Icemule Temple, Basement]
description: This long hallway carved deep under the glacier is unadorned save for the two round doors at the far end.  Due to some acoustical anomaly the corridor echoes with the sound of footsteps from above, providing the temple staff with notice that the building is in use.

title: [Temple Burrow, Lumnis Street]
description: Escorted by lamp posts whose bases are adorned with linked rings, the road delves between two rises in the glacier.  Carved ice steps wind up toward the temple, which crowns the southeastern rise, while a simple trail mounts the opposing slope.  From up the trail comes a vigorous splashing sound.  Shopkeepers do business from burrows that delve down into the ice, and several families have even cut dwellings out of the glacier.

You are situated between two hills in the glacier.  On the southeast hill is the Temple, accessible by a set of carved ice steps, while a simple trail leads up the side of the other hill.  A couple of ambitious shopkeepers do business from shops within the ice, and several families have made homes in the glacier.  From up the trail, a vigorous splashing can be heard.

title: [Temple Burrow, Penguin Hill]
description: Cold and crystal clear, a small lake has formed at the peak of the hill, providing a popular spot for local wildlife to congregate.  A huge colony of penguins flourishes on the shores of the lake.  They waddle comically around the edge, preen themselves and one another, and dive after little silvery fish darting through the frigid waters.  A smooth runnel in the bank makes an ideal slide for the creatures and, it appears, some of the younger townsfolk.

A small lake has formed here, making this a popular spot for the local wildlife.  A huge grouping of penguins lives on the shore of the lake, waddling comically around the edge, preening or catching the cold water fish.  A smooth area on the bank makes an ideal slide for the creatures and, looking more closely, it seems you could join in the fun.

title: [Icemule Trace, North Road]
description: The crowds attenuate near the northern boundary of the town, reduced to a few clerics headed east into the Temple Burrow and several stalwarts bound toward the northern gates.  Most everyone on the road wears thick boots and fur-lined cloaks, though a sprinkling of krolvin wear lighter clothing of hide with accoutrements of whalebone and sharktooth.   The glacier overshadows the roadway, its severe wall rising high above the streets, and the cobblestones are slippery with ice and tracked-in snow.

This part of the road is on the very edge of the glacier.  The cobbles are slippery with ice and tracked-in snow, and most everyone on the road is wearing thick boots and fur-lined cloaks.  To the north you can see a group of guards around a hole in the wall of ice, presumably guarding the entrance to the town.

title: [Icemule Trace, North Gate]
description: Several town guards watch the northern gate of the town, which is little more than a chasm hollowed out of the encroaching glacier.  Though armed, the guards seem less focused on watching for foes from the ice and more on discouraging the unwary or unprepared from braving the frigid depths.  The faint shadow of what once must have been the actual gates is visible through the ice, evidently devoured during the glacier's unrelenting advance.  Some stairs cut into the ice leading up to the city walls climb the natural wall created by the ice.

Several well-armed guards stand to either side of a hole in the glacier.  People wander in and out of the opening, which apparently serves as a gate to the town.  Within the ice you can see the faint shadow of what once must have been the actual gates.  However, the glacier has devoured it over time, and the resourceful halflings have taken advantage of the natural wall created by the ice.

Several well-armed guards stand to either side of a hole in the glacier.  People wander in and out of the opening, which apparantly serves as a gate to the town.  Within the ice you can see the faint shadow of what once must have been the actual gates.  However, the glacier has devoured it over time, and the resourceful halflings have taken advantage of the natural wall created by the ice.

title: [Magical Burrow, Banshee Lane]
description: A biting wind screeches down the lane from the east.  In that direction, in a break between the last houses on the street winks the glacial ice framing the northern gate of the town.  Past the entrance to Enchantment Alley, the road curves to the southwest, delving into the heart of the burrow.
A biting wind comes from the east.  Between the last houses on the street, you can see the glacial North Gate of Icemule Trace.  The road curves to the southwest into the eerie Magical Burrow.

title: [Magical Burrow, Banshee Lane]
description: Low-eaved houses line the street and residents, predominantly halflings and humans, bustle in and out of them.  Despite the chill in the air, a small group of children plays nearby, giggles chasing them as they run down the cobblestone lane.  They seem to shy away from the entrance to a dark and narrow alley between two especially ramshackle shops.
Low-eaved houses line the streets and halflings bustle in and out of them.  Despite the chill in the air, a small group of halfling children play nearby, running around and giggling continuously.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Magical Burrow, Wraith Road]
description: Heavy fog encroaches upon the twisting, turning road, so thick as to obscure the cobblestones completely in places.  The lamp posts along the road have bases wrought in the forms of swirling wraiths with their talons outstretched, the figures doing little to dispel the ill look of the area.  Several houses have lanterns swinging from heavy iron chains over their doors, as if not entirely trusting the street lights to ward off darkness.

The weird way that the roads twist and turn, compounded by a thick fog, make keeping your bearings straight difficult.  The fog near the ground is so thick that you can feel the road, but you can't see it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Entrance]
description: Heavy fog swirls in this entrance area but does not seem to pass through the silver gate.  Sharp ivory mammoth tusks protrude outward from the top of a tall, rough-hewn ironwood fence enclosing the compound.

title: [Magical Burrow, Wraith Road]
description: Cold fog prowls along the cobblestones, so thick that travelers of shorter stature might be entirely engulfed by its dense banks.  It eddies away from the gated entrance of a villa set back from the street.  The entrance is chained shut and there are piles of construction materials stacked outside.
A low, dense, cold fog blankets everything.  In some places a halfling could walk with only his or her head sticking above the eerie fog.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Magical Burrow, Wraith Road]
description: Dense fog creeps over the street in heavy banks.  Hanging low to the ground, it swirls in a chilling caress, muting the footsteps of passerby and making the noises of the district sound distant and strange.  Wrought iron fences guard the stolid old estates along the sides of the street.  Their windows stare down like empty sockets, and even the burrows nearby are grim things with dark-painted doors.  One gate is partly askew, allowing access to the porch of a small house.

Wrought-iron fences and a dense fog seem to be everywhere.  The fog is low to the ground and swirls in a chilling caress around you, even when you stand still.  The fog is probably just from the nearby glacier--at least, that is what you keep telling yourself.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Magical Burrow, Banshee Lane]
description: Small magical shops offering cure-all potions and other far-fetched elixirs line the narrow ribbon of cobblestone street.  Peddlers, the halfling ones standing atop crates to better their vantage and visibility, hawk their wares loudly and more quietly try to convince passersby of their authenticity.  Only the occasional street lamp stands along the roadside, their bases fashioned in the shapes of hollow-eyed banshees, and the shadows of the lamp posts stretch long across the thoroughfare.
Small magical shops offering cure-all potions line the street.  Peddlers walk by trying to sell their wares and to convince travellers that they are effective.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Magical Burrow, Demons Run]
[Magical Burrow, Demons Lane]
description: Shadows stretch long and tenebrous along the crooked span of cobblestones.  Short dark houses lurk down winding drives, their snowy yards guarded by intricately patterns fences of wrought iron.  There is a chill in the air that is not entirely born from the frigid breeze that howls down the lane, moaning low in the spaces between homes.

A constant chilly breeze together with the short dark houses surrounded by intricately patterned wrought-iron fences give you an uneasy feeling about this part of town.  It does not quite feel evil, but there is something disquieting in the air.

title: [Magical Burrow, Demons Run]
[Magical Burrow, Demons Lane]
description: Cold wind moans down the lonesome street, feeling as if it is blowing right off of the glacier itself.  The chill in the air and the tightly shuttered windows of the houses make the stretch of road an unwelcoming one.  A whiff of strange incense, woodsy and bitter, lingers on the wind, though its source is unclear.

A cold wind blows down this lonesome street, feeling as if it's blowing right off the glacier itself.  The chill in the air and the tightly shuttered windows of the houses add to the trepidation one feels at passing through this burrow.

title: [Magical Burrow, Sage Bend]
[Magical Burrow, Cursed Street]
[Magical Burrow, Sages' Bend]
description: A mural stretches along the face of a low stone fence separating a nearby manor from the street.  Depicted in vivid paint is a battle between ten small, dark figures with stretching shadows and a brave force of adventurers.  The leader of the tenebrous coterie is wreathed in twisting flames.  An ironwork gate opens out of the center of the fence, offering access to a welcoming if wintry courtyard beyond.
A few empty houses line the road here, probably vacated due to all the noise coming from the other burrows to the south and southeast.

title: [Magical Burrow, Demons Run]
[Magical Burrow, Demons Lane]
description: Behind a tall mithril gate, a flagstone path winds toward a rushing stream, threading in the direction of a stately fieldstone building mostly obscured by intervening drifts of snow.  Figures in colorful robes wander through the entry, some supported by ornate staves of pine or even silvery hoarbeam.  Houses and storefronts give the estate a wide berth, mostly cleaving to the opposite side of the road.

Behind a tall, mithril gate lies a flagstone path that winds past a small stream as it moves in the direction of a stately fieldstone building at the opposite end of the estate.  Dark robed figures move purposefully in and out of the building, or wander the grounds in silent contemplation, at all hours of the day and night.

title: [Icemule, Enchantment Alley]
description: Snaking its way between the stone ramparts and the more established streets of Magical Burrow is the sinuous path known as Enchantment Alley.  Tiny bare feet and boots of various size have left their prints in the muddy snow, and a few ramshackle buildings huddle against the ravages of the brutal north wind.

title: [Icemule, Enchantment Alley]
description: The north wall of the city is thickly rimed with ice, giving its carved surface an irony unintended by its artisan creators.  The lifesize bas-relief mural depicts a small cadre of robed halfling mages huddled together on the slopes of Mount Aenatumgana vanquishing a force of ice elementals.

title: [Icemule, Enchantment Alley]
description: Wizards of every shape and size move quietly through the shops of Enchantment Alley clutching potion bottles, bundled spell components, or merely wands and staffs.  Nervous glances cut from the city wall to the other mages, as if unsure which constitutes the greater threat.

title: [Icemule, Enchantment Alley]
description: Snow blown up against the walls is the only pure white in the alley, because all the rest has been trampled into a muddy filth by the passage of innumerable feet.  Passing a back corner of the Sorcerer Guild compound, Enchantment Alley boasts even less-reputable buildings than are its norm.

title: [Incantation and Enchantment]
description: At the northwest corner of Icemule Trace stands a sturdy square tower, its impressive height casting the meeting point of Incantation and Enchantment alleys into cold, damp shadow.  A few militia guardsmen slip in and among the spellcasters who move between the run-down alleys at all hours of the day.

At the northwest corner of Icemule Trace stands a sturdy square tower, its impressive height blocking the light from all but the stars directly overhead.  The halfling militia patrols in pairs, their spears and tridents held ready to meet any threat that might approach under cover of darkness.

title: [Icemule, Incantation Alley]
description: An irregular crack running down the length of the wall bleeds rust from the spent iron wands that have been crammed into the open space through the years.  A small puddle in the center of the alley offers the only relief from the frozen mud, and that relief comes only in the form of an icy window that opens onto frozen mud.

title: [Icemule, Incantation Alley]
description: Magical workshops, amulet shops, wand stores, and other businesses catering to the magical professions fill this narrow alley, which snakes behind an old abandoned workshop at the end of Wraith Road.  A few tendrils of fog work their way into the alley, leaving the rest of Magical Burrow obscured behind the mist.

title: [Icemule, Incantation Alley]
description: Slush and snow trampled into mud are all that pave Incantation Alley, the narrow thoroughfare running between the western wall of Icemule Trace and the Magical Burrow.  The grey granite wall has been scarred and scored by innumerable marks where mystical energy of every sort has gone awry in various failed experiments by apprentice members of the spellcasting professions.

title: [Icemule, Incantation Alley]
description: Emerging from the granite wall are several horrible figures, their rotting female bodies rendered in lifelike detail.  Standing at the opposite side of the cul-de-sac are two halfling sorcerers, each statue capturing a spellcaster in the act of incanting a powerful attack.

title: [Magical Burrow, Banshee Lane]
description: Gloomy houses with steepled roofs spotted with snowfall join strange magic shops to both sides of the winding thread of cobblestone road.  Halflings and the occasional krolvin hurry by on their way to some place else.  Ragged tendrils of mist rise off of the ice and snow dotting the landscape, swirling in eddies around the entrance to Incantation Alley.

The earthen road turns to the northeast here and heads toward the center of the Magical Burrow.  Houses and strange magical shops line the streets and halflings hurry by on their way to someplace else.

title: [Magical Burrow, Illusionist Way]
description: Narrowing to a tenuous thread of cobblestone, the street is crowded by huddled houses with snow-dusted yards.  Thick fog drapes the street, though the locals largely ignore its presence as they shuffle on their way to one task or another.  A brightly illuminated shop sits between a bank of snow and a corner street light, the sign above its entry swaying in the wintry air.
The road narrows here as houses crowd the street.  Some halflings wander past in the fog, talking to themselves.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
[Magical Burrow, Tunnelway]
description: Fog roils down from above, obscuring the uneven ground.  The tunnel's walls are hard earth, packed and frozen besides.  Hanging roots dip down from the rough ceiling, some fringed with spindly icicles.

Fog rolls in from above, obscuring your view of the ground beneath your feet.  The walls are hard, packed dirt with hanging roots that entwine around themselves and the small rocks embedded in the walls.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
[Magical Burrow, Tunnelway]
description: Roots dangle from the ceiling and snatch from the walls of the tunnel, old and nearly as unyielding as iron.  The fog choking the ground swirls and eddies, driven by the languorous air currents underground.  So cold is it below the earth that the walls have frozen.  They glisten darkly with a sheet of glassy ice.

Roots dangle from the ceiling and from the walls.  As you move they continually brush against you, almost like some small insects were running all over you.  Instinctively, you run a quick hand across your face to brush the imaginary creatures away.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
[Magical Burrow, Tunnelway]
description: An acrid scent, not entirely natural, travels through the air in a biting undercurrent.  Tangled roots hang from the walls, while a few larger ones stretch across the ground, making the terrain difficult but not impassable.  Fog mostly conceals the obstacles, but here and there, a gnarled tangle breaches through the mist.  To the south, an opening in the roots offers access to a shop occupying a well-lit burrow.
Tangled roots hang from the walls while a few larger ones lie on the ground, making walking difficult.  To the south, you can see an opening in the roots that looks like some sort of burrow.

title: [Sorena's Emporium]
[Sorena's Emporium, Showroom]
[Sorena's Alchemy, Showroom]
description: Lamps are slung from some of the thickest roots.  Shelves have been hollowed out of the walls and are filled with dark glass jars and clay pots.  A slab of granite in the center of the room serves as the worktable.  It is covered with vials, tubes, candles and various tools of alchemy.  Fluids, in all colors of the spectrum, bubble and hiss in their glass containers.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Road]
description: Between a pair of barbican towers, a constant stream of halfling farmers from the Olbin Strath and richly dressed human traders from Briarmoon Cove flows through the West Gate, with the occasional krolvin crew scattered among them.  Town guards inspect cargo, sharply dressed in dark blue and brown leathers emblazoned with the rampant mule that is the town's sigil.  Outside of the gates, the land is spotted with scraggly grasses and snows, and there is little tree cover.
The cobblestone road ends at the large western gate here.  Through the gate you see vast plains of grass about as tall as a halfling, with very few trees for cover.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Pilsner Avenue]
description: The Nightowl Pub stands at the end of Pilsner Avenue, the grimy windows along its north-facing facade looking out over the span of West Road.  A single lamp post stands out front, its base etched with a relief of spread-winged owls in flight.

Pilsner Avenue ends at the West Road, although you can see that another road continues beyond this intersection.  A tall, narrow, wooden framed building, apparently hastily constructed some years past, houses the Nightowl Pub.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Lager Street, Cul-de-sac]
[Lager Road, Cul-de-Sac]
description: A stone wall abuts the cobblestone street and looms overhead.  On top of the wall are stone lion sculptures, spaced at equal intervals, standing like guardians facing outward.  Framed within the middle of the stonework is a gate wrought of steel and gilded with silver filigrees.  The regal escutcheon of the Warrior Guild hangs prominently upon the center of the gate.

title: [The Nightowl Pub, Entry]
description: Upon entering the dimly lit room, you are startled by the row of round eyes staring at you from above.  As your vision adjusts to the darkness, you realize that you are merely being watched by the many owl statues lining a plate rail high on the wall.  It appears that each pair of eyes is formed by different gems, backlit by candles.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Pilsner Avenue]
description: A small niche has been carved into an old stone wall fronting the street.  Dried flowers and small folded notes surround the opening.  A young woman kneels before the wall, a wedding bouquet in one hand.  The other presses against the wall so hard that its fingertips have whitened.

A small niche has been carved into the old stone wall, and is surrounded by dried flowers and small folded notes.  A young woman kneels before the wall, a wedding bouquet in one hand, her other hand pressing against the wall so hard that her fingertips have whitened.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Pilsner Avenue]
description: Winterberry hedges grow at the base of a wrought iron fence enclosing the yard of some forging workshops located beyond a blued steel gate.  The greenery helps to muffle some of the repetitive clanging of metal on metal emanating from within the workshops.  A narrow alley, marked with a clever sign crafted from the top of a hogshead barrel, jags off to the northeast.

Boxwood hedge have been trained to grow here, wrapping around the poles of a wrought iron fence.  The grey stone of the outer wall of the city is just visible over the top of the fence, surrounding a cleared work yard.  The greenery helps to muffle some of the volume of the repetitive metal-on-metal noises emanating from the forging workshops located beyond the gate.  A narrow alley, marked with a clever sign crafted from the top of hogshead barrel, jags off to the northeast.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Pilsner Avenue]
description: In the shadow of the city's western wall stands a smithy, the door to its attached shop propped open by an oversized claidhmore.  White walls contrast tastefully with the dark blue trim of the windows and eaves and the sloping slate roof.  Through an open window, the clang of metal on metal and the effervescent smoke of burning pine drift out onto the street.  A green and gold imflass sign identifies the shop of Dalt Wineberry, one of the richest halflings in town.

In the shadow of the city's western wall stands a long workshop, its door propped open by an over-sized claidhmore.  Bright white walls contrast tastefully with the dark blue that trims the windows and the eaves, while new slate tiles defend the sloping roof from the elements.  Through an open window, the *clang* of metal on metal and an acrid smell of burning wood drift out onto the street.  A green and gold sign identifies the shop of Dalt Wineberry, one of the richest halflings in town.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Bitters Bend]
[Tavern Burrow, Pilsner Avenue]
[Tavern Burrow, Bend]
description: Near the shadow of the town walls, a stone-walled mill marks the southwestern corner of Icemule Trace.  Pilsner Avenue heads northward along the western wall, while Honeybeer Road leads eastward toward the South Gate, passing by a quaint neighborhood down a neat cobblestone path.  Bakers' apprentices pushing wheelbarrows full of grain or flour hustle to and from the mill tower.

A stone windmill marks the southwest corner of Icemule Trace.  From here, Pilsner Avenue heads northward along the western wall.  Honeybeer Road leads eastward towards the South Gate.  Bakers' apprentices pushing wheelbarrows full of grain or flour hustle to and from the mill tower.
A stone windmill marks the southwest corner of Icemule Trace.  From here, Pilsner Avenue heads northward along the western wall.  Honeybeer Road leads eastward towards the South Gate.

Near the night-blackened shadow of the town walls, a stone windmill marks the southwestern corner of Icemule Trace.  Pilsner Avenue heads northward along the western wall, while Honeybeer Road leads eastward toward the South Gate.  The mill tower is quiet and dark, a silhouette against the starlight.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Honeybeer Road]
description: A few small shops front Honeybeer Road, selling odds and ends.  One shop has a windowbox filled with colorful pinwheels that spin wildly whenever the wind blows, flashing their bright colors in a dizzying dance.  Another storefront's window is filled with a display of beer steins.  A carved spruce sign shaped like an arrow points toward the doorway of the local fletcher's shop.

A few small shops front Honeybeer Road here, selling odds and ends.  One shop has a windowbox filled with colorful pinwheels that spin wildly whenever someone passes nearby.  Another shop window is filled with a display of beer mugs.  A freshly hung arrow points towards a doorway.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Honeybeer Road]
