description: The Honeybeer Inn is a homey, cheerful-looking tavern with low, broad eaves and two round dormer windows that overlook the street.  Smoke curls upward from the stone chimney.  The scent of roasting rolton drifts out of the oak door each time it opens.  A standing hoarbeam-framed slate stands out front to welcome customers.

The local inn is a homey and cheery place with low, broad eaves and two round dormer windows overlooking the street.  Smoke curls upward from the stone chimney, and the scent of roast rolton drifts out from the oak door each time it is opened.

The local inn is a homey and cheery place with low, broad eaves and two round dormer windows overlooking the street.  The windows are shuttered now, but you can see some candlelight through the slats.  Smoke curls upward from the stone chimney, and the sounds of merriment drift out from a small window that seems to be in the pub.

The Honeybeer Inn is a homey, cheerful place with low, broad eaves and two round dormer windows overlooking the street.  The windows are shuttered against the night's chill, but candlelight winks through the slats.  Smoke curls upward from the stone chimney to join the darkness of night.  The sounds of muffled merriment escape the door every time it opens.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Honeybeer Road]
description: A two-toned stone wall absorbs the heat of the sun.  A young couple leans against the warm stone as they share some piping hot tarts.  The sight of food, coupled with the smell of baked goods that lingers over the area, inspires some passing townsfolk to hurry along to the nearest bakeshop or pub.  A few glance over their shoulders as they skulk toward the entrance to Bootlegger's Alley.

A two-toned stone wall absorbs the heat of the sun, and a young couple leans against it, munching on some pastries.  The sight of food, coupled with the smell of baking that permeates this corner of the town, inspires some passing townsfolk to hurry along to the nearest bakeshop or pub.

A two-toned stone wall still radiates the warmth absorbed during the day, and an old couple leans against it as they rest from their travels.  The cold winds that whip around this corner of the town inspire the few passersby to hurry along to the nearest pub or inn.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Porter Street]
description: Two-story rowhouses painted in vivid colors line Porter Street.  On the steps of a blue and white house, an older halfling woman sits, peeling apples and watching the people passing by.  Opposite the homes, a colorful wooden sign hangs next to the door of a dyer's shop.  Several of the homes burn herbs in their windows to keep out the faint stench of the dyes.

Two-story row houses painted in vivid colors line Porter Street, though at second glance, they are not as new as they had first appeared.  An older halfling woman sits on the steps of a blue-tinted house, peeling apples and watching the people passing by.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west

title: [Tavern Burrow, Porter Street]
description: Porter Street angles sharply towards the northeast as if veering toward the Silvermule Gaming Hall.  Crowds push past on their way to gamble, krolvin and half-krolvin, giantkin and halflings alike united by the allure of easily attained riches.  Only a few seem to pay any mind to a small snow-covered shop on the corner.  The southern wall of Icemule Trace is just visible down a short lane heading south.

Porter Street angles sharply towards the northeast here, in the direction of the Silvermule Gaming Hall.  A group of dwarves pushes past you on their way to the Silvermule, obviously intent upon furthering their riches.  Down the short lane heading south, you can just barely see the stone wall forming the border of the Trace.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Ale Street]
description: Bright-berried yew trees line the street, muffling the sounds of merrymaking echoing from the nearby gaming hall.  The bright rowhouses of Porter Street give way to wider boarding houses with balconies protected by wrought iron rail.  One tennant flies a pennant of giantkin tartan, while another has a ship's flag draped from their balcony.

The sounds of gaiety from the Silvermule are slightly muffled by the yew trees lining the street.  The bright row houses down on Porter Street have been replaced by slightly wider stucco boarding houses, apparently the homes for many of the Silvermule's workers.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Ale Street]
description: A stucco well has attracted a small group of children, who drop stones into its depths and hoot with glee at each muffled splash.  Across the cobblestone street, an enterprising group of young toughs has erected a hoarbeam trestle table.  They work industriously at picking the chests and coffers of local adventurers, one lad sitting atop an old oak beer barrel.  Lighter cobbles on the road form the outline of a frothing tankard, and the nearest lamp posts have bases wrought in the shapes of dancing revelers.

Stucco seems the preferred building material of the Tavern Burrow residents.  The street has been newly cobbled, and the rough edges cause several people to nearly trip as they hurry along.  A stucco well attracts a group of children, who drop stones into it, then hoot with glee at the muffled splash.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Lager Road]
description: Lager Road turns slightly, bending away from a solitary building with boarded up windows.  The edifice's clapboards are grey and weathered, contrasting starkly with the raw wooden planks across the doors and windows.  It almost appears as though the building was transported intact from another town, then allowed to fall into disuse.

Lager Road turns slightly here, away from the facade of a boarded up wooden building.  The building's clapboards are grey and weathered, in contrast to the light tan planks across the doors and windows.  It almost appears as though this building was transported here intact from another town, then never used.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Lager Road]
description: A twisting staircase with slender wrought iron rails spirals precariously up the back of the Nightowl Pub.  The stairs climb to a small grated ledge just below an open window on the second story of the ramshackle building.  Empty hogsheads, still smelling of the beer they once contained, are stacked beneath the staircase, as if to provide a splintery cushion for anyone who might fall.

A twisting staircase with slender, wrought-iron rails hangs precariously from the backside of the Nightowl Pub.  The top of the staircase ends just below an open window on the second story.  Empty barrels are stacked in the space beneath the staircase, providing a rather splintery cushion for anyone who might fall.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Malt Road]
description: The cobblestones of Malt Road alternate in whites and wan ambers reminiscent of a pale ale's hue.  Merry whistling lilts through the traffic along the road, which mostly consists of merchants and porters with cask-laden wagons bound for local taverns and inns.  Dried herbs hanging from the eaves of a rickety cottage impart a sweet fragrance to the cold wind.

The cobblestones of Malt Road are new enough to still have sharp edges.  Merrily whistling a tune, a delivery boy pushes along a cart with some oak casks on it.  The wheel of the cart just catches on the edge of a cobble, but the boy manages to right the cart before losing any cargo.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Barley Lane]
description: The narrow rowhouses along Barley Lane are taller than most of the surrounding homes.  The eaves of the buildings are low and broad to shade their porches from the sun and keep walkways free of snow.  Lamp posts to either side of the road have bases etched with sheaves of barley.

The narrow buildings on Barley Lane appear taller than others in the Trace, possibly due to the lowering of the street level.  The eaves of the buildings are low and broad, shading their porches from the southern sun in summer, and keeping the walkways snow-free in winter.

title: [Cottage, Back Room]
description: The back room is cluttered with bits of dried animal hanging on strings from the ceiling, jars full of oddly colored liquids and foul smells that cling to the walls and your clothes like the cloying grip of a banshee.  Sitting amidst the clutter you see a decrepit wreck of a man, his stringy hair jutting at odd angles away from his head, his clothes mere rags that hang limply on his cadaverous frame.

title: [Cottage, Living Room]
description: Littered about the main room of the rickety cottage are cots made of stone.  They look very functional but also very hard and uncomfortable.  Several wounded people lie on them, being tended to by Mirtag, the local healer.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Ale Street]
[Tavern Burrow, Thirsty Penguin]
description: Arms slung companionably over one another's shoulders, a group of halflings enters the Thirsty Penguin.  A mother cat rests on the broad stone step.  From beyond the swinging doors come the sounds of clinking mugs and hearty laughter.

Arms slung casually over one another's shoulders, a group of halflings enters the Thirsty Penguin.  A mother cat rests on the broad stone step, consenting to the occasional caress but flicking her tail in warning at the approach of strangers.  From beyond the swinging doors come the sounds of clinking mugs and hearty laughter.
An occasional halfling walks out of the darkened cold to enter the Thirsty Penguin.  A mother cat rests on the broad stone step, sleeping in the warmth that spills through the swinging doors.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [Tavern Burrow, Stout Street]
description: A jumble of boxes is piled at the base of a tall evergreen hedge where Stout Street meets Barley Lane.  Soft mewing from one of the boxes is almost obscured by the muffled drumbeats, soft arpeggios, and muted voices lifted in song at nearby taverns.  A gap in the hedge leads through a split-rail fence into the courtyard beyond.  The fence and hedge end at the corner of the property, where an easily overlooked side door serves as a side entrance to a nondescript building.

A jumble of boxes is piled against a tall evergreen hedge where Stout Street ends at Barley Lane.  Soft mewing from one of the boxes mingles with the sound of muffled drumbeats, soft arpeggios, and muted voices lifted in song.  A gap in the hedge leads through the split-rail fence into the courtyard beyond.  The fence and hedge end at the corner of the property, where an easily-overlooked door leads into the side of a non-descript low building.

title: [Icemule Trace, South Road]
description: A narrow house juts out into the cobblestone thoroughfare as if displaced from where it ought to be by the sprawl of the gaming hall to the southwest.  The savory aroma of baked apples tantalizes from an open window at street level.  Less pleasant, though mostly muted by hanging nosegays of rosebay and bilberry, is the odor of dyes wafting from a colorful canvas pavilion on the opposite side of the road.

A narrow house juts into the street, as though pushed off its foundation by the expanding gaming hall to the southwest.  You step carefully along the cobblestones and try not to glance into the open window at street level.

title: [Icemule Trace, South Road]
description: Occasional cheers of victory or groans of failure echo from the west, where the rooftop of the town's gaming hall glistens with a fresh tracing of silvery ice.  Several newcomers to town, standing out due to their foreign garb and lack of layered clothing, filter through the doors of a stone cottage.  A few crafty young krolvin linger outside, plying them for spare silvers.

The hoarse voices from the west are hard to understand.  Either they are happy cries or anguished moans, or perhaps both.  A group of enterprising youths approach you and ask for silvers, but continue along the road without pausing for your response.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Icemule Trace, South Road]
description: Halfling and giantkin vendors hawk their wares along the sides of the busy thoroughfare, the former cohort frequently standing atop crates and soapboxes so as not to be lost in the crowd.  A troop of half-krolvin trappers makes their way through the throng, coins jingling in their pockets.  Though drifts of fresh-fallen snow dot the roadside, a wrought iron street lamp at the corner stands near a cleared path, occasionally serving as a resting post for weary travelers.

Various halfling vendors hawking their wares block your way for a moment.  You notice a number of giantmen and dwarves heading north, coins jingling in their pockets.  A twisted, wrought-iron street lamp at the corner keeps an inebriated halfling from meeting the pavement.

Various halfling vendors hawking their wares block your way for a moment.  You notice a number of giantmen and dwarves heading north, coins jingling in their pockets.  A twisted, wrought iron street lamp at the corner keeps an inebriated halfling from meeting the pavement.

title: [Icemule Trace, South Road]
description: A flow of adventurers, merchants, trappers, and lumberjacks congeals into a noisy throng near the South Gate of Icemule Trace.  Adding to the clack of wagon wheels and the din of the crowd, sounds of laughter and clanking mugs beckon from the inns and taverns that occupy the Tavern Burrow, just to the west.   The road lies in the shadow of the town's high walls and barbican towers, the foundations of which are of darker stone than the top.

Several groups of adventurers jostle past you on their way through the South Gate.  The sounds of laughter from the west remind you of the inns and taverns back home.  You notice that the lowest part of the wall is darker stone than the top, a sign that this fortification was raised at some point in the past.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Trader Way]
[Commerce Burrow, Trader's Way]
description: A brisk wind blows down the street, shivering the branches of evergreens along the roadside.  The road comes to a sharp corner in front of a marvelous two-story bakery.  Countless small windows with white shutters peek out of the brick facade of the shop, and a polished silver plaque is affixed next to the door.  Woodsmoke billows gently from the stone chimney, though its bite is sweetened by the aroma of baked goods.

Trader's Way comes to a sharp corner here, in front of a marvelously grand bakery.  Painted bright pink, the front of the shop is decorated with numerous tiny windows outlined with white shutters.  A polished silver plaque hangs next to the door.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Trader Way]
[Commerce Burrow, Trader's Way]
description: The enticing aroma of baked goods wafts in from the south, luring a steady stream of travelers toward a bakery there that stands a story taller than the other businesses along the street.  Several halflings coming from that direction clutch tarts with a delectable variety of fillings in parchment wrappings, the pastries still piping hot.  Near a windblown leather tent sporting a sign etched with carved logs, an alley juts off of the main drag.
An enticing aroma wafts in from the south as several large groups of chattering halflings head off in that direction.  To the east, the road turns into a narrow alley.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Krolvin Alley]
[Commerce Burrow, Elven Alley]
description: Wedged into a cramped walk between two tall buildings, the alley slumbers in shadow.  The brick wall behind a stack of empty crates is scrawled with an ugly symbol in dark brown pigment that looks like a harpy wreathed by a burning ring.  Soft scuttling resounds from within the crates.  Despite the unappealing locale, a grungy little shop does brisk business near the midpoint of the alleyway.
Wedged between two sturdy stone buildings, the alley is blanketed with shadows.  A stack of empty crates leans against one wall, from which a quiet scuttling noise can be heard.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Krolvin Alley]
[Commerce Burrow, Elven Alley]
description: Twisting and turning between weathered buildings of brick and pine, the cobbled alley slopes steeply downward.  Dense shadows lurk to either side of the walkway.  As if oblivious to the foreboding look of the span, an elegant little shop opens onto the alleyway, hand-drawn maps of locales familiar and foreign on display through its wide bay windows.
Twisting and turning between weathered buildings of stone and wood, the alley slopes steeply downward.  Shadows dance along the high walls and across the packed earth road.

title: [Corleo's Cartography]
description: Thousands of scrolls sit neatly in an oversized bookshelf, each neatly placed in its own beautifully lacquered pigeonhole and clearly labelled.  A drawing table erected in the corner has a piece of fresh clean parchment tacked to it, and several pots of tightly closed ink sit nearby, ready for use.  A huge skylight above showers the small, clean shop with soft light.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Krolvin Alley]
[Commerce Burrow, Elven Alley]
description: A tall, brightly painted building stands at the end of the alleyway.  Banners of red, blue, yellow, and green wool dangle from the awnings, rustling slightly in the breeze.  Finely dressed halflings bustle past, their arms loaded with bright packages from the clothier's shop, while a space between two storefronts dovetails into another alley.

A tall, brightly painted building dominates the lower end of Elven Alley.  Banners of red, blue, yellow and green dangle from the awnings, rustling slightly in the breeze.  Finely dressed halflings bustle past you, their arms loaded with bright packages from the clothier shop.

title: [Tartifacts Bakery]
description: Light pierces the windows and strikes dozens of cut glass display cases, sending rainbows of color dancing around the walls of this decadent shrine to the tart.  Young halflings run around, tripping over each other to polish the sparkling silver tables normally filled with chatting patrons.

Moonlight pierces the windows and strikes dozens of cut glass display cases, sending rainbows of color dancing around the walls of this decadent shrine to the tart.  Young halflings run around, tripping over each other to polish the sparkling silver tables normally filled with chatting patrons.

title: [Tartifacts Bakery]
description: The master tart-baker himself holds court over a beautifully polished glass counter decorated with diamond inlay.  Patrons approach the counter with heads bowed to order his delicacies while others waddle off with arms loaded with the hand-crafted confections.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Trader Way]
[Commerce Burrow, Trader's Way]
description: A group of sylvankind tightens cloaks in woodland hues against the chill wind off of the glacier as they glide down the street.  Towering high over the road, the town wall stands between the niceties of civilization and the cruel beauty of the wilds beyond.  In the shadow of the wall stands a gem shop, a sturdy stone building bearing a shiny gold plaque.  Gems and jewelry glimmer from the windows on beds of black velvet.
A group of elves tightens their cloaks against the chilling north wind as they pass along the road.  To the east sits the gemshop, a sturdy stone building bearing a shiny gold plaque.

title: [Glowing Zircon Gem Shop]
description: Zirconia the Jeweller sits with her feet up on a short steel counter as she sorts through a small chest full of gems.  Occasionally digging into a bulging money bag to toss coins at gem sellers, she whistles happily to herself as she works.

Apprentices, all lined up in a row at a short steel counter, work diligently grading and sorting the incoming stones and precious gems under the eagle eye of their supervisor.  An assortment of jeweler's loupes, polishing cloths, and sizing charts lay close to hand, ready to help in the evaluation of the merchandise.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Trader Way]
[Commerce Burrow, Trader's Way]
description: Peddlers from out of Briarmoon Cove and Pinefar wander up and down the road, loudly touting their wares.  A general store sits to the side of the road, decorated with banners in a cheerful rainbow of colors.  The customers are an eclectic mix of fledgling adventurers and townsfolk, the two groups united in their need for various odds and ends.

Halfling merchants wander up and down the road here, hawking their wares.  A low wooden building sits to the side of the road, decorated with banners in a rainbow of colors, each declaring it a general store.  From inside, the hustle and bustle of feet can be heard, punctuated by an occasional shout as items are bought and sold.

title: [Berrytoe's General Store]
[Berrytoe's Bare Essentials]
description: Barrels and boxes draped in cloth of all shades cover the wooden floor of this small store.  A group of dwarves stands off to one side, haggling furiously with a halfling.  The halfling waves his arms angrily, nearly hitting a dwarf with a tiny backpack.  At one end of the room, another halfling guards a counter full of wares.

Polished barrels and decoratively etched crates draped in bright cloth have been placed strategically around the shop to attract the eyes of milling customers to the wares set out upon them.  A round glass skylight in the ceiling above casts sunbeams on a miniature snow-covered village placed on a stand in the center of the room.  A group of dwarves off to the side haggles furiously with a flustered sales assistant, while behind a counter against the the opposite wall, the merchant Berrytoe stands with a welcoming smile.

title: [Blackfinger's Locks]
description: The walls of this small room are lined with small, gold-framed cases holding some of Blackfinger's finer wares.  Ranging from diamond-encrusted lockpicks to the simplest pick, the cases glow in the warm candlelight.  A low oak workstand lines one wall of the room, on which Blackfinger cheerfully works his talents.

title: [Icemule Trace, East Road]
description: A pair of town guards are stationed outside the archway leading into the town's bank.  One halfling guard seems to be dozing on his stool, while the other keeps a close and wary eye on the foot traffic flowing past.  The bank is a tall building, its clapboard exterior painted a bright wintry blue that complements its dark slate-shingled roof.  Several krolvin sailors count their money nearby, using the top of an old oaken hogshead to stack coins familiar and strange.

A pair of guards lean back against the the archway of the bright blue building housing the Icemule Trace branch of the First Elanith Bank.  One guard seems to be dozing on his stool, while the other keeps a close and wary eye on the traffic flowing past.

A pair of guards lean back against the archway of the bright blue building housing the Icemule Trace branch of the First Elanith Bank.  One guard seems to be dozing on his stool, while the other keeps a close and wary eye on the traffic flowing past.

title: [Icemule Trace, East Road]
description: As it passes by a half-timbered pale grey stone guildhall, the straight march of the cobblestone road offers a view of snowy foothills beyond the town's walls.  Over the heads of fur-clad merchants from Pinefar and robed sisters leading groups of fresh-faced initiates out of town, the snow-swept wilds are dotted with evergreens and dark rock.  Glimpses of a pale stone abbey in the extreme distance are almost entirely lost to the cloud cover.  To the south, the slate-shingled roof of Clovertooth Hall rises high into the sky.
Merchants and adventurers crowd this gravel path, talking and laughing as they stroll along.  Off to the south, a stately white dome rises high into the sky.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Sylvan Hollow]
description: Paved with cobblestones, a wide cul-de-sac spreads before Clovertooth Hall, the civic center of the bustling town.  Meticulously clean windows sparkle to either side of the wide, arched entry, the keystone of which is stamped with a mule in bright copper inlay.  The slate shingles of the building are tidy and even, and they are sealed with pine pitch.  High-topped spruce trees with verdant needles dusted by fresh snow frame the circle, softening the sounds of peddlers and foot traffic along the road to the north.

A cobblestone circle marks the entrance to an ornate white marble structure.  Sparkling clean windows mark either side of the entrance, over which the words "Clovertooth Hall" are deeply engraved.  The circle bustles with the townspeople of Icemule Trace.

A cobblestone circle marks the entrance to an ornate white marble structure.  Sparkling clean windows mark either side of the entrance, over which the words "Clovertooth Hall" are deeply engraved.  The circle is empty but for a few bleary-eyed clerks and visitors doing after-hours business with the government of Icemule Trace.

A cobblestone circle marks the entrance to an ornate white marble structure, though half of its western wall is blackened with fire marks.  Smoke-darkened windows windows mark either side of the entrance, over which the words "Clovertooth Hall" are deeply engraved.

A wide cul-de-sac lined with cobblestones spreads before a two-story stone structure.  Scaffolding climbs the facade, laden with the leavings of day workers: cleaning cloths, buckets, and acrid-smelling scouring solution.  Much of the building's facade is blackened by scorch marks, and it looks as if an extensive effort at remodeling and recovery is underway.  Smoke-darkened windows mark either side of the building's arched entrance, over which the words "Clovertooth Hall" are inlaid in bronze.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Saferoom]
description: Judging from the time-rounded stones and smooth floor, the saferoom is old, but it is kept free of dust.  Crates and barrels full of preserved foodstuffs are stacked floor to ceiling, filling the air with the sharp odor of brine and more muted hints of dry meat and fish.  A large metal lever protrudes from one wall.

title: [Icemule Trace Clerks Suite]
description: A long hallway stretches off to the west, leading to the offices of minor town officials.  Various clerks rush about, shuffling paperwork and directing visitors to the lockers to the east.  A large painting hangs on the south wall.

title: [Icemule Trace Clerks Suite]
description: The wide hallway leading from the east branches north and south as it continues to the west.  Two white marble benches covered with blackworked cushions sit low to the floor on either side of a large painting that hangs on the south wall.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Icemule Trace Clerks Suite]
description: The white marble hallway comes to an end at a small chute tucked away in a protected alcove.  A large painting dominates the western wall.

title: [Icemule Trace Clerks Suite]
description: The white marble hallway comes to an end at an enormous anchor, which rests on its side in a quiet alcove.  A large painting covers the entire southern wall.

title: [Icemule Homesteaders Office]
description: A small desk sits in the middle of this small office, buried under mounds and mounds of paperwork.  The claims clerk looks up with a perturbed look on her face, lets out an exasperated sigh and roughly squares a stack of parchment before settling down to work again.

title: [Calradian's Deed Conveyance]
description: Narrow as a closet and almost as dark, save for a lone oil lamp that emits a sooty wisp of smoke, the tiny office is as neat as possible thanks to several shelves stacked with piles of paper.  A small, battered desk has been pushed up against one wall and rests beneath a sign that simply says "Deeds."

title: [Ceraleth's Cartage]
description: Short and very rotund, a grumpy dwarf sits off in a corner, his clothing filthy with dirt and wood shavings.  A plate of sliced rolton meat has been piled atop a wedge of bread that sits in a pool of natural gravy.  A crude sign tacked up on the wall loudly declares, "You buy it, we move it" in heavy black lettering.

title: [Inking Den, Annex Hallway]
description: Frosted globes nestled within decorative wall sconces provide a steady glow of welcoming light down the long corridor.  The walls are hidden behind bright ivory white silk drapery, the soft ends of which pool upon the thick cerulean and azure carpet.  Built into opposing walls, a lacquered white door and a lacquered beige door part the drapery and have a trio of brightly glowing globes directly above their pointed, cinquefoil frames.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Bondsman]
description: Two halfling guards in matching uniforms flank each end of a long marble counter behind which sits another gleefully counting his coins.  Marking the center of the counter is a shiny silver-plated sign.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A long hallway stretches off to the east, leading to the public locker rooms.  Various clerks rush about, shuffling paperwork and directing visitors to the offices to the west.  A large sign hangs on the south wall.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A bright blue curtain hangs on the south wall, masking the entrance to a locker booth.  More lockers are visible off to the east.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A shiny orange curtain covers the north wall, marking the entrance to a locker booth.  The hallway branches off here, with more locker booths visible to the southeast and northeast.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: The north wall of this hallway is covered with a garish blue curtain marking the entrance to a locker booth.  More lockers are visible to the east, while to the southwest the corridor heads back to the main lobby.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A stark black curtain covers the entrance to a locker booth on the north wall of this long hallway.  More locker booths are visible off to the east and west.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: The north wall of this hallway is covered by a shiny gold curtain, masking the entrance to a locker booth.  More locker booths can be seen to the east and west.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: The hallway ends in a sharp turn here, with a flashy azure curtain masking the entrance to a locker booth in the north wall.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: Marking the entrance to a locker booth, a fuzzy grey curtain hangs on the east wall.  Visible to the north and south, more curtains line the walls.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: The hallway ends in a sharp corner here, with a shiny silver curtain covering the entrance to a locker booth in the south wall.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A rainbow of colors covers the curtain marking a locker booth to the north.  A small bench rests against the south wall and more locker booths are visible to the east and west.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A gaudy orange curtain covers a locker booth entrance on the south wall.  The hallway continues to more lockers at the east and west.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: The south wall of the corridor is masked by a bright green curtain covering the entrance to a locker booth.  More booths are visible to the east and northwest.

title: [Icemule Trace, East Road]
description: Adventurers thread through the crowd cluttering the eastbound road, ornate weapons and flamboyant attire standing out from the more common furs and wool worn by merchants and locals.  Young halfling and human children run around near the street, tugging at travelers' coattails in an effort to hawk cheap gems.  Wooden building sits amidst the chaos, its yard heaped with crates, barrels, and trunks, while a well-lit dark stone shop seems to have taken a more reserved approach, standing away from the busy throng.

Crowds of adventurers flock along this main road, traveling back and forth between the East Gate and the Icemule town center.  Young children run around, tugging at travellers' coattails as they hawk cheap gems.  A rather squat wooden building sits comfortably on the north side of the road.

title: [Icemule Trace, East Road]
description: Tall brownstone rowhouses line both sides of the busy road, their round doors painted a wide variety of colors.  A gnarled birch hunches over the southern edge of the road, its roots snaking beneath the cobblestones and its bark lending the breeze a pleasant bite.  Beneath the tree, a scattering of bright green leaves litters the ground.  The bent stalwart marks the property line of a small snow-covered cottage standing back from the thoroughfare.

Short, sturdy buildings line both sides of the road here, providing homes to the merchants of Icemule Trace.  A gnarled and twisted tree guards the south edge of the road, its roots snaking along the dirt road underfoot.  Beneath the tree, a scattering of leaves litter the ground.

Short, sturdy buildings line both sides of the road here, providing homes to the merchants of Icemule Trace.  A gnarled and twisted tree guards the south edge of the road, its roots snaking along the dirt road underfoot.  Beneath the tree, a scattering of leaves litter the ground about a a snow-covered cottage with a simple parchment sign tacked to the door.

Short, sturdy buildings line both sides of the road here, providing homes to the merchants of Icemule Trace.  A gnarled and twisted tree guards the south edge of the road, its roots snaking along the dirt road underfoot.  Beneath the tree, a scattering of leaves litter the ground about a snow-covered cottage.

title: [A Cozy Cottage]
description: Rich, knotted wood paneling lines the walls, hung with tapestries in autumn colors of russet and deep green.  Small windows bedecked with red and yellow leaf-patterned curtains look out on the icy lane, and several polished brass oil-lamps warmly illuminate the room.

title: [Cozy Cottage, Hearth]
description: The oak-paneled walls are hung with garlands of autumn leaves and pinecones in colors of red and orange and yellow and brown.  Hangings of dried corn and flowers adorn the small stone fireplace which warms the room with its flickering light, and beeswax candles glow merrily among the goods arranged on a carved oaken table.

title: [Icemule Trace, East Gate]
description: Pack mules bray from wide hitching posts to either side of the East Gate, laden with luggage and gear from travelers fixing to brave the snowy wilderness.  Crowds pass through the barbican beyond, a peculiar mix of returning adventurers, weary merchants, and serene monks and sisters from the abbey to the east.  A group of halfling children plays a game by the barbican towers, daring one another to run out into the wilds beyond.

Pack mules bray from wide hitching posts to either side of the East Gate, laden with luggage and gear from travelers fixing to brave the snowy wilderness.  Crowds pass through the barbican beyond, a peculiar mix of returning adventurers, weary merchants, and serene monks and sisters from the abbey to the east.  Several town guards stand watch in the darkness near the barbican towers, their eyes trained on the wilds beyond.

A layer of dust swirls around the ground, stirred up by the trampling feet of the crowds passing in and out of a tall gate.  A group of halfling children play a game by the gate, daring each other to run out into the wilds beyond.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: The windows of the town's jail look out over the road, the bars guarding them filigreed with silvery rime.  Across the road from the jail, a dark-eyed halfling leans against the wall of a barrister's office and quietly observes the passerby.  A rocky path winds toward the jailhouse's door, passing by a large boulder with a few crude etchings on its surface.

The barred windows of the Icemule Trace Jailhouse look out over the road here.  A rocky path winds toward the jail door, passing by a large boulder.  Across the road from the jail, a dark-eyed halfling leans against a building wall and quietly observes the passersby.

title: [Icemule Trace, Jailhouse Path]
description: There are garden plots along the walls to either side of the jail entrance, a sturdy steel door etched with a dour-looking mule.  The hardy herbs and flowers growing in the cold soil lend the gloomy structure a glimmer of natural beauty.  The jailhouse path bends around a large boulder that is worn smooth by the elements.  The rock's sheer size suggests that its presence might predate the town around it.

A small, well-tended garden surrounds the entrance to the Icemule Trace Jailhouse, providing it with a sense of simple beauty.  The garden is centered around a large boulder that has rested here since long before Icemule was founded.

title: [Icemule Trace Jailhouse]
description: A large and quite cluttered desk consumes most of the space in this office.  Along one wall, the bars of a tiny cage-like cell offer a view of its inhabitants.  Hanging above the cell is a oak pole that looks just wide enough to fit between the cell bars.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: Several townhouses stand along the cobblestone street.  Their neatly manicured yards are home to fine-looking statuary, and all are kept meticulously clear of snow, suggesting that they are the residences of well-to-do merchants and other luminaries of the town.  Smaller homes front a nearby alley, while an arched gate leads to a less prosperous neighborhood lazing beneath the town's outer wall.  A young halfling girl sweeps the walk in front of one of the homes, hurrying to complete her daily chores.

Several simple houses line the road here, providing homes for merchants and businessmen of the Trace.  Towering high behind them, the town wall provides protection from the wilds beyond.  A young halfling boy sweeps the walk in front of one of the homes, hurrying to complete his daily chore.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: A riotous throng crowds the entrance of a large grey tent with a ten-foot long rat tail on top.  Standing atop a wooden crate, a halfling rogue dressed in fine grey leathers stands in front of a sign depicting a wheel of cheese.  Paying little mind to the untenable size of the crowd that his establishment has already amassed, he exhorts passerby to come closer, only adding to the horde.

A crowd gathers here, circling a shouting halfling rogue dressed in fine leathers.  Standing atop a wooden crate, the halfling's cries of "Rat bets! All the odds you need to know! And some you don't!" ring out through the crisp air.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: Most of the shops along the way are prosperous two-story storefronts with clear glass windows and stately porches.   Fine furnishings glint in the candlelight from within a long wooden building near the end of the row.  Near the end of its freshly plowed front walk, a young trapper toils at the side of the road, pulling on a heavy sack of fresh skins.

A brisk wind blows along the path here, carrying with it the sounds of heated shouts and cheers from the northwest.  A young halfling warrior toils at the side of the road, pulling on a heavy sack of skins.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: Bumblefinger's Pawnshop is perched on the south side of the road, the well-tended wooden building draped with several blue and green banners proclaiming its low prices and fine goods.  Several giantkin mill about outside, counting their coins.  Freshly painted some white stairs climb up to the pawnshop porch.

A giantman strolls merrily away from Bumblefinger's Pawnshop, counting his coins.  The pawnshop is perched on the south side of the road, housed in a well tended wooden building.  Freshly painted white stairs lead up to the pawnshop porch.

title: [Pawnshop, Porch]
description: Several tables line the porch, offering Bumblefinger's odds and ends to passing adventurers.  A sleepy-eyed halfling leans against the pawnshop door, keeping one eye trained on the tables at all times.

title: [Pawnshop, Interior]
description: Stark wooden floorboards creak under the weight of stacks of bundled weapons and leather.  Perched atop the tall bundles is a halfling clerk who looks none too eager to help you.  In a place of honor on the wall opposite the door is a portrait of Sniffberry, the pawnshop proprietor.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: The stink of tanning solution and uncured hides sours the air, barely fettered by the presence of floral sachets in the windows of nearby shops.  Trappers wait in line outside the furrier's shop that is the odor's obvious source, most carrying pelts, but a few laboring beneath the weight of a whole carcass.  Hanging from the thatched roof of the shop is a bright blue banner.

A rather squat-looking wooden store perches south of the road and the sound of high pitched shouting rings out from within.  Hanging from the thatched roof of the furrier's store is a bright blue banner.

title: [Furryback's Pelt and Skin]
description: Stacks of hides and pelts cover the floor in this cramped shop, leaving a narrow trail to the counter.  A bright-eyed halfling sits on top of the counter, sorting through a stack of skins as he talks to himself under his breath.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Giantman Path]
description: A quiet path veers south of the bazaar along a residential street fronted by homes of all shapes and sizes.  Rowhouses stand by small manses owned by some of the town's wealthiest denizens.  The sounds of the town are muffled by the thatched roofs of several houses, aided in the effort by evergreens growing along the road.  A fountain burbles in the courtyard of a tall brick building near the far end of the road.

This quiet path veers south of the bazaar, along a residential street lined with simple homes of all shapes and sizes.  The sounds of the Trace are muffled by thatched roofs and several sturdy oak trees lining the path.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Giantman Path]
description: Surrounded by a small field of snow-dotted grass, an ancient oak tree marks the southeastern boundary of the town.  Its highest branches tower above the outer wall, and from within, a songbird cries, filling the air with its gentle twittering.  The old stalwart's roots have dug beneath the wall's foundations, tirelessly working at them until the very stones have surrendered to their efforts.

An ancient oak tree marks the southeastern corner of Icemule Trace.  Towering high overhead, the tree is surrounded by a small grassy field.  A lone bird calls from somewhere within the branches, singing a cheerful song.

An ancient oak tree marks the southeastern corner of Icemule Trace.  Towering high overhead, the tree is surrounded by a small grassy field.  A lone owl calls from somewhere within the branches, its haunting voice fading into the night.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: Hard-looking sylvankind and half-krolvin trappers, burdened with pelts and furs from the wilds beyond, trudge southeast toward the local furrier.  A raw timber cottage faces the street, the snow cleared from its front path.  The trilling of a flute drifts from the cottage's doorway, gently punctuating the din of the bazaar to the east.

Passing merchants, laden with pelts of all shapes and sizes, trudge southeast towards Furryback's Pelt and Skin.  An earthen-worked cottage faces the street, the snow cleared from its front path.  The trilling sounds of a flute drift from the cottage's doorway.  To the east lie the sights and sounds of the Icemule Bazaar.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Commerce Burrow, Bazaar]
description: A dizzying assortment of colorful tents and booths crowds the cobbles of the bazaar.  Farm stands selling produce from the Olbin Strath stand shoulder to shoulder with the bright silk pavilions of merchants out of Briarmoon Cove.  The savory aroma of roasting rolton weds tantalizingly with the sweetness of fresh-baked tarts on the chilly air.  One wooden warehouse along the perimeter is festooned with garlands, though many of the flowers are dusted with ice crystals.

The sights and sounds of this bustling bazaar almost overwhelm you.  Stands are set up all through this area selling various wares.  A group of halflings wander past, heading straight for the nearest food stand.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Bazaar]
description: Flamboyantly dressed merchants, many of them halflings but with a scattering of half-krolvin, humans, and giantkin mixed in, rest from their work and devour local delicacies at large round tables scattered around the center of the bazaar.  Off to the edges, more peddler's booths and tents in raucous colors stand, their owners selling exotic spices, bright copper pots and pans, and everything in between.  A dainty shop stands back from the fray, sedate in comparison to the throng despite its sky blue roof.

Large tables with flamboyantly dressed halfling merchants are scattered around the center part of the bazaar.  Off to the edge of the bazaar more tables are set up with merchants of various races trying to hawk their wares.  As you move between the tables each merchant in turn waves at you and motions for you to come closer to his table.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: The shouts of traders drift over the slate-shingled rooftops of the shops to the south.  Evidently unbothered by the noise, an ancient halfling sits on a bench along the side of the road.  He twirls a slender blue wand between his fingers while lecturing to a group of young, attentive pupils.

The shouting of traders drifts over the buildings to the south.  An ancient halfling sits off to the side of the road, twirling a slender blue wand between his fingers while holding discourse over a group of young, attentive pupils.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Twisty Alley]
description: The cold alley twists out of sight, winding between closely set buildings.  Delectable aromas of pastries baking scent the frosty air, so strong and tangible, they seem almost visible.  Halflings hurry by each other with purposeful strides, shoulders brushing in the confined avenue.
tags: meta:mapname:Neighborhoods of Icemule Trace and Pinefar

title: [Dabbings Mews, Mews Lane]
description: A long, straight avenue stretches north and south, bordered by a row of buildings on the west side.  On the east, a tall wall flanks the lane, carved stone figures set along its top.  A frosty breeze gusts down the road, the wind using the clear open straightaway to gain momentum.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Dabbings Mews, Talbot Court]
description: Tall, thin houses ring the court, their facades immaculate.  A few halfling children chase each other down the narrow alleys created by the residences' closely set foundations.  Pushed by the demanding Icemulian wind, clouds fly swiftly overhead, casting enormous shadows that dwarf the buildings below.

Tall, thin houses ring the court, their facades immaculate.  Only a few muffled footsteps suggest the presence of halflings as they walk swiftly down the narrow alleys created by the residences' closely set foundations.  Pushed by the demanding Icemulian wind, clouds fly swiftly overhead, casting the buildings below into total darkness.

title: [Icemule, Trade Alley]
description: Bashed and battered packing crates litter the ground, providing some traction for the carts and wagons that move regularly through the narrow confines of Trade Alley.  A few humble shops open on the alley, but the thoroughfare mostly serves as a delivery route for the businesses of Commerce Burrow and the homes of Dabbings Mews.

title: [Icemule, Trade Alley]
description: A large mural showing wagon trains moving up and down the glacier covers the granite walls of this cul-de-sac.  Underfoot, the snow and ice hide all manner of trash swept here by the brisk arctic winds.

title: [Icemule, Trade Alley]
description: Deep ruts from wagon wheels scar the frozen ground of Trade Alley, especially where it passes the rear entrance to a large furniture warehouse that opens on Dwarven Circle.  In the shadow of the eastern wall is a huge formation of mica that has been cut to resemble an enormous pile of coins.

title: [Icemule, Trade Alley]
description: Packing crate panels and other odd bits of wood pave the frozen ground, keeping the passersby from tracking mud into the small shops and stores that dot the landscape of Trade Alley.  A brisk business goes on between the customers and business owners, and even between the owners themselves, as no one lets an opportunity for dealmaking pass them by.

title: [Barter and Trade]
description: The packing crate pavement of Barter and Trade Alleys widen into a broad if unimpressive plaza in front of the sturdy tower in the southeast corner of Icemule Trace.  A few halfling militia guards patrol the square at all hours, but most of the people in view have more important matters in mind:  doing business with one of the many small merchants whose shops stand in the shadow of the tower.

title: [Icemule, Barter Alley]
description: Store owners bark their goods and services from the open doors of small shops, and customers brave the cold to listen.  Others peer in shop windows and examine signs, alert for bargains or hard-to-find treasures.  From the north comes the sound of a voice bellowing something about "rats" and "racing."

Many of the small shops are closed for the night, but others linger open through the night to capture every last silver coin that might wander in from the alley, looking for a warm place to spend the night.  From the north a harsh voice rasps out something about "rats" and "racing."

title: [Icemule, Barter Alley]
description: An old pushcart lies abandoned at the side of the alley, where its wooden wheels gave out under its final load.  Many footprints marked on the packing-crate pavement suggest that visitors to the alley frequently inspect the cart before rejecting its value at salvage.

title: [Icemule, Barter Alley]
description: Long shadows creep out from under shop awnings, and mud-covered ice is pushed into mounds on either side of the packing-crate pavement.  A halfling merchant holds up two pieces of jewelry to a potential customer, who offers an ivory dagger in exchange.  The wary merchant keeps a close eye on the customer's small child, who keeps trying to enter the shop without supervision.

Darkness fills this quiet alley, and mud-covered ice is pushed into mounds on either side of the packing-crate pavement.  Wagons move slowly through the area, delivering goods to the shops and kiosks whose colorful awnings brighten this moonlit edge of town.

title: [Icemule, Barter Alley]
description: The grey granite wall is almost hidden in shadows along this part of the alley.  The mud ruts are deep here, and the packing crate pavement is almost lost in the mud and ice that have accumulated from the road.  Wooden planks serve as bridges across the sludge.  The smell of freshly baked tarts fills the air as halfling merchants loudly argue with cart drivers about various loads of merchandise.

The granite wall is almost completely hidden in darkness.  The mud ruts are deep here, and the packing crate pavement is almost lost in the mud and ice that have accumulated from the road.  Wooden planks serve as bridges across the sludge.  The smell of freshly baked tarts fills the air as halfling merchants loudly argue with cart drivers about various loads of merchandise.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Locker Booth]
description: You are standing in a cramped room filled with short stacks of lockers.  One of these lockers has been removed for you and placed on a tiny wooden counter.

title: [South Barbican, Gate]
description: Under the massive barbican is a shadowy passageway, with sturdy stone walls on each side and overhead.  Iron-barred windows provide access to this area from each of the barbican towers as well as from overhead, creating the distinct impression that someone is watching from the shadows.  The sharp spikes of raised portcullises jut from the ceiling at the northern entrance to the city and the southern exit to the wilds.

title: [Icemule Trace, South Gate]
description: Thick stone walls frame a wide, wooden gate.  A vaulted stone archway provides some cover from the weather, which is often inclement so close to the glaciers.  The packed earth pathway skirting the town's walls gives way to a cobbled street in the same dark grey stone as the lower half of the walls.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: The conifers of the forest have been cleared away near the stone walls of the town, providing space for the pathway.  Voices, hearty and reassuring, drift over the wall on the cold air.  It is pleasant to envision warm rooms and cozy fires, only a few steps away.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Gravel has been strewn over the earthen pathway to provide better footing.  What appears to be an odd discoloration of the wall is, upon closer inspection, the by-product of the birds who have been nesting in the mouth of a gargoyle protruding from the top of the wall.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Rising above the pathway which skirts the town are the blades of a windmill, which forms the southwestern corner of the town's wall.  The dark wood of the blades, as they turn to catch the wind, provides a sharp contrast to the light grey stone of the wall.

Rising above the pathway which skirts the town are the blades of a windmill, which forms the southwestern corner of the town's wall.  The dark wood of the blades, as they turn to catch the wind, provides a sharp contrast to the light grey stone of the wall.  A snow-covered path is completely blocked by a large stone barrier.

Rising above the pathway which skirts the town are the blades of a windmill, which forms the southwestern corner of the town's wall.  The dark wood of the blades, as they turn to catch the wind, provides a sharp contrast to the light grey stone of the wall.  Nearby, a snow-covered path leads toward a rustic hall, which looms above an icy courtyard.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: Along the edge of the forest, the pines give way to vine maples and bare-limbed oaks.  The pale branches of the deciduous trees look like spider webs against the deep green of the thick stand of pines.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: Snow crunches beneath your feet as you walk along the narrow path through the forest.  The air is cold and crisp, and filled with the sharp scent of pine.  Startled by your approach, an owl takes flight from the cover of a nearby tree.  It passes so close you feel the rush of air from its wings.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: A low, snow-covered branch juts into the pathway, causing you to duck your head to pass beneath it.  The ground beneath the trees is matted with fallen pine needles and traces of snow.  Small tracks lead off the main path, but disappear without a trace into the woods.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: The air is still, heavy with the closeness of the spruce and fir trees.  The movement of a bird or squirrel high above in the trees sends a cascade of snow from the upper branches down onto the path.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: The path curves to avoid a fir tree so wide you cannot stretch your arms even halfway around it.  The remaining trees around it seem dwarfed by its immense size, although they, too, tower high above you.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: The lowest branches of the trees have been cut away, allowing visibility further into the woods.  Beyond the first row of pines you can see the dark boles of another row of trees.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: A solitary wooden signpost stands at the head of a road leading southwest.  It marks the intersection with a smaller trail leading east and west.  Straw has been scattered on the snowy road, helping you maintain your footing as you continue on your way.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: You find yourself just southwest of the town of Icemule Trace where the trail continues through the dark forest.  A lumbering cart, filled with wood needed by the townspeople to heat their buildings, is being pulled northeast toward town.
tags: meta:mapname:Icemule Trace - Trail to Wehnimer's Landing
meta:mapshortname:Trail between Wehnimer's Landing and Icemule

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: The wide track leading to the clearing east of you is free of snow and has been pounded flat by the heavily-laden carts headed toward the southeast.  The forest is filled with the sound of heavy objects striking wood.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: Paw prints crisscross the faint trail, making random patterns in the freshly-fallen snow.  They are just the right size to be from some of the snow hares you saw earlier.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: A drooping pine tree stands to one side of the trail, its long branches sweeping downward to brush against the ice-crusted ground.  High overhead, the snow-tipped spires of the towering trees dance in the wind.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: A large branch is tightly wedged against a massive tree that has been uprooted and is lying across the southern path.  Powdery snow and slippery ice cover everything, making every step an effort.

wayto.2501: ;e if (UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait') or ((UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode != 'run') and ((XMLData.encumbrance_value > 50) or ((Skills.survival < 50) and not Spell['Haste'].active?))); sleep 0.2; echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 4; end; move 'north'

title: [Icemule Trail, Tree Path]
description: A snowy owl glides silently among the trees above the path, searching for a likely victim in the falling snow.  The ghostly figure suddenly dives, then rises--a tiny animal grasped in its talons--and quickly spirals up out of the trees and wings its way home.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tree Path]
description: A light snowfall has dusted the path that ends at the trunk of a massive, fallen tree.  Hardy lichen has taken root along the sides of the tree providing homes for the hardy northern bugs.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: A massive tree lies on its side across the trail -- branches piled against it to make it easier to clamber over.  You judge its girth to be about head high on a tall halfling -- or perhaps a bit higher.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: Heavy snow from the upper branches of the wind-blown trees plops wetly on the trail, creating little islands of slippery ice that impede your way.  It is impossible to avoid the falling snow which slips down your neck and seeps into your clothing, setting your teeth to chattering.

wayto.2505: ;e if (UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait') or ((UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode != 'run') and ((XMLData.encumbrance_value > 50) or ((Skills.survival < 50) and not Spell['Haste'].active?))); sleep 0.2; echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 4; end; move 'north'

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: Some relief from the howling wind that races across the tundra is found when the trail tapers off into the edge of the pines.  Powdery snow drifts silently from the sky, covering the deep forest like a soft blanket.

wayto.2508: ;e if (UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait') or ((UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode != 'run') and ((XMLData.encumbrance_value > 50) or ((Skills.survival < 50) and not Spell['Haste'].active?))); sleep 0.2; echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 4; end; move 'southwest'

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: The wintry marsh stretches boundlessly to the south and the east before ending in the far northeast where a thick pine forest blocks any further view.  What looks like elk tracks crisscross the snow-covered trail but are much larger than any you have ever seen before.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: The constant, fierce wind has wreaked havoc with the few trees that line the bank of the frozen river.  With branches bent low, they look as though they are bowing to the river in homage.

title: [Icemule Trail, Icy River]
description: Moving cautiously over the ice-covered river, you scan the marsh that seems to extend forever past the northern bank.  You might be able to traverse that quagmire by stepping from hummock to hummock, but truly dry land seems scarce.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: A sunbeam glints off a rock lying among many others scattered along the shore of the frozen river before you.  Across the river, which flows from the mountains and feeds the marsh, a few stubborn trees bravely line the bank.

A moonbeam glints off a rock lying among many others scattered along the shore of the frozen river before you.  Across the river, which flows from the mountains and feeds the marsh, a few stubborn trees bravely line the bank.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: A fierce wind blows across the marsh and straight through you.  Your teeth are chattering so hard you can be heard a mile away and if you shivered any worse, your bones would snap from the effort.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: The icy trail skirts the very edge of the deadly, partially frozen marsh.  Beside the trail lies the dead carcass of some unidentifiable animal--mute evidence that the marsh should be avoided at all costs.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: Large, granite boulders dot the landscape, left behind by the receding glacier sometime in the distant past.  Considering the size of the rocks, the power of the glacier that moved them must have been amazing.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: Small, dark holes pockmark the sloping sides of these hills and as you study the area, movement in one of the holes captures your attention.  Amid the multitude of tracks connecting the burrows, you spy signs that something heavy has been dragged through the snow.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: As you crest one of the larger foothills of the mountain range, you behold the vast, semi-frozen wasteland of the tundra spreading northward to the horizon.  The blowing snow makes progress difficult and adds to the urgency that tells you to push onward.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: The view is remarkable from your vantage point at the top of this plateau as you stop to rest.  You gaze north to find the snow-blown expanse of the tundra stretching as far as the eye can see.  To the southwest, the jagged magnificence of the Blue Glacier Mountains rises to great heights and embraces the clouds.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: If it were not for the rough sides of the narrow pass, you would surely lose your way in the blinding snow that swirls around you.  You grope your way forward, fervently praying you will live long enough to look back on this perilous journey.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: It is difficult to fathom how such a dangerous place can also offer beauty.  However, so it is when an occasional sunbeam peeks through the cloud cover, bathing the ice with rays of light that transform it into dazzling color.

It is difficult to fathom how such a dangerous place can also offer beauty.  However, so it is when an occasional moonbeam peeks through the cloud cover, bathing the ice with rays of moonlight that transform it into soft color.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: You are hardly aware of your surroundings as you slowly and painfully work your way through the treacherous mountains.  The mind-numbing cold clouds your thinking and you find you have been traveling for hours with no conscious thought.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: You pick your way carefully over the rocks heavily coated with ice as you push forward on your stone-bruised feet.  The snow clouds hang low over the rugged mountains, hiding the glacier tops from your view.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: All the climbing up and down over the icy rocks of this pass has exhausted you -- the bitter cold has taken its toll as well.  The ever-present wind with all its whistling and howling has come close to driving you mad.  What you wouldn't give for a hot bath, a good meal, and a tankard of mulled wine!

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: Staring at the grotesque, frozen foot of some poor soul protruding from beneath the rockslide tells you this mountain has been forsaken by the gods and is no fit place for man nor beast.  You glance furtively upwards, ever fearful that the rocks above will tumble down upon you.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: Ahead of you a mammoth rockslide has blocked the way.  You study the steep mountain slopes around you and wish, not for the first time, that you were part goat.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: Blowing snow makes the going tough and you hug the walls of the mountainside as you proceed cautiously along the rough trail.  Small rocks slip and slide beneath your feet, aided by the slickness of the wet snow.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowy Plains]
description: Massive boulders and rocks lie to the sides of the rough trail as it winds its way up into the majestic mountains.  The whistling wind has increased and even though you had not thought it possible, it has become colder.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowy Plains]
description: A tree of gigantic proportions dominates your view -- its massive trunk clawed and ripped away!  The huge tracks that cross the trail before you attest to the size of the beast that made them.

title: [Snowy Plains, White Ice Lake]
description: An ancient signpost sits amid a pile of rocks beside the ice-shrouded expanse of White Ice Lake.  Beyond the rough track leading north, the snowy rooftops of several small buildings can be seen peeking over the horizon.

title: [Snowy Plains, White Ice Lake]
description: The broken remains of an old, weather-beaten dinghy lies upon the lake shore.  It seems rather odd to find a boat of any kind beside a frozen lake, even a broken one.  You ponder on what possible use it might serve.

title: [Snowy Plains, White Ice Lake]
description: An old, deserted tavern sits to one side just off the trail, its door creaking back and forth in the wind.  Snow has drifted up over the roof of the dilapidated lean-to resting heavily against the other structure.  By all appearances, neither building should still be standing.

title: [Snowy Plains, White Ice Lake]
description: The driving snow has almost filled the animal tracks leading down the bank and out onto the ice.  A blur of movement far out on the frozen lake catches your eye but is just as quickly lost from view in the swirling snow.

title: [Snowy Plains, White Ice Lake]
description: There is nothing here but the blinding whiteness of the ice and snow--and the incessant wind.  Only careful concentration keeps your plodding feet on the almost nonexistent trail.  The prospect of straying out upon the frozen lake or into the barren wilderness strikes fear into many a soul!

title: [Snowy Plains, White Ice Lake]
description: It is bitterly cold and no shelter can be found as you continue to follow the trail along the shoreline of the enormous lake.  It has been a long while since you could feel your feet and you wonder if this torturous trek will ever end.  There is a small path leading off to the southwest, away from the main trail.

title: [Snowy Plains, White Ice Lake]
description: The snow-packed trail has led you to where the raging river feeds into White Ice Lake.  The roiling water sends huge ice chunks crashing together, some skittering and sliding across the frozen lake.

title: [Snowy Plains, The River]
description: Beside the trail, the river has become a torrent of rushing water.  Huge chunks of ice gnash forcefully together, spraying you with frigid droplets.  A formation of rocks points the way south toward a barely seen small path.

wayto.2534: ;e if (UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait') or ((UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode != 'run') and ((XMLData.encumbrance_value > 50) or ((Skills.survival < 50) and not Spell['Haste'].active?))); sleep 0.2; echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 4; end; move 'southeast'

title: [Snowy Plains, The River]
description: A loud crunching sound echoes through the air as you trudge forward through the ice-covered snow on the trail.  On the opposite bank, a fast moving stream empties noisily into the already swollen river.

wayto.2535: ;e if (UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait') or ((UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode != 'run') and ((XMLData.encumbrance_value > 50) or ((Skills.survival < 50) and not Spell['Haste'].active?))); sleep 0.2; echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 4; end; move 'east'

title: [Snowy Plains, The River]
description: Freshly fallen snow all but covers the faint trail as it hugs the banks of the icy river which flows swiftly past you.  The freezing wind whips about--stinging your face, jerking at your clothing and urging you to hurry on.

title: [Snowy Plains, Bridge]
description: Animal tracks can be seen crossing in front of you in the fallen snow covering the trail.  They seem to lead down to the river and disappear under the bridge.  Looking north, snow covered plains stretch on as far as you can see.

title: [Snowy Plains, Bridge]
description: A huge glacier can be seen to the south of you, its cracked and worn face a stark comparison to the flatness of the plains to the north.  An old, stone bridge stands to the north and crosses over the icy river.

title: [Glatoph, Shallow Gully]
description: Snow is piled in deep drifts and slows your movement through the gully.  By the edge of the river a large tree stands covered with ice.  Its branches, like skeletal arms, droop low giving it the appearance that it is waiting to catch something.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Ravine]
description: The icy walls stand just over your head giving some relief from the blowing wind.  Occasionally the wind gusts harder and sends a light spray of water in your face.  Covering your face to keep dry, you almost trip on some rocks that seem to be worn smooth by the force of the glacier.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Ravine]
description: The wind-carved walls of the ravine loom high above you in icy spires.  Several small passages can be seen leading off in different directions with one large passage to the southwest.  The river slowly flows by, heading north toward the plains.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Ravine]
description: Snow blown from the top of the glacier makes it difficult to see the trail.  Through the wind-driven snow, you glimpse the river continuing to roar past you as it winds its way down the ravine.  To the south, a large passage leads deep into the heart of the glacier.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Ravine]
description: The sound is almost deafening as the river breaks through the icy floor, keeping you near the walls for fear of falling into the frigid waters.  High above, an occasional chunk of ice breaks away from the lip of the glacier and splashes into the river.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: Small openings in the ceiling allow rays of light to shine in, illuminating the trail beneath you.  Being careful not to slip on the icy floor, you look down through thin ice and see what you can only assume to be the river, moving under your feet.

Small openings in the ceiling allow rays of moonlight to shine in, illuminating the trail beneath you.  Being careful not to slip on the icy floor, you look down through thin ice and see what you can only assume to be the river, moving under your feet.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: The wind blows strongly through the narrow passages leading into this area, creating a loud howling sound.  From time to time, there is a lull in the wind which allows you to hear a low rumble coming from the south.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: The ceiling seems too thin here, allowing a brief ray of light to enter the room and dance among the icicles stretching from above to meld with the floor.  The light reflects off the walls, forming a rainbow pattern the width of the room.

The ceiling seems too thin here, allowing a brief ray of moonlight to enter the room and dance among the icicles stretching from above to meld with the floor.  The light reflects off the walls, forming a rainbow pattern the width of the room.
