title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: The path continues and forms a spectacular ice bridge over a growing stream.  As you look down, the water cascades from a waterfall into a mist that shrouds an opening in the ice.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: The passage opens up into a large cavernous area with the stream running through the middle.  Icy stalactites hang all around you as you carefully walk through this forest of ice.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: Passages lead off in different directions with the largest heading to the north and south.  Water trickles into the room and joins forces with the ice cold stream before it heads out the south passage.  Above your head you see the outline of a creature frozen in the ice.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: The smooth ice walls of this passage narrow, forcing you to choose a path among the rocks in the stream.  Stepping from rock to rock, you perilously continue on the trail hoping not to slip and fall into the freezing water.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: Huge icicles are suspended from the ceiling and overhang the stream, dripping into its frigid waters.  The dripping sounds echo throughout this passage sending shivers down your spine.  Off to the south you see the passage widen.

title: [Glatoph, Icy Passage]
description: You are standing in the mouth of a large passage which heads off deep into the glacier.  A small, ice cold stream trickles past you and grows in size as other, smaller streams feed into it.

title: [Glatoph, Chasm Floor]
description: Trickles of water flow down the icy walls and gather in a pool.  Above you the chasm widens and a trail winds its way upward.  Off to the north, the trail heads into a large icy passage.  Flowing from the pool, a small stream runs down the ice and into the opening.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier Chasm]
description: The icy walls sparkle as rays of light from above reflect off of them, throwing a rainbow of colors down on you.  Off in the distance you can hear the faint sounds of running water.
The icy walls sparkle as rays of moonlight from above reflect off of them, throwing a rainbow of colors down on you.  Off in the distance you can hear the faint sounds of running water.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier Chasm]
description: Deep cracks can be seen in the icy walls surrounding you.  From this vantage point you can barely see the bottom of the chasm.  The howling of the strong winds above creates an eerie feeling as you continue along the trail.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier Chasm]
description: The snow blowing from the cliffs above makes it hard to see the half-hidden trail.  Heading upward, the trail widens as you reach the top of the glacier while the other end heads deeper into the chasm.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The way to the east ends in an icy abyss.  The chasm's bottom cannot be seen, and you move carefully away from the edge, hoping the wind will not shove you over and to your death.

The way to the east ends in an icy abyss.  Stinging snow and darkness make it impossible to see to the chasm's bottom, and you move carefully away from the edge, hoping the wind will not shove you over and to your death.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Further travel to the east is cut off by a large mountain.  The cliff provides some cover from the wind and snow, although not enough for you to feel secure from the cold.  Two ice totems stand facing the mountain, sentinels against some unknown threat.
Further travel to the east is cut off by a large mountain.  It provides some cover from the wind and snow.  Two ice totems stand facing the mountain.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: For a moment you feel cut off from the world you know.  All you can hear is the shrieking wind, sounding like an angry soul bemoaning its fate, and all you can see is blowing white snow.  With an effort you shake the feeling, although you cannot seem to warm the cold in your soul.

For a moment you feel cut off from the world you know.  All you can hear is the shrieking wind, sounding like an angry soul bemoaning its fate, and all you can see is blowing snow and shadow.  With an effort you shake the feeling, although you cannot seem to warm the cold in your soul.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Through the ice-laden gusts of wind you see a large crack in the ice.  Too large to cross and certainly large enough for you to fall into, it blocks the eastern path, forcing a detour to the southeast if you choose to travel that direction.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: To the north and northeast, you can barely see the outline of several towering mountain peaks.  The blasts of wind from that area are even colder than the rest, and are laden with sharp crystals of ice.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: You trip and nearly fall over an almost invisible mound of snow.  The visibility is awful here, and your eyes are sorely strained from peering through the snow brought by the freezing wind.

You trip and nearly fall over an almost invisible mound of snow.  The visibility is awful here, and your eyes are sorely strained from peering through the snow brought by the freezing wind.  You occasionally catch a glimpse of the cold brilliance of the stars, but they neither warm nor cheer you.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Vaguely, you can make out the shadow of a large snowy hill off to the southwest.  To the east, the nebulous shapes of smaller mounds can be seen, although peering through the harsh flurries makes your eyes smart and water.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Although the flying snow makes it difficult to tell, you seem to be going around a large hill.  Wind whips through the valley, the chill cutting straight to the bone.  You wonder briefly if you still have feet, or if they've frozen off.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The howling wind drives snow and ice into your face and clothing.  You can barely see three feet in front of you, and are forced to blink rapidly to clear your eyelashes of frost.  You can see vague shapes that look like hills about you, but it is hard to make anything out for certain.  The hill to the southwest might provide a bit of cover from the gale.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Two large totems of snow-covered ice stand here, side by side, before a large snowy hill.  They have been carved from the ice in shapes too intricate for the shrieking wind to have made and tower twenty feet into the air, as if marking this place, or posting a warning.  You shiver, not entirely from the cold, at the implication that something that large might not want you here.
Two totems of ice stand here, side by side, before a large snowy hill.  They have been carved from the ice and tower twenty feet into the air.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Ice crunches beneath your feet as you plod along the slope.  Mounds and hills of snow have been carved into eerie shapes by the ever present wind, bulges and hollows glistening.
Ice crunches beneath your feet as you plod along the slope.  Mounds and hills of snow have been carved into eerie shapes by the ever present wind, bulges and hollows glistening in the moonlight.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The side of the mountain is blanketed with white, the glittering ice and snow glaring into your eyes.  Everywhere you look is cold and white and bare, as though the whole world has frozen.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The ice glistens brilliant white, dazzling your eyes.  Frigid wind howls across the landscape, chilling you to the very marrow of your bones.  Upslope, to the west, you see a dark spot that might be a cave.  Even if it's not very deep, it might provide shelter for a while.

Upslope and to the west, you see a dark spot that might be a cave.  Even if it's not very deep, it might provide shelter for a while.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: This side of the mountain is covered with ice.  The ice field is almost big enough to be called a glacier, except that the conditions are all wrong for a glacier.  You suspect some sort of magic at work, and wonder at the wizard powerful enough to freeze half a mountain.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: A layer of frost covers everything, making the rocks slick and treacherous.  A lonely hawk glides through the clear sky, searching vainly for prey.
A layer of frost covers everything, making the rocks you can see in the faint light slick and treacherous.  A lonely owl glides through the clear sky, searching vainly for prey.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: The chill wind whips across the face of the mountain, scouring away what little soil is left and leaving bare rock.  A pair of stunted thorn bushes and some clingy grey-green moss are the only signs of life that you see.

The chill wind whips across the face of the mountain, scouring away what little soil is left and leaving bare rock.  A pair of stunted thorn bushes, their spikes silvered by moonlight, and some clingy greyish moss are the only signs of life that you see.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: Two side paths branch off of the main trail here, running east and west around the mountain.  The north-south path is steeper, but is wider and more deeply worn even so.  A cold wind blows in from the east, and you see signs of snow on the eastern slopes.  The western face seems a bit warmer -- you even fancy you glimpse some green grass in the distance in that direction.

paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Upper Trollfang, Foothills]
description: A lone modwir stands on this bare slope, its gnarled branches swept bare by the winds that whistle down from the mountains.  You feel dwarfed by the huge tree as you climb past it.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Foothills]
description: You're in a shallow depression between the hill to the south and the higher slope to the north.  A sheer cliff to the east and a gorge to the west prevent travel in those directions.  There's actually green grass in this hollow, protected as it is on three sides.  It might be a nice place to rest for a while.

The soft grass underfoot might make this a nice place to rest for a while if it weren't for the occasional sounds of large nocturnal scavengers going about their business.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Foothills]
description: From the top of this hill, you can look to the north and see the peak of the Glatoph, tallest and easternmost of the dragon's fangs in this range of mountains.  To the south and extending to the west you see the rest of the Trollfang range, fading into the hazy distance.

From the top of this hill, you can barely make out the peak of the Glatoph, tallest and easternmost of the dragon's fangs in this range of mountains.  The dark masses of the rest of the Trollfang range blot out the stars toward the western and southern horizons.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Foothills]
description: Your legs ache as you negotiate this steep path.  The trail winds around rocks and chasms and clumps of modwirs, the ground spongy with fallen needles.
Your legs ache as you negotiate the steep path, choosing your footing carefully in the darkness.  The trail winds around rocks and chasms and clumps of modwirs, the ground spongy with fallen needles.

title: [The Rift]
description: A cold, grey mist swirls around you, making it difficult to gain any sense of what is here.  Through the haze a huge, gnarled hand stretches upward reaching grimly for something past your vision.  As you move closer, it turns out to be only a dead tree, the bent and gnarled limbs twisting toward a blood eagle hovering just out of reach.

title: [The Rift]
description: A small wooden sign sits before you, ancient writing scrawled across the surface.  Just behind it, a huge pit extends deep into the ground.  An unusual silence hangs heavily over the area, broken occasionally by a metallic squeak from the pit.  Looking inside, you see thousands of small, grooved metal rods imbedded in the walls rotating slowly.  The further down the pit extends, the more narrow it becomes until you can see no more.

title: [The Rift]
description: A volcano erupts in the distance, spewing molten lava and ash all over.  The lava flies high into the air, carrying with it chunks of mountain and clouds of ash.  In the large crater the eruption created, you see figures moving about in the lava itself.  They splash in it and throw it on each other, howling and laughing.  Above the mountain, dark red birds of some kind dodge flying lava and debris, screeching in contentment.

title: [The Rift]
description: In the distance walks a tall man.  His robe is grey and tattered, but the frame beneath it remains strong.  Above his head floats the symbol of infinity, black and tarnished as the path he walks.  No matter how rapidly you proceed towards him, you cannot seem to catch him, although he moves no faster than a saunter.

title: [The Rift]
description: An immense structure stands before you, built of now-ruined white marble columns.  In the center sits a crumbling throne, flanked by two pillars.  Each may have had a symbol at one time, but ages of decay have erased any decoration.  Upon the throne sits a rotting zombie.  Her sightless eyes stare out into nothingness, and her feet have fallen into the bowl of the stone crescent at the base of her seat.

title: [The Rift]
description: Screaming wind tears through this area, filling the air with a dreadful howling.  Just ahead a cavern looms, offering a bit of solace from the biting wind.  As you move closer to the safehaven, you see that the cavern is actually the open mouth of a massive, long-fallen statue.

title: [The Rift]
description: A huge fountain of blood erupts from the ground here, gushing hundreds of feet into the air and raining back down hard.  At its apex, the thick fluid holds the pattern of a pair of eyes, watching your movements as you pass through.  The eyes hold your own a moment, and a wave of nausea passes over you. When it fades, they have wavered and fallen with their medium.

title: [The Rift]
description: Before you stands a large green house, with smoke billowing out the chimney and the windows broken out.  In front of the worn domicile, an older man and woman lie dead, chests slashed open and eyes staring sightlessly into the sky.  Above them stands a young man, resembling them.  He regards you in a cold, calculating manner, hand clenching and unclenching a bloody blade.

title: [The Rift]
description: A dilapidated yellow house sits just to the west of you.  It is surrounded by a small, white fence, and a pebble walkway flanked by withered flowers leads to the old domicile.  Sitting in the windowsill is a large, orange cat that looks at you with spectral eyes.  Just behind it is a small, ghostly girl with her hair in pigtails, stroking the fur of her long departed friend. She looks at you with large eyes, seeming to see through you into some other realm altogether.

title: [The Rift]
description: A graveyard lies before you.  Unlike a normal graveyard, however, the things that now rest here never were alive.  Hundreds of broken statues litter the field, some gazing sightlessly off into the distance, others reaching with stone hands up to whatever salvation waits for them beyond.  The forgotten relics' final resting place gives an eerie air to the surrounding areas, as if you could share their unfortunate fate.

title: [The Rift]

title: [The Rift]
description: Despair and desolation hang heavy in the air over the small plain before you.  Off in the distance, near the coast, what was once a small city lies smouldering in ruins.  The thick, black smoke from the razed hamlet lies heavy near the building tops, as if the weight of the carnage held it fast.  A huge stack of bodies is piled near the western gate, some of which almost look familiar.

title: [The Rift]
description: A battered wooden gate rests against the pitted stone walls surrounding a small city.  Mail-clad guards with pikes and heavy crossbows pace back and forth atop the walls.  Members of an invading force, beasts of burden, and captives travel the broken street leading into the remnants of town.  A bestial military squad drills on the rocky parade ground just inside the gate.  Fog obscures them as they march to and fro, and the gruff barks of their sergeant blend in with the din of the prisoners at the gate.

title: [The Rift]
description: Deep in the forest rests what was once a small shrine carefully carved of the butchered haon wood that surrounds you.  Screams and the violent falling of trees fill the air with a strong sense of destruction.  From somewhere nearby, the angry sound of a river rapids completes the unusual symphony.  Little else alters the disquiet save for an occasional muted plea drifting in on the breeze.

title: [The Rift]
description: Four banks of mist flow together, a distant scene forming within them.  A bustling town comes together in the square.  Halflings dressed in old style clothing stand about, some yelling angrily, others slain as they lay on their cloaks on the ground.  One ancient dark elf leans against the base of the large frozen statue of a pack animal, smirking arrogantly.

title: [The Rift]
description: Crimson veins run through the black marble of the walls of the throne room.  The streaks seem to pulse, as if it they were not streamers of red lacing the black stone, but actual arteries carrying blood through the rock.  Upon a massive, corroded silver throne sits a man whose eyes are pools of black essence.  They seem to pull the light into themselves, allowing no spark of brightness or hope to escape.  "Slaughter them," he is saying.  "Kill them all and leave their corpses for the maggots."

title: [The Rift]
description: The path is flanked on both sides by black water, thick and sluggish with salt.  A tiny boat is beached on the shore, but the waves and tide still reach beyond its bow.  As the waves break around it, the dinghy rocks slightly and shifts in the swirling, bubbling sand.  Two people relax in the boat, a young man and woman, talking and laughing. While they sit, however, the boat lurches sickeningly and begins to take on water.  They look sad, and stare into each other's eyes as the sea claims them.

title: [The Rift]
description: A small, faded festival tent has been set up in a patch of grass here.  The tent covers several long tables with cakes and pastries arranged on them.  Behind and to the sides of the tent, couples dance together, completely oblivious to your presence.  The crowd of revelers moves stiffly, like puppets under the hand of a new master. title: [The Rift]
description: A huge three-masted ship floats in midair here just above the ground, sails rippling gently in the slight breeze. title: [The Rift]
description: A huge cliff looms before you, stretching far into the sky above. title: [The Rift]
description: A stout wooden wall impedes your progress forward.  In the center of the wall, on a large yellowed parchment, is a poster. title: [The Rift]
description: A white pillar stretches up into the vast reaches of the dark sky here.  On either side of the enruned pillar are two full length mirrors, slowly rotating horizontally. title: [The Rift]
description: A beached ship lies in the middle of the field here, no clues or explanation as to how it arrived.  The once shiny maoral wood has dulled now with age, and the ship's ribs and masts have split and fallen.  The only passengers of the vessel are the rats, which number in the thousands. title: [The Rift]
description: The path you travel upon winds its way through the scrubby ground.  Amid the bushes hangs a man, suspended from his ankle.  His face is a purple crimson from the blood pooled within, and his eyes have rolled back into his head.  While this is not uncommon, perhaps more remarkable is the fact that the rope is anchored in the ground, and the man hangs upwards.

title: [Birthing Sands, Cavern of Ages]
description: This part of the cavern seems intimate after the expansiveness just around a bend of the red stone.  Recesses all along the east wall give the rock a filigreed appearance which belies the vast size of each enclosure.  The fine sand is a constant carpet, however, the light it expends is much dimmer here, fading to a soft twilight within the eastern niches.  To the south, the walls swirl to create an oval passageway into another cavern where more of the recesses can be glimpsed.

title: [Breach, Cavern of Ages]
description: The chamber's walls are modulated with the same large recesses that pocket the walls of the chamber to the north.  Inside each, the red stone is polished to an indulgent surface that highlights the striations in the rock.  On the cavern's eastern wall however, something went horribly wrong.  The undulating niches are blasted into shambles around a central oval just behind a golden pedestal with a nebulous sphere hovering above it.  There, the rock appears to have melted, running down the cavern wall in eddies of molten stone.

title: [Heated Sands, Cavern of Ages]
description: After the bitter, numbing cold of outside, the luxuriousness of warm air is all encompassing.  Then the surroundings creep upon one's consciousness, like a panoramic view emerging as fog lifts.  Red stone walls arch in ridges overhead, reminiscent of an immense rib cage.  The cavern's higher regions are remote and dark, however, soft light radiates from a fine, ivory-colored carpet of sand that stretches from wall to wall.  Heat rises from the sand as well, lending a shimmering quality to the air.

wayto.2635: northeast

title: [Horde, Cavern of Ages]
description: An amazing pile -- more a mountain really -- of old chests and boxes inhabits this region of the cavern, rising up out of the drifts of fine sand, a monumental refuse heap of riches that have vanished.  The boxes are apparently empty, most of them gaped open and lying upon each other in various stages of decay like fallen soldiers.  Not even the tarnished hardware avoids the appearance of desolation.

title: [Lake of Tears]
description: The warm water of the lake churns in the grip of strong currents.  Tossed by the confluence, water droplets spray into the air above the waves, creating shimmering rainbows in the low cavern light.  The bank of the lake beckons with its promise of solid ground, while below, the depths descend into shifting shadows.

title: [Lake of Tears]
description: Currents roil the tepid water, with bits of debris and sand caught in a hectic dance.  Overhead, light filters down in shifting beams, which flicker at the mercy of the water's movement.  A shadowy opening creates a fissure in the rock walls, and below that, the lake descends into darkness.

title: [Lake of Tears]
description: The currents kick up sand into a shifting curtain.  Light from above barely intrudes, splicing into the gloom in weak shafts, which flicker as the currents assault them.  An array of curved spines rises out of the sands on the lake's floor, looking like a huge arching fan in the wavering shadows.

title: [Water Tunnel]
description: Turbulence heaves the water into a nightmarish beast, smashing against the rough rock walls of the dark tunnel and then rolling over itself in a roaring fury.  Vague light ventures in at either end of the confining passageway, but quickly fades as if in deference to the currents' delirious momentum.

The roar of water crashing against the rock walls of the tunnel is deafening, its voice a low rumble that penetrates the rock where the water, for all its fury and force, cannot reach.  At each end of the watery maelstrom, low light filters in.  However, the violent cascade filling the passageway obscures what little illumination can be seen.

The currents careen through the hollow rock in a rampage.  It's impossible to tell if they follow a specific course, or merely churn and rage through the tunnel in an unending assault against the confining walls.  Light is barely visible at each end of the subterranean passage, however, a strange phosphorescence outshines it, glowing from the rock walls with an unearthly emerald light.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [The Rift]
description: A circular marble pillar sits in the middle of a room with thick grey tapestries for walls.  Above this pillar floats a large skull that appears to be serpentine or lizardlike in nature, slowly rotating in a sphere of blue energy.  The skull rotates, morphing into an elven one, then gently spinning again and changing into a human one, then a krolvin skull, then a giant one, and finally back to the serpent one.

title: [The Rift]
description: A marble wall stretches for some distance to either side of you.  In the center of the wall hangs a golden scale, with a small shelf on either side of it.  On each of the shelves lies a shiny razor and a white towel.  The bowls of the scales are spotless, although they have a slight coppery odor.

title: [Pool]
description: The depths churn with ferocious tenacity, tossing everything within its embrace like leaves caught in a wind.  Directions are difficult to ascertain, and even the brave beams of light filtering down into the morass seem to bend and stretch in response the currents' vicious onslaught.  Through a momentary lull in the flux, the rough surface of the rock wall of the pool is revealed, scarred by pits and depressions.

wayto.2642: ;e fput 'search wall'; move 'swim crevice'; sleep 1; waitrt?

title: [Pool]
description: The water is a startling shade of cerulean blue, edged with deeper blue shadows.  It moves vigorously, tossing itself over and under, and throwing sprays of drops high into the air at the command of hidden currents.  Above the pool, a large finger of stone extends over the pool, casting a shadow on the waves below it.  Standing behind the pool's rim, a throne can be seen, sitting silently as if meditating on the movement of the water.

title: [Altar of the Elder]
description: The ledge is more generous than it appeared from the lower stone platform, which now looks extremely narrow and far below.  The view from here of the monumental ice sculpture reveals its top to be as superbly detailed as its other aspects.   Incongruously, a pool of clear, sapphire-colored water lies between the ledge and an immense statue of a sleeping drake, its recumbent body curled around a large throne on the pool's northern edge.

title: [Dais of Ice]
description: The mist from the pool lays a fine sheen on the ice covering the dais, making footing a risky business at best.  Above, the huge carved head of the drake slumbers in its stony impassivity.  The great eyes are closed, each immaculately carved with rows of spikes along the rims of the eyelids.  Fans on either side are tucked gracefully along the dragon's jaws, reaching back toward the shoulders.  Steps continue a northeast ascent toward a narrow ledge at the beast's feet.

title: [The Dragon Sleeps]
description: An elaborate throne sits before the swirling water of the pool.   The thing is so large it would dwarf the tallest giantman.  However, the huge shape of the stone drake behind it makes the chair look small and fragile.  It seems to be made of the same stone as that of the wyrm, and its ornamentation is a mantle of carved, interlocking sigils.  Incised upon the throne's backrest is a crown within a circle.

title: [Drake's Neck, Ice Shrine]
description: Large spines along the neck are half laid back in a posture that accents the statue's somnolent pose.  The neck muscles are pronounced, making the carved scales undulate.  As a result, the footing here is hazardous at best, but the neck spines provide a welcome handhold.  The neck curves west toward the head, and east in a more dangerous climb, up the beast's back.

title: [Drake's Back, Ice Shrine]
description: The drake's back is a mere span away from the ceiling, giving a panoramic view of the shrine and its central mass of ice.  Like the neck, the beast's back is ridged with spines that are dropped into a near-horizontal attitude.  The great wings are furled close to the body, and a finger-like claw is visible at the tip of each.

title: [Drake's Haunch, Ice Shrine]
description: The bunched muscles of the beast's haunch are partially obscured by the huge, closed wings.  A narrow passage between the body and wing leads down to the drake's foot.  To the east, the tail curls around like an ice-covered promenade, its furthest point obscured in shadow.

title: [Drake's Toe, Ice Shrine]
description: The drake's toe is as big around as a dwarf's belly and twice again as long.  It culminates in a formidable, curved claw.  Standing here, one is prompted to contemplate just how vulnerable would be this perch, was the dragon to draw breath and awaken.

title: [Drake's Tail, Ice Shrine]
description: The spines characteristic of the stone drake's neck and back continue down the length of its tail, although here, the spikes are shorter and more barbarously sharp.  The prospect of carving stone into a point as keen as any rendered in steel is daunting, yet here a whole row of them stands like a honed ridge of deadly pikes.

title: [Drake's Tail, Ice Shrine]
description: The tip of the drake's tail concludes in a barbed horn that is poised directly over the rippling surface of the spring-warmed pool.  A temperate column of air rising from the water envelops the scaled extremity and leaves the stone free of ice, but slippery nonetheless from the constant moisture.

title: [Drake's Head, Ice Shrine]
description: Monstrous brow ridges glower over blank, stone eyes.  Then the muzzle tapers down to ridged nostrils and a generously toothed mouth.  The monumental drake possesses a sense of tension, exhibited in each curve of carved muscle.  The level of sculpted detail is astounding, as if a living, breathing creature had been caught in slumber and sentenced to lie here for all eternity, imprisoned within its own magnificent form.

title: [Drake's Eye, Ice Shrine]
description: Again, one is moved to marvel at the superb workmanship epitomized by this statue.  A lattice of delicate veins trace a pattern across the eyelid, making it seem that the eye could open at any moment.  Each masterfully rendered eyelash framing it is sheathed in ice, like frozen tears collected along the eye's fringe.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: To the northwest, a flight of steps leads up, so icy that climbing their hazardous incline seems an impossible feat.  Above the course of steps, a dais is visible below a ridge.  Strange flickers of reflected light bounce off the icy walls above and around the dais, as if the low light were rebounding off water.  To the south, the huge, sculpted mountain of ice exudes a constant wave of brutal cold, as if it was exhaling the wilderness of rime encasing the ancient edifice.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: The ice coating the platform flows unbroken into the nave's huge iceberg, a seamless sweep of graceful spirals that eventually merge with a monumental figure towering above.  There, a dragon plummets from the sky, its wings trailing behind it like tattered streamers.  Icy shafts protrude from the drake's neck and body and rivulets of ice seep from the wounds.  The form hovers moments before impact, its features a study of agony and at the same time, resignation to the finality of its endless fall.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: To the northeast, a flight of steps leads up, so icy that climbing their hazardous incline seems an impossible feat.  This platform is totally encased in a frozen sheet that muffles sound and reflects light in a glistening shimmer.  Above the treacherous ascent, a ledge is visible - and towering above that, a monstrous, serpentine figure reclines, its head and tail forming a protective curve around the ice-sheathed dais.

title: [Stone Font, Ice Shrine]
description: The octagonal room boasts the familiar double columns standing guard around its walls, crowned with elaborately adorned capitals.  In the chamber's center stands a stone font.  Its base is supported with a spiral of small, carved dragonettes cavorting in a winged torrent that sweeps up from the floor.  A thin trickle of water from the font sends soft echoes bouncing off the columns, like the sound of a solitary brook.

title: [Vaulted Aisle West, Ice Shrine]
description: The symmetry of the long aisle flanked by columns shifts as it veers to the northeast.   The high, inset windows stop as the hallway's curve is initiated, however, reflected light from the frozen mountain of ice shines in through the spaces between the interior columns, illuminating the colors of frescos decorating the exterior walls.  An alcove can be glimpsed to the northeast.

The symmetry of the long aisle flanked by columns shifts as it veers to the northeast.  The high, inset windows stop as the hallway's curve is initiated, however, reflected moonlight from the frozen mountain of ice shines in through the spaces between the interior columns, illuminating the colors of frescos decorating the exterior walls.  An alcove can be glimpsed to the northeast.

title: [Dance of the Drakes, Sunset]
description: A walkway curves around the massive slab of ice crouched in the center of the nave, its crown hidden in the shadows of the tall, arched ceiling.  Where the flagstones meet the formation's foot, the rocks are cracked, yet they still retain their uniform plane.  The sculpture changes as the walkway circles it, transforming from a single drake to the contorted forms of two of the great beasts in flight.  Their bodies are twisted about each other, with only the four grand wings free to maintain flight.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Vaulted Aisle West, Ice Shrine]
description: The colonnaded aisle traverses the central nave, with its omnipotent ice sculpture.  The walls within the long, curved hallway are tall and inset with narrow, rectangular windows placed high, so that beams of light play down on the ice-covered flagstones in distinct ovals.  The repeated columns march away into the shadows, creating a steady rhythm of modulating, ice-covered surfaces, caught in the grip of the implacable cold.

The colonnaded aisle traverses the central nave, with its omnipotent ice sculpture.  The walls within the long, curved hallway are tall and inset with narrow, rectangular windows placed high, so that beams of moonlight play down on the ice-covered flagstones in distinct ovals.  The repeated columns march away into the shadows, creating a steady rhythm of modulating, ice-covered surfaces, caught in the grip of the implacable cold.

title: [Sunset Alcove, Ice Shrine]
description: The alcove is octagonal, its perimeter surrounded by a row of double columns boasting highly decorated capitals supporting likewise elegantly carved entablatures.  On the eastern wall is a cistern, into which drops of water fall from somewhere in the shadows of the high ceiling.  The droplets send a stately drum of sound into the chamber's hollow silence.

title: [Chamber of the Maw, Ice Shrine]
description: The chamber's center aisle is spanned by an impressive pointed barrel-vault, emphasizing the ceiling's lofty height.  Light falls at the north end, illuminating a twisted form of ice so large, it reaches to the ceiling, as if lifting arms of ice in supplication.  Where the massive ice form begins, side aisles branch to the northwest and northeast.  Curiously, the frozen formation resembles a gigantic dragon's head, its mouth open to reveal curved teeth taller than a giantman.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Dance of the Drakes, Sunrise]
description: The aisle works its way around the glacial mass, growing narrow then wide with the permutations of the ice.  The single, massive drake guarding the nave's approach has transmuted into a large adult, surrounded by a brace of smaller wyrms flying in perfect symmetry beneath the adult's outstretched wings.  The three spiral up towards the ceiling high above in a silent, joyful dance, looking as if they are caught in the space of a heartbeat, frozen for the ages.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [Dragon's Hoard, Ice Shrine]
description: Although the octagonal chamber isn't small, the aisle through it is crowded and difficult to navigate.  The room's center is dominated by a large sculpture depicting a pile of treasure so lifelike, only the dull surface of the stone reveals it as a fabrication.  Piles of exactingly carved coins spread in all directions, punctuated with strands of pearls and all manner of jewelry and fanciful armor.  On its summit rests a drake, rendered in a lazy and contented repose.

title: [Vaulted Aisle East, Ice Shrine]
description: The vaulted hallway veers to the northwest, marked by an increase of shadow in that direction as the reflections from the ice behemoth are less ambient.   This part of the hallway is notable for its rich frescos that alternate with the columns on the aisle's exterior walls.  Overhead, the ceiling's elevated arch is as graceful as a heron's wing poised for flight.

title: [Vaulted Aisle East, Ice Shrine]
description: The colonnaded aisle traverses the central nave.  Rectangular windows set high in the tall exterior walls throw oval pools of light down onto the frozen flagstones.  On either side, rows of columns stretch away into the shadowy interior like silent guardians made of ice.  To the west, glimpses of the huge frozen formation alternate with the double row of columns.

The colonnaded aisle traverses the central nave.  Rectangular windows set high in the tall exterior walls throw oval pools of moonlight down onto the frozen flagstones.  On either side, rows of columns stretch away into the shadowy interior like silent guardians made of ice.  To the west, glimpses of the huge frozen formation alternate with the double row of columns.

title: [Sunrise Alcove, Ice Shrine]
description: The octagonal alcove is surrounded by a row of double columns.  On the west wall, between an arch of alternating red and black stone and a high doorway, stands a frieze of carved felines.  Three pairs of lions rampant, each with hind paws planted on the ground and forepaws on the back of his companion stand in the icy shadows like silent guardians.  They depict an attitude of strength at first glance, but the curling tongues of ice-covered flame licking at their backs impart a whiff of evil.

title: [Domed Entry Hall, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs culminate in an entry hall, little more than a glorified landing replete with sculpted stone.  Stairwells curving down to the southeast and southwest converge at a double column surmounted by capitals carved in high relief.  Opposite the trumeau, two arches, crafted of alternating dark and reddish-toned granite blocks, open to the northeast and northwest.  Over every surface, the relentless sheath of ice gives a reflective coating that is as lovely as it is precarious.

title: [East Stair, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs curve up toward the west, dark with shadow and treacherous with ice.  The stone of the outside walls is heavily carved in bas-relief.  Overhead, the ceiling is a distant, shadowy pool of darkness, but the intricate detail of the carved walls can be glimpsed reaching past the point of sight in a rich landscape of embellishment.

title: [Antechamber, Hill of Ice]
description: An anteroom is flanked with arches to the left and right.  The walls are dark stone, rising overhead to a peak that follows the curve of the vaulting.   Footing is hazardous, owing to the sheet of ice coating everything with its brittle, glistening veneer.  Through the arches, courses of stairs can be glimpsed, composed of the same dark stone and filled with shadows.

title: [West Stair, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs curve up toward the east, dark with shadow and treacherous with ice.  Along the outside wall, friezes follow the ascent, providing a rich panorama of dense detail that adds to the menace of the ice, adding the temptation of studying the carved stone instead of the ice-covered steps.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Whirling snow is tinted an incongruous rose color by the low arctic light.  Then, a lull in the wind offers a breathtaking vision!  Mantled by the storm's flurry, a monument perches on the mountain's top, immense in size and of extraordinary beauty.  Columns march across the facade, their tops almost lost in the clouds, framing a colossal door.  Beside the door, a shining gold crown is mounted in bas-relief, erratically throwing out brilliant reflections as light fights through the fog to caress it.

Whirling snow is tinted silvery grey by the low arctic moonlight.  Then, a lull in the wind offers a breathtaking vision!  Mantled by the storm's flurry, a monument perches on the mountain's top, immense in size and of extraordinary beauty.  Columns march across the facade, their tops almost lost in the clouds, framing a colossal door.  Beside the door, a gold crown is mounted in bas-relief, erratically throwing out muted reflections as moonlight fights through the fog to caress it.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Clouds merge with blowing snow and an uncertain horizon.  Courageous patches of light randomly filter through the wind, sparkling off the frozen path and then fraying back into the haze as if devoured.  The way curves to the northwest around a wall of stone, encrusted with ice that almost obscures its carved surface.  To the northeast, a trail, little more than packed ice, snakes across a narrow ledge which is almost obscured by a dense shower of blowing snow.
