title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The trail ends in a redoubt created by immense formations of ice.  Snow rains down in sheets, like a frozen waterfall cascading down from above in slow motion.  What remains of the trail meanders down to the northeast, fraught with dangerous patches of ice and irregular outcrops of stone, which wait for an unwary footfall to offer up disaster.

wayto.2678: ;e 8.times { if celerity = Spell[506] and celerity.known? and celerity.affordable? and not celerity.active?; celerity.cast; end; dothistimeout 'search', 3, /You make a careful search of the area and discover a narrow icy ledge!|You don't find anything of interest here./; break if move 'go ledge' }

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Ice and snow whirl around in a shifting dance, caressing the mountainside then racing away in a cloud which leaves a majestic view of the arctic plains in its wake.  In the far distance, the tiny forms of a couple of polar bears cavort in a patch of sunlight.  The bears roll and tumble in play, until they are swallowed up along with the horizon in the persistent blizzard.  A trail winds to the northwest and southwest in a dangerous bend that traverses gaps and stone outcroppings.

Ice and snow whirl around in a shifting dance, caressing the mountainside then racing away in a cloud which leaves a majestic view of the moonlit plains in its wake.  In the far distance, a pair of snowy owls patrols the night sky, until they are swallowed up along with the horizon in the persistent blizzard.  A trail winds to the northwest and southwest in a dangerous bend that traverses gaps and stone outcroppings.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The horizon is painted with shifting color, strange flickers playing in the clouds like distant lightning tinted with a monumental paintbrush.  Underfoot, a small cliff is formed by a rock outcropping.  It narrows into a trail which leads up to the southeast.  Another narrow trail leads northwest from a ledge below, and beyond that, the mountainside extends down in a dizzying fall.

The horizon is painted with layers of clouds, waves of grey upon black roiling across the sky.  Underfoot, a small cliff is formed by a rock outcropping.  It narrows into a trail which leads up to the southeast.  Another narrow trail leads northwest from a ledge below, and beyond that, the mountainside extends down in a dizzying fall.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: A small ledge marks the end of a poor excuse for a trail, which winds down the mountainside to the northwest.  Snow flurries keep the way pristine with a slick coating.  Overhead, low clouds conceal everything beyond a close pocket of vision, however, another small ledge is visible within climbing distance.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The trail winds steadily downward toward the west, riven by ice and boulders, and endlessly flailed by the wind.  To the southeast, a narrower track climbs up, skirting large outcrops of ice, and finally accesses a small ledge above.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The winds roar around the peak like banshees frenzied by the ruthless winter.  To the northwest, the slope descends, bearing the path upon its back as if it would shake off the interloper at the first opportunity.  In an eastern direction, the trail levels off a bit before it begins to climb around the steep slope in a precarious cant.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The full fury of the winter wind hurls needle-sharp spicules of ice against the mountain, shearing the rock of any gentle drifts of snow here on an exposed ledge.  As if retreating from the onslaught, the trail doglegs, descending to the south and climbing up the slopes in a southeast direction.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The cold wracks the cliff with ice-laced wind.  A strange rainbow flickers through the cloud cover, tinting the haze in a diffused glow.  The trail rises to the north and seems to disappear into a cloud bank as the way crooks to follow the mountain.  To the south, a large outcrop of rock forces the ledge into a southwest curve around the snowy rock.

The cold wracks the cliff with ice-laced wind.  Pale, wavering moonlight flickers through the cloud cover, tinting the haze in a suffused glow.  The trail rises to the north and seems to disappear into a cloud bank as the way crooks to follow the mountain.  To the south, a large outcrop of rock forces the ledge into a southwest curve around the snowy rock.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The scarred face of the glacier is dotted with rock and an occasional collection of bones, shriven by the wind to a white as pure as the snow.  The path curves northeast, skirting a large rock and ice outcrop.  To the south, it meanders through a field of snow-covered boulders strewn across the head of the glacier like pebbles, making the track more haphazard and dangerous.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: A massive glacier decends the western mountain face, carving enormous canyons as it flows.  The path works its way around the head of the glacier, weaving through the avalanche scarred terrain.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Bitter gusts of wind drive clouds of loose snow up from an icy slope to the south.  The slope descends amidst jagged cliffs, at the bottom of which the faint image of a trail can be seen.  Overhead, large snowdrifts threaten to dislodge at the slightest opportunity.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Wind driven flurries of snow keep vision poor.  Further down the southern face an immense arch is barely visible through the snow.  A narrow trail follows the base of the cliff wall, starting at an icy slope then running towards the northeast.  The slope climbs upwards among the cliffs until it is lost in the clouds.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Footing is treacherous as winds blast the mountainside relentlessly.  On the north side of the trail lifeless frozen cliffs tower ominously.  The southern edge drops straight into nothingness until lost into the snowstorms below.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Rocks and chunks of ice litter the narrow trail, left behind from a previous avalanche or signs of one to come.  Overhead, more threaten to dislodge as the elements continually erode the cliff face.  A barren, icy slope stretches down to the south, dissappearing out of sight.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The trail is little more than a narrow ledge, hugging the cliff walls as it winds its way around the mountain.  Further down to the southeast a small plateau emerges from the haze.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Large snaps and cracks accompany the wind howling out of the jagged break trailing its way up the canyon floor towards the heart of the peak.  The cacophonic symphony foretells destruction for those unlucky enough to fall or be blown off the narrow trail following the edge of the crevasse.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: A small ledge provides an icy stage from which to view the vast panorama of storm-swept tundra.  Here and there, smudges show the location of roving bears and mammoths, which are soon swallowed up in the shifting storm fronts.  The snowy shelf is backed by a sloping formation which appears to be solid ice, with a jagged crevice along one side.  A path leads to the northeast, where a trail is visible through the flurries.

title: [Top of the World, Ice Cave]
description: The ice cave is bright with reflected light shining through the walls.  A fire pit is centered beneath walls that curve up to the ceiling in a dome.  Out of the driving wind, the small enclosure seems surprisingly snug.  A few rough skins are rolled in a pile toward the cave's further corners, too ragged to be worth anything, but still offering warmth in an emergency.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The great chasm turns into the mountainside, wedging itself in between two tall bluffs, creating a small ledge along the southern wall.  A small footpath follows the overhang created by the massive cliffside, edging right up against the deep canyon.  Icy spots glisten brightly as light bounces off the far side of the wide crevasse, the only cheery sight in this otherwise bleak wasteland.

The great chasm turns into the mountainside, wedging itself in between two tall bluffs, creating a small ledge along the southern wall.  A small footpath follows the overhang created by the massive cliffside, edging right up against the deep canyon.  Icy spots twinkle faintly as moonlight bounces off the far side of the wide crevasse, the only cheery sight in this otherwise bleak wasteland.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Loud cracking and groaning knifes through the arctic air, spilling out of the dangerous crevasse with alarming regularity.  The canyon makes a sharp turn as it skirts the edges of Aenatumgana intent at finding a way to split the mighty peak in two.  Black rock spears up out of the solid ice in a failing attempt at creating a windbreak against the fury of the shrieking winds.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: A deep crevasse slices its way across the face of the titanic mountain, tearing further into the glacier with every shift of the moving ice.  Great walls of ice break off and tumble down into the frozen canyon.  Several seconds pass before the crash of the blocks hitting bottom can be heard over the winds.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Piles of black stones act as trailmarkers strung out to the southeast and southwest, marking the least treacherous path up the mountainside.  Deep rumbles can be heard with alarming regularity as massive snowslides flatten anything in their path, knocked loose by loud noises and the relentless arctic wind.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: High winds battered the north face of Mount Aenatumgana, breaking off chunks of rock constantly, forming a cliff that towers over a thousand feet into the sky.  Sleet and snow cling doggedly to the crag, making an assault to reach the summit impossible from this vantage.  Stinging ice hammers into the lower corners of the cliff, breaking loose anything without solid roots and blowing away snow trying to cling to the little protection offered by the rock.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: A wide split in the glacier is spanned by a bridge of rock and ice that shakes and shudders wildly whenever the frozen river shifts.  In the chasm far below the expanse, a slick floor strangely resembles an alpine toboggan run.  Towering cliffs to the south encourage travelers to find another way up the mountain.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The great glacier grinds its way down the canyon, pulverizing rock and mountain alike.  An icy slope serves as the leading edge to the mighty frozen river inching its way towards the flats of the polar cap.  Deep tracks in the permafrost hint at creatures eking out an existence in this bitter climate.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The makeshift trail that leads back to the tundra comes to a halt at the bottom slope of a gigantic glacier, dwarfed only in size by the mountain itself.  Further up the glacier, the going gets even rougher, with piles of rock frozen in place to mark the way across the ice.  Deep rumbles shake the ground as the ice grinds its way down the steep grade.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Jet black stones, blasted smooth by the constant force of the ice and snow, rise out of the frozen landscape.  Charred, frozen hunks of coal sit in the lee of one of the great stones.  They once served to cook a traveler's tiny meal, now held captive by a sheet of clear ice.  The rocks bear chip marks at their base, telling a tale of a desperate attempt to gain freedom from the arctic cold.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Clutching to either side of a deep split in the snowfield, a narrow ice bridge remains as the sole survivor of an avalanche crashing into a cliff face.  Black boulders stick out of the blindingly white freeze, trying desperately to add some color to the bleak landscape.  Long scratches start at the middle of the bridge stretching down its side towards the gorge, ending at a climber's pick half buried in the ice.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: On the southern face of the mountain, a break in the jagged cliffs reveals a steep sluice that in more reasonable climbs would be a challenging ski slope.  Heavy blankets of snow line either side of the slope, jammed in between two imposing ridges caked with black ice.  Only the most foolhardy would attempt to scale the high bluffs.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Small steps hacked out of the side of the mountain lead down, providing meager protection from the howling gales on the slopes.  High above, cornices hang dangerously low, shuddering with each renewed gust of wind.  Packed ice and snow make assaults on the peak slow at best, fatal at worst.  Blocks of ice the size of buildings lie in heaps at the bottom of the western slope, a testament to the power of the titanic avalanches that ravage the mountain.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: An immense arch of ice battles to remain standing against the ravages of the wind.  Through the makeshift gateway, the open expanses of the frozen tundra provide little protection from the chilling temperatures.  The treacherous slopes of Mount Aenatumgana tower above the flats, the peak of the gigantic mountain invisible through the blowing sleet and snow.  Two sets of frozen steps, carved out of the mountainside, lead up to the precarious east and west approaches to the summit.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: At the northwestern edge of a small elevated plateau, winds swirl angrily in no particular direction.  A narrow path leads into the shadows northeast between jagged rock walls, and steps carved into the ice lead haphazardly down towards the arch to the southwest.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The southern edge of the plateau ends abruptly with a steep drop-off.  Far below to the west stands the hazy image of an arch of ice.  Further out a vast white wasteland stretches out until it's lost in the snow storms.  In the absence of wind breaks, the bitter gales blow fiercely.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The plateau narrows and finally comes to a stop.  A sheer cliff rising towards the summit seals off the north, and the southwestern edge of the plateau is a steep precipice.  The ground below is lost amidst clouds of swirling snow.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Cavern walls rise out of sight all around the small clearing, except for a narrow path that leads to the southwest.  Winds screech as they blast through the area, looking for escape.  High on the north wall a trail leads upwards to the east and disappears over the other side of the wall to the west.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The end of the ravine is blocked off to the south by a sheer wall of ice.  Despite the gorge's relative isolation, it provides little shelter from the elements.  Furious winds blast down the steep canyon faces, driving blinding sheets of ice and snow.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Jagged cliffs seal off most of this end of the ravine.  A steep trail leads to the east at a sharp angle, climbing the wall that isolates the area.  The trail is extremely narrow and appears treacherous at best.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: About halfway up a steep slope, a small ledge stands exposed to the bitter elements, cleared of snow by the driving blasts of wind.  A trail to the west skirts the icy wall into a ravine below, and to the north a path winds its way up the rock-littered slope.  Both directions appear extremely dangerous.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The slope levels out here at the base of a trail headed to the north.  To the south the slope grows considerably steeper, and a path treacherously winds its way down.  The weather shows no signs of letting up.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The monotonous white terrain of this area is only broken by what appears to be a well-worn path littered with tracks of some unidentified creature.  Sunken deep into the cold wet snow, the tracks seem to vanish behind a small mound of ice, though there is no trace of habitation anywhere.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The glaring whiteness of the snow has been stained a grimy drab gray color on this leg of the path.  Oily flakes have mottled almost every inch of the landscape here, though there is no evidence of anything that could have been their origin.  The wind whips the ashes about, making breathing difficult in the bitter-cold air.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Ferocious winds blast down the icy path.  Shaded almost entirely by a wall of solid ice, the slick path is treacherous and as cold as a banshee's breath.  The wall curves high overhead like a wave, forever frozen in a grotesque parody of an aquatic swell.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Sharp chunks of ice maliciously pierce the frozen ground like a dagger through its heart, creating deep fissures that render the trail slow and dangerous.  Other icy chunks seem to take on macabre shapes that stir the imagination with images only found in the most horrid of nightmares.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: A dull pale-blue hue emanates from a massive wall of ice, drawing attention to its surface.  Smooth as glass, the outer layer of ice is seamless except for a section of it that seems to have been cut out and removed.  In the depression is a deformed snowman, its face frozen in a comical expression.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The wind seems to have increased its already cruel velocity as the wall of ice recedes.  Strong eddies have whipped the ice and snow around to form several deep drifts.  A foot of snow covers most of the ground, but some larger drifts could easily cover a large troll.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: A shallow depression cuts into the side of the mountain, however, it offers little cover from the raging elements.  There is evidence of a few frozen remains of an old fire pit -- next to the remains of whoever built it.  The pitiful heap of ice-sheathed rags reclines in an endless sleep.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The biting wind howls incessantly over a sharp precipice, whipping jagged pieces of ice around brutally. Deep indentations have been etched into the surface ice covering the precipice from the ferocity of the wind.  High overhead, several large icicles look dangerously close to falling from a small outcropping.

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The frozen tundra comes to an end here, at an arch of ice standing defiantly against the savage elements.  The arch leads into the largest mountain in the world, beyond it steps lead up the mountain before disappearing from sight.  To the west, the wasteland stretches on endlessly.

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: Stretching higher than can be seen, the great frozen peak rises into the sky.  The southern face appears treacherous at best, jagged ice and rock rise in a steep slope until fading out of sight.  The swirling snow and wind keep the vision a blur, but it appears to meet the tundra to the east.

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The massive mountain rises before the plains, dwarfing all before it.  A glacier descends its western edge, making access to it from here impossible.  Snow covered tundra stretches out to the east, west, and south.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The winds are a bit calmer here, in lee of a large glacier that prevents travel to the north.  The glacier descends the western slope of the huge mountain, weaving its way through the frozen black landscape.  Snowstorms block vision to the east and south.

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: A glacier is visible to the north, descending the western side of the mountain.  Southeast of the glacier, white capped ridges rise into the clouds on the southern face.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The southwestern face of the mountain is dimly visible through the storms to the north.  Its frozen surface stands in an eternal battle with elements.  The jagged cliffs of black rock and ice rise defiantly towards the sky until they are lost in the clouds.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The mountain appears to descend and meet the tundra to the northeast, but the whirling storms make it impossible to see clearly.  The slopes appear not as steep there, on the southern face.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The elements continue the assault on anything living that dares to trespass across their frozen home.  Blasting sheets of sleet and snow keep the mountain a blurred shadow.

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The mountain is clearly visible through a break in the storms, though the biting winds remain.  It looms as a massive tower of rock and ice, sitting to the northeast beyond the sea of white.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: Squalls blow bitterly across the snow dunes, showing no signs of softening their endless blast.  A huddled dwarf sits quietly against one of the dunes, having settled down for a rest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The snow dunes continue to rise and fall as the harsh winds perpetually reshape the landscape.  The stoic mountain maintains its perch to the northeast in silence.

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: A glimpse of the mountain is quickly lost amidst the mass of clouds.  The drifts themselves have thinned considerably, leaving several paths safe for travel.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, west

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: Most of the surface snow has been blown from here, leaving a packed field of older snow.  The field is littered with deep cracks, but several paths appear relatively safe for travel.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: A frozen hand reaches out of a snowbank in an eternal last grasp at life, while the winds howl in search of life to devour.  Shapes form, dissolve, and then reform in the swirling gusts.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: A grey mist of clouds and snow swirls about in no particular direction.  If it were not for the ever present mountain, it would be impossible to judge direction in the bitter gales.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: Snow ripples across plateaus lashed with swirling flurries as far as the eye can see.  Through the grey haze, the great lonely mountain sits to the northeast, observing its frozen kingdom in silence.

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: Swirling white eddies form as the squalls blast across the snowdrift, almost giving life to this dead wasteland.  In the distance the looming mountain quietly watches your progress.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: The snowy wasteland stretches out of sight.  In the absence of other life, the elements seem to have taken on one of their own, screeching in hatred of anything that penetrates their home.  A large snowbank has accumulated just off the trail to the east.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: A desolate blanket of snow stretches out endlessly, interrupted only by an enormous mountain far to the northeast.  Swirling winds quickly cover any irregularities on the lifeless plains. The snowdrifts lapse to allow passage to the north and west, and an opening in the ice to the south offers some protection from the elements.

title: [Top of the World, Frozen Tundra]
description: There is no shelter from the bitter winds, only blinding white in every direction.  Snowdrifts shift and reform continually, washing away any signs of life. Through the flurries, the shadowy form of the mountain stands menacingly in the distance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west

title: [Ice Cave]
description: A small refuge has been carved into the snow and domed with ice blocks, giving shelter from the merciless winds.  Light filtering through the crystalline walls bathes the enclosure in a soft glow.  A wooden hatch leads out to the freezing hinterland to the south and an opening offers passage north.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: To the west, a large spire of ice towers far above your head and is quickly lost in the swirling snowstorm.  A wooden hatch to the north leads, strangely enough, down into the snow.  Paths lead from the hatch to the south and southwest.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: The screaming wind howls across the frozen wasteland, scouring all signs of life from the bleak tundra.  Deep snow piles atop a tall ridgeline to the east, threatening to dislodge at any moment.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: The barren white tundra stretches on endlessly, interrupted only by a ridge of mountains to the south.  Paths lead out of sight to the north and east.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: Freezing winds have scoured away much of the snow, allowing passage in several directions.  Through the flurries to the north, a ghostly outline can barely be discerned, a towering spire standing imperviously within the onslaught of the storms.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: Through the falling snow a tall structure is visible to the east, but deep snow drift prevents travel in that direction.  Trails lead west and southeast.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: Unbroken snow fields stretch as far as the eye can see, drifting to 20 meters in some places and blocking travel in most directions.  The faint trail appears to offer safe travel to the south and east.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: Large snowdrifts towering on both sides of the trail block what little light makes it through the heavy snowfall.  Shadows follow the trail to the north and east, disappearing into the flurries.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: Whirling snowstorms continue to blast mercilessly, making it difficult to see clearly.  A faint path heading east is barely discernable in the waist deep snow.  The snow fields appear to thin out to the southwest.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: Snow continues to fall heavily, hiding what little there is to be seen.  A line of mountaintops are faintly visible to the west and south.  Weaving between snowdrifts, the trail leads northeast and southeast.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: The mountain range extends from a pass to the southeast, curling up to the northwest before fading out of sight.  Across the vast tundra stretching north and east, wind whips up flurries of snow that shimmer in the half-light like strange portals leading into a white maw.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: Several faint paths lead off in different directions through the large snowfield.  A mountain range skirts the horizon to the south.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: Snow falls in a steady white curtain, making progress on the trail slow and cumbersome.  Deep drifts off of the trail make wandering there impossible.  A range of mountains breaks for a pass to the south, quietly watching the tundra with indifference.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: A wandering trail leads up into the mountain pass to the south.  A path leads into a frozen wasteland to the north and northeast, the end of which cannot be seen.

title: [Arctic Tundra]
description: The arctic terrain languishes in the grip of the cruel storms ranging across the bleak landscape like distant galleons on a frozen sea.  Ridges of ice fringe the caps of undulating waves of snowdrifts.  In the northern distance, an immense mountain fills the horizon, its feet obscured by storms.

title: [Arctic Embankment]
description: The treacherous path crosses the wall of stone, snaking through lurking pitfalls and dangerous cracks camouflaged with sheets of ice and snow.  To the north, the boulders descend and flatten into a tundra marked with little more than shifting snowbanks.  A great peak cuts through the mist of the far northern horizon like a forbidding mirage floating in the clouds of snow.

title: [Arctic Embankment]
description: The wind is a cruel master, reigning at the apex of the boulders with dangerous gusts spiked with needle-sharp ice and sleet.  A sheath of ice covers the stones, making a perilous catwalk of the embankment's top.  Wind screams its way over the jumble of rock and barrels against the mountains to the south in an endless onslaught.

title: [Northern Slopes, Arctic Plateau]
description: To the north, a band of broken stones borders the snowy plateau like a final break-water against the savage grip of the tundra stretching away to the northern horizon.  Snow and wind blast the rocks, leaving drifts in the lee of their southern faces.  Pine-covered mountains provide a backdrop to the south, misted with fog and snowy clouds that drift across the peaks like ghostly barges on a dark green sea.

title: [Northern Slopes, Arctic Track]
description: The snow is crusted into a brittle carapace with ice, marred here and there with stone outcrops that shine with a frozen veneer.  To the wind's sighs and murmurs is added the occasional cry of an eagle flying high above, adding an eerie chord to the winter lullaby and echoing like a siren's call across the ocean waves.

The snow is crusted into a brittle carapace with ice, marred here and there with stone outcrops that shine with a frozen veneer.  To the wind's sighs and murmurs is added the occasional cry of a snowy owl high above, adding an eerie chord to the winter lullaby and echoing like a siren's call across the ocean waves.

title: [Northern Slopes, Arctic Plateau]
description: A flat plateau of snow stretches into the distance, bounded in the northern reaches by a snowy peak that shimmers in the light, looking as much cloud as mountain.  A cascade of boulders offers egress to a forested range of mountains, guarding the southern borders of the tundra.  Snow falls over the still landscape in intermittent flurries which sparkle when a persistent beam of light breaks through the assault of bitter storms.

A flat plateau of snow stretches into the distance, bounded in the northern reaches by a snowy peak that shimmers in the moonlight, looking as much cloud as mountain.  A cascade of boulders offers egress to a forested range of mountains, guarding the southern borders of the tundra.  Snow falls over the still landscape in intermittent flurries which sparkle when a persistent beam of light breaks through the assault of bitter storms.

title: [Northern Slopes, Arctic Track]
description: A jumble of snowy rock cascades across the trail, blocking further progress to the east.  The stones descend to an expanse of flat tundra that stretches away to the northeast in an almost featureless plain.  Clouds of snow cross the vast wilderness of ice in the distance, moving like great behemoths over the land in a silent dance.

title: [Northern Mountains, Timberline]
description: The trail snakes along the edge of the precipice, the way rendered treacherous by snow and ice.  Below, the bottom of the gorge is lost in shadows where jagged boulders lift their heads out of the gloom here and there like massive, motionless swimmers in a dark pool.

title: [Northern Slopes, Bluff]
description: Lichen mottles the surface of boulders forming the bluff, their surface sheared of snow by gusting winds blowing up from the gorge below.  The flurries are buffered to the northwest by a dense forest of pines that stand dark and seemingly impenetrable.  A trail forms and winds away to the northeast, as though fleeing the maw of the shadowy ravine.  It soon disappears, lost in a vast expanse of blizzard-swept tundra.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: A ring of tall modwirs surrounds an outcrop of granite that peeks from a mantle of snowdrifts like a recluse.  At the stone's feet, the trail splits into tentative fingers in all directions, the remnants divided by tree trunks and obscured by snow.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: The expanse of towering pines cloaked in clumps of snow is broken by the stark silhouette of a large, wrought-iron gate straddling the trail.  It is unattached to a fence of any kind.  Across the arched top are the words 'Pinefar Trading Post', crowned by a 'P' enclosed within a circle.  Although no buildings can be seen through the gusting snow, a smudge of smoke can be glimpsed curling above the trees.

title: [Pinefar Forest, Trail]
description: The trail winds through the pines, the banks of snow covering it marked here and there by animal tracks.  Among the black branches of  the conifers to either side is the occasional dark bulk of a squirrel nest.  To the northwest, lights twinkle through the pine needles, and the scent of a fire is discernible, carried on the crisp, wintry air.

title: [Pinefar Forest, Snowy Trail]
description: Drifts crowd the trail, laying in graceful mounds punctuated by the dark trunks of modwir pines.  The trees huddle against a sheer granite cliff, which rises up from the snow banks and blocks all further progress.  Set into the stone face is a wooden door, painted red and banded with veniom.

title: [Pinefar Trading Post, Lawn]
description: The snow-covered lawn stretches up to a rambling log manor that blends into the surrounding forests with an uncanny grace.  The building looks inviting and cozy despite its sprawling size.  A front porch wraps around the entire facade of the building, and a number of stone chimneys stand guard on the roof, each spouting an aromatic plume of smoke.  Stone steps lead up to the porch, flanked by a pair of fanciful carved drakes.

title: [Pinefar Trading Post, Trail]
description: The lodge casts reflections across the drifts from candles in its many windows, lit against the gloom of the blowing wind and snow.  Boulders mark a path which turns and twists, following the foundation of the lodge then leading away into the forest of pines to the northwest.  A curious building stands against the north wall of the inn, its walls and ceiling fashioned of glass.

title: [Pinefar Trading Post, Porch]
description: The porch is floored with wide, wooden planks, swept clean of snow and painted a wishful shade of green.  All down the length of it, rocking chairs sit in a row, silent in the winter hush.  This far north, the snow is a constant presence, transforming the row of pristine, green and white rockers into a wonderful winter folly.  Generous, albeit short, double doors lead into the building.

title: [Pinefar, Hothouse]
description: Wooden tables are set in orderly rows down the length of the building, their tops crowned and overflowing with plants of all descriptions.  Against the exterior wall, herbs grow from their loamy flats, and the center aisle is filled with flowering plants.  The large floor tiles in the building are covered with a plush carpet of moss, coaxed into abundance by the heavy humidity.

title: [Pinefar Trading Post, Greatroom]
description: Shining wood floors and a beamed ceiling distinguish the spacious room.  An impressive rock fireplace dominates the back wall, flanked by a wide staircase leading to an upper floor.  Before the hearth sits a tawny leather sofa with a variety of armchairs sitting in attendance around it.  Rugs scattered across the plank floor add tones of coral, blue and red to the warm ambience.  All along the walls, paintings compete with windows offering views of the snow-bound countryside.

Shining wood floors and a beamed ceiling distinguish the spacious room.  An impressive rock fireplace dominates the back wall, flanked by a wide staircase leading to an upper floor.  Before the hearth sits a tawny leather sofa with a variety of armchairs sitting in attendance around it.  Rugs scattered across the plank floor add tones of coral, blue and red to the warm ambience.  All along the walls, paintings compete with windows offering views of the moonlit, snow-bound countryside.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Nine of Cups Cafe and Bar]
description: Here in the Cups, the knotty-pine walls are hung with a variety of game trophies and paintings.  A row of booths lines the back wall, and opposite them stands a long, low bar with a shining brass foot-rail.  Wooden panels suspended from the ceiling sway gently back and forth, propelled by a complex system of cords and pulleys that crisscrosses the wainscoting.  The panels whisper a lazy swish that keeps the air moving gently and dissipates the distinctive aroma of cigar smoke.

title: [Pinefar, General Store]
description: This is a warm domain of polished oak surfaces and clumps of sweet-smelling herbs hanging from low rafters.  Another of the generous hearths covers one wall, with a low sales-counter opposite it.  Shelves stretch from floor to ceiling behind the counter, filled with a variety of merchandise, and pastries line the counter-top in a tempting display.

title: [Pinefar Realty]
description: The rustic realty outlet has little more in it other than a counter, a board with some notices pasted up and a statue of a bear like the ones the dwarves carve with nothing more than an axe and then barter to unsuspecting Wehnimer's tourists.  A few colorful braided rugs are scattered about the pine plank floor, as well.  Against the back wall, a black wood-stove puts out heat, keeping the little office welcoming and warm.

title: [Pinefar, Furrier Shop]
description: The  shop has the aromatic scent of tanned hides, filled as it is with floor-to-ceiling shelves which sport all manner of furs and leathers, each neatly rolled.  A tall stack of furs and pelts fills one corner as well. Over the curtain leading into the General Store, a horseshoe hangs askew, making one wonder if it'll fall with one more passage beneath its precarious perch.

title: [Pinefar, Infirmary]
description: The room is aromatic, scented with bunches of herbs that hang from the beamed ceiling like garland.  An oak counter is cluttered with glass canisters filled with all sorts of powders and leaves, and a bed sits against the far wall, the two pieces being the room's only furnishings.  A window sporting a white linen drape offers a view of the snowy landscape.

The room is aromatic, scented with bunches of herbs that hang from the beamed ceiling like garland.  An oak counter is cluttered with glass canisters filled with all sorts of powders and leaves, and a bed sits against the far wall, the two pieces being the room's only furnishings.  A window sporting a white linen drape offers a view of the moonlit, snowy landscape.

title: [Pinefar, Front Desk]
description: No more than an alcove tucked beneath the wide staircase, this cozy nook is dominated by an imposing oak desk cluttered with papers.  Sitting on a table-easel amidst the debris is a small painting of a whiskered halfling.  Next to the portrait is a paper-weight that reads "Office."  A narrow hall passes the desk and continues around the corner, its length hung with paintings of mountain scenes inspired, very likely, by local panoramas.

title: [Pinefar, Smoke Shop]
description: The spicy scent of tobacco permeates the cozy room tucked beneath the inn's wide staircase.  Its walls are painted a deep shade of hunter green that compliments the rich grain of polished oak shelves lining the walls.  On the back wall, the shelves are filled with wooden tobacco boxes, while books crowd the others.  A painting of a hunting scene occupies the only expanse sans shelves, keeping watch above two over-stuffed leather armchairs.

title: [Pinefar, Narrow Hall]
description: The narrow hall dead-ends at a wall hung with a painting flanked by two doorways.  Small lanterns cast a soft, golden light on the portrait and spark reflections off brass plaques attached to the doors, one reading 'Jeweler' and the other 'Depository'.

title: [Pinefar, Gemshop]
description: The small cranny of a shop has walls painted a deep shade of burgundy, which are edged with polished oak.  Shelves cover the back wall, fronted by a low counter with a glass top and shallow drawers beneath that.  One small window gives a view of the mountainside, but heavy bars criss-cross the view just outside the glass, protecting the room from intrusion.

Shelves cover the back wall, fronted by a low counter with a glass top and shallow drawers beneath that.  One small window gives a view of the moonlit mountainside, but heavy bars criss-cross the view just outside the glass, protecting the room from intrusion.

title: [Pinefar, Depository]
description: Pinefar's Depository is painted a respectable shade of dark green.  A couple of dusty-looking animal trophies decorate the walls.  The entire back of the room is covered with a wooden screen polished to the same luster as elsewhere in the manor, and behind this carved grill sits a sleepy-looking halfling, painstakingly counting a pile of coins.

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Hallway]
description: Here at the top of the wide stairway, one has a good view of the expansive great room below.  The banisters sweeping down to the lower floor are intricately carved in a pine cone motif and polished to a high luster.  A long hallway stretches north, one wall occupied almost entirely by a large oak door.  The green length of the hallway is carpeted in a finely woven runner depicting a pattern of pine needles and cones.

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Hallway]
description: The hall is quiet, allowing a distant susurrus of wind in the pines outside to intrude, sighing like the sound of a restless ocean.  Doorways stand to the right and to the left, on either side of the passageway, framed in fine oak and decorated with carving in the pine needle pattern exhibited by the hall's rug.  Finely worked iron candlestick holders hang on the walls, providing a golden light that glistens in reflection on the hall's polished wood.

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Hallway]
description: The hall ends at the foot of an oak door, but branches to the left and right diagonals.  A second door to the right stands opposite a fine painting, depicting a strange, craggy mountain of seemingly pure ice.  The mount is surrounded by low, thick clouds, giving it a moody, introspective quality.

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Hallway]
description: A tall, leaded-glass window stretching from rafters to floor cuts off the hall's further progress, offering in exchange an expansive view of the pine-mantled mountains surrounding the inn.  On the left is a handsome oak door and opposite that, a large painting occupies almost the entire wall.  The wintry light sparkles through the diamond shaped panes in the window, throwing reflections off the polish of the oak floor.

A tall, leaded-glass window stretching from rafters to floor cuts off the hall's further progress, offering in exchange an expansive view of the pine-mantled mountains surrounding the inn.  On the left is a handsome oak door and opposite that, a large painting occupies almost the entire wall.  The wintry moonlight sparkles through the diamond shaped panes in the window, throwing reflections off the polish of the oak floor.

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Hallway]
description: The hall runs east and west, flanked with more of the carved doors and carpeted with its coniferously patterned runner.  The door on the left stands facing an alcove where a couple of comfortable chairs sit on either side of a low table.

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Alcove]
description: Each armchair of the pair positioned in this cozy alcove looks comfortable.  A wrought-iron stand beside each, topped with a thick beeswax candle, hints that the nook is a tidy place to find amusement or solace in a good book.  On the table, a decanter is filled with liquid, the rich golden color of a wheat field on a sunny, late-afternoon day.

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Hallway]
description: Two oak doors mark the hall's eastern end, one heavily carved and the other simply marked, embraced within their carved lintels.  To the west, the hall marches along, the gold glow of beeswax candles in their iron holders throwing puddles of light on the beamed ceiling and carpeted floor.

title: [Nightmare Gorge]
description: An eruption of boulders, detritus of a rockslide, blocks the trail's advance to the east.  Many of the huge stones show cracks and scars from the violence of the fall down the precipice.  The resulting stair-stepped slope offers an escape from the gorge, made perilous by the continual onslaught of ice and snow.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: Swirling snow drifts at the feet of a row of towering pines.  They lean majestically over the path in a dark tunnel that stands as grandly as the nave of a cathedral.  No sound other than the whisper of the wind breaks the reverential hush reigning among the tall trees.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: The trees crowding on either side of the path grow so closely together, the trunks almost touch, and the boughs intertwine like a solid, arched roof overhead.  An absence of any sound other than the wind is like an unseen presence, sensed in a way that grows upon the consciousness gradually until it is finally, unmistakably there.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: Fine mists of snow drift down through the pine boughs overhead in a gentle shower, making the air sparkle with their iridescence.  The light is low and gentle, breaking through the needle canopy in stark rays that mottle the carpet of needles on the ground.  Only the wind can penetrate the heavy hush, caressing the silence with its lonely whisper.

Fine mists of snow drift down through the pine boughs overhead in a gentle shower, making the air sparkle with their iridescence.  The light is low and gentle, breaking through the needle canopy in pale, thin rays that mottle the carpet of needles on the ground.  Only the wind can penetrate the heavy hush, caressing the silence with its lonely whisper.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: A stark ray of light breaks through the pine boughs, casting a puddle of light on the ruts of the path like a spotlight.  Fine flakes of snow drift down through the beam, swirling and drifting in response to the wind's melody.  The trees standing like an audience to either side seem darker and quieter than they are, as though they are transfixed by the beauty of the performance.

A wan ray of moonlight breaks through the pine boughs, casting a puddle of light on the ruts of the path.  Fine flakes of snow drift down through the light, swirling and drifting in response to the wind's melody.  The trees standing like an audience to either side seem darker and quieter than they are, as though they are transfixed by the beauty of the performance.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: A large stone cuts the path in two, its surface mottled and dark against the background of misty snow.  Lichens trace a pattern of fancy lace over it, as delicate and fine as the flakes of snow powdering the rock.  The canopy of trees is especially thick overhead, as though they are grouped above the boulder like a curious crowd of giants.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: While the trail splits into a junction, its accompanying pines are steadfast and in perfect formation.  The way leads off in its various directions bounded on both sides by the arched canopy, like the intersection of naves in a grand temple to silence.  The wind spits in dizzy gusts, as if undecided upon which path to follow.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: One pine among the proud rows lining the path has succumbed to age and the elements.  It angles across the way, supported by its fellows on the facing row, creating a triangular door through which the trail passes.  The boughs of the crippled tree sweep down in elegant, needled swashes, as though they are appendages bracing the pine's slow descent to the ground.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: The trail winds through its silent escort of pines, angling upwards in a gentle climb to the southeast.  Snow has drifted into irregular eddies between the dark trunks, the shadows created there cloaked in beautiful tones of purple, blue and grey.  A fine wind gusts down the path, sculpting the snow in languid motions.

title: [Courtyard]
description: The courtyard is swept with fine drifts of snow that reach over the polished granite tiles like elongated, playful fingers.  From the shelter of an ancient and stately pine growing in the center of the enclosure, birdsong is a constant background, as if the serenading chorus is intent upon making up for melody lost along the silent trails leading to the plaza.  An edifice rises from the granite courtyard like a temple of ice, its white stone glistening with a mantle of snow crystals.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: A halo of light surrounds the opening of the trees to the southwest, casting the proud trunks of the pines into deeper shadow.  The light is mesmerizing, with its floating motes of snow and hazy yet vivid colors of green, white and deeper shadowy tones of purple, blue and brown.  As the trail descends to the north, the trees arch closely over it, as if drawing together to whisper to each other.

An ethereal halo of moonlight surrounds the opening of the trees to the southwest, casting the proud trunks of the pines into the deepest shadow.  The pale silver light is mesmerizing, with its floating motes of snow, and hazy shades of green and white, and deeper shadowy tones of purple, blue, and brown.  As the trail descends to the north, the trees arch closely over it, as if drawing together to whisper to each other.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: The trees draw closer to the path.  Their trunks create a repeating pattern of rugged bark, peeling and cracked in irregular plates and at close look, beautiful in the subtlety of color.  A movement up in the dark green wilderness of needles reveals a chickadee.  The bird flits silently through the branches, bright chirps smothered by the silence inhabiting the path.

The trees draw closer to the path.  Their trunks create a repeating pattern of rugged bark, peeling and cracked in irregular plates and at close look, beautiful in the subtlety of color.  A movement up in the dark wilderness of needles reveals a nighthawk.  The bird flits silently through the branches, bright chirps smothered by the silence inhabiting the path.

title: [Nightmare Gorge]
description: For a few steps, the trail levels out before churning into a chaos of broken boulders in all directions.  A thin finger of rock soars up from the floor of the ravine, like a gnarled finger pointing at the low-hanging clouds.  Snow and ice coat most every surface with a shiny veneer that glistens in the dim light.

title: [Nightmare Gorge]
description: The tumbled boulders corrupting the trail become almost impassable here in the gorge's elbow.  Stone piled on cracked and icy layers of more stone threaten to clutch at feet and ankles.  Occasional fingers of bone reach up from the snowy rubble, marking where creatures have succumbed to the treachery of the course.

title: [Nightmare Gorge]
description: The walls of the gorge are marked with a variety of cracks and crevices, seen in sketchy detail at best through the blowing snow and sleet.  An army could hide up in such a jumble of rocks without risk of discovery.  The scant excuse for a trail is forced to veer to the south by a formation of large boulders jutting from the ravine's north precipice.

title: [Nightmare Gorge]
description: Jagged crags of stone tower up on either side from a broken field of boulders made more treacherous by ice and snow.  The gorge snakes its way west, twisting out of sight around a large outcrop of stone protruding from the north face in the distance.  Here and there, scraggly bushes crouch between the rocks, their branches cloaked in a layer of ice.

title: [Northern Slopes, Rocky Incline]
description: The precarious path down the steep face of the bluff levels off briefly, forming a small ledge with dangerously unstable edges.  Wind whips by, buffeting the precipice with sleet and snow.  Lodged pitifully in a pile of boulders next to the sheer rock face lies the carcass of an antelope.  Its limbs are broken across the granite, and little more than a pile of hide and protruding bones remains of the graceful creature, mute testament to the brutality of the region.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: An embankment of granite swallows the trail abruptly, its demise marked by a small circular patch of ground covered with loose shale and stones.  Past the embankment, the ground drops away into shadowy depths, leaving only clouds and blowing snow visible from the path.  The wind is cruelly edged, blowing up from the dark gorge with a fury.   A rickety sign stands crookedly beside the gravel turn, with rough letters inscribed that proclaim the warning, 'Beware'.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: Large, snow-covered boulders ridge the trail on the north, forming a low embankment that plunges down into a gorge.  The forest stands to the south, rising up the mountain in frosted tones ranging from green to black, dotted with splotches of white where snow has found purchase on the tree branches.  Brisk winds gust up from the gorge, whipping the nearby trees and casting mists of snow across the panorama.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: A stand of hemlock trees mix with the other conifers, adding the gnarled silhouette of their branches to that of the pines.  Wind moves the limbs in a lazy dance, occasionally launching puffs of snow from them with a heavy gust.  The trail begins a gentle descent to the north, where vestiges of ground fog cluster and creep through the tree trunks.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: The silence of the pines is gently broken by snatches of bird song and an occasional rustle in the underbrush.  A thin sound of wind whistling through branches adds to the chorale, the gusts heavily laden with the rich loamy scent of the forest.  The path curves around a thick growth of rhododendron that edges the trail on its western shoulder.

The silence of the pines is gently broken by an occasional rustle in the underbrush.  A thin sound of wind whistling through branches adds to the chorale, the gusts heavily laden with the rich loamy scent of the forest.  The path curves around a thick growth of rhododendron that edges the trail on its western shoulder.

title: [Northern Mountains, Bluff]
description: The trees open into a clearing bound on one side by a fallen log.  The tree trunk's wood is rotted in parts, and coated with thick moss and snow elsewhere.  It points away from the thick stands of pines, as if gesturing to the south where the ground disappears, dropping into a sheer cliff of granite that shelters a pool nestled at its feet.

title: [Northern Mountains, Forest Pool]
description: The trail opens up into a clearing bounded by huge stones ringing a pool of water.  Lichens and vivid green moss mottle the stones, growing to the brink of the water's edge in a thick mantle.  The pool is still and deep, bounded on the west by a high escarpment of granite that throws a shadow across the water's surface.

title: [Northern Mountains, Timberline]
description: The trail disappears into the agglomeration of a granite outcrop that holds a covering of snow on its cold pate like a growth of silver hair.  On either side of the stone, fingers of the path sneak away, winding and twisting through the tree trunks and smaller dogwoods.

title: [Northern Mountains, Timberline]
description: The forest is absolute, the thick pine trunks crowding close to the path on all sides.  The trees intertwine their heavily needled boughs into impassable walls which support daubs of pristine snow like diamonds upon a finger.  The trail breaks into three directions, each avenue winding away into the forest and soon lost in the thick verdure.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: The path doglegs, diverted by a small stream which trickles through a jumble of boulders and fallen tree trunks.  The watercourse is negligible, its edges encased in crystals of ice, and its path often lost in drifts of snow which cover it like thick white bridges.  It parallels the path briefly, then veers off and disappears around a stand of dogwood.

title: [Northern Mountains, Pine Forest]
description: The forest grows close and thick, crowding the path with low branches, their tips buried in drifts of snow.  Shafts of light angle down through the trees here and there, cleanly defined in the twilight created by the heavy foliage.  Every so often, clumps of snow fall to the ground from above with soft plops, dislodged by wind or one of the squirrels, which caper frenetically through the upper regions of the pines.

The forest grows close and thick, crowding the path with low branches, their tips buried in drifts of snow.  Shafts of moonlight angle down through the trees here and there, cleanly defined by the heavy foliage.  Every so often, clumps of snow fall to the ground from above with soft plops, dislodged by wind or one of the squirrels, which caper frenetically through the upper regions of the pines.

title: [Northern Mountains, Timberline]
description: The trail meanders and curves, dancing around the feet of trees that grow more substantial the higher one climbs.  Above, an opening in the branch cover allows light to reach a number of dogwood trees huddling in the small clearing.  An immense giant of a pine stands staunchly to the north, its feet and lower branches forcing the path to sneak past by veering southwest.

The trail meanders and curves, dancing around the feet of trees that grow more substantial the higher one climbs.  Above, an opening in the branch cover allows moonlight to reach a number of dogwood trees huddling in the small clearing.  An immense giant of a pine stands staunchly to the north, its feet and lower branches forcing the path to sneak past by veering southwest.

title: [Northern Slopes, Bluff]
description: As the altitude rises, the air grows more crisp and biting, full of the rich aroma manufactured by the pines.  The bluff is a narrow ridge of stone, banded on the north by thick stands of trees, and open to the wind on the south, where the trail disappears down into the jumble of boulders creating a steep incline.

title: [Northern Slopes, Clearing]
description: The pines open into a clearing produced by a large outcrop of boulders in its center.  A number of rhododendron bushes grow in a clump against the rock, their oval leaves curled into thin fingers with the cold.  The trail disappears at the foot of an incline, where more of the granite breaks through the loam and displays a face banded with minerals.

title: [Northern Slopes, Forest Trail]
description: The trees are interrupted by a swath of tumbled boulders, lying in the snow like sleeping mammoths, their backs furred and fringed with lichens.  A few more of the small, hardy bushes flaunt their colorful reds and oranges among the more somber arrays of the lichens.  The trail winds through the rocks and climbs through the pines to the east.

title: [Northern Slopes, Snowy Drifts]
description: Tall green giants lift their needled branches in graceful arcs, some weighted down with thick sleeves of snow, vivid white against the near-black boughs of the pines.  The sound of the river to the south has faded into the fog, which shifts in a silent dance and frays the further north one looks.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, west

title: [Northern Slopes, Timberline]
description: As the trail winds north into thick stands of pine, outcrops of rock become less frequent.  Underfoot, a dense carpet of needles alternates with the covering of snow, peeking out from under the blanket of white in rich browns and reds.  Lichen grows on the rough bark of the trees, adding gold and bronze to the color medley of the pine mulch.

title: [Northern Slopes, River Bank]
description: Rocks are tumbled in a precarious course that makes crossing them a demanding pursuit.  Patches of snow dot the crevices between the granite, studded here and there with small, brightly leafed bushes.  North of the field of stones, spruce and pine begin to grow, looming out of the river's fog like spectres.

title: [Northern Slopes, Alpine Track]
description: Strange shingles of ice coat nearby rocks, protruding in fingers and giving the stones a hoary appearance reminiscent of great age.  Spruce and pines begin to crowd the boulders, growing more numerous as the trees march up the incline to the north.  The river to the south sounds more distant than it is, cloaked with the fog drifting up from its banks.

title: [Northern Slopes, Alpine Track]
description: Ancient, pocked granite domes create a steep slope that extends up to a stand of pines on a ridge above.  Here and there, smaller trees cling to folds in the boulders, stunted into contorted forms by starting life in the rocks instead of in nourishing peat.

title: [Northern Slopes, River Overlook]
description: The boulders level into a promontory, with the surrounding countryside spreading out below in a breathtaking view.  Below, at the cliff's foot, the river looks silver, sending sparkles of reflection up through the fog when persistent beams of light occasionally manage to make their way through the haze.  Another face of stone continues up the incline toward a ridge fringed with dark green conifers.

The boulders level into a promontory, with the surrounding countryside spreading out below in a breathtaking view.  Below, at the cliff's foot, the river looks silver, sending sparkles of reflection up through the fog when persistent beams of moonlight occasionally manage to make their way through the haze.  Another face of stone continues up the incline toward a ridge fringed with dark green conifers.

title: [Northern Slopes, Rock Ledge]
description: The trees crowd the edge of the precipice, as if eager for a change to gaze out over the expansive horizon.  Majestic mountains rise up from deep green forests dotted with snow and caressed here and there with drifting fog and low-lying clouds.  The conifers are so thick, further passage through them is impossible.

title: [Northern Mountains, Cave]
description: Stone with vivid striations of color creates sloping walls which narrow as they lead into the shadows at the cave's back.  Heaps of dried pine needles are strewn about the rough floor, and a blackened ring near the entrance gives evidence of old fires.  The round opening leading outside is a flat facade of white, blanketed as it is with the raging blizzard and low clouds.

title: [Northern Slopes, Snowy Drifts]
description: The trail dwindles to nothing, engulfed by the gentle swells of deep snow drifts that surround the trunks of the conifers like a stark, frozen ocean.  Here and there, animal tracks mar the snow's surface, leaving deep indentations.  They create an erratic pattern that circles and backtracks, then meanders away through the drifts as if following an invisible path.

title: [Northern Slopes, Snowy Drifts]
description: A fierce wind drives the heavy white snow forcefully into knee-deep drifts, eradicating any sign of passage. A forested slope rises in the snow-obscured distance.

title: [Northern Slopes, Timberline]
description: The timberline is thinly forested, being thicker further up the mountainous slope, but even the sparse tree cover helps decrease the brutal force of the wind. Snow piles in high drifts at the base of each tree and covers every branch.

title: [Northern Slopes, Timberline]
description: A beautiful frozen waterfall formed from once-melted snow runs over a rocky cliff and forms an ice-covered pool. A few hardy, twisted trees struggle to keep purchase in their rocky soil, having fought the brutal elements to a standstill.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: The thick tree coverage runs up to the edge of a steep cliff and provides welcome shelter from the harsh wind. Without those frigid gusts howling through the tree branches, the forest is remarkably peaceful. Several sets of tracks wind chaotically through the forest, and a few disappear up a fairly steep incline.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: A large pine tree stands in the middle of a small clearing. The lower branches of the massive tree are broken and split, and the trunk looks as if it's been repeatedly battered by something large and blunt. The snow around the base of the tree has been churned up, revealing dirt and pine needles underneath.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: This rocky, tree-covered ledge is clearly hazardous. Pebbles, snow, and loose ice slide down the slope with each powerful gust of chill wind. An icy incline leads to a large forested shelf above you.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: The huge trees provide shelter from the harsh wind, and the air is crisp and still. Melting ice drips from branches, pattering softly like raindrops as they fall into the snow.  Partially frozen rivulets are formed by the melting ice, running down a slippery incline nearby.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: Broken branches poke through the snow, surrounding a massive fallen pine tree. The wind blows through the forest, making pine needles quiver and shaking a light dusting of snow from them. Several trees on a well-forested incline sway gently with each rush of cold wind.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: The snow here is extremely churned up, and broken branches and pine needles cover the ground. The trees are scarred and damaged, and one pine tree has been splintered almost completely into bits. A path of arboreal wreckage leads up a once heavily forested incline.

title: [Mountains, Quiet Forest]
description: A mix of broken branches, fallen pine needles and the occasional pinecone are scattered down a steep incline.

title: [Mountains, Quiet Forest]
description: An immense boulder covered with snow and ice sits in the middle of a clearing. Smaller rocks lie in various positions around the boulder, casting irregular shadows on the fresh snow. The wind is almost non-existent, and the scent of fresh pine needles is overpowering.

title: [Atop an Immense Boulder]
description: Snow covers the top of this large rock, and large footprints mark much of the surface. A small, fist-sized hole sits almost in the middle of the boulder, and snow and ice have been cleared away from it. The snow at the edge of the top of the boulder looks as if it has been flattened by the passage of many climbers.

title: [Mountains, Quiet Forest]
description: A clearing can be seen to the west, and low, steady, rhythmic tones come from that direction. Several sets of fresh footprints can be found here, leading deeper into the forest in various directions, and a few of the trails appear to lead from a slippery incline.

title: [Northern Mountains, Clearing]
description: Verdant and clad in fresh snowfall, the dense pine forest gives way to a large clearing near the mouth of a high pass.  Marking the perimeters of the glade are singularly immense totems carved from pine, their features weathered by the onslaught of the northern gale.  Each of the totems bears a different face, but all stare mutely, patiently standing watch despite the grinding of time's cruel teeth.  The largest is immense, several times the height of a tall man, but most are merely huge and imposing.

The forest gives way to a large natural clearing to the west. Standing in front of you are two totems, primitive looking, but skillfully carved. The faces on the totems stare mutely, patiently waiting and watching you.

title: [Northern Mountains, Cliff Face]
description: The forest runs up to the face of a sheer granite cliff. A roughly hewn wooden totem stands by the entrance of a cave. Faint chittering and squeaking can be heard coming from the darkness.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: Light from the cave opening above streams in, revealing scattered, gnawed bones and broken weapons. The smell of rotting leaves mixes with the smell of decaying flesh, creating a truly repulsive odor.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The rough, natural walls of the cave are covered with lichen, and on the ground, loose stone is mixed with various debris, making the footing treacherous.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The darkness of the cave is almost absolute, the only light coming from luminescent lichen which covers the walls and ceiling in irregular patches.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The air in the cave is cool and stagnant, like the atmosphere of a sealed crypt. Water drips from the ceiling occasionally, falling into still puddles, which reflect the eerie glow of the lichen.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: A corpse is slumped against the wall, its leather armor torn open in several places. Shredded sacks lie by the body, their contents either taken or long since decayed.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The cool, stagnant air feels particularly damp here. Thick mud makes up the floor of the cave here and holds several clawed pawprints. Sharp rock shards stick out of the soft, wet ground.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The stench of decay and old blood comes from further down, adding to the distinctive foul odor only found in the lairs of large animals. Scraping can be heard from all directions, the unmistakable sound of sharp claws on stone.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: A large skeleton lies here missing an arm and a leg. Shreds of rotting pelts lie strewn around the cave, and tufts of fur float in the still air.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: Bones and rotting corpses fill this cave, making the stench here almost unbearable. Bloody bodies, destroyed armor, and other debris is piled high against the walls of the cave, making vile, gruesome nests.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The utter darkness of this part of the cave is broken only by occasional glittering caused by the faint reflections of light coming off puddles and bits of metal scattered about on the floor.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: Lichen is notably absent from the walls and ceiling here, making this part of the cave even darker than the rest. A faint, feral odor permeates the air.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The faint light from the lichen reveals dried blood spattered on the walls and floor of the cave. Tracks on the floor look as if something heavy were dragged from here.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The utter darkness of the cave is stifling, the only light coming from luminescent lichen which covers the walls and ceiling in a few places.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The air in the cave is cool and stagnant.  Icy water drips from the ceiling occasionally, falling into cold puddles, which reflect the glow of the lichen.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: A cool breeze filters in from somewhere, stirring the still air and dispelling the foul odor that seems to permeate the rest of the cave.  Icy water trickles down a wall, forming a large puddle on the floor.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The walls are particularly smooth here, and damp to the touch. Smooth rock covers the floor and, unlike the remainder of the cave, is free from all debris.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The cave is particularly dark here, and the rustling of claws on stone and dirt echoes through the air. A splintered thighbone projects dangerously from the wall, as if in warning.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The lichen that covers the wall glows with an eerie, pale green light that illuminates the cave poorly. In the dim light, the rocky, uneven floor sparkles with a faint iridescence.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: A cool breeze filters in from somewhere, stirring the still air and dispelling the stench that seems to permeate the rest of the cave. Cold water trickles down a wall, making a large puddle on the floor.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The cool, still air feels particularly damp here. Thick mud covers the ground, and small sharp bone fragments stick out of the soft, squishy ground.

title: [Northern Mountains, Dark Caves]
description: The rough walls of the cave are covered with glowing lichen, penetrating the dense darkness with an eerie light. The sound of small rodents chirping and squeaking is strong here, and the feeling that there are hundreds of them all around is hard to shake.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: A steep, tree-covered slope leads up towards an icy ledge. The wind is strong, and ice and snow fall from above when the frigid gusts blow. The chittering of birds fills the air, sounding much like the chattering of teeth.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: The large, snow-covered trees are beautiful and full, and the forest looks undisturbed. The only sound is the quiet hiss of snow being blown over drifts and through the branches of the trees.

title: [Northern Slopes, Alpine Track]
description: Boulders are strewn helter-skelter, reaching down to a river that plunges in white froth over the stones at the water line.  The sound of the river, while muffled by the fog at any distance, is now a roar, giving testament to the violence of its passing.  The water is a deep shade of grey where the froth isn't churned up, as if it is too cold and quick to embrace a color as gentle as blue.

title: [Northern Slopes, River Bank]
description: A crude path snakes down to the waterline through the boulders, no doubt the result of animals coming to drink.  The narrow width of ground is muddy and pitted with animal tracks, too many to leave any distinct.  Bits of moss and lichen on the path create tones of green and gold that glow against the drab grey of stone and white of snow patches.

title: [Northern Slopes, Alpine Track]
description: A jumbled landscape of boulders stretches down toward the sound of rushing water.  Small, hardy bushes that have succeeded in conquering the chill sufficiently to produce leaves in vivid oranges and reds add color to the bleak terrain, growing among the rocks with aplomb as if it were an easy feat.  Through a light fog, the shadows of spruce trees extend ragged arms out like sleep-walkers.

title: [Northern Slopes, Alpine Track]
description: A wide avenue of packed snow reaches from the mountain slopes down to a low ridge of rocks to the north.  Broken branches and boulders stick up out of the snow here and there, mangled testimony to the violence of an avalanche.  The low susurrus of rushing water creates an undertone to the howling and fussing of the wind.

title: [Northern Slopes, Timberline]
description: Scrub pines clutch the ground, struggling against the elements.  Their withered branches quiver in the wind, as if they too feel its biting chill.  Below, larger trees spring from the slope, forming a thick alpine forest.  Above, only snow and rock dare brave the steep mountain.

wayto.2878:
;e 
		resolve=Spell['Sigil of Resolve']
		haste=Spell['Haste']
		if UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait' || Skills.survival < 50 || XMLData.encumbrance_value >= 50
			echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 6
		elsif resolve.known? && resolve.affordable? && !resolve.active?
			resolve.cast
		end
		result = fput 'down'
		if result =~ /^Rushing heedlessly/
			haste.cast if haste.known? && haste.affordable? && !haste.active?
			fput 'stand'
			$go2_restart = true
		end

title: [Northern Slopes, Alpine Track]
description: Pine and maple huddle close together, their boughs sagging wearily with snow.  Occasionally, a gust of wind shakes them, dusting you with fresh powder as their branches are relieved.  Not far above, the forest disappears at the timberline.

title: [Northern Slopes, Alpine Track]
description: A large spruce tree has taken root here, its thick branches pressing outwards against the other trees.  Beneath it, yellowed grass struggles up through the carpet of fallen needles and snow.  Small circles indent the snow, footprints left by the passing of a small animal.  To the west, a thin mist can be seen creeping through the forest.

title: [Northern Slopes, Alpine Track]
description: Mist fills the forest, cloaking the area in a haze.  Trees appear as phantom forms stepping from the shadows.  Nearby, a small stream bubbles and churns as it spills down the rolling incline.  Along its banks, patches of juniper sprout from the thin layer of snow, their needled stems woven into thick mats of green.

title: [Northern Slopes, Timberline]
description: Hewn into the mountain, a narrow chute leads upwards from here.  Deep snow has piled beneath it, as have a few large rocks.  High above, a low curve in the mountains dips between snow streaked peaks to the east and west.

title: [Northern Slopes, Timberline]
description: Thick mists drape over the snowy ground.  To the west, a small stream rushes by, gurgling. Slicks of calm water trail the rocks where the current is broken.  Not far below, the stream disappears into an alpine forest.
