title: [Olbin Pass, North Rim]
description: The mountain plunges to the north, stabbing downward past a rocky outcropping until it reaches the timberline below.  Beyond the timberline, the slope levels to join a wide valley, its broad expanse disappearing into the distance.  Trees and snow cover the undulating hills of the valley.  Southwards, the pass ascends a short ridge framed by rugged peaks to the east and west.

title: [Olbin Pass]
description: Soaring overhead, the eastern peak guards this edge of the pass.  Its base is formed by a sheer rock precipice which has been blasted smooth by the vicious winds.  Deep furrows of snow cover the ground, the remains of avalanches fallen from above.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, up

title: [Olbin Pass, South Rim]
description: A rugged butte forms the southern edge of the pass.   Below it, a concave bowl sweeps down towards the tree line, its curved depression filled with snow.  Wandering through the forest beyond, a twisting trail can be seen leisurely making its way down the mountain.  To the east and west, tall peaks cradle the pass.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Olbin Pass, Summit]
description: Here, a short ridge forms the summit of Olbin Pass.  Winds gust through the area, funneled in between the sharp, rocky crags to the east and west.  Jutting from their rugged slopes, flat outcroppings are piled high with heavy drifts of snow, clashing with the dark uncovered rock of the steeps and drop-offs.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Olbin Pass]
description: The snowy terrain descends to the north, curving gracefully over the rim of the pass towards a rocky prominence.  Beyond it, a thick column of white smoke spirals up into the sky, whipping to and fro with the wintry winds.  Above, a short ridge stretches between the peaks to the east and west.

title: [Olbin Pass, Rocky Prominence]
description: Below this prominence sits a small, oval shaped lake.  Its greenish waters are partially hidden behind a thick cloud of steam rising from its surface.  Tufts of snow coat the rocks of the short slope leading down towards the lake.  Occasionally a faint gurgling can be heard, its soft murmur becoming noticeable during a lull in the winds.

title: [Olbin Pass, Boiling Lake]
description: The air is filled with steam, the source of which is a bubbling, spring fed lake nestled amongst snowless rocks.  The water is deep, and colored an emerald green that grows darker towards the outlet at the far end of the lake.  Spouting from the outlet is a small stream that rushes down the northern slope in a torrent.  Snowflakes melt in the air, sprinkling the effervescent lake as tiny droplets of water.

title: [Olbin Pass]
description: The pass angles down to the north, its broad width stretching towards a rocky prominence set against the sky.  Smoke, or perhaps mist, rises up beyond the jagged rocks.  Shimmering, the snow underfoot twinkles dimly with reflective light, as if it were imbedded with thousands of tiny gemstones.

The pass angles down to the north, its broad width stretching towards a rocky prominence set against the sky.  Smoke, or perhaps mist, rises up beyond the jagged rocks.  Shimmering, the snow underfoot twinkles dimly with reflected moonlight, as if it were imbedded with thousands of tiny gemstones.

title: [Olbin Pass, Summit]
description: The western peak towers above, a stern protector of this side of the pass.  Curving upwards to meet its slope, a rocky ridge melds with the peak, forming the summit of the crossing.  Snow covers the ground, rising and falling in deep drifts swept together by the wicked winds.

title: [Olbin Pass, Summit]
description: Buried under a deep carpet of snow, this east-west running ridge forms the top of the mountain crossing.  Its slopes step gingerly downward to the north and south, coming to end at the jagged edges of the pass that cut across the dull winter sky.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, down

title: [Southern Slopes, Icy Climb]
description: A rugged butte beckons from above, marking the upwards end of the pitted mountain slope.  Slick ice covers its rocky surface, making what would already be a difficult climb even more dangerous.  The wind tugs incessantly, trying to pluck you from this frozen perch.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: A large rock formation hunkers in the snow at the end of the trail.  The formation is shaped like a natural stairway, its fractured surface forming steps that are piled high with snow.  Above here, the alpine forest begins to thin considerably.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: The trail splits here, leading east, southwest and northwest.  The northwest trail seems to climb a short way towards a rock formation, while the southwest trail disappears around a patch of pines.  To the east, a thick grove of aspen covers the snow swept ridge.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: The trail curves around a patch of lodgepole pine.  The dagger shaped conifers stand proudly above the ridge, as if silent sentries keeping vigil over it.  Their bows droop drearily under their burden of snow.  To the west, a sheer rock slope can be seen ascending above the forest.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: Bracketed by pines at either side, a sheer rock slope rises over the snowscape.  The slope is formed of a dark gray rock that is stained a rusty red in spots, and is encased entirely in ice.  Near its base, a dark cave opens into the mountain, its mouth a shadowy maw that stands in stark contrast to the snowy hillside around it.

title: [Ice Cave]
description: This small cave is filled with shadows, the only illumination provided by a dim ray of light that peeks through an opening in the southern wall.  In the cave's center is a fire pit, its rim ringed with a number of scorched rocks.  Overhead, a multitude of designs cover the walls and ceiling, incised upon the rock with rich earth tones.  Noticeable by its lack of ornamentation is a small silhouette on the east wall, the crevice about the size of a halfling.  Dense shadows cloak the back of the cave.

title: [Ice Cave]
description: The tunnel is narrow and rough, its sides pocked and notched.  Sharp protrusions and angry-looking gouges mark every twist of its tortuous progress.  The wounds in the rock look recent.  Since the corridor meanders in such a haphazard squiggle, little light penetrates from either end.  Most noticeable, though, is the silence.  The wind's constant dirge finds no admittance here.

title: [Chamber of the Dead]
description: The corridor widens into a chamber that is bare except for an object in its center, a sarcophagus made entirely of ice.  The panels forming its walls are cloudy and striated with swirls and variegations.  Although the chamber is austere, designs cover walls and ceiling on every side, a veritable riot of color and form all possessing a striking sense of movement and vitality.  The playfulness of the renderings lends the somber form in the cold, icebound bed a sense of joyful transfiguration.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: Aspen cover the ridge, some as slender as an elf's wrist.  The trees are almost as white as the snow, a stark contrast to the dark colored spruce and maple that also reside upon this mountain.  Peculiarly, the aspen spring from the ground perpendicular to the angled ridge, only to curve straight upwards after a few feet.  Northwards, the grade of the mountain steepens until it joins a rocky shelf above.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: The snowpack is deep, its upper layer frozen into a hard crust that makes walking arduous.  Just west, a thick grove of aspen closes in on the trail.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: The eastern peak of the mountain range looms overhead, a stoic monarch watching over this alpine ridge.  Beneath its gaze, maple and spruce stand rigid in the winds, as if they were subjects snapped to attention.  The dense forest abruptly ends at the edge of a short cliff nearby.

title: [Foothills, Narrow Ledge]
description: The icy ledge is narrow, yet provides just enough space to maneuver along the sheer cliff.  The grade of the mountain seems to lessen not far above, as the needled tops of pine trees can be seen peeking over the top of the cliff.

title: [Foothills, Narrow Ledge]
description: A cascade of ice hangs from the jagged lip of the cliff overhead, its once rushing waters having frozen into a large icicle that has fused with the slippery layer of ice covering the ledge.  Long ago the cascade must have been a beautiful spectacle of harmless serenity, but no more.  Now it is a treacherous obstacle that must be navigated with caution.

title: [Foothills, Narrow Ledge]
description: The ice covered ledge rises to the east as it hugs a sheer cliff wall.  High above, a curving saddle in the mountain range droops between the snow covered peaks to the east and west.

title: [Foothills, Snowy Trail]
description: The northern edge of the trail is crowded by the sheer cliff, leaving no room for trees to grow.  To the south, a thick grove of maples shade the gentle downward slope of the hillside.  Large icicles hanging from the cliff face dig into the snow, as if pillars of ice meant to support the heavy wall of stone.

title: [Foothills, Snowy Trail]
description: The air is cold and heavy with blowing snow.  Sloping downward to the east, the trail twists away from the sheer cliff at its northern edge.  Trees grow along both sides of the trail in that direction.

title: [Foothills, Frozen Lake]
description: The trail ends at the shore of a frozen lake that sits in a low basin here.  Waterfowl slip and slide across the opaque ice, like children at play.  The northern shore of the lake is formed by the sheer cliff stretching upwards towards a craggy mountain peak.  The other shorelines are comparatively flat, and heavily wooded.  Perched high upon the boughs of an edge-water pine is a thatched stick birds nest.

The trail ends at the shore of a frozen lake that sits in a low basin here.  The northern shore of the lake is formed by the sheer cliff stretching upwards towards a craggy mountain peak.  The other shorelines are comparatively flat, and heavily wooded.  Perched high upon the boughs of an edge-water pine is a thatched stick birds nest.

title: [Southern Slopes, Narrow Shelf]
description: Above, the granite canopy has broken, leaving a narrow vertical crevice in the pinkish rock.  Through it, the sharp pinnacle of the eastern peak can be seen set against the sky.  Large boulders crouch beneath the crevice.  Over the cliff to the south, a frozen lake sits far below.

title: [Southern Slopes, Narrow Shelf]
description: This shelf writhes around the mountain for a short distance to the east.  A large outcropping of pink granite juts out from the slope above, creating a canopy overhead that has kept the shelf mostly snow-free.  The outcropping does nothing to weaken the bitter winds, however.  Strewn over the ground are tufts of fur and gnawed bones, their presence marking this shelf as some creature's lair.

title: [Foothills, Snowy Trail]
description: The trail wanders aimlessly amongst the shuddering trees that sprinkle the hillside.  Withered pine cones litter the ground, the dormant seeds resting upon a bed of fresh snow.  Not far to the north, a sheer cliff wall rises above the forest.

title: [Foothills, Snowy Trail]
description: Lining the edges of the trail are rows of yearling pine.  Most of them barely top the snow, their delicate branches struggling for growth in the shade of their soaring parents.  A few of the miniature trees that have taken root nearest the trail lie trampled and broken.

title: [Foothills, Snowy Trail]
description: The curving hillside is covered with pine and maple, their snow burdened branches creaking in the fierce winds.  The only break in the forest is along the barren face of a sheer rock slope just to the north.  At its base, a deep mound of snow buries all but the roots of a few splintered trees.  Eastwards, a snowy trail winds its way across the foothills.

title: [Northward Trail, Ice Floe]
description: Carved over centuries by the floe of ice at its bottom, this narrow gorge provides some relief from the elements.  The air is still bitterly cold, but at least the harsh winter winds are kept at bay by the lichen-covered walls that lie to the north and the south.  The carcass of a mule lies nearby, preserved from decay by the freezing temperatures.

title: [Northward Trail, Snow Plains]
description: Marking the northern boundary of the valley, a narrow gorge slices through the plain.  A row of trees lines its edge, visible only as vertical streaks smudged across a dull, gray canvas.  The land begins to rise and fall past the gorge, forming low hills that strain upwards as if trying to match the magnificence of the mountains they sit beneath.  The wind whistles hauntingly.

title: [Northward Trail, Snow Plains]
description: A towering mountain range peeks through the snowy haze to the north.  The rugged outline of the range is distinctive, looking remarkably like a giant woman sleeping on her side.  Streaks of snow line the ridges of the mountains.  Southwards, all that can be seen is the vast plain disappearing into a shroud of swirling powder.

A towering mountain range is barely visible in the snow-filled darkness to the north.  The rugged outline of the range faintly resembles a giant woman sleeping on her side.  Streaks of snow line the ridges of the mountains.  Southwards, all that can be seen is the vast plain disappearing into a shroud of swirling powder.

title: [Northward Trail, Snow Plains]
description: Snowflakes whirl around you.  Occasionally a vague form will materialize in the distance, only to disappear in a gust of blowing snow.  Nothing else can be seen in the dim haze but an endless sea of white in all directions.
Snowflakes whirl around you.  Occasionally a vague form will materialize in the distance, only to disappear in a gust of blowing snow.  Nothing else can be seen in the darkness.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Northward Trail, Snow Plains]
description: Wintry gales rage freely across the flat expanse of this valley plain, cloaking the land in a gray fog of wind-born snow.  A mountain rises above the plains not far to the south, its snow-laced peak stabbing at the sky.  To the west, a strange dome rises out of the snow, all but concealed by its absence of color and the relentless flurries.  Anything that might be seen to the north is hidden beyond a curtain of swirling snowflakes.

title: [Northward Trail, Snow Plains]
description: A strange, crystalline dome rises up out of the snow like a giant bubble, its surface a frosted white that sparkles in the light.  All round it, snow is piled in drifts that vary in depth, some reaching halfway up the side which is a respectable distance.  The storm sends sheets of flurries dancing around the structure, like frenzied participants in a wild ritual.
location: the Crystal Dome, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Northward Trail, Snow Plains]
description: Deep drifts of snow cover the ground, making travel difficult.  Fresh footprints can be seen in them, a clear indication that someone, or something, has been this way before.  The trail all but disappears to the north.  To the south, a short rock wall climbs up out of the snow.

title: [Northward Trail]
description: The trail stops at a small drop-off, then continues northwards into a windswept valley.  There, powdered snow layers the ground, as if a thick carpeting of plush white velvet.  Only a few trees interrupt the uniform perfection of the snowscape.  To the south, a large boulder nearly blocks the trail.

title: [Northward Trail, Shelf]
description: Delicate snowflakes dance in the air, swirling.  A large boulder has broken off from the mountainside and now sits upon the shelf, blocking the trail.  Crowned with a layer of snow, the boulder nearly touches the slope rising up at its side.  Only a slim crevice between the two allows passage beyond.

title: [Northward Trail, Shelf]
description: Strong winds blow over the shelf, bringing with them a bitter, numbing cold.  A few scrub pines cling desperately to the slopes above and below, apparently the only plant life able to survive the harsh conditions of this mountain.  Not far to the north, a large boulder sits on the trail.

title: [Northward Trail, Shelf]
description: This shelf hangs high on the mountain slope, its narrow width blanketed with fresh snow.  Red and purple layers of rock can be seen in the vertical walls of the mountainside, their stratified bands revealed by erosion and weathering.  A rocky trail leads to the north.

title: [Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: A large pile of rocks blocks passage northward along the stone pathway.  Skirting along the very edge of the cliff, a narrow path heads west.  From far overhead come the cries of a raptor calling to its mate.

title: [Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: The walls of the mountain lean over the path, sheltering it from the winds and snows which periodically swirl about.  The remains of the stone pathway reappear and continue around the bend.

title: [Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: A massive stone structure rises above as though growing from the mountain itself.  Two carved granite sentinels stand to either side of the stone pathway, their eyes glittering with hidden thoughts.

title: [Abbey Approach, Ledge]
description: The trail ends at a rose-veined white marble arch laid into the side of the mountain, its pale hue marking it immediately as distinct from the surrounding stone.  Narrow slits in the surrounding rock face are paned with stained glass, indicating that the mountainside is the facade of a small stronghold.  An engraved golden ora plaque gleams through the snow and ice from a smoothed plane of stone to the right of the entryway.

title: [The Abbey]
[Abbey, Entry Hall]
description: A rose-veined white marble arch stands at the entryway to a resplendent chamber with a high, dome-shaped ceiling.  Though the wide, tall entrance allows in daylight and a spectacular vista of snow-swept mountains and shining sky, the cold does not come with it.  The walls slant to the northeast, following the curve of the mountain face outside.  Glowing golden in the light of a hundred-candle chandelier hanging high above, a pair of honey maple double doors opens onto a lush courtyard.

title: [Abbey, Greeting Chamber]
description: Carved from the mountainside, the room is narrow but well-lit, and is mostly dominated by a varnished maple desk, behind which sits a lovely blue-eyed initiate.  Tall, branched candelabra of wrought iron frame the desk to either side, filling the chamber with honeyed light and the heady sweetness of hot beeswax.

title: [Abbey Guest House, Solar]
[Abbey, Waiting Chamber]
description: Angled off of the main hall, this room is semiprivate.  Remains of stout wooden furnishings imply a certain level of comfort afforded the guests of the Merciful Sisters.

Angled off from the main hall, the chamber is semiprivate.  A stout honey maple sideboard lines one wall, sitting opposite a few comfortable chairs of arctic puma hide leather.  The far wall features a large stained glass window that looks out onto tree-lined mountains crowned in snow.

title: [Abbey, Courtyard]
description: A pair of wide double doors leads into the abbey's receiving hall, part of an old stonehold built into the mountainside.  A carved stone wall hewn from massive blocks of granite encircles the courtyard and continues along the edge of the abbey.  To the northwest, the smell and sound of horses and mules rises from timber-framed stables against the wall.

title: [Abbey, Stables]
description: The intense smell of horse wafting from the nearby stables is leavened by the sweetness of distant blossoms and honey on the breeze.  The small building verges on one side against a series of gigantic granite blocks that form the abbey courtyard's retaining well.  Old runes are carved into the granite.

title: [Abbey Stables, Entrance]
description: Motes of dust and the occasional piece of drifting hay float gently in shafts of light streaming into the stable through small gaps in the thatched ceiling.  Near the entrance, fresh straw is piled high on the hard-packed floor.  The neighs and whinnies of horses is a constant chorus from the north, punctuated occasionally by the needful braying of a mule.

Motes of dust and the occasional piece of drifting hay float gently in wan moonlight creeping into the stable through small gaps in the thatched ceiling.  Near the entrance, fresh straw is piled high on the hard-packed floor.  The shuffling and heavy breath of sleeping horses comes from the north, punctuated occasionally by the plaintive braying of a mule.

title: [Abbey Stables, Stalls]
[Abbey Stables]
description: A solitary stall toward the rear of the stables is occupied by a braying, white-muzzled mule.  The creature makes more noise than the half-dozen horses quartered next to it.  Hanging from the rafters above is an arrangement of wild roses and garlic, swaying slightly in the still air.

Motes of dust float gently in shafts of light streaming into the stable through great holes torn from the thatched ceiling.  The hard-packed floor is littered with molding straw, from which puffs of dust arise with one's every movement.

title: [Abbey, Receiving Yard]
description: Rising sharply along the mountainside, the grounds are green and well-tended despite the stark banks of snow scattered here and there.  The hewn blocks of native granite that comprise the the abbey are dark with time and worn by the elements.  Huge stone urns are spaced along the walk, holding blossoming roses bushes that seem unfazed by the cold.  Nearby, broad stone steps lead to a wide, uncovered porch with a low balustrade.

title: [Abbey, Porch]
description: From its vantage atop a spiraling rise of stone steps, the porch provides a sweeping view of the bordering valley, which stretches in a sea of white and grey and green to the misty horizon.  The stonehold below is built into the mountainside, blocking views of the trail leading away from the abbey.  Polished parquet doors of spruce and maple are flung open like outstretched, welcoming arms.  The lintel above is intricately carved.

title: [Abbey, Porch]
description: Some broad stone steps curve downward from the porch toward a verdant garden of evergreens, the minty bite of resin rising from below on the breeze.  At the end of the low balustrade, a carved stone figure stands poised and proud.  Several garlands of rose are heaped at her feet.

title: [Abbey Evergreen Garden]
description: At the base of some broad stone steps, cultivated cousins of wild local trees form a small arbor.  The bite of pine resin is cool and clean on the frigid air, rising off of Olbin pine and Ossian spruce.  One side of the garden is bordered by the facade of abbey, while the other is framed by the edge of the cliff upon which the compound is built.

title: [Abbey Kitchen Garden]
description: Round stone pavers wind their way between lush sections of fertile earth decorated with aged brass placards describing the herbs grown in each.  Eaves made of thick timbers shelter a heavy spruce door in the abbey's facade, conspicuously coated with resin at the sides to create a better seal when it is closed.  At the far end of the garden, along the cliff's edge, a loud droning emanates from a large apiary swarming with countless bees.

title: [Abbey Chapel Garden]
description: A cream-colored marble fountain marks the end of the cloistered walk to the east.  Beds of wild rose have been planted in a circle around the base, perfuming the air with their sweetness.  The vividly red blossoms contrast starkly with the dusting of snow on the leaves, but despite the chill, the bushes thrive and the water of the fountain echoes merrily off of the stones of the nearby walk.

title: [Abbey Cloistered Walk]
description: The cloister arcade bends northward toward the abbey chapel and east toward the cells of the dorter.  To the west is a cultivated garden, from which the music of falling water and the perfume of wild roses beckons.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Abbey, Great Hall]
description: Left open to the crisp air of day via vast maple doors, the great hall is a cavernous chamber lined with long wooden benches that march in neatly ordered rows beneath its gabled windows.  At its eastern end, two steps lead from the main floor to the dais.  Three lancet windows on the eastern wall halo the dais in light, crowned by a wheel-shaped window inset with rose-colored stained glass.  The small minstrels' gallery sits over the oak-paneled buttery screen that graces the western wall.

Left open to the chill of night via vast maple doors, the great hall is a cavernous chamber lined with long wooden benches that march in neatly ordered rows beneath its gabled windows.  At its eastern end, two steps lead from the main floor to the dais.  Three lancet windows on the eastern wall halo the dais in muted moonlight, crowned by a wheel-shaped window inset with rose-colored stained glass.  The small minstrels' gallery sits over the oak-paneled buttery screen that graces the western wall.

title: [Abbey, Grand Stair]
[Abbey Grand Stair]
description: Seven broad, stone steps lead upwards, bracketed by ornate wooden bannisters.  The balusters are carved into the spearheaded shapes of irises, while the newels are shaped like frogs upon lilypads.

title: [Abbey, Grand Stair Landing]
[Abbey Grand Stair Landing]
description: The broad landing of the grand stair is oval, with its wooden floor painted dark green.  A semi-circular railing surrounds the landing and continues up the final five steps to the upper gallery.

title: [Abbey, High Gallery]
[Abbey Gallery]
description: Silvery moonlight glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Bright-pigmented paintings depicting the surrounding lands in different seasons are spaced along the opposite wall.  One depicts the environs in high summer, the greenery verdant and the fields blossoming, with nary a hint of snow to be seen.

Pale sunlight glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Bright-pigmented paintings depicting the surrounding lands in different seasons are spaced along the opposite wall.  One depicts the environs in high summer, the greenery verdant and the fields blossoming, with nary a hint of snow to be seen.

Silver light glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Fading paintings, which depict the surrounding lands in the days before the permafrost, cover the opposite wall.

Silver moonlight glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Fading paintings, which depict the surrounding lands in the days before the permafrost, cover the opposite wall.

title: [Abbey Gallery]
description: The gallery bends at an oak-framed maple door in the eastern wall, continuing to the southeast toward a wide marble-arched opening that leads into a chamber that smells of preservatives and old parchment.  Jewel-toned stained glass panes wink from the windows along the southern wall, letting in moonlight but mostly repelling the draft.

The gallery bends at an oak-framed maple door in the eastern wall, continuing to the southeast toward a wide marble-arched opening that leads into a chamber that smells of preservatives and old parchment.  Jewel-toned stained glass panes wink from the windows along the southern wall, letting in sunlight but mostly repelling the draft.

The gallery ends at an oak-framed doorway leading east toward a private chamber.  To the southeast, a narrow archway leads to another, smaller chamber.  Several panes have broken in the diamond-paned windows along the southern wall, creating an icy draft.

title: [Abbey, Library]
[Abbey Library]
description: Dark shelves line the walls, crowded with leather-bound volumes and racks full of painstakingly preserved scrolls.  A gleaming marble fireplace adorns the far wall of the cozy chamber, its tall plaster hood tapering gracefully into a spear-shaped point near the ceiling.  Tall mullioned windows permit moonlight into the room from the darkened landscape outside.

Dark shelves line the walls, crowded with leather-bound volumes and racks full of painstakingly preserved scrolls.  A gleaming marble fireplace adorns the far wall of the cozy chamber, its tall plaster hood tapering gracefully into a spear-shaped point near the ceiling.  Tall mullioned windows allow daylight into the room from the snow-covered landscape outside.

Dark shelves line the walls, filled with crumbling leather-bound volumes and scrolls.  A small fireplace stands at the far end of the room, its tall, plaster hood tapering gracefully into a spear-shaped point near the ceiling.  Tall mullioned windows reflect light into the room from the snow-covered landscape outside.

Dark shelves line the walls, filled with crumbling leather-bound volumes and scrolls.  A small fireplace stands at the far end of the room, its tall, plaster hood tapering gracefully into a spear-shaped point near the ceiling.  Tall mullioned windows reflect moonlight into the room from the snow-covered landscape outside.

title: [Abbey Prioress' Solar]
description: The coffered ceilings are of dark, ancient oak, trimmed faintly with gold leaf.  A faded grey and black mural on the plaster over the fireplace depicts the abbey in the days before it was converted from private residence to religious settlement.  Heraldic devices, faded with time, are painted on either side of the mural.

title: [Abbey Prioress' Chamber]
description: Small as any of the cells in the dorter, the chamber of the abbey's prioress is made brighter by a tall lancet window to the north.  To the east, a broken doorway leads to an even smaller chamber.

title: [Abbey Prioress' Garderobe]
description: The small laver beneath the window is still topped by a brass puma-shaped spout, green with age and corrosion.  A lead pipe leads from the drain of the laver through the wooden latrine covering.  On a small shelf above the laver are the remains of the small cistern.

title: [Abbey Dorter]
description: Small, poorly lit cells line the northern walls.  High, louvered windows provide the only source of light for these dormitory rooms.  Some of the cells still contain remnants of furniture, though for the most part, they are barren.

title: [Abbey, Dorter]
description: A colorful woven rug provides a lone spot of color amidst the grey, even walls of the dorter.  High, louvered windows let in a bit of pallid daylight, but otherwise, the light of torches is only sufficient to keep the hall in dim twilight.  The odor of beeswax wafts strongly from a plain spruce door in the western wall.

A colorful woven rug provides a lone spot of color amidst the grey, even walls of the dorter.  High, louvered windows let in a bit of tantalizingly bright moonglow, but otherwise, the light of torches is only sufficient to keep the hall in dim twilight.  The odor of beeswax wafts strongly from a plain spruce door in the western wall.

title: [Abbey, Dorter]
description: Small, spare cells line the walls, each guarded by a door with a slotted window.  Beyond, every cell is remarkably similar, housing a bed, nightstand, and writing desk.  Torches along the walls drive back the day's chill, but the dorter's entrance is open and doorless, waiting at the top of a narrow staircase.

Small, spare cells line the walls, each guarded by a door with a slotted window.  Beyond, every cell is remarkably similar, housing a bed, nightstand, and writing desk.  Torches along the walls drive back the bitter cold of night, but the dorter's entrance is open and doorless, waiting at the top of a narrow staircase.

title: [Abbey Cloistered Walk]
description: A narrow staircase climbs the stone walls of the abbey.  High hedges grow along the arcade, tidily tended.  They are verdant and green in a manner that seems inconsistent with the cold terrain.

title: [Abbey Cloistered Walk]
description: The columns supporting the graceful arches are carved with intricate ivy vines twined with rosebuds.  Iron brackets on the walls of the abbey hold remnants of thick, yellow beeswax candles.

title: [Abbey Cloistered Walk]
description: In the gap between the arcade and the wall of the chapel, a narrow strip of earth is lightly dusted with snow.  A single red crocus peeks from the white, apparently unbothered by the cold, providing a solitary spot of color amid the monochrome.

title: [Abbey Chapel]
description: Ornate doors of heavy bronze muffle sounds from outside of the chapel, a long chamber with a low maple ceiling that has fanciful patterns of leaves and rosettes carved into its surface.  Framed on either side by pews of sturdy spruce, a walk proceeds to the east.  A thickly balustraded stair along the northern wall spirals up into a small loft.
To the right, a thickly balustraded stair leads upwards.  The low oak ceiling is carved into a fanciful pattern of leaves and rosettes.

title: [Abbey Choir Loft]
description: At the top of the stair, the thick beam balustrade, seamless as if hewn from a single tree, is supported by thick wooden columns carved with rose vines and snowflakes.  Three shallow risers stand beneath the traceried lancet window that runs the length of the loft.

The thick beam balustrade, hewn from a single tree, is supported by thick wooden columns carved with vines of roses.  Three shallow risers stand beneath the traceried lancet window that runs the length of the loft.

title: [Abbey Chapel, Vaulted Aisle]
description: Vaulted aisles extend to the far end of the chapel, lit by sunlight streaming through narrow lancet windows in alternating niches along the walls.  Pews beneath the arcading are well worn, but just as well maintained.  At a break in the seating along the northern wall, a recessed niche features a heavy oaken panel trimmed with painted mournblooms and bleeding heart blossoms.
The vaulted aisles extend to the far end of the chapel.  Narrow lancet windows alternate with niches along the walls.  Stone benches beneath the arcading provide rest for the weary.

title: [Abbey Chapel, Vaulted Aisle]
description: Posts of ancient wood, each seamless as if hewn from the trunk of a single tree, stand wide and straight to either side of the aisle, supporting a beautifully intricate ceiling carved with depictions of each season at its height.  Sounds, no matter how slight, echo clearly off of the high ceiling and seemed magnified by its high curves.
The posts, each hewn from a single tree, stand wide and straight.  Sounds, no matter how slight, travel lightly along the high ceiling and seem magnified by the distance they must travel.

title: [Abbey Chapel, Altar]
description: The eastern wall is composed almost completely of leaded panes of glass that brilliantly shatter the sunlight and send it scattering in prismatic shards over the surface of a weathered stone altar.   Tall and narrow, the windows end in a trio of points covered by a single arched dripstone.
The eastern wall is composed almost completely of leaded panes of glass.  The windows, tall and narrow, end in a trio of points covered by a single arched dripstone.

title: [Abbey Cellar]
[Abbey, Cellar]
description: Long rows of oak wine casks create dark aisles in the cold, damp cellar.  The air is tinged with the musty scent of decaying wood mixed with the sweet smell of aged wine.  A crumbling doorway, propped by thick timbers, opens onto the kitchen garden.

Long rows of casks create dark aisles in the cold darkness of the cellar.  The air is heavy with the distinctive odor of fermented honey commingled with the dry, woodsy aroma of the aging casks.  A heavy spruce door, coated with hardened resin at the sides to better seal it when closed, opens onto the kitchen garden.

title: [Abbey Ossuary, Antechamber]
description: Thousands of wild rose petals carpet the cold stone floor, filling the chamber with a sweetly perfumed smell.  To either side of a heavy oaken panel leading out to the chapel, golden torch sconces support torches that bathe the antechamber in bright light.  Despite the roses' aroma, there is a creeping scent of death wafting up from a crumbling stone staircase leading down into stygian darkness.

Thousands of crushed, dried rose petals carpet the floor, blackened with age, their fragrance long since departed.  Golden torch sconces adorn the plain fitted stone walls, but no torches sit within them.  It is dark, yet quiet, lending a sense of serenity.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: The staircase narrows to a claustrophobic tunnel of greyish, fitted stone.  Sputtering torches throw dim, flickering light down the narrow corridor, giving a sense of life to the old slate flooring.  The dust-filled air is stale and heavy, smelling of rotting cloth and long-dry bone.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: Odd scraping sounds echo ominously within this intersection, their source unseen.  Torches cast dancing shadows upon one wall, their forms writhing across the cracked surface of the wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: A grate of sturdy iron guards an alcove carved into the pitted stone wall.  Inside the niche, a faded silk sash of ivory and crimson rests upon a cube of flawless white opal.  The thick iron bars are battered and bent, as if someone or something had tried unsuccessfully to relocate the treasures within.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: A huge column of marble dominates this room, tiny golden flecks within its form glittering in the scant illumination.  At its base is affixed a wooden plaque, eroded with the passage of time.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: Large ceremonial urns of glazed ceramic have been placed in every corner, each filled with a collection of dried bones.  One has been painted with a stylized wisp of green smoke, one with a skull, another with a pair of jackals, and the last with nothing save a single, unreadable rune.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: The still, ancient air deep in this tomb is sour and dry.  Deep, narrow alcoves along one wall hold the bones of the honored.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: The wavering shadows that fill this intersection flow with a pattern that seems to ignore the dim, flickering flames of torches held in ancient wall sconces.  Eerie dark shapes dance up and down the wall with purpose, seeming to vanish under a direct stare.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: A small path of pale rock chunks and powdered plaster leads up to a breached white brick wall at the ossuary's far end.  The wall looks to have exploded outward, as if blown apart from the other side.  Oddly undisturbed, a thin marble shelf to the left of the opening holds a tall slender vase, which is adorned with a dried garland of wild roses around its slender neck.  A flickering torch has been driven into the ground below it, though its light seems uncertain and barely throws back the darkness beyond the breach.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: Several large niches have been carved into the stone, each holding skeletal remains.  Long-withered flowers, brittle with time, lie in dusty piles at the base of each of these alcoves.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: A mound of polished skulls has been stacked with intricate precision so that their peak is just shy of reaching the ceiling.  A fence of golden chain has been built around the bones, securing them in their place of eternal honor.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: A heavy scraping sound echoes in the distance, methodical and repetitive.  An odd stain mars an otherwise featureless stone wall, four dark ragged lines that trace all the way to the floor, then lead off into the darkness.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: The floor tiling stops at a sunken rectangular pit completely filled with bones.  A faint rattling sound disturbs the silence, nothing more than a soft echo, and low clouds of dust filter from the pit as if something were moving underneath the collection of skulls and tibiae.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: Two urns of solid ivory, one tall and one squat, guard the entrance to this room, both deeply etched with the symbol of Oleani.  Dust crawls about the floor with every footfall, carpetlike in its thickness.  A single strand of web stretches the length of the room, creating a tiny bridge from one corner to the other, its delicate form swaying gently from some recent disturbance.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: Small golden studs have been pounded into the wall with symmetrical precision, perhaps as markers to remember those who faithfully served the goddess.  A quiet stillness encompasses the area, not even the faintest of sounds penetrating this gloom.

title: [Abbey, Pantry]
description: Sturdy wooden shelves completely line the walls of the abbey's pantry, each neatly crowded with rows of clay pots.  A plenitude of burlap sacks, stuffed with grains and other dry goods, crowds most of the available floor space.

title: [Abbey, Kitchen]
description: A large granite fireplace occupies most of the northern wall.  Suspended within on a spit is a roasted deer that has been roasted to perfection.  Clinging to the carved granite inner wall, three broad stone steps lead downward towards the buttery, while an archway to the south leads into the abbey's pantry.  Laden heavily with fresh herbs, a great stone table stands squarely in the center of the room.

title: [Abbey, Buttery]
description: Wide shelves climb the walls, holding mead tankards crafted from steel, stone, and bone.  The wide windows of the great hall are brightly visible through the traceries of the buttery screen, which sits beneath a small gallery that partially comprises the ceiling of the buttery.

Wide shelves climb the walls, holding mead tankards crafted from steel, stone, and bone.  The wide windows of the great hall are barely visible through the traceries of the buttery screen, which sits beneath a small gallery that partially comprises the ceiling of the buttery.

title: [Abbey, Minstrels' Gallery]
[Abbey Minstrels' Gallery]
description: Velvet-padded wooden stools are spaced near to the railing of the small balcony, meant to provide rest for the musicians who entertain the abbey's guests.   The traceries of the parapet are ornate and intricate.  Several music stands are stowed to one corner, discreetly out of view of the grand hall below.

Wooden stools that once provided rest for the musicians who entertained the abbey's guests now lie broken and splintered upon the floor.  The traceries of the parapet are less ornate and intricate than those of the buttery screen below, indicating that this room was perhaps a later addition.

title: [A Winding Path]
[Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: The stone pathway continues around a bend in the mountainside.  The drop-off at the edge of the pathway is abrupt, although the pathway itself still seems intact.

title: [A Winding Path]
[Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: Every branch of the trees is covered in sheaths of silver ice.  The effect is mesmerizingly beautiful.  At the side of the pathway, the leaves and buds on a small rose bush are encased in ice as clear as crystal.

title: [A Winding Path]
[Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: The trail breaks into two sections, one several feet higher than the other, as though sliced by a giant hand.  A small frozen rivulet hangs like a glistening teardrop from the edge of the cut.

title: [A Winding Path]
[Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: The pathway rises, shifting sometimes eastward, sometimes westward, ever continuing up the side of the mountain.  Dead grey wood and stunted black pine trees jut into the pathway, but do not obliterate it.

title: [A Winding Path]
[Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: Curving around the base of the mountain, the stone pathway provides solid footing.  Tundra gives way now to stunted branches and twigs, sheltered from the blowing winds by the rising side of the mountain.

title: [A Winding Path]
[Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: An enormous landslide chokes the pathway, yet it is not as impenetrable as it first appeared.  Beneath the rubble, traces of a wider, stone pathway emerge and continue upwards and around the base of a broad mountain.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Passage to the east is blocked by an enormous landslide.  Rocks and ice long ago melded together to form a slick, seemingly unclimbable barrier.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Several paths converge here in a well trod circle of hard, packed earth.  High snowdrifts form a circle providing a semblance of brief shelter from the passing wind.  One nearby drift is frozen near solid around a dark object.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Passing winds have swirled the snow here into delicate designs, forming a winter tapestry covering the ground.  The snow is marked with glistening shards of ice and small piles of smooth pebbles.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: A deep snowfield blocks passage to the east, sparkling brightly with a fresh layer of snow.  Small stones scatter the ground, their edges worn smooth by years of cold and wind.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: The mountainside winds down into a deep valley to the east, marred with the debris of many a long ago landslide.  Deep scratch marks in the snow attest to the danger of wandering too far from the well-marked trail.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: A steep cliff falls away to the south, the edge buried under a deep layer of snow.  Stepping cautiously, you note how difficult it is to see where the trail ends and oblivion begins.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: A large boulder blocks passage to the west, imbedded deeply into the frozen ground.  Its age is belied by the deep cracks worn in its near smooth surface.  Colorful moss grows in a soft carpet around the base of the boulder.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: A small rise lifts you high above the rest of the tundra here.  Squinting against the blowing snow, you gaze about and realize the view extends hundreds of miles in every direction.  Far off in the distance, Wehnimer's Landing is visible as a small speck on the shores of Darkstone Bay.

A small rise lifts you high above the rest of the tundra here.  Squinting against the blowing snow, you gaze about and realize the view extends hundreds of miles in every direction.  Far off in the distance, the dim night lights of Wehnimer's Landing are visible as a small glow on the shores of Darkstone Bay.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Life on the tundra is a constant struggle against the elements, leaving it barren except for the few plants hardy enough to survive.  Tiny yellow flowers struggle up between the rocks, reaching for any glimmer of light.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Hardy tundra grass clings to the rocky ground, the only life strong enough to survive on these plains.  High snow-covered peaks tower in the far distance, watching over all Elanthia.  A tight trail leads back down into the trees.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Snowfields line both sides of the path, swirled into delicate patterns by the constant chilling wind.  Occasional tufts of brown grass poke their way up above the snow cover, scavenging any light they can.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Ice crackles underfoot as you pass along the edge of a towering glacier.  Sparkling hues of blue and yellow glint off the glacier, and a closer look reveals patches of colorful moss clinging to its side.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: A small garrison of ice and snow looms to the east, shining brightly with an inner glow.  A tower reaches high overhead, sparkling with fresh snow crystals.
A small garrison of ice and snow looms to the east, shining with an inner glow in the moonlight.  A tower reaches high overhead, sparkling with fresh snow crystals.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Heavy snowdrifts hinder passage along the north side of the snow fort, making each step a worthy task.  Blowing snow covers your tracks behind you, leaving the tundra unmarked.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Broken icicles litter the ground, fallen from the high fort walls towering above you.  To the southeast, a sturdy snow arch has formed over a deep ravine.  Footprints trampled in the snow to the southeast imply safe passage.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: A sparkling peninsula of ice bridges the deep ravine in front of the garrison entrance.  High overhead, a lone falcon calls out as it passes, searching for prey.  Tiny tracks in the snow give evidence that there is more to this tundra than meets the eye.

A moonlit peninsula of ice bridges the deep ravine in front of the garrison entrance.  High overhead, a lone snowy owl calls out as it passes, searching for prey.  Tiny tracks in the snow give evidence that there is more to this tundra than meets the eye.

title: [Snow Fort, Bridge]
description: Ice crunches beneath your feet as you carefully make your way along the bridge.  A deep ravine disappears into the distance below the bridge, causing you to briefly wonder on the countless souls who met oblivion below.  A translucent arch of ice and snow is carved into the side of the fort.

title: [Snow Fort, Entry]
description: Crystals dance high overhead along the packed snow ceiling of the entryway.  Several small niches have been carved into the walls to accent elaborate ice carvings.  A light breeze blows through the room, seeming to start somewhere down the narrow passages leading out.

title: [Snow Fort, Tunnel]
description: This round tunnel through the ice twists and turns towards an upward slope.  The shimmering ice crystals are nearly blinding in their beauty, their light dancing across the remains of a fallen statue lying near one wall.  The statue may have been beautiful in its day, but now lies scattered in pieces on the floor.

title: [Snow Fort, Tunnel]
description: Shards of ice litter the ground of the passage, pieces of a strange mirror, broken long ago.  Whatever broke the ice mirror did so with amazing force, imbedding even the tiniest bits deep in the passage walls.  Kicked off to one side, the remains of a vultite frame lie in shambles on the ground.

title: [Snow Fort, Passage]
description: Torches line the walls of this passage, flaring with an eerie blue flame.  The smooth ice walls seem unaffected by the flames, in fact they glow with the same blue light.  The cold glow dances and flickers hypnotically, until it seems the tunnel walls and floor twist and writhe beneath you.

title: [Snow Fort, Spiral]
description: A frozen tower of dark ice spirals far above and below.  The jagged edges of the ice provide barely enough friction to enable you to continue on your way.  Light filters down from somewhere high up the spiral.

title: [Snow Fort, Battlement]
description: Ensconced torches glow with a magical blue fire, casting a cold light out over the battlement.  High above the tundra now, it seems all of Elanthia stretches out below you.

title: [Snow Fort, Battlement]
description: Crumbled piles of snow mark spots where the battlement walls have succumbed to the elements.  Through the broken sections the frozen tundra can be seen far below, swirling with powdery snow flurries.

title: [Snow Fort, Battlement]
description: Deep gashes mar the frozen floor, as if something heavy or unwilling had been dragged across it.  Scratched into the battlement walls, cryptic runes point toward the southwest.

title: [Snow Fort, Battlement]
description: A high wall of ice and snow bends over the battlement, forming a ceiling of sorts.  Resting beneath it, an ominous gallows stands guard over several stone benches arranged as pews before it.  The walls of this room, while still ice and snow, seem less smooth than elsewhere in the fort and somewhat disturbing as well.

title: [Snow Fort, Tunnel]
description: Ice spirals and swirls about you along passages leading off in several directions.  Ancient runes and symbols are etched deep into the frozen walls, though their significance is indecipherable.

title: [Snow Fort, Ice Altar]
description: An elaborate chapel is hollowed out of the ice here, calling praise to an unknown deity.  Towering pure white pillars stand sentinel over a massive altar of snow and ice.  Strange, ensconced torches illuminate the altar, glowing with a cold blue fire.

title: [Arctic Tundra, Under Altar]
description: Several lanterns light the corners of this tiny room.  Warm fur throws cover the floor, providing a sense of comfort.  Nestled in one corner is a tiny trapdoor.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Rough tundra grass grows at the base of the south castle wall, sheltered from the elements.  A small pile of stones rests here, carefully arranged into a pyramid of unknown origin.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: High snow drifts line both sides of the faint trail here, encroaching upon it in spots.  They serve as a reminder that nothing is permanent on the high plains, but merely tolerated.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Towering frozen walls curve over the path.  The ground is covered by ice blanketed with snow, which masks a beautiful yet slippery danger.

title: [A Steep Trail]
description: The icy air grows thin at this altitude, making any exertion difficult.  High above, the trail opens out onto a wide, snow-blanketed plain.  A lone fir tree climbs precariously to the trail side, bent close to the ground from years of pummeling by the deadly winter winds.  Nestled against the mountain, a dark tower stands within the shadow of the peak like a spectral sentinel watching the trail.

title: [A Steep Trail]
description: A chilling wind whips down from above, stirring the dirt along this narrow trail.  The vegetation grows sparse here, only a few scrawny firs cling to the mountain side, their branches bent and gnarled.

title: [Mountainside, Snow Drifts]
description: A high cliff towers before you, impassable but for the rubble of an ancient landslide.  Among the boulders and strewn rocks, a trail is visible twisting up the mountainside.

title: [Mountainside, Snow Drifts]
description: Heavy snow mounds rise high on either side of the trail, providing some shelter from the wind.  A few hardy pines grow along the trailside.  From high up in the pines, the chatter of squirrels can be heard.

title: [A Wooded Path]
description: Fresh snow rests on the branches of the cedar trees lining the narrow path.  The conifers choke out much of the underbrush that grows here, the remaining scattered shrubs struggle for light.

title: [Lost In The Woods]
description: Tracks of previous travelers wander aimlessly through the snow.  A large spruce tree lies on the ground off to the side, covered in ice and snow.  The small open area where the tree once stood lets the bitter-cold breeze flow through the area.
The silence of the snow-covered forest is frightening.  Distant howls of coyotes and occasional sounds of snow falling from high branches is all that can be heard.

It is difficult to see any great distance through the dense forest.  Landmarks are sparse, making it tough to navigate your way out of the trees.  You hear a faint rustling coming from a small bush off to the side of the trail.
An oddly shaped cedar tree stands off to the side of the trail.  An owl is startled by your presence, and its screech echos through the forest as it flies off.
The path here winds through the trees and braches off into several directions.  You have lost all sense of direction and wonder if you are ever going to make it out of this maze.
Tracks from a snowshoe hare meander in and out of the dense forest.  A few fallen branches lay in the middle of the trail, but are not large enough to impede your progress.

The trees are starting to all look the same, giving you the feeling you are lost.  The tops of the conifers sway silently in the chilly breeze.  You notice a small critter darting through the woods out of the corner of your eye.
The tracks in the snow here look familiar, making you wonder if you are just walking in circles.  A strange chittering coming from up in a tree echos through the cold dry air of the forest.

Snow drifts against fallen trees off of the beaten paths.  Occasionally, the sounds of snow falling from branches can be heard throughout the forest.  The trees all look alike, making you wonder if you have been here before.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: There is no distinguishing feature in the midst of all the snow.  You squint your eyes against the blowing wind and snow.  Trails lead this way and that across the snowfield.
There is no distinguishing feature in the midst of all the snow.  You squint your eyes against the brightness of your surroundings.  Trails lead this way and that across the snowfield.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: To the south, the glow of lamps backlights the protective town walls, providing assurance that civilization is nearby.  Continuing northward, the snowy path climbs a small hill before disappearing into the darkness created by a stand of trees.  In the quiet of the night, the soft strain of tavern music drifts on the wind.

To the south, a comforting glimpse of the town wall assures that civilization is nearby and within easy reach.  Continuing northward, the snowy path climbs a small hill before disappearing back into the trees.

title: [Northern Fortress, Facade]
description: Winding its way through a large open field, the broad flagstone pathway ends at the bottom of a short flight of stone steps.  Crenellated in design and constructed of cut granite, an imposing keep rests on a hilltop, the stone steps leading the way to its massive double doors.  Flanking the doors are two well-sculpted drake statues carved into fierce stances atop their stone platforms.  Battle standards have been placed behind each statue, the banners snapping loudly in the wind.

title: [Northern Fortress, Entry Hall]
description: Framed by an arched oak beam ceiling high overhead, the great windowless hall is lit by dimly glowing braziers set into each corner of the room.  A giant four-pointed star of cerulean-hued stone is inset into the center of the lightly buffed grey marble floor.  Standing open, some oak double doors lead further into the keep, while a pair of iron-bound doors lead outside.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: A chill wind blows down from beyond the glacier, rustling the sparse clumps of grass along the ground.  The high walls of Icemule Trace tower overhead, muffling the noises of the town beyond.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: A red brick chimney peeks above the high stone walls of Icemule Trace.  The laughter of children rings clearly in the crisp air.  A plume of white smoke billows overhead, fading to a mere pinpoint in the sunlit sky.

A red brick chimney peeks above the high stone walls of Icemule Trace.  The calm and quiet of the night settles like a blanket on the immediate area.  A plume of white smoke billows overhead, fading to a mere pinpoint in the moonlit sky.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Rivulets of water have seeped beyond the sparse patches of grass and onto the pathway.  Due to the cold weather, the water has frozen over, creating tiny slippery veins on the well-trodden path.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Widening somewhat, the path expands to accommodate both wagons and people.  Judging from several pairs of ruts, perhaps many have glanced at the narrowing trail to the north and turned around to look for a different way to enter the town walls.  Dark patches of the ground have been revealed from all the comings and goings, contrasting with the pale snow here.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: A light coating of sand crunches with each step, adding some traction to the icy, slick pathway.  The howl of a nocturnal animal echoes in the night, its lonesome cry continuing unanswered.  Moonlight makes the snow softly glitter here and there and gives it a pale blue cast.

A light coating of sand crunches with each step, adding some traction to the icy, slick pathway.  The loping tracks of a creature trail along for a bit before heading towards the forest.  A young pine tree pushes its way up through the drift, the wiry branches tipped with a slight dusting of snow.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Level ground makes the path more defined as the snow has been tamped down to create a firm base.  Constant traffic packs the soft powder into a thick cushion, slightly slippery from the daily melting and nightly refreezing at the edge of the glacier.  Spidery tracings of snow are plastered along the stone wall guarding the town, a result of wind kicking up the drifts.

Level ground makes the path more defined as the snow has been tamped down to create a firm base.  Constant traffic packs the soft powder into a thick cushion, slightly slippery from the daily melting and nightly refreezing at the edge of the glacier.  Gusts of wind carry the loose snow covering the top of the nearby town wall up into feathery, ice crystal plumes silhouetted against the indigo night.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Needles of the nearby conifers lie scattered on the otherwise clear path.  A bright yellow scabbard hangs from an exposed limb, swinging gently in the chill wind.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Wind gusts billow powdering snow down from the distant glacier, coating everything in sight.  Someone has taken to measuring snowfalls against the height of the town walls, judging from the numerous red lines on the grey stones.  Wedged securely between the stones is a faded wooden yardstick.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Pebbles have been strewn across the path for additional traction.  An adjacent snowbank has been covered with the numerous tracks of small animals.  The prints split in every direction as they approach the protective cover of trees.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Someone has chipped away at the town wall to create a small hole.  A bundle of pure white moonflowers burst from the opening.  Their delicate petals perfectly match the pristine surrounding snow.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: A small tower rises at this corner of the town walls, indistinct as the same stones comprise both structures.  The small windows high above are shuttered against the light of day.  Long and slender icicles dangle like fingers, pointing towards the ground.

A small tower rises at this corner of the town walls, indistinct as the same stones comprise both structures.  The small windows high above are points of light that glow within the darkness of the night.  Long and slender icicles dangle like fingers, pointing towards the ground.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Thick snowberry bushes run along this corner of Icemule's stone wall, enclosing its well-trodden path.  Some of the glossy white fruit has fallen to the ground and been trampled.  The choicest berries are continuously being harvested by bushy tailed squirrels that dart in and out of the foliage.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Snow blankets the landscape, though the path around Icemule Trace has been cleared, leaving piles of snow flush against the stone wall.  Shrubbery grows in great abundance here, most notably winterberry with its showy red berries.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Much of the snow has been cleared away from the stone walls, though some streaks of white still cover the frozen ground.  The green peaks of firs and pines dot the surrounding area, covered in a coat of thick snow.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Workbenches and temporary shelters of pinewood dot the hardy red tundra grasses on the small thoroughfare, which passes beneath the high stone walls of Icemule Trace.  The fortifications span east and west for quite a distance in either direction.  At this close a proximity, the bustle of Icemule Trace's southern gate is a dull roar in the crisp, cold air.

Poking through a layer of frost are patches of hardy tundra grass.  Rising stone walls span east and west for quite a distance in each direction.  The bustle of Icemule Trace's South Gate is quite audible at this close proximity.

title: [A Snow-covered Path]
description: Almost completely hidden by snowy boughs, a narrow, secluded path winds northeast towards a tall stone gatehouse.  Fallen pine needles from the coniferous forest pad the trail with a fragrant carpet.

title: [Williwaw Hall, Gate House]
description: The grey stone of the gatehouse is a sharp contrast to the deep green pine of the surrounding trees.  Narrow lancet windows are set on either side of the gatehouse doorway.  Strands of ivy vines are beginning to take hold on the stones, smoothing the rough edges with the natural softness of their leaves.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: Snowdrifts rest against the exterior wall of Icemule Trace.  The snowfield spreads as far south as you can see.  Someone has created a statue of snow and ice that leans against the wall, its edges worn away by recent snowfalls.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: The footprints in the snow provide the only indication that others have passed this way before you.  You can make out a dark line in the distance across the rolling snowfield.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: The dark line in the distance does not appear to be any closer.  Quick, sudden gusts of ice and snow swirl around you, making progress difficult.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: An icy blast of wind from the north tugs at you, making it difficult to walk.  It is only luck which keeps you from falling into the drifts that line the trails.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield Trench]
description: A deep trench has been dug into the snowdrifts, creating a wind-free pathway.  The sides of the trench rise above you until they are above your head, muffling the sounds of the icy winds that blow across the snowfield.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield Trench]
description: Wind whistles above you as you continue along the sharp turn in the trench.  An oozing, green lichen grows on the walls of the trench and fills the air with a musty scent.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield Trench]
description: The trench continues east and west and its walls stretch higher than your fingertips can reach.  Far above, you can see snow blowing across the trench, but none of the flakes ever reach this level.  The air is damp and close, as though the breath of all who have passed here has never been cleaned away.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield Trench]
description: Lichen almost completely covers the walls and the air is filled with the smell of moist decay.  Gagging, you almost miss the sharp bend in the trench as it makes a hairpin turn.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield Trench]
description: A large flat stone has been pressed into the trench wall.  The walls of the trench blend smoothly with the drifts covering the snowfield, replacing their dank walls with surroundings of pure white.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: A dark line of trees forms the eastern boundary of the snowfield.  Animal tracks lead off in a variety of directions, crossing the main trail and confusing the pathway.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: A single tree grows here, the bark on its limbs twisting and peeling away, as though someone had grabbed it and wrenched it violently.  Icicles, some of them reaching down into the snow, hang forlornly from its branches.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Winding around and between the giant conifers, the path is almost buried due to the snow that sloughs off the branches from time to time.  The darkness makes it difficult to navigate between the haunting silhouettes.

Winding around and between the giant conifers, the path is almost buried due to the snow that sloughs off the branches from time to time.  Dried pinecones, opened like blossoms, skitter across the glistening surface with each windy gust.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: A row of pines nearly conceals a wooden archway to the east.  The wind blows through the upper branches of the trees, alternately hiding or revealing some sort of building in that direction.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: A drift of snow curls against the southeastern corner of the wall which surrounds Icemule Trace.  The snowfield stretches away to the south and ends at a dark line on the horizon.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: Aside from the eastern wall of Icemule Trace a short distance to the west and the freshly dug path that leads through the halfling-high snow to the southwest, the only thing to break the monotony of the tedious blanket of white is the gentle slope that begins to rise to the northeast.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield Slope]
description: Chill wind blows across the slope, kicking up shifting drifts of snow that nearly obscure the path.  Something that might be the town wall of Icemule Trace is faintly visible through the flurries to the west, and the weather seems clearer further up the slope to the northeast.

title: [Snowfields, Slope]
description: A long, slowly rising slope leads up to a pack of small houses and a low stone wall huddled together against the weather.  Steps are cut into the ice, and a wooden rail has been set into the stairs to make the slippery climb easier.  Snow blows across the incline, dusting the steps frequently and more completely hiding the footfalls of previous travellers with each passing minute.

title: [Snowfields, Avalanche Road]
description: Tall banks of snow act as windbreaks for the houses huddling in their lee, encircling the small neighborhood.  A thick sheet of permafrost covers the daily-plowed roadway, making the surface more of a skating rink than a true street.  Children take advantage of it, running quickly down the hills, then sliding as far as they can down the ice.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Snowfields, Icicle Avenue]
description: Footprints lead up the side of a snowy hill, ending a short distance away.  A string of snow angels sits at the top of the trail, having frozen into semi-permanent shapes in the smooth white surface.  Above the makeshift artwork, a thick shelf of snow partially shields the area from being covered up by inclement weather.

title: [Snowfields, Icicle Avenue]
description: Originally an ice quarry, the snowfields have been converted by the adventurous and the well-heeled into a habitable neighborhood.  Steep banks prevent the worst of the weather from reaching the homes, while heavily pitched roofs force snow to slide off to the sides of the buildings.  The roadway and paths snaking around the area appear to have been recently cleared from the constant snowfall.

title: [Snowfields, Icicle Avenue]
description: Black clouds build in the distance, perhaps another storm preparing to sweep across the flats, its fury unchecked.  Snowflakes flutter gently down from the grey, overcast sky, tossed around at the mercy of a swirling breeze.  The lights from the houses in the neighborhood reflect off the low-hanging clouds, making the heavy slate shade a lighter grey directly overhead.

title: [Snowfields, Blizzard Way]
description: The harsh weather has given a creative individual the wonderful idea of creating a playground of ice and snow.  Hollowed out tubes create snakey slides whipping through the heart of the snowbank, while a plank leads up to an icy pirate ship.  Another icy spot creates a makeshift flat slide for children to skim across before careening into a fluffy embankment.

title: [Snowfields, Blizzard Way]
description: Rocks are visible within the northern icewall of the former quarry, the farthest projection into the hillside the project managed to accomplish.  Iron ore veins leach slowly out of the stone, leaving a trail of red flakes as dark as blood within the cold surface.  Remnants of avalanches have all but covered the mines, the entrances lost long ago in legend.

title: [Snowfields, Blizzard Way]
description: Remnants of a massive avalanche that swept across the edge of the quarry and down into the pit have left an immense blockade of snow covering the road.  A large tunnel has been laboriously drilled through the ice and rock to allow passage and stand against future disasters.  Several villagers have taken advantage of the wide tunnel, building homes within its protective cover.

title: [Snowfields, Blizzard Way]
description: A rack of ice tongs lies fallen in the deep snow, unused and virtually forgotten.  A row of houses nestle up against the outside wall of the quarry, having been constructed by an adventurous few thumbing their noses at the avalanche reputation of the area.  The last few scrapes made by the workers can still be seen in the escarpment.

title: [Snowfields, Blizzard Way]
description: The former office of the ice quarry stands slightly apart from the rest of the buildings.  Blackened timber and a caved-in roof are all that remains of the burned-out hulk, a silent reminder to the former quarryhands.  Thick walls of ice hold up the wood, the water used to douse the flames having become a solid reminder of the fierce weather that rips through the area.

title: [Snowfields, Frozen Lane]
description: A well that has been built of thick stone blocks sits prominently by the side of the road.  Heat rises up from the thermal waters and meets the cold air headed down into the cylinder, creating a thick fog that spills out over the edges of the rockwork and dissipates across the ground.

title: [Snowfields, Frozen Lane]
description: Remnants of the former ice block operation have become parts of homes and snow clearing devices.  Prints in the deep snow indicate wandering animals in search of food encroach upon the settlement frequently.  The wind howls in frustration overhead, whipping ice and snow across the embankment, not quite reaching the housing.

title: [Snowfields, Frozen Lane]
description: Scrapes and scratches have been gouged into the flagstones paving the road's surface by the deep digging of the heavy snowplow.  Tall evergreens mark the boundaries of the street, with lengths of icy chain between them serving as fences.  Thick smoke curls up from chimneys, adding to the grey clouds hanging low overhead.

title: [Snowfields, Frozen Lane]
description: A horse-drawn plow and several shovels rest by the side of the road, awaiting the next major storm.  A massive chain hangs from the front of the plow to fasten to a team of draft horses or some other huge pack animal.  A large scrape along the edge of the roadway looks to have been created by the blade of the plow hitting a protruding flagstone as it was pushed over the ice-covered street.

title: [Snowfields, Frozen Lane]
description: An enterprising young child has set up a stand on the street corner.  Scrawled crudely on a rough wooden sign attached to the makeshift booth is a picture of a fruit basket and an icicle.  Several vials sit on the counter filled with different flavorings, while a string holding quite a few icicles hangs across the low store front.

title: [Snowfields, Avalanche Road]
description: The remains of the ice quarry operation, shut down long ago by avalanches crashing down from the mountainsides, are visible here.  A tall berm has been constructed along the outer edge of the pit, blocking and rerouting the dangerous falls.  Some enterprising group has created a neighborhood that circles what remains of the operation, turning the dangerous area into an attraction of sculptured snow.

title: [Snowfields, Avalanche Road]
description: A huge ice-covered boulder blocks the road, forcing the flow of traffic to split around its massive bulk to get by.  A set of stairs is cut into the stone, enabling the more adventurous to climb to its windswept top for a view of the valley to the northwest.  A chain across the bottom of the stairs announces that the vantage point is closed until further notice.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Garden]
description: A broken-down farm house stands just inside the wooden archway, its empty door and broken windows leering over the snow-filled garden.  A dilapidated barn slumps into the snow to the north of the garden.  To the southeast, a thin trail leads around the corner of the house.

wayto.31352: ;e if GameObj.inv.find {|obj| obj.noun == "key"};fput "go snow cabin";else;empty_hand;multifput "get my key from my #{UserVars.key_sack}","go snow cabin","put my key in my #{UserVars.key_sack}";fill_hand;end

title: [Abandoned Farm, Kitchen]
description: Plaster peels from the walls exposing large patches of grey stone.  There are no furnishings left in this room except for the brick mantel over the wide fireplace.  Broken crockery is heaped in a corner and the windows are shutterless.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Hall]
description: The narrow window at the end of the hall is barred--from the inside.  Logs and broken bits of furniture are piled against the window and scattered across the floor.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Parlor]
description: The bannisters are missing from the stairway leading upstairs from the parlor.  As elsewhere in this house, everything is either broken or crushed.  Tattered cloths droop from warped curtain rods over the arched windows.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Upper Hall]
description: Dark, watery stains discolor the ceiling and the walls.  Flakes of plaster form a gritty dust on the hardwood floor.  Long strands of dust hang in the corners of the ceiling and in the doorways.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Attic]
description: Large patches of the roof are missing, exposing the wattle framework.  The wood floor is warped from the years of exposure to the elements.  The air is heavy with the smell of mildew and decay.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Attic]
description: The wattle of woven twigs and sticks forming the walls is visible through its thin coat of plaster.  Shredded paper and cloth are strewn about the floor and stuffed into holes in the ceiling.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Bedroom]
description: The low ceiling slopes downward almost to the floor.  As in the hallway below, furniture is piled against the barred window as though the occupants had tried in vain to keep something out.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Bedroom]
