description: The bed is slashed and the frame splintered.  Broken glass litters the floor in a wide arc from the open window across the room.  A faded rocking horse lies on its side in the corner, its severed head crushed as though it had been stomped on by heavy nailed boots.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Garden]
description: A rain barrel has been upturned and placed beneath an open window.  Deep scratches mar the walls and the door which leads down into the cellar.  A withered vine still clings to a broken trellis against the house.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Cellar]
description: The narrow windows near the ceiling of the cellar are translucent with grime.  Jagged pieces of blue and green glass litter the ground and crunch under your feet.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Cellar]
description: The earthen walls of the cellar are deeply gouged by claw marks.  Dirt and dust rise as you move through the room, obscuring your vision and clogging your nose and throat.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Cellar]
description: The hard-packed dirt floor is littered with debris from the collapsed shelves which once lined the walls.  A row of rusted hooks and splintered wood are still in place beneath a small, grimy window near the ceiling.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Barn]
description: Snow blows in through the cracks and missing planks of the barn.  Low stone walls frame several empty stalls to the north while from the west comes a nauseating stench.  A rickety ladder leads upwards into the gloom.

title: [Abandoned Barn, Stall]
description: The lower half of the stall is made of crumbling stone.  Rust marks are all that is left of the iron gate that shut one stall from the next.  Molding hay lines the manger and fills the air with the scent of decay.

title: [Abandoned Barn, Stall]
description: The lower half of the stall is made of crumbling stone.  Rust marks are all that is left of the iron gate that shut one stall from the next.  Molding hay lines the manger and fills the air with the scent of decay.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Yard]
description: The hard-packed earth of the yard is cluttered with heaps of broken equipment and rusty tools.  Ramshackle wooden buildings lean into each other, as though a sudden gust of wind might come through and demolish them all.  A broken plank leads into the barn.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Yard]
description: Packed snow covers the yard, making the area seem rather large and open.  Several rain barrels are frozen along a thin wood-framed building in puddles of brownish ice.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Yard]
description: Lengths of rotting fencing sag beneath the weight of brambles climbing over them, struggling to reclaim this stretch of open land.  The snow lingers in thick clumps on the brambles.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Yard]
description: A ravine is visible beneath the bramble hedge.  The dark, rocky sides and black brambles are accentuated by the patches of white snow.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Yard]
description: The ravine has swallowed up the remains of the wooden fencing, while its companion brambles rear up to climb the lowest branches of the trees at the edge of the yard.

title: [Bramble Ravine]
description: Gnarled, thick brambles clutch at any protrusion on the surface of the ravine.  The thorny black limbs pull down hunks of rock and smother small evergreens trying to establish a foothold.

title: [Bramble Ravine]
description: Without a covering of greenery or a redeeming offering of berries, the brambles twist and grope like writhing snakes.  A cold mist rises from the ground in a chilly caress.

title: [Bramble Ravine]
description: A picture of eerie beauty, the white mists curl gently around the trunks of stark black brambles.  Spiked branches twist this way and that, their intertwining limbs creating a mosaic of black against the white.

title: [Bramble Ravine]
description: The footing is treacherous beyond this point as icy rocks and sharp spikes combine in an effort to throw you to the ground.  Branches snap and crackle in the undergrowth as though some small creature is attempting to bypass this route.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Outhouse]
description: Long neglected, the wood-frame is rotting and partially collapsed.  The smell of decaying organic matter is heavy in the small enclosed space.  In between the gaps in the walls, one can see the snow-covered yard.  At least, it's warm inside the building.

Long neglected, the wood-frame is rotting and partially collapsed.  The smell of decaying organic matter is heavy in the small enclosed space.  In between the gaps in the walls, one can see the snow-covered yard.

title: [Abandoned Barn, Pen]
description: A dark brown pit bubbles and froths in this open-air enclosure.  The snow melts around the muddy ooze creating dark rivulets.  Your nose tells you that this was once the pigsty of the farm.

title: [Abandoned Barn, Hayloft]
description: A rickety ladder leans up against the edge of the hayloft, providing the only means of escape.  Most of the roof is gone from this part of the barn and snow drifts fill the corners in a soft blanket over the jumble of broken farming implements left behind when this farm was abandoned.

title: [Abandoned Barn, Hayloft]
description: A chill breeze flows in through the chinks in the walls and the gaping holes in the barn roof.  It looks as though this loft had been used as a camping spot for vagrants.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: Snow nearly covers stacks of rotting crates that form a fence between the farm house and the apple orchard.  Gnarled and twisted old apple trees raise their blackened arms to the sky, as though begging for another chance to bear fruit.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: Rows of apple trees stand covered with snow, their trunks curled and branches broken.  Rotting planks that once braced fruit-laden branches now curve limply against the trunks of the leafless trees.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: The end of the apple orchard is marked by a mound of petrified fruit dusted with snow.  Shriveled and frozen, the dried apples look more like tiny skulls than fruit.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: The ground ripples beneath the snow in long, undulating rows.  The wheat stubble beneath the snowy ground cover is sharp enough to pierce most boots.  It is much easier to walk along in the furrows than battle the long-frozen grain.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: The snow-covered field stretches on for miles.  A forlorn scarecrow, its clothes blown to tattered strips of cloth by the sharp glacial breeze, stands guard over fields which will forever lie fallow.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: The fields end in a deep, boggy ravine filled with small cloudberry bushes and broken equipment.  There does not appear to be any way to cross the ravine without considerable loss of skin and blood.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: A fallen apple tree spans a steep, icy ravine, and snow blankets the ground evenly, hiding any and all traces of undergrowth or life.  A small boulder pokes its top out of the clean, white snow, as if struggling from being smothered.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: A rusted iron plow rises out of the deep snow, its days of usefulness long since gone.  The chill breeze carries with it the mournful sound of those who no longer till this frozen wasteland.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: Ominous shapes can be seen in the distance, their shadowy figures disguised and unrecognizable in the falling snow.  Footprints lead off in every direction, some more recent then others, none of them bearing any resemblance to your own.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: An old sinkhole has collapsed the field, causing a huge bowl-like depression to form.  The center of the pit is a mass of loose branches, dried leaves, and many other unrecognizable things that the wind has managed to pick up and place here.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: Sacks have been heaped in a pile here, the burlap fabric rotting and blackened.  Grain of some sort still rests within the sacks, mostly moldy and frozen.  Ice has piled up against the bags, unable as of yet to topple them.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: The remains of a wooden fence poke up from the frosty ground, the rails warped from years of water damage.  Ragged pieces of torn cloth have caught on the rough edges, the wind causing them to ripple with the breeze.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: Runoff from numerous spring thaws has formed a small carpet of hardened ice.  Within the dark, slick ice, you can see hazy, nebulous shapes frozen in time, no longer recognizable, but well-preserved in their icy stasis.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: Withered stalks of corn bend oddly from the ground, the decaying plants hobbled and stooped like old men against the harsh winter.  The wind catches the dried leaves of the plants, which tumble to litter the stark white snowfall around you.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: An empty and half-collapsed barn provides no cover from the terrible cold here.  A door swings slowly open and shut in the tug of the wind, its dance repetitive and never ceasing.  A massive pile of snow leans up against one of the remaining walls of the structure.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Field]
description: A lone tree has managed to sprout up in the middle of this barren field and survive the wind and cold, its branches twisted and intertwined.  The skeleton of something not quite humanoid hangs limply from one of the empty branches, the breeze shifting it ever so slowly in an eerie spiral.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Abandoned Farm, Forest]
description: A wickedly steep slope leads to the south, the pale sunlight glinting from its smooth, mirror-like surface.  Splintered hafts and handles of some long-destroyed implements litter the ground and protrude from the trunks of dead trees, having been forced harshly into the once-living wood.

A wickedly steep slope leads to the south, the pale moonlight glinting from its smooth, mirror-like surface.  Splintered hafts and handles of some long-destroyed implements litter the ground and protrude from the trunks of dead trees, having been forced harshly into the once-living wood.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Forest]
description: Snowbanks form a maze of hills here, obscuring vision, and quiet white flakes scatter in the moderate breeze, decreasing visibility still further.  Darkened forms flicker in the distance, and the flurries swirling about foil attempts to focus on the distant shapes.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Forest]
description: The frozen snowbanks loom high here, allowing one to look down upon the area below.  From this vantage, a large field lies to the south, along with an odd shed nearby.  The wind swirls about, seeking any chance to chill the area further.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Forest]
description: Dead trees poke from an endless field of white.  Weak sunlight penetrates the heavy clouds and reflects brightly off the icepack, the glare harsh and intense.
Dead trees poke from an endless field of white.  Weak moonlight penetrates the heavy clouds and reflects brightly off the icepack, the glare harsh and intense.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [A Frozen Garden]
description: A frozen, timeless garden has taken on deeper beauty in the icy permafrost covering this tiny glade.  Tall red roses with kisses of white neighbor delicate crystalline violets that would shatter at the slightest touch.  Slender ivy vines caress a polished wood bench dusted with a light covering of snow.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Forest]
description: The wind continues to bite, its numerous tendrils reaching out to ensnare all within its grasp.  A few hardy shrubs have managed to fight off the fierce weather, and they hold firm against the stiff gales.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Forest]
description: A few hardy trees dot the landscape here, their branches reaching out in all directions.  A frayed rope hangs from one stout branch, swaying in the harsh wind.  A splintered piece of wood attached to a similar length of rope lies nearby, frozen into a snowbank.

title: [A Frozen Glen]
description: A flat, featureless glen opens wider to the south, looking like nothing more than a barren white desert.  Snow swirls across the plain, stopping only to rest on an occasional rise or dead stump in its path.  The bitter cold assails you from all directions.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [A Frozen Glen]
description: A tumble of fallen trees blocks passage to the east, each torn asunder by some fierce storm that ripped through the area.  Branches and loose twigs cover the ground, nearly obscuring the carpet of snow at your feet.

title: [A Frozen Glen]
description: A single young tree has managed to gain purchase, its branches covered with tiny leaves.  Stacked nearby is a pyramid of four stones, each lightly capped with a hat of white frost.  The small boulders are perfectly round, about the size of a human head, and unmarked.

title: [A Frozen Glen]
description: The breeze softly blowing through here carries a mournful wail, its sound as bleak as the white wasteland surrounding you.  High above, the sun is clearly losing its battle to free itself from the bonds of the darkened clouds embracing it.

The breeze softly blowing through here carries a mournful wail, its sound as bleak as the white wasteland surrounding you.  High above, the moon is clearly losing its battle to free itself from the bonds of the darkened clouds embracing it.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: Broken wooden slats and rotting crates are scattered about the area, a few spoiled apples still decaying within the boxes.  Several trees grow in defiance of the harsh wind and numbing cold.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: Tiny pawprints lead into a growth of wild brush, from which a faint rustling can be heard.  The frigid air never wearies, its touch unending and merciless.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: Ice covers a small pond that feeds the roots of the frozen trees.  A thin layer of snow covers the icy surface, which crackles ominously as if something is moving beneath it.  The wind howls through the nearly-bare branches of the trees, sending flurries of falling snow through the area.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: A stack of timber has been piled here, topped with a heavy dusting of snow.  The stumps of several trees barely peak the snowfall, their axe-scarred wood surfaces darkened with time.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: A ruined shack rots quietly away, all of the windows broken, and huge, gaping holes in the walls reveal the sparse, rotted interior.  Vague shapes flicker from within, perhaps nothing more than shadows.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Orchard]
description: A brutally slick slope leads north, nothing more than a sheer ramp of ice leading downward.  Several trees ring the area, no longer bearing fruit, but still sprouting frozen, sparse leaves from their gnarled branches.

title: [Icemule Trace, Hillside]
description: A narrow trail disappears into a thick tangle of evergreens.  Small icicles cling to the bare limbs of a maple tree at the edge of the path.  An unnatural chittering further up the hillside breaks the snowy silence.

title: [Icemule Trace, Hillside]
description: Evergreens crowd the trail, making it difficult to see very far ahead.  Despite the closeness of the trees, the air is refreshed by the chill breeze flowing down from the top of the hill.

title: [Icemule Trace, Hilltop]
description: The thicket gives way suddenly to a clearing at the crest of the hill.  A solitary oak tree, its branches blackened and charred, stands in the center of the clearing.  At the opposite end of the clearing lies a neatly trimmed hedge draped in a coverlet of snow.

title: [Frozen Garden, Path]
description: The path winds between two rows of neatly trimmed, snow capped hedges.  Small clusters of delicately carved ice flowers hide under the shade provided by the hedges.  Small patches of ice peek through the light dusting of snow that covers the path.

title: [Frozen Garden, Clearing]
description: Several small shrubs and bushes define the edge of a small clearing.  A lone oak tree stands in the middle of the clearing, its bare limbs reaching towards the sky as if pleading for the warmth of the sun.
Several small shrubs and bushes define the edge of a small clearing.  A lone oak tree stands in the middle of the clearing, its bare limbs reaching towards the sky, silhouetted in the moonlight.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Frozen Garden, Pond]
description: Small groves of evergreen trees grow at the edge of a small, frozen pond.  A thin ribbon of ice leads from the pond and marks what was once a shallow stream.  Snow drifts climb above the edges of the stream creating a narrow gully for it to wind its way through.

title: [Frozen Garden, Marsh]
description: This piece of land was once marshy and vibrant with life.  Now tufts of long, brown grass stick up out of the ice and snow.  Thin sheets of ice cover the ground where water had seeped through the surface.

title: [Frozen Garden, Shack]
description: The remains of a small shack or shed rises out of the snow like skeletal hands grasping for life.  The amount of snow and ice built up around it testifies to the manner of its destruction.  A steady wind blows through the wreckage, causing a broken door to sway on its rusted hinges.

title: [Frozen Garden, Ruins]
description: A ruined mansion of honey-colored stone dominates this low hill.  Empty windows and archways clogged with ice, snow and other debris line a small courtyard.  Broken statuary is strewn about the area as if it was smashed deliberately.

title: [Frozen Garden, Mending Wall]
description: A battered and broken row of stones runs alongside the dirt path.  What had once served as a fence lies strewn about in disarray.  Snow now replaces the masonry where obvious breaks can be seen in the fence.  In the distance, the remains of a structure are visible beyond the sparse evergreen ferns that dot the landscape.

title: [Frozen Garden, Field]
description: Long dead stalks of sunflowers stand encased in ice looking like the eyestalks of some gigantic creature.  The tall brown grass rustles in the slight breeze releasing a sound like giant scales sliding over the earth.  Small trees rise out of the grass, their stark forms hunched down as if to protect themselves from cold.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Frozen Garden, Glade]
description: A small river meanders through this wooded glade, the sun sparkling and reflecting from its frozen surface.  Several tall evergreens climb towards the sky, their limbs drooping under the weight of accumulated snow and ice.

A small river meanders through this wooded glade, moonbeams sparkling and reflecting from its frozen surface.  Several tall evergreens climb towards the sky, their limbs drooping under the weight of accumulated snow and ice.

title: [Frozen Garden, Ice Spire]
description: A twisting spire of ice climbs into the sky, reaching an impressive height.  Shifting patterns of color and light spark and fire from within the spire's crystalline center.  Around the base of the spire can be seen odd symbols and shapes, seemingly carved there.

title: [Frozen Garden, Standing Stones]
description: The river winds its way past a small knoll on which stands a circle of granite columns.  The wind whips through the stones causing small whirlwinds of snow to spin lazily around the stones.  Strangely the wind does not disturb anything within the circle itself.

title: [Frozen Garden, Crossroads]
description: The path opens up to a crossroads of sort with dirt trails leading southwest and southeast.  The winding path continues southward as it heads towards a sparse field.  The frozen remnant of a river can be seen through the scant vegetation that borders its edge.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Frozen Garden, River's Edge]
description: The trail is slippery from the patches of ice that intermingle with the snow drifting down to the frozen embankment of this once fast flowing stream.  The surface of the stream has long since solidified under the merciless arctic conditions.  A light breeze blows across the frosty surface nudging the snowy particles to dance about in chaotic swirling patterns.

title: [Frozen Garden, Embankment]
description: The trail continues its companionship with the frozen stream as it wanders eastward and turns north.  The steep icy embankment nearby stands in testimonial to the erosion of the former river's flow.  The ice and snow encased ground reveals itself in occasional deposits of silt that emerge alongside thickets of phragmites and brown grass.

title: [Frozen Garden, Narrow Trail]
description: The trail narrows as it heads northward into denser thickets and wooded landscape.  Though numerous, the trees here are stunted and gangly as their barren branches reach outward to intertwine with their neighbors, as if to embrace each other for warmth.  To the northeast, the ground slopes downward towards deeper snow drifts.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Frozen Garden, Mound Base]
description: The ground is steep as the trail coils around a small snow covered earthen mound.  The snow drift is deep, making travel an arduous effort with every passing step.  A frigid wind blows across the mound, sending showers of snowy particulates to drift onto the trail.

title: [Frozen Garden, Mound Summit]
description: Atop this mound, the snow has piled to form a perfectly smooth round summit.  With no refuge from the trees, the wind is blistering at this elevation as it batters its way past.  Wisps of snow are picked up from the surface and dispersed to the landscape below in twisting flurries.

title: [Frozen Garden, Clearing]
description: The ground rises slightly and the snow is deeper here as the forest canopy abruptly opens up to the dark skies.  Snowflakes can be seen slowly drifting aimlessly upon the soft breeze and then disappearing as they join their brethren blanketing the landscape.

title: [Frozen Garden, Field Edge]
description: The winding path continues its way eastward and bends towards the south.  The underbrush is thicker here as it edges the periphery of a large snow-ridden field.  There are curious tracks and marks in the snow trailing from the shrubbery to the field and back again.

title: [Frozen Garden, Winding Path]
description: A small path winds its way to the northeast from the clearing to the west.  Odd tracks and marks in the snow give mute testimony that other creatures inhabit this once beautiful place.  Odd grunts and rustlings from the surrounding foliage echo with the garden.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: A dark green holly tree spreads its boughs low and wide, nearly hiding the path.  Wary of the sharp points of its thick leaves, you carefully skirt around it.  Someone less agile than you has left shreds of some sort of clothing in its branches.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: The trail becomes narrower with branches jutting into it from all sides.  It takes some skill to balance your steps without losing an eye to the sharp twigs that always seem to be in the wrong place.  An icy path heads north into the woods and is clear of the treacherous branches.

title: [Icemule Trace, Forest]
description: The pathway ends abruptly at a tangle of berry brambles and holly trees.  Interestingly, there is a small, dark hole at the exact center of the thicket.  A hidden songbird trills a melody that is suddenly cut off, leaving an uneasy silence behind.

title: [Lower Icemule Forest]
description: A thick line of bramble hedges make the route westward nearly impassable.  The narrow, icy trail is pockmarked with ice-filled holes and dips, making footing treacherous.

title: [Lower Icemule Forest]
description: The trail widens slightly as it continues onward through the forest.  Long icicles dangle from the branches of the bare deciduous trees, occasionally breaking off and shattering on the ground.

title: [Icemule Cemetery, Entrance]
description: Tall, thick spruce trees nearly obscure the entrance to an old cemetery.  Between two of the sharply-scented trees, you glimpse white fields and a dull grey building.

title: [Icemule Pioneer Cemetery]
description: Winds have shifted some of the carved tombstones, wrinkling the otherwise smooth blanket of snow.  Here and there, some of the grave markers thrust upwards, defying the winds to move them from their resting place.  The cemetery's exit is marked by several thick spruce trees.

title: [Icemule Pioneer Cemetery]
description: Row after row of tilted tombstones look like grey teeth jutting from the jaws of some fell snow beast.  Small evergreens, their seeds dropped long ago by passing birds or animals, further distort some of the graves.

title: [Icemule Pioneer Cemetery]
description: A short, square grey building to the northeast barely stands out against the white of the surrounding snow.  Along the narrow trail that leads there are several small graves -- smaller than would be necessary for a full-grown halfling.

title: [Icemule Pioneer Cemetery]
description: A narrow, gravel path encircles the grey stone mausoleum.  At one time, the area might have been landscaped, but now scraggly bushes compete for the tiny space between the path and the building, choking one another.

title: [Icemule Pioneer Cemetery]
description: Bits of straw and twigs litter the ground, the remnants of a bird's nest from some nearby tree.  Small feathers still cling to some of the twigs, fluttering slightly as you pass.  The building provides a barrier from the worst of the winds.

title: [Icemule Pioneer Cemetery]
description: An odd-shaped room juts from the side of the otherwise square building.  Narrow slit windows are set high into the walls.  The wind picks up as you continue down the path, but it is not as bitter or harsh as in other places near Icemule Trace.

title: [Icemule Pioneer Cemetery]
description: A stone fountain lies on its side, half-buried in a drift of snow against the side of the mausoleum.  The gravel path is just a faint impression under the snow, turning southwest around another bend in the building.

title: [Icemule Pioneer Mausoleum]
description: There are no doors to the building, just a gaping entry flanked by finely carved marble statues.  Snow blown against the side of the building fills what appears to be an inscription on the door lintel, making it impossible to read.

title: [Icemule Mausoleum, Main Room]
description: Archways lead off in three directions from the main chamber of the mausoleum.  Snow, spilling in from the open entryway, makes the ground somewhat slick.  In between the arches are lancet-shaped niches holding large earthenware vases.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Icemule Mausoleum, Chamber]
description: High upon the wall, narrow slit windows provide some light to this otherwise gloomy chamber.  Empty iron brackets are spaced along the walls in between the windows.

title: [Icemule Mausoleum, Chamber]
description: A crack somewhere near the ceiling has allowed melting snow to drip into the room, then freeze again into a glistening curtain of icy beads.  There does not appear to be any other structural damage to the room, despite the unusual drapery.

title: [Mausoleum, Grand Chamber]
description: The chamber is large, but quite simple, evidently designed to hold the large tomb resting upon the darkened soil of the floor.  Great care was evidently put into the craftsmanship of the tomb, its form elegant and worthy of a hero.

title: [Cemetery Chamber]
description: The chamber is cold, dark, and deathly quiet.  The thick earthen walls of this vault-like room muffle any sounds that might be coming from above or below.  What looks to have been a stairwell or door is now boarded up with thick planks of wood and heavily reinforced with sturdy bars of iron.  Intricate runes have been etched in an arc above the barrier.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: The icy path emerges from the darkness of the evergreen forest into a shallow valley of mixed conifers and deciduous trees.  The valley floor is snow-covered, making the meandering trails highly visible.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: A soft breeze loosens snow from the upper limbs of the trees.  It is difficult to tell whether the falling flakes are part of a new snowfall, or just floating aimlessly from the branches.  Solitary blades of grass, whitened by frost, mar the smooth white blanket of snow on the ground.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: Several trails cross this small clearing in the Vale.  From the northwest comes the faint sound of trickling water.  A deep furrow in the snow reveals a narrow stream flowing southward and out of sight into the woods.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: Cold mist rises from a wide, reed-fringed pond.  Only the edges of the pond are completely frozen.  A trail leads southwest, accessible only by stepping carefully along the frozen edges of the pond.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: A wide, half-frozen pond appears suddenly from under the blanket of snow.  The ice does not extend to the middle of the pond, making it impossible to cross.  Faint footprints in the snow indicate that the edge of the pond is used often as a trail to the northeast.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: Trails criss-cross through the snow-covered trees.  A small stream covered in a thin veil of ice leaves a deep furrow in the snow, adding to the confusion over which trail to take.  The sharp scent of freshly cut pine is strong enough to make your eyes water.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: The branches of many of the trees have been broken off, leaving behind ugly welts and gashes.  Beneath the pines and leafless maples, sap oozes slowly onto the snow, an amber stain against the pure white.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: A small clearing in the trees provides a welcome change from the closeness of the woods.  At the center of the clearing is a stack of dead wood, mixed with fresh pine boughs.  Small animal traps and broken bones are scattered beside the wood pile, as though discarded in a hurry.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: Several broken snares and traps are scattered at the base of a tall fir tree.  Some of the traps are half-covered by snow, causing you to step very cautiously, lest you accidentally set one off yourself.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: Occasionally, a clump of snow falls from somewhere above you, cascading down the branches and snapping twigs as it gathers momentum.  Several trails converge here, but only two of them seem well-used.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: A light breeze stirs up the powdery snow on the ground, briefly obscuring the trails.  A thicket of blackberry brambles is covered with a delicate icing of snow.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Forest]
description: Wide gashes mar the bark of almost every tree along this portion of the trail.  Some of the trees have been killed by the ravaging, others have covered their wounds with thick, sticky sap.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: The trees of the forest give way suddenly to a snowy clearing.  Several jagged-edged stumps peek cautiously from beneath their blanket of snow, as though inquiring if it is safe to come out.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: The edges of the clearing are fringed by dark, closely set trees.  Sounds seem to carry from great distances over the snowy clearing, filling the air with unnatural noises that might ordinarily go unnoticed.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: Trails pass this way and that through the snowy field.  Some tracks appear to have been made by small animals, while other, larger tracks are unfamiliar to you.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: A narrow trail ends at the stump of a massive fir tree.  From the scent on the crisp air, it seems that this is a burrow of skunks, which requires a respectful distance.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: The icy stream flows into a mist-covered pond.  The farthest edge of the pond is shrouded by the rising curls of mist, and shadowed by the overhanging tree branches.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: Stumps of trees crudely felled long ago jut out from the snow in all directions.  The narrow, icy stream continues southward through the devastation like a teardrop.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: The shallow root system of a fir tree, felled many years past, rises on its side like a shield in the snow.  A small sapling grows outward from the base of the tangle of roots, reminding you that even in death, there is life.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: Nearly hidden in the drifts, a small stream meanders southward beneath a thin shell of ice.  Broken patches on the surface of the stream indicate where the residents of the forest and clearing have stopped to refresh themselves.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: A large pile of charred branches still releases a rich, smoky scent.  Spindles of ice hang in uneven rows from the blackened branches.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: Twitterings and nervous animal chittering erupt from the edges of the forest.  Twigs snap as heavy loads of snow fall from the uppermost branches of the trees.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Clearing]
description: The snow-covered clearcut begins to blend with the forest again.  Small, twisted maples and alders push upwards through the snow beside the remains of trees harvested in their prime.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Trodden paths have muddied the snow between the clumped edges of snowbanks formed from the constant clearing of walkways buried beneath each fresh fall.  Sunlight glares off the quilt of white that covers the ground and sparkles like crushed diamonds.

Trodden paths have muddied the snow between the clumped edges of snowbanks formed from the constant clearing of walkways buried beneath each fresh fall.  Moonlight illuminates the quilt of white that covers the ground and sparkles like crushed diamonds.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Branches of pine trees reach out like ghostly arms dripping with a frosting of ice crystals.  They sag slightly under the weight of the snow, and as an occasional clump falls off, it causes the limb to spring up, creating a miniature wintry squall.  Nearby stands the massive walls that cordon off the town and several birds perch along the top, taking advantage of its cleared, windswept surface.

Branches of pine trees reach out like ghostly arms dripping with a frosting of ice crystals.  Their massive forms are silhouetted by the darkness of night, creating little coves of shadow.  Nearby, the massive walls that cordon off the town block any other source of illumination, except for the rare glow from a second story window.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: The glassy surface of an iced over pond reflects the sun's rays, making a cheery display for the single bench that keeps it company.  Breadcrumbs and bird seed have been scattered around in a kindhearted attempt to keep the local livestock well-fed.

The glassy surface of an iced over pond distorts the moon's reflection, making an eerie display for the single bench that keeps it company.  The soft hoot of an owl comes from the shelter of a nearby tree and is followed with a reply a moment later.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Snow drifts thicken the path as it moves parallel to the town walls and along the edge of the surrounding forest.  Several footsteps disturb the fresh powder and the crude shapes of snow angels grace the small field.  A single red mitten is half-buried near one of the smaller displays.

Snow drifts thicken the path as it moves parallel to the town walls and along the edge of the surrounding forest.  Several footsteps disturb the fresh powder and the crude shapes of snow angels can just barely be picked out under the brilliant starlight.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Gate]
description: The wind whistles around you as it passes along this side of the town walls.  The road leading up to the gate itself is merely a dirt path but you notice it has seen some extensive use.  A huge snowbank is off to one side from all the snow being removed in front of the gates.  Just to the south of the gate is a stout building with a large sign over the door that reads "The Icehouse Tavern".

title: [Tavern Burrow, Barley Lane]
description: The simple design and ramshackle look of wooden boarding houses along the road suggest that the occupants belong to the burrow's working class.  A number of the buildings have oiled parchment tacked over their windows to block out intrusive light.  Two young halfling girls sit on the front steps of one of the houses.

From the simple design and sheer number of closely set wooden houses, it appears that this is a residential area for the neighborhood's working class.  A number of houses have oiled parchment tacked over their windows, as though to block any external light from disturbing the inhabitants.  A dim lantern hanging from one of the houses illuminates its front steps and casts a pale pool of light into the street.

From the simple design and sheer number of closely set wooden houses, it appears that this is a residential area for the neighborhood's working class.  A number of houses have oiled parchment tacked over their windows, as though to block any external light from disturbing the inhabitants.  Two young halfling girls sit on the front steps of one of the houses.

title: [Ravenswood, Forest]
description: The path winds through a small clearing.  The patch of sunlight between the trees is filled with a heavy growth of bright green ferns that stands four feet high.  Bright yellow butterflies flitter around trails leading through the ferns to several small cottages set back in the shadows of the woods.

The path winds through a small clearing.  The patch of moonlight between the trees is filled with a heavy growth of ferns that stands four feet high.  Bright fireflies flitter around trails leading through the ferns to several small cottages set back in the shadows of the woods.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: A slight grade makes traversing this section of the path a bit more challenging.  The fight to maintain balance has been lost many times, apparent from the arm-deep holes next to several footsteps.  Chimneys thick with smoke protrude from the rooftops of buildings that begin to crest over the city walls from this angle.

A slight grade makes traversing this section of the path a bit more challenging.  The fight to maintain balance has been lost many times, apparent from the shadowy arm-deep holes next to several footsteps.  Several upper level windows glow warmly with a golden light as the rooftops of buildings begin to crest over the city walls from this angle.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Cresting the hill provides an overview of Icemule Trace near this part of the wall.  Several streets are visible, crowded with people going about their daily business.  Smooth, flattened paths streak down the hill to the stone fortification rising up at the bottom, indicating that this is a popular locale for sledding.

Cresting the hill provides an overview of Icemule Trace near this part of the wall.  Several dark streets are visible, dotted with circles of flickering gold from lampposts that line the way.  The trees have pulled back from this small rise just enough to make it an ideal location for stargazing, distant from most ambient light.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Parallel with the stone bulwark surrounding the town, the path continues to skirt the forest edge and dodges the occasional lone fir tree before petering out at the edge of the glacier.  Leaning at an angle and with a canted tip, a nearby snow-covered tree resembles a pointed hat tossed carelessly into a corner.

Parallel with the stone bulwark surrounding the town, the path continues to skirt the forest edge and dodges the occasional lone fir tree before petering out at the edge of the glacier.  Leaning at an angle and with a canted tip, a nearby shadowy tree resembles a pointed hat tossed carelessly into a corner.

title: [The Icehouse Tavern]
description: This old tavern was once a great storehouse for meats and perishables.  Dangling from the ceiling are several meat hooks from which lanterns have been hung.  Tables and benches are placed along the walls leaving the center one big muddy pit.  A row of crates is stacked along one wall forming a bar of sorts, tended by a rather grimy looking halfling.  The only other feature is a heavy wooden door, which leads to the frigid weather outside.

title: [West Barbican, Gate]
description: Under the massive barbican is a shadowy passageway, with sturdy stone walls on each side and overhead.  Iron-barred windows provide access to this area from each of the barbican towers as well as from overhead, creating the distinct impression that someone is watching from the shadows.  The sharp spikes of raised portcullises jut from the ceiling at the eastern entrance to the city and the western exit to the wilds.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Road]
description: Rowdy shouts from customers in taverns and the gaming hall cut through the din of foot traffic along the road, making the burrows and above-ground shops to the north seem almost too quiet by comparison.  Stately street lights of wrought iron proceed to either side of the cobblestone road.  Those to the south have bases fashioned into the shapes of halflings holding tankards and ale mugs aloft, while their northern counterparts are robed or cowled, bearing wands and staves.
On the north side of the cobblestone road everything seems quiet, almost too quiet.  To the south, you can hear the rowdy shouts of people in the taverns and the gaming hall.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Road]
description: Most of the businesses to either side of the cobblestone road have facades of raw pine, though there are a few of stone.  Still more are dug out of the frozen earth of abounding hillsides.  Most have round doors painted with bright colors.  To the east, the foot traffic thickens as the road strikes toward the heart of town.  It seems especially busy where the road dovetails into a cobblestone walkway leading to a spacious courtyard framed by lofty trees, the windblown needles of which dot the landscape.
The cobblestone road continues east and west between the narrow buildings.  To the east the foot traffic seems to grow considerably worse.  A gate is just visible at the western end of the road.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Road]
description: Groups of boisterous and cheerful halflings pass by rapidly.  Most of them seem to be heading south towards the Tavern Burrow for entertainment or refreshment.  An old, drunk halfling sits in a doorway, alternating between singing at the top of his lungs and munching on a tart.

title: [Icemule Trace, West Road]
description: Travelers crowd the road, making it difficult to traverse without the occasional bump or jostle.  They crowd the entrance of a small fired brick building, an obstacle to the message runners in the deep blue elk hides commonly worn by local couriers.  Wagons drawn by surly mules struggle to make their way toward the town's central square in the east, completely stymied by the foot traffic.
Travellers go by at a dizzying pace.  It is difficult to walk by without running into one of them.  Walking sideways seems to be the only way to make any progress down the road.

title: [East Barbican, Gate]
description: Under the massive barbican is a shadowy passageway, with sturdy stone walls on each side and overhead.  Iron-barred windows provide access to this area from each of the barbican towers as well as from overhead, creating the distinct impression that someone is watching from the shadows.  The sharp spikes of raised portcullises jut from the ceiling at the western entrance to the city and the eastern exit to the wilds.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snow Drifts]
description: The area around you is barren except for patches of grass that poke through the snow along this rough trail.  You see the familiar walls of Icemule Trace in the distance but are too far away to see the gate.

title: [Icemule Trace, Secluded Path]
description: The trail is less visible here but the drifts of snow are set along either side protecting it from being lost completely.  There is little to see across the barren landscape save for a few small evergreen trees with icicles dangling from their limbs.

title: [Icemule Trace, Secluded Path]
description: The path here is a bit more visible and the wind in the area is calmer than you've encountered thus far.  In the distance to the west you see some foothills rising off the horizon.

title: [Icemule Trace, Secluded Path]
description: The snow is deep along this part of the path making it difficult to travel very quickly.  Directly in front of you are several large foothills that stretch out to the west and continue on to the north.  A narrow path is cut from the snow and leads along one of the valleys between the two foremost hills.  It appears to be unused but with the snow and ice around you it would be hard to tell if anything had been by here recently.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Base]
description: A small path leads towards the foothill and forks sharply here with another path heading north and a well-worn, wider path headed east.  A massive rolaren gate blocks the path to the east with solid, snow-covered stone walls on both sides of the gate.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Base]
description: This small path guides you along the west side of the foothill through drifts of snow that cover the path in several places.  The surrounding hills stretch off as far as the eye can see leaving you looking at a blank, snow-covered landscape.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Base]
description: The valley is covered with snow and there seems to be no sign of life in this harsh environment.  A cold blast of wind blows through, sending a cold chill up your spine making your teeth chatter.  The skeleton of an oak tree stands at the bottom of the small hill, the only indication that life was ever possible here.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Base]
description: Two ranges of hills embrace a valley swathed in deep drifts of snow.  Travel further along the path without getting lost beneath the snow might be possible, with some luck.  The wind is not as noticeable in this area, as the abounding hills provide some protection from its cruelty.  A descending ridge heading westward is mostly clear of snowfall.

The hills join together here in a valley covered with deep drifts of snow.  Travel further along the path without getting lost beneath the snow might be possible, with some luck.  The wind is not as noticeable in this area, as the hills around you provide excellent protection.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: The hills dissolve into a barren plain of frost, the thick white carpet having buried anything in its path.  Barricades, trenches and crumbling walls dot the ancient battlefield, now mere markers of the past wars.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: The warped remains of a large wooden wagon sit smothered deep in the snowpack, only one corner and a slowly turning wheel still visible.  Loud shuffling noises can be heard from all directions, any ability to determine their source dissolving in the low fog blanketing the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Deep pits fortified with large stones and boulders still remain as quiet momentos of the war that ravaged this plain.  Dented greaves and smashed helms lie crushed between two huge boulders, implying the violence of previous battles.  Wind screeches through the gaps in the low rock walls, bringing a terrifying, ominous song to the area.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: The constant wind has created a large berm of snow and ice, its small crest blocking the view to the west.  Odd thudding noises rumble the ground, the frost dancing with each new thump.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Shattered weapons of pitted steel and broken wooden shields lie scattered about this frigid wasteland.  Scavengers have long since looted anything usable from this carnage, but the debris remaining silently tells the tale of ancient battles and fierce rivalries.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Snowdrifts cover the area in random patterns, the swirling wind leaving nothing of permanence within this wasteland of ice and frost.  The gusting wind bites deep, reinforcing the unrelenting chill.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: The snow falls in heavy waves, the piercing wind only intensifying the brutal chill.  A headless skeleton has been propped up against a tall boulder, one arm missing, the other raised in some ghastly greeting.  A tattered scarf has been wrapped around its neck, perhaps in some cruel jest.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: A yellowed troll skull sits upon the tip of a tall spear, its eyeless sockets staring hopelessly outward.  A pile of worn armor is stacked at its base, nothing more than frozen rags now.  The bitter, unrelenting cold gives no quarter as it seeps across the plain, seeking to clutch all within its chill embrace.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Tired grey clouds pass slowly overhead, unable to bring little more than gloom to this barren expanse.  Snow drifts aimlessly about, a few flurries lightly dusting the large stones peeking out from the ice.  Several ruined shields are scattered about, most half-buried in the frost.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Ancient pikes still form a lethal barricade, most of the wooden handles rotting in the frosty floor beneath them.  Many of the tips bear long-darkened stains, lending evidence to the fact that the weapons probably served their purpose well.  One point bears an old set of ragged leather impaled upon it, the armor long empty of life.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [A Frozen Battlefield, Trench]
description: A solid wall of ice brings the trench to an abrupt end.  Walls on both sides are slick with frost, and a few deep scratches lend evidence of previous attempted climbs.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: The ice-covered plain comes to an abrupt end as the ground drops off into a steep, impassable cliff.  A nearly vertical slope of jagged stone and sharp ridges leads down to the fog-shrouded terrain below, and the occasional chunk of ice or stone loses its tenuous hold on the cliffside and tumbles off into oblivion.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Old axes, rusted swords and broken clubs litter this icy tundra, all of them nothing more then wreckage now.  A battered, wooden sign leans toward the ground, the letters eroded and unreadable.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Deep, heavy footsteps lead in varying directions, far fresher than the discarded helm frozen in the ice at your feet.  A quick survey does little to reveal the owners of the tracks, but shuffling and faint cursing can be heard in the distance.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: The ice and snow covering the ground fail to completely hide an overturned sled.  Its rails are bent and useless, the leather thongs holding the slats rotted, and the wood itself grotesquely warped.  The child's toy seems very out of place amidst the death and decay of this area.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Deep grey fog battles with a harsh driving snow, completely eliminating any visibility.  A deep gouge mars the icy ground cover, clearly created by someone or something big.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: A tall semi-circular ring of boulders forms a solid battlement, its position secure upon a small crest.  From this vantage most of the battlefield below is visible, although the heavy weather obscures most detail.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [A Frozen Battlefield, Trench]
description: Odd echoes fill the deep trench with malevolent tones, monotonous and constant.  The prevailing shadows formed by the outcroppings of rock and ice seem to dance to the eerie music, making the battlement seem more chill and foreboding.

description: The crumbling stones appear to be rapidly losing their war with the encroaching ice, and huge chunks of rock have fallen to the trench floor, revealing the frozen dirt beneath the stone reinforcement of the battlements. description: The thudding and pounding above have been replaced by thin scratching sounds.  An occasional rattle fills the air, a familiar yet unnerving noise, perhaps steel on bone. title: [A Frozen Battlefield, Trench]
description: The wind howls with menace above, but finds itself unable to gain entrance to the deep battlement.  The stone-reinforced walls are covered with slick ice, and what might have granted sanctuary long ago seems nothing more than an icy prison now.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Base]
description: The path leads you closer to the south side of the hill where large cave openings can be seen scattered along the base.  The closest opening is one of three along this side and has heavy gouges around the lower edges.  To the left of the opening is a staircase that has been carved into the side of the hill leading upwards to a wide ledge.
