title: [Ice Plains, Hill Base]
description: Around a slight bend in the path you spot another dark opening cut into the foothill.  The remnants of an iron gate lay broken to one side of the opening set against a small, snow-covered boulder.  Pieces of iron and small rock lie scattered about as if some great force had shattered this section of the structure.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Base]
description: The path curves around the foothill slightly to reveal a large opening with icicles dangling from the ceiling.  A recent rockslide has left the path around this side of the foothill buried beneath several hundred tons of rock, making it impossible to continue in this direction.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: The entrance opens into a large cavern that continues to the north and the northeast.  The opening is the only apparent source of light making it difficult to see further into the cavern.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: The light is very dim here and you can barely make out your hand in front of your face.  The wind is but a whisper this deep into the cavern and the only sound you hear are your footsteps as you walk through the tunnel with caution.  The passage begins to narrow and for a moment you would swear you heard something breathing.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: The passage ends here in a roughly circular room that stretches just beyond your sight.  Several iron rings line the entire wall, some with nothing attached while others hold lengths of rusted chain.  Along the north side of the chamber are several wooden barrels that are stacked neatly to one side and chained to the wall.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: The passage dead ends here into a small room with bits of chain strewn across the cavern floor.  Several small piles of bones are scattered throughout the chamber, apparently discarded after being picked clean.  The stale air reeks of death and decay causing you to gasp for breath as the stench overcomes you.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: The passage here is long and narrow with several timbers in place to shore up the ceiling in several places.  The well-travelled floor is littered with tracks of some very large creatures but you can't quite identify them.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: You have wandered into what appears to be a supply room with many different items stacked to one side of the room.  More timbers are evident in this room underneath a large fissure an arms length in width that runs down the center of the room.  Rope, spikes, and unused timbers are stacked neatly against the west wall.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: Several large cells are set near each other along the north side of this room with straw-covered floors that have seen some use recently.  Timbers are lined up in this area and several have been erected to shore up the opening to the southeast but have yet to be completed.  An opening in the ceiling catches your attention and as you look into it, you notice a dark room some twenty feet above you.  At your feet are the remains of an iron ladder that is rusted and broken.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: The tunnel is cramped as years of ice have accumulated around the somewhat cylindrical walls.  Although slippery and dangerous, the passage is still passable and leads deeper under the hill.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: The passage widens once again as the ice along the floor thins, allowing patches of dirt to show through in several places.  The passage grows darker as you move further under the hill but the shelter that it provides from the biting wind is gratifying nonetheless.  Several chunks of dried meat are scattered along the floor, long since frozen in place.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: The passage opens up into a large chamber with additional passages leading off in several other directions.  There is a familiar smell about the place, but no indication of its source.  Chains, whips, and large harnesses are secured to a wooden rack along the east side of the room.  The rest of the area is taken up by several devices that may have been used to torture captives.  Along the walls, several rusted sets of manacles hang lifelessly, awaiting yet another victim.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, west

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: Several open-air cells are scattered throughout this room, along with several sets of shackles that are bolted to the cavern wall.  The area is free of debris and several large footprints are evident in the dirt floor.  The cell doors and shackles look to be in good condition but show no signs of recent use.  Two large iron hooks are set about five feet high along the north wall and hold several lengths of heavy chain.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: This small area houses several open-air cells.  At one time this may have been where prisoners awaited their turn to be tortured or questioned.  The cells look surprisingly well-kept and there is no evidence of rust on the bars or locks.  Bundles of fresh rope lie off to one side, while above them some keys dangle just out of reach.

title: [Ice Plains, Dark Cavern]
description: This area is small and cramped and houses several sets of shelves with all sorts of dusty, dirt-covered jars.  Bones of varying humanoid and avian skeletons are scattered about the floor.  Set off to one side are skulls of various size, several of which have large circular holes in them.  The air is stale and an aftertaste of death lingers with each breath.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Side]
description: The staircase leads onto a smooth pathway that has been excavated from the side of the hill.  A thin layer of snow covers the ground along the path but stops short of an opening hidden behind a drift of snow.  The entrance leads north into a tunnel that was not formed naturally.  As you get closer to the opening, a waft of warm air against your face reminds you how cold you are.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Side]
description: Making your way along the ledge you catch yourself on a small boulder as you misstep and almost fall to the ground below.  The wind is bitter along this section of the path causing you to shiver and wish for a warm drink to soothe your chilled bones.  Just ahead you spy a path leading north into a large cavern.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Side]
description: The ledge tapers off and once again becomes part of the hill leaving no way for you to continue around the east side of the hill.  A smooth ramp continues upward to another ledge that looks to head back in the direction you came from.  The ramp has two iron railings along each side and is completely covered with ice, making it difficult to climb.  Just underneath the ramp is the entrance to a tunnel heading north.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: This room branches off into several different directions but appears to be the central location to this tunnel.  A large table dominates the room, with many stools arranged along the outside for the inhabitants to sit while they dine.  A large firepit ringed with stones is off to one side of the room.  It looks as if the area has seen a lot of use recently, and the odor of burnt flesh lingers in the air.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: Walking through the doorway you enter another rest area with a small firepit in the center of the room with fur bedding laid out around it.  Along the east wall are several timbers in place to reinforce the ceiling and the wall itself.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: You notice a small firepit in this room with many furs laid out across the floor as beds.  Several crates are stacked along the south side of the room containing more furs and chunks of rusted iron.  Along the north side of the room, several timbers have been set in place to support the ceiling and wall from a possible cave-in.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: This area is completely bare except for the unused firepit in the center.  A cave-in along the outer edge has left a pile of rubble and a thick layer of dust across the entire floor, causing you to leave your footprints in the dust.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: The tunnel leads you back into a small room with many exits.  This appears to be a central area where the inhabitants gather to prepare and eat their meals.  A ring of stones surrounds a large fire with several cooking utensils resting against one of the stones.  Two long tables surrounded by several stools show many stains from previous meals.  A third table is set about ten feet from the fire and has several items on it.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: This area is a small bedroom with very few furnishings.  Several furs are set in a row close to a firepit in the center of the room.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: This room is exceptionally dark and casts oddly shaped shadows from the fire in the main hall.  You feel soft fur underneath your feet as you move about.  Parts of the room are pitch black and you make more noise than you would like as you stumble about bumping into the walls and kicking around scrap pieces of iron.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: You have wandered into what appears to be a simple bedroom.  Several odd furs line the floor around the outer edge of the room.  In the center of the room is a small firepit that is smoldering.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: The passage narrows here as you work your way deep into the cavern.  Timbers line the walls and ceiling to reinforce them against a possible cave-in.  One of the timbers has a large hook nailed to it with several lengths of thick chain dangling from it.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: The passage opens up here into a large cavern where many supplies are kept.  A row of hooks along one wall hold varying sizes of ropes and several rusted lengths of chain.  Crates of dried meat are stacked neatly to one side and marked with writing, the likes of which you have never seen before.  Timbers line the walls and you hear a creak from time to time as the ceiling settles onto the timbers.

title: [Ice Plains, Worker Burrows]
description: The tunnel ends abruptly here and the room is bare except for timbers along the southern portion of the room to reinforce the ceiling.  A large hole in the floor about three feet across leads to a darkened room below where the remains of a ladder are scattered on the floor.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Top]
description: From here you can see across the valleys and hills that stretch out for miles to the west.  You pause a moment to take in a breath of fresh air and revel at the beauty unfolded before you.  You're very close to the top of the hill and as you glance around, you notice the faint outline of another opening hidden by a snowbank.  A ramp leading down is off to one side with iron railings on either side.

title: [Ice Plains, Master Quarters]
description: Several torches line the walls as the cavern heads deeper into the foothill.  There is stout-looking timber reinforcing this entire corridor.  Some of the timbers have recently been replaced, but by whom or what you don't know.

title: [Ice Plains, Master Quarters]
description: You have entered upon what looks to be a gathering room for the upper class of this small colony.  Two large wooden tables are set parallel to one another around a large fire in the center of the room.  The fire has just been tended to and generates enough heat to warm the entire area.  Several cupboards line the far wall and hold eating utensils and primitive crockery.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Ice Plains, Master Quarters]
description: The flickering fire in the next room can be seen dancing on the far wall of this room.  A cloth curtain in the doorway is easily pulled to prevent any disturbances while the occupants sleep.  Two beds are set along the far wall along with two dressers along the adjoining wall.  Each has strange markings that you seem to recall seeing elsewhere.

title: [Ice Plains, Master Quarters]
description: This room is just big enough for the two wooden beds and small dressers that it holds.  The fire from the common room is enough to keep it comfortably warm.  The dressers and beds are made of aged modwir with strange runes etched into them.  The beds look cozy, with soft puma hide furs piled high.

title: [Ice Plains, Master Quarters]
description: As you enter, you bang your knee into a hardened surface.  As you rub your pained joint, you glance around to see a small bedroom.  A bed made from modwir is set along the wall with a dresser at the foot of the bed.  Both pieces bear some odd markings that look vaguely familiar.  The bed is lined with large furs that look very comfortable and warm.  Off to one side of the room is a very narrow crack that leads south.

title: [Ice Plains, Master Quarters]
description: A crackling fire greets you as you wander into a large room filled with crates of dried meats and kegs of some unknown liquid.  A small table is set just on the far side of the fire with a cloth covering and several chair around it.  A second table on this side of the fire has no chairs but has an odd knife and small bowls of oregano and dillweed arranged on it.

title: [Ice Plains, Master Quarters]
description: Passing through a blackened curtain, you enter a small bedroom.  Two large oak beds are set parallel to each other along the east wall with two dressers set on the opposite wall.  The fire in the common room keeps this room surprisingly warm.  The beds have seen some use recently but you can't tell if by man or beast.

title: [Ice Plains, Shrine]
description: The room is lit by dozens of torches and marble dais is set at the end of the chamber atop stone altar.  The dais has gold and platinum inlays along the top with veins of silver twisted down the supports of the base.  Several stools are arranged in rows in front of the altar, with a path large enough to walk down the center of the room to the altar.  Behind the dais is a dark alcove with a life-sized statue of Amasalen, servant of Luukos.

The room is lit by a dozen torches, and a marble dais is set at the end of the chamber atop a stone altar.  The dais has gold and platinum inlays along the top with veins of silver twisted down the supports of the base.  Several stools are arranged in rows in front of the altar, with a path large enough to walk down the center of the room to the altar.  Behind the dais is a dark alcove with a life-sized statue of Amasalen, servant of Luukos.

title: [Ice Plains, Master Quarters]
description: You are just inside the opening as it leads slightly downward deeper into the foothill.  Several torches set in iron sconces line the wall and make it easier to see.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Top]
description: The ledge you are on narrows rapidly as it rejoins the side of the hill making it impossible to travel around to the north side.  An opening leads into the peak of the hill and winds its way downward into the darkness.  The wind suddenly picks up stinging your face with an icy chill and causing your eyes to water.  It is a cold reminder that makes you want to head for shelter.

title: [Icemule Trace, North Road]
description: Wind gusts down from the north, chilling the air along the roadway.  Sunshine reflects brilliantly off of the glacier, blazing like a beacon in the pale daylight.  Above, the temple rises above the town on a hill of colorless ice, watching over the city and shining like polished crystal.  Carillons sound in the distance, their imperious pealing rising above even the din of the road.

The air takes on a definite chill here.  To the north, you can see the gleam of sunshine reflecting off ice, and it seems the road is headed straight into the glacier.  To the north and east, the Temple rises above the city on a hill of ice, watching over the city and shining like a polished crystal.

The air takes on a definite chill here.  To the north, you can see the gleam of moonlight reflecting off ice, and it seems the road is headed straight into the glacier.  To the north and east, the Temple rises above the city on a hill of ice, watching over the city and shining like a polished crystal in the moonlight.

title: [Icemule Trace, North Road]
description: Sheets of glassy ice slick the street, forcing foot traffic to the margins of the road, where the bases of lamp posts depict circles of halflings holding hands.  The glacier looms over the northern gates and its icy slopes have intruded into the town to either side.  Ctizens have taken this in stride, and have dug burrows into the ancient ice.  Their round, painted doors dot the slopes.

The cobblestone street is slick in some places, covered in frozen puddles.  The glacier looms much closer now and actually seems to have spread over the town to either side.  The citizens have taken this in stride and have carved buildings from the ice to live and work in.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: Several armed guards stand outside a hole in the wall, watching all who enter and exit Icemule Trace.  Halflings bundled against the cold wander in and out of the gate, some leading pack animals while others carry large packs on their back.  A trail leads off to the northeast, and although it's slick and icy, the halflings seem to pay no notice to the dangers.

title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
description: A sheer cliff of ice blocks the ice trail.  A crevice opens in the wall, likely leading into and perhaps under the glacier.  The sparkle of the sun on the ice is nearly blinding, making your eyes squint and water.
A sheer cliff of ice blocks the ice trail.  A crevice opens in the wall, likely leading into and perhaps under the glacier.  Moonlight sparkles on the ice illuminating the area.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Entryway]
description: Lit only by a single iron-sconced torch east of the gated entrance, this ice-enclosed cavern is filled with an unwelcoming silence and a sense of foreboding.  To the northwest, countless stalagmites of crystalline ice jut wickedly upwards towards a suspended rope bridge far above the penitentiary floor.  Garbed in hooded black robes, a pair of grizzled halflings guard a thick imflass-chain ladder that leads upwards into the Icewall.

title: [In The Crevice]
description: The crevice walls press close together, giving you a sense of claustrophobia.  A crack in the wall of ice provides the only exit to the outside, and the ice slopes downward opposite the fissure, leading into the gloom.

title: [Ice Tunnel, Entryway]
description: The cold seeps into your bones, seeming to chill your very soul.  The tunnel through the ice is short, suited for halflings and those of a like size, if only just.  It does not seem to be naturally formed, and long grooves in the walls appear to have been made by ice picks.

title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
description: The rough edges of the wall give the reflecting light an eerie cast that plays tricks with your eyes.  Glancing at the reflection coming from the bend of the wall, you can see hundreds of shapes moving in agitation.  Quickly, almost hopefully, you realize this is but a trick of the light.

title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
description: Jagged plates of ice flow over one another, forming the roof of the tunnel.  The occasional groan of shifting ice makes you start and glance nervously upwards, saying a silent prayer that the tunnel does not collapse upon you.

title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
description: The tunnel sharply turns back on itself here, disorienting you slightly.  This, coupled with the sloping floor, causes you to slip several times as you make your way through the ice.  Your own breathing echoes about you, making you tense with unease.

title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
description: Deep grooves mar the walls of this corridor.  Further inspection leads you to believe that these are sword slices, likely from someone swinging a blade too long for the size of the tunnel.  A shudder passes through you, although from the cold or something else you cannot tell.

title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
description: The ice glows a dirty grey, reflecting light from above the ice.  Occasionally a whisper of sound touches your ears, giving you goosebumps.  The tunnel winds to the northeast, where you can see dark shapes within the ice.

title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
description: A hole in the ice opens in the north wall.  Through it, you can make out the details of the shapes in the ice, seeing them to be the remains of buildings.  Shapes flicker through the ice, making you very uneasy.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: The ice forms a small natural cavern here.  Within the walls, you can see the flattened remains of several houses, crushed to bits by the flow of the glacier.  The rubble is still in good relative condition, as if frozen in time.  A hole opens in the ice to the south.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: A tiny cottage sits perfectly preserved within the glacier.  Several children's toys sit in the yard, and a broom leans against the stoop.  You can almost see smoke rising from the chimney, as if a fire still burned in the hearth.  But the windows remain dim, and the scene has an eerie air of timelessness about it.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: The collapsed husks of several houses lay entombed in the ice.  The occasional board or piece of metal sticks out of the ice, almost as if reaching for freedom.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: All that remains here is a large pile of boards and glass.  You cannot tell what these buildings might have been, as the damage is far too complete.  As you look away, something catches your eye, and looking again, you see something sticking out of the rubble that looks suspiciously like an arm.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: You must step carefully in this room.  Unfinished (yet rather sharp) sword blades poke out of the ice at your feet, threatening to shorten you by a foot.  They seem to have come from the remains of a shop smashed by the ice, the pieces of a sign in the shape of a sword indicating that this was once the armory.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: The ice takes on a greyish cast, colored by the soot from the forge it has crushed.  Twisted wrecks of metal lay within the frozen walls, and tools have been scattered across the dirt at the front of the building.  An anvil sticks out of the ice, nearly making you stub your toe.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: Several poor-looking shanties have been demolished by the glacier.  Their condition was likely never sterling, and it's likely that the glacier sped the process that time eventually would have completed.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: The unmistakable scent of mule manure reaches your nose.  Sticking partially out of the ice is a stable, and unfortunately, the scent did not freeze with the building.  Pieces of harness and tack hang from the fence, slowly rotting in the moist air, and straw dusts the floor.  You involuntarily wrinkle your nose, trying not to sneeze.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: A neatly-kept house sits enveloped in several feet of ice.  The back half, as well as much of the left side, has collapsed, crushed by the ice.  The rest looks much like it must have before, the paint bright and lovingly done.  A small garden has been plotted in the front yard, carrot stalks flattened against the ground and heads of lettuce splattered across the dirt.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: The ice glimmers and scintillates, refracting the light from gems and gold trapped within.  What was a gemcutter's shop has been destroyed by the movement of the glacier, its wares scattered and entombed by the ice.  Chip marks in the ice indicate that someone has attempted to salvage the jewels, but was largely unsuccessful.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: Your breath echoes off the walls of this huge chamber.  At the north side stands a large temple.  An immense plate of ice sits atop it, slowly crushing the finely varnished wood.  Colored glass litters the floor, forced from the windows by the pressure the ice is putting on the structure.  You cannot help but marvel that the building still stands, and wonder if perhaps it is only faith that allows it to do so.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: What once was a two-story house sits at the edge of this cavern.  A huge slab of ice has knocked the second story down, scattering bedding and parts of furniture across the slick floor.  The rest of the house creaks and groans, as if it could fall to bits at any moment.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, west

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: A cart sits flattened within the ice.  Fruits and vegetables sit around it, some pulped, others whole, wrinkled and withered from the cold but still in decent condition.  A mule harness remains attached to the front, twisted by the force of the glacier.

title: [Icemule, Ruins]
description: Bright swathes of cloth from beneath the ice-bound rubble mark what was once a tailor's shop.  The ice reflects the colors, creating jumbled rainbows about the tunnel.  Little other than the fabric remains intact, and you only hope that the proprietor of the shop made it out in time.

title: [Magical Burrow, Warlock's Way]
description: A dark alley splits the buildings to the east, glittering feline eyes blinking out into the light, then disappearing into the blackness.  A breath of wind races across the rooftops, sending weathervanes spinning, loudly squeaking, announcing their lack of oil for all to hear.  The snow brave enough to crowd the vanes flies in every direction, looking like a vessel of white sugar had just broken open.

title: [Magical Burrow, Warlock's Way]
description: Wisps of smoke rise from a grate in the street, and judging by the smell, most likely coming from the sewers.  The walkway paralleling the roadway is heavily pockmarked by dripping acid and is stained several unusual colors.  Tipped over on its side, a table with similar damage exhibits a jagged, gaping hole right through the center of its marble top.

title: [Magical Burrow, Warlock's Way]
description: A staircase hangs on for dear life to a rare two story building, many of its steps broken out by the constant weight of the snow constantly piled on it.  Most of the bolts holding the carpentry together have rusted away, leaving a few bits of over-stressed metal to do the work of the missing parts.  A sign blocks off the bottom of the incline, warning of the danger obviously awaiting to befall a careless climber.

title: [Magical Burrow, Warlock's Way]
description: A collapsed building lies across the former roadway, rerouting it to the southeast.  The brickwork and wood that once supported the structure bear burn marks on what was obviously the former interior of the building.  The fence that lined the yard is now bent beyond repair, strangely left there by the street cleaning crew.

title: [Magical Burrow, Shaman Road]
description: The pavement in the road breaks up over an earthen lump struggling through the stones.  Some of the cobblestones are smashed in two, thrown back away from the rise as if something had tried to break its way through to the surface.  Other buildings lean crazily away from the middle of the road, their internal structures groaning when the wind picks up.

title: [Magical Burrow, Shaman Road]
description: A low hanging fog clings to ankles and swirls around the legs of pedestrians traversing the street.  The thick blanket is so dense that if it weren't for the occasional patches broken up by drafts out of the sewer grates, it would appear to be a solid snowbank.  The breeze that pervades the rest of the Trace is strangely absent along Shaman Road.

title: [Magical Burrow, Shaman Road]
description: An imposing iron fence dissuades the overly inquisitive from climbing into an overgrown garden.  A series of sharpened spikes crowns the fence, further fending off those that would trespass.  Behind an immense tangle of vines, a small workshed struggles to remain standing.

title: [Magical Burrow, Dirge Street]
description: A low wooden tower sits on one side of the street, a sluice built off one side sloping down to meet the ground.  The weather has been used to advantage by the local children, letting ice form on the ramp to make a nice hill to sled down.  Some of the more daring have tried it on skates, judging from the body impressions in the snowbank built to slow down the sledders.

title: [Magical Burrow, Spectre Square]
description: Wild roses scrabble for a purchase on a tall iron fence topped by an imposing array of spikes.  An immense padlock guards the gate entering the long-forgotten garden, the owner long since vanished in circumstances that at best could be considered suspect.  A simple gravel path leads back from the fenceline into the tangled overgrown bushes.

title: [Magical Burrow, Spectre Square]
description: Wrought iron fences surround individual property lines, the detailing on them quite intricate.  The black paint of the houses absorbs all light, turning the structures into inky shadows in dim illumination.  Trailing moss hangs heavily overhead, draped off of low tree branches.

title: [Magical Burrow, Spectre Square]
description: Lamp posts line the road around Spectre Square, wavering and flickering, fitfully trying to light the plaza.  Drifting fog creates halos around the lanterns, enveloping the poles they rest on.  The flagstones paving the road are perenially wet, freezing over and melting again as feet continually trample them.

title: [Magical Burrow, Apparition Way]
description: Lights flicker behind curtained windows, drifting to and fro before winking out leaving a black void.  A few houses lining the street are painted with strange mystical symbols in bright colors, while others have unusual machines and tools sitting in their yards.

title: [Magical Burrow, Warlock's Way]
description: Strange mists drift through the neighborhood, there one moment, gone the next.  A chill breeze sends shivers up and down spines, ambushing those passing through, seemingly aware of its targets.  Dark buildings stand in the gloom, great black hulks waiting for something to happen.

title: [Magical Burrow, Warlock's Way]
description: The peculiar tang of tea and cigars drifts momentarily in the air, then disappears like an apparition, replaced by the brisk smell of fresh fallen snow.  Smoke curls lazily upwards, loosely swirling around itself before it dissipates high in the sky.  Bungalows and cabins huddle together on the ground, fighting to stay warm.

title: [Magical Burrow, Dirge Street]
description: Low-slung buildings crowd the street, jockeying with each other for position.  The names of many who have travelled over this road are carved into the cobblestones paving the street, the result of a massive fund raising effort to redo the roadwork in the Burrow.  Lamps hang off the fronts of the houses, throwing wavering pools of light on the doorways.

title: [Magical Burrow, Apparition Way]
description: A howl echoes in the distance, reverberating off the walls of the closely packed buildings, turning into something odd and eerie.  Strangely, loud drips are further amplified by the enclosed space, becoming loud pops and smacks instead of the light taps one would expect.  The light of the sun rarely reaches through the thick overgrowth of vines stretching overhead between buildings.

title: [The Heart of the Art, Icemule]
description: A winding passageway feeds into this surprisingly large marble alcove.  At the end of the chamber, where an enclosing wall should be, is an open view into the town center of the town center of Icemule Trace.  The opening into the city defies all logic as the view would seem to indicate that this chamber is directly in the middle of the town, which would be impossible.  The impressiveness of this chamber relays that its current function betrays its true origin.

title: [The Heart of the Art]
description: This giant chamber is carved from a large hulk of marble and has been fashioned into the shape of a humanoid heart.  Passageways snake away from the chamber like arteries ready to carry freshly infused blood to distant parts of the body.  Hatchets overhang these arteries and swing across the openings at regular rhythmic intervals, restricting further movement outside of the central chamber to those with a quick foot and a fair amount of daring.
tags: peer passage =~ /^\[The Heart of the Art, Icemule\]/

title: [Small House, Porch]
description: The curls of fog end abruptly at an abandoned house.  The windows are broken and rough-hewn pine boards are nailed haphazardly over them.  The door is also boarded up although it is obvious that the lock has been forced.  The house is covered in soot and broken down from where flames ate at the already decrepit structure.

Curls of fog end abruptly at a freshly painted house.  The windows of thickly bubbled glass are spotlessly clean, bordered by newly hewn pine shutters.  The door also bears a new coat of paint, though it is not quite enough to disguise the gouges in the wood at the corners of the frame nearest the handle.  Despite their new paint, the foundation stones are still noticeably discolored at the base of the building, showing where flames once blackened the rock.

Curls of fog end abruptly at a freshly painted house.  The windows of thickly bubbled glass are spotlessly clean, allowing flashes of light that appear at regular intervals to illuminate the porch.  The door also bears a new coat of paint, though it is not quite enough to disguise the gouges in the wood at the corners of the frame nearest the handle.  Despite their new paint, the foundation stones are still noticeably discolored at the base of the building, showing where flames blackened the rock.

title: [Magical Burrow, Illusionist Way]
description: The street is barely wide enough for a mule-drawn cart to make its way.  Dark houses line both sides of the street, punctuated by the occasional burrow.  All appear well-to-do, with spacious estates whose high walls permit glimpses of ice gardens and hedge mazes flanking their drives.  Fog blankets everything, transforming nearby trees into silhouettes with snatching black claws.
This narrow street seems barely wide enough for an arctic yak to pull a cart down.  Dark houses line both sides of the street and fog blankets everything.

title: [Wizard Guild, Icy Walkway]
description: The dome of the expansive fieldstone edifice to the north is painted such a brilliant white that even the weak northern sunlight is blinding on it.  Snowdrifts standing waist high to a halfling line the walkway leading to the arched doors of the building, yet the flagstones of the walk are curiously dry and free of ice.  A footbridge spans a narrow, fast-moving stream that rushes in a sweeping arc around the cylindrical building.

The dome of the expansive fieldstone edifice to the north is painted such a brilliant white that it nearly glows from the starlight reflected off it.  The dark shapes of snowdrifts standing waist high to a halfling line the walkway leading towards the building.  A footbridge spans a stream that you hear swiftly rushing along below in the dark somewhere.

title: [Magical Burrow, Sorcerer Way]
[Magical Burrow, Sorcerers Way]
description: Cold breezes sneak along the street, shivering the branches of pine trees in the abounding yards.  Small burrows with doors painted in vibrant reds or stark blacks occupy the faces of flanking hillocks, but there are just as many above-ground dwellings.  Most have a vaguely unwelcoming look, though one brick home has a small orchard of wintercrisp apple trees out front.  The few lamp posts along the way have bases depicting robed figures with shrouded features.
A cold breeze catches up with you, sending shivers down your spine.  Smaller, halfling homes line the streets, looking like over-sized toy models when compared to a human or giantman home.

title: [Magical Burrow, Sorcerer Way]
[Magical Burrow, Sorcerers Way]
description: Hanging from a wooden arm above the tall double doors of a nearby shop, a white holly sign creaks in the restless wind howling down the way.  A small pathway of brightly colored gravel leads through the front gate, snaking past a few stunted alder trees.  Although the windows of the storefront are shuttered, periodic bursts of light shine through their wooden slats to illuminate the entire street.

A small sign proclaims in bright letters that this is the home of Wurt the Amulet Maker.  A small gravel pathway leads through a wrought-iron gate to the tall double doors of the house.  The windows of the house are shuttered, but periodically a burst of light shines through their wooden slats and illuminates the entire street.

title: [Wurt's Amulets]
description: The double doors open into Wurt's work area.  The other visible doors are closed and appear to lead to Wurt's private residence.  A long countertop is set at the end of the room.  It is heaped with semi-precious gems, gold and silver chains, and racks full of small cobalt blue jars.

title: [Magical Burrow, Banshee Lane]
description: The lane swerves between a row of rickety shops occupied by merchants trafficking in wares mundane, magical, and outright preposterous.  Not all of the structures are permanent, as the storefronts are joined by tents and the occasional covered wagon.  One stand sports a fresh coat of white paint and a brightly polished brass sign.

The hustle and bustle of Banshee Lane passes between a row of rickety stands occupied by merchants hawking a variety of magical and mundane wares.  One long-empty stand features a bright coat of white paint and a brightly polished brass sign.

title: [A Derelict Hovel]
description: Thin shafts of light seep between the rough wooden planks that form the walls of the hovel.  A broken glass window, now boarded up, allows for a faint breeze to drift through, stirring up small dust devils.  Near the back wall, a pile of canvas sacks and twine form a makeshift bed.

Shadows creep along the rough wooden planks that form the walls of the hovel.  A broken glass window, now boarded up, allows for a faint breeze to drift through, stirring up small dust devils.  Near the back wall, a pile of canvas sacks and twine form a makeshift bed.

title: [Temple Burrow, Icy Pool]
description: Penguins churn the frigid pool.  They swim through the limpid waters, diving and splashing with a comedic flair that provokes uproarious laughter from onlookers on the banks.  The water is freezing cold, but the birds do not seem to mind in the slightest.  To the side, an icy ledge offers a way out of the gelid drink.

The water is alive with penguins.  They swim all about the pool, diving and splashing so comically that you cannot help but laugh.  The water is freezing cold, making your teeth chatter and turning your lips blue, but the birds don't seem to mind in the slightest.  To the side you spy an icy ledge that you believe you could climb to get out of the drink.

title: [Luminaries and Aromatics]
description: Silken standards, bearing various denominational insignias and mounted directly into the wood floorboards, line one side of this room.  In front of the standards is a two-tiered glass table with a large candle-centered floral arrangement.  Scattered rugs, hooked from vibrant silk yarn, appear like colorful shadows under the weight of the cabinets that hold them to the floor.

title: [Luminaries and Aromatics]
description: Smoldering scents of rare herbs and delicate florals saturate the air inside the opulent room.  Anchoring the corners of an ornately carved counter, which is centered between mirrored shelves, are two jeweled censers.  Ringlets of amber-hued smoke lift gently from the vessels toward the ceiling's peak, only to be scattered by a breeze.  Rich in gemlike color, a thick burgundy carpet, embroidered around the border in various sacred symbols, spreads across the floor.

title: [Luminaries and Aromatics, Niche]
description: Luscious damask covered benches flank either side of this cozy niche.  Chips of various dyes, bottles of fragrant oils, and wicks made of assorted fibers lay neatly arranged on a spotless worktable in the middle of the room.  Slabs of sticky paraffin and molds in a range of shapes are stacked in rows on some unadorned shelves.

title: [Empath Guild, Entrance]
description: A small iron door nestles into an expansive white marble wall.  To the left of the door the wall is decorated with a large insignia, and to the right a silver plaque is firmly affixed.  Torches line the top of the wall to await nightfall.  The ground is firm yet icy, the dirt covered by a layer of snow compressed by the passage of many footsteps.  A few small pines struggle for existence in the frigid conditions.

A small iron door nestles into an expansive white marble wall.  To the left of the door the wall is decorated with a large insignia, and to the right a silver plaque is firmly affixed.  Brightly burning torches line the top of the wall.  The ground is firm yet icy, the dirt covered by a layer of snow compressed by the passage of many footsteps.  A few small pines struggle for existence in the frigid conditions.

title: [Leaftoe's Health and Bake Shop]
description: A brick oven radiates heat from the corner.  Flour dusts the walls and floor, almost like a light snow.  Tins of sugar and other components line shelves on the walls, and bundles of herbs hang from the ceiling.  The room is filled with happy chaos, centering on the famed baker Leaftoe, who bustles about checking on the wares.

title: [Leaftoe's Bakery]
description: A brick oven radiates heat from the corner.  Flour dusts the walls and floor, almost like a light snow.  Tins of sugar and other components line shelves on the walls, and bundles of herbs hang from the ceiling.  The room is filled with happy chaos, bringing a smile to your lips.

title: [Icemule Trace, Ice Garden]
description: Alpine flowerbeds ring this tucked-away courtyard, their bright colors a feast for the eyes in comparison to the white of all the snow that lies beyond the gate.  Tamped snow paths keep footsteps soft in this small haven as travellers make their way to and from the chambers north of here.  Centered in a bed of white edelweiss and aromatic purple-flowered calamintha is an ice fountain, its watery spray frozen in a sparkling plume.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Gangplank Way]
description: A hand crafted stone arch crosses the street, an intricately carved skull relief on the keystone.  Ice and snow is jammed in between the massive rocks, the stonework weathered by the constant blast of frozen winds.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Galleon Road]
description: Some children built a snowman on the northwest corner of the street, its stick arms standing out as if poised for battle.  A passerby changed the image a bit, adding a black head scarf and a black patch over the sculpture's eye, leaving a dueling snowpirate to fend off invisible attackers.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Galleon Road]
description: The familiar construction of a seaside town spreads throughout the neighborhood, complete with garish colors and several buildings sitting on stilts to raise them out of the snow.  Keepsakes and trophies from seafaring ventures past hang in windows up and down Galleon Road, proudly displayed by their owners for all to see.

title: [Ice Garden, Altar]
description: Benches of carved ice with seats of wood surround the central altar, bowered with beardtongue shrubs.  The glitter of the fallen snow reflects light in a myriad of rainbows, creating a hypnotic effect ideal for settling into a meditative state.  Carved into the base of the glacier is a dark crevice leading into the mountain of ice.

title: [Icemule Trace, Bank]
description: A row of highly polished brass teller windows lines the back wall of the bank.  Staggered in height from short to tall, their ledges comfortably accommodate travellers of all sizes.  Suspended from the ceiling is a gilded silver sign.

title: [Icemule Trace Exchange]
description: The room is a bustle of activity with clerks moving stacks of paper left and right for reasons you cannot begin to fathom.  A musty wood fragrance fills the air, somewhat reminiscent of an old log cabin filled with dust.  Just behind a low wooden desk sits a middle-aged halfling clerk who seems to be waiting impatiently for something.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Lobby]
description: A cozy fire burns in the stone fireplace, casting a warm glow about the room.  Numbered boxes line the walls, marked with scrawled destinations.  In the center of the lobby, a group of burly halfling movers play a game of dice on a low table.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Office]
description: Deep fur rugs line the floors of the office, providing warm beds for several sleeping cats and dogs.  Stacks of crates and boxes line the office walls, marked with exotic destinations.

title: [Icemule Sheriff's Office]
description: This office is strangely opulent in a stark contrast to the sparse outer rooms of the jailhouse.  Blue velvet drapes cover the barred windows, and a large polished glaes desk dominates the center of the room.  On the wall behind the desk hangs a small portrait.

title: [Whimbley's Four Corners]
description: Several glass display cases with miniature room models line the walls of this tidy shop.  Decorated with lilliputian furniture, each tiny room shows how well Whimbly's wall treatments compliment the homeowner's styles.  The proprietor wrings her hands expectantly as she watches you browse.

Several glass display cases with miniature room models line the walls of this tidy shop.  Decorated with lilliputian furniture, each tiny room shows how well Whimbly's wall treatments complement the homeowner's styles.  The proprietor wrings her hands expectantly as she watches you browse.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Dreamshine's Bedding]
description: Raised platforms line the walls, each containing different types of bedding in a rainbow of hues.  Soft golden light trickles from shuttered lanterns hanging from the rafters, creating an intimate atmosphere.

title: [Melisii's Fireplace Emporium]
description: The glazed sandstone walls and floor of Melisii's cozy shop are lined with a large selection of fireplaces and heaters, and soft candlelight glints warmly on the various metals and trims.  The merchant smiles brightly as she demonstrates her wares to potential customers, commenting favorably on the fine workmanship of her expensive models and emphasizing the excellent value offered by her braziers and firepits.

title: [Theislan's Tables]
description: This tiny but elegant shop houses a number of small tables, each one more elegant than the last.  Light filters through a skylight above, casting soft shadows across the myriad surfaces.  The proprietor, his pockets bulging with tarts, looks anxiously about.

title: [The Distinctive Elf]
description: The crests of the Elven Houses hang from the rafters in this tiny shop, each more colorful than the last.  A small maoral counter rests near the back of the room.

title: [The House Well-Heeled]
description: Swatches of flooring materials pasted to large flat boards stand in a row against the back wall.  Each board has casters to make it easy to wheel out a sample for closer viewing.  Tiradell sits quietly at her small oak desk, reading a book and occasionally glancing disinterestedly at you before pursing her lips and returning her attention to her novel.

title: [Katanka's Table Shop]
description: Tall planks of various hardwoods stand in neat, stacked rows at the periphery of this spacious shop.  Each piece of wood is cut and sanded to perfection, ready to be used in making one of the many fine tables available for purchase.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Maerhyn's Marble]
description: Silent slabs of marble are positioned like sentinels along every wall of this expansive shop.  The air is cool and still, all footsteps muffled by the thickly carpeted floor on which the thick stone samples rest.

title: [The Silvered Glaes Window Shop]
description: Bright sunlight streams into this tiny shop, pouring through countless apertures in the walls and ceiling.  Delicate silk hangings draped across the openings flutter lightly with each passing breeze.
Soft moonlight streams into this tiny shop, pouring through countless apertures in the walls and ceiling.  Delicate silk hangings draped across the openings flutter lightly with each passing breeze.

title: [Fileene's Flooring]
description: Footsteps of customers make a soft shushing sound as they move over the expanse of snowy-white marble that tiles the floor of this open, airy room.  Samples of marble flooring are displayed in chunky squares stacked in small colorful towers all about the shop.

title: [The Crackling Blaze]
description: Fireplaces, braziers and kilns of all shapes and sizes line the walls of this large shop.  An old, battered brazier rests in the center of the room, its coals glowing a dull red.

title: [Sweet Dreams Shop]
description: Raised platforms are built around the perimeter of the shop, holding up for display a wide assortment of bedroom furnishings. The polished cedar panels dividing the wares into distinct decorative groups impart a crisp, pleasant fragrance to the surrounding area.

title: [The Winter Garden]
description: Exquisite wall hangings depicting various flowers and trees decorate the walls of this gallery from top to bottom.  The variety of textures and colors available promises something unusual for every discriminating homeowner.

title: [Tartle's Rugs]
description: Rugs and carpets are piled to the ceiling, creating a colorful maze of textures.  A rough-hewn chair rests off in the room's only empty space, with Tartle's half-eaten lunch upon it.

title: [Icemule Historical Society]
description: Painted on one plaster wall is an enormous mural of the brightly decorated round gers of the northern steppes.  A pair of small stools sit next to a three-sided table in the center of the room.  Leaning up against the walls all around you are rough sketches of different landscapes and cities.

title: [Icemule Historical Society]
description: Although clearly still a functional kitchen, this room is also being used as a sort of office.  Stacks of paperwork held down by soup ladles and whisks are crowded together at one end of a long maoral table.  The aroma of freshly-baked bread fills the air.

title: [Icemule Historical Society]
description: Hung on the wall in order from smallest to largest is an array of hammers, some with specialized heads or claws.  Other hand tools are set out on narrow counters next to jars of nails and assorted measuring devices.  Delicate curlings of wood have tumbled to the floor near a double-horned spokeshave.

title: [Icemule Historical Society]
description: Rows of smoke-yellowed oil paintings portraying distinguished halflings line either side of this long, narrow room.  At the far end a broad desk topped with dusty green leather sits in a pool of dim light.  The half-round window above is tinted a very pale blue.

Rows of smoke-yellowed oil paintings portraying distinguished halflings line either side of this long, narrow room.  At the far end a broad desk topped with dusty green leather sits in a pool of silvery moonlight.  The half-round window above is tinted a very pale blue.

title: [Icemule Historical Society]
description: It is difficult to get much sense of what this room looks like underneath the flurries and drifts of paper that cover most surfaces.  A large mound that could possibly be a desk faces a window with rippled panes of glass.  Rising from the snowy detritus is an easel supporting a large corkboard.

title: [Icemule Historical Society]
description: A curved wooden bench faces a small raised platform in one corner of this cheerfully decorated room.  Prominently displayed on the platform is a scale model of a three-masted sailing ship.  Wooden letter blocks are jumbled on a shelf underneath a well-used abacus.

title: [Trill's Music Shop]
description: The earthen walls of this tiny burrow are shored up by thick modwir beams that have been polished to a soft dark golden sheen.  Flames dance in the grate of a small fireplace centered on the back wall, bringing a warm cozy glow to the space.  Colorful braided rugs carpet the hard-packed earthen floor.  Displayed on stands and on racks hung from the wooden beams are musical instruments of various types.

title: [Inking Den, Annex Hallway]
description: Frosted globes nestled within decorative wall sconces provide a steady glow of welcoming light down the long corridor.  The walls are hidden behind bright ivory white silk drapery, the soft ends of which pool upon the thick cerulean and azure carpet.  Built into opposing walls, a lacquered beige door and a lacquered white door part the drapery and have a trio of brightly glowing globes directly above their pointed, cinquefoil frames.

title: [Uxbri's Firewood]
description: A massive pile of split logs dominates the back of the small tent, and the pleasant smell of freshly chopped wood fills the air. Sawdust and chips of wood cover the floor, and small footprints lead out of the tent.

title: [Crumpy's Slightly Used Stuff]
description: Dirty, cracked, and broken windows fill this part of a small shop.  Bits and pieces of wood and glass shards litter the floor.  Some attempt has been made to clean the merchandise, but has only succeeded in demonstrating exactly how dirty the windows really are.

title: [Crumpy's Slightly Used Stuff]
description: Old, broken weapons and assorted military paraphernalia hang on the walls and litter the floor.  A fine coat of thick grey dust sits on everything in this corner of the shop...including Old Man Crumpy.

title: [Crumpy's Slightly Used Stuff]
description: Samples of all sorts of wood and stone floors are stacked haphazardly and teeter menacingly.  Little models of rooms sit on top of the heaps, grungy and battered from years of handling.

title: [Crumpy's Slightly Used Stuff]
description: Stacks of moth-eaten rugs and other floor coverings are strewn about, covering every horizontal surface in this part of the cramped shop.  The smell of rot and mildew here is overpowering.

title: [Eleani's Wagon, Boutique]
description: A small ceramic-tiled mudroom opens up into the interior of the wagon.  A soft area rug, woven from prismatic hues, covers a large area of the oak floor.  Lengths of silk have been suspended from the ceiling, draping across the rows of rectangular windows along the upper edge of each wall and coloring the light as it crosses the room.  Flanked on the left by a cherrywood armoire is an intricate rack fashioned into a weeping willow tree.  Opposite the rack, a row of pegs displays numerous containers

A small ceramic-tiled mudroom opens up into the interior of the wagon.  A soft area rug, woven from prismatic hues, covers a large area of the oak floor.  Lengths of silk have been suspended from the ceiling, draping across the rows of rectangular windows along the upper edge of each wall and coloring the light as it crosses the room.  Flanked on the left by a cherrywood armoire is an intricate rack fashioned into a weeping willow tree.  Opposite the rack, a row of pegs displays numerous containers.

title: [Flashfeet's Fine Fashions]
description: Stands and dummies draped with the sturdy clothing necessary for such a cold climate are arranged near the windows, while a blazing matte black iron stove glows with red coals exuding warmth.

A small sign hangs over a series of dummies and stands with several outfits on display.  A pairing of suggested outfits hang on either side of the dressing room.  Sitting beneath a narrow frosted window is a matte black iron stove, exuding warmth throughout the shop.  A painted mural of Icemule Trace hangs above a small wooden door leading deeper into the shop.

Warmed by a halfling-sized cast iron stove, this room features several mannequins in various outfits.  A small sign hangs near the dressing room, which is flanked by elegant fur coats and leather jackets.  Pristine white polar bear furs, silvery arctic wolverine pelts, and shimmering ivory snowcat skins adorn the walls.  A freshly retouched mural of Icemule Trace hangs above a small wooden door leading deeper into the shop.

title: [Flashfeet's, Traveller's Togs]
description: Displayed here are accessories for those traveling out and about in the snowy clime.  A young apprentice bustles about, straightening the drape of a cloth and dusting away signs of the recent renovations.

A row of raised wooden cases display cold weather accessories, each overflowing with assorted wares.  The walls are lined with animal fur rugs, suspended from thick iron rods hanging from the ceiling.  A small sign sits atop a podium nestled against the wall.  A young shop apprentice bustles about, seeing to the stock of the shop.

A row of wooden pegs lines one oak-paneled wall, displaying thick, colorful caps and scarves.  The remaining three walls are covered in rich tapestries suspended from thick mithril rods that hang from the ceiling and embroidered with scenes of local wildlife.  The floor is covered with a lush, white rug made to resemble snow.  A long, glass case that holds a variety of mittens and gloves occupies one corner of the shop.  A young sylvan apprentice tidies the shawls on a nearby wooden rack.

title: [Flashfeet's, Fine Footwear]
description: Walls of white contrast with the colorful footwear on display in this part of the clothier's.  Customers browse through the wares nearby, handling the boots and slippers while discussing prices with a young clerk.

The walls of this shop are painted a pristine white and accented with several blue markings to look like small snow-dusted mountains.  Resting atop a circular animal print rug is a pair of low shelves, each filled with a variety of colorful footwear.  Positioned neatly between the shelves is a small sign, with a smug looking shop clerk next to it.  Off in the corner, a short stove filled with glowing embers offers limited amounts of warmth.

Pristine white walls accented with silvery swirls create the illusion of windblown snow.  Several clear glass tables displaying slippers and shoes sit upon luxurious white carpet.  Along the rear wall, two narrow glass shelves stand bearing several styles of boots.  Positioned between the shelves is a small sign, with a smug-looking elven clerk close by.  Off in one corner, a short stove filled with glowing embers offers limited amounts of warmth, making this room a bit colder than the rest.

title: [Flashfeet's, Original Outfits]
description: Polished woods and darkly-stained shelves warm the room with their rich hues.  An older journeyman sorts through a new shipment of separates and other apparel, placing each arrival on the correct shelf.

Lengths of polished wood are spaced evenly across the floor of the shop.  Several tall, darkly stained shelves warm the room with their rich hues.  Positioned in front of the shelves is a stately oak desk with a small sign sitting on top of it.  A row of lit candelabras rest on either side of the shelves, illuminating their contents.  An older shopkeeper leans against a wide shelf, a welcoming smile on his face.

Along the back wall of this room, an elegant gold-trimmed glass case bears several unique clothing designs, a small sign positioned neatly above it.  On each adjacent wall, several wide shelves stand evenly spaced, their contents folded in neat stacks.  Dancing light emanating from candelabras placed throughout the room illuminates the wares for sale.  A stately oak desk rests atop an ornate rug in the center of the room.  An older dwarven shopkeeper stands next to the desk, a welcoming smile on his face.

title: [Flashfeet's, Pins and Pendants]
description: Elaborately draped counters and richly lined boxes display the jewelry on sale here.  A young woman stands by the counter, keeping a friendly eye on the browsing customers.

Several lengths of velvet draping accent the intricately carved counters of the shop.  A row of golden snowflakes lines the outsides of the jewelry  on display.  Each piece of jewelry inside the cases rests atop small velvet podiums.  Suspended by twisting lengths of silver chain overhead is a small sign.  A young woman stands by the counter, keeping a watchful eye on the browsing customers.

Soft, white velvet fabric has been draped over the tops of various intricately carved counters, creating a bright showroom.  Shimmering silver tinsel snowflakes draw eyes to the glittering wares on display.  Inside a series of carved jewelry cases, small, white podiums exhibit semi-precious gems set in an assortment of earrings, necklaces, and other trinkets.  A lively human clerk keeps a watchful eye on cases and customers alike.

title: [Tartifacts, Balcony]
description: Silver tables and chairs line this balcony, resting on a floor covered with a fine layer of tart crumbs.  A group of dwarves sits at an end table, grumbling about the lack of good ale in Icemule Trace.

title: [White Haven, Outside Facade]
description: A crystalline tower streaked with gold rises above an outer wall of white stone, radiating warmth and light against the chill surroundings.  A finely detailed ice sculpture stands guard at each side of a white modwir gate bearing the words "White Haven" in gold leaf.

title: [White Haven, Grand Courtyard]
description: A vast and peaceful courtyard surrounds the crystal tower bordered by a stone wall.  Engulfed by clinging ice-coated vines that create a large frozen mosaic on the wall are a white birch branch message board and a heavy slate blackboard.  Almost hidden by the vines, a staircase spirals upward against the central tower, while a massive white modwir-framed entryway stands as the obvious entrance, with a granite monument placed nearby.  An ice-covered pond dominates one corner of the courtyard.

A vast and peaceful courtyard surrounds the crystal tower, bordered by a stone wall.  Delicate vines coated with a fine layer of ice cling to the wall, creating a frozen mosaic.  Almost hidden by the vines, a staircase spirals upwards against the central tower, while a massive white modwir-framed entryway stands as the obvious entrance.

A vast and peaceful courtyard surrounds the crystal tower, bordered by a stone wall.  Delicate vines coated with a fine layer of ice cling to the wall, creating a frozen mosaic.  Almost hidden by the vines, a staircase spirals upwards against the central tower, while a massive white modwir-framed entryway stands as the obvious entrance.  An ice-covered pond dominates one corner of the courtyard.

title: [Icemule Trace, Travel Office]
description: Light from the fireplace near the end of the room causes shadows to dance merrily across the plain stone walls.  Rugs and furs line the ground, providing further insulation from the harsh conditions outside.  Near the heavy door is a squat white clerk's counter and before the fireplace is a blue-cushioned bench.

title: [New Look, Hair Coloration]
description: The canvas walls of this small pavilion are hung with carefully tied bundles of hair in a variety of colors.  A vat of lye sits next to the pinned-back tent flap, but even that extra ventilation isn't enough to keep the harsh vapors from stinging your eyes.  Casually stacked on a low counter are bowls of henna paste, vinegar, sodden ashes, and dark ink.

title: [New Look, Hairdressing]
description: Here in the back corner of the pavilion a makeshift station has been set up to wash, dirty, curl, straighten, braid, loosen, and otherwise fuss with all kinds of hair.  Jumbled together in a crate are bottles of olive oil, combs, ribbons and pins.  Wood-handled irons are propped over a small fire pit, and the smoke has started to fill the enclosed space.

title: [New Look, Hair Adornment]
description: In this shaded walkway between the three tents is a round iron table supporting a jar of brushes and a few pots of dye.  A cedar box full of bone hairpins and narrow strips of leather has been left right on the ground, in danger of being kicked over by a clumsy foot.

title: [New Look, Skin Care]
description: Wooden screens divide this large tent into smaller spaces, but they don't block the howls of agony coming from every corner.  A raised pallet partially obscured by a thin gauze curtain rests conveniently near a set of freestanding shelves.  Stored haphazardly therein are cyclamen roots, a bowl of birch sap, some sheep dung, a bottle of lemon juice, and a tub of quicklime.

title: [New Look, Eye Colors]
description: The rivulets of blood trickling down the legs of a crude operating table give some indication of the unpleasantness of this procedure.  Thick glass jars are stacked three deep, each one packed full of preserved eyes with their optic nerves still attached.  A very sharp-looking scalpel has been left at the foot of the table, ready for further use.

title: [New Look, Eye Enhancements]
description: Lancets, needles, razors, and scalpels have been laid out in tidy arrays atop a narrow chest of drawers.  A solid oak chair fitted with many leather straps is pushed up against the flimsy wooden screen.  The sole nod to cleanliness appears to be a bowl of wine used to soak the instruments between uses.

title: [New Look, Nasal Sculpting]
description: This small corner has been festively decorated with sketches of noses, illustrating a wide variety of shapes and sizes.  The cheeriness is broken, however, by the display of instruments used to achieve these many effects.  A chest full of neatly-rolled bandages and a basket of brown eggs sit at the ready.

title: [New Look, Short and Tall]
description: Here inside the tent, the light wicker frame that provides support is just visible between the wool blankets used to help muffle sound.  A massive apparatus bearing a strong resemblance to a stretching rack is dwarfed only by a device whose purpose seems to involve a great deal of crushing and compacting.  Stuck into the ground is a tall pole marked off at intervals with red paint.

title: [New Look, Distinctive Marks]
description: The strange emptiness of this portion of the tent gives it an even more ominous feel.  The only object is an upright wooden box just large enough to contain one person.  Its narrow door latches solidly on the outside.

title: [New Look, Facial Repair]
description: A series of shaped wooden frames with adjustable metal screws have been fixed at head height in front of a row of straight-backed chairs.  They all face the near wall of the tent, where inspirational phrases have been painted in bright, cheery colors.  A few of the protruding screws still show traces of former users.

title: [New Look, Haircuts]
description: An old chair with a wobbly leg takes up most of the space under this crooked awning.  A string has been tied from the side of the tent to a post stuck in the ground, and dangling from it are dull-looking shears and carving knives.  Drifts of shorn hair cover the ground, forming hummocks and valleys of blond and brunette.

title: [Icemule Hall, Courtyard]
description: A long cobblestone walkway winds through the courtyard, its surface glossy with the sheen of ice.  Lofty pine trees tower high overhead, their boughs low with the weight of new fallen snow.  A multitude of iceblossoms peek out from beneath the trees, brightening the landscape with a riot of color.  At the foot of the walkway is a sprawling oak building, its eaves draped in dripping icicles.  Cobblestone steps lead up to a set of rounded oak doors.

title: [The Nightowl Pub, Lounge]
description: Waitresses wearing feathered headdresses fashioned like the heads of owls work the room swiftly and quietly, trying not to interrupt the guests or the stage act.  Although the tables are set relatively close together, the darkness creates a feeling of intimacy.  After their number, the chorus glides off the stage and all but disappears behind a dark curtain.
