title: [Tavern Burrow, Nightowl Landing]
[Twisting Staircase, Landing]
description: The narrow landing is wrought from the same metal as the staircase, though its surface is grated to provide a glimpse of the street below.  Though thin, the railings seem sturdy enough to support the weight of most humanoids.  Whispers, giggles, and the occasional feather drift onto the landing from an open window at the back of the pub.

You pause at the narrow landing to catch your breath.  To your relief, the thin iron railings are much sturdier than they appeared to be at first glance.  Whispers, giggles, and the occasional feather drift onto the landing from an open window.

title: [The Thirsty Penguin, Bar]
description: Practical, as are most halfling institutions, the entry leads straight into the bar of the Thirsty Penguin Tavern.  A glittering bead curtain hangs off to one side, swinging lazily each time someone passes through it.  The entire wall behind the bar is studded with small, polished bronze mirrors.

title: [Thirsty Penguin, Front Desk]
description: A narrow desk with a bouquet of forget-me-nots perched cheerfully on its top is set before a short hallway.  Highly polished lamps brighten up every corner of this crowded room, encouraging you to warm yourself before setting out again.  A crystal statue of a penguin, nearly as tall as a halfling, twinkles in the light.

title: [Thirsty Penguin, Parlour]
description: Thin muslin curtains are pulled back with twisted burgundy and gold silk cords.  Chairs and small tables cluttered with bric-a-brac make maneuvering difficult.  A small, tiled woodstove warms the room from its place in the corner.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Stout Street]
description: The rear entrance to the gaming hall is nearly as resplendent as its main one.  Espaliered wintercrisp apple trees grow to either side of the massive dark modwir doors.  Bright green apples weigh down their branches, but not a single fruit has been suffered to splatter the cobblestones below.  A smiling attendant in silver and blue waves at passerby.

The rear entry to the Silvermule Gaming Hall is nearly as impressive as the main entrance.  Espaliered pear trees grow to either side of the massive doors, with silvery fruit affixed to their branches.  A smiling attendant in silver and blue waves at you as you pass by.

title: [Silvermule, East Game Room]
description: Rows of wooden boxes with intricate scroll-work designs nearly fill the room.  Patrons are amused by the mechanical dancing couples and other wondrous scenes displayed by the various devices.  Although the room is crowded, the clamor is softened by the tapestries that cover the walls.

title: [Silvermule Gaming Hall, Foyer]
description: The high-ceilinged foyer is paved with royal blue and white marble tiles flecked with silver.  A clerk smiles from behind a silver teller's cage and exchanges pleasantries with the guests.  Some topiary, trimmed carefully into the shapes of spades and hearts, stands on either side of the arched doorways leading east and west.

title: [Silvermule Gaming Hall, Library]
description: The Library is lined with ceiling-height bookcases.  Each shelf is filled with a variety of leather-bound tomes, some thick, others thin, but all obviously unused.  The feature which is receiving the most attention in this richly carpeted room is the paneled cherrywood bar, which stands off to one side.

title: [Silvermule, Corridor]
description: A long corridor stretches before you, lit by mining lamps hung on the walls.  Boxes are stacked along the walls with peculiar runes scratched onto them.

title: [Silvermule, Corridor]
description: The corridor is lined with piles of neatly folded--and empty--money sacks.  Boxes of playing cards are stacked upon closed crates bearing labels from the Borthuum Mining Company.

title: [Silvermule, Corridor]
description: The corridor is lined with piles of neatly folded--and empty--money sacks.  Boxes of playing cards are stacked upon closed crates bearing labels from the Borthuum Mining Company.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Stout Street]
[Tavern Burrow, Gaming Hall]
description: A bright blue carpet fringed with silver tassels leads up to the entrance of a gaming hall, proceeding between two yew trees that have been trimmed into the shapes of mules and sprinkled with silvery powder.  A stout halfling in silver and blue livery bows low as would-be gamblers pass through the doors, an inviting smile on his lips.  An occasional shout of excitement erupts from within the hall as someone wins another hand.

On either side of a carpeted entry are two dark yew trees, trimmed into the shapes of mules and sprinkled with silvery powder.  A young halfling in silver and blue livery bows low as you pass by, gesturing toward the doorway with an inviting smile on his lips.  From inside the gaming hall comes a rising cry, as someone wins another hand.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Tavern Burrow, Stout Street]
description: An unofficial moneychanger does brisk business at the corner, moving from streetcorner to streetcorner to avoid contact with town officials.  Brightly colored banners in silver and blue fly from surrounding windows, proclaiming the way to various local establishments.  Across the way, a low-roofed stone guard post is surrounded by a spade-tipped fence with a heavy wrought iron gate.

An unofficial moneychanger does brisk business at the corner, moving from side to side of the road to avoid any contact with town officials.  Brightly colored banners in silver and blue fly from surrounding windows, proclaiming the way to various local establishments.  Across the way, a low-roofed stone guard post is surrounded by a spade-tipped fence with a heavy wrought iron gate.

An unofficial moneychanger appears to be doing a brisk business at the corner, moving from side to side of the road as he avoids any contact with town officials.  Brightly colored banners in silver and blue are hung from several windows, proclaiming the way to the Silvermule Gaming Hall and other nearby establishments.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Honeybeer Road]
description: At the busy intersection of Stout Street and Honeybeer Road, the smell of roasting meats drifts from the west on a cold breeze.  The whistling of a traveling merchant rises over the moaning of the wind as her mule-drawn cart clatters down the road.  Sounds of town guards drilling filter over the high wall of an armory to the north.

You find yourself at the busy intersection of Stout Street and Honeybeer Road.  The smells of roasting meats entice you to move west, yet there seems to be some activity to the north which might be worth investigating.  Pausing briefly, you whistle a quick tune and make your way down the road.

title: [Icemule, Bootlegger's Alley]
description: Short, sturdy buildings and multi-colored kiosks line both sides of the cobblestone alley here, under the protective south wall of Icemule Trace.  Passing merchants laden with goods of all shapes and sizes wander out of the alley towards Honeybeer Road on various errands.

Short, sturdy buildings and multi-colored kiosks line both sides of the cobblestone alley here, under the protective south wall of Icemule Trace.  The occasional merchant laden with goods wanders out of the shadowed alley towards Honeybeer Road.

title: [Icemule, Bootlegger's Alley]
description: Bootlegger's Alley comes to an end at a cul-de-sac, sheltered by the wind by walls on two sides and the back sides of the shops of Tavern Burrow on the third.  Bright sunlight streams down, highlighting the odd bits of trash that collect along with leaves and snow in the corners of the walls.

Bootlegger's Alley comes to an end at a cul-de-sac, sheltered by the wind by walls on two sides and the back sides of the shops of Tavern Burrow on the third.  Silvery starlight almost hides the odd bits of trash that collect along with leaves and snow in the corners of the walls.

title: [Icemule, Bootlegger's Alley]
description: The cobblestone alley is slick in some places, covered in frozen puddles.  Patches of snow and ice hang from the eaves of various short buildings that are spread out on either side of the alley.  To the south, you can see the gleam of sunlight reflecting off the icy wall.

The cobblestone alley is slick in some places, covered in frozen puddles.  Patches of snow and ice hang from the eaves of various short buildings that are spread out on either side of the alley.  To the south, you can see the gleam of moonlight reflecting off the icy wall.

title: [Icemule, Bootlegger's Alley]
description: Snow accumulates against the South Wall, which leans over the alley and casts a long shadow over its stores.  An empty cask abandoned at the side of the alley, its staves kicked in by some tremendous force, spreads a faint odor of hops over the cobblestones.

Snow accumulates against the South Wall, casting a gloomy dark shadow over the alley and its stores.  At the side of the alley lies an empty cask, its staves kicked in by some tremendous force.  A faint odor of hops rises from the cobblestones beneath your feet.

title: [Bootlegger's and Brewer's]
description: The intersection of Bootlegger's Alley and Brewer's Alley creates a large clear space in front of the defensive tower that occupies the southwestern corner of Icemule Trace.  The comings and goings of the militia can be seen as uniformed halflings weave their way in and among the cobbles.

The intersection of Bootlegger's Alley and Brewer's Alley creates a large, clear space in front of the defensive tower that occupies the southwestern corner of Icemule Trace.  A pair of flickering torches outside the tower illuminates the area and causes the shadows of the militia to flicker off the walls, as the guards weave their way in and among the cobbles.

title: [Icemule, Brewer's Alley]
description: Under the protection of the towering west wall, an odd assortment of ramshackle buildings appears in this back street.  Some artistic soul recently scraped the ice off the wall, revealing a multi-colored mural depicting a troupe of halflings performing for a crowd of onlookers.

Under the protection of the towering west wall, an odd assortment of ramshackle buildings appears in this shadowy back street.  Some artistic soul recently scraped the ice off the wall, revealing a multi-colored mural depicting a troupe of halflings performing for a crowd of onlookers.

title: [Icemule, Brewer's Alley]
description: The impressive west wall dominates the view of this alley, towering over the various squat buildings and the randomly placed kiosks.  Bright pennants of different colors snap in the wind from dark doorways, attempting to draw the eyes of the occasional person who wanders past.

The impressive west wall dominates the view of this alley, casting a long shadow over the various squat buildings and the randomly placed kiosks.  Pennants of muted colors snap in the wind from lit doorways, attempting to draw the eyes of the occasional person who wanders past.

title: [Icemule, Brewer's Alley]
description: The ice-encrusted west wall towers over the small, squat buildings that line Brewer's Alley.  The wall does little to prevent the icy winds from freezing the occasional passersby, as they meander among the shops and kiosks.

The ice-encrusted west wall towers over the small, squat buildings that line Brewer's Alley.  From the look on the faces of the infrequent passersby, the granite bulwark offers little comfort from the icy winds that course through the shadowed shops and kiosks.

title: [Icemule, Brewer's Alley]
description: The alley dead ends here at the base of an intricately carved statue set flush against the northern wall.  The cobblestones look to be in dire need of cleaning, as small bits of refuse can be seen strewn about the alley.

The alley dead ends here at the base of an intricately carved statue set flush against the northern wall.  The shadows make it difficult to see the cobblestones in any great detail, though strewn bits of refuse can be easily observed as dark unidentifiable objects here and there.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Main Room]
description: The walls and ceiling are paneled in dark cherry wood, which makes the room seem smaller than it really is.  Low-backed chairs upholstered with red leather seats are arranged beside a glowing brazier.  The sounds of clinking mugs and low voices provide the comforting sense that refreshments are near.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Tap Room]
description: The lower walls are tinted plaster over stone, as evidenced by the chips at the exact level of the chair backs.  The bar itself is worn, and the low brass footrest is polished only by the shoes of the many customers who have cradled a pint while leaning against the bar.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Dining Room]
description: A large stone hearth dominates one wall, with several roasts at different stages of completion turning on the spit.  Diners select items for their meal from a giantman-sized oak sideboard, which is crowded with a wide assortment of platters.

title: [Xenophon's Fletcher Shop]
description: This cozy shop is lit by dozens of wax candles that glimmer on the shelves, illuminating stacks of elk hide quivers and various style of bolts and arrows.  Bows of fine wood and bone stand along the walls, ready for inspection by discerning archers.  Shop assistants busy themselves with wood and feathers in the back of the room, and a wooden counter inlaid with polished mithril stands before you.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Granary Lane]
description: The east side of the street is lined with wooden silos.  Their snow-covered tops contrast with the bright red and yellow patterns painted on the sides.

title: [Wineberry's Weapons, Shop]
description: In spite of the obviously recent renovations, the main room of the shop retains a faint scent of oil and smoke that is not altogether unpleasant.  Several halflings wander about, polishing metal surfaces or adjusting the position of something to better catch the light.  Fresh sawdust is scattered on the ground, wet footprints tracked through it here and there.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Porter Street]
description: Three shallow steps descend from the street toward the low doorway of a building, an armor shop if judging by the dark blue banner over the entrance.  The shop's crisply edged stucco walls have been painted steel grey, with white and black spirals accenting the swirls of the mortar.  Sets of armor, most designed to fit a diminutive frame, are on display through the wide bay windows.  A family pauses before the statue of a halfling standing opposite the door as the parents tell the hero's story to their children.

Three shallow steps lead from the street down to a low doorway at the side of a building, apparently the local armor shop.  Its crisply edged stucco walls have been painted steely grey, with faint traces of white and black accenting each swirl of mortar.  Inside a polished bay window are displayed several sets of armor, each designed to fit a diminutive frame.  A family pauses briefly before the statue of a halfling warrior standing opposite the door as the parents tell the hero's story to their children.

title: [Haldrick's Armory]
description: This shop lies below street level, half-moon windows along the front illuminating racks of armor and shields.  Recent renovations have left traces of dust currently being excised by an apprentice with a broom.

title: [Abloid's Upholstery]
description: Obviously proud of his work, the shop owner has gone to great expense to elaborately frame several life-sized portraits of the specialty chairs his family has created for several generations.  Great gilded borders lend an elegance to the paintings displayed on the walls, much like an art gallery.  Behind a tidy carved rosewood desk sits a fashionably-attired clerk, ready to greet customers as they enter.

title: [Abloid's Upholstery]
description: Though quite small, the tiny room is filled with light streaming in from the large glaes-paned windows that line the front of the shop.  The natural illumination adds a homey glow, and creates quite a comfortable setting for the customers.  A small doorway leading into the back, where all the crafting of the chairs takes place, affords a glimpse of the hustle and bustle of the workers.

Moonlight streaming through large glaes-paned windows provides plenty of light to illuminate the insides of this small shop.  A semicircle of comfortable looking chairs provide customers an opportunity to try out the wares, or simply to sit and view the night sky.  A small doorway leading into the back, where all the crafting of the chairs takes place, affords a glimpse of the hustle and bustle of the workers.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Barley Lane]
description: The lane turns sharply north, its forward progress blocked by a low stone well.  Attached to a length of frayed rope, the well's bucket has been hauled out of its depths.  Its wood looks to have been dry for some time.  Voices of parties heading home or to nearby taverns echo off of the brick facades of the narrow buildings to either side of the road, but the stretch is quieter than most of the surrounding district.

Barley Lane turns sharply north here, its forward progress blocked by a community well.  This section of town is somewhat quieter, although occasionally, the voices of parties heading home or to a tavern echo off the narrow buildings.

title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
description: A precarious ledge juts out from the wall and a few broken stones of the well shaft's lining, icy to the touch, serve as a handhold.  The pale circle of the well's mouth above outlines a rusted winch.  A fraying rope dangles past you into the shadows below.

title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
description: The well's bucket is firmly lodged in a mass of frozen tree limbs and dried brush.  The rope holding the bucket, grey with frost, dangles slackly above, rising upward like a wisp of smoke.  There doesn't seem to be any way to get farther down.

title: [Bard Guild, Courtyard]
description: A sturdy split-rail fence surrounds the neat courtyard.  The snow has been shoveled away from the center, revealing a surface paved in riverstone.  Embedded in the riverstone and reflecting the moonlight, small silver stepping stones depict a large treble clef.  A private yet inviting atmosphere is created by the evergreen shrubs lining the fence.  The low building at one end displays a marquee over the carved door, beneath large luminescent blue letters proclaiming "Icemule Theater."

A sturdy split-rail fence surrounds the neat courtyard.  The snow has been shoveled away from the center, revealing a surface paved in riverstone.  Embedded in the riverstone and glinting in the sunlight, small silver stepping stones depict a large treble clef.  A private yet inviting atmosphere is created by the evergreen shrubs lining the fence.  The low building at one end displays a marquee over the carved door, beneath large luminescent blue letters proclaiming "Icemule Theater."

title: [Icemule Trail, Clearing]
description: Burly woodcutters have chopped down a number of trees and stacked the logs neatly to one side of the clearing, ready for transport down the wide track.  A small lean-to shelters the open fire pit that gives the workers a warm place to rest from their labors.

title: [Icemule Trail, Pine Tree]
description: The tree shelters all who are within the embrace of its branches.  Although the wind batters hard against the intertwined limbs, it fails to find entry, making the confines of the shelter much warmer.  A pile of sweet-smelling pine needles offers a comfortable, resting place.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: The severe cold is mind-numbing and the howling wind screams in your ears as you strain to see what direction you should take.  Through the driving snow, you spy a towering rock formation to the south.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: As you plod along in this wintry wasteland, you find it hard to avoid the slippery ice patches.  The snowfall has reduced visibility to less than an arm's length and it is decidedly colder.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: Through the light snowfall, you can see some enormous footprints in the snow.  Peering nervously about, you shudder and are not sure if it is the cold...or dread of meeting the creature that made the tracks.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: The deep snow is almost up to the tops of your boots and is still coming down.  You seriously doubt that you will ever be warm again and worry again about your poor feet which you haven't been able to feel in such a long time.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: You heave a thankful sigh of relief as the snowfall all but stops and a few rays of sun find their way through the dense cloud cover.  Although it brings no warmth, the sunlight brightens your mood and with new resolve, you forge ahead.

You heave a thankful sigh of relief as the snowfall all but stops and a few rays of moonlight find their way through the dense cloud cover.  Although it brings no warmth, the moonlight brightens your mood and with new resolve, you forge ahead.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: Although the snowfall has eased a bit, the shrieking wind continues to whip and whistle about you.  You wonder, not for the first time, if you will wander until you succumb to the elements and draw your final breath.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: Search though you may, no shelter can be found in this wintry wilderness that stretches on endlessly.  You stumble forward over the dangerous, icy ground -- head bent to prevent the snow from freezing on your face.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: What a miserable, desolate place this is with its never-ending wind, blinding snow and treacherous ice.  You simply can't fathom why any creature would choose such an abominable area to call home.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: Groping your way through the driving snow, you stumble upon an enormous heap of jagged, ice-glazed rocks.  Even though they shelter your body, nothing will rid you of the screaming, incessant wind which threatens to drive you insane and flails the exposed skin of your body.

title: [Snowy Plains, Deep Freeze]
description: You have somehow managed to stay on your feet in the slick ice and deep snow you have encountered.  It is a constant struggle to keep your eyes from freezing shut and never, in all your life, have you ever been so cold.

title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
description: You are dazzled by an explosion of dancing lights reflected by the occasional sunbeams venturing through the crack into this chamber of ice.  A multitude of gleaming stalactites and stalagmites makes passage through the area a grand feat.

You are dazzled by an explosion of dancing lights reflected by the occasional moonbeams venturing through the crack into this chamber of ice.  A multitude of gleaming stalactites and stalagmites makes passage through the area a grand feat.

title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
description: Overhead, a wide fissure in the high ceiling of this cavern admits the screeching wind and spitting snow and appears to extend beyond the yawning gap in the southern wall of the chamber.  The falling snow threatens to obliterate the huge footprints that cover the ground.

title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
description: Tiny rivulets of water trickle slowly down a multitude of stalactites and drip noisily onto the stalagmites rising from the frozen ground.  There are jagged shards of ice everywhere that crunch loudly beneath your feet as you explore this icy chamber.

title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
description: There is scarcely enough room to move about in this frightfully cold recess.  Yet, it is evident that something ventures into this tiny area.  Your breath forms a frosty mist as you shudder violently at the thought of being trapped in this confining space.

title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
description: On first glance, this chamber looks like the others -- until you notice a slick, icy pile of rocks against the far wall, and the frozen corpse slumped beside them.  Upon closer inspection, you discover that the ice-glazed body is frozen to the rocks themselves.  Nothing short of a thorough thaw will free the pitiful soul for a proper burial.

title: [Chivalrous' Combat Gear]

title: [Aralynn's Outfitting]
description: Smooth white plaster walls rise from a varnished oak floor.  Just above a well-pruned lemon tree hangs a bundle of dried flowers, and a blue plaster ceiling completes the picture.  A long varnished counter stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Between the severe winds and the sloping ground your footing is rather precarious.  To the east, a chasm drops into the glacier, heading off to the northeast.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: There is a pronounced slope in the ground here, causing a great deal of slipping and sliding.  To the south the ground evens into a somewhat elevated plateau, although it is difficult to tell with the snow blowing into your face.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Hills of wind-sculpted snow block what little you might be able to see through the blizzard.  Sliding slightly to the north each time you stand still, you conclude that the ground beneath the snow rises in the other direction.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The wind here is too fierce for you to see anything but flying snow.  You can barely make out general paths to the west, southwest and southeast, and hope that going one of those directions will lead to a bit of shelter.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The snow surrounding you seems to gleam with a ghostly blue-white radiance of its own.  The snow and ice buffet you, nearly blinding you and numbing your extremities.  You wish you had worn warmer clothing, although you wonder if anything you own could possibly be warm enough.

title: [Fyndra's Wall Hangings]

An elderly elven woman hums softly as she meticulously dusts a striking portrait of a beautiful and vaguely familiar face.

title: [Ta'Illistim Cartage]

title: [Reignbeau Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Small tunnels branch out in every direction and it's hard to be sure which one you entered through, let alone which to leave through.  Colored footprints dot the floor, wandering in every direction.

description: Funneled between a plateau to the south and a mountain range to the north, the wind here is vicious.  Any bare skin is rapidly chafed and burned by the cold, turning a sickly shade of blue.

title: [Galith's Bedding]
description: Dozens of exuberantly dressed beds of all sizes are set on platforms of various heights, effectively breaking the monotony of a straight-line type display. description: An enormous blue ice statue dominates this small cave. title: [Thanatoph, Stone Valley]

title: [Thanatoph, Stone Valley]

title: [Thanatoph, Stone Valley]

title: [Thanatoph, Lower Landing]

Rough-hewn and oversized, the stairs appear hard to climb.

title: [Stronghold, Entry]

title: [Stronghold, Entry Hall]

title: [Stronghold, North Hall]

Large tiles cover the floor, their rich sienna surfaces incised with glyphs.  On the stone walls, ora braziers are bolted at intervals.  They are crafted in a blocky style, which is elegant in its simplicity.  The light held in each fixture flickers to life as the shadow of movement passes before it.

title: [Stronghold, North Hall]

Clouds of dust float and dance down the nave in the twilight like cavorting spirits caught up in celebrating some revel of old.  On the north wall, an immense ora door is bolted into the stone, its proportions as ponderous as the slabs that form the walls of the thoroughfare.

title: [Stronghold, North Hall]

Overhead, the high ceiling is lost to view.  The hallway stretches away to east and west, its expanse a hollow cavern that would dwarf a mammoth.

title: [Stronghold, North Hall]

All around the sill, sigils have been carved into the stone wall in an interlocking pattern of blocky glyphs.  The symbols are obscure and meaningless, however their design is handsome.  The passageway skews to the north where light can be seen filling the adjoining room, making the gloom of the hallway more pronounced.

title: [Stronghold, Illoke's Sanctum]
description: The sanctum is large, with walls constructed of immense stone slabs.  Against the back wall stands an enormous statue, which guards the room wearing a stoic expression.  The wide southern entrance admits light, enough to bathe the place in a hazy gloom animated with shifting shadows.  They play over the colossus, giving it the appearance of movement every now and then.  A crevice on the northwest wall gives access to an adjacent chamber.

title: [Stronghold, Illoke's Sanctum]
description: Tall stone walls stretch up, becoming ragged granite fingers as they arch and meet at the apex of the lofty ceiling.  The light is low, flickering from four large braziers, hewn from the rock floor and carved into the likeness of stocky figures.  Each statue bears its burden of a brazier with head bowed, their posture one of supreme sorrow and resignation.  A pattern of strange sigils crosses the floor, disappearing into the gloom of a massive arched doorway, which dominates the far wall.

title: [Stronghold, South Hall]

To the north sits an alcove, its darker interior creating a gloomy maw at its entrance.  The southern hallway is likewise shadowy, however braziers can be glimpsed on the walls, promising the possibility of illumination.

title: [Stronghold, Southwest Skew]
description: Shadows huddle into dense pools within the recesses of the corridor, growing thicker as the hallway snakes to the southwest.  Within their darkness, a dense covering of contorted runes is visible, skittering across the walls like a spidery army.  No breezes intrude here, as if the air current is reluctant to pass the runic display.

title: [Stronghold, Alcove]
description: The alcove has a lofty, arched ceiling, yet the vast expanses of the rooms around it tend to dwarf it in comparison.  A stone slab rises out of the floor to the height of a giantman's brow.  Its surface is smooth and polished, and fine veins of ora run through the rock lengthwise, striping the slab's sides.

title: [Stronghold, South Hall]
description: The cavernous hallway continues to the east and west, its tall stone walls interrupted on its southern expanse by the lintels of an immense ora door.  Across from the door is an alcove, the entrance surrounded with a dense halo of carved sigils.  Ora braziers are set into the rock to either side of the alcove.

title: [Stronghold, Alcove]
description: Within the hush of the alcove, the still atmosphere hangs heavily, cloaked with dust and shadows.  Nothing is present in the way of furnishings, only a panorama of carved walls to ornament the quiet ambiance.  The ceiling is high above, reaching up into the darkness beyond reach of what little light penetrates the chamber from the hallway outside.

title: [Stronghold, Barracks]
description: The barracks looks more like a mausoleum than a billet, with its double row of huge stone slabs marching down the cavernous chamber.  Above, the ceiling arches into multiple peaks, each sending ribs of stone down the walls that take on a skeletal quality in the half-light.  A deep layer of dust rises on each side of the center path through the rows of bier-like bunks.

wayto.3590: ;e unless (move 'go door'); echo 'Waiting for the door to open... '; waitfor 'You hear a soft click from the door and it suddenly flies open.'; move 'go door'; end

title: [Stronghold, Barracks]
description: The two rows of titanic slabs inhabiting the sleeping quarters leave little room for other furnishings.  Each slab could easily accommodate a large wagon, and fine glyphs skitter across their surfaces like a sorcerous dressing of bedclothes.  The ornament of carvings is fine and subtle, only evident at close examination.  An ora door at the room's end offers access to the hallway outside.

title: [Stronghold, South Hall]
description: Pools of light cast from the ora braziers dot the flagstones of the corridor as it runs its east to west course.  An ora door is set into the stone walls to the south, affixed to the rock with solid hardware of ora notable for its over-sized proportions.  Dust hangs in the air, shifting idly in clouds like billowing sails on a derelict ship.

title: [Stronghold, South Hall]
description: The hallway doglegs to the south, its progress diverted at the foot of a wall covered with a dense covering of carved glyphs.  Dust is banked against this eastern bulwark, swept into deep eddies by the fitful gusts of wind snaking down the corridor.  The gloom is thick, shadows deepened by the hazy, grit-filled atmosphere.

wayto.17746: ;e unless (move 'go door'); echo 'Waiting for the door to open... '; waitfor 'You hear a soft click from the door and it suddenly flies open.'; move 'go door'; end

title: [Stronghold, Southeast Skew]
description: The floor breaks up into a rough course, growing more hazardous as it progresses to the southeast.  Jumbled boulders are flung against the uneven stone walls in great heaps, their silhouettes cloaked in shifting clouds of gloomy dust.  A penetrating odor of stale air hangs in the corridor, like a haunt reigning over the place where it died for all eternity.

title: [Stronghold, Southeast Skew]
description: The corridor dwindles into nothing, choked by rough piles of rock and walls that draw together into a pinched termination.  Strewn with boulders and choked with thick piles of dust, the floor quickly grows impassable.  Marks are noticeable on the rough stone walls, the scores of chisel, hammer and pick.

title: [Stronghold, Southwest Skew]
description: The tunnel narrows as the floor begins to exhibit deep fissures.  Across the walls, the cracks reach up from the floor and spread their splayed fingers in long, running fractures.  Deep piles of dust occupy corners produced by the ruptures, and a fine cloud of the stuff hangs in the air as if suspended in time.

title: [Stronghold, Southwest Skew]
description: As the corridor snakes through the solid stone of the mountain, it grows more confined and chaotic.  Large boulders are heaped to either side, protruding into the walkway here and there in stubborn feints.  The walls are pocked and rough, giving little evidence of any pretense at conformity.

title: [Courtyard]
description: A well maintained and healthy garden occupies the entirety of the courtyard.  The air here is cool and crisp, though the sun's strong rays beat back any feelings of cold.  In the center of the garden is a natural spring bubbling up several inches above the surface of the encircling pool of crystal clear water.  A large stone and iron gate blocks the entrance to the monastery flanked by a statue of a woman carrying a crystal staff and a set of crystalline keys facing a second statue of a kneeling young man bedecked in battle-worn black chain armor.

The air here is cool and crisp, but the bulk of the monastery shelters you from wind and makes the air bracing instead of chilling.  In the center of the garden is a natural spring bubbling up several inches above the surface of the encircling pool of crystal clear water.  A large stone and iron gate blocks the entrance to the monastery flanked by a statue of a woman carrying a crystal staff and a set of crystalline keys facing a second statue of a kneeling young man bedecked in battle-worn black chain armor.

;e need_set_roomname_off = false

if last_roomdesc = $_SERVERBUFFER_.reverse.find { |line| line =~ /<resource picture="\d+"\/><style id="roomName" ?\/\>\[[^\]]+\]/ || line =~ /You will no longer see room names./ }
  if last_roomdesc =~ /You will no longer see room names./
    fput "set roomname on"
    need_set_roomname_off = true
  end
end

save_want_downstream = Script.current.want_downstream
save_want_downstream_xml = Script.current.want_downstream_xml
Script.current.want_downstream = false

destination = Map[$mapdb_seeking_destination]
roomname_pattern = /<style id="roomName" \/>(.*?)$/
failed_to_find_destination = false
first_roomname = nil
seeking_destination = nil

20.times do
  waitcastrt?
  put "symbol of seeking"
  matchtimeout(6, "Your vision is pulled away from you...")

  result = matchtimeout(6, roomname_pattern)
  next unless result

  seeking_destination = result.match(roomname_pattern)&.captures&.first
  next unless seeking_destination

  if seeking_destination[0] == "<"
    need_set_roomname_off = true
    fput "flag roomname on"
    next
  end

  # Remove trailing numeric room ID in parentheses, if any
  if seeking_destination =~ /( \(\d+\))$/
    seeking_destination.slice!($1)
  end
  
  if first_roomname == seeking_destination
    failed_to_find_destination = true
    break
  end

  first_roomname ||= seeking_destination
  break if destination.title.include?(seeking_destination)
end

title: [A Silent Path]
description: A chilling wind pursues the trail here causing several small plants to sway to and fro, caught in its unyielding grasp.  To the east a flourishing garden unfolds from the edges of the rich forest.  A stream of clear water flows out from the garden paralleling the path for some distance.  Sunbeams dance and refract off of the windows and sides of a monastery, lending the appearance of a rainbow like aura enshrouding it.  Hushed sounds, like garbled voices, whisper upon the wind.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: The sun's rays penetrate through the umbrage here and are baking the path into a cracked and rocklike surface.  The beams dance across a small stream as it bubbles and turns northward being split into irrigation channels to be consumed by the monastery's fields.  In the distance, monks wearing robes of pure white, labor in a field while a lone monk, adorned in a silver trimmed black robe, watches their toil from a balcony.

The moon's light penetrates the foliage here and dimly reveals the cracked and rocklike path.  The scattered silver beams dance across a small stream as it bubbles and turns northward being split into irrigation channels to be consumed by the monastery's fields.  In the distance, monks wearing robes of pure white, labor in a field while a lone monk, adorned in a silver trimmed black robe, watches their toil from a balcony.

title: [A Silent Path]
description: Animated leaves skitter west on the wings of a light breeze, catching every so often on the small stones that protrude from the red clay surface of the path.  Imprints, marring a soft section of the clay, provide evidence of recent passage.  Traesharm bushes flourish along the fringe of the woods, though their bounty has already been harvested by the small woodland creatures that hastily scurry about.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: The smell of the sea is quite strong here and you can hear the sound of crashing waves to the north.  The logs that make up the high palisade that surrounds the town have been treated with oils but small cakes of salt, deposited by the moist saline air, still can be seen clinging to the wood.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: Thick brambles grow high upon the walls of this, the east, side of Wehnimer's Landing.  Small pieces of cloth (and flesh) still cling to the sharp thorns of these bushes, left behind by those foolish enough to think that they could gain access to the walled town by climbing the prickly vines.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You are feeling a bit uneasy as you walk around this part of the outer wall.  Glancing up, you notice the reason for this apprehension.  Several of the town militia are staring down at you from their guard posts high on the walls of the barricade.  Though you see no weapons, you are quite sure that each guard has one handy and is well versed in its use.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: This open field stretches from the southeast corner of Wehnimer's Landing.  From here, a faint path can be seen heading to the northeast and to the west as it follows the high walls of the fortified town.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You stand below the top bank of the eastern shore of the Locksmehr River.  From here you have a good view of the many merchant barges and fishing boats that move along the river.  Some move towards the Landing to exchange their goods for silver, while others are working their way upstream to gather new cargo.

title: [Barn Owl Table]
description: This table has been made with dark red battens and boards, styled to look like the side of a barn.  Even the lamp on the table is topped by a shade of barn red, with a finial shaped like a weathervane.  The chairs are stylized milking stools, thickly-padded for comfort.

title: [Flying Tart Table]
description: Remnants of a vicious food fight are scattered about this table.  Bits of tarts stick to the walls and chairs and litter the table with multi-colored scraps.

title: [Frosted Tart Table]
description: Flecks of frosting cover the chairs and floor around the circular oak table.  In the center of the table, a bored would-be artist left his mark by carving an overstuffed, frosted tart.

title: [Stronghold, Southwest Skew]
description: The passageway relents to the pressure of the mountain on all sides, dwindling to an impassable jumble of rocks.  Shadows are thick, adding the mystery of what lurks among the crevices within its folds.  The air hangs so still, the dust suspended in its grasp hangs like a transparent shroud.

title: [Stronghold, Lookout]
description: The stairwell bursts out upon the landing of a tower bounded by a high stone wall.  Open air blows briskly through the large openings between the walls and the beamed ceiling, carrying a chill on its shoulders and a shriek in its jaws.  A panoramic view spreads itself out against the horizon in all directions.

title: [Stronghold, Northwest Skew]
description: As the hallway narrows, the walls degrade into a broken surface distressed with the marks of chisel and pick.  The ceiling draws down toward the floor, likewise pocked and unfinished.  To the northwest, the passageway curves sharply, its route cloaked in hazy shadow.

title: [Stronghold, Northwest Skew]
description: A jumble of boulders is piled against the far wall where the hallway dead-ends.  The ceiling has dropped, its ragged surface little higher than a dwarf near the impasse.  Light barely intrudes into the half-gloom, casting uneven designs on the walls.  The air is still and dusty, lacking the currents which breathe a better atmosphere into the more finished hallways of the stone fortress.

title: [Triskele, West Corridor]
description: Stout modwir timbers are symmetrically spaced between walls of precisely fitted stone blocks, each carved with a detailed bas-relief scene depicting battle with orcs, ogres, or trolls.  Shining down through glaes panel skylights of irregular thickness, sunlight dances over the carvings, creating an illusion of movement.  Corridors branch off to the northwest and southwest, while the entrance lies to the east.

Shining down through glaes panel skylights of irregular thickness, moonlight dances over the carvings, creating an illusion of movement.  Corridors branch off to the northwest and southeast, while the entrance lies to the east.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: It is hard to walk in the screaming wind.  Ice and snow cake your form, making you shiver.  You can barely hear your footsteps over the wind and your own chattering teeth.  A large mound of snow to the northwest seems to provide some shelter.

It is hard to walk in the screaming wind.  Ice and snow cake your form, making you shiver.  You can barely hear your footsteps over the wind and your own chattering teeth.  You find yourself missing even the pallid sunlight this frigid place sees, as the moons provide little light and no heat at all.  A large mound of snow to the northwest seems to provide some shelter.

title: [Ta'Illistim Deed Conveyance]
description: An aubergine wool carpet bordered by an a pattern of elaborate ivory scrolls mutes the sounds that drift in from the cartage.  Thick tapestries weave ancient stories of Illistim history, as well as keep the warmth in during winter.  The room is furnished simply, with a carved maoral desk as its centerpiece, flanked by two straight-backed chairs.  Nevertheless, there is an aura of opulence in this room, as if the smell of silver floats in the air.

title: [Wayside Inn, Dining Room]
description: This ramshackle hostel bears the signs of rough use by hard-bitten travellers and headstrong adventurers.  Several blade-scarred tables and low stools are lined up against the walls, while the central area is dominated by a large firepit around which is a low platform covered with a few ratty bearskins.  The clatter of clay tankards and the smell of humble victuals provide some small comfort to the steady stream of wayfarers who pause here to meet and greet one another.

title: [Indigo Iris Table]
description: A shallow rectangular dish in the center of the table holds an arrangement of irises and maple branches.  The branches have been preserved with their red-gold autumn leaves still affixed to them, providing a sharp contrast to the deep indigo of the irises.

title: [Fragrant Freesia Table]
description: A small bouquet of freesias fills the air around the table with a heady fragrance.  Narrow green and blue ribbons are tied around the neck of the simple glass jar that serves as a vase, giving the table a rather homespun air.

title: [Giant Thrak Table]
description: In an effort to accomodate larger clientele, this section of the table has been raised on wooden blocks, which does nothing to increase the stability of its surface.  Two of the chairs gathered here are oversized, padded chairs with high winged sides.  Squarely in the center of this section is a block-style thrak figure painted dark grey.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Fragile curtains of sticky cobwebs brush across your face and cling to your skin as you move through this passage.  The floor is damp and rotting, laced with patches of blue-black mold and covered with decaying carcasses, including that of a rodent, whose open eyes still gleam evilly even in death.

title: [Thanatoph, Valley Ridge]
description: The fel trees evident along the ridgeline have been cut down here, their stumps a quiet testament to their former stature.  Enormous piles of boulders are carelessly strewn about this section of the ridge.  Looking down into the valley, you realize that this is a perfect vantage point from which to launch an ambush.

title: [Aesthetic Aster Table]
description: A tall, slender ceramic vase filled with golden asters sits primly in the center of the table.  Carefully starched and folded linen napkins sit squarely in the centers of four matching pewter plates.

title: [Crumbly Tart Table]
description: Tart crumbs litter the floor beneath this table, crunching under your feet as you approach.  A tiny black kitten sniffs at the crumbs on the floor.

title: [Owlet Table]
description: Etched into the table top are what appear to be hundreds of tiny owls emerging from their eggs.  The whole table is topped by a sheet of thick glass which is bolted down, to prevent further carving into the table's surface.  Each chairseat is shaped like a cream-colored oval, giving the surreal impression that the patrons are also emerging from eggs.

title: [Stronghold, Illoke's Sanctum]
description: Huge round columns stand in a ring in the center of the cavernous chamber.  The pillars, walls, ceiling and floor are all solid stone.  The walls are built of such massive slabs, the placing of them defies the imagination.  In the center of the ring of pillars rests an altar, its dark granite surface rough with deeply incised sigils.  Light shines up through the carved glyphs, casting eerie shadows that flicker across the ceiling in an endless dance.

title: [Bubbling Spring]
description: Shooting forth from a single hole in the stone floor of the pool the spring pierces the surface and rises several inches before coming down in a shower of drops.  Mist wafts up from the warm water, though you can still see the entire garden through the hazy air.  Draining through a rectangular notch that is cut into the southern lip of the pool, the water cascades down a series of stone steps before turning westward and forming a small stream.

title: [Screech Owl Table]
description: Placed closest to the stage, it is sometimes difficult to hear your own conversation without raising your voice.  Many a guest has left this particular table after enjoying the show, unable to determine why their throat is sore.

title: [Hoot Owl Table]
description: This table is shaped like an hourglass, except that one end has a wider flare than the other.  This arrangement allows for additional chairs to be placed, which makes this table popular with larger crowds.

title: [Hall of Rebirth]
description: Designed to resemble a natural cave rather than a building's interior, this room is both forbidding and welcoming.  Above a tile floor, the curved walls and ceilings are studded with shards of crystalline ice, which threaten to rip and tear at skin and cloth.  Yet several small peat fires fill the room with soft light and a rich, earthy smell.  A black marble arch leads through the south wall into the temple's nave.

title: [Tolli's Tree, Office]
description: Stretching across the entire inner width of the enormous oak tree, this office is a haven of chaos and confusion.  Papers, an open book and partially unrolled scrolls cover the surface of a massive desk that is built into the wall of the room, spilling off the desk to the floor.  Lying crumpled, a double wedding ring quilt trails half underneath the desk, tangled with a pair of fuzzy, long-eared bunny slippers.

title: [Honeysuckle and Daisy Avenue]
description: Almost completely shaded from the moonlight by the tall weeping willows that flank the small ivy-covered cottage, only the soft glow from the candlelight in its windows can be seen clearly.  The soothing sound of crickets chirping mixes with the intermittent hoot of a nearby owl.  Dew glistens on the blossoms and shrubs in the small herb garden to the side of the shop.

At the end of Honeysuckle Avenue and nestled cozily between a pair of weeping willows is a handsome cottage overgrown with ivy.  The sweet scent of honeysuckle drifts on the cool breeze that rustles the leaves of the sentinel trees and gives the lane its name.  A small, well-kept garden sits off to one side, guarded by a white picket fence.

title: [Honeysuckle Avenue]
description: Nighttime has settled in on the Isle of the Four Winds, and a crisp coolness is in the air.  Accented by silvery moonlight, a small pale yellow-hued boutique appears to have a golden glow to it.  The shadows of the mannequins, lit from behind by the flickering candlelight inside the boutique, move across the street in an eerie dance.

A boutique has been nestled in amongst the various shops along Honeysuckle Avenue.  In contrast to the surrounding shops, the small cottage housing the boutique has been painted a soft yellow with a lighter shade for the trim.  Ladies pause, now and again, to admire the latest fashions modeled by the mannequins in the window.

title: [Honeysuckle Crossing]
description: The silver light of the moon pours down and reflects across the large stained glass-trimmed windows of the gemshop.  Lit from within as well, the two opposing hues of light appear to wage their war from opposite sides of the glass as they flicker and glow.  As a cloud passes over the moon, the candlelight appears to take the upper hand, crossing through the window and casting its warm glow upon the cobblestone street.

Stained glass windows, capped in green and white awnings, decorate the otherwise ordinary facing of the white gemshop that stands opposite an establishment that has a vine-covered roof.  Sunlight slants across the four corners of the crossing to illuminate exquisitely a pair of decorated signs, one hanging over each shop's doorway.

title: [Tigerlily Crossing]
description: Candlelight, cast from the windows of every home on the street, lights the cobblestones up in a hauntingly eerie dance of golden light.  Somehow, water has collected inside the glass case of a lantern, creating tiny luminescent ripples across the cobblestones below it.  A slinky, black cat moves with stealth across the street, his prey in his sights.

Candlelight spills forth from the glaesine windows of each of the shops that are nestled into a single, long and low building built upon one side of the lane.  Awnings, neatly folded back and tied in place, form colorful arches over each shop's doorway, while artistic signs sway slightly in the night breeze.  Somehow, water has collected inside the glass case of a lantern, creating tiny luminescent ripples across the cobblestones below it.

Stretching across one side of the lane is a single, long and low building that houses a wide variety of shops.  Sunlight pours across the colorful awnings, creating rectangular shadows on the ground that shift and change as the seaborne breeze tugs at them.  Artistic signs are strung upon wrought iron hangers over each shop's entry, their odd shapes and bright coloring eye-catching.

description: In lieu of window boxes, the shops lining this lane have hedges and bushes of various species along their storefronts.  The pastel blooms of the hydrangea and buddleia, now wet with the evening dew, glisten in the pale light of the moon.  A few of the shopkeepers have pruned their bushes into various shapes and animals, giving the street a slightly eerie appearance as the shadows cast them into ghoulish forms.

title: [Tigerlily Avenue]
description: Pale silver moonlight pours down over the cottages here, muting the bright hues of their terra cotta roofs into cool shades of grey.  Candlelight flickers in the mullion-framed windows of the homes, creating dancing shadows upon the cool cobblestone street.  In the distance, the tall facade of the bank can be seen rising above the rest of the structures around it.

The houses grow fewer in number as the road leads away from the center of town.  Each cottage is freshly whitewashed and trimmed in a colorful stain.  The sunlight warms the thick, terra cotta tiles that cover the homes and causes them to appear as if on fire.  A gentle breeze, laden with the gentle scent of honeysuckle, blows through the area.

Sunlight reflects off sudsy puddles of water on the cobblestone streets, causing passersby to shade their eyes as they pass.  The origin of the bubbling liquid is from a washbasin set into the lee of a nearby house, its side featuring a large crack.  As its contents trickle down the sidewalk, they split at each cobblestone to create small rivers that cascade over the edge and into the street beyond.

Moonlight reflects off puddles of water on the cobblestone street, creating a cool silver glow upon the ground.  They appear to originate from an abandoned washbasin that is set into the lee of a nearby house.  Its contents slowly trickle down the sidewalk, splitting at each cobblestone to create smaller rivers before finally pouring into the street.  The effect causes ripples of moonlight to arc across the area in a chaotic dance of pure light.

title: [Tigerlily and Rose Avenue]
description: Outside a local shop, a small evergreen has been neatly trimmed into the shape of a seated rolton.  Someone has attached two small black discs to emulate the eyes.  Another bush has been carved into the likeness of a small halfling and stands nearly three feet high, its entire body wreathed in blossoms of an intriguing, pale purple hue.  Silver moonlight strikes the figures from an awkward angle, creating shadows that shudder and curl across the cobblestones.

title: [Cobblestone Path]
description: Silver moonlight pours down over the terra cotta tiled rooftops of the whitewashed cottages lining the avenue, dappling them in a cool purplish hue.  A soft breeze rustles the awnings that hang above each window, breaking the silence with the sound of canvas against canvas.

A row of small, whitewashed cottages lines each side of the path, the varying hues of their terra cotta roofs the only thing distinguishing one from another.
