description: Time and again you wish there was something for you to duck behind to get out of the raging blizzard.  With no shelter in sight your only choice is to trudge onward through the night in hopes that you do not become a living icicle before you've gone ten steps.

Time and again you wish there was something for you to duck behind to get out of the raging blizzard.  With no shelter in sight your only choice is to trudge onward in hopes that you do not become a living icicle before you've gone ten steps.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The cold has claimed at least one victim.  A pile of bones lies half buried in the snow, an eerie reminder of the frailties of life in this harsh environment.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: A feeble ray of moonlight filters through the storm, lending the ice it touches an eerily beautiful radiance.  You pause to savor the sight, but all too quickly, the driving wind forces your eyes to close tightly against it.

A small ray of sunlight filters through the storm, nearly blinding you as the light reflects off the ice and snow.  You shut your eyes tightly, and after what seems like forever the light fades, leaving you blinking to regain your vision.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Entry Hall]
description: A massive arched ceiling lifts up from a circular floor splitting from four arches to eight as they curve into the wide dome.  Each section is dominated by a spectacular stained glass depiction of a Lord of Liabo.  At the ceiling's apex a huge transparent crystal forms the capstone.  Along with windows of transparent crystal encircling the room, it emits a soft relaxing light which seems to caress everything with a holy peace.

title: [Hall of Brotherhood]
description: Members of the order walk along the stone floor under the graceful arch of the ceiling in hushed conversation, their footsteps echoing as they pass by.  Tapestries depicting key events in the order cover the walls extending eastward.

title: [Master's Hall]
description: The arched ceiling ends in a flat wall whose entire face is made of glass framed in arches of pure white ora.  Beyond the glass is a long row of greenery interspersed with flowers and shrubs.  Sunken into the floor is a lounge with tables and soft couches.  Intricate tapestries decorate the walls with scenes of the struggle to free the undead.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Your eyes strain to adjust to the utter darkness of your surroundings.  Strange, scuffling noises from the corner of the room cause your nerves to prickle unpleasantly.  Moving cautiously, your hands outstretched before you, you discover a smooth, cold rock which feels as if it's been pulled from the wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A row of small, desolate cells stands along the east side of the corridor.  Gleaming, new chains and locks have been added to reinforce the bolts on the heavy, iron door to a nearby cell.  Odd, scuffling noises can be heard from within the tiny chamber.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A reinforced, iron door appears to have been ripped from its hinges by a remarkable force.  It hangs by fragile, twisted bits of metal from its frame, revealing the utter darkness within the cell beyond.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Torchlight dances across the surface of the polished stone wall, reflecting brightly off the quartz veins streaking its surface.  Low, moaning sounds, occasionally punctuated by a thin, blood-curdling shriek, weave their way through the air, hinting of madness and torture nearby.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Strange, high-pitched wailing echoes through the passage.  You feel something brush against your face in the darkness.  As your eyes adjust to the lack of light, you realize that it is a wispy mass of spider webs.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Damp, stagnant air hangs trapped in this bend in the passage.  The floor beneath your feet is worn smooth from the feet of prisoners herded like cattle into tiny cells which can be glimpsed to the south.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Brittle bits of bone and rock crunch beneath your feet, the sound echoing eerily down every branch of the dark, chilly corridor.  Though you may proceed in several directions, none of them are appealing, and you feel an icy chill shudder down your spine.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Your footsteps echo in the long, dim corridor--heavy, hollow sounds that seem unnaturally sharp to your ears, attuned as they are by rapidly fraying nerves.  You get the distinct feeling you are being watched.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The passage bends sharply, sloping gradually downward as you move southeast.  The walls are coated with moisture, and the smell of death and decay clings to the sickly yellow moss which creeps up the surfaces of stone around you.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The cold, stone floor is slick with damp and slime, and it is hard not to slip and fall as you travel the sloping passage.  Hundreds of pairs of small, glowing yellow eyes watch your progress from tiny fissures in the rock walls.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Slick with mold and slime and barely lit by torches which seem likely to die in a heartbeat, the narrow passage is difficult to travel.  It seems to lead deeper into the earth as you move southeast, yet you wonder if its twists and turns are only a diabolical means of getting you to a dead end.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: An immense, fortified, iron door takes up most of the eastern wall.  The stench of oil and burnt flesh clings to the stone walls and to the charred and blackened bars of the door through which you glimpse the horror that lies within the chamber.

title: [Darkstone, Outer Chamber]
description: Row upon row of iron manacles bolted securely into the ceiling still hold tightly to the remains of the poor souls trapped forever in this horrible place.  Something about the floor catches your eye as you dodge to avoid the clattering, lifeless bodies.

title: [Darkstone, A Dark Tunnel]
description: Darkness blankets you like a thick cloak weighing heavily across your shoulders.  Struggling to focus on something, anything, you spot a skeleton partially buried in the mud.

title: [Darkstone, A Dark Tunnel]
description: The air takes on an uncomfortable thickness here.  Moldy odors invade your senses making each breath you take a bitter, unsavory experience.

title: [Darkstone, A Dark Tunnel]
description: As your eyes begin to adjust to the change of light you cannot help but notice the damp clay walls of this forgotten tunnel.  Smooth swirling patterns cover its surface.

title: [Darkstone, A Dark Tunnel]
description: Rough outcroppings of hardened clay protrude from the walls taking on a dark green incandescence, slowly shifting in intensity as you approach them.  You feel a steady flow of air at your feet but its source is hidden in the darkness.

title: [Darkstone, A Dark Tunnel]
description: Scattered debris covers the floor and you find yourself laboring to keep a steady foothold.  A draft of fetid air rolls in from some unseen direction.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Along the east wall of this wide corridor are fortified, iron doors which once held hundreds captive in large, mass cells.  Now many of the doors have rusted, their bolts shot, their hinges giving way from overuse.  The chambers now stand dark and empty.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The ill-lit corridor widens to an open square.  A wide, doorless opening leads to the guards' chambers.  To the northwest is a large metal door which stands slightly ajar, pitted with rust and corrosion.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Hundreds of tortured souls have travelled this corridor to their doom.  Their cries and moans still seem to echo in the passage as your mind conjures gruesome images of their suffering.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The damp chill in the air, the dark, echoing stillness, and the occasional scratching, rodent noises make you long for warmth, fresh air, and light.  An iron door hangs loosely from corroded hinges; now and then, it seems to move, though it is only a trick of the torchlight.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The sound of your own footsteps echoes around you in the silent, cavernous chamber.  The silence is disturbing, and you sense that you are being watched.  Your head is filled with the pounding noise of your own heartbeat.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Bits of straw and fragments of decayed cloth, bone, and metal are strewn across the floor of this cell.  An unnatural stench hangs thickly in a pocket of warm, stifling air.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Broken crates, decaying cloth sacks, and metal troughs once contained the worm-ridden grains and filthy water upon which the condemned were forced to live or face slow starvation.  A cavernous hearth holds only ashes now, and the rusted hulk of a large, iron cauldron.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: It is difficult to see here, due to a thick swirling mist that blankets this room entirely.  Now and again it wavers just enough for you to see a dark stone monolith towering nearly to the ceiling.  The iron bunks and other furnishings that may have once served to accommodate the guards are carelessly tossed to one corner of the room in order to make way for this mysterious artifact.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The cool, damp air is stale and difficult to breathe.  Torches flicker with an unsteady light, threatening to plunge you into utter darkness.  Now and then one flares unexpectedly, fraying your taut nerves just a bit more.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The walls are covered with moist, putrid mold and the mortar crumbles beneath the slightest touch.  You sense that small, dark, malevolent eyes are watching your every move with interest.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The dim flicker of torchlight casts shadows that flit across the uneven stone walls in a macabre dance that evokes images of death and demons.  A heavy, iron door hangs from rusted hinges.  A crude, iron ladder leads up to a sturdy-looking trapdoor.  The trapdoor has a strong-looking spring mechanism across its underside.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A few, dim, flickering torches seem to cast more shadow than light along this musty passage.  The floor is rough and uneven.  Now and then your foot encounters something soft and squishy, something your mind would rather not deal with at the moment.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The remains of this cell's inhabitant are nothing but dust now, scattered across the cold, bare floor and marked with the tracks of sharp-clawed creatures, scavengers of ancient crypts and dank, dark dungeons.

title: [Darkstone, Winding Tunnel]
description: A subtle change in the atmosphere brings an eerie silence to your ears.  The tunnel begins to slope downward and splits off into two directions.  Traces of blood mark the path to the southeast.

title: [Darkstone, Winding Tunnel]
description: You hug the walls in this narrow, downward sloping tunnel.  Feeling the smooth, curved ridges you realize this passage must have been cut by an underground river which has long since passed further beneath the ground.

title: [Darkstone, Winding Tunnel]
description: A cold damp breeze blows across your face, carrying the scent of decay.  You notice the walls are riddled with notches serving as ducts for the foul aroma.

title: [Darkstone, Winding Tunnel]
description: The ceiling dips low and the floor begins rising to meet it.  You wonder if this may be the end of the line.  Still, there seems to be room to squeeze a bit further west.

title: [Darkstone, Winding Tunnel]
description: Suddenly the tunnel widens and branches in several directions.  A dark foreboding incline leads upward to the north.  To the northwest, a small cavity looks to have been dug out of the wall by some unknown creature.

title: [Darkstone, Burrow]
description: The closeness of the walls in this burrow make you uneasy.  Visible signs of a large animal cover the area in the form of deep claw marks.  Loose dirt and pebbles occupy the floor while a single curious root dangles from the ceiling.  An unending procession of water droplets dive from the root forming a small murky pool on the ground.

title: [A Dark Cavern]
description: Though you feel the immense open space of this cavern, the darkness succeeds in hiding its boundaries.  Somewhere in the distance, a steady dripping joins the chorus of your echoing footsteps.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Wehnimer's Historical Society]
description: A curious variety of artifacts punctuate the rough pine walls, ranging from a scuffed and tarnished Giantman clan armband to a remarkably well-preserved Dwarven pickaxe.  Small woolen tapestry rugs cover most of the floor, overlapping in casual disarray.  Sitting on the narrow table in the center of the room is a woven basket full of Sylvan woodcarvings.

title: [Dragon Bones Tent]
description: A large table carved in an elaborate dragon motif dominates the center of the chamber, the crimson silk of the tent walls casting a reddish glow upon the waiting dice.  Several signs and warnings are scattered about, waiting to be read.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: This vantage point affords a view of the North Gate and the wide North Road running straight into the heart of Icemule Trace.  The few travelers at the near end of the road slip and slide over the ice-covered cobbles, while a few local citizens measure their strides for a more steady pace.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Amaranth Gate]
description: The towering city gate looms above, its massive edifice built from thick blocks of pale ivory limestone.  Intricate carvings adorn the blocks, each depicting various scenes of battle and occasionally a representation of Koar or Eonak.  City guardsmen flank the gate's opening, inspecting each entrant into the city's vast interior.

The towering city gate looms above.  Oily burning torches cast flickering light across the carvings, making them appear to writhe against the pale stone.  City guardsmen flank the gate's opening, inspecting each entrant into the city's vast interior.

The towering city gate looms above, its massive edifice built from thick blocks of pale ivory limestone.  Intricate carvings adorn the blocks, each depicting various scenes of battle and occasionally a representation of Koar or Eonak.  Oily burning torches cast flickering light across the carvings, making them appear to writhe against the pale stone.  City guardsmen flank the gate's opening, inspecting each entrant into the city's vast interior.

title: [Iseng's Home Flooring]
description: Brightly lit and impeccably clean, this modest shop displays samples of various types of floors available for purchase.  Large, but still portable square sections of assorted wood, stone, and metal are lined on three tall, plain oak racks.  A plank of unfinished pinewood atop two sections of tree trunks has been turned into a makeshift customer counter, where several of the sample squares have been set down for a previous customer's evaluation.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Pass]
description: Wandering through a narrow, boulder strewn pass, you are chilled to the bone as the wind howls like a baying pack of hounds.  You pick your way carefully through the treacherous pass, relieved as you near the end.

title: [Thanatoph, Highland Hills]
description: A chill wind howls in your ears, causing you to stop for a moment to examine your surroundings and make sure that the wind is the only source of the howling.  Through the treetops to the northeast you catch a glimpse of the expanse of Potter's Field.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Slope]
description: The mountain rises sharply to the south while the path you are on leisurely wends its way eastward.  You are sheltered somewhat from the wind and see that in the past, others have chosen this spot to set up camp.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, west, up

title: [Dancing Daisy Table]
description: Suspended from the ceiling is a mirrored planter box.  Dozens of daisies -- yellow, white, light purple -- crowd the box and sway gently as though dancing in the air.

title: [Shady Table]
description: Several chairs surround a marble table which sits in a patch of shade cast by the vine-covered wall.  Three small finches enjoy each other's company nearby, their chattering conversation fills the air as they chase each other around the courtyard and preen on the fountain.

title: [Silvergate, A Small Courtyard]
description: An ivy-covered wall surrounds this small, enclosed courtyard.  Several comfortable tables, resting on tiles set into the close-cropped grass, are scattered about the courtyard, with plenty of room between them for privacy.  You faintly hear the sounds of the city coming from the other side of the wall, and in the distance you can see the towers of the temple as they rise over the rest of the city.

title: [Silvergate, Private Lounge]
[Silvergate Inn, Private Lounge]
description: Leaded glass windows provide a glimpse of the sun-dappled back gardens.  Overstuffed burgundy damask sofas and chairs with matching footrests face a carved marble fireplace.  Exquisitely detailed tapestries adorn the ivory silk-covered walls, and an Inn News chalkboard hangs above a mahogany marble-topped bar spanning the west wall, near a wide carpeted staircase.  An antique cabinet stands opposite an ancient oak door, and a bubbling fountain can be seen through a dark stone arch.

The grey stone of the manor walls is softened by a silvery wool carpet and large tapestries depicting the histories of the peoples of this land.  Comfortable chairs and a sofa, flanked by end tables, are arranged to provide a quiet spot to sit and compare notes at the end of a long day's hunt.  In the far corner of the lounge you see a silver veined marble bar, its mahogany base gleaming in the light which filters through windows overlooking the wilderness beyond this haven.

Leaded glass windows provide a glimpse of the sun-dappled back gardens.  Overstuffed burgundy damask sofas and chairs with matching footrests face a carved marble fireplace.  Exquisitely detailed tapestries adorn the ivory silk-covered walls, and an Inn News board hangs above a mahogany marble-topped bar spanning the west wall, near a wide carpeted staircase.  An antique cabinet stands opposite an ancient oak door, and a bubbling fountain can be seen through a dark stone arch.

title: [Silvergate, Foyer]
description: Comfortable sofas fronted with low tables are arranged neatly around this welcoming lobby.  Well-placed sconces highlight the paintings and statues which decorate the walls.  Small groups of smiling people pass through, filling the lobby with their voices, while at the far end of the room a cheerful clerk stands behind a large modwir desk, busily attending to the Inn's guests.  To the southwest is a secure-looking ancient oak door.

A polished maoral table holding a bouquet of roses and jasmine rests near the tall arched doors leading to the courtyard.  Damask-covered sofas are arranged neatly around this welcoming lobby.  Silver sconces highlight paintings which decorate the walls, and chandeliers dance with light overhead.  The lobby bustles with life, while a cheerful clerk stands behind a large modwir desk, busily attending to the inn's guests.  To the southwest is an ancient oak door guarded by a footman.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Silvergate, Grand Ballroom]
description: Burgundy and gold damask frame the arched windows and alcoves lining the walls of this spacious room.  The polished oak floor beckons you to the dance while comfortable sofas fill the alcoves, inviting guests weary from the dance to rest.  A marble archway to the north leads to the foyer.

Magnificent cut-crystal chandeliers, hung above the gleaming gold-veined marble floor, softly illuminate the ballroom.  Golden silk frames the alcoves lining the west wall.  An exquisite mural covers the remaining walls.  Tucked in each alcove are elegant settees and chairs in conversational groups.  Musicians populate a long mahogany stage carved with gilded lions at each corner.  Tall topiaries stand between alcoves, and liveried servants flank the marble archway to the north, ready to attend guests.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Tea Room]
description: Tiny, colorful songbirds and magnificent honeysuckle vines on hand-painted white silk wall coverings reach up to the high, coffered ceiling.  Lit crystal-shaded golden oil lamps rest on tables scattered around the plush green carpet.  Overstuffed armchairs circle each table.  A tall leaded glass window offering a view of a bustling courtyard neatly frames a wide bench seat with pale golden silk cushions.  Opposite the window is a tray-covered pearwood sideboard.

Tiny, colorful songbirds and magnificent honeysuckle vines on hand-painted white silk wall coverings reach up to the high, coffered ceiling.  Crystal-shaded golden oil lamps rest on tables scattered around the plush green carpet.  Overstuffed armchairs circle each table.  A tall leaded glass window offering a view of a bustling courtyard neatly frames a wide bench seat with pale golden silk cushions.  Opposite the window is a tray-covered pearwood side table.

title: [Silvergate, Grand Hall]
description: Although large and open, this hallway manages to feel cozy.  Burgundy wool carpet covers the stone floors and a wide stone staircase with garland-trimmed bannisters which rises gracefully to the upper levels of this fine old manor house.  Carved oak display cases flank the foot of the stairs and fill most of the eastern wall.  Opposite the stairs, well-cushioned sofas and chairs are grouped around each of four large leaded glass windows.

Shadows dance across the onyx-tiled floor of this spacious room.  In the center of the room is a bed shrouded with a black and silver spidersilk veil suspended from the ceiling.  One long-stemmed blood red rose lies across the pillows.  A night stand of gleaming black onyx is carved in the shape of a wolf standing guard.  A silver-tipped scroll lays on a delicate mahogany writing desk, and a large mural on the west wall catches your eye.

Cut-crystal chandeliers brightly illuminate the hall, the light reflecting off tall leaded glass windows.  Plush cream damask sofas and chairs rest atop a crested rug.  Carved sideboards flank a magnificent fireplace under an oil painting of Silvergate Inn.  A sweeping grand staircase with lustrous mahogany banisters rises to the upper level, and elaborate bouquets of jasmine and golden roses artfully fill tall vases decorating the hall.  Liveried footmen and bellmen bustle about, attending to the guests.

Tall leaded glass windows allow light to stream in and reflect off the gold-veined marble floors.  Plush cream damask sofas and chairs rest atop a crested rug.  Carved sideboards flank a magnificent fireplace under an oil painting of Silvergate Inn.  A sweeping grand staircase with lustrous mahogany banisters rises to the upper level, and elaborate bouquets of jasmine and golden roses artfully fill tall vases decorating the hall.  Liveried footmen and bellmen bustle about, attending to the guests.

title: [Silvergate, Lion's Den Pub]
description: Bemused, your eyes wander around this well-occupied lounge.  Happy conversations drift on the air with only an occasional voice rising in heated argument.  A serving maid deftly weaves her way from the bar through the maze of tables arranged in the center of the room, serving platter expertly balanced in her hands.  Among the high-backed booths lining the walls, you see one that appears to be unoccupied.

A well-occupied lounge stretches before you.  Happy conversations drift on the air with only an occasional voice rising in heated argument.  A serving maid deftly weaves her way from the bar through the maze of tables arranged in the center of the room, serving platter expertly balanced in her hands.  Among the high-backed booths lining the walls, you see one that appears to be unoccupied.

A high-beamed ceiling rises over walls of wine racks and a live edge mistwood bar with polished lion-head taps.  Opposite the bar, a circle of leather-cushioned swing chairs hang around an oiled table.  A myriad of silver lions holding glowing oil lamps hang between the racks at varying heights and a long sideboard holding an antique racing game stretches along the west wall.  An assortment of drinks on a silver tray rests near a liveried bartender.  Perched on a sturdy crossbeam is a large silver lion.

title: [Silvergate, Courtyard]
description: A magnificent grey stone manor rises before you.  Thick arrays of ivy climb the ancient walls and frame a set of arched doors leading into the manor itself.  Flanking the main building, twin towers rise gracefully, providing a striking balance and harmony to the view.

A magnificent grey stone manor rises before you.  Thick arrays of ivy climb the ancient walls and frame a set of elegantly arched doors leading into the manor itself.  Flanking the main building, twin towers rise gracefully, providing a striking balance and harmony to the view.

A magnificent grey stone manor with a crested cornerstone rises into view, light dancing in its windows.  Thick arrays of ivy climb the ancient walls, framing an elegant bronze plaque and a set of tall arched doors.  Flanking the main building, twin towers rise gracefully, providing a striking balance and harmony to the view.  Cushioned silver benches are scattered about the paved courtyard in pools of light shed by wrought iron lamposts.  A high stone wall with an ornate silver gate circles the property.

title: [A Secluded Shrine]
description: This tiny area is hidden away in the underbrush, bushes and wild plants having grown up around on all sides.  A vine-covered arch leads out, and the only other feature is a tiny shrine of carved stone, almost overgrown with weeds.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Lion's Den Pub]
description: The serving maid stops in at each of the tables to check on her customers, and she nods a greeting in your direction.  The conversation is louder here, and someone's cigar adds to the smoky haze that fills one side of the room.

title: [Red Table]
description: Fine red linen fabric with yellow and orange swirling flame embroidery covers this table elegantly set for four.  The crystal goblets and polished silverware reflect the light of nearby flickering candles.

title: [Fayhlia's Fineries, Entrance]
description: Rough hewn blue-grey granite blocks line the facade of this tiny shop, an edging of feldspar trimming the paned windows.  Oak flower boxes filled with a variety of colorful native flowers prove to be a magnet for a myriad of butterflies and industrious bees.  A bright periwinkle blue-painted oak door bearing a small oval gold sign leads into the shop, while a slate walkway leads back to the main street.

Rough hewn blue-grey granite blocks line the facade of this tiny shop, an edging of feldspar trimming the paned windows.  Oak flower boxes filled with a variety of colorful native flowers delicately scent the evening air.  A bright periwinkle blue-painted oak door bearing a small oval gold sign leads into the shop, while a slate walkway leads back to the main street.

title: [Hall of Justice, Clerk's Office]
description: A heavily carved modwir desk occupies the center of the office.  One wall is lined floor to ceiling with built-in wooden shelves, each one burdened with orderly stacks of files and thick sheaves of parchment.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Courtyard]
description: Vines of bright purple clematis creep up the high granite walls that frame this cozy hexagonal courtyard.  Benches have been placed on the slate patio, shaded by large potted orange trees.  Opposite an ornate wrought-iron gate stands a pair of tall double doors that lead into a large greystone building.  Small flowerbeds have been placed against the free walls, planted with daisies and lilacs.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, Armory]
description: Hardly larger than an ample closet, this stone-walled room serves as the armory for the prison guards.  Lining one wall is a large rack filled with various polearms and a smaller, more elaborate rack holding an assortment of swords of obvious elven make.  A rack of axes, both fantastical and functional, rests near a set of heavy brass-bound oak doors.  The weapons are held in the racks by thick iron bars, each secured with a large lock.  Chain shirts and shields hang from hooks on the walls, serving as martial wallpaper.

title: [The Belt Booth]
[North Market, The Belts Booth]
description: Sheltered beneath the booth's weathered canvas awning, brightly colored sashes are intermingled with the assortment of leather belts that lend the booth their scent of freshly-worked leather.

title: [Schoolhouse, Office]
description: A long counter separates the front part of the office from the rear, where a smaller desk is laden with stacks of parchment and books.  An elderly woman sits behind the desk and quietly attends to her workload.  A door behind her is clearly marked, "Headmaster's Office" and looks otherwise off limits.  A row of benches fill the eastern wall, some of them taken up by children with appointments to see the headmaster.

A long counter separates the front part of the office from the rear where a smaller desk is laden with stacks of parchment and books.  A door behind the desk is clearly marked, "Headmaster's Office" and looks otherwise off limits.  A row of benches fill the eastern wall, an unfortunate destination for problem children during the day.

title: [Twin Thraks Table]
description: A collection of highly polished shields hangs on the wall beside this table, reflecting the table and its occupants in a softly rounded way.  A thick candle with three lit wicks appears to burn all the brighter for being reflected in the burnished surfaces of so many shields.  A pair of identical thraks are painted on the table.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Slope]
description: The path narrows here giving you an unpleasant view of the drop below.  A hundred feet below, a narrow ledge wends its way around the mountain to the south.  Fighting back vertigo, you keep your eyes on the path beneath your feet.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Slope]
description: Carefully stepping through the loose rubble of a recent rockslide, you take care not to make too much noise.  A wide ledge sits just out of reach above you, beckoning you with the promise of shelter.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Slope]
description: Large claw marks cut a swath across the ground in front of you.  The line of markings runs into the mountain wall, disappearing from sight.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Slope]
description: The path trudging around the slopes ends abruptly, only to be picked up again on the other side of a large hole.  You have to scramble around the hole to continue on your way.  Looking into the breach you realize that the mountain simply gave way, tired of carrying the path on its shoulders.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Slope]
description: The trail continues to wrap itself around the mountain, collaring the eastern peak.  The peak looms directly above you, just out of reach from the trail.  Sheer stone walls make the climb to the peak from here impossible, but you can make out a narrow winding trail that reaches the peak to the southeast.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Journey]
description: The dirt path ends here.  From this vantage point, you look out over the river and plain which stretch for countless miles south.  Carried from there on a warm breeze, you hear the faint whisperings of secrets waiting to be revealed, treasures to be found, and adventure to had, and the darker promise of death to the unwary and the unprepared.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Crossing]
description: Large stones peeking out of the river make a bridge here.  Silver-sided fish swim about in the water, their bodies almost indistinguishable from the moonlit ripples their movements create on the surface of the river, and crayfish scoot backwards under the rocks.  The air is cool, and should it strike your fancy, this place would make a lovely fishing and picnic spot.

Large stones peeking out of the river make a bridge here.  Silver-sided fish swim about in the water, and crayfish scoot backwards under the rocks.  The air is cool, and should it strike your fancy, this place would make a lovely fishing and picnic spot.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Riverbank]
description: From here, you can see under the bridge that crosses the river.  Phosphorescent lichen covers the underside, and large spiderwebs hang from the corners.  You think you might see large, shiny eyes in one of the shadows, but when you look again they have disappeared.  Shaken, you continue through the grass.

From here, you can see under the bridge that crosses the river.  Moss covers the underside, and large spiderwebs hang from the corners.  You think you might see large, shiny eyes in one of the shadows, but when you look again they have disappeared.  Shaken, you continue through the grass.

title: [Esculent Echinacea Table]
description: Carved onto the wooden surface of the table is a bouquet of echinacea and ferns.  The fringed petals of the blossoms are tinted a pale lavender.  The flowers are so realistically depicted that one of them appears to have been nibbled at by a passing animal.

title: [Glowing Zircon Gem Shop]
description: A long display case sits in this alcove, showing off Zirconia's finest works.  At one end of the display case, a finely carved oak table supports a zircon-encrusted silver sign.

title: [Chivalrous' Outfitting]
[Chivalrous' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A low wrought iron table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Chivalrous' Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A low wrought iron table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: Slowed by the narrow ledge and the sheer drop below, you notice how cold and biting the wind has become.  Angry barking rises above the wind momentarily before dying down.  Breaking up the horizon, Glatoph looms darkly to the north, a distant echo of Thanatoph's spires.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: The wind picks up, pounding you with gust after gust, forcing you to bend to block out its chilling effects.  Glancing at an avalanche waiting to happen, you decide to move quickly from under the mass of loose boulders and stones above you.

title: [Thanatoph, Winding Trail]
description: A hazardous trail weaves down from the ledge in a helter-skelter pattern, defying gravity with every twist and turn.  Rocks make the way more difficult still, with a propensity for dislodging and tumbling down the slopes.  The cold adds a final contribution in the form of lacy hoar-frost, coating rocks and skree with a dangerous icing.

title: [Thanatoph, Dead-end]
description: The trail turns into the mountain, winding through a narrow trail edged with tall cliffs to either side.  Finally, it dead-ends at a rough jumble of stones.  Small enclaves and crevices cultivate deep shadows as the cold sun fights its way past the towering rock.
The trail turns into the mountain, winding through a narrow trail edged with tall cliffs to either side.  Finally, it dead-ends at a rough jumble of stones.

title: [Thanatoph, Lowland Hills]
description: The fels covering this hill rise high above you, but are thin and sickly, slowly wasting away while casting a jealous shadow over the valley below.  Moving between the fels you can't help but think that they lean towards you as you pass.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: The landscape is wild and challenging here, remote and forbidding.  The ground dips and rises between thick, close undergrowth and rocky outcroppings.  The level of the land rises to the south gradually at first, and then more sharply, disappearing up into the distance.  To the north, the slope is gentler and less hazardous.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: The sharper slant of the terrain causes you to brace yourself against the rocky ground at an angle.  Small pebbles and clumps of dirt are dislodged by your progress.  The clatter of their descent echoes off the rising rock formations to the south as you utter a low, involuntary curse under your breath, chiding yourself for your clumsiness and lack of stealth.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: A towering boulder stands in the middle of the path, blocking it to the south, where it splits into two forks around the southeastern and southwestern sides of the rock.  To the north, the slope descends slightly, leading you back towards the forests of the lowlands.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: The western rim of the boulder casts a long shadow, causing you to sense a fleeting chill.  The cool mountain breeze and the elevation reinforce that feeling, but it soon passes as you linger to admire the breathtaking scenery here.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: The two paths around the towering boulder directly to the north allow you to skirt it, but the boulder itself looks fairly easy to scale.  From its top, you might be able to get your bearings and stay out of harm's way for a bit.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Boulder]
description: The crest of the towering boulder affords a good view of the surrounding countryside.  To the north, you see the dense forests of the Lower Dragonsclaw.  Looking northeast, the verdant grasslands sprawl down towards the coast.  Gazing southward at the slopes, in the distance you see the snow-covered summits of the Dragonsclaw mountain range, shrouded in perpetual mist.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: The surrounding area seems strangely quiet for such a cool and pleasant upland region as this.  You wonder where the wildlife could have gone.  Looking around, you notice something startling and disconcerting.  Beneath a low-growing shrub beside the path are several carcasses of small animals and birds.  They seem to be recently deceased.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: The grass is paler green here, as though the altitude and dearth of sunlight have stunted its growth.  Coarse mosses and lichens hug the ground and form powdery, white crusts upon the rocks scattered about.  The steepness of the slope makes you breathe heavily under the exertion of negotiating it, and you see your breath condense in vapor clouds in the crisp air.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: Tall, ghostly mountain peaks loom above you.  Although you know they are quite far distant to the south, it feels as though you could almost reach out and touch them from here.  Dark, contorted trails wind up the sides of the mountains, but they seem to be fit only for a few hardy mountain goats - or foolish climbers.  The ground here is mostly bare, save for gravel, moss and a few stray weeds.  The trail here winds to the east, with a high rocky ridge looming to the west.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Lobby]
description: Complex layers of stacked stone, ranging in color from palest grey to nearly solid black, form the entire rear wall into one massive fireplace.  The flames spread their welcome warmth throughout the greatroom, warding off the chill let in by the constant comings and goings of guild members.  Enormous tusked and horned heads of the fierce beasts of the north are mounted along the east wall, gazing at the rest of the guild through glass eyes.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Office]
description: Neatly appointed and exuding a brisk, business-like air, the office holds only a trace of the warmth given off by the fireplace in the lobby.  An octagonal display case occupies the back of the room, partially blocking the walkway to a sturdy mithril-barred door that takes up a good portion of the rear wall.  A tall apothecary desk stands parallel to the west wall.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Strongroom]
description: Sumptuous lengths of fur and swathes of velvet cloak the stone walls, insulating the room from stray drafts and giving it an indefinable air of luxury.  Brilliantly woven carpets cover the floor, stacked several layers deep and weighted down by row upon row of strongboxes and coffers.  Clear, golden light illuminates the room, cast by an elaborate chandelier mounted high overhead.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A ladder of woven palm fronds hangs over the wide ledge and is the only way to gain entry to the pit.  It looks quite frayed and in terrible condition, with most of the fronds torn or tattered.  The giant red splatter stains on the floor below are not reassuring in the least.

title: [The Small Blades Stand]
description: Its edge nicked and scarred by customers testing the merchandise, the small stand's modwir counter holds knives and daggers of various sizes and shapes.  Several types of sheaths hang on a rack towards the back of the stand.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Vault]
description: Suits of polished armor stand at attention holding massive battle-axes in opposite corners of the quaint shop.  Gold stand-lamps are strategically placed to provide adequate lighting for the various items on display.  Mounted on the wall behind a massively carved desk is the head of a greater boar.  Closed and locked bejeweled chests flank both sides of the counter.  On the other side of the room are several rows of shelves each containing trophies cast from gold and silver in various shapes and sizes.

title: [Headmaster's Office]
description: Plush, cerulean carpets spread from wall to wall.  An elegantly carved mahogany desk stands on the center of the carpeting.  Heavy, midnight blue brocade drapes embroidered with the images of silver coins are tied back, allowing a circle of watery moonlight to bathe a patch of the floor.  Etched with tiny winged creatures, a brass flowerpot contains a well-trimmed smastan bush.  A few browned leaves and berries litter the floor.

Plush, cerulean carpets spread from wall to wall.  An elegantly carved mahogany desk stands on the center of the carpeting.  Heavy, midnight blue brocade drapes embroidered with the images of silver coins are tied back, allowing sunlight to fill the interior.  Etched with tiny winged creatures, a brass flowerpot contains a well-trimmed smastan bush.  A few browned leaves and berries litter the floor.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Office]
description: Pushed against the polished mahogany walls are matching leather armchairs separated by gilt-edged end tables.  Twirling gently from its chain overhead, the clacking prisms from the crystal chandelier produce a soft melodic chime.  Directly beneath the fixture rests an oval shaped desk inlaid with blue lapis lazuli along its edges.  Tucked at the back of the room, the dried and well-preserved carcass of a mammoth arachnid rests within a glass display case.

title: [Thrakling Table]
description: Tallow candles set in tin pans light this table, their heavy scent mingling with the smells of roasts and ales in the Inn's air.  A moth, having fluttered too close to the flames, has fallen onto its back in one of the pans.  Little thraklings are painted beside egg-shaped knot holes, as though they are emerging from their nest.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Trail]
description: Winding its way past a shadowy crevice, the trail zigzags through tall cliff walls with little rhyme or reason.  Outcrops of rock force it to dogleg and twist, while a dense layer of boulders makes each step a menace.

title: [Thanatoph, Box Canyon]
description: High cliff walls enclose the canyon, leaving it a bowl floored with gritty sand where the night weaves deep shadows around the perimeter.  The cliffs are rugged and sheer, their faces scarred with cracks and the striated pattern of sedimentary layers.  In the center of the canyon stands a rock pedestal with a flat top.  While its form is rough, it still bears the appearance of having been carved by something other than the elements.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: The ledge widens slightly only to constrict again in an undulating pattern forcing you to crawl along at a snail's pace.  The stench of rotting flesh carried on the wind from Potter's Field below wraps itself around you, tugging at you.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: Some chalk drawings catch your eye as you climb over the rubble that blocks this part of the ledge.  Carefully making your way across the rubble, you glimpse over the ledge to see the hundred foot drop below.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: The stark peaks of Thanatoph rise high above you, filling you with a deep sense of proportion.  Your contemplative state is broken as the winds lash out at you, driving you on.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: The ledge narrows further here, forcing you to cling close to the wall to continue on your way.  Shimmying along the ledge, you notice an alcove filled with numerous chalk drawings.  As the air thins further, breathing becomes laborious, and you almost upset your balance with heavy inhalations.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: Sheer stone walls rising hundreds of feet above your head blot out the sky, making any further upward movement impossible.  You turn to look out over the ledge, but your perch is precipitous and you quickly decide that the view from here is not worth the possible, and highly likely, fall.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Peak]
description: The peak levels off slightly here, and movement becomes easier.  Leading off to the northwest, the tracks of a large animal follow alongside a path of burrowed earth.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Peak]
description: The ground dives sharply over the edge of the peak here.  The drop is dizzying and you turn your gaze to the south.  A great plain stretches southwards as far as you can see.  A trail wends its way down the southern face of Thanatoph towards the plain below, but you can't see how to get to the trail from here.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Peak]
description: A shadow passes over you, wrapping you in the cold comfort of Thanatoph.  For a moment, you feel the weight of the mountain on your shoulders, but the feeling passes as quickly as it came.  The dark peak under your feet reinforces the somber tone of the mountain.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Peak]
description: Standing at the northern edge of the peak, you can see for miles in every direction.  Far below you, the land stretches away from you, only to be swallowed by the dark waters of Darkstone Bay.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Peak]
description: Twisted and bare, a lone fel sapling reaches out from the ground.  A defiant sign of life amid the desolation, the sapling clutches wearily to the earth.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Peak]
description: A path of burrowed earth ends abruptly as it runs right off the western side of the peak.  Except for the burrowed earth, the ground here is flat and barren of even the hint of life.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The air is stagnant, cellar-damp, and icy cold.  As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you notice the iron manacles chained to the walls, the dark, rusty stains on the grey, mold-flecked stones, and the fragmented, bashed-in skull of some unfortunate creature.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A few brass buttons and a heavy mace distinguish the otherwise charred and unrecognizable remains of a guard near the door.  His torch, now cold, lies at his side.  Other bodies lie huddled together as if trying to shield one another from the disaster without success.  Their flesh has long since given way to bone, and yet the stench of burning flesh hangs in the air as if the conflagration had occurred only yesterday.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The remains of an iron bunk hang twisted from heavy link chains, attached to huge bolts that have been nearly torn from the stone wall.  A guard's uniform, stiffened with dried blood, lies shredded over an unrecognizable mass of bone and hair.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Iron shelves chained to the walls are laden with sinister-looking instruments, obviously designed to remove a prisoner's reluctance to confess to any crime put before him.  Sharp, wickedly curved blades still bear the bloodstains of the innocent, and shreds of torn flesh still cling to an ancient rack.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The only furnishings in this cold, barren cell are a rusted, iron bunk chained to one wall and a few wisps of rotted straw to cover the filthy, cracked floor.  Names, dates, even fragments of poetry and sentiments of despair are carved into the rough, stone wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A lone set of rusted shackles still hangs from the wall of this dungeon cell.  The drab grey walls are dotted with patches of mold that give off a peculiar sour odor.  A heavy iron door appears to be the only exit from this dank room.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Dark, rusty stains upon the stone wall at the back of this cell speak of the brutal end of its inhabitant, the remains of whose broken body lie on the floor in a crumpled heap, mouth stretched in a hideous, contorted howl.

title: [Land Tower East, Office]
description: The ground floor of this guard tower appears to be some kind of office.  A single guard sits behind one of the desks reviewing some paperwork.  A small wood stove in the corner provides heat to the room.

title: [Pink Thrak Table]
description: Several heavy notches line the edges of this table.  You wonder briefly what was being tallied, and by whom.  In the center of the table is a painting of a pink thrak sniffing a daisy.

title: [Helga's Tavern, Barroom]
description: The blended odors of ale, sweat, leather, perfume and hearty stew fill the stifling air of the tavern.  Disheveled regulars and road-weary travelers rub elbows at the wooden bar, which looks recently varnished but already bears a variety of stains and grime.  Helga, the ancient, obese proprietor, moves behind the bar, wiping glasses with a dirty towel as she keeps a beady eye on the patrons.  A small fireplace in one corner burns feebly, adding little light or warmth to the room.

title: [A Dark Cavern]
description: Though you feel the immense open space of this cavern, the darkness succeeds in hiding its boundaries.  Somewhere in the distance, a steady dripping joins the chorus of your echoing footsteps.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [A Dark Cavern]
description: The walls of the great cavern curve somewhat here from the northeast to a more westerly direction before fading away into an inky blackness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [A Dark Cavern]
description: The steady dripping that echoes through the dark cavern seems to fade away somewhat as you stumble upon its eastern edge.  Peering around you can see no visible signs of exit further to the east.

title: [A Dark Cavern]
description: The steady dripping that echoes through the dark cavern seems to fade away somewhat as you stumble upon its western edge.  Peering around you can see no visible signs of exit further to the west.

title: [A Dark Cavern]
description: The walls of the great cavern curve somewhat here from the southwest to a more easterly direction before fading away into an inky blackness.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [A Dark Cavern]
description: The steady dripping that echoes through the dark cavern seems to fade away somewhat as you stumble upon its northern edge.  Peering around you can see no visible signs of exit further to the north.

title: [A Dark Cavern]
description: The immense open space of the cavern narrows a bit here to the point that you can barely make out the walls to the west and the southeast.  It appears that you might be in the southwest corner of the large space, yet there remains a large dark opening that leads further to the south and southwest.  A deep mist rolls out of the opening, making further inspection on that direction impossible without moving there.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [A Deep Mist]
description: A wall of dark sinuous mist enfolds itself around you, obscuring your vision.  The cold unwelcome blanket suppresses any hope of spotting a way out.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [A Deep Mist]
description: A wall of dark sinuous mist enfolds itself around you, obscuring your vision.  The cold unwelcome blanket suppresses any hope of spotting a way out.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Darkstone, Dark Lair]
description: Blackness, betrayal, death, outrage... the air of lingering rancor is staggering!  The ground is spotted and stained dark red.  An obscured tunnel leads upward to the east.  In the corner, a long stone slab serves as the focal point of this loathsome lair.

title: [Our Colorful Place, Entry]
description: Multi-colored rugs and brilliantly hued walls mark the entry into this small, cozy shop.  A multi-colored counter, painted with every color of the rainbow, monopolizes most of the room.  Standing behind the counter, Darirose, the tiny halfling owner, and her night staff await new orders and instructions.

Multi-colored rugs and brilliantly hued walls mark the entry into this small, cozy shop.  A multi-colored counter, painted with every color of the rainbow, monopolizes most of the room.  Standing behind the counter, Darirose, the tiny halfling owner, and her children await new orders and instructions.

title: [White Owl Table]
description: A snowy white linen tablecloth blankets the table.  Three cut-crystal votives shimmer at the center of the table, casting a flickering, icy gleam.  Silvery lace ribbons are strewn casually across the table, as though left-over from a party.

title: [Spotted Owl Table]
description: The tabletop is painted white, and dotted with large, brown circles.  As you aimlessly study the patterns, you see the forms of cats, cows, and owls in the blurry spots.  It is probably just a trick of the light.

title: [The New Look, Hair Coloration]
description: The canvas walls of this small pavilion are hung with carefully tied bundles of hair in a variety of colors.  A vat of lye sits next to the pinned-back tent flap, but even that extra ventilation isn't enough to keep the harsh vapors from stinging your eyes.  Casually stacked on a low counter are bowls of henna paste, vinegar, sodden ashes, and dark ink.

title: [Healer's Tent, Treatment Room]
description: A sense of relief and anticipation pervades the softly-lit tent.  The makeshift room, small and crowded with the ill and wounded, contains the astringent odor of balms and ungents.  Old rugs depicting the healing powers of various deities and magical practices lie on the ground.  At the far end of the tent stands a long, padded table.

A sense of relief and anticipation pervades the softly-lit tent.  The makeshift room, small and crowded with the ill and wounded, contains the astringent odor of balms and unguents.  Old rugs depicting the healing powers of various deities and magical practices lie on the ground.  At the far end of the tent stands a long, padded table.

title: [Thanatoph, Valley Ridge]
description: Large elderberry brambles cluster around the tall fel trees that top this ridge.  The enormous fels loom above the valley, standing silent guard over the valley's lush vegetation.  The harsh buzz of wyvernflies nesting in the brambles distracts you as one streaks off in the direction of a patch of wildflowers down in the valley.

title: [Thanatoph, Valley Ridge]
description: The tall fel trees thin out somewhat as the ridge dives back into the valley below.  Sounds of the bustling activity of wyvernflies emanate from the elderberry brambles that blanket this area.  The overgrown brambles give way to a well-trodden path leading northeast.

title: [Rolling Thrak Table]
description: Rich, red clay soil has been ground into the table top, giving it a mottled appearance.  A picture of a thrak rolling around on its back in a patch of grass has been painted in the center of the table.

title: [Jeweled Jasmine Table]
description: A clear glaes dome forms the centerpiece of the table.  Within the dome is a bouquet of creamy jasmine blossoms and maidenhair ferns.  Small, grey pearls take the place of the stamens in each flower.

title: [Burnt Tart Table]
description: A slightly foul scent fills the air over this table, as if Master Tartlicker left a tart baking a bit too long.  The top of the table is seared with a burn mark from something rather small and terribly hot.

title: [Ancient Thrak Table]
description: Smooth to the touch, the edges of the table and the chairs placed here are comfortably worn.  Even the letters carved into the table top are now shallow, perhaps carved by lovers, long ago.  The outline of an old thrak curls around one set of initials.  The only feature not worn away by time is an eye with a tear at the corner.

title: [Thanatoph, Clearing]
description: The elderberry brambles give way to a small clearing of flattened longgrass.  Small boulders strewn about form a rough ring around a burnt and charred pit.  Embers still smolder in the pit, so whoever tended the fire may not be far from here.

title: [Patient Peony Table]
description: Two narrow sketches are propped against the wall.  Rough charcoal strokes form the outlines of a grouping of peony plants in terra cotta pots.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Crevice]
description: Darkness huddles around, but provides no comfort as you find yourself at the bottom of a narrow crevice.  The crevice walls reach hundreds of feet above you, blotting out any light.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Crevice]
description: Darkness huddles around, but provides no comfort as you find yourself at the bottom of a narrow crevice.  The crevice walls reach hundreds of feet above you, blotting out any light.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Crevice]
description: Darkness huddles around, but provides no comfort as you find yourself at the bottom of a narrow crevice.  The crevice walls reach hundreds of feet above you, blotting out any light.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Crevice]
description: Darkness huddles around, but provides no comfort as you find yourself at the bottom of a narrow crevice.  The crevice walls reach hundreds of feet above you, blotting out any light.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Crevice]
description: Darkness huddles around, but provides no comfort as you find yourself at the bottom of a narrow crevice.  The crevice walls reach hundreds of feet above you, blotting out any light.  A massive landslide has blocked further passage through the crevice at this point.

title: [Thanatoph, Wide Ledge]
description: Wide and sheltered, the ledge offers a respite from the cold wind howling outside.  Worn smooth from years of providing shelter, the ledge also offers a few comfortable boulders to lean against.  The ledge reaches back about fifteen feet before running abruptly into a cracked and fissured stone wall.

title: [Thanatoph, Hot Springs]
description: Surrounded by the warm soothing water you sit back and relax, letting the dust of the day wash away.  Many small springs gently splash water into the pool you sit in, sending a light steam into the air.  The steam lingers over your head forming a gentle fog that slowly wafts out.

title: [Bleeding Heart Table]
description: A wooden planter forms a square in the center of the table.  Tiny, purple bleeding hearts bend over the rim of the planter box as though too shy to raise their heads.

title: [Queen's Lace Table]
description: The heavy wooden table is completely swathed in a thick, ivory lace tablecloth.  A bundle of wild carrot flowers, commonly called Queen's lace, is tied together with a ribbon of dried grass.

title: [Cobblestone Path]
description: The cobblestone path narrows slightly as the sidewalk becomes wider, creating better access for the pedestrian.  Houses and cottages dot the areas, many of them nondescript and rather ordinary.  One particular cottage stands out from the rest because of the driftwood gate that has a flower painted into its face.  A large stone wall covered with climbing ivy is fitted with a white picket gate set before a pathway that leads to the west, the moonlight causing the ivy to pale to a greyish-green.

title: [Cobblestone Path]
description: The stones paving the street have been recently painted, their hues varying from cool shades of blue, green, and purple to bright gold and silver.  Adopting their festive appearance, the trim along the nearby cottages has been painted in the same fashion.  Flurries of colorful silk ribbons, tied to the lanterns flanking the street, dance in the cool breeze.  A rough flagstone path slips between the rows of hedges and into a nearby garden.

The stones paving the street have been recently painted, their hues varying from cool shades of blue, green, and purple to bright gold and silver.  Adopting their festive appearance, the trim along the nearby cottages has been painted in the same fashion. title: [Misted Cottage, Receiving Room]
description: Bleached white oak floorboards spread across from one end of the small receiving room to the other, the smooth expanse topped with a braided rug of cobalt blue and bright red linen.  Scattered furnishings, that of a driftwood cabinet near the open front door and a pair of matching sofas, face an enormous fireplace crafted of sturdy granite stones and topped with a simple mantle of rough driftwood.  A nearby open window allows the fragrances of the front yard to trickle in, while also cooling the warm room.

title: [Etaenia's Jewels]
description: Blue, green, and purple striped rugs are scattered about on the floor, like small islands, while an oak counter partially spans one side of the room.  A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, the curtains drawn back allowing daylight to enter.

A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, and crystal lamps are hung between the windows, providing additional lighting.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, War Room]
description: A massive table surrounded by several worn chairs serves as the centerpiece of this room.  The surface of the table is covered with numerous maps and sketches; more maps, dotted with small pins of different colors, hang all over the walls.  Several large cabinets stand sentry here, each fitted with many doors and drawers.  Opposite the heavy tanik door opening into this room is a darkened niche lit by a flickering candle.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, Small Shrine]
description: An icy-blue glaes basin sits on a round, finely-carved tanik table placed at this room's exact center.  A heavy, cool mist billows off the water contained in the basin, making the room chill and damp.  Behind the basin is a tall marble statue fashioned to resemble Koar, with a medallion wrapped around its shoulders.  The walls are draped with heavy, blue tapestries.  The floor is bare stone, worn to almost icy smoothness by the passage of many booted feet.

title: [Celestin's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a silver-hued polished haon ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the patterned white walls.  A twisted dark metal rack and an elegantly carved oak armoire sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a solid plank ebonwood floor.

title: [Teeah's Magic Shoppe]
[Teeah's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the sea glass floor is interrupted by some puffed raw silk pillows.  Halfway to the cloud-painted ceiling, a wrinkled parchment gown pattern hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls.  A large oak table and a small brown box are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Four Winds Bank, Office]
[Mist Harbor Bank, Office]
description: A simple maoral desk sits upon a leaf-patterned carpet in the middle of the room, a pair of comfy looking chairs in front of it.  An exchange board bordered with paneled white curtains covers nearly the whole wall behind the desk.  A wooden bookshelf filled with various books and scrolls takes up another wall, while a regal mahogany curio filled with manifests fills a third.

A simple maoral desk sits upon a leaf-patterned carpet in the middle of the room, a pair of comfy looking chairs in front of it.  An exchange board bordered with paneled white curtains covers nearly the whole wall behind the desk.  A wooden bookshelf filled with various manifests takes up another wall, while a regal mahogany curio filled with bankbooks fills a third.

title: [Half-Eaten Tart Table]
description: A half-eaten tart sits on the table, implying that the last occupants left in a bit of a hurry.  A crisp white tablecloth covers the table, topped with a tiny bud vase.

title: [Cavorting Thrak Table]
description: Centered on the central plank of the table is a glass full of water, set upside down on a small plate.  There are grooves in the floor boards, where the heavy wooden chairs have been dragged back and forth through the years over the same places.  Marching around the edge of the table are tiny paintings of dozens of thraks in a madcap parade.

title: [Magical Burrow, Spectre Square]
description: A dirge emanates from an organ's deep pipes, crawls out of a nearby window, and settles its musical pall about the square.  Bright pennants make their best efforts at bringing up the mood, but the fog, the dark buildings, and the grey light that manages to batter its way through are steep obstacles to overcome.

title: [Sleeping Thrak Table]
description: The lamp on the table has been neatly trimmed, and casts a soft warm glow over the area.  Fluffy rolton fur cushions tied to the chairs create the impression that a flock of the sheep-like creatures has stopped by the Inn.  Painted on the table around the lamp is a circle of drowsy thraks, the head of one resting on the tail of the next.

title: [Public Lockers]
description: You are standing in a tiny room whose facing wall is an array of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and is sitting on a small counter.

title: [Thanatoph, Lowland Hills]
description: In stark contrast to the valley below, there is no vegetation here.  The few trees that do survive upon this rocky hillside are bent and misshapen.  The jagged spires of dark Thanatoph loom above you, a gloomy echo of the trees before you.

title: [Thanatoph, Lowland Hills]
description: All pretense of vegetation has vanished and the hills struggle against the mountain, gasping for life.  Boulders jut awkwardly from the ground, dotting the trail like the broken bones of the fallen valley far below.

title: [Thanatoph, Lowland Hills]
description: Freshly dug earth lies strewn about, surrounding the entrance to a tunnel burrowed into the ground.  The entrance to the tunnel has closed in on itself, preventing access.  A trail of buckled earth leads away from the collapsed tunnel towards Thanatoph.

title: [Thanatoph, Lowland Hills]
description: A semi-circle of blackened and scorched boulders dominates this hill.  The stench of burnt flesh invades your senses, wrapping tightly around your throat.  Fresh claw marks encircle the ground around the boulders, forming an odd pattern.

title: [Thanatoph, Lowland Hills]
description: The taller hills are barren and joyless, and the somber tone of the area begins to pervade your thoughts.  Pushing on, you notice that the few fels that survive here are riddled with disease and writhe with the agony of slow death.

title: [Thanatoph, Lowland Hills]
description: Standing atop one of the larger hills in the area, you discern a small vine covered shrine in the valley to the northeast, unfortunately, there does not appear to be any direct way to get there.

title: [North Shore, Sandy Path]
description: Deep white sand winds closer down to the shoreline.  Scrub bushes and low dunes line the path.  A few thatched roof beach-houses stand out from behind the dunes.
Deep white sand winds closer down to the shoreline, glowing in the shifting moonlight.  Scrub bushes and low dunes line the path.  A few thatched roof beach-houses stand out from behind the dunes.

title: [North Shore, Beach]
description: Sparkling blue white-capped waves roll inward, breaking onto the beach.  Broken bits of seashells and dried seaweed are intermingled with the sand.  White-winged gulls float lazily overhead, riding the crisp offshore breeze.

Dark white-capped waves roll inward, breaking onto the beach.  Broken bits of seashells and dried seaweed are intermingled with the sand.  A few seabirds float lazily overhead even in the night, riding the crisp offshore breeze.

title: [Kristalis' Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the painted black oak walls, and an oak beam ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a stained oak floor.  There is a low wrought iron table on one side of the shop.

title: [Tukero's Magic Shoppe]
[Tukero's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by smooth sandstone walls, the shop features an ivory elven noble statue in the center of its hardwood floor.  A fringed crimson silk banner hangs under the haon ceiling.  Right near the front is a large oak table.

Enclosed by smooth sandstone walls, the shop features an ivory elven noble statue in the center of its hardwood floor.  A fringed crimson silk banner hangs under the haon ceiling.  Right near the front is a small brown box and a large oak table.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Zephyr Lane]
description: The elevation here offers a spectacular view of the hills below cast in a pale glow of available moonlight, with beautiful well-groomed trees towering over the vista.  Recessed paths lit by small lanterns lead to elaborate estates carved into the mountainside, some nearly obscured by bushes.

The elevation here offers a spectacular view of the hills below, with beautiful well-groomed trees towering over the vista.  Recessed paths lead to elaborate estates carved into the mountainside, some nearly obscured by bushes.

title: [Cobblestone Path]
description: Brightly painted cobblestones in red, blue, gold, and green transition into a sandy path to the north.  Jutting out into the pathway here and there, razor grass lines the path interspersed with stems of torch ginger, their blooms a brilliant red.  Obviously well traveled, the sandy part of the path is well packed into an almost rock-like surface.

Mullein torches have been set out to light the way and illuminate the brightly painted cobblestones.  Jutting out into the pathway here and there, razor grass lines the path interspersed with stems of torch ginger, their blooms a brilliant red.  Obviously well traveled, the sandy part of the path to the north is well packed into an almost rock-like surface.

title: [Heleconia Way]
description: A large palm tree with a weatherworn wooden sign tacked to it rises above the intersection here and bows out, its fronds blocking the view of the sun.  A well-beaten path leads off to the northeast toward a two-story sandstone building with a terracotta tile roof.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west

title: [Heleconia Way]
description: A dragonfly hovers over the path momentarily before landing on a yellow flower growing beside the sandy trail.  A weather-beaten wood boat with a large hole in its hull sits to one side of the path, half buried in the sand.  Clumps of grass and hardy purple wildflowers have taken root, threatening to overtake what little is left of the craft.

The sounds of insect life can be heard, but in the dim light here you can't see them.  A weather-beaten wood boat with a large hole in its hull sits to one side of the path, half buried in the sand.  A lantern with five or six glow worms in it has been set on the boat's hull to light the area.

The soft sand of the path comes to a crossroads here with a less traveled route proceeding west and fresh footprints leading to a large sandstone building to the south.  An empty cart with a broken wheel sits off to one side of the western path, the axel propped up on a wooden crate awaiting its owner's return.  Flowerpots filled with bright yellow-leafed plants and deep green ivy fill the cart, their journey to a new home interrupted by the wheel's untimely demise.

title: [Cobblestone Path]
description: The sandy path leads up to the front of a large sandstone building surrounded by tall island grasses and small banana trees still too young to bear fruit.  Bright green shutters frame each window while a sturdy iron-banded door presents itself as the entrance.  A rusting iron stand surrounded by a ring of colorful island flowers rests along one side of the path adorned, with a tattered and faded stuffed parrot that sits upon it.

The sandy path leads up to the front of a large sandstone building surrounded by tall island grasses and small banana trees still too young to bear fruit.  Green shutters frame each window while a sturdy iron-banded door presents itself as the entrance.  An old iron stand with a ring of island flowers planted around it sits rusting along one side of the path, and a spluttering torch attached to the top of it illuminates the way.

title: [Cobblestone Path]
description: Scrub grasses push up here and there from the sandy pathway, giving it an almost mottled look.  More torches have been set out here to light the path.  Small palm trees grow unchecked in various places along the walkway, their fronds not much higher than the heads of passersby.  Through the trees on one side you see a large sandstone building.
