title: [Mirarte's General Store]
description: Beneath an etched seaglass ceiling, a framed lighthouse painting hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a wooden lighthouse figurine rests on an intricate patterned floor.

title: [Mirarte's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Taerel's Outfitting]
[Taerel's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a paneled haon ceiling, a decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table and a painted red cedar rack sit in opposite corners while a knotted woolen rug rests on a buffed cherrywood floor.

title: [Crystelfyra's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case and a small brown box sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Hypolyta's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A tall oak and ivory cabinet and a long carved oak counter sit in opposite corners while a thick off-white carpet rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [East Row, Ebonwood Way]
description: Empty spaces to the north and south beyond the ebonwood trees allow for further construction.  Townsfolk amble by, casually chatting between moments of shopping.

title: [Helden Hall, Outside the Gate]
description: Rough-hewn stone walls tower above a wrought-iron gate, the only entrance.  As you peer through the gate, you see an immense structure at the end of a vast bailey.

title: [Helden Hall, Great Hall]
description: Rushes are strewn across the floor of this enormous room with a lofty ceiling, and elaborate tapestries adorn the walls.  Opposite the entrance is a raised dais dominated by a massive table overlooking scores of smaller tables.  In the center of the Hall lies a large hearth providing warmth and light, and a few comfortable leather chairs are scattered about.  A display case rests against the east wall, flanked by trophies of conquered beasts.  Stairs lead up the north wall to a railed balcony.

title: [Helden Hall, Inner Bailey]
description: As you step through the gate, you find yourself in a walled enclosure some one hundred yards square.  To the north is a massive hall with large oaken doors, and the sounds of livestock are coming from pens to the northeast.  There is a hut against the western wall of the Hall with tendrils of steam escaping from an opening in the roof.

title: [Helden Hall, Meeting Hall]
description: This large circular chamber is made entirely of oak, from the walls and floors to the benches and many chairs that fill the space.  An immense curved table dominates the room.  Within the open center of the table sits a large bench, and numerous chairs surround the outside of the table and each wall.  A large embroidered tapestry adorns the far wall, displaying the house crest for all within this chamber.

title: [City Stables, Stalls]
description: Soft whinnying, snorting, and the stamping of hooves resound throughout the stables.  Stablehands are constantly on the move, fetching fresh horses for the travelling merchants, messengers, or guards who board their steeds here.  The stalls are clean and well-tended, and the horses seem content with their lots in life here in the Landing.

title: [Helden Hall, Fighting Pit]
description: This huge, circular, deep stone pit assaults the nose with the odor of sweat and blood.  The sand floor still bears traces of the last battle that took place here - obviously a place where warriors can fight honorable battles for practice and pleasure.  Above are seat indentations within the stone walls so that spectators can watch and cheer without being hit accidentally, or sprayed with the combatants' bodily fluids.

title: [Prison, Courtyard]
description: A stiff breeze carries the faint scent of Darkstone Bay over the high basalt walls into this small, secluded yard.  Several low marble benches are scattered here and there, and a heavy iron portcullis leads to the interior of the prison.  A slender stone path leads out of the courtyard and back to the crowded streets.

title: [Prison, Foyer]
description: Footsteps echo off the smooth stone floor and barren walls of this sparsely decorated foyer.  A slender ebon pedestal stands in the center of the room, with a golden statue of the scales of justice displayed atop it.  A pair of sleepy-looking guards stand to either side of the thick iron gate leading west into the depths of the prison and an arched doorway leading directly east.

title: [Prison, Office]
description: Rough oak walls climb to high wooden rafters in this stuffy, smoky room.  Several wall-candles provide dim illumination, revealing a sparsely decorated office.  A squat oak desk stands in the northeastern corner with an oak chair on either side, the only furnishings in the room.  A rank smell and odd sounds emanate from the western hallway, and muffled shuffling can be heard coming from the door on the northern wall.

title: [Prison, Operations]
description: A massive oak table dominates the cramped confines of this space, and half-open cabinets line the walls.  Three burning lanterns dangle from chains fastened to the ceiling, providing ample light for the constable and his assistants.  Glimpses inside the open cabinets reveal piles and piles of folders--some thin, many fat.  Sprawled across the table is a detailed map of Wehnimer's Landing, held in place with four stones and imbedded with pins signifying important locations.

title: [Prison, Sleeping Quarters]
description: Two bunk beds reside in opposing corners, their mattresses thin and hard.  A tiny round table stands in the center, the unwashed tin plate and utensils resting upon it already attracting the interest of flies.  A large weapons rack leans against the north wall, with a matching armor stand taking a position along the southern wall.

title: [Prestidigitorium, Entrance]
description: The rock-lined path leads behind several of the shacks and ends at a structure that looks incongruous for this area.  The small shop is constructed of the finest modwir, which someone has apparently decided to paint a sky blue.  The workmanship of the construction is exquisite, perhaps even elven handywork.  A large sign hangs above the door.

title: [Bailey Meadow]
description: At the western end of a small meadow stands the crumbling shell of a circular tower.  Large stones scattered about the tower's base, and the uneven line of the tower's top, are ample proof that it once stood much taller than it does now.  A gaping hole marks where the tower's doorway used to be.  The squareness of the small meadow tells you that a bailey once stood before the tower, but there is no other sign of it remaining.

title: [Tower Ruins]
description: A large V of sky fills a gap in the south wall, and fallen building stones lie about, cleared from the center of the tower's floor by those who have taken refuge here in the past.  Long grass covers the ground, although it has become trampled and matted around a stone-lined firepit.

title: [Marshtown Road]
description: Almost hidden among the tall grasses, brush, and young trees north of the road, charred timbers and blackened chimney stones show that farms and cottages once spread north of the river.

title: [Marshtown Road]
description: A weed-infested jumble of weather-worn rocks at the break of the riverbank marks where a bridge spanned the Cairnfang long ago.  Across the river, the blue granite walls of Vornavis' north wall dwarf the roofs, tents, and low stone wall of the caravansary.

title: [Marshtown Road]
description: To the southwest, the vista of ivory sailed fishing boats scattered across the sparkling blue of Solhaven Bay spreads out below, while nearer at hand the mist and roar of the Cascade of Tears rise above the cliff edge.

title: [Marshtown Road]
description: The road follows the cliff edge southeast toward the head of the falls and also to the west.  Gazing south beyond the rising mist of the Cascade of Tears, the rooftops of Solhaven stretch south between Vornavis' west wall and the waters of the bay.  Closer at hand, the docks, floating catwalks, and shabby buildings of Marshtown spread across the salt marsh.

title: [Marshtown Road]
description: To the west, an ancient stone bridge stretches across a north-south ravine, but the road veers northward, then arcs back to the south and enters the ravine just north of the bridge.  Looking more closely, you see that the ravine has ceased to be an obstacle.  Decades of silt have been topped off with a roadbed of gravel, and the ravine now provides a comfortable descent to the tidal marshes below.

title: [Marshtown Road, Ravine]
description: An ancient stone bridge stretches overhead from one side of the ravine to the other and as the ravine shallows to the north, a gravel ramp provides an easy route to the the eastern lip.  Beyond the bridge the roadbed drops as it heads south.

title: [Marshtown Road, Ravine]
description: Following a course carved into the cliff by centuries of drainage, the roadway swerves to the east and west.

title: [Marshtown Road, Ravine]
description: The walls of the ravine rise high on either side, wrapping the trail in constant shadow except for high noon.  Close to sea level, the dampness and odor of the tidal marsh are carried into the ravine by the onshore breeze, while cattails fill the ditches to either side of the trail.

title: [Marshtown Road, Tidal Marsh]
description: The road dips lower as it heads south, the marsh grass and tides encroaching on the gravel causeway that tries to keep the roadway above the muck.  To the northeast the road enters a ravine and begins to climb.

title: [Marshtown, Land's End]
description: The firm soil of the path to the northeast quickly turns to mud and pools of stagnant water to the southwest.  As progress becomes more difficult, a raised walkway made of wooden planks elevates travelers above the treacherous, sliding mud.  The falls to the northeast, known as Kaskara Zahar, or the Cascade Taehhar, pour from the Cairnfang River above, and the delta of the mighty Cairnfang rushes into Solhaven Bay to the south.

title: [The Muffinsmith Stall]
description: Heat from the stall's small wrought iron oven radiates from the booth, trapped by the canvas roof and overhang.  The aroma of freshly baked muffins fills the air and seems to draw customers more effectively than any shouted bargain could.

title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: Occasional splashing waves wet the planks of the walkway here, making footing treacherous in places.  Warped and cracked planks are difficult to navigate and are in dire need of repair.  To the south, the Market Bridge rises out of the marsh and curving to the southeast, crosses Solhaven Bay into the heart of Solhaven.

Occasional splashing waves wet the planks of the walkway here, making footing treacherous in places.  Warped and cracked planks are difficult to navigate and are in dire need of repair.  To the south, the Market Bridge rises out of the marsh curves to the southeast, crossing Solhaven Bay to lead down into the heart of Solhaven.

title: [Market Bridge]
description: This section of the market bridge slopes strongly upward toward the center of the bridge high above the Cairnfang delta, and down into Marshtown to the north.  The timbers that make up the bridge are reinforced with thick ropes and iron bands.  Long spikes hold planks firmly in place.

title: [Market Bridge]
description: Perhaps feeling there is less risk on the exposed timbers of the bridge than on the floating platforms of Marshtown, a series of small shops crowd the sides of the bridge.  While more stable, they still appear precariously perched.

title: [Market Bridge]
description: This tall and sturdy bridge rises high above the currents of the Cairnfang delta.  From the top of the wide bridge, both Marshtown and the entire layout of Solhaven are clearly visible.  To the northwest, the bridge slopes down into Marshtown, kept afloat by barrels and planks.  To the southeast, Solhaven spreads out under the walls of Vornavis, a massive urban sprawl stretching from the walls to the shore.

title: [Maidenly Magnolia Table]
description: On the wall behind the table hangs a gilt-framed oil painting of a dark ceramic vase filled with magnolia blossoms.  A dainty lace handkerchief is neatly folded beside the vase.

title: [Sea Thrak Table]
description: A large painting of the Coastal Cliffs hangs over this section of the table, so realistic a view you practically feel the salt spray on your face.  The chairs pulled up to the table have been painted in stormy greys and blues.

title: [Dancing Thrak Table]
description: There are oddly shaped pits and cracks in the surface of the wooden table and on the seats of the sturdy chairs pulled up against it.  The table surface is so uneven, you wonder if it's safe to put down your drink.  A painting of a thrak is difficult to make out amongst the other wear and tear marks on the table.  The thrak is standing on one toe in mid-pirouette.

title: [Lucid Lotus Table]
description: Panels of white glass are set into the wooden table forming the outlines of a large lotus.  The thick stems supporting the tiled blossom are each carved from green-stained pine.

title: [Stronghold, Stone Grove]
description: The tunnel threads its way through a series of rock columns.  Each is carved in the image of a tree trunk, with finely rendered bark, branches and an impossibly complex pattern of leaves overhead.  Shadows intertwined within the boughs both hide and highlight variations within the carved foliage, yielding a strange effect of movement as if wind is playing through the frozen leaves.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Stronghold, Stone Grove]
description: The crevice threads its way through a series of rock columns.  Each is carved in the image of a tree trunk, with finely rendered bark, branches and an impossibly complex pattern of leaves overhead.  To the south, the boles grow dense and close, their carved boles almost menacing in their frozen stance.

title: [Stronghold, Refuge]
description: After snaking around a series of rocks grouped around the narrow crevice giving egress, the chamber widens into a comfortable size.  Around the perimeter are hollows where drifts of small boulders have been collected.  A number of large stones stand upright in a circle in the center of the area, their surfaces covered with faint, incised sigils.

title: [Stronghold, Stone Grove]
description: The tunnel threads its way through a series of rock columns.  Each is carved in the image of a tree trunk, with finely rendered bark, branches and an impossibly complex pattern of leaves overhead.  The elegant bend of the branches that lift from the boles create an intricate pattern of shadows within the shifting cloud of dust that moves through the ageless trees.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Stronghold, Stone Grove]
description: The tunnel threads its way through a series of rock columns.  Each is carved in the image of a tree trunk, with finely rendered bark, branches and an impossibly complex pattern of leaves overhead.  A couple of boughs on a nearby tree drop down in graceful curves, revealing their finery of leaves like a masterful dancer.

title: [Stronghold, Stone Grove]
description: Weaving along in a haphazard pattern, the tunnel threads through a series of rock columns.  Each is carved in the image of a tree trunk, with finely rendered bark, branches and an impossibly complex pattern of leaves overhead.  The sculpted tree boles stand solemnly like an army of frozen sentries.  Above, the leaves intertwine in an abundance that staggers the imagination.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Stronghold, Stone Grove]
description: Snaking along in a haphazard pattern, the tunnel weaves through a series of rock columns.  Each is carved in the image of a tree trunk, and the tops of the pillars fan out into a majestic representation of branches and leaves.  The detail is astounding, each stone leaf rendered in the image of its living counterpart, as if a true grove of trees had been instantly petrified and transported into the heart of the mountain.  The tall trunks stand silently, providing an easy trap for losing one's way.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Stronghold, Stone Grove]
description: The tunnel threads its way through a series of rock columns.  Each is carved in the image of a tree trunk, with finely rendered bark, branches and an impossibly complex pattern of leaves overhead.  The trunks are majestic, their silence made more noticeable for lack of bird song and the breath of wind moving through their boughs.

title: [Stronghold, Tunnel Crossroads]
description: Three branches of the tunnels converge in a low-ceilinged, yet expansive chamber.  Ruts in the floor suggest heavy foot-travel passed this way at some point in time.  Within the gloom of the far corners, bits of bone can be glimpsed mixed in with a skree of boulders and other debris.

title: [Stronghold, Tunnel]
description: A pile of rocks disfigure the tunnel floor, covering the path and making footing treacherous.  The irregular jumble is echoed in the rough surfaces of walls and ceiling, giving the tunnel the appearance of a construction only just begun.  Dust lies thick in the deep crevices between the rocks, concealing possible hazards from unwary passersby.

title: [Stronghold, Tunnel]
description: The rough tunnel widens, creating a hollow within the mountain.  The bulge, narrowing in each direction, is shaped much like an inverse view of a snake that has swallowed a rat.  Boulders litter the uneven floor and the walls are rendered hazardous by large outcrops of rock.  Here and there, old, decrepit pieces of hammers and picks lie in the jumble of stones, mixing with other debris that time has eroded into unidentifiable rubble.

title: [Stronghold, Tunnel]
description: A thick layer of dust covers rocks laying in heaps against the sloping tunnel walls to either side of a narrow trail.  At places, rat tracks are visible in the dust, as well as other, much larger prints with a canine configuration.  Dust hangs heavily in the air, lifted by occasional drafts of wind breathing down the tunnel.  It stirs the gritty curtain into a roiling cloud that slowly enshrouds any evidence of life with its relentless grey mantle.

title: [Stronghold, Eastern Skew]
description: Large boulders litter the passageway, making progress difficult.  The walls, however, show no evidence that the debris originated there, and the ceiling high above is likewise unmarred.  Yet the stone floor is a hazardous tumble, the huge slabs broken and thrust up in places like broken teeth.

wayto.3584: ;e unless (move 'go door'); echo 'Waiting for the door to open... '; waitfor 'You hear a soft click from the door and it suddenly flies open.'; move 'go door'; end

title: [Stronghold, Eastern Skew]
description: Two massive arches span the chamber, their lintels covered with ragged glyphs.  Fog shifts and drifts through, like ghostly wanderers lost in the immensity of half-light embraced by the doorways' curves.  A light sand covers the floor, heaped up against the stone walls in places.  Indentions of footprints pock the sand, leaving winding patterns in it with varying shapes and depths.

title: [Stronghold, Tunnel Turn]
description: Dust lies deep in a corner where the tunnel turns, its languid slope reaching high up the wall.  Small bones stick up out of it here and there, evidence of rats caught within the fine powder and unable to escape.

title: [Stronghold, Tunnel Rocks]
description: A litter of boulders lies on either side of a faint trail leading through the tunnels.  By their placement, the stones possess the quality of having been deliberately positioned.  Surrounding them is fine, white sand, providing a pleasing contrast to striations visible in the rocks.  Here and there along the path, stepping-stones are visible, their surface abraded over time to a mere suggestion that a pattern was once carved upon them.

title: [Stronghold, Tunnel Junction]
description: The mouths of a number of tunnels circle the walls of the cavern, leading off into darkness.  In the center of the area, where the tunnel trails converge, is a pillar of stacked stones.  The construction stands lonely guard over the junction, casting a faint, disjointed shadow across the hard floor of the cavern.

title: [Stronghold, Narrow Pass]
description: A large boulder constricts the tunnel, making it necessary to edge past the outcropping single file, taking care to avoid sharp extrusions of rock in the wall opposite it.  Once embraced in the narrow crevice, it is possible to see a striking series of carvings on the stone's surface.  They depict groups of giants in a primitive style that is nonetheless evocative and beautiful in its simplicity.

title: [Stronghold, Tunnel of Faces]
description: Rounding a curve, the tunnel shrinks into a passageway barely wide enough to accommodate a single giant.  The ceiling is low as well, with sharp stones projecting down from it.  In the half-light, they take on the appearance of jagged teeth.  In many places the protruding stones have been carved with faces, the features distorted and grotesque.  They gaze down from above with expressions of despair, horror and outrage.

title: [Wehnimer's, Catacombs]
description: Several niches in the stone walls of this small, musty chamber hold heaps of dust, tarnished trinkets and shreds of cloth.  The sunken, dried face of a crumpled corpse in the center of the room still wears an expression of shock and horror.  Small, furry creatures dart in and out of a jagged opening, where some stones have been removed, in the far wall.  As it dawns on you that they cannot be the source of the loud, sinister scraping noises coming from the east, a chill runs down your spine.

title: [Wehnimer's, Tunnel]
description: The stone floor is slimy and treacherous underfoot.  Although you find it difficult to see well enough to progress unaided, you hesitate to feel your way along the clammy, lichen-covered walls.  Water seeps from the ceiling with a constant dripping sound that echoes around you.  Disturbing grunts and squeals emanate from a particularly dark corner of the room.

title: [Catacombs, Rat's Nest]
description: This suffocatingly close room is dark and foul-smelling.  Murky light filters in through a clawed-out hole in the crumbling brick wall on one side of the chamber.  Decaying straw and rotting refuse litter the floor.  From somewhere nearby, you can hear the faint trickling of water.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: A clammy chill descends upon your skin as you take a moment to survey the enveloping gloom.  A tunnel carved through glistening black rock stretches as far as the dim light allows you to see, to the east and west.  Hundreds of cramped, oblong tombs open out of the walls wherever space permits.  Most have remained sealed but others have collapsed or been pillaged over time.  A thin rivulet of water runs east down the center of the floor.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: A warm gust of air counteracts the dank chill of the tunnel as it blows in from an opening to the north, and through a side passage to the south.  Graves are excavated at close intervals into the walls along the east-west axis of the tunnel here.  Several small streams flow into this room to connect with a larger one running down the center of the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Catacombs, Mossy Climb]
description: Thick moss covers every available surface here.  Where you can see through the growth, you notice that the walls seem fairly recent and are made of red brick.  Openings in the ceiling at seemingly random intervals provide some faint light and occasionally you hear footsteps and murmurings overhead.  The tunnel continues on to the north, up along a high ledge.

title: [Wehnimer's Sewer, Nexus]
description: Dim light filters down from the rusty grate imbedded in the ceiling.  The walls are cracked and broken, while the floor is covered with a thin layer of mud, or worse.  The air is damp and musty, while gently drifting in from the surrounding tunnels are some of the most appalling odors it has ever been your misfortune to experience.  Tunnels slope slightly downward in all directions.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The openings of small pipes are visible through the muck on the walls.  To judge from the smell, they used to deliver raw sewage into this main tunnel.  The tunnel continues to descend, as the darkness and humidity seem to close in around you.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: A faint light trickles in through the cracks in the ceiling, as the tunnel continues to drop.  In the distance, you can hear the faint scratching sounds of vermin being about their business.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The tunnel slopes gently downward, and much of the floor is shattered and broken.  You could easily do without the slight movement of the air, as it only brings ever more appalling scents to your attention.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: Large blobs of some sort of slime occasionally drip from the ceiling here.  They collect on the floor, making the footing a bit more treacherous than normal.  Keeping one eye on the descending blobs, and one eye on your path, you gingerly pick your way through.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: You carefully pick your way around the bits and pieces of debris.  Just thinking about the nature of this debris makes you a bit nauseous.  The smell of the place is revolting, making matters even worse.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: There is a small bit of sludgy water pouring out of one of the many small pipes.  It has collected into a dark slimy looking pool here, with a small trickle of filth oozing on down the tunnel.  There is just enough room to pick your way around it as you continue on deeper into the earth.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The trickle of sludge begins to move a bit faster, as the slope steepens.  The small pipes in the walls grow fewer, but no less filthy.  You can feel a touch of moving air, perhaps a bit fresher than that which you've grown used to breathing.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The air smells unbelievably fresh, and you inhale great gasping breaths, having nearly forgotten what fresh air smells like.  You seem to have reached the end of the tunnel, as it empties out into a large underground river.  The slope is quite steep, and the small stream of sludge would be racing along, if it was any less thick.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: This tunnel has obviously been neglected for a number of years.  The mortar is falling out from around many of the bricks, some of which are broken.  Much of the floor is covered with various mosses and slimes, puddles of stagnant water, and many kinds of disgusting creepy-crawlies.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: It appears that some of the ceiling has fallen, partially damming up the noxious liquid that could only be called water by a distant stretch of the imagination.  You shudder, as you realize that in order to pass, you are going to have to wade, for at least a few feet.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: Entering this stretch of the tunnel, you notice a shifting blob of some sort on one wall.  As you approach, the mound breaks up into hundreds of bugs, running for cover.  Left behind is what appears to be some type of skull, imbedded in the wall!  It's hard to even imagine the force it would take to do this.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]

title: [Hardy Heather Table]
description: Small bundles of pink heather hang from dark green and blue ribbons from the ceiling over the table as though being dried for everlasting bouquets.  Some of the small flowerets have fallen to the floor, where their scent is released time and again by passing footsteps.

title: [Helden Hall, Viewing Chamber]
description: A wide walkway encircles the fighting pit.  Carved into the stone walls are seats for spectators to view the contests of bravery and honor below.  The stones of the walkway are worn smooth from years of stomping as the observers cheer for their favorite combatant.  The only decoration on the chamber's circular wall is a finely made tapestry.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Crossroads]
description: This mostly level spot is a respite from the climb, but not from the wind that buffets you from all directions.  Packed brown dirt pocked with eruptions of grey marble make the trail tricky in spite of its gentle slope.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Southern Track]
description: The sloping trail is wide here and provides solid footing.  The flank of the mountain stretches out before you, patterned with protrusions of grey marble.  Beyond it, distance blurs the Emerald Forest into a blue-green carpet.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Southern Track]
description: A large outcropping of grey and black marble takes up most of the level part of the trail here, forcing you to squeeze around it.  The rough marble catches at your clothes on one side and the prickly brown gorse that lines the trail pokes at you from the other.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Southern Track]
description: The trail rises and falls as it crosses over giant ridges caused by the yearly flows of melted snow and ice.  A cold, grey stream rushes down the crease between two ridges and flows through a deep groove in the trail.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Southern Track]
description: The wind whips around from the north face of the mountain, threatening to pull the trail-side bushes up by the roots.  Wet caps of pocked grey snow cling to the top of a pile of half-buried marble boulders.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: Grey snow gives way to black, ice-covered rock as the trail curves around a large ridge and starts to snake its way up the bleak, steep mountainside.  Hollow sounding cries pierce the air from time to time, punctuating the almost constant wind.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Western Track]
description: The air is thin here, and clusters of brown shrubs grow in the direction the wind blows.  Their bare branches are splayed against marble outcroppings and their roots are partially exposed to the wind.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Western Track]
description: The difficult path clings to the mountainside, sloping acutely.  A lone bush grows right out of the mountain face, and the rocky trail is speckled with clumps of wet snow.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Western Track]
description: Snow drifts accumulate on the ground and fill in the crevices and ridges of the rock face.  Days of thin sunlight and nights of bitter cold have made a permanent layer of ice on the solid rock.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: This part of the trail is far too high for any vegetation and if any of the natural fauna venture here, the evidence of it is lost on the hard icy surface.  The mountainside itself has been crudely carved in spots to widen the trail where otherwise it would have dwindled to an end.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: The extreme west turnaround of this part of the trail provides a view of the humps and peaks of the DragonSpine Mountain range extending off to the west and north.  Pearl grey peaks light up the horizon under the star dotted black skies.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: Halfway up the mountainside, the trail dwindles away to nothing.  The last few feet are so slender as to prevent even a halfling's step.  Ten feet above, another level surface holds the promise of a continuation of the trail.

wayto.3990: ;e if (UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait') or ((UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode != 'run') and ((XMLData.encumbrance_value > 50) or ((Skills.survival < 50) and not Spell['Haste'].active?))); sleep 0.2; echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 4; end; move 'east'

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: The trail ends here in a wide ledge, part of which is sheltered under a shallow overhang of snow-covered rock.  Back from the edge and obscured by the black and greys of ice and stone, a dark blotch marks the entrance to a wide-mouthed cave.

wayto.3993: ;e if (UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait') or ((UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode != 'run') and ((XMLData.encumbrance_value > 50) or ((Skills.survival < 50) and not Spell['Haste'].active?))); sleep 0.2; echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 4; end; move 'northwest'

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: The rise of the trail is shallow here, but a misstep could still send an unwary climber tumbling.  The slender trail hugs the icy mountainside and almost disappears in places.

wayto.3992: ;e if (UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode == 'wait') or ((UserVars.mapdb_ice_mode != 'run') and ((XMLData.encumbrance_value > 50) or ((Skills.survival < 50) and not Spell['Haste'].active?))); sleep 0.2; echo 'trying not to slip...'; sleep 4; end; move 'southeast'

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: Chunks of rock and ice have fallen away from the wall, leaving a gap in the trail.  Iced over pegs and broken scraps of rope show where someone had once constructed a bridge here--or had tried.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: A dark peak looms above, making a blank spot in a field of stars.  The thin air is cold and makes breathing difficult, but it brings such clarity of vision that the diamond bright stars look close enough to touch.

A black peak looms above, piercing the jewel blue sky.  At your feet, delicate crystalline patterns deep in the black ice make the trail look beautiful rather than dangerous.  In the distance, white peaks shine with diamond clarity.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Switchbacks]
description: Shallow steps carved into the trail give the illusion of purchase, but the years have smoothed them over with layers of ice.  What once were vertical edges and flat surfaces are now no more than blurry stripes on the ground.  Near the topmost step, a large hole in the rock face looks like it leads to a sheltered spot.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Turnaround]
description: The path takes a perpendicular turn here as the slow rising switchbacks below give way to an almost vertical ascent above.  To the north, the DragonSpine Mountains march off into the purple distance, their snow-covered sides glistening in the moonlight.

The path takes a perpendicular turn here as the slow rising switchbacks below give way to an almost vertical ascent above.  To the north, the DragonSpine Mountains march off into the purple distance, their snow-covered sides spreading below them like so many pure white wedding gowns.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Onyx Point]
description: A short scramble up from here would place you on the mountain's peak, but the downward trail is steep and less than alluring.  This bleak northern facing wall is worn almost smooth by the coursing wind.  Layered with years of alternating snow and ice, its surface is black and almost featureless.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Protected Lee]
description: While not offering the comforts of a well-stoked hearth and a brimming pantry, this secluded spot inside Onyx Point is a welcome relief from the noise and cold of the mountainside.  A ring of char-streaked stones marks where travelers before you have managed to scrape together a fire.  A pearly thread of moonlight filters down from a hole in the high ceiling.

While not offering the comforts of a well-stoked hearth and a brimming pantry, this secluded spot inside Onyx Point is a welcome relief from the noise and cold of the mountainside.  A ring of char-streaked stones marks where travelers before you have managed to scrape together a fire.  A thin ray of sunlight filters down from a hole in the high ceiling.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Onyx Point]
description: The top of this peak is a rise of solid black stone covered in ice.  In stark contrast to the high winds on the winding trails below, the air here is completely still.  Apparently the calm appeals to something else, as a huge nest of twisted tree trunks and whole bushes is splayed over much of the available level surface.  To the southwest, a long gash in the black rock leads back into the wind.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Onyx Point]
description: The path disappears into a long gash that pierces the cracked and broken ice wall.  This near the peak, the wind rips at your clothes with a force that threatens to part you from the mountain, but cracks and crags in the grey ice face provide handholds for anyone who can manage to grab on.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: Towering overhead, a black peak can be seen blocking out the night sky.  Moonlight streams eerily down the mountainside, lighting up the snow.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Couloir]
description: The blue-white ice walls of the ravine widen out to a gully as the ground begins to rise.  Half carved steps begin the route up from the valley floor, but trail off quickly.  An abandoned pick lies by the side of the path, one end solidly frozen into the ice.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Couloir]
description: This ice-lined ravine is no wider than the arm span of a halfling and the wind whistles across the top of it, making a shrill song.  The crack that forms this gorge bends and twists at acute angles.  On one wall, a thin break in the ice looks wide enough to pass through.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: Billowing snow tumbles down the mountainside carried on the shrieking wind.  The frozen carcass of a mountain rolton lies wedged into the crease formed where the trail meets the mountainside.  Even through the layers of ice you can see the matted coat has been torn into ragged strips.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: The valley below is not much more than a ravine cut through snow and ice, but it seems a much better place to be than this precipitous, wind-swept trail.  The sloped outer edge of the path could easily claim the most careful climber.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: The trail curls up out of the gully, hugging the grey-white mountainside closely.  Shrieking wails sound from all around, but whether they are the tortured cries of intelligent souls or the whistling screech of the wind is unclear.

description: Slick with ice and almost vertical, the trail leading up the south face of this peak is all too direct.  The craggy rock face, though covered in white ice, provides adequate, if chilly, handholds.

title: [Aegenis General Store]
description: Torches cast flickering light across the stone walls of this cavernous shop.  The high walls terminate in a vaulted roof high above, fashioned of thick wooden timber.  Various pieces of metalwork hang suspended from the beams above.  A long wooden counter stands before a curtained doorway through which employees occasionally wander.

title: [Aegenis General Store]
description: A cavernous fireplace occupies most of the north wall, the flames flickering brightly across the smooth stone floor.  An odd assortment of crates and barrels occupies one corner.  A fat black cat sits upon the mantelpiece, eyeing the customers with unblinking suspicion.

title: [Braesella's Baked Goods]
description: The cobblestoned walls have been painted a creamy eggshell and the curtains framing the glaesine windows are fashioned of the sheerest white gauze.  The shouts and chuckles coming from the kitchen indicate a large and lively group of cooks.  The heat of the ovens in the shop's back room blasts outward each time an employee enters and exits the swinging kitchen door.  A lovely glaesine case holds treats and sweetmeats of all types.

title: [Ta'Illistim Armory]
description: Torchlight glimmers on the armory's marcasite-flecked granite walls and across the dull sheen of the smooth black slate floor.  Stacks of leather and heavy cloth are piled atop a bench near the back of the shop, ready to be fashioned into tunics and robes.  A clerk sits behind a massive sales counter just inside the door.

title: [Mist Harbor, Cavern Entry]
description: An enormous black iron door, its face carved with labyrinthine whorls and bas-relief tunnels, stands as a formidable guard to the world beyond the cavern.  A series of wide bronze braziers, each one set equidistant from its neighbor, lines the long corridor, the brightly glowing coals casting shadows on the distant ceiling.  Painted onto the smooth walls are a series of bright blue, azure, and white murals.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Lobby]
description: The vaulted ceiling, high above, is carved of soft white marble and decorated with ornately carved scrollwork.  Finely polished maoral panelling lines the lobby walls.  Dark green marble tiles clad the floor, punctuated by small golden cabochons.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Lobby]
description: The dark green marble floors, inset with golden cabochons at the clipped corners of the tiles, have been polished to a glassy sheen.  High above, a delicate glaesine chandelier hangs from the ceiling, the sparkling crystals refracting tiny pinpoints of light across the length and breadth of the lobby.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Lobby]
description: Tall leaded glaesine windows permit light to enter, the soft rays glancing across the dark green marble floors of the great lobby.  Through the eastern windows, airships are visible arriving and departing the docks, which are raised above the level of most city rooftops.

Tall leaded glaesine windows permit moonlight to enter, the soft rays glancing across the dark green marble floors of the great lobby.  Through the eastern windows, the lights of airships floating above the city docks are visible.

title: [Bella's Bridal Boutique]
description: An intricately woven Loenthran carpet covers the center of the polished haon floor.  The walls are draped in lush, ivory silk that shimmers in light cast from a glimmering glaesine chandelier suspended from the rafters.  Garlands of delicate pink roses intertwined with deep green ivy and strands of tiny pearls bedeck the sales counter, scenting the air with a lovely fragrance.  An engraved silver sign advertises the shop's bridal fashions and a velvet curtain leads to the back room.

title: [Bella's Bridal, Backroom]
description: More of a closet or passageway than a true room, the back area of the shop is piled high with bolts and other material. A modesty curtain separates the area from the front room of the shop, while a closed door leads further into the cottage.

title: [Gaedrein's Furs and Pelts]
description: Stacks of furs and pelts are thickly layered upon maoral shelves which cover the shop's stone walls from floor to ceiling.  Several glaesine lanterns hanging from the rafters above cast a dim amber glow across the windowless room.  A lone counter sits at the rear of the shop, behind which the shop's proprietor stands, waiting for patrons to assist.

title: [Elrenie's Walls]
description: A quiet, almost solemn ambience drifts through the shop, the sounds muffled by a maze of wall samples and multihued wood paneling.  The back wall is painted white and devoid of decoration. presumably to allow customers to view their selections against it, apart from the rest of the available choices.  Several patrons converse in small groups, probably deciding on their purchases.

title: [Vathiel's Tables]
description: Attention to detail, both in decor and wares, distinguishes this somewhat small shop.  Each table surface holds a small vase with fresh wildflowers, enough to create a pleasant atmosphere without detracting from the focus of home decoration.  Behind a long, silk-draped counter, a smiling elven lass arranges miniature replicas of the tables in the same pattern as the ones on the floor.

title: [Fiwen's Heatsources]
description: Flawlessly maintained, a spacious and well-lit circular chamber houses a myriad of heat sources, all displayed on individual blue granite pedestals.  Subtly decorated with vibrant-colored mosaic accents, eight fluted marble columns are spaced throughout, like standing guards of the perpetual fire blazing in the center of the rotunda.  Near the entryway, a robe-clad assistant fitfully polishes the marble counter while keeping a keen eye on the shoppers.

title: [Fiwen's Heatsources]
description: Attached to the circular shop westward, this small shed is more of a lean-to, complete with low ceiling and dirt floor.  The walls are stacked high with cords of wood, leaving little walking space for purchasing or perusal.  A lone elf stands against the far wall, absently brushing bits of dust and lint from his clothes.

title: [Ta'Illistim Locksmith]
description: Small hooks have been fastened to the stone wall behind the locksmith's counter.  Dangling from the hooks are key blanks and lockpicks fashioned of a wide array of materials, some plain and others quite ornate.  Multicolored carpets are scattered across the stone floor, glowing in the sunlight beaming in through the glaesine windows.

title: [Bank of Ta'Illistim Exchange]
description: The small cottage that serves as the city's exchange booth clearly is often visited, as the stone flooring underfoot has been deeply worn in a path from the door to the clerk's desk.  An engraved mithglin sign is mounted upon the wall behind the desk.

The ground level of the tower which serves as the city's exchange is clearly often visited, as the stone flooring underfoot has been deeply worn in a path from the door to the clerk's desk.  An engraved silver sign is mounted upon the wall behind the desk.

title: [Wizard Guild, Courtyard]
description: Flanked by a small hill of verdant green grass, a massive spire of silver-sheened crystal rises up amid the tall rooftops of the city, its surface sparkling and pristine.  A white walkway leads up to the base of the tower, yet its flawless walls offer no obvious means of access.  A ring of identical silver monoliths encircle the tower, and a scarlet circle of runes is scribed into the soft earth at the end of the walkway.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Golden monir panelling lines this relatively featureless hallway.  Dark green marble clads the floor, lined in the center with a narrow strip of amber-hued carpeting.  Amber lamps, mounted to the monir panelling, march onward down the hallway.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Registrar's Office]
description: Dark sapphire blue velvet frames a glaesine mosaic on the rear wall of this small office.  Illumination in the form of several oil-burning glaes sconces casts a flickering light that dances across the mosaic, reflecting small multicolored spots of color across the worn stone floor.  An ornately carved monir desk occupies the center of the high-ceilinged room.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Golden monir panelling lines this relatively featureless hallway.  Dark green marble clads the floor, lined in the center with a narrow strip of amber-hued carpeting.  Amber lamps, mounted to the monir panelling, march onward down the hallway.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Golden monir panelling lines this relatively featureless hallway.  Dark green marble clads the floor, lined in the center with a narrow strip of amber-hued carpeting.  Amber lamps, mounted to the monir panelling, march onward down the hallway.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Citizenry]
description: Pale sunlight filters in through the leaded glass panes of the windows here, providing barely sufficient illumination for the clerks working diligently at their desks.  Several patrons lean against a gleaming mistwood counter that partitions the room, carefully scanning official-looking documents under the watchful eye of a clerk.

Pale light from candles set in burnished faenor sconces  provides barely sufficient illumination for the clerks working diligently at their desks.  Several patrons lean against a gleaming mistwood counter that partitions the room, carefully scanning official-looking documents under the watchful eye of a clerk.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Clerk]
description: Thick dark blue carpeting muffles all sounds underfoot, as the city's residents wander into and out of the clerk's small office.  The efficient city clerk sits behind his desk, dealing with patrons quickly and quietly, and smiling little.

title: [Hall of Patrons, Vestibule]
description: Cool marble floors and frescoed walls enclose this spacious entryway.  Candlelight flickers brightly from brass wall sconces, illuminating the area and seamless marble columns support a large archway to the north, opening into a large rotunda.  To the south, large gated doors stand open.
