title: [Hall of Patrons, Chamber]
description: A variety of verdant ivy adorns the walls, creeping along the high windows in a twining embrace.  The surroundings are a stark white -- the brilliant luster of the polished marble reflecting the light in beautiful, sparkling waves.  A deep black pool stands within the center of the room, its edges chased with delicate silver-hued designs.

title: [Hall of Patrons, Corridor]
description: The walls of the corridor are unadorned except for a pair of brass wall sconces, used to illuminate the area.  Arches flank the eastern and western ends of the corridor and silver-veined marble covers the floor.

title: [Hall of Patrons, Corridor]
description: The walls of the corridor are unadorned except for a pair of brass wall sconces, used to illuminate the area.  There are doors on either side of the corridor and one at the end.  An arch to the south opens into the rotunda and silver-veined marble covers the floor.

title: [Hall of Patrons, Corridor]
description: The walls of the corridor are unadorned except for a pair of brass wall sconces, used to illuminate the area.  There are doors on either side of the corridor and one at the end.  An arch to the southeast opens into the rotunda and silver-veined marble covers the floor.

title: [Hall of Patrons, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard evokes a serenity and harmony that express the essence of nature.  With its carefully styled plants and judiciously placed stones, the courtyard is a tribute to the beauty of pure form.  At the north end of the courtyard large gated doors lead to the Hall of Patrons rising behind its corbelled facade.

title: [Temple, Hall of Sacrifice]
description: This part of the hallway is decorated in tapestries which were hung methodically in rows.  Each of the handwoven marvels depicts various acts of self-sacrifice: a valiant warrior placing himself in front of a fallen friend, a noble-looking lady giving her cloak to an impoverished child and many other similar scenes.

title: [Temple, Corridor]
description: Fragrant flowers are crushed beneath your feet as you walk down this corridor of polished white marble.  An ornate arch of pink granite marks the entrance to the wedding chapel, where many a blushing bride and her betrothed have exchanged their vows of everlasting love under the watchful eyes of their gods.

title: [Temple, Chapel]
description: Two pillars frame a simple chapel.  Followers of the land's many religions offer prayers here, each to their own gods.  On a pine pew a Zhaolmin monk in tattered robes sits beside a solitary elf softly intoning an ancient chant.  In front of the pews, you see an unadorned altar.

title: [Temple, Wedding Chapel]
description: Stained-glass windows glow like jewels, reflecting the light of the many pure white candles that flicker around the simple altar where couples kneel to exchange their wedding vows.  Hand-sewn tapestries depict scenes from married life in rich, colorful detail along the walls.  Fresh flowers are brought in each day, and their soft, romantic fragrance fills the small chapel.

title: [Temple, Bridal Room]
description: Soft candlelight casts a warm glow about the room.  The white marble floor is covered with hand-woven rugs and a huge mirror hangs from the wall in an ornate frame of gold.  Here, the bride and her attendants await the start of the wedding ceremony in privacy, serenity, and comfort.

title: [Temple, Tapestry Room]
description: A large candle burns with a steady flame in each corner of this room.  Various forms of artwork adorn the walls of this chamber, each representing one of the Gods of Elanthia.  One particular object, a long black tapestry, attracts your attention.  A small chair sits next to the tapestry and seated in this chair is the hooded figure of a man.

title: [Temple, Black Altar]
description: The smoke of scores of incense burners fills the air of this room with a thick, acrid haze.  Through this haze can be seen the faint outline of a large, black altar of obsidian surrounded by a high rail.  Behind the altar is an arch leading to a blackened passage. Hanging nearby is a brass tube, or chime, suspended from the ceiling by a thong of leather.  Next to this chime hangs a small mallet.  The two acolytes that greeted you as you entered are standing nearby.

title: [Temple, Cleric's Office]
description: The Lord High Cleric of the Landing has his study here, which houses priceless manuscripts and scrolls, the sum of the learning of the ancient Lords of Liabo and their Sages.  An impassive monk is stationed by the door.  Though unarmed, he inspires awe and respect.  On the Lord Cleric's writing table are an ora chalice and a finely carved, inlaid reliquary.

title: [Elaraeyn's Boutique]
description: The scents of oak paneling, oiled leather, and fine cigar smoke indicate that Elanthia's most discriminating gentlemen shop here.  Several hooks placed along the wall are bedecked with finery of all hues and textures.

Muted panels of hunter green and russet cloth form the backdrop for the room, highlighting some antler-shaped hooks and a polished modwir dresser dominating the side wall.  The faint scent of oiled leather and cigar tobacco wafts through the room, the fragrance's origins unknown.

title: [Elaraeyn's Boutique]
description: Handsomely-textured tartans draped and gathered with braided gold silk cords hang from clear glaes rods, symbols from various clans and houses mounted as decoration.

Thickly woven tartans and silks are draped across the room, suspended from burnished rods high above.  Matching animal hides create makeshift rugs beneath the wooden containers set out in the middle of the shop, the various creatures carved into the surfaces of a heavy cedar and oak chest and a lacquered mahogany dresser.

title: [Elaraeyn's Boutique]
description: Rich jewel-toned lengths of velvet conceal the walls along this part of the shop, the surroundings becoming more intimate and cozy.  Outerwear for body and head have been displayed here, in all the newest fashions and colors.

Sheets of vellum and parchment decorate the vanilla-hued walls, the papers covered in sketches of various fashions in a myriad of vivid colors.  Well-organized piles of fabric and vials of dye are arranged neatly against the walls, each labeled item placed within a tall metal filigree display.

title: [Elaraeyn's Boutique]
description: All sorts of accessories in the way of belts, headwear, and fashionable jewelry can be found on this side of the shop.

Silk-leafed strands of vivid ivy form a frame along the ivory walls, the fabric forming haphazard lattices across the room.  Accessories and bits of jewelry lay draped upon an ivy-painted box and a velvet-padded shelf, adding additional color to the otherwise neutral-toned area.

title: [Elaraeyn's Boutique]
description: The heady scent of mixing essences wafts fragrantly around this section of the boutique.  Several porcelain bowls filled with crushed coloring agents line the back shelf, where a dwarven woman works mixing them.

Colorful bits of powder and cream decorate the rose-embroidered linen upon the glass display, the stains creating watercolor-like designs that complement the vellum paintings along the walls.  An etched iridescent glass counter dominates the center of the area, the glass container diagonally facing a tall wood-framed mirror, both pieces decorated with an elaborate floral motif.

title: [Elaraeyn's Boutique]
description: Yards of spidersilk suspended overhead form a canopy trimmed with fragrant garlands of white roses and Imaera's lace.

Garlands of vibrant roses are strung along the linden-latticed ceiling of the room, the fragrant blooms matching the others spilling over in glass vases spread against the ivory-painted walls.  A soft wool rug, dyed pale blue, leads toward a blush-stained linden armoire set at an angle towards a stained glass partition situated towards the back of the area.

title: [Osby's Salvage and Construction]
description: The rough warehouse is stacked to the eaves with scrap metal, scorched bits of wood, and other salvaged materials.  Scurrying noises in the shadows indicate that the scrawny, unkempt half-elf who oversees the operation may not be the only inhabitant of the room -- though he seems to be the only two-legged one.

title: [Coggin's Used Doors]
description: The lean, oily-looking human standing behind the low counter glances up from polishing his locksmithing tools and pushes his dark, greasy hair back from his face as you enter.  Disorganized stacks of wood and metal doors rest against the walls, most with their hinges broken or skilfully dismantled.

title: [Shanty Town, Intersection]
description: Mud-filled paths that might conceivably be called roads wander off in many directions, through a veritable maze of run-down shacks, fences and puddles.  An ancient, corroded brass figure of a mermaid lies half-buried in the muck, as if salvaged from some ship lost on the riverbank many years ago and set here to guard the neighborhood.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south

title: [Shanty Town, Riverfront]
description: The muddy path rises into a patch of relatively dry ground, populated by numerous shacks clustered out of range of the mud and quite a few tufts of grass and weeds.  A makeshift flowerbed flourishes between two shanties, filled with scrawny rosebushes that are probably stolen.

title: [Shanty Town, Riverfront]
description: The muddy riverbank winds around a shallow pool that swirls slowly as the current feeds it.  Many seagulls and several muddy children forage in the shallow water.  Tattered fishing nets strung between wooden poles to dry festoon the area, set between run-down cottages and shacks built precariously on the muddy ground.

title: [Shanty Town, Riverfront]
description: The path spreads into an expanse of muddy ground that stretches down to the riverbank.  Dilapidated shacks are built on the drier patches of ground, some resting at slight angles as they sink into the shifting muddy surface.  Seabirds roam the area, squalling loudly as they poke in the wet ground for snails and other goodies.

title: [Shanty Town, Boatyard Alley]
description: The boatyard fence winds to the east down to the river's edge.  A variety of graffiti, colorful in more ways than one, has been painted and carved into the wood.  A scrawny dog roots around in the tufts of grass by the side of the muddy road.

title: [Shanty Town, Boatyard Alley]
description: A narrow crack in the boatyard fence between two shacks provides a view of a scenic storage yard full of salvaged boats and other jetsam and assorted trash.  Someone has stacked a pile of rusted and barnacle-encrusted junk dredged up from the river by the side of the road.

title: [Shanty Town, Boatyard Alley]
description: The muddy lane curves around the tall wooden fence that surrounds the boatyard, and shouting and banging noises from the other side fill the air, along with a pervasive scent of paint, sawdust, and old fish.  Rundown shacks line the fence and fill the puddle-strewn flatland that extends to the river's edge.

title: [Shanty Town, Muddy Lane]
description: The roadway becomes almost impassible as it circles a burned-out stump sitting directly in its path.  Ramshackle dwellings sit crowded around the old stump, as if they are mesmerized by the senseless meander the pitiful excuse for a road is executing.  The hovels lurch shoulder to shoulder, like a stack of dominoes ready to topple over in a cascading heap.

title: [Shanty Town, Muddy Lane]
description: The path turns sharply, dipping down into a mud-filled patch of low ground.  Someone has lain some flat rocks down in an attempt to provide footing in the mud, which has resulted in a patch of slippery, mud-covered flat rocks.

title: [Shanty Town, South Wall]
description: Rows of tumbledown shacks nestle together along a hillock of dirt that rises up along the south wall.  Dozens of grey pigeons waddle around the street, pecking at morsels in the dirt or fluttering up to rest on the edges of the thatched rooftops.

title: [Shanty Town, South Wall]
description: A wisp of foul-smelling smoke rises from a heap of smoldering refuse in a pit by the side of the road.  A group of small boys play in a vacant space between the clusters of shacks, tossing coins against the south wall as they curse and slap at one another.

title: [Shanty Town, South Wall]
description: Run-down shacks and makeshift cottages stand crowded in the shade of the south wall of town.  Guardsmen patrolling above seem to not pay much attention to this corner of town, except to occasionally lean over to spit.

title: [Shanty Town, Riverfront]
description: The path ends where the south wall of the town meets the river, extending west in a narrow trail against the wall and upstream into a cluster of riverfront shacks.  Piles of flotsam and jetsam left by the river lie in mounds against the end of the wall where it extends into the water, and several filthy children and dogs rummage among the debris, searching for treasures left by the current.

title: [Shanty Town, Riverfront]
description: The network of paths winds down the riverbank, crossing the half-submerged bulk of a huge rusted pipe that runs northeast to the water's edge.  Ramshackle huts and unpainted shacks stand close together, clustered around the muddy byways.

title: [Reignbeau Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Small tunnels branch out in every direction and it's hard to be sure which one you entered through, let alone which to leave through.  Colored footprints dot the floor, wandering in every direction.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Reignbeau Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The roof of the cavern is fairly low here, and a giantman could almost reach up and poke the clay above.  A large fissure cuts through the middle of the cavern, giving off steam like an angry drake.

title: [Reignbeau Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Many-colored clays drip down the walls of the tunnel, forming rainbow puddles on the floor.  A small niche in the side of the tunnel is filled with a layer of matted straw, and apparently serves as a cozy spot for the dye-splattered workers to take a nap.

title: [Reignbeau Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Small tunnels branch out in every direction and it's hard to be sure which one you entered through, let alone which to leave through.  Colored footprints dot the floor, wandering in every direction.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Reignbeau Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Splotches of color cover the walls, dripping down onto the floor.  Your feet stick a bit with every step and their soles must surely be turning every color of the rainbow.  More disgruntled dwarves lounge about, trying to avoid getting their tunics covered with clay.

title: [Wehnimer's, East Jetty]
description: This windswept jetty, built of granite and basalt boulders, shelters the beach here from the river currents made more insistent by the pounding surf of Darkstone Bay.  A corroded bronze gate stands high across the path, blocking further travel.

title: [Urudwek's Magic Shoppe]
description: A decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling rises overhead.  A sphere-topped black marble fountain sits in one corner of a buffed cherrywood floor.  There is a large oak table on one side of the shop and a painted red cedar rack on the other.

title: [Warehouse, Entry]
description: A fresh layer of soft straw covers the weathered oak floorboards, softening the sound of rumbling wagons as they carry their loads of fine leathers and rare furs to the back of the warehouse for storage.  Tanned hides lay stacked in piles against the smooth stone walls, waiting to be shipped to distant markets, or sold to local merchants and artisans.

title: [Warehouse, Nexus]
description: The air is filled with shouts and bellowed orders as warehouse workers, wagons, and tradesmen barely avoid each other in their rush to get to their appointed locations at their appointed times.  A large wooden platform sits in the center of this whirling pool of chaos, a calm eye in the center of the howling storm of commerce.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Warehouse, East Wing]
description: Well-worn flagstones peek through the scattered piles of fresh straw that have inadvertently been kicked in from the warehouse floor.  The straw collects against the clean oak walls of the hallway and settles on the floor between the workshop doors, like small drifts of golden snow.

title: [Warehouse, East Wing]
description: The quiet hallway is warmly lit by a string of torches evenly spaced along the length of the corridor.  Surprisingly, one of the torches has been allowed to burn out, creating odd shadows that reach towards you, one moment beckoning you forward, the next pushing you away.

title: [Warehouse, East Wing]
description: The torch at this end of the hallway has been allowed to go out, allowing shadowed darkness to fill the quiet corridor.  A lively draft whistles through a crack somewhere in the ceiling high above you, doubtless the reason the torch went out in the first place.

title: [Warehouse, Office]
description: One of the legs of a rickety chair is shorter than the others are; to help compensate for its imperfection the leg rests on a square piece of wood.  Occupying the chair, an abandoned stuffed steel golem with pieces of jet for eyes sits limply.  The warped oak floor is covered with a light dusting of straw.  Along the back wall, a pile of cushions takes up space in front of a gaping hole.

title: [Warehouse, West Wing]
description: The hallway is darker, cooler, and much quieter then the warehouse itself.  Small torches light the long hallway at even intervals, softly illuminating the scattered bits of straw, which cover the oak floor.

title: [Warehouse, West Wing]
description: The sounds from the warehouse are a distant murmur, often overpowered by the tapping of metal tools, or a soft, sudden curse coming from inside one of the workshops.

title: [Warehouse, West Wing]
description: The hallway comes to an abrupt end, marked by a large, smoking torch set into the middle of the western wall.  A long, black, sooty smudge runs up the wall above the torch towards the ceiling, a quiet call for soap, water, and determination.

title: [Wehnimer's Garden, Trees]
description: As your eyes follow the path into the trees you can just barely discern a small cottage nestled snugly among the foliage.  The vegetation grows so close to the building that it seems to be a part of it.  Flowers and vines cover the walls and roof, yet you realize that they grow in such a way that neither the wooden door nor the windows are blocked.

title: [Tedra's Cottage, Garden]
description: A cobblestone path halts at the foot of a garden wall made of large flagstones.  Moss and lichens grow in pockets in the rock, studding the wall with lacy viridian fronds.  Sitting in the center of the luxuriant growth, a cottage rests in the shade from a tall oak tree, the dwelling's green shutters complementing the surrounding foliage.  Something about the dwelling seems different, out of the ordinary, as if the place exudes an ambiance that is alive.

title: [Bay's Watch, Rocky Path]
description: A well-kept stone path leads down the bluff at the base of the watchtower, splitting to double back along the bluff and continuing down to the rugged shore to the east.  The bustle of the city above fades as the sound of crashing surf echoes from the stone.

A well-kept stone path leads down the bluff at the base of the watchtower, splitting to double back along the bluff and continuing down to the rugged, night-misted shore to the east.  The faint bustle of the city above fades as the sound of crashing surf echoes from the stone.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, northwest, up, down

title: [Bay's Watch, Rocky Beach]
description: Whitecaps crash against the rocky shore, filling the air with sea spray and the scent of the bay.  The bluff rises above the scattered boulders, home to the nests of countless seabirds that swoop down from the watch above.  In the distance, merchant ships pass in the bay, their colorful sails moving across the horizon.

Whitecaps crash against the rocky shore, filling the air with sea spray and the cold night scent of the bay.  The bluff rises above the scattered boulders, home to the nests of countless seabirds that swoop down from the watch above.  In the distance, an occasional ship passes in the bay, its sails dark against the horizon.

title: [Bay's Watch, Promontory]
description: A jetty of waterworn stone juts out into the shallow water of the river delta.  The water is calmer here, but the steady breeze brings with it the scent of the open bay.  Gulls swarm around the end of the promontory, searching for meals in the shallow water, and small cargo ships pass into and out of the river's mouth in a steady stream.

A jetty of waterworn stone juts out into the shallow water of the river delta.  The water is calmer here, but the steady breeze brings with it the scent of the open bay.  A few gulls alight around the end of the promontory, searching for meals in the dark, shallow water, and small cargo ships pass into and out of the river's mouth, their lanterns flickering in the dark.

title: [Bay's Watch, Shore]
description: The path winds along the edge of the bay, cooled by seaspray from the surf that splashes on the rocky shoreline.  Several cottages are clustered in an open area near a sturdy wooden dock that extends out into the blue water, surrounded by racks of drying nets and floats.

The path winds along the edge of the bay, cooled by seaspray from the surf that splashes on the rocky shoreline.  Several cottages are clustered in an open area near a sturdy wooden dock that extends out into the dark water, surrounded by racks of drying nets and floats.

title: [Bay's Watch, Shore]
description: The narrow expanse of sand between the jagged shore and the rocky bluffs above is filled with scattered boulders and lines of seaweed and debris left by the high tide.  Small shacks and cottages are set up against the shadow of the bluff, out of reach of the highest water.

title: [Bay's Watch, Shore]
description: The shore curves to the south here, bordering the mud flats that stretch out into the water.  Merchant ships pass in the deeper water, their sails bright against the horizon, and the shallows are busy with flocks of seabirds noisily scavenging for food.

The shore curves to the south here, bordering the mud flats that stretch out into the water.  Merchant ships pass in the deeper water, their sails dark against the horizon, and the shallows are busy with schools of fish noisily disturbing the water as they scavenge for food.

title: [Bay's Watch, Eastern Shore]
description: A rocky trail leads up the shore of the bluff, which is capped by a stand of pines that have scattered needles and a few cones even down here in the sand.  The current laps softly at the shore, and a brisk bay breeze blows in, bearing the cries of seagulls and the spray of salt air.

title: [Bay's Watch, Bluffs]
description: The fresh sea breeze combines with the scent of the towering pines that line the bluffs, filling the air with a light, brisk scent.  Gulls screech and dive over the water below, occasionally stopping to roost on the rocky edge of the bluff.

title: [Bay's Watch, Bluffs]
description: A row of tall pines forms a barrier separating the bluff from the town above, their needles rustling softly in the sea breeze.  Several cottages stand back from the bluff in the shade of the pines.  The air is filled with the soft sound of the bay surf rushing against the rocks far below.

title: [Bay's Watch, East Bluffs]
description: A boulder as big as a house rests near the edge of the cliff, its rugged edges and sharp angles too inhospitable to climb.  Far below, merchant ships pass through the bay, their sails and banners colorful against the blue water.

A boulder as big as a house rests near the edge of the cliff, its rugged edges and sharp angles too inhospitable to climb.  Far below, merchant ships pass through the bay, their sails and banners dark against the moonlit water.

title: [Bay's Watch, Eastern Shore]
description: A few rocks dot the sandy shore, and trees grow near the bluff that rises steeply into the pine woods.  The mud swirls in the shallows, stirred by the wakes of passing ships, and gulls gather to screech and squabble over bits of food.

title: [Bay's Watch, East Bluffs]
description: The trail winds back from the edge of the bluff through a stand of tall pines.  A soft carpet of needles covers the ground, and a fresh hint of sea breeze fills the air.  The passing sails of boats can be spotted through the trees in the distance.

The trail winds back from the edge of the bluff through a stand of tall pines.  A soft carpet of needles covers the ground, and a fresh hint of sea breeze fills the air.  The dark sails of passing boats can be spotted now and then through the trees in the distance.

title: [Bay's Watch, East Bluffs]
description: Several huge grey boulders along the edge of the bluff provide a vantage point from which to enjoy the fresh air and the view of the bay and the shore below.  Windswept pines shade the area, and a path leads down the rocky slope to the sand.

title: [Bay's Watch, Eastern Shore]
description: The trail ends here against an outcropping of rock that extends into the bay, blocking passage south.  A jetty of sand, piled against the stone over the years, extends into the water, and a path leads up the stony bluffs to the woods above.

title: [Bay's Watch, East Jetty]
description: Rocks and sand, deposited over the centuries by the flow against the stone barrier, extend into the water, forming a spit of dry land.  Gulls flock everywhere, feasting on the bounty of the shallow waters and screeching raucously.

title: [Bay's Watch, Bluffs]
description: The trail winds along the stone bluffs above the rocky shore some thirty feet below.  Gulls and other seabirds nest in the rocks at the edge of the cliff and in the rafters of the small houses built along the rim.

title: [Bay's Watch, Overlook]
description: The sheer wall of the watchtower rises above you, casting a shadow over the rocky ledge overlooking the bay.  Seabirds circle the tower, occasionally descending to roost on the crags or dive into the expanse of blue water below for a meal.  A strong sea breeze whistles over the rocks and against the tower, drowning out any sounds of the town nearby.

The sheer wall of the watchtower rises above you, casting a black shadow over the rocky ledge overlooking the bay.  A few seabirds circle the tower, occasionally descending to roost on the crags or dive into the expanse of dark water below for a meal.  A strong sea breeze whistles over the rocks and against the tower, drowning out any sounds of the town nearby.

title: [Bay's Watch, Dock]
description: Seaside cabins stand clustered at the base of the weathered wooden dock extending out into the surf on barnacled stone pilings.  Flocks of gulls invade the dock, squalling at visitors and soaring overhead in a pattern of shifting white and grey against the blue sky.

Seaside cabins stand clustered at the base of the weathered wooden dock extending out into the surf on barnacled stone pilings.  An occasional gull glides above the dock, squalling at visitors and soaring overhead in a tiny shadow against the night sky.

title: [Grocer's, Tidbit Shop]
description: This room contains all sorts of foodstuffs and refreshments to delight the hungry or thirsty adventurer.  Smiling young clerks trot past every so often, their faces flushed from the constant exercise.  Occasionally, one of the youths grabs an item from behind the wooden counter stretching along one wall, then darts away to serve another customer.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: High grasses encroach upon the trail, nearly covering it in some places as it moves up the side of hill.  As it dips to the southwest, the path becomes quite narrow and dusty.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The coarse grass that clings to life on the summit of this high windswept hill seems to be permanently bent and deformed by the force of the wind.  A deep secluded valley lies down the hill to the north.  Far off to the southwest can be seen the snaking shape of a wide road.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This heavily wooded valley sits like a natural bowl nestled between several high rugged hills.  Thick grasses grow on those patches of ground where the sun is able to penetrate the dense canopy of leaves overhead.  The air is still, quiet and surprisingly warm, even in the deep shade.  To the northeast can be heard the sound of falling water.

This heavily wooded valley sits like a natural bowl nestled between several high rugged hills.  Thick grasses grow on those patches of ground where the sun is able to penetrate the dense canopy of leaves overhead during the daylight hours.  The air is still, quiet and surprisingly warm, even though the sun has set.  To the northeast can be heard the sound of falling water.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Tumbling from a rock ledge several feet above the floor of the valley is a torrent of ice cold water.  As the cascade crashes on the rocks beneath it, a great plume of silver mist billows into the damp, and refreshingly cool, air of this shadowed glen.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The deep shadows cast by the towering walls of this narrow canyon bathe this area in constant darkness.  A few lacy ferns and a small amount of deep green moss grow near the trickles of water that seep from the myriad of tiny cracks that break up the sheer cliff face.

The deep shadows cast by the towering walls of this narrow canyon bathe this area in constant darkness.  A few ferns and a small amount of deep green moss grow near the trickles of water that seep from the myriad of tiny cracks that break up the sheer cliff face.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The canyon walls of this region are covered by thick trunked shrubs and hardy sedges.  The buzzing of insects and the scampering noises caused by unseen tiny feet ring off the bare rock of the walls with surprising intensity.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The steep hills of this area rise suddenly and become the steep walls of a narrow canyon to the south.  Scores of tiny caves riddle the slopes of this region, all much too small to allow you to enter.  A large number of animal tracks crisscross the dry floor here and seem to lead to and from the natural dens created by the caves.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Smaller shrubs and bushes appear to be battling the large trees that grow here for one of the few patches of level and earth covered ground.  The size of a few of them indicates that they may have a chance.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Sitting squarely in the center of the trail is a large boulder.  Though the boulder is large, you might just be able to squeeze between it and the surrounding hillside.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A large boulder, quite unlike any of the surrounding rock, sits squarely in the middle of the trail.  Though narrow, there appears to be sufficient room between the rock and the sides of the valley for you to squeeze through.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A steep path twists up the slope of the hill to the north and disappears as it plunges through a thick patch of berry bushes.  Clinging to the intimidating thorns of these bushes are a few strips of shiny metal and some decaying bits of now unrecognizable flesh.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A wide variety of hardy bushes and shrubs grows with surprising abundance on the steep hillsides of this region.  Equally surprising is the large number of very long, and very sharp, thorns that protect each bush and successfully discourage any thought of venturing off of the path.  In the distance, a deep gorge opens from the steep mountains to the northeast.  A waterfall tumbles violently out of the gorge, splashing to form a river that widens and slows as it flows over more even ground.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: The breeze blowing from the west is merely cool, rather than icy cold, as it is farther east around the mountain.  The modwirs are numerous here, and some broadleaved bushes clump around their trunks.

The breeze blowing from the west is merely cool, rather than icy cold, as it is farther east around the mountain.  The modwirs are numerous here, and some broadleaved bushes clump around their trunks.  Owls hidden in the modwir needles above your head call out their eternal question in the night.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: Oaks and aspens mingle with the modwirs, and acorns crunch under your feet.  Poison oak tangles through the underbrush, keeping you carefully on the path.  Birds call over your head, leaves and twigs rustling to mark their passage in the branches.

Oaks and aspens mingle with the modwirs, and acorns crunch under your feet.  Poison oak tangles through the underbrush, keeping you carefully on the path.  Nocturnal animals, possibly mice, stir fallen leaves in their haste to remain unseen by any passing owl.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: A warm wind blows from the northwest, dancing through the trees and bushes, setting the leaves and flowers to swaying.  Half a dozen haaries screech and climb over your head, pelting you with acorns and branches.  Sniffing the breeze, you smell a faint trace of sulphur in the air.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: Lush vegetation grows thick in this spot, bushes and flowers and trees and ferns crowding each other for space.  Pushing your way through the growth, you discover a gash in the mountainside.  This opening seems to be the source of the warm wind heating up the area.  The smell of sulphur is very strong, and you think long and hard about entering.

Lush vegetation grows thick in this spot, bushes and flowers and trees and ferns crowding each other for space.  Pushing your way through the growth, you discover a gash in the mountainside.  You aren't certain, but you imagine you see a faint ruddy glow at the opening.  The smell of sulphur is very strong, and you think long and hard about entering.

title: [Glatoph, Vent Hole]
description: You're near the mouth of a dark, rounded tunnel leading down into the mountain.  Hot air rushes up the tunnel and out the opening, ruffling through your hair and clothes on the way.  The grey rock that forms the tunnel looks like solidified sponge, as though millions of tiny bubbles had formed and hardened.

title: [Glatoph, Vent Hole]
description: The width of this tunnel varies along its length, from barely wide enough to crawl through, to about twice your height, but its shape is always a circle, or very near.  The rough stone makes it easy to find footing on the slope, but scrapes your hands, and anything else that might touch it or brush against it.  The deep end of the tunnel is definitely warmer.

title: [Glatoph, Vent Hole]
description: The walls and ceiling of this room curve gently around, blending into each other without any sharp corners or straight lines.  It's hot enough in here that you wish you could do with a bit less clothing, like maybe a loincloth.  Four round tunnels lead out of here in different directions.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, up, down

title: [Glatoph, Vent Hole]
description: The tunnel walls are hot enough to burn your hands if you touch them.  This narrow passage slopes deep into the mountain, channeling hot air up toward the surface.  Looking downslope, you see an orange-red glow at the far end of the tunnel.

title: [Glatoph, Lava Pool]
description: You're standing at one end of a huge domed cavern that could easily swallow Wehnimer's Landing with elbow room to spare.  The ceiling curves up smoothly, suggesting that the cavern was formed as a bubble that solidified.  A ledge runs around to the north and southeast.  About three manheights below your feet is a pool of molten rock, a deep orange webwork of cracks around solid chunks of black crust.

title: [Glatoph, Lava Pool]
description: A gigantic arch soars up toward the ceiling, apparently spanning the lava pool.  Examining the arch, you see signs of tools being used on the lava that formed it.  It seems someone carved it, although the thought of doing heavy labor in this heat makes you queasy.

title: [Glatoph, Lava Pool]
description: Waves of heat rise from the lava, and everything around you shimmers and dances.  To the west, you see a huge grey arch reaching for the ceiling of the chamber.  The arch seems to vibrate in the billows of heated air, as though it's about to tumble into the pool below.

title: [Glatoph, Lava Pool]
description: Two bubbles form near each other, below you in the pool.  They rise and merge, forming a huge, elongated bubble.  It rises high in the air before it finally bursts, spitting molten rock high in the air.  You hear a sizzle near your foot, and see a splat of cooling rock inches from your toe.

title: [Glatoph, Lava Pool]
description: You feel a strong, hot breeze here.  Looking around, you see a hole far above your head, about twice as far up the wall as you could hope to reach.  The lava below glows a brighter orange, stimulated by the rushing air.

title: [Glatoph, Lava Pool]
description: One end of a grey arch reaches up toward the ceiling, its even planes and distinct corners obviously hewn by some intelligent hand wielding tools.  It looks as though a second, smaller bubble had formed at one time inside the one that forms the cavern, and someone carved away all of it but this arch.  You gaze nervously at the smaller bubbles plopping in the lava below and wonder how often such large bubbles form.

title: [Glatoph, Lava Pool]
description: The ledge here is barely a double-handspan wide, giving room for your feet with no margin for error.  The rough grey walls offer nothing to hang onto if you should stumble.  Heat rises in waves from the lava below, making the air and everything around you seem to shimmer.  To the east you see what looks like an arch stretching across the cavern, high above the glowing pool.

title: [Glatoph, Lava Pool]
description: The ledge narrows along here, and you step carefully, eyeing the lava pool below.  Every few minutes, the crust will rise up, slowly forming a bump, a hill, a bubble, the crust sliding down the sides, leaving the cooling liquid to pop with a burst of heat and sulphur-stench, sending globs of molten glowing-hot rock flying in all directions.  Luckily, this hasn't happened near you, at least not yet.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: This small grassy clearing is dotted with occasional low bushes and young trees.  To the east the trees become larger and more numerous, while to the west a faint trail leads back to the walls of Wehnimer's Landing.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: The moon shines through the canopy of hundreds of vibrant young trees, dappling everything beneath them with pockets of light and shadow.
The sun shines merrily through the canopy of hundreds of vibrant young trees, dappling everything beneath them with pockets of light and shadow.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: You are surrounded by trees.  Trees in front of you, trees behind you.  Trees to the right and trees to the left.  Never before in your life have you seen so many trees.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

wayto.4135: ;e loop { move 'south'; break if Room.current.id != 4136; move 'southwest'; break if Room.current.id != 4136; }
wayto.4137: ;e loop { move 'north'; break if Room.current.id != 4136; move 'northeast'; break if Room.current.id != 4136; }

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: The trees are older and higher here, and their leaves more densely intertwined, lending a somewhat gloomy atmosphere to an otherwise pleasant forest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

wayto.4136: ;e loop { move 'south'; break if Room.current.id != 4137; move 'southwest'; break if Room.current.id != 4137; }
wayto.4138: ;e loop { move 'north'; break if Room.current.id != 4137; move 'northeast'; break if Room.current.id != 4137; }

title: [Graveyard]
description: Through the dense forest, you can barely make out an overgrown trail that leads northeast up a gentle slope.  As the slope rises and levels off, the foliage thins out, changing in hue from deep forest shades and refreshing greens to sere browns and dull, wilted yellows.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The trees part to reveal a trodden dirt path.  Along its edges grow scraggly clumps of creeping dirge-vaon vines.  The scant leaves on the few sickly trees that support the vines seem to tremble in some unfelt and disquieting breeze.  A narrow trail leads southwest.

title: [Graveyard]
description: A massive bronze gate spans the path, blocking the way north.  On either side are high stone walls surmounted with jagged rocks.  Now green and pitted, the gate is still locked shut by a rusted chain fastened with an ancient padlock.  A cast likeness of the goddess Lorminstra, Keeper of the Gates of Oblivion, her Staff of Doom in hand, and a grotesque statue of the Empress Gosaena are the main motifs of the elaborately decorated portal.

timeto.4141: ;e if [407, 1604, 304, 1207].any? { |num| Spell[num].known? }; 0.6; elsif Skills.climbing >= [XMLData.encumbrance_value/1.25,12].max; 120.0; elsif (Stats.prof == 'Warrior') and (Stats.level >= 15); 5.2; else 30.0; end;

title: [Graveyard]
description: You pause inside the gates to survey the eerie scene.  A magnificently crafted granite crypt to the north inspires wonder and loathing.  The carvings on the facade are horrific, detailing the onslaughts of the Unlife throughout the chaotic history of Elanthia.  A gravel path wraps around the structure, while thorny brambles growing among the tombstones deter you from leaving the paved route.
