title: [Graveyard, Crypt]
description: The entry foyer to this enormous granite crypt is stark, adorned only with grisly friezes sculpted in low relief into the walls.  Bands of bluish-green ahnver are inlaid into the stone in thin strips just below the ceiling throughout the entire structure, bathing the rooms in a subtle light.  A shadowy arch curves overhead and leads deeper into the inner sanctum of the sepulcher.

title: [Graveyard, Crypt]
description: You enter the close, stuffy room that houses the sarcophagus of the once-illustrious inhabitant of this imposing crypt.  The coffin stands upright against one wall, almost touching the low ceiling, its painted lid stuck open on sagging hinges.  You shudder as you notice that there are long, fresh tracks on the dust-covered stone floor.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Tunnel]
description: As you enter into the tunnel you feel the cold wind of death chill you to the bone.  You know this is where many a dead adventurer lies to rest.  You shudder with the revulsion of such a fate befalling you.  The flickering torch in the wall mount does little more than bring the shadows to life.

title: [Hall of the Dead]
description: The passage has seen many weary footsteps.  Only the worn ruts in the rock can tell just how many have walked these dim tunnels.  As with other rooms you have encountered, light is cast by a single torch in the wall.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Tunnel]
description: This room is a stark contrast to the others, brightly lit by torches and oil-filled pots.  The walls are painted pure white, with pictures depicting scenes of peace and serenity.  Various artworks depict many of the local deities.  No one worship has been slighted as each sect has tried to outdo the other in worship of their gods.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southwest, west

title: [Hall of the Dead, Tunnel]
description: The torches hanging on the wall burn brightly and the stone beneath your feet echos your steps.  The smell of death is getting stronger as you advance.  Though not as ornate, the room is still painted in the white which allows you to see the entire section of tunnel much like daytime.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Tunnel]
description: Flickering torchlight reveals tunnels running off in all directions.  They must lead to rooms that actually house the dead.  This is just part of the connecting tunnels leading you to your final destination.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Hall of the Dead, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel continues east and west, the torches lining the wall cast strange shadows.  The quiet gives your mind a chance to race.  Your thoughts are not pleasant.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Tunnel]
description: The stone of the room is worn smooth with the passing of many feet.  Flickering torches cast forbidding shadows on the walls, which reflect little light.  Here the paint has lost all of its sheen and has seen little care.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: You find more notches to house the dead, but all the care has gone out of the carving of the receptacles.  Here the only interest was in conserving space.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: This central core is huge.  Every inch of the wall has been cut away to provide housing for the dead.  With little care to the design, some shelves have crumbled to fall into the crypt below.  So much for reverence for the dead.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: Bodies are falling from the crypts carved into the wall and bones litter the floor.  As you walk along you unknowingly kick the skull of some poor unfortunate person who perished long ago.  It skitters across the room to shatter against the far wall.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: As the light of the room flickers something is different, the wall carvings have become very shallow.  They are so shallow that bodies have been turned on their side to save work in carving the holes.  In fact, most are held to the wall pockets by simple restraining straps, some of which have rotted, allowing the bodies to tumble from their resting place.

wayto.4168: ;e fput 'turn torch' unless checkloot.include?('stairway'); move 'go stairway'

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: You stop and murmur a silent prayer for one of the dead entombed here could be a friend or relative.  The lack of identification markings on the crypts, makes it impossible to tell who might rest here.  You bolster your resolve as you move on.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: More of the unfortunate dead have been packed into the crudely carved wall slots.  Looking at some of the corpses you notice that they dangle from the often shallow openings.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: Bodies are stuffed into the extremely small wall pockets.  Looking into one of the pockets, you notice that there are actually two bodies in it.  To save time and space, dead dwarves are being packed, two and sometimes three bodies at a time into the slots.  Bodies of giantmen seem to be folded to fit into the openings.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: The smell of death is getting stronger and a feeling of foreboding churns your stomach as the stench increases.  The room is lit only by the single torch in its mounting.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: The dead are packed into notches that bear little resemblance to the beautiful crypts you have witnessed before.  In fact, various body parts dangle from several of the ledges.  Not even a simple name card shows you who might be in the wall pockets.

title: [Hall of the Dead]
description: You note the crevices have lost most of their neatness.  In fact, some are not carved deeply enough to hold some of the bodies.  As a result, an occasional arm or leg hangs out of the slots.  Still, each is labeled with a small sign, identifying the brave adventurer resting within.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Vault Room]
description: Although not as ornately carved as some in these halls, the niches here are neat.  The placards are simply decorated, while still reflecting some form of family wealth.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Vault Room]
description: The room is bare except for the rows and rows of crevices carved into the walls, each holding its own body.  Great care has been taken to see that each was treated with the utmost respect in death if not in life.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Vault Room]
description: The rows of crevices containing the bodies seem endless and are all filled with the remains of adventurers much like yourself.  Some are more richly carved than others, indicating wealth on the families' behalf.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Vault Room]
description: You are awestruck by the sheer number of dead in this room.  Not one inch of wall space has been wasted in carving the niches for their final resting spots.  It pains you to see that each one is filled with bodies in various stages of decay.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Lavish Crypts]
description: Only the richest of the lands could afford such a burial crypt.  The walls between the well spaced crypts are covered with artwork depicting their life before death.  Each has been mortared over to cover and protect the dead from the would-be robber.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Lavish Crypts]
description: This room is obviously one where the well-to-do have been laid to rest.  Although not private crypts, each is meticulously carved from the stone, with gold leaf brushed into the deeply carved nameplates.  Solid gold would only bring out the lust of grave robbers.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Clerics Room]
description: Families and friends who wished a last farewell to the dead congregated here.  A mammoth stone pedestal sitting in the middle of the room is rounded near the top edges.  Only its frequent use could have caused such wear.  The pedestal is ringed by ceremonial candle holders that cascade around it.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: The smell of death and decay almost overcomes you and you gasp for air, but your lungs refuse it.  Although you have smelled death before, you have never experienced the revulsion you feel entering this area.  You wonder if you should advance any further as the nausea drains your strength.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: The neatness of the crypt is gone and so is the formality shown the dead.  Most bodies are dumped, two and three at a time, into the slots.  The stench of rotting flesh is very heavy and you take in short shallow breaths in hopes of not being overwhelmed by the stench.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: Again you see the dried blood trail.  There is just too much blood on the ground for only one person to have been bleeding.  It looks like the dead were dragged through the area and not carried to their final resting place.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: The scent of decay is still strong here but every one of the crypts is empty.  They look like they might have been used at one time, as blood runs from the wall slots.  You wonder what fate befell those that were here.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: This cavern is caked with dried blood which coats the floor and walls in this area drinking in all the light.  Every cave looks like the last as you struggle to find your way around inside them.

wayto.4171: ;e unless checkloot.include?('door'); move 'south'; fput 'search'; move 'go stair'; move 'southwest'; move 'southwest'; move 'southeast'; move 'go crack'; move 'north'; end; move 'go door'
wayto.4173: ;e unless checkloot.include?('door'); move 'south'; fput 'search'; move 'go stair'; move 'southwest'; move 'southwest'; move 'southeast'; move 'go crack'; move 'north'; end; move 'south'

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: This cavern is caked with dried blood which coats the floor and walls in this area drinking in all the light.  Every cave looks like the last as you struggle to find your way around inside them.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: This cavern is caked with dried blood which coats the floor and walls in this area drinking in all the light.  Every cave looks like the last as you struggle to find your way around inside them.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: Heat as from the depths of the underworld assaults you as you enter the room.  The walls look more like they have been melted into this giant cavern.  This room was not cut by the crude carvings of man or elf.  The light of the flickering torch shows off some movement on the ground.  Looking down, you see a heavy mist floating around your feet.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: The heat here is very intense, and you take short shallow breaths to prevent your lungs from being singed.  Sweat runs down your arms and into your hands, causing you to rub them unconsciously to dry them.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: Magma bubbles from the ground here.  The heat is so intense that you start to sweat almost immediately upon entering the room.  There is a chain hanging from the ceiling that holds a pot boiling over the intense heat.  Sacks of carrots, potatoes, and onions are next to the wall.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: A long table designed to hold many a guest sits in the middle of the room.  Dishes and silverware are scattered across the surface of the table.  Chairs are turned over and sprawled throughout the room.  It's as if everyone left in a hurry.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: As you enter this cavern, it quickly opens up into a spacious dome.  The smoothness of the wall and the absence of digging lets you know this was all etched by nature.  The lava pools have receded leaving behind this area gutted in the rock, with just the heavy fog swirling about your feet to remind you that the walls are still warm enough to turn water to steam.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: You now see what has caused the fog.  Water bleeds from the upper part of the stone wall in a small trickle here.  When it strikes the hotter stone of the floor the water heats, and evaporates into steam.  As time cools it, the steam sinks to the low level of the caves to surround your ankles as fog.  It almost has a life of its own as it moves around you.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: This room is the bed chamber.  The cots are nothing more than straw filled boxes, large enough to fit a man.  The straw has been covered by moth eaten blankets.  These cots have been stacked four high, to form bunks, thus saving space.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: A thin layer of gold reflects from the torch as you enter the room.  There is just enough gold to show itself in the wall, but not enough to be profitable to mine.  This area might have originally been a mine.  Now the use is much different.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: The fog hangs very close to the floor here.  Each step causes it to swirl into strange patterns that give the fog a lifelike quality.  A large chunk of rock has fallen from the ceiling here.  This room is carved larger than most of the others and it causes you no inconvenience as you go around it.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: A small stack of bodies, stripped of all valuables, are stacked in the corner.  There is no reverence shown the dead here, they are merely lumps of flesh, a commodity to be exploited and nothing else.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: In the corner stands what could only be described as a giant chopper.  Its purpose is unclear but you are sure that no common flesh and bone could withstand a blow from such a cruel device.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: This room is empty except for a few bloody barrels used to transport something, which are empty now but caked with dried blood.  A small cart in the corner is used to usher the barrels around, presumably when they are full.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: The walls still have that melted look except where some excavation has been done to widen the area or search for something.  You see a few thin lines of gold in the rock.  As you reach out to touch the gold, you can feel the warmth like a great oven assault your fingertips.  It is not hot enough to instantly burn you, but hot enough to make you recoil in surprise.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: You know now what was eating at you in the crypts above.  The dead are being hacked to pieces and packed into pockets like so much refuse.  They are only important for the items of value that they might have carried.  Only someone very evil and sinister could have put together this processing shop.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: The ground is covered with the swirling monster of a mist.  You can only hope there is not an abyss in here that you might fall into, maybe never to return.  You begin to move with guarded caution as you slide your feet forward feeling for a possible hole.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: The heat is not quite so intense here.  But the air is still hot with humidity.  The normal dampness of the cavern has been heated up to cause a sauna like effect in the area.  This has also caused a natural layer of fog to seep into the room obscuring your view of the ground.

title: [Dark-One's Keep]
description: There is a large smelting pot suspended by stone supports hanging over a small magma pool here.  The pool is the perfect method to melt down gold and silver into bars that might later be sold.  You see some residue layers of gold and silver on the pot and the trough where the process of smelting has occurred before.  Casting molds lie in the corner.

title: [Dark-One's Keep]
description: This room looks much like an infirmary by the contents, but somehow you get the feeling that healing has nothing to do with what goes on here.  Dried blood on the labels of the jars prevents you from reading the contents of the jars on the shelf.

title: [Dark-One's Keep]
description: This room houses bins and containers.  Some containers are overflowing with garments, others have weapons stacked into them.  The thought crosses your mind that you might be able to find something here you could use.  But you change your mind when you realize that would probably be equivalent to robbing the dead.

title: [Dark-One's Keep]
description: Dead bodies are everywhere.  They are thrown into stacks that go all the way to the ceiling.  The only thing that keeps them from tumbling on you is a low wooden retaining wall that runs the full length of each side of the room.  There is only enough room for you to traverse to the next room.

title: [Dark-One's Keep]
description: Lavish can not even begin to describe this room.  There are gold and jeweled objects everywhere.  Thick fur carpets the floor covering every inch of the rock.  Elaborate pillows are thrown about the room to be used for relaxing.  The walls have large tapestries, intricately woven into beautiful mosaics.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Mine Road]
description: As you top the ridge of the bank of the Locksmehr River you see the remains of the northern mining road that leads northeastward into the hills near Darkstone Bay.  It is obvious that the road is in little use now.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The packed dirt road is almost swallowed by the grassy hills that surround you.  There are tree stumps all around and some young trees grow as evidence that the fringes of the forest here were once mined for timber.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The long grass quickly hides your trail as you proceed along this route.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You move between shallow hills in the tall grass that swallows the trail you leave behind you.  The steady sound of the wind muffles the usual sounds of nature you have come to expect in this wilderness country.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: As you reach the crest of a small hill you can see a trail to the south that leads in the general direction of Wehnimer's Landing.  You also see the gradual climbing slope of the hills as you proceed to the northeast.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: It takes effort climbing through the rolling hills, but you move easily now through this level glen.  Other people have rested here, as it is quiet, with no hint of the Bay winds.  There is evidence of old fire pits here.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The shattered frame of an ancient tree stands alone here, ravaged by lightning and fire on this hillcrest.  You see the trees end abruptly nearby to the west as the hills drop off into Darkstone Bay.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The grass holds fast some larger boulders that have fallen from the start of a ridge line above this trail.  The smell of ocean breezes and the sounds of gulls high above remind you of this land's seafaring heritage.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You reach another hilltop and the valley is clearly visible to the south and west.  The trail leads ever upward to the north and trees now start to line this trail.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The path is not well defined as you move along the grassy trail.  Tall pines sway with the ocean winds that are so prevalent here.  The grass has been trodden upon in different places here confusing the trail.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This hill crest reveals three routes to follow.  You have a choice of continuing upward to the ridge crest, or over a small hill and into a winding run under the ridge, as the trail downward to the south is the final choice.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You reach this nobby hill that is devoid of vegetation.  It appears that various travelers have camped in this place and you can see half buried trash from these previous visitors.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You reach a rock filled crevice that used to be a narrow passage.  It looks as if a rockslide from above has decided to impede your progress.  It could take days to remove all the rocks and clear the passageway.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail narrows as you pass between the two rock faces.  To the west, a pile of fallen rock impedes your passage.  To the east, you view a winding trail descending into a grassy valley meadow.

title: [Upper Valley]
description: The forces of nature meet here as the rock face of the ridge dives into the top of the rolling grassy meadow.  There are a few places in the grass where it appears that some larger animals have bedded under the open sky.

title: [Valley]
description: A few large rocks rise from the grassy hillside as the rocky ridgeline gives way to the meadows at this juncture.  A few treestumps also protrude from the grasses giving evidence of a slain forest.

title: [Valley]
description: Dead and burned tree stumps hide playfully among the tall grasses of this rolling meadow country.  The thorny undergrowth takes its toll on cloth garments and exposed flesh.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Valley]
description: The tall grasses recede as you near a line of pine trees which have been spared the axe.  Dense undergrowth now blocks the trail and moonlight must work to find its path through the treelimbs.
The tall grasses recede as you near a line of pine trees which have been spared the axe.  Dense undergrowth now blocks the trail and sunlight must work to find its path through the treelimbs.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: As the trail climbs slowly out of the valley through the soft scent of pines, small stones mark the way, their larger kin disrupting the roots of the trees that loom overhead.  Clear tracks in the loam indicate other creatures have traveled this way.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: The trail splits here.  The southeast path goes more steeply uphill, while the southwest path looks both more inviting, and better traveled.  A large sphinx moth flutters around a tree next to the trail leading north, its rapidly beating wings a stark contrast to the quiet serenity that dominates the view.

The trail splits here.  The southeast path goes more steeply uphill, while the southwest path looks both more inviting, and better traveled.  A butterfly lands on a tree next to the trail leading north, and its softly waving wings splatter color beyond the greens and browns that dominate the view.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: The path rises quickly underfoot.  A cool breeze wafts through the trees, carrying an unidentified odor.  The trees seem taller here, with the trunks increasing in size as well.  A twilight of calm settles around you.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: A flash of motion may be an owl, but in the gloom it moves too quickly to be identifiable.  The trees crowd in together, as if to block any vision beyond the next few feet.  A trickle of water breaks through the rocks beside the path, but is barely enough to keep the moss wet.

A flash of motion above reveals a swooping bird, snacking on the bugs hovering in the air.  The trees crowd in together, as if to block any vision beyond the next few feet.  A trickle of water breaks through the rocks beside the path, but is barely enough to keep the moss wet.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: The trees seem to press into the path, with seemingly malicious intent.  The scrub under the trees is almost gone, with the thickness of the limbs above closing out most of the moonlight.  The quiet here is oppressive, and the feeling of being watched is inescapable.

The trees seem to press into the path, with seemingly malicious intent.  The scrub under the trees is almost gone, with the thickness of the limbs above closing out most direct light.  The quiet here is oppressive, and the feeling of being watched is inescapable.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: The path bends around a huge boulder.  The rock face is covered with lichen, and water drips slowly down its face to puddle at the bottom in a morass of mud.  Mosquitoes fly about the rock, along with other bugs which seem to be drawn to your body heat.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: The path is level here, allowing a small breather.  The quiet of the forest pervades the area, with only buzzing from insects and the occasional hooting of an owl from the distance.  A flowering bush leans against the closest tree trunk, its dusky perfume filling the air.

The path is level here, allowing a small breather.  The quiet of the forest pervades the area, with only buzzing from insects and the occasional call of a bird from the distance.  A flowering bush leans against the closest tree trunk, its dusky perfume filling the air.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: The trees overhead are thin here, allowing brief glimpses of the sky above.  The footing is rocky, limiting any spare thoughts for the beauty of this place.  To the north, through the boles of the trees, you see a glen.

title: [The Slope, Forest Path]
description: The footing remains rocky.  The buzzing of insects fills the air, and although you can hear the burbling of a small brook, the brush beneath the trees keeps you from finding it.
The footing remains rocky.  The chirp of birds fills the air, and although you can hear the burbling of a small brook, the brush beneath the trees keeps you from finding it.

title: [The Slope, Forest Path]
description: Surrounding foliage cools the air as the trees reach for the heights.  The tracks of the smaller inhabitants of the forest appear here and there on the trail.

title: [The Slope, Lava Bridge]
description: With walls rising sharply out of the ground, a natural bridge appears to the southwest.  The walls themselves are curved, giving the impression it may have been a lava tube at one time, but the top has collapsed, leaving it open to the weather.  The path to the northeast moves quickly into the waiting forest.

title: [The Slope, Lava Bridge]
description: The bridge itself appears to be the remains of a lave tube, as on each side huge walls block any view of what might be below.  The walls themselves are jagged and appear to be sharp.
The bridge itself appears to be the remains of a lava tube, as on each side huge walls block any view of what might be below.  The walls themselves are jagged and appear to be sharp.

title: [The Slope, Outcropping]
description: To the northeast appears a natural stone bridge, while the path leads down the outcropping, following the natural erosion ridges in the rock.

title: [The Slope, Outcropping]
description: The large mass of rock stands above you with the path working its way down its face.  To the west, the path follows the rim of the canyon precariously.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Rim]
description: The path comes close to the rim of the canyon here, close enough to give a good view of the bottom of the canyon.  An owl circles, silhouetted against the night sky.  To the northwest, there is a small stand of trees, while to the east, a large outcropping hides the way.

The path comes close to the rim of the canyon here, close enough to give a good view of the bottom of the canyon.  A screech of a hunting hawk rings through the air.  To the northwest, there is a small stand of trees, while to the east, a large outcropping hides the way.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Rim]
description: Coolness pervades this quiet glen, and the trees block the moonlight, casting the area into darkness.  From the bushes to the west, small bugs chirp quietly.
Coolness pervades this quiet glen, the trees shading the area from direct sunlight.  From the bushes to the west, small bugs chirp quietly.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Rim]
description: A large boulder stands solidly by the rim.  The trail moves into the trees to the north, and follows the rim of the canyon to the southeast.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Rim]
description: The path switches direction along the edge of the canyon here, with the trees leaning in overhead, as if to catch each ray of moonlight before it falls into the chasm.
The path switches direction along the edge of the canyon here, with the trees leaning in overhead, as if to catch each ray of light before it falls into the chasm.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Rim]
description: The path follows along the edge of the canyon, skirting between the trees and the rim itself.  Fireflies flit along nearby, their blinkings giving the only cheery aspect to the path.  A faint touch of smoke rises with the breeze that wafts up out of the depths.

The path follows along the edge of the canyon, skirting between the trees and the rim itself.  Birds sweep along nearby, feeding on the bugs that float there.  A faint touch of smoke rises with the breeze that wafts up out of the depths.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Rim]
description: Looking out over the lip of the canyon, the moonlit view is spectacular.  Trees line both rims, and below, huge boulders sprout at random out of the brush that fills the floor.  A path leads along the rim to the west, while a small ledge, barely wide enough to travel, moves down the cliff face into the depths below.

Looking out over the lip of the canyon, the view is spectacular.  Trees line both rims, and below, huge boulders sprout at random out of the brush that fills the floor.  A path leads along the rim to the west, while a small ledge, barely wide enough to travel, moves down the cliff face into the depths below.

title: [The Slope, Ledge]
description: This close to the canyon top, the view of the brush surrounding the huge stones that litter the entire width of the canyon floor is still clear, although the brush is too thick to make out any details of any trails that might be there.

title: [The Slope, Ledge]
description: Roughly half way along the cliff wall, the ledge switches back suddenly, the footing treacherous.  A small lizard peers out from a crevice, its unblinking eye watching your passage.

title: [The Slope, Ledge]
description: Small bushes cling to the cracks along the ledge.  Below lies the floor of the canyon, while high above looms the rim.
Small bushes cling to the cracks along the ledge.  Below lies the floor of the canyon, while high above looms the rim.  A bird flies by, its screeching cry an effort to protect the nearby nest.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: A tang of smoke follows the eddies of the breeze along the bottom of the canyon.  The rock formations tower above the brush, obscuring any view of the path as it moves to the north, while to the southwest, the path climbs up a ledge on the cliff face.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: The smell of smoke is strong in the eddies of the wind along the canyon wall here.  A fire pit filled with charred logs is the obvious culprit, but any evidence of who might have used it unclear.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: A large outcropping from the canyon wall looms above you.  The smell of smoke is strong here, but no evidence of where it has come from can be found.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: The path turns in on itself here, following the outcropping in the canyon wall.  Small feathers litter the path, and looking up, nests can be seen nestled in to the face.  No sound can be heard above the wind, however.

The path turns in on itself here, following the outcropping in the canyon wall.  Small feathers litter the path, and looking up, nests can be seen nestled in to the face.  The faint peeping of young birds can be heard above the wind.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: The path continues around some large stones to the northwest, while following the contours of an outcropping in the canyon wall to the west.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: Smaller boulders are mixed in with the huge stones here, making the footing even more treacherous.  The path continues to follow the contours of each large rock, moving across the way from one to another.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: A tang of smoke faintly wafts in from the south.  No clear view can be seen around the rocks, and it is unclear which way to go.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: Moving around in this maze would be easier for a drake, who could use each large boulder as a stepping stone.  The walls of the canyon appear to be turning, the wall face twisting in to the west and to the south, while the path still wanders around each huge boulder.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: Picking a way around these stones is not easy, but the path is clearly marked, as many appear to have taken this same path.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: Huge boulders block any easy passage, and the path winds carefully around each rock.  Any sight of what may be ahead is blocked by these stones and the walls of the canyon.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: Huge boulders block any easy passage, and the path winds carefully around each rock.  Any sight of what may be ahead is blocked by these stones and the walls of the canyon.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: Forcing the path back and forth, the walls loom closer.  The underbrush is almost nonexistent here, with only the smallest plants clinging to the rocks.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: High above the path, a natural stone bridge crosses from one side to the other.  Bird nests hug the cliff face, almost invisible in the shadow cast against the wall by the stone arch above.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: The walls of the canyon loom over the path, leaning in to see what is occurring within their domain.  The vegetation crowds into the path, plucking at all who pass.

title: [The Slope, Canyon Floor]
description: On either side of the path, stone walls raise up, with the brush leaning against them.  To the southeast, the walls seem to get higher, while to the northwest, only more shrubs can be seen.

title: [The Slope, Thicket]
description: The thicket guides the path along the terrain here, pushing in as if to close off any passage.

title: [The Slope, Thicket]
description: A thicket envelopes the rocky path, tall enough to block any view.  Small trees dot the area, but they are thin and scraggly.

title: [The Slope, Forest Path]
description: The trees are not tall here, obviously in need of additional nutrition.  Their roots gnarl around the rocks, as if by their very grasp, they can wring food from the stones.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: Above, the canopy is thinning, giving an occasional glimpse of the stars above.  The rocks intrude on the path from below, requiring extra attention to the footing.
Above, the canopy is thinning, giving an occasional glimpse of the sky above.  The rocks intrude on the path from below, requiring extra attention to the footing.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: Moving around the trees, the path meanders back and forth, clearly following the path of least resistance through the brush.  The smell of forest decay fills the air.

title: [The Slope, Cliff Top]
description: While large trees line the ledge, the view below is inspiring, the verdant green spreading northwards towards the sea.  To the east a path leads through the forest towards an opening in the trees.  Along the ledge you see a series of steps that appear to have been carved into the face of the rock.  A breeze from the ocean reaches here, bringing a faint smell of saltwater to mix with the odor of the forest.

title: [The Slope, Glen]
description: The trees open up above this glen, giving a welcome view of the constellations above.  The grass grows tall on either side of the path, almost hiding the small brook where water moves quietly along its course.  On the edge of the glen, massive stones stand in a circle.

The trees open up above this glen, giving a welcome view of the sky above.  The grass grows tall on either side of the path, almost hiding the small brook where water moves quietly along its course.  On the edge of the glen, massive stones stand in a circle.

title: [The Slope, Cliff Bottom]
description: A cliff rises through the treetops here, and rude steps have been carved into its face, leading upwards.  Beside the bottom of the cliff is a cairn, but it is hard to tell whether this cairn marks the final resting place of a fellow explorer, or is just the refuse of the stonework completed in the cliff face.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: The trees obscure any view above, but the rustling in the underbrush is more than enough to capture attention. The complete lack of normal forest sounds is disconcerting, as the expected cry of the bird or the buzz of the insects never comes.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: Gnarled tree branches seem to grasp lower in a vain attempt to reach the trail.  The trees themselves seem to thicken, reaching ever higher in an effort to reach the sky.  The brush on the forest floor impedes any sight beyond the next turn in the trail.

Gnarled tree branches seem to grasp lower in a vain attempt to reach the trail.  The trees themselves seem to thicken, reaching ever higher in an effort to reach the sun.  The brush on the forest floor impedes any sight beyond the next turn in the trail.

title: [The Slope, Forest Trail]
description: The trail ambles below the boughs of the trees. Their age is evident in the substantial girth and height.  The underbrush is thick as well, making an excellent hiding place for the denizens of the forest to live out their lives unseen.  The hunting calls of the predators and the rustling of the leaves in the breeze fill the night air.

The trail ambles below the boughs of the trees. Their age is evident in the substantial girth and height.  The underbrush is thick as well, making an excellent hiding place for the denizens of the forest to live out their lives unseen.  The calls of the birds and the rustling of the leaves in the breeze fill the air.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Moving between the shallow hills, the tall grass bends slightly under foot, leaving the trail behind.  The steady sound of the wind muffles the usual sounds of nature that one would expect in this wilderness country.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Trees and more trees is the predominant feature of this hilly place. Your footsteps are heard by all as twigs crackle beneath each step you take.

title: [Valley]
description: Each footstep is swallowed by the sea of grass that flows across the meadows and hills around you.  High above you see gulls dancing on the ocean breezes.

title: [Valley]
description: The tall grasses that adorn the hillside appear to be in perpetual motion.  You leave a narrow trail of bent grass in your wake as you glide between the sometimes man tall flora.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forested Path]
description: This wide natural path runs through the surrounding forest in a straight north-south line.  Towering pine trees loom ominously over the path on both sides.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forested Path]
description: Here a narrow brook crosses the path.  The water in the swiftly flowing brook is crystal clear and icy cold.  You pause to listen to the natural babble of the brook and the counterpoint of the birds singing in the trees.

Here a narrow brook crosses the path.  The water in the swiftly flowing brook is crystal clear and icy cold.  You pause to listen to the natural babble of the brook and the chirps of sleeping birds from the trees.  The night air is cool, filled with the smell of clean water and musty leaves.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forested Path]
description: A boulder stands comically to one side of the path, looking like a huge nose protruding from a mass of flowering vines.  The scent of the flowers is indeed sweet; no wonder the boulder wanted to smell them.  Here the path splits in several directions.  The path to the north is rougher, while the paths to the south and southeast appear to lead toward easier ground.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Path]
description: The path here is easy to follow, like taking a pleasant hike through a well kept forest.  You are brought back to harsh reality when you hear the angry buzzing of a nearby hornets nest and are reminded that there are more dangers in the wilds than are often considered.

The path here is easy to follow, like taking a pleasant hike through a well kept forest.  From nearby a muted buzzing can be heard, as a number of hornets try in vain to settle in their nest for the night.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Path]
description: You are following the path along a high ridge.  The thinning trees give you an occasional view to the northeast, looking down over a dense forest.  The forest below seems to be enshrouded in the silvery mist of a low lying fog.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Fork in Path]
description: You have come to a fork in the path.  The northeast leg seems to plunge steeply down into denser forest.  The southeast leg climbs slightly but steadily to higher elevations.  The northwest leg seems to follow a ridge into thinner forest.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Winding Path]
description: This path leads from the lower lands of the northwest up into the foothills of the east.  The path wanders and winds in and between trees and large boulders; you are soon winded by all the extra walking and climbing.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Winding Path]
description: The winding path leads from the sparse forest of the highlands to the east to the denser forest down to the west.  You can hear the playful sounds of a pair of bear cubs playing nearby.  You shudder a little and hope that the mamma bear is occupied elsewhere.

The winding path leads from the sparse forest of the highlands to the east to the denser forest down to the west.  In the dim moonlight you can make out several gashes on the nearby trees.  Apparently, this is bear territory.

title: [Valley]
description: From this hillcrest you can see much of the middle meadowlands and the hilly crests above the city of Wehnimer's Landing.  Rocky ledges lie to the northeast with the meadows in every other direction.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Valley]
description: This shallow run is littered with large boulders that lead up to a stone wall to the west.  Animal bones, bleached by the intense sun, lay in a pile near the wall.

title: [Helden Hall, Workshop]
description: Your pulse pounds and your skin tingles from the essence-saturated contents of this room.  Images of weapons come to mind, fashioned from many different exotic ores being molded and sharpened to a degree you have only dreamed of.  A large table sits in the center of the room, containing every imaginable type of item.  A chest rests against the far wall and a pedal-driven whetstone takes up a full corner of the room

Your pulse pounds and your skin tingles from the essence-saturated contents of this room.  Images of weapons come to mind, fashioned from many different exotic ores being molded and sharpened to a degree you have only dreamed of.  A large table sits in the center of the room, containing every imaginable type of item.  A chest rests against the far wall and a pedal-driven whetstone takes up a full corner of the room.

title: [Wooded Path]
description: The tall pines standing majestically on either side of the path provide a thick canopy overhead, from which birdsong can be heard in a continuous chorus.  At the forest's foot, giant ferns cascade down the trail's embankments in a deep emerald drift of fronds.  An occasional patch of light winning through the layered branches dapples the trail, which twists and turns through the luxuriant foliation.

The tall pines standing majestically on either side of the path provide a thick canopy overhead, from which can be heard the occasional sleepy chirp of a bird.  At the forest's foot, giant ferns cascade down the trail's embankments in a deep emerald drift of fronds.  An occasional patch of moonlight winning through the layered branches dapples the trail, which twists and turns through the luxuriant foliation.

title: [Wooded Path]
description: The path curves like a serpent, the smooth half-hidden stones in it forming a stippled pattern of brown, ochre and grey.  Ferns crowd the edges, sending their furred ivory runners snaking across the trail's way as if seeking an embrace.  The crisp, sweet smell of the pines creates a tranquil perfume punctuated by the clean smell of the loamy soil.

title: [Wooded Path]
description: At the verdant feet of an incredibly large growth of the ferns, the dwindling path abruptly ends.  The pines have withdrawn a few paces, growing in a symmetrical ring that creates an intimate glade.  Rich mosses and clover provide a soft carpet dotted here and there with tiny white blossoms.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Sunny Path]
description: Underbrush gives way to thick meadow grass where the trail begins a steep ascent.  A tall hill fills the southeastern horizon, its gentle slopes adorned with patches of green and gold pasturage.  Dwellings are visible, nestled on the slopes in colorful groups, their sod roofs blending with the hill's thick mantle of grass.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Grassy Knoll]
description: The trail turns, giving egress to a wide plateau, which is bejeweled with a pond that sparkles in the sunlight.  Birds wheel overhead, diving occasionally to alight near the water.  Cottages cluster in groups around the pool, some boasting picket fences and most decorated with gardens and brightly painted shutters.

The trail turns, giving egress to a wide plateau, which is bejeweled with a pond that sparkles in the moonlight.  Cottages cluster in groups around the pool, some boasting picket fences and most decorated with gardens and brightly painted shutters.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Sunny Meadow]
description: The trail splits, each branch offering an opposite perambulation of the pond.  Halflings saunter by on their short legs, calling greetings to the open windows of houses as they pass.  A gaggle of ducks is clustered on the grassy bank of the pond.  The birds waddle in and out of the water, intent upon duckish pursuits.  One brown duck guards a little cluster of ducklings, and the chicks' adamant pips constantly harangue the mother.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Pond Stroll]
description: The cobblestone walk parallels the bank of Hummingbird Pond, edged with a lush border of red and white zinnias.  Cottages line up side by side, with flowers blooming on their sod roofs like blossoms woven into a halfling's hair.  Access to the buildings is gained through doors that are perfectly round, giving the homes a slight ambiance of surprise.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, North Bank]
description: Hummingbird Pond's north bank is lush with flowers and ferns.  A large blackberry bush sits right next to the water, its surface covered with a shifting, fluttering cloud of butterflies.  Honey bees visiting the thick patches of clover growing around the prickly bush provide a constant hum.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Pond Stroll]
description: The cobblestone road courts the edge of Hummingbird Pond, then veers deceitfully away to follow the slope of a hummock.  Quaint cottages camp alongside the avenue, sending delectable aromas wafting from open windows.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Bridgeunder]
description: An arched bridge spans the avenue.  Halflings crossing overhead stop occasionally to peer down over the rail in curiosity.  The underside of the bridge is decorated with a painted mural depicting a festival of some sort, celebrated with a bountiful feast.  Halflings munch cheerfully on all sorts of roasted meats and pastries.  Houses crowd next to the bridge's elegantly carved pilings, lending charm to the bridge's belly.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Bridgeunder]
description: The cul-de-sac is dominated by the ornate bridge arching overhead.  Beneath it, a cluster of houses grow like mushrooms at the foot of the pilings, every square foot of ground around them planted with flowering gardens.  Honeysuckle vines climb the ladder of the bridge's underpinnings,  spicing the air with their sweet perfume.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Path]
description: A bend in the path here marks a significant change in the terrain.  To the south, the trees are much thicker and the ground less rocky.  To the northeast, the trees are somewhat thinner and the ground rougher, with large rocks and boulders protruding from the underbrush in many spots.  The rising foothills to the east are barely discernible through the thinning trees.

A bend in the path here marks a significant change in the terrain.  To the south, the trees are much thicker and the ground less rocky.  To the northeast, the trees are somewhat thinner and the ground rougher, with large rocks and boulders protruding from the underbrush in many spots.  The rising foothills to the east are barely visible in the darkness.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Path]
description: A huge log lies across the path here.  As rough as this path has been and considering all the boulders that you have been climbing over and around, this isn't really an obstacle.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Path]
description: The path makes a hairpin turn here, following the contour of the hills rising before you.  The rock-strewn path leads more or less downward in both directions, but there is also a faint trail leading up into the foothills.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forested Path]
description: The forested area to the south appears to be much more dense than the area to the northeast.  Following the path downhill to the south seems to be a much easier path than going north up into the foothills.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Clearing]
description: Suddenly coming across this small clearing is a pleasant surprise after traveling through the dim surrounding forest.  When you first stepped into the clearing you caught a glimpse of a brace of playful rabbits that scampered away into the underbrush as soon as you intruded into their private playground.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Path]
description: You cannot see very far through the dense trees of this forest.  There is no hint of the foothills that you know rise somewhere in this area.
You cannot see very far through the dense trees of this forest and the nocturnal gloom.  There is no hint of the foothills that you know rise somewhere in this area.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Path]
description: You can occasionally hear the rustle of movement through the underbrush.  There is an abundance of small game throughout this forest.  A professional hunter could make a good living here.

The nighttime forest is quiet, devoid of the wildlife that must romp here during the day.  An occasional rustle in the underbrush startles you, leaving you to wonder what kind of creature might roam the darkness around you.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Path]
description: While the path does not have a really steep grade, it is obvious that traveling to the south takes you up hill, while travel to the northwest is an easier walk down to lower ground.  The natural path meanders, first one direction, then another, making a way around and between the natural obstacles of large boulders and trees.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Path]
description: The path slopes steeply downhill to the north, and up to the high ground in the southwest.  High overhead you can hear the cry of a solitary hawk, probably out hunting up a meal.
The path slopes steeply downhill to the north, and up to the high ground in the southwest.  High overhead stretches a vault of stars, parts blotted out by the occasional cloud.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Winding Path]
description: Standing on a high ridge, you can see a lush valley before you to the north.  A trail to the southeast leads deeper into the foothills, down into denser forest.  The path to the west leads gently downhill.  Dense bushes grow along the edges of the trail, making it difficult to see into the forest.

title: [Valley]
description: You are surrounded by a circle of trees with an ancient oak in its center.  The oak is carved with many small ornate symbols and a few wood carvings are tied to limbs high above you.

title: [Mine]
description: There is a black doorway supported by wooden pillars in the face of the hill.  The grass grows tall around mounds of crushed rocks and various rusted tools are scattered about the ground.

title: [Valley]
description: You are at the crest of a group of rolling hills beneath the ridge line of Upper Trollfang.  A sea of hills moves with grassy waves from the swift ocean breezes.

title: [Mine]
description: This passage is very dim, but it is wide enough for two people to stand abreast between the wooden supports.  The light fades as you look northward down the long passageway and dark recesses are easily discerned a few yards away.

title: [Mine]
description: A large boulder blocks the middle of the tunnel here.  In the ceiling above is a jagged hole where it was ripped away from the native stone of the mountain.

title: [Mine]
description: To the west is a rough opening to another tunnel which looks cavelike and lacks the shoring timbers as in the passageway where you stand.

title: [Mine]
description: The wide passage continues north and south, but an eastern tunnel is readily visible as you examine the hewn rock walls along which you travel.

title: [Mine]
description: The wide passage continues north and south along the rubble-strewn shaft.  In some places rock piles lay abandoned and force you to walk on one side of the passage or the other.

title: [Mine]
description: A wide opening in the western wall is partially blocked by fallen timbers.  Dust trickles from the ceiling as some of the shoring desperately needs repair.  This north-south passage you stand in seems unaffected.

title: [Mine]
description: This passage continues from north to south.  A narrow opening in the wall on the east side of the tunnel reveals a narrow, well-mined ore vein on the eastern wall.

title: [Mine]
description: The wide tunnel continues north and south along this rubble-strewn passage.  In some places rock piles impede your progress and cause you to walk on one side of the passage or the other.

title: [Mine]
description: The north-south passage continues but a wide opening in the wall on the east side of the tunnel shows a wide opening to a natural cavern.  There are small rocks strewn about the floor but none of any size.

title: [Mine]
description: The tunnel slopes slightly upward towards the northern end and you can hear the sounds of fluttering wings coming from the north.  The floor of the passage is slippery and there is an unsettling absence of rubble here.

title: [Mine]
description: The ceiling takes an abrupt upward swing revealing an expansive natural cavern.  The formations of stalactites on the cavern's ceiling provide a wonderous race course as thousands of bats glide between the rocky pillars.

title: [Mine]
description: The floor is covered with guano which makes footing unsure as you make your way between the stalagmites.  The sounds from the bats above you grow louder as you sense that they are disturbed by your presence.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest, up

title: [Mine]
description: The guano is deep here and you see a deep crevice nearby, but the maze of stalagmites is confusing your excellent sense of direction.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Mine]
description: The floor is covered with guano which makes footing unsure as you make your way between the stalagmites.  The sounds from the bats above you grow louder as you sense that they are disturbed by your presence.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Mine]
description: The flat cave wall here is carved and painted in muddled colors in what appears to be a early primitive art masterpiece.  Or maybe it was created by a cloudy headed, frustrated adventurer like yourself.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Mine]
description: The sound of dripping calcium-laden cave water is pervasive as you now understand how this forest of stalagmites came into being.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Mine]
description: This natural cavern is tall but not very deep and the floor is covered with pine branches that have been dragged in from the hillside of the Upper Trollfang outside of the mine.

title: [Mine]
description: A large pile of rocks is carefully stacked against the northern wall of the cavern.  The rocks have been sorted by size and what appears to be color as well.  There are empty sacks on the floor which are in good condition.

title: [Mine]
description: Bones lay strewn about the floor and rock tools which could be used for mining ore are piled in an area near the cavern entrance.  The floor is unusually clear of any rock debris but animal hides also litter the floor.

title: [Mine]
description: A rather large boulder lays on the floor near the eastern edge of the room and you can see a ledge above the room in the southern wall with a set of stone steps cut into the rock face there.

title: [Mine]
description: You carefully move between the fallen timbers and wisely choose your footsteps in this rubble-filled opening.  It reveals a much larger room to the west and a wide passage to the east.

title: [Mine]
description: Rubble fills the majority of this section of the mine and it is difficult to move between the fallen timbers.  Rocks of all sizes lay piled in your path making your footing treacherous.

title: [Mine]
description: Rubble fills the majority of this area and it is difficult to move between the fallen timbers.  A large rock pile makes it impossible for you to move any farther west.

title: [Mine]
description: Rubble fills most of this cavernous space you occupy and it is difficult to see past the fallen pillars or to move between them without disturbing them and bringing down the rest of the rocky roof.
Rubble fills most of this cavernous space you occupy and it is difficult to see past the pillars or to move between them without disturbing them and bringing down the rest of the rocky roof.

title: [Mine]
description: The passage is well shorn with timbers but the ceiling is low compared to the other passages.  You notice an odd stench that has not been present in the rest of this mine.

title: [Mine]
description: Various bits of rubble litter the ground of this place, giving you mind to watch your step.  The ceiling supports are much newer in here than in other parts of the cavern, and to your relief, look much sturdier.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Mine]
description: You are at the western edge of this cavern and the walls appear to have been forcedly carved from the rock hillside.  The sturdy timbers above relieve your fears that this place could become the image of the previous rock-filled chamber.

title: [Mine]
description: At the northern edge of this cavern, the walls appear to have been laboriously carved from the rock hillside.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Mine]
description: You are at the northeastern edge of this cavern and the walls appear to have been laboriously carved from the rock hillside.  The number of timbers in place remind you that the room is a man made creation rather than a natural chamber.

title: [Mine]
description: You are at the eastern edge of this cavern where the walls have been gouged in a way that suggests it has been hand-carved from the rock hillside.  The numerous unused ceiling timbers standing up against one wall give you the impression of standing in an underground forest of square trees.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Mine]
description: Standing in the center of this part of the mine seems to be the safest thing to do, as the ceiling timbers at either end are bowing considerably, while the one directly above you looks rather sturdy.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Mine]
description: Rubble fills the majority of the room and it is difficult to move between the fallen timbers.  Rocks of all sizes lay piled in your path making your footing unsure.

title: [Mine]
description: The walls expand to reveal a large chamber which seems to have been naturally constructed.  Rock shafts hang from the ceiling and are covered with veils of what looks like a cotton-like substance.

title: [Mine]
description: You disturb thick sticky webs which connect the ceiling of this chamber and the floor.  The floor of this chamber is littered with rubble to which the webs are attached. You can easily break the webs but your sight is impaired.

title: [Mine]
description: The webs grow thick, and you must struggle to break them as they are more firmly attached at this point to the floor and curved rock walls of the chamber.  You see the carcass of a giant rat floating in the white cloud-like webs above.

title: [Mine]
description: The webs thin as you reach the end of this large curved chamber.  Hanging from the ceiling are various sized cocoons made from the same sticky webs that you see covering the ceiling above you.  Trash litters the floor of the chamber.

title: [Mine]
description: The webs grow thick, and you must struggle to break them as they are more firmly attached in this place to the floor and curved rock walls of the chamber.  You see the carcass of a giant rat floating in the white cloud-like webs above.

title: [Hillside, Trail]
description: This small trail snakes up a verdant hillside.  A copse of pine trees lies below, barring your view of the rest of the valley.  Hiking this trail is quite invigorating, and you can hardly wait to get started again.

title: [Hillside, Trail]
description: The trail stops its persistent climb up the hill, and you can see it veer southward up ahead.  Stunted, small-leafed bushes lean in on the trail in an attempt to reclaim it.  Below you can see a valley filled with tall, swaying grass.  The wavy grass makes the valley seem like an extension of the barely visible dark waters of Darkstone Bay.

title: [Hillside, Crest]
description: From this barren crest you can look down into a small, beautiful vale that lies to the east.  The slopes going down into the vale are covered with flowering bushes.  The heavy fragrance of the dark-orange flowers makes you feel light-headed and light-hearted.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Slope]
description: Prickly bushes dominate the slopes -- their dark-orange flowers attracting countless butterflies and honeybees.  The colors are so vibrant, you almost feel like you're walking in a field of fire.  The flowery slope ends abruptly further down, as it crashes into a dark forest.

Prickly bushes dominate the slopes -- their dark-orange flowers attracting countless fireflies.  The colors are so vibrant, you can distinguish them easily in the moonlight.  The flowery slope ends abruptly further down, as it crashes into a dark forest.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: Large fir trees tower over the fern-covered, mossy ground.  Strange vines climb up some of the larger trees, their scaly leaves stirring as if caught in a breeze.

title: [Graveyard, Crypt]
description: This room is a square space with plain stone walls on three sides composed of virtually seamless granite blocks.  The far wall draws your attention immediately.  Before it stands a black onyx tablet, nearly tall enough to touch the flat ceiling.
