title: [Graveyard, Crypt]
description: This room holds niches and chests filled with dusty tomes, yellowing scrolls and brittle manuscripts.  The scrolls are fastened with sealing wax and silk ribbons, while the volumes are bound in rare leathers.  Although fragile from the passage of time, the dry atmosphere of the tomb has preserved them.  The documents arouse your interest but the fear that they may contain evil spells and dangerous knowledge prompts you to leave them be.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: On this rocky beach stands the northeast corner of Wehnimer's Landing.  Gazing off to the north you see the great rolling waters of the Darkstone Bay while to the east can be seen the rolling hills and high plateaus that skirt the icy waters.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You are standing on the eastern shore of the Locksmehr River at the point where it rushes out of the great river gates of Wehnimer's Landing.  The twin guard towers that protect the gates rise far above the beach, perhaps as much as fifty feet above the level of the water.  The heavy sea gates that span the river have been magnificently crafted so that they can be closed quickly and easily to prevent unwanted intrusions by seafaring craft.

title: [Emerald Level, Central Shaft]
description: Four different tunnels can be accessed from this central shaft area.  None of the passageways are well lit, as each of the shafts are illuminated by only a few sparse torches.  A ladder ascends to the upper levels.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Emerald Level, Northwest Shaft]
description: This portion of the passage is considerably wider than most, and seems to be under repair.  Thick planks of wood are piled up on one side, while crates filled with wire and tools are lined up against the other.  Two carpenters are looking over a parchment, both with looks of confusion etched on their faces.

title: [Emerald Level, Northwest Shaft]
description: A single dwarf is sitting up against the wall, muttering words best not heard by children or the faint of heart.  He is holding a badly damaged pickaxe in one hand.  At his feet is a shard of stone, granite by the looks of it.

title: [Emerald Level, Northwest Shaft]
description: The cavern's ceiling is dotted with stalactites of various hues, creating an odd yet captivating underground landscape.  Passage through this area can be treacherous for non-dwarven folks, as one must be as careful with the loose rocks and uneven walking surface as well as the cave formations overhead.

title: [Emerald Level, Corridor]
description: Naturally formed stalactites and stalagmites give way to the ironwood bracings of an artificial tunnel.  Where torchlight streaming from farther up the passage strikes the ground, the stone appears to be a dusky green-grey shade, though it seems perfectly black in shadow.

title: [Emerald Level, Corridor]
description: Broken pieces of rock crunch underfoot at the base of the passage, but, as the tunnel rises to the northeast, the hard fragments give way to the distinctive streaks of a broom's passage traversing mining dust upon the stony floor.  Twin burning torches shed brilliant yellow light at the top of the passage, and a massive pair of blue mithril doors set between the torches blocks access to whatever lies beyond.

title: [Emerald Level, Morgue]
description: The tiny room is simple, but clean, although the limited size will make it a challenge to store more than one or two dead bodies at one time.  A pair of short, but wide, metal slab tables placed up against the walls are unoccupied at the moment.

title: [Emerald Level, Southwest Shaft]
description: Miners crowd the tunnel, most looking over a jagged vein along one wall.  The ore doesn't look particularly impressive, but perhaps it is evidence of a richer deposit nearby.  Two of the dwarves, evidently supervisors, shout out orders and delegate work details.

title: [Good Eats]
description: A variety of rich and hearty scents mingle in the air to create one flavorful aroma of roasted meats, vegetables, and nuts.  Flames crackle in the open-faced oven set into the back wall of the shop, the smoke and ash drawn up through the flue above, while a wood stove sits by topped with an iron pot of boiling soup.  Occupying the heart of the room, a long linen-covered table is arranged with a myriad of edibles for sale.

title: [Good Eats, Niche]
description: Set back away from the stove, the air here is cool, but no less aromatic.  A low wooden counter topped with a narrow linen runner holds a display of dried foods, and a nearby table offers a selection of breads and miscellaneous items.  A small wax paper pouch hangs from a single iron hook above the table.

title: [Armor Accoutrements, Entry]
description: Narrow panels of finely woven wool suspended from the reinforcing beams overhead do little to hide the rough packed walls of this small room.  The ceiling is set so low that only the shortest patrons can browse the wares without stooping.  The opening that provides entry to the shop stands opposite a tall stand peppered with helms of various sorts.  Two passageways, leading deeper into the shop, flank the stand.

title: [Armor Accoutrements, Side Room]
description: A wall of rock, too dense to hollow out further, forms two walls of this showroom, creating a rough triangular shape that makes the viewing of wares for sale on a large stand difficult.  The crowd shuffles in an oval formation, allowing each patron a chance to make their way in front of the stand and purchase an aventail, if they find one to their liking.  Those having difficulty making a decision are forced to make their way through the odd dance multiple times.

title: [Armor Accoutrements, Side Room]
description: A sheet of solid rock forms one wall of this showroom, its craggy surface a stark contrast to the smoothed and packed dirt on the facing walls.  Spikes of iron have been driven into the stone to allow the suspension of colorful wool panels, lending a bit of warmth to the otherwise cool atmosphere.  A large stand covered with greaves takes up the wall opposite the passageway to the main area of the shop.  A densely woven rug of burgundy, navy, and gold pattern decorates the floor.

title: [Emerald Level, Southwest Shaft]
description: The sound of a forge can be heard in a nearby room, the clang of metal on metal echoing loudly down the passage.  The noise borders on annoying, but there is an odd musical quality to it as well.  An aproned apprentice hustles by, a large bucket of steaming water in one hand.

title: [Warm Corner, Food Counter]
description: This earthen corner of the mine extends far into the distance, the back wall obscured by hazy smoke that hovers over the busy dwarves crowded around pot-topped cooking stoves.  Despite the close confines of the area, customers have packed themselves in, exchanging silvers with the clerk for warm food and a mug of tantalizing cider.  A few intrepid souls remain in the corner to consume their purchases, but most escape as soon as they can to the relatively cooler freedom of the passage.

title: [Stowin' Stuffs]
description: Mid-chest stacks of unopened storage boxes line the far walls of this cave.  The flickering candlelight from a few sporadically placed candles reflects from glittering ore within the walls, giving the illusion of starlight.  Closest to the entrance, a large wooden strongbox and a heavy steel chest have been left open.  A small iron box and a massive mithril strongbox have been placed close together in the center of the floor.  A few items have also been tossed on top of an unopened storage box.

title: [Emerald Level, Southwest Shaft]
description: A vultite door surrounded by a pair of intensely bright torches signals the end of this portion of the shaft.  Two crossed jewel-hilted daggers have been inset into the door, rendered unopenable for the moment due to a broken beam overhead from the caving ceiling.

title: [Emerald Level, Southeast Shaft]
description: A giant cobweb inhabited by a large spider with dull teal markings stretches across the ceiling beams.  A few cocooned prey are its only guests at the moment.  Fortunately, the arachnid isn't quite large enough to be worrisome.

title: [Luxury Leathers, Entrance]
description: The raw stone floor is scoured smooth to keep dust and debris to a minimum in this high-ceilinged cave.  Glaes-enclosed lanterns line the walls, which are painted with numerous colorful murals.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Luxury Leathers, Accessories]
description: This side of the cave is painted with a large mural of a celebration.  Long trestle tables are piled high with a variety of foods for a feast as dwarves of all ages participate in the revel.  Some are eating and drinking, while others dance in a big circle.

title: [Luxury, Robes and Tunics]
description: The back wall of the cave here contains a multitude of small murals in brilliant colors depicting dwarves hard at work in a wide variety of crafts including leatherworking and the forging of metals.  Centered low in the wall is a heavy leather curtain.

title: [Luxury Leathers, Armor]
description: Painted in amazing detail along the stone wall is a giant, colorful mural of a huge battle between dwarves and orcs in a gigantic cavern.  Lanterns set into carved niches cast a bright illumination over the leather armors on display.

title: [Emerald Level, Southeast Shaft]
description: This portion of the passage is worked out and clearly has been neglected for some time.  Rubbish is strewn across the floor, mostly discarded tools or old gear.  What might have been a decorative mug or bowl at one time is nothing more than shattered ceramic shards now.

title: [Tunnel's End]
description: The narrow tunnel opens into a spacious circular room with several small lit braziers illuminating the interior.  Several enormous moss-covered stalactites hang precariously from the ceiling, forming dark shadows along the walls.  The farside wall seem to be hidden by a curtain of colorful stalactites that drapes over the surface.  Niches have been carved along the remaining circumference of the room, and within them are set some inviting tables.

title: [Emerald Level, Southeast Shaft]
description: Thick wooden beams bar further passage down the tunnel.  The barrier is cracked outwardly in several places, as if something was trying to gain access from the opposite side.  A few more solid strikes, and the wall will likely collapse.

title: [Ruby Level, Emerald Access]
description: A sturdy ladder descends into the next level of the mine, the rungs thick and capable of holding even the stoutest giant.  A huge, but badly flawed, emerald is inset into the wall.  A disinterested dwarven sentry stands nearby.

title: [Strange Skins]
description: Along the jagged cavern walls of this expansive shop hang the mounted heads of various exotic creatures, each one staring ahead with a blank expression.  A thick striped fur rug stretches across the dusty floor, while unusual animal skins hang from hooks about the shop, waiting their turn to be tanned.  Postured about the room are candle pedestals of various heights, allowing the yellowish light to illuminate the many wares for sale.

title: [Strange Skins, Storage Room]
description: Stacked wooden crates of unopened merchandise have been piled about the room, leaving only a small walkway to maneuver.  Tiny tealight candles illuminate the narrow path through the middle of the room, casting grotesque shadows of the wandering customers along the various crates.

title: [Strange Skins, Backroom]
description: A rank odor, seemingly the combination of decaying flesh and tanning solution, wafts from the piles of animal skins stacked about the room.  Makeshift torches set a flickering glow against the crumbling cavern walls, as dwarven workers filter in and out of the area with supplies.  In the center of the room is a long wooden workbench strewn with tools and various tarnished metal objects.

title: [Blademistress, Entry]
description: Entering the hushed calm of this cavern, the mild scent of oiled leather wafts on the breeze.  A round oak table with delicate gold scrollwork covering the top is set in the center of the room, upon which rests a beige vellum placard.  Underfoot is a soft brown bearhide rug, while two distinctly female suits of armor stand sentry at the back corners.

title: [Blademistress, Battle-Wear]
description: Several rainbow glaes sconces are on each wall, providing enough light so that the wares in this room are clearly displayed.  Along the back wall is a row of three female mannequins, while a pair of rich leather armchairs sit opposite each other on the sides.  A small table of refreshments has been placed in the center, seemingly available to shoppers while they peruse.

title: [Blademistress, Final Touches]
description: A single wrought-iron rack stands in the middle of this room, while an oak display counter has been set against one wall.  A rather elaborate mithril fixture hangs from the ceiling, holding dozens of burning candles.  The otherwise smooth stone floor is covered by a pure white rabbit fur rug.

title: [Ruby Level, North Hall]
description: This portion of the mine widens quite a bit and is at least twice the span of the passages leading to it.  A pair of gleaming mithril swords hang on the wall, one pointing to the west, the other east.

title: [Ruby Level, Bottomless Pit]
description: An astoundingly deep shaft leads farther down into the mine, but the ladder is broken and no longer serviceable.  A fall from this height would surely be fatal.  A small sign is posted nearby.

title: [Brellech's Beadworks]
description: The small natural cavern is shored up at intervals with petrified wood beams carved in deep relief.  Leafy garlands spiral about a pair of stalagmites and fringe their cropped tops, which themselves are hollowed into basins filled with brightly colored beads.  Curtains of ribbons and dangling chips of semi-precious stone drape two wrought iron archways set into the northeastern and northwestern walls of the chamber.

title: [Brellech's Beadworks, Textiles]
description: Artful draperies of knotted yarn and bright stone beads festoon the wrought iron archway in the southeast wall.  Hundreds of ribbons and cords hang from gilded hooks in the striated stone walls, enclosing the cavern in a riot of mingled color and texture.  A standing iron brazier occupies the center of the chamber, and the flames that leap from it flare green and blue in turns.

title: [Brellech's Beadworks, Flora]
description: Ropes of woven ribbon and glittering beads are wound through the iron archway in the southwest wall.  Mithril mesh baskets hang from long chains anchored in the pitted stone ceiling, and each basket is overflowing with alpine flowers.  A trio of gilded iron sconces imbedded in the striated stone walls bears huge torches that illuminate the small cavern with flickering golden light.

title: [Heave Ho]
description: Sturdy frames of haon line this narrow cavern, probably from a previous mining expedition that discovered little of note down this path.  The current owner has nailed additional boards to the frame, as if uncertain about its ability to keep the roof overhead.  A free-standing rack and a low table face each other in the center of the area, alone aside from a clerk perched upon a stool.

title: [Ruby Level, East Hall]
description: Inset into the far wall is a magnificent invar shield trimmed with silver and gold accents.  It doesn't appear to ever have been used in battle.

title: [Defenders in the Dark]
description: Crusts of luminescent lichen cling to the walls.  Their frail green light barely reaches the floor, leaving heavy shadows that obscure the corners of the low, rough-hewn cavern.  A taciturn dwarf garbed in battle leathers stands beside a weapon rack.  His head is even with the middle ledge in a set of three ledges carved from the rock wall.  Except for the occasional shift of his gaze, he stands as still as a statue in the gloom.

title: [Fungus of the Gods]
description: Evenly spaced mullein torches create an intricate series of dancing shadows across the ore-embedded walls of the cavern.  Overhead, water seeps in from several cracks, generating an incessant dripping sound as droplets strike the surface of the puddle.  Scattered around the natural stalagmite in the center of the floor are cave bear hides.  Pushed against walls that are chock-full of nooks and crannies, are crates and boxes with the words "special fungus" branded in block letters.

title: [Ruby Level, Crystal Access]
description: A darkened shaft contains a ladder leading further down into the mine.  Torchlight illuminates the opening, and a glance within reveals quite a few workers below.  Muffled sounds can be heard coming from the lower level, perhaps a mining operation in progress.

title: [Hoarbeam Lode]
description: Smooth, grey granite makes up the surfaces of this cavern, which is carved out into a perfectly orb-shaped area.  Tied around nails that have been hammered into the ceiling are thin ropes weighted down by a long, iron candle fixture.  An unusually carved sign hangs down in the midst of the candles.  To one side of the cavern is a tall iron rack, while a short iron stand crafted with various grooves and hooks stands opposite.

title: [Ruby Level, South Hall]
description: A pair of crossed battle-axes adorn one of the earthen walls, both of the weapons bearing leather-wrapped ebon hafts and sharp invar blades.

title: [Ruby Level, Topaz Access]
description: Two stout dwarves are chatting with each other, not terribly interested in anything but their conversation.  They look up briefly as folks pass, but continue their heated debate.  A ladder leading down is visible just behind the pair.

title: [Irsalla's]
description: Several faded banners depicting images of mythical beasts and symbols hang limply from the uneven walls, evidencing the lack of air currents here.  Primly positioned in the center of the cavern, a humongous flat rock serves as a pedestal for a collection of uncut gems.  A small plaque engraved with silvery inscription has been affixed at dwarven eye-level.

title: [Irsalla's]
description: A large, tattered tapestry depicting a battlefield scene, banners and flags hoisted high, is the only attempt at decoration in this rectangular chamber.  Just below the tapestry, a small stone-topped counter chiseled with a large "I" in the center, rests amid pebbles and a thin layer of dust.

title: [Ruby Level, West Hall]
description: Displayed in a tall glass case is an ornate suit of armor, clearly of dwarven craftsmanship.  There doesn't appear to be any way to open the case.

title: [The Sharp End Of The Stick]
description: The mineshaft widens into a small cavern lined with warmly glowing lanterns.  Along one wall numerous long crates and boxes are stacked haphazardly out of the way to ensure the path is kept clear.  On the opposite wall is mounted a large weapons rack filled with lances and other long polearms.

title: [The Sharp End Of The Stick]
description: The mineshaft ends abruptly in this cavern.  The rear of the area is a huge pile of randomly strewn boxes, crates and chests.  Along the north wall of the cavern is a hastily made display rack while the against the south wall sits a stack of long wooden crates that have been pried open.  Various dwarven workers move gruffly about their business paying you absolutely no attention.

title: [Ruby Level, Passage]
description: A pair of tall kegs partially blocks the passageway, both clearly labeled in dwarven.  There is an acrid stench coming from somewhere nearby, the smell tangy and metallic.  Whatever the stench is, it's definitely not pleasant.

One of the torches illuminating this portion of the passageway is sputtering badly and nearly spent.  Several miners walk past, all ignoring the torch.  One of them can be overheard muttering, "Must be an elven torch."

title: [Equip Thyself]
description: A trio of simple carved pillars support the low ceiling of the main entryway of the store.  Hanging from the far wall is a tanned rolton hide tapestry depicting a fierce battle between a dwarven brigade and a horde of trolls.  A motley assortment of rugs covers up the floor, subduing the stone's chill and muffling footfalls.

title: [Equip Thyself, Tower Shields]
description: Rendered in dull and drab pigments on the stone walls are images of dwarves clad in full armor, each equipped with a much more vividly depicted shield.  Racks stand freely on the floor, covered from top to bottom with well-crafted wares.

title: [Equip Thyself, Large Shields]
description: Sitting in the middle of the room is a gigantic boulder with several poles rising from its massive body.  A wide array of shields have been hung from the numerous notched poles for display purposes.  Light from the entranceway filters into the area, glinting off the great amount of metal present.

title: [Ruby Level, Central Access]
description: Passageways loom in all directions, all heavily fortified with wooden beams and quite secure.  Occasionally a dwarf will wander into view, far more interested in his beard than the strangers in the halls.  A ladder leads back up to ground level.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Ruby Level, Western Access]
description: Hanging from one wall is a massive stone sign.  It has been attached to a thick wooden beam and would take several men to remove it.  Just to the north are what appear to be barracks.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Hammer it Out, Entry]
description: Carved out of rough hewn stone, this empty midsized entryway is shored up with old timbers.  Twin passages lead off to the east and west, and a plain granite door has been set flush against the northern rock face.

title: [Hammer it Out, Blunted]
description: This small corner room has been crammed full of miscellaneous weapons of various sizes and shapes.  Illuminating the room is a pair of brass lanterns hanging from the ceiling.  A dirty shelf, steel rack, and oak table proudly display the wares for all to see and buy.

title: [Hammer it Out, Maces]
description: This tiny stone room is well lighted by cleverly inset wall sconces placed on either side of the entry, and by a second pair to either side of a northwestern passageway.  Shoved against the eastern wall is a sturdy oak table with an iron weapons rack leaning against it.  A plain wooden barrel has been placed off to one side of the room near the northwestern passage.

title: [Hammer it Out, Morningstars]
description: The area opens up into a large stone cavern.  A hard packed pathway leads off to the southeast and a much smaller passageway angles off to the southwest.  A trio of torches has been bracketed along the natural curve of the north wall.

title: [Hammer it Out, Workshop]
description: The warm and friendly atmosphere of this room can be mainly attributed to the large roaring fireplace strategically placed dead center along the eastern wall.  Various weapon crafting implements have been pushed over against the wall opposite the fireplace. A pile of old comfortable cushions fills one corner of the room near the entrance.

title: [Ruby Level, Tool Crib]
description: A wide array of mining tools are on display in this room, evidently a storage area for various implements.  A sturdy metal rack holds some of the gear, while the smaller items can be found resting on a wooden shelf.  A grizzled dwarf overseer wanders about the room, muttering something about oversized ogres roaming through his section of the mine.

title: [Well In Hand]
description: Abundantly plain and drab, the floor of the shop is nothing more than plank boards set in place with tarnished nails.  Similarly, old, grey pieces of tongue-and-groove board comprise the walls, which are adorned with naught but a scattering of iron-mounted torches.  Soot and ash cling to the ceiling, discoloring the wood and infusing the entire area with the lingering aroma of smoke.

title: [Well In Hand]
description: Large clumps of dirt and dust crowd the corners of this wing of the shop, adding a dusky aroma to the already dry atmosphere.  One of the many torches lining this room has burned out, leaving one wall a conglomeration of variegated light and shadow as the other flames struggle to fill the void.

title: [Well In Hand]
description: An arid quality suffuses the air in this part of the shop, making it almost painful to breathe in the dryness.  With each step, the floorboards underfoot protest, and the walls do little to keep out the chill of the underground.  Along the upper edge of the wall, torches sputter and spark.

title: [Size Does Matter]
description: Flickering torchlight from a single iron sconce dimly illuminates a steel weapon rack and a large metal stand.  Numerous hooks along one wall display further wares next to a hastily scrawled sign, but the rocky walls and stone floor are otherwise bare.

title: [Size Does Matter]
description: A worn rug covers the floor of this cavern, and the rock walls have been chiseled smooth.  Strung along one wall is a length of mithril chain displaying assorted blades, while a solid wooden stand and an enameled white rack occupy opposite corners.  A long marble slab sits in the center of the cavern.

title: [Ruby Level, Barracks]
description: Simple cots fill the room, each fronted by a small wooden chest.  The room is empty for the moment, each of the beds made, but hardly done so with military precision.  A few tools lean up against one wall, mostly picks and shovels.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: The sounds of squawking seagulls and lapping waves filter in through an open window, and a layer of salt coats nearly every surface.  A ship's figurehead, deeply pitted and stained, looms over an old chart table.  In one corner of the room is a rope-trimmed chair with a silvery grey cat curled up on the seat.

title: [Ruby Level, Passage]
description: A heated argument can be heard coming from the room to the north, something about cheating.  A stout dwarven woman in a thick leather apron leans against one wall, staring in consternation at a broken hammer.

title: [Ruby Level, Office]
description: A battered fel desk and a few old chairs furnish this room.  Behind the desk is a wall-sized map of the mine encompassing all five levels.  There appears to be a sixth level in the works, but that portion of the map isn't terribly detailed.

title: [Aagor's Armory, Helms]
description: The light of brightly burning brass lanterns glints off polished metals everywhere the eye looks.  Solid oak posts and beams serve as a support structure to prevent damage from cave-in.  All manner of metal armors and accessories fill the shop, pride of craftsmanship evident in how they are maintained and displayed.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Aagor's Armory, Chain Room]
description: Light pine panels line the walls to protect the wares on display from damage.  Lanterns hanging from brass hooks illuminate the area so that shoppers can get a good look at the armors arranged on racks and stands.

title: [Aagor's Armory, Plate Room]
description: Plate armors of all types are displayed on racks and stands, leaving enough room for shoppers to move around and carefully inspect the wares.  Brass lanterns hung overhead cast a warm glow, their light glinting off the polished metals.

title: [Aagor's Armory, Accessories]
description: Brass lanterns are strung across the overhead beams to provide light for the discriminating shopper.  Pine paneling lines the walls to keep falling dirt and rock at bay from the armor accessories arranged on display.

title: [Bone Crusher, Entry]
description: A golden glow from glass lanterns fills this small, natural cave.  Earth-toned wool rugs cover the dirt floor in order to keep dust to a minimum.  The shop is neat and tidy, with all the displayed wares having received a recent polishing to make them shine.  A curtained narrow passage can be seen to the rear of the cave.

title: [Bone Crusher, Alcove]
description: Glass lanterns hung from an overhead beam illuminate the fine wares for sale.  Velvet-lined containers carefully display weapons of various styles and metals.

title: [Bone Crusher, Niche]
description: Lantern light glints off the gleaming metals of the wares displayed for sale.  Racks and cases of polished wood line the bare stone walls where large weapons of all sorts are neatly arranged to attract the eye of a discriminating buyer.

title: [Ruby Level, Barracks]
description: Several dwarves sit at a table playing cards.  Mostly they seem to be using silvers, but gold nuggets, a few gems, and bit of jewelry also seem to be used for wagering.  A massive pitcher of ale is within reach of all of the gamblers.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Interior]
description: An overturned railcar partially covered with rubble and debris rests in one corner, its days of hauling ore over.  A massive cave-in blocks any further passage into the mine on this level, but a ladder provides further egress.  If the numerous fissures and cracks in the ceiling are indications of things to come, it might not be wise to remain here for very long.  Within a small iron-barred cage toward the west end of the area sits an attentive teller.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Interior]
description: Light filters in from a distant opening, but it is still very dim in this portion of the tunnel.  A broken shovel lies discarded off to one side, its handle badly cracked and splintered.  Footprints lead in all directions, but most seem to be heading out.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Interior]
description: Reinforced wooden beams line both the walls and ceiling, but most are shattered and no longer serve any actual purpose.  Vibrations from above and below rumble about the passage, creating a blizzard of dust and silt that swirls madly in all directions.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Entry]
description: The opening to this mine is fairly narrow, but still wide enough to allow a cart past.  Badly pitted and slightly bent rails lead into the shaft, although they don't appear to have been used in quite some time.  Darkness is the only thing waiting to greet those entering the area.

title: [Topaz Level, Central Access]
description: A metal ladder bolted into the wall ascends to the upper levels of the mine.  The ladder looks sturdy enough to bear the weight of a giantman, but the rung separation is much better suited to a dwarf or halfling.  A pair of shafts leads out from this accessway.

title: [Garnith's Goods, Entry]
description: The shop is pleasantly appointed and well-lit, encouraging shoppers to linger over the wares displayed for sale.  Soft wool rugs cover the floor, and two leather-seated chairs are placed on either side of a small brazier burning scented coals.  Woven fabrics of various hues are draped over the walls to mitigate the bare stone.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, out

title: [Garnith's Goods, Sheaths]
description: A giant mural depicting a heated battle between dwarves and orcs in a large cavern covers the back wall.  Several clan banners drape the remaining walls.  Weapon holders of all sorts are neatly arranged for viewing by prospective buyers.

title: [Garnith's Goods, Outerwear]
description: Colorful tapestries cover the walls, depicting dwarves in various battle scenes.  One especially large tapestry displays images of the pact at Sunfist.  Racks and stands are placed at wide intervals around the room to allow shoppers freedom of movement without disturbing the goods.

title: [Garnith's Goods, Containers]
description: Wool rugs with abstract designs in earth-toned colors cover the floor, dampening the sound of footsteps.  The room is pervaded with a heavy scent from the brazier in the entryway.  A wide assortment of containers are on display, covering most of the available space.

title: [Shield Shed, Entry]
description: At first glance, the dim shop seems a bit dreary and dingy.  Rustic wooden beams support the ceiling, and the grey stone walls are drab.  No decorations alleviate the monotony.  Slowly adjusting to the low light, it can be seen that the shop is filled with magnificent shields of all sizes and types.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Shield Shed, Recess]
description: The stone wall of the tunnel curves into a small recess in this part of the shop.  A splintered beam hangs low overhead, causing taller patrons to have to stoop, and a spluttering torch sends shifting light over the displayed shields.

title: [Shield Shed, Cranny]
description: This part of the shop is little more than a wide crack.  Shields are crammed into the cramped space, allowing scant room to move about.  A lone, dented lantern provides negligible illumination.

title: [Shield Shed, Nook]
description: A lone flickering torch is set into the wall of this low-ceilinged nook.  Shields are piled wherever there is space available, and shoppers have to squeeze through to get a look at the wares.  A low wooden doorway in the back leads to a small alcove.

title: [Boarseye]
description: There doesn't appear to be any rhyme or reason to this chamber.  It looks hastily dug out, ill-lit, and it is completely devoid of any features save for the image of a giant warthog that is deeply etched into the earthen floor.  Two uneven circles surround the head of the beast, one inside the other, leaving the eye of the boar dead center.

title: [Topaz Level, Mess]
description: Several long tables surrounded by simple wooden chairs serve as a mess area for the miners.  Pewter flagons filled with ale rest near large loaves of bread and assorted fruit and nuts.  A cook stares out from the nearby pantry, his apron covered with food stains.

title: [Topaz Level, Pantry]
description: Row upon row of shelves line each wall of this ample pantry, each filled with spices, grains, and other food supplies.  Cleanliness doesn't seem the primary concern, as there are roaches, ants, rats, and several other varieties of vermin quite happily munching on the feast.

title: [Topaz Level, Chute]
description: Loose dirt and silt make footing treacherous, but the dwarves traveling through the area don't seem to notice.  A dumbwaiter in one wall might have worked at one time, but looks disabled and unusable for the moment.

title: [Topaz Level, Chute]
description: The steep tilt of the passage ends briefly at a leveled area, allowing access to several other tunnels.  It looks reasonably safe, although the downward edge of the earthen platform is starting to crumble.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down

title: [Toss Yer Cookies]
description: In braces of dark iron, torches frame the entryway, giving off the heavy scent of tar along with a wavering wash of tawny light.  Largely bare, the rough-hewn walls are vacant except for the back wall, which is lined with large mithril hooks set on a long plank of beveled-edge maoral.  Mannequins stand on each side of the hooks, displaying the proper use of the wares.

title: [Toss Yer Cookies]
description: A number of long maoral racks line the walls, each offering weapons of various design for display.  Set below, along the perimeter of the room, display cases bear neatly arranged selections of smaller weaponry.  A large, dusty rug sits at the center of the room.

title: [Hallway]
description: The short, roughly hewn hallway ends in a curtained opening flanked on either side by torches borne by intricately wrought mithril sconces.  Each side wall bears a number thickly woven tapestries depicting a bronze-bearded dwarf in various poses of forging.  The opposite end of the hallway forks, the bustle of shops drifting in from beyond.

title: [Keepin' Yeh Alive, First Aid]
description: Here in the quiet back area of the shop, multiple maoral display cases line the roughly hewn stone walls, each paired with some maoral shelves secured just above.  Sprawled hastily across the cracked and striated floor, a threadbare rug curls at the edges and leads through a narrow passage to the northwest.

title: [Keepin' Yeh Alive]
description: The roughly hewn walls open up to the central area of the dimly torch-lit shop.  Dominating the center of the room, a maoral table sits offering an assortment of wares, with a pair of mannequins flanking it on either side.  A dusty rug covers the majority of the floor, while iron-sconced torches flicker and gutter along the outer walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Keepin' Yeh Alive, Storage]
description: Packs of various design and size line the sides of this chamber, each suspended from one of the many thick wooden pegs set into the walls.  Spanning the rear of the room, a long oak counter bears a number of smaller containers for display.  The mingled scents of dust and leather fill the area.

title: [Keepin' Yeh Alive, Vials]
description: This section of the shop is slightly secluded, situated around the corner of a roughly hewn half-wall of stone.  Numerous display cases line the perimeter of the area, each filled with an array of vials that glimmer in the soft, flickering torchlight.  Set on the rear wall, just above the cases, a long oak shelf bearing flasks of various shape and size stretches across the width of the nook.  A slightly sweet scent hangs in the air.

title: [Topaz Level, Infirmary]
description: Two simple cots lined up next to each other provide the only comfort for the sick or infirm.  A hastily built wooden case holds a few common herbs and poultices, but clearly this area wasn't designed for anything more than the occasional burn or bruise.

title: [Topaz Level, Alcove]
description: A pair of stout wooden cases fronted by glass doors take up one corner of the chamber, while a smaller more delicate curio atop a pedestal sits in another.  The locks on all the cases look quite intricate.  The insignia of the Grenroa Clan, a pair of crossed golden shovels, adorns one wall.

title: [Charenda's Casual Cothurns]
description: Thick, overlapping deep pink-colored carpets cover the packed earth floor.  Placed in the center of the cavern is a large brass cauldron with a blazing fire, surrounded by overstuffed pillows in various shades of violet and trimmed in thick silver braiding that have been piled atop each other.  In one corner lies a bejeweled footlocker, resting beside an overturned box of slippers.  A box of cothurns are stuffed inside of a niche in the back wall above boxes of laced and buckled boots.

title: [Mace, Shield, and Spirit]
description: Golden flames dance in mithril-caged lanterns set along the spacious tunnel.  The walls and ceiling are reinforced at intervals with broad oak beams.  A low, sturdy invar rack padded with gnarp wool displays an assortment of maces and morning stars to people passing by the north wall.  To the south, a long, granite block sits against the rock face.  More weaponry has been arrayed upon the granite.

title: [Mace, Shield, and Spirit]
description: On both sides of the tunnel, lantern light gleams off polished shields hanging from hooks in the dark rock walls.  Those to the north are painted and enamelled, while those to the south are decorated with jewel inlay.  More shields sit atop a makeshift table formed from shipping crates covered with a clean white wool cloth.  Although the tunnel's roof is tall enough for a giantman to walk upright, everything is placed conveniently low for the brown-robed dwarf tending the merchandise.

title: [Mace, Shield, and Spirit]
description: When compared to the lantern-lit expanse stretching away to the east, this section of the oak-braced tunnel seems dim, but candlelight blazes in a circle around the life-sized iron dwarf statue standing sentinel in the dead end.  To either side, the rock face has been carved with images of mace-wielding dwarves fighting through an onslaught of banshees and skeletons.  An ancient dwarven monk sits on a prayer rug at the statue's feet.  Five talismans are displayed upon a tray beside her.

title: [Topaz Level, Chute]
description: The steepness of the floor is such that extreme care must be taken to navigate it.  A wide metal chute runs parallel to the passage, carrying murky water towards the bottom of the mine.  Occasionally, a tool or sack will rattle down the steel slide as well.

title: [Topaz Level, Elbow]
description: Two columns centered in the shaft fortify the passage, but both are buckling badly under the weight.  A dust-covered sign is attached to one wall, the words barely readable.

title: [The Invar Dog, Entry]
description: Some time in the past, this narrow cavern was visited by an industrious dwarf who took his pickaxe to the wall, creating a wider space complete with a stone-hewn bar.  In a nook behind the bar, a dog, fashioned from invar and accompanied by a plaque, watches over the patrons.  Some visitors, especially dwarves, belly up to the bar for a drink, but many others drift to the east, searching for wares.

title: [The Invar Dog, Sales]
description: The north, east, and south walls of this chamber have been covered with spikes which display all manner of small shields for purchase.  A cranky-looking dwarf presides over the wares and uses a long hook-tipped plank of wood to retrieve purchases from high over his head.  The tell-tale odor of grog drifts in from the west.

title: [Razin' Sharp Stuffs]
description: Randomly placed candles offer a dim, yet functional, source of light to this dark cave.  The flickering candlelight illuminates patches of lichen on the walls.  A mithril weapons rack has been haphazardly attached to one of the cave walls.  Two boxes, a large wooden strongbox and a heavy steel chest, have been left open to display the wares inside.  Flanking the weapons rack are two glass display cases.

title: [Topaz Level, Elbow]
description: A portion of the wall looks as if it exploded outward, revealing a ragged unworked opening that seems to lead to nowhere.  The tunnel is filled with far too much rubble to pass through, though.  Something must be deep inside of it, however, as odd rumblings continue to escape the hole.

title: [Lapidary by Larilas]
description: Flecks of mica in the natural rock walls of this low tunnel sparkle as they reflect the dancing flames of torches placed at intervals to light the way.  Niches directly beneath the torches house exquisitely detailed statuettes of Arkati, kings, and heroes carved from semi-precious stones.

title: [Lapidary by Larilas]
description: The vaulted roof of this cave soars high overhead, supported on slender columns of fluted stone crowned with elaborate foliate capitals.  The golden light from tiers of pure beeswax candles is caught and refracted into shimmering rainbows by crystalline inclusions in the rock.  Broad shelves of polished onyx, agate, and chalcedony display the wares to their fullest advantage.

title: [Lapidary by Larilas]
description: Subdued light from elegant arrangements of glowing fungi casts weird shadows on walls of rough-hewn granite.  Gargoyles crouch and prowl on every surface, displaying the most fantastic combinations of humanoid and animal features as their clawed, taloned, furred, and scaled paws proffer trays heaped high with trinkets for the consideration of the discerning customer.

title: [Lapidary by Larilas]
description: Delicate cages of jade carved into lace-fine filigree contain the glow-worms and fireflies which light this grotto of rose-streaked white marble.  A collection of statues, figurines, and sculptures are fantastically bedecked with jewelry for sale.

title: [Zigiluk's Helms, Main Cavern]
description: Illuminated by dozens of low-burning torches, the granite walls of this wide cavern are so finely smoothed and polished that it is difficult to believe that they were carved by mortal hands.  Two tunnels exit this main chamber, to the northeast and the northwest, each wide corridor circling around a massive blue stone stalagmite rising from the cavern's center.  Several large crates and boxes are piled up against one wall, all bound with mithril chains and secured with very intricate-looking locks.

title: [Zigiluk's Helms, Greathelms]
description: Narrower than the cavern's entrance, this tunnel-like corridor is barely wide enough for three dwarves to walk abreast.  Further complicating the issue of movement, a long wooden table rests against the western wall, its slightly curving length standing at about waist-high for a dwarf.

title: [Zigiluk's Helms, Helms & Coifs]
description: The cavern widens out again as you enter the northernmost room.  An invar-banded polished steel table rests against the north wall, and a long ironwood shelf is suspended immediately above it.

title: [Zigiluk's Helms, Visored Helms]
description: Narrower than the cavern's entrance, this tunnel-like corridor is barely wide enough for three dwarves to walk abreast.  Further complicating the issue of movement, a long wooden table rests against the eastern wall, its slightly curving length standing about waist-high for a dwarf.

title: [Zigiluk's Helms, Forge]
description: This circular cavern appears to be much smaller than it actually is, probably because almost every possible inch of floorspace is covered with assorted tools, scraps of metal, and half-finished helms.  A large invar anvil stands in one corner, and an unlit forge is set into the wall behind it.  A weathered oak barrel stands in one corner with a large sign attached to the front.

title: [Topaz Level, Elbow]
description: Solid stone on either wall has made it necessary to carve a steep bend to continue the shaft.  The stone is scarred with numerous attempts to widen the gap, but evidently without success.  A few twisted pieces of metal litter the ground, remnants of what must have been a pickaxe at one time.

title: [The Plaid Brat]
description: This small shop is brilliant with whitewash, liberally applied over carefully plastered walls.  Tea has been laid upon a plaid tablecloth covering a three-legged table.  The table provides an excellent vantage point for perusal of the polished clothes press adjacent to the arch or contemplation of the niche carved into the wall close to the exit.  An assortment of brats and cloaks on the rack in the shop's center also invites a second glance.

title: [Mawd's Kitchen]
description: This immaculate yellow kitchen bears the mark of fanatic housekeeping.  A huge coal stove, standing before the painted rock walls, emits a scorching heat, despite the chimney that rises from the firebox and vanishes into the granite ceiling overhead.  Something is simmering on the stove in a tightly covered pot.  A box of footwear has been placed near the bleached pine table.

title: [Topaz Level, Elbow]
description: Mining efforts are in full bore on the northern wall, but don't impede progress through the passage.  Several dwarves are busy working the stone, carefully searching for new veins or traces of mineral deposits.  Of the three miners, it appears the woman is working the hardest.

title: [Sister Olba's Holy House]
description: An immense fluted marble column stands to the north, surrounded by a series of gilt-work stands.  Each display has been enclosed in glass and contains a collection of holy relics and artifacts.  A burnished plaque sits atop a small stone pillar draped with cobalt blue velvet.

title: [Sister Olba's Holy House]
description: An embroidered grey wool curtain has been drawn back from the west wall to reveal a large alcove.  The recessed area is illuminated by an antique iron candelabra set with thick white pillar candles.  Bathed in the warm radiance of candlelight is an array of holy wares that sit on display upon a gold-flecked marble-topped table.

title: [Sister Olba's Holy House]
description: Sitting against an immense marble column is a circular glass-topped stand illuminated from beneath by a glowing orb.  A few shallow niches have been carved into the wall in order to house tiny copper-brushed censers.  The fragrant and pale smoke from the burning incense drifts lazily through the air, creating lacy patterns that soon dissipate.

title: [Sister Olba's Holy House]
description: An embroidered grey wool curtain has been drawn back from the east wall to reveal a large alcove.  The recessed area is illuminated by an antique iron candelabra set with thick indigo pillar candles.  Bathed in the warm radiance of candlelight is an array of holy wares that sit on display upon a glossy green marble-topped table.

title: [Sister Olba's Sanctuary]
description: Set within a handful of niches carved into the domed ceiling are radiant orbs, shining their light down upon this circular chamber.  A dark blue woven prayer mat rests before a low-lying table holding several lit votives.  The air is scented heavily with the aroma of sandalwood emanating from a pair of brass censers flanking a heavy crimson velvet curtain.

title: [Emerald Level, Northeast Shaft]
description: The earthen walls look recently worked, the surface pitted with numerous tool marks and divots.  Glittering metallic ore is all that is left of what might have been a rich vein of minerals or gems.  A small army of ants scurry about, their home evidently destroyed in the process.

title: [Emerald Level, Northeast Shaft]
description: A stout miner pushing a nearly full wheelbarrow walks past, her attention fully on the load in front of her.  A glance in the wheelbarrow shows it to be mostly rocks with a few scattered semi-precious gems.  The quality of the stones is so poor however, a town jeweler probably wouldn't give the stones a second look.

title: [Emerald Shaft, Northeast Shaft]
description: This portion of the tunnel is quite dark.  There is a torch on one wall, but it is burnt out and no longer serviceable.  Light filtering in from either side of the passage provides scant illumination.

title: [Crystal Level, Entry]
description: A ladder ascending into a darkened shaft is the only way off of this level of the mine.  Stone, dirt, and other debris continually splatters onto the ground, not a reassuring sign of stability or security this far down.  There are several shaft tunnels leading out from this chamber.

title: [Ririn's Scaleworks]
description: Sturdy wooden planks support the cramped quarters' walls.  With candles shedding just enough light to illuminate a large sign, the area's combination of dim lighting, low ceiling, and rugged granite floor creates a marked lack of space in the cavern.  Faded tapestries cover the walls, their weaves depicting a variety of scenes in which dwarves are hunting and gathering a multitude of skins.

title: [Ririn's Scaleworks]
description: Despite the lack of bright light, leaning wooden bins and dark metal bins are clearly heaped with armor, which are obviously the source of the strong aroma of leather that permeates the narrow area.  On each wall, tapestries depict dwarves preparing and tanning skins, and further scenes show them cutting, shaping, embellishing, and ultimately finishing off suits of leather armor.

title: [Ririn's Scaleworks, Workshop]
description: Although tidy and neat, the workshop itself is poorly lit, with shadows creeping about in all corners of the room.  Several low tables are scattered over the hard cavern floor.  Along one wall, two large cabinets stand locked and closed, though a sign across the front of them clearly indicates that the contents are for leather-working.  The remaining walls of the workshop are strung with weathered tapestries, their scenes that of armor-clad dwarves engaged in battle.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: The walls are scored with test holes and deep scars, the miners evidently seeking a new vein in this area.  Ominous rumbling sounds deep within the walls, its source unknown.  Some of the vibrations are violent enough to rattle your teeth.

title: [Heavy Handed, Entry]
description: A broad oak counter has been set opposite the shop's heavy door.  Its surface is stacked with twine-tied ledgers and a scattering of dry straw, probably pulled from the many crates and boxes stacked around the display cases in the room.  A small note has been pinned to the front of the counter, at dwarven eye-level.

title: [Heavy Handed, Showroom]
description: A rough rectangle of burlap has been spread under the partially empty weapon stand in the center of the room, its surface covered with bits of straw that have fallen from the unpacked weapons.  Sealed crates have been neatly stacked in one corner, while another stack of empty ones have been haphazardly piled in another.  A clerk occasionally wanders through, adding inventory to the rack and making checks in a small parchment notebook.

title: [Heavy Handed, Showroom]
description: A rolled-up rug placed near the entrance to the room provides a small obstacle to the patrons entering and exiting this corner of the shop.  A partially empty weapon stand rests near a heavy hide curtain leading further into the shop.  A few framed paintings of various mountain landscapes lean against the walls, waiting for someone equipped with wire to suspend them from the reinforcing beams around the edges of the ceiling.

title: [Heavy Handed, Backroom]
description: This tiny room is bare of any decoration and immaculately swept.  A long mahogany table is the only furniture of note, save a ceiling-high stack of packing crates.  Each time a customer purchases the item displayed on the table, the clerk rushes to replace it with a new specimen from the crates.  Browsers and purchasers alike make their way in and out of the room via a heavy hide curtain suspended from an oak-framed arch.

title: [Contain Yourself]
description: Chunky rocks jut out of the cavern wall, creating natural hooks hung with a variety of sheaths.  Set just below, a long stone table, masterfully carved with thick rings of ivory marble, displays various wares.

title: [Contain Yourself Some More]
description: Shallow veins of quartz crystal line the rough-cut walls here, where the stone was obviously not gutted out to make way for any long-term mining operation.  Several areas of the cavern are so completely lacking in smooth areas that the rock rises out of the walls to create natural, table-like surfaces and flat shelves.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: Compared to the narrow confines of most of the tunnels and passages, this portion of the mine is immense.  Large contraptions suitable to prospecting fill the room, most topped with large stones or a variety of ores.  A water-filled trench bisects the work area.

title: [More Razin' Sharp Stuffs]
description: This cave would be completely engulfed in darkness were it not for the use of three half-lit lanterns.  One lantern sits close to the cave's entrance, its light falling onto an open wooden strongbox.  Two lanterns sit at the far side of the cave, their light splashing on a pair of glass display cases.  A wooden weapons rack has been propped up against one of the display cases, while an open chest has been pushed against the other.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: Stout wooden columns brace the shaft and partially block passage in either direction.  In spite of their thickness, they seem to be splintering under the immense weight they are supporting.  A dwarf leans up against one of the columns, clearly unconcerned.

title: [Crystal Level, Office]
description: A huge desk covered with a variety of maps and parchments seems a bit large for this cluttered room.  A jeweled compass rests atop one of the papers, the platinum tool embedded with numerous small gems.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: Two large metal pipes run along the ceiling, water dripping from both of them.  The metal is rusting badly, and looks patched in several places.  A small mouse has taken up residence atop one of the pipes.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: The tunnel curves slightly, although not smoothly.  The reason for the bend is quite evident: a solid wall of hard stone amidst the softer earth of the passage.  Tool marks mar the surface of the stone, but it clearly was too much work to try to continue clearing the rock.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: A wide hall leads south into a massive well-lit chamber.  There are a good number of miners both entering and exiting the room, most no longer wearing their work clothing.  Torch smoke fills the air, creating an odd smell in the area.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: A gaping hole in the ceiling vanishes into the darkness.  It is uneven and unworked, clearly not the result of mining efforts.  Dirt and rubble piled at the base of the hole look fresh.

title: [The Locksmith's Helper]
description: Descending deep into the mountain, a narrow walkway winds steeply through a curtain of liquid-sheened rock.  The colors vary as the rock reaches deeper into the abyss, starting with a yellow-lit dun colored rock near the entranceway that deepens with streaks of coppery orange as it works its way down.  Mellow illumination seeps in from the passageway, keeping this part of the cavern in permanent twilight.

title: [The Locksmith's Helper]
description: Descending deep into the mountain, a narrow walkway winds steeply through a curtain of liquid-sheened rock.  The colors vary as the rock reaches deeper into the abyss, starting with a coppery orange colored rock near the upper part of the path that deepens with streaks of scarlet, reminiscent of despanal's hue, as it works its way down.  Mellow illumination seeps in from the entranceway, making this part of the cavern barely visible.

title: [The Locksmith's Helper]
description: Descending deep into the mountain, a narrow walkway winds steeply through a curtain of liquid-sheened rock.  The colors vary as the rock reaches deeper into the abyss, starting with a vivid crimson rock that is nearly black in the dim light.  Striations of a duskier wine-dark purple writhe across the rock wall as it works its way down into the depths.  Uncertain light, given by flickering torches set into the walls illuminates the room only partially.

title: [The Locksmith's Helper]
description: Spiraling sharply to work its way past an enormous stalagmite, the path skirts the growth that projects from below like a giant tusk, piercing multiple levels of the cave structure.  The colors on the wall are rich and saturated, ranging at the top from a red-tinged plum to deepest blue.  Tiny bits of mica are imbedded in the rock walls, catching and reflecting sparks of light like embers in a dying fire.

title: [The Locksmith's Helper]
description: A narrow walkway edges its way around the wide base of a stalagmite that rises up into the darkness.  Pale stone, almost leprously white, forms the enormous tooth, gleaming in the darkness.  Ridges and bumps, as if the stone had partially melted and then re-solidified halfway through the process, decorate the exterior of the formation.  Walls of grey-streaked ebon stone surround the tooth, like the maw of a great beast with a single fang projecting from it.

title: [The Pack Mule, Entry]
description: Small braziers stand in each corner of this small room, casting reflections off the various mining tools mounted securely to the walls.  Two large archways lead off to the east and west from the center of the room.  Along the north wall a heavy velvet curtain conceals the contents of the room behind it.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [The Pack Mule, West Room]
description: This room appears to be well lit, with numerous torches in evenly spaced sconces along the walls.  Along the far wall an empty weapons rack leans up against a large crate.  Curiously enough the room seems to have been kept relatively clean, indicating it's probably used primarily as a show room.

title: [The Pack Mule, East Room]
description: Suspended from the ceiling of this room is a large candelabra.  The light shines warmly down upon the well-stocked showroom.  Scattered around the room are various closed boxes and crates along with a long polished counter against one wall.

title: [The Pack Mule, North Room]
description: This dimly lit room is both small and sparsely decorated.  A single lit candle has been set up on small stand just inside the door and provides very little illumination for the room.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: The curving passageway is filled with crates and sacks, most filled with gear or supplies.  A bit of grain spills out from one of the large canvas bags, a small hole at the bottom likely caused by vermin of some sort.  A swarm of insects are taking advantage of the unlikely feast.

title: [Big Things, Foyer]
description: Stone walls smoothed over by both tools and time form a large cavern, however, little of the walls remain visible.  Polished teak plaques adorn the walls, covering most of the stone.  Each plaque has been decorated with at least one oversized weapon, some far to large in size to be of any practical use to anyone.  A bright green runner lines the floor leading off deeper into the cave.

title: [Big Things, Combination Room]
description: Many mediums come together along the walls here, including stone, metal, and wood.  From one medium to the next, the junctures are smooth.  In the center of the floor, a large table covered with a plush red cloth holds stacks of weapons.  The table, too tall for the shorter races, has several stepstools surrounding it to allow them to peer at the displayed wares here.  A large wooden door, banded with iron, is set in the north wall.

title: [Big Things, Wood Room]
description: Narrow bands of wood, each affixed to the wall with a number of stout little wooden pegs, cover the stone walls save the path leading back east.  Small patches of cured furs serve as a floor covering.  On a raised dais, a wooden stand holds several long handled weapons and has numerous quarterstaves leaning against it.

title: [Big Things, Metal Room]
description: Thin sheets of metal have been somehow affixed to the walls of this cavern.  Incised into the metal, non-geometric patterns swirl and dance around the walls.  In the center of the room, on a raised metal box, sits a large iron rack.

title: [Big Things, Workshop]
description: Rush mats cover the floor, providing a place to sit.  Each mat can easily hold four or five bodies comfortably.  Set on the back wall, as far from the wooden door as possible is a single stone chair cut from the very chamber wall.  A large round pedestal stands in the center of the room bearing a few snacks.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: A crudely built passage to the west leads to a small dugout chamber.  From this vantage, it isn't possible to see much of the room, especially since it isn't very well lit.  A simple canvas and wood stretcher is leaning up against the wall.

title: [Works of War, Entry]
description: Several large mithril hooks hang from the reinforced oak beams, which support the ceiling of this large mineshaft, while piles of old rushes are strewn randomly across the bare stone floor.  Some dark wooden benches run along the smoke-stained walls under the brightly burning torches, which light the area.  The tunnel branches off and continues on to the southeast and southwest, while recessed in an alcove on the far wall a heavy oak door reinforced with steel bands leads off to the south.

title: [Works of War, Workshop]
description: Heavy pieces of leather and fur hang from the walls of this cramped room and serve to dampen the sounds of the workshop somewhat.  Dwarven apprentices and craftsmen work diligently at various tables and forging anvils located around the room.  In the center of the room sits a large mithril-plated table and a heavy mithril anvil, both located conveniently close to the blazing furnace at the rear of the room.

title: [Works of War, Weaponry]
description: Occasional trickles of dust slowly sift down from above and cover the veins of pure white quartz that run through the walls of this large, hollowed out section of the mine.  Small indentations and holes, where ore was removed from the rock, scar the walls like pock marks.  Along one wall, an old wooden door has been placed upon two sawhorses to form a makeshift table.  Beside it sits a small mine cart, which is missing three of its wheels.  Amid the rubble of a collapsed tunnel to the west, some of the broken timbers have been split up and used as a set of rough shelves.

title: [Works of War, Armorworks]
description: Occasional gouts of thick smoke and fumes leak from the seals off a large pipe that runs out of the northern wall and then up through the ceiling.  Hot gases waft about the room, stinging your eyes and making it hard to breathe.  A large armor rack adorns the south wall, while a stout oak table occupies the center of the room.

title: [Works of War, Narrow Tunnel]
description: This area of the mine seems to have been constructed almost as an afterthought; the ceiling juts downward in awkward places, making walking upright a dangerous prospect and careful steps are required as the floor is rough and riddled with holes and protrusions.  Casually piled to one side of the narrow corridor are several boxes, chests, and other containers.

title: [Crystal Level, Infirmary]
description: A single torch sputters and flares, but provides little more than a glimmer of light.  The room looks like it was dug out in a hurry and furnished just as quickly.  There are crates of medicinal supplies in the chamber, but many are crude and wouldn't be of much practical use for anything more than the tamest injuries.  A dwarven medic sits near the supplies on an over turned crate, occasionally exchanging an ale for a few coins to a wounded passer-by.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: A wheelbarrow filled with ore separates two miners engaged in a heated debate.  Their faces are covered with soot, and their beards are so full of the dark silt that one good shake would create a dust storm.  The argument is in the dwarven tongue, but the word "elf" is repeated often, and not in a very pleasant tone.

title: [ArmorWorks - Breastplates]
description: The grey-hued limestone floor of the cave has been worn to an almost slippery smoothness and a dull reflection.  On the concave stone walls there is not much to be admired in the way of decorative efforts.  Instead, an odd pile of leather and metal pieces is somewhat reminiscent of a broken statuary.

title: [ArmorWorks - Cuirbouilli]
description: Boiled leather remnants of various shapes and colors has been stitched together to create a singular patchwork covering that graces the center of this almost-round cavern.  Several dwarven workers, clad in long aprons, chat animatedly as they keep their eyes trained on would-be customers.

title: [ArmorWorks - Studded]
description: This cavern is dotted with small stalactites and wavy formations throughout, giving the distinct impression that the stone started to melt at some point.  Flat-topped stones serve as stools for tired patrons and enterprising dwarves alike.

title: [ArmorWorks - Brigandine]
description: Wide bands of light-colored stone provide eye-catching contrast against the more prominent dull grey stone walls in this area.  Pebbles of various sizes are strewn about most of the floor, making it a bit of a challenge to walk about.

title: [Crystal Level, Hall]
description: Water sporadically drips from the ceiling, although it never seems to fall to the same spot twice.  As a result of this constant leaking, the ground is muddy and soft.  Somebody has thoughtfully placed a few planks over the muck, but they are mostly underwater and of little use.

title: [Cloth of Life]
description: Durable oilcloth flaps are held around the opening of the makeshift tent, their ends tied in place with braided hemp.  Three large support posts are driven into the bare rock floor with large metal stakes to create evenly spaced peeks throughout, which help divide the area into three chambers.

title: [Cloth of Life]
description: Braided hemp cords arc outward from the central support post to create a latticework design across the top of the ceiling that binds the sturdy canvas panels in place both above and along the three walls.  Cracked barrels and oaken hampers lay in a disorganized mess about the area, their contents strewn or heaped in odd piles.  An exasperated dwarf mutters to herself as she attempts to draw the chaos into order by folding several robes into tidy piles along the back wall.

title: [Cloth of Life]
description: Tapering slightly from the central post, the ceiling in this section of the tent is only slightly lower from the main entry chamber.  Durable cords of hemp draw the walls outward at an angle to create a free flowing space that is riddled with crates, boxes, and footlockers.  Unpacked wares mix with sealed ones along the back of the tent, where a young dwarf sporting a new beard growth works furiously at polishing a slender runestaff.

title: [A Dark Shaft]
description: Piles of dirt and debris fill this end of the shaft.  An odd sound echoes in from somewhere above and as you look up to find its source, you see a mottled clay ramp, covered with thousands of tiny wood chips.

title: [A Dark Shaft]
description: Endless tangles of cobwebs hang down from the ceiling, finding their way into your hair and clothes.  The walls here are scarred with pick marks but evidently the miners gave up in favor of other more profitable sites.

title: [A Dark Enclosure]
description: Unlike the other enclosures, this one is completely devoid of debris and cobwebs.  The ground feels like densely packed earth and the walls are made of unusually smooth solid rock.  There is not even a speck of loose dirt to be found.

wayto.7389: ;e %w(circular triangular square rectangular).each{|d| dothistimeout "push #{d} depression", 3, /\*[A-Z]+\*$/};fput "stand" until standing?

title: [A Dark Shaft]
description: Odd shuffling sounds from somewhere nearby put you on guard as you struggle to make out your surroundings in the odd light.  The ground seems mottled with hoofprints, pressed deep into the earth as if the makers had been packed with some tremendous burden.

title: [A Dark Enclosure]
description: This makeshift stall is filled with the shredded remains of some unidentifiable material.  Old racks still rest upon the walls but whatever once hung there is gone.

title: [A Dark Shaft]
description: The air tastes stale in this long forgotten mine shaft.  Several rows of wooden braces extend to the east serving to hold up the ceiling.  An eerie soft white glow emanates from the braces causing the view eastward to fill you with uncertainty and dread.

title: [A Dark Enclosure]
description: Cobwebs dominate this smallish enclosure from floor to ceiling but no sign of their eight-legged creators remain.  Amongst the dirt and decay covering the floor, you notice the remnants of what looks to have been hay or straw.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The ground before you is cluttered with rubble and huge clumps of clay and earth.  It appears that this section of the mine was once blocked off, perhaps the result of a cave in.  More recent tremors have doubtlessly cleared the way.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The tunnels open up into three paths, two leading deeper into the mine.  Deep hoof marks cover the ground, a sign of many beasts of burden which must have once labored within these walls.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Silvery dust blankets the walls of the tunnel, the faintest glimmer of light revealing its presence.  Hand-sized holes are evidence of mining tests in this area but only cobwebs fill them now.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Another trio of tunnels meet to form a junction within this fair sized hollow.  Most of the old hoof tracks turn towards the south leading into the darkness beyond.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Gnarled walls encroach upon you, giving you an eerie feeling of being buried alive within a massive living grave.  The presence of a trail of hoof marks gives you small comfort that a ready pathway out of the area is evident.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Dust is thick in the air making breathing a chore.  Tunnels break off in three directions, the one leading west marked with a pillar carefully bracing the ceiling.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Blotchy patches of cobwebs fill a vast array of holes within the walls.  Considering the odd placement of many of the holes, you are not quite convinced these were made by miners, but perhaps by some burrowing creature long since dead.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Trails of hoof prints lead in from the north and turn into the adjacent tunnels.  A slight breeze of musty air makes itself known though you are not certain from which direction it originates.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The absence of support pillars in the tunnel makes you uneasy as the walls of clay and dirt seem to close in upon you.  Stale musty air compliments the flavor of this detestable place.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The walls narrow slightly, enhancing the claustrophobic feel of this gloomy excavation.  Rotting roots reach out from the ceiling, seemingly adding their touch to the loathsomeness of these tunnels.

title: [Dark Pit]
description: A large round pit rests in the center of the tunnel as the hoof paths circle around it.  At first glance, it appears to be just another hole in this ancient excavation, but signs of blood along the walls and near the edge of pit make you wonder if it had been used for something other than mining silver.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Endless hoof marks in the ground lead off to the south, following a time-worn trail of past labor.  Cobwebs mark the ceiling of the tunnel adding a silvery glow to the darkness.

title: [Dark Shaft]
description: This section of the mine is carefully braced, leading you to believe this area was either used for storage or heavier traffic.  Several large enclosures along the shaft confirm your suspicions.

title: [Dark Enclosure]
description: Dirt and straw cover the ground in this long-abandoned stall.  Remnants of a wooden rack mark the back of the walls but leave no hints to what its purpose once was.

title: [Dark Shaft]
description: Bits of broken chain and wood lay strewn about area in a chaotic pattern.  Amongst the odd decoration, small black splotches of some unidentifiable substance have been splattered about.
Bits of broken chain and wood lay strewn about the area in a chaotic pattern.  Amongst the odd decoration, small black splotches of some unidentifiable substance have been splattered about.

title: [Dark Enclosure]
description: Very little of note is to be found in this enclosure, except for the remnants of decaying straw.  The air seems colder here than other spots in the mine but you can sense no reason for it to be so.

title: [Dark Shaft]
description: Silvery cobwebs swirl along the walls in a most unusual spiral pattern.  You almost feel dizzy examining the detail of the spidery remnants.

title: [Dark Enclosure]
description: Dozens of odd markings in the ground obscure the usual hoof prints in this stall.  The strange symbols bring to mind thoughts of dark rituals and arcane practices which fill your mind making your ability to concentrate much more difficult.

title: [Dark Shaft]
description: The shaft ends here suddenly, signs of unfinished digging still left in the west wall.  Very little is to be found beyond the few stray clumps of dirt pushed into the corners of the room.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: The trail here is barely wide enough to place one foot after the other.  In places, it would have dwindled into nothing, but marks in the stone and ice show where hands and chisels have been employed to save the trail from disappearing.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Corrie]
description: After a final steep scramble, the trail widens out to a path that slopes to an end at a sheer drop off.  About twenty feet below, the snowy valley floor is cut in half by the black stripe of a cold, rushing stream.  Heavy pegs, pounded into the old ice, look like they have been there for generations.  From the pegs, a knotted rope disappears over the side of the cliff.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Corrie]
description: The rock face rising out of the snow at your feet is completely featureless.  A thick rope, crusted in ice and apparently secured above, turns slowly in the ever-present wind.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Mountain Hole]
description: A wide path leads into this hole in the side of the mountain.  The stone floor is marked with trails of scratches leading back and forth from the huge tangle of tree branches and oddments that sits in the middle of the floor.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Emerald Point]
description: Still steep, the path here winds down the side of the peak.  To the east, the next peak shines white in the clear moonlight.
Still steep, the path here winds down the side of the peak.  To the east, the next peak shines bright white in the harsh sunlight.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Emerald Point]
description: On the highest point of this peak, an uneven half ring of ice-coated stone spires makes a sheltered spot.  To the south, the elongated green rectangle of the Emerald Forest stretches out from the bottom of the foothills into the purple haze of distance.  At your feet, almost hidden by the overlapping of two spires, a large hole leads back into a darkened recess.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Emerald Point]
description: Here at the top of the crevasse, there is a dangerous looking gap where a thick sheet of ice has broken away from the rock wall of the mountainside.  Blowing snow is already beginning to fill in the opening, threatening to widen it.  This glacier may turn from slow moving ice to unbelievably fast moving ice any time now.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: The night chill gives the always-cold air a cruel bite that stabs through your clothing like a knife.  Pale moonlight bounces off sheets of ice, elongating shadows and illuminating drifts of opalescent snow.

Harsh sunlight blazes here, though in this rarefied air it provides no heat.  The unforgiving cold and the whipping wind stave off any warmth the sun could provide.  The bright light itself is painful as it bounces off the mirror-intensity ice and snow.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: A rock overhang partially shelters this part of the trail.  A curve of moonlit snow dips below the edge of it like an apron.  This small protection from the constant wind has been noticed by other inhabitants of the area as evidenced by faint hoof prints in the dense snow underfoot.

A rock overhang partially shelters this part of the trail.  A curve of bright white snow dips below the edge of it like an apron.  This small protection from the constant wind has been noticed by other inhabitants of the area as evidenced by faint hoof prints in the dense snow underfoot.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: Black ice coats everything on the north face of the mountain.  Snow clings to it in cracks and crevices, but blows by in a flurry everywhere else.  The track is slick and climbing is perilous.  Half frozen into the ice are the tattered remains of a canvas backpack, doubtless left behind by some climber desperate to lighten his load.
