title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley of Peace]
description: A worn track threads through piles of broken rock and snow-covered scree.  More suited to mountain rolton than the upright races, it winds up and around toward the north face of the mountainside.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley of Peace]
description: The floor of the valley is featureless and white.  Each step you take threatens to pin your leg in a jagged hole as your foot breaks through the hardened top layer of snow.  A scraggly stick poking out of the ground looks suspiciously like the top of a pine tree.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley of Peace]
description: This shallow valley is covered in a blue-white snowfield.  On the far side, a wall of broken rocks emerges from the dense white surface to begin the climb up the next peak.  If there is a passable trail, it is not visible at this distance.  Here, the mountain face is a smooth rock surface pierced with faint lines.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley View]
description: A jagged horizontal crack parts the rock along the base of the trail making an uncomfortable space between you and the mountain.  Although the trail here seems solid and is not as steep as in the higher reaches, the effect is dizzying.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley View]
description: From here a moonlit snow-covered valley can be seen far below.  Across the pearl grey field, another peak stands even with this one, almost entirely hiding two other peaks behind it.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley View]
description: Snow and sleet pelts you mercilessly, thudding against your clothing and stinging your skin wherever it touches.  The trail wraps around the side of the peak, steeply canted and slick with ice.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Topaz Point]
description: The uneven trail is almost vertical here, and keeping your balance is difficult.  The ice-covered wall of the mountain is veined with spidery cracks which might give purchase to a grasping hand.  A collection of sticks or bones is wedged into the bottom of one of the larger ones.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Topaz Point]
description: A jagged spire of granite rises out of the ground in this unexpected flat spot on the top of the peak.  A huge nest constructed of tree branches, whole bushes, and bits and pieces of broken armor takes up most of the available space in this sheltered spot.  What ground you can see is littered with the bones of small and not-so-small animals frozen into the ice.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Topaz Point]
description: This steeply curved ledge winds around an ice-slicked bend and ends against the side of an uneven stone spire.  The craggy tops of other spires can be seen beyond it, forming a nearly straight line.  Where the spire and the mountainside meet, a long dark crevice looks wide enough to provide shelter.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Snow Scramble]
description: Lack of handholds on the ice covered rock and piles of shifting snow on the trail make progress slow and painful.  A loud, shrill sound echoes down the wall of the mountainside.  One can only hope that it is the shriek of the wind.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Snow Scramble]
description: The thin trail crawls up the mountain face, making upright travel impossible.  The wind stirs up the blanket of snow that covers everything, muffling the shapes of the rock and making a careless step a potential disaster.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Snow Scramble]
description: Getting a purchase on wall or ground is difficult here as any handhold is hidden under layers of ice.  The air is white with blowing snow, and visibility is about as good as it would be for a bug inside a bag of flour.

title: [Kraken Manor, Courtyard]
description: Standing in the center of the walled courtyard is a masterfully crafted water fountain created in the image of a sea kraken.  Wrapped in the kraken's tentacles is a flawless crown-of-Charl shell, from which the water cascades into the base of the fountain.  Well-kept flowerbeds containing an assortment of exotic flowers have been bordered with a collection of ruby-lined nassa shells, along with yellow, pink, and blue coquina shells.  An opal-flecked walkway leads up to a set of double doors.

title: [Kraken Manor, Entrance Hall]
description: An elegant stairway dominates this spacious foyer as it curves round and round leading up to the second floor.  Suspended from the balustrade above is a dark green silk banner that has been embroidered with the words, "Welcome One And All," in gold thread.  Polished to a shine, the speckled marble floor is uncluttered, save for an elaborately made coat rack with carved seashells.

title: [Kraken Manor, Hall of Mirrors]
description: Underfoot, plush ivory-colored carpet spreads from wall to wall, and dozens of ornate mirrors hang on the deep blue watersilk walls.  The corners on each of the mirror frames have been inlaid with silvery conch shells.  Underneath each mirror stand tables with gilded edges, each bearing transparent quartz vases with a bouquet of blood-red roses.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Kraken Manor, Dining Hall]
description: Three steps lead up to the platform of a raised dais, where a massive rectangular-shaped oak table rests.  Intricately carved chairs covered in blue velvet surround the table.  Serving as a centerpiece, a crystal bowl is filled with exotic and local fruit.  Mouthwatering aromas of roasting meat and baking bread drift in from the nearby kitchen.

title: [Kraken Manor, Library]
description: A considerable-sized, oval-shaped, lacquered table with matching chairs dominates the center of the room.  Standing in the middle of the table is a fair-sized jade and gold vase that is overflowing with purple monkey flowers.  A roaring fire blazes within the fireplace, casting deep shadows along the walls and marble floor.  Built-in bookcases are filled with dusty leather-bound tomes.

title: [Kraken Manor, Parlour]
description: Clustered together in several small circles are high-backed leather armchairs.  Nestled in the center of each group of chairs are tables, which are constructed from black willow and trimmed in rhimar metal.  Delicate wisps of cigar smoke drift lazily in the air as its sweet, pungent scent fills the room.  Heavy brocatelle curtains completely block the bay window behind.

title: [Kraken Manor, Kitchen]
description: The breeze coming from the open window does little to alleviate the heat in this room.  Hanging on the walls by the hearth is an assortment of copper pots and stoneware.  Spread out over a wooden cutting table are various spoons, knives, and forks with long wooden handles used in the daily preparation of the meals.  A trail of spilled flour leads toward the partially opened door of the pantry.  At the far end of the kitchen, a darkened doorway leading down to the wine cellar stands wide open.

title: [Kraken Manor, Wine Cellar]
description: Racks of clay bottle-holders take up most of the floor space in this spacious and well-lit wine cellar.  Nestled in their own individual cradles, touching nothing but their supports are bottles of wine, made from the nearby vineyards.  Polished oak paneling covers the stone walls and the natural knots in the paneling resemble eyes.  In one corner of the room, a tall wood cabinet with stained glass is pushed up against the wall, its door stands slightly ajar.

title: [Wine Cellar, Alcove]
description: A low murmuring, like the sound of whispering voices, fills the room.  A slowly twirling globe lantern hangs mysteriously overhead, its violet tint creating a variety of odd shape-shifting shadows against the walls and floor.  Creeping, finger-like tendrils of a fine mist rise slowly upwards, slightly obscuring vision.  An abstract noise, very much like the sound of something ripping, grows increasingly perceptible, drowning out the whispering.

title: [Wine Cellar, Hallway]
description: Flanking both sides of the gilded doorway are two sets of immaculate suits of armor.  One of the sets wears a helmet that greatly resembles the head of a bird, and the other holds a wickedly barbed mace in both gauntleted fists.  Cerulean carpeting spreads from wall-to-wall and a low oval-shaped glass cabinet containing an ancient map is surrounded by an assortment of seashells and sand.

title: [Wine Cellar, Office]
description: An intricately carved oak desk, which is trimmed in coraesine metal, dominates this room.  The wood trim of a high-backed leather chair has been inlaid with an assortment of crushed pink and blue coquina shells, and is twisted sideways to the desk.  The wall opposite the desk has a mural of a map depicting the geography of the early Turamzzyr Empire.  Hanging from metal supports in the walls is an assemblage of various weapons of war.

title: [Wine Cellar, Hallway]
description: Resting on the plush, cerulean carpeting is a frosted glass cabinet that contains an assortment of crystal figurines.  A black velvet painting depicting a school of dolphins flanking both sides of a fishing vessel hangs on the wall opposite the door.  Placed directly on both sides of the doorway are identical copper pots containing snapdragons in full bloom.

title: [Wine Cellar, Nexus]
description: Murals on the walls depict various scenes from the life and times of the earlier years of the Turamzzyrian Empire.  Soft tinkling sounds and the scent of wild roses fill the room giving it a light and carefree atmosphere.  Swaying gently back and forth from the heavy chain that holds it securely to the ceiling, the prisms of a multifaceted crystal chandelier create a musical sound.  The crystal prisms refract the light and lengthen the shadows over the walls and floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Wine Cellar, Services]
description: An oval-shaped table has been set in the center of a semi-circular row of waist-high filing cabinets.  Inlaid with crushed pieces of crown-of-Charl shells, a high-backed chair sits on the marble floor between the table and cabinets.  There is a neat stack of papers on one corner of the desk, which is held down by a fluted limpet shell.  On the northern wall, a raised mural depicts a scene of children running and laughing in a field of wild flowers.

title: [Wine Cellar, Library]
description: Glazed and then polished to a mirror-like finish, a half-moon shaped modwir desk stands slightly off-center before several rows of tall bookcases.  Well-maintained ancient tomes, scrolls, and manuscripts have been neatly placed inside of a locked glass cabinet.  To protect its contents, the cabinet has a thick tri-colored rope surrounding it to prevent anyone from coming too near.  In each corner of the room are vibrantly colored potted plants.

title: [Wine Cellar, Altar]
description: Constructed from white monir, an altar has been masterfully carved with vines and flowers in all shapes and sizes.  Frosted glass-globed lanterns have been strategically placed throughout the area and cast a warm, soft glow of light, which illuminates the low altar.  Directly behind the altar is a marble statue of a robed female figure, with her head bowed and her hands clasped together as if in prayer.  Piles of pillows in varying shades of yellow, green, and white spread out from the base of the altar.

title: [Old News Pawnshop]
description: Several tables of carefully displayed items have been arranged around the room.  A prominent sign reads, "All items sold as-is and all sales are final."  A sales clerk carefully tags items from a crate before placing them on the appropriate tables.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Cave]
description: Snow billows into a tall tunnel and drifts against the walls.  A few steps from the mouth, the cave opens out into a wide cavern that is taken up almost entirely by a huge nest.  Tree branches, entire bushes, and other debris have been crudely woven together to form a roughly circular structure that would stand chest high to a giant.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Corrie]
description: In the bitter cold, it's hard to imagine anything melting, but a stream of rushing black water cuts through the valley floor here.  Rounded rocks on the creek's banks are covered with dense, clear blue ice.  In between two of the larger rocks, what should be a space filled with ice or snow looks only dark and empty.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: Water gushes out of a large vertical crack in the rock face, cutting a gash in the trail and falling over the side into the valley below.  Thick, black ice has accumulated high up along the edges of the crack showing just how deep the water can get.

description: The sound of rushing water provides the bass for the piercing shriek of the wind.  From time to time a sharp squawk or a chorus of shrill caws provide percussion.  The steep, ice-laden trail hugs the mountainside closely as it winds around huge wrinkles in the rock face.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: A narrow arch has been carved through one of the particularly broad outthrusts of rock.  The work is hurried and inelegant, with the far side of it being no more than a broken opening.  Still, without it, the trail would have ended here.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Ruby Point]
description: Above, a jagged red peak looks close enough to touch.  Fierce wind streaming down the mountainside makes it difficult to stay on the trail, and the climb from here is very steep.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Ruby Point]
description: The top of this peak is little more than a snow-topped spike of red granite.   Footing is precarious, and the pummeling wind does not invite contemplation.  The trail drops away steeply from the peak on two sides.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Ruby Point]
description: To the north, the DragonSpine Mountains march off into the distance, their moonlit white grandeur providing a breathtaking backdrop for the climb.  By contrast, the peak just across the valley looks less inviting, topped as it is with jagged black outcroppings of stone.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Ruby Point]
description: A huge nest takes up the entire available level space in this cramped cave.  Inside it you see grisly reminders of what it would be like to be caught here by the inhabitants.  A faded red cap dangles forlornly from the broken end of one of the many tree branches woven into the nest.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: The trail is almost vertical here, and travel would be impossible if not for the metal rings that some long ago hand has hammered into the rock to serve as handholds.  They seem to have held steady for years as they themselves are covered with layers of the black ice that is everywhere.

title: [Locksmith, Salesroom]
description: The walls of this shop are covered with keys and locks of all colors, shapes, and sizes, from large iron padlocks to bone-white skeleton keys.  A white-hot coal fire burns steadily under a pot of molten metal over which stoops the locksmith's apprentice.  Forms for keys and lock parts sit wedged in sand on a wood work table nearby.  To the north, a dimly lit doorway recedes into the shadows.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The edge of a conifer forest presents itself.  The trees thicken northward until they completely block the horizon.  To the south the landscape opens up to allow fields and pastures with only an occasional clump of trees to punctuate the scenery.  Smooth and dry, the cobblestone road provides easy passage in both directions, although here and there some of the cobblestones are missing, replaced by clumps of dark green weeds.

title: [Wooded Hillside, Trail]
description: Overhanging branches and spreading underbrush nearly conceal the narrow trail, the strip of trampled leaves and packed earth barely obvious enough to hint at the passing of many woodland feet over the years.  The wooded hillside slopes slightly down to the east, but the dark woods obscure any sight of what may lie in that direction.

The wooded hillside slopes slightly down to the east, but the thickening woods obscure any sight of what may lie in that direction.

title: [Sylvarraend, Mistglin Wey]
description: The trail peters to an end in a small but well-kept woodland garden nestled beneath a small group of haon and oak trees.  Delicate white blaeston blooms glow in the moonlight across the breadth of the garden.  The sweet fragrances of wild sage and rosemary drift on the night air.

The trail peters to an end in a small but well-kept woodland garden nestled beneath a small group of haon and oak trees.  Delicate white blaeston blooms across the breadth of the garden, interspersed with more brightly colored blossoms along the edges of the clearing.  Patches of wild sage and rosemary grow beside the solitary stone bench, filling the area with a sweet fragrance.

title: [The Sea Chest]
description: The inside of this old shed still looks like...a shed.  At any rate it's clean, and a single table holds an assortment of traditional seafaring accoutrements.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood, Trail]
description: Here at the trailhead, just beneath the cresting at Whistler's Pass, the surrounding landscape of the ancient forest is like a dark blanket settled over a valley.  To the southeast, the keep of Ta'Vaalor barely rises above the treeline edging Fearling Pass, its tower torches casting a tiny fiery glow in the otherwise blackened night.

Here at the trailhead, just beneath the cresting at Whistler's Pass, the surrounding landscape of the ancient forest is breathtaking.  Jutting out and away from the mountainside, the view captures a glimpse of Mreanith Lake to the south and the rolling hills of Khalerineth Valley to the east.  Just beyond, the keep of Ta'Vaalor barely rises above the treeline edging Fearling Pass.

title: [Cairnfang, South Bank]
description: A rambling half-timbered building stands along the north side of the road, its size and second story proclaiming it as an inn or public house.  Fresh whitewash on the plaster and stain on the timbers gives it a new look, but the moss on the weather-bleached wooden shingles suggest that the building is older than the bridge to the west.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Exterior]
description: Low stone walls surround the caravansary grounds, here in the shadow of Vornavis' north wall.  Easily visible over the low walls are the tops of the beast pens, the board-and-canvas roofs of the caravansary's less temporary structures, and the peaks of the caravaners' tents.  Two square stone pillars mark the ends of the walls and the entrance to the caravansary grounds.  Set into the pillars are a pair of wardstones.

title: [Vornavis Cliffs, River Trail]
description: The roaring sound of the Cairnfang falling into the bay fills your ears at the top of the trail.  A group of huge boulders blocks any view of the river from here.

title: [Garden of Death]
description: This enclosed area looks remarkably like a graveyard, with a large brownstone crypt standing at the center of a garden of blank white marble headstones.  Beside the crypt, a boulder rests with a brass plaque set into its surface.

Blank white marble headstones dot the uneven landscape of red-veined creepers and thick crabgrass, the bulk of which is yellowed and hovering between life and death.  An immense brownstone crypt stands at the center of the dying garden.  The ancient cypress leaning over it boasts a wealth of gnarled branches, the black, finger-like shadows of which strain over the austere cenotaph.  Some reach so far as to brush the bulk of a boulder with a brass plaque set into its surface.

title: [Garden of Destruction]
description: Devoid of living plants, the "garden" is a desolate volcanic wasteland.  Large boulders of glaes-striated tufa sit half-buried in cinders, cracks gaping here and there in the various stones.  Sculpted bronze demonic limbs protrude from the larger crevices, while a large, bronze statue stands crouched in the garden's center.

title: [Garden of Suffering]
description: Pure white cobblestones mark the entrance to a low-roofed marble shrine, its alabaster surface wrought with a tangle of crimson veins.  Fluted columns of the same unblemished ivory hue line the walkway leading to the small structure, each set with stylized black daggers overlaying faceted ruby hearts.  Well-trimmed topiaries flank the edges of the garden, their inorganic shapes and deep green leaves adding a touch of elegance to the surroundings.

title: [Andelas' Temple, Entry Hall]
description: Large columns of jet black marble ascending toward the high ceiling compliment the patterns of crimson flowing along the walls in elaborate designs.  Small niches are carved into the stone surroundings, each containing stylized golden felines beset with unblinking, dark ruby eyes.  A high dome expands to the north, while a pair of engraved felwood doors loom to the south.

title: [Dark Alley]
description: The brick paving ends several feet to the north and an aged stone wall blocks further passage.  Piles of debris and refuse have been strewn along the alleyway, several feet high in some places.  Minimal light from the sun filters in causing the shadows to dance and waver.

The brick paving ends several feet to the north and an aged stone wall blocks further passage.  Piles of debris and refuse have been strewn along the alleyway, several feet high in some places.  Minimal light from the moons filters in causing the shadows to dance and waver.

title: [Garden of Forbidden Knowledge]
description: Shrubs, small trees and neatly bordered garden beds filled with a variety of plants and herbs are clustered about the garden, centered around sculptures of granite, sandstone and limestone.  At the heart of the park rests a bronze statue of an aged man with a thick tome open on his lap, a brass plaque set into a granite boulder at its feet.

title: [Garden of Desire]
description: Lilac bushes burdened with dark purple blossoms line the low walls of this small garden, sirenflowers and lavender filling the beds around them.  Standing in front of several fan-shaped trellises laden with fragrant passionflower vines, a bronze statue of a cloaked woman faces all who enter.  A boulder bearing a brass plaque rests at her feet.

title: [Vornavis, Ruins]
description: A thin layer of loose stones and gravel covers the hardpan, providing rootholds for only a sparse scattering of ragged plantains.  Here and there the smooth surfaces and symmetrical edges of ancient flagstoning are visible.

title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: Eddies and currents tug at the rafts of thickly-tarred barrels supporting this walkway that parallels the river.  Barrels of refuse line the boardwalk on either side.  A concerted effort has obviously been made to keep the marsh free of debris.  To the southwest, a crowded pier juts out into Solhaven Bay.  To the north, the walkway drives deeper into Marshtown.

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen]
description: Dimly lit by kraken-oil lamps, the interior of the Sea Troll's Kitchen is crowded with upholstered booths at each point of the compass except due south.  The center of the south wall is taken up by the order counter, and the diner's jawbone doorway stands opposite it between the north and northeast booths.  Obviously shooting for that cozy, run-down waterfront diner atmosphere, with booths that are far past their prime, it's not clear whether "cozy" or "run-down" is the dominant element.

title: [Hall]
description: A wrought iron railing runs the length of the western side of the corridor, preventing accidental forays into the ground floor courtyard below.  The stars are visible through a skylight set in the courtyard's arched ceiling, well above your head.  A wide arch in the outer wall leads into what appears to be a formal dining area, although several tables are placed out on the landing for patrons to enjoy the cool night air.

A wrought iron railing runs the length of the western side of the corridor, preventing accidental forays into the ground floor courtyard below.  Sunlight pours through a skylight set in the courtyard's arched ceiling, well above your head.  A wide arch in the outer wall leads into what appears to be a formal dining area, although several tables are placed out on the landing for those who prefer the fresh air.

title: [Hall]
description: A small, whitewashed curio cabinet sits diagonally in the corner of the hall, a number of cleverly crafted gem and metal figurines visible through its glass door.  Some appear to have been painted and arranged in mock battles, and while each one is of a size very suitable for a pocket, they do not appear to be mismatched as so many of the guild's other accoutrements are.

title: [Hall]
description: An elaborate plaque hangs from the brass-trimmed door in the southern wall.  Opposite the door, a pair of windows looks down into the courtyard below, although it is impossible to see much through them, due to the glare from an oil lamp resting in the iron sconce between them.

An elaborate plaque hangs from the brass-trimmed door in the southern wall of this brightly lit hallway.  A pair of windows opposite the door looks down into the courtyard below, while allowing the sunlight to play off the door's trimmings.  A thick iron sconce set between the windows holds an unlit oil lamp.

title: [Sylvarraend, Glade]
description: A sense of serenity blankets the glade, undisturbed by the drifting breeze that dances around the surrounding trees.  In the distance, Sylvarraend is merely a collection of pinpoints of light in the tranquil darkness.  Cast in cool moonlight, twelve white stones encircle a pale limestone altar that houses the occasional tribute to this shrine celebrating the quiet beauty of nature.

A sense of serenity blankets the glade, undisturbed by the drifting breeze that dances around the surrounding trees.  Lush grass is spotted by the occasional wildflower, a florid island amidst an ocean of green.  Twelve white stones encircle a pale limestone altar that houses the occasional tribute to this shrine celebrating the quiet beauty of nature.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood, Trail]
description: Ancient blue spruce trees and bristlecone pines give way to clumps of tanik, creating a shadowy presence in this section of the thick forest climbing the ridge along Whistler's Pass.  The silence is omnipresent, broken only by the lone hoot of a saw-whet owl.

Ancient blue spruce trees and bristlecone pines give way to clumps of tanik, creating a very cooling hue in this section of the thick forest climbing the ridge along Whistler's Pass.  Birds call out from their tall perches up in the canopy and the ground cover growth rustles now and again as chipmunks scamper about.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood, Trail]
description: The trail continues its twisting climb, and signs of recent maintenance are evident from split timbers that line the sides of the trodden path.  A wispy scarlet ribbon, slightly frayed along the ends, dangles forlornly from the branch of a low thanot bush sporting slender thorns.  A secondary path of fitted cobblestones, tucked between two hedges, splits away into the trees.

The trail continues its twisting climb, and signs of recent maintenance are evident from split timbers that line the sides of the trodden path.  Low tanik bushes sporting slender thorns threaten to jab all those that pass too close.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood, Trail]
description: Blue spruce trees mix with silvery beeches and golden aspens as the trail switchbacks along the mountainside.  Several tree trunks that have succumbed to the ravages of time have cracked and fallen, forming triangulated right angles to still-rooted bases.  Thick moss covers the upper sections of the decaying wood, while the hollowed centers house birds and other wildlife.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood, Trail]
description: A soothing, babbling rush signals that a waterfall is close by, yet the thick foliage and plentiful trunks of the forest don't afford much of a view beyond the immediate trail and several steps off in any direction.  The incline ascends steeply to the northwest, yet appears to be leveling off towards the southwest.  Standing out like a giant amongst the labyrinth of trees, a sequoia looms to the east.  Nestled up against the colossal timber is a riverstone cottage accompanied by a cobbled pathway.

The incline ascends steeply to the northwest, yet appears to be leveling off towards the southwest.

title: [Glimae'den Wildwood, Trail]
description: The trail flattens out here, traversing along even ground through a recently maintained break in the brush.  Aromatic sassafras, with its hand-shaped lobed leaves, is predominant in this forested area, thriving in spite of the moon-silhouetted stands of beech and aspen.

The trail flattens out here, traversing along even ground through a recently maintained break in the brush.  Aromatic sassafras, with its hand-shaped lobed leaves, is predominant in this forested area, thriving in spite of the sun-dappling stands of beech and aspen.

The trail flattens out here, traversing along even ground through a recently maintained break in the brush.  Branching off to the east is a a smooth sandy path.  Aromatic sassafras, with its hand-shaped lobed leaves, is predominant in this forested area, thriving in spite of the moon-silhouetted stands of beech and aspen.

title: [Cysaegir, Citadel Drawbridge]
description: Massive stones, pale grey in color, and fitted together so well that the joins are nearly invisible, rest at the top of a brush covered hill.  Blaestonberry cling heartily to the tower-flanked gates with a vaulted archway in the center of the stone wall.  Vines struggle in vain to reach the pointed domes of the towers, which appear to be made of polished silver in the moonlight.  Running along one side of the wall rising up here is a narrow path traversing down into a deep gorge.

Massive stones, pale grey in color, and fitted together so well that the joins are nearly invisible, rest at the top of a low hill.  Blaestonberry cling heartily to the tower-flanked gates with a vaulted archway in the center of the stone wall.  Sunlight glitters on the pointed domes of the towers, making it appear as if the domes themselves are made of burnished gold.  Running along one side of the wall rising up here is a narrow path traversing down into a deep gorge.

title: [Cysaegir, Citadel Bailey]
description: Twin towers stand as sentinels to a vaulted archway leading out to the town common.  The adjoining, thick stone walls extend to encircle a grassy bailey, until they butt up against the stony face of the granite mountainside.  Protected within this small fortress are a rustic wooden hostelry and the grey granite facade of the bank.
Twin towers stand as sentinels to a vaulted archway leading out to the town common.  Across from the bank is a pale stone gate that gives entrance to a corral near the wooden hostelry.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: Thick oak beams are nailed together to form a wide platform suspended from the trunks of massive trees.  The planks are cut to split around a particularly wide one and both sections wind further into the shadowy forest.  A sturdy rope bridge leads over a rushing waterfall towards an aqueduct, while a single oak plank leads away from the main platform and comes to rest on the edge of a hollowed out opening in a nearby tree.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: Hugging the tree's southern side, the platform stretches out eastward over the large supportive branches of the ancient forest.  A hemlock tree pokes through an intentional break in the planking and looks sturdy enough to climb down to get to ground level.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: The platform follows the contour of a tanik tree to the south and butts up against its rough bark.  The north side has a stout wood-beamed railing to prevent a drop down to the forest floor.  The only break in the beams is for a rope ladder leading down to the ground.  Carved into the bark is a pair of initials surrounded by a crude heart.

title: [Cysaegir, Wishing Well]
description: Nestled beneath the peacefully spreading branches of several tanik trees is a charming, fel-gabled edifice.  Set in the elegant bay window, a lone candle burns and an inviting soft light spills forth from the opened window.  A wishing well, affixed with a polished plaque set in its center stands not far off from the building.  Trumpet-shaped purple blossoms of mournblooms snake along the lip of the wishing well and vines of creeping clematis drape down the sides.

Nestled beneath the peacefully spreading branches of several tanik trees is a charming, fel-gabled edifice.  Glimpsed from the open bay window, a set of ivory brocade drapes billow on a soft breeze.  A wishing well, affixed with a polished plaque set at its center stands not far off from the building.  Trumpet-shaped purple blossoms of mournblooms snake along the lip of the wishing well and vines of creeping clematis drape down the sides.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: This side of the tree platform ends here in an open, rounded area.  Set along the south side of the platform is a circular riser elevated to the level of the railing, providing a precarious perch for those wishing to take in the view at this height.  Tied off on one side of the railing are several lengths of rope that can be seen climbing up into higher tree branches overhead.

Perched high in the trees, the platform ends here in an open, rounded area.  Set along the south side of the platform is a circular riser elevated to the level of the railing, providing a precarious perch for those wishing to take in the view at this height.  Tied off on one side of the railing are several lengths of rope that can be seen climbing up into higher tree branches overhead.  A small wooden structure juts out from the decking suspended over the ground below by supports attached to the side of the trunk.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: The platform turns sharply here, around the trunk of an ancient tanik tree, and features reinforced railings along both sides.  Coming to a stop at a raised section, steps climb up a set of risers that lead to a bar where several lengths of rope have been tied off.  The other end of those hempen cables soar high into the towering treetop canopy.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: The platform here is interrupted by a massive tree and the decking splits around the trunk, continuing on in northeasterly and southeasterly directions.  A large central section of the tree has been carved away and a large bell hangs within the tiny wooden alcove.

title: [Gaertira's Herbs]
description: Colorfully-painted planters brimming with fresh herbs and flowers are supported by wooden poles that are evenly spaced around this open-air platform.  The numerous fragrances of this tiny treetop garden mingle together into a delightful harmony of aroma.  A modwir counter has been topped off with a granite slab, serving as a worktable for creating tinctures, tonics, and other healing concoctions.

title: [Laetira's Dispensary]
description: Glass and teak shelves hang securely from the branches of a towering oak that rises through the center of this wide platform.  A pair of white linen-draped cots have been separated by a translucent curtain painted with whimsicial butterflies and flowers, in order to maintain patient privacy.  Gilded wind chimes jingle melodically in the breeze while delicately-scented votives perfume the air with their subtle fragrance.

title: [Treetop Market]
description: Fragrant wisteria coils around the white-washed latticework that has been suspended as the ceiling, from which dangles several of the smaller wares for sale.  Stocked shelves are festooned with garlands of lilies and roses, while lovely bouquets sit upon display tables.  An antique rocking chair with a throw blanket folded over one arm rests cozily beside a simple carved stand.

title: [Cysaegir, Disk Statue]
description: Thick vines of creeping clematis completely entwine the bole of a hemlock tree.  A curious looking relic rests beneath its spreading branches.  Revolving slowly on an invisible axis above a pedestal made of intricate stonework traceries is an oval-shaped disk of glass.  Relieving the darkness, alternating shades of purple, pink, and white light flash from within the depths of the disk.  The air and ground immediately surrounding the relic seems to shimmer and crackle with energy.

Revolving slowly on an invisible axis above a pedestal made of intricate stonework traceries is an oval-shaped disk of glass. The air and ground immediately surrounding the relic seems to shimmer and crackle with energy.

title: [Cysaegir, Vista Knoll]
description: Cresting the top of the hill provides an ideal vantage point of the snow-capped mountains that tower in the distance and the town common spreading out below.  The wan glow of a moon peeks out from between two of the largest mountains, their perpetual misty clouds breaking apart to allow a thick beam of light.  Illuminated by the faint moonlight is a small clearing surrounded on three sides by thick ancient forest growth and a steep mountain slope in the remaining direction.

title: [Cysaegir, Garden]
description: Brilliant displays of flora in methodic rows thrive in the garden, creating a quiet, soothing peace of calm and beauty.  Moonbeams shine on the surface of flat rocks serving as stepping stones and reveal deeply embedded flecks of color.  The carefully placed stones are arranged in a symmetrical pattern to allow movement through the garden without fear of trampling the delicate flowers.  Directly in the center of the garden, an oval-shaped, thick block of clear crystal encases a deep pool of water.

title: [Cysaegir, Linsandrych Common]
description: Placed strategically under a leafy arbor for shade, a vine-carved bench hides in the darkness.  Interrupting the natural beauty of a grassy knoll sprinkled with a scattering of buttercups is a lattice-worked gazebo.  A slate-paved walkway that snakes through flowering bushes and trees leads toward the steps of the structure.  Gorgeous bell-shaped flowers in shades of blue and pink encircle the base of a pedestal upon which a magnificent gold statue of an elven man is perched.

title: [Cysaegir, Linsandrych Common]
description: Centered on a stretch of land, in the middle of a network of several small ponds, is the beckoning shelter of a growth of willow trees.  Their long, graceful branches sway gently back and forth on a barely palpable wind.  A soft rustling sound emits from the characteristic leaves covering the branches of the willow trees that droop and almost reach to the ground.  Under the wavering light of the moon, the willow trees resemble ghosts dragging their distended arms along the surface of the ground.

title: [Gems of the Earth]
description: Shards of colored glass dangle from the ceiling, casting a myriad of jewel tones upon the platform as sunlight shines through them.  A simple wooden counter houses two rather large chests and serves as the only furniture on this level of the store.  Sturdy-looking steps rise to the second floor in a wide spiral around a massive tree trunk.

title: [Cysaegir, Linsandrych Common]
description: Moonlight glints on broken shards of glass littering the ground around a ramshackle cabin that is surrounded by rank weeds.  Bursting through the floor and roof of the cabin is a twisted tree.  Barely hanging on its last remaining hinge, a huge rusted lock is the only thing that is keeping the door from falling to the ground.  Not far off, on a scorched piece of land, the bare trees beyond the shed look like fingers stripped to the bone.

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Base]
description: Water crashes down from overhead and breaks over several crags jutting out from the face of the mountainside.  A cave mouth creates a dark roundish shadow peeking out from behind the curtain of cascading water, near an overgrown path leading back up the side of the steep gorge.  Heading east from the crystaline pool collecting at the base of the cliff, a cobblestone walk glimmers in the moonlight as it leads to the town common.

A cave mouth partially peeks out from behind the curtain of cascading water, near an overgrown path leading back up the side of the steep gorge. title: [Cysaegir, Tribute]
description: Erected on a clover-covered section of the field is an elaborate sculpture protected behind a barrier of hedges surrounded by a rail fence.  Frozen in time and locked in mortal combat are two bronze figures, one of an elf, the other of a kiramon.

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Switchback]
description: A slight mist fills the air here and is accompanied by the rushing sound of the nearby waterfall.  The rough bark on the tree log cross-section steps provides sturdy footing for any that try to navigate the narrow, switchbacking mountain trail.  Trees, grass, and other lush flora glisten and thrive in the gentle dampness here, nearly obscuring an overgrown path that leads down to the bottom of the gorge.

title: [Cysaegir, Behind Waterfall]
description: Water flows down over the rockface, creating small puddles that either need to be stepped over or crossed through to enter the cave mouth.  Echoes from the waterfall bounce against the walls of this grotto.  Small holes serve as natural sconces for several burning mullein torches, their flickering light creating dancing shadows along the surface and revealing a narrow opening to the north.

title: [Cysaegir, Boulder]
description: A lichen-coated boulder that strongly resembles a rabbit missing one ear rests beside an ivy-covered bungalow.  Placed just outside the doors of the building is a polished white-marble bench that has a raggedy toy sorcerer perched precariously on the edge of the seat.  A circle of light from the opened doorway illuminates ground that is paved with numerous multicolored tiles that create a superb mosaic depicting a kneeling elven child proffering a budding red rose to a woman of indescribable beauty.

title: [Cysaegir, Pond]
description: The lotus-shaped blossoms of water lilies dot the moon-streaked surface of the pond, and several stepping stones lead down into the water.  Towering over a square cottage and a matching riverstone bungalow is an old birch tree.  Pieces of its papery-thin bark litter the ground, and an assortment of red and blue trafel mushrooms grows at the base of its trunk.

A family of frolicking geese creates a cacophony of sound as they playfully swim around the pond nipping at each other.  A lone duck swims the circumference of a barrel, which is next to the entrance of a square cottage made of riverstone. title: [Hihaeim's Locksmithery]
description: Plaster and stone walls remain unadorned, along with the majority of the room.  Though vacant, the shop is meticulously clean and nary a speck of dust can be found.  A bejeweled brass bin is tucked behind a smooth granite counter, prominently displaying a catalog of wares.  Warm light shines through a narrow oak archway draped in pale blue fabric.

title: [Helden Hall, Private Armory]
description: This small chamber is made purely of stone.  Torchlight illuminates all and the pungent smell of polishing oil fills the air.  A bedraggled brown curtain covers half the room.

title: [Cysaegir, Pond]
description: Low, drooping branches of a willow tree gently caress the surface of the warm, crystal clear water.  Wisps of steam rise up, prompted by the thermal vents along the bottom of the spring, and create a series of effervescent bubbles that glide along the surface.  Moss clings thickly to the tree, and every so often a strong breeze causes a flurry of its catkins to take flight.  Thriving swamp buttercups break the surface and lily pads float serenely around the circumference of the pond.

title: [Cysaegir, Waterwheels]
description: Magnificent rose bushes with deep-pink petals that fade to a white toward their centers are in full bloom alongside a millpond.  The shadows of the dormant waterwheels loom in the night like huge, stalking beasts.  Spiderwebs of clematis creep along the grey walls of a rustic stone mill.  Every so often a loud clanging sound echoes from somewhere behind the building.

title: [Cysaegir, Retreat]
description: Following the natural contour of the land, a cobblestone walkway lined with columns meanders around a pool, large enough for several giantman to recline in comfortably.  Cascading waterfalls are etched on the bronze apron of the deep basin and set with a trim of golden topaz cabochons.  A detailed peacock on a field of blue rests at the center-bottom of the limestone lining.  A wrought-iron gate bars the end of the walkway, and the shape of a building is barely visible under the night sky.

title: [Haegan's Weaponry]
description: Recent renovations are apparent in this small shop, from the new tile floor to a rather pristine wood-paneled walls.  The tang of metal and faint scent of oil linger in the air, drifting over from the neighboring forge.  A small burnished counter stands before several organized racks that display the numerous weapons for sale.

title: [Bulwark, Yard]
description: A garden thrives with creeping clematis and blaestonberry covering the walls on this side of the gate.  Crowns of trees stretch high above the walls of thick stone.  Boxwoods shaped into an odd group of creatures stand sentinel on the grounds.  In the dim light of the moon, the topiaries cast menacing shadows across the ground.  Rocks that have been chiseled into their current forms and fit together like puzzle pieces protectively surround beds of flowers in full bloom.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall]
description: Ivory inlaid doors line both sides of the hallway.  Most of the doors remain closed and locked while the rooms behind them are still undergoing construction.  Further down the hall, an opened doorway that leads to the citizenship office and a stairway leads to the upper floor.  A magnificent bouquet of delphinuris thrives in a faceted crystal vase sitting atop an ebonwood table that features fluted legs and gilded scrollwork.

title: [Cysaegir, Reformatory Entry]
description: Marble walls with thick gold veins snake their way through the crystallized rock that sparkles every so often.  Save for a lone ladder-backed chair in the far corner and a sapphire blue banner with the words, "Knowledge is the key to eternity" embroidered in white thread, the vast chamber is bare of furnishings.  Brilliantly colored floor terrazzo come together to form a breathtaking image of a drake in flight.  Sunlight falls from the opened entryway causing some of the tiles to glow softly.

title: [Cysaegir, Pebble Pathway]
description: Shadowed by fiddlehead ferns, a pathway of soft white pebbles follows the gentle curve of a bubbling brook as it slips past clusters of glossy-leafed holly trees.  A quaint bungalow can be glimpsed over the edge of the ferns at one end of the pathway, while a large tanik tree stands at the other side across an arched footbridge.  Cross-hatched beams support platforms that are wrapped in railings and silken banners, which create a colorful dwelling.

title: [Cysaegir, Brook]
description: A quaint bungalow rests quietly alongside a bubbling brook teeming with an assortment of fish and other aquatic life, creating a picture-perfect scene.  Fiddlehead ferns line the western side of the brook, and the light of the sun brightly illuminates clusters of glossy-leafed holly trees beyond them.  A white pebble pathway following a bubbling brook leads into the area and terminates at a towering modwir tree whose broad limbs support a colorful canopy-covered shop.

title: [Cysaegir, Dwelling]
description: Traipsing across a bubbling brook is an arched footbridge painted a soft white that matches the pebbles of the meandering pathway that leads to a cluster of glossy-leafed holly trees.  Thick green moss creates an alluring carpet around the base of an ancient tanik that is surrounded by a complex platform system.  Wide steps separate the ground level from the first platform, which is obscured from sight by vibrantly colored silk banners.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Entry]
description: Clear lacquer preserves the golden hue of the oak used to create wide railings and the shelves beneath, which are fitted into the wide sides of the tanik tree at the edge of the circular platform.  Silken banners spread through the branches forming a colorful roof that shimmers when sunlight filters through the leafy canopy above.  Pillows lay in organized heaps among wicker baskets filled with vials of dye.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Show Room]
description: Oak planks form the wide platform that surrounds this towering tanik tree, as well as the lacquered railing.  Beneath the railing, a series of low shelves displays tiny vials of multi-hued dye.  Tacked to the lip of each shelf, and arranged just beneath each vial of dye, are thin swatches of silk dyed to match the colors in each vial.  Stretched between the railing and the edge of the silken banner roofing is a transparent sheet of gossamer.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Display Room]
description: Oak beams riddle the space above this platform, the lacquered wood offering support to the platform above.  Dangling from hemp ropes fitted into the underside of the platform above are large pot-bellied bottles filled with colorful dyes that create a prismatic spray across the entire platform as the sunlight strikes.  Banners of multi-hued silk create a gentle barrier at the platform's edges, making them safe from a long drop to the brook below.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Held in place by metal pegs, thick chains serve as sconces for the mullein torches that burn brightly here.  Thick wooden planks cover an uneven floor and a detailed fresco depicting a scene of drakes hovering above a barren land sprawled with bodies covers one wall.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Stalagmites create natural pillars in this cyclopean chamber that leads toward a steel-banded ironwood door.  A milky iridescent substance coats the walls and floors, giving off a bluish color that seems to glow as it illuminates this section of the cave.

Stalagmites create natural pillars in this cyclopean chamber that leads toward a lopsided wooden door.  A milky iridescent substance coats the walls and floors, giving off a bluish color that seems to glow as it illuminates this section of the cave.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Echoes bounce back and forth over the smooth stone walls of the cavern.  Cylindrical cones of calcite protrude from the ceiling in a haphazard manner.  Pointed spikes dot the surface of the stalactites, and every so often drops of water plummet to the ground, creating small puddles on the floor.  Irregular stone steps lead up to an oval-shaped hole in the wall.

title: [Raechaer's Alchemical Supplies]
description: Colorful dupioni silk tapestries showing various scenes of wizards at work and play conceal one of the shop's stone walls.  The room is illuminated by mullein torches that cast a flickering light along the walls.  Natural recesses in the stone serve as bookcases, housing huge, dusty leather-bound volumes.  A stalagmite draped with an irregular piece of water-stained damask stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: A dozen or so torches line the walls of the cave, which probably aids in keeping these walls dry.  Small square marble tiles decorate the surface of an open wood-framed doorway.  Along the back of the cave, broken crates and barrels are piled almost to the ceiling.

title: [Urgaen's Pawnshop]
description: Melodic chimes dangle above the ash door, signaling the arrivals and departures from this cozy pawnshop.  Dangling above a polished white oak counter, a crooked plank has been decorated with a child's colorful beadwork that reads, "Pawnshop."  A fringed curtain obscures an archway that leads to the rear of the shop.

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Switchback]
description: Lined on both sides with fallen trees, the steep path along the mountain seems well maintained and moderately easy to travel along.  Cross sections of logs, set into the dirt at the foot of this section of the trail, serve as crude steps to proceed down into the gorge.  A steep trail leading up lends no aid to those ascending the switchback.

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Switchback]
description: The sound of rushing water nearby fills the area with a gentle natural murmur.  Trees, shrubs, and lichen struggle among the crags for footing and their very survival.  Cut into the natural stone of the cliffside, a narrow path leads up the mountain while a steep trail leads further down the rock face.

title: [Cysaegir Bank]
description: Simple wooden teller windows fitted with glaes panes stand open to service the many Aelotoi men and women bustling about.  A domed skylight allows sunshine to stream in, glinting off the silver coins being transferred, withdrawn, and deposited.  Vivid butterflies have been painted flitting across the pale pink and blue-tinted stone walls.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Lobby]
description: Beautifully rendered watercolor and oil paintings adorn the silver-speckled marble walls.  Cushioned benches offer a grand view of the heavily trafficked foyer while a banistered oak stairway leads off to other attractions of the Naerine Hostelry.  Faint sounds of rushing water can be heard through a set of glaes-paned doors leading out to the bailey.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Tavern]
description: Warmth emanates from a monstrous red brick fireplace situated opposite cushy sofas arranged around a plush oval rug.  Savory aromas drift in from the swinging kitchen door, while hearty laughter roars from around a lacquered mahogany bar.  The tawny plaster walls have been framed with the same thick wooden beams that cross the high ceiling.  Wrought iron sconces cast the entire tavern in a warm glow befitting its friendly atmosphere.

description: Beautiful stained glass windows depict idyllic landscapes of an exotic world, cast aglow by the warm rays of golden sunlight.  A vivid silk tapestry of a robed female silhouette hangs behind the varnished front desk, greeting those checking in for a stay.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Indoor Garden]
description: Ornamental trees rise like natural pillars towards a clear crystal dome and a picturesque starlit sky.  A lush grass pathway leads towards a rock-enclosed waterfall that soothes the airy chamber with its perpetual flowing melody.  Padded benches and cozy rattan chairs are arranged neatly around the lovely indoor garden, promoting quiet conversation and peaceful relaxation among guests.

description: An ornate chandelier hangs above the bedroom's heart, suspended from a burnished sunburst medallion. title: [Naerine Hostelry, Moon Room]
description: A sprawling featherbed occupies most of the space in this elegantly furnished bedroom.  A celestial scrollworked ebonwood settee abuts a wall painted in a deep midnight hue, and is arranged with several silvery crescent pillows.  Argent highlights adorn the decor, from the gauzy bed canopy to the plush navy carpet underfoot.

description: Here, just beyond an open window at this end of the narrow hall, the lights of Cysaegir appear like stars in the darkness. A star-inset ebonwood door and a cloud-inset white ash door face each other across the span of a velvet floral runner.

Draping over the four posters of a neatly made bed is a sheer, gauzy canopy, made from the same fine material adorning a pair of frost-paned windows.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Atrium]
description: Plum trees thrive in the middle of the central hall.  Freely growing Imaera's lace and other creeping vines obscures most of the walls of the airy chamber.  Individual beds of various plants and bushes are scattered throughout, creating a tranquil setting.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Hallway]
description: In a roped off corner of the hallway, a collection of hand-carved walking sticks are propped up against the wall.  Beautifully fashioned, the handles are crafted from solid gold and silver into the likeness of both real and mythical creatures.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Hallway]
description: An oddly shaped glass bowl is positioned alongside an even more strangely fashioned table in the hallway.  Numerous turtles dwell in the bowl, and the clicking noises produced by their claws closely resemble the sounds generated from a kiramon.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Hallway]
description: Mounted on the wall, greeting all that walk this corridor, is the gruesome sight of a stuffed Agresh troll warrior head.  Steel grey paint runs down the warrior's face in equal strips, and its mouth is frozen in a rictus snarl.  The shaggy hair of the beast moves ever so slightly on a current of air from an open window, while its glass eyes appear to track your every move.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Hallway]
description: Small niches make up most of the wall.  Displayed within each slot are styles of boots, shoes, and slippers from past and present eras.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Hallway]
description: Soft tapping sounds reverberate off the walls of the hallway from an unknown location.  Discarded pieces of tanned hides are piled neatly beside one of the closed doors.

title: [Jewels of the Sky]
description: A patched canopy shields this tiny shop from sun and rain, though more importantly, the thick wooden rails along the perimeter protects patrons from suffering a terrible demise at the hands of gravity.  The melodious warbling of songbirds sets a pleasant atmosphere for the jewelers to work under, crafting lovely baubles and trinkets.  A circular table covered with velvet displays their beautiful creations.

title: [Reformatory, Refectory]
description: Devoid of windows, most of the stand-lamps are lit in the dining hall managing to chase away some of the shadows.  A single mural on the wall depicts two male aelotoi and a single female standing before the Sapphire Throne.  Rows of tables in perfect symmetry are arranged in the interior of the room with fruit bowls set in the center of each table containing apples, oranges, bananas, and grapes.  Mouth-watering aromas waft in from the open kitchen door at the back of the room, where a life-sized figure stands.

title: [Reformatory, Antechamber]
description: A heavy, barred gateway at the edge of the immense and circular chamber leads to a walkway that reaches three cellblocks.  Thick hinges and iron straps reinforced by huge black iron locks adorn the gateway, prohibiting further passage toward the holding cells.  The rhythmic sound of marching boots echoes off the walls as sentries tread on a metal catwalk high overhead while patrolling the area from up above.

title: [Reformatory, Kitchen]
description: Along the back wall, steam pours out from enormous pots cooking over a fire within a stone hearth.  Long handled forks, ladles, and other cooking implements are spread out on a low wooden counter.  Dangling from the side of a chopping stand are nets of potatoes, carrots, and turnips.  The small pail of water used for washing the vegetables has been placed beneath them.  Two doors are on opposite sides of the kitchen, one leads to the pantry and the other to the storage room.

title: [Reformatory, Storage Room]
description: This snug little closet is cleanly swept and rodent free.  Labeled in a neat and precise hand, the efficiently organized shelves, cabinets, and barrels contain items that are required for the daily needs of the inmates and staff alike.  Leaning against the wall, and missing a rung or three, a ladder rests beneath a trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [Reformatory, Roof]
description: The trapdoor leading back down to the storage room has been painted with a large bull's-eye in red paint.  Partially hidden behind a huge wall of trees and dimly illuminated by moonlight, the roof provides a perfect spot to rest and relax while contemplating life.  A dart board hangs above a copper urn.  Stored in a glass bowl on one side of a felt covered table are small red and blue tokens.  Brightly colored rocks hold down stacks of playing cards and, on the opposite side of the table, a leather-bound black book.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Sunlight streams in liberally across the road through a large break in the conifer canopy.  An ancient fir tree has collapsed and taken a large number of lesser trees down with it.  Fortunately the old one chose to fall away from the road, rather than across it, allowing travel to continue unobstructed.  Now the huge trunk lies in the soft ground, relentlessly attacked by the elements and insects that will eventually return it to the soil from which it sprang.

Warm air circulates lazily along the road, and it would be as easy to curl up and sleep under one of the large, spreading pines as to continue to forge on along the cobblestone way.

A small brook cascades down from the north then veers west and disappears.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: A brook babbles in happily from the northwest then veers to its right and follows the slight decline of the cobblestone road to the southwest.  The brook's waters are clear and cool, and the exposed stones carry not the slightest indication of algae or any ominous discolorations.  The accumulated dirt on the brook's banks indicates that it is at its heaviest flow point right now.  Perhaps, in other seasons, it ceases to flow entirely, accounting for the lack of fish within.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Tall pines and firs spread their branches over the cobblestone road, covering it with mottled patches of sunlight and shade.  In many places the tree roots have disturbed the cobblestones, buckling what once may have been a smooth, evenly laid surface.  Despite the changes wrought by the area's fauna, and the erosion caused by natural forces, the roadway is in surprisingly good condition, a tribute to those who built it.

description: A suffocating stench, like the foul gasses released from especially deep and ancient bogs, rises from a wide circular well in a blighted clearing some forty feet beneath the vine bridge.  The cracked and broken stone of the well's wall has been overrun by a thick, viscous fluid which seeps from the interior of the well, spreading across the clearing like a malignant ink stain.  Rotting trunks and withered vegetation border the edges of the diseased pool.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: Greyed and cracked, an ancient oak rises from the thick undergrowth, a plethora of broken branches, fallen leaves and other debris scattered about its base.  The old oak has collapsed in upon itself.  Long cracks run the length of its trunk, and the knobby ends of fractured branches protrude at odd angles.  A massive branch has fallen from some height and lodged itself in an opening, providing a steep but stable climb to the upper area of the tree.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: Fur-like moss and clinging lichen have engulfed the few remaining cobblestones, obscuring their presence from all but the keenest observation.  A chill mountain wind gusts through the ancient oaks, rattling their dry leaves and sending a whisper through the dark woods.  Nearby the stone-grey trunk of a massive oak contrasts with the dark natural bark of its peers.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cobbled Path]
description: Tangled beards of dark green moss hang heavily from gnarled limbs, tiny forest beetles crawling within their hair-like strands.  Tall oaks shelter the ancient path from the light of the sun, blanketing the wild undergrowth in cool shadow.  A muffled chittering, similar to the jeering cry of restless squirrels, echoes through the woods.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cobbled Path]
description: An outcropping of granite, striated with twisting veins, protrudes from the leaf-strewn forest floor, its pale hulk glimmering like polished bone in the low light.  Small clusters of lichen, like dry barnacles, cling to the stone surface, their lime-colored blooms forming strange patterns on the rock.  A subtle scent, like the damp odor associated with upturned soil, permeates the area.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cobbled Path]
description: Scattered shards of bark and broken branches litter the old pathway.  Nearby the trunk of an ancient oak has been damaged by a strong force, its bark torn away in a series of deep claw marks.  Crystalline sap fills the wounds, running down the side of the old tree like tears.  A clump of matted fur, dark and wiry, lies trapped between two slivers of wood.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cobbled Path]
description: Trampled ferns and upturned leaves mark the passage of a large beast along the old path.  Scored with deep footprints, the dark and rich earth of the forest floor has been disturbed.  The broken stalks of small bushes and shrubs dangle at odd angles, and the bark of a nearby tree has been scratched, its dark surface riddled with abrasions.  A musky odor, like the scent exuded by wild animals, lingers in the still air.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Mossy Shack]
description: Laced with shadows from a heavy border of stout black oaks, a quiet clearing opens in the woods.   Squatting in its midst, the crumbling ruin of a small stone shack sits silently, humbled by time and weather.  A skin of damp moss and fungus grows along the remaining stone walls, and what may have once been a thatched roof has completely disappeared.  An open doorway, fringed with moss, leads to a shadowed interior.

title: [Mossy Shack, Interior]
description: Cluttered with fallen leaves and heavily laden with dirt and grime, the interior of the small shack has suffered from exposure to the elements and neglect.  Even though the warm glow of sunlight filters down through bare beams which once held a thatched roof, the broken remnants of a table and a few scattered chair legs are coated with a thin greyish mold.  A stone hearth sits cold and empty within one of the crumbling walls.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: A woven net hangs limply between two oaks, its web-like material tattered and broken.  Resembling a hammock, the net is cluttered with dead leaves and the broken ends of branches, its frayed ends hanging low enough to touch the leaf-covered earth.  A faint overgrown trail breaks off from the crumbling cobbled path, heading off into the deeper shadows of the woods.

title: [Outpost, Overgrown Trail]
description: Nearly consumed by creeping tendrils, wide-leafed ferns and prickly briars, the barely visible path winds its way through a forest of black oaks and the occasional yellow birch.  Hanging from a stout branch, a wooden placard about the size of a human face moves gently in the slight breeze.  The woven cord which suspends the placard is badly frayed, but appears strong enough to maintain its weight.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: Jagged ends of broken wood peek out from beneath the mossy undergrowth, the remnants of a hand-crafted dwelling which has succumbed to the will of the forest or some darker entity. The malady which afflicts them has drained them of their strength, their branches bending toward the earth and their limbs nearly leafless.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Fallen Oak]
description: Shattered wooden panels and the collapsed trunk of a fallen oak lie across the path, slowly decaying amidst the vine-like creepers of the forest floor.  Once a tree house of some size, the jagged remains of wooden walls and flooring lie intermixed with the cracked branches, torn bark and dead leaves of the tree which once held it.  The old trunk, although showing signs of dry rot and termite infestation, appears to have contracted some form of disease, for its bark has turned a pale grey.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Fallen Oak]
description: The vertical outstretched roots of a fallen oak, standing taller than an average human, extend outward from a half-buried trunk lying across the path.  Like the twisted tentacles of a creature from the unfathomed depths, the star-shaped root pattern almost appears to move in the shadowy half-light of the forest.  The fallen trunk, cluttered with dead leaves and splotched with mud, has been infected with termites, its once noble wood slowly being devoured and turned to dust.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: A dank odor, like the fetid smell associated with deep swamps or boggy regions, wafts through the air, disturbing the otherwise natural scent of the forest. The bark of one oak is peeling backward, exposing the pale wood beneath.

title: [Outpost, Grassy Clearing]
description: A haggard oak rises from the grassy clearing, its branches heavy with brittle leaves which crackle in the slight breeze.  Affixed to woven cords which dangle from its limbs, circular objects ranging from the size of a small buckler to the length of a kite shield sway back and forth with the movement of the tree.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: A massive oak, its wide girth dominating this small clearing, extends its finger-like branches toward the heavens.  Around its base, a cluster of pale cobblestones has been upturned, as if the roots of the large tree were clawing toward the surface.  The trunk has taken on a light grey hue, as if the tree itself were suffering from some unknown malady.  A thick woven cord, knotted in numerous places, dangles from some branch hidden in the heights of the old tree.

title: [Outpost, Withered Cabin]
description: Cradled in the branches of the oak, this small cabin was crafted to fit within the natural contours of the tree.  Sheets of wood panel the walls and floor, but the roof has collapsed inward, littering the floor with piles of debris and leaves.  Sagging inward, the outer walls have been pierced by withered branches, and dark stains, perhaps from leaking sap, run down their surfaces.  Much of the room is blanketed in dust, but a small stove with a cracked vent pipe sits near an open trapdoor in the floor.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: Ancient black oaks rise up from the leafy earth, shadowing the crumbled remains of the cobbled road.  Spotted in places with patches of dark green moss and lighter tones of lichen, the wrinkled bark of the old trees seems well-suited to repelling the ravages of time and weather.  Underfoot, the crackle of dead leaves keeps time with each footstep.

description: A hulking mass of leaf-strewn, rotting cloth lies across the broken path, resembling the fallen carcass of a large woodland creature. Tiny beetles, bearing shiny black carapaces, march across the surface of the wreck, seemingly unaware of the sickly-sweet odor which pervades the area.

description: A cluster of misshapen figures stands in the clearing, their ragged clothing hanging loosely from their thin twisted limbs. description: Tall yellow-tipped blades of grass wave gently in the slight breeze, lending the wide clearing the illusion of being filled with water.  Roughly circular, the clearing is ringed with a border of tall birches and stout oaks which seem to form a dark enclosure around the swaying grasses.  A few isolated oaks emerge from the interior of the clearing, like rough islands in a softly undulating sea.

title: [Outpost, Overgrown Trail]
description: A wide overgrown trail cuts through a stand of yellow birches, their slender trunks ensnared by the dull green tendrils of the surrounding undergrowth.  Burrs and sharp-skinned briars tear at clothing and unprotected flesh, as if attempting to draw unwary travelers into their torturous embrace.  Toward the south, the forest appears to open into a wide clearing, the pale blue of the sky just visible amongst the intergrown branches of the nearby trees.

title: [Outpost, Overgrown Trail]
description: A small clearing opens at the mouth of the overgrown trail, revealing a ramshackle hut squatting in its midst. Although badly damaged and pocked with gaping holes, the hut appears stable.  An arched doorway leads within.

title: [Ramshackle Hut, Interior]
description: Wide beams of light stream down through gaping holes in the wooden walls, illuminating a large chamber nearly covered with a thick layer of dust, dead leaves and other debris.  A stout birch pole rises up from the floor to the ceiling in the center of the room and from hooks along its sides dangle a half dozen cord leashes.  An animal musk hangs heavy in the still air, and numerous paw prints crisscross the dusty floor.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Animal Run]
description: Dark oaks crowd together around the thin twisting run, blanketing everything beneath them in dense shadows.  Moss and lichen grow thick on the exposed tree trunks and low-lying foliage of the forest, obscuring details of the immediate surroundings.  A stillness hangs in the heavy damp air.

description: Mushrooms and other less identifiable fungi bloom profusely in the damp bark of the nearby oak trees, feeding off of the rich soil and decaying matter of the forest undergrowth. The fungi seem to cluster in bands around the wide trunks, forming living rings which cling to the damp bark.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Animal Run]
description: Fallen leaves from overhanging oak branches and greyish-green moss border the edges of the faint path running through the woods.  Probably a passage meant for use by small woodland rodents or swine, the run is little more than a twisting line of trampled undergrowth, nearly invisible among the thick ferns and shrubs of the forest floor.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Animal Run]
description: Near the base of a large oak, the thick layer of decaying leaves and other forest debris has been disturbed, revealing a shallow depression in the damp earth.  No more than two feet deep at its center, the depression may have served as a resting area for a large hound, wolf or some unknown denizen of the deep woods.  Clumps of mud and damp leaves lie scattered around the edges of the small pit, perhaps once having filled it.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: A cluster of young larch trees huddles just off the road to the east.  Their needles have turned a brilliant yellow, and many of the needles have dropped, covering the ground in a crunchy, golden carpet.  The trees look very much out of place, surrounded by the deep green foliage of the evergreen pines and cedars.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The hillside to the northwest looks very much like a green pincushion.  Thick underbrush of competing young trees and holly bushes blankets the slope, providing a rolling sea of light and dark green foliage.  Through this carpet many blackened tree trunks protrude, giant burnt matchsticks thrust up toward the sky.  A few have bits of greenery still on them, sticking out at odd angles, but for the most part they are just charred reminders of a fire long since past.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Pine needles appear to flow like rivers underneath the conifers and around the rock outcroppings.  The rocks are rather soft, being mostly layered shale, and seem to break off easily, scattering their flat gravel down the slope from the main exposed deposits.  Occasionally these pieces scatter over the roadway to slip between the cobblestones.  The sharp shale edges then puncture and slash the bottoms of passing feet and footwear.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The wind sweeps through the landscape, bringing a slight chill to an otherwise pleasant atmosphere.  The sugar pines and spruces bend slightly in the wind, only to straighten at the breeze's abatement.  Cones hang from the undersides of the upper branches, nature's ornaments on the tough evergreens, and the occasional dead needle drifts lazily toward the ground, spinning and swaying back and forth before finally coming to rest.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Ground squirrels bustle about between the exposed boulders, searching for pine nuts and other delicacies to take to their burrows.  Occasionally they bump into each other and playfully jump and swat at one another in mock battle.  The approach of a stranger, though, sends one or two into chittering fits, alerting the others to the presence of a possible danger.  All of them suddenly seem to vanish from sight, and the area becomes strangely quiet.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The sun glints off the steel grey surfaces of the exposed boulders, adding an extra bit of illumination to the area.  Some of the flat, exposed rocks are wide enough that branches from the flanking trees do not completely overshadow the rocks, and these spots absorb the sun's warmth, storing it to radiate back into the air later.  Some is reflected now, though, making the area much warmer than if it were heavily forested.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The road dips a bit, allowing water to collect in the low spots and making the cobblestones slippery and moss-covered.  The area is cool and still, with only an occasional beam of sunlight penetrating the forest canopy.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The road drops sharply to the north, although travel looks much easier to the west.  Much of the undergrowth is gone, replaced by scoured rock surfaces.  Sugar pines anchor what little soil is left, and they show the stress of malnutrition in their twisted, scraggly trunks and sparse foliage.  Many of the flatter rocks display a reddish-brown discoloration similar in appearance to rust left behind by evaporating water.  Perhaps it is indicative of iron deposits in the area.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The road traverses the face of the hillside, moving back and forth in a series of short switchbacks.  The builders apparently dug out much of the soil, then built up retaining walls to keep the hill from collapsing totally and taking the road down with it.  After all this time the skill of the builders is very much apparent, although in short stretches the shifting soil has moved the roadway out of line or taken it far down the hill.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Pines, firs and spruces mix with walnuts, oaks and maples where the conifer forest and deciduous forest collide.  Both leaves and needles blanket the ground, rather heavily, as the road continues its winding ascent to the west and descent to the east.  A soft, warm wind pushes against the hillside, rolling upward and causing the trees to sway gently.  The smell of rain is in the air.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The cobblestone road rolls off to the north and climbs the hillside to the west.  A wide causeway branches off to the southeast, its surface paved with huge, flat stones.  An occasional pine rises to the sky, but for the most part the area is dominated by spreading oaks and a species of low, thorny shrub.  The density of the shrubs and the sharpness of their serrated leaves are usually convincing enough to keep travelers from wandering off the marked paths.

title: [Gyldemar Forest]
description: Paving stones the size of coffin lids and rounded with age lay broken along the wide causeway, their uneven surfaces forcing the movement of travelers into a slow and irregular dance.  A few of the stones bear wheel ruts a handspan deep, evidence of the caravans -- or perhaps the armies -- which once rode this way.  Gigantic oaks link branches over the road and cast the crumbling rocks beneath in melancholy half-light.
