title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The tracks of several different types of creatures are apparent in the mud that parallels the road.  The deep, cloven hoof prints of elk and deer mingle with the light impressions of rabbits and raccoons and the paw prints of coyotes and wolves.  From the smeared appearance of the coyote and wolf paw prints, the animals were most likely on the run, either after prey or away from a predator.  However, the only predator of theirs around these parts leaves the same muddy prints you do.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: A warm, slightly humid stillness pervades the area.  Not a leaf stirs on any of the hundreds of trees surrounding the remains of the cobblestone road.  Movement is absent in the air, but the air is still filled with the sounds of the forest--the buzzing and humming of winged insects, the calls and songs of birds, the croaking and booming of amphibian life, and the occasional far off howl of a coyote or wolf.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: A warm fog envelops the area.  Visibility is reduced to a few yards.  The trees all around display a wet sheen on their trunks, and droplets of water slide down their branches and drip from their leaves.  Footing is mushy at best when off the road and slick when on the road.  As the road is heaved and buckled from years of plant growth, walking on the road is nearly as perilous as venturing off of it.  Fortunately, the cobblestones of the road are readily apparent, running east and south.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The forest is less dense here and the air lighter.  Sunlight filters though the foliage above creating a mottled effect on the plants and undergrowth.  Although somewhat overgrown, this looks to have once been a road.  The forest thins to the northeast and a large structure is visible through the trees.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The forest floor slopes up and a large number of coniferous trees are scattered among the growth.  Some trees are leaning, some have recently fallen over, and many are decomposing on the ground.  A hemlock has grown through a crack in a large boulder that was probably left here by glacial action during the last ice age.

title: [Calelith Villa, Courtyard]
description: Bright sunlight fills this area overgrown with shrubs and bushes.  The forest has begun to close in around a large dilapidated villa looming to the north, obscuring any signs of a road or path.
Bright moonlight fills this area overgrown with shrubs and bushes.  The forest has begun to close in around a large dilapidated villa looming to the north, obscuring any signs of a road or path.

title: [Calelith Villa, Portico]
description: Ivy surrounds the support columns and covers much of the portico floor.  The roof is sagging and a section to the west has fallen, the debris landing on what remains of a chair.  A large maoral door hangs on one hinge, its frame splintered.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Chattering fills the air as two squirrels chase each other through the branches of a towering monir tree.  Small yews grow amidst tall monirs, their needles creating a blanket on the forest floor.  To the northwest, parts of a structure are visible through the trees.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The foliage above is so thick that only a few rays of sunlight can filter through to the ground.  There also seem to be several different levels of growth.  The tallest trees form the canopy and younger trees are pushing up into the spaces below the canopy.  Near the ground are the plants that form the undergrowth.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Pine cones of various sizes litter the ground, dropping their seeds.  Pine needles, sharp enough to skewer a finger, make for slow passage through this area.  Sticking out in all directions, the needles easily puncture exposed skin, drawing blood.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Amid the branches of a towering maoral, a large nest can be seen high overhead.  Nestled between two large branches, the nest appears large enough to hold several people.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Looking around, you can see trees in all stages of growth and decay.  This forest has reached an equilibrium that includes constant change within it.  A small dark speck flits into a young tanik ahead, and then disappears.  It is a wren, which has an impressive call for such a small bird.

Looking around, you can see trees in all stages of growth and decay.  This forest has reached an equilibrium that includes constant change within it.  A small dark speck flits into a young tanik ahead, and then disappears.  It is impossible to tell what it was in the faint moonlight.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Five huge trees are seen growing right together in a row, as if they were planted in a line.  The large maorals, with their distinctive reddish grain, could be six or seven hundred years old.  Towering high into the sky, these maorals can live for over a thousand years.

title: [Calelith Villa, Foyer]
description: Shards of pottery litter the cracked and scratched marble floor and a shattered maoral table lies against the western wall.  Overhead, a tarnished brass chandelier hangs, its candles long since extinguished.

title: [Calelith Villa, Hall]
description: An oak door lies in the middle of the hall, its bent hinges still hanging on the western wall.  A rounded arch on the eastern wall leads to the villa's library.

title: [Calelith Villa, Parlor]
description: The elegant velvet sofas and wing chairs that once decorated this room are now slashed and faded.  Delicate end tables lie shattered and broken, covered with dust.  A large painting over the fireplace is no longer discernible, its canvas having been slashed numerous times.  A doorway on the northern wall stands open, the door nowhere to be seen.

title: [Calelith Villa, Upper Hall]
description: Thick carpeting covers the floor, faded and frayed.  Splintered pieces of wood litter the hall, the remains of bedroom doors.

title: [Calelith Villa, Dining Room]
description: The once elegant dining room is strewn with shattered crystal and pottery.  The sideboard has been tipped over, two of its legs snapped off.  A large waraxe is imbedded into the center of the table, its wood splintered and covered with dust.  Sunlight glints off a shard of glass beneath a broken window.

A large waraxe is imbedded into the center of the table, its wood splintered and covered with dust.  Moonlight glints off a shard of glass beneath a broken window.

title: [Calelith Villa, Kitchen]
description: Torn, empty grain and rice sacks are strewn about the floor, their contents long since eaten by rodents.  A large stone fireplace takes up the western wall.  Inside the fireplace, a kettle hangs on a hook over long cold ashes, a ladle still inside.  A thick layer of dust covers the large wooden worktable in the center of the room.

title: [Calelith Villa, Herb Garden]
description: Amid the tall grass and shrubs are spearmint, thyme, parsley and several other herbs whose names you don't recall.  Now overgrown and wild, this appears to have once been an herb garden.

title: [Calelith Villa, Wine Cellar]
description: The cellar is dark and musty, with the smell of wine still lingering in the air.  Dark stains cover the floor and several kegs sit with their spigots in the open position.  Large wine racks cover two walls.  Curiously, all the bottles are still in place but the corks have been removed.  Odd scratches are visible in the floor, beneath the dust.

title: [Calelith Villa, Master Bedroom]
description: The canopy over the four-poster bed hangs in tatters.  A shutter bangs noisily against a window, the glass cracked and broken.  The wardrobe stands open, its contents relatively undisturbed, though showing the ravages of time.  A large dresser has been ransacked, each drawer opened and its contents hanging out.  A portrait over the fireplace has been slashed, though the picture is still discernible.

title: [Calelith Villa, Bedroom]
description: A pair of crossed wooden swords hangs on the wall above an overturned bed.  A small wooden shield lies discarded in the corner.  A large wardrobe stands open, the door hanging by one hinge and its contents strewn about.  A layer of dust covers everything in the room.

title: [Calelith Villa, Upper Hall]
description: Tarnished silver wall sconces flank a window on the northern wall.  Sunlight filters through the jagged, broken glass of the window, illuminating the hall.  Doorways stand open to the east and west.
Tarnished silver wall sconces flank a window on the northern wall.  Moonlight filters through the jagged, broken glass of the window, illuminating the hall.  Doorways stand open to the east and west.

title: [Calelith Villa, Bedroom]
description: A plain oak bed is pushed against the eastern wall, the feather mattress slashed.  The drawers of an oak dresser are open and the contents strewn about, much of it decaying with age.

title: [Calelith Villa, Grounds]
description: A large weathered barn, its doors standing open, rises from the tall grass and shrubs.  Although overgrown, it's still possible to follow the old path from the villa to the once cultivated lands to the north and east.  The forest closes in from the west and is visible to the far north.

title: [Calelith Villa, Grounds]
description: Tall weeds, brush and grass cover the old path, making passage though the area slow.  Five tall maoral trees stretch eastward, providing a natural wall along the path.

title: [Calelith Villa, Garden]
description: The tall grass and weeds spread out to the east and north, the once cultivated lands now growing wild.  Stalks of wheat grow alongside bunches of carrots amidst a myriad of weeds and grass.

title: [Calelith Villa, Garden]
description: Passage is easiest to the north and west, while to the east a small overgrown flower garden is visible.  A breeze across the field creates a whisper on the wind as the tall grass moves and sways.  To the south, the back wall of the villa rises up.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: A break in the woods heads southward, while the trail continues to the east and west.  Under the shade of a large oak tree are several long mounds of dirt.  Atop each mound stones have been arranged to form a circle, with a larger stone placed in the center.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: An old fire pit at the base of several rocks provides evidence that others have passed this way before.  A modwir leans against the trunk of an old oak, lightning scars visible on its scorched trunk.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The landscape is challenging here, dipping and rising between thick undergrowth and rocky outcroppings.  Yew and tanik trees dominate the area, sloping steeply up to the northwest.  A rotting tree stump provides shelter to a small chipmunk.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Towering yews cling precariously to the hillside, shadows dancing and flickering over the branches.  From somewhere high in the branches a muted chattering fills the air.  A chilling breeze blows through the area, rustling dead leaves and pine needles.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The density of the woods lessens slightly here and a clearing is visible to the west.  Most of the surrounding hillsides can be seen quite clearly.  A deep bed of brown pine needles blankets the area, muffling all sounds.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Thick woods surround this wide clearing.  High ferns and rocky outcroppings dot the landscape amid tall grasses.  The tall grass sways rhythmically when a breeze stirs the air.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The land climbs steadily, if gradually and the vegetation changes to include pines and firs intermingled with oak, haon and birch trees.  The pungent aroma of pine is noticeable in the air.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Several small boulders scattered amidst the trees form a break in the trail.  Lichen covers the base of several of the rocks, growing unchecked.  The air is brisk and the sound of running water is heard in the distance.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The area is hilly and the terrain rocky, sloping gradually upwards to the northwest.  A pair of tall willow trees is visible to the northeast, their branches trailing down to brush the ground.  The sound of cascading water is a loud roar here.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Lights and shadows dance between the branches of several tall yews.  A squirrel chitters noisily from atop a large boulder, a small pine cone clutched in its claws.  Sharp black brambles climb over the trunk of and wind through the branches of a tanik tree.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Camp]
description: In the shelter of a large tanik tree, two lean-tos are nestled.  Pine needles and leaves have been carefully scattered to create a soft bed.  Though this region is heavily forested and the trees are large and ancient, a clearing is visible to the west.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Camp]
description: Tall fir and pine trees surround this small clearing.  A circle of rocks in the center of the clearing surrounds an open fire-pit.  The tall grass growing here has been recently trampled and the fire-pit appears to have seen recent use.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Camp]
description: Low-growing thanot shrubs, with towering pines growing behind them, enclose this area on three sides.  Hanging from a high branch is a large sack, suspended from a length of heavy twine.  A small lean-to appears to be used for storage, rather than sleeping.  In front of the lean-to, stones have been arranged to form a circle, with a larger dark stone placed in the center.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Camp]
description: Three small lean-tos are nestled between a pair of towering pine trees.  A sprawling thanot bush has been carefully cut-away, remnants and pieces of its wood woven together lie at the opening of a lean-to.  A crude cutting knife is impaled in a piece of the wood, perhaps awaiting future use.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Camp]
description: Surrounded by thick thanot shrubs and tall pines, this area is cut off from the rest of the camp.  A putrid odor comes from a pile of leaves and pine needles at the base of a tall tanik tree.  The fetid odor is strong enough to cause eyes to tear.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Several hazel trees grow close together here, their shrub-like limbs twisting together and blocking travel to the north.  A tuft of brown and black fur is caught on one of the twisting branches.  The sound of water cascading over rocks comes from the east.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: The source of the loud roar of rushing water stands before you.  A waterfall, tall and majestic, plunges down from a great height into a large pool at its base.  The water cascades over the cliff face of a rocky ridge to the north and over two lower tiers, emitting a spray of mist that is carried on the wind.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: Water from the pool emerges from beneath an outcropping of rocks, forming a fast-flowing stream that widens and flows south.  A small grove of trees flourishes at the edge of the stream.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: The terrain is rocky and steep, rising sharply to the north.  A light mist from the falls makes the rocky trail slick and treacherous.  Small white and blue flowers grow in bunches between the rocks.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: Several magnificent willow trees line the southern edge of the large pool, their roots thriving on the water.  The view of the falls is unobstructed and you are able to discern a natural rock formation that appears to span the top of the falls.  Water from the pool flows underground, only to emerge again as a stream to the south.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: Atop the ridge is a magnificent view of the pool below and the forest to the south.  High above the spray of the falls, the air is crisp and clean.  To the west a stand of yews rises tall.  Rocks form a natural stair that appears to head down and behind the falls.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: Water has eroded a hole through the rocks creating a natural bridge over the falls.  To the north lies a large, spring-fed pond of water, runoff from the mountains.   Water from the pond flows beneath the rock bridge and over the falls, creating a magnificent spectacle.  Looking out over the falls and pool below, sunlight on the mist creates a vibrant rainbow.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Beneath the shade of tall oak trees, several hazel trees flourish.  Smaller than the oaks, and shade loving, the hazel trees are more like tall shrubs than trees.  Clusters of unripe nuts are clearly visible among the leaves.  The distant sound of running water can be heard over the rustle of leaves.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The forest is bright and airy here.  Travel is easy and passage is possible in several directions.  To the south lies a large open meadow, while the path to the southwest climbs a gentle slope winding between white birches.  The ground seems to level off to both the north and east, with several majestic oak trees towering to the east.  The sound of running water can be heard near at hand.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: A wide stream meanders north to south, cascading over rocks and sending up a spray of light mist.  The rocks form a natural bridge across the stream for the sure-footed.  Tall reeds and lush, green grass grow along the banks of the stream.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Green grass grows lush and thick as the meadow rises to form a knoll towards the south.  Several majestic oaks edge the meadow to the northeast and a line of birches is visible to the southwest.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The stream crosses the path to the northwest, a natural rock bridge providing a way to the opposite bank.  To the southeast, the path continues to follow the stream, birch trees lining the eastern bank.  An eddy in the stream creates an illusion of the water flowing upstream.  Just below the water's surface, several trout are visible, fighting the current.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The stream narrows as it curves, winding its way southward.  A large bullfrog croaks loudly at the water's edge, only to be answered by another across the stream.  A cool breeze rustles the leaves of a nearby birch tree.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: A small red fox stands on the opposite bank, drinking from the cool stream.  Accustomed to the stream's life, the fox is not startled when a small fish jumps nearby.  A colorful meadow on the hillock behind the fox creates a beautiful backdrop.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Beavers have created a dam across the stream here.  Birch and oak limbs have been carefully placed to slow the stream and create a deep pool of water, an engineering marvel that has redirected the stream away from a beaver lodge.  To the east are several tree stumps, each gnawed in the same pattern with notches on the sides of the stumps.  Water cascades gently over the top of the dam, the sound soothing and relaxing, as it continues to flow to the southwest.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: A carefully constructed beaver dam crosses a stream to the northeast, creating a deep pool on the northern side of the dam.  Stately oak trees to the south block any further view of the stream, as it continues to flow southward.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The sound of running water can be heard in the distance as sunlight filters through the trees and is reflected off something to the northeast.  The dulcet voice of a songbird drifts on the wind.

The sound of running water can be heard in the distance as moonlight filters through the trees and is reflected off something to the northeast.  The incessant chirping of a crickets drifts on the wind.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Covering the top of this knoll is a large meadow.  Butterfly-weed, creeping phlox, asters and little bluestem blanket the area in color.  Butterflies and bees flit from flower to flower.

Covering the top of this knoll is a large meadow.  Butterfly-weed, creeping phlox, asters and little bluestem blanket the area in color.  Fireflies and moths flit from flower to flower in the moonlight.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The path winds its way downward to the north, twisting and turning between the trees.  To the east, a meadow is visible through the trees, sunlight streaming down on the palette of color.
The path winds its way downward to the north, twisting and turning between the trees.  To the east, a meadow is visible through the trees, moonlight streaming down on the pale palette of color.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Dense brush blocks passage to the south and creates a natural border around this end of the meadow.  To the east a wide stream winds its way south and the sound of water cascading over rocks is clearly heard.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Passage is easiest to the north as the terrain slopes downward.  Not really a trail, the forest appears to have a natural path easy to navigate for man or beast.  A stand of white birch lies to the west on a small slope.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Pine and fir trees give way to large leafy trees in this part of the forest.  Haon, oak and birch trees provide a leafy canopy overhead.  The faint sound of running water can be heard far to east, as the terrain slopes to the north.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The ground is steeply sloped and pitted with rocks.  Thick bluish thanot shrubs grow close together to the northwest, their long poisonous barbs preventing passage in that direction.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Milkweed grows along the forest floor, bees and butterflies hovering around the pale flowers and sampling the nectar.  A small spider spins its web on a nearby branch, hoping one of the nectar eaters will drop in.
Milkweed grows along the forest floor, a favorite of bees and butterflies during the daylight hours.  A small spider spins its web on a nearby branch, hoping one of the nectar eaters will drop in.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The forest is damp and moss covers the base of several tree trunks.  Delicate blue flowers grow wild in a small sunny patch.  A rustling sound is heard high overhead in the branches of a lone monir tree, nestled between several yews.

The forest is damp and moss covers the base of several tree trunks.  Delicate blue flowers grow wild in a small moonlit patch.  A rustling sound is heard high overhead in the branches of a lone monir tree, nestled between several yews.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: An outcropping of large rocks blocks passage to the east as the terrain becomes rough and hilly.  What appears to be a trail or path disappears into a stand of trees to the northeast.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Pine and fir trees to the southwest give way to stately oak trees and white birches.  A large oak tree lies toppled on the ground, its root mass torn and broken by an act of nature.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: A large dead yew stands tall, its trunk blackened from a lightning strike.  Much of the trunk is now hollow, home to termites and ants.  The once stately tree still serves the forest, providing food and shelter to several forest dwellers.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crumbling Road]
description: Mosses and wildflowers grow between the massive paving stones, clothing the rough edges of naked broken rock with brilliant green.  The trees press close to both sides of the avenue, their roots buckling the roadway into hills and valleys.  A southerly wind carries the thick scent of animal musk, but the forest is silent and belies the presence of any sentient thing within it.

Mosses and wildflowers grow between the massive paving stones, softening the rough edges of the broken rock.  The trees press close to both sides of the avenue, occluding the moonlight almost totally and leaving only the path itself visible in the dim light.  A southerly wind carries the thick scent of animal musk, but even at night the forest is silent and belies the presence of any sentient thing within it.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crumbling Road]
description: Light slanting through the branches above reveals a cairn beside the road, though whether the rounded stones are a memorial to someone long vanished or merely the remnants of a toppled structure is impossible to tell.  One of the massive oaks along the causeway has fallen, the vacancy it left admitting dazzlingly bright sunlight that throws the thickly grown forest beyond it into deep shadow.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crumbling Road]
description: The paving stones are so widely spaced that the causeway is almost nonexistent, only the youth of the trees to the northwest revealing where the roadbed once lay.  Creepers as thick as a troll's wrist and almost as warty hang from the branches of some of the older trees.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crumbling Road]
description: The remains of an arch which once spanned the road now lie tumbled across it, making passage along the ancient roadbed difficult.  The once-jagged edges of the great stone blocks have been worn smooth with age, but carvings are still faintly visible on the broad bases that once held the structure aloft.  Wildflowers grow atop the tumbled blocks, giving them the look of a terraced garden and imbuing them with a beauty at odds with the ruin they represent.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Narrow Trail]
description: The passage through the trees is littered with stones and choked with densely grown underbrush.  Liana festoons the lower branches of the ancient trees which tower above you, the vines thicker than the trunks of some of the youngest trees.  The spicy scent of oak leaves only imperfectly masks a sharper animal smell.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Narrow Trail]
description: Massive tree trunks to either side of the trail rise up like columns in a grand, but ruinous temple.  The soft carpet of leaves on the forest floor and the mist which obscures them muffles all sound, and without any landmarks it would be easy to become lost and wander forever amidst the giant oaks.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Winding Trail]
description: Animal tracks cross the trail as it twists through the trees, and some of the leaves covering the ground seem to have been recently disturbed.  Aside from a few small pieces of worked stone scattered about the exposed tree roots, there is no evidence that people ever passed this way.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Winding Trail]
description: A stiff breeze sweeps the fallen leaves from the path to reveal irregular and deeply weathered blocks of native stone.  Subtle colors in the rock set off the brilliant viridian hue of the moss which grows between the stones.  A less defined path, perhaps an animal track, branches off to the southwest.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crooked Path]
description: The path ends near a gigantic oak tree.  Its upper branches sway in the wind, while the lower branches remain still, shielded by the other trees.  A woodpecker occasionally attacks the oak vainly, the old wood hard like stone.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Winding Trail]
description: The trees thin out as the trail slopes up toward a nearly sheer cliff face to the north.  Insects flit through the air, their soporific drone the only sound audible aside from the wind through the boughs above.

The trees thin out as the trail slopes up to the north, their branches barely meeting over the widened path.  Nocturnal insects flit through the air, their soporific humming the only sound audible aside from the wind through the boughs above.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Clearing]
description: The scree at the base of the cliff is inhospitable to larger trees, but hosts a variety of small shrubs and grasses as well as providing welcome shade to a pair of vividly colored lizards.  The cliff face is utterly featureless above the first few feet, almost as though the rock had been fused to a glassy smoothness by some unimaginable heat.

The scree at the base of the cliff is inhospitable to the larger trees, but hosts a variety of smaller shrubs and grasses.  The sheer rock wall to the north blots out the stars, and bright moonlight reveals that after the first few feet, the cliff is as smooth as if it had been fused by some unimaginable heat.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Clearing]
description: Swallows dip and wheel around a deep cleft in the cliff face, some of them bearing bits of grass and vines to be used for nests.  The wildflowers that carpet the clearing are in full bloom, their brilliant yellows and purples a welcome change from the starkness of the pale grey cliff face to the north.

Bats flutter around the night-blooming plants at the base of the cliff, drawn there by drifts of insects which swarm around the sweet-smelling blossoms.  Denser foliage to the south obscures the more distant trees, but seems passable if potentially treacherous at night.  A deep cleft in the cliff face is a blacker shadow against the dark grey stone.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Clearing]
description: The clearing slopes down to the south toward an overgrown thicket of brambles and prickly holly trees.  A small rabbit skeleton lies nestled in the brambles.
The clearing slopes down to the south toward an overgrown thicket of brambles and prickly holly trees, illuminated by the moonlight.  A small rabbit skeleton lies nestled in the brambles.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cliffside]
description: A series of steps carved in the native rock winds down the cliffside, each step worn so smooth at its center that they form more of a treacherously slippery ramp.  Jagged rocks line the deeply incised passage on either side.  The highest point of the cliffs is not too far away now.

Darkness does little to aid in the safety of the steps.  Jagged rocks line the deeply incised passage on either side.  The highest point of the cliffs is not too far away now.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Overgrown Path]
description: A fallen tree and a mass of low-hanging vines nearly block the path.  The thick growth prevents any breeze from reaching the path.  Nearby, a woodpecker works hard on another tree.
A fallen tree and a mass of low-hanging vines nearly block the path.  The thick growth prevents any breeze from reaching the path.  Nearby, an owl hoots softly, passing the night with his song.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crooked Path]
description: Wild bushes encroach on the path, only constant travel prevents them from overrunning the trail.  Birds chirp softly in the trees above, while a squirrel chatters from the bushes.
Wild bushes encroach on the path, only constant travel prevents them from overrunning the trail.  Only the occasional nighttime seranade of a bird breaks the silence.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crooked Path]
description: The trees thin somewhat, allowing sunlight to bathe the area in a golden hue.  A few flat rocks lie on the path, providing for a quieter walk compared to the dry leaves around the stones.
The trees thin somewhat, allowing moonlight to bathe the area in a silver hue.  A few flat rocks lie on the path, providing for a quieter walk compared to the dry leaves around the stones.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crooked Path]
description: The path makes a wide loop around a particularly large oak to the southwest.  A broken branch hangs across the path like a skeletal arm, blocking passage through the forest.

The path makes a wide loop around a particularly large oak to the southwest.  A broken branch hangs across the path like a skeletal arm blocking passage through the forest, a threat to the careless nighttime traveller.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crooked Path]
description: The path twists and bends around several large oaks.  Green grass struggles for light and space amongst the trees.  A few fallen branches have formed a home for a badger family.
The path twists and bends wildly in the night around several large oaks.  Green grass struggles for space amongst the trees.  A few fallen branches have formed a home for a badger family.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Stagnant Pool]
description: Sickly green scum covers the surface of the pool, parting temporarily with each intrusion.  Decaying leaves form a fittingly disgusting border to the pool.

Sickly green scum covers the surface of the pool, parting temporarily with each intrusion.  Decaying leaves form a fittingly disgusting border to the pool.  The nighttime darkness does little to hide the disgusting sight.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Depression]
description: Dead leaves and limbs fill the bottom of the depression.  The leaves create a nice spot to rest, while the limbs discourage careless relaxation in the leaf piles.

Dead leaves and limbs fill the bottom of the depression.  The leaves create a nice spot to rest, while the limbs discourage careless relaxation in the leaf piles.  Small animals can be heard scurrying through the leaves in the black of the night.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Stagnant Pool]
description: Black, brackish water fills the area, a stinking topping to the mud beneath.  Dead plant matter surrounds the pool.  Whether it died due to natural causes or from drinking from the pool remains a mystery.

Black, brackish water fills the area, a stinking topping to the mud beneath, which doesn't improve in appearance in the moonlight.  Dead plant matter surrounds the pool.  Whether it died due to natural causes or from drinking from the pool remains a mystery.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Slope]
description: A leaf-covered slope drops steeply to the southwest.  The thick covering of leaves conceals holes and other potential hazards from view.  Thin trees provide handholds to aid in traversing the slope.

A leaf-covered slope drops steeply into the darkness to the southwest.  The thick covering of leaves, aided by the darkness, conceals holes and other potential hazards from view.  Thin trees provide handholds to aid in traversing the slope.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Defile]
description: Small scorch marks dot the surface of the rocks forming the defile.  Wind gusts stir up the small twigs and ash that litter the area.  The trunk of a blasted tree lies across the defile, forcing travellers to stoop low to keep their heads uninjured.

Small scorch marks dot the surface of the rocks, barely visible at night, forming the defile.  Wind gusts stir up the small twigs and ash that litter the area.  The trunk of a blasted tree lies across the defile, forcing travellers to stoop low to keep their heads uninjured.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Defile]
description: Blackened rocks form a narrow path that turns sharply to the southwest.  A few blades of grass have conquered the carpet of blackened limbs and grey ash that fills the defile.  Chunks of stone occasionally break loose from the defile's walls.

Blackened rocks form a narrow path that turns sharply in the darkness to the southwest.  A few blades of grass have conquered the carpet of blackened limbs and grey ash that fills the defile.  Chunks of stone occasionally break loose from the defile's walls.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Blasted Heath]
description: Wind has formed a sea of grey ash dunes.  A few blackened limbs lie scattered across the desert, while large rocks barely peak through the ash.  One rock appears to have been sheared in half by some tremendous force.

Wind has formed a sea of grey ash dunes, now a pale grey in the sparkle of the moonlight.  A few blackened limbs lie scattered across the desert, while large rocks barely peak through the ash.  One rock appears to have been sheared in half by some tremendous force.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Blasted Heath]
description: Nothing grows at all in this desolate expanse of ash, and even the twisted trees that hid the wasteland from view seem healthy by comparison.  The powder-fine grey ash swirls and eddies around you, though not even a faint breeze stirs the close air.

Nothing grows at all in this desolate expanse of ash, and even the twisted trees that hid the wasteland from view seem healthy by comparison.  The powder-fine grey ash swirls and eddies around you, though not even a faint breeze stirs the stillness of the nighttime close air.  Although the area looks scorched, there is none of the sharp charred scent that normally accompanies a forest fire.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Blasted Heath]
description: The trees thin to reveal a broad expanse of fine ash.  Powder-fine dust clings to the leaves of nearby trees, fading their green to grey and killing weaker vegetation altogether.  The foliage closest to the edge of the blighted clearing is stunted and gnarled, the tree limbs twisted back as if bent against a constant onslaught of wind despite the stillness of the air.  Whatever force flattened the area also sunk it deeper into the ground, leaving the sea of ash a few feet lower than its surroundings.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Overgrown Path]
description: The path thins slightly, the foliage somehow pushed back.  Some of the taller grasses have become brittle and few reach higher then two feet.  Uprooted bushes lie here and there, most blackened.

The path thins slightly, the foliage somewhat pushed back into the night.  Some of the taller grasses have become brittle and few reach higher then two feet.  Uprooted bushes lie here and there, most blackened.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Rocky Trail]
description: Weathered rocks cover the trail as it ascends to the north.  Water fills the nooks and crannies in the rocks.  Birds swoop in to take advantage of the little drinking pools.
Weathered rocks cover the trail as it ascends into the darkness to the north.  Water fills the nooks and crannies in the rocks.  Birds swoop in to take advantage of the little drinking pools.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Rocky Trail]
description: Gravel surrounds flat stones set into the trail.  A large slab of granite stands upright on the east side of the trail.  Lichen has almost taken over one side of the slab.
Gravel surrounds flat stones set into the trail.  A large slab of granite stands upright in the darkness on the east side of the trail.  Lichen has almost taken over one side of the slab.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Rocky Trail]
description: Sand and gravel continue to form the trail while oaks  form a wall of wood along the path.  A lone oak leans awkwardly, most of its trunk blackened.
Sand and gravel continue to form the trail while oaks form a wall of wood along the path.  A lone oak leans awkwardly in the star-filled sky, most of its trunk blackened.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Rocky Trail]
description: Only white gravel marks the trail ahead.  The pure white of the gravel reflects the sunlight strongly, making it hard to watch where you walk.  Large white boulders mark the probable source of the gravel.  A family of sparrows has made their nest atop one of the boulders.

Only white gravel marks the trail ahead.  Moonlight gives the gravel a subtle glow.  Large white boulders mark the probable source of the gravel.  A family of sparrows has made their nest atop one of the boulders.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Plateau]
description: Few trees cover the plateau due to the amount of rock that fills the base.  Patches of grass have pushed up between some of the larger rocks.
Few trees cover the plateau due to the amount of rock that fills the base.  Patches of grass have pushed up through the darkness between some of the larger rocks.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Plateau]
description: A large depression in the plateau marks what might have once been the foundation of a small building.  A few of the cornerstones remain in place, though each is badly damaged.  No other trace of the building's stones can be seen.

A large depression in the plateau marks what might have once been the foundation of a small building.  A few of the cornerstones remain in place, though the damage to each can be plainly seen even in the night's darkness.  No other trace of the building's stones can be seen.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Chute]
description: The stone chute veers slightly to the east as it descends.  A low-hanging rock waits to ambush the unwary traveller.  Spiders continuously attempt to build webs across the chute, but are forced to begin anew with each traveller's passing.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Chute]
description: The chute narrows before flaring open at the bottom.  Organic debris fills the base of the chute.  A thin layer of slime coats the walls around the base.
The chute narrows before flaring open at the bottom.  Organic debris fills the base of the chute.  A thin layer of slime seems to glow in the moonlight on the walls around the base.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Narrow Defile]
description: The trail continues down into the low gully.  Rainwater has pushed gravel into the lower end, creating a soft cushion for walking.  A few broken tree limbs have also settled in the defile.

The trail continues down into the low gully.  Rainwater has pushed gravel into the lower end, creating a soft cushion for walking.  A few nocturnal animals skitter about.  A few broken tree limbs have also settled in the defile.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cliff Base]
description: Gentle winds blow along the cliffs, sending pebbles skipping downward.  A few small trees have grown out from the cliffside, their thin limbs gently rustling in the wind.
Gentle winds blow along the cliffs, sending pebbles skipping downward.  A few small trees have grown out from the dark cliffside, their thin limbs gently rustling in the wind.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Among the Oaks]
description: Dozens upon dozens of oak trees cluster together in a bewildering array before you.  Thick underbrush obscures what few trails can be seen in the forest.
Dozens upon dozens of oak trees cluster together in a bewildering array before you.  Thick underbrush obscures what few trails can be seen in the darkened forest.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Among the Oaks]
description: The endless panorama of trees lends no clues to your position in the forest.  A few dead branches lie scattered across the forest floor.
The endless panorama of trees lends no clues to your position in the dark forest.  A few dead branches lie scattered across the forest floor, awaiting an unsuspecting traveller to trip.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Among the Oaks]
description: A dozen oaks stand in a tight cluster, apart from the rest of the forest.  Large vines wrap around the great trees like a tentacled sea monster trying to drag down its prey.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Among the Oaks]
description: Many of the nearby trees wear wide splotches of dead brown leaves.  Two have fully succumbed to the disease and only show shriveled brown leaves.
Many of the nearby trees wear wide splotches of dead brown leaves, now blackish in the night light.  Two have fully succumbed to the disease and only show shriveled brown leaves.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Among the Oaks]
description: Only a few oaks stand here, their relatives clustering heavily to the northeast.  Tremendous piles of leaves lie near the oaks, creating homes for various varmints.
A few oaks stand proudly in the nighttime glow.  The stars overhead seem to outnumber the leaves that lie at the bases of the great trees.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ancient Road]
description: A few broken paving stones have survived from the badly weathered road.  Most of the pavers have sunk below the surface of the surrounding grass.  To the south, the road improves somewhat.

A few broken paving stones have survived from the badly weathered road, creating a stumbling hazard in the nighttime darkness.  Most of the pavers have sunk below the surface of the surrounding grass.  To the south, the road improves somewhat.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ancient Road]
description: Dark bricks form the road to the north and south.  Tufts of dry grass sprout from cracks in the mortar between stones.  A small tree has pushed its way up through the bricks like a volcano forming from a plain.

Dark bricks form the road to the north and south.  Tufts of dry grass sprout from cracks in the mortar between stones.  A small tree has pushed its way up through the bricks like a volcano forming from a plain.  The cool night air whistles through the tree.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ancient Road]
description: What once might have been a road is now a jumble of weatherworn bricks.  The jumble meanders to the north and south.
What once might have been a road is now a jumble of weatherworn bricks.  The jumble meanders into the darkness to the north and south.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ancient Road]
description: Bits of bricks and mortar lie scattered across the ground to form a rough road.  A line of maorals line the road, their branches arching to form a canopy for the rubble.

Bits of bricks and mortar lie scattered across the ground to form a rough road.  A line of maorals line the road, their branches arching to form a canopy for the rubble, further darkening the area in the night.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Crossroads]
description: As the old road ends, a barely visible path begins to the southeast.  The forest seems to be attempting to smother the path with new growth.  A few young saplings fight to survive among the large trees.

As the old road ends, a barely visible path begins to the southeast.  The forest seems to be attempting to smother the path with new growth.  A few young saplings fight to survive among the large trees.  Little moonlight filters through to the forest floor.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Overgrown Path]
description: The path almost disappears in the dense underbrush of the forest.  Leafy vines twist around one another to engulf the forest floor.  The looping vines have engulfed the trunks of several nearby oaks in a leafy curtain of green.

The path disappears beneath the dark brush covering the florest floor.  Leafy vines twist together to create a tangled carpet for the forest floor.  Moonlight creates shadows in the mass of vines, giving them a sinister look.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Overgrown Path]
description: The undergrowth nearly envelopes the pair of oaks that have fallen across the path.  A handful of acorns spill out from a knothole in one of the fallen oaks.

The undergrowth nearly envelopes the pair of oaks that have fallen across the path, appearing like the fallen forms of giants in the nighttime darkness.  A handful of acorns spill out from a knothole in one of the fallen oaks.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Arch]
description: Soaring above all but the tallest trees and as narrow as a sapling, a white stone arch stands in singular splendor at the center of a clearing.  Perhaps some residual magic still holds it up or perhaps it was simply too well-built to fall, but its presence only serves to emphasize the absence of the civilization that once surrounded it.  Stone slabs mark where buildings once stood, home now only to lichen and ferns.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Clearing]
description: A single oak tree stands at each of the cardinal directions around the clearing.  A ring of short bushes fills the gaps between the trees around the clearing's edge.  Centered in the clearing is a moss-covered stone.  Around the stone, a ring of curved bricks forms a circle.

A single oak tree stands at each of the cardinal directions around the clearing.  A ring of short bushes fills the gaps between the trees around the clearing's edge.  Centered in the clearing is moss-covered stone, illuminated by pale moon glow.  Around the stone, a ring of curved bricks forms a circle.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Standing Stone]
description: To the west, a wedge-shaped stone, the size of a great cat, rests on its side.  Several pairs of the same shape have been pushed together to form ramps that travel upwards to the north.

To the west, a wedge-shaped stone, the size of a great cat, rests on its side.  Several pairs of the same shape have been pushed together to form ramps in the darkness that travel upwards to the north.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Arched Path]
description: A series of stone arches cover the path.  Each arch is decorated on top with a pair of dragon statues.  The tails of the mighty wyrms loop around the pillars of each arch, their mouths opened towards the heavens.

A series of stone arches cover the path.  Each arch is decorated on top with a pair of dragon statues.  The tails of the mighty wyrms loop around the pillars of each arch, their mouths opened towards the black sky.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Standing Stone]
description: A number of the stone ramps have been placed here, their blunt ends now joined.  The ramp pairs encircle a larger ramp with an enormous block of stone at one end.

A number of the stone ramps have been placed here, their blunt ends pressed together.  The ramp pairs encircle a larger ramp with an enormous block of stone at one end.  The dark grey color of the stones seem almost black in the starlight.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Arched Path]
description: The arches converge to form a Y-shaped pathway here.  To the northwest the arches have tipped back and now lean against the largest arch.  Although the arches no longer stand on their own, not a one shows a crack throughout their frames.

The arches converge to form a Y-shaped pathway here.  To the northwest the arches have tipped back and now lean against the largest arch.  Although the arches no longer stand on their own, not a one shows a crack throughout their moonlit frames.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ruined Road]
description: A pair of short retaining walls hold back the surrounding earth at the entry to the road.  The walls continue alongside the road as it winds to the southwest.  Sections of the walls have collapsed, spilling mounds of earth.

A pair of short retaining walls hold back the surrounding earth at the entry to the road.  The walls continue alongside the road as it winds to the southwest.  Sections of the walls have collapsed, spilling mounds of earth.  A number of nocturnal insects creep along the walls.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ruined Road]
description: The stone retaining walls fan out to open up on a clearing to the southwest.  A pair of broken drake statues lie in ruin at the end of the walls while weeds threaten to engulf them.

The stone retaining walls fan out to open up on a clearing to the southwest.  The nighttime darkness nearly conceals a pair of broken drake statues, which lie in ruin at the end of the walls while weeds threaten to engulf them.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Clearing]
description: The only thing clear about this area is the lack of debris.  Weeds that would obscure a halfling fill the clearing, making convenient hiding places for ambushers.
The only thing clear about this area is the lack of debris.  Weeds that would obscure a halfling fill the clearing, making convenient hiding places for ambushers in the night.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ruins]
description: A trail of trampled grass winds its way among the many ruined stone foundations.  A pile of rubble marks what must have been an outbuilding of some sort.  The lower half of a guard tower remains nearby, the upper half now in pieces inside.

Moonlight illuminates a trail of trampled grass winds its way among the many ruined stone foundations.  A pile of rubble marks what must have been an outbuilding of some sort.  The lower half of a guard tower remains nearby, the upper half now in pieces inside.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, The Barrens]
description: Dead trees stand like ghostly skeletons, their branches waving like arms in the wind.  The deceased trees cast spindly shadows across the dry dirt.  Wind gusts send bits of dirt flying around in stinging sheets.

Dead trees stand like ghostly skeletons, their branches waving like arms in the wind.  The deceased trees cast spindly shadows across the dry dirt.  Wind gusts send bits of dirt flying around in stinging sheets as unsuspected attacks in the night.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ruins]
description: Cyclopean marble and granite blocks lie scattered about, their surfaces rounded by ages of wind and rain.  Foundations of buildings circle a deep depression which may once have been a fountain or well, the mosaics set into the slabs all the more beautiful for the desolation that surrounds them.  Although they lean from the vertical, a few columns still stand near one of the largest and most ornate mosaics, marking the site as the probable center of town government or worship in the distant past.

Although they lean from the vertical, a few columns still stand near one of the largest and most ornate mosaics, marking the site as the probable center of town government or worship in the distant past.  The moonlight lends a ghostly glow to the ruins.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ruins]
description: Little remains of a white marble wall that once stood here.  A spiderweb of cracks runs through the remaining marble, while lizards have made a home where a large chunk of the stone is missing.  Nearby, a marble fountain stands untouched by ruin.  Only stagnant water and leaves fill the fountain's bowls now.

Nearby, a marble fountain stands untouched by ruin, its white form clearly visible in the darkness.  Only stagnant water and leaves fill the fountain's bowls now.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, The Barrens]
description: The barren trees have begun to fall here.  One has nearly broken in two, the upper half now leaning over far enough so that the top of the tree bows low to the ground.  Blasted pieces of bark and wood litter the area under the trees.
One of the trees here has nearly broken in two, the upper half now leaning over far enough so that the top of the tree bows low to the ground.  A family of eagles have made the tree into their home.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, The Barrens]
description: A pale white tree, leaning against a gigantic boulder, now stands upside down with its roots in the air.  Bits of wood fan out from the tree to the north.

A pale white tree, leaning against a gigantic boulder, now stands upside down with its roots in the air.  Bits of wood fan out from the tree to the north.  The darkness of the barrens seems to become even darker here.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, The Barrens]
description: Splinters of wood, now blackened, lie like fallen pine needles throughout the area.  Only a single stump interrupts the field of blasted wood.
Splinters of wood, now blackened, lie like fallen pine needles throughout the area.  Only a single stump interrupts the field of blasted wood, a dangerous obstacle in the black of the night.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, The Barrens]
description: A nearly flat expanse of rock spreads to the east.  A bowl in the rock has collected a considerable amount of ash.  The remains of a tree trunk lie across the depression.  To the north, a wide arch opens up into a large structure.

Bathed in moonlight, a nearly flat expanse of rock spreads to the east.  A darkened bowl in the rock has collected a considerable amount of ash.  The remains of a tree trunk lie across the depression.  To the north, a wide arch opens up into a large structure.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ruined Hall]
description: The archway opens onto a hall that must once have held hundreds, but now contains only animal droppings and dead leaves.  Every available surface on the otherwise bare walls is covered with detailed carvings of mythical creatures, vermilion and ultramarine paint still clinging to the deeper recesses of the bas-reliefs.  There is no history to be read in the mute stone, though, and it is impossible to tell if the owners of the hall fled or died here.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ruined Hall]
description: Deep gouges mar the magnificent carvings lining the hall.  A tarnished axe blade remains buried in the neck of a drake carving.  One of the hall's support columns rests as rubble across the hall.  The column's elaborate capital remains intact, covered in animal filth.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Stairwell]
description: A wide crack travels the length of the stairwell while light from grates set into the walls above cuts through the gloom.  The musty smell of decaying plant matter makes the air heavy and unpleasant.

A wide crack travels the length of the stairwell while a small amount of light from the night sky filters through the grates set into the walls above.  The musty smell of decaying plant matter makes the air heavy and unpleasant.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Basement]
description: Musty air fills the basement, a fitting companion to the stagnant puddles covering the cool earthen floor.  A menagerie of insects scurry about the room while large spiders slowly travel across the floor towards new homes.  Crumbling stone steps head up to a small landing before turning towards a doorway above.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Tunnel]
description: Oil-soaked timbers support the earth and rocks forming the tunnel walls and roof.  A lantern hangs from a badly rusted hook secured to one of the timbers.  Wooden planks line the walls, helping to hold the earth back.  A cool draft flows throughout the tunnel.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Tunnel]
description: Tangles of cobwebs hang from the tunnel roof, creating a curtain of sticky strands.  Nearby, an imflass spearhead remains imbedded deeply in the stone of the wall.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Hidden Chamber]
description: Little light illuminates the end of the tunnel.  A few odd tools are left in the dirt near the tunnel's end.  The pilings bracing the tunnel have begun to rot, making staying here a dubious proposition.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Rocky Trail]
description: The trail continues its ascent to the plateau above.  Large numbers of plants have found homes in the niches that spot the rocks along the trail.  A misstep here would result in a very rough roll down the mountain.

The trail continues its ascent into the darkness above.  Large numbers of plants have made homes in the niches that spot the rocks along the trail.  A misstep here would result in a rough tumble down the dark mountainside.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Winding Path]
[Seethe Naedal, Grassy Plateau]
description: Several tall shrubs cast their shadows across the dark grass that blankets the plateau.  The path winds its way in between the greenery, splitting into a fork.  One way lies a trail of rough terrain, while the other way appears to be well traveled and better tended.  A pine tree towers over the path, its branches swaying occasionally in the breeze.

Several boulders are scattered across the emerald green grass that blankets the plateau.  The path winds its way in between the larger rocks while smaller stones rest on the path itself.  A pine tree towers over the path, its lower branches providing shelter against the elements.

Several boulders cast their moonlit shadows across the dark grass that blankets the plateau.  The path winds its way in between the larger rocks while dark stones create a hazard to progress along the path.  A pine tree towers over the path, its branches swaying in the night breeze.

One way lays rough terrain, while the other way appears tended.  A pine tree towers over the path, its branches swaying occasionally in the breeze.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Beneath the Pine]
description: The heavy boughs of the pine droop low as they fan out from the tree trunk, and the dense fur of the needles creates a raincoat for the sheltering pine.  Stray beams of sunlight filter through the needles.  A ring of stones surrounds a patch of blackened ground and a thick matting of fallen pine needles provides a comfortable bed for the weary traveller.

The heavy boughs of the pine droop low as they fan out from the tree trunk.  The dense fur of pine needles creates a raincoat for the sheltering pine.  Stray beams of moonlight filter through the needles.  A ring of stones surround some blackened ground while a thick matting of fallen pine needles provides a comfortable bed for the weary traveller.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Winding Path]
description: A jumble of oddly-shaped rocks litter the path.  Some of the stones appear to have been worked by tools, but abandoned before finished.  Patches of lichen have taken over some of the stones while others are strangely bare.  A stream parallels the path before flowing off an overhang of rock to the west.

A jumble of oddly-shaped rocks litter the path.  Some of the stones appear to have been worked by tools, but abandoned before finished.  Patches of lichen have taken over some of the stones while others are strangely bare.  A stream parallels the path before flowing off an overhang of rock to the west.  Moonlight glints off the stream as it tumbles into the darkness below.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Winding Path]
description: The gravel covered path veers to the west to avoid a cluster of trees.  Tall grasses surround a fallen tree, a charred victim of a lightning strike.  Nearby, a pebble-lined stream winds its way through the tall grass like a snake.  Centered in the stream is a stepping stone aligned with the path.

Nearby, a pebble-lined stream crosses the path then continues to wind its way through the tall grass like a snake.  Reflected in the stream is the wavery image of a moon above.  Centered in the stream is a stepping stone aligned with the path.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Winding Path]
description: Passing through a dense copse of trees, the path continues its journey along the mountainside.  A smaller side pathway leads through the dense branches, as the trees invade the space of their neighbors, dueling for precious land.  Songbirds whistle the day away while a stream flows through the copse.  The stream spills over a rocky outcropping before rushing under a hollow log.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Winding Path]
description: Situated a short distance off the path is an enormous pile of stone chips.  Tall grasses have pushed their way up from pockets of soil in the pile.  Above here, a range of rocky crags begin.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Hot Springs]
description: Sunlight streams through the branches of the pine trees that surround the springs while short bushes fight for what sun they can gain in the shadow of the pines.  Lush grass creates a ring of green carpet around the pool.  A hollow log rests near a circle of flat stones that surround the hot springs.

Moonlight flows through the branches of the pines trees that surround the springs while short bushes fill the spaces between the pine.  Dark green grass creates a ring of dark carpet around the pool.  A hollow log rests near a circle of flat stones that surrounds the hot springs.

Lush grass carpets the area around a circle of flat stones that surrounds the steaming pool, one side of the formation creating steps that descend into the water.  A hollow log rests near a thick hedgerow that grows to either side of a scrollworked wrought-iron gate.
