title: [Seethe Naedal, Crags]
description: The path continues upward through a channel in the rock before changing to crudely carved steps that provide a precarious way up through the rocky terrain.  A family of birds have built a nest not far off the path.

The path continues upward through a channel in the rock before changing to crudely carved steps that provide a precarious way up through the rocky terrain towards the stars.  A family of birds have built a nest not far off the path.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Crags]
description: Fallen stones have smashed the rock steps near the top of the crags.  However, the stones provide an easier climb then the rocky terrain surrounding the path.  Small rocks and clumps of dirt occasionally roll down the mountain, showering any unsuspecting climbers.

A silent stillness pervades the area with the coming of darkness.  Fallen stones have smashed the rock steps near the top of the crags.  However, the stones provide an easier climb then the rocky terrain surrounding the path.  Small rocks and clumps of dirt occasionally roll down the mountain, showering any unsuspecting climbers.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Crags]
description: Finding footholds along this steep path is difficult, as it climbs nearly straight up into the DragonSpine Mountains.  You scramble to keep upright as loose rocks slip underneath your feet, and there is little to hold onto for balance.  The path seems to disappear into silvery mists above.  The downward direction looks somewhat safer, as you can see a rocky trail below that follows the mountain pass.

Finding your footing along this path is made difficult by the shadows moving across the area.  Loose rocks and earth further hinder efforts to climb further up the path.  Moonlight illuminates the silvery mist into which the path ascends.  Below, the rocky trail follows the mountain pass.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Crags]
description: The rocks provide a small resting place in the form of a narrow ledge jutting out from the sheer cliff.  Far below, the city of Ta'Illistim spreads eastward, the valley below it a blur of verdant green.  A large crevasse opens into the cliff's face.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Ridge]
description: The slope of the path lessens somewhat here, offering a small respite from the difficult ascent.  The air is still and crisp, indicative of the high altitude.  Strangely, there are no signs of snow on the mountainside.  In fact, the only thing of note along the path is its sudden disappearance into a thick silver mist that completely obscures your vision upward.

The slope of the path lessens somewhat here, offering a small respite from the difficult ascent.  The cool night breeze drifts by, bringing a myriad of forest scents with it.  Just above here, the path disappears into a thick silver mist that sparkles in the moonlight.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Ridge]
description: The softly rounded rocks forming the ridge provide for easier climbing compared to their more jagged relatives below.  A scraggly bush has pushed its way up through a crack in the rocks.  Small vines weave their way along the ridge, providing a tenuous handhold.

The softly rounded rocks forming the ridge provide for easier climbing compared to their more jagged relatives hidden in darkness below.  A scraggly bush has pushed its way up through a crack in the rocks.  The leaves rustle ominously in the night breeze.  Small vines weave their way along the ridge, providing a tenuous handhold.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Ridge]
description: You pause to take a deep breath and look at the beauty of the land around you.  A sea of mountain peaks fills your vision, rising and falling like storm waves tossed about in a titanic gale, but silent and unmoving.  The precarious path hugs the ridgeline closely.

A sea of mountain peaks fill the view from this ridge.  The mist-shrouded peaks glow in the moonlight, while the valleys below are lost in the deep darkness.  The treacherous path follows the ridgeline closely.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Observatory]
description: The trail turns here, widening to show a magnificent structure.  A tall round building looms above you, seemingly carved from the very rocks of the mountain peak itself.  The building is smooth and there are no visible seams to mar the fine craftsmanship.  On top of the large building is a curious slitted dome.

title: [Observatory, Entry Hall]
description: The building's age becomes evident as you look around this expansive entry hall.  Tapestries hang from the tall ceiling and cover most of the walls, and rugs, once rich and vibrant but now faded, cover nearly the entire floor.  Strangely, there is no dust or clutter despite the absence of any housekeeping.  The chamber is vaguely shaped like a huge piece of pie, the far walls sloping inward to meet at one point, and the wall opposite them curving inward on either side.

title: [Observatory, Library of the Sky]
description: Most of the shelves within this modest library stand empty.  Whatever books may have held a place here are either lost, or may have long since decayed to dust since unlike the other rooms within the observatory, this place is in poor shape.  Torn and tattered pages lie scattered on the floor and worktables, and the books that do remain on the shelves appear cluttered and disorganized.  Someone, or something, appears to have been searching here, but it is unclear as to what they were looking for.

title: [Observatory, Bedchamber]
description: A strange feeling of timelessness is evident here, moreso than in the rest of the observatory.  The air feels almost stagnant, and very little dust rises as it is disturbed by movement in the room.  Silent and still, a richly robed figure lies in a seemingly quiet slumber on the room's lone bed.  The figure appears as ageless as the rest of the place, but her skin is dull and grey, and she does not appear to breathe.

title: [Observatory, Dome]
description: Footsteps echo loudly in the cavernous dome overhead.  There is a four-foot slit in the side of the dome, running from the top to nearly the bottom.  In the exact center of the room, a magnificent telescope fashioned from eahnor and coraesine points toward the opening.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Entryway]
description: A sun-bleached skull lies partially buried at the jagged opening of the cavern entrance with what appears to be a baby cave worm slithering in and out of the empty eye sockets.  The rest of the skeletal remains are nowhere to be seen.  A circle of rocks encases charred pieces of wood and ashes, apparently the surviving traces of an old campfire.  Tattered and torn clothing hangs from two tree branches that have been buried deeply in the dirt.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A nice-sized hole runs the length of the southern wall of this chamber.  Dozens of furry creatures scramble back inside of it, where they disappear into its depths.  Their high-pitched cries are a clear indication that they are not happy with the intrusion.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Unlit torches hang on both sides of the narrow opening in this section of the tunnel.  Various tools lie discarded in one corner, their wooden handles warped and rotting, making them unusable.  Without warning, an onslaught of pebbles and dust rains down from above making it quite difficult to breathe.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The metallic smell of dried blood permeates this area.  Closer inspection of the walls reveals where blood was splashed by the bucketful and then dripped onto the floor.  Shattered broadswords and wooden shields lie useless in the interior of the cavern space.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Hundreds of fire beetles dance hypnotically in the air.  The eerie green light from their underbellies casts unsettling shadows on the far walls.  The floor is littered with rocks and debris making movement dangerous and burdensome.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Strange looking, thick bluish-green goop covers these walls.  From within the sticky substance radiates an unearthly glow, which illuminates this space.  Along the western wall, and at the top of a huge pile of dirt and rocks, a fair-sized roost of bats is visible.  An earlier avalanche prevents further movement in that direction.  Unrecognizable pear-shaped objects with a semi-hard outer casing are placed haphazardly on the floors of this chamber.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: More of the unknown pear-shaped objects are all around.  Oddly enough, a scratching sound seems to be coming from inside several of them.  The unmistakable sound of an insect-like chittering fills the air.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Silken threads of a gigantic spiderweb completely ensconce the far right wall of this chamber.  Some rusted, augmented chain mail armor and a visored helm, as well as the bones of various creatures, rest underneath this silent deathtrap.  Huge, beady red eyes stare out from an orifice directly above the spiderweb.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Foul smelling air in this section makes breathing through the nose optional.  Walking becomes difficult as the ground suddenly shifts underfoot.  The serrated surface of the walls is covered with webs, and their owners stand their ground defiantly.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Piles of thick greenish goop cover a few spots on the floors and walls in here.  In one corner of the room, a skeleton is plastered against a wall by the sticky substance.  An unbearable stench, accompanied by an odd clicking sound, seems to be coming from directly ahead.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Resembling a plush carpet, chunky blue and green fuzzy mold covers the floors entirely, muffling the steps of anyone or anything that may be moving about.  The mildew on the walls is thick enough to be scraped off with a fingernail, making the walls even denser.  Emptied of its contents and almost buried in a small nook lies a corroded treasure chest.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A large body of thick, black stagnant water rests directly in the center of this chamber, forcing you to inch cautiously along the edges of the pool.  Huge ripples run silently and sluggishly across the surface of the water.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Overhead tremendous stalactites dangle perilously high above the cavern floor.  A series of drawings are etched on the walls illustrating an ancient struggle.  Elven runes appear to be underneath several of the depictions.  Some are so old that they are almost indecipherable, while a few have obvious claw marks slashed through them.  In one of the far corners can be heard the rustling noises of small creatures.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: An unexplainable wind howls throughout this cyclopean chamber, kicking up and stirring huge clouds of dust.  Columns of stalagmites dot the surface of the ground.  They appear to have been artfully arranged by the creators of the caverns themselves.  Some are so tall they seem to be connecting with the stalactites on the ceiling.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The ceiling appears to be made of living black leather as a sudden gust of wind creates a ripple-like effect.  Suddenly, the flapping of many wings and the high-pitched screeching cries of thousands of bats fills your very soul.  From somewhere in the shadows comes the sound of something heavy crashing to the earth.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The unmistakable cadence of rushing water fills the air.  The water plummets from a considerably sized gap from above and crashes down into the depths of a seemingly bottomless chasm below.  The spray from the underground waterfall creates a light mist, which covers the ground in this chamber.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The pear-shaped objects that occupied other parts of the cavern line the floor.  These stand empty now.  Cracked and jagged pieces from their tops are scattered across the ground as if something fought its way out of their interiors.  Beside the eggs are heaps of gnawed bones.  On the very top of the bone-pile lies the skull of a human child.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Odd clicking sounds surround you, as they echo and bounce off the ceilings and walls in this section of the cavern, making it difficult to determine which direction the noise is truly coming from.  What appear to be the skeletal remains of a gigantic insect are slumped against the wall in a corner.  An inhuman stench wafts through the area.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: This vast cavernous space serves as the mausoleum for the inhabitants of these tunnels.  Row upon row of oblong niches are cut deeply into these walls, stretching from the ground all the way to the ceiling to house the bones of those now long dead.  The air itself is putrid.

title: [Maernstrike Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Both walls and floor seem to glitter and sparkle from pieces of ore which are embedded within them.  Corroded carts are turned over on their sides not far from the tracks that were once used to carry the ore the miners freed to the outside of the cavern to be used in a nearby town.  The tracks are bent and twisted, perhaps by a huge burrowing creature.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Hot Springs]
description: Wisps of steam rise off the pool as the hot water comes in contact with the cool mountain air.  Centered in the pool is a flat rock, barely protruding above the surface.  The rock has become home to several dragonflies.  Shadows from the tree branches above dance across the water.

Wisps of steam rise from the pool as the hot water comes in contact with the cool night breeze.  Moonlight illuminates a flat rock centered in the pool which has become home to several dragonflies.  The midnight-black water mirrors the night sky, seemingly an extension of the heavens above.

title: [Wooded Hillside, Trail]
description: A matted carpet of fallen leaves covers the narrow trail, which winds downward to the northeast through a stand of young oak trees.  Faint sounds of footsteps or conversation can be heard now and then from the road to the west, muffled by the underbrush and the deepening foliage.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: The trail dips into a patch of low ground, dappled moonlight filtering through the sparse branches of the oaks and dogwoods to illuminate patches of green fiddlehead ferns.  A few fireflies dance around the path, and the cry of some distant nightbird echoes from somewhere to the east.

The trail dips into a patch of low ground, dappled sunlight filtering through the sparse branches of the oaks and dogwoods to splash on patches of bright green fiddlehead ferns.  The cry of a distant bird of prey echoes from somewhere to the east.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: An ancient black oak stands just to the north, turning the trail northwest across its sprawling roots and up a gentle rise in the uneven hillside.  A heavy, woodsy scent of moss and loam fills the air, drifting on the night breeze in a quiet rhythm with the shifting patterns of moonlight on the ground.

An ancient black oak stands just to the north, turning the trail northwest across its sprawling roots and up a gentle rise in the uneven hillside.  A heavy, woodsy scent of moss and loam fills the air, drifting on the breeze in a quiet rhythm with the shifting patterns of sunlight on the ground.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: Chipmunks and beetles scurry for shelter in the stands of ferns that line both sides of the trail as it winds up the sloping hillside to the northwest.  A dogwood tree spreads its delicate branches over the path, its snowy blossoms glistening in the sparse moonlight.

Chipmunks and beetles scurry for shelter in the stands of ferns that line both sides of the trail as it winds up the sloping hillside to the northwest.  A dogwood tree spreads its delicate branches over the trail, dropping a patch of snowy blossoms on the blanket of dirt and fallen leaves.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: The trail wanders over a rise in the forest floor, passing through a stand of white birches than bend over the leaf-carpeted path from both sides.  The hillside slopes gently down to the southeast, and the faint sound of a gurgling spring somewhere in the distance can be heard during lulls in the forest breeze.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: The trail is a bit wider here, as if many woodland creatures have traveled it over the years, and it narrows as it winds through a stand of graceful birches to the south.  A faint scent of burning wood wafts through the cool air, and an owl hoots mournfully somewhere in a nearby tree.

The trail is a bit wider here, as if many woodland creatures have traveled it over the years, and it narrows as it winds through a stand of graceful birches to the south.  A faint scent of burning wood wafts through the cool air, and a woodland bird sings somewhere in a nearby tree.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: A thicket of gnarled oaks forces the trail in a sharp bend, the trampled ground curving around what looks like a small clearing just behind the trees to the south.  The oaks' heavy trunks are etched with the marks of countless crude hatchets, the moss-covered markings somehow forming a pattern reminiscent of ancient runes.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: The trail slopes steeply down to the east, descending into a lush, wooded valley.  Bright green fireflies flicker among the ferns that line the shaded path.  Far to the east, a vast moonlit expanse of tree-dotted grassland and distant mist-shrouded moors can be glimpsed through the branches.

The trail slopes steeply down to the east, descending into a lush, wooded valley.  Bright yellow butterflies flitter among the ferns that line the shaded path.  Far to the east, a vast expanse of tree-dotted grassland and distant mist-shrouded moors can be glimpsed through the branches.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Trail]
description: Branches grow thickly overhead, weaving in a nearly junglelike canopy of oak and cedar boughs and drifting moss.  The narrow trail slopes further down to the southeast, its route becoming clearer as it winds between tree trunks and hillside boulders.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Riverbed]
description: A narrow ribbon of moonlight forms a shimmering path down the center of what seems to be an ancient riverbed, the low ground covered by a carpet of ferns and wintergreen that thrive in the rich soil born of eons of fallen and rotting leaves.  Massive oaks and cedars stand to either side, their dark trunks standing like silent sentinels along the ancient path.

A narrow strip of sunlight forms a shimmering path down the center of what seems to be an ancient riverbed, the low ground covered by a carpet of ferns and wintergreen that thrive in the rich soil born of eons of fallen and rotting leaves.  Massive oaks and cedars stand to either side, inhabited by seemingly dozens of squirrels that scamper chittering along the branches.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, northwest

title: [Yegharren Valley, Riverbed]
description: Piles of ancient stones, shaded by the overhanging branches of the oak forest and now half-covered with dirt and moss, mark the border of the river that flowed through the valley millions of years before.  Moonlight filters through the branches overhead, dappling the leaf-covered ground in an ever-shifting pattern of faint light and shadow.

Piles of ancient stones, shaded by the overhanging branches of the oak forest and now half-covered with dirt and moss, mark the border of the river that flowed through the valley millions of years before.  Sunlight filters through the branches overhead, dappling the leaf-covered ground in an ever-shifting pattern of light.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Wooded Slope]
description: Patches of green ferns and a profusion of wildflowers cover the gentle, rocky slope, thriving in the scattered moonlight that glistens through the branches of the surrounding oak trees.  Thick moss covers the numerous roots and rocks that encroach on the trail, ready to trip the unwary traveller.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Riverbed]
description: A large, flat boulder rests half-buried in the loamy ground, its surface covered with moss that is worn away in many places as if it has been used as a resting place over time.  A faint breeze wafts through from the east, bringing a faint whiff of something burning somewhere that blends with the forest scents of cedar and decaying leaves.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Clearing]
description: Banks of deep green grass surround a bubbling spring that emerges from the forest floor in the center of a bright clearing between the trees.  Moonlight glints faintly on the water and illuminates the flat, moss-carpeted boulder that extends over the woodland pool.

Banks of deep green grass surround a bubbling spring that emerges from the forest floor in the center of a bright clearing between the trees.  Sunlight sparkles on the water and warms the surface of the flat, moss-carpeted boulder that extends over the woodland pool.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Wooded Slope]
description: Acorns lie scattered around the leaf-carpeted soil under a particularly fruitful old oak, and a few red and grey squirrels scamper in and around the tree, gathering their nutty feast even in the night's darkness.  The forest floor dips in a shaded, brush-filled furrow just to the north.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Forest]
description: A thick canopy of leafy branches conceals most of the sky, making this low-lying thicket even darker than the rest of the night.  Thick bushes fill the gaps between the massive trunks of the trees, and earthworms and beetles crawl in and out of the deep, soft carpet of decaying leaves on the ground.

A thick canopy of leafy branches makes this low-lying thicket nearly as dark as night.  Thick bushes fill the gaps between the massive trunks of the trees, and earthworms and beetles crawl in and out of the deep, soft carpet of decaying leaves on the ground.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Wooded Slope]
description: A wide trail winds eastward between the trees, zigzagging up a steep slope that rises out of the forest to a grassy plateau.  Thick patches of fiddlehead ferns thrive beneath the spreading branches of the older maples and oaks, competing with saplings born of falling seeds and acorns for the space between the roots.

Thick patches of fiddlehead ferns thrive beneath the spreading branches of the older maples and oaks, competing with saplings born of falling seeds and acorns for the remaining sunlight.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Riverbed]
description: A wooded hillside slopes up to the south, rising away from the flat ground of the ancient riverbed.  A deep depression in the ground near the trail is filled with muddy rainwater, and the tracks and droppings of many animals are visible in the soft ground around its edges.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Wooded Slope]
description: Younger oaks and maples dot the hillside above an undergrowth of moonlit ferns and the dark forms of bushes.  The wind blows stronger here, occasional gusts from the east rustling ominously in the shadowy branches of the trees.

Younger oaks and maples dot the hillside above an undergrowth of bright ferns and berry bushes.  The wind blows stronger here, occasional gusts from the east rustling ominously in the branches of the trees.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: A vast sea of grass as tall as a full-grown dwarf stretches off to the east, dotted here and there by the spreading forms of ghostly acacia trees silhouetted against the night sky.  The shadowy outlines of predatory nightbirds glide above the grass in the distance.  A sloping trail leads down to the west into a forested valley below.

A vast sea of grass as tall as a full-grown dwarf stretches off to the east, dotted here and there by the spreading forms of lone acacia trees.  The black outlines of predatory birds glide above the grass in the distance.  A sloping trail leads down to the west into a forested valley below.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine's Edge]
description: The level ground of the old riverbed suddenly disappears as the ground falls away to the east amid a jumble of boulders and fallen branches where a rushing waterfall must have once filled the still air with mist countless years ago.  A huge formation of piled rocks bounds the northern entrance to the ravine, and the more traversable ground of the forest rises in a shady hillside to the south.  High moors rise beyond the deep ravine, their geography shrouded in clouds of darkening mist.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Riverbed]
description: Smaller trees have taken root in the shade of the older oaks that bound the ancient riverbed, their leafy branches intertwining in the filtered moonlight.  The subtle, rich scent of earth and rotting leaves drifts through the air.  A narrow strip of ground leading east through the trees has been obviously trampled, as if many visitors have passed in that direction.

The subtle, rich scent of earth and rotting leaves drifts through the air. title: [Yegharren Valley, Forest]
description: A moss-covered boulder as big as a house blocks the path to the east, its face covered with a network of fragile climbing vines.  An occasional faint buzzing breaks the silence of the night, its source a huge grey wasp nest suspended from a branch high above.

A moss-covered boulder as big as a house blocks the path to the east, its face covered with a network of fragile climbing vines.  A constant faint buzzing breaks the silence of the forest, its source a huge grey wasp nest suspended from a branch high above.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Forest]
description: A sprawling thicket of blackberry bushes threatens to overrun the path here, its tangled branches forming ominous shapes in the filtered moonlight.  The roots of the surrounding oaks crisscross the open ground, peeking out from the thick carpet of dirt and leaves.

A sprawling thicket of blackberry bushes threatens to overrun the path here, its tangled branches populated by a small flock of multicolored forest birds that whistle noisily as they feed on the ripe berries.  The roots of the surrounding oaks crisscross the open ground, peeking out from the thick carpet of dirt and leaves.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Forest]
description: The massive trunk of a fallen oak lies half-buried in the loam, home to colonies of tiny brown and white mushrooms that in turn are home to thousands of tiny beetles and spiders.  The underbrush grows thicker on the northern hillside, making the forest impassable in that direction.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Riverbed]
description: Dappled moonlight filters down from above, illuminating patches of lilies-of-the-valley beneath the trees with a ghostly light.  The forest air is still, broken now and then by the song of a nearby bird or the rustling of an animal passing through the underbrush.

Dappled sunlight filters down from above, illuminating patches of lilies-of-the-valley that thrive in the rich soil beneath the trees.  The forest air is still, broken now and then by the song of a nearby bird or the rustling of an animal passing through the underbrush.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: Tall grass surrounds the narrow strip of the hunting trail on all sides, the saw-edged blades rustling in the constant wind.  The silence is broken by a heavy rustling as some large creature thunders through the vegetation somewhere nearby.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: A faint, narrow trail winds through the tall grass, the ground cleared of vegetation along a narrow strip where untold hundreds of hunters and hunted have passed.  A single acacia tree stands near the trail here, its lacy branches spreading like a filigreed umbrella under the night sky.

A faint, narrow trail winds through the tall grass, the ground cleared of vegetation along a narrow strip where untold hundreds of hunters and hunted have passed.  A single acacia tree stands near the trail here, its flowered branches spreading like a filigreed umbrella in the bright sun.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: A faint trail has been trampled through the endless expanse of tall grass, as if numerous creatures and perhaps hunters have passed this way.  A steady wind blows through from the east, rustling the moonlit green blades in a constant hushed hiss.

A faint trail has been trampled through the endless expanse of tall grass, as if numerous creatures and perhaps hunters have passed this way.  A steady wind blows through from the east, rustling the green and yellow blades in a constant hushed hiss.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: Tall grass surrounds the trail on all sides, providing shelter for whatever large creatures pass nearby, heard but not seen as they rustle through the dry blades.  Numerous flies hover above the grass here and there, adding their faint buzzing to the ever-present sound of the wind.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: Wind sweeps through the tall grass, rustling the heavy blades in a constant background noise.  The clawed footprints of large orcs can be seen here and there in cleared patches of soil along the trail.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: The sea of tall grass that extends as far as the eye can see to the north and east ends in a wooded hillside that slopes down into a vegetation-choked valley.  A few head-sized stones have been set at the edge of the woods in an oddly unnatural pattern, as if placed there to leave some unknown message or to mark the way.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: A section of grass not far from the trail is matted and trampled into something that looks like a nest, and a faint whiff of animal dung fills the air.  A cloud of black flies drifts around the trail, scattering at any approach then reassembling into a droning mass.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Wooded Trail]
description: The trail winds down the hillside into a wooded valley, the dense underbrush threatening to cover the path and obscure the way.  Smells of woods and dirt and moss fill the shaded air, and a clear patch of open moonlit sky is visible to the east.

The trail winds down the hillside into a wooded valley, the dense underbrush threatening to cover the path and obscure the way.  Smells of woods and dirt and moss fill the shaded air, and a bright spot of sunlit sky is visible to the east.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: The field of grass ends in a wooded hillside that slopes gently to the west.  A clear spring emerges from a pile of rocks near the edge of the grass, gathering to trickle off down the slope in a shade-dappled ribbon of water.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Wooded Slope]
description: Sparkling faintly with occasional glints of moonlight, a small woodland stream runs alongside the gently sloping trail from east to west.  A fat raccoon crouches on the other side of the stream, eyeing you cautiously as he washes a piece of food in the clear water.

Sparkling with occasional glints of filtered sunlight, a small woodland stream runs alongside the gently sloping trail from east to west.  A fat raccoon crouches on the other side of the stream, eyeing you cautiously as he washes a piece of food in the clear water.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Wooded Trail]
description: Overhanging branches cast moving shadows on the trail, swaying in the breeze like jagged arms reaching down from above to grasp unwary visitors.  Patches of ferns, deep green in the filtered moonlight, encroach on the path from both sides, their lacy fronds trampled into the soil here and there by passing hunters or prey.

Overhanging branches cast irregular shadows on the trail, swaying in the breeze like jagged arms reaching down from above to grasp unwary visitors.  Bright green ferns encroach on the path from both sides, their lacy fronds trampled into the soil here and there by passing hunters or prey.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Wooded Slope]
description: The trail makes a sharp turn from east to southwest, curving around the trunk of an ancient black oak tree.  A huge white-faced owl rests on an overhanging branch, breaking the silence with an occasional mournful hoot.

The trail makes a sharp turn from east to southwest, curving around the trunk of an ancient black oak tree.  A flock of noisy black crows rest in the overhanging branches, filling the air with their raucous cries.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: Small burrows dot the earth where the thick grass borders the trail, home to some unseen ground dweller.  A low, muddy patch in the trail shows evidence of footprints of large, orclike creatures.  Some large bird of prey, its species unidentifiable in the darkness, perches on an outstretched branch of a nearby acacia, scanning the expanse of grass for its next meal.

Small burrows dot the earth where the thick grass borders the trail, home to some unseen ground dweller.  A low, muddy patch in the trail shows evidence of footprints of large, orclike creatures.  A red hawk perches on an outstretched branch of a nearby acacia, scanning the expanse of grass for its next meal.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: The ocean of high grass that bounds the narrow hunting path rustles now and then with the movement of some unknown creature passing close by.  The moons cast a dim glow over the plain, broken by the occasional dark form of a passing cloud.

The ocean of high grass that bounds the narrow hunting path rustles now and then with the movement of some unknown creature passing close by.  The sunlight is broken by the occasional shifting form of a passing cloud.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: A sea of tall grass surrounds the hunting path on all sides, occasionally rustling with the passing of some large unseen creature.  The breeze carries a scent of cool night air and drying grass, and occasionally a more ominous odor of something lying dead nearby.

A sea of tall grass surrounds the hunting path on all sides, occasionally rustling with the passing of some large unseen creature.  The breeze carries a scent of sun and drying grass, and occasionally a more ominous odor of something lying dead nearby.

title: [Grasslands, Ravine Bank]
description: The plateau ends abruptly here at the bank of a deep ravine, the ground falling away in a sheer drop to the black grotto far below.  A lone acacia stands on a strip of rocky dirt at the edge of the grass, its branches extending in a canopy over the treacherous cliff.

The plateau ends abruptly here at the bank of a deep ravine, the ground falling away in a sheer drop to the grotto far below.  A lone acacia stands on a strip of rocky dirt at the edge of the grass, its branches extending in a canopy over the treacherous cliff.

title: [Grasslands, Ravine Bank]
description: A tiny stream, no more than a trickle of muddy rainwater, emerges from the tall grass and drips over the sheer edge of the ravine.  Footprints of various denizens of the grasslands and the marks of many a struggle are visible in the muddy ground near the lifegiving water, and a few flecks of what appears to be blood form dark patches on the thick blades of grass.

A tiny stream, no more than a trickle of muddy rainwater, emerges from the tall grass and drips over the sheer edge of the ravine.  Footprints of various denizens of the grasslands and the marks of many a struggle are visible in the muddy ground near the lifegiving water, and a few flecks of what appears to be blood show bright red on the thick blades of grass.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: The hunting trail turns in a right angle around a dense tuft of grass.  A swarm of flies drones loudly somewhere nearby, unseen in the darkness as they gather over some abandoned kill.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: A tall acacia rises from the sea of grass beside the path, its branches spreading like a dark canopy and its fragrant blossoms attracting a few buzzing insects even in the night air.  A constant breeze from the east rustles the tips of the tall grass in an endless wave.

A tall acacia rises from the sea of grass beside the path, its spreading branches providing welcome shade and its fragrant blossoms attracting a variety of colorful insects.  A constant breeze from the east rustles the tips of the tall grass in an endless wave.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Grasslands]
description: The trail winds downward to the east as the ground slopes gently into another wide plain of grassland below.  A sea of dark, rustling grass higher than a halfling's head leads off as far as the eye can see to the north and west.

The trail winds downward to the east as the ground slopes gently into another wide plain of grassland below.  A sea of green and golden grass higher than a halfling's head leads off as far as the eye can see to the north and west.

title: [Elysiana's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the glossy tanik floor is interrupted by a sphere-topped black marble fountain.  Halfway to the nightscape ceiling, a detailed landscape painting hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Marshtown, Crafters' Gatehouse]
description: An anvil-shaped sign hangs above the entrance of a wooden gatehouse, and a high modwir fence encloses the entire floating platform that stretches northward behind it.  A fellow wearing a leather work apron, which looks like it serves more as an over-taxed belly support than a protective garment, leans against the gatehouse wall.

title: [Metalworkers' Enclave]
description: A broad wooden walkway leads north to a canopied platform.  A counter and attendant occupy the center of the platform, and a number of narrower walkways radiate from it to other platforms, each supporting a small, tin-roofed building with a brick chimney.  To either side of the gatehouse to the south, the roofs and upper stories of Marshtown's taller buildings can be seen above the enclave's high fence.

title: [Metalworkers' Central Platform]
description: A metal-topped counter occupies the central third of the platform, and a large sign hangs from the main post that rises behind the counter.  A ruddy-complected giantman, with shoulders and arms heavily muscled even for one of his race, leans on an oversized boarding pike, a polished glaes toothpick protruding from his mouth.

title: [Marshtown, Green Ell]
description: The plank walkway turns a corner to the east and heads south into Marshtown.  To the west, the boardwalk approaches a seafood eatery.  The eatery sits some distance above the water level, anchored on the north to a hill that rises out of the marsh.  The south of the building is secured to tall, thick pilings that have been driven deep into the marsh.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: The buildings rise precariously high along this section of the boardwalks that serve as the streets of this floating town.  The tall wooden buildings sway noticeably at the top, the barrels beneath creaking and groaning constantly.  The boardwalk is warped in places here, needing repair from constant exposure to the elements.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: The boardwalk turns a bend to the south and northwest.  A break in the buildings that flank the walkway provides a view of the marsh that the town is built upon.  Occasional muddy mounds rise up from the marsh, possibly homes to some of the wildlife in the area.  The marsh sports several solid areas where the soil is exposed, but only thick, murky water sits beneath the barrels of Marshtown.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: The walkway turns abruptly southeast from here, while striking due west toward a large hill.  The buildings here sport signs reading "Jag Hill" and have shining steel numbers attached.  This section of town seems very well kept when compared with the rest of the sprawl.  A dark, narrow alley leads due south between two taller buildings.  Denuded of its mane by the elements, the skin of a cragviper is stretched on a tanning frame that hangs above a doorway just inside the alley.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: This section of boardwalk is wide and appears newer than in other places in town.  Some of the planks have obviously been recently replaced and have not been faded and stained by the elements.  A storefront on the north side of the boardwalk sports several new boards and a large glaes-paned window, making it stand out from the buildings to either side of it.  A large hill rises out of the marsh to the northwest.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: The walkway widens considerably for a stretch into an oval bulge.  No buildings can be found this far along, and the boardwalk opens to the surrounding marsh.  Railings border the walkway, and benches and tables line the edges of the planks, providing a place to rest and perhaps have a meal.  To the northeast, a muddy path rises out of the marsh and climbs a tall hill.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: The muddy path is treacherous and lined to either side by sharp-leafed plants that cut and slice at exposed skin.  Rolling mud and loose rocks make the climb very difficult, and the lack of any railing provides a frustrating ascent to the top of the hill.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Point]
description: A wide, flat clearing stretches out here atop Jag Hill, rising from the bog and providing a much needed break from the damp and soggy conditions down the hill to the south.  A ring of stones in the center of the clearing contains the burned out remains of many campfires.  Large stones, crates, and small barrels have been arranged around the fire pit, providing convenient resting places while drying out.  To the north, the terrain flattens out, but is covered by dense brush.

title: [Vornavis Exterior, Underbrush]
description: The brush here is dense and low to the ground, and squeezing through leaves many scratches and small cuts on exposed skin.  Occasional posts can be seen off to the east, indicating that a rail or walkway existed here long ago.  Puddles gather to the west, but the worn path is very firm.

title: [Vornavis, Underbrush]
description: The thicket clears out to the north and narrows inward and down to the south.  A small opening in the wall of briars to the south indicates a regularly traveled but well secluded path.  To the north, the path opens up more like a road.

title: [Vornavis, Ruins]
description: Near the path, cut stone blocks can be found in the underbrush.  Far off to either side of the path, ruins of small stone buildings can be seen.  Long worn by the elements and overgrown with mosses and vines, these buildings seem to have been uninhabited for a very long time.

title: [Vornavis, Ruins]
description: Dense brush crowds the cliff edge to the south, but here an expanse of ancient paving stones chokes out all but a few saplings and lines of weeds that have managed to take root in the seams.  Further to the north, single blocks of stone and the tumbled remains of buildings peek through the scrub and tall grasses.

title: [Vornavis, Ruins]
description: Stone markers line either side of the well-defined path here, but any lettering on the markers has long since been worn away by the elements and the years.  In the distance to the north, the ruins of a shattered tower break the skyline.  Occasional cobblestones stick through the grass here, indicating that the path may have once been paved.

title: [Vornavis, Ruins]
description: To the north, the ring of a broken tower blocks further progress.  To the south, the path leads toward a large marsh.  Burned and broken stone buildings are near the path here, and large mounds of earth and vegetation indicate where other buildings may have once stood, but are now long forgotten and hidden from sight.

title: [Vornavis, Broken Tower]
description: Inside the tower, the floor is still sturdy and strong.  The walls have cracked and crumbled, but still stand nearly two stories high in some places.  To the west, a large doorway leads outward to a cobblestone road.  The width of the ring of remains indicates that the tower was once very tall, possibly a watchtower capable of viewing the countryside for miles around.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road here was once extremely well maintained, and looks to be more like a city street than a wilderness road.  Cobblestones pave the road that runs up to the remains of a broken and ruined tower to the east, and into the distance in the west.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: As the road continues to the east, the condition of the cobblestones improves drastically.  Many of the cobblestones of the road are in very good shape, and the gutters are practically clean of debris.  The road is remarkably intact in spite of the obvious lack of use and untold years of neglect.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road is marked here by potholes and missing cobblestones.  Travel conditions improve to the east, but this section would be extremely hard on wagon wheels.  To the southwest, the road continues to deteriorate.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Sections of gutter are filled with thick mud here, and long stretches of road have no cobblestones.  Where the cobblestones remain, weeds and small bushes poke through, making the road very uneven.  The brush begins to close in on the road.  Scattered small trees dot the landscape.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road is well defined here, but not very well maintained.  To the east, cobblestones appear occasionally, indicating that this road was once very well looked after.  To the west, the road continues as far as the eye can see into the horizon.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A series of small hills interrupts the flat flow of the road for a stretch.  The hills are topped with bushes and trees, but the valleys between are filled with grasses and cattails.  The road is very steady, and shows signs of nearly constant travel.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Dry grasses stretch out in a plain to the south of the path here.  Amber fields of tall swaying grass wave hypnotically in the slight, steady breeze.  The rustling hiss of the grasses in the breeze sets the mind at ease.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The fields to the south of the path here change from amber to the east to green and lush to the west.  The fields have no paths or roads leading into them, but occasionally, the tall grasses are crushed or swept to one side as if by a traveler or a large animal.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road continues to the east into a wide, flat area marked by fields of tall grasses.  To the west, a small wooded area crosses the road, becoming more dense and lush far to the north.  The road remains well defined, and wagon wheel ruts show regular use.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road travels through a very sparsely wooded area for a stretch here.  The woods are not dense, and allow direct moonlight to touch the forest floor.  This is either the beginning of a very young forest, or the end of a very old one.

The road travels through a very sparsely wooded area for a stretch here.  The woods are not dense, and allow direct sunlight to touch the forest floor.  This is either the beginning of a very young forest, or the end of a very old one.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: To the east, a small wooded area crosses the path, and green leaves cling to trees swaying in the breeze.  The road slopes sharply downward for a stretch before turning toward the southwest.  A clump of holly bushes to the north of the path here looks out of place.

To the east, a small wooded area crosses the path, and vibrant green leaves cling to trees swaying in the breeze.  The road slopes sharply downward for a stretch before turning toward the southwest.  A clump of holly bushes to the north of the path here looks out of place.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A huge pit opens to the north of the path here.  Piles of dirt lie all around the rim of the hole, as if pushed outward from underground.  Shattered bones, now unidentifiable, litter the area around the mouth of the pit.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road rises to the top of a rather tall hill here before sloping down to the east and the west.  Many rings of rocks mark the area around the top of the hill, the vantage point from on high making this a popular campsite.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A swampy area approaches the road from the north here, but does not come close enough to make the road wet.  Frogs and crickets can be heard from the dank-smelling fens, and mosquitoes buzz about, seeking a meal from the road.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The path here is very marshy, and tall grasses grow in patches near puddles underfoot.  Two gnarled trees border the mouth of the path leading out of the bog onto the road to the north.  To the south, the path strikes deeper into the foul smelling fen.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Thousands of sunflowers decorate the fields south of the road here, painting the landscape yellow in the moonlight.  Tall grasses grow through the sunflowers, and the leaves rustle against the dry grasses in the breeze.

Thousands of sunflowers decorate the fields south of the road here, painting the landscape a vibrant yellow.  Tall grasses grow through the sunflowers, and the leaves rustle against the dry grasses in the breeze.  Bees swarm about the field busily.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road moves into a very hilly area to the west, but flattens out considerably to the east.  The hills are choppy and irregular, but are not very tall and are easily navigated by staying on the road.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The hills here jump more than roll through the landscape.  Short, pointed peaks stand jaggedly above the hills.  Boulders and rock outcroppings appear regularly near the road, marking progress and providing homes for insects looking for shade.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Hills that rise to the east fall away to the west, leaving a broken plain dotted with boulders and rock outcroppings.  The fields to the south of the path sport short brush and grasses.  To the north, trees stand side by side with the boulders littering the fields.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road to the west begins to run along a slight ridge, while to the east, the road flattens to plains.  The ridge borders a wide lake stretching out in an oval to the south.  Flocks of geese take flight above the lake, occasionally swooping down into the water.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The path here bends around a ridge above a large lake to the south and southeast.  In the crags of the ridge, crows nest and look out over the lake.  No paths lead down to the lake, and the ridge crumbles dangerously at any attempt to climb.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The path slopes up a ridge to the northeast, but flattens out to wide, featureless plains to the west.  The ridge borders a large lake to the southeast.  Flocks of nocturnal birds fly up and away from the lake, crossing the ridge into the plains to the northwest.

The path slopes up a ridge to the northeast, but flattens out to wide, featureless plains to the west.  The ridge borders a large lake to the southeast.  Flocks of birds fly up and away from the lake, crossing the ridge into the plains to the northwest.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The plains to the north and south of the path here are featureless, unbroken by hills, rocks, or trees.  Herds of velnalin grazing in the fields far away from the road eye the grasses suspiciously watching for predators.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The beige, featureless plains stretch on nearly endlessly in all directions, dulling the senses.  The road resembles a trench dug through the landscape, bisecting it into northern and southern sections.

title: [Noman's Land, Muddy Trail]
description: A crude wooden sign stands sentry at the head of the trail here.  The muddy ground is filled with footprints, some of which are disturbingly large.  To the south, a clump of low hills squats around a small valley.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: There seems to be no end to the plains here which monotonously roll out each mile of the journey along the path.  Campsites made along the road are swallowed quickly by the dry, rustling grasses.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A narrow river appears to the west, crossing the path.  The river was completely hidden by the tall grasses at a distance.  A bridge crosses the river to the west, while dry grasslands stretch out as far as the eye can see to the east.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: From the top of the bridge here, the river winds through the dry plains to the north and south.  The water is not wide or fast, but provides sustenance to the short, green grasses that grow along the banks, highlighting the course of the river.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Plains of high grasses wave gently in the breeze that blows here, making a hypnotic pattern in the otherwise featureless plains surrounding the road as far as the eye can see.  The road approaches a bridge to the east where a small river cuts across the path.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road curves southwest into a series of rolling hills, cutting a straight path directly over them.  To the east, the road plunges into an endless plain of dry, amber grasses rustling in the breezes.  Herds of roltons graze on the grasses at the foot of the hills.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Rocks and boulders litter the area about the path, some large enough to conceal small caves.  Goats and roltons move among the rocks, vying for grazing position.  Small rings of stone contain the remains of many campfires lit in this area.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Off the path to the north, a large stone has been carved smooth on top, seemingly to be used as some sort of table or altar.  Piles of animal bones and ruined, improperly stretched skins litter the area surrounding the stone.  Tree stumps dot the hills, indicating the regular cutting of firewood.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The hills are tall and wide here, becoming challenging to cross with a wagon or carrying a heavy pack.  The tops of the hills are often crowned with trees.  Clumps of bushes also adorn the hillsides, sporting bright green leaves and bright red berries.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road climbs to the top of a tall peak here, and the hills roll out to the east.  From the top of this hill, a wide area of plains cut in two by the road can be seen to the east.  A valley to the west appears to be lush with plant life, and several plowed fields are visible in the distance.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The hill slopes down gradually to the west into a wide valley dotted with farmhouses.  To the east, the hill climbs to a high peak, a great vantage point for viewing the surrounding area.  The road is well defined and very well traveled.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The valley is alive with the sounds of buzzing locusts and merrily chirping crickets in the fields.  Small dirt roads lead off into fields of crops grown by the farmers of the valley.  A wide river can be seen to the west.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The valley is lush with all varieties of life, from plants to birds to beavers and opossums.  A wide river to the west is crossed by a flat stone bridge which lies low to the river and stretches long from bank to bank.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The flat stones of the bridge have been expertly crafted to fit snugly together and provide safe passage across the water.  From the bridge, the river seems to flow by slowly with few ripples and no rapids.  Judging from the size of the river, however, it must flow swifter below than on the surface.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A stone cottage lies off the path to the north here, perhaps the home of a stonecutter judging by the tools and stones in the yard.  To the east, a flat stone bridge crosses a wide river.  To the west, the road continues across the valley.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Fields of corn lie off the path to the north, and fields of tobacco to the south.  The smell of the crops is invigorating, but pollen hanging in the air is enough to make a dwarf sneeze.  Barrels and small carts, fully functional, have been left trustingly by the side of the path near the fields.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The valley that stretches out to the east is lush with life.  Fields of crops mark the landscape, and a wide river can be seen cutting through the center of the valley.  To the west, a high hill rises far above the valley floor.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The hill here is steep, making going rough for wagons and laden travelers.  To the west, the hill rises to a tall peak covered with pine trees.  To the east, the road descends into a wide, green valley dotted with farm houses and fields of crops.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The view from the top of this hill is obscured by the pine trees growing here, making the view no less breathtaking, but somewhat less informative.  The path cuts through the pines, and strikes down the hill east to the valley, and west to the shattered hills.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The path runs steeply up a hill to the east into a cluster of pine trees growing on top of the hill.  To the west, the road runs down the hillside into a series of much lower, rolling hills that support an orchard of apple trees.  The orchard looks untended, but regularly used.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Hundreds of apples in various states of ripeness and decay litter the sides of the road as the path strikes through an apple orchard.  Flies and gnats swarm from the fruit when approached.  The trees still support many edible, ripe apples ready for the plucking.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A deep trench has been dug alongside the path here, and is filled with branches and rotting apples.  The edges of the trench show signs of scorching, indicating that the trench is used for regular burning.  Diseased and damaged fruits and trees are discarded and burned here.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road continues to roll through hills to the east and the west.  To the east, the hills are populated with apple trees.  To the west, the hills grow much more barren, often showing bare stone faces, or long stretches of gray, blasted earth.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The dirt of the road turns to fine, gray ash here, and no plants grow anywhere near the path.  Travelers stir up dust clouds while moving through this bleak, desolate valley.  Jumbles of rocks break up the otherwise featureless landscape.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road continues through the gray, blasted earth to the east and the west.  The stones and boulders near the path here are cracked and splintered into long thin slivers.  The soil is dry and gray, and no signs of life are visible as far as the eye can see.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Dust stirred up by the boots of travelers hangs in the air, making mouths and throats dry.  Not even boulders exist in the flat wasteland.  The vast, gray desert stretches out in all directions, the only noticeable feature being the road which cuts through straight as an arrow.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The gray landscape is broken up only by large black and gray rock outcroppings that defy the desert.  The rocks are splintered and falling in piles near the path.  Billowing clouds of gray dust blow across the flat plains.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: To the east, the road becomes gray and dry, supporting no plants anywhere alongside.  To the west, the road climbs a hill which turns green at the top, showing signs of hope for life on the other side.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: From top of the hill, the view to the east is one of desolation.  The road cuts like a ribbon through a gray, featureless plain.  To the west, life gradually returns to the surrounding areas.  Trees grow near the path, and bushes and short grasses live in the fields.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Short grasses cover the hills here, which are dotted by peach trees that also grow along the path.  Bushes near the path are covered with small, deep purple berries that look very appetizing.  Tufts of taller grasses grow here and there along the road.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Trees close in on the road for a stretch and canopy the path, providing shade and shelter for weary travelers.  Many campsites have been made under the cover of the small woods, and ample fallen dead wood lies conveniently nearby for small campfires.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: Herds of sheep and roltons roam the hills here, tended by sheep dogs and shepherds who watch their flocks grazing lazily on the hillsides.  Sparse trees provide shade and a place to rest for the weary shepherds who lie about watching the dogs work.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A small watering hole lies off the road to the south here, supporting lush green grasses and cattails.  Roltons, sheep, and dogs all drink from the hole in turn.  Shepherds in the fields and on the road stand watch for wayward herd animals.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road descends into a valley of rolling hills and lush green grasses to the east.  Herds of sheep roam in the valley, grazing on the short grasses.  To the west, the road takes a steep incline toward a ridge overlooking the valley.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: From the top of this ridge, a valley stretches out to the east bordered on the east by a gray expanse of wasteland.  To the west, the road flattens out for a stretch before plunging sharply downward.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road follows a steep incline to the east here, and plunges down toward the ocean to the west.  From this high vantage point, the ocean fills the horizon to the west, although still many leagues away.  Winds whip through the bushes and trees on the hillside.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: A breeze blows in swiftly from the west, carrying a slight chill and the smell of salt in the air.  The ocean must be close, as seagulls fly in small flocks above the horizon to the west.  Trees sway gently near the path, creaking and groaning in the higher winds.

title: [Vornavis, West Road]
description: The road leads to a beach to the west and off into the distance to the east.  When the wind dies down, the sounds of the ocean can be heard.  Cawing gulls and crashing waves are not far off to the west.  The dirt of the road becomes more sandy to the west, and the plants grow more dry and rustle in the breeze.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Path]
description: Small hills of sandy dirt line this path to both sides.  Tall, dry grasses hiss softly, swaying lazily in the breeze.  To the east, the path meets with a well-defined road.  To the southwest, the sandy path continues toward the coast.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Path]
description: Burs and stickers dot the bushes on either side of the path here.  Tall grasses and cattails grow up through the bushes and reach to the sky.  A stiff wind blows in from the west, carrying the salty smell of sea air.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Path]
description: To the northeast, the path is mostly soil mixed in with sand.  To the southwest, the dirt of the path gives way completely to sand as it approaches the beach.  Only dry, brown grasses stand along the sides of the path here.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Path]
description: The path remains straight as an arrow, running toward the beach to the southwest, and into the distance to the northeast.  To the sides of the path, small holes dot the sandy hills, indicating the presence of unseen wildlife making their homes in the dunes.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Path]
description: The dunes grow taller here for a stretch, making the path a bit like a ravine though a series of small hills.  Tall grasses grow in patches on the dunes, swaying slightly in the breeze and hissing as sand blows through the reeds.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Path]
description: The path runs between the high dunes to the northeast, as the dunes to the southwest grow more gentle and flowing.  Dugouts in the dunes indicate possible places where travelers might have bedded down for the night, attempting to hide from the chill ocean breezes.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Path]
description: Low, rolling dunes rise outward from the path to the north.  To the west, a cliff line runs along the shore, and a vast, blue ocean stretches out to the horizon.

title: [Vornavis, Sandy Path]
description: To the northeast, the path flattens out a bit, running between low, rolling sand dunes.  To the southwest, the path slopes up sharply before descending down onto the beach below.  Gulls circle the path, landing on the dunes to watch travelers make their way on the path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: A deep indentation in the sand marks the beach.  Oddly, no water pools in the cone-shaped indentation.  The shells of many sea creatures lie strewn about the rim of the pit.  No seagulls or crows perch anywhere near the pit, or anywhere on this stretch of beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: Large dunes serve as a windbreak here, making the crashing waves seem louder and the cries of seagulls much more clear. The absence of constant wind makes this stretch of beach quite warm and enjoyable, a fine place for a rest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: The sandy dunes to the north grow to rocky cliffs here, as the surf reaches steadily further inland.  Eventually, the surf meets the cliff face, and northern progress is impossible except by a sandy path winding into the cliffs.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: A natural cavern has been worn into the cliff face by the constant pounding of the surf.  Jagged rocks surround the entrance to the cavern, but the floor inside is sandy and dry.  The crashing waves can be heard just outside, but none of the waves manage to enter the cavern.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The cavern turns sharply here, the sounds of the ocean fading away to the south.  Echoes of dripping water grow steadily louder to the west.  The floor of the cavern dips low here, and a shallow pool of salt water gathers in the corner.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The caverns to the east appear to have been created naturally by rushing water, but to the north, the cavern is obviously dug with tools.  Decorative patterns are etched into the walls, and etchings depicting battle scenes are mixed in with unfamiliar symbols.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: A large crack in the ceiling shows evidence that the caverns might not be so safe to travel.  The crack is nearly wide enough for a child to climb through.  Occasional rustling in the crack is evidence of unseen life.  Huge stone panels carved into the walls depict a story.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The floor slopes up to the northeast and down to the south here.  Stone replaces the sand at the bottom of the cavern.  The floor has been carved and smoothed with tools, but shows many cracks and crevices which could catch the boot of an unwary traveler.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The floor of the cavern here has been carved into a cobblestone pattern.  The ceiling of the cave has been squared and flattened, giving the area a polished appearance.  Huge stone panels carved into the walls depict a story.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The floor here, which has been polished to a smooth sheen, shows fine cracks through the surface.  Dust and sand collect in the corners of the hallway.  Huge stone panels carved into the walls depict a story.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: Discarded torches litter this area of the cavern, as if someone recently spent a great deal of time here exploring.  Closer examination reveals wax drippings on the floor and the burnt-out ends of candles littering the corridor.  Huge stone panels carved into the walls depict a story.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: This adjunct cavern is not as well-tooled as the main cavern, and appears to have been dug more recently.  The walls are stone, but are crudely dug with many rough, sharp surfaces remaining.  Occasional veins of metal can be seen in the walls and ceiling here.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The rush of air blowing from the southeast is frigid.  The crashing of the waves is only a memory, as no sound from the beach can possibly reach this far into the cavern.  Occasional drops of water from the ceiling provide the only sounds.

The rush of air blowing from the southeast is frigid in stark contrast to the warm sun and salty breeze of the nearby beach.  The crashing of the waves is only a memory, as no sound from the beach can possibly reach this far into the cavern.  Occasional drops of water from the ceiling provide the only sounds.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The cavern bends sharply here.  Many small holes have been dug into the walls, possibly to extract gems or precious metals.  Small streams of water run from the ceiling to the floor, forming shallow pools which hide the floor of the cavern.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The cavern continues east and west here, widening to the east.  The floor begins to slope gently down to the east, and water runs through gutters that have been worn into the floor by years of erosion.  Spider webs cover the ceiling, full of scores of dead or struggling insects.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The cavern levels off here for a short stretch before sloping upward to the west and downward to the east.  A crack in the north wall stretches from floor to ceiling, and many insects move in and out of the crack, drinking from the streams of running water.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The cavern comes to a dead end to the east, after sloping very sharply down.  The water that has pooled here is rather deep and extremely cold.  The floor slopes upward to the west, and a tunnel enters this room high in the southwest wall.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: A crevice has opened in the floor of the cavern here.  The crevice is not very wide, and is only as long as a quarter staff, but no bottom is visible.  A cold draft blows upward out of the crevice.  To the northeast, a ledge overlooks a pool of water gathering below.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: A large crack in the ceiling shows evidence that the caverns might not be so safe to travel.  The crack is nearly wide enough for a child to climb through.  Occasional rustling in the crack is evidence of unseen life.  Huge stone panels carved into the walls depict a story.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: A warm breeze blows into this chilled room from the east, and a faint light can be seen reflecting from pools of water on the floor.  The dampness increases to the west, while the drier, warmer air to the east seems much more inviting.  Small piles of sand dot the floor occasionally.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: The floor here is about half covered with sand.  A steady breeze blows from the south, where the light grows much brighter.  The sound of the surf can be heard faintly to the south.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: An updraft of cold air blows through this room from the south to the north, making the damp chill of the caverns seem more extreme.  Brighter light to the north illuminates the room, revealing a wide crevice to the south.  The crevice is not wide enough to move through, but allows a strong, cold wind to pass.

An updraft of cold air blows through this room from the south to the north, making the damp chill of the caverns seem more extreme.  Bright light to the north illuminates the room, revealing a wide crevice to the south.  The crevice is not wide enough to move through, but allows a strong, cold wind to pass.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Caverns]
description: This room glows with a soft light, as moonlight pours in from a large hole in the ceiling directly overhead.  Warmer air blows steadily through the hole, and sand that has blown in on the breeze covers the floor.  Small grasses grow in the sand, not nearly as tall as the grasses on the rolling dunes outside.

This room is dazzlingly bright, as the sun pours in from a large hole in the ceiling directly overhead.  Warm air blows steadily through the hole, and sand that has blown in on the breeze covers the floor.  Small grasses grow in the sand, not nearly as tall as the grasses on the rolling dunes outside.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Cliff Top]
description: This strand of cliff top is flat, and soil and sand have mixed here, providing hold for many grasses and plants.  The moon shines brightly overhead, and the smell of strawberries growing near the edge of the cliff permeates the air.  The cliff top provides a magnificent view of the entire beach to the southeast, and the pine woods to the east.  The broken masts of a beached ship rise at an angle high above the beach.

This strand of cliff top is flat, and soil and sand have mixed here, providing hold for many grasses and plants.  The sun shines brightly overhead, and the smell of strawberries growing near the edge of the cliff permeates the air.  The cliff top provides a magnificent view of the entire beach to the southeast, and the pine woods to the east.  The broken masts of a beached ship rise at an angle high above the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: The moon shines brightly down and the sea breeze blows strongly from the beach over the cliffs.  Far below, crashing waves pound the surf.  To the east, rolling fields of grass fill the landscape.
The sun shines brightly down and the sea breeze blows strongly from the beach over the cliffs.  Far below, crashing waves pound the surf.  To the east, rolling fields of grass fill the landscape.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: The path follows the edge of the cliff face here, providing a magnificent view of the ocean in the moonlight.  Small shapes skitter across the shore far below, unrecognizable in the dim light.

The path follows the edge of the cliff face here, providing a magnificent view of the ocean.  Seagulls fly from the tops of the cliffs to the shore far below in search of a meal.  Crows perch among the crags of the cliffs, waiting for unwary sand crabs to venture past the shore line.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: The winds blowing up from the beach here are so strong that they nearly drown out the sound of the crashing waves below.  Thick grasses grow in the sandy soil here, hiding small creatures that scurry amongst the tall grasses and underbrush.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: The path moves away from the cliff face to the north, but follows the line of the shore quite closely to the south.  Small bushes and squat, sturdy trees dot the landscape to the east.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: The path splits here to the south and southwest toward the cliff and continues into the savanna to the northwest.  Chipmunks and rabbits dart in and out of the tall grasses across the path.  A hawk circles high overhead, watching the path carefully.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: The tall grasses move in waves, stirred by the constant breezes that blow across the plains from the coast.  The salty smell of the sea is still strong in the air, a reminder that the ocean is still very close.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: A rock juts out from the cliff face here, tempting travelers to climb out to see the wondrous view afforded from this perch.  Several seagulls perch on the rocks, vying constantly for position on the edge.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: A tall modwir tree stands to the north of the path here, and gnarled roots of the mighty tree break through the path in several places.  The leaves of the tree sway in the breeze blowing up from the beach below, where the waves crash among the rocks of the cliffs.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: A line of lilac bushes grows along the path to the northeast, but only brief wafts of scent remain through the strong breezes blowing through.  Fireflies flitter about the lilacs, seeming to blink in and out of existence.  Purple and white flowers dot the bushes and lie on the path.

A line of lilac bushes grows along the path to the northeast, but only brief wafts of scent remain through the strong breezes blowing through.  Bees buzz about the lilacs, gathering nectar for a nearby hive.  Purple and white flowers dot the bushes and lie on the path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: A crack that starts in the cliff face to the southeast extends through the path here, but is mostly filled with sand and stubborn weeds that cling to life within the crack.  The gap is not very wide on the path, and can be easily stepped across, but grows steadily wider close to the cliff face.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: Tall grasses rustle in the wind as they grow closer to the path to the northeast.  A wide, dark hole near the north of the path was probably once a gopher hole that has eroded over the years.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: An ancient tree stump, cut clean as if by a saw, sits to the northeast of the path here.  Something small and furry perchs warily on the stump, barely visible in the dark, watching travelers on the path.

An ancient tree stump, cut clean as if by a saw, sits to the northeast of the path here.  Ravens perch warily on the stump, watching travelers on the path.  Seagulls circle overhead, but do not land on this stretch of path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: Rocks from the cliff face rise above the edge of the cliff here, providing perches for hundreds of seagulls and crows.  A host of birds takes noisily to the air at the approach of any traveler on the path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: A tangle of rose bushes grows up from the rocks of the cliff face to the southeast.  Red roses grow amongst the bushes, protected by long, thick thorns.
