The ocean crashes ceaselessly against the rocks of the cliff face below, spraying sea water as high as the tops of the cliffs.  As each wave blows a spray of mist into the air, a rainbow forms momentarily above the cliffs.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: A tangle of rose bushes grows up from the rocks of the cliff face to the southeast.  Brilliant red roses grow amongst the bushes, protected by long, thick thorns.  Bees buzz about the flowers, clinging desperately to the roses in the sea breeze.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: A mound of soil rises next to a large hole in the ground just to the north of the path.  The hole is not very deep, but appears to have been dug by shovels and not by the claws of an animal.  Rocks protrude into the hole from all angles, making further digging difficult.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: Rocks break through the surface of the path here, making progress more difficult.  The path continues to the northwest through the jumble of protruding stones, but is much more passable to the east.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: The rocks of the cliff face make further progress to the west or north impossible.  A rough path, strewn with sharp, protruding rocks from the cliff face, continues to the southeast.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: The sand on this stretch of beach is almost completely black, having come from the volcanic rocks of the cliff face to the east.  The cliff looms high above the beach and, while having many crags and crevices, does not offer enough handholds to be climbable.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: The moon shines down on the beach here, and the wind is diminished by the high cliff face to the east.  The black sands absorb all of the rays of the moon.  Occasional precious stones or metals partly buried in the sand sparkle in the moonlight.

The sun bears down on the beach here, and the wind is diminished by the high cliff face to the east.  The black sands absorb all of the rays of the sun, and waves of heat rise off the dunes.  Occasional precious stones or metals partly buried in the sand sparkle in the sun.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: A large pool of salt water gathers here, slightly inland from the crashing tides but still away from the cliffs to the east.  The pool apparently fills at high tide, but is not touched by the ocean at low tide.

A large pool of salt water gathers here, slightly inland from the crashing tides but still away from the cliffs to the east.  The pool apparently fills at high tide, but is not touched by the ocean at low tide.  Crabs dance around the edge of the pool, scurrying away from seagulls which land nearby looking for a meal.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: This section of beach is littered with sharp, broken stone fallen from the cliffs to the east.  A large section of the cliff has crumbled and strewn rocks nearly to the shore.  Atop the cliff, tree roots poke through the rocks, the probable cause of the landslide.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: Choked, dying grasses cling desperately to life atop a short dune here.  The beach is very wide between the cliffs and the shore here, and the tide seems very far off.

Choked, dying grasses cling desperately to life atop a short dune here.  The black sands afford no comfort to the grasses, which wither in the beating sun.  The beach is very wide between the cliffs and the shore here, and the tide seems very far off.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: The black dunes grow larger to the north, obscuring the view of the coastline.  To the south, smaller dunes support struggling grasses.  A huge, pillar-shaped boulder rises from the beach near the cliffs here.  The boulder is broken near the base and leans against the cliff face.

The black dunes grow larger to the north, obscuring the view of the coastline.  To the south, smaller dunes support struggling grasses.  A huge, pillar-shaped boulder rises from the beach near the cliffs here.  The boulder is broken near the base and leans against the cliff face, providing a bit of cool shade on the otherwise sun-scorched beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: A shallow gully, currently dry, runs from the cliff face to the edge of the shore.  During heavy rains, this gully is likely full of water draining from the cliffs above.  An indentation high above in the cliff line indicates the probable source of the runoff.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: To the south, tall dunes rise up to block the view of the coast line.  To the north, the black dunes grow much flatter.  Occasional flecks of quartz sparkle in the black sands.  To the north, the beach follows the cliff face around a bend to the east.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: Small boulders litter the base of the cliff and dark crags are visible along the cliff face.  Stars wink in and out of existence in the night sky and small critters scurry between the boulders.

Seagulls perch in the crags and on small boulders in and near the cliff face, watching travelers warily and taking to flight when approached.  Crows sit atop the cliff face, vying for position with the larger seagulls in the crags.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: A river delta lies to the north, flowing in falls from the cliff face, running west through the black sands, and emptying into the ocean. The flow of fresh water from the east is steady and could not be crossed but for the bridge erected across the delta.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: From this bridge, the view of the falls to the east is wondrous.  Lush green trees border the falls atop the cliff face, and grass clings to the black, sandy banks of the delta.  Moonlight illuminates the crashing falls, providing a breathtaking silvery display which dazzles the eye in contrast to the black sands of the beach.

From this bridge, the view of the falls to the east is wondrous.  Lush green trees border the falls atop the cliff face, and deep emerald-green grasses cling to the black, sandy banks of the delta.  Rainbows hover over the crashing falls, providing a breathtaking display of color which dazzles the eye in contrast to the black sands of the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: The source of the waterfalls to the west, a large, fresh water lagoon, lies to the east, contained by the cliff face.  Colorful birds dart in and out of the large bushes and ferns that surround the narrow beach of the lagoon.  To the west, some rickety stairs lead down the cliff face to the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: A river delta lies to the south, spanned by a weathered wooden bridge.  To the north, the beach is more cluttered with debris than to the south.  The looming cliff face to the east grows closer to the shore line to the north, giving the beach the illusion of disappearing into the distance.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: The waters of the lagoon rush over the edge of the cliff face here, falling hundreds of feet to the beach far below.  Standing here on the edge of the cliff face, the black beach stretches out below for great distances to the north and south.  The falls form a small delta on the beach below, which is crossed by a weathered, old bridge.  A rickety set of wooden stairs leads down.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: Several large trees lie on the beach near the cliff face, toppled by years of erosion, and eventually brought down by their own weight.  Unseen critters can be heard darting about under cover of the fallen timbers.

Several large trees lie on the beach near the cliff face, toppled by years of erosion, and eventually brought down by their own weight.  Seagulls and crows fly into and out of the clump of trees, and other unseen critters dart about under cover of the fallen timbers.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: The beach dips here and becomes very flat for a stretch.  This area is probably under water during high tide.  The black sands are hard packed and washed clean of footprints nightly by the crashing waves of the restless ocean.  Conch shells lie on the banks of the dunes surrounding the flat area.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: The beach widens to the south, but narrows to the north from this section of shoreline.  A row of driftwood lines the beach, washed ashore by the ends of waves which exhaust themselves on the black sands.

The beach widens to the south, but narrows to the north from this section of shoreline.  A flock of seagulls stands near the tide, seemingly washing their feet in the ends of waves which exhaust themselves on the black sands.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: Orange streaks of sand run through the beach here, mirrored by colored rock striations in the cliff face.  The orange color could be clays or rust from iron deposits.  No attempt has been made to mine the cliffs, however, possibly due to the population of dangerous critters living on this section of beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: The wind decreases to a breeze as the towering cliffs approach the shoreline here.  The black sands are bathed in moonlight and stars dot the evening sky.  Grasses and small bushes sway in the breeze high atop the cliffs.

The wind decreases to a breeze as the towering cliffs approach the shoreline here.  The black sands bake so hotly in the sun that the heat can be felt even through boots.  Grasses and small bushes sway in the breeze high atop the cliffs.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: Further progress to the north or west is impossible as the beach disappears under the crashing surf which now pounds directly on the stubborn cliff face.  Occasional rocks fall from above, and waves dash them thoroughly to bits, clearly demonstrating that further northern travel would be fatal.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: The cliffs approach the shoreline very closely on this section of beach, and the high tide brings waves up to the cliff.  The sand here is hard packed, and mixed with a variety of stones from the cliff face, some sharp and some worn smooth by constant washing.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: Several jumbles of driftwood have washed ashore on this section of beach.  Once proud, large trees have fallen victim to the relentless tides and now rest partly submerged on the beach.  Sun-bleached leafless branches and roots bereft of soil jumble together in this tangle of fallen timber.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: The waters swirl and eddy a bit at this end of the lagoon, moving toward the falls that can be heard in the distance to the west.  Insects swarm near stagnant pools that have gathered near the water's edge.  The forest falls away to the plains which continue to the edge of the cliff face off to the west.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: A canopy of palm trees overhead blocks the view of the moon on this serene section of beach.  The soft sands of the beach provide a comfortable resting place for travelers.  High in the trees, the occasional rustling sound of a restless monkey can be heard as they sleep in their lofts.

A canopy of palm trees overhead provides shade on this serene section of beach.  The soft sands of the beach provide a comfortable resting place for travelers.  High in the trees, monkeys hang lazily from trunks and branches, sunning themselves and napping in their lofts.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: The edge of the forest here has been burned back away from the beach, probably the result of an uncontrolled camp fire.  Through the blackened branches and tree stumps, young saplings and squat bushes have begun to grow in the wake of the destruction.  Animals shun this area of beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: Brambles and sticker bushes grow out from the forest here, nearly reaching the shore of the lagoon.  Strawberries and cantaloupes grow within the brambles, protected from most animals by the sharp thorns about them.  Burrs dot the sand and prick the feet of the bare footed traveler.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: Bamboo and rattan grow close to the beach here.  Much of the rattan has been cut and hauled away.  Piles of bamboo lie near the edge of the forest.  Some bamboo has been dragged near to the edge of the lagoon and strung together with rope into a broken, make-shift raft.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: A small fire pit is on the shore of the lagoon here.  The burnt ends of firewood sit in a shallow, black puddle in the pit, the fire having long been spent.  Rocks large enough to serve as seats have been placed near the fire pit, and a small pile of unused wood sits near the edge of the woods to the east.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: Several large trees, apparently upturned by high winds, lay across the beach of the lagoon here.  The tops of the trees lie in the lagoon itself, and the roots remain upturned in the forest.  The trees can be crossed easily, and do not block progress further to the east or northwest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: A small river pours into the lagoon from the southeast.  Rushing water sprays from slick rocks near the bank of the river, creating occasional rainbows in the sun.  A natural stone bridge crosses the river to the southwest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: This bridge looks to be many years old, and the feet of uncounted travelers have worn a smooth path in the center of the stone bridge.  Small puddles gather in indentations in the bridge.  The splash of rushing water feeding steadily into the lagoon makes small waves that ripple to the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: A small river pours into the lagoon from the southeast here, providing the source of the freshwater lagoon.  Rapids can be seen in the river just away from the lagoon, indicating a steady, fast source of water.  A natural stone bridge crosses the river outlet to the northeast.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: The plant life from the woods actually reaches the edge of the lagoon here, bushes and small trees encroaching on the sandy beach.  Vibrant colors of thousands of flowers which dot the bushes provide a dazzling display of natural beauty giving pause to the weary adventurer.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: Dried, sun-bleached animal bones litter this section of the lagoon beach, and no living animals linger here.  Huge paw prints in the sand appear to be cat-like, perhaps from a tiger or lion.  The forest to the south and east is eerily quiet.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: A din of animal sounds, from cheeting monkeys to cawing birds, comes from the lush woods approaching the lagoon from the east.  The underbrush is too dense to allow passage here, but the monkeys have no trouble navigating among the treetops, and come to the lagoon for an occasional drink.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: Huge, smooth slabs of stone lie on the shore of the lagoon here, dimly visible in the evening light.  The moon's rays glitter upon the reflective surface of the lagoon.

Huge, smooth slabs of stone lie on the shore of the lagoon here, gathering warmth from the sunlight bearing down on them.  Lizards and snakes sun themselves on the rocks, eyeing the occasional bird that comes too close.

title: [Helden Hall, Lockers]
description: A large wooden counter fills this area, and your locker sits on top of it.  The torchlight flickers, as if in excitement as you prepare to open your bounty-filled locker.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: A large fire pit disrupts the blanket of sand covering the beach here.  The fire pit was once huge, and remains almost intact in spite of constant erosion of wind and surf.  A small pool of water gathers in the hole left by the fire pit.  No footprints can be seen near the pit, but thousands of insects and shellfish call it home.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: This quiet cove is a haven from the wind and rough surf.  Some distance out at sea, waves break against a line of coral reefs.  Tall dunes of dark sand surround the cove like the eroded walls of an ancient fortress.  The cries of sea birds seem all the more plaintive in the tranquility of the cove.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: The hulk of a beached ship lies here, partly submerged in the advancing waves.  The ship, once proud and tall, is broken and rotting as it lies on its starboard side on the shore.  Seagulls and crows nest in the masts that remain.  A gaping gash in the side of the ship indicates the probable cause of the ship's demise.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: A gaping tear in the bow of the ship shows clearly how she was beached.  Jagged timbers, splintered and torn, border the hole.  Through the opening, moonlight can be seen reflected off the water.  A port side arch leads into a dark cabin, and a starboard door creaks on rusty hinges.  The hold continues to the southwest.

A gaping tear in the bow of the ship shows clearly how she was beached.  Jagged timbers, splintered and torn, border the hole.  Through the opening, seagulls can be seen on the beach, standing in the shallow water searching for meals.  A port side arch leads into a dark cabin, and a starboard door creaks on rusty hinges.  The hold continues to the southwest.

A gaping tear in the bow of the ship shows clearly how she was beached.  Jagged timbers, splintered and torn, border the hole.  Through the opening, moonlight can be seen reflected off the water.  A port side arch leads into a dark cabin, and a burnt and blackened starboard door creaks on rusty hinges.  The hold continues to the southwest.

A gaping tear in the bow of the ship shows clearly how she was beached.  Jagged timbers, splintered and torn, border the hole.  Through the opening, seagulls can be seen on the beach, standing in the shallow water searching for meals.  A port side arch leads into a dark cabin, and a burnt and blackened starboard door creaks on rusty hinges.  The hold continues to the southwest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: A natural stone pier juts into the surf, the rocks of the pier being more resistant to the pounding of the ocean than the rest of the shore along here.  Sand crabs gather amongst broken seashells near the edge of the surf and the rocks of the pier.  The noise of waves crashing against the pier is deafening.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: The natural stone pier has been worn for countless years by wind, surf, and storm, making the surface irregular and difficult to navigate.  A spray of salty sea water covers the rocks each time a wave crashes against the pier, making the surface treacherously slippery.  Marine life gathers in pools and in cracks in the pier.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: A huge piece of driftwood, obviously once a large tree, lies not far from the pounding surf.  Fireflies hover by the fallen tree, their luminescent posteriors producing a flashing light.

A huge piece of driftwood, obviously once a large tree, lies not far from the pounding surf.  Seagulls and crows share the perches provided by the fallen tree, scanning the beach for signs of movement, and perhaps a meal, near the edge of the crashing surf.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: Visible in the moonlight, thousands of small footprints dot the sand here, leading from the coastal grasses far from the pounding surf right up to the tide.  Dozens of small creatures have made their way to the surf for sustenance.  A path leads northeast from the beach into a pine woods.

Thousands of small footprints dot the sands here, leading from the coastal grasses far from the pounding surf right up to the tide.  Dozens of small creatures have made their way to the surf for sustenance.  The cries of seagulls can be heard over the crashing waves.  A path leads northeast from the beach into a pine woods.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: Waves crash over a stubborn rock outcropping that has defied the erosion of the shore over the years.  Moonlight reflects off the crest of each wave and sounds of the surf breaking on the beach are carried on the night air.

Waves crash over a stubborn rock outcropping that has defied the erosion of the shore over the years.  Seagulls perch on the outcropping, cracking shellfish with their beaks.  Hermit crabs scurry in and out of cracks in the moss-covered rocks, burying themselves in the soft sands.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: A break in the dunes reveals a path leading southwest to the beach and northeast into the pine woods.  The scent of pine wafts in from the path, and the tops of pine trees can be seen towering over the dunes.  Pine cones and small branches litter the dunes, and tall grasses provide haven for scores of small animals who move quickly onto and off of the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beach]
description: The salty sea wind rushes past, whipping over the tops of foam-covered waves, adding to the mist that is carried on the breeze.  Waves crash on the shore, washing over the sands of the beach here.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The beach grows smoother and sandier to the north, while the southern beach is strewn with rocks encroaching on the shore from the cliffs to the east.  Pools of water collect around the huge rock formations after each pounding wave, only to sink slowly into the sands.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The rock formations on the beach grow larger, and form a maze to walk through on this section of beach.  The shallow surf pours in around the rocks here, pushed in by the tide, but the force of the waves is spent on the rocks, leaving only foam-covered, rushing sea water.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The pounding waves nearly reach the cliffs here, with occasional rock formations providing some cover from the onslaught of the surf.  This section of beach is completely submerged during storms, and extremely difficult to navigate at high tide.  The beach widens to the southeast and north.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The sand here is hard packed as each wave reaches nearly to the cliffs, making the entire beach constantly wet.  The winds that blow up from the southeast carry a hint of woodland timber along with the scent of the sea air.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: Rock formations dominate this beach, towering over travelers and defying the relentless pounding of the waves.  Salty sprays of mist rise continually here and are whisked away by the sea breeze.  Moats form around the rock formations as the retreating waves rush around them to rejoin the ocean.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The beach widens here, populated by small rock formations and gently rolling dunes.  The cliffs to the east grow slightly shorter to the south, and appear to meet the beach at the horizon.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: High up on the cliffs to the east, ropes dangle well out of reach, and a bell can be heard ringing in the breeze.  The beach is wide here, and many recent fire pits can be seen scattered about, partially buried in the sands.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: Rolling dunes nearly cover some stubborn rock outcroppings on the beach here, and tall grasses find purchase near the rocks.  Atop some of the dunes, short bushes have taken root and sway in the breeze.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The dunes grow very tall here, and must be climbed to navigate the beach.  The sands reach nearly to the height of the cliff to the east, and several areas of the cliff look climbable.  The waves of the beach continue to crash endlessly to the west.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: From high on top of the dunes, the beach stretches out to the north and south, endless sands dimly reflecting the soft rays of the moon.  Occasional dunes sport tall, sparse grasses on top, looking like the heads of so many balding men.

From high on top of the dunes, the beach stretches out to the north and south, endless sands reflecting the glaring rays of the sun.  Occasional dunes sport tall, sparse grasses on top, looking like the heads of so many balding men.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: Bright moonlight flows in from the west, where the sounds of the crashing surf can be heard over the rushing winds and rustling leaves.  The woods here are lush, and thick underbrush covers the ground around the trees.  The cliff to the west can be climbed down to the beach.

Glaring sunlight flows in from the west, where the sounds of the crashing surf can be heard over the rushing winds and rustling leaves.  The woods here are lush, and thick underbrush covers the ground around the trees.  The cliff to the west can be climbed down to the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The dunes grow very steep to the north from here, but level out nicely to the south.  A flock of seagulls stands near to the surf, watching for each wave to uncover or carry in a meal to them.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: A huge crate has washed ashore here, possibly brought in by a storm.  The crate lies well inland from the surf, and has been bleached near-white by the constant sun.

A huge crate has washed ashore here, possibly brought in by a storm.  The crate lies well inland from the surf, and has been bleached near-white by the constant sun.  A seagull perches atop the crate, glaring at other gulls as they approach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: A massive oak tree has toppled from the cliff to the east here, and is tall enough to allow a climb to the top of the cliffs.  The roots of the tree still cling to the cliffside, and rocks lie strewn about the tree on the beach, dislodged in the fall.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: Brambles and sticker bushes grow all along the beach here, poking bare feet and clinging to the clothes of travelers.  Brown bushes appear dead on this section of beach, but cling stubbornly to life.

Brambles and sticker bushes grow all along the beach here, poking bare feet and clinging to the clothes of travelers.  Brown bushes appear dead on this section of beach, but cling stubbornly to life in the glaring sun.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The beach grows wide here, and the surf seems far from the cliffs looming to the east.  The skeleton of a small animal lies here on the beach, bones blown clean and bleached white.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The surf runs right up to the cliffs here, making further progress to the south impossible.  Even when the waves recede, rushing water still blocks the beach, indicating that this is the possible flow from an underground river from beneath the cliffs.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: This larder once held the food supplies of the crew.  Dozens of barrels, some still intact, litter the room.  Some of the whole barrels bear the names of nearby port cities, including Wehnimer's Landing and Solhaven.

Dozens of barrels, some still intact, litter the larder, which once held the food supplies of the crew.  Most of the barrels are stained with soot, and some have burst from within to spill their rotten contents on the deck.  Some of the whole barrels bear the names of nearby port cities, including Kharam Dzu and Vornavis.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: The hold continues to the northeast to the bow and southwest to the aft from here.  Moonlight pours in through a hole in the deck above about the size of a large barrel.  Seagull dung has collected on the floor directly under the hole.  An arch opens to the west, and the shattered remains of a broken door hang tenuously on failing hinges to the south.

The hold continues to the northeast to the bow and southwest to the aft from here.  Light pours in through a hole in the deck above about the size of a large barrel.  Seagull dung has collected on the floor directly under the hole.  An arch opens to the west, and the shattered remains of a broken door hang tenuously on failing hinges to the south.

The hold continues to the northeast to the bow and southwest to the aft from here.  Moonlight pours in through a burned hole in the deck above about the size of a small wagon.  Cinders and seagull dung have collected on the floor directly under the hole.  An arch opens to the west, and the shattered remains of a broken door hang tenuously on failing hinges to the south.

The hold continues to the northeast to the bow and southwest to the aft from here.  Light pours in through a burned hole in the deck above about the size of a small wagon.  Cinders and seagull dung have collected on the floor directly under the hole.  An arch opens to the west, and the shattered remains of a broken door hang tenuously on failing hinges to the south.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west
Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: This cabin served as the crew quarters, as indicated by the broken and rotting bunks which line the bulkhead.  Moonlight pours in from an arch leading starboard.  Waves can be heard crashing against the port side hull.

This cabin served as the crew quarters, as indicated by the broken and rotting bunks which line the bulkhead.  Light pours in from an arch leading starboard.  Waves can be heard crashing against the port side hull.

This cabin served as the crew quarters, as indicated by the broken and rotting bunks which line the bulkhead.  Most of them are burnt beyond recognition.  Moonlight pours in from an arch leading starboard.  Waves can be heard crashing against the port side hull.

The ruined cabin appears to have served as the crew quarters, as indicated by the broken and rotting bunks which line the bulkhead.  Most of them are burnt beyond recognition.  Light pours in from an arch leading starboard.  Waves can be heard crashing against the port side hull.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: The remains of the galley lie shattered and dispersed throughout this room.  Splintered tables and benches lie in heaps throughout the room.  Wooden bowls and mugs, cracked and warped, can be seen amongst the junk in the room.  An arch leads to the hold to the east.

The remains of the galley lie shattered and dispersed throughout this room.  Splintered tables and the charred remains of benches lie in heaps throughout the room.  Wooden bowls and mugs, cracked and warped by heat, can be seen amongst the junk in the room.  An arch leads to the hold to the east.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: This cabin was likely an officer's quarters.  A complex lock, rusted and inoperable, hangs amongst the remains of the door.  A broken and rotting desk sits tipped on one side in the northeast corner of the room.  A looted footlocker, broken and empty, sits in the middle of the room.  The door leads north into the hold.

This cabin was likely an officer's quarters.  The remains of a lock, molten as if by great heat, glistens from the ashy remains of the door.  A pile of burnt wood that might have once been a desk sits tipped on one side in the northeast corner of the room.  A looted footlocker, shattered and empty and coated with soot, sits in the middle of the room.  The hole where the door once hung leads north into the hold.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: The hold is dark here, and the angled deck is covered nearly to the center of the room by gently lapping sea water.  Sand collects on the floor, showing how far the tide reaches daily.  A louvered door leads to the southeast, and an open arch leads to the northwest.  To the southwest, a doorway leads to a small ladder room.

The hold is dark here and the walls are charred, despite the fact that the angled deck is covered nearly to the center of the room by gently lapping sea water.  Sand collects on the floor, showing how far the tide reaches daily.   Some of it has been turned to glass by great heat.  A crumbling and burnt louvered door leads to the southeast, and an open arch leads to the northwest.  To the southwest, a doorway leads to a small ladder room.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: Rusted weapons and shattered weapons racks reach above the water level here, indicating that this compartment was once the armory.  The store of weapons must have once been fine, but the weapons remaining are ruined.  Spear shafts have warped and splintered, and the blades of glaives and broadswords are pitted and rusted badly.  An open arch leads to the hold to the southeast.

Rusted weapons and singed weapon racks reach above the water level here, indicating that the compartment was once an armory.  The store of weapons must have once been fine, but the weapons remaining are ruined, and some of them melted by great heat.  Spear shafts that survived the touch of fire have warped and splintered, and the blades of glaives and broadswords are pitted and rusted badly.  An open arch leads to the hold to the southeast.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: A sturdy companionway ladder leads down into the water, and upward to the upper deck.  As the ladder leads underwater to lower decks of the ship, the tide washing through the hull is so strong that further progress in that direction is impossible.

A sturdy companionway ladder leads down into the water, and upward to the upper deck.  As the soot-stained ladder leads underwater to lower decks of the ship, the tide washing through the hull is so strong that further progress in that direction is impossible.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: This compartment is almost completely underwater.  Small waves mimic the tide outside and wash repeatedly along the bulkhead.  Small fish can be seen darting in the water, indicating a hole in the hull below the surface of the water.  A louvered door leads to the hold to the northwest.

The compartment is almost completely underwater.  Small waves mimic the tide outside and wash repeatedly along the bulkhead.  Small fish can be seen darting in the water, indicating a hole in the hull below the surface of the water.  Several shards of black dreamstone jut from the sand beneath the water.  A louvered door leads to the hold to the northwest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: Here on deck, the weathered ship looks almost seaworthy, belying the massive holes in the hull.  The wooden timbers of the deck are bleached almost white from years of the relentless beating of the sun.  Still solid but worn smooth by years of weathering, the deck continues northeast to the bow.  A ladder leads down into the hold.

Here on deck, the weathered ship looks almost seaworthy, belying the massive holes in the hull.  The wooden timbers of the deck are bleached almost white from years of the relentless beating of the sun, and stand in stark contrast to the black scars of a recent fire about many of the holes in the deck.  Still solid but worn smooth by years of weathering, the deck continues northeast to the bow.  A blackened ladder leads down into the hold.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: The port side rail has been broken through completely while the rail to starboard is still intact, and overlooks a view of the beach and coastal cliffs.  The mizzenmast reaches high above the deck, which continues northeast to the bow and southwest to stern.

The port side rail has been broken through completely while the rail to starboard is still intact, and overlooks a view of the beach and coastal cliffs.  The mizzenmast reaches high above the deck, which continues northeast to the bow and southwest to stern.  A pattern of blackened scars spirals up the mizzenmast.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: The main mast of the ship rises here, broken at about midpoint, but still reaching high overhead.  A hole in the deck looks like it could have been made when the mainmast fell.  Handholds ascend the mast, and the deck continues northeast to the bow and southwest to stern.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: The bow of the ship lies to the northeast, overlooking the beach and the pine woods beyond the dunes.  The wind and stars are magnificent, and the view of the moonlit beach is breathtaking.  The deck continues southwest to the stern, and the foremast rises high above the deck.

The bow of the ship lies to the northeast, overlooking the beach and the pine woods beyond the dunes.  Seagulls perch on the rails that border the deck.  The wind and sun are magnificent, and the view of the beach is breathtaking.  The deck continues southwest to the stern, and the foremast rises high above the deck.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: A plank crosses the mast here, providing lookouts and dockhands a place to rest while working.  Rusted metal rings provide tie-offs for ropes that once hoisted sails up this mast.  The ladder continues up and down from this point.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: The mast is broken and splintered, having been shattered by some great force.  The rungs of the ladder grow less stable toward the top of the mast.  Continuing upwards would be treacherous, as the integrity of the mast itself is damaged by the splintering caused by the break.  The ladder continues downward.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: Moonlight filters in through the leaves in the trees high overhead in this stretch of woods.  A steady wind blows in from the southwest, carrying the smell of salt on the air, evidence that the ocean is nearby.  The woods grow denser to the northeast.

Sunlight filters in through the leaves in the trees high overhead in this stretch of woods.  A steady wind blows in from the southwest, carrying the smell of salt on the air, evidence that the ocean is nearby.  The woods grow denser to the northeast.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A pair of nocturnal birds flit back and forth among the trees, trilling loudly as they chase one and other through the branches.  High above, the treetops sway in the wind which, while strong up above the trees, slows to a slight breeze on the forest floor.

Birds flit back and forth among the trees, trilling loudly as they chase one and other through the branches.  High above, the treetops sway in the wind which, while strong up above the trees, slows to a slight breeze on the forest floor.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: Oak and fir trees dominate this section of forest, and acorns crunch underfoot on the packed earth of the path.  The thick underbrush is pierced in places by young fir or oak saplings which, having found purchase, stretch upward to join the fully grown trees.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: The path turns sharply to the southwest and southeast here, looping around a small, marshy area to the south.  Stepping off the path to the south here means sinking to the ankle in mud.  A small spring could be the source of the wetland.

title: [Warrens]
description: The cramped tunnel begins to squeeze in on all sides and travel in this passage is reduced to an uncomfortable crawl.  While the earthy aroma of the area is not unpleasant, the thick and heavy air is making it quite difficult to breath.  Muffled sounds can be heard coming from either direction, although it is difficult to tell just how far off they might be.

The cramped tunnel begins to squeeze in on all sides and travel in this passage is reduced to an uncomfortable crawl.  While the earthy aroma of the area is not unpleasant, the thick and heavy air is making it quite difficult to breathe.  Muffled sounds can be heard coming from either direction, although it is difficult to tell just how far off they might be.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: The path crests a small hill here, and three paths lead away down into the surrounding woods.  The trees above sway continually, making it difficult to hear any approaching animals until you see them.  The sounds of occasionally crashing branches break through the constant rustling.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A path has been worn through rock outcroppings that poke through the hill here on this steep incline.  Small snakes and lizards move their way through the rocks, scurrying away at the approach of any travelers.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: The path runs along a steeply inclined bank to the east and northeast here.  The bank, which is dotted by occasional rock outcroppings,  runs along the path for some distance, creating a ridge line that runs parallel to the path.  The earth of the bank is soft, and crumbles making it impossible to climb.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A steep bank follows the path to the east here, sporting bushes and small trees that grow on the incline.  On the rock formations which protrude from the leaves covering the incline, several birds of prey have seemingly taken posts, eyeing the path suspiciously.

A steep bank follows the path to the east here, sporting bushes and small trees that grow on the incline.  On the rock formations which protrude from the leaves covering the incline, dozens of crows have seemingly taken posts, eyeing the path suspiciously.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A tall, thick tree to the southwest of the path has collapsed and leans across the path on the incline.  The tree is long dead, bereft of roots and leaves, but is wedged tightly in a rock outcropping in the incline.  The tree does not block the path, but looms overhead as travelers pass beneath.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: The path becomes a very steep climb here, and branches and small tree trunks lying across the path provide the only decent footing along this incline.  Bark peels back from the branches and trunks as they are stepped on, leaving thousands of insects exposed and scurrying for cover.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: The path follows an incline running northwest to southeast, but turns away from the incline to the southwest.  Just off the path to the northwest are the remnants of a small campfire, long since extinguished.  Stones placed in a ring around the fire pit are now covered with vines from the encroaching woods.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A shallow stream, not more than ankle-deep, crosses the path here.  Several flat rocks exposed by the running water make it possible to cross the stream without getting wet.  Green and black mosses grow around the bases of the rocks in the stream.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: High overhead, a leafless, dying tree allows a column of moonlight to penetrate the woods.  A patch of hundreds of wild flowers growing where the light touches the forest floor produces a sweet aroma that fills the air.

High overhead, a leafless, dying tree allows a column of sunlight to penetrate the woods.  A patch of hundreds of wild flowers growing where the light touches the forest floor produces a sweet aroma that fills the air.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: Several huge trees have fallen across the path here, possibly felled by the high winds of a strong storm.  The thick trunks are passable, but slow progress through this area.  Squirrels dart in and out amongst the fallen trees.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: The path continues to the east and southwest, and a smaller path runs down a steep hillside to the northwest down into a wooded valley.  Mushrooms grow at the bases of trees around the path toward the valley.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: This section of path has been cut clean.  Mounds of overturned earth and displaced boulders lie near the path, evidence of the effort to clear a way.  The woods grow more dense to the northeast, and thin out to the southwest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A forest of oak and fir trees spreads out to the east from the top of the cliff line here.  The ocean roars against the beach below to the west, and the smell of the salt is carried in mists on the breeze blowing in from the west.  The roots of a massive oak tree that has toppled to the beach below still cling firmly to the cliff top.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: A slight breeze breaks the stifling silence here, causing the firs and pines to sway gently.  Crashing waves can be heard to the west as the path approaches the beach.  To the east, the woods grow thicker and moonlight wanes as the trees begin to block out the moon.  The shattered remains of broken seashells litter the path.

A slight breeze breaks the stifling silence here, causing the firs and pines to sway gently.  Crashing waves can be heard to the west as the path approaches the beach.  To the east, the woods grow thicker and sunlight wanes as the trees begin to block out the sun.  The shattered remains of broken seashells litter the path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: High above, the green canopy of pine grows thin, allowing light to stream through the woods and brighten the path here.  The soft glow illuminates the woods, and moonlight leaks through to shine on rocks and bushes off to the side of the path.  Toads lounge on larger rocks, flicking out tongues to catch the occasional insect buzzing past.

High above, the green canopy of pine grows thin, allowing bright light to stream through the woods and brighten the path here.  The green glow warms the woods, and direct sunlight leaks through to shine on rocks and bushes off to the side of the path.  Lizards sun themselves on larger rocks, flicking out tongues to catch the occasional insect buzzing past.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Thick fog covers the valley floor as far as the eye can see.  Pine trees grow more dense to the southwest, and thin out considerably to the north.  The tops of bushes poke through the top of the mist that carpets the ground.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The hollowed trunk of a broken tree stands here high above the fog.  The jagged edges of the trunk show the tremendous force that must have been necessary to rend this once mighty tree.  To the north and west, hills rise out of the fog, but the thick mist persists to the east and south.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: To the north, the hills rise out of the fog that grows denser to the south.  Dense bushes and vines cover the hills, except along this well-trodden path.  A steep climb to the northeast leads through some tall lilac bushes, and a steady incline leads alongside a dry ravine to the northwest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path rises toward a stone ridge to the northeast, and descends into a foggy valley to the south and southwest.  A wide, flat area off the path to the east has been used as a campsite by many travelers, as evidenced by a ring of stones used many times to contain campfires.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path comes to the edge of a ravine to the west before turning away to the north and southeast here.  The ravine is currently dry, but looks as if it might fill in a heavy rain.  Small trees and light brush dot the banks of the dry river bed.  The path crumbles underfoot very close to the banks.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: Several large boulders are scattered about near the path here, providing many cracks, crevices, nooks, and crannies where small animals and lizards can hide.  Gaps in the boulders to the east and west are wide enough to allow passage.  The path continues to the northeast and the southwest.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, west

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: This circular area almost looks like a temple of some sort.  The walls, which are made from the natural rock of the area, rise high enough that only the midday sun touches the soil here.  Winds can be heard high above, but do not disturb this protected alcove.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The rocks and boulders which flank either side of this crevice force a zigzag direction, making it impossible to see very far ahead.  Occasional clattering stones, dislodged by something moving through the crevices, rain down from the walls which rise high above.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: A pile of shattered stone banks the path to the east.  The tips and jagged ends of shattered stone that point in all directions sport swatches of fur and cloth left by travelers foolish enough to attempt to cross the pile.  The stones shift occasionally, as if the earth deep beneath them were moving, or as if something were moving unseen amidst the stones.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path slopes steeply here, making footing tricky.  Shattered granite litters the bushes to either side of the path.  A thanot tree on the south edge of the path has many broken branches and is missing bark, having been used to break the fall of many a careless traveler.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path descends into a deep ravine running northeast to southwest here.  The ravine walls are too steep and treacherous to climb.  Nothing grows on the floor of the ravine, and the occasional stones emerging from the ground or the ravine walls are cold and moist to the touch.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path is very steep here, making the climb to the northwest challenging.  A clump of holly bushes banks the path to the northeast, providing berries and shelter to a throng of small birds.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: On this flat stretch of path, the soil on the ground is replaced by smooth granite.  Stubborn weeds and wildflowers fight for the bits of earth that gather in the crevices of the granite.  Dense woods grow to the north, making further progress in that direction impossible.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path bends gently around the sloping hills here.  Modwir trees intrude on the occasional oaks and pines that dot the hillside.  Large rocks are strewn throughout the area, some jagged and broken, others work smooth by the elements.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: A huge boulder breaks through the side of the hill here.  The top of the boulder juts out over the bottom, making a horizontal crevice in the stone.  Water constantly drips and pools into a natural basin that has been worn in the bottom part of the boulder.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path peaks and turns sharply here, sloping downward to the northeast and southeast.  Grass grows stubbornly on the path, and bushes ring the hilltop.  The tops of pine trees can be seen to the south and west.  To the east, the hills are veined with paths and dotted with trees.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: Two large oaks flank the path on either side here, almost as if placed intentionally.  Leaves carpet the path, rustling in the occasional breezes that blow up from the southeast.  Beyond the oaks to the north, the path forks to the northwest and into a ravine to the northeast.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The ravine reaches a low point here, sloping up sharply to the southwest and gently to the northeast.  A pool of thick, black water collects here at the low point of the ravine.  Occasional bubbles break the surface of the otherwise calm pool.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path is nearly blocked by fallen rubble from one of the walls of the path here.  Shattered stones lie in huge chunks on the ground, making it necessary to choose the path carefully and climb occasionally to proceed.  Weeds grow amongst the boulders, occasionally dotted with colorful wildflowers.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path is passable to the southwest, but is blocked to the northeast by a jumble of boulders and shattered stone.  The stone has fallen from the high walls on either side of the path, broken loose by years of erosion.

The path is passable to the southwest, but is blocked to the northeast by a jumble of boulders and shattered stone.  The stone has fallen from the high walls on either side of the path, broken loose by years of erosion.  Lizards climb amongst the fallen rocks, making their way to the top to sun themselves.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The descent into the fog to the southeast is accompanied by a decrease in temperature that seems unnatural for this area.  The fog swirls in delight at the approach of travelers, as if feeding on the heat they bring to the area.  A breeze high above does not touch the fog, but occasionally whines like a wailing child.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The ground flattens out to the east, but slopes up sharply to the northwest.  The ground is soft underfoot, as if kept constantly damp by the unrelenting fog that swirls ceaselessly on the path.  Leaves high above in the trees have a gray tint, almost as if covered by a thick layer of frost or spider webs.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The path is flanked on either side by the thick trunks of trees so dense that a virtual wall is formed.  The walls of trees are unnaturally straight, as if guiding travelers due east and west.  The fog rises higher from the ground behind the trees, making swirling shapes which dance ominously behind the wooden curtain.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The thick fog continues to hide the ground from sight along this east-west path.  Squirrels chitter occasionally from high above, dislodging an occasional twig or acorn that falls silently into the fog.  Sounds seem to be swallowed up by the fog, making practically all movement almost completely silent.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Columns of trees guide the path straight to the west, but the tops of stubborn bushes poke above the fog, defining the path to the southeast.  The tops of the trees above provide a complete canopy, blocking out all moonlight and giving the fog an eerie greenish glow.

Columns of trees guide the path straight to the west, but the tops of stubborn bushes poke above the fog, defining the path to the southeast.  The tops of the trees above provide a complete canopy, blocking out all sunlight and giving the fog an eerie greenish glow.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The path slopes slightly downward to the southeast, and upward to the northeast and northwest.  Fog completely covers the ground, and occasional short trees and tall bushes poke like islands in the mist.  The temperature continues to drop along the descent to the southeast.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The path pokes just above the fog here, revealing black, moist earth that makes up the path to the southwest and the east.  The trees creak slightly, as if an unseen wind high above were blowing amongst the treetops.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The fog here is so deep that all but the tallest of travelers are swallowed up completely by the fog.  Banks on either side of the path guide travelers along to the east and west, and a large fallen tree provides an escape to the northwest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: A monolith carved out of a boulder that erupts from the surface here dominates the northern side of the path.  To the southeast, the path descends into the swirling, thick fog which blankets everything to the south.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: A rocky hillock of pine trees stands to the east of the path from here, the top of which just barely breaks the fog.  Unseen currents cause the fog to wash over the hillock in waves, as if the fog were trying to swallow up the stubborn formation.

title: [Deep Woods, Hillock]
description: Fog eddies and swirls around the trunks of the tall pines standing on this hillock.  Moisture beads on the rough trunks, feeding the velvety growths of moss that blanket the trees in a rich green.  The ground slopes downward both to the west and northeast, barely seen under the thick mist.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Many fallen trees nearly block the path here, slowing progress to a crawl.  The roots of the fallen trees stand tall above the fog off the path to either side.  Despite the felled trees, no moonlight penetrates this place.  A hill to the east looks to be climbable.

Many fallen trees nearly block the path here, slowing progress to a crawl.  The roots of the fallen trees stand tall above the fog off the path to either side.  Despite the felled trees, no sunlight penetrates this place.  A hill to the east looks to be climbable.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: The trees overhead, combined with the hillock to the southwest, almost completely block all light from ever reaching the ground.  The smell of must is pervasive, perpetuated by large toadstools spreading over the rich black earth.  A diagonal line of thick underbrush and overgrown bushes grows to the east, perhaps marking the run of an underground river.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: Lush moss grows beneath the tangled thorn bushes, nurtured by the cool wet mists.  The first several feet of each tree trunk is coated in the green velvet plant life, stained by constant exposure to moisture.  Smooth stones litter the ground, polished as if tumbled over and over by flowing water.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: Thorny brambles grow tumbled over the earth.  They leave only the faintest of trails to walk upon, and even that path is hazardous to clothing and skin.  Their leaves are thick and deep green, as if fed by a constant water source other than the swirling fog.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: The ground drops off sharply to the north and northwest, creating a small cliff of dirt and rock.  Far below you can hear the sounds of water falling, but the actual falls are obscured by a thick layer of fog.  A few tenacious bramble bushes cling to the steep face, but the trees have all toppled downwards with the earth.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: A wall of slate grey stone lies hidden behind the brush and trees to the southeast.  A small hole in it displays darkness beyond, leading inside the forgotten structure.  The rock is stained from years in the elements untended, and is slick with green-black slime and moss.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: Dim light emanates from a hole in the stone wall to the west.  Dirt, dead plants and pine needles cover the once-fine marble grey marble floor, and branches take the place of the ceiling in multiple places.  The faint smell of rot tickles the back of your throat, not strong enough to make you retch but too pervasive to simply ignore.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: Several broken benches lay scattered across the floor, the golden velvet skin ripped to expose the cotton fluff innards.  Pages torn from books have been thrown to the nonexistent winds, unreadable now after years outside their covers.  A votive cup of yellow glass has been thrown against the stone wall, vaporized into a glittering powder that mixes unflatteringly with the thick dust.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: Burned out torches and shredded tapestries litter the floor, covering pools of crusted, dried blood.  Bones of several humanoid races as well as other unknown creatures mingle with the other debris, broken and chipped as if dropped onto the hard marble.  The air is stagnant, holding the smell of death and decay hostage in the stone ruins.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: A grey marble altar sits against the wall, oddly preserved amid the other destruction in this place of worship.  An immense golden topaz sits in the center of the dais, broken only by a piece of onyx running down the center like the pupil in the eye of a cat.  Atop the altar is a huge book, pages yellowed but writing still legible even after all this time.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: Chipped and broken votive candle holders sit entombed by melted wax on a niche in the wall.  The years and elements have hardened the wax to the consistency of mortar, making the lumpy mass a permanent fixture.  The scent, probably pleasant at one time, now only adds to the cloying stench of rot.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: Multiple bodies have been stacked here like firewood.  The skin is drawn tightly across the skeletons almost as if sucked inward, thin enough that each bone fracture can be clearly seen.  One of the corpses is significantly newer than the rest, still moist and pinkish blue over the bony framework.  Blood has washed over the entire floor, and the scent is nearly unbearable.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: The remains of a marble arch have fallen about the floor.  The ceiling sags dangerously, bereft of its support, held in place only by the interloping branches of a pine outside.  Melted wax has spilled over the walls, spattered by candles set in the mangled gold candelabras that lean there.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: An interior wall has fallen over, creating many crevices for dust and pine needles to blow into.  Marble-sized pieces of yellow topaz roll on the floor, each with a black cats-eye slit in the center.  Twisted gold candelabras lean against the walls, threatening to fall over with the slightest movement.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: An enruned thanot door opens to the outside, giving a view of the deep forest.  Ruined splendors fill this area, likely once the foyer of the temple, telling a story of destruction and neglect.  Yellow topaz eyes surround the portal, each looking at you and eerily seeming to track your movements.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: A slit-pupiled yellow eye winks out from behind camouflaging trees and bracken.  It sits over an enruned thanot door, watching all who would enter the ruins of what once was likely a temple.  The pines threaten to overtake the structure, nearly hostile in their dominance over the area.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: The pine trees cluster close about each other, making movement nearly impossible.  Clumps of needles have stuck between the trees, unable to fall through the embracing branches.  All sunlight has been driven from the area, making it dark as midnight even in the middle of the day.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: A pine with a trunk half again too large for a giantman to put his arms around reaches toward the sky, as if to single-handedly guard the ground from the touch of the sun.  Streamers of moss grow from the craggy bark, decorating it like a shaggy, musty maypole that was left out of doors for a century.  Sharp-thorned bushes grow close about it, trying but not succeeding in strangling the life from the giant arbole.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: The ground is sodden, squishing with each bit of pressure placed upon it.  The scent of mold is strong, choking out the scents of the trees and bushes attempting to grow in the greenish muck.  Mist pools here, eddying restlessly before finding its way up the small hillock to the southwest.

title: [Deep Woods, Hillock]
description: A small patch of feathers lays on the ground, scattered as if by violent force.  The rest of the avian that once wore them is nowhere to be found, and a bit of dried blood speaks a silent testimony to the savage nature of the attack.

title: [Deep Woods, Hillock]
description: Saplings fight older trees for space and nutrients on the top of this hill, struggling upwards towards the weak sunlight filtering through the branches.  The fog shimmers in the dim light, glowing with an unearthly golden cast around the grey-brown trunks and pouring downwards off the sides of the mound.

title: [Deep Woods, Hillock]
description: The trees thin slightly to the west and southwest, giving glimpses of the valley opening beneath the small hill.  Mist swirls around you, crawling over the ground like a stalking cat following a mouse into the dell.

title: [Deep Woods, Hillock]
description: A break in the trees gives you a spectacular view of the valley to the west.  Deep green pines float ethereally over an airy quilt of fog, leading a small trail between the mountain walls.  Wind whistles through the trees about you, riffling your hair and whispering secrets of nature in your ear.

title: [Deep Woods, Hillock]
description: Fog rolls over the hillock, flowing like a waterfall into the valley to the west.  Pine trees reach toward the sky and fill the moist air with their crisp aroma.  Both new and dried needles cover the ground, making it slick and slightly dangerous.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The path turns sharply here to the northeast and the southeast.  A single, tall oak stands to the east, rising up into the canopy of trees and out of sight.  Trickling water can also be heard to the east.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A large inland lake stretches out to the east, circled by a well-traveled dirt road.  The forest closes in on the path all around the lake, making a beautiful landscape for watching the sunrise.  A breeze from the west blows the trees gently, and dips down to make occasional ripples on the lake.  A hill slopes down into a foggy valley to the west.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: The road here is well maintained and shows signs of regular wagon travel.  The long, wide lake serves as a source of food and work for wildlife and fishermen in the surrounding area.  The sounds of a myriad of creatures come from the forest and echo across the lake.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A small section of dark green pines borders the path to the southeast here, dropping pine cones and needles on the path.  Sticky pine sap coats the leaves and bark that lie in the path, making them stick to the feet of travelers and animals that pass by.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A flock of geese floats serenely on the water here, following each other in single file.  They seem to chase one and other in circles and figure-eights as they paddle through the water, poking heads below the surface for a quick bite.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: Several bushes, damaged by fire, border the path here.  The fire was not large, but burned away a small portion of the underbrush.  New sprouts and saplings poke hopefully through the ashes toward the sky.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: The remains of a wooden crate lie off the path here.  The crate appears to have been bashed open by repeated blows.  The crate has lettering on one side, barely visible now, faded by the sun and weathered by the elements.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: The road continues around the lake to the east and west here, and is joined by a path that runs out of the forest down from the southeast.  Trees overhead sway in the breeze that blows steadily from the west.

The road continues around the lake to the east and west here, and is joined by a path that runs out of the forest down from the southeast.  Trees overhead sway in the breeze that blows steadily from the west.  Bird calls echo through the forest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: Several large rocks lie partly in the lake to the north here, providing a nice place to dive from or to sit and gaze at the stars above.  A picnic basket with a broken handle has been discarded near the rocks, and ants nearly encase the basket, crawling in and out looking for a meal.

Several large rocks lie partly in the lake to the north here, providing a nice place to dive from or to sit and absorb the midday sun.  A picnic basket with a broken handle has been discarded near the rocks, and ants nearly encase the basket, crawling in and out looking for a meal.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: To the northwest, the Old Forest Road rejoins the road circling the lake below.  To the southeast, the road strikes up a hill and into the deep green forest.  Many branches and other dead wood litter this area, possibly the result of a recent storm.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: Two trees, relatively close together, are off the path to the south here.  The trees here were apparently used to dry animal pelts and skins, and sport many nails and several spikes.  Caught in the spikes and nails are catches of fur and hide.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: The beginnings of a house lie to the southeast of the path here.  Apparently, someone had begun building a cabin of sorts.  The frame is broken and burned, and the tools used to start building lie about the area, rusting and rotting away.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A small picnic area has been cleared to the southwest of the path here.  Crude tables and benches, rough but functional, have been hammered together and are distributed around the area.  A small dock juts into the lake, perfect for diving from for a swim.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: An overturned tree lies to the east of the path here, uprooted apparently from below.  Large mounds of earth lie about the exposed roots, and the hole left under the base of the tree looks suspiciously deep, as if something had burrowed a way out from under the tree.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A small stream trickles into the lake from the east here.  The stream is only ankle deep, and can be easily crossed without getting wet.  Stones lie along the path, exposed by the stream, then cleared for the passage of wagons.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A sign stands off the path to the northeast, next to a well-worn trail that leads off and up into the forest.  The road continues around the lake to the northwest and southeast.  A stump off the path here has been used to cut a great deal of firewood, as is evidenced by the many axe cuts in the surface.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: The road bends around the northeastern corner of the lake here, and a large, flat section of shore resembles a beach.  This section of shore is likely a launching point for many boats, and many wagon wheel ruts work their way to the edge of the water.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The path here winds through the trees up a steep hill.  Ruts in the center of the path indicate the regular dragging of lumber through this area.  The surrounding forest is very dense, and straying far from the path here would almost certainly mean getting lost.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: Acorns crunch underfoot as the path curves around a massive oak tree to the east here.  The tree is huge, with a trunk as wide around as ten giantmen.  Somehow, the oak has remained untouched by blight, and has survived the axes and saws of the many lumberjacks who have traveled this path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The point of a huge rock erupts from the path here, like a sapling reaching for the sun.  The path is well-worn around the rock, and passage is not hindered.  A trench has been dug around the base of the rock, perhaps in an unsuccessful attempt at moving it from the path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: A small cliff face rises to the north of the path here, its crags being covered with mosses and tall grasses.  Vines cling to the boulders and dangle towards the path.  The cliff face is not climbable, but could provide shelter in the event of a storm.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: Several large trees have been felled near the path here, and the stumps of the trees are still fresh and flat.  The underbrush has been cleared away to cut the trees, and the stumps stand out in contrast to the surrounding forest.

Several large trees have been felled near the path here, and the stumps of the trees are still fresh and flat.  Blue-jays and mockingbirds that perch on the stumps dart away at the approach of travelers.  The underbrush has been cleared away to cut the trees, and the stumps stand out in contrast to the surrounding forest.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: Flies buzz around a rotting mound to the north of the path here.  Deadwood, weeds, rotting vegetables, and garbage have been piled here, turning slowly into fertilizer.  This is likely the compost heap for a nearby garden.  A small path leads to the south from here, while the main path continues to the southwest and east.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: A magnificent garden, expertly tended, fills the entire area.  Tomatoes, cucumbers, lettuce, carrots, and vegetables of all sorts grow in neatly tended rows here.  Fireflies hover over the variety of plant life, tiny torches blinking in the night.

A magnificent garden, expertly tended, fills the entire area.  Tomatoes, cucumbers, lettuce, carrots, and vegetables of all sorts grow in neatly tended rows here.  Bees buzz from row to row, taking advantage of the bounty and variety of plant life.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: A broken axe lies off the path to the east here.  The head of the axe is rusted and notched, and the handle has been splintered through completely.  Several of the trees in the area are scarred by axe notches.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: A ring of pine trees circles a large flat stone here, too obviously arranged to be a natural growth.  This area may have once been an altar.  Now, the stone is covered with moss and vines, and the trees drop pine cones which litter the area.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: Dozens of small, steep hills mark the path here, making it difficult to ascend or descend.  Logs lie in some of the small valleys, many of which are filled with loose rocks.  Branches of nearby trees have been broken off by travelers trying to keep afoot.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The path inclines steeply to the northeast, but flattens out to the south.  Dozens of round rocks, about the size of wagon wheels, lie at the bottom of the hills, as if they had rolled down from above.  Bushes grow thickly around the trees here.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: Bushes close in around the path here, and appear to persist on the path in spite of being regularly cut back.  Brambles and thorn bushes sport vibrant flowers, but bite and tear at anyone or anything coming too close.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The path widens here, and the bushes have been cut back to make room for several camp sites.  A supply of wood has been left here, possibly for use by the many loggers who travel through regularly.  Rings of stones mark semi-permanent fire pits.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The remains of a covered wagon lie to the west of the path here, partly burned and brutally smashed by something large.  Three grave stones have been placed to the east of the path here, memorials to the occupants of the wagon.  The graves have been very well tended, and fresh flowers lie on each stone.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: A stream cuts across the path here, babbling down from the hills in the southeast toward the lake to the northwest.  The stream is shallow, and can be easily crossed without getting wet.  Rocks lying on the path have been washed smooth by the running water.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: Some of the roots of an immense tree growing on a hill to the southeast have been exposed by the erosion of the hill.  The roots reach down the hillside before curving back into the earth.  Water trickles in thin rivulets down the roots, keeping them moist and alive.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: A small rift, only about a hand's width across, crosses the path here.  The crack continues up the hill to the east and down toward the lake to the west.  The crack has yet to fill in with dirt, indicating that it is recent, or that it opens and closes regularly.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The road forks to the northeast and southeast here, and continues along the lake to the west.  The path to the southeast is nearly overgrown, and clearly not often traveled.  To the west, the woods thin out a bit, allowing more moonlight to the forest floor.

The road forks to the northeast and southeast here, and continues along the lake to the west.  The path to the southeast is nearly overgrown, and clearly not often traveled.  To the west, the woods thin out a bit, allowing more sunlight to the forest floor.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: A tattered piece of canvas hangs from several trees in this area just off the path to the south.  The canvas appears to have once been used as a crude shelter or tent, but is now dry rotted and twists in the wind.  The trees around the canvas still serve well as shelter.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The path here is choked with weeds and vines.  Bushes close in on the path, nearly closing it to further travel.  The main road to the northwest looks much easier to travel.  The path grows rougher to the east.  Shaped like a balled-up fist with a single extended finger, a large boulder points accusingly at the bone white tower looming above you on a rocky hillock.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The road begins to slope gently downward to the west and levels off to the east.  Bushes and other underbrush gather around the trees here, making the road look especially bare.  A broken wagon wheel lies off the path to the north.

title: [Noman's Land, Valley]
description: There's little vegetation here -- it's mostly rocks and mud.  The few gnarled trees struggling to survive have been stripped of their leaves.  Well-trodden, soggy paths lead off to the southwest and southeast, past low walls of stacked rocks.

title: [Noman's Land, Urgh Pens]
description: The walls are more extended rockpiles than any sort of proper fence, but they serve well enough as borders for the pen.  Wooden troughs for fodder are piled in the middle.  Well-gnawed bones surround them.

title: [Noman's Land, Urgh Pens]
