description: A particularly stubborn scrub tree clings to life here, somehow finding sustenance in the mud.  It has but a few leaves, and its trunk is bare of bark from the ground up to the span of a dwarf.  A mud-spattered raven perches on one branch, huddled against the damp breeze.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Noman's Land, Urgh Pens]
description: The mud and slop of the pens gives way to the mud and rock of the hill to the south.  A narrow path winds its way up.  The climb looks fairly difficult, given the slippery and uncertain footing.  At the other end, you can see the black maw of a large cave gaping from the hillside.

title: [Noman's Land, Urgh Pens]
description: A particularly stubborn scrub tree clings to life here, somehow finding sustenance in the mud.  It has but a few leaves, and its trunk is bare of bark from the ground up to the span of a dwarf.  A mud-spattered raven perches on one branch, huddled against the damp breeze.

title: [Noman's Land, Urgh Pens]
description: The rock walls of the pens narrow here, providing an east-west passage.  A particularly large pile of offal spills over the southern wall, flies buzzing about the fetid mass.  The banks of a small creek lie to the east.

title: [Noman's Land, Creek]
description: The bloated corpse of some kind of ox bobs in the creek waters below you.  A pair of muddy birds scavenge supper from this bounty, sharing the meal with countless insects.  Countless small, cloven footprints in the mud by the creek's edge evidence that this is the urghs' favored watering hole.

title: [Noman's Land, Creek]
description: The bank of the creek is a crumbling wall of mud.  Below you, the waters gargle and slosh along, covered with an ill-smelling layer of bubbling slime.  The few hardy weeds sprouting out of the mud have been trampled flat.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave Mouth]
description: The ledge here at the mouth of the cave provides a splendid view of the valley below in all its mud-spattered, ill-smelling beauty.  The cave entrance itself is at least twenty feet high, and a dank, sickly-sweet smoke wafts from it.  To the southwest, a dimly lit passage leads deeper into the hillside.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: Some crude, oversize reed torches provide a flickering light, which dances off the rough rock walls.  The smells of smoke, mud and carrion blend into an unpleasant melange.  From somewhere to the south, a low grumble echoes through the cavern.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: The cavern twists sharply here, curving north and east.  The southern wall is covered with a sickly grey fungus, which smells even worse than it looks.  Several chunks have been scooped out of it, as if by the hand of a giant.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: Hide ropes are strung from massive wooden stakes driven into the ground around the perimeter of this large, round chamber.  Urgh carcasses hang here to ripen, some of them skinned, some still bearing fur.  A small, smoky fire burns in a small pit in the center of this oversize pantry.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: Some large, fetid-smelling piles of urgh hides are grouped about a fire pit.  A small cookpot hangs above the fire from an iron spear driven into the soil.  Koar only knows what's for supper, but it smells a lot like wet, long-dead orc.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: A large, brownish-red dot has been painted on the wall here.  Below it lies a pile of splintered skulls, some urgh, some humanoid, some too badly smashed to tell.  Several empty barrels are piled haphazardly in one corner below a sputtering reed torch.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: Bugs swarm about piles of urgh hides scattered here as beds.  The fire pit in the center is cold.  The walls are covered with huge, crudely done paintings in a rust-colored dye.  They appear to depict a group of cyclopes dancing around a bonfire.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: A large pit has been dug in the center of this cavern.  It overflows with carrion, the torsos, skulls and limbs of several species.  Several piles of urgh hides are spread about the pit as makeshift beds.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: A large pile of rocks in the center of this chamber has been festooned with scraps of once-colorful cloth, polished bones and shiny bits of metal.  One particularly large skull is perched atop the pile, a bright piece of red glaes set into its single eye-socket.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: The cave narrows here, and the ceiling is much lower -- barely large enough for a giantman to stand upright.  Splintered bones, scraps of cloth and various unidentifiable bits of trash are scattered on the ground.  To the east, a narrow opening leads into darkness.

title: [Noman's Land, Cave]
description: A massive pile of urgh hides lies in the center of this room.  A cloud of fleas rises from the putrid rags.  A splintered barrel lies at the foot of this makeshift bed.  The firepit is cold, though someone has already prepared their next meal and left it here for cooking.  The flayed and quartered corpse was probably a goblin.

title: [Noman's Land, Niche]
description: Dim light filters through a narrow opening to the west, but most of this small chamber lies in deep shadow.  The walls are covered with a sweet-smelling moss, and water drips slowly from a stalactite into a small pool of clear, dark water.  The chill, damp air is still.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: A bubbling pool of mud lies just off the path to the west here.  Steam rises from the boiling mud, reaching the treetops that hang over the pool.  Foul smells occasionally assault the senses as the bubbles burst on the surface, spraying nearby plants with gray mud.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: An old, splintered sign post is off the path to the north here.  Two nails rust uselessly near the top of the weathered and broken post where a sign once hung.  Weeds and vines strangle the area, nearly tripping any travelers attempting to navigate the path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The trees begin to thin out to the east here, while the woods grow denser to the west.  Tall wild grasses begin to grow where the underbrush once dominated.  Saplings border the edge of the forest, signs of the advance of the woods into the grassy fields.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Forest Road]
description: The woods, grasses, and underbrush turn to brown, then to black and dead as the path progresses east toward an old rickety house.  The house looks strangely out of place here, its fine craftsmanship obvious even though it is now dilapidated.  No plants grow anywhere near the house, and animals seem to keep their distance.

The woods, grasses, and underbrush turn to brown, then to black and dead as the path progresses east toward an old, rickety house.  The house looks strangely out of place here, its fine craftsmanship obvious even though it is now dilapidated.  No plants grow anywhere near the house, and animals seem to keep their distance.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: The road continues around the lake here, and a smaller path, not as well maintained as the road, branches off to the north.  Ruts in the path indicate not only the passage of wagons, but also the dragging of trees by loggers.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: An old house stands at the northern end of this path.  The house was obviously never opulent, but is now in a state of disrepair that indicates it is no longer inhabited.  A long porch, now rotting and warped, stretches the length of the front of the house.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A large, flat stone has been set up to the north of the path here as a table.  Fish heads lie all around the table, and flies buzz all around, feeding on the remains.  The ends of fishing lines and many bent and mangled hooks litter the ground around the table.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A wrecked rowboat lies on one side on the shore of the lake here.  The boat has a hole in the bottom, and has been sitting on the shore for so long that the rails and planks have rotted and warped, destroying all hope of repairing the boat.  No oars are anywhere to be found.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: The lake laps steadily against the sandy shores, ripples moving back and forth across the surface.  A thick layer of algae grows on the top of the water wherever it pools and remains still.  The remains of a barrel, rotted planks and rusted hoops, lies off the path to the north.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A small but sturdy dock extends into the lake here, a possible launching point for rowboats or small fishing boats.  There are currently no boats in the lake or at the dock.  Many campfires have been lit in this area, evidenced by the numerous remaining fire pits.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: An amazing tangle of dried out shrubs and thorn-covered hedges are forcing the path to fork off in two directions.  The decaying remains of a small rodent are still visible within the spiky brush, the unfortunate animal clearly a victim of one of the sharp spines.  Above the path, a massive tower pierces the sky.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: The narrow path has fallen victim to time, and the dirt is now covered with a thick layer of dead leaves and long wiry vines that are disguising its direction.  A low, guttural growl breaks the silence on occasion, the ominous noise seeming to be coming from beyond the nearby gate.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: The rusted iron gate placed here long ago outlived its usefulness.  The hinges are shattered, and if there was ever a lock, it is nowhere to be seen.  There are no obstacles to keep invaders from the monstrous tower, save for a lack of courage.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: There is an odd stillness to the air, and with it comes the faint stench of rot and decay.  There is nothing tangible to reach out and touch, but the odd sounds coming from nearby courtyard reveal that there is clearly something amiss nearby.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: What's left of this entry gate can no longer be opened or closed, and the only question that remains is, is this a good thing or a bad thing?  The mournful baying of a wolf or large dog pierces the air, and one can only hope it doesn't serve as a guardian to this area.

title: [Library, Foyer]
description: Suspended from exposed oak beams, across a white-washed ceiling, are several iron rings, their ends dangling candle-filled glass globes.  A thick dark blue cotton rug covers the limestone floor and shows signs of heavy foot traffic, especially near the brass-handled oak door that leads out to the street beyond.  Cloaks hang from pegs to the right of the foyer, above benches where a trio of girls share a book.

Soft candlelight spills from glass globes that are suspended from exposed oak beams of the white-washed ceiling by large iron rings.  Shadows line the walls where the light does not reach leaving a single reading bench with little illumination.  A withered old woman bends down on her hands and knees as she attempts to scrub the day's dirt from a blue cotton rug that covers the limestone floor.  Her soft sighing is the only sound that disturbs the nighttime quiet of the library's entryway.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: What might have been a fountain or sculpture at one time now lies ruined in several jagged pieces upon the ground, most of the stone debris blackened as if hit by lightning.  The brush surrounding the artwork is hardly more than ash now, giving further evidence that something malevolent might have occured in this area.

title: [Captain's Rest, Entryway]
description: The walls are half paneled with modwir wood with whitewashed walls above.  Time darkened beams above support brass oil lanterns.  Just to the right of some well-worn oaken stairs is a large painting of a ship in a stormy sea.  From the common room to the east comes the clink of glasses and the sound of conversation.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: A bench is barely peering out from a morass of weeds and ivy, and no longer looks to be a pleasant spot to rest.  In fact, there is nothing pleasant about anything in this courtyard, rather it appears to be nothing more than a field of weeds and decay.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: A large dried-out tumbleweed rocks back and forth in the subtle breeze, the roundish shrub only one good stiff wind from rolling off.  Behind the dead plant, dark shapes can be seen gliding silently in the distance, their forms low to the ground and animal-like in their movement.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: The iron gate that allowed entrance to this courtyard is no longer in sight, so there will be no quick escape to safety if needed.  A badly mangled piece of what might have been a shield is protruding from the ground, and based on its condition, it did a very poor job of protecting its owner.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: The iron fence surrounding the courtyard still stands, but the corrosion and rust is so bad in the metal, it's only a matter of time before it collapses.  It does still serve to keep out the wildlife, or perhaps keep it in.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: A small simple marker has been placed here, and it sits within a tiny garden that stands out amidst the decay of the courtyard.  A few timeless roses bloom within the patch of soil, eternal in their grace.  There is something clearly magical about this spot.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: The pale form of the tall ivory spire dwarfs all else within the courtyard, but while it is clearly visible, a gnarled mass of thorns and bushes is blocking any path towards the tower.  It is almost as if those who designed the structure only wished there to be the one point of entrance.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: The wind is hardly more than a whisper, but its caress is cold and lingering.  The lack of a stiff breeze only serves to further the rank scent of death that seems to be swirling about.  It's hardly the place one would consider an ideal picnic spot.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: Numerous small bones that could either be human or animal have been piled into a large mound.  Judging by the structure of the tower, it's clear that these are just the leftovers used in building it.  The sheer number of corpses that must have been needed to construct this grim keep is staggering.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Trail]
description: You can see gulls circling in the distance off toward the north and you can smell the salty odor of the nearby Darkstone Bay, but you cannot see the bay from this vantage point.
The night air is filled with the salty tang of the sea.  The faintest sound of breaking waves and ebbing tides can be heard from the north where Darkstone Bay rests, lulling the animals to sleep.

title: [Ruined Courtyard]
description: The massive tower looms over you, its spire clawing toward the the sky.  There is something very odd about the structure however,  and while it is difficult to tell from this distance, the material used to construct the tower does not look like ordinary stone.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the east and south.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Entrance]
description: The tower, which looms a hundred feet overhead, is devoid of any windows or balconies save for the massive iron doors that lead inside.  The entire structure appears to be made from all manner of humanoid and animal bone fragments.

The tower, which looms a hundred feet overhead, is devoid of any windows or balconies save for a towering iron double door that leads inside.  The entire structure appears to be made from all manner of humanoid and animal bone fragments.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: Against one of the walls of the warehouse, many of the boxes have been cleared away.  This would be a good place to be away from prying eyes while throwing dice if one were so inclined.  The boxes have been pushed aside, clearing paths east, south, and west.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Antechamber]
description: Two grand arches reach up towards the ceiling, and both have been completely covered with chipped and yellowed bone fragments.  The floor is covered with dust, and the antechamber itself is empty save for some scattered unidentifiable bits of debris.

title: [Lyrofelos' Weaponry]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a large oak table on one side of the shop and a long mahogany rack on the other.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: Covering the floor is a dark tattered rug that is heavily damaged from what looks like a series of claw marks.  Similar gouges in rows of three and four are also marring the walls and ceiling, and only a beast of immense power could leave such scars in the stone.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: Several jagged holes have been blasted into the walls, and tiny bits of bone fragments and white dust are scattered all over the floor from whatever it was that might have caused this damage.  Amidst the rubble is a yellowed skull with its eye sockets chewed out, but it's impossible to determine if this is part of the structure or a recent arrival.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Stairwell]
description: Spiral stairs made of braided rib-bones are coiling up out of sight and into the upper reaches of the tower, but there is nothing but darkness and gloom above.  An occasional shriek pierces the eerie calm.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Stairwell]
description: The stairs continue both upward and downward from this vantage, but a flickering light down one passage invites those with courage to step out of the narrow stairwell.  The air is very stale, but while the scent is unpleasant, it is still breathable.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, up, down

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: What looks to have been a door at some point is no longer anything but a few shattered pieces of bone surrounding a gaping portal.  Several ruined pieces of furniture have spilled out into the hall from what's left of this doorway and look as if they were used as a scratching post by some massive clawed beast.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Stairwell]
description: One of the stairs has cracked so badly that it's one heavy foot away from snapping, and judging from the appearance of the rest of this tower, it doesn't appear as if anybody will be along to repair it in the near future.  A look downward reveals that any misstep will surely result in a horrendous fall with nothing less than a grisly death as its reward.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: A tattered red carpet covers the length of this passage, and its condition is no better than the large tanik picture frame hanging on one wall.  The portrait has been knocked cock-eyed, and the canvas is completely ruined by scratches.   The hallway ends with an archway to the east and a similar passage that branches off to the south.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: The crushed bone walls and ceiling of this hallway are devoid of any decoration, but there are deep gouges covering every surface as if something was trying to claw its way out of this hall.  A low gutteral snarling is coming from somewhere in the passage, but its source is hidden from view.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: A skull hung on one wall has been hollowed out and appears to have been used as a sconce, but for the moment, it's nothing more than a gruesome decoration.  Its empty eye sockets are staring blankly outward and appear to be fixated on the warped door that is visible in this hall.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Trophy Room]
description: Two plush sofas and several chairs are strewn across a shredded scarlet rug, their legs broken and the fabric coverings ripped.  Several fierce beasts that must be from the surrounding wilderness have been mounted on the wall as trophies, but one of them, a fearsome mottled rock lizard, has been mutilated and lies ruined on the floor.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Guest Bedroom]
description: The destruction within this room was so complete that it is impossible to determine just what this area was used for.  The shelving and carpet toward the back of the room have been reduced to cinders, and the wall directly behind them is splotched and scorched.  Burned wood fragments, some of which vaguely resemble parts of tables and chairs, are scattered about the floor.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: There is not much left to this hallway, as most of it is scattered all over the floor.  The wreckage was so intense that many of the ragged holes go clear through the bone walls, allowing the moonlight beyond to peek through.

There is not much left to this hallway, as most of it is scattered all over the floor.  The wreckage was so intense that many of the ragged holes go clear through the bone walls, allowing the daylight beyond to peek through.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Stairwell]
description: An immense pile of debris and rubble caused by what might have been a massive explosion has blocked off access to this level save for the small passages to the north.  The stairwell itself escaped much of the destruction, but a few scorch marks and large chips show that it did not escape the damage completely.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, up, down

title: [Bonespear Tower, Mid Chamber]
description: This room appears to be a nexus to several others, but any purpose that it might have held would be difficult to determine as a huge fireball has completely devastated the area.  Scorch marks and fused bone cover every inch of this spot, and it is impossible to walk in any direction without the sound of something crunching underneath.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Bonespear Tower, Laboratory]
description: The floor is covered with a carpet of shattered glass, and from the looks of the ruined tubes and wires scattered about, this might have been a lab at one time.  Unlike the yellow color of most of the bones making up this tower, the walls here have been badly stained with reddish splotches.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Upper Hallway]
description: The remains of an iron door are doing a very poor job of barring the passage, but based on the splotches of discoloration covering it, it's rather easy to see why.  The metal of the door looks as if some powerful acid must have splashed it from top to bottom, and what isn't corroded and melted is barely hanging on to the hinge.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Closet]
description: There is no longer a wall on the outer side of this room, only sky, and what sounds like the barks and growls of several massive dogs are echoing through the opening.  They don't sound very friendly, and if the shapes traveling through the courtyard below are any indication of what these might be coming from, they don't look friendly either.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Upper Hallway]
description: Some empty, tattered sacks lie scattered on the floor, but there is no indication of what they once contained.  There are what looks like mystical glyphs on a couple of the canvas bags,  but their condition is so bad that it is no longer possible to decipher them.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Attic]
description: This room is nothing more than a pile of bone chips and shattered chunks of wood.  What looks like the carcass of a huge dog is slowly decaying in a corner near one wall, but the rotting beast has been gnawed at so badly, it's hardly recognizeable anymore.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Stairwell]
description: A solid steel trapdoor has been twisted and warped by a fierce explosive force.  Its iron latch has been fused and it is no longer possible to close the trapdoor.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: A giant gouge has been ripped into one wall, and a few bits of cloth are still stuck to the jagged bones protruding from the hole.  It is difficult to determine if wizardry or beast made this mark, but either way, it's quite unsettling.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Hallway]
description: The ceiling is bowing dangerously low as if some great weight might be resting upon it, and several bits of the bone structure have fallen to the floor and shattered into a fine white powder.  A noise that sounds much like a bark is interrupting the silence from time to time.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Sitting Room]
description: This small room must have served as a spot to meditate or ponder.  A sturdy wooden chair placed near a small window is all that remains in this alcove, and it has been pointed to face a small open window.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Breakout]
description: What might have been the top of the tower is no longer anything but a bone-covered platform with no walls.  Something so violent erupted here as to completely destroy this entire level.  Faintly visible on the floor is a broken star circle.  The floor is in ruins and one wrong step over what remains will cause a fatal fall.

title: [Kunz's Weaponry]
[Kunz's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A large oak table and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Vornavis Exterior, River Road]
description: Sparse trees line the sides of this well-traveled dirt road, offering a little bit of shade to the farmers who use it daily.  Just to the west you see a half-timbered building sitting north of the road, its long porch with a wooden swing and awning providing an inviting respite for weary travellers.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: The sharp buzz of crickets rises from a field.  Left untilled this season, clover has moved in and the field is a bed of deep green sprinkled with dots of dark lavender.

Sunlight flashes from the wings of bees buzzing between the clover blossoms.  Left untilled this season, clover has moved in and the field is a bed of deep green sprinkled with dots of bright lavender.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Vornavis Holdings]
description: Deep ruts in the dirt road give testament to the amount of cart and foot traffic in the area.  Several wooden open air sheds lie just off the roadway and might afford some protection from a sudden storm or a quick nights rest.  To the southwest, the massive walls of a large city rise in the distance.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: An empty field of short-cropped grass appears to be a common pasture for several of the nearby holdings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: Smoke curls lazily from the chimney of a peasant cottage, its whitewashed walls almost lost beneath the overhang of golden thatch.  A matching shed and storage bin huddle close by with the common tracks between them worn to bare dirt.  A well-worn path leads north towards the river road.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis Holdings]
description: Well-tended fields line both sides of the road.  Numerous iron plows and irrigation ditches can be seen in the area and a large apple orchard stretches out to the south.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Vornavis Holdings]
description: Sitting among the numerous small fields in the area are crude thatched dwellings.  Lazy tendrils of smoke rise from the tops of the wooden structures and you catch the faint smell of roasting meat on a passing breeze.

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: With bare poles still showing near the peak and the dull grey of unpainted walls, this farmstead is not yet finished or habitable.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis Holdings]
description: The road ends abruptly and fades into a large wheat field.  Faint tracks in the dirt continuing east indicate a road may have once traveled onward, but for unknown reasons is no longer in use.

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: A stand of cattails and the sparkle of dragonfly wings above a green blanket of watercress mark a pond at the bottom of a small hollow.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: Several rolton lift their heads and survey their surroundings, but the rest of the herd continues grazing on the thick grass that covers the meadow.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: Bands of tall barley between rows of low-topped turnips stripe a field in alternating shades of green.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: This area is an irrigation nexus.  Several large irrigation pools feed numerous canals and ditches that run off into the expanse of the orchard.  Small wooden dams have been placed on many of the runoff ditches allowing the farmers to send water where it is needed most.  Based on the disrepair of the system, it appears the farmers have neglected it for some time.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: A small herd of swine root about the trunks of a stand of oak trees, searching for acorns among the dead leaves.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: A small clearing opens up deep inside the orchard.  In the center of the clearing sits a massive apple tree, its darkened branches covering several of the surrounding trees.  The twisting boughs and gnarled trunk of the tree look like they were formed by the hand of an evil giant, and a sense of brooding seeps from its shadowy depths.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: A faint breeze rustles the hundreds of apple branches populating the orchard.  Dark shadows dart in and out of the trees, hiding in the gloom before you catch a glimpse of what they might be.  A strange leathery flapping sound seems to emanate from all around.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: To the south, a large apple orchard stretches out into the distance.  Several iron plows sit rusting by the side of the road next to a large produce cart that has seen better years.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: Rows of ancient apple trees stretch across the orchard.  Dug between the trees are crude irrigation canals filled with slow moving muddy water.  Small wooden planks span the canals every few yards allowing pickers to cross the water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: The apple orchard ends abruptly at a wide grassland.  Several crude wooden ladders have been neatly stacked against a small work shed and are probably used by the pickers to gather fruit from atop the trees.  Poking out from behind the shed are stacks of old wicker fruit baskets.

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: A large wheeled produce cart sits abandoned next to an irrigation pool.  Several wooden ladders and large wicker baskets lie strewn about the cart as if the pickers had fled the area in a rush.  An odd leathery sound seems to emanate from the shadowed boughs of the ancient apple trees.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis' Holdings]
description: The apple orchard comes to an end just to the west.  To the northwest, several rickety windmills can be seen poking above the trees.  Lying next to the small irrigation path is the withered husk of a small animal.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: Rows of ancient apple trees troop off in every direction.  The air here holds a sour, musty scent that does not seem quite natural.  Strange noises coming from the depths of the tree branches give rise to speculation about what might be living in there.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Vornavis, Peasant Holdings]
description: Two large wooden windmills turning slowly in the breeze pump water from underground springs.  Beneath the windmills, a large iron tank gathers the water and then pipes it into several irrigation pools.

title: [Vornavis Holdings]
description: A thread of smoke rises from the stone chimney of a farmstead on the road's north side, and the scent of a wood fire hangs in the air, masking the other odors common to a holding where chickens nest about the yard and hogs sleep beneath the nearby fruit trees.  Alone of four holdings along this stretch of the road, this thatch roofed house shows signs of habitation.

A thread of smoke rises from the stone chimney of a farmstead on the road's north side, and the scent of a wood fire hangs in the air, masking the other odors common to a holding where chickens nest about the yard and hogs root beneath the nearby fruit trees.  Alone of four holdings along this stretch of the road, this thatch roofed house shows signs of habitation.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The drooping branches of untended apple trees form leafy domes above the goldenrod and tall grasses that fill the abandoned orchards on either hand.  An empty hovel, its thatched roof half-collapsed and its doorway filled by a small gorse bush, stands forlornly at the side of the road.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Low hills form a backdrop to the north beyond the evenly spaced trees that must once have been an orchard.  The dogwood-choked gully of a dry streambed loops almost to the road's edge before bending south, its winding course visible both to the south and east.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The rounded shapes of low-growing trees stand among the tall grass to the west, but only the rough-bladed grasses common to the unforested outlands cover the ground to the north, south and east.  The jagged silhouette of a ruined wall is just visible atop a rise to the east.

The rounded shapes of low-growing trees stand among the tall grass to the west, but only the rough-bladed grasses common to the unforested outlands cover the ground to the north, south and east.  The jagged edge of a ruined wall is just visible atop a rise to the east.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The fire-blackened and half-toppled walls of a courtyard surround what must once have been either a cider mill or a roadside inn.  Charred skeletons of fruit trees stand in ordered rows outside the fallen walls, while shattered roof beams protrude from the ash-choked pit that was the building's cellar.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The road follows the north bank of a dry streambed as it runs surprisingly straight east-west.  Tall grasses cover the landscape to the north and east, but the sharp-edged silhouette of man-made ruins is visible, low against the sky to the west.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Reaching southward from a line of mountains just visible on the northern horizon, foothills rise up from the shallow slopes covered by the steppe grasses.  Here and there, the paler greys of exposed rock faces can be seen beneath the moonlight.

Reaching southward from a line of grey mountains just visible on the northern horizon, foothills rise up from the brighter green of the steppe grasses.  Here and there, the lighter earth tones of exposed rock faces show through the vegetation on the steeper slopes.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Far to the south, a lone modwir stands above the undulating sea of grass that is the outlands.  Pristine in its form and of remarkable size, the tree appears to have survived grass fires and avoided lightning strikes which would have scarred or split the trunk.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: A broad band of cone flowers breaks the grass-covered sameness of the grassland.  Standing as tall as the grasses, and wearing a fringe of narrow petals, the flowers wave silently in the night wind.

A broad band of purple cone flowers breaks the green and gold sameness of the grassland.  Standing as tall as the grasses, and wearing a fringe of narrow lavender petals, the flowers draw scores of fluttering butterflies and hovering bees.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The weathered planks of a broken wagon lie at the side of the road near a small firepit.  Missing boards and numerous hatchet marks tell a tale of cannibalization of the fallen cart in this wood-scarce expanse and suggest that the firepit is the progeny of the wain's demise.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Brush and bracken dot the unending expanse of grass-covered plains that stretch to the horizon.  Only a pair of wagon ruts and the burr clover that has sprouted from the trampled earth mark the road that runs west to east through the tall grasses.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: A brush-filled ravine drops toward the starlit waters of the Rockspawn River to the northeast, where the tops of willows peak above the steppe grasses.  To the southeast, hooves, boots and cart wheels have beaten a clear trail across the grassland.

A brush-filled ravine drops toward the brown waters of the Rockspawn River to the northeast, where the tops of willows peak above the steppe grasses.  To the southeast, hooves, boots and cart wheels have beaten a clear trail across the grassland.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: West winds ripple the tall steppe grasses.  The backs of grazing Bresnahanini's roltons dot the sea of wind-dried green like shaggy islands.

title: [Outlands, Rockspawn River]
description: This broad, gravel wash has been scoured by the waters of the Rockspawn River.  A line of driftwood and desiccated water plants entangled in the cottonwoods marks the crest of the river's spring flood.  The currently placid waters of the Rockspawn sweep around a bend here and flow off towards the northwest.

title: [Outlands, Rockspawn River]
description: An ancient willow straddles the southern bank of the Rockspawn.  The canopy of arched branches and streamered leaves forms a pavilion of living green that stands half on the bank and half on the surface of the river.
Meadowlarks flash overhead, leaving and returning to an ancient willow.  The canopy of arched branches and streamered leaves forms a pavilion of living green that straddles the water's edge.

title: [Outlands, Rockspawn River]
description: Over time the river has cut down through the plains, and here in the shelter of steep banks cottonwoods, cattails, and willows compete along the water's edge.  A ways to the east the terrain becomes hilly, and sheer rock walls close in on either side of the river.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: A shallow depression in the plains, nothing is visible from here but wind-swept green rising gently toward the vastness of the sky.  Only the wheel ruts, forming a pair of shallow grooves in the sea of grass, give any sign that more than nature has touched the land.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: From this low rise the grasslands sweep on toward the horizon in all directions.  The shadows of hills and mountains beyond can just barely be seen far to the north and east.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Unshadowed by any trees, the moonlit expanse of the grassland spreads out in all directions.  As if intent on stealing any comfort from the setting, the unobstructed wind leeches the warmth from plant, animal and mineral alike, leaving behind only a gnawing chill.

Unshaded by any trees, the sunlit expanse of the grassland spreads out in all directions.  As if intent on stealing any comfort from the setting, the unobstructed wind leeches the warmth from plant, animal and mineral alike, leaving behind only a gnawing chill.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Trampled grasses and torn up turf littering this area are signs that bull rolton have fought over the dominion of a herd recently.  Splashes of dried blood suggest that the challenge was serious.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Like a pale sentinel in the night, a white granite obelisk stands at the side of the trail.  The once crisp corners of the stone's faces have been worn and rounded by wind and weather.

A white granite obelisk stands at the side of the trail, its angled peak adorned with the impure white of recently-bestowed droppings.  The once crisp corners of the stone's faces have been worn and rounded by wind and weather.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: To one side of the trail the pale ivory of a rolton's ribcage is almost lost from view.  Steppe grasses have grown up lush and verdant between the bones, hiding most of them.
To one side of the trail the sun-bleached ivory of a rolton's ribcage is almost lost from view.  Steppe grasses have grown up lush and verdant between the bones, hiding most of them.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Dark patches glide silently across the moonlit grasses, invisibly tied to the wind-driven clouds above.  The whisper of each blade of grass brushing gently against its neighbor combines to form a constant, unending hiss that rises and falls with the wind.

Dark patches glide silently across the nodding grasses, invisibly tied to the wind-driven clouds above.  The whisper of each blade of grass brushing gently against its neighbor combines to form a constant, unending hiss that rises and falls with the wind.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Pale beneath the moonlit sky, splintered bones poking up through tufts of dark fur, and a fanged jawbone, are all that remain - mute testimony to a wolf that chose as its prey a Bresnahanini's Rolton that was not as sick and feeble as it appeared.  Then again, perhaps it was just in a particularly bad mood.

Splintered bones poking up through tufts of grey fur, and a fanged lower jawbone, are all that remain - mute testimony to a wolf that chose as its prey a Bresnahanini's Rolton that was not as sick and feeble as it appeared.  Then again, perhaps it was just in a particularly bad mood.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: To the side of the trail, a cluster of tubebrush plants has displaced the steppe grass.  A half dozen plants, their circular fans of broad, ground-hugging leaves carpeting an area the size of a cottage, lift their namesake cylinders of pale blossoms aloft on stalks in the moonlight.

To the side of the trail, a cluster of tubebrush plants has displaced the steppe grass.  A half dozen plants, their circular fans of broad, ground-hugging leaves carpeting an area the size of a cottage, lift their namesake cylinders of violet blossoms aloft on stalks of jade green.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: A broad, barren mound of earth punctuated with dozens of slit-shaped holes, and littered with the clean-picked bones of small animals, marks this area as a prairie earwig warren.  The mound appears to have grown recently and is beginning to encroach upon the road.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Twisted laurel trees and scrub dot the plains here, becoming more numerous to the northeast where the grassland gives way to hills.  Beyond the unevenness of foothills to the north snow-capped mountain peaks stand pale beneath the stars.

Twisted laurel trees and scrub dot the plains here, becoming more numerous to the northeast where the grassland gives way to hills.  Beyond the unevenness of foothills to the north white-topped mountain peaks seem almost to hang in the sky.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Tall grasses mix with bracken and stunted trees on the slopes of shallow hills.  Black against the eastern night sky, the top of an ancient tower peers menacingly over the crests of the intervening hills.
Tall grasses mix with bracken and stunted trees on the slopes of shallow hills.  Just visible to the east, the top of an ancient tower peers menacingly over the crests of the intervening hills.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Tall grasses give way to brush and sparse trees as the terrain becomes hilly.  Granite boulders stand alone or protrude from hillsides or clumps of bracken.  The wind seems never to cease here, sweeping in from the west or down off the flanks of the mountains to the north.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The road climbs the gentle slope of the hills to the east.  The scrub is slightly thicker here, and the occasional hardy flower colors the landscape.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The rutted remains of the Outlands Road run through a valley created by two small hills.  Many animal tracks can be seen in the dirt, but there is no other evidence that animals live in this area.  The road continues east through dense brush at that end of the valley.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Flagstones show through the dirt here and there along the roadway.  Although it is overgrown by brush as it enters a small valley to the west, more of the flagstones have survived as the road turns and heads south.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: Following the base of a boulder-strewn hill to the east, more of the road's paving stones are buried beneath a layer of dirt eroded from the hillside.  Coarse and stunted bushes grow close to the ground, competing with splayed brown grasses.

title: [Foothills, Trail]
description: This narrow track strays off to the south, paralleling the main road over the slightly rolling ground.  It has little purpose it seems, save as a flight of fancy by those who have walked it.

title: [Foothills, Trail]
description: The road bends around a small hill leading to the southeast.  The scrubby bushes here are stripped of their greenery, and a strange musky scent fills the air.  In the dirt, long thin drag marks are evident.

title: [Foothills, Trail]
description: Turning out of sight around the hill to the northwest, the stones of the road form a wide and solidly-built thoroughfare that has survived surprisingly well.  The road runs eastward toward the squared shapes of small buildings on a gentle hillside.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Foothills, Trail]
description: Running east-west across the flat land, the road leads towards a distant group of buildings to the east.  To the north, the peak of a mountain can be seen silhouetted against the night sky, giving this area a striking view.

Running east-west across the flat land, the road leads towards a distant group of buildings to the east.  To the north, the peak of a snow-capped mountain can be seen reaching into the clouds, giving this area a striking view.

title: [Foothills, Trail]
description: The ground is broken by a large, flat rock.  The face of the stone is weathered, but one side is marked with straight, regular scratches, and has been worn smooth by constant rubbing.  On the ground below the rock is a strange white mass that looks suspiciously like the skin of a reptile.

title: [Foothills, Trail]
description: The bushes lining the tiny path are scraggly and stripped of any leaves.  Several plants have been torn from the ground, and long claw marks mar the ground.  The scent of musk is heavy in the area, irritating your nose and throat.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The buildings to the east are near enough to see that they are only ruins.  The roofs have all fallen in, and many are missing walls.  Vague, four-legged shapes moving about the tumbled stones do nothing to ease your mind.

title: [Vornavis, Outlands Road]
description: The remains of a village stand just to the east.  The shells of the buildings are all that is left, although looking at the remaining door frames and the height of the structures, it is evident that this village was inhabited by very small people.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: The road from the west widens into a street that winds between the shells of the small cottages to the east and south.  The remains of thatch are strewn about, carried by the wind.  The street leads off into various parts of the village.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west

title: [Ruined Village]
description: The rotted remains of a cart lie sprawled in the street.  The harness poles are not as far apart as a horse cart, and the entire affair would be quite short, were it still standing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Ruined Village]
description: A broken flowerbox from one of the small houses has rolled into the street.  Once neat, the houses are now little more than piles of rock and brick.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: Tumbled houses line the street.  The structures look very unsound, discouraging any thought of going inside.  Time has not been kind to this village, and the elements have taken their toll.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: Two houses have fallen against each other here, creating an arch that creaks with the slightest breeze.  It seems likely that only the pressure of the other house, or the will of the gods, keeps each house from falling down completely.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: A lump of slag outside this building indicates that it was once a smithy.  The scattered ore in the yard has rusted over time, and the skeleton of a bellows lies mostly buried in the dirt.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Ruined Village]
description: The musty, unpleasant odor of goat permeates this area, even after all this time.  The remnants of a fence and shed stand amongst tall grasses, but the feed troughs have been utterly torn apart and clawed through.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: Two worm-ridden fruit bins have fallen across the empty doorframe of the general store.  The building has only two standing walls, and the once-bright sign has split and cracked into kindling.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west

title: [Ruined Village]
description: The remains of a tiny shop are collapsed against the back of the general store.  Half a small dress dummy sticks out from beneath the rubble, and a tatter of cloth flutters from beneath a brick.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: The houses in this area were of a higher quality than the others, as they are more intact.  Despite the better construction, they are still far too unstable to attempt going into.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Ruined Village]
description: A sign embellished with a faded foaming mug hangs tenuously from the ruined building here.  A scratched wooden bench has found its way into the street, as has a dented pewter mug.  The back wall of the building has collapsed inward, crushing anything that might have remained.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: A door of iron bars lies rusting in the narrow street, making footing a concern.  The door appears to have come from the pile of rubble on the south side of the street, presumably the constabulary.  The building is nothing more than a pile of bricks at this point.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: Paving stones from the village's streets continue up the gentle slope to the east, where a low stone wall surrounds a half-timber manor house and a small stone tower.  The manor house's windows have all been boarded over, and the roof is missing more shingles than are remaining.  The weather-greyed bulk of a stable can be glimpsed past the southern end of the house.  The flagstones stop at a rusted iron gate that pierces the stone wall's center.

title: [Outlands, Manor Gate]
description: The manor's rusted gate stands open, the corroded metal of its hinges having long since locked it in that position.  Beyond the gate, the manor house sits at the crest of the hill, its trim faded and the plaster cracked from years of neglect.  A stone tower stands atop a small rise at the hill's northern end, least affected of the buildings by time and circumstance.

title: [Outlands Manor, Courtyard]
description: This overgrown courtyard might have been impressive once, but the flagstones are almost entirely hidden by the weeds and bushes that have grown up between them.  A pathway has been trampled through the weeds to the northeast where the tower stands and another to the southeast and the front door of the manor house.

title: [Outlands Manor, Courtyard]
description: Although only three stories tall, the square tower is substantial -- its walls constructed of large stone blocks.  Clearly more defensible than the manor house, the tower is crowned with battlements that provide deadly vantage points for its occupants.  The grasses and weeds growing between the paving stones have been trodden almost to extinction close by the tower and the half-raised portcullis that once protected its entrance.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: A rotted modwir overhang protects the west entrance of the manor house.  The door itself is made of oaken heartwood and appears to be firm and solid.  Rusted helms, aventails, and other bits of armor lie scattered about, as well as a pile of broken weapons.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: The northwest corner of the manor house wears a brown and green fringe of weeds along its stone foundation, and all of the windows along the north and west walls that can be seen are boarded over.  A path of weed-free flagstones runs north to the tower's entrance.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: This is the tower's antechamber and was designed to be a death trap to invaders.  Only a single narrow doorway allows access to the tower's interior, and kill holes pierce the chamber's ceiling from the floor above.  An iron chute above the inner doorway still bears a dust-covered coating of oil, and the chamber's walls are fire-blackened.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: The flagstones paving the manor yard are more visible here along the front of the manor house, because the obstructing weeds have been trodden upon by foot traffic between the west door of the house and the tower on the rise just to the north.  Only a trio of thistles rooted tight against the manor house's foundation have persisted and now present prickly nuisances to those who pass by.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: A trellis sags against the north side of the manor house, reaching to the second floor.  The wood of the trellis that is visible appears paintless and dull beneath the night sky, but most of it is shrouded in dried leaves that rattle in the wind that sweeps along the hilltop.

A trellis sags against the north side of the manor house, reaching to the second floor.  The wood of the trellis that is visible is paintless and has weathered to a uniform grey, but most of it is shrouded in dried brown leaves that rattle in the wind that sweeps along the hilltop.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: Along this face of the house, the courtyard is overgrown with prairie grass.  A pale mass of mushrooms sprout from a fallen tree that has evidently fed them for years.
Along this face of the house, the courtyard is overgrown with prairie grass.  A colorless mass of mushrooms sprout from a fallen tree that has evidently fed them for years.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: This is the southwest corner of the manor house.  The tall grass grows unfettered, rustling softly against the walls.  The windows have long since been broken, and bits of glass sparkle in the grass.  A short distance off you can see a ruined stable set behind the house.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: Pale beneath the night sky, a skeleton lies in the grass near the south wall of the manor house.  It has rested here for several seasons, if not years, and any belongings it had have long since been taken.
A skeleton lies in the grass near the south wall of the manor house.  It has rested here for several seasons, if not years, and any belongings it had have long since been taken.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: The southeastern corner of the manor house rises here.  The grass near the wall appears to be well trampled beneath boarded windows that are missing a board or two.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: Along this stretch of the manor house plaster has cracked and fallen from between the timbers.  Also, several boards litter the ground, likely from one or more of the windows, although none appear to be missing along this side of the building.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: The eastern porch of the manor house was built of stone blocks long ago.  Over time, the individual blocks have settled unevenly and weeds have grown up through the cracks, right in front of the maoral door that opens from the house onto the porch.  Just a bit north along the face of the house, a small tiled courtyard is littered with a broken table and chairs, and a short distance to the east stands a weathered stable.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: Not large, but still of a respectable size, the stable looks big enough to have held ten or twelve horses.  Away from the shelter of manor house the wind blows across the hilltop, moaning eerily between the boards.  Lacking both of the doors, the stable's doorway looms dark and empty.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: Weeds grow up between the tiles paving this small courtyard.  Broken chairs lie scattered about, and the rusted frame of a once glaes-topped table leans sadly to one side.  An empty, modwir door frame leads into the manorhouse, but no sign of the door that once hung there is visible, only splintered gaps in the frame where the hinges were bolted.  Just a bit northeast of here stands a well.

title: [Manor House, East Entryway]
description: Unadorned woodwork surrounds the maoral door that is the eastern entrance to the manor house.  Doorways leading to the north and south provide ready access to the manor's laundry and kitchen respectively.  A wide corridor runs to the west, with doors leading off of it and the manor's western entryway visible at the far end.  The inlaid pattern of the wooden floor has warped and discolored, but the plaster of the walls and ceiling is still intact.

title: [Outlands Manor, Stable]
description: Smelling more of moldered hay and rotted wood than of horses, the dark interior of the stable provides a faded image of its past glory.  Outlines and nail holes mark the wood where metallic crests once adorned the now warped maoral stalls and the carved haon doorjamb.  An old modwir ladder leads up to the stable's hayloft above the empty stalls.

title: [Outlands Manor, Well]
description: A fieldstone well stands in the middle of the manor yard, sheltered by its own wooden roof.  A pulley hangs above the well, but there is no sign of the rope or any bucket.

title: [Outlands Manor, Exterior]
description: A bed of overgrown rosebushes wraps around the house's northeast corner, lending the area a bright touch with a mix of red, pink and white blossoms.  Whatever bedding plants may have shared the space with the rosebushes have not survived, crowded out by the weeds that have taken over most of the manor yard.

title: [Manor House, North Parlor]
description: Devoid of the door that once filled it, a modwir-framed doorway in the east wall lets out onto a small tiled courtyard.  A pile of refuse lies in the room's southwest corner, partially obscuring the outline of a trapdoor set into the floor, but otherwise the room is bare.  A tanik door leads to the corridor at the west end of the room.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: The bright paint on this building has somehow remained, although from the look of it, there are so many layers of color that it would be impossible to remove them all.  In places one or two layers have been scoured off, giving the building a polka-dotted appearance.  A sign dangles from the roof nearly to the ground.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: Set off a bit from the street are the crumbled blocks of what was once a large building.  The size and design suggest that this was an important building within the culture of the village -- a hall of elders, perhaps, although the lack of open portals halts any exploration.

title: [Ruined Village]
description: This part of the street runs between the temple gate and the rest of the town.  The gate has been forced off one hinge, and is badly bent and twisted.  The elements could not have caused this damage, leaving you to wonder what did.

title: [Temple Courtyard]
description: The temple is the only building left intact in town, although not by much.  From the courtyard, you can see that all four walls and the ceiling still stand, though the door is long gone.  It seems safe enough to enter, but the smell drifting from the doorway leaves you gagging and choking.

title: [Destroyed Temple]
description: The temple is filled with dirt, brush, and worse.  Something lives here, and it is certainly not civilized.  Shed lizard skins line the walls, as do bones and rotting bits of flesh.  Large tracks lead into a hole in the south wall.

title: [Egg Room]
description: A large depression has been dug in the southeast corner of the room.  Under a thin layer of moist dirt, several mottled eggs can be seen in the pit.  The room smells of musk and refuse, and the claw tracks in the dirt confirm that this is the basilisks' lair and egging ground.  The only way out seems to be through the hole in the north wall.

title: [Outlands, Manorhouse]
description: A pair of large wooden tubs, one taller than the other, and a large copper boiler take up most of this room.  Mold grows in patches on the floor and walls as well as floor joists of the room above.  Either the ceiling in this room was never plastered, or the plaster has all fallen and become part of the uneven, mold-covered floor.

title: [Manor House, Kitchen]
description: As dirty and damp as this room is, with patches of yellow mold and cobwebs in the corners, the steel spit spanning the large fireplace and the butcher block counter make the original purpose of the room quite plain.  A rusted basin rests on a table between a boarded up window and a stairway set against the east wall that climbs to the second floor.  Beneath the stairway, stone steps descend to the manor's cellar.  A haon door stands just south of the fireplace in the kitchen's west wall.

title: [Manor House, Central Corridor]
description: The corridor connects the eastern and western entrances of the manor house.  A fluted oaken doorway in the south wall leads to the dining room, and opposite it a paneled tanik door is set into the pale blue plaster of the hallway's north wall.

title: [Manor House, West Entryway]
description: Moonlight washes over the once-beautiful tiles that cover the floor of the entryway in front of the oak entry door, but the boards beneath have warped, causing the tiles to crack and buckle.  Hallways lead from here to the north and south wings of the house, and a third corridor with several doors off it runs due east.  Pieces of broken wood beneath the window by the entry door are all that remain of a small table and chair.  A curving stairway leads up to an overlooking landing on the second floor.

Once-beautiful tiles cover the floor of the entryway in front of the oak entry door, but the boards beneath have warped, causing the tiles to crack and buckle.  Hallways lead from here to the north and south wings of the house, and a third corridor with several rooms off it runs due east.  Pieces of broken wood beneath the window by the entry door are all that remain of a small table and chair.  A curving stairway leads up to an overlooking landing on the second floor.

title: [Manor House, Sitting Room]
description: Two large armchairs stand near the room's fireplace.  The leather covers of both have been torn off, and the stuffing has been pulled loose and strewn about the room.  Pieces of a broken table lie near the east wall, but the wooden frames of the chairs appear to be intact.  A tanik door is set in the center of the south wall.

title: [Manor House, Dining Room]
description: At one time a long dining table stood in the center of the room...now it lies broken on the floor.  A lone chair rests against the west wall beside a haon door, and a heap of broken dishes lies just inside the room's main doorway.

title: [Manor House, South Wing]
description: Lit only by what moonlight leaks between the boards covering the west-facing windows, the hallway seems dark and confining.  A continuous spiderweb of cracks riddles the plaster of the east wall and several large patches of plaster have fallen from the ceiling.  A pale doorframe carved with vines fills the south end of the corridor, and a maple door is set into the east wall.

Lit only by the light leaking between the boards covering the west-facing windows, the hallway seems dark and confining.  A continuous spiderweb of cracks riddles the plaster of the east wall, and several large patches of plaster have fallen from the ceiling.  An oak doorframe carved with vines fills the south end of the corridor, and a maple door is set into the east wall.

title: [Manor House, North Wing]
description: This corridor is narrow and lit only by what moonlight manages to squeeze in past the boards over the west-facing windows.  The plaster on the walls and ceiling is cracked and coming off in several places, and the floorboards have warped over the years.  Set into the dingy yellow plaster, an ornate maple doorway fills the corridor's northern end, and two doors are set into the east wall.

This corridor is narrow and lit only by what light manages to squeeze in past the boards over the west-facing windows.  The plaster on the walls and ceiling is cracked and coming off in several places, and the floorboards have warped over the years.  Set into the dingy yellow plaster, an ornate maple doorway fills the corridor's northern end, and two doors are set into the east wall.

title: [Manor House, South Parlor]
description: A large fireplace occupies the center of the room's southern wall.  It appears that no fire has been lit in it in some time, since there are small pale mushrooms growing across the hearth.  Aside from the fireplace and its resident fungi the room is empty.  Two boards missing from across one of the room's eastern windows let a fair amount of starlight into the room.

A large fireplace occupies the center of the room's southern wall.  It appears that no fire has been lit in it in some time, since there are small lavender mushrooms growing across the hearth.  Aside from the fireplace and its resident fungi the room is empty.  Two boards missing from across one of the room's eastern windows let a fair amount of sunlight into the room.

title: [Manor House, Servants' Room]
description: The frames of four beds lie broken on the floor, but no sign of the mattresses remains.  Most of the room's ceiling has fallen, leaving bare lathes overhead and chunks of plaster spread across the floor.

title: [Manor House, Wine Cellar]
description: Splintered and broken, bottle racks line the walls, and the shattered pieces of what must have been dozens of bottles cover the floor.  In the center of the cellar is sprawled the face-down skeleton of a giantman, its spine and several of its ribs cleanly severed.  A set of stone steps lead upward along the east wall.

title: [Manor House, Library]
description: Bookshelves line the walls of this room.  Most have been broken and the few that are intact are empty.  A corridor can be seen through an ornate maple doorway in the room's southwest corner.

title: [Manor House, Study]
description: A large wooden writing desk, partially broken and riddled with dry rot, leans against the east wall beneath a boarded-over window.  Scattered about the room, broken drawer fronts and splintered slats are all that remain of the numerous drawers that once filled the desk.  The smashed pieces of what must once have been a harpsichord lie in a heap near the door.

title: [Manor House, Cellar]
description: This room is well lit by torches lining the walls in sconces.  Piles of furs and the shredded pieces of straw mattresses lie about the chamber, evidence that the cellar now serves as sleeping quarters for at least a score of beings.  A table and chairs stand in the center of the room, intact and apparently well used.  Just to the right of an ironbound door, a ladder set into the stone of the south wall leads up to a trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [Manor House, Cellar]
description: This chamber is relatively clean.  A comfortable looking bed stands in the northwest corner of the room, and a single torch in a sconce provides adequate lighting.  Several books are stacked in a corner, but their covers are warped and they appear to be extensively water-damaged.

title: [Outlands Manor, Stable Loft]
description: An uneven layer of hay covers most of the loft, with pale splotches of mold forming a second, less wholesome layer.  Here and there the hay slopes downward into a soft-edged hole where the floor boards have rotted away beneath it, and elsewhere the hay is striped with accumulated pigeon droppings beneath the roof beams.  An old modwir ladder leans against the edge of the loft and provides an easy means of reaching the ground.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Whatever may once have occupied this chamber has long since been removed.  Only an iron trapdoor set into the chamber's floor remains.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: This chamber is fairly large and is still littered with the broken staves and rusted hoops of several large barrels.  Splintered boards from some crates lie against the lead-coated wall of the tower's cistern at the room's western end.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Trampled ashes, scattered pieces of charred cot frames and burnt shreds of mattress ticking cover most of the floor in this chamber.  The layer of soot that covers the ceiling suggests that the contents of the room were piled in the center of it and then set ablaze.  A narrow stone stairway climbs to the second level of the tower along the room's east wall.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Empty weapon racks line the walls of this room, but not a single sword or bow has been left behind.  Only a pair of short bins that look like they might have once held crossbow quarrels remain.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Brownish stains darken the stone floor in this chamber, although a distinct pattern is evident after more than a cursory glance.  Remnants of bloodstained canvas still sheath the broken frames of cots that lie crumpled against the walls, but most of the cloth appears to have been chewed away.  More recent than the stains, narrow cracks and an upward warping of the floor are evident in the center of the room and extend toward the stairway to the first floor along the east wall.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: A large, oil-coated chute constructed of iron plates narrows as it pierces the floor near the chamber's southern wall.  Two stove-in barrels lie in the southeast corner of the room, well away from the shallow brazier built into the floor in the room's center.  Heavy chains dangle from a set of pulleys mounted to the ceiling above the brazier.  A small fireplace is built into the portion of the west wall that backs onto the floor's western chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Dark, but for the light coming through the arrow slits in the west wall, the upright posts of the garrison's bunks -- still bolted tight to the chamber's other three walls -- form pale stripes against the stone.  A small fireplace is built into the portion of the eastern wall that backs onto the floor's center chamber.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: The winch for raising and lowering the tower's portcullis occupies the center of this room.  Several long iron bars protrude from between the gears of the mechanism, obviously jammed into the heart of it to prevent it from working.  Evenly spaced about the floor are a half dozen kill holes opening into the entry chamber below.  Four down-angled arrow slits allow archers to fire into the area of the courtyard just in front of the portcullis.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Littered with the bits and pieces of smashed bins and racks, boxes and casks -- this area at the foot of the stairway to the tower's third level appears to have been used for storing weapons and equipment as well as provisions.  Arrow slits pierce the north wall where the stone stairs allow, letting a small amount of moonlight into the otherwise dark room.

Littered with the bits and pieces of smashed bins and racks, boxes and casks -- this area at the foot of the stairway to the tower's third level appears to have been used for storing weapons and equipment as well as provisions.  Arrow slits pierce the north wall where the stone stairs allow, letting a small amount of sunlight into the otherwise dark room.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Unlike the lower floors of the tower, this level was built with no dividing walls connected to the outer shell, so archers can move easily around the tower's perimeter.  Also, counting reveals that each of the tower's walls visible from here are pierced by ten arrow slits.  A steel-sheathed trapdoor, hinged along the side of the opening where the stairway comes up from the second floor, can be closed to isolate this level from access below and to provide solid footing for the arrow slits above the stairs.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Unwilling to disrupt the symmetrical spacing of the arrow slits along the tower's west wall just to provide access to the tower's roof, the builders constructed a narrow, freestanding set of steps that rise from near the wall of the inner chamber and end little more than a pace from the outer wall.  Empty quarrel bins and an empty barrel, of a size to hold cloth yard shafts, are lined up along the wall between the arrow slits.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: The arrow slits in this chamber face east, towards the Mestanir border and overlooking the eastern hillside where any foreign threat to the manor or the village would be expected.  Surprisingly, the most noticeable feature in this room is the faintly glowing circle drawn in the center of the floor and circumscribed with arcane symbols.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: An empty water barrel, the tin dipper still hanging by its chain, stands in the middle of the floor.  Empty weapon racks and short barrels that must once have held either arrows or quarrels form short lines that radiate from the water barrel.  The arrangement appears to have been constructed to provide ready access to the necessities of defense to defenders from the adjacent rooms.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Several of the arrow slits along the south wall have been broken in and enlarged by strikes from without.  The walls within this chamber also bear numerous scratches, gouges and chipped blocks, indication that fierce fighting has taken place here on at least one occasion.

title: [Vornavis, North Gate]
description: The sounds of the beast pens and other caravan noises to the north echo off the immense blue granite walls that surround Vornavis.  From within the walls come the familiar noises of city life that, in turn, combine with the animal noises to make an odd mix of sounds.  A guard stands at the gate into the city, watching carefully all who enter.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Interior]
description: From here the more permanent buildings lie to the south, close under the city wall.  To the west huddle the semi-permanent canvas-and-timber tents where the caravan hands bunk during their brief stays.  To the northwest the beast pens line the inside of the caravansary's north wall.  The caravansary entrance lies to the east.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Stable]
description: A dilapidated stable leans in on itself, looking more like a good excuse for a fire than any real form of shelter.  A serviceable corral built of oak posts and rails is attached at the west end of the building.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Tent Lane]
description: Foot traffic moves steadily past a trio of tents clustered around a firepit to the south, and a similar set of tents and firepit to the north.

A trio of tents cluster around a firepit to the south, huddling against the considerable activity of a large caravaner's tent to the north.  Several disgruntled-looking yaks are yoked up to hitches at the tent's front, and a constant stream of caravans moves to and from its open-air embrace, filling the area with the squeaking music of wagon wheels.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Interior]
description: From a low, rambling building built next to the North Wall hangs a weathered and faded sign, barely recognizable as a wagon laden with goods.
From a low, rambling building built entirely within the North Wall's shadow hangs a weathered and faded sign, barely recognizable as a wagon laden with goods.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Beast Pen]
description: A chest-high fence made of split modwir timbers forms a pen here, for mules or some other easily contained beasts of burden.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Beast Pen]
description: A beast pen of rusted wrought-iron bars, each set with 6-inch spikes and curving in at the top to end in a spearpoint, stands in the northwest corner of the caravansary.
A beast pen of rusted wrought iron bars, each set with 6-inch spikes and curving in at the top to end in a spearpoint, stands in the northwest corner of the caravansary.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Back Wall]
description: A small shrine stands here, built of stone and easily predating the towering city walls.  The caravansary's low wall passes close behind the shrine, bending westward as if a special effort was made to include it in the grounds.

title: [Ancient Shrine, Entry]
