description: Built of stacked flagstones, it is clear that this  was constructed to symbolically house a place of reverence and not to provide real shelter.  The arched tunnel of the entry is separated from the tiny, domed altar chamber by a burlap curtain, and from the outside by nothing at all.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, The Row]
description: A sprawling building built of rough-cut logs, chinked with mud, and roofed with red tiles stands half-buried beneath the ground here.  The peak of the roof rises to waist level, and a wide timber stairway set into the turf descends to an equally wide doorway.  A wooden sign depicting a cluster of barrels, crates, and grainsacks hangs above the door.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, The Row]
description: Before you stands the only building in the entire caravansary that appears to have been built to last.  The grey slate roof and half-timber construction give this two-story hall a look of permanence.  Hanging above the door, a brightly painted sign of a fully laden wagon indicates that the Mercantylers' Guild is housed here.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Ancient Shrine, Altar]
description: A verdigrised bronze brazier rests atop a roughly-shaped granite altarstone in the center of this small beehive-vaulted chamber.  Fluttering in the drafts that easily find their way through flagstone walls, a brass-bound felwood torch burns brightly in a polished mithril stand to one side.  An oilskin worked with jet and gold beads hangs from a hook beneath the torch.

title: [Caravansary Chandler's Shop]
description: Freestanding shelves, stacked barrels and piles of dry goods all arranged in rows divide the shop into a half dozen aisles where caravaners, adventurers and guildsfolk browse.  A Dark Elven woman whose build resembles more that of an overgrown Halfling than any kind of Elf waits on customers at a counter along the back wall.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, The Row]
description: A large skin-covered wagon stands here with a short set of wooden stairs leading up to its door.  It appears that the wagon has been here for some time, since morning-glories completely hide the wheels beneath a shroud of blossoms and greenery.

title: [Mercantylers' Guild Hall]
description: A large, arched doorway framed in polished monir leads to the interior of the guildhall.  To one side a staircase with an ebony-and-brass banister leads up to the second floor.  An elegantly painted sign resembling a brilliant cut ruby the size of a melon hangs above the foot of the stairs.  A small notice is posted next to the stairs.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Tent Lane]
description: On the north side of the path stands a wagon bearing the sword-and-anvil symbol of the weaponcrafters' guild and the grey cuirass on a blue circle symbol of the armorers' guild side-by-side.  Just to the west the path forks in front of a plank-sided tent and continues to the southwest and the northwest.

title: [Herbalist's Wagon]
description: Large, circular windows filled with a myriad of tiny, leaded panes flood this wagon with moonlight.  The potted plants, perched on anything resembling a flat surface, appear to thrive here.  Only a small space on the counter is kept clear for the transaction of business.

Large, circular windows filled with a myriad of tiny, leaded panes flood this wagon with sunlight.  The potted plants, perched on anything resembling a flat surface, appear to thrive here.  Only a small space on the counter is kept clear for the transaction of business.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, The Row]
description: A drab canvas-roofed shack is tucked between the larger building to the east and a wagon to the west.  A faded, wooden drop of blood the size of a bushel basket hangs above the door.  To the north a footpath threads its way between a couple of caravaners' tents.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Tents]
description: Three large tents are grouped around a large firepit here.  The eastern tent is a dull, reddish-brown color.  The southern tent looks brand new and is made of a bright green canvas.  The western tent is a faded blue color, almost grey.  A tall pole stands near the firepit with a coiled whip affixed to the top of it.  A worn footpath leads south between the green and the blue tents.

title: [Empath's Shack]
description: The mixed odors of medicinal herbs and fresh blood are almost overpowering in here, where a large, bloodstained table stands in the center of the shack.  Fresh straw mercifully covers the floorboards beneath the table, and also partially fills a bucket that rests against one of the table's legs.

title: [Reddish-Brown Caravaners' Tent]
description: A dozen cots are spaced evenly along the tent's walls, six to either side.  The cots appear well-worn but sturdy, and any bedrolls or blankets must come and go with each caravan hand that bunks here.  Wooden pegs are set into the tent's frame between the cots so the caravaners can hang up some of their belongings.

title: [Green Caravaners' Tent]
description: Half-a-dozen pairs of stacked bunks line the walls of this tall tent.  The tent seems unusually roomy as a result, but if you're stuck with a top bunk and don't have faith in the lower bunk's construction, then it is a poor tradeoff.

title: [Mercantylers' Storage Warehouse]
description: This dimly lit room appears to be an entryway which opens out and leads to the south.

title: [Mercantylers' Storage Warehouse]
description: Lanterns light this windowless central chamber, where carved signs resembling small, locked strongboxes point to a curtained alcove and to hallways leading east and south.   A padlocked and barred double door closes off the entire western wing of the building from prying eyes and public access.  The wooden image of a wagon stacked high with lockers hangs above a doorway set in the northwest corner of the chamber.

title: [Storage Warehouse, Hallway]
description: Dimly lit, this hallway runs west to a larger chamber and also turns to the south.  In the north wall is a curtained opening.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Office]
description: A faded threadbare rug covers the floorboards in front of the desk that a half-Elven clerk is seated behind.  Everywhere else, chests and crates stenciled with the letters 'S O L H A V E N' fill the corners and stand in stacks along the walls.

title: [Storage Warehouse, Hallway]
description: To the north the hallway joins the warehouse's central chamber, and beyond a curtained opening in the east wall the hallway turns east.

title: [Storage Warehouse, Hallway]
description: A guttering lantern provides enough light to avoid tripping on the uneven flooring, but the musty odor of mildew and the black-stained boards of the walls give the hallway a close, malevolent feel.  A curtained opening is visible in the west wall.

title: [Storage Warehouse, Hallway]
description: Lit only by what light manages to leak around the corner to the east, this short length of hallway turns north at its eastern end, but otherwise runs west.  A curtained opening is set into the north wall.

title: [Mercantylers' Hall, Landing]
description: The ebony-and-brass banister from the staircase changes to an ebon railing that follows the plaster walls of this small landing.  The railing ends at a plain ebon doorway adorned with a sign carved to resemble a faceted gem.  A small dark hallway leads to the south.

title: [Mercantylers' Hall, Hallway]
description: The white plaster walls are partially paneled in highly polished oak and extend to the east and west.   The warm highlights in the paneling are enhanced by light from brass ship lanterns along either wall.  A pair of carved signs, one pointing east and the other pointing west, hang on the wall opposite the arched doorway.

title: [Mercantylers' Hall, Hallway]
description: The oak paneled hallway ends at a polished monir doorway.  Upon the door is carved a gray pouch empty of any coin.  From inside can be heard the constant scratching of a quill on paper.

title: [Mercantylers' Hall, Hallway]
description: The paneled hallway ends at an oak doorway, above which is a sign in the shape of a bulging pouch of coins.  A tapestry adorns the north wall, showing a fleet of ships, apparently heavy-laden, approaching a sprawling harbor town.  The light from the brass lanterns highlights the rich colors of the tapestry, practically bringing the scene to life before your eyes.

title: [Mercantyler's Debt Collection]
description: The bright moonlight spilling through the south facing window makes this cluttered office appear less crowded.  Shelves filled with dust-covered ledgers cover the walls.  A large oak desk sits in the center of the room.  A thick ledger takes up most of the desk space, along with several quills and bottles of red and black ink.

The bright sun spilling through the south facing window makes this cluttered office appear less crowded.  Shelves filled with dust-covered ledgers cover the walls.  A large oak desk sits in the center of the room.  A thick ledger takes up most of the desk space, along with several quills and bottles of red and black ink.

title: [Mercantylers' Banking Hall]
description: Brasswork at the two tellers' windows gleams brightly in this well-lit hall.  While lacking the fabrics and tapestries that might make the room more comfortable, the polished brass and oak surfaces speak of meticulous care.

title: [Mercantylers' Hall, Dark Hall]
description: The illumination in this small hallway comes only from light reflected from lamps at the landing.  The hallway ends at an aged oaken door.  A sign on the door stating Registrar's Office is just readable in the dim light.

title: [Locksmith, Backroom]
description: The backroom of the locksmith's shop is stark, and lit by a single tallow candle.  A blob of wax secures the candle atop a locked case that provides the only seating in the uncomfortable room.  A tall cabinet secured with a sturdy padlock occupies the far wall.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Thick bushes grow near the path on either side here, making the ground underfoot a bit more stable.  Puddles can be found on the ground to the northwest and southeast, but this section of path rises slightly and is nearly dry.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Croaking frogs and chirping crickets serenade travelers moving through this section of path.  Ferns cling to the earth surrounding nearby trees, forming small islands in the increasingly wet swamp surrounding the road.  Occasional splashes are evidence of unseen life moving about in the bog.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The road crumbles at the edges here, and even the center of the path is soft enough to give underfoot.  Puddles stagnate on the path, creating a foul, oppressive odor that hangs constantly in the still air.  Mosquitoes swarm around travelers as they splash along the path, looking for a bit of exposed flesh for a quick meal.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The trees in this section of the bog have made the ground much more stable, allowing short grasses a chance to grow roots and flourish.  This section of the path looks like a mound rising defiantly out of the swamp, an island of stability in the shifting, murky waters all around.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: To the north, a large mound rises out of the swamp, crowned with short grasses and trees.  Here, the water is very still and stagnant, stinging the nostrils of travelers.  Black birds flit occasionally through the trees, swooping down to the surface of the swamp to catch unwary insects.

To the north, a large mound rises out of the swamp, crowned with short grasses and trees.  Here, the water is very still and stagnant, stinging the nostrils of travelers.  Mosquitoes and fireflies flit occasionally through the trees.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Twisted, gnarled trees fill the swamp with shapes that trick the eye, giving the illusion of a host of creatures standing nearby, peering at the path through the vines and bushes of the swamp.  Large blue flies and dragonflies buzz from plant to plant, crossing the path in a flurry of activity.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The path descends into a depression here, dipping below the surface of the swamp for a short stretch.  Roots of trees and bushes can be felt underfoot but cannot be seen while moving through the murky waters.  Nearby trees have begun to lean inward toward the path, perhaps on the way to a collapse caused by erosion.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Standing water on either side of the path here forms oddly shaped pools around the plants and trees of the bog.  Swells move through the puddles, possibly from snakes swimming just under the surface.  Leaves and small branches float serenely in the still water.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Trees close in on the path here, forming a wooded area that is more dense than in the surrounding swamp.  Vines and mosses hang from the branches of the trees, dipping to the mud of the path and to the surface of the water on either side of the path.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Cattails and tall grasses grow along the edge of the path here to either side.  Dragonflies buzz among the cattails, landing on stalks for a rest.  The blades of the tall grasses are sharp and cut at the unprotected skin of unwary travelers.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Vines hang from the nearby trees, and snakes hang hidden amongst the vines, waiting for unwary travelers to come a bit too close.  Ants climb up the vines in columns, marching to the tops of the trees for the fruits growing high above the swamp.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: To the east, the path slopes sharply upward to crest a small ridge.  To the southwest, the path descends deeper into the thick, humid swamp that stretches out in all directions.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The path crests a ridge here before descending to the west, south, and southeast.  To the west, the swamp is thick and active, with birds flying about the treetops and insects swarming along the water.  To the south and southeast, the plant life has turned brown and gray, as if struggling for life.

The path crests a ridge here before descending to the west, south, and southeast.  To the west, the swamp is thick and active, with insects swarming along the water.  To the south and southeast, the plant life has turned brown and gray, as if struggling for life.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The path rolls downward and dives into the bog to the northwest.  The path becomes wet and soft as large puddles of water gather underfoot.  Plants choke and die from lack of soil in the bog, while the path provides purchase to small, diseased brush.  The root work of the dying plants is probably all that provides any stability to the path.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The trunks of the dead trees in this area are moist from the swamp waters, but the branches are dry and bereft of leaves.  The trees sport stumps and broken branches, but the fallen wood has been swallowed up by the bog.  Gray and brown bushes struggle for life near the path.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The black, brackish water of the swamp approaches the path very closely, making the path muddy and spotted with puddles.  The water is colder here than in other areas of the swamp.  No insects buzz above the stagnant water, giving the area an eerie stillness and silence.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: On either side of the narrow path, steam erupts from bubbles as they break the surface of the cold water.  The steam lingers over the surface of the water, clinging around small bushes and trees that cling to life in the bog.  Large dragonflies buzz across the path while flying from shrub to shrub.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Large bubbles erupt from the surface of the bog here, releasing steams and gases of a variety of colors.  The steams and gasses swirl and mingle, creating the illusion of movement all around the path.  Frogs croak on the mist-covered path, but remain hidden to the eye under the foggy carpet.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Mounds of wet earth rise above the bog not far off the path here.  A variety of snakes and lizards slither from the water onto and over the mounds.  Swarms of gnats rise in a cloud around the bushes as the passing of travelers and small animals brushes the leaves, making them quiver.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: A lone, grass-covered hilltop, crowned by a ring of healthy oak trees, rises high above the bog to the east of the path.  This unlikely hill seems strangely out of place in the decaying bog, and seems pleasant and inviting.  Progress toward the hill is barred, however, as the eastern edge of the path crumbles away underfoot, threatening to dump travelers into the bog.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: The fog rolling over the bog breaks for a stretch along the path here, and the walled city of Vornavis can be seen looming off to the east.  Plumes of smoke from forges and cooking fires within the city rise above the walls.  The fires of the city provide no comfort, but instead serve as reminders of the dampness of the bog and the cold dark nights travelers must face here.

title: [Vornavis, The Bog]
description: Long, rolling inclines elevate the path above the bog here, providing the little remaining life in the bog a chance to cling to soil.  The path is hedged in very tightly on either side by dense copses of sickly thorn bushes and gnarled, bent trees.  Grey leaves, splattered with mud, stretch in futility toward a sun obscured by fogs and mists.

Long, rolling inclines elevate the path above the bog here, providing the little remaining life in the bog a chance to cling to soil.  The path is hedged in very tightly on either side by dense copses of sickly thorn bushes and gnarled, bent trees.  Grey leaves, splattered with mud, stretch in futility toward a night sky obscured by fogs and mists.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The path descends into the fog so deeply that visibility is completely lost.  The fog swirls and bites coldly at exposed flesh.  Any further progress east would be impossible without becoming lost.  The slope upward to the west leads back to the path above the fog.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Puddles of water splash underfoot as the path descends to the east and ascends to the southwest.  Banks rise on either side of the path, clearly indicating that this section of the path is the bed of what was once a stream or small river.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Rocks about the size of pumpkins litter the path here, which appears to have once been a stream bed.  The rocks, unseen beneath the fog, make walking painful and treacherous.  The swirling fog pours downward into a large hole in the ground.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Evergreens poke upward to the canopy of trees above, filling this area with a piney scent.  Pine needles and occasional pine cones crunch underfoot, unseen beneath the carpet of fog.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The fog seems to permeate everything here, making clothing damp and skin moist.  The fog, combined with the drop in temperature, makes the cold nearly unbearable.  The fog swirls about continually, despite the lack of breeze.

title: [Captain's Rest, Landing]
description: The well-worn oaken stairs open out to a green carpeted hall leading to rooms to the east and west.  A spiral staircase continues up toward the roof.  The sound of conversation from the common room downstairs drifts up the stairs.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: A large cliff face borders the south of the path here.  The rock of the cliff is crumbling, leaving a litter of broken stone on the path underfoot.  Clattering rocks rain down from above regularly, making this a bad place to stand and talk.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The ground of the path turns to shattered stone here, poking sharply up from the ground.  Footing is difficult on the shifting, sliding rocks.  Clattering stones can be heard to the west.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: The path turns sharply here to the northwest and the southwest.  A babbling stream can be heard but not seen to the east.  Occasional splashes in the water could be small animals finding a drink, or could be something else.

title: [Warrens]
description: Large gnarled roots run along the walls and roof of this tunnelway, likely the only support for the soft earth forming this passage.  Dim light peeking through a jagged hole overhead is managing to provide a bit of illumination for this otherwise darkened lair.  Curious grunts echo from all about, the sound magnified by the claustrophobic terrain.

title: [Warrens]
description: A large but badly flawed quartz crystal embedded into the ceiling catches the torchlight and glitters with an eerie reddish glow.  Thousands of other tiny minerals trapped in the walls catch the light as well and they form the illusion of an underground evening sky.  If the stench of molding plants and moist earth wasn't so strong, this might be a very romantic spot.

title: [Warrens]
description: The rough texture of the passage appears to have been dug by hand or claw and looks to have been quite a job.  A mass of plantlike tendrils hanging from the top of the passage partially cover a flat stone that has been pushed into the wall.  The face of the stone is completely marred by scratches and marks.

title: [Warrens]
description: A large tree stump has been dragged into this room and evidently serves as a crude table.  The uncomfortable looking piles of straw near the table appear to be the seating arrangements for this dining area and serve as both chairs and trash cans based on the various bits of food that can be seen sticking out from them.

title: [Warrens]
description: From the god-awful stench is this room, it's clear that this is a refuse dump.  Trash fills the entire room and it's impossible to avoid the disgusting garbage littering the floor.  Only a kobold could remain here for any period of time without running for air.

title: [Warrens]
description: With no landmarks or features to help navigate this passage, it appears the nature of the tunnel is to both confuse and baffle any unwelcome visitors.  Odd footprints lead off in both directions, their shape appearing manlike but much smaller than most.

title: [Warrens]
description: A dented iron cauldron resting upon a crude firepit constructed of smooth round stones seems to be the lone cooking utensil in the room.  The pot is heavily stained from constant use and a few bits of food stubbornly cling to the outside of the metal.  Several coarse baskets filled with grain have been stored near the stove, but one look at the feasting weevils gives evidence that freshness is not an issue for whoever prepares the meals of this burrow.

title: [Warrens]
description: Several large roots have been torn from the walls and are now being used to suspend wooden buckets from the ground.  Each of the containers is filled with brackish water, one of them with a rusted iron ladle hanging from its rim.  A tiny spring is bubbling softly in one corner, evidently the watering hole for the inhabitants of this warren.

title: [Warrens]
description: Several rolton carcasses are hanging from the ceiling, most likely tommorow's dinner for the Fenghai that live in this lair.  The hides have been removed and stretched across several large stones to dry and a look at the ragged edges of the skins show that whatever tool was used to skin these beasts was far from sharp.

title: [Warrens]
description: Two crude wooden spears have been crossed at the tips and form an odd portal that guards the northeastern passageway.  Hanging directly above the weapons is a yellowed skull of unknown origin.  It has been affixed to a rusting chain and placed so that the eye sockets are staring directly outward.

title: [Warrens]
description: A deep rumble can be heard reverberating about the burrow, sounding almost as if it were coming from within the walls.  It's hard to determine exactly what might cause such a noise, but judging from the rhythm of the sound, it clearly isn't natural.

title: [Warrens]
description: A few gigantic mushrooms have sprouted along the ceiling, and from their immense size, it's apparent that the climate of the warrens is contributing greatly to their growth.  A faint glow emanates from several of the mushrooms, evidently an odd side effect of a thick green moss that has attached itself to them in parasitic fashion.

title: [Warrens]
description: Thick ropelike roots protruding from the walls have been hacked away to allow further passage in both directions.  Most of the underground tendrils are brown and dried, but a few still ooze a sticky brownish sap.  Trapped within the syrupy fluid are numerous tiny insects, this meal evidently their last.

title: [Warrens]
description: There is an odd barking sound echoing along the walls, but the source of the noise is nowhere to be seen.  A look in any direction reveals nothing but identical passages, the twisting nature of the tunnels further confusing all attempts to gain a bearing.

title: [Warrens]
description: A steadily burning torch along one wall is providing the light source for the odd shadows that are dancing along the floor of this passageway.  While the air is stagnant and breezeless, the flickering of the flame is causing the shadows to waver to and fro in a mesmerizing fashion.

title: [Warrens]
description: A mound of dirt and rocks reveal that the underground burrow might not be completely stable.  The path has been somewhat cleared to allow passage, but soil continues to shake loose from above at every tiny sound. It's only a matter of time before the passage is once again blocked.

title: [Warrens]
description: A carpet of tangled roots has been placed over a small hole evidently in a feeble attempt to camouflage its existence.  The dim glow of torchlight peeking out from beneath the jumble of plants is further proof of the existence of a lower level below this room.

title: [Warrens]
description: A few jagged divots have been clawed into the wall to allow easier access to the gaping opening above, and a gnarled root hanging near the hole serves as a handhold to further ease the climb.  As skinny as the plantlike tendril is, it doesn't appear is if it could support much weight.  Several other roots tumble to the floor in a twisted mass.

title: [Warrens]
description: A jumbled mass of roots that are dangling from the ceiling has been turned into a crude hammock.  It's evident that somebody has used it recently as well, as tufts of brown fur have gotten caught on some of the rough edges.

title: [Warrens]
description: Several colorful baskets of woven straw have been hung onto the walls and add a bit of decoration to this humble room.  A cot covered with the soft hide of some animal has been elevated off the ground by ropelike roots and looks to be quite comfortable despite the simplicity of its design.

title: [Warrens]
description: Large niches dug into the earthen walls and filled with heaps of coarse straw would appear to serve as a crude sleeping area for the inhabitants of this warren.  Small insects scurry within the dried bedding, darting into one of the many cracks or crevices at even the slightest disturbance.

title: [Warrens]
description: A tiny cove has been created in one corner and a few bits of tattered cloth have been laid out to provide a bit more comfort than the unforgiving dirt is willing to provide.  An old raggedy doll has been propped up against one wall, perhaps the keepsake of some Fenghai infant.

title: [Warrens]
description: Several large piles of pelts and hides have been placed along the walls and are stacked to the ceiling.  A small ledge holds a few simple bone tools that would appear to be used to stitch and cut the leather to a more useful form.

title: [Warrens]
description: Odd shuffling sounds seem to come from both sides of this passage, but their source is unseen.  A large root dangles from above, and a thick sap is slowly oozing out from the exposed tuber.  Several tooth marks on the root show that something has made a habit of chewing on the thing.

title: [Warrens]
description: The earthen ceiling is badly saturated from some unknown source of water and this is causing the run-off to splatter to the floor in large droplets.  The excess liquid on the ground has made the floor muddy and difficult to walk on, although a few small footprints lend evidence that others have passed this way.

title: [Warrens]
description: It appears that the inhabitants of the warren were attempting to create another tunnel, but a huge chunk of stone clearly ended any attempts to dig further.  The surface of the partially buried boulder glitters in the dim light from numerous crystalline growths covering its surface.

title: [Warrens]
description: A few simple baskets filled with an assortment of nuts and dried fruits are resting near a large flattened stone.  A fine ivory dust covers the surface of the rock, and it looks as if it might be used for food preparation.  A small alcove dug into the wall holds several clay bowls, each containing a thick unidentifiable paste.  A stack of large broad leaves is also stored within this alcove, their purpose unknown.

title: [Warrens]
description: A massive gaping hole along one wall has been crudely boarded up with old planks and an assortment of twisted branches.  At the foot of this barrier lies a immense worm whose decaying form is covered with numerous puncture marks.  Several deep stains along the wall and ground, along with some tattered cloth reveal that the oversized bug did not go out quietly.

title: [Warrens]
description: A rotted monir chest has been tipped over in one corner and is completely empty of any contents.  The lock appears to have been smashed open by the force of some blunt object and whatever valuables this box might have contained are long gone.

title: [Warrens]
description: A massive piece of slate has been propped up so that it leans against one wall, the surface of the stone completely covered with glyphs.  Crude wax candles have been placed in a perfect semi-circle about this tablet and a few of them show signs of having been lit recently.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: All sounds, save the footfalls of travelers, fall away along this dark stretch of path.  The end of a rope dangles out of reach, suspended from the branch of a tall oak tree here.  The rope is very thick, and has been cut clean through at the end.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A pool of black water collects here at the low point of this huge valley.  All around, hills rise leading out of this area.  The path is somewhat flat to the north, but a steep incline rises to the south.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A huge, flat rock here provides a good place to rest from the slipping and sliding required to travel this section of path along this steep incline.  The path ascends to the southeast, and descends to the north.

title: [Shrine of Suffering]
description: Wide, polished columns of deep black marble ascend toward the ceiling, a contrast to the pure white walls of the chamber.  Set between the low pillars is an altar of flawless ivory, elaborately inlaid with bloodjewels and a base twined with thorny, carved brambles.  Overlooking the altar, a statue of a young man with his arms stretched above his head, casts a slight shadow across the room.

title: [Andelas' Temple, Main Chamber]
description: A pair of polished jet statues stand to either side of a massive, cloth-of-gold cushion lying unoccupied at the top of the high dais.  Similar in physical magnitude, one statue is an oversized representation of a sleek-coated housecat, while the other is a sabertoothed tiger resplendent with golden canines.  Both are adorned with gold tiaras, torcs and earrings, although the smaller statue's jewelry is set with primarily red gemstones, while the tiger's jewelry is set with a variety of blue stones.

title: [Hall of the Hunters]
description: A thin rug of vivid crimson spreads across the cold black marble of this hall, and the walls are carved with detailed images of large felines waiting patiently in ambush.  Golden claw-topped columns tower above, the structures casting long shadows that waver with the faintest flicker of torchlight.  An uneasy silence permeates the area, and the very air seems charged with tension.

title: [Hall of the Feline]
description: Dark red silk cushions trimmed in velvet are placed atop neatly-ascending ledges along the opposing walls, the small steps rising nearly to the ceiling.  Painted high overhead are numerous stylized images of sleek housecats, some in repose and others simply standing there regarding everything below in a ponderous fashion.  The dim amber glow from excess candles placed throughout the room imparts a relaxing, lazy atmosphere to the surroundings.

title: [Chamber of Convergence]
description: Dark ebonwood doors are set into the southern walls, their surfaces engraved with arcing crimson designs.  Images of felines grace the surroundings nearly everywhere -- from the subtle carvings upon the columns marking the northern hall to the huge, elaborate murals upon the wall.  A faceted ruby brazier is set in the middle of the room.  Wispy grey tendrils of smoke rise from it casting a faint, odd scent to the air.

title: [Hall of the Claw]
description: Dark marble columns ascend toward the arched ceiling, their golden capitals formed into the shape of large, spread claws.  Crossed slashes form a ragged, interlinked pattern across the walls, the gouges in the marble quite deep.  A simple velvet rug of crimson leads further north toward a dark, circular chamber.

title: [Hall of the Claw]
description: An elaborate inlay of an onyx cat's head graces the mottled crimson marble of the floor, its circular design mirrored in the shape of the chamber.  The room is ringed by nine huge feline statues reclining upon unadorned slabs, their golden eyes staring eternally at one another.  A weathered black monolith is set in the precise center of the floor.  Silver script is written upon it, distorted by the wavering amber glow of the numerous torches above.

title: [Hall of the Claw, Altar]
description: A massive onyx statue of a reclining feline dominates the entire room, its huge jaws open in a yawn revealing curved ivory teeth.  The dark panther is stretched out languidly before you, its front paws reaching along both sides of the room in a lazy embrace, claws extended.  A simple altar draped with deep red silk is set before the cat's unblinking, intensely focused gaze, an open book lying upon its surface.

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen, Booth]
description: A stylized iron porthole marks the circular window that allows one to gaze out at the bright, churning sea.  A small table decorated with carven images of numerous underwater creatures adds to the coziness of the slightly small space, and the dark benches on either side of the booth further add to the intimate ambiance.  A single brass oil lamp sits near the window, its dim light overpowered by the sunlight streaming in.

A stylized iron porthole marks the circular window that allows one to gaze out at the dark, moonlit sea.  A small table decorated with carven images of numerous underwater creatures adds to the coziness of the slightly small space, and the dark benches on either side of the booth further add to the intimate ambiance.  A single brass oil lamp sits near the window, its dim light softly illuminating the dark surroundings.

title: [Captain's Rest, Garret]
description: Two small round windows streaked on the outside with dried salt shed dim light on a spiral staircase leading down into the Rest.  A small bird's nest sits up in the rafters.  A weathered haon door leads out to the Captain's Walk.

title: [Treeva's Outfitting]
[Treeva's General Store]
[Treeva's Weaponry]
description: A framed Ta'Illistim map hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls, and a sturdy white cedar ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a cream-colored ceramic tile floor.  There is a long mahogany rack on one side of the shop and a wide faenor-trimmed table on the other.

Enclosed by painted emerald green walls, the shop features a grey-veined white marble fountain in the center of its ceramic tile floor.  A framed Ta'Illistim map hangs under the white cedar ceiling.  Right near the front is a wide faenor-trimmed table and a long mahogany rack.

title: [Captain's Rest, Captain's Walk]
description: A white painted rail runs around a narrow walkway that extends along the roof of the Rest.  A wonderful view of the entire bay and its busy wharves is available from here.  To the north, the Market Bridge crosses the bay toward Marshtown.  Just to the southwest the North Haven and Charl's Piers jut out into the bay.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: The floor of the warehouse creaks and groans underfoot.  A thin layer of dust coats everything, and packing straw collects in almost every corner, nook, and crack.  The boxes and crates part to allow passage to the east, north, and west from here.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Sulien's Outfitting]
[Sulien's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a scuffed pine floor.  There is a wide knotted oak counter on one side of the shop.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: Several small boxes have been turned on end here and placed around a slightly taller box.  This appears to be where some warehouse workers take their lunch, or maybe play an occasional game of cards.  The boxes have been pushed aside clearing paths east and south.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the south and east.

title: [Queen's Ransom]
description: Beneath a silk-draped ceiling with a twinkling chandelier, a series of platinum sconces hangs on one of the exquisitely muralled walls.  A circular cut-glass display and a crystalline counter sit in opposite corners while a stunning crystal statue rests on a lustrous cream marble floor.

title: [Kiyya's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A small brown box and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a weathered cobblestone floor.

title: [Larien's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Jedhan's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: Shredded scrolls have been scattered about like a heavy snowfall, piling against the walls in drifts and fluttering in the breeze that comes in from the east.  The walls themselves waver in the wind, pressed and pulled by the trees outside.  While interesting to look at, the instability hardly inspires confidence in the remaining lifespan of the architecture.

title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
description: Golden glass covers everything, creating the illusion of inclusions in amber.  Beneath the glimmering surface are books, scrolls and other containers for knowledge, trapped for all time by the razored shards.  A large branch grows through the hole where the window once sat, raining pine needles down over the room.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: A block of grey stone is half buried in the soft earth, set in a crater as if it had fallen from some height.  To the east another part of the wall it fell from still stands, riddled with breaks and crevices.  The fog curls back from the structure's surface, as if loathe to touch the ruined building.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: A dense copse of trees stands to the southeast, nearly impassable but not quite.  Beneath a fine layer of dark dirt is river sand, peppered with polished stones and the dried corpses of water plants.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: A huge patch of toadstools once stood here, in the shadow of the small hillock to the southwest.  Some creature has knocked them all down, however, crushing them into the soft dirt in a fit of pique.  Claw marks scar the trees, scabbed over by bits of crusty yellow sap.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: Silence hangs heavy in the air, as if all of nature held its breath.  Even the mists are still, stagnating around the thorny plants and sky-reaching pines.  A current of tension coils about the trees, as if two great but unseen armies watched each other across a wooded battleground, merely waiting for the general's signal before exploding into violence.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: The corpse of some small mammal lies mangled on the soft earth.  The body is oddly dessicated, and seems to have decayed one part at a time, instead of all at once.  The fur, once soft and plush, is rough and dry, as if all moisture and essence had been pulled forcibly from it.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: Something with sharp claws has wounded one of the trees, ripping the protective bark from the tree's grainy flesh.  From the gashes pours thick amber sap, running down the trunk as if the tree bled.  Several insects have been trapped in the substance, sacrificing themselves as fascinating pieces of amber in the making.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: An immense branch lies broken on the ground.  Through the hole in the canopy of trees its fall created shines sunlight, perhaps the only patch of it in the entire forest.  Its warmth dispells the cool mist, and small white flowers grow from the rich brown earth, basking in the light.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: Bramble bushes and tall pine trees pull stone from the ruined temple to the north, as if seeking to tear it down.  Fog swirls about, curling up the treetrunks and hissing softly through the underbrush but refusing to touch the temple itself.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: The thorn bushes grow thicker to the east, shredding cloth and flesh with equal voracity.  The mighty pines fight the brush for space, leaving hardly any room to stand, let alone walk, uninjured.  Furry moss creeps up the trees, unable to find another space in which to live.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: Twigs and other bits of thorn bush stick out over the top of the tall fogbank, giving you almost no warning as to the positions of the sharp bracken.  Trees stretch toward the unseen sky, covered in slick green moss, and a soft breeze caresses you, giving you goosebumps.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: The trees, brambles and fog all conspire to lose you within the forest, making visibility uncertain at best.  Any movement becomes a shambling stagger, more controlled tripping than a true walk as the bushes seem to reach out to purposely snare you.  Brambles obscure a crumbling section of the temple wall.

title: [Bank of Vornavis, Solhaven]
description: Dark panelled walls rise above you, culminating in a carved coffered ceiling.  The plush burgundy carpets are silent underfoot.  Merchants and townsfolk mill about, speaking in hushed, reverent whispers.  Three teller windows are open, the quiet clink of coins drifting from within.

title: [The North 'Haven Pawnery]
description: A middle-aged man wearing a bushy salt-and-pepper beard and a sour expression stands behind a modwir counter that bears the rounded edges and marring of a thousand transactions.  The cracked and yellowed plaster walls, dilapidated counter and the appearance of the proprietor suggest a distinctly Dwarven influence, if not lineage.

title: [The North 'Haven Pawnery]
description: Boxes, crates, sea chests, and bulging canvas sacks are piled throughout the pawnshop in great, teetering stacks, leaving only narrow avenues between the tables of wares.  Two windows high on the plaster walls allow daylight to peek between the stacks, supplementing two small oil lanterns fixed on stout beams over the tables.

Boxes, crates, sea chests, and bulging canvas sacks are piled throughout the pawnshop in great, teetering stacks, leaving only narrow avenues between the tables of wares.  Four small oil lanterns fixed on stout beams over the tables provide illumination.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Main Hall]
description: Royal blue wall hangings and marble sheathed walls lend an air of elegance to the main hall of the Inn.  Black, white, and rose marble is placed in an elaborate pattern covering the floor.  Several vultite inlaid modwir tables are ranged around the edge of the room, each with a pair of heavy carved modwir chairs in attendance.  The centerpiece of the room is an immense crystal and candle chandelier, which sends sparks of soft light throughout the room.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Front Desk]
description: A highly-polished black marble counter runs along one wall, flanked by two large brass urns, each planted with a flowering tree heavy with red and white blossoms unlike anything ever seen in nature before.  The white marble tiled floor reflects the light from the brass and crystal wall-mounted lamps, giving off just enough illumination to sign the registration book.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Taproom]
description: A highly polished modwir bar runs the length of the room with several stools in front of it.  Brass and crystal wall sconces lend some light to the otherwise dim room.  The wall behind the bar is mirrored, which reflects the myriad bottles of every shape, size, and color that are on the shelf in front of it.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Dining Room]
description: White tablecloths and vultite tableware grace the tables in this room.  Surrounding each table are comfortable chairs padded in royal blue.  Brass and crystal lamps hang from the ceiling shedding light on the tables and diners below.  Impeccably dressed waiters bustle around taking care of the diners' every need.

title: [The Tentacled Tavern, Barroom]
description: This octagon-shaped room is paneled with polished modwir.  Above the eight-sided bar, racks are meticulously lined with polished glasses and imported liqueurs.  Several merchants stand nearby, engaged in quiet conversation.

title: [The Tentacled Tavern, Lounge]
description: Wall sconces made of candlelit conch shells cast a warm glow across this room.  Fishnets, strung with starfish and other seashells, decorate the modwir-paneled walls.  High half-walls surround each table, allowing the occupants conversational privacy.

title: [Kahlyr's Precious Gems]
description: Everything in this small shop gleams softly in the candlelight flickering from a crystal chandelier hanging overhead.  A row of glaes-paned cases lines one wall, the first holding a collection of gems and the second displaying a diamond necklet.  A carved wooden counter rests opposite.  A carpeted stairway leads up to the second floor of the shop.

title: [Kahlyr's Precious Gems]
description: Glaes-topped wrought iron tables line the dark mahogany walls of this narrow room.  A deep scarlet carpet runs the length of the room, framed in by dark fel floor molding which has been embossed with repeating diamond shapes.  An intricately latticed, arched window faces the entrance from the opposite wall.

title: [Kahlyr's Precious Gems]
description: A pure white snowflake against a jet black background covers the floor within the semicircle formed by the three display cases in this upper chamber.  The central display case is flanked on the right and left by two glaes-paned display cases that enclose the room.  The tight woolen pile of the carpet absorbs the sound of footsteps and creates a sense of inherent luxury.  A carpeted stairway leads down to the first floor.

title: [Sargassa's, Front Room]
description: This bright, sunny room smells strongly of dried herbs and flowers.  Long shelves hold rows of glaes-blown bottles and small wooden herb boxes.  A young half-elven girl whistles to herself as she busily stocks the shelves.

title: [Sargassa's, Infirmary]
description: Cots covered in soft blankets line the walls of this cozy, darkened room.  A merry fire dances in a small fireplace opposite the door.  From an iron pot dangling over the fire, a foul-smelling concoction bubbles over.  An ancient-looking elven woman bustles about, herbs bursting from her apron pockets and bandages dangling from her arms.

title: [Slim Jyhm's]
description: An eight-paned glaes window in the front of the shop makes this undoubtedly the best lit shop in all of Marshtown.  A leather topped counter separates the locksmith, his workbench and impressive array of lockpicking tools from the area where customers stand.

title: [Slim Jyhm's, Picks 'n Such]
description: Narrow and windowless, this room isn't much more than a closet.  A lantern hangs low over the single showcase and an attentive half-elven fellow stands behind it, offering information and prices to those that ask.

title: [Delta Dessication & Rendering]
description: The walkway turns abruptly southeast from here, while striking due west toward a large hill.  The buildings here sport signs reading "Jag Hill" and have shining steel numbers attached.  This section of town seems very well kept when compared with the rest of the sprawl.  A dark, narrow alley leads due south between two taller buildings.  Denuded of its mane by the elements, the skin of a cragviper is stretched on a tanning frame that hangs above a doorway just inside the alley.

An assortment of meat cleavers, bone saws and fang-jawed pincers hanging on the back wall, and the stained butcher block counter that Yonno Rundig is leaning on give this shop an unwholesome air.  Of course the odor of rotting flesh that permeates the room might also have something to do with it.

title: [Marshtown, Bog Alley]
description: The buildings along this section of walkway are so close together that two people cannot walk abreast.  The proximity of the buildings blocks out the light, making the alley seem dark even at high noon.  Barrels of refuse and empty crates litter the alley, providing good hiding spots for derelicts and rogues alike.  Almost lost in the shadows is a door painted a dull, lifeless black.

title: [Marshtown, Bog Alley]
description: The dead end of this dark and quiet alley is practically a refuse pit.  The only sound is the creaking of the barrels underfoot as the current sways them gently.  While no rotting garbage is included amongst the offal, all other manners of debris can be found.  Boxes, crates, broken barrels, broken carts, discarded horseshoes, and many other manners of items clutter the walkway.  Only a mildewed door, with the letters - B A B S - scrawled across it in dried mud, is clear of debris.

title: [Onion Dome Chamber]
description: The flaring curves of five vertical fel beams give this chamber its shape -- tapering to meet overhead in a sky-reaching point.  A myriad of horizontal fel boards has been expertly fitted to the beams and sanded to give the dome its smooth outer skin.  Radiating outward to each of the five beams, a spiderweb of brass wire is inlaid in the fel floorboards of the chamber.  At the center of the pattern, a polished blue sphere rests atop a rune-engraved brass column inlaid with a tiny plinite chip.
