title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: Booths and stands have been set up along this section of the boardwalk.  Teams of merchants hawk fish and produce to travelers as they pass by from the docks on their way into town.  Clusters of people gather around each of the stands watching the merchants and customers haggle over prices.

title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: The boardwalk widens at this point to a circular-shaped gathering area, almost a town square.  Many folks loiter about on the docks or on benches, watching the ships and sailors at their work.  To the northwest sits a chandler's shop, the center of most of the commotion in the area.  Supplies are brought in and out of the building almost constantly.

The boardwalk widens at this point to a circular-shaped gathering area, almost a town square.  Many folks loiter about on the docks or on wooden benches, watching the ships and sailors at their work.  To the northwest sits a chandler's shop, the center of most of the commotion in the area.  Supplies are brought in and out of the building almost constantly.

title: [Marshtown, Haycribs]
description: The scent of drying marshgrass hangs heavy in the air, one of the four tall haycribs that take up this platform looking newly-filled.  Evidently filled in a regular order, the haycribs overflow with marshgrass that ranges from dark green through a pale golden-brown.  A half dozen square-prowed johnboats are moored to the platform's sides.

title: [Marshtown, Shoreline]
description: The planks on this section of the huge barrel-raft of the town are unusually thick and well maintained.  This may be due to the large pier to the south.  A number of larger ships dock there, and crewmen busy themselves moving barrels and crates from ship to shore and shore to ship.  The majority of Marshtown lies to the northeast.

title: [Glarstim Cavern, Playground]
description: Enclosed by numerous stout stalagmites, a little playground has been constructed for the smallest residents of Glarstim Cavern.  Children gleefully slide down the back of a giant metal snail while their parents watch from a ring of tables and benches carved from salt rock.  Other children find amusement on a pair of seesaws, swings, or climbing atop a massive cube strewn with holes.
tags: meta:mapname:Neighborhood of Elven Nations and Solhaven

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: Giant potted toadstools reflect off the dark waters of a canal in wavering streaks of blue and white.  The rivulet runs toward the cavern wall, disappearing beneath a platform of reinforced steel.  A tiny island, barely more than a rock, houses a life-like statue of a stoic dwarven miner wielding an invar pick.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: Crystals of salt glimmer beautifully within the cavern, illuminated in soft hues of white and blue by toadstools as tall as trees.  A pair of the luminescent fungi flank the entrance of a glistening salt bridge that crosses a dark canal on the north side of the brine lake.  The soft murmur of wind echoes through the stalactites, though there is no tangible breeze.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: A cool dampness lingers in throughout the massive cavern around the calm brine lake.  Crossing over a slender canal cutting through the northern bank is a glistening salt bridge.  Stalagmites lining the waterway have been skillfully carved into sparkling grey trees, strung with silver garlands.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: A smooth granite bench overlooks the peaceful waters of the brine lake, flanked by glimmering salt rock trees.  Luminescent toadstools line the large walkway that mirrors every curve of the lake's edge, interrupted only by the slender paths that lead to residents' homes.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: A pair of dwarven boys casually skip pebbles onto the lake, cheering themselves on with every bounce.  Exquisite salt facades have been carved into the cave walls, resembling the splendid mansions of the surface world.  A pair of invar-wrought doves perch atop the eaves of one particular home.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: Dwarven couples stroll quietly along the lakefront, admiring the splendid homes and their wonderful view.  A peculiar garden crafted from glittering salt rock boasts larger than life flowers -- roses, daisies, and tulips that stand to the average dwarf's waist.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: Cool, damp air lingers with the taste of salt, imbued by the mineral rocks of the floor, walls, and ceiling.  This small cave opens up into a much larger cavern which is home to a dark brine lake, frequented by boaters and fishermen.  A steel-braced archway leads toward the main arteries of Zul Logoth.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: Along this quiet bend of the cavern, pinpoints of light are visible through the glass windows inset in the elegant facades of residents' homes.  Stone-lined paths break away from the main lake trail, leading to each polished front door.  Several tired-looking dwarves trudge past, on their way to a well-deserved rest.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: On the edge of the lake, a magnificent salt rock fountain has been constructed.  Cool water flows over six tiers of glittering mushrooms, flowing into the dark lake.  A tiny granite bird rests at the top of the fountain, with wing upraised as if splashing.

title: [Glarstim Cavern]
description: A dwarven groundskeeper carefully inspects the condition of the luminescent toadstools that line the lake.  Taking samples of the humus from the large stone pots, he occasionally pauses from his work to wave at the locals as they go about their business.

title: [Glarstim Cavern, Dock]
description: Wavering reflections of luminescent toadstools play across the lake's glassy surface like many moons in the night sky.  A natural jetty glimmers in the ambient light, where a small shack has been carved out of the salt rock.

title: [Glarstim Cavern, Shack]
description: An assortment of fishing equipment is prominently displayed on the glimmering racks that are carved right out of the shack's walls.  Miniature potted toadstools illuminate the cozy space with variable hues of soft white, blue, and peach.  Tacked onto a hanging bulletin board are the names of fishermen with descriptions of their prize catches.

title: [Zul Logoth, Emerald Tunnel]
description: Two attractive residential houses line the tunnel.  They are not quite 'houses,' though, but rather excellent depictions painted on the walls and timbers of the tunnel itself.  The only part that actually exists on most of the houses is the door.  A brownstone manor with a striped door painted in brilliant yellows and reds occupies the west wall, while a cozy ranch home with a faux-wood door spreads out along the east wall.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Emerald Tunnel]
description: One house mural lines each wall along the tunnel.  A light blue cottage with white trim nestles against the east well, its eaves fluted and its edges covered in white scrollwork.  A brilliant white door allows entrance.  On the opposite wall the impressive black granite stones of a stately manor rise for one story.  The 'windows' of the manor provide static glimpses of the interior that is accessible through the carved door.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Emerald Tunnel]
description: The developers of this section of tunnel have attempted to render it as rustic and outdoorsy as possible.  Massive pine trees, skillfully painted on the walls, thrust up to the ceiling overhead.  A giant toadstool, growing in a large stone pot, enhances the scene by bathing the ceiling and upper walls in an emerald light.  On the north wall, a log home nestles behind the pine tree screen.  A painted fawn shyly peers around the corner of the house, as if examining the interlopers with curiosity.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Emerald Tunnel]
description: A tunnel looms to the north, dark and foreboding.  The approach to the tunnel does not make it any less foreboding.  From the dust outlines in the floor, it seems that many of the pots and toadstools have been removed from this area.  The reason is unclear, but the section is quite dim, with the majority of the light located to the southeast.  Even under the low light conditions, it is apparent that stains the color of dried blood mar the floor just this side of the tunnel's entrance.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Mraent Cavern, Entrance Tunnel]
description: A low, dark shaft leads down into the heart of the mountains.  A number of large stone blocks have been placed to discourage progress down the tunnel.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Entrance Tunnel]
description: A small oil lamp casts a feeble light onto this part of the tunnel.  The walls and floor have been polished, creating a sharp contrast with the ceiling, which still bears the mark of the tools that delved into the stone.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Entrance Tunnel]
description: The stone through which the tunnel passes changes suddenly to granite.  Right at the transition line, a twisted pickaxe is lodged in the wall, which glistens with moisture condensed out of the chill subterranean air.

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Exterior]
description: The tunnel opens out into a large, open, hemispherical space.  Extending from the wall is a building facade with the words "Mraent Granite Quarry" carved above a rounded archway.  A heavy iron door, smashed by some tremendous blow, hangs precariously from its hinges, no longer securing the hallway that leads deep into the darkness beyond.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Loading Dock]
description: A wooden platform contains blocks of marble cut in various shapes and sizes.  A block and tackle system used for moving the heavy stone remains set into the ceiling, though there is no sign of any rope.  Some rail ties have been twisted around a tall pillar of black granite, which appears to have been damaged by the mining cart that lies smashed nearby.  Two rows of holes drilled into the granite floor lead away from the pillar into the low, dark tunnel to the east.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
description: A long tunnel runs straight and level through the heart of the mountain.  Steel pins and brackets are scattered on the floor, the only evidence that the quarry's rail system once ran though here.  Directional signals are scratched into the marble walls at regular intervals to prevent the workers from becoming disoriented in the darkness.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
description: It appears that a pitched battle took place in this part of the tunnel.  Arms and armor, broken almost into its constitutive metals, lie scattered about the floor.  A large piece of torn-up rail has been lodged into the granite just at the height of a dwarf's chest.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
description: Sound begins to echo as the tunnel approaches the first of the marble quarries.  Several mining carts, smashed beyond use or repair, lie on the ground alongside the track way.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Main Quarry]
description: This enormous space was opened out of the mountain by the work of the stonecutters.  Flatbed rail cars loaded with granite lie on a small portion of intact railway, while various hammers, chisels, and other tools sit in steel buckets nearby.  An enormous sculpture fills the center of the room.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Dodecahedron]
description: Black marble has been polished to a mirror shine in this distinctive room, which appears more like the work of a jeweler than an architect.  Five pentagonal walls surround a thick, rope-like vein of silvery mithril that runs diagonally from the ceiling into the floor below.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Octahedron]
description: This room consists of eight walls, each a perfect triangle--except that a level floor prevents the lower walls from reaching a point.  The presence of pink marble lends a distinctive hue to the space, highlighted by the variation of polished and rough-cut walls.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Pentagonal Prism]
description: Five walls, each a perfect square, enclose this distinctive space.  A large phenocryst emerges from the floor, refracting the low light into an array of colors against the polished grey marble walls.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Tetrahedron]
description: Designed to show off the stonecutters' skill and the natural beauty of the granite, this room resembles the center of a pyramid with three triangular walls sloping to meet at a point overhead.  The stonecutters left the grey marble rough, polishing only the corners in order to accentuate the distinctive shape of the room.  A small vein of iron ore lies exposed in the floor, its surface beginning to rust in the damp air.

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Reception]
description: This large open hall once welcomed visitors and workers alike, though from its current state it appears that no guests have been received in quite some time.  Damp, dark, and uninviting, the room is completely empty of furnishings.  A number of vaulted archways lead into other sections of the lodge.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Office]
description: A low stone table, now cracked down the middle, lies on the floor in the middle of the room.  The black granite walls are covered with chalk markings, grown faint over time from the moisture that drips from the ceiling.  The acrid smell of mildew rises from several canvas bags rotting on the floor.

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Storeroom]
description: This large storeroom has been looted with savage fury.  Iron shelves lie rusting on the ground, the metal twisted and torn from some tremendous stress.  Barrel staves and metal hoops lie shattered against the walls, their contents long since disappeared.  A wooden rack that once contained pickaxes and other tools of the stonecutters' trade remains intact, though the tools themselves have been broken and scattered about the room.

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Kitchen]
description: This small room once served as a kitchen.  A small firepit has been carved into the floor, and a number of iron skillets still hang from hooks set into the walls.  The rest of the contents, including several heavy wooden tables and various cooking implements, have been smashed beyond the possibility of repair.

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Dormitory]
description: Dozens of small iron bed frames have been piled into the corners, all that remains of the furnishings of the stonecutters' bedchamber.  Thick dust covers the floor, softening your footsteps and obscuring an area of discolored marble in the center of the room.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
description: A broad ramp leads from the lower tunnels to the main quarry above.  A pleasant sound of falling water reaches your ears from some unseen, distant source.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Garnet Lode]
description: These grey granite walls are studded with deep red garnets.  A small fortune in gems remains in its original setting, offering mute testimony of the stonecutters' preference for natural beauty over monetary gain.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
description: The tunnel flattens out through a long stretch of dark grey stone.  The rough granite drips with moisture, which collects in pools on the ground.  A large crack in one wall suggests the enormous pressure created by the weight of the mountain above.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Wound]
description: A rare formation of red granite provides an opportunity for an odd artistic expression.  A crevice, suggestive of a knife wound, has been carved into one of the walls of this square room.  Thick waves of blood red granite seem to pour out of this crevice and collect on the floor below.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
description: A granite statue of a dwarf, carved out of the tunnel wall, looks out over the destroyed railway.  The figure has somehow been riddled with lengths of steel rail without any damage to the stone form.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Grove]
description: This section of granite has a distinctive brown hue.  The walls have been carved to resemble a grove of elm trees, with thick wavy trunks and arm-like branches that reach up toward the stony sky.  Some trick of perspective half convinces you to walk between the boles and wander into the distance--but just in time you reconsider and spare yourself a bonk on the nose.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
description: A light mist fills the air here, where the tunnel begins to approach the second quarry.  The rushing sound of falling water makes it difficult to hear anything else.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Topaz Orb]
description: It is difficult to stand on the sloping floor of this room, which has been carved into a perfectly round space.  Gem quality topaz of various hue glitter against the polished grey marble.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Waterfall Quarry]
description: An underground river runs through this natural cavern, which has been enlarged and beautified by the stonecutters' work.  The water enters near the ceiling and cascades down a rippled ramp.  Reforming into a rushing stream, the water runs back and forth across the room in a series of channels cut deep into the stone until it crashes against a black marble wall, throwing up a tremendous mist.  The water collects in a large pool at the base of this wall.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Spiral Sluice]
description: Carved into the granite beneath the waterfall quarry, a wide spiraling sluice carries the spillover deep underground.  It is quite difficult to keep your footing on the slick, canting stone.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Spiral Sluice]
description: The spiral sluice descends into the layer of gneiss.  The water's flow accentuates the wavy bands of pink and purple stone while obscuring the dents and chips that mar the surface of the floor.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Murky Pool]
description: The spiral sluice ends at a small pool carved into the layer of schist.  Tiny motes of silvery dust detach from the walls and ceiling, almost floating on the damp and motionless air.  The schist falls into the water, floats briefly on the surface, then sinks to the bottom of the pool.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Nest]
description: Piles of coarse hides are stacked almost to the low ceiling in the corners of the chamber.  Crude bone tools, barely visible in the flickering illumination from the entrance, are scattered about the floor.  A niche in the rear wall holds a small statue which has been hewn with barely more skill than the tools surrounding it.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Large Chamber]
description: Hunks of what smells like rotting meat hang from the high ceiling of this large chamber, each coated with so many luminescent flying insects that it acts as a gruesome natural lantern.  The sickly yellow light reveals a series of holes carved into the rock, some draped with coarsely cured hides.  A stained circular rock crouches at the center of the cavern.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Large Chamber]
description: The natural beauty of sinuous rock formations hanging from the ceiling and rippling along the walls is offset by the rows of primitive cages squatting on the cavern floor.  None of the cages have living occupants, and though some contain evidence that they were once used, the dim yellowish light from swarms of glowing insects reveals no specifics about the cages' contents.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Stream]
description: The cavern floor slopes down to a sluggish subterranean stream.  Scintillant insects dance above the water's surface, their reflections dim as if the surface of the water were coated with oil.  The stream's bank looks wide enough to follow north, but a rockfall chokes off the southern passage along the water.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Stream]
description: Only the sound of the stream lapping against its banks delineates water from rock in the lightless passage.  The slimy walls press closer to the stream they confine as the tunnel snakes to the north.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Stream]
description: The tunnel floor takes a sharp downturn as it winds northward and the roar of a waterfall makes any further movement in that direction unlikely.  By the hollow sound of its echo, the cataract is a precipitous drop.  Perhaps in the light of day such falls would be lovely, but the endless blackness ensures that none will ever admire its beauty.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Crawlspace]
description: The ceiling is no higher than a halfling's upstretched arm could reach, forcing anyone taller to move along the crawlspace in a crouch.  Cool air and the constant hiss of a nearby waterfall emanate from the passage to the east.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Narrow Passage]
description: Free of stalactites and worn smooth by water, the ceiling of the passage lowers dramatically to the northeast. Luminous insects cast an intermittent dim yellow light on the oppressively low rock, the creatures' movements erratic in the stronger and somewhat fresher current of air coming from the northeast.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Narrow Passage]
description: Stalactites cluster closely overhead, their dagger-like points a grim reminder of the incalculable weight of rock poised above you.  A few luminescent insects flit among the rock formations like bees in a garden, alighting for a moment only to move on to the next stalactite.  Flickering, but brighter light from the east casts phantasmagoric shadows on the smooth walls.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Cavern]
description: Luminous insects rise in clouds from a pit to your west, the living motes of light drifting in the air as if in an unseen tide.  Their feeble light glints off of the clusters of crystal formations along the cavern's walls, an eerily beautiful effect quite at odds with the charnel reek of the nearby pit.  A low stone wall surrounds the fissure.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Cavern]
description: Drifts of refuse have collected between stalagmites rising from the cavern floor, white bones visible amidst the less identifiable debris.  A sharp animal reek pervades the chamber, though its source is invisible in the greenish glow of luminescent fungi festooning the uneven ceiling.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chimney]
description: The only way to travel up or down within the smooth and featureless vertical passage is to brace hands and feet along its sides.  Your halting motion along the slick walls is uncomfortably reminescent of peristalsis.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chimney]
description: The cavern narrows abruptly to the north and ends in a pit little wider than a stout giantman's shoulders.  The rim of the pit is worn smooth, almost slick.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Natural Cavern]
description: The curvilinear forms of stalactites and stalagmites are a dramatic contrast to rigidly angular mine shafts.  Curtainlike rock formations as thin as parchment hang down almost to the floor, and the only sign of sentient hands is a serpentine form crudely incised on one of the larger stalagmites.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
description: The tunnel ends abruptly in a wall of blank, rough rock.  Veins of metal shimmer in faint light from the south, beautiful to see but apparently not rich enough to mine.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Nexus]
description: The ceiling rises to an expansive height, giving the chamber an airy feel which belies the unfathomable weight of the DragonSpine Mountains above.  A pair of torches flank the passage to the west, and streaks of minerals along the walls reveal their true hues under the torchlight.  Lichen blurs the rough edges of the scarred rock walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, west

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
description: Brighter light from the passage to the northwest reveals the neglected state of your surroundings.  Sturdy beams have given way to haphazard replacements of dubious strength and dust has sifted down from the rough-hewn ceiling to blanket everything.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
description: The mine shaft widens into a square chamber strewn with evidence of past habitation.  Shards of shattered drinking vessels, a crate encrusted with candle-wax, and a pair of broken stools beside the makeshift table suggest that the chamber was once a resting place for miners.  A thick layer of dust on the crude furnishings bespeaks many years' disuse.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
description: Between the beams, the walls of the passage are riddled with holes.  Even the lichen doesn't grow too near the smooth rims of the holes, and the still air holds an acrid tang that stings the nose.  Although it's hard to tell in the gloom, the tunnel seems to widen to the northeast.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
description: Scanty patches of lichen along the walls serve only to emphasize the profound darkness of the mine shaft.  Rock walls rough enough to abrade skin press close on either side, and a furtive slithering sound occasionally echoes from more distant parts of the tunnel.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
description: A portion of the tunnel wall has collapsed, leaving the few beams supporting it bowed with the added pressure.  The sound of small stones crunching underfoot as you pass is startlingly loud in the silent mines.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
description: Dim fungous light and an uneven floor make walking a potentially bone-breaking hazard.  The beams bracing up the rock bear scratches and look none too sturdy despite their girth.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
description: An old mining cart, its sides so eaten with rust that faint light from the phosphorescent lichen on the rough rock wall behind it shows through the holes.  Tools scattered near the cart and scraps of dry-rotted cloth tell a story of a hasty, possibly violent exit.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
description: Fallen beams narrow the mine shaft to no more than a yard's width at points.  A fine sifting of dust covers every available surface, including your skin and hair.  Holes along the walls near their bases look uncomfortably like burrows, their entrances a deeper blackness in the eternal twilight.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
description: A glimmer of brighter light to the east reveals the surroundings clearly, though there is little of note to see.  The sturdy supports along the mine walls are black with soot in spots and a number of unusually smooth holes mar the ceiling between the beams.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
description: A solitary lantern, its flame small but bright, casts a welcome light on the broad passage.  The tunnel doesn't seem to have been used lately, and a litter of old rags and bones is piled in drifts along the walls.  A vein of mica sparkles in the lantern's flickering light, a surprising hint of ethereal beauty amidst the sameness of grey rock and pale dust.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Main Tunnel]
description: Spent torches litter one wall of the wide passage and the faint smell of greasy smoke lingers in the air.  Underlying the scent is some more acrid, but unidentifiable odor.  Faint, but warm light emanates from somewhere to the south.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Main Tunnel]
description: Subterranean creatures scratch furtively in fissures lining the rock walls of the tunnel, clearly heard but unseen in the ghostly light of phosphorescent lichen.  Deeper shadows between the ceiling supports mark the position of a series of round holes, each about a giantman's arm-span in diameter.  In the faint illumination, it's impossible to say whether the holes are natural formations or the product of conscious design.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chasm]
description: The floor gives way to a gaping pit spanned by a narrow bridge.  Stout pegs driven into the rock support the bridge, which rocks gently in the reeking current of air rising from the depths.  A nearby beam bears scratches that look like writing in the wan fungal glow.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Bridge]
description: Constellations of fungal growths as coldly bright as stars line the abyss beneath the bridge, but the ceiling of the chamber is in total darkness.  Unusually thick rope handholds and solid planks suggest that the builders of the bridge were not immune to the vertiginous illusory reversal of sky and ground.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chasm]
description: A humid breeze emanates from the yawning chasm to your west, carrying with it the too-sweet stench of tombs.  Luxuriant growths of lichen within the pit reveal the dark outline of a narrow bridge spanning it, but give no hint as to its depth.  The bridge itself has been kept scrupulously free of lichen, perhaps because the only way of seeing the span is by noting the dark path where the luminescent growth is not.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Defile]
description: The floor slopes sharply and the air carries a whiff of corruption that is stronger to the west.  The faint crunch of pebbles disturbed by your passage sounds as loud as a shout in the silent tunnels.  Sparse patches of lichen give off feeble light that barely delineates the position of the beams lining the walls.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Narrow Pass]
description: The nearly lightless corridor slants down to the west.  A furtive sliding noise from the deepest shadows suggests that the tunnel is not quite as disused as the stale air would imply.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Narrow Pass]
description: A fallen wall support lies to one side of the tunnel, its replacement easily differentiated from its companions by its sharply squared corners and the faint scent of pitch still clinging to it.  The walls press close on either side, though the tunnel is still large enough to allow two burly men to walk abreast.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Switchback]
description: Patches of phosphorescent fungi growing along the walls provide dim illumination, the light barely sufficient to reveal the slope of the tunnel floor.  Scars on the surrounding beams mark places where lanterns once hung.  The walls are riddled with shallow holes the size of small wagon wheels, though there is no sign of who or what created them.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Switchback]
description: The tunnel broadens to a semicircle at its western end, leaving it wide enough to turn a wagon and a brace of horses.  A depression carved into an oblong stone apparently served as a trough, although the only remnant of the water which filled it is a rust-colored ring a few inches below its rim.  The sloping passage doubles back on itself, leading down to the southeast and away from the feeble lantern-light to the northeast.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
description: The air smells of horses, but faintly as if none have passed this way too recently.  A fine sifting of sand coats the sloping floor where it meets the walls and the rock above you is almost completely hidden by a maze of crossbeams.  Metal bolts holding the beams to the ceiling and to each other reflect the wan light of distant lanterns.  The floor slants sharply down to the southwest.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
description: The faintly blue, almost undine luminescence of lichens festooning the tunnel's supports and lining the rock walls contrasts sharply with the warmly familiar radiance of widely-spaced lanterns.  Niches between the beams hold a few scattered mining tools, some in good condition and others nearly rusted away.  The tunnel widens to the northeast.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
description: Pools of amber light reveal where lanterns have been recently lit, but many of the glassed globes suspended from the ceiling beams have been extinguished.  Within the shadowed reaches between the beams, faintly phosphorescent lichen furs the planes of the bare rock, softening its angles into curves.  The smooth floor of the tunnel slopes down to the southwest.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
description: Massive square beams are braced against the rock walls of the tunnel, the solid pillars and their lanterns lending the otherwise plain passage a certain grandeur.  The sound of hammer-blows ringing against metal occasionally echo off the high ceiling, their source from somewhere to the north.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Lanterns hung from closely-spaced wooden beams supporting the dark sandstone walls and ceiling illuminate the wide tunnel.  Broad enough to permit the passage of three or four horses walking in tandem, the tunnel ends in a pair of large gates.  A few tufts of lichen adorn the beams, scratch-marks on the wood revealing that the lichen is regularly removed.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ruby Tunnel]
description: The tunnel has been sealed off directly to the south.  Thick chunks of granite are piled to the ceiling and filled with mortar to try to prevent anyone from proceeding further down the tunnel...or to prevent something from proceeding up the tunnel.  The workmanship is not up to the usual dwarven standards, though, and shrinkage, or seismic activity, or something else totally unknown has caused a narrow but deep crevasse to appear on one side along the wall.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Black Marble Table]
description: The square marble table's top matches perfectly with the marble in the bottom tier of the huge fountain that looms to the southeast.  Thin silver strands course through the black marble, causing the surface to sparkle in the light.  The table's top has been buffed to a fine sheen, and the edges and supports are exactly chiseled.  The table's grey-and-black umbrella is closed, allowing a breathtaking view of the constellation-filled night sky.  A freestanding torch flickers brightly nearby.

The square marble table's top matches perfectly with the marble in the bottom tier of the huge fountain that looms to the southeast.  Thin silver strands course through the black marble, causing the surface to sparkle in the light.  The table's top has been buffed to a fine sheen, and the edges and supports are exactly chiseled.  An umbrella with a grey-and-black awning spreads out over the table in an attempt to shade the occupants from the sun.  A freestanding torch occupies a place near the table.

title: [The Legendary Rest, Courtyard]
description: Flat marble walkways lead northeast and southeast to the inn's rooms.  A towering marble fountain dominates the courtyard's center, and its cascading waters change their flow patterns regularly to create different appearances and effects.  Six tables surround the fountain, keeping a safe distance from the fountain's watery spray, and freestanding torches occupy places near each table to await the coming night.  An immaculately dressed lady supplies food and drink from behind a polished brass bar.

title: [The Legendary Rest, Lobby]
description: A spacious lobby replete with gleaming brass fixtures, plush woolen carpet, and polished walnut furniture greets guests both coming and going.  Carved, thickly padded walnut chairs reside next to lacquered walnut tables, their wood grain surfaces rubbed to a mirror-like sheen, and richly appointed tapestries adorn the walls.  A pair of heavy walnut doors, inlaid with cut-glass panes, allow exit to an immaculate courtyard, while a dignified elf waits stiffly behind a polished walnut desk.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Vermilion Gate]
description: A massive stone wall rises high above, crennelated along the top of the city's last defense as far as the eye can see.  As it reaches the surface of the river the wall disappears into the murky depths of the Mistydeep, leaving no hint as to how far down the stonework may go.  The wall is pierced by the Vermilion Gate, a large ironwork gate above which the crest of House Vaalor is deeply carved into limestone blocks.  Decorated with rich dark red enamel and lined with pure gold, the crest glitters opulently.

The wall is pierced by the Vermilion Gate, a large ironwork gate above which the crest of House Vaalor is deeply carved into massive limestone blocks.  Decorated with rich dark red enamel and lined with pure gold, the crest glitters opulently in the light of torches lining the bridge.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Vermilion Bridge]
description: The massive stone bridge slopes gently downwards toward the city walls, its graceful arc and delicately interspersed cobbles belying the sheer weight and magnitude of its construction.  City guardsmen line the bridge at irregular intervals, some exchanging quiet conversation while others merely stand and watch the passersby.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Vermilion Bridge]
description: Arcing gently across the river, the bridge spans the surface of the Mistydeep with a massive yet quiet grace.  The crennelated city wall across the water hides and protects the city within as far as the eye can see.  Atop the tremendous limestone walls florid ruby and golden pennants flutter in the breeze.

title: [Timmorain Road]
description: A vibrant deciduous forest presses toward the waters of the Mistydeep River, leaving scant room for passage between the trees and the riverbank.  Cutting into the forest to the northeast, a well-maintained cobblestone road provides sure footing for travelers wishing to venture that direction, while a massive limestone bridge leads southwest, out over the river's waters toward an impressive city.

title: [Timmorain Road]
description: Massive oaks, maples and sycamores line the cobblestone road, and their branches cross overhead.  The sunlight filters through the leafy canopy to dapple the road with intermittent bright and dark patches.  A brisk wind rustles the trees' upper leaves, but nearer the road the foliage softens the gusts, turning them into a warm, gentle breeze.

Massive oaks, maples and sycamores line the cobblestone road, and their branches cross overhead.  The moonlight filters through the leafy canopy to dapple the road with intermittent bright and dark patches.  A brisk wind rustles the trees' upper leaves, but nearer the road the foliage softens the gusts, turning them into a cool, gentle breeze.

title: [Timmorain Road]
description: The road runs steadily northeast and southwest, and though the trees press in rather close, no cobblestones are buckled by encroaching tree roots.  The road's surface is smooth, and the cobblestones huddle closely together to allow fast, unhindered travel.  Strangely, the cobblestones are cleaner than one might expect for a road through the forest, as if someone has recently come out and given them a brisk sweeping.

title: [Timmorain Road]
description: A bridge to the northeast has collapsed into a swift stream, and though the cobblestone road obviously continues into the forest on the other side, there is no way to cross the surging waters.  The collapse appears to be rather recent, judging from the condition of the broken timbers, and there is no evidence of repair efforts.  A tree-lined path leads into the forest, perhaps providing a means of circumventing the ruined bridge.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: The path is flanked by stately tanik trees and widens as it passes between tall black iron gates that stand open.  A bronze plaque is firmly affixed to a stone column on the left side of the gates.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: The well-trod path splits here as it follows the fence to the northeast and northwest.  A worn thanot door appears to enter a hillock to the north.  The hillock is moss-covered, with ivy climbing the flat southern face to which the door has been securely affixed.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: A small plot of five headstones is enclosed by a low border of cut granite blocks.  Wild violets grow between the markers, providing a splash of purple to the green grass blanketing the resting place.
A small plot of five headstones is enclosed by a low border of cut granite blocks.  Visible in the moonlight, wild violets grow between the markers on the grass blanketing the resting place.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: The cemetery path, almost gardenlike in appearance, continues on through land carefully cultivated with trees, shrubs and flowers.  To the southeast honeysuckle decorates the iron fence enclosing the cemetary, its scarlet trumpets filling the air with a sweet fragrance.

The cemetery path, almost gardenlike in appearance, continues on through land carefully cultivated with trees, shrubs and flowers.  To the southeast honeysuckle decorates the iron fence enclosing the cemetery, its scarlet trumpets filling the night air with a sweet fragrance.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: A lone headstone sits in the shade of a towering willow tree.  A gentle breeze rustles the long narrow leaves of the willow as its tendrils reach toward the ground.  Drooping branches from the tree's large canopy extend over the path, providing shade.

A lone headstone sits in the shade of a towering willow tree.  A gentle breeze rustles the long narrow leaves of the willow as its tendrils reach toward the ground.  Drooping branches from the tree's large canopy extend over the path, creating eerie shadows in the moonlight.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: Lush grass carpets the ground on either side of the path that continues to follow the iron fence.  A climbing rosebush completely obscures a large section of the fence behind a profusion of buds, thorns and leaves.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: A tall granite obelisk serves as a grave marker atop a low hillock.  Framed against the sky, it appears to touch the clouds, a lone sentinel casting its shadow over the grave it guards.
A tall granite obelisk serves as a grave marker atop a low hillock.  Framed against the sky, it appears to swallow all light, a black void in a star-filled sky.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: Four grave markers are enclosed within a low granite wall.  Tendrils of ivy weave their way along the wall, softening the harshness of the granite.  Scattered around the markers, within the confines of the wall, are small clusters of wild violets.

Four grave markers are enclosed within a low granite wall.  Tendrils of ivy weave their way along the wall, like fingers reaching up from the grave, in the moonlight.  Scattered around the markers, within the confines of the wall, are small clusters of wild violets.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: The path curves towards the north here, still following the iron fence.  Under the shade of a large oak tree, a wooden bench provides visitors a place to sit and relax, or quietly contemplate what has brought them here.

The path curves towards the north here, still following the iron fence.  Under the canopy of a large oak tree, a wooden bench provides visitors a place to sit and relax, or quietly contemplate what has brought them here.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: Sunlight filters through the canopy of leaves created by towering twin oaks flanking the sides of a small mausoleum.  The giant oaks make the mausoleum appear smaller than it is.  A cobblestoned walk leads from the path to ornately carved ebon doors that mark the entrance to the mausoleum.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: The landscape here is dotted with small white grave markers.  Scattered among the markers, purple, white and pink wildflowers grow undisturbed.  A cool breeze rustles the leaves of a stately oak tree.  To the northwest the path inclines slightly as it climbs a small hillock.

Shattered crates and barrels mar the surface of the floor, and almost hidden behind them lies the rusted top of an opened hatch.

title: [Catacombs, Eatery]
description: A gentle breeze from the open hatch above creates enough disturbances in the air to send tiny particles of dust and dirt sailing through the air.  An old wood burner is slumped over onto its side in the far corner of the room.  A wooden bowl still contains the molded remnants of the last meal served in this morbid place.

A gentle breeze from the open hatch above creates enough disturbances in the air to send tiny particles of dust and dirt sailing through the air.  One of its legs missing, an old wood burner is slumped over onto its side in the far corner of the room.  A splintered barrel, with a warped and pockmarked flat piece of wood lying atop it looms above several broken crates that once served as a crude table and chairs.  A wooden bowl still contains the molded remnants of the last meal served in this morbid place.

title: [Catacombs, Tunnels]
description: Muffled sounds from the city above provide some comfort in this section of the sewer.

Muffled sounds from the city above provide some comfort in this section of the sewer.  Blackened stone walls make the room feel even smaller and more cramped than it really is.  Faint traces of the suet once used to flame the fire of the mullein torches still linger in the air.  Carved deeply within the wall, an arrow conveniently points downward towards a fair-sized hole in the ground.

title: [Catacombs, Workroom]
description: Abandoned machinery, clearly decades old, lies scattered about in this chamber.  Apparently, their owners just dropped them where they stood as they hastily vacated the area.  Along the western wall, a small, mostly rusted cart lies on its side.  Hordes of small gelatinous creatures slither and squirm about on the inside of the cart.  An old, woebegone door stands slightly ajar.

title: [Catacombs, Tunnels]
description: An ungodly funk permeates throughout this chamber, and the reason for the stench rests along the southern wall.  Slumped in the corner rests the decaying corpse of a fallen warrior.  In his hands, he still clutches his instruments of warfare.  Pity, for they obviously did very little to fend off whatever may have killed him.

title: [Catacombs, Tunnels]
description: Oddly deformed mushrooms dot the rocky surface in this chamber.

Oddly deformed mushrooms dot the rocky surface in this chamber.  The horrid, ghastly-grey mushrooms are thin and flat in some places, while other sections appear ready to burst in a spray of viscid liquid.  Unlit torches adorn both sides of an opened doorway.

title: [Catacombs, Storage Room]
description: A stockpile of the mutant mushrooms reaches the ceiling in this chamber.

A stockpile of the mutant mushrooms reaches the ceiling in this chamber.  Throughout the mushrooms, which have all shrunken down into one huge organic mess, small armies of maggots and other bugs march defiantly.  With nary a care, the maggots seem to glide gracefully on top of the liquid mess that seeped from the mushrooms.

title: [Catacombs, Chute]
description: In the center of the room sits a huge boulder.  In the far corner and missing several rungs, an old rickety ladder leans against the wall.  Only the portion that is eye-level is visible as the rest of it ascends upwards into total darkness.

In the center of the room sits a huge boulder.  Tattered and torn clothing rests among some white ashes and sticks, which protrude from beneath the rock.  Closer inspection reveals them to be a skeleton, which is turning to dust.  In the far corner and missing several rungs, an old rickety ladder leans against the wall.  Only the portion that is eye-level is visible as the rest of it ascends upwards into total darkness.

title: [Catacombs, Cavern]
description: A slight breeze stirs the silken-threads of a monstrous cobweb, which almost entirely hides the eastern wall.

A slight breeze stirs the silken-threads of a monstrous cobweb, which almost entirely hides the eastern wall.  From a niche directly above what serves as a dining table for the denizens, eerily red glowing eyes shine brightly.  Piles of shredded clothing, helmets and other items lie in the corner.

title: [Catacombs, Pool]
description: Cobwebs have woven themselves over humanoid remains that have been carefully placed in the niches carved into stone walls.

Cobwebs have woven themselves over humanoid remains that have been carefully placed in the niches carved into stone walls.  Coarse dirt grinds against the rough cobbles underfoot, and the scratchy sound echoes off of the hard surfaces of the cavern.  Pools of murky water have collected in the low spots of the floor.

title: [Catacombs, Cavern]
description: Wet black sludge lines the base of the catacombs walls.  The monotonous sound of dripping water fills the otherwise silent cavern.  Empty sconces, which once lit the arched corridor, are evenly spaced along the slimy, mold-ridden walls.  The corridor stretches to the north and south as far as the dim light carries.

title: [Catacombs, Tunnel]
description: Stones and larger rocks are scattered across the uneven floor.

Stones and larger rocks are scattered across the uneven floor.  Occasionally, the distant sound of splashing drifts in from a far cavern.  Strands of light filter through the iron gratings above and stretch across the rough stone wall.  The smell of musty mildew wafts across the damp air that fills the corridor.

title: [Catacombs, Landfill]
description: Various refuse litters the floor, discarded from the city street above.

Various refuse litters the floor, discarded from the city street above.  Some of the compost has begun to degrade, causing a vile, rotten smell to permeate through the dank air.  Patches of brown moss are scattered along the moist walls, clinging heartily.  Roaches and maggots scurry in and out of large cracks along stone walls.

title: [Catacombs, Tunnel]
description: Along the back wall a huge patch of skin, with matted fur still attached, clings to a jagged spot of rocks.

Along the back wall a huge patch of skin, with matted fur still attached, clings to a jagged spot of rocks.  There is no trace of the wounded animal.  In the distance, the high-pitched metallic ping of hundreds of bats echo and bounce off the walls.  The vibrations cause a small avalanche of dirt and other debris.

wayto.10476: ;e move 'go niche';while Room.current.id == 5922;line = get?;if line.nil?;sleep 0.2;elsif line == 'Your eyes have recovered from the poor light within the niche.';move 'go niche';break;end;end;

title: [Catacombs, Torture Chamber]
description: Dozens of sharp metallic spikes protrude from the walls, and impaled on three of them are the mummified, humanoid remains of two males and one female.

Dozens of sharp metallic spikes protrude from the walls, and impaled on three of them are the mummified, humanoid remains of two males and one female.  Their battered armor appears to have been sliced open with a sharp instrument and is scattered haphazardly along the ground.  Blood splatters cover the wall and a pool of it had collected underneath the corpses.  An odd scraping sound comes from the far corner.

title: [Catacombs, Altar]
description: Thick bluish-green mold covers the walls entirely.  Sudden cracks and holes in the ground make walking treacherous.  In each corner of the room, stands considerably sized candelabras with partially burnt blood-red candles perched atop them.  A wooden lectern rests atop a raised, rock platform in the center of the room.  An old tome lies open on the lecturn.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: The flow of the murky water is abruptly halted by a huge mass of garbage.  Rats and roaches hunt through the refuse for signs of food.  Crumpled papers sail across the water on the damp breezes of the cavern.  The walls of the cavern sweat from the cold dampness of the stale air.

title: [Catacombs, Passageway]
description: The ceiling and walls to the east have cracked and crumbled under the weight of the solid ground above.  A makeshift brace lies broken off to the side of the passageway.  An elven corpse lies half buried under a large boulder that fell from the ceiling.  Rotten torches and wooden mallets are scattered among the rocky debris.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: A small cave-in happened here recently, nearly blocking the path to the west.

A small cave-in happened here recently, nearly blocking the path to the west.  Stone and debris cover the floor in large piles.  Even the slightest of disturbances in the area cause more dust to rain down from the ceiling every so often.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: To the west, the cavern narrows considerably as some of the walls have crumbled towards the middle of the passageway.  A clammy breeze stirs some dust into a whirlwind as it passes through the narrow openings in the crumbled stones.  A small river of water winds through the piles of refuse that litter the ground.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: Faint scratching emanates from behind the walls as rats forage for a snack.

Faint scratching emanates from behind the walls as rats forage for a snack.  A large spider web is constructed perfectly in front of one of the recesses in the wall.  A grey spider nestles inconspicuously at the top corner watching for prey.

title: [Catacombs, Burial Chamber]
description: This corner of the cavern is bigger and oddly cleaner than the rest of the catacombs.

This corner of the cavern is bigger and oddly cleaner than the rest of the catacombs.  Four stone caskets are centered in the room, intricately carved on the covers.  Long wooden torches are mounted on the walls, long burnt out.  A shattered vase lies on the floor in the center of the room on top of a painted family crest.

This corner of the cavern is bigger and oddly cleaner than the rest of the catacombs.  Four stone caskets are centered in the room, intricately carved on the covers.  Long wooden torches are mounted on the walls, long burnt out.  The brickwork between the torches differs from the surrounding masonry,indicating it has been repaired.  A shattered vase lies on the floor in the center of the room on top of a painted family crest.

title: [Catacombs, Nexus]
description: All of the pipes seem to empty out into this general area, and large amounts of rancid water are unavoidable.

All of the pipes seem to empty out into this general area, and large amounts of rancid water are unavoidable.  Floating bones and refuse, among other debris, makes the water's level rise.  On the walls, mildew commemorates the different lines of water levels over the years past.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: A thin trickle of rank water flows down from the ceiling, rudely destroying the homes of several spiders.

A thin trickle of rank water flows down from the ceiling, rudely destroying the homes of several spiders.  In a heated frenzy, the spiders scurry along the walls, looking for any openings they can slide into to escape the onslaught of water.  Water carries away garbage and other debris that have collected on the floor for years, hardly improving the smell of the room.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: Wet, foul smelling compost lines the floor making interesting squishing sounds underfoot.

Wet, foul smelling compost lines the floor making interesting squishing sounds underfoot.  From behind the wall, comes the distinct sound of someone or something clawing at the ground.  Perhaps it is anxious to find its next meal here.

title: [Catacombs, Serpent's Den]
description: A huge snake pit dominates this area.  Near the pit lies a pool of murky water filled with more snakes.  It is impossible to determine which direction the reptiles are moving as they splash in the foul smelling fluid.

title: [Catacombs, Lair]
description: In the middle of this room lies a stack of discarded paper-thin skins.

In the middle of this room lies a stack of discarded paper-thin skins.  Closer inspection reveals them to be the cracked and dried outer coverings from various breeds of serpents.  As they crunch under foot, sloughed off scales litter the ground along the far wall.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: Interestingly, the walls have been crafted with stacked bones and skulls in artsy, symmetric patterns.

Interestingly, the walls have been crafted with stacked bones and skulls in artsy, symmetric patterns.  Even more unusual than the walls is a massive statue, meticulously crafted into a detailed image of a rat.  The statue stands at least ten feet high and looms in the center of this chamber.  The raised platform that the statue resides on is a pile of skulls and bones.  Located on the base of the platform is a plaque.

title: [Catacombs, Crypt]
description: Eight masterfully designed sarcophagi fill the chamber.  Entombed within each sarcophagus are the bodies of fallen legends, killed during one or more of the many great wars against different invaders of the city.  Carved to resemble scrolls, the walls above each of the biers served as tombstones with the epitaphs for the slain heroes.  Unfortunately, they are all now very unreadable.

title: [Catacombs, Pool]
description: Swimming might be easier than walking in this chamber, since it is filled with water from a broken pipe nearby.  The walls and floors are worn smooth due to the constant flow of the water.  Bodies of drowned small rodents float on the water and in one of the corners a massive collection of them are visible.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: Hundreds of flies and maggots swarm over the remains of a massive creature, which lies partially buried in the center of this room.

Hundreds of flies and maggots swarm over the remains of a massive creature, which lies partially buried in the center of this room.  The crumbling ceiling above has created massive piles of rocks in various sizes along the ground, forcing you to inch along the jagged walls of the room.  Sudden drops in the floor make walking quite deadly.

title: [Catacombs, Balcony]
description: Thick, clear slimy stuff covers both walls and floor in the room.

Thick, clear slimy stuff covers both walls and floor in the room.  A strange green glow seems to emanate eerily from within the unknown substance which illuminates this chamber.  Peering closely within the green slime, the fossilized remains of insects are visible.  Stone steps leading to a balcony, with skulls carefully placed in each corner, stand at the back of this room.

title: [Catacombs, Trophy Room]
description: In one corner of the chamber, a table created from rocks holds a dozen human skulls.

In one corner of the chamber, a table created from rocks holds a dozen human skulls.  Huge gaping holes are evident in some of the skulls, a clear indication of how the victim's life had brutally ended.  The remainder of the skeletons are contained within carefully carved out niches from the stone walls.  Some tattered and torn clothing still clings to some of the bones.

title: [Catacombs, Chart Room]
description: Ancient maps have been stashed away into a small nook in the wall.

Ancient maps have been stashed away into a small nook in the wall.  From the looks of them, a slight breeze would send them sailing through the air in a cloud of fine dust.  The sounds of someone or something breathing heavily comes from the darkened corner along the western wall.

title: [Catacombs, Passageway]
description: This huge cavern has cart tracks going in several different directions.  Great cyclopean doors stand at the end of each track.  Only two of them remain open.  One door is covered with moss, and allows easy access to the outside of these tunnels, while the warped door leads to yet another section of the sewers.  Only the tops of the other doors are visible, their bottom halves have been blocked by an earlier avalanche of rock and debris, forever shutting off the section of tunnels that lie behind them.

title: [Catacombs, Pool]
description: Vast stone pillars dot the rocky surface of this chamber.  The walls have been crafted with a raised mural, which depicts a section of buildings from the city street that is directly above this tunnel.  In the center of the ceiling is a dark gaping hole.  A rush of water pours from the hole into a seemingly bottomless pool of water.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: Heaps of warped and withered wood litter the ground.  Sections of the old tracks used to carry rocks and other minerals to the outside are visible from underneath the rubbish.  A twisted, slender pipe runs the length of the western wall.  Drops of water seep from a small hole in the pipe, which is creating a small pool of mud.

title: [Catacombs, Junk Room]
description: Shredded bits and pieces of clothing from previous adventurers traipsing around down here are stuck to the rough edges of the walls in this circular in shape chamber.

Shredded bits and pieces of clothing from previous adventurers traipsing around down here are stuck to the rough edges of the walls in this circular in shape chamber.  The cramped quarters make walking two abreast almost impossible.  Packed to the rim with an odd assortment of items, rocks and other debris are dozens of compartments in the stone walls.

title: [Catacombs, Sewers]
description: The low uneven ceiling with jagged protrusions makes walking upright burdensome.

The low uneven ceiling with jagged protrusions makes walking upright burdensome.  An almost new helmet sits on its base in the corner of the room.  Closer inspection shows a decapitated head with glossed over eyes raised to the ceiling seeing nothing.  In a small nook of the chamber the remaining dismembered body parts of the corpse rest silently.  Small armies of rodents scamper, with high-pitched squeals, back into a hole in the ground.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Victory Bridge]
description: Carved into the limestone balustrades of the bridge's side walls, miniature elven warriors stand sentinel in the stone, worn by years of weather.  Each of the carved warriors holds a shield bearing the crest of House Vaalor.  The crenellated walls of Ta'Vaalor, stretching around the island as far as the eye can see, are punctured only by the gaping maw of the Victory Gate.

title: [Solhaven, Niima's Steps]
[Solhaven, Stormdaughter's Steps]
description: Hooked onto a mooring ring, a gig and its crew sit with shipped oars, evidently waiting for the return of an officer or the arrival of a passenger.  Seemingly oblivious to the comings and goings of people, dozens of tiny, dark green crabs scavenge along the algae-coated steps between the tide marks.

title: [Victory Road]
description: A small whirlpool forms in the center of the rapidly rushing water underneath the bridge.

A small whirlpool forms in the center of the rapidly rushing water underneath the bridge.  The jagged tops of huge boulders break the surface of the water, giving a clear indication of its depth.  A gentle mist from the waves crashing below causes the bridge to be quite slippery.

title: [Victory Road]
description: Ancient oak trees stand as sentinels along both sides of the road.

Ancient oak trees stand as sentinels along both sides of the road.  Earlier travelers have carved into some of the boughs with their initials.  Wedged between some branches in the tallest of the magnificent trees lies an over-sized birds nest.  A gentle breeze carries the soft scent of wild roses through the air.

title: [Victory Road]
description: Small rocks and pebbles litter the ground and patches of white mushrooms grow haphazardly near a weathered stone turret.

Small rocks and pebbles litter the ground and patches of white mushrooms grow haphazardly alongside the gnarled roots of a twisted and bent tree growing near a weathered stone turret.  Etchings in the cobblestones have been worn thin over the years.  Off in the distance, a lone bird sings a sad melodic tune.

title: [Victory Road]
description: Grass and other types of weeds grow in between some of the cracks that have formed in the cobblestones over the years.

Grass and other types of weeds grow in between some of the cracks that have formed in the cobblestones over the years.  Along the side of the road a huge boulder that strongly resembles a frog lies at the edge of a thorn bush.   Beautiful assortments of various wild flowers are in full bloom their fragrance filling the air.

title: [Victory Road]
description: A decaying log lies off to the side of the road.  It provides shelter for some small furry animals that have made it their home.  Their high-pitched mewling gives away their hiding spot.  A gentle breeze sends tiny particles of dirt and dust sailing through the air.

title: [Victory Road]
description: An enormous tree has grown in the center of this stretch of the road.

An enormous tree has grown in the center of this stretch of the road.  Standing roughly two hundred feet tall its center has been hollowed out to allow passage through it.  As far as the eye can see fields of wild roses and other greenery blanket the landscape.

title: [Rambling Meadows, Path]
description: A crumbling dirt path winds southward through a sea of tall grass, its uneven surface patched with a few scattered remnants of the gravel road which once existed here.  On one side of the old road, a warped and rotting wooden structure sags under its own weight, its demise at the hands of the elements and time clearly arriving soon.

A crumbling dirt path winds southward through a sea of tall grass, its uneven surface patched with a few scattered remnants of the gravel road which once existed here.  Crunching underfoot, the fragile clods of dried soil and the occasional piece of stone provide rugged passage toward the gently sloping hills to the south.  On one side of the old road, a warped and rotting wooden structure sags under its own weight, its demise at the hands of the elements and time clearly arriving soon.

A crumbling dirt path winds southward through a sea of tall yellow-tipped grasses, its uneven surface patched with a few scattered remnants of the gravel road which once existed here.  Crunching underfoot, the fragile clods of dried soil and the occasional piece of stone provide rugged passage toward the gently sloping hills to the south.  On one side of the old road, a warped and rotting wooden structure sags under its own weight, its demise at the hands of the elements and time clearly arriving soon.

title: [Rambling Meadows, Path]
description: Overgrown with two-foot tall tufts of gently swaying grass, the dirt path curves along the hillside, a thin serpentine rut carved through a thick layer of wild grassland.

Overgrown with two-foot tall tufts of gently swaying grass, the dirt path curves along the hillside, a thin serpentine rut carved through a thick layer of wild grassland.  Rising out of the yellowed grass, an old wooden marker, its surface marred by deep gouges and dry rot, stands silently amid the wind-blown blades of vegetation.

title: [Rambling Meadows, Path]
description: The once-graveled path fades away as patches of wild grass sprout from the crumbling soil, masking any clear passage through the meadows.  The high-pitched song of crickets flows through the air, the rhythm of their sounds varying as they sense changes in the cool night air.

The once-graveled path fades away as patches of wild grass sprout from the crumbling soil, masking any clear passage through the meadows.  The high-pitched drone of cicadas flows through the air, the volume of their intonations varying as they buzz above the gently swaying blades of grass.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: Under the pale night sky, a sea of tall grasses rises from the uneven soil, reaching heights nearing two feet and obscuring most of the ground below.

Under the pale night sky, a sea of tall grasses rises from the uneven soil, reaching heights nearing two feet and obscuring most of the ground below.  Although the foliage seems to grow with wild abandon, the seemingly intentional rise and fall of the earth indicates that this area may have once been used to cultivate crops, leaving the deep scars of the plow still evident in the soil.

A sea of tall yellow grasses rises from the uneven soil, reaching heights nearing two feet and obscuring most of the ground below.  Although the foliage seems to grow with wild abandon, the seemingly intentional rise and fall of the earth indicates that this area may have once been used to cultivate crops, leaving the deep scars of the plow still evident in the soil.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: A rickety, badly warped wooden fence emerges from the tall grass to the northwest, its rotten posts no longer able to separate the thriving grasslands from the once-cultivated fields.

A rickety, badly warped wooden fence emerges from the tall grass to the northwest, its rotten posts no longer able to separate the thriving grasslands from the once-cultivated fields.  Blades of grass grow amidst the rotting timber, drawing the remnants of the fence toward inevitable decay.

A rickety, badly warped wooden fence emerges from the tall grass to the northwest, its rotten posts no longer able to separate the thriving grasslands from the once-cultivated fields.  Yellow-tipped blades of grass grow amidst the rotting timber, drawing the remnants of the fence toward inevitable decay.

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: A few lonely fence posts stand vigilantly along the western edge of the fields, their wooden railings lost to the insurgent grasses many years ago.

A few lonely fence posts stand vigilantly along the western edge of the fields, their wooden railings lost to the insurgent grasses many years ago.  Marked by twisted rusty nails and the pale stains of bird droppings, the blackened wood of the posts stands out in the dim moonlight.

A few lonely fence posts stand vigilantly along the western edge of the fields, their wooden railings lost to the insurgent grasses many years ago.  Marked by twisted rusty nails and the pale stains of bird droppings, the blackened wood of the posts stands out against the natural hues of the local plant life.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: Surrounded by thick tufts of long-bladed meadow grass, a single weatherworn fence post is all that remains of a border once designed to separate the wild plains from a series of cultivated fields.

Surrounded by thick tufts of long-bladed meadow grass, a single weatherworn fence post is all that remains of a border once designed to separate the wild plains from a series of cultivated fields.  Although wracked by the sheer force of the elements and a serious infestation of dry rot, the aged wooden post seems determined to remain standing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: The black husk of a small tool shed squats amidst the tall grasses, its badly weathered and rotting wall panels leaning against a low rise to the south.  A rhythmic squeaking emanates from a vacant doorway on one side of the ruined shed.

The black husk of a small tool shed squats amidst the tall grasses, its badly weathered and rotting wall panels leaning against a low rise to the south.  Its roof has completely disintegrated, leaving its interior victim to the elements and the unstoppable progress of the meadow grass.  A rhythmic squeaking emanates from a vacant doorway on one side of the ruined shed.

The sun-blackened husk of a small tool shed squats amidst the tall grasses, its badly weathered and rotting wall panels leaning against a low rise to the south.  Its roof has completely disintegrated, leaving its interior victim to the elements and the unstoppable progress of the meadow grass.  A rhythmic squeaking emanates from a vacant doorway on one side of the ruined shed.

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: The loose dark soil in this area has been upturned, as if large burrowing creatures had suddenly erupted from some unseen subterranean realm.

The loose dark soil in this area has been upturned, as if large burrowing creatures had suddenly erupted from some unseen subterranean realm.  A noxious musty odor hangs in the air, and the wild tufts of grass lie at odd angles, their blades crooked and torn.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: A small barren area in the midst of the tufts of tall grass has been lightly imprinted with thin curving lines, as if a small child had dragged a branch across the surface of the soil.

A small barren area in the midst of the tufts of tall grass has been lightly imprinted with thin curving lines, as if a small child had dragged a branch across the surface of the soil.  Nearby, a roughly circular hole appears in the dirt, perhaps home to a ground squirrel or other burrowing rodent.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: A low depression divides the otherwise thick growth of meadow grasses, creating a clearing in the tall weeds which contains a dried watering hole.

A low depression divides the otherwise thick growth of meadow grasses, creating a clearing in the tall weeds which contains a dried watering hole.  The brittle mud on the surface of the currently empty pond has curled up like dead skin, forming shapes which are reminiscent of scales.  A dank musty odor lingers close to the surface of the mud.

A low depression divides the otherwise thick growth of meadow grasses, creating a clearing in the tall weeds which contains a dried watering hole.  The brittle mud on the surface of the currently empty pond has curled up like dead skin, forming shapes which are reminiscent of scales.  A vague musty odor lingers close to the surface of the dried mud.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: A foul-smelling pond occupies a small clearing in the meadow grasses, its surface coated with a thick muck and its irregular edges surrounded by a border of mud.  Around the edge of the pond, a chaotic array of imprints have been frozen in the thick layer of mud.

A foul-smelling pond occupies a small clearing in the meadow grasses, its surface coated with a thick muck and its irregular edges surrounded by a border of mud.  Noisome mosquitoes dance above the still water, their incessant buzzing carried on a light breeze.  Around the edge of the pond, a chaotic array of imprints have been frozen in the thick layer of mud.

A foul-smelling pond occupies a small clearing in the meadow grasses, its surface coated with a thick greenish muck and its irregular edges surrounded by a border of dark mud.  Noisome black flies and buzzing wasps dance above the still water, their incessant droning carried on a light breeze.  Around the edge of the pond, a chaotic array of imprints have been frozen in the thick layer of mud.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: A light breeze rustles the tall meadow grasses, bringing with it a cold chill from the distant mountains.

A light breeze rustles the tall meadow grasses, bringing with it a cold chill from the distant mountains.  The auburn blades flutter into motion in the slight gust, creating waves which ripple across the open field.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: Deep furrows cut through the grasslands, dividing the long-bladed tufts into a semblance of rows.  A small nest of tiny sticks and shredded grass lies nearly hidden in the darkness.

Deep furrows cut through the grasslands, dividing the long-bladed tufts into a semblance of rows.  At the base of the ruts, smaller plants like fennel, nettles and tarweed lie beneath the greedy meadow grasses.  A small nest of tiny sticks and shredded grass lies nearly hidden in the darkness.

Deep furrows cut through the grasslands, dividing the long-bladed tufts into a semblance of rows.  At the base of the ruts, smaller plants like fennel, nettles and tarweed steal glimpses of the sun from beneath the shifting shadows of the greedy meadow grasses.  A small nest of tiny sticks and shredded grass lies nearly hidden amongst the foliage.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Rambling Meadows, Lower Fields]
description: Clumps of tall grass blanket most of the ground with their windswept blades, making movement through the meadow slow and footing unsure.

The sickly sweet scent of over-ripened grapes is born on a slight breeze.

title: [Rambling Meadows, Shrine]
description: A rough wooden altar stands in the center of the clearing, surrounded by a bountiful abundance of Imaera's Lace growing in wild profusion.  Moonlight silvers the white blooms of Imaera's Lace but does little to illuminate the other plant life intermingled with the flowers.  An abandoned bird feeder swings from a nearby tree limb above a partially shadowed oak bench.

Encircling the white blooms of Imaera's Lace are touches of purple from the wild violets that have grown in the rich soil. title: [Yander's Farm, Open Path]
description: A worn track leads out onto the road to the southeast.  Thick weeds flank the edges of the track, keeping a distance of about six feet apart, but few of them attempt to invade the central ribbon.  To the north, a wooden barn, the only building in the area, stands out against the skyline.  All else seems to be weeds, rocks, road, or fields.  The plaintive bleating of roltons reverberates across the landscape, its source apparently somewhere to the northwest.

title: [Yander's Farm, Barn]
description: Several paths converge in front of a wide, tall, well-constructed barn.  The wide barn door stands ajar, creaking slightly as it waves in the warm wind.

Several paths converge in front of a wide, tall, well-constructed barn.  A dark grey in the moonlight, the barn appears to be fairly new, with its cedar boards running straight and true.  The boards are tightly nailed to the framework, and show very little gap anywhere between them.  Bits of chaff, wheat, and barley litter the ground, fodder for the birds that keep a safe distance from you.  The wide barn door stands ajar, creaking slightly as it waves in the warm wind.

paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Yander's Farm, Barn]
description: A dry coolness pervades the inside of the barn.  A small, gateless stall on the west wall holds a couple of ropes and two short troughs.  The open barn door allows exit.

A dry coolness pervades the inside of the barn.  The walls keep the night's cold out, and the layer of chaff on the floor absorbs much of the moisture from the air.  High above, the upward cant of the roof reverses for a few feet, and spaces purposely left between the boards allow moonlight to enter the barn and illuminate the area.  A small, gateless stall on the west wall holds a couple of ropes and two short troughs.  The open barn door allows exit.
