title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: A gnarled modwir tree grows downward from high on the steep slope to the south -- half of its exposed roots grope in the air like grasping fingers.  A small ledge protrudes from the slope beside the tree and a jagged crevice can be seen among the darkness there.

A gnarled modwir tree grows downward from high on the steep slope to the south -- half of its exposed roots grope in the air like grasping fingers.  A small ledge protrudes from the slope beside the tree and a jagged crevice can be seen among the deep shadows there.

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: A cold, wet mist rises from the hard-packed ground that is strewn with crushed pieces of stone.  Huge boulders and slabs of rock are separated here and there by trails which lead off in many directions, like the spokes in a wheel.  Tufts of fur cling to the wet surface of the nearest rock, which has a footprint of enormous proportions visible at its base.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: The misty fog winds its way slowly across the frozen ground as if it has a life of its own.  High on the slope, tatters of cloth cling to the branches of a scrawny bush that struggles to free itself from the mammoth boulder that pins it down.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: The heavy clouds that wreathe the mountain and the billowing ground fog combine to reduce visibility to a bare minimum.  All sound is muffled as well, adding an eerie tone to this desolate place.

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: A single, scraggly bush struggles for existence amid the barren rocks littering the mountainside.  As the incline grows steeper, the air becomes colder and clammier.  There is nothing that distinguishes one path from another.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: A steep landslide has tumbled masses of rocks and boulders down the western slope, preventing further passage in that direction.  The tip of a boot-clad foot protrudes from beneath the rubble.

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: An upheaval deep within the earth has rent the mountainside to form a gaping gorge along the western slope.  Billows of swirling fog rise from the depths of the gorge shielding what lies within it from view.  A decaying log of considerable size is lodged against the sharp rocks near the edge of the precipice.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: Atop a projecting shelf of blood-splattered rock lies a splintered wooden shield and the haft of a sword.  Blood once dripped down the side of the slab to stain the ground and something white glistens amidst the dried blood.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: Across the surface of the hard-packed ground are signs that something was dragged up the incline to the northeast recently.  A visual search of the surrounding rocks reveals nothing more than a few tufts of fur.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: Low-lying clouds vie with the ground mist to obscure the dark, shadowy passages through the rocks littering the side of the mountain.  The skeletal remains of a giantman are propped against a mammoth slab of rock to one side of the path.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: A haphazard pile of boulders sits here, yet it doesn't look as if the area is being cleared.  Higher up the incline, a crushed helmet is wedged between two rocks, apparently cast aside because of its battered condition.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: As the mountainside becomes steeper, it is evident that the summit cannot be too far away.  The thin, frigid air hampers breathing and the rough rock surface of the wall facing offers little in the way of handholds.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: Thin, wispy clouds, buffeted by the whistling wind, shroud the rocky incline and prohibit a view of the mountaintop.  Thick fog has layered the ground with dew so that traversing the area is more treacherous.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: The summit of the mountain is almost lost in a smothering mixture of low clouds and dense fog.  An occasional glimpse of the valley far below is afforded when the intermittent wind scatters the clouds and fog.  The shadowy entrance to a cave can be seen emerging from the rocks to the northeast.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes]
description: The ghostly veil of clouds hanging over the mountain peak shifts and swirls when tousled by the prevailing wind.  An unscalable pinnacle of rock rises majestically to the northwest like a finger pointing to the sky and at the base the shadowy mouth of a dark cave can be seen.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Upper Krag Slopes, Dark Cave]
description: A vile, overwhelming stench fills this spacious cavern.  Against the right wall, the dead, broken bodies of a number of adventurers have been tossed unceremoniously.  Weapons and gear of all sorts have been piled against the left wall.  A half-ring of gigantic boulders has been placed near the back wall and the floor of the cave is littered with bits of bone and tufts of fur.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A large outcropping stretches away from the upper slopes, its surface littered with large rocks and scraggly plants.  Half-dead trees sway gently in the near-constant breeze that swirls stiffly across the plain.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A ruined stone walkway traverses the base of the steep mountainside, running from north to south.  Struggling grasses and shattered marble ruins dot the terrain along the path, and a large weathered stone rests near a fork in the path.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A thin rock wall runs northwest to southeast, separating the plateau from the steep cliffs nearby.  Flowers of red, orange, yellow, and blue flourish along the base of the mountain, each more vibrant than the last.  A small stream flows down from the peaks above, supplying water to the plethora of flora along its banks.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A simple stone barrier, crumbling from the effects of weather and time, has been erected near the edge of the plateau.  The small wall runs from the steep slopes of the Upper Krag and continues a short distance to the northwest.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: Jagged rocks jut out at various angles from the cliffs of the Upper Krag Slopes to the east.  A ruined stone walkway travels along the base of the mountain, strangled at times by large patches of dead or dying grass.  A large marble structure breaks the skyline to the west, dilapidated from years of neglect.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: Consisting of dirt and trampled grass, the path continues along the base of the mountain wall, as well as to the west.  Large chunks of marble and metal, as well as shards of painted clay pottery, lie haphazardly in the grasses about the area.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: The path turns sharply away from the ruined structure to the north, cutting through the tall grasses of various green and brown hues.  Nestled with the gently swaying field of waves is a small nest littered with patches of fur.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: Snow-capped mountain peaks rise up to the south, glinting softly in the night's light.  Near the path, foliage has started creeping up the surface of a bronze dwarf statue, broken and resting on its side.

Snow-capped mountain peaks rise up to the south, shining brightly in the sun's light.  Near the path, foliage has started creeping up the surface of a bronze dwarf statue, broken and shoved on its side.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A stone-circled garden remains undisturbed near the base of the wall, ringed by large, smooth stones.  In its center stands a tall maple tree, decaying and dying, but still adorned with stray bits of green.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: The path continues to the east and west, following the elegant marble palace walls to the north.  To the south, dilapidated stands, collapsed wagons, corroded structures, and ruined foundations dot the width of the plateau.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: Trampled paths cut through the tall grasses of the area, heading onward in several directions.  A single marble pillar, tilted and worn with time, stretches upward from the earth.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A small path of strewn cobblestones leads to an ancient stone structure that rests solemnly in the lush green grass that grows here.  Portions of its walls have become overgrown, while others have succumbed to time and the elements, and collapsed completely.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A polished steel axe with a burnished modwir hilt has been embedded into the palace wall, scrawled red runes painted on its side.  Carrion birds are perched high on the palace roof above, glaring down at the small animal carcasses that have been tossed haphazardly about the path, left to rot and decay.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: Strong, swirling winds whip about violently where the plateau's edge meets the steep face of the Upper Krag Slopes.  Gaping holes through the thick, fortified stone wall to the north offer a view of mountain range to the north.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: The stone walkway, littered with chipped rock and debris, turns sharply as it runs to the west and southeast.  Newly trampled paths through the scraggly grasses that grow here fork off to the north and east, back toward the towering slopes of the Upper Krag.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A rotted wooden fence forms a barrier around a small garden of blueberry bushes that grows along the base of the wall to the south.  The sweet smell of ripened fruit emanates from the bushes, several of which have been recently trampled.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: The crumbling length of stone wall continues its run from east to west along the northern edge of the plateau, standing guard over the long decimated palace to the south.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: Marble pillars rise up from the ground, standing tall above the remaining ruins they once supported.  Runes and sigils have been carved into their surfaces and run in a spiraling pattern of bold red and ebon from their tops to their bases.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A large portion of the northern wall has collapsed, offering a clear view of the region below.  A long dead tree stands sentry here, its broken and withered limbs creaking with the coming and going of the mountain breeze.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: Strangling brown vines clutch desperately to the collapsing wall that runs along the edge of the plateau.  Small burrows occasionally rest near the wall's base, partially hidden beneath the scraggly grasses that grow here.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A small pond rests in the center of the field, fed by a gently trickling stream to the east.  Several brightly colored fish, ranging in hue from golden browns to pale white to vibrant reds, yellows, and golds, swim about in circles near the pond's bank.  Small white flowers rest atop lily pads that float on the water's surface, and the occasional croak of a bullfrog breaks the silence in the air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A dull stone fountain rests near the base of the chipped marble staircase that leads into the palace ruins.  Scattered cobblestones circle around the fountain and head away to the west, hinting at a long overgrown road.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: Vibrant wild flowers grow in a small abandoned garden near the edge of the outcropping, filling the air with a sweet fragrance.  A broken and collapsed stone bench, placed to offer a view outward from the plateau, rests nearby.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Dilapidated metal fire pits flank the massive, broken doors that form the entryway into the building.  Grime-covered shards of blue, white, and yellow stone form a detailed mosaic of the sun rising over some mountain peaks on the ceiling above.  Smooth marble floors stretch down the halls to the east, marred and scratched violently at random intervals.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Tattered purple and gold tapestries dot the walls of the lengthy hall, their colors now stained and faded.  A torn red carpet runs along the floor, soggy and covered with patches of mold.  A pair of solid marble pillars forms an arched doorway to the north, their surface carved with images of spiraling grape vines.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: An empty cobblestone fireplace rests in the western wall, its surface covered in cobwebs.  Encircled by rotting oak chairs, a lengthy wooden table has collapsed near the middle of the room, splintered and cracked down its center.  Particles of dust and debris dance and swirl about the open area, seen clearly in the gentle light that streams in through the thin, open-air windows in the northern wall.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: A battered trapdoor in the floor has been swung wide open, leading into a dark and stuffy area below.  Light enters the hallway in small beams that stream through tiny holes in the ceiling above, dimly illuminating the area.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Fallen debris blocks the entry to the north, dust-covered and undisturbed.  Faded paintings hang tilted at angles from the walls, their frames bent and warped with time.  The marble bust of an elven male rests on its side on the floor, its base inscribed with archaic runes.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: A portion of northern wall has crumble and collapsed, its once sturdy stone strangled by creeping vines and mosses.  Shards of broken glass are scattered across the marble floor, resting where they fell from the domed glass ceiling above.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Dark spots of ash and soot mar the room, stretching from the scratched walls to the arched ceiling above.  A tarnished metal candleholder rests tilted against a pile of burned debris gathered along the northern wall, partially blocking access through the room beyond.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, west

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Aside from the debris near the room's entry, this small study is undisturbed.  Tarnished brass candelabra flank the doorway, each still supporting a half-burnt candle.  Dust-covered shelves line the walls, each covered with a stretch of tomes and texts, and a large wooden desk rests near the northern wall.  A dark bear-skin rug rests on floor before the empty cobblestone fireplace in the eastern wall.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Massive marble pillars, each carved with the images of spiraling grape vines, run the length of the hallway.  Brass candelabra hang from most of the pillars, though several rest on the floor, where they have fallen from their perch.  In addition to supporting the ceiling above, the elegant structures form an arched entryway to the south.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, northwest

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Dust and burn marks cover a majority of the walls, ceiling, and cobblestone floor of the room.  Scattered utensils, pots, and pans, long rusted and useless, litter the area, and a large, dark iron stove rests in the corner.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: A small stream of water flows down along the lengthy crack that runs up the southern wall, stretching from the floor to near the ceiling.  Scattered remnants of wooden furniture lie about the area, some swollen with moisture, and all rotting.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Several small holes, and one large one, have been dug into various portions of the chipped and scratched floor.  Makeshift torch-holders have been attached to the walls, several still supporting torches.  A broken, primitive pick-axe with a leather-wrapped hilt rests near the base of the wall.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Toppled sets of furniture rest atop scraps of moldy carpet soaked and rotted from years of exposure to the elements.  Dim light streams in through the holes left by the shattered panes of glass in the domed, grimy ceiling above.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Elegantly carved marble statues, each depicting a human woman bearing a torch, flank the archway to the northeast.  A tattered purple and gold banner droops down from the ceiling above, dangling from the one support hook that has yet to give.  The remains of several chairs and a small couch, long since surrendering to time and neglect, rest at the base of the northern wall.  A heavy wooden door is propped open to the south.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: A thick wooden door, warped and faded, has been propped open with a large rock.  A second door, crafted of thin metal bars, leans against the western wall, ripped from its hinges.  Deep grooves and scratches mar the walls, and a single weathered trapdoor rests in the center of the floor.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Two massive chairs rest on a small dais to the east, one splintered and shoved aside to reveal a large trapdoor behind the pair.  Large purple and gold banners hang from the ceiling and walls, moldy and torn.  A small balcony extends from the eastern wall, offering a view of the slopes of the Upper Krag.

title: [Labyrinth]
description: Thin shafts of light stream through tiny openings in the cave roof above, casting a dim light about the area.  Shattered pottery rests near the base of the cave wall, several shards stained with blood.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth]
description: Elegantly carved marble structures flank a small set of stairs leading to an arched doorway, brightly burning braziers placed atop them.  Etched into the structures are wide bull's heads.  The doorway itself is barred by a heavy iron gate.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Unending Path]
description: Gently burning fires rest inside metal braziers, illuminating the entirety of the circular room.  Several tunnels snake away from different sections of the room, each flanked by a pair of bronze bull statues.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Unending Path]
description: The tunnel narrows as it continues forward, and the air becomes less stale.  The path transforms slowly from unending darkness and rough walls and flooring to a dimly lit, cobblestone trail.  The walls are crafted from sandstone blocks, and the remains of murals and tapestries hang from its height.

title: [Labyrinth, The Unending Path]
description: The path continues through the darkness via a series of statue-flanked arches.  Each statue rests atop a sturdy stone pedestal and depicts a well-armed human soldier with a bull's head.  The arches are etched with runes, though their meanings have been lost to time.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Unending Path]
description: A series of large chutes snakes back and forth above, swiveling and swerving in and out of the shadows.  Small motes and specks of dirt and dust dance slowly downward, visible in the streams of moonlight that break in through the holes in the ceiling above.

title: [Labyrinth]
description: The stone passage continues in several directions with no remarkable changes.  The gentle trickling of running water can be heard coming from somewhere nearby, but the source is elusive in the darkness.

title: [Labyrinth]
description: The hallway continues onward with no visible end.  A gentle stream of moonlight breaks through the darkness as it shines down on a small path that rises steeply to the west, bringing with it the smell of fresh air.

The hallway continues onward with no visible end.  A gentle stream of sunlight breaks through the darkness as it shines down on a small path that rises steeply to the west, bringing with it the smell of fresh air.

title: [Labyrinth, Promontory]
description: A small stone promontory stretches outward slightly from the mountainside, overlooking the ground far below.  A gentle breeze swirls about playfully, carrying with it the strong scent of pine.  Stone benches travel around the walled edge of the circular platform, turned to face the handsome statue of a warrior-king.  A steep trail leads away from the simple sanctuary, down and across the cliffs of the plateau.

title: [Labyrinth]
description: Dimly glowing mushrooms cast light across the metal surface of an extinguished fire bowl that rests at the base of the wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: A massive metal forge rests in the center of the room, its fire still burning brightly.  A large bull's head has been carved into it on each of its four sides, their crimson eyes glaring outward around the area.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: Torches flicker and dance violently, causing dark shadows to snake back and forth about the tunnel.  Images of oddly drawn men forcing labor onto others have been carved into the wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: A dim light spreads across the cave wall as the path continues to twist and sharply turn onward.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: Sweltering heat and the stench of rot smother the area, striking at the senses from the forge-fires that burn throughout the area.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: The hall ends at an elaborately carved doorway that leads into a dark, open room.  A pair of stone pedestals rests on either side of the doorway, each supporting a bronzed soldier statue.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: Dilapidated weapon racks line the walls, some collapsed and others no longer supporting any wares.  Metal shards lie scattered near the racks, their surfaces glinting in the light from the nearby forge-fires.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: Large stone pillars cast dark shadows across the walls and floor, forming a net of darkness that has engulfed the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: The path descends slightly as it continues through the darkness with no notable change.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: The cold, damp bite of the complex begins to fade as the tunnel takes another sharp turn.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: The tunnel opens into a large, open room.  Carpet remnants line the floor, stretching into separate tunnels as they split into different directions.  Bronze statues depicting large, cloaked priests rest between each path.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: The path ends in a small room.  Bronze candleholders have been strewn about the area, many covered with dried wax.  A single rotting bench rests in the center of the room, an axe imbedded into it.

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: Stone pillars support the ceiling above, the wide girths strangled by dark vines.  Rusted and broken weapons, long since discarded, lie scattered haphazardly about the cobblestone floor.

title: [Labyrinth]
description: Strangling vines have broken through small holes in the cave roof above, stretching their grasping clutches along the walls and floor.  A steady stream of smoke rises from a dimly glowing brazier, but it does little to cover the scent of rot and decay.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth]

title: [Labyrinth, Great Hall]
description: The remains of several unlucky visitors are strewn about the area, but most rest near the gently streaming brook that travels across the stone floor of this open room.  Light streams in from high above, where a wide stone bridge stretches from one doorway to another.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Tareesa's Outfitting]
[Tareesa's General Store]
[Tareesa's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an elegantly arched fel ceiling, a gold and crimson wyvern tapestry hangs on one of the grey watered silk walls.  A gold-veined black marble counter and an elegantly carved oak armoire sit in opposite corners while a serene golden wyvern fountain rests on a glossy black ebonwood floor.

title: [Alchemist's House, Consignment]
description: Blackened from a previous mishap with fire, the wooden table in one corner of the room has a rickety bench tucked beneath it.  Lining the back wall of this spacious room, sturdy oak planks serve as bookshelves housing over a dozen thick, leather-bound tomes.  Directly opposite the bookcase stands an oval-shaped glass counter, completely empty except for a lantern capped with a multicolored glass globe.

title: [Alchemist's House, Commodities]
description: Carpets in a variety of somber shades are tossed haphazardly across the floor.  Patterned in the center of each rug, in a brilliant gold thread, are interlocking spheres of assorted sizes.  Pushed against the wall of the chamber, holding an assortment of alchemical paraphernalia, stands a sturdy solid oak table.  Several clear-globed lanterns hang high overhead to provide adequate lighting for the various accoutrements available for purchase.

title: [Grey Wind Manor, Garden Path]
description: The path is lined with white-speckled grey stones that stand in stark contrast against the surrounding foliage eating up the rest of the terrain.  A thick layer of mist, shimmering from unseen moonlight, covers the floor of the garden, caressing the glossy leaves of the shrubs and wrapping delicately around the wide, straight trunks of the trees that tower overhead.

The path is lined with white-speckled grey stones that stand in stark contrast against the surrounding foliage eating up the rest of the terrain.  A thick layer of mist, shimmering from unseen moonlight, covers the floor of the garden, carressing the glossy leaves of the shrubs, wrapping delicately around the wide, straight trunks of the trees that tower overhead.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Briar Patch]
description: Thick thorn bushes choke the few young oaks brave enough to root here.  Long trailing vines drop pliant nooses from above and curl about your feet like vipers.  There is no path to speak of and the only way through seems to be to find the shrub with the fewest thorns and put a shoulder into it.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Briar Patch]
description: Wooden carving knives slice away the flesh of all intruders to this horrible maze, leaving rivulets of blood and sweat to trickle down the brow of any so foolhardy as to enter here on two legs.  Twist or turn, but there is no escape from the dagger-spine pressed painfully into the soft flesh of the abdomen or the clump of stinging nettles thrust suddenly into the face.  At times the only way forward is by scrabbling on hands and knees.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Briar Patch]
description: Underbrush and stunted oaks twist together in a death grip as the ground begins to slope downward.  Some of the nearby briars have stems so thick that, if not for their hateful thorns, you could almost mistake them for saplings.  The oaks, in turn, are bent double by masses of clinging vines.  The whole effect is of a nasty little miniature Dragonsclaw.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Brambles]
description: A gnarled hedgerow of brambles marches north and south, blocking any further progress down the westward slope.  The smell of homemade cooking wafts over the stubby barrier ... or maybe something died over there.  A sturdy adventurer might be able to squeeze under the hedge without too much loss of blood.  On the other hand, a naked march back through the briars would probably be more fun.

title: [Kobold Village, Hedgerow]
description: A ramshackle collection of shanties and lean-to sheds huddles amid a yellowish river of mist in the small, dark vale below.  The pitiful little huts crowd together in clumps, each seemingly hoping not to stand out enough to be noticed.  If the size of the dwellings left any doubt, their bedraggled state leaves none:  Only kobolds could have made such squalor in the midst of a pristine forest.

title: [Kobold Village, Commons]
description: The village commons is a grassy swath cut into the terraced strip of land east of the village proper.  The green is set down into the rich earth just enough to keep a lethargic rolton from scrambling out on a hot day.  An unwholesome mist pools in the sunken grassy area, and the moist earth gives way to a quagmire at one end.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, up

title: [Kobold Village]
description: The ground slopes downward and the thin yellow mist that clings about the vale hangs heaviest to the west.  Northward a wooded promontory overlooks the vale.  The great splendid oaks of the Dragonsclaw lean out over the precipice as though peering in disapproval at the shabby squatters below.  Some of the huts here have been built against the face of the promontory: an architectural style favored by lazy builders and maggot-hunters.

title: [Kobold Village, Shanty]
description: The owner of this little home was either too poor or too lazy to build a roof.  Fortunately, the north wall is a scavenged piece of drawbridge that lists inward enough to huddle under during a storm.  For a door, someone has nailed up a smelly shirt that reminds you of its presence periodically as it flaps in the breeze.

title: [Kobold Village, Promontory]
description: A steep earthen cliff rises above you, roots dangling over the edge far above.  Several large piles of dirt lie nearby, and a broken wheelbarrow is partially buried by one.

title: [Kobold Village]
description: A fetid pond of murky green slime swirls lazily around a gurgling spring at the lowest point of the vale.  A circle of tumbled stones nearby suggests that this was once the site of a well, and a few scattered buckets and washboards hint that the kobolds might actually use the brackish filth here as a water supply.  It's not a pleasant thought.

title: [Kobold Village]
description: The huts at this far end of the little valley are in slightly better shape and somewhat larger than elsewhere in the village.  The slothful kobolds must prize the extra hour of morning shade the rubbish mound to the east provides, or maybe they just like the smell.  One hut stands out from the others for its size and relatively sturdy construction.  The architect was surely the only one of his brethren ever to have heard of right angles.

title: [Kobold Village, Royal Mound]
description: A great mound of rubbish and filth rises up here west of the commons.  Trash from every inn and tavern in Elanthia must have been dragged here to make it.  High above the surrounding slovenly huts rests an even more slovenly sight: a decrepit fishing boat lies keel-up amid the filth.  Gaping holes dot the rotting hull, only a few stopped with rickety shields and other scraps of wood serving as doorways and shutters.  The fishermen are gone, but the smell of fish lingers on.

title: [Kobold Village, Shaman's Hut]
description: Thick scented smoke chokes the air, fed from a banked fire of aromatic green branches in the center of the hut.  The walls of the hut are lined with piles of moth-eaten blankets and personal effects, suggesting that quite a few kobolds live here.  The remainder of the hut is crowded with jars of unguents, crooked staves, feathered bags, and every other form of talisman or source of evocative magic imaginable.

title: [Kobold Village, Royal Lodge]
description: Some mad decorator transformed the belly of this beached fishing boat into a royal audience chamber fit only for a kobold king.  Rags and tattered clothing serve as tapestries and a carpet of red woolen undergarments, stitched end-to-end, leads up to a rickety barstool painted gold.  To the south gapes the rotting, fish-scented maw of the hold.  The crushed and inverted remains of the crew's quarters are to the north.

title: [Kobold Village, King's Pantry]
description: The fishermen's bunks hang empty from the ceiling, their undersides now serving as shelves for the royal larder.  Piles of rotting fruits and meats line the jury-rigged storage areas and spill over onto the floor.  The menu boasts mainly garbage scraps and the place smells more like a compost heap than anything else.

title: [Kobold Village, King's Loo]
description: Clearly His Majesty spends a great deal of time here when he isn't hiding from adventurers.  The decor is certainly the best that generations of kobold artists have produced, the centerpiece consisting of a dented helm balanced on a stick so that it rattles a bit if you tap it.  There are other equally fine treasures here, no doubt taken as spoils from the king's many victories and each almost as marvelous as the last.

wayto.11032:
;e container_action_timeout = 3
open_success_regex = /^You open|^Oh no|(?:is )?already open|^There doesn't seem to be any way to do that|^What were you referring to|^I could not find what you were referring to/
look_in_success_regex = /^In the|^Peering|^You (?:look|absentmindedly)|^There is nothing|^That is closed|^What were you referring to|^I could not find what you were referring to|is stuffed with a variety of/
drag_success_regex = /^You (?:carefully )?(?:remove|grab|reach|slip|tuck)|^Get what/

run_go2_and_wait = proc { |waypoint|
  go2_count = Script.running.find_all { |s| s.name == 'go2' }.length
  force_start_script('go2', [waypoint.to_s])
  wait_while { Script.running.find_all { |s| s.name == 'go2' }.length > go2_count }
}

script = Script.self
river_rest_citizen = (Char.citizenship == "River's Rest")

crystal_amulet = nil
sunwashed_driftwood = nil
containers_opened_by_script = []

if UserVars.lootsack.nil? or UserVars.lootsack.empty?
  loot_container = GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.noun =~ /cloak|longcoat|backpack|pack/ }
else
  loot_container = GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name =~ /#{Regexp.escape(UserVars.lootsack.strip)}/i } || GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name =~ /#{Regexp.escape(UserVars.lootsack).sub(' ', ' .*')}/i }
end

worn_containers_cache = nil

all_worn_containers = proc {
  if worn_containers_cache.nil?
    strip_hook_after_wearing_line = proc { |line|
      if line =~ /^You are wearing/
        DownstreamHook.remove('find_all_container_ids')
        nil
      else
        line
      end
    }
    DownstreamHook.add('find_all_container_ids', strip_hook_after_wearing_line)
    saved_silent = script.silent
    saved_want_downstream = script.want_downstream
    saved_want_downstream_xml = script.want_downstream_xml
    script.silent = true
    script.want_downstream = false
    script.want_downstream_xml = true
    clear
    put('inventory containers')
    script.silent = saved_silent
    scrape_deadline = Time.now + 30
    worn_container_ids = []
    while (Time.now < scrape_deadline) and (line = get)
      if line =~ /^You are wearing/
        worn_container_ids = line.scan(/<a exist="([^"]+)"/).flatten
        break
      end
    end
    script.want_downstream = saved_want_downstream
    script.want_downstream_xml = saved_want_downstream_xml
    clear
    worn_containers_cache = worn_container_ids.collect { |id| GameObj[id] }
  end
  worn_containers_cache
}

open_and_reveal_contents = proc { |container|
  next if container.contents.is_a?(Array)

  open_result = dothistimeout "open ##{container.id}", container_action_timeout, open_success_regex
  if container.contents.nil? and open_result =~ /^Oh no|already open/
    dothistimeout "look in ##{container.id}", container_action_timeout, look_in_success_regex
  elsif open_result =~ /^You open|^Oh no|already open|^You glance/
    containers_opened_by_script.push(container)
  end
}

empty_hands

if loot_container
  open_and_reveal_contents.call(loot_container)
  sunwashed_driftwood = loot_container.contents.find { |obj| obj.name == 'piece of sun-washed driftwood' } if river_rest_citizen
  crystal_amulet = loot_container.contents.find { |obj| obj.name == 'crystal amulet' }
end

if crystal_amulet.nil? && sunwashed_driftwood.nil?
  all_worn_containers.call.each do |container|
    next if container == loot_container

    open_and_reveal_contents.call(container)

    if river_rest_citizen
      break if (sunwashed_driftwood = container.contents.find { |obj| obj.name == 'piece of sun-washed driftwood' })
    end
    break if (crystal_amulet = container.contents.find { |obj| obj.name == 'crystal amulet' })
  end
end

if river_rest_citizen && sunwashed_driftwood
  dothistimeout "_drag ##{sunwashed_driftwood.id} right", container_action_timeout, drag_success_regex
  containers_opened_by_script.each { |c| fput "close ##{c.id}" }
elsif crystal_amulet
  dothistimeout "_drag ##{crystal_amulet.id} right", container_action_timeout, drag_success_regex
  containers_opened_by_script.each { |c| fput "close ##{c.id}" }
else
  containers_opened_by_script.each { |c| fput "close ##{c.id}" }

  if $go2_get_silvers
    run_go2_and_wait.call('bank --disable-confirm')
    fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?
    withdraw_result = dothistimeout "withdraw 2000 silvers", container_action_timeout, /hands you|don't seem to have that much/
    unless withdraw_result =~ /hands you/
      echo "Too poor to go to River's Rest"
      exit
    end
    run_go2_and_wait.call('alchemist --disable-confirm')
    fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?
    fput 'order 10'
    buy_result = dothistimeout "buy", container_action_timeout, /hands you a crystal amulet|Looks like you might buckle under this weight/
    unless buy_result =~ /hands you a crystal amulet/
      echo "Too encumbered to go to River's Rest"
      exit
    end
    crystal_amulet = GameObj.right_hand if righthand?('amulet')
    run_go2_and_wait.call('bank --disable-confirm')
    fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?
    fput 'deposit all'
    run_go2_and_wait.call('6274 --disable-confirm')
  else
    echo 'You have no crystal amulet!  If you want this script to buy you one, issue the command:'
    echo 'go2 --getsilvers=on'
    fill_hands
    exit
  end
end

if river_rest_citizen && sunwashed_driftwood
  fput 'put my driftwood in giant\'s boot'
else
  fput 'put my crystal amulet in giant\'s boot'
end

move 'go giant\'s boot'
fill_hands

title: [Kobold Village]
description: A little circle of huts have collapsed inward on themselves, leaning together for support like a group of their owners in a drunken stupor.  Around them, a twisted octopus of metal extends its tentacles.  The strange conglomeration of metal debris at first appears to be some hellish sculpture, but closer inspection, by sight and smell, suggests it is an animal cage.

title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
description: While the hutch is massive for an animal cage, it's still pretty cramped to be strolling around in.  Here and there, the metal framework sags inward and patches fill most of the holes.  Picking a path through the warren of detritus is a job calling for the skill of a Ranger Lord, the fortitude of a besotted Dwarf, and the sensibilities of a guttersnipe.

title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
description: The dirt floor slopes sharply downward and less light filters in through the arch of wire mesh above.  This westernmost tentacle of the hutch, by design or mishap, seems to be burrowing its way into the soft soil.  Muffled by earthen walls, the everpresent scrabbling recedes a bit, but from the dimness ahead comes an odd new sound...softer and somehow more unsettling.

title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Pit]
description: The chamber is cloaked in mist, hot with the breath of hundreds of small, unwholesome lungs.  A single ghostly shaft of moonlight cuts downward, illuminating an awful panorama:  The roof of the hutch sags over a twenty foot earthen bowl, alive with the tiny bodies of infant rodents.  Sticks, fur, and scraps of refuse fill the bowl with a horrifying nest for the little beasts. Rabid from birth, their passionate cries pierce the shadows like shattering glass.

The chamber is cloaked in mist, hot with the breath of hundreds of small, unwholesome lungs.  A single yellow shaft of light cuts downward, illuminating an awful panorama:  The roof of the hutch sags over a twenty foot earthen bowl, alive with the tiny bodies of infant rodents.  Sticks, fur, and scraps of refuse fill the bowl with a horrifying nest for the little beasts.  Rabid from birth, their passionate cries pierce the shadows like shattering glass.

title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
description: Jagged fingers of metal point from the walls and roof at a thousand angles like a mob of kobolds asked to give directions.  The ground is awash with rodent urine and there are more squirrel pellets piled across the sodden ground than gems in an archmage's coffers.  If you lived here, you'd have a bad attitude too.

title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
description: Gnawed bones and other more obscene carrion weave a grisly carpet here, a tapestry depicting carnage more vivid than the most gifted and demented of mortal artists might dare.  You struggle to hold down your latest meal as you note a familiar looking skull nearby.  What fate could be worse than to spend eternity between the razor sharp teeth of diseased rodents?

title: [Kobold Village, Squirrel Hutch]
description: Darkness shrouds this tentacle of the hutch formed from iron shields fused into a great mass.  Dozens of little blood-shot eyes stare malignantly at you from the shadows, and the air is thick with the stench of disease and four-legged reproach.  Overcome with horror, your mind slips unbidden into thoughts of the chaotic passions and horrible terror that drive these villainous abominations.

title: [Kobold Village]
description: This part of the village is not only shabby, it's boring.  Absolutely nothing distinguishes the meritless huts, one from another.  The kobolds who live here must shuffle off sadly into the forest each day with little hope of anything interesting in their pathetic lives... unless they are fortunate enough to find an end to their miserable existences at the swordpoint of some Wehnimerian whelp.

title: [Kobold Village, Hovel]
description: The walls of this tiny hut are little more than some crooked branches tied together with twine.  Why, the builder didn't even bother to pull off the wilted leaves before bundling up the branches into thatch.  A strong breeze might collapse the whole place, not that anyone would be likely to notice.  A forlorn and threadbare cot is the only furnishing.

title: [Kobold Village, Crater]
description: What appears to be a huge mound of dirt from outside, actually slopes to a hole in the center, as though a rabid giant rodent had tunneled there, throwing dirt in all directions.  The hole is protected from the shifting earthy dunes by a sheath of rotting boards.  A confused mass of knotted ropes and pulleys dangles down into the darkness.

title: [Dirt Mines, A Really Big Bucket]
description: A large bucket, half filled with dirt, sways precariously at the end of a set of heavy ropes.  Down below, the shaft stretches away into endless darkness, while moonlight glimmers above. The bucket swings back and forth, striking first one side of the shaft and then the other, sending showers of dust into the shadowy depths.  There's a dark opening in one wall, and with good timing you might climb down the side of the bucket and into the opening.

A large bucket, half filled with dirt, sways precariously at the end of a set of heavy ropes.  Down below, the shaft stretches away into endless darkness, while light glimmers above. The bucket swings back and forth, striking first one side of the shaft and then the other, sending showers of dust into the shadowy depths.  There's a dark opening in one wall, and with good timing you might climb down the side of the bucket and into the opening.

title: [Dirt Mines, Dark Opening]
description: A long dark tunnel opens onto the mine's main vertical shaft.  A huge bucket swings lazily in the void, striking the opening every so often.  A musty breeze blows out from the tunnel, carrying the frighteningly seductive odor of warm loam.

title: [Dirt Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The first thing you notice about this tunnel is that it is dark.  It's also the last thing you notice, as it is too dark to see much else.  To the south is the faint glimmer of...well...less darkness.  To the north you think you can make out a bend in the tunnel.  Actually it's just your over-active imagination, since it's too dark to really see the bend.

title: [Dirt Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The air is thick with the scent of earth and the walls are warm and crumbly to the touch.  A few rickety timbers prop up the ceiling and walls where the earth seems to long to embrace itself again, along with any surface creatures foolish enough to stand in the way.

title: [Dirt Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: An errant ray of light illuminates dozens of cold glittering eyes.  They stare malignantly at you from down the corridor, sparkling with cold metallic hatred, until the soothing calm of reason returns them to bits of unmined gold.  Kobold picks have tunneled around the vein of gold in search of precious loam.  Perhaps the little brutes have left it here reflecting upon the virtue of poverty, perhaps because metal is heavy, or perhaps simply because the word "gold" is difficult to pronounce.

title: [Dirt Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The tunnel narrows and slopes downward a bit.  A faint hint of light flickers somewhere in the darkness to the north.  The floor is broken with small holes and mounds of dirt, either the signs of recent mining or perhaps the burrows of some small animals.

title: [Dirt Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The tunnel falls off steeply to the north.  Something large peers out from behind the dirt ceiling ahead of you.  It's impossible to make out just what it is, but it seems to have been enough to convince the lazy little diggers to give up and head downward.

title: [Dirt Mines, Archaeological Dig]
description: The passage ends in a crumbling clay wall which extends into the uneven earthen floor and ceiling.  Pickaxe scars mark its accidental discovery, but care has been taken to clear and clean it since.  Several large shards of clay are piled nearby, and a large hole gapes from the wall.  The shards resemble pieces of a large jigsaw puzzle waiting to be completed.

title: [Dirt Mines, Archaeological Dig]
description: Large pieces of rusted iron cover the floor.  In the center, several large pieces rest precariously atop each other, tied together with lengths of rough rat-hair rope.  Some look like sections of pipe and a corroded valve rests at the bottom.  Small tallow torches sputter from the walls, sending shadowy mockeries of the already ridiculous iron statue cavorting about the room.

title: [Dirt Mines, Archaeological Dig]
description: A vertical shaft serves as a transom of sorts, bringing down a square of moonlight into the center of the chamber.  A couple of rotting scrolls and broken tablets are gathered together in the dim light.  A fresh but crumpled parchment beside the others is covered with fine scribbles and a stylus lies nearby, as if some scholar had been studying and taking notes.

A vertical shaft serves as a transom of sorts, bringing down a square of light into the center of the chamber.  A couple of rotting scrolls and broken tablets are gathered together in the light.  A fresh but crumpled parchment beside the others is covered with fine scribbles and a stylus lies nearby, as if some scholar had been studying and taking notes.

title: [Dirt Mines, Archaeological Dig]
description: Piles of refuse are strewn about, including a few slightly less useless implements that must pass for kobold mining equipment.  A delicate odor wafts across the room.  The kobolds have a word for such a place: "Mukt."  The term may be translatable, but no reputable linguist has ever bothered, beyond concluding that it includes the concepts of out-house, kitchen, bedroom, and sauna.  A bit of colored mosaic peeks from beneath a rotting tarpaulin.

title: [Dirt Mines, Archaeological Dig]
description: A large clay pipe, some ten feet in diameter, runs across the tunnel.  Little hands have lovingly cleared away the dirt from floor to ceiling.  Unidentifiable chalk pictures sprawl across the sides, and scraps of fly-ridden meat are gathered in small piles at the base.  Dark water drips from a large vertical crack.

title: [Dirt Mines, Sluice]
description: The pipe runs northeast and southwest.  A foot or two of dark water pours down the pipe, carrying bits of flotsam beneath the dark eddies.  The slightest misstep threatens to turn the reckless explorer into sewage bound for some subterranean marsh.

title: [Dirt Mines, Sluice]
description: Calcified sewage clogs the pipe, forcing the raging torrent of grey water into a narrow channel.  The stream struggles by in fits, like an angry mob pouring over a barricade.

title: [Dirt Mines, Sluice]
description: A large rusty grate blocks any further progress up the pipe.  Several rotted carcasses are pinioned against the grate, flailing in the constant wash of filth pouring over them.  Carried down from the warrens of the town sewers, the sounds of boots on cobblestone and muffled shouts slip between the rush and splash of the rancid river.

title: [Dirt Mines, Sluice]
description: Poorly milled timbers and lashed branches form a catwalk just above the surface of the malignant stream.  A few rusted tin pans and a bucket of dirt suggest that the kobolds conducted what they try to pass off as labor here.  The whole scene resembles a mining operation, normally reserved for gold and other minerals.  Could it be possible that the kobolds spend their days panning for dirt?

title: [Dirt Mines, Sluice]
description: The clay roof sags downward, drops of viscous orange liquid falling into the underground stream.  The walls have rotted outward, losing themselves in the rich earth and leaving miniature crumbly cliffs overhanging the water.  As a result, the stream is wider and shallower for several paces.

title: [Dirt Mines, Sluice]
description: Dirty waves break against the rounded sides of the pipe.  They crest in sets, sloshing first to one side and then to another.  The rhythmic echo reverberates against the hard clay louder than a monstrous waterfall.

title: [Dirt Mines, Sluice]
description: The thirsty roots of the forest hold the old sewer in a death grip, their fingers piercing the walls and ceiling and choking the stream.  This contest of strength is slower than the ponderous wrestling matches of Stone Trolls, but while the end may be centuries away, the outcome is certain.  Kiln-fired clay and masonry are no equal to these remorseless wooden hands.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: The drip-drop of water and the squish-squash of mud echo through these low tunnels and subterranean pockets.  Bubbles of foul smelling air struggle free from the muck nearby, splattering everything.  Not that you'd notice.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: Some northern tribes are said to have a hundred words for snow.  No doubt the kobolds would have two-hundred words for mud if they were conversationalists.  Your eyes throb with the dull pain of trying to distinguish one shade of brown from another in the seeping gloom.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: Moss and lichen hang from every solid surface.  Among them, small glowing beetles dangle in squirming clumps and flit about, making much more racket than anything so small has any business doing.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: Something slimy and sinewy is moving around beneath the mud, working its way about the room in sporadic jerks.  Hopefully it doesn't have teeth.  Near the north wall, a small skeletal hand juts up from the muck, clutching a dark object.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: Dark silt fills this small chamber almost to the roof.  The silt appears like solid ground, but everything that touches it seems to be sinking very slowly.  A weary traveller taking a nap here might wake up six feet under.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: A feeble geyser bubbles up under the mud, sloshing filth onto everything within twenty feet.  It is quite impossible to pass without becoming so wet and dirty that you're likely to be mistaken for a kobold.  You shudder at the thought and wonder how far the nearest bath is from this subterranean pit of indignity.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: Water runs down the walls in grimy rivulets, turning the muddy ground into a bog ahead.  There's no telling how deep it goes, but thankfully someone has placed several rotten planks across the mire, making an incomplete floor.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: It looks like something big has been rolling around in the muck here.  Whatever it was, you really hope you don't come across it.  A few tufts of hair can be seen sticking out of the mud.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: Great bubbles burst up from the mud on all sides, filling the chamber with a putrid smell of sulphur.  The overpowering odor probably reminds the kobolds of the rotten eggs their mothers used to serve for breakfast.  It just reminds you of kobolds.

title: [Dirt Mines, Mud Pits]
description: The mud in this high chamber has hardened into an almost solid clay.  Sticking out of the dark red gunk is an ancient crusted boot.  The owner seems to have gotten away.

title: [Wehnimer's Exterior, Pine Path]
description: The path beneath your feet has been strewn with fragrant pine needles.  Before you stands an arch of pine and spruce boughs, with wildflowers intertwined among them.

title: [Wedding Glade]
description: You are in a large glade, ringed by tall and majestic oaks.  At its farther end, two of these venerable trees stand entwined as a living symbol of two souls bonded in matrimony.  In the pale moonlight, the oaks almost look like lovers hugging, renewing their special bond.  A small rosewood altar is set before the large oak trees, and an arch of modwir pine and spruce boughs leads to a shady path.

You are in a large glade, ringed by tall and majestic oaks.  At its farther end, two of these venerable trees stand entwined as a living symbol of two souls bonded in matrimony.  In the filtered light, the oaks almost look like lovers hugging, renewing their special bond.  A small rosewood altar is set before the large oak trees, and an arch of modwir pine and spruce boughs leads to a shady path.

title: [Wehnimer's, Outside Dance Tent]
description: To one side of the wedding glade, a large tent of dark velvet has been erected.  You stand near the entrance flap through which you can see a large open space set aside for the evening's dancing and festivities.  From time to time, happy couples flushed from dancing and the warmth of the interior come out to cool themselves or to seek a quieter spot for a moment's kiss.

title: [Wehnimer's, East of Tent]
description: Here on the east side of the tent is a quiet shadowed spot removed from the noise and bustle of the party.  Off to one side, a group of trees provides a deeper shade over a mossy spot even more removed and private.

title: [Wehnimer's, Shady Bower]
description: This tree shaded bower seems miles away from the noise and bustle of the party within the tent nearby.  A thick cushion of dry leaves and soft moss beckons you to rest your weary feet and relax for a time.  Songbirds high up in the branches overhead provide a gentle harmony to the strains of music from the party.

title: [Wehnimer's, West of Tent]
description: Here on the west side of the tent, it is quieter.  Somehow the sounds of the revelry within are muted by the heavy fabric of the tent.  A copse of trees provides a quiet, shady spot even more removed from the noise and heat of the dancers.

title: [Wehnimer's, Mossy Bower]
description: A semi-circle of rocks covered thickly with moss makes a private retreat from the hubbub of the merrymaking within the tent nearby.  A gently rounded stone shelf serves as a bench made by some long forgotten craftsmen or a kindly nature.  The noise and strife of adventuring seem far away and almost forgotten in this island of tranquility.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: Flanked by several lush trees, a large and elaborate building stands to the north, its golden dome glinting in the sunlight.  Small benches are placed throughout the thriving courtyard, and small colonies of flowers have sprouted around them.  A narrow pathway of pure white cobblestones leads toward the structure and stretches back to a smaller building to the south.

Flanked by several lush trees, a large and elaborate building stands to the north, its pale golden dome glinting in the soft moonlight.  Small benches are placed throughout the thriving courtyard, and small colonies of flowers have sprouted around them.  A narrow pathway of pure white cobblestones leads toward the structure and stretches back to a smaller building to the south.

title: [Grey Wind Manor, Front Steps]
description: Tendrils of silver mist snake across the landscape in undulating waves, obscuring the ground.  Appearing out of the massive growth of the garden is a large manor, its windows warm with cool white light that shines through the shadows cast by the canopy of the trees that dwarf it.  There is an otherworldly quality to the light of the garden; with its lack of direct moon- or sunlight, one is left to question if it is even they which illuminate this green and mist-filled world.

Tendrils of silver mist snake across the landscape in undulating waves, obscuring the ground.  Appearing out of the massive growth of the garden is a large manor, painted the colors of an overcast sky, and permanently shadowed by the canopy of the trees that dwarf it.  There is an otherworldly quality to the light of the garden, with its lack of direct sunlight -- if it is even the sun that illuminates this green and mist-filled world.

title: [Gratkor's Cart]
description: This rather large cart, pulled by two placid-looking roltons, sits in the middle of a roped-off clearing.  One side of the cart has been folded down to make a short table, revealing piles of boxes and crates filling the interior.  Standing at either corner of the cart are two dwarven clerks, handling sales.  Hanging along the top of the cart is a large banner.  Along the front of the cart stands a weapon rack.  At the back of the cart is a modwir display case.

title: [Gemcutter's, Salon]
description: Set aside from the hustle and bustle of the front room, this cozy salon has an atmosphere of luxury and comfort.  A warm fire crackles in the hearth, and thick, colorful carpets cushion your steps.  Sparkling display cases show off the finest gems, exquisitely crafted and faceted to catch the warmth and brilliance of reflected light.

title: [Gemcutter's, Commodities]
description: Scattered around the room are colorful carpets with thick borders around the edges.  In the center of the shop, a gold veined marble counter holds a collection of objects, including a tiered jewelry stand.  Small shelves along the back wall hold an assortment of magical vessels.  On the opposite side of the shop are two tables, one holding figurines and the other holding miscellaneous items.  Nestled between the tables is a crystal stand resembling blocks of ice pieced together to create different levels upon which items are carefully arranged.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Overlook]
description: This small clearing reveals a view overlooking the moonlit reflections from Lake Eonak far below.  A few steps away, a narrow set of stairs lead up toward an imposing grey tower.  A broad path is barely visible at the end of the clearing.

This small clearing reveals a spectacular view of Lake Eonak and Wehnimer's Landing far below.  A few steps away, a narrow set of stairs lead up toward an imposing grey tower.  A large mountain blocks the sunlight and casts darkness along a broad path pushing down into a grassy valley.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Tower]
description: Looming before you stands a tall grey tower shrouded in a misty fog.  A courtyard surrounds the tower and is protected by a massive portcullis.  A thin blanket of mist flows toward a narrow set of stairs leading down.

Looming before you stands a tall grey tower silhouetted by a dark mountain.  A courtyard surrounds the tower and is protected by a massive portcullis.  A few steps away lie a narrow set of stairs leading down.

title: [Wizard Guild, Courtyard]
description: A few fireflies flit around the large courtyard of lush green grass.  The faint scent of twisted rose bushes wafts with the night air.  A dark glistening obelisk rests upon a pedestal in the center of the courtyard and a few lanterns light the doors to the guild foyer.

A large courtyard of lush green grass surrounds the guild.  The sweet scent of twisted rose bushes mingles with the fresh air.  A dark glistening obelisk rests upon a pedestal in the center of the courtyard and a few benches line the south wall of the guild fortifications.

title: [Wizard Guild, Foyer]
description: Thick plush carpets cover the flagstone floor and rich tapestries depicting the exploits of wizards of old hang from the walls.  A large mithril chandelier hangs from the arched ceiling, the numerous candles lighting up the entire room.

title: [Wizard Guild, Courtyard]
description: Across the expansive courtyard are scattered colorful lanterns that light up the well tended flowers and shrubbery.  At the center stands a magnificent fountain with water that catches the colorful light and sparkles as if a river of gemstones were pouring into the pool.

An expansive open courtyard at the heart of the guild is lined with brick walkways around the well tended flowers and shrubbery.  At the center of the courtyard stands a magnificent fountain, pouring forth water into a large pool.

title: [Wizard Guild, Day Room]
description: The long broad room is dimly lit by the light coming from the few occupied tables that hold lanterns.  A few candles are set up near the middle of a long counter that runs along a good portion of the opposite wall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Study Room]
description: Set within the southwestern tower, the rounded walls of this spacious study are obscured by several tapestries.  The large banners depict images of wizards clad in grandiose garb casting several spells of a classical elemental nature.  The soft sounds of the tapestries fluttering and the occasional quiet shuffling sounds of a student's feet mingle with each other, creating a peaceful background for contemplation.  A few chairs and tables stand scattered throughout the room.

title: [Wizard Guild, Private Room]
description: A brass candelabra and small fireplace light up the small comfortable room.  A few comfortable chairs and a small sofa are arranged to catch the warmth of the fire that dispels the night chill.  Except for quill and ink, there is only a brass lamp upon an otherwise immaculate desk.  The floor is covered with plush carpets and the walls with rich tapestries.

The small comfortable room has a few comfortable padded chairs and a small sofa arranged near a fireplace.  Except for quill and ink there is only a single large volume on an otherwise immaculate desk.  The floor is covered in plush carpets and the walls with rich tapestries.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stairway SE]
description: The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with a door.  Spaced out along the walls are eonake sconces that hold glowing torches that provides more than enough light to see by without any visible flame.  An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.

The narrow stairs wind their way up the tower far higher than one would expect only to end at a door at the top.  Light streams in from the narrow windows that ring the tower at evenly spaced intervals.

title: [Wizard Guild, Master Office]
description: Open windows let in faint moon and starlight along with an occasional cool night breeze.  The sparsely furnished room only has a few comfortable chairs and a big heavy desk.  A mithril chandelier that glows brightly without any sign of flame provides more than enough light along with the large fireplace.  One large plush carpet covers the flagstone floor from wall to wall.

Light streams in through large stained glass windows, colorfully lighting up the sparsely furnished room.  The spacious room only has a large heavy desk and a few chairs.  A large fireplace burns brightly, but doesn't give off much heat.  One plush carpet covers the flagstone floor from wall to wall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: Enormous book and scroll cases reach all the way to the ceiling and run along all the walls of this large room.  The chandeliers and large candelabra flanking the numerous tables burn with a bright inner light that illuminates even this immense room well enough to easily read by, but none show signs of candles or open flame.  Scrolls and books are stacked haphazardly on the tables, and even though there are more tables than wizards it still isn't enough room even at this late hour.

Enormous bookcases reaching all the way to the ceiling stretch the length and breadth of the room and smaller ones crisscross between the numerous wide tables.  Large brass candelabra flank the heavy tables, while forged mithril chandeliers hang from above.  Scrolls and books are stacked up haphazardly upon the tables and despite how many there are, there still isn't enough room to hold everything being used by the wizards currently absorbed in study.

title: [Wizard Guild Annex, Locus]
description: An offshoot of the courtyard, this small piazza is open to the sky and bounded by a circle of pillar-supported arches.  A cobblestone walk leads east and west, while smaller flagstone paths radiate outward in a semi-sunburst pattern from a centrally-located marble birdbath.  Covering the ground between the walks, creeping phlox creates pale lavender and white wedges of foliage above which night moths flit from flower to flower in the moonlight.

An offshoot of the courtyard, this small piazza is open to the sky and bounded by a circle of pillar-supported arches.  A cobblestone walk leads east and west, while smaller flagstone paths radiate outward in a semi-sunburst pattern from a centrally-located marble birdbath.  Covering the ground between the walks, creeping phlox creates bright lavender and white wedges of foliage above which bumblebees and butterflies flit from flower to flower in the sunlight.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Annex, Water Workshop]
description: Walls of sea foam green are illuminated by diffuse rays of moonlight that saturate the room through frosted glass windows acid-etched with the alchemical symbol for water.  Crafted of gnarled natural driftwood, wall sconces cradle pillar candles whose flickering flames glitter off bits of colorful sea glass inlaid in the aqua ceramic tile flooring.  The musical tinkling of a wind chime can be heard from high above the brushed steel workbench as gentle breezes trickle in from the piazza.

title: [Annex, Wind Workshop]
description: Walls painted the subtle hues of a desert sunset, and overlaid with wind-blown cloud wisps, are illuminated by diffuse rays of moonlight that saturate the room through frosted glass windows etched with the alchemical symbol for wind.  Resembling metal box kites, wall sconces cradle pillar candles whose flickering flames glitter off eagle feathers inlaid in azure ceramic tile flooring.  The musical tinkling of a wind chime can be heard from high above the brushed steel workbench as gentle breezes trickle in from the piazza.

title: [Annex, Lightning Workshop]
description: Storm grey walls, painted with jagged lightning bolts and ominous dark clouds, are illuminated by diffuse rays of moonlight that saturate the room through frosted glass windows etched with the alchemical symbol for energy.  Stark white tree branches, oddly singed and naked of bark, form wall sconces whose flickering candle flames glitter off gold flecks in the ebon ceramic floor tile.  The musical tinkling of a wind chime can be heard from high above the brushed steel workbench as gentle breezes trickle in from the piazza.

title: [Annex, Ice Workshop]
description: Walls of pale ice blue, painted with silver snowflakes, are illuminated by diffuse rays of moonlight that saturate the room through frosted glass windows etched with the alchemical symbols for water and cold.  Crafted of walrus tusk, wall sconces cradle pillar candles whose flickering flames glitter off cut crystal tile flooring that resembles blocks of ice.  The musical tinkling of a wind chime can be heard from high above the brushed steel workbench as gentle breezes trickle in from the piazza.

title: [Annex, Earth Workshop]
description: Sand-colored walls, lined half-way up with woven rattan matting, are illuminated by diffuse rays of moonlight that saturate the room through frosted glass windows etched with the alchemical symbol for earth.  Crafted of unfired clay pottery, wall sconces cradle pillar candles whose flickering flames glitter off tiny bits of quartz inlaid in the umber ceramic tile flooring.  The musical tinkling of a wind chime can be heard from high above the brushed steel workbench as gentle breezes trickle in from the piazza.

title: [Annex, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Annex, Fire Workshop]
description: Walls of smoky grey, painted with lambent red, yellow, and orange flames, are illuminated by diffuse rays of moonlight that saturate the room through frosted glass windows etched with the alchemical symbol for fire.  Crafted of half-charred wood, wall sconces cradle pillar candles whose flickering flames glitter off bits of volcanic glass inlaid in the crimson ceramic tile flooring.  The musical tinkling of a wind chime can be heard from high above the brushed steel workbench as gentle breezes trickle in from the piazza.

title: [Annex, Reagent Room]
description: Dwarfing the broad fel worktable in the center of the room, row upon row of polished steel shelves line the walls.  Each wall shelf, as well as several additional cabinets and shelving units, is filled to near capacity with a diverse array of cork-stoppered flasks and bottles.  Though most are meticulously labeled, the lettering on some has long since faded.  Mortar and pestle sets, funnels, droppers, and assorted laboratory utensils are conveniently located on the tabletop.

title: [Annex, Equipment Room]
description: Amid the cobwebs of this dark and musty storeroom are a number of lockers and cabinets, some secured by large padlocks or ominous runes.  Disorganized piles of equipment lie strewn across shelves and heaped in corners with seemingly little effort given to care or cleanliness.  A free-standing modwir closet, missing its door, holds brooms, some heavy iron dust pans, and other cleaning supplies.

title: [Annex, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Wizard Guild, Study Room]
description: Dark modwir tables gleam softly in the pale blue light cast by several small crystalline orbs set in the center of the tables.  A quiet thrumming sound is heard every few moments from the dark spheres as they occasionally dim and then glow stronger.  The subtle, rhythmically-shifting illumination provides a peaceful atmosphere for relaxing study.

title: [Wizard Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: The hall is so large that the lanterns along the walls and chandeliers hanging from the vaulted ceiling only manage to cast the room in a dim light.  Despite this, a gilt lectern on the far side of the room glimmers in the faint light and almost seems to shine.  Countless rows of benches and chairs arrayed about the hall are like huddled shapes in the dark bowing down before the light of the lectern upon the raised floor.

Countless rows of cushioned benches and chairs line this meeting hall that stretches beyond even the northernmost battlements.  A raised floor on the far side of the hall holds a wide lectern and a few stately chairs aligned across the back.  Light streams in through stained glass windows above, casting the near walls in a colorful tapestry of light.

title: [Wizard Guild, Study Room]
description: The first floor of the northeast tower is a spacious study, yet small for a single room in a tower of this size.  A large slab of black slate has been framed in oak and fastened to the wall and used to display symbols and runes.  A few well worn tables and chairs are scattered about the room and some steep stairs spiral high up into the tower.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stairway NW]
description: The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with a door.  Spaced out along the walls are bronze sconces that hold glowing torches that provides more than enough light to see by without any visible flame.  An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.

The narrow stairs wind their way up the tower far higher than one would expect only to end at a door at the top.  Light streams in from the narrow windows that ring the tower at evenly spaced intervals.

title: [Wizard Guild, Observatory]
description: The top of the tower is open to the elements and a cold steady wind tugs at you.  A few glow globes spaced about the low tower wall barely provide enough illumination to see by, but you can clearly see the glowing designs of the star charts and constellations inlaid in the granite walls.  A tremendous, gleaming telescope pointing towards the starfilled night sky dominates the center of the tower.  Far below you can see the street lanterns of Wehnimer's Landing spread out like a crystal latticework.

The top of the tower is open to the elements and a steady wind tugs at you.  A tremendous, gleaming silver telescope pointing towards the sky dominates the center of the tower.  Engraved into the thick marble wall surrounding the top of the tower are star charts and constellations inlaid with mithglin, which gleams brightly when the sun strikes it.  You can see all of Wehnimer's Landing spread out below you from here.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stairway NE]
description: The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with a door.
