An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.

The narrow stairs wind their way up the tower far higher than one would expect only to end at a door at the top.  Light streams in from the narrow windows that ring the tower at evenly spaced intervals.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: The spacious room has a large worktable set up in the center, above which floats a large clear crystal orb that glows, sending light sparkling off the alabaster walls.  Arcane runes and symbols are inlaid in the black polished floors, which gleam with no trace of dust to be seen.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stairway SW]
description: The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with a door.  Spaced out along the walls are iron sconces that hold glowing torches that provides more than enough light to see by without any visible flame.  An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.

The narrow stairs wind their way up the tower far higher than one would expect only to end at an iron-bound door at the top.  Light streams in from the narrow windows that ring the tower at evenly spaced intervals.

The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with an iron-bound door.  Spaced out along the walls are iron sconces that hold glowing torches that provides more than enough light to see by without any visible flame.  An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.

title: [Wizard Guild, Atrium]
description: The star-filled sky shows clearly through the clear-cut crystal that covers the top of the tower, yet keeps out the cool night air.  The room is warm and humid and the air is heavy with the scent of tropical flowers.  You can hear the trickle and splash of water from somewhere in the dark dense foliage, filling the broad room with all manner of dark, monstrous shapes.

Lush greenery of tropical plants and flowers fills the broad room.  Pools and fountains of splashing water are hidden within the dense foliage.  The cries of numerous birds ring throughout the top of the tower that is covered with a clear cut crystal that lets in sunlight and warmth, making the room hot and humid.

title: [Henty's Depot, Entry]
description: The walls of the warehouse are left unpainted, their rough-hewn plank sides apparently made of pine, given the fragrance.  The warm, pale color of the pine siding indicates the newness of the building.  A small office sits to the west while a steady stream of townsfolk and shoppers head due east.

title: [Henty's Depot, Permit Office]
description: Pale blue carpet covers the floor in this tidy little office.  Wooden models of buildings crowd the surface of a stained oak cabinet that is nestled between two plant stands.  Resting on the corner of the polished oak desk is a glass oil lamp.  The flame of the lamp dances across neatly stacked papers which are bound by a thin cord on the desk.

title: [Henty's Depot, Facades]
description: An assortment of tables and counters have been arranged in orderly rows based on size.  Entrepreneurs shuffle around the bulky merchandise in search of a piece to fit their invidual needs.  The scratched wooden planks of the floor bear the scars and wear of the store's constant foot traffic.

title: [Henty's Depot, Roofs]
description: Curious passersby press their faces against the windows, gazing the wonderful displays on the floor.  Evenly spaced along the walls are brass sconces that illuminate this corner in a soft, golden light.  Several patrons pause to rest on decorative seating beside a pair of glass-topped tables.

title: [Henty's Depot, Ceilings]
description: A massive ramp runs along side some stairs connecting the first and second floors of the building.  Stacks of sealed crates have been marked with red paint, gathering dust while awaiting transport up the ramp.  Beside an open window with a clear view of the street, a varnished maple stand holds a thick tome listing the store inventory.

title: [Henty's Depot, Floors]
description: Rows of beautifully carved stands have been arranged against the wall, their polished veneers gleaming in the sunlight.  A shop clerk occasionally patrols the long aisle and adjusts the pricing of the wares, tearing off the old tags and disposing them in an iron wastebasket.

Rows of beautifully carved stands have been arranged against the wall, their polished veneers gleaming in the dim torchlight.  A shop clerk occasionally patrols the long aisle and adjusts the pricing of the wares, tearing off the old tags and disposing them in an iron wastebasket.

title: [Henty's Depot, Walls]
description: Amid the bartering of merchants, the furniture showcased in this section of the store all reflect deep, rich earth tones.  Lingering in the air is the faint scent of leather, although there is no apparent hide in this area.  Gold-accented plaques proudly display the artisan who created each piece.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: Moonlight teases the area from the ceiling, hinting at the unreachable surface above.  Unnatural yellow fires burn steadily in bronze fire bowls along the path, but emanate no heat.
Daylight teases the area from the ceiling, hinting at the unreachable surface above.  Unnatural yellow fires burn steadily in bronze fire bowls along the path, but emanate no heat.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: The paths opens into a small room dotted with the scattered remnants of torn and rotted tapestries along its floor and walls.  An unusual geometric design has been carved into the center of the floor, directly beneath an opening in the ceiling high above.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: The path continues up a set of marble stairs flanked by a fire bowl.  The smell of rot is strong, smothering the area with its stench.  At the top of the stairway is a large, dark altar, its surface covered and stained with blood.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: A large stone statue stands in the center of the hall, illuminated by the series of firepits that circle it.  The statue depicts a warrior-king, but his face has been scratched, chipped, and marred.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: This section of the hallway widens, and large marble pillars connect ceiling to floor.  Torn and mutilated portraits hang from the walls, their depictions deformed and defaced by time.  Several doorways line the hall, but each has been blockaded by furniture or collapsed rubble.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: The near-overpowering stench of death and decay clings to the end of the hall.  Large splatters of blood mar the room, often used to creative primitive and violent paintings on the walls.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: Shadows creep along the length of the floor, streaming in through the large opening in the ceiling high above.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: Deep grooves and gashes carved into the walls and floor form a series of archaic runes.  Torn tapestries and shattered artifacts have been tossed away from the carvings and now lie scattered about in pieces.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Trail]
description: This rough, difficult trail leads up into the foothills towards the Trollfang Mountains.  The trees in this area are sparse and become even thinner at higher altitudes.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Trail]
description: The trail follows the contours of the low peaks of the foothills.  You are forced to take great care selecting your footing because of loose rocks and uneven ground.  One bad step could send you tumbling down a slope strewn with sharp, jagged rocks.

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen, Booth]
description: A group of black candles sits atop the dark ebonwood table, their flames illuminating the cramped space and unadorned walls.  A rendition of clouds gathering across a roiling sea is painted along the arcing, low ceiling in dark shades.  An iron porthole is inset upon the nearest wall, the edges of its thick glass flecked with bits of grime that break the sunlight streaming through into fractured beams.  The table is devoid of any decoration save for a small drawing in the middle of its surface.

A group of black candles sits atop the dark ebonwood table, their flames illuminating the cramped space and unadorned walls.  A rendition of clouds gathering across a roiling sea is painted along the arcing, low ceiling in dark shades.  An iron porthole is inset upon the nearest wall, the edges of its thick glass flecked with bits of grime that fracture the soft moonlight streaming in.  The table is devoid of any decoration save for a small drawing in the middle of its surface.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Trail]
description: A single old gnarled tree is perched precariously on the edge of an overhanging ledge on the slope above; a testament to the ability of life in any form to withstand adversity and relentlessly deny failure.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Trail]
description: To the southeast, the trail rises toward the saddle between two low peaks.  The area is rocky and barren except for a few scrub bushes and some sparse clumps of tall monkey grass.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Trail]
description: You stand at a high pass between two higher peaks.  To the northwest, the trail leads down, out of the foothills.  The southeast trail leads deeper into the Trollfang Mountains.  Looking either side of the pass, you can see isolated patches of low lying fog.  The silvery sheen of the misty patches bears out the reason that this place is called "The Land of the Silver Mists."

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocky Trail]
description: A stream cuts across the path here where a small copse of trees has sprung up, taking advantage of the water source.  A steep path plunges suddenly downward to the east, into a small lush valley.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Foothills]
description: With rocks, stones and boulders all around, you see few bushes and fewer trees breaking up the desolate brown of the surrounding high country.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Foothills]
description: The footing along this trail is treacherous.  You are occasionally caught off balance as the scree underfoot shifts when you walk on it.  You can occasionally hear a boulder rolling down some unseen slope, causing minor rock slides.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Foothills]
description: At one time a trail probably wound around this cliff face both to the north and south.  It now appears that an avalanche has destroyed the southern part of the trail.  However, in addition to the north bound trail, a high ledge offers some promise of passage.  The cliff face seems to have been weathered and worn almost into a natural stair leading up to the high ledge.  It should be fairly easy to get up there.

title: [Lysierian Hills, High Ridge]
description: From here you can look down on the foothills to the north and east.  The high ridge follows the contour of an even higher peak and it looks like you could fairly easily negotiate a way down the cliff face below.

title: [Lysierian Hills, High Ridge]
description: As you make your way along this ridge, you can see a dense forest to the southwest and barren foothills to the northeast.  There is no obvious safe passage in either of these directions, so you are forced to follow the ridge either to the north or to the southeast.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Promontory]
description: You are standing on a rocky promontory, gazing up at the steep cliffs of a high peak to the west.  A high ridge leads away to the south, promising passage down into the foothills.  In the side of the cliff you can make out a small cave opening.  There is a faint odor of charcoal rising out of the opening.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: This small cave is dimly lit by the light shining in from the opening at the east end.  There is a gritty layer of some strange black dirt underfoot that leaves black smudges on anything it touches.  The walls and ceiling of the cave are also covered in the same black grit.

title: [Smokey Cave, Tunnel]
description: You are in a wide straight tunnel that stretches from the southeast to the northwest.  The tunnel branches in two directions at the northwest end.  Everything here continues to be covered in the same black gritty substance.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: There is a strong odor in the air, as if someone had recently built a camp fire in this cave.  The floor, walls and ceiling of this cavern are covered in the same black grit as the outer cavern.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: You find yourself in a small dead-end cavern.  The ceiling here is very low.  Again, all surfaces are covered with a fine black grit.

title: [Smokey Cave, Tunnel]
description: You are in a broad twisting tunnel.  There is a strong odor of burnt wood pervading the entire area.  The floor, walls and ceiling of the entire length of this tunnel are covered in the same fine black grit as you have seen throughout all of these caves.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: You are in a huge, irregularly shaped cavern.  It appears as if shallow hollows have been carved from the stone walls all around the cavern.  Each of the hollows is approximately 7 feet long, 4 feet high and 4 feet deep, and all appear to be empty.  All surfaces are covered with a fine black grit.

title: [Smokey Cave, Tunnel]
description: As you progress down the tunnel, the black grit that seems to cover everything grinds underfoot.  All echoes of your footfalls sound muffled and any sounds you make will not travel very far.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: This large round cavern has a high, domed ceiling.  A huge stalactite descends from the ceiling at the center of the cavern, reaching down to within inches of the cavern floor.  The same black grit seems to cover everything.

title: [Smokey Cave, Tunnel]
description: This broad tunnel branches off in three directions, each branch being straight and smooth.  A fine black grit covers the floor, walls and ceiling of the tunnel.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: The floor of this small cavern dips at the center to form a small basin.  The black grit that seems to cover everything has collected in the depression.  The thick collection of grit moves in waves when it is disturbed, almost as if it were a liquid.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: A faint, greenish light fills this cavern.  You notice that the light stems from the lichen-covered walls.  In spaces between the lichen, flow a few grainy rivulets.  The ground is covered with heaps of dark grit, which makes walking rather difficult.  A jagged crevice can be seen in the shadows.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: Though most of the cavern walls are scorched black, enough lichen grows to add an eerie light.  The dark, sandy ground seems to show signs that something large is roaming these caverns.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: Large, lichen-covered stalactites hang from the low cavern ceiling.  Should one of them fall on you, it would surely mean your death.  The treacherously loose ground doesn't really help matters much at all.

title: [Blackened Cave, Tunnel]
description: This narrow tunnel is quite dark.  You can feel the smooth walls as you endeavor to move around.  The tunnel walls seem to have a glazed texture -- as if they've been subjected to some form of extreme heat.

title: [Blackened Cave, Chamber]
description: This giant, underground chamber is filled with stalactites and stalagmites of every size.  The sound of dripping water echoes through the grotto, the water collecting in a shallow pool nearby.  Strange forms of fungi grow everywhere, adding to the otherworldly atmosphere of this place.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: Though the cavern is dark and shadowy, you can see some claw-marks etched deeply into the walls.  A dank, musky smell hangs heavily in the air, and you have to really concentrate not to cough.  Who knows what kind of beasts might be attracted by the sound and the poor soul making it?  Judging by the size of the claw-marks, it is probably best to be a bit cautious.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: A large stalagmite juts up near the dark cavern walls.  You might be able to squeeze by it, if you suck in your tummy.  The ground is covered with black, gritty sand.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: This cavern looks like it's hollowed out of obsidian -- hollowed out by the massive fist of nature.  Sharp obsidian shards cover the ground, crunching with every step you take.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: This dark cavern doesn't hold much of interest.  Unless, of course, you consider the heavy air of danger that hangs over you with suffocating familiarity.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: In the darkness you can barely make out an old tree trunk propped up against a ledge.  Someone has gone to great trouble to drag the trunk in here and hoist it against the ledge.  If safety awaits up there, it was bought with a lot of sweat.

title: [Blackened Cave, Ledge]
description: This ledge might not be very large, but a modicum of safety certainly outweighs any inconvenience.  There is evidence that someone has tried to enlarge the ledge by chipping at the walls.  Pieces of rock are strewn all about.  An old tree trunk leans against the lip of the ledge.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Downhill Path]
description: The path plunges steeply down out of the foothills to lower lands below.  The area is thickly forested, as if the trees were massing for an assault on the barren high country above.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Downhill Path]
description: The sky above is completely hidden from view by the thick foliage of the surrounding forest.  The thick overhang of tree limbs only adds to the night's thick darkness, making it well nigh impossible to see

The sky above is completely hidden from view by the thick foliage of the surrounding forest.  The path is dim, lit only by a dull green glow from above.  However, the area to the east seems to be a bit brighter.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Clearing]
description: You find yourself in a small open clearing.  At the center of the clearing is an odd ring of multicolored mushrooms.  Disturbingly, a hushed silence seems to have fallen over the entire area.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Years of fallen leaves and twigs carpet the path so thickly that no sign of the dirt beneath can be seen.  Trailing vines slither across the trail, tunneling in and out of the debris like a snake moving through a burrow.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Winding Path]
description: This path, threading in and out of the trees, winds downward to the lush valley below.  Another steep path leads up onto the densely forested ridges high above you.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Winding Path]
description: The path winds in and out of the dense forest that surrounds you.  Normally there is a great number of small game throughout this area during the day.  At night, however, the forest falls silent, save for the occasional hoot of an owl or snarl of a lone predator.

The path winds in and out of the dense forest that surrounds you.  There is a great number of small game throughout this area.  Colorful birds perched in the trees pipe their questioning songs at you.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Winding Path]
description: This path seems to be leading you on a wild tour through the forest, first turning this way, then that way.  You probably have not covered very much ground when measured in a straight line.  Even so, it seems as if you have been walking forever.

title: [Lysierian Hills, High Ridge]
description: You are on a high ridge that runs from east to west.  Below you, the floor of the lush valley is dotted with isolated patches of eerily moonlit fog.  On the slopes above, the forest is much denser.
You are on a high ridge that runs from east to west.  Below you, the floor of the lush valley is dotted with isolated patches of fog.  On the slopes above, the forest is much denser.

title: [Lysierian Hills, High Ridge]
description: You can see the river snaking its way across the valley floor below.  Gazing down across the entire valley, you think it looks like an excellent place to make a home.  In fact, there seems to be a small village, or at least a group of buildings, at the far end.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Steep Gully]
description: This gully cuts sharply down to the valley floor.  The sides look steep and dangerous, so your choice is to go down towards the valley or head up to the ridge.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Steep Gully]
description: A tall pine tree has fallen across the gully at this point, forming a natural arch.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Green Valley]
description: Here amid the thick grass and lush forest of this serene valley, you happen upon a small crystal clear lake.  Two large willow trees bend gracefully in the cool night breeze, their long boughs dipping down to trace delicate patterns on the surface of the moonlit water.  Near the center of the lake, a small, dark island covered with a thicket of pine trees draws your attention.

Here amid the emerald green grass and lush forest of this lovely valley, you happen upon a small crystal clear lake.  Two large willow trees bend gracefully in the slight breeze, their long boughs dipping down to trace delicate patterns on the surface of the shimmering water.  Near the center of the lake, a small island covered with a thicket of pine trees draws your attention.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Marliese]
description: Here at the shallowest part of the lake, thick blades of grass just break the surface of the water.  A chorus of frogs croak out their welcome, their guttural night song echoing with an odd harmony across the valley.

Here at the shallowest part of the lake, bright green blades of grass just break the surface of the water.  A chorus of frogs croak out their welcome, their guttural song echoing with an odd harmony across the valley.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Green Valley]
description: This pleasant valley is lightly forested, and the widely spaced trees allow for easy travel.  You can just barely discern a few buildings through the trees to the northeast.

This pleasant valley is a rich and healthy green.  It is lightly forested, so the widely spaced trees allow for easy travel.  You can just barely discern a few buildings through the trees to the northeast.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Ruined Village]
description: What was probably once a narrow street cutting between the old crumbling buildings of this abandoned village, is now a carpet of thick grass.  Most of the buildings have collapsed, leaving little more than a few rocky foundations.  One small cottage nearby, however, seems to be mostly intact, and there is also a small shack standing to one side of the grassy street.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Shack]
description: Other than grass sprouting from the dirt floor, this room is nearly empty.  Dead leaves shift with each gust of air, their rasping sound mingling with the creaking of an exposed wooden rafter.

Other than grass sprouting from the dirt floor, this room is nearly empty.  Dead leaves shift with each gust of air, their rasping sound mingling with the lilting song of birds nesting along a wooden rafter.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Cottage]
description: A pile of broken wood and scraps might have been the furnishings of the great room of this cottage, but it is little more than kindling now.  All of the windows here have been broken, and the doors have been removed or smashed.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Bedroom]
description: A draft from the open doorway stirs up a cloud of dust that makes you sneeze.  Looking around it is easy to see why: a thick layer of dust covers the hardwood floors and collects in the corners of the room.  Most of the furnishings have been removed over time, and now only a broken bed remains amid the debris and dirt.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Ruined Village]
description: Though the village now lies in silence, it is easy to imagine a much livelier time.  Many structures are near ruins, but a few still stand as testament to the builders' craftsmanship.  A large log building sprawls out to the west, with a sign still mounted over the doorway.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Shack]
description: Several harmless, furry creatures scurry to hide among numerous crevices in the floor and walls.  Strips of rotting wood that might have been barrels at one time are scattered throughout the otherwise empty room.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Cottage]
description: Other than a few birds seeking shelter from the weather up among the rafters, this old cottage is almost completely empty.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Bedroom]
description: This small room attached to the larger great room of the cottage was probably the master bedroom.  It is completely empty now, except for a few small bushes that have sprung up through the floor near the window of the north wall.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Ruined Village]
description: The largest building you have seen in the village stands to the north.  There is a long porch across its front.  Another small shack is still standing on the southeast side of the grass covered street.  To the northeast, a tall cliff face cuts across the valley.  An opening in the cliff face, which appears to be the entrance to an old mine, is shored by large timbers.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Saloon]
description: The old saloon looks as if it has seen a few too many wild parties.  All of the tables, benches and chairs have been broken and scattered about the room.  On the north wall, a long bar looks as though it has been bashed with battering rams.  Overhead, a large chandelier dangles precariously from the ceiling, the bolts that fasten it nearly ripped from their moorings.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Saloon Kitchen]
description: A large stone fireplace and oven make up the entire south wall of this room.  Again, all of the furnishings have been broken and scattered across the floor.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Shack]
description: There is no telling what used to be stored in the crates that now lie shattered on the floor of this shack.  There are a few rusted pieces of iron that may have once been farming tools.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Store Porch]
description: The porch is long and narrow, spanning the entire length of the building.  Some of the boards are badly worn and rotten, probably ready to collapse at any moment.  At one end, a path meanders back toward the village, and in the center, you see a doorway leading into the store.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Store]
description: A potbellied stove occupies the center of the room, its squat black body now covered with dust and cobwebs.  Some shelves still hang on the walls, but most have fallen down from the brackets that held them.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, out

title: [Lysierian Hills, Great Room]
description: A small fireplace occupies the east wall of this otherwise empty room.  The wood floor creaks loudly as you walk across it.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Store Bedroom]
description: The windows of this small room have been shuttered closed.  The glass panes, however, have been shattered and their shards scattered across the worn wood floor.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Storeroom]
description: Rows of wooden shelves, some collapsed, some standing, line the walls of this room.  A large sturdy trunk whose lid has been torn off is sitting in one of the cobwebbed corners.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: The large timbers shoring up the entrance of the mine have mostly rotted away so that the entire area looks unsafe.  There is a set of badly rusted rails running down the center of the tunnel into the old abandoned mine.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: Dust coated rails snake through from west to southeast, then disappear into the darkness beyond.  The sound of water dripping echoes down dark and musty corridors, setting your teeth on edge with its constant, steady rhythm.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: This short straight tunnel runs from the north to the south and its walls have been worked so that they are nearly smooth.  There are no beams or timbers supporting the passage, but they are probably not needed as this tunnel has been carved from solid rock.  You can hear the steady drip of water from somewhere to the north.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Cavern]
description: Unlike other sections of the mine, where the walls have been relatively smooth, all of the surfaces of this cavern are rough and uneven.  A colorful variety of stalagmites and stalactites present curious and grotesque images all around you.  Water runs down the sides of the strange formations, and drips into a shallow pool that has formed at the bottom of the cavern.  A strong pungent odor similar to vinegar is in the air.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Dead-end Tunnel]
description: This short, dead-end tunnel is featureless.  To the northwest, you can hear the steady sound of water dripping.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Cold Tunnel]
description: The rails end here, at an odd looking wooden barricade.  An old mine cart lies overturned against one wall of smooth rock.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Dead-end Tunnel]
description: The rock wall at the end of this short tunnel shows signs of having been chipped by the miners that have now abandoned this old dig.  The atmosphere is damp, and there is a sheen of moisture on all the corridor's surfaces.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Diggings]
description: Broken and rusted tools lie scattered on the ground surrounding a large hole at the end of the tunnel.  It appears as if those who worked this mine had decided to start a vertical shaft here.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Shaft]
description: This shaft is narrower than it appeared from above ground, and you tense as a sudden wave of claustrophobia threatens to overtake you.  A boulder has worked loose from one earthen wall, and now rests on the floor, making the space seem even more cramped.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Mudslide]
description: A wall of mud slopes down into this small, cramped space from a height of nearly eight feet, to a viscous layer covering the ground.  Here and there, stalactites pierce the mud ceiling overhead, making every movement an exercise in agility.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Storage]
description: Broken equipment, rusted with age, pokes up from beneath the thick layer of mud and slime covering the floor.  A creaking sound nearby breaks the silence, but closer inspection proves it is only a slight shifting of some old boards used to brace the walls.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Tunnel]
description: The stone floors in this narrow passageway are stable enough, but the boulders jutting out from the walls appear to be teetering precariously from whatever holds them in place.  Faint light is visible at what is probably the northern end of the tunnel, though the winding path snaking through the depths of the mine make it difficult to be certain of compass directions.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Tunnel]
description: Like a large snake, the tunnel slithers through the darkness, spiraling and twisting downward.  Soft moonlight spills in from a narrow opening, illuminating a stone shelf crudely chiseled into the western wall.

Like a large snake, the tunnel slithers through the darkness, spiraling and twisting downward.  Soft light spills in from a narrow opening, illuminating a stone shelf crudely chiseled into the western wall.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Cavern]
description: Faint moonlight trickles down from fissures in the natural ceiling high overhead, dappling the floor below and glancing off the hundreds of stalagmites and stalactites that have turned this chamber into a ghostly collection of white and grey pillars.

Light trickles down from fissures in the natural ceiling high overhead, dappling the floor below and glancing off the hundreds of stalagmites and stalactites that have turned this chamber into a symphony of brilliant color.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Cavern]
description: An enormous boulder juts out from the southeastern wall, making passage in that direction impossible.  Directly south, several huge stalactites have fused together to form a graceful, natural arch overhead.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Cavern]
description: The rhythmic sound of water dripping against stone somewhere beyond this immense cavern echoes pleasantly in the darkness.  Here amid some of her most beautiful creations, the sweet music of Nature at work is both a reminder of the past and a promise for the future.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Cavern]
description: A crystalline garden, glittering softly in the subdued light, is gradually taking over this section of the cavern.  The delicately colored growths have cascaded down the northern wall and have begun to creep up the forest of stalagmites rising from the center of the chamber.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Cavern]
description: The northern wall of the cavern is shadowed by the unusually large formation of stalagmites in the center of the chamber.  Even so, the colors are vibrant and rich beyond compare.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Cavern]
description: Odd outcroppings of rock and calcium deposits angle sharply downward from ceiling to floor in this part of the cavern, creating the illusion of a giant mouth poised to crunch down on some tasty morsel.  To the northeast there is a break in the stalagmite formation that dominates the center of the chamber.

title: [Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: Tall columns of limestone surge upward from floor to ceiling, mingling there with splendid formations of multicolored stalactites that drape like a magical canopy over this enchanting forest.  At the very highest point of the expansive ceiling, a large cluster of crystals have formed, and each flicker of light passing through the natural prisms splits into thin beams that dance across the cavern.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Marliese]
description: From this angle, the surface of the lake appears to be covered with diamonds.  Moonlight shimmers off the water all around you, providing a flickering counterpoint to the starry night sky.
From this angle, the surface of the lake appears to be covered with diamonds.  Light shimmers off the water all around you, almost blinding you to anything beyond this spot.
From this angle, the surface of the lake appears silver.  Moonlight casts slivers of silver along the crystal lake.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Marliese]
description: The water here is so clear, you can see through to the lakebed beneath.  Slender, light gray reeds push their way up from the rich soil, contrasting beautifully with dark gray stones, their surfaces polished smooth by time and tide.

The water here is so clear, you can see through to the lakebed beneath.  Slender green reeds push their way up from the rich soil, contrasting beautifully with brilliant blue stones, their surfaces polished smooth by time and tide.
The water here is clear.  Slender, light gray reeds push their way up from the rich soil, their surfaces polished smooth by time and tide.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Small Island]
description: Towering pines ring the edge of this small island, their fragrance wafting about you on each wisp of a breeze.  Wildflowers, their colors washed away by the greying moonlight, carpet the ground, and mingle with honeysuckle to creep up the stone walls of a small shrine that stands in the center of the circle of trees.  From somewhere nearby, an owl calls out its strange song, and is answered by another deeper in the forest.

Towering pines ring the edge of this small island, their fragrance wafting about you on each wisp of a breeze.  Wildflowers in vibrant hues of pink, yellow, red, and blue carpet the ground, and mingle with honeysuckle to creep up the stone walls of a small shrine that stands in the center of the circle of trees.  From somewhere nearby, a loon calls out its strange song, and is answered by the chirping of other small birds of the forest.

title: [Lysierian Hills, A Small Shrine]
description: Though there is no door to shut out the world beyond, a feeling of utter tranquility envelops you here.  The soothing reminders of the forests are everywhere, wrapping you in a blanket of calm and serenity.  Heavy woven rugs cover the floors, and nestle against walls lined with polished mahogany.  In the center of the room, a simple stone altar rises up from the midst of a tiny garden of carefully tended, sweetly scented herbs.

Though there is no door to shut out the world beyond, a feeling of utter tranquility envelops you here.  The richest colors of the forests are everywhere, wrapping you in a blanket of calm and serenity.  Heavy woven rugs of dark green and brown cover the floors, and nestle against walls lined with polished mahogany.  In the center of the room, a simple stone altar rises up from the midst of a tiny garden of carefully tended, sweetly scented herbs.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Trail]
description: This heavily forested trail cuts sharply up and down the steep slopes high in the foothills of the Trollfang Mountains.  There are many large boulders and short cliff faces, and the trail meanders between these various obstacles.  To the northwest a path leads up along a high ridge that stretches out to the west.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Trail]
description: Just off to one side of the trail, a common spider has constructed a huge web between two trees.  It is difficult to make out in the moonlight, but you can see that it stretches up at least six feet off the ground and some four or five feet from side to side.  An overgrown trail winds its way around the web, as if in deference to the integrity of the spider's creation.

Just off to one side of the trail, a common spider has constructed a huge web between two trees.  The sun glints off the threads of the intricately woven web, and you can see that it stretches up at least six feet off the ground and some four or five feet from side to side.  An overgrown trail winds its way around the web, as if in deference to the integrity of the spider's creation.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Trail]
description: The trail here used to split in three directions, but a rockfall blocks what was the southeast path; there appears to be no way around it.  A large boulder standing just west of the fork in the trail looks somewhat like a large hand pointing a single finger at the southwest leg of the trail.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Shore]
description: You are standing at the north end of a long lake.  The water is clear and blue, and looks to be pure and clean.  Looking out across the lake, you can see a tall waterfall at the south end of the lake, cascading down high cliffs to feed the lake.  However, you can see no river or stream carrying the water of the lake away.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Shore]
description: Tall grasses and reeds grow at the edge of the lake and you can see fish, frogs and other small creatures living in and around it.  The sounds of the waterfall that feeds the lake makes a low rumble of background noise.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Shore]
description: A high cliff runs from east to west, forming the southern edge of the lake.  The surrounding forest grows down to within a few feet of the lake shore at this point.  There is even one old willow that grows at the very edge of the lake; the gnarled roots of the old tree dipping into the water, reminding you of an old man attempting to cool his tired feet.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Shore]
description: The long lake that spreads out before you looks peaceful and pleasant.  The water at the base of the waterfall churns and bubbles, but the disturbances caused by the falling water are localized and do not spread far, indicating that the lake is very deep indeed.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake Shore]
description: Standing this near to the waterfall, the roar of the water pounding on the rocks at the base of the cliff drowns out all other sound.  A natural jetty of rocks reaches out into the lake and across the base of the cliffs.  The waterfall descends in several stages, disrupted by outcroppings of rock, causing it to fall in a series of tiers and spreading out to a wide curtain of falling water.

title: [Abandoned Trail]
description: Overgrown almost to the point of non-existence, a continuing gap between the trees to the southeast seems wide enough for wagons to have passed that way some years ago.  To the northwest a rockfall blocks what must have been the route in that direction.

title: [Abandoned Trail]
description: The gap between the older trees continues downhill to the southeast where it enters a ravine overgrown with ferns.  The ravine appears to cut due east.

title: [Abandoned Trail]
description: Ferns crowd the bottom of this ravine, where a small stream trickles down its center.  The floor of the ravine slopes gradually downhill to the east, and then disappears where the cattails and reeds begin and the ground becomes spongy underfoot.  You also see the western mouth of the ravine.

title: [Abandoned Trail]
description: Taller grasses and small trees are all that mark a strip of high ground that runs southeast through the cattails and reeds.  Peering over the tops of the marsh plants in that direction is the squat shape of a stone building with a gabled roof.

title: [Gryphon Holding]
description: Marsh grasses and bracken almost hide a half dozen wooden gravemarkers on this slope of the hillock.  The stone tower looms at the top of the rise, but to the south the slope of the hillock appears less steep.

title: [Gryphon Holding]
description: The stone tower rises above the surrounding marsh, narrow window slits and a battlement about the gabled roof giving it an almost sinister appearance.  To the north, east, and west, the slope of the hillock descends sharply and is quickly lost beneath the reeds and cattails.

title: [Gryphon Holding]
description: Eight apple trees stand here in two rows of four, competing with the heather and gorse that cover the gentle southern slope of the hillock.  To the northeast the stone tower is plainly visible.

title: [Forest Trail]
description: The trail winds through paper birch and poplar, which crowd the taller oaks.  Thick shrubs and brambles cower at the feet of the trees and infringe on the path.  Here and there, the way widens and shows evidence underfoot of an old road.  The track leads southeast where it disappears into deeper forest, and the faint susurrus of a brook can be heard from that direction.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Rocks]
description: The rocks are smooth and slick from being wet.  You are soon drenched by the spray of falling water.  Unlike the other calmer banks of the lake, which spreads out before you, there are no grasses or reeds growing here.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Lake]
description: The water is shallow, but churns and bubbles with many currents that tug you in all directions.  The bottom of the lake here is solid rock and the footing seems to be fairly even.

title: [Underground Lake, In The Water]
description: A broad underground lake fills this huge cavern that stretches out to the south and east.  The water that you are wading through is shallow, but the currents caused by the water falling just outside of the cavern opening pull and tug you in many directions.  High up on one wall of the cavern there is a broad ledge.

title: [Underground Lake, In The Water]
description: The water that you are wading through is crystal clear.  There is firm footing on the rocky bottom of the shallow lake that spreads out to fill this huge cavern.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Underground Lake, In The Water]
description: The splashing sounds that you make as you wade through the still water of the underground lake echo off the walls of this huge cavern.

wayto.6484: ;e empty_hands; while Room.current == Room[6481]; put 'swim opening'; sleep 1; waitrt?; end; fill_hands

title: [Underground Lake, In The Water]
description: A slow but steady dripping from somewhere above creates ringed patterns in the lake surface.  The flat plunking noise disturbs the cathedral-like silence of the cavern.

title: [Underground Lake, In The Water]
description: The water is calm and shallow.  You can hear the dim rumble of the nearby waterfall.

title: [Underground Lake]
description: A wash of steam rises from the water that bubbles out of a small crack in the cavern wall.  The hot spring has warmed the water of this small underground pool enough to make it comfortable to wade in.  Echoes of the running water ring from the walls of the surrounding cavern.  A narrow sandy beach rises up out of the water, leading to the floor of the huge cavern.  To the east, you can see a small opening just below the water line.

wayto.6481: ;e empty_hands; while Room.current == Room[6484]; put 'swim opening'; sleep 1; waitrt?; end; fill_hands

title: [Huge Cavern]
description: The floor of this huge featureless cavern is covered with clean white sand.  Wisps of steam rise off a small underground pool nearby.  Bright luminescent mosses and lichens cling to walls of the cavern, providing a dim but steady light.  Far to the west end of the cavern, you can see what looks like a massive stone structure.

title: [Huge Cavern]
description: A large stone structure rises up out of the sandy cavern floor.  It appears as if the face of this building has been carved from the very rock of the cavern, since you can see neither joint nor seam where the structure meets the cavern wall.  Six massive stone columns support a narrow roof which juts out over the few steps in front of a huge set of stone doors.

title: [Monastery, Atrium]
description: This large room appears to have been carved from solid rock.  The walls, floor, and ceiling are totally seamless, leaving no evidence that stones have been fitted together to form this structure.  There are several high-backed chairs, also carved from solid stone, and several low stone tables.  Each of the heavy-looking pieces of furniture resembles a piece of art, having its own unique pattern of mineral deposits.

wayto.6486: ;e unless move 'go doors'; dothistimeout 'pull lever', 3, /^Suddenly, the stone doors swing silently open\.$/; move 'go doors'; end

title: [Monastery, Gallery]
description: A magnificent modwir armoire and long tapestry dominate this room, which is lined with various pieces of artwork.  Among other pieces of note are an exceptionally well-crafted shadowbox and an elegant oil painting.  Off in a corner of the room stand a stone bust and a bronze statue, each on their own marble pedestal.

title: [Monastery, Hallway]
description: This short hallway is quite plain in comparison to the intricate artistry and craftmanship of the other rooms.  Several doors line the hallway, each well fitted and free from any signs of the passage of time, and a low broad archway opens to the northwest appearing incongruously like the mouth of a giant carp.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Monastery, Dining Room]
description: The simplicity of this room seems to breed silence and introspection.  It is easy to call to mind the image of fourteen stoic monks seated in the stone chairs around the long table in the center of the room, eating their meal in silence as they reflect on their lives, their gods and their tasks at hand.

title: [Monastery, Kitchen]
description: The scent of fresh baked bread and the odor of the cooking fire somehow still linger in the air of this modest kitchen.  A large stone worktable occupies the center of the room, ringed with an array of cooking utensils that hang from hooks over the table.  The fireplace on the east wall is a gaping hole of brick, blackened with ages of soot and ash.

title: [Monastery, Meditation Room]
description: This small room is quiet and restful.  A beautiful geometric pattern has been inlaid in the west wall, with four plain stone benches facing it.

title: [Monastery, Chapel]
description: Colorful tiles form a mosaic on the floor of this small chapel.  There are no benches or pews, but there is a low kneeling rail at the west end of the room, separating the main chapel area from the altar to the west.

title: [Monastery, Hallway]
description: The low ceiling makes this short hallway cramped and uncomfortable to be in.  Less care and craftsmanship seems to have been put into this area of the structure.  The walls and floor are a bit uneven and a sheen of slimy moisture covers the walls.  The hallway bends slightly, curving around from the north to the southwest, and a low wide archway opens on the east wall.

title: [Monastery, Hallway]
description: The cramped closeness of this area is quite a contrast to the open airy rooms throughout the rest of the monastery.  The low ceiling and close walls give the place a prisonlike atmosphere.  The six squat wooden doors that lead off the hallway reach from ceiling to floor.  The stones in the walls, floor and ceiling here are ill-fitted and uneven.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Monastery, Hallway]
description: This narrow cramped hallway is just an extension of that to the south.  The stones in the walls, floor and ceiling continue to be ill-fitted and uneven.  The prisonlike quality of this area is heightened by the drab bare wall which abruptly ends the hallway to the north. Six identical wooden doors lead off this hallway.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Monastery, Altar]
description: This altar shows the only signs of age or destruction that you have seen anywhere in the monastery.  The altar is badly burned and the long stone altar table has been shattered into more than a dozen pieces.  A tall brazier mounted from a long pole in the floor of the room stands to one side, but the supporting pole has been bent and twisted.  There is a large iron chest on the floor behind what was once the altar, badly blackened and charred by the fire that must have occurred here.

title: [Monastery, Monk's Cell]
description: This small stone alcove contains nothing more than a small wooden cot and a single iron spike protruding from the wall at head level.

title: [Monastery, Spiral Stair]
description: A spiral stair has been carved from the stone here.  You cannot see very far down the stair since the sharp curve of the steps quickly leads down and around, out of the line of sight.  The walls are smooth and featureless, and the steps are narrow and deep.  A light sheen of moisture covers everything here, making the stairs look somewhat risky.

title: [Monastery, Landing]
description: A steep spiral stair rises from the landing here, the steps slick with moisture that has condensed there.  Opposite the stair, a broad low arch opens onto a larger chamber to the south.  The stones surrounding the arch have been carved with symbols and images significant to the followers of Kai.

title: [Monastery, Chamber]
description: The four exits leading out of this circular chamber are evenly spaced around the wall.  Each exit is identical except for the grotesque faces that have been carved into the stone above the exits.  The faces all appear to be human, but each has been twisted into a travesty of emotional expression.  The face to the north appears to be smiling or grinning, to the east is the face of one in great pain, to the south is an image of great shock or surprise, and the image to the west appears to be crying.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Monastery, Library]
description: The shelves and tables in this large library are still intact, but the books and scrolls that were stored here have long since crumbled into piles of so much paper and dust.

title: [Monastery, Meditation Chamber]
description: A low table with a kneeling rail in front of it lines the west wall.  There is a tall candle on the table that has been mostly burned away.  The crumbling remains of a book also lie on the table next to the candle.

title: [Monastery, Abbots' Room]
description: The furniture in this room seems to have withstood the passage of time well.  A large four poster bed stands against one wall.  There is a wooden chair in one corner, adjacent to a plain wooden table.  Against the north wall stands a large bureau, with torches mounted on the wall on either side of it.  There is a large frame hanging over the bureau, but there is nothing mounted in it.

title: [Monastery, Misty Chamber]
description: A damp mist seems to seep from the very walls of this vast chamber casting the walls in an eerie green pallor.  A large round stone stands upright in the center of the room, rotating like a coin that has been stood on edge and spun.  The opening at the center of the stone is pitch black and odd runes are engraved around the edge.  A low steady hum emanates from the stone, and the sound soothes your tired nerves.

title: [Forest Trail]
description: On this windswept ridge, patches of sky can be seen through the canopy of trees.  Wispy tamaracks stretch their long branches across the trail, their pale green needles giving off a pleasant perfume.  Winterberry and sheep laurel take advantage of the more ambient light here, and creeping wood sorrel cloaks the ground.  To the south, the road descends toward the sound of water.  Northwest, it meanders into denser woods.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The old road is more evident here, although its double tracks are overgrown with tufts of grass and wildflowers.  Overhead, conifers make a patchy canopy that allows the ground cover to spread.  A stream cuts across the way, its banks defined by stones and large boulders which are carpeted green with moss.  The stream appears to be shallow, and on its opposite bank, the road climbs out of the water and continues on.  To the southwest, a trail, little more than a game path, winds into deeper forest.

title: [Noralgar Forest]
description: The rhythmic chirping of crickets creates a backdrop for a tranquil glade.  The trees ring a circle carpeted with leaves interspersed with the dark, blue-purple of woodland violets peeking through.  On the glade's opposite side, the trail meanders off and disappears into the trees.  However, a large, fallen tree-trunk lying across the path blocks any further passage.

Soft bird-song creates a backdrop for a tranquil glade.  The trees ring a circle carpeted with leaves interspersed with the dark, blue-purple of woodland violets peeking through.  On the glade's opposite side, the trail meanders off and disappears into the trees.  However, a large, fallen tree-trunk lying across the path blocks any further passage.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: A stream dissects the road to the west, and beyond it, a ridge stands sentinel with a fringe of conifers adding a plumed frill to its profile.  Looking to the northwest, the trees recede and a body of water is visible in the distance.  The old highway branches here, leading northeast and south.  The main thoroughfare appears to have been the south byway, for to the northeast, the turnoff dwindles quickly into little more than an overgrown path.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: Stands of tall ash trees border the road, interspersed with delicate flowering dogwoods.  The way is furrowed and prodigious potholes are the rule instead of the exception.  A large boulder, its veined surface encrusted with a frieze of lichens, forces the track to curve in a southeasterly direction.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The road curves through a stand of hemlock and beech trees.  The conifers add their distinctive scent to the crisp air, and squirrels run chattering through the branches, occasionally dislodging large beechnuts.  Sprouts of young beech crowd the feet of the larger trees, making thick underbrush.  The thicket quivers from time to time with the antics of a hidden population of wildlife sheltered there.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The road ambles through the forest, marred by potholes and insurgent boulders which have been liberated by the elements.  Dense beds of dwarf andromeda create intermittent patches of dark green color on either side of the way.  A courageous deer mouse suddenly darts through the ruts, almost underfoot, before disappearing into a thick carpet of tall clover.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The ancient highway has become almost impassable.  Its double tracks are so deeply rutted, the rocky outcrops are reminiscent of crooked teeth in an open maw.  A dried streambed intersects the road's trenches and winds north toward the lake, its passage marked by a jumble of stones and pieces of driftwood.  To the south and west, the forest is a dense, impenetrable wall of green.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: Brush and boulders cloak a sharp embankment on the road's southern shoulder.  On one of the rocks, a large snake sleeps, its impressive length curled into a sinuous pile of spotted coils.  It lifts its head briefly, responding to vibrations on the road, then settles back into its unconcerned slumber, confident in the protection of its venomous defenses.  The road turns to the southeast, following the curve of a stand of conifers.

Brush and boulders cloak a sharp embankment on the road's southern shoulder.  On one of the rocks, a large snake suns itself, its impressive length curled into a sinuous pile of spotted coils.  It lifts its head briefly, responding to vibrations on the road, then settles back into its unconcerned slumber, confident in the protection of its venomous defenses.  The road turns to the southeast, following the curve of a stand of conifers.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The derelict thoroughfare emerges from the thickets and trees, offering an engaging, moonlit panorama of the surroundings.  To the north lies a lake, with dense banks of fog drifting across its surface like clouds against a gray sky.  The road meanders away to the east, where it finally crosses a grassy plain.  Barely visible on the lake's eastern shores, a fortress with crenellations rises up out of the mist.  A thick forest stands impassively to the southwest.

The derelict thoroughfare emerges from the thickets and trees, offering an engaging panorama of the surroundings.  To the north lies a lake, with dense banks of fog drifting across its surface like clouds against a gray sky.  The road meanders away to the east, where it finally crosses a grassy plain.  Barely visible on the lake's eastern shores, a fortress with crenellations rises up out of the mist.  A thick forest stands impassively to the southwest.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The road snakes down a hill in lazy curves.  Water run-off has rendered the rocks and ruts into a hazardous obstacle course.  To the northeast, a trail descends toward a lake, which lies in the distance like a flat, grey mirror.  It's curious how the surface of the water seems to absorb light instead of reflect it.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: To the southwest, the forest has receded into a distant, impenetrable wall.  Around the road, however, prairie grasses have overtaken the forest's grip on the countryside, and they grow more lush the further one gets from the barrier of trees.  The road barely holds its ground, winding away through the golden verdure like a ribbon rippling in the wind.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The prairie grass grows almost as tall as a halfling, and as the wind sends it swaying like waves, it produces a soft susurrus.  To the west, the double ruts of the road proceed toward the distant castle, glimpsed through gaps in the strange lake-fog that mantles the old fortress like a cloak.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The grass stretches away, bounded by the dark smudge of the forest to the southwest and a fog-shrouded lake to the north.  Out of the mists on the lake's eastern rim, a forbidding castle hulks like a dark mountain floating upon the lusterless water.

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Clearing]
description: A mound dominates a clearing bordered on the south by the beginnings of forest.  An impenetrable wall of tall prairie grass stands to the east.  The mound itself is covered with a soft carpet of velvety green grass.

title: [Old Noralgar Road]
description: The intersection was apparently once well-traveled, judging from a collective of ruined buildings standing around it.  A derelict inn still maintains a stand against the barrage of prairie grass and elements, with a weathered sign hanging by a single ring above its door.  The castle dominates the horizon to the north, silhouetted against the night sky.

The intersection was apparently once well-traveled, judging from a collective of ruined buildings standing around it.  A derelict inn still maintains a stand against the barrage of prairie grass and elements, with a weathered sign hanging by a single ring above its door.  The castle dominates the horizon to the north, its ramparts surrounded by flocks of crows that circle it like a pestilence of rapacious insects.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Prairie]
description: A sea of tall, rich grass stretches away to the eastern horizon.  The golden ranges of pasture are mottled by what little moonlight is able to penetrate the fog emanating from the lake to the northwest.  A stormfront in the distant covers the skyline with low clouds.  The road branches, leading off into the verdant monochrome in three directions.

A sea of tall, rich grass stretches away to the eastern horizon.  The golden ranges of pasture are mottled by what half-light is able to penetrate the fog emanating from the lake to the northwest.  A stormfront in the distant covers the skyline with low clouds, their undersides painted a brilliant gold by reflection from the gilded plains below.  The road branches, leading off into the verdant monochrome in three directions.

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Prairie]
description: The walls of grass bordering the faltering highway have grown to the height of a giantman. More and more, branches in its progress are a thing to dread, carrying the risk of becoming lost in the undulating ocean.  At this juncture, the main road appears to run east and west, for the other turn-offs quickly dwindle into the sward.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Prairie]
description: The road bends here, breaking through the imprisoning grasses to the northeast. Only the top-most towers of Castle Anwyn, on the northwest horizon, are visible above the swaying, tufted tops of the vigorous prairie grass.  A nearly impassable trail leads south into deeper vegetation.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Trail]
description: The trail narrows then bends back upon itself, winding through the blanket of grass with irrational abandon.  A shudder within the thick verdure is accompanied by a snarl and brief tussle.  Then a wild cat leaps over the trail, carrying a limp rabbit in its jaws, and disappears again into the overgrowth.

title: [Trail]
description: The footpath grows more tenuous to the north.  Finally, the way is blocked by a mound of earth bordered by a jumble of boulders, the whole covered by a thick beard of resolute prairie grass.  Further progress in a northerly direction seems impossible, however, the trail branches in other directions.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Prairie]
description: The road has climbed up a promontory that offers a shorter variety of grass, as well as a sweeping view of the plains.  The panorama is illuminated by soft moonlight, broken on the eastern horizon by a range of mountains.  In the distance, a herd of animals sleeps peacefully upon the pasture, their variety disguised by the haze of distance.

The road has climbed up a promontory that offers a shorter variety of grass, as well as a sweeping view of the plains.  The panorama is a golden expanse, broken on the eastern horizon by a range of mountains.  In the distance, a herd of animals grazes peacefully upon the pasture land's bounty, their variety disguised by the haze of distance.

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Prairie]
description: The old highway is broken here and there by dry gullies and erosion.  Occasionally, field mice, hares and prairie dogs make a brief appearance within the ruts, scurrying out of sight in a panic at the first sign of a trespasser.

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Prairie]
description: Anwyn Castle is again within sight, standing resolutely in the northwest.  This vantage offers a good view of the fortress's eastern ramparts, the dark turrets rising up from the hulking walls like spikes.  The track narrows to the north, where cliffs cut off Noralgar Road's further progress.

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Cliffs]
description: The road comes to an abrupt end at the foot of sheer cliffs which tower hundreds of feet above.  Lough Ne'halin encircles the castle's eastern face and reaches to the foot of the precipices, its dark waters lapping at a large jumble of rocks massed there.

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Cliffs]
description: The rough jumble of rocks almost obscures the small trail, breaking its progress every few feet with turns and stone shelves that must be traversed.  Small, red-leafed shrubs grow in pockets of soil, and moss and lichens cover the rocks.  As the way gains altitude, the view of the grey lake becomes ever more impressive.

title: [Old Noralgar Road, Cliffs]
description: Granite cliffs tower overhead, their faces marked with a wealth of striations and their peaks bearded with slowly drifting clouds.  A small door is cut into the stone, with seams that are joined so cleverly they are almost invisible.  To the west, the escarpment meets an imposing castle perched against the protective rock, while a glassy lake stretches from its foot into the foggy distance.

title: [Noralgar Road, Castle Approach]
description: As the old thoroughfare travels toward the castle, the prairie grass begins to thin and wither away.  The fortress is a huge, rambling edifice, thrusting up from the cold lake-water lapping at its feet.  The shores of the lake known as Lough Ne'halin stretch away to the northwest, bounded by stark cliffs, and in the distance there, a thin tower sticks up out of the gloomy fog like a skeletal finger.

title: [Noralgar Road, Castle Approach]
description: The cold waters of Lough Ne'halin serve as a moat, wrapping around the feet of the cliff-like curtain wall girding the dark castle called Anwyn.  The old drawbridge stands open, spanning the lake and giving access to a barbican that guards the fortress's approach.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: The hard packed dirt is broken here and there by small tufts of grass, pushing through the surface.  On each side of the square loom seemingly abandoned buildings, their doors absent from vandalism or decay.  A bird darts out from one of the eaves, the noise of its wings shattering the still air.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: To the south, only the front and left walls of the building remain standing, the door open to the grasses that grow in the windbreak provided.  The building to the east has suffered in the elements as well, as the roof beams have fallen, blocking the doorway.  Rising above the beams are tall grasses, protected from grazing animals by the huge wooden forms they surround.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: Slate fallen from the roof blocks the slim passage between these two buildings.  The gaping door in the corner of the building to the north opens into darkness, as the roof on that structure remains intact. Despite the size of the door opening, little light appears to fall inside the building.

title: [Abandoned Village, Workshop]
description: Shadows surround a massive stone fireplace standing next to the door.  The rock is coated with the grime and soot accumulated over years of use.  Next to it lies a massive slab of stone with deep holes drilled into it.  The room is silent except for a few chirps from birds nesting in the rafters overhead.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: The building to the west shows signs of forced entry, huge chips of stone taken from the vicinity of where the hinges would have hung.  The massive wooden doors themselves lie flat just inside the opening, with dents in the wood where they have been struck in an attempt to enter this building.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: The edifice of this building is stained white, a reminder of the birds that nest in the peak of the roof, hidden under the exposed timbers.  Large windows flank the door, open to the elements.  To the left of the building lies a pile of rocks, ranging from the size of a giantman, to pebbles.

title: [Abandoned Village, Bunkhouse]
description: Moonlight spills across the floor, the dust motes swirling in the beams as they lance through the windows and door.  The walls on either side are compartmented, with cubbyholes the length of a man.  Much of the wood has rotted, making each platform a precarious place to put any substantial weight.  By the looks of the accumulated detritus, it appears that many smaller animals have made their homes here.  A mass writhes above, the darkness hiding all but the motion and rustling sound of bats.
