Much of the wood has rotted, making each platform a precarious place to put any substantial weight.  By the looks of the accumulated detritus, it appears that many smaller animals have made their homes here.  A mass writhes above, the darkness hiding all but the motion and rustling sound of bats.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: Small waves beat gently against the shoreline, quietly mixing in with the echoes of the waves slapping against the stone foundation of the castle.  To the west, trees stand along the lough, rising through the fog that floats in and out across the shore.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: Fog drifts in and out across the water, floating above the waves between here and the castle to the east.  The stone battlements rise forbodingly in dark stone, mute testament to the need for protection of the builders.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: Short pines rise from the ground, searching for nourishment in the damp soil.  Mist rises from the ground to join the fog that floats in and out of the trees to the west, and out along the shore of the lough.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: Rising from the fog to the east is a crenellated tower, dark stone etched bleakly against the clouded sky.  Gently lapping water is muffled in the fog that drifts silently across the vista.  Short grass grows in small clumps, slick in the moist air.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: At the top of this hillock, the view is blocked on three sides by the stands of trees.  The ground is less wet than below, but only marginally so, and the path is still slick from the fog.  Off to the northeast, glimpses of the lake can be seen here and there, as the fog moves slowly across the surface.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: Slightly further from the water, the trees have grown even closer together, the canopy above blocking out almost all the light.  The light remaining highlights the tendrils of fog snaking between the trunks.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: The fog drifts quietly through the lower branches of these trees, the trunks covered with moss.  Scattered underneath the boughs are small mounds of dirt, signs of some sort of small creature digging.  Chittering comes from above, the scolding noise making it clear they are unhappy that their haven has been disturbed.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: The path meanders closer to the lake, rocks covered in moss and moisture, making for treacherous footing.  Water laps gently against the stones, the sound a quiet refrain.  To the south, a copse of trees stands in silent vigil, a guardian to this shore.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: Fog floats lazily, hanging over the water like a wraith, curling gently in some unfelt breeze.  Luxuriant grass crowds the path, stalks pushed back by the passage of unknown creatures.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: A dense stand of modwir trees crowds the shore line.  Beneath their large branches, a path wends along, following the curves of the water like an admiring suitor.  A thin fog floats gently in the air, curling sensuously around the modwir trunks, and slipping out across the quiet water.  The gentle slapping of the waves against the rocks is absorbed almost completely, lending an eerie ambiance to the beach.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: Reeds and water grasses mark the cold lake's edge.  The water murmurs a quiet melody as it slaps against the shore.  Further out, the fog drifts over the lake's surface like ghostly barges.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: The grasses and reeds give way as the stream flows quietly into the lake.  Calm waters of this cove stifle the remaining movement of the stream, with only the faint waving of tall reeds giving any motion to this peaceful scene.  A deep fog hangs in the air further out from shore, smothering sound and vision.

title: [Shores of Lough Ne'halin]
description: Through the tall reeds can be seen the slowly moving stream, wending its way around boulders covered in a deep moss.  Stagnant water fills the depressions around the reeds, with small bugs skittering to and fro across the surface.

title: [Castle Anwyn, Drawbridge]
description: The rough timber planks of this drawbridge must be at least two feet thick, and are obviously of great antiquity.  Here and there, the surface of the bridge is mottled with the green of mosses and the pale gold of lichens.  But the integrity of the heartwood appears to be unbreached, with not a crack or spot of rot to be seen.  Beneath it, the forbiddingly cold water of the lake ripples silently.

title: [Castle Anwyn, Barbican]
description: This barbican provides a highly defensible access to the castle's outer ward, surrounded as it is by the lake's water and flanked by crenelated towers.  The drawbridge approach to the stone structure boasts a machicoulis as well as a huge portcullis, standing open and secured by an iron chain as big around as a young roa'ter.  On the castle side, a stone bridge that connects the barbican to the castle leads to another lake traverse -- via a stone bridge -- which grants entrance to Castle Anwyn's impressive curtain wall.

title: [Bridge to Castle Anwyn]
description: This bridge between the guardhouse and the barbican is surfaced with cobblestones, their uneven surfaces slippery with the humid fog drifting across the lake.  Little protection from a fall into the grey water is offered, since the bridge's walls are barely higher than a dwarf's knee on either side.  Castellated towers flanking the guardhouse keep silent vigil over the span, warding the approach to the castle.

title: [Castle Anwyn Gatehouse]
description: This gatehouse is immensely solid, thirty feet square at least, with walls a foot thick.  Its inner and outer doors are each framed by a twelve-foot arch.  Overhead, the two-story structure is furnished with small slits of windows and a catwalk shielded with slotted walls for archers to use as cover.

title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
description: A gateway leading into the castle proper is close at hand, to the northwest.  From this vantage point, the castle's mighty towers and battlements seem impregnable.  The structure's beautiful ornamentation is evident here, from the richly carved arches with their scrollwork and fanciful friezes, to the hulking gargoyles perched on the ramparts of the flanking towers.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Anwyn Castle, Storage Shed]
description: This near-dilapidated building was apparently once used to store supplies and tools.  Broken barrels and rusty pieces of metal pepper the floor, making it difficult to walk through the place without tripping.  Squeaks and scratching sounds join the cooing of doves in the rafters, producing a soft harmony.

title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
description: The yard seems almost too quiet, even though the frigid climate would naturally discourage any serenade by locust or lark.  An old building sits to the east, the architecture suggesting that it's an old chapel.  The entrance stands doorless and dark, giving it a melancholy appearance.

The yard seems almost too quiet, even though the frigid climate would naturally discourage any serenade by locust or lark.  A few crows can be seen flying in the distance, but they're too far away to hear.  An old building sits to the east, the architecture suggesting that it's an old chapel.  The entrance stands doorless and dark, giving it a melancholy appearance.

title: [Anwyn Castle Chapel]
description: By all external appearances, one would have expected the serene atmosphere born of years of reverie and worship within the castle's chapel.  But this is no place of quiet introspection.  Bones lie scattered about haphazardly.  The air is fetid and almost unbreathable.  Small burial urns sit in no discernible order among the litter of bones, making navigation through the structure an exercise in caution.  Set into niches in the walls are piles of skulls, their blank stares a sinister accusation.

title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
description: The castle yard is bordered here by a quaint, old chapel on the east and the flanking tower of the inner castle wall on the west.  The tower looks to be three stories in height at least, and is topped by a crow-stepped gable.  To the north, the castle yard stops at the foot of a sizable wall.

title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
description: The castle yard ends here, at a wall topped by crenellations that extends between the wall surrounding the inner ward and the exterior curtain wall.  A corridor with a fine, carved doorcase passes through the barrier, revealing its width to be more than ten spans.  The remains of an iron gate lie on the ground a short distance away.

title: [Kitchen Garden]
description: A sprawling bramble of red-berried nettle bushes has spread itself over much of the old kitchen garden.  A few resolute herbs still hold their own -- mint, chervil and a ragged patch of lavender next to the kitchen door.  A low wall divides the garden from a bower beyond, where fruit trees survive.  The wall is richly carved, its vine scrolls inset with hollow-eyed masks, a popular motif during the castle's heyday.  An arched corridor offers passage through the towering wall enclosing this inviting area.

title: [Castle Bower]
description: The branches of ancient fruit trees create an interwoven shelter that gives this part of the garden an intimate ambiance.  A carved stone bench sits before the cliff wall at the back, extending its timeless invitation.  Against the east wall, a stone fish with flared gills and arched tail spits a stream of water into a stone-edged pool choked with green algae.

title: [Castle Kitchen]
description: An overwhelming stink is the most noticeable feature of this chamber.  It was obviously the kitchen for the old fortification.  There's a massive stone slab in its center that offers a generous work surface and an impressive hearth on the far wall, now cold and empty.  A litter of pot shards and old implements pepper the floor, looking as if they were thrown about in a fury.  However, there is nothing that suggests what is causing the terrible stench.

title: [Castle Larder]
description: Though it hardly seems possible, the odor permeating the adjoining room is even worse here.  The cause is now apparent.  Carcasses are strewn around the room in various stages of putrefaction.  Something has obviously been using this as a cache for prey.  The shelves that once held the castle's provisions lie in a pile on one side of the larder and could possibly conceal something large enough -- or mean enough -- to cause this gory slaughter.

title: [Castle Hall]
description: This long gallery connects the kitchen apartments and buttery with the Great Hall via an impressive staircase at the hall's north end.  Another hall intersects this one, leading west to other chambers and the building's main entrance.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, up

title: [Anwyn Castle, Great Hall]
description: This cathedral-sized room, the heart of the castle, extends up at least three-stories tall.  Two rows of stone piers march down its length, each with an elaborately carved capital.  The huge beams supporting the ceiling rest on the tops of the piers.  Doors are visible on the hall's southern expanse, but are curiously walled up with stone.  On the room's western wall, an impressive flight of stairs leads to other rooms in that wing.  At the opposite end, discrete stairs lead into the flanking tower.

This cathedral-sized room, the heart of the castle, extends up at least three-stories tall.  Two rows of stone piers march down its length, each with an elaborately carved capital.  The huge beams supporting the ceiling rest on the tops of the piers.  Doors are visible on the hall's southern expanse, but are curiously walled up with stone.  On the room's western wall, an impressive flight of stairs leads to other rooms in that wing.  At the opposite end, discreet stairs lead into the flanking tower.

title: [Anwyn Castle, East Tower]
description: This circular chamber is littered with the broken bones of its former furnishings.  No big surprise there.  One thing is distinctive though -- the stench here could knock an orc on its back.  That and the cold.  Every breath exhaled here frosts the air into a white fog.  No wind is stealing in to account for it, a fierce, dead cold that permeates the warmest garment.  A staircase winds up to the floor above.

title: [Tower Chamber]
description: Cold inhabits the chamber as if it were bred here.  Across the floor, debris and dust mark uninhabited time as well as a clock, sifting into the room's corners in gentle drifts.  The odor of decay hangs over the emptiness with its secretive nuances, speaking a subtle language universal to all lands.

title: [Turret]
description: The turret is dark and empty -- at first glance.  Then one after another, and then another winged shape swoops past your line of vision.  A look at the ceiling reveals the whole of it is covered by a vast complex of hornet nests.  Their papery convolutions curve around the roof's beams like a blanket, folding out here and there into incredible blossoms of living chambers.  Busy winged workers labor across the surface of the monstrous construction.  The staircase leading down looks exceedingly inviting.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Hall]
description: This paneled passage connects the Great Hall to the old keep.  A row of tall, mullioned windows -- each with a window embrasure forming a 'sitting window' -- casts irregularly shaped reflections onto the broad beams of the floor.  They shift and fade in synchrony with the drifting fog outside.

title: [Audience Chamber]
description: A strange, flickering blue aurora illuminates this room.  It has no direct source, but seems to be brightest around a monstrous bone chair, the color of old teeth.  The thing is as big as a throne and its surface is polished to a soft gleam.  Facing the chair is a grisly row of pikes, each one bearing a shriveled, mummified head.

title: [Castle Anwyn Keep]
description: The cylindrical keep looks as if it's much older than the other parts of the castle, which follows a more modern, rectangular design.  The keep's ground floor stands two-stories tall.  Its old 'murder-holes' -- through which rocks or scalding oil were once thrown down on unwelcome guests -- are now filled in.  Halls lead off to the east and to the south, and a handsomely carved, arched door leads outside.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, up, down

title: [Anwyn Castle, Keep]
description: The second level of the ancient keep is starkly bare.  The floor is uneven, its stone flagging broken and cracked.  At intervals along the curved walls, arrow slits are placed, granting defense of the tiered wall-walk below.  Circular windows are located high on the walls, shedding a diffused light that leaves this chamber in gloom.  The staircase leading to upper stories is completely demolished, prohibiting further ascent.

title: [Tiered Wall-Walk]
description: From the high vantage point of this wall-walk, there is an excellent view of the western outer yard and the towers and spires of the castle itself.  The walk is built in attractive tiers, with balustrades ornamented with the masterful carving seen throughout the old fortification.  Two gargoyles peer down from crannies on the towers that flank the walk, their contorted appearance whimsical and forbidding as well.

title: [Anwyn Castle, West Tower]
description: The vaulted ceiling is low, and as a result, the room seems warmer than most of the other parts of the castle.  The chamber is in remarkably good condition -- the large fireplace still possesses its decorative carving and a few furnishings survive intact.  By far, the most noticeable thing in the room is the large mirror hanging above the hearth.  It seems to absorb and amplify the low light drifting in through the narrow slit windows.

title: [Tower Chamber]
description: This circular room was probably once living quarters.  Now however, it's in a shambles, with broken pieces of furnishings cluttering the floor.  The remains of heavy draperies -- now tattered -- hang from the towering windows, like shrouds hanging off of a graveyard mummy.  A cold wind blows through, making the strips flutter hopelessly in the half-light.  A hazardous-looking staircase winds up to the floor above.

title: [Turret]
description: A narrow staircase ends here in the tower's summit.  Large shapes, crates and boxes that miraculously survived time lurk against sloping walls that form an arch overhead.  Little sounds in the shadows give evidence of mice scurrying about.

title: [Small Courtyard]
description: This small courtyard is enclosed by the curtain wall and tower on the west, and an ancient keep that stands to the northeast.  There is a battlement walk that appears to connect the two, its walls covered with a thick curtain of ivy that's so dark, it appears more black than green.  Curiously, the fog has not intruded here, although low clouds are hanging around the parapets of the keep.

title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
description: The castle yard comes to a stop before a tall, stone wall inset with a highly carved doorcase.  An old iron gate hangs in it, rusty and weathered over the countless years.  One side of the gate stands resolutely closed, but its mate swings in the wind, shrieking like a tortured soul.  The dark entrance to a building crouches in the shadow of the curtain wall to the west.

title: [Castle Crypt]
description: Just inside the doorway of the crypt, a stone altar stands alone, vestiges of old candle wax clinging to its cold surface.  The wall just above the altar boasts a handsome frieze, framing a panel with worn inscriptions -- probably a list of the dead who rest here.  The room's boundaries stretch away into darkness.

title: [Castle Crypt]
description: Long tendrils of cobweb trail down from the shadowy ceiling, creating a haphazard garland that attaches to the burial slabs.  The biers are spaced closely together and each one carries its silent passenger covered with a shroud of netting.  Light from the crypt's door barely trespasses, as if in deference to the chamber's inhabitants.

title: [Castle Crypt]
description: The crypt's somber atmosphere is punctuated by the occasional scratching of rodents and gusts of cold wind that set the cobwebs to billowing.  A heavy aroma of decay has settled over the chamber like a harbinger of the inevitability of death.

title: [Castle Crypt]
description: The biers march in stately rows into the darkness.  Between them, the stone floor is forced into a complex zigzag, meandering around the burial slabs with no thought wasted on ease of passage, since the business of the chamber has little to do with comings and goings.

title: [Castle Crypt]
description: Darkness cloaks the corner of the old crypt.  The carved marble slabs crowd together, supporting their veil-shrouded burdens with little room left to thread between them.

title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
description: The expanse of the yard is so quiet, it's unsettling.  In the southwest corner, the grass is thin, a result of the almost constant shadow cast by the curtain wall and its western tower.  The fog is thicker here, shrouding the view of the castle in a shifting veil of mist.

title: [Curtain Wall Building]
description: The splintered remains of tables and benches are strewn about this large chamber.  Antiquated pikes are still mounted at intervals along the walls, suggesting this was the castle barracks.  Over in a dark corner, something scuttles about in the debris.

title: [Castle Barracks]
description: Walking into this room is like walking into winter.  A gripping cold that defies explanation holds the chamber in its fist.  Wooden bunks stand in rows along the walls, almost all of them in one piece -- surprising with so much wreckage to be found in other parts of this old fortification. Some strange characters have been painted over the doorframe with a red-tinted pigment.

title: [Anwyn Castle Yard]
description: Wisps of cold fog drift across the yard in an eerie dance.  A sparse, wiry turf braves the frigid climes, covering the expansive area between the outer curtain wall and the castle itself.  Near the wall, stones lie jumbled on the ground, dislodged from the battlements above by time, wind and weather.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Anwyn Castle, Stables]
description: This old, wooden structure is barely still standing.  Moonlight shines down through the roof in beams that highlight floating motes of dust.  In the quiet, a faint 'cooing' can be heard, revealing the presence of doves roosting in the rafters above.  Derelict horse stalls along the back wall march east, down the length of the building.

This old, wooden structure is barely still standing.  Light shines down through the roof in beams that highlight floating motes of dust.  In the quiet, a faint 'cooing' can be heard, revealing the presence of doves roosting in the rafters above.  Derelict horse stalls along the back wall march east, down the length of the building.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Stables]
description: The number of stalls filling this long building would seem to indicate a sizable cavalry once was garrisoned here.  Piles of hay are still heaped up in some of the stalls, emitting suspicious rustling noises.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Stables]
description: The doorway in this section of the old building is generous enough to allow a wagon passage through.  Hooks are prevalent on the walls, with old tack hanging from some of them.  Most of the leather has long ago rotted away, but the metal pieces remaining exhibit fine workmanship.  A rank of empty stalls extends away to the west.

title: [Inner Ward Gateway]
description: This is the main gateway into the castle's inner ward.  On each side, octagonal towers flank it, and a wall-walk above it, with parapet walls, offers additional defense.  Once inside, the old portcullis is visible, now frozen in its raised position.  North is the castle's inner yard and beyond that, the castle itself -- finally visible, wrapped like a precious piece of porcelain within its walls and battlements.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Inner Yard]
description: The facade of the castle, viewed from across this spacious forecourt, is impressive despite its derelict condition.  A finely fashioned doorcase stands over a broad course of steps, topped by a heraldic carving.  To either side, robust statues of crouched wolves stand guard.  Firing holes are noticeable on the sides of the doorframe.  Other doorways are spaced along the wings of the castle, which surround this inner ward in a protective embrace.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Hall]
description: This hall is in a decrepit condition.  Large holes deface its exterior walls, granting a glimpse of one of the eastern towers.  The doorway leading to the inner yard is doorless and bereft of its ornamental carving.  The entrance to a residential chamber opens to the west, while a hall to the southwest grants entry into a corner tower.  To the northeast, the hall veers, making it difficult to tell what lies in that direction.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southwest, west

title: [Western Flanking Tower]
description: This western tower offers a good view of Lough Ne'halin and the vast, green 'ocean' that is Noralgar Forest.  Save for the splendid view, the room is empty.  The walls, built of solid stone, are now inhabited only by the small-minded creatures scurrying around in the ruins of past greatness -- when horns had sounded and swords had glittered, and armies had marched out through the castle gates.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Hall]
description: The castle's buttery opens off of this hall's southern end.  To the north, the hall continues, where the main stair into Anwyn's Great Hall can be seen.  The windows here are tall and furnished with the facing window seats pervasive throughout the place.  A hall to the southeast grants entry into one of the octagonal corner towers, and some narrow stairs curve up out of sight.  A wooden doorway stands open to the inner yard, admitting a chilly breeze.

title: [Eastern Flanking Tower]
description: This octagonal tower has the narrow windows especially suited to archers.  A splendid view of the lake and the sheer walls of the cliffs protecting the castle's back can be had from the more easterly of the windows.  The sound of waves slapping against the cliffs is carried in on the wind, making the chamber seem very close to the water's swell.

title: [Castle Buttery]
description: The distinctive, musty smell common to very old buildings is strong here.  Long rows of shelves fill half the area and the other side has overturned tables, probably once a work area.  Rustling noises in the shadows betray the presence of mice or rats.  Suddenly, a choking cloud of dust erupts as a huge, white owl bursts into flight from the low rafters!  It disappears down the hall to the north, within the blink of an eye.

title: [Gatehouse Wall-walk]
description: This walk, crossing the battlements protecting the gate, gives a shielded vista of the castle yard.  It also offers an exceptional view of the surrounding countryside outside the castle environs.  The cold waters of Lough Ne'halin encompass the fortress's feet like a steel-gray carpet.  To the west, a dark forest approaches the lake's edge and stretches inviolately to the horizon.  On the wall's east end, narrow stairs lead down into the castle buildings.

title: [Archer's Gallery]
description: This spare hallway, running along the castle's front, has no decoration -- only rough, stone walls broken by narrow windows, where bowmen once stood to shoot down at enemies.  Patches of moonlight dapple the rough flagstones of a floor that time has canted into a downward slant.  The passage opens onto a wall-walk at its east end.

This spare hallway, running along the castle's front, has no decoration -- only rough, stone walls broken by narrow windows, where bowmen once stood to shoot down at enemies.  Patches of light dapple the rough flagstones of a floor that time has canted into a downward slant.  The passage opens onto a wall-walk at its east end.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Gallery]
description: This gallery is an impressive promenade.  Running parallel to the castle's Great Hall, it possesses a lofty, arch-braced ceiling with crown posts.  Apparently, its generous length was once hung with tapestries, and a couple still remain, now thread-bare and faded.  The castle's main door, generously decorated with a carved doorframe and paneling, is to the south.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Withdrawing Room]
description: The walls here are cloaked in shadows and faded tapestries, their subjects now obscured.  Remnants of old rugs lie on the flagged floor.  The wooden rafters of the ceiling are festooned with birds' nests and the webs of spiders long since gone, like decorations for some dreadful festival day.  In this chamber, time seems bound only to the measured tread of decay.

title: [Castle Chamber]
description: This room is dominated by a beautifully preserved hearth, its handsome overmantel rich with carved grotesques and armorial bearings.  Wood-paneled walls surround it, and the whole is illuminated by three large, mullioned windows.  Tapestries decorate the walls, offering faded views of woodland scenes.  A small door on the north wall is crowned by a carved panel bearing an elaborate coat-of-arms.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Chamber]
description: The stone walls of the spacious chamber are covered with tapestries, luxurious hangings which still boast vibrant color and fanciful designs.  A majestic bed stands in the room's center, hung with heavy velvet in a deep shade of blue.  Tall windows between the wall hangings offer a breathtaking view of the lake through their glazed crystal panes, still unbroken despite the decay elsewhere in Castle Anwyn.

title: [Wine Cellar]
description: The dark, cavernous cellar is filled with racks holding dust-covered bottles of wine.  Lining one of the walls are huge casks, taller than a giantman, with massive spigots tapping the front of each one.  A glance at one of the bottles reveals a date of such antiquity, it would render the contents either exquisite or pure vinegar.  Whichever is the case, there is an abundance of it, for the shelves, with their bottles, stand rank after rank in this cavernous cellar.

title: [Dim Recess]
description: This small closet of a room is dank and redolent with the heavy odor of the spirit-saturated, wooden casks.  On the back wall, almost obscured by darkness, stone steps lead down into the guts of the ancient keep.

title: [Stone Ledge]
description: The treacherous stairs have widened into a landing, yielding an opportunity to ponder the strange, underground tower that extends into the darkness beyond the crumbling edge of the parapet.  The stairs are cut into the stone walls and have no rail to guard against falling.  They follow the round walls, spiraling down into the depths.

title: [Lower Chamber]
description: This long cellar is paved with rough flagstones, their pocked surfaces holding puddles of water here and there.  The ceiling arches down to the floor on either side, and the low convergences are so deeply shadowed, it's impossible to see into them.

title: [Lower Chamber]
description: To the east, this strange, arched cellar opens into a small room and a door is visible there.  To the west, the cellar disappears into the darkness of the underground tower.

title: [Alcove]
description: This alcove is a small, octagonal room.  The ceiling is arched and richly adorned with murals, their colors still vivid, resulting from the preservative absence of light.  They depict a fascinating panorama of satyrs and nymphs, cavorting through a fantastic wooded landscape.  A substantial door dominates the alcove, its modwir beams crossed with thick iron bands.  There is a faint outline of strange symbols across the door's surface.

title: [Pentagram Chamber]
description: This is a vast natural cavern.  The walls and corners are uneven, hewn from solid stone and cloaked in gloom.  What captures one's attention, though, is a colossal pentagram that covers the chamber's floor.  It is drawn in a multi-colored dust that glitters like powdered gems.  A jagged fissure in the floor crosses the symbol, sundering it completely.  Elaborately wrought braziers stand at each point of the pentagram like silent sentries.

title: [Pentagram East]
description: On this side of the macabre design, the cavern walls become extremely uneven, with deep pockets and niches that aren't visible from further away.  In one particular cranny, a small skeleton shelters, still curled in its death repose.  Behind another outcrop, a dark recess can be seen, looking as though it might yield passage into the stone wall.

title: [Cavern Niche]
description: Once past the perimeter of the pentagram, the room narrows into a curved niche.  Mounted on the stone of the back wall is a large mirror, its frame thickly carved with serpentine figures that writhe and curl around each other.  The mirror seems strangely compelling.

title: [Pentagram West]
description: As you move around the pentagram, the lines seem to waver.  Parts of the lines that seemed golden a moment before shift to bronze, then fade to the verdigris of old copper.  The walls are very rough, and here at close range, one can see a pattern of scratches etched across their surface -- almost as if something had marked the rock walls with claws.

title: [A Dark Recess]
description: The narrow walkway, hardly more than a fissure, stops abruptly at a solid modwir door.  It's bound with iron straps and a large, iron ring bolted to the front offers a way to pull it open.  There are hefty slide-bolts above and below the ring.

title: [Dungeon]
description: This small chamber is paneled in thick wood.  Sets of round, iron rings are bolted to the walls at intervals and many have lengths of chain hanging from them.  In one corner are three curious contraptions, each one comprised of two parallel, wooden blocks fastened together with iron pins.  A stout torture bench sits in the other corner -- the large crank-wheel at one end and the iron cuffs attached to the other make its function soberingly obvious.

title: [The Broken Lands, Chamber]
description: A damp mist seems to seep from the very walls of this vast chamber, casting the walls in an eerie green pallor.  A large, round stone stands upright in the center of the room, rotating like a coin that has been stood on edge and spun.  The opening at the center of the stone is pitch black and odd runes are engraved around the edge.  A low, steady hum emanates from the stone and the sound soothes your tired nerves.

title: [The Broken Lands, Central Hall]
description: The high ceiling of this large hall is supported by several tall columns.  Discolored areas on the floor indicate that several pieces of furniture or other large items once stood here for a long period of time.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [The Broken Lands, Library]
description: The tall shelves of this once-magnificent library are now completely bare.  A large globe stands in one corner, covered with a thick layer of dust.  Even though all of the books and scrolls are long gone, the room still carries the odor of old paper and ink.

title: [Broken Lands, East Hall]
description: Several of the tall columns that support the ceiling of this vast hall have crumbled, leaving the eastern wall completely covered by rubble.  The remains of a large table juts out from the rubble, completely crushed by the collapse of the ceiling.

title: [Broken Lands, West Hall]
description: A large, circular table covered in a thick layer of dust stands in the center of the room.  The table is surrounded by stiff backed felwood chairs in various states of decay.  The tapestries that hang from the walls may have once been beautiful, but are now faded and moth-ridden.

title: [The Broken Lands, South Hall]
description: Incandescent globes hung from the ceiling cast gloomy lights on the large stone chair at the south end of the room, deepening the shadows of the bas relief above it.  The floor is pitted and marred by long deep gouges.

move 'go stair'

title: [The Broken Lands, Storage Room]
description: All of the shelves in this small storage room are empty.  A layer of dust covers the shelves and the floor, and thick cobwebs are strung across the corners of the room.

title: [The Broken Lands, Living Area]
description: A large discolored area marks the north wall of this room, as if a large picture, or perhaps a mirror, had hung there for many years.  A tattered, broken down wing chair sits next to a small dilapidated table in one corner and an old poster bed occupies most of the east wall.  Like four bowing monks before a mattress altar, the bed sags from years of humidity and parasites.

title: [The Broken Lands, Workshop]
description: Other than a few shards of glass scattered about the floor of this small chamber, the only object here is a large, plain wooden table.  A sour odor still hangs in the air, and the almost metallic smell sets your teeth on edge.

title: [The Broken Lands, Closet]
description: This cramped, dark space appears to have once been a storage area for whoever worked in the workshop beyond the curtain.  Cobwebs and dust cover everything in a thick blanket and the shattered remains of shelves line the walls, now devoid of any treasures they may have once held.  A heavy iron-bound strongbox stands alone in one corner.

wayto.6631: ;e if celerity = Spell[506] and celerity.known? and celerity.affordable? and not celerity.active?; celerity.cast; end; until dothistimeout('search', 3, /anything of interest|rough hole/) =~ /rough hole/ do end; move 'go hole'

title: [Broken Lands, Hidden Stairs]
description: The stairwell is cramped and musty, with a thick layer of dust which rises into the air from the slightest breeze.  A lone pinpoint of light can be seen at the top of the stairs, while a blanket of darkness shrouds the bottom.

wayto.6632: ;e if celerity = Spell[506] and celerity.known? and celerity.affordable? and not celerity.active?; celerity.cast; end; until dothistimeout('search', 3, /anything of interest|concealed door/) =~ /concealed door/ do end; move 'go door'

title: [Broken Lands, Passage]
description: Incandescent globes hang at set intervals along the passage, casting an eerie light over it.  A symphony of shadows is played out along the walls, giving the impression that this passage is not as empty as it appears.

wayto.6631: ;e if celerity = Spell[506] and celerity.known? and celerity.affordable? and not celerity.active?; celerity.cast; end; until dothistimeout('search', 3, /anything of interest|concealed door/) =~ /concealed door/ do end; move 'go door'

title: [Broken Lands, Passage]
description: The passage ends at a small wooden door set into the western wall.  Small globes hang to either side of the door and a faint rustle can be heard from that direction.

title: [Monastery, Meditation Room]
description: The smell of pungent incense dominates this room.  A globe hangs from the ceiling casting dim light over the room.  A small, hand-woven mat lies on the floor in front of a small shrine with two unlit candles atop it.  Several other mats lie rolled up next to a small wicker basket.  Standing in the corner is a simple wooden box.

wayto.6633: ;e move 'go door'; if checkpaths.include?('n'); move 'north'; move 'northeast'; move 'west'; end
wayto.6636: ;e move 'go door'; if checkpaths.include?('e'); move 'east'; move 'southeast'; move 'south'; end

title: [Broken Lands, Passage]
description: Incandescent globes hang at set intervals along the passage, casting an eerie light over it.  A symphony of shadows is played out along the walls, giving the impression that this passage is not as empty as it appears.  To the south the passage appears to get brighter.

title: [Broken Lands, Hallway]
description: The corridor ends at an ornate black marble arch leading to what appears to be a large, open area to the south.  Two small wooden doors stand across from each other on the eastern and western walls.  A crimson vaalin sconce holding a lit torch is mounted on the wall to either side of the arch.

title: [Monastery, Nexus]
description: This appears to be the central point of all activity for this stronghold.  Lit torches mounted in crimson vaalin sconces illuminate the room.  An ornate black marble arch adorns the northern wall and corridors lead off in almost every direction.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: This plain stone corridor is unremarkable except for the lit torches resting in brass sconces mounted on the walls at five foot intervals.  A light draft can be felt moving down the corridor from the west.  The corridor continues to the east and west.

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: Lit torches are mounted to either side of the doorways leading northeast and southwest.  The doorways are open, with no doors mounted in the frames to block passage.  The corridor continues to the east and to the northwest.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Monastery, Living Quarters]
description: This room appears to be used as living quarters for those who reside in this stronghold.  A row of six bunks lines each of the walls and a row of a dozen cabinets stands opposite the doorway.  A large table stands in the center of the room with a half dozen chairs scattered around it.  Mounted onto the ceiling is a large cast iron chandelier with dozens of small, lit candles dropping wax down onto the top of the table.

title: [Monastery, Living Quarters]
description: This room appears to be used as living quarters for those who reside in this stronghold.  A row of six bunks lines each of the walls and a row of a dozen cabinets stands opposite the doorway.  A large table stands in the center of the room with a half dozen chairs scattered around it.  Mounted onto the ceiling is a large cast iron chandelier with dozens of small, lit candles dropping wax down onto the top of the table.

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: Lit torches are mounted to either side of the doorways leading north and south.  The doorways are open, with no doors mounted in the frames to block passage.  The corridor continues to the southeast and west.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, west

title: [Monastery, Living Quarters]
description: This room appears to be used as living quarters for those who reside in this stronghold.  A row of six bunks lines each of the walls and a row of a dozen cabinets stands opposite the doorway.  A large table stands in the center of the room with a half dozen chairs scattered around it.  Mounted onto the ceiling is a large cast iron chandelier with dozens of small, lit candles dropping wax down onto the top of the table.

title: [Monastery, Living Quarters]
description: This room appears to be used as living quarters for those who reside in this stronghold.  A row of six bunks lines each of the walls and a row of a dozen cabinets stands opposite the doorway.  A large table stands in the center of the room with a half dozen chairs scattered around it.  Mounted onto the ceiling is a large cast iron chandelier with dozens of small, lit candles dropping wax down onto the top of the table.

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: Lit torches are mounted to either side of the doorways leading north and south.  The doorways are open, with no doors mounted in the frames to block passage.  To the west is an arch leading to a larger room, from which emanates the faint smell of roasting meat.  The corridor continues to the east.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Monastery, Dining Hall]
description: Five long tables, a row of chairs to either side of each, dominate this room waiting for someone to sit down and take their place at them.  A dozen cast iron chandeliers hang from the ceiling with a multitude of small candles casting their light down upon the room.  A large serving table runs the length of the west wall, while a pair of swinging doors leads to the north, and a smaller black modwir door leads to the south.

title: [Monastery, Kitchen]
description: A large firepit dominates the center of the room.  No fire burns within, however the ash and charred remains of previous fires still litter the bottom.  A large table stands near the western wall, pitted and scarred from many years of food preparation.  Hanging above the table is a long rack from which hangs a myriad of utensils, from razor-sharp butcher knives to heavy soup ladles.  Cooking pots of all shapes and sizes stand against the eastern wall.

title: [Kitchen, Pantry]
description: The pantry is overloaded with supplies.  Crates of food take up every inch of floor space, and the shelves are overfilled with dry goods.  Even the ceiling is being used for storage, with bundled goods hanging from solid iron chains bolted into the ceiling.

title: [Kitchen, Cold Storage]
description: The floor, ceiling and walls of this room have all been covered with iron plating to keep this room at a very frigid temperature.  Large chunks of ice litter the floor with crates of goods stacked between them.  Large flanks of meat hang from heavy iron hooks along the walls of the room.  As you look closer at the flanks, you notice that one of them is an ice-covered body.

title: [Dining Hall, Private Lounge]
description: Plush black carpet covers the floor here beneath an array of heavy embroidered tapestries that line the walls.  A dozen carved modwir chairs surround a huge table crafted of the same dark wood, and a single large chair of fine maoral stands at the head.  Along one wall, a silver serving table stands beside a polished maoral bar, and a stone basin rests in a corner of the room, barely visible in the flickering light of the elaborate crimson vaalin chandelier above you.

title: [Monastery, Carpeted Hall]
description: Incandescent globes hang from the ceiling, illuminating the hallway with an eerie glow.  Plush carpeting the color of warm blood covers the stone floor here, its pristine surface well-kept and free of stains.  The walls have been painted with archaic runes the same color as the carpeting.

title: [Monastery, Carpeted Hall]
description: One large globe hangs from the ceiling emitting a soft red light that covers everything in the hallway.  The runes along the walls seem to converge on the set of black vaalin double doors which stand at the west end of the passage.

title: [Sheruvian Monastery, Chapel]
description: A circular dais, with three small steps surrounding it, squats in the center of the room.  Standing alone on the dais is an altar formed from a block of black marble, the pale glow from the sphere overhead reflecting off of the veniom inlaid into its surface.  Lurking on the outskirts of this circular room, almost hidden in the heavy brocade tapestries adorning the walls, are statues, one for each of the Gods of Lornon.  Spaced between the statues are large candles on vaalin stands.

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: Torches are mounted on the walls at evenly spaced five-foot intervals down this corridor.  A portcullis is raised into the ceiling here, looking as if it could drop down at any moment to bar access in either direction.  A single iron-bound door stands on the east side of the portcullis.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Monastery, Well-Lit Hallway]
description: Faceted crystal globes a foot in diameter hang at five foot intervals, casting their unsettling light down on the tightly woven spidersilk carpet that lines the floors.  Mounted on the walls between each globe is a pair of crossed jeddart-axes, their blades polished to a mirror finish reflecting the light which dances across the wall opposite them.

title: [Monastery, Guard Room]
description: A large globe casts an eerie light from its position on the ceiling in the center of the room.  A weapon rack stands to either side of the iron-bound door on the south side of the chamber.  Four bunks occupy the room, with a footlocker resting at the end of each.  A large circular table with six chairs surrounding it sits near the northern wall.  Mounted over the table is a large crimson vaalin symbol of Sheru.

title: [Monastery, Granite Hallway]
description: A small hallway leads to the north and southwest.  The floors and walls are made of perfectly cut granite slabs which form a seamless surface.  Religious trappings for some of the dark gods adorn the walls at randomly spaced intervals down the hallway.

title: [Monastery, Granite Hallway]
description: Open doorways lead into small offices to the east and west.  The floors and walls are made of granite slabs cut to fit perfectly to form a seamless surface.  Religious trappings for some of the dark gods adorn the walls at randomly spaced intervals down the hallway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Monastery, Dead End]
description: Hanging from the northern wall is a tapestry dedicated to Sheru.  The remainder of the wall is devoid of any adornment, leaving Sheru to appear as if set off from the rest of the dark gods.  Large slabs of granite make up the floor and walls of this hallway, cut to perfection to form a seamless surface.

title: [High Priest's Chamber]
description: A large tapestry depicting the image of the sunset over the Lyserian Hills, the monastary perched upon a cliff face in the forefront, dominates the eastern wall of the room.  Standing in front of the tapestry is a large, intricately carved maoral desk.  Plush puma hide carpeting lines the floor and a grey puma hide couch covered in a large bear skin sits next to the open doorway to the west.

A large tapestry depicting the image of the sunset over the Lysierian Hills, the monastary perched upon a cliff face in the forefront, dominates the eastern wall of the room.  Standing in front of the tapestry is a large, intricately carved maoral desk.  Plush puma hide carpeting lines the floor and a grey puma hide couch covered in a large bear skin sits next to the open doorway to the west.

title: [Guard Captain's Chambers]
description: A pair of crossed jeddart-axes adorns the wall over a large felwood desk with a padded felwood chair behind it.  Sitting opposite the desk are two stiff-backed hardwood chairs that make the prospect of standing more appealing than settling into them.  But for a small mesh wastebasket, the floor of the office is bare, revealing the seamless granite surface underneath, and an open doorway leads into the hallway to the east.

title: [Monastery, Dark Passage]
description: The only light in this passage streams in from the open doorway to the west.  Rough grey carpeting sewn with golden runic patterns lines the floor, turning each footfall from the hard click of a stone floor to an almost inaudible thump.

title: [Monastery, Reading Room]
description: Incandescent globes hang in the corners of this room, casting a bright light throughout it.  An opened doorway leads to the east but that is the only open area in the room.  Every inch of floor space is occupied by small cubicles, into which one can bring books from the library to study.

title: [Monastery, Dark Passage]
description: Two faceted crystal spheres hang in mid air, to either side of a set of intricately carved haon double doors, casting an eerie yellow light across the passage.  Shadows dance around the rough grey carpeting before leaping onto the wall and taking rest upon the ceiling as the light chases them around the room.  The faint smell of sulphur and rose petals drifts through the air.

title: [Monastery, Summoning Chamber]
description: Wisps of smoke waft up from a black vaalin censer mounted on one richly panelled wall, filling the room with a sweet, sulfurous scent.  The walls are hung with ancient tapestries depicting the magical arts, and low cabinets along the walls hold a variety of phials, bottles, and leather tomes behind securely latched glaes panels.  A single incandescent globe is suspended from the ceiling, illuminating the room with its eerie glow.

title: [Monastery, Council Room]
description: In the center of the room stands a large triangular table cut from a single slab of granite.  A large faceted crystal globe hangs over the table, and three smaller ones adorn each corner.  A lone chair sits on each face of the triangle that forms the table.  Five feet behind each of those chairs rest two more with a small table between them.

title: [Monastery, Well-Lit Hallway]
description: An open doorway leads to the south, and a faint musty smell drifts in from that direction.  There are three faceted crystal orbs hanging in this section of the hallway, casting their strange yellow light down upon the spidersilk carpeting.

title: [Monastery, Library]
description: Tall bookshelves of dark modwir and ashwood line the walls, their glaes panels revealing glimpses of arcane tomes in languages you cannot begin to comprehend.  A large wooden table rests in the center of the room, illuminated by several small oil-fueled reading lamps, though no one seems to be studying here right now.

title: [Monastery, Hallway End]
description: Silence pervades this section of the hallway -- not even the lit torches standing to either side of the polished maoral double doors dare crackle to break it.  The light cast by the torches throws dancing shadows upon the walls of rough stone and the carpet of tightly-woven spidersilk.  The faceted crystal globe hanging from the ceiling here is devoid of any light at all.

title: [Elder's Chambers, Anteroom]
description: A musty odor of old, damp fiber rises from the plush carpeting beneath your feet.  Carefully arranged groupings of chairs and couches, richly upholstered in crimson and black brocade, are arranged around ornate tables of black vaalin and carved wood.  Heavy, dusty tapestries along the walls muffle any sound.

title: [Elder's Chambers, Bed Chamber]
description: The spacious chamber is dominated by a huge four-poster bed of dark maoral, its posts carved artfully into images of horrific monsters and demons.  The heavy, blood-red curtains that cover the walls make it impossible to tell if there are any windows, and the only illumination is the flickering light from a few black vaalin sconces.

title: [Elder's Chambers, Bath]
description: The sound of slowly dripping water echoes from somewhere behind the black and crimson tiles that line the chamber.  A deep black porcelain bathing-tub stands empty of water, glistening in the light of a few flickering candles set around its edges as if someone had been recently putting it to some use.  An ornate black iron incense burner emits wisps of a thick, almost overpowering fragrance.

title: [Elder's Meditation Chamber]
description: Plush crimson carpeting lines the floor of this small meditation room.  A block of dark vaalin stands against the northern wall with a lit golvern brazier atop it.  Hanging on the wall over the altar is an intricate unholy symbol of Sheru.

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: Torches stand opposite each other mounted on the walls in engraved brass sconces at five foot intervals.  Every sound in the corridor resonates off of the hard stone walls and floor, echoing into the distance.  Steel clashing can be heard in the distance.

title: [Monastery, Training Arena]
description: At first glance, this massive room looks like an open air courtyard found in many strongholds.  After a few moments, however, subtle differences can be seen.  The light illuminating this room comes from dozens of large globes suspended from the ceiling two stories above your head.  The floor is covered with dirt and grass, with a few spots worn away to reveal the stone underneath.  Three doors lead west, and a curtain hangs on the eastern wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Monastery, Training Area]
description: The floor of this room is littered with mats and the walls are lined with six-foot lengths of hardwood suspended from the ceiling by heavy chains.  Apparently, this room is used by the residents of this stronghold to stretch out and limber up before moving into the training area for a workout.

title: [Monastery, Training Area]
description: The floor of this room is littered with mats and the walls are lined with six-foot lengths of hardwood suspended from the ceiling by heavy chains.  Apparently, this room is used by the residents of this stronghold to stretch out and limber up before moving into the training area for a workout.

title: [Monastery, Armor Storage]
description: Racks of armor line the walls and mannequins containing the heavier armors stand throughout the room.  Heavy suits of polished plate stand side by side with the hardened leather breastplate of a suit of brigandine.  Each suit of armor in this room appears to have been made by a master armorsmith, but none of it contains the markings of an enchanter.  You also see an iron-bound heavy modwir door.

title: [Monastery, Storage Room]
description: Large crates and iron-bound barrels fill this cramped storage room from floor to ceiling.  A damp, musty odor hangs in the air surrounding the stacks of hay to either side of the door.  The cracked stone blocks that compose the floor are stained with dried blood where the barrels stand.

title: [Monastery, Weapons Storage]
description: Racks of weapons line the walls and floors, forming cramped aisles for anyone wishing to traverse this room.  Weapons of every shape and size, of every style imaginable, line the racks awaiting the day they are called into service once again.  All of the weapons are very well crafted, but none of them are of exceptional quality and none of them appear to contain any magical properties.  You also see an iron-bound heavy modwir door.

title: [Monastery, Baths]
description: Set into the cold stone floor are a half dozen baths lined with seamless granite.  Steam rolls off of the water in each bath, casting a layer of fog over the entire room.  The steady rhythm of a drop of water falling from the ceiling and into one of the tubs of water is the only sound that pierces the silence here.  You also see a thick black velvet curtain.

title: [Baths, Sauna]
description: The tiled room is darker here, lit only by the light from the south and the glow of a pit of steaming rocks that lies in one corner, sizzling with foul steam as a rivulet of water drips into it from above.  The air is thick with the smell of decay and sweat.

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: Two lit torches stand sentry over the open doorway to the west.  Light streams in from the open archway to the north, and the ground in that direction appears to be covered with grass.  A faint breeze sails down the hallway, causing the tapestries to the south to rustle as it passes.

title: [Monastery, Chamber]
description: Plush grey carpeting covers the floor from wall to wall, and a large modwir conference table dominates the center of the room with a dozen stiff-backed modwir chairs encircling it.  Covering the wall opposite the open doorway is a large tapestry hanging over a small polished modwir sideboard.

title: [Monastery, Stone Corridor]
description: The musty stone corridor ends here at a sculpted black vaalin arch.  Nineteen small crystal globes run the length of the arch, casting an eerie blue tint over everything in the room.  From the north, a faint breeze rushes in, causing the dust on the floor to swirl to life for a moment before settling back down between the cracks in the stones that line the floor.  An open doorway stands to the east.

title: [Monastery, Chamber]
description: Plush grey carpeting covers the floor from wall to wall, and a large modwir conference table dominates the center of the room with a dozen stiff-backed modwir chairs encircling it.  Covering the wall opposite the open doorway is a large tapestry hanging over a small polished modwir sideboard.

title: [Sheruvian Monastery, Main Hall]
description: Thick beams of timber support the cathedral ceiling in what appears to be the main entrance hall for this stronghold.  Massive cast-iron chandeliers hang from the support beams by thick chains, and each is adorned with hundreds of small, lit candles.  Elegant tapestries hang from the walls, proudly displaying crests and sigils unknown to you.  Every sound in this room echoes off of the hard stone blocks, giving the impression that there is more to the shadows than there appears to be.

title: [Monastery, Side Chamber]
description: Several plush chairs and couches line the walls of this room, with a low, round table in the center of them.  This looks like it is used as a waiting area for those visiting the stronghold to meet their guests within.

title: [Monastery, Cloak Room]
description: The walls of this small, cramped space are covered with rows of hooks.  Several of the hooks contain cloaks and capes, most likely deposited here by those visiting the monastery.  Several small mud-caked shelves stand near the curtained doorway to the west, a place to store your boots to prevent the mud from being tracked into the halls of the stronghold.

title: [Monastery, Chamber]
description: Plush grey carpeting covers the floor from wall to wall, and a large modwir conference table dominates the center of the room with a dozen stiff-backed modwir chairs encircling it.  Covering the wall opposite the open doorway is a large tapestry hanging over a small polished modwir sideboard.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Slopes]
description: This area is more sparsely wooded than the lower areas on the slope.  The trail leads gently upward here to the southwest.  A rocky mountain trail leads downward.

title: [Mountain Trail]
description: The trail runs northeast and southwest here.  A large pile of rocks and small boulders from an old avalanche forms a rocky slope to the southeast.  The slope levels off a little above the trail that you are on and looks to be an easy climb.

title: [Fire Pit]
description: The trail comes to a halt here.  The steep walls around this natural enclosure provide shelter from the winds blowing across the face of the mountain.  The remnants of an old fire pit lie in the center of this sheltered area.

title: [Cave Entrance]
description: The light from outside casts strange shadows along the walls of this natural cave.  You see the faint outline of old footprints in the hard packed earth.  Strange, crude drawings have been drawn on the walls.  To the south you see that the cave goes deeper into the side of the mountain.

title: [Gnoll Lair, Guard Post]
description: This seems to be a guard post of a sort.  A pile of rough stones looks as if it would provide good cover from anyone entering these caves.  As you peer behind the pile of stones, you notice a round depression in the soil, apparently left by many shifts of sleeping sentries.  To the north, faint light can be seen from the cave entrance, and to the south the caves descend rapidly into the depths of the mountain.

This seems to be a guard post of a sort.  A pile of rough stones looks as if it would provide good cover from anyone entering these caves.  As you peer behind the pile of stones, you notice a round depression in the soil, apparently left by many shifts of sleeping sentries.  To the north, faint moonlight can be seen from the cave entrance, and to the south the caves descend rapidly into the depths of the mountain.

title: [Gnoll Lair, Underground Lake]
description: This area is by the shore of an underground lake.  Dim light comes from some of the phosporescent lichen here.  As you look across the lake you notice a slight current seems to flow through it, possibly feeding to the Locksmehr River at some point.  Some discarded fishing tools and a few fish remains lie on the shore.  The shore continues to the east.  To the south you see a smaller tunnel heading off from this massive chamber.

title: [Gnoll Lair, Living Area]
description: This seems to be the home of the cave gnolls.  A few piles of lichen and mushrooms lie stacked along the western wall.  Stacked along the southern wall are several casks of some sort of gnollish wine.  A rack of dried fish leans against the eastern wall.  The central part of this chamber has a few fur pelts and a couple piles of bare white bones.  To the north the cave opens to a wider area, and to the southeast lies a very dark cavern.

title: [Misty Cavern]
description: This part of the caves seems to be mostly untouched.  A fine mist blankets the floor of this cavern.  Stalactites and stalagmites have grown from the ceiling and floor blocking your path in places.  Minerals create a glimmering effect on the natural formations of rock.  The dim illumination from the cave lichen creates an unsettling sense of quiet here.  You feel a sense of holiness and sanctuary here.  The cave leads northwest and east out of the place of wonder.

title: [Gnome Mine, Supplies]
description: This massive cave dwarfs the few supplies stored here.  What few items that are here, have all been placed near the exit to the northwest.  Your footsteps echo strangely in this wide cavern.  The lighting is so dim that you cannot see into the furthest recesses of the cavern.  A fine mist gently rolls out along the floor of the cave from the west.

title: [Gnome Mine, Living Area]
description: This is the central area of the gnome mine.  A small stove burns low near the center of the room.  Near the stove, a pile of freshly mined ore is stacked neatly against a small forge.  Some furs are stacked in the northwestern corner near a large cask of water.  The tunnel to the southeast leads to a much larger cavern.

title: [Gnome Mine, Tunnels]
description: This area is riddled with small tunnels that lead off in all directions.  Apparently this is the central room for a myriad of small mining shafts.  An overturned cart on the side of the room looks like it was used to pull ore out of these small shafts at one time.  You hear the steady ring of metal on stone coming from deep within one of these small holes.  The main path through the caves leads west and northeast from here.  To the southwest you see a much larger cavern.

title: [Gnome Mine, Mine Entrance]
description: This area is dimly lit by the lichen on the ceiling of the cave.  From the scratches on the walls it looks like all the lichen that could be reached has been harvested for some purpose.  To the northwest the cave leads to an area of better light.  The cave winds around from the northeast to the southwest.

title: [Gnome Mine, Entrance]
description: This is the entrance to a series of natural caves.  As your eyes adjust to the change in light you see a path worn in the cave floor leading to the southeast.  It looks like the cave off to the southwest is seldom used by the cave occupants.

title: [Gnome Mine, Guard Post]
description: The remains of an old guard post are here.  From the positioning of a small rock barrier, it seems that this post was made to prevent anyone from entering the caves in this direction.  A small rut has been worn behind the barrier, apparently from the repeated pacing of sentries at this point.  To the west the cave seems to open into a much larger cavern.  Dim light can be seen coming from the northeast.

title: [Gnoll Lair, Underground Lake]
description: You are on the south side of an underground lake.  The water in the lake is more stagnant here.  You can see a couple of blind cave fish swimming lazily in the shallows of the lake.  The lichen on the walls here gives off a dim blue-grey light which is barely enough to see by.  To the west lies the western shore of the lake, and to the east you notice a small tunnel leading into darkness.

title: [Underground Lake, Shallows]
description: You stand in the shallow waters of an underground lake.  You can feel a slight current flowing around your legs.  A few cave fish float about in the water around you.  Along the cave walls here you see more of the lightly glowing lichen.  The light from the lichen gives the water an unusual hue, that plays tricks on your eyes.  Every now and then, you see something dart past you, underwater. This is as deep as you'd like to go.

title: [Mountain Trail]
description: This spot is at the crest of an old rockslide, a few stray rocks still littering the ground.  It seems that they have been arranged into a definite pattern, though its meaning eludes you.  The rocky slope of the avalanche leads down to the northwest.  A trail leads upwards to a small plateau to the southeast.

title: [Mountain Trail, Plateau]
description: Several trails lead up to this plateau.  A strong wind blows from the northeast, howling across the openness of the plateau.  A small tree still clings to the rocks, fighting the constant wind.  Small claw marks have shredded the base of the tree.  The trail to the east slopes downward towards a dark crevice in the rock.  To the northeast and southeast the trail follows a ridge around the sides of the crevice.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Ridge Line]
description: The ridge continues here.  As you peer down into the crevice below, you can barely make out the floor far below you.  You hear the strange echo of an animal growling nearby.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: The ridge continues west and northeast here.  The sound of something skittering across bare rock can just be heard.  The ridge slopes downward to the northeast.

title: [Ridge End]
description: The ridge continues to the northwest and southwest.  The walls of the mountain rise up to the east, providing some shelter from the biting winds.  You notice a small tuft of fur wedged amongst the rocks.  It looks like some animal has been using this area as its lair.

title: [Rocky Ridge]
description: The cold wind is at its fiercest here.  A natural rock formation tunnels the wind directly at you, threatening to push you off into the deep crevice to the south.  The trail slopes downward to the southeast and seems better sheltered from the wind.

title: [Rocky Ridge]
description: The trail here runs along the rim of a deep crevice.  The winds cut into you as you cross this exposed section of the trail.

title: [Mountain Crevice]
description: The walls of the crevice close in upon the trail here.  A narrow opening, which you can just edge your way through, leads downward into the crevice itself.  The trail leads upward to the west to a plateau.

title: [Crevice Floor]
description: The confined space here gives you a sense of claustrophobia.  The wind blowing across the top of the crevice creates a haunting melody throughout this area.  A dark hole lies in the southern wall, and it seems that you can just make out the sound of shuffling footsteps coming from it.  The crevice narrows to the east and a narrow path leads out of the crevice.

title: [Crevice Floor]
description: The crevice floor is hard packed here, apparently having been trod upon by many small feet.  Small pockmarks and a broken mining pick indicate that some mining has been done on the walls of the crevice here.  To the east the walls of the crevice come together, preventing any further travel in that direction.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Winding Path]
description: Towering pines cling precariously to the mountainside along this twisted trail.  Shadows dance and flicker over the branches, and a large tower looms in the distant sky.
Towering pines cling precariously to the mountainside along this twisted trail.  Rays of moonlight dance and flicker over the branches, and a large tower looms silhouetted in the distant night sky.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Clearing]
description: Thorny branches tangle and twist along the contorted path.  A decrepit stone tower looms darkly before you, nearly hidden behind the brush.  Stopping to peer closely at the tower, you spot a small entrance nearly hidden behind some toppled boulders.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Dark Tower]
description: Cobwebs of immense size hang from the rafters, and a musky smell wafts up from the rotting wood floor.  A charred glaes orb lies in a dark corner, emanating a sickly faint glow.  Entranced by its power, you still hesitate to touch it, feeling a definite evil presence.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Tower Cellar]
description: An eerie pall of silence falls over this dark chamber filled with an array of torturous devices.  Battered shackles dangle from loops on the walls, and dried patches of blood stain the packed dirt floor.  Behind an imposing iron table, you see a rough-edged hole carved into the wall.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Shady Path]
description: A narrow trail carved out of the rock meanders away from the tower.  Disturbing grunting noises beckon to the northeast, just past a gnarled pine.  A chilling breeze blows down from the mountains above, blowing dead leaves across your path.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Village]
description: A decrepit village lies sprawled in all directions.  Ragged tents lie in various states of disarray and small fires burn along the path.  Off to your side, a rabid mutt tears at the carcass of some small animal and snarls menacingly at you as it chews.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Village NW]
description: The path winds its way past several scrappy tents and hovels.  The burnt shell of a tent blocks part of the path, causing you to step cautiously around it.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Inside Tent]
description: No one seems to be home in this decrepit hovel, and you wonder what sort of creature could actually live in this filth.  A fire pit dug in the center of the tent holds some gnawed on bones covered with ashes.  The stench inside here is revolting, turning your stomach as you gasp for a breath of fresh clean air.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Village NE]
description: A well-traveled path winds up the side of the mountain, away from the main village.  A penetrating wind howls through the scraggly pines that cling dangerously among the rocks.  A rotten stench wafts out at you from the mouth of a small cave dug into the mountainside.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Dark Shrine]
description: A powerful stench overwhelms you as you step inside the cave.  Rotting animal carcasses lie scattered about the dirt floor, below a bloodstained crude stone altar.  Pelts of various sizes and shapes cover walls marked with odd scratchings, and you shudder as your gaze falls on one that looks quite a bit like the remains of a halfling.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Rocky Trail]
description: A steep and rocky trail heads up the mountainside.  Twisted and gnarled pines cling desperately to the few patches of soil scattered among the rocks.  From somewhere high above in the branches muted chirping and chattering fills the chilly air.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Rocky Trail]
description: A pile of impassable rubble marks an abrupt end to the path.  Swirling tendrils of fog weave around the rubble while a slight damp breeze stirs up the sand underfoot.  This high on the mountainside, even the slightest breeze quickly numbs everything it touches.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Twisted Path]
description: Sturdy pine trees line a path scattered with brush.  The muted sounds of the village fade off into the distance as you scrabble east along the mountainside.  A lone squirrel chatters from a branch high above, sending a warning of your presence.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Twisted Path]
description: Breathing heavily in the thin cold air, you manuever around a fallen log that blocks the trail.  Dead lichen blankets the log, chewed partly away by some unknown animal.  Winding off to the east, the trail heads higher into the mountains.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Twisted Path]
description: Wandering past the ancient rocks, you can barely make out the path between the twisted pine trees.  Crunching pine cones under your feet, you make out the sounds of small animals scurrying off at your approach.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Twisted Path]
description: A small hilltop looms to the southeast, marking the end of this quiet path.  Clouds roll in from the valley below, and you try to catch your breath as you realize you've climbed quite high into the mountainside.  The chilling wind whistles down from above, stirring dust along the path.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Barren Hill]
description: The sweat from your exhaustive climbing turns to chill as you reach the crest of this barren hilltop.  A slight fog swirls about the ground, wisping up from the clouds below.  A narrow ravine leads down the mountainside, disappearing behind the rocks.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Ledge]
description: At the base of a rocky ravine, this narrow ledge is eroded from the side of the mountain.  The wind blows fiercely down from above, threatening to sweep you along with it.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Overlook]
description: A chill runs down your spine as the clouds part to reveal Darkstone in all its evil glory.  Even from this distance, the foreboding sight brings a shudder deep in your bones and a sense of dread to your heart.  A path leads down to the valley below, but is barred by immovable rubble.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Ledge]
description: The ledge melds back into the side of the mountain here.  Sparse clumps of weeds cling to the mountainside, nearly buried amongst the rubble left from a long dormant landslide.  Peering off through the clouds, you can barely make out the spires of a sinister-looking castle.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A rugged trail leads away from the landslide in front of you, passing through a thicket of bushes and short pines.  Crossing the landslide appears treacherous, and several boulders teeter precariously on the mountainside above, seeming to taunt those who would dare the climb.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Large rocks crop out from the sparse, rolling pastureland.  It is no wonder that this area has not been settled, as the uneven, rocky terrain could hardly be considered prime farmland.  To the north, a thin track leads into a brushy forest of modwirs and pines.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: A few sprigs of grass poke out from between two large boulders, the stones sheltering the grass from even the most persistent grazers.  The distant sound of running water can be heard from the vicinity of the thick brush in the middle of the pasture, further down the slope to the southwest.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Thousands of hooves have worn a track around a large yellow pine that has fallen into the pasture, as the herds have been forced to acknowledge the massive intruder.  As testament to a blaze long past, a large fire scar has blackened nearly half of the butt of the fallen tree.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Pesky, foot-tangling alder encroaches upon the pasture, reaching as far as it can from the forest edge.  The lower leaves of the large shrubs have been eaten away by the roaming herds.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: The stony ground is hard to walk on, threatening to turn an ankle with every step.  As with most of the pasture here, the grass has been trimmed down to the ground by the grazing of the herds.  In the forest to the northeast, a thrush sings out its three-note call.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Meadow grasses eke out an existence in clumps here and there in this field of stones, and a few persistent clover flowers can be seen nestled next to a rugged boulder.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Thick brush lines the stream running through the middle of the pasture, the shrubs clinging tenaciously to the banks, refusing to cede their ground.  The herds have worn a trail along the streambanks, avoiding the annoyance of the brush in search of easier access elsewhere.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: The stream meanders through the rocky meadowlands, wandering lazily into the trees to the north.  Where it enters the forest, you catch a glimpse of a large pool of water nestled in the modwirs and pines.  The natural boundary of the pasture has been expanded up the slope to the northwest, and scattered stumps can be seen dotting the hillside.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: The stream flowing from the stony meadowland to the south gathers in a large waterhole which spreads placidly before you.  The herds have worn a path from the pastures and along the waterhole towards a heavily leaning tree that can be seen to the west.  A breeze gently wafts over the pool, creating a barely noticeable ripple.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: A sweeping modwir tree leans far over the pool before you, struggling to keep from falling into the water.  A heavily worn trail leads down to the pool at the base of the tree, and many rolton and gak tracks can be seen in the shallow water near the edge.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: The trees lining the pond shade a small wooden dam that has been haphazardly thrown into the streambed.  Dark algae has collected on the sides of the pool, turning the water to a yellow-brown tint as it flows over the logs of the dam.
