The gentle sounds of the water pouring over the dam and splashing on the rocks add a soothing touch to this rugged terrain.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: A noisy brook flows into a line of thick brush that runs through the middle of the pasture to the northwest.  Thin meadow grasses grow with determined resolve, dodging stones and gopher holes as they reach their short stems skyward.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: The modwirs and pines have parted here and the pasture has pressed into the forest, rising up the slope as it follows the quickly flowing stream.  Farther up the slope, a small waterfall can be seen where the stream flows over a rock outcropping more than three giantmen in height.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Water chuckles boisterously as it falls into the stream, cascading over an outcropping some twenty feet above and splashing off of the rock wall.  Scattered about the forest floor, modwir and pine cones rest amongst fallen needles.  To the northwest, the stream flows down into a sparse, rocky pasture.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: The thin turf has been torn from the ground in places, unable to resist the persistent nibbling of the herds.  Scattered shapes can be seen up the hillsides to both sides of the small creek, randomly making their way across the field.  A small ring of stones has been left by an unknown traveller, circling a charred fire pit.  A gently eddying breeze blows over the fire, tossing up small puffs of ashes.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Weathered boards have been laid across the bubbling, winding creek in a makeshift bridge, apparently placed there for creatures too small to leap its narrow width.  The stony grassland rises up to the east and west to meet distant tree-lined ridges.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Flowing to the northwest, the stream bubbles over rocks and wood with a pleasant, relaxing laughter.  The thin carpet of meadow grasses spreads away from the stream, interspersed with a few large clumps that appear untouched by the herds.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: The thick snowberry and gooseberry shrubs part slightly, and a worn path wends between them down to the edge of a stream.  Up the slopes along the sides of the stream, roltons and gaks wander about, grazing on the sparse grass.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Stones rest in piles along the path that winds beside the brushy creek, placed in small mounds by unknown hands.  The rocky pasture rises up to the southwest, towards a tree-lined ridge.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: A broken, stony meadow slopes down before you towards a brush-lined creek.  Short, limby pines and modwirs line the ridgetop, and a shaded path wends its way towards a forested valley to the west.  A gentle breeze blows across the meadow, carrying the distinct smell of the roltons and gaks that call this pasture home.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Branches and blocks of wood have been piled together to create a windbreak between the trees along the ridgetop, and the ground between the trees has been worn down to dirt by the hooves of the gaks and roltons over time.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Dozens of small, dusty mounds lie scattered amongst the grasses and stones, each betraying the location of a gopher's hole.  One gopher stands at the entrance to its hole and chews on a blade of grass, seemingly unconcerned with your intrusion.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Short, purple-tufted thistles fight with the stubborn meadow grasses for dominance in this corner of the pasture.  The thistles appear to be winning the battle, since the herds have been avoiding such prickly fare in favor of the more appealing clover and grasses.

title: [Graendlor Pasture]
description: Fire-blackened stumps stand silently, the pale meadow grasses growing in the rocky terrain that surrounds the charred remains.  Rough axe marks can be seen at the tops of some of the stumps, and it is evident that the shepherds have been trying to expand their stony pastureland.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Branches drape over the trail here, sheltering the path from the sunlight above you.  Sporadic bleating is carried on the breeze, wafting over the trail that leads over the ridge to the east.
Branches drape over the trail here, sheltering the path from the moonlight above you.  Sporadic bleating is carried on the breeze, wafting over the trail that leads over the ridge to the east.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Wending its way amongst the trees and undergrowth, the trail leads down towards a small clearing.  Up the slope towards the northeast a squirrel chitters noisily, disturbed by your presence.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A break in the trees reveals a clear view of the wooded valley below and of the rugged peaks beyond it to the south.  The scent of the pines and modwirs surrounding the small clearing fills the air.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Not far below, the valley widens and the trees thin, leaving grassy meadows amongst the arboreal landscape.  A brief gust of wind eddies across the path up the slope, kicking up a small cloud of dust.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: The grassy sward sways gently, dancing as a slight breeze carries over the meadow.  The peacefulness of the moment is lost quickly, however, as the harsh, guttural voices of hobgoblins are carried on the wind.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A massive boulder, nearly the size of two houses, dominates the forest with its gargantuan presence.  A hodgepodge of small poles and branches has been laid against the boulder on one side, providing shelter from the wind and rain in stormy weather.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: The vantage point here behind the massive boulder affords a good view of the trail below.  Bits and pieces of rusted weapons are scattered about on the ground, suggesting that perhaps this place has been used more than once as a handy base for an ambush.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Small purple violets poke their way through the grass surrounding a pile of stones, growing comfortably in the sheltering shade.  A myriad of tracks can be seen in this crossroads, most of the prints the easily discernible plodding tracks of hobgoblins.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A large patch of grass has been burned away in a circle, leaving singed black turf amongst the stony ground.  In the center of the circle a swash of bloody red has been painted across a blue-green triangle, and the faint, pungent scent of incense hangs around the symbol.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Large rocks crop up from the floor of the valley, interspersed among the trees and grasses.  The view of Wehntoph is magnificent as it rises from the foothills to the southeast like a grand monolith, challenging the sky.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Creeping underbrush intrudes on the path, its grasping fingers creating a nuisance with every step.  Some of the branches have been crudely hacked by impatient travellers, the shrubs' annoyance leading to their demise.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A small group of rickety huts stands on the edge of a small clearing, creaking loudly as a short gust of wind carries through the vale.  Though no creatures can be seen within the dilapidated hovels, there is a sense that someone or something is watching.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Silvery clouds stretch across the sky above this stony meadow like celestial candles reaching for the flame of the sun.  The sun shines brightly over the meadow as it steadily moves on its path, keeping just slightly ahead of the thin clouds.

Silvery clouds stretch across the sky above this stony meadow like celestial candles reaching for the moon.  The moon shines brightly over the meadow as it steadily moves on its path, keeping just slightly ahead of the thin clouds.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Grasshoppers leap amongst the thick blades of grass, the larger insects' wings chattering loudly as they fly.  Winding, time-worn paths lead through the grassy meadow in several directions, beckoning you to follow.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Trees stand silently on the edge of the valley, passive witnesses to the passing of travellers and hunters.  Unwilling to be as silent as their forest abode, dark blue jays chatter loudly as they swoop through the branches overhead.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Fungus grows along the length of some greyed rolton bones that have been hung from the low branches of a pine tree.  The bones dangle in a circular pattern, surrounding a small pile of stones which are topped with the rolton's skull.  The silence of the forest seems to deepen eerily in the presence of the odd marker.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: The pleasant scent of modwir branches hangs over the area, mingled with the distinct presence of pines.  The rugged beauty of the mountain and the fresh forest smells lend an invigorating quality to the air.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Off to the side of the trail through the trees, branches and grasses have been gathered into a circular pile, creating a bed for some wandering creature.  The trees thin towards the southwest, offering a glimpse of the rocky peak.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A thick patch of snarled hobgoblin hair clings to a nearby stump, disturbing the serenity of the grassy meadow to the southeast.  Sparse trees line the path as it leads into the forest, snaking away from the silent glen.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A lone pine snag stands in the middle of this grassy clearing like an aging monarch.  Lightning scars can be seen encircling the trunk of the tree, and its top has fallen a short distance away, victim to the ravages of a storm long past.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Faint trails wind through the grassy sward surrounding you, disappearing into the meadow like tendrils of smoke.  The muted, sweet scent of clover rises from the plush green vale.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: Modwirs and pines hem in on the edge of the meadow, forming a small cul-de-sac.  A large storm cloud hangs ominously in the grey sky over the majestic mountain above, flashing and rumbling as it drapes over the peak.  The black cloud suddenly flashes and a great bolt of lightning crashes down on the mountaintop.  Moments later the low rumble of thunder rolls over the vale.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: This end of the valley spreads in a pleasant, green meadow of wild grasses and flowers.  To the south, foothills rise up towards the towering peak of Wehntoph, the gentle slopes giving way to the mountain's rugged face.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A small stream borders the grassy glen, wending along the edge of a heavy thicket of alder and modwir trees.  Small golden butterflies dance their way through the meadow and into the forest, flitting frenetically as they evade imaginary perils.

A small stream borders the grassy glen, wending along the edge of a heavy thicket of alder and modwir trees.  Tiny fireflies dance their way through the meadow and into the forest, flitting frenetically as they evade imaginary perils.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: The terrain gently slopes upward from the valley below, the lush green of the vale losing its hold to the less friendly soil.  Small wildflowers begin to peek out from the grass, their forms varied and colorful.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: A tiny spring bubbles gently, several small rocks purposely encircling it.  An iridescent green dragonfly floats lightly upon the surface of the water, shifting only to compensate for the slight breeze.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: The ground is peppered with dozens of little holes, home to some of the many tiny rodents that live in the area.  From time to time a small furry head pops out, only to dive back into the burrow at the faintest movement or noise.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: Litter, charred wood, and a few old utensils are scattered about a much-used firepit of worn round stones.  You can look down to the vale from this vantage point, but the cliffside beneath is treacherous and unclimbable.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: Years of erosion have formed a ragged trench between two hills.  The sides of the rut are steep, severely restricting where one can walk.  Loose stones tumble from the hillside, making the bad footing even worse.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: Winter runoff has deepened the rut, creating a wide crevice in the hillside.  Several twisted weeds have sprouted within the ditch, a few bushes atop its edges.  A small cave looms to the southwest.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: A gentle breeze softly tugs at the hillside flowers, their stalks gently swaying to and fro atop the narrow gully.  The trench continues upward towards a small ledge.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: From atop this ledge a wonderful view of the vale nearby is revealed, the lush greenery a stark contrast to the scattered chaparral of the hillside. Small lizards dart amongst the many rocks, frightened by your presence.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: The bones of a small animal rest near a patch of fireweed, tiny midges buzzing nearby.  The grass here grows in clumps, a few hardy shrubs dotting the path as well.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: An odd greyish rock sits directly in the path, a large crack running down its center.  A huge chunk is also missing from the top of the stone, as if somebody or something had slammed it quite hard.

title: [Wehntoph, Highland Hills]
description: While the ledge here is comfortably wide, the view below reveals a considerable drop.  Rusted iron spikes long ago driven into the stony outcropping below allow easier climbing.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, up

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: Perched on the side of this rugged hillside, a small granite tombstone stands as a testimony to a long past traveller.  The elements have taken their toll upon this marker, and its surface is chipped and worn, the engraving upon it barely legible.

title: [Wehntoph, Cave]
description: A natural cave has formed in the hillside, providing shelter from the elements and a convenient resting place.  Drawings mar the walls, clear evidence that others have been here before you.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: A large horned goat peers at you from a safe distance, his ears cocked at your intrusion.  His cloven feet seem far better suited to this terrain than yours.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: The wind carries a sharp edge, cutting through even the heaviest apparel.  The vale is a distant carpet of green, and the mountain looms taller than ever.  Ragweed, spindly brush and loose stones are all that seem to take hold upon this slope.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: Huge footprints lead off in all directions, their marks forming an odd pattern around a broken and now useless club resting just off the path.  The soil beneath your feet rumbles ever so slightly, as if something quite large were passing near.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: A wooden lean-to has been built here, far too large for any normal being.  Peering in, you see a cracked clay bowl and a few crude utensils.  It appears to have been abandoned for quite some time.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: The trail curves a bit, narrowing around this rim of the hill.  Several large boulders loom overhead, nervously perched against flimsy brush.  A peek down the hillside reveals a few massive stones that have lost their hold and crashed down the slope.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: A huge wall of timber has been dragged here, stopping any further passage upward.  Thunderous footsteps nearby rattle the trunks, causing a few wild birds to take flight.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: The dirt here is quite loose, small stones shifting and tumbling with every footstep.  A lightning strike has blackened and scorched the soil, the charred remains of several shrubs also victims to the bolt.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: A low growl can be heard from nearby, but a quick look reveals no trace of the source.  The shrub-covered hills provide considerable cover for any creatures that might be lurking.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: The area flattens into a small plateau.  The pathway down towards the vale is well-travelled and fairly wide, with few obstructions blocking your way.  Old sticks have been pounded into the trail, creating a makeshift rail.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: The trail runs along the rim of the hill, the ledge narrow and dangerous.  A dislodged rock rolls over the lip of the ledge, and the clattering of its fall can be heard for several moments.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: The view from this spot is both spectacular and frightening.  One misstep from here would surely be your last, yet the breathtaking panorama before you is quite stunning.  There is a howling in the wind, however, that would give even the bravest a moment's pause.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Slopes]
description: This small flat clearing separates the gentle slope of the hill from the fierce incline of the mountain.  A lone white cloud hangs high above, lingering in the sky like a lone sentinel.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: The terrain takes a turn for the worse above you.  While the hike down is no picnic, there are clear paths to follow.  The mountain face is steep, covered with thorny shrubs, and the few roots you might use to pull yourself up look weak and unsupporting.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: To the east is nothing but sky and a long fall downwards.  Chittering barks out from a small burrow, warning you off.  Clearly the creature within the tiny lair is not the one to worry about.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: A well-defined trail leads down from this flattened area, completely clear of brush or stones.  Several small rock pikas dive for cover at your approach, chittering loudly as they flee.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: Huge odd-shaped boulders form a ring, perhaps a crude shrine.  Glyphs and runes have been scratched into the stones, their origin and meaning both unknown.  This is as high as you can climb, and the breathtaking view gives the illusion of being atop the clouds, gazing down upon the world from heavenly heights.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: Shattered stone litters the trail, remnants of some larger boulders.  The few plants that have managed to poke through the hardened soil have been trampled by heavy footfall.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: Past travellers' attempts to carve a path further upward on the face of the great mountain have failed miserably.  A pile of dirt, boulders and brush has tumbled down and formed a crude barrier, dissuading future foolhardy efforts.  Amidst the rubble are some torn pieces of leather battle armor, stained with old dried blood.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: Nearly a hundred feet above, a ledge is well out of reach from this path along the cliff face.  Stones and pebbles rain down from the ledge, dislodged by an unseen disturbance.  A series of deep divots carved into the mountainside lead down from the narrow path.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: The peak of the mountain can be seen from this ledge, still high above you.  The wind comes to greet you, its touch fierce and unwelcome.  An occasional lightning flash fills the sky, though only this mountain peak seems clouded.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: Tall brush reaches out to embrace you with its spiny fingers, the sharp thorns making your trek all the more uncomfortable.  Booming thunder sounds in the distance, its origin unknown.

title: [Wehntoph, Northern Face]
description: A ragged flag pierces the ground, its rough construction nothing more than an iron pike with a tattered cloth attached.  This is as close to the peak of the mountain as is attainable, the marker before you testimony that others have travelled here as well.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A large boulder, surrounded by several smaller stones, sets just off the path.  These rocks are unlike any nearby, making their presence even more intriguing.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A roughly built lean-to shelter stands in obvious disrepair near the trail.  How long it has been here or who built it is unclear, but it is still quite functional.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A strange "squeaking" sound reaches your ears as you enter this area.  Glancing about, you realize that it is caused as two great trees rub against each other as they sway in the wind.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The ridge bends sharply here and the trail bends as well as it follows along the top.  A rocky outcropping on each side of the trail provides a tremendous view of the surrounding countryside.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The path is difficult to follow here.  It has become very faint as it follows along the top of the ridge.  Obviously, little traffic passes this way.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The ridge becomes a little wider here and the path cuts through a section of weatherbeaten grasses and shrubs.  The clear view of the sky allows the sun to warm this area, making it a pleasant place to rest and relax.

The ridge becomes a little wider here and the path cuts through a section of weatherbeaten grasses and shrubs.  The clear view of the sky allows the moonlight to illuminate this area with a soft glow, making it a pleasant place to rest and relax.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Large clumps of grass grow up on the path making travel difficult.  To the north can be seen a bright clearing while to the south can be seen a rocky ledge.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This is the wide northern end of a rugged outcropping of rock that juts from the winding ridge that lies further to the north.  To the south can be seen the abrupt end of the outcropping while north is a faint path.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You are standing at the end of a narrow twisting ridge.  A faint trail can be seen heading off to the north.  The sheer drop of several hundred feet to the valley floor below provides you with an excellent view of the surrounding area.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Outside Inn]
description: The path continues around the exterior of the drear, ramshackle shell of the old inn.  As you gaze at it, it is hard to imagine it once provided a welcome haven for weary travellers in the wilderness.  Now, as the hills of the Upper Trollfang press in around you, it inspires only a sense of fear and foreboding.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Outside Inn]
description: Scrubby, low brush and withered, sere wildflowers encroach on the path and the revitalized wooden structure nearby.  The lush hills in the distance are an odd contrast to your immediate surroundings, where signs of life seem too much to hope for within the once-deserted and still forbidding building.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Outside Inn]
description: A patch of scorched earth, a blackened, hardened ring of now baked mud, crosses the path and forbids the growth of any vegetation within its dead, foul boundaries.  The spot forms a perfect circle, and no signs of brushfire, lightning strike or other natural disaster mar the landscape.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Outside Inn]
description: Planks, splinters and old rusted iron nails are strewn across the footpath here.  In the side of the wreck is a gaping hole, now boarded up.  It appears that someone was in a great hurry to check out, without benefit of a door.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Outside Inn]
description: The hills huddle close to the path here, a smallish formation of earth and gravel looming directly above you.  Its surface is divided into networks of rain-washed gullies and channels.  The hillock casts an ominous gloom upon the path and the old inn.

The hills huddle close to the path here, a smallish formation of earth and gravel looming directly above you.  Its surface is divided into networks of rain-washed gullies and channels.  The night casts a sinister darkness upon the path and the old inn.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Outside Inn]
description: You stand atop a low, rolling hill.  Green waves of grass and trees stretch back towards the higher hills that cradle this low clearing around the old inn.  From this vantage point, you can survey the inn and its grounds, the decaying roof, the smashed windows, the empty courtyard.  The wind whistles softly, forlornly, through the ruins and twists and eddies around you, causing the foliage to dance.

You are atop a low, rolling hill.  Waves of grass and trees stretch back towards the higher hills that cradle this low clearing around the old inn, blanketed in darkness.  From this vantage point, you can survey the inn and its grounds, the decaying roof, the smashed windows, the empty courtyard.  The wind whistles softly, forlornly, through the ruins and twists and eddies around you, causing the foliage to dance.

title: [Badlands, Ravine]
description: Years of harsh wind and rain have torn all vegetation from the hills, carving out a ravine that mars the barren land like a vicious scar.  Aside from standing here in the bitter draft blowing off the hill to the south, your only options are to climb the sheer ravine wall, or to follow the twists and turns between the hills to the north.

Years of harsh wind and rain have torn all vegetation from the hills, carving out a ravine that mars the barren land like a vicious scar.  Aside from standing here in the bitter draft blowing off the hill to the south, your only options are to climb the sheer ravine wall in near-total darkness or to follow the twists and turns between the hills to the north.

title: [Badlands, Ravine]
description: The parched hills rise sharply on either side of the ravine.  The hard, cold ground is free of grass, and the only wild beasts that manage to survive here are small lizards that scamper in and out of the jagged rock formations.

The parched hills rise sharply on either side of the ravine.  The hard, cold ground is free of grass, and the only wild beasts that manage to survive here are small lizards that scamper in and out of the jagged rock formations in an sometimes vain attempt to elude larger nocturnal predators.

title: [Badlands, Ravine]
description: Stagnant flood water pools between the rocks of a shallow bend, the roots of a lone oak sipping the moisture jealously.  What little sunlight finds its way down the steep hillside walls is shaded out by the oak, leaving the wide, flat rocks cold as gravestones.

Stagnant flood water pools between the rocks of a shallow bend, the roots of a lone oak sipping the moisture jealously.  What little moonlight finds its way down the steep hillside walls is blotted out by the oak, leaving the wide, flat rocks in almost impenetrable darkness.

title: [Badlands, Ravine]
description: As the ravine reaches its widest, the protection of the steep walls lessens and wind tears through in intermittent blasts.  A gale howls one moment, and the next, the air is still as a tomb.  But always, a deep roar echoes down from the rocks above.

title: [Badlands, Ravine]
description: A pair of hills crowds in, and to the north the ground rises swiftly.  The path, if you want to call it that, narrows as it climbs toward the summit of the northernmost of the two hills.

title: [Badlands, Ravine]
description: The ravine ends in a sheer wall of crumbling shale.  The slightest movement sends showers of rock cascading down to the floor of the ravine below.  A few tiny yellow flowers have sprung up on a ledge nearby, bringing some color to this otherwise dismal land.

The ravine ends in a sheer wall of crumbling shale.  The slightest movement sends showers of rock cascading down to the floor of the ravine below.  A few tiny flowers, pale yellow in the moonlight, have sprung up on a ledge nearby, bringing some color to this otherwise dismal land.

title: [Badlands, Hillock]
description: The hilltop, frequently blasted by cold winds and chill rain, is barren of all but the toughest shrubs.  A warren of canyons twists between the forlorn hills in every direction.  On the next hillock to the southeast, you spy a huge humanoid figure.  It slumps motionless, perhaps a fearsome giant contemplating the wastelands.

The hilltop, frequently blasted by cold winds and chill rain, is barren of all but the toughest shrubs.  A warren of canyons twists between the forlorn hills in every direction.  On the next hillock to the southeast, you spy a huge humanoid figure which blots out the stars.  It slumps motionless, perhaps a fearsome giant contemplating the wastelands.

title: [Badlands, Hillock]
description: The hill slopes rapidly down into a small gully.  Rain and melting snow have etched hundreds of small canals down the hillside, combining together to form a small gully, perhaps fifteen feet deep, below.

title: [Badlands, Gully]
description: A pile of stones almost blocks your way.  The large rocks look as though they might have been piled here to form a floodbreak.  Climbing over them is easy enough though, and a torrent of water might slow here, but would find its way through the large spaces eventually.

title: [Badlands, Gully]
description: The riverbed is filled with stones, some coarse, some smooth, some huge, and some ground into fine sand, with no clear point where the one gives way to the other.  The swirling winds and flood waters have sculpted the sandy banks into fantastic shapes that crumble in your fingers.

The riverbed is filled with stones, some coarse, some smooth, some huge, and some ground into fine sand, with no clear point where the one gives way to the other.  The swirling winds and flood waters have sculpted the sandy banks into fantastic shapes that gleam almost like snow in the faint moonlight.

title: [Badlands, Gully]
description: A landslide has left the underlying rock of the northern hillside bare.  The sandstone is a darker red than the greyish topsoil, and is colored in layers like an artist's palette.  Claw marks from some large creature mar the stone in places.

A landslide has left the underlying rock of the northern hillside bare.  The revealed sandstone is darker than the pale topsoil and is arranged in layers of varying shades of grey.  Claw marks from some large creature mar the stone in places.

title: [Badlands, Gully]
description: The gully abruptly meets a solid rock cliff face.  The cliff face slants inward a bit, and errant drops of water fall from the overhang.  The shadowy area under the cliff is slick with a thin layer of ice.

The gully abruptly meets a solid rock cliff face.  The cliff face slants inward a bit, and errant drops of water fall from the overhang.  The area under the cliff is slick with a thin layer of ice which shines coldly in the moonlight.

title: [Badlands, Hillock]
description: Atop a lonely hill sits a massive granite figure.  The great stone colossus sits astride the tumbled rocks of the mount like a king enthroned.  His reign has been a tragic one, and both feet, as well as his left arm, have long since crumbled away.  He sternly surveys the lands to the south, no doubt contemplating how to regain the lost glory of his dominion.

Atop a lonely hill sits a massive granite figure, his brow limned in moonlight.  The great stone colossus sits astride the tumbled rocks of the mount like a king enthroned.  His reign has been a tragic one, and both feet, as well as his left arm, have long since crumbled away.  He sternly surveys the lands to the south, no doubt contemplating how to regain the lost glory of his dominion.

title: [Colossus, Knees]
description: The knees of the giant are fused into a single smooth mass, unlike the pitted shins of the stone legs below.  A pair of great stone thighs stretches over to the bulk of the torso.  The stone is deathly cold, even through booted feet.

title: [Colossus, Lap]
description: A great puffed chest looms above you.  To one side, the bicep of a vast stone arm bulges, the forearm forming a railing and a windbreak as it melds with the stone of the lap.  The other arm is lost at the shoulder.

title: [Colossus, Right Shoulder]
description: On the windward side, the shoulder, face, and head of the giant statue are worn smooth.  The almost obliterated features appear childlike in their smoothness, but a majestic beard sprawls across the great chest, a forest of hewn stalactites hanging down from a noble chin.

title: [Colossus, Left Shoulder]
description: Sheltered from the worst of the winter gales, the left profile is still largely intact.  The solemn brow and aquiline nose bespeak of royal lineage. Locks of granite hair fall thickly over a chipped and fractured ear that cannot hear the shouts of mustered troops or supplicant peasants.  You also see a majestic beard of stone.

title: [Colossus, Crown]
description: The king's stone locks have been blasted by centuries of wind, and the head that was once crowned and full is bald now except for a few rounded protrusions.  As you gaze out across the lands before you, you feel as though you too are an immortal ruler surveying your lands.  But the lands are barren and the wind buffets you with fits of mocking laughter.

The king's stone locks have been blasted by centuries of wind, and the head that was once crowned and full is bald now except for a few rounded protrusions.  As you gaze up at the stars which fill the sky from horizon to horizon, you feel as though you too are an immortal ruler surveying your domain.  But the lands are barren and the chill night wind buffets you with fits of mocking laughter.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Entry]
description: A large rug woven in shades of light and dark green protects the floor in front of the door, looking comforting to tired feet.  Light from several candelabras plays over the golden grain of a polished wood desk, illuminating the neat stack of papers and ledgers necessary to keep an inn running smoothly.  The hall stretches north, flanked on the east by a curved wooden stair, and on the immediate west by a curtain of rich green brocade.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Bright brass candle holders line the walls.  They are filled with sweet-smelling beeswax candles, shedding light and a comforting warmth down the corridor.  A runner of forest green carpet covers the length of the hall's floor, leading the way to the guest room doors and a good night's sleep.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Pictures hang from the walls along this long corridor.  Portraits of important guests who once stayed in the inn, landscapes, and a wedding portrait of the proprietors while they still lived liven up the wood paneling between the guest room doors.  A simple wooden stair a little to the west marks the end of the hallway.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Suite]
description: An overstuffed couch done in a bright, leafy pattern sits against the wall, looking outside through the thick windows.  Upon a table by the windowsill stands a small vase, filled with fresh wildflowers likely picked this morning.  Simple open arches lead off to the north and south.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Bedroom]
description: The massive bed standing under the window leaves no room for other furniture.  An overabundance of pillows in green and gold tones pile high against the headboard, and a leaf-patterned comforter spreads across the deep mattress.  A rug in autumnal golds and oranges lies next to the bed, protecting warm feet from cold morning floors.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Suite]
description: Several chairs surround the small table that sits in the middle of the room.  Polished brass sconces hang in the corners, their candles illuminating the room gently.  It seems a perfect place to play cards, finish a bit of paperwork, or have an intimate meal.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Guest Room]
description: This cozy room has been done in shades of rich red.  Crimson curtains with tasselled ropes cover the windows, complemented by the deep red comforter resting on the bed.  Cream colored sheets peek out from under the heavy quilt, and a small cream spiral rug rests next to the bed.  A redwood nightstand finishes the look, standing just under the window.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Guest Room]
description: This room is larger than the rest of the guestrooms.  Several chairs and a small sofa provide a cozy sitting area, and a large bed leans against the wall behind them.  Rich purples and violets give the room a slightly regal touch, as if this room were perhaps meant for finer travellers passing through on their way to important business.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Alcove]
description: Windows decorated with colorful stained glaes look out over the countryside.  Jutting out slightly from the rest of the building, this alcove provides a pleasant place to sit and read, or simply daydream.  Fluffy pillows covered in soft velvet line the padded seat, and a small wooden ledge thoughtfully offers a spot to place a drink or light snack.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Attic]
description: Obvious effort has been expended to make this attic space respectable and neat.  No boxes or other storage containers clutter the corners, and the floor speaks of a recent soaping.  Brightly burning candles sit in polished sconces on either side of the door to the north.  Little crystals dangle from the holders, as if attempting to catch a casual observer's attention.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Guest Room]
description: A wood-framed bed stands in a corner, covered in fresh linens and thick down comforters.  Next to it is a small nightstand, providing a place for a clean bowl of wash water and a drawer for small necessities.  Dark curtains cover the windows to keep the light at bay until the room's occupant is ready to face it.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Guest Room]
description: A small hearth burns brightly in the corner of the room, grated against popping embers.  Comforters of deep blue shroud the bed in the opposite corner.  They are turned down invitingly, revealing soft cotton sheets and plump pillows.  A sunny yellow wash basin sits atop a small table placed under the windows, and thick curtains keep out any unwanted light.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: The forest green runner butts up against the wall at this end of the hallway.  To the south opens a pair of glass doors, allowing fresh air to flow in from the balcony.  A small door to the north leads into the common bathing chamber.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Bathing Room]
description: A deep tub rests on polished dragon claw feet in the center of the room.  Beside it stands a set of low shelves, holding an array of soaps, salts and potions.  Thick towels hang from a rack along one wall, and a fuzzy mat lies on the floor, ready to dry wet feet.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Balcony]
description: A few stray branches hang over the balcony, giving it a secluded, wooded feel.  The treetops of the Upper Trollfang stretch before you, branches rustling in a soft breeze.  Birds sing in the fresh air, insects buzz, and a stray hill troll glances upwards, shaking his fist angrily.

A few stray branches hang over the balcony, giving it a secluded, wooded feel.  The treetops of the Upper Trollfang stretch before you, branches rustling in the moonlight.  Nightengales sing in the fresh air, insects buzz, and a stray hill troll glances upwards, scowling away from the light.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Office]
description: Bookshelves stacked with ledgers, books and other records line the walls of this modest office.  A quill pen lies on a small table in the corner next to a jar of ink, ready to make last minute corrections and notes before the papers are stored.  Under the table squats a heavy safe, locked tightly against unwanted intrusion.  A small bookstand is tucked into one corner of the room.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Common Room]
description: The circular hearth in the center of the room burns merrily, shedding warmth and cheerful light.  Benches, chairs and other places to ease tired feet line the walls, promising comfort and rest to weary travellers.  A small archway opens to the west, giving a glimpse of a cozy tavern, while a green brocade curtain leads back into the front hall.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Tavern]
description: A long bar made of polished golden oak dominates one wall.  Partially shuttered lanterns provide a comfortingly dim light, and both tables and padded stools along the bar itself give nice places to rest and enjoy a drink.  Pretty waitresses in flirtatious attire weave in and out of the tables, smiling despite their obviously ghostly state.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Gaming Room]
description: Card tables, dice bowls, and other implements for games of skill and chance sit about the room for public use.  Lanterns hang from the ceiling, giving off plenty of light to play games by.  Brightly colored rugs cover the floor with a gentle cacophony of shades.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Dining Room]
description: Tables and chairs of deeply polished wood lend a simple elegance to this comfortable room.  Waiters and waitresses float between the tables, attending to the guests sitting at them, bringing food and drink to those who order it.  Thick glass windows provide a view of the outside, keeping out even the worst winds and inclement weather.  Happy chatter and savory, homelike smells fill the room with a sense of contentment.

title: [Abandoned Inn, North Hall]
description: The hall ends here with a single swinging door to the east.  Mouthwatering smells waft out each time a member of the wait staff swings the portal open, coaxing a reflexive growl from your stomach.  A loud, energetic bellowing voice echoes through the corridor, issuing instructions for food preparation and presentation that rival the orders of any military commander.  To the west opens a graceful archway, framed in engraved wood.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Kitchen]
description: The kitchen is a whirlwind of ordered chaos.  Assistants, corporeal and non, bustle about tending pots and preparing ingredients in a masterfully orchestrated dance.  Their choreographer is a massive zombie wearing an oversized chef's hat, who shouts orders in a voice loud enough to rattle the glass in the windows.  A trapdoor dominates one corner of the room, presumably leading down to the cellar space.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Cellar]
description: A small window set high in the wall provides dim light to this slightly musty cellar.  A few boxes and pieces of unused kitchen equipment lean in the corner nearest the trapdoor, likely placed for easiest access by the kitchen staff.  A few wispy cobwebs decorate the ceiling, looking recently spun by spiders made homeless in a good sweeping.  A door opens in the south wall, giving a glimpse of racks beyond it.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Wine Cellar]
description: A thin layer of dust covers most of the bottles sitting on the racks.  Fine vintages of wine rest in their cradles, representing many of the best wineries in the region.  Spare glasses hang upside-down from holders in the ceiling.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Larder]
description: Shelves full of preserves, jars of ingredients, and other foodstuffs line the walls, neatly placed with their labels facing out.  Boxes marked with the names of durable vegetables and fruits sit before them, and rounds of wax-covered cheese hang from the ceiling.  A small jar of honey has been opened and dribbles of the golden liquid cling to the container, as if a member of the kitchen staff had been snitching a sweet treat while fetching another item.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Junk Room]
description: Rusty-bladed scythes, buckets with holes, bushel baskets, and all manner of things that have seen better days are tossed here with no rhyme or reason.  This seems to be the holding pen for items that no one wants...but no one wants to throw away, either.  A truly hideous painting of an old woman stares out from the back of the room, as if disapproving of the entire mess.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Workshop]
description: A wide assortment of hardware, lumber, pipes and window glass sit arranged about the room.  Brushes for paint, buckets of odds and ends, and other tools sit among them, giving the place the look of every other workshop kept by a handyman.  A single industrious spider makes a web high in a corner, as if looking for refuge from the clutter.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Laundry Room]
description: Large barrels, basins and wringers line the walls.  The smells of lye, bleach, dyes and assorted soaps are strong in the air, mixed with the smell of newly-washed linen.  Coils of clothesline are stacked next to a huge pile of dirty tablecloths heaped in one of the corners.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Magical Workshop]
[Abandoned Inn, Ruined Workshop]
description: Mortars and pestles, unlit braziers, jars and bowls and other tools of the wizard's art are strewn chaotically about the perimeter of this room, as if by an explosion.  Walls, floor and ceiling are spattered with random patterns of powders, liquids and blobs, most of which are probably better left unidentified.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Gift Shop]
description: Crystal-decorated sconces hang from the walls of this little room.  Cases filled with knick-knacks and souvenirs crowd each other for space, each trinket hung with a neat little price tag.  Several shopkeepers hustle about, attending the merchandise, watched over by the eagle-eyed wife of the innkeeper.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Attic Storage]
description: Old furniture, trunks, crates and the like are spread chaotically around the room.  Some have been hastily covered with sheets, others were simply jammed into any available space.  Old clothes and piles of shabby china add to the rubble.  The only thing left clear of chaos is a large full-length mirror which leans against a wall, almost hidden in a shadow.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Sitting Room]
description: Comfortable couches, divans, and chairs sit in a comfortable pattern about the room, just the right space apart for casual conversation.  Filmy curtains billow around an open window, and the soft sound of windchimes fills the air.  A large loom sits in one corner, holding a half-finished tapestry.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Master's Bedroom]
description: A lady of perhaps overly grand tastes had an obvious hand in decorating this bed chamber.  A riot of slightly tacky paintings and knick-knacks decorates mismatched but fine furnishings, and an ostentatious royal purple quilt covers the bed.  Sitting huddled in a back corner is a small, scratched nightstand with a man's personal effects placed on it.  Likely, it is the poor gent's last refuge in this far too feminine room.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Mirror Room]
description: You are in a small room, doorless and windowless.  The walls are all shrouded in thick black drapes that seem to suck in all the heat and light near them.  In the center of the room stands a small pedestal, with a large crystal sphere upon it.  A full length mirror rests against one wall.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Under Inn]
description: Old timbers shore up the walls and ceiling of the tunnel.  A small pile of excess dirt and rocks has been shoved into a corner at the end of the corridor, next to a hole leading out.  Rusting in the corner is an ancient pickaxe head, long ago bereft of its handle.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Guard Post]
description: Thick wooden timbers shore the walls and ceiling up, unbothered by time.  A sturdy wooden table sits in the center of the room, its positioning providing a good view down all of the wide tunnels surrounding it.  The remains of a deck of cards are scattered over the floor, and old weaponry leans against the walls.  Nearly unseen under the table is a small notebook.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Office]
description: A scuffed and dented desk sits in the corner, its contents strewn about the room.  Only a few ledgers remain on the desk itself, the ink inside them worn and nearly illegible.  One drawer remains securely closed, locked against intrusion with the key long since gone.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Mess Hall]
description: Pots, pans, and other metal dishes scatter across the floor, all covered with a fine layer of dust.  Soup bones and other cooking ingredients rot in the dirt, adding a less than pleasant fragrance to the air.  How one of the plates got halfway imbedded into the ceiling is anyone's guess.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Storage Room]
description: A metal and wood cage, still sturdy and speaking of good workmanship, is affixed to one of the walls.  Large enough to hold a sizeable creature, it is certainly large and strong enough to contain a man.  A chair leans in the opposite corner, keeping an empty watch on the no longer present captive.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Storage]
description: A multitude of small nuggets of ore have rolled in from the room to the west, laying in wait like little caltrops.  Large crates are stacked two and three high against the east wall, marked with a variety of contents.  Four lanterns hang from the ceiling, strangely still burning despite an obvious lack of oil.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Storage]
description: The broken remnants of several iron bound chests stand shakily against the east wall.  Whatever they once held has long gone the way of the swallow, but the trunks still remain, wood mostly rotted from them and the iron gone totally to rust.  A small rat scurries through them, looking for something shiny to take back to his nest.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Storage]
description: Several tall bolts of cloth lean in the corners, carefully tied about the middle.  The crimsons and azures have long since faded into ruin, and the dust makes them unrecoverable, but they do serve to speak of the prosperity of this smuggling operation.  A stack of hides stands next to them, looking ugly beside the elegant material.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Storage]
description: Wooden planks marked with various symbols and halves of words pile into the eastern corners of the room as if swept there.  Tattered bits of textiles, piles of grain, and other odd smuggled bits mix in with the kindling, and a small pile of an unidentifiable ore has tumbled piece by piece into the next room.  A few odd scorch marks line the dirt in the walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Rest Area]
description: The remains of a row of cots have all been blasted back against the walls to the east.  Several are completely splintered, the cotton inside the mattresses dusting the floor like dirty snow.  The rest are mangled and tangled wrecks of wood and twine, unsalvageable for anything but firewood.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Guard Post]
description: A small wooden table, missing a leg, wobbles in the center of the floor.  A dice bowl still sits on top of it, the pips on the cubes inside it nearly worn off from time and use.  Beneath it is a small notebook, covered in dirt and rat footprints.  Two lanterns burn overhead, bright and constant despite having no fuel.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Storage]
description: Rudimentary animal pens, small and cramped in this limited space, divide the room off.  The northern edge of them has been scorched and damaged, but the rest still stand, devoid of occupants.  Torches still burn in their holders on the walls, filling the room with a ruddy glow.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Guard Post]
description: Guarding this room is a single chair, backless after time and neglect have taken their toll.  The only living sentry seems to be a paranoid looking rat, staring out from beneath the seat.  His fur is matted and dirty, and he seems completely insane, even for a rodent.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: A single die sits in the middle of the tunnel.  The single pip on the "one" side stares up into the darkness, a sightless eye unblinking for all time.  Light shines in from the northwest, providing at least some illumination in the dank underground.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: The planks of wood are beginning to warp away from the ceiling, bending into the room and lowering the roof enough to make giantmen duck.  Several have already fallen down, tumbled in splintering ruins on the floor.  A shattered lantern sits beneath them, bent and mangled by the impact.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Nearly hidden in the shadows of the dirt walls is a large sack of cotton.  The markings on the sack are illegible now, but the burlap of the sack itself looks like it came from a well-known merchant in Wehnimer's Landing.  Whether he was having his own goods smuggled, or they were being stolen, is something only the sack itself knows.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Although the air is still, you would swear you heard the whisper of wind.  A single coin of unrecognizable origin sits forgotten in the dirt next to one wall, the owner long since gone from this place.  Even the token-loving rats have left it be, for not even tiny footprints walk around it.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: A single lantern hangs from the ceiling beams.  Its flame burns brightly and constantly, unwavering in the still air.  While its presence is something of a mystery, the light it brings is welcome, showing the dirt on the floor to be unmarred by footprints.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: The darkness in this room is nearly complete, with only the faintest glow of light for comfort.  The blackness seems almost alive, whispering with voices that have no source and caressing with fingers that have no substance.  Only that fitful radiance keeps it all at bay, keeping the living safe in a place ruled by the dead.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: The air is completely motionless, stagnant after centuries of pooling.  Dirt completely blocks the tunnel to the south, leaving this as the end of this smuggling line.  Only weak light filters in from the northeast, casting the area in shadow.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: A large pile of bones caps off the tunnel.  They are stacked against the wall of rubble blocking further travel to the south, stacked as high as a human's shoulders.  No rodents or other life scurry through them, and the bones are surprisingly intact.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Dimly burning lanterns hang from the ceiling, spaced at regular intervals to shed a bit of light.  They are dented and abused, looking mostly like castoffs and irregular bits from a lantern maker's mistake pile.  Large footprints track through the dirt of the floor.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: A maze of tunnels branches off from this small pocket in the dirt.  There is barely room for a giantman to squeeze through, let alone someone laden with merchandise.  No lanterns or torches have been placed here, leaving the only light to filter in from the surrounding areas.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Bits of shattered stone litter the floor.  A disturbingly large hole gapes in the ceiling, and a dent has been forced into the ground just beneath it.  Judging by the size of the holes and the quantity of rock fragments, it would have taken great strength to break the boulder into manageable bits.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: A store of extra boards for strengthening the walls and ceilings leans against the west wall of the pocket in the tunnels.  Dirt, dust and spiderwebs cover them, and it seems that a family of marmots has built their nest in the dark spot behind them.  A variety of odd bits stick out from the rodent den, including several dead flowers and an old pair of shoelaces.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Cobwebs stream from the ancient shorings like party streamers, perfectly still in the stagnant air.  Spiders large and small crawl over them, building them up and repairing them where passers-by have damaged the threads.  One spider has a large silken bundle on one corner of his web, likely an insectile victim for his evening meal.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Dirt sifts down onto your head, leaving doubts as to the stability of this corridor.  Large chunks of wall have fallen away, but the tunnel remains clear for the passage of people or goods.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: The maze created by the tunnels would be the envy of any minotaur.  Branches wind off to nearly all compass directions, spinning through the dirt like the work of a drunken roa'ter.  A single lantern dangles from the wooden planks above, shedding a sickly light over the area.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: The tunnel to the southeast is illuminated by a pair of brightly burning lanterns.  The wooden shorings supporting the walls and ceiling look a bit worse for the wear of time but are, in general, whole.  Half a barrel leans against the wall, perhaps for watering beasts or cleaning up in.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Fingers of lamp light reach in from the tunnel to the northwest, a welcome sight in the dimness of the lower tunnels.  The remains of a lamp dangle down, a wreckage of metal and shards of glass.  The rest of the glass, however, has long since been ground into the floor, giving the dirt a sparkling quality.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: The bony hand of some poor unfortunate sticks out of the wall.  His arm bones have been shattered in the forearm, leaving little more than the appendage to remind the world of his existence.  An unknown culprit with a sense of humor has put a guttering torch in the hand, seeing a convenient place to hang an inexpensive light.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southwest, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: The tunnel has long since fallen into disrepair and neglect.  The wooden shoring is rotting and cracked, only adding to the danger it is supposed to eliminate, and the nearly total lack of light makes movement difficult.  Only a single fitful candle stuck onto a fallen beam provides anything to see by.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southwest, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: A sword, long since rusted into worthlessness, lies mostly covered in dirt on the floor.  Dings, nicks, and other signs of hard use riddle the edge, and the pommel's wood has gone to dust.  Gash marks in the dirt of the walls suggest a battle long in the past, although who the combatants were has since been forgotten.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Wooden beams, tumbled from the ceiling, litter the floor in one large heap.  A nest of termites has moved in, turning the pile into a writhing mass of slimy insectile bodies.  Powdered wood sprinkles the floor in clumps, further fodder for the disgusting little creatures.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Most of the ceiling has fallen in to the south, closing the tunnel almost completely.  Signs of recent excavation and repair are evident, but the work seems to be progressing slowly.  An orc claw hanging out of the wall may explain the delay.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Shovels, picks and wooden beams lean against the walls, as do a variety of weapons.  Long grooves in the wall, even and deep, speak of an attempt to reopen the tunnels for business, but the work is far from complete.  A single iron shackle has rolled into one pocket in the dirt walls, as if hiding from any who would find it.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Two lanterns flank the tunnel to the southeast, providing a bright light by which to see.  A keg of slightly fusty water sits in one corner, and a deep ladle hangs off the side of the barrel for ease of drinking.  Some thoughtful soul has left a tattered woolen blanket next to the water, in case someone needed a quick nap while on their smuggling run.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Footprints and faint tracks from tiny man-drawn carts are prevalent through the western and southern tunnels here, avoiding the impossibly narrow tunnel to the north.  A few grains of wheat remain on the floor from where a sack split open, although the marmot paw prints around them suggest the rest of the grain has been eaten.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Dark and narrow, this section of tunnel is any claustrophobic's nightmare.  The dirt raining down from the ceiling certainly does not help matters, only serving to exacerbate the feeling of being closed in.  Ambient light filters in from other areas, providing only scant illumination.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Golden light shines in from the northwest, driving back the darkness encroaching from the southern reaches of the tunnel.  The illumination displays a variety of footprints in the dirt, booted and barefoot alike.  Disturbingly, not all seem made by humans or other friendly races.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Workshop]
description: The dirt and stone walls have been ashed and blackened by a powerful force of energy.  What was once a mage's workshop is now little more than warped wrecks of metalwork and splintered bits of wood, laden with the scent of ozone and electricity.  Nothing escaped whatever disaster occurred here, but the feeling of magic remains, putting the hairs on your arms and the back of your neck at attention.

title: [Land Tower West, Dining Room]
[Land Tower West, Infirmary]
description: This large open room serves as a combination dining and recreation room for the guards stationed in the two land towers.  Although the room is empty, the long wooden tables are set for the next meal.  In the corner, a wooden ladder leads to the upper levels of the tower.

Formerly a dining room for the tower guards, this large open room has been converted to a makeshift infirmary.  Most of the wooden tables have been shoved against the walls, though a few have been draped with linens to serve as treatment platforms.  A battered metal cabinet, sparsely stocked with healing herbs, hangs near the entrance.  Having borne the brunt of bleeding bodies and rotting corpses, the wood floors are clean, but heavily stained.  A sturdy ladder leads to the upper levels of the tower.

title: [Land Tower West, Ladder Room]
description: A long wooden ladder connects this floor to the floors above and below.  A couple of crates and some old uniforms hanging on wall hooks are the only items in the room.

title: [Land Tower West, Roof]
description: A small overhang on the south side of the tower provides the on-duty guards with some shelter from the elements.  From there, you can see the roofs of the town buildings to the south and southeast.  Directly south, you can see a large open square among the buildings.  Your view east is blocked by another guard tower.  To the north, you can see the road that leads to the main gate of Wehnimer's and beyond it, to the shoreline.

A small overhang on the south side of the tower provides the on-duty guards with some shelter from the elements.  From there, you can see the roofs of the town buildings to the south and southeast.  Directly south, you can see a large open square among the buildings.  Your view east is blocked by another guard tower.  To the north, you can see the road that leads to the main gate of Wehnimer's and beyond it, to the shoreline.  A large amber-tinted orb is set into a curved steel-bound glass shell.

title: [Land Tower East, Dormitory]
description: This room contains several wood cots with rough woolen blankets.  You can hear noise from the area outside the gate through slit-like windows on the northern wall of the room.

title: [Land Tower East, Roof]
description: A small lean-to on the south side of the tower provides the on-duty guards with some shelter.  You can see the roofs of town buildings to the south and southeast.  To the east you can see two more guard towers, apparently sitting on either side of the river.  To the northwest, you can see the road that leads to the main gate of Wehnimer's and, beyond it, to the shoreline.

title: [The New Look, Haircuts]
description: An old chair with a wobbly leg takes up most of the space under this crooked awning.  A string has been tied from the side of the tent to a post stuck in the ground, and dangling from it are dull-looking shears and carving knives.  Drifts of shorn hair cover the ground, forming hummocks and valleys of blond and brunette.

title: [The New Look, Hairdressing]
description: Here in the back corner of the pavilion a makeshift station has been set up to wash, dirty, curl, straighten, braid, loosen, and otherwise fuss with all kinds of hair.  Jumbled together in a crate are bottles of olive oil, combs, ribbons and pins.  Wood-handled irons are propped over a small fire pit, and the smoke has started to fill the enclosed space.

title: [The New Look, Hair Adornment]
description: In this shaded walkway between the three tents is a round iron table supporting a jar of brushes and a few pots of dye.  A cedar box full of bone hairpins and narrow strips of leather has been left right on the ground, in danger of being kicked over by a clumsy foot.

title: [The New Look, Skin Care]
description: Wooden screens divide this large tent into smaller spaces, but they don't block the howls of agony coming from every corner.  A raised pallet partially obscured by a thin gauze curtain rests conveniently near a set of freestanding shelves.  Stored haphazardly therein are cyclamen roots, a bowl of birch sap, some sheep dung, a bottle of lemon juice, and a tub of quicklime.

title: [The New Look, Nasal Sculpting]
description: This small corner has been festively decorated with sketches of noses, illustrating a wide variety of shapes and sizes.  The cheeriness is broken, however, by the display of instruments used to achieve these many effects.  A chest full of neatly-rolled bandages and a basket of brown eggs sit at the ready.

title: [The New Look, Eye Enhancements]
description: Lancets, needles, razors, and scalpels have been laid out in tidy arrays atop a narrow chest of drawers.  A solid oak chair fitted with many leather straps is pushed up against the flimsy wooden screen.  The sole nod to cleanliness appears to be a bowl of wine used to soak the instruments between uses.

title: [The New Look, Eye Colors]
description: The rivulets of blood trickling down the legs of a crude operating table give some indication of the unpleasantness of this procedure.  Thick glass jars are stacked three deep, each one packed full of preserved eyes with their optic nerves still attached.  A very sharp-looking scalpel has been left at the foot of the table, ready for further use.

title: [The New Look, Short and Tall]
description: Here inside the tent, the light wicker frame that provides support is just visible between the wool blankets used to help muffle sound.  A massive apparatus bearing a strong resemblance to a stretching rack is dwarfed only by a device whose purpose seems to involve a great deal of crushing and compacting.  Stuck into the ground is a tall pole marked off at intervals with red paint.

title: [The New Look, Facial Repair]
description: A series of shaped wooden frames with adjustable metal screws have been fixed at head height in front of a row of straight-backed chairs.  They all face the near wall of the tent, where inspirational phrases have been painted in bright, cheery colors.  A few of the protruding screws still show traces of former users.

title: [The New Look, Distinctive Marks]
description: The strange emptiness of this portion of the tent gives it an even more ominous feel.  The only object is an upright wooden box just large enough to contain one person.  Its narrow door latches solidly on the outside.

title: [Wehnimer's, Festival Grounds]
description: Brightened by daylight, a broad swathe of cultivated meadow grass is crisscrossed with small footpaths and dotted with the occasional tree.  Tall hedges enclose the festival grounds, the only visible openings a red-bricked pathway and an ironbound gate.  A moss-covered, riverstone fountain burbles in one corner, surrounded by a bright splash of roses.  A copper-banded, riverstone marker rests beside the red-bricked path.

Bathed in moonlight and shadows, a broad swathe of cultivated meadow grass is crisscrossed with small footpaths and dotted with the occasional tree.  Tall hedges enclose the festival grounds, the only visible openings a red-bricked pathway and an ironbound gate.  A moss-covered, riverstone fountain burbles in one corner, surrounded by a bright splash of roses.  A copper-banded, riverstone marker rests beside the red-bricked path.

Bathed in moonlight and shadows, a broad swathe of cultivated meadow grass is crisscrossed with small footpaths and dotted with the occasional tree.  Tall hedges enclose the festival grounds, the only visible openings a red-bricked pathway, a marble walkway, and an ironbound gate.  A moss-covered, riverstone fountain burbles in one corner, surrounded by a bright splash of roses.  A copper-banded, riverstone marker rests beside the red-bricked path.

Brightened by daylight, a broad swathe of cultivated meadow grass is crisscrossed with small footpaths and dotted with the occasional tree.  Tall hedges enclose the festival grounds, the only visible openings a red-bricked pathway, a marble walkway, and an ironbound gate.  A moss-covered, riverstone fountain burbles in one corner, surrounded by a bright splash of roses.  A copper-banded, riverstone marker rests beside the red-bricked path.

title: [Militia Barracks, Entrance]
description: This is the entry hall to the large militia barracks.  Housed within is the Town Guard.  The hall itself is narrow and dark.

title: [Militia Barracks, Dormitory]
description: This plain barracks room, devoid of any ornamentation save for the narrow cots the militiamen sleep on, seems to be standard fare throughout the local military.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Militia Barracks, Guardpost]
description: This small, often cramped bare room is the barracks guardpost.  A guard is on duty here most of the time.

title: [Militia Barracks, Officers' Den]
description: Only slightly less spartan than the larger enlisted men's barracks room, this officers' barracks contains several narrow cots and a mirror.

title: [Militia Barracks, Armory]
description: A weapon rack hangs neatly along the wall here, the barracks armory.

title: [Militia Barracks, Mess Hall]
description: Much the same as the militia sleeping quarters, the mess hall contains row upon row of polished modwir tables and benches.  Twice a day militiamen converge here for their meals.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entryway]
description: You are standing face-to-face with the southern wall of the Warrior Guild.  More fortress than building, its stone walls are interspersed with towering spires, the highest and most impressive being the two on the wall facing you.  Each of the spires is inset with thick-glazed, narrow windows that purchase them a view at every angle.  The entrance to the Guild itself is guarded by a massive portcullis of stout iron bars faced overall with mein reinforcing.

title: [Forest Path]
description: The forest canopy is particularly thick here, making the forest floor dark and damp below.  Spongy green moss coats the northern sides of the tree trunks, and a number of ferns and other plants still grow here, despite the dense shade.  What little you can make of the trail extends east and west from here.

title: [Forest Path, Clearing]
description: A large tree has fallen very near the path here, opening the forest canopy to the sky above.  Light from the sky above provides a welcome relief from the dense shade of the old forest.  A multitude of saplings cover the ground here, desperately struggling for the right to become the fallen tree's successor.  What remains of the old road reenters the forest on the east and west sides of the small clearing.

title: [Forest Path]
description: The forest undergrowth has all but obscured the path here, making it difficult for you to determine its exact course.  Tree limbs and saplings brush against your legs and shoulders as you work your way through.  To the east, a slight brightening of the forest's darkness suggests the path leads in that direction.  You strain your ears to catch the faint, distant sound of flowing water, which seems to come from the south.

title: [Gorge, Intersection]
description: A large stream, or perhaps a small river, has carved a deep, narrow gorge into the native sedimentary stone here.  The walls of the gorge are almost vertical and provide no purchase.  In places, the limestone walls turn to glassy marbleized outcrops, as though some intense heat or force had crystallized or fused the rock together.  Such patches make it impossible to climb your way out.
