title: [Forest Path]
description: The trail narrows here as the forest undergrowth asserts itself over the feeble efforts of mankind.   Dark shadows from the massive, ancient trees distort your vision as you peer ahead along the fading path.   Little or no traffic seems to pass this way, or at least not recently.  What remains of the long forgotten road leads to the east and west.

title: [Forest Path]
description: The footing is uneven at the base of this hill.  Rocks and rubble litter the ground.  There was apparently a landslide here some time past.  A narrow path winds down from the top of the hill, then continues off to the west.  Saplings and undergrowth prevent you from moving off of the path, and what little light filters down through the thick foliage lies in splotchy pools on the ground.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Wooded Hills]
description: The forest thins nearer the top of the hill, and you find yourself bracing against the constant, nagging chill.  Old trees, gnarled by years of assault, shudder against the cold winds, cowering yet strong against the constant harassment of the elements.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Rocky Trail]
description: Crisp, cold air fills your lungs as you survey the stark landscape above the treeline.  The trail here is rugged but passable, and though the hillside is nearly barren, the view of Darkstone Bay in the distance is spectacular enough to take your mind off the dingy grey rocks underfoot.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Summit]
description: In stunning contrast to the somewhat dull scenery below, the summit is a vivid study in color and light.  Large rectangular talismans carved from pale grey granite ring the edges of the summit, like sentries guarding the precious grounds of this jewel among the heavens.  Sunlight pierces through the clouds overhead, warming your aching bones, and carrying with it a faint promise of brighter days ahead.  Set in the exact center of the circle, a tall octagonal building with an arch of pure granite beckons.

Large rectangular talismans carved from pale grey granite ring the edges of the summit, like sentries guarding the precious grounds of this jewel among the heavens.  Moonlight pierces through the clouds overhead, carrying with it a faint promise of light found even in the darkness.  Set in the exact center of the circle, a tall octagonal building with an arch of pure granite beckons.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Slime Pit]
description: You balance on a narrow ledge above a pit of dark, slimy water.  The rock around the pit is clean and smooth to the touch.  A shiny white bone protrudes out of the water, its lower half, and whatever may be attached to it, completely hidden beneath the black sludgy water.

title: [Gorge, North Rim]
description: The gorge narrows here a bit, its sheer walls rising almost vertically from the stream's edges.  Tiny ledges provide many footholds, but the damp walls and tremendous height make you wonder if climbing is safe.  The path disappears into a blackened, glasslike cliff face that completely blocks the gorge to the southwest.  Looking around, you find no easy way to pass in that direction, save for some serious climbing.

title: [Gorge, North Rim]
description: A section of the path edge has recently collapsed here.  Peering over the edge you spot a pile of rubble and the glint of steel, perhaps the remains of a previous adventurer who met an untimely death.  The forest to the north remains impassable, but the path, despite its fragility, seems safe enough to the northeast and southwest.

title: [Gorge, North Rim]
description: The gorge makes a slight turn to the southwest here, its steep walls curving in a graceful arc to follow the course of the stream far below.  To the east, a narrow spot in the gorge appears to be spanned by some sort of crude bridge.  The path also extends to the southwest, along the edge.

title: [Gorge, North Rim]
description: A narrow spot in the gorge here is conveniently spanned by a huge log, although it is unclear whether this was an accident or was done by some intelligent creature.  A thick forest encroaches on the path from the north.  To the west, a path follows the course of the stream.

title: [Gorge, South Rim]
description: The deep gorge narrows here, and a huge log convieniently spans the gap between the sheer walls.  This end of the log is rotted and jagged, making you wonder if it was cut or fell here.  In either case, it provides access to the other side.  A wide path also extends along the gorge here, to the west.

title: [Gorge, South Rim]
description: This bank of the gorge is slightly lower than the opposite, and you can clearly see the sheer walls rising from the swirling water below.  The path extends towards a narrow spot in the gorge to the east.  It also continues to the southwest.

title: [Gorge, South Rim]
description: A recent collapse on the other side of the gorge from here brings your attention to the severe undercutting of the edge.  Spotting the dented breastplate hanging from a jutting rock far below makes you shy away from the edge, in dismay.  The path you travel continues both southwest and northeast, along the edge of the gorge.

title: [Gorge, South Rim]
description: This section of bank appears to have been quarried at some point, as the walls have been carved out in a pattern of geometric blocks.  Who cut the huge blocks away, or what they were used for, remains a mystery.  The path skirts the huge hole to the southwest and northeast.

title: [Gorge, South Rim]
description: The charred and broken bits of stone and timber here indicate that the gorge was once spanned here by a large bridge.  Travelling to the other side is now quite impossible, due to the menacing cliffs and swirling waters below them, but there is a remnant of a wide road to the south.

title: [Darkstone, Derelict Road]
description: Broken cobblestones and scattered gravel show that this once was a fine paved road, but lately has fallen into disrepair.  At its height, this road could have carried heavy traffic of carts and horses, but now it is little better than the forest path on the north side of the gorge.  The road runs precisely north-south here.

title: [Darkstone, Derelict Road]
description: The ancient road here is cleft by a large tree that has sprung up defiantly in the exact midpoint.  Weeds and grass poke out here and there between the stones of the road surface.  The southern route leads towards the looming visage of a tall, craggy cliff, while to the north, the way continues.

title: [Darkstone, Derelict Road]
description: A sheer rock face of several hundred feet rises to the south of here, blocking further travel in that direction.  The old road turns to the east, following the line of the cliff.

title: [Forest Clearing]
description: A peculiar clearing has formed in the forest here.  A large depression in the ground is totally devoid of trees or shrubs.  In the center of the depression is a dark hole, leading down into the earth.  The trees are far too thick to penetrate into the forest in any direction from here.  A narrow path, however, leads away from the clearing into the woods.

title: [Cavern]
description: This is a small cavern of some kind, possibly carved in the rock by an underground stream.  Thick tree roots have penetrated the cavern and hang down like moist fingers from the ceiling.  Above you is a circular hole, which you could likely climb out of.  A steep, dark passageway leads down deeper into the cavern.

title: [Cavern]
description: This is some sort of cavern, hollowed out by the past action of the stream.  The walls are smooth and wet, and mineral-laden water drips from the ceiling, forming a number of sharp stalagmites on the floor.  High above here a circle of light shows clearly through the darkness.  In the murk you can see a steeply sloping passageway leading up towards it.  From the north comes the hollow echo of trickling water.

title: [Cavern]
description: This narrow passage is cold and shadowy.  The walls narrow and a chill breeze blows through, raising the hairs on the back of your neck.  The floor is slimy under your feet, and you hear a steady dripping sound.

title: [Cavern]
description: This passageway slopes downward slightly as it curves gently to the southeast.  A small stream flows across the cavern here, out one wall and on down a hole in the floor, near the other.  Although the stream is quite small, ominous stains on the wall left by the water in past floods reach almost to the top of the arched ceiling.

title: [Cavern]
description: The floor drops off practically from beneath your feet, plunging into a dark chasm.  The wall opposite the ledge on your side is a sheer, unbroken expanse of stone, plunging straight down into the fissure.  Water drips from stalactites in slow, steady drops, and a plopping sound echoes from the chasm.

title: [Behind the Waterfall]
description: You stand in a small alcove in the rock behind the trickling waterfall.  Although the sheet of water is only a few feet away, this area is mostly dry, protected by the thick rocks above, yet the sound of the water fills this chamber with a hollow echo.  A narrow ledge leads out around the waterfall, and a dark passage also leads further into the rocks to the south.

title: [Gorge, Waterfall]
description: A small waterfall trickles down the headwall of the gorge here, splashing down upon the rocks in an unceasing rain.  You find yourself looking about at the smooth face of the gorge and wonder whatever happened to this obviously one-time magnificent spectacle.

title: [Gorge, Stairway Bottom]
description: A wide ledge extends along the wall of the canyon here, a few feet above the water's surface, meeting the stairway carved in the rock above you which leads to the rim of the gorge.  The canyon curves noticeably to the south, preventing you from seeing what lies upstream.  The high, steep walls keep most of the gorge in shadow, and echo hollowly with the trickle of water flowing in the once mighty river.

title: [Gorge, Stairway Top]
description: You stand at the top of an ancient stairway, carved into the natural rock by a long forgotten hand in another age.  Although wet and moss-covered like the canyon walls, it is quite wide and seems safe enough to travel.  The stairs lead down to a ledge of rock which juts out from the side of the cliff just above the shallow waters of the once violently raging river.  A narrow path also leads around the rocks beside you, at the rim of the gorge.

title: [Gorge, North Rim]
description: The trail along the top of the cliff ends abruptly here, blocked by a large wall of broken rocks which jut up from the ground at unusual angles.  A small path leads around the rocks right at the rim of the chasm, but it seems dangerously narrow considering its proximity to the sheer drop into the gorge.

title: [Gorge, North Rim]
description: The gorge ends in a sheer cliff face here, but looking at it you notice that the phenomenon is clearly not natural.  The cliff wall is blackened and fused together such that it forms a near glasslike face.  The path that follows along the gorge leads directly up the cliff as though it once continued onward, and the floor of the gorge only contains a mere trickle of water where a raging river once flowed.

title: [Gorge, Rock Ledge]
description: You stand in awe on a large rock shelf which protrudes out over the canyon as if by magic.  Gazing northeast, you turn your attention to the sheer cliff that blocks further passage in that direction.  You can find no way to scale the wall from this side.

title: [Darkstone, Derelict Road]
description: The dilapidated road runs parallel to the cliff face here.  Although no trees have dared to take root in the road, a number of large stones have fallen from the face above, littering the road with rock and debris.  A large boulder has made a significant impact on the road, buckling and cracking its surface.  The road runs east and west along the base of the cliff.

title: [Darkstone, Derelict Road]
description: A small stream tumbles over the cliff face here.  Over the ages the stream has cut a bit of a hollow out of the sheer wall, allowing the roadbuilders a bit of purchase into the face.  Although the going is steep, the road continues through a series of switchbacks which climb to the top of the plateau above.

title: [Darkstone, Derelict Road]
description: This section of the old road is exceptionally decrepit, having been littered by a great many large rocks and boulders, which were dislodged from the cliff face and road above you.  The road continues to wind through a series of switchbacks to the northwest and southwest.

title: [Darkstone, Derelict Road]
description: Your legs strain as you climb the steep road here, which follows a crevice carved out from the cliff face by a small stream.  Switchbacks make a road a possiblility here, but the progress is agonizingly slow as you track back and forth.  The section below you goes down to the northeast, and the trail winds up the cliff to the southeast.

title: [Darkstone, Derelict Road]
description: The edge of the cliff looms just above you as you turn at this switchback.  The stream which flows along the road here falls from the cliff in a fine spray, coating the rocks nearby with a moist sheen.  The road leads up to the top of the cliff to the southwest, and down to the forest below, through a number of switchbacks, to the northwest.

title: [Darkstone, Plateau]
description: You are standing on the edge of a high plateau which stretches far to the south from here.  To the north, a sheer cliff of several hundred feet drops to the floor of a vast forest below.  From your vantage point high above the forest canopy, the forest seems to stretch in a great unbroken sea which crashes into the cliff below.

title: [Darkstone, Plateau]
description: Tree stumps surround you in all directions, indicating that this area was once forested like the area below and to the north, but someone has gone to great lengths to cut all the trees down.  The plateau is now barren and desolate, and a cold wind tugs at your clothing.

title: [Darkstone, Plateau]
description: Not a tree remains here of what once must have been a mighty forest.  Stumps and bare dirt extend to the edge of the plateau.  The remains of the road continue to the south from here, towards a structure of some kind, and wind towards the plateau edge to the northeast.

title: [Darkstone, Plateau]
description: Although the trees here have been leveled, their wood remains in the form of gruesome engines of war.  Most have been ravaged by enemies and time to the point of collapse, but one old siege tower still stands defiantly above the battlefield.  An uneasy awareness of death and decay fills you as you scan these twisted monuments to the long forgotten dead of the battle.  To the east of here lies the battered and abandoned remains of a once magnificent castle.

title: [Darkstone, Siege Tower]
description: Although time has taken its toll on this veteran machine, it remains extremely solid and secure.  It was once mobile, but its wheels have long since sunk into the mud and dirt below, making it a permanent feature here.

title: [Castle Darkstone]
description: You are standing before the main gate of a decrepit ruin of stone, which appears to have once been a great fortress.  A moat filled with brackish water and foul smells surrounds the ruin, providing safeguard against intruders.

title: [Castle Darkstone]
description: You peer up at the intimidating stone towers which flank the entrance to the castle, silently guarding the passage in.  Inexplicably, a mound of hay has been piled up close to the wall here, in odd contrast to the gleaming white mein portcullis which towers overhead.

title: [Castle Darkstone]
description: This narrow passage between the gatetowers is flanked at either end by two great portcullises crafted from solid mein.  Slits in the walls and holes in the ceiling provide defenders of the castle means to eliminate enemy forces trapped between the great gates.  Deep red stains on the floors and walls attest to their efficiency.

wayto.7000:

fput 'kiss red portcullis'

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: This wide space lies between the inner and outer curtain walls and extends all the way around the castle.  You stand just inside the portcullis which leads out of the castle through the gatehouse.  Before you stands the massive inner curtain wall whose crumbling towers rise high above you.  To the south of here is the inner curtain gatehouse.

wayto.6998:
;e fput 'kneel'
fput 'kiss red portcullis'
fput 'stand' unless standing?

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: You are standing in the shadow of the massive northwest tower of the castle, which, unlike the others, is remarkably free of damage.  The two walls of the castle flank you to either side, while to the north lies the smaller outer curtain tower.  South of here is the crumbling gatehouse.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: The northwest guardtower stands firmly above the outer curtain here, but its squat form is overpowered by the huge corner tower of the inner keep which stands behind it.  The guardtower provides access to the parapets which top the outer wall, but you can see no way into the inner keep from here.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: A deep trough here seems to be the remains of an attempt to tunnel into the castle from the outside which has long since collapsed into itself.  A section of the outer wall seems to have been destroyed in the collapse, but the northwest tower of the inner keep seems quite undamaged.  To the west of here lies the northwest guardtower.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: A stunted tree struggles to survive inside the keep here, perhaps started from a seed borne by a bird from the forests near here.  Had the castle's owners discovered it, it would surely have been removed.  The outer keep continues between the walls to the east and west.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: The collapsing remains of a ballista rests here, a rusty spear still loaded in it, poised to fire at a long-gone enemy.  A broken ammunition rack stands nearby.  The outer keep continues east and west from here, between the two walls of the castle.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: This space lies in between the inner and outer curtain walls of the castle.  The air here is damp and cold, and the wind blows constantly.  Ominous scratches in the inner curtain wall make you wonder if the castle really is abandoned.  To the east is the northeast guardtower, and to the outer ward continues to the west.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: This corner of the outer keep is below the northeast tower, which has ominous black streaks starting above each arrow-loop.  Several rocks from fallen parts of the walls are scattered about here, causing you to look up from time to time with concern.  The squat outer curtain guardtower stands before you.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: A large section of the inner curtain wall has collapsed here, virtually filling the outer ward with huge blocks and bits and pieces of stone.  Although the ward once continued to the south from here, it is quite impossible to travel that way today.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: A large oak desk sits prominently in the middle of this room; perhaps it was the office of the captain of the guards, or some similarly important post.  Tattered banners hang on the walls around the room, but they have long since faded and decayed beyond recognition.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: This round tower marks the intersection of the northern and eastern walls of the outer keep.  Although it was once patrolled by many strong guards, the tower is now home to only a few blades of grass which struggle to grow in the cracks between the stones.  The parapets run along the walls to the west and south here, and some steps lead down into the tower.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: A great cauldron hangs upside down on a hinged mount on the edge of the parapet, having dumped its contents long ago in a desperate attempt to thwart attackers.  The sooty marks around its base suggest that it was formerly heated over an open fire.  A guardtower lies to the east along the parapet, and the parapet itself continues to the west.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: A breach in the outer curtain wall has collapsed the parapet to the west of here, preventing you from crossing it.  This section looks rather unsturdy too, as great cracks have formed between the stones of the walkway.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: Rubble from the collapsed inner tower has completely blocked off the parapet from here.  The guardtower lies to the north.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: Simple furniture once adorned this room, but it has now been reduced to splinters and dust.  The round stone walls seem firm enough, though, considering their age and use.  Light filters down from above through cracks in the roof illuminating the swirling dust in fingers of gold.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: The northern and western walls meet here to form a squat round tower.  Archers stationed here would have a clear shot along the bases of both walls to deter invaders, but no one has stood at these posts for ages.  A stone parapet extends along the tops of the walls to the east and south from here, and some steps lead down into the guardtower.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: A large section of the wall has collapsed here, and the parapet along with it, perhaps due to enemy sabotage.  Although the wall is intact further to the west from here, further travel in that direction is quite impossible from here.  To the west lies the northwest guardtower.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: You are standing on a high stone walk which extends all along the top of the outer curtain wall.  The wall is far lower than the inner curtain and generally in good shape, aside from a few loose stones and broken mortar.  To the north from here is the guardtower, while the gatehouse lies to the south.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Gatehouse]
description: This is the top of the northern gatehouse, which protects the entrance to the outer keep.  Some machinery rests here that looks as if it may control the operation of the drawbridge and portcullis below, but you cannot find any way to manipulate it.  A thin plank connects this tower to the other of the pair, to the south.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Gatehouse]
description: You are standing atop the southernmost of the two towers which flank the entrance to the outer keep.  A large drum wound with chain rests here, apparently to control the motion of the inner portcullis, but you see no way to manipulate the mechanism.  A thin plank of wood connects this tower to its twin to the north.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: This part of the parapet has become home to a number of grasses which have come up in the cracks between the stones beneath you, evidence to the age and abandonment of the castle.  To the north of here is the gatehouse.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: A large rounded boulder lies squarely in the middle of the parapet here, apparently a direct hit from the siege engines outside.  The walkway has buckled and cracked around the boulder, but remains more or less solid, a testament to the builders of the castle.  To the south is the southwest guardtower.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: You pick your way carefully around the edge of the top of the tower here, as most of it has plummeted down into the building below, filling the room below with rubble.  Some stone steps lead down to ground level from here, and the parapet extends along the tops of the walls to the north and east from here.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: The walkway is covered with pieces of rock here, making passage difficult.  One particularly large block of stone has forced itself into the stone top of the parapet, and stands on one corner in a most peculiar pose.  To the west is a guardtower, while the parapet extends on to the east.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Parapet]
description: The entire southeast corner of the castle appears to have been demolished, leaving only a massive jumble of rock which has completely buried the parapet from here to the east.  The parapet is rather more intact to the west from here.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: Two huge D-shaped towers here form a massive gatehouse which guards the entrance to the inner keep.  The walls here are much heavier in their construction than the outer curtain, and much higher.  To the north is the much smaller gatehouse.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: The top of the southwest tower of the inner keep appears to have been shattered by some unknown force, and fragments ranging from tiny pebbles to massive blocks of stone are strewn about this area.  You pick your way carefully through the rubble, avoiding the sharper bits.  To the south lies the southwest guardtower.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: Rubble from the broken inner tower here makes you wonder what could have so damaged such a structure.  The tower is fully fifty feet shorter than the one to the north, and large cracks continue from the broken top almost to the ground.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: A large block of stone, perhaps part of the inner tower, has collapsed the roof inward here, filling the room with shards of wood and stone, as well as the block itself.  Sunlight coming in from the now-open roof has warmed the rocks to a pleasant temperature, which gives you a bit of comfort from the chill which pervades the castle.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: A cold shiver runs up your back as you step gingerly around some vaguely human remains.  Who, or even what, they belonged to is quite beyond you, but their presence is enough to fill you with dread.  The inner keep continues to the east, and the southwest guardtower lies to the west.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Outer Ward]
description: Rubble and blocks of stone from the shattered remains of the main southeast tower have all but filled the space between the walls to the east, making further passage in that direction quite impossible.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Gatehouse]
description: You are standing between the gate towers in front of a massive iron-bound door.  This door was obviously of first-rate construction as it has taken the passage of time far better than the rest of the castle.  Despite the flakes of rust on its hinges and fittings, the door remains solid.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Gatehouse]
description: A short passage here lies between the door and a finely-wrought portcullis of gleaming, coal-black mein.  Some intense heat seems to have been present here at one time, as the walls of the passage are sooty and charred, but the portcullis looks sturdy, and relatively new.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Inner Keep]
description: You are standing in the southwest corner of a large square yard, which forms the center of the castle.  The high inner curtain walls give the place a sense of being isolated from the rest of the world, making you feel both secure and claustrophobic at the same time.  The southwest tower, with its jagged and broken top, rises high above you from here, and a portcullis of pure mein guards the exit back to the outer keep.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Inner Keep]
description: This is the northwest corner of the central square of the castle.  The tower at this corner of the keep is virtually undamaged and even shows signs of recent renovation, unlike the others which are in various states of delapidation.  Against the northern curtain wall is a large building that also looks recently renovated.  Closer inspection indicates that the northern building is the castle's great hall.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: This room is in surprisingly good condition.  The walls are solid and unbroken and there are even some furnishings in good repair to be seen.  Perhaps a guardroom or entry hall, it now seems to do duty as both a bedchamber and library.  A rough but servicable bed sits in one corner and a massively solid blackened oak table sits in the center of the room with some ancient leather-bound books upon it.  A woven tapestry hangs on the far wall, heavy and black as primordial sin.

title: [Shrine of the Jackal]
description: Once elegant, but now ruined, stained glass windows show this was once a chapel.  A smooth slab of obsidian seems to suck up all the faint light that falls upon it, and gives back only darkness.  On the slab, in sharp contrast, sits a statue carved of glittering crystal that bends and twists the few glimmers of light left into a mockery of beauty.  The question remains as to just what has been worshipped in here of late and you like not the thoughts it stirs.

wayto.7154: ;e unless move 'go door'; fput 'kneel'; fput 'touch statue'; waitfor 'the black mein door has opened'; fput 'stand'; move 'go door'; end

title: [Castle Darkstone, Great Hall]
description: Once a hall for meetings and pleasurable dinners, this spacious structure now is the apparent workshop of the new castle occupants.  Several tables have been set up and show recent signs of use.  Empty flasks and mein shavings litter the floor.  The most notable fixture here is a massive stone pedestal that has been placed in the center of the room.  Atop the pedestal is a curious swirling void, and the whole apparatus seems to hum with a mysterious power.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Great Hall]
description: A large black iron kettle hangs here from a rusty chain over a blackened fire pit.  A large hole in the ceiling above this crude hearth is stained with the smoke and soot of many fires.  Strangely the kettle and firepit show signs of recent use, unlike anything else in the castle.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Inner Keep]
description: This is the northeastern corner of the central courtyard of the inner keep.  The great hall runs along the northern wall here, and the northeast tower rises high above you.  The castle's well is conveniently located here, well defended and close to the great hall.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Inner Keep]
description: The southeast tower of the castle appears to have collapsed entirely, although it is unclear whether this was due to damage or simply the ravages of time.  In either case, all that remains of the great tower now is a huge pile of rubble.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Crypt]
description: The air is still and silent in this dimly-lit space.  Several ornately carved stone coffins, probably containing dead ancestors of the castle's lords, lie under thick blankets of dust here.  A thick, swirling mist blankets this room almost completely, only briefly wavering to reveal a dark stone monolith towering silently in the center of the room.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Stables]
description: The ordered stalls and mouldering horse tack clearly indicate that this room once held the finest of horses.  Although no horses now remain, a pile of bones lies in the last stall, with a bridle still fastened around the long-dead skull.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: Large cracks in the walls here make you question the structural integrity of this tower.  Broken bits of stone and a fine rocky dust cover most everything in this room, what little there is.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: The entire top of the tower has been smashed and broken off here, just about at the level of your head.  Whether this damage was due to enemy aggression or to the long passage of time is not at all clear, but the thought of a massive stone tower falling, for any reason, makes you uneasy.

title: [Torture Chamber]
description: Gruesome instruments of torture fill this room, although most are now broken beyond repair.  The dampness of the castle walls here has promoted the growth of several molds, and a dank, musty smell hangs about the room.  The vague stench of death wafts up from cracks surrounding a trap door in the floor, filling you with dread.

title: [Iron Maiden]
description: This exceptionally small space is made to seem even smaller by the menacingly sharp and disturbingly stained spikes, which poke at you from all directions.  A strap allows you to open and close the door, but that would seem to be exceedingly dangerous.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: There is barely enough room for you to squeeze through this tunnel, and you find you must alternately stoop and crawl, pressing yourself hard against the damp, earthen walls.  Hundreds of tiny, blind worms writhe in the crevices, making your skin crawl as you brush past them.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The passage turns abruptly at an odd angle.  Stale air is trapped in this section of tunnel, and your breathing becomes shallow and labored.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: It must have taken great effort to carve this tunnel out of the earth, and yet the futility of it all is beginning to wear upon you as you wonder if you are making any progress at all.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Another sharp bend in the tunnel, and you get the feeling you are travelling in circles.  The dried husks of large beetles crunch beneath your feet.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Stifling, musty air closes in around you.  You notice tiny burrows in the dirt walls and try not to think about the crawling creatures that call them home.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Several tunnels intersect at this point, branching off in all directions.  You begin to wonder if any of the brave, desperate souls who dug them ever saw daylight.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Behind the dirt there is a wall of solid rock.  Crude tools have barely chipped away at its surface.  You sense the frustration and futility of this thwarted attempt to regain freedom, and your heart is heavy with a feeling of impending doom.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Tightly-woven spider webs blanket the walls and cling to your face and hair as you slip through the narrow crevice that passes for a tunnel.  Blind centipedes writhe frantically, trapped in the webs, awaiting death.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A dejected-looking corpse lies slumped in this cramped, V-shaped bend in the passage.  What remains of his rotted clothing is smeared with dark,  reddish-brown stains.  One frail, bony hand still clutches a crudely-made shovel blade, obviously ineffective against the wall of solid rock he encountered here.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: An occasional hint of fresh air wafts through this section of tunnel, which it stretches off in three directions as far as your eyes can see.

title: [Darkstone, Tunnel]
description: A narrow tunnel runs like a gash through the natural rock, intersecting here with a carved, dirt passage that leads off to the west. The passage slopes steeply upwards, and the jagged rocks provide a precarious foothold at best.

title: [Darkstone, Tunnel]
description: Darkness surrounds you in this rocky, steeply sloped passage.  The air below you is chilly and stale, making breathing difficult.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A number of passages converge here, some tiny and cramped, others a bit wider, but all of them musty and damp.  A strange, sticky substance oozes from the dirt walls.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Huge, black beetles crawl in and out of the eyesockets of a twisted skeleton.  Bits of cloth still cling to its fragile frame, and bony fingers clutch a sharpened piece of scrap metal.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Massive piles of musty dirt and rubble make squeezing through narrow openings in this roughly hewn passage quite difficult.  The tunnel branches in three directions here.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A skeletal arm protrudes, fingers outstretched in a gesture of supplication, from the rubble of a section of collapsed dirt wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Assorted rubble--dirt, bones, and other debris--has been dug up from the ground beneath the dungeon, revealing a network of tunnels.  Sections of the tunnel are wide, others narrow and in danger of imminent collapse.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The dirt walls are damp and pitted with the burrows of small, nocturnal creatures.  A thin, sticky webwork covers the wall to your left, dotted with the corpses of hapless rodents and slugs.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Crude tools--sharpened stones, bone fragments, bits of metal--are strewn about the tunnel in various states of decay, hinting at their ineffectiveness.  The tunnel is narrow here, as if its creators were trying to save their strength.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The tunnel ends in a crumbling pile of dirt and rock.  The rat-gnawed bones of would-be escapees lie disjointed against the crude walls and you begin to wonder if the poor souls were finally overcome by exhaustion and lack of air.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Groundwater seeps up through the dirt, collecting in stagnant, strong-smelling puddles of filth and mud.  Sections of the walls here have collapsed, leaving piles of rubble as obstacles in your path.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The tunnel bends sharply here, its walls ragged and hastily cut, as if its creator had lost all sense of direction and purpose.  The air is stale and damp, and your skin is matted with a fine film of dirt as you press through the narrow passage.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Pools of fetid, muddy water splash up around your ankles as you creep through this tiny, dismal tunnel.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Squatting precariously atop this immense pile of dirt, debris, and animal remains, you see a small, dark opening.  Soft, shuffling sounds travel through from above, making the tiny hairs at the back of your neck stand on end.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Deep brown wood panels this room, making it look even darker and smaller than it actually is.  A solid-looking trapdoor with heavy hinges is set into one corner of the floor, surrounded by tightly fitted grey stone.  A burned-out torch lies discarded in the corner near the trapdoor, which looks blackened and singed in places, but is still as solid as ever.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This passage is very, very dark.  The walls feel spongy, and seem to be covered with some kind of moss.  It seems to absorb any light in the area, with the result that you can't see much past your nose.  Hopefully, any monsters lurking about can't see either.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: You pick your way fearfully through the dark, one careful step at a time.  You hear a drip, drip, drip coming from somewhere over your head, and a faint rustling noise coming from the north.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The ceiling seems to have partly collapsed here some time in the past, leaving boulders, rocks and smaller rubble to block the passageway.  As you climb over the pile, careful of where you place your feet, something with a lot of legs crawls over your hand.  You hear rustling and clicking noises coming from the north.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This stretch of passage echoes with rustling, clicking and scuttling noises.  Your boots crunch with each step you take.  You get a horrible, sick suspicion in the pit of your stomach, which is confirmed when hundreds of crawly little feet start climbing up your legs.  You imagine suffocating under a mountain of insects and feel slightly sick to your stomach.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: You run into a post and stumble back, almost falling to the ground.  Approaching more cautiously, you discover a line of thin posts set across the passage.  You explore one with your hands, but jerk back when you find a half-rotted skull impaled at the top.  You can probably squeeze between the posts if you're careful.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Feeling around in the dark, you discover a cold stone altar.  It's covered with a rough, dried crust that you suspect is old blood as well as some sticky patches that appear to be fresher.  Deep grooves are cut into the surface, and you can imagine the blood pouring down during a sacrifice.  The shackles at the four corners of the altar are smooth to the touch, not rusty at all.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A small clay pot is set high on the wall in the corner.  The pot glows with a dim, flickering light, illuminating the north and east branches of the corridor for a few paces in each direction, and leaves many wavering shadows where monsters may be lurking.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Pebbles and dirt and sandy grit cover the floor in this stretch of corridor.  You notice with some consternation that there's a large crack in the western wall, from the ceiling down to within a few handspans of the floor.  Dust covers everything, and puffs up in clouds with every step you take.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The floor of this room is covered with a thick layer of mouldy straw, the thickest and most-compacted layer lying directly beneath a dark hole in the ceiling.  Rustles and scratches alert you to the fact that not all of the inhabitants of this room are two-legged.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Large rocks and piles of dirt make the footing here difficult.  The walls are webbed with cracks, and chunks appear to be missing from the ceiling.  Dust fills the air as you move through.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A large section of wall has collapsed, partially blocking the corridor.  Rubble and rocks lie strewn across the floor, making it hard to scramble from one place to the next.  Ominous creaks and groans, and streams of dust and dirt sifting down from the ceiling, make you wonder how soon before the rest of the passage collapses.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Climbing under the wall and up into this room, you find yourself on top of a pile of rubble, up near the ceiling.  There's a trapdoor set in the center of the ceiling within your reach.  This is a good thing, because you can make out the remnants of a ladder, smashed to splinters beneath the collapsed wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A section of ceiling is crumbled all over the floor, and the northern wall is definitely leaning toward you.  There's a rather largish crack in the southern wall, with rats scurrying in and out.  The floor, what isn't covered by pieces of ceiling, looks decidedly uneven.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This small space is dark and cramped.  Feeling your way around, you find something that feels rather like an arm, and it seems to have been here for a while.  There's a largish crack to the north, and rubble all around.  The ceiling is black with shadows, but you get the impression of space above.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Stones and gravel and gritty stuff cover the floor, making your footsteps crunch.  There are cracks in the walls, and the ceiling looks like it's missing a few chunks.  You hear a pebble fall and bounce off of a couple of other rocks, landing with a click on the floor.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Dust and pebbles are scattered across the intersection, and appear to get thicker to the west.  A thin crack runs across the ceiling; the western side of the crack is visibly lower than the eastern side.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A rat scuttles down the hallway, drawing your attention to the floor.  Low on one wall, you notice some writing.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The corner is a bit lower than the rest of the corridor, and water has collected there.  The water is brackish and slimy, and furry green moss spreads across the floor and up the walls from the puddle.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: There's a small, round hole carved in the north wall at about eye level.  Peering into it, you see two beady eyes peering back out.  There's a HISSSS! and a forked tongue flickers out.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Eerie shadows flicker through this section of corridor, casting grotesque shapes on the walls and floor.  There are tracks of rats and other things in the dust on the floor, and filmy grey cobwebs swagging from the ceiling.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A structure much like a well stands in the center of the room.  Looking like a stone box, with sides about three feet high, the shaft descends into blackness.  A passage leads off to the north, and another slopes upward to the west.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A mummified corpse gapes at you from where it hangs on the far wall.  Iron spikes are driven through the body and into the stone, each spike carefully positioned to avoid vital organs.  Death was doubtless many days in coming.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A mummified head screams silent agony from where it's entombed in the wall.  The wall, of brick and plaster, was built around the neck with the head protruding from the other side.  Likewise trapped are two hands, their fingers straining toward you, and two feet.  The legs must have been broken to get the feet to stick out at that angle.  The victim must have died slowly and in a state of terrified madness.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The south wall of this room is covered with chips of flat, colored stone, forming an intricate mosaic.  A carved stone bench is placed next to the door, opposite the mosaic.  A few shreds of cloth that might have been cushions a century or three ago lie on the bench.  A stone arch, carved all around with strong, blunt designs, leads off to the east.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: In the center of the room, opposite the arch, stands a statue.  Carved of black marble with fine white veining, it portrays a noble looking man of middle years, dressed in the garb of several centuries past.  He bears a striking resemblance to the man in the mosaic in the outer room.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Deeply carved symbols cover the walls in this stretch of passage, row upon row, speaking in a language you can't comprehend, however hard you try. The characters are vaguely pictographic, but interpreting them literally, those that are recognizable as objects, results in no coherent meaning for any group of them.  The carvings continue on down the corridor to the east.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The eastern and northern walls of this corner curve to meet each other smoothly, rather than forming a sharp angle as do the other walls in these passages.  Formed of flat, colored stones, a bright mosaic diagram covers the curve from floor to ceiling, and a double armspan wide.  Unfamiliar symbols radiate out from the diagram, looking rather like text but in no alphabet with which you are familiar.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Strange characters are carved into the walls, looking rather like an alphabet, and grouped to form words, but you've never seen anything like them before.  The symbols continue along the walls, disappearing into the shadows to the north.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This room is a shambles.  Benches and other furniture that would be antiques if they were in one piece are smashed and splintered, their pieces strewn all over the room in a chaotic explosion.  A few rusty swords, and a shield rim like a great iron hoop protrude from the junk.  Most of the wood is blackened, and a great charred table lies upended against one wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This passage is crudely carved from the surrounding stone.  The floor is bumpy and pitted, and the walls are crooked, with cracks and protrusions.  A small wooden trapdoor is set in the low ceiling.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The footing is difficult in this rough tunnel.  To the south, the floor rises at a steep angle.  Someone in a charitable frame of mind might call the gouges in the slope "steps," but that wouldn't make them any more even.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The tunnel opens out into a roughly squarish chamber.  On the far wall, a mummified body is shackled upside down, arms and legs spread.  A post about as thick as your thumb and none too smooth is inserted in the mouth.  Judging by the nasty stains and calcified globs on the post and the floor around it, it probably continues a ways beyond the throat.  Positioned squarely in front of the figure is a towering dark stone monolith, shrouded in a thick mist.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A harsh draft blows through this intersection, a chill wind that sears to your very bones.  It carries the scent of evil, and of death, and your soul trembles at the feel of its icy caress.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A breeze wafts down the passage, carrying with it the odor of something in a state of advanced decay.  The shadows seem deeper and more ominous, and you look over your shoulder nervously.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This is an absolutely bare room.  There's not even any dust on the floor.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The stink here is overpowering.  A score of rats swarm over what remains of a medium sized carcass.  It isn't quite the right size or shape to be a human or an elf, but it could conceivably have been a dwarf.  The rats squeak and hiss at your approach, backing reluctantly into the shadows until only their glowing yellow eyes are visible.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A dozen large barrels are stacked in here, and the acid smell of sour vinegar is staggering.  The wood of the barrels is old and rotted, and a touch could cause them to disintegrate, a truly horrifying thought.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The corridor dead ends here at the blank south wall.  The walls and floor show signs of age and stress, with cracks and crumbled spots here and there.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This room is littered with stone and dirt, a dusty boulder and assorted rubble.  It's incredibly dusty, and by the time you've taken a couple of steps in here, the air is so full of dust that it's hard to breathe, and your eyes are watering.  The cause of all this mess seems to be a rough black hole gaping in the ceiling, from which the debris seems to have come.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: There are signs that a battle raged in this intersection long ago.  Dark rust stains spatter the floor and walls, and there's a large chip missing out of the stone on the southwest corner.  The oaken door to the south is cracked and gouged, and even the iron door to the east is streaked with rust where steel once scratched its surface.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A chill breeze blows through this small room, finding its way to your skin no matter how you adjust what you're wearing.  A mouldering tapestry hanging on one wall trembles every minute or so, and the table and three chairs are unevenly dusty.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This narrow corridor is thick with dust and crawling with beetles.  They scatter at your approach, clicking furiously, waiting in the dark corners just out of sight.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Beetles scuttle back and forth across the floor, a few clinging to the walls and ceiling.  It smells like something is rotting in here, even in the cool of the underground.  The smell gets stronger to the east.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The passage dead ends just east of here, at a rough stone wall with a putrid corpse collapsed in front of it.  The odor permeates the entire area; apparently the body has been here for a couple of weeks.  It's definitely humanoid, and it's short and stocky enough to have been a dwarf, but you really can't tell for sure.  Beetles and worms and larger scavengers have been at work, and the results are grisly.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: You have the feeling that you're being watched.  The corridors to the west and south look empty, and you don't hear anything, but there's a feeling between your shoulder blades as though someone were about to stick a knife there.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A burned out torch lies cast aside against one wall, where it landed after skidding across the floor for several feet.  The floor is streaked black with dried pitch and soot, which mark the trail of the torch when it was discarded.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: An axe blade is embedded in the stone floor, its shaft rotted away long ago.  Parallel scratches on the wall next to the blade are evidence of a rather largish creature, or at least a creature with larger than average claws.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: You hear a steady dripping sound, the PLOPLOPLOP of water trickling slowly from a height.  The stone under your feet is patchy with moss, but there's no other indication of water nearby.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This room is empty except for a trap door set in the middle of the floor. The wood is solid, and there's no ring or latch visible.  Even the hinges are on the other side, with whatever else may be there.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The hall dead ends here, with a door on the north wall and an archway on the south wall.  A large black beetle is making its slow way across the ceiling, and is currently right over your head.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The walls of this room are set with ledges, shallow depressions that each contain a large jar.  Narrow conical vases are hanging from metal brackets between the ledges, but whatever may have once been in them has rotted away to nothing.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Your footsteps echo weirdly in this stretch of hall.  You almost fancy that there is another set behind you, or maybe in front of you, but it must be just the sound reflecting through the stone corridors.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Timbers are set up every few feet near this corner, propping up the ceiling.  Large chunks of stone are piled around next to the walls, and corresponding gaps in the ceiling show where they came from.  A couple of timbers lie fallen on the floor, and you wonder just how steady the roof might be without their support.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The mouldy remains of some large animal lie in a heap in the corner.  A nicked and rusted sword sticks out at an angle, and white bones protrude from rotten, rat-chewed hide.  It looks like it's been here for a long time, which is good, since it would probably smell horrible otherwise.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Rats scuttle back and forth across the floor, chittering and squeaking and hissing at you, expressing their displeasure at being disturbed.  In the dust on the floor, you see a few footprints that are far too large to have been made by a rat, or by a normal rat anyway, but before you can examine them, they're obliterated by the smaller rats scurrying across them.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A skeleton lies stretched out on the floor, one hand straining east.  Only a few shreds remain of his (her?) clothes, along with the mouldy remains of some leather armor.  Dark patches of some long-ago dried liquid stain the floor around the skeleton, and splatter the walls.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The floor is slimy under your feet, and very slippery.  Water seems to be running in trickles down the corridor from the east.  Scuttling noises fill the air, but with all the echoes in this intersection, you can't tell where they're coming from.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The floor in here is torn up, with rocks and rubble piled around against the walls.  There's a shallow pit in the middle of the room, with some rags and a broken pick in it.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Everything's damp in this stretch of corridor, and various colored molds streak the walls.  The air smells wet and musty.  Tiny rivulets of greenish water run across the floor, making it slick and slippery.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A large amount of rubble lies here, apparently having fallen out of the bottom of the well shaft above you.  Faint trickling noises catch your attention and you look down to notice a fair amount of water running in a streamlet at your feet.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A light breeze blows down this corridor, bringing a putrid scent with it.  The odor seems to cling to the moss growing on the walls, fouling the air for quite a stretch.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The corridor bends here, with branches going north and east.  You hear the trickling of running water coming from the east, but the north is dead and silent.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The floor slopes down to the east at quite a steep angle.  The air gets damper and the walls moldier the farther to the east you look.  It looks much drier up to the west.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The walls down here are of fitted stone, with a bowl-shaped niche built into the north wall at about waist high.  The niche is full of water, a trickle of which is overflowing the bowl and puddling on the floor.  Hairy molds and bulbous fungus grow across the walls, while the floor is slippery with slime.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The floor slopes down to the center of this room, like a great bowl.  At the lowest point is a dark chute, disappearing at a steep angle into the floor.  A black snake hisses at you, then slithers down the chute.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A really horrible-looking fungus clings to the walls in patches, fouling the still air until you wish you didn't have to breathe.  A rusty iron door is set into the east wall, and looks rather sturdy despite its obvious age.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: All manner of debris is heaped and strewn about this room.  It looks like someone (or something) was using it as a stash, and then just never came back.  Broken armor, rusty weapons, and even bits of rotted bodies are heaped up with no apparent organization.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The grey stone walls are covered with a spreading fungus.  It looks rather like milk that's been left out for a few days, and smells about the same too.  The floor is squishy beneath your feet, and strewn with scattered rocks and pebbles.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Small pots set high on the walls cast a flickering glow over this messy room.  Shelves and pieces of a broken bench lie scattered around the floor, most of the shelving reduced to splintered boards.  Shards of shattered pots litter the already messy floor, their sharp edges protruding from all the places where you might want to put down your feet.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The corridor widens a bit here at the corner.  The walls are uneven, as though hewn roughly from the bedrock.  A dark niche and many rocky extrusions twist the shadows into eerie forms.  In a couple of places, it looks like someone meant to dig a tunnel, then changed his mind.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Your footsteps echo off of the bare walls, floor and ceiling.  Some trick of acoustics seems to send sounds to this corridor from all over the area.  The faint sounds of water dripping and rats chittering breeze by your awareness, along with the more ominous sound of shuffling footsteps.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This corner is blanketed with shadows.  Dust puffs up in clouds with your every step.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: An arched niche is carved out of the south wall, empty now of all but dust.  Chunks of stone are scattered across the corridor, some of them with smooth or regular faces.  A statue must have fallen from the niche, shattering on the stone floor.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Strands of spider web brush your face, and something with lots of legs scuttles across your chest, disappearing into the shadows.  Looking up, you see that the corner is fuzzy grey with webs.  Half a dozen lumpy blobs are wrapped in silk and hanging from the webs.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Several benches and a table are piled against the wall in this smallish room.  Chunks of grey stone are stacked in front of them, and smaller pieces of rubble are piled around a pitch-black hole gaping in the center of the floor.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: A great stone table dominates the center of this room.  Arcane runes are carved into its pitted surface, and are all but obscured by time and wear.  A stone pillar stands at the head of the table, close against the wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The floor in this passage is uneven and none too stable beneath your feet, but you probably don't want to examine the litter too closely.  A dim light dances in a pot set high on one wall, casting flickering shadows all around.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Sticky cobwebs cling to your face, despite your best efforts to brush them away.  The webbing is tougher and stickier than any you've ever encountered before.  A small pot set high on a wall sheds a flickering light over the area, just enough to turn the webs into shadowy traps.

Sticky cobwebs cling to your face despite your best efforts to brush them away.  The webbing is tougher and stickier than any you've ever encountered before.  A small pot set high on a wall sheds a flickering light over the area, just enough to turn the webs into shadowy traps.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This dark, cavernous room smells like a slaughterhouse.  Bodies in varying states of extended decomposition, from mummies to bare bones, litter the floor.  A dim light comes from a pot set high on the wall.  There is a dark hole in the roof, high above your head, far out of reach.  Gloomy passages lead away in three directions.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The wall opposite the door is covered with moss and oozing water.  If you listen, you hear a steady trickling sound.  A slimy stream crosses the floor to its center and vanishes into an iron grate.  Light from a small pot set high on a wall sparkles off the water droplets clinging to the moss.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The center of this room is taken up by a five sided pool.  Silvery grey stone mortared with something black and grainy borders the inky water.  The pool is still as death and completely opaque.  There could be literally anything down there.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This is a bare stone room.  Slimy green mold streaks the walls, filling the air with a damp smell.  There's a small grate in the ceiling, letting in a bit of dim light from above.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower's Top]
description: The very top of this tower, the only one remaining fully intact to judge from the wreckage strewn far below, is open to the wind and rain and elements.  Great powers once strove here, for the massive stones are blackened and charred.  In spots the stone has been melted and cooled so that brittle puddles of black glass crunch underfoot.  Crowning the battlements, a massive jackal, cast or carved out of the blackest ora, peers down at the surroundings like a brooding monarch above a dead kingdom.

wayto.7036: ;e unless move 'go door'; fput 'kneel'; fput 'touch jackal'; waitfor 'the black mein door has opened'; fput 'stand'; move 'go door'; end

title: [Upper Trollfang, Path]
description: A path meanders through large tree trunks encrusted with moss and lichens.  Underfoot, a thick carpet of leaves mutes footsteps, its soft brown tones spotted here and there with small dots of deep purple where woodland violets bloom.
location: Kestrel's Perch, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The wide trail swings back to the northwest here.  From the north, you can hear the sound of crashing water.  A smaller path leads in that direction.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The stream disappears into a deep sink hole here.  The sound of rushing water and the cloud of fine spray is invigorating and relaxing.  You pause for a moment to look at the sink hole more closely.  It seems wider and deeper than you recall it being.  There are signs of fresh excavations around the opening.
