title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This part of the trail is steep and strewn with loose rocks and rubble.  As you stumble along, an occasional stone works loose and bounces down the path.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This part of the trail is difficult to follow as it winds up the side of a long and winding ridge.  Up and to the north the trail becomes even steeper while to the south it appears to dive into a hedge of thick undergrowth.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You are standing on the north bank of a fast moving stream that has cut a deep gully through this part of the forest.  A dense growth of thick underbrush surrounds you, the leaves of which sparkle with tiny drops of water that have been cast into the air by the rushing water.  A tremendous elm tree has been felled and placed across the gully and appears to provide you with a way to bridge the chasm.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail dips down as it twists from northeast to southeast.  The sound of pounding water can also be heard below.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The steep angle of the trail is treacherous where it ends, blocked by a pile of rubble at the base of a high ridge.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The crypt casts fell shadows that block out any bleak light imparted by the heavens.  They also seem to absorb all sounds and signs of life.  The rough stone walls that enclose the graveyard stretch far to the northeast, sheltering the irregular rows of burial sites from unwanted intrusions.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Weeds striving to grow between the gravel, and the thorn bushes and milk-white trumpet shrubs obscuring the foundation of the crypt provide the only clues that life goes on amid the desolation.  Wisps of tattered cloth and stray tufts of fur are caught upon the thorns.  Several intact gravesites lie to the east.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The path bends around the northeast corner of the building.  From the northwest comes a very faint odor of rot and a warm, clammy breeze.  To the south, the path continues around the crypt.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Several graves here are clustered around a large marble monument.  A low iron railing encloses the area.  The burial plots seem to be unplundered, but the dark, freshly turned earth atop one of the graves indicates the presence of an unquiet soul.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The path leads you close to the crypt.  The grey-flecked rock has been ground to a smooth, dull surface.  To the southwest, the boundary walls extend up to the edge of a shallow creek, and to the southeast, the spires of a high gate can be seen.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Here a few of the perfectly fitted granite blocks of the crypt have been chipped away flake by flake over the ages by persistent forces.  Brownish mosses and powdery lichen have taken hold in the crannies, further weakening the stone.  The sharp bits of stone are scattered over the blunter pebbles of the path.

title: [Graveyard]
description: You glance over to the west to relieve the depressing view of the somber crypt.  In that direction, a small creek etches a deep azure line through the dark landscape between low, thickly overgrown banks.

title: [Graveyard]
description: From this corner of the crypt, you spy lowlying terrain to the north and west, as the vegetation takes on a darker green color and low curling mists obscure the ground in the distance.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The back wall of the crypt is a solid vertical mass of granite.  The blocks are held firmly in place by the clever shaping, with no mortar.  The path continues around the tomb, while to the north, a trail weaves through the shrubs and wilds.

title: [Graveyard, Path]
description: Tall grasses grow unchecked to the base of a rough stone wall.  Limbs from the forest beyond the wall overhang into the graveyard, dropping leaves that have blown into piles.  There are no graves in this area between the iron railing and the stone wall.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: Bits of broken bone are strewn across the uneven ground.  Cracked, uprooted headstones mark graves violated by some unknown occurence.  The graves remain as hunks of overturned earth grown over by sparse grass.  The rough stone wall stretches to the north and south, dividing this area from the rest of the graveyard.  Thick undergrowth borders the grounds, growing up to dense woods to the north and south.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: A gnarled and twisted viburnum tree grows out over a rectangular hole in the ground.  Tall spindly grass and rotting leaves fill the hole, making it appear shallow.  The trunk of the viburnum tree is dotted with blotches of brown ooze, but sparse leaves grow on its thin branches, showing a fight for life against an unknown blight.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: Toppled tombstones lie in broken pieces on the ground where the grass, briar bushes, and dead leaves nearly obscure them from view.  Two grave markers remain standing, one leaning against the other, both cracked and crumbling.  Thin boards and bits of splintered wood, rotten with age, show the destruction of more than one grave site.  Nothing remains of the bodies once buried in the plundered graves.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: The ground slopes to the southeast toward a stagnant, weed-choked pond.  The graves show the same abuse as the rest of the burial grounds.  Tombstones and grave markers dot the ground, either toppled on their sides or crumbled to pieces of stone.  A partially submerged stone statue pokes out of the pond, its features too worn to make out.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: A slime-covered pond to the southwest has claimed most of the graves where mossy tombstones lie partially submerged in the inky water.  From the thick forest to the north and east, limbs overgrown with thick lichen reach out to obscure the sky.  The air is thick with moisture and the stench of decay.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: The scarred and buckled ground slopes sharply to the north and west, forming a narrow path around an inky, stagnant pond.  The dense forest grows to the edge of the pond, where thick moss-covered roots disappear into the rancid water.  The path is muddy and slick where it crosses over the large roots.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: The path rises over a mound, providing a view of the surrounding desolation.  Crumbling and toppled tombstones mark the earth around plundered and violated graves.  To the northeast, the edge of a slime-covered pond encroaches on the graves, the inky water lapping at the edges of overturned tombstones.  The air is stagnant and foul.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: The undergrowth from the woods to the east has taken over this part of the grounds.  Weeds grow up around grave markers that are nothing more than lashed-together sticks and branches, or piles of rocks.  The graves have been violated, left as humps of overturned earth from freshly dug to completely overgrown.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: The trail is more defined here as it winds to the east, fading into the grass as it weaves around the grounds.  The forest creates a solid wall of trees and dense underbrush to the south.  Scraggly bare trees dot the grounds, their twisted branches reaching into the sky like claws.  The air is still and heavy with the stench of decay.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Graveyard, Burial Grounds]
description: Leading around uprooted headstones and mounds of overturned earth, a faint trail winds through the grounds, marked only by areas where the grass lies flat.  Some of the graves are nothing more than humps of sparse grass, while others are mounds of freshly overturned earth.  Thick woods border the area to the west and south.

title: [Graveyard, Wooded Glade]
description: The dense forest opens into a small clearing, growing thick around the perimeter to leave only a narrow path to the west.  The thick undergrowth of the forest meets tall grass which thins to bare earth at the center of the clearing, where a ring of partially buried stones protects the charred remains of a fire.  A low haunting sound fills the air as the wind sweeps over the trees and into the glade.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The soft loam of the trail is cushioned by fallen leaves.  The crest of a broad moundlike formation is silhouetted against the sky to the northeast, its slopes carpeted with purple heather and pink-flowering salorisa shrubs.  The ghostly grey visage of a granite crypt haunts the southwest horizon.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The trail turns at a sharp angle, causing you to move with greater purpose.  The air is sweet with the earthy scents of rich soil, growing things and long-buried secrets.  A lone gorcrow croaks overhead and alights upon a mysterious mound of earth to the north.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Before you is a hill with an abundance of weeds and groundcover on its slopes.  The mound rises abruptly from the surrounding level land, indicating that it is not a natural feature.  The base runs roughly west to east and tapers to a narrow point at the eastern extreme.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The mound comes to a point just to the northeast, resembling the prow of a mighty ship.  To the south is an open, level field containing nondescript graves of common and humble folk.  The mound before you is the main source of interest and curiosity.

title: [Graveyard]
description: At the eastern tip of the mound, the sides of the hill spread out, forming a broad shape reminiscent of the overturned hull of a dark, menacing warship.  Although the vertical slopes are steep and treacherous, the top of the mound would afford a good view of the surrounding area.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The trail wraps around the flat western edge of the mound.  To the northwest, a cluster of monumental stone ruins draws your attention.  Deep ruts in the paths from heavy objects being dragged or scraped along the ground seem to lead towards the dolmens.

title: [Graveyard]
description: You are led right up against the mound's west slope, which meets the ground at a right angle.  The precision of the angle leads you to suspect that this hill is actually an earth-sheltered structure of some sort.  As you continue to explore, the brooding remnants of some ancient monoliths to the northwest cast a sense of abiding melancholy and sadness over the scene.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The western end of the mound is wider than the eastern terminus, forming a broad earth wall.  In contrast to the steep side of the mound, the land to the west slants gently downhill in a gradual drop in the elevation from this level plateau.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The path girds the northern perimeter of the mound far enough away from it to grant a full view of the slopes.  The closecropped surface vegetation might offer handholds for scaling to the top to the adventurer who travels light.  To the north, the plateau continues off beyond the horizon, a trackless, windswept mesa of tall grass and thick sod that presents a hostile and formidable obstacle.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The mysterious mound seems like an unanswered riddle yet the worn dirt path around it and the curiously domed crest of the hill arouse your suspicion.  Judging from the deep tracks in all directions, others before you must have felt it worthy of investigation.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Along the northeast flank of the great earthen barrow, some loose stones and mud have washed down the slope, slashing a narrow gully through the sod and spewing detritus out onto the trail.  You detour around the debris, stepping back onto the turf.  From this perspective, you pause to get your bearings, gazing up thoughtfully at the silent, inscrutable heights.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The land is level here, away from the main graveyard.  A few slab-like stone monoliths lie fallen in a rough semicircle on the grass, part of a ruined funerary gate honoring some past hero.  Had they remained standing, they would form a perfect frame through which could be seen a large dirt mound to the east.  Southwest is a dark lowland dotted by broken tombstones.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The land rises slightly to the west, in the direction of some odd stone ruins.  The air here is noticeably clammy and causes beads of humidity to mix with the perspiration of dread already present on your skin.  The hollow calls of tree frogs and the humming of countless tiny gnats grate on your nerves.  The wild noises and dank breeze seem to originate from the bog to the west.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Along the roadside is a wide swath of grass holding a series of tombstones resting at the heads of narrow mounds of dirt in regular array.  The graves are now overgrown with weeds and wildflowers.  Despite their state of ruin, it is still apparent that this is the ancestral burial plot of some ancient, noble family.  The firm path continues around the bog.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Your feet sink deeply into the muddy way.  Struggling to go in the direction you choose rather than yield to the tug of the mire, you look to the side of the road towards the source of the damp chill.  The foul bog that lies there holds a strange and potentially fatal attraction.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Skirting the fringes of the bog, you come upon the cause of its existence.  A small creek has been blocked off by fallen trees to create a turbid lake behind a natural dam.  The water seeps over the banks to flood the graveyard here, with damp earth and brackish puddles forming a bog that surrounds broken and overturned tombstones.  Small trails where the earth is more solid crisscross the fetid swamp.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The small lake overflows the creek bank and laps against your feet.  Low, shrubby spinewood trees grow right up to the edge and some protrude from the surface of the water.  The only firm footing to be found is over the felled logs that hold back the course of the creek, blocking its northward flow.

title: [Graveyard]
description: Glancing quickly to the south, you see the rear of the crypt and the gray gravel path encircling it.  Turning the corner at the edge of the bog, you struggle to suppress the feeling of queasiness in the pit of your stomach that the dreary view instills in you.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The trail verges on a muddy depression that dips to the northwest.  To the east the byway widens as it is intersected by faint, smaller arteries.  They seem to vanish and then reappear as they lead into the seething, pulsating heart of the unstable swampland or off towards the creek.

title: [Graveyard]
description: The land sinks down into a bowl-shaped depression to the side of the route.  The trail in that direction has become muddy and indistinct, ending in a watery conclusion.  The brown, foul water that just covers the surface of the ground within the depression seems to hide a multitude of traps and treasures.

title: [Graveyard, Creek Bank]
description: You see the bank of the creek that helps hold back the waters farther upstream.  The route along the bank is not easy, but lying between the swamp and the murky waters of the creek, it seems to offer the best path for the cautious traveller.

title: [Graveyard, Creek Bank]
description: The creek here widens and there is no way to ford it.  Steep banks to the south are directly bordered by thorny underbrush and slick gravelly trails. The only safe path is back in the direction you came.

title: [Graveyard, Top of Mound]
description: From the lofty perch atop the burial mound, you look out over the lowlands and marshes to the south and west and the desolate plateau to the north.  Facing southeast are the ominous graveyard, unquiet crypt, and the gates and cemetary walls beyond.  The ridge is narrow and uneven, with little room to maneuver.  Startled by the cawing of a nesting gorcrow, you realize that any distraction from keeping your balance would be courting to disaster.

title: [Top of Mound, Depression]
description: A saucer-shaped depression here encroaches into the summit of the burial mound.  Dark, rich earth forms a concave hollow, as though the wrathful fist of some angered deity had just left its mark of utter contempt upon the land.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: The dark, well-fertilized earth of the mound rises into a blackened ridge, the soft soil sinking under your feet to reveal glimpses of bleached bone and worm-eaten flesh.  A few blades of grass and rough bushes grow here, fed by the open air and the rich soil.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, out

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: The ground slopes away into a deep, dark hole at the corner of the mound, a rough ledge dug into the soil providing access into the darkness below.  Bones and grinning, fleshless skulls from ages past protrude from the ancient layers of dirt, their peace disrupted by the digging.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, down

title: [Graveyard, Barrow Tunnel]
description: The piled dirt that forms the burial mound gives way to a passage hewn into the stone of the ground below.  A narrow ledge has been carved into the walls, providing a precarious means of descent as it circles downward into darkness.

title: [Graveyard, Barrow Tunnel]
description: A stone ledge, carved into the chamber walls, circles the passage and leads upward into darkness.  A foul miasma settles from above, filling the chamber with a heavy odor of tainted soil and ancient decay.  The passage narrows to the east, its walls still showing the marks of the tools used to painstakingly carve it from the rock countless centuries ago.

title: [Graveyard, Barrow Tunnel]
description: Faint scratching sounds echo through the dark passages of the tunnels from all directions, breaking the deathly silence.  Walls of grey stone encroach on both sides here, reducing the tunnel to a narrow passage for a few feet before it widens to the west and splits to the east around a carved rock outcropping.

title: [Graveyard, Barrow Tunnel]
description: The tunnel widens into a small circular chamber that has been dug out of the dirt and stone.  The curved, irregular walls are covered with thick layers of spiderwebs, some of the strands as big around as a finger, which almost conceal the dozens of dark holes that dot the chamber.  A faint, chill breeze passes through the room.

title: [Graveyard, Barrow Tunnel]
description: A chill breeze bearing a faint odor of decay wafts through the huge stone arch that dominates the eastern end of the tunnel.  The arch is worn by dark rivulets of water dripping from somewhere above, the acidic liquid etching deep streaks in the ancient grey stone and nearly obliterating the many symbols of dark gods carved into its pockmarked surface.

title: [Underbarrow, Tunnels]
description: The steady drip of water echoes in the bleak rock chamber.  The scents of must and decay fill your nose, hanging heavy in the stagnant air.  Large blocks of grey stone have tumbled from the ceiling and walls, piling against the ancient arch that seems to lead out of the tunnels.

title: [Underbarrow, Tunnels]
description: A deep chill laces the air, clammy against your skin.  Bones litter the floor of the tunnel, glossed with frost and covered with small bits of flesh and tendon.  Spiderwebs curtain the stone walls and glisten with crystals of ice in the low light.  A fine layer of dust lies over the tunnel like a blanket, disturbed only by scuffed footprints and other disturbing signs of movement.

title: [Underbarrow, Tunnels]
description: Skeletons, partial and full, have been stacked high against the walls like cords of firewood.  Silken strands of webbing hold them against the grey stone, shimmering with a light coating of ice.  Several bones have escaped the spiders' nets to fall to the dusty floor, cluttering the path like the discarded toys of a macabre child.

title: [Underbarrow, Burial Chamber]
description: The grey stone of the walls is obscured behind piles upon piles of stacked corpses.  Each is in a state of perfect preservation, encased in thick sheets of pure ice.  Eyes stare up at the web-coated ceiling, forever watching the arachnids weaving their wispy tapestry.  The hand has fallen from one of the bodies and shattered, small frozen fragments of flesh scattered across the floor like grisly pieces of a puzzle.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Underbarrow, Burial Chamber]
description: Frozen bodies are tumbled across the floor like fallen logs.  Some have broken into pieces, fallen from the rows that once lined the grey stone walls, others show only a light scuffing of the ice that coats them.  Spiderwebs string between them like a cat's cradle, glimmering with tiny gems of frost.  Sitting in the center of the room is a perfectly preserved heart, frozen as solid as the rock of the chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Underbarrow, Tunnels]
description: Clammy, cold air caresses your skin, awakening goosebumps over any exposed flesh.  Spiderwebs tie the bones scattered across the floor together like delicate tendons, forming a collapsed parody of a complete skeleton.  Dust sifts out from between the grey stone blocks of the walls, telling a tale of age and instability in the architecture.

title: [Underbarrow, Tunnels]
description: The chill is deep, soaking into your body and making your bones ache.  Skeletons long past feeling the cold have been stacked against the walls, coated in a blue-white sheen of ice.  A low tunnel burrows through the grey stone wall, funneling the frosty air into the area.  Spiderwebs flutter in the cold breeze, reaching out like grasping fingers to entangle you.

title: [Underbarrow, Dead End]
description: A low altar made of grey stone sits against the far wall of this cul-de-sac.  The markings that once covered it have long since been obscured by spiderwebs and ice, leaving the god it once honored a mystery.  Gnawed bones sit haphazardly about it, perhaps gifts to appease the forgotten deity.  A chill breeze stirs the air, tickling over your skin.

title: [Underbarrow, Burial Chamber]
description: The chamber is lined with bodies.  Stacked as high as a human is tall, they are sealed in a thick casing of ice.  Young and old, male and female, they hold to no particular theme save that of death.  Some seem to have died natural deaths, their corpses devoid of injury.  Others are bloody and mangled, the ice closing over gaping wounds but forever leaving the insides of the bodies open to inspection.

title: [Underbarrow, Burial Chamber]
description: A nest of tangled spiderwebs sits partially hidden behind the walls of piled corpses.  Sticky, oozing white spheres of webbing are tucked into the nest, likely full of eggs laid by the arachnids.  Rows of bodies guard the nursery, both babysitters and pantries for the newborn spiders when they hatch.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: The cold here is so bad that your fingers and toes are becoming numb.  You try to stomp some warmth back into your feet but the echoes you raise makes you worry as to who or what might be listening, so you grit your teeth against their chattering and continue on.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: The condensation has turned to frost here, giving the walls a pale sheen like the pallor of death.  Ice crunches under your feet no matter how hard you try to move silently.  From time to time, ice cold drops of water fall from the ceiling and manage, with great skill, to find their way down the back of your neck.  You choke back a muttered curse at the biting cold.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: A glitter of something set in the wall catches your eye for a moment before you realize it is merely a reflection from ice crystals forming from the deepening cold.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: This area looks like a ghoul's larder.  Bodies and parts of bodies lie buried in ice that was scraped off the walls and ceiling then covered with layers of the gruesome pink icicles.  Not a pretty sight.  In one corner of the room you see some roughly carved stairs leading upwards.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Under Crypt, Ice Room]
description: This room is dominated by a giant slab of ice.  There is a chill here that transcends the cold you felt elsewhere.  Piled in front of the ice slab are the remains of many a grisly sacrifice.  Bones and skulls lie piled at the base of the slab as though in homage to something.  Your curiosity piqued, you draw close to the slab.  Dimly within you can make out a richly robed figure.  On one side of the room are some roughly carved stairs.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: The ice on the floor of the frost-coated tunnel makes walking tricky and the reflections of light from the walls make you think you see movement from the corner of your eye, causing you to glance about uneasily at every pace.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: As you wander through these tunnels, the cold gets deeper and deeper, penetrating to your very soul.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: These tunnels are dank and chill, your breath forms clouds of steam in front of you as you walk along.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: There is a decided chill here; a cold wind finds its way down your neck despite your efforts to keep it out.  Condensation runs down the walls to form chill rivulets underfoot.  Closer examination of the east wall reveals a small crevice you hadn't noticed before.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: Icicles have begun to form here from moisture dripping down from the graveyard above. Rather than the pure white of water, these are tinged with a faint red that makes you shudder at the thought of their source.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Under Barrow, Shaft]
description: The ground here is partially frozen into a slippery, nasty slush.  A damp chill causes moisture to run down the walls making your footing uncertain.  The handholds on the wall are slick and muddy from the moisture.

title: [Under Barrow, Shaft]
description: You pause as you cling to the treacherous handholds to adjust your gear.  Here there is neither light nor any sound save that of your breathing.  Suddenly, your foot slips free of its fragile hold and you scramble frantically for a more secure position and continue onwards, shaken but still alive.

title: [Under Barrow, Shaft]
description: You find yourself teetering precariously on the lip of a deep shaft.  The faint whisper of a freezing wind makes you shiver slightly.  There are rough handholds dug into the walls that you can get to if you lean way out over the unseen depths.  The shaft goes down a long ways, to judge from the length of time you can hear echoes from a small pebble that you knocked into the darkness below.  Above you is a warped wooden grating.

title: [Under Barrow, Deep Shaft]
description: Inside the old cabinet, you find dessicated remnants of various items of food: slabs of mouldy beef, dusty mounds that once were vegetables and other less identifiable things.  These have mostly been shoved off the shelves and lie heaped on the flooring.  Part of the floor is an old wooden grating, now so warped and rotted that you could easily squeeze through it into the chilling darkness below.

title: [Under Barrow, Banquet Hall]
description: This place has been the scene of many a revolting semblance of a feast.  You have trouble holding on to your insides as the horror of what transpired in here sinks in.  A scattering of chairs, benches and old broken tables tells of the terrifying attempts of the sinister celebrants to mock and imitate the ways of their civilized and unsuspecting prey.  At one end of the room is an ancient cabinet that once may have held food.  A numbingly cold breeze flows from that direction.

title: [Under Barrow, Throne Room]
description: This high chamber is a madman's travesty of a throne room in purgatory.  On a dais sits an eldritch throne inlaid with the ivory of human bones.  The walls are carved with gut-wrenching scenes of sub-human figures dancing and gibbering with hellish glee under constellations you have never seen.  Behind the throne is a tapestry whose subject turns your stomach.

title: [Under Barrow, Storeroom]
description: This room is low roofed and very cramped.  It is stuffed full of ancient clothing, unsalvagable armor, rotted backpacks, battered chests and many more things you cannot even identify.  Time, damp and vermin have taken their toll here.  Nothing in the form of serviceable plunder is apparent in this stuffy, closet-like anteroom.

title: [Under Barrow, Cavern]
description: A smallish cavern domes out above you, the packed earthern walls appear part natural and part artificial.  It is dimly lit by the same fungus that infests the entire area.  But there are sights here that would be better left in total darkness, piles of bones, heaps of rotting flesh, and things less recognizable, in diverse stages of decay.  The air is full of unseen comings and goings though you feel no earthly breeze.

title: [Under Barrow, Slimy Passage]
description: This part of the corridor is so steep that keeping your footing is a questionable concept.  You grab at the walls to forestall an impending stumble but immediately regret this instinctive action as your hands touch upon many small, wriggly things embedded in the slime coating the sweaty walls.  Down the slope, receding off into the murk, the corridor widens.

title: [Under Barrow, Sloping Passage]
description: This narrow, cramped passage slopes at a steep angle.  Years of accumulated muck makes the footing very treacherous.  As you proceed along it, you come to the disturbing conclusion that the tunnel seems to have been dug upwards from deep underground, by constant clawing and scraping, as though something were desperately trying to burrow its way out.

title: [Graveyard, Tunnel]
description: Stone gives way to dirt walls, shored up by several stripped treetrunks.  A short, crude stairway of fir timber leads up to a hole in the earth ceiling.

title: [Graveyard, Barrow Tunnel]
description: The tunnel curves against a solid wall of rock to the east and south, marked by numerous gouges and scratches that indicate failed attempts to dig further.  The air is damp and chill, and water condenses on the dark stone to drip into foul-smelling puddles on the dirt floor.

title: [Graveyard, Barrow Tunnel]
description: Foul water drips steadily from the ceiling, carrying the faint decaying smells of whatever has been buried in the dirt above.  The passage narrows to the west and opens to a wider area to the east, though the way is nearly blocked by a curtain of heavy spiderwebs that move faintly in the damp wafts of air that circulate through the tunnels.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: The dark earth sinks into a deep depression, providing slippery footing as you make your way among the collection of mummified flesh and bone that has fallen here, loosed from the soil by the movements of the earth and the passage of wandering visitors.  A sun-bleached skull grins up at the sky, still firmly attached to its body buried somewhere beneath the loam.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: A ridge of blackened earth surrounds the edge of the mound, home to patches of dry grasses and the remains of uncountable corpses that poke bones and bits of flesh through the dirt surface.  To the north, the desolate expanse of the graveyard stretches off into the distance.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: A weathered wooden grave-marker stands here, leaning to one side in the dark soil that shifts damply underfoot.  A ridge of black earth forms a boundary at the west end of the mound, blocking access to the dark bogs in the distance.

title: [Graveyard, Bog]
description: The ground is dark and springy, the damp peat concealing the high water table beneath.  Ominous vapors and swamp gases born of rotting vegetation and corpses bubble up through the muck.  Moving in lazy eddies just above the ruined gravesites, the fumes cause you to choke and gag.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Graveyard, Bog]
description: Intermittent pools of murky water smear a scummy film over the ground as seepage through the porous humus has made it a shifting, almost liquid mass.  The wet earth here cannot support the tombstones upright.  Tilted at odd angles, or fallen, the markers are now partially submerged or sunken in the mud.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Graveyard, Boggy Path]
description: The underbrush grows thickly on the drier spots of ground that protrude here and there above the dank mud of the bog.  Shadowy branches of ancient yew trees rise to the west, creaking and beckoning amidst the flickering lights and mist of the deep recesses of the swamp.

title: [Graveyard, Boggy Path]
description: The overgrown trail that winds through the scrawny trees to the east sinks deep into the bog here, barely forming patches of ground solid enough to walk on.  The darkness is deeper and the swamp gas thicker to the west, where thick patches of scrub and twisted yew trees stand amid pits of swirling muck and water.  Two somewhat drier paths wind along the edges of the bog to the northwest and southwest.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Wormwood Slough, Boggy Trail]
description: Black water seeps from the spongy ground to the south where the path dips.  Blighted trees provide little shade and no color, their limbs greyed by a layer of the same mud that covers everything in sight.  A bedraggled trio of carrion birds squabble over a rancid and unrecognizable meal.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Burial Pits]
description: Stinking mud seeps into the large rectangular depressions sunk here and there into the relatively dry ground of this rise.  Some of the filled pits to the south of the path bear markers, but no names grace the stones above the mass graves.  Those who lie beneath the markers were likely nameless even in life, and clearly none there are lamented now.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Burial Pits]
description: A dank mist rises from the depths of the bog, seeping along even the highest points of the creek bank to collect in the sunken patches of ground that mark age-old graves.  The high ground continues to the east, dropping off steeply into the effluvium of the slough, the precipitous path held together only by the glistening black roots of the ancient trees.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Burial Pits]
description: The foul air from the bog below forms ghostly tendrils of rank-smelling mist that swirl and eddy around the twisted trunks of the ancient yews.  The trees crowd the path, their blackened shapes guarding over several deep pits that look to have been dug up long ago and now lie half-overgrown and filled in with dirt and scrub.  A particularly large excavation lies just north of the path, its near side shaped into a ramp leading into its depth.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Excavated Pit]
description: The thick, mossy branches of the overhanging yews cast shifting shadows over the walls and floor of the excavation, and filtered light flickers on the ground where a few shallow puddles of dampness have seeped in from the bog.  The walls of the pit are riddled with gnarled roots and long-buried bones still imbedded in the earth, and matted with layers of dirt and moss that hint that the depression was dug at least a century ago.  The south wall forms a slope leading up to the path.

The walls of the pit are riddled with gnarled roots and long-buried bones still imbedded in the earth, and matted with layers of dirt and moss that hint that the depression was dug at least a century ago.  The south wall forms a slope leading up to the path.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Excavation]
description: The walls of the small vestibule are formed of solid slabs of granite, mottled in dark and light grey and a deep mossy green that almost matches the color of the creeping fingers of lichen that spread up from the dirt-covered stone floor on every side.  The north wall is a pile of rubble and broken stone, some age-old landslide having obscured whatever passage may lie beyond.  A large grey stone slab lies half-buried in the rubble, as if an attempt to unearth it had gone unfinished long ago.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Creek Bank]
description: The creek has eroded the rise which stretches to the east, undercutting the bank and casting itself in its shadow.  There seems to be no safe path to the water's edge from here, as only the roots of long-dead trees hold the overhanging earth together.  The trail dips to the southwest and allows a nearer approach to the creek.

title: [Graveyard, Bog]
description: Strangely carved tombstones with fiendish faces and creatures incised upon them bear epitaphs in long-forgotten scripts.  Mute testament to slain heroes and fallen villains, the unearthly silence is broken only by the eerie rustlings of the sirenflower plants growing among the gravesites.

title: [Graveyard, Bog]
description: Slogging through the mud, dampness envelopes your lower limbs.  Wet garments cling closer to your tense body, making movement ever more exhausting.  Your breath comes fitfully in short gasps as the methanous air burns your lungs.  Acrawl with countless imagined leeches, your skin tingles with fear and revulsion.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Slippery Path]
description: The ground is somewhat solid here, though covered with a layer of slippery muck that threatens your footing at every step.  A few ancient graves marked by corroded monuments are set along the path, their occupants untouched as yet by the ravages of the swamp.  A foul miasma of vapors and rot emanates from the mire to the west.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Trench]
description: The fetid odor of the mud that fills this furrow drives off even the gorcrows.  Gnarled tree roots reach through the low sloping sides of the trench and lie just beneath the surface of the muck, making every step a hazard for the unwary.  The few tombstones nearby are tilted at sharp angles and appear in some cases to have been pushed aslant from beneath.  To the west, tussocks of greying grass amidst the mud might provide more solid footing.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Creek Bank]
description: Rushes droop over the bank of the creek, their long leaves trailing in the dark water and occasionally dipping beneath it as something rises from the depths to pull at them.  The mosquitoes are lively and swarm around anything that promises a meal.  A solitary and startlingly green frog rests itself on a rock at the water's edge, clearly well-fed even though the mosquitoes seem hungry.  Paths to the southeast and northeast lead to higher ground and away from the fast-moving but silent stream.

The mosquitoes are lively and swarm around anything that promises a meal.  A solitary frog rests itself on a rock at the water's edge, clearly well-fed even though the mosquitoes seem hungry.  Paths to the southeast and northeast lead to higher ground and away from the fast-moving but silent stream.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Muddy Slope]
description: Many gravemarkers, some of stone and some of ancient broken wood, have been set into the higher ground here where the land slopes up out of the mire into a rise along the creek bank to the west.  A flicker of white in the mist draws attention to an ancient skull, dangling from a high branch of a moss-covered yew and swinging with an eternal haunting motion in the undulating currents of fog.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Mire]
description: The wartlike clumps of grass rising from the mire look solid, but the mud they conceal sucks at the feet of anything that moves, no matter how careful its tread.  As the only alternative is wading through the reeking water surrounding the tussocks, even the treacherous grass seems preferable.  Something moving beneath the water's oily surface sends up bubbles occasionally, though how anything thrives in water so choked with filth is a mystery.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Mire]
description: Higher ground to the north and south promises a respite from the sucking mud, but not from the stench of corruption that pervades the air.  Blighted trees provide little shade and less color, their limbs and leaves greyed with a coating of the same mud that fills the depression.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Wormwood Slough, Mire]
description: The dank water of the bog runs slowly to the west, collecting in an impassable mire that seethes and emits bubbles of fetid gases as it seeps into the black waters of the creek.  A few raised patches of dirt provide insecure footing and purchase for a variety of scrawny plants, and the blackened roots of the surrounding trees rise from the bog like spectral knees.

title: [Wormwood Slough, Mound]
description: The ground rises from the surrounding swampland in a mound here near the overgrown creek bank.  An ancient monument rises above the driest point of land, any names or inscriptions it once bore long since obliterated by time and fetid air.

title: [Graveyard, Bog]
description: The overflow from the dammed creek floods this low-lying part of the graveyard, spilling over the banks and creating a sea of muck and ruins.  The graves here are all despoiled, the ornate coffins and their inhabitants long since victims to mouldering, watery decay and determined grave robbers.  A few rotted splinters of wood, corroded iron and brass fittings, and darkened shards of bone have been pushed to the surface of the bog.

title: [Graveyard, Natural Dam]
description: A pile of uprooted trees lying across the creek creates this natural dam that holds back the scummy green waters.  The waters contain the slimy remains of putrifying vegetation and carcasses.  A dragonfly skims the surface, causing concentric ripples to radiate out from its landing spot.  Looking down, you see the dry remnants of the creek bed.

title: [Graveyard, Creek Bed]
description: A shallow puddle surrounded by a darker ring of sand punctuates the otherwise dry powdery surface of the old creek bed.  Water seeps in a slow trickle between the mud-wattled logs that form the natural dam here.  The logs have fallen in a staggered pattern, acting as the only scalable way out of the gulch.

title: [Graveyard, Creek Bed]
description: The fine, white sand and rounded pebbles on the floor of the dry creek bed make walking difficult but the dense thickets of the spinewood trees and traesharm shrubs along the banks make the former watercourse the best route.  Better to struggle through the sand than to get lost in the trackless wilds that can hide all manner of unpleasant surprises.

title: [Graveyard, Creek Bed]
description: The creek bed tapers off here into an indistinguishable part of the landscape, its banks having crumbled and collapsed into mild slopes leading up out of the ravine.  Scrubby trees encroach upon the sandy floor of the gulch, and all hope of safe onward travel is ruled out by a series of vague and dubious tracks through the undergrowth.

title: [Mild Slope]
description: Tall evergreens line the slope, roots digging deeply into the fertile soil.  Thick shrubs line the ground, making walking difficult as you pick your way down the small trail through the plant life.  From nearby you can hear the trickle of running water, and can smell the moisture in the heavy air.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The woods end at a marshy creek.  Cattails line the gently sloping banks, moving with the flow of the water, although an occasional rustle and splash from the plants lead you to believe there may be something more than water there.  Given the gentle slope of the ground, it looks like you could enter the creek anywhere along the bank.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: Strange thin tracks mark the soil here, giving you an idea of how the creek got its name.  The banks slope down into the creek, making accessing the water easy, although the vague shapes you catch moving through the cattails make you wonder if you want to.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The nest of a marsh bird is nestled in the water plants, and several mottled eggs rest in the bowl of sticks and mud.  A thin track leads to the nest, and a slightly fatter track leads away from the nest, each long and squiggled.  Apparently, a snake found the bird's eggs to be a much-desired delicacy, as the creek is easily accessible from the bank.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: A breeze moves through the area, rippling the surface of the creek.  You can hear it whisper through the forest in the distance, and it seems the trees may be trying to tell you something, if only you could understand what.  The bank slopes easily into the creek, providing you with an easy way to the water.

title: [Slither Creek, Stone Bank]
description: The soft soil turns rocky here.  Further travel to the northeast is impossible over the uncertain ground, but it seems the creek can still be reached safely enough.  The soft hissing of scales against stone makes you uneasy, and you glance at the ground, attempting to locate the source of the sound.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: Several bushes covered with berries cling to the bank of the creek.  The berries are plump and dark, and very tempting, but as you reach for some you notice the corpse of a small animal beneath the bush.  Several half-eaten berries sit near the body, and you wonder if eating anything from these bushes would be a good idea.  The bank seems solid enough for you to walk into the creek without difficulty.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The banks of the creek are softer here than to the east, although access to the creek is still possible.  To the west, the ground seems more damp, and a humming sound can be heard from that direction.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The air is filled with gnats.  They have swarmed in an immense cloud just off the creek, filling the air with an unpleasant hum.  You wave your hands about your head in an effort to keep stray insects off your face, but it seems to do very little good.  There is plenty of room around the gnats to continue to the west, and you could still make it into the creek around the black mass.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: The ground here is quite sodden, making walking unpleasant, and your feet make squishing noises each time you take a step.  It is likely that your feet would get less wet walking in the creek, and strolling through the creek might be less messy than slogging through the mud.  A hum can be heard from the east, the sound sending a shiver down the back of your neck.

title: [Slither Creek, South Bank]
description: Just downstream, the creek empties into a small lake.  Cattails grow at the edge of the water, waving in a slight breeze, and jewel-hued dragonflies dart about the pool.  Although the banks are marshy, they look stable enough to support you, giving you safe access to the creek.

Just downstream, the creek empties into a small lake.  Cattails grow at the edge of the water, waving in a slight breeze, and you hear insects darting about the pool.  Although the banks are marshy, they look stable enough to support you, giving you safe access to the creek.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The creek widens into a small lake.  Dragonflies dart about, filling the air with color, while other, less pleasant insects buzz about the cattails lining the bank.  Something brushes against your leg, causing you to start, and you desperately hope it's a fish.  The bank seems stable enough for you to climb to dry land.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The creek overflows its banks slightly, making the banks sodden, but not impossible to climb.  Beneath your feet, bright green slime covers the bottom, easily seen in the shallow water.  From the east a slight hum reaches your ears, unpleasantly familiar.

The creek overflows its banks slightly, making the banks sodden, but not impossible to climb.  Beneath your feet, green slime covers the bottom, easily seen in the shallow water.  From the east a slight hum reaches your ears, unpleasantly familiar.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A black swarm of gnats hovers over the bank a few feet away.  Stray insects fill the air, buzzing too near your face for comfort.  The ground beneath your feet is slick, covered in slippery green slime, and the movement of the water makes standing precarious.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The creek is flowing rapidly here, digging away at the banks and making them soft and muddy, although sturdy enough to walk on.  A patch of water grass clings to the side, seeming to hold on with all its strength, and a few small fish nibble at the leaves.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A few dead fish float here, trapped in the dangling branches of a berry bush on the bank.  The smell is noxious, and you briefly wonder what killed the fish only in this area of the creek.  The dirt and rocks beneath your feet are very slick, and you don't care to think about what you may be stepping on.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A stand of cattails lines the bank, waving in the current.  Rustling sounds come from the plants, making you very uneasy, and your feet keep slipping on the slime clinging to the bottom of the creek.  Beyond the cattails you can see tall trees, very near the edge, and it looks like getting to the bank would not be a problem from here.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A long, thin shape weaves through the forest of cattails on the bank.  The plants continue off in both directions, leaning with the current, and although it is difficult to get to the bank, it is certainly not impossible.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: A mass of mud and sticks can be seen through the thick plants growing along the bank.  On closer inspection the mass becomes the nest of a water bird, nestled in the grasses and cattails.  Four mottled eggs rest in the bowl, although looking at the placement, one egg may be missing.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The soil beneath your feet is rockier here than to the southwest.  The slime clinging to the rocks and the creek bank complicates walking, causing the occasional slip and curse.  Above the babble of the water and your own clumsy splashing you can hear the whisper of wind through trees, speaking in a language you do not understand.

title: [Slither Creek]
description: The water tumbles over dirt-coated stone.  Your way to the northeast is blocked by a large shale slab, too big to step over and not stable enough to climb, although the bank is easy enough to reach from here.  The creek flows out from beneath the slab, talking happily to itself as it wanders to the southwest.

title: [Graveyard, Crypt]
description: The room is nearly dark, barely illuminated by the iridescent mosaic strips in the granite wall.  You sense that things of greater interest and danger lie off in other directions.  A few stray pieces of metal, of unknown purpose, glint in the pale light.

title: [Graveyard, Anteroom]
description: This stone chamber is elaborately decorated and furnished.  One wall contains a doorway leading north and another is covered with rich embroideries and gilt-framed paintings.  In one corner is a statue formed from various precious minerals and metals.  You notice the same thin bands of ahnver embedded along the walls, shedding enough light for you to realize that fabulous treasures once must have filled this room to the rafters.  A long stone ramp leads down, its destination cloaked in darkness.

title: [Graveyard, Under Crypt]
description: A long stone ramp angles up from this room.  You carefully make your way along the slick, granite floor.  Muck, slime and condensation make the walls a perfect haven for the glowing lichen that lights the route.

title: [Graveyard, Under Crypt]
description: A bewildering series of tunnels through the rock greets you.  While not shaped by clever craftsmen, the channels do not appear natural.  Trails of slime coat the ground and lead off in several directions.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Graveyard, Tunnel]
description: The granite-walled tunnel here is in a state of disrepair, although it appears never to have been very well planned or constructed to begin with.  A low stone corridor leads off to the north, while a confusing jumble of channels are cut into the ground as you look south.

title: [Graveyard, Under Crypt]
description: A bewildering series of tunnels through the rock greets you.  While not shaped by clever craftsmen, the channels do not appear natural.  Trails of slime coat the ground and lead off in several directions.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, up

title: [Graveyard, Tunnel]
description: Plain granite walls form this tunnel, unadorned and poorly finished.  The rough surface is now home to fluorescent mosses, which give off a faint, pale glow and are nourished by the water seeping through the dark joints in the stone.

title: [Graveyard, Tunnel]
description: The hurried construction of the tunnel is apparent here, and the level of the slipperly stone walkway changes unevenly and suddenly.  The stone blocks in the walls and floor are fitted together carelessly, allowing water and the roots of trees to enter.

The hurried construction of the tunnel is apparent here, and the level of the slippery stone walkway changes unevenly and suddenly.  The stone blocks in the walls and floor are fitted together carelessly, allowing water and the roots of trees to enter.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: The remains here consist of the dead bodies of a few small burrowing creatures and little else of apparent value.  Broken chests, torn hogsheads and gunny sacks, stiff goatskins filled with sour ale, some worm-eaten leatherbound books, and other everyday items that have long outlived their usefulness have been left behind here to rot.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: Your eyes adjust to the semi-darkness as a pale shaft of light filters through the tiny natural chimney in the domed roof of the curved chamber.  You see no signs of life yet low, unearthly murmurings, vague rustlings and flickers of faint lights swirl about you.  The only reality you are sure of is the dull thud of your footsteps on the earthern floor, echoing off the packed dirt walls.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: This is the burial chamber of a great warrior-king.  There are empty chests made of precious woods, now mildewed and rotten with fittings of beaten gold and silver.  Rusted weapons are scattered about.  A wooden coffin, carved in the shape of a proud warship with a dragon prow, lies at the far side of the circular room.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: The room is triangular, the "prow" of the shiplike structure.  On the dirt walls are faded remains of strange murals.  The line drawings all have an oppressive and ominous sameness about them, even though they depict different scenes.  You approach one wall to get a closer look, stooping down as the elevation of the roof drops sharply.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: Here the concave dirt walls have partially collasped.  Under the rubble, you see a half-buried corpse, one bony hand still holding a chipped mein dagger in a vise-like deathgrip.  You ponder what prizes may lie beneath the debris along with the unfortunate soul but the fresh earth atop the rubble pile makes you wary of lingering here too long.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: This small dirt annex houses crudely fashioned wooden furniture of a very functional kind.  One striking exception is a tall chair, which appears to have served as an impromptu throne on the field of battle or in the relative safety of troop encampments.  Though the chair is scarred with sword cuts and arrow holes, it is still a remarkable piece of work.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: There is a biting cold in the air that causes you to stamp your feet to try and stay warm as you survey this narrow tunnel.  The walls are rough, and the dirt is a bit moist, which leads you to believe that the tunnel itself was recently dug, apart from the rest of the crypt.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: The tunnel continues, seemingly without end, in both directions.  Shadows play off the rough rock walls, causing your eyes to dart about looking for enemies that may or may not be there.

wayto.7312: ;e if (bounty? =~ /^You have made contact with the child/); child = GameObj.npcs.find { |npc| npc.noun == 'child' }; else; child = nil; end; move 'southwest'; if Room.current == Room[7313]; 50.times { break if GameObj.npcs.any? { |npc| npc.id == child.id }; sleep 0.1 } if child; move 'southwest'; end
wayto.22426: ;e if (bounty? =~ /^You have made contact with the child/); child = GameObj.npcs.find { |npc| npc.noun == 'child' }; else; child = nil; end; move 'northeast'; if Room.current == Room[7313]; 50.times { break if GameObj.npcs.any? { |npc| npc.id == child.id }; sleep 0.1 } if child; move 'northeast'; end

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: Chilly air wafts toward you from the southwest carrying with it a cloying smell that makes you gag.  Peering in that direction you can see no visible end to the confined passage that you are in now.  Off to the east, the tunnel seems to widen a bit and you can almost make out a larger passage, or perhaps a small chamber.

title: [Underground Chamber]
description: This underground chamber seems to be naturally formed, perhaps from some tectonic movement or similar seismic activity.  The tunnel leading away however is obviously recently dug and, it appears, somewhat hastily done.  The layout of this place is rounded, with a concave floor in the middle.

title: [Dark Crevice]
description: Darkness prevents a clear survey of this small niche, but you feel a space above your head.  The floor begins a steep incline rising up into the rock and a narrow fissure, possibly wide enough to squeeze through, is barely visible along the wall.  You feel a cool dampness around your ankles.

title: [Dark Crevice]
description: The rough path continues up the steep terrain.  Step after step, you feel your legs growing hot as you strain to keep a sure footing.  A pressure in your ears lets you know you have climbed quite a distance.

title: [Dark Crevice]
description: You strain to keep clear of the rough outcroppings of rock in this dark space.  The floor continues its steep incline causing you to lean severely to remain upright.  In the dim light, you can just make out a trail of flowing mist moving slowly downward from a small opening above.

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: The walls open wide and high forming a small valley forgotten by the waking world.  Covering the entire range is a low layer of thick white mist, lending the land an eerie glow.  Near the base of the wall, you see a crevice leading down into darkness.

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: Steep rocky walls rise high above, squelching any thoughts of climbing out.  A cold biting wind blows across your face, stinging your eyes and lips.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: Dead trees reach out of the mist towards the sky, seeking to grasp some remnant of hope.  A few large black rocks break the surface of the chalky vapors, marking the surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: The lack of color throughout the valley creates an odd feeling of unreality within you, as if you were reliving a long forgotten memory.  Sharp grey stones mark the ground in the few spots where the mist thins.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: A sea of grey clouds fills the sky above.  From somewhere in the distance, the sound of pounding hooves echoes across the valley.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: A rough granite gravestone stands against the west wall of the valley.  The torn and broken ground beneath the marker leads you to believe that whatever was buried here chose to leave.  Strangely, the thick mists circle the area, carefully avoiding the gravesite.

title: [Shadow Valley]
description: A thousand tiny particles of shattered wood cover a mottled clay ramp which descends into the ground before you.  Torn and broken earth indicates that the opening may have been caused by an explosive force.  Strangely, odd black mists twist and flow around the entryway, as if trying to conceal it.

title: [Shadow Valley]
description: A sea of grey clouds fills the sky above.  Coming from all around you, the sound of pounding hooves echoes across the valley.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Shadow Valley]
description: Dead trees reach out of the mist towards the sky, seeking to grasp some remnant of hope.  A few large white rocks break the surface of the charcoal vapors, marking the surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Shadow Valley]
description: The walls open wide and high forming a small valley forgotten by the waking world.  Covering the entire range is a low layer of thick black mist, lending the land an eerie demeanor.  Near the base of the wall, you see a crevice leading down into darkness.

title: [Shadow Valley]
description: Steep rocky walls rise high above, squelching any thoughts of climbing out.  A cold biting wind blows across your face, stinging your eyes and lips.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Shadow Valley]
description: The lack of color throughout the valley creates an odd feeling of unreality within you, as if you were reliving a long forgotten memory.  Sharp grey stones mark the ground in the few spots where the black mist thins.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [A Dark Crevice]
description: You are perched on the ledge of a dangerously steep crevice which juts out from the wall hanging over a dark abyss.  The odd mists within it glow with an ethereal light as they lash about in their chaotic dance.  From above, the sound of thundering hooves reverberate throughout the chasm, seemingly vanishing into the bottomless pit below.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Drab grey clouds twist overhead in muted anguish, casting writhing shadows over this secluded pasture.  The pasture spreads out dully to the southeast, broken only by the occasional misshapen tree or rotted trunk.  An ancient trail, overgrown from countless years of disuse, weaves its way from the rising valley walls into the desolation.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: All around you, the pasture is in various states of decay, with a few spots where a thorny undergrowth has strangled out a life for itself.  Imbued with the stench of rotting earth, the air hangs like a noose about your neck.  Choking for air, you continue on your way, moving as far away from the smell as you can.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Studying the ground carefully, you can see that this pasture was once grazed by a group of large horses.  The sound of thundering hooves bounces off the valley walls behind you, but as you turn to locate the source, the sound stops.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: A dull mist hangs low to the ground, obscuring whatever features this pasture had.  Above you dull grey clouds float in a lazy mimic of the mist at your feet.  A lone twisted tree rises up from the mist, in muted defiance of the desolation around it.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Little is left of what once was a lush green pasture.  Barren and devoid of life, only a few rotted stumps scattered across the pasture remain to prove that life once thrived here.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Dry brittle grass clumps remain as little islands amidst this sea of desolation.  Dried flowers, their seeds wasted on the barren ground, lie long forgotten by the passage of time.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Some ancient horse tracks have become barren patches of dry earth between the small clumps of yellowed longgrass.  A few starched-white bones stick up at odd angles here and there, like the shattered ribs of the pasture itself.

title: [Dark Pasture, Black Stream]
description: No longer able to contain the dark murk, the surrounding ground has crumbled into the streambed.  A noxious odor rises from the putrid black sludge, stifling your senses.  Choking back the urge to flee, you continue on your way.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: The bones of a mighty steed tell a grim tale of unsuccessful flight from danger.  The steed's skeleton looks to be laid out in full stride, struck down by some fell blow to the skull.  Some longgrass has sprouted up through the bones, a yellowish-green reminder of the life that once flourished here.

title: [Dark Pasture, Black Stream]
description: The black murk has infiltrated the surrounding ground covering everything in the area with slime.  A few bubbles pop to the surface of the sludge only to shatter and spray you with goo.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Rotted through, this area is a twisted dark image of the once beautiful pasture that thrived here.  The few spots that aren't decaying are overgrown by a thorny underbrush.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: The dull, grey sky contrasts with the dark deterioration of the pasture around you.  The trail meanders through the ruined pasture, bending to avoid the encroaching decay.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Dark Pasture, Black Stream]
description: Silence rings heavily in your ears, as even the thorny tangles evident elsewhere avoid this area.  Protruding from the black sludge, masquerading as a stream, are the remnants of a wooden footbridge.  The stream bank dips down here, scooping up a trail that begins where the footbridge was swallowed by the murk.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Sloping down to the edge of a stream bank, the trail ends abruptly at a rotten wooden footbridge.  The footbridge once provided passage over the large stream, but now has rotted to the point of being unusable.  The water has dried up on this side, but near the other bank, a black sludgy liquid moves languidly to the east.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: The vacant eye sockets of a horse skull bear silent witness to the desolation of the pasture.  Oddly enough, a small patch of green longgrass has sprouted up behind the skull.

title: [Dark Pasture, Black Stream]
description: Walking down the bank into the stream bed, you notice that it's not as dry as you thought.  Instead of water, a black viscous liquid oozes slowly beneath your feet, a ghastly echo of the water that once ran here.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: The trail dies out here, swallowed by the desolation surrounding it.  Parched and cracked, the ground crumbles beneath your feet as you walk through.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: The windswept plains stretch as far as you can see to the south.  You can see dust swirls blowing across the flats.  Far in the distance to the southeast, you can make out some dark hills.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A muddy wallow covers most of the side of a small slope.  The deep muck is difficult to move through, making sucking noises as you labor on.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A single boulder sits by itself in the middle of a dusty field, blasted smooth by the fierce winds on the plain.  One side of the boulder is blackened with soot while the other side looks to have been smashed and shattered, spreading rubble and dust everywhere.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Several skeletons lie awkwardly on the ground, with some bones trampled into dusty fragments.  A very faint trail of hoofprints leads from the flats of the plain towards some rolling black hills to the southeast.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: This desolate land seems populated by almost nothing except a few fallen petrified trees and blowing dust.  To the southeast you see the base of a group of desolate dark hills.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: The remains of a small hovel sit at the base of the black hills.  The hovel, charred black, is nothing more than ashes and cold embers now.

title: [Shadow Plain, Black Hills]
description: Barren black hills undulate across the horizon for as far as you can see.  A high velocity wind whips up from a precipice to the east and across the hills, causing dust storms to batter the area.

title: [Shadow Plain, Black Hills]
description: The wind blows so hard across the hills that you have to lean into it.  Several dust storms swirl around, throwing black dirt in every direction.  As far as you can see, only the desolate, black hills break up the monotonous horizon.

title: [Shadow Plain, Black Hills]
description: This small clearing provides a short respite from the constant duststorms.  You can see faint lines on the slopes of a stream where water may have once ran.  Petrified remains of once mighty trees lay broken around the landscape.

title: [Shadow Plain, Black Hills]
description: From atop one of the tallest hill in the area, you can see the remnants of a building far to the west.  The wind howls mournfully as it blows across the rise.

title: [Shadow Plain, Black Hills]
description: The landscape transitions from low rising hills to a featureless flat plain.  Broken pieces of rock, the remnants of petrified trees, seem to be the only thing to slow down the wind and dark dust as it blows.

title: [Shadow Plain, Black Hills]
description: Hoofprints are the only mark on this particular hill.  The wind blows across the summit of the hill, kicking the dust over the edge and then up into the sky in the shape of a flowing horsetail.

title: [Shadow Plain, Black Hills]
description: The low rolling hills are constantly battered by fierce winds.  Black dust kicked up by the wind swirls through the area.  In the distance, you see crumbled walls from a collapsed building.  The walls lean precariously into the wind.

title: [Shadow Plain, Black Hills]
description: The mostly featureless flat ground slopes upwards towards the north rising to a series of dark, low hills.  Wind whips up the slope, kicking the black dirt up into fierce dust storms that rage across the plains.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Broken limbs from ancient trees litter the ground.  The wind blows by shaking the dark tumbleweed stuck in the tree branches.  A slimy black sludge cakes the remaining trees.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: The parched earth begs the dull, grey skies overhead for some long sought after relief.  A few patches of yellowed longgrass cling to the hardscrabble ground, but most living things have left this area in search of a more hospitable climate.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Ominous dark clouds travel swiftly across the horizon filling you with a sense of dread.  Twisted tumbleweed roll across the dusty ground pushed by a strong biting wind.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A rotting stench wafts up from the dark surface of a decaying pond surrounded by dead pastureland.  Piles of large bleached bones dot the landscape, causing you to wonder what may have happened here.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Long, twisting shadows drape over the barren and desolate ground, dancing a slow ballet of death as some clouds move languidly overhead.  The shadows stretch to the horizon joining the dark clouds as they lurch out of sight.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A chilly grey mist swirls through a stand of long dead fels casting ghostly shadows upon the ground.  The damp mist turns the ground underfoot into thick black mud, making travel more difficult.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Dark desolation envelops you in this particularly dead section of the plains.  Chilled to the bone by the sheer emptiness of the plain, you forge on.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A shallow ravine cuts through the dying pasture making travel slightly treacherous.  Several large boulders and dead tree stumps litter the ground in an oddly shaped pattern.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Low stone walls, battered smooth by blowing winds, cling to the ground.  Shattered rock from the fractures in the wall lies strewn about on the barren ground.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: A wall of earth blocking passageway to the south slopes roughly to the northeast.  A few starched-white bones stick out from where the wall and the ground adjoin.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Deep cracks spread over the barren earth like skeletal fingers choking the life out of the pasture.  Rust colored stains flow along the broken web of cracks.  The dark stains lay a quiet, persistent siege to what little life remains.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Like a wounded beast bleeding, a strange red mist oozes from the ground.  The stench is awful and you are forced to choke back your last meal.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: A sheer wall rising twenty feet above you blocks your way.  Obviously the product of some cataclysmic event long past, the wall and the ground near it are laced with cracks and fissures.  The countless years since have produced a fine black sand where the wall and the ground grind into each other.

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: A wall of earth rises up in front of you blocking further passage south.  The wall almost looks as if it rose up of its own volition, dead roots still poking out from the dried earth.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Decaying barren trees sit atop a small windswept hill like hideous skeletons swaying in the breeze.  Eerie shadows dance across the hard rocky ground casting misshapen figures all around you.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A cold wind whistles through the crumbled walls of an ancient shrine.  Rising from the ruins is a magnificent silver statue of a large equine surrounded by a pool of dark murky water.  Several twisted skeletons litter the ground around the area.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: The dried out and barren remains of this once beautiful plain are peppered by small mounds of black sand.  Dark clouds overhead cast haunting shadows that ooze over the barren ground.  Stretched out to the southeast lie long stretches of shattered and dead land.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A putrid greenish-yellow spring oozes from a jagged outcropping, forming a small puddle on the ground.  The overwhelming stench of rotted flesh rises up from the puddle, filling the air with a sickly sweet odor.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Mist and dust intermingle with the blowing breeze to form a sludge that sticks to everything it touches.  The sludge seeps into your skin making you long for fresh water in which to bathe.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Ominous black clouds gather overhead, casting an imposing gloom that seeps into your soul.  Mounds of splintered bones protrude from the dying brown longgrass.  Atop one mound rests a large misshapen equine skull.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Tree trunks are gathered in an odd pile on the ground.  Part of a skeletal arm and hand stick out from under the trunks.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: Smooth black sand swallows the few remaining patches of longgrass.  The sand is flecked grey with small bits of bone that have been trampled into a fine grit.  In the distance, dark barren hills shrouded in mist spring from the gloom.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A decaying fel tree has smashed into the remains of a large rotting barn surrounded by a few smaller buildings.  A cold biting wind blows by, chilling you to the bone.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: A narrow ravine leads off to the southeast, providing a brief windbreak.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: This ravine ends abruptly at a makeshift wall of tree trunks, dirt, and rocks.  The wind blows into the ravine and swirls around viciously, kicking up rocks and dust.

title: [Shadow Plain]
description: The trail leads down into a narrow ravine blocked by a huge pile of rocks and dirt.  The wind whistles as it blows around and through the gully.

title: [Mine Shaft]
description: A long dark mine shaft extends on a slight incline heading downward to the west and upward to the east.  This area of the shaft is wider than the rest and has been cleared of debris.  Just above you, the surface of the ceiling is strangely flat as if it were not natural.

title: [Mine Shaft]
description: Climbing steadily upward to the east, you note small pockets in the walls from failed mining attempts.  You can almost hear the distant sounds of miners swinging their picks hard against earth and stone.

title: [Mine Shaft]
description: Something about this part of the shaft sends a chill down your spine.  Warily looking about the area, you find the source of the uneasiness.  Embedded into the walls are the skeletal remains of several unfortunate former humanoids.  From this vantage point you cannot quite make out their race.

title: [Mine Shaft]
description: Faint echoes of a strange singsong chant enter your mind without the courtesy of using your ears.  Disturbed, you can find no visible source of the uninvited memories.  The walls seem to grow closer as the tunnel continues upward to the east.

title: [Mine Shaft]
description: The shaft comes to an abrupt end as the ceiling begins to slope rapidly downward to meet the floor.  The wall juts sharply underneath itself and you can see the ground reaching far underneath it.
