title: [Mine Shaft]
description: Dark shadows line the underside of the sharp stone outcroppings extending from the north wall.  The air tastes stale and musty as if this same air has been here for hundreds of years.

title: [Mine Shaft]
description: The floors of the tunnel are covered with dirt and debris from the heavily mottled walls.  You notice a slight incline as the shaft extends to the east.

title: [Mine Shaft]
description: Impenetrable stone walls mark the end of this long musty shaft.  On the ground, shattered remains of broken mining picks lead you to believe that the sudden outcropping of hard rock was not well received.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Rubble and dirt cover the ground at this junction of tunnels, marking the site with the telltale signs of a cave-in.  The low ceiling makes you nervous and causes you to involuntarily stoop beneath it.  Westward, the paths dip as they progress deeper underground.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Darkness prevails as the tunnel winds deeper into the ground to the west.  A fair incline to the northeast is curiously marked with small clods of dirt and clay.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Loose clumps of dirt and clay cover the area, increasing in number to the southeast.  The air is cold and dry with a musty unpleasant taste.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: A noticeable incline in the tunnel's direction makes travel eastward rougher on your legs.  The ground is striped with black marks as if something was dragged through here, down into the tunnels below.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Little clods of dirt and clay are scattered about the ground before you.  Though certainly not unusual to find within a mine of dirt and clay, their presence seems almost intentional despite the lack of any apparent use for them.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Strange sounds make their way to your ears from the southwest, nothing quite distinct enough to make out.  The ground feels soft underfoot, making you take greater care with your steps.

title: [Tunnel Chamber]
description: Three tunnels have met to form a large chamber within the mine.  Every sound you make echoes down the tunnels, and returns to your ears seconds later as a faint unrecognizable jumble of voices and sound.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Smooth streaks of discolored clay paint the walls of the tunnel as it turns northward.  A slight increase in the airflow through the tunnel is noticeable.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: A cool chill permeates the tunnel, feeling as if you just walked into the midst of a ghostly presence.  Faint, unidentified echoes and strange sounds enhance the uneasy feeling here.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: The walls are definitely closing in on you.  Dust and dirt fill the air causing your breathing to become labored and your eyes to squint.  The tunnels leading south and northeast seem much more survivable.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: A definite crunch can be heard and felt beneath your footsteps.  Too dark to see the ground, you hope the source of the noise to be pebbles and not something small and crawly.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Light is definitely in short supply within these twisting tunnels.  Nowhere can you find even the remnants of a lantern or torch.  You wonder if the former miners had some unnatural source of light to work by.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Solid oak support beams mark this junction point.  They stand out from the drab dirt scenery like arches of gold, restoring some of your confidence in the ceiling above.  Along the ground you see several strange indentions in a criss-cross pattern.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: A steady dripping sound intrudes on the dead silence of the tunnels.  Despite a careful inspection, you cannot find the source of the drip.  The air tastes stale and dry regardless of the audible signs of moisture.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Broken pieces of mining equipment lie scattered about the tunnel.  One large mining pick juts out from the wall next to a chalky-white outline.  The pick is the only unbroken piece of equipment in the area.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Crawling up from the floor, a chalky-white human-shaped outline stretches over part of the floor and part of the wall.  A mining shovel is imbedded into the wall around the neck area of the outline.  A roundish splotch of the chalky-white substance lies a few feet away from the outline on the floor.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Narrowing to almost single-file width, the tunnel bends slightly from the east to the southwest.  As you walk through you become covered with a chalky-white paste that coats the walls here.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: The tunnel bends and narrows to the point where you have to squeeze by sideways.  Working your way through to where the tunnel widens, you notice that your hands are covered by the chalky-white paste that covers everything here.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: A violent upheaval has left this part of the tunnel partially collapsed.  You are forced to pick your way carefully through the rubble to continue.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Much of what was the ceiling now blocks the passageway, having caved in some time ago.  What few wooden beams remain above you support the cracks and fissures as much as they support what's left of the ceiling.

title: [Mine Tunnels, Intersection]
description: Massive wooden beams support the tunnel at this large open intersection.  A warmly pulsating moss grows on the beams providing a soft light to the area.  Tracks lead off to the north, and you can see that the tunnel has partially collapsed to the east.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: The walls are splotched with strange glowing moss, shading the tunnel in ethereal blue.  Scratch marks around some of the moss hint that someone may have tried to carve something into the wall.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Odd blotches of glowing silvery grey moss cover the tunnel walls.  Some of the blotches have been marked or scraped, as if someone once tried to draw or carve some sort of message on the wall, though nothing of it is still recognizable.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Thick glowing green moss covers the walls of this mine.  The soft glow lends an eerie feel as the tunnel begins to ramp downward steeply towards the northwest.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Glowing green symbols formed out of luminescent moss blanket the walls.  Curiously most of the symbols seem to follow a pattern, carefully spiraling to a single point near the bottom of the north wall.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: The walls are covered with silvery glowing moss, each patch shaped into a strange symbol.  The absence of glowing moss along the ground is almost as distracting, as the effect of glow above and black dirt below feels odd, as if there were no ground to stand on here.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Swirling blue symbols formed of luminescent moss mark the walls.  Though none are of any symbol set you can recognize, the largest is quite obviously a dragon.  Several spheroid-shaped patches of moss surround it, causing the entire wall to be reminiscent of a star-covered night sky.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Dark mud covers the ground making each step more difficult in maintaining your balance.  The mud carries a rather putrid scent which you wish you hadn't bothered to breathe in.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Dust, dirt, and mud... the tunnel grows more and more monotonous with every step.  The only saving grace of this unremarkable tunnel is that it continues both north and south.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: The walls are mottled with little holes, probably from the random pickings of miners searching for silver metal.  No sign of the mineral still exists that you can see.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Subtle echoes reflect off the north wall, creating an illusion of a space or hollow somewhere just behind it.  You note the oily marks which must have been made by the hands of those probing these walls, searching for the odd sound's origin.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Scattered clumps of clay and mud cover the southern end of the tunnel.  A few of the clumps have been trampled and squished by something, though there is not enough detail to determine the identity of the squisher.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Deep indentions in the ground are prominent, most forming the twisted shapes of bodies.  Though the base of the room is quite large and round, its walls taper inward as they rise.  High above, you can just make out the faint light from the opening of another tunnel which is quite hopelessly out of reach.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: A patch of black roots hangs low from the ceiling above.  The walls of soft clay jut out into your path, making travel through this section of tunnel somewhat uncomfortable.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: A large stone table rests silently in the far corner, very much out of place within this small tunnel.  The lack of any other distinguishing features to this prison of mud and clay would almost make the table a welcome sight, if it were not for general feeling of unease that seems to permeate the area.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Black mud cakes have been piled along the base of the walls.  Resembling nothing you'd expect to find in a silver mine, they serve only to promote a sense of puzzlement about the former workers of this mine.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: The tunnel turns sharply to the east despite the mole-inviting soft clay walls along the west side.  Small grey pebbles on the ground beneath your feet help to accent the sound of your footsteps.

title: [Mine Tunnels]
description: Greyish-white marks blanket the walls here.  Though there is no distinguishable pattern, the markings are reminiscent of bones.  You get an eerie feeling that this tunnel has dug its way into an old boneyard, long buried by time.

title: [Repository, Permit Office]
description: A plain oak desk stained a dark hue resides in the eastern alcove of the room, topped with neatly stacked piles of papers and work orders.  Across the room, a few benches are set apart by miniature, manicured fig topiaries, while pale grey-blue granite extends to the north.

title: [The Broken Lands, Cavern]
description: The ceiling and floor of this small cavern are dotted with stalactites and stalagmites of various sizes.  Near one wall of the cavern, a particularly large stalactite dips down from the ceiling of the cavern, almost touching the tip of a matching stalagmite that rises from the cavern floor.

description: Huge boulders and jagged rocks are the predominant features on the vast plain that stretches out to the east.  The high, sheer cliff which looms above you to the west and southwest is clean and straight, as if cut with some gargantuan knife.  The cliff face is featureless, except for a small, jagged opening at the base of the cliff.

title: [Jagged Plains, High Ledge]
description: Perched here, high above the quietude of the rock and boulder strewn expanse of the jagged plains below, the stillness holds an almost palpable tension.  The strained feeling of expectancy has you poised and alert, and you cannot escape the feeling that someone, or something, is watching you.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: The tunnel is small and cramped.  It is wider than it is tall, and the floor, walls and ceiling are fairly smooth.  Patches of lichen dotting the area give off an eerie, dim light that casts a green hue over everything.  A subdued, slightly bitter odor nags at your senses.  Though not strong, it is pervasive and seems to irritate your eyes.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: The tunnel twists and turns, undulating through the surrounding rock.  The floor, walls and low ceiling are irregular but smooth, as if something had passed this way many times to wear away any jagged edges.  The dim green light given off by patches of glowing lichen shrouds the tunnel in odd shadows that dance and waver before your eyes.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: A peculiar smell permeates the area, irritating your nose and eyes.  The odor is not strong and has no discernible source, but it leaves a bitter, foul taste in the back of your mouth.  The reek only adds to the general feeling of discomfort in the narrow confines of the tunnel.

title: [Dark Grotto, Cavern]
description: A single huge stalactite descends from the ceiling at the center of this small cavern.  The uneven walls of the cavern have been worn smooth, as have the walls of the small tunnels leading into the cavern.  Every minute or so, the intense quiet of the cavern is shattered by the sound of a single drop of water, falling from the tip of the stalactite into a small pool that has collected in a depression at the center of the cavern.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: The irregular walls of the tunnel have been worn smooth, as if they had been polished with abrasive cloths.  There are no jagged edges, no scratches or other marks in the stone, no signs that the tunnel is anything but a natural formation.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: The tunnel meanders through the surrounding stone, twisting and turning, rising and falling with no particular regularity or pattern.  The stone surface is irregular, but the tunnel maintains the same general size and shape as it continues along.  The dim, green illumination, provided by patches of glowing lichen that dot the walls, makes visibility poor and you find yourself squinting at the dark features of the tunnel walls.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: The tunnel branches in three directions here.  The air is still, there is no detectable breeze or air current from any of the branches.  A subtle, bitter odor nags at your palate, leaving a foul taste in your mouth, and irritating your nose and eyes.

title: [Dark Grotto, Cavern]
description: The floor of this small round cavern dips suddenly down, forming a kind of bowl with the lowest point at the center of the cavern.  Large round stones, all of them roughly the same size and shape, lie scattered around the cavern, but for the most part are heaped in a loose pile at the center of the cavern.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: The irregular stone surfaces of the tunnel floor, walls and ceiling are smooth.  There are no jagged edges or sharp protrusions anywhere.  The floor of the tunnel seems as if it had been swept clean, there is no dirt or debris, no grit, no pebbles or loose rocks, large or small.  The only foreign substances you see anywhere are the occasional patches of glowing lichen that cast a pale, green light throughout the tunnel.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: The tunnel is quiet.  Abnormally so.  Even the sounds that you make as you navigate the tunnel are muted and seem to die in the air almost immediately.  There are no echoes from the stone surfaces as one might expect in a tunnel through solid rock.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]

The area is dotted with patches of lichen which give off an eerie, dim light, casting a green hue over everything.  A subdued, slightly bitter odor nags at your senses.  Though the smell is not strong, it is pervasive and seems to irritate your eyes and nose.

title: [Dark Grotto, Cavern]
description: A sour, fetid odor fills this cavern, stinging your eyes and making breathing difficult.  A strange, gritty substance covers the floor of the cavern which crunches when it is walked upon.  At first sight it appeared to be simply a layer of dirt, but closer examination shows it to be some kind of finely pulverized stone.  The grey-white caps of mushrooms poke up in small clusters dotted around on the surface of the grit.

title: [Dark Grotto, Cavern]
description: A broad ledge runs all the way around the edge of this cavern, circling a huge pit at the center.  The ledge is smooth and even, with plenty of room for you to walk around.

title: [Deep Pit]
description: A deep layer of old bones forms the floor of this deep pit. The high straight walls are rough and irregular, riddled with cracks and sharp protrusions of stone.

title: [Dark Grotto, Small Tunnel]
description: The tunnel meanders through the surrounding stone, twisting and turning, rising and falling with no particular regularity or pattern.  The stone surface is irregular, but the tunnel maintains the same general size and shape as it continues along.  The dim, green illumination, provided by patches of glowing lichen that dot the walls, makes visibility poor and you find yourself squinting at the dark features of the tunnel walls.

title: [Dark Grotto, Cavern]
description: Every sound that you make is amplified by the high domed ceiling of this oblong cavern.  One end of the cavern has  been hollowed out, forming a kind of amphitheater with four broad, terraced ledges forming a semicircle around a stone platform.  The cavern could not be a natural formation, but there are no tool marks from where the stone might have been carved or worked by hand, no telltale joints where stones have been fitted together.  Deep niches line the walls of the cavern.

wayto.7476: ;e if not kneeling?;	fput 'kneel' if Stats.race !~ /dwarf|halfling|gnome/i;end;fput 'southeast'

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: The huge cavern that stretches out to the northeast presents an eerie, other-worldly vista, filled with tall spires of stone and crystal, and dotted with growths of giant mushrooms and huge fans of lichen.  Somewhere high overhead, the ceiling of the cavern lies out of sight, shrouded in darkness.  Many varieties of mold, moss, lichen and fungi fill the underground landscape, some of them glowing with pale unearthly light that fills the cavern with dim, shadowy illumination.

wayto.7477: ;e if celerity = Spell[506] and celerity.known? and celerity.affordable? and not celerity.active?; celerity.cast; end; fput 'search'; waitrt?; move 'go crack'; waitrt?

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: Making your way among the spires of stone that rise from the cavern floor is like traveling through a strange and exotic forest.  Instead of vines and bushes, long growths of stringy moss and huge mushrooms and toadstools provide an undergrowth that chokes the way.  The small creatures of a sylvan setting, mice, squirrels and other small furry beasts are not present.  Instead, the pale bulging eyes of small lizards blink at you silently before the owners scurry away through the growths of fungi.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: The muted gurgle of running water is an odd intrusion into the quietude of the cavern.  A weak flow of water emerges from a small crack high up on the western cavern wall and cascades down over the stone to collect in a small rivulet that runs off to the east.  The stream presents no barrier to passage, being only a foot or two wide, and it is only the shallow stone channel, etched into the floor of the cavern by the flow of water over uncounted years, that keeps it from simply spreading out.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: A broad stair of gigantic proportion has been carved into the face of the north wall of the huge cavern.  The gargantuan stairway trails upward, out of sight, following the wall of the cavern to the east.  The unnatural flora of the cavern ends abruptly at the edge of the stone platform that forms the landing of the great stairway.  The huge cavern that stretches out to the south is an eerie, other-worldly vista, filled with tall spires of stone and growths of giant mushrooms and huge fans of lichen.

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: Somewhere overhead, the ceiling of the cavern lies out of sight, shrouded in darkness.  Some of the varieties of lichen and fungi that fill the underground landscape glow with pale unearthly light that provides dim, shadowy illumination.  Molds and mosses growing on the stone spires take the place of leaves and bark that you might see in a forest of trees.  Instead of mottled browns and variegated greens, everything here is a dull, washed-out grey with only a hint of color here and there.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: The shallow stream flowing in from the west empties into a broad pool which butts against the east wall of the cavern.  The surface of the pool is marked with occasional ripples, as if something were moving around below the surface of the water.  Along the bank of the pool, the moss is thick and bushy, providing homes for the small lizards that you can see darting around between the rocks and fungi.

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: Molds and mosses growing on the sides of the stone spires take the place of leaves and bark that you might see in a forest of trees.  Instead of mottled browns and variegated greens, everything here is a dull, washed-out grey with only a hint of color here and there.  The dim illumination provided by some of the varieties of mold and fungi that glow with pale internal light is shadowy and insubstantial, a feeble mockery of true daylight.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: A narrow, shallow channel filled with the lively burble of flowing water forms a small stream that winds its way through the tall stone spires, creating a twisted line that cuts across the center of the cavern from west to east.  The thick moss that grows along the banks of the miniature river gives off a sweet, but slightly fetid odor.  Small lizards watch you with reptilian stoicism before darting off to hide among the rocks and fungi.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Dark Grotto, Long Stairway]
description: The gargantuan stairway rises from the landing here, reaching up along the wall of the cavern farther than you can see.  The stair is a marvel, an engineering feat of unparalleled proportions.  The broad steps are more than twenty feet wide, some seven or eight feet deep, and about three feet high.

title: [Dark Grotto, Long Stairway]
description: Huge steps have been carved into the stone wall of the cavern forming a stairway of gigantic proportions.  No creature that you have ever seen has had the size or length of leg to negotiate stairs of this size.  The floor of the cavern is far below, and anyone who fell over the unprotected edge of the stairway would surely die in the fall.

title: [Dark Grotto, Long Stairway]
description: A gargantuan stairway descends from the landing here, reaching down along a solid stone wall into a huge cavern, farther than you can see.  The stair is a marvel, an engineering feat of unparalleled proportions.  The broad steps are more than twenty feet wide, some seven or eight feet deep, and about three feet high.  The floor of the huge cavern lies so far below that all detail is lost in the distance.  A large, dark tunnel has been bored into the stone wall.

title: [Dark Grotto, Dark Cavern]
description: Age seeps from the walls of this huge chamber, smothering everything with a dust laden blanket of silence.  There is a huge relief carved into the wall at the end of the long chamber, opposite the opening to the south.
