title: [Wehnimer's, Tunnel]
description: The walls of this low stone tunnel are covered with a glowing, grey lichen that makes your eyes strain and gives your skin an eerie, pallid cast.  The damp, close air is warmer here than you would have expected, but the lingering chill of the unknown stays with you.  A stone stairway, appearing to turn sharply, breaches one wall of the room.

The walls of this low stone tunnel are covered with a glowing, grey lichen that makes your eyes strain and gives your skin an eerie, pallid cast.  The damp, close air is warmer here than you would have expected, but the lingering chill of the unknown stays with you.  A crumbled stone stairway, appearing to turn sharply, breaches one wall of the room.

title: [Wehnimer's, Catacombs]
description: The air is almost oppressive in this narrow, lichen covered tunnel.  Passing through, you constantly check to see if anything is following, as clawing and scraping sounds echo down from the tunnel toward you.  Just ahead, the passageway begins to slope downward, and the dripping water from overhead flows down in a westerly direction.

title: [Wehnimer's, Catacombs]
description: Thick patches of slimy lichen cover the walls and ceiling of this narrow tunnel.  The scraping and clawing noises that can be heard coming from all directions are not missing here, and you wonder just how limitless is the population of the creatures who make the noise.

title: [Wehnimer's, Catacombs]
description: Thick, damp air makes it hard to breathe as you trudge along this narrow, winding tunnel.  Odd scratch marks cover the ceiling and walls here as if something has been burrowing recently, but left in a hurry.

title: [Wehnimer's, Catacombs]
description: A faint glow filters into the branching tunnel from the west.  Peering in that direction you can find no evidence as to the source of the illumination and wonder where it might come from.  The trickle of water at your feet continues west, and as before, the lichen covered walls are slimy and slippery.

title: [Catacombs, Wide Tunnel]
description: The passage widens almost to the point that it could be considered a chamber.  The walls and ceiling are illuminated brightly by a strange, glowing lichen, and the eerie light now shows plainly a series of burrows and holes set into the walls from which strange clawing and scratching sounds emanate.

title: [Catacombs, Tunnel]
description: The dank, twisting passage bends from east to southwest, widening somewhat on its eastern side.  Lichen cover the walls and ceiling here, sending droplets of condensation onto the floor and creating a very dangerous, slippery situation on its surface.

title: [Catacombs, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel continues on in a seemingly endless fashion.  The slimy, slippery lichen brushes you now and again as you advance, causing you to shiver from its cold, clammy touch.

title: [Catacombs, Tunnel]
description: The trickle of water running along the floor disappears into a hole too small to wiggle through, however the tunnel itself continues onward.  As you look ahead, you see it twists in a new direction, but you cannot find an end to the long passage.

title: [Catacombs, Steep Passage]
description: The otherwise less than interesting tunnel suddenly turns into a steeply sloping passage that extends from the west to the east.  Climbing is rather difficult here since the lichen that covers the walls and ceiling as in the other nearby tunnels now covers the floor as well.  The trickling water has turned into a small flowing stream, also making it harder to stand.

title: [Wehnimer's, Tunnel]
description: The twisting stairway seems to go on without end.  After every few steps, you come to another stone landing where the way continues at a sharp angle.  The air is warm and humid, and a feeling of closeness presses in on you.

title: [Wehnimer's, Tunnel]
description: You are on a broad stone landing, with a series of wedge-shaped stone stairs fanning out before you.  As you look down, they are swallowed up by increasing darkness.  Two torches in crude iron sconces flicker off the clammy walls, casting a harsh, unrelenting light that illuminates a trapdoor just within reach above your head.

title: [Catacombs, Collapsed Tunnel]
description: Most of the roof has collapsed here, totally blocking travel farther east.  Water enters from the western tunnels and accumulates in a fairly deep, circular pool at the foot of the rubble.  Besides the sound of the gurgling water, you hear a low rumble from beyond the obstructing debris.

title: [Catacombs, Filthy Pool]
description: The path dips into a trough here, creating a stagnant, filthy pool that fills the room from wall to wall.  As you wade through the miasma, you notice the water has flooded some of the low-set tombs.  Black water rolls in from the southeast, draining to the northwest.  Clumps and strands of flotsam and jetsam swirl around you, and you cringe each time some of the debris brushes your legs.

title: [Catacombs, Effluent]
description: Brackish water seeps in through the joints in the stone walls, and mingles with occasional gushes of black, malodorous liquid from several pipes set into the masonry.  A few of the tombs have been carved into the rock but it appears they were left unused.  Just as you move closer to examine them, one of the pipes spews out a stream of filthy sludge and deposits an oozing puddle of gunk at your feet.  It lazily flows to the northwest and vanishes into the tunnels.

title: [Catacombs, Side Passage]
description: The tunnel looks dry and clean in this region, with only a few light patches of moss covering the brick walls.  At various places about the ceiling, small openings provide some faint lighting.  In the southernmost wall, a large opening is blocked by a recently built wooden barricade.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: Dark openings in the walls remind you of your own fragile mortality as you try to peer inside them.  Most are empty, but others contain old bones and tattered rags, evidence of plundering.  A narrow ribbon of water flows gently eastward along the tunnel floor.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: The tunnel continues here with little noticeable change.  Streaks of yellow and orange deposits smear the walls in places where the aquiferous stone has been cut through.  Droplets from that stone layer trickle down the walls to join the small flow in the center of the room.  Most of the crypts in this section have been picked clean by grave robbers long ago.

title: [Catacombs, East-West Tunnel]
description: This smallish, circular chamber seems to mark the beginning of a series of branching tunnels.  To the east, a long passage recedes into the murk, while a narrower one leads southwest.  Sepulchers line the walls, broken into at random intervals.  A tangle of roots on the northwest side of the chamber conceals the source of a tiny streamlet.  A channel in the floor of the tunnel cradles the trickling water.

title: [Catacombs, Uneven Stair]
description: A wide, very uneven stair leads downward and southwest from here.  You wonder as you look at the floor and walls how many centuries these catacombs have been in use.  Deep footholds have been worn into the steps, and the center of the tunnel leading northeast has developed a slight trough in the bare, polished stone.  Graves lining the tunnel here seem to have been well-cared for, most still sealed.

title: [Catacombs, Temple Crypt]
description: A small, octagonal chamber surrounds you.  To the northeast an uneven, well worn stair leads upward into darkness, and a huge, arched door of thick iron blocks further passage to the southwest.  Large, black oil lamps hang in the center of each wall, and on either side of the door are two beautifully decorated urns.  Tombs of priests from ages long past line the walls wherever space allowed.

title: [Catacombs, High Ledge]
description: You are somewhat out of breath, and stand atop the ledge looking down.  As you glance north, you are disappointed to discover that the recessed tunnel, which looked clear from below, has actually been blocked by a cave-in.  You must halt your northern explorations here for now.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: This tunnel has obviously been neglected for a number of years.  The mortar is falling out from around many of the bricks, some of which are broken.  Much of the floor is covered with various mosses and slimes, puddles of stagnant water, and many kinds of disgusting creepy-crawlies.

title: [Catacombs, Inside Crypt]
description: You curse instinctively as you hit your head on the low ceiling of the crypt chamber, and revile your ancestors under your breath for having been so short.  There is barely enough room to crawl through here, so you quickly glance from side to side to discover anything of interest.  Among the crushed bones and the rubble, you spy a very narrow chute.

title: [Shanty Town, Inside Hut]
description: You are inside a one-room hovel.  A worn quilt patched together from hundreds of tiny scraps of fabric is folded neatly in the corner.  A fat candle, melted down to a waxy stub, rests atop a warped crate in the center of the room.

title: [Catacombs, Narrow Corridor]
description: A solidly constructed, well-maintained passage leads west.  The crumbling brick walls have been plastered over with lime to keep them intact and small shelves built into the brick still contain tools and supplies used to dig out the niches for the tombs in the catacombs.

title: [Catacombs, Blank Passage]
description: The eastern passage opens out into a large, rather barren square room here.  Except for the western wall, which seems relatively new, the walls have begun to crumble in places where water has seeped in through the bricks.  Picks and other tools lie strewn about the room, obviously unused for quite some time.  Some of them have long since turned into unrecognizable piles of rust with partially petrified handles.

title: [Catacombs, Dank Cellar]
description: A few brown sewer rats dart across the floor and scurry north, in the direction of the odor of spoiled food and ancient cooking grease.  In a far bleak corner stands a filthy cot, a heap of dirty laundry piled high at its foot.  Anchored into the southern wall is a ladder, which disappears into the total darkness that obscures the vaulted ceiling.

wayto.8686:
;e begin
clear
fput 'climb ladder'
climb_result = waitfor "As you try to climb the ladder, a rung breaks under your weight", "You carefully make your way up the dilapidated ladder."
fput 'stand' unless climb_result == "You carefully make your way up the dilapidated ladder."
end until climb_result == "You carefully make your way up the dilapidated ladder."

title: [Catacombs, Dank Cellar]
description: This dank, musty room looks like it was used as a cooking area of some sort, by someone not too concerned with hygiene.  Moldy dishes are piled high in a huge wooden tub and the acrid smell of some long-since-burnt animal lingers in the close air.  In the northern wall is a large, rectangular opening, and beside it a vertical slot with a chain hanging down.

title: [Jail, Cramped Box]
description: You are inside a very dark, smelly, cramped space.  There are rusty bolts overhead in the top of the box, and spilled food and other noxious stains are on the floor.  Looking around the edge through a gap between the box and the wall, you can see a broken, rusty chain that may have served to move this box vertically when pulled.

title: [Temple Crypt, Inside Urn]
description: You are inside a great temple urn.  You cannot imagine there could be so much room inside any single piece of crockery!  Dust raised by your arrival chokes you, and you shudder to realize that you may have just inhaled some long-departed temple acolyte.  Even though you feel protected in here, you don't want to linger for too long.

title: [Temple Crypt, Black Stair]
description: The stone on this stairway is curiously worn, in a manner that almost makes each step slope backwards.  Very little in the way of illumination guides you.  Drafts of air, alternatingly fresh and fetid, offer the only proof there really is an end to this winding and twisting series of steps.

title: [Temple Crypt, Black Stair]
description: A narrow landing here is lit by dim rays which filter through a crack in the stonework.  The crack is barely wide enough to allow a supple person to slip through.

title: [Temple, Altar]
description: The altar is plain, and bears only onyx bowls of smouldering incense and smoking paraffin.  Draped behind it is a cloth banner, appliqued with an ancient mystical pattern.  A legend is embroidered along the bottom.  On the far side of the room at the end of an aisle, you see two pillars.

title: [Catacombs, Old Tunnel]
description: Through the holes in the barricade you can see that the tunnel continues on the other side.  The tunnel here is very old and threatens to cave in, several of the old bricks have crumbled littering the floor with dirt, rocks, and rubble.

title: [Catacombs, Old Tunnel]
description: One too many of the eastern wall supports seems to have given way, allowing most of the wall to collapse, and blocking most of the passage.  As you survey the remaining intact supports, you wonder how much longer they will last.

title: [Catacombs, Old Tunnel]
description: The tunnel comes to a dead end here.  Unlike the other areas of the tunnel, the floor here is suprisingly clear of debris.  A slender crack runs along the length of the floor.  Strange sounds echo through the chamber and the floor shifts underfoot periodically.

The tunnel comes to a dead end here.  Unlike the other areas of the tunnel, the floor here is surprisingly clear of debris.  A crack runs along the length of the floor.  Strange sounds echo through the chamber and the floor shifts underfoot periodically.

title: [Catacombs, Underground Lake]
description: Ripples from a small underground lake gently lap at the black, muddy shore in this cavernous chamber.  Occasionally, soft splashes and gurgles resound, seeming to originate to the northwest.  The shore curves north and west from here, punctuated by tracks of humans and animals and by a slimy trail whose maker you would rather not come face to face with.

title: [Catacombs, Underground Lake]
description: The northeastern edge of this underground lake cuts abruptly into the smooth stone wall of the cavern here, forming a narrow, half-submerged grotto.  The slick rock surrounding it on either side forms a dangerous but passable route to the west.

title: [Catacombs, Underground Lake]
description: Fresh, clear water pours out of a smooth, elliptical passage to the west and gently cascades into a lake here.  About the only sound you can hear is the soft chuckling of the water as it rolls through small stones that have been rounded with time.  To the north and east, the shore of the lake becomes muddy and disappears into darkness.

title: [Catacombs, Underground Lake]
description: Water tumbles gently out of a brick passage to the north and slowly winds its way across rounded rocks and into a lake to the southeast.  From the smell of things, the lake is a bit cleaner than the sewage water pouring out of the northern passage.  Occasional splashes and gurgling noises echo throughout the chamber.

title: [Catacombs, Effluent]
description: Pipes of all shapes and sizes end in the brick walls here at various heights.  Fetid water from unknown sources pours out into the tunnel from some of them, adding to a small stream crawling slowly southward in the center of the passage.

title: [Catacombs, Twisting Tunnels]
description: This section of the tunnels is almost perfectly elliptical and leads generally in an east-west direction.  It seems to have been formed by rapidly moving water eons ago, but now it is almost dry as time and use have forced the water table down deeper.  A small trickle of clear water still travels along the center of the tunnel eastward.

title: [Catacombs, Twisting Tunnels]
description: You try and make sense out of the twisting and turning mess of tunnels here, but more openings only add to your dilemma.  Gaps in the walls everywhere confound you, including one in the floor that serves to drain off some of the running water.  Two of the largest tunnels branch off from the main passage at this juncture.  One leads sharply upward and southwest.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Catacombs, Twisting Tunnels]
description: This junction of tunnels is very disorienting.  Here the walls are perfectly smooth and featureless except for an occasional streak of mineral deposits.  The tunnel slopes sharply upward to the north and east, while the ceiling arches up in the center to form a small, dark hole.

title: [Catacombs, Twisting Tunnels]
description: This junction of tunnels is very disorienting.  Here the walls are perfectly smooth and featureless except for an occasional streak of mineral deposits.  The tunnel slopes sharply downward to the west and northeast, while the floor dips down in the center to form a small, dark hole.

title: [Catacombs, Twisting Tunnels]
description: A cave-in some time in the distant past must have sealed off the western extension of the manmade tunnel here.  Pristinely clear water cascades in waves over the heap of rubble left in the wake of the collapse, forming a limpid pool at its base.  Overflow from the pool runs off eastward down the center of the floor along a time-worn channel.

title: [Catacombs, Twisting Tunnels]
description: This junction of tunnels is very disorienting.  Here the walls are perfectly smooth and featureless except for an occasional streak of mineral deposits.  The tunnel shifts direction slightly and continues both up and down.  Another, almost identical, passage leads in a flat, westward direction.

title: [Catacombs, Upward Tunnel]
description: This chamber seems artificial in some way you can't quite place.  The walls are still smooth, but the whole room is shaped like a teardrop laid sideways, narrowing to a small opening at its eastern end.  In the middle of the western wall is a very small, gothic-style wooden plank door with a brass sign on it.

title: [Catacombs, Effluent]
description: An ancient brick tunnel lined with pipe openings leads to the northwest and southeast here.  Most of the water running down its center seems to be coming from only a few of the pipes, and the flow tapers off to the northwest.  Another smaller passage heading west opens out of the southwestern wall a few feet above the floor.

title: [Catacombs, Dry Passage]
description: A rough-hewn passage slopes gently down and eastward here.  The tunnel seems remarkably dry, so dry that motes of dust, not beads of moisture, coat the floor and walls.  The tinkling of water is not far off, however, with splashing sounds echoing from the east.  The western wall seems more finely finished and well-preserved than the rest of the structure here.  A plain iron cresset is bolted to the wall at almost dead center.

title: [Catacombs, Effluent]
description: This is the northern end of a long effluent constructed of ancient, moss-encrusted brick.  Pipe openings line the walls everywhere, but only a few have small trickles of brown water pouring out of them.  In the northwestern wall, a circular opening wide enough to crawl through is barred by a heavy iron grate.  At the foot of the grate, on either side, are rotting piles of hay and sawdust, mixed with crumbling material giving off the distinctive aroma of manure.

title: [Catacombs, Secret Workshop]
description: This seems to be a secret workshop of some sort.  Weapons in various states of completion are held in locked vises atop a large wooden workbench.  Shelves filled with finely made tools line the walls.  Against one corner leans a huge broadsword, the hugest you have ever seen.

title: [Catacombs, Muddy Bend]
description: Dirt and rock, held together by stout, ancient tree roots, are all that is left of the walls here.  An old cave-in reduced the original tunnel to a mass of jumbled rubble beneath you.  Mud and loose stones line the sides of the passage, and the earthen roof is just high enough for you to stand up.  A thin trickle of glassy water flows eastward and down the rubble pile, from a large chamber just to the north.

title: [Catacombs, Beneath a Well]
description: The columnar stone shaft of an old well punctures the vaulted ceiling above and extends about halfway to the ground.  Directly beneath is the glassy surface of a spring-fed lake of unsurpassed crystalline beauty.  Diffuse light refracts off the lake and casts multihued reflections on the walls, as though filtered through a thousand tiny prisms of Elven devising.  The scene is so enchanting, you almost forget the harsh, muffled sounds echoing down the well.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Cavern]
description: Thick, spongy moss covers the floor and muffles the sound of your footsteps.  Large limestone stalactites hang from the ceiling like the sharpened fangs of a giant maw waiting to devour any who pass within.  The sound of dripping water echoes through the cavern and mingles with the more ominous sounds of screeches and growls as the denizens of this place move through the darkness.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Cavern]
description: Massive columns of limestone formed by the joining of stalagmite and stalactite climb to the ceiling far above.  Sparse patches of moss cling to the side of the columns and shed a faint illumination through the area.  Several large pools and puddles have gathered on the floor and reflect the dim glow, which does nothing to further illuminate the cavern.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Cavern]
description: The thick limestone columns are spaced widely apart here forming a clearing in the forest of stone.  Rivulets of water run down the walls of the cavern to gather in large puddles where the walls meet the floor.  A dark passage opens to the north and continues out of sight.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: Small trickles of water travel along the sloping tunnel towards the south causing the floor to be slick with mud and slime.  A slight breeze blows through the tunnels sending shivers down your spine and causing the small tendrils of mist near the floor to swirl and eddy.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: A thin layer of mist covers the floor which swirls and surges as you walk through it.  The mist glows eerily as the light from the moss that grows on the walls is diffused through it.  Thick drops of water splash down upon you from the ceiling, adding to the chill which fills the area.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Cavern]
description: The floor is littered with rubble and debris that varies in size from small rocks to huge boulders.  The perpetually dripping water mixes with dirt on the floor to make moving about extremely difficult without slipping.  A large gap on the northern wall recedes into the darkness beyond.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: You are in a narrow tunnel that forks to the northeast and northwest.  Small patches of phosphorescent moss cling to the walls and ceiling, providing a dim glow.  The floor is choked with rubble and debris, making it difficult not to trip in the darkness.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: The tunnel widens considerably here allowing for easier movement.  Unlike other sections of the tunnels the floor is relatively free of rubble and clutter.  Loud scratching noises and low growls echo through the area, their source unknown.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: This section of the passage turns from the south to the east, where it narrows slightly.  Patches of faintly glowing moss cling to the walls, shedding a faint illumination around you.  Small puddles of water have gathered across the floor, making footing slippery at best.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: The tunnels widen sharply here at this intersection of tunnels and then become narrow again away from the center.  A smaller side tunnel leads off to the north into the darkness while the main tunnel continues east and west.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: The tunnel narrows sharply making the going extremely difficult and treacherous.  The air hangs damp and heavy making it difficult to breathe and adding to the illusion of the walls closing in.  The tight confines seem to magnify the sounds of the water dripping from the ceiling above.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: The tunnel ends here in a rubble and boulder choked cave in.  Sparkling veins of minerals reflect and magnify the light shed by the glowing moss to make this dead-end well lit.  The scratching and growling that fills the rest of this network of tunnels is much fainter here as if the light has driven away the denizens of this place.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: A warm gust of air blows through the tunnel counteracting the perpetual dampness that hangs in the air.  Tiny malevolent eyes shine in the darkness of several small holes, glaring at you from their hiding place as you pass by.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: The floor here has been rutted and worn by the passage of water over the years as it cut out this tunnel.  Shimmering veins of minerals reflect and magnify the light shed from the luminescent moss that clings to the walls.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: The tunnel dips drastically causing mist to flow in and gather in a thick layer.  Visibility drops to almost nothing as the swirling mist hangs around you like a damp shroud.  Sounds echo strangely in this confined area, most probably due to the lower level of the floor here.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: The passage slopes down slightly making the rubble strewn floor even more treacherous to negotiate.  Thin streams of water wind their way through the rubble following the slope of the tunnel into darkness.

title: [Twisting Tunnel]
description: This section of the tunnel ends in a narrow cul-de-sac which is filled with water.  A narrow crack allows for minimal drainage that just manages to keep ahead of the inward flow.  Small ripples dance across the surface of the water as the occasional drop from overhead breaks the surface with a small splash.

title: [Town Well]
description: The old well is made of flat stones built up around a circular opening.  A slate roof overhangs the opening, keeping the drinking water clear and refreshing.  Several skin water buckets, with long ropes attached, are scattered on the hard-packed earth surrounding the well.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Room]
description: This anteroom houses benches, tables, podiums, portable altars and special items that regular users of the hall pay to have stored here.  There is very little space, this being more of a closet than a room.

title: [Moot Hall, Assembly Room]
description: In this large assembly room meetings are convened to deal with the affairs of the town, and the locals hold their religious and social events.  There is ample room for benches, long tables and other furnishings befitting special occasions.  Sconces for torches, chandeliers holding many candles, and broad windows impart a warm, friendly glow of good fellowship to this space.

title: [Catacombs, Narrow Passage]
description: There is barely room to walk between the walls of solid stone that narrow to a crack at the east end of the passage.  Shining veins of mineral deposits in the rock glitter in the light from the southwest, where the passage widens into a cavern.

title: [Catacombs, Natural Cavern]
description: The cavern widens into a large room, illuminated by moonlight that streams in through cracks in the ceiling far above.  Colorful mosses, nourished by the sparse sunlight that filters in during the day, grow on ancient stalagmites formed by centuries of dripping water.  To the north, an opening in the wall leads into a darker tunnel.

The cavern widens into a large room, illuminated by light that streams in through cracks in the ceiling far above.  Colorful mosses, nourished by the sparse sunlight, grow on ancient stalagmites formed by centuries of dripping water.  To the north, an opening in the wall leads into a darker tunnel.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: Dim light filters in from the opening to the south, illuminating a broad tunnel that winds northward.  The air is dank and still except for an occasional wisp of breeze from the opening, and a faint acrid smell touches your nostrils.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: The tunnel narrows as it turns from the south to the northwest, the darkness broken by the faint phosphorescent glow of a greenish lichen that grows in patches on the dirt walls.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: Bits of dirt fall from the ceiling as you make your way through the dim tunnel, your eyes adjusting to the glow of the lichen that grows in the nooks and crannies of the walls.  Your nose wrinkles at the sour scent that permeates the passage with each waft of air from the west.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: A dim phosphorescence lights the east-west tunnel, and a faint sound of dripping water echoes from somewhere in the distance.  Odd lumps of minerals are imbedded in the dirt walls, showing scratches from unsuccessful attempts to pry them out.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: The skeleton of an unfortunate gnome lies half-imbedded in the dirt, its bones glowing eerily with lichen that has migrated from the walls.  The air is heavy and stale, and something skitters across the dirt floor but is gone before you can see what it was.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: The passage widens here, and the dirt floor is scattered with the remains of a vicious battle.  Skeletons of gnomes, some still hung with scraps of tattered leather, lie among the dried and broken jaws and limbs of giant ants.  Glowing lichen from the walls has crept over many of the corpses, its greenish light illuminating the eerie tableau.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: Water drips down the tunnel wall from somewhere above, collecting in a depression at your feet and trickling off to the north as the tunnel slopes slightly down in that direction.  The air is damp, and reeks of the acrid scent that permeates the tunnels.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: You step around the muddy pits in the floor formed by the constant dripping of water from the ceiling.  Rivulets trickle down the walls through deep crevices worn by years of erosion.  The soft plip-plop of water droplets echoes all around you, along with a faint but constant clicking that seems to come from all directions.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: The tunnel slopes up to the north and southwest here.  Trickles of muddy water collect at your feet and run off into a large hole at the base of the wall.  The clicking noise that fills the tunnel, as well as the acrid scent that assaults your nostrils, seems to emanate from the dark hole, which is large enough for even a giantman to squeeze through.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: You make your way around dozens of glistening stalagmites formed by the muddy water that drips from the ceiling.  Glowing lichen covers everything, each falling droplet of water shining in its greenish light.  A small passage leads off to the northwest.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: The walls are more rock than dirt here, and the water that trickles down into a pool and runs off to the south is clear.  Lichen covers the outcroppings of timeworn stone, its greenish light reflecting on the pool.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: The walls of the tunnel are moist and covered with phosphorescent lichen that provides an eerie green glow.  A constant sound of dripping water echoes from the southeast, distracting you as you try to keep your footing on the muddy, sloping floor.

title: [Dark Cavern, Dead End]
description: The passage ends suddenly here, blocked by a wall of rubble where the tunnel has collapsed.  The glowing greenish lichen that covers the landslide is well-worn in several places as if someone or something had crawled over it many times, and a slight current of fresh air seems to come from above.

title: [Dark Cavern, Landslide]
description: The passage widens into a small room, blocked by a landslide of dirt and rocks that seems to have fallen a long time ago, as the glowing lichen has spread over most of its surface.  The gnawed arm of a skeleton that appears somewhat human protrudes from beneath a fallen boulder.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: The stone walls sparkle with veins of mineral deposits, glinting in the glow of the lichen.  Small insects scurry among the fallen rocks, running for cover as you startle them.

title: [Dark Cavern, Tunnels]
description: A beam of light filters through a crack in the stone above, throwing a bright patch on the floor.  A breeze of fresh air helps to dissipate the unpleasant acrid smell that seems to come from a deep tunnel that winds down into the dirt floor.  Faint clicking noises echo on the rock walls, but you cannot tell their source.

title: [Ant Nest, Passage]
description: Water flows down through the hole above you, pooling in a muddy pond at the southeast wall.  Unlike the natural passage above, this tunnel seems to have been intentionally dug, its walls smooth and packed with mineral deposits.  The passage leads deeper to the northwest.

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: The passage ends here in a wall of solid rock, but you notice a tunnel winding up through the dirt next to the slab.  Piles of refuse, glowing with the greenish lichen that has spread over them, litter the ground at your feet.

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: Passages lead off in many directions here, carved into the rock and dirt in an oddly geometric pattern.  Water drips from the roof of the tunnel, forming glistening pools at the base of the walls.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: The smooth wall of the tunnel curves before you, its surface covered with glowing lichen and damp stone.  The ground is littered with shards of bone and bits of old leather, and the acid stench in the air burns your nostrils.

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: Columns of smooth stone support the roof of the cavern, the tunnels dug out in a regular pattern around them.  The acrid, burning scent fills the thick air here, making you nauseous.  The constant clicking that echoes through the tunnels seems to come from the northwest.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: The lichen creeps up the surface of the stone columns, providing an eerie glow throughout the tunnels.  Sounds of something scurrying about in the tunnels echo faintly from the stone, nearly drowned out by the incessant clicking from the west.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [The Ant Nest, Central Chamber]
description: The tunnels lead out in all directions from this rounded chamber.  The huge mound in the center of the room seems to be built of dirt, minerals, and various other assorted debris, packed together so hard it is almost indistinguishable from the rock.  The clicking sound that resonates throughout the tunnels emanates from a series of holes that lead into the base of the mound, and the acidic stench is nearly unbearable here.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: The damp dirt floor between the stone columns is marked with many lines and tracks, as if objects of various sizes have been dragged to and fro.  Faint greenish light from the everpresent lichen reflects from the metallic deposits in the rock.  The sounds of clicking and scurrying creatures echo around you.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: This niche in the tunnel is dark.  Though your eyes adjust to the faint glow of the lichen to the south, no water drips into this dry, raised alcove, and the smooth stone is bare.  The continual clicking echoes louder here from the rock walls, though the crevice that forms a large opening between two slabs of rock seems oddly silent.

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: The south wall of the tunnel is covered in a thick bed of lichen, bathing the entire area in a bright green glow.  The tunnels lead off to the northeast and northwest in a regular pattern, the smooth walls glistening with moisture.

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: You make your way among the stone pillars, tripping over bits of rock and bone that litter the ground.  The sound of things scurrying along the hard floor is all around you, blending with the constant clicking that seems to come from the north passage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: Water drips from the ceiling, collecting in a small pool between the stone columns.  A few bones lie scattered around the tunnel, pressed into the dirt floor by time and passing creatures.  The damp air is heavy with the acrid smell that permeates the tunnels.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: The tunnels wind in a regular pattern around you, marked off by the stone pillars that support them.  The pillars themselves are covered with a pattern of green lichen and shining deposits of metal in the natural rock.  The incessant clicking sound echoes loudest from the east.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: Tunnels lead off in many directions, separated by the glistening columns that support the rock above, forming a pattern too regular to have been carved by the flow of water and random shifting of stone.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Ant Nest, Alcove]
description: A foul scent of rotting flesh fills the air in this alcove.  Close examination shows that the bed of moss and lichen against the wall has been filled with bones and bodies of various creatures, some almost human or at least gnomelike.  The corpses stuck between the rocks appear to be gnawed and stripped of flesh, as if they were being stored for food.

title: [Ant Nest, Tunnels]
description: A few rocks have fallen from above, splattering dirt on the smooth walls and half-covering the relatively fresh skeleton of a gnome.  The poor fellow looks to have been trapped in the landslide, but his bones have been picked almost clean - only tatters of flesh and leather clothing remain.  The stone clutched in his bony hand and the odd scratches on the wall indicate that perhaps he had tried to write something before he expired.

title: [Ant Nest, Pool]
description: Numerous streams of water drip down the stone walls here, collecting in a deep pool at the lowest end of the tunnel.  The glowing lichen grows thick on the damp rock, except for the glistening stripes where water flows from some underground stream through small crevices in the stone above.

title: [Ant Nest, Burial Chamber]
description: The natural shape of the stone forms a deep, arching crevice.  Only a few shreds of lichen grow on the dry rock, providing little light.  As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you notice that the walls are piled high with the dried exoskeletons of thousands of huge dead ants, each at least as long as a halfling is tall.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Shoreline]
description: The rocky shoreline along the bottom of the cliff makes entry into the bay too treacherous to consider.  Muddy water covers the few soft spots in the ground between the rocks.

title: [A Muddy Pool]
description: You are in the middle of a mucky brown pool of mud and water which has formed just at the mouth of a river flow.  The river itself is flowing out of a low opening in the cliff face.  From this angle you can tell you'd never be able to see the opening from above.

title: [Beach Area, Rocky Shore]
description: Standing near the cliff path, you halt upon a narrow spit of sand and gravel.  Your choices here are limited by the sea and the largely unscaleable cliffs above.  To the east, the shore gives way to a tide pool carved out among the rocks.  Turning west, a narrow strand leads to an old pier jutting into the ocean.  Near the old pier, several buildings still stand beneath the cliffs.  Beyond the tumbled structures, among the rocks and boulders, you spy gaps that may lead down to the sea.

title: [Beach Area, Tide Pool]
description: Standing among tumbled rocks made slick with still-wet seaweed, you gaze down at the pools of water that linger between the rocks.   Between one crevice and the next odd bits of sea-life cling, waiting for the return of the tide and the sheltering sea.  Much of the area below appears shallow and easily wadeable, even by a halfling, but there are pools that show a darker surface, hinting that they may be deeper than your first look would indicate.

title: [Beach Area, Rocky Shore]
description: Wandering along here, the rough crunch of gravel in your ears and the smell of salt and sea air in your nostrils, you observe a large number of crabs of various sizes scuttling among the rocks and debris near the water.  The soft sounds of sleeping seabirds drift down from the cracks and ledges high up along the cliffs.

Wandering along here, the rough crunch of gravel in your ears and the smell of salt and sea air in your nostrils, you observe a large number of crabs of various sizes scuttling among the rocks and debris near the water.  From time to time, seabirds swoop and dive to snatch one of the smaller specimens up to be devoured in relative safety among the cracks and ledges high up along the cliffs.

title: [Beach Area, Rocky Shore]
description: This stretch of beach is mostly rough boulders and broken rock.  The going is slow here, as you must carefully pick your way along the rounded rocks in the dark.   Here and there, huge flat slabs of rock lie where they have fallen, broken loose from above by some long forgotten storm or cataclysm.  You travel more easily along these but occasionally, one will tilt slightly as you cross it, making you guard your steps.

This stretch of beach is mostly rough boulders and broken rock.  The going is slow here as you must pick your way carefully since many of the rocks are rounded from being tumbled in the sea.   Here and there, huge flat slabs of rock lie where they have fallen, broken loose from above by some long forgotten storm or cataclysm.  You travel more easily along these but occasionally, one will tilt slightly as you cross it, making you guard your steps.

title: [Beach Area, Rocky Shore]
description: One huge chunk of rock has settled here, giving a surface as smooth as a paved road.  Even the ubiquitous crabs seem absent here, despite a slight slope running down into the water, where the surf washes it smooth and slick.  Bits of broken shell litter the otherwise smooth ground as it seems the local birds have oft used this as a place to drop shellfish from a height, to break them open and feast.

title: [Beach Area, Rocky Shore]
description: Here, very near the wooden remains of a small fishing pier, you can still make out the stumps of poles used to hang nets out to dry.  This place is level and over time, sand has drifted in to make a deep enough carpet to smooth the rough stones and soften the harshness of bare rock.  Bits of wood and a few rusted nails lie in a pattern that resolves itself into the outline of a small skiff, long since rotted away.  It has been long since anyone came here to fish, since the coming of the Undead.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Rocky Shore, Boat Ramp]
description: A long, gently sloping ramp made of polished stone leads down to the restless waves of the sea.  Once used to drag boats into and out of the waters, it stands abandoned.  A series of rings set alongside the ramp shows where ropes were used to lever the heavy skiffs onto the ramp.

title: [Rocky Shore, Boulder Field]
description: To the west, the rocky shoreline grows even more rugged and broken.  Enormous granite boulders the size of houses lie tumbled and cracked open and a goodly portion of the cliff above you has crumbled onto the beach.  To the west, one massive boulder dominates your view, a grey flecked monster that a legion of Gnolls could not reduce to gravel in a century.

title: [Rocky Shore, Boulder Field]
description: The huge boulder to the west blots out the view in that direction and deflects the sea breeze as well, leaving the air here curiously dry and dusty.   Balancing a moment on one larger rock, you pause to wipe the dusty sweat from your face and check your progress.

title: [Rocky Shore, Boat House]
description: A low, ramshackle building squats here on the dark rocks.  Made itself of slabs of the basalt found here, it almost blends into the cliff wall behind it.  Grooves worn into the rocks speak of seasons of men toiling to store their precious craft against the winter storms.

title: [Beach Area, Sailors' Haven]
description: A tumble-down building once made of stout wood, stands here, still resisting the winds and weather.  Whatever paint it had has long been scoured by sand and salt, and the wood looks sickly pale in the moonlight.  Age and the harsh climate here give an almost serene dignity to the old place.  On the side facing the sea, an old hatch cover still serves as a door, hanging by the corroded threads of bronze hinges.

A tumble-down building once made of stout wood, stands here, still resisting the winds and weather.  Whatever paint it had has long been scoured by sand and salt and the wood has been bleached golden with streaks and lines of white from crusted salt with deeper red smears from rusted nails.  Age and the harsh climate here give an almost serene dignity to the old place.  On the side facing the sea, an old hatch cover still serves as a door, hanging by the corroded threads of bronze hinges.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Rocky Shore, Outside Haven]
description: This side of the structure has received the brunt of the wind for decades.  The wood is bleached almost white and it is warped and seared by the weather.  Bits of wood and greenish bronze mark where oars were kept when the boats had been dragged ashore elsewhere.

title: [Beach Area, Rocky Shore]
description: A forest of poles, warped and bent by wind and weather, stand in mute rows.  This was where a long vanished fisherfolk spread their nets to dry.  North from here stands an ancient dock, now broken and twisted.

A forest of poles, warped and bent by wind and sun, stand in mute rows.  This was where a long vanished fisherfolk spread their nets to dry in the sun.  North from here stands an ancient dock, now broken and twisted.

title: [Beach Area, Dock]
description: As you make your way rather heavily through the sand, you come upon the remains of an old wooden dock that juts out some ways over the water.  Old pilings lean at drunken angles and support dry-rotted planks that look to crumble at a footstep.  Moonlight plays over the ancient pier, making it look nearly otherworldly.

As you make your way rather heavily through the sand, you come upon the remains of an old wooden dock that juts out some ways over the water.  Old pilings lean at drunken angles and support dry-rotted planks that look to crumble at a footstep.  At the far end of the dock sit a pair of sea-birds looking as old and weathered as the pier itself.

title: [Rocky Shore, Outside Haven]
description: Standing here in the lee of the building, you can smell the ancient wood that makes the wall of the haven.  Ancient graffiti, carved by long dead fisherfolk, has been scoured by wind and sand until it can no longer be read.

title: [Sailor's Haven, Outside Rear]
description: A small patch of sand lies between the building and the cliff face.  Green and brown scrubby bushes have gained a foothold here and salt grass flourishes in rank tufts.  A badly corroded iron ladder clings to the wall and leads to the roof.

title: [Beach Area, The Seam]
description: This stretch of beach is a patch of dirty whitish sand, stuck in between the craggy grey rocks to the east and the smooth black sands to the west.  It's as though the two surrounding areas didn't quite meet, and the Lords of Liabo had to put something in here, but didn't give it much thought.  You can see a tumbledown dock stretching out into the bay to the east, pointing north into the water like an arthritic finger.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: Black sands mix with white in this stretch of beach, the black encroaching from the west and the white defending from the east.  To the southwest, rough mounds of porous black rock stretch from the Trollfang to the bay, their rounded forms giving an illusion of motion, as though they were still flowing.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: Smooth black sand stretches north to the bay.  To the south, mounds of lava sit poised over the narrow beach, as though ready to flow down to the water.  Long strands of rubbery seaweed lie strewn about, adding a pungent tang to the already briny air.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: Waves roll up onto the dull black beach, the seafoam tracing lacy patterns against the dark background.  Flies buzz among the rotting seaweed, rising up in swarms as you pass.  To the northwest, a pillar of rock rises out of the water.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: The wind shrieks down the beach, cutting through your clothes to raise goosebumps on your skin.  The bay shore curves in gently here, and the volcanic rocks to the south are just high enough to channel the wind down the beach.  To the northeast, a dark stone pillar rises out of the bay, its base eroded by the waves.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: A rough stone pillar rises up out of the surf.  Hundreds of black-shelled mussels cling to its sides, black bumps nestled in the wiry strands that connect them to the rock.  The mussels are splotched with white, droppings from the sea birds who now sleep soundly in their nests.  You notice a patch of rock spotted with connecting fibers, but lacking in mussels.  It looks like someone has been out recently harvesting their dinner.

A rough stone pillar rises up out of the surf.  Hundreds of black-shelled mussels cling to its sides, black bumps nestled in the wiry strands that connect them to the rock.  The mussels are splotched with white, droppings from the sea birds whose screeches from above are ringing in your ears.  You notice a patch of rock spotted with connecting fibers, but lacking in mussels.  It looks like someone has been out recently harvesting their dinner.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: A narrow strip of black sand winds between the pulsing sea and the huddled rocks.  You look out at the dark waters of the bay, set against the grey sky.  With the black sands beneath your feet and the frozen black lava behind you, you feel as though all the color has been blotted out of the world.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: The waves break into white foam and come rolling up the black beach.  A magnificent sandcastle stands lone sentry near the tide line.  Every few minutes, a wave comes along and sweeps over it, but it remains whole and unmarred.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: The beach narrows here, disappearing to the west between the bay and the rocks.  A wall of gnarled black lava rises to the south, stretching in a ridgeline to the east and west.  The flowing lava must have extended the land nearly a hundred yards into the bay before it froze into place.  Some day it'll likely have a layer of soil on it, and plants and animals will make their homes there, but for now it's barren and lifeless.

title: [Rocky Shore, Boulder Field]
description: You are in a narrow gap between the massive boulder and the cliffside.  The breeze is totally absent and despite the cool rock surface, you are sweating in the stagnant night air.  The rocks here are slippery with accumulated droppings from the nests of birds high above you in the broken clefts of the upper cliffs.

You are in a narrow gap between the massive boulder and the cliffside.  The breeze is totally absent and despite the cool rock surface, you are sweating in the stagnant air.  The rocks here are slippery with accumulated droppings from the nests of birds high above you in the broken clefts of the upper cliffs.

title: [Rocky Shore, Boulder Field]
description: You are standing at the base of a boulder the size of the Moot Hall in Wehnimer's at the very least.  Wedged tightly in the space between it and the cliff, you notice cracks and fissures of sufficient number and placement to give a brave person a chance of gaining the summit of this rock.

title: [Rocky Shore, Massive Boulder]
description: As you scramble and claw your way along the crevices, you dislodge several bird's nests.  One at least is still occupied and the owner gives vent to a raucous screeching that makes your ears ring as it echoes from the cliffs behind you.

title: [Rocky Shore, Massive Boulder]
description: Gaining the top of the boulder, you pause to drink in gulps of cool sea air.  The surface here is mostly flat and bare, though covered with minute cracks and fissures.  The surface of the rock is weathered a deep grey overlaid with a faint growth of moss in some of the deeper cracks.  A small tree has somehow taken root in the center of this stony place and seems to thrive.

title: [Beach Area, Tide Pools]
description: Scrambling among the rocks, part way down the sides of the pool, you find dismembered bits of fish and small crabs.  Much of it appears to have been flung here by the retreating waves, but there are also larger pieces that seem out of place.  Looking closer, you realize that not all of them come from sea creatures, for you recognize the carcasses of small land animals as well.

title: [Beach Area, Tide Pools]
description: Almost to the level of the remaining seawater trapped in the pool, you find more and larger bits of torn flesh and cracked shells.  The broken remains of a shell easily half the size of a rolton makes you search among the rocks warily and gives you new impetus in keeping alert.

title: [Beach Area, Tide Pools]
description: Here, at the bottom of the rocky slope, you stand along the edge of the pool itself.  The far end opens out to the sea and unknown depths.  The only way out is back up the slope behind you, as even with power to walk on water, the pounding surf a few yards out would make short work of any such attempt.  As you lean against a worn boulder to rest a moment, you notice an odd smell all around the area.  Further examining of the rocks shows a large smudge of some black viscous goo that stains your fingers.

title: [Sailor's Haven, Roof]
description: The low flat roof is made from large slabs of locally quarried slate and is still sound after years of neglect.  The dark blue-grey surface crunches underfoot with an accumulation of salt crystals blown here by the wind.  A low railing still stands along the seaward edge of the roof.

title: [Sailor's Haven, Widow's Walk]
description: A low railing still stands along this end of the roof, allowing one to lean against it and stare out at the sea.  Once used by the wives of the fishermen to watch for a safe return of their men, it is lonely and windswept now with only the ghosts of long gone memories to stand alongside you.

title: [Beach Area, Rotting Dock]
description: This is shoreward end of the old dock.  A few broken and warped planks lead down to the shore from here.  Perched at one end of the ancient and creaking structure, you wonder just how safe it really is.  In many places, entire sections of the flooring have given way and a misstep could send you tumbling down onto the rocks below.

This is the shoreward end of the old dock.  A few broken and warped planks lead down to the shore from here.  Perched at one end of the ancient and creaking structure, you wonder just how safe it really is.  In many places, entire sections of the flooring have given way and a misstep could send you tumbling down onto the rocks below.

title: [Beach Area, Rotting Dock]
description: This section of the pier is relatively sound.  It lies beyond the wrath of all but the worst of storm and waves, so that most of the structure is intact, albeit shaky.  Sun-bleached wood groans and creaks beneath your feet, echoing in your ears above the booming of the surf.

title: [Beach Area, Rotting Dock]
description: You are at the part of the dock that extends just short of the high water mark, to judge from the more-or-less sound condition of the deck planks and reinforcing beams.  From time to time, an unusually large wave breaks against the seaward supports and causes the whole structure to shake and sway dizzyingly.  The view out over the bay is magnificent, but you hesitate to linger here.

title: [Beach Area, Rotting Dock]
description: This part of the pier shows a good deal more deterioration than the drier, landward parts.  Decades of pounding surf have taken their toll and marine worms and mollusks have eaten away at the pilings, weakening them gravely.  An occasional burst of spume from the larger waves catches you by surprise as you look through gaps in the decking to watch the waves break beneath you.

title: [Beach Area, Rotting Dock]
description: Time and many seasons of tides have ruined the outer parts of the structure almost beyond use.  You cling to precarious handholds along the rotted wood as bits and pieces break off under your grip.  The entire aging construction sways and moans with each passing surge of the waves and you wonder just what keeps the whole thing from sliding into the bay.

title: [Beach Area, Rotting Dock]
description: As you reach the tip of the pier, ancient sea-birds awaken to noisy flight and startle you so that you almost lose your footing and plunge into the cold bay.  Catching yourself, barely, you pause to survey the structure.  Exploring a bit, you realize that you could, if you dared, clamber down the pilings and gain a closer look at the large marine growth that encrust them near the water line.  There also appear to be remnants of a wooden platform almost on a level with the sea.

title: [Beach Area, Dock Piling]
description: You manage to make it this far, clinging to the sour smelling wood, your fingers digging splinters out of the piling.  Above you is the relative safety of the dock.  Below you is a slimy wooden platform largely covered with odd growths.

title: [Beach Area, Rotting Dock]
description: Gasping for breath, from the climb down and from knowing how shaky your perch is here, you pause to wonder that the whole platform has not crumbled into the sea lurking below your feet.  At high tide, this entire ledge would be several feet under water to judge from some of the more spectacular examples of barnacles, mussels and larger, less easily identifiable things growing here.  Many bulky cylindrical shapes, each topped with numerous thin tentacles, are clustered at the perimeter of the ledge.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Entrance]
description: A silver portcullis with sharp protruding spikes looms ominously over the entrance to a sandy courtyard.  Tall, black marble walls streaked with red veins enclose this compound to the east and west.  The black sand from the beaches has migrated here to cover the entire area.

title: [Sailors' Haven, Inside]
description: Inside, out of the wind and spray, it feels warmer, almost cheerful.  Broken bits of furniture litter the wooden floor and sand has piled up in the corners.  Old bits of netting still dangle from the rafters and some antique glass fishing floats lie in a heap on the floor.  An old hatch cover serves as a door to the outside and a passage leads further back into the building.

title: [Sailors' Haven, Common Room]
description: You get the feeling no one has gathered here in ages as you enter this once cheerful room.  Trying to avoid the rotted fishing nets that hang from the ceiling proves to be quite tricky.  A musty smell emanates from several overstuffed chairs that are strewn about the room.  You hear strange sounds that seem to come from behind the soggy planks nailed loosely to the fireplace.

title: [Sailors' Haven, Sleeping Room]
description: For a moment, you feel as though you have been somehow transported into the forecastle of some sailing ship.  This room is long and narrow, with wooden shelves on both walls that may have once served as bunks.  Even the windows here appear to have been salvaged from portholes, as they are small, round, and heavy.  The only disturbing note is a human skeleton, stretched out on the floor, one hand pointed towards the doorway in mute warning.

title: [Sailors' Haven, Storageroom]
description: This appears to have once been a storeroom for the fishermens' supplies.  Piles of rotted nets slump in corners and old casks and chests lie broken and splintered about the place.  A dull grey film of dust and dried salt covers every surface.

title: [Sailors' Haven, Supply Room]
description: The scent of creosote and tar still pervades this room which once was used to store boat repair supplies.  Lumps of old tar litter the floor and walls, being flung haphazardly around the room by someone or something in a frenzy.  A coil of rope once used to stuff into cracks and leaks looks ready to crumble into dust at a touch.

title: [A Tidal Cave]
description: Years of tidal erosion have carved out a rough cave large enough for unrestricted movement.  Cool seawater laps around your ankles and the light filtering in from the cave mouth reflects off the resulting wavelets in a hypnotic display.  The tunnel extends southward, deep within the cliff, but peering in that direction you notice that the light does not diminish into blackness.  Far into the cave, you can barely make out a faint emerald glow illuminating the rough walls.

title: [The Emerald Pool]
description: The cave widens here and the rough floor drops away leaving you wading in cool, shallow water.  Looking around, you have a feeling of an otherworldly silence, as the sounds of your splashing are not reflected back to you by the cavern walls.  Below you, underneath the surface of the water, you see a faint emerald glow emanating from a small opening.

title: [The Sea's Judge]
description: Water dances about you in lazy waves as you float in this underground pool.  The chamber above is domed and uncommonly smooth, and there are no visible exits save for the opening you just swam through.  Looking upward, the most prominent thing visible is an enormous statue of white coral tinged with blue flecks.  The statue's form glares down at you with impassive, seemingly harsh, blue eyes.

title: [Beach Area, Small Cave]
description: Water from the high tide has left numerous puddles on the floor of this low, cramped cave.  The air has a stale, moldy odor, possibly coming from the decaying patches of bladderwrack that cover some of the rocks.  A dark narrow tunnel leads off to the west.

title: [Sea Cave, Narrow Tunnel]
description: The damp walls of this confining tunnel are of grey and pitted stone.  The rough floor descending westward at a steep pitch makes walking a chore.  Amongst the eerie, near-silent sounds echoing about the caves, you hear an underlying thrumming noise coming from the west.

title: [Sea Cave, Wide Tunnel]
description: The tunnel here is high and wide.  The floor is smooth for the most part, except for a small crack here and there.  The sound of rushing water is quite clear, and a refreshing breeze blows in from the opening to the west.

title: [Sea Cave, Limestone Cliff]
description: Your heart skips a beat as you look into the plummeting depths of the ravine below, into a lively, roiling underground river.  Above, the cave ceiling forms a dome with a jagged opening to the surface.  Through the opening, a narrow beam of silver light shines on the various rock formations and reflects off the mica deposits in glittering, hypnotic patterns.  A wide slab of rock spans the river, forming a natural bridge to the west side of the ravine.

Your heart skips a beat as you look into the plummeting depths of the ravine below, into a lively, roiling underground river.  Above, the cave ceiling forms a dome with a jagged opening to the surface.  Through the opening, a narrow beam of light shines on the various rock formations and reflects off the mica deposits in glittering, hypnotic patterns.  A wide slab of rock spans the river, forming a natural bridge to the west side of the ravine.

title: [Sea Cave, Stone Bridge]
description: From either side of this wide rock slab you can see the river rushing under you.  The dangerous speed of the current whips foam and spray around the rocks below.  You carefully stay away from the edges as you make your way to the other side.

title: [Sea Cave, Limestone Cliff]
description: You are on a broad limestone cliff between a towering wall of sheer rock and the deep river ravine.  The distant howl of wind and surf echoes dimly from outside.  It reverberates and booms until it sounds like the wailing of the damned.  The cliff curves around the wall to the southwest.  A crevice in the wall opens a passageway heading northwest.  The natural stone bridge provides a convenient way to cross the river.

You are on a broad limestone cliff between a towering wall of sheer rock and the deep river ravine.  The distant call of a seabird echoes dimly from outside.  It reverberates and booms until it sounds like the wailing of the damned.  The cliff curves around the wall to the southwest.  A crevice in the wall opens a passageway heading northwest.  The natural stone bridge provides a convenient way to cross the river.

title: [Sea Cave, Flat Area]
description: The floor of this low, dry chamber is spotted with holes; some of them shallow indentations a stride across and some deep fissures blacker than night.  One of the largest holes descends into a narrow passage.

title: [Sea Cave, Small Passage]
description: The walls and ceiling converge at a steep angle, and a faint musty smell adds to the cramped unpleasant feel of the place.  The rocks are dry and cold to the touch.

title: [Sea Cave, Dank Tunnel]
description: An odor of decay permeates the tunnel.  The entire floor is covered with flat round stones.  A stream of water trickles slowly down one of the walls collecting in small puddles that empty into a dark crevice between two of the stones.  The tunnel is blocked by a huge boulder.

title: [Sea Cave, Abandoned Lair]
description: As you drop through the crevice, your senses are assaulted by the foul stench that fills this cavernous room.  A pile of dried weeds and straw lies on the floor, and several stone shelves line the walls.  Water drips from a crack in the ceiling into a shallow basin carved into a rock.

title: [Sea Cave, Rocky Cavern]
description: Jagged stone teeth protrude from the floor beneath you, as though from the rotting jaw of a decaying giant.  As you make your way through the stalagmites, you notice one rough column of stone that extends over to a high ledge.
