title: [Sea Cave, Stone Forest]
description: This narrow pathway leads you away from the underground river through a grey forest of stone that is eerily quiet.  Towering stalagmites reach upward toward the high ceiling, and an acrid tang taints the air.

This narrow pathway leads you away from the underground river through a grey forest of stone that is eerily quiet.  Towering stalagmites reach upward toward the high ceiling.  Your echoing footsteps disturb something far above you, and you hear the rustle of leathery wings.

title: [Sea Cave, Narrow Path]
description: A cramped walkway cuts through solid walls of rock that are cold and slick with moisture.  Odd patterns that ripple in shades of grey and brown cover the walls, forming bizarre wraith-like images.

title: [Sea Cave, Waterfall Room]
description: Standing on a small ledge, you pause for a moment to take in the sight of a subterranean waterfall, tumbling and frothing in the furthest corner of the cave.  There is a large fissure between the boulders that line one of the walls.  Somewhere upstream, a hot spring has merged into the flow, and the water is surprisingly warm.  The room is comfortable, and a pleasant change from the dankness of the outer cave.

title: [Sea Cave, Behind Waterfall]
description: The rush of the waterfall cascading down into the black depths creates an oddly refreshing breeze, making you feel invigorated and somehow less weary.  The rock walls of this hidden room are pitted with holes and niches of different sizes, and the wall of water shimmers and dances before your eyes.

title: [Sea Cave, High Path]
description: From this high point, you can see clusters of stalagmites rising from the floor below.  A path continues up the ledge.  A fresh sea breeze wafts in from the high ceiling holes.

title: [Sea Cave, Steep Incline]
description: Numerous outcroppings on this steep incline provide convenient footholds.  The stone is dry and dusty.  You spot a small beetle scurrying nervously from rock to rock.

title: [Sea Cave, Waterfall Ledge]
description: You stare down at a multitude of tiny droplets dancing around the cascading waterfall below you.  A fresh breeze blows in from a crevice in the wall.  As you gaze around the room, a drawing, deeply chiseled into the rock wall, catches your eye.  A small stone shelf protrudes from the wall below the drawing.

title: [Sea Cave, Ocean Vista]
description: Balanced on a narrow ledge, you perch uneasily between the starry sky above and the raging waves below.  Argent moonlight gilds the swells, turning the seafoam into silver filigree.  Far out to sea something rises from the water, but in the darkness the nature of the thing is impossible to distinguish.

Balanced on a narrow ledge, you perch uneasily between the sky above and the raging waves below.  Gazing far out to sea you spy many soaring birds.  As they wheel and dive looking for their food, something rises out of the water and drags a helpless gull to its own doom.  The flock continues on, uncaring, unheeding.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: The strange song of the Sirenflower is more distinct and more eerie here.  Tree branches, heavy with the old growth and dripping with vines, seem to bend over in mourning.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: Broken stones, streaked grey with mold, are placed at regular intervals in small clearings beside the path.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: A plain and dreary little mausoleum of grime-streaked stone, pockmarked by erosion and damaged by looters, stands empty and abandoned in a small clearing by itself.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Mausoleum]
description: The interior of this mausoleum is dim, the air dry and stale.  It appears to have been carved and hollowed out of a solid stone outcropping, its construction keeping the contents free of rot and decay.  Primitive friezes in low bas relief cover the walls, telling of raging tides, storms and warriors lost at sea.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: Whitened bones are scattered carelessly to the side of an open pit.  Several broken boards lie scattered in and around the pit.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: You are standing in what is obviously a plundered grave.  Given the tools lying about in the muck, it would appear that the grave robbers were frightened off.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: Wildflowers spring up from the fertile earth, their seeds sown long ago by the now-dried husks of bouquets placed by loving hands across the graves of fathers, brothers, sons.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: Huddled trees throw long shadows over the gloomy clearing where fishwives and sailors' widows buried their dead.  Now and then a low, baleful howling can be heard in the distance.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: Isolated by a thicket of bramble bushes and all but hidden from view, one sturdy marker stands in proud solitude.  Carved in the shape of a sailing vessel borne aloft by a sea drake, it was most likely erected in memorial to those lost at sea.

title: [Underground Ruin, Entrance Hall]
description: You are in the northern end of a huge entrance hall.  It goes on to the south beyound the reach of your eyesight.  Your feet kick up small clouds of dust as you make your way around.  The smooth walls are covered with the faint rememberings of murals depicting great sea battles.

You are in the northern end of a huge entrance hall.  It goes on to the south beyond the reach of your eyesight.  Your feet kick up small clouds of dust as you make your way around.  The smooth walls are covered with the faint rememberings of murals depicting great sea battles.

title: [Underground Ruin, Entrance Hall]
description: The huge entrance hall continues both north and south.  The murals, however, cover only part way.  To the south, the painting is unfinished, lacking detail or, in some cases, the stone is not even primed.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Underground Ruin, Dining Hall]
description: This huge room seems to have been meant for grand entertainment.  There is a large fireplace, now caved in, on the south wall.  Sconces designed to hold torches line the walls but were obviously never used.  Oddly, there is no evidence of furnishings here.

title: [Underground Ruin, Fire Room]
description: Fitted stones cover every square foot of this room.  The entire east wall is nothing but a huge fireplace for cooking.  It seems very odd to you that there are no burn marks in the fireplace.

title: [Underground Ruin, Kitchen]
description: This room is cluttered with various food preparation tables that seem to have never been used.  Large bins used for washing food stand empty and rusting.  Pots and cauldrons are covered in dust.

title: [Underground Ruin, Cold Storage]
description: It's oddly chilly and very dry in here.  Sides of meat, whole birds and other food stuffs hang from the ceiling.  However, the cold and dry mummified them long ago.

title: [Underground Ruin, Cold Storage]
description: The faint smell of mold permeates the air here.  Dried out fruits and vegetables are piled in crates and bins stacked on the floor and on shelves all over the rooms.

title: [Underground Ruin, Worker's Dorm]
description: This large room contains many, many beds and footlockers.  Some tools are stacked neatly in wall mounted racks, while more litter the floor.

title: [Underground Ruin, Entrance Hall]
description: This is the southern most end of the entrance hall.  The walls are bare except for a few burnt out torches.  Flattened against the south wall is the mummified corpse of a guard.

title: [Underground Ruin, West Wing]
description: The stones in the floor are cracked and splintered looking as if some huge thing had tried to punch its way in from underneath.  The walls here show signs of great stress and the roof looks as if it will cave in at any moment.

title: [Underground Ruin, West Wing]
description: The walls here are unfinished.  Marks gouged deep into the rock suggest that the work was abandoned long before it was finished.  Tools lie scattered about the floor.  The dry air has kept them in remarkably good shape.

title: [Underground Ruin, West Wing]
description: This room is completely unfinished.  Obviously abandoned in the early stages of excavation the walls, floor, and ceiling are pock marked full of diggings.  At the west end, however, is a remarkably flat spot that seems very out of place.

title: [Underground Ruin, Excavation]
description: It looks as if this chamber was on its way to completion.  The south wall has been smoothed and a torch rests in a sconce there.

title: [Underground Ruin, Excavation]
description: You look upon a hideous sight.  Scores of twisted, broken skeletons are pressed against the rough hewn walls and floor.  It's as if they were swept in here by a great wind or wall of water.

title: [Underground, A Deep Pit]
description: You are in a deep pit.  The walls are smooth for the most part but enough roots have grown through to make some good hand and toe holds.  Above you, the trapdoor taunts you with visions of freedom.

title: [Underground Ruin, Antechamber]
description: This room is completely finished off.  The walls are smooth and polished.  The floor is covered with fitted stone.  The remains of rich tapestries and banners hang from hooks on the walls.  Ornate torch holders still cling to the walls.  Furniture is scattered around the room, some of it smashed, other pieces in good shape.

title: [Underground Ruin, Royal Bedroom]
description: A huge bed dominates the east wall of this room.  Along the other walls are a few armoires and low chests, all undamaged.  The occupant of the bed, however, was not as fortunate; while his body continues to rest in pieces, his head seems to have taken a walk.

title: [Underground Ruin, Bedchamber]
description: This small bedroom seems to have escaped the destruction of the outer areas.  It is decorated in what must have been light colors.  A fourposter bed, light furniture and faded tapestries decorate the chamber.  Against one wall is a lady's vanity.  All in all a very comfortable room.

title: [Underground, Hidden Wing]
description: The walls, floor and ceiling of this room are finished smooth.  Unlike other rooms, these surfaces are not covered with finished stones, but are polished to a dull luster.

title: [Underground, Hidden Wing]
description: The hallway here takes a ninety degree turn.

title: [Underground, Hidden Wing]
description: The walls here are absolutely smooth and featureless.  The uniform tone attempts to defeat your depth perception.

title: [Underground, Hidden Wing]
description: This appears to be a small shrine of some sort.  Against the east wall is an altar with tarnished religious symbols on it.  The covering is tattered and the three pews here are dry and rotted.  For the first time you notice that the thick dust on the floor is punctuated by shallow footprints, leading you to think that this place is not as abandoned as you first imagined.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The cavern's ceiling is lost in the cloying darkness above, and quiet dripping sounds rebound and echo about the massive chamber.  Two flickering torches are set upon the craggy grey walls, casting an uneasy light into the shadows that shrouds the chamber.  The air is mildly chilly deep within the embrace of the earth, and the faint scent of decaying flesh hangs in the air like a fog.

title: [Inking Den, Annex Hallway]
description: Frosted globes nestled within decorative wall sconces provide a steady glow of welcoming light down the long corridor.  The walls are hidden behind bright ivory white silk drapery, the soft ends of which pool upon the thick cerulean and azure carpet.  Built into opposing walls, a lacquered white door and a lacquered beige door part the drapery and have a trio of brightly glowing globes directly above their pointed, cinquefoil frames.

title: [Underground, Small Cavern]
description: A few hastily placed half-rotting timbers help to support the roof, and rough chunks of stone and dirt hacked from the tunnel cover most of the floor.  A few skeletons lie on the uneven dirt floor of the low cavern, their mouths agape and a few stringy bits of dirty hair still clinging to their pale yellow crowns.  Faint rivulets of muddy water trickle steadily down the rough walls, collecting in shallow puddles that seep across the chamber floor.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A cramped, narrow tunnel leads to the west, a faint scent of musty stone and stale air wafting from within.  A few scattered shards of bone lie half-buried in the dirt still heaped at the foot of the roughly cut walls.

title: [Underground Ruin, Sub-Basement]
description: A shallow puddle of fetid water spreads across the dirt floor, trickling down from the cracked walls of the long-abandoned basement.  Stacks of crates and boxes, long since emptied by looters, line the walls, and an old broken armoire stands doorless in one corner.

title: [Underground Ruin, Sub-Basement]
description: The timbers creak with the weight of the ruin above, almost threatening to collapse what remains of the old storage area.  Bits of cloth and other small remainders of the departed occupants lie mixed in with splinters of timber fallen from the rotting ceiling.  A dark iron oil lamp is affixed to the low ceiling, its flame long extinguished.

title: [Underground Ruin, Sub-Basement]
description: A few scattered bits of broken lumber surround a small trapdoor in the south wall, its surface scarred with raking claw marks and dark stains.  The room is littered with fallen beams leaning awkwardly against the walls and various other broken remnants of the prior inhabitants.

title: [Underground Ruin, Basement Pit]
description: Whirling motes of dust flicker in and out of sight as they pass through the faint beams of light filtering in through the broken trapdoor.  The air is stifling with mold and ancient decay, and a few yellowed scraps of bone litter the moist dirt floor.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The low, crudely dug tunnel to the east opens into a series of natural caves to the west, the dividing point a pale arch of solid limestone where the diggers broke through the cavern's wall.  Faint sounds of trickling water echo endlessly through the tunnels from the west and southwest, where the uneven tunnel floors slope downward.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Weblike trails of what appears to be long-dried seaweed hang from the craggy walls and ceiling, swaying gently in the chill breeze that permeates the curving tunnel.  A few scattered bits of metal lie half-imbedded in the floor, including a discarded and now rusted breastplate sealed to a narrow ledge by ages of mineral deposits.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel Intersection]
description: The tunnel branches off into three different directions here, and bits of broken pottery and wood litter the stone floor, left by some long-ago inhabitants or explorers.  A series of etched figures, their fluid shapes depicting sea creatures and other strange forms, are carved into the limestone walls.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Pieces of a few broken skulls lie discarded upon the ground where the tunnel curves sharply under a low patch of the ceiling.  Faint striations are visible in the dense rock, their greyish tones blending with the pale limestone and dried strands of vegetation in an elaborate shifting pattern.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Arcing limestone formations rise into a small dome-like natural chamber here, considerably less cramped than the low surrounding tunnels.  Patches of ever-growing stalactites spread across the ceiling, their small forms slowly releasing a steady trickle of water onto the floor.  Three tunnels lead into the darkness.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A single large stalactite hangs suspended overhead, more resembling a massive column than a formation of nature and the ages.  Faint bands of stylized patterns run around the pillar of stone, arcing across it in a series of converging loops.  A few ancient bones lie in piles near the walls, marking the four branches of the tunnels.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A small stream of brackish water flows in a narrow channel along the eastern base of the wall and disappears into a narrow crevice there, its gentle trickling sound echoing faintly through the cavernous chamber.  Bits of greenish mold have colonized the tiny ledges around the water, their slippery forms glistening in the dim light.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel widens into a yawning cavern, its pale grey walls festooned with small glowing patches of greenish lichen.  An arch of rock opens into a small cave in the northern wall, faint beams of light winking in and out of existence from within.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A few sparkling spokes of crystals protrude from the craggy ceiling, reflecting the faint light filtering into the area.  The tunnel turns sharply here, crossing into a sharp descent then beginning an ascent to the southwest.  Green and white lichen spreads across the rough floor, serving as a tattered and fuzzy carpet.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A delicate elven skull lies atop a shallow ledge which protrudes from the cave wall near the ceiling, sealed forever on its perch by the hardened trickle of thousands of years of mineral-rich water.  Tiny blind cave fish swim down the small stream that follows the cavern wall, flickering spots of iridescent white.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The patches of limestone stalactites hanging from the ceiling glitter like icicles, their tapered forms coated with a thin, glistening coat of slowly dripping water.  Pale green lichen lines the gaps between the natural structures, casting a soft, unearthly phosphorescent glow around the chamber.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The floor of the tunnel slopes upward, and a number of large stones lie piled against the walls in small, uneven pyramids.  The raised part of the cavern floor is dry and rough, and a few patches of moss, dried lichen and seaweed provide a mottled carpet.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The greyish stone of the ceiling above resembles a honeycomb of tiny holes and curving channels, its wavy natural patterns carved by ages of trickling moisture.  The air is dank and moist, and small puddles collect in shallow depressions in the floor, casting a faint whitish mist up from their surface.

title: [Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The constant faint dripping of water echoes from the darkness, rebounding through the vast network of caverns.  The little light that manages to filter into this dismal, dank chamber illuminates the prolific carvings scattered over the limestone walls.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Caverns, Chamber]
description: The narrow tunnel slopes downward to the northwest, riddled with slender columns of limestone that have slowly fused together over the ages.  Moisture hangs heavily in the air, and a musty odor of rotting seaweed permeates the dampness.

title: [Caverns, Chamber]
description: The center of the cavern rises high above into a natural dome, near enough to the surface that rays of moonlight filter in through cracks and fissures in its vast crown.  Subtle shifts in the hues of the uneven stone, from greens to greys to spots of bright white, lend an almost unnatural beauty to the cavern.  A continuous trickle of water drips here and there from the sloping ceiling, disappearing into damp crevices in the porous stone.

The center of the cavern rises high above into a natural dome, near enough to the surface that rays of sunlight filter in through cracks and fissures in its vast crown.  Subtle shifts in the hues of the uneven stone, from greens to greys to spots of bright white, lend an almost unnatural beauty to the cavern.  A continuous trickle of water drips here and there from the sloping ceiling, disappearing into damp crevices in the porous stone.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Caverns, Chamber]
description: A low, darkened tunnel branches off the main cavern to the west, its jagged opening almost resembling a gaping maw.  A few fragile stalactites have broken away from their brethren, lying broken in a damp puddle that collects at the tunnel's opening.

title: [Caverns, Chamber]
description: Seven crude limestone obelisks stand peculiarly out of place, apparently cut from nearby stalagmites and arranged into a small circle in some long-forgotten ceremony.  A towering chimney breaks the roof above the monoliths, allowing a distant glimpse of starlit sky.  As drafts of wind whistle downward through the stone passage, the higher galleries produce a resonant hum, culminating in an ethereal song that echoes throughout the cavern.

Seven crude limestone obelisks stand peculiarly out of place, apparently cut from nearby stalagmites and arranged into a small circle in some long-forgotten ceremony.  A towering chimney breaks the roof above the monoliths, allowing a distant glimpse of blue sky.  As drafts of wind whistle downward through the stone passage, the higher galleries produce a resonant hum, culminating in an ethereal song that echoes throughout the cavern.

title: [Caverns, Low Tunnel]
description: Phosphorescent moss grows profusely in streaks down the undulating stone walls and in saucer-shaped hollows along the rough cave floor, its pale glow almost making it appear as if the walls were melting.  The floor of the tunnel meanders downward to the northwest, where the darkness emits a faint scent of distant salt air.

title: [Caverns, Cave-in]
description: The uneven floor dips sharply at the northern end of the tunnel, where rivulets of dripping water have collected in a deep, clear pool.  The tunnel has long ago collapsed into a caved-in barrier of stone that half-fills the pool and blocks any further passage.  The tips of several stalagmites break the mirrored surface of the water like the spines of some enormous sea creature.

title: [Caverns, Ledge]
description: The spacious ledge is large enough for many people to make camp safely, but drops away to the west in a sheer precipice overlooking an expansive cavern below.  The cave stretches out farther than the eye can see in the dim shadows of deep subterranean structures and the faint glow of patches of phosphorescence below.  Now and then, unidentifiable forms move in the shifting darkness, the echoing sounds of footsteps and scratching indicating that they are more than a trick of the light.

title: [Caverns, Crystal Pool]
description: Spokes of quartz peek out from beneath a large, circular pool, the glassy water illuminated by an eerie glow filtering from above.  Pale white lichen hangs down from the ceiling, casting the chamber in a steady, faint light that shimmers with a rainbow luminescence.  The crystals within the pool continually reflect the unearthly, pristine light, sending off fractured beams across the chamber like twinkling stars.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Small Room]
description: You find yourself in a small roughly hewn room.  There are signs of recent excavation; however, the room appears to have been abandoned in a hurry.  To the south, the digging has revealed a natural tunnel.  A faint luminescence emanates from the tunnel opening.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel descends gently downwards and to the south.  The walls are covered in a strange green moss, which glows with an eerie luminescence.  Just ahead, the tunnel opens into a brightly-lit cavern.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Cave]
description: The ground levels out here and a large cave opens before you.  Glowing moss grows from the ceiling and walls, bathing the entire area in a soft yellow light.  A pair of side passages lead out of the cave, one to the southeast and the other to the southwest.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The air in this portion of the tunnel is very still.  The tunnel walls seem to have been worn smooth by an underground river, long since dried up.  A sandy path continues southeast into the gloom, and the tunnel seems to brighten towards the northwest.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The silence here is almost absolute.  Patches of glowing moss sprout from the tunnel walls and cast a dim light on the sandy passage.  Strange impressions in the sand leave you wondering what might inhabit these lonely tunnels.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A heavy coating of silt has covered the tunnel floor and walls here.  A faint breeze flows past you, kicking up small dust clouds at your feet.  To the southeast, you hear a strange noise in the distance.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A strong wind blows past you from the south end of the tunnel.  Pieces of glowing moss ride on the wind, illuminating the passage with small, dancing lights.  The faint sound of something wailing can be heard to the south.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A shrieking wind from the south carries clouds of fine debris through the passage, making vision difficult at best.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A soft breeze flows gently past you, carrying a slight scent of sulfur.  Patches of glowing lichen and mushrooms grow from the tunnel floor casting a dim light on your surroundings.  You notice the tunnel brighten towards the northeast.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The odor of sulfur is strong here.  Faint wisps of steam rise from small cracks in the tunnel floor and catch the luminous glow of the ever-present moss.  Small beads of water drip from the ceiling, landing in murky puddles at your feet.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Clouds of steam pour into this section of the tunnel from an opening to the southwest.  The floors are slick with moisture and moss, making footing treacherous at best.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Hot Springs]
description: The tunnel expands here into a small cave.  Yellow strands of vapor rise towards the ceiling from a large natural hot spring in the center of the cavern.  Steam pours from several fissures in the ground surrounding the spring, and the air is warm and humid.  You notice two holes in the ceiling that the steam seems to escape through.  Strangely, the holes do not look natural.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel walls here seem to have taken on a hewn look.  Boiling water pours out of a small fissure in the ground and flows south in a handmade channel.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Thin rivulets of water spill from small crevices in the tunnel walls.  The water feeds into a small channel that flows south and disappears into the gloom.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel begins to widen out here.  A small crevice in the ground swallows a thin rivulet of water that flows in from the north.  To the southeast, you notice the tunnel opens into the darkness.

title: [Mossy Caverns]
description: To the east, a massive cavern opens before you.  To the north and south someone has planted rows of glowing moss, which stretch off into the distance.  A well-used trail runs east through the glowing fields.  To the northwest, you see a tunnel opening in the cavern wall.

title: [Mossy Caverns]
description: You notice the surrounding moss fields seem well tended.  Water slowly pumps out of small fissures in the ground and flows into several irrigation channels.  The trail continues east and west.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Pool]
description: The trail skirts a large pool of water here.  A stone bridge spans the pool and ends at what appears to be a small stone shrine.  The trail continues both east and west.

title: [Mossy Caverns]
description: A massive cavern opens before you.  North and south, fields of glowing moss grow in what appears to be a well tended farm.  A worn trail runs west through the fields.  To the northeast, you see a tunnel opening in the cavern wall.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Small patches of glowing moss sprout from the tunnel walls here.  From the north, you hear a screeching wail that makes your skin crawl.  Southwest, the tunnel appears to open into a massive cavern.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Cave]
description: The passage widens out here to form a small cave.  Heavy gusts of wind flow from dozens of small openings in the south end of the cave. The holes in the cave have created a natural organ and a symphony of wailing notes fill the area.  Bits of glowing moss swirl on the wind creating a dazzling display of light and sound.

title: [Mossy Caverns, Shrine]
description: Seven monoliths form a crude triangle in this room.  Thin beams of wood with glowing vines growing on them have been placed on the top of the stones.  The strange canopy and silent stone guardians seem to lend the shrine a dark sense of security.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The surrounding hillsides become increasingly steep to the northwest and the trees and grasses are considerably sturdier in that direction.  To the east, the hills become more gentle and rolling and the grasses lusher.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Dried leaves, whipped into frenzied action by the winds, dance and swirl in seemingly choreographed patterns on the ground and in the air before you.  A fascinating sight, indeed.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The charred remains of an old shack, now overgrown and collapsed, stand just off the trail to the west.  Surrounding the shack can be seen the tools and implements generally used for farming, though now they are rusted or broken beyond use.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Though several of the trees in this area are quite large, one in particular attracts your attention.  It is a magnificent oak standing at least fifty feet taller and considerably larger in diameter than any of the surrounding trees.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Oak and maple trees mingle freely here, with their green and yellowing leaves forming a whispering canopy overhead.  The closely grown trees begin to thin somewhat towards the south, as if fearing to grow.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Several large pits are clearly visible in this area.  They have apparently been caused by the uprooting of several of the oak and maple trees that grow here.  One of these pits now serves as the entrance to an exceptionally small cave.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, west

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Coarse grasses and shrubs struggle for existence on the rocky slopes of the surrounding hills.  Large pieces of limestone rest in precarious positions on the steep slopes and seem to be waiting for the opportunity to crash to the floor below.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A lone fir tree clings to the rocky slope, its gnarled roots seeking across the stony hillside for pockets of soil.  Chunks of chalk-white limestone are strewn about, apparently having tumbled down from the summit.  The trail forges straight up the slope, heedless of your aching legs.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The hillside is steep here and the trail is rougher.  Rocky patches thrust up into the moonlight where the earth has been worn away.  The fir trees here are smaller and more twisted than the ones lower down.

The hillside is steep here and the trail is rougher.  Rocky patches thrust up into the sunlight where the earth has been worn away.  The fir trees here are smaller and more twisted than the ones lower down.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Several ancient trees have been felled in an obviously haphazard manner and now lie rotting on the rocky slopes of the steep hills.  A particularly interesting jumble of rocks leads up to the blackened entrance of a cave.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Several well used trails come together in this hushed area of the forest.  The occasional chirp of a distant bird does little to lift the oppressive blanket of silence that hangs heavy in the air.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The steep hills of this area seem to crouch in waiting as the trail runs surprisingly straight in a east to west direction.  The condition of the trail shows that someone or something makes frequent use of this thoroughfare.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: An eerie silence hangs over this area and the branches of the many trees that grow here seem to droop with a sort of melancholy appearance.  Rusted weapons and tattered armor can also be seen here.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A crude structure, possibly an altar, has been erected here.  The ground in this area has been worn smooth by the stomping of many feet.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Several of the large trees that stand sentinel over this area have been badly bashed and battered by a blunt object swung or thrown with immense force.  Scores of smaller trees and bushes have been uprooted and now lie dead upon the ground.  Even the rocks of the area appear to have been hurled about like the toys of a child.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Bones of animals and odd bits and pieces of litter are scattered about this area.  Leading up to a small opening in the hillside stands a crude ladder.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: An expanse of grassy meadow stretches before you, a lake of green bounded by grayish firs.  Bright golden butterflies flit among the flowers that dot the grass.  A pile of churned earth to one side marks a gopher's back door.  A trail winds through the trees to the northeast, and curves around to a gentle climb up a hill to the southeast.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail winds back and forth across the face of the hill, skirting several small pools.  A bluejay thrashes around in one of the pools, happily bathing.  Fir trees march up the hill, following the trail.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The high rolling hills clearly visible to the south and east have become a surprisingly flat and open plain.  A faint trail heads off to the west towards an area of tall grass and odd shaped trees.  In the distance, the gentle winding course of a river is visible, marked by the flickering reflections glancing off its surface.

title: [Burned Shack]
description: There is little to be seen in this charred husk of a building.  Everything has been burned and blackened, most beyond recognition.  Even the stones seem to have been distorted by the heat and flame that obviously raged here.

title: [Arboreal Platform]
description: This sturdy platform seems to have served as a vantage point for someone or something.  From here is commanded a magnificent view of the surrounding countryside as well as a leafy alcove protected from spying eyes and silvery moon.

This sturdy platform seems to have served as a vantage point for someone or something.  From here is commanded a magnificent view of the surrounding countryside as well as a leafy alcove protected from spying eyes and blazing sun.

title: [Cave Entrance]
description: Tucked in the nooks and crannies of the pile of rock that leads down to the trail below are bits of shiny metal and broken shards of brightly enameled pottery.  A few animal bones, which have been gnawed clean, are also visible.

title: [Cave]
description: The huge entrance of the cave is terribly deceiving as the cave itself is relatively small.  This large room, and the room that lies to the northwest, are all that make up this small cavern.

title: [Cave]
description: Shreds of bright cloth hang on rough hooks above the broken furniture of this small chamber.  Household goods, stolen from the early settlers of this region and in various states of cleanliness and repair, are also scattered about.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Thick bladed grasses grow to staggering height in this area, but they fail to hide the twisted and scorched trees that stand here.  Apparently some devasting catastrophe bent these once regal trees into their present grotesque shapes.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Abruptly, the tall grass ceases to grow in a wide circular area, giving the land a barren and alien appearance.  Patches of tough grass poke their way through dry earth irregularly across this makeshift plain.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This small and uncharacteristically flat expanse of land surrounds the crumbling remnants of a once great tower that still manages despite its great age to stand tall.  Stones and rocks, some natural, some part of the original construct lie scattered around the landscape.  A rotted log stretches over the moat, leading shakily up to the battered and time weary doors which hang awkwardly from their hinges.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Grass grows in scrubby patches around the ruined tower, struggling for life amid fallen stonework.  The moat, colored of dark sludge, provides possible concealment for all manner of black things, though it is a wonder anything could live in the thick muck.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The tower holds your gaze as you traverse this strangely flat plain amid the scattered hills.  Made of dull gray stone, the decaying structure is a patchwork of subtle dark hues contrasted against the sky.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Muted crunching sounds greet your steps in your following of the trail surrounding the tower.  Upon inspection you note that bones litter the flatland here, partially obscured by scrub grass and fallen stonework.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: High above you, crumbled battlements draw your attention, a possible glint of steel flashing in your eyes.  An observation balcony high above, or its remains, juts part way over the black moat.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Unnoticed to you before, a flag, now tattered beyond all recognition, flies from the tower's highest point: mute testimony to the age of the structure.  Your path picks its way among stones and grass, each seeming to fight the other for the right to exist in this strange land.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Stretching high and somehow still majestic in its dilapidated state, the tower touches the sky.  A fine watchpost it might have once made, or the makeshift prison for a beautiful maiden.  The stark gray structure seems to mock you with its silence, daring you to find its secret.

title: [Tower]
description: Precious little room is available for standing on this side of the moat.  Scant steps separate you from the dangerous log bridge and the sagging wooden doors of the tower, which rudely bear the nicks and cuts reminiscent of blademarks as well as the ravages of age.

title: [Littered Ledge]
description: This narrow ledge is covered with garbage and trash of nearly every shape, size and description imaginable.  You recognize the craftsmanship of most of the known races of Elanthia in the broken shards of pottery, the rusting and useless weaponry and the faded scraps of cloth.  Extending to the floor of the valley below is a crude ladder while to the north can be seen the darkened entrance to a large cave.

title: [Cave, Sandy Floor]
description: The sandy floor of this cave is cool to the touch and smells damp.  The sound of dripping water can be heard from within the cave.

title: [Cave, Roaring Room]
description: The sound of your breathing seems to be amplified by the curved walls and ceiling of this chamber.  The resulting roar is somewhat disturbing as it seems to come from all directions at once.

title: [Cave, Bat Room]
description: A few small bats cling to the high ceiling of this room, waiting for the coming of night so they may venture out for their nightly forage of insects.  One or two of them peep quietly as you pass, but they remain suspended from their lofty perches.  The remaining bats seem blissfully unaware of your presence.

title: [Cave, Spider Room]
description: A large cave spider scurries into an attack position far above your head.  Though not nearly as big as the great spiders that can be found near the sea, it is still of sufficient size to inject a lethal dose of venom.  Bound securely in its huge web are the silent corpses of several creatures that learned this lesson far too late.

title: [Cave, Drip Room]
description: Water drips from the ceiling of this room with a rhythmic, almost hypnotizing, cadence.  The air is damp and heavy but the smell of "cave perfume" is nearly as intoxicating as a strong ale.

title: [Cave, Sharp Bend]
description: The passage and room in this part of the cave bends back sharply on itself.  It is as if nature had a change of mind when this cave was being formed.

title: [Cave, Root Room]
description: A large clump of roots hangs from the ceiling of this room.  Apparently this chamber is relatively close to the surface.

title: [Cave, Living Room]
description: A few broken pieces of furniture clutter this small chamber.  Whoever (or whatever) lives here is certainly not tidy.  Piles of half-eaten food and bits of garbage are scattered among the ratty furniture.

title: [Cave, Rimstone Dam]
description: The passage and chamber quickly become too narrow for you to continue further, though a small crevice in the north wall does allow a small trickle of water to exit in that direction.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A huge ring of blackened and scorched stones sits in the center of this small clearing.  Scattered about can be seen the bones and belongings of a score of creatures and beings.  To the north, the river cuts a wide blue ribbon through the landscape before disappearing between the thick trees and the foothills.  Leading out of the clearing is a wide trail.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Huge trees huddle close together here and little light filters through the dense crown of lush foliage.  Nearly hidden in the deep shadows, and well off the trail, is a tall wooden obelisk.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail winds around the base of a large grassy hill as it passes through this region.  To the north can be seen a tract of thickly wooded forest while further east is a flat, relatively open, stretch of land.

title: [Cave, Entrance]
description: A large opening in the rock face of the north wall of this cliffside has been covered with a few scraps of roughly cured leather.  Apparently this leather was meant to serve as a crude door to the obvious cave behind it.

title: [Cave, Intersection]
description: Several large passageways converge here near the opening to the cave.  A crude leather flap covers the way out, and to the west you hear the distant sound of dripping water.  A foul stench, which seems to be coming from the north, permeates the air of this room.  To the northwest, a well travelled passage leads back into darkness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, west, northwest, out

title: [Cave, Something Room]
description: The slow moving air seems to be carrying the odor of decaying flesh as it moves towards the mouth of the cave to the south.  Scattered about this small room are the dessicated remains of several...somethings.

title: [Cave, Litter Room]
description: The bones of animals, bits of bright colored cloth, a few scraps of odd metal and some broken pottery shards litter the floor of this room.  It could be a storeroom.  Or it could be a garbage pit.

title: [Cave, Rat Room]
description: The quiet scurrying of tiny feet and the hushed peeps that fill the air tell you that you've stumbled into a lair of small rats.  The smell of rotting flesh is quite strong here.  Apparently the rats don't lack a food supply.

title: [Cave, Bear Room]
description: A small hole in the ceiling of this chamber appears to be the source of the moving air.  Apparently the differential temperatures between the mouth of the cave, the cave itself and the air above the hole are causing the movement.

title: [Cave, Pantry]
description: Several baskets of fruit (most of it rotted to the point of being inedible) are heaped in the nooks and crannies of this large room.  A low ledge runs along the west wall of the chamber and seems to serve as a crude larder.

title: [Cave, Markings Room]
description: A pot of putrid dye and a few sticks with colored ends collect dust on the floor of this room.  Crude markings, the same color as the dye on the sticks, mark one wall and part of the ceiling of the chamber.

title: [Cave, Ledge]
description: This narrow ledge is at least twenty feet above the floor of the high ceilinged room.  From here you have a good view of the room itself and the jumble of stones that provide access to the floor below.

title: [Cave, Vaulted Chamber]
description: A narrow ledge is perched high on the north wall of this vaulted chamber.  Several large rocks have been moved from other parts of the room and now rest in a jumble directly beneath the ledge.

title: [Cave, Pool]
description: A slow drip of water falls from the ceiling of this room and into a pool that ripples quietly near the south wall.  Several cups, many of surprising craftsmanship and beauty, lie around the edges of the pool.

title: [Cave, Wood Pile]
description: The smell of smoke hangs heavy in the air here.  Stashed in a wide crack that splits the north wall is a pile of wood that has been hurridly stacked.  A few bones, some with scraps of meat still attached, are strewn about the room.

The smell of smoke hangs heavy in the air here.  Stashed in a wide crack that splits the north wall is a pile of wood that has been hurriedly stacked.  A few bones, some with scraps of meat still attached, are strewn about the room.

title: [Cave, Living Quarters]
description: This is apparently the living quarters of whoever or whatever lives in this cave.  A few sticks of crude furniture, some rough leather clothing and a firepit are the only contents of the small room.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Great blocks of stone thrust out of the earth all about you as you pick your way across the jagged landscape.  Here and there, a patch of crinkly lichen clings to the pale gray stone, but other than that, this area is devoid of plant life.  You hear a faint skittering in the distance, and think of claws on rock.  You glance around nervously, wondering what lives here.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Winds have scoured the dirt from the rocks in this area, polishing them til they're so white they almost shine.  The smooth surfaces gleam, glaring in your eyes, making them water.  You squint, shading your eyes with your hands, as you pick your way carefully across.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trees are few here, and the largest is barely more than a sapling.  Spiky bushes clump together in splotches, a large group forming a thicket to the east.  A hill rises up to the southeast, the bushes thinning out as the land rises.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You reach the summit of the hill and enter an alpine meadow.  The expanse of short grass suggests that a flock of shopai usually graze here, and indeed have grazed here recently, but the rich pasture is empty.  A crooked gray shack stands on one side of the meadow, barely more than a lean-to.  Shepherds should shelter there during this time of year, but it too is deserted.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You push through the bushes heading toward the vine-covered mound.  The thick foliage around you obscures most of the light, and you squint into the gloomy shadows.  Up close, you see that the mound is actually a wagon.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Higher up the mountain, the chill wind carries a hint of snow.  Lacy ice crystals twinkle in the shadows under bushes and beside rocks.  Frilly moss outlined with glittering frost, clings to the stones and softens the edges of their shadows against the deeper black of the night.

Higher up the mountain, the chill wind carries a hint of snow.  Lacy ice crystals twinkle in the shadows under bushes and beside rocks.  Frilly moss, outlined with glittering frost, clings to the rock.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: There are no bushes here -- the cold and altitude keep such plants to the lower slopes.  A variety of mosses and lichens spread over the bare rock faces, wherever the thin soil has been stripped away by the wind.  Upslope, you notice a large dark spot on the side of the mountain.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Glatoph]
description: Here, within a thousand feet of the summit, you see a tunnel leading into the mountain.  The tunnel mouth is a perfectly rectangular patch of pure black against the cliff face.  A thick steel door, its twisted and mangled hinges bright in the moonlight, lies on the ground in front of the opening like a bridge or a welcome mat.

Here, within a thousand feet of the summit, you see a tunnel leading into the mountain.  The tunnel mouth is perfectly rectangular, as though it were deliberately carved out.  A thick steel door lies on the ground in front of the opening like a bridge or a welcome mat, its hinges and bolt twisted and mangled.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This passage leads straight into the mountain.  The walls, floor and ceiling are covered with steel, smoothly and without seam.  There's enough steel in here to make weapons and armor for every man, woman, child, rolton, rat and canary in Elanith.  To the south is a rectangular opening, with a steel door fallen over the threshold.  The tunnel goes north into the mountain.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: Your steps ring on the steel floor as you move down this bare corridor.  There are no doors, no corners, nothing to mar the dull, featureless steel.  The shadowy tunnel goes north and south.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This intersection leads east, west, and south.  The north wall is covered with steel for a double-armspan in either direction, beyond which point the steel gives way to dull grey stone.  None of the passages has any distinguishing feature to help you select one over the other.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is an intersection in a dull grey corridor.  Passages lead in three directions.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is an intersection in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the east wall, and passages lead in three directions.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is a bend in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the east wall, and passages lead northwest and south.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is an intersection in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the east wall, and passages lead in three directions.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is an intersection in a dull, grey corridor.  Passages lead off in three directions.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: Sagging shelves and collapsed cabinets fill what once served as a storeroom.  Various items litter the room, all of them seemingly rusty, rotten, shredded, mildewed, or otherwise rendered useless by the passage of time.  A thick layer of dust covers everything, and is stirred up in clouds with every move you make.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is an intersection in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the west wall, and passages lead in three directions.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is a bend in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the west wall, and passages lead northeast and south.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is a bend in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the north wall, and an arch on the south wall.  Passages lead southwest and east.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is a bend in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the north wall and an arch in the south wall.  Passages lead west and southeast.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This is an intersection in a dull grey corridor.  There's a door on the west wall, and passages lead in three directions.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: Three chairs and a small couch are grouped around a rectangular table in the center of this room.  Two of the chairs and the table have collapsed, and all the upholstery is mouldy.  Rodents have gnawed holes in the upholstery and made off with most of the stuffing.  A mosaic, faded and filthy, is set into the south wall over a small fireplace.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This grand hall still echoes with the ghosts of powerful people and momentous happenings.  A great firepit dominates the center of the room, its sides lined with ceramic tiles.  A steel block sits next to the table, waist-high and as long as a man is tall.  A hammer-shaped impression is left in the dust, but there doesn't seem to be a hammer in the room.  Twenty niches are set into the walls, each with a panel in the back.  One of the panels has collapsed, revealing a lifesized steel statue.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: A long wooden table stretches the length of this room.  A grand, tall-backed chair sits at the head, while benches are placed along the sides.  The chair is moldy and dusty, and is missing an arm.  One of the benches has fallen over, and the other has collapsed.  The table is still standing, but doesn't look terribly steady.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This looks like a dining hall of some sort.  Two long plank tables with benches sit in the middle of the room.  They're coated with dust, and look like they'll collapse if you put too much weight on them.  A huge fireplace takes up most of the western wall.  Piles of wood that were probably once shelves fixed to the wall lie amid various rusty and dented cooking implements.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: The wreckage of several bunk beds and a few chairs lie heaped around this small room.  There probably wasn't much room to walk in here even before the furniture was destroyed -- now you can't get past the doorway without climbing over splintered boards.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: Four bunk beds are stuffed into this small room.  A chair sits next to each bed, jammed against the bed next to it, and a set of shelves, empty now, are attached to the north wall.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: A wooden seat with a hole in it is the only feature of this small room.  Any odor usually associated with such a room has long since dissipated.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: A huge bed dominates this room, its shredded canopy sagging off its frame.  Two upholstered chairs, their fabric rotted and stuffing scattered, sit in front of the large fireplace that takes up most of the west wall.  A wardrobe full of rotted grey silk robes stands in a corner.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: This appears to be an office, with a desk and two chairs, and a cabinet.  A rotted carpet covers the floor, and there's a small fireplace on the east wall.  The empty cabinet stands open, its doors having fallen off long ago.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: Shelves of books fill this room, lining the walls and standing in the middle of the floor to form narrow aisles.  Uncounted years of rats and mice and cold and damp and dust have taken their toll, to the point where the books fall apart at a touch.  Pity -- some of the titles look VERY interesting.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: Two cots and a chair stand alone in this room.  The cots have been stripped of bedcovers, and the chair's back is lying on the floor next to the chair.  Two rectangular impressions in the dust indicate where two chests used to sit.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: Two cots, two chests and a chair are the only furnishings in this room.  One chest is empty, the other is full of rotten cloth and dead moths.  The beds are made, but there is dust all over everything.

title: [Glatoph, Ruins]
description: Low tables line the walls of this room.  Shards of broken glassware are scattered everywhere, as are sheets of parchment too faded to read.  Colorful stains are splashed on the floor and furniture, and a round black mark on a wall around the wreckage of an oven suggests an explosion.  An intricate balance is bolted to one of the tables, and an assortment of weights is scattered across the floor.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: A sheer outcropping of granite rises high above the ice, blotting out the stars with its solid grey mass.  The outcropping forms a sharp ridge that curves around from west to north to east, its sheer sides scoured down by centuries of grinding ice.

A sheer outcropping of granite rises high above the ice, dominating the skyline with its solid grey mass.  The outcropping forms a sharp ridge that curves around from west to north to east, its sheer sides scoured down by centuries of grinding ice.

title: [Watchtower, Foyer]
description: Crafted entirely of limestone, this vaulted room is adorned with pennants and banners depicting the allies of Solhaven as well as the H.E.R.T. coat of arms.  Deep blue rolton wool rugs stretch the expanse of the oak floor and provide a cushion for the room's centerpiece, a replica of the Sea Wolf.  Beneath the supports of a circular staircase are some wide double doors leading to the courtyard beyond, while a crest-adorned oak door leads to the streets.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: A large shadow looms out of the blizzard to the north, implying that a hill stands in that direction.  It seems to funnel the wind, directing the icy blasts directly at you.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The path to the east is blocked by a huge spire of ice.  Instead of lessening the wind here, it seems to pour it down onto you with arctic ferocity, howling and swirling.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Blinking a few times to clear the frost from your eyelashes, you can see a huge ice spire to the east.  It seems to be directing the wind right at you, making any loose cloth snap and flutter wildly.  Keeping your balance is something of a challenge with the gale attempting to throw you over.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: You have begun to wonder if the realm of the demonic has indeed frozen over, and if you have perhaps stumbled into it, as there seems to be no end to the fields of ice you walk through.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The howling of the wind resounds through your head, lulling you into a half-trance as you stumble over the ice.  The flying ice and snow pelting you leave you as numb in body as the wind has left you in mind, leading your thoughts downward in a spiral of near hopelessness.  Night seems absolute here, and try as you might to recall it, the memory of the sun's warmth eludes you.

The howling of the wind resounds through your head, lulling you into a half-trance as you stumble over the ice.  The flying ice and snow pelting you leave you as numb in body as the wind has left you in mind, leading your thoughts downward in a spiral of near hopelessness.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Ice crumbles from under your feet as you stand at the edge of the chasm, falling too far for you to see them hit the bottom.  It is obvious that the glacier is not very solid here, making it a dangerous place to stand.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The opposite edge of the abyss is a bit closer here than in other areas.  It is possible that you could jump over it, given the wind at your back and a bit of luck.  However, with the wind conditions as unpredictable as they are, you do not want to chance it.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: A strange whistling sound is carried on the wind, adding an eerie overtone to the howling.  You cannot imagine what might make that sound, but whatever it is you hope it is not alive and hungry this night.
A strange whistling sound is carried on the wind, adding an eerie overtone to the howling.  You cannot imagine what might make that sound, but whatever it is you hope it is not alive and hungry.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, northwest

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: A mournful whistle fills your ears, issuing from a narrow hole in the glacier.  The wind passes over the breach, coaxing the hollow wail into the air.  A totem stands on either side of the hole, silent guardians amidst the wind's song.

title: [Inside the Glacier]
description: Roughly carved from the strangely clear ice, the hall you stand in leads off to the southeast and southwest.  Your breath streams before you in the cold, still air, and the sounds of the wind howling outside the hole make you very glad you are not out there.

title: [Inside the Glacier]
description: Light from somewhere on the surface refracts through the walls and shines in this room, dimly illuminating it.  Your eyes adjust to the reflected moonlight and you see multicolored streaks of light dancing along the walls.

Light from somewhere on the surface refracts through the walls and shines in this room, sending shimmering rainbows across the walls.  Your eyes are dazzled by the sight, and you can see multicolored stars even when you close them.

title: [Inside the Glacier]
description: The air here is somehow more still than in the other parts of the halls.  It is difficult to break the silence, and you find yourself moving more quietly than you usually do.  A long set of what can only be called stairs leads further down into the glacier.

title: [Inside the Glacier]
description: Rows of icicles line the walls, creating sheets of glistening spikes and spires.  The effect of the light playing off the icicles is spectacular, certainly worth standing in the cold for.

title: [Shrine]
description: The chamber is a huge circular cavity within the ice.  Icicles drip from the walls, giving the area a severe beauty in the cold light shining through from somewhere in the glacier.  Centered in the room is a huge ice totem, a dominating presence that makes you feel small and very mortal.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Sleet blows in your face, cutting visibility even more than the darkness would account for.  You feel your way across the slope, picking your way carefully around cracks and cliff edges.
Sleet blows in your face, cutting visibility down to about zero.  You feel your way across the slope, picking your way carefully around cracks and cliff edges.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: You reach a spot at the base of an ice-covered cliff.  The cliff blocks most of the wind, but the temperature is still far colder than you care to contemplate.  This might be a good place to rest a while, if you can manage to keep your feet on the icy rock.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: A sheer ice cliff rises before you, its wind-scoured surface perfectly smooth and reflecting the chilly glitter of the stars.  The ice is marred by a dark gash that leads into a tunnel.  The opening seems to slope down into the mountain.

A sheer white cliff rises before you, its frozen surface perfectly smooth, scoured by the wind.  The ice is marred by a dark gash that leads into a tunnel.  The opening seems to slope down into the mountain.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: The footing is slick in this icy tunnel.  The slope is gentle, but enough to give you trouble.  Your boots slip and slide no matter how carefully you step.  Above you, an opening reveals the season's constellations.  Curiously, the tunnel below seems lit with a luminescence of its own.

The footing is slick in this icy tunnel.  The slope is gentle, but enough to give you trouble.  Your boots slip and slide no matter how carefully you step.  Above you, an opening leads to glaring daylight.  Below, the tunnel continues into the dark.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: This area is illuminated by some light source you can't identify.  The light glares on the ice, reflecting off the walls, floor and ceiling.  You squint, your eyes watering.

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Reflections off of the ice dazzle your eyes.  Shivering with the cold, you can barely make out four passages leading out in different directions.  Nothing stands out to distinguish this chamber from dozens just like it.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Tunnel of Trees]
description: Thick, low-hanging branches force you on your belly and you find yourself having to wiggle your way under them.  Fortunately, the ground is relatively clear and covered in soft grass, making your worst worry fall into the range of the odd grass stain.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Before you lies the remnants of an old graveyard, long forgotten by living folk.  Trees and other plant life have moved their way across the old field, in many places pushing the ancient markers from their original resting places.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Skirting the field, a simple path leads you east along the edge of a few fading gravesites.  The abandoned plots may have once had markers, but there is no remaining evidence of them.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Dark shapes from towering pines weave their way across the path as it begins bending to the southeast.

Shadows from towering pines weave their way across the path as it begins bending to the southeast.  The criss-cross of patterns along the ground stirs up memories of stained glass mosaics which lend a certain sad reverence to this forgotten field.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: A rough path winds around the edge of this long-forgotten graveyard.  Most of the area seems filled with trees which have pushed their way through the field with little regard for the dead.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: A dark canopy of leaves hangs low, almost making you feel the need to stoop to protect your head.  The tunnel of foliage splits off in three directions.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Rows upon rows of decrepit, wooden grave markers line the field.  Most of the markers have been surrounded by foliage which seems to have grown almost unnaturally thick throughout the area.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: A huge stone marker next to the path stands completely out of place in this former potter's field.  Encroaching trees have tried to uproot it, but in this case the immense stone has won the battle.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Dirt and rubble are scattered along the path.  A rotting wooden marker draws your attention, but upon closer inspection you see that whatever was written upon it has long since vanished from its face.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Old stone markers are strewn about the field, many overturned and broken.  Only a few have writing on them and those that do are faded and near unreadable.  One marker stands out from the others alongside the path.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Ruined graves line the path as it winds its way eastward.  The ground is torn and broken as if something, or someone, ripped its way up from beneath the graves.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Huge towering oaks have burst out of the ground making what must have been a quiet, solemn graveyard into the chaotic shambles that it is today.  Toppled markers, some still leaning against the trunks of the intruding trees, are the only clue that once, long ago, this field was a simple resting place for the dead.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: A pile of dead trees blocks any further progress west, but a smaller path winds in from the south.  Just over the pile, you think you see some sort of large stone object.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: The path opens up into a field of knotted trees.  Dying leaves cover the ground at your feet, making every step an audible report of your movement.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: A particularly large oak intrudes upon the path with its enormous roots reaching out as if to grasp the pathway and pull it right out of the ground.  A small stone marker has been uprooted next to the oak, pushed aside by the gnarled wooden growth.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Dark, leafy branches reach out across the path to the northeast, forming a tunnel of foliage.  The ground is mottled with thick patches of grass, each a separate island along the river of dirt.

Dark, leafy branches reach out across the path to the northeast, forming a shadowy tunnel of foliage.  The ground is mottled with thick patches of grass, each a separate island along the river of dirt.

title: [Ruined Potter's Field]
description: Branches from the trees arch over the path creating a cave-like tunnel which ends at the foot of a huge oak tree.  A curious relic of petrified wood hangs from one of the oak branches.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Winding Trees]
description: Dark roots tear their way up through the ground, making the path much more difficult to traverse.  You hear the incessant chirp of an unseen small bird somewhere above your head.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Winding Trees]
description: Moonlight shines though the dense branches from above, striking the ground around you.  The columns of pale light seem to form their own tiny forest within the larger forest of trees.
Light shines though the dense branches from above, striking the ground around you.  The bright columns of golden light seem to form their own tiny forest within the larger forest of trees.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Winding Trees]
description: A dense wall of thick fog covers the path to the southeast making it impossible to venture further in that direction.  You feel an odd stirring of mana within it that makes you uneasy, as if it were somehow alive and aware of your presence.

title: [Tree Grove]
description: The trees seem more carefully placed within this pocket of forest.  Lush and resilient against the encroaching cold of Glatoph, they bring a welcome warmth to the wood.

title: [Above the Grove]
description: The trees part to form a pocket opening on the hill just above the grove.  Underbrush creeps into the path fullfilling nature's effort to erase the presense of past visitors.  Situated at the edge of the overlook is a large grey pedestal with a massive lens mounted on it.  A tall steel lever protrudes from the pedestal to the left of the lens, and a short grey mithril crank rises up on its right.

title: [Hidden Settlement]
description: Two small tents flank the path as it splits to the southeast and southwest and you note a pair of eyes watching you quietly from inside one of them.  Silence prevails here as even the wind blowing lightly through the trees is a barely audible whisper.

title: [Hidden Settlement]
description: Various odds and ends hang from the elaborate tent flap of the medium large tent along this portion of the path.  You note one particular item of significance, a simple wind chime made of dark red wood which quietly adds its soft clacking music to the air.

title: [Hidden Settlement]
description: Thick pines border the path as it curves from northeast to northwest.  A short tree stump stands guard at the entrance to a simple tent that is set back in the pines, giving it a buried look.

title: [Hidden Settlement]
description: You can barely make out the path through the tightly packed pines.  Only a sliver of moonlight seems to make its presence known from far above.

title: [Tree Statue]
description: You find yourself at the foot of a giant tree, which towers over your head rising about fifty feet into the air.  It is shaped in the form of an elf dressed in feathers with arms outstretched in front of it, holding something you cannot quite make out from here.  The forest surrounding the area is strangely silent except for the wind, which sings softly as it moves through the treetops above.

title: [Tree Statue, Arm's Cradle]
description: The view from the arms of the statue is breathtaking as you look out across the treetops of the forest which spans for miles.  Looking upon the face of the statue, you sense a calm, giving presence and wonder just whose arms you rest in.  The winds eddy and flow around you as if attracted by the very nature of the majestic figure.  Several long vines drape across the statue's hand.

title: [Hidden Settlement]
description: Two small birds sit silently on a tree branch high above you, watching you with a disturbingly uncharacteristic curiosity.  The scent of fresh baked goods draws your attention to a small tent that sits along side of the path.

title: [Glatoph, Arch]
description: You're perched at the very top of the stone arch, overlooking the lava pool.  It's hotter up here than you've ever imagined any place could be, without actually being on fire.  The porous lava rock under your feet is covered with rusty brown stains.

title: [Glatoph, Vent Hole]
description: This tunnel winds around inside the mountain.  The rough grey walls press close, seeming to intensify the heat.  You pick your way through the dim passage, most of your attention taken by how sweaty and sticky you are.

title: [Glatoph, Vent Hole]
description: You're standing on a narrow ledge overlooking a lake of solidified lava.  The domed ceiling stretches far over your head, catching the heavy air and shaping the breezes.  On the far side of the room, a frozen fall of lava plunges into the lake, its churns and ripples sending frozen waves across the lava sea.

title: [Glatoph, Vent Hole]
description: This shallow tunnel stops at a dead end.  If you examine the far wall, you will notice that the tunnel used to go through -- it looks like fresh lava came bubbling up to this point, then hardened.  Towards the ground is a small crack.  You look around, wondering exactly how stable this mountain is.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Dinghy]
description: The tiny boat is beached on the shore, but the waves and tide still reach beyond its bow.  As the waves break behind you, the dinghy rocks slightly and shifts in the swirling, bubbling sand.  Finding no oars on board, you are thankful that the dinghy is anchored with a rope tied around a large rock on the beach.

title: [A Tree-Lined Walkway]
description: The branches of two rows of carefully trimmed monir trees form an arch overhead, shading the flagstone walkway.  The flat stones at your feet form geometric patterns leading up to a wrought iron fence surrounded by a variety of flowering bushes, and several carved carved stone bench are set along the sides of the walkway.

title: [Courtyard]
description: Drakes surrounded by fluffy clouds are etched upon all sides of an elaborate fountain and basin that dominates the courtyard.  Rising from the center and spewing a continuous stream of water up into the air from its open maw, is a finely detailed bronze drake with outstretched wings.  Towering behind the fountain and flanked by two ancient monir trees is an expansive, ivy-covered manor house.  Polished wide marble steps lead to the opened arched doorway.

title: [Museum, Entry Hall]
description: Covering the floor are squares of black marble polished to sheer perfection and the superb luster gives the impression of being more like a black liquid than stone.  Cast upon the mirror-like surface of the floor is a perfect reflection of the crystal chandelier hanging overhead.  Soft tinkling sounds emanate from the crystals as it sways gently back and forth from its chain, created by the breeze of the opened doorway.  An impressive statue of Rone Wehnimer nearly blocks a massive iron arch.

title: [Museum, Gift Shop]
description: Speckled marble benches line the walls and are placed so that they provide adequate viewing of the booths that contain various food items.  An ivory-inlaid doorway leading to the museums curator's office is tucked away behind a glass display case, in which an odd assortment of knickknacks are kept to be used as treasured keepsakes.  Mounted on the wall above the benches is a stone tablet.

title: [Museum of Weapons and Armor]
description: Enclosed behind heavy, rectangular glass display cases standing atop identical white marble pedestals are ancient sets of brigandine, hauberk, augmented breastplate, and full plate armor.  Speckled marble columns reaching from floor to ceiling divide the room in half, separating the glass casements.  Thick braided rope strung between metal poles, keep the overly curious from venturing too closely to the exhibits.

Sunlight pours through the half-dozen stained glaes windows, casting a reddish tint over the entire room. title: [Museum of Weapons and Armor]
description: Detailed wooden mannequins wearing a variety of leather armor and robes stand behind glass screens to keep them safe.  Dressed the way they are, with their well made uniforms, the mannequins resemble real soldiers standing at attention.  Globed lanterns create a series of dancing shadows along the walls and further enhance the illusion that the mannequins are sentient beings.

title: [Museum of Weapons and Armor]
description: Heavy blue watered silk tapestries embroidered with a scattering of silver-threaded crescent moons and stars decorate the walls and block the windows.  Rectangular displays enclosed with glass holds a variety of edged weapons.  Along the back wall, an assortment of throwing weapons dangle from an old throwing net.  Several handblown glass lanterns are deliberately positioned on tall metal poles designed to provide sufficient lighting for viewing the various exhibits.

title: [Museum of Weapons and Armor]
description: A bronze replica of a forge, complete with hammer, tongs, and a blacksmith, resides along the back wall.  Supported by metal brackets in the ceiling, an intricately designed, fringed banner drapes down above the forge, and billows softly from a barely palpable breeze.  Hanging on the three remaining walls from sturdy wooden pegs, shiny metal bolts, and some thick metal rivets is a vast assortment of shields, polearms, and two-handed weapons, and protected behind thin sheets of glaes.  Brass flowerpots flank the sides of a wide staircase.

title: [Museum, Balcony]
description: Interrupted by the staircase, a wrought iron railing runs the entire length on the upper level of the gallery.  The sullen glow of the moon creates a rainbow of cascading colors, as it peeks through the iridescent domed skylight above.  An amazing collection of masks and armets hang on metal pegs that protrude from the walls.

The brilliant glare of the sun creates a rainbow of cascading colors, as it shines through the iridescent domed skylight above.  An amazing collection of masks and armets hang on metal pegs that protrude from the walls.

title: [Museum, Balcony]
description: Standing near the railing, the entire ground level of the showroom can be viewed from this vantage point of the gallery.  A wide curving staircase leads back down to the main floor.  Emanating from the iridescent, domed skylight above, pale moonlight creates a rainbow of cascading colors.  Streaks of colors rain down over an antique thanot wood cabinet containing a few brawling weapons set securely behind heavy, etched glass doors.

title: [Twin Canyons, Rockface Slope]
description: Atop the rubble, the western wall contains several cracks and crevices that could easily be used as foot and handholds.  About two hundred feet above, a natural ledge juts out from the wall, a small stream of water flowing over the edge and shimmering like liquid silver as it rains down nearby.  To the northeast the jagged top of the rock outcrop can be seen as well as the rim of the eastern canyon.
