The rubble pile appears to be rather stable and the wall appears to be worn from use, not jagged with fresh cracks.

title: [Twin Canyons, Overlook Ledge]
description: Nestled serenely against the western wall, a large coniferous tree grows from cracks next to a small pool of crystal clear warm water.  Vapors dance across the pool while water spills over the rim of the ledge and showers down to the canyon below.  From this vantage and with the illumination of the silvery night sky, the entire canyon is visible to the northeast and beyond, all the way to Darkstone Bay.

title: [Twin Canyons, Rockslide]
description: Small rocks skip down the wall, making a clattering noise for several moments before finding a place to rest.  The remaining wall appears highly unstable and the source for the majority of rubble that comprises the rockslide.  Not far above, the rim of the canyon is visible against the silvery night sky.  Sloping steeply and containing many loose and jagged rocks, the wall beyond this point appears to be an impossible climb.

title: [Krag, Twin Canyon Rim]
description: The silvery sky illuminates the slope of The Krag as a chilling wind blows down the valley formed by the eastern slope of Sentoph Mountain and the western slope of The Krag.  Below, a steeply sloped wall leads to the top of a rockslide at the southern end of the Twin Canyons, while to the southeast a trail climbs towards Krag's Peak which towers several thousand feet away.  Across the canyon Sentoph's peak reaches nearly as high into the night sky.

title: [Twin Canyons, Western Canyon]
description: Heat radiates off the rock faces that have been baked in the sun during the day.  Cool air tries to steal the stored warmth but the mass of rocks holds it in.  The contrast in temperature causes the air to swirl in highly chaotic patterns forming small shadows of dust that dance above the canyon floor with the appearance of small, drunken ghosts.

Rays of sunlight almost make it to the floor here as they bake the outcrop of rock that splits the canyons.  The sunlight is in sharp contrast to the cool air that swirls about forming little dust devils that dance above the canyon floor.  A worn crack in the eastern face of the outcrop stands out against the jagged edges that guard the rest of the rockface.

title: [A Mountain Trail]
description: Loose stones are scattered about here, final reminders of a long-ago display of nature's violence.  Lush forests line the trail on both sides, their branches reaching out overhead, to form a beautiful, living canopy.

title: [A Hidden Glade]
description: The mountain trail ends here, in a peaceful glade dotted with elegant fel trees.  The beauty of their dark trunks is enhanced by silvery-green leaves which dance with each gentle breeze caressing the branches.  Thin rays of moonlight stream through the trees, grazing the tall grass like delicate fingers probing for treasure.  From somewhere nearby, you can hear the music of water tapping against stones, in an endless serenade that must surely be dedicated to the sylvan splendor of this place.

title: [The Shore of Dreams]
description: Fel and pine trees crowd close to the shore of an almost perfectly clear pool.  A low wall crafted from bright blue Liabo marble surrounds the tiny pond, encircling it in a loving embrace.  The gleaming surface of the water is disturbed only by concentric rings drifting away from the waterfall lazily spilling down from an outcropping of rocks overhead.  Though the night's shadows are deep here, an occasional beam of argent light pierces the darkness, illuminating the forest surrounding you.

title: [Beyond the Shore of Dreams]
description: Tears spring unbidden to your eyes as you bask in the serenity found here behind the waterfall.  The music of water rushing over the stones surrounds you, easing away the cares of the world as you ponder the liquid wall enclosing this room on two sides.  Moonlight angles down from a break in the rocks on the northern wall, illuminating the fine spray of droplets floating through the air so that you are in the midst of a small sea of swirling silver stars.

Tears spring unbidden to your eyes as you bask in the serenity found here behind the waterfall.  The music of water rushing over the stones surrounds you, easing away the cares of the world as you ponder the liquid wall enclosing this room on two sides.  Light angles down from a break in the rocks on the northern wall, illuminating the fine spray of droplets floating through the air so that you are in the midst of a tiny, swirling rainbow of glorious color.

title: [The Shrine of Dreams]
description: Stars surround you, twinkling brightly as far as the eye can see.  Or so it seems, until you look more closely, and realize that the walls and ceiling of this room are made of rocks pieced together in such a way that bits of light flicker through the crevices, giving the illusion of being beneath a starlit sky.  Pinpoints of light reflect off of the polished black marble floor, adding to the sensation that you have entered the heavens themselves.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: Melgorehn's Reach towers off to the southwest.  It dominates the valley, a constant presence in the waving grass.  The ground is broken and ill-lit by the wan moonlight, causing you to trip and curse several times.  No insects buzz through the area, giving you an uneasy feeling.

Melgorehn's Reach towers off to the southwest.  It dominates the valley, a constant presence in the waving grass.  The ground is broken, causing you to trip and curse several times.  No insects buzz through the area, giving you an uneasy feeling.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Riverbank]
description: The river is swift, its dark waters tufted white in some places as it travels southeast.  The grass is a bit greener here, and moss lines the bank of the river.  However, the ground is uneven, making walking unpleasant, and making the chances of tumbling into the black waters of the river greater.

The river is swift, even white in some places as it travels southeast.  The grass is a bit greener here, and moss lines the bank of the river.  However, the ground is uneven, making walking unpleasant, and making the chances of tumbling into the river greater.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Clay Quarry]
description: The grass ends in a large stretch of river clay.  The ground is badly trampled, and large clawfuls of clay have been taken from the area.  The clay is messy and slick, halting any further riverward exploration.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: The grass waves about you, rustling in the breeze.  In the distance you can hear the river running, and the call of the occasional frog.  A headless, dead fish lies on the ground, toothmarks evident in the body.  Whatever took a bite from this fish had very large teeth.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: The grass is a bit shorter here as you move on through the valley.  Strange paths have been trampled through it, and in some areas large chunks have been uprooted.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: The grass here has died and part of the broken ground is sunken, as if a hole underground collapsed onto itself.  In the dirt around the depression, skeletal fingers can be seen reaching for the surface.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: Close off to the west, the Reach looms.  This is the back face of the mountain, seldom seen by most.  It rises out of the grassland as if striving to touch the stars, the upheaval of the rocks evident in the pristine mountainside.  The flattened paths through the grass go no further west, instead leading off to the east, south, and southeast.

Close off to the west, the Reach looms.  This is the back face of the mountain, seldom seen by most.  It rises out of the grassland to touch the sky, the upheaval of the rocks evident in the pristine mountainside.  The flattened paths through the grass go no further west, instead leading off to the east, south, and southeast.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: A hint of moisture is carried on the air.  The grass waves against your knees, over ground pocked with strange holes and pits.  These do not seem to be from small burrowers, but from something much larger.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: Although the night conceals its source from sight, the sound of falling water can be heard somewhere to the northeast.  The grass is much thicker here, and for the first time since you arrived the hum of insects drones in your ears.  The ground is not as broken beneath your feet, but the strange holes remain.

To the northeast, the sound of falling water can be heard.  The grass is much thicker here, and for the first time since you arrived the hum of insects drones in your ears.  The ground is not as broken beneath your feet, but the strange holes remain.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Waterfall]
description: The river tumbles over a small slope of rocks, creating a miniature waterfall.  Continuing off to the southeast, it leaves the grasslands for the forest.  Water spiders play on the surface of the river, occasionally disappearing to a hungry fish below.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: The grass lowers to your knees as you continue through the area.  There are several spots of bare dirt here, and several shallow holes in the ground that appear scooped out with a clawed hand.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: Stopping for a moment, you take a look around.  You are nearly in the center of the valley.  The scent of grass and earth fills your nose, carried on a gentle breeze.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: Still dwarfed by the Reach, you come to a large boulder.  Perhaps from a small rockslide, this boulder is nearly 10 feet tall, with one flat surface where it once connected with the mountain.  The stone seems very out of place in the grass, as if it did not truly belong.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: The rustle of grass off to your left causes you to start.  There does not seem to be anything there, but the eerie feeling does not leave.  To the south, a tree stands by itself in the plain, casting a deeper shadow on the moon-silvered grasses which break around it like waves against a lifeless and rocky island.
The rustle of grass off to your left causes you to start.  There does not seem to be anything there, but the eerie feeling does not leave.  To the south, a tree stands by itself in the plain.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: A lone scrawny tree rises up from the grass.  Two large owls perch on the branches above, arguing between themselves and occasionally gazing impassively at you with eerily lambent eyes.  The tree might provide some shelter from the wind, but the respite from the chill is not worth sharing the company of the quarrelsome birds.

A lone, scrawny tree rises up from the grass.  Two large black birds sit in the branches, mocking you from above with shrill squawks and raucous laughter.  The tree provides the only shade in the area, but the respite from the sun is not worth having to listen to the birds making fun of you.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: A large horned owl circles overhead, headed for the tree to the east.  A few scratch marks in the dirt indicate that the bird may have been hunting here, but you see no sign of whether the prey was taken or managed to elude its captor this time.  Some stalks of the grass are shortened, perhaps snapped off by a sharp beak or teeth.

A large black bird circles overhead, headed for the tree to the east.  A few scratch marks in the dirt indicate that the bird may have been hunting here, but did not dig up much of a meal.  Some stalks of the grass are shortened, snapped off by a sharp beak.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: You are nearly at the opposite end of the grasslands from the bridge.  Far to the south, you can see the edge of a forest, over rough terrain.  Getting there from here would be difficult in the meager light and with so many treacherous burrows about, and you decide it's simply not worth the walk.

You are nearly at the opposite end of the grasslands from the bridge.  Far to the south, you can see the edge of a forest, over rough terrain.  Getting there from here would be difficult, and you decide it's simply not worth the walk.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: A wooden shield lies rotting in the dirt.  It is half buried in the ground, grown over with grass and weeds.  Its exposed surface is bleached bone-white in the moonlight and is deeply cracked, a testament to the time it has spent forgotten in this place.

A wooden shield lies rotting in the dirt.  It is half buried in the ground, grown over with grass and weeds.  Its exposed surface is bleached and cracked, a testament to the time it has spent forgotten in this place.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: The grass has grown over a small hillock here.  The top of the mound is smooth, and obviously not natural.  Something is buried here, although you are not certain you'd like to see what.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: A small patch of wildflowers decorates the area, breaking the monotony of the grasslands.  The shadow of Melgorehn's Reach blots out a wedge of the starry sky.  In the distance, you can hear the call of a mountain bird.

A small patch of wildflowers decorates the area, breaking the monotony of the grasslands.  The air is a bit cooler here as you begin to move into the shadow of Melgorehn's Reach.  In the distance, you can hear the call of a mountain bird.

title: [Melgorehn's Valley, Grasslands]
description: Beneath your feet, the ground crunches slightly.  The soil is slightly rockier here, the grass less thick.  To the northwest is the face of the mountain, its details cloaked in night and mystery, taunting you with the need to explore.

Beneath your feet, the ground crunches slightly.  The soil is slightly rockier here, the grass less thick.  To the northwest is the face of the mountain, large and mysterious, taunting you with the need to explore.

title: [Valley, Base of the Mountain]
description: You have reached the base of Melgorehn's Reach.  The face before you is rugged, as if violently heaved from the earth below.  As you stand before the immense mountain, you can hear the soft sound of water running, perhaps from one of the crevices in the rock.

title: [Underground Pool]
description: The walls of the cavern are rough.  Stalactites drip from the ceiling, some joining with stalagmites to form huge limestone pillars.  The air is damp and cold, and the floor is just slick enough to make you place your feet carefully with each step.  A small cascade of water runs down the back wall into a shallow pool.  The steady trickling sound is soothing to your ears, creating a tranquil atmosphere in the room.  The breeze from a small crevice is warm and fresh, likely from the outside.

title: [Stone Tunnel]
description: The tunnel leads down, out of the stone and into soft, moist dirt as you pass from under the mountain.  Large swaths through the dirt walls give the impression that the makers of the passage used claws to do their tunneling.  Small roots hang from the ceiling, as if from young trees.

title: [Burrows, Ambush]
description: This narrow room would be ideal for a surprise attack, at least one by an organized force.  Tunnels lead east and northwest to crude guard posts, leaving the only escapes deeper into the burrow or back to scramble up the tunnel.  Assuming this is used to keep intruders out of the main burrows, you conclude that it is not very effective.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, northwest

title: [Burrows, Guard Post]
description: Set down a short tunnel, this small room looks out onto the entry to the burrows.  From the look of heavy footprints in the dirt, it appears as if this is where guards stand, awaiting intruders as they enter the burrows.  Crude weapons stand in one corner, as well as a rough chair and bones left over from dinners taken on watch.

title: [Burrows, Bend]
description: The tunnel takes a sharp bend around a large boulder here.  It looks as if the diggers hit the stone, and decided it would be easier to go around it rather than remove it from the area.  Larger roots dangle from the ceiling, showing a lovely array of subterranean insects.

title: [Burrows, Guard Post]
description: Set down a short tunnel, this small room looks out onto the entry to the burrows.  From the look of heavy footprints in the dirt, it appears as if this is where guards stand, awaiting intruders as they enter the burrows.  Crude weapons stand in one corner, as well as a rough chair and bones left over from dinners taken on watch.

title: [Burrows, Entryway]
description: Thick roots line the walls and ceiling of this chamber.  Bones left over from meals lay strewn about, covered with industrious insects, as well as broken pottery and ruined furniture.  The smell of the area leaves much to be desired, as the lack of ventilation and heavy air trap the stench of rotting flesh in the room.

title: [Burrows, Root Room]
description: This seems to be the main area of the burrow.  The massive roots of a giant tree grow down through the wide room and into the floor, creating something of a maze.  The dirt you walk on is scuffled by many feet, and the roots of the tree are nicked, scraped, and even bitten.  Several tunnels branch off through the roots, leading to various chambers.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Burrows, Barracks]
description: The first thing you notice is the strong scent of poorly distilled alcohol.  Crude clay jugs are tipped over about the room, the liquid spilled on the rough sleeping pallets.  In some places, the drink seems to have eaten through the cloth, but moths could be responsible for the holes as well.   Weapons lean in the corners, in varying states of disrepair.

title: [Burrows, Shaman's Chamber]
description: This room is the most civilized of the lot.  Primitive rugs are spread on the floor, and the room is nearly orderly.  Lumpy clay bowls line the walls, but from the strange and often revolting smells coming from them, you aren't sure you want to know what is stored in them.  Thin, strangely marked bones spill out from a sack onto a small table.

title: [Burrows, Storage]
description: The room is a haven of chaos.  A sad attempt at shelves hangs from the back wall, with oddities like bits of rope, broken swords, half a table, and other things you cannot identify stored in every dirty nook and cranny.  Even the spider spinning a web in the corner looks disgusted at the mess.

title: [Burrows, Tool Room]
description: Rough digging tools clutter the room.  Poorly shaped shovels and mattocks lean against the walls, and a few picks, likely stolen, lie on the floor, rusting quietly.  The passage leading down seems relatively new, and the air blowing up from it smells of the outdoors.

title: [Burrows, Chieftain's Chamber]
description: Poorly tanned pelts hang from the walls, the stains beneath them looking suspiciously like blood.  Dominating one wall is a large bear head, still dripping occasionally onto the bronze-tipped spear below.  The owner of the room must be highly esteemed in the orcish society, although his badges of power do very little to inspire anything but nausea in you.

title: [Burrows, Dirt Room]
description: Piles of dirt and stone fill the chamber.  The smell of freshly turned earth fills the air, and earthworms wiggle through the piles of soil.  Poor wood buckets sit near the corridor to the southwest, waiting to be carried back down the tunnel.

title: [Burrows, Corridor]
description: The corridor is freshly dug.  Dirt sifts down onto your head, increasing the feeling of claustrophobia.  Strangely, there are large holes in the ceiling, as if something was ripped out from the ground above.  Fresh air moves through the tunnel, stirring up the dust and making you sneeze.

title: [Burrows, Excavation]
description: Signs of fresh digging are evident here.  A few tools lie in the dirt, as well as large chunks of rock taken from the face of the wall.  The main focus of the excavation seems to be a small fissure in the rock, just large enough for you to slide through if you exhale completely.

title: [Base of Chasm]
description: You're at the muddy base of a narrow gully formed by a brisk stream.  A wall of the gully rises high on either side of you.  Directly above, a tree has been felled across the chasm as a makeshift bridge.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Small Cottage]
description: You find yourself in a dense wooded area in front of a small cottage with stone steps leading up to the front door.  Two large, well tended flower beds on either side of the steps contain a huge variety of plants of differing colors and sizes.  The night air is cool and refreshing and you hear the muffled sounds of the unseen wildlife in the trees surrounding you and from the river beyond.

You find yourself in a dense wooded area in front of a small cottage with stone steps leading up to the front door.  Two large, well tended flower beds on either side of the steps contain a huge variety of plants of differing colors and sizes.  The air is cool and refreshing and you hear the muffled sounds of the unseen wildlife in the trees surrounding you and from the river beyond.
location: Kodos' Cottage, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Small Cottage, Living Room]
description: This simple living room looks both comfortable and inviting.  A large oak table sits at its center, surrounded by a couch and two chairs.  The furniture is covered with fine, tanned leather and plush, white puma fur cushions.  Several lamps on the walls provide a soft, ambient lighting to the room.  A stone archway frames a small courtyard outside, and a narrow hallway leads off in the opposite direction.

title: [Small Cottage, Workshop]
description: A huge glyph-covered slab, with a potion cabinet at one end, dominates the center of this room.  The temperature here feels slightly warmer than the rest of the cottage.  A faint scent of ozone lingers in the air about you, and a slight tingling sensation occasionally travels across your skin.  Scrolls, and other miscellaneous items, lay scattered about the workshop.

title: [Moot Hall, Waiting Area]
description: The crowds waiting to pay their debts mill about, some heading east and some heading west.  The carpet underfoot is worn from years of footsteps but it still shines a soft green in the bright light.  Several benches line the walls, functional, yet comfortable enough if you wish to rest your feet for a bit.  A few still seem to be unoccupied.

title: [Moot Hall, Debt Collector's]
description: This is the office of the Debt Collector of Wehnimer's Landing.  An old, wizened clerk is sitting behind a desk, poring through yellowed record ledgers.

title: [Moot Hall, Debt Collector's]
description: This is the office of the Debt Collector of Wehnimer's Landing.  An old, wizened clerk is sitting behind a desk, poring through yellowed record ledgers.

title: [Wehnimer's Courtroom]
description: The courtroom is uncomfortably chilly and plainly furnished.  Several benches are lined up to face a raised platform at the far end of the room.  The town magistrate dispenses justice, swiftly and summarily, seated in the straightbacked chair behind a simple table on the platform.  An armed guard leans against the wall, next to the door, looking casual but ready for trouble should it arise.

title: [Wehnimer's Real Estate]
description: Variegated maps of mixed depth, detail and scale plaster the walls of this office.  Pins with little scraps of paper are affixed to the maps, identifying properties for sale or lease.  Not surprisingly, the musty smell of old parchment perfumes the place.  Behind the clerk's desk is a large cabinet honeycombed with tiny compartments, each stuffed with dozens of scrolls, most likely deeds for homes and property.

title: [Ceraleth's Cartage]
description: Tall wooden crates, reinforced with crossed planks and sealed with heavy hinged locks, stand in rows in this large room.  Workmen stuggle in pairs, or groups of four, handling the big crates with care as they move them in or out.  The stone floors are meticulously kept and there is not a speck of dust to be seen.

title: [Calradian's Contracts]
description: A large maoral desk, polished to a deep red sheen, rests across one corner of the room.  Precisely placed quills and a careful arrangement of dry ink pots give the desk an unused air.  By contrast, a library table in the center of the room is strewn with piles of contracts and lists of figures.  Thick wool carpets and velvet-draped windows muffle the sounds of passersby on the street outside.

title: [Moot Hall, Mayor's Office]
[Moot Hall, Mayor Lylia's Office]
[Moot Hall, Mayor's Office.]
description: The mayor's office is spartan, with straightbacked chairs, over one of which is draped a striped voalcat vest, and a stolid desk.  A cabinet contains a menacing assortment of iron and steel weapons, a few hunting trophies, and parchment maps of the Landing and outlying districts.

At the varnished modwir door, a red bear skin rug stretches across the polished hardwood floors while twin velnalin hide chairs face the Mayor's pine desk.  A great stag's head is mounted above a cobblestone fireplace set into the western wall.  Several tumblers of liquor and shot glasses rest atop an oak bar beside a tall arched window.  A blue-streaked river trout is mounted above an open closet, its mouth still wedged open by a fish hook.

From a dais, the maoral desk and an ivory and velvet curule seat loom over two carved wooden chairs.  Tapestry rugs cover the hardwood floor, their patterns complementing the arched windows flanking the desk.  A stag's head stares at a panoramic fresco mounted opposite it.  In a corner near the bar, a scarred witchwood perch rises to the high ceiling, while several feet away, a black iron stove rests against the west wall and is topped with a silver kettle.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Tall shelves crammed with dusty books leave but a narrow corridor to the low desk at the far end of the room.  A faded green velvet curtain falls halfway across a large window, the rippled glass casting watery patterns on the oak floor.  A lone fly buzzes in the very center, describing drunken circles in the heavy air.

title: [Moot Hall, House Clerk's Office]
description: This is the plain office of the Head Clerk of the Cooperative of Houses of Elanthia.  Behind a small desk sits a rather harried civil servant.  His quill pen is never at rest as he records and updates every detail needed for the efficient administration of the houses of Wehnimer's Landing.  The main features of note are the long velvet curtains on the wall behind the desk, that seem to rustle slightly.

This is the plain office of the Head Clerk of the Cooperative of Houses of Elanthia.  Behind a small desk sits a rather harried House Clerk.  His quill pen is never at rest as he records and updates every detail needed for the efficient administration of the Great Houses.  The main features of note are the long velvet curtains on the wall behind the desk, that seem to rustle slightly.

title: [Moot Hall, House Annex Hallway]
description: Rich lacquered walls arch overhead, each trimmed neatly with strips of mahogany.  Dark red velvet drapes from the ceiling, collected in elegant, deep folds to impart a cozy, relaxed atmosphere about the area.  Several oil lamps sit in recessed niches in the wall, lending a soft amber-hued glow to the surroundings.

title: [Moot Hall, House Annex Hallway]
description: A brass oil lamp occupies each of the many small niches lining the walls, the tiny wavering flames casting a moody glow over the surroundings.  A fine red satin curtain embroidered with the sigil of White Haven sways softly to the north, its satin form rippling with the honey-colored light.

title: [Moot Hall, House Annex Hallway]
description: Swaths of black velvet drape to either side of a black curtain with the sigil of Moonstone Abbey of the same hue, while the dim lighting casts most of the room in darkness.  The silvery sigil of Moonstone Abbey arches over the curtain, its highly polished surface glinting softly in the reflected light.

title: [Moot Hall, House Annex Hallway]
description: A pair of brass oil lamps are suspended near a golden curtain to the north side of the room, the light playing in waves across the fine silk.  The ivory sigil of Beacon Hall curves over the curtain, its pure white color a stark contrast to the mellow burgundy tones of the surroundings.

title: [Paupers, Outer Grounds]
[House of Paupers, Outer Grounds]
description: A weathered stone building is nestled low among tall modwir and weeping willow trees.  A gleaming vultite plaque is affixed to the dark, wrought iron fence which surrounds and defines the grounds, through which formally clipped hedges and an elegant fountain in the midst of a rose garden are visible.  Beyond the wrought iron gate, a red-carpeted walkway covered by a long, narrow awning leads up to massive double doors.

Clouds scuttle across the harvest moon, their shapes reminiscent of ghastly images seen only in fevered dreams.  In the dim light, you see a battered plaque dangling from a rusty spike on the wrought iron fence.  Swirling about your feet, a blanket of mist lines what appears to be a freshly dug grave.  A crooked tree grabs desperately at the sky and you can see the flickering silhouette of a broken-down house through tortured branches.  A cobblestone walkway leads back to the square.

title: [House of Paupers, Inner Grounds]
[Paupers, Inner Grounds]
description: To either side of the carpeted walkway, you see rows of neatly clipped hedges and shady trees.  Vibrant roses in every imaginable hue surround you with their delicate, pleasing scent.  Nestled within the shelter of proud modwirs and softly swaying willow trees, the massive double doors beckon you to enter the House of Paupers and forget the hustle and bustle of the Landing just outside the gate.

title: [House of Paupers, Entry Hall]
[Paupers, Entry Hall]
description: Deep fur floor covering cushions your feet as you walk past opulent portraits of distinguished explorers and huntsmen dressed in stiff, formal attire.  The far end of the room is dominated by a plush comfortable sofa and several overstuffed chairs near tables on which lie scrolls of Wehnimer Edition.  You approach a large oaken desk, behind which sits a poised, elven receptionist who looks up just as you glance through the ora door to her right.

title: [House of Paupers, Commons]
[Paupers, Commons]
description: More books and scrolls than you've ever seen in one place line the walls of this spacious room, the central focus of which is a massive fireplace with a mahogany mantel in which fragrant cherry wood crackles and pops.  Trophies, busts and sketches of prominent local citizens are in evidence.  Large floor cushions and comfortable armchairs invite you to relax, read or enjoy conversation at an immaculately polished table in one corner.  The gleaming mahogany bar is well-stocked with only the finest libations.

title: [House of Paupers, Vault]
[Paupers, Vault]
description: Light from several torches flickers over silver sconces fastened to the walls.  Legend has it that this heavily carpeted, soundproofed vault once successfully protected a king's ransom from an attempted siege by rampaging barbarians.  Few have attempted to breach the security of the members' steel-reinforced storage lockers in modern times, for tales of the consequences abound and are not for the faint of heart.

title: [Paupers, Hallway]
[House of Paupers, Hallway]
description: This short, carpeted hallway ends at a brightly lit room filled with wooden tables.  Many odd-looking trinkets and knickknacks are mounted on the walls, covering all available shelf space.  Someone at one of the tables has apparently taken it upon himself to try and explain each and every single item in the room, and his droning voice indicates no sign of stopping.  On one wall is a curtained opening and on another you see a curtain that looks out of place.

title: [Paupers, Vault]
[House of Paupers, Vault]
description: Light from several torches flickers over silver sconces fastened to the walls.  Legend has it that this heavily carpeted, soundproofed vault once successfully protected a king's ransom from an attempted siege by rampaging barbarians.  Few have attempted to breach the security of the members' steel-reinforced storage lockers in modern times, for tales of the consequences abound and are not for the faint of heart.

title: [House of Paupers, Lounge]
[Paupers, Lounge]
description: You hear the sound of muted conversation and laughter coming from the Common room, though the thick carpets which cover the floor seem to absorb some of the sound.  The walls are paneled in polished mahogany and are decorated with several silver candle sconces which shed their warm light onto the tables scattered about the room.

title: [House of Paupers, Crystal Room]
[Paupers, Crystal Room]
description: An abundance of overgrown hanging plants and excessive humidity encourage you to shed your inhibitions along with your clothing to participate in the water sports played in this enormous area covered by a translucent crystal dome.  In one corner you see a steaming hot tub surrounded by rocks and lush greenery.  The plants release aromatic vapors which relax your senses.  An expansive swimming pool sparkles as it reflects the moonlight.

An abundance of overgrown hanging plants and excessive humidity encourage you to shed your inhibitions along with your clothing to participate in the water sports played in this enormous area covered by a translucent crystal dome.  In one corner you see a steaming hot tub surrounded by rocks and lush greenery.  The plants release aromatic vapors which relax your senses.  An expansive swimming pool sparkles as it reflects the light from the sun.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A shallow cave has been carved in the side of this cliff overlooking the Bay.  Small animal bones lay strewn about a cold fire pit.  The cave's low ceiling provides some shelter from cloudbursts but the cold breezes echo around you.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The steep path makes travel difficult and the sight of not so well balanced boulders on the slopes above you, explains why few travellers pass this way.  An iron ring is attached to a rusty spike in the rock face and the shredded remains of a rope dangles from the ring.

wayto.7997: ;e empty_hand; fput 'turn ring'; move 'go hole'; fill_hand

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The steep path is covered with small boulders that have fallen from ledges above.  The ground is strewn with rubble that you have no choice but to tread upon.  It shifts beneath your feet as if walking on a concrete marsh.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You are just below the ridge line of Upper Trollfang.  There are tall trees all around and the trail ends at a sheer wall that does not appear to have any handholds.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: You stand at one end of what now barely could be construed as a trail.  The road's remains form a path leading into the pine forest of the temperate Lower Trollfang.  Woods stretch out to the south and east, dark green and black against the sky.  Upright, majestic conifers stand a watchful vigil, jealously guarding their ancient secrets.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Gully]
description: A wide lip of rock rises overhead to provide a place of cool shadows.  A thick band of low growing shrubs obscures the far end of the gully.  Small straggly bushes are growing over a pair of rust streaks set into the rocky floor.

title: [Gully, A Small Clearing]
description: Here, in a small clearing surrounded by a thick tangle of bushes, is an odd thing.  Set into the ground is a large wood-fired burner.  Looking closer, you see scattered bits of half-burned wood and charcoal everywhere.  Next to the burner is a massive pile of wood in all shapes and sizes.  Beyond the sooty greenery, pale reddish rock walls block all further view.

title: [Kobold Mines, Entrance]
description: This is a wide section of cavern that slopes rapidly downwards into darkness.  The rock-strewn floor has been worn smooth by the passing of many feet hauling heavy loads.  Several smaller caverns and chambers open up in several directions, but in the uncertain light their contents remain hidden.  Twin streaks of rust vanish downslope into the chill and damp air of this benighted domain.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northwest, down, out

title: [Kobold Mines, Blank Wall]
description: The cave ends abruptly with a sheer wall of basalt apparently thrust up through a fissure in the floor by a long ago and forgotten volcanic eruption.  Faint tool marks, rusted bits of broken tools and some small chips knocked out of the glass-smooth surface are the only evidence of attempts to pass here.

title: [Kobold Mines, Short Passageway]
description: Thick wooden beams lend support to this dark passage.  The walls are jagged and the ground is slick with mud.  One wooden brace sags wetly overhead and you quickly duck past it.

title: [Kobold Mines, Short Passageway]
description: A dozen thin hollow tubes of calcite hang jaggedly from the ceiling and water drips occasionally from the broken ends.  The slimy ground is littered with pieces of glass-like needles and bits of soggy wood.

title: [Kobold Mines, Dead End]
description: The passageway ends abruptly and you find yourself standing in the middle of a small chamber.  The walls press in upon you and the air is thick and humid, making it hard to breathe.  An ugly brown fungus growing in one corner gives off a sickly odor, vaguely reminiscent of rotting flesh.

title: [Kobold Mines, Cavern]
description: Dark and damp, this small cavern is silent save for the eternal sound of water, dripping and flowing, echoing dimly as it seeks the depths of these caverns.  Columns of rust-tinted limestone form a lifeless and grotesque forest that waits endlessly for the ages to pass, hoping for a Spring that never comes.

title: [Kobold Mines, Sublevel One]
description: Several small caverns lead off from this landing.  There is a slope running up towards the surface and continuing down into the depths.  Rusted iron rails gleam dully in the gloom.  A broken ore cart sits to one side where it was apparently abandoned long ago.  Smashed chunks of ore and rusted iron litter the floor and there is a tang of metal in the air.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, up, down

title: [Kobold Mines, Office]
description: This room has the look of an office or workroom, probably because there's been an attempt to smooth the walls and floors into level surfaces.  Some decorative touches set this room apart from the others, including ragged hangings, now a faded blue-violet, which adorn the walls.  In the center of the room a massive slab of smooth iron has been set across some limestone outcroppings, forming a crude desk.

title: [Kobold Mines, Dormitory]
description: This was once a dormitory for the miners.  Evidently it is still being used this way to judge from the half-cured furs and roughly woven mats stuffed with fetid straw.  The stench of unwashed bodies fills your nostrils.

title: [Kobold Mines, Sublevel Two]
description: The slope is treacherously steep here and your footing threatens to give way and send you sprawling on the rock floor.  Several broken shovels and picks are scattered about and one or two ruined iron caps lie, rusting, on the floor.  Metal rails in the floor continue both up and down the steep slope, but they also branch and pass through some double doors set into a walled-up cave entrance.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, up, down

title: [Kobold Mines, Oil Room]
description: The walls and floor here are coated with a thick layer of oil and grease.  Broken barrels and slashed-open skins each in a puddle of stinking lubricant, along with heaps of moldy oil-soaked rags, lead you to believe this room held the various things needed to keep equipment from the quick death by rust that is common in caves.

title: [Kobold Mines, Crevice]
description: Low and narrow and cramped, this crevice twists and turns sharply.  Fungous growths cling to the clammy walls and send puffs of spores into the air at every touch.  Blind cave insects scuttle about and their long thin feelers brush your hands, seeking food in this eternal darkness.

title: [Kobold Mines, Cavern]
description: From a narrow crevice at one end, this cave opens out into an immense echoing distance.  A pale cadaverous light fills the room coming, from mushrooms of every size and shape.  Gelatinous green cave slugs, thick as a brawny man's arm, crawl along the mounds and hummocks of fungus, grazing endlessly on this underworld orchard.  A thick column of polished stone is set before you and the remains of brickwork here and there show this is more than an accident of nature.

title: [Kobold Mines, Storage]
description: A tiny, crowded and narrow cave apparently used as storage.  Piles of crude picks and shovels lie heaped everywhere to rust and rot in the damp air.  The remains of several greasy animal skin sacks give off the pungent scent of some sort of oil but appear to be beyond use.  A large pile of crushed and bent iron caps sit, heaped in one corner, next to a broken anvil where they were repaired.

title: [Kobold Mines, Crucible]
description: This room reeks of hot iron and smoke.  Dominating the cave is a massive crucible set over a firebox of metal and stone.  A stone trough lies on the floor next to the crucible.  A thick layer of soot covers the walls, floor and ceiling except for a pair of iron rails set in the ground leading out of the cavern.  Far overhead, a narrow crack leads to the outside and a constant breeze blows upwards.

title: [Kobold Mines, Machinery Room]
description: This massive stone room contains several odd devices.  A huge leather bellows dominates the place, rising almost to the high ceiling where a heavy chain hangs down from a pulley far above.  The far end of the bellows tapers to an arm-thick tube leading through the wall.  An odd set of pipes and metal drums squats on the floor like an ancient idol.  Broken clay flasks reeking of oil and ruined skins that once held more oil litter the room.  A thin film of congealed oil and grease covers everything.

title: [Kobold Mines, Storeroom]
description: There are piles of black grit covering the floor here, almost causing you to sneeze.  Rotting pieces of soggy wood and several rusted shovels are scattered about the room, and a ruined wheelbarrow lies overturned next to a row of large empty bins.  Looking closer, you notice that there are faded words and symbols scratched into the walls above the bins.

title: [Kobold Mines, Sublevel Three]
description: You are at the bottom of a steep slope in a relatively level area.  This is apparently where the actual mining is being done as there are stacked timbers and shoring beams and a good deal of other gear in crude but serviceable shape.  A pair of rails set into the floor must have provided some assistance for the laborers in the dim past, but are now so rusted and worn as to be beyond use.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, up

title: [Kobold Mines, Workface]
description: This is the actual workface of the mine.  Gravel-sized chunks of raw ore litter the ground and there are piles of rock and stone waiting to be carried away for processing.  The rock ceiling is low and cramped and the air is cold and stale.  Poorly placed and rotting timbers that sag do little for your feelings of security.  Rust-stained ruts in the ground show where rails may have once lain, long since pried up for other uses it seems.

title: [Kobold Mines, Grooved Wall]
description: You are standing before a smooth wall crisscrossed by a number of long, deep grooves.  The grooves are scratched and pitted, with no pattern at all, as far as you can tell.  Near the floor, the grooves disappear, only to be replaced by finger-sized holes drilled straight into the rock.  Some rusted tools are piled against the wall and a thick layer of dust coats the floor, casting up swirling clouds every time you move your feet.

title: [Kobold Mines, Large Cavern]
description: A smooth stone footpath leads to a large pool of dark liquid that dominates this cavern.  There is an oily film covering the water's surface, and the stench wafts up into your nostrils, threatening to overcome you with its intense odor.  A loud dripping sound echoes up and down the walls in a monotonous hypnotic pattern.  Several thick stalagmites break the surface of the pool and reach up towards the jagged ceiling.

title: [Kobold Mines, Dark Pool]
description: You are standing on a narrow footpath worn into the smooth stone in between the cavern wall and the edge of the dark pool.  As you gaze out over the pool, you notice step-like terraces of slick rock that rise along one wall, creating a multi-layered natural dam.  Water trickles down from level to level, forming a quiet waterfall that pools near your feet.

title: [Kobold Mines, Deep Pit]
description: Standing on a narrow ledge before a yawning black pit, you peer down only to see that the walls soon drop out of sight.  The ground is dry and your footing seems secure, but a feeling of uneasiness hangs in the musty air.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This dark, narrow tunnel smells from the remains of small creatures that have crawled in here to die.  The walls are covered with a slimy residue that also has an unpleasant odor.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: A hushed atmosphere weighs upon this shadowy forest.  Fir, and a few smaller pine trees, grow close enough together to make it difficult to see more than a few arm-lengths ahead.  Bushy ferns thrive amongst the tree trunks.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: The forest opens up a bit here, giving a variety of plants, bushes and mushrooms a place to thrive.  A giant anthill stands close by, a myriad of reddish ants marching to and fro.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: A family of rabbits has made a home under a nearby fir tree, the burrows staring up like empty eyes.  Despite the tracks all around, no rabbits are seen or heard.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: A few stunted birch trees stand forlornly on the spongy, moss-covered ground.  Some cloudberry bushes proudly display their golden fruits.  In the distance looms a large, dark forest.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: A white sprinkle of lilies of the valley covers the marshy ground here.  A few stark-white birch trees grow nearby.  The soil is so soggy that you can't help but get a bit wet as you make your way forth.  Someone has had the forethought to place a few planks across a particularly foreboding area.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: Birch and evergreens admix on the soft, moss-covered ground.  A weather-bleached tree trunk lies nearby, its lower part fading into a soggy rot.  A few lilies of the valley grow near the decaying trunk -- their small, white flowers dancing playfully with every slight waft.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: Evergreens grow so tightly here that their canopy filters out much of the light, covering everything in an eerie cloak of shadows.  Some of the oldest fir trees look dead or dying -- their life being choked out of them by strange, clinging vines.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: In the midst of these dark firs stands a lone oak tree, its hefty branches muscling nearby trees aside.  An owlet peeks curiously out of the large hole high up in the oak trunk -- big, round eyes gleaming with a green-yellow brilliance.  A solitary hoot echoes through the woods every so often, the melancholy sound adding to the already gloomy atmosphere.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Grove]
description: A small animal track leads through the dark, menacing forest.  A wall of dark green fir trees towers over the mossy ground, many of the large branches intertwined above the trail.  Faint rustling sounds escape the verdant screen.

wayto.8029:
