title: [Aillidh Brae, Grove]
description: Large, dark evergreens loom over the small trail.  Some of the larger trees are entangled in clinging reddish vines.  The vine-covered trees look sickly, much of their remaining needles a drab brown.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Grove]
description: The pine forest is so dense it threatens to obliterate the remnants of the animal path.  Only the persistent movement of tenacious local beasts allow the survival of the track.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Grove]
description: The grove opens up enough to let in small beams of moonlight.  Dust drifts slowly through the rays, adding a touch of the fantastical.  Slightly to the northeast lies a giant boulder lightly covered with orange and red lichen.

The grove opens up enough to let in small beams of light.  Dust drifts slowly through the rays, adding a touch of the fantastical.  Slightly to the northeast lies a giant boulder lightly covered with orange and red lichen.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Grove]
description: Large roots extend from the nearby pine trees like the skeletal toes of giants.  The roots crowd the animal path, making movement slow and rough.  Layers of pine needles have collected between the roots, their smell quite rejuvenating.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Boulder]
description: Though mostly bare, the granite boulder is splotched with mottled orange and red lichen.  A natural hollow is centered on top of the rock, still damp from the remains of the last rainfall.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: A white sprinkle of lilies of the valley, intermingled with a few cloudberry bushes, covers the marshy ground.  A few stark-white birch trees grow nearby, blending in well with the fragrant flowers.  The soil is so soggy that you almost get stuck in it with every step you take.  Someone has had the forethought to place a few planks across a particularly forbidding area.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: Small, pink flowers brighten up the flat, mossy ground.  Two large rocks lie nearby, their surface covered by lime-green lichen.  The tranquility of this place is marred by a very loud and annoying bird of some sort.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: The meadowy terrain is broken up by shallow crevices, jagged tree stumps and pitted rocks.  The tree stumps are weathered a light-grey, reminding you of beached whale bones.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: The plainness of the moss-covered ground stands in sharp contrast to the colorful slope rising out of the vale.  Bushes erupting with dark-orange flowers cover the ascent, hints of their exotic fragrance occasionally drifting down to you.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: In the midst of this copse of haons lies a tiny pool.  The shape of the pool is reminiscent of a man-made well -- long abandoned.  The ground surrounding the pool is covered with soft moss and a few lichenous rocks.  Algae have tinged the water a beautiful, translucent green.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: White haon trees and small-leafed bushes grow on the springy moss.  In some of the nearby trees you can see large, intricately made birds' nests.  An occasional flutter of wings reminds you that the nests are occupied.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: Black-splotched haon trees surround you, their dark branches reaching forth menacingly.  Or so it almost seems.  The ground is covered in earthy humus, decayed remains of leaves and twigs from past seasons.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: An old rock slide has deposited its remains all across the valley floor.  Rocks of all sizes are strewn everywhere, making hiking quite difficult.  A crevice gapes like a jagged wound in the otherwise pristine hillside.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Crevice]
description: Loose rocks and soil make it hard to hike this crevice.  Small, thorny bushes cling desperately to the sandy soil, not making movement any easier at all.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: The view of Aillidh Brae is spectacular from here. Moonlight silhouettes the mountain and illuminates the area.  The mountain itself is barren granite, though the wavy terrain interferes with any notion of seeing much of it.

The view of Aillidh Brae is spectacular from here.  Shades of green and grey in the vale buttress the surrounding bands of dark purple and brown.  The mountain itself is barren granite, though the wavy terrain interferes with any notion of seeing much of it.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: A large, wind-scarred rock blocks off the northern horizon, leaving this part of the path in shadows.  A huge crow hops around on top of the rock, cawing gleefully.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: Patches of dark green moss fill every small dip in the mountainous terrain.  A few, crooked dwarf birch trees hug the rocky surface, roots gripping tightly any soil-filled cracks.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: The smooth, rising granite to the south is interrupted by a narrow animal trail.  A few tufts of sickly grass edge part of the trail.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: A few scrawny grouse peck nervously at the ground, searching for anything edible that may have escaped the notice of the ever-harsh wind.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: The path swings around a small body of crystal-clear water that has collected in a hollow.  The granite next to the water has been worn smooth over the years by animals seeking to quench their thirst.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: Rounded waves of dark-speckled granite stretch as far as the mortal eye can see, the sameness only broken up by splotches of reddish lichen.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: It looks like a battle has taken place on this barren mountain side.  Bits and pieces of rusted metal fleck the light-grey granite.  A broken spear juts out from under a rock.  Near it lies a smashed mithril helm, rocking gently in the wind.  The sound of the helm's wobble adds a touch of gloom or sorrow to this place.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: A stark, leafless tree rises to the north.  The dark trunk and branches lean out over a steep cliff, as if seeking final respite after many arduous years of simply trying to survive.  Part of a pitiful bird's nest straddles two branches, the rest having been stripped away by the incessant wind.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: The path ends abruptly at a steep ravine.  Howling wind blasts out of the ravine with enough force to make it very difficult to remain standing.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Mountain]
description: The mountain rises steeply on three sides, hemming in the narrow path.  Perpetual darkness drapes the westernmost part of this dead end.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: Someone has gone to a lot of bother to build a cairn right next to the narrow trail.  The cairn may only be the size of a halfling child, but the effort of collecting and stacking the rocks would seem to suggest that the cairn had some worthwhile meaning to its builder.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: Great furrows slashed by wind and rain mar the granite swells.  An occasional wild snarl can be heard, sounds beastly enough to make most any spine rattle.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: Erosion has tumbled away part of the ridge here, exposing slanted layers of ancient rock formations.  The edge of the ridge looks very unstable.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: A small group of mountain goats leans into the fierce wind, seemingly quite happy with the harshness that firmly grips this mountain.  Their long, white fur whirls in the gusts as the goats eagerly search for palatable flora.  Patches of close-cropped grass provide evidence that some was found.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: Swirling purple heather covers the barren mountain plateau.  A few moths are tossed around by the gusty wind, their already short lifespan haughtily put in peril by the forces of nature.

Swirling purple heather brightens up the barren mountain plateau.  A few frost-blue butterflies are tossed around by the gusty wind, their already short lifespan haughtily put in peril by the forces of nature.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: To the south stands an ancient cromlech, defying time and nature.  The circle of giant, grey rocks is only flawed by one crumbled monolith.  The massive red-grey slab roofing the cromlech looks sturdy enough to last a millennium or two, despite the constant bone-gnawing winds.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: Part of a weather-bleached skull is lodged firmly into a small crack nearby.  The top of the skull looks like it has been chopped off by a very sharp weapon.  Whether the gruesome remnant attests to a nearby sacrifice or to a struggle of some sort is impossible to tell at this point, the victim's demise was quite foul and final regardless.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: The mountain rises sharply to the east, affording some relief from the wind.  It looks like there's a small ledge a ways up the mountain, though only a mountain goat or a dwarf would enjoy the climb up to it.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ledge]
description: A small ledge is cut into the steep, west-facing mountainside.  The ledge is filled with rocks of all sizes, and more tumble down every so often.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ledge]
description: The ledge widens just enough to make it possible for a small group of adventurers to sit down and rest a bit.  The southern portion of the ledge is almost choked off by a couple of large rocks, but it is possible for the slim of waist to squeeze by them.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Cliff]
description: Smooth granite makes getting a purchase difficult, though the climb up is decidedly easier than the steep mountainside that awaits below.  An eerie strain drifts down occasionally from the pass further up.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Pass]
description: A cold wind blasts through the narrow pass, at times tugging rocks loose from the close mountainsides.  The wind's furious passage brings forth a low, haunting melody.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Pass]
description: Steep, ominous mountain walls lean away from the rugged trail.  A narrow sliver of dark grey sky is visible between the serrated mountain crowns.  An unrelenting wind howls through the pass.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Pass]
description: Dark, granite mountain walls hem the small trail.  A cave is partly hidden in the shadows.  Strange-looking symbols are chiseled around the cave opening.  An eerie aura seems to emanate from the cave and you can't help but notice that the locals stay well away from it.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Pass]
description: The foot of the pass is met by a small, wooden drawbridge straddling a deep cleft.  At the bottom of the cleft flows a small stream, foaming white as it washes over smooth rocks.  On the other side of the bridge lies a settlement of some sort.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Pass]
description: A bluish-grey mountain spire dominates the terrain.  The top of the spire is hidden by clinging clouds.  Around the base of the mountain pillar are strewn rocks of a variety of shapes and sizes.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Cave]
description: Enough moonlight leaks in to make the outermost portion of the cave hazily visible.  A couple of rusted torch-holders are bolted to the walls, and fantastical petroglyphs adorn most of the surfaces.  The ground is hardpacked soil and surprisingly flat.  The depth of the cave disappears in darkness, though a small crevice can be seen just where the blackness usurps the remaining light.

Enough light leaks in to make the outermost portion of the cave hazily visible.  A couple of rusted torch-holders are bolted to the walls, and fantastical petroglyphs adorn most of the surfaces.  The ground is hardpacked soil and surprisingly flat.  The depth of the cave disappears in darkness, though a small crevice can be seen just where the blackness usurps the remaining light.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: A squat, stone guard house stands next to the small drawbridge.  A stream gurgles cheerfully under the bridge.  From here the rocky path splits off in three directions, the eastern option leading directly into the settlement.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: Many feet have walked this trail over the years, grinding a smooth, furrowed trail in the speckled granite.  Off to the side rushes a stream, gaining frothy speed as it hastens down the mountain.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The mountain is shorn off to the side, the vertical drop fading into the mist far below.  A hawk floats serenely on the strong wind currents high above, its sad, high-pitched cry occasionally piercing the air.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: Large cracks cut across the speckled granite, making walking precarious.  Rocks along the cracks occasionally rive free and tumble into dark oblivion.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: A stone obelisk, inlaid with patina covered bronze, stands a bit off to the side of the trail.  The obelisk is surrounded by a short cast-iron picket fence.  A wreath of dry heather lies next to the monument.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: Long furrows carved by wind and rain mar the granite swells, the cuts conjuring up images of a gigantic bird ripping up the mountain with man-sized talons.  In the distance the desolate ruins of a peel tower can be seen.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: Rusted pieces of metal are scattered around, staining the nearby rock reddish brown.  Some of the pieces can be identified as remnants of weapons or armor, but most are just flaky chunks waiting to weather into nothingness.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The mountain drops steeply to the north, affording a view of the misty lands below.  Erosion has cut away part of the ridge, conceivably making it possible for those with contempt for intelligence, death and danger to climb.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The worn granite trail continues to wind around the settlement.  At times as you make your way forth, you spot reivers on guard duty, their proud bearing ever vigilant as they watch for krolvin raiders.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: A small covey of grouse busily peck for food on the smooth, undulating granite terrain.  Drab feathers ruffle slightly with each gust of wind.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outside Tower]
description: To the east stands the ruins of an old peel, its splintered doorway toothlessly agape.  The massive rock walls must have provided great protection at one time, before something or someone reduced the tower to its present state.  Enough of the tower remains to easily dominate the nearby area, the jagged top of it snapping hungrily at the sky.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: A lone house occupies this area.  Dark shaded shutters and door lend a sad feel to the house and its environs.  A leafless dwarf birch grows next to the house, completing the grey bleakness of the place.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: Small, thatch-roofed houses stand on both sides of the pathway.  Their sturdy, grey rock walls brightened somewhat by green-washed shutters and doors.  Next to one door stands a wooden planter filled with colorful irises.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: Houses made of mortared rocks flank the pathway.  Thatched roofs extend further from the walls than seem normal.  A dried bouquet of wild thyme, tied with a lavender ribbon, hangs upside down in one of the windows.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: Some of the houses here are badly damaged, one of them in utter ruins.  The destruction seems of fairly recent origin.  Judging by the bashed door on one of the houses, there must have been some fierce fighting here of late.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: A small church stands a bit on its own north of the pathway.  Built with large, round granite rocks with a roof of slate shingles, it shows signs of weathered age.  A brass plaque covered with verdigris is fastened next to the door.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: Small, thatch-roofed houses stand on both sides of the pathway.  Their sturdy, grey rock walls brightened somewhat by green-washed shutters and doors.  A face peeks out through one of the windows briefly, then disappears.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: A small garden, surrounded by a low rock fence, lies next to one of the houses.  In one section of the garden grow carrots, cucumbers, cabbage and a few other hardy vegetables.  Thyme, parsley and other unusual looking herbs grow elsewhere.  The garden adds a very comfortable, almost rustic, homeyness to this area.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: An open gate between two houses leads into the settlement.  The houses are made of sturdy rock walls and have thick, green-washed shutters.  A lone reiver guard attentively patrols the area.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The meandering pathway runs up to a steep cliff thrice the height of man.  Loose rocks edging the cliff blur in the grey of dusky shadows.  A small crack can be discerned in the darkness.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The trail snakes around a cracked boulder.  Apt, since a small family of black adders seem to have made their home in this area.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: A sturdy smithy stands to the north, acrid smoke wafting from its chimney.  The door leading into the smithy is split, the upper part usually open to let heat inside escape.  A few farm tools, damaged and speckled with rust, lean against the smithy.  A large, but simple, house stands to the south.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: Several small houses occupy this junction, making this area seem a bit more busy than others.  One of the houses has an open-walled shed built against its side.  The shed is partly filled with thatch.  In front of the shed, partly obscuring some of the thatch, stands an old wheelbarrow.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: A large building dominates the rest.  Though squat like most of the other buildings, the Great Hall is easily three times the size of any other.  Narrow windows, a reinforced door and a slate roof make the hall an admirable defensive structure, should that dire need occur.  Mostly it is just used for village gatherings and feasts.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: Small, thatch-roofed houses stand on both sides of the pathway.  Their sturdy, grey rock walls brightened somewhat by green-washed shutters and doors.  An old broom leans next to one door.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: To the west stands a cozy-looking tavern.  The rocks used to build it are obviously taken from an older portion of the ruined peel tower.  A colorful sign dangles back and forth above the red-painted door of the tavern.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: A crystal clear stream runs next to the path.  Thorny, purple thistle covers the lower part of the steep banks.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: A huge boulder forces the trail to detour around it.  In the shadows under the boulder glint tiny eyes.  Once in awhile a high-pitched squeak can be heard from the dark shadows.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: Tufts of coarse grass poke up from soil-filled dips in the granite terrain.  A few mountain roltons look up from feeding briefly, then, almost with disdain, go back to it.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The worn granite trail continues to circle around the settlement.  At times as you make your way forth, you spot reivers on guard duty, their proud bearing ever vigilant as they watch for krolvin attackers.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: A bit north of the trail lies a patch of arable land.  Poorly growing turnips and potatos show off their stunted greenery.  It also looks like there is some type of farm equipment on the far side of the fields.  A pathetic-looking scarecrow fails miserably at its task, a black bird resting contentedly on one of its shoulders.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The mountainous path and its wavy granite surroundings are contrasted by the drab grain fields that lie to the north.  A few nocturnal birds circle the fields occasionally, perhaps eyeing either the grains or any small rodents that might be running around.

The mountainous path and its wavy granite surroundings are contrasted by the drab grain fields that lie to the north.  A few dark birds circle the fields occasionally, perhaps eyeing either the grains or any small rodents that might be running around.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The monotony of the mountainous terrain is broken up by some small buildings in the distance.  An unusual smell catches your attention at times, leaving you with a nagging feeling that this is not a place to linger overlong.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: Thin, crusty moss covers almost everything, except the crests of the wavy mountain.  An algae-filled puddle of water struggles to survive in the rough, windy terrain.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: A crooked crabapple tree stands forlornly near the trail.  Despite the sickly, lichen-covered trunk and the twisted or broken branches, a few bright red apples sway boldly in the wind.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: The smell easily gives away what the old, wooden structure to the south is.  The slightly tilting outhouse seems to lean defiantly into the wind, the result of a ground-wall in need of repairs.  Two interlocked hearts have been carved into the door, with a small wooden peg on each side.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: Fields of stunted grain swirl around in the wind.  The dull-yellow rye and wheat reign over most of the barely arable land, oat stalks occupying the remainder.  On the far side of the rye stands a rather large compost heap with a pitchfork stuck into it.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: To the west and south lie some pitiful-looking fields.  The potato and turnip plants look scrawny and unhealthy.  It is obvious that much back-breaking labor is needed to make anything grow here at all.  A beat-up, old plough stands next to the turnip field.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Settlement]
description: Houses made of mortared rocks flank the pathway.  Thatched roofs extend further from the walls than seem normal.  A fluffy, white cat sits in one of the windows, licking its paw with utter concentration.  It did seem like its bright blue eyes were looking out of the window just a moment ago.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The plateau opens up a bit to the north, as the cliff to the east slowly descends to the level of the pathway.  The settlement can barely be seen in the distance.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Guard House]
description: The guard house is a scene of dusty simplicity.  Towards one wall stands a large, well-used table with two opposing chairs.  A few spears and a broadsword are propped up against one corner.  A sturdy door leads outside.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Peel Tower]
description: Rough granite walls encircle this large room.  Pieces of smashed furniture litter the floor, much of it covered in dust.  Occasional gusts of wind send minor whirlwinds twirling playfully through the area.  A narrow, curving stairway hugs the wall, leading to the floor above.  A broken doorway leads outside.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Peel Tower]
description: The top of the tower looks like it has been sheared off at an angle, leaving this area vulnerable to the often harsh climate.  A narrow, curving stairway hugs the wall, leading to the floor below.  Part of a large, oaken beam juts out from a small pile of rubble nearby.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Church]
description: This part of the church is filled with heavy, wooden pews.  Hauling the pews up to this mountain settlement must have been a long and strenuous affair.  Red, amber and blue lights caress the top portion of the pews.  An oaken door leads outside.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Church]
description: Bathed in warm colors, a wooden pulpit dominates this area.  Behind the pulpit is a hexagonal window inlaid with red, amber and blue crystal panes.  A large oak tablet hangs on the wall.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Smithy]
description: A rock-walled furnace filled with red glowing embers stands a bit off center on the dirt floor.  Next to it are two large barrels filled with tepid water.  Gear in various shapes and forms hang on the wall or lie on the workbenches.  A much-abused axe rests on a large, steel anvil.  The air is heavy with acrid smoke.  A sooty door leads out.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Great Hall]
description: A long table surrounded by high-backed chairs dominates the hall.  Carvings decorate much of the wooden surfaces.  Studded targes and crossed weapons adorn the walls.  The weaponry looks well-used and in excellent shape.  A reinforced oaken door leads outside.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Chief's Bedroom]
description: This chamber is small, but comfortable.  A high, wood-paneled bed stands in one corner, its shape reminiscent of a seafaring captain's bunk.  A small writing desk stands against the other wall -- a few papers, an old quill pen and a few other odds and ends lying on it.  A tawny humpbacked puma fur hangs on the wall.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Tavern]
description: A long counter takes up most of the space against one wall.  Flickering candles make the low ceiling dark and sooty, but cast a warm, amber light throughout the room.  A few round tables are surrounded by sturdy chairs.  The intimate ambiance is only slightly detracted from by the thin layer of dust that covers some of the less used areas.  An old, red-painted door leads outside.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Tavern]
description: Round tables and old chairs occupy most of the floor space.  The tables all have lit candles on them, many of the candles stuck onto wine bottles.  The wooden floor is worn and uneven, more a dirty-grey than the original brown.  On the walls hang weapons, a couple of brass-studded targes and several finely carved oak crests.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outhouse]
description: Planked seating take up much of the space here.  Two holes have been cut out of the top of the planks, the surrounding area well-polished by long usage.  A metal bucket filled with a mixture of lime powder and ashes stands in a corner.  A white-washed haon door, with a painted slate hanging on it, leads outside.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of moonlight parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of light parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cave]
description: The hollow may be cold and clammy, but it is also impossible for large beasts to enter.  Nasty snarls from somewhere outside the opening almost make it possible to forget the shivering and the darkness.  Almost, but not quite.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: The cavern slopes up steeply, though cracks and dips in the speckled granite make it fairly easy to climb.  A tiny stream of water runs down along the side, but the ground is mostly dry underfoot.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: High above, dark shadows flutter and odd sounds echo softly.  A great number of bats have made this portion of the cave their home.  Clustered like rotten fruit on a tree, it may seem strange that they simply don't fall.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: The surrounding grey granite is veiled by darkness.  A large chunk of pyrite penetrates the veil near the ground, its multi-faceted shine buffed by passing beasts.  The polished golden metal would surely look fitting on anyone with a taste for the gaudy, if only one could find a way to easily remove it.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: Though the ground is flat and smooth, except for coarse sand and small pebbles nestling the perimeter, the domed ceiling and walls are corrugated diagonally.  Barring one area on the southern wall, the furrows are quite shallow.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: Dark shadows hide much of the pitted rock surfaces, though it is possible to see stalactites forming aloft.  Mineral-rich water drips from the larger stalactites, the resulting sounds strangely relaxing and harmonious.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: The walls narrow a bit, making this section a tight squeeze.  The dark rock is flecked with silvery glitter, beckoning hypnotically like a star-filled night.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: A large block of granite, surprisingly flat and smooth, obstructs passage.  Since it is only the height of a short human, it shouldn't be hard to scamper up at all.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: The cavern bends around a sharp and jagged corner.  A chasm gapes darkly parallel to the pathway, leaving only a foot-width or so to walk on in some areas.  Very faint echoes of distant lapping water can be heard.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: A faintly glowing vein of quartz streaks through the dark granite of the northern wall like a bolt of lightning.  Though the width of the vein varies, the average is about a hand's span.  The quartz is an opaque white, reminiscent of dirty or cloudy ice.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: Shadows exaggerate the rugged surfaces, conjuring up images of twisted faces and fantastical beasts.  Some of the images seem alive in the flickering darkness, as if they are struggling to escape their rocky imprisonment.  Contorted faces gape open with silent screams of hysteria.  But there is no escape.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: Dark shadows hide much of the rough granite surfaces, though it is possible to see small stalactites protruding through the darkness.  An occasional droplet of murky water drips from the canine formations, conjuring up eerie images of a giant's sharp teeth dripping with blood.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: The lava tunnel on the eastern end of the cavern flares open and merges into dark granite.  Faint cracks vein much of the area where the lava and granite meet, small amounts of water seeping through them.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: The shadowy lava tunnel bends slightly before continuing into darkness.  The lower portion of the walls has been rubbed smooth, and a slight musky smell clings to the black surface.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: Abrasive lava, solidified into a tunnel-like cavern, squeezes in on all sides -- forcing careful movement lest gear or skin be scraped or torn.  The air has a slight hint of sulphur to it.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: The dark cavern is formed from black lava, frozen in porous splendor.  The ceiling is low enough that crawling or stooping are the only options.  Nasty snarls in the distance suggest that stooping is better than crawling at this point.

title: [Clearing]
description: Pines ringing the clearing deepen the night's shadows, their boughs heavy with long, fragrant needles.  Although the trees stand back, seemingly respectful of the circle's perimeter, the invasive ferns have surrendered little ground.  They dance around the pines' feet, lacing among an embankment of boulders blanketing a rise that borders the clearing on one side.

title: [Crown of Boulders]
description: The large boulders jumbled about are mottled with delicate mosses.  Trillium grows here and there, offering tri-leafed stems crowned with snow-white blossoms.  Ferns resume their rampant play behind the edge of the granite outcrop, sprawling over and around the feet of a beautifully veined, black marble portal.

title: [Marble Hallway]
description: The bright rectangle at the hallway's end fades into the gloom of the dark marble walls.  At the opposite end of the hall, a soft, greenish light glows from the building's interior.  The air smells damp, but it's more the fresh, clean scent of woodland shade than an odor of decay, as one might expect of such a place as this old edifice.

title: [Shrine of Leya]
description: Moonlight streams down into the circular building from an opening in the domed ceiling.  Around the walls, niches at each point of the compass are filled with statuary.  A marble altar with flaring edges, supported by two arching pedestal legs, stands against the far wall.  In the room's center is a round, marble-edged pool.  Drops of water fall from the dome's "eye" into the pool like tears.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, northwest, out

title: [Shrine of Leya, Northwest Wall]
description: Against the curved wall sits a marble altar, its contours echoing the arcuation.  Light from the dome above plays across its polished surface, dappling it as clouds drift past the moons outside.  A formidable sword rests upon the altar, and although the altar's dimensions seem perfectly contrived to bear the weapon's span, the sword lies there askew, as if casually discarded.

title: [Shrine of Leya, West Niche]
description: This side of the building is bathed in vertigris shadow.  Positioned within the niche is a grey marble figure of a young woman reclining against the bole of a tree.  Her form is supple and her features possess a divine grace as fierce as it is sublime.  Occasional reflections of light from the building's walls play across the statue, making it almost seem to breathe.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Shrine of Leya, South Niche]
description: The area within the alcove is almost completely overtaken by the sculpture it harbors.  An ensemble of two figures, the monument bears a carved legend across its base that reads "Mercy".  Appropriately, the soft illumination bathing the statuary promotes a meditative ambiance.

title: [Shrine of Leya, East Niche]
description: The alcove harbors a figure embodying the quality of action-in-repose, the figure of "Day".  A warrior with a face of classic beauty, he kneels on one knee, resting an arm upon the hilt of a formidable sword.  Grasped in his other hand is a scepter crowned by a snarling lion.  His visage is fierce as he gazes forward with a resolute expression in his blank, marble eyes.

title: [Shrine of Leya, North Niche]
description: The sound of water dripping into the shrine's pool echoes quietly within the north niche.  Only a modicum of light manages to intrude, leaving the imposing figure of "Strength" cloaked in partial shadow.  He is turned, and looks back over a thickly muscled shoulder, almost as if he were about to disappear into the niche's wall.  The twisted pose of the statue emphasizes its powerful musculature.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [The Slope, Circle of Stones]
description: The massive stones completely encircle you.  The fit of each lintel is exact, and a twin of the others.  Underneath one arch, the brook burbles down into a pool in the center of the circle, filling a small depression, and then moving on through the other side.  The quietness and tranquillity of this place is lulling, and seems to provide a haven for rest and healing.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, West Bank]
description: The trail follows the pond's bank, while sending a branch up the hillside where more cottages cling to the slope like colorful patches on a jester's doublet.  Thick beds of blossoms line the avenue, attended by bees and butterflies, all competing for the ample nectar within the blooms.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, South Bank]
description: Cottages line the road, their backs tucked neatly against the hillside. A collection of mussel shells suspended from thin silk threads hangs from a garden arch, which spans the cobbled entrance of one of the homes.  As the wind caresses them, the shells make a pleasant melody.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, South Bank]
description: The walk turns, following the pond's kidney-shaped circumference.  A gentle breeze kicks up low swells on the pond's surface, which sparkle in the sunlight.  Diverging from the avenue, a smaller track quickly disappears between two cottages.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, East Bank]
description: A dense hedge boasts a thick mantle of bright yellow blossoms.  It follows the road for a piece, then turns to run beside a cottage with shutters painted a shade of yellow that rivals the flowers.  Sitting on a pole anchored in the ground rests a flat platform of wood, filled with seeds and nuts.  Birds cluster around it, chirping at each other in an effort to gain control of the feast.

title: [Hillside]
description: The track meanders up to a door set into the vertical face of an immense boulder buried in the hillside.  Mighty hinges are bolted into the rock sill, supporting the heavy oak of the portal.  Occupying the door's center is a large bronze knocker cast in the shape of a bee.  It launches out, wings outstretched, as if it had been frozen in mid-flight.  The insect's expression looks ferocious in such an exaggerated context.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Beehive Trail]
description: Perched on the ample shoulder of the hill, the trail skirts the incline, passing between cottages blessed with an expansive view of Hummingbird Pond as well as an impressive expanse of the surrounding countryside.  Further up, a collection of bee hives is visible, and beyond, the forest reclaims the hillside.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Hillview Lane]
description: Hillview Lane curves past a cottage set into the pronounced slope.  The road is bolstered in places with stone walls, where the incline drops away.  Vines cling to the rock, offering a riot of blossoms to disguise the stone supports.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Hillview Lane]
description: The lane circles into a sharp turn at the gate of a peculiar dwelling.  It is built in cantilevered sections, which skirt the hillside in flagstone wings.  A brook bursts from its underground course and cascades over a ridge of large natural rock beside one of the residence's balconies.  The home appears to float in space above the waterfall, intimately related to the hillside which gives it a foundation.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Beehive Hill]
description: A group of beehives sits on the hillside, each one surrounded by a peppery-looking cloud of bees hovering around it.  Two or three halflings toddle back and forth tending the apiary, wearing netted headgear to protect them from their charges.  A small grove of aspen trees grows behind the hives, their swaying branches lending a dappled pattern to the supers.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, East Bank]
description: The cobblestone walk veers toward the pond, following it so closely, one misstep will leave the unwary pedestrian ankle-deep in pond water.  A cottage sits on pilings sunk into the pond's mud floor, its gardens composed of water lilies.  Raised stones offer a walkway to the cottage's round door.  Baskets of blooming jasmine hang from the eaves, spicing the air with exotic perfume.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Bridgeover]
description: The avenue halts at the foot of a bridge, which lifts over the road in an exaggerated arch.  The span is painted in a rainbow of color, each curl and turn of wood calling for its own unique pigment.  Blossoms and vines are carved into the wooden handrails, rivaling the authentic lace of vines clinging to the bridge in detail and beauty.  The cottages below add color to the scene with the flowers blooming on their sod roofs.

title: [Mine, Crystal Caves]
description: Rose quartz and amethyst crystals glitter pastel pink and purple in this small cave.  To one side, a gruesome contrast to the delicate color of the minerals, lies the mangled body of a dwarf.

title: [Mine]
description: You can see various crevices of differing colors of rock in the walls of the passageway.  It appears that some have been explored further and small, rough hewn ledges have been carved to find veins of desired minerals.

title: [Mine]
description: The passage narrows and the floor falls away to reveal a wide crevice over a dark pit.  The passage appears to continue on the other side of the crevice that is bridged by an old, rotted plank that was once a shoring timber.

title: [Mine]
description: A large natural cavern starts to expand as you step amid piles of rock debris.  The north wall has been chipped and hewn up to the edge of the crevice.  The black maw of a chasm before you is broken only by a single rotted plank that bridges it.

title: [Mine]
description: The high ceiling of the cavern arches here about thirty feet above your head.  Mounds of crushed rock lay as evidence of the hours of work that must have taken place here in the quest for precious minerals.

title: [Mine]
description: The walls of the cavern contain many exploratory digs which revealed no signs of the minerals that the people were searching for.  Other deeper veins have been worked until they yielded no more traces of the mineral wealth.

title: [Mine]
description: The cavern walls converge here at the point of a deep well-worked vein of ore.  Rotted sacks lay on the floor near some broken pick axe handles and the moss covered remains of a mine worker.

title: [Mine]
description: This tunnel is quite narrow and has been shored with sturdy timbers every few feet.  The floor of the passage is rubble-strewn and in some places you stoop to avoid the timbers which hold back the rocks overhead.

title: [Alisis' Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls, and a paneled haon ceiling rises overhead.  A fragrant pink jasmine plant sits in one corner of a patterned hardwood floor.  There is a long mahogany rack on one side of the shop and a heavy lead glass display case on the other.

title: [Mine]
description: This tunnel is quite narrow, following what must be a fully-mined vein.  Timbers shore the roof securely, but it seems the workers stopped expanding the passage much further than the veinal flow.

title: [Mine]
description: The vein turns slowly to the south where a larger hole has been cut from the rock, as it apparently became richer with whatever ore it yielded.  At the eastern edge of this tunnel, the passage widens, obviously to let more workers at the richer ore.

title: [Mine]
description: A broken cot and the remnants of a wooden table and oil lamp rest near the northern wall.  Piles of rubble and rotten, gnawed sacks lay scattered about the room, glum evidence that men had long ago worked this vein of mineral wealth.

title: [Mine]
description: A pick axe is embedded in a large rock of hard stone.  It is difficult to comprehend the strength needed to bury the shaft of that tool so deeply into the rock.  Another vein of ore has been worked on the northern edge of this room.

title: [Mine]
description: A ruined wheelbarrow lays filled with rubble near the mined vein of mineral.  A few tools lay scattered about the floor.

title: [Mine]
description: A natural room gives way to the western passage, and an area of over-mined rock lines the southern wall.

title: [Mine]
description: The ledge above the cavern is larger than appeared from the room below.  It continues to the east and appears to be covered with more of the pine branches that you saw at the entrance to the cavern.

title: [Mine]
description: The ledge ends at the eastern wall above the cavern and some full sacks of ore lay neatly stacked in a corner.  The top of a large boulder is near the edge of the ledge.  The center of the boulder has a hand carved depression.

title: [Mine]
description: The top of the boulder here is hollowed out, forming a hiding place and a spot to pause to survey the scene.  Its hollowed out center reveals that it is a very special boulder, in fact it is a huge geode.  Crystal spikes of various hues cover the interior, and fade into darkness.

title: [Mine, Crystal Caves]
description: The hard-packed dirt and dull grey stone that form the walls in so much of the mines are nowhere to be found here.  Instead, outcroppings of crystals of every size and color dazzle you, glinting with light from an unseen source.  Quartz, citrine and amethyst glow gently, bathing you in jewel-like hues.

title: [Mine, Crystal Caves]
description: Rose quartz flows across the ceiling, dripping down to the floor in huge pink columns that look almost liquid.  Olivine carpets the floor like fresh grass, crunching under your feet as you cross the room.  You hear a dripping in the distance, but with all the echoes you can't tell which direction it's coming from.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, up, down

title: [Mine, Crystal Caves]
description: Milky quartz and stilbite encrust this room, their dull white bulk giving it an oppressive air.  You pick your way across the uneven floor, fearful of impaling yourself on something sharp if you trip.  You hear a dripping sound coming from somewhere, but with all the echoes in these caverns, you can't quite tell the direction.

title: [Mine, Crystal Caves]
description: You wander in between mounds and pillars and walls of quartz, the twisted patterns making your eyes cross a bit as you wonder where that dripping sound is coming from.  In the middle of a blink, you catch a glimmer of something gold!

title: [Mine, Crystal Caves]
description: Great outcroppings of citrine give this cavern a warm, golden radiance.  As you look around, you notice that many of the crystals are shattered, their fragments littering the floor.  You hear a dripping sound in the distance, but can't quite figure out where it's coming from.

title: [Mine, Crystal Caves]
description: This huge, circular cavern glitters pink and gold and green around the edges, fading to sparkling white in the center.  In the middle of the room, you see a round pool full of milky liquid, its surface disturbed by the drops that drip off of a great white stalactite hanging from the center of the ceiling.  The PLOP, PLOP, PLOP echoes throughout the room and beyond.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ridge Line]
description: You are grasped by the stiff sea breeze that makes its way along the crest of the ridge you are standing upon.  Sea gulls dance on the sky's waves, their cries from above warn that you approach their hidden nests in the rocks.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: A large section of the inner curtain wall has collapsed here, virtually filling the outer ward with huge blocks and bits and pieces of stone.  Although the ward once continued to the south from here, it is quite impossible to travel that way today.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: You enter a realm so splendid and bewitching that you are left speechless.  Later, when asked to describe what you saw, you are unable to do more than open your mouth and gawk at the memories.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: Rivulets of water from pools nearby form miniature waterfalls cascading over small rocky ledges.  Moss hangs from the rocks like an ancient dwarf's beard and drinks from the falling fountains.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: Sun-bleached bones lie scattered over the rocky ridge, none of them discernable as human.  Large aerial guardians circle high overhead as they keep watch over the ocean, hilltop and meadow.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: A group of tall, rough cut boulders lies carefully placed in a semi-circle with its opening toward the ocean below.  There are numerous carvings of stone faces, some quite intricate, and others which appear to have been hewn with poor stone tools.

title: [Ocean View]
description: The ocean and all of its majesty dance far below this man made perch.  A bench of solid stone, carved from the cliff, overlooks a simple stone table.  Dried flowers adorn the table, an offering by some unknown person devoted to the old ways.

title: [Sea Caverns]
description: It's damp and chilly in the cavern, and only a little moonlight filters in from a hole leading up.  The walls are natural rock, worn smooth by wind, water and time.  The cavern widens to the east.
It's damp and chilly in the cavern, and the only light comes from a hole leading up.  The walls are natural rock, worn smooth by wind, water and time.  The cavern widens to the east.

title: [Sea Caverns]
description: Luminescent fungi grow on the walls of the cavern, casting a faint greenish-blue glow.  Stalactites hang from ceiling to floor.  A crack along the eastern wall leads into darkness.

title: [Sea Caverns]
description: This small cavern is bare, save for a few large boulders near the wall.  The air in here is still and musty.

title: [Sea Caverns]
description: Small footprints cover the floor of this large, round cavern.  Grunts, squeals and high-pitched squeaks echo down the passages leading out.  In the center of the room are the ashes of a small fire pit.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Sea Caverns, Massive Chamber]
description: This chamber is vast, and the far walls are barely visible in the flickering light from the fire-pit in the center.  A ring of spears surrounds the fire, each topped by a small, fanged skull.  A wide passage leads off to the north, and there's a small opening low on the eastern wall.

title: [Sea Caverns, Sleeping Quarters]
description: The walls of this chamber are lined with piles of filthy rags.  A banged-up wooden rack against the eastern wall holds various sorts of weapons, none in very good shape.  Scraps of leather, metal and various shiny objects are strewn about the floor.

title: [Sea Caverns, Chieftain's Lair]
description: This chamber is furnished with an old, battered table and a trio of rickety chairs.  An especially large pile of rags lies in the northeast corner.  At its foot is a massive iron chest.  A ragged tapestry is hung upon the southern wall.

title: [Sea Caverns, Low Tunnel]
description: The floor of this narrow tunnel is slippery with moss.  Light filters in from a passage to the north and the low opening in the wall to the southwest.

title: [Sea Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel is narrow and light is barely able to intrude.  Garbage is also present here, muffling the sound of footsteps.  To the southeast, the darkness deepens making visibility difficult, and it appears the going gets more confining in that direction.

title: [Sea Caverns, Crawl Space]
description: The rough-hewn stone walls have narrowed, becoming nothing more than a crawl space.  The darkness here is almost a palpable thing, making the thought of fresh air and sunlight difficult to imagine.

title: [Sea Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The dank rock walls are close, but it's not as claustrophobic here as in other parts of these caverns.  The garbage, however, seems to be uniformly deep.  A curious 'whisper' of sound can be heard coming from the southeast direction.  To the southwest, a visible trail has been forged through the muck on the tunnel floor.

title: [Sea Caverns, Small Chamber]
description: The walls widen here, making it comfortable to take a moment's ease.  Although there's garbage about, a cool breeze wafting in from the east dilutes the stench a bit.  A soft gurgle of water is identifiable, emanating from the same direction as the fresher air.  Underfoot, the cave's floor has turned to a loose shale leading down towards the water's song.

title: [Sea Caverns, River's Edge]
description: Here, the cavern is more spacious.  The loose pebbles of the floor disappear into the embrace of a river as dark as a moonless night.  It appears to have a swift current, judging from the sound of it flowing through a fissure in the southern wall.

title: [Sea Caverns, Small Chamber]
description: This small space is unremarkable except for the hideous stench of the refuse.  Peeking out of an impressive pile heaped against the south wall are various bones and ragged pelts, obviously unpalatable even to goblins.  To the southeast, a shimmer of light can be discerned. To the northeast, the darkness thickens.

title: [Sea Caverns, Sleeping Quarters]
description: This is obviously another area the goblins have claimed as living quarters.  Piles of rags line the walls all about.  A fire pit smolders in the chamber's center, giving off the rank smell of burning hair.  All sorts of scraps and trinkets litter the ground around the pit's perimeter.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Sea Caverns, Sleeping Quarters]
description: Here in the southeast corner of the large cavern, the air is hazy with the fire pit's acrid smoke.  Piles of garbage have overtaken the rags.  It seems likely that the goblins toss the remains of meals in this direction from the comfort of the nests on the cavern's other side.

title: [Sea Caverns, Sleeping Quarters]
description: This is the northeast corner of the large chamber.  The piles of rags are so thick here, progress in any direction requires wading through them, stirring up a noxious stink.

title: [Sea Caverns, Sleeping Quarters]
description: This southwest corner of the cavern is strewn with bits of leather and broken weapons.  Some old swords in better repair, although not by much, are stacked haphazardly against the wall.  A pile of various types of skulls nearby seems like a small monument to carnage.

title: [Sea Caverns, Cooking Chamber]
description: Rusted iron pots are strewn about this chamber.  There's an iron cauldron boiling on the fire in the middle of the room, and the smell wafting from it is sickly sweet.  Something is roasting on a spit within the hearth against the northern wall.  A small passage leads southwest.

title: [Sea Caverns, Storage Chamber]
description: Boxes and sacks are jumbled together in this small, round chamber.  A thick swarm of flies buzzes about, and various sorts of beetles work over the foodstuffs stored here.  Some rusted cookware hangs from hooks on the wall.

title: [Sea Caverns, Dark Passage]
description: A chill draft blows through this low, narrow passage, carrying the distinctive odor of rotting garbage.  The stench is thicker toward the south.

title: [Sea Caverns, Garbage Chamber]
description: Massive piles of garbage reach nearly to the ceiling.  Bones, scraps and unrecognizables mix together in a rotten morass of greys, browns and black.  Much of it is piled about a fissure in the floor.  The stench is so bad it's almost visible.

title: [Sea Caverns, Refuse Pile]
description: The floor is covered with rotting piles of garbage, apparently dumped from the dark fissure above.  Some of the piles seem to be writhing, though it's tough to be sure through the noxious fog that blankets the floor.  To the southeast, a mass of webs fills the tunnel.

title: [Sea Caverns, Spider Lair]
description: The cavern widens into a vast, circular chamber.  Various small skeletons are scattered about, all of them stripped clean.  Faint chitterings echo down the passages to the east and southeast.  The western wall is covered by a mass of webs.

title: [Sea Caverns, Spider Lair]
description: The yellow-green fungi covering the eastern wall give off a soft, sickly glow.  Webs drape down from a ceiling lost in darkness above, the silky strands dancing gently in the still air.  Small white bones litter the floor below, some of them large enough to be humanoid.

title: [Sea Caverns, Spider Lair]
description: This cavern is shaped like an elbow, and a dim glow creeps in from the northeast passage.  The walls are pocked with small, dark openings, through which drift faint scuffling sounds and chitterings.  The air is damp and still.

title: [Sea Caverns, Dark Tunnel]
description: A damp draft blows toward the east down this narrow tunnel.  Discarded husks, the skin of some worm or snake, litter the floor.

title: [Sea Caverns, Lower Level]
description: Moss clings to the walls of this small, chilly cavern.  The smashed remains of a barrel rot in one corner.  A cool draft blows toward the east, and progress to the south is blocked by a crude but sturdy gate.

title: [Sea Caverns]
description: The size of this cavern is larger than one would have anticipated while making the precarious climb up the wall.  The darkness is pierced by a single shaft of light from a narrow fissure high above.  A faint chirping noise tells you there are bats nesting in lofty aeries overhead.  There is no sign at all of the garbage here, however, so a little bat dung underfoot seems a reasonable exchange.  A large rock slide to the south seems to block further travel on this level.

title: [Sea Caverns, Hidden Chamber]
description: Crawling over the rocks, you find yourself in yet another chamber.  This one is smaller, with its corners cloaked in shadow.  Looking up elicits a gasp of surprise...cave paintings!  Roltons, velnalins, horses and wolves race across walls and ceilings in wild profusion.  Some are simply outlined in black while others are filled in with bright earth colors, but all show the same uncanny sense of life.  This is obviously not the work of goblins!

title: [Sea Caverns, Lower Level]
description: The air is still in the circular cavern, smelling faintly of salt water.  A sturdy gate blocks the passage to the northwest, while the southern wall is hidden by a mass of stalagmites.  Piled in front of the stalagmites are three white goblin skulls.

title: [Sea Caverns, Stagnant Pool]
description: The black waters of a small pool lie still against the southern wall.  Luminescent fungi grow upon the walls, their odd green glow reflected off the surface of the pond.  A circle of stalagmites stands just at the shore, surrounding the pool like silent stone sentries.

title: [Wolves' Den, Stagnant Pool]
description: Grey stone blocks form the walls of this small, square room.  The sturdy gates against the eastern wall are surrounded by arrow slits.  A pool of brackish water, perhaps 15 feet across, lies in the northwest corner.

title: [Wolves' Den, Entry Hall]
description: A tattered red banner hangs from the grey stones of the north wall.  The sturdy gates to the west have arrow slits to each side.  An armored skeleton lies by each.  A matched pair of doors leads east, and a passage south opens into a larger chamber.
