title: [Wolves' Den, Assembly Hall]
description: This long, vast hall is empty.  Torch sconces line the grey stone walls.  The remains of a small podium molder at the southern end.  A passage just beyond them leads south into the shadows.

title: [Wolves' Den, Seal Room]
description: In the center of the floor is a great red and black seal.  Ancient footprints in the dust lead in circles around it, heading down the passages that lead off in all directions.  A makeshift barricade leans against the northwest corner.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Wolves' Den, Long Hall]
description: Along the northern wall of this long, dark hallway are a dented iron door, a corroded iron door, and a rusted iron door.  A rough stone arch and a pitted stone arch open in the south wall.

title: [Wolves' Den, Well]
description: The ancient well in the center of the room is filled with water.  It bubbles up from below, clear and cold.  The walls are lined with finely carved stone benches, and a passage leads off northeast.

title: [Wolves' Den, Baths]
description: Ten tubs of copper, now green with verdigris, circle the fire-pit in the center of the room.  The walls are lined with iron pegs.  Upon a wooden rack, small bottles and clay pots lie covered with a blanket of dust.

title: [Wolves' Den, Corridor]
description: The walls are lined with torch sconces set into the grey stone.  Lichens have taken root on the ceiling, staining it a greenish-brown.

title: [Wolves' Den, Corridor]
description: This passage turns a corner, leading east and south.  The white granite arch against the northern wall leads into a larger chamber.

title: [Wolves' Den, Long Hallway]
description: Six wooden doors line the eastern wall of this cold stone passage.  The first, second, and third doors seem almost intact, but insect husks lie thick on the floor around the fourth and fifth and a smell of mildew fills that part of the hall.  The sixth door is nearly broken off its hinges.

title: [Wolves' Den, Sleeping Quarters]
description: Many of the beds in this spacious room have crumbled into piles of wood, mold and cloth, and the rest are well on their way.  Some of the beds are surrounded by frames of metal and wood, from which hang tattered cloths.  Apparently, this was an attempt at privacy.  A wide passage leads off south, and there's a wooden door in the eastern wall.

title: [Wolves' Den, Nursery]
description: Perhaps twenty cribs line the walls of this small room.  Unrecognizable lumps of wood and cloth are scattered on the floor.  Above, the ceiling is painted with an image of the night sky.

title: [Wolves' Den, Schoolroom]
description: Three rows of small desks face a single larger one, which tilts on two collapsed legs.  A single pillar in the northeast corner is carved with various letters.  A pair of faded tapestries hangs limply from the northern wall.

title: [Wolves' Den, Corridor]
description: The dust of eons covers the floor of this long, dark corridor.  To the north, it fades into the shadows.  A long, sloping ramp at the southern end leads downward.  At the top of the ramp, the hallway angles off towards the east.

title: [Wolves' Den, Marble Corridor]
description: Black and green lichens stain the once gleaming walls of this corridor, which are made of carved white marble.  A stout iron door is set in the middle of the southern wall.  To the west, the hallway intersects another at a right angle.

title: [Wolves' Den, Marble Corridor]
description: The white marble walls of this corridor are hung with faded tapestries.  The hallway ends to the east in a t-intersection, with iron doors to the north and the south, and a stout mithril door leading east.

title: [Wolves' Den, Chapel]
description: Dozens, perhaps hundreds of skeletons lie jumbled together amidst the stone pews.  Desiccated chunks of flesh and hair hang loosely from the bones.  Small metal cups are strewn among them.  Great stone pillars line the walls, and there's a white marble altar at the east end.  Behind the altar is an open doorway, and a wide passage in the southern wall leads into darkness.

title: [Wolves' Den, Priests' Chamber]
description: The stone walls of this sparsely-appointed chamber have been painted white.  A cot and a small dresser are the only furnishings, save for the holy symbol on the wall.

title: [Wolves' Den, Funeral Chamber]
description: Two large, stone tables flank the iron doors of a massive oven.  Empty coffins, half-collapsed from dry rot, are stacked in one corner.  The southern wall bears an image of Lorminstra in faded inks and oil, her arms spread wide before her.

title: [Wolves' Den, Barracks]
description: Water has seeped through the northern wall of what was once a barracks.  The moldering remains of cots and wooden racks lie in even rows.  An iron door leads west, and the remains of a wooden one hang in the open doorway to the east.

title: [Wolves' Den, Officers' Barracks]
description: The stone blocks of the northern wall are cracked, the silent work of water and the eons.  The cots that lined the walls are little but dust, and fungi grow among their outlines.  An open doorway along the western wall leads back into the main barracks.  Just south of it is a wooden door, rotten but still intact.

title: [Wolves' Den, Barracks]
description: Most of the floor is submerged under a shallow pool of brackish water.  A blanket of light green scum floats atop it.  Nothing remains of whatever furnished this room, save for a few rusted torch sconces along the southern wall.  A wooden doorway to the east remains intact, just out of the water's reach.

title: [Wolves' Den, Infirmary]
description: The stone walls are whitewashed, though the floor is stained dark brown.  The cots, lined up in neat rows, are empty save for one.  Upon it lies a tiny skeleton.  The moth-eaten remnants of a blanket are pulled up over its face.  A table stands next to the cot.

title: [Wolves' Den, Bedchamber]
description: Whatever furnishings this room contained are long departed.  Only the vague outline of a bed remains, the work of some long-departed parasite.

title: [Wolves' Den, Bedchamber]
description: The collapsed remains of a double bed lie next to a small table.  The air is still and cold.

title: [Wolves' Den, Bedchamber]
description: This room contains what was once a sizeable bed, now lying in a heap upon the floor.  A tarnished oil lamp stands upon a table.

title: [Wolves' Den, Bedchamber]
description: There's a large, unmade bed in here and a small wood table.  An empty wine bottle sits on the table, covered with a blanket of dust.

title: [Wolves' Den, Bedchamber]
description: There is little here.  A mildewed bed covered with green fungi and a pile of splinters are all the room contains.

title: [Wolves' Den, Bedchamber]
description: Two skeletons lie entwined on a rotting bed.  A pair of glass vials lies at its foot.

title: [Wolves' Den, Barracks]
description: Long rows of narrow bunks lie tumbled on the floor.  Water drips from a narrow crack along the ceiling, landing with a "plop" in a puddle of brine and rust.  The doorway to the north has rotted away altogether, leaving nothing but wooden scraps hanging from the frame.

title: [Wolves' Den, Officers' Barracks]
description: What may once have been a row of cots is now covered with great lumps of greenish mold.   A tattered, blackened parchment clings to the southern wall next to an open archway.

title: [Wolves' Den, Armory]
description: The weapon racks that lined the walls are rotten, and most have collapsed into piles of splinters and rust.  Several corroded shields hang on the north wall, all bearing the head of a wolf.

title: [Wolves' Den, Forge]
description: The massive iron anvil in the center of the room is pitted with rust.  The fire pit beside it is cold, filled with ashes eons old.  A rack filled with blacksmith's tools leans to the left, partway through a slow collapse.

title: [Wolves' Den, Mess Hall]
description: Long tables nearly span this large, square room, lined with neat rows of wooden chairs.  Upon the tables are stone pitchers, but nothing else.  To the east, an opening in the wall leads to a larger chamber.  The double doors set in the southern wall have fallen off their hinges, leaving the way unbarred.

title: [Wolves' Den, Training Hall]
description: Circles and squares are painted on the floor of this vast chamber.  Weapon and armor racks are scattered throughout, their contents covered with rust.  One wall is hung with targets.  The doorway to the south is unbarred, the remains of the doors lying flat on the floor.  An opening in the western wall leads into a large, dark area.  A stone arch leads north.

title: [Wolves' Den, Kitchen]
description: The walls of the kitchen are lined with rotten cabinets and rusty iron cutlery.  A great stove and fire-pit sit in the center of the room, surrounded by wooden carving tables.  Passages lead off in several directions, and a chill draft blows up from the one leading down to the south.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, down

title: [Wolves' Den, Cold Storage]
description: A long, sloping ramp leads down from the kitchens above.  It's icy cold here, and the walls are covered with frost.  Great hooks hang from poles that span the walls of this cavern.  Nothing hangs from the hooks.  A shriveled, frozen corpse sits on a metal chair near the base of the ramp.

title: [Wolves' Den, Food Stores]
description: This room is filled with boxes and barrels.  All are utterly empty, but for a thin layer of dust.  A small metal chair sits just inside the entrance.

title: [Wolves' Den, Waste Room]
description: The walls here are blackened with soot.  A gaping pit opens up in the center of the room.  A draft rises from it, bearing the smell of ancient corruption.  Small bits of trash are scattered about the mouth of the pit.

title: [Wolves' Den, Guard Room]
description: Four metal chairs sit around a block of stone which must once have served as a table.  The weapons rack that once stood against the northern wall has collapsed, sprawling into the center of the room.  Red lines of rust are all that remain of its contents.  To the south, a steep spiral staircase leads down.  The steel portcullis before it is rusted open.

title: [Wolves' Den, Stairway]
description: The stairs are steep and narrow, winding their way down into shadow.  A steady, chill draft blows up from below.

title: [Wolves' Den, Prison]
description: An iron-banded wooden post, wrapped with corroded chains, stands next to the fire-pit in the center of the room.  Iron cell doors yawn open to the east, south and west, and an iron-grilled trapdoor leads down.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, up

title: [Wolves' Den, Cell]
description: There's nothing in this dank, cramped cell but scraps of trash and gloom.

title: [Wolves' Den, Cell]
description: A narrow stone pallet is set against the wall, covered with dust and cloth scraps.  The crushed remains of what look to be a skull lie before it.

title: [Wolves' Den, Cell]
description: A pair of humanoid skeletons lie piled against the southern wall.  Above them, the bones of arms and hands hang from rusted manacles.

title: [Wolves' Den, Oubliette]
description: A puddle of black, noisome sludge covers the floor of this small cell.  Water seeps through the south wall, which is covered in glistening slime.  Steel manacles rust on the opposite wall.

title: [Wolves' Den, Council Chamber]
description: A great round table of mithril-banded oak dominates this room.  Upon it rot the fragile remains of what must have been maps of the area outside.  Eight high-backed chairs of ebony surround the table.  Their feet are carved to be claws, and the backs are topped with twin wolf heads.  The double doors to the north have fallen off their hinges, leaving the way open.  An iron door is set in the middle of the southern wall.

title: [Wolves' Den, Fenog's Room]
description: There is little in the small, square chamber -- a sleeping pallet and a metal rack are the only furnishings.  The stone walls are unadorned, save for a row of grisly trophies mounted above the pallet.  They are mummified elven heads.

title: [Wolves' Den, Aramur's Room]
description: The walls were once wood-paneled, but dry rot has left patches of stone exposed.  The bed, its frame collapsed, lies in a pile of moldering cloth.  Tarnished metal globes and stars hang from the ceiling on nearly invisible wires.  The small hearth to the south is filled with cold ash, and the bookcases along the northern wall have long since begun their slow collapse.

title: [Wolves' Den, Aramur's Workshop]
description: A long metal table lines the western and northern walls of this small chamber.  The bottles, alembics, tubes and jars upon it are jumbled together and covered with dust.  Strange symbols are etched on the ceiling and floor.  A mural painted on the eastern wall depicts a flight of dragons soaring through a twilight sky.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: A small brook gurgles by the side of the path, making your progress a bit easier as you pick your way along its bank, where the overgrowth is less dense.  Though it looks cool and clear, you resist the urge to pause and refresh yourself, and press onward with grim determination.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: The path snakes between tall, straight-trunked pines, interspersed with a few modwirs struggling for their share of light and nourishment.  You feel as unwelcome in this strange terrain as the few straggly modwirs must feel among the more dominant evergreens.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: The ground rises slightly here, and a subtle breeze causes the needles of the conifers that tower above you to whisper with a soft yet sinister tone.  The path yields underfoot, springy from fallen leaves and twigs which snap and cause you to fear your presence will be detected.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: The scents of pine, of resin, pitch and tar assault you as you trudge through this thickly forested region.  Although it seems for the most part like virgin forest, a few trunks lay scattered on the ground, with roughly hewn or gnawed stumps nearby.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: Dark, straight stands of pine trees close in around you, instilling a sense of claustrophobia and dread.  The dense canopy of the pine forest filters out any natural light, shading all in perpetual gloom.  A rough path leads east, where the trees seem to thin out slightly.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: Murky shapes, indistinct in the primeval forest gloom, filter through the swaying pine boughs of the woods surrounding you.  Suspended between two ancient and venerable pines is a large, intricate spider web.  Tattered to shreds and fluttering in the breeze, it appears to have been spun to trap man-sized prey.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Forest]
description: The path here broadens and splits off into small, overgrown trails leading deeper into the impenetrable forest.  The way east is rutted and worn, bearing some signs of frequent travel.  After a short distance, the path leaves the cover of the forest and veers off towards a stand of tall conifers which frame the entrance to a large clearing.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: Towering, stately pines ring this expansive open area.  To the north of this clearing can be seen the outline of a sprawling structure.  The building appears to be constructed in the shape of a giant black spider.  Its somber dome is visible through the trees.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: A humble hut is wedged here between the underbrush and the sparse trees bordering the clearing.  The wooden hut is thatched with straw and unadorned in any way.  A ragged, greasy hide hangs over the doorway, in front of which you notice a bare patch of earth strewn with chips of flint and obsidian.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: The interior of the hut is stark and poorly furnished.  A large bronze cooking pot stands in a corner, the walls surrounding it blackened by wood smoke.  A few simple chairs and a round table, all made from ringed sections of tree trunks, are the only other items in the one-room hovel.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: As you skirt the outer edge of a very large clearing, you notice a rather drab and nondescript hut to the east.  Farther to the west, you can barely discern the shape of a sinister black dome.  The path continues through the brush.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: The hut reeks of noxious smoke and dead animals.  Along the left wall are hung fresh velnalin hides, stretched out to cure.  An obsidian knife, crudely fashioned and covered with dried blood, sits upon a split tree trunk.  The trunk has been split vertically, and serves as a long, flat work surface.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: A shabby, neglected hut lies to the east, barely catching your eye as it blends into the foliage.  As you gaze north and south, you notice that a row of similar huts lines the eastern side of the path.  All the doors of the huts face west, in the direction of the entrance to the black, domed edifice that dominates this part of the forest.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: A firepit is dug into the floor of this spartan room.  Lumps of charcoal are piled on one side of it, and a flint and striking steel hang from a leather thong attached to a hook on the far wall.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: Your sense of direction fails you somewhat along this path, caught as you are between the oddly similar thatch-roofed huts that frequently dot the clearing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: Bales of straw are stacked on the floor of this hut, along with cut lengths of golsemar rope.  Roughly shaped wooden planks and beams are propped along the walls.  A primitive iron plane and an axe with a nicked blade hang from hooks near the ceiling.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: The crisscrossing paths which connect the space between tiny huts cease to the northwest, as if fear keeps the huts from being built any closer to the Great Spider, whose dome and gates loom near.  Pine-scented forest breezes buffet you with their unnaturally penetrating chill, causing you to shiver.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, northwest

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: You find yourself continuing along the winding path that weaves among the thatched huts.  Near you, to the west, stretches one of the immense basalt legs of the great spider edifice.  The black stone walls cast long shadows and almost seem to absorb any existing light that surrounds them.  To the east stands a hut, its narrow windows dark and lifeless.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: The floor of this hut is almost obscured by strands, nooses and coils of spidersilk rope.  The deceptively delicate cord is strong and unyielding to your touch.  Recently gathered webs and spools of spun spidersilk fill the large willow baskets that line the room, awaiting transformation into beautiful but merciless bonds.  A roughhewn wooden contraption resembling a giant spinning wheel occupies the entire far wall.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: Your pace slackens along the path that wends its way between the thatched huts, as you pause to contemplate the stark building to the west.  The spider-shaped monument leaves you awed and humbled, almost feeling as though you were some sort of offering, transfixed in its web of shadows.  Paths continue on through the clearing, eventually trailing off into the dense, fragrant pine forest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: The path through the cluster of ramshackle habitations brings you nearer to one of the eight black basalt legs of the spider shrine.  The similarity of the huts, and the confusing jumble of curves and bends in the wall of the temple make you pause momentarily to get your bearings.  You continue along the north-south route, barely noticing a hut to the northeast.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: This hut is stuffy and hot, and the air seems to sear your lungs as you inhale.  Through the murk and heat-induced haze, you notice the source of your discomfort is a raised earthen oven serving as a smelting forge in the middle of the room.  The embers glow fierce and red, and a crucible of molten metal is perched on a tripod amid the flames.  Forms and molds of various sinister instruments lie empty on the ground.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: The sameness of the huts that surround you on all sides here, at the center of this broad clearing, is depressing and forbidding.  All their entrances face towards the west, where the gates of the large, black temple loom in the distance.  One hut lies closest to you, just beside the path, and appears to merit further investigation.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: Many footprints and scuff marks, showing signs of a struggle, are all that is left to adorn this small, utilitarian thatched home.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: From this vantage point, the massive dome to the west takes on greater definition, its resemblance to a huge spider now obvious.  The sinuous outlines of the temple walls capture the essence of a predator, tensed and ready to pounce on the quarry trapped within the gossamer web.  A small thatched hut stands near you, small and helpless, like a victim cowering in the shadow of the temple.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: This hut is dark and empty, save for a few beetles and scorpions scurrying along the floor, startled by your approach.  Tiny, dense cobwebs hang from the rafters that support the straw roof.  Strands of spider silk dangling from the low roof attach themselves persistently, almost malevolently, to your clothing.  You are not inclined to stay here for very long.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: Making your way along the path between the huts, you are momentarily distracted by the sharp, flapping sound of a hide curtain over the doorway of the hut to the east.  The tattered, patched skin is stained and streaked with years of exposure to the elements.  The rest of the hut reflects a similar degree of neglect.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: Tiny chips of obsidian left over from the sharpening of daggers and repair of spears litter the floor of this simple hut.  A worn and tattered blanket is all that covers a small cot in the corner.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: The path through the clearing here snakes among the cluster of thatched huts.  Minor trails meander off in several directions.  Ominous, disturbing footprints and mysterious tracks in the dirt make you ill at ease even in this open area.  A seemingly deserted hut stands to the east.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: This hut bears the signs of recent habitation.  A smoky fire smoulders in a small firepit, which holds the remnants of a charred joint of bear meat.  The floor is covered with the bones of various game and small animals, but some of them appear to be suspiciously humanoid.  A few clay pots, filled with viscous, noxious liquids, are arranged around the room.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: You are on a path, winding among the thatch-roof huts.  Paths lead in several directions, with a hut to the east.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: This hut bears little sign of use except for sleeping and an occasional hasty meal.  A few hides are scattered on the floor, and an iron pot is balanced precariously on a flat stone in the middle of a heap of ashes.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: You come upon the northern edge of the clearing.  Dense underbrush and closely-spaced pine form an unpenetrable barrier to the north.  The shadowy presence of the black obsidian dome dominates your view, even here.  The area also is the northernmost outpost of the cluster of huts, with one lying to the side of the path's end.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: The interior of this hut is sparsely furnished, aside from the usual tools and items required for day-to-day survival.  A dented bronze cauldron sits in an ash-filled depression in the middle of the floor, with a rough hole in the thatched roof directly above it.  The walls are decorated with charcoal renderings of a primitive yet awe-inspiring nature.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: A foul stench floats heavily on the air here, almost causing you to retch.  You are led to assume the source is a ramshackle hut which lies to the east, its poor condition a stark contrast both to the other huts nearby and to the impressive and finely sculpted temple which hovers near.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: Two faint paths diverge to the south and east.  A wider track leads northwest, and seems to be oft-travelled.  In that direction, beyond the huts and the stands of pine trees, you spot the dark outline of a rambling, squat stone building.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: The path turns here, like a sharp "v", veering to the southeast and into a maze of pathways, or attempting to go around the great structure to the southwest, where one of the large black legs of the sprawling spidery building curls ominously.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Hut]
description: This single-room hovel is filthy, and the nauseating smell makes it difficult for you to linger here.  Dirty straw is scattered over the packed earthen floor, and the thatched roof is rent by several large holes that allow the elements in to do their worst.  A few soiled hides that might have served as clothing are heaped in one corner.  The only items of any value here are contained in a locked wooden rack on the wall.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: This narrow dirt path hugs the northern wall of the black basalt spider shrine.  Two of the eight stone annexes, the legs of the spider goddess in whose likeness the shrine was erected, curve around you to the east and west in a sinister embrace.  A few tall pines, with dark green moss clinging to their trunks, cast deeper shadows over the brooding scene.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: The black stones are highly polished, and reflect a grotesque, distorted image back at you as you gaze up at the arched, convex rear wall of the temple.  At sharp angles, two wings of the building meet the main structure.  Your route weaves along the bends in the exterior, forcing you to make your way carefully and warily.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: From the northwest corner of the grounds of the spider shrine, you overlook the dense pine forest surrounding the entire area.  Far to the east, you see a clearing in the trees, and the cluster of thatched shacks that serve as the dwellings of the fanatic servants of Arachne, the demanding and relentless spider goddess.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: Rounding the northwest corner of the structure, where the trail almost brushes the encroaching forest, something moves behind a thick cluster of pines.  You shudder suddenly, feeling the hair on the back of your neck rise, all without really knowing why, though your imagination effortlessly yields up several gruesome guesses.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: Two large basalt spider legs stretch far to either side of you, as if preparing to take hold of you if you swerve from the path that takes you from the rear around the building's perimeter.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: The rear of the structure is revealed to be no less imposing than the entrance; perhaps even more so given the absence of windows or light from within.  Paths of trodden grass lead around the immense queen spider.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: Cold shadows cast from this imposing stone arachnid momentarily shelter you from any watchful eyes.  Paths here, either along the flank of the building or threading around the squalid huts offer you no solace, only fear.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: Moving through deeper gloom, only luck keeps you on your path here, among the black leg-like wings of the structure.  Shadows cast by trees in the nearby forest sway in the wind, seeming to lend the shrine a fearsome life all its own.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: You are walking a narrow, well worn path on the southern side of this forbidding shrine.  Two large basalt legs, polished to a dull gleam, menacingly flank you to the east and west.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Near Shrine]
description: The path narrows, forking off to the cluster of huts to the northeast, and winding around the perimeter of the black stone temple to the northwest.  The legs of the shrine, bent at an angle as though the huge stone spider were crouching, ready to pounce on its prey, hold a strange fascination for you.

title: [Lower Trollfang, Clearing]
description: Nearing the front gate of the great spider shrine, you find yourself standing between its two polished basalt mandibles.  The stone spider jaws reach out from the main structure of the temple, seemingly poised to close on you and pinch you in half in one deft movement.  Paths continue eastward, winding their way through the myriad simple hut-like dwellings.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Spider Temple, Entrance]
description: You come upon the entrance to the Great Temple of Arachne, the Spider Goddess, whose fearsome likeness provides the plan for the layout of the temple.  Set above the ironbound oaken doors leading into the forbidding black basalt structure are eight moonstones arrayed in dual rows of four.  Representing eyes, they seem to glare down at you with evil intent and a peculiar, insatiable greed.

title: [Spider Temple, Entry Hall]
description: The only light in the entrance hall comes from two marvelously crafted candelabra, which from certain angles reflects back at you from the polished black basalt walls.  The shuffle of your feet against the teak floor produces scuffling sounds.  Large oaken doors lead in and out of this temple of Arachne, the spider goddess.

title: [Spider Temple, Central Chamber]
description: The flickering, shifting light of candles fills this imposing central chamber with moving shadows.  Overhead a web-patterned tracery of red glaes supports the high domed ceiling, which rises tens of feet over the altar that lies at the center of the chamber.  Candle sconces flank each of the doors that lead to the "legs" of this shrine to the spider goddess.  Your eyes are drawn to the grotesque arrangement of inlaid floor tiles which depict scenes of death by poison.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Aldemur]
description: The walls of this room are covered with fine tapestries.  Among them, the small bed, wooden chair and simple table that furnish the room, look out of place.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Aldemur]
description: This appears to be a little-used storeroom with a jumble of cots, awkward and uncomfortable-looking chairs, and dilapidated tables lining the walls.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Volnar]
description: This long corridor of a room is spartanly furnished with a single desk and chair.  The walls are covered with murals which depict Arachne in all of her power.  A small curtained area lies roughly southeast.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Volnar]
description: This small area contains little more than a bed, covered in fine velvet, with an ice goose down pillow at its head.

title: [Spider Temple, Central Chamber]
description: Scenes of death by slow torture play out in the floor tiles of this portion of the central chamber.  To the northeast, the doors into the shrine allow a little more light into the building.  The altar to the north and the tracery overhead intercept that light, sending long shadows into the area to the northwest.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Drevthrel]
description: Velvet hangings drape lavishly along the long walls, interrupted occasionally by fine crystal sculpture.  Near a curtained off area to the east are a gilt full length mirror, two soft chairs, and a low table of polished modwir.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Drevthrel]
description: Plain wool blankets cover the simple bed here, clearly a sign this room is used only for sleep.

title: [Spider Temple, Kitchen]
description: A large open fireplace dominates this busy main chamber of one of the legs.  A large stone oven, wooden worktables and a dining table with several chairs around it manage to fill much of the other space.  A small alcove lies east.

title: [Spider Temple, Pantry]
description: This alcove holds deep, long shelves on its walls.  It seems to have served as some sort of pantry or larder, but now the few burlap sacks, casks and hogheads of provisions here look rotten and gnawed at.  Everything in the room is covered in a sticky coating of dust and cobwebs.

title: [Spider Temple, Central Chamber]
description: A shiver runs down your spine as you notice white marble carvings of webbed and cocooned creatures suspended among the web-patterned tracery overhead.  The floor tiles here depict scenes of death by arachnids.  To the east, the altar lies between you and the door out of the shrine.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Folthren]
description: A large trunk and an ornate wooden chair are almost all that decorate the long main chamber of this leg.  A large marble statue of Arachne the Spider Goddess sits prominently in a corner, its moonstone eyes glittering.  A small curtained alcove is west.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Folthren]
description: A rather large bed lies in one corner of this curtained area, with a rich brocade coverlet.  Three simple cloak hooks adorn the wall.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Acolytes]
description: The austere antechamber in this leg contains only one wooden chair.  A long, narrow hallway stretches to the west.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Acolytes]
description: You are in a very narrow hallway. An ebony cell door lies to the south.

title: [Spider Temple, Cell]
description: The murky darkness of the room cloaks its spartan contents in obscurity.  Feeling your way around the chamber, you find it devoid of furnishings save for a low, uncomfortable-looking cot and a few hooks nailed to the wall from which hang tattered and patched black robes.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Acolytes]
description: You traverse a narrow hallway, your footfalls echoing off the cold stone.  A cell door is recessed into one of the stone walls here.

title: [Spider Temple, Cell]
description: Black whispery velvet drapes each of the walls of this tiny cell.  A wall hook extends angrily at the back, while a small cot with a single covering huddles in the corner.  All personal identity once belonging to the acolyte who dwells here is lost amidst this sea of pious black.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Acolytes]
description: You are moving slowly and cautiously down a narrow hall that runs from east to west.

title: [Spider Temple, Cell]
description: Through a gap in the black curtains lining the walls, you catch a glimpse of the polished basalt that encloses the Spider Temple and spy a corner of a small window slit.  Though the plain, shabby furniture in the room is covered with a fine filigree of dust and spider webs, you have the eerie feeling that this part of the temple is far from abandoned.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Acolytes]
description: You are at the end of a narrow hallway.

title: [Spider Temple, Cell]
description: A quiet hush attends the small living area; somehow appropriate against the stark black velvet drapery that covers the walls of this cell with the oppressive weight of fanaticism, or devotion.  Only a single covering giving all the warmth of breezy silk wards a small cot in the corner.  A hook juts expectantly from the wall, as if waiting to grasp the throat of a victim in the spider's way of tender torture.

title: [Spider Temple, Central Chamber]
description: Scenes of death by pestilence are played out in the floor tiles of this portion of the central chamber.  To the southeast, the doors into the shrine allow a little more light into the building.  The altar to the south and the tracery overhead intercept that light, sending long shadows into the area to the southwest.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Carelin]
description: A large map hangs on the wall beside a wooden desk.  The desk is covered with papers that seem to describe and diagram various troop movements.  A leather bound trunk sits in one corner, near a curtained alcove to the east.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Carelin]
description: A simple bed and nightstand are the only furniture in this room.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Victim]
description: A long hallway with thick stone walls presses northwest from here.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Victim]
description: A long hallway, its thick stone walls beaded with moisture from the humidity, presses close as it stretches its way west and southeast.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Victim]
description: A long, poorly lit hallway extends east and west of you.  Its walls press close to either side of you, confining your movement, perhaps to keep you from straying too far.

title: [Spider Temple, Leg of Victim]
description: The close confines of the hallway snakes its stony way northwest and to the east from here, its ends bending sinuously out of sight.

title: [Spider Temple, Spider Home]
description: A myriad of metal cages in all shapes and sizes fill the room.  The larger cages are unlatched and empty, with the smaller occupied by all manner of scurrying beasts.

title: [Spider Temple, Cell]
description: A small cot is jammed into one corner of the hard basalt walls of the cell.  Its awkward position would seem to make cramped sleeping quarters.  Holding out the promise of passing an even more restless night are the sets of iron manacles sunk into the wall opposite the cot.  The exit afforded by the iron-bound oak door seems to offer the best alternative.

title: [Spider Temple, Cell]
description: Cool air seems to radiate from the large basalt slab that serves as bed but looks, for all the world, like a bier, giving the room a funereal cast.  Manacles, anxious to slowly gnaw upon the spirit of another captive, hang expectant against the basalt walls which seem to suck the light from the very air.

title: [Spider Temple, Cell]
description: A small cot, shoved hastily in the corner, provides the captive's only refuge:  slumber.  Several pairs of well-tended manacles are chained from the basalt walls, which are hard and unforgiving, enduring in their silent torture longer than the mercurial will of the gods.
