title: [Spider Temple, Cell]
description: Cold iron manacles gleam dully, the color of rain, against the far wall of this small cell -- their tantalizing reach preciously few inches too short for a bid to freedom.  The oppressive nature of the dark stone walls causes hope to dwindle in the captives who must survive here, whittling away until it is a small spark, an ember whose fate is decided for good or ill by the wind.

title: [Spider Temple, Near Altar]
description: You are standing before the spiritual center of the shrine--a massive black marble altar that rises several feet from the floor.  Its sides are adorned with images of various spiders.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Stronghold, Walk of the Shaman]
description: The Walk of the Shaman is a high-ceilinged corkscrew of a corridor, climbing so steeply that passage along it would be dangerous if not for the piles of rubble to use as footholds.  On either side, the walls are densely carved with a veneer of sigils, which appear to shift and pulsate in the gloomy light.  The air is thick with dust, adding to the surreal atmosphere of the skewed concourse.

title: [Stronghold, Descent]
description: The corridor narrows, constricting past the huge arch that dominates the chamber.  Stone slabs making up the walls here are chipped and scarred, as if massive claws had rent the rock.  The grooves are uneven, casting tattered shadows down the sides of the passageway.

title: [Stronghold, Descent]
description: The corridor doglegs to the southwest, growing more open and less shadowy in that direction.  A marked descent devours the northern section, wrapping the corridor in deep gloom and stale air.  Walls, ceiling and floor bear a repeating pattern of ridges, as if the hallway has become the gullet of some immense creature, waiting silently for the right moment to swallow any unsuspecting trespassers.

title: [Stronghold, Descent]
description: The air hangs heavily in the gloom, thick with dust and antiquity.  A steep downward angle canting to the north makes walking a hazardous procedure.  Only the pronounced ridges circling the chamber give any purchase against a headlong plunge into darkness.

title: [Stronghold, Descent]
description: The passageway ends in an alcove, its bottom a well of dust.  The sediment creates a miniature landscape of dunes rippling across the chamber with no solid floor visible.  Shadows crouch in the corners and cower in the lee of the drifts, and the walls tower silently into the gloom's embrace, their faces covered with runes.

title: [Stronghold, Walk of the Shaman]
description: The floor of the steep hallway is an obstacle course of floor slabs canted up and piles of boulders braced against them.  Overhead, the ceiling is a convoluted barrel vault, its proportions looking off-kilter from the exaggerated twist of the passageway.  The rock walls exhibit an expanse of runic bas-relief, its intricacy and sheer scope an amazing accomplishment.  Stale air hangs in the corridor, thick with dust and the smell of antiquity.

title: [Stronghold, Walk of the Shaman]
description: The passageway twists like an immense stone serpent, and as it curls back over itself, the cant grows steeper and less fraught with debris.  On the walls, the glyphs grow smaller and more intricate, the higher one climbs.  Fragments of whispers tug at the consciousness intermittently, as if the mountain itself is trying to communicate the dangers it embraces.

title: [Stronghold, Walk of the Shaman]
description: The convolution of the hallway results in each segment of its passage possessing the intimacy of a small chamber.  Sight to higher and lower sections is limited, blocked by the densely carved walls and the gloom.  The clouds of dust have compressed into a low-lying fog, which drifts up the corridor with a steady resolution.

title: [Stronghold, Walk of the Shaman]
description: Immense outcroppings of stone protrude from the walls in this bend of the corridor, their exteriors as thickly carved with blocky sigils as the smoother sections.  They offer surfaces from which cling a plethora of shadows.  The air has grown cold and clammy, and dust leaps from the gloom each time the coiled passageway shivers in the clutches of successive tremors.

title: [Stronghold, Walk of the Shaman]
description: The air plunges to a cold that produces clouds of condensed breath, which mingle with the dust hanging in the passageway.  On the walls are strange, carved pictographs, their language lost but their evocative quality intact.  The symbols create a panorama of small images, most dealing with a company of stylized figures interacting with a startling sense of life.

title: [Stronghold, Walk of the Shaman]
description: The passageway seems to exhale, growing larger and more extensively decorated as it twists up.  A larger chamber is just visible above this one, its perimeters hidden by the curve of the corridor and the gloom.  Light flickers in short bursts in that direction, amplified by the clouds of dust swirling in the shadows.

title: [Stronghold, Walk of the Shaman]
description: The coiled passageway culminates in a vast chamber, its farthest corners hidden in darkness and clouds of dust.  Flickers of static electricity light the clouds from within, sending arcane reflections arcing across the towering walls.  Overhead, a monstrous ring of stone hangs in the center of the chamber, its source of support invisible.  It hovers over a matching ring carved into the rock floor.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Quatrefoil]
description: Deepening shadows in the rubbled entryway to this four-lobed structure fade into darkness at the far end of a southeast passage leading into the Stronghold bowels.  Glyphic markings repeat in a puzzling pattern along the crumbling walls, their ancient meaning lost.  Scraping noises from beyond a crude arched opening echo loudly in the emptiness of this underground labyrinth.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: A passageway of moss-covered hardened mud leads off to the west.  Greenish slime dripping down the walls glows faintly, and provides scant light for the area.  The sound of something moving along the ground can be heard in the distance.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: Large gaping holes scattered about the muddied floor make the path zigzag within this tunnel.  Brackish water dripping from above slowly empties into these pits, creating tiny ponds that reflect the eerie glow of the fungus about the passage.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: A small rut running along the floor is filled with murky water, small ripples in the tiny pond fanning outward with every passing footfall.  Odd reflections dance upon the surface of the water, the shapes distorted and abstract.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: Rivulets of brown murky water trickle down the slighty sloping floor, cutting tiny ruts into the soft muddy ground.  The ceiling is covered with sickly grey mushrooms, all of them distorted and misshapen.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: The rough-hewn dirt walls are irregular and uneven, clearly not man-made.  The clay-like floor is a quagmire of mud and slop, which makes travel slow and messy.  The tunnel is filled with ominous echoes, the sounds muffled and indeterminate in the darkness.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: Loose dirt is piled along the edges of the floor, but the middle of the path is smooth and flat as if something heavy travels this direction quite often.  A giant pockmark mars the earthen wall of this tunnel, but the faint light of the area refuses to reveal its contents.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: The walls of the tunnel begin to close in tighter, the area becoming claustrophobic and narrow here at the dead end.  The passageway to the northwest is pitch black and allows for minimal visibility at best.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: An old broken axe handle and a cracked wooden shield lie off to the side of the passageway, useless and discarded.  Odd loud thumping sounds can be heard from somewhere nearby and are causing loose dirt to rain down from the ceiling.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: Silt and dirt trickle down from the earthen ceiling above, accompanied by a very low rumbling from off in the distance.  Its hard to ascertain what is causing the disturbance, but the noise continues to be steady and rhythmic.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: The sound of muffled shuffling fills the area, the noise random and varying in intensity.  The passageway is partially blocked by a large boulder completely covered with a thick brown fungus.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: The light that penetrates this area of the tunnel is faint, making it very difficult to see much of the passageway in either direction.  The walls are peppered with holes, bits of dirt and rocks littering the base as if something had exploded out of them.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: A charred and spent torch is pressed deep into the mud-covered floor, perhaps ground in by the weight of something passing over it.  Large ruts lead off in all possible directions, their big imprints an undefinable match for any imaginable beasts.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: A dark tunnel leads off to the northeast, its contents hidden in shadow.  Faint echoes reverberate off the earthen walls here, the noises sounding as if something heavy is being dragged along the ground.  It is impossible to determine which direction the sounds are coming from.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: Tendrils of uneven moss fan out along the walls, their greenish illumination creating oddly shaped shadows within this passage.  The air trapped in this tunnel is old and stale but still breathable.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, East Lobe]
description: A slight sulphuric scent taints the already stale air, and moistures beads on the surface of the passage walls.  Little light exists to the northwest, plunging this narrow way into darkness, except for the thin veins of fluorescence caused by channels of calcite.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, East Lobe]
description: Cracked stone flooring thrusts up sharply at odd angles, as though a massive upheaval wracked this structure.  Moss and lichen thrive along the edges of the jutting pieces, drinking from the damp surroundings.  Smooth, ridged tracks cut into the clay exposed underneath the broken stone, the result of collected moisture running off in rivulets.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, East Lobe]
description: Spattered walls streaked with clumps of clay seem to indicate a massive struggle, reflected by the pitted and scored clay floor strewn with piles of broken stone.  The atmosphere is rank and damp.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, East Lobe]
description: At the eastern juncture of the quatrefoil, faded yellow symbols of rising suns grace the walls.  Broken jars lie on the floor, spilling ground copal and frankincense powders.  Several ora braziers lie scattered about, dusty and damaged.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, East Lobe]
description: Crimson shadowing towards the southwest makes the walls at the far end of the passage appear to be bathed in blood, while several streaks of yellow can be seen peeking from the opening to the northeast.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, East Lobe]
description: Huge chunks of broken stone along with the clay-spattered walls give clear indication that a massive struggle occured within this passageway.  The atmosphere is rank and damp, the stench so vile it's almost unbreathable.  Fragments of bone and partial skulls lie strewn along this path.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, South Lobe]
description: A faint hum and increasing light appear to the north, making the strange glyphs carved into the walls more readable.  A charge fills the air, adding to the eeriness coming from the center of this hub.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, South Lobe]
description: A far-off throbbing rumble seems to draw closer, then ebb away.  Cracked flooring bears a ridged pattern unnatural in composition and often broken with deep holes, as though something was burrowing here.  To the southwest, an eerie blood red lighting beckons.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, South Lobe]
description: A narrow slit window fitted with ruby crystals floods a blood-like bath over the room.  Soot climbs the walls, evidence of a great fire.  The black stains obscure the glyphs carved deeply in the stone.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, South Lobe]
description: A crimson tinge glows to the southeast and shadows dancing from the flickering, opposing torches resemble a violent struggle.  Whistling wind streaks down the narrow corridor, rustling large cobwebs draping from the ceiling like lacy curtains.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, South Lobe]
description: Stone flooring is cracked and tilted at odd angles, making the path more of a climbing traverse than an easy walk, and threatening to twist ankles along the way.  Remnants of broken arrows and twisted bolts litter the ground, and slickened lichen clings to the crevices of exposed clay.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, West Lobe]
description: Two passages meet here in a short angled corner, creating a blind spot.  The lack of ambient light allows for no betraying shadows to even hint of what might lie beyond.  The smooth and rounded edge where the two walls come to a point has been worn down by the touch of many hands over time, perhaps from a need for caution.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, West Lobe]
description: The dark corridor widens slightly, allowing several ridged tracks to criss-cross wildly along the damp clay floor.  Bone fragments lodged here and there are the only clue that this place is not as peaceful as it seems.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, West Lobe]
description: The western wall of the quatrefoil is streaked with undulating waves of flaking blue woad, like rolling seawaves.  The pattern is bordered with hundreds of arcane glyphs, which mimic the painted waves.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, West Lobe]
description: The stillness of the passage is broken by an occasional rumbling and a low buzz, the origin of which cannot be determined.  A fine dust covers the walls, almost obscuring the glyphs carved into them.  Rivulets of water gather in the ridged clay tracks along the floor, pooling in tiny puddles whose surfaces shimmer slightly when far-off tremors occur.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, West Lobe]
description: This dimly lit T-intersection echoes with a soft thrumming heightened by a vibrating thwump-thwump as something imaginably massive heads in this direction.  The soft sound of trickling water seems to come from within the walls and moves in a southeasterly direction.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, North Lobe]
description: Churned clay floors pitted with holes and tiny puddles make for a hazardous obstacle course while traversing the north to south corridor.  Cracked stone walls seep with moisture, feeding the lichen crawling along the walls.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, North Lobe]
description: Dark shadows and cobwebs deepen the length of this corridor, with an odd displacement of cool air in spots, as though updrafts seep through the solid rock walls and flooring.  Dark glyphs blend in the dim lighting, making them difficult to discern.  A northeast branch leads gradually uphill towards a slightly brighter area.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, North Lobe]
description: At the northernmost point of the quatrefoil, a series of carved glyphs dabbed with greenish-black soot stand out against the pale stone surface of the walls.  Emptied sacks of grain lie scattered on the floor, as though ransacked by something unspeakably powerful.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: This north-south route slants, becoming more cavernlike as it moves below ground level toward the center of the quatrefoil.  Heated, humid air rises up, carrying the thick rotten egg-like stench of sulphur with it.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: Nearly searing heat scorches the sulphuric air, and flecks of ash drift up like grey snowflakes from cracks in the slick, cracked stone floor.  Only a wispy tendril of cooler air beckons from the lighted opening to the south, accompanying a low, constant hum.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Central Hub]
description: Perfectly round and suffused with an eery unnatural light, the room serves as a hub to a wheel of corridors surrounding it.  Glyphs, carved and smudged with soot, almost stand out and writhe in the odd lighting.  A slightly raised stone platform with blackened arrows pointing off in all directions sits in the focal point, emitting a strange hum.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, West Lobe]
description: Luminescent veins of calcite glow eerily in the subdued light of flickering torches, striping the walls with their fiery essence.  Rubble along the passage creates obstacles for the less than surefooted traversing the area.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, West Lobe]
description: Slippery tracks of ridged clay wind around outcroppings of rock sunk deep into the muck.  The large broken fragments, some carved with strange glyphs, are edged with pale green lichen thriving in this damp passage.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, East Lobe]
description: Rubble is strewn here and there, gathered in tiny piles.  The mixture of crumbled wall, ceiling chunks, dirt, and clay causes the mounds to send off tiny avalanches with the occasional tremors that shake this room, scattering the debris along the floor.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, East Lobe]
description: Cooler air fills this narrow east-to-west corridor leading into the center of the Thanatoph bowels.  Cobwebs coated with ages of dust line the passageway, often criss-crossing in stringy valances overhead.  A trickle of dampness seeps along the clay floor tracked with long ridges.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: A soft hum vibrates in the air, growing in volume and tremor to the east.  Its accompanying charge crackles from time to time as dust motes swirl about in slow motion.  A short north-to-south passageway runs parallel to the hub of the quatrefoil.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Tunnel]
description: The walls and ceiling close in, creating a cavern-like feeling along this east-west passageway.  A clearly illuminated opening is nearby, while the opposite length of the tunnel extends into darkness.  An occasional flare of fiery lava glows from beneath the cracked stone floor, followed by the sharp tang of brimstone.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Several odd, misshapen chunks of material are piled about the area, roughly round in shape and somewhat flaky.  It's difficult to ascertain just what they are, but a few seem to have bone fragments embedded within them.  Rumbling continues to echo along the walls from time to time.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Smooth boulders with oddly rounded edges protrude from the hardened earth floor, each looking like the egg of some huge beast.  The surface of the stones have a sheen to them as if they had been polished for some reason, and certainly this type of erosion is not normal.  A semi-circular ring of stalagmites and stalactites just barely meet, resembling a giant maw swallowing one end of the passageway.  The calcite pillars are thin, though, leaving just enough room for egress.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Dripping stalagmites make tinny *plinks* as droplets fall into a stagnant pool off to one side.  Occasional low rumbles can be heard, the vibration in the ground creating tiny ripples on the waters surface.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: The path is flat and level here, the only obstructions being a few fallen stalactites.  A look up reveals that the ceiling is covered with these spearlike stones, hopefully firmly attached.  The constant vibrations rumbling through the area are not reassuring in the least.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: A thin beam of light has managed to penetrate the darkness here, but it fails to make any dent in the deep gloom smothering the area.  A huge pile of stones and dirt has collapsed within the passageway, preventing any further progress through a northerly opening.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: The cavern ends in a small cave, the walls pressing in on all sides.  A mold-covered skull in one corner peers blankly outward with a toothy smile upon its face.  Numerous other bones lie scattered about.  Clearly, this is not a good spot to rest.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: A path leads upward but abruptly ends at a massive barrier of rocks and dirt.  The passage may have led to an exit, but it would take an army of workers to clear the rubble piled here.  Thudding can be heard from the other side of the heap, but there is no way to tell what might be causing it.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: A huge cracked boulder has fallen into the path and now leans heavily against the cavern wall.  Passage is possible on one side of the massive stone, but it's a long drop into steamy, sulphur-scented water below, through the hole where the cavern wall gave way under collision with the boulder.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Constant vibrations are causing silt and dirt to shake free from the ceiling.  Light catches the particles on their way down and gives the area a rainlike effect.  The falling dust in this area only worsens the poor visibility provided by the dim light of this cavern.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: The thin path continues along the underground stream, the path treacherous and twisted as it skirts a forest of stalactites.  Below, in the thin cut, faint illumination creates odd reflections that dance upon the surface of the water.  Muffled quakes shatter the silence at random intervals and send up clouds of dust, but there is no trace of their source.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Erosion and time have formed a tall earthen cliff, the lake below still visible from this vantage.  Several crushed pieces of stone lie scattered about the ground, most no bigger than a pebble.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: The walls of the cavern glitter in the dim light from the many veins of metallic ores embedded within clear channels of calcite.  Several ruts have been ground into the dirt, forming patterns that are almost artistic in their nature.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Fallen boulders cant at precarious angles within a span of stalactites and stalagmites, creating a crumbling stone bridge rising up over a channel of water, and making it a dangerous proposition to cross.  A violent churning within the depths of the stream brings a boiling fury of bubbles to the top, then it subsides.  A moment later, it begins anew in a different spot.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Unlike many of the earthen tunnels near this cavern that appear to be natural in origin, there is clear evidence that this well hidden area is man-made.  A pile of perfectly square stones has been neatly stacked along one wall, each of them placed with complete precision.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Upper Trollfang, Shaded Path]
description: Thick underbrush and fallen oak leaves waist-high to a halfling obscure any remnants of a trail here.  Acorns crunch underfoot with every step, the sound echoing off of the trees in an otherwise quiet forest.  The magnificent oak trees of the forest are unmoving in the calm air, steadfast as they have stood through their many years.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This is the southern bank of a fast moving stream that runs roughly west to east.  Spanning the steep walled gully that holds the swiftly moving water is a large elm tree which serves as a makeshift bridge.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The path splits three ways here.  The most traveled branch heads off to the north, towards the sound of running water.  The second branch heads off to the south and disappears over a heavily forest hill.  The third, and least visible, path runs off to the east towards a low boggy region.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The surrounding landscape begins a gradual ascent to the south as you are nearing the base of the Dragonsclaw Mountains.  This region is heavily forested and the trees are large and ancient.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Path]
description: At a fork in the trail stands a dead tree.  A little clearing opens to the north.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: You stand at the base of a harsh, craggy mountain.  The few trees in sight are greyish-green, their leaves sparse.  The ground here is rocky and uneven, the footing dangerous to the unwary.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: A thick fog clings to Sentoph on this side.  Chilly grey tendrils of fog wind through the rocks and in between the branches of the half-dead trees.  They remind you of ghostly grey tentacles, and send a shiver down your back.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: The path winds through a tumble of boulders, jagged rocks ranging between the size of your fist and the size of the Moot Hall in Wehnimer's.  Your range of vision is limited to the next rock, and the trail beneath your feet -- the boulders cut off any sight of the mountain or the slopes, or, in places, even the sky.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: A few scraggly shrubs cling to the rocky hillside, their roots digging deep into whatever cracks they can find, searching out earth and moisture.  Greyish dust has settled on everything, and seems to be finding its way into your eyes and ears, and under your clothes.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: The wind has scoured the rock clean on this side of the mountain.  Not a bush nor a tree nor a blade of grass mars the harsh nakedness of the stone.  The wind whips up small pockets of dust, depositing them in your eyes and ears and clothing.  Through the swirling dust, you glimpse a narrow trail cutting its way up the mountainside.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: The path widens here, and passes through a little hollow in the side of the mountain.  Rough-hewn blockish rocks form a crude rectangle on the ground.  It looks like the ruins of a small hut or shed, with only the foundation left.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: You stumble and trip over the loose rocks and pebbles that litter the narrow path.  Greyish bushes cling to the rock, dusty, half-dead things that look like they haven't had water in months.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: Dust devils whirl about in the shrieking wind, whipping across the stones and through your clothing.  A treacherous path winds its way around the mountain and a steep trail heads up the mountainside, neither way looking particularly easy.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: A chilly breeze whips around the mountainside, frigid gusts finding every chink in your armor and clothing.  You start to daydream about hot fires and hot blankets and hot food and hot baths.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: The bleak, grey landscape stretches out, above and below the path.  A dirty white fungus crawls up the cliff, its surface veined with brownish fibers and broken by occasional yellowish pustules.  It looks like it should be poisonous, whether it is or not.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: Jagged, barren rock soars toward the sky, casting macabre shadows in the enshrouding fog.  A handful of scraggly bushes cling to the stone, their roots forcing cracks into the rock as they seek whatever scanty nourishment may be had, up here on the barren heights.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: A few greyish-brown shrubs cling to the cracks and crevices that pit the slope.  They must suck moisture from the fog that blankets this side of the mountain, since no spring or stream is in evidence.  A narrow ridge of stone winds its way up toward the mountaintop, losing itself in the grey mist within a few dozen yards.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: The path widens a bit here, and curves around an outcropping, overlooking a steep slope.  Part of the path has crumbled away.  It looks like there must have been a rockslide here some time in the past.  Looking over the side, you see a jumble of rocks and boulders piled up far below.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: The path narrows to a mere handspan, forcing you to turn sideways and edge your way across, one careful step at a time.  No trees nor even bushes grow here to give you a handhold.  An occasional gust of wind howls past, threatening to pluck you from your unsteady perch, setting your heart thumping with terror.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: Up here on the peak of Sentoph, the crags soar like teeth into the sky.  A narrow, rocky ridge winds its way down the mountainside where it soon gets lost in the fog that covers the lower slopes.  Footing is uneven here, and you see no plant life anywhere.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: A great rounded chunk of the mountain is missing, as though some giant took a bite out of it.  You pick your way around the arc, careful not to lose your footing lest you follow the path of the broken rocks to the shattered bottom.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: A steady howl fills your ears as the wind sings a lonely, desolate song through the crags of the mountaintop.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: Wind whips through your hair, raising chilblains on your face, and anywhere else that's exposed to the air.  Frost is forming in the shadows of the rocks, leaving the footing icy and treacherous.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: A huge monolith soars to the sky, its peak pointed like a tooth.  As tall as it is, it's dwarfed by the summit of Sentoph, yet a few hundred yards over your head.  It's large enough, however, to force you to climb a ways upslope to get around it.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: The trail has vanished and you're forced to work your way around rocks and crags, picking a path across the uneven landscape.  Boulders and peaks obscure your view, bringing the horizon near enough to touch.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: From this high point you can see all around Sentoph.  Signs of a rockslide mar the northwestern slope, while fog blankets the eastern side.  Jagged peaks strain for the sky, as though seeking to blend their flat stony grey with the deep stormy grey of the clouds.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest

title: [A Faint Path]
description: In the distance, you can make out a black, ominous tower.  It looms over the hills like a dark sentinel, the walls shimmering faintly despite the absence of light created by the stormclouds above.  A faint path winds towards the tower, almost completely hidden by brambles.

In the distance, you can make out a black, ominous tower.  It looms over the hills like a dark sentinel, the walls shimmering faintly despite the absence of light.  A faint path winds towards the tower, almost completely hidden by brambles.

title: [A Faint Path]
description: Thorns and brambles line the path, tearing at the clothing of all who pass.  To the southwest the trail opens into the rugged, rocky terrain of the Sentoph mountains, while to the northeast it widens into the barren landscape around the tower.  Loose stones tumble onto the path, dislodged from the jagged boulders that rise to either side.

title: [A Faint Path]
description: Only a few scattered rosebushes remain in the magic-scarred waste, bearing roses as black as the tower that rises in their midst.  The graceful obsidian walls of the dark edifice are smooth and seamless, and no entrance is visible.  The air here in the tower's shadow crackles with a dark energy that seems to crawl along your skin.

Only a few scattered bushes remain in the magic-scarred waste, bearing roses as black as the tower that rises in their midst.  The graceful obsidian walls of the dark edifice are smooth and seamless, and no entrance is visible.  The air here in the tower's shadow crackles with a dark energy that seems to crawl along your skin.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: You skitter across the side of the mountain, expecting to tumble down the slope any moment.  After a few scary slips you come upon a small trail twisting its way across the rocky incline and into a narrow valley.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: The trail is little more than a game path winding through the rugged mountains, although no animal tracks are visible in the hard-packed dirt.  The silence is oppressive, weighing down upon you and making you strain your ears in hopes of catching any sound, even one you might not want to hear.  A small trail meets this one from the mountain to the west, cutting a precarious way across the slope.

The trail is little more than a game path winding through the rugged mountains, although no animal tracks are visible in the faint moonlight.  The silence is oppressive, weighing down upon you and making you strain your ears in hopes of catching any sound, even one you might not want to hear.  A small trail meets this one from the mountain to the west, cutting a precarious way across the slope.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: Dark grey clouds hang low across the tops of the peaks around you.  The occasional rumble of thunder startles you, loud in the silence that hangs over the area.  The mountainsides are a brownish green, as if the plants that grow there are fighting for survival...and losing the battle.  The trail winds through a pass in the mountains to the northwest, and retreats to the east, towards Sentoph.

Clouds obscure the stars and cloak the tops of the peaks around you.  The occasional rumble of thunder startles you, loud in the silence that hangs over the area.  The foliage that covers the mountainside is sere, as if the plants that grow there are fighting for survival...and losing the battle.  The trail winds through a pass in the mountains to the northwest, and retreats to the east, towards Sentoph.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: Mountains tower to either side.  At irregular intervals rocks slide down the slopes, but how they were dislodged you cannot be certain.  The trail is obstructed by several small boulders, obviously from the mountainsides, and you fervently hope that another does not choose this moment to fall.

Towering mountains blot out the stars to either side of the pass, making the darkness almost absolute.  At irregular intervals rocks slide down the slopes, but how they were dislodged you cannot be certain.  The trail is obstructed by several small boulders, obviously from the mountainsides, and you fervently hope that another does not choose this moment to fall.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: You stumble over something.  Looking down, your stomach turns as you see the corpse of a person nearly through the stages of decay, although not decayed enough to be unrevolting.  The right arm reaches towards the pass to the southeast, as if crawling in that direction, and the jaw hangs wide in a never-ending silent scream.  You shudder and say a brief prayer for the fallen, but somehow, you wonder if your prayers can be heard.

You stumble over something in the darkness.  Looking down, your stomach turns as you see the corpse of a person nearly through the stages of decay, although not decayed enough to be unrevolting.  The right arm reaches towards the pass to the southeast, as if crawling in that direction, and the jaw hangs wide in a never-ending silent scream.  You shudder and say a brief prayer for the fallen, but somehow, you wonder if your prayers can be heard.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: A small trickle of water runs down the mountainside to the south, made green by algae and slime.  A few scraggly flowers and bushes grow next to the flow, but they look sickly and half dead.  Glancing at the heavy clouds, you wonder if the sun ever shines here, and briefly, you wonder if there even is a sun.

A small trickle of water runs down the mountainside to the south, made green by algae and slime.  A few scraggly flowers and bushes grow next to the flow, but they look sickly and half dead.  Glancing at the featureless night sky, you wonder if the moons ever shine here, and briefly, you wonder if the moons are even there.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: The mountain juts out here, forcing a detour to the southwest.  As you look up the mountainside, you notice a building nestled back on a cliff.  It seems to be intact, if dilapidated, and although the detail is lost at this distance, it seems to be some sort of abbey.

The mountain juts out here, forcing a detour to the southwest.  As you look up the mountainside, you notice a building nestled back on a cliff.  It seems to be intact, if dilapidated, and although the detail is lost in the dark, it seems to be some sort of abbey.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: The trail skirts around the edge of the mountain.  The grey-black rocks are marked by scratches, which are too regular to be from animals or the elements.  The clouds seem particularly ominous here, and each rumble of thunder sounds threateningly close.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: You stand at the base of the mountain.  The trail continues up the slope, treacherous but seemingly passable, and back around to the southeast away from the mountain.  A few fat raindrops fall on your head, and a gust of wind hits you full in the face, making you shiver and blink.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: Rocks slip out from under your feet.  You grasp convulsively at the stone around you, trying to get a more solid grip as you scale the side of the mountain.  The tiny trail you climb winds up to a ledge above you, which seems flat and stable, and down to the ground beneath you.  You only hope you make it up or down before you tumble earthward.

title: [Twisted Trail]
description: A gust of moisture-heavy wind buffets you, nearly knocking you off the ledge you stand on.  Set back on the rock shelf is what appears to be a ruined temple.  The remnants of colored glass hang in the windows, and the doorway is empty.  A warped and faded wooden sign lies on the ground before the building, set at an odd angle that suggests it was ripped from the face of the structure.

A gust of moisture-heavy wind buffets you, nearly knocking you off the ledge you stand on.  Set back on the rock shelf is what appears to be a ruined temple.  The remnants of colored glass hang in the windows, visible only during the fitful flashes of lightning, and the doorway is empty.  A warped and faded wooden sign lies on the ground before the building, set at an odd angle that suggests it was ripped from the face of the structure.

title: [Temple, Foyer]
description: The room is dimly lit by light coming in through an empty doorway.  Wispy cobwebs hang from the rafters, waving in the hint of a draft, and dust covers every surface, tickling your nose until you sneeze.  The sound does not carry far, but breaking the silence seems somehow iniquitous.  A pair of double doors opens to the north, while a small arch leads off to the west.

title: [Temple, Hallway]
description: The remains of an oil lamp hang from the low, square rafters in the hall.  A dark spot beneath the dust on the floor proves to be a large oil stain, and shards of glass against the walls seem to be from the oil reservoir.  A small arch leads off to the east, lit by dim but harsh daylight.

The remains of an oil lamp hang from the low, square rafters in the hall.  A dark spot beneath the dust on the floor proves to be a large oil stain, and shards of glass against the walls seem to be from the oil reservoir.  A small arch leads off to the east, lit by cloud-dimmed moonlight.

title: [Temple, Hallway]
description: Stale air fills the hall.  The dust here is thick, breeding undisturbed by wind or being.  A narrow staircase, flanked by two empty torch sconces, leads up into darkness, while the hallway continues to the north.

title: [Temple, Kitchen]
description: Chaos abounds in this large stone room.  Cookpots have been strewn about, and crockery has been flung against the wall.  Tattered curtains hang in the small window, fluttering in the breeze whistling through a splintered door in the corner.  The destruction here was thorough and callous, and you are certain that you do not want to meet the perpetrator.

title: [Temple, Pantry]
description: Storage containers are scattered about the room, their contents spilled across the floor.  The scent of cinnamon mingled with pepper and rotted fruit makes being in the room barely tolerable to your nose.

title: [Vegetable Garden]
description: Wind rustles through the dry stalks of plants in what must have been a small vegetable garden.  The neat rows of plants have all withered and died, but strangely no other damage is evident.  To the north rises the sheer face of the mountain, capped in dark clouds, and a splintered door leads back into the temple to the southeast.

Wind rustles through the dry stalks of plants in what must have been a small vegetable garden.  The neat rows of plants have all withered and died, but strangely no other damage is evident.  To the north rises the sheer face of the mountain, capped in moonlight-silvered clouds, and a splintered door leads back into the temple to the southeast.

title: [Temple, Dressing Area]
description: Glass from several shattered mirrors covers the floor, and it seems the bad luck from the broken looking glasses has spread throughout the room.  The polished wood vanities are scratched and dented, the silver hairbrushes tarnished and destroyed, and pieces of broken perfume bottles mix with the bits of mirror on the floor.  A narrow staircase descends to the ground floor, the candle sconces lighting it long gone.

title: [Temple, Bath]
description: A large wooden tub sits overturned in the center of the room.  The room is filled with the nauseatingly cloying scent of the soap rotting on the floor mixed with the scent of oxidizing copper from the dented boiler leaning against one wall.  You step carefully, attempting to avoid the slick spots, so as not to fall, or track the soap slime out on your feet.

title: [Temple, Closet]
description: Tattered bits of cloth litter the floor.  A twisted and mangled clothing rack lies discarded in the corner, and shelves have been half torn from their braces to hang precariously from the walls.  A rickety ladder leans in the corner, heading up through a trapdoor in the roof to what you presume is the attic.

title: [Temple, Attic]
description: The contents of several boxes have been scattered about the room.  Gold candlesticks, altarcloths, white robes, and other items litter the floor, thrown with obvious disregard to their symbolic worth.  A rickety ladder leads down through a trapdoor in the floor.

title: [Temple, Attic]
description: The floor creaks beneath your feet.  It seems to give a little, and you carefully test where you put your feet with each step, for fear that you will fall through.  Upended boxes line the walls, their contents spilling from their mouths.  To the south, the attic grows brighter, as if from sunlight through a window.

The floor creaks beneath your feet.  It seems to give a little, and you carefully test where you put your feet with each step, for fear that you will fall through.  Upended boxes line the walls, their contents spilling from their mouths.  The faint rustle of bats in the rafters above your head keep you ready to duck.

title: [Temple, Window Seat]
description: A wooden bench has been placed next to a small window in the south wall.  It looks out over the bluff the temple sits upon and across the huge range of mountains.  Far to the west, sitting high on one of the mountains, you think you can make out a large castle, but the clouds obscuring the peak make it difficult to tell.

A wooden bench has been placed next to a small window in the south wall.  It looks out over the bluff the temple sits upon and across the huge range of mountains.  Far to the west, sitting high on one of the mountains, you think you can make out the silhouette of a large castle, but the storm and the darkness make it difficult to be certain.

title: [Temple, Priestesses' Chambers]
description: Feathers from a dozen featherbeds cover the floor in white down.  The mattresses have been pulled to bits, almost as if two titans had had a pillow war.  The appearance would be comical, were it not for the violence displayed in the havoc wreaked on the frames of the beds and other furniture.

title: [Temple, Priestesses' Chambers]
description: The twisted wrecks of a half dozen bedframes fill the room.  More disturbing is the mangled dress form in the corner, torso shredded in such a way as to suggest a living person's body.  A few cobwebs hang from the rafters, although you can see no sign of the spiders that made them.

title: [Temple, High Priestess' Chamber]
description: The dust is thick in this once elegant room.  The window remains in the pane, although cracks spider through the glass in crazed patterns, fragmenting your view of the outside.  The bed has been ripped in half, and a small nightstand smashed against the wall.  A white sheet lays draped over the featherbed like a shroud, and a ruined portrait leans in the corner, canvas ripped by four parallel slashes.  A small white door stands open in the north wall.

title: [Temple, Private Chapel]
description: The air is far too still.  Red light washes the tiny chapel in a bloody glow, coming from the pristine stained glass window to the north.  Sitting before the window is a small thanot altar, covered with a heavy film of dust.  A small rectangle of satin lies in a heap at the base of the altar, with little puffs of stuffing about it, as if the pillow had simply given up the ghost.

The air is far too still.  Flashes of lightning occasionally wash the tiny chapel in a lurid and bloody glow, coming from the pristine stained glass window to the north.  Sitting before the window is a small thanot altar, covered with a heavy film of dust.  A small rectangle of satin lies in a heap at the base of the altar, with little puffs of stuffing about it, as if the pillow had simply given up the ghost.

title: [Temple, Bedroom]
description: A tattered tapestry hangs from the wall, fluttering in the breeze coming from the broken window to the west.  Outside, thunder rumbles, shaking the shards of glass left in the panes.  The dirt and clutter have been swept to the east side of the room by the wind, beneath a collapsed bed.

A tattered tapestry hangs from the wall, fluttering in the chill night breeze coming from the broken window to the west.  Outside, thunder rumbles, shaking the shards of glass left in the panes.  The dirt and clutter have been swept to the east side of the room by the wind, beneath a collapsed bed.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: Your footsteps echo through the large, open sanctuary.  Chandeliers hang from the square beams above you, the red wax dripping from them looking disturbingly like blood.  Overturned and splintered pews litter the floor, sprinkled with sparkling dust from the ruined stained glass windows in the walls.  To the east opens a collapsing archway, sagging beneath the stone above it.  A pair of double doors opens to the south.

title: [Temple, Wedding Chapel]
description: A small altar sits at the east end of the room, silhouetted by a broken window behind it.  A large gash runs down the center of the altar, filled with slabs of red glass that overflow to cover the surface, as if it bled to death in the silence.  White and pink glass litters the floor, mixed with dried flower petals and incense ash.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: Dust falls from a huge crack in the column bracing the wall.  The column groans occasionally as if straining to hold the ceiling up, making you quite nervous about standing here.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: The shadows are deep on this side of the sanctuary.  To the north is the altar, sitting above the level of the pews, seemingly casting the shadows down upon you.  To the east, a small prayer chapel sits apart from the sanctuary in a small alcove and a small passageway leads northeast.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: A damp breeze blows in through a warped door tucked away in an alcove in the west wall.  Dead leaves skitter across the floor, leaving tracings in the dirt.  To the north, at the head of the sanctuary, the altar sits above the floor level for all to see.  Once a comforting presence, the altar now seems dead at best, malevolent at worst.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: The crash of glass falling against stone startles you, making your heart pound against your ribcage.  A wooden column braces the wall, the pilaster carved with symbols that are now indecipherable.  A pair of faded ribbons dangles from the column, and a pile of dead flowers rests at your feet, likely fallen from the restraining ribbons.

title: [Temple, Sanctuary]
description: A pile of wood splinters sits in the corner, covered in colored glass shards and dust.  You are forced to step over large chunks of wooden benches as you make your way through the area, careful not to cut yourself on the sharp glass.  Although the destruction in the sanctuary has left the room in chaos, the feeling of peace in the area is more than disturbing.

title: [Meditation Garden]
description: Once-beautiful flower gardens surround you.  They are dead now, dried into corpses of the colorful blooms of the past.  The rubble of ruined stone benches litters the ground, and the walls containing the area are crumbling slowly into dust.  To the north is a bower of dead vines, which arch over the remains of a modwir trellis.  A warped door leads back into the sanctuary to the east.

title: [Garden Bower]
description: All around you is the rustle of dead vines moving in the breeze.  Likely green and peaceful at one time, the bower is now a monument to death and time.  A bench broken in half down the center rests in the center of the nook, perhaps symbolic of the condition of the temple.

title: [Temple, Office]
description: The remains of comfortable chairs and a large desk are spread about the room.  This appears to have been the office of the High Priestess of the temple, where she did her work or spoke with members of her congregation.  The destruction here is complete, leaving nothing unharmed.

title: [Temple, Prayer Chapel]
description: The old chapel is sparsely lit.  Once, votive candles burned in red glass holders set in niches in the walls, lighting the room with a warm golden glow.  The room is full of shadows now, cold and silent as the grave.  A dark wood altar sits in the middle of the room, and the kneeling pillow before it is in tatters, but, from age or some other force you cannot tell.  The feeling of the area is one of peace, but somehow, this is not a peace most would choose to experience.

title: [Temple, Altar]
description: The old altar sits overlooking the sanctuary.  From here, the shadows seem deeper, the silence more ominous, as if the sonorous breathing of a majestic life had suddenly ceased, leaving you alone and afraid.  Set into the wall behind the altar is a massive glass window, not yet broken, although a creeping dark stain has spread over it, turning the colors an unwholesome red-black.  Some marble stairs lead down into darkness, providing an alternative to going back to the sanctuary itself.

title: [Temple, Crypt]
description: Not a breath of wind stirs the air here.  Faint light issues from the walls, the source unknown, illuminating rows of biers leading to the south.  Upon each bier rests a shrouded form, slim and delicate, a silver symbol clutched in dead hands upon each chest.  They seem to be priestesses of the order this temple is dedicated to, long passed on into time.  Some marble stairs lead upward from the crypt.

title: [Temple, Crypt]
description: Rows of white marble biers flank you, untouched by time and the destruction of the temple above.  Priestesses lay in their final repose, although a feeling of restlessness charges the area, as if those that rest now may not do so for much longer.

title: [Temple, Crypt]
description: Many of the biers in this area are empty.  You hope they still await those that have passed on, and shudder to think that they may have been abandoned by those who once slept here.  The platforms that are occupied hold the bodies of priestesses, silver symbols clutched in their hands.

title: [Temple, Crypt]
description: The corpses resting on the biers here are much older than the ones to the north.  The air smells of must and aged linen, and you step quietly with an irrational fear of disturbing the deep silence.  A single row of biers leads off to the south, more ornate than the rest.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Temple, Commoner's Biers]
description: Several rough stone biers stand here, bearing two and three shrouded bodies apiece.  One bier has been built off to the side, apart from the rest.  The two shrouded forms upon it are twined together, embracing for eternity.

title: [Temple, Commoner's Biers]
description: The biers here are not made of marble, but of smooth polished stone.  Bodies in rough shrouds lie two and three to a platform, although they have been laid out with obvious respect.  The corpses seem to be those of men, women, and children, likely commoners from the surrounding villages.

title: [Temple, Crypt]
description: Ten wide marble biers stand here, five to each side.  They are carved with runes along the edges, and the surfaces have been polished so smooth that you could nearly use them as a mirror.  Upon five of the biers rest bodies shrouded in white silk.  The graveclothes are embroidered with gold thread, the symbols denoting High Priestesses of the order.  The silk has been draped unevenly over the fifth body, as if she was hastily covered.

title: [Grave]
description: A single bier stands here, upraised on a small dais.  The bier is wide, made of intricately carved white marble.  Resting upon the bier is the body of a woman, clad in a long white satin robe.  Her face is covered by a platinum mask, the features of which are kind and wise.  Her hands are gloved and her feet shod, giving you no view of her flesh.  A feeling of peace permeates the area as it has nowhere else in the temple, making you feel safe and cared for.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Path]
description: The path becomes less and less lush, and the grass withers off to straw beneath your feet.  Whatever sinister force has caused the very sap of living things to curdle and run dry chills you to the depths of your being.  Still something draws you to the dark circle of trees to the southeast.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Clearing]
description: You approach an arc of curious looking dead trees.  Each has a small altar in front of it and seems to have died in a different manner.  One has had copper nails driven into it to poison its system, another has been exposed, stripped of its bark and so on.  They all bow towards the north, in silent homage to the seemingly lifeless hulk of an ancient mighty tree.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Trees]
description: Here stand more trees.  One has had a stone ring built around it that apparently sinks down deep into the ground and choked the roots to death.  Another shows signs of insect infestation.  Perhaps some swarm of beetles was let loose to feed on its sap like fleas on the blood of animals.  Again, each tree has an altar before it.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Trees]
description: Here you see a tree seared by a strange killing blight, with shrivelled fruit still clinging to the dead limbs.  Another tree shows the strips and pieces of some coarse fabric that blocked the life-giving sun until the tree weakened and died.  No trees in this area died naturally.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Trees]
description: Along the circular path are more trees that have died from unnatural causes.  One has been scorched by fire until it died.  Its sap boiled out of the stumps of its branches, the leaves curled and turned to ash as they fell.  Another was denied water until it could no longer continue.  Here too, each tree has a small stone altar in front of it.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Trees]
description: You approach an arc of curious looking dead trees.  Each has a small altar in front of it and seems to have died in a different manner.  One has had copper nails driven into it to poison its system, another has been exposed, stripped of its bark and so on.  They all bow towards the north, in silent homage to the seemingly lifeless hulk of an ancient mighty tree.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Trees]
description: In the center of the circle of trees stands what once was a giant among trees.  It is long dead, but it seems not to have died a quiet death.  Its twisted, black stumps of branches writhe and sway in the wind as though the very spirit of the tree itself were still rooted to this spot in eternal torment.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west, up

title: [Upper Trollfang, Dead Tree Top]
description: Here, in what once was the crown of this monarch of trees, sits still another of the small altars.  Looking down, you see that the center of the tree has been hollowed out.  It looks to you that the heartwood was slowly removed until the tree was too weak to defend itself from whatever evil was intended here.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail darts in and out of the deep shadows cast by the thick canopy of leaves that crown the huge trees in this ancient forest.  Moss grows thick and hangs from the branches and bark of the trees like a deep green cloak.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Several of the older trees of this area bare the marks of an attempt by a reasonably intelligent creature to harvest the wood.  The scars of axe and adze are clearly visible and yet no stumps can be seen.  For some strange reason, the trees have been badly injured but none have been hewn.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Though deep within the forest, this small clearing is surprisingly well lit and warm.  Standing in the center of this clearing is a cleverly constructed column of wood and stone.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The roar of an unseen beast of some size rings in your ears followed by the squeal of a smaller animal.  Hunter and hunted.  Each has a place.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This part of the forest bears the scars of a recent fire.  Though none of the bigger trees were killed, they were badly damaged and blackened.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Your eyes strain to adjust to the varying intensities of light as you pass from deep shadow into brilliant shafts of golden sunlight.  The rapid changes make the darkness seem even more oppressive while the sunlight nearly blinds you.

Your eyes strain to adjust to the varying intensities of darkness as you pass from deep shadow into shafts of bright moonlight.  The rapid changes make the darkness seem even more oppressive while the moonlight relaxes you.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Thick coats of green moss seem to drip and hang from the huge boughs of the trees here.  The smell of damp earth mingles with the pungent smell of decaying vegetation creating a unique and oddly pleasing aroma.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You are deep within the forest and the thick cover of leaves blocks most of the available sunlight, making this region dark on even the brightest of days.  The seemingly reverent silence at first thrills you with a feeling of awe, but this feeling soon gives way to one of dread and fear as the ominous lack of noise works its way into your soul.

You are deep within the forest and the thick cover of leaves blocks most of the available moonlight, making this region dark on even the brightest of days.  The seemingly reverent silence at first thrills you with a feeling of awe, but this feeling soon gives way to one of dread and fear as the ominous lack of noise works its way into your soul.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Even the tallest of the Giantmen feels dwarfed by the huge trees that grow here.  Reaching heights of 500 feet and with diameters of up to 30 feet, these tremendous trees are possibly as old as the land itself.  A crew of woodcutters work at felling some of the smaller trees.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The density of trees lessens slightly here and you can see a bit further into the wooded hills.  As you scan your surroundings, you notice a faint wisp of smoke coming from the northwest.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A small cottage stands in this small and very secluded glen.  Smoke is curling lazily from the high chimney and drifts gently into the surrounding wood.  Behind the cottage can be seen a quiet pool that has formed below a bubbling spring.

title: [Inside Cottage]
description: You are in the main room of the cottage.  A stone fireplace crackles merrily on the south wall, casting a yellow-gold glow throughout the room.  All the furniture here is made of heavy wood and is simple and functional.  Scattered about the room are weapons, traps, bundles of animal skins and sacks of food.  Obviously this is the cottage of a trained woodsman.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You stand at the entrance to a deep forest which rises out of the plain to the west and south.  The quiet of the meadow gives way to the ruckus of the forest here.  Birds, beasts and insects are all vying for attention as they raise their voices in an attempt to be heard.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The path twists and turns as it covers this area of transition between a deep forest to the southwest and a bright and sunny plain to the north.
The path twists and turns as it covers this area of transition between a dark forest to the southwest and a flat, moonlit plain to the north.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Winding up over the rolling hills, the path has been located in such a way as to provide you with stunning views of the grassy plains that surround you.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail winds down between a series of low hills and the ground becomes increasingly soft as it moves down.  Further up the hills can be seen a stand of huge fir trees.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: This is the northeastern corner of a great expanse of swampy land.  The path appears to lead deeper into the mist shrouded moors as it runs south.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The ground is quite soft here and you notice that your footprints are quickly filling with water as you pass.  Swarms of bloodsucking flying insects, similar to mosquitoes but much larger, seem to sense that you are having trouble moving through this area.  They land on every inch of exposed flesh and the resulting pain is enough to cause you to cry out in frustration.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The tangled mass of roots that grow here seem to reach out and grab your ankles as you pass.  The fact that you are sinking deep into the mud only complicates your situation.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The small island upon which you stand looks like the hump of a great turtle, its green back providing you with a brief bit of rest from the unrelenting tug of the mud as you cross this swamp.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Tufts of dead grass poke up through the deep mud and provide you with a convenient, though slow, means of crossing the black waters of the swamp.  Unseen bubbling and splashing can be heard off in the mist, but who or what is causing it is veiled in the oppressive grey of the thick air.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The mist seems to lift slightly in this area and you are afforded a view of a large pool of bubbling dark water.  The trail seems to follow along the banks of the water and you find the black depths to be both fascinating and hideous.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The nauseating smell of sulphur hangs heavy in the air here, stinging your eyes and making your every breath rasp and rattle in your lungs.  The thick mist that blankets this low lying wetland seems to set your mood to the same grey as the surrounding bleak landscape.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Scores of small hillocks rise out of the black water in this area.  To the northwest, a trail rises out of the water and heads off over a small hill.  Further to the southeast, you notice that a similiar trail plunges deeper into the swamp.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The path dips quickly as it passes from the west to the east into a low lying and very wet area.  Despite the obvious supply of water, little grows here and even the animals seem to be avoiding this region.

title: [Foothills]
description: You are atop a small hill.  To the south looms Zeltoph Mountain while to the north stretches a long, rolling plain.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Foothills]
description: You are wandering along a gentle sloping series of foothills.  Small plains creatures dart in and out of the low scrub that grows on these hillsides.

title: [Foothills]
description: You are wandering along a series of gently sloping foothills.  The low scrub growing here provides protection for a wide variety of plains creatures that live on these hillsides.

title: [Foothills]
description: The soaring peak of Zeltoph Mountain looms to the south.  Cloaked in pine trees, the northern base of the mountain rises above the foothills, wearing the zigzag scar of the caravan trail switchbacks.

title: [Foothills]
description: The hills are steeply inclined and rugged here.  Further south they reach to the base of Zeltoph Mountain.  Stunted bushes and patches of low-lying scrub can be seen growing from the rough grass.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Mountain Path]
description: The high walls of this twisting canyon keep this area bathed in a deep and constant shadow.  A narrow crevice in the north wall appears to lead out to brighter ground while a little used trail follows along the rubble strewn floor of this secret pass.

The high walls of this twisting canyon plunge the area into almost total darkness.  A narrow crevice in the north wall appears to lead out to moonlit ground while a little used trail follows along the rubble strewn floor of this secret pass.

title: [Mountain Path]
description: Here the path winds close to the steep canyon walls, with large stones collecting in staggered piles at irregular intervals.  Just ahead, you spot a narrow ledge, with some interesting carvings barely discernible from here.  You pause for a moment to survey the scene.

title: [Mountain Path, Ledge]
description: You are standing on a narrow ledge jutting out from the sheer, rocky slope of the canyon.  The odd runes carved into the rock here that first attracted your attention are close enough to read now.  You realize they are inscribed above a foot-high vertical fissure recessed into the rough stone.

You are standing on a narrow ledge jutting out from the sheer, rocky slope of the canyon.  The odd runes carved into the rock here that first attracted your attention are close enough to read now, even in the dim moonlight.  You realize they are inscribed above a foot-high vertical fissure recessed into the rough stone.
location: Ye Oddity Workshop, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Mountain Path]
description: The twisting trail, which follows the canyon to the northwest, suddenly ends at the base of a huge pile of rubble.  Glancing about, you assure yourself that the rocks have fallen from the sides of the surrounding cliffs.  You have heard that landslides and avalanches are not uncommon to this region and this seems to prove it.

title: [Rubble Pile]
description: You are standing on the northern edge of the huge rubble pile.  It is much wider up here than you expected and you can easily travel several yards to the south with little difficulty.  To reach the floor of the narrow canyon to the north, you'll have to climb down the rubble pile.

title: [Rubble Pile]
description: You are atop the huge rubble pile.  From here you can travel a few yards to the north or you can climb down to the valley floor to the south.

title: [Mountain Path]
description: A huge pile of rubble has tumbled down from the surrounding cliff face and appears to effectively block further travel to the north.  To the southeast, a narrow road leads up and then twists out of sight around a large boulder.

title: [Mountain Path]
description: The narrow road twists and turns as it wraps around the steep mountains and winds through the high passes.  Carefully checking your bearings as you move along, you decide that the road runs in a general northwest to southeast direction.

title: [Alpine Meadow]
description: This beautiful meadow is deep within the mountains and slightly southeast of the rugged peak known as Lyftoth.  The wildflowers that grow here are fragrant and plentiful.  The dainty petals of the blaeston seem to reflect the brilliant colors of the alpine sky.  Traesharm berries grow in startling abundance and small patches of the strange Dreamer lichen can be seen clinging to a few of the exposed rocks.

This serene meadow is deep within the mountains and slightly southeast of the rugged peak known as Lyftoth.  The wildflowers that grow here are fragrant and plentiful.  Traesharm berries grow in startling abundance and small patches of the strange Dreamer lichen can be seen clinging to a few of the exposed rocks.

title: [Alpine Meadow]
description: Tumbling gently over a bed of rocks is a stream of crystal clear and icy cold water.  Berry bushes grow in great abundance on the banks, and the brook itself is teeming with fish.  You decide this is an idyllic location to make camp.

title: [Alpine Meadow, Bridge]
description: A small wooden bridge provides dry passage over a picturesque crystal clear stream that is bursting with life.  Small schools of silvery fish dart back and forth in the water and tiny green frogs sun themselves on the half-submerged rocks.  Meandering towards the north is a dirt path with scores of wildflowers growing up on either side.

A small wooden bridge provides dry passage over a picturesque crystal clear stream that is bursting with life.  Small schools of silvery fish dart back and forth in the water, among the half-submerged rocks.  Meandering towards the north is a dirt path with scores of wildflowers growing up on either side.

title: [Alpine Meadow, Imaera's Path]
description: Colorful bursts of wildflowers sprout up alongside the dirt path as it slowly curves west through the meadow.  Occasionally a small herd of spotted deer stop here to graze, lazily nibbling at grass.  Behind them is a watchful buck, his stunning antlers held high as the sunlight glints off his shiny russet coat.

Colorful bursts of wildflowers sprout up alongside the dirt path as it slowly curves west through the meadow.  Occasionally a small herd of spotted deer stop here to graze, lazily nibbling at grass.  Behind them is a watchful buck, the moonlight glinting off his onyx eyes.

title: [Alpine Meadow, Imaera's Path]
description: Dozens of wildflowers bloom here, creating a rainbow of color across the landscape.  Near a particularly large grouping of bluebells is a small cluster of blue-grey frilly-capped toadstools with cream spots.  Every so often a colorful butterfly flutters over and lands on one of the toadstools for a brief moment before searching out its next flower.

Dozens of wildflowers bloom here, creating a rainbow of color across the landscape that is muted by the darkness of night.  Near a particularly large grouping of bluebells is a small cluster of blue-grey frilly-capped toadstools with cream spots.  Every so often a dull colored moth flutters over and lands on one of the toadstools, blending out of sight.

title: [Alpine Meadow, Imaera's Path]
description: As a soft breeze gently flows through the meadow, the tall grasses sway slowly in an almost melodic rythym.  The wind brings with it the sweet-sounding symphonic ballad of a nearby songbird.

title: [Alpine Meadow, Imaera's Path]
description: The rolling green of the meadow slopes upwards here, making it impossible to see what lies further north along the path.  Scattered wildflowers attract dozens of butterflies, which add even more color to the meadow as they flit about from flower to flower.

The rolling green of the meadow slopes upwards here, making it impossible to see what lies further north along the path.  Hundreds of fireflies dance about the night sky, their blinking lights flashing like twinkling stars.

title: [Alpine Meadow, Imaera's Path]
description: As you crest the grassy hill here, you see that the footprint-laden path winds down the slope towards a rickety dome-shaped wooden structure.  For some reason, on this side of the hill the wildflowers and vegetation seem even more abundant.  Virtually all of the area surrounding the structure is filled with vibrant, colorful flowers and very little of the tall meadow grass.

title: [Alpine Meadow, Wooden Dome]
description: This massive dome-shaped structure looks rickety from afar, but up close it appears much sturdier with its thick oak and maple beams.  Protruding several feet from the top of the structure is a twisted crystal spire.  Between each beam is a round oak-framed window decorated with an overflowing flowerbox and a pair of dimly lit hanging lanterns.  Surrounding the structure are tens of thousands of wildflowers in every imagineable color.

title: [Crystal Room]
description: Crafted from rich oak and maple woods, this rickety dome-shaped structure seems even more enormous from the inside.  Anchored on the floor in the center of the structure is a twisted crystal spire that stretches skywards, through a large hole cut in the ceiling.  Surrounding the base of the spire is an ornate wooden bin etched with a golden anvil.

title: [Garden Path]
description: This small garden has been meticulously tended, each shrub is carefully pruned and each vibrant flower is in full bloom.  A quaint cobblestone path leads over to a small hut which is hardly noticeable next to the much larger dome-shaped structure.  Atop the hut is a tiny chimney, from which a steady stream of smoke rises.

title: [Small Hut]
description: Small and cozy, this isolated hut is crafted from wood and sealed with dried mud.  Towards the back of the hut is a large pot sitting atop a blackened steel stove.  Near the stove is a table with an assortment of alchemy tools strewn about its surface.

title: [Alpine Meadow]
description: A narrow road, which stretches far out of sight to the west, comes to an abrupt end here under a carpet of lush grasses.  The surrounding countryside appears to have been used for pasture, but no animals can be seen.

title: [Alpine Meadow]
description: This area is marked by sharp contrast.  To the southwest, a thin trail leads to a lush grassy meadow.  All other directions end at the edge of a steep, and quite sheer, cliff.  A jagged path seems to hug the face of the precipice, but the footing is poor at best.

title: [Mountain Path]
description: This narrow ledge seems to cling to the rock face of the cliff like a tiny thread.  Perched precariously on the narrow path, you have a good view of the surrounding mountain landscape.  The path appears to lead up to a level meadow and down to an ominously inaccessable valley.

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: You stand at the base of a jagged path that stretches up the side of a sheer cliff.  To the southeast of here extends a narrow valley, quite hidden and superbly isolated from the rest of the Upper Trollfang region.  Glancing about your surroundings, you also notice that you have made your way far to the east and are now directly south of Zeltoph Mountain.

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: A restful quiet hangs over this part of the world, as if none of the strifes or worries of Elanthia have found this little corner of the continent.  The gentle breeze that touches your skin with a cool caress and the pleasing fragrance of blooming wildflowers makes this little valley almost idyllic.

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: Thick and sturdy undergrowth flourishes on the jumble of rocks that are scattered about on this side of the valley.  Scores of tiny eyes peer out at you from the many nooks and crannies formed by the haphazard assemblage of stone.

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: An icy cold and clear spring bubbles from the rock face to the south of you.  A small pool has formed where the cascading water has eroded away the thin layer of topsoil and sandy subsoil.  High grasses crowd the edges of the pool, their lush green growth nearly concealing the calm water behind a natural wall.

An icy cold and clear spring bubbles from the rock face to the south of you.  A small pool has formed where the cascading water has eroded away the thin layer of topsoil and sandy subsoil.  High grasses crowd the edges of the pool, their lush growth nearly concealing the calm water behind a natural wall.

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: You have reached the end of this little valley.  The high stone walls that tower above you are quite unclimbable and very flat, almost as if unknown hands had carved them in this way to prevent an easy ascent.

title: [Secluded Valley]
description: Outcroppings of bare rock jut from the heavily brush covered slope that rises to the north of you.  Rugged Zeltoph Mountain looms above the entire scene, its snow covered peak barely visible beneath a blanket of thick gray clouds.

Outcroppings of bare rock jut from the heavily brush covered slope that rises to the north of you.  Rugged Zeltoph Mountain looms above the entire scene, its snow covered peak barely visible high in the night sky.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, northwest
