description: A large, tiger-striped tomcat stalks along the top of the low brick wall, ignoring passersby as he concentrates on some invisible prey.  Flamestalks wave softly in the light breeze, flashing bright orange in the sunlight that filters through the trees.

A large, tiger-striped tomcat stalks along the top of the low brick wall, ignoring passersby as he concentrates on the shadows, watching some unseen prey.  Flamestalks wave softly in the light breeze, glowing deep orange in the moonlight that filters through the trees.

title: [Tiger Court, Tabby Lane]
description: A sleek black cat crouches in the shade, its tail flicking as it eyes the colorful birds that play around a small stone fountain in the corner of the lane.  Neatly trimmed hedges line the shaded cobblestones, bordering the small yards of the cottages beneath the oaks.

A sleek black cat crouches in a shadow, its tail flicking as it eyes a small mouse that scurries around a small stone fountain in the corner of the lane.  Neatly trimmed hedges line the dark cobblestones, bordering the small yards of the cottages beneath the oaks.

title: [Tiger Court, Calico Lane]
description: Filtered light streams through the oaks and elms that shade the lane, throwing flickering patterns on the cobblestones.  Songbirds flitter and roost among the branches, avoiding the felines that roam the hedges below.

Filtered moonlight streams through the oaks and elms that shade the lane, throwing flickering patterns on the cobblestones.  A few night birds flitter and roost among the branches, avoiding the prowling felines that roam the hedges below.

title: [Tiger Court, Lynx Circle]
description: A group of kittens of various colors play among the hedges that surround the neatly kept yards of the cottages, darting in and out of the greenery.  Flowerbeds line the cobblestones and the edge of the granite fountain, filling the air with the fragrances of various blossoms.

title: [Tiger Court, Lynx Circle]
description: Colorful lilies and snapdragons grow around the base of the circular fountain that forms the center of the circle.  The branches of shade trees whisper in the slight breeze.  A grey kitten plays at the edge of the fountain, splashing playfully in the water.

title: [Wehnimer's, Courtyard]
description: A wooden gate framed by a high wall covered with ivy encloses the small, sunlit courtyard on all sides.  The ivy's dark green leaves create a dense cover that blocks out almost all of the noise from Wehnimer's busy streets.  Flagstones are set into a path passing under a lattice arch, which offers an avenue out of the picturesque enclosure.

A small courtyard is bordered on all sides by a high wooden wall.  Ivy covers much of it, the dark green leaves creating a dense cover which blocks out almost all of the noise from Wehnimer's busy streets.  Flagstones are set into a path passing under a lattice arch, which offers an avenue out of the picturesque enclosure.
location: the Garden Cottage, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Flagstone Terrace]
description: A flagstone terrace is ringed with tall trees and beds of flowers, each competing to outshine the others with an abundance of blooms.  The walk meanders, from a wooden gate framed by a high wall covered with ivy, to a shingle-clad cottage.  The dwelling is settled into its array of gardens like a jewel, the trees overhead dappling its curved roofline with shade and keeping the interior cool and comfortable.  A deep violet door opens into the cottage.

A flagstone terrace is ringed with tall trees and beds of flowers, each competing to outshine the others with an abundance of blooms.  The walk meanders, from the tall wall with its inset gate, to a shingle-clad cottage.  The dwelling is settled into its array of gardens like a jewel, the trees overhead dappling its curved roofline with shade and keeping the interior cool and comfortable.  A deep violet door opens into the cottage.
location: the Garden Cottage, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Lobby]
description: The spacious lobby is furnished with old but well-kept chairs and couches in a variety of deep-toned upholstery.  Several residents and locals lounge around the quiet room, reading and drinking coffee or bottles of ale.  An expansive carpet woven with the image of an ancient dragon bordered in elaborate mystical patterns covers the floor.  A polished wooden staircase leads up.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Hallway]
description: The cozy hallway is panelled in dark, polished wood that seems to have been installed centuries ago.  A thick burgundy-colored carpet covers most of the stone floor, worn by many years of passing boots but still soft under your feet.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Hallway]
description: The hallway is dimly illuminated by faintly glowing oil-lamps set in brass sconces on the wood-panelled walls.  A pile of mops and brooms and buckets of greyish water stands in the corner.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Hallway]
description: A colorful braided rug covers a worn patch in the deep wool carpeting where the hallway turns.  Hanging on the wall is a gold-framed portrait of a chainmail-clad warrior standing over the corpse of a huge bear.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Hallway]
description: The faint glow of the oil-lamps fills the hallways with a faint yellowish light. An open door casts a shadow along the deep red woolen carpeting.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Second Floor]
description: The carpet here is a deep emerald green, and it seems to have been replaced at least some time in the last decade.  Brass chandeliers hang at intervals from the ceiling, filling the hall with dim candlelight.  A polished wooden stairwell leads up and down.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, up, down

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Second Floor]
description: A darker patch on the thick green carpet lies under the small window that looks out on the street below - apparently the residents have neglected to close it when it rains.  The brass chandelier on the ceiling is missing a few candles, but the window provides plenty of light to find the doors.

A darker patch on the thick green carpet lies under the small window that looks out on the lantern-lit street below - apparently the residents have neglected to close it when it rains.  The brass chandelier on the ceiling is missing a few candles, but the window provides sufficient light to find the doors.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Second Floor]
description: The remains of a few colorful streamers hang from the brass chandelier, left over from some past celebration.  An old brass shield has been nailed up on the oaken wall, with two hooks that look to have once held some ornamental weapon below them.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Second Floor]
description: Footsteps on a hard floor echo from somewhere above, but the deep green carpeting here is soft under your feet.  An unidentifiable but appetizing aroma of someone's dinner cooking wafts through the air.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Second Floor]
description: A dwarven workman stands atop a ladder in the center of the hall, changing the candles in one of the chandeliers.  His movements throw flickering shadows on the deep green carpet and polished oaken walls.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Second Floor]
description: A small glazed window looks out on the nearby buildings and the patch of weeds that passes for a backyard below.  An ornately framed landscape of a typical woodland scene hangs on the panelled wall amid numerous old nail-holes where other paintings have hung over the years.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Third Floor]
description: The floor here is bare hardwood, polished to a sheen by generations of passing feet.  Large wax candles set in sconces along the walls cast a yellowish light along the hallway.  A polished wooden staircase leads down.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Third Floor]
description: A small window provides a view of the nearby rooftops and the street below.  The slight breeze from the window causes the candle-flames to flicker, casting odd shadows on the painted walls. A narrow staircase leads up into the ceiling.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Third Floor]
description: Faint footsteps echo on the hardwood floor from somewhere around a corner.  A gold-framed painting of a rotund but not unattractive human woman reclining on a couch in a state of semi-undress is mounted on the beige-painted wall.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Third Floor]
description: A small metal bucket has been set in the corner to catch a drip of water from a leak in the ceiling.  One small section of the wall appears to have been recently repaired, and a faint smell of paint is noticeable.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Third Floor]
description: The hardwood floor of the hall looks to be recently waxed, but worn by generations of footsteps.  A small pile of empty chests rests in the corner, waiting to be taken out with the trash.  A large wax candle flickers in a sconce on the wall.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Third Floor]
description: The walls here have been plastered and recently painted over in a lovely shade of deep beige.  Candles set in sconces along the walls provide flickering illumination.

title: [Frith's Inn, Second Floor]
description: You are on the second floor of the inn.  As you lean over the polished modwir railing that surrounds the open landing, you see the front room below.  The stairway continues up and down here.  To the east is an oak door and to the west a teakwood door bearing a brass plaque.

title: [Frith's Inn, Boudoir]
description: This boudoir is lushly appointed with curtains and bedclothes of red velvet and black satin.  A large brass bed dominates the room.  Beside the bed is a richly carved nightstand with a gilt frame on it.

title: [Frith's Inn, Bedchamber]
description: The welcome sight of a roomy cot bedecked with a featherbed mattress, ice goose down quilt, and plump pillows greets you.  Any weary traveller would gladly rest and restore body and spirits alike in this comfortable, airy chamber.

title: [Frith's Inn, Loft]
description: Shards of shattered glass crackle as you make your way across this loft of the inn, which appears to have been plundered and left unrepaired.  A rope ladder dangles from the skylight above.  There is no longer anything here of value, only cobwebs, rain-warped floorboards and the odor of rotting wood.

title: [Frith's Inn, A Private Booth]
description: Off in this cozy corner booth you are treated to a bit more privacy by high wooden partitions, but afforded a good view of the bustling saloon hall. The small oil lamp on the table provides a warm and steady glow of light. The noises of the crowds out there seem far away from this perfect little spot for a quiet dinner, while you watch the patrons and the innkeep go about their evening's business.

title: [Beldrin's Game Hall, Reception]
description: From the southwest, the clatter of dice, the clicking of ivory, and the shuffling of cards is heard.  Looking around the reception area, you see a faded sofa upon which sits a young couple, passing the time in pleasant self-involvement.  To the north is a black door guarded by a shifty-looking dwarf.

title: [Beldrin's Game Hall, Main Room]
description: This is the main gambling den of the hall.  The air is rife with the perspiration of nervous intensity.  The lack of distractions indicates this is the domain of serious gamblers.  A dice table, some card tables and a gaming table have players and kibbitzers clustered around them.  Looking about, you try to sort out the winners and losers.  The cry of a hawker and excited shouts from players can be heard from beyond a narrow arch on the far side of room.

title: [Beldrin's Gaming Hall, Wheel]
description: This small room seems even smaller because of the tremendously high ceiling here.  Nearly cutting the room in half is a large counter.  Behind the counter and hanging on the back wall is the Wheel of Chance.  Keeping a watchful eye on the entire proceedings is a large man, the hawker.  The only exit is through the narrow arch that leads back to the main gaming hall.

title: [Beldrin's Game Hall, Office]
description: This is Beldrin's office.  Though alone, the uneasy feeling that your movements do not go undetected persists.  A portrait of Beldrin hangs over a desk, depicting him flatteringly in the style of the Elanith masters.  A decanter of traesharm berry liqueur and two accounting ledgers, both labeled with identical dates, are atop the desk.

title: [The Merchants' Emporium]
description: Customers wander through this room, headed into and out of the various shops.  Lazing against a nearby wall, a merchant takes a break from the bustle of his work.

title: [Barbley's Beds]
description: Multitudes of beds in a huge variety of styles and finishes lie stacked haphazardly around the shop, some tilting precariously.  Small pathways wind between the items, giving customers just enough room to view the floor samples.  At one end of the showroom, a collection of stately four-poster beds enjoys a more spacious display area and the benefit of subtle lighting.

title: [Mreeth's Quality Walls]
description: The walls and floor of this salesroom are covered with a mismatched patchwork of polished woods in a variety of finishes and hues.  Each gleaming piece of wood fits precisely against its neighbor, an impressive demonstration of the skill of the craftsman who decorated the shop.

title: [Drumble's Oddities]
description: Drumble's dimly lit shop is piled to the rafters with a tangle of tables.  From each tottering pile protrudes a strange combination of plain and polished and white-painted table legs, the item to which they belong quite indiscernible without close inspection.  Drumble himself leans casually against one particularly diverse stack, grumbling quietly to himself every time a customer requests a deeply-buried item.

title: [Rhynnde's Exquisite Rugs]
description: Elegant candelabra laden with fat beeswax candles softly illuminate this charming shop and the pleasant, smiling features of its proprietor.  A highly-polished floor of rich-hued maoral complements and enhances Rhynnde's impressive collection of thick woolen rugs and elegant mats, their deep colors and varied textures inviting customers to linger deliciously over the extensive selection.

title: [Lianedra's Hangings]
description: Various wall hangings flutter from the rafters, wafting in the tiny breeze created by shoppers moving beneath.  Displayed prominently on the rear wall, a large hanging depicting the symbol of Koar glows beneath a softly focused light.  The scent of incense drifts gently in the air.

title: [Firenna's Fireplaces]
description: The walls and much of the floorspace in Firenna's sizeable showroom are lined with hearths and stoves of every imaginable variety.  Ranging from the simplest stone firepit to the most ornate and elaborate marble fireplace, there is something in her catalog to suit every taste and budget.

title: [Flaygeyl's Flooring]
description: The sweet, dry fragrance of freshly sanded wood permeates the air in this spacious shop, combining comfortably with the smell of deep orange polishing oil.  Spread across the floor and proudly propped on sample racks around the walls, Flaygeyl's diverse selection of wooden floorboards await the purchaser's home decorating whimsy.

title: [Sprytea's Window Shoppe]
description: The pale, varnished wooden floors and whitewashed walls of Sprytea's store are designed to show off her merchandise to best advantage.  Glinting window displays hang from white oak beams high in the lofty ceiling, lending the sophisticated air of an art gallery to the cool, quiet shop.  Only the occasional murmured transaction or footstep on floorboard breaks the soft silence.

title: [Orc's Nest Road]
description: The narrow cobblestone lane leads east and west, winding between rows of humble wood and stone houses.  Smoke rises from many chimneys, filling the air with smells of burning wood and cooking food and more than a little haze.  A life-size stone statue of a grinning orc stands by the gate, keeping watch as workmen and visitors pass to and fro.

title: [Orc's Nest Road]
description: An open stone fireplace stands by the side of the road here, between the cottages in the shade of a small oak tree.  Judging by the rough wooden benches arranged nearby and the lingering smell of roasted meat, it probably serves as a neighborhood barbecue of sorts.  A narrow dirt lane leads north.

title: [Orc's Nest Road]
description: A low wooden fence lines the cobblestones, surrounded by tufts of colorful weeds.  Small gates in the fence lead to the entrances of cottages along the way.  A faint haze of smoke from chimneys and cooking fires permeates the area.

title: [Orc's Nest Road]
description: The high wooden wall that borders the road to the east is covered with sun-faded paintings of orcs and trolls, the caricatures grinning down on the shingled cottages that rest in its shade.  An aroma of apple pie wafts from an oven in a nearby cottage, and faint sounds of revelry can be heard from an inn somewhere beyond the wall.

title: [Orc's Nest Road]
description: The cobblestones end here at a low stone wall that bounds a group of small cottages.  Sunflowers poke their heads over the wall, turning to face the light, and a small dog pants lazily in the shade of the stone.  A dirt road leads off to the west.

The cobblestones end here at a low stone wall that bounds a group of small cottages.  Sunflowers poke their heads over the wall, outlined in the moonlight, and a small dog sleeps peacefully in the lee of the stone.  A dirt road leads off to the west.

title: [Gnoll Street, Garden]
description: A vacant lot between two cottages is home to a thriving vegetable garden, filled with cabbages, tomatoes, cucumbers, and the green tops of what look like onions and carrots.  A calico cat stretches on the wooden fence surrounding the garden, watching passing pedestrians with a bored expression.

title: [Gnoll Street, Dead End]
description: The road ends at the back wall of an inn that rises two stories above you.  Clinging vines of ivy climb the stone wall, thriving in the shade and spreading onto the nearby cottages, and patches of flowering weeds and grass grow thickly in the corners.

title: [Troll's Way]
description: Low stone walls border the cobblestones on both sides, broken by gaps in the wall in front of the thatched stone cottages.  Set atop the wall at intervals are carved stone heads, their troll-like visages grinning at you as you pass.

title: [Troll's Way, Rock Garden]
description: An army of carved rocks stands in the heat, each statue throwing a shadow over a miscellany of smaller stones in its lee.  Rock buildings ring the central tableau, like an audience watching a sport of combat.  Curtains in the windows reveal the buildings to be residences, although the exteriors more resemble roadside huts.

An army of carved rocks hulks silently in the moonlight, each statue throwing a deeper shadow over a miscellany of smaller stones in its lee.  Rock buildings ring the central tableau, like an audience watching a sport of combat.  Curtains in the windows reveal the buildings to be residences, although the exteriors more resemble roadside huts.

title: [Troll's Way, Gnome Corner]
description: The jumbled lane ends in a sorry excuse for a cul-de-sac.  Buildings stand haphazardly around a disjointed turn in the road.  The homes are built of stone, with roofs thatched in scanty shrub.  A lively group of small statues stands in one corner of the circle,  carved as a trio of prancing, bearded gnomes.

title: [Troll's Way, Golem Corner]
description: A grove of large boulders throws a little shade over a cluster of buildings.  Rocks stand around, some half-carved, most just positioned, creating a haphazard walkway between the dwellings.  One large stone, certainly the most dominant one of the group, is carved into the image of a golem, its heavy features somber with thought.

A grove of large boulders throws a deep shadow over a cluster of buildings.  Rocks stand around, some half-carved, most just positioned, creating a haphazard walkway between the dwellings.  One large stone, certainly the most dominant one of the group, is carved into the image of a golem, its heavy features somber with thought.

title: [Orc's Nest Road]
description: Wooden wagons stand parked along the lane, some empty and some packed with goods brought from market.  A few children carry on a game of stickball on the cobblestones, kicking up clouds of dust that hang in the air.  The thatched cottages that line the street are not luxurious, but lace curtains in the glassless windows and occasional flowerpots lend an air of civility.

title: [Orc's Nest Road, Intersection]
description: The lane curves along the back of a row of old warehouses, forming an intersection with a smaller dirt road that leads north.  Clotheslines have been hung between the cottages and the warehouse walls, and a variety of colorful but simple garb flaps in the intermittent breeze.  A circle of stones in the intersection surrounds a poorly tended flowerbed that sports more weeds than roses.

title: [Manticore Lane]
description: Thatched cottages bounded by small yards that are more dirt than grass line the narrow lane.  The marks of countless wagon-wheels have been worn into the hard dirt surface of the road, and a bit of water from the last rainfall remains in the ruts, providing refreshment for neighborhood dogs.

title: [Manticore Lane, Cul-de-sac]
description: The dirt road ends in a small cul-de-sac bounded by a circle of flowerbeds that contain a variety of blooming weeds.  A small stone well stands at the center of the road, and passers-by lower the bucket for a drink or to carry a pot of water back to their home.  The pleasant voice of a woman singing a familiar Dwarven drinking song echoes from a nearby cottage.

title: [Manticore Lane]
description: A larger-than-life wooden statue of a snarling manticore stands on a block of stone by the side of the lane, overseeing the passing wagons and playing children as they go by.  Patches of grass and flowering weeds grow along the dirt thoroughfare, and the various odors of cooking and firewood fill the air.

title: [Goblin Road, Intersection]
description: The road widens here, branching off into a dirt lane to the south and ending in a cobblestoned cul-de-sac to the east.  A circle of stones in the intersection surrounds a bright patch of flowering weeds.  A faint haze of smoke from numerous chimneys fills the air.

title: [Goblin Road, Alleyway]
description: The cobblestones turn through an area of tightly clustered cottages set across from a high wooden fence that borders the street, forming a narrow alleyway.  Some local artist has painted the fence with a fanciful mural of a group of trolls and giants engaged in some bloody sport.  Clumps of grass and a few weeds grow along the fence and between the old cobblestones.

title: [Goblin Road, Mound]
description: The road curves as it rises over the mound of a low hill that is little more than a large bump in the road.  Thumps, clangs, clatters and the shouts of workmen can be heard from the warehouses to the west.  Crows roost on the thatched and shingled roofs of the cottages, squawking at passing residents.

title: [Gnoll Street, Muddy Bend]
description: The dirt road dips into a small depression as it turns, and the wagon-wheel ruts are filled with muddy water.  A patch of bright flowers, nourished by the relative dampness, thrives around a fence that borders a small group of cottages.  The discordant sound of someone engaged in much-needed practice on a fiddle echoes in the air.

title: [Gnoll Street]
description: A larger-than-life carved wooden statue of a gnoll stands beside the dirt road, its colorful paint faded by the smoke and weather.  Long ruts made by countless passing wagon-wheels stripe the road, a few stray tufts of grass sprouting between them.

title: [Goblin Road, Cul-de-sac]
description: A dog yelps from someone's back yard, keeping up his barking until a half-dozen neighborhood mutts join in the chorus.  A stone bench circles a small tree in the center of the cul-de-sac, providing a shady place to chat amid the cobblestones and dust.  The mouthwatering aroma of roasting meat wafts from a nearby window.

title: [Wehnimer's Historical Society]
description: Ribbon-tied scrolls bearing the wax seals of different guilds are piled eight and nine layers deep on the broad mahogany desk that sits under a dust-speckled window.  Nailed to one wall is an old map bristling with colored pins.

title: [Wehnimer's Historical Society]
description: Built into the simple pine plank walls are towering shelves overstuffed with old books.  Most of the volumes hold bookmarks, torn scraps of paper, or even small twigs.  If this is a reference library, there is no discernible order to its contents.

title: [Wehnimer's Historical Society]
description: A plain rosewood table draped with a narrow white linen cloth rests in the center of the room, its only decoration a polished silver bowl lit by a falling shaft of sunlight.  Placed reverently before the table is a straight-backed dark teak bench.  The floor is bare and scrubbed clean to the very corners.

A plain rosewood table draped with a narrow white linen cloth rests in the center of the room, its only decoration a polished silver bowl shining softly in the moonlight.  Placed reverently before the table is a straight-backed dark teak bench.  The floor is bare and scrubbed clean to the very corners.

title: [Wehnimer's Historical Society]
description: The most notable aspect of this room is the imposing blackboard which takes up the entire eastern wall.  Stationed in front of it is a slightly canted lectern dusted with ancient layers of chalk.  The only available place to sit is at a cramped little desk with a leaking inkwell.

title: [Wehnimer's Historical Society]
description: Many toys in various stages of repair spill out from a large stamped tin chest to colonize the polished floor.  The long vertical planks of the wall are painted in an alternating rainbow of primary colors, with some additional charcoal decoration in the lowest portion.  Stacked on a little oak table are several sheets of parchment and a selection of drawing tools.

title: [Engraver's Shop, Atelier]
description: Weapons and armor, intricately engraved, etched and damascened, line the walls of this impressive, cluttered workshop.  Apprentices and students hunch over benches, lavishing ornamentation on finely forged arms.  Overseeing it all from one corner is Karl Owntafeet, Master Engraver.

title: [Helga's, Dining Hall]
description: Unlit oil lamps hang in iron sconces along the smoke-stained walls of the low-ceilinged room.  Several tables and an oaken sideboard, bearing traces of the previous day's meals, are flanked by a long wooden bench and a few smaller chairs.  A leaded glass window, its dusty panes half-covered by filmy curtains, lets a little filtered light into the room, and a brick hearth smolders against the north wall.

Tinted glass oil lamps hang from iron sconces, casting a dim glow over the smoke-stained walls of the low-ceilinged room.  Several tables and an oaken sideboard, bearing traces of the previous day's meals, are flanked by a long wooden bench and a few smaller chairs.  A leaded glass window, its dusty panes half-covered by filmy curtains, looks out on the dark street, and a brick hearth smolders against the north wall.

title: [Helga's, Pub Room]
description: The narrow, dimly lit room is cluttered with rickety, ale-stained tables and chairs.  Candle stubs mounted in earthenware ale flasks offer the only light, their yellowish glow making the room seem more decrepit than it actually is.  Several dockworkers converse around a table in hushed voices, between sips of grog and puffs of strong pipe tobacco.  A low wooden stage, no more than a small platform, stands at the far end of the room.

title: [Helga's, Back Alley]
description: The narrow alley, shaded by the overhanging eaves of the stone and wood buildings that rise on all sides, is full of debris, piles of rags and filth.  A broken wooden chair, an old crate and a trash barrel are piled to either side of the smoke-stained oaken door that leads into the back of the building to the south.

title: [Helga's, Kitchen]
description: Puffs of foul-smelling steam rise from a pot of simmering, scum-covered liquid resting atop an ancient cast-iron stove, condensing on the formerly whitewashed walls to form dripping, greasy smears.  A stained wooden counter stands along one wall, a row of iron hooks hanging above it, and a heap of filthy rags and aprons in the corner occasionally twitches with the explorations of hungry vermin.

title: [Local Warehouse, Dry Storage]
description: The wooden floor groans in protest at your weight.  Sacks of wheat, rye, and other grains are stacked high against one wall.  You notice ants marching in the cracks between the floorboards.

title: [Local Warehouse, Stowage]
description: This chamber's high ceilings accommodate an array of equipment designed for loading merchandise between ships and the dock.

title: [Local Warehouse, Entry]
description: You watch as crates, boxes and assorted other goods come though the entrance into the warehouse.  The local merchants who own the goods are also here checking each item as it is stowed away.

title: [Local Warehouse, Office]
description: A gaunt cat glances up at you as you look around this unkept office.  The desk, made of a piece of wood across two crates, is overflowing with documents related to the inventory of items in the warehouse.  You see a small sign on the desk, and a trunk with a lock in the corner.

title: [Herbalist's, Laboratory]
description: This room resembles nothing so much as an exotic greenhouse.  The air is heavy, warm and humid, with a constant stream of steam rising from a kettle in the corner.  Trailing vines, velvety mosses, and woody herbs grow in pots along the floor.

title: [Kilron's Pawnshop, Stash Room]
description: You slip behind the rack and are startled to see all manner of precious gems, ora and mein jewelry, and sacks of coins piled on the floor. Tempted to help yourself, thinking a missing sack might go unnoticed, the narrow exit and the pawnbroker in the outer room make you reconsider.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: Traffic in and out of the neighborhood flows through a stone gateway, the road surface changing from hard-packed dirt to rock at the property line.  Several merchants hawk their wares from carts just outside the entrance, hoping to land a big sale from the well-heeled Lords and Ladies passing by.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: Sunlight bounces off the red brick used for the chimneys in the surrounding houses, giving it a slight orange cast.  Cattails poke out of a small lily pond, waving gently in the breeze as small tassels puff away from the tops of their stalks.  The airborne seedlings waft away, so thick they look like a gentle snowfall.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: The shafts of broken lances were cleaned up and trimmed to create the fencing around the cabins here.  Butterflies fly about lazily enjoying the beautiful day.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: An intricately carved marble birdbath stands companion to a birdfeeder suspended from a tree branch overhead.  A gentle breeze rustles leaves, cooling off the warm day.  A wagon wheel with the spokes taken out of it hangs from a rope tied to another branch in the tree near the bath.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: An immense oak spreads its large branches out over the roadway, shading a wide expanse that includes some of the houses in the area.  Several benches are set in the cooler space, huddled together in a circle.  Up in the boughs of the great wood, a treehouse overlooks the goings on below.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: Cobblestone Court's great circle is paved with granite cobblestones, each with the name of a family donating money or goods to help construct the neighborhood.  Masons carefully set the stones, then sealed them with a moisture-resistant resin to preserve the inscriptions.  Gutters run the circumference of the curving road, taking away excess rainwater.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: Coachlights hang suspended from lengths of wrought iron carefully curved into long 'S' shapes and bolted onto homefronts.  Four-paned windows welcome the light pouring into the houses.  Carefully tended flower gardens line the fronts of the buildings, filled with bright colors.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: A broken wagon wheel lies right where it fractured, in the middle of the road across a large beam it partly shoved away towards the side of the street.  Open yards come right up to the edge of the pavement, large rounded bushes marking the corners of each property.  Several houses sport bird feeders and birdbaths out front, and several feathered guests take advantage of the thoughtfulness.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: Sunlight glitters off a reflection pool in a small park populated with young children with fishing rods.  Dogs run playfully around, barking at the butterflies flitting from flower to flower.  The shadows of large golden fish are visible underneath the surface of the water in the pond.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: A brick kiln puffs black smoke along the back wall of the development, hard at work firing pottery for use by the citizens of the town.  A drying rack sits next to the massive oven, covered with plates and vessels of every description.  On the other side of the structure, pieces of china await final touches before being taken to market for sale.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: Thick, brightly colored paint brings some life to an otherwise unremarkable shed situated between two homes on the south side of the road.  Stars ranging in size from tiny to an entire wall cover the exterior of the building, meeting at a waning sliver of a moon on the front.  A stack caps the roof, thick black smoking belching out of it.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Circle]
description: A field of clover and dandelions rolls out to the southeast, bounded by the crumbling walls of a once-proud keep.  Bright yellow flowers spot the green expanse, sunflares against the darker background.  An overgrown vine climbs one wall, forming a natural backdrop for the open grassland.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Square]
description: A few park benches sit around a small square, taking advantage of the shade trees stretching out over the plaza.  The central focus of the clearing is an elegant wishing well, complete with decorative roof.  Children beg their parents for coins to flip into its inky blackness, hoping for their planned extravagance to come true.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Garden]
description: Twin evergreens pruned into three-dimensional spirals stand as a gateway to the well to the south.  A formal garden of carefully groomed bushes and domestic flowers fits into curving geometric shapes, the walkways trailing the outer edges of the arcs.  A high wall sets the exquisite garden off from the rest of the neighborhood.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Garden]
description: A quiet lily-covered pond is surrounded by a bed of wildflowers and exotic groundcover.  An occasional golden fin breaks the surface sending tiny ripples across the surface, making the pads undulate slowly on the top of the water.  Small bees buzz busily from flower to flower, then ferrying it back to their hive high up in the trees.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Fortune Lane]
description: Carefully inset into the stone, a coin on the ground just outside the front door of each home along the lane.  Legend has it that families observing this custom will give good luck to those passing through the portal.  The constant hum of crickets in the background recalls times spent in the wide open grasslands, far away from civilization.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Fortune Lane]
description: Wide red brick walkways lead up through wooden gates to intricately carved front doors on the homes in the neighborhood.  Each door on this street bears some charm for luck, ranging from a simple rabbits foot to the unusual four-leaf clover.  A family of ducks makes its home in a small pond behind one of the residences.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Fortune Lane]
description: Flecks of gold and silver glitter brightly from the sunlight striking the embedded metals in the cobblestone street.  Crickets and frogs chirp and croak loudly, adding to the rich environment surrounding the houses.

Flecks of silver glitter faintly from the moonlight striking the embedded metals in the cobblestone street.  Crickets and frogs chirp and croak loudly, adding to the rich environment surrounding the houses.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Kismet Lane]
description: An enterprising young child set up a lemonade stand on the streetcorner, with business so brisk that he had to leave to make more.  An empty jar sits on the counter of the stand next to a box of glasses.  Some of the neighborhood animals mill about, waiting for the boy's return and perhaps a tasty handout.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Kismet Lane]
description: A mound of dirt looks to have been created from the hole in the ground off to the side of the roadway.  The source of the digging is most likely the large hound chained to a tree in the front yard of one of the houses.  The dog has quite a collection of bones piled near the tree, their origin a mystery.

title: [Cobblestone Court, Kismet Lane]
description: Thatched roofs cap cozy homes along the length of Kismet Lane.  Birds warble in the trees, flitting back and forth in search of the perfect perch.  Lightly planted yards surround the quaint buildings, while vegetable gardens sit in between.

title: [Wehnimer's, Middle Dock]
description: Laboring dockworkers and strolling seamen mingle here on the weathered planks of the dock, between the hulls of large seafaring merchantmen.  The groan of ships pulling at hawsers, the clatter of feet upon gangplanks, and the swearing of the dockworkers mix with the cries of seabirds and the cadence of waves against the pilings.

title: [Flowers Galore]
description: Within the tent, the air is warm and humid, and the fragrances of all types of flowers assail the senses.  Rows of buckets hold flowers of every shape and hue, each stem carefully trimmed and stripped of any sharp thorns.  The ground is littered with fallen petals, making a colorful carpet to walk upon.

title: [Lanai's Warehouse, Cargo Room]
description: Coming upon a cavernous space, you see bags, crates, and barrels filled with items worth being shipped on the great merchantmen that ply their trade to and from the port of Wehnimer's Landing.

title: [Lanai's Warehouse, Crate Room]
description: Immense crates are stacked several high, creating a maze of sorts between their myriad piles.

title: [Lanai's Warehouse, Clay Jars]
description: Sealed clay jars lie neatly stacked against the western wall of the warehouse.  They seem to be given a wide berth by the warehouse workers.

title: [Lanai's Warehouse, Granary]
description: Full bags of grain are stacked ten feet high in this far corner of the warehouse.  A few of the bags have punctured, leaving a scattering of grain in small mounds upon the floor.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Lobby]
description: A thin layer of sawdust covers the floor, marked by the footprints of a legion of shuffling feet.  Sturdy wooden benches line the walls, wedged between stacks of crates.  A stone fireplace is built into one wall and the lingering scent of burnt wood fills the air.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Office]
description: Tidier than the lobby, the office is arranged quite professionally.  A well-crafted dark rug covers the wooden floor and a small, charcoal etching is framed on the wall behind the desk.  Stacks of crates labelled with various destinations are arranged neatly in a corner.

title: [Wehnimer's Exchange, Inside]
description: The inside of the booth is brightly lit.  Clerks in smart uniforms greet customers with a smile, inquiring about the voyage and the wonders found on the other side of the sea as they exchange your funds.  The air of the place is one of salutation, bidding you a cheerful welcome home.

title: [Wehnimer's, South Wharf]
description: Dockworkers curse you and each other as they carry their loads from the great trade ships to the warehouses of Wehnimer's Landing.  Intermixed with the dockworkers are the crews of ships from various exotic and faraway ports.

title: [Wehnimer Travel Office]
description: This ticket office appears to be nothing more than a remodelled fishing shack.  On one of the unevenly boarded walls is a mural of some island scene, beneath which a slogan reads, "Teras Isle:  Voyages Daily!"

title: [Wrenrick's, Main Chamber]
description: Dim light diffuses through the main chamber of Wrenrick's Storage.  Unlabeled crates are neatly stacked to the south, bags of dried bread lichen to the east, while barrels and casks with varying contents line the western and northern walls.  In the distance, the war cry of a cat signals the impending death of a would be inhabitant.

title: [Wrenrick's, Trunk Room]
description: This small room contains trunks of all sizes and shapes.  Sturdy shelves from floor to ceiling increase the number that may be stored here.  A pulley and rope is attached to the high ceiling.

title: [Wrenrick's, Office]
description: A small desk and a crickety wooden chair almost fill this small office at the back of the warehouse.  From the half-solid white substance in it, you suspect the bowl in the corner once held milk for the cat.

title: [Reignbeau Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Splotches of color cover the walls, dripping down onto the floor.  Your feet stick a bit with every step and their soles must surely be turning every color of the rainbow.  More disgruntled dwarves lounge about, trying to avoid getting their tunics covered with clay.

title: [Warehouse, Musty Room]
description: A large open area surrounds you.  The musty odor of items stored too long in one place fills the room, and the floor is coated with dust and traces of vermin.  Sacks, crates, and barrels are stacked haphazardly around the room.  You somehow feel uneasy even though it appears that this warehouse has not been active for quite some time.  In the corner, a wooden ladder with a broken rung leads up.

title: [Warehouse, Loft]
description: You are in a loft above the warehouse.  The low ceiling causes you to hunch over.  The floor is spread with filthy straw, as though bedding for a vagrant or squatter.

title: [Wineshop Salesroom]
description: A wide variety of wine is on display within the hand-carved case, many of the vintages appearing to be quite rare.  A tall, well-dressed clerk attends to the bottles, quite busy as he moves about the room checking inventory.  He seems to be paying far more attention to the wine than to the customers.

title: [Wine Shop, Lounge]
description: Large candles resting upon elegant brass stands illuminate this richly appointed chamber, the candlelight soft and inviting.  While the bookcase along one wall is not completely full, the numerous tomes arranged within provide ample variety for those interested in a bit of reading.

title: [Wine Shop, Cellar]
description: Floor-to-ceiling iron racks house row after row of wine bottles, the shelving covering nearly every inch of wall space.  Dim flickering light coming from a single dusty sconce dances off the glassy surfaces of the bottles, the kaleidoscope of reflections all warped in similar fashion.

title: [Cozy Shack]
description: This is a cheery little shack, filled with light, the sound of birds outside and the heady scents of the herbs and flowers surrounding it.  A small fireplace burns brightly in the far wall.  White lace curtains adorn the windows, and a high fourposter bed sits invitingly in the corner.

This cozy little shack is filled with shadows.  The chirping of crickets and the smells of herbs and flowers drift quietly through the darkened room.  A soft red light gleams from the coals in a fireplace in the far wall.  White lace curtains adorn the windows, and a high fourposter bed sits invitingly in the corner.

title: [Brewery, Entry Hall]
description: The organic, musky smell of fermentation fills this large entry hall.  Here the famous ales and beers of Wehnimer's Landing are brewed.  Deliverymen scurry by with sacks of grain, wheelbarrows filled with hops and casks of spring water.  A corridor lies ahead to the north.

title: [Brewery, Office]
description: This is the brewmaster's office.  A long table by the window holds some corked bottles of pale golden liquid and crockery mugs.  An impressive fireplace occupies the major part of one entire wall and seems to demand closer scrutiny.

title: [River Tower East, Roof]
description: A small, roofed structure provides some weather protection on the open top level of the guard tower.  The view north across the bay affords a valuable vantage point, looking out towards the island of Glaoveln, home port of the warlike Ice Krolvin.  To the west and south, the blue rivers and rocky slopes of the Lower Trollfang region provide a breathtaking vista.

title: [Observation Platform]
description: All manner of gadgets presents themselves for manipulation.  A crystal eyepiece mounted on a spring arm can be raised and lowered on a whim by use of a horizontal and vertical cranks and a lever made of invar.  The rotating chair swivels easily around, showing great views of the surrounding area through vertical-slit windows that traverse the walls.

title: [Velvette's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by smooth sandstone walls, the shop features a handblown double-heart bottle in the center of its cobblestone floor.  A midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs under the nightscape ceiling.  Right near the front is a brass treasure chest and some wrought-iron hooks.

title: [Magical Burrow, Dirge Street]
description: A low mithril gate stands at the entrance to Dervish Park.  The fence surrounding the sanctuary is obscured with a silvery haze, blocking the view of the grounds beyond as well.  The open gate is finely crafted from the purest mithril, beckoning visitors to enter and discover what lies on the other side.

title: [Loci Workshop, Antechamber]
description: A granite worktable, clearly a relic of the workshop's past, stands immovably at the center of the room.  Positioned behind the massive slab of granite and blocking the passageway that leads further into the shop is a bulky, heavily robed figure.  Freshly strewn rushes spotted with dried lavender and rosemary cover the floor, their scent failing to combat the lingering, acrid odor of smoke.  The aroma is not aided by the pungent smell of fish oil burning in the lamps suspended from the ceiling.

title: [Magical Burrow, Apparition Way]
description: A metal gate bangs against its frame while the loud clacks echo off the walls of the closely packed surrounding buildings.  Light stabs out from windows into the grey mists trying vainly to illuminate the exteriors of the houses, succeeding only in creating a weak glow in the meandering fog.

title: [Wizard Guild, Courtyard]
description: Winter appears to have somewhat loosened its cold grip upon the verdant swath of lawn surrounding the stone building.  Flowers imported from a more mild climate much farther to the south line either side of the path that courses through a green sea of impeccably clipped grass.  A cobblestone path arcs away from the courtyard while a pair of large arched doors leading into the guild stand slightly ajar.

title: [Wizard Guild, North Lawn]
description: An ice-frosted hedge skirts the border of the guild walls as several small gardens full of herbs and roots surround a translucent ice block shelter.  The lawn is illuminated by stray beams of sunlight that pierce the cloud cover, reflect off the ice blocks, and dance upon the manicured grass.

An ice frosted hedge skirts the border of the guild walls as several small gardens full of herbs and roots surround a translucent ice block shelter.  The night air is crisp and the lawn is illuminated by small orbs filled with some kind of phosphorescent liquid.

title: [Wizard Guild, Foyer]
description: The rippling and faintly bluish light that fills the foyer seems to have no visible source, but is bright enough to reveal the vivid colors of the mosaics that line the curving walls.  A confluence of warm air from the hall to the east and a chill breeze from the arch to the west leaves the flagstones damp with condensation.  A curtained passage opens to the north.

title: [Wizard Guild, Hallway]
description: A blue glow illuminates the wide hallway to the northwest.  Torches along the walls burn steady and bright despite a noticeable cool breeze.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: The ceiling of the workshop is formed from a solid sheet of blue ice marked with phantasmagorical shapes, but whether they were created by sentient hands or the result of slow melting is impossible to tell.  The glare from the translucent ice above casts a dim, cold blue light on a wide array of alembics, retorts and other materials filling the brass racks that line the walls.  In one corner is a winding brass stairway centered around a solid zorchar rod reaching up through the ceiling.

title: [Wizard Guild, Hallway]
description: A chill breeze blows steadily from the southwest, stirring the tapestries hung along the damp stone walls.  The wind is cold enough to rime the windowpanes with frost, although the stone beneath you seems unnaturally warm.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: Well-stuffed blue velvet chairs scattered throughout the spacious library provide comfortable seating for lounging wizards.  Bookcases that rise well above the reach of even the tallest giantman line the walls in orderly ranks starkly contrasting with the clutter of scrolls and quills heaped on numerous tables.  A large fireplace dominates the east wall, illuminating the chamber and the portrait hanging above it.

title: [Wizard Guild, Hallway]
description: The faint sound of running water echoes off the high vaulted ceiling of the corridor and melds with the rhythm of the rustling robes of wizards making their way to and from the chamber to the west.  Shadows dance to the flickering of the torches that line the corridor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Conservatory]
description: A tiled fountain is the centerpiece of the conservatory, its polished surfaces casting back the effulgent sunlight that pours through the glass-filled walls and ceiling of the expansive chamber.  Water spilling into a central pond gently rocks the water lilies which dot its surface, their succulent stems bowing beneath the weight of their fragrant blossoms.  Wrought iron benches with celadon green silk cushions add to the serene atmosphere.

A tiled fountain is the centerpiece of the conservatory, its polished surfaces casting back the pale moonlight that pours through the glass-filled walls and ceiling of the expansive chamber.  Water spilling into a central pond gently rocks the water lilies which dot its surface, their succulent stems bowing beneath the weight of their fragrant blossoms.  Wrought iron benches with celadon green silk cushions add to the serene atmosphere.

title: [Wizard Guild, Hallway]
description: Unexpectedly warm air fills the broad hallway and provides a welcome respite from the harsh artic winds outside.  A constant flow of mist falls from an icy arch as warm air filled with the scent of tropical flowers makes contact.  Torches along each wall illuminate lifelike murals that depict a realistic courtyard with a fountain.  The murals look so real that one could easily imagine faint sounds of splashing water coming from the paintings.

title: [Wizard Guild, Auditorium]
description: The auditorium is large enough to seat hundreds and is clearly the heart of the guild.  A mosaic of sea life surrounds the circular chamber and the light cast by girandoles containing white candles, give the undine creatures the illusion of motion.  Benches are arranged concentrically about a high dais with a lectern draped in vivid blue silk.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Wizard Guild, Masters' Chamber]
description: Containing little more than a capacious desk and a comfortably stuffed velvet sofa, the office derives its beauty from the magnificent view of Icemule Trace through the mullioned windows.  The warmth of the nearby conservatory graces this room as well, though a fire is laid in the hearth to chase any vagrant chill.

Containing little more than a capacious desk and a comfortably stuffed velvet sofa, the office derives its beauty from the magnificent view of torchlit Icemule Trace through the mullioned windows.  The warmth of the nearby conservatory graces this room as well, and a fire burns in the hearth to augment it and chase away the night's chill.

title: [Wizard Guild, Scribe's Workroom]
description: Several tall wooden-backed seats surround a large table with piles of scrolls lying about.  A small dome of frost-covered glass acts as the only means of illumination, casting a soft blue light.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stair]
description: A warm draft curls up from below as the temperature becomes chilly.  A solid zorchar rod extends from well below the stairway and reaches up into the observatory above.  Viridian and cerulean stained glass windows lining the narrow tower reflect the dim sunlight from outside, making the stairway brighter and casting an amorphous light on the carvings engraved along the polished stone walls.

A warm draft curls up from below as the temperature becomes chilly.  A solid zorchar rod extends from well below the stairway and reaches up into the observatory above.  Viridian and cerulean stained glass windows lining the narrow tower reflect the light from a few torches hanging from the stairway, casting an amorphous light on the carvings engraved along the polished stone walls.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, up, down

title: [Wizard Guild, Balcony]
description: A wide balustrade of unevenly twisted metals defines the edge of the walkway.  Stonework, set in a herringbone pattern along the balcony, is washed in hues of violet and celadon from the endless lightstorm swirling through the center of the tower.

title: [Wizard Guild, Balcony]
description: Writhing tendrils of white-limned purple and viridian light tangle together and separate forming intricate designs in an endless, complicated dance.  Fingers of light crash together in eye-searing, silent lightning strikes while others crawl up and down the length of the zorchar rod that projects through the center of the tower.

title: [Wizard Guild, Balcony]
description: Opaque green mist rolls over the balcony, spilling into the open air in the center of the tower.  The virulent shade of mist and the distinctly strange shapes it produces suggest that it may be the product of an alchemical experiment gone wrong, or perhaps completely right.

title: [Wizard Guild, Promontory]
description: Jutting out into the open air within the core of the tower, this promontory affords an unmatchable vantage point for observing the ever-raging lightstorm.  The violent lightning strikes, eye-searing both in their brightness and in their virulent hues, arc off the zorchar rod rising through the center of the tower but avoid hitting this balcony, leaving it untouched.  A well-stocked bookcase partially blocks the outer walkway, its studious contents at odds with the wildness of the lightstorm.

title: [Wizard Guild, Balcony]
description: Clusters of scorch marks dot the stonework on this part of the walkway, as if this stretch is a favorite target of the constant lightstorm roiling through the tower.  The air itself roils uneasily, the naturally cool air of the tower surging against the superheated air caused by the storm's continuous lightning strikes.

title: [Wizard Guild, Balcony]
description: Curving gently to the east and west, the arms of the balcony surround the open column of air in the middle of the tower.  From here, the full length of the zorchar rod centering the tower is visible as it stretches up and through the domed quartz ceiling that supports the observatory on the top floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Balcony]
description: The amorphous shapes carved into the stonework of the staircase give way here to more definite images graven in bas relief.  Arctic and red foxes, tall, gently-rounded penguins, cats of all sizes, and a lone snowshoe hare are pictured in an endless march across the expanse of wall, momentarily accompanying any wizard traversing the balcony.  Higher up, a veritable flock of various types of owls, rock ptarmigans, and a gyrfalcon patrol the stoneworker's sky.

title: [Wizard Guild, Observatory]
description: Cold wisps of wind pass through the observatory, causing your breath to fog and swirl before you.  The town of Icemule Trace spreads out to the south, while the mass of Aenatumgana obscures the lowermost portion of the northern sky.  A solid zorchar rod covered in frost extends upward, reaching for the sky.  Star charts heavily inked with notes plaster every available surface, and an impressive brass telescope occupies a central dais.

Cold wisps of wind pass through the observatory, causing the fog of your breath to drift in the dim light of a single hooded lantern.  A solid zorchar rod covered in frost extends upward, reaching for the sky.  Star charts heavily inked with notes plaster every available surface, and an impressive brass telescope occupies a central dais.

title: [Alchemical Workshop]
description: Set high up in the outside wall, a single narrow lancet window allows crimson-hued natural light to flood the interior of the workroom.  A solid, nearly immovable workbench occupies the majority of the floor space.  Several workstations are set up around the granite workbench, each neatly fitted with a translucent glass alembic, a crucible, and a silver gem lens assembly.

title: [Alchemical Supplies]
description: Wax-sealed jars, each labeled in neat, yet spidery script, are deployed along the shelves in orderly rows.  Apothecary's chests, their drawers labeled in a matching script, stand beneath the shelves on sturdy legs.  A granite workbench with mortars stationed on it at even intervals occupies the center of the floor.

title: [Mundane Supplies]
description: Wedged into an awkward and oddly angled scrap of space, this store room is barely able to house a bulky but serviceable haon broom cupboard.  Warring for what little space is available, a large dust bin hunkers down, occupying the majority of the floor that is left.

title: [Northwest Tower, Entrance]
description: The base of this square tower is patrolled by a halfling militia guard.  The stone floors are empty but for a few wooden chairs and a wooden trash barrel, and the woolen wall hangings provide more quiet and warmth than cheer.  A narrow staircase bends along the walls as it rises into the heights above.

title: [Northeast Tower, Entrance]
description: Several halfling guards keep watch over the staircase that curves around the tower's walls.  One always paces in front of an iron-barred gate across the stairs, while the others maintain poses of rest or prayer in corners of the room.  Two elaborately embroidered woolen tapestries adorn the hall, the only furniture save for a small wooden barrel conveniently placed for the collection of trash.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Gangplank Way]
description: On the north side of some of the buildings, icicles have grown into giant ice columns, the dripping water from around chimneys adding to their size every day.  Other houses have icicles beginning to form, the previous ones broken out by the homeowners.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Gangplank Way]
description: Snow and ice whisk across the chilly roadway, piling up on the bushes and walls of the neighborhood.  Frozen branches crash noisily to the ground, breaking the relative quiet surrounding the houses.  Lamps flicker fitfully, their dim light hardly seen even during the lightest of storms.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Gangplank Way]
description: Heavily layered snow warps the roof of a house struggling desperately to remain standing.  In the early morning and late evening, the snow takes on a blue cast reflecting the changing skies above.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Jezebelly Plaza]
description: A long string of flags hangs suspended over Jezebelly Plaza, crossing at the center of the square.  Dark painted houses with round windows crowd upon the very edge of the gathering area, trying to get in on the fun.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west

title: [Spitfire Alley, Tartrunner Row]
description: The peculiar halfling naval architecture is evident throughout the alley, the entire neighborhood of bungalows and cottages having a seagoing air about them.  Many of the citizens and inhabitants have settled down in Icemule Trace to start a quieter life and get away from their bloodthirsty (or tartstealing) pasts.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Tartrunner Row]
description: Twin cannon guard the entrances to Jezebelly Plaza and Gunner's Lane, their muzzles crammed with dirt and spikes to prevent an accidental firing.  Heavy traffic passes through frequently, most headed for the Crow's Nest Pub, planning on warming themselves up with the bar's more unusual concoctions.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Spitfire Alley, Tartrunner Row]
description: A solitary lamp stands atop a single rusty post. The other lamps and posts that lined the row have completely rusted away, leaving pitted stumps of flaking iron.  An unfinished carving of a noose is scratched into the weathered, faded paint, a remnant of a disrupted attempt to leave a signal for one of the town's seedier residents.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Tartrunner Row]
description: The reputation of Spitfire Alley is evident in a sign requesting that travellers beware of pickpockets and tart thieves.  Dark alleyways sidle between closely packed houses, the depths of the passages only traveled by the underhanded and the foolish.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Galleon Road]
description: Off to the southeast, a large peachbasket sits atop a tall staff, the pole topped with a flying Jolly Roger.  The landmark of the Crow's Nest Pub telling only part of the story of the rough and tumble origins of many of the burrow's inhabitants.  Drunken citizens totter towards their homes, mumbling to themselves in a crude attempt at singing.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Jezebelly Plaza]
description: An eerie wind whistles through the plaza, blowing its way across empty space and howling around corners.  Old paper, dead plants, and debris tumble through, catching on tiny protrusions, piling up until the street sweepers can catch up with the weather.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Jezebelly Plaza]
description: Peeling paint and highly polished brass fittings make conflicting statements about the opulence that the area was known for in earlier times.  Circular windows and stained glass on some of the buildings look to be "borrowed" from a church.  Ice covers some of the window clasps, effectively sealing the openings shut.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Jezebelly Plaza]
description: The rainbow of flags suspended above the plaza are tied to a series of belaying pins anchored by a railing constructed to look like a ship's rail.  The wall continues around the square, defining the space as well as giving it the unique flavor of being aboard a wide ship.   Small snowdrifts and icicles hanging from the flags dampen the image a bit.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Gunner's Lane]
description: A giant brass ship's bell sits at the eastern edge of Gunner's Lane, a remnant of the seafaring past of many of the inhabitants of the burrow.  A silver plaque on the bell has long since been rendered unreadable by the opaque ice and snow plastered to it by the frequent inclement weather.  The immense frame holding the entire piece off the ground shows signs of wear, cracked in several places.

title: [Spitfire Alley, Gunner's Lane]
description: The Crow's Nest pub stands shakily on the north side of the street, its clapboard walls peeling paint and desperately in need of a good cleaning.  Whenever the doors to the place swing open, loud sea chanties tumble out, usually followed by a flying body or two and an emphatic "And don't come back neither, ya lubbers!"

title: [Spitfire Alley, Gunner's Lane]
description: A massive rock sits in the middle of the road, diverting traffic to the north and down Gunner's Lane to the northeast and southeast.  The familiar skull and crossbones of seaborne brigands is scratched into the surface of the immense stone, probably left there by a drunken reveler staggering home from the Crow's Nest Pub.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Snowflake patterns of frost coat the windows, giving a fractured view of the outside world.  A large couch piled high with furs sits almost dangerously close to a pot-bellied woodstove, and a pair of snowshoes hangs on the wall.  Carefully labeled scrolls fill a shelf at the back, behind a massive oak desk with clawed feet.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Talvon Turn]
description: The Turn is composed of a circular road ringed on its perimeter with neat houses.  A small median sits within the circle's embrace with a large rock positioned in its center.  The top of the rock is mantled with snow, and a few halfling children climb nimbly through large craters in the stone, their laughter and calls echoing off the faces of the buildings watching their play.

The Turn is composed of a circular road ringed on its perimeter with neat houses.  A small median sits within the circle's embrace with a large rock positioned in its center.  The top of the rock is mantled with snow that is marked with the footprints of halfling children.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Mews Lane]
description: The houses edging Mews Lane are charming and well-tended.  Urns containing small hedges sit in front of some, while others boast bright window shutters.  A row of wrought iron street lamps fronts the houses, facing the long wall running parallel to the street on its east side.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Dabbings Mews, Monument Turn]
description: The cobblestone lane makes a turn around the base of a stone statue.  Residences crowd around the circle's circumference, separated from the street by fitted paving stones which provide a promenade.  An enormous statue stands in the center of the circle, and with its up-raised hand and animated expression it appears to hold the audience of buildings in thrall.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Mews Lane]
description: Mews Lane ends at the foot of a flight of stone steps leading up to an imposing building, its front girthed by a generous porch stretching completely across it.  In its lee, the row houses reach their end, and an alley leads between them and the large edifice.  The path bordering Mews Lane turns the corner in back of the building, containing the Mews in its embrace.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Dabbings Mews, Stand Alley]
description: The alley is narrow and the tall buildings crowded along its length almost seem to meet overhead.  Rough paving stones demand attention lest they claim a stubbed toe, and a gully runs down the center of the lane.  The smell of pastries baking hangs in the still, cold air, protected from the gusting wind by the alley's cozy enclosure.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Ma's Court]
description: Ma's Court is scarcely more than an alley, yet the quaint charm of the buildings along it give it a decided appeal.  The lane runs near to the Tuckered Inn, and that edifice's imposing facade can be glimpsed over the rooftops of the houses bordering the court.  From somewhere close by, the melody of a mandolin can be heard, its double strings singing a harmonic air.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Leaftoe Circle]
description: Leaftoe Circle passes a quiet row of houses, their chimneys puffing out smoke over their red tiled roofs.  The buildings sit close to the street, but some of the residents have made the most of what stoop they have.  Small benches and decorative stone ornaments carved in the likenesses of animals perch neatly in front of the homes.  From beyond the last house on the lane, the busy commotion of Icemule's more commercial quarters can be faintly heard.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Toe Cul-de-sac]
description: The lane ends in a cul-de-sac, its pristine curbs ringed with narrow residences.  Many of the polished doors on the houses are hung with wreaths of holly and ivy, and the roofs are composed of sienna-red tiles.  Clumps of snow rest on some of the eaves, the bright white making the crimson tiles look crisp and bright in contrast.  In the shelter of a couple of the eaves huddle a few pigeons, sending their soft song out into the enclave.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Leaftoe Lane]
description: Leaftoe Lane comes to an abrupt halt at the foot of a row of thin residences.  The granite curb before the dwellings is swept spotless, and brass kick-plates on some of the doors shine cheerfully in the cold grey light.  The eaves of the houses are steeply pitched and their windows are as tall and thin as their silhouettes.

title: [Southeast Tower, Entrance]
description: Two hinged doors do little to keep the winds from swirling around this square keep, and the halfling militia guard that patrols the stairs shivers in the cold.  More spartan than drab, this room boasts little in the way of furniture: a small wooden trash barrel near the door, a few odd chairs, and some woolen tapestries on the walls.

title: [The Rat Race Tent]
description: Low lighting produces deep shadows in the interior of this massive tent.  A few unsavory halflings loiter in the corners, sharing a bit of gossip or handicapping the next race.  One side of the tent is dominated by a wall of multicolored crates, while wooden benches of various heights line the other side.  At the center of the tent is a large model of the city of Icemule Trace.

title: [Fenster's Window Shop]
description: A brightly painted, lifelike mural depicting a forest meadow decorates the walls of this well-lit shop.  Mock-up windows hang upon the walls, giving the impression that you are in a house with an ecclectic arrangement of windows looking out into the wild woods.  Fenster beams proudly as he rocks back and forth upon his heels, his arms clasped behind his back.  A sign reads, "Installing a Fenster window gives new light and charm to your home."

title: [Icemule Historical Society]
description: Nestled within this stone-walled courtyard is a frosty garden of holly and hummock grass shaded by a knobby pine tree.  An old stump serves as a primitive altar, its level top crowded with candle stubs and offerings.  Draped from the overhanging tree limbs are strings of tiny bells which chime with every gusting breath of wind.

Nestled within this stone-walled courtyard is a frosty garden of holly and hummock grass sheltered by a knobby pine tree.  An old stump serves as a primitive altar, its level top crowded with candle stubs and offerings.  Draped from the overhanging tree limbs are strings of tiny bells which chime with every gusting breath of wind.

title: [Magical Burrow, Dervish Park]
description: The snow and ice which dominate Icemule Trace stop abruptly at the fenceline of the park.  In their place sits a wide open greensward full of laughing children running everywhere.  A strange glow hangs about the area, an odd magical field, slightly shimmering, its outer edge falling right at the snowline.  A tall statue comprised of ten wizened halflings in enruned robes stands majestically at the center of the field.

title: [Glowing Zircon, Showroom]
description: Decorated in rich, but subdued shades, the showroom gives a feeling of understated comfort while providing little to draw attention away from the sparkling wares.  Overhead, a chandelier strung with quartz prisms provides ample lighting for a brushed silver jewelry stand sitting atop a long glass display case.  The back wall is occupied by ornately carved shelves holding a collection of curios.

title: [Silvermule, Upper Hall]
description: Tall potted palms lean gracefully over the carved, white railings.  At the top of the landing hangs a large oil painting of the town.  Bright silver and blue tapestried carpet runs the length of the hall, softening the patrons' footsteps.  A massive chandelier sways from silver chains, hanging low in order to light not only the landing, but the entry on the floor below.

title: [Silvermule, Sunrise Room]
description: The eastern wall of the room is made of leaded panes of thick, ruby-colored glass.  A slight draft from the fireplaces set on either side of the room stirs the crystal drops from the chandeliers, filling the air with a gentle musical chiming.  A dais is set against the ruby-glass wall, which provides an elegant backdrop to the entertainers who perform here.

title: [Silvermule, Wheel Room]
description: Elegant gilt velvet covers the walls, diffusing the light from the dazzling chandelier into a pleasant glow.  The energy and excitement of millions of silvers being won and lost fills the room as a rather well dressed halfling exhorts players to bet on the large wheel that dominates the floor.

title: [Gooseberry Room]
description: An enormous crystal chandelier sparkles in the ceiling.  The smaller crystal pieces are cut in the shape of plump gooseberries.  Yellow candlelight brightens the glaes-veined, green marble floor.

title: [Southwest Tower, Entrance]
description: Warm woolen tapestries decorate the stone walls of this square tower, providing some measure of softness to what is otherwise a stark, military space.  A halfling militia guard paces in front of a narrow staircase that winds along the side and back walls before rising into the upper stories.  The double oak doors leading out to the intersection of two alleys swing loosely in the wind, providing very little in the way of protection against the chill.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Upper Hallway]
description: Several doorways open off the hallway, however, only two are currently used as guest rooms.  The chandelier hangs low enough that you must duck your head or risk being splattered with hot tallow should you bump into it.  A slightly worn tapestry carpet has been tacked down the center of the hallway.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Maoral Room]
description: The dark, maoral-paneled walls contrast sharply with the cream-colored plaster ceiling, which is molded with lacy filigree and delicate curves.  An antique sleigh bed fills the space beneath the round dormer window, its headboard curving gracefully like the prow of a ship.  Beside the door stands a carved wood valet draped with a silk brocade blanket.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, White Room]
description: The ceiling slopes low towards the floor on either side of a round dormer window.  Twin beds with thick down comforters are set to either side of the window, where the ceiling merges with the walls.  A white snowcat fur rug covers the floor between the beds.  Simple cedar chests are at the foot of each bed, filling the air with an agreeably woodsy scent each time their lids are raised.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Granary Lane]
description: Stout wooden buildings, most with small, round doors, line the street.  Bundled-up halflings wander about their daily routine.  One pauses to catch a snowflake on his tongue.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Barleywine Way]
description: By the side of the street, a group of halfling children are building a snowman.  They seem to be arguing over what sort of nose to use, a carrot or a radish.  You doubt the eyes will last long -- they're muffins of some sort.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Barleywine Way]
description: A smiling elven couple merrily drags a sled down the street.  He is holding a picnic basket, while she's carrying a bottle of wine.  The sled slides along the ice-covered cobblestones with a jolly slushing sound.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Barleywine Way]
description: The street bends around a granite statue, a knight astride his charger.  Icicles hang from his lance, and a snowbird is perched on his helm.  A broad alleyway leads off to the south between a pair of two-story homes.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Wheatbeer Lane]
description: The crowds of happy halflings and the lingering scent of freshly baked tarts indicate a bakery is near.  Even the dogs seem happy, as one barks enthusiastically at a non-plussed penguin.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Oatmeal Street]
description: An old dwarf shovels the snow off his porch, grumbling while he works.  The silver of his beard matches the icicles which hang from the eaves of his home.  A flight of snowbirds zips by overhead, chattering to each other as they travel.
An old dwarf shovels the snow off his porch, grumbling while he works.  The silver of his beard matches the icicles which hang from the eaves of his home.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Oatmeal Street]
description: The open field to the north of the street is filled with snowmen.  They have been built in two groups, opposing armies facing each other with stick-swords, broomhandle lances and pie-plate bucklers.  The windows of the small houses opposite the field are brightly lit through the rime of frost.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Oatmeal Street]
description: The road curves around a massive pine on the northern side.  Snow hangs heavily from its branches, and every breeze produces a spray of flakes.  On the porch of a small home facing the tree, a tubby old halfling smokes his pipe, grinning up at the sun.

The road curves around a massive pine on the northern side.  Snow hangs heavily from its branches, and every breeze produces a spray of flakes.  On the porch of a small home facing the tree, a tubby old halfling smokes his pipe, grinning up at the moon.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Oatmeal Street]
description: Snug, one-story wooden homes press the sides of this narrow road.  The cobblestones are of alternating black and yellow granite, forming an abstract pattern where the snow has been cleared.  A trio of penguins stand to one side, chattering and chirping at one another with great enthusiasm.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Barleywine Way]
description: Quaint wood-and-stone homes line this bend in the road.  A pair of fat penguins waddle down the middle of the street, beaks high in the air, intent on some vital penguin-business.

title: [Barleywine Way, Alley]
description: This is not so much an alley as a very narrow street, pressed on both sides by a crowd of homes and shops.
