At the south end on the west side is a tall wooden fence, intricately painted in a green and gold pattern.  There's a large gap underneath it where someone has scooped out the snow.  Off to one side, a wooden counter squats before a target painted on a wall.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Wheatbeer Lane]
description: Snow-forts have been constructed to either side of this narrow cobblestone lane.  Each is garrisoned with a hearty band of young warriors, well-armored in wool hats, fur boots and warm mittens.  The hostilities have not yet commenced, as both sides are still hoarding and stacking snowballs.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Wheatbeer Lane]
description: The road bends around a small hill to the south.  Groups of children and adults trudge up the snowy slope, dragging sleds, shields and the occasional oversize pan along.  The trip down is much shorter and more fun.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Granary Lane]
description: Snug wooden houses crowd either side of this narrow lane.  Snow covers their sloped roofs and smoke puffs from the chimneys.  The faint aroma of hot cocoa indicates that someone is enjoying the cold.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Granary Lane]
description: Faint strains of lute music drift from one of the cozy homes lining this street.  The tempting scent of blueberry pie wafts from the half-open window of another.

title: [Windmill Burrow, Granary Lane]
description: Small shops, storehouses and homes are clustered along the street here.  Icicles hang down from their eaves.  An alley leads between two of the storehouses.  It's narrow, but well-lit with oil lamps.

title: [Mill Tower, Entry]
description: The floors are lightly dusted with flour that has overshot the holding bins.  A wheelbarrow is propped against the wall, having been emptied of its load of wheat, it now awaits the final product for the return trip home.

title: [Mill Tower, Second Floor]
description: Great gears and pulleys nearly fill the room.  A bewildering assortment of ropes and pulleys for hauling grain to the hoppers on the floor above is in one corner.

title: [Mill Tower, Windmill]
description: The wind creaks through the boards around the shaft of the windmill, which drives the gears to grind grain into flour for the town.  The miller carefully checks the hoppers which feed the grain to the millstones below, ensuring that each sack of flour produced is of the same high-quality as the last.  Hoppers filled with corn, wheat, and oats are brimming, testifying to the abilities of the nearby farmers.

title: [Thirsty Penguin, Alcove]
description: A dark velvet curtain hangs at the end of the circular alcove.  Quiet murmurings from beyond the curtain remind you of the soft hush of water flowing slowly beneath an ice-covered stream.

title: [Trevor Dabbings, Sitting Room]
description: Dark velvet curtains cover every inch of wall space, keeping out both external sound and the bitter cold.  Seated upon a richly cushioned chair of polished hoarbeam is a middle-aged halfling in very fine garb.  The resemblance to the statue on Porter Street, which depicts the legendary Krolvin War hero Talbot Dabbings, is uncanny.  This must be his descendant, the no-less-famous Trevor Dabbings, the current patriarch of that august family.

Dark velvet curtains cover every inch of wall space, seemingly in order to keep out both sound and the bitter cold.  Seated upon a richly cushioned chair of highly polished modwir is a rather youngish, but richly dressed, halfling.  You recognize a resemblance to the statue of the warrior in Porter Street and realize that this must be his infamous descendant, Trevor Dabbings, who first showed the residents of Wehnimer's the way to Icemule Trace.

title: [Nightowl Pub, Dressing Room]
description: Large closets line the walls beside the heavy curtain leading out to the main room.  Costumes and plumage spill from the open closets in a colorful disarray.  Cluttered pine tables hold a full-length mirror against the wall, and several chorus girls chatter as they vie for a chance to check their reflection before returning to the stage.  A soft breeze from the open window ruffles a feather boa draped casually over the sill.

title: [Icemule Forging Supply Shop]
description: A well-beaten path provides contrast against the frost covered area leading up to a small counter.  Various glyphs and metals have been neatly stacked next to a small iron brazier.  To the south you see the rooftops of the local armory and weapons shop.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Several steps down from street level, this passageway winds a twisting path that tunnels underneath city buildings.  Here, the cobblestones of the roads above are repeated, however they're less weathered and more cumbersome to navigate with sound footing.  Oil lamps glow permanently, day and night, due to the subterranean nature of the area.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Water trickles slowly down the passageway wall, echoing softly with an almost song-like quality as droplets *plink* upon the rounded cobblestones.  More light grey than black, the opening to the east beckons, issuing a slight breeze that courses down the corridor.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Oil lamps flicker in the unnatural breeze coming from the opening at the top of the steps.  Several leaves swirl down around the cobblestones, making dry skittering noises as they are moved further into the passageway.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Between twin rows of buildings sits an open courtyard blotted with an occasional fragrant midden.  Fresh air keeps the smell from permeating this narrow space.  Oil lamps outline a patch of lush grass neatly maintained with a trim of blue-grey riverstones.  Several well-placed benches create a small common area for socializing, or just for stargazing in a somewhat private setting.

Between twin rows of buildings sits an open courtyard blotted with an occasional fragrant midden.  Fresh air keeps the smell from permeating this narrow space.  Attempts have been made to make the area more appealing, as a patch of lush grass is neatly maintained with a trim of blue-grey riverstones.  Colorful flowers dot each corner of the park-like oblong, between which rest benches.  Laundry draped upon the ropes stretched between the buildings is barely noticeable, except when they flap loudly.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: A lone rat scampers close to a saucer of milk left out for stray cats near one of the building's closed back doors.  Oil lamps create gargantuan shadows along the walls surrounding this courtyard, as passersby come and go.  Several trumpet vines climb and intertwine along the walls, their brilliant flame-hued blossoms closed into tight buds for the night.

Several scrawny cats crowd around a saucer of milk left out for them near one of the building's closed back doors.  Birds take advantage of the laundry ropes strung overheard, using them as convenient perches, to the distraction of the gathering felines.  Several trumpet vines climb and intertwine along the walls, their showy dark green foliage contrasting with brilliant flame-hued blossoms.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: The scent of burning oil is thick in this section of the underground passageway, mainly from the constant illumination provided by the lamps that light the way.  Stone steps at either end lead up to courtyards set between the rows of buildings that line the streets above.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Two dogs wander aimlessly in the passageway, pausing to sniff along some unseen trail.  The loud clatter of cans sends them running off, tails tucked between their legs.  A pair of lovers hide in the shadows, in an attempt to conceal the illicitness of their affair, only to be startled by the sudden noise.

Two children play hide and seek in the passageway, their voices and laughing echoing loudly.  Tiny feet running up and down steps reverberate with a hollowness to their sound.  A young woman carries several packages, balancing them with the skill of a juggler, as she makes her way along the subterranean egress.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Wind whistles around the corner and down the steps, as it creeps in through the opening at street level.  A torn and dirty copy of the Elanthia Journal turns cartwheels over the cobblestones, making its way deeper into the cavern-like passageway.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Several people gather around a blazing firepit in the middle of the courtyard, telling stories and singing songs as they watch sparks dance towards the heavens.  Several windows are open and lit with a candle, adding to the festive atmosphere.  From one set of curtained panes comes the delicate notes of a sweet melody accompanied by an enchanting voice.

Bright and sunny, this large courtyard offers little in the way of shade, other than what appears naturally from the angle of the sun.  Trumpet vines snake along the building walls thickly, covering them with lush foliage and reddish-orange blossoms, while skirting clear of the many windows.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Faintly briney air serves to remind that the bay is close by, and enhances other smells noticeable.  The scent of cooking meats is redolent with the night breeze, thick with garlic and spices.  A lone bench sits next to a flight of stone steps leading down into a passageway, and offers a panoramic view of this sheltered hideaway and the night sky above.

At this end of the courtyard, someone has tried to create a small vegetable garden.  Leggy tomato plants wind around their supports, profuse with yellow blossoms, yet there is no fruit forthcoming.  Pumpkin vines sprawl along the ground, anemic with yellowed leaves.  A nearby bench sits next to a flight of stone steps leading down into a passageway, and offers a panoramic view of this sheltered hideaway.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Faded silk banners with their words long gone hang in frayed valances, draping from each oil  mounted on the passageway walls.  The end of one section hangs down limply, detached from the remainder and trailing in a rivulet of water meandering along the cobblestones.

Faded silk banners with their words long gone hang in frayed valances, draping from each oil lamp mounted on the passageway walls.  The end of one section hangs down limply, detached from the remainder and trailing in a rivulet of water meandering along the cobblestones.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Turning slightly, the passageway continues to wind its way underneath the city, never far from the streets or the cool dampness of the bay.  Flickering lamplight from smoky wall sconces does little to dispell the dank surroundings.  The scent of freshly-baked bread from a nearby bakery draws passersby to the steps at either end of this large tunnel.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: At the top of the steps, flanking pots of white and crimson geraniums stand like sentinels.  Birds roost just under the eaves of the arched opening, their straw nests fringed with bits of string and paper.  Echoing footsteps along the passageway cobblestones sound loudly, but it's hard to discern if they are coming closer or moving farther away.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Wider than the other courtyards along this twisting passageway, due to the proximity of Vornavis' western wall, this sanctuary boasts a large grassy area for family gatherings or celebratory moments.  The buildings that ring the tiny park feature windows with shutters and awnings, many of them tossed open and illuminated with candlelight.

Wider than the other courtyards along this twisting passageway, due to the proximity of Vornavis' western wall, this sanctuary boasts a large grassy area for rest and for play.  Slightly better maintained, the buildings that ring the tiny park feature windows with shutters and awnings, a sure sign of prosperity.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: A wooden double door, the kind generally found in stables, has been painted a dark forest green and set with shiny brass fittings.  Propped open, the busy sounds of mercantiling come from within, ranging from the shouting out of orders to stock being moved around noisily.

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: The warehouse sprawls out from the wooden double door that serves as the entryway.  Off to the side of the large foyer that greets customers, several large facade displays are positioned along the walls.  Renderings of brick, stone, wood, and other rock faces have been expertly executed in exquisite detail.

title: [Warehouse, Permit Office]
description: Crates and barrels fill the outer edges of the large room, rising up from the smooth stone floor towards the high rafters.  Boxes of paper and other parchment surround a large oak desk that sits near the center of the room.  Heavy lanterns hang from the support beams of the ceiling, washing illumination throughout the area.

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: Thick wooden columns rise up from the dirty stone floor, offering support to the high celing.  Wall replicas fill the area, offering up a variety of furnishings for any owner's business.  Heavy lanterns hang from hooks inset into the columns, providing the area with enough illumination to browse at any hour.

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: Heavy shipping crates fill most of the corridor, only allowing a thin passage through this end of the warehouse.  Floor models are leaned up against the walls, offering buyers a glimpse at the textures and colors available.

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: The back of the warehouse splits off into various corridors, and the loud ruckus of clerks moving large crates around is more prevalent here.  A few stock ceiling models hang nearby on the wooden columns, but most of the area is taken up by shipping crates.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: Wall displays hang from the ceiling, giving the patrons of the warehouse an easy glance at the fine pieces the place has to offer.  Pieces of hay can bee seen littering the western portion of the stone floor, tracked in by the shipping clerks that work busily in the back of the warehouse.

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: An assortment of rugs and statuary line the two walls of the corridor, and hay has been tossed around leaving the area to appear in a state of disarray.  Various labels and tags are strewn about the floor, their surfaces written with splotchy ink that once marked the contents of a shipping crate that is no longer near.

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: Crammed into the back corner of the warehouse, a pile of signs can be discerned off to the side.  The entire back wall is filled with huge shipping crates and other assortment of packaging.  Shipping clerks roam throughout moving boxes and inventory around, causing a large ruckus that echoes throughout the warehouse.

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: The corridor runs by a small area off to the side that contains a variety of display cases and tables, each piece mounted on a hook attached to the wooden columns that support the high ceiling of the warehouse.  A few business owners browse the stock as they wander past, discussing the different styles.

title: [Warehouse, Decadent Decor]
description: Stylized roofs of all shapes, sizes and colors sway on the display racks off to the side of the corridor.  Several renditions of tiny completed models, matching facades with roof, are shown to give the casual buyer something to visually compare.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: To the south, the path joins a major road running east to west.  To the north, a fork in the path leads into a less dense wooded area to the northeast and a dense forest to the northwest.  Breezes blow through the trees, and spots of moonlight break through the canopy of leaves overhead.

To the south, the path joins a major road running east to west.  To the north, a fork in the path leads into a less dense wooded area to the northeast and a dense forest to the northwest.  Breezes blow through the trees, and dazzling spots of sunlight break through the canopy of leaves overhead.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: To the northeast, the path works through a wooded area sparsely populated with small trees and heavy underbrush.  To the northwest, the woods are older and denser, blocking out more of the moonlight and creating an eerie darkness.

To the northeast, the path works through a wooded area sparsely populated with small trees and heavy underbrush.  To the northwest, the woods are older and denser, blocking out more of the sunlight and creating an eerie green glow.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: Briars and brambles choke the path here, making progress slow and painful for those not wearing high boots.  The trees in this area struggle for life amongst the thick underbrush and the vines that cling to and climb the small trees.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: Moths and fireflies flit about this area of woodland, moving from bush to bush in breathtaking displays of light and motion.  Many of the bushes here have no leaves, and many empty cocoons can be found hanging from tree branches and bush limbs.

Moths and butterflies flit about this area of woodland, moving from bush to bush in breathtaking displays of color and motion.  Many of the bushes here have no leaves, and many empty cocoons can be found hanging from tree branches and bush limbs.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: A bubbling spring to the northeast of the path here gurgles steadily from a subterranean source.  Small animals gather near the banks of the stream, drinking from the pool of cool, refreshing water.  The ground near the spring is damp and marshy.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: A huge formation of gray and white rocks bursts from the ground to the north of the path here.  The base of the formation is huge, and the tops of the rocks reach as high as the tallest of the young trees in the area.  Moss and lichen grow on the rocks in damp crannies and crevices, hidden from the moonlight.

A huge formation of gray and white rocks bursts from the ground to the north of the path here.  The base of the formation is huge, and the tops of the rocks reach as high as the tallest of the young trees in the area.  Moss and lichen grow on the rocks in damp crannies and crevices, hidden from the sunlight.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The path makes a wide, sweeping turn to the west here around an old oak tree just off the path to the southwest.  The tree is massive, and judging from the size, is much older than the surrounding forest.  Behind the tree, a hill runs up to the denser forest to the south and west.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: To the west, the woods become more dense overhead, while thinning out to the east and allowing more moonlight to shine into the forest.  Owls hoot noisily from the trees, their calls echoing in the woods in all directions.

To the west, the woods become more dense overhead, while thinning out to the east and allowing more sunlight to shine into the forest.  Birds whistle shrilly from the trees, their calls echoing in the woods in all directions.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The underbrush thins out to the west here, becoming almost nonexistent in the darkness created by the thick blanket of leaves and branches overhead.  More moonlight can be seen to the east, but to the west, the woods become nearly pitch black.

The underbrush thins out to the west here, becoming almost nonexistent in the darkness created by the thick blanket of leaves and branches overhead.  More sunlight can be seen to the east, but to the west, the woods become nearly pitch black.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: A chill wind blows up from a hillside that leads down to the south, while the air to the west seems stiflingly still.  To the east, a dim light can be seen in the distance, while the woods here are extremely dark in the night.

A chill wind blows up from a hillside that leads down to the south, while the air to the west seems stiflingly still.  To the east, a dim light can be seen in the distance, while the woods here are darker than the night.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: Owls in unseen perches high in the trees hoot at travelers on the path who fumble along in the darkness.  Piles of fallen branches have been pushed to the sides of the path, indicating regular upkeep of the path.  The air here is still and hot, as if it had not been stirred by breeze in years.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The dead stillness and the lack of any breeze makes the woods strangely silent.  No birds chirp, no animals scurry, and no leaves rustle through this silent section of woods.  Compared to the quiet of the surrounding woods, travelers seem to crash along the road in a clamor.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The path runs directly into a smooth, black cliff face to the west.  To the east, the path continues into the pitch dark of the woods.  To the south, the path runs along the edge of the massive cliff looming to the west.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The cliff face to the west disappears into the tree tops high above.  The path runs north and south along the base of the cliff here.  Thin rivulets of water trickle down the cliff from an unseen source above.  Small pools of water gather at the base of the cliff where the running water collects.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: A huge, black cliff face looms to the west of the path here.  The path continues north along the cliff face, and turns to the southeast away from the cliff down into a valley in the dark woods.  Small rocks skitter down the hill from under the feet of travelers on the road.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The path runs along a steep incline here, upward to the northwest and down to the southeast.  The stillness of the woods is disturbed only by movement on the path.  Leaves and dead fall lie off the path under the trees, but no underbrush grows in the darkness of the woods.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The path dips into a deep, dry gully before sloping steeply upward to the northwest and leveling out to the northeast.  Occasionally, pairs of red or yellow eyes peer out of the darkness of the surrounding woods, scanning the path for travelers.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The path winds through a field of boulders here.  The huge rocks seem to have poked through the earth almost at random in this area, forcing travelers to carefully pick their way.  The boulders show no signs of erosion and no cracking near the base.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: Light seeps in to the darkness from the southeast, while to the north and west, the darkness becomes nearly absolute.  A slight breeze can be heard stirring trees to the southeast, but the breeze does not reach here to break the stifling stillness of the air.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The moonlight begins to fall away to the northwest as the path slopes downward and the branches and leaves of the trees close overhead, blocking out the sky.  To the southeast, the woods open up and animals scurry in and out of the underbrush.  The temperature seems to drop down the slope to the northwest.

The sunlight begins to fall away to the northwest as the path slopes downward and the branches and leaves of the trees close overhead, blocking out the sky.  To the southeast, the woods open up and animals scurry in and out of the underbrush.  The temperature seems to drop down the slope to the northwest.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: Logs have been cut and laid across the path here to provide footing as the path climbs very steeply to the north.  To the south, a dim light can be seen, the moonlight giving hope for an eventual way out of the black woods.  All sounds fall away, making the echoes of boots on logs seem deafening.

Logs have been cut and laid across the path here to provide footing as the path climbs very steeply to the north.  To the south, a dim light can be seen, the sunlight giving hope for an eventual way out of the black woods.  All sounds fall away, making the echoes of boots on logs seem deafening.

title: [Vornavis, Wooded Plains]
description: The path winds up a steep hillside to the north, sloping steeply downward to the southeast.  Loose earth and scattered stones make the climb difficult without grasping nearby trees for support.  A clicking sound snaps occasionally in the distance.

title: [Solhaven, Travel Office]
description: The interior of the cottage is painted a pale cerulean blue and simple crenelated molding at the top of the walls gives way to a slightly domed, white-painted ceiling.  The pine plank floors are lacquered to a glossy sheen, except for a dull, scuffed pathway leading directly from the front door to the clerk's podium at the rear.  Positioned strategically amidst the worn sections, a few benches divert visitors toward the perimeter of the room.

title: [Warrior Guild Entryway]
description: The unadorned facade of a sturdy limestone building rises before you, its weathered surface broken only by several vertical slits in the ancient stone and a heavy mithril portcullis bearing an engraved brass plaque.  Well-groomed hedges fill the small flagstone courtyard with a peaceful scent of sunlit leaves, but the sounds of grunts and clashing weapons echoing from somewhere above dispel any sense of calm.

Well-groomed hedges fill the small flagstone courtyard with a peaceful scent of moonlit leaves, but the sounds of grunts and clashing weapons echoing from somewhere above dispel any sense of calm.

title: [Library, Front Desk]
description: A small crystal chandelier with candle-filled globes hangs from the ceiling, its illumination softly spreading across the exposed oak paneling of the room.  A long lacquered oak counter sits to the north, its surface cleaned off and ready for tomorrow's rush of daily book returns.  The area is silent as most of the patrons have left for the night.

A small crystal chandelier with candle-filled globes hangs from the ceiling and exposed oak paneling spreads throughout the room.  A long lacquered oak counter sits to the north, its surface littered with dozens of books and volumes of various sorts.  A group of scholars stand off to the side, their voices lowered as they enjoy a hearty debate about something.

title: [Library, West Wing]
description: Polished oak cases line the long walls from limestone flooring to white-washed ceiling.  Books of every size and shape take up all available space on the rows of shelves, as well as litter several high-backed oak benches at the center of the room.  Silvery moonlight spills through the high window to illuminate the library's lone occupant as he sits in quiet study upon the window seat.  Glass spheres, filled with lit candles, stand upon iron pedestals at the four corners of the room offering a modicum of light.

Polished oak cases line the long walls from limestone flooring to white-washed ceiling.  Books of every size and shape take up all available space on the rows of shelves, as well as litter several high-backed oak benches at the center of the room.  Bright sunlight streams through the rooms lone window and offers the perfect reading spot for the seat built into it.  A quilter's easel rests in the back corner where a blonde-haired woman gives a quiet lesson to a ring of much younger women.

title: [Library, West Wing]
description: Thick black carpeting lines the limestone floors at this section of the library and muffles the sound of all foot traffic.  A single frosted globe is suspended by a long iron chain over a long oak table and is the only light to touch the room.  Several empty stools have been neatly pushed against the table for the evening.  Chests, bins and shelves line the three walls, some filled with quills, inks and sand-trays while others are lined with ribbon-bound scrolls.

Thick black carpeting lines the limestone floors at this section of the library and muffles the sound of all foot traffic.  A single frosted globe is suspended by a long iron chain over a long oak table and is the only light to touch this room.  Several quiet scribes sit upon the stools that ring the table, each with their heads bent over the scroll that they are carefully working to recreate.  Chests, bins and shelves line the three walls, some filled with quills, inks and sand-trays.

title: [Library, East Wing]
description: Floor to ceiling bookcases line the eastern and western walls at this section of the library, each shelf packed tightly with volumes and tomes.  A tall window neatly bisects the eastern wall and is lined with a deep window seat.  Plump blue cushions adorned with white piping lay in neat piles to the right of the seat while a pair of three-tiered bookcases divide the room in half and are lined with past issues of the Elanthian Times.

Floor to ceiling bookcases line the eastern and western walls at this section of the library, each shelf packed tightly with volumes and tomes.  A tall window neatly bisects the eastern wall and is lined with a deep window seat.  Plump blue cushions adorned with white piping are laid in a semi-circle around the seat where a young librarian reads stories to the group of toddlers sitting upon them.  Separating the group of toddlers from the library's other patrons is a pair of three-tiered bookcases covered with past issues of the Elanthian Times.

title: [Library, East Wing]
description: Crates and a few volumes are piled up in the back of the room, most of them holding a thin layer of dust.  Tall oak bookshelves line the paneled walls, their shelves bowing under the weight of the stuffed manuscripts and parchment that overflows its space.  Despite the flickering of a nearby candle-filled globe, the quintessence of silence fills the air of the library at night.

Crates and a few volumes are piled up in the back of the room, most of them holding a thin layer of dust.  Tall oak bookshelves line the paneled walls, their shelves bowing under the weight of the stuffed manuscripts and parchment that overflows its space.  A few robed figures move about the back of the room, carefully marking on pieces of parchment they carry as they categorize inventory.

title: [Solhaven Contractual Services]
description: Several oak desks stand in neat rows behind a low railing that bisects the small room.  A thin gate allows the clerks to move between the two halves of the room and is latched from the other side with a thin iron bar.  Bulletin boards line the walls and are covered with rough sketches of property from the surrounding area.  Polished glass panes allow sunlight to stream into the waiting area, which is littered with low oak benches.

Several oak desks stand in neat rows behind a low railing that bisects the small room.  A thin gate allows the lone clerk to move between the two halves of the room and is latched from the other side with a thin iron bar.  Brass wall sconces illuminate the bulletin boards lining the walls, each covered with rough sketches of property from the surrounding area.  Polished glass panes allow moonlight to stream into the waiting area, which is littered with low oak benches.

title: [Ilyra's Fashions]
description: A crystal chandelier hangs from the high ceiling, casting a warm glow across the room.  Soft periwinkle velvet drapes frame the tall windows, and deep blue carpeting underfoot muffles all sound.  The high ceiling has been painted a soft blue and scudded with fluffy white clouds.

title: [Ilyra's Fashions]
description: Darkly stained maoral walls provide a rich backdrop for the goods displayed here.  A cloak rack rests against one wall of this spacious room.  A graceful archway leads deeper into the shop.

title: [The Cobbler's Shop]
description: The smell of leather fills the air, tinged with the sharper odors of oils and polishes.  Shoes and boots in the current styles line the shelves, and a workbench covered with scraps of leather stands at the back of the room.

title: [Morayna's Pet Shop]
description: A small bell above the entryway jingles each time a patron passes through the front door of the shop.  The square black tiles of the floor are laid out throughout the area, and a large oak counter sits off to the right of the doorway with a large sign hanging on its front.  A dark-haired woman stands behind the counter, keeping herself busy.

title: [Morayna's Pet Shop, Aquariums]
description: Aquariums of various sizes line the walls of the small room, the faint sound of water trickling in each of the tanks filling the air.  A large glass aquarium takes up most of the space in the center of the room, its interior filled to the brim with a variety of fish and aquatic creatures.  A small child sits next to the center aquarium as if she was the tiny sentry for the large underwater domain.

title: [Morayna's Pet Shop, Exotics]
description: The walls are littered with hooks and shelves covered in various tools of animal handling.  Stacks of falconry gloves and brushes are piled in one corner while a long oak counter sits in the other.  A large sign rests on top of the counter, and behind it a sales clerk that looks about his area of the shop.

title: [Morayna's Pet Shop, Dark Room]
description: The lighting in the room is very minimal; a few strategically placed votive candles on some shelves.  A large glass dome sits near the back of the room, its inside a flurry of activity and color from small specks of light.  A large sign rests near the dome, and a small slot is attached directly to the glass.

title: [Magical Burrow, Dervish Park]
description: The strange lack of snow goes right up to the western edge of Dervish Park, and several homefronts take advantage of it with their walkways directed towards the field.  Several planters line the edge of a small serene pond.  A few halflings sit on the bank fishing and basking in the warmth before returning to the cold outside the mithril gate.  Others stroll happily along carefully manicured pathways, enjoying the flora and fauna that thrive in this temperate haven.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
description: A massive clump of roots dangles down from the ceiling as the tunnel ends abruptly.  The tunnel slants downward as it twists to the south.  There are several holes along one wall, possibly the burrows of some small animal.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
description: The nondescript tunnel runs off into the darkness.  A dull thudding reverberates through the tunnel, shaking dirt clods loose from the ceiling which explode on the floor in syncopated time.  A thick cloud of dust obscures your vision.

title: [Twisting Tunnels]
description: A maze of tunnels leads away from this small chamber in all directions.  The low ceiling, poor lighting, and sudden twists and turns make it impossible to see far enough in any direction to get your bearings.  Some passageways lead only a few feet and dead end, while others twist and turn in odd directions before opening into another chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southwest, west, down
tags: peer northeast =~ /^Obvious exits: north, northeast, southwest, west$/

title: [Underground Tunnel]
description: Water has seeped down from above and run down the walls and floor only to freeze in the frigid air of the tunnel.  A thin sheet of ice covers everything, making the footing treacherous.  A cold draft blows from some unseen vent.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: A large hole on the north wall of the tunnel is blocked on the far side by a boulder.  It looks as though you might be able to wriggle through the space beneath it if you don't mind getting dirty.  If you minded getting dirty, you probably wouldn't be wandering around a rat's nest.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: Three tunnels converge at an underground crossroads.  There are no signs, only varying degrees of stench to guide you.  None of the options is very palatable.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: The rodents who made these tunnels were certainly industrious.  There are bite marks plainly visible on the ceiling, well out of the reach of even the largest of giant rats.  Come to think of it, some of those bite marks are awfully large.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: A pool of warm liquid all but blocks the tunnel.  It looks to be only a few inches deep, but the acrid smell of it prevents you from stepping in it to find out for sure. A swarm of large white flies seem elated at the presence of the little pool.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: Shredded paper, scraps of leather, dried grass, and some unidentifiable wispy stuff with an odd odor line the walls and ceiling.  Trash is piled against the walls, and round indentations show where rodents nuzzle together for their night's rest.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: The stench is unbearable.  You really don't want to linger overlong, lest the odor incapacitate you.  Rotting pieces of straw, pieces of fruit rind and some soft, dark pellets cover the tunnel floor. Together they make a squishy carpet that turns your stomach.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: Shrill rodent screeching echoes off the rough walls.  A great multitude of tracks cover the filthy ground.  Amongst the decaying debris you spot a small scrap of yellowed paper.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: A part-eaten halfling cadaver is partly propped up against the nearby wall.  Rotting pieces of flesh hang loosely on the skeletal frame.  The eye-sockets are empty, the halfling's eerie, empty stare perpetual.  The horrid stench threatens to overwhelm you.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: This central area is cleaner than the surrounding tunnels.  Relatively fresh straw covers the ground and in one corner is a tiny mound of partly digested cloudberry seeds.  The walls are old and full of small holes and cracks -- with a bit of effort you might be able to climb them.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: A natural ledge gives a clear view of a large chamber.  The ceiling is far above and the floor far below.  You might be able to make it down if you climbed over the edge.  But then who'd want to go down there?
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: Bits of fur and other filth drift about in the air along the dark tunnels.  You can't shake the feeling that as you stalk the rats, contagion stalks you.  Cold steel is no protection against the slow death of disease.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: Broken bones litter the floor, arranged in heaps and piled against the walls in the way straw and other debris are used in the chambers below.  Even a lich would turn up its nose at this place.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: The piles of bones are so high here that the tunnel is almost impassable.  They shift and crunch with every movement, and even when all else seems still.  There's no telling how many foul creatures are crawling around in this mess.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: The tunnels wind featurelessly through the earth.  For a moment you cannot recall which you entered through.  A cold sweat breaks out on your brow at the thought of being lost down here forever.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: The tunnel is very narrow here, and the air is almost warm.  The walls are suspiciously warm as well.  Tufts of mangy fur protrude from a few cracks on the western side and the unhealthy sound of breathing slips out as well.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: Bones, bones, and more bones.  Looking too closely makes your stomach turn summersaults, but you suspect not all the bones belonged to animals. In one corner some half-eaten intestines provide a bit of unwelcome variation.

Bones, bones, and more bones.  Looking too closely makes your stomach turn somersaults, but you suspect not all the bones belonged to animals.  In one corner, some half-eaten intestines provide a bit of unwelcome variation.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: Most of the roof has fallen in across the tunnel ahead.  The lifeless bodies of rats lie under the rubble.  A few bodies are imbedded in the empty space left in the ceiling.  The rats must be nesting in the earth around you.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: A crack in the ceiling lets a glimmer of light into the gloom.  The light draws a line along the ground like an arrow pointing upward.  Perhaps some kind of deity is suggesting the way out.

title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
description: Tightly packed brush and branches form a low ceiling.  A few icicles point downward, but the air is warmer than above.  Even allowing for the absence of wind, it shouldn't be this warm...not that anyone's likely to complain.

title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
description: Shattered paving stones mark where the well once ended.  A dark crack runs the length of the floor and beyond are a set of stairs curving down into the darkness.  Grating encircles you, where water must have once entered.  The floor is bone-dry now.

title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
description: Wide stairs of limestone curve down into the depths around a central shaft. The stairs go no further upward, but a dark opening leads somewhere.  A warm mist gathers around you like a cloud on a mountain top.

title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
description: The stone of the stairs and walls is pitted and flakes off easily.  Even so, the stairs are sturdy and seem to have stood for ages.  Glowing moss grows in occasional patches, illuminating the steps with a dull shine.

title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
description: The stairs corkscrew up and down into the gloom.  The air is cold near the rock walls, but warm currents force their way up the shaft out of the darkness.

title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
description: The stone steps grow warmer as they descend.  The passing of the numbing cold is a welcome change as insensitive feet can easily misstep, but with the new warmth comes another change less welcome.  The stairs are now covered with a thin layer of slime.

title: [Great Cavern, Flue]
description: A wide tunnel extends straight upwards.  Below, the tunnel slopes downward and off to one side a bit.  The ceiling of the flue is covered in thick glowing moss and a drop or two of water falls from above.  The air is still cool here, but well above freezing.

title: [Great Cavern, Flue]
description: The natural vent is wider than it is tall as it slopes lazily upwards.  Rough steps are carved periodically in the wall that serves as a floor, although they aren't strictly necessary.

title: [Great Cavern, Flue]
description: Moss grows so thickly around you that it is impossible to make out the stone behind it.  A constant flow of warm, moist air feeds the glowing moss.  It hangs down in clumps here and there, almost to the floor where another sort grows in rough clumps.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: A vast forest of rock formations stretches off in all directions.  The ceiling is low here, and a squat stalagmite hill leads up to the opening of a natural flue.  It would be pretty easy to scramble up it.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: A particularly large stalagmite squats here among the others.  The sides are awash with natural flowing stone deposits. Its tip merges with a stalactite above, resembling a giant apple core.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: The massive stalagmites stretch up toward the ceiling.  In most places you cannot make out their tips, as a cloud-like fog rolls about the cavern's ceiling.  Another layer of fog obscures your feet, hovering a yard off the floor.  Below and above the air is relatively clear.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: At the edge of the caverns thin sheets of stone cling between the rock formations and the walls.  Fog puddles between the stone dividers, making misty alcoves for the tired adventurer.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: A clearing opens unexpectedly among the columns of stone.  The strange double-layer of fog still obscures floor and ceiling, but you begin to get a sense of how truly large this cavern is.  In the open space, the charred remnants of a fire mar the stone floor beneath the mist.  It's impossible to say whether this was some battle, a camp, or perhaps a religious rite.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: The fog that rolls about the cavern in twin layers has grown so thick here that it is a single massive bank of dark grey.  Dim shapes of stone mark the edges of your vision like sentries.  Every now and then the fog lifts a bit, giving you a glimpse of what lies beyond.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: The vaulted ceiling disappears above you.  Through the mist that curls about the stalactites, you almost imagine you can see a glimmer of light creeping its way down from the surface above.  Fact or fancy, the skeleton of a snake entwines itself nearby, as if basking in the sun.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: An ancient landslide blocks the way to the north.  The scrabble of stones rests securely now under a glaze of mineral deposits.  A lone mushroom peeks up through a crack in the stone.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: The stalagmites and stalactites stand farther apart as the cavern opens to the south.  The cavern slopes downward and is quickly covered by a layer of mud and plant debris.  The thin layers of mist behind you are replaced by a thick yellow fog that shrouds the bog below you.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, northwest, down

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: The cavern continues to the west, but a dark fissure blocks any further progress.  Fumes pour forth in waves, and it takes a moment to recover from their impact.  Fortified with a deep breath and steeled to the reek, the stench is just bearable.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: To the east the floor of the cavern rises to meet the ceiling.  A dark vent may lead into another chamber beyond, but there is too much rubble to get near.  A small spring bubbles between the rocks and trickles off to the southwest.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: Shattered stone covers the ground, crunching underfoot and seeking to lame the unwary with its sharp edges.  Several columns lie in cracked sections where they seem to have been cast down to either side by some great force.  Whatever the force was, it came from the bog to the south.

title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
description: There must be a stone floor beneath the mist here, but it is covered by thick, oozing mud.  You might step down into it to find out how deep it goes, but a little voice tells you that you are better off keeping to the firmer spots.  Odd sounds reverberate through the dark mist, continuing too long to be echos.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, up

title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
description: The mud moves underneath the platform of vines on which you stand.  It may be some great slimy creature moving about, or it may be a river flowing below you.  In any event, a nearby stalagmite serves as a welcome crutch as the vines slip about unsteadily.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
description: The sheer west wall of the cavern looms darkly in the gray haze.  A great plant has grown against it, perhaps finding some solid purchase among the cracked stone.  The plant is like nothing you've ever seen, half mold and half palm.

title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
description: Fog drifts lazily across what could easily be a desolate swamp above ground, were it not for the spikes of stone rising out of the marsh.  Only a thick layer of decaying vines makes the bog passable.  Giant fireflies flit madly about just out of reach.

title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
description: The cavern narrows suddenly, its walls pressing inwards and the ceiling descending.  Fog swirls in from all sides and pours into the huge opening creating a curtain of mist.  Beneath your feet, the muck is definitely flowing slowly into the arch.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
description: Vines hang down from above in a shaggy curtain.  They are thick and tangled, and some bear an uncomfortable resemblance to hangmen's nooses.  Beneath your feet, thicker vines form a shifting platform across the mire.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: The west wall of the cavern rises suddenly out of the mist.  A thin layer of fog pours down like a waterfall, but there's no telling quite where the fog is coming from.  The stone is cool to the touch and covered with glowing moss.  To the south, the stone floor of the cavern is swallowed by a mushy bog.

title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
description: A swarm of giant fireflies crawls over the surface of the east wall of the cavern.  Even through the thick fog, their combined luminescence is painful to eyes grown accustomed to making do with fainter shadows and shades of gray.

title: [Subterranean Lake, Shore]
description: Before you stretches a vast underground lake.  The ceiling and the far shore are lost in darkness and mist, but there is enough water here to create small waves lapping at your feet.  As elsewhere in the great cavern, stalagmites rise out of the murky water.  Beyond them huddles the dark form of an island.

title: [Subterranean Lake, Shore]
description: To the east the waters of the bog flow slowly into the dark lake.  A rock outcropping gives you firm footing to one side and a clearer view of the island offshore.  Even from this vantage point, the rocky humps can only be dimly seen through the fog on the water.

title: [Subterranean Lake, Shore]
description: Masses of lichen cover the wall of the cavern and drape out into the stagnant water.  They cling among the stalagmites dotting the lake forming a natural bridge across its surface.  How sturdy it is is anybody's guess.

title: [Dark Fissure]
description: Two slabs of stone leave a few feet to squeeze between, and that at an angle that is sure to cause permanent injury to spine and hips if you don't keep moving.  Bursts of air from below carry a searing heat and a stench that would make Onar blanch.

title: [Gas Pocket]
description: This chamber is almost perfectly round except where it is marred by cracks and openings in floor and ceiling.  A powerful stench fills the nostrils.  Whatever foul wizard's breath gathers here, it must be light, for it seems to pool in the ceiling and spark into flame periodically.  The unnatural flashes of lighting illuminate the chamber fitfully.

title: [Cavern, Lichen Bridge]
description: Thick sheets of lichen lie across the surface of the water, bobbing and swaying with the slightest bit of movement.  The sheets also stretch vertically between the stalagmites that anchor them, obscuring any view of the lake beyond.

title: [Cavern, Lichen Bridge]
description: Incredible as it seems, the lichen is almost impervious to tearing.  Where a bit has been ripped away, you can make out another layer beneath.  For all you can tell, it may extend down to the bottom of the lake.  The bridge stretches away to the north and twists slightly as it heads south.

title: [Cavern, Lichen Bridge]
description: The lichen grows happily here, its surface slick with moss and mold.  The natural fabric is so thick and abundant that its excess folds almost block your way.  Still, with a good deal of pushing and scrambling, it's possible to make some progress.

title: [Mossy Hollow]
description: Tall stalagmites arch above your head, curving to almost meet above you.  They form a pair of rows, bound together with limestone deposits and moss.  You don't recall ever seeing stalagmites bent that way before.  To the north, a dark green opening leads to a lichen-lined tunnel.

title: [Subterranean Island, Large Hill]
description: Murky water stretches into the haze in all directions.  To the south the island curves away in a long rocky spit.  To the north a lower hill rests beyond a row of natural stepping stones.  Moss covers the island from one end to the other.  The top of the hill is split open revealing a mossy cave below.

title: [Subterranean Island, Large Hill]
description: The hillside slopes downward to a row of stepping stones to the north.  Offshore to the west a stone reef stretches away at a right angle.  Below it and to the south a dark shelf lies just below the surface of the lake.

title: [Subterranean Island, Stones]
description: An almost straight row of stepping stones rises out of the lake between the two hills of the island.  Whether they were placed here or are natural is difficult to say.  Moss covers the stones, but they are wide enough that there is little danger of falling into the muddy depths.

title: [Subterranean Island, Hillock]
description: This small hill rises forlornly just above the water's edge.  Jagged rocks surround a tiny inaccessible cove on the north shore.  There is something unsettling about the place.

title: [Subterranean Island, Rocky Spit]
description: The south end of the main hill drops away slowly to the water's surface.  Moss and lichen line the stones, making a springy carpet beneath the feet.  Overhead, great fireflies wheel and dart in the cool updrafts over the lake.

title: [Subterranean Island, Rocky Spit]
description: As the island comes to an end, the spit disappears into a line of stones.  They offer footing out into the lake a ways, a natural pier with no boats to dock.  Every now and then a small wave washes over them, making you think twice about heading too far out.  Who knows what manner of great reptilian beast might frequent this cavern?

title: [Raised Stone Path]
description: Small flat stones jut from the water, closely spaced such that even a halfling could scamper from rock to rock with no difficulty.  The water sloshes gently over the path now and again, briefly covering the stones then sliding effortlessly off the smooth surfaces.

title: [Raised Stone Path]
description: The water swells and ebbs in an easy, soft rhythm, occasionally slopping over the sides of the smooth stone path that pokes up from the clear, dark surface of the underground lake.  From time to time, a small splash breaks the water, ripples gliding away from the obvious point of disturbance.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A simple path of smooth, flat stones leads off into the water to the southwest, ending here on a clean, white sandy beach.  Small footprints lead in all directions, their paths crossing and recrossing dozens of times before leading off to the north.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A very large statue of a very squat halfling has been constructed on the tip of the island.  It stands upon a pedestal of polished pink coral, and is made completely from eroded chunks of seaglass.  In spite of the odd material used to create the artwork, the piece is quite detailed.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: Tall orange grass shaped in tight spirals covers the fine sand of this beach.  The spring-like plants bounce upward with every passing breeze, the motion scattering the many tiny golden butterflies that are flittering about the stalks.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A tiny toy boat bobs placidly near the dock, far too small to carry any passengers.  It is not attached with any rope, yet for some odd reason, it does not float off with the tide.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A slate-tiled path leads to a small keep that has been constructed entirely of garishly colored stones.  There seems to be no rhyme or reason to this structure, only madness.  The only visible entrance to this small castle is through a pink coral portcullis.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: The looming wall of a strange-looking keep has been decorated with an odd assortment of seashells and hollowed coconuts.  Perhaps it's just an illusion, but the pattern of shells suggests the shape of a tart.  A splintery wooden ladder has been dragged along the sand and discarded.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A massive clump of hand-crafted stone palm trees surrounds an artificial pond.  The water-like substance making up the pool is a translucent blue material and is utterly lifelike, looking as if it were frozen in time.  Two grooves are cut deep into the sand and lead off to the southwest.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A rickety pier has been built along the beachside and it leads off to provide a short walkway over the sea.  The wood is warped from the constant moisture in the air, and the entire structure looks unsafe at best.  A battered sign has been posted.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: The pier comes to a sudden and abrupt end with no guard rail or warning.  The broken and cracked bits of plank point to either storm damage or just plain rot.

The pier comes to a sudden and abrupt end with no guard rail or warning.  The broken and cracked bits of plank point to either storm damage or just plain rot.  A watery vortex churns dangerously in the waters just below the pier, its center crackling with energy.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: Odd tremors at your feet reveal the fearsome power of the lake.  Large waves crash onto the beach with a thunderous roar, each new wave exploding in a spray of white surf as it pounds into the trembling sand.  The water lingers for but a moment before the water recalls its violent probe.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: The pounding surf beats upon the shore with monotonous intensity, seeking nothing more than to make its presence felt.  The constant slap of the waves has dragged off most of the sand within the area, and the slow erosion has revealed the tip of a buried object made of obsidian.  It is impossible to discern what exactly is protruding from the sand.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A shallow tidepool filled with an assortment of bizarre critters sits amidst a congregation of smooth round stones.  The crystal-clear water ripples softly, the tiny waves not seeming to bother the sea life within.  Along the bottom of the pond, a sea star slowly glides along, each of its five arms wildly different.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: The rear of the keep is constructed of thick palm fronds and hardened mud.  A graceful tower of seashells has been built on one end and is topped with a huge flag that is fluttering overhead in the breeze.  The flag is embroidered with a skull and crossbones overlaying a field of frosted tarts.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: This portion of the island is covered with white sand and black stones.  The rocks seem to be scattered about randomly, but oddly all of them are exactly the same size.  There is no telling what they are made of, as the material of the stone is very unfamiliar.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A tiny hill of stones is piled at the base of a tall tree with thin ropelike leaves.  The plant has the trunk of a palm tree, but any resemblance ends at the tendrils growing from its top.  Round orbs similar to the stones at the base are attached to the upper trunk.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: Tiny plantlike eyestalks protrude from the sand and quickly whirl in unison with every passing motion.  Closer inspection reveals slitted golden feline eyeballs at the end of the stalks, providing strong argument against the plant theory.  The sand seems to shift and undulate underfoot, despite the lack of any breeze.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A rusting metallic pyramid stands on an emerald green marble platform, nearly blocking the width of the beach.  No doors or openings are apparent in the structure, and its four walls are etched with mysterious glyphs.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: Huge seabirds circle overhead, their raucous squawking filling the air as they idly glide above the beach.  From time to time, one will swoop into the lake and come up with a wriggling fish trapped within its beak.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A quiet inlet of water intrudes upon this portion of the island, a large sandbar just offshore sheltering the lagoon from the rough offshore waves.  Giant crystal stakes topped with sapphire blue globes have been pounded into the sand, perfectly equidistant from each other.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A look to the cavern ceiling above reveals a few odd rippling masses of lichen overhead.  The huge growth glows with an eerie green tint, and the illumination creates some very odd shadows upon the ground.  All in all, it's a rather serene spot save for the half-buried skeleton protruding from the sand.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: A low white picket fence completely surrounds the lone flat area amidst the many sand dunes upon this beach.  A tiny sign has been erected within the walled-off area, and seems to be far better preserved than the warping and flaking painted wood of the fence.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: Large fins slice through the water, circling a tiny raft that bobs in the waves just offshore.  A huddled shape is visible on the raft, but the fog and spray of the surf make it difficult to see clearly.  An occasional shrieking pierces the air, the noise drowned out by the pounding waves.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: Grossly misshapen crabs scramble along the rocks of this shoreline, scattering at even the slightest disturbance.  Moving far too fast to catch, the shelled critters have numerous cracks and crevices to hide in.  A jagged purple growth of coral seems to be the favored spot to hide for the speedy crustaceans.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: The entire shore of this beachfront is made up of brightly colored tiny glass marbles, each with its own unique design.  The odd rounded stones dance about madly with each new wave, the clashes creating a rather pleasant bell-like music.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: As eclectic and bizarre as this keep might look, it still bears all of the standard protection that any fortress might provide its owner.  Passage to or from the outside of the structure is guarded by a sturdy glaes portcullis that has been colored in the wildest pink imaginable.  Numerous strands of colorful seashells that have been suspended from the ceiling are all that bar the path into the keep itself.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Embedded into the ceiling is a massive growth of multi-colored coral that glows softly with an eerie phosphorescent light.  From time to time, a thin, wiry tendril slowly peeks out from one of the many orifices of the coral and telescopes outward as if searching for something.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: An impossible stack of tomes and books piled floor to ceiling leads to a small opening overhead.  Most of the titles are far too worn to be readable, but the few that still peek through the dust of time all bear some reference to wizardry.  It doesn't look as if the mound of ancient leather-bound volumes would hold much weight, yet they are covered by tiny footprints.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: There is no apparent reason for the odd bowl-like depression that cracks the floor tiles of this passage, but perhaps the ominous sound of rushing water coming from beneath the keep lends a clue.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Four flat boulders dangerously support a legless desk and provide what looks to be a very unsafe method of reaching the upper level.  Considering how badly the desk is wobbling just from the faint breeze, it's hardly going to be an easy climb.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A large barrel sitting directly in the middle of the floor makes it necessary to veer to either side in order to pass.  Oddly, a rhythmic ticking that sounds much like a muffled metronome comes from within the sealed container.  At the base of this barrel, a small crack has allowed a tiny pile of greyish powder to spill out.  The faint scent of sulphur touches the air.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: One of the floor tiles clearly stands out from the rest, as it is both a different size and color than the others.  Directly above this tile, a long narrow slot has been cut into the ceiling with symmetrical precision.  Something deep within the opening glints from the flickering light of the wall sconces.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Leaning up against one of the walls is a long slender plank.  The wood is cracked from top to bottom and it doesn't look particularly sturdy.  Near this makeshift ladder, one of the roundish stones used in the wall has been scrawled on with some crude graffiti.  It's difficult to make out, but it looks as if it might be a picture or drawing of some sort.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Most of the floor tiles of this passage are warped, and from their gnarled shape it appears that they have melted.  A few discolored splotches that stain what's left of the remaining floor suggest that something rather nasty was spilled onto the tile, perhaps some odd potion or concoction.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A stack of rotting crates piled in one corner appears to be an unsafe method of gaining the upper level.  The wood is pitted and moldy, numerous splinters and cracks marring the surface of the wood.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: The irregularly shaped stones that were used to construct these walls are marred by a series of deep gouges that score the surface from top to bottom.  The marks look animal-like, but it's difficult to imagine what sort of beast might have the power to leave such jagged cuts in the sturdy rock.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: The amount of workmanship put into the eroded seaglass floor of this entry is mindboggling.  Painstakingly laid with meticulous care, the faded pastel glass forms the mosaic of an overflowing cream-filled tart.  The room itself is quite barren, although smoke and mist can be seen through an archway leading north.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A pulsating green and yellow mist fills this room, making it nearly impossible to see anything further than your own hand.  There doesn't appear to be any reason for the fog or the slowly dancing lights within it, but it does bear a rather pleasant light citrus smell.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Banners of bright green silk suspended from each wall are so clean and pressed they look as if they might have been hung yesterday.  There is not a trace of dust or age on any of the hangings, and the embroidered pastries that adorn each of them have been stitched so expertly, it almost looks as if one could pluck them off and eat them.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A very small peephole covered with clear glass has been set into the inner wall but is placed so that most people would have to stoop to their knees in order to use it.  Somebody with a wry sense of humor has painted a huge arrow from the ceiling leading down to the peephole in bright yellow paint.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: The outer wall is blackened and scorched so severely that the heat that blasted the fitted stone must have been tremendous.  Curiously, the damage is limited to a very small area no bigger than a melon.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: An incredible contraption of glass, wires and gears has evidently withstood the decay of time and continues to function quite smoothly.  The gnashing of the metal joints and occasional loud clang unfortunately give no clue to what the device might actually do.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Protruding from one of the stone walls is the wooden haft of an axe.  The weapon has been driven so deep into the stone that only the tiniest glint of steel blade peeks out from the wall.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Two glowing amber gems partially embedded into the walls provide illumination for this passageway.  The opaque surface of the stones glitter wildly as if a swarm of tiny fireflies might be nesting within.  Interestingly, it radiates a great deal of heat as well.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Three garish wooden masks hang on the walls, each of them adorned with semi-precious stones for eyes.  The wall hangings are quite crude, the craftmanship such that they must have been made by an artisan of little skill.  Interestingly, the wood used to carve the pieces does not look native to the island.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Covering every possible inch of wall space are shelves filled to capacity with an incredible assortment of vials, jars, and flasks.  Some of the substances within the containers look somewhat familiar, but many more hold liquids and powders that are completely unrecognizable.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Shimmering silver glyphs painted on the floor and wall form three very distinct patterns.  Each of the sigils is extremely detailed, and, considering their placement, they seem oddly unworn.  Directly above these etchings, the ceiling looks quite discolored.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: An eerie stillness encompasses this passage, and something in the architecture muffles any and all noises substantially.  An odd twisted rod of polished metal dangles from the ceiling, the device tipped with a tiny, crystal globe.  Other than an occasional pulse from the small sphere, it doesn't appear to have any purpose.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Odd gurgling noises emanate from somewhere rather close and sound much like a pot of boiling stew.  The sweet smell of strawberries is thick in the air as well, and, while not unpleasant, it's a rather odd scent to be wafting down a stone hallway.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Hundreds of identical, smooth glass eyeballs completely cover this passageway.  The oddities move in unison with any motion, continuing to track the movement until it ceases.  The marble-like spheres are uncannily lifelike.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Oddly, set into the floor is a huge iron door banded with brass.  Considering its strange placement, it might lead to a lower level in the keep.  Perhaps crafted as some bad joke, a multitude of doorknobs, handles and latches cover the door.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A small protrusion on the outside of the keep provides an ample perch for the small orange bird roosting upon it.  The beak of the animal is nearly as large as its body, and it is rather comical to say the least.  The feathered critter doesn't seem to be terribly concerned with any of the outside noise or distractions.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: The crystalline bridge spanning the top of the keep is a fragile contrast to the outlandish tower it leads to.  Crafted entirely of rose-colored crystals, it looks as if the slightest weight might shatter the entire construction, yet the solid coral spire it holds must weigh tons.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, down

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Four arrow slits have been cut into the tower wall, but their placement is much too low for the average person to use.  As low as the slots might be though, it hasn't stopped the seabirds of the island from using them for nesting.  Each of the holes is filled with a woven mixture of dried grass, palm fronds and dead seaweed.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A delicate bridge constructed of rose-colored crystal spans the entire keep and leads to a garish tower of coral and shells.  Light glittering off the bridge's glassy surface reflects so brightly that it is difficult to look at for any length of time.  The bridge has been built with no visible seams or flaws and appears crafted from a single gemstone of gigantic proportion.

A delicate bridge constructed of rose-colored crystal spans the entire keep and leads to a garish tower of coral and shells.  Light glittering off the bridge's glassine surface reflects so brightly that it is difficult to look at for any length of time.  The bridge has been built with no visible seams or flaws and appears crafted from a single gemstone of gigantic proportion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, down

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A large chunk of stone is missing from the top of one of the walls, and it looks very much as if some giant beast might have bitten it off.  Several jagged pieces of ivory are embedded into the damaged stone and don't appear to be part of the original construction.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: The shattered remains of a tiny catapult lean against one wall, the contraption clearly no longer capable of doing anything more than gathering rust.  The salty sea air has further corroded the device, all of the metallic pieces fully covered with a thick coating of reddish grunge.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: It could be just an illusion, but a sinuous serpent-like shape the size of a large schooner circles the waters near the shore.  The distance to the lake and the distracting reflection of the water's surface makes it difficult to pinpoint the oddity, but whatever it is, it continues to surface and descend into the sea of this cavern with alarming regularity.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Several iron pots heavily stained with a blackish residue top the wall and have been set into wooden dowels to allow them to be easily tipped.  The containers aren't terribly large however, hardly bigger than a child's cookpot.  The spillage from whatever might have been in these miniature cauldrons has left the walls below them coated with a thick dried sludge.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: The view from this vantage point is quite spectacular, allowing an unimpeded line of sight to both the island and the underground sea surrounding it.  Several tiny specks far off on the lake show that this is not the only island hiding in this massive underground cavern.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A stout breeze ripples along the walkway, the brisk air filled with the heady tang of saltwater.  Considering how near the frozen town of Icemule is to this cavern, one would expect the climate to be considerably less comfortable.  There is little trace of winter's cold bite about this island.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Tiny barbs of shining steel jutting out from the wall present a formidable and painful challenge to those who would attempt to scale the barrier from the outside.  A few bits of tattered cloth still attached to one of the spikes flutter softly in the wind, unable to escape their painless impalement.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Extremely loud howling echoes off the outside walls of the keep, clearly coming from a large band of monkeys who are assaulting the tower in earnest.  An amazing assortment of rotted fruits, garbage, and numerous chunks of other unidentifiable substances are being heaved over the walls by the excited animals.  Luckily, the aim of the agitated chimps is a bit off.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Piled near what might have been a small slingshot is a small stack of tiny round stones.  The contraption no longer bears any rubber straps to make it work, the material having long rotted away, but it does look to be usable if repaired.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A towering pinnacle constructed of brightly colored coral and oddly shaped shells rises well above the crystal bridge.  The garish structure presents a highly visible landmark for those who might be down below on the island.  It doesn't appear to have much of a purpose, but it is quite a work of art.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: This portion of the wall was clearly damaged and repaired at some point, most of the stones of the crenellated barrier not matching any in the rest of the keep.  In fact, the material used in repairing the wall doesn't look much like stone at all, rather, it appears to be several irregular pieces of opaque glass that have been marred with clawlike scratches and scrapes.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: This cramped and claustrophobic room is nothing more than four walls.  A ladder leads downward, but there doesn't seem to be any doors or exits back into the keep.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: This room is nothing more than a tiny closet.  With the exception of the ornately framed mirror that is nearly covering one of the walls, it is completely barren.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A granite walkway both surrounds and bisects a huge square pit filled with cages and contraptions.  The only way down appears to be two rope ladders on the opposite side of these sunken rooms.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Pounded into the wall in a triangular pattern are three huge spikes.  A tiny bit of severed cord dangles from one of them, but the small remnant of rope reveals little of its purpose.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: The walkway vanishes into a swirling mist to the south, and it is totally impossible to see anything past the impenetrable fog.  A few sparkles of light dance within the haze, changing colors as they move within the spiralling substance.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Bare earth peeks out from several gaps in the structure, lending evidence that someone or something has been picking away at it.  Whatever it was that caused this damage didn't seem to bother the walkway though, as it remains intact and unmarred.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A thick plume of murky black smoke fills the passageway, its source a violently shaking contraption below.  The haze dissipates fairly quickly, but the unpleasant scent of tar lingers in the air.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Deeply set into the stone wall is a large amber globe, numerous others clearly visible about the cellar.  Each of these devices glow with a soft yellowish light and appear to be all that keeps this underground area from total darkness.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Shrieks and shrill howls echo off the walls of the sunken pit, the sounds coming from within one of the cages below.  The screeches are bad enough, but the rhythmic pounding of whatever is trapped within the prison is far more annoying.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Covering the ceiling is a thick, brown fur that bears considerable resemblance to a moss or fungus.  Unlike moss however, the irregular shape above ripples and undulates.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
