description: A thick rope of braided palm fronds knotted around a sturdy iron loop leads downward into the pit.  Parts of the rope look chewed on and frayed, but it still seems to be in serviceable condition.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: One of the walls is discolored with a rather large splotch.  The shape of the stain suggests something was hurled into the stone, then squashed like an overripe melon.  The stain has long since dried, but a few pieces of short brownish hair are still stuck within the cracks of the stone.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Securely bolted into the walls below this walkway are several thick iron chains.  The links on the ends are bent and broken, whatever beast they may have imprisoned evidently far stronger than the metal.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: The southern wall is slightly discolored compared to the rest of the construction, and while the stones and brick look similar to the those nearby, they never seem to look exactly the same when looked at for a second time.  There is something quite odd about the barrier to say the least.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: The walkway narrows considerably as half of it is missing for some reason.  What's left of the stone ledge is only wide enough for single file travel, and even the smallest weight on the path shakes a few more pieces free.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: This portion of the path is barely wide enough to travel upon.  Any slip or stumble promises a nasty spill to the pit below for those careless enough not to pay attention.  A trail of slime on the stone floor indicates that something odd has passed this way.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Pitted and stained stone covers the floor, the damage quite old.  A frenzied commotion below disturbs the silence, clearly coming from a badly rattling cage.  Something is trying very hard to get out.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A fitted stone wall blocks passage to the north.  This vantage overlooks a large divided pit filled with devices and cages.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Etched into the stone is a series of several odd glyphs surrounded by a jagged square border.  They aren't recognizable as anything familiar and might be anything from an intricately mystical sigil to directions out of the cellar.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A blinding white light covers a good deal of the northern wall, but oddly, it's doing very little to illuminate the cellar.  From this vantage point, it is possible to see both sides of the sunken pit below.  Polished tables in one of the rooms suggest that it is used for research or experimentation.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: The amber globe that is inset into the wall here has burnt out, or its magic has failed.  In either case, this part of the cellar is considerably darker than the rest, and perhaps it's an illusion, but it seems colder as well.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: The stone walkway comes to an abrupt end, swallowed by the sizeable black void in the northern wall.  A few low growls echo out from within the darkness, revealing that it may not be completely empty.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Smeared on the wall is a long trail of slime.  The dim light of the passageway glistens off the shiny substance, the goo evidently very slow to dry.  A few bits of cracked shell are scattered on the path, but if they came from a snail, it was far larger than most.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Coming from somewhere nearby, a faint cackling laugh disturbs the silence of the path.  The source of the noise is impossible to pinpoint, but there doesn't seem to be anything amusing about the gloom of this cellar.  Even a touch of sunlight would be welcome.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A gleaming pole of silvery metal reaches from ceiling to floor and allows easy access into the room beneath.  It looks to be wedged quite securely into the stone above and below, and should be able to hold the weight of even the heaviest adventurer.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A dried out glob of some unidentifiable substance rests directly in the center of the walkway.  It resembles stone, but the bizarre surface of the object suggests it might be something other than a rock.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Dug into the stone wall is a perfectly circular hole, its interior coated with a shiny reflective glaze.  The mirror-like finish is clear of any flaws or blemishes, but the rounded nature of the hole warps any images it reflects.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Thick black smoke belches up from a large metal vat in the pit below.  Clearly, the cauldron is not empty.  Whatever might be inside the huge iron pot is hidden from view by the black haze, but an occasional gurgling noise lends evidence to something brewing within.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: An elegant stairway crafted from handcarved chunks of pink coral leads downward into the sunken pit.  One of the stairs is badly cracked and chipped, but is easily enough skipped as the distance between each of the steps is quite small.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Deep claw marks in the walls lead from the floor up to the ceiling, terminating with a dozen or more gouges scratched overhead.  It is quite clear however, the stone was far too formidable to allow escape to whatever created the marks.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Clearly this cellar could use a bit more ventilation, as the air is old and stale.  There are no visible openings or windows, and the entire area is quite claustrophic to say the least.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: The lack of a handrail makes this narrow ledge extremely dangerous.  Clearly the builder wasn't concerned about safety.  This treacherous spot provides an excellent view of the pit below though.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: The buckled floor along this portion of the walkway makes it a considerable chore to pass.  Tiny halfling-size footprints peek out from the exposed earth where the stone has cracked, the marks quite fresh.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Several large vats have been overturned and whatever was contained within them is now nothing more than a few stains on the floor.  One cauldron remains upright, however, and is issuing forth huge gouts of black smoke from its madly bubbling brew.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Placed with precision about the room are several tables bearing thick leather straps.  Each table is perfectly spotless.  If they have been used recently,  considerable care was taken to clean up any mess that was made.  The floor, however, is not nearly as pristine and is covered with splotches and stains.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Bolted into the wall are several thick iron chains, every last one shattered so badly that the links are torn wide open.  Scattered about the floor are a few ruined and warped steel manacles, clearly far too weak to hold whatever they may have imprisoned originally.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Three huge cages dominate this room, two of which are empty.  The third, made of sturdy iron, imprisons a dangerous looking beast.  A smoke-spewing metal contraption rattles nearby, and although its purpose isn't clear, it's quite obviously doing something.

title: [Thurfel's Island]
description: Resting upon the pebbly terrain of this beach is a gigantic grey geode the size of a large cart.  It is cracked completely in half revealing large clusters of red spinel crystals.  Oddly, the gems within the huge stone do not appear to be natural in origin.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Courtyard]
description: Tucked away from the bustle of town, the courtyard is awash with the warm light that streams through the manor's windows.  Cascades of cool water glint in the moonlight as they tumble down from a white marble fountain.  Flower-laden gardens are nestled under trees, curving around benches, and running alongside the creek stone path that leads to a large manor.  Above the manor's door hangs a brilliant red banner emblazoned with the head of a great black wolf.

Tucked away from the bustle of town, the courtyard is surrounded by a tall stone wall brimming with honeysuckle and yellow trumpet vines.  Cascades of cool water tumble down from a marble fountain into a shallow pool.  Flower-laden gardens are nestled under trees, curving around benches, and running alongside the creek stone path that leads to a large manor.  Above the manor's door hangs a brilliant red banner emblazoned with the head of a great black wolf.

Tucked away from the bustle of town, the courtyard is awash with the warm light that streams through the manor's windows.  Cascades of cool water glint in the moonlight as they tumble down from a marble fountain.  Flower-laden gardens are nestled under trees, curving around benches, and running alongside the creek stone path that leads to a large manor.  Above the manor's door hangs a brilliant red banner emblazoned with the head of a great black wolf.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Interior]
description: Just south of here lies the caravansary green, an oasis of grass amidst the dust of the beast pens and the caravaners' tents.  Beyond it to the south stands a row of merchant wagons in the shadow of the stockade's southern wall.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west

title: [Northern Caravansary, NW Corner]
description: A solid, log building has been built in the northwest corner of the palisade.  Split log steps lead up to the heavy, brass-bound door.  A brightly painted sign depicting a diamond the size of a melon hangs above the door.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Pens]
description: Split rails form a yierka pen, a rolton pen, and a mule pen to hold the beasts of burden used by the caravans.  A low log building takes up the corner of the stockade to the north, and a black and white tent has been pitched just south of the pens.

title: [Northern Caravansary, West Wall]
description: A nonagonal tent with alternating black and white panels stands here, a little too close to the beast pens for the comfort of anyone with a normal sense of smell.

title: [Northern Caravansary, SW Corner]
description: Stacked beneath and about a merchant wagon are scores of barrels and hogsheads, all tightly sealed and bound together with ropes.  A crudely fashioned sign depicting a pile of animals with 'X's' for eyes hangs above the door that the steps lead up to.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Wagon Row]
description: Numerous tarps, stretched from the side of the merchant wagon and pegged to the turf, make this look less like a wagon and more like a tent grown wild.  Stairs emerge from beneath a low, canvas awning.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Wagon Row]
description: Two large wagons parked side-by-side dominate this area, with oversized hoops that stretch the crimson canvas into a common roof for both.  The sound of laughter, loud voices and the clink of glass on glass coming from within make a sign unnecessary.  The stairs leading up to the wagon's door look wider and sturdier than those of the neighboring wagons.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Wagon Row]
description: An oversized, boiled leather cuirass hangs on a post-and-crossbeam here, close alongside the steps leading up to this merchant wagon.  The dun canvas of the wagon's roof bears the armorers' guild symbol, a grey cuirass on a circle of blue.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Wagon Row]
description: A merchant wagon has been parked almost in the corner of the caravansary, its grey canvas roof bearing the sword-and-anvil symbol of the weaponcrafters guild.  Worn steps lead up to the rear of the wagon where a wooden sword has been bolted alongside the door.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Northern Caravansary, East Row]
description: Looking like an ivory pyramid in a setting of green, this tent of undyed canvas is marked as an herbalist's by the gardens planted around its base.  A pair of loam-filled barrel halves stand to either side of the tent's entrance.

title: [Northern Caravansary, East Row]
description: A weather-worn hide tent has been pitched by a firepit, and beyond it a row of tents is visible close under the east wall.  Caravan hands seem to choose tents almost at random upon arrival and depart with their bedrolls without a backward glance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Northern Caravansary, East Row]
description: Leaning severely to one side, the multicolored tent standing here appears to have been set up by someone who never set one up before.  Stitched together from odd-sized pieces of red, black, green, blue, and white silk, it's a small wonder that the thing actually stands erect.  A low log building sits close to the stockade wall just to the north, and further south stands the eastern-most of a string of merchant wagons.

title: [Northern Caravansary, NE Corner]
description: A squat log building has been built into the northeast corner of the palisade.  Split log steps lead down to the heavy, iron-banded door that is half below ground level.  A pair of burly dwarves stand to either side of the steps, suspiciously eyeing each person as they come and go.  A brightly painted sign depicting a golden pouch bulging with coins hangs above the door.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Green]
description: Four large dogwood trees stand at the northern, eastern, southern and western corners of this patch of grass, forming a refuge from the dust and odors of the pens to the west and the smoke from a campsite to the east.  A row of merchant wagons lines the southern wall of the palisade.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Northern Caravansary, SE corner]
description: Surrounded by a scattering of haymaker's mushrooms, a green-striped tent sags forlornly in the perpetual shadow of the stockade's southeast corner.

title: [Caravaners' Tents]
description: A dull orange tent stands here, the richer color along its seams suggesting that it was once a vibrant orange.

title: [Caravaners' Tents]
description: The forest green color of the tent here matches that of the grass, here in the shade of the east wall.  Almost brand new, it looks sturdy, weatherproof, and expertly pitched.

title: [Caravaners' Tents]
description: A fair-sized, faded red tent has been pitched between the herbalist's tent and the stockade's east wall, making it difficult to get past to the tents further south along the wall.

title: [Caravaners' Tents]
description: An ample-bellied halfling snoozes peacefully in front of a bright yellow tent.  Even prone, his belly's comfort has required the unbuttoning of his gravy-stained vest.  Likely worn out from having to push himself away from the table, he snores quietly, oblivious to the goings-on around him.

title: [Caravaners' Tents]
description: A sandy brown tent stands close by the east wall of the stockade.  The tent doesn't look new, but it does look better than most you've seen around here.

title: [Caravaners' Tents]
description: A toothless old caravaner sits cross-legged in front of a sky blue tent, sawing tunelessly on a travel-battered rebec.

title: [Caravaners' Tents]
description: A red-and-white striped tent fills the gap between the half-buried log bankinghouse and the stockade's east wall.

title: [Clenchfist Bros. Banking, Entry]
description: The log walls of this long, narrow entryway are unadorned and give the room a closed-in feeling.  Split log steps are visible just outside the southern doorway.

title: [Clenchfist Bros. Banking, Lobby]
description: Lit by plain iron lanterns, the unfinished modwir boards of the teller's counter, rough-sawn planks of the floor, bare log walls and drab garb of the dour dwarven teller make it obvious that no extra expense or effort has been spent here to dress the place up.  Nothing more has been done than was needed to provide a secure place for the exchange of silvers.

title: [Stonebiter's Gemporium, Entry]
description: The log walls of this long, narrow entry, along with heavy doors at both ends and a kill-hole above the northern doorway, leave little doubt as to this room's purpose.  Split log steps are visible just outside the southern doorway.

title: [Stonebiter's Gemporium, Lobby]
description: Footfalls, voices and lanternlight reflect off the polished brass and steel panels of the gemshop's wainscoting, making it a bright and noisy room.  Behind the low, steel-clad counter, Tolruk Stonebiter rests atop a three-legged stool -- jeweller's loupe, black velvet pad and pan balance ready to appraise the next gem or piece of jewelry.

title: [Stonebiter's Gemporium]
description: A steel-framed display case with clear glaes panes takes up most of this small room.  Within it, pieces of jewelry and unmounted gems lie strikingly displayed on a bed of black velvet.

title: [Small Wonder Clerics' Tent]
description: A polished modwir weapon rack and a long thanot display case fill most of the tent, leaving little room for customers, though there is one central aisle with room enough for a paunchy priest.  The items on display all gleam with the pride of their maker.

title: [Pets No More]
description: Taking up less than a quarter of the length of the wagon, this small room contains only a short, butcher block counter with Mettys Rundig standing behind it.  A curtained doorway to the left of the counter leads further into the wagon.

title: [Finders-Sellers Pawnshop]
description: Wooden bins are lined up along the canvas partition behind Brenteera Zule's counter.  Silvers paid out come from a small chest resting in her lap, and each item pawned gets tossed into the appropriate bin without her eyes leaving the counter in front of her.

title: [Killin's Thirsty Work Tavern]
description: Light filtering through the red canvas of the roof and red-lensed nomad lanterns wash everything with a lurid glow.  The polished fel bar, resting on stacked casks, runs along the east wall, and bottles of every shape and color line the two shelves behind it.  Pedestal tables of various heights and ledges along the wagon sides provide rests for tankards and mugs, but with such cramped quarters there's no sign of anything to sit on.

title: [You Bet Your Life Armory]
description: Narrow tables laden with an assortment of armors, all obviously used, run along both sides of the wagon.  Runtahk Schen stands behind the hinged, fold-down counter, smiling pleasantly.  A pair of straw-filled dummies stand to either side of the entrance, one sans armor and quite severely hacked up, the other sporting badly cut and dented armor, but appearing otherwise intact.

title: [Weapons With a History]
description: Sword hilts and weapon hafts sprout from open barrels that line the walls in this small room.  A board laid across two barrels serves as a counter for the transaction of business.  A narrow, curtained doorway to the right of the counter leads further into the wagon.

title: [Imaera's Bounty Herbalist Tent]
description: Hanging bunches of drying herbs force all but the shortest customers to stoop.  Appearing quite at home among the dangling obstacles, Marijon Pestlethwaite hums quietly as she works her way through the tent, checking the bundles, taking some down and hanging others up to dry.

title: [A Weatherworn Hide Tent]
description: A single, large, recently-used bedroll takes up half the tent.  From its size you'd guess that it either belongs to a couple of individuals of Giantkin lineage, or to three or four lesser individuals.  In either case, messing with it seems unlikely to produce any positive result.

title: ['Tain't Much Magic Tent]
description: The enclosed atmosphere of this small tent is laden with the greasy odor of spiced rolton jerky.  A tangled heap of blankets has been shoved into a back corner, and a pock-faced young Dark Elf slouches on a three-legged stool behind a display case and an open strongbox resting on crates.

title: ['Tain't Much Magic, Consignment]
description: A spiced rolton jerky odor mixed with a mild vanilla scent overwhelms the area.  Along the tent's dusky edges, dim lanterns light the way.

title: ['Tain't Much Magic, Emporium]
description: A strong vanilla scent pervades the air, overwhelming the faint aroma of jerky.  A small, overturned flask lies on the ground, giving a hint as to the origin of some of the smells.

title: [Green Striped Tent]
description: A pair of wooden-framed canvas cots stand along either side of the tent.  Neither has a blanket or pillow, but they do look stable and sturdy.

title: [Dull Orange Tent]
description: A canvas groundcloth provides a clean floor in this tent.  A pile of plush sleeping-furs fills the back half of the tent, suggesting that either someone left without them, or this tent is already being used.

title: [Forest Green Tent]
description: The tent poles still have that freshly-sanded gleam, and the canvas still holds the faint odor of green dye.  Even the ground looks like it hasn't had a tent pitched over it before.  This may be the nicest tent in the caravansary.

title: [Faded Red Tent]
description: A pair of straw-filled canvas pallets lie on the ground, stained and dirty, but probably softer than the ground itself.

title: [Bright Yellow Tent]
description: No one's left a thing behind in this tent.  Aside from matted grass and a couple trampled plantains, the place is empty.

title: [Sandy Brown Tent]
description: A threadbare Tyrecean carpet covers the ground.  It must get aired out frequently, since it looks relatively clean and doesn't smell of mildew.

title: [Sky Blue Tent]
description: This tent is empty, except for a dented canteen that hangs from one of the tent poles.

title: [Red-and-White Striped Tent]
description: Set up by someone with more time and conscientiousness than most, this tent has a raised modwir plank floor.  It's definitely cleaner and drier than the bare ground.

title: [Curious Thrak Table]
description: Scented smoke drifts upwards from a low brass lamp, curling toward the ceiling before dissipating.  The table top is etched with letters in several different styles, from roughly hewn initials to lightly flowing elven lettering.  Carved into the table is the phrase: "R. Thrak is a big fat...."  The scrawl ends in a dark brown stain resembling a thrak shaped like a question mark.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: Entering this stretch of the tunnel, you notice a shifting blob of some sort on one wall.  As you approach, the mound breaks up into hundreds of bugs, running for cover.  Left behind is what appears to be some type of skull, imbedded in the wall!  It's hard to even imagine the force it would take to do this.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: There is a small bit of sludgy water pouring out of one of the many small pipes.  It has collected into a dark slimy looking pool here, with a small trickle of filth oozing on down the tunnel.  There is just enough room to pick your way around it as you continue on deeper into the earth.

title: [Abandoned Sewer]
description: The air smells unbelievably fresh, and you inhale great gasping breaths, having nearly forgotten what fresh air smells like.  You seem to have reached the end of the tunnel, as it empties out into a large underground river.  The slope is quite steep, and the small stream of sludge would be racing along, if it was any less thick.

title: [One-eyed Thrak Table]
description: The largest knot hole you have ever seen is right here on this table.  It has been filled with a chunk of modwir that doesn't match the rough pattern on the table top.  A pale lace doily has been placed on the knot hole, but fails to cover it entirely.

title: [The Magi's Stave]
description: Long wooden shelves fill the back portion of the shop and a large counter sits in the center.  Several unfinished runestaves sit in holders behind the counter in a line, their wood shavings littering the floor.  Bright sunlight streams in through the front window of the room, the shafts of light dancing about the oak floorboards.

Long wooden shelves fill the back portion of the shop and a large counter sits in the center.  Several unfinished runestaves sit in holders behind the counter in a line, their wood shavings littering the floor.  Pale moonlight filters in through the front window of the room, the ghostly light dancing about the oak floorboards.

title: [Bagorom's Cartage]
description: Exposed oak rafters line the ceiling and house large crates adorned with packing labels written in various tongues.  Resting at an angle over a low counter is a wide rung ladder, its hooked end binding it to track upon one of the rafters.  A low bookshelf is set behind the counter holding journals and neatly stacked shipping documents.  Dusty windows set to either side of the entryway allow a bit of sunlight to stream into the room.

Exposed oak rafters line the ceiling, their depths shrouded in inky blackness.  Resting at an angle over a low counter is a wide rung ladder, its hooked end binding it to track upon one of the rafters.  The low bookshelf that is set behind the counter houses a small brass lamp, which illuminates some journals and neatly stacked shipping documents that rest upon its shelves.  Dusty windows set to either side of the entryway allow a bit of moonlight to stream into the room.

title: [Temple of Industry, Courtyard]
description: Lazing beneath the shadow of the a smoky steel-trimmed temple, a dry landscape of boulders borders the ovular granite courtyard.  The granite stones, laden with ruddy iron veins, form a small trail that slopes down to the west.  Sunlight gleams off of the temple's metal surfaces, lending grace to the hard-edged edifice.

Slumbering below the dark silhouette of a smoky steel-trimmed temple, a dry landscape of boulders borders the ovular granite courtyard.  The granite stones, laden with ruddy iron veins, form a small trail that slopes down to the west.  Moonlight pools in the crevices of the temple's metallic construction, softening the edifice's hard edges.

title: [Tipsy Thrak Table]
description: The table wobbles a bit here, sloshing the drinks set down upon it.  Someone thoughtfully tried to even it up by placing a broken dagger blade beneath one of the table legs.  The table surface is darkened with age and spilled ale, but the painting of a thrak can still be seen:  it is sitting on its rump, a flagon of ale in hand and balanced upon its comical pot-belly, with stars and birds flying about its head.

title: [Velvette's Outfitting]
description: A round invar-framed window hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls, and a sturdy white cedar ceiling rises overhead.  A glazed ceramic snail planter sits in one corner of a weathered cobblestone floor.  There is a painted red cedar rack on one side of the shop and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on the other.

title: [Thanatoph, Spiked Pit]
description: The walls of this pit reach nearly twenty feet straight above you.  Strewn about at odd angles are sharpened tree limbs for impaling anything that has had the misfortune to fall in.

title: [Dralen's Weaponry]
[Dralen's Magic Shoppe]
[Dralen's General Store]
[Dralen's Outfitting]
[Dralen's Armory]
[Dralen's Combat Gear]
[Dralen's Trinkets]
[Dralen's Lockpicks]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a large oak table and a small brown box.

title: [Watchtower, Practice Ring]
description: High limestone walls surround the wide courtyard providing both privacy for those at practice and protection to the commoners beyond.  An oak ring set into the ground forms a perfect dirt-filled ring at the center of the yard where practice is held.  Wooden practice swords and padded gambesons stand in neat piles upon a shelf set beneath copper-roofed eaves.  Beyond the dirt practice area is a lush herbal garden with trailing vinca and honeysuckle vines snaking across the wall and its partially hidden garden gate.

title: [Niima's Temple, Vestibule]
description: Massive blued steel double doors have been ornately carved with a border of rolling waves, and a bas-relief of various sea shells and other small sea creatures adorn their surfaces.  In the topmost panel of each door, a cresting silver dolphin emerges from a wave.  Soft candlelight draws the focus inside the temple, towards the dimly-lit foyer.

title: [A Small Shack]
description: A small counter holding numerous plates is the only adornment to this cramped shack, and a huge cast iron pot sits in the center of the circular structure.  Set upon a bed of coals, the water within the pot bubbles and roils constantly, its percolations drowning out nearly any other sound in the room.

title: [Tidewater Warehouse]
description: Coils of cordage ranging from light cotton halyards to massive hemp anchor cables lie ranged in rows along the floor or hanging from pegs set into the rafters.  Lined up closest to the doorway are spools of double-woven cord used in lobster and crab traps.

title: [Solhaven, Boatwright's Yard]
description: Half shaded by a canvas awning, the workyard is crowded with an organized disarray of stacked planks of various lengths and kinds of wood.  Occupying most of the unshaded side of the yard is a long, plate metal box with pipes connecting it to a small charcoal-fired boiler.  Heat radiates from the contraption, and steam leaks from several seams along its sides.

title: [Solhaven, Bobo's Toy Park]
[Solhaven, Trader Rise]
description: Extending out over the bay, this substantial cedar deck is surrounded by a high railing and several benches, leaving a generous expanse of open deck, presumably for activities that require room.  A pair of catwalks provide access to the northwest and southwest corners of the South Market without having to pass through any of the shops whose backs line the east side of the deck.

Extending out over the bay, this substantial cedar deck is surrounded by a high railing and several benches, leaving a generous expanse of open space.  A pair of catwalks provide access to the northwest and southwest corners of the South Market without having to pass through any of the shops whose backs line the east side of the deck.

title: [Wierdling's Magic Shoppe]
description: The broad sweep of the marble floor is interrupted by an iron candelabra.  Halfway to the polished haon ceiling, a round invar-framed window hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A low wrought iron table and a long mahogany rack are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Karrish's Armory]
[Karrish's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A small brown box and a large oak table are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Aelfwine's Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is an ora-bound large walnut trunk on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Wil's Fish Shop]
description: Dim light filters into the small shack through chinks in the poorly fitted slat walls.  A few rough tables with benches and a long countertop are the main furnishings.  Behind the counter, the proprietor cooks various fish in a huge iron skillet over a hooded fireplace.

title: [Plateau, Flynth River]
description: Small fish play tag in an eddy behind a boulder in the river.  Paw prints on the muddy bank lead into the water and then back out, fading away on the firmer ground.

title: [Zeltoph Mountain, Ledge]
description: Blackened rocks show evidence that others have stopped here to take a break from the arduous trail.  In the distance, foothills of the great mountain, Zeltoph, are barely visible.

title: [Zeltoph Mountain, Cave]
description: The interior of this cave is larger than it appears to be from the outside.  Someone has built a firepit on one side and from the smell, it seems firewood is not what is normally used as fuel.  A trickle near the back has been dammed up to form a small pool, just big enough to water an animal or provide a quick bath.

title: [Flynth Lake, Cabin]
description: Reigning supreme over this one room cabin is a large stone fireplace built both for ease of cooking and heating of the entire room.  Near the fireplace is a small stack of wood, already split and ready to feed a hungry fire.  Pegs line the other walls, conveniently placed to hang cloaks and packs, freeing the limited floor space for other uses.

title: [Flynth Lake, Barn]
description: Footsteps send echoes into the barn's cavernous space.  From up in the lofty rafters, the soft chattering of swallows mingles with the occasional coo of doves.  Slanting beams of moonlight shine in, throwing pools of silver light on the rough-planked floor.  The place is reminiscent of a cathedral and the sweet smell of hay makes a fine replacement for the aroma of incense.

Footsteps send echoes into the barn's cavernous space.  From up in the lofty rafters, the soft chattering of swallows mingles with the occasional coo of doves.  Slanting beams of sunlight shine in, throwing pools of golden light on the rough-planked floor.  The place is reminiscent of a cathedral and the sweet smell of hay makes a fine replacement for the aroma of incense.

title: [Flynth Lake, Barn]
description: Here in the back of the barn, stalls for eight animals take up most of the area.  The enclosures are spacious and sturdy, and piles of hay fill a couple of them, spilling out onto the rough planks of the barn floor.  Freshly cut wood lies in a corner, ready to be split and stacked.

title: [Flynth Lake, Hayloft]
description: In this peaceful loft, great mounds of sweet-smelling hay are piled high, awaiting hungry oxen fresh off the trail.  It brings to mind idyllic thoughts of lazy afternoons spent lying in the hay, listening to the nicker of horses from below.  With a rustle of wings, a startled barn owl takes flight and soars to another, quieter part of the barn, where it settles down to its slumber once again.

title: [Plateau, Hilltop]
description: The crest of the hill provides a good vantage point to survey the surrounding area.  From here the effects of the old fire to the north and the lack of regrown grass in the burnt areas are evident.  An old bit of mirror is embedded in the dirt, obstructing the grass growing around it.

title: [Mountains, Hut]
description: The walls of this shabby hut are barely standing.  The holes are almost bigger than the planks that are supposed to be covering them.  Debris is scattered around the hut, obscuring most of the dirt floor.

title: [Zortahg's Spine, Highroad]
description: Within the deep shadow of the southern battlement, unmelted snow forms a stark band along the granite roadway, dwindling into the distance.
White within the deep shadow of the southern battlement, unmelted snow forms a stark band along the granite roadway, dwindling into the distance.

title: [Zortahg's Spine, Highroad]
description: Running counter to the ridges and valleys that radiate from Tor Aganrahk, the ridge that supports the highroad dips as it crosses a canyon.  Stretching to make up the difference, the wall soars upward out of the shadows of the canyon, holding the roadway aloft and level.

title: [Zortahg's Spine, Neck]
description: Crossing a north-south ridge, the road rises to provide a glimpse of what lies ahead and behind.  To the west, the road dips slightly between this ridge and the next.  To the east, the road dips lower and disappears beneath a blanket of cloud.  Beyond it the roadway re-emerges, a faint string of grey in the distance.

title: [Zortahg's Spine, Neck]
description: Submerged in a sea of fog, the world loses all of its sharp edges -- sounds and colors are muffled, and droplets of moisture form and give smooth surfaces a studded, satin sheen.

title: [Zortahg's Spine, Neck]
description: Although the area is shrouded in the dense fog, the shifting of the roadway stones underfoot and the press of a breeze out of the north suggest that at least the northern battlement is missing and that the highroad ends abruptly within the next stride or two.  Further travel to the east is therefore too dangerous to consider.

title: [Zortahg's Spine, Chasm Bridge]
description: Built in the same style and of the same rock as the archway at its northern end, the bridge appears to be relatively new.

title: [Underway, Topmost]
description: Pale golden pools of radiance spill from enchanted sunstones, lighting the walls and floor of the tunnel as it burrows down into the bowels of the mountain.  Moonlight spills in through a cut stone archway, and beyond it a stone bridge reaches across a chasm to the white granite of a fortified highroad.

Pale golden pools of radiance spill from enchanted sunstones, lighting the walls and floor of the tunnel as it burrows down into the bowels of the mountain.  Daylight floods in through a cut stone archway, and beyond it a stone bridge reaches across a chasm to the white granite of a fortified highroad.

title: [Underway, Tunnel]
description: Meticulously carved to give the appearance and traction of paving stones, and lit at intervals by the sunstone glow, the tunnel burrows its way into the mountain.

title: [Underway, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel descends more slowly as it veers westward, the gurgle of running water echoing up from below.  To the south, magicked gemstones light the way as the path continues uphill.

title: [Underway, Tunnel]
description: Downhill the tunnel opens out into a cavern, the expanse hinted at by isolated patches of golden light.  Eastward the tunnel narrows, and enchanted sunstones light the carved stone floor at regular intervals.

title: [Underway, Cavern]
description: The odor of wet mud and mold fills the chill air, and the sound of flowing water echoes through the cavern.  Two stalactite-stalagmite pairs bracket the trail.  The stalactites have been hollowed out, polished, and inset with a glowing sunstone each.  The stonecrafted spotlights shine down upon statues carved from the stalagmites beneath them: pair of dwarven warriors, one bearing a clawed gauntlet and the other a two-handed morning star, guarding the trail.

title: [Underway, Cavern]
description: A thin layer of mud covers the cavern floor, evidence that whatever water source is echoing in here must flood from time to time.  Footprints, wheel marks, and hoofprints create an unmistakable trail that runs northeast to southwest.

title: [Underway, Cavern]
description: Standing apart, as if accorded some special regard by the Dwarven masters that sculpted the statuary in this cavern, the broken base of a fluted stalagmite pedestal is all that is visible here.

title: [Underway, Cavern]
description: A stalactite-and-gemstone spotlight shines down on the bald pate of a two-foot-tall rock carving that stands just north of the trail.

title: [Underway, Cavern]
description: Sloping more steeply downhill to the southwest, the cavern floor wears a thicker layer of mud and the sound of running water echoes loudly off the cavern walls.

title: [Underway, Cavern]
description: The trail ends at the brink of a swollen underground river.  Clearly a ford exists beneath the rushing waters, but right now the water is too deep and the current too swift for any wagon, beast of burden or person to cross.

title: [Cairnfang Uplands]
description: Heading east towards the sound of rushing water, the trail descends beneath sparse pines, and thin soil gives way to broad stretches of barren limestone.

title: [Cairnfang Uplands, Crossing]
description: Narrow files of tall grass mark the few cracks in the sloping expanse of limestone that reaches eastward and meets the rushing waters of the Cairnfang River.  A bed of gravel and an absence of boulders marks a well maintained ford.

title: [Cairnfang, East Valley]
description: The grass waves gently in the breeze coming across the valley.  To the south a sheer cliff rises sharply to the blue sky, preventing any travel in that direction.  To the west the valley slopes down to a rocky ford.

title: [Cairnfang, East Valley]
description: Moonlight sparkles off of quartz deposits within the towering rock walls to the south.  The valley itself begins to narrow as some rocky bluffs begin to rise on the north.  A lone nighthawk circles in the sky above.

title: [Cairnfang, East Valley]
description: The valley narrows here and bends somewhat to pass around a large granite bluff on the south side.  A few large stones lay half buried, imbedded deep in the ground where they fell from the cliff above.  The great age of some of the stones is evident in the deep layers of moss covering them.

title: [Cairnfang, East Valley]
description: The valley is quite narrow here between towering walls.  The ground has sparse patches of grass here and there, probably due to the lack of sunlight reaching the ground.  Along the north wall a rockfall is noted, though it's quite impassable at present.  At the edge of the rockfall several pieces of shattered wood and a broken wheel are visible, apparently from a wagon of some type.

title: [Cairnfang, East Valley]
description: The valley continues to wind between sheer rock walls extending hundreds of feet high.  A few stunted trees can be seen at the upper edge of the walls.  To the northeast the valley widens out once again.

title: [Cairnfang, East Valley]
description: The valley widens out here into a large open area heavily carpeted with tall grass.  A rocky pass heads north out of the valley, ascending into the hills to the north.  A stream tumbles down the south wall in a large waterfall, filling a lake at the base of the wall.

title: [Rocky Pass]
description: The rock-strewn floor of this pass leads on between towering black stone walls.  Piles of broken stone at the base of the walls show where pieces have fallen in the past.  The wind causes a lonely whistling sound as it blows through the pass.  A few stunted bushes indicate how difficult it is for anything to survive in such inhospitable and rocky ground.

title: [Rocky Pass]
description: At the summit of the pass even the few plants have lost their hold.  If someone were to grow rocks for a living, this would be a good place.  The wind and time have scoured them into odd shapes, faintly reminiscent of unpleasant childhood dreams.

title: [Rocky Pass]
description: The pass widens out into a meadow leading down into a small valley.  There is a stream meandering through the valley, and beyond a bend in its bed an overgrown and ruined village can be seen.  The source of the stream is hidden in a ravine on the far side of the valley.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: The buildings in the village surround a central square, which is completely overgrown now. In the center of the square is a large tree.  Even though old fire scars are still visible on the tree, it still seems to thrive.  All that remains of the buildings in this corner of the square are the stone foundations and a few old burned beams thrusting up through the vegetation now covering the wounds.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: A single building sits here, its ivy-wreathed walls still standing, though the roof is long gone.  Patches of color to either side of the ruined doorway show where flowerbeds may once have been, though they are quite overgrown.

title: [Ruined Chapel]
description: The soaring grey granite walls are scorched, but still standing, though the roof of this building is only a memory.  Windows can be seen spaced at even intervals along the walls, beautifully arched, but minus any glass to complete them.  Any furnishings that were once in this chapel have long since burned and been ground to dust, but the smoke-blackened altar remains as a testament to the belief of those who once worshipped here.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: In front of the fire-gutted walls of a ruined building is a single well-weathered sign.  Any paint that may have once covered it is long gone, however the carving of a bunch of grapes can still be made out.  A second destroyed building that may have once been a stable sits slightly behind the first set of blackened roofless walls.

title: [Ruined Tavern]
description: The fieldstone walls rise over two stories high in a couple spots, and stubs of charred beams protrude from the walls, evidence that this building once had a second floor.  Wind and rain have washed the soot from the walls, except in the corners and the seams between the stones, giving the interior a shadowed and darkened cast even in broad daylight.  Shards of broken glass, pottery and charred barrel staves along one wall indicate that this was likely a public house or tavern prior to its demise.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: A small stream winds out of a ravine entrance and passes behind several piles of rubble. The rubble is covered by thick grass, but several blackened beams reach up to the open sky above, appearing like skeletal ribs of a long dead creature.

title: [Ravine]
description: A glance upwards reveals a steep drop from above to the rocky floor of the ravine.  The sides rise so high that most of the ravine is cast in total darkness.  A small stream trickles past, seemingly in no hurry to get anywhere, though the depth of the ravine attests that this was not always so.

title: [Ravine]
description: Deeper into the ravine, the stream becomes wider, and the bank narrower.  The water flows faster, its burbling a lovely accompaniment to the whistle of wind past the rocky sides of the ravine.  To the northwest, the ground becomes rockier, and a huge wall rises up out of the ground.

title: [Ravine]
description: The ravine comes to a dead end here at a high rock wall which is pocked with holes, some openings even large enough for a giantman to walk through.  Sound seems to echo strangely in these openings, as though they are deeper than they first appear.  The stream flows from inside one of the larger ones.

title: [Cave Entrance]
description: Moonlight slants in the opening from outside, but deeper in the cave there is little illumination at all, and it may be difficult to see if you go any further inside.  Water drips from the ceiling of the cave in a slow, steady *plop*.

title: [Caves]
description: Moss grows on the walls of the cave, glowing a soft green when the light from the torch does not directly hit it.  Light flickers, creating odd, unpleasant shadows on the uneven surface of the cavern walls.

title: [Caves]
description: Faint skittering sounds come from just beyond the edge of the torchlight, heading off further into the shadows.  You wonder for a moment what lives back here, and how long it has been since it might have seen light.

title: [Caves]
description: This particular tunnel appears to be a dead end, at least for anything larger than a rat.  The ceiling drops dramatically until it nearly meets the floor, and the water has pooled at the far end of the room into a nice sized puddle.  One might consider taking a refreshing drink, except for the odd, unearthly glow to the water.  Nope, that can't be healthy.

title: [Caves]
description: As you travel deeper into the caves, sound echoes more oddly, leaving you slightly confused and off balance.  The floor of the cave is getting slicker from the water dripping down the sides, and the air is getting distinctly more chill.

title: [Caves]
description: There is definitely an odd smell in this corner of the caves, as though something crept back here into the eternal inky night and died...quite some time ago.  The temptation to cast about looking for it with the torch is not stronger than the desire to flee the odor, however.

title: [Caves]
description: The unrelenting drip-drip-drip of the water in the caves is enough to drive anyone batty.  A glance upwards reveals that this isn't too far off the mark.  Several pairs of blinking eyes look back from the ceiling of the cave, disturbed by the torchlight.

title: [Caves]
description: The floor of the cave is very slick with the frigid water and the slime that has flourished in the dampness.  As the cave makes a sharp bend the floor rises slightly, and you mentally caution yourself to watch your step.

title: [Caves]
description: The high-pitched squeak of bats comes from further inside the cave, leaving suspicions about the slickness of the floor.  The torchlight flickers ominously as a draft passes from some unseen source.

title: [Caves]
description: Eerie sounds echo from further into the cave, punctuated by the incessant dripping of water.  The air is damp and growing cooler with each step into the cave.

title: [Lower Caves]
description: The distant sound of rushing water reminds you of the stream that probably cut these caves with its erosive flow.  It is impossible to tell from which direction the sound comes, but the air is warm and humid.

title: [Lower Caves]
description: The damp air grows distinctly colder as you descend into the caves.  The scant warmth from the torch is almost as welcome as the light it sheds.  The utter darkness presses in at the edge of the torchlight, almost a physical presence.

title: [Lower Caves]
description: The faint sound of sobbing seems to echo from all directions in a disconcerting way.  It is occasionally interrupted by deep male chuckles, though there is something as cold and chilling about the sound as there is about the air in the cave.

title: [Lower Caves]
description: All sound seems to coalesce here, unseen feet skittering, shrieking bats, a woman's sobbing, water dripping, cold masculine laughter, and something riding just underneath the cacophony to make your blood run cold in dread.

title: [Lower Caves]
description: A small fire burns here, illuminating the room.  The remains of a modest meal lie on a scarred table in one corner, and iron shackles have been bolted to the far wall.  A small shrine lies in one corner, strewn with candles and other tiny objects, but as a whole it pulses with restrained power.

title: [Abandoned Village]
description: Two old stone walls stand in mute silence at right angles to one another.  Both are blackened and broken.  A few yellow wildflowers grow from the corner of what may have once been a window in one of the walls. To either side of them are old broken beams and scattered piles of stone.  The building that once may have stood here was larger than the others, but little remains.  A rocky path leads north over a small hill.

title: [Overlook Path]
description: This path is so overgrown that it is difficult to tell if human feet had once walked it.  The only sign that persons may have passed this way in the past is an old broken and weathered sign pointing to the west.  Whatever may have been once written on it is now unreadable.  Walking on this path one must be extremely careful not to be tripped by the overgrown vegetation.  A rocky path leads south back toward the village.

title: [Overlook]
description: The path ends here at a small clearing overlooking the ravine below.  There is a stone bench here which is cracked in two by a small tree growing up through it.  At the edge of the clearing the land drops off steeply to the ravine below.  A few trees perch precariously right on the edge of the drop-off.

title: [Cairnfang Falls, Basin]
description: Lost in a world of roiling mist and slippery rock, pine-studded outcroppings ring a huge pool.  Moisture beads everywhere as water crashes onto jagged rocks at the cliff's base, and the thunder of it echoes deafeningly.

title: [Cairnfang Falls, Hidden Pool]
description: Hidden from the basin by rock outcroppings and a curtain of young pines, this pool is a starlit backwater, ringed with sandstone ledges and a tiny beach of pale golden sand.
Hidden from the basin by rock outcroppings and a curtain of young pines, this pool is a sun-warmed backwater, ringed with sandstone ledges and a tiny beach of golden sand.

title: [Cairnfang Forest, Riverbank]
description: Upriver, the sandstone walls of the Stepfalls Gorge frame the tumbling waters of the Cairnfang, but the river quiets as it leaves the gorge behind and broadens.  Only two of the ancient stone cairns can be seen from here: one is barely visible amidst the white water at the bottom of the gorge, while the other stands almost straight out in the middle of the river.

title: [Ranger Guild, Trail]
description: The meandering trail makes its way through the dark woods, the hard-packed earth providing a sure path through the night's murkiness.  Abruptly the trail ends in a small clearing.  A fire burns brightly in one corner of the glade, pushing back the night with its light.  In the flickering firelight you can make out where the trail resumes on the northern side of the clearing.

The meandering trail makes its way through the trees, the hard-packed earth giving silent testament to the number of people that have gone this way before.  Abruptly the trail ends in a small clearing in the middle of the woods.  The trail starts again at the northern side of the clearing, its end lost among the trees.  A ring of round stones encircles the smoldering remains of a fire at one end of the clearing.

title: [Trading Post, Foyer]
description: The foyer is decorated with banners from nearby cities.  A large, pine desk sits in one corner of the room.  Near the entrance, a rickety podium, covered with a thick layer of dust, stands to greet visitors.  Chairs and tables, clearly not often used, are placed at intervals along the unadorned wooden walls.

title: [Trading Post, Front Porch]
description: The floor planks of this long, wide porch creak and groan underfoot, and swinging doors leading inside squeak on their hinges.  Overhead, a wooden awning provides protection from rain.  Square, wooden pillars, part of the rail surrounding the porch, support the awning above.  Several chairs, a bench, and a suspended wooden swing are placed about the porch for watching the road.

The floor planks of this long, wide porch creak and groan underfoot, and swinging doors leading inside squeak on their hinges.  Overhead, a wooden awning provides protection from both sun and rain.  Square, wooden pillars, part of the rail surrounding the porch, support the awning above.  Several chairs, a bench, and a suspended wooden swing are placed about the porch for watching the road.

title: [Trading Post, Common Room]
description: Travelers and adventurers of all races and ages find rest in this large, open room.  A fire pit is located in the center of the room, providing warmth and light.  Barmaids serve food and drink from behind a long oak bar.

title: [Trading Post, Upstairs Hallway]
description: A faded, fraying carpet pads the center of the floor in this hall.  Oil lamps hang at odd intervals on the walls, providing patchy, flickering light.

title: [Trading Post, Leather Room]
description: Stretched skins hang from the walls as decoration in this musty room.  Leather bindings adorn most of the furniture, and leather thongs have been used in lieu of nails to hold the furniture together.  A badly damaged, leather-bound oak trunk sits at the foot of the bed.

title: [Trading Post, Rose Room]
description: This dimly lit room is decorated with rose colored tapestries and wall hangings.  The bedding is rose colored, and a lamp on a side table has a rose colored shade.  A round carpet that covers most of the floor is worn nearly through next to the bed.

title: [Trading Post, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Several of the oil lamps here have either burnt out or have been extinguished.  The hallway is quite dark, and a small table sits against the wall.

title: [Trading Post, Incense Room]
description: This room can barely be seen through the haze of incense hanging in the air.  A plainly adorned bed sits in the center of the room.  Incense holders of all sorts sit on two tables at opposite ends of the room.

title: [Trading Post, Wicker Room]
description: This room is full of wicker furniture and art, much of it in disrepair.  Some of the wicker is painted, but most of it is not.  Wicker chairs sit next to wicker tables.  The only piece of furniture that is not wicker is the bed, which sits against the wall opposite the door.

title: [Trading Post, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Dim light flickers in this dead-end hallway.  The combination of no windows and smoking lamps gives the hallway a hazy look.  The ironbound oak door at the end of the hallway seems out of place, looking stronger and newer than the other doors or even the walls of the trading post.

title: [Trading Post, Sea Room]
description: Rusting anchors and crude, broken sextants hang as decoration on the walls of this room.  Seashells of many sizes sit on the tables, and the lamps here are crafted from large conches.  A net decorated with starfish hangs over the bed.

title: [Trading Post, Rope Room]
description: The furniture in this room is tied together with rope instead of nails, and thin ropes are wound around the wood of the furniture.  On the walls, ropes with a wide variety of knots in them are hung for display.  Many different sizes of baskets and other decorations all made of rope are placed on the tables in this room.

title: [Trading Post, Cellar]
description: This cellar serves as storage for the wines and ales sold in the common room.  Roots and dried goods are also stored in barrels and casks along the walls.  Bottles of wine sit in racks that form aisles throughout the room.

title: [A Curtained Alcove]
description: This alcove provides a quiet, out of the way place for the front desk to the Inn here in the Trading Post.  A polished desk sits before a set of rickety stairs leading upward to further privacy and rest.  A red satin curtain muffles the dull roar from the common room.

title: [Trading Post, Skinner]
description: Piles of hides and furs of various animals lie behind a sturdy pine table that stretches nearly the length of the room.  Vadil the skinner sits on a tall stool behind the long table, glancing down his nose at customers as they arrive and depart.  Skins hang from hooks on the walls, and animal tails and lizard skins dangle from the rafters just out of reach.

title: [Trading Post, Trophy Room]
description: Stuffed and mounted creatures serve as decoration in this musty room.  Moonlight streams in through a shuttered window in the west wall.  A soft couch and several comfortable chairs are available for prolonged viewing of the trophies.  A wide variety of weapons adorn the walls, some in display cases, others simply hung by nails.

Stuffed and mounted creatures serve as decoration in this musty room.  Light streams in through a shuttered window in the west wall.  A soft couch and several comfortable chairs are available for prolonged viewing of the trophies.  A wide variety of weapons adorn the walls, some in display cases, others simply hung by nails.

title: [Cascade of Tears, Promontory]
description: The view of the falls is breathtaking.  As the rushing river cascades over the cliff's edge, droplets of water mist the air and the moonlight refracts into a glittering curtain.  Yet for all its beauty, there is still a haunting sadness about this place.

The view of the falls is breathtaking.  As the rushing river cascades over the cliff's edge, droplets of water mist the air and the sunlight refracts into a brilliant rainbow.  Yet for all its beauty, there is still a haunting sadness about this place.

title: [Marshtown, Langi's Pier]
description: This pier juts out into the current of the Cairnfang delta.  Moored to the pier is a variety of small craft that run from bank to bank of the delta.  Fishing boats are laden with deep sea fishing poles, while flat barges carry materials and workers for maintaining the Market Bridge.

title: [Darbo Phoop's Arcane Outfitters]
description: A scattering of arcane symbols, worked in polished brass, are inlaid in the blue granite floor.  A few of the sigils even gleam from the stair treads and risers that circle upward to the floor above.  Opposite the stairway,  a midnight blue tapestry stitched with gold astrological diagrams forms a backdrop for a glaes-paned display case and a dark maoral counter.  Cracked plaster walls peek between the wall hangings.

title: [Darbo Phoop's, Consignment]
description: The shop's granite floor continues to extend into this area, but has changed from blue to dark grey streaked with white swirls.  From the ceiling, a massive contraption hangs by tightly woven rope, its purpose unclear.

title: [Darbo Phoop's, Used Emporium]
description: Along each wall, hand-carved display cases sit undisturbed.  A large marble table claims the center of the room, offering the most prominent wares.

title: [Wizard Guild, Shop]
description: Shelves, display cases, and boxes of all sizes line the walls of this little shop.  Most anything an apprentice needs to start a profession as a wizard can be found here.  At the ends of long strings of twine, shards of crystal dangle from the ceiling, emitting a dull glow that illuminates the shop.

title: [Cavernhold, Inside Hut]
description: The inside of the hut is simple and quite barren.  A few sticks of crude furniture are scattered about the room and an old map hangs on the back wall.

title: [Fethilryn's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, a fringed crimson silk banner hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a long mahogany rack sit in opposite corners while a sphere-topped black marble fountain rests on a dark oak parquet floor.

title: [Card Playing Thraks Table]
description: A soft green fabric, threadbare in many places, has been draped across a section of the table.  A bowl of candy sits near the center of the shabby cloth covering.  One chair is tipped over on its side, as though its occupant had made a hasty exit.

title: [Zul Logoth, A Damp Hole]
description: Pieces of rock continuously slide down the sides of this crudely dug hole.  Pickaxe markings form gouges along the top edge of the hole, marking the ridge of stone that rims it.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Excavation]
description: The tunnel ends abruptly at a sheer rock face.  Pick marks in the shapes of deep gouges and long channels mar the granite surface.  At the foot of the workface, a pile of rubble leans against the wall with chunks scattered out across the floor.  Several timbers rest against the wall, waiting to be put to use in the tunnel extension.  No work proceeds at the moment, though.  Perhaps the work crew is on break, sleeping, or has been called away to do a task elsewhere.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Ruby Tunnel]
description: The tunnel ends, widening out just a little and forming a circle.  Depictions of urban dwellings reside on the northeast, southeast and southwest walls.  A steel grey townhouse occupies the northeast wall.  The window boxes with their brightly colored mushrooms look almost real.  On the southeast wall, the flat wooden slats of a blue row house frame long vertical windows.  Strangely, the back of a home fills the southwest wall.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Emerald Tunnel]
description: The tunnel spur ends quickly at a black metal door.  The door looks anything but ordinary, sporting three heavy hinges on its left side and a turnbuckle opening device.  Firelight flickers brightly beyond the door, and warm air streams out of the doorway into the room.  Two green toadstools in large stone pots flank the doorway and cast their illumination across the ceiling.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Crystalline Cavern]
description: The northwest corner of the crystalline cavern is bathed mostly in tints of sapphire and white due to the preponderance of blue toadstools in this section.  Other colors are evident, though, due to the refractions from the dome's crystals.  A long, thin opening interrupts the crystals high on the north side of the dome, and the sound of wind coursing through a tunnel emanates from that area.  A wide entry occupies the west wall, flanked by two huge furs, and a marble table abuts the north wall.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Hall of Arches]
description: A spacious, semicircular room curves to the west, north and east.  A steel gate interrupts the long, flat southern wall, allowing exit to Zul Logoth proper.  Openings line the curved granite walls, most of them darkened and giving no indication of their reason for existence.  Several heavy timbers anchored to the smooth granite floor support a web of ceiling timbers, which, in turn, support the wide granite ceiling.

title: [Solano Hall, Entrance]
description: A short corridor runs between a granite arch and a steel gate.  Near the arch, the walls are composed of grey granite, but near the gate they suddenly give way to a black rock flecked with silvery flakes of mica.  The grey granite floor is rough but level, and two toadstools in stone pots, one at either end of the corridor, provide ample light.  The sound of rushing water comes from somewhere beyond the gate.

A short corridor runs from a granite arch to a steel gate, a curved grey doorway set between them.  Near the arch, the walls are composed of grey granite, but near the gate they give way to a black rock flecked with silvery flakes of mica.  The grey granite floor is rough but level, and two toadstools in stone pots that flank the gate provide ample light, while a dark wooden planter containing a myriad of colorful flowers, somehow growing in the harsh environment, sits against one wall.  The sound of rushing water comes from beyond the gate.

title: [Zul Logoth, Crystalline Cavern]
description: Water courses out of a pair of small metal pipes to cascade over several rocks before filling a shallow pool.  Dwarves come from all directions to fill containers, urns, cups, pitchers, and other water-bearing vessels.  The pool reflects the crystalline dome, bringing in the colors from overhead and dispersing them on the walls and rocks in an enthralling display of rippling rainbow hues.  Splashed water covers the floor around the pool, making footing somewhat slippery.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, west
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Amber Tunnel]
description: An elderly dwarf dressed in plate armor stands stiffly directly in front of the stone arch leading north from this short stretch of tunnel.  Dwarves pass by him, yet he neither looks right or left, his gaze fixed on some object in the distance.  A pair of large stone pots flank the arch, and the glow from their toadstools fills the area with a radiant, amber illumination.  To the south the tunnel widens out into a massive cavern.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Crystalline Cavern]
description: Dwarven miners pass in and out of the stone arch on the west wall in this corner of the crystalline cavern.  Most of the dwarves going in carry bulging sacks, while those who exit have flattened sacks and a rather satisfied expression.  A huge ruby is set into the stone wall just above the arch.  On the south wall, a steel door operates as the entry to a windowless shop.  The sounds of hammering and grinding emanate from the shop.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Crystalline Cavern]
description: Dwarves in mining attire move constantly through the tunnel to the south.  Those approaching look dusty and weary, while those walking away are cleaner and in much better spirits.  Occasionally slight tremors shake the floor, but the cause of these is indeterminate.  A narrow, grey stone doorway in the southeast wall leads into a rather official-looking building.  A pick-and-shovel insignia looms over the doorway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, west
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Agate Tunnel]
description: The toadstools in this short section of tunnel have been arranged to throw bands of colored light on the ceiling.  Red, amber, green, blue, silver, and light grey bands arc across the ceiling.  Despite the bands of light, the tunnel is dimly lit.  A wide entry yawns in the wall to the north, and a silver sign decorated with the shapes of musical instruments sits on the wall above the entry.  On the east wall, a brass sign hangs next to a thick iron door.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]
description: The section of tunnel is brightly lit due to the type of toadstool in this area.  Very little coloration impedes the light flow as the toadstools project a light grey illumination upward and a soft white light downward.  The excellent illumination makes for easy travel, though the cleanliness and flatness of the floor makes footing not a concern.  An iron-lined opening leads into the office of the local constable, while a leather-covered door serves as the entry to a shop.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]
description: Near the stone arch on the west wall, the floor looks much cleaner than in the rest of the tunnel, as if someone has recently scrubbed it.  Faded dark red stains are still evident in the granite, though.  Dwarves, some injured, enter through the arch.  None of those exiting display injuries of any type.  A brass sign hangs on the wall above the arch.  Low rumblings seem to come from somewhere down the southern tunnel accompanied by slight tremors.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]
description: Dwarven men and women trudge slowly in and out of the stone arch to the south.  Those entering the arch seem to be alert and talkative, while those exiting are, for the most part, tired and quiet.  A desk abuts the wall just beside the arch, and a dwarven guard carefully examines those passing through.  The guard points to various items on each dwarf and notes something on her clipboard.  The items she points to most often are tools of the mining trade.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]
description: Dwarven miners wander in and out of the stone arch to the south.  Those proceeding north are dusty and grimy, their faces covered by a layer of sweaty dirt and their beards tangled.  In contrast, those proceeding south are clean and neat, with washed faces and combed beards.  The tunnel to the south appears to be tighter, of much rougher construction than the surrounding area, and also poorly lit.  The dwarves moving in and out seem to pay no attention to the change in construction.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]
description: A wide, plate glass window flanks a grey steel door on the east wall.  Dwarven children excitedly peer through, jabbering among themselves and pointing at things within.  Elder dwarves shoo them away from the window, but they return as soon as the older ones wander out of sight.  Rumblings emanate from inside the building every so often, causing the floor to tremble underfoot, and the air seems hotter in this section of the tunnel.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]
description: Grains of white salt are scattered across the floor of the tunnel, making footing crunchy and a bit slippery.  The salt also causes the air to be extremely dry in this section, and the timbers here display an extremely heavy tar coating in response.  A single white door occupies the east wall next to a thick, wide metal door that appears to open upward.  Salt oozes liberally from underneath the metal door to be tracked all along the tunnel by the many dwarves who are constantly moving through.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]
description: Climbing sharply to the west, the tunnel bends to the northwest.  An intricate crosshatch pattern gives the floor a safe footing and melds with the stone block carving of the tunnel walls.  The faint echoes of rhythmic hammerfalls can be heard from upslope.

title: [Zul Logoth Forging Supply Shop]
description: Resembling an hourglass laid on its side, this chamber appears to have been naturally formed, but then embellished and made functional by dwarven design and labor.  The choke-point in the center of the cavern is now almost entirely filled by a steel-topped counter and display case, while beyond it, hammerfalls echo from a dozen or so tunnels that pierce the curved wall of the chamber.  A dwarven attendant stands behind the counter, patiently waiting to provide whatever assistance might be needed.

title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]
description: Evenly spaced, brightly-colored pots illuminate this well-traveled tunnel with a soft white and peach glow.  The low din of bartering and trading dwarves echo off the high ceiling, occasionally pierced by the hearty laughter of a merchant striking an opportune deal.  Carts laden with goods and wares continually pass in and out of a large invar-braced archway.

title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]
description: Fanciful storefronts with white-shuttered windows have been painted in amazing detail onto the smoothened walls, though only their doors are real.  One particularly creative shopkeeper has incorporated the tunnel's glimmering opal veins into rising spires for their facade.

title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]
description: Rising from the stone floor, slender stalagmites form an elegant colonnade along a motley row of stores.  Dwarves pass by slowly, grunting in appreciation of the tunnel's inherent beauty and cleanliness.  Occasionally, a dwarf wanders into one of the many shops in search of a bargain.

title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]
description: Giant toadstools tower, shedding a pale blue luminescence upon this slight bend of the tunnel, causing diminutive veins of black opal to shimmer faintly.  Hanging above the numerous brightly-colored doors are boldly painted signs advertising each merchant's names.  The faint aroma of cigar smoke filters in from a small niche frequented by resting miners.

title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]
description: Vivid banners completely cover a rather larger stalagmite jutting from the middle of the tunnel, so much so that there appears to be numerous layers to dig through before reaching the actual stone formation.  As residents go about their errands, an occasional mother and child pause as the youngster tugs on the mother's skirt and points to a particularly inviting shop selling sweets.

title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]
description: Many colorful characters have set up their shop at this toadstool-lined cul-de-sac.  Visible through a wide garnet-studded archway is a notable dwarven merchant.  He plays his hanging steins like chimes, while an assistant stands outside, hawking the rest of the wares.

title: [Zul Logoth, Sapphire Tunnel]
description: A matronly dwarf dressed in chainmail watches as dwarves move through the southern arch.  Brisk traffic proceeds in both directions.  The dwarves that enter and exit the arch are dressed for a variety of functions, from mining to business to pleasure.  One gigantic toadstool sits in a stone pot on either side of the arch.  Their twin pools of white light clearly illuminate the area, making it easy for the guard to spot anyone who might try to pass by.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Sapphire Tunnel]
description: A chainmail-clad dwarven guard lounges against the western wall, his posture indicating a lack of attention.  His eyes, however, dart to and fro, scanning each person as he or she wanders through the stone arch just to the south.  He seems to know them all by name, and they give him nods of recognition or brief smiles in a most respectful manner.  The young ones, in particular, seemed somewhat awed by this dwarf.  They deferentially intone, "Hello, sir," as they pass.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Wizard Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Orderly tiers of polished stone benches rise in a semicircle, conforming to the curve of the chamber.  Engraved upon the deep blue marble walls are simulacra of elemental embodiments.  A white granite lectern with burnished invar accents sits upon a slightly raised dais, within excellent view of all the seating.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ametrine Tunnel]
description: A steady stream of dwarves passes along through the tunnel to the northwest, busily going about their day.  Several small shops fitted with brightly painted shutters stand nearby, taking advantage of the heavy foot traffic.  The scent of rich loam wafts from one particular storefront lined with numerous potted luminescent toadstools.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Ametrine Tunnel]
description: A lone stalactite has been painted with swirls of deep amethyst and streaks of sunny yellow-gold.  Elaborate feats of dwarven masonry stand on display out in front of an expansive storefront.  Idle chatter between shopkeepers, patrons, and neighbors runs together with the heavy footsteps of passersby.  Growing in the shadowed nooks of the tunnel are small clumps of softly glowing blue-green moss.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Ametrine Tunnel]
description: Tiny pink granite figurines have been placed on a natural ledge in the wall, along with offerings of dried bundled mushrooms.  A handful of shops line the tunnel, with brightly colored doors and boldly lettered signs adding a splash of color to the drab stone environs.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Ametrine Tunnel]
description: Vividly painted upon the walls is an idyllic pastoral scene with quaint cottages set against rolling green hills.  The sounds of dwarven families as they go about their business are barely audible beyond the doors of the artistically rendered homes.  Several of the windows are crafted with clear glaes, but drawn curtains shield the goings-on beyond them from prying eyes.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Ametrine Tunnel]
description: A small, semi-circular granite and limestone rock garden marks the end of the tunnel, illuminated by toadstools placed evenly around its perimeter.  Flanking an invar-barred gate are a pair of giant luminescent toadstools that provides the immediate area with a soft, blue-toned glow.  A sloping walkway leads to a large manor house that, unlike the neighboring homes, is a freestanding building and not merely an artist's creation.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Marcasite Tunnel]
description: The sounds of bustling traffic emanate far down the corridor to the southeast, but this tunnel has a rather unused feel to it.  Gigantic toadstools sprouting from large stone pots illuminate a floor covered with a thin layer of dust.
