Footprints traveling in both directions mar the dusty layer, but the footprints are mostly obvious, well-defined, and rarely overlap.  A few cobwebs cling to the ceiling and walls, but even these appear to be abandoned by their makers.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Marcasite Tunnel]
description: The coatings on the beams have worn away in many spots, and several of the beams display ominous cracks.  The beams protest loudly when the rock above them shifts, and occasionally small showers of dusty particles rain down from the ceiling.  The air, somewhat stale and tinged with the odor of decayed flesh, hangs heavily in this section of the tunnel.  A metal sign affixed to one of the large stone pots sports bright red lettering.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Marcasite Tunnel]
description: Only two toadstools, growing in large pots, remain alive along the tunnel, and their weak glows indicate that they are not long for this world.  The others have died and fallen over, extinguishing their luminescence and plunging those areas into darkness.  Several of the crossing support beams have broken, littering the floor with sharp wooden pieces, and the ceiling sags dangerously in these sections.  To the north, a timber extends across a wide trench that traverses the floor from wall to wall.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Marcasite Tunnel]
description: The dull grey granite gives way to redstone as the tunnel widens and descends.  No toadstools light the area, and the way is barely visible.  To the south a timber extends across a wide trench that traverses the floor from wall to wall, while to the north a cavernous opening allows entrance to expansive mine works.  A bit of light filters in from both ends, but hardly enough to do any serious work by.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Winding Tunnel]
description: Luminescent moss clings to the walls and ceiling of this naturally-formed tunnel.  Tiny shards of cloudy quartz sparkle amidst the stone in the soft light.  The floor slopes gently to the northeast, leading further into the depths of the earth.

title: [Zaratek Hall, Foyer]
description: A series of three arches branch off to the west, each a fine example of masonry.  The gentle luminescence of giant glowing toadstools cast upon the foyer's stonework illuminates their cleanly hewn surfaces.  Standing forefront, a life-sized statue wrought of bronze has been set upon a polished granite pedestal.
paths: Obvious exits: southwest, west, northwest, out

title: [Zaratek Hall, Repository]
description: Multi-tiered austere iron shelving abut each other along the perimeter of the chamber, while reinforced steel racks and stacked boxes occupy its center.  The vast storage capacity is put to use, housing the repository's bountiful inventory.  Despite the great volume, the items are systematically catalogued with military organization.

title: [Zaratek Hall, Corridor]
description: Encased within thick panes of imported Terasian glaes, trophies from many an adventurer's journeys sit out on display.  A thick fringed runner in hues of russet and olive leads up to a pair of faux-oak doors.  Fragrant smoke drifts from the open portal, dissipating as it meets the ceiling.

title: [Zaratek Hall, Alcove]
description: Pale stone walls enclose this alcove on three sides, flecked randomly with glossy mica.  Corkboards and bulletins are occupied by an abundance of scrolls delineating tasks and requested services of the guild.  The lone piece of furniture, a sturdy iron-worked stand, supports a thick leather-bound logbook.

title: [Jail, Entry]
description: Lofty ceilings mark the entry to the jail, the dark wood of the beams beginning the journey into the deep passageways.  The illumination provided by the two enormous torches on either side of the entry reveals the ancient markings of numerous pickaxes, delving into the earth to discover the valuable materials hidden beneath the unrelenting rock.  A large table stands against the wall, the prisoner log opened upon it.

title: [Jail, Hallway]
description: Brightly lit by several torches set in iron sconces on the walls, the smoothly tunneled corridor allows no room for shadows to dwell.  Colorful iron doors mark the entry to each cell, each with a different native gem set into the doorway to make differentiation simple.  A set of low steps leads north and down to a lower level of the prison, while to the south, the entry can be glimpsed beyond the burly dwarven guard who stands watch.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Entrance]
description: The foyer of the brewery flares out to the north, a smooth granite archway inset into the far wall, opening up into a large room filled with detailed informational signs and notices.  A length of braided white cordon winds its way throughout the area, serving as a way to direct the flow of visitors.  In the center of the room, a large chunk of bluerock rises up from the floor, its jagged contours resembling a form of primitive art.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Giftshop]
description: Smooth grey stone walls have had numerous niches and shelves carved out of their very rock, creating natural display areas for the wares in this giftshop.  A variety of glassware and other novelty items are neatly arranged on the available space.  Behind an immaculate speckled marble counter is a cheery dwarven clerk ready to assist customers.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Corridor]
description: Formed from unadorned grey stone, the corridor is neat and tidy.  The smooth stone floor meets the walls in a single seamless line that is echoed by the gentle curve of the high ceiling.  Standing open at the far end of the corridor is a pair of invar double doors, their stone casing carved with gentle whorls and slashes.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Grain Silo]
description: Giant piles of grain are neatly kept in enormous bins in this large storage facility encased by four walls of thick granite rock.  Against the far wall, a multi-tiered malting rack houses a thin layer of grain on each level that is being continually misted by workers.  Huge vats of water stand nearby, soaking ample quantities of oats and barley.  A steady flow of malt-laden carts pass through a reinforced invar arch to the west, only to return empty.

title: [Furniture Foyer]
description: A series of tunnels branch off from this larger cavern, leading to numerous shops.  The smooth rock walls have been coated with a reflective metallic paint, augmenting the illumination provided by a few luminescent toadstools.  Occasionally, a dwarven janitor passes through, sweeping the floors and humming to himself.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Fleishort's Flooring]
description: A polished granite counter stands forefront in this tiny shop, situated in front of the wall dividing two tunnels to the west.  Samples of the available flooring are displayed on a wrought iron shelf, flanked by a pile of empty kegs.

title: [Torik's Beds]
description: A rolton wool rug spans a large area of the cold stone floor, with brightly painted pots housing luminescent toadstools placed at each corner.  Resting atop a pair of large, rounded boulders is a faux-maple board which serves as a makeshift counter for the shop.

title: [Darfler's Tables]
description: Colorful inked parchments nearly cover the limited wall space in this shop, each displaying one of the available tables that can be bought here.  A closed burlap curtain hangs behind a smooth granite counter, while several wooden crates are stacked up beside it.

title: [Clerane's Wall Hangings]
description: Sample decorative wall hangings adorn this cozy shop's smooth rock walls, arranged on a diagonal for an eye-catching display.  A three-legged stool and pink granite stand are the only other adornments.

title: [Sellivar's Heat Sources]
description: Noticeably warmer than its neighbors, this shop features an assortment of heat sources on display around the area.  A wrought iron stove radiates heat in the far corner, its fire tended to by a dwarven attendant.  A polished bell and a stack of papers sit atop a raised rock slab serving as a desk along the back wall.

title: [Bettleforth's Rugs]
description: Hung from thick metal pegs on the walls are a number of rugs and other floor coverings.  Several empty crates have been stacked in the corner beside a simple invar-braced table.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Gneiss Tunnel]
description: Some wide stairs lead from the granite quarry above into a layer of gneiss.  Thick, wavy bands of color characterize this stone, which has been formed by the extreme pressure exerted on granite during the formation of the mountain range.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Gneiss Tunnel]
description: Black and purple bands of stone ripple across the walls in this section of the tunnel.  Two large, ovoid formations of quartz stare out from the walls.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Zircon Mine]
description: The gneiss in this area has been mined for gem-quality zircons, several of which are still visible in the walls.  Hammers and chisels lie broken on the floor, and a smashed iron pail has apparently been emptied of its contents.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Gneiss Tunnel]
description: Pink and brown waves of gneiss create a soft mood in this section of the tunnel.  The air grows brackish and stale here in the most remote area of the cavern.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Garnet Mine]
description: The walls of this small mine remain studded with almandine garnets, despite the pockmarks that show where gems have been pried from the black and grey gneiss.  A thin layer of flaky stone covers one corner of the floor like dust.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Gneiss Tunnel]
description: In this section of the tunnel, the gneiss alternates bands of pink and grey stone.  A surprisingly optimistic spider has built a web in one corner of the nearly airless, dark, damp tunnel.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Hidden Tunnel]
description: An iron trapdoor covers the entrance to this hidden tunnel, which runs from the gneiss into a layer of schist below.  The high mica content of the schist creates an unstable environment as the stone breaks off in silvery flakes at the slightest disturbance.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Schist Tunnel]
description: Silvery dust covers the floor of this low, narrow tunnel.  The walls appear to have been scraped rather than cut, and three iron buckets have spilled their contents of flaky schist onto the ground.  You see several large emeralds embedded in the walls of the tunnel.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Schist Tunnel]
description: The air grows ever fainter as the tunnel narrows almost to an impassible width.  A well-used rock hammer, its wooden handle splintered from a forceful blow, pins a coat of chain mail to the wall.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Schist Tunnel]
description: It appears likely that the tunnel once proceeded further, until the ceiling was deliberately collapsed here.  A tiny block of black marble lies in the fallen schist.

title: [Warewic, Warewic and Mastil]
[Warewic, Warewic, and Mastil]
description: Behind the clear crystal of the granite counter is an assortment of prepared meats and other delectables.  Smoked, broiled, baked and even raw steaks from a dozen or more animals decorate the shop.  In the middle of the rear wall, a rhimar door seals off the cold storage area.  The counter itself is made from two great slabs of granite separated by a clear sheet of crystal.  The floor is freshly scrubbed, though a line of brown stains runs from the front door, behind the counter to the rhimar door.

title: [Hervina's Baubles]
description: Numerous small coffers and chests rest upon many carved stone shelves in the shop.  The soft white light cast from potted toadstools illuminates the sparkling wares for sale here.  Occasionally, gems will fall from a large hole in the back wall, accumulating in an iron-reinforced cart.  The jeweler carefully sorts them by type, color and quality into the surrounding containers, from which she harvests only the choicest jewels for her bauble creations.

title: [Dagresar's Furs]
description: A lone luminescent toadstool tries vainly to light all the corners in this small stone shop.  The walls, floor and ceiling are covered with furs, hides, and skins from nearly every creature across the lands.  A metal cabinet on the north wall contains teeth, bones, eyes, and other assorted parts, while two large large metal racks hold hides in various states of scraping and tanning.  From behind a low stone counter, the proprietor keeps an eye on his stock and customers.

title: [Bank of Zul Logoth]
description: Two heavily heavily barred windows set just above a small marble ledge are the only items of real interest in this barren yet elegant lobby.  The walls, ceiling and floor, though, speak of a wealth of silvers that have enriched the owners of the establishment.  Two dwarves mill about behind the windows, counting coins, writing notes, and conducting the customary bank business.  A gilded sign, affixed to the wall between the two windows, gives information on the use of the bank's services.

Two heavily barred windows set just above a small marble ledge are the only items of real interest in this barren yet elegant lobby.  The walls, ceiling and floor, though, speak of a wealth of silvers that have enriched the owners of the establishment.  Two dwarves mill about behind the windows, counting coins, writing notes, and conducting the customary bank business.  A gilded sign, affixed to the wall between the two windows, gives information on the use of the bank's services.

title: [Bank of Zul Logoth, Exchange]
description: A very elegant nook serves as the place of transaction for those wishing to convert currency or notes.  White marble walls, ceiling and floor with veins of gold coursing through them give the room a rich appearance.  Polished brass bars enclose the teller's window, and the toadstool that lights the room is set into a circular, polished brass pot.  Its one light is ample to illuminate the entire area brightly.

title: [Gust's Armory]
description: Adding to the cacophony and overall state of disarray in this cluttered little cave is the noise of the nearby forge.  Several tallow candles placed on mismatched sconces along the walls do little to penetrate the soot and smoke lingering heavily inside the shop.  Shields and armor of all sizes and shapes hang from hooks carved from the rough stone walls.

title: [Praeteria's Gems and Jewels]
description: A stocky, middle-aged dwarf works behind a long, low counter, sorting gems and purchasing jewels from miners.  A long, wide shelf behind her contains several boxes with various titles.  She purchases the gems, then sorts them into the boxes.  When a box becomes too full, she empties it onto a tray and shoves the tray through an opening in the back wall.  The only other furnishings in this sparse shop are some crates stacked against the south wall and two amber toadstools in stone pots.

title: [Praeteria's Trinkets and Curios]
description: Unmarked crates line the wall opposite a small doorway, beneath a series of stone shelves.  A dwarven assistant occasionally meanders in to sort and inventory the wares.  The lone illumination for this small room is a luminescent toadstool standing in the corner, its mottled cap just barely touching the ceiling.

title: [Hortemeyer's Pre-Owned Goods]
description: The metal shelves of this shop are crammed full of assorted knick knacks, weapons, armor, containers, and many types of unrecognizable items.  The shelves run from floor to ceiling on all four walls except where they are forced to allow customers to enter.  Several ladders lean against the shelves to facilitate retrieval of items from the upper levels.  Larger items occupy places on the floor.  In the midst of it all, an old dwarf totters around, using a cane for support as he straightens the displays.

title: [Hortemeyer's Resales]
description: This backroom contains several tables, a bright metal sign, and boxes piled upon boxes.  Several stacks have tumbled down or, were it not for the wall they encountered, would have tumbled down.  Markings on the boxes indicate origins from places both familiar and unfamiliar.  Several dwarven clerks paw through the boxes as if looking for certain ones.  From time to time, a clerk will grab one of the boxes and rush out, often returning with the same box and a puzzled look.

title: [Marcketel Mushroom Exporters]
description: A damp, earthy smell permeates this shop and the light-giving potted mushrooms seen everywhere in town are almost lost in the profusion of other fungi.  Trays of mushrooms in damp soil are racked on the walls using wire shelves.  Small polished rocks have been strung on twine to form a bead curtain between the storefront and kitchen.  Beside the curtain, a smooth slate counter holds a variety of mushroom-prepared foods.

title: [Brutarius Kodel Weaponry]
description: Three displays dominate this small shop.  A tall oak cabinet with a glass front rests against the north wall, while an oak display case occupies much of the west wall's area next to the door.  A narrow marble table nestles between the two displays.  The proprietor keeps a sharp eye on the customers from behind a U-shaped granite counter, and a curtain on the east wall apparently allows egress to another room.  The counter's shape completely blocks patrons from using this curtain.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Entry]
description: The heavy scent of pine tar mixes with the odor of ale and cooked delicacies. The sounds of revelry and the clink of mugs appear to come from beyond the stone arch.  Dwarves in assorted garb enter and go east or through the arch, though those dressed in rougher attire seem to prefer the arch.  The patrons entering also seem to be much less inebriated than those exiting.  The patrons tread over an expansive oval rug, and silhouettes of larger-than-life musical instruments hang on the walls.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Front Desk]
description: A low stone counter wraps around a small private space, providing a place for the innkeeper to do business separate from the customer area.  The counter is bare except for a ledger, a sign and a shiny brass bell.  Several tapestries depicting various famous dwarven bards hang from the austere timber-and-stone walls.  A dimly lit hallway leads off to the east.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Hallway]
description: The short hallway extends to the east, and a lone toadstool in a stone pot at the hallway's far end casts a pool of light to dimly illuminate the entire corridor.  Thick cedar timbers support both the granite walls and the sturdy cedar ceiling timbers at regular intervals, except where doors allow entrance to the sleeping rooms. Soft, thick green carpet muffles the sound of footsteps.  A faux-birch door occupies the south wall while a faux-maple door allows passage through the north wall.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Hallway]
description: The hallway comes to an end.  To the east, a lone toadstool rests in a large stone pot just in front of a bare granite wall.  The north and south walls as well as the ceiling are also granite, cut directly from the solid rock that supports the mountains hundreds, perhaps thousands, of feet overhead.  These are shored up by thick cedar timbers.  Thick green carpet provides the only vibrant coloration.  A faux-oak door breaks up the monotony of the south wall while a faux-walnut door breaches the north wall.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Music Shop]
description: Completely covering the low dome ceiling are a sea of brightly dyed tapestries woven with the glorified images of bards engrossed in their artistry.  Smooth stone ledges display a variety of musical instruments, ranging from the smallest flute to a gigantic set of bagpipes.  A red-bearded dwarven clerk sits behind an austere granite counter, assisting customers with their purchases.

title: [Percussion Room]
description: A perfectly circular room provides snug sleeping quarters.  White woolen carpet covers the floor from wall to wall, and cotton sheeting in the same white shade hides the ceiling.  The room's supporting timbers are painted a light grey, while the granite wall between the timbers is painted a vibrant shade of dark blue.  A metal frame bed rests against one wall, and a toadstool in a stone pot occupies a spot near the opposite wall.  A faux-birch door allows exit to the corridor just outside.

title: [Strings Room]
description: A short, narrow entry widens out into an oval-shaped room.  A bed abuts the wall at the room's north end, and a toadstool in a stone pot sits in the wider curve of the oval, easily lighting the entire room.  Umber carpet covers the floor, and five narrow black lines run north from the faux-walnut door on the south wall to disappear underneath the bed.  The curving granite wall encompassing the room and the ceiling are painted a matching umber color, though the timbers have been left in their natural state.

title: [Horn Room]
description: A long corridor-like room widens out at the south end, much like the bell on a horn.  A bed is placed against the wall at the wide end, and twin toadstools in large stone pots flank the bed to brightly light it.  Light golden carpet covers the floor, and the walls and ceiling are painted a similar color.  Given the bed's positioning and the room's length, one could easily take a running start and jump onto the bed, but the management might frown on that.

title: [Woodwind Room]
description: A long narrow room extends northward from the faux-maple door on the south wall.  The granite floor is painted a light sienna color, and small, black oval rugs affixed to the floor lead to the bed against the north wall.  The walls and ceiling match the floor in color.  Two toadstools in large stone pots, one near the door and one near the bed, illuminate the room with a soft amber-and-white glow.  No other furniture intrudes upon the rather austere setting.

title: [J.M. and Descendants, Foyer]
description: A small, entry room forms a T-shaped intersection with larger shops to the north and south.  Occasionally the sound of metal grinding on metal comes from either direction, and sometimes from both directions simultaneously.  Overhead, a large, tightly woven metal mesh cage houses a goodly number of fireflies, and their winking on and off illuminates the room with a soft strobe effect.  A metal sign affixed to the west wall offers a directory of services, and a heavy black door provides an exit.

title: [J.M. and Descendants, Werstel]
description: A long counter extends from the north wall nearly to the south wall, splitting the room neatly in half.  Two large stone pots, one on either side of the counter, house luminescent toadstools, their glowing caps providing ample light by which to conduct trade.  Behind the counter a smiling dwarf goes about the business of opening boxes, creating lockpicks, and cheerfully helping customers.  A metal work table abuts the west wall, behind the counter, and a sign resides on the counter.

title: [J.M. and Descendants, Warstel]
description: A long counter extends from the south wall nearly to the north wall, splitting the room neatly in half.  Two large stone pots, one on either side of the counter, house luminescent toadstools, their glowing caps providing ample light by which to conduct trade.  Behind the counter a serious dwarf goes about the business of repairing lockpicks and stoically helping customers.  A metal work table abuts the west wall, behind the counter, and a sign resides on the counter.

title: [Zul Logoth General Store]
description: All the varied dry goods that a dwarf would need for day-to-day living seem to be on display in this store.  The displays may seem more packed, however, because the store itself is so very small.  A sales desk sits near the south wall and provides a place where the proprietor can transact business.  Pushed into a corner, one tall toadstool in a lone stone pot does its best to light the area.  The only means of exit is through a crude stone arch.

title: [Rockslinger Relocation Services]
description: Several crates stand in one corner, all marked with the same destination.  The rest of the room is austere.  Only a stone desk and straight-backed chair break up the monotony of a grey granite floor, grey granite walls, and grey granite ceiling.  Two huge luminescent toadstools in large stone pots, each occupying opposite corners, appear sufficient to light the room.  A steel door allows exit to the corridors of Zul Logoth, a dark hallway extends to the west, and a wide corridor extends south.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east and west, although quite a bit of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on either side are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east, although a faint bit of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on the north and south sides are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

title: [Rockslinger's, Annex Corridor]
description: A long, wide corridor extends north and south, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  To the north the corridor widens out into a spacious room, while to the south extends more corridor.

title: [Rockslinger's, Annex Corridor]
description: A long, wide corridor extends north and west, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  More corridor extends north and west.

A long, wide corridor extends north and south, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  More corridor extends north and south.

title: [Rockslinger's, Annex Corridor]
description: A long, wide corridor extends north and west, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  More corridor extends east and west.

title: [Rockslinger's, Annex Corridor]
description: A long, wide corridor extends north and west, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  More corridor extends east and west.

title: [Chocolate Shop]
description: A wide, gold-trimmed window looks out into the Sapphire Tunnel.  The faces of dwarven children are occasionally pressed against the glass as they admire the wares within.  Displayed on a polished granite shelf in the window is a breathtaking assortment of chocolates.  A long glaes counter also holds an assortment of mouthwatering delectables.  The savory scents of chocolate and other goodies permeates the air.

title: [Lucretia's Fashions]
description: A pair of dwarven-proportioned mannequins, one covered in leather and one in suede, frame each side of the doorway, staring across a narrow aisle at each other.  Beyond one mannequin, hooks have been carved from the living stone of the wall, but remain empty while the opposite side has been formed into a large rack.  The back wall of this cozy shop has been taken up by a motif of a golden suede anvil on a wide brown leather backing.

title: [Zul Logoth, Constabulary]
description: A massive metal desk dominates this office.  Perhaps it is not that the desk is so massive, though, but that the office is so very small.  The surface of the desk is rather clean, though, as if the constable is either very organized, caught up on his work, or both.  Toward the back of the office, a barred doorway leads into a dimly-lit area.

title: [Zul Logoth Salt Exporters]
description: Great grey bins of salt line the stone walls of the warehouse.  Tucked away in one corner is a small refreshment stand with a cluster of dwarves and other travelers surrounding it.  The air here is dry and white salt crystals are tracked everywhere across the floor, even spilling out the wide sliding metal door that leads into the main tunnels.

title: [Brother Barnstel's Herbals]
description: The tops of large large wooden casks line the back wall, the bodies of the casks imbedded in the wall and the bulk of the containers perhaps sticking out in some room behind.  Only the tops are visible here.  Smaller containers sit neatly stacked on the floor in front of the barrel-lined wall, and the odor of cooking herbs pervades the small shop.  A long stone counter traverses the shop from wall to wall, separating the medicinal area from the customer area.

title: [Sister Cocytel's Hospice]
description: Blood-splattered beams line blood-splattered walls and cross a relatively unmarred ceiling in this small healing room.  A few uncomfortable stone slabs occupy places near the walls, and the granite's light grey color in the corners indicates that the floor was not intended to be reddish brown.  A pile of dirty rags nestles in a far corner, and a stone arch provides an exit from the room.  The scent of drying blood and medicinal preparations hangs heavy in the air.

title: [A Short Hallway]
description: This short hallway runs only a few feet to the west before giving way to a narrow passageway.  The hallway's stone walls and ceiling are not shored, but they seem solid enough.  From the look of the various medical items heaped against the south wall, the Healer Cocytel probably uses this area for storage, though her organizational habits certainly leave a lot to be desired.  Although large, the pile of items does not conceal the small door which is set into the south wall.

title: [Father Horndel's Holy Artifacts]
description: A coat of pure white paint adorns the walls, reflecting the soft illumination of golden candelabras placed at the four corners of the chamber.  Fragrant smoke flows out of an invar-wrought censer suspended by a thick chain from the center of the ceiling.  Holy relics are beautifully displayed on shelves protected by clear glaes.  A massive anvil sits atop four solid stone blocks and has been draped with a richly embroidered cloth to serve as a counter.

title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
description: Roughly hewn, unfinished timbers support a ceiling and chiseled walls that still bear the marks of the miner's pick.  The only attempts at finishing seem to have been limited to the floor.  Though it is fairly level and smooth, a thick carpet of dust and mining debris makes footing hazardous.  A lone amber toadstool in a stone pot lights the passageway, and a pair of steel rails follow the east wall, disappearing through closed doors at the north end of the tunnel.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
description: The tunnel gently curves north and southeast.  Though easily overlooked in traversing tunnel's length, the southeast end seems to be somewhat higher than the north end, possibly the result of the miners following a vein of ore as they excavated in that direction.  The temperature also changes noticeably between ends, although the climate is uniformly dry.  The tunnel's southeast end is much cooler than the north end.  A pair of steel rails parallels the east wall.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
description: The intersection of three tunnels forms a rough Y-shape.  Judging from the condition of the floor and the coloration of the supporting timbers, the tunnels to the northwest and south appear to be older than the tunnel to the southeast.  The steel rails also follow the northwest and south tunnels, crossing over the entrance to the southeast tunnel.  A single amber toadstool in a stone pot casts a baleful light across the tunnels' convergence.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
description: To the north the tunnel slopes slowly downward, while to the south it levels out as it approaches a granite arch.  The sounds of picks on stone and rumbling carts emanate from beyond the arch.  A guard leans against the arch, carefully eyeing those that move in and out and occasionally exchanging a word or two with them.  One amber toadstool in a stone pot resides next to the arch, providing a little light for the guard and a bit of illumination for the rest of the mining tunnel.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
description: The tunnel proceeds perhaps six yards to the southeast before stopping abruptly.  Weak traces of quartz snake through the granite, but no mining appears to be going on here at the moment.  Several long, timbers lie strewn about, perhaps to be used for shoring up later excavation, and a heavy pile of rubble is heaped against the west wall.  A wide crevice yawns in the east wall, a few feet from the tunnel's end, and an unmoving waterfall of bones cascades out to the tunnel floor.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: A huge pile of bones slopes upward to the east, the dry white cascade hemmed in by rock formations to the north, south and west.  No rock floor presents itself, though, and the depth of the bones is indiscernible.  All types of bones litter the area, including skulls, femurs, tibias, ulnas, vertebrae, and other assorted bones from large bipedal creatures.  The size and shape of the bones are quite suggestive of trolls.  The rock face on the west wall has collapsed somewhat, revealing a wide crevice.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Thousands of fireflies flit to and fro in the air above the bones.  Exactly what the attraction is for the fireflies is unknown, but their heatless lights wink on and off, illuminating the surrounding area in an eerily shifting, cold light.  Occasionally a bat wings through, mouth agape, harvesting the fireflies and leaving an empty swath in the firefly constellation.  Slowly, though, the fireflies fill the emptiness until the air seems once again occupied by evenly spaced fireflies.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The huge pile of bones slants down toward you from the southeast then splits into three directions, continuing on down to the northwest, northeast and southwest. Occasionally the pile itself seems to shift just a bit, or quiver a bit, rising or falling just slightly.  Even individual bones appear to move, sliding across other bones or rolling a bit before stopping.  This would not seem so very strange if the movements were not uphill at times.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southwest, up, down

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The pile of bones peaks, flowing away to the east, south and northwest.  Barely decomposed troll bodies lie atop heavily decomposed troll bodies, and some bodies have rolled far down the mountain of bones regardless of their state.  The wind's soft whistling reaches your ears from somewhere far above, its source lost in the inky blackness of the cavern's roof.  The stench of rotting flesh assails your nostrils, and, although breathing is not difficult, it is rather unpleasant.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: For a place full of dead bones, the caverns are alive with noise.  Undertaker bat squeaks echo out of the gloom, mostly from the darkened ceiling.  Occasionally the sound of a bat's flapping passes from one direction to another as the creature flies through, unseen.  Shrieks, cries and moans emanate from the very pile of bones itself, the sounds reverberating off the walls and pillars to finally fade away in the distance.  It is a sheer cacophony of sound, and silence would be welcome.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, west, down

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The bone slope funnels tightly between a granite wall on the east and a granite pillar on the west, dropping to the north and northwest while rising to the south and southwest.  A dark opening recedes into the stone high up on the granite wall, but there appears to be no way to scale the wall and reach the opening.  The remains of a rope ladder, twisted and brittle, entwine around the bones at the base of the wall, but nothing hangs down from above.
paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, northwest, down

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: White, bleached, powdery bones flow in from the west and slide downhill to the north.  The level is roughly the same to the east, and little migration occurs in that direction.  The bones are desiccated, their porous surfaces heavily scraped from the tumbling they have received on their way down from above or the stirring from the heaving movements below.  The dry bones create an extremely arid environment, with the moisture sucked out of the air, leaving it temperate but dehydrated.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, up, down

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The flow of bones reaches its end in this direction, and there is no outlet to allow the flow to continue.  The bones slide in through an aperture in the southern wall, but on all other sides the granite walls are solid and impenetrable.  A single stalagmite has formed near the northeast curve in the granite walls.  Its accompanying stalactite, if it even exists, is nowhere to be seen, and perhaps it still hangs far above in the darkness.  The stalagmite is quite curious in shape.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Hemmed in to the east and north by unscalable granite walls, the bones tumble down from the south to pile up in this dark, dry corner.  The level of the bones seems about the same to the west, though, and perhaps a different flow fills that area.  The cries of hundreds of bats descend from above, reverberating off the granite walls and the piled bones to create a painful cacophony of sound.  The presence of so many bats brings another annoying feature to the area: bat guano.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Bones flow in a wide, bending river from the southwest to the east.  Black granite walls rise to the north and northeast, their flat vertical surfaces extending far off into the overhead darkness.  To the southeast, a huge pillar bursts from among the bones and climbs straight up to wherever the canopy resides.  The canopy's height is unknown, as the only way to find it seems to be through the use of imprecise echoes.  For all one knows it may be just as far down to the granite floor, too.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Cascading downhill from the southeast, the bones form a small bone lake hemmed in by granite walls on the east, southwest, west, and northwest.  Eventually the incoming bones become too much for the area, and they slide off to the northeast.  Slender dry stalagmites dot the bone lake, their pointed fingers reaching up toward the gloom-shrouded ceiling.  In one small area, several stalactites hang down, attempting to reach their counterparts.  The absence of moisture will doom the attempt.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The bones gravitate slowly down from the west, their movement imperceptible.  A sheer granite wall blocks the flow of bones from proceeding eastward, diverting them instead to the north and south.  A temperate wind blows through the area, generally following the flow of bones in from the west and moving out to the north.  As the wind moves across the field of dry bones, the skeletal pieces suck the moisture out of the air, leaving it to course along as an arid, intermittent breeze.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The sloping sea of bones and the vertical walls are barely visible in the dim, flickering light provided by the fireflies.  Their abdomens wink on and off, and, individually, would not be enough to light much of anything.  Given the amount of fireflies, though, the area is bathed in a wavering, barely perceptible green glow.  The strobe effect from so many fireflies makes it seem as if many of the bones are moving slightly, but it must be a trick of the light.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The bones continue to flow imperceptibly to the southeast, southwest, and west, with a slightly steeper drop to the southwest.  To the east, barely noticeable in the firefly-lit gloom, the lip of a large crater rises a couple of feet above the bones.  The crater's sides are rough granite of the same composition as the surrounding walls and have served thus far to channel the bones around the hole to other parts of the cavern. A few more centuries and the crater itself may become the bone repository.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, west, down

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The stench of death pools against the western wall, filling the area with the near-overpowering odor of decomposing flesh.  Small pieces of flesh still cling to many of the bones that litter the top of the bone river, putrefying and rotting away slowly in the dry conditions.  The odor of decay seems to be everywhere in the cavern, but, for some odd reason, is particularly nauseous at this juncture. Perhaps it is because the air doesn't seem to move at all here.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The flickering light cast by the fireflies reflects off something metallic near the west wall.  A metal breastplate, badly corroded but in one piece, rests mostly buried in the jumbled bones.  Its straps are wrapped around several of the larger bones, which are, in turn, entwined with other bones.  The straps are strong enough, and the weight of the bones heavy enough, that the breastplate refuses to budge.  Even if it could be freed, it is in such bad shape that it would be worthless.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: High-pitched chittering and squeaking resound from somewhere in the darkness far above.  Often the sounds are punctuated by the flapping of wings as something flies away into the cavern, the flapping growing fainter and fainter before disappearing.  The bones here are covered with bat guano, both dried and moist, though the dried portions seem to quickly turn to powder that filters down through the spaces between the tightly packed bones.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: A wide chasm yawns from wall to wall, effectively cutting off travel to the east.  Occasionally a bone spills into the chasm, glancing off the walls with a thwacking sound on its way down, yet there is no clattering sound as one would expect to hear when it hits bottom.  A dark spot looms across the chasm, but it is too far away to tell if it is a grotto or merely a wide, curved spot of darker granite on the opposite wall.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The pile of bones slopes westward, hemmed in by high granite walls.  Walking is treacherous, each step shifting the pile and causing individual bones to roll underfoot.  As the pile shifts, the putrescent odor of rotting flesh is exacerbated.  The sound of undertaker bats high in the darkness reverberates through the area.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Clouds of fireflies swarm above the pile of bones, providing an eerily shifting, cold light.  It is difficult to find stable footing through the pile of bones, especially in the dim light provided by the fireflies.  The depth of the sea of bones is as indeterminable as the height of the ceiling.  Occasionally, the sounds of wings flapping high overhead and the scurrying of rodents in the pile echo through the room.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Vertical black walls hem in the large pile of bones, the pile higher on one wall than the other, as if someone had been digging through the pile in that area.  Though the pile has been disturbed in places, no floor is visible to make crossing the bones any easier.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Bones flow east to west, hemmed in by the high granite walls.  The stench of death is overpowering and any movement of the sea of bones serves to renew the putrescent odor.  Occasionally, rats can be seen darting over and through the piles of bones, their chittering and squeaking accentuated in the thick, malodorous air.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The flow of bones continues to the east and west seemingly without end.  The smell of bat guano mingles with the stinking rot and decay that is ever present in these caverns.  Firefly light occasionally glints off tiny bits of metallic substances buried in the midst of the stark whiteness of the endless sea of bones.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The high granite walls appear closer together here, narrowing toward the west.  The flow of bones continues east and west and is packed slightly tighter between the walls, making the footing a touch less treacherous.  The pitted surface of the walls provides decent handholds for use in crossing the path of bones.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: A single, conical stalagmite thrusts up through the sea of bones in the center of the room.  The space between the walls has narrowed considerably and it is a tight squeeze between the stalagmite and the walls.  To make matters worse, the closeness of the room has intensified the stench of decay, making breathing difficult.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The high walls narrow to the east and west, but open up into a huge circular chamber here.  Swarms of fireflies flit to and fro over the bones, providing dim, flickering light in the gloom.  The pile of bones flattens out somewhat, though the depth of it is still undeterminable.  Several pillars surround the chamber, their height extending upwards into the darkness.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The sea of bones filters into this room from the large chamber to the east, the narrowness of the walls forcing the bones into sloping piles.  The unstable surface makes walking difficult, the bones shifting with each step, exposing potentially dangerous broken points of bone or bits of rusted metal.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The walls narrow even further here, making it possible to stand atop the pile of bones and touch each wall with an outstretched arm.  Undertaker bats have been particularly active in this room, evidenced by the large amount of bat guano covering most surfaces.  Dust and bits of dried guano, kicked up by scavenging rats, mingle with the thick, rotting air.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The sea of bones ends abruptly at a flat, black granite wall.  Piled high against the far wall and spilling back toward the west, the sloping bones make it difficult to stand in this room.  The perpetual smell of death and decay culminates into an overpowering, almost palpable stench in this nearly closed-off room.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Very little flesh remains on the bones that have drifted down to this area.  Still, hundreds of rats scrabble and claw through the bones in hopes of finding even a small piece of decomposing, gristly flesh to consume.  The rats dart from bone to bone, living a precarious existence as they attempt to find sustenance while avoiding the predatory undertaker bats.  Tempers flare as two rats fight over a bone each one wants, their battle punctuated by shrieks and squealings.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southwest, up, down

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Fireflies flit, whirl and hover above the thick layer of bones, their abdomens winking on and off in small flashing displays of emerald light.  The light does nothing to warm the area, though, and the dim green cast only adds to the impression of lifeless scenery.  White bones, black walls, and pale green light combine to create an eerie starkness to the landscape.  It might even be a serene starkness were it not for the cries, moans and roars that come from deep within the piled bones.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: The cascade of bones becomes steeper as it flows in from the east and out to the west, south and southwest, as if a radical change in the cavern's stone floor occurs somewhere down below.  The dry air makes breathing laborious, and dust rises easily, stirred up by even the slightest disturbance in the area.  The bones underfoot do not provide a sturdy walking surface, but instead shift downhill when only a little pressure is applied.
paths: Obvious exits: south, west, up, down

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: High granite walls hem in the area on the north and west sides, blocking the flow of bones and channeling them off to the south.  Despite the heavy gloom, an interesting formation is evident on the west wall.  The stalagmites are tightly bunched and extremely narrow, forming cylinders of various sizes that creep up the wall.  In many places these cylinders have broken open, leaving holes in the stalagmites and making the formation look like a long series of panpipes.

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Dry bones pile against the western wall and slope down to the southeast.  In the southwestern corner, a relatively small stalagmite shows that water still affects at least this very small area.  The stalagmite is moist, and its sides display recent mineral deposits.  Even more indication of water's effects resides at the stalagmite's base.  The bones surrounding the base do not just abut it, but have actually become part of the stalagmite as the minerals have coated and hardened around them.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, up, down

title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
description: Vertical, black walls hem in the area on the east, south and west sides. The flow of bones descends from the north and northwest but does not quite reach the boundary walls.  The granite floor of the cavern is exposed here and proves to be no different in composition than the walls.  Many of the bones lie scattered across the floor instead of neatly bunched up with the others, as if someone or something has come through, kicking the bones around as it proceeded.

title: [Dwarven Lineage]
description: Detailed emblems from the dwarven clans are displayed prominently upon the drab stone walls, while a miniature model of Kalaza rests upon a table in the middle of the shop.  The faint odor of ale permeates the air, though its exact source isn't visible.  Residing in the corners are large stone pots, illuminating the chamber with a cheerful white and amber light.

title: [Granite Building, Foyer]
description: Inlaid into the smooth stone floor is a giant ring rendered in intertwined gold and brass.  A lacquered rosewood desk sits before the back wall, along with a comfortable high-backed chair.  Heavy, grey velvet curtains have been draped across a pair of arches for a touch of privacy.

title: [Granite Building, Departure]
description: Carved into the granite walls are a series of landscapes from around Elanthia, worked in great detail.  Several thick-cushioned chairs have been arranged neatly around the room for waiting patrons.

title: [Granite Building, Arrival]
description: Intricate bas-reliefs of the DragonSpine have been carved into the granite walls of this circular chamber.  A luminescent toadstool rests within an alcove, casting a cheerful, soft white light against the stone.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stone Courtyard]
description: Giant luminescent toadstools planted in neat rows along the perimeter cast a soft, bluish-white light upon the small courtyard.  A wide, limestone and slate walkway encircles an ametrine geode fountain midway between the dark mithril arch leading to the main tunnel and a domed white granite building with heavy marble doors.  The faint aroma of loam and brine lingers in the air.

title: [Wizard Guild, Antechamber]
description: Five tall, silver-flecked pillars support the domed ceiling, spaced evenly around the periphery of the antechamber.  A deep blue granite stele stands alone in the center of the floor in front of a winding stairway.

title: [Wizard Guild, First Stratum]
description: Twin, narrow stairs spiral steeply downward, providing access to the lower levels of the guild.  Through the circular opening in the floor, the other strata are clearly visible.  A pair of agate-inset doors lies within the northwest wall, facing some quartz-inset doors to the southeast.

title: [Wizard Guild, Second Stratum]
description: A few potted luminescent toadstools shed diffuse light upon the silver-flecked cobalt blue marble.  Embossed runes adorn the wall around the mithril-framed doors to the north while an azurite-inset door stands to the south.

title: [Wizard Guild, Third Stratum]
description: Polished blocks of marble give way to natural rock in the structure of the third stratum.  A shallow alcove lies across the way from a well-lit tunnel to the northwest.  Roughly hewn into the wall to the east is a large opening, allowing passage below.

title: [Wizard Guild, Storage Room]
description: A handful of shelving units occupies this small room, stocked with the supplies needed for the daily activity of the guild.  Inventory lists penned in a meticulous hand have been tacked to the sides of each container.  Standing in the far corner is a sturdy invar cabinet, beside a few nondescript robes hanging on a rack.

title: [Wizard Guild, Tunnel]
description: Though the walls are unevenly carved, the floor has been smoothened by the feet of wizards over time.  A single glowing toadstool lights this narrow tunnel, ending at a rune-etched door.

title: [Wizard Guild, Magical Workshop]
description: Brilliant white marble comprises the structure of this chamber, with runes inscribed along the seams.  A single, glowing crystal has been imbedded in the domed ceiling just above a burnished mithril table at the heart of the workshop.  Housed within a series of shallow ledges that have been carved into the wall are a wide variety of potions, alembics, and phials.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cavern of Lava]
description: A reddish glow washes over the rocky walls and stalactites, emanating from a fissure that bisects the cavern from north to south.  High above the river of molten rock, a pair of sturdy glaes bridges adjoins the two sides of the cavern.  Several of the larger stalagmites situated in a rough circle have been carved into monoliths bearing giant engraved runes of the elements.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: Woven tapestries adorn the walls, depicting the intense, red lava flows deep beneath the earth and the windy, icy peaks of the DragonSpine.  Within the northeast corner of this tidy office, a full runestave rack has been draped with an embroidered canvas.  Neatly bundled scrolls lie in a wire basket alongside blank pieces of parchment and an inkwell on a gold-flecked blue marble desk.

title: [The Waggler's Warehouse]
description: Reflective tiles of polished steel have been deeply imbedded into the natural walls in a repeating pattern of diamonds.  A navy blue wool curtain drapes across a small passageway leading into the shop's storage area, though access to it is restricted by an expansive granite counter.  Prominently displayed on a series of wrought iron tables and racks are magical devices and tools of differing origin, each merely a small example of the wares for sale.

title: [The Waggler's, Consignment]
description: Mirrors line the walls of this shop from east to west, multiplying the tiniest amount of light to create a well-lit area.  Many objects are stockpiled, offering a cluttered appearance.

title: [The Waggler's, Used Emporium]
description: The back of shop empties out into a desolate nook, a stark contrast to the front.  A simple stone table guards the corner, undisturbed, as a metallic scent hangs heavily in the air.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Cavern]
description: A small but well-lit cavern surrounds a building carved from the mountain itself.  A gold-veined rolaren path leads to a large stone entryway in the side of the hall.  Several torches burn brightly along the path, lighting the cavern's smooth walls and ceiling.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The walls of the tunnel are cool and dry to the touch.  Carved out of redstone, the tunnel is wide enough and tall enough to accommodate three giantmen walking abreast.  A phosphorescent mineral vein through the redstone provides a dim light.  The tunnel slopes gradually to the southwest deeper into the earth.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: With the exception of an occasional crevice, the redstone walls are worn smooth here.  Small piles of rubble on the floor make travel through the area slow.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Small blue lichen grows along the base of the wall, its putrid odor assailing your senses.  The lichen clings to the phosphorescent minerals that provide the only light in the area.  The walls of the tunnel are narrower, but there is still ample room to walk easily.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Small Cavern]
description: The tunnel widens here into a small cavern, the walls like flowing stone waterfalls.  The dim light in the cavern is enough to see that the flowstone formations vary in color, forming random patterns of red, yellow, green and white.  A passage to the southeast leads further down into the earth.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The floor of the tunnel is uneven here and the footing difficult.  Several fossils imbedded into the tunnel walls are visible.  About the length of a human finger, the fossils look like centipedes.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel narrows and slopes more steeply to the southeast.  The walls of the tunnel are rough here, small crevices and niches dimly illuminated with phosphorescent minerals.  The sound of something scratching seems to come from all directions.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Gypsum Cavern]
description: The dim phosphorescent light is magnified by thousands of crystal formations.  White and gold flower-like structures of gypsum ooze and curl like icing from the walls, ceiling and floor.  Chittering sounds echo through the cavern.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Gypsum Cavern]
description: The floor of the cavern is covered with gypsum formations, making navigation through this cavern treacherous.  The speleotherms seem to grow magically from the walls, ceiling and floor of the cavern.  A dark niche is visible to the southeast.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Dark Niche]
description: Darkness engulfs this small niche, which is almost completely enclosed by stone walls.  The phosphorescent minerals that provided dim light throughout the tunnels do not exist here.  Surprisingly, the air in the niche is moving slightly.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Assorted bits of rubble and stones make travel through this area slow.  The tunnel continues in a downward slope to the northeast and widens to the southwest into a small cavern.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel walls are damp and pitted here.  Long streaks are visible on the floor, seemingly scratched into it.  Thin veins of phosphorescent minerals weave their way through the stone walls.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Sections of the wall have collapsed here, rubble and debris scattered throughout the tunnel creating obstacles.  Amid the debris several bones can be seen, most of them snapped and splintered.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The air is stale and dry here.  Large amounts of debris seem to have settled here when the walls to the southeast crumbled.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Piles of debris and rocks hamper passage to the northeast as the tunnel continues downward to the southwest.  Fossils pockmark the walls amid small cracks and crevices.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel has widened and passage is relatively easy here.  A rank, acidic odor emanates from the southwest.  What appear to be skeletal remains jut out from behind a pile of rubble.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel walls are pitted with crevices and close in here, leaving just enough room for two giantmen to stand abreast.  The rank, acidic odor is very strong, causing your eyes and nose to burn and water.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Thin drapery formations, hanging in folds along the wall, cast eerie shadows in the dim phosphorescent light.  Several fossils are visible in the formations.  The tunnel curves upwards to the northeast and deeper into the earth to the southeast.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Despite the distant sound of water dripping, the air here is dry and stale, with a faint acidic odor coming from the southeast.  Several large bones lie in a pile against one wall.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Fumes assail the senses in this area of the tunnel, leaving your throat dry and a metallic taste in your mouth.  Crevices pockmark the walls of the tunnel, barely visible in the dim light.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Cavern]
description: Broad stalagmites grow up from the cavern floor, reaching up to the stalactites above them.  The sound of water dripping can be heard echoing throughout the cavern as nature continues to build here.  Floor-to-ceiling columns appear to support the roof of the cavern.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Cavern]
description: The cavern's ceiling is lower here and covered with thousands of thin hollow tubes growing towards the floor.  Water drips from the thin tubes, creating conical stalagmites on the floor.  Something has caused several stalagmites to be broken off, forming a passage through the cavern.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel walls are rough and jagged, with numerous pieces broken off and strewn about amid several long thin cracks and crevices that snake across the floor of the tunnel.  Occasional acrid clouds burst from the crevices, burning the eyes and nose.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A large curve in the tunnel winds down to the northwest and veins of phosphorescent minerals dimly illuminate several fossils along one wall.  Looking much like a common centipede, the fossils are about the size of a wolverine.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The walls close in and the grade is much steeper, making passage perilous.  Odd scratching sounds can be heard, but it is impossible to tell where they originate.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A portion of the tunnel ceiling has caved in here, leaving a mound of rubble in the path blocking further passage to the northwest.  Strangely, the air here is not still - though stale smelling, it circulates through the area.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A large mound of rubble slopes steeply up towards the northeast, blocking passage in that direction.  Mingled with the steady sound of water dripping, strange scraping and chittering noises can be heard.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A strange formation on the northwest wall of the tunnel appears to be outlined in phosphorescence, giving it an eerie glow.  A faint, acrid odor is discernable as dry air moves through the tunnel.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Gypsum flowers and needles poke out from the walls, the sharp points on the needle formations capable of inflicting painful damage.  The acrid odor is much stronger here and emanates from long thin fissures in the floor.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A sharp curve in the tunnel leads deeper into the earth to the southeast.  The northern wall of the tunnel is lined with columns created when stalagmites and stalactites joined, formed so close as to become a solid wall.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Mineral-rich water slowly drips down the walls of the tunnel, creating a small pool of water at the base.  Phosphorescent minerals beneath the pool create a surrealistic glow.  A faint acrid odor comes from the southeast.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel slopes down to the southeast and appears to curve northward in the distance.  Breathing is difficult as acrid fumes bubble up from small pools in crevices along the base of the tunnel walls.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A sharp curve in the tunnel allows passage to either the northeast or northwest.  The sound of dripping water echoes through the air, seeming to come from all directions.  A faint chittering is heard among the echoes.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel slopes steeply here, making it difficult to maintain your footing, and the smooth ground offers little traction.  Small veins of silver are visible on the tunnel walls.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A large indentation along the southern wall looks as though something tried to burrow a new tunnel.  The phosphorescent glow is more pronounced here, casting an eerie luminescence about the tunnel.  The tunnel opens wider to the northeast and the air feels damper.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Small Cavern]
description: Water seeping along cracks in the ceiling has created translucent draperies along the walls of the cavern.  Bands of color in hues of brown and orange tint the draperies, indicating traces of different minerals.  Moisture from the walls leaves a thin slippery coating on the cavern floor.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: A heap of boulders blocks what might have once been an adjacent tunnel to the west, indicating a possible cave-in here.  The walls in this section of tunnel are cracked and filled with crevices, as if under great stress.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Great Cavern]
description: The walls of the tunnel fall away and the ceiling rises dramatically as a colossal cavern opens up to the southwest.  An abundance of phosphorescent minerals illuminates the cavern enough to see magnificent looping helictite crystals, walls of flowstone drapery, gypsum flowers, towering columns, stalactites and stalagmites.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Great Cavern]
description: A large murky, bubbling, rimstone pool occupies the center of the cavern.  Enormous stalactites hang down from the cavern's roof, dripping into the murky pool.  A rancid odor emanates from the murky pool and occasional gas bubbles burst on its green oily surface.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Great Cavern]
description: Drops of water fall into the holes of a bottle-shaped flowstone formation, creating a drumming sound that echoes throughout the cavern and sounds like a distant moaning.  The floor of the cavern is slick and treacherous.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Great Cavern]
description: Along the edge of the murky pool, beaded helictite looks like thousands of pearls.  A large outcrop of gypsum flowers grows at the pool's edge.  If not for the rancid odors, this would be a magnificent cavern.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Great Cavern]
description: The roof of the cavern dips here and shining crystals of gypsum are visible in hundreds of cracks and crevices.  A pile of limestone and gypsum on the floor blocks passage into an eastern crevice.
The roof of the cavern dips here and shining crystals of gypsum are visible in hundreds of cracks and crevices.  A pile of limestone and gypsum on the floor lays beside an eastern crevice.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Shaft]
description: A shaft rises high above, its top lost in darkness.  Phosphorescent minerals dimly illuminating the shaft's lower end reveal little to hold onto.  A narrow crevice to the northwest is visible in the dim light.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Rancid Pool]
description: You are in a murky, rancid pool.  Putrid fumes from the pool make your eyes tear and your skin burn.  Although the pool is not deep, it is difficult to gain a sure footing on the slippery bottom.

title: [Khazar's Hold, Grotto]
description: Three large tents are pitched in the quiet corner of the grotto.  Tall weeds have grown in the small amounts of soil that have collected in the calm areas against the tents and rock face.  The small cavern has been carved into the mountainside slightly, and the stone wall arcs somewhat overhead.

title: [Khazar's Hold, Ledge]
description: Most of the permanent residents of the village live here on a less-traveled section of the ledge.  A threadbare tent is tied down with crude metal spikes hammered into the solid rock.  The wind ruffles the cloth of the tent with every gust.  A patch of dirt covers the ledge's surface, some blades of long grass have taken hold in the small amount of soil.

title: [Tregg's Tavern]
description: Half-rotten beams precariously hold up the old roof of the tavern.  Bursts of air rush through the open windows and cracks in the walls, creating a chilly draft.  Grimy unfinished tables and chairs are scattered across the uneven floor.  Glasses of different shapes, sizes and colors sit on top of a shoddy rough shelf on the back wall.

title: [Tregg's Tavern, Hallway]
description: Two private rooms are opposite each other on this narrow hall, both with sturdy and latching doors.  The walls and ceiling are bare.  Nothing but the old wooden walls decorate the passage.  Dust from the rotting wood of the walls and ceiling floats through the air.  The clinking of glass and mumbling from the patrons of the bar drifts in from the tavern.

title: [Tregg's Tavern, Iron Room]
description: A carved oak armoire and a polished oak writer's desk are pushed up against the wall opposite the door.  Scarlet red drapes stifle nearly all of the light from the outside.  Tall white candles in iron candlesticks add a soft light to the room.  A dark, iron-framed bed lies under the window, the covers turned down and pillow fluffed perfectly at the head.

title: [Tregg's Tavern, Brass Room]
description: In a sharp contrast to the rest of the tavern, this room is very well decorated.  Tapestries of mountain and forest scenes hang on the walls, and thick carpeting runs from wall to wall.  Elaborate candelabras stand in each corner, each filled with fresh scented candles.  The window is crystal clear, overlooking the southern section of the valley, the dim moonlight providing just enough light to see the features of the surrounding mountains.

In a sharp contrast to the rest of the tavern, this room is very well decorated.  Tapestries of mountain and forest scenes hang on the walls, and thick carpeting runs from wall to wall.  Elaborate candelabras stand in each corner, each filled with fresh scented candles.  The window is crystal clear, overlooking the southern section of the valley.

title: [Khazar's Hold, Ledge]
description: Dimly glowing spots of light eerily light and fade away in the valley.  Dim moonlight reflects off of the snow-capped mountains to the north.  The cold wind whips around the mountains, raising the little dust that litters the ground.

This part of the ledge offers a spectacular view of the top of the Dead Plateau which lies beyond the Glo'antern Moor.  A few lush green treetops poke through the mists in the valley.  The sounds of the dwarven settlement to the northwest echoes off of the solid rock walls of the surrounding mountains.

title: [Locksmehr River, Wiley Island]
description: A muskrat splashes quickly into the water, startled by your approach.  Its den is barely visible in the reeds that grow at the river's side, sheltered by a group of mired logs that divert the river's force away.  The river hurls past, deep and swift, carrying everything it can grasp quickly downstream.  A thick rope dangles over the water a bit upstream, and thus far it appears to be the only passage to the western bank.

title: [Locksmehr River, Wiley Island]
description: The sound of rushing waters comes from both sides, although quite a bit louder from the west.  Birches and poplars dominate the island's tree population, their long, thin trunks reaching up to the sky inside narrow columns of light grey leaves.  Many of them have died and fallen over, eventually decaying to leave white tunnels of birch bark scattered across the ground.  Thick grasses a foot high fill in the spaces between the trees.

The sound of rushing waters comes from both sides, although quite a bit louder from the west.  Birches and poplars dominate the island's tree population, their long, thin trunks reaching up to the sky inside narrow columns of green leaves.  Many of them have died and fallen over, eventually decaying to leave white tunnels of birch bark scattered across the ground.  Thick grasses a foot high fill in the spaces between the trees.

title: [Locksmehr River, Wiley Island]
description: Driftwood is scattered all over this sand bar at the confluence of the Locksmehr River's two channels.  The sand has been pushed up in a wide, triangular-shaped patch, mostly by the action of the western channel which sweeps by, depositing whatever it is carrying onto the bar.  Further south the two flows collide in rolling riffles and swirling eddies, fighting, combining, then charging on downstream as one river.

title: [A Rustic Cabin]
description: A fire burns cheerily in this one-room cabin's fireplace.  Spartan furnishings convey a sense of loneliness and a lack of concern for creature comforts.  In one corner a cot resides, covered with an unkempt grey blanket.  A single chair snuggles up to the rough-hewn pine table in the room's center.  The cabin's door is propped open, allowing fresh air to circulate liberally.  Much of it is drawn up in the fireplace's rising heat, carrying the scent of cooking stew out through the chimney.

title: [Vipershroud, Mossy Trail]
description: The trail, barely perceptible, snakes darkly among the brambles.  The trees stand closely, their soaring branches denying the moonlight to the twisted, grayish vegetation below.  A bit of faded red cloth, impaled on several pointed brambles, bears witness to the fact that others have gone before.

title: [Vipershroud, Upland Trail]
description: The brambles thin into large clumps, and the moss reveals patches of barren earth.  The mixed forest continues to dominate the area, though, with large tree trunks and spreading upper branches.  Although still quite damp, the air is considerably cooler here than in the valley below.

title: [Vipershroud, Upland Trail]
description: Conifers completely replace the deciduous forest at this altitude, and the pine needles give off a soft crunching underfoot.  Here and there bare stones push up through the needles, and the scent of pinesap is readily apparent.  The tall forest allows some starlight to filter through, although the large trunks and low, spreading branches prevent deviations of more than a few yards from the beaten path.  The ground slopes sharply upward to the southwest.

title: [Vipershroud, Upland Trail]
description: The trail turns here, blocked by a cliff of sheer stone.  Water seeps from a fissure in the stone about twenty feet up, dribbling down to the base and running off to the east.  The flat rock surface, dampened by the running water, presents no means of ascent.  The water, though, seems pure enough, perhaps filtered by its passage through the rock strata.

title: [Vipershroud, Upland Trail]
description: The trail ends at the base of a large hillock.  The firs, pines and other conifers crowd up against the hillock, heavily filtering the sunlight that falls on the forest floor.  Notable, in their absence, are the usual small woodland creatures, such as chipmunks and woodpeckers, which normally inhabit the branches of a forest such as this.

title: [Vipershroud, Hillock]
description: The large, rocky hillock juts up out of the Vipershroud into the moonlight.  Unable to find sufficient soil or purchase on the rounded stones, the trees have abandoned the area to a few hardy trumpet flowers and low shrubs.  A cool, soft breeze rolls over the hillock, and the tops of the Vipershroud forest can be seen for miles all around.  To the east, a large eagle moves in slow circles on the air currents.  A cabin stands in a clearing to the southwest.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Vipershroud, Shrine]
description: A single, giant, petrified redwood stands amongst lesser pines and firs.  A deep black, onyx tablet displaying an eight-pointed star of pure silver is firmly imbedded in the tree, and a row of small stones, carefully placed end-to-end, encircles the tree.  A large bouquet of trumpet flowers and the carcass of a woodchuck have been laid at the tree's base.  Interestingly, both offerings seem to be fresh.

title: [Vipershroud, Logged Trail]
description: A trail winds southwest from the hillock.  To the sides, numerous stumps protrude up from the forest floor, and deep gouges in the earth indicate that felled logs may have been dragged south.  Numerous branches litter the forest floor, and the stars twinkle through the opening created by the absent trees.

title: [Vipershroud, Log Cabin]
description: A log cabin resides silently in the clearing.  Moss has begun to take root on the exposed logs, and the thatch roof has collapsed, exposing the supporting rafters.  Logging instruments, rusted from lack of proper maintenance, are propped neatly against the side of the cabin.  The front door stands partially ajar.

title: [Vipershroud, Log Cabin]
description: Moonlight streams through the open roof, illuminating the inside of this snugly built, one-room cabin.  Straw piled in a corner apparently served for a bed, and a large iron stove in the far corner provided the meals.  A short message appears to have been carved onto the doorpost.  In the center of the cabin, suspended from the rafters, hangs the corpse of a man.

title: [Gateway Tower]
description: A tower of red sandstone rises above the forest in proud defiance of the trees that crowd against it.  The massive rock faces carved high on each side of the edifice direct their gaze to the black and trackless forest beyond, their enigmatic smiles and lowered eyelids revealing nothing and suggesting much.
