Dark soil dusts the flagstones that lead past a pair of thick pillars and through an arch in the tower's base.

title: [Causeway]
description: Laterite flagstones polished to the dull sheen of watered silk span the stretch of low ground from the southern tower's arch to the steps of an opulent temple north of here.  The building's marble inlays and ornate bas-reliefs glimmer in the moonlight and graceful statues, males on one side of the bridge and females on the other, uphold a balustrade worn smooth by time and pilgrims' hands.

Laterite flagstones polished to the dull sheen of watered silk span the stretch of low ground from the southern tower's arch to the steps of an opulent temple north of here. The great trees have grown over the smaller outbuildings of the temple complex, their trunks assuming fantastic shapes stolen from the stones they have covered.  Wide landings allow visitors to pause and admire the sight of the temple's conical towers reaching toward the stars.

Friezes of stylized flames and lotus flowers that span the length of the facade are almost hidden in the shadows, but the sandstone figure of a kneeling woman on the lintel above the entrance is plainly visible even in the faint moonlight.

description: The reek of corruption is barely detectable beneath the sharper, cleaner scents of ginger and temple incense that pervade the air in this circular chamber.  Walkways inlaid with chalcedony and malachite extend to your east and west.

title: [Hall of the Marred]
description: Part of the north wall has succumbed to the spreading roots of vegetation growing along its outer surface, allowing a glimpse of starry sky and the courtyard beyond.  The mural's colors are still visible in the flickering candlelight even where the elements have spoiled some of its detail.

title: [Temple, Bathing Chamber]
description: Water droplets condensing on the hollow-tiled ceiling above the central bath grow gravid in the steamy air and return to their source with a quiet splash.  Silver ewers and vials of scented oil are within easy reach of the communal bath, their tarnished surfaces reflecting the flickering candlelight dimly.  A large window on the western wall appears to serve the dual purpose of allowing bathers to admire the night skies and to put themselves on display.

description: The bath has apparently been built over a natural hot spring, its murky waters steaming hot but not quite to the point of discomfort.  The cloyingly strong smell of incense doesn't quite conceal the faint mineral tang in the air.

title: [Hall of the Impure]
description: So many of the statues along this hall have yielded to the depredations of vegetation and looters that it's impossible to tell what dubious pleasure they once represented.  A piece of the vaulted ceiling has collapsed, and the rubble has lain for so long that it too wears a verdant cloak of moss that thrives in the moist atmosphere.

title: [Sleeping Quarters]
description: Whoever lives here seems not so much to scorn privacy as to be completely unfamiliar with the concept.  Communal satin cushions and fur throws are strewn haphazardly on the floor in lieu of beds.  Inspirational tapestries flank the arched rosewood door to the south, while a pair of mirrors on the east and west walls reflect soft moonlight into every part of the chamber, leaving nowhere to hide.

title: [Temple Courtyard]
description: A low sandstone building crouches in the center of this expansive courtyard, its mass a dramatic contrast to the gracefully tapering towers that surround it. title: [Temple Courtyard]
description: The sound of trickling water from a recent rain should be relaxing, yet in time the monotony of the noise begins to wear at the nerves as the water itself has worn the stone wall of the courtyard.

title: [Temple Courtyard]
description: A pair of curving stone pillars flank the candlelit archway to the inner reaches of the building that occupies the center of the courtyard.  The walkway leading to the arch is almost completely overgrown by a variety of vines and mosses.  Bells atop the squat building chime in the night breeze.

title: [Temple of Ivas, Inner Sanctum]
description: The room is bare except for thick crimson rugs that cover the stone floor apart from a wide ring around a central dais.  Candles set in niches carved into the walls of this sunless chamber cast their flickering light on frescoes, making the painted figures seem to writhe.  The massive jade statue of Ivas crouched upon the dais is a commanding presence despite her lowered gaze.

title: [Hall of the Eternal Dance]
description: As a river smoothes the rocks of its bed, the haut-relief sandstone carvings of temple dancers that line the hall have been worn to a shine in spots by the passage of countless worshippers.  The dancers' contorted limbs are braceleted here and there with vines that have taken advantage of cracks in the masonry.

title: [Refectory]
description: Despite the spaciousness of this circular refectory, the air feels close and thick with the odor of past meals.  Trestle tables bear wine stains and other flaws from less recognizable sources.  Candles in etched red glass holders cast a ruddy, yet somehow unsavory light on the surrounding tapestries.

title: [Hall of the Feast]
description: The too-sweet smell of rot grows stronger to the east and mingles with the scents of cinnamon, cardamom, and clove.  Beeswax candles set in bronze sconces cast a fitful illumination on the mural, the flickering light giving the painted figures the illusion of movement.

title: [Hall of the Feast]
description: Moonlight streams through cutwork teak shutters to cast lacy shadows on the polished stone floor.  A mural lit by flickering candles stretches the length of the hallway. title: [Plateau's Edge, Steep Path]
description: Slick and frozen terrain prevents passage back up the cliff.  The path continues sharply down the edge of the plateau, ending abruptly several feet above the ground of the frozen slopes below.

title: [Wayside Inn, Chamber]
description: Tables and chairs of all shapes, sizes and states of disrepair fill this large, undecorated chamber.  Seated at many of the tables are groups intent on serious card games.  From the far side of the room you hear the noisy cheers of a ragtag group of spectators rooting for the underdog in a wristwrestling match between the local blacksmith and an overfed member of the Wehnimer's Citizens' Militia.

title: [Zhindel's Post]
description: Two elderly dwarven ladies sit in rocking chairs on the front porch of one of the tidy homes of Zhindel's Post.  They smile and wave at passers by while chatting quietly.  A few scattered businesses mingle with a like number of houses on this road.  The area is surprisingly free of trash or unsightly elements, and no stray animals roam the streets.  Occasionally a full cart pulled by several dwarven men rumbles past, headed into the forest to the north or an empty one comes past the other direction.

title: [Furrier]
description: The pungent scent of curing chemicals assails your nostrils.  The walls are covered with hides from many sorts of animals, some very recognizable, some totally foreign.  Bear hide rugs cover the floor underfoot from wall to wall, the protruding heads with open mouths creating trip hazards in several places.  An unusually lean dwarf moves around toward the back of the room, sorting furs, hides and pelts into piles and muttering to himself.

title: [Zhindel's Post]
description: A few houses hide serenely in the woods.  Paths have been meticulously cleared through the snow to each doorstep.  In the yard outside one home, a snowman leans precariously, a lopsided grin on its face and totally oblivious to its impending fall.  No one stirs outside the homes, although the tracks of small feet throughout the snow suggest the recent passage of children, and the occasional muffled voice indicates that the homes are occupied.  One home in particular seems quite inviting.

title: [Dwarven Home]
description: The glow from a cheery fire crackling in the fireplace competes with the sunlight streaming through the windows to bathe this large, one-room dwelling with light and warmth.  One large bed and two smaller beds nestle into the corners, and a wooden table with four chairs occupies the center of the room.  Several furs cover the polished hardwood floor.  The house is in immaculate order, although the occupants are nowhere to be seen.

Knitted curtains, drawn for the night, cover the windows and help keep out the cold. title: [Zhindel's Plateau, Forest]
description: The trees close in tightly along the wide road.  Their branches intertwine above to form a coniferous canopy that filters the light and supports sheets of snow.  The wary traveler keeps an eye up as well as forward lest a sheet of snow suddenly become a wet blanket.  Although the forest is thick, the road is totally free of encroaching plants and seedlings, and its depth, slightly below that of the surrounding forest, suggests that the road has been in use for quite a long time.

title: [Zhindel's Plateau, Forest]
description: The roadway stretches straight and true to the northwest and southeast.  The thick forest on either side diverts the wind upward, creating a still pocket of heavy, foggy air.  It is like walking through a cloud.  The damp air chills everything around it, but it also coats the trees with a gleaming white frost, turning the conifers into beautiful, fragile, crystalline statues.  A hush pervades the area as if a sound might make the entire splendor collapse into ice fragments.

title: [Zhindel's Plateau, Forest]
description: Someone is constructing a building just to the south of the roadway.  A stone base supports thick plank flooring and tall beams.  The skeleton of a roof arches high overhead, and the height of the roof suggests that this is not a home under construction.  Piles of building materials dot the clearing, although no work is being performed right now, and quite a bit of snow has filtered into the work area.

title: [Zhindel's Plateau, Pulley]
description: A clearing has been created with enough room for a multi-person loading operation.  A pulley system with a large platform attached is affixed to the mountainside.  Dwarves unload heavily laden wagons, placing the freight on the platform, or remove freight from the platform, placing it on the wagons.  The snow is rather slushy and dirty from the constant movement of the wagons and the tromping of heavy dwarven feet.

The snow is rather slushy and dirty from the constant movement of the wagons and the tromping of heavy dwarven feet.

title: [Cindek's Spirits]
description: The walls, floor and atmosphere are all rough inside this tavern, but the place is well lighted and the dwarf behind the bar doesn't look like he'd take much guff.  A long table extends down the middle of the public area, and a multitude of benches surround the table to give patrons a place to drink and visit.  Small lamps hung on the walls provide smoky but ample lighting, and the tavern is swept and free of dirt.  The odors of stale ale and pipe smoke linger in the air.

title: [Gem Shop]
description: The inside of the shop is warm and cheery, with sunlight streaming in through the windows and a fire in a small, black brazier providing just the right amount of heat.  The floor is heavily lacquered with a dark varnish, and the walls sparkle with cheap, multicolored gems.  An elderly dwarf sits behind a narrow worktable.  He selects gems from a stack next to the vise, clamps them in, meticulously cuts them and moves them off to a small box.  Every so often he glances up and greets a customer.

title: [Sawmill]
description: A counter just inside the door prevents you from moving back into the work area.  Several teams of stout dwarves bend their backs at the ends of two-man saws, cutting noisily through huge logs to fill the air with sawdust.  Others, wielding shorter saws, hew the planks into smaller boards of varying thicknesses and lengths.  The din from the sawing drowns out all speech, and the dwarves seem totally oblivious to your presence.  Stacks of banded boards sit in one corner.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Overlook]
description: A thin finger of stone points through the pass toward the peaks beyond.  Peering down, your eyes can follow the trail as it winds through ice and snow, valley and ridge, tundra and forest--all of the strata that make up the alpine landscape.  From this commanding height, your voice can project across great distances.

title: [Yugreckol's Weaponry]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a large oak table are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Siphere's Weaponry]
[Siphere's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a verdant elderberry bush in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest and a large oak table.

title: [Cysaegir Exchange]
description: Facing a wide archway is a single maple counter upon which sits a pair of quills and a large inkwell.  Thick black curtains have been drawn over all the windows, casting the room in perpetual darkness, save for the glow of three sconces set into the stone wall.  Behind the counter, the exchange clerk sits on a tall four-legged stool, his face plagued with a perpetual look of boredom.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Library]
description: Tall mahogany shelves house numerous texts and tomes, the highest of which can only be accessed by a sliding ladder.  Situated around the library are several glass display cases, housing a few tokens of remembrance from the Aelotoi homeworld.  Cozy, ruby-hued armchairs and lacquered reading tables have been arranged near the windows along the far wall, looking out over the inn's indoor garden.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Deeper into the cave, the walls are a tad drier and set with several burning torches that reveal a rough carving of winged beasts towering over smaller figures holding spears in their hands.  Small niches are visible on both the east and west walls of the cave.  Burning mullein torches frame a jagged opening.

title: [Cysaegir, West Niche]
description: A deep hole in the cave's floor divides the room in two.  Lining the wall on the other side of the hole are several small recesses.  Bundles of rolled parchment paper bound by a thin cord fill two of the nooks in the wall.  Clusters of deformed mushrooms crowd the corners, their mottled crowns drooping over as if weighted down with fluid.

title: [Cysaegir, East Niche]
description: Clearing the opening of the niche, there is plenty of room to stand or sit.  Several torches illuminate this cramped space.  Against the back wall, an overturned chest lies empty on its side.  A small hole is in the side of the chest, and occasionally scratching sounds emanate from within it.

title: [Cysaegir, Dragonfly Aqueduct]
description: A gurgling stream runs through a small aqueduct capped with thick solid crystal that reflects a prismatic hue of colors in the gleaming sunlight. Rising above the wall are identical round towers with pointed domes from which nondescript banners flutter on a gentle breeze.

The concentric bands of color in dazzling shades of yellow, blue, purple, and green creates the rainbow that gives the falls their name.

High-backed chairs encircle a silver serving cart containing both hot and cold drinks and a few snacks.  Strange symbols border the edges of arched openings located at both ends of the hall.  At the back of the rectangular chamber, an ivory inlaid door stands ajar.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Annex]
description: Only the sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.  Identical brass flowerpots stand opposite each other filled to the brim with trumpet-shaped purple blossoms of mournblooms.  Every so often, melancholy sounds, like the sad song of a lone woman, emanates from somewhere nearby.

description: Etched brass flowerpots stand opposite each other overflowing with purple and yellow pansies. The sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.

Working diligently, the head of a male clerk is barely visible above the huge stacks of papers covering the desktop.

title: [Morvaeyn's Armory]
description: Despite the banner reading, "Morvaeyn's Armory" on the far wall, there is no actual armor on display in this shop.  Instead, the chiseled stone-block walls feature a panoramic showcase of the wares, rendered in vivid paints.  Hanging above each painting, a large sign boasts the benefits and values of the individual armament.

title: [Jewels of the Sky]
description: Decorating the patched canopy overhead are various images of extinct birds.  In the center of the shop, a glass counter, crafted to resemble the head of a raptor, holds an exotic multi-tiered jewelry stand on one end.  At the back of the shop, a life-sized statue of a multi-armed creature displays an assortment of trinkets.  Nestled between two tables, one holding figurines, and the other holding miscellaneous items, is a bejeweled tree.

title: [Cysaegir, Brook]
description: A quaint bungalow rests quietly alongside a bubbling brook teeming with an assortment of fish and other aquatic life, creating a picture perfect scene.  The delicate lace curtains from the window of the cobbler's cobby billows gently on a soft breeze.  Fiddlehead ferns surround the brook on all sides and clusters of holly trees, crowned with bright red berries and glossy evergreen leaves house a huge host of birds.  The air fills with a melodious harmony as they trill their songs.

description: Exemplary displays of taxidermy decorate this spacious shop, though several of the arrangements are disturbing at best. title: [Cysaegir, Copse]
description: Larkspurs, violets, alyssums, and bluebells thrive here by a gurgling brook.  Offering shades of yellow, blue, pink, and purple, their raceme clusters face the sun, and seem to quiver in excitement whenever a soft breeze sweeps across the ground.  Some spiraling stairs twine around a bole and lead to a shop built mid-level on the massive tree.  An exceptionally over-sized branch droops low offering shade and relaxation beside a whitewashed cottage.  Securely strung up between the trees are well-made hammocks, constructed from woven vines.

description: A sprawling azure canopy, painted like the sky it obscures, shades this open-air platform enclosed by sturdy fel railing. A florid orange tree nearby scents the air with a heady fragrance, drawing iridescent hummingbirds to flit through the shop in search of sweet nectar.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Within the sheltering walls of this courtyard, a small fountain gurgles quietly into a fish pond.  Stepping stones trace a path through the beds of roses and banks of lavender, while curved stone benches allow for restful contemplation.  Birds sing in the branches of the apple trees that provide respites of shade along the walkway.

title: [Gossamer Valley, Blind Canyon]
description: A large cavern nestles underneath the sheltering mountain, blocking the wind and keeping the driven snow at bay.  The floor of the cavern is fairly level and dry, although it is definitely no warmer in here than outside.  A wide chasm separates this snug harbor from the glacier directly to the south.  Every so often, across the chasm, a predator moves up, sniffing the air and glaring across at you.  Then it turns and grudgingly retreats.

title: [Dark Forest, Stream Bank]
description: The trees give ground at the edge of a swift stream, running through its rocky banks in a raging torrent.  A couple of large boulders sitting mid-stream send plumes of spray into the air as the water collides with them.  A few sunbeams penetrate the thick canopy of branches reaching out overhead from the trees lining the bank, creating flickering rainbows in the shifting cloud of mist.

A shifting pattern of moonlight penetrates the thick canopy of branches reaching out overhead from the trees lining the bank, sparkling off the roiling surface of the stream.

title: [Dark Forest, Trail]
description: A ragged trail winds through immense tree-trunks, skirting gnarled roots and clumps of ostrich ferns that stand taller than a dwarf.  The trees are so thick, they take on the appearance of a solid wall of deeply furrowed bark, some carrying growths of lichen that protrude from the wood in a wide cascade of semi-circular stair steps.  Finely arched fronds of fiddlehead ferns grow in all directions, slowly waving at the touch of a breeze as if they are watching the trail.

title: [Dark Forest, Glade]
description: The trail emerges through the maze of tree trunks into a small glade, edged with shade-tolerant redbud trees and, here and there, a dogwood with its white blossoms that float in the low light like moths.  Ferns create a dense, circular carpet beneath the trees, dotted with white blossoms of wild orchids.  Birds chirp in a riotous din overhead, hidden by the black leaves of the glade's guard of trees.

Ferns create a dense, circular carpet beneath the trees, dotted with the white blossoms of wild orchids.  Crickets, hidden in the ferns, chirp in a constant chorus.

title: [Dark Forest, Trail]
description: Threading through the crowded boles of trees, the trail winds in a serpentine ribbon, making directions turn back on themselves in a dizzy coil.  The trees seem like an endless, confusing wall of similarity, each with heavily furrowed bark and impossible size.  Overhead, the dense ceiling of black leaves creates a murky gloom beneath their boughs, as if the sun is afraid to penetrate their shadows.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Dark Forest, Rough Trail]
description: The trail straightens abruptly, as though the trees are standing aside to usher the path along.  On either side, huge trunks stand side-by-side, making any deviation from the way impossible.  Sunlight is unable to penetrate the thick canopy overhead, leaving the ground a dark tunnel ringed in black foliage and bark.

title: [Dark Forest, Crossing]
description: The trail reaches an impasse of tree trunks on the south.  To the north and south, it winds around a huge boulder, sitting in the shelter of the leafy boughs like a sultan beneath a black canopy.  The surface of the rock is a rich pattern of lichens, with ferns edging its foot in a lazy fringe.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, northwest

title: [Dark Forest, Shrouded Relic]
description: The trail skirts the base of a large growth of scrub trees and arrives at the foot of a sheer wall composed of stone.  The boulders are symmetrical and skillfully positioned, betraying the fact that this edifice was built by other forces than nature.  The wall rises for close to thirty spans.  At its summit, the upper reaches of a second and third tier of rectangular sections can be glimpsed.  All around the monument, thick boughs robed with black foliage all but conceal the ziggurat's location.

title: [Dark Forest, Stone Wall]
description: The high wall of a looming edifice borders the trail along the north side, while thick stands of the black-barked trees stand like a towering palisade to the south.  With the overhanging branches of the trees, the path takes on the appearance of a tunnel, with occasional beams of sunlight dappling the craggy stone surface of the ziggurat's face as breezes stir the foliage.

title: [Dark Forest, Path]
description: The path zigzags its way through the forest, its way dictated by huge root outcroppings and trunks of trees.  Thick drifts of fallen leaves collected in crevices among the roots and boulders give off a strong, verdant scent, the perfume of both growth and decay.

title: [Dark Forest, Leafy Tunnel]
description: The leafy canopy overhead lowers, making the path resemble a rabbit warren more so than a trail.  Huge cinnamon ferns on either side almost obscure its progress, punctuated by boulders encroaching at regular intervals.  Ropy vines dangle from the branches overhead, their loops festooned with leaves and tendrils.

title: [Dark Forest, Overlook]
description: The trail emerges from the claustrophobic stand of trees into a clearing overlooking the bank of a lake.  To either side, the trees block more than a cursory view of the water's edge.  On the lake's opposite shore, the trees continue in an even thicker wall reflected within the blue mirror of the lake's surface.

title: [Dark Forest, Dead End]
description: The trail ends in a circular glade ringed by a wall of trees so thick, they are impassible to any direction other than north.  Between the trees, a growth of small painted ferns is dappled by sunlight, their fronds waving delicately in what little breeze can penetrate the nigh-impregnable trees.  A single stone stands guard in the glade's center, its surface a venerable mottle of lichens and moss.

title: [Dark Forest, Trail]
description: The path widens into a modest-sized grotto where it splits in three directions.  Heavy black foliage makes it impossible to see what lies down any of the alternatives, other than more closely growing tree trunks with a dense filler of ferns and rhododendrons crowding the space between them.

title: [Dark Forest, Lakeside]
description: A large lake stops the trail's progress, closely edged by the trees and thick clumps of cattails.  Here and there, tall knee-like roots rise out of the shallows, where trees have grown so close to the water than their foundations are submerged.  Across the lake, the distant shore is likewise heavily cloaked with forest.

title: [Dark Forest, Serene Lake]
description: The trail loops out of one break in the trees and back into another, skirting the edge of a beautiful lake in its progress.  Rushes and cattails growing at the waterline fringe a few large boulders in a picturesque tableau.  The stones are eloquently mirrored on the water's immaculate surface, the reflection faintly rippled with breezes blowing from offshore.

description: A break in the branches to the west prohibits crossing in that direction.  However, the wide limbs offer easy access to neighboring trees on the north and east.  Smaller branches create a tunnel effect, with the brightly colored plumage of birds dotting the dark foliage.

title: [Blighted Forest, Meadow]
description: Opposite the golden expanse of a meadow to the north, a huge tree sits on the southern horizon, filling the sky with its monstrous canopy.  To either side of it rise dark cliffs, creating an impassable barrier behind the oak.  The trail has become gravelly, its course made laborious by rubble and rock, and clumps of nettles armed with prodigious thorns.

title: [Blighted Forest, Approach]
description: As the path threads its way through rocky scree, it passes large boulders and thick patches of nettles.  A tree with pitch-black foliage and contorted proportions occupies the entire southern vista.  Hundreds of crows sit in its branches, making a chaotic racket with their caws and squawks.

title: [Tower Approach]
description: As the trail comes in close proximity to the huge oak tree dominating the landscape, it fades into nothing other than scattered stones.  At the foot of the monster tree is a long platform.  A steep flight of stairs gives access to the ledge, which stands higher than a giantman.  Wings branch from either end in southwest and southeast directions, following the circumference of the tree.

title: [Maaghara Tower]
description: Crafted of polished oak planks, the ledge is both wide and long, spanning the front of a huge oak tree.  The bark covering the colossus is rough and as black as coal.  Overhead, contorted branches as thick as a mammoth jut out in all directions, blocking out all direct sunlight.

title: [Maaghara Tower]
description: The platform is polished and entirely covered with an intricate pattern of tiny runes crafted of inlaid wood.  To cover the expansive structure requires unimaginable numbers of the diminutive symbols.  Overhead, the boughs of a huge oak tree cover the sky with thick, black foliage.

title: [Maaghara Tower]
description: After turning a diagonal leg southwest from the main platform, the porch ends at the foot of a monumental door set into the side of the tree.  The door is heavily carved, its surface a wealth of interlocking scenes.  Most depict views of a forest.  A single knob occupies the door's center.

title: [Maaghara Tower]
description: Hugging the huge bole of a giant oak, the porch offers an expansive view of the surrounding rock fields.  In the distance, a line of pitch-black forest divides the horizon into firmament and ground.  Overhead, hundreds of crows carry on a constant racket with their harsh caws.

title: [Maaghara Tower]

title: [Maaghara Tower, Entry]
description: The sides of the immense hall reach upward to a vaulted ceiling.  The smooth, natural surface of the wood is broken by veins of dark, twisting structures that run along the inside of the walls.  The lighting is surreal and shifts with each passing moment, coming in odd colors and intensities, seemingly from the walls themselves.  Two looming corridors gape to the northwest and northeast.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Hall]
description: The ancient walls of the tree tower up out of sight into the gloom.  Sturdy, darkened wood forms the smooth floor of the great hall.  High above, flickering lights move erratically through the blackness in a bizarre aerial dance.  A steep spiral staircase circles the eastern wall upward to the north.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Hall]
description: Circling the inside wall of the tree to the northwest, a dark spiral staircase climbs upward.  Occasional puffs of air bring odd smells of acrid bile or ancient wood.  A large corridor leads off to the southeast, while a smaller, darker passage leads east.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Hall]
description: Sinuous, root-like veins break the smooth floor of the hall as they creep slowly back and forth from the center of the tree outward.  Debris--leaves and other, perhaps best not identified substances--is pushed slowly towards a circular portal to the west.  A spiraling set of stairs leads down the western wall and a corridor continues around the edge of the tree to the northeast.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Refuse Heap]
description: A series of black fissures pit the floor of this dank, malodorous hole.  Rotting debris is constantly pushed into the holes by multiple, root-like tendrils.  A bitter, acidic vapor rises from the crevices as the tree slowly processes its waste.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Hall]
description: Warm mist drifts from tiny orifices across the roof of the landing, making the floors and walls bead with condensation.  Larger droplets gather on odd-looking protrusions and eventually fall to puddles on the floor with a soft *PLOP*.  A fog-shrouded corridor slopes up to the northwest, while to the east, a small alcove lies behind some hanging, root-like tendrils.  A steep spiral stair circles down to the east.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Alcove]
description: Branching tendrils sprout out of the ceiling and grow downward, splitting into fine, thin fibers as they go.  Any movement of the tendrils--by touch or breeze--sets them softly ablaze with internal flashes of light.  The floor is covered with soft, damp detritus.  The cloying smell of compost and decay wafts upward from the floor.

Branching tendrils sprout out of the ceiling and grow downward, splitting into fine, thin fibers as they go.  Any movement of the tendrils, by touch or breeze, sets them softly ablaze with internal flashes of light.  The cloying smell of compost wafts upward from the damp detritus covering the floor.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Eastern Hall]
description: Dark, veined columns climb the walls of the tree trunk, towering up into the heights.  Random flashes of light pulse through the veins, casting quickly-moving shadows over the room.  A narrow, dark passage leads off to the west under a steep stair that climbs further above.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Dark Stair]
description: The spiraling stair curves sharply, moving away from the wall and towards the center of the tree, ending above at a central landing.  Odd sighs and groans echo through the interior of the tree at irregular intervals.  The light from the walls casts disturbing shadows across the area, shadows that move one way for an instant then dart away in the opposite direction.  Under the stairwell, a narrow, dark passage leads off to the east.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: This small, open landing is supported at the center of a complex nexus of structural growths attached to the walls.  Looking over the edge you can see down through the hollow tree to the levels below, but the fog and mist obscure most details.  Above, a steep staircase climbs to another landing overhead with twin spiral stairs stretching farther up the inside of the tree wall.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: This spacious landing serves as a junction for twin, spiraling stairs leading up and some steep steps leading down into the misty darkness below.  The walls facing the interior of the tree here are porous with small, irregular holes allowing glimpses of the hollow area outside.  The omnipresent veins run through the floor and stairs in all sizes and configurations.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: The stairs continue here, circling for almost a quarter-circle along the inside of the tree trunk.  Far below you, mists shroud the bottom of the tower.  Woody growths crisscross the open area and to the east, far across the hollow interior, another spiral stair circles the tree in the opposite direction.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: The stairs seem to stretch out for miles in either direction.  Below, they circle down into the mists and above they stretch out into the darkness.  Mist rises from below and forms small, dusky, cloud-like patches that drift across the interior of the tree.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: Interior branch-like supports crisscross the tree trunk here.  Hundreds of bats fly through the air, or hang from the branches, squeaking and chittering loudly to themselves.  The distinct odor of bat guano rises from the branches below.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: The climb ends here as a small landing juts out from the wall of the trunk.  A narrow alcove lies to the west, while a catwalk leads east under a flight of stairs.  A breath of fresh air wafts from the niche, bringing with it the scent and sounds of the open forest.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Canopy Opening]
description: A large hole gapes in the trunk of the tree, allowing small creatures access to the open air high in the canopy of the blighted forest.  The edges of the hole are splintered and new growth is covering the raw areas over with bark.  Large amounts of bat droppings cover the floor, while small fungus-like growths and ferns sprout from the guano-covered bark.  Protruding from the growth and droppings are the remains of a decomposing corpse.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: A hemispherical landing juts out from the dark bole of the tree.  Soft twilight bathes the floor with a shimmery, ethereal glow that seems to come from every direction and no direction at once.  The polished, ebon wood gleams with reflections, yet upon closer inspection you realize that the images are of things not even present in the room.  Narrow passageways bear east and west, while the polished stairway leads up away from the wall to a platform at the center of the trunk.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, west, up

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: The tree towers up and up into the misty darkness, while the spiraling steps continue their climb up the side of the trunk.  High above, bats circle in and amongst the huge, woody branches and growths that run across the interior of the tree.  Mists rise from below, cloaking the bottom of the tower in a hazy shroud.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: The smooth, polished stair circles eastward up the bole of the great tree, climbing upward into the distance.  Flickering lights from far above shine down to strike the floor and the wall in random, dancing patterns.  To the west, the staircase sweeps down the trunk to a landing farther below.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: The shrill squeaks of bats flying throughout the interior of the tree assault your ears.  Sweeping and diving in the gloomy light, they call to each other in exaggerated twitters.  Several large openings to the surrounding forest permit entry and exit from the tree but the sheer sides of the trunk restrict any mode of travel other than flight.  The steep stairs circle down to the southwest in a graceful curve, while to the northwest the passageway continues its climb farther up the tree.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: Great arching branches come together in the center of the tree, forming a huge cathedral-like hall.  The walls stretching upwards from the landing are a deep, black hue so dark they appear liquid.  Great branch-like structures form a majestic colonnade down the periphery of the huge chamber.  The smooth, expansive floor is broken abruptly in the center of the room by the passage leading down.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: The walls of the great tree stretch up into a gloomy half-light, here and there punctured by stark beams of colored light.  Whether the rays come from openings to the outside, or are generated in some fashion isn't certain.  Underfoot, an outcropping of the tree's wall comprises the floor.  It extends out in a polished, veined semicircle as though the wood was as malleable as clay when the landing was formed.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Incline]
description: Following the turn of the tree's wall, the ramp offers less than reliable footing.  Bulges and gullies mark it as part of the living wall of the tree rather than an attached construction.  To the south, the way skirts a large tapestry covering the wall.  In the gulf between the curved sides of the monstrous tree, small globes hang on silvery threads so fine they are almost invisible.  Soft pinpoints of light flicker around the globes in various colors, as though sparks are orbiting each one.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Incline]
description: The outcropping of wood comprising the incline levels off at the foot of a large tapestry covering the wall.  It appears to be woven of silk, and the vibrant colors used in its panoramic composition glow in jewel-like tones in the hazy light.  To the southeast, the incline continues to follow the bend of the tree's inner walls as it rises into the giant's dizzy heights.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Spiral Stair]
description: The incline narrows as it rises through the cavern of the tree's belly.  The light has grown softer with tones colored by the hanging globes from which it emanates.  A thick haze further obscures the illumination, giving the elevation a strangely intimate ambiance.  Barely visible in the heights above is the underside of a platform.  Its surface flickers with glowing motes reflecting from the globes suspended below it.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Incline]
description: The walkway levels off, skirting a pair of wall hangings.  As it passes them, it widens, offering a much safer vantage point from which to examine the two artifacts.  On the left hangs a woven band, no wider than a palm, but so long that it stretches up out of sight in the gloom above.  Beside it hangs a large silk tapestry depicting a forest scene.  The incline narrows to either side of the wall hangings, spiraling both up and down the bole of the tree in a sinuous curve.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Spiral Stair]
description: The incline begins a steep rise to the north, snaking around the mammoth bole in a daunting spiral.  Fine growths of some type of moss cling to the edge of the walkway, sending spidery, silver-grey tendrils down into the chasm to a depth of six feet in some places.  From this vantage point, the floor of the tower is so far below, it is almost hidden in the gloom.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: A tapestry covers the wooden wall of the tree at the landing, its breadth easily as wide as a barn.  As the walkway curves to the west, the spiraling incline passes beneath the arch of a graceful, hanging stair.  The construction floats in the haze as though it has no support, suspended as it is on silver threads as fine as sewing silk.  It stretches from the head of the incline higher above, connecting that with a platform attached to the top of the hollow bole.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Incline]
description: Following the narrowing inner circumference of the great tree, the incline becomes more precarious as it gains altitude.  An unusual variety of moss has grown into thick patches on the wood of the ledge here and there, and its wiry, corkscrew foliage lends a slippery hazard to the passageway.  Overhead, the details of a large platform are coalescing out of the gloom, revealing the fact that it is a substantial garret of more than one floor, accessed only by the dizzy ascent of a suspended stairway.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: The platform widens into something of a landing, offering a vantage point from which to view the suspended stairway overhead.  Each ebony step and its riser are connected to its own guide wires, which are so fine, they are almost invisible in the gloom.  A matched pair of arched handrails hangs over the collection of steps, supported independently of any other part of the construction.  On the wall of the landing, a tapestry covers the wood, its colors and workmanship every bit as amazing as the stair.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Incline]
description: As the incline nears its head, it slants sharply upward and narrows.  The footing deteriorates as indentations and bulges in the wood become more pronounced.  A cloud of floating motes adds a distracting factor to the peril of the walkway, as they spiral and flicker in dizzy flight around the chasm at the tree's heart.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: The incline stops at the foot of a suspended bridge that traverses the abyss of empty air with delicate stairs made of polished ebony.  Each stair hangs on silver wire no greater in diameter than a hair, and the steps are inlaid with tiny pieces of colored wood that form a pattern of runes around the risers.  A tapestry hangs on the wall opposite the stair, its vast dimensions dwarfing the delicate construction of the stair.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Observatory]
description: An expansive chamber stretches above the hanging platform serving as its base.  The ceiling is made of some sort of translucent material that more resembles air than a solid substance.  The sides of the tree dwindle into scrambled paths resembling veins tracing through the crystalline bubble.  Sunlight intrudes in great beams that shimmer on the strange, monumental construction, a machine that takes up most of the room within the sphere.

Moonlight intrudes in great beams that shimmer on the strange, monumental construction, a machine that takes up most of the room within the sphere.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Observatory]
description: Overhead, the arterial fingers of the great tree trace intricate patterns within the sheer substance making up the roof of the Observatory.  At the bubble's center sits a construction, a machine of some sort.  It has gears and gadgets and arms and globes reaching up in all directions.  Around it hangs a catwalk, which circles the globe-like interior of the chamber on impossibly thin, wire supports.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Observatory]
description: The catwalk encircling the lofty chamber seems dangerous, suspended on very thin wire supports attached to the transparent bubble overhead.  At the sphere's center, a colossal machine dominates everything, its gears, arms and pulleys so numerous, no self-evident logic can be determined by looking at them.  A flight of tenuous stairs, likewise suspended on thin wires, leads up to a higher vantage point.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Observatory]
description: At the tree's apex, the walls abruptly dwindle into a circulatory of twisting tendrils that supports a huge, transparent sphere.  Outside, the dark foliage of the tree can be seen cradling the bubble in its black embrace.  Most of the interior of the observatory is filled with a vast construction.  Its surfaces appear to be mostly made of metals -- copper, iron, and bronze.  However, some gears, globes and wires are also crafted of silver and gold, giving the thing a marvelous, exotic sparkle.

title: [The Heavens Machine]
description: In the center of a translucent sphere sits a marvelous machine, huge beyond reckoning and more complex than the eye can take in.  Its complicated turns, twists and coils surround a narrow slab of rolaren at the precise heart of both the machine and the sphere.  A few dials can be seen on a dais beside the slab.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Dead End]
description: The passageway comes to an abrupt end in a small, dark niche.  Ridges run underfoot through the floor and up into the walls, making the footing somewhat treacherous and uneven.  The walls have a rough, wavy texture with the exception of the far one, which is smooth and made of wood.  Occasionally, the entire room shudders in a rhythmic, pulsing motion and contracts in upon itself before returning to its normal size.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Several rough stones litter the floor in a scattered design.  Someone or something has burrowed into the northern wall, leaving a narrow passage of snapped roots and broken rocks.  Smattered against the opposing wall in a spray pattern are flecks of heavy burgundy-colored moss.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, west

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Tiny pebbles dot the floor randomly, their pale hue a stark contrast to the dark roots which slither across and up into the curving ceiling.  Light scratches mar the smooth wall, some twisting jaggedly several different ways while others form straight, rough lines in the earth.  A few patches of lichen nestle inside the shallow gouges, though they do not grow in any other place within the cramped chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The round tunnel makes a sharp turn here, the texture of the moist walls a mottled collection of rolling bumps.  Rich streaks of dark red and ochre flow across the earth of the passageway, the color bleeding together in languid waves.  The perpetual sameness of the area is unbroken save for small pieces of debris spread about the floor.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Small tendrils of roots hang from the ceiling and a light mist rises from the ground.  A cluster of tiny worms writhe in pockets of slime oozing from the wall.  The sounds of the squirming pockets of worms echo down the tunnel.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Constricted with roots and moss hanging from ceiling and walls, the tunnel is hazardous and cloaked with shadow.  Clay and dirt combine to form an uneven floor, and a large boulder composed of granite and alexandrite has cracked and fallen across the tunnel in great shards.  It creates a twisted obstacle course in the already congested labyrinth.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Intricate wrappings of rootlets twist and turn, growing larger as they mature in spiral patterns toward the Northwest.  The air becomes still as a single cricket breaks the silence.  Greenish moss clings to the earthen sides of every wall.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Large depressions in the clay are filled with a layer of crushed roots and moss.  A strong earthy odor fills the tunnel as a slight breeze comes in.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: A mass of gnarled and twisted roots grow out from the wall and into the floor.  Chilled drafts of air come from several directions.  The salubrious scent of fresh air mixes with stale pockets of stench, causing a swirling mist of concentrated vapor to float around.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The roots have been burned clean from the walls of the circular tunnel, leaving the clay severely scorched.  Dried patches of the black soot mixed with clay leave evidence of several muddy footprints that lead off in both directions.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The walls have fallen away to reveal a hollowed out grotto with a lowered center.  Small mounds of a strange substance emit a putrid smell that wafts around the entire grotto.  Rough sections of broken stone and clay have fallen from the ceiling, creating a lofted area of low-hanging roots.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Deep scratches mar the walls and floor of the tunnel.  Roots are broken and wilted and there is the foul scent of death in the air.  Fragments of bone with bits of black hair lie here and there.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The three way intersection of tunnels creates a noticeable air tunnel, heavy with currents of mist-laden vapor.  Fog swirls and eddies, spinning wisps of vapor from side to side as it caresses the damp, root-burdened walls.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The rounded, almost circular corridor continues its winding journey, the walls around you slick and heavy with moisture.  A few large spiderwebs spread across the low ceiling, adding to the cramped feeling within the chamber.  The ghostly white shrouds of silk hang limply in the still, musty air of the tunnel.  A few stones lie across the floor, some stained with dark splotches.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Seamless walls of earth enclose the room, their towering forms meeting the equally featureless floor at a sharp angle.  Unlike most of the cramped corridors, this chamber is unusually roomy and open.  The uniform look of the area is broken only by a few scattered pieces of rotting leather armor lying upon the ground.  Though most of the leather is barely distinguishable, one breastplate has a fist-sized hole in the middle of it.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Tendrils of fog seep out of cracks upon the low ceiling of this rounded corridor, the wisps flowing down toward the floor to shroud the cramped tunnel in a thick haze.  The blurred forms of scattered stones can be seen upon the ground, their rugged surfaces bare.  Verdant moss hangs down from the fissures above, the fuzzy curtains tinted a sickly grey-green by the outpouring mists.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The walls of the cramped tunnel are pockmarked with a multitude of tiny holes, little streams of water trickling down from each.  Fed constantly by the small streams, the floor is slick and slippery with moisture, slime mold flourishing in the damp environs.  The globules of grey ooze glisten with a multicolored sheen, whorls of color swimming across their lumpy forms.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Patches of phosphorescent red fungus grow along ceiling of this circular tunnel, the invasive confines of the room tinted a melancholy sanguine by the growth.  Vertical fissures spread across the walls like jagged crackles of energy.  A light coating of moisture edges the deep scars upon the earth, the tiny drops imparting a sparkling sheen to the otherwise dismal surroundings.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Patches of crimson and green moss fight for survival on one of the rooted walls.  Pockets of rancid water collect from dripping roots, giving off a stench that mixes with a suspended mist.  The sound of droplets hitting water nearby can be heard.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Thin roots hang from the ceiling down toward the tunnel floor like long strands of hair.  A few patches of green luminous slime growing on the wall bring some relief from the oppressive darkness.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The root-supported clay walls bulge inward from both sides as if some extreme pressure has built up on the other side.  A bed of translucent lichen rises up from the floor, searching for some sign of light.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The moisture has eroded the walls, revealing a constricted network of roots.  The air, once alive with the fragrance of nature, now smells imprisoned and devoid of life.  Even the roots and moss seem to writhe in some sort of unnatural pain.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The contorted shapes of roots crooks the tunnel slightly.  Faint whispers of cool air drift down through the roots, creating soft hollow whistles from every corner.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Pockets of wet moss have collected on the dark clay walls.  A hollow whistle can be heard in the distance down one of the corridors.  The floor of the tunnel looks to be covered with patches of dried brownish grey film, which has exuded from some lacerated roots.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Some sections of the larger roots have broken from their rough brown skins to display pale shafts.  The cool, damp scent of moisture permeates the air and the moisture-laden air has softened the tunnel floor.  A few impressions in the soft root-embedded floor lay scattered about.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The moist earth beneath you is home to small colonies of deep red mushrooms, their tiny caps resembling small, shiny marbles. title: [Maaghara Tower, Platform]
description: Tiny pieces of quartz are visible through the thick clay of the surrounding walls, their jagged forms glinting with the little reflected light that reaches the area. title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]

Small roots twist their way along the walls, their pale needle-thin forms creating delicate swirling patterns upon the earth.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Long pale roots descend from the ceiling at random intervals, some growing so closely together that they form a ghostly white curtain amongst the dull, monotonous surroundings.  The walls are cracked and badly faded, their surfaces riddled with tiny fissures.  Tiny motes of dust dance erratically about the area, barely discernable in the hazy darkness.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Several gouges mar the walls on either side of the cramped passageway, deep enough to fit a giantman's arm within.  Pale lichen festoons the small ledges upon the scarred earth, trailing toward the floor in thin waves.  A few shattered bones lie beneath the fungus, each obscured by the fuzzy grey-green tendrils.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Thick curls of mist rise up from small fissures in the floor, the wavering wisps enshrouding the area in a light haze. As the mist swirls about the area lazily, the slime upon the wall glistens faintly, resembling a cascading waterfall of green ooze.

description: A small pool of water has collected in a depression upon the ground, a thick root hanging from the ceiling dripping water into it constantly.  The narrow walls descend to meet the floor in a sharp angle, their surfaces smooth and featureless except for the occasional small rock or root breaking the monotony of packed earth.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: A large hole in the otherwise nondescript dirt walls is the only thing that breaks the uniformly dull surroundings.  The hole's progress has been stopped by what appears to be a block of granite only a few feet within the wall, its rough surface holding scratchy, dark stains.  The dusty earthen floor also shows signs of having granite beneath it, some of the more worn sections revealing the dark grey patches of rock.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Thick, smooth roots grow along the walls, their dark forms illuminated by the tiny colonies of luminescent fungi growing upon them.  A light fog creeps across the floor, brought on by the heavy chill hanging over the area.  A few yellowed bones have been staked into the ground, the curling mists rising up to caress each of the macabre artifacts.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Bumpy walls surround you, their uneven surfaces stained by several small rivulets of water, which trickle down silently.  A few patches of slick mold grow on the sides of the floor, catching the moisture from the tiny streams.  The small collections of green slime shiver slightly at times, though there is no sign of anything that disturbs the glistening lumps.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: Soft echoes filter through the narrow passageway, muffled by the dense growth of lichen upon the walls.  The mildly fuzzy fungus covers nearly all of the twisting walls, creating odd round patterns of growth upon them.  A slight breeze whistles through the area, causing some of the looser particles of earth to swirl chaotically about.

title: [Inside Tree, Narrow Tunnel]
description: The overpowering scent of bile fills the tube-like chute as it curves upward.  Tiny pale, hair-like roots coat the smooth walls of the tube, their tips waving back and forth as they brush across your body.  The walls glisten with a slick substance that is moved along the chute with you, supported by the roots.

title: [Maaghara Labyrinth]
description: The surface of the surrounding walls is mottled and bumpy, harboring a collection of putrid green mold clusters that sweat a translucent slime.  The ooze drips downward in thick rivulets, lending a glistening sheen to the walls.  Tiny iridescent stalks sprout from the clusters, each waving about frantically at the slightest sign of movement.

title: [Emerald Forest, Beech Grove]
description: The beech trees lean right up against the hillside, struggling to remain vertical.  Tresses of moss trail from every branch and lichens feather the tree trunks with greens and yellows.

title: [Emerald Forest, Beech Grove]
description: Delicate clusters of low-lying ferns fill in the spaces between the beech trees here, then give way to rocks and dirt where the hill grows steeper.  A yellow-crowned parakeet sits quietly on a crooked bough, fanning out its painted tailfeathers.  To the northeast the trail vanishes into the undergrowth.

title: [Emerald Forest, Mound]
description: There is a fine view of the rustling green canopy below from this elevated spot.  A wiry bush with dark green foliage leans out daringly over the steep slope.  The wind is steady here, gnarling and stunting the exposed trees.

title: [Emerald Forest, Mound]
description: Ferns grow thickly to the north, a welcome shelter from the brisk wind on this promontory.  Through a gap in the treeline you can see a gentle dropoff to a dry gully below.  A lone cricket chirrups from its hiding spot.

title: [Emerald Forest, Fern Tunnel]
description: Filmy ferns lift their clenched tips like little fists.  A dusty grey robin hops out onto the path and cocks its head at you boldly.  Beaded with dew, a spiderweb lends a bejewelled majesty to a cluster of fronds.

title: [Emerald Forest, Fern Tunnel]
description: Tree ferns on tall, slender trunks stand sentinel here, aloft in a viridian sea of waving fronds.  Dappled light falls through the lacy screen and dances playfully across the shifting surfaces.  The shadowy alcoves harbor cooler air in their mysterious depths.

Tree ferns on tall, slender trunks stand sentinel here, aloft in a viridian sea of waving fronds.  Dappled moonlight falls through the lacy screen and dances playfully across the shifting surfaces.  The shadowy alcoves harbor cooler air in their mysterious depths.

title: [Emerald Forest, Fern Tunnel]
description: Tiny, delicate fern fronds push through the rich soil of the path, their tips curled into exquisite spirals.  High above them giant ferns spread their broad arms, dew still sparkling on each dimpled leaf.  Startled by a sudden noise, an intensely green tree frog leaps from a nearby frond and disappears into the undergrowth.

title: [Emerald Forest, Fallen Tree]
description: Within the decaying root ball of this toppled tree, a multitude of creatures make their home.  A rippled shelf fungus clings to the damp bark and epiphytes sprout from its cascading formation.

title: [Emerald Forest, Hillside Trail]
description: The steep hill necessitates a switchback, cutting just below a network of exposed tree roots.  A lizard lies motionless on a sunny rock.  Something inside a bush scuttles, then falls silent.

The steep hill necessitates a switchback, cutting just below a network of exposed tree roots.  A centipede marches slowly across a low, flat rock.  Something inside a bush scuttles, then falls silent.

title: [Emerald Forest, Gully]
description: Within this narrow ravine a skeletal tree stands by itself, unwilling to mingle with its leafy cousins to either side.  Salmon-colored lichen obscures the green granite rocks protruding from the abrupt hillside.

title: [Emerald Forest, Mound]
description: Tall grasses have taken advantage of this small clearing, growing thickly and moving as one green, murmuring wave in the gusting wind.  A circular flattened patch remains where some large creature rested not too long ago.

title: [Emerald Forest, Mound]
description: Trees are sparse here, opening up sightlines to encompass the clearing to the southeast and the commiserating willow trees in the bog below.  The distant sound of rushing water is occasionally audible, a meditative counterpoint to the piercing calls of a nearby flock of parrots.

Trees are sparse here, opening up sightlines to encompass the clearing to the southeast and the commiserating willow trees in the bog below.  The distant sound of rushing water is occasionally audible, a meditative counterpoint to the piercing calls of a nearby flock of roosting parrots.

title: [Emerald Forest, Secluded Path]
description: Majestic oak trees arch high overhead, forming a corridor of crooked branches and rustling breezes.  A pair of dragonflies chase one another in an expanding spiral through hazy shafts of sunlight.  A faint path of amber leaves and loamy earth wanders aimlessly through the middle.

Majestic oak trees arch high overhead, forming a corridor of crooked branches and rustling breezes.  A pair of luna moths chase one another in an expanding spiral through silver shafts of moonlight.  A faint path of amber leaves and loamy earth wanders aimlessly through the middle.

title: [Emerald Forest, Blackberry Row]
description: Compact, thorny bushes prevent any passage in an eastern direction, but to the south the trail heads past pale mossy boulders and up a slight rise.  A few trees cling tenaciously, roots exposed, along the edge of the trail where it drops off sharply to the west.

title: [Emerald Forest, Blackberry Row]
description: A few exploratory tendrils from the mass of blackberry bushes to the southeast have crept out onto the path, looking for more territory to annex.  Several saplings have gained a toehold here, and already their slender branches spread handfuls of shining leaves as an offering to the sun.

A few exploratory tendrils from the mass of blackberry bushes to the southeast have crept out onto the path, looking for more territory to annex.  Several saplings have gained a toehold here, and already their slender branches spread handfuls of shining leaves as an offering to the heavens.

title: [Emerald Forest, Blackberry Row]
description: To the south is a dense tangle of blackberry bushes, barely holding its ground against the verdant springing forest which threatens to shade it entirely.  All the outer branches have been picked clean of berries, but some still remain deep within the thorny interior, tantalizingly ripe.

title: [Emerald Forest, Fallen Tree]
description: An enormous tree trunk blocks all passage to the south, and has now become a mossy cradle for new growth.  Its antennae twitching nervously, a glossy horned beetle pauses in its exploration of the soft wood.

title: [Emerald Forest, Junction]
description: Converging in a clearing of flattened grass, the well-worn trails indicate a great deal of animal traffic.  A broken bough hangs limply from an oak tree with a deeply scarred trunk.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, southwest, west, up

title: [Emerald Forest, Hillside Trail]
description: Lichen-covered branches reach out to brush against you, making it difficult to move quietly along this small pathway.  The well-trodden trail is carpeted in decaying leaves and edged with orange-capped mushrooms.

title: [Emerald Forest, Bracken]
description: Brake ferns grow in a dense wall, leaving only a narrow passageway.  A tiny patch of wintergreen flourishes next to a lichen-scaled boulder.

title: [Emerald Forest, Narrow Trail]
description: There is very little room to maneuver along this section of the trail, as the hillside is steep and the footing chancy.  Bits of gravel shift and tumble down the slope at the least provocation.  One enormous fig tree dominates the area, casting its cool green shade like a blanket over the ground.

There is very little room to maneuver along this section of the trail, as the hillside is steep and the footing chancy.  Bits of gravel shift and tumble down the slope at the least provocation.  One enormous fig tree dominates the area, casting its deep black shadow like a blanket over the ground.

title: [Gorget Trails, Foothills]
description: Canted precariously to one side, the giant maple tree here seems to be hanging on by just a few roots.  Its trunk, cleft nearly in two by a lightning strike, is dry and charred.  Yet high above your head its branches are bursting with leaves and seed-pods litter the ground in all directions.  A small stream flows over speckled blue granite and plunges down the hill.

title: [Gorget Trails, Foothills]
description: Though not as lush as the thick forest below, the vegetation here is still vibrant and plentiful.  Pale blue chicory covers the ground in large swaths and yellow tree tobacco flowers hang their flute-like heads from slender branches.

title: [Gorget Trails, Foothills]
description: Deep claw marks scar the trunks of several trees in this area.  The trail heading down the slope to the south is broad and layered with many criss-crossed tracks.  Bright patches of scarlet creeper enliven the dusty green scrub which carpets the hills.

title: [Gorget Trails, Foothills]
description: Quartz-veined boulders interrupt the green wash of tall grass and darker splotches of bushes.  A flock of parrots bursts out of the forest canopy to the southwest, circling madly, then plunges back into the rippling sea of leaves.

Quartz-veined boulders interrupt the green wash of tall grass and darker splotches of bushes.  A cloud of bats bursts out of the forest canopy to the southwest, circling madly, then plunges back into the rippling sea of leaves.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Switchback]
description: Three charred, branchless tree trunks stand together, remnants of an old fire.  Just past them the trail turns, skirting a thorny bush with waxy yellow flowers.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: The dark cliff rising overhead is bereft of handholds, save a narrow ridge of rock which slants across the face.  Dead branches and twigs are piled loosely at the base, tufts of white fur caught in the forks.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Switchback]
description: The hillside is so steep here that the trail remains nearly level as it changes direction.  At the turning point a few coarse, spiky grasses are putting up a good fight against the eroding soil.

title: [Emerald Forest, Gully Slope]
description: Trees lean conspiratorially close to the hillside, dropping leaves like secrets.  A young oak tree has claimed the dark cavity where a giant boulder once rested.  Somnolent buzzing surrounds a tree-perched beehive overhead.

title: [Emerald Forest, Gully]
description: There is a slight bend to the gully as it curves around the slope to the west.  This seems to be an old streambed, still lined in water-tumbled pebbles and patches of dry moss.  A velvety green caterpillar is working its way up a mottled, shaggy trunk, searching for the simplest path to its unknown goal.

title: [Emerald Forest, Gully]
description: A recent rockfall has left a trail of uprooted saplings and exposed dirt on the steep slope to the west.  Gathered around the base of an ancient, spreading oak tree are several clusters of foxgloves and buttercups.

title: [Emerald Forest, Gully]
description: The gully comes to an end here, choked by a massive wall of vegetation.  An apple-green parrot with a crimson tail is perched on a forked branch, loudly proclaiming its presence to the entire forest.  A single beech tree, aloof yet gracious, holds court in a fawning stand of young oaks and maples.

The gully comes to an end here, choked by a massive wall of wall of vegetation.  An apple-green parrot with a crimson tail is perched on a forked branch, head tucked under one wing as it sleeps.  A single beech tree, aloof yet gracious, holds court in a fawning stand of young oaks and maples.

title: [Emerald Forest, Pool]
description: Tiny fish dart past your legs and gusts of spray from the waterfall wash over your face as you bob in this chilly pool.  Something glints in the crevice of a rock at the very bottom, but the swirling current obscures the details.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: A layer of feldspar glittering with garnet fragments runs across this section of the cliff.  Fuzzy black moss grows in clumps along a shallow horizontal crevice.  Handholds are few, but a slight outcropping just above you looks promising.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: Plunging straight down from the trail is a sheer cliff face with only a small outcropping providing purchase.  A sparsely foliated bush with small green berries grows from the only pocket of soil in the area.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: The path cuts shelflike into the hillside, overlooking a precipitous dropoff.  One tilted layer of rock, clearly more resistant to erosion than the rest, stands out as a sharp ridge running down the cliff face.

title: [Masked Hills, Eroded Spires]
description: The reassuring width of this plateau is a welcome change from the ridge trails to either side.  Your eyes sting from the cold, gusting winds.  Ankle-turning cracks in the rocks underfoot require careful navigation, though the breathtaking view is somewhat distracting.

title: [Masked Hills, Eroded Spires]
description: Passage to the west is obstructed by two skyward-pointing fingers of stone.  Battered by the elements, these misshapen spindles keep watch over the criss-crossing trails below and play host to the occasional visiting bird.

title: [Masked Hills, Saddle Ridge]
description: Looking over the edge of the path you can see a narrow crevasse with a boulder lodged in its maw.  A glossy black crow takes off, startled, from an unidentifiable mound of carrion by the trailside.  To the southwest you see the looming forms of a pair of weathered rock spires.

title: [Masked Hills, Saddle Ridge]
description: From here you can scramble down to the lower ring of trails or walk along the storm-scoured ridgeline.  Blasted bare by the constant winds, no dirt or even small rocks remain along the path.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Masked Hills, Saddle Ridge]
description: Connected to the lower hills by no more than a faint goat path, this exposed ridge commands a spectacular view of the lush valleys below.  The wind-carved boulder rising from the trail resembles a sailing ship provided you squint at it from the right direction.

title: [Masked Hills, Saddle Ridge]
description: A bold outcropping of rock stands up against the ceaseless buffeting, providing a small windbreak.  The air is dry, and you can feel it pulling moisture from your body as it races by.  To the northeast the trail ascends, approaching a ragged peak.

title: [Masked Hills, Saddle Ridge]
description: Further progress up the mountain to the north is blocked by a sprawling rockfall.  Given the steepness of this peak and the apparent instability of the rock pile, attempting to climb it would be unwise.  The mountain goats around here do not seem to be constrained by wisdom, however, if the scatterings of spoor are anything to go by.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: A slight misstep from this rocky prominence would mean a long and painful fall.  The air has a chilly bite to it, despite the clear, bright sunshine.  A papery ribbon of discarded snakeskin flutters in the wind, snagged under a speckled blue rock.

A slight misstep from this rocky prominence would mean a long and painful fall.  The night air is extremely cold, now that the sun has gone into hiding.  A papery ribbon of discarded snakeskin flutters in the wind, snagged under a speckled blue rock.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Round Cave]
description: This shallow cave provides slight protection from the shrieking wind that bolts up the mountainside outside.  It's enough for something, though, as the entire space is taken up with a motley collection of tree branches and animal hides.  Even in the cold air, an acrid stench rises from the nest.

title: [Fethilryn's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Giant Nest]
description: This dark cave is almost completely filled with a great pile of broken and bent tree branches.  Here and there a feather is stuck to the point of a stick or in one of the white smudges on the cavern's floor.

title: [Fethilryn's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a fringed crimson silk banner hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A painted red cedar rack and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Granite Cave]
description: Sunlight sifts thinly through the blue sheet of ice that forms one wall of this large cave.  Glittering granite rock forms two long, low walls that come to a point deep in the darkness.  This haven, though smelling strongly of bear, offers a quiet spot to collect your thoughts.  An ancient pile of blackened bones and shreds of cloth is a reminder to move along before you freeze to the floor.

This haven, though smelling strongly of bear, offers a quiet spot to collect your thoughts.  An ancient pile of blackened bones and shreds of cloth is a reminder to move along before you freeze to the floor.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Foul Cavern]
description: A foul-looking nest the size of small boat takes up most of the space in this natural cavern in the tip of the peak.  Fresh air streams in but is quickly transformed by the acidic odor rising from the white droppings that cover the floor.  This nest is certainly not abandoned.

title: [Kamajen's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a stained mahogany ceiling, a framed Ta'Illistim map hangs on one of the red dragon-inlaid walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a large oak table sit in opposite corners while a sphere-topped black marble fountain rests on a polished marble floor.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley Cave]
description: The thick snow walls of this cave muffle the sound of the crying wind and insulate this cozy space from the biting cold air of the valley above.  Its ceiling is supported by the lower branches of a tall pine tree whose trunk forms a column of grey in the center of the room.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Cavern of Light]
description: High above the door of this hollowed out room, a large crack in the mountainside lets in thin streams of sunlight.  Over the years, it has also let in snow which has melted and frozen many times to form a line of ice stalagmites under it.  The grey light falls on a huge nest built from a collection of whole trees and bushes as well as bits of collected matter like clothing and boots.  A leaning altar is almost completely buried in one of the stalagmites.

title: [Deep Forest, Path]
description: Within the forest's heart, the pungent mustiness of loam rules hand in hand with the relentless green of the woods.  A ragged path winds its way through boles of trees growing so closely together, they look almost like a solid wall.  Chinks of green light filter down from the intertwined branches overhead and sway gently at the prompt of a breeze, dappling the trail where it can be seen through the overhang of fern fronds.
