title: [Deep Forest, Path]
description: Trees grow so densely within the fastness of the forest, the origin of the boughs overhead is practically indistinguishable from one massive bole to the next.  The crisscrossed canopy shades everything beneath them with deep shadow.  Here and there, lacy-edged lichens frill the edge of a rock or up-thrust root with their ivory toned growth, casting a supernatural luminescence in the darkness.

title: [Linden Grove, Path]
description: The path traverses a grove of tall linden trees, their trunks straight and elegant and their lowest branches beginning a good ways off the forest floor.  Beneath the leafy canopy, the ceiling hangs significantly higher than that of the surrounding forest, giving the glade the lofty majesty of a temple nave.  Across the glade's floor, the trail meanders in a loopy pattern that circles trees, crisscrosses and turns back on itself like a drunken serpent.

title: [Linden Grove, Path]
description: Tall, well-spaced linden trees lift their mantle of branches in an attitude of nobility and grace.  At their feet, a path winds through the boles in a haphazard course, ushered along the way by large mounds of silver-edged ferns.  An occasional boulder stands alongside the trail here and there like spectators at a parade, the stones' massive shoulders covered with lichens that look determined to outdo the ferns with their amplitude of silvery patina.

title: [Linden Grove, Path]
description: While the path loops and gambols beneath the tall, stately linden trees of the grove, the trees give the appearance of watching its antics like benevolent, albeit aloof elders pondering the headlong pursuits of children.  Although the grove seems airy with its tall canopy and spacious growth, nonetheless, to all sides the impenetrable quality of deep forest maintains a presence that is never out of mind.

title: [Linden Grove, Path]
description: Next to the path, a filigree of lichens cover the shoulders of a grouping of three boulders huddled like ancient old trolls squatting over a game of knucklebones.  Birds chatter and dart through the linden boughs overhead, the leafy half-light of the thick canopy offering them almost constant concealment.  The grove wears its scent of rich, moist earth and leafy compost like a rare perfume, alternately strong and subtle depending on the whim of the breeze.

A nightingale, hidden within the linden boughs overhead, periodically sings its call to the moonlight.  The grove wears its scent of rich, moist earth and leafy compost like a rare perfume, alternately strong and subtle depending on the whim of the breeze.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Crystal Lake]
description: A grove of linden trees grows almost to the banks of a large, pristine lake, its waters a shade of blue usually reserved for only the most beautiful of sapphires.  Here and there, drifts of fog rise from the mirror-smooth surface like wraiths twirling in a slow-motion dance.  Due north, on the lake's distant shore, stands an unusual building.  Three towers flank the domed structure, and drifting fog girds its striking configuration like a robe of mystery.

Three towers flank the domed structure, and drifting fog girds its striking configuration like a robe of mystery.

A wooden fishing dock juts out over the lake, and drifts of fog rise from the mirror-smooth surface of the water like wraiths twirling in a slow-motion dance.  On the lake's distant shore stands an unusual building.  Three towers flank the domed structure, and drifting fog girds its striking configuration like a robe of mystery.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Entrance]
description: Slight tendrils of mist reach out from the shimmering lake to the south, but neither they nor the tall linden trees they drift through are quite close enough to fall within the shadows of the twin towers rising gracefully from a huge moonstone building.  The crimson summit of a third tower peeks above the smooth dome that crowns the abbey.  A thin marble walkway ends in two imposing ebonwood doors, unfettered by the verdant ivy that clusters so thickly on the walls.

Two slender spires rise gracefully from the structure, and the crimson summit of a third tower peeks above the smooth dome that crowns the abbey.  A thin marble walkway, pale in the moonlight, ends in two imposing ebonwood doors, unfettered by the verdant ivy that clusters so thickly on the walls.

title: [Loreley's Outfitting]
description: A decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and a paneled haon ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a buffed cherrywood floor.  There is an ora-bound large walnut trunk on one side of the shop and a long mahogany rack on the other.

title: [Wraithenmist, Forest Hollow]
description: The trail winds around an ancient monir tree, its limbs covered in silvery-grey moss that has long since stolen the tree's ability to generate foliage of its own.  The moss sways slightly in the breeze, giving the tree a ghostly appearance.

title: [Ravine, Vulture's Nest]
description: Broken shards of a few massive, discolored eggshells are strewn on the floor of the nest, which is as large as a good-sized wagon.  Bird droppings that would each fill a bucket festoon the edges of the nest, dripping from the jagged sticks and thatches of grass in various states of desiccation.

title: [Wraithenmist, Maze of Mist]
description: The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible even to see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

title: [Wraithenmist, Whisper Hollow]
description: The mist thins somewhat in this small clearing.  A lone hollow tree occupies the center of the area, its dark grey bark nearly covered in silvery moss.  The hollow is so quiet it seems even a whisper could be carried far away.

title: [Wraithenmist, Sloping Trail]
description: The trail winds around an outcropping of granite, moisture tricking down the rocks in thin rivulets.  The mist crowds in against the stone, flailing uselessly at the hard surface before rolling backwards towards the lake once more.

title: [Wraithenmist, Sloping Trail]
description: The trail approaches the crest of a small hill.  Few trees remain here, most having been broken off a scant dozen feet above the ground by some unknown force.  The remains of the upper limbs lie rotting on the sodden ground.

title: [Wraithenmist, Hilltop]
description: The eerily glowing mist swirls and eddies across the hilltop, obscuring any view of the Wraithenmist that might have been found here.  Small patches of lichen and moss dot the landscape.

title: [Wraithenmist, Hilltop]
description: A dead thanot tree stands sentinel atop the hill.  Its gnarled and twisted limbs reach skyward, draped here and there with thin tendrils of silvery moss as a lady would wear a fine strand of pearls.

title: [Wraithenmist, Hilltop]
description: With no trees to interrupt its stealthy approach, the mist thickens considerably, lowering visibility to only a few feet in any direction. A patch of glowing lichen encroaches upon the surface of a nearby boulder, emitting a strange greenish glow.

title: [Wraithenmist, Hilltop]
description: The hilltop slopes downwards, signs of a narrow trail barely visible in the thickening mist.  Silvery tendrils of wispy fog gather and flow about the trees nearby as if caressing them tenderly.

title: [Wraithenmist, Sloping Trail]
description: The trail winds its way down a gently rolling hillside.  Thickly gathered haon trees crowd the path, their thin leafless branches reaching forth spindly arms as if to grab and hold passersby.

title: [Wraithenmist, Sloping Trail]
description: The trail, barely visible on the moss-covered ground, winds its way between stands of trees barely visible thanks to the ever-present mist that encroaches upon the landscape.

title: [Wraithenmist, Steep Slope]
description: The stillness of the forest is broken only by the sounds of water.  The gurgling of trickles and the soft *plop* and *plunk* of droplets reverberate through the trees, the ricochets of sound seeming nearly as loud as thunder compared to the utter silence of the dead forest.

title: [Wraithenmist, Steep Slope]
description: A thick stand of thanot trees reach their leafless, lifeless limbs skyward, as if trying to find some sunlight above the choking silvery mist.  Rivulets of moisture run down their half-rotted trunks to puddle on the ground beneath before trickling down the slope.

title: [Wraithenmist, Steep Slope]
description: The slope transitions to a narrow gully to the south.  A crowd of long-dead thanot trees hugs the slope.  Several of the largest have fallen to the ground, victims of the predatory moss, incessant moisture and root rot.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, up

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Gully]
description: Tendrils of silvery moss trail from the lifeless limbs of a huge haon tree.  The breeze stirs the moss, sending it into writhing contortions and scattering the condensation which clings to it in a fine spray of droplets.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Gully]
description: Scraggly trees struggle for purchase on the sloping walls of the gully, a few sporting sickly grey-hued leaves.  The wind whips steadily through the area, tossing the tree limbs together with a staccato *crack*.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Gully]
description: A long-abandoned shack sits at the foot of the gully, its roof long since rotted away.  The wooden walls of the structure, turned grey with exposure to the elements, provide a home for a variety of clinging moss and lichen.

title: [Wraithenmist, Creek Bed]
description: A scant trickle of water runs down the creek bed, its thin choked gurgle the only sound in the silent forest.  The ruined shell of a wooden box protrudes from the creek's bank at a haphazard angle.

title: [Wraithenmist, Creek Bed]
description: The thin trickling stream pools into a small hollow in the ground, eddying a bit before tumbling out the other side of the hollow and progressing down the creek bed.  The murmur of the stream is punctuated by the occasional *plop* of moisture falling from the trees overhead into the water below.

title: [Wraithenmist, Creek Bed]
description: The remains of a small wooden raft lie discarded on the creek bank.  The wooden logs forming the raft's base lie at odd angles, loosely held together by some half-rotted ropes.  At one time, there must have been enough water here to support such a conveyance.

title: [Wraithenmist, Creek Bed]
description: The creek's pathetic little trickle of water dribbles into the edge of a shallow swamp.  Ancient stands of maoral and monir trees, leafless and decaying, dot the landscape.  Silvery moss drifts in thin strands from the tree limbs.

title: [Wraithenmist, Shallow Swamp]
description: The thickly wooded forest melts into swampland, the bushes giving way to thin silvery reeds.  A few trees, gnarled and ancient, grow from the boggy ground, their twisted roots rearing above the water.

title: [Wraithenmist, Shallow Swamp]
description: A small hut, surrounded by a strangely profuse herb garden, stands on the rise of a hill in the center of the clearing.  A thin column of smoke wafts from the hut's stacked stone chimney.  Oddly, the air about the hut's dooryard shimmers slightly, as if there is some sort of invisible barrier present.

title: [Wraithenmist, Shallow Swamp]
description: A massive tree, its roots thoroughly rotted, lies haphazardly half in and half out of the shallow water.  The silvery moss still clinging to the tree's dead trunk floats upon the surface of the dank water, undulating gently.

title: [Wraithenmist, Shallow Swamp]
description: Though moved by no visible force, the shallow water of the swamp undulates gently, lapping against the roots of trees.  The only sound in the area is the gentle *swish* of the water as it slaps immoveable objects that lie in its path.

title: [Wraithenmist, Hollow Tree]
description: The interior of the tree, cavernous by any standard, shows no signs of what caused the massive hollow's creation.  Small patches of glowing lichen cling to the tree's ancient woody pulp, casting a dim phosphorescent glow across the darkened space.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Entry]
description: The entry hall of the inn is small and stuffy, smelling as if the place hasn't been aired out in years.  A ratty tapestry covers the wall opposite the front entrance, its fabric too moth-eaten to discern what the scene upon it may have once depicted.  Raucous noise comes from behind a swinging door in the south wall.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Front Desk]
description: A bored-looking clerk sits behind a scarred wooden desk, occasionally handing out keys to patrons, who accept their keys from him with expressions varying from blank stares to annoyed grimaces.  Although this establishment is fairly shady, many of the customers look even shadier.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Upper Landing]
description: Shabby carpeting covers the wooden floorboards, but does nothing to disguise the creaking and groaning underfoot as the few patrons of this dubious establishment wander the hallway.  A battered brass chandelier hangs from the beams above, casting a dim sickly light across the hall.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Sitting Room]
description: Dingy curtains frame an equally grimy window, its glaes panes so dirty that seeing through them is virtually impossible.  A couch, its stuffing popping out in various locations, rests against one wall.  Pushed up against the opposite wall rests a wooden table scarred with gouges and water rings.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Bedroom]
description: A small straw-tick bed covered with wrinkled sheets is shoved into a corner of the tiny room.  So small there is barely room to squeeze a washstand in the opposite corner, the room's only luxury appears to be a cracked mirror hanging above the washstand.

title: [The Elven Hold, Sanctuary]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Valley, Oak Clearing]
description: The small, bright woodland clearing bounds a small overhanging ledge of granite on the south side, looking out over a scenic view of the vast wooded valley and the distant road beyond.  Thick moss carpets the flat, sun-warmed stone, and sparrows and finches flutter and chirp in the branches of the surrounding oaks.

The small, moonlit woodland clearing bounds a small overhanging ledge of granite on the south side, looking out over a scenic view of the vast wooded valley and the distant road beyond.  Thick moss carpets the darkened stone, and an owl hoots softly somewhere nearby in the branches of the surrounding oaks.

title: [Gylterhom's General Store]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is an ora-bound large walnut trunk and a wide faenor-trimmed table.

title: [Gylterhom's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is an ora-bound large walnut trunk and a wide faenor-trimmed table.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Thicket]
description: The rough brambles of the underbrush and the sturdier branches of the overhanging trees fill the dark thicket with a nearly impassable mass of tortuous vegetation.  A glistening black spider crouches in her irregular web amid the sharp-thorned bushes, and a pitted, moss-covered headstone marks the location of a long-forgotten grave.

title: [Gylterhom's General Store]

title: [Orcswold, Wooded Trail]
description: Flecks of sunlight gleam through the thick foliage overhead, dappling the dark soil of the winding path.  Many of the nearby trees appear to have been stripped of small shoots and branches, and the berry bushes closest to the open path have been stripped of fruit.  A shady trail leads through the underbrush.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: The low, grass-covered plain stretches off to the south and east, the foot-high grass speckled with clumps of trees and patches of taller vegetation.  The wind blows constantly across the plain, ruffling the grass in ever-shifting patterns of green and brown.  A trail winds up to a plateau of higher grass to the west.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: The distant form of some large creature bounding through the grass moves across the horizon, its species indistinguishable as its fast-moving brownish blur blends with the dirt and grass.  The sea of grass moves in endless waves, blown by the continual breeze from the east.

The distant form of some large creature bounding through the grass moves across the dark horizon, its species indistinguishable as its fast-moving greyish blur blends with the dirt and grass.  The sea of grass moves in endless waves, blown by the continual breeze from the east.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Cliff Face]
description: A sheer, rocky cliff stands at the east end of the grassy veldt, forming an impassable barrier to the plateau high above.  Piles of rocks of various sizes lie at the base of the cliff, having fallen over the years from the rough crags overhead.  An island of hardwood trees stands to the west, rising from the green plain.

paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Yegharren Plain, Cliff Face]
description: The dark forms of massive birds soar high above, circling above their nests high on the face of the cliff that bounds the eastern edge of the veldt.  The grass grows more sparsely here in the shade of the cliff face, taking root among the many sharp rocks fallen from above.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: The expanse of grass continues for acres in every direction, ending at the face of a cliff some distance to the east.  The level plain is broken by a spreading thicket of trees that stands like an island just north of the trail.

paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west

title: [Yegharren Plain, Trees]
description: A raised mound of earth provides root for a clump of hardy trees and temporary shelter for many passing creatures, judging by the number of foot and claw prints and the scratch-marked trunks.  A variety of colorful birds perch in the branches above, chirping and singing in a chaotic chorale.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: Odd ridges of dirt cross the trail here and there, as if something had constructed burrows just beneath the surface.  A patch of taller grass nearby rustles with a sudden movement, then goes still.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Cliff Face]
description: The sunlit plain of grass extends off to the west as far as the eye can see.  A constant wind blows down from the rugged crags above, carrying a slight chill and a touch of humid mist in the air.  The gliding form of a huge bird circling overhead casts a momentary shadow over the grass.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: Patterns of light and shadow move in waves across the foot-high grass, shifting in the constant wind.  A tiny stream no more that a foot wide trickles slowly, cutting a narrow swathe through the level sea of green.

paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: A few graceful trees stand tall above the grassy veldt, their flowering branches attracting swarms of buzzing bees and a few jewel-like hummingbirds.  The shrieking cry of some distant bird of prey echoes faintly on the wind.

A few graceful trees stand tall above the grassy veldt, their flowering branches attracting a few buzzing bees and other insects even in the darkness of the night.  The shrieking cry of some distant bird of prey echoes faintly on the wind.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: Several large grasshoppers leap from the field near the path, extending their buzzing wings to fly for a few seconds before disappearing into a new grassy hideout away from the disturbance.  The wind whistles down from the high moors to the east, bringing a faint scent of something desolate and unwholesome along with the cooling air.

paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: A wide expanse of grass surrounds you in every direction, bounded by the woods to the southwest and the rising mass of the high moors to the east.  The crumpled skeleton of a large boarlike animal lies beside the trail, its weathered bones glistening in the sunlight, while white and yellow butterflies cavort above the grass, oblivious to the evidence of death below.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: The grass buzzes with the vibrations of countless bees and flies and locusts, the sound a constant faint hum under the whistling of the eastern wind.  Rising from the level plain like a miniature mountain, the severed trunk of a long-dead tree provides shelter for a colony of ants and beetles.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: Patches of tall flowering weeds grow here and there above the level plain, attracting swarms of bees and a few brightly colored birds that add their chirping to the constant sound of wind across the grass.  The path winds around to the southwest, where the grassland borders a heavily wooded area.

Patches of tall flowering weeds grow here and there above the level plain, their leaves fading to silvery grey in the wan moonlight.  A few crickets add their chirping to the incessant shush of night breezes through the grass.  The path winds around to the southwest, where the grassland borders a heavily wooded area.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: A wall of thick underbrush separates the western edge of the grassy plain from the dense woods beyond.  The sea of grass extends northeast as far as the eye can see, broken by stands of trees and the faint tracings of hunting trails.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Veldt]
description: A vast expanse of grass covers the plain to the north, stretching off to the horizon around a scattering of trees.  Heavy underbrush marks the edge of the plain, forming a thicket of brambles and scrub.

title: [Orcswold, Scrub]
description: A patch of thick brambles and weeds covers the side of the sloping hillock, thriving on the seeping water that makes the ground soft beneath your feet.  A few sparrows flit among the brambles, collecting twigs and dried leaves for their hidden nests.

title: [Orcswold, Grassy Slope]
description: The field opens into an expanse of grass in shades of green and brown, clear of rocks and trees and home to a flock of scrawny wild rolton that carefully keep their distance from wandering hunters as they graze.  A steady wind blows down from the higher moors to the east, bringing a slight chill to the air.

The field opens into an expanse of grass in shades of green and brown, clear of rocks and trees and home to a flock of scrawny wild rolton that rest warily some distance from the well-trodden hunting trails.  A steady wind blows down from the higher moors to the east, bringing a slight chill to the air.

title: [Orcswold, Grassy Slope]
description: The grassland ends in a low cliff that runs just to the east like a giant's step up to the next level of the plain, where a smattering of shade-loving wildflowers adorn the partially sun-shielded ground.  Far in the distance, the outlines of huge birds circle over the high moors above, riding on the constant wind that whistles down from that direction.

title: [Orcswold, Fields]
description: A gently rolling field of grass, dotted with scattered stones and patches of rough weeds, extends from the western woods to the eastern moors.  A faint sound of indecipherable chanting, almost musical and not quite human, echoes from somewhere in the distance.

title: [Orcswold, Grasslands]
description: The field rises in a scrub-covered hillock, the low brush and sparse grass windswept by a stiff breeze from the east.  Several black crows fly near to the ground in the distance, their harsh cries echoing across the barren field.

The field rises in a scrub-covered hillock, the low brush and sparse grass windswept by a stiff breeze from the east.  A lone crow flies near to the ground in the distance, its dark silhouette a shadow against the distant hills.

title: [Orcswold, Scrub]
description: A small wallow of mud fills a slight depression in the plain, its edges dotted with the tracks of a variety of passing creatures.  Flowering weeds and tangled brambles grow thickly in the damp ground near the wallow.

title: [Orcswold, Grasslands]
description: A pile of stones has been arranged in a small circle to one side of the path, but any evidence of a fire that must have once burned at their center has long since blown away with the wind and rain.  A rolling landscape of grass and dirt and scraggly bushes stretches off in several directions.

title: [Orcswold, Grasslands]
description: A horned lizard suns on a flat rock some distance from the well-trodden path, oblivious to passing hunters.  The rolling landscape of rough scrub, dirt, and grass extends in every direction.
A horned lizard scurries over a flat rock some distance from the well-trodden path, oblivious to passing hunters.  The rolling landscape of rough scrub, dirt, and grass extends in every direction.

title: [Orcswold, Grasslands]
description: The rough, rolling ground is covered with sparse grass and patches of weeds.  A swarm of flies hovers around a nearly clump of brambles, and the scent that wafts by on the breeze hints that perhaps something has died in there.

title: [Orcswold, Grasslands]
description: Brilliant yellow butterflies flitter around a patch of tall white-flowered weeds that grow at the edge of the woods along the western edge of the path.  A few head-sized stones have been moved from the open field and placed in a rough row just this side of the trees, arranged in a crude boundary line.

Crickets chirp a constant chorus from within the patches of weeds that grow at the edge of the woods along the western edge of the path.  A few head-sized stones have been moved from the open field and placed in a rough row just this side of the trees, arranged in a crude boundary line.

title: [Orcswold, Grasslands]
description: Small mounds of dirt are scattered here and there among the weeds and rocks, as if dug up by some small burrowing animal.  The sharp staccato of a woodpecker hard at work in the woods just to the west echoes over the grassy field.

title: [Orcswold, Wooded Trail]
description: Well-trodden paths lead off into the woods in several directions.  A strong whiff of animal dung is carried on the cool breeze that wafts through the dense forest, alternating with a faint smell of cooking meat.  Patches of ferns near the path are sparse in places, their coiled shoots broken off at the stem.

title: [Orcswold, Wooded Trail]
description: The trail curves sharply over the top of a small ridge, sloping down steeply to the southeast.  Patches of delicate wildflowers are sprinkled beneath the ominous canopy of branches, seeming somehow out of place next to the clawed footprints that have trampled their borders.

title: [Orcswold, Wooded Trail]
description: Two large oak trees stand on either side of the trail, their branches forming a low arch over the mossy ground.  A flash of color in the intermittent sunlight shows that the overhanging foliage has been decorated with a variety of feathers and strange totems.

title: [Orcswold, Village Camp]
description: The sparsely wooded clearing is peppered with the severed trunks of trees of all sizes that were cut down to make space for what seems to be a permanent settlement.  Dust rises from the ground where most of the grass has been trampled and cleared by passing orcs and dogs.

title: [Orcswold, Village Camp]
description: Several primitive huts, built of rough-hewn wood and branches and thatched with bundles of long dried grass, are scattered around the dusty clearing.  A strong animal stench permeates the air, and the ground is rife with the trampled leavings of dogs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Orcswold, Village Camp]
description: Rough wooden drying racks are arranged around the perimeters of the clearing, spread with animal hides in various states of tanning, and the stench that rises from the dilapidated hut near the racks hangs like a foul mist in the air.  Scraps of fur and half-dried flesh litter the ground amid tufts of scrawny weeds.

title: [Orcswold, Village Camp]
description: The charred remains of an oft-used campfire fill a rough circle of stones in front of a low mud-roofed hut.  Scraps of bone and half-burnt animal skin litter the dirt near the firepit, and the overhanging branches of nearby trees are blackened with soot.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Orcswold, Village Camp]
description: A half-built wooden structure that seems to be either a half-built hut or a hut that has been half-destroyed stands at the edge of the woods amidst a sparse stand of young pine trees.  The ground is marked with dozens of footprints of orcs and hounds, and a distinct animal stench fills the air.

title: [Orcswold, Dog Runs]
description: Swarms of flies buzz around this wide strip of cleared ground, which is covered with scuffs and tracks of the passing of hundreds of large hounds and their orcish masters.  Rough stakes are pounded into the dirt here and there, some hung with braided leather leashes, though no animals are presently fettered here for training.  An overpowering smell of unwashed dog and excrement fills the air.

title: [Orcswold, Fields]
description: The trampled ground of the clearing to the west opens into an expanse of barren, hilly scrub.  Patches of scrawny bushes and brambles are scattered here and there, and rocks and irregular paths of well-trampled dirt break up the grassy field.

title: [Orcswold, Fields]
description: The field dips into a shallow depression between the hills, and the ground is muddy with gathered rainwater in the hollow of ground.  Paths lead off through the grass in several directions, winding between patches of wildflowers and scrub.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Orcswold, Cliffside]
description: A sheer cliff, only about thirty feet high but far too sheer and slippery to climb here, rises to the next level of the plain, bounding the eastern edge of the field.  Tendrils of mist drift down the face of the cliff now and then, blown by the constant wind, and shade-loving bushes flourish in the shadow of the rocky barrier.

title: [Orcswold, Fields]
description: A cool wind sweeps over the grassy field, murmuring in the grass and chilling the air with a touch of mist from the high moors to the east.  Startled by your presence, a sleek brown rabbit leaps from behind a stone and bounds away into the grass.

title: [Orcswold, Fields]
description: A rectangular stone as tall as a giantman stands alone beside the path, its ancient markings obscured by age and weather.  A strong animal smell wafts though the air, drowning out the delicate scent of the wildflowers that sprout from the grass around the standing stone.

title: [Orcswold, Fields]
description: A scattering of trees mark the edge of the wooded area that bounds the grassy fields to the north, and the twittering of a flock of birds nestled invisibly somewhere in the nearby trees fills the air.  The ground slopes down to the south, leveling into a low windswept moor.

title: [Orcswold, Low Moors]
description: The fields spread out into a low, boggy field to the south, featureless except for a grassy mound of earth that rises from the flat landscape just to the south. title: [Orcswold, Old Road]
description: Lines of stony rubble that trace the outlines of an ancient dirt road begin at the high, grassy mound just to the west and continue east over the moors into the misty distance.  The cool wind ruffles the grass, bringing a whiff of ozone and a tingle of electricity in the air.

title: [Orcswold, Low Moors]
description: The ground is boggy at the foot of the grassy mound that rises from the moor just to the north, and patches of delicate wildflowers thrive near the collected moisture. title: [Orcswold, Low Moors]
description: The crumbled stones that mark the edges of the old road end at the foot of a large, grassy mound that rises from the field just to the east.  The air is still here, shielded from the wind by the unnaturally symmetrical hill, and a strange crackling like nearby lightning shimmers in the air.

title: [Orcswold, Fields]
description: Sparse grass in varying shades of brown and green covers the hillside, torn up in regular patches in some places as if someone has been collecting the sod for fuel.  The well-trodden path slopes down to the southeast to what looks like the remnant of an ancient road running west to east across the moor.

title: [Orcswold, Low Moors]
description: Two parallel lines of lichen-covered rubble that must have been low stone walls centuries ago stretch off to the east, marking the boundaries of an ancient road that now ends abruptly at the thick woods to the west.  Patches of weeds and occasional bright wildflowers grow among and around the broken stones, encroaching on the rutted path.

title: [Orcswold, Dog Warren]
description: The foul stench of unwashed dogs and excrement fills the air like a tangible, dank fog.  Rough beds of malodorous straw are strewn around the pitted, mucky floor of the low structure, surrounded by scraps of matted fur and gnawed bones, some still bearing strips of bloody meat.

title: [Orcswold, Food Storage]
description: Swarms of black and green flies buzz around a revolting assortment of dead animal parts suspended from rough wooden beams on the ceiling of the dirt-floored hut.  Piles of stems and roots and a few crude baskets of mushrooms and berries cover most of the floor, most of them crawling with ants and beetles enjoying the feast of stored foodstuffs.

title: [Orcswold, Tannery]
description: The rough-cut wooden logs of the walls are covered with the skins and furs of a variety of local animals, from a huge, stinking bear skin on one wall to the smaller pelts of rabbits and squirrels, all in various states of cleaning and preparation and all exuding an overpowering smell of rotting flesh.  A snake skin twice as long as a giantman is tall is draped over a crude drying rack, its fanged head still attached.

title: [Orcswold, Thatched Hut]
description: The wind whistles through the roughly built walls of the dirt-floored hut, but the touch of fresh air is not enough to blow away the overpowering stench of sweaty orc that fills the room.  Pallets of dried grass, stacked with stinking, matted furs and rife with crawling insects, are arranged around the filthy floor, and crude talismans of bone and tattered feathers hang from the thatched ceiling.

title: [Orcswold, Wooden Hut]
description: The crude, dirt-floored hut is decorated -- if it could be called decor -- with dozens of carved bones and bright feathers and primitive totems of wood, hung haphazardly from the thatched ceiling and stuck into the gaps in the walls.  A musty, stinking straw pallet rests at the back of the hut, next to a crude wooden bowl filled with some dark, reeking liquid.

title: [Orcswold Moor, Mound]
description: The grass-covered mound rises twenty feet above the surrounding moor, too perfectly round and flat-topped to have been formed by nature.  The wind seems to swirl in a constant vortex here, tossing faint tendrils of mist and tiny bits of grass and debris in playful eddies, and the air crackles with a strange, tingling energy, as if a storm were brewing overhead.

The grass-covered mound rises twenty feet above the surrounding moor, too perfectly round and flat-topped to have been formed by nature.  The wind seems to swirl in a constant vortex here, tossing faint tendrils of mist and tiny bits of grass and debris in playful eddies, and the night crackles with a strange, tingling energy, as if a storm were brewing overhead.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Yegharren Valley, Narrow Cave]
description: Massive walls of dark granite meet overhead to form a small passage, shielded from the wind and weather.  The walls are patterned with greenish lichen, and clumps of white-capped mushrooms grow in the sparse patches of soil and debris that have collected in the cool darkness of the cave.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The ravine ends abruptly in a wide, rocky area, the floor of the chasm smoothed by the pounding of falling water eons ago.  A few small trees and patches of weeds have taken root in the stony ground, amid piles of fallen rocks and a few bones of fallen adventurers, at the foot of the precipitous wall.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The steep walls of the ancient ravine cast deep shadows even in the brightness of day.  The dark outlines of huge birds glide overhead, momentarily blocking out what remains of the sun.  Sharp fallen rocks and muddy patches of ground make the passage treacherous even to the surefooted.

The steep walls of the ancient ravine cast deep shadows that block out the bright moonlight from far above.  The dark outlines of huge birds occasionally glide overhead, their shadows obliterating the distant stars as they pass.  Sharp fallen rocks and muddy patches of ground make the passage treacherous even to the surefooted.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: A huge pile of fallen rocks, left by some long-ago landslide, blocks the entire width of the ravine to the east.  Scraggly bushes grow in the patches of soil that have built up in the sharp nooks and crannies, and the half-dried corpse of what looks like it was once a large dog lies shattered and impaled where it fell.

A huge pile of fallen rocks, left by some long-ago landslide, blocks the entire width of the ravine to the east.  Scraggly bushes grow in the patches of soil that have built up in the sharp nooks and crannies, and the half-dried corpse of what looks like it was once a large dog lies shattered and impaled, its bones glinting in a shard of moonlight.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: A lone tree protrudes from a ledge some distance above, its twisted form, grown from a fallen seed many years ago, casting an uneven shadow over the ravine.  A huge pile of fallen rocks blocks the ravine to the west, its sharp and unstable edges forming a treacherous obstacle.

A lone tree protrudes from a ledge some distance above, its twisted form, grown from a fallen seed many years ago, casting a ghostly shadow in the moonlight.  A huge pile of fallen rocks blocks the ravine to the west, its sharp and unstable edges forming a treacherous obstacle.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The eastern floor of the ravine climbs steeply upward, the nearly vertical slope slick with mud.  Heaps of fallen rock litter the ground amid patches of muck and trampled weeds in the ever-changing shadows of the precipitous ravine walls.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The floor of the ravine is soft and muddy here, the runoff of soil from the moors high above piled twenty feet deep under your feet.  Jagged shards of stone protrude from the dirt, along with a few shards of weatherworn bone.  A narrow ledge extends from the rock wall a few feet above the present level of the ground, and the ground descends a dangerously slippery slope to the west.

title: [Ravine, Narrow Ledge]
description: A niche in the ravine wall partially conceals the low opening of a small cave.  A rough natural shelf of stone protrudes from the wall next to the cave, its flat surface covered with soot, old wax, and scraps of burnt offerings left over the years.  The greyish splotches of huge bird droppings, most of them dried by the sun and wind, cover the dirt and stone of the ledge.

title: [Ravine, A Small Cave]
description: The walls of the narrow cave are covered with crude paintings of boars and birds and primitive hunting scenes, the broad strokes half-concealed by the effects of crawling lichen and dripping moisture.  The ceiling is stained with the soot of a thousand ancient torches.

title: [Ravine, A Small Cave]
description: The old marks of axes and chisels are visible on the stone walls and ceiling of the small cave, which has been shaped into a crude but almost circular dome.  A low stone slab, roughly cut into a door-sized rectangle, rests against the far wall, its surface dotted with the long-dried wax and soot of burnt candles and torches.  Any adornment the altar once bore has been long since stolen away, and all that remains of the primitive shrine are the broad strokes of lichen-faded paintings on the stone.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: A patch of bright white wildflowers provide a spot of brightness in the shadow, having taken root in the thick, muddy soil that has fallen from the plains above and built into a thick layer over the years, seeming oddly out of place in the rocky desolation of the ravine.  The dirt drops off into a steep, slippery slope back to the rough stone floor of the chasm.

A patch of bright white wildflowers glow in the sparse moonlight, having taken root in the thick, muddy soil that has fallen from the plains above and built into a thick layer over the years, seeming oddly out of place in the rocky desolation of the ravine.  The dirt drops off into a steep, slippery slope back to the rough stone floor of the chasm.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: A twenty-foot-high mound of earth blocks passage to the west, its steep borders slick with mud as if it had been washed down into the grotto by centuries of rain and drainage.  Thick patches of weeds grow in profusion around the dirt, but the bare ravine floor to the east is stony and desolate.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: Huge boulders are scattered about the floor of the ravine, some old and weather-worn, some shattered into knife-sharp shards in their recent fall from above.  A long-standing heap of stone forms a natural staircase leading up the ravine wall to an overhanging ledge above.

Huge boulders are scattered about the dark floor of the ravine, some old and weather-worn, some shattered into knife-sharp shards in their recent fall from above.  A long-standing heap of stone forms a natural staircase leading up the ravine wall to an overhanging ledge above.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine Ledge]
description: Loose clods of dirt and shards of bone litter the ledge beneath a huge nest, which adheres precariously to a niche just above on the ravine wall.  The ledge narrows to the east, curving under a sharp overhang in the wall, but appears to be wide enough to pass.

title: [Ravine, Vulture's Nest]
description: Broken branches, thatches of dried grass, clods of dirt, and bits of feathers and dried flesh and bone from long-dead corpses make up the massive nest.  A crumbling outcropping of stone hangs directly overhead, blocking out the sun.

Broken branches, thatches of dried grass, clods of dirt, and bits of feathers and dried flesh and bone from long-dead corpses make up the massive nest.  A crumbling outcropping of stone hangs directly overhead, blocking any view of the stars above.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine Ledge]
description: The precarious ledge winds beneath a jagged overhang of the wall, and the stone under the eternal shadow is dark and cool.  Crude paintings of soaring, monstrous birds cover the moss-tinged wall in the shelter of the ledge, untouched by the howling wind that whistles through the grotto.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine Ledge]
description: The stone ledge is narrow here, but the rough wall of the ravine provides plenty of handholds.  A huge nest built of grass and sticks and mud, large enough for a family of giantmen to sleep in, is tucked into a crevice just off the ledge.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: Pieces of bushes and dried scrub lie scattered around the dirt and stone floor of the ravine, having fallen over the years from the edges of the moors above.  Tendrils of damp, silvery mist seep down into the ravine, dissipating as they swirl and slide down the ancient sheer rock walls.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The long-buried bones of some unfortunate fallen adventurer protrude from a huge pile of jagged rocks left by the ancient landslide that buried the east end of the ravine in crumbled stone.  The walls rise steeply to both sides, revealing subtle grey patterns of striated rock.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The ravine is narrow and dark here in the shadow of the overhanging ledge above, and the walls are slick with moisture dripping slowly from the plains above.  An assortment of broken rocks, weathered bones, and clods of fallen dirt litter the hard floor of the gully.

title: [Ravine's End]
description: Piles of jagged rocks fill the end of the ravine, deposited by some long-ago landslide or explosion that has completely concealed whatever route the ancient stream that carved out the ravine took to disappear into the earth.  A steep ladder of crude stairs extends up the north wall, transformed by the rubble and muddy runoff from above into an unstable and treacherous climb.

title: [Ravine's End, Ledge]
description: The ledge protrudes from a sheltered niche tucked into the end of the ravine, a spot of relative safety above the piles of jagged rocks below.  The blackened remains of a long-dead torch stand in a crude sconce carved from the solid rock of the ravine wall, and mist creeps down from the overhanging edge of the moors above like an ethereal waterfall, dissipating in the still air and dampening the cold stone.

title: [High Plains, Old Barrow Road]
description: A brisk, steady wind blows over the plain, swirling odd bits of grass and leaves across the ancient road and bending the rough patches of brambles and heather that dot the surrounding plain in an eternal slant.  Parallel lines of crumbled stone that once were walls stretch to the north, marking the edges of the rutted road.

A brisk, chill night wind blows over the plain, bending the dark patches of brambles and heather that dot the surrounding plain in an eternal slant.  Parallel lines of crumbled stone stretch to the north, marking the edges of the rutted road.

title: [High Plains, Old Barrow Road]
description: Uprooted chunks of bramble bushes blow across the road like ghostly tumbleweeds, joining the mist in a windblown dance.  The crumbling stones that border the ancient road lead due north, to where a dark, misty moor rises above the plain.

title: [High Plains, Moorgate]
description: The road rises to the north, the ground piled into a sloping ramp that ends in a massive, ancient stone gate.  No barrier stands to either side of the gate but the sheer ledge that forms the edge of the higher ground, and the heavy mist that covers the dark plateau beyond seeps down around its sides to swirl and dissipate in the damp air.

The road rises to the north, the ground piled into a sloping ramp that ends in a massive, ancient stone gate.  No barrier stands to either side of the gate but the sheer ledge that forms the edge of the higher ground, and the heavy mist that covers the dark plateau beyond seeps down around its sides to swirl and dissipate in the cold night air.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [High Plains, Plateau]
description: The plain ends a short distance to the north in the dark shape of an even higher and more desolate plateau, its heights shrouded in an ethereal mist that seems to gather and flow in the chill wind to swirl around your feet.  Several faint rectangular depressions dimple the cold ground, arranged in a row like ancient graves but unmarked by any stone.

title: [High Plains, Plateau]
description: A steady, cold wind blows across the plain from the east, rustling in the damp grass and swirling tendrils of mist over the rolling ground.  A few solitary trees stand sentinel on the plain, their bare branches silhouetted against the distant sky.

A steady, cold wind blows across the plain from the east, rustling in the damp grass and swirling tendrils of mist over the rolling ground.  A few solitary trees stand sentinel on the plain, their bare branches silhouetted against the night sky.

title: [High Plains, Plateau]
description: A fallen pillar of grey stone lies half-hidden under a patch of windswept brambles, broken into many pieces by the force of its fall and the forces of nature.  A constant, faint howl seems to fill the air, and whether it is the howling of the chill wind or of some distant ghostly creature is difficult to tell.

title: [High Plains, Plateau]
description: The ground rises into a desolate plateau, overlooking the rocky abyss of the ravine far below.  A lone tree stands on the moor amid tendrils of swirling mist, its branches stripped by the constant wind into an ominous skeleton of wood.

The ground rises into a desolate plateau, overlooking the abyss of the ravine far below, its darkness bottomless in the night.  A lone tree stands on the moor amid tendrils of swirling mist, its dark branches stripped by the constant wind into an ominous skeleton of wood.

title: [Yegharren Plain, High Plains]
description: The distant howl of some unknown beast echoes faintly over the plain, carried on the damp, chill wind.  A few trees, their branches denuded by the wind and weather, stand in a small group near the trail, as if huddling together against some threatening force.

title: [Yegharren Plain, High Plains]
description: The rolling, misty plain stretches in all directions, bounded by the dark forms of the distant hills.  Scattered stones and patches of brambles break the landscape here and there, and the steady wind pushes faint clouds of fog in an everchanging swirling pattern.

The misty, moonlit plain stretches in all directions, bounded by the dark forms of the distant hills.  Scattered stones and patches of brambles break the landscape here and there, and the steady wind pushes faint clouds of fog in an everchanging swirling pattern.

title: [High Plains, Cliff's Edge]
description: The trail rounds the edge of the barren plain, coming dangerously close to the treacherous edge of the rocky ravine.  The gliding silhouettes of huge birds circle overhead, black against the dismal grey of the sky, as they scan the desolate landscape for their next meal.

The trail rounds the edge of the barren plain, coming dangerously close to the treacherous edge of the rocky ravine.  The gliding silhouettes of huge birds circle overhead, darker black against the deep grey of the sky, as they scan the desolate landscape for their next meal.

title: [High Plains, Cliff's Edge]
description: The plain ends just to the south at the edge of a deep ravine, where the wind blows wispy tendrils of mist past the sudden border of the grass to disperse over the rocks far below.  The dark forms of huge birds circle overhead, casting drifting shadows in the fog-filtered sunlight.

The plain ends just to the south at the edge of a deep ravine, where the wind blows wispy tendrils of mist past the sudden border of the grass to disperse over the rocks far below.  The dark forms of huge birds circle overhead, casting drifting shadows over the fog-shrouded moons.

title: [High Plains, Gorse Ridge]
description: The trail winds across a narrow ridge of stony ground, threading through a patch of spiny gorse that threatens to shred both clothing or skin at the slightest misstep.  The chill wind whistles through the spiked branches, blowing waves of silvery mist down from the dark moors to the north.

title: [High Plains, Gorse Ridge]
description: Sharp-spined gorse grows thickly around the trail, thriving in the rocky soil of the small, windswept ridge.  Not much sprouts from the broken ground but the prickly, unwelcoming bushes and a few scattered blades of rough grass.

title: [High Plains, Cliff's Edge]
description: Rough, misshapen bushes cling to the lip of the ravine, some leaning over the precipice as the gradual erosion of the plain leads them on to their eventual doom in the rocky crevice below.  The desolate expanse of the moors extends to the north, the rolling landscape concealed here and there by shifting clouds of silvery mist.

Rough, misshapen bushes cling to the lip of the ravine, some leaning over the precipice as the gradual erosion of the plain leads them on to their eventual doom in the rocky crevice below.  The desolate expanse of the moors extends to the north, the rolling landscape concealed here and there by shifting clouds of moonlit mist.

title: [High Plains, Killing Field]
description: This low, sodden patch of ground is bare of trees and heather, as if the vegetation had made an effort to avoid taking root here.  The weathered bones and skulls of elves and humans and dogs and unidentifiable monstrous creatures lie scattered around the cheerless landscape, as if they had lain undisturbed for centuries amid tufts of windblown grass.  A narrow trail leads into the deep woods that form the western edge of the field.

title: [High Plains, Killing Field]
description: The ground slopes unevenly to form a shallow depression, full of stagnant water and stinking of swamp gases and decay.  Gnawed bones and empty-eyed bleached skulls protrude from the barren ground amid patches of rough grass and shrubs of gorse that struggle against the chill wind.

title: [Yegharren Plain, High Plains]
description: Mist swirls down from the higher moors to the north, swept by the constant wind in an ethereal dance.  Patches of silvery heather stand interspersed with patches of barren, stony ground, and the gusting wind occasionally blows an uprooted branch across the desolate plain.

Mist swirls down from the higher moors to the north, swept by the constant wind in an ethereal dance.  Patches of moonlit heather stand interspersed with patches of barren, stony ground, and the gusting wind occasionally blows an uprooted branch across the desolate plain.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: The dark, twisted forms of trees surround the trail, their skeletal branches reaching out as if to grasp at unwary travelers and draw them into their tangled clutches.  Little sunlight filters through the heavy growth, and the forest floor is covered with a thick mulch of leaves that silences almost any footstep.

Only a little moonlight filters through the heavy growth, and the forest floor is covered with a thick mulch of leaves that silences almost any footstep.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: Patches of black-spotted ferns cover the ground beneath a canopy of heavy, twisted branches.  A huge spider web spreads above the trail, its hand-sized arachnid occupant dangling between tendrils of dripping moss.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: Narrow trails lead through the dark woods in several directions, beneath the tangled arches of the trees that encroach on the twisting paths from all sides.  Clumps of deep green and brown moss dangle from the branches, hanging over the trail to brush at unwary hunters with their weblike tendrils.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: Gnarled trees crowd around the trail, their dark roots protruding from the ground amid a haphazard arrangement of moss-covered, square-cut stones.  Iridescent swirls of mist stream from a winding path between the trees, collecting in damp eddies above the leaf-carpeted ground.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: The shadowed forest is blanketed with an almost unnatural silence, broken only by the faint howl of the wind passing through the higher branches of the ancient trees.  Deathly white orchids grow on a branch high above the trail, hovering patches of pale light against the dark wood and moss.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: Centuries-old yew trees guard this corner of the forest, replacing the gnarled oaks to the south with the twisted growth of their blackened roots.  Beneath the yews, the sunken outlines of several oblong pits filled with rotted leaves and dirt mark ancient graves, long-emptied of their dead.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: A half-crumbled ring of stones circles the black maw of an ancient well, its rim nearly concealed by endless layers of fallen leaves and soil.  The gnarled forms of yews and black oaks extend their grasping branches in an interwoven canopy that reduces the day's light to a faint, shifting glow.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: Huge, gnarled roots crisscross the path, almost seeming to move like shifting serpents in the dim light.  The occasional sound of something rustling as it moves through the canopy above drifts through the thick silence of the forest air.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: Slippery, moss-covered roots protrude from the rotting carpet of fallen leaves that covers the ground, ready to trip the unwary who move too quickly along the uneven trail.  What little light filters through the heavy, twisted branches of the trees illuminates the forest with an eerie greenish glow.

What little moonlight filters through the heavy, twisted branches of the trees illuminates the forest with an eerie greenish glow.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Forest's Edge]
description: A jagged, flat-topped boulder rests in the shadow of a massive, gnarled oak, its lichen-etched surface covered by a layer of crawling vines that cling to the stone like a nest of sleeping serpents.  Black and purple shards of moss hang from the branches above, dangling their ethereal fingers over the path.

title: [Black Moor, Wastelands]
description: Windblown patches of gorse and heather rise above the swirling eddies of mist, nearly concealing a narrow path that winds into the dark wooded area to the west.  The air is chilly and damp and filled with the constant whistling of the wind, punctuated by the occasional howl of some unknown creature echoing across the broken, blackened moor.

The night air is chilly and damp and filled with the constant whistling of the wind, punctuated by the occasional howl of some unknown creature echoing across the broken, blackened moor.

title: [Black Moor, Ruins]
description: A pair of broken granite pillars stand just to the north, their misshapen and lichen-encrusted forms looming above the eddies of silver mist.  The piles of crumbled stone between the pillars hint that they were once the supports of some ancient arch.  The desolate, blackened ground almost feels unsteady, as if it were groaning soundlessly with the force of some ancient, hidden evil.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Black Moor, Ruins]
description: A huge stone arch, pitted by moisture and acrid air, rises overhead, the only standing remnant of the courtyard that stood here uncounted centuries ago.  The crumbled circle of a fountain lies in the center of the ruin amid broken limestone slabs and fallen chunks of weatherworn granite, all but a few shards of its marble long since looted.

title: [Black Moor, Wastelands]
description: A few spindly trees stand on the uneven, wind-scoured plain, their stark skeletons silhouetted against the rising mass of the old barrow to the north.  Broken, weathered chunks of granite and limestone lie scattered about the dark moor, amid hardy patches of brush and silvery tendrils of cold mist.

title: [Black Moor, Old Barrow Road]
description: Swirling mist nearly conceals the low mound of the ancient barrow that rises on the horizon to the north.  The black dirt of the road is surrounded on both sides by a barren landscape of scrawny, windswept bushes and broken stones, and the fog-shrouded sky is an eternal twilight grey even in daytime.

Swirling mist nearly conceals the low mound of the ancient barrow that rises on the horizon to the north.  The black dirt of the road is surrounded on both sides by a barren landscape of scrawny, windswept bushes and broken stones, and the fog-shrouded sky is an eternal twilight grey.

title: [Black Moor, Old Barrow Road]
description: A crude grey limestone arch stands before the entrance to the ancient barrow, leading north into a narrow passage of free-standing slabs of weatherworn stone.  The chill wind blows strong here, its stream directed by the looming form of the barrow mound, and swirls of mist and dead black leaves dance across the dark road.

title: [Black Moor, Scorched Heath]
description: The blackened plain extends off into the mist, the rough ground and scattered rocks scorched by some long-ago evil.  The ever-present mist crawls like a moving carpet along the cold ground, shifting to reveal dark patches of scrub and a few skeletal trees that stand like ghastly sentinels under the grey sky.

title: [Black Moor, Scorched Heath]
description: The mist collects in a series of gravelike furrows in the ground, swirling and writhing like some almost-living thing.  Blackened, broken stones and scrawny patches of heather and brush lie scattered around the bleak moor, and the ghostly howl of the wind echoes through the miasmal air.

title: [Black Moor, Old Barrow Road]
description: No stone walls mark the edges of the ancient road here, only a narrow strip of black dirt that is clearer of plants and jagged rocks than the desolate landscape that surrounds it.  A massive stone gate marks the southern edge of the moor, standing sentinel over the slope that leads beyond it into the lowlands.

title: [Black Moor, Wastelands]
description: A sea of swirling grey mist covers the buckled, dark ground, seeping up from irregular crevices in the landscape to swirl in the constant whistling wind.  A few slabs of ancient stone lie scattered about the moor, pitted by centuries of moisture and stained with patches of black and grey lichen.

A sea of swirling grey mist covers the buckled, dark ground, seeping up from irregular crevices in the landscape to swirl in the constant whistling night wind.  A few slabs of ancient stone lie scattered about the moor, pitted by centuries of moisture and stained with patches of black and grey lichen.

title: [Black Moor, Wastelands]
description: Blackened dirt and moisture have collected in a low patch of ground to form a malodorous bog, the mucky ground dotted with ghostly, protruding branches and scattered shards of half-buried bone and stone.  The cold wind that blows the shifting coils of mist across the moor is not enough to disperse a constant, sickly smell of death and decay.

title: [Yegharren Plain, Black Moor]
description: Silvery mist seeps through jagged cracks in the blackened ground, collecting in swirls and eddies that glide over and around the rough scrub and broken stones that dot the moor.  Several jet-black crows perch in a skeletal tree in the distance, fluffing their inky feathers against the cold wind as they impassively watch their surroundings.

title: [Black Moor, Scorched Heath]
description: Blackened heather and charred rocks cover the bleak ground, and only a few deep green blades of living grass push through the scorched earth as a faint sign of life.  Thick grey mist swirls in the bone-chilling wind, its ghostly tendrils like ancient smoke from whatever long-ago fire blackened the land.

title: [Black Moor, Scorched Heath]
description: The chill wind howls across the damp, boggy ground, sending banks of clinging mist swirling around you like a shroud.  A few gnarled trees stand above the blanket of mist, their charred bark now covered with sickly lichen and their twisted branches grasping at the air like a ghoul's fingers.

The chill wind howls through the darkness across the damp, boggy ground, sending banks of clinging mist swirling around you like a shroud.  A few gnarled trees stand above the blanket of mist, their charred bark now covered with sickly lichen and their twisted branches grasping at the air like a ghoul's fingers.

title: [North Barrow, Threshhold]
description: The huge mound of the barrow looms above the small, almost garden-like entry area, its entrance a dark tunnel partially covered by an ancient, broken slab of granite.  Standing stones as tall as a giantman shield the narrow space from the harsh wind of the moor beyond the limestone arch that leads back out to the bleak landscape.  A few blades of grass grow around the stones, nourished by the rich soil and shielded from the chill wind.

title: [North Barrow, Vestibule]
description: Heavy walls of rough-cut limestone blocks surround the low, dark vestibule, their surfaces etched deeply by thousands of years of seeping water, creeping lichen, and time.  A huge slab of granite, now broken and fallen away from the entry it once sealed, lies at the exit to the moors outside, and a narrow passage leads into a larger chamber to the north.

title: [North Barrow, Central Chamber]
description: The spacious, roughly oval chamber is suffused with a dim light that seems to come from nowhere in particular, certainly not from the charred but empty sconces carved into the heavy stone walls.  The heavy timbers of the ceiling bow under the weight of the mound above, and a few drops of muddy water drip steadily on the ancient granite blocks of the floor.  Low stone arches lead into dark tunnels at the corners of the chamber, and a narrow passage opens to the north.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [North Barrow, Tunnel]
description: A dank smell of ancient mold fills the still air, much of it emanating from an area in the corner of the tunnel where the ceiling has partially collapsed into a pile of long-untouched rubble.  Half-crushed skeletons lie scattered around the sharp turn in the tunnel, and a few odd bones protrude from the pile of fallen stone.

title: [North Barrow, Ossuary]
description: The heavy stone blocks of the walls strain against the weight of the ground above them, tilting at a slight angle as if ready to crumble and collapse into rubble.  Faint scratching sounds echo through the dim, musty chamber, signaling the presence of what is hopefully only rats among the stacks of ancient bones.

title: [North Barrow, Ossuary]
description: Piles of bones and skulls are stacked along every wall, the dark spaces between them filled with spider webs and ancient dust.  Muddy water drips slowly down the limestone wall from a crack in the ceiling, draining from the grassy mound above and collecting in a foul-smelling puddle on the cold stone floor.

title: [North Barrow, Ossuary]
description: Many deep niches are carved in the rough walls, each filled with stacks of dusty bones, most of which appear to be human or elven.  The damp stones of the floor are buckled and uneven, pushed out of place by some long-ago movement of the earth below.

title: [North Barrow, Ossuary]
description: Water drips in glistening rivulets down the cracks in the rough limestone walls, seeping into the black dirt between the heavy, flat stones that form the floor.  Tiny black spiders skitter over the piles of skulls and bones that lie stacked against the walls like piles of old firewood, and a faint scratching sound echoing from somewhere nearby hints at the presence of some larger denizens.

title: [North Barrow, Ossuary]
description: A dank, musty odor of mold and ancient stone fills the low tunnel.   Piles of old, fleshless bones, some neatly stacked and some fallen to lie scattered around the cold stone floor, line the walls and fill the dark niches in the rough limestone.  A pyramid of skulls stands undisturbed in the corner beneath the low, sloping ceiling.

title: [North Barrow, Inner Chamber]
description: The chamber is roughly circular, the stacked stones of its domed ceiling rising twenty feet high under the highest part of the barrow mound.  Every inch of the ancient, pockmarked stone has been festooned with bones set into elaborate geometric patterns, the femurs and fingers and vertebrae and grimacing skulls of countless long-dead corpses.  A gruesome chandelier, crafted of more of the same bones, hangs from an iron bolt at the apex of the dome.

title: [North Barrow, Pit]
description: Piles of broken bones lie stacked around the scratched and lichen-stained walls of the deep pit, their random arrangement suggesting that the osseous collection was thrown in piecemeal from above -- perhaps rejected by the designers of the bone-adorned chamber overhead.  The deep scratches on the dirt walls hint at some unknown inhabitants' long-ago efforts to escape, though a crude rope ladder now leads up to the dimly-lit barrow chambers.

title: [North Barrow, Dead End]
description: The unsuccessful attempt to dig the tunnel north ends abruptly here against a solid wall of limestone, its uneven surface pitted with the marks of many hammers and axes.  Black spiders crouch in pits in the stone, partially concealed by filmy cauls of webbing.

title: [North Barrow, Tunnels]
description: A chill draft blows through the tunnels, coming from some unseen openings somewhere in the jumble of dirt and crumbled stone.  A malignant-looking yellowish fungus decorates the rough walls of the curving tunnel in a random pattern of ochre and black.

title: [North Barrow, Tunnels]
description: The walls of the tunnel are marked with deep mars and scratches, as if someone had once tried to extend the passage in a hurried and disorganized manner.  Narrow crevices break the hard-packed soil of the floor, emitting wisps of the same unnaturally glowing mist that drifts over the moors above.  Bones of various types lie scattered across the floor, in a random fashion which suggests that they were not buried here but died here.

title: [Small Estate, Courtyard]
description: A large ivory-hued manor is situated amongst the lush farmland, its long arched windows shrouded by carmine curtains.  The gardens of the estate offer a plentiful bounty for the eye -- cultivated in an immaculate display of elegant beauty are collections of flaming violets interspersed with a deep black variety, while the tiny yellow buds of wood violets peek through the darker petals.  A white trellis arcs over the walkway that leads to the dark marble door, twined with lush, incarnadine roses.

title: [Lobstereum]
description: The briny air from the nearby sea assaults the senses in this dark, dank, and enclosed space.  Slivers of light filter through the numerous scattered wormholes, highlighting the filthy orange hue of the lobster-shaped mat that spans the muddy floor.  Mounted askew on the rotting wooden walls are displays of prized catches, complete with their cages suspended from the ceiling on a web of mooring rope.  A boldly painted sign hangs above a ratty oilskin curtain to the west while a dimly lit passage leads further in.

title: [Sylvarraend Sweet Shoppe]
description: Illuminated by a blown-glaes chandelier hung from the cottage's crossbeam high above, the air is drenched in deliciously sweet and spicy smells.  A long glaes-paned counter runs the length of this tiny shop.  Nestled inside on small silver trays are various confections, each one more beautifully crafted than the last.

title: [Sylvarraend Pawn and Thrift]
description: Baskets and trunks full of arcane items are stacked high against the walls of this tiny cottage.  However full it may be, there does appear to be order to the madness, as the shop proprietor scurries about adding pawned goods to various tables and marking them for sale.

title: [Pawn and Thrift, Backroom]
description: Haphazardly organized to provide a modicum of maneuverability, the rear of the tiny cottage contains even more pawned goods.  Sunlight filters through an oval window set high on the east wall, highlighting the slightly used wares for sale.

Haphazardly organized to provide a modicum of maneuverability, the rear of the tiny cottage contains even more pawned goods.  Silvery moonlight filters through an oval window set high on the east wall, highlighting the slightly used wares for sale.

title: [Sylvarraend, Town Commons]
description: Nestled just off the town square, this tree-shaded knoll provides ample opportunity for rest and reflection.  Towering maorals spread their branches overhead, the thick leaves rustling gently with each stir of the air about them.  An intricately carved wooden bench rests beneath one tree.

title: [Sylvarraend, Town Commons]
description: Facing the square sits a well-kept building, its walls made of stacked round river rock.  The structure's clay tiled roof glows with a dull red hue, the tiles chipped here and there from years of exposure to the elements.  Flowers spill over the sides of a wooden planter next to the front door, above which hangs a carved wooden sign.

Facing the square sits a well-kept building, its walls made of stacked round river rock.  The structure's clay tiled roof glows with a dull red hue, the tiles chipped here and there from years of exposure to the elements.  Golden yellow light is barely visible in the crevice between the front door and its sturdy frame, above which hangs a carved wooden sign.

title: [The United Bank of City-States]
description: Flickering golden yellow light from dozens of bronze sconces that hang high up on the walls illuminates this chamber.  On the far right wall hangs a lovely brocade tapestry which depicts scenes from the town's early days.  A threadbare rug covers the entire floor, muffling the steps of the townsfolk.  A perky young elven clerk sits patiently waiting to assist someone.

title: [Hagatha's Brew and Barley]
description: Wooden planks worn smooth by years of constant use line the floor of the tavern, strewn with fresh rushes and smelling slightly of ale.  Several elves are crowded around an ornately carved bar that runs the length of one wall, drinking and conversing quietly.  A few tables, each decorated with a lone candle as centerpiece, are scattered about the tavern.
