title: [Sylvarraend Tinkers & Whatnots]
description: Scattered across the polished wooden floors, deep red rugs bring cheer to this rather austere room.  Boxes and trunks are stacked along one wall, each fastened with a small shiny lock.  In one corner, banked orange coals glow dimly in a small brazier.

title: [Sylvarraend, Foehn Var]
description: The trail winds past a wooden building whose walls are constructed of thick maoral timber, the peeling bark providing a rustic look to the structure.  Several stacks of freshly hewn tree trunks are piled beside the cottage, sheltered by a thick canvas awning.  A carved wooden sign sits atop a post beside the building's door.

The trail winds past a wooden building whose walls are constructed of thick maoral timber, the peeling bark providing a rustic look to the structure.  A carved wooden sign sits atop a post beside the building's door, barely illuminated by a dim metal lantern attached to a ring on the post.

title: [Sylvarraend Bowyer Supplies]
description: The wooden walls have been sanded smooth, but left unvarnished, creating a rustic look.  Bows of various types, some appearing to be nearly antiques, hang from the walls.  The flames flickering in the small fireplace cast a yellow-orange glow across the smooth maple planked flooring.

title: [Sylvarraend, Foehn Var]
description: An elegant cottage sits to one side of the trail, boasting smooth tan-hued river rock walls and an unusual blue slate tiled roof.  Deep blue shutters frame the structure's glaesine windows, beneath which foamy cascades of blaestonberry mingle with deeply fragrant creeping rosemary.  An engraved silver sign swings from an awning above the shop's blue-painted door.

An elegant cottage sits to one side of the trail, boasting smooth tan-hued river rock walls and an unusual blue slate tiled roof.  Deep blue shutters frame the structure's glaesine windows, beneath which foamy cascades of blaestonberry mingle with deeply fragrant creeping rosemary.  An engraved silver sign swings from an awning above the shop's blue-painted door, barely illuminated by the light from the windows.

title: [Sylvarraend Clothiers]
description: Scantily dressed mannequins line the far wall of this small shop.  A glass counter lies somewhere under a huge pile of bolts of fabric in a vast array of colors and materials.  In one corner of the room, open boxes lay on their side, most of the contents pulled out haphazardly and strewn over the plush sea-blue carpet.  Several sachets overstuffed with rosemary are strategically placed about the room, their fragrant aroma filling the area.

title: [Sylvarraend, Foehn Var]
description: The small wooden bridge spans a cheerfully bubbling brook, its water tumbling over various rocks and fallen limbs in its giddy haste to arrive at its destination.  A small bench is set beneath the bridge's railing, providing a peaceful spot for a few minutes' contemplation.

title: [Sylvarraend, Foehn Var]
description: Herbs and flowers of all kinds are planted in an orderly fashion in beds surrounding a small stone cottage, the plants clearly benefiting from a large patch of sunshine streaming through a break in the surrounding forest.  Bees whir happily betwixt the various blooms as the heady fragrance of the flora drifts on the air.

Herbs and flowers of all kinds are planted in an orderly fashion in beds surrounding a small stone cottage, the cool night air stirring the plants just enough to waft their heady fragrances upon the breeze.  Golden yellow light shines from the cottage's glaesine windows, a welcoming beacon in the darkness.

title: [Covered Pathway]
description: Linden and beech trees arch over the pathway, their limbs extending outward, meshing into a thick canopy of brown lines and multi-hued green leaves.  Vines cling to the trunks and lower hanging limbs, draping the sides of the path in a concealing curtain of emerald leaves from which come the chirps and tweets of unseen birds.

title: [Outpost, Entrance]
description: A large wooden palisade stands in the center of a forest glade encircled by a wall of greenery.  Shafts of sunlight cover the palisade and the large parade ground intersected by a dirt-worn path from the west.  A row of practice dummies lines one side of the grounds, the earth around them needled with numerous arrows sticking upwards in various directions.

A large wooden palisade stands in the center of a forest glade encircled by a wall of greenery.  Shafts of moonlight cover the palisade and the large parade ground intersected by a dirt-worn path from the west.  A row of practice dummies lines one side of the grounds, the earth around them needled with numerous arrows sticking upwards in various directions.

title: [Sylvarraend, Furrier]
description: Displayed over the doorway of small cottage is a stuffed stag's head, complete with a magnificent set of ten-tined antlers.  Cleaned furs and pelts line the wooden walls, trophies of many an adventurer's victorious hunt.  A tidy rack filled with sharp tools is set on the wall behind a wide counter.

title: [Shimmarglin Jewels and Gems]
description: The leaded glaesine windows are paned in a delicate floral pattern, detailing intertwining roses and ivy.  The windows are framed of the same garnet-hued curtains that decorate the front portion of the shop.  A thick sapphire-hued carpet covers the floor.  A series of shelves lines one wall, providing ample storage for the gem dealer's supplies.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Sparse trees dot the hillside, like tall sentinels gathered about the encroaching underbrush.  The area here is teeming with wildlife, yet they remain unseen in your direct vision.  Just when you think you've spotted one, looking directly at it reveals nothing but moving brush.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: An enormous tree has fallen across the road, taking several smaller trees with it on its plunge.  The cobblestoned road is cracked and the stones upturned in a jumbled heap alongside the massive trunk.  The area has become a sort of construction zone, as groups of elves work to clear the rubble and remove the tree.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Small trees line the edges of the cobblestone path as it continues southward.  Chirping birds can be heard throughout the woods, but not one to be seen.  Entangling vines weave between the trees, making travel off the path nearly impossible.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The road continues along the trail, shifting with the change in direction.  Small blades of grass peek through the creases between the grey cobblestones.  The density of the lush forest wanes as it continues eastward.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Along the western side of the path lies a moss-covered boulder imbedded deeply within the ground.  Large trees are spread out upon both sides of the trail, creating a small canopy above.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The forest clears out as it meets an opulent meadow upon the peak of a hill.  Separated by long fences, farms of various size can be seen throughout the valley below.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The brush within the meadow rises high, lining the path with a golden hue.  Small insects buzz around the fields, bobbing in and out of the tall grass.

title: [Oak Grove, Path]
description: The ancient silvery-barked oaks pull in close, their tall trunks ascending toward the sky to block out most of the light -- the thin golden shafts shining through the canopy like divine gifts from the heavens.  Massive, sprawling roots crawl along the forest floor, their gnarled surfaces covered with a fine, soft carpet of deep green moss.  A weathered path winds its way through the small bushes and trees, its presence barely noticed amid the majesty of the surrounding forest.

The ancient silvery-barked oaks pull in close, their tall trunks ascending toward the sky to block out most of the light -- the pale white shafts shining through the canopy in an ethereal dance of beauty. A weathered path winds its way through the small bushes and trees, its presence barely noticed amid the majesty of the surrounding forest.

title: [Oak Grove, Quiet Pool]
description: A small outcropping of moss-covered grey stone allows a tiny stream to trickle down in a serene waterfall into a large, circular pool that breaks up the soft verdant hue of the forest with a deep, rippling blackness.  Young trees grow along the edges and in between the gaps of the grey stone, their sparse, green boughs casting pale shadows across the surroundings.  Faint slivers of luminescence alight in the pool from time to time, and the area holds a tranquil silence.

title: [Oak Grove, Stream]
description: Flame-red shelf fungi line the ancient trunks of the trees, while their roots are laden with deep green moss.  A small stream flows through the surrounding underbrush, its soft trickles providing a pleasant accompaniment to the quiet trills of birds and the soft rustle of the plants against one another.  Clusters of purple flowers chase the edges of the stream, their vivid hue starkly contrasted by the solid green.

Flame-red shelf fungi line the ancient trunks of the trees, while their roots are laden with deep green moss.  A small stream flows through the surrounding underbrush, its soft trickles providing a pleasant accompaniment to the quiet trills of birds and the soft chirrups of many a hidden frog.  Clusters of purple flowers chase the edges of the stream, their vivid hue starkly contrasted by the solid green

title: [Oak Grove, Stream]
description: Sunlight peeks through the canopy in soft shafts, illumining tiny creatures as they go about their day.  The narrow stream continues its journey southward, its surface cast in brilliant light that sets it afire with glimmering jewels of sunlight.  Tiny spiraled weeds creep among the underbrush, tangling and ensnaring a few unfortunate bushes.

Moonlight peeks through the canopy dimly, highlighting the greenness of the leaves around the area.  The narrow stream continues its journey southward, its surface cast in an ethereal light that glows wanly with each tiny ripple.  Tiny spiraled weeds creep among the underbrush, tangling and ensnaring a few unfortunate bushes.

title: [Oak Grove, Stream]
description: The surrounding trees and dense cover of bushes begin to thin out here, revealing a lush, thriving carpet of green grass.  The small stream, revealed in full now, gurgles and bubbles melodically amid the pristine atmosphere.  Curls of thin mist filter in from the north, and the shadow of a large hill looms in the distance.

title: [Oak Grove, Hill]
description: A large hill rises to the north, its base wreathed by a wavering ring of pale white mist.  Wavy blades of longrass make up the entirety of its base, shivering and stirring with every faint gust of wind that passes by.  A few oaks cluster around the area, their leafy boughs adding a touch of pleasant shade.  A thin trail winds its way through the tall grasses, ascending up toward the peak of the green hill.

title: [Oak Grove, Ascent]
description: Nothing stirs here save for the whistling wind through the long grass.  A palpable sense of peace permeates the area, and the path continues upwards.

title: [Oak Grove, Top of the Hill]
description: The massive bough of some gargantuan tree hangs in arcing tendrils to the north, completely enshrouding the hill in its leafy embrace.  A small archway appears to have formed naturally out of the dense thicket, providing the only entry into the shadow-strewn interior.  The constant current of wind that flows through the area whispers softly as it passes through the thicket of leaves, casting a mysterious feel to the air.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A farm's fence starts its travel near the edge of the path as the nearby grass begins to drop in height.  Along the eastern side of the road, a large wooden post stands firmly in the ground.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A large wooden fence encloses the path along both sides, with a small distance to spare from the edge.  Beyond the fence lies a finely-tilled field with an iron plow resting against the barn in the distance.

title: [Lobstereum, Showroom]
description: Desiccated local fish have been set upon boughs of dried seaweed that drape across the ceiling.  A layer of gritty sand has worked itself into the cracks and crevices of the weathered floorboards which, combined with the omnipresent mist of the sea, makes traction an uncertain prospect.  A large tank, its contents announced by a garish purple and yellow sign, occupies what little floor space is available.

title: [A Muddy Path]
description: Two deep ruts have been dug into the muddy path leading towards the barn.  The ruts are well worn into the path by the many wagons that have passed through this way.  A small gap in the fence leads out towards a cobblestone path.

title: [A Muddy Path]
description: Stray grasses that have crept onto the muddy path, have been trampled to near death by frequent travelers.  A glimpse of a red barn can be seen toward the east.

title: [Outside The Barn]
description: A large red barn towers before you as the door is swung wide open.  An iron plow rests against the side of the barn with traces of rust along the edges.  A small pulley is attached to the roof of the barn with a thickened rope swung around the wheel.

title: [Inside The Barn]
description: Bales of hay are stacked all along the floor of the barn and piled high up near the ceiling.  There's not much room to move around as farm tools and supplies lie scattered about.  A piece of fabric drapes across a long wooden rafter set equal with the top of the door.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A long fence runs perpendicular to the path as it separates the properties of two neighboring farms.  The smooth grey cobblestones of the road are worn by years of travel.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Set within the middle of the western field lies a small, decrepit building.  The fence and path curve towards the east, forming a sharp corner.  A small rabbit can be seen hopping away from the path.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Signs of wear and tear upon the fence are apparent as boards hang towards the ground from some of the posts.  Grass pokes through the dirt, climbing up and around the cobblestones that form the path.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Firmly set in place, the cobblestones continue along their winding path.  Due to lack of upkeep, some boards have gone missing along the fence while others lie broken and shattered where they fell.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A black snake slithers its way through the heightened brush near the fence.  The setting of the fence has shifted through the years as the ground has settled.  While the cobblestones are nearly covered with dirt and mud, small cracks can be seen on their surface.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Worn down with years of travel, the cobblestones have burrowed deeply into the ground.  Small cracks and chips have appeared upon their surface as they have been ill-kept since the time of their placement.  The fence juts outward, widening its distance from the edges of the path.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: Running perpendicular to the path is a long fence separating the properties of two neighboring farms.  Sitting on one of the vertical posts is a large black raven, whose reflection is clearly visible in a small glittering puddle.

title: [The Ensignery, Showroom]
description: Scraps of brightly colored cloth are swept neatly into the corner near the large working table of this showroom.  Flags, ensigns, and banners depend from the rafters in a bright array of primary colors.  Benches surround the worktable, where a number of local seamstresses sit chattering as they stitch their latest flag.  A large sign displays the selection of standard flags currently in stock.

title: [Jer's Fyne Fouds Cart]
description: The smell of food permeates the air around this rickety food stand.  It's a poorly constructed wooden box with large wheels and a push handle, but one wheel has come off and the cart leans at a precarious angle.  A small weather-beaten sign is tacked to one side.

title: [The Rat-On-A-Stick Cart]
description: Heat from the cart's small wrought iron brazier radiates outward, trapped by the canvas umbrella.  The odor of burnt fur fills the air, mixing with the aromas of melted chocolate and barbecue sauce and appearing to drive off as many potential custommers as it attracts.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The cobblestones of the path widen out to the edges of the large fel dock, which stands upon the sandy beach just ahead.  A small, twisted path leads towards the darkness below the dock, where the waves crash upon the supports.

title: [Under The Dock]
description: Loud thumping comes from above as travellers walk upon the fel dock.  Tall modwir posts raise the dock above the water as the waves splash against the shore.  A small, twisted path leads back up towards the top of the dock.

title: [Lake of Fear, North Dock]
description: Finely-carved modwir posts support the weight of the fel boards that form the floor of the dock.  The boards are fastened securely to the posts with a thick rope twined between each board.  The gentle sway of the dock causes a light creaking sound as the waves brush against the posts.  A cobblestone path leads away from the dock back towards the village.

title: [Lake of Fear, Ferry]
description: The thick wooden planks of the ferry provide solid footing.  Along the center of the ferry, a striped canvas awning provides modest shelter for some rudimentary seating arrangements.  Several elven crewmen line the sides of the ferry, each grasping a thick wooden oar.

title: [Lake of Fear, South Dock]
description: Water laps about the pilings that hold up the greying surface of the wooden dock, the only sound to be heard across the eerily silent lake.  A thick coil of rope lies at the edge of the dock, waiting for the next boat to arrive.  A small wooden sign is tacked to the dock's sturdy railing.

title: [Lake of Fear, South Dock]
description: Greying planks sit just above the surface of the water, meeting boats arriving from across the way and providing access to the rocky shoreline.  Under the brilliance of day, the lake resembles a mirror reflecting the sky and milky clouds in its calm depths.  Though still now, there is an eeriness about this place that alludes to a superficial deception.  Over a jumble of stones lies the start of a trodden dirt path that curves southward.

Under the cloak of evening, the lake resembles a pool of onyx and reflects the night sky in its calm depths.  Though still now, there is an eeriness about this place that alludes to a superficial deception.  Over a jumble of stones lies the start of a trodden dirt path that curves southward.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: Dirt pebbled with rounded stones form this pass that concludes at the bank of a lake to the north.  A short dock juts out from the rocky shoreline, studded with faded crimson and yellow mooring floats.  Though the grade of the climb to the forest towards the south is slight and gradual, the view from this distance is still remarkable.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: Meadowlike fields awash with wildflowers stretch in all directions, a symphony of crickets and locusts filling the air with their song.  Lakebed rocks occasionally line the trail, an ancient effort to keep the encroaching weeds from overtaking the pass.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: Lakebed rocks become more prominent along this offshoot of the trail, as though more recently maintained.  The dark rich stones sport a mottled hue speared with alabaster veins.  The pass meanders east a short distance before a steep ledge cuts it off, descending into a deep gully and down to the edge of a morose-looking swamp.  Forbidding scents waft outward, festooning its banks like a decorative collar.

title: [A Cobblestone Walkway]
description: Two lines of stately yew trees flank a broad cobblestone road.  The yews are ancient, covered in dense growth all the way from nearly ground level to the top of their soaring trunks.  The growth is thick enough that it barely allows any glimpse of the land beyond.  Beside the path, a swiftly running stream sends a spray of mist up to accompany the dissonant sound of rushing water.  To the north a large clearing is visible.

Two lines of stately yew trees crowd in on a dark cobblestone road.  The yews are ancient, covered in dense growth all the way from nearly ground level to the top of their soaring trunks.  The growth is thick enough that it allows no outside light through the branches.  To the north a large clearing is illuminated by the silvery starlight.

title: [Voln Forecourt]
description: Several cast iron park benches back against a swiftly moving stream along one side of the large, open courtyard.  A cobbled walkway extends through the courtyard's center and continues over a small bridge which spans the moat, connecting the forecourt to the gated entryway of a large fortress.  Opposite the flowing water lies a narrow knot garden with a meadow beyond.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Marsh Edge]
description: An old wagon lies buried in the mud near the shore of a murky bog, dark green lichen already finding a home upon its timbers.  A light green carpet of minute plant life floats on the surface of the stagnant water, an occasional bubble parting the greenery as it expands outwards toward the shore.  At the edge of the marsh, stands of cattails mark the entrance to a shadowed archway beneath the burdened boughs of an ancient willow tree.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Murky water surrounds a collection of cypress trees, the broad roots sinking deep into the mud.  Buttonbush speckles the tufted sedge that borders the faint pathway forking around a small pond.  Elven moss and poison ivy lines the cypress knees sitting nearby, overshadowing the trail with their silhouettes in the dim sunlight.

Murky water surrounds a collection of cypress trees, the broad roots sinking deep into the mud.  Buttonbush speckles the tufted sedge that borders the faint pathway forking around a small pond.  Elven moss and poison ivy lines the cypress knees sitting nearby, overshadowing the trail with their silhouettes in the dim moonlight.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: A spindly-limbed tree rises up from the dark mire, its skeletal branches clawing at the sky.  Green moss hangs down from some of the stronger branches of the tree, giving the illusion of life long since stripped away.  The long trails of moss sway hypnotically as stray currents of wind brush by them, their wavering green forms a stark contrast to the bleak, dead surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Fog rides across glassy black pools of water in wisps, enveloping nearly all the ground in a hazy blur.  A rotting log, its gnarled and dead roots exposed to the air, appears to be the source of the murk.  Trails of thick mist pour forth from a ragged hole in the log's bark.  A few sparse patches of moss grow at the base of the tree, their grey-green forms shrouded within the haze.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Muddy Slough]
description: The nearby saw grass has overgrown the trail in some places and rustles softly in the breeze.  Where the trail is still clear, some recent disturbances in the mud indicate that it may be deeper than it looks.  A lake of thick mud, littered with several unidentifiable objects discarded by previous travelers, blocks passage to the southeast.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Brown moss spreads down from the tree trunks of the live oak copse outlining the swamp, thickening the brackish water with their thin tendrils.  Tall stalks of cattails rise up from the deep quagmire like a small symphony, scattering a few aloof notes in the wind to a somber chord.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Fethayl Bog, Mudpit]
description: Thick vines and overgrowth drape from the tall gaunt trees, the foliage brushing at the still surface water pooled beneath them.  Fallen logs allow passage over the morass of bubbling mud.  Acidic vapors rise up into the air with the rupture of each bubble, releasing a pungent odor.  An ethereal green light, casting flickering apparitions against the vapors, spreads out from the site of an granite headstone that rests on a slow incline.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Fallen Tree]
description: An enormous tree lays across the path, crushed vegetation splayed out beneath the trunk.  Jagged splinters protrude through thick crusts of mud and moss, and the pale roots of a sapling form a knotted mesh over the stump.  The bark is covered in shelf fungus and mushrooms while darkened areas show where the wood has long since rotted away.  To the northwest, a lake of thick, roiling mud inhibits passage.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Ruined Shrine]
description: Shrouded in long grey-green lichen that drifts ghostlike in the humid air, tall cypresses surround a ruined shrine which is half-sunken in the brackish water.  The walls of the shrine are filthy, water-stained and cracked, but on the north wall, the remnants of a mosaic are visible.  A spotless alabaster altar stands in the center of the shrine.  Fresh muddy footprints, reeking of dead water and rotten eggs, lead to--but not from--the altar.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Sunken Mausoleum]
description: A large, grey structure barely peeks above the surface of the black mire.  The rampant growth of moss obscures most of the marble roof.  Two lopsided pillars flank the submerged mausoleum, sentinels to all those who pass over it.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: A path cuts through the thicket of vines to the west, the faint outline of a meadow seen behind the sinuous plants.  Tussock lines the dark mere floor, encircling numerous deep pools of sticky ooze emanating a noisome smell.  The surroundings impede any light passing through its dense foliage, the air itself seems black and heavy to breathe.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Fethayl Bog, Caretaker's Hovel]
description: A gnarled, dead oak tree looms to the east, overshadowing a small dilapidated hovel.  Sitting lopsided amongst the marshy swamp, the hovel is overgrown with moss clinging tightly to the walls.  A small, marble bench sits on a lone patch of dry ground, just in front of the hovel.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Trail]
description: Shrubbery and other overgrowth blend the faint trail with the murk that lingers over the ground like a haze.  Sunlight sifts through the canopy enshrouding the area, a few thin shafts of light falling upon a large secluded stone.  The northern portion of the path splits off into a fork as it follows the bog edge around the meadowland, where a solitary tree can be seen towering into the sky.

Shrubbery and other overgrowth blend the faint trail with the murk that lingers over the ground like a haze.  Moonlight sifts through the canopy enshrouding the area, a few thin shafts of pale light falling upon a large secluded stone.  The northern portion of the path splits off into a fork as it follows the bog edge around the meadowland, where a solitary tree can be seen towering into the sky.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Meadowland]
description: The murk of the swamp begins to fade into a pasture of dead grass as the land rises into a hill.  Sitting alone in the middle of the meadowland is a scorched oak, its dead limbs reaching into the sky.  Crumbled blocks are scattered along the ground, some pinned into the soil by the gnarled roots which worm along the surface.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Boneyard]
description: Low-hanging moss sways silently from towering oak trees in the dank air.  Scattered, weathered gravestones lie halfway submerged in the marshy ground, their lettering worn off long ago.  A freshly dug plot lies in the center of the yard.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Fethayl Bog, Pools]
description: Sparsely covered trees sway in the slight breeze, causing shadows to play across the fetid, stagnant water.  Thick green algae obscure the hidden depths of the swamp, while slender reeds poke out of the mire in the shallower areas.  A faint buzzing originates around a rotting tree, from the tiny black flies that flit about in search of a meal.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Murky water spreads across the area in dark pools, the still surface unbroken except for the occasional stray bubble.  A few small patches of land have escaped the water's reach, clumps of sickly-looking grass clinging to them.  A mild stench of decay hangs across the area, the putrid smell accompanied by the deep croaking of frogs.

Murky water spreads across the area in dark pools, the still surface unbroken except for the occasional flurry of splashes.  A few small patches of land have escaped the water's reach, clumps of sickly-looking grass clinging to them.  A mild stench of decay hangs across the area, the putrid smell accompanied by the loud humming emanating from a cloud of mosquitoes.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Grove]
description: Several small puddles are interspersed amongst the muddy trail, the black water within them casting a reflection of the bright sky above.  One pool, particularly larger than the others, swallows up a good portion of the muck and nearly halts all progress further.  A lone cypress log has fallen across the pool, the submerged timber covered in thick, slimy algae.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, northwest

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: The landscape slants downward to the southeast, the sodden ground being overtaken by the dark marsh water.  Tall, slender swamp ashes form an impassable, tunnel-like barrier on both sides of the path.  Nondescript, rounded stones jut out from the meager grass, their forms a semblance of ancient crumbling ruins.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Ivory Pillar]
description: Small islands of waving cord grass surrounded by black marsh water dot the landscape, most of them overhung with dark clouds of gnats and mosquitoes shimmering in the light.  Orange-gold mushrooms shaped like miniature goblets are interspersed throughout the cord grass, while a dark brown saddle-shaped fungus sprawls across tree branches.  Rising from one of the larger islands, a moss-covered ivory pillar glistens in the sparse rays of the sun.

Orange-gold mushrooms shaped like miniature goblets are interspersed throughout the cord grass, while a dark brown saddle-shaped fungus sprawls across tree branches.  Rising from one of the larger islands, a moss-covered ivory pillar glistens in the sparse moonbeams.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Floods have carried away much of the soil, exposing the twisted roots of trees that cling and sink into the ground like skeletal fingers.  A dense canopy of foliage blocks most of the light, allowing only a few thin rays to creep through the branches and forests of hanging ivy.  There is barely a path to travel, but the swamp has thinned enough to make way through the trees.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Corroded Statue]
description: Rising high above the swamp, a corroded green statue surveys the thick undergrowth below and blocks further passage to the north.  Multitudes of saw grasses and brilliant crimson flora wind along the thin, narrow ledge descending to the southwest.  A curtain of vines hangs over the precipice, the sinuous tangles creating a foreboding sound in the faintest of breezes.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Marsh reeds rise out of the thick, odorous mud, the gnarled stalks forming a small thicket.  Fallen ironwood trees lie scattered about the obscured path, the aged logs covered with ferns and white lichen.  A wooden plank has been placed over a murky pond filled with miniature lily pads, the rickety board making a path through the tall brush to the north.  Swamp roses and magnolia shrubs trim the edge of the pond, creating a diorama of color that contrasts sharply with the surrounding mire.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Tufts of wet moss spread along the trail, interspersed with stinking lumps of humid mud that strive to reach the surface.  The unsettling cry of a swamp lark occasionally breaks the incessant hum of the mosquitoes swarming around you.  A spongy trail leads to the south, heading deeper into the fetid swamp.  Gnarled lengths of twisted blood-vines dangle from the sheer rock wall that blocks passage to the north.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Spider's Nest]
description: Standing guard like silent sentinels, moss-covered trees hold their decaying branches protectively over holes left in their trunks.  Thick shrouds of white cobwebs span the gaps between the branches, their dense forms glistening in the rays of sunlight filtering through the canopy.  A few of the large webs have broken off from their wooden anchors, swaying slowly from their lofty perch like ghosts.

Thick shrouds of white cobwebs span the gaps between the branches, their dense forms glistening in the beams of moonlight filtering through the canopy.  A few of the large webs have broken off from their wooden anchors, swaying slowly from their lofty perch like ghosts.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Dead End]
description: A vast copse of tree trunks creates an impassible barrier, preempting any chance of northern progress.  The swamp bubbles at recurrent intervals, releasing putrid green gases that swirl just above the muddy ground.  Misshapen land and footprints surround a stagnant pool, the tracks look to be fresh but have no visible source.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Cypress Grove]
description: Ascending into the sky, a cypress dome blocks out nearly all of the sun's rays with their broad branches.  Grey, somber fog clings to the ground persistently, adding to the uniform dreariness of the area.  Through the bleak greyness, the land dips into a small depression to the southeast, while higher land remains unsubmerged.
