Grey, somber fog clings to the ground persistently, adding to the uniform dreariness of the area.  Through the bleak greyness, the land dips into a small depression to the southeast, while higher land remains unsubmerged.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Bone Pile]
description: Rotting vegetation litters the thin strip of dry land that lies in the distance to the west.  A curious pile of bones rests amidst the decay, bleached by extended exposure to the sun.  An occasional *pop* can be heard, as swamp gas bubbles up through the quagmire, leaving in its wake a putrid and nauseating odor.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Hillock]
description: Stinking spongy turf rises above the fetid water of the swamp, forming a small hillock.  Mud oozes into and out of small sucking holes between stalks of wispy saw grass.  The only other ground above water rises to the northwest, across a section of greasy, thick swamp water.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Inside the Hovel]
description: In no better state than the outside, the interior of the hovel is cramped with aged furniture and wooden debris.  Along the back wall, a lopsided shelf holds empty jars, old tools and scraps of cloth which cascade to the floor.  Portions of the floor have long since rotted away, while the remaining planks are coated by oily sludge and swamp water.  An old chair in near-perfect condition sits in one corner, untouched by the dust so prevalent elsewhere.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Underground Crypt]
description: Dried, dead roots wind their way across the earthen walls, occasionally being blocked by the crumbling remains of a stone wall visible through the moist dirt.  A few rusted sconces still perch upon some of the sturdier stones, though each now holds a skull instead of a flame.  The aged scent of decay lingers within the musty air, and an overwhelming stillness pervades the underground crypt that not even the faintest sound from the surface disturbs.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Lone Grave]
description: Flourishing beautifully in the drier soil, a tall, sturdy swamp ash is disfigured along the trunk with an odd red moss.  The tree overlooks a large muddy pond hedged by cattails and rushes.  Sticking out from behind the tree, a small grave marker has sunken into the ground at an angle.  The piercing song of a warbler echoes across the water, momentarily silencing the humming of dragonflies.

Flourishing beautifully in the drier soil, a tall, sturdy swamp ash is disfigured along the trunk with an odd red moss.  The tree overlooks a large muddy pond hedged by cattails and rushes.  Sticking out from behind the tree, a small grave marker has sunken into the ground at an angle.  The mournful song of a whippoorwill echoes across the water, momentarily silencing a chorus of croaking frogs.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: The incline becomes a bit more challenging as the trail turns slightly and approaches the boundaries of the forest ahead.  A boulder or two provides the only respite from the sun and a place to rest or picnic.  Sloping downhill towards the north, the pass heads towards a glimmer of a lake in the distance.

The incline becomes a bit more challenging as the trail turns slightly and approaches the boundaries of the forest ahead.  A boulder or two provides a respite from the climb and a place to camp for the night.  Sloping downhill towards the north, the pass heads towards a glimmer of a lake in the distance.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: Guelder rose and sarsaparilla bushes crop up in tiny patches along the sides of the pass, the terrain growing a bit more rugged as it approaches the crest of the hill, upon which sits a dark forest.  Ahead, the thick growth of deciduous trees stretches southeast, while the trail returns to more open fields to the north.

Guelder rose and sarsaparilla bushes crop up in tiny patches along the sides of the pass, their ends wilted and slimy, the terrain growing a bit more rugged as it approaches the crest of the hill, upon which sits a dark forest.  Ahead, the thick growth of deciduous trees stretches southeast and is laden with choking veins and blackened ooze, while the trail returns to more open fields to the north.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: The brush and other undergrowth here is quite dense as the pass dodges around outcroppings of lichen-covered granite and marble, tiny lizards darting over their mottled surfaces.  Off to one side are the ruins of a farmhouse, its crumbling stone walls not much more than piles edging a charred foundation.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: A sudden rise in the landscape and the trail stair-steps up among a small crown of boulders.  From this vantage point, the sun glimmers off the surface of the lake, its size difficult to judge from this distance, yet docks on opposing shores are evident.  Below, the ground slopes down to a steep ravine cut long ago from the ravages of a river.

A sudden rise in the landscape and the trail stair-steps up among a small crown of boulders.  From this vantage point, the moonlight barely illuminates the surface of the lake off in the distance.  Below, the ground slopes down to a steep ravine cut long ago from the ravages of a river.

title: [Fearling Pass, Ravine]
description: Sharply-inclined sides of dark loamy earth carpeted with creeping vines and thorny bushes skirt the narrow path along the floor of the ravine.  A residual trickle of what was once a raging streambed slips lazily around element-worn rocks.  Silver beeches and tall oaks, younger than the old growth of the forest that meets the ravine, provide some cover overhead.

title: [Fearling Pass, Ravine]
description: Between dodging tree trunks and slick rocks, the going is slow here along the bottom of the ravine.  Dappled sunlight gives the narrow cut a claustrophic feel and the sound of rustling undergrowth is enough to quicken even the bravest pace.

Between dodging tree trunks and slick rocks, the going is slow here along the bottom of the ravine.  Dappled moonlight gives the narrow cut a claustrophic feel and the sound of rustling undergrowth is enough to quicken even the bravest pace.

title: [Fearling Pass, Ravine]
description: A slight bend in the gully here has allowed the trickling stream to gather into a small pool before it continues over a small dam of rocks and a rotting tree trunk.  Verdant moss has overwhelmed the surface of the fallen oak, and a small hole near the wide end nurtures the growth of several fiddlehead ferns.

title: [Fearling Pass, Ravine]
description: Rushing downhill towards a clump of boulders, a thin stream covers what remains of a navigable trail in this slender gulch.  Many smaller rocks divide the path of the water, providing a rich environment for several wild mustard plants, their showy yellow flowers adding a touch of color to the neutral surroundings.

Rushing downhill towards a clump of boulders, a thin stream covers what remains of a navigable trail in this slender gulch.  Many smaller rocks divide the path of the water, creating a boggy and slick underfooting.

title: [Fearling Pass, Crevasse]
description: Up close, the wall of towering boulders looks impenetrable, but a thin stream slips around behind one of the lichen-etched granite monoliths, revealing a narrow crevasse.

title: [Fearling Pass, Forest Trail]
description: Snaking out from a narrow crevasse tucked away within a wall of towering boulders, a small stream skirts the edge of the forest here, disappearing into its dark depths.  Diverging towards the southeast, a well-trodden pass continues through a wide break in the trees, open to the heavens.

title: [Fearling Pass, Forest Trail]
description: Uncommonly wide, the pass appears to be able to accommodate the girth of an army, though some of the ruts in the dirt trail are by no means fresh and signal that more peaceful era has passed.  Crowded trees filled with singing birds hug both sides and extend back farther than the eye can see.

title: [Fearling Pass, Forest Trail]
description: The wind whips down this corridor created by a canyon of old-growth trees, tearing at a faded banner flapping from a branch high overhead.  On either side, encampments arranged around dead firepits indicate this could have been a strategic resting place during battle.

title: [Fearling Pass, Forest Trail]
description: Beams of sunlight cut through the woods as the trees begin to thin out, though apparently more through careful lumbering than natural devastation.  The weald mouth widens at this point, and continues south as the trail winds its way out of the forest.

Patches of moonlight cut through the woods as the trees begin to thin out, though apparently more through careful lumbering than natural devastation.  The weald mouth widens at this point, and continues south as the trail winds its way out of the forest.

title: [Foothills]
description: This shallow valley spreads west between the rise of two high hills then narrows into a tiny path that continues to the east.  Delicate wildflowers have taken advantage of the shade and protection of the surrounding stone walls, and have made the valley their own.  Purple, white and yellow petal blossoms mingle profusely on every side of the game trail that extends through the valley.

title: [Foothills]
description: The bases of two rain-washed hills meet here to form the mouth of a shallow valley to the east.  A game trail follows the path of the valley, the print of many a predator and the prey they followed pressed indelibly into the beaten dirt.

title: [Foothills]
description: A scraggly tree struggles to grow through a broken boulder resting on the edge of the low cliff to the north, a monument to tenacity.  Though it hangs at such a steep angle that it looks dangerously close to falling over, the tree's strong roots keep it steady.  The narrow trail continues up the steep slope to the east, though its markings in the rocky soil are growing more faint.

title: [Foothills]
description: A treacherous rock outcrop reaches upward to the west, creating a fine vantage point up the trail from here.  Dust and rocks skitter down the trail at every footstep, but the footholds seem sturdy enough to allow travel upward.

title: [Foothills]
description: A large outcropping of jagged boulders to the west rises to support a narrow ledge.  A trail has been dug into the hill around the outcropping by a number of large, heavy feet, providing a way to reach the ledge above.  Though the rocky trail is a bit treacherous, the footholds are firm enough to keep travelers from slipping down the hill.

title: [Foothills]
description: This small ledge hangs over a large outcropping of rock, giving a grand view of the lands below.  A stream runs down the slope of the low foothills, winding along the edge of the old, abandoned apple orchard to the south.  Deteriorating fields of barley and grapes stretch beyond the orchard to the west.  Stony cliffs rise up behind the ledge to the north, too steep for practical climbing.

title: [Foothills]
description: The slope of the low hills rises more steeply, striving to meet the higher foothills to the north.  The craggy rocks of the foothills stretch across the horizon, looming above like a long row of soldiers ordered to block the smaller hills from further invasion.

title: [Foothills]
description: The path crosses a leveled out area on the side of the hill and splits off in two directions as it skirts a formidable rise of speckled grey granite.  Runoff from many seasons of rain has formed a small gully down the middle of the fork in the path, a jagged indentation that snakes across the dusty surface, then disappears into a clump of bushes growing along the edge of the trail.

title: [Foothills]
description: From the descending slope of a path leading to the west, one can look out over a spreading field of grass.  Movement through the grass reveals the position of animals, large and small, making their way through the waving greenery.

title: [Foothills]
description: A jumbled fall of rocks blocks a portion of the east-west trail that runs through this portion of the eastern foothills.  Vegetation is sparse at this level, but further up the slopes clumps of bushes and small trees soften the jagged edges of the hills with blurred touches of green.

title: [Foothills]
description: The path climbs steadily upwards to the east with a more gradual slope leading west.  Loose stones litter the edges of the path, but the center has been packed solid by years of foot traffic stomping up and down the side of the hill.

title: [Foothills]
description: The path ends at the edge of a high flat cliff.  Chalk-white bird droppings splattered over the jagged boulders that litter the area suggest that this is a popular resting place for the local avian population.  A deep gorge cuts the hill to the north, with a longer range of foothills rising to greater heights beyond.

title: [Grassland]
description: A small path leads up into the eastern foothills.  Stone and sand replace the rich soil of the field as the ground rises, and the tender rooted grass gives way to long mounds of scraggly bushes.

title: [Grassland]
description: A path leads down to a bridge that crosses the stream to the south and up the hilly slope to the northeast.  A small patch of violets grows to the side of the trail, forming a soft blanket on the lush green carpet of the tall grass.

title: [Foothills]
description: Silvery schools of fish leap and swirl through the clear water of the nearby stream.  A narrow trail leads along the side of the stream, following the rise of the land to the east where the low hills meet the edges of higher stone cliffs.  A wider path descends down the hill to the west.

title: [Foothills]
description: The narrow trail walks between a short cliff which drops down to the west and a higher, rockier outcropping which rises sharply to the east.  Just below the western cliff, a swift stream winds its way down the hilly slopes and along the edge of a dense apple orchard.

title: [Foothills]
description: The narrow animal trail following the edges of the stream fades away to nothing more than scuffed prints between the jutting rocks and stones that form the surface of the ground.  The soft, musical gurgle of a waterfall echoes from the east.

title: [Foothills]
description: Water pours through a stony gap up the side of the rocky hill.  Falling over a ragged-edged cliff in a crashing spray, the white frothing flow pushes everything in its path to the bottom of the streambed.  The path ends at the edge of the cliff, leaving the only exit back out to the west.

title: [Grassland]
description: A beaten path cuts through the grass, leading off to the west and disappearing up the slope of the foothills to the east.  To the side of the path, as if mimicking in miniature the larger field, a number of ants trudge along a tiny trail that leads up into the hill that is their home.

A beaten path cuts through the grass, leading off to the west and disappearing up the slope of the foothills to the east.  Fireflies dance in the grass on each side of the path, providing a faint flickering luminescence to light the way.

title: [Grassland]
description: This furrow has become home to a collection of brambles and other woody bushes.  As a result, a variety of wildlife has itself taken up residence in the new environment.

title: [Grassland]
description: The curve of the foothills forms a pocket where large boulders break up the smooth contours of the grassland.  A ring of firestones has been placed beneath an outcropping of rock that provided shelter for some weary traveler who chose to camp here.

title: [Grassland]
description: Gopher mounds and other small burrows dot the landscape, half-hidden by the thick grass growing in the field.  Each little hole is a tiny trap, waiting to snag the feet of the unwary.

title: [Grassland]
description: The grass in this section of the field has been attacked by some parasitic fungus.  A fuzzy cocoon of fibers surrounds the seed-bearing sheaths on each stalk and sprouts filaments that catch in the wind to seek out new plants to feed on.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Grassland]
description: A swift breeze rushes down from the rocky foothills to the north, rustling through the tall grass.  A copse of scraggly oak trees, mingled with a dense undergrowth of prickly bushes blocks passage to the west.

title: [Grassland]
description: The tall grass forms a lush green carpet up to the base of the hills rising to the north, adding its own soft, sweet scent to the smell of damp stone.  Sheer, steep and overgrown with prickly growths of bushes, there seems little chance of surmounting the rocky obstacle.

title: [Grassland]
description: The steep, rocky cliffs of the foothills rise to the north and east, bringing an end to the verdant grasslands.  Reaching steeply upward, the rough face of the cliffs offers no handhold for further travel.  The wind rushes down from the high hills, bearing with it the scent of thin, fresh air.

title: [Grassland]
description: The grasses here are wide-bladed and scratchy, and are growing much more thickly than to the south.  Grasshoppers and other insects fill the air at the passing of man or beast, but quickly settle back to feasting on the plants once danger has passed.

The grasses here are wide-bladed and scratchy, and are growing much more thickly than to the south.  Rustling sounds of small creatures scuttling to safety fill the night air at the passing of man or beast, quickly dying down again once danger has passed.

title: [Grassland]
description: Lines in the soil lead to a small hole under a stunted bush, apparently home to a snake.  It has likely been feeding on the rodents that thrive in the surrounding field of seed-laden grass.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Grassland]
description: Rounded boulders poke through the grassy soil like mushrooms popping up after a summer rain.  A few opportunistic weeds have taken advantage of the break in the dense growth of grass, and grow profusely around the circumference of the stones.
Rounded boulders have broken through the surface of the ground.  The tops of the stones are white and stark against the night-shadowed soil, like disinterred skulls in a graveyard.

title: [Grassland]
description: A jutting chunk of rock sprawls north and south from the edges of a copse of trees down to the bank of a small inland pond.  Lichen, bird droppings and the bones of small rodents plaster the sides of the massive boulder, indication that some winged predator favors the spot as a dining perch.

title: [Grassland]
description: The skeletal remains of a large cat lie next to the bones of heavily antlered deer.  The fight between the two creatures must have been horrific, but in the end the only creatures to profit were the scavengers of the field.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Grassland]
description: A large, tranquil pond stretches out to the west, its waters rippling in a soft breeze.  The tips of marsh grass and cattails rise from the surface of the pond, looking as though each plant had decided to take a quick dip in the cool, refreshing water.  Many deep sets of prints and diggings in the muddy shore mark this spot as a favored watering hole for the nearby fauna.

title: [Grassland]
description: Algae-coated stones provide dry but slippery footing along the edge of the streambed.  The shadowy forms of larger boulders can be seen beneath the surface of the water, closer to the center of the stream.  To the west, the stream widens out into a small deep pond.

title: [Grassland]
description: A depression to the east has created a large muddy area where grass has been replaced by moss and bulrush.  In the more immediate area, stalks of grass grow in isolated clumps, and the prints of small rodents run tracks through the muddy soil between them.

title: [Grassland]
description: A group of large rocks juts up in the center of the stream, allowing passage across the swiftly flowing water.  A large branch has lodged just upstream of the rocks, forming an organic net that catches leaves and debris that have dropped into the stream.

title: [Grassland]
description: Fewer grasses are growing here where the streambed has backed up and spread out into a large muddy swamp.  Boulders sunk into the mud support a riotous growth of moss and lichen.  Bulrush shoots up between the boulders, grasslike plants supporting clusters of purple thorns at the tips.

title: [Grassland]
description: A wooden bridge leads south across the stream that cuts across this grassy field.  A narrow path parallels the stream to the west, then skirts around a large boulder to travel up the side of a hill to the northeast.

title: [Barley Field]
description: A low-hanging bridge built across the width of the stream blocks passage to the east, but the path along the edge of the stream is unimpeded to the west.  Silver-scaled fish dart around the shadows cast by the bridge, bursting briefly into the sky before falling back below the water's surface in an ongoing game of hide-and-seek with the sun.

A low-hanging bridge built across the width of the stream blocks passage to the east, but the path along the edge of the stream is unimpeded to the west.  Occasionally the plopping sound of a light body hitting the water, perhaps a frog or water snake going for a swim, echoes hollowly from the dark shadows beneath the bridge.

title: [Barley Field]
description: Intermittent rustlings provide evidence of small wild life residing in the tall barley grass.  The rotting trunk of an apple tree torn from the orchard to the east pokes its way into the open field.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Barley Field]
description: Foam-topped ripples spread across the surface of the stream that cuts across the northern end of the barley field.  Fresh from its passage over the rocky slopes to the east, the water is crystal clear and the sparkling forms of silvery fish can be seen gliding through the translucent depths.

Foam-topped ripples spread across the surface of the stream that cuts across the northern end of the barley field.  Fresh from its passage over the rocky slopes to the east, the water is crystal clear and the shadowed forms of fish can be seen gliding through the darkened depths of the streambed.

title: [Barley Field]
description: Several low-growing shrubs dot the grassy furrows of this abandoned field.  Feathery silver leaves shiver with the movement of air as breezes waft across the landscape.

title: [Barley Field]
description: The merry trilling of meadow fowl hiding in the grass provides a gentle background music to the constant whisper of water rushing along the streambed.  A shaggy apple sapling has sprouted near the banks of the stream, escaping the confines of the orchard to the east.  The tree trails delicate branches in the water of the stream, trembling the smooth surface with each passing breeze.

The rhythmic chirp of frogs provides a gentle background music to the constant whisper of water rushing along the streambed.  A shaggy apple sapling has sprouted near the banks of the stream, escaping the confines of the orchard to the east.  The tree trails delicate branches in the water of the stream, trembling the smooth surface with each passing breeze.

title: [Barley Field]
description: Rocky foothills to the west rise like brooding sentinels over the sun-touched field of barley grass.  Clouds overhead cast fleeting shadows across the surrounding plain.  Directly to the east a small apple orchard is nestled at the base of another range of low-lying hills.

Rocky foothills to the west rise like brooding sentinels over the shadowed field of barley grass.  Directly to the east a small apple orchard is nestled at the base of another range of low-lying hills.

title: [Barley Field]
description: The field's upper end takes on a slightly sandier composition near the banks of the meadow stream.  Wide blade grasses and moss have taken over and pushed the growth of barley out of existence along the edge of the water.

title: [Barley Field]
description: The bleached, half-buried skull of a large feline shows starkly against the dark soil of the field.  An industrious spider has woven her webs around the skull and the silken threads tremble with each passing breeze like shivering gossamer flesh on the creature's long dead bone.
The bleached, half-buried skull of a large feline shows ghostly pale against the darker soil of the field.  Black shadowed eye holes peer up blankly at the deep night sky.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Tendrils of vines creep from beneath the shade of the apple orchard to the east and trail out into the barley grass, blurring the line between furrowed field and the tangled undergrowth of the trees.  Tiny hooked thorns at the tips of the vine stems clutch at the grass stalks, anchoring the plant firmly to the territory it has conquered.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A particularly deep depression in the ground has filled with silt and a thick collection of fallen leaves.  Upon closer examination it can be seen that this is the patchy remnants of a pebble-lined irrigation trench which once brought water from the stream to the north into the orchard.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A large, flat stone sits by the side of the stream, resting in the shade of spreading apple tree branches.  Bunches of violets cluster near the stream, the soft lavender blending smoothly with the deep green grass that lines the shore.

A large, flat stone sits by the side of the stream, resting in the shadow of spreading apple tree branches.  Bunches of violets cluster near the stream, the soft lavender blending smoothly with the deep green grass that lines the shore.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A few apple trees have fallen across the path of the stream, acting as a natural dam and slowing the water's flow.  The stream has pooled upstream of the blockage, forming a wide marshy area around the trunks of the trees that still stand.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A stream to the north gurgles as it flows, joining the rise of low hills in preventing further growth of the orchard.  The old apple trees grow right up to the stream's edge, dropping a leaf into the rushing waters now and again.  Like a child's toy paper boat, the leaves are quickly swept downstream and out of sight.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Colorful wildflowers grow along the edge of the stream, a slowly swaying rainbow in the soft breeze.  Old apple trees crowd along the water, their numbers decreasing as the grassy hills begin their steep upward climb to the east.

Fragrant wildflowers grow along the edge of the stream, slowly swaying in the soft night breeze.  Old apple trees crowd along the water, their numbers decreasing as the grassy hills begin their steep upward climb to the east.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A few straggling apple saplings stand on the boulder-strewn slope of a low hill, delineating the outermost edge of the orchard.  A swift stream rushes down the slope, falling from a cluster of rocks that mark the source of the water.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A stray apple tree grows on the steep slope of the grassy hill to the east, spreading its branches as proudly as if it were its own grand orchard.  Its leaves rustle in the occasional breeze that blows down the slope, waving merrily at all who pass by.

A stray apple tree grows on the steep slope of the grassy hill to the east, spreading its branches as proudly as if it were its own grand orchard.  Its leaves rustle in the vagrant breezes blowing over the slope, a faint whispering song fading quickly in the night.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Thick, dark growths of trees crowd in closely to the trail, the leafy depths vibrating with a series of deep grunts and low growls.  The rippling gurgle of a rushing stream to the north provides a strangely musical accompaniment to the menacing sounds.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: The undergrowth of brambles and weeds grows particularly dense here, making footing even more treacherous.  The thick growth thins out a bit to the north where a stream cuts a path through the wild growth.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A large boulder has settled in the middle of a clearing to the north.  It has the appearance of an ancient giant who lay down for a nap and forgot to wake up.  Wild vines creep up the sides of the boulder to form a woven network of green veins around the glossy, black stone.

A large boulder has settled in the middle of a clearing to the north.  It has the appearance of an ancient giant who lay down for a nap and forgot to wake up.  Wild vines creep up the sides of the boulder to form a woven network of green veins around the dark, black stone.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: The trees that once stood thick in this area have fallen, forming a tiny clearing in the middle of the orchard.  The trunks of the toppled trees form a hedge to the north, east and west, leaving the trail to the south as the only way back into the depths of the orchard.  In the middle of the clearing squats a massive black boulder.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: The trail through the orchard ends abruptly, the growth of trees blocked by the steep rise of jagged hills that reach northward toward a range of higher foothills.  The few saplings that struggle to grow on the side of the hill are already losing the battle for life, most of their greenery gnawed off by wild beasts.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: The orchard begins to thin out as the apple trees struggle to grow up the slope of the low hills which rise to the east.  A few young saplings stand at the very edge of the tree line, enjoying an amount of room and open air that cannot be had in the center of the dense orchard.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A small burrow has been dug among the roots of one of the apple trees, just large enough for a snake or a small mammal.  The opening of the burrow has been partly dug up, as though a larger predator had been trying to get in at the burrow's occupant.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Dense trees and thick underbrush close in, erasing the former orchard trail.  The spreading branches reach overhead, nearly cutting off all light.  Through the darkness, a lone songbird twitters merrily, echoing its joyful call through the decadent growth.

Dense trees and thick underbrush close in, erasing the former orchard trail.  The spreading branches reach overhead, cutting off view of the night sky.  Through the darkness, a lone owl hoots softly, echoing its mournful call through the decadent growth.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Weeds and bushes grow close around the trunks of the old apple trees, crowding out the growth of any new saplings.  Old fruit and damaged branches hang from the abandoned trees, decaying reminders of their many years of neglect.

title: [Barley Field]
description: The furrows cut across the field could cause the unwary walker to stumble while crossing this ridged carpet of green.  Now and again a bird wings its way over the undulating vista which stretches toward a darker line of trees to the east.

title: [Barley Field]
description: An occasional flutter of sound marks the rapid passing of some small animal skittering its way through the surrounding vegetation.  Less easily heard, but more easily seen, is the pebbly-sided mound of a large ant hill.  Tiny black ants go about their daily business with military precision as they march in and out of the hole at the top of this miniature mountain.

An occasional flutter of sound marks the rapid passing of some small animal skittering its way through the surrounding vegetation.  Silent, but more easily seen, is the pebbly-sided mound of a large ant hill.  No movement can be seen about the hill.  Most likely its inhabitants have retired for the night to earthen chambers below the ground.

title: [Barley Field]
description: Trampled grass creates a criss-cross pattern of narrow trails across the furrowed field.  Here and there a bare spot of damp ground supports a circle of flat-topped speckled mushrooms.

title: [Barley Field]
description: A spattering of bright color dots the landscape here and there where patches of wildflowers mingle with the hardy meadow grass that is slowly crowding out the uncut stands of barley.  A faint sweet fragrance wafts across the field with each passing breeze.

title: [Barley Field]
description: The path through the trellises ends at an open field extending to the north.  The field has an appearance as neglected as that of the vineyard, and high stands of domestic barley grass grow wild alongside a collection of thistles, wildflowers and weeds.

title: [Barley Field]
description: Patches of thistle grow along the edge of the boundary where the vineyard meets the field.  Tipped with fuzzy pink and purple blossoms, the weeds have a pastel soft appearance that is belied by the prickly thorns on the edges of their grass-like growth of leaves.

title: [Barley Field]
description: Tall grass sways gently in the breezes passing over the field.  Here and there, the precise furrows made by plows are broken up by more recent signs of digging.  The earthen hills of moles and gophers mingle with shoveled trenches made by the noses of wild creatures searching for burrowing insects and tasty roots.

title: [Vineyard]
description: The nibbling of some hungry herbivore has checked the growth of the grapevines here where the vineyard ends and a large field begins.  Vines which trail freely along the paths amongst the trellises have been nipped off in surprisingly precise lines along the edge of the open land.  It's as if the creature grazing here is willing to venture only so far amongst the man-made structure of the trellises, but no further.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, northwest

title: [Vineyard]
description: Birds twitter and chirp amongst the unchecked growth of vines, squabbling over bits of grape or a particularly delectable beetle discovered beneath a sheltering leaf.  To the north, through the crumbling structure of the trellises, you can see an open field.

title: [Vineyard]
description: Thorn-covered vines have usurped the position of the grapes that once grew on the surrounding trellises, binding the wooden posts and rails in a weave of greenery as tight as a sailor's knot.  The path amongst the vines is blocked by a wall to the east, but continues on to the south and west.

title: [Vineyard]
description: Vines trailing over the crumbled splinters of broken trellises have found a new source of support on the headless skeleton of a large bear.  Green leafy tendrils are twisted and entwined about the yellowed rib bones of the creature like yarn on a rug maker's loom.

title: [Vineyard]
description: A path continues on through the maze of vines, wandering east and west and turning off to the north toward an open field.  To the northeast a small apple orchard is nestled at the base of another range of low-lying hills.

title: [Vineyard]
description: Thick brambles crowd the path between the trellises and choke the growth of the grapes in this portion of the vineyard.  Thorns and dense foliage appear to attract the patronage of small animals seeking refuge from predators.  The ground beneath the brambles is littered with grape seeds and bits and pieces of a broken bird's nest.

title: [Vineyard]
description: The gnarled hedges of brambles curve across the last visible path at this point in the vineyard.  The only direction out of the thorny clump seems to be to the east.

title: [Vineyard]
description: Well-worn paths lead through the tangled vines of this abandoned vineyard.  The once sturdy trellises that supported the prolifically growing grapes have all crumbled under the wearing effects of nature, or have been removed by villagers searching for an easy supply of firewood.

title: [Vineyard]
description: Bright red berries dot the branches of the bramble bushes that crowd in on the paths of the vineyard.  Given the tenacious reach of the thorns on the bushes, one could almost imagine that the berries are the drops of blood left behind by unwary travelers who have passed this way.

title: [Vineyard]
description: A slowly advancing hedge of bramble bushes rises to the west, blocking all passage in that direction.  The steady encroachment of the thorny plants into the territory of the vineyard does not bode well for the grapes left defenseless without the careful tending of a farmer's hands.

title: [Vineyard]
description: Tracks in the damp soil beneath the tangled grapevines suggest that this untended arbor is a popular stomping ground for rabbits, birds and an occasional field mouse.  Here and there can also be seen the blurred prints of some large, barefooted creature mingled with the indentations left by booted travelers.

title: [Vineyard]
description: A low stone wall cuts across the southern end of the vineyard.  To the east it meets with another wall running north to south, and to the west it eventually disappears beneath a thick growth of thorny bushes.

title: [Vineyard]
description: An enclosed garden can be seen through a gap in the wall to the east.  To the west opens a stretch of land that was once a cultivated vineyard, but now appears to be returning to a rather wild state.  Brambles, weeds and untended vines vie for space in soil that seems oddly churned considering how long it has been since a plow touched these fields.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A large log lies rotting here, its insides turned mostly to dust by termites and age.  All around the fallen apple tree, its former sisters continue to grow and bear fruit, oblivious to the decay that surrounds them.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: The trees here grow more closely together, becoming less like an orchard and more like a dense woods.  Strange grunting noises echo from the shadows, sounding eerily through the dark growth.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A menacing bramble bush grows among a few of the larger apple trees, forming a low wall that blocks passage to the south. Bits of feathers and patches of fur are caught in the spiky tangles, showing the effectiveness of the natural barrier.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Spindly young apple trees, many nipped off at the top by browsing animals, have sprouted along the border between field and orchard.  Less hardy and slower growing than the bramble bushes that compete with them for space, the tender saplings are unlikely to reach maturity.  Even so, the parent trees to the east continue to cast seed-laden apples into the field every season with the falling of the leaves.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Butterflies hover over a patch of pale pink wildflowers growing in the shade of several large apple trees.  To the west, sun-loving grass and weeds spread through the open barley field.
Fireflies dart in and out of a patch of wildflowers that is nestled in the shadows beneath the apple trees.  Vagrant night breezes ripple through the barley growing in the field to the west.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Scratches and strange marks mar the trunks of apple trees in the neglected orchard.  Though deep, the gouging is superficial to the old, large trees, which spread branches heavy and bent from lack of pruning.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: A compact bush covered with sweet-smelling pink flowers huddles in the shadow of the spreading branches of a particularly enormous apple tree.  Spreading out from the base of the tree is a thick hedge of another variety of bush, grey-leafed and thorny.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Low hills rise up to the east, tracing a line along the old apple orchard up to the rocky foothills in the north.  A few wildflowers grow up the steep slope of the hill, their bright yellow blossoms contrasting sharply with the muted green and grey of grass and stone.

title: [Barley Field]
description: The fragrance of wildflowers mingles pleasantly with the scent of damp soil.  Plowed furrows, now overgrown with grass and weeds, rise and fall in lines which curve to meet the contours of the gently rolling landscape.

title: [Wildflower Field, Pond]
description: A sparkling stream of water pouring from beneath a small white building to the east feeds into a small clear pond.  Roughly oval in shape, the pond is little more than a stone-lined depression in the ground, surrounded by grass and flowers, with a stacked stone wall to the north and west.

title: [Wildflower Field]
description: A brick path weaves in and around several raised boxes that once enclosed plantings of invasive herbs.  Left untended by the restraining hands of a gardener, the plants have escaped the confines of the boxes and now spread unchecked across this portion of the field.

title: [Wildflower Field]
description: The trunk of an oak tree, split and charred by lightning, lies rotting against the southern wall of the garden.  Tangled vines grow over the trunk, tiny roots and tendrils fastened deeply into the wood, hastening its decomposition.  Several missing stones have opened a gap along the western edge of the wall.

title: [Wildflower Field]
description: A narrow baked brick path winds lazily through a fragrant field of pastel-colored wildflowers.  Sprigs of grass push between the crumbled mortar of the path, giving it a somewhat overgrown appearance. It looks as if the whole area was once a cultivated garden spot, now abandoned to the care of the sun and weather.

title: [Wildflower Field]
description: A tall oak casts a cool shadow over the brick pathway that runs through this small enclosed field.  Beneath the tree a shade-loving ground cover forms a soft carpet of vines and leaves.  A little to the north you can see a small white building nestled amongst the abundant growth of flowers.

A tall oak casts a dark shadow against the barely visible brick pathway that runs through this small enclosed field.  Beneath the tree a hearty ground cover forms a soft carpet of vines and leaves.  A little to the north you can see a small white building nestled amongst the abundant growth of flowers.

title: [Wildflower Field]
description: The brick path ends in front of a tiny wooden structure constructed of latticework panels.  The red paving stones surrounding the building are imprinted with fanciful representations of flowers and herbs.  A low wall running from north to south turns and continues in a westerly direction, creating a cozy sun-warmed corner in this part of the field.

The brick path ends in front of a tiny wooden structure constructed of latticework panels.  The red paving stones surrounding the building are imprinted with fanciful representations of flowers and herbs.  A low wall running from north to south turns and continues in a westerly direction, creating a cozy moonlit corner in this part of the field.

title: [Latticework Building]
description: Padded benches line five of the latticework walls of this six-cornered building.  An open arch in the remaining wall leads out to the surrounding fields.  A marble statue carved into the indistinct shape of a woman stands near the center of the small room, forming the back of a vine-covered stone altar.  She carries in her hands a large jug which pours out a stream of sparkling water that spills over a bed of carved stone flowers and seeps away into the cracks and crannies in the floor.

title: [Barefoot Hill, Abandoned Field]
description: The ancient wall that bounds the field curves from south to northeast, its stones nearly crumbled into rubble by the gnarled roots of a large oak tree which has outgrown the boundaries of its original planting over many decades.  A shady path is visible leading from the other side of the fallen stone to the nearby grasslands.

title: [Fearling Pass, Cobbled Road]
description: Young maples flourish amid some more stately trees and much of the landscape gives way to brush, as the dirt trail merges with a limestone-cobbled road.  A well-kept sign, trimmed to a point that directs traffic southeast, stands along one side of this maintained pass.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Coral berry shrubs blanket the ground with nearly four feet of evergreen leaves and tiny yellow flowers.  Pushing through the dense cover, you are surrounded by a faint perfume that rises from the dark red, waxy berries crushed by every footstep.  To the northeast stands a grove of trees, their spindly trunks bound up like bundled kindling by thick, twining vines.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Bits of tattered cloth torn from the clothing of passersby indicate the narrow gaps through the bittersweet vines surrounding this grove.  The crab apple trees groan under the weight of these unwelcome guests, which steal the best of rain and sun from their stunted hosts.  The vines twine around every available limb until the grove resembles nothing more than a gargantuan bird's nest.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Very little wind penetrates the dense growth of tree and vine, leaving the center of the grove oversweet with the perfume of crab apple blossoms.  The ground is covered with yellow and orange pods dropped from the bittersweet vines, their contents long since pillaged by scavenging birds and squirrels.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: At the edge of the grove of crab apple trees, the bittersweet vines open onto a vast growth of hawthorn.  These massive shrubs grow to a height of more than thirty feet, completely obscuring the view to the north.  The ground runs sharply downhill to the southeast, from which direction you can hear the pleasant melody of a gently burbling brook.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: A pleasant little brook cuts across the faint path that leads down a sharp slope from the north.  Moving swiftly down the incline, the crystal clear water splashes against the rocky bed and gurgles into shallow pools.  The brook is narrow enough for even the shortest halfling to cross with ease, were it not for the impassable stand of privet that blocks further travel in that direction.

A pleasant little brook cuts across the faint path that leads down a sharp slope from the north.  Moving swiftly down the incline, the night-darkened water splashes against the rocky bed and gurgles into shallow pools.  The brook is narrow enough for even the shortest halfling to cross with ease, were it not for the impassable stand of privet that blocks further travel in that direction.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Marked by hard-stamped soil, a narrow trail snakes off in several directions through the dense thicket of hawthorn.  Thick, thorny branches reach out from every direction at once, with a clear intention to tear at clothing and skin.  As if in celebration of their success, wispy fibres of tattered cloth remain dangling from dark-stained thorns.  Littering the ground are dozens of crab apple cores.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: A small boulder sits in the center of this tiny clearing, its rounded and hollow top filled with rainwater.  The berry-colored droppings that cover the surrounding thicket suggest that this clearing is a favorite with the local avian population, though some grimy rags at the foot of the boulder indicate that other creatures, too, make use of this bathing facility.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Elderberry shrubs grow in and among the tall hawthorn, struggling to compete for the thin sunlight that penetrates the dense thicket.  Clusters of tiny white flowers put forth a delicate fragrance, which almost masks the reek rising from the ripped canvas bags lying beneath the shrubs.

Elderberry shrubs grow in and among the tall hawthorn, their tiny white flowers shimmering like pale ghosts in the silvery moonlight that penetrates the dense thicket.  The delicate fragrance of elderberry blossoms almost masks the reek rising from the ripped canvas bags lying beneath the shrubs.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Red and yellow hawthorn fruit has been ground into the soil, turning the narrow footpath into a sticky morass.  Any temptation to seek higher ground is quelled by the thorny picket surrounding the shrubbery.  Some bristly greenbriar grows over the top of the hawthorn, blocking all but a few tiny motes of sunlight.

Red and yellow hawthorn fruit has been ground into the soil, turning the narrow footpath into a sticky morass.  Any temptation to seek higher ground is quelled by the thorny picket surrounding the shrubbery.  Some bristly greenbriar grows over the top of the hawthorn, blocking all but a few wan beams of moonlight.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: The faint trail climbs onto a short ridge that runs from the heart of the thicket, the rocky clearing providing the best view of the sky and freshest breath of air available for some distance around.  A brisk wind passes the top of the ridge, producing almost no movement at all in the densely wooded thicket.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Four logs have been placed to form a large square surrounding a small firepit.  The hawthorn seems to shrink away from the square, some scorched branches indicating that it learned the perils of growing too near an open flame.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: The trail leads up a sharp rise to the northwest and down a precipitous drop to the northeast, the dramatic alteration in terrain masked by the tall hawthorn.  Where the trail diverges, a small wooden figure peeks shyly from behind a sheltering gauntlet of thorns.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Muddy soil, a steep slope, and razor sharp thorns render the climb to and from the top of this hill a real challenge.  The arduous climb is rewarded with a breathtaking view ... of yet more hawthorn.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: The ladder reaches a wooden platform in the heart of the briar thicket.  Constructed of pine boards, now weathered and warped and eaten by worms, the platform offers little in the way of shelter or security.  A three-legged stool dangles from a thorny branch several feet above the platform, almost as if the hawthorn grabbed it as the thicket grew.  A series of handholds have been cleared of thorns to allow those with sufficient courage to climb even higher into the thicket.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: The dangerous climb to the top of the briar thicket yields a view of the surrounding countryside, including the entire briar thicket and the small crab apple grove beyond it to the south.  Though, truth be told, as a lookout spot it leaves much to be desired: whoever or whatever might be moving through the thicket is completely obscured beneath thirty feet of thorns, branches, leaves, flowers, and berries.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: At the base of a steep incline, waterlogged soil has been stirred into a morass of thick, black mud that clings to everything it comes into contact with.  The sludge has been splashed over the low-lying hawthorn branches and tracked across a rickety wooden trapdoor that lies atop the mire, like a raft afloat on a mud-dark sea.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Thick wooden planks support the walls of this tiny underground room, trying none too successfully to keep mud and dirt from entering.  The tiny room is cluttered with boxes and barrels, as well as some raggedy patchwork blankets.  Low on the southern wall is a gap in the boards that opens onto a tunnel leading down.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: This tiny room has been carved directly into the drier soil at the center of the hill.  Thick roots cross the floor and walls, like arteries running through the body of the land.  An unspeakably foul odor rises from inside a covered bucket in the darkened corner of the room.

title: [Barefoot Hill, Abandoned Field]
description: Tall clumps of weeds and grass are mingled with overgrown wheat, their stalks interwoven to form a mass of underbrush.  A thin layer of ash dusts the surface of the field like newly fallen snow, and below the plants a heavier cinder smothers the trough-marked dirt.  Small reddish lumps of clay and stone dot the field.

title: [Barefoot Hill, Abandoned Field]
description: The singed scrub brush thins somewhat near a circular patch of empty land.  A pile of what used to be harvested wheat, grass and weeds now forms a heap of decaying compost situated next to a large indentation in the soil.  Wildflowers add a soft pastel hue to the reddish tilled topsoil.

title: [Barefoot Hill, Abandoned Field]
description: Furrows that once marked golden rows of wheat run side by side through the overgrown field, their parallel depressions puddled with foul, acrid black water.  A few hardy wildflowers grow here and there, sprouting fresh green leaves and tiny white blossoms from charred patches of brush.

title: [Barefoot Hill, Abandoned Field]
description: The desiccated forms of blackened, twisted weeds dot the ground, their withered leaves drooping into the black ash that partially obscures the cracked, red dirt underneath.  Hardier vegetation grows in random clusters throughout the area, adding a faint tinge of green to the otherwise lifeless surroundings.

title: [Barefoot Hill, Abandoned Field]
description: Singed grass covers the ground, resembling a massive, tattered web that spreads across the area.  Thin stalks of wheat poke up from the bits of dirt the grass hasn't claimed, straight grooves in the parched, reddened earth faintly visible beneath them.  Dark wisps of sulfurous-smelling smoke rise up from some of the vegetation, becoming blurred by the harsh waves of heat emanating from the ground.

title: [Barefoot Hill, Abandoned Field]
description: A thick layer of rough brush and weeds covers the long-fallow field, becoming thicker near the old stone wall which borders its western edge.  Narrow, well-worn trails have been worn into the vegetation in several directions, the matted grass and weeds charred in patches and even still smoldering here and there.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Hopai's Magic Shoppe]
[Hopai's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A carved mahogany box and a plain wooden table are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Ferich Porich, Cartographer]
description: This tiny shop is cramped further by large compartmented shelves on either side filled with charts, maps, atlases, and instruments for navigation.  The pigeonholes are each carefully labeled in tiny handwritten script.  Cramped into a small space surrounded by stacks of dusty reference books is the writing table of the shop's proprietor.

title: [Pasha's Pavilion]
description: Erected on a rounded rectangular base, the room reaches upward toward a domed interior peaking at an octagonal oculus.  Suspended from the pendentives are large bleached yierka-hide lozenges, bearing stylized fiery images.  Large square tiles of alternating crimson and ivory ceramic begin at the northern archway, slowly dispersing into a mosaic of red and orange swirling patterns.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Travel Office]
description: The white plaster interior is richly draped with gold brocaded satin and near the entry is a tall golden stand.  The darkly stained wooden floor is covered in a variety of crimson and grey wool runners.  In the center of the room is a massive plush crimson davenport and near the perimeter are a few elegantly carved wooden benches.

title: [Lower Walkway North]
description: The marble walkway leads southwest and southeast underneath a thick walnut lattice apparently used by those moving about the second floor.  At the northern tip where the walkway comes to a point, a carved walnut door allows entrance to one of The Legendary Rest's sleeping rooms.  On the other side of the walkway, a honeysuckle hedge separates the walkway from the courtyard, though it is easy to see the courtyard's magnificent fountain from this vantage.

title: [Lower Walkway East]
description: A carved walnut door flanked by two brass torch holders is recessed into the wall of the inn's easternmost sleeping room.  Smooth marble walkways lead northwest and southwest around the diamond that is the inn's central courtyard.  A flourishing honeysuckle hedge forms a pleasant barrier between the walkways and the inner courtyard, separating those who wish to find a sleeping room from those who wish to sit at the tables and converse or just enjoy the courtyard's fountain.

title: [Lower Walkway South]
description: Thick beams shore up the sturdy walnut lattice directly overhead.  The lattice allows extra illumination and air to filter down from above while providing a sturdy walking surface for those moving about the second floor of the inn.  Directly to the north, a huge marble fountain burbles pleasantly in the center of a spacious courtyard, and thick honeysuckle vines shaped into a wide hedge perfume the air.  A carved walnut door, the entrance to a sleeping room, resides on the south wall.

title: [Upper Walkway North]
description: The lattice walkway overlooks the courtyard below, with its huge fountain, flowering bushes and honeysuckle hedge.  The top of the fountain is approximately at the same height as the walkway's surface, so the fountain's piping, wheels, doors, and other intricacies are readily visible.  Directly to the north, a carved walnut door allows entrance to one of the Rest's sleeping rooms, and a polished stairway with plush, carpeted steps provides a descent to the level below.

title: [Upper Walkway West]
description: A thick walnut lattice walkway extends in a diamond shape to the east.  Sturdy beams rise from the walkway to support a wide overhang that is an extension of the golden tile roof.  At each of the four points of the diamond, a walnut door allows entrance into one of The Legendary Rest's sleeping rooms.  The walls of the rooms touch, so the area is actually a diamond-shape, open to the sky, within a walnut-lined square, and the courtyard and fountain are easily viewed below.

title: [Upper Walkway South]
description: The top of the fountain in the courtyard reaches to just about the height of the second story walkway, and from the walkway most of the courtyard and all of the fountain are visible.  The walkway heads northeast and northwest to the doors of the eastern and western sleeping rooms, then converges back again to meet at the northernmost room.  Directly to the south is the carved walnut door of the southernmost sleeping room.  Although the walkway is covered, the Rest's courtyard is open to the sky.

title: [Upper Walkway East]
description: Carved into the walnut door on the east wall is a detailed rendering of a seashore scene, painstakingly cut to include the smallest details.  Two brass torch holders flank the door, and the torches they contain are totally fresh, with no sign of burning at all.  The courtyard and its huge fountain are plainly visible from this point, as the walkways of the upper floor form the perimeter of a diamond, with the room doors at the four points and the walkways as the sides.

Carved into the walnut door on the east wall is a detailed rendering of a seashore scene, painstakingly cut to include the smallest details.  Two brass torch holders flank the door, and the torches within the holders blaze brightly to illuminate the room entrance.  The courtyard and its huge fountain are plainly visible from this point, as the walkways of the upper floor form the perimeter of a diamond, with the room doors at the four points and the walkways as the sides.

title: [Sea N' Shore Room]
description: Thick, speckled white-and-golden carpet stretches from wall to wall, much as the sand on the beach might stretch from horizon to horizon.  The ceiling is painted a soft sky blue with wispy white patches.  The sky blue color also extends down the walls, but turns slowly and subtly to a dark ocean blue a foot or so before it reaches the carpet.  Candles in brass holders light the room from each corner, illuminating the room's furniture, including a full replica ship's wheel mounted on the east wall.

title: [Golden Harvest Room]
description: Candles blaze in sixteen brass holders to brightly light the room.  The greens, yellows and golds of harvest predominate in the carpet, walls and ceiling, and the use of wicker lends a rustic feeling to the setting.  A large bed occupies much of the south wall, and wide wicker chairs rest in the northwest and northeast corners.  A window box containing numerous potted herbs extends from the west wall, and the box's glass panes allow the sunlight to flow in and nourish the plants.

A large bed occupies much of the south wall, and wide wicker chairs rest in the northwest and northeast corners.  A window box containing numerous potted herbs extends from the west wall, and the box's glass panes protect the herbs from the lower nighttime temperatures.

title: [Forest Clearing Room]
description: Wood tones and greenery predominate throughout the room.  A heavily polished, oak plank floor supports a heavy, walnut four-post bed, a forest green woven throw rug, a walnut dressing table, and two elegant walnut chairs.  The walls are paneled in the same shade of oak as the floor.  A tapestry of a relaxing forest scene hangs on two of the four walls, while another covers the ceiling.  A huge window of frosted glass occupies a third wall.  Potted plants are strategically placed.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Lobby]
description: A gleaming, red marble floor extends at least a hundred feet to the east, its shiny surface reflecting the sunlight that pours through the glass panes high overhead.  White marble columns shot with gold veins support an oak framework two stories up, and large metal baskets filled with trailing ivy and climbing roses hang from the oak mesh.  Immaculate, carved chairs occupy places around the lobby near tables polished to a mirror-like sheen.

White marble columns shot with gold veins support an oak girder framework two stories up, and large metal baskets filled with trailing ivy and climbing roses hang from the oak mesh.  Immaculate, carved chairs occupy places around the lobby near tables polished to a mirror-like sheen.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Real Estate Office]
description: This small realtor's office has a quiet, subdued ambiance.  A large polished oak desk rests in one corner with a detailed map tacked to the wall above it.  Well-kept filing cabinets flank the desk, filled with paperwork for property ownership.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Cartage Office]
description: The office here doubles as a warehouse, as evidenced by the stacks of wooden crates and large boxes that fill nearly two thirds of this room.  Workmen can be seen, handling various crates with care as they move them in and out of the area.  A well maintained sign with rates hangs on the wall near the entrance.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Deed Conveyance]
description: This small office is kept meticulously clean and the mahogany paneled walls are polished to a deep golden, mirror-like sheen.   A large oak desk rests across the far side of the room under long wooden shelves that hold a number of ledgers along with carefully arranged contracts.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Lobby]
description: Footsteps echo noisily off the red marble floor, the sound amplified by the immense glass-and-oak ceiling that arches high overhead.  Carved walnut chairs and polished walnut tables scattered about the lobby do little to reduce the lobby's cavernous impression.  A golden pine, twenty feet high, thrives in a circular brass planter in the lobby's center, and hundreds of framed portraits, apparently of famous Ta'Vaalor citizens, occupy the varnished walnut walls.

Carved chairs and polished tables scattered about the lobby do little to reduce the lobby's cavernous impression.  A golden pine, twenty feet high, thrives in a circular brass planter in the lobby's center, and hundreds of framed portraits, apparently of famous Ta'Vaalor citizens, occupy the varnished walls.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Hallway]
description: A runner of thick, red woolen carpet follows the hallway north and south.  The runner covers the center of the red marble floor, providing a stable, soft, quiet area on which to walk.  Along the hallway, heavy golden curtains allow entrance to private booths where one can access a personal locker.  Candles burn steadily in brass candleholders spaced evenly along the hallway's walls, casting a dim but consistent illumination throughout the corridor.

Along the hallway, heavy golden velvet curtains allow entrance to private booths where one can access a personal locker.  Candles burn steadily in brass candleholders spaced evenly along the hallway's walnut walls, casting a dim but consistent illumination throughout the corridor.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Meeting Hall]
description: Chairs arranged in concentric circles radiate out from the center of this spacious circular chamber.  A clear area approximately fifteen feet wide directly in the center provides ample space for speech-giving, pontificating, lecturing, or whatever activity might need to be done in front of a large audience.  Elegant tapestries sewn in a red and gold pattern drape the walls and ceiling to dampen the echo from the red marble floor.  A set of walnut double doors allows exit to the lobby.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Citizens' Office]
description: The low vaulted stone ceiling has been ornamented by whimsical carvings of small woodland creatures chasing among twining ivies.  The pattern is continued in a carved stone counter, upon which rest several official-looking tomes and documents.  Behind the counter, several serious-looking clerks bend studiously over scrolls, occasionally making an annotation as they read.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Neatly ordered rows of chairs face the front of the room, their wooden backs ramrod-straight.  The walls are decorated with framed genealogy charts, each one beautifully painted with family crests.  Vaalorian flags hang to either side of a large portrait of King Tyrnian.

Neatly ordered rows of chairs face the front of the room, their wooden backs ramrod-straight.  The walls are decorated with framed genealogy charts, each one beautifully painted with family crests.  Vaalorian flags hang to either side of a large portrait of King Qalinor.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Registrar]
description: Deep wine-hued velvet curtains drape the rear wall of the small room, providing a softening effect for the otherwise austere stone walls of the keep.  Several glaesine lamps dangle from ornate mithril chains, casting a dim amber light across the plush Loenthran carpets.  A stately carved haon desk occupies the center of the carpeted floor.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Hallway]
description: A runner of thick, red woolen carpet follows the hallway to the north.  The runner covers the center of the red marble floor, providing a stable, soft, quiet area on which to walk.  Along the hallway, heavy golden velvet curtains allow entrance to private booths where one can access a personal locker.  Candles burn steadily in brass candleholders spaced evenly along the hallway's walnut walls, casting a dim but consistent illumination throughout the corridor.

title: [Bank of Ta'Vaalor, Lobby]
description: Thick Loenthran carpets in shimmering hues of aubergine, olive and amber cover the smooth stone floors, adding warmth and luxury to the chamber.  A vaulted ceiling, painted with a scene of ancient battle, soars overhead.  Small beams of colored light refracting through the panes of stained glaes windows arc across the otherwise undecorated ivory limestone walls.

title: [United Bank of City-States]
description: Thick aubergine carpeting and heavy dark green velvet drapes help to muffle sound inside the bank, but the faint *clink* of coins can still be heard filtering from behind the bank's teller, who sits patiently waiting to help the next patron.  A small but elegant wrought iron chandelier hangs from the ceiling above, its amber glaesine globes casting a warm hue across the room.

title: [Bank of Ta'Vaalor, Exchange]
description: A rich blue and green Loenthran carpet covers the floor of this small alcove.  A large maoral desk resides in one corner, where the clerk waits to assist patrons with their financial needs.  Piled atop the desk are stacks of blank notes.

title: [Areacne's Gems of Ta'Vaalor]
[Ta'Vaalor, Areacne's Gemshop]
description: Exquisite antique-white dupioni silk curtains, trimmed in fine lace covers the bay window.  A beautifully arranged bouquet of wild roses in a transparent quartz vase rests in the center of the speckled marble-topped counter, which is trimmed in black willow.  Overhead, the delicate prisms of the crystal chandelier emit soft chimes, as a slight breeze makes it gently sway back and forth.  The thick, plush forest-green wall-to-wall carpet muffles the steps of the patrons of this elegant shop.

Various cut and uncut gemstones wink from where they sit on pale, stained oak shelves that line the sides of the room.  The gemsmith, Areacne, swiftly strides about the area, buying the occasional gem or stone for the store's collection or answering the questions of curious customers gazing over her merchandise.

title: [Areacne's Heirloom Treasures]
[Ta'Vaalor, Tmareantha's Jewels]
description: Heavy cloth-of-gold curtains frame a pair of windows, glinting in the sunlight filtered through heavy silk sheers.  A lithe elven woman, elegantly attired in a layered black duponi silk gown, moves serenely among the velvet-draped tables dotted about the room, adjusting their displays of glittering jewels and heirloom pieces to best advantage.

Wooden counters topped with glass cases are scattered around the room, each holding glittering pieces of jewelry.  An elven guard stands watch in each of the four corners of the room, keeping a wary eye over patrons as they glance over the selection.  The jeweler, Tmareanth, glides around the room, helping customers as needed.  Hanging upon the wall is a black-inked sign.

Wooden counters topped with glass cases are scattered around the room, each holding glittering pieces of jewelry.  An elven guard stands watch in each of the four corners of the room, keeping a wary eye over patrons as they glance over the selection.  The jeweler, Tmareantha, glides around the room, helping customers as needed.  Hanging upon the wall is a black-inked sign.

title: [Ghaerdish's Furs and Pelts]
[Ghaerdish's Tannery]
description: Set on bronze plated frames and arranged in a triangular pattern over the Eastern wall are the mounted heads of four beasts.  The glass eyes of the magnificent specimens appear to track the movements of those within the quaint shop.  Lying on the floor directly in front of the counter are the hides of two arctic bears, sewn together by their back paws.  Hidden underneath a leather canvas in one corner of the room is a neat stack of cured animal hides.

A small part of the warehouse has been enclosed to form a shop where hunters may sell their scavenged skins and pelts to the furrier.  Several large windows allow a glimpse into the major operation of the business -- the tannery that provides cured leather and hides to outfit the armed forces of the fortress of Ta'Vaalor.  Although the smells are subdued in this room, there is still a stench that cannot be ignored emanating from the giant vats in the rear of the warehouse.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall]
description: A stately building constructed from weathered blue-veined grey marble stands behind a neatly trimmed hawthorn hedge that grows along the edge of the wey.  Sunlight filters through tall trees to cast dappled light along the building's high walls.  A massive granite block archway with lanterns hanging on either side interrupts the hedge to provide an entrance.

A stately building constructed from weathered blue-veined grey marble stands behind a neatly trimmed hawthorn hedge that grows along the edge of the wey.  Moonlight filters through tall trees to cast delicate shadows along the building's high walls.  A massive granite block archway with lanterns hanging on either side interrupts the hedge to provide an entrance.

title: [Adventurers' Guild, Foyer]
description: Heavy oak posts define this large, octagonal room.  Dominating the center of the space is a massive fireplace, its dressed basalt blocks rising into the dimness of the vaults overhead.  An odd assortment of people is seated on benches scattered around the room, some sitting singly, others in small groups huddled in private conversation.  A staircase winds behind the chimney, leading to the upper story.

title: [Adventurers' Guild, Hiring Hall]
description: This long gathering hall is lined with rough wooden benches and a few posting boards with odd scraps of parchment tacked on them.  A few anxious-looking young men hover about the edges of the room, their nervous pacing a sharp contrast to the resigned attitude of some older folks resting on the benches.  At the far end of the hall, a sturdy maoral table serves as a desk, its contents meticulously arranged.

A few anxious-looking young men hover about the edges of the room, their nervous pacing a sharp contrast to the resigned attitude of some older folks resting on the benches. title: [Adventurers' Guild, Provisioner]
description: Stacks of crates, boxes, and bins crowd the floor of this large alcove, as rich an assortment to the eye as the pungent smells of tar, new leather and cured meats are to the nose.  Behind a long counter at the far end, an old elf bustles about, his stature so bent that he might be mistaken for a tall burghal gnome.

title: [Adventurers' Guild, Office]
description: Layers of overlapping, thick wool carpets cover the floor of this spacious room, presenting a bewildering range of styles spanning the primitive geometrics of Tehir to the subtly shaded hues of Loenthra.  At the far end of the room stands an ebony desk inlaid with intricate marquetry, while closer to the stairs leading down, several leather chairs are gathered around a well-tended fire in the stone hearth.  Heavily shuttered windows allow only a few stray beams of light into the comfortable dimness.

title: [Adventurers' Guild, Vault]
description: The iron-shod door guards a trove of treasures from across the continent.  Racks of skillfully forged weapons run down the center of the room, with finely crafted armors arrayed upon one wall and bolts of costly fabrics and finely tailored garments hanging upon the facing wall.  Along the far wall is a tall chest of slender drawers, a few of which are open, revealing gleaming jewelry and arcane instruments.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: The ebonwood and mahogany parquet floor forms an unbroken pattern from one side of this grand entryway to the other.  A pair of tall, narrow windows frame the iron-hinged front door, spilling sunlight into the nearly empty room.  Set at a slight angle just by the entrance is a sparsely ornamented writing desk.

The ebonwood and mahogany parquet floor forms an unbroken pattern from one side of this grand entryway to the other.  A pair of tall, narrow windows frame the iron-hinged front door, spilling moonlight into the nearly empty room.  Set at a slight angle just by the entrance is a sparsely ornamented writing desk.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: White-framed mullioned windows fill the northern wall from floor to ceiling.  The rose garden outside is lushly green, coloring the light that filters into this airy space.  A wicker chaise lounge draped with a fringed silk shawl sits conveniently near a low table laden with iced tea and fresh fruit.
