A wicker chaise lounge draped with a fringed silk shawl sits conveniently near a low table laden with iced tea and fresh fruit.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: The ceiling is much higher here, vaulting up in an uninterrupted expanse of white plaster.  Pride of place is taken by a gilded harpsichord on a low dais.  A scattering of ladder-backed chairs are arranged in casual groupings on the herringbone floor.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: A maze of overstuffed armchairs and delicate end tables makes navigation through this room a tricky proposition.  Heavy celadon velvet drapes cover the windows and pool on the dark floor beneath.  Displayed atop the red marble fireplace is a collection of glass plates filled with bright pinwheels of color.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: Heavy wood paneling topped with egg and dart molding lines the walls of this broad hallway.  A claw-footed roll top desk presides at one end, while at the other stands a gilded and enameled suit of platemail.  Snapdragons nod brightly in a porcelain vase underneath a round window.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: An elaborate rose window filled with blue and green stained glass turns the sunlight to underwater tendrils as it pours over the thin silk rugs which cover the floor.  Tasseled red velvet cushions have been placed in front of low pedestals holding oversized leather bound tomes.  The dark walls are plain save for a fan of peacock feathers mounted above the entryway.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: A dark walnut dining table with fluted legs runs down the center of the room, its richly grained surface set with pewter plates and bone-handled silver cutlery.  A crystal-hung candelabra casts rippling shadows over the stained oak floor.  Hung over the fireplace is a tranquil landscape painting in an ornate silver frame.

title: [Marble Springs, Arch]
description: An elegant archway of grey-veined, pale white marble stands as a solemn attendant at the entrance to this small, riverside neighborhood.  Embraced by the thriving local flora, the lower portions of the marble columns have become entangled in flower-laden vines and lush, leafy creepers, whose natural beauty and slender tendrils seem to add to the quiet dignity of the carven stone.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: Accompanied by a pair of black oak trees, a well-crafted oaken figure rises up from the flowering undergrowth.  Carved into the life-sized image of an elven huntress, the figure holds an ornate longbow between its hands, an arrow notched at the ready.  A look of grim determination crosses the otherwise delicate feminine face, and a suit of hunting leathers has been meticulously engraved into the fine wood.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: A leafy border of slender ash trees prevents a clear view of the slow-moving river beyond, but the thick scent of river water and a gentle, lapping rhythm attest to its proximity.  A few corrugated marble columns have been artfully placed amid the narrow line of trees, their stark, white surfaces ensnared by local creepers.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: A pathway of yellowish grey alabaster winds its way along the edge of the river, its gently curving borders outlined with blooming vegetation.  Flowers of many varieties, their petals shining in brilliant shades of yellow, pink, and pale blue, line the walkway. A sweet perfume rising above their outstretched leaves.

A pathway of pale alabaster winds its way along the edge of the river, its gently curving borders outlined with blooming vegetation.  Flowers of many varieties, their petals dim under the shimmering moonlight, line the walkway.  A sweet perfume rising above their outstretched leaves.

title: [Marble Springs, Statue]
description: Free from weeds or stray blades of grass, the cobblestone walkway has been well-fitted and maintained, providing a secure path through the small community.  Just off the path, a quartz-veined marble statue rises from a stone flowerbed thick with wooly thyme and violets, the purple hue of the flowers making the white marble seem all the more stark and pale.

Just off the path, a quartz-veined marble statue rises from a stone flowerbed thick with wooly thyme and violets, the purple hue of the flowers making the white marble seem all the more stark and pale in the moonlight.

title: [Marble Springs, Bridge]
description: Gurgling quietly, a thin silvery stream passes beneath a short ash-wood bridge here, as it flows on its way toward the river to the southwest.  The bridge itself has been built atop a sturdy alabaster foundation, its wooden railings and supports decorated to resemble marsh reeds and other waterside foliage.  A polished oak lamppost, bearing a large brass lantern, stands next to the bridge.

The bridge itself has been built atop a sturdy alabaster foundation, its wooden railings and supports decorated to resemble marsh reeds and other waterside foliage.  A polished oak lamppost, bearing a large brass lantern which glows brightly in the misty night, stands next to the bridge.

title: [Marble Springs, Channels]
description: Flowing with silver-flecked stream water, a series of marble channels follows the cobblestone path.  The shallow channels, built to hold no more than a few inches of water each, crisscross one another and rise and fall as the rushing water ascends and descends a pattern of carefully constructed, miniature steps.  The quiet gurgling of the silvery fluid seems harmonious with the natural sounds made by local birds and the rustling of nearby trees.

The shallow channels, built to hold no more than a few inches of water each, crisscross one another and rise and fall as the rushing water ascends and descends a pattern of carefully constructed, miniature steps.  The quiet gurgling of the silvery fluid seems harmonious with the natural sounds made by crickets and the rustling of nearby trees.

title: [Marble Springs, Stream]
description: A small stream parallels the cobbled path for a while, its fast-moving, happily gurgling water eventually veering off toward the southwest to join up with the larger river.  The crystal clear water allows for an unobstructed view of the river stone-lined streambed, small wisp-like algae clinging to a few of the smooth pebbles along its bottom.

title: [Marble Springs, Basins]
description: Set atop multi-tiered wooden poles of varying heights, a series of shallow, circular stone basins has been erected in a small clearing hedged by a row of squat berry bushes.  Oddly tree-like in their appearance, the artistic structures have managed to catch fallen rain water or retained the morning dew, much to the delight of a small flock of red-bellied songbirds which flutter from basin to basin, happily flapping their wings and pruning themselves in the collected moisture.

Set atop multi-tiered wooden poles of varying heights, a series of shallow, circular stone basins has been erected in a small clearing hedged by a row of squat berry bushes.  Oddly tree-like in their appearance, the artistic structures have managed to catch fallen rain water or collected the night mist, which now forms shallow pools in each of the stone basins.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: The pathway of alabaster cobblestones curves closer to the sluggish expanse of the river, the scattered black oaks and slender ash trees giving way to a rough shoreline of smooth river stones and pebbles.  The dark waters gently lap at the rock-strewn shoreline to the southwest, each small crest topped with a cap of pale foam.  The melodic rhythm of the incoming tide and quiet splash of water on stone is soothing to the ear and mind.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: Semicircular stone arches stand on either side of the cobbled path, their marble frames supporting an array of wooden flowerpots.  Hung from cords of braided twine, the flowerpots have been carved into a variety of decorative shapes, and each sustains a flowering plant in its soil-filled interior.  A sweet aroma, reminiscent of honey and delicate perfumes, lingers in the air.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: The dark expanse of the river can be glimpsed through a copse of slender ash trees to the south, its slow-moving waters casting occasional flashes of light from the bright sun overhead.  Barely visible through the tightly clustered woods, a short stone dock juts out into the river, a small wooden skiff resting next to its sturdy frame.

title: [Marble Springs, Statue]
description: A golden-veined marble statue rises from a low flowerbed of blooming chrysanthemums, the puff-shaped flowers reaching no higher than its carven boots.  The statue has been meticulously detailed to resemble a young elven warrior, his stony visage frozen in a stern, indignant stare.  A pair of spiraling pair of columns flank the marble figure, their lower reaches entwined with verdant tendrils.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: The cool, refreshing scent of the river to the south is strong here, its natural odor carried along by a light breeze.  A few black oak trees overshadow the path, their broad trunks obscuring the rocky shore beyond.  A couple of red-tiled roofs peek through the leafy branches.

The cool, refreshing scent of the river to the south is strong here, its natural odor carried along by a light breeze.  A few black oak trees overshadow the path, their broad trunks obscuring the rocky, moonlit shore beyond.  A couple of red-tiled roofs peek through the leafy branches.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: The cobbled path winds its way amongst a backdrop of flourishing gardens and lush vegetation.  Light yellow sandalwood has been carved into intricate latticework, allowing slender, leaf-tipped vines to reach toward the glimmering sun.  Delicate pink and bright yellow petals bloom from the tendrils, providing brilliant decoration for the wooden frames.

The cobbled path winds its way amongst a backdrop of flourishing gardens and lush vegetation.  Pale sandalwood has been carved into intricate latticework, allowing slender, leaf-tipped vines to reach toward the dark heavens overhead.  Delicate buds adorn the tendrils, providing berry-like decoration for the wooden frames.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: The melodic hum of honeybees drifts through the warm air as each tiny drone flits from blossom to blossom, collecting pollen for the hive.  A few small, golden butterflies accompany the bees, their delicate movements amongst the broad, colorful petals and slender, verdant stalks silent amid the lazy buzz of their counterparts.

The distant lapping sound of the river drifts through the cool night air as a collection of glowing fireflies hovers over a series of flower gardens.  The high-pitched music of crickets, as well as the low croaking voices of a hidden chorus of bullfrogs, accompanies the slow dance of the tiny glimmering insects.

title: [Marble Springs, Shrine]
description: Surrounded by a semicircle of multi-hued alabaster tiles, a small shrine rests beneath the protective boughs of an old black oak.  At the center of the shrine, mottled by the shadows of the overhanging branches, sits a solid block of silver-laced white marble, its top hewn to create a shallow bowl-like depression.  A mat of woven river reeds lies in front of the marble block.

title: [Marble Springs, Chimes]
description: A few scattered black oaks border the cobbled path, their short trunks and slight branches indicative of younger trees.  Underneath the speckled shade of their leafy boughs, wind chimes made from hollow river reeds sing in cascading voices.

A few scattered black oaks border the cobbled path, their short trunks and slight branches indicative of younger trees.  Underneath the dim moonlight shadowed by their leafy boughs, wind chimes made from hollow river reeds sing in cascading voices.

title: [Marble Springs, Cobbled Path]
description: The scent of the river, cool and refreshing, floats on the breeze like a gentle whisper.  Somewhere nearby, the soothing sound of wind chimes dances in the air, the light notes reminiscent of the laughter of children.  A stone flowerbed, set atop a squat pedestal, overflows with yellow loosestrife blooms.

Somewhere nearby, the soothing sound of wind chimes dances in the air, the light notes reminiscent of the laughter of children.  A stone flowerbed, set atop a squat pedestal, overflows with pale loosestrife blooms.

title: [Vonder's Archery Supply]
description: A newly polished mahogany counter spans the length of the room, completely dividing the room in half.  Several unfinished bows hang from a rack situated behind the counter, along with several displays holding various types of archery supplies.

title: [Vonder's Fletching Supply]
description: This well lit chamber holds a variety of fletching supplies.  Stacked bins positioned against the back wall contain vials of paint in all different colors as well as thin paint sticks.  Beside the bins are several barrels of trimmed fletchings in a variety of hues.

title: [Elantaran's Magic Supply]
[Ta'Vaalor, Magical Supply]
description: An eclectic mix of glassware fills a pair of long tables.  Beakers, tubes and dishes make up most of the glassware.  Each table is supported by four legs carved to resemble rampant dragons.  A stunningly carved rolltop desk made from beautiful mahogany rests in one corner.  Quills, scrolls and one overly large bottle of black ink reside on the desktop.  A beautifully crafted scroll case towers over the desk, its many slots for scrolls mostly occupied now by a number of tomes.

title: [Elantaran's Magic, Consignment]
description: Filled with many miscellaneous, alchemic products, storage bins are neatly organized throughout the room.  An orb-chased candle chandelier hangs from above, offering a source of illumination.  Two shop attendants wander about, taking inventory and keeping a watchful eye.

title: [Elantaran's Magic, Used Goods]
description: A hand-carved yew table is centered among the walls enclosing the area.   Light floods in from the chandelier to the south, offering a conglomeration of dancing shadows and light.

title: [The Ta'Vaalor Weaponry]
description: The aromatic scent of oil and leather fills the air.  Trimmed with faenor metal, a well-crafted solid oak counter dominates the length of this shop.  Skillfully wrought and forged from rare, exotic material and hanging from metal supports in the walls is an assemblage of various weapons of war.  They have been artfully arranged in geometric patterns.  A black-inked sign is directly above an executioner's axe, which is leaning in the corner behind the counter.

title: [Annatto Rations Shop]
description: A long counter, manned by a flour-dusted young elf, runs the length of the room, displaying the various rations for sale.  Savory smells of roasting meat, baking bread and pungent spices drift from behind a set of swinging doors in the back wall.  Occasionally, the dark, rich scent of chocolate wafts in from the kitchen, but there are no chocolates laid out on the display counter.

title: [Hall of the Arkati, Entry]
description: Fluted white marble columns hold up a high-arched, plastered ceiling.  Exquisite frescoes are painted across the expanse of plaster, reflecting the night sky of Elanith with her myriad moons and constellations.  Several mithglin lanterns line the edges of the rooms, each containing a small white votive that sheds just enough light to illuminate the artwork.

title: [Hall of the Arkati, Altar]
description: Golden light filters into the chamber from a diamond-paned glaesine skylight high above.  Raw silk carpets cover the floor and the pale undecorated walls have the smooth ivory gleam of aged lime plaster.  A carved haon altar sits upon a small dais.  Atop the altar, a lone white candle burns steadily.

Silvery moonlight filters into the chamber from a diamond-paned glaesine skylight high above.  Raw silk carpets cover the floor and the pale undecorated walls have the smooth ivory gleam of aged lime plaster.  A carved haon altar sits upon a small dais.  Atop the altar, a lone white candle burns steadily.

title: [Hall of the Arkati, Hallway]
description: A pale green and gold Loenthran runner carpets the narrow hallway from end to end.  Glaesine sconces line the wall at regular intervals, their candles snuffed for the day.  A glaes-paned door leads out into a small courtyard, barely visible through the cloudy diamond-shaped panes.

A pale green and gold Loenthran runner carpets the narrow hallway from end to end.  Glaesine sconces line the wall at regular intervals, their candles burning with an amber glow.  A glaes-paned door leads out into a small courtyard, barely visible through the cloudy diamond-shaped panes.

title: [Clentaran's Clerical Supply]
description: The golden statue of a stately drake dominates the room.  Crouched on all fours, the drake's long neck curves like a wave to leave the beast's head looking down over the room.  Elaborately formed candlestick holders rise up to each side of the drake's head, their candles burning near the eyes.  A tall counter runs the length of the room opposite the statue.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Garden of Ancients]
description: Delicately formed stargazer lilies proudly wave their pink blossoms above beds filled with creeping thyme, fragrant rosemary, sweet buttercups, and pale lavender verbena.  A nearby birdbath provides the musical accompaniment of trickling water, as the statue in the bath's bowl pours a bubbling stream into the basin.

A nearby birdbath provides the musical accompaniment of trickling water, as the statue in the bath's bowl pours a bubbling stream into the basin.  A shady path leads back to the wey, while a large moss covered gate grants access to a quiet meadow beyond.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Garden of Ancients]
description: A small niche has been carved into the high city wall, providing a resting place for a small statue of an elven woman.  Thick ferns cluster about the foot of the wall and the bases of the nearby trees.  A small stone bench provides a resting place for quiet contemplation.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Garden of Ancients]
description: Tall maoral trees surround this tiny clearing, providing cool leafy shade above a carpet of thick grass.  Flowering bushes gather close around the bases of the trees.  Clinging to the high stone wall that forms the city's defenses, thick white jasmine vines climb the weathered stones to well over the height of even the tallest elves.

Tall maoral trees surround this tiny clearing, moonlight filtering through their branches to fall across a carpet of thick grass.  Flowering bushes gather close around the bases of the trees.  Clinging to the high stone wall that forms the city's defenses, thick white jasmine vines climb the weathered stones to well over the height of even the tallest elves.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: Rows of neatly-trimmed hedges line the walkway leading toward an ivory-walled building to the east, while a smaller domed structure is visible to the north.  Oak trees stretch their gnarled limbs across the sky, their large boughs filled with a healthy collection of verdant leaves.  Carved wooden benches beneath the trees bear ornate, looping designs across their richly-stained surfaces, and the buzz of daily life filters in faintly from beyond the courtyard.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: Thin columns of ivory form a circular design around the golden domed building situated in the northern end of the courtyard, the metal gleaming in the sunlight.  Pale white cobblestones lead toward the shallow steps of the low structure.  Vines are twined around the large iron gates enclosing the area, the verdant growths blocking all but the tallest buildings of the city from view.

Thin columns of ivory form a circular design around the golden domed building situated in the northern end of the courtyard, the metal cast in a dim illumination from the moons.  Pale white cobblestones lead toward the shallow steps of the low structure.  Vines are twined around the large iron gates enclosing the area, the verdant growths blocking all but the tallest buildings of the city from view.

title: [Tmareantha's Jewels]
description: Amber spidersilk curtains waft gently in the stir of air drifting in through the open windows.  Glittering droplets of ruby-hued glaesine hanging from the arms of a chandelier cast small rays of crimson light across the spacious shop.  Various display cases show off both simple and ostentatious jewelry pieces to their best advantage.  A faenor-edged mithglin counter stands along the rear wall of the shop.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Antique Goods]
[Ta'Vaalor, Secondhand Wares]
description: Beautiful gold sconces adorn both sides of the doorway in this quaint little shop.  A frosted glass cabinet, resting in the center of the royal-blue carpeting, holds an assortment of beautiful glass figurines.  An elegant emerald-green tapestry with gold stitching covers the wall above the fireplace.  Emptied of its cargo, a fair-sized gold chest lies on its side.  Its contents have been strewn haphazardly on the floor behind the counter.

An overwhelming stench of smoke fills the shop.  The remains of a a frosted-glass cabinet stand in the center of the room, the contents broken into piles of colorful glass dust.  The pawnbroker stands behind a makeshift counter of two crates and a scorched length of floor planking, trying desperately to pretend that everything is perfectly normal.

The stone walls are clean, but bare, and a simple woven wool carpet covers the wooden floor planks.  The pawnbroker stands behind a long counter, rows of tall shelves stretching behind him laden with a broad assortment of weapons, armor, potions, and trinkets, each meticulously labeled and catalogued.  A small trashcan stands against a side wall.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Antique Goods]
[Ta'Vaalor, Secondhand Wares]
description: A polished brass chandelier brightens the room, the flame from its solid white candles reflecting off of several antique mirrors that hang on the walls.  Velvet draped tables display a wide variety of treasures, from arcane trinkets to fine quality armor and weapons.

The formerly ornate room has been reduced to a burned-out husk of its former self.  The ceiling has partially collapsed, causing the scorched brass chandelier to list dangerously to one side.  Four scratched wooden tables have been set up for the shop's wares, displaying a wide variety of treasures, from arcane trinkets to fine quality armor and weapons.

Four tables loaded with a variety of treasures, from arcane trinkets to fine quality armor and weapons, form the centerpiece of this room.  A large crimson and gold-threaded rug covers the wooden planks of the floor, and a sales clerk stands crisply at attention, a watchful eye on his merchandise.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Mistydeep River Dock]
description: The darkness of the Mistydeep swirls about the docks, the nearly black water impenetrable to the eye.  Several pleasure boats bob atop the gentle waves created by passing watercraft, bumping the padded edges of the dock.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Hall of Justice]
description: A thick iron chandelier hangs from the wide-beamed ceiling, casting flickering light across the stone walls and ivory-veined black marble floors of the Hall.  Several plain ironwork sconces line a flight of steps leading upwards into the shadows.

title: [Hall of Justice, Courtroom]
description: The deep red and glimmering gold banners of House Vaalor hang unmoving from the thick wooden beams of the courtroom's high ceiling.  Ironwork sconces line the walls, casting an amber light across the polished black marble floors and dark stained thanot panelling.

title: [Malwith Inn, Entry]
description: Fine woodwork fills the grand entryway.  A large braided rug covers most of the wood floor.  Wood support beams along the ceiling are carved with various depictions of drakes in flight.  Lanterns hang from thick iron hooks attached to the beams.  To the north a grand desk can be seen.

title: [Malwith Inn, Front Desk]
description: A large desk surrounds a small office area.  Books, scrolls and other odds and ends litter a table behind the desk.  A grand staircase leads up to the second floor, its railings ending in stylized dragon claws.

title: [Malwith Inn, Bar]
description: A long bar, highly polished, fills one corner of the room.  Leather barstools span the outer length of the bar.  Shelves behind the bar hold a wide array of sparkling glasses and exotic liquors.  Candles atop a pair of brass chandeliers illuminate the room.

title: [Malwith Inn, Buffet]
description: A long buffet table dominates the room.  Various foods are spread along its top, all freshly prepared.  Candles in wall sconces throw their light across the table, while creating flickering shadows elsewhere in the room.

title: [Malwith Inn, Dining Room]
description: A few small tables fill the room, while a string of chandeliers occupy the ceiling above.  Chairs surround the tables, leaving just enough room between tables to allow people to pass between.  An elaborate wood hat and coat stand stands near the entrance.

title: [Malwith Inn, Upper Hallway]
description: Plush carpeting, blood red, fills the hallway from corner to corner.  The ceiling of the room arches high overhead.  Looking eastward, a number of doors can be seen on both sides of the hallway.  A carpeted staircase descends to the room below, mahogany handrails flanking both sides.

title: [Malwith Inn, Balcony]
description: The city seems to fan out from the balcony.  Elaborately turned posts support the short railing around the balcony.  A potted fern hangs from an iron hook attached to the inn wall.

The city seems to fan out from the balcony.  Elaborately turned posts support the short railing around the balcony.  A potted fern hangs from an iron hook attached to the inn wall.  Moonlight bathes the balcony in a pale glow.

title: [Malwith Inn, Hallway]
description: Crystal lanterns, filled with a pale red oil, illuminate the room with a golden glow.  A tall, mahogany door with a brass doorknob dominates the northern wall.  An identical twin made from pine occupies the southern wall.  A silver plaque, centered perfectly, adorns each door.

title: [Malwith Inn, Hallway]
description: The hallway ends before a pair of large double doors.  The doors are elegantly carved from wondrous haon.  A brass door handle adorns each door.  A gold plaque is attached to the wall just above the doors.

title: [Malwith Inn, Balcony]
description: Just a few square feet in area, the balcony provides a spectacular view of the city.  Ivy engulfs the semicircle of railing around the balcony, its vibrant green color contrasting with the darkly stained wood.  Looking to the inn's roof, the drake-shaped weather vane can be seen, slightly squeaking with each breeze.

Looking to the inn's roof, the drake-shaped weather vane can be seen, slightly squeaking with each breeze.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Forging Supply Shop]
description: Located snugly behind the armory, the area is secluded enough to cause minimal disturbance.  A set of wooden stairs leads up to a raised platform, adorned with decorative banners and display cases.  A brilliant cloth banner hangs from the counter, bearing the crest of Vaalor.  A stone walkway leads back around to the thoroughfare.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Ambra's Musicalities]
[Ambra's Musicalities]
description: Pale amber spidersilk curtains frame a row of diamond-shaped windows.  In front of each window stands a uniformed mannequin, jauntily sporting the crimson and gold of the Vaalor military.  The mannequins stand at attention, each clutching a different musical instrument between its fingers, the overall effect resembling a drill band lined up for a parade.  The merchant Ambra stands behind a long thanot counter edged in mithglin, on top of which is a small sign.

Pale amber spidersilk curtains frame several glaesine paned windows.  Each diamond-shaped pane is fashioned of a different colored piece of glaes, and the resulting cascade of hues glimmers across the various instruments displayed on the shop's carved haon shelves.  A long thanot counter edged in mithglin rests along one wall.

title: [Saphrie's Herbs and Tinctures]
[Ta'Vaalor, Triage Station]
description: Soft aquamarine curtains frame the glaesine-paned windows of the herb shop.  Whitewashed haon shelves line the walls, each shelf carefully stocked with a variety of glaes bottles.  A long monir counter, well worn and apparently used as a worktable, rests in the center of the shop.

Whitewashed haon shelves line the walls of this room, each shelf carefully stocked with a variety of glaes bottles, bandages, herbs, and other healing supplies.  Elven nurses flow around and behind a long monir counter, well-worn and apparently used as a worktable, that rests in the center of the room.  An open doorway to the west leads to the infirmary, and a black-inked sign rests upon the far wall.

title: [Saphrie's Herbs and Tinctures]
[Ta'Vaalor, Triage Station]
description: Sturdy wooden cots line the walls of this narrow room, each covered with pristine white linens.  High shelves loaded with herbs and bandages are mounted on the whitewashed walls above the cots.  A gentle breeze, redolent with the fragrance of acantha and blaeston, stirs the gauzy curtains framing the open windows.

Elven nurses bustle quietly about the room, tending to the ill and injured that lie on the sturdy wooden cots that line the walls of this narrow room.  The faintly herbal scents of acantha and blaeston linger in the air, and high shelves loaded with herbs and bandages are mounted on the whitewashed walls.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Entry]
description: Gracious and welcoming, this well-appointed foyer is floored in a buttery cream marble, which is subtly veined with smoky grey.  Blue glaesine windows are set into the walls at wide intervals, allowing a small bit of sunlight into the room.  The main source of illumination is an elaborate silver chandelier hanging far above, suspended from the high, arched ceiling.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Front Desk]
description: Hand-knotted throw rugs in vibrant jewel tones adorn the polished white marble floor.  In sharp contrast with the pale floor, a massive dark walnut desk dominates the room.  Its blunt shape is softened by baskets of bright lilies, snapdragons and petunias placed strategically in corners and around the front edge of the desk.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Blending smoothly with the creamy marble of the entryway floor, the grey-veined marble continues into the center of this winding hallway, flanked on each side with pale oak floorboards.  Rose scented oil burns in a carefully suspended sconce, casting a warm glow over a walnut sideboard.  Resting atop the sideboard, a shallow cut glaes bowl contains an artistic arrangement of floating candles and rose blossoms.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: The marble in this section of the long hallway features a gradual change in color from cream to pure white as the veining melds from grey to silver.  Some candle-lit glaes globes mounted in concentric circles illuminate the passage.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: The pale marble and oak flooring in this section of the hallway is nearly obscured by an enormous crimson runner.  Stylized flames picked out in gold and red-tinged vaalin threads occupy the center of the carpeting.  An arch formed of ash-grey marble at the base blends into a deep red marble crazed with finger-like grey veins as it rises to a peak.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: The striking white-and-red marble flooring here is complemented by several thick rugs, predominately the hue of red sandstone, woven in a geometric pattern of seashells.  The hallway is lit by graceful seashell lamps that glow unwaveringly.  A single bright shaft of sunlight from one of the blue glaesine windows falls directly on a carved basalt arch piercing the eastern wall.

The hallway is lit by graceful seashell lamps that glow unwaveringly. title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: This section of hallway is fitted with richly-veined marble and oak floors that complement the polished oak wainscotting.  Pale shafts of sunlight pass through the deep blue glaesine windows, casting this space in an otherworldly hue.  A plain granite arch has the beginnings of some carvings near the floor, but it appears that the stonemasons stopped work soon after beginning.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Mullioned glaes windows allow shards of sunlight to enter this corner of the hallway.  Chips of moonstone and quartz imbedded in the walls catch and reflect the light, giving the appearance of stars.  The primary sources of illumination are four spheres suspended from the ceiling, lit from within.  By their colors and size, it is likely that they are meant to represent the moons Liabo, Lornon, Tilaok and Makiri.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Silvery water pours down one side of the hallway, over striated stones set into glaes.  The water trickling and tumbling sends a light mist to coat this section of the hallway, as the restful sound echoes down the passage.  At the base of the wall a shallow willow basin catches the water, which is then somehow transported to the top to begin its fall again.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: A perfectly symmetrical circle of eight candles, each contained by a blue-violet glaes bowl, dominates one white limestone wall.  Within the circle of candles, two crossed mithglin longswords are mounted against the wall.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Elaborate iron censers hang from the ceiling, casting a ruddy, dim glow over this portion of the hallway.  The pale marble farther down the hallway gives way here to immense black marble blocks flecked with silver.  Nearly hidden in the shadows, a chipped obsidian archway features a single silvery moonstone set into the apex of the curve.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Cream white marble flooring and polished white oak walls present a classic contrast to the burnished gold arches spanning the passageway at regular intervals.  A narrower arch is set into the side of the hallway, the sides formed of gold posts capped with finials ending in polished blazestar spheres.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Two massive tower shields are mounted, one on each of the outside walls, at this corner junction.  Standing in the corner, an elegant glaes cabinet stretches from floor to ceiling and encloses an immense flamberge.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Oily, deep green vines, some nearly black, have overtaken the walls of the corridor, making it more of a jungle than a hallway.  Originally planted in large tubs along each side of the passage, the vines have grown together over the ceiling, making them impossible to remove without destroying the plants entirely.  Wickedly barbed, tendril-like feelers reach from the sides of the hallway across the pale marble flooring.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: A profusion of plants grace this portion of the corridor, giving it a garden-like air.  Broad-leafed calla lilies send violet, maroon and milky-white blooms to nod towards the center of the passage, while vinca, petunias and snapdragons add bursts of color at floor level.  Hanging from the ceiling are several small bunches of white-blossomed flowers.  A white painted trellis archway stands to one side of the hall, enveloped almost entirely by tangerine colored climbing roses.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Stained glaes windows, ranging in color from pale blue to a deep navy occupy the outside walls at this turn in the hall.  The windows admit a minimal amount of sunlight that washes coldly over the white walls and silver-veined cream marble floor.  Carefully cultivated iceblossoms reside in several glaesine pots in the corner and to either side of the silver arch.

Stained glaes windows, ranging in color from pale blue to a deep navy occupy the outside walls at this turn in the hall.  The windows admit a minimal amount of moonlight that washes coldly over the white walls and silver-veined cream marble floor.  Carefully cultivated iceblossoms reside in several glaesine pots in the corner and to either side of the silver arch.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Pale, nearly colorless walls and floors serve to make a brilliantly colored tapestry the focal point of this section of corridor.  Hanging from a white oak rod finished with elaborately carved finials, the tapestry depicts a wyvern, its tail curling and re-curling around itself.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Ground flecks of white quartz have been mixed into the limestone whitewashing used on the walls in this section of the hallway.  Chips of dragonseye sapphire have been set into the walls at various points.  The sapphire and quartz cause the walls to reflect tiny pinpoints of brilliance in the light cast by several hanging lanterns, giving the impression of a firmament of stars.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: Mounted against one wall, a glaes case encloses a bizarrely twisted and knotted mistwood staff.  The glaes container appears to have been constructed as part of the original building, as there are no apparent seams or hinges that suggest the case is able to open.  A rough arch, formed of rare pieces of polished mistwood, jointed with shimmartine-studded imflass, stands opposite the case.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Hallway]
description: A veritable armory's worth of weapons have been mounted on the walls, the metal polished to a high gleam.  Blued steel flamberges are mounted next to invar claidhmores, interspersed with smaller weapons such as dirks and fist-scythes.  All the weapons are centered around a vaalorn plaque.  A simple limestone arch is bordered on each side by an upright pike.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Bar]
description: Darkly paneled walls, composed of rich cherry wood and black walnut arranged in a herringbone pattern, enclose this large lounge.  The paneling on the walls is echoed in the marquetry floor.  Several comfortably upholstered wing chairs are arranged around small tables throughout the room and several brass and black leather bar stools are drawn up before a glossy cherry wood bar that stretches the length of one wall.

title: [Bastille, Entrance Hall]
[Stockade, Entrance Hall]
description: Not quite the grim welcome a prisoner might expect at the doorway to incarceration, vivid red and gold banners hang from the surrounding stone walls.  Casting candlelight down from its midst, a wrought iron chandelier hovers overhead, suspended from the high beams of the ceiling.  Several guards pass by, their footsteps clattering harshly on the dark fel wood flooring.  Set into the eastern wall, several barred windows peer out at the city.

Casting candlelight down from its many curved arms, a wrought iron chandelier hovers overhead, suspended from the high beams of the ceiling.  Several guards pass by, their footsteps clattering harshly on the dark fel wood flooring.  Set into the eastern wall, several barred windows peer out at the city.

title: [Bastille, Central Hall]
[Stockade, Central Hall]
description: The windowless stone walls here are bare of all decoration, save for a portrait on the eastern wall.  Dangling from the chandelier, a large House Vaalor crest announces the keep's affiliation.  Torches set in the walls burn busily, lending light to an otherwise lackluster environment.  Heavy oak doors garnish the northern end of the area.  To the west, an open iron doorway leads to a dim passageway.

title: [Stockade, Cell Corridor]
[Bastille, Cell Corridor]
description: In an abrupt departure from the elegance of the public areas of the bastille visible through the iron doorway to the east, bare stone floors run the length of this hallway.  Bright torches are set in the walls between the cell doors, shedding light through the heavy bars.  Lightly blowing through the hallway, a faint breeze carries the aroma of sweat on its tail.

title: [Stockade, Cell Corridor]
[Bastille, Cell Corridor]
description: Burning staunchly, torches light the hard stone floor and walls.  The stink of sweat clouds the hallway, though its origin is unidentified.  Drifting in from further down the hallway, a quick breeze lightly kisses the air, doing little to blow the heavy stench away.  A set of shackles hangs from a hook on the wall next to a door that, unlike the other barred doors lining the hallway, is constructed solely from solid wood.

title: [Stockade, Cell Corridor]
[Bastille, Cell Corridor]
description: The hallway ends abruptly, with barred cell doors on two sides.  The air would smell almost clean, reminiscent of the city outside the prison, were it not for the stench pouring out of one cell.  A wooden chair rests in one corner, the abandoned seat of an absent guard.

title: [Helgreth's Tavern, Taproom]
description: Boisterous laughter erupts often from the congregation of imbibing patrons seated at Helgreth's tables.  A scattering of flickering beeswax candles glimmer off the numerous brass fixtures and pristine inverted glassware suspended above the polished bar.  In their starched uniforms, off-duty military officers traverse the tumult of the taproom as they come and go from a plush sanguine velvet curtain marked by a heraldic Vaalorian buckler overhead.

title: [Helgreth's Tavern, Second Floor]
description: Most of the central area of this spacious room has been cordoned off, leaving a comfortable walkway around its perimeter, replete with padded leather benches and stools.  A trio of burnished chandeliers remain unlit as sunlight streams in through cut-glass windows from all four sides, illuminating the highly detailed, miniaturized terrain of the City-States laid out upon the floor.  A small alcove branches off from the main chamber to the north.  Several wooden cases line the walls, their glass fronts revealing tiny figures within.

title: [Helgreth's Tavern, Alcove]
description: For those patrons desiring a game, a dart board in red, black, and gold accents hangs prominently upon the wall in the alcove.  A lacquered cherrywood bureau complete with silver tray serves as a temporary resting place for players' beverages while they test their skills against each other.

title: [Samyrle's Salon, Foyer]
description: Gilded molding, brilliant with black-flecked gold, outlines the doorway and front windows of this elegant little shop.  Ebonwood walls polished to a magnificent sheen are inset with panels of striated white marble.  Faenor sconces shaped like scallop shells curve slightly outward, and flicker with a warm light, the fragrance of their gardenia-scented oil filling the air.  Wide marble stairs lead up to the second floor, gold wrought-vine railings on either side.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, out

title: [Samyrle's Salon, Men's Wear]
description: A large glaes bay window hides behind sheer gold-threaded ivory voile curtains, giving discriminating shoppers a modicum of privacy as they look over the displayed wares.  Suspended by thin gold chains in the center of the window, an ebonwood sign has been painted with the name of the shop on both sides.

title: [Samyrle's Salon, Women's Wear]
description: Dominating this side of the room is a large glaes bay window hung with sheer gold-threaded ivory voile curtains, pulled back to the wall with a black silk tassel.  A window seat with a tufted cushion awaits weary shoppers, affording them a prime view of the busy street.

title: [Samyrle's Salon, Second Floor]
description: At the top of the stairs, you face a wall of ebonwood that leads off to rooms at the left and right.  Scallop shell sconces continue to serve as illumination sources here, although the windows and open doorway from the main floor below keep the upper part of the shop well lit.

title: [Samyrle's Salon, Outer Wear]
description: Mirrors line the ebonwood wall, giving the room a multi-dimensional effect, perfect for examining all angles of the various wares for sale here.  A narrow double door lies open and leads out onto a small balcony.

title: [Samyrle's Salon, Balcony]
description: Wrought iron railings coated with gilt resemble a diagonal weave of ivy, surrounding this small balcony overlooking the street.  A small trellis along the sides supports the tendrils from pots of bright violet flowering clematis.  Small cafe chairs and tables have been placed here for those wishing to rest a bit and enjoy some tea.

title: [Samyrle's Salon, Accessories]
description: White marble walls flecked with gold keep this small room bright, as does a central chandelier of clear glaes set with ivory candles.  The soft light reflects a flicker of rainbow refractions from the glaes prisms and an occasional breeze creates a soft chime as crystals touch.

title: [Locksmith]
[Ta'Vaalor, Locksmith]
description: The wooden walls are bare except for unfinished shelves adorned with locks and lockpicks.  A frayed red carpet covers the center of the room, leaving the bare wooden slats exposed around the border of the floor.  The walls and floor of the building creak and groan as patrons move about the store.

The wall behind the counter is lined with an extensive array of meticulously labeled cubbyholes, each organized to hold specific types of locks, lock components, and lockpicks.  The locksmith, Shind, works behind counter, his spectacles perched on the tip of his nose.  To the left of the counter, a small sign has been tacked to the wall, under which is a stained oak barrel that serves as a trash bin.

title: [Theatre Andaire, Foyer]
description: Thick Loenthran carpets in rich shades of garnet, sapphire and amber cover the theatre's stone floors, effectively muffling the sound of footfalls.  The granite walls are hung with tapestries depicting mummers, bards and other players in various scenes both comedic and dramatic.  Wall sconces of delicately wrought iron hold glimmering amber glaesine spheres, each containing beeswax candles whose brightly burning wicks cast a golden glow across the room.

title: [Theatre Andaire, Lounge]
description: A large divan covered in plush garnet-hued velvet rests along the rear wall of the bar.  To one side, a carved monir bar holds an array of delicate glassware, the faceted glaes sparkling in the light cast from several dimly glowing wall sconces.  An engraved eahnor sign sits upon the bar's polished countertop.

title: [Theatre Andaire]
description: The stage, its underpinnings carved of rich darkly stained maoral, sits recessed into the theatre's back wall.  Thick garnet-hued velvet curtains, trimmed with glimmering golden cords and tassels, hang across the wall, providing a lush backdrop to the stage.  Creatively shuttered glaesine lanterns hanging from the rafters above direct warm golden light at the stage while leaving the seating area in almost complete darkness.

title: [Bard Guild, Entry]
description: Slender oak columns frame this grand entry hall, whose pale granite walls rise the full two stories of the building.  The columns support a second floor gallery, reached by a sweeping staircase and bordered by a heavily carved balustrade from which are hung dozens of banners bearing crests of ancient elven families.  The east and west walls are pierced by tall, lancet-topped leaded glass windows, through which dappled sunlight pours into the hall.

title: [Glimaerseen Moving Company]
description: Pale haon walls set with brightly-trimmed windows make for a light and airy waiting room.  Neatly arranged next to one of the large openings is a sitting area with a view of the street.  Fresh gardenias gently float in a round glaes bowl sitting on a low counter, adding their sweet fragrance to the room.  Towards the back sits a desk with two wire baskets that overflow with paperwork, the only contrast to the otherwise tidy office.

title: [Old Manor, Dark Altar]
description: Three torches are set against the north wall in iron sconces crafted as skeletal hands.  The reddish glow dances off of the sculptures set in each corner.  Four black glaes drakes stand upright, wings spread, their claws thrust into the ceiling.  The drakes' ruby eyes are fixed on the black ora altar in the center of the room.  It is trimmed with gold flecks, which glow red in the quavering moonlight.

title: [Guardian Keep, Grassy Sward]
description: The tall outer wall on the western side of this grassy courtyard joins up with the massive inner wall of the keep.  The presence of militia can be seen wandering around between the many tents and kiosks that have been set up in this area.

title: [Warehouse Entry]
description: This chamber's high ceilings can easily accommodate a wide array of various sized goods, allowing for easy transportation.  Several merchants scurry about, moving pieces around the warehouse as orders are placed and shipments arrive.

title: [Warehouse, Containers Section]
description: This area of the warehouse contains rows upon rows of various types and styles of shop keeping containers, which have been stacked and labeled as neatly as possible for easy transportation.  Many busy workers can be seen transporting goods of different sizes and quantities around the warehouse.

title: [Warehouse, Walls Section]
description: The sweet, dry fragrance of freshly cut wood permeates the air in this spacious area, combining comfortably with the smell of the various oils used to protect and waterproof different types of wood.  Spread across the floor and proudly propped against specialized standing racks are sections of interlocking wall samples that can be found in the many shops in this area.

title: [Warehouse, Roofing Section]
description: This enormous warehouse contains rows upon rows of various types and styles of shop keeping paraphernalia which has been stacked and labeled as neatly as possible.  Various types of roofing materials resting in the nearby shelves and crates for easy distribution to the local merchants in the area.

title: [Warehouse, Ceilings Section]
description: The expansive area of this section of the warehouse is filled with stacks of different colored shop ceilings of unknown quantity and styles.  Several warehouse workers scurry about moving the stacks of ceiling pieces in and out of the area, as orders are placed and new shipments arrive.

title: [Warehouse, Wall Displays]
description: This moderately sized area of the warehouse is crammed full of odds and ends.  Stacks of shop displays meant for mounting on walls can be seen overflowing from the racks and containers that litter every corner of this section.

title: [Warehouse, Flooring Section]
description: Spread across this area of the warehouse, a diverse selection of wooden floorboards awaits inspection before being purchased by local shop owners.  Warehouse inspectors drift through the area checking and rechecking the quality of the different flooring materials before allowing them to be shipped and installed into the local shops in the city.

title: [Warehouse, Floor Displays]
description: This area of the warehouse is small and cramped compared to the rest of the large building.  Stacks of shop oddities fill the many racks around the room and piles of different types of shopping accessories have been neatly stacked in the corners, providing easy access to everything by various warehouse workers.

title: [Warehouse, Lot'O'Signs]
description: This section of the warehouse is taken up by twin double racks of various types of shop signs, crated and ready for transportation out of the warehouse.  Several local workers can be seen restocking shop materials off to the west.

title: [Warehouse, Shop Facades]
description: Large displays of shops in different stages of construction can be seen here taking up the majority of this enormous section of the warehouse with enough space for buyers and warehouse workers to move about freely.  A series of crates and large boxes have been neatly stacked and laid out to maximize the available open space in the center of the room.

title: [Permit Office]
description: The office here is small and cramped compared to the rest of the warehouse, filled with neatly stacked piles of returned merchandise that have been pushed up against the walls.  A sturdy oak desk overflows with documents related to the inventory of the items in the warehouse and stacks of different shop permits.

title: [Catacombs, Temple]
description: Oddly colored stone pillars, which are really stones stacked atop each other, look ready to topple over and crush anyone foolish enough to venture too close.  In the center of the pillars rests an empty raised dais.  Directly behind the dais, strange and indecipherable markings mar the surface of the wall.  Closer inspection reveals that blood covers all surfaces in this chamber.

description: The stone walls are smooth and covered with faint, yet meticulously-detailed wards that periodically shimmer with pale silver light. The very air crackles with a powerful energy, as the occasional spark of lightning dances harmlessly across the high-domed ceiling.

Overhead, a view of the night sky is visible through the missing roof, and a few small bird nests lie ensconced in the upper corners of the badly weathered walls.  A rusted iron chain dangles from a fastener on one wall, its corroded links squealing as it sways back and forth in the slight breeze.

A sour odor emanates from the hole, which seems to lead down into a hollow area beneath the structure.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Raised above the level of the underbrush and banked to provide for drainage after storms, the road provides a safe and comfortable journey through the forest.  Constant maintenance keeps the road clear of leaves and twigs, and the acorns that pose an even more serious danger to the cobblestone pavement.  At either side of the road, small clumps of young oaks grow out of refuse piles left by the road-clearing crews.

title: [Neartofar Road]

A horde of midge larvae and various other infaunas slither and bump along the surface of the mud.

title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]

From time to time, an air bubble breaks the surface.  Apparently, the pool is home for some unknown creatures.

title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]
description: A cyclopean red mangrove stands in the center of several clusters of various shrubs and trees, under the starry sky.  A gentle breeze softly stirs the dark, waxy leaves. Clearly, the thorns would easily rend the flesh of anyone who was desperate enough to try to crawl through the opening.

title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]
description: A gap in the trees and shrubs reveals a partially concealed trail, which makes it possible to venture closer to the ancient red mangrove.  From this angle, there is a better view of the twisted and gnarled roots, which still appear to be in search of food.  The grisly remains of at least three corpses entangled in some roots are now clearly visible.  One of the roots is still wrapped, though now loosely, around the throat of one of its victims.

title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]
description: Moss-draped cypress trees crowd a tiny island.  Under the glow of the full moon, a capsized and warped dory can be seen near the island. A family of beavers has made a home for themselves in a dead and fallen tree nearby the rotting remains of the dory.

title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]
description: Scores of long-legged water striders send minute ripples over the muddy water as they quickly traverse its surface and disappear around a stand of trees. For all the world, the thin branches appear to be trying to cover the hollowed out bough, which creates an unsettling impression that the tree is silently screaming.

title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]
description: The flapping wings of bats accompanied by their cries, a high-pitched metallic ping, fill the night air.  Mid-sized knolls rise up from the low-lying, sodden ground.  While hopping from one to another makes travel decidedly slower, they do offer some relief from treading through the muddy soil.  The tangle of tree roots, shrubs and plants provide the perfect home for a variety of birds and animals.

title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]
description: Moist, soft grass blankets most of the ground in this portion of the swamp, and seemingly dry sand devoid of any visible signs of life covers the rest. Unseen, but clearly heard, yellow throats call out to one another, and a small nest is located at the base of a stunted, unidentified bush.

title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]
description: Moonlight shines through the heavy fog that blankets the ground, making it appear as if the fog itself glows with an inner white light. title: [The Toadwort, Grasping Mire]
description: Lush water hemlocks mingle with wood nettles, completely covering the sodden ground underfoot.  White clusters of tiny flowers occupy the tops of the tall stalks on the water hemlocks. If one barb pricks flesh, it releases a deadly acid into its victim's bloodstream.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: A wicked stench permeates the air and the soil becomes moist and sticky with an unknown blackish substance.  The entire structure of the landscape changes dramatically.  Huge boulders are partially embedded in the soil, and most are completely covered with the same thick, blackish muck that also covers the ground.  It is almost as if the ground itself has birthed the stones.  A skull, a pile of bones and what appear to be teeth lie in a small ditch.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: In this section of the swamp, the malodorous fragrance grows increasingly stronger.  Lofty, yellow grass with bearded heads bows slightly under a strong gust of foul wind, sending tiny grains sailing through the air.  Shadows flicker across a ramshackle little shed as the breeze stirs the branches of deformed trees, which surround it.  A pile of bones that are slowly turning to dust rests beside a deep pit that is a few steps away from the shed.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]

From the distance, a loud crash and the sound of splashing water is heard.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]

Moonlight illuminates the surface of the water and reveals an abundance of featherfoils.  Dark pink petals that have fallen from the canes of a swamp rose bush, littering the surface of the water.

Littering the surface of the water are dark pink petals that have fallen from the canes of a swamp rose bush.  Low-growing creeping plants dominate a dead tree as it twines itself up the length of the trunk.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: Patches of tri-colored lady-slippers cluster around the bases of buttonwood trees.  Approximately one half of an inch from the sodden ground, the sagging royal blue, white and blood-red pouches of the flowers flutter softly, caressed by the gentlest of breezes.  Two trees have twisted themselves around each other and a thick mat of creeping dogwood has covered their roots.  The gnarly boles of the trees are covered with slimy, bluish mold.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: Dense thickets of swamp roses border the bayou, and a thick covering of pale green duckweed covers the surface of the water.  A lush blanket of decumbent shrubbery covers the standing water as well as the ground in this section of the swamp.  Whorls of pointed oval leaves sprinkled with white flowers and bright red berries along the stems of the shrubs are barely noticeable under the starless night sky.

Whorls of pointed oval leaves are sprinkled with white flowers and bright red berries along the stems of the shrubs.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: A massive tree dominates the center of an overflowing bourn.  Rising above and scattered throughout the water are the knees of the trees, some of which resemble frogs and other odd shapes.  The eviscerated remains of a large animal lie on the broad surface of one knee.  Dead foliage and fallen branches litter the ground and the smell of long-dead flowers saturates the air.  The soil is a thick, sticky, mixture of mud, rotting flowers and decomposing leaves.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: Boldened by the protection offered under the moonless sky, the mewling of black caimans grows louder from the distance.  Decumbent vines cover the ground like a plush carpet, with their trifoliate leaves and oddly shaped white and green flowers that bear a strong likeness to a hooded figure.  Clusters of star-shaped, pink and purple flowers rise up from the water that is hidden by the vines.

Clusters of star-shaped, pink and purple flowers rise up from the water that is hidden by the vines.  Multicolored funnel-shaped flowers coil upward and wrap themselves around a majority of the trees, giving them the appearance of wearing brightly colored coats.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: Ingrown and disfigured trees line up on both sides of a small gully that is filled with water the consistency of tar.  One tree stands out from the rest, because of the way its arm-like branches seem to be straining in an effort to cover its tormented face.  Deep slash marks are visible in the mud as they crisscross through each other.  Some of the tracks make a beeline straight toward the gully, while others head off into the safety of the trees.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: Standing under the starry sky is a lone stone bier that is splattered with brownish stains.  A shallow ditch contains the remains of several unrecognizable and disarranged corpses.  Covering a good portion of the carcasses is a thick, greenish, bubbling liquid.  A rancid stench rides on the vapors, saturating the night air with utter foulness.

A rancid stench rides on the vapors, saturating the air with utter foulness.  Stationed adjacent a tupelo tree is a long stone bier, which is splattered with brownish stains.

title: [The Toadwort, Fetid Muck]
description: Oval-shaped objects are visible in the black muck that fills a narrow bayou.  Branches from a dwarfed willow tree hang low to the ground.  Their lance-shaped leaves sweeps gently over the land around it, as a chilly wind ruffles them.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: Mutated and wilted swamp buttercups droop listlessly above shallow water.  Fallen leaves and cypress needles litter the ground, almost unnoticed under the dim light of the moon.  A large hole rests near the flared base of a tree that has been split straight down its middle.  At the entrance of the hole, the shredded remains of what may have once been a cloak are visible.

Their distorted waxy leaves, which should be a vibrant yellow, are a dull ruddy shade of brown and are splattered with bluish-green mold.  A large hole rests near the flared base of a tree that has been split straight down its middle.  At the entrance of the hole, the shredded remains of what may have once been a cloak are visible.

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: Purple weeds, which stand tall and sturdy about knee-high to a giantman, blanket the ground.  Swirls of deep green, lance-shaped and serrated leaves, about a foot long themselves, cover thick but hollow purple stems.  Rosy pink, purple and white circular clusters of flowers top the stems.  The purple and cream-colored roots are woody with rough hair-like projections.

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: Smoke rises in thick, choking vines from the depth of a hollow cavity in the ground.  A stench like that of sulfur and burning flesh punishes the air.  A narrow thread of land spirals downward into the pit.  Huge shiny pieces of ore are embedded into its walls and are illuminated by a particularly bright moonbeam.  The ground surrounding the pit is dry and sandy and completely devoid of life.

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: A disheveled skeleton lies in a tangle of roots and vines, and patches of bluish-green mold and mildew are visible on the shredded remains of its clothing.  A gut-wrenching stench seems to be coming from small crevices in the ground that are filled with a greenish, bubbling goop.  Under the light of the moon the goop appears to shimmer.  The air thickens with moisture as dense fog blankets the ground and rises steadily.

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: A thicket of odd-shaped purple flowers stand sentinel over a burrow directly below it.  Tufts of fur cling to the tiny barbs that protrude from the flowers' stems.  Paw prints in the mud lead both to and from the burrow and a gnawed bone lies partially buried not far from its entrance.  Off in the distance, deep guttural growls and snarls are audible.

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: Under a cloudless night sky, a small clearing is visible between some trees.  In the center of the clearing, a circle of stones is filled with charred twigs and leaves.  A makeshift hammock is stretched between two tree trunks and is held in place by some of the cord-like vines.

Thick cord-like vines dangle overhead from various trees and drape down to partially conceal a small clearing.  In the center of the clearing, a circle of stones is filled with charred twigs and leaves.  A makeshift hammock is stretched between two tree trunks and is held in place by some of the cord-like vines.

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: Thick, elongated tufts of bearded grass blanket the floor and tiny granular particles from them float serenely through the air.  Flickering shadows dance across enormous mottled eggs that are resting in a nest of dead grass and leaves.  The bottom of the nest is littered with strange looking triangular seeds that seem ready to burst open and spray their contents over the eggs at any given moment.

Enormous mottled eggs from an unknown creature are resting in a nest of dead grass and leaves at the base of a dead tupelo tree.  The bottom of the nest is littered with strange looking triangular seeds that seem ready to burst open and spray their contents over the eggs at any given moment.  Thick, elongated tufts of bearded grass blanket the floor and tiny granular particles from them float serenely through the air.

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: Clumps of dead grass lie trampled in the mud along a narrow path that leads to a rushing creek of black water.  A fallen, algae-covered tree rests in the creek and hordes of mud whelks are clearly visible as they slowly trek across its trunk.  Along the edge of the creek, scores of tiny crustaceans crawl around in the thick mud.

title: [The Toadwort, Blackened Morass]
description: Disfigured trees have coiled and twisted themselves together and a thick tangle of dark grey roots protrude from the ground, which is covered with dark roiling mud from the overflowing bourn.  Small hillocks provide just a touch of solid ground and offer some relief from treading through the thick mud.  Littering the ground are small rocks and stones that, combined with fallen branches and mud, make this a hazardous area for walking.

title: [Lunule Weald, Slade]
description: Tall swamp reeds grow in thick clumps on either side of the muddy trail.  Clouds of insects assail anything that moves here, buzzing loudly and annoyingly.  The occasional croaking of a frog, deep in the reeds, cuts through the perpetual buzzing of the insects.  Darkness provides little relief from the humidity.
