title: [Plains of Bone, Mound Top]
description: At the top of the stairs the hill flattens, small dark blades of grass cover the hilltop.  A thick mist seems to cling to everything in the area.  A gentle slope to the northeast leads to a ruined structure awash in moonlight.

At the top of the stairs the hill flattens, small dark blades of grass cover the hilltop.  A thick mist seems to cling to everything in the area.  A gentle slope to the northeast leads to a ruined structure.

title: [Plains of Bone, Mound Top]
description: Crowning the mound is the rubble of what once was a tower.  Now the black stone lies broken, with only the entrance and lowest portion of the tower still standing.  A doorway darker than the night leads into the tower.

Crowning the mound is the rubble of what once was a tower.  Now the black stone lies broken, with only the entrance and lowest portion of the tower still standing.  A dark doorway leads into the tower.

title: [Plains of Bone, Ruins]
description: The black stone rubble nearly fills what's left of the tower.  Only a small area near the doorway remains rubble free.  A small break in the rubble overhead allows moonlight to stream in.  Stars can be seen twinkling above through gaps in the rubble.  One of the double doors that forms the entrance to the tower is missing.

title: [Cleric Guild, Stone Path]
description: Irregularly shaped stones pave the short road that leads to an expansive bronze gate.  Delicate tendrils of ivy caress the metal, winding through the pattern of interlocking squares.  Just beyond the gate, a glimpse of tall alabaster columns can be seen through the greenery.

title: [Loreley's Outfitting]
[Loreley's Magic Shoppe]
[Loreley's General Store]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from a buffed cherrywood floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a decorative linden branch wreath, and a paneled haon ceiling completes the picture.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Loreley's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its cherrywood floor.  A decorative linden branch wreath hangs under the haon ceiling.  Right near the front is a long mistwood counter and an elegant silver jewelry rack.

title: [Anghosina's Outfitting]
description: A multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs on one of the patterned white walls, and a paneled haon ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of striped throw pillows sits in one corner of a wide-plank glossy tanik floor.  There is a wicker basket on one side of the shop and an elegantly carved oak armoire on the other.

title: [Anghosina's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a weathered dark birch ceiling, a curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls.  A flexible willow woven basket and a iron-bound ebonwood chest sit in opposite corners while a thick off-white carpet rests on a patterned hardwood floor.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: A large maoral tree lies toppled on the ground to the west, displaying its massive root system.  Thick pieces of dried bark have separated from the trunk of the tree and provide shelter to a family of squirrels.  A break in the canopy overhead allows sunlight to filter into the area.

A large maoral tree lies toppled on the ground to the west, displaying its massive root system.  Thick pieces of dried bark have separated from the trunk of the tree and provide shelter to a family of squirrels.  A break in the canopy overhead allows moonlight to filter into the area.

title: [Elven Enchantment, Magical Hour]
description: A noble elf maiden portrait hangs on one of the patterned white walls, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling rises overhead.  A verdant elderberry bush sits in one corner of a buffed cherrywood floor.  There is a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest on one side of the shop and a large oak table on the other.

title: [Elven Enchantment, By Day]
description: Beneath a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling, a noble elf maiden portrait hangs on one of the plain baby blue walls.  A gold-trimmed ebonwood chest and a large oak table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a patterned hardwood floor.

title: [Eaglesoul's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a weathered dark birch ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain baby blue walls.  A large oak table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the pine floor.

title: [Eaglesoul's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a sturdy white cedar ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A large oak table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the marble floor.

title: [Empath Guild, Forecourt]
description: A small pocket garden borders a low stone wall running along Gaeld Var, its neatly kept beds showcasing richly colored perennials and fragrant herbs.  Sunshine warmly cavorts about the bright green leaves of the ivy which winds about the beds and along the stone wall.  A brick path bisects the garden leading southerly towards a cloister awash in lush green vines.

A small pocket garden borders a low stone wall running along Gaeld Var, its neatly kept beds showcasing richly colored perennials and fragrant herbs.  Starlight streaks the night-dark green leaves of the ivy which winds about the beds and along the stone wall.  A brick path bisects the garden leading southerly towards a night-shadowed cloister wrapped in vines.

title: [Empath Guild, Cloister]
description: Pale green vines, dotted with vivid morning glory blooms, twine up the columns on either side of this wide corridor that defines the north side of a cloister.  Darker vines with large, tightly closed flowers twist about the pale green counterparts, casting occasional shadows.  An intricate mosaic underfoot picks up the theme, with lapis and chalcedony flowers dotted among the variegated malachite leaves.

Vines so green as to be almost black dominate the columns of the cloister, overshadowing paler green counterparts.  Translucent white moonflower blossoms reveal themselves to the moons and stars above, filtering the night's offerings through their iridescent petals to dance upon the mosaic underfoot.

title: [Bard Guild, Gallery]
description: Encircling the the whole of the guildhall entry, this wide gallery is bounded by pale granite walls and a richly carved oak balustrade, which forms an elongated oval flowing up from a sweeping staircase.  Sunlight filtered through tall, lancet-topped leaded glass windows illumines four magnificent paintings, two flanking a pair of wide doors on the south side, and the other two placed symmetrically on the north side, framing a wide archway leading north.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The road rises slightly to the northeast and declines to the south, following the landscape in a slow, lazy arc.  A stream runs along a few yards to the west, paralleling the roadbed and darting around the old, stately pines that drink from its coursing waters.  Here and there a large conifer interrupts the flow, creating a small pool upon which water striders dart about in search of food before they themselves become food for larger, more carnivorous insects.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The path winds down to the northeast and climbs towards denser foliage to the south.  Far to the north you glimpse a ridge rising through the trees, in the dim moonlight.  A feral growl is carried on the wind, sending a chill down your spine.

title: [Larien's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A long mahogany rack and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Small Estate, Hallway]
description: Large bay windows look out upon the dark exterior of the manor, their arched forms shot through with webs of glimmering silver that sparkle with lustrous opalescent highlights.  Rich crimson rugs drape across the hardwood floor, their soft tassles brushing against the creamy white walls.  A variety of doors run along the northern edge of the hallway, their surfaces chased with incarnadine spirals.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Pine needles carpet the ground, creating a natural bed for tiny flowers that grow at the base of the huge trees.  It is amazing the flowers can get enough light to grow in the poor soil and dense forest.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: A large maoral tree lies toppled on the ground leaving an opening in the canopy that allows moonlight to filter down, brightening the area.  The root mass of the toppled tree is large, though surprisingly shallow.  The easiest way around the tree appears to be over it.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: Six oak trees extend to great heights and form a circle around a large cairn.  A black ring of ashes surrounds the cairn.  Moonlight filters down through the canopy of leaves, glinting off the stones.  A stillness blankets the area, no sound or movement noticeable.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Forest]
description: The trees are thinner here at the forest's edge.  Under the shade of a large oak tree are several long mounds of dirt.  Atop each mound stones have been arranged to form a circle, with a larger stone placed in the center.

title: [Calelith Villa, Garden]
description: Tall stalks of wheat grow wild, swaying in the breeze like ripples on the sea.  Wildflowers dot the golden sea of wheat, providing stark contrasts of color in the moonlight.  To the north, the forest borders the golden field.

Tall stalks of wheat grow wild, swaying in the breeze like ripples on the sea.  Wildflowers dot the golden sea of wheat, providing stark contrasts of color in the sunlight.  To the north, the forest borders the golden field.

title: [Calelith Villa, Garden]
description: Once cultivated, this overgrown flower garden has a beauty of its own.  Roses of yellow and white grow wild and tall, their fragrance filling the air.  White clematis climbs an old trellis along the back of the villa.  Fireflies dance about, flitting from flower to flower.

Once cultivated, this overgrown flower garden has a beauty of its own.  Roses of yellow and white grow wild and tall, their fragrance filling the air.  White clematis climbs an old trellis along the back of the villa.  Bees buzz about, flitting from flower to flower.

title: [Calelith Villa, Bedroom]
description: A small bed in the center of the room is covered with a faded pink blanket.  A dresser has been tipped over, its legs broken, and a gilded mirror lies shattered on the floor.  The tattered remains of a child's clothes are strewn about the room.

title: [Calelith Villa, Library]
description: Bookcases line the walls of the room, mostly empty now.  Clearly the largest room in the villa, it is also the one where the destruction is most disturbing.  Thousands of scrolls and tomes have been slashed and burned, corners of burnt pages still visible among the ashes in the fireplace.  Broken pieces of pottery, shards of crystal and pieces of several unknown materials lie strewn among the remains of tomes and scrolls.

title: [Calelith Villa, Root Cellar]
description: Empty sacks and broken crates cover the floor, the contents long since decomposed.  A chittering noise can be heard coming from behind a stack of crates.  A chill permeates the air.

title: [Calelith Villa, Storage Room]
description: Large crates fill this room, most of them smashed and broken.  Pieces of pottery, glass, splintered wood and odd metals are strewn about.  Empty shelves line the walls, each with a small plaque on it.

title: [Calelith Villa, Barn]
description: The barn is large and open.  An old wooden plow sits along the northern wall.  The yoke used to pull it hangs from hooks on the wall above.  Assorted pitchforks, hoes and garden implements are neatly hanging from pegs on the wall.

title: [Calelith Villa, Barn]
description: Stalls line either side of the barn, all empty now.  Old leather harnesses hang from pegs by some of the stalls.  An old feed bucket sits overturned in the back of one stall.

title: [Calelith Villa, Hayloft]
description: The loft has a musty smell, most likely from what remains of the old hay.  Sunlight enters through the open loft doors, used for lifting hay into the loft.  An owl sits perched in the rafters overhead, his head swiveling at the slightest sound.

title: [Calelith Villa, Storage Shed]
description: Sunlight filters through several splits in the walls and ceiling of the shed.  A worn counter runs along the wall, covered with old rusty gardening tools.  An old plow blade holds the door open.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: A fine mist keeps the air cool and damp, while water glistens on the rock walls of this small cave behind the falls.  Water roils from the force of the falls where the cavern floor meets the pool.  Nature has left handholds and rock steps on both the eastern and western faces of the cave, making it possible to climb in and out of here without difficulty.  Gazing out at the falls, moonlight creates a crystalline curtain of water.

title: [Gyldemar Road, Ruins]
description: A triad of ebon pillars stands in a triangular pattern upon the road, their angular architecture resembling a singular massive claw stretching out to grasp at the sky.  A circular pattern of arcing patterns is faintly visible in the parched earth within the pillars, the faint writing similar in design to the rows upon rows of sigils incised into each of the towering monoliths.  A stillness pervades the area, broken only by the occasional chill draft of wind.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The road jogs to avoid a massive boulder just to the northwest.  The rock appears to have been thrust up from the soil at some time and now leans somewhat in a southeast direction as it points toward the sky.  The road builders may have reasoned that it would be much easier to expend a few extra cobblestones moving the road around the boulder than trying to hammer away the rock surface in order to put the road over the boulder.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The bend in the treetops is somewhat more pronounced as the wind picks up.  All of them have a definite lean to the southwest, indicating the prevailing direction of the breeze.  Closer to the ground the wind is still brisk, however, scuttling needles, small branches and other forest debris across the woodland floor.  Much of the debris gathers into small piles against the northeast sides of the trees, leaving rather clean areas on the other sides.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: A breeze rolls up the side of the ridgeline, bringing cold, dry air from the valley below.  Strangely, the top of the ridgeline seems to be warmer than the area below it.  Perhaps this is due to the presence of heavily sheltered but rather dry areas down below, but it is impossible to see through the thick deciduous forest in order to make any definite analysis.  The wind seems to have affected the growth along the ridgeline, as the forest stands quite a distance from the edge.

title: [Decrepit Shack, Interior]
description: Littered with a layer of dried leaves, animal droppings and other woodland debris, the warped wood plank floor of the leaning shack creaks beneath your feet.  Pale rays of moonlight filter through the gaping holes in the hide roof, shedding a soft illumination across the remains of this small room.  A scratched wooden counter and various pegs and racks hung from the walls attest to the idea that this structure may have once been a shop of sorts, but its exact nature has been lost to time.

title: [Charred Stump, Interior]
description: Even the passage of unknown years has not erased the sharp scent of burnt wood from this low, cramped hollow within the ancient stump.  The wooden walls of this tiny chamber have been ravaged by heat and stained by the thick smoke of the lightning-induced fire which tore the oak asunder and obliterated its uppermost reaches.  Dim light filters through two gouge-like openings in the old trunk, creating a passageway to another area of the woods.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Animal Run]
description: The faint outlines and twisting pathways of the animal run seem to terminate in a small trampled clearing.  The black oaks which dominated the run have given way to tall pines, whose fresh aroma now fills the area.  The clearing is bathed in a strange silence and a tense, semi-perceptible energy lingers in the air, as if in wait.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Animal Run]
description: Darkness cloaks the run, hindering a clear view of the surrounding woods.  Above, stout oak branches blot out most of the moonlight, allowing only a few slivers of light to penetrate the near perpetual darkness.  From somewhere in the shadows, something rustles the branches of a small shrub, its exact nature and location obscured by the low light.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Animal Run]
description: Knobby, moss-coated protrusions of pale granite emerge from the leaf-covered undergrowth, appearing like small helmeted soldiers hiding to ambush unwary trespassers.  A thick coating of damp moss caps each stone, providing camouflage within the broad ferns and wispy tendrils of the forest floor.  Although apparently harmless, the granite outcroppings and exposed roots which infest the run could pose problems for those travelers who do not keep a keen eye on their steps.

title: [Great Oak, Platform]
description: Some thirty feet above the forest floor, a carefully camouflaged wooden platform has been built around the great oak.  Littered with a thin layer of leaves and dust, the platform has not been used in some time.  Even in the dim moonlight, gazing down over the edge provides an excellent view of the old path and intimate woods, while providing the looker with near invisibility among the thick oak branches.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Young Oak]
description: This small circular clearing in the otherwise dense woods contains a single oak sapling, its trunk only the length of a human hand in width.  Nearly half a dozen branches reach out from the tree, but their ends are withered and devoid of leaves as if infected with a foul contagion.  The area around the base of the young oak is raised slightly, as if the small tree had been placed on a pedestal as a thing of some importance.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Perch]
description: Strung between a pair of stout branches, the woven netting provides a camouflaged perch for observation of the crumbling path below.  Although torn in a few places and adorned with fallen leaves, the web of the netting is surprisingly intact.  Portions of the bark show signs of wearing, perhaps from the leaning shoulders of silent watchers who held vigil in this perch long ago.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: An oak of wide girth, its trunk a stony grey hue, rises from the thick forest undergrowth, its skeletal branches oddly absent of leaves.  Its once sturdy bark has turned brittle, flaking off in long strips which litter the path.  Short stubby branches extend from the trunk in a seemingly intelligent pattern, almost appearing as footholds for ascension.  A heavy odor, like the scent of moist earth in swampy regions, pervades the area.

title: [Outpost, Warped Cabin]
description: Split and warped from a drastic change in the shape of the tree which holds it, the one-room cabin creaks and shudders from even the slightest movement within its ragged confines.  Gaping holes, torn open from branches which at one time supported the weight of the small structure, rend the walls.  The wooden flooring is blanketed with dead leaves and an odd assortment of feathers.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: Shapes darker than the night seem to haunt the moonlit path, some forms seeming to follow those travelers who would dare to walk among the ancient oaks.  The muffled crackle of dry leaves and the occasional snap of an unseen twig mark the movement of hidden entities within the overgrown foliage.  Sometimes, when all else is still, a husky thick-throated panting can be heard somewhere nearby.

Dark shapes seem to haunt the shadows beyond the broken path, some forms seeming to follow those travelers who would dare to walk among the ancient oaks.  The muffled crackle of dry leaves and the occasional snap of an unseen twig mark the movement of hidden entities within the overgrown foliage.  Sometimes, when all else is still, a husky thick-throated panting can be heard somewhere nearby.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: A mass of tangled creepers and briars has overgrown the path, its wispy tendrils wrapping around the nearby oak trunks.  A man-sized wooden figurine, its engraved surface barely visible within the tentacled foliage, stands amid the amassed greenery, its minute details lost amid the clinging vines.  Although heavy with the weight of the thorny growth, the figurine remains standing, as if it refuses to yield.

title: [Great Oak, Collapsed Room]
description: Heavy branches, turned a slate grey by an unknown disease or infestation, have collapsed inward, blocking all access to this chamber.  Dagger-sized splinters of decaying wood are strewn across the floor, and a heavy odor, like the foul scent associated with bogs and weedy marshes, lingers in the area.

title: [Great Oak, Landing]
description: A wide doorway in the side of the great oak opens out onto a small landing.  Strewn with dried leaves and a thick layer of dust and grime, the landing looks out over the forest floor, some forty feet below.  From this height, it is apparent that some of the surrounding oaks have been infected with an unknown disease, altering their healthy bark to a stone-like grey and making it crack and splinter.  A barely perceptible breeze rustles the fallen leaves, causing them to swirl in a miniature whirlwind.

title: [Great Oak, Vine Bridge]
description: A soft breeze brushes across the vine bridge, causing it to sway back and forth, before returning to a reasonable sense of stability.  Dry leaves on the nearby oak branches rustle in the wind, the quiet sound mimicking the low wheezing of hushed whispers.  A damp murky scent lingers in the air, its source unclear.

title: [Great Oak, Cracked Landing]
description: Shaped from the once-living wood of the tree, the landing extends outward from an arch-shaped opening in the side of a great oak.  The bark of the tree itself has turned a sickly grey hue, and numerous thin cracks mar its surface.  Once sturdy branches have begun to lose their strength, bending low toward the ground some forty feet below.

title: [Great Oak, Collapsed Hall]
description: Sharp splinters and jagged shards of wood emerge from the once-smooth walls and floors of the hollow interior of the great oak.  The ceiling has completely collapsed, raining dead branches and leaves across the uneven floor.  The southern side of the chamber has fallen away, leaving a gaping hole to the outside.  An enormous branch, grey and dying like the other parts of this infected oak, has lodged itself in the opening, allowing access to the forest floor below.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cobbled Path]
description: Intertwined creepers and vine-like tendrils blanket the path, growing with wild abandon and enveloping the few remaining pale cobblestones.  Local tree bark has been infested with a combination of pale lichens and woolly moss, lending the old trunks a patched and mottled appearance.  Leaves rustle slightly in the breeze, their voices the sound of raspy whispers.

Local tree bark has been infested with a combination of pale lichens and woolly moss, lending the old trunks a patched and mottled appearance.  Leaves rustle slightly in the breeze, their voices the sound of raspy whispers.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cobbled Path]
description: Entwined with slender vines and leafy tendrils, a half-obscured wooden totem stands just to the side of the broken path, its base surrounded by moss-coated cobblestones and a thick mass of creepers.  Although nearly invisible within the dim light and heavy growth, the totem appears to be of nearly human height and of the same thickness as a heavy lance.  Cracked and upturned, the cobblestones are more prevalent near the engraved symbol.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cobbled Path]
description: Oak branches, heavy with their load of crackling leaves, crisscross overhead, forming a thick canopy.  Thin slivers of pale light filter down through the layered canopy, illuminating tiny sections of leaf-strewn undergrowth.  The ancient path, checkered in silvery moonlight and dull blackness, winds its way among the silent oaks.

Oak branches, heavy with their load of crackling leaves, crisscross overhead, forming a thick canopy.  Thin slivers of golden light filter down through the layered canopy, illuminating tiny sections of leaf-strewn undergrowth.  The ancient path, checkered in shimmering light and dull blackness, winds its way among the silent oaks.

title: [Outpost, Overgrown Trail]
description: A musky scent, strong and wild, rides the light breeze.  The oak trees rustle with its presence, as if some fierce beast walked in their midst.  Although nothing is distinct, the sensation of being watched from the darkness of the surrounding foliage is unmistakable.  To the south, a small clearing opens in the woods, just visible under the dim light of the night sky.

Although nothing is distinct, the sensation of being watched from the shadows of the surrounding foliage is unmistakable.  To the south, a small clearing opens in the woods, the rounded edge of a hut or cabin visible through the lightly swaying branches.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Smaller trees and shrubs abound in the area, filling the forest and making travel impossible in any direction except along the road.  Where many of the large trees might have once stood, only charred trunks extend up toward the sky.  From all appearances a fire moved through this area, but not recently.  The extent of the undergrowth and the size of many of the smaller trees indicate that the fire may have scoured the area three years ago or so.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: A thick redwood tree, perhaps fifteen feet in diameter near the ground, extends only twenty-five feet or so up into the air.  Blackened and scarred, the trunk has snapped off, leaving a jagged, charred, lifeless spire.  Nearer the ground, though, the tree has sent out branches again, the dark grey needles indicating that, although the tree's outside is badly damaged, the heartwood is still healthy.  Like the proverbial phoenix, the redwood rises again from the ashes of the fire.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Something or somethings rustle nearby in the underbrush, causing the bushes and small trees to waver slightly.  The undergrowth is so thick, though, that it is impossible to get near the source of the disturbance.  Every so often the rustlings are punctuated by short, high-pitched squealings and quiet growlings as the action shifts from point to point.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Gnarled sugar pines grow through the cracks in the rocks, splitting the large boulders apart into smaller fragments.  The soil in the area has been denuded through the actions of fire, water and wind, exposing long slabs of rock between which strips of soil maintain the vegetation.  Holly bushes compete with squat spruces and the tough sugar pines.  The stunted appearance of the growth suggests either a lack of soil nutrients, sparse rainfall, or both.

title: [Kiyya's General Store]
description: Smooth sandstone walls rise from a weathered cobblestone floor.  Just above a small potted boxwood shrub hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a paneled haon ceiling completes the picture.  A gold-trimmed ebonwood chest and an ora-bound large walnut trunk stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Weeds, bushes, saplings and even larger trees have disrupted the cobblestone road severely, making it impossible to walk the road.  Instead one must circumvent the obstacles but still continue in the general direction.  Most of the cobblestones are still evident, although overturned and moved well out of position, and the forest bed is not choked with underbrush, so the road is still fairly easy to follow.  It would be much easier to travel if someone had maintained the road, though.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The poorly kept road emerges onto a swampy plain to the northeast and delves into the forest to the west.  Cattails attempt to push the wooded area back, while oaks and maples lead the assault in the other direction.  The constant droning of unseen insects emanates from the swamp.  Here, at the forest's edge, the moon shines down brightly on the surrounding area.  The warm night air raises the humidity, and a rather foul odor drifts in from the moist areas.

Here, at the forest's edge, the sun shines down brightly to warm the surrounding area, although the warmth raises the humidity, and a rather foul odor drifts in from the moist areas.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The road is barely a raised area of drier mud above a flat area of oozing mud and monotonous swamp grass.  Here and there part of a cobblestone protrudes up through the mud, often at an angle completely different from that which the builders intended.  The buzzing of the swamp insects seems to swell and abate in unison but without any discernible regularity, as though the insects know the tune though it follows no known meter.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Worn away by rain and the underground action of continual water, the road has sunk to swamp level.  At this point, though, it remains firm enough for passage and rises slightly out of the swamp to the west.  To the east the road disappears entirely under black water for twenty yards or so then emerges again to proceed unsteadily on its way.  Continuing east is most likely a sink or swim proposition, and perhaps both.

title: [Under The Black Water]
description: Wet blackness envelops everything, and the mud grasps powerfully at feet and legs.  The lack of vision and the unsure footing in the muck below combine to confuse the senses, making direction a meaningless idea.  Even "up" is in question at times.  One can only swim and hope.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Although the forest is visible on the horizon to the south, there is no way of getting there across the treacherous swamp in between.  Slowly the swamp seems to be reclaiming the cobblestone road, leaving less than half the cobblestones even visible in this area.  To the west the black water has completely covered the roadway, and to the east the roadway dips and jogs, fighting to stay above the sinking terrain.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Patches of black, slimy water spread across the road in many places, causing slight detours, if possible on the muddy terrain.  Mostly, though, one is forced to splash through them, leaving a grimy dark residue on feet, footwear, or, in the case of rather deep puddles, both.  Often hordes of insects or small amphibians scatter out of the puddles at the footsteps' approach, disturbing and roiling the puddles as they skitter away into the safety of the flanking bulrushes.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The road takes a brief northern jog, rising slightly as it does so.  The reeds, cattails and bulrushes still press in against the road, but the ground seems parched and dry, as if there hasn't been a rain in a good while.  The surrounding vegetation is stiff and colorless, easily breaking off at the touch of a hand.  The sheer thickness of it, though, prevents any digression from the road.  An errant spark would quickly turn this area into a raging inferno.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: A thick, clammy haze oozes out of the surrounding weeds to choke the road and reduce vision to merely a few feet.  The moon is a wide orb with blurry edges hanging somewhere far above the mist, adding no heat to help assuage the dank chill.  If not for the few cobblestones still visible above the mud, the correct direction of travel would be anyone's guess.

description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and a small brown box sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and a floral-etched ceramic case sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

description: Beneath a paneled haon ceiling, an antique wall hanging hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A long varnished counter and a large oak table sit in opposite corners while a knotted woolen rug rests on a buffed cherrywood floor.

title: [Taerel's Outfitting]
[Taerel's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a paneled haon ceiling, a decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A long mahogany rack and a large oak table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a buffed cherrywood floor.

title: [Teeah's General Store]
[Teeah's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, a snarling war griffin painting hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A large oak table and a small brown box sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a patterned hardwood floor.

title: [Teeah's Magic Shoppe]
[Teeah's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by painted emerald green walls, the shop features a small potted boxwood shrub in the center of its mosaic floor.  A detailed landscape painting hangs under the nightscape ceiling.  Right near the front is a large oak table and a small brown box.

title: [Aniwaya's General Store]
[Aniwaya's Outfitting]
description: A framed Ta'Illistim map hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls, and a paneled haon ceiling rises overhead.  A verdant elderberry bush sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a painted red cedar rack on one side of the shop and a painted red cedar rack on the other.

title: [Aniwaya's Weaponry]
[Aniwaya's Magic Shoppe]
description: A detailed landscape painting hangs on one of the plain baby blue walls, and a painted nightscape ceiling rises overhead.  An ivory elven noble statue sits in one corner of a weathered cobblestone floor.  There is a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest on one side of the shop and a long mahogany rack on the other.

title: [Aniwaya's Outfitting]
[Aniwaya's General Store]
[Aniwaya's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by patterned white walls, the shop features a life-sized granite maiden statue in the center of its cherrywood floor.  A gold silk crown tapestry hangs under the mahogany ceiling.  Right near the front is a long mahogany rack and a wide faenor-trimmed table.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: The bog has almost totally reclaimed the road.  Rushes spring up where once a flat, well-maintained road might have run.  Only here and there do cobblestones still make a wary appearance, fighting to stay on top of the cloying sludge.  So very few of them remain, though, that it often takes careful searching to find the next cobblestone and thus continue in the right direction.  Growls and snarls out in the thicker rushes suggest that there are those that wish the stones could not be found.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Thick rushes rise from the dank water, choking the area and providing excellent cover for anything small enough to fit underneath them.  The rushes, combined with the water cover and unsure footing, keep the larger predators out of the area.  Muskrat dens appear frequently along the edges of what might still be called a 'road,' and often one of the small, bare-tailed mammals can be seen scurrying for the safety of its home.

title: [Gyldemar Road]
description: Something has died just off the road.  It is far enough out in the swamp that moving off the road to investigate would be foolhardy at best, but close enough that the flies and odor are very much apparent.  This, combined with the oppressive humidity, mist, sucking mud and monotonous vegetation suggest that there are probably far more interesting places one could occupy.  The road, as best as can be ascertained, continues to forge northwest and east.

title: [Gyldemar Road, Sentinels]
description: The roadway rises slightly above the swamp.  From the appearances, someone has purposely built a small hillock here atop which two massive granite sentinels stand, silent and unmoving.  No method of circumventing the sentinels presents itself.  If one wishes to continue along the road in an easterly direction, one must pass between the sentinels.  Westward the road slides into the swamp and fights to stay above the sucking mud.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Gateyard]
description: A small guardroom has been built into the city's massive stone wall, the room large enough to hold several guards but still insignificant compared to the enormous city wall.  An open window allows the guardsman within to keep a watchful eye on the gateyard's ever-changing occupancy.

A small guardroom has been built into the city's massive stone wall, the room large enough to potentially hold several guards but still insignificant compared to the enormous city wall.  An open window allows anyone on-duty within to keep a watchful eye on the gateyard's ever-changing occupancy.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Gateyard]
description: A low wooden platform occupies the length of the city wall in this corner of the busy gateyard.  Atop the platform, a scaffolding of untold origin and use sits, ignored by the local populace and city guard alike.  Torches mounted in ironwork brackets upon the wall burn brightly, keeping the darkness of night at bay.

Torches mounted in ironwork brackets upon the wall are snuffed in deference to the day's light.

title: [River's Rest, Underbridge]
description: It's shady and cool beneath the drawbridge.  The Tempest River, though swift in the channel, chuckles slowly and cheerfully among the stones and alluvium along the bank.  Reeds, cattails, tall river grasses, and other various weeds flourish in the rich mud and silt.  Set off to the side of the drawbridge is a rickety shack with a cast iron fish set into the ground in front of it.

title: [River's Rest, Underbridge]
description: Tucked into the space between the drawbridge and the bank is a small wooden structure nearly hidden from sight by cattails and tall river grasses.  Two pathways have been cut and beaten through the abundant riverside weeds, one to the west and another down to the Tempest itself, where a small dock sits causing swirling pools in the current.  The noise of the passing water is amplified by the bridge above, creating a heightened sense of the river and the wetness in the air about it.

title: [River's Rest, River Road]
description: As safe as a gate, the river runs swiftly east to west, secure against intrusion when the well-built drawbridge to the mainland is raised.  Along the riverfront, comfortable benches are interspersed with odd three sided structures, large enough to hold a giant man comfortably, but their use not readily apparent.  A fresh breeze carries the sounds of a nearby marketplace from the east, and an occasional hint of roasting meat from somewhere to the north.

title: [River's Rest, River Road]
description: As the river widens here, the growth along the shallows takes stronger hold.  Reeds and rushes sway gently in the slow-moving current, crowding the odd structures lining the waterfront.  A birch shop nestles next to the Captain's Quarters and a garden-encircled colorful oak dwelling, sunlight glinting off its indigo-hued tile roof.  The noise to the west gives way to the quiet sounds of waterlife of all sorts: croaking frogs, splashing fish, and bustling waterfowl.  Across the river, the forest is held at bay, a world apart from this island retreat.

As the river widens here, the growth along the shallows takes stronger hold.  Reeds and rushes sway gently in the slow moving current and crowd the odd structures which line the waterfront as far as you can see.  The noise to the west gives way to the quiet sounds of waterlife of all sorts: croaking frogs, splashing fish and silently stalking them both, a heron standing regally at the waters edge.  Across the river, the forest is held at bay and seems a world apart from this island retreat.

title: [River's Rest, River Road]
description: River Road ends at the shore of a mighty bay and the sight of the river spilling into it is awe inspiring.  Dancing over a bed of small stones and almost lost in thick clumps of reeds, a small creek meanders from the north and turns to empty into the bay east of this sandy point.  A dilapidated pier juts into the river, its pilings standing strong against the river current, but its planking now hazardous.  Drifting on the breeze is the lonely cry of a waterbird hunting its dinner.

title: [River's Rest, Dilapidated Pier]
description: Not as worn as it first appears to be, this pier is actually a sturdy and pleasant platform.  From this vantage, the river is clearly visible to the north, the comings and goings at the drawbridge seen but not heard.  Visible in the deep waters are the reflections of thousands of stars from the evening sky, occasionally obscured by a passing cloud.  Rustling reeds and the sudden splash of a fish leaping from the water do little to disturb the peace.

Not as worn as it first appears to be, this pier is actually a sturdy and pleasant platform.  From this vantage, the river is clearly visible to the north, the comings and goings at the drawbridge seen but not heard.  Visible in the deep waters are the shadowy shapes of what one hopes are large fish and tiny crabs cling to the pilings, scurrying from view when the shadows of water fowl fall over them.  Rustling reeds and the sudden splash of a fish leaping from the water do little to disturb the peace.

title: [River's Rest, Creek Bank]
description: The pebbled path leads you to a grassy hillock overlooking the creek.  The creek bank here is rather steep.  At the water's edge is a small half moon of pebbles...blue, green and brown...flanked by reeds and cattails.  To the north you can see a small footbridge crossing the creek.  Tied to a limb of a tall oak tree is a length of hempen rope.

title: [River's Rest, Creek]
description: An eddy has formed in a curve of the creek a short distance before it joins the wide Tempest River.  The bottom of the creek, visible through the clear water, consists of small pebbles that have been washed downstream by the current.  The creek bank, a half moon of brown, blue and green pebbles, is surrounded by tall cattails and reeds.  A small wooden footbridge crosses the creek to the north.  In the middle of the creek is an old pier piling.

title: [River's Rest, Merchants' Walk]
description: The swift sound of rushing water is barely audible for the shops which nestle along the riverbank.  Sturdily built to withstand the elements, Felinium's Fur Emporium, Diamante's Gemshop and Hortinger's Armory stand open to those with silver to spare.  The flow of traffic thins to the east, although many who leave the shops here continue on that way, most with smiles but a few grumbling about thieves.  The sound of laughter occasionally drifts in from the north.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [River's Rest, Riverwalk]
description: A modest yard of neatly trimmed grass grows along the embankment of the south fork of the Tempest River.  Cattails and rushes grow in abundance along the bank.  Across the river, travelers and an occasional rolton can be seen moving along the river road.  A small, open-sided shelter stands beside the shoreline.  A weathered building, erected on dozens of barnacle-covered pilings, juts out over the reed-choked shallows.  Moonlight illuminates a narrow, shell-strewn path leading east along the river.

title: [River's Rest, Riverwalk]
description: The narrow walkway, made from broken fragments of white and pink shells, follows the gently meandering contours of the wide river.  To the north are the delivery entries in the backs of various town shops.  Between the back entrances is a small shop door, from which emanates a powerful smell of pickle brine.  To the south, the wide Tempest River wends it way out toward Maelstrom Bay.

title: [River's Rest, Breakwater]
description: The riverwalk ends at a stone breakwater on the eastern end of the island.  The great Tempest River divides here, a smaller branch flowing north, the main branch continuing along the southern side of the island.  A stucco watchtower stands like a ghostly sentinel in the moonlight atop a grassy knoll on the breakwater.

title: [River's Rest, Merchants' Walk]
description: The roadway ends here at the edge of a noisy bazaar.  Filled with tiled rooftops and colorful awnings, an occasional minaret can be seen reaching up into the sky.  Townsfolk seem to take no note however, as they hurry to safeguard their hard-earned silver at a small, but sturdily built bank, which is guarded by the river and the walls of the bazaar.  Many others seem bent on spending their wealth, judging from the packages they carry from a small store located to the north.

title: [River's Rest, Dark Alley]
description: Off the beaten path and slightly seedy, the alley is dark and cool.  An occasional voice drifts down the alley from the southwest and a few folks wander by.  Set off to one side of the path is a small shabby shop sporting a sign, which hangs by one hinge and squeaks whenever a stray breeze happens by.  Facing you is what appears to be the back door of a well kept building.  At the end of the alley is a large building with a sign hanging over its large double doors.

title: [River's Rest, Commons Circle]
description: Here, the dusty roadway splits and continues to the northeast and northwest.  The rush of River Road traffic to the south is faint in the air and the pace of life seems slower and calmer to the north.  Between the roads, a dusty pathway fades into a broad expanse of green lawn.

title: [River's Rest, Commons Circle]
description: Strolling along this road, bounded on the right by a tall fragrant evergreen hedge, folks seem to be in good spirits.  The hurried pace of life to the south is forgotten as the soft sound of gently flowing water filters in from the west.  One man in the crowd attracts the eye as he enters the circle from the west, his face drawn and pale, but filled with hope as he leans heavily on the shoulder of his companion.  They move on, leaving behind a sense of well-being that is slow to fade.

title: [River's Rest, Spring Rest]
description: All about, leaves and small twigs litter the forest floor, but at the forest's edge, in this clearing, brush marks in the soft dirt show the care that someone takes here.  A pool of clear water dominates the area and feeds a small stream which meanders southward beside a small path.  At the edge of the clearing, two large stone pillars mark a pathway west.  Moonlight filters through the trees and seems to invite the weary to rest here in peace.

Warm sunlight filters through the trees and seems to invite the weary to rest here in peace.

title: [River's Rest, Sanctuary]
description: Deep in the forest rests a small shrine lovingly carved of the silvery haon wood that surrounds you.  Crickets chirping and the gentle rustling of leaves fill the air with a strong sense of life.  From somewhere nearby the gentle sound of running water completes the quiet symphony.  Little else disturbs the peace save for an occasional muted voice drifting on the breeze.

title: [River's Rest, Forested Path]
description: The rustling leaves of haon trees overhead and a swiftly flowing creek beside this path create a quiet symphony.  To the south, a footbridge crosses the creek amidst a smaller forest of reeds.  A clearing is visible in the forest to the north, where the creek seems to originate.  Occasional soft voices can be heard from that direction, heightening the feeling of peace that seems to permeate this woodland haven.  A well worn path heads into the trees, ending at the foot of a large haon tree.

title: [Small Clearing]
description: Moonlight filters in through the canopy high above you in this standing of trees.  Large half exposed roots weave a tight bramble that surrounds you.  A narrow but well worn path carefully winds its way through a huge tangle of roots.  Hanging down from the tree before you is a long spidersilk ladder which leads upward.

title: [Fletcher Shop, Porch]
description: A swift breeze gently rustles the leaves of this large haon tree, partially obscuring your view of the town to the west.  The thick branches provide a natural support for the frame of the shop, while smaller branches form a railing which surrounds the porch.  Hanging off the edge of the porch is a spidersilk ladder which leads to the ground far below.

title: [River's Rest, Commons Circle]
description: Livelier than the other parts of this circular path, crowds come and go along the road to the east, where shouts of laughter and cries of recognition can be heard as people spy acquaintances amongst the crowd.  Heavy in the air is the smell of wood smoke and roasting meat, tempting to those famished after an arduous hunt.

title: [River's Rest, Targon's Square]
description: This large, welcoming square is set away from the center of town and paved with large stone blocks.  The crowds that gather here do not seem to crowd the openness of the square, but to make it feel warm and welcoming.  Set off to one side, a small tavern seems to attract many in the crowd, and each time its doors open, sounds of revelry spill out into the open to attract even more.  The River's Rest Inn stands nestled back in the brambles that guard the eastern side of the tavern.

title: [River's Rest, Town Commons]
description: Fresh green grass, green as the greenest emerald, is soft underfoot and a pleasing foreground for a weathered wooden bench resting in the shade of a graceful willow tree.  Chirping crickets fill the air and mingle with the voices of folk who stroll through the commons, and on occasion stop to exchange a tale or two with friends they meet along their way.  A dusty path to the south and a riverstone walkway to the north are joined by a tall evergreen hedge which borders the edges of the lawn.

title: [River's Rest, Commons Circle]
description: Curving gently from the southeast to the southwest, the roadway flows with a river of small stones in varying hues of grey.  As a creek feeds a river, a riverstone walkway merges with the road, snaking smoothly from between two evergreen hedges which border the main roads to the south.  A narrow, moss-covered trail is just visible in the heavily wooded area opposite the hedges and channels the faint sound of a song to the ears of those that walk here.

title: [River's Rest, Town Gardens]
description: Against the backdrop of a forest to the south, this garden is open to a starlit sky.  In unruly disorder, flowers and herbs of all descriptions are scattered in several beds throughout the gardens.  To the north, a large meadow spreads out as far as you can see.  Off to one side, a wizened old elf is busily uprooting weeds from one particularly overgrown bed.  Whistling a merry tune, he occasionally breaks into a sweet song as he works, smiling at all who enter his domain.

To the north, a large meadow spreads out as far as you can see.  Off to one side, a wizened old elf is busily uprooting weeds from one particularly overgrown bed.  Whistling a merry tune, he occasionally breaks into a sweet song as he works, smiling at all who enter his domain.

title: [Empath Guild, Entrance]
description: Two stately magnolias stand as sentinels before a black wrought iron gate.  What the gate is attached to has been entirely obscured by the dark green privet hedges that crowd the gate on both sides.  Torches mounted in wrought iron sconces blaze brilliantly, illuminating the entrance and surrounding area.  A large banner suspended between the magnolias sways gently in the warm breeze, and a lush layer of bluegrass carpets the area except for the well-worn path leading to and from the gate.

title: [Willow Tree, Platform]
description: Moonlight filters through the dense foliage of the willow tree, illuminating the platform.  The rough-hewn oak planks that form the platform are clearly old ship's timbers.  They are slightly curved and retain a faint odor of pitch.  Twigs and windblown leafy detritus are stuck in the cracks of the planks.

title: [River's Rest, Sandy Path]
description: To one side of this sandy path is a forest and to the other the seemingly endless bramble thicket that only the foolhardy would dare to travel.  Shifting with each footstep that touches it, the path shimmers in the moonlight, constantly changing - always the same.  Swiftly moving water is heard to the east and north, although the source is not yet visible to the eye.

title: [Bramble Thicket, Clearing]
description: Cordoned off from the town by an impenetrable hedge is a quaint little spot, its immaculate lawn dotted with myrtle.  A row of date palms frames a path of crushed shell that leads from the edge of the thicket straight to an impressive building at the center of the lawn.  An arched doorway leads into the building, and a weathered lattice keeps the local fauna from entering the open windows to either side.

title: [River's Rest, Persimmon Lane]
description: This quiet lane is lined with fragrant old persimmon trees.  On either side of the lane, set back behind the trees, are a pair of frond-roofed, stucco bungalows...one behind a brass-knobbed gate, the other through a graceful arch.  To the west, rising above the nearby treetops, is a blue-domed pavilion.  Fireflies flitter among the trees.

paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [River's Rest, Pavilion Grove]
description: A small, open-air pavilion stands near the center of a clearing in a grove of fragrant persimmon trees.  Tall columns of green riverstone are topped with a dome painted deep blue.  Ivy grows profusely in the narrow spaces between the columns, creating a leafy wall that conceals the interior of the pavilion.  Moonlight glints off something metallic behind the ivy.

title: [River's Rest Museum]
description: A dense grove of tall persimmon trees surround a small green lawn.  In the center of the lawn stands a squat, circular stucco tower illuminated by the flaming torches that line the white gravel walkway.  The torches cast strange, flickering shadows on the trees.

A dense grove of tall persimmon trees surround a small green lawn.  In the center of the lawn stands a squat, circular tower made of stucco.  Unlit torches line the white gravel walkway leading to the tower.  Muted birdsong filters in through the trees.

title: [Lomara's Yard]
description: A series of riverstones forms a walkway bisecting this small yard, leading to the frond-roofed bungalow.  The grass, lush and green by the arch, shows patches of yellow and brown near the bungalow.  Faint traces of sharp smells hover in the air.  The old brass sign attached to the bungalow's door is unnaturally bright in the moonlight.

title: [Collip's Yard]
description: Although this small yard is just a short distance from the noise and bustle of the Commons Circle, it's remarkably tranquil.  The frond-roofed, stucco bungalow is painted a cheery yellow with bright green shutters.  Moonlight, dappled by the trees, plays off a brass sign hanging above the door of the bungalow.  In the farthest corner of the yard is an egg-shaped bee hive.

title: [River's Rest, Olive Grove]
description: Here the olive trees are younger and smaller than those in the rest of the grove.  Growing only about 20 feet in height, they appear to have been deliberately planted in roughly straight rows.  The moons illuminate a wooden sign set firmly into the ground by the nearest olive tree.  A few pastel-colored stucco buildings line the pathway.

The trees have been carefully tended and pruned.  A wooden sign is firmly set into the ground by the nearest olive tree.  A few pastel-colored stucco buildings line the pathway.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [River's Rest, Olive Grove]
description: The olive trees here are clearly the oldest and wildest in the grove, growing to a height of nearly 50 feet.  Lanterns hang from the lower limbs of the tall trees and the pathway is illuminated by low braziers. The smell of ripening olives drifts through the air.  A few stucco buildings scattered among the trees are visible in the moonlight.

Brightly colored banners and ribbons hang from the trees, rippling in the breeze like the tails of exotic birds.  The smell of ripening olives drifts through the air.  A few pastel-colored stucco buildings are scattered among the trees.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [River's Rest, Olive Grove]
description: A refreshing breeze blows through the olive trees, riffling through the leaves with the sound of a gossip's whisper.  The lanterns hung from the branches sway slightly, casting strange shadows.  Moonlight filtering through the trees gives an odd hue to the pastel-colored stucco buildings scattered among the trees.

title: [River's Rest, Olive Grove]
description: Fireflies wink in and out of sight as they flit through the olive grove.  The pallid light of the lanterns hung among the branches of the trees is enough to reveal the outlines of a few stucco buildings.  The air is redolent with the pleasant smell of ripening olives.  A blue riverstone bench sits beneath a particularly well-pruned tree.

Birdsong drifts faintly through the olive grove, providing a delicate and melodious environment for the pastel-colored stucco buildings scattered among the trees.  The air is redolent with the pleasant smell of ripening olives.  A blue riverstone bench sits beneath a particularly well-pruned tree.

title: [River's Rest, Olive Grove]
description: Ancient olive trees, their trunks as thick and rough as the hands of old fishermen, line the pathway.  Lanterns hanging among the thick, grey-green leaves give off a pallid light.  The lanterns in the more distant trees look like fireflies.  Scattered among the trees are a few small, pastel-colored stucco buildings.

title: [River's Rest, Sandy Path]
description: This quiet path approaches its end, opening onto a wide sandy beach to the north.  The bramble thicket shows no signs of thinning, seemingly running to the river's edge ahead, but the forest is slowly giving way to the sandy beach.

title: [Plaza of Stars]
description: A large plaza fronts the imposing facade of the Jastev Amphitheater, which is linked to its companion Bard Guild via a beautifully arched covered walkway.  The tile paving the plaza is laid in alternating bands of color, soft salmon contrasted with ivory, the tone and pattern matched in the walls of the buildings.  A statue stands in the plaza's center and a wide bank of stairs leads up to the amphitheater's entrance, at least a story higher than the plaza's floor.

title: [Bard Guild, Terrace]
description: A generous terrace stretches before the entrance to the Jastev Amphitheater.  From the elevated vantage point, the plaza below is striking with its alternating bands of color.  At the apex of the monumental arch leading into the theater, the lintel is carved with an image of a bearded man framed by a crossed pair of artist's brushes.

title: [Jastev Amphitheater]
description: Tiers of carved stone seats descend in orderly, semi-circular waves toward a stage at the lower end of the open-air amphitheater.  Overhead, the sky provides a black velvet ceiling, sparkling with stars and the moons.  Cerulean blue stage curtains as well as the stage itself are shielded from any inclement weather by an overhanging roof.

Overhead, the sky provides a brilliant blue ceiling, studded with occasional passing clouds.  Cerulean blue stage curtains as well as the stage itself are shielded from any inclement weather by an overhanging roof.

title: [River's Rest, East River Beach]
description: Swift and narrow, the North River rushes madly from east to west.  It is just wide enough that jumping it would likely lead to a quick trip to the bay visible downstream.  From this point, you can see that the brambles extend to the river, overhanging the river bank, their branches dipping into the water.  Stone outcroppings break through to the surface of the thicket and a small lizard sleeps in the moonlight on the flat surface of the largest one.

Stone outcroppings break through to the surface of the thicket and a small lizard suns itself on the flat surface of the largest one.

title: [River's Rest, River Beach]
description: A mixture of sand, pebbles and small rocks underfoot is still warm from the earlier sun of the day, counteracting a stiff, cool breeze from the Bay.  The beach runs to the river, the bank to the north having slowly disappeared leaving small eddying pools at the waters edge.  Across the widening river, a large rocky field is visible, ending at a high cliff far to the north.

The beach runs to the river, the bank to the north having slowly disappeared leaving small eddying pools at the waters edge.  Across the widening river, a large rocky field is visible, ending at a high cliff far to the north.

title: [River's Rest, Land's End Beach]
description: Here at the mouth of the river, the rocky beach has given way to sand, only one large boulder marring the warm, golden glow.  It stands as a sentinel, overlooking the river and bay and a narrow sandy point that extends to the west.  Dark shadows behind the boulder seem eerie in the moonlight.  A path leads into the woods.  The distant sound of water birds and the whispering winds fill the air with a joyous song.

Dark shadows behind the boulder seem to promise relief when the sun's warmth grows too strong.  A path leads into the woods.  The distant sound of water birds and the whispering winds fill the air with a joyous song.

title: [River's Rest, Narrow Point]
description: Surrounded by water, this narrow strip of beach offers a clear view of Maelstrom Bay and a larger body of water to the south.  Small shells litter the beach and an occasional crab scuttles quickly to the safety of the water, leaving a tell-tale track in the soft sands which is soon erased by the gentle breezes.  To the east, the mainland seems far away from this quiet and peaceful corner of the island.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Entrance]
description: Tall palisade walls of logged white birch trunks march into the vicious brambles on either side.  The tips of the log wall's trunks have been whittled to nasty points, and something brown and malodorous has been spread across these sharpened spires.  A wide piece of surfaced redwood arches over the open gate, upon which an insignia has been painted, and to one side something has been burned into the palisade wall itself.  Several torches illuminate the path and gate.

Several torches line the path, ready to provide illumination when darkness falls.

title: [River's Rest, Captain's Room]
description: Although few signs of the maritime heritage of this town remain, it seems the law is a throwback.  The Captain's Quarter is sparsely outfitted with a map station gracing one wall and a large bench resting at the foot of a neatly made bunk.  The floor is made of rough wood planks.  In one corner you notice a hatchway, large enough to allow a giantman to slip through easily.  However, the large lock which secures it makes you pause to think twice about investigating any further.

title: [Fleet Captain's Yard]
description: This small yard is bounded on the east by the walls of the Captain's Quarters, on the west by a reed-lined creek, and on the northeast by the tall stucco wall of the River's Rest Hoosegow.  A rabbit hutch stands against the wall of the Captain's Quarters.  A pathway leads north between the creek and the Hoosegow wall.  The fetid smell of the slow-moving creek water competes with the acrid smell of the hutch.  The moons glint off the surface of the creek.

title: [River's Rest, Fens]
description: The narrow pathway follows the contours of the sluggish, reed-lined creek.  The tall, whitewashed stucco wall of the River's Rest Hoosegow runs roughly parallel to the creek.  The creek's center channel has been cleared enough to permit the passage of small watercraft.

title: [River's Rest, Fens]
description: The pathway follows the contours of the sluggish, reed-lined creek.  The tall, whitewashed stucco wall of the River's Rest Hoosegow runs roughly parallel to the creek.  A slight breeze makes the reeds sway.  From somewhere deep in the reeds comes the weird croaking of a bittern.

title: [River's Rest, Fens]
description: The pathway follows the contours of a sluggish, reed-lined creek.  The tall, whitewashed stucco wall of the River's Rest Hoosegow runs roughly parallel to the creek.  A tall keyhole arch with an ornate gate provides an entrance into the Hoosegow.

title: [River's Rest Hoosegow]
description: Tall, thick walls of orange-hued stucco surround a courtyard paved with grey riverstone slabs.  The hot, humid night air carries the fecund smell of a nearby salt creek.  In the center of the courtyard is a statue carved in milky-colored granite.  A studded iron portcullis guards the entrance to the hoosegow rotunda.  A keyhole arch leads out.

title: [River's Rest, Fens]
description: The pathway follows the contours of a sluggish, reed-lined creek.  To the southeast is the tall, whitewashed stucco wall of the River's Rest Hoosegow.  To the north boats are scattered in a wide, grassy yard.

title: [Fleet Captain's Boatyard]
description: Boats of various sizes...luggers, cutters, dories, square-bowed johnboats...lie scattered around the wide, grassy area beside the creek.  Some of the vessels are obviously under repair.  Others, irreparably damaged and set aside to rot, have become nearly lost in the tall grass.  A few of the smaller boats have been turned hull up, exposing their barnacle-covered bottoms.

title: [River's Rest, Citizen Clerk]
description: The rear wall of this small office is dominated by a massive oaken scroll cabinet.  A long counter bisects the room.  On the east wall hangs a small painting of a seascape.  Moonlight leaks in through an open window.

The rear wall of this small office is dominated by a massive oaken scroll cabinet.  A long counter bisects the room.  On the east wall hangs a small painting of a seascape.  Sunlight pours through an open window, which carries the sounds and smells of a nearby creek.

title: [River's Rest, Admiral's Court]
description: Stark whitewashed plaster walls are somewhat softened by darkly stained wood chair railings which surround the room.  There is a beautiful antique desk at one end of the room with a large polished brass ship's bell standing to its right side.  Several benches are provided for those with an interest in the legal proceedings of this small town.  Those coming before the Admiral do not have the luxury of being seated however.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Time has caused the wooden planks that form the walls to draw away from one another, letting in the smells and sounds of the river, along with several of its small, winged denizens.  A rocking chair and a braided rug give the room a homey feel, though the tall cabinets indicate more professional activities.  Several bundles of wildflowers hang upside-down from the rafters, perfuming the air as they dry and fade.

title: [Finiegan's Flooring]
description: The walls and floors of this shop are covered with a dazzling array of wood flooring samples.  The scents of fresh cut bark and tree sap intermingle with those of stain and varnish.

title: [Abalonia's Oceanic Artwork]
description: Beautiful wall hangings sway from the rafters in this small room, catching the moonlight and casting small rainbows of color on the walls.  A small stool rests in one corner, stacked with embroidery thread and tools.

Beautiful wall hangings sway from the rafters in this small room, catching the light and casting small rainbows of color on the walls.  A small stool rests in one corner, stacked with embroidery thread and tools.

title: [Fyria's Fireplaces]
description: Fireplaces, braziers and firepits are scattered haphazardly about this small room.

title: [Aeliena's Tables]
description: This room is filled with small tables of all shapes and description.  A copper lantern swings from the rafters, throwing shifting golden light across the room.

title: [Rael's Rugs and Carpets]
description: Piles of colorful carpets and rugs are stacked around the room.  A copper brazier sits in one corner, throwing out warmth and soft golden light.

title: [Tweedor's Bedding Shop]
description: Beds of all shapes and sizes line the walls, one piled atop another.  A copper lantern hangs from a hook on the wall, casting dancing shadows across the furnishings.

title: [Drezdin's Walls]
description: Various wall materials are cleverly displayed in small stands that are scattered about the room.  The pungent scent of fresh cedar drifts from the displays.

title: [Glimmera's Windows]
description: Cleverly designed displays house windows of all shapes and sizes.  A skylight, nestled high above, casts moonlight upon the various pieces.
Cleverly designed displays house windows of all shapes and sizes.  A skylight, nestled high above, casts clear light upon the various pieces.

title: [Secondfoot Floors]
description: Samples of flooring are stacked about the room.  Some are in excellent condition, while some seem to be pre-owned and broken in.  The smell of floor varnish and other, less pleasant scents, assail your nose, making your time here a truly unique experience.

title: [Comfy Catnaps]
description: Felines crawl all over the wares in this establishment.  Many are curled on the beds presented, sleeping the day away with contented expressions, while others play hide-and-seek under the beds and hammocks.  They, at least, seem to approve of what is being sold here.

title: [Classy Ceiling-Holders]
description: Pieces of wood serving as wall-covering samples hang from the ceiling, clicking against each other in the slight breeze.  The sound is very like windchimes, putting you at ease as you shop.  The rich scent of wood fills the air, pleasing to the nose and to the soul.

title: [Cleve's Sure Surfaces]
description: Sturdy tables and odd treestumps fill the room, seemingly all for sale.  While some look quite classy and stable, the others are much less certain in their quality.

title: [Views of the World]
description: Windows set into false walls dominate the shop, displaying the wares presented here.  Given the condition of a few of the portals, you have to wonder at the skill of the person making them.

title: [River's Rest Bank, Teller]
description: Unlike the other buildings in this town, this one is built of stone blocks, and decorated with wood beams.  When you realize that it is protecting the wealth of all who do business here, you can understand why.  Heavily armed guards watch over the lobby although you notice one flirting with a pretty elven teller who is currently between customers.  The window she is standing at is protected by heavy metal bars and appears to be very secure.

title: [River's Rest Realty]
description: A polished bamboo desk surrounded by comfortable wicker chairs sits in the middle of this modestly sized office.  Behind the desk hangs a large, yellowed map of River's Rest and the surrounding areas.  A pleasant-looking, bespectacled young man sits behind the desk with an eager smile.  Near the desk stands a tall chest containing drawers labelled "maps" and "deeds" as well as drawers devoted to letters of the alphabet.

title: [Ceraleth's Cartage]
description: On one side of the room a young couple speak earnestly with a clerk while their two children run in and around the long row of shipping crates.  The pale wood crates are marked with exotic runes and common lettering alike.  Nearby, another clerk whistles tunefully while he studies a long list of figures.  The mixed scent of wood dust and salt air wafts on the warm breeze that rolls in through the large open door.

title: [Calradian's Deed Conveyance]
description: Gauzy curtains flutter at the bamboo-framed windows of this cool and comfortable office.  A friendly-looking young woman fingers through stacks of contracts, humming happily.  Behind her, brightly colored cushions on wicker chairs provide a restful spot to sit and talk over details of deed transactions.

title: [River's Rest, Purser's Office]
description: Off the main lobby of the bank, the River's Rest purser's office is tucked away in a corner, out of the way of traffic.  Securely ensconced behind an old scarred wooden counter, the purser peers at his ledgers, while discussing the matters of finance his customers bring his way.  Efficiently and precisely, he notes each transaction completed in his ledger before he glances up to welcome his next customer with a smile.

title: [General Store]
description: Although small, this shop appears to be the depository for just about anything anyone could possibly want.  Precariously loaded shelves fill the room and customers avidly browse the inventory.  Standing at a roomy counter, keeping an eagle eye on the scene, is an elderly shopkeeper.  A fat grey cat graces the counter with his presence and looks up, annoyed, as a customer places a package too close to his tail, but he is soon catnapping once again in a patch of moonlight.
