Standing at a roomy counter, keeping an eagle eye on the scene, is an elderly shopkeeper.  A fat grey cat graces the counter with his presence and looks up, annoyed, as a customer places a package too close to his tail, but he is soon catnapping once again in a patch of sunlight.

title: [Alleyway]
description: The crowded alley is filled with clashing currents of pedestrians, flowing in both directions.  Here and there, handcarts disrupt the traffic, causing eddies and halts.  The cobblestone thoroughfare is remarkably busy, considering its narrow confines and crazy zigzagging route.   Overhead, the upper stories of buildings shade the street, their windows closed off by ornately carved wooden latticework which protects the inhabitants from the sight of strangers.

title: [Gamaliya Alley]
description: The alley opens a bit to accommodate a vaulted gateway.  Its surface is covered with intricately carved swashes and fanciful creatures intertwined.  A carved plaque is positioned in the center of the embellishment, inscribed with calligraphy that is ornate yet still readable.  Huddled in the shadow of the gateway are a couple of doors, their surfaces as richly decorated.  To the northeast, the alley widens and crowds cloak the entrance, the milling figures haloed with moonlight.

The alley opens a bit to accommodate a vaulted gateway.  Its surface is covered with intricately carved swashes and fanciful creatures intertwined.  A carved plaque is positioned in the center of the embellishment, inscribed with calligraphy that is ornate yet still readable.  Huddled in the shadow of the gateway are a couple of doors, their surfaces as richly decorated.  To the northeast, the alley widens and crowds cloak the entrance, the milling figures haloed with bright sunlight.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar]
description: The crowded bazaar assaults with sensation: heat, smells, the din of voices raised in peddlers' hawk.  Facades of buildings around its perimeter catch the clamor and send it back on itself.  The surrounding skyline is a jumble of soaring minarets and buildings crowded closely together.  Interspersed are the tops of tall lebbek trees, their thin foliage jutting up over the architecture like jaunty plumes in a patchwork hat.  Shaded by a pomegranate tree are an open air cafe and a small shop.

The crowded bazaar assaults with sensation: heat, exotic smells, the din of voices raised in peddlers' hawk.  Facades of buildings around its perimeter catch the clamor and send it back on itself.   In every direction, the surrounding skyline is a jumble of soaring minarets and buildings crowded together so closely, one could stroll easily from roof to roof.  Interspersed are the tops of tall lebbek trees, their thin foliage jutting up over the architecture like jaunty plumes in a patchwork hat.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Qasr al-Shawg ]
description: The cul-de-sac known as Qasr al-Shawg is a quiet one, ringed by tall houses standing closely side-by-side.  A few palm trees arch up from large terra-cotta urns sitting before the residences, their graceful fronds drooping in the heat.  In the center of the cul-de-sac sits a small fountain.  It sends up a small, desultory spray of water, which is tossed about by breezes wafting by.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Shop of Abdul]
description: Brightening the crammed shop with a rainbow of vivid hues, varied fabric bolts occupy every surface, heaped in precarious, pyramidal piles.  Dip-dyed sindon curtains stretch from one plaster wall to another, the peeling facades cluttered with leather straps and striped galabias.  Smoke coils from the smoldering chips inside a chalice-shaped brass incense burner nestled in the chaos on the counter, suffusing the air with the musky fragrance of agarwood.

The small shop is crammed with cloth of every type and description.  Vividly colored bolts sit on every surface, and straps and fragments of leather clutter the walls.  The whiskery old elf who is proprietor of the mayhem sidles toward you, smiling craftily.  He is wearing a striped galabia, the long, loose robe seen in abundance on the cobbled thoroughfares outside.  Heavy incense scents the air, coiling up from a lit stick stuck into a brazier on the counter.

title: [al'Khalili Coffeeshop]
description: Moonlight filters through the branches of a pomegranate tree hanging over one tall wall of this open air cafe.  The enclosed courtyard is ringed with partitioned alcoves and tables, and lebbek latticework arches overhead, connecting large swathes of sun-faded cotton.  Lit incense censers clutter the tabletops, casting a heavy haze of scented-smoke across the area, and dozens of lamps bring a dim illumination.  A tall cafe proprietor stands behind a counter covered in numerous braziers, coffeepots, cups, and bottles.

A low, arched door grants entrance to a courtyard ringed with partitioned alcoves and tables.  The lamps here are lit both day and night, and the calm, dreamy atmosphere seems to blur the edges of time and place.  Here and there, tabletops are littered with braziers, coffeepots and cups, along with small glasses that offer stronger poisons.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Sharia El Dona]
description: A cobblestone thoroughfare winds through rows of houses flanked by brightly colored tents, and venders selling all manner of wares from the backs of wagons.  Against the side of one house, a basket seller has set up shop.  The well-made merchandise sits beneath a red and white striped awning, different sized containers stacked one on top the other.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Nob Rala Court]
description: The road opens to allow the traffic to veer off down avenues leading in a number of directions.  It is shady, sheltered by the overhang of houses crammed into every available square foot of ground not taken by the thoroughfares.  A strong odor of coffee emerges from an awning stretched over a niche in a wall.  Beneath its striped canopy, a man brews the beverage over a small fire flickering in a large brazier.  Sacks of coffee beans are stacked around him like pillows.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Cheol Court]
description: The lane ends in a circular court, ringed by stately houses.  None of the street venders crowded into the busy avenues of Khan'Kel have penetrated into this plaza.  On the court's far side, one of the buildings houses a school, as advertised by the banner hanging outside its door sporting a spell-book, a candle and a wand.  The homes crowding close on all other sides have a graceful elegance and manicured shrubbery in pots outside many of the doors.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, El Kiza Market]
description: A circular market is surrounded by residences, shops and tents pitched in every available spot on the crowded paving stones.  The scents in the breeze are strong and varied, from coffee beans to flowers to livestock.  Chickens crow raucously from their wooden crates, and doves add their soft cooing to the cacophony.  Gaily striped pennants add color to the plaza, hanging from poles over the doors of homes and stores alike.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, El Kiza Alley]
description: El Kiza Alley is dank and dark, shadowed by the over-hang of ramshackle buildings crowding its length.  A gutter trench runs down the middle of the lane, and the paving stones on either side of it are irregular and treacherous.  Pockets of stale water are blocked here and there in the trench by garbage, and rats dart occasionally from cracks in building foundations to snatch a quick drink.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, El Mikimen Row]
description: The lane named after El Mikimen is less than orderly and pristine.  Gutters are clogged with debris and the homes are so crowded, they seem to share overlapping foundations.  Stray curs dash in and around holes in walls and legs of pedestrians.  A permeating odor of strongly spiced food pours from open windows on every side.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Tibek Circle]
description: Tibek Circle is an oddly shaped plaza, its perimeter more kidney-shaped than round.  Bordering it on all sides are homes built snugly next to one another.  In the center of the court stands a large sculpture depicting a lean muscular figure.  It stands on a base of polished granite, its color a deep shade of grey.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Tibek Alley]
description: The walls of Tibek Alley are pocked with a riot of shapes, carved with Onaresque symbols and now-indistinct script.  Homes lining the narrow way are bunched together, standing locked in an attitude of attention like hapless soldiers unable to stand at ease.  The crowds have thinned here to a mere dribble, waning as the lane proceeds into shadow.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Ghaza Court]
description: Palm trees ring a small court, dividing the houses with their luxurious fronds.  The homes are spaced more generously, some boasting attractive awnings and small patio gardens.  Residents hurry past occasionally, their arms laden with wrapped parcels, large bunches of fresh flowers and baskets full with freshly baked bread.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, El Kiza Mews]
description: The Mews consists of a tall line of houses down each side of a narrow, but straight lane.  At each end, the avenue veers away, giving the straightaway an enclosed feeling of privacy.  Above some of the homes fly family crests woven on banners, and the stoops are maintained in scrupulous condition.  Small shrubbery planted in urns are placed intermittently down the block.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Faraf Way East]
description: Faraf Way meanders through a cluster of homes with gaily patterned banners fluttering from latticework above the doors.  The street is crowded and the ever-present awnings of street venders add more pattern to the busy view.  Above the craggy roofline of homes, a line of lebbek trees is visible, their tops swaying in the light breeze.

title: [Felinium's Fur Emporium]
description: The walls of this small shop appear to be covered with the furs and skins of all types of creatures.  Closer inspection reveals that many are still being prepared for use, although an occasional impeccably finished specimen is found.  Hunt souvenirs rest on a set of shelves tucked in one corner, where a cluster of roughly clad traders have gathered to examine them closely.

title: [Diamante's Gemshop]
description: With a smile that sparkles as does her wares, Diamante dusts a sturdy display case, inspecting the assorted gems within as she does.  Her shop is neat and tidy, with comfortable chairs and tables scattered about for her customers to enjoy as they examine particularly interesting items - such as the rings a young couple examine in one corner.  A small bell sounds as the shop door opens, bringing yet another group into this cheerfully warm establishment.

title: [Diamante's Gemshop, Backroom]
description: Small, round tables scattered across a creaky wooden floor comprise this small backroom shop.  Each of the tables has been covered with a cream-colored linen cloth, providing ample space for the shop's wide variety of wares.  A brass lamp hanging from one wall serves as the only decorative piece in this quaint little space, and an iron-worked rich maoral door is inset into the back wall.

Small, round tables scattered across a creaky wooden floor comprise this small backroom shop.  Each of the tables has been covered with a cream-colored linen cloth, providing ample space for the shop's wide variety of wares.  A brass lamp hanging from one wall serves as the only decorative piece in this quaint little space.

title: [Hortinger's Armory, Lobby]
description: Colorful and detailed murals cover the walls of this shop, depicting battles large and small.  Many of the weapons on display in racks scattered throughout the room figure prominently in the scenes.  However, a few look very unfamiliar.  Wandering between the racks and a large counter, the store's clerk polishes the inventory to a bright sheen, helping his customers as he does so.

title: [Hortinger's Armory, Armaments]
description: A young man in a thick leather apron is obviously overworked as he hurries about, trying to aid the roomful of customers that are browsing through the racks and trunks of weapons.  Finely crafted armor hangs on sturdy hooks on the wall, and a variety of other accoutrements are displayed on counters and tables.  Draped across the wall over the armor display, an old, tattered pirate's flag is a clear warning to any potential thieves.

title: [Uxbri's Cut-Rate Firewood]
description: A massive pile of split logs dominates the back of the small tent, and the pleasant smell of freshly chopped wood fills the air.  Sawdust and chips of wood cover the floor, and small footprints lead out of the tent.

title: [River's Rest, Quay Shelter]
description: A soft river breeze blows gently through the stucco shelter.  The occasional, plaintive cry of a sea bird can be heard over the sound of the river chuckling against the stones of the quay.  A pair of wicker benches with woven reed seats occupy two of the low shelter walls.  A low altar stands in the center of the shelter.

A soft river breeze blows gently through the small, open-sided, stucco shelter.  The plaintive cries of marsh birds can be heard over the sound of the river chuckling through the reeds.  A low altar stands in the center of the shelter.

title: [Bertha Crabbe's, Hallway]
description: The wide planks of the floor have warped over time and are scuffed from years of foot traffic.  Thin cracks between the floorboards let the sound of slow-moving water filter up from below.  The walls of the hallway, however, are covered with fresh coat of gleaming white paint.

title: [Bertha Crabbe's Stuff and Such]
description: Although the wide-planked floor is warped, it is waxed and polished to a high gleam.  The plaster walls, painted a cheery yellow, are decorated with small images of local flora.  A pair of brass oil lamps, mounted on opposite walls, add a flickering glow to the ambient moonlight from the window.  Beneath a series of brass hooks is a large modwir bin.  A tall rack stands against the wall.  A sturdy oak table stands in the center of the room.

A pair of brass oil lamps, mounted on opposite walls, add a flickering glow to the ambient light from the window.  Beneath a series of brass hooks is a large modwir bin.  A tall rack stands against the wall.  A sturdy oak table stands in the center of the room.

title: [Galena's Lockworks]
description: A wooden counter divides this small workshop.  The flickering flames of a brazier reflect off the two tall, glazed windows, bathing the room in yellowish light.  An impressive array of antique locks and keys can be seen in a display case.  Behind the counter, leaning against a tall oak filing cabinet, is the smiling but watchful owner, the widow Galena.  A sign hangs above the counter.

A wooden counter divides this small workshop.  Two tall, glazed windows allow the room to be filled with a soft, diffused light.  An impressive array of antique locks and keys can be seen in a display case.  Behind the counter, leaning against a tall oak filing cabinet, is the smiling but watchful owner, the widow Galena.  A sign hangs above the counter.

title: [Moomph's Picklesmithy]
description: The spice-laden odor of pickle brine pervades the small, quiet shop.  Pale beams of moonlight filter through a pair of small windows.  Ceramic oil lamps hanging from the beamed ceiling illuminate three large pickle barrels and a pair of stubby, wooden tubs.  An oak-topped counter holds a few tall jars and ceramic jugs.  A sign hangs on the wall above the counter.  Moonlit greenery can be seen through an archway leading to the east.

The spice-laden odor of pickle brine pervades the small, quiet shop.  Sunlight filtering through a pair of small windows illuminates three large pickle barrels and a pair of stubby, wooden tubs.  An oak-topped counter holds a few tall jars and ceramic jugs.  A sign hangs on the wall above the counter.  Greenery can be seen through an archway leading to the east.

title: [Moomph's Garden]
description: The silvery moonlight gives this tidy little side yard garden plot a mystical glow.  Vines, laden with cucumbers in various stages of growth, twine on a series of low wooden trellises.  A gardener's bench occupies one corner of the plot.  The walls of the surrounding shops block the noise, making the small garden an oasis of quietude.

The bright sunlight turns this tidy little side yard garden plot into a green jewel.  Vines, laden with cucumbers in various stages of growth, twine on a series of low wooden trellises.  A gardener's bench occupies one corner of the plot.  The walls of the surrounding shops block the noise, making the small garden an oasis of quietude.

title: [Watchtower, Main Floor]
description: The thick stucco walls of the watchtower keep the room cool.  Moonlight filters in through a number of cross-shaped arrow loops.  A commemorative shield is hung on the wall beside a rack of oak-hafted spears.  A wooden stairway leading up follows the curve of the wall.

The thick stucco walls of the watchtower keep the room cool.  Sunlight filters in through a number of cross-shaped arrow loops.  A commemorative shield is hung on the wall beside a rack of oak-hafted spears.  A wooden stairway leading up follows the curve of the wall.

title: [Watchtower, Second Floor]
description: This room is a jumble of wooden crates, rolled-up mattresses, bins of arrow shafts, and other supplies necessary for withstanding a siege.  Numerous arrow loops allow the light to stream in.  A wooden stairway leading down follows the curve of the wall.  At the top of the stairway is a rope, which hangs from a narrow trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [Watchtower, Rooftop]
description: In the moonlight you can see the entire southern approach to River's Rest...the wide river all the way from the Tempest Falls in the east to Maelstrom Bay in the west, the South River Road, the town drawbridge.  To the north and west, with the exception of the busy Merchant's Walk and the onion-shaped spire of a minaret, much of the town itself is hidden by the trees.  A length of rope tied to an iron stanchion drops down through a trapdoor in the floor.

From here you are able to see the entire southern approach to River's Rest...the wide river all the way from the Tempest Falls in the east to Maelstrom Bay in the west, the South River Road, the town drawbridge.  To the north and west, with the exception of the busy Merchant's Walk and the onion-shaped spire of a minaret, much of the town itself is hidden by the trees.  A length of rope tied to an iron stanchion drops down through a trapdoor in the floor.

title: [Relynard's Pawnshop]
description: A bit brighter than it appears from the alley outside, this small shop is piled haphazardly with all manner of goods.  A pile of armor in one corner is complimented by a row of neatly arranged weapons in another corner.  Shelves full of other assorted items tower along the walls and seem ready to fall at the slightest touch.  Relynard is resting at his counter, apparently asleep.  However, you somehow know he is not and you resolve to watch your step.

title: [Relynard's Pawnshop]
description: A narrow beam of moonlight filters down through the grimy skylight.  Four tables are crowded into the small room, leaving little space for moving.  The wide-planked walls are marred by scratches and holes where prospective customers have tested the points and blades of various weapons.

Motes of dust are illuminated in the stingy shaft of sunlight that finds its way through the grimy skylight.  Four tables are crowded into the small room, leaving little space for moving.  The wide-planked walls are marred by scratches and holes where prospective customers have tested the points and blades of various weapons.

title: [Targon's Tavern, Tap Room]
description: Revelry seems to be the order of the day in this spacious room.  Targon reigns at fireside, exchanging tales of heroism with his customers which border on the impossible, but no one seems to mind.  As the tavern's back door opens to admit yet another hungry and thirsty traveler a barmaid makes her way to the bar, filling her tray with an order for the table in the corner.  Behind the gleaming bar, a wizened dwarf bartender awaits his next order, polishing the bartop with a well-used rag while he waits.

title: [Timor's Storage, Lobby]
description: Aged floorboards soften the echoes of the busy foot traffic passing in an out of the building.  Oil lamps mounted on the walls light the way for those hurrying in and out of the locker entryway to the east.  Chatter from the nearby office spills out into the lobby when voices grow heated.  One whole wall is almost completely covered with shop advertisements, meeting notices, and warrants.

title: [Timor's Storage, Hallway]
description: You are in a dimly lit hallway.  The torches on the walls flicker and fade casting all manner of shadows about the hallway.

title: [Timor's Storage, Shipping]
description: Overcrowded and piled with stacks of papers, some stamped RUSH in big red letters, the stuffy and small office looks tidy for all the chaos that it contains.  An occassional draft rustles the top layers of each stack, threatening to scatter papers everywhere.

title: [Hornswoggler's Tent]
description: There is a strong funk of recently disturbed dust and pungent smoke in the still air of the small tent.  A small, smoky oil lamp provides a dim yellowish light.  In the back of the tent a remarkably homely giantman snoozes while leaning against a pair of sturdy-looking strongboxes.  The hornswoggler sits cross-legged on a bamboo mat, smoking tobacco from a hookah.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Lobby]
description: Spacious and airy, the lobby of this small island inn welcomes the weary traveler.  Tucked away in the far corner of the room, a simple wooden staircase spirals up, out of sight, to the second floor.  Casual groups of comfortably worn sofas and chairs are scattered about.  At the base of the staircase, a jovial innkeeper stands behind a massive counter, passing out keys and keeping an eye on the lobby.  Occasional bursts of laughter filter in from the archway to the north.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Meeting Hall]
description: Like any good inn, this one has a meeting hall, well suited to large gatherings.  This hall serves as a gathering spot for those interested in relaxing in the company of good friends.  There is an oaken doorway leading to a dining area featuring several tables with high-backed chairs and off to one side you notice a small door that just might lead to a kitchen, judging from the wonderful smells that seem to come from that direction.  At the far end of the room, a small stage rises above the main floor.

title: [River's Rest, Dining Room]
description: Fresh cooked meats and herbs beckon you to have a seat at one of the many tables here and enjoy some of the towns finest meals.  A servant passes you with a smile as she continues to a nearby table to deliver a feast for some of the hungry customers.  From a door to the south you hear an occasional rattle of pots and pans.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Sitting Room]
description: Smaller and more intimate than the lobby, this sitting room is graced by a large fireplace with a massive mantel.  Underfoot, a light grey carpeting muffles footsteps that would otherwise echo throughout the room.  The grey of the carpeting complements the unusual plaster walls, which are painted a shade of blue which reminds you of the color of the waters of Maelstrom Bay on a clear sunny day.  In one corner, beside an inscribed brass plaque, an ornamental sword hangs above a large copper kettle.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Narrow Hall]
description: Many plaques and paintings adorn the walls here as light from ceiling windows reflect down on them.  An elegant oak staircase leads up to an open balcony of the upper floor.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Overlook]
description: A breath-taking view of the lower hallway makes you stop and admire the beauty of the intricately carved walls and plaques below.  An elegant painting hangs from the northern wall.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Guest Bedroom]
description: Space is all that this room was designed for as the bed and chest take up only a small fraction of the room.  Fresh flowers stand on a trunk near a window on the south side of the room.  A fragrance you are not quite sure of fills the room and puts you at ease.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Upper Hallway]
description: Smaller but still as lavish as the one on the ground floor, this hallway is well lit by a large window on the far eastern wall.  Small vases of flowers stand in each of the corners of the room.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Guest Bedroom]
description: Set in the corner of the second floor, this is one of the rare rooms that is built with two windows, one on the southern and one on the eastern walls.  Of the dozens of flowers placed throughout the area, a single red rose sitting on a window ledge catches your eye.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Guest Bedroom]
description: The bare wooden planked walls and growing ferns here give thoughts of a forest clearing with brushes and trees amidst.

title: [Carousel Court, Roundabout Way]
description: Small windchimes dangle from the overhangs on several domiciles lining the quiet street, clinking against each other to create a natural concert.  Silver Park rolls out to the southeast, dominated by the large carousel at its far end.  A steep hill slopes up against the bushes defining the yards in the neighborhood, providing a sporting venue for the children sledding down them on sheets of metal and many kinds of shields.

title: [Carousel Court, Roundabout Way]
description: Surrounding the busy Silver Park, Roundabout Way is a much quieter respite from the din.  Evergreen bushes line the roadway, a guardian to the yards fronting neighborhood houses whose windows overlook the fields.  A dog barks frequently in the distance breaking the quiet that otherwise reigns over the area.

title: [Carousel Court, Roundabout Way]
description: Footprints from roaming neighborhood animals in search of a dry haven are temporarily enshrined in the dried mud in the middle of the road.  Sounds of cheerful music drift over on the wind from Silver Park, sharing the winds with the happy cries of children at play.  Bungalows and quaint houses are built back into the protective slopes of the gentle rolling hills abutting the neighborhood.

title: [Carousel Court, Roundabout Way]
description: Quaint houses line the avenue, their yards defined by flowering hedges that double as property lines and decorative fences.  A few small gardens are planted between the homes, some filled with a rainbow of blooming flowers and others with fruits and vegetables.

title: [Carousel Court, Silver Park]
description: The northern end of Silver Park is less crowded than its southern counterpart, lush with a large expanse of carefully groomed grasses.  Playground equipment of all kinds dot the land, frequently in use by gleeful children and adults.  The centerpiece of the city park, The Silver Park Carousel, dominates the southern end of the grounds - a testament to the artisans who poured their heart and soul into its construction.

title: [Carousel Court, Silver Park]
description: Silver Park stretches out to the north, a playground for both young and old alike.  Verdant green grass thrives in the nourished land, surrounding a brilliantly colored Carousel.  The Silver Park Carousel, reputedly the largest of its kind in the world, bears many fantastic carvings of creatures painted in every color of the rainbow parading about its wide circular expanse.

title: [Carousel Court, Roundabout Way]
description: A street sign stands half buried in a riverbank, its wooden vanes pointing the way to Whirlaway Lane to the northwest and to the continuations of Roundabout Way to the northeast and south.  Small rock pathways lead up to the front doors of houses, many doorways bearing seasonal decorations for upcoming and past festivities.

title: [Carousel Court, Roundabout Way]
description: A pattern of boxes marked in chalk covers the scuffed roadway, hinting at spritied and frequent games of hopscotch.  A streetlamp flickers fitfully on the corner, dimly illuminating the area.

A pattern of boxes marked in chalk covers the scuffed roadway, hinting at spritied and frequent games of hopscotch.  A streetlamp flickers fitfully on the corner, failing in its attempt to add further light to the brilliant day.

title: [Carousel Court, Whirlaway Lane]
description: Smoke puffs from brick and clay chimneys, and the windows of the houses glow with the fires lit within.  Collected rainfall drips from the gutters of the houses along the lane, flowing into rainbarrels that lead to pipes that disappear into the ground, perhaps to route the water back to the sea.

title: [Carousel Court, Whirlaway Lane]
description: A scarecrow stands at the side of the roadway, his arms in the air directing phantom traffic.  Several shaky wooden forts built by children guard the neighborhood yards, piles of mud ready for a spirited defense.

title: [Carousel Court, Whirlaway Lane]
description: A gentle breeze wafts across verdant green fields, rustling the tall grass and wildflowers, wending its way across the landscape.  Several carefully constructed residences back up onto the picturesque expanse, enfolded by a long grassy knoll.  A lazy river winds through the field, feeding a stand of whispering willows that crowd the banks as if in search of a cooler spot on a hot sunny day.

title: [Carousel Court, Whirlaway Lane]
description: The entrance to the square lies to the southeast, the gate clacking loudly in the wind, its latch broken beyond repair.  The quiet neighborhood silence is broken by laughing children engaging in all kinds of games like jump rope, hopscotch, and pitching stones.

title: [Carousel Court, Whirlaway Lane]
description: A marker announces the former site of a large stable, the land now in use by several nice residences.  The fencing used to define the track now surrounds several of the houses, turned into a beautiful white picket line.

title: [Carousel Court, Archway Square]
description: Archway Square receives its name from the magnificent arch colonnade lining the perimeter.  Each arch is uniquely carved by artisans residing in town and kept up by dedicated crews each night. Houses within Archway Square stand aloof, regally reflecting the light bouncing off the beautiful columns near them.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south

title: [Carousel Court, Archway Square]
description: A colonnade parades around the edges of the square, sun glinting off the translucent surfaces.  Dark shadows lance across the ground, an echo of the arches leaping overhead.  During festivals, Archway Square is used by merchants and travelling shows to display artistic talent.

title: [Carousel Court, Archway Square]
description: Each archway has a unique design, representative of many artistic styles of the lands.  In the center of the square stands a totem bearing faces of each of the races involved in the construction of Archway Square.  A smattering of houses surrounds the plaza, overlooking the graceful columns.

title: [Carousel Court, Archway Square]
description: Small racks and shelves sit off to the side of the square, ready for use during the next neighborhood festival.  A fountain burbles happily in the square, surrounded by the massive artistic colonnade and bungalows set just off the plaza.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Carousel Court, Whirlaway Lane]
description: The housing along Whirlaway Lane echoes that of Roundabout Way, although the coloring is a shade different.  Heavy timber struts in the buildings stave off the weather.  Bright lights glow from windows all along the block, proof of the hardy folk that live within.

title: [Carousel Court, Roundabout Way]
description: A sparkling silver sign graces the southwestern entrance to Silver Park.  Brightly colored bunting spirals down the poles in a red, green, and blue braid.  An intricate wrought iron fence abuts the festive sign, continuing around the perimeter of the fields.  A few houses dot the opposite side of the road, affording them a panoramic view of the unusual landmark.

title: [Carousel Court, Roundabout Way]
description: The southern entrance to Silver Park is guarded by a massive wrought iron gate encrusted in clear crystal.  Moonlight reflects off the prisms, illuminating the area in a soft glow.  Marking the southern side of the road, undulating earthen mounds act as fences to for small houses with a spectacular view of the beautiful grounds of the park.

The southern entrance to Silver Park is guarded by a massive wrought iron gate encrusted in clear crystal.  Sunlight bounces off the prisms, throwing rainbows of color everywhere.  Marking the southern side of the road, undulating earthen mounds act as fences to for small houses with a spectacular view of the beautiful grounds of the park.

title: [Mistean's Charming Chairs]
description: A precise arrangement of chairs rings a long oval table in the center of this airy room.  The chairs are facing outward, however, so that prospective customers can try out each one.  A small child plays on a red velvet chair, her half eaten piece of chocolate coming into dangerously close range of its elegant gold trim.  In one corner, a harried mother gesticulates and a plump sales clerk politely pays attention while keeping one nervous eye on his threatened chair.

title: [Mistean's Charming Chairs]
description: Tufts of cottony stuffing, long-handled mithril scissors, loops of heavy thread, and unwound bolts of velvet and brocade litter every available bit of space in this back room.  Lining the two long walls, rows of chairs in various states of completion display a lesson in the art of chair making.  Pearly moonlight streams in through the large window at the far end of the room.

Tufts of cottony stuffing, long-handled mithril scissors, loops of heavy thread, and unwound bolts of velvet and brocade litter every available bit of space in this back room.  Lining the two long walls, rows of chairs in various states of completion display a lesson in the art of chair making.  At the far end of the room a large open window lets in sunlight and fresh air, keeping this workroom pleasant and comfortable.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: Dark wooden trellises are positioned against the walls of the guild, and lush ivy has wrapped around the structures so completely as to nearly obscure the building.  A simple dirt path leads northward into a small valley where a ring of willows lies, and soft white flowers line its edges.  Blades of long grass sway slowly with every gentle breeze that passes through the area, and the quiet sounds of nature abound in this peaceful garden.

title: [Cleric Guild, Garden Shrine]
description: Cloaked in shades of deep verdant, this small retreat is enshrouded by willows all around, while vines of ivy twine around their bases.  Flowers of every hue imaginable blossom here and there, adding a splash of vibrant color to the lush green which is so prominent in the area.  Standing to the north, a wooden statue of a woman with benevolent eyes gazes down kindly at you, and at her feet lies a simple wooden altar, its surface completely covered by flourishing white lilies.

title: [Relegan's Fletcher Shop]
description: Small intertwined branches make up the walls of this small workshop.  Carved from the stump of a haon tree, a counter sits in the middle of the room, partially covered in woodshavings and cut feathers.  Lining the walls are shelves which hold bows and crossbows, a dark curtain situated between two of them.

title: [Mislin Hall, Entry]
description: A rustic chandelier crafted from an old ship's wheel casts a ruddy glow across a polished maoral floor inlaid with a detailed pattern in knotted pale oak.  Weapon racks and full suits of armor guard archways leading off the entry foyer, and a plush green runner softens a grand staircase leading to the second floor.

title: [Mislin Hall, Clerk's Office]
description: Dark maoral paneling and sparse furnishings -- only a desk and bookcase -- make for an austere and purely functional office.  Two shallow wooden boxes sit atop the desk, each filled with neatly penned documents, while parchment scrolls and thick ledgers fill the bookcase and lend a musty bite to the air.

title: [Mislin Hall, Supply Office]
description: A restrained chaos dominates the supply office of the Adventurer's Guild.  Bolts of fabric are scattered about the area, covering walls, tables, and floor with garish combinations of color.  Half-finished project lists are strewn across the tables or stuffed haphazardly onto shelves.  A long oak counter blocks access to the work area, which features a more orderly selection of wares, including many fine weapons and jewelry items arranged in peculiar pairings on the various display racks.

title: [Mislin Hall, Hallway]
description: A narrow green runner follows the length of the hall from a maoral-framed slatted door and down the staircase to the main floor.  Faded paintings adorn the hallway, alternating with brass candle sconces and closed doors.

title: [Mislin Hall, Master's Office]
description: Moonlight casts faint colored beams through a stained glass picture window set in the western wall and glints off the antique brass sextant set upon the marble-topped table below it.  The golden luster of the plank flooring is worn dull in a path between the headmaster's desk and a maoral-framed door.  A thick leather-bound ledger lies open and askew on the surface of the teak desk, and dark stains ring the inkpot and quill perched beside it.

Sunlight casts brightly colored beams through a stained glass picture window set in the western wall and glints off the antique brass sextant set upon the marble-topped table below it.  The golden luster of the plank flooring is worn dull in a path between the headmaster's desk and a maoral-framed door.  A thick leather-bound ledger lies open and askew on the surface of the teak desk, and dark stains ring the inkpot and quill perched beside it.

title: [Pavilion of the Bells]
description: The tall columns of green riverstone support a large dome.  The interior is lined with deep blue diamond-shaped ceramic tiles.  Dense ivy vines grow in abundance between the columns.  Lining the side and rear walls of the pavilion is a complex oaken frame on which tens of thousands of small, tubular silver bells are hung.  Hanging in the center of the pavilion, directly above a large, lichen-covered stone, is a large tubular bell.  A ball-headed mallet hangs on a leather thong beside the bell.

title: [Museum, Entrance Hall]
description: A gigantic mosaic forms the floor of the entrance hall.  Exhibit rooms branch off in the cardinal directions.  The circular stairway at the back of the hall is blocked off by a velvet rope barrier.  A small sign stands beside the graceful arched doorway leading out.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Museum, Exhibit Room]
description: The room smells of beeswax and incense.  A large, faded tapestry graces one of the walls.  Standing in a corner of the room is a tall statue of a brawny man in armor.  A pair of crossed spears border the exit.  A wide shelf on one wall overhangs a sturdy exhibit table.

title: [Museum, Exhibit Room]
description: In the center of the room is a sturdy oak platform holding a slab of riverstone.  Overhanging an oak table in the back is a family portrait of a man and woman.  A tall wig stand in the corner holds a wig of dark, tightly-curled hair.  The room smells slightly of beeswax and incense.

title: [Museum, Exhibit Room]
description: An exhibit table is flanked by a pair of very tall ceramic vases.  Hanging from the ceiling is a giant stuffed lizard.  A shelf along the wall contains a number of smaller items.  A large pick-axe with a silver head leans in the corner.  The pleasant scent of beeswax and incense suffuses the room.

title: [Museum, Exhibit Room]
description: A thick carpet covers the floor.  The subtle scent of beeswax and incense infiltrates the room.  A delicate maoral stand against the wall holds a small sand timer.  Leaning against the wall are two giant palm frond fans.  A pair of massive ivory tusks flank a long shelf.

title: [Lomara's Supernatural Supplies]
description: The interior of the small bungalow is awash in peculiar smells...sour stinks, sweet aromas, sharp odors, oily scents, metallic effluvia, fetid reeks.  Shelves of potions in odd-shaped jars and phials line one wall.  The doors of a large cabinet are ajar, providing a tantalizing glimpse of elixirs, nostrums, amulets and periapts.

title: [Lomara's, Consignment]
description: The bungalow extends into a smaller area which houses a large maoral counter.  The wooden floor to the front of it remains clean and clear, while the area behind the counter is stacked with a number of storage bins varying in size and color.

title: [Lomara's, Used Emporium]
description: Opposite the consignment counter, this corner offers a display of used goods.  One of Lomara's assistants stands behind the table offering assistance to potential buyers.

title: [Collip's Transcendental Gear]
description: An aura of tranquility and somber introspection suffuses the bungalow.  A wisp of smoke, coiling up from ceramic censer molded to resemble a large turtle, carries the sweet odor of cinnamon.  An equipment rack and a tall cabinet stand against one of the pale stucco walls.  A brass-bound chest is pushed into one corner.  Beneath an intricate mosaic is a small wooden crate.

title: [South River Road, Drawbridge]
description: A worn but sturdy drawbridge spans the vast river here, connecting the road with the town on the opposite bank.  Some of the more daring children from town make sport of jumping off the bridge into the water below, swimming quickly to the beach a short way down the river.  You also see a road winding westward to a wide body of water while to the east it travels further up river.

timeto.10840: ;e if Char.citizenship == "River's Rest" || invisible? ; 0.2; else; nil; end

title: [River Beach]
description: The river widens here past the town, opening up and emptying into a large bay of water.  Sand lines the mouth of the river, making it a convenient place for people to sit about and relax.  A path between two ancient, gnarled olive trees leads to the southeast.  The land rises to the southwest, creating a bluff overlooking the bay.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bluff]
description: This bluff overlooks the vast body of water known to the locals as Maelstrom Bay.  Despite the name, the bay is quite beautiful.  The moonlight reflects off the gentle waves lapping up on shore, and local fishermen practice their trade in the plentiful waters.

This bluff overlooks the vast body of water known to the locals as Maelstrom Bay.  Despite the name, the bay is quite beautiful.  The sunlight reflects off the gentle waves lapping up on shore, and local fishermen practice their trade in the plentiful waters.

title: [Bluff, Maelstrom Bay]
description: Scrub grasses cling tenaciously to this rocky bluff.  A constant wind blows off the bay and across the hilltop, scouring the ground and exposing numerous large, flat boulders.

title: [Courtyard]
[Beacon Hall, Courtyard]
description: The building is comprised entirely of huge red sandstone blocks.  The upper story is accented with airy galleries and latticework windows of white-and-red marble.  A tall door frame of ornately carved basalt surrounds an antique wooden door.  Numerous torches held in wrought iron sconces illuminate the house's exterior and surrounding courtyard.

Silhouetted against the bay, an imposing structure dominates the paved courtyard.  The building is comprised entirely of huge red sandstone blocks.  The upper story is accented with airy galleries and latticework windows of white-and-red marble.  A tall door frame of ornately carved basalt surrounds an antique wooden door.

title: [Bluff, Narrow Precipice]
description: A strong wind whips around the side of the bluff, attempting to dislodge anything foolish enough to venture up to this precipice.  The way ends here as the trail ahead has apparently lost its battle to stay attached to the bluff.  A sheer drop to the bay hundreds of feet below cuts off further advance, and the sheer cliff face makes upward travel possible only if one has wings.  The only safe exit is back down the trail.

title: [Shady Trail]
description: Olive trees, ancient and gnarled, line the moon-dappled path.  The muted sound of a river flowing nearby competes with the wind blowing through the thick, grey-green leaves.  Branches overhang the path in places, making the path appear almost tunnel-like.  A mortared-stone structure stands nearby.

Olive trees, ancient and gnarled, line the sun-dappled path.  The muted sound of a river flowing nearby competes with the wind blowing through the thick, grey-green leaves.  Branches overhang the path in places, making the path appear almost tunnel-like.  A mortared-stone structure stands nearby.

title: [Shady Trail]
description: Olive trees, their trunks gnarled like the calloused hands of old crones, grow ragged and wild on either side of the path.  A soft breeze rustling through the grey-green leaves carries the faint and distant sound of birdsong.

title: [Shady Trail]
description: The trail winds among the trees.  From behind a gap in the thick yew hedge to the southwest comes the clanging of hammers on anvils and the sizzle of hot metals.  The smell of burning charcoal competes with the pleasant odor of fresh sawdust.  To the north is a grove of gnarled olive trees.  Southeast, the path leads to a wide clearing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, west

title: [River's Rest Forging Supply]
description: Tucked behind a massive hedge, the area is surrounded with dense foliage.  A small raised platform rests in the center, stocked with shelves of oils, metal, and glyphs.  Pillars of smoke rise from behind the platform, accompanied by ringing hammer-falls.

title: [Grassy Clearing]
description: To the north of the clearing stands a long, decorative stone wall crafted from grey and brown native stone.  The wall is barely tall enough to deter a halfling child at its westernmost end but it grows in height as it progresses eastward, where it joins a larger wall of formidable proportions.  The thick green grass in the clearing is cropped close to the ground, as though some sheep-like creature has been grazing on it.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entryway]
description: A long wall of native grey stone extends across a clearing, interrupted only by a wrought iron gate.  Two tall modwir trees stand guard a few paces in front of the entrance.

A long wall of native grey stone extends across a clearing, interrupted only by a wrought iron gate.  Two tall modwir trees stand guard a few paces in front of the entrance, their wide branches providing plentiful shade.  A grassy courtyard can be glimpsed through the wide bars of the gate.

title: [Overgrown Trail]
description: The trail is clotted with tall weeds and clumps of thistle.  Scattered among the stumpy olive trees are a few thin haon and mahogany trees.  Green with mold and lichen, the trees lean over the trail at strange angles.  A few dead and dying vines hang from the gnarled and twisted branches of the trees.

title: [Overgrown Trail]
description: A network of thin vines covers the oddly bent trees like some sort of shabby netting.  The trees grow closely together, intertwining with each other, slowly killing each other.  The tall grasses grow in regular clumps.  They sway in the moonlight as if in devout prayer.

A network of thin vines covers the oddly bent trees like some sort of shabby netting.  The trees grow closely together, intertwining with each other, slowly killing each other.  Tall grasses grow in the few patches where sunlight filters through.

title: [Overgrown Trail]
description: The foliage of the trees combined with the hundreds of vines that enshroud them is so thick as to keep the area in almost total darkness.  Tiny yellow flowers luminesce in the pallid threads of moonlight.  Tall, segmented grasses grow on the trail, making it difficult to follow.  Underfoot are a few haphazardly placed and badly cracked paving stones.

The foliage of the trees combined with the hundreds of vines that enshroud them is so thick as to keep the area in perpetual near-gloom.  Tiny yellow flowers grow in bright profusion on the upper vines.  Tall, segmented grasses grow on the trail, making it difficult to follow.  Underfoot are a few haphazardly placed and badly cracked paving stones.

title: [Overgrown Trail]
description: Thick, leafy vines hang between the tall trees.  Smaller vines grow on the larger vines, and strange mosses grow on the smaller ones, giving the entire area a shaggy look.  Only a few pale beams of moonlight filter through the dense growth.  A tall, moss-covered stone pillar stands to one side of the obscure trail.  Bits of stone lie scattered throughout the area.

Thick, leafy vines hang between the tall trees.  Smaller vines grow on the larger vines, and strange mosses grow on the smaller ones, giving the entire area a shaggy look.  Only a few pale beams of sunlight filter through the dense growth.  A tall, moss-covered stone pillar stands to one side of the obscure trail.  Bits of stone lie scattered throughout the area.

title: [Overgrown Trail]
description: The foliage is so dense that it is jungle-like.  It's difficult to determine the direction of the path.  Segmented grasses, some as tall as an adult halfling, shift and rattle with the breeze.  A slight smell of decaying vegetation filters through the air.  Giant, primitive-looking ferns grow in abundance.

title: [South River Road]
description: You can see some of the town inhabitants sitting in the moonlight on the opposite bank of the river.  In fact, the whole town looks to be a very restful and relaxed place.  Local businesses and shops line the roads that you can see in town, displaying their goods for all to see.

You can see some of the town inhabitants sunning themselves on the opposite bank of the river.  In fact, the whole town looks to be a very restful and relaxed place.  Local businesses and shops line the roads that you can see in town, displaying their goods for all to see.

title: [South River Road]
description: The river branches here at the edge of a stone breakwater surrounding the riverfront of this part of town.  As a result, the river is slowed down considerably as it flows around the north and south sides of town.  You also see a watchtower overlooking the road and the eastern half of town, its guards wary of any mischievous travelers.

title: [South River Road]
description: Stifling waves of heat blow a hot mist over you making breathing difficult.  Small droplets of water condense onto the orchids, which have replaced the roses in the arch overhead.  A small amount of moonlight filters its way through the thick foliage of the arch to illuminate your way.

Birdsong accompanied by the soft roar of the waterfall fills your ears.  The road runs east and west here, along the sparkling water.  The air is fresh, and the cool wet breeze feels nice on your face.

title: [A Narrow Path]
description: Trees crowd the path, growing so close to your north that it is hard to see a trail through them at all.  Birdsong is the only accompaniment to the sound of leaves rustling beneath your feet as you pass and the bustle of civilization is nowhere to be heard.

title: [Grassland Path]
description: Freshly shorn grass contrasts the chaotic tangle of greenery surrounding this path.  The twists and turns of the trail make it impossible to see much in either direction, a glance forward or back revealing nothing but a wall of trees and bushes.

title: [Dense Grove]
description: Moonlight trickles through from above, its presence nothing more than a whisper among the army of massive trees.  A small horned owl peers down at the passage, the bird silent and vigilant.
Sunlight trickles through from above, its presence nothing more than a whisper among the army of massive trees.  A small horned owl peers down at the passage, the bird silent and vigilant.

title: [Dense Grove]
description: A small pile of stones off to the side of the serpentine path bears notice, the rocks forming what should be an impossible shape.  The foliage on either side of the path is thick enough to daunt even the sharpest falchion, leaving only two directions, forward or back.

title: [A Small Clearing]
description: Towards the southern end of the path, the forest appears to thin a bit, the trees no longer a solid wall.  A courtyard lies just beyond the edge of the path, hints of a large building visible beyond the tangle of vegetation surrounding the trail.  A few figures roam about the clearing, most of them in robes.

title: [Wizard Guild, Courtyard]
description: An expanse of lush grass stretches north to a pair of ivy-grown gates.  Ancient trees, their shadows long in the moonlight, almost obscure a domed building to your south, its curvilinear architecture giving it the look of having grown from the land it occupies.  A winding flagstone walkway leads to the ivy-covered gates of the guild hall.

An expanse of lush grass stretches north to a pair of ivy-grown gates.  Ancient trees cast dappled shadows on a domed building to your south, its curvilinear architecture giving it the look of something grown from the land rather than an artificial construct.  A winding flagstone walkway leads to the ivy-covered gates of the guild hall.

title: [South River Road]
description: The trees alongside the road filter out the majority of the sound from the falls to the northeast, shielding your ears from the noise.  The road also runs westward along the bank of the river.

}

script = Script.self
river_rest_citizen = (Char.citizenship == "River's Rest")

crystal_amulet = nil
sunwashed_driftwood = nil
containers_opened_by_script = []

if UserVars.lootsack.nil? or UserVars.lootsack.empty?
  loot_container = GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.noun =~ /cloak|longcoat|backpack|pack/ }
else
  loot_container = GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name =~ /#{Regexp.escape(UserVars.lootsack.strip)}/i } || GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name =~ /#{Regexp.escape(UserVars.lootsack).sub(' ', ' .*')}/i }
end

worn_containers_cache = nil

all_worn_containers = proc {
  if worn_containers_cache.nil?
    strip_hook_after_wearing_line = proc { |line|
      if line =~ /^You are wearing/
        DownstreamHook.remove('find_all_container_ids')
        nil
      else
        line
      end
    }
    DownstreamHook.add('find_all_container_ids', strip_hook_after_wearing_line)
    saved_silent = script.silent
    saved_want_downstream = script.want_downstream
    saved_want_downstream_xml = script.want_downstream_xml
    script.silent = true
    script.want_downstream = false
    script.want_downstream_xml = true
    clear
    put('inventory containers')
    script.silent = saved_silent
    scrape_deadline = Time.now + 30
    worn_container_ids = []
    while (Time.now < scrape_deadline) and (line = get)
      if line =~ /^You are wearing/
        worn_container_ids = line.scan(/<a exist="([^"]+)"/).flatten
        break
      end
    end
    script.want_downstream = saved_want_downstream
    script.want_downstream_xml = saved_want_downstream_xml
    clear
    worn_containers_cache = worn_container_ids.collect { |id| GameObj[id] }
  end
  worn_containers_cache
}

open_and_reveal_contents = proc { |container|
  next if container.contents.is_a?(Array)

  open_result = dothistimeout "open ##{container.id}", container_action_timeout, open_success_regex
  if container.contents.nil? and open_result =~ /^Oh no|already open/
    dothistimeout "look in ##{container.id}", container_action_timeout, look_in_success_regex
  elsif open_result =~ /^You open|^Oh no|already open|^You glance/
    containers_opened_by_script.push(container)
  end
}

empty_hands

if loot_container
  open_and_reveal_contents.call(loot_container)
  sunwashed_driftwood = loot_container.contents.find { |obj| obj.name == 'piece of sun-washed driftwood' } if river_rest_citizen
  crystal_amulet = loot_container.contents.find { |obj| obj.name == 'crystal amulet' }
end

if crystal_amulet.nil? && sunwashed_driftwood.nil?
  all_worn_containers.call.each do |container|
    next if container == loot_container

    open_and_reveal_contents.call(container)

    if river_rest_citizen
      break if (sunwashed_driftwood = container.contents.find { |obj| obj.name == 'piece of sun-washed driftwood' })
    end
    break if (crystal_amulet = container.contents.find { |obj| obj.name == 'crystal amulet' })
  end
end

if river_rest_citizen && sunwashed_driftwood
  dothistimeout "_drag ##{sunwashed_driftwood.id} right", container_action_timeout, drag_success_regex
  containers_opened_by_script.each { |c| fput "close ##{c.id}" }
elsif crystal_amulet
  dothistimeout "_drag ##{crystal_amulet.id} right", container_action_timeout, drag_success_regex
  containers_opened_by_script.each { |c| fput "close ##{c.id}" }
else
  containers_opened_by_script.each { |c| fput "close ##{c.id}" }

  if $go2_get_silvers
    run_go2_and_wait.call('bank --disable-confirm')
    fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?

    if river_rest_citizen
      withdraw_result = dothistimeout "withdraw 600 silvers", container_action_timeout, /hands you|don't seem to have that much/
      unless withdraw_result =~ /hands you/
        echo "Too poor to go to Wehnimer's Landing"
        exit
      end
      run_go2_and_wait.call('general store --disable-confirm')
      fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?
      fput 'order 11'
      buy_result = dothistimeout "buy", container_action_timeout, /hands you a piece of sun-washed driftwood|Looks like you might buckle under this weight/
      unless buy_result =~ /hands you a piece of sun-washed driftwood/
        echo "Too encumbered to go to Wehnimer's Landing"
        exit
      end
      sunwashed_driftwood = GameObj.right_hand if righthand?('driftwood')
    else
      withdraw_result = dothistimeout "withdraw 2000 silvers", container_action_timeout, /hands you|don't seem to have that much/
      unless withdraw_result =~ /hands you/
        echo "Too poor to go to Wehnimer's Landing"
        exit
      end
      run_go2_and_wait.call('alchemist --disable-confirm')
      fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?
      fput 'order 15'
      buy_result = dothistimeout "buy", container_action_timeout, /hands you a crystal amulet|Looks like you might buckle under this weight/
      unless buy_result =~ /hands you a crystal amulet/
        echo "Too encumbered to go to Wehnimer's Landing"
        exit
      end
      crystal_amulet = GameObj.right_hand if righthand?('amulet')
    end

    run_go2_and_wait.call('bank --disable-confirm')
    fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?
    fput 'deposit all'
    run_go2_and_wait.call('11032 --disable-confirm')
  else
    echo 'You have no crystal amulet!  If you want this script to buy you one, issue the command:'
    echo 'go2 --getsilvers=on'
    fill_hands
    exit
  end
end

if river_rest_citizen && sunwashed_driftwood
  fput 'put my driftwood in log'
else
  fput 'put my crystal amulet in log'
end

move 'go log'
fill_hands

title: [South River Road, Waterfall]
description: The waterfall violently empties into the Tempest River here, tossing up billowing clouds of water vapor.  The moonlight glints off each individual droplet, filling the air with dancing pulses of light.  One might think it relaxing if it weren't for the deafening roar of the waterfall filling your ears.  Peeking out from behind the falls you see some stone steps carved into the face of the cliff, leading upward to the plateau above.  A road also follows alongside the river to the southwest.

title: [Tempest Falls, Landing]
description: The steps pause at a landing of sorts behind the waterfall.  Only inches from the edge of the landing, the water falls rather noisily from above.  Any further progress up the steps is impossible, as the rushing water blocks your way.

title: [A Silent Path, Cave]
description: Distant sounds of a waterfall echo softly in this ancient grotto.  A crystal clear pool feeds from a fissure, then narrows into a small creek disappearing under some ivory-colored flowstone along the floor of the cavern.  Eerie fluoresence streaking the walls glows a sickly yellow-green, just enough to make out an easterly passage.

title: [A Silent Path, Cave]
description: Barely more than a crawlway, this claustrophobic passage continues parallel to the twisting creek.  Traveling quickly over smooth stones, the waterway serves as both companion and guide.  Tiny blindfish traverse the length of the creekbed, blissfully unaware of the nearby foot traffic.  Small oil-soaked rag torches stuck into the walls help illuminate the path.

title: [A Silent Path, Mouth of Cave]
description: Moonlight filters in from the cave opening southeast, dust motes and insects swirling in the pale rays.  Tendrils of vines drape down from the top edge of the entrance, almost hiding it from outside view.  A box containing unlit wooden torches and strips of torn cloth sits next to a southwesterly passage leading deeper into the delve.

Light filters in from the cave opening southeast, dust motes and insects swirling in the pale rays.  Tendrils of vines drape down from the top edge of the entrance, almost hiding it from outside view.  A box containing unlit wooden torches and strips of torn cloth sits next to a southwesterly passage leading deeper into the delve.

title: [A Silent Path, Cul-de-Sac]
description: The path appears deadended in this cul-de-sac ringed by tall tanik trees.  The dark trunks reach skyward, splitting into multi-tiered branches with blue-green fir needles.  Verdant moss covers the ground, playing hide and seek underneath lush fiddlehead ferns.  A lichen-covered granite outcropping in the distance to the northwest has a curtain of vines descending over what looks like a dark opening.  A path leads northeast out of the cul-de-sac.

title: [A Silent Path, Forest]
description: Tanik trees line this winding path, the forest floor littered with browning pinecones full of seed.  Dappled moonlight breaking through the twisting branches settles in patches here and there.  A small creek trickles out from an underground seep, running clear over multi-hued stones that almost look like dusky jewels.

Tanik trees line this winding path, the forest floor littered with browning pinecones full of seed.  Dappled light breaking through the twisting branches settles in patches here and there.  A small creek trickles out from an underground seep, running clear over multi-colored stones that almost look like glittering jewels.

title: [A Silent Path, Meadowlands]
description: In this pastoral setting, a babbling creek rushes alongside the path, starlight glinting on the water in silvery glimmers of reflection.  As it turns it widens and hurries past grassy banks blooming with tiny flowers.  Large stones smoothed by eons of running water line the creek shores, signaling the long ago existence of an ancient riverbed.  The path runs northwest towards a forest, while the northeast direction moves over rolling meadowed hills.

The path runs northwest towards a forest, while the northeast direction moves over rolling meadowed hills.

title: [A Silent Path, Meadowlands]
description: The oft-trodden dirt path snakes around grassy knolls in this wide-open meadow.  Views from the small rises reveal a building off in the distance southeast of here.  A wide, meandering creek keeps travellers company as they make their way to their destination, while benches made of tanik and stone provide a scenic resting place by the water's edge for the weary.  A southwest turn in the path heads further into the meadow.

title: [A Silent Path, Gateway]
description: To the northwest, a meadow stretches out like a soft carpet of tall waving grass and flowers, while the eastern turn of the path is well-tended and lined with yew hedges braced by a striking iron and stone gate.  A monk wanders by, his lips moving in silent prayer as he strolls along the creek following the path.

title: [Courtyard]
description: A flagstone courtyard centers around a pool fed by a creek, its clear, cool waters sheltered by a weeping willow tree.  An enormous sandstone statue stands sentry next to a bustling monastery made from green-veined riverstone and timbered tanik.  Neatly pruned rose bushes softly scent the courtyard adding to the serenity of the surroundings.  A paved pathway leads through the rose bushes to a nearby meadow.

title: [Port Valley, Shaded Path]
description: The path leads into a grove of flowering linden trees, the quiet of the wooded area settling around you broken by the rushing sound of the nearby waterfall.  Colorful wildflowers dot the well-maintained path, and grassy trails lead up to the doors of cabins nestled among the trees.

title: [Port Valley, Shaded Path]
description: The path crosses a stony ridge, leading through a rough patch of boulders that dot the grassy area.  Songbirds flitter among the lindens, flickering patches of bright color in the light that filters through the trees.  An open valley lies to the northeast, and the rooftops of a village can be seen clustered in its center.

title: [Port Valley, Shaded Path]
description: Shaded by tall linden trees, this well-tended dirt path is lined with golden flowers.  Bees buzz about them, intent on their own business.

title: [Port Valley, Village]
description: A small village stretches out to the northeast.  The buildings are clay-and-stucco, all painted pastel shades.  The streets are paved with clay tiles, some painted in bright colors.  A pleasant breeze cools the area, despite the lack of shade.

title: [Port Valley, Village]
description: The pastel shades of the clay homes here blend with the colors of the flower garden planted before them.  Hummingbirds and butterflies flit among the blooms.  An aging human couple sits hand-in-hand on a polished wooden bench, admiring the view.  A stone path leads off northeast.

title: [Port Valley, Stone Path]
description: This stone path cuts through a manicured lawn.  There are a few small buildings tucked away here, but it's mostly a grassy expanse, home to a trio of rabbits.

title: [Port Valley, Stone Path]
description: The Gladberry Farms Winery sits amidst an expanse of grass and willow trees.  The two story structure is delicate, almost graceful in design, every wooden surface stained a light shade.  The eaves and windowsills are intricately carved.  People wander in and out with grins on their faces and glasses in hand.

title: [Port Valley, Vineyards]
description: A row of low trees displays a red and yellow bounty of ripe peaches.  A pair of human girls, perhaps six years old, takes advantage of this, though they've managed to get as much peach on their faces as in their bellies.  An old man rocks on the porch of a small, clay-and-wood home opposite the shrubs, one eye on his pipe and one on his hungry young charges.

title: [Port Valley, Vineyards]
description: Great red strawberries grow here, big as the nose on a dwarf.  Moonlight shines down on the field, illuminating the area in its soft glow, while a pleasant breeze cools the night air.
Great red strawberries grow here, big as the nose on a dwarf.  The sun shines down on the field, bright and hot, but a pleasant breeze from the west keeps things comfortable.

title: [Port Valley, Village]
description: A tall fountain of red marble graces this corner of the village.  The clay paving stones around it have been painted in pastel shades of red and yellow, forming an abstract pattern centered on the fountain.  At its base, a ring of buttercups and petunias soaks up the sun.

title: [Port Valley, Village]
description: Moonlight is reflected off the copper roofs of the clay structures here.  Newly planted willow trees line the street before them.  An elven couple meanders by arm in arm, sharing a cup of ice cream.

The sun is reflected off the gleaming copper roofs of the clay structures here.  Newly planted willow trees line the street before them.  An elven couple meanders by arm in arm, sharing a cup of ice cream.

title: [Port Valley, Streambank]
description: A small stream gurgles along here, flowing in from the northeast and then curving off west.  The far bank is lined with linden trees, while wildflowers are scattered on the near.

title: [Port Valley, Streambank]
description: A flash of silver in the stream's dark waters betrays the presence of a school of small fish.  Above them, a pair of frogs occasionally croak at each other, engaged in some obscure and deliberate amphibian debate.  The wind whispers through the linden trees, a message of serenity.

title: [Port Valley, Streambank]
description: The stream bends sharply here, the southern end of a lazily flowing 'S'.  A small path has been trudged through the wildflowers down to the waters.  Tiny footprints cover the mud at the water's edge.

title: [Port Valley, Hilltop]
description: Dandelions cover this small hill like sprinkles on a dish of ice cream.  From its crest, you can see the whole valley spread before you, the copper roofs of the village, the streambed and the many flower gardens.  A lone linden tree grows here, still too small to provide any shade.

title: [Port Valley, Vineyards]
description: Rows of elderberry shrubs border a few small homes here.  Small birds flit about the bushes, chirping and chattering at one another.  From the west, the faint smell of wildflowers drifts in with the breeze.

title: [Port Valley, Vineyards]
description: A small stream flows in from the northeast, curving towards the south.  A small bridge crosses it for travel in that direction.  Here on the near bank is the edge of the Gladberry Farms vineyard, fairly bursting with various berries.

title: [Port Valley, Vineyards]
description: Great wooden trellises are overgrown with flaeshornberries, soaking up the sun.  A small path weaves its way among them.  Several snug little buildings have also been established here.

title: [Port Valley, Vineyards]
description: Blueberries burst from their vines here, plump, round and ready to harvest.  The patches wind amidst some small structures.  A trio of deliberate old elves wanders among the berries, picking the choicest ones and tucking them away in their baskets.

title: [River Tunnels, Bramble Cave]
description: This mysterious cavern appears to have been purposefully crafted and carefully hidden by the growing brambles.  What little moonlight makes it through the brambles creates shifting and unsettling shadows on the walls, the dripping of water creating an odd accompaniment which seems to coincide with the shifting shadows.  In the shadows, you notice a small tunnel leading down steeply.

This mysterious cavern appears to have been purposefully crafted and carefully hidden by the growing brambles.  What little light makes it through the brambles creates shifting and unsettling shadows on the walls, the dripping of water creating an odd accompaniment which seems to coincide with the shifting shadows.  In the shadows, you notice a small tunnel leading down steeply.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A faint rumble can be heard here, perhaps the echoes of the river above, or some fearsome beast lying in wait, or a hungry halfling.  A hint of salt is in the air, which seems odd for a freshwater river tunnel.  A stairway carved of sandstone appears to lead further below the river here.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The stairs continue, carved out of the sandstone that makes up one wall of this chamber.  A small landing is present here, as it appears that the original carvers had to pick up the vein of sandstone on the other side of the chamber.  A chimney and ladder have been carved from the sandstone vein and a roaring noise can be heard from below as a steady cloud of mist rises up the chimney.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A sizable stream enters this cavern from an opening near the ceiling in the southwest wall.  The water from the stream splashes into a rock-lined pool, dousing the walls with its spray as it hits.  The pool feeds through a grate placed underneath a set of carved stairs.  Where the grate goes is anyone's guess, as even the years of rushing water have left it intact and far too strong for even a giantman or dwarf to bend.  The stairs have been carved of sandstone and lead upwards.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: Water pours into this room from a waist high hole in the east wall.  To the west, a half-submerged, iron grate sways slightly in the strong current flowing through the room.  The current is strong, but should be manageable.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: There is space between the water and the ceiling in this room, but the ceiling meets the water to the east.  The current flows through the room from a completely submerged tunnel.  A lack of handholds on the floor and walls make it necessary to swim to progress further through the tunnel.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: Water bubbles up into a large pool that nearly fills this room.  The shores of the pool are sandy, and booted footprints in the sand are evidence of regular travel here.  The pool drains to the west.  A natural opening to the east leads into some sea caves.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: Many meals from the bounty of the pool to the west have been shared here, and broken sea shells and dried fish bones litter the floor of the cave.  Broken ends of knives and splintered wooden handles lie amongst the refuse.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: A sizable excavation has been made to the north on this section of cave.  Apparently some precious metal or cache of gems was discovered in the cave wall and removed.  The sound of flowing water can be heard to the northwest.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: An old wooden cart sits to the side of the cave here, both wheels broken and splintered.  Worthless rocks, specked with the flecks of precious metals litter the floor near the cart.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: Rocks about the size of chairs are gathered together to the southeast in this section of the cave, and a small, flat stone sits between them.  This may have been the location of many a game of dice.  Cold air blows through an opening high in the northeast wall.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: Extremely hard rock forms the floor and the ceiling of the cave here, as the cave narrows to nearly a crawl space.  The cave opens wider to the north and east, and an opening leads southwest.  A slight breeze blows in from the north and the east.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: The cave here is of uncut stone, and appears to have been a natural cave only recently disturbed.  Moss and lichen grow on the walls and ceiling, and pools of water dot the floor.  The cave slopes upward to the northeast.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: This section of cave sits atop an incline, the cave continuing downward to the southeast and southwest.  Dry sand covers the floor of the cave here, and a steady breeze blows directly down from unseen crevices and cracks in the ceiling.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: The cave flattens out for a brief stretch before continuing upward to the northwest and downward to the southeast.  Bubbles occasionally burst through the surface of a dark pool near the northeast wall.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: The cave turns sharply here, sloping upward to the northwest and southwest.  One of the cave walls has been worked on with mining tools, and sharp rocks protrude from the wall there.  Broken picks and shovels litter the floor, the miners having been unsuccessful.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: The cave continues to the northeast, but a short cliff face stops further progress to the south.  The cliff is not tall, and can be easily climbed.  Small swatches of cloth can be found among the sharp rocks of the cliff face.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: A broken barrel sits against the southern wall of the cave here, with hoops nearly rusted through and wood severely warped.  A cliff face descends to the north, but should be navigable.  The cave continues to the northwest.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: A jumble of boulders blocks what might have once been an adjunct to this cave to the west, indicating a recent cave-in here.  The walls in this section of cave are cracked and flaking, as if under great stress.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: The cave narrows to the west, but grows much wider to the south.  A slight breeze blows in from the south, bringing fresh air to the caves.  Dry sand mixed with fist-sized rocks covers the floor.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: The cave turns sharply to the northwest and southwest here.  The caves to the northwest look like they were naturally worn by rushing water years ago, but to the southwest, the cave has certainly been dug.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: Timbers, some banded with iron, support the ceiling in this short section of cave.  The walls are soft, and crumble at the touch, threatening a cave-in at any moment.

title: [Sea Caves]
description: The sound of water can be heard to the west, where the cave widens.  The cave narrows to the northeast, with occasional tarred timbers placed in the walls for added support.  Empty torch braces in the walls show recent use.

title: [Sea Cove]
description: This cove provides an ideal spot for trading boats and ships to drop anchor away from the current of the river.  To the east a sea cave opens, leading into the cliff walls.  Boulders dot the beach, evidence that occasional rock slides occur here.

title: [Sand Bar]
description: Although this section of the cove is deserted except for the occasional seagull, a wide, well-travelled path leads toward the water's edge, where you can see a great deal of activity.

title: [Landing]
description: The tarred timbers of a floating platform shift gently on the water.  Moored at the end of this makeshift dock is a large krolvin caravel.

title: [Floating Platform]
description: This small floating platform extends out into the cove.  Crates and barrels piled around on the rickety structure block your view of the ship docked nearby.  You can't see much, but you can hear the raucous laughter of the Krolvin as they swear, laugh, and boast while they work.  Peering between the piles of cargo, you see a gangplank stretched between the dock and the ship.

title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Amidships]
description: This is the center of the ship, where the Krolvin load their cargo and move on and off the ship via the gangplank.  To the north, towards the stern, you can see the massive base of the mainmast.  Further aft is the quarterdeck.  Forward from here are the foremast trunk and the forecastle.

title: [In The Skiff]
description: This skiff is small and appears not to have seen recent use.  There are some nicks and scratches in here, perhaps from someone hiding in here long ago.

title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Aft]
