description: The massive mainmast of the ship towers high above your head here.  High up the mast, near the top, is a small crow's nest.  Ratlines lead up from both sides of the ship to provide access to the crow's nest for the lookouts.  Forward from here, to the south, are the gangplank and cargo hatch.  Stairs lead up to the quarterdeck at the aft end.

title: [Krol Ship, Crow's Nest]
description: This is a small wooden basket suspended high above the deck on the mainmast.  Lookouts here have a commanding view of the surrounding seas, but even the slight motion of the ship riding at anchor is enough to make you feel ill at this tremendous height.

title: [Krol Ship, Quarterdeck]
description: This is the command center of the ship, where the captain typically stands while the ship is at sea.  In the center of this deck is the ship's wheel from which the helmsmen steer the ship.  Some steps lead up to the poop deck, and another flight of stairs leads down to the main deck.

title: [Krol Ship, Poop Deck]
description: This is the smallest and highest of the ship's decks and is surrounded on three sides by a sturdy wooden rail.  The mizzenmast trunk is located roughly in the center of this deck, and although it is the smallest of the vessel's three masts, it still rises to a dizzying height.

title: [Krol Ship, Companionway]
description: The companionway provides access to the lower decks of the ship here, while the corridor leads to the officers' quarters and the wardroom aft.  A small chartroom is off the companionway on the east side, and the companionway continues down.

title: [Krol Ship, Chart Room]
description: This small room is almost filled with the massive chart table located in its center.  Numerous charts and maps cover the table, and navigational instruments are stored in lockers on either side of the room.

title: [Krol Ship, Corridor]
description: This corridor extends fore and aft here, connecting the officers' quarters and the wardroom to the quarterdeck.

title: [Krol Ship, Officer's Cabins]
description: This cabin is shared by the middle ranking Krolvin officers, and can be distinguished from the junior officers' cabin only in that the room has two beds.  Of course, this leaves little room for anything else, so the room is otherwise empty.

title: [Krol Ship, Officer's Cabins]
description: This small cabin serves as sleeping quarters for the most junior of the Krolvin officers.  The room is remarkably cramped and spartan as it is filled almost entirely by a large bunk bed.

title: [Krol Ship, Corridor]
description: This corridor extends fore and aft.  An ornate archway leads into the large wardroom aft of here, while the corridor continues forward to the south.

title: [Krol Ship, Officer's Cabins]
description: This is the cabin of the first officer of the Krolvin ship.  Despite the importance of this position, the ship's design affords him little luxury.  A small desk and a bed are the only items of furniture here, while the walls are adorned with nothing but an empty ornamental sheath, which is firmly attached to the bulkhead.

title: [Krol Ship, Officer's Cabins]
description: This cabin is shared by the second and third officers of the ship, and is slightly larger than that of their underlings.  Two beds and a desk are all the furniture that could fit in this cabin.

title: [Krol Ship, Wardroom]
description: This room extends across the entire beam of the ship here at the stern, making it one of the biggest on board.  Delicate windows once looked out over the transom, but have now been boarded up by the practical Krolvin.  A large dining table, with seats for a dozen or so, is still set with plundered porcelain, crystal, and the remnants of the Krolvins' meal.

title: [Krol Ship, Hold, Casks]
description: You find yourself precariously balanced atop a stack of several large casks, but well within reach of the cargo grate above you.

title: [Krol Ship, Hold Amidships]
description: The hold is a bit brighter here due to the moonlight filtering in through the cargo grate high above.  Several large casks are stacked beneath the grate.
The hold is a bit brighter here due to the sunlight filtering in through the cargo grate high above.  Several large casks are stacked beneath the grate.

title: [Krol Ship, Hold Aft]
description: The hold extends the length of the ship, from the aft companionway all the way to the bow.  The air here is damp and stuffy, and the meager light filtering down from the decks above is barely enough to see by.  Large crates and barrels are piled all around, as far into the semi-darkness as you can see.  The companionway leads up from here to the upper decks and down into the bilge.

title: [Krol Ship, Brig]
description: It is so dark in this room that you can barely discern shapes in the gloom.  Through the shadows you can make out the form of a skeleton of some sort hanging from the shackles on the wall.  The whole place has a distinct air of death and decay.

title: [Krol Ship, Companionway]
description: This hallway connects to the Purser's office and the arms locker off to the south.  An elegantly crafted set of double doors is the entrance to the captain's quarters.  Even the area outside the cabin is neat and tidy, with not a splotch of dirt to be seen.

title: [Krol Ship, Captain's Cabin]
description: This cabin extends from the companionway aft to the stern, and across the entire width of the ship.  Compared to the squalor of the crew's and officers' quarters, the elegance of this cavernous room is unbelievable.  Plush carpets cover the floor, and tapestries hang on the walls.  Gold trim shines brightly on the ornate woodwork, and comfortable furniture invites the visitor to relax.

title: [Krol Ship, Passageway]
description: This hallway connects the Purser's office and the arms locker to the companionway aft.  This area appears to have been the scene of some recent violence.  The arms locker door hangs uselessly off its hinges, little more than a splintered plank, and the steel door to the Purser's cabin appears to have been forced open by repeated blows with a large hammer.

title: [Krol Ship, Purser's Office]
description: The Purser's Office, once the orderly financial center of the ship, appears to have been recently ransacked.  The strongboxes and files have been strewn about, and the furniture smashed.

title: [Krol Ship, Armory]
description: This room contains half a dozen various racks for swords, axes, and other weapons, but not a dagger remains.  All the racks have been splintered, their locks destroyed, and the contents pilfered.

title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Forward]
description: This section of the deck lies beneath the ship's foremast, the peak of which is some fifty feet above your head.  A flight of stairs leads up from here to the forecastle, while the gangplank and the cargo hatch lie aft of here along the deck.  Underneath the forecastle you spot a door leading inside.

title: [Krol Ship, Forecastle]
description: The deck here is elevated from the main deck to provide a tactical advantage to the sailors during boardings.  From here most of the river can be viewed, as well as most of the cove to the south.

title: [Krol Ship, Bowsprit]
description: Tenuously you cling to the large spar here which extends out from the bow of the ship.  Below you the water from a small river flows past the anchor chain and into the cove with a constant gurgle.  It looks as though the only way to go is back down the bowsprit, but you may be able to climb down the anchor chain with care.

title: [Krol Ship, Anchor Chain]
description: You are holding on to the wet anchor chain with the greatest of care, fully aware of the water swirling under the ship, below you.  Although the bowsprit is not high above you, trying to climb up to it would be suicide.  A few feet above you, the chain disappears into the ship's hull through the hawse hole.  You may be able to squeeze through it.

title: [Krol Ship, Forecastle]
description: This large room seems to serve many purposes but from the strong smell of sweat you can guess that it's most commonly used as the crew quarters.  A wooden ladder extends down into the hold from here.

title: [Krol Ship, Hold Forward]
description: This is the forward section of the hold, the bulkheads curving inward toward the bow.  The hold is damp and dimly lit, as the only light seems to be coming from the grate high overhead aft of here.  A wooden ladder extends up into the forecastle and down into the darkness of the bilge.

title: [Krol Ship, Bilge Aft]
description: A slight amount of light coming down from the companionway allows you to detect the steep stairs, but otherwise this part of the ship is totally dark.  Sounds of lapping water and a rank smell disturb your other senses.

title: [Krol Ship, Bilge Forward]
description: The foul stench of rotting flesh fills your nose as you strain to see in the blackness of the bilge.  There is barely enough room to stand beneath the beams which form the floor of the hold above.  Brackish water swirls about, ankle deep.

title: [Under the Ship's Shadow]
description: The ship towers over the water, casting its shadow over the rocks as well as the shore.  The anchor chain trails down the side of the ship, and disappears into the depths of the river.

title: [River Tunnels, Boulder Cave]
description: The rushing water of the river outside can be clearly heard in this odd little cave, in fact it seems to ricochet and magnify itself through the strange shape of the cavern.  Some small amount of moonlight makes its way past the boulder providing a bit of illumination here.  Concentrating through the deafening noise, you notice that leading from this cavern are two tunnels, both leading steeply down underneath the town.

The rushing water of the river outside can be clearly heard in this odd little cave, in fact it seems to ricochet and magnify itself through the strange shape of the cavern.  Some small amount of light makes its way past the boulder providing a bit of illumination here.  Concentrating through the deafening noise, you notice that leading from this cavern are two tunnels, both leading steeply down underneath the town.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The roar of the river is muted by the masses of mushrooms growing from the floor.  They appear to have a dampening effect on sound, so much so that even speech seems difficult here.  Fortunately, they also seem to be glowing, allowing you to see a tunnel to the southwest.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The sound of the river above is barely audible, drowned out by the earth and rock around you and the crunch of sand and plant life under your feet.  The tunnel continues off to the southeast and up to the northeast, where the sound of the river grows a bit louder.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The air loses its salty taste completely here as fresh, clean air pours in from the northwest.  The fungus and plant life seem to like it too, as they grow unchecked all over the walls and floor of the tunnel.  They do, however, lose quite a bit of their iridescent qualities when compared to the ones to the east.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The air is less salty here, probably due to the gusts of fresh air coming in from the west.  The glow from the growths here is as consistent as ever, casting an eerie luminescence about the tunnel.  A smaller tunnel also continues northward into darkness and a larger one to the southwest.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The tunnel ends suddenly, blocked off by a massive cave-in that appears to be rather recent.  Now and then, bits of dirt and rock fall from the ceiling and you feel less than willing to stay here much longer.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The tunnel splits here in a junction of sorts, heading off in three different directions.  Off to the southwest, the glow of the mushrooms and moss is intensely bright, and a fresh breeze blows in from the northeast.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The light here is almost blinding, due to the salt crystals embedded in the walls and the stalactites about you reflecting the glow of the mushrooms in the tunnel.  You can taste the salt in the air every time you take a breath, making your lungs itch and burn.  The light seems a tad dimmer to the northeast and the ground gets rather soggy to the east.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A powerful jet of salt water intermittently shoots forth from a small hole in the ceiling, causing a rainbow colored mist in the room as the light filters through in between the spurts of water.  Your feet sink a bit in the sandy muck as the water collects on the ground around your legs.  Some of the water runs off to the east as a small breeze carries the salty mist off to the west.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The smell of sea salt is heavy in the moist air of the tunnel, enough so that it burns your eyes slightly.  The ground is thoroughly soaked and you plod about trying not to get stuck in the sandy muck.  Small cracks in the walls glow an eerie fluorescent green, illuminating the tunnel so that you can see it continue to the north and west.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The iridescent glow from the various growths in these tunnels is dimmer here, probably due to the partial cave-in of the northern wall that has littered the ground with sharp, brittle stones.  The tunnel continues onward to the south and west, though it is too dark to see what lies in either direction.

title: [River Tunnels]
description: The tunnel here levels off to the east and a side passage leads sharply down.  The distant sounds of the river can be faintly heard as echoes along with a mysterious slurping sound that sends shivers up your spine and sets the short hairs on your neck standing straight up.

title: [River Tunnels]
description: Grasses growing in the river above you have thrust their roots through the roof of this moist tunnel and have grown straight into the floor, making movement difficult.  River water runs down each of the roots, providing nourishment before forming a small stream in the floor which runs east.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A small stream trickles down from a steep incline before gathering steam and plunging down towards the east.  The walls around you are covered in some sort of mucous or slime.  It's hard to tell which without actually testing, or tasting, it.  It looks like the only purchase here is in the stream bed itself.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A deposit of some sort of ore in the walls here has prevented the rushing stream from eroding the walls of the tunnel and redirected its flow downwards and to the northeast.  The many years of splashing water have left the ore unaffected, except for being very clean.  You hear a roaring sound emanating from the northeast.

title: [River Tunnels]
description: It is very hard to keep your footing on this steep section of tunnel, as the ground is covered with very damp moss.  Some small amount of light is provided here though, as the moss underfoot seems to glow with an internal luminescence.

title: [River Tunnels]
description: The tunnels slope upwards to the northwest with two other branches appearing to level out here.  If you listen closely you can hear the rushing waters of the river above your head.  You breathe in the damp air and realize that, not knowing how much rock is between you and the river, it is a good thing you are not claustrophobic.

title: [River Tunnels]
description: Lichen and other mosses hang from the roof of the tunnels obscuring your view somewhat.  Small droplets of water drip onto your head, making little plopping sounds as they land which is really quite annoying.  The floor here is muddy with the accumulated water dripping from the mosses.

title: [River Tunnels, Barrier]
description: The humming, glowing barriers that make up the north and south walls immediately grab your attention when you enter this chamber.  The amount of mana involved in constructing and maintaining two such barriers throughout the ages staggers you as you think about it.  You can even feel the ambient mana in the room bathing you in its flows.

title: [River Tunnels]
description: Pools of water cover the ground, fed by the streams of water flowing down the walls of the tunnel.  The rushing sound of the river overhead is much louder here, drowning out any other sounds.  You also notice some odd markings on the tunnel wall.

title: [River Tunnels]
description: The humming, glowing barrier that makes up the north wall immediately grabs your attention when you enter this chamber.  The deposits on the floor and the smell of sea air give evidence that the ocean once reigned here.  The stone of the cavern has been formed by ancient waves into exotic and disturbing shapes, perhaps warped by the continual magic emanating from the barrier as well.

title: [River Tunnels]
description: Cool, salt air fills this passageway which slopes steeply up to the south and steeply down to the northwest.  Small depressions which may once have been tidal pools lie dried and coated in rime, long since cut off from the sea.  The remains of small crustaceans rest in the depressions, trapped here when the seas retreated.

title: [River Tunnels, Dead End]
description: Old calcium deposits and the fossilized remains of ancient sea creatures indicate that at one time this passage was underwater.  The only reminder of its ancient oceanic heritage is the hint of salt and cold moisture in the air.  Oddly, the smell of some type of mold or fungus is also in the air, although none is visible.  The passage slopes downward to the north.

title: [Citadel Stables]
description: Very little light penetrates this far into the back of the barn, making it hard to discern your surroundings.  Several piles of mold lie on the ground near the back wall, apparently once having been bales of hay.  Several metal rings hang on hooks on the wall, all that is left of feedbags long rotted away.

title: [Citadel Stables, Enclosure]
description: This stall smells of old leather oil, brass polish and the scents of some type of animal unknown to you, possibly used as riding beasts by the ancients.  No sign remains in the stall of what that beast may have looked like.

title: [Citadel Stables, Enclosure]
description: This stall smells of old leather oil, brass polish and the scents of some type of animal unknown to you, possibly used as riding beasts by the ancients.  The skeleton of one of the beasts lies in the corner of the stall, making it clear that this was not a horse, but, what kind of creature it was remains very unclear.

title: [Citadel Stables]
description: The smell of rotting hay and oats wafts through the air causing your stomach to churn.  A broken ladder rests on the ground, showing that once this barn must have had a second story, which has long since rotted away.  To either side can be seen stalls that once held some kind of riding beast.

title: [Citadel Stables, Stall]
description: This stall smells of old leather oil, brass polish and the scents of some type of animal unknown to you, possibly used as riding beasts by the ancients.  A cracked and faded saddle, once made of the finest velnalin leather in the lands, now sits neglected to one side of the stall.

title: [Citadel, Outside Stables]
description: The building here is quite large, even for a stable, giving a clue as to the number of horses and other animals that were once kept here.  Two large doors are the most dominant features of the building that you can see, obviously leading inside to whatever might still be left in the old stable.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The road opens up here to make room for a large, circular trough.  Though it has apparently been empty for quite some time, you can tell by the even wear on the stone that it once held water.  Off to the northwest, a large wooden barn stands tall but decrepit, its wooden sides rotten from age.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The smell of rotting organics fills the air as you pick your way though the rotting straw that clutters up the road.  The road looks much the same off to the north and south.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Small clumps of grass grow from the many piles of rotting straw lining this brick street, casting up invisible fumes that make your eyes water slightly.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Cluttered with weeds and rotting straw, a large brick road leads off to the north.  A very overgrown walkway continues to the west and south.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The walkway here is cracked and broken, with knee-high grass and weeds poking up between the old cobblestones.  To either side, large bushy hedges close in.  Obviously, nobody has been trimming these hedges in a long, long time.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The cool, damp air makes you shiver, as the ruined walkway bends northwest, away from the castle.  The overgrown hedges have gone completely wild, nearly blocking the path.  To the northwest, through the shreds of mist, you get a glimpse of an old stone building that appears to be in fair shape, all things considered.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The grass nearly reaches your knees and the old walkway is only identifiable as a line of short grass, heading north.  You get a glimpse of something through the wisps of mist to the north, but can't get a clear enough look to tell what it is.  To the southeast, the grass gets crowded out by two huge bushy hedges flanking the walkway.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Faint swirls of mist drift by and the tall grass twines itself around your ankles, as you wade through the area.  To the north you can see what appears to be a horse, while to the south you can just make out the outlines of two large bushes.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The old walkway approaches from the south and branches to pass around an old fountain, in the shape of a rearing horse.  To the northeast is an old two-story building.  A peculiar odor fills the area, slightly sweet and musty, rather like that of decaying flowers.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The pathway circles around the dried up fountain to the south and heads north following the wall of the old stone building to the east.  Patches of fog twist and waver in the wind, hiding and revealing distant objects in turn.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: To the east you can see a huge old oak tree and to the west, the windowless walls of the old building.  The walkway continues to the north and south and seems to be in somewhat better shape than elsewhere.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The walkway continues to the north and south in fairly good shape.  To the north you can see the shattered ruins of the castle walls.  To the east you see a reddish-brown trellis, although there are no flowers growing near it.  The northern corner of an old stone building stands to the west.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: To the north are the fallen remains of the castle walls.  A few of the stone blocks are still standing, although most have been scattered and overgrown with weeds.  What remains is more nearly a long mound, rather than a wall.  The walkway heads west along the wall and to the south alongside an old stone building.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The wind blows in over the ruined walls with an eerie moan.  To the west you can see a section of the wall still standing.  Here, however, there are rarely more than two blocks together and those are charred and scorched.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: This section of the wall has remained mostly intact although charred, as if a large bonfire had been set beside it.  Stray gusts of wind bluster around the edges, carrying damp wisps of mist.  The massive stone structure just south of the pathway was apparently the garrison for the citadel's troops.

title: [Garrison, Entrance]
description: Krolvin and troll remains litter the area.  Large stains on the huge limestone blocks are a sure sign that this was a bloody battle.  Apparently, many lives were lost in just reaching the portcullis and entering the garrison.

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: A large, rusting chunk of the portcullis, broken away by some great force, lies on the ground.  Scrapes and gouges mar the walls and floors, accompanied by splotches and dark stains.

title: [Garrison, Guard Post]
description: This used to be the watch post for on-duty guards.  All that remains of the guards, however, is their armor.  One breastplate is crumpled into a corner while another hangs from a piece of lance which had been thrust through the body and pierced the wall.

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: This huge chamber has a large marble floor with a beautiful design that is now marred with scratches and stains.  A marble stairway in the center of the room ascends to the next floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: On the north wall is an intricate design depicting a proud warrior in gleaming armor.  He sits astride a heavily armored war-horse, wielding a large menacing blade on a field of battle.  His foes litter the ground about him.  The design has been splashed with paint, which disfigures the image, but does not detract from its dignity.

title: [Garrison, Outer Room]
description: A long table of polished modwir stands in the center of the room, flanked by benches.  Campaign chairs with brass hinges are still neatly positioned at the head and the foot of the  table.  A third bench stands against the far wall.  Over it is a fresco of a shield divided into six fields, each showing a bird or beast and representing the six companies assigned to the garrison.

title: [Garrison, Bedroom]
description: A cracked bed frame is piled into one corner.  Beside it, the doors on a large wardrobe sag open, revealing several slashed and faded uniforms.

title: [Garrison, Storeroom]
description: The shelves lining the walls are filled with supplies, now rendered useless by time and insects.  A beetle scuttles over a pile of firelogs in the corner of the room.

title: [Garrison, Trophy Room]
description: This room holds shabby trophies from battles long ago.  The tattered remains of eight barbarian national flags hang on the wall, together with a seven foot high tower shield and the hilt of its matching weapon.  Hanging at a precarious angle is the claw of some huge fell beast.

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: The thick walls of this hallway were once lined with wondrous tapestries and paintings, but now all that remains are rags and bits of wood.  A few decaying skeletons litter the ground.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Common Room]
description: The only furnishings left in this room are a wooden table, bracketed by two chairs.  The long-ago interrupted game on the table seems as if it still awaits finishing.

title: [Garrison, Kitchen]
description: The most prominent feature is the huge stone fireplace, large enough to roast an entire calf on the spit.  Knives, pots and pans, and strings that once held onions and garlic hang from hooks on the wall.  Three large worktables line the other walls of the room.  Under them lie pallets, a final resting place for rotting sacks and the skeletons of the cooks' assistants.

title: [Garrison, Mess Hall]
description: Most of the furniture in the mess hall is broken, and the room is littered with the skeletons of men and trolls.  High along the wall, a bas relief has been broken and chipped to such an extent that you are unable to determine what it had once proudly depicted.

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: At the west end of the hallway are the remnants of a once full-length tapestry, long ago cut into shreds so that its meaning would be forever lost.  Skeletons of troll, krolvin, and men lie everywhere, slowly crumbling to dust.

title: [Garrison, Pantry]
description: A skeleton holding a cleaver is stretched face down just inside the door.  Several moldering sacks are split open, spilling their contents onto the floor.  The air is heavy with the pungent smell of decay and the rodents who now call the pantry home.

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: A skull and parts of a ribcage are all that remains of a warrior.  Stairs wind up to the floors above, and down to the main floor below.  The iron banisters are oddly twisted, forming sculptures of rust flecked with black.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, up, down

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: Several parts of skeletons lie about the floor, a few of them looking as though they were literally ripped in two by some unknown force.  The floor is stained a dark brown, probably from all the blood that flowed here.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Lieutenant's Quarters]
description: This may have been a nice place to hang one's hat at one time, but now all the furnishings are gone.  Faintly, beneath some rust-colored stains, you can see parts of a crest on the wall.

title: [Garrison, Common Room]
description: This room, long and wide, was apparently the lounge or meeting room for the soldiers housed here.  Broken furniture and weapons litter the floor.  A rat scuttles across the floor, its claws rasping against the stones.

title: [Garrison, Latrine]
description: Unusually free of blood, the tiled walls are merely mildewed with time.  A small and rusty spring water tap and a few lidless commodes are reminders that this place once housed living beings.  Given the destruction just outside, this room is in surprisingly good shape.

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: Dozens of tapestries and paintings once hung along this hallway.  Now, all but one have been ripped to shreds.  The remaining painting is so badly stained by blood that you cannot even guess what it portrayed.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Sergeant's Quarters]
description: A smashed weapon case and insect-ridden mattress are the focal points in the sergeant's sleeping quarters.  A looted display case probably once held the sergeant's medals and battle trophies.

title: [Garrison, Barracks]
description: Long and narrow, this barracks room once housed about two dozen soldiers in relative comfort.  All the bedding and furniture has long since been destroyed.  The remains of the soldiers do not seem to mind the mess in their once polished room.

title: [Garrison, Sergeant's Quarters]
description: A smashed weapon case and insect-ridden mattress are the focal points in the sergeant's sleeping quarters.  A looted display case probably once held the sergeant's medals and battle trophies.

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: The walls are badly scorched here, the mortar flowing in frozen drips, testimony to some tremendous heat.  Blackened bits of bone are scattered about the floor.  As you pass by, your footsteps raise puffs of oily ashes, clogging your nose and throat.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: The stairs continue upwards.  A few skeletal remains litter the landing, but you should be able to step carefully around them.  There is an unusual lack of broken weaponry here, despite the carnage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, up, down

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: A glass display case lies overturned, and broken glass covers the floor, along with several dark stains and skeletons.  A porcupine comes to mind as you glance at one troll skeleton, filled with more arrows than most quivers would ever see.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: It appears that the soldiers tried to barricade against the trolls and krolvin, but failed.  Broken furnishings are strewn about in a disorder that matches the skeletons which also lie here.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: Tapestries, long ago destroyed, lie in shredded and mildewed piles along the base of the walls.  A number of objects seem to have been brought to this hallway just so that they could be slashed and destroyed.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: From this top floor landing, you can see the stairs spiraling down below you to the ground floor.  Although the light is very dim, you can see that some of the bones you passed on your way up here had fallen from this point.  The bannisters are completely missing, causing you to glance cautiously over your shoulder as you back away from the edge.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, down

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: A shattered glass display case rests in the center of the floor here, a skeleton skull lying with the broken glass within the case. The rest of the skeleton lies on the ground, and whatever was in the case is long gone.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: On the wall hangs the upper torso of a skeleton.  Below it, a dark stain cascades down the wall to form a dry rust-colored pool on the stone floor.  The walls, and even the ceiling, are deeply gouged and pitted.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Garrison, Lieutenant's Quarters]
description: This looks to have been a very nice place to hang your hat, at one time.  Now all the furniture has been destroyed or looted, leaving nothing of value behind.  A skeleton lies on what remains of the bed, the skull crushed beyond recognition, and a dark stain covers the remaining bedding and the wall.

title: [Garrison, Hallway]
description: This part of the hallway is fairly clear of debris.  Apparently, much of the fighting went on elsewhere in the garrison.  Only one skeleton remains, though it is so mangled it is hard to tell if it is human.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [An Ancient Oak]
description: This branch is about as high as you can go, since the next one appears to be about 8 feet over your head.  It's not a particularly comfortable spot, as the branch you're standing on is only about 2 feet thick.  Far above, you can see an armored skeleton impaled on a broken branch.  It's hard to imagine how it got up there, much less managed to impale itself horizontally on the branch.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Most of the wall here is still standing, with only a small pile of collapsed blocks.  You can see the feet and legs of an armored body, crushed under the pile when siege engines blasted a hole in the wall.

title: [Armory, Entrance]
description: Thick vines, like hairy arms, are entwined around the door, as though pulling it further apart.  Several small tendrils curl upwards, swaying in every air current, seeking another surface to latch onto and destroy.

title: [Armory, Hallway]
description: The hallway has been narrowed over time by large stone blocks that may have fallen from the armory's roof.  A thick matting of vines now shrouds the ceiling, so that light and sound are muffled.

title: [Armory, Hallway]
description: The long hallway is still overhung with a thick tangle of vines in place of a real roof.  Occasionally, the leaves rustle, or a twig snaps overhead, causing you to flinch involuntarily.  As you glance into the vines, you see a small bird silent among the branches.

title: [Armory, Hallway]
description: The vines which covered the ceiling in the other parts of the hallway have not made much headway in this section.  The floor is clear of debris, although the walls bear heavy gouge-marks.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Armory, Hallway]
description: The hallway is littered with splintered wood and small bits of metal.  Twisted iron hinges creak mournfully against the empty doorway on the northern wall.  A foul smell wafts toward you from an opening in the southern wall.

title: [Armory, Latrine]
description: This room holds a large tub and a row of four seats, all of which connect to the large sewage cavern below.  The roof here has been pulled completely down, which has done nothing to relieve the stench.

title: [Armory, Hallway]
description: The walls are broken and battered.  The fact that they have not completely crumbled is a testament to the builders who first crafted this place years ago.  A broken sword hilt lies in a pile of rocks that nearly blocks the entrance to the smithy.

title: [Armory, Smithy]
description: Three rusted anvils are set on heavy wooden blocks in the center of the room.  Equally rusted tongs and hammers hang from hooks on the edges of the blocks.  A large brick forge dominates the far wall, its mouth widened by the removal of a number of bricks which had once lined its opening.

title: [Armory, Armorers]
description: The smiths in this room were responsible for repairing the garrison's armor.  An iron cauldron is suspended over a fire pit beside the large forge.  Several small anvils and a variety of shaping hammers are scattered on the ground.  The cauldron contains a residual coating of tar.  Some old leather and a scattering of metal studs and rings lie on the floor.

title: [Armory, Armorer Stores]
description: Long since looted, the large racks on the wall are the only reminder that heavy armor once hung here.  Bits of cuirbouilli leather are strewn about amongst the litter.

title: [Armory, Weapons Maintenance]
description: Although the air still carries a bitter tang, it is apparent that no maintenance has been done here for many years.  The brick forge near the southeastern corner of the room has had a number of bricks torn from the opening.  You can see through the forge to the smithy's room.

title: [Armory, Fitting Room]
description: Rubbish litters the floor, and you pick your way carefully to avoid stepping on any of the piles of discarded and decaying leather armor.  The sight of so many headless mannequin forms, evidently used to fit armor for a variety of body types, sends gooseflesh rippling down your arms.

title: [Armory, Weapons Stores]
description: The walls are lined with rubbish-filled niches, each long since emptied of the weapons once stored here.  A narrow doorway faces south, metal hinges the only remnants of whatever door had closed this storeroom from the rest of the armory.

title: [Armory, Archery Range]
description: Three targets, battered and worn with time, are at the far end of this long and narrow room.  Grooves are cut into the stones for the archers to line up against.  A piece of slate on the wall is still marked with white crosshatches, drawn with a piece of limestone to keep score.  Burnt-out torches rest in four wall sconces in the corners.

title: [Armory, Training Area]
description: This large open area was used for the training of soldiers.  The thick stone walls still bear colorful mosaics demonstrating various throws and holds.  Jumbled on the floor are several musty woven mats, stone weights, and a large tackling dummy.

title: [Armory, Hallway]
description: A doorway opens north towards the former training area.  Several burnt-out branches are piled at the base of the thick stone wall, as though someone had intended to set fire to the armory.

title: [Armory, Commander's Office]
description: The room holds a desk, two chairs, a set of shelves, and two skeletons.  Both skeletons have fallen across warped bows near the arrow slits, one with an arrow through its eye socket.  The desk has been turned over on its side, as though it had been used as a last defense from whatever ransacked this place.

title: [Armory, Living Room]
description: The only evidence that this room once was used by officers is the cracked plaster on the walls, a token bit of civilization for this outpost.  The furnishings that remain after the sacking of the armory are so battered, it's impossible to tell what purpose they had once served.

title: [Armory, Latrine]
description: Only half of the latrine pit's wooden cover remains in place.  The thick stone walls here have kept the stench from the open pit contained, much to your discomfort.  Every sound is amplified and echoed back in disorienting confusion.

title: [Armory, Bedroom]
description: The hair on the back of your neck rises slightly, as this room appears to have been only recently vacated.  Although sparsely furnished, everything here is intact.  A low pallet covered by a rough wool blanket sits in the far corner, while a plain chair stands guard beside a tall lacquered wardrobe.  A tin of armor polish and a whetstone lie on the nightstand, as though awaiting their owner's return.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: You could swear that you saw something moving to the north, but perhaps it was just a bit of mist -- there was nothing there when you took a second look anyway.  The old walkway heads east, along the inside of what remains of the castle wall, and southwest, to what seems to be a small well.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: In front of you stands a well, covered with a moss so thick that none of the original structure is visible.  Though the roof has long since vanished, the well appears to have escaped much of the destruction.  To the northwest you can see the collapsed remains of one of the guard towers.  Westward stands a small brick structure.  To the south and southeast you can make out the outlines of large stone buildings, details obscured by the mist.  A walkway leads northeast along the fallen castle wall.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: You stand in front of the burnt out remains of one of the towers that used to guard the walls.  To judge from what you can see, it most likely stood several stories tall, although there is little left above the first floor now.  It would seem that most of the upper floors simply vanished or the stones were hauled away at some later time, as there is relatively little debris scattered around.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The mist curls around you, taking almost familiar shapes.  Faces, figures and creatures seem to hang back at the edge of your vision.  As you near this small brick structure, you see that it still stands, mostly intact.  The only damage appears to be the result of time and neglect.  Too small to be a building, perhaps it was an oven or incinerator at one time.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: You jump, startled as the silence is broken by the howl of a not so distant wolf.  It's possible that this walkway once led to a sally port or gateway in the castle walls.  But if so, it is lost under the tons of rubble left when those walls were destroyed.  Now, the walkway disappears under a long mossy mound of huge stones.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Before you stands an old, but relatively intact, building.  The crumbly walls appear to have once been painted white, but have since yellowed with weather and age.  A small door set into the wall hangs on by its rusted hinges, a sharp, distinct odor drifting out from within.  Moss covered walkways lead off in several directions, but the passing mist obscures whatever might lay down them.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Furniture has been piled in each of the hallways leading away from the entry room, forming ineffective barricades.  Each of the barricades has been breached.  Skeletons, all savagely hewn and hacked, are strewn about the area.  A sign hangs crookedly on the wall.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Tattered cobwebs hang from the ceiling and cover the dusty, brass oil lamp.  Painted on the wall beside a wide staircase are the words Staff Only.  A dented brass lantern hangs from the ceiling.  Tiny fungi grow in the cracks of the wide-planked floor.  A skeleton lies crumpled beside the staircase.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: A single large terra cotta pot, bathed in the rays from a dusty skylight, rests in the center of the hallway.  A faded, time-ravaged carpet covers the floor.  Arched doorways lead east and south.

title: [Infirmary, Master's Quarters]
description: Although dust-covered and draped with cobwebs, the once-vivid colors of this long, wide room are obvious.  Ceramic lamps in the shapes and colors of tropical birds hang from the ceiling.  The walls are painted to resemble a garden.  The frame of the modwir bed is painted a leafy green and the faded remnants of the comforters reveal a wildflower pattern.  A large ceramic urn stands beside the arched doorway.

title: [Infirmary, Temple]
description: Silence and serenity reign in this oblong room.  On a table beside the arched doorway are a matching silver basin and goblet, now tarnished with age.  The tattered remains of woven prayer mats are aligned in front of a faded tapestry.  In the center of the room is a perfectly circular pool of still water.

title: [Infirmary, Meditation Room]
description: An ivy vine grows in through a crack in the small rectangular window near the ceiling.  It has clambered and coiled its way across the ceiling, turning the oil lamp into a leafy bump.  One shoot of the vine has climbed down the wall and into the small meditation fountain, completely filling the basin.  Scattered about the floor are the remains of prayer rugs and the empty shreds of meditation cushions.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: The wide-planked pine hallway floor has been worn and scuffed in the middle by the passage of many shuffling feet.  The lower third of the walls are lined with pale green ceramic tiles.  A brass lantern hangs from the ceiling.  The air smells of dust and mold.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: The walls of this hallway are covered with grey and heather-colored molds.  Dust, grit and mold spore gather along the walls.  A dented brass lantern hangs from the ceiling.  The wide-planked floor is slightly warped and tiny fungi grow in the cracks.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: A dark stain coming from the room to the north mars the wide-planked floor.  The lower third of the walls are lined with pale green ceramic tiles.  A brass lantern hangs from the ceiling.  The air smells of dust and mold.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Infirmary, Patient Room]
description: This spartan room is furnished only with a narrow bed, a small nightstand, and stiff-backed wooden chair.  The mattress has been flipped onto the floor.  Moonlight streams through a small, round window set high on the wall, casting the room in a blue glow.

This spartan room is furnished only with a narrow bed, a small nightstand, and stiff-backed wooden chair.  The mattress has been flipped onto the floor.  Sunlight streams through a small, round window set high on the wall, casting the room in a gold aura.

title: [Hebe's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a sturdy white cedar ceiling, a noble elf maiden portrait hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls.  A large oak table sits in one corner while a small potted boxwood shrub rests on a cream-colored ceramic tile floor.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Grey and heather-colored molds have grown on the walls, making patterns that eerily resemble some ancient language. The warped, wide-planked pine floor is worn and scuffed in the middle.  Tiny fungi grow in the cracks of the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Infirmary, Supply Closet]
description: The walls of the closet are line with shelves containing the necessities of a well-run infirmary.  Time has worked its effect on the infirmary supplies.  The neat rolls of bandages are brown with rot.  Crisply folded sheets are nests for beetles and other insects.  A foul smell wafts from the jars and crocks of spoiled healing salves.

title: [Infirmary, Library]
description: This quiet room is paneled in dark maoral wood.  Tiny holes, evidence of a thriving insect population, cover the paneling.  Shelves of books line two of the walls.  A shallow nook is filled with a maoral scroll cupboard.  A large desk fills one corner.  Diffused light enters through a dusty window.

title: [Infirmary, Staff Bedroom]
description: An ornate carpet, moth-damaged and faded with time, covers the floor.  On the far wall hangs a vividly-colored tapestry.  The shelves of an iron etagere are filled with multi-colored glazed clay pots which still retain the stalks of long-dead plants.  Bamboo rats have nested in the once-thick down-filled mattress on the monir bed.

title: [Infirmary, Patient Ward]
description: Eight beds with straw tick mattresses line the walls of this ward room.  The tattered shreds of the linen curtains used to separate the beds hang limply from their hooks.  The air, stuffy and still, smells of mold and dust.

title: [Infirmary, Surgery]
description: Molds have grown on the white, reflective tile walls of the Surgery.  In the center of the room is a sturdy wooden surgical table large enough to hold a giantkin.  Large brass oil lamps are hung in the four corners of the room and a fifth lamp hangs directly above the table.  A skeleton is crumpled in the corner of the room.  Another remains strapped to the surgical table.  Scalpels, clamps, and other surgical instruments are scattered around the room.

title: [Infirmary, Treatment Room]
description: A long, sturdy oak table dominates the room.  Brass oil lamps hang from each corner of the room and a larger lamp dangles directly over the table.  On the shelves which line the walls are the dried husks of medicinal herbs. The cobweb-flecked walls are of white, reflective tile.  An instrument stand lies toppled on its side.  Bandages, medical instruments and herbs lie scattered across the floor.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Footprints mar the tiled floor of the hallway.  The words "Staff Only" are painted on the wall beside a narrow set of wooden stairs.  The lower stair railings have been indiscriminately hacked and chopped.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Moonlight through a small, broken window set high on the wall illuminates the hallway.  Through the window you hear the blowing wind and the distant, plaintive cries of gulls.  Faint, krolvin-sized footprints lead away from some stairs.

A small, broken window set high on the wall illuminates the hallway.  Through the window you hear the blowing wind and the distant, plaintive cries of gulls.  Faint, krolvin-sized footprints lead away from some stairs.

title: [Infirmary, Glassworks]
description: The moth-eaten remains of a large, decayed rug covers the floor.  A shelf-backed table stands against one wall.  Shards of reflective glass litter the floor beneath a full length mirror frame.  A brass oil lamp hangs from the ceiling.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: A dusty, brass oil lamp hangs from the ceiling.  Cobwebs clutter the ceiling.  A scattering of wood shavings litter the tiled floor of the hallway and sawdust has accumulated along the walls.  The tracks of tiny insects are visible in the sawdust.

title: [Infirmary, Woodworks]
description: The smell of wood and old lacquer linger in the air.  On the walls are detailed diagrams of arms, legs, wrists and ankles.  A well-worn workbench takes up one entire wall, its surface littered with old woodworking tools.  A rusty treadle lathe sits against one wall.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Old, tattered cobwebs hang from the ceiling and the dusty, brass oil lamp.  The tiled hallway floor is badly scratched and scored.  Tiny, half-rusted metal shavings litter the floor.  As you move through the hallway the metal shavings grind into the tile under your feet, creating a whispery screech.

title: [Infirmary, Metalworks]
description: There is barely enough room to move around between the sturdy steel-topped workbench and the tall oaken table.  The floor is strewn with metal shavings and sharp metal slivers.  Oil lamps hang low over the workbench and tables.

title: [Dark Passageway]
description: The powerful, loamy smell of mold, fungus and decay drifts up from a dank hole.  Some oddly spaced handholds lead down into the hole.

title: [Dank Tunnel]
description: Despite a hint of light filtering in from the northwest it is too dark to distinguish anything with certainty in the tunnel.  Roots, damp and dripping, hang low from the dirt ceiling.  The footing is slick with slime and mold.  The stink of decay is formidable, as if foul beasts might use this tunnel as a place to die...or feed.

title: [Rubble]
description: A beam of moonlight shines through a narrow opening revealing a jumble of stone blocks and wooden beams.  Clearly, this ruin was once a room.  The remnants of a table lie shattered under a fallen block.  Bones, scattered and gnawed, litter the area.  A large monir cabinet, rotten with age, has toppled on its side revealing a dark tunnel leading southeast.

A beam of sunlight shines through a narrow opening revealing a jumble of stone blocks and wooden beams.  Clearly, this ruin was once a room.  The remnants of a table lie shattered under a fallen block.  Bones, scattered and gnawed, litter the area.  A large monir cabinet, rotten with age, has toppled on its side revealing a dark tunnel leading southeast.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: You shiver slightly as tendrils of dark mist swirl about you, seemingly trying in vain to hold you in place.  Through the mist, you can make out a winding walkway leading off to the north and west.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The mist clears a bit here due to a small breeze coming in through the ruined castle walls, giving you a good look at the ruin around you.  The buildings and structures seem to have not only crumbled with age, but appear to have been damaged deliberately quite some time ago.  Blasted walls and charred timber seem to make up most of the destruction.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Moss and vines fill in the holes blasted in the wall that runs along the path here.  The path itself is littered with stones and other parts of the crumbling buildings and wall, forcing you to pick your way through them slowly.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The walkway opens into a small square, leading up to what looks like an old gazebo.  Vines and moss are overtaking the gazebo in an apparent effort to pull it to the ground.  Other than that, there isn't much else left intact here.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The castle wall is almost completely gone, leaving nothing but a spectacular view of the plains beyond.  Beyond the wall and to the south, you can hear the dull roar of what sounds like a waterfall, this being made more apparent by the gusts of mist flowing through the air from that direction.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The castle wall was completely demolished here, the rubble littering the area completely, leaving a spectacular view of the plains outside.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The tall spires of the citadel itself loom ominously overhead.  Remarkably, the whole structure looks relatively untouched by the raiders when compared to the desolation surrounding it.  Loud claps of thunder and lightning burst above you, the clouds and mists obscuring the uppermost parts of the structure.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Your skin crawls as mist rolls down the sides of the citadel, swirling down and around the tower as if it were trying to smother everything about it, including you.  Bright pulses of light, resembling lightning, flash far above, seemingly flashing between the towers and spires of the structure itself.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The path comes to a dead end here, leaving little to see aside from a blackened portion of the citadel wall.  For some strange reason the mist in the air pulls away from it, as if some unseen force prevents it from touching the wall.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The littered walkway here runs from northeast to southwest, lined by relatively intact but deserted buildings.  A cool breeze follows the pathway, creating soft whispers as it flows through the cracks and holes in the building walls.

title: [Aquarium Entrance]
description: You stand before a large brick enclosure that rises about twelve feet from the ground.  There doesn't appear to be a roof to the structure but a set of slate steps leads to the top.

title: [Zoo, Slate Path]
description: The tank below has a crack in its outer wall.  Water that flows in from the other tanks is lost through the crack leaving this one dry.  A variety of different sized skeletons of fish lie scattered about the tank.  The only living thing in the tank is a small tree, growing near the center, that gathers its nourishment from the water that flows through.

title: [Zoo, Slate Path]
description: To one side of the path lies a tank containing a small school of piranha.  On the bottom of the pool lie the gleaming white skeletons of the hapless victims that wandered into the tank and never made it out again.  The tank on the other side is home to a large school of minnows, several carp and a giant water beetle.

title: [Zoo, Slate Path]
description: Several dozen large koi swim aimlessly about in one of the tanks, occasionally stopping to search the sandy bottom for anything edible.  Their white bodies with patchworks of gold, red, black, orange and yellow must have made some of them extremely valuable to their owners.  The other tank is filled with a variety of greenery and scattered about the bottom are clams and other freshwater shellfish.

title: [Zoo, Slate Path]
description: You look down into one of the pools and are momentarily startled to see a huge crayfish staring back at you with glossy black eyes.  The other pool is filled with plantlife and holds a small, spring-fed fountain.  This is the source of the water for the other tanks as the overflow from this one keeps the rest filled.

title: [Zoo, Slate Path]
description: The skeleton of a long-dead crocodile rests on a small island in the middle of one of the tanks.  Beside it lies what was probably its last meal, the remains of a half-eaten man in rotted leather armor.  The other pool holds a small variety of catfish, and a large school of minnows upon which the catfish feed.

title: [Zoo, Slate Path]
description: The pool here is swarming with many differing species of small fish, all swimming peacefully among the weeds.  You can see several varieties of colorful guppies, minnows and fresh water damselfish and a few that you don't recognize.  The slate path slopes downward to the east, leading to another part of the zoo.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: You face an empty cage, its door open and broken, dangling by one hinge.  The door swings slowly back and forth in the wind, creating a sound like fingernails on slate.  A rock path winds westward, up into the aquarium.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: Thick vegetation grows through the cage bars here, partially obscuring your view of the herd of mountain goats inside.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: The stream from the mountain goat cage runs through the cage before you.  Aside from the lush growth of grass within, you see no other outward signs of life.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: The path ends here between two cages, one of them barren of vegetation.  The other has a thick growth of grass and a small stream running through the center.

title: [Zoo, Monkey Cage]
description: A small wooden shelter sits to one side of this cage, once home to a family of monkeys, their skeletons now heaped on the floor.  The only bright note of the demise of the monkeys is the full banana tree in this cage.  Unfortunately, the bananas seem to be out of your reach.

title: [Zoo, Jadeback Cage]
description: This cage has a thick carpet of grass and a small stream running through it from the adjacent mountain goat cage.  The hollow carcass of a giant beetle lies near the stream, its carapace punctured by three score round holes, each a sixteenth of an inch in diameter.

title: [Zoo, Mountain Goat Cage]
description: Four large mountain goats make their home amidst the very prolific vegetation that grows here.  A small stream of water runs through, fed by the runoff from the pond in a cage nearby.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: A small channel cut into the floor provides the inhabitants of the goat cage on one side with water from the overflow of the pond in the tapir cage on the other.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: The bars of the cage before you show signs of rust, perhaps brought on by the moisture in the air here.  Molds and mildews of various sorts cover the slates beneath your feet, making your footing a bit treacherous.

title: [Zoo, Tapir Cage]
description: The middle of this cage contains a large, spring-fed pond and is surrounded by thick grasses.  A small family of tapirs still makes their home here and shows no inclination to leave the relative safety of the cage.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: There is an opening in the bars here where it appears they were forced apart by a beast of great strength.  The fresh animal smells in the cage make you think that the beast could still lair inside.

title: [Zoo, Wolverine Cage]
description: A section of the bars of this cage were bent apart, allowing the wolverines inside to escape.  It seems they keep returning to their familiar lair, using the area inside and outside the zoo as a hunting ground.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: You peer through the steel bars of the cage before you and see a large number of bones scattered about the floor.  No signs of life seem to stir within the cage.

title: [Zoo, Wolf Cage]
description: This cage once held a small pack of wolves, though the last of them died long ago.  Ironically, their skeletons lie heaped in several places on the floor, among the bones of the other small animals they once fed upon.

title: [Zoo, Cage Area]
description: A mountain goat stares inquisitively at you from behind the bars of a cage to one side.  From the scraggly remnants of grass growing in the cage, you get the impression that maybe the goat is eyeing you for his next meal.  There are no signs of life from the cage on your other side.

title: [Zoo, Fox Cage]
description: A clean-picked fox skeleton lies in the back corner of this cage.  Aside from the small wooden box that was once its den, the cage is barren.

title: [Zoo, Storage Room]
description: The room is barren except for a pile of blankets in the corner.  The thick dust is criss-cossed with footprints.

title: [Zoo, Slate Path]
description: You look down into one of the pools and see an astonishing variety of snails of differing shapes and sizes.  A myriad of shell colors dot the green plants growing in the tank.  The other pool contains a large school of carp, several of which have stinging lampreys hanging from their sides.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Only small areas of the stone walls making up this building are free of scorch marks and cracks.  It's obvious that this was the scene of intense fighting, as the defenders made a desperate last stand.  To the east the walkway leads past a fractured stone entryway.  To the northwest it heads towards a small green mound.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Foul-smelling yellow smoke lingers in the air around a fractured stone entryway, hampering sight and breathing alike.  Although the building's walls still stand, hair-fine fracture marks spiderweb the scorched grey stone.  Among the rubble of the former brick walkway, small pieces of dark-veined faenor shimmer faintly in the moonlight.  The spray of hardened metal droplets leads directly to the twisted, half-melted urn imbedded in the ground beneath a dead flaeshornberry bush.

Foul-smelling yellow smoke lingers in the air around a fractured stone entryway, hampering sight and breathing alike.  Although the building's walls still stand, hair-fine fracture marks spiderweb the scorched grey stone.  Among the rubble of the former brick walkway, small pieces of dark-veined faenor shimmer faintly with the touch of the sun.  The spray of hardened metal droplets leads directly to the twisted, half-melted urn imbedded in the ground beneath a dead flaeshornberry bush.

title: [Alchemist, Hallway]
description: Every ancient tapestry lining this hall has been torn into long tatters, which sway and twist drunkenly with even the ghost of a breeze.  To the east, the walls have caved and crumbled, with jagged timbers spiking like the points of a morning star from the impenetrable heap of rubble.  A dreamlike quality possesses the place, induced by the eye-stinging yellow haze that fills the ruined hall.

title: [Alchemist, Potion Room]
description: The disarray here is just short of spectacular.  Reigning over the chaos, a large stained workbench strewn with shattered flasks, alembics, and bottles stands in the middle of the room.  The eastern wall has collapsed, cascading rubble and dust over every surface, and leaving large chunks of wood and stone lying about the floor.  Mixed into the mess are stirring rods, bits of glass, and metal, something that might have been a balance years ago, and a small brazier containing only soot.

title: [Alchemist, Storeroom]
description: Worthless bits of hide, stone, and crystal crunch underfoot with any step, and streaks of dried ochre powder stain the broken stone floor.  Fetid yellow smoke hangs over a half-congealed puddle of goo, obscuring the sight of a shattered rosewood cabinet.  Several torn parchment labels cling to shards of glass in the wreckage, but age has so faded the script that the labels are impossible to read.

title: [Alchemist, Library]
description: Every one of the ancient bookshelves has fallen, and they slump against one another like drunken soldiers.  The northernmost bookshelf broke in two after its collision with the wall, and its bulk mostly blocks access to the large fireplace.  It appears that extra damage was done to the tomes after the library's collapse, for crumpled pages ripped from their bindings litter the floor, evidence of an intruder's presence.

title: [Alchemist, Hallway]
description: Massive chunks of stone and fallen timbers force anyone who would traverse the hallway to duck and weave through the hazardous ruin, a labyrinth made more disorienting by the light dusting of broken glass sparkling from every surface.  Although shadows dominate the wreckage, a single shaft of moonlight lances down through a gaping hole in the ceiling, illuminating a round spot on the dusty, threadbare hall rug.

Massive chunks of stone and fallen timbers force anyone who would traverse the hallway to duck and weave through the hazardous ruin, a labyrinth made more disorienting by the light dusting of broken glass sparkling from every surface.  Although shadows dominate the wreckage, a single shaft of sunlight lances down through a gaping hole in the ceiling, illuminating a round spot on the dusty, threadbare hall rug.

title: [Alchemist, Organics Room]
description: A great deal of care was clearly taken to clean this room and make it comfortable and homelike -- care turned into a mockery by the ghastly collapse of the roof and walls.  White cushions embroidered with blue flowers are piled in a comfortable sleeping-nest in one corner, but the end of a massive timber has fallen to crush the vanity case placed beside it.  Animal bones, seeds, crystal shards, and bits of porcelain litter the ground.  Wilted violets lie desolately among the ruin.

title: [Alchemist, Sitting Room]
description: Two contoured sandstone chairs rest in this chamber, although one has been half-buried by the wreckage of the eastern wall.  Moonlight-silvered leaves spotted with the fanciful shapes of orchids can be seen through a wide zigzagging crack in the wall, making the striped sandstone look dingy by contrast.  Crumpled papers litter the ground.

Two contoured sandstone chairs rest in this chamber, although one has been half-buried by the wreckage of the eastern wall.  Bright green leaves spotted with brightly hued orchids can be seen through a wide zigzagging crack in the wall, making the striped green sandstone look dingy by contrast.  Crumpled papers litter the ground.

title: [Alchemist, Hallway]
description: Stone and timber alike gave way here beneath some colossal impact, which ripped the floor asunder and brought down the ceiling at the same time.  Even a dwarf might feel a bit claustrophobic in this space, with barely enough room to squeeze through the rubble.  Dark, foul-tasting smoke drifts lazily up from a wide hole in the floor, hot enough to sting eyes and lungs alike.

title: [Alchemist, Inorganics Room]
description: This room holds a large forge, an anvil, and two massive coal bins, one of which sits in its accustomed place and one of which has been shoved to the side to expose the only intact wall.  Near the doorway, the fractured stone tiles forms strange bumps and ripples, as if some great force had struck from beneath the rock.  Smudged charcoal footprints are visible among the debris, leading to and from the intact wall.

title: [Alchemist, Destroyed Workroom]
description: The grey rock floor has melted and reformed, creating long concentric ripples that radiate from a central blast point.  A shimmering crystal rests at the blast point, almost completely obscured by the dense, searingly hot smoke drifting slowly off its surface.  Glistening blobs of red and blue corundum rest imbedded in the stone, each placed within the shallow valley between two of the floor's ridges.  There is a wide hole in the ceiling and a stylized male face sculpted into the wall.

title: [Alchemist, Secret Junction]
description: A narrow corridor branches north from this winding, torch-lit hall.  Dense smoke and rock dust hang heavily in the still air, stinging eyes and throat alike, and a monotonous dripping sound echoes down the passage from somewhere to the west.  Above the nearest torch is a small grate, but if it once served to ventilate the hall, the earth and rubble pressing against the grate from the far side now prevent it from serving its function.

title: [Alchemist, Secret Tunnel]
description: Stone tiles and grey brick walls give way to packed earth at this bend in the tunnel, and the floor slopes subtly downward as it continues to the east.  Red-spotted lichen grows along the wooden supports, slowly weakening them against the indefatigable pressure of the earth.

title: [Alchemist, Secret Tunnel]
description: The tunnel widens slightly as it detours around a deep shaft carved into the ground.  Judging by the malodorous fumes drifting up from its depths, the shaft has been routinely used as a garbage pit in the not-so-distant past.  An iron grate has been set across the shaft to prevent any accidental falls, but the bars are orange with rust, and surely will not endure the humid climate much longer.

title: [Alchemist, Secret Tunnel]
description: No torches burn in the empty iron sconces, but torchlight from the west casts a weak orange gleam over your surroundings.  The floor slopes unevenly downward as the tunnel curves toward the northeast, and a distinct chill enters the air.  Tiny roots weave through the packed earth walls, caressing the aging wooden supports like the hair on an old man's head clinging to his balding pate.

title: [Alchemist, Cul-De-Sac]
description: Clammy darkness surrounds you, broken only by the faint greenish glow emanating from a few crusts of lichen on the walls.  Although the tunnel might once have progressed beyond this point, the ancient wooden supports have given way beneath the weight of the earth, and the passage shrinks to the height of a gnome before ending abruptly.  Several rotting timbers jut dejectedly from beneath the colossal heap of dirt.

title: [Alchemist, Secret Hall]
description: Coal dust and dirt smudge the grey stone tiles underfoot.  Only one torch still gutters among the empty sconces, and the shadows leap and dance in counterpoint to the movement of the sputtering orange flame.  A quiet but constant dripping sound echoes down the corridor.

title: [Alchemist, Secret Library]
description: A bat-winged humanoid skeleton perches atop the tallest shelf, staring balefully down at intruders to its domain.  At first, the skeleton might be taken for nothing but a decorative, though macabre, statue, but watchful pupils gleam within the scarlet flames dancing in its eyesockets.  Heavy vultite chains set with massive padlocks connect each ornate tome to its designated place upon a shelf.

title: [Alchemist, Secret Bedroom]
description: Yellowish-white mildew clings to a narrow cot, an aging maoral desk, a low chest, and every other organic surface within this small chamber.  Beads of water roll slowly down from a tiny crack above the cot, and then, diverted by a splinter in a support beam, slide along the splinter and splash down into a wide puddle on the waterlogged mattress.  More puddles have long since washed all ink from the fragmenting scrolls scattered over the floor.

title: [Alchemist, Hidden Stair]
description: Each narrow stone step bears several smudged footprints, which are marked in coal dust and barely visible within the shadowed stairwell.  A gilded handle offers better leverage to open the concealed stone door at the top of the stair.  Angular runes have been etched along the outer wall, spiralling down into darkness along with the steps.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: By night, the dominant hues of the courtyard are the delicate silver of reflected moonlight and the greenish-black of shadowy leaves.  Crumbling walls border the courtyard, demarcating the line between an untended interior and an equally wild exterior.  Broken slate tiles and shattered pots litter the ground around the remains of a fallen balcony.  A single shaft of moonlight pierces a jagged crack in the building's wall, but darkness dominates whatever lies beyond.

Crumbling walls border the courtyard, demarcating the line between an untended interior and an equally wild exterior.  Broken slate tiles and shattered pots litter the ground around the remains of a fallen balcony.  Part of the building's interior may be glimpsed through a jagged crack in the wall, seeming shadowy and dim by contrast with the brilliant orchids and verdant leaves that fill the overgrown garden.

title: [Alchemist, Ruined Balcony]
description: Only a narrow ledge still remains of the former balcony.  This vantage provides an excellent view of the overgrown courtyard and the decrepit buildings beyond the crumbling perimeter walls.  Twenty feet below the ledge, slate tiles and shattered pots record the rest of the balcony's demise.  With some care, it might be possible to climb down the wall, but a heap of jaggedly splintered support beams awaits anyone with more confidence than skill.

title: [Alchemist, Bedroom]
description: A large maoral table dominates the room, making the narrow bed in the corner seem almost an afterthought.  Shards of crystal litter the floor from the remains of a broken vase, which probably once contained the dead lilies scattered beside a small, ornate trunk.  Dried ink glues several scrolls and diagrams to the table's scarred surface, but the same ink that holds the scrolls has stained them into illegibility.

title: [Alchemist, Hallway]
description: The ragged silver stump of a former sconce projects from the wall, but the sconce is gone, and concealing shadows curtain the passage.  Four bloodstained handprints mar the pale yellow paint of the western wall, descending from north to south.  Wooden splinters and crystal shards have been tracked between the northern and southern doorway, accompanied by several more streaks of long-dried blood upon the scratched floor.

title: [Alchemist, Bedroom]
description: This simply furnished room holds a massive bed, still covered with faded green sheets. Shredded papers, broken quills, smashed inkpots, and other ruined tools of a researcher's work have been scattered over the floor near the sandstone desk standing opposite the bed. To one side is a tall wardrobe, doors ajar, which houses a set of mithril chains, among other things.

title: [Alchemist, Glass Room]
description: The colorful stains adorning the walls seem to have originated from smashed dye pots, instead of a sinister source.  A massive kiln stands against the rear wall, overshadowing four coal bins and several overturned buckets.  Multicolored sand spills from the mouth of each bucket, causing the floor to crunch softly with every step.  A trash barrel occupied one corner, but it too, has toppled, adding pieces of broken glass and other garbage to the surrounding debris.

title: [Alchemist, Hallway]
description: At this intersection, a ragged gap in the ceiling is positioned above a large hole sundering the weakened floorbeams.  Dust motes dance through a single beam of silvery moonlight that falls through roof and floor alike.  Ancient portraits hang crookedly upon the sagging walls, but the dead alchemists are not required to gaze upon the damage to their old demense, for the eyes have been torn from every image.

At this intersection, a ragged gap in the ceiling is positioned above a large hole sundering the weakened floorbeams.  Dust motes dance through a single beam of golden sunlight that falls through roof and floor alike.  Ancient portraits hang crookedly upon the sagging walls, but the dead alchemists are not required to gaze upon the damage to their old demense, for the eyes have been torn from every image.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Alchemist, Hallway]
description: Shadows haunt the stark corridor.  Only streaks of dust and unevenly spaced footprints decorate the floor, and the walls are bare of even that adornment.  The fetid odor of rotting animal flesh drifts from the south, and some peculiar scratches mark the floor at that entrance to the room.

title: [Alchemist, Cage Room]
description: Iron cages line the far wall, all strangely distorted in shape and reinforced with silvery vultite wire.  Lumpy sacks of animal feed have been piled in a corner of the room, but the corpses filling the various cages were clearly well-enough fed -- for the rats, kobolds, and other animal corpses are grotesquely large as well as hideously distorted in their features.  Spots of yellow mold grow on some of the corpses, adding a fungal smell to the reek of rotting flesh.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The walkway heads southwest around to the front of the old stone building.  Towards the east it forks, circling to the north and south of the old dry fountain.  A cold clammy breeze blows through the area, sending you into a fit of shivering.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The pathway ends suddenly, piles of rubble forming a barrier of sorts, only allowing passage in a few directions.  Large vines and growths sprout up along the walls and overhead, blocking out all light from the sky above.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Gentle breezes flow along the path, coming in from the west.  Weeds and vines overgrow the path and you have to pick your way through them to avoid falling over.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Suddenly, you notice scents in the air.  A slight breeze from the enruned archway to the west carries an enticing potpourri of smells to you.  You realize how dead the air has been and the fresh new smells lift your spirits.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The pathway is completely bare here, offering nothing but a place to walk.
