title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: Nothing seems to live close to the Citadel.  The dead space seems to provide a convenient pathway circumnavigating the wall.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The pathway is completely bare here, offering nothing but a place to walk.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: Your sense of smell is rewarded with the scent of spices and herbs.  A garden of luxurious quality is laid out before you in such a neat and orderly fashion that it is pleasing to both sight and smell.  The finely crushed stone of the path crunches softly beneath your steps, leading off in two directions through the garden and one back through the enruned archway.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: The path, like a snake surrounded by tall grass on either side, twists and turns through the area.  Crickets chirping alongside and grasshoppers jumping from beneath your feet provide some small entertainment as you walk through.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: A variety of cacti and sagebrush surrounded by desert flowers have been neatly planted in the sandy soil.  The hot, arid air seems to pull the moisture from your body, your sweat drying as soon as it reaches the surface of your skin.  The sandy path is slightly discolored from the tread of many feet.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: A tall oak tree stands near the wall, its upper limbs reaching out to the top of the stone.  Smaller trees, mostly fruit trees dwarfed by its size, surround the oak like children protected by its shadow.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: Lined with tile, a large pool rests in the center of the citadel's garden.  A statue carved in the likeness of Aeia, a local goddess of the earth, stands in the middle of the pool.  The water that feeds the pool seeps forth from the base of the statue.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: Sheltered by the great wall to the south and further shaded by the tall trees overhead, this quiet spot provides a cool place to rest, relax and recover from more strenuous activities.  A lone bench rests in a small cleared spot.

Sheltered by the great wall to the south and further shaded by the tall trees overhead, this quiet spot provides a respite from the warmth of the sun.  A cool place to rest, relax and recover from more strenuous activities.  A lone bench rests in a small cleared spot.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: A strong scent of mint and other herbs and spices fills the air with a potpourri of odors that cause your mouth to water and your stomach to growl.  Low trees and shrubs provide a variety of habitats for both animal and plant life.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: There is a definite chill here.  A light frosting of snow covers the ground making the tufts of rye grass stand out in relief upon the ground.  A perpetual shadow from the citadel wall to the south blankets the area.  Short stubby bushes and evergreen trees add to the darkened atmosphere initiated by the high wall.

title: [Citadel, Gardens]
description: The citadel wall to the south darkens the area, stunting the growth of the deciduous trees in this part of the garden.  Their leaves, now fallen, create a soft humus that softens your footsteps.  While not as cold or as dark as the area to the west, the fall-like chill here is enough to cause you to want to move on.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The smooth ebony wall of the wizard's Citadel rises above you, with no obvious openings.  The grasses growing around the base of the citadel are verdant and a pleasant warmth emanates from the wall.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: A single ebony brick, of a type of rock unknown to you, has fallen from the top of the Citadel and rests on the ground.  No grass grows near the brick.  A rock-lined path leads around the edge of the Citadel.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The ground is littered with bits of black rubble, apparently fallen from the Citadel's heights.  The path you are walking on appears to be circular, rolling around to the northeast and southeast.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The only thing of interest is the small amount of rubble cluttering up this otherwise nondescript pathway.  The path rolls gently in a circle to the southeast and southwest.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The path here is about as plain as can be, rolling around in a circle to the northwest and southwest.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: The path here is about as plain as can be, rolling around in a circle to the northeast and northwest.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: The rock-lined path beneath your feet seems to be made of chips of ebony stone left over from the construction of the Citadel.  The rose bushes that once formed neat columns along the path now grow wildly.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: The rose bushes to either side of the walkway have grown into a natural arch here, blotting out your view of the sky.  The buds of the roses seem unusually large and contain such unnatural colors as black, blue and even stripes.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: The sounds of buzzing insects fill your ears as you feel their stings and bites all over your skin.  The humid air forces sweat to roll down your face, blurring your vision momentarily before dripping into the ground where it is thirstily absorbed by the porous black rock that makes up the pathway.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: Stifling waves of heat blow a hot mist over you making breathing difficult.  Small droplets of water condense onto the orchids, which have replaced the roses in the arch overhead.  A small amount of moonlight filters its way through the thick foliage of the arch to illuminate your way.

Stifling waves of heat blow a hot mist over you making breathing difficult.  Small droplets of water condense onto the orchids, which have replaced the roses in the arch overhead.  A small amount of light filters its way through the thick foliage of the arch to illuminate your way.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: The pathway twists, blocking your vision both forward and back, making it seem as if you are entirely isolated from the rest of the world.  The shrubbery here is so thick that no sound or light reaches you, except for the buzzing and glowing of the many fireflies in the air.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: Miniature flaming violets grow from the arch overhead.  Oddly, the flames don't seem to consume the violets or the arch itself.  The air, however, is very hot and the myriad charred avian bones show what happened to the few birds who got too close to the burning violets.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: The archway above is almost entirely made of flaming vines, causing you to duck your head in order to keep from getting your hair singed.  Obviously the ancients who once used this pathway had access to some protective material or spell in order to pass this way.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: The porous black rocks of the pathway glow a dull red with the heat they contain.  Smoke rises from the soles of your feet as you make your way quickly through this section of the walkway.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: It seems as bright as day here as the rocks beneath your feet give off a bright red glow, as well as a considerable amount of heat.  A fog seems to have permanently settled over this room, perhaps caused by the heat continually forcing moisture from the surrounding plants that make up the archway overhead.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: The walkway here has become so hot that the rocks have become molten.  The archway overhead seems to be made entirely of living flames which appear to be laughing at your feeble attempts to pass by.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: A breath of cold air blasts you as you turn the corner of the walkway. The archway seems to be made of icy plants and the pathway below you appears to have been fused into a solid pane of black glass similar to obsidian.

title: [Citadel, Outside Gates]
description: As would be expected of wizards, the normal drawbridge construction is missing from the entrance to the citadel.  Traversing the ravine that surrounds the citadel is a large contraption which resembles a balance with several levers and ropes attached.  On the other side of the ravine you can see two doors which form the entrance to the citadel.

wayto.11357:
;e empty_hands
old_stance = XMLData.stance_text
fput 'stance offensive' unless old_stance == 'offensive'
until !checkpaths
fput 'stand' unless standing?
fput 'climb ledge'
sleep 0.1
waitrt?
end
fput 'stance ' + old_stance unless old_stance == 'offensive'

title: [Bridge]
description: From here you can see the ravine below as it runs east-west beneath you.  The main doors to the Citadel stand on the northern ledge from here.  Wind howls by threatening to toss you off the bridge, making you feel a bit nervous.

title: [Ravine Bottom]
description: You are at the very bottom of a ravine.  Above you looms an odd structure with ropes and pulleys and lots of things that do complex stuff.  It looks as if the only way out of here is up the southern wall.

wayto.11355: ;e save_stance = XMLData.stance_text;fput 'stance offensive' if save_stance != 'offensive';move('climb wall');fput "stance #{save_stance}" if save_stance != XMLData.stance_text;;$go2_restart = true;
wayto.11358: ;e while XMLData.room_title == '[Ravine Bottom]'; fput 'search'; move 'climb footholds'; waitrt?; end; fill_hands

title: [Outside Citadel]
description: To the south in the ravine, you see a odd contraption that looks like half of a bridge, there are levers and weights and gears and pulleys.  You also stand next to the mighty doors to the Citadel.

title: [Entrance Hall]
description: Made of shining bronze and adorned with glistening obsidian, two doors rise high and wide above the fine tiled floors, now faded and covered with dust.  A shriveled corpse sits with its back against the wall, its leather armor brittle and cracked and a rusty shortsword still encased in its bony grip.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, out

title: [Guard Room]
description: It must have been quick, you think, looking at the two skeletons before you, circled in dark stains.  Your gaze follows the stains across the room as they lead to a sturdy table, upon which rests the petrified remains of a meal.

title: [Waiting Room]
description: A couch and three chairs, sparingly upholstered, look uncomfortable, even when you imagine them new.  Perhaps comfort was never their intent.  The tapestries covering the walls, however, are another matter.  You sense they were once plush and richly woven, but many unkind years have exacted a heavy toll on them and they are now too faded and moth-eaten to even discern what they once depicted.

title: [Council Audience Chamber]
description: Six columns of stone rise to the ceiling of this large audience chamber.  As your eye follows the columns you see a raised dais, upon which rest four carved fel wood thrones.  Each of these cushioned thrones is painted a different color: blue, white, red, and green.  Two tapestries are hung in this room, one depicting the founding of Elanith, the other bearing the seal of the Council of Twelve.  A skeleton lies at the base of the dais, obviously killed by a mighty blow to the chest.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: The smooth granite walls of this hallway were probably very beautiful when polished daily, but now appear to be sadly neglected.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: Many layers of dust coat the floor of the hallway here, dampening the sounds of your footfalls.

title: [Storeroom]
description: Shelves line this storeroom from the floor to the ceiling.  Many of them appear to be empty and a thick layer of dust covers the remaining piles of jars and rotting crates.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: The forces of time seem to have left the smooth granite of this hallway untouched as no cracks show in the walls.

title: [Guard Post]
description: You are greeted by the scenes of a battle fought long ago as you enter the small guard post.  An overturned table lies in the middle of the room and the shattered pieces of several chairs lie strewn about.  Several dried, dark brown stains cover the floor.  Could they be the dried blood of the former guardians?

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A large, ironbound door interrupts the simplistic beauty of the smooth granite wall here.  Next to the door is a small pile of decaying rags and sticks which appears to once have been used as torches.

title: [Hall of Records]
description: Scribes once worked furiously at these four desks, detailing all of the actions taken by the Council and its servants.  The shelves are crammed from floor to ceiling with papers and scrolls:  census records, imports, exports, treaties, council meetings, and military actions.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: The dust of many years covers the floor of the hallway and a stale smell assaults the senses.  The walls here glow with a pulsating light which speeds through the spectrum making you dizzy.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: The silence of the long-deserted citadel is oppressive here as no sounds seem to reach you from the outside.  A door of shining black enamel is set into one wall of the hallway.

title: [Council Conference Room]
description: As you enter the room a soft light emanates from above but has no apparent source.  A large oval table of black enamel dominates the room.  Placed around the table are twelve black-enameled chairs, each bearing the gilt symbol of one of the Twelve Magi of Elanith.

title: [Council Library]
description: Once the private library of the magi, this room appears to have been ransacked in earlier times.  Three desks, three chairs, and a large sculpture of a knight slaying a small drake remain.  The understated elegance of the chamber is hinted at by the exquisitely carved bookshelves, still lined with the remains of books, tomes, scrolls and letters.

title: [Council War Room]
description: One wall of this room holds two large murals, one of the city defenses, and one of the shores of Maelstrom Bay, dotted with forts and settlements.  A large sand table holds lead figurines in warlike poses, and six small wooden ships.  The far wall is dominated by a huge stone fireplace.  A third wall has a silver inlay of the seal of the Council of Mages.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A cool draft drifts down a staircase.  Carved from the very granite of the walls, it appears to lead up to a second floor.  A rusty iron handrail held in place by two loose rivets provides the only support on the stairway.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A cool draft blows down the spiral stone staircase in this corner of the hallway, sending the dust on the floor into intricate spirals in the air.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: The hallway is adorned with oak paneling which would look beautiful if polished.  However, it doesn't appear as if anyone has been by in many decades to perform that function.  It's a wonder that the wood has survived at all, with the obvious lack of care.

title: [Exercise Room]
description: Sawdust on the floor makes your footing uncertain here.  Stone weights, target dummies and a hacking post are positioned about the room.  On the far wall is a well-used knife target.  Against one wall stands a rack of wooden practice weapons.  Several charts are plastered to the walls showing wrestling holds and areas of the body which will cripple or critically wound a foe.

title: [Bedroom]
description: A large four poster bed with decaying linen hangings dominates the room.  Sitting on a simple nightstand next to the bed is a yellowed and cracked porcelain pitcher.  A simple wooden trunk rests at the foot of the bed.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: Bare stone shows through gaps where the paneling has been ripped from the walls.  Some malevolent force or creature appears to have caused this damage, rather than time itself.  Claw and weapon marks score the granite walls where the paneling was destroyed.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: The oak paneling of the hallway has decayed into sawdust in several areas revealing the grey stone of the walls beneath.  As you walk down this hallway, your feet make a soft shuffling noise in the sawdust that has fallen to the floor.

title: [Living Room]
description: This room has a purposeful look about it, as if important work was once performed here.  A desk occupies the center of the room, positioned to face a couch and within easy reach of a bookcase.  Resting on the shelves of the bookcase are several sculptures and figurines of wood and metal, all bearing a military theme.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: Dust blows into the hallway from the west in delicate spirals that rise as high as the ceiling before drifting to the floor.  An empty bookshelf sits against the wall next to a circular window in the east wall.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: Placed on the west wall is a massive painting opposite a narrow stone door seamlessly set into the wall.  Torch sconces line the hallway leading to the north and south above wood paneling and a faded dark blue carpet laid down along the expanse of the corridor.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: Dulled by age and dust, a large wood-paneled door stands at the end of the corner of the hallway.  From beneath the door flows warm drafts that stir the dust into the air, where it hangs in transparent light brown clouds before slowly dropping to the floor.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: Spiraling upward, the black stone staircase is cut from the very stone of the wall of the Citadel.  Lining the hallway to the west is wood paneling covered in a thin layer of dust, occasionally gutted by the presence of dry rot and scarred by claw marks.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: The floor in the corner of the battlement drops away into a spiraling stone staircase that vanishes below.  On either side of the staircase, the crenellated walls of the battlement run to the west and to the east, periodically marked by rusting flagpoles absent any streaming banners.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Bolted firmly to a battlement is a small ballista crafted entirely of metal pointed downward and overlooking the western expanse surrounding the Citadel.  Set underneath the ballista is a rack filled with narrow metal arrows permanently fused together by a layer of thick red and brown rust.  The rust has flaked away, coating the surrounding ground, which is peppered with footprints from recent passersby.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: A single rusting gauntlet lies against a battlement, its fingers curled around a simple black iron chain attached to the stone floor for no apparent purpose.  The end of the chain ends abruptly in a broken metal link.  A series of hills and a deep vale are visible to the east surrounded by wilderness.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: This section of the battlements is clear of rusting metal with the exception of an unadorned flagpole, which is covered in occasional patches of browns and reds.  Nothing shattered nor broken is visible to speak of the violent fall of the fortress, with this section affected only by the warm breezes buffeting the uppermost section of the Citadel.  Twinkling burning violets line the pathway below, their etheral light halting abruptly along the rim of the ravine.

This section of the battlements is clear of rusting metal with the exception of an unadorned flagpole, which is covered in occasional patches of browns and reds.  Nothing shattered nor broken is visible to speak of the violent fall of the fortress, with this section affected only by the warm breezes buffeting the uppermost section of the Citadel.  Twinkling burning violets line the pathway below, their ethereal light halting abruptly along the rim of the ravine.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: An iron bucket filled with rain-packed sand and rusting metal arrowheads sits in the corner of the battlement.  From a flagpole bolted to the wall of the battlement, a blue and buff banner ripples in the warm breezes drifting over the top of the wall, snapping with every strong burst of wind.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Reaching out across the stone floor of the battlements is a bleached bony hand belonging to an armored skeleton.  The skeleton lies propped against the wall, a large boulder resting on his lower half.  The passage of time has removed the skull from the body, depositing it elsewhere out of sight, leaving the unknown Citadel defender to an eternity of indignity.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Driven into the mortar between the blocks of the battlement is a rusting dagger framed by the fields of burning violets below, which flank the approach to the Citadel and the drawbridge.  Lying askew on the ground next to the wall is a pitted and rusted helmet with a panache of faded feathers.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Wind whistles through a gap in the battlement in a space created by the absence of a stone block.  The wail climbs and lowers in an intensity as the strength of the breeze rises and diminishes, offering a haunting song rich with the aroma of the burning violets carried upon the wind.  Below, the ravine beckons along the base of the Citadel, dark and forboding.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Through the spaces in the crenellated wall, fields of burning violets shimmer and sway, taking on the appearance of a bed of molten lava.  Strong breezes lift up the fragrance of the violets, swirling it about the battlements.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Perched from the top of a battlement is a single flagpole bereft of flag or banner.  Painted up and down its length are spirals of rust, which coalesces at the base of the pole, staining the metal brackets that attach it to the stone.  Beyond the battlement, lies the western domain of the Citadel in its ruined glory, left as testament to the fall of the mighty fortress.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Sand spills out from a rusted metal bucket knocked over on its side beside a battlement, covering much of the surrounding floor with its gritty substance.  Interspersed in the spillage are numerous metal arrowheads and faded fletchings, absent the wooden shafts that once made them whole.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: From high overhead come the screams of massive blood eagles.  The great birds circle slowly above the Citadel, casting their massive shadows down across the battlement as they pass between the moonlit sky and the ground.  The night is periodically interrupted as one of the winged beasts appears from over the horizon, screams in pleasure, and releases an unfortunate victim from a great height to plummet to the earth below.

From high overhead come the screams of massive blood eagles.  The great birds circle slowly above the Citadel, casting their massive shadows down across the battlement as they pass between the moonlit sky and the ground.  The night is periodically interrupted as one of the winged beasts appears from over the horizon, screams in pleasure, and releases an unfortunate victim from a great hight to plummet to earth below.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Rattling in the warm breezes, the flagpole fights against the rusted brackets securing it to the battlement.  Below and slightly to the north are the gardens of the Citadel, represented by a patchwork of colors focused upon a pool of blue.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Spectral lights randomly flare in and out of existence across the vista viewable from the top of the battlement as the present inhabitants of the Citadel make their presence known.  Bolted to the stone surface of the battlement is a rusted stand, designed to support some unknown device.  Below the stand is an equally rusted rack with a single tarnished metal arrow still awaiting use.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Warm winds sweep over the battlement overlooking the northern half of the Citadel complex, offering a bird's eye view to the disrepair and destruction visited upon the fortress over the centuries.  A steel bucket sits by the wall, filled with rusted metal arrow heads interspersed with faded fletchings.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: Marking the northern boundary of the complex are the rooflines of the armory and the garrison to the north and the infirmary to the northwest.  Beyond the buildings and the surrounding walls of the Citadel is empty wilderness, stretching off toward the horizon, interrupted only by the occasional tall tree or open meadow.

title: [Cavern]
description: The boulders which comprise the floor of this irregular cavern have been worn smooth by repeated floodings.  The air is very damp and you can hear the trickle of water farther down the passage.

title: [Cavern]
description: The walls of the cavern slope randomly in various directions, leaving no secure path to navigate the tunnel.  Water drips down the rocky walls of the interior, and a louder continuous splashing sound can be heard from the north.

title: [Cavern, Waterfall]
description: The ceiling of the natural chamber rises high above your head.  The north wall forms a steep slope, smoothed by the wide cascade of water that flows down its surface and disappears into an underground stream.  Looking up, you can see a space of light near the top of the wall where the fall originates.

title: [Cavern, Ledge]
description: You are balanced on a small ledge which is jutting out from a soft waterfall which forms the north wall.  Below is the cavern floor and above you can make out the edge of a chamber.  From here you can see more hand-holds which can get you to the top.

title: [Cavern, Ledge]
description: You find yourself standing in a very shallow stream which dribbles over the edge of this chamber and down into a deep cavern.  The water originates from outside and a dim light filters in with it.
You find yourself standing in a very shallow stream which dribbles over the edge of this chamber and down into a deep cavern.  The water originates from outside and a bright light filters in with it.

title: [Hidden Vale, Slopes]
description: The ground slopes down into a quiet grassy vale which extends off into the misty horizon.  The wind is fresh and crisp on your face, and a slight breeze ruffles the surface of the quiet stream that winds into an opening in the rocky mountainside.

title: [Hidden Vale, Slopes]
description: Here on the slopes overlooking the hidden vale, soft grasses and tiny flowering blossoms line the path leading down and north into the valley.  To the south the slope rises steeply into the barrier of mountains.  Patterns of green meadows and scattered matches of trees fill the valley below.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, northwest, up

title: [Hidden Vale, Hill Wall]
description: A steep hill blocks the path to the north and east, its vine-covered slope providing little anchor for climbing.  Atop the hill, a stand of trees extends into the distance.

title: [Hidden Vale, Slopes]
description: A stand of thick and sturdy trees cuts across from east to west where the valley floor begins to level off.  The hills rise to the south, reaching upwards towards the mountains.  Small animals can be seen dashing from place to place.

title: [Hidden Vale, Slopes]
description: The lower slope of the vale drops off into a small but unpassably deep ravine to the northwest.  A line of trees extends to the east, and the grassy mountain slopes rise steeply to the south.

title: [Cliffs, Bushes]
description: The hills ascend steeply to the mountains here in a cliff that rises high above you, with no handholds to climb.  The base of the cliff is surrounded by scrub grass and clumps of bushes.

title: [Troll Lair, Entrance Hall]
description: The passage slants downward from the entrance in the cliff side.  It is damp in here and your feet have a little trouble gaining a good hold on the uneven floor.  Looking at the walls you see that some effort has been made to smooth the stone, but the attempts seem to have been made with primitive tools.  Away from the entrance you think you see the faint glowing of lichens and moss.  A slight stench pervades here.

title: [Troll Lair, Entrance Hall]
description: The passage continues dropping slightly as it runs east.  Moss and lichens grow thick on the walls and in patches on the ceiling.  The lichens are glowing slightly giving an eerie aura to everything here.  Your stomach turns at the reek in the air.

title: [Troll Lair, Main Chamber]
description: This huge chamber smells of rotted meat. There are several uncured pelts here, each covering a mat of dried leaves.  The pelts are moth-eaten, slightly bald and generally torn up.  In the center is a well used firepit.  There are large animal bones and skulls lying about.

title: [Troll Lair, Hall]
description: The hall is strewn with droppings, litter, and animal parts, making footing difficult at best.  Among the debris can be seen various bits of leather and metal that appear to have once been armor.  A fouler stench wafts in from the northeast.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Troll Lair, Quarters]
description: A single skin-covered pallet stands by the wall of the small chamber, which is apparently home to a single troll.  The floor is covered in debris, old bones, and half-eaten game, and a small cask stands in one corner.

title: [Troll Lair, Stores]
description: This tiny room holds a stash of food, sacks and tools for digging.

title: [Troll Lair, Quarters]
description: This room is small, cramped and dank.  There are three skins, covering matted leaves, which serve as beds.  Moss competes with garbage for floor space.  The walls are caked with grime and decaying meat.  The corners are crowded with bones and rancid flesh.

title: [Troll Lair, Stores]
description: The tiny chamber is piled with the worldly possessions of a troll family.  Dead game animals, stone tools and rough, bloody skins litter the floor.

title: [Troll Lair, Pet's Room]
description: Ugh! What a smell you've discovered.  The combination of wet grass, animal musk, and urine almost makes you pass out.  Only the revolting thought of falling into the moldy grass that covers the floor keeps you awake.

title: [Troll Lair, Long Hall]
description: The stench lessens as you continue along the passage, yet you are still surrounded by filth.  Rotting leaves and gamey-smelling skins litter the floor.  Dried blood stains the walls and floors, which are pitted and marked as if they had been hit with something heavy.  A large skin lies in the center of the hall.

title: [Clan Leader's Stores]
description: This irregularly-shaped chamber is filled with deep shadows, in which can be seen the forms of various rabbits, birds and small reptiles hung up to be stored as food.  The rotting hulk of a slaughtered rolton fills one corner, and the room is littered with sacks, tools, and casks.

title: [Clan Leader's Room]
description: This appears to be the living quarters of a high-ranking family of the troll clan, judging by the relative quality of the stinking, worthless skins on the matted beds that line the walls.  Some small glittering items are piled by the beds, and a large flat rock surrounded by two stumps and a smaller rock seems to serve as a table.

title: [The Pit]
description: You are trapped in a very deep pit.  It really smells of rotted meat here.  If you dare to look about you, you'll see the moldy bones of others who did not escape.

title: [The Stone Eye, Foyer]
description: Large slabs of granite, sitting snugly into solid oak crossbeams, make up the four walls, floor and ceiling.  Tiny gargoyles leer at you from a ledge affixed slightly below ceiling height.  Each gargoyle appears to have been hand carved with its own personality.

title: [The Stone Eye, Bar]
description: A granite bar the length of two giantmen dominates the room.  At each end of the bar sit two life-size gargoyles, crouching as if ready to pounce upon an unwary patron.  The stone eyes of the gargoyles radiate a smoky malevolence that seems directed towards you personally.

title: [The Stone Eye, Den]
description: Overstuffed armchairs, upholstered in comfortable rolton cotton dyed in muted oranges and browns, are arranged in small groups around the room.  A large fireplace warms the air around you with its lively blaze.  A picture window allows an unobstructed view of the river below and the delta in the distance.  An arched doorway leads out to the veranda.  The silky, slow, susurrations of river water passing over rocks lend an atmosphere of peace to the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, southwest, down

title: [The Stone Eye, Meeting Hall]
description: This circular chamber contains a single bench which runs along the wall.  No other seat is available, except the floor, in order that everyone may look into the eyes of every other person here.  By design of the proprietor, this configuration is intended to force honesty, or at least acceptance of one's actions, upon those who discuss weighty matters.

title: [The Stone Eye, Veranda]
description: The slanted roof of the veranda keeps out the night insects.  The veranda overlooks the North Fork of the Tempest River.  Moonlight reflects off the swiftly moving river, giving it a silvery glow.  The steep, densely wooded cliffs on the northern bank of the river are barely visible in the dark.  A ramp leads down to a narrow wooden dock.

The slanted roof of the veranda offers respite from the sun.  The veranda overlooks the North Fork of the Tempest River.  The sunlight catches the ripples of the swiftly moving river, making the water dance with diamond-bright sparkles.  Steep, densely wooded cliffs form the northern bank of the river.  A ramp leads down to a narrow wooden dock.

title: [Floating Dock, Tempest River]
description: The dock is little more than a few hundred narrowly-spaced slats carefully tied with sail cordage to a trio of long beams.  Large, ovoid casks, coated with pitch and spaced every few yards, keep it afloat.  The dock juts into an eddy formed by the current of the river rushing west and the waves from the Bay moving east.  A ramp leads up to the Stone Eye veranda.

A massive dock stretches far out over the river's surface, complete with large support columns at regular intervals, several slips for boats of various sizes, and a series of steps leading towards the swiftly flowing river.  A large warehouse sits adjacent to the slips, and a ramp leads up to the Stone Eye veranda.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: The uneven floor of the bay is dotted with clumps of seaweed and tall, tree-like clusters of elkhorn coral.  The floor of the bay rises sharply to the south.  A rocky wall, covered with bladder rockweed, emerges abruptly from the sandy bay floor to the east.
paths: Obvious exits: north, west, northwest, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: Elkhorn coral, ten feet tall and branched like trees, grows in small groves.  The floor of the bay, uneven and dotted with clumps of kelp and seaweed, rises sharply to south.  The tracks of crabs and mud shrimp score the sand on the bay floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: A steady and powerful current prevents swimming to the west.  Long strands of broad-leafed kelp undulate in the current.  A few tall fans of elkhorn coral stand like trees on the sandy bay floor.  To the south, the bay floor rises abruptly.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: To the west a coral reef grows out of the golden sand of the bay floor.  A large colony of spiral gilled tube worms has attached itself to the coral.  The wreck of a small coastal cutter lies on its side.  The tracks of crabs and lobsters lead in and out of the wreck.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, up

description: Light green water above, deep green water below, green water all around.  The shimmering surface of the bay rolls sinuously overhead.  A gentle current presses in from the west.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up, down

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: A pair of tall elkhorn corals stand in the sand of the bay floor like sentinels.  Bluish turtle grass, thick as a lawn, surrounds the coral.  A few grey, egg-sized stones lay scattered in the turtle grass.  Dozens of yellow-striped fish, no bigger than a dwarf's thumb, meander through the thick grasses.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: A rocky wall, strewn with dark green clumps of bladder rockweed, rises to the east.  A boulder the size of a hermit's hut is sunk into the sand of the bay floor.  Small, brightly- colored fish dart back and forth between the barnacle-covered boulder and the rockweed.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Underwater]
description: Light green water above, deep green water below, green water all around.  Bladder rockweed grows in crowded clumps on the rocky wall to the east.  The shimmering surface of the bay rolls sinuously overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, west, northwest, up, down

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: The rocky wall curves from the south to the northwest.  Bladder rockweed clings to the stones and sways in slow motion.  Schools of mud shrimp scurry among the rockweed.  A few loggerhead sponges the size of large pumpkins grow in the sand of the bay floor.
paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: The sandy bay floor is crisscrossed with the tracks of marine life...crabs, lobsters, sea slugs, bay roaches.  A hazy spray of silt is suspended in the water, carried slowly eastward by the gentle current.  A pair of sea fans, like the ears of an elephant, grows out of the golden sand of the bay floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Underwater]
description: Light green water above, deep green water below, green water all around.  The shimmering surface of the bay rolls sinuously overhead.  A moderate current presses in from the west.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up, down

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: A coral reef blocks the way west.  A colony of spiral gilled tube worms has attached itself to the dead coral of the reef.  Kelp and seaweed undulate sinuously in the current.  A few small silvery fish, thin as stiletto blades, slice through the water among the seaweed.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: A strong current prevents swimming to the west.  The current makes the long strands of broad-leafed kelp undulate like underwater belly-dancers.  Crabs and lobsters have scuttled along the sandy floor of the bay, leaving tiny dimple-like tracks.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Under Water]
description: Light green water above, deep green water below, green water all around.  To the southwest is a reef covered with club-fingered coral.  A powerful current makes swimming to the west and north impossible.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, up, down

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Under Water]
description: Light green water above, deep green water below, green water all around. Organ-pipe sponges grow among the knotted rockweed on the rocky wall to the northeast.  Overhead, the shimmering surface of the bay rolls sinuously.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up, down

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: A rock wall, running southeast to northwest, rises abruptly from the sand of the bay floor.  The rocks are dotted with knotted rockweed and organ pipe sponges.  A current of warmer water channels through the rock wall, kicking up tiny spirals of golden sand.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bottom]
description: A rocky wall rising from the sandy bay floor curves gently from the southwest to the north.  Clumps of knotted rockweed grow among the dark stones of the rock wall.  A mass of pale organ pipe sponges gives the rocky wall an odd-mildewed appearance.  Strong currents prevent swimming to the north or west.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Underwater]
description: Light green water above, deep green water below, green water all around.  Pale patches of organ-pipe sponges grow among the knotted rockweed attached to the rocky wall that curves from the southwest to the north.  Overhead, the shimmering surface of the bay rolls sinuously.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, up, down

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Coral Reef]
description: The narrow coral reef barely rises above the surface of the bay.  The low, foam-flecked swells hardly break as they roll by the small reef.  A few ships' timbers, broken and whitened by saltwater and age, have washed up on the reef and lodged in the coral crags.  A sharp current prevents any movement to the west.  The low line of the mainland can be seen in the distance to the northeast.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Coral Reef]
description: Barely rising above the surface of the bay, the coral reef offers a slippery foothold.  The reef stretches to the north.  The shells of small crabs and shellfish, cracked and empty, lie scattered about in the nooks and crannies of the reef.  Sea birds screech overhead as they search for food.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Shipwreck]
description: A deep layer of muck covers the curve of the starboard bulkhead underfoot.  Overhead, the arc of the port bulkhead is buckled.  A massive gash in the wall now formed by the hull is surrounded by huge, jagged splinters.  A smashed hatchway that once would have led to the deck now acts as a window, blocked by the coral reef.  The broken staves of barrels, turned almost blonde by the saltwater, float overhead against the port bulkhead.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Shipwreck]
description: A deep layer of muck covers the curve of the starboard bulkhead underfoot.  Overhead, the arc of the port bulkhead is buckled and sprung.  A brass ship's lantern hangs at an improbable angle from what was once the ceiling.  The rotted remains of burlap bags, their contents long ago consumed by seawater and crustaceans, are scattered through the muck.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Shipwreck]
description: A deep layer of muck covers the curve of the starboard bulkhead underfoot.  A pocket of air, stale and stinking of decaying wood, has been caught in the gentle arc of the port bulkhead.  Wooden barrels lie in turbulent disorder partially covered by the muck, making for awkward footing.  A brass ship's lantern hangs at an improbable angle from what was once the ceiling.

title: [Ruined Tower, Exterior]
description: Deep grass extends all the way to the stony reef to the south.  Waves crash into the reef, sending up a white plume of salt spray.  The magnificent, white-capped expanse of Maelstrom Bay is spread out before you.  The reef extends to the southwest, beyond which can be seen a portion of the forested mainland and a sliver of the island of River's Rest.

title: [Ruined Tower, Exterior]
description: The high stucco wall forms a right angle, creating a sort of yard.  A very old and very tattered straw archery butt is set back away from the wall.  The target is nearly hidden by the tall grasses that sway as the breeze swirls around the area.  Maelstrom Bay is visible beyond the reef to the south.

title: [Ruined Tower, Exterior]
description: Deep beach and scrub grasses cover the area between the high stucco wall and the rocky reef to the south.  Maelstrom Bay stretches out beyond the reef to the southwest.  The horizon there is indistinguishable from the great western sea.  From this angle, the blue-tiled roof of the tower to the northeast is barely visible behind the wall.

title: [Ruined Tower, Exterior]
description: The grasses grow high on either side of the pathway.  The path itself is little more than a slightly lower growth of scrub grass and weeds.  The crunching of oyster shells underfoot is the only reminder that this was once a real walkway.  A brown vine has creeped partway up the high stucco wall.

title: [Ruined Tower, Exterior]
description: A pathway of crushed oyster shells, barely visible in the thick scrub grass, leads northeast and south following a high stucco wall.  Behind the wall a tall, damaged tower with a blue-tiled roof can be seen.  A marshy gully bars any passage to the north, but a thin trail through the grass leads northwest, down into the gully.

title: [Ruined Tower, Exterior]
description: Scrub grass and patches of thin, reedy weeds grow in the sandy soil.  To the north is a gully, at the bottom of which is a salt marsh.  Beyond the gully a hilly moor stretches off to the mist-shrouded horizon.  Behind the high stucco wall on the southern side of the pathway stands a tall, damaged tower.

title: [Ruined Tower, Exterior]
description: Scrub grass grows in fitful clumps and patches in the sandy soil.  A large wooden gate is set in the tall stucco wall.  Looming behind the wall, which is decorated with bits of bright coral, is a tall tower.  An ancient pathway made from crushed oyster shells is barely visible in the grass.

title: [Ruined Tower, Outer Ward]
description: Scrub grass grows in wild clumps in this small ward.  A large wooden gate on the eastern side of this gatehouse was evidently barricaded at one time.  The heavy timbers that barred the gate have been removed and lie rotting on the ground.  To the west, a heavily pitted portcullis has been raised to allow entrance to the courtyard that is visible beyond.  A broad flight of stairs descends into a shadowy room below.

title: [Ruined Tower, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard spreads broadly under the imposing presence of a tall, aging tower.  Remnants of a large broken seashell lie shattered in front of a portcullis leading into a rough stone gatehouse.  The archway over the portcullis is formed of white and blue corals, and an imprint at the apex of the arch shows a relief of the fallen shell.  Fragments of blue tile lie scattered across the courtyard.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ruined Tower, Courtyard]
description: Only small sections of the walls surrounding the courtyard retain the images painted on them in years gone by.  Although badly faded by long exposure to the sun and salt air, the remaining designs are sufficiently intact to reveal an aquatic motif.

title: [Ruined Tower, Courtyard]
description: Scrub grass and weeds grow between the loose cobbles of the courtyard.  Cracks abound on the tall wall surrounding the area.  The ancient tower looms ominously overhead in the moonlight.  Gaping windows look out over the bay and courtyard from high on the tower walls.

Scrub grass and weeds grow between the loose cobbles of the courtyard.  Cracks abound on the tall wall surrounding the area.  The shadow of the ancient tower cascades over the wall and courtyard, providing a cool respite from the glaring sun.  Gaping windows look out over the bay and courtyard from high on the tower wall.

title: [Ruined Tower, Courtyard]
description: An open archway leads west directly into the high tower.  The archway, adorned with mottled pink and white shells, shows the signs of ancient damage and small weeds and wildflowers have taken root in the wide cracks.  Barely visible near the top of the interior of the arch are the sharpened spikes of a portcullis, now firmly corroded in place by the salty air.  A gentle breeze scatters fine-grained sand throughout the courtyard.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Ruined Tower, Courtyard]
description: Rubble from a ruined alabaster statue lies scattered among the stunted weeds which grow between the cracks of the cobblestones.  The base of the statue remains relatively intact, but the upper third has been reduced to fist-sized chunks of alabaster.  Cracks appear in the wall surrounding the courtyard.

title: [Ruined Tower, Courtyard]
description: The cobblestone courtyard is in terrible disrepair, and weeds struggle to grow between the gaps in the stone.  The entire plaza is spattered with the white-grey streaks of gull droppings, and several gulls watch warily from the tops of the surrounding walls.

title: [Ruined Tower, Entry Hall]
description: The sounds of a soft breeze and the cries of seagulls carry through a large archway, providing a touch of serenity to the abandoned tower.  A wide track of water leads from the arch to the center of the room where it ends in a puddle.  The small puddle appears to be a recent addition to the tower as there are no signs of a water ring around its edge.  The entry hall narrows to the west.

title: [Ruined Tower, Entry Hall]
description: Murals line both sides of the spacious entry hall.  A pair of tall, arched windows face east, the glass long ago shattered and replaced by a fine network of silvery cobwebs.  A gentle breeze, laden with the scent of the bay, billows the web.

title: [Ruined Tower, Audience Room]
description: Great vaulted ceilings arch high above, supported by thick ribs of gold-flecked blue riverstone.  Although fuscous patches of mold spread over parts of the walls, the original color of the chamber is still visible.  The pallid blue hue of the plaster walls contrasts pleasantly with the deeper blue of the riverstone.  Bas relief carvings of fantastic sea creatures encircle the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Ruined Tower, Great Hall]
description: Two great haon tables are aligned in parallel in the center of the room.  Above them, hanging from a web of brass chains, is a massive and very ornate crystal chandelier.  A pair of stained glass windows, their panes long ago shattered, allow the sea breeze to waft through the room.  Moonlight filtering in through the windows illuminates the bits of colored glass scattered on the stone floor beneath the windows.

Two great haon tables are aligned in parallel in the center of the room.  Above them, hanging from a web of brass chains, is a massive and very ornate crystal chandelier.  A pair of stained glass windows, their panes long ago shattered, allow the sea breeze to waft through the room.  Sunlight filtering in through the windows illuminates the bits of colored glass scattered on the stone floor beneath the windows.

title: [Ruined Tower, Ballroom]
description: Time-ravaged frescoes adorn the walls.  The floor, a checkerboard of blackened and greyed flagstones, is smeared where water has mingled with the coating of dust and grime.  The large, crystal chandelier is partially concealed by thick insect-ridden spider webs.

title: [Ruined Tower, Passageway]
description: A wide stairway encircles a thick, fluted pillar, both rising and descending from the flagstone landing floor.  The molding remains of old tapestries lie in damp, blackened heaps at the base of the western wall, never again to dazzle visitors with their finery.

title: [Ruined Tower, Pool]
description: In the center of the room is an onyx and lapis-inlaid pool, its lip rising three feet above the floor.  The entire chamber is bathed in a preternatural turquoise light that shines from four lanterns symmetrically spaced around the room.  A mosaic of interwoven golden circles and silver triangles is inset in the walls ringing the pool.

title: [Ruined Tower, Workshop]
description: Heavily corroded brass curtain rods are barely intact over the archway leading westward, the curtains that once draped over the arch long gone.  A large crystal orb stands on a pedestal in the middle of the chamber, a bluish-green viscous fluid writhing on the interior of the sphere.  The sphere gives off a faint glow that fills the chamber, highlighting the alembics, phials, crucibles and retorts that rest on an old workbench.

title: [Ruined Tower, Small Chamber]
description: Small windows in the bare stone walls look out over Maelstrom Bay to the north and west.  The view is partially obscured in each direction by the outer walls of the fortress, but is still a pleasant sight in the midst of this ruin.  The fluted column in the center of the room supports a wide circular stair.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, up, down

title: [Ruined Tower, Library]
description: Dusty tomes, most showing signs of mildew and water damage, are stacked in disarray on the wooden shelves lining the walls of this old library.  The plaster walls are badly cracked.  A moldy journal rests atop a mahogany pedestal standing near the southern wall.  A large, faintly glowing crystal is set on sculpted riverstone stand.

title: [Ruined Tower, Aquarium]
description: Shattered glass lies scattered about on the floor where two large aquarium tanks have been broken, and a variety of fish skeletons lie mixed with other, more unusual, aquatic remains.  Several other glass tanks still filled with water stand throughout the room.  Large globs of green algae cover the sides of the tanks.

title: [Ruined Tower, Gallery]
description: The light grey stone walls would have provided an unobtrusive background for the works of art gathered here.  The artwork is in disarray, as if the entire room had been seized by giant hands and shaken.  Many of the paintings have fallen from the wall, and several of the statues have tipped over or fallen from their stands.  In one corner of the gallery a statue of Niima, the Wavedancer, has fallen against a statue of Charl, her harsh father.

title: [Ruined Tower, Sitting Room]
description: The blue riverstone lintel of the small window has toppled onto the floor, leaving an ugly crack in the grey slate tiles.  The once comfortable settee and the overstuffed chair have become a nesting site for rodents and vermin.  The bronze dolphin-shaped oil lamps suspended from the ceiling are enshrouded in cobwebs.  The breeze through the open window carries the scent of saltwater.

title: [Ruined Tower, Stairwell]
description: A small leaded glass window in the bare stone wall looks out over Maelstrom Bay to the east.  A spider has woven a delicate web in one angle of the window.  The fluted column in the center of the room supports a narrow circular stair.

title: [Ruined Tower, Bedroom]
description: A faint, sour odor of mildew and mold suffuses the small bedroom.  The bed linens have rotted, leaving only a thin mattress with the ticking poking through the seams.  A straight-backed chair is set near a small oak writing desk.  Heavy wooden shutters bar the two small windows, leaving the room rather dark.  A copper brazier in the corner has toppled onto its side.

title: [Ruined Tower, Roof]
description: Moonlight shines off the blue barrel tiles that cover the top of the tower.  Many tiles have cracked and begun to crumble, others have been dislodged and fallen to the courtyard below.  The view is panoramic.  To the east lies the forest-covered mainland.  South and east are Maelstrom Bay and the very tip of the island of River's Rest.  To the west is the expanse of the bay and beyond it, the great western sea.

Sunlight glares off the blue barrel tiles that cover the top of the tower.  Many tiles have cracked and begun to crumble, others have been dislodged and fallen to the courtyard below.  The view is panoramic.  To the east lies the forest-covered mainland.  South and east are Maelstrom Bay and the very tip of the island of River's Rest.  To the west is the expanse of the bay and beyond it, the great western sea.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Chamber]
description: A broad stairway descends into this chamber, and muted grey light carries down the stairs to wash over the rough stone floor.  The rounded chamber was a guardpost, judging by the iron bell hanging from a steel brace protruding from the wall and the rotting weapon rack that rests against the side of the stairwell.  The remains of an iron gate, long ago turned to rust, lie on the floor before a shadow-draped corridor leading southeast.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Passageway]
description: The rough-hewn stone corridor proceeds into darkness to the southeast, and faint grey light can be seen to the northwest.  An old cell door stands open in the northeast wall, at once beckoning and menacing.  Faint dark streaks can be seen on the floor coming from the doorway, though it is obvious that they have faded over time.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Cell]
description: Nothing save a few scattered remnants of a cot are left in this otherwise barren cell.  Only cold stone and the cries of other prisoners would have kept the unfortunate inhabitants of this old dungeon company.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Passageway]
description: Dark shadows play off of the walls of the dank corridor, giving the impression of scampering imps just out of your sight.  The passage continues in two directions, angling slightly upward to the northwest, with a gentle downward slope to the northeast.  Web-shrouded steps descend into the darkness below.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Passageway]
description: An ancient, rusting sconce holds the crumbling remains of a torch on the dark stone wall.  Blackened streaks mar the wall above the sconce, stretching to the ceiling of the passage.  A door hangs loosely in the entrance to a cell to the southeast, the iron spikes in the hinges reluctantly releasing their grip on the rotting wood.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Cell]
description: Nothing save a few scattered remnants of a cot are left in this otherwise barren cell.  Only cold stone and the cries of other prisoners would have kept the unfortunate inhabitants of this old dungeon company.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Passageway]
description: The rough, utilitarian workmanship of the tenebrous dungeon corridor emphasizes the grim environment.  From the southwest a slight breeze filters in, tinging the barely perceptible odor of rotting wood with the brackish scent of saltwater.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Cell]
description: Nothing save a few scattered remnants of a cot are left in this otherwise barren cell.  Only cold stone and the cries of other prisoners would have kept the unfortunate inhabitants of this old dungeon company.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Passageway]
description: The black-brown walls encroach upon the passage, stones jutting from the sides as the corridor narrows.  Aging oak doors to the northeast and southeast stand ajar, their rusted hinges locking them in place.  Shadows shroud the rooms beyond the decaying portals, unwilling to reveal the secrets that they have held for so long.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Cell]
description: A few tattered scraps of ticking are scattered in one corner of this dank cell, the final remnants of a rotted bedding pile.  Faint scratch marks can be seen on the wall beside the door, signifying a long-forgotten prisoner's accounting tablet.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Torture Chamber]
description: Large torture devices fill this dim dank room.  Dark brown stains spot the floor, and indescribable odors linger in the air.  The pain and anguish that has been poured forth into this room seems to have become a part of the walls, and the whole chamber exudes a dolorous aura.

title: [Ruined Dungeon, Stairway]
description: A rough stone stairway has been carved out of the limestone that leads up from the watery passageway.  A few steps up, mist-laden spiderwebs hang across the stairwell, their creators long gone from this secluded corridor.  The gentle splashing of water can be heard to the west, carried on a warm, salty breeze.

title: [Reef, Submerged Passageway]
description: Knee-deep water covers the sandy path as it winds between coral outcroppings.  A musical dripping sound echoes through the passage as condensation falls from the walls of the passage into the water below.  To the east the passageway, wrapped in darkness, has clearly been formed by hands rather than by nature.

title: [Reef, Submerged Passageway]
description: The path leads between two very tall coral structures that seem to dance with life inside.  Crossed spears have been stuck into the reef above the path, forcing passersby to duck or risk a nasty head wound.  A group of small radiant fish have made a home in this area, and they dart frenetically through the submerged passage.

title: [Reef, Submerged Passageway]
description: Several inches of water cover the floor of this tall, narrow grotto formed in the coral reef.  The moon filters through cracks overhead and reflects off the water, casting strange shadows that dance on the water as it ebbs and flows.  Small fish flash among the pink and orange coral like living darts.  The grotto extends north.

Several inches of water cover the floor of this tall, narrow grotto formed in the coral reef.  The sun filters through cracks overhead and reflects off the water, casting strange shadows that dance on the water as it ebbs and flows.  Small fish flash among the pink and orange coral like living darts.  The grotto extends north.

title: [Ruined Tower, Salt Marsh]
description: The air is fetid and still.  Tall reeds and bullrushes grow in the scum-covered marsh on either side of the thin trail.  The whirring of gnats and midges, so high-pitched as to be almost beyond the range of hearing, drifts across the marsh.

title: [Shattered Moors, Salt Marsh]
description: The basso croak of a bullfrog and the trill of crickets are the only sounds to be heard in the still air of the salt marsh.  The boggy trail is only slightly more firm than the reeking muck on either side.  The pale moonlight reflects eerily in the small patches of brackish water.

The oily screech of a marsh bird and the high-pitched humming of midges and gnats are the only sounds to be heard in the still air of the salt marsh.  The boggy trail is only slightly more firm than the reeking muck on either side.  The sunlight seems hazy, as if the weight of the air leans too heavily on the light.

title: [Shattered Moors, Salt Marsh]
description: A massive boulder rises from the muck and mud of the marsh.  The air is gravid with the primordial odor of decaying vegetation, thick alluvial ooze, and slow-moving brackish water.  Through the reeds and bullrushes to the southeast one can glimpse the moonlight glinting off the blue roof of an ancient tower.

A massive boulder rises from the muck and mud of the marsh.  The air is gravid with the primordial odor of decaying vegetation, thick alluvial ooze, and slow-moving brackish water.  Through the reeds and bullrushes to the southeast one can glimpse the sun glinting off the blue roof of an ancient tower.

title: [Shattered Moors]
description: The ground is soft and marshy.  Tiny rivulets of dark, brackish water trickle musically through the peaty soil.  Heather shrubs, thin and spindly, dot the landscape.  The ground rises steeply to the north.  To the southwest can be seen a large boulder.

title: [Shattered Moors]
description: The path follows the contour of the steeply rolling moors, weaving among the gorse and heather.  The trickling of tiny rivulets of water can be heard, a melodious counterpoint to the wind rustling through the low bushes.  The pungent scent of juniper is carried on the breeze.

title: [Shattered Moors]
description: A large, disordered pile of stones lies close by the pathway.  A spindly tree, its branches achingly twisted, grows nearby.  Heather and gorse grow thickly across the desolate moors.  The ground drops sharply to the south.

title: [Shattered Moors]
description: A light mist covers the ground, growing more dense and opaque to the northwest.  The breeze seems unnaturally chilly.  The crisp scent of heather and gorse carried on the breeze is suffused with an earthy smell of peat.

title: [Shattered Moors]
description: Tendrils of grey mist coil around the few low trees.  The mist is thick enough to obscure the lay of the terrain, but not so thick that it hides the pathway.  The topmost branches of the low trees are silhouetted by the cool bluish light of the moons.

Tendrils of grey mist coil around the few low trees.  The mist is thick enough to obscure the lay of the terrain, but not so thick that it hides the pathway.  The topmost branches of the low trees are illuminated by the warm yellow light of the sun.

title: [Shattered Moors]
description: The slight elevation in the trail is enough to raise it above the mist.  The small knoll is like an island entirely surrounded by wispy grey mist.  Only a few small, twisted trees are visible above the mist, their branches looking pathetic in the moonlight.  The path, though apparently more solid than the soil elsewhere, is spongy under foot.

Only a few small, twisted trees are visible above the mist, their branches looking pathetic in the sunlight.  The path, though apparently more solid than the soil elsewhere, is spongy under foot.

title: [Shattered Moors]
description: Mist obscures the moors beyond the trail, turning the landscape into an eldritch patchwork of greens and browns.  The mist seems to catch the moonlight, which gives it an otherworldly glow.  A few wild roses, little more than pale splashes of pink, grow among the heather and gorse.

Mist obscures the moors beyond the trail, turning the landscape into an eldritch patchwork of greens and browns.  The mist seems impervious to the heat of the sun.  A few wild roses, little more than pale splashes of pink, grow among the heather and gorse.

title: [Shattered Moors, Trail]
description: The sound of distant waves carries in from the east and south.  The moors, a tapestry of mottled greens and sedgy browns, stretch off in all other directions.  An eerie mist rises over the trail leading down into the moors.  In the center of the trail is a weathered post with a dead gore crow nailed to it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, down

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Headland]
description: A path follows the curve of the steep headland.  A narrow trail leads north into the thick grasses of the moor.  A ship, stark in the moonlit sky, lies careened on the dark, stony beach of the inlet below.  The sound of the waves is barely audible over the rush of the wind through the tall grasses.

A path follows the curve of the steep headland.  A narrow trail leads north into the thick grasses of the moor.  A ship lies careened on the dark, stony beach of the inlet below.  The sound of the waves is barely audible over the rush of the wind through the tall grasses.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, northwest, down

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Headland]
description: Pink-hued rocks and small boulders are scattered among the tall grasses lining the headland.  To the west the greyish expanse of Maelstrom Bay sparkles in the moonlight, opening out to the great western sea.  The wind, scented with wild red sorrel, whirls among the grasses, making them shift and bow.

Pink-hued rocks and small boulders are scattered among the tall grasses lining the headland.  To the west the greyish expanse of Maelstrom Bay sparkles in the sunlight, opening out to the great western sea.  The wind, scented with wild red sorrel, whirls among the grasses, making them shift and bow.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Headland]
description: The grasses grow singularly tall on this part of the headlands, creating a sort of golden screen that nearly conceals a house-sized boulder that emerges from an earthen mound.  The southward path slopes down to a series of low seaside bluffs.  The waves on the beach below are an eerie green in the moonlight.

The grasses grow singularly tall on this part of the headlands, creating a sort of golden screen that nearly conceals a house-sized boulder that emerges from an earthen mound.  The southward path slopes down to a series of low seaside bluffs.  On the dark beach below sandpipers dart back and forth, dodging the incoming waves as they feed.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bluffs]
description: The bluff overlooks Maelstrom Bay.  The sky over the bay is dotted with grey gulls, hovering and diving for fish.  Razor grass, impenetrably thick, is mixed with the taller beach grasses that line the landward side of the path.  To the north the terrain climbs up to a steep headland.  Southward the path slopes gently down.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bluffs]
description: The wind off Maelstrom Bay blows black gritty sand up from the narrow beach below.  The thick razor grass waves in the wind, swaying like spear tips of warriors on the march.  A bit of water has gathered in the depression left by some footprints in a soft patch of marshy soil beside the trail.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bluffs]
description: The trail edges perilously close to the bluff.  A few large chunks of soil and turf are visible on the narrow beach below, evidence that erosion is slowly forcing the bluffs to collapse into Maelstrom Bay.  Razor grass grows thickly on the landward side of the trail.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Bluffs]
description: A trail leads north along the bluff.  Maelstrom Bay stretches off to the west.  Along the base of the bluff to the west is a narrow strip of shingle beach, against which the surf pounds noisily.  To the south the ground falls away abruptly as if some cataclysmic tectonic shift took place, creating a steep escarpment in the stone-riddled, peaty soil.  The thick reeds of a salt marsh grow abundantly at the bottom of the escarpment.

title: [Shattered Moors, Salt Marsh]
description: The marsh abuts an escarpment so steep and geologically out of place it's as if the ground suddenly shifted up over a dozen feet.  Thick reeds and cattails grow directly up against the escarpment.  Sedge grass grows thickly on either side of the narrow, mucky path.  The air, uncomfortably still, is redolent with the rich organic smell of primordial ooze.

title: [Shattered Moors, Salt Marsh]
description: Tall cattails and reeds crowd each other.  Cordgrass grows thickly in rich diluvial soil deposited by the brackish water.  A high-pitched hum draws attention to a cloud of moquitoes hovering over the winding path.  The cool light of the moons casts a strange silvery hue on the path.

Tall cattails and reeds crowd each other.  Cordgrass grows thickly in rich diluvial soil deposited by the brackish water.  A high-pitched hum draws attention to a cloud of moquitoes hovering over the winding path.  The heat of the sun cannot lessen the stickiness of the still air.

title: [Shattered Moors, Salt Marsh]
description: Odd, curlicued trails and strange slash marks, the tracks of worms and small crabs, are traced in the thick slime that covers the path.  The hum of mosquitoes, black gnats and green-headed flies is constant.  The cordgrass is abundant, crowding the reeds.  A small patch of sea lavender is crowded in amongst the cordgrass, but the small delicately scented flowers fail to soften the deep odor of slowly decomposing vegetation.

title: [Shattered Moors, Salt Marsh]
description: The trail widens as it passes a brackish pool.  The small clearing permits the shallowest hint of a cooling breeze, just enough to reduce the constant hum of gnats and mosquitoes.  The thin, errant breeze stirs up the primal stink of rotting plants and rich, diluvial mud.  A small hummock rises out of the cattails to the south.

title: [Shattered Moors, Salt Marsh]
description: The path climbs a small hummock, completely surrounded by tall cattails, bullrushes and thick reeds.  A ridge can be seen thrusting up along the north side of the marsh, leading to a spare and desolate moor.  A large boulder is visible to the east.  The path to the southwest disappears among the reeds.

title: [Shattered Moors, Trail]
description: A damp haze fills the air...not wet enough to be mist, not opaque enough to be fog.  The trail, winding through hummocks of gorse and heather, is spongy underfoot.  A wide trail or an under-used road lies beyond a weedy footpath leading northwest.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Headland]
description: The ground here has split open, torn asunder by some ancient cataclysm.  Large sections of the headland have collapsed, sliding downward, leaving a geological scar that is still obvious.  The unstable ground makes further travel along the headland impossible.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Dunes]
description: Small, wave-rounded, black and grey stones mix with coarse blackish sand to form a tall berm.  The furtive sound of scuttling claws over the moonlit stones sounds like the rattling of bones.  A badly damaged ship lies to the west, careened on the beach.  To the east, a path takes a circuitous route up the sides of the dark dunes to the headlands above.  Stacked on one side of the berm is a pile of coral, forming a simple burial marker.

Small, wave-rounded, black and grey stones mix with coarse blackish sand to form a tall berm.  Small mottle-shelled crabs skittle frantically across the sand.  Gulls wheel and dart, diving down to snatch at the small crabs.  A badly damaged ship lies to the west, careened on the beach.  To the east, a path takes a circuitous route up the sides of the dark dunes to the headlands above.  Stacked on one side of the berm is a pile of coral, forming a simple burial marker.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Rocky Beach]
description: The narrow inlet is sheltered from the large swells and waves of Maelstrom Bay by a rocky reef.  The beach is comprised of small black and grey stones.  The gentle action of the waves washing up on the beach creates a continuous rattle as the stones abrade each other.  Moonlight glints off the stony beach, making it seem to sparkle.  Tall bluffs and cliffs rise to the east.  A much-battered ship...a carrack of krolvin design...is careened awkwardly on the beach.

Tall bluffs and cliffs rise to the east.  A much-battered ship...a carrack of krolvin design...is careened awkwardly on the beach.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Main Deck]
description: The deck slants to starboard, making footing awkward.  The mainmast, shattered just above the deckline, angles downward through a splintered bulwark toward the reef below.  Rigging, useless now, lies coiled and scattered around the deck.  The oaken hatchway into the forecastle has been torn partially from its hinges.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Forecastle]
description: Overhead the hatch covering the ceiling grating has sprung partially open, letting a few beams of moonlight filter in.  The room is a maze of rope hammocks slung fore-and-aft, all hanging aslant of the starboard-tilted deck.  A steep companionway leads down.

Overhead the hatch covering the ceiling grating has sprung partially open, letting a few rays of sunlight filter in.  The room is a maze of rope hammocks slung fore-and-aft, all hanging aslant of the starboard-tilted deck.  A steep companionway leads down.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Forecastle]
description: The low-ceilinged, dark room is a maze of rope hammocks slung fore-and-aft, all hanging aslant of the starboard-tilted deck.  The starboard bulkhead is partly stove in, creating a large, splintery dent in the side of the ship.  Gear is slung about the area in disarray.

title: [Slave Deck, Passageway]
description: The acute slant of the deck makes for treacherous footing in the dark and narrow passageway.  The smell of stale sweat and harsh soap combine to form a rank, noxious stink.  On each side of the passageway is a wide, iron-reinforced door.  A steep companionway leads up and down.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down

title: [Branding Room]
description: An iron brazier is upended against the starboard bulkhead, spilling chunks of pitch-soaked wood.  Hung on the bulkhead is a rack containing a variety of smoke-blackened branding irons.  A low chest is made fast against the wall.

title: [Slave Pen]
description: Low-ceilinged and shallow, this room is lighted only by the modest rays of moonlight permitted by the small porthole.  Iron manacles, flecked with rust and what might be dried blood, are attached to a bolt on the inner bulkhead.

title: [Slave Deck, Passageway]
description: The acute slant of the deck makes for treacherous footing in the dark and narrow passageway.  The smell of stale sweat and harsh soap combine to form a rank, noxious stink.  On each side of the passageway is a wide, iron-reinforced door.

title: [Cargo Hold]
description: The wide-planked deck slants to starboard.  Wooden crates and barrels are stacked from deck to ceiling.  Most are lashed against each other and to the bulkhead, but a few have broken loose.  A steep companionway leads up.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, up, down

title: [Cordage Locker]
description: Miles of cordage is carefully stowed away here.  A huge length of hawser thicker than a giantman's thigh is coiled in one corner of the slanting deck.  Oft-spliced ropes for the braces, clewlines and other rigging are hung on stout pegs.  Fine lengths of light but sturdy cord for hoisting ensigns and flags are gathered in figure-eight loops.

title: [Cargo Hold]
description: The wide-planked deck slants to starboard.  Wooden crates and barrels are stacked from deck to ceiling.  Most are lashed against each other and to the bulkhead, but a few have broken loose.  The starboard bulkhead is buckled inward, creating a small hole high on the bulkhead wall just below the ceiling.  Moonlight pours through the hole, and the sound of waves can be heard.
