title: [Cargo Deck, Passageway]
description: The passageway is narrow and dark and the woodwork is rather dingy.  The deck tilts radically to starboard.  A companionway leads up and down.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south, west, up, down

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Bilge]
description: Dark and cramped, this narrow passageway is awash in foul, briny water.  The air is fetid.  The poor footing of the slimy and slippery deck is exacerbated by the extreme tilt of the ship.

title: [Cargo Deck, Aft Hold]
description: Large barrels made of brine-soaked pine are stacked and made fast against the bulkhead.  One barrel has snapped the restraining rope and broken against the starboard bulkhead, spilling chunks of rancid-looking salt-pork across the deck.

title: [Cargo Deck, Aft Hold]
description: Fat burlap bags and overstuffed gunnysacks are jammed from deck to ceiling and secured with a complex web of rope.  The area is scented with the smell of coffee, cocoa, tea and chicory root.  A brass lantern hook has recently been snapped off, leaving a sharp and shiny point.

title: [Ship's Surgery]
description: The deck, stained unpleasantly dark, slants to starboard.  A pair of sea chests have been lashed together to form a makeshift surgical table.  The area is littered with medical supplies and instruments...bandages, pledgets made from lint and spiderwebs, tourniquets, hammers of various sizes, bone saws.  The stink of corrupt flesh pervades the room.

title: [Ship's Carpentry]
description: Saws and hammers of various sizes and designs were once attached to a pegboard on the bulkhead.  They now lie scattered about the deck among a welter of nails, pegs, brass swivels, pins, cleats, and dowels.  Planks and slabs of oak, ash, fel and tarred hazelwood have been jolted from neatly piled stacks into chaotic clusters.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Passageway]
description: The acute slant of the deck makes for treacherous footing in the dark and narrow passageway.  The woodwork is bleached almost white from the use of harsh soap, the smell of which competes with the odor of sawdust and the spicy smell of sausages.  A small hatch leads up.  A companionway ladder leads down.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south, up, down

title: [Sailmaker's Closet]
description: Yards and yards of canvas are stored here, most of it furled in long rolls but some spread out as much as the tiny room will allow.  A small bench is dotted with various sized needles, balls of yellowed wax, thick leather palm pads, and large spools of thread.

title: [Sail Locker]
description: Yards and yards of canvas sails are folded and stacked in orderly piles throughout the small, dark room.  Heavy weather sails, lightweight sails, some much-patched, some spotless and new.

title: [Ship's Stores]
description: The room is redolent with an unusual but piquant smell that you sense on the back of your tongue as much as through your nose.  Crates and barrels are stacked and made fast against the bulkheads.  Hanging at an odd angle from the ceiling are joints of meat wrapped in an orangish gauze and bound securely with lengths of twine.

title: [Ship's Galley]
description: The bulkhead and ceiling near the small ship's oven are badly charred.  Smoke-blackened pots and pans hang from a grating overhead.  Sacks of flour, bags of rice, and burlap packets of cocoa have all split open, covering the tilting deck with a slick, crunchy, sweet-smelling mess.  Wooden ladles and spoons, once neatly organized on a shelf, lie a-jumble in the corner.

title: [Officer's Quarters]
description: The deck slants alarmingly to starboard.  One of a pair of ship's lanterns lies in a clutter of broken glass on the deck.  The other, still attached to its stanchion on the wall, appears to hang at an odd angle.  A sea chest has slid across the deck, leaving deep gouges in the wood.  A steep companionway leads down.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest, down

title: [First Officer's Cabin]
description: A large bloodstain is partially hidden by a ship's locker, torn loose by the wreck and smashed against the dented starboard bulkhead.  The thin mattress, flung from the bunk by the impact, has ruptured, scattering wads of cotton ticking throughout the cabin.  A short length of rope tied with a series of knots is coiled on the deck.

title: [Officer's Mess]
description: A set of brass gimbals allows the mess table to remain horizontal despite the awkward tilt of the deck.  Two of the four doors of a cabinet have sprung open.  The remains of the ship's china and crystal glassware, scattered about the deck, crunch under your feet.  In the crease of the deck and starboard bulkhead is a pile of simple steel cutlery.

title: [Midshipmen's Berth]
description: The ceiling of this small, low-beamed berth is nothing more than a hatch covering a piece of iron grating.  Three canvas hammocks slung fore-and-aft hang aslant, the lowermost besmirched by a malodorous dark stain in the center.  Sea chests and ship's duffles lie cluttered against the bulkhead.

title: [Captain's Cabin]
description: A long row of leaded glass stern windows looks out at a crazy angle over Maelstrom Bay.  Moonlight streams through the windows, revealing a scene of chaos.  Pillows from the bench locker beneath the windows are scattered across the deck.  Furniture, usually battened down, is strewn about the area.  Charts, crumpled and torn, are spread out on the deck.

Pillows from the bench locker beneath the windows are scattered across the deck.  Furniture, usually battened down, is strewn about the area.  Charts, crumpled and torn, are spread out on the deck.

title: [Captain's Cabin]
description: The angle of the ship causes the pair of small starboard windows, smaller and less ornate than the leaded glass stern windows, to look down on the choppy water of the bay.  Loose furniture lies jumbled and damaged against the bulkhead.  The deck is littered with papers, charts, overturned inkpots, a dented brass lantern, and the shards of a whiskey jug.

title: [Captain's Cabin]
description: An oak chart table is attached to the port bulkhead, its shallow drawers drawn open by the angle of the ship.  The ship's log is attached to the table by a brass chain.  Charts are strewn about the cabin.  Above the table is a neat row of texts held in place by a slat.  One of the leaded glass stern window has shattered, allowing a salty breeze into the cabin.  A ship's lantern sways in the breeze.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Quarterdeck]
description: Looking forward from the quarterdeck rail you can see the shattered mainmast lying across the main deck and the splintered starboard bulwark.  The masthead reaches down to the reef below.  A hatchway leads into the officer's quarters.  A short flight of steps leads up to the poopdeck and a narrow companionway ladder leads down to the main deck.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Poopdeck]
description: The deck slants to starboard.  The mizzenmast has been broken a few yards above the deck.  Although the mizzen masthead dangles dangerously above it is held aloft by the remains of the standing rigging, the shrouds and stays taut as bowstrings.  The wind blows through the ship's bell, an oddly-shaped bit of brass tubing, creating an eerie, sepulchral moan.  Steps lead down to the quarterdeck.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Main Deck]
description: The starboard-slanting deck is littered with rigging and tackle.  The belaying pins in the portside pin-rail have all been ripped away.  Part of the broken mainyard lies in the bulwarks.  A narrow companionway ladder leads up to the quarterdeck.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Bilge]
description: Dark and cramped, this narrow passageway is awash in foul, briny water.  The air is fetid.  The poor footing of the slimy and slippery deck is exacerbated by the extreme tilt of the ship.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Headland Boulder]
description: A wide vista can be viewed from the top of the boulder.  To the west all of Maelstrom Bay and the great western sea spreads out before you.  To the north and east, obscure in the gloom of night, are the rolling hills of the Shattered Moors.  To the south the land dips down into darkness.  A moonlit tower rises beyond the marsh to the southeast.  Some small bones are lodged in a crevice of the boulder.

A wide vista can be viewed from the top of the boulder.  To the west all of Maelstrom Bay and the great western sea spreads out before you.  To the north and east are the rolling hills of the Shattered Moors, and beyond them the dark line of a forest.  To the south the land dips down into a marsh.  A tower rises beyond the marsh to the southeast.  Some small bones are lodged in a crevice of the boulder.

title: [Headland Boulder, Doorway]
description: Tall grasses surround the area, concealing it from view of the headlands path.  Like a giant fist, the huge boulder thrusts itself out of a small hillock.  The distant, repetitive sound of waves is like an insistent whisper.

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Entry]
description: The floor, the ceiling and the walls are all constructed of the same ash planking.  Placed every few feet is a thick support column of tarred oak.  Pale, thin light is provided by a softly glowing orb hanging from the ceiling in the center of the entryway.  Dust covers everything.  The air is stale and absolutely still.

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Storage]
description: The wide-planked ash floor is badly scratched and scarred.  The shattered ribs and staves of broken barrels are scattered among the splintered slats of damaged crates.   A pale, glowing orb hangs in a rope net strung from one of the tarred oak support columns.  The tracks of some small rodent are visible in the dust.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Storage]
description: A group of large iron-banded barrels, all lying on their sides, are aligned in one corner of the room.  A line of smaller barrels is stacked from floor to ceiling against the west wall.  An oval table stands in the middle of the room, with four small kegs placed around it like stools.  A layer of fine dust covers everything.

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Storage]
description: Stacks of wooden crates...some small, some the size of coffins...line one wall.  A large heap of moldy, decaying carpets is piled in the center of the room.  A half dozen rolled tapestries, stinking of mildew, lean against one of the oak support columns.  In one corner, barely illuminated by the soft light of a glowing orb, is a wooden rack on which hangs the tattered remnants of cloth.

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Hallway]
description: The hallway is dark, illuminated only by the light coming from adjacent rooms.  Dust motes hang still in the stale air.  Beneath a layer of dust the wide-planked floor is badly scratched, as if heavy objects were once dragged across it.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Common Room]
description: A long table, lined with benches, stands in the center of the room.  Some ratty bunks are set against the far wall.  Near the doorway is a smaller table with a chess board carved into the surface.  Stools and straight-backed chairs are scattered throughout.  A pair of dusty glowing orbs hang from the plank ceiling, casting a hazy light throughout the room.

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Kitchen]
description: A small brass cooking brazier stands on a tripod in one corner of the kitchen.  The planked ceiling above the brazier is smeared with soot, to which a thick layer of dust has attached.  Some shelving against the wall is filled with rotting bags and dusty jars.  A small barrel and a dusty crate stand near the doorway.

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Counting Room]
description: The room is sparsely furnished, although it is as large as a storage room.  A trestle table sits in the southwest corner under a pale, glowing orb.  A few dust-ridden crates, all open and empty, line the northern wall.  The floor near the crates is badly scratched.  A faint whisper of a breeze carries a hint of the dank smell of mold.

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Tunnel]
description: This narrow, natural cavern appears to have been formed over the centuries by water seeping down from the giant boulder overhead.  The cavern has been worked by hand.  Tarred timbers reinforce the walls and a few thick planks make the floor somewhat less irregular.  Water continues to trickle down from the boulder, rotting the planks and making them slippery.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel]
description: Widely spaced planks, rotting from age and exposure to moisture, make the floor of the cavern somewhat less treacherous.  The small room is dimly lit by a pale, glowing orb hanging in a moldy rope net.  Plank steps lead down.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel]
description: Pale yellow light filters through the tunnel from upstairs, reflecting on the thin trickle of dark, tannic water that dribbles down the wide plank steps.  The rough walls of the narrow tunnel are shored up with stout, tarred timbers.  The smell of loamy dirt fills the tunnel.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel]
description: The absence of light in the tunnel magnifies the sound of the water trickling down the stairs and the smell of the dirt.  The wide plank steps are moldy and slippery underfoot.  A slight breeze rises up the tunnel.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel]
description: Moonlight filters into the tunnel from a small opening to the west.  Some steps, made of wide planks of wood set into the dirt, lead upward into the darkness.  A trickle of water runs down the steps and out the small tunnel entrance.  The smell of saltwater and the sound of crashing waves fills the tunnel.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Rocky Shelf]
description: This small shelf in the cliff face overlooks a small cove of large, jagged rocks.  Waves crash into the rocks below, sending up a white spray that glows eerily in the moonlight.  A large iron lantern hangs from a metal davit set firmly into the shelf.  A small tunnel enters the cliff face to the east.  A narrow path leads down to the rocks.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Rocky Cove]
description: Bits of flotsam and jetsam lie scattered along the flood tide mark...shattered staves of barrels, broken spars, lengths of sodden rope.  Waves crash against the jagged rocks, sending a huge froth into the air.  The noise of the sea, echoed back by the tall cliffs, is deafening.  A narrow pathway leads up to a rocky shelf in the cliff face.

title: [Smuggler's Lair, Hallway]
description: The hallway is dark, illuminated only by the light coming from adjacent rooms.  Dust motes hang still in the stale air.  Beneath a layer of dust the wide-planked floor is badly scratched, as if heavy objects were once dragged across it.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: A heavy fog shrouds the barren trees.  Water drizzles silently down the trunks and branches to collect in scattered puddles.  An old road covered with tufts of dead grass wends its way through the fog and trees.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: To the east, nightmarish trees loom over the fog-enshrouded road, their dead branches reaching out like great skeletal spiders trying to pull in their prey.  The thick, unnatural fog smells faintly of sulfur.  A weathered and faded sign hangs high over the road on a twisted piece of rusted wire.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The ground is soft and marshy underfoot.  Somewhere, lost in the bone-white fog, water quietly trickles in a creek.  A line of animal tracks run parallel to the boggy path.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The stench of rotting swampgrass mingles with the odor of wet bark and decaying wood.  The pathway is bounded by thick, foul muck.  The path disappears east and west into the thick fog.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: Leaves and small branches from the surrounding trees float on the surface of a dark, brackish pool.  Condensed moisture from the trees drips sporadically into the pool with a sound that is strangely melodic.  The boggy ground around the umbrageous pool is devoid of footprints.  The soft moonlight barely filters through the fog and casts no reflection on the surface of the pool.

Leaves and small branches from the surrounding trees float on the surface of a dark, brackish pool.  Condensed moisture from the trees drips sporadically into the pool with a sound that is strangely melodic.  The boggy ground around the umbrageous pool is devoid of footprints.  The pale sunlight barely filters through the fog and does not refract off the surface of the pool.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The dead and dying trees that line the pathway are obscured by the sulphurous fog.  A rusting spike protrudes from one strangely asymmetric monir.  Water drips down a thin strand of rotting twine tied to the spike, plinking monotonously into a small puddle at the base of the tree.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: Grotesquely twisted trees stretch out on both sides of the old road.  A slight breeze eddies the fog, creating tendrils that snake through the trees.  On the northern side of the old road is a tree that appears to have been struck by lightning.  The tree's upper trunk is splintered and blackened, its lower limbs hang low over the scrub brush.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: A creek bisects the old road.  The ribs of a fallen bridge are visible through the fog, its rotting timbers now mired below in the turgid creek they once spanned.  The neatly trimmed trunk of a felled tree now spans the creek.  Tall, greasy weeds and scrub brush line the northern side of the road.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: The road ends at a miasmal creek.  Below, visible through the fog, are the beams and crossties of an ancient, collapsed bridge.  A tree trunk, denuded of bark and branches, has been laid across the stream as a makeshift crossing.  Grass grows between the rutted tracks of the road leading east.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: A gloomy layer of fog envelopes the road.  Strands of mold-blackened moss hang from the branches of the trees lining the road.  The older trees are badly scarred and show evidence of ancient magical damage.  A rusted blade is imbedded in one of the trees.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: Weeds grow tall between the tracks of the ancient, rutted road.  A few scattered pieces of bone and some rusted chain mail can be seen in the middle of a thicket of thorns.  The moonlight gives the fog a bluish tint, the color of a dead man's skin.  Both the eastern and western ends of the road disappear into the eddying fog.

Weeds grow tall between the tracks of the ancient, rutted road.  A few scattered pieces of bone and some rusted chain mail can be seen in the middle of a thicket of thorns.  The feeble sunlight gives the fog a diseased tint.  Both the eastern and western ends of the road disappear into the eddying fog.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: The old road wends it way in and out of the gnarled forest.  Saplings grow in the weedy row between the wagon ruts.  The faint odor of damp animal fur lingers in the air.  To the south is a well-trodden foot trail.  The ancient road runs primarily east and west, where it rapidly disappears into the mist.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Old Road]
description: Small pearls of dew are gathered on the tall blades of grass growing in the middle of the old road.  Dead and dying trees line the road like ancient, stoic sentries.  A faint odor of putrefaction hovers in the fog.

The moisture gathered on the tall blades of grass growing in the middle of the old road glow like dull pearls in the weak sunlight.  Dead and dying trees line the road like ancient, stoic sentries.  A faint odor of putrefaction hovers in the fog.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Hanging Tree]
description: A great, grotesquely malformed oak tree towers overhead.  Skeletons and bodies in advanced states of decomposition dangle upside down from the tree's contorted branches like obscene fruit.  Scattered among them are ankle and footbones still attached to fraying lengths of rope.  Beneath the tree is a jumble of mouldering bones and fallen skeletons.  The stink of corrupt flesh hangs heavy in the fog.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The soft, spongy soil of the path is dotted with myriad animal tracks.  The soil is too mucky to hold the form of the tracks well, so little can be determined from the water-filled depressions.  A trickle of slow-running water can be heard to the southeast.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The quagmire on either side of the boggy pathway is filled with rot-blackened willows, bare-branched grey birches and bark-damaged monirs.  Tall brown grass has been trodden into the muck beside the path.  Somewhere nearby, hidden by the ash-grey fog, can be heard the trickle of creek water.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: Just off the pathway the smoke-blackened stump of a once-magnificent monir tree points up into the odd-smelling fog.  The trunk of the tree lies nearly submerged in the mire a few feet away.  Each pathway disappears quickly into the murky haze.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The pathway is slick from frequent trampling.  A thick clot of reeds, fouled black by rot, clog the slough.  The fetid odor of stagnant water hangs heavy in the air, having infused its stink into the bone-grey fog.  To the south, the path inclines slightly downward.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The trees along the pathway through the slough have a diseased look about them.  A patch of color visible through the dull grey fog reveals itself to be a deep, reddish-purple patch of mold on the side of a gnarled and dying haon tree.  The boggy path disappears into the fog to the north and northeast.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Spectral Mist]
description: Weeds, black and slick with some singularly foul form of rot, grow thick in the malodorous bogs that line the twisting trails.  The bone-grey fog eddies slowly through the bent, skeletal trees.  The listless breeze is tainted with the stink of decay.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: A small, boggy clearing appears in the midst of the twisted trees and rotting stumps.  Low mounds covered with brownish moss rise out of the fog-enshrouded slough.  Hundreds of small snail shells lie in the muck that surrounds the mounds.  The faint moonlight gives the fog a cool, deathlike tint.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The pathways loop around a long, narrow pool of slick, slime-covered water.  The fog, thick elsewhere, lays lightly on the surface of the pool.  The lower branches of a sickly willow tree, nearly devoid of leaves, dip into the foul-smelling water.  A thin gurgle of water can be heard to the northeast.

title: [Miasmal Forest]
description: A few of the smaller trees have been denuded of their branches and stripped of their bark.  Those long-dead, ash-colored trees stand amid the dark, gnarled live ones like tall, contorted needles.  The fog coils along the pathways, partly concealing the spiky undergrowth that lines them.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest

title: [Miasmal Forest]
description: Spiky-leafed plants dot the marshy ground on either side of the pathway.  Scattered amid the deformed trees, partially hidden by the thick fog, are some small, dead trees that have been stripped of their limbs and bark.  To the north, a stubby hillock rises above the fog.

title: [Miasmal Forest]
description: A stubby hillock of dormant, brown grass rises among the stunted trees.  Atop the hillock is low platform created out of dried mud and dead weeds.  Skulls and parts of skulls are stacked on the platform in a jumble.  The heavy fog, although thick amongst the trees, shuns the hillock.

title: [Miasmal Forest]
description: This small rise in the surrounding swampland allows a fog-hindered view to the south, where a low mound arises from the mist.  A fringe of tall, spiky-leafed plants surround the rise, blocking any passage to the north and west.  The stink of stagnant water filters in from the northeast.

title: [Miasmal Forest]
description: A foggy, malodorous mire, dotted with the grey stumps of dead trees, impedes any passage to the north.  The far end of the mire is lost in the fog.  A soft breeze carries the stink of rot and decay from the mire.  The pathway is boggy underfoot.  Only the faintest hint of moonlight filters through the thick fog.

title: [Miasmal Forest]
description: A pair of skeletal monir trees, embraced by the bone-grey fog, guard the northern pathway.  A sluggish breeze barely shifts the fetid air.  Barbed and spiky weeds, their broad leaves spotted with diseased-looking blotches, line the pathways.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Slough]
description: The malodorous mire to the north is barely distinguishable from the boggy soil on either side of the pathways.  The mire is fed by a thin, reed-choked creek that curls to the northeast.  An acrid miasma, harsh on the eyes and the nose, emerges from the mire.  Many of the slowly-dying trees in the forest are nearly entirely wound around with brown, dead vines.  To the northeast, barely visible through the fog, the barest hint of a wooden structure can be seen beside the creek.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, down

title: [Miasmal Forest]
description: The noisome mire to the north stinks of dead and rotting plants.  Except for a few ripples near the trunks of the dead trees which dot the mire, the scummy surface of the water is almost perfectly still and placid.  The fog hovers a few feet above the water, as if reluctant to touch it.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Creek]
description: To the north the creek devolves into a foul-smelling quagmire.  The creek banks have collapsed, creating a mucky drift of mud and stones that crosses the slow-moving channel of the creek.  The fog swirls in chaotic, mesmerizing patterns.  Footprints lead up through the muck.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Creek]
description: The creek is little more than a thin trickle of dark, tannic water gurgling around the stony creekbed.  The muddy, reed-choked banks are too slippery to climb.  The fog is so thick that it would be disorienting anywhere but in the steep-walled creekbed.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Creek]
description: The fog roils slowly down the creekbed, obscuring everything in the thick, bone-grey haze.  The bare, gnarled limbs of a dead willow, barely visible in the fog, rise over the tall, muddy creek banks.  The slowly trickling water and moss-slick stones underfoot make for treacherous walking.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Creek]
description: The creek banks are precipitous and muddy, making them impossible to climb.  The murky water in the creek bed chuckles musically as it flows over and around small, rounded stones.  The limbs of dead and dying trees arch over the creek.  Wisps of fog and mist obscure the tops of the trees.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Creek]
description: The dark, tannic water of the reed-choked creek moves just enough to keep it from becoming completely stagnant.  The ribs of a collapsed bridge jut out of the scummy water.  The creek banks are steep and slippery.  Overhead, just out of reach, the denuded trunk of a tree spans the creek.  To the south the creek becomes an impassable slough.

title: [Dismal Slough]
description: A slow-moving, green tidal creek feeds into a wide, reed-choked, fetid mire.  Trees line both sides of the creek.  Some of the branches that would have overhung the creek have been systematically lopped off.  The scars left on those branches are grey and overgrown, indicating they were removed many years in the past.  Wisps of fog hover over the creek.

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: The turf of the pathway is squishy underfoot.  The air is heavy with the primal stink of decaying vegetation and swamp ooze.   The fog moves slowly in vague, bloated clouds.  Spiky-leafed plants grow in clumps amid the scrub brush and gnarled trees.

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: The pathway is like a valley between the tall fuzzy-headed reeds and rushes.  Water trickles softly in some rivulet hidden by the reeds.  Overhead, the fog coils and distends in the pale moonlight with a snakelike motion.  The foul reek of swamp gas pervades the area.

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: The pathway undulates and wends its way through a vale of deep reeds and cattails.  The reeds bow and flutter, although no breeze can be felt.  The fog writhes slowly overhead.  To the southwest a mound of green turf rises up out of the swamp.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Troll Mound]
description: The pathway is uneven and littered with small stones.  One of the small, gaunt trees that line the pathway has snapped off, leaving a ragged stump sticking up out of the ground like a broken tooth.  The fog appears a sickly green in the pale moonlight.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Troll Mound]
description: The undulating ground is pocked and bumpy.  Sharp, spiky shrubs grow in knots beneath the small, misshapen trees.  Masses of ochre-colored moss are draped from the branches of the trees.  The fog smells faintly of sulphur mixed with loam.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Troll Mound]
description: Lumpy turf rises out of the marshy ground.  Spiky-leafed plants grow in clumps beneath the scraggly branches of the trees lining the pathway.  Jagged, lichen-covered rocks jab through the soil.  Fog, cool and damp, coils through the trees.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south

title: [Miasmal Forest, Ghostly Trees]
description: Rotting reeds and marsh grasses mix with the turbid water to befoul the air with a noxious stench.  The sickly trees rising from the miasma look like skeletal figures reaching into the befouled mist.  The trails disappear into the thick chalky mist.

tags: peer north =~ /^Obvious paths: northeast, south, northwest/

title: [Miasmal Forest, Troll Mound]
description: The ground is knobby and dimpled from hundreds of small rocks and stones.  Strange ochre moss hangs from the limbs of the small, gnarled trees.  The fog barely shifts, as if caught on the thorny undergrowth.  Moonlight filters listlessly through the thick fog.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Troll Mound]
description: The stony pathway rises and falls along the contours of the undulating turf.  The air is unnaturally cool and smells faintly of sulphur.  A small bird's nest, set in the juncture of some small branches, is visible through the strands of fog that filter through the trees.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Troll Mound]
description: The undulating, rock-strewn pathway follows a serpentine course through the small trees.  Although no hint of breeze can be detected, tendrils of the oddly chilly fog snake through the branches overhead.  The spiky-leafed plants in the undergrowth have been trampled down.  The wooden figurehead of a ship has been set into the rocky soil adjoining one of the taller trees.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Troll Mound]
description: Jagged pebbles, sharp as blades, break through the turf in the pathway.  The branches of the small trees are twisted and intertwined, creating a natural bower.  Ochre-colored moss hangs from the branches in ruffled masses.  The fog roils slowly overhead.

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: Tall reeds and bullrushes line the rolling, spongy pathway.  Bone grey fog floats over the path, enveloping the area in an abnormal, foul-smelling chill air.  The rushes sway sinuously, although there is no breeze to move the fog.  The noise of night insects, muted by the thick fog, comes from all directions.

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: Tall cattails and bullrushes line the spongy pathway, drastically limiting the line of sight.  The fog, smelling faintly of sulphur, hovers overhead.  The hum and whine of gnats and mosquitoes is muted by the damp, chill fog.  The odor of decomposing vegetation and swamp gas competes with the sulphurous fog.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: The valley of tall reeds and rushes crowd in on the soft turf of the pathway.  A slick, oily residue coats the base of the reeds.  Wisps of fog snake along low overhead, coiling around the fuzzy heads of the reeds.  The foul smell of swamp gas hangs over the area like a pall.

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: The highest branches of the low, gaunt trees disappear into the bone-grey fog.  Clots of thick sedge grass line the pathway.  The unnatural chill of the fog pervades the area.  To the north, the pathways ease into a tall swale of reeds, bullrushes and cattails.

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: Black, brackish water seeps up through the porous ground just inches off the boggy pathway.  The sound of trickling water seems muted by the thick, bone-grey fog.  The reeds and rushes sway as the fog shifts, although no breeze can be felt.  The stink of swamp ooze hangs heavily in the area.

title: [Ghastly Swamp]
description: The high-pitched hum of insects floats softly on the air.  The spongy pathway is barely more firm than the muck that borders it.  In the dense, oddly chilly fog the clumps of reeds and bullrushes that grow off the path resemble fists rising out of the swamp.

title: [Dismal Slough, Tidal Creek]
description: The greenish water of the creek moves sluggishly.  The air is tinged with the primal stink of saltmarsh and ocean.  Reeds, slimy and dark, grow thick along the banks of the creek.  Tall trees, their lower creekside branches trimmed back, lean out over the banks.  Chilly wisps of fog eddy drowsily over the water.

title: [Dismal Slough, Tidal Creek]
description: The creek curves from the northwest to the southwest.  The barnacle-encrusted pilings of an old dock stand forlornly in the elbow of the foggy creek.  An overgrown path from the pilings wends its way northeast between two large, oddly-shaped hummocks.  Thick, thorny brambles grow in wild profusion on the hummocks.  Beyond the hummocks can be seen a knot of dilapidated wooden buildings.

title: [Dismal Slough, Oteska's Haven]
description: A deep layer of mud covers what must have once been a dirt walkway leading between a collection of decrepit shanties and shacks constructed from planks of weathered wood.  The doorways to the structures have all been battered and broken.  Fog drifts among the structures like ghosts.  To the southwest the path wends between a pair of oddly-shaped hummocks.

title: [Oteska's Haven, Shanty]
description: Rows of primitive bunk beds line two of the walls.  The remains of old footlockers are strewn around the room in chaotic disarray.  Mold grows in the grooves between the wide plank floorboards.  The smell of woodrot and fungus pervades the room.  A set of crude steps lead up through a small trapdoor in ceiling.

description: The wide-planked floor is slightly warped from the damp.  A small turf fire burns in a brass brazier, providing both warmth and a flickering golden-hued light. A low altar stands before an oaken statue of Niima, the Wavedancer.

title: [Ghastly Swamp, Foggy Path]
description: The path through the swamp twists and turns, no more than an animal trail leading deeper into the marshy area.  Reeds and tall cattails line the path preventing little access to the insect-ridden waters to either side.  Dark shapes pass overhead, vanishing silhouettes in the thick, damp fog blanketing the area.

The path through the swamp twists and turns, no more than an animal trail leading deeper into the marshy area.  Reeds and tall cattails are barely visible in the darkness, lining the path and serving as tactile warning of the insect-ridden waters beyond.  A thick, damp fog blankets the area, reducing visibility to only a few feet ahead at any time.

title: [Ghastly Swamp, Foggy Path]
description: The thick fog reduces visiblity to the surrounding reeds, great brown and tan stalks that rise high over head and frame the twisting soggy pathway.  Muted screams from unknown inhabitants filter through the thick, white wall of mist that hides their origin and location.  Occasionally, something splashes through the water and mud just beyond the wall of reeds, drawing close, then fading away.

title: [Ghastly Swamp, Foggy Path]
description: The fog borders on impentrable and only the closest reeds are visible.  The twisting path narrows as it winds to the northwest, disappearing into the fog.  Every footstep creates a sucking sound as the mud protests passage, while previous foot and paw prints are filled with water reflecting the available light.  Overhead, the dark limb of a tree extends over the path, connected to a dead tree hidden somewhere in the surrounding fog.

title: [Ghastly Swamp, Foggy Path]
description: Tendrils of cold, damp fog swirl about the area, reducing visibility to nothing with encompassing walls of white mist, leaving no sign of the pathway underfoot.  Even the surrounding sounds and noises of the swampy area are muted by the fog, creating a stillness that permeates the area.

title: [Millah's Fens, Foggy Path]
description: Thick, impenetrable fog looms over a pathway leading to the west.  In the oppsite direction, the surrounding mist appears to be less dense and is filled with the silhouettes of thousands of tall reeds.  Birds call back and forth to each other from above and to either side, their songs muted by the damp whiteness that plagues the fens.  The sun's light, reduced to a weak presence, filters through a low ceiling of grey.

title: [Millah's Fens, Narrow Path]
description: The pathway narrows suddenly into little more than the track of the errant animals who have made the fens their home.  An increasing number of reeds appear to the east between slow moving tendrils of fog which rise from the surrounding marshy waters to drift gradually towards the sky.  Scattered across a low mound not far from the path are the remains of a human skeleton, bereft of the bones from its lower half and draped across the ground as if attempting to crawl away.

title: [Millah's Fens, Tall Reeds]
description: Walls of thin reeds tower and surround, giving way only to narrow, winding animal paths.  The once omnipresent fog is reduced to ground crawling white spectral tendrils that slowly slip over the earth.  From the northeast comes the sound of moving water, while from all other directions is nothing but the stillness of the fens broken intermittenly by the angry screams of local animal residents.

title: [Millah's Fens, Stream Bank]
description: The remnants of a stone road emerge from the narrow pathway leading to the southwest, only to disappear once again into the waters of a cold, languid stream.  Cutting its way through the tall surrounding wall of reeds, the stream disappears to the north, while dispersing into several fast moving rivulets to the south.  Dark, elongated shapes move beneath the surface of the water, vanishing and emerging from shadows in the stream.

title: [Millah's Fen, Cold Stream]
description: The cobbled ruins of a road emerge from the cold stream and lead up to a nearby stream bank, the only opening in the two walls of massive reeds that constrain the stream to its pathway.  The water is clear but deep, allowing for the passage of dark, unknowns slipping through the water from shadow to shadow.

title: [Millah's Fen, Cold Stream]
description: A ruined cobbled road rises from the waters of the cold stream and ascends a nearby stream bank.  The tall reeds give way to smaller reeds and grasses that overwhelm the stream and prevent any further passage north.  A gnarled sycamore bends over the stream with pale white limbs draped in hanging moss.

wayto.11687: ;e if checkspell(112); move 'south'; else; empty_hands; move 'swim south'; fill_hands; end; waitrt?

title: [Millah's Fen, Stream Bank]
description: The remnants of a cobbled stone road emerge from a wide stream and climb over the bank in the direction of a rocky hill.  The hill stands tall and alone, its rock-strewn sides covered in moss and patches of brown grass, rising out of the patchy fog, oblivious to the surrounding flat fens and marshes.  Pale, gnarled sycamores bend over the stream and surround the area with moss-draped ghostly white forms.

title: [A Ceramic Tile Teleporting Ring]
description: Sunlight glints off of the orange and ebon tiles set into the slightly raised ground.  Large white stones form a perfect circle around the tiles, except where they are split to allow passage into the practice yard.

title: [Millah's Fens, Tall Reeds]
description: The reeds bend in and over the pathway, leaving little room to navigate without stepping off into shallow pools of tepid water or brushing against the tall plant life.  Spiderwebs decorate reeds with glistening beadlets of moisture and small, silken lumps of unfortunate victims.  The faint sound of moving water comes from the north, fading in and out depending on the stillness of the wind.

title: [Millah's Fens, Tall Reeds]
description: Discarded and rusting pieces of armor cover a small clearing in the tall reeds, many overgrown with mosses and lichen, and held together by little more than rust.  Only a single shattered skull fixed to the trunk of a dead tree offers any evidence of human remains in the clearing, while the silence of the fens is interrupted only by the buzzing swarm cloud of gnats.

title: [Millah's Fens, Spongy Path]
description: Movement is impossible without the ground giving way several inches into a thin layer of muck, as the pathway dips lower into the surrounding water before winding its way to the northeast and southwest.  Rotting broken shields and spear hafts covered in moss, lay about the area half-submerged in shallow pools of water.  Farther away from the pathway, a small mound has been built of the neglected armor and shields covered with mud and filth.

title: [Millah's Fens, Keep Approach]
description: An imposing keep rises out of the surrounding mist and fens to dominate the view to the northeast.  Encircling the keep are great earthen bulwarks decorated sporadically with gnarled willow and sycamore trees, designed to prevent any encroachment towards the walls by the fens.  Widening from the animal path that wound through the weeds, the trail broadens into a narrow dirt road leading towards the keep.

title: [Marsh Keep, South Wall]
description: Passing up and over an earthen barrier, a dirt road runs along the edge of the keep's outer wall toward a portcullis to the east.  The ground is barren but for lichens, mosses, and the occasional patch of brown marsh grass that appear over a layer of gravel spreading outward from the wall for many feet.

title: [Millah's Fens, Pool]
description: The pathway ends abruptly in a large, shallow pool.  Reflected in the still surface of the water are dozens of skeletons impaled on wooden spikes that have been driven into the pool's bed.  Many of the skeletons are incomplete, held together by the threads and rags of faded uniforms or wire used to bound the hands and feet of victims.  Ash grey kingfishers rest on the tips of the spikes and skulls, scanning the water for meals and occasionally sharpening their beaks on their perches.

title: [Marsh Keep, South Wall]
description: The shrubs quickly fall away as the wall advances to the east toward the keep's gateway and portcullis.  The footpath expands to the east and adopts a more gravel-like consistency, joining a wide road leading in the same direction.  Two large stakes, driven cross-wise into the ground, are tied together to support the skeletal remains of a soldier in tattered armor.

title: [Marsh Keep, Southwest Corner]
description: Numerous grey shrubs, expanding from the shallow valley between the earthen barriers and the wall, have encompassed the footpath as it rounds the southwest corner of the keep.  Narrow and indistinct animal trails weave through the shrubs and out of sight to the east.  Flecks of rotting meat are caught on the short little branches of the shrubs, filling the air with their nauseating decay.

title: [Marsh Keep, West Wall]
description: The tall earthen barriers continue to run alongside the walls, beyond which rising out of the fog of far away, is a tall hill.  The ever present mist comes and goes, revealing a desolate landscape of tall reeds and the occasional lone and bent sycamore or willow tree rising above them.

title: [Marsh Keep, West Wall]
description: The earthen barriers protecting the keep from the surrounding marshes rise higher and wider as they run parallel to the west wall of the keep.  Little vegetation grows upon them, but the shallow valley between them and the wall is filled with marsh grass accompanied by large pools of collected rain water.  Muddy tracks lead down and back to the pools of water, and then further to the south down the pathway.

title: [Marsh Keep, Northwest Corner]
description: The north wall intersects with the west, forming a sharp corner which the footpath wraps around to disappear to the south.  A field of old, rotting stumps surrounds the area near the corner, indicating that once a sizable grove of trees stood nearby before being chopped down for security.  Animal paths run in and around the stumps before running up and merging into the footpath by the wall.

title: [Marsh Keep, North Wall]
description: Shattered pieces of masonry lie scattered about the footpath that runs along the north wall.  Made from a different material than the wall, the masonry offers no hints or clues to its original apppearance.  Sickly appearing pale white flowers grow in the earth surrounding the masonry.

title: [Marsh Keep, North Wall]
description: Continuing along its east-west path, the north wall is covered in a thicker application of the brown moss which runs along the edges of the stones, outlining the individual blocks in dark fuzzy lines.  Closer to the ground, the moss has managed to bridge the gap between earth and stone, creating a soft base running along the wall's bottom.  Patches of bare stone appear in the thick moss where something has feasted on the abundant plant growth.

title: [Marsh Keep, North Wall]
description: Large blocks of stone, fallen from somewhere above on the wall, lie scattered about the pathway that now follows the wall along its east-west direction.  North of the wall, the earthen barriers protecting the keep are lower and narrower than those to the south, which almost vanish under marsh grass and reeds.

title: [Marsh Keep, Northeast Corner]
description: Dead branches of a sycamore brush against the corner where the east and north walls meet.  Unlikely to have been allowed to grow so close to the walls of the keep, the tree appears to have begun and ended its life years after the occupation of the fortification ceased.  Placed throughout and upon its branches are the abandoned twig nests of unknown birds who made their home in the tree and have since departed.

title: [Marsh Keep, East Wall]
description: Sparse patches of brown weeds border the pathway as it continues to follow the north-south direction of the east wall of the keep.  The tracks of a marsh deer cross back and forth over nearby ground, giving wide berth to the partial skeletal remains of a hog.  Beyond the hog skeleton, an animal trail climbs up and over an earthen barrier to disappear into the fens.

title: [Marsh Keep, East Wall]
description: Ending abruptly to the south, the wall continues to the north toward the end of the eastern side of the fortification.  The narrow pathway continues along the same basic direction, skirting away from the wall where the earth has given way to a gaping hole in the ground.  Footprints, none of them from the civilized races, lead in and out of the hole and down into the nearby fens.

title: [Marsh Keep, Southeast Corner]
description: The wall abruptly stops its procession between east and west and turns north, followed by the narrow footpath beaten into the adjacent ground.  The corner of the wall allows a view of the land to the north, beyond the keep, consisting of nothing more than desolate, fog-shrouded fens and marshes.

title: [Marsh Keep, South Wall]
description: Running along the length of the wall east to the corner and west to the gateway, the path widens and narrows without explanation or reason.  Built of uniform grey stone, the wall retains the appearance of strength and integrity despite patches of brown moss clinging to its surface.

title: [Marsh Keep, Portcullis]
description: Extending from the wall by several feet is the imposing gateway through the walls of the keep.  A portcullis remains only partially lowered, frozen by rust and covered with dead brown vines, allowing for entry underneath its rows of black metal points designed to penetrate the ground.  beneath the portcullis, the graveled road leads inward while a footpath extends to the east to the corner of the walls.

title: [Marsh Keep, Inner Portcullis]
description: Daylight pours through a kill hole located in the ceiling of the narrow inner chamber between the outer and inner portculli, illuminating a grim scene of abandoment and destruction.  Leaning askew against one wall are the remains of a once thick, wooden door with the hinges still attached to its sides.  Broken pieces of wood and gravel litter the ground between the outside and a courtyard visible to the north.

title: [Marsh Keep, Courtyard]
description: The inner portcullis opens up on a large courtyard surfaced with red octagonal paving stones.  Few signs of ill repair and neglect are openly visible with the exception of the random tuft of brown weeds creeping up through crevices in the stones and scattered, unrecognizable sun-bleached bones.  Overlooking the courtyard is the parapet of the outer wall, accessible by a series of stone steps to the east.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Marsh Keep, Courtyard]
description: The western side of the courtyard is empty but for the rotting remains of a ladder extended down from the parapet of the outer wall.  Set near the same wall is a stone hitching post constructed by the laying of a rusting metal bar between two large blocks.  Across the faded red paving stones are scattered pieces of broken white bones, dry leaves, and small twigs.

title: [Marsh Keep, Courtyard]
description: Five wide stone steps lead up from the courtyard pavement to a large iron-bound door leading into the keep.  Two women sculpted from black stone flank the steps and offer their open hands in the direction of the portcullis to the south.  Set above the door is a face sculpted from the same stone as the women, but malformed with creature-like features displaying an expression of mockery.

title: [Marsh Keep, Courtyard]
description: Stone steps lead upward to the parapet of the outerwall along the perimeter of the courtyard.  A stone trough placed next to the steps is filled to the brim with tepid and foul-smelling rain water, and home to numerous insects which dart across the water's surface.  Set next to the trough is a rotting wooden bucket, set on its side and slowly collapsing inward on itself under the stress and decay of time.

title: [Marsh Keep, Grand Hall]
description: Originally designed for feasting, the hall has been turned into a room of experimentation, with two large examination tables set side by side and encircled by countertops bristling with lab equipment and arcane instruments.  Layers of dust cover everything, broken only by tracks leading back and forth across the floor.  High above, a candelabra hangs from a vaulted ceiling, rimmed with the melted remnants of dozens of candles.

title: [Marsh Keep, Stone Staircase]
description: Spiraling up and down is a massive stone staircase decorated with a faded red rug held in place by narrow gleaming brass bars and pins hammered into the side of steps.  A chilling draft flows up from the darkness below, carrying with it a strong sense of decay and death.  Set on the wall above the upward-destined steps is a slashed painting hung within a gold gilded frame.

title: [Marsh Keep, Storage Room]
description: Bowing beneath the weight of dust-laden jars and boxes are shelves that line the four walls of the storage room from floor to ceiling.  Little tags are attached to the various containers by long brown threads, and hang over the side of their respective shelves to allow for identification without requiring the use of the ladder leaning against one wall.  A single glass vial lays shattered on the floor, perhaps the origin of a powerful stench that pervades the room.

title: [Marsh Keep, Grand Hall]
description: A draft slowly swings a large candelabra above back and forth over on the other side of the great hall, directly above a wide, black hole set in the middle of the floor.  Dark stains trail from a large examining table over the stone floor to the edge of the hole, from which emanates a rank odor.  Separating this area from the one to the south are a row of bookshelves brimming with tomes, scrolls, and odd artifacts.

title: [Marsh Keep, Landing]
description: The spiraling staircase ends evenly with the floor of the landing, next to a turned over column and a partially shattered bust lying on the ground.  A hallway extends to the west, past a row of narrow windows and a small table that provides the setting for a vase full of wilted flowers.  Dust swirls about in the columns of light that pour in from the windows, changing directions with every errant draft of wind.

title: [Marsh Keep, Hallway]
description: Running to the east and north, the hallway turns at a right angle past a simple wooden door.  Paintings line each side of the hallway, interspersed between brass candelabras built into the wall and backed by small mirrors.  The rug laid out along the length of the hallway, decorated in a diamond and square pattern, is particularly worn at the doorway.

title: [Marsh Keep, Bedroom]
description: The focus of the decadently decorated bedroom is a tall four-poster bed set immediately within sight of the doorway.  Underneath the bed's canopy, a skeleton in rotting robes lies sprawled across the dusty sheets, one boney hand still gripping a hanging canopy cord.  A second skeleton lies against an opposite wall near a book shelf and just under a candelabra.  Light streams into the room from a large window across from the bed to shine across an opened tome lying on the floor as if dropped.

title: [Marsh Keep, Library]
description: The spines of countless dozens of books greet the visitor to a rectangular space north of the hallway.  A large highback chair is situated next to a small fireplace set with three equally small logs, ready to provide heat and illumination.  A pair of dust-covered reading glasses sit on a table adjacent to the chair, while behind the chair rests a scroll rack filled almost to capacity with rolled up pieces of vellum and paper.

title: [Marsh Keep, Storage Room]
description: Folded white sheets buried under the dust of ages sits on a wooden table that takes up much of the available space in the small storage room.  A metal wash tub rests underneath the table, along with a rippled piece of metal with a wooden handle and a stack of yellowed bars of soap.  A single window slit, set high on the wall just above a three-legged stool, draws light into the room, illuminating only the disrepair of abandonment.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Landing]
description: A dark gloom greets the end of the great stone stairwell as it comes to a stop at broad landing.  Pierced only by the light of a single flickering torch, the gloom gives way to a hallway leading to the east, the same direction from which flows a damp breeze thick with the smell of decay.  Footprints cover the surrounding floor in a haphazard pattern of chaotic activity, many possessing clawed toes and heels.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: The walls of the dungeon widen into a hallway with passages leading to the north and southeast, with the stairwell landing to the west. Irregularly cut blocks of granite make up the primary building material, except to the south where smooth black stones run along the edge of the floor.  A torch located down the south hallway provides little available light, reflected off a pile of glistening white bones stacked against the wall.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: The hallway ends with the intersection of another that runs east to west.  The paltry amount of available light comes from torches burning in the same directions and does nothing to reveal the source of a horrendous smell encompassing the area.  Elsewhere in the dungeon something roars loudly and hungerily, its bellows echoing off the stone walls.

Elsewhere in the dungeon something roars loudly and hungrily, its bellows echoing off the stone walls.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Filfth of undeterminable origin is spread over the floor of the hallway in smelly clumps of grey sludge speckled with white, and fills the air with a nauseating stench.  No torches line this part of the dungeon's hallway, leaving only the sputtering light of torches to the east and west, which splay constantly shifting shadows on the floor and walls.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Hissing and sputtering comes from a torch, while flaming bits of its meager fuel drip to the ground, where they immediately are extinguished in a puddle of water.  Beside the torch is an iron door which hangs from a broken hinge, allowing barely enough space for passage into the cell beyond.  The skeletal remains of a hand, stained yellow and covered with dust and cobwebs, lies nearby.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Cell]
description: Little light enters the cell, creeping in from the hallway outside and revealing only a few feet of a filthy stone floor.  Dirty pieces of hay scattered over the visible surface of the ground intermingles with hundreds of large, roach husks that crunch underfoot.  The sound of skittering feet come from the shadows, sometimes from the blackness where the corners of the room should be, and other times from the walls and the ceiling.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Smooth black stone provide the foundation for the widening walls of the hallway, rising halfway up before being replaced by roughly hewn granite blocks.  Much the ground is bathed in darkness with the only light coming from the north and the south.  Sounds echo off the stone walls as someone or something else stirs elsewhere in the dungeon, followed by a loud clanging noise.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Smooth black stone runs from the floor to the ceiling, leaving no evidence of the granite block used to the north in the dungeon hallway.  Claw marks in the floor lead to the skeletal remains of a hand positioned downward and lying halfway out into the hallway from behind an iron door.  The hallway opens up to the east into a large vaulted area.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Cell]
description: A skeleton lies near the doorway, its arm reaching out into the hallway behind.  Five more skeletons inhabit the room, each chained to the wall, some by their hands and others by their feet.  Several rib cages are stuffed with miscellaneous tufts of cloth, straw, and fur, creating homes for some of the dungeon's smaller furrier residents.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Vault]
description: Five torches burn in the center of the chamber to the east, below a large half-dome of concentric rings.  Above, the outer edge of the dome meets with the lower ceiling of a hallway which leads off to the west.  Pieces of rusting and damaged armor lie spread across the ground, many dented and splattered with dark stains, and accompanied by broken spear hafts and the splintered remains of arrows.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Vault]
description: A half-dome rises above the dungeon floor, constructed by the application of multiple ceiling vaults.  The black smooth stone of the dome forms a networks of intersecting lines that merge with concentric half-rings, which grow narrower towards the center of the ceiling.  Five black torch stands are set in a circle in the center of the room, directly beneath the ceiling, casting playful shadows across the entire area.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Vault]
description: From the direction of a hallway to the east, a loud clanking noise as if someone or something is bashing a metal object, Echoes into the vaulted chamber.  The tattered remains of an old tapestry lie heaped in a corner, partially concealing a broken metal rod from which it once was suspended.  Flickering light from five torches to the east create the sensation of dark figures moving back and forth in nearby shadows.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Darkness shrouds this corner of the hallway.  The only light comes from a vaulted chamber to the west and a single torch, neither strong enough to completely pierce the vell of blackness over this portion of the dungeon.  Underfoot, something crunches with every step.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Three torches placed on the curving wall of the hallway provide ample light for passage between walls built of mostly roughly-hewn granite, and near the floor, smooth black stones.  Scattered across the floor are rotting heaps of skin, removed from their possessors by some unknown instrument, and left to decay.  Insects swarm over the flesh, chewing up from underneath to crawl across the surface, the repulsive sight not enough to distract from the stench.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Curving to the northeast, the hallway begins to narrow as the granite blocks become the predominant material used in the construction, with the black stone sinking further toward the ground.  Pieces of clothing litter the floor, creating a trail that leads to the south toward an open iron door.  A loud trollish roar reverberates through the dungeon, and bounces off the walls, followed by the sound of something scratching its claws against metal.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Flickering pitifully is a torch afixed to the wall next to an iron door.  The wall is built of two materials, smooth, black stone on the lower half and granite blocks on the upper half, leading up to the ceiling.  Discarded clothing covers the floor, creating a trail of pieces of cloth leading into the cell behind the door.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Vault]
description: The southern lip of the half-dome ends above and the ceiling of the chamber seamlessly meets the top of a massive iron door.  Set between the door and five burning torches on the northside of the chamber is a large stone altar, atop which lies a skeleton impaled through the chest by metal spear.  The dark sockets of the skeleton's skull gazes silently at the metal door while its boney hands grasp the spear by its haft above its chest.

title: [Marsh Keep, Flooded Chamber]
description: Somber murals surround this chamber where the stone paved floor has sunk several feet below the doorway leading back out into the vaulted room.  All but for a few paces of floor remain, the rest has quietly succumbed to a rising pool of black water that dominates most of the room.  Occasionally, something causes the water to ripple as unseen things stir beneath the surface.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Cell]
description: Rubble fills most of the cell from the collapse of the eastern wall of the room.  Light flickers in from outside the doorway, dimly reflected off the surfaces of chains and manacles still attached to the unaffected walls.  Piled near to the door are mounds of discarded clothes, most torn and shredded.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Hallway]
description: Flickering light comes from the torch mounted in a rusting metal bracket next to an iron door.  The flame sputters off and on as if low on fuel, providing just enough illumination to reveal a dead-end formed by a solid wall of bricks glistening with beads of moisture.  An unidentifiable stench drifts into this end of the hallway from the west.

title: [Marsh Keep, Dungeon Cell]
description: The partial skeleton of a troll hangs from a pair of manacles bolted to the wall of the small damp cell.  Discarded bones lie beneath the skeleton and scattered across the floor, next to a pile of rotting skins, hides, and even more bones.  A dark green moss covers much of the wall opposite the door, filling the room with the smell of earth, and a cold dampness that lingers in the air fails to overpower the stench of decomposition emanating from the pile.

title: [Marsh Keep, Kitchen]
description: Dust blankets the surfaces of the kitchen, from brass pots hanging from a ceiling rack to a large countertop built to slope towards a rusted metal sink.  A wood chopping block sits in the middle of the room, with a butcher's cleaver buried an inch into its surface, along with the skeletal remains of a chicken resting alongside it.  Many cooking instruments lie about the room as if the staff simply walked away and never returned, including an oversized metal spit in a looming fireplace across from the doorway.

title: [Forgotten Cairn, Interior]
description: Strung from the ceiling of the chamber, a single green orb provides lighting to the interior of the cairn, bathing all surfaces in an eerie green glow.  A sarcophagus sits in the center of the chamber, which is slightly flooded by dark, slow moving pools of water.  Armor, weapons, and shields surround, set on racks or placed upon numerous chests, many of antique design or build.  At the head of the tomb stands a banner, reduced to faded cloth by the passage of time.

title: [The Stone Eye, Top of the Eye]
description: Small ebonywood dining tables are situated such that every diner has a magnificent view of the countryside:  River's Rest, the river below and the Citadel of Elanith above.  Oaken frames supporting massive panes of glass make up the walls and ceiling of the circular dining area.  Bustling servants seem to be at your shoulder at your slightest whim to satisfy your every need.

title: [Smuggler's Cutter, Deck]
description: The wood of the deck is missing varnish where the salt-water has eaten through.  The brass fittings are a dull green and are in desperate need of some polish.  Ratty coils of rope lie about the deck ready for use when needed.  The single mast and large sail are the only things in pristine condition on the deck.

wayto.10838: ;e while line = get;if line=~ /The crew hurriedly puts out the gangplank\.|River's Rest\.\.\..+ ashore!/;fput "out";break;end;end
wayto.11753: ;e while line = get;if line=~ /The crew hurriedly puts out the gangplank\.|Solhaven\.\.\..+ ashore!/;fput "out";break;end;end

title: [Smuggler's Cutter, Galley]
description: The galley is well-lit by a large brass oil lantern hanging from the center beam.  In one corner is a rather messy table that should be able to flip down if it was in working order.  The table is currently covered in scraps from some unidentifiable meal as well as part of a map with a knife cleaving it to the table.  In another corner is a cook stove covered in grime.

title: [Smuggler's Cutter, Hold]
description: The smoky illumination of a brass oil lamp reveals the hold to be a dark, dank room.  Bags of grain are stacked haphazardly against the moldy bulkheads.  A tattered notice and a slate board are affixed to one of the walls.  Against the base of the aft bulkead is a low, screened enclosure attached to a small box.  The smell of mold, mildew and rancid meat hover in the still air.

A tattered notice and a slate board are affixed to one of the walls.  Against the base of the aft bulkhead is a low, screened enclosure attached to a small box.  The smell of mold, mildew and rancid meat hover in the still air.

title: [Smuggler's Cutter, Cabin]
description: The brass oil lantern in this room swings back and forth with the tossing of the waves.  The light from the lamp reflects in the few brass fittings, and brightens the otherwise dark room.  There is a mustiness in the air that reeks of moldering dead things.

title: [Marshtown, Glok's Pier]
description: This pier is crowded with merchants and sailors alike, all moving from ship to ship, and some from ship to shore.  Dozens of small sea craft anchor here, tied off by thick but worn ropes.  Taller mooring posts designed for ships and galleys are on the southern part of the pier.  A number of barrels litter the pier at various places, and a cast iron fish is fastened securely at its center.

title: [Penitentiary, Yard]
description: Indolent guards lean casually against an iron portcullis, lazily surveying their surroundings.  A refreshing breeze from the ocean wafts into the yard, and seagulls can be heard in the distance.  The massive granite walls of the prison cast long shadows across the yard.  A wide, beaten trail leads back towards Marshtown Road.

Indolent guards lean casually against an iron portcullis, lazily surveying their surroundings.  A refreshing breeze from the ocean wafts into the yard, and seagulls can be heard in the distance.  The massive granite walls of the prison rise high above the yard, blacker than the night sky.  A wide, beaten trail leads back towards Marshtown Road.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The trail meanders through a copse of trees, at the center of which is an ancient oak.  It remains standing, yet it no longer lives, its trunk is blackened and burned from a devastating strike of lightning.  Its limbs are devoid of leaves and the jagged branches reach toward the traitorous sky in a final futile gesture of defiance.

title: [Marshtown, Fewr's Pier]
description: This pier is secured to pilings as thick as tall trees that are sunk deep into the mud of Solhaven Bay.  The thickly-tarred barrel raft extends under the pier, but is not used for support.  Caravels and large carracks dock at this pier, some bringing in wares and others docked for shore leave.  The pier is bustling with sailors.

title: [Cypress Walk, Gate]
description: A weathered wooden walkway leads south from an elaborate wrought iron gate.  To each side, moss spreads amongst flowers ringed by giant cypress and willows.  Far back from the wide walkway can be glimpsed a small house raised up on stilts and a broad platform, while others closer by stand on firmer ground.

title: [Cypress Walk, Promenade]
description: Shade provided by carefully tended willows shelters the houses along the cobbled promenade from the sun during daylight hours.  Small gardens of flowers and herbs provide a colorful border between the whitewashed homes and the flow of traffic.

Filtered through carefully tended willows, moonlight dots the cobbled promenade and surrounding homes.  Small gardens of flowers and herbs provide a colorful border between the whitewashed homes and the flow of traffic.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Cypress Walk]
description: Tufts of moss in a variety of shades spread across the uneven land.  Whitewashed houses are separated only by the giant sentinel cypress and willow tress that stretch towards the sky.  Sunbeams flicker through the leaves of the canopy, causing chaotically distorted shadows to dance to and fro.

Tufts of moss in a variety of shades spread across the uneven land.  White-washed houses are separated only by the giant sentinel cypress and willow tress that stretch towards the sky.  Moonbeams flicker through the leaves of the canopy, causing chaotically distorted shadows to dance to and fro.

title: [Cypress Walk, Old Tree]
description: Moss hangs in matted clumps from the ancient boughs of the old cypress tree.  A set of ruined steps built into the trunk lead up to the ramshackled and abandoned building balanced between the branches.  A creaky sign sways in the marsh breezes, breaking through the silence of the fog.

title: [Cypress Walk]
description: A white stone retaining wall builds to the south, as the pathway declines deeper into the swampy forest.  Many paces to the east, another terraced barrier holds back the growing mass of vegetation.

title: [Cypress Walk, Promenade]
description: A wide stone promenade extends south, the grand houses lining each side rising behind elaborate ironwork gates and arches standing in proud contrast to the smaller homes to the north.  Well-dressed couples stroll back and forth, and a man carrying a fiddle case whistles softly as he walks south towards the central plaza.

title: [Cypress Walk, West]
description: Mangroves, willows and cypress trees shade the broad wooden walkway.  Tangled roots are fenced in by small wrought iron islands, keeping the paths to the surrounding houses clear and level.  A faint chorus of frogs sounds from a northern pond, the sound marking a nearly invisible spot through the trees.

title: [Cypress Walk, West]
description: The surrounding swamp has been cleared and tamed to provide solid ground for a series of white stucco homes with broad wooden porches bearing pots of herbs and wide wooden swings.  On one sits an old elven woman in a rocking chair, surveying passerbys with a proprietary eye.

title: [Cypress Walk]
description: Mangrove fields create an impenetrable wall to the west, while houses on stilts dot the space between the watery mass and the cultivated greenery to the east.  A pair of cypress mark the pathway east, leading toward the commons area.

title: [Cypress Walk, Plaza]
description: The bustling plaza is ringed by prosperous homes, their wrought iron gates decorated with climbing vines and blooming roses.  On the north side of the stone circle stands a small wooden building, its weathered appearance a gentle contrast to the stately whitewash of the surrounding homes.  Faint strains of music drift from its swinging doors.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Cypress Walk]
description: The tall white retaining wall curves around to the southwest.  Barely visible above the top is a lichen-covered white stone building.  Homes dot the cramped space between the high stone wall to the northeast and the lower one, leading into the impenetrable swamps.

title: [Cypress Walk, Promenade]
description: South of the main plaza the promenade bows outwards to a graceful ellipse to give full view of a colorful flower bed that divides the way.  A weathered wooden bench nearby provides a place to rest and admire the colorful display.

title: [Cypress Walk]
description: Long mossy tendrils of green embrace two low stone walls that separate the curve of cleared land from the swampy groves of cypress behind.  High above the northeastern wall, a white stone building is visible beneath a mass of vines.

title: [Cypress Walk]
description: Beyond the stepped grassy terraces of the cleared land, a tangled mass of mangroves to the southwest impedes further travel.  Small white stones top the retaining wall, serving as a visual identifier when all else is covered in green.

title: [Cypress Walk]
description: The grassy plane of the terrace is broader here, spanning nearly fifteen yards in either direction from the pathway.  The only thing visible at the top of the northern retaining wall is a gigantic cypress sprouting out of a mass of vines.

title: [Cypress Walk, Graveyard]
description: A circle of ancient cypress trees surrounds the quiet graveyard.  The carved markers, gravestones and statues have been kept free of moss, and offerings of flowers rest near the most recent memorials.  To the south side of the small cemetery stands a simple stone chapel, its double doors open both day and night.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: Wooden planks that long ago warped into bent and twisted shapes are all that allow passage into this dank, muck-filled grotto.  A few trees solemnly greet visitors to the area, their trunks deeply submerged within the swamp, and their long, thick leaves bending down so far as to brush the brackish water.

Wooden planks that long ago warped into bent and twisted shapes are all that allow passage into this dank, muck-filled grotto.  A few trees solemnly greet visitors to the area, their trunks deeply submerged within the swamp, and their long, thick leaves bending down so far as to brush the brackish water.  A pair of guttering torches cast a fitful light against the almost tangible gloom.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: The deep swamp has laid claim to a wagon, but only the badly stained canvas canopy is now showing above the soupy quagmire.  Why the owner would veer off the rugged path is anyone's guess, but four of the wooden slats of the road are missing, and several others are cracked in half.  A torch has been placed on what is left of the wagon, either as a memorial or perhaps as a warning.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: A small hillock that is completely covered with tall, sturdy swampgrass has risen high enough out of the muck to allow for a few structures to be built upon it.  Since the ground is somewhat solid, the homes don't have any of the thick stout poles generally attached to the huts and shacks of this neighborhood.  Several flittering will-o'-the-wisps are winking in and out of sight nearby, creating a dazzling light show for those with time to watch.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: A battered and abandoned general store that is slowly sinking into the marsh doesn't look as if it will be opening anytime soon, but that hasn't stopped anybody from building a few ramshackle huts along the somewhat dry gnoll.  A tall stick peers out of the deep mud, the pole etched top to bottom with crude scratch marks.

A battered and abandoned general store that is slowly sinking into the marsh doesn't look as if it will be opening anytime soon, but that hasn't stopped anybody from building a few ramshackle huts along the somewhat dry gnoll.  A tall stick peers out of the deep mud, pale beneath the night sky.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: An industrious sort has tried to repair the badly damaged road by replacing a few of the busted planks with halved logs, but based on the way they are bobbing in the rippling current of the swamp, it might not have been such a good idea.  Nearby trees look to be serving as neighborhood pantries, as the carcasses of several small critters can be seen hanging from the branches.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: Low dark shapes break the surface of the swamp for but a moment, then slowly descend and vanish into the depths of the gloom.  Some of the shadowy forms look to be quite large, but thankfully, none of them appear to be heading for the shore... yet.  Whatever they are, they evidentally aren't worrisome enough to keep folks from building a shack or two along the shoreline.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: A massive tree with a trunk as wide as a large wagon has overtaken the middle of this neighborhood, and rather than fight the immovable object, those living here have built their shacks in a wide circle around it.  A low stone wall rings the base of the tree, and adds a bit of decoration to its otherwise overwhelming shape.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: It looks as if the residents have attempted to scratch out a clearing, but already the tenacious growth of the marsh can be seen sneaking around its borders.  A few scant gardens are dotting the front yards of the modest shacks, but most of them have been overtaken by the wiry vines of the swamp.  Clearly it's a losing battle.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
