description: A massive tangle of low vines and deep moss have completely covered the wooden pathway, and it would be quite easy to get lost in the thick wilderness surrounding the area.  A few markers have been placed near the homes, but they too are buried in the thick tendrils of the heavy foilage.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: The moisture of the marsh has badly damaged the simple homes over time, and it's difficult to tell if the moss covering them might not actually be holding them together.  The residents don't seem to mind nor care about the appearance of their hovels as they seem more interested in privacy.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: A few beams of sunlight have managed to break through the tree cover and their glittering reflection can be seen dancing upon the dark waters of the swamp.  The marsh-dwellers have set up a platform for fishing, and one would suspect they bring in a good haul of catfish and mudpuppies from time to time.  A rusted tin bucket has been firmly bolted to the wood to hold the day's catch.

A few beams of moonlight have managed to break through the tree cover and their glittering reflection can be seen dancing upon the dark waters of the swamp.  The marsh-dwellers have set up a platform for fishing, and one would suspect they bring in a good haul of catfish and mudpuppies from time to time.  A rusted tin bucket has been firmly bolted to the wood to hold the day's catch.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: Moss-covered boulders and garishly painted stones have been dragged into this clearing to provide a bit of color and decoration to the huts of this area.  A pair of shabbily dressed urchins dart in and out of the stone formations, pelting each other with tiny rocks and laughing gleefully all the while.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Gator Grove]
description: The dwellers within the shacks built in this tiny clearing are drenched in eternal gloom as the thick trees completely blot out any sight of the sky above.  The slowly rippling water of the swamp is serene and placid however, and although this alcove is quite dreary, it does provide quiet and solitude for those who prefer privacy.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Gator Grove]
description: A massive snake ringed with coral and black weaves its way around one of the dense trees and vanishes into the leafy depths only to appear a few branches higher.  Quiet as the viper might be in its movement, it must be disturbing something nearby as a loud chittering can be heard coming from the tall brush near the hovels.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Gator Grove]
description: The tall hill that these homes have been constructed upon is providing the residents with an excellent view of the entire marsh below.  The pathway forks in several directions and the southern trail has been reinforced to provide safe passage towards what appears to be an arena.  A wide trellis has been built along the side of this road, and tiny red flowers dot its entire length quite prettily.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, down

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Gator Grove]
description: Serpentine trails weave through the deep grass and then disapear into the heavy growth, but the gentle swaying motion of the stalks show that whatever originated the marks is likely still about.  One of the wooden planks of the path has what looks to be teeth marks deeply inbedded into it from the powerful jaws of some large beast.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Gator Grove]
description: An elegant scrolled iron fence that must have been constructed years ago serves as a border to this grassy plateau.  The brackish waters of the swamp haven't invaded this area yet, and several lush gardens decorate the modest homes.  The cheerful sounds of a whippoorwill fill the air with song, the bird deeply hidden within one of the thickly leaved trees.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Gator Trayle]
description: Perhaps in the spirit of the neighborhood, the residents here have all decorated their porches or lawns with a variety of ornamental wooden and pottery gators.  One resident has gone so far as to hollow one out and make a lantern of it, both of the eyes flickering with a soft light.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Misty Pit]
description: A treacherous path of slick mud is the only way in or out of this dreary spot, and the low carpet of thick grey fog that is blanketing the entire grotto only makes it worse.  Jet black dragonflies silently zig-zag their way about the mire, their forms quite frantic compared to the slowly moving waterbugs gracefully crossing the surface of the nearby swamp.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Rasslin Pit]
description: A small and very crude mudpit has been built out of stacked logs, but the height of the walls doesn't look nearly tall enough to keep the large beast inside it from escaping.  There is a evil gleam in the eyes of the reptilian critter, and it doesn't look as if it has eaten in weeks.  A battered sign has been shoved into the ground near the pit.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: The marsh surrounding the makeshift hovels of this neighborhood is particularly deep and has forced the residents to used raised platforms to keep their homes dry.  Several simple rafts have been dragged up on shore near a few of the homes, and resting atop them are long wooden poles used to help navigate the thick waters.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: Those living in the nearby shacks have set up several crude wooden cages and snares in the hopes of catching dinner, but a close inspection of the devices reveals they have succeeded in trapping nothing other than some green algae.  One of the jawed snares has slammed shut, but it too is empty, the animal evidently outsmarting the contraption and running off with the bait.

title: [Kwagmire Kourt, Outer Rim]
description: A massive tree, evidently stricken by swamp rot, has fallen across the path and is blocking its entire length.  Rather than go to the trouble of moving it however, the residents have nailed together a few coarse wooden steps to the trunk, so that it can be easily climbed over.

title: [Urudwek's Weaponry]
[Urudwek's Combat Gear]
description: A decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the chipped red brick walls, and a painted nightscape ceiling rises overhead.  A verdant elderberry bush sits in one corner of a buffed cherrywood floor.  There is a small brown box on one side of the shop and a large oak table on the other.

title: [Urudwek's Combat Gear]
[Urudwek's Armory]
[Urudwek's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a sturdy white cedar ceiling, a snarling war griffin painting hangs on one of the patterned white walls.  A gold-trimmed ebonwood chest and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while an ivory elven noble statue rests on a polished marble floor.

title: [Lwin's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Marshtown Chandler's Shop]
description: Goods of all kinds are stacked against the walls, piled on tarps, or hang from pegs on the walls or from the rafters themselves.  From the strange mix of items you get the impression that the chandler accepts barter from the ships' pursers that frequent his shop.

title: [Lwin's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Elysiana's Combat Gear]
[Elysiana's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by smooth sandstone walls, the shop features a life-sized granite maiden statue in the center of its glossy tanik floor.  A brilliant peacock painting hangs under the nightscape ceiling.  Right near the front is a floral-etched ceramic case.

title: [Elysiana's Magic Shoppe]
[Elysiana's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by smooth sandstone walls, the shop features a life-sized granite maiden statue in the center of its glossy tanik floor.  A brilliant peacock painting hangs under the nightscape ceiling.  Right near the front is a floral-etched ceramic case.

title: [Kunz's Magic Shoppe]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A large oak table and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: Two massive granite sentinels reach toward the sky, flanking the road as it moves to the west.  The sentinels are highly weathered, and their surfaces are pitted and cracked.  No method of circumventing the sentinels presents itself if one wishes to continue along the road in a western direction.  One must pass between the sentinels.  To the southeast the road enters a spacious mud plain.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: A flat sea of black mud with a rusty red tinge spreads out on all sides, and its surface shines from the thin layer of water that covers it.  The water reflects the moonlight brilliantly, almost blindingly.  The beauty is marred by the uncomfortable humidity that rises from the mud sea, causing clothing and armor to take on a moist feel and chafe annoyingly.  The area also carries the nauseating odor of putrefying plant life.

A flat sea of black mud with a rusty red tinge spreads out on all sides, and its surface shines from the thin layer of water that covers it.  The water reflects the sunlight brilliantly, almost blindingly.  The beauty is marred by the uncomfortable humidity that rises from the mud sea, causing clothing and armor to take on a moist feel and chafe annoyingly.  The area also carries the nauseating odor of putrefying plant life.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: A flat expanse of reddish-black mud follows the road on both sides, trying vainly to suck the few remaining cobblestones down into its dank depths.  In several spots the mud has actually dried a bit, and large cracks crisscross the surface of the swamp, breaking each patch into multisided plates.  A slight fog rises from the swampy ground, merely a mist that causes the ground further away to appear to waver slightly.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: Mud, nothing but mud, is all around.  The dark, wet ground reflects heat and light back intensely, filling the air with cloying wetness.  Nothing grows in the mud, perhaps due to the heavy reddish tinge, indicative of intense iron deposits mixed into the soil.  It does attract one form of life in abundance, however.  Massive clouds of gnats flit back and forth across the roadway as if searching vainly for something lost.  Occasionally they find an adventurer with very uncomfortable results.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: A few hardy swamp grasses form mounds of tight vegetation atop the black mud plain.  Their thin, dusty yellow-green blades indicate that they need very little in the way of nutrients to survive, and their shallow, wide roots are able to tolerate the consistently wet conditions.  Grey biting flies flit among the grasses, examining them for signs of some animal from which to drink blood.   Moving along quickly seems to help keep the flies at bay.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: Patches of greenery rise up from patches of dead vegetation as the cycle of death and rebirth continues unabated, even in this seemingly deity-forsaken place.  Clumps of cattails huddle protectively together, as if their numbers will be enough to ward off the creeping disease of the black mud.  Braver swamp grasses venture out into the open spaces, heedless of the danger lurking just below the still waters.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: What remains of the cobblestone road ventures northeast and southwest, unconcerned with the struggle for survival occurring on either side of it.  Thousands of frogs have clambered up on the cobblestones, escaping a threat unknown, only to die in the exposed conditions.  Their bodies have decayed to the point where all that remains are flattened, leathery pieces of eyeless amphibian stuck to the cobblestones or compressed into the cracks between them.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: Tall reeds and cattails block the line of sight on either side of the road.  Their stalks stand perfectly still as no breeze stirs the area.  In many places the cattails actually grow up through the road to separate the cobblestones and expose the water pooling just below road level.  Frogs croak and bellow deep within the covering vegetation, calling out to one another in a cacophony of amphibian sound.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: The swamp moves across the road to the north, disrupting the stones and eventually sucking them all down into the mire.  Passage is impossible in that direction.  To the southwest the road is still passable, though, as its surface is still above the muddy plain.  A huge mud mound rises just to the northeast and extends eastward as far as the eye can see.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: A cobblestone road swings in a wide arc northeast and west.  Many of the stones are missing, but for the most part the road is still level and easily traveled.  A huge mound of mud rises just to the southwest and extends to the west as far as the eye can see.  The area is eerily quiet, as if no life of any kind resides here.  A few dead trees, now petrified, rise into the sky in bleak silhouette, but the earth has a scorched look to it, and the usual underbrush seems to have retreated.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: The road runs west and east, paralleling a huge mud mound.  To the west the road ends at the edge of a sucking, bubbling swamp.  The swamp has engulfed the road, submerging the stones and rendering passage impossible.  Eastward the road appears to be in much better shape.  Humidity and rank odors rise liberally from the muck, and strange gurglings, growlings and squealings emanate from deep within the swamp grass, the area's only vegetation.

title: [Ta'Faendryl Approach]
description: The cobblestone road wanders through a contorted landscape, both overgrown and nearly dead at the same time.  Blackened, woody vines replete with long, jagged thorns and sickly grey leaves parallel the road as if examining it for potential victims.  Here and there trees battle for survival among the choking underbrush, but the stunted appearance of the trees indicate that the battle is difficult.  Several trees, merely large stumps now, indicate that the battle is often lost.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southern Road]
description: The road slopes down to the southwest and rises toward the northeast.  To the north a high wall cuts across the darkened horizon.
The road slopes down to the southwest and rises toward the northeast.  To the north a high wall, covered with a thick growth of green vegetation, cuts across the horizon.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southern Road]
description: Trees and brush thicken and grow with an increasingly vigorous appearance along the edges of the road to the north.  To the south, the road is wider, the sicklier vegetation of the swampy lowlands apparently less able to compete with its cobbled surface.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southern Road]
description: A flight of cracked stone steps lead up the final slope of the hill, ending at the base of a large tower.  A faint breeze brings the sound of running water up from the river flowing past the base of the hill to the east.  Further on a pyramid, as tall as the hill and nearly as wide, lifts a sparkling white marble structure high above the city.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southern Road]
description: The broken surface of the cobbled road winds down to the south, disappearing from view as it bends slightly to the west and is hidden by a heavy growth of underbrush.  Two long shadowed lines of tumbled stones, which appear to have once been columns, flank each side of the road.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Market Road]
description: A massive wall of earth and vegetation casts deep shadows on each side of the road, and continues on like two hulking black snakes, slithering off to the east and west.  To the north the ruined walls and towers of a large city appear as dark silhouettes against the night sky.

A massive wall of earth and vegetation extends on each side of the road and continues on to the east and the west.  Here and there, through the obscuring layer of dirt can be seen a gleaming patch of white.  To the north the ruined walls and towers of a large city struggle valiantly beneath the weight of the encroaching forest.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Market Road]
description: The road moves north and south between broken mounds of dirt and stone that mark out a boundary along the edges of two wide plazas on either side of the road.  Unusually straight cracks and an occasional gleam of grey peeping through the dirt indicates the presence of cracked granite blocks buried beneath the soil.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Market]
description: Creeping vines and a thick growth of low-lying grass extends across a large space of ground that was probably once a huge open market where the inhabitants of the city could hawk their assorted produce and wares.  A series of bulky dark hillocks extend beyond the plaza, skulking like rats in the shadow of the massive city wall.

Creeping vines and a thick growth of low-lying grass extends across a large space of ground that was probably once a huge open market where the inhabitants of the city could hawk their assorted produce and wares.  The exterior wall of the city cuts diagonally across the plaza to the northwest, rising past squared off hillocks of verdant green.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Market]
description: A recessed alcove in the city wall shelters a large thorny bush within its darkened depths.  Sharply tipped branches jut out away from the wall and clutch at the clothes of passing travelers like the fingers of an inept cutpurse reaching brazenly from the shadows.

A recessed alcove built into a jog in the city walls shelters a bush that is covered with what appears to be an equal abundance of small, cup-shaped red blossoms and vicious looking thorns.  The bush clings limpet-like to the wall, its prickly defenses amply sufficient protection against would be intruders to its private space.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: The ground here is uneven, liberally littered with stones and blocks that have fallen from the surrounding building walls.  Flaked off bits and pieces of granite have been ground into the dirt by the long term pressure of passing hooves, feet and paws.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: A high mound of earth has accumulated here in a corner of the outer wall, burying all remains of the structures that once occupied this section of the city.  The ground is lumpy and uneven, dips and valleys in the surface hinting at structures buried deep beneath the soil.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: The sound of running water can be heard to the north.  A narrow road also leads to the east, past the time-blasted remains of roofless stone buildings.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, River Edge]
description: The end of the road crumbles into a swiftly moving river.  The churning water gleams dimly, rippled rapids appearing black and oily under the night stars.
The end of the road crumbles into a swiftly moving river.  The water churns and grumbles around the foundations of the ancient ruins of homes that once graced its edge.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, River Edge]
description: Huge chunks of granite, half-submerged in the center of the river to the north, do little to impede the progress of the rushing water.  Dark and bulky, with edges rounded off by the constant erosion of the water, the massive boulders have the appearance of a herd of huge sea creatures lurking in the oily depths of the water.

Huge chunks of granite, half-submerged in the center of the river to the north, do little to impede the progress of the rushing brown water.  Grey and wet, with edges rounded off by the constant erosion of the water, the massive boulders have the appearance of a herd of huge sea creatures basking in the sun.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, River Edge]
description: Cracks and crannies of broken stone tumbled all along river's edge provide a haven for tiny creatures of the night.  A low drone of insect song fills the air.
Green moss creeps silently over the blocks of stone tumbled all along river's edge.  The fuzzy surface shines dark and wet in the light of the sun.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, River Bend]
description: The river bends in from the north, the flow of silted water slapping up against a rocky embankment before traveling on to the west.  Slender stalks of bulrush rise from the deeper crevices of the rocks, rooted firmly in the silt and mud collected in the broken cracks.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, River Bend]
description: A huge pile of refuse, broken stone and rotting vegetation blocks the road to the east and spills down along the edge of the river.  A strong, musty odor of decay rises from the jumbled pile.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: Amidst the cracked and beaten walls lining the edges of the road, a granite column rises like a slender grey finger pointing toward the sun.  It appears to be the only survivor of a series of columns that now lie scattered in chunks and pieces across the ground at its base.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: The road runs from east to west, coming to an end at a wide area of land that opens to the east.  Thick blades of grass, bristling at the tips with clinging seed heads, poke through the web of cracks and crevices that splinter the path.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Market]
description: A circular stand of stones marks the position of the well that once served as a focal point in center of the market.  Completely filled with dirt and broken stone, the structure seems to have been more recently employed as a handy firepit for some opportunistic traveler.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Market]
description: Creeping vines and a thick growth of low-lying grass extends across a large space of ground that was probably once a huge open market where the inhabitants of the city could hawk their assorted produce and wares.  To the east the flattened tip of a tall tower pokes its black silhouette above the dark, jagged outline of a series of walls.

Creeping vines and a thick growth of low-lying grass extends across a large space of ground that was probably once a huge open market where the inhabitants of the city could hawk their assorted produce and wares.  To the east the flattened tip of a tall tower rises high above a series of walls and roofless buildings.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Market]
description: A twisted limb has snaked its way through a fissure in the crumbling wall, stretching its way into the open plaza.  Twigs and branches claw at the crumbling stone on each edge of the gap, as if intent on forcing enough open space for the entire tree to enter.

A twisted limb has snaked its way through a fissure in the crumbling wall, stretching its way into the open plaza as if struggling to squeeze past, into the sunlight.  Twigs and branches claw at the crumbling stone on each edge of the gap, as if intent on forcing enough open space for the entire tree to enter.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, South]
description: A dense jumble of collapsed walls and toppled pillars gives way to a scattering of stone blocks spread across an open plaza to the west.  A flight of wide stone steps leads up to the back of a building that is perched upon base of stone.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Asylum Square]
description: A high portico, still retaining a portion of its roof, extends out from the back of the building.  Vines twine up the supportive columns of the structure and out across the walls.  A brick walkway, badly overgrown with wild grass and moss, leads up to a gaping space in the wall of the building where once hung doors of more perishable material than the surviving bricks and stone.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Asylum Square]
description: A long walkway extends down the side of the granite building, lined by a series of statues placed at regular intervals along the outer edge.  Fashioned in the form of Elven men and woman, each stone figure is engaged in some mundane, domestic activity.  It is as if the artist wished to encourage a feeling of familiarity and peace in those who viewed his works.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Asylum Square]
description: A long, low building rests in the center of this open plaza, its roofless walls stretched toward the star-flecked sky.  Two green columns fashioned into the form of coiled serpents flank the entrance into the structure.  A wide brick walkway leads back to the road.

A long, low building rests in the center of this open plaza, its roofless walls stretched toward the sun.  Built of light gray granite that is liberally laced with tiny specks of mica, the entire building gleams and sparkles through the leafy interlacing of ivy that covers its length.  Two green columns fashioned in the form of coiled serpents flank the entrance into the structure.  A wide brick walkway leads back to the road.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Asylum Square]
description: Shattered statues of men and women lay across the path, bits of their arms and faces strewn about in the ankle-high grass that spreads across the square.  Here and there a leafy veil of vines has draped itself over one of the stone forms as if nature, in its mercy, has attempted to restore some measure of modesty and dignity to the fallen figures.

title: [Asylum, Small Chamber]
description: Thick ivy covers the vines of this small chamber in a rumpled tapestry of stems and leaves.  The same vines spread across the floor in a thick, but rather damp green carpet.  At the southern end of the room, a gaping hole leads out to an overgrown garden.

title: [Asylum, Central Hall]
description: Paired off marble pillars line each side of a long central hall that runs down the entire length of the building.  Here and there, a pillar has toppled, joining the bits and pieces of beams that are all that remain of a tile roof long collapsed and ground into dust on the ground.  Hardy vines of ivy coil up every pillar and creep like a green carpet across the stone slab floor.  A particularly heavy curtain of vines extends across the southern wall of the hall.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East]
description: A tree-lined path extends past broken pillars and collapsed walls.  To the southeast, up a wide brick walkway can be seen a large building that still retains some semblance of its original shape and structure.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Market]
description: A huge oak tree rises from the cracked pavement of the plaza.  The gnarled, massive roots of the tree churn up the ground around it, adding a finishing touch to the destruction that time has wrought on the ancient market square.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Market Road]
description: To the northeast, the dark silhouette of a great and spacious building rises into sight.  With the foundation supporting it blocked from view, the shadowed edifice appears to float in brooding silence above the ruined city.  A few stone steps lead up to a high platform that spreads out to the north.

To the northeast, a great and spacious building rises into sight.  With the foundation supporting it blocked from view, the sparkling white edifice appears to float in brooding silence above the ruined city.  A few stone steps lead up to a high platform that spreads out to the north.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Market Road]
description: Deep crevices running through the dusty surface of the road expose the multiple layers of clay topped with limestone slabs that successive generations of the ancient city's inhabitants used to repair this once busy thoroughfare.  A final layer of dirt, laid down by nature, tops the rest like thick icing on a cake.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Market Road]
description: Wall surrounding an open plaza to the south run up against higher walls constructed of limestone blocks.  A heavy growth of vines and brambles creep along the wall in a dark, tangled mass of thorns and leaves.

Wall surrounding an open plaza to the south run up against higher walls constructed of limestone blocks.  The angular shape of the expertly cut blocks is barely visible through the heavy growth of vines and brambles growing along the full length of the wall.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Market Road]
description: Breaks in the wall lining the road reveal the four-sided courtyards of once-elegant homes that are now completely overrun with vegetation.  Tree roots snake from beneath the remaining walls in twisted, furrowed humps - mute evidence of the destructive forces contributing to the decay of the city.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: The road to the north opens out into a wide plaza that encircles a huge tower of cut granite blocks.  Down a few steps to the south can be seen the collapsing remains of a residential section of the city.  The cracked pieces of what may have once been a green marble pedestal lie in a jumbled heap at the southwestern corner of the plaza.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East]
description: A long walkway, once paved but now kept barely passable by the browsing animals that move freely about the city, continues on beneath the branches of several different species of trees.  Tangled roots thrust across the path in every direction, threatening the feet and toes of unwary travelers.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East]
description: Weeds, ivy, and grass fill in the cracks that extend in a webbed pattern down the entire length of a long paved walkway.  On each side of the path, vegetation creeps over sun-bleached blocks of stone, like mold growing over the skeleton of the city.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southeast]
description: A demolished wall allows a peek inside what must have once been the courtyard of a house.  Centered in the middle of the space is a dried-up fountain surrounded by mud-spattered, yet all too lifelike, statues of Elven men and women.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southeast]
description: A narrow path weaves through a tangled mass of thorny rose bushes that have spread in rampant abandon over the garden walls that once enclosed their ancient ancestors.  Fallen petals and leaves decorate the path in multi-colored layers.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southeast]
description: A toppled pillar, twisted by erosion and stained by water and time, leans like a weary old man against the trunk of a young oak.  Rounded stones from collapsing garden walls mark out a sporadic path through the ruins of the city.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East]
description: The path through the ruins turns and skirts along the edge of the city wall.  Tree branches reach through numerous breaks in the wall and cast their leaves across the path, like a creature marking territory on which it plans to lay claim.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southeast]
description: Vegetation grows thick and green over a long mound of stone and dirt that runs along the edge of the path.  A break in the mound allows passage northward into a wide field that is bounded by tower, wall and a series of toppled ruins.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, The Palestra]
description: A large rectangular space formed by a series of walls built between broken towers, opens out to the north.  The remains of several barrack-like buildings, low and roofless, occupy the opposite end of the field.  Positioned in this corner of the field is the statue of a woman perched on the edge of a wall that circles around a deep well.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, The Palestra]
description: Trailing branches of ivy have crept their way up the length of a statue sculpted in the form of a broad-shouldered shot-putter.  Once frozen in the act of launching a heavy ball, the Elven warrior now appears to be preparing to toss festoons of leafy green vines across the open field.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, The Palestra]
description: A slender Elven male crouches atop the pedestal resting in the northeast corner of the field.  Long, slender daggers rest in each of his hands, the blade of one held back and the other held forward as if poised to strike at enemies both in front and behind.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Barracks]
description: An accumulation of mud and debris is packed into the passages running between the barracks, like mortar between two paving stones.  The paths where warriors once marched and mingled could now barely accommodate the movement of a small squeaking mouse.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, The Palestra]
description: Two marble statues fashioned in the form of heavily muscled male warriors are locked together at the foot of a wide granite pedestal.  Toppled from their lofty perch, the once heroic figures now have the somewhat humorous appearance of boys rolling about in the dirt.  One statue is half-buried in the weed-riddled earth, as if forced beneath the ground by the hands of the second statue whose arms are locked about its head in a classic wrestlers' pose.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, The Palestra]
description: The statue of a slender Elven woman rests near the eastern side of the wall.  She stands with feet slightly spread, hands raised, and eyes gazing off across the field toward some distant point on the horizon.  One arm is drawn back toward her shoulder as if pulling on the string of a bow, but her hands are empty and her once gracefully fashioned fingers are chipped and broken.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, The Palestra]
description: Two swordsman sculpted in grey marble rest upon a large stone base in the northwest corner of the field.  They face each other, frozen in combat, the sinews of their arms stretched and muscles across their backs bulged in a titanic struggle of strength.  Their efforts are, however, quite futile. The swords that once clashed between them have broken off, leaving nothing but the stumps of the hilts within their clenching fists.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Barracks]
description: A faint acrid smell rises from the barracks that are crouched at the northern end of the field, lingering evidence of the animal life that has taken up residence in the ruined building.  A few stunted trees and hardy bushes have also found shelter within a number of the roofless walls.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A dimly lit cavern opens up to allow passage of a glowing emerald stream barely a foot deep.  The stream fills the cavern from wall to wall, though, entering from a tunnel to the north and exiting through a tunnel to the west.  In a small alcove on the eastern wall, steps wind upward, following a chimney into the darkness.  A slight amount of fresh air wafts down from the chimney, but for the most part the air in the cavern is still and cool.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: Small droplets of glowing, bright green liquid collect slowly along the cracks in the ceiling of the tunnel.  When the droplets reach sufficient size, they fall into the slowly moving water underneath, spreading out and dissipating into the water to give it a dim emerald glow.  The glowing stream then moves off to the south in a wide, iridescent, emerald ribbon.  Interestingly, nothing seems to grow or live in the water.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The tunnel ends at a sheer granite wall.  A sparse amount of green light filters in from the south to barely illuminate the walls and floor in this dead-end.  Apparently whoever dug the tunnel decided there was no need to go any further.  The answer, perhaps, is on the floor.  Water bubbles up liberally through several large cracks that cross the floor from wall to wall.  The water fills the area to about a foot high or so, and then flows off to the south.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A chill pervades the tunnel, rising damply from the slowly moving stream underfoot.  The dimly lit walls run slick with moisture, and the water's emerald glow is reflected much more deeply in the darkened surface of the wet granite.  The air hangs heavily, unmoving, and each breath draws in a lungful of the cold, humid air.  Three directions present potential exits, each with the same amount of sinister darkness.  The stream has made its choice, though, and it flows to the south.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The short tunnel ends at a smooth granite wall.  A large pile of debris has mounded up against the wall, including pieces of petrified wood, bones, and other less recognizable items.  Atop these, near the water's edge, a very few examples of less durable items such as old leaves and bits of cloth reside, but for the most part the pile looks as if it has existed here a very long time, with only the hardiest items surviving.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The soft emerald glow from the slowly moving stream barely illuminates the granite floor and the lower portions of the walls on either side of the tunnel.  The walls disappear into darkness farther up, and for all one knows the ceiling could be several hundred feet above, or just a scant few feet.  Noises echo, but in all directions at once, and they give no dependable indication of distances.  Only the sloshing green water and the pressing granite walls are apparent.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The western wall has crumbled into the stream, creating a high, long pile of rubble that follows the western side of the tunnel.  The collapse has stopped just within sight of the eastern exit, though the dim lighting makes it hard to determine if the wall there is truly stable.  On the northwest side, the wall has collapsed sufficiently to open a breach to another part of the tunnel works.  The breach is high up on the rubble, but looks accessible.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The northwestern wall has partially collapsed, pushing a long mound of rubble onto the floor of the tunnel and forcing passage against the southeastern side.  The subsequent constriction causes the water to race along the narrower channel before slowing considerably when the tunnel widens out to the southwest.  Shiny particles sparkle from some of the submerged rocks, indicating a possible source of mica may be nearby, but the volume apparent to the naked eye is not worth collecting.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A steady stream pours down the slope from the east, and another stream of nearly the same volume joins from the northeast.  The water sprays up into the air where the two streams collide, showering anything near with the emerald spray before continuing on its way westward through the dimly lit tunnel.  Near the bottom of the slope, the constant action of pouring water has eroded a deep hole, but the rest of the area seems to be covered by a uniform two feet of water.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The water rushes in from the east and is presented with a decision.  The tunnel forks.  One path leads northwest, and another leads southwest.  The water slams against the western wall, spraying and churning, then makes its decision and races off to the northwest, leaving the southwestern tunnel awash in an undisturbed pool of green water.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The water sits unmoving in this stretch of tunnel, its green glow muted by a layer of scum that has accumulated on the surface.  Apparently the water hasn't moved in a long time.  On the southern wall, the granite has been replaced by brickwork, as if someone had sealed off another tunnel.  Though aged, the brick and its surrounding mortar are still solid and unyielding.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The air is dry and stale, hanging heavily above the slimy surface of the water.  The heavy layer of scum reduces the projected light to a diffuse glow, and most of the walls and ceiling are not visible.  The scum clings to armor, boots, clothing, and most anything else it can contact.  Breathing is laborious at best due to the lack of air circulation.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The darkness closes in as the scum covering the water becomes heavier and heavier, compressed to the northwest by additions from the east.  On the north wall a skeleton hangs from a steel-like spike driven deep into the granite rock.  The force necessary to hammer a spike that deeply must have been tremendous, and the spike has not only been driven deeply into the rock but directly through one of the skeleton's vertebrae.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: This forgotten arm of the tunnels ends at a cave-in that totally blocks passage of water or creature.  Perhaps once a stream flowed through here, but now it is a dead-end, causing the water to stop, the scum to accumulate heavily, and the air to become nearly unbreathable due to the decomposing layer of slime on the water's surface.  Strange patches of light and shadow play off the walls as the scum layer is disturbed by the passage of wading adventurers.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A side tunnel basically extends nowhere here.  Perhaps it was slated to be a future aqueduct to another part of the city, or just to provide a well for something overhead that ended up not needing a well.  The reason is lost in history, and the unmoving, emerald water provides no clue.  The eastern wall has crumbled away, though, to reveal a high breach.  The sound of rapidly flowing water comes from the other side of the breach.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The only illumination in the constricted, foreboding tunnel comes from the water that courses from the north and empties out to the southwest.  The water itself is transparent, and everything on the bottom of the tunnel is completely visible.  The transparency, though, is tinged with an emerald glow, as if one is looking through green-colored lenses.  The glow is not at all powerful, and the illumination ends only a few feet up the wall, leaving the ceiling in total darkness.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: Thousands, perhaps hundreds of thousands of gossamer webs spread across the upper walls and ceiling of this portion of the tunnel.  The tiny webs collect the dampness and shine as a galaxy of faint green nebulae in the emerald light from the moving stream.  In each web a tiny spider holds sway, crouching at the center and ferociously guarding its territory.  It is impossible to determine what these spiders feed on, though, as no flying or crawling insect-life is evident.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A convergence of streams occurs, with a larger body of water rushing in from the southeast to collide with a smaller flow from the northeast.  The two flows intermix violently, buffeting each other and anything in their path, then seem to agree on a point of exit and move off peaceably to the west, less agitated but also considerably deeper than before.  Likewise, the air following the streams whistles and howls as it is forced to accommodate an additional volume in a more constricted space.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The stream flows steadily east to west, hemmed in by the tunnel walls on either side.  A shaft of light pierces the gloom overhead to illuminate the rounded sides of an old well.  No rope dangles down, probably long rotted away, and no bucket lies in the water on the floor, most likely rusted to nothing or carried away by the current.  Fresh air descends from the well, intermingling with the stuffier air in the tunnel to make it more breathable.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A foot or so above the stream's flow, small clumps of moss have taken hold on the granite sides of the tunnel.  Apparently the humidity provides enough water, and the airflow provides enough fresh air, for the moss to at least stay alive.  The moss that lives here, though, does not appear to be thriving, but rather, clinging to life.  It is also interesting to note that no moss grows anywhere near the flowing water.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The tunnel branches at this point, but the water all flows northwest.  To the south the tunnel abruptly ends at a pile of broken granite.  The collapse of the ceiling has totally sealed off travel in that direction and plugged the water's flow.  The sound of rushing water echoes down the tunnel from the northwest, and the water's flow picks up speed as it moves northwestward.  The northwestern tunnel also appears to be more brightly lit than the tunnel here or in the other directions.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The tunnel ends at a jagged, partially collapsed opening.  Moonlight streams in liberally through the upper part of the opening to illuminate the tunnel's walls and, wherever it strikes the water, seems to totally eliminate the green glow.  The water rushes out of the constricted opening with a loud roar, spraying as if under pressure and plunging down to intermingle with the river's waters just below.  The water tugs at you insistently, beckoning you to become one with the river as it soon will.

The tunnel ends at a jagged, partially collapsed opening.  Sunlight streams in liberally through the upper part of the opening to illuminate the tunnel's walls and, wherever it strikes the water, seems to totally eliminate the green glow.  The water rushes out of the constricted opening with a loud roar, spraying as if under pressure and plunging down to intermingle with the river's waters just below.  The water tugs at you insistently, beckoning you to become one with the river as it soon will.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: An intersection of sorts occurs in this widened stretch of the flowing stream.  Glowing emerald water flows in from the north, swirls a bit as the tunnel widens, and then speeds up slightly as the tunnel constricts and heads off to the south.  Another tunnel extends off to the west, but the water in it is placid and unmoving.  On the east wall, a large hole leads off into darkness.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A heavy layer of squishy silt has accumulated in this area of the tunnel, forced in by the continual lapping action of the stream just to the east.  The silt grasps at feet and legs, attempting to immobilize anything that has the audacity to try to pass through it, and it only seems to get thicker to the northwest. Although the emerald water covers the silt in this area, the thin layer casts very little light, making it difficult to see well more than a few yards in any direction.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: Only a stray bit of emerald light from the southeast intrudes upon the darkness of this silt-filled room.  The clay silt is wet and heavy, defying attempts to move through it or remove it, and it has piled high against the northwest wall.  The outline of the top of a door is just discernible through the gloom, but the volume of sucking, cloying silt keeps away any who would wish to examine it more closely.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: Green liquid oozes up from the floor to mingle with the water flowing through from the northeast.  As it disperses, it colors the water a light emerald green and imparts a glow to the stream that bathes the floor and walls with a dim luminescence.  Thus the tunnel to the northeast, sans liquid, is shrouded in darkness, while the tunnel to the south is eerily lit from below.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The sound of bubbling, flowing water is apparent in this chamber, but the source is not discernible in the darkness.  The walls on all sides are damp and cold to the touch, and the moving water is apparent around one's ankles and feet.  To the northeast the wall feels flat and smooth in comparison to the roughness and curvature of the other walls.  Perhaps at one time an opening existed but has now been sealed, yet the water has still found a way in.  One never knows for sure.

title: [Dry Ring Pool]
description: A raised island sits in the middle of a sunken granite ring, and a granite stairway rises from the center of the ring to a room above.  From the marks all along the sunken ring, it appears that people descended the stairway from above in order to draw water from a sunken ring pool.  Once-colorful frescoes, now faded and cracked, adorn the walls above the outside edge of the pool.

title: [Basilica, Lower Level]
description: This room appears to have been cut directly out of the dark grey granite from which the outer pyramid was composed.  The room forms a six-pointed star that is slightly rounded at the tips.  At the eastern point of the star a marble staircase spirals out of sight to the floor above you, while at the western point a stairway drops to the floor below.

title: [Basilica, East Apse]
description: This octagonal room appears to be some sort of council chamber, for centered within it is a large, circular table cut from red marble and surrounded by eight obsidian chairs.  The floor and walls, also of obsidian, are polished to a high sheen, and inlaid in the floor is a silver eight-pointed star.  A staircase, cut into the stone at the perimeter of the room, spirals out of sight to the floors above and below you.

title: [Basilica, Obsidian Sphere]
description: This room is spherical in shape, save for the smooth black floor underfoot.  The walls, floor and ceiling are composed of obsidian, and the effect is not unlike being trapped inside a giant black bubble.  Standing in the center of the room is an enormous obsidian stone, flat and thick at the top and spreading wider to its base, which appears to have melted and fused into the floor.  A staircase, cut into the stone at the perimeter of the room, spirals out of sight below you.

title: [Basilica, Central Nave]
description: A huge obsidian throne rests in the center of the long rectangular hallway.  The floor beneath the throne is tiled in polished red marble streaked with ebony black lines.  Shadowed anterooms can be seen behind the columns that flank both sides of the hallway and arches open off each end.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Basilica, North Anteroom]
description: Glossy black walls form a large half-circle flowing out from the high columns at the southern end of the room.  The walls extend up, far past the columns, supporting a vast, domed ceiling.  A bench carved from the same red marble as the floor hugs the perimeter of the room.

title: [Basilica, South Anteroom]
description: Glossy black walls form a large half-circle flowing out from the high columns at the northern end of the room.  The walls extend up, far past the columns, supporting a vast, domed ceiling.  A bench carved from the same red marble as the floor hugs the perimeter of the room.

title: [Basilica, Narthex]
description: This large, cubic room serves as the entryway into the building. Tiled entirely in black marble, it seems smaller than its actual size.  An open space leads back outside and a high arch leads east, further into the building.  Over the arch, carved into the dark marble, is a design formed of several geometrical shapes entwined together in a complicated, interlocking pattern.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East]
description: The road here is wide, bounded to the east by the height of the city wall, and to the west by a series of shattered towers.  The ruins of several long low buildings form dark mounds beneath the slender silhouettes of the towers.

The road here is wide, bounded to the east by the height of the city wall, and to the west by a series of shattered towers.  Several ruined barracks crouch in the slender shadows of the towers, like dogs cowering beneath a scolding finger.

title: [Execution Square]
description: The paving stones of this open plaza fit together so precisely that the entire area appears to be covered by one huge slab of granite.  No sign of cracking, pitting, dust or debris mars the hard surface.  Even the ubiquitous vines creeping up the walls that surround the plaza seem reluctant to cast their invasive branches across the polished pavement.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Entrance]
description: Two huge columns flank either side of a walkway that leads out past the city walls.  Each column is miraculously intact, but so badly tilted that they lean against each other in a precarious equilibrium, forming a triangular arch over the opening.  A road leading north and south runs past the opening, and a large square plaza extends out to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East]
description: The road jogs away from the city wall and runs along the muddy banks of a swiftly flowing river.  Vegetation creeps between the paving stones of the road, but comes to an abrupt halt at the edge of an open square to the west.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The path near the city wall is composed of chocolate-brown clay, cracked and chipped in places where it has dried after a season of heavy rains.  Extending out from the remains of the city gate, it wends its way up hills covered in bushes and a dense growth of deciduous trees, then drops from sight as it ducks behind a bend in the distance.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Tree-dotted hillsides rise on both sides of the path, providing ample cover for the wildlife living in the woods.  The road here is mostly flat as it meanders along the city plateau, although there is a slight incline to the north.  One especially large modwir tree lies fallen near the edge of the road, its roots helplessly exposed.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: A tall, regal oak stands watch here over a bend in the path where the beaten trail skirts around several large boulders. A circle of stones surrounds a small firepit near a low outcropping of rocks.  Apparently some weary traveler paused here for a moment of rest.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: A thick blanket of reeds and marshy vegetation meanders alongside the river bank.  A thin pathway stamped out among the reeds climbs over a small rise to the east.  The high-pitched chirp of a frog echoes from within a stand of cattails that waves mockingly from the edge of the darkened water.

A jagged stump as large around as a table sticks dangerously out of the ground at the edge of the path.  It looks as if an army of termites weakened the inner structure of the tree, leaving it prey to a storm that ripped the upper portion away from the stump.  Oddly enough, the trunk of the tree is nowhere to be seen.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, west

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Tall, moss-covered modwir rub shoulders with lush, green oak on the slopes bordering both sides of the road.  An occasional glimpse through the curtain of trees up the northern slope reveals a path paralleling a wide river.  To the west you can see a break in the trees where the trail turns to march down the hillside below.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The sound of burbling water echoes in darkness, whispery faint, muffled by the surrounding trees.  Deep shadows hug the trunks of the closest trees while night breezes sigh in the darkness beyond.  A glimmer of moonlight filters from the canopy above giving dim life to a few blades of grass scattered across the muddy earth.

The sound of burbling water echoes from the north, whispery faint, muffled by the surrounding trees.  The path is shaded by the trees and a chorus of birds trill from the branches overhead.  Filtered sunlight seeps through the canopy above giving dim life to a few blades of grass scattered across the muddy earth.

title: [East Woods, River Bank]
description: Tall patches of grass and an occasional clump of reeds grow here among the smooth stones of the riverbank.  A small game trail wends its way among the grasses, trailing from the lower ground to the west up a small incline running east.

title: [East Woods, River Bank]
description: The game trail widens, pressing against the heavy overgrowth of vegetation.  A thick cluster of trees to the south of the riverbank provides a canopy over the path.  The river gently laps against the bank in a rhythmic fashion, the sound blending smoothly with the chirping of tiny insects going about their nightly business.

The game trail widens, pressing against the heavy overgrowth of vegetation.  A thick cluster of trees to the south of the riverbank provides a canopy over the path.  The river gently laps against the bank in a rhythmic fashion, covering the bulrush growing at the edge with a moist gleam.

title: [East Woods, River Bank]
description: The rounded top of a beavers' lodge extends from the edge of the bank out into the muddy water of the river.  A few small bushes push up through the weave of tree branches, mud and marsh grass from which the structure was constructed.  The path all around the little dwelling is smooth and firmly packed, as if it too has been subjected to the ministrations of the industrious owner of the lodge.

title: [East Woods, River Bank]
description: The path here is soggy with the overflow of small rivulets of water from the undulating waves of the river.  Reeds, cattails and other water-loving plants encroach upon the narrow trail until it finally fades away and disappears to the west.  The only direction open for travel is back to the east.

title: [East Woods, River Bank]
description: A muddy brown river flows shallow and wide over a multitude of rounded stones.  The rippled water flows smoothly past the stones underfoot, adding its whispers to those of the winds blowing up the river canyon which stretches off to the east.  A wide path of hard-packed soil climbs its way uphill along the edge of the river.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [East Woods, River Bank]
description: A thick blanket of reeds and marshy vegetation meanders alongside the river bank.  A thin pathway stamped out among the reeds climbs over a small rise to the east.  The high-pitched chirp of a frog echoes from within a stand of cattails that waves mockingly from the edge of the darkened water.

A thick blanket of reeds and marshy vegetation meanders alongside the river bank.  A thin pathway stamped out among the reeds climbs over a small rise to the east.  The sounds of small creatures, apparently making their homes inside the safety of the reeds, fill the air.

title: [East Woods, River Bank]
description: Wet, algae-coated rocks rise at nearly perpendicular angles along both sides of the river.  Near the center of the water an occasional twig or leaf floats by, bobbing like a storm-tossed ship before being sucked down by a sudden whirlpool breaking the surface of the flow.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The sound of the river to the north is muted by the denseness of the surrounding trees.  A dark path, only discernable by virtue of the small white rocks that border it in a haphazard fashion, guides the way southward into the woods.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The stump of a modwir tree sits in the middle of the path, its decaying wood soft with decay and riddled with termites.  Other trees in the area show signs of gnawing by industrious creatures with sharp teeth, most likely the handiwork of beavers seeking lumber for their dams and dens.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Thick tangles of branches arch overhead as the oaks and modwir surrounding the path stretch their branches toward the sky.  The dank scent of ancient trees lingers in the air like a moment frozen in time.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The soft coo of birds comfortably nested in the branches overhead pervade the night.  Somewhere not far distant, a chorus of crickets chirp, harmonious accompaniment to the rustle of leaves blown by a sighing wind.

The twitter of birds going about their daily business fills the surrounding woods.  Speckled beams of sunlight dance past the branches overhead and touch the blossoms and herbs growing on the forest floor like a bright benediction.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The underbrush is quite thick at the edges of the trail.  Dim moonlight filters down through the leafy boughs above, picking out a small shadowed path that maneuvers its way around the trunks of the trees like a dusty serpent slithering through a maze.

The underbrush is quite thick at the edges of the trail.  Speckled motes of sunlight dance down through the leafy boughs above.  A small path maneuvers its way around the trunks of the trees like a dusty serpent slithering through a maze.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Thickly interwoven branches of oak and maple cast deep night shadows in this portion of the woods. Faint trails seem to cut through the heavy undergrowth of vines and brambles at the foot of the trees, but most appear to dwindle away to nonexistence after a few feet of travel.

Thickly interwoven branches of oak and maple block the sunlight in this portion of the woods.  Faint trails seem to cut through the heavy undergrowth of vines and brambles at the foot of the trees, but most appear to dwindle away to nonexistence after a few feet of travel.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: A gnarled oak tree grows at an odd angle up the sloping rise to the north, bent so far over that a portion of its weight is supported by a sturdy branch, like an old man propped up on one elbow.  The narrow trail twists off to the southwest.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The long slope rising to the north is marred by a deep rut leading to the ragged end of a fallen oak tree.  The branches of the tree have tangled with the surrounding bushes preventing it from sliding any further down the incline.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The path rises up an incline, slipping between two massive granite rocks that guard the way in sullen silence.  Bushes encircle each hulking grey stone like shield men crouched protectively around the feet of their captain.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The trees and undergrowth are so thick that little can be seen beyond the faint path that weaves its way through the woods.  Ivy has grown up and between the larger trees, forming a living veil that further conceals the landscape beyond the trail.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Bramble bushes compete with delicate ferns for light and space between the trees.  The trail splits around a particularly thick stand of bushes to the south and continues up a small incline to the northeast.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: A large patch of shriveled vegetation is encircled by a guard of blackened tree trunks.  The tallest of the trees has been split in two by the lightning bolt that scarred its neighbors.  Half the trunk remains standing while the other half rests, twisted and rotting, in a cradle of burned out undergrowth.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: What appears to be a tangled mass of ivy thrown into a heap on the forest floor is actually the rotting trunk of a fallen tree buried beneath the opportunistic vines.  The trail seems to disappear beneath the hapless tree, but further inspection reveals that the path splits around it, moving off in two different directions.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The path beneath the trees is soft with mud and moss.  Deep foot and hoof prints mark the passage of both people and animals that have traveled through the woods.  Something has dug a hole in the ground near one of the trees, piling earth and leaves along the edge of a curved root in a high mound that brings to mind a rampart surrounding a castle.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: A dense growth of high thorny bushes chokes even the roots of the sturdy young oak trees struggling to grow in this spot.  Travel in any direction except back up the trail to the northeast would be difficult and not likely worth the effort.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: The trees line both sides of the path, arching together to form a leafy green canopy overhead.  Moss and ferns, sheltered from the full strength of the sun, carpet the area beneath the trees.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Roots snake across the path in a every direction, a tangled net eager to trap the feet of any passer-by. The hulking shadow of a root bound boulder sits brooding by the side of a fork in the path.  Small fireflies flitting over its crenellated crown give it the look of a small granite fortress guarded by fairies.

A large patch of shriveled vegetation is encircled by a guard of blackened tree trunks.  The tallest of the trees has been split in two by the lightning bolt that scarred its neighbors.  Half the trunk remains standing while the other half rests, twisted and rotting, in a cradle of burned out undergrowth.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Tiny mushrooms show as a lighter splotch against the darkened roots of the trees.  The smell of decaying leaves and moist earth wafts in on a vagrant breeze slinking out from the depths of the wooded shadows surrounding the path.

Pale blades of grass struggle to find light beneath the leafy canopy spreading over the path.  The smell of decaying leaves and moist earth wafts in on a vagrant breeze slinking out from the depths of the wooded shadows surrounding the path.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: To the east a series of wide stone steps lead up the side of a pyramid.  A palatial building awaits at the top of the stairs, towering above the ruins of the surrounding city.  In the river to the west, partially submerged in the water, can be seen a carved obsidian statue fashioned in the image of a massive warrior.  The tip of a thick obsidian spear rests among the bulrush growing along the edge of the river bank.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Colossus Arm]
description: Widely ridged trenches form the draped folds of the sleeve that covers the arm of the colossus up to the elbow.  The arm stretches out, slightly above the head of the gargantuan warrior, coming to an end at a mighty stone hand.  The fingers of the hand are wrapped in a tight grip around the width of a spear that runs along the length of the statues' body and out over the water.  The very tip of the spear rests on the eastern bank of the river.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Colossus Torso]
description: An intricate pattern of crisscrossed lines form the lacing of the vest that was carved into being about the torso of the colossus.  The statue is tilted slightly on its side, so one arm reaches down into the depths of the river water, while the other extends toward the east.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Colossus Hip]
description: One leg of the colossus is immersed in the river and hidden from view by the muddy brown water.  The river churns along the length of stone that still remains above its surface, forming frothing whirlpools in the carved nooks and crannies of the statue, and grumbling mightily at its inability to engulf the rest of the mighty warrior within its depths.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Colossus Leg]
description: Higher ripples of the river wash across the calf and thigh of the colossus, making passage across the statue a precarious undertaking.  The stone leg ends in a booted foot that rests on the western bank of the river.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Glory Road]
description: Two wide stone platforms, tilted and crumbled, flank the sides of the road.  A huge, obsidian colossus, fashioned in the likeness of a mighty warrior, has toppled from its perch upon the platforms.  It now lies stretched, like an enemy slain in battle, across the river to the east.  One booted obsidian foot touches the bank of the river, heel firmly lodged in a stand of cattails growing at the water's edge.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: Smashed white marble structures, that must have been impressive homes in the golden days of Ta'Faendryl, clutter up the paths that run through the city.  A fallen statue, reduced to a mere torso and legs, lies half buried in the soil at the side of the road.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: Jumbled piles of cracked stone and slumping arches leading into emptiness line both sides of the street.  The sound of water to the south explains the spongy feel of the ground underfoot, and the thick moss that creeps like stealthy green fingers over the shattered bones of ancient Elven homes.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: A stone-lined aqueduct allows passage of a river through the wall of the city.  Creeping vines travel down the length of the wall and hang like a thick green curtain over the water.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Glory Road]
description: A stone lion lies on its side at the edge of the road, toppled by the sinking of the pavement into a quagmire of mud that extends along the southern border of the path.  Identical statues, still standing, flank both edges of the road leading west.  Each leonine head is focused eternally forward, visage wrinkled in a fearsome snarl, oblivious to the unfortunate fate of their fallen companion.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Glory Road]
description: Tenacious blades of grass skulk within the cracks between the broken pavement of the road.  Stealthy stems and rhizomes creep silently across the massive paws of the marble lions positioned on each side of the road, twisting and intertwining to bind the stone-faced creatures ever more firmly to the path.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Glory Road]
description: Two huge marble lions crouch on either side of the road, baleful gazes focused to the east where additional representations of their kind form an honor guard along a line of cracked marble pavement.  To the west a pylon formed by a pair of truncated pyramids opens out onto the surrounding forest.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Glory Gate]
description: A cracked and weathered pylon marks the entrance into the ancient city.  The massive stone lintel is fashioned in the image of an eagle.  Though stained and worn by wind and weather, the regal bird still beckons all to pass beneath its outspread wings.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: A block wall towers up over the path, higher by far than the tops of the trees that press up against its base like cattle seeking shelter from a storm.  A wide gap in the wall leads east into the ruins of an ancient city.

title: [West Woods, River Edge]
description: The long trail runs east to west, parallel to a wide, muddy river.  Water runs past the trail, muddy and fast, with occasional white-capped waves brushing over submerged stones.

title: [West Woods, River Edge]
description: This long trail runs east to west, parallel to a wide, muddy river. Water runs past you, clear and fast, with occasional white-capped waves brushing over submerged stones.

title: [West Woods, River Edge]
description: The overgrowth grows very thick, reeds and other plant life crowding the edge of the river in chaotic confusion, forcing the trail to turn northwest toward the woods.  The abandoned nest of a water bird, little more than concave bundle of twigs and grass, lays nestled within a particularly thick cluster of bulrush.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The bark of several trees along the path has split and cracked, revealing the smoother wood inside.  Burnt to the color of charcoal, the splits have healed to long black scars, evidence of a long ago fire that once raced through this portion of the woods.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The crumbling remains of a hollowed out tree lays splayed out across the trail.  Red lichen, white mushrooms and velvet green moss create a subtle blending of color along the length of the trunk, nature's colors splayed over a canvas of wood.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Visibility along the path becomes is challenging beneath the ancient overgrowth of the woods.  Massive trees seem weighted down by the aged and gnarled branches that reach out from their trunks like huge outstretched arms grasping at the blanket of leaves overhead.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The woods form the walls of a natural maze, confusing direction and senses.  Soft green moss covers most of the trees and extends across the trail.  The overhead cover is fairly thick, stunting the growth of normal plants down on the ground.  Clear openings lie to the north and south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The overgrown foliage is so dense in this part of the woods that the trail becomes extremely hard to follow.  Trees seem to grow one atop another in their struggle to reach upwards and into the light.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Ponderous modwir extend limbs as thick as a man's torso across the path, making passage beneath the trees which show signs of age or sickness a somewhat chancy occupation. The trail winds restlessly around huge tree trunks, stretching further into the dark woods.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Thick-trunked trees stand too closely together in this part of the woods, branches tangling like the arms of wrestlers administering a choking hold.  One tree is indistinguishable from another, one patch of overgrowth appears to be a replica of what was passed a few moments ago.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The trail is thin and weak, barely holding its own against the encroaching vegetation around it.  Inch by inch, the trail has slowly relinquished the small portions of the woods that it had managed to claim for its own.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The path fades away to nothing amongst a thick stand of oak and brambles.  Protected on all side by ground sweeping breezes, the forest floor is covered with a thick layer of leaves.  The cloyingly sweetish smell of rotting organic matter lingers in the air.

The path fades away to nothing amongst a thick stand of oak and brambles.  Constantly shaded from the drying effects of the sun, the ground around the trees is moist and covered with a thick layer of leaves.  The sweetish smell of rotting organic matter lingers in the air.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Tiny wood violets poke shy purple faces up between the roots of an ancient oak.   Gnarled and bent, the tree supports a thick growth of moss that hangs from its branches like the untrimmed hairs of an old man's beard.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: A hole dug beneath the root of a lofty modwir reveals the dwelling place of some small creature who, given the evidence of broken shells scattered at the base of the tree, has a great fondness for acorns.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The path meanders into a small grassy clearing in the trees that is totally surrounded by trees and a thick growth of prickly brambles.  The stars twinkle down on the tiny meadow and the dim light of the moons picks out a fairy ring of mushrooms poking up through the grass.

The path meanders into a small grassy clearing in the trees that is totally surrounded by trees and a thick growth of prickly brambles.  A ray of light descends from the sky and into the center of the tiny meadow, illuminating the broken stump of a modwir tree, where the steady sound of humming indicates the presence of a busy hive of bees.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Beneath the branches of an oak tree, a little pool of water has collected in a basin formed by a tangle of rock and roots.  A dusting of yellow pollen and fragments of dried, crumpled leaves float on the oily surface of the pool and thick growths of mushrooms sprout around its edge.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Faint footprints have beaten the grasses here, leaving a faint trail to the southeast where a small clearing is visible.  An opening in the trees allows passage to the north, leading off into the depths of the woods.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The natural canopy parts in this small clearing, just wide enough to see a sprinkling of stars in the sky above.  A plume of smoke, faintly illuminated by the fire that gave it birth, rises from the chimney of a tiny stone cottage that rests within a high wall at the edge of the clearing.

The natural canopy parts in this small clearing, just wide enough to see the sky above.  The faint smell of wood smoke lingers in the air, mingling pleasantly with the light fragrance of grass and wildflowers rising up from the earth.  At the edge of the clearing, surrounded on three sides by a high wall, is a tiny stone cottage.

title: [West Woods, Tiny Cottage]
description: The stringent smell of crushed herbs pervades the front room of the cottage.  Shelves positioned above a large, well-scrubbed pine table hold a neat assortment of jars and bottles that seem to be the source of the smell.  Unglazed windows are shut tightly against the coolness of the night air and a crackling fire from the hearth in the corner of the room paints long shadows up the cottage walls.  A wide arch opens into the back of the cottage and a door leads out to the woods.

The stringent smell of crushed herbs pervades the front room of the cottage.  Shelves positioned above a large, well-scrubbed pine table hold a neat assortment of jars and bottles that seem to be the source of the smell.  Dozens of wicker baskets hang from the ceiling, along with bunches of drying flowers.  Unglazed windows have their shutters opened to let in the daytime breezes.  A wide arch opens into the back of the cottage and a door leads out to the woods.

title: [Tiny Cottage, Kitchen]
description: Herbs planted in clay pots grow in a pungent tangle on a wide window ledge in this little cottage kitchen.  Beneath the window are a deep wooden washtub and a rack holding several strips of clean linen cloth.  A long plank table and several four-legged stools are positioned in the center of the kitchen and a heavy oak door leads to an outside garden.

Herbs planted in clay pots grow in a pungent tangle on a wide window ledge in this little cottage kitchen.  Beneath the window are a deep wooden washtub and a rack holding several strips of clean linen cloth.   A long plank table and several four-legged stools are positioned in the center of the kitchen and a heavy oak door leads to an outside garden.

title: [Tiny Cottage, Back Garden]
description: This well tended garden in the back of the tiny cottage seems to specialize in herbs both medicinal and culinary.  Red clay paving stones provide a way to navigate through the garden without crushing any of the carefully nurtured plants and a high stone wall protects the plants from marauding intruders from the surrounding woods.  A heavy oak door provides entrance into the cottage and a brick-lined footpath circles around the building to the east and the west.

title: [Tiny Cottage, Back Garden]
description: A windswept fall of leaves creates a soft cushion over the brick path that winds its way through the high supple grass growing in this open corner of the garden.
