An apple tree crowds up against the furthest wall, its leafy branches spreading up and out over the stacked-stone wall that separates the garden from the surrounding woods. Through the screen of branches can be seen a darkened niche set back into the furthest corner of the wall.

A windswept fall of leaves creates a soft cushion over the brick path that winds its way through the high supple grass growing in this sunny corner of the garden.  An apple tree crowds up against the furthest wall, its leafy branches spreading up and out over the stacked-stone wall that separates the garden from the surrounding woods.  Through the screen of branches can be seen a tiny niche set back into the furthest corner of the wall.

title: [Cottage Garden, Niche]
description: This small niche set into the wall at the furthest corner of the garden is neatly swept and obviously well tended.  A mosaic pattern of flagstones surrounds a low granite altar placed in the center of the niche.  Overhead, a white wooden trellis supports the trailing stems of a lush blossoming rose vine.

title: [Cottage Garden, Brick Path]
description: The narrow brick path winds lazily through a fragrant patch of pastel-colored wildflowers.  Sprigs of grass push between the crumbled mortar of the path, giving it a somewhat overgrown appearance.  The path ends at a small stone barn that extends out from the corner of the high stone wall that surrounds the cottage to the west.

title: [Cottage Garden, Stone Building]
description: Clean wood shavings cover the floor of this one room building and several mounds of dried grass line the back wall.   The cozy scent of oak, modwir and grass wars with a faint underlying smell of goat.  An oak bucket rests next to a milking stool in one corner of the room and a watering trough and feed bin in the other.

title: [Stone Building, Attic Loft]
description: Piles of straw and dried grass completely cover the floor of the upper story of the stone building.  The exposed wooden beams and slanted roof of the barn form a low ceiling overhead.  A ladder descends down to the floor below.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: A lone apple tree sits by the edge of the path, looking quite out of place amongst the oak and modwir that surround it on every side, like a family hound plopped unexpectedly in the center of a pack of wolves.  The path twists back to the southeast, toward a huge wall of stone and ivy.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Skirting the edge of a particularly dense tract of wood, the beaten footpath runs from the south to the northwest.  On each side of the path, gaps in the tree line reveal nothing but dark, murky shadows.

Skirting the edge of a particularly dense tract of wood, the beaten footpath runs from the south to the northwest.  On each side of the path, gaps in the tree line reveal little but brambles and the trunks of more trees.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The canopy over this parcel of wood is thick enough to block out all light, trapping the ground beneath the trees in dark, murky shadows.  A grayish break in the blackness can be seen through openings in the thickets to the north and the southeast.

The canopy over this parcel of wood is thick enough to block out all light, trapping the ground beneath the trees in deep, cool shadows.  Faint light streams in through openings in the thickets to the north and the southeast.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The velvet dark shadows of the trees seem to converge and tremble as the path winds through and around them.  The brush bristles with tell-tale signs of life, chirping insects singing a night song from the leaf-littered woods floor.

The light-dappled shadows of the trees seem to converge and tremble as the path winds through and around them.  The woods bristle with tell-tale signs of life, chirping birds singing throatily from the leafy canopy overhead.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The depths of the thick, overgrown woods embrace the path like the folds of a thick, green tapestry.  It is possible to push through the foliage to the north or southeast, but it is impossible to see what lies in either direction.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Trees curl around each other in a tangle of limbs and branches that gives the appearance of a troop of performers frozen in time in the midst of a frenzied dance.  One especially huge tree dominates the pathway, forcing it to swerve northeast, around the massive trunk.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: Rocks as sharp as fangs break through the surface of the earth as the trail climbs toward a low line of foothills to the north.  The path to the southwest leads into a deeper portion of the woods.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: A shallow ditch, worn into the ground by water draining down the side of the hill, allows passage through the brambles that have taken over this rocky slope.  A few oak trees speckle the sides of the path, mingling with stunted pines that have managed to find purchase in the thin soil.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West Woods]
description: The ground slopes steeply, up the side of a hill that is littered with ragged chunks of granite.  The path ends abruptly in a deep rut that is thronged by thick brambles.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, West]
description: The road rises on a long slope up a hill to the north and northwest, and meanders southeast toward the banks of a swiftly moving river.  At the top of the hill can be seen the dark silhouette of a short, squat tower topped with a domed roof.

The road rises on a long slope up a hill to the north and northwest, and meanders southeast toward the banks of a swiftly moving river.  At the top of the hill rests a short squat tower topped with a white quartz dome that sparkles faintly in the sun.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Foothill]
description: Disordered piles of huge granite blocks lie strewn down the side of the hill, making navigation below the tower challenging at best.  The western side of the hill drops down into a sheer granite cliff that butts directly up against the city wall.  A narrow path along the edge of the hill leads to the north and back eastward toward the center of the city.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Foothill]
description: Gnarled trees jutting from the side of the hill spread a canopy of branches above the narrow path that leads between the city wall and the side of the hill.  Opportunistic vines dangling from the heights of the western wall weave their way across the leafy bridge of limbs and branches, forming a dark tunnel of damp vegetation.

Gnarled trees jutting up from the ground spread a canopy of branches above the narrow path that leads between the city wall and the side of the hill.  Opportunistic vines dangling from the heights of the western wall weave their way across the leafy bridge of limbs and branches, forming an impenetrable tunnel of green.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Foothill]
description: The entire northern side of the hill has slumped like the shoulders of a tired warrior giving up the battle, tumbling the structures that once rested upon this lofty perch into the shallow valley below.  A narrow path continues along the edge of the hill, leading east and southwest.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Foothill]
description: Perched atop the foothill is a squat granite tower topped with a white quartz dome.  The rounded roof of the edifice is shattered along the northern side, like a soft-boiled egg tapped open by a teaspoon.  A narrow path leads down the hill through the scattered ruins of the city, while a wider walk circles around a rise to the south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Foothill]
description: A flight of cracked stone steps lead up the final slope of the hill, ending at the base of a large tower.  A faint breeze brings the sound of running water up from the river flowing past the base of the hill to the east.

A flight of cracked stone steps lead up the final slope of the hill, ending at the base of a large tower.  A faint breeze brings the sound of running water up from the river flowing past the base of the hill to the east.  Further on a pyramid, as tall as the hill and nearly as wide, lifts a sparkling white marble structure high above the city.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Observatory]
description: A grey tower thrusts itself up from the pinnacle of the hill like a finger pointing toward the stars.  Each block of granite making up the wall of the tower is carved with varying sizes of eight-pointed stars. Etched into the keystone of the arched entrance leading into the tower is the rounded orb of a full moon.  A flight of broken stone steps leads back down the side of the hill.

A grey tower thrusts itself up from the pinnacle of the hill like a finger pointing toward the sun.  Each block of granite making up the wall of the tower is carved with varying sizes of eight-pointed stars. Etched into the keystone of the arched entrance leading into the tower is a multi-rayed representation of the sky.  A flight of broken stone steps leads back down the side of the hill.

title: [Observatory Entrance]
description: The interior walls of the tower are composed of the same roughly hewn granite blocks as the exterior of the structure.  A star chart, partially obscured by dust and debris blown in from the outside, has been carved across the polished marble floor.  Stone steps circle around the perimeter of the circular room, one flight leading up and a second flight descending to the floor below.

title: [Observatory, Upper Level]
description: A domed ceiling rests upon the high block walls of this room.  A slotted opening cut into the ceiling has cracked along its edges and no longer retains its original shape and size.  Large chunks of the marble forming the dome have dropped from the heights to shatter on the hard stone floor below.  A series of steps circling the perimeter of the room descend to the main level of the tower.

title: [Observatory, Lower Level]
description: Stone steps descending from the floor above continue to circle around the perimeter of this basement room, dropping down out of sight to another level below.  The air here is musty, smelling of damp earth and rock dust.  Smoke blackened marks on the stone walls indicate where torches must have once burned in this subterranean room.

title: [Forgotten Pool]
description: A spacious circular room chiseled directly out of the granite rock bed surrounds what may once have been a shallow pool.  The sides of the pool slope slowly down to the center of the room where they suddenly plunge into a dark hole perhaps six feet wide.  Circular stairs, cut into the walls of the room, rise to the Observatory above, following faded pictures inked into the granite.  A musty odor pervades the area, and there is a noticeable lack of air circulation.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A layer of water only a foot deep covers the floor of what once was an aqueduct for the city above.  A tunnel runs off in six directions from this point to carry the water to the thirsty residents.  A hole leads upward, and a small amount of light filters down from the hole.  The main illumination, however, is provided by a light green glow from the water underneath.  The air is still and cool, and sounds echo easily off the cramped walls.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The tunnel abruptly ends as the ceiling has caved in, filling the tunnel with rubble and blocking any further movement.  A low moaning fills the area every so often, its source seemingly somewhere past the blockage.  It is not apparent, though, whether the moaning is produced by something alive or just the wind moving intermittently through a passage.  In any case, the only exit direction is to the southeast.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The tunnel moves off to the southwest, the shallow, green water casting an uneven emerald glow on the walls as the water's peace is disturbed by sloshing feet.  Solid granite walls prevent movement in all other directions.  A pile of rubble in the center of the tunnel indicates that there may once have been a hole above to allow water to be drawn from the aqueduct.  It is too dark, though, to see if such a hole exists anymore.  Strangely out of place, a misshapen panel is set into the northeast wall.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The tunnel ends here with the only exit to the east.  The north and south sides of the tunnel, though roughly cut, are vertical and flat, and they curve around to meet at the west, blocking further travel in that direction.  It looks as if the miners intended the tunnel to stop at this point and left it for possible expansion at a later time.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The greenish glow from the cool water flickers eerily off the rough granite wall.  Perhaps the miners had difficulty removing the rock from this section, for the tunnel narrows to only a few feet across, and the ceiling drops dangerously low.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A metal grate bars exit from the tunnel to the east, leaving the only means of egress to the west.  The grate is firmly set in the surrounding rock, as if someone had managed to open the rock up, slide the grate in on all sides, and then close the rock again.  On the other side of the grate, the river moves slowly past, and the height of the river allows a foot of water or so to filter into the aqueduct.  The water in the aqueduct simply pools, though, without movement or current of any kind.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: White, horizontal lines left by retreating water levels line the walls of the tunnel.  Some lines are thicker than others, indicating that the water level held constant at that depth for a longer period.  Others have a bit of coloration to them, perhaps indicative of certain minerals carried in by the water.  The lines exist on the wall almost all the way down to the current water level, and one can surmise that, currently, the water is at the highest point it has been for a long time.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A side tunnel heads east off the north/south aqueduct.  The area is unnervingly quiet.  The only sounds are those produced by the lapping of the water against the tunnel sides and those produced by interlopers from outside.  Even the lapping, though, is an unnatural consequence of the invasion by those who do not belong here.  The area was totally quiet before the intruders arrived, and it will become totally quiet again once they leave.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The tunnel ends, the wall turning into a rounded corner to the south.  Just above, a tight hole leads up into the darkness.  The hole barely looks big enough for a dwarf to slide down through, and there is no way that anyone, dwarf or larger, could climb up through the hole.  Low whistling sounds emanate from the hole, as if somewhere far above the wind is blowing across the opening.  Bits of broken stoneware litter the floor of the tunnel just underneath the hole.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The aqueduct proceeds due east and west.  Rough-hewn, the sides of the aqueduct maintain their distance fairly evenly, although the ceiling appears to vary in height from place to place.  The floor is mostly level, with the odd rock here and there making for interesting footing.  The water's flickering green glow makes the light and shadows dance on the walls.  The rolling light effect makes the walls appear first to close in ominously, then retreat once again.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The ceiling tapers upward from the sides to the middle until the center is lost in blackness.  The floor is slippery, and leaves seem to have mixed with the sediment to make the entire area one slimy, blackish mess.  The odor of decay lingers in the tunnel as the decomposing leaves produce a slight amount of methane.  A few insects seem to be mixed in with the leaves under the water, but none of these insects are alive.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: Passage to the east is blocked by tons of fallen granite.  The rubble has cascaded down from above to choke the tunnel and render it totally impassable.  The water seeps in underneath the rubble, leaving a sickly green discoloration on the lower pieces.  The collapse must have happened long ago, though, for even the upper portion of the pile displays no dust.  The finer particles must have been carried down to the floor long ago by the gentle rising and falling of the water level.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The walls of the tunnel are dry above the water even with the constant presence of a foot of water at the bottom.  The air, likewise, is dry, and the water is rather cold.  The greenish cast emanating from the liquid does nothing to warm the area but only serves to illuminate the walls and ceiling with a cold emerald light.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: It looks as though at one time the tunnel branched off to the west.  Now the tunnel in that direction is filled with rubble that spills out into the north/south aqueduct.  The rubble litters the usually smooth floor of the tunnel, making the footing even more unsure than it already is in the strange lighting conditions.  Overhead, a large crack perhaps two inches wide snakes out of the cave-in and across the ceiling, hinting at more instability above.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: On the outside of this bend in the aqueduct, a skeleton sits in the cold water and reclines against the granite wall.  Not a bit of flesh remains on the skeleton's frame.  The skeleton's upper legs, partially buried in the thin layer of sediment on the tunnel's bottom, both appear to be broken, and the skull has been smashed in on one side as if from the blow of some blunt instrument.  How long the skeleton has been here is anyone's guess.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: The aqueduct makes a very short turn to the south and stops dead against a flat granite wall.  Several lines of numbers have been etched into the wall, and a crude arrow has been drawn that points to the upper right corner of the tunnel.  Small cracks crisscross the wall, and liquid weeps out of the cracks, sliding down the wall and leaving a trail of green minerals in its wake.  Aside from the deposits left by the liquid, the wall is very clean.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: Branches from the trees growing at street level reach across the raised platform of a plaza and drip leaves along its surface.  Twigs, leaves and bits of bark have piled up against the southern face of the pyramid at the center of the plaza.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A multi-stemmed vine has worked its way up the side of the platform and across the plaza in wide semi-circular spray.  Tiny curved thorns along the length of each supple stem cling like cat's claws to minute irregularities in the surface of the pavement.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A statue of a woman, carved out of beige-colored marble, towers over the southeast corner of the plaza.  Clothed in flowing robes that sweep down around her feet and over the pedestal on which she stands, the woman presents a regal appearance that is only slightly marred by the fact that she no longer possesses a right arm or the fingers of her left hand.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A wide aisle runs between the pyramid and tiers of stone benches arranged in an oval pattern around an open space to the east.  Here and there, a small sapling has broken through the paved surface between the benches, like potted plants perched on a sitting room shelf.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the east.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A pile of granite blocks rises to the north.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the east.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]
description: The long woody branches of a vine creep up the southern wall of the amphitheatre then descend across the tiered benches toward the ground below in a thick curtain of green.  A thick, sweet fragrance rises from the tubular orange blossoms clustered along the stems of the vine.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]
description: Moisture has washed out portions of the substrate beneath the retaining wall of the amphitheatre, dotting the upper platform with potholes.  Dark stains caused by leached out minerals carried by streams of rain water ripple down over the cracked benches that slump in uneven rows toward the ground below.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]
description: Broken stone slabs sliding down a steep incline is all that remains of the tiered benches that once ran along the eastern side of a wide field.  A narrow platform along the edge of a retaining wall leads to the northwest and south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]
description: A narrow path formed by the remains of a long stone bench picks its way between haphazard piles of crumbling granite blocks.  It would be possible, by climbing over the fallen stone, to descend to the grassy area to the south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A series of stone benches circles out and around a large oval space to the east.  A section of the tiered seats is toppled over at the northern end of the oval, breaking the perfect symmetry of the structure and forming a wall along the edge of the river.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A huge pedestal of gold-veined blue marble rests at the northeast corner of the plaza.  A pair of heroic legs stretches up toward the sky but come to an abrupt halt at the point where a mighty hand rests on an equally massive hip.  All features above the waist of the statue have sheared off, as if sliced by a mighty sickle.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: Rising swells carry small bits of flotsam along the surface of the lake.  Deeper in the water a moderately strong undertow flows in a southwesterly direction, bending stalks of tall lake grass into humble submission, like rows of courtiers bowing before the might of the massive pyramid to the south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: Large chunks of the marble slab pavement have broken off along the edge of the plaza and plummeted into the depths of the lake below.  The broken edges reveal the solid granite base on which the pyramid rests, mute testimony to the skills of the engineers who leveled the top of what must have once been a substantial hill of stone.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A huge pedestal of pinkish-white marble rests at the northwest corner of the plaza.  Whatever image once rested upon this pedestal is now gone, perhaps sunk in the depths of the lake to the north of the pyramid.  All that remains is a portion of one elfish foot, broken off at the arch, leaving behind only a few surprisingly feminine-looking toes.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A tower rises up in the center of the city.  Perched atop its massive height is an octogonal shaped building.  Wide stone steps lead up the side of the pyramid.

A tower in the form of a terraced pyramid of successively receding stories rises up in the center of the city.  Perched atop its massive height is an octogonal shaped building constructed of gleaming white marble.  Wide stone steps lead up the side of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, First Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the west of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

Positioned above all the single story buildings of the city, it is possible to see the damage that time has wrought.  Several blocks to the northwest a tall, dark tower pokes its tip above the cracked and crumbling walls of the surrounding structures.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, First Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the southeast of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps leads further up the sides of this pyramid.

Positioned above all the single story buildings of the city, it is possible to see the damage that time has wrought.  Several blocks to the southeast can be seen a long roofless building.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second story of the pyramid.

description: The short jagged edges of a row of broken towers thrust skyward, like a line of upraised swords, along the edge of the path.  Running between each tower is a ragged line of dirt and stone, the last remnants of a low wall that once enclosed a large open square to the north.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Alley]
description: The path weaves between high piles of baked bricks, dirt and windblown debris.  Towering walls rise on either side of the path, looming darkly above the remains of what may have once been small residential buildings lining this narrow alley.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, River Bank]
description: Little remains of the retaining wall that once held back the lapping currents of the river. title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, River Edge]

title: [Old Ta' Faendryl, Foothill Base]
description: A narrow path leads up the side of a steep foothill to the south and winds down into a wide, shallow valley to the west. title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, North Valley]
description: Massive blocks of granite, toppled columns and shattered statues lie strewn about the landscape like the contents of a child's toy box emptied in a fit of temper.  Scattered down the side of the foothill to the south is a similar assortment of debris, remnants of the structures that once graced its terraced slopes.  A single tower remains at the top of the hill, a noticeably battered survivor of the city's battle with time.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, North Valley]
description: A massive oak tree grows across the rock-strewn path, branches spreading out in regal glory in all directions, acorns dispersed in profuse abundance about its base. title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, North Valley]
description: The sheer stone face of the foothill butts up against the exterior wall of the city.  Whatever narrow space once existed between wall and cliff has filled up with the detritus of countless years, now packed into tight seal of dirt and vegetation.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, North Valley]
description: Trees sprout through cracked foundations, lifting and tumbling walls with their gnarled roots and expanding limbs -- belligerent invaders claiming squatter's rights in the abandoned ruins.  Drifts of leaves, piled deep through the passage of countless years, cram the cracks and crannies of the broken walls.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Northwest]
description: A sunken spot beneath a cluster of apple trees has collected a considerable amount of moisture, turning the ground soft and wet.  Cricket chirps rise from the thick moss growing along the base of the tree roots.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, North Valley]
description: The low ridge of ancient stonework meets up with the higher exterior wall of the city. title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, North Valley]
description: A stone arm, pale and perfect, stretches up from a tangle of roots at the base of an apple tree growing near the edge of the path. The hand and fingers of the arm, in an ironic twist of fate, close tightly over an apple-shaped lump of rosy pink quartz.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Treetop]
description: A canopy of leaves blocking out most of the view of the sky and the ground below gives this treetop perch a feeling of privacy. title: [The Rift]
description: The path is flanked on both sides by black water, thick and sluggish with salt.  A tiny boat is beached on the shore, but the waves and tide still reach beyond its bow.  As the waves break around it, the dinghy rocks slightly and shifts in the swirling, bubbling sand.  Two people relax in the boat, a young man and woman, talking and laughing. While they sit, however, the boat lurches sickeningly and begins to take on water.  They look sad, and stare into each other's eyes as the sea claims them.

As you watch them, they morph into various shapes and sizes, speaking amongst themselves in some deep, flowing tongue.

title: [The Rift]
description: A cold, grey mist swirls around you, making it difficult to gain any sense of what is here. description: Chains creak and strain under the load they are holding in the center of this stone-walled room. The chains glow slightly in the dim light, throwing unusual shadows on the walls while keeping the mass from growing too much.

By the advanced stages of decay, you estimate that the happy couple has been dead for several hundred years.

title: [The Rift]
description: A woman stands at the head of the huge cavern.  The right half of her is perhaps the most beautiful woman you have seen.  Her skin is the color of milk, and blonde hair streams down over one feathered wing.  The other half of her body is the opposite.  The skin is rough, with matted hair tangled with a wing like leather.  In her right hand she holds a staff of light, with which she gestures towards a field of surpassing beauty.  Her left bears a scythe, pointing towards a pit of angry flames.

title: [The Rift]
description: A sphere of delicate glass encases you, moving as you do.  Outside the sphere sits the wide, starry universe.  Stars and galaxies stretch before you, spinning in the deep silence of space.  At the edge of your vision, something nags.  Looking, you see a dark shadow passing over the stars, the worlds, creeping and devouring all it touches.  It does not seem to have intentions of stopping, and far too rapidly for comfort, it will overtake all of the glittering motes of space before you.

title: [The Rift]

title: [The Rift]
description: Headstones of grey marble seem to grow from the ground, placed in neat rows.  A pall of silence hangs over the graveyard, and not even a breath of wind disturbs the serenity.  Set slightly apart from the rest of the graves is a large black tomb.  Carved upon the face of the stone, in the place reserved for the identity of the departed, is the name "Elanthia."

title: [The Rift]
description: The sounds of battle cut through the air.  Melee rages around you, threatening to draw you in.  People, dressed only in shreds of clothing, beat each other into the ground, climbing over the bodies of their fallen comrades in an attempt to reach a pile of gold and gems at the far side of the field.  From this distance, the pile seems to be shaped like a mocking horned head, looking on at the destruction with evil glee.

title: [The Rift]
description: Thick mist covers the ground in this small cemetery.  Moss-covered headstones and graves placed in a chaotic order stretch as far as the eye can see.  Several tombs rest on a small hill in the center of the quiet graves, on which three shapeless collections of ooze gather.  As you watch them, they morph into various shapes and sizes, speaking amongst themselves in some deep, flowing tongue.

title: [The Rift]
description: A small, faded festival tent has been set up in a patch of grass here.  The tent covers several long tables with cakes and pastries arranged on them.  Behind and to the sides of the tent, couples dance together, completely oblivious to your presence.  The crowd of revelers moves stiffly, like puppets under the hand of a new master.  Slowly they all turn and look at you, lifeless eyes pleading for release from this grim masquerade, then return to their partners in resignation as the dance continues.

title: [The Rift]
description: A large, decrepit building stands on the top of a small hillock here.  Vines cover most of the building, avoiding only the dark stains running from the windows and roof. title: [The Rift]

Inside the cell sits an old Krolvin warlord missing a few chunks of flesh, probably from attempted escapes.

title: [The Rift]

title: [The Rift]
description: A knight in black armor rides through a crowd, his black steed prancing with ringing steps.  In his hand he holds a staff, topped with the head of a vanquished foe. title: [The Rift]

title: [The Rift]
description: The chapel walls are lined with statues, one for each of the Lords of Liabo and Lornon. title: [The Rift]
description: Rows of sarcophagi line the rough stone walls of the corridor.  They remain tightly shut, although hopeless moans emanate from within the sealed boxes.  At the head of the hallway leans a mummy.  His arms are crossed over his chest, bound by the shrouds that cover the large frame.  From his back sprout two wings, also wrapped within the bandages.  Although perhaps a trick of the dim light, you could swear you saw one of the wings move.

title: [The Rift]
description: A huge fountain of blood erupts from the ground here, gushing hundreds of feet into the air and raining back down hard. When it fades, they have wavered and fallen with their medium.

title: [The Rift]
description: Climbing a small hill, you now look over a long valley filled with warriors.  A huge giantman in plate-mail stands at the front of the vanguard, holding a battle axe in each hand. The entire host of undead soldiers shifts anxiously behind him, as if waiting for a command from their chieftain.

title: [The Rift]
description: A long field stretches before you, covered by dark clouds.  The field is lined with rows and rows of long metal poles, each of which is situated near a stone door.  While you look over the field, lightning flashes down from the clouds and strikes one of the poles.  As the pole absorbs the burst of energy, the door nearest to it slowly swings open, revealing a black stone passage behind.  The door stays open a few seconds, then slowly swings closed again.

title: [The Rift]
description: You stand at the base of an immense tower.  The spire seeks to pierce the heart of the heavens, reaching into the center of a horrible lightning storm.  Bolts play over the black stone surface, illuminating it with a blinding blue light.  Winds howl about the structure, and the screams of those it throws from the top of the tower barely rise above the sound of the tempest.  Rain pours from the sky, as if the world wept at the wound created by the stabbing spire.

title: [The Rift]
description: A huge cliff looms before you, stretching far into the sky above.  About halfway up the face an immense red-skinned man rides the air currents, flapping his leathery wings to hold his position. title: [The Rift]
description: A beached ship lies in the middle of the field here, no clues or explanation as to how it arrived. title: [The Rift]
description: The smell of fresh mortar is in the air, thick and moist.  Rough brick walls surround you, each roughly four feet wide and as high as a giantman's head.  From behind the structures come muffled cries, and one blockade trembles with the rhythmic pounding it is taking from within.

title: [The Rift]
description: The garden about you is dead, as dead as the rubble of the castle it sits behind.  Dead branches overhang the paths, their bark scorched and marred by deep gashes. Upon a cracked and battered pedestal resting in one of the flowerbeds rests a gold coin, still strangely bright.

title: [The Rift]
description: A herd of horses plays in the dead grass of the meadow.  They frolic in the thin light that filters through the clouds, bending their heads to graze or simply standing with their herdmates.  Upon the back of the leader sits a small child whose giggles seem to brighten the day.  With a second look, the skin melts from the horses to leave nothing more than equine skeletons playing in the sun.

title: [The Rift]
description: A stone basin sits in the center of the castle courtyard.  Standing within it is a man, badly wounded, up to his knees in blood.  The crimson liquid pours from his cuts, trickling into the pool with a happy sound reminiscent of a burbling fountain.  He holds his hands above his head, as if bound by an invisible cord, although his face registers no emotion at all.

title: [The Rift]
description: Four banks of mist flow together, a distant scene forming within them.  A bustling town comes together in the square.  Halflings dressed in old style clothing stand about, some yelling angrily, others slain as they lay on their cloaks on the ground.  One ancient dark elf leans against the base of the large frozen statue of a pack animal, smirking arrogantly.

title: [The Rift]
description: Blood pours in from the corridor to the northeast.  Unlike the blood you are used to seeing, this blood is blue, the color of suffocation and death.  Indeed suffocation is a good metaphor, for the walls close in on you in regular constrictions, only to move back out and repeat the process.  The azure slime is forced southward, turning a deep violet as it moves.

title: [Glaesen Star, Fo'c'sle Deck]
[Glaesen Star, Fo'csle Deck]
description: Topped by maroon glaes trim, the crenellated, oaken bulwarks that surround this deck create a fantastic blend of ship and castle.  Immediately aft of the foremast, the galley chimney rises through the middle of the steam grating: a cylinder of heat-discolored black iron surrounded by a gleaming symmetry of ebon glaes.  Aft of the grating stands the belfry, itself a testimony to the skill of the glaes-crafters' art.

title: [The Rift]
description: The walls are a deep red color, pulsating and constricting.  At times you wonder if they will crush you, but you are only soundly squeezed between them as they contract and release, over and over.  Blood flows in rivers over the floor, forced out of the chamber by the movement of the walls and into a corridor to the north.

title: [The Rift]
description: A large snow-filled valley with rough sloping sides opens up before you.  On the ridge tops from one end to the other stand two main groups of creatures.  The north ridge holds huge clans of ice trolls standing ready with large slabs of ice, while on the south ridge groups of frost giants mutter at each other, holding equally large slabs.  In the center of the valley a lone storm giant stands, arms up to signal the racers.

title: [The Rift]
description: A portrait rests against an immense boulder here.  The boulder seems to have a vaguely familiar shape, but exactly what is too difficult to place.  Leaning against the base of the boulder is a modwir-framed picture, depicting an incredibly strong man wrestling with a heavy burden.  The rock he holds appears to grow heavier, and he looks tired and pained by the weight of it.  At the base of the painting before you are two footprints imbedded deeply into the ground.

title: [The Rift]
description: A battered wooden gate rests against the pitted stone walls surrounding a small city.  Mail-clad guards with pikes and heavy crossbows pace back and forth atop the walls.  Members of an invading force, beasts of burden, and captives travel the broken street leading into the remnants of town.  A bestial military squad drills on the rocky parade ground just inside the gate.  Fog obscures them as they march to and fro, and the gruff barks of their sergeant blend in with the din of the prisoners at the gate.

title: [The Rift]
description: The river of blood moves through a hole to the east.  Your feet squelch and squish with each step, and you are forced to place them carefully for fear of slipping. title: [The Rift]
description: Chains creak and strain under the load they are holding in the center of this stone-walled room.  Eight rolaren chains reach up, entangle, and reach down to the ground on the opposite side of the large shadowy mass hovering just above the floor. title: [The Rift]
description: A dilapidated yellow house sits just to the west of you.  It is surrounded by a small, white fence, and a pebble walkway flanked by withered flowers leads to the old domicile.  Sitting in the windowsill is a large, orange cat that looks at you with spectral eyes. title: [The Rift]

title: [The Rift]
description: A graveyard lies before you.  Unlike a normal graveyard, however, the things that now rest here never were alive.  Hundreds of broken statues litter the field, some gazing sightlessly off into the distance, others reaching with stone hands up to whatever salvation waits for them beyond.  The forgotten relics' final resting place gives an eerie air to the surrounding areas, as if you could share their unfortunate fate.

A huge stack of bodies is piled near the western gate, some of which almost look familiar.

title: [The Rift]
description: A small, faded festival tent has been set up in a patch of grass here.  The tent covers several long tables with cakes and pastries arranged on them.  Behind and to the sides of the tent, couples dance together, completely oblivious to your presence.  The crowd of revelers moves stiffly, like puppets under the hand of a new master.  Slowly they all turn and look at you, lifeless eyes pleading for release from this grim masquerade, then return to their partners in resignation as the dance continues.

title: [The Rift]
description: Four banks of mist flow together, a distant scene forming within them.  A bustling town comes together in the square.  Halflings dressed in old style clothing stand about, some yelling angrily, others slain as they lay on their cloaks on the ground. title: [The Rift]
description: A battered wooden gate rests against the pitted stone walls surrounding a small city.  Mail-clad guards with pikes and heavy crossbows pace back and forth atop the walls.  Members of an invading force, beasts of burden, and captives travel the broken street leading into the remnants of town.  A bestial military squad drills on the rocky parade ground just inside the gate.  Fog obscures them as they march to and fro, and the gruff barks of their sergeant blend in with the din of the prisoners at the gate.

title: [The Rift]
description: A forest of large trees stretches in all directions.  Their bark is an ashen grey, and their leaves almost glow crimson in the dim light. title: [The Rift]
description: Purple blood flows over the floor, making footing hazardous and slick.  As it moves to the south, it slowly turns red, brought to life by the breeze flowing through.  The walls squeeze in and out, forcing the blood to move south and east.  The floor ripples beneath your feet as worms burrow through, tooth-filled maws breaking the surface violently then diving back below.

title: [The Rift]
description: A wide stretch of forest opens before you, the huge border of trees giving the impression of stoic guards protecting their land and secrets. description: A plain of snow and ice stretches out as far as the eye can see.  In the twilight sky, shimmering golds, pinks, and blues dance across the heavens.  The colorful lights reflect off of the tiny flakes of snow that fall all around.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: A giant pair of stone hands clasped together forms the immense platform underfoot.  In the distance, a small white sun illuminates the rocky landscape, glistening off the silvery water of a magnificent cascade from a cliff to the east.  Cold vapor drifts from the base of the waterfall towards the hands, coating everything in a thin layer of ice as it settles.

A giant pair of stone hands clasped together forms the immense platform underfoot.  In the distance, a blazing red sun illuminates the rocky landscape, glistening off the crimson water of a magnificent cascade from a cliff to the east.  Hot steam drifts from the base of the waterfall towards the hands, coating everything in a thin layer of sweat-like mist.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: A landscape of socks unfolds in peaks and valleys, as well as far-stretching planes of multihued footwear.  In the immediate area are socks of wool and cotton, plain and with designs, such as midget pickles and plump sausages.  Some even have holes and are unraveling.  A few socks have been crumpled into balls, frozen into globes of ice and fabric, and are piled into a pyramid shape.

Peaks rise into the sky, and valleys fall low between, while the foreground stretches out in a sea of mismatched socks.  The mounds in the distance are made of the same, and occasionally, a spark will flare from the sky, setting a sock aflame.  It will burn away, and others tumble to the valley in its wake.  There are woolen socks and cotton socks, some with designs and some without.  Some have holes, while others have been carefully darned.  But, nowhere in sight are two that match.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: Grizzly animal skeletons in polished silver cages moan in pain along a narrow corridor.  Tiles of slippery ice compose the floor, with small spikes rising out from several of them.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: Eyes of various shapes and sizes peer out from the soft pink ceiling above, blinking and following every movement within the room.  Hands from different beasts and humanoids protrude from the walls, grasping for anything within reach.  The floor is covered with ice water and dark swimming shapes, with only a few slightly raised stones providing safe passage from one end to the other.

Eyes of various shapes and sizes peer out from the soft pink ceiling above, blinking and following every movement within the room.  Hands from different beasts and humanoids protrude from the walls, grasping for anything within reach.  The floor is composed of molten rock, with only a few slightly raised stones providing safe passage from one end to the other.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: A fresh smell haunts the chill air here, and underfoot, the ground is green-tinged and full of seeds.  What looks to be strips of cucumber are laid out side by side, studded here and there by a sliced ring of black olive.  Opaque granules the size of small apples appear to have been sprinkled over the cucumbers, and looking up finds a substance that is very pale and porous, much like bread.  Though there is no crust on the odd ceiling above, it has been smeared with a white and green-flecked substance.

Underfoot, the ground is slippery, slopped with a sort of brown goo -- it resembles a heavy sort of gravy.  Beneath the sludge are strips of meat, the smell of which wafts upward in waves of warmth.  Looking over the edge of this platform of meat finds a crust of bread all around, and instead of a sky above, there is the color of wheat on a substance that looks soft and porous.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: Frigid white snow assaults any exposed skin in a shower of burning cold.  The storm obscures everything around, making visibility even a few feet away impossible.
Burning white sand assaults any exposed skin in a shower of abrasive grittiness.  The storm obscures everything around, making visibility even a few feet away impossible.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: The cold in the air shows itself with every breath, and the leaves of the ironwood are encased in ice.  From its branches hangs an emaciated man in a jester's suit of black and purple.  He hangs upside-down, lanky arms dangling to scrape his knuckles against the frosted dirt.  Nearby stands a shirtless elf, his torso a play of cuts, one crisscrossing the other.  In one hand, the elf holds a long knife, and in the other hand, he holds the jester's hat.  The jester giggles between whimpering, tortured cries.

Steam rises from crevices in the dark earth, making the air swelter and the leaves on the ironwood here withered.  The air ripples with the heat, creating a dizzying distortion.  From the tree hangs an elf, his arms splayed and affixed to branches, his weight left to bear on his ribcage.  Nearby is an emaciated man in a jester's suit of black and purple.  His thin lips stretch in a raucous grin of crooked teeth.  A long knife in the merryman's spidery digits jabs at the elf as the jester sways and giggles.

title: [The Rift]
description: The camp slumbers.  All the soldiers rest soundly in their tents, and even the night sentries have dozed off, chins resting against their chests.  As the seven guardsmen sleep, a man clad in a cloak bearing the symbol of the slumbering army creeps outside the camp, bearing the seven swords of the watchmen.  He gives a nod towards a copse of trees, and out rides a raiding party, thundering into the unprotected camp.

description: Stretching as far as the eye can see are dunes of stark white sand.  Discarded windows, violently ripped from their frames, are littered across the bleak landscape.  Some of the shattered glass takes flight in the harsh wind, glittering across the grey sky.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: Ripe with icicles, an assortment of wooden chairs and tables sit upon the ceiling in this disorienting dining hall.  A full banquet has been set, though none of the settings or food succumb to gravity's pull.  Tangled in the enormous crystal chandelier immediately ahead, a yellowed skeleton wears a macabre grin while clutching a rusty saber.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: Crumbling stone walls that appear ready to topple at a moment's notice rise taller than a mighty oak's height in myriad directions. title: [The Rift]
description: Walls comprised of stacked skulls rise into the starless black sky.  The ground below seems to cradle you as you move, and a quick glance downward explains the reason.  Skeletal hands make up the floor, reflexively clutching and releasing as the weight they carry shifts.  In the center of the room stand three staves of tall femurs, bound together by still-bloody veins.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: An array of yarn crisscrosses throughout the entire area, making navigation and travel difficult.  Razor sharp shrapnel lies hidden beneath much of the tangled web, their presence only evident from the many blood stains that mar the strands.  A frozen body has become trapped within a cocoon of ice-covered string only several feet away.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: Humanoid shadows float across the otherwise empty alleyways of a desolate marketplace.  The fruit in stands are rotten and covered in frost, while shop fronts have been built up with immense blocks of ice.  An eerie silence pervades the area, occasionally broken by soft mumbling.

Humanoid shadows float across the otherwise empty alleyways of a desolate marketplace.  The fruit in stands are rotten, and several of shop fronts have been burnt down to ashes.  An eerie silence pervades the area, occasionally broken by soft mumbling.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: Spears of white grass cover the ground, frosted and frozen in place.  The sky is a panorama violets and blues, silvered with gusts of wind full of glistening snowflakes.  Orbs of liquid hover in the air, both near and far, and tiny sprites are suspended within, trapped in the viscous fluid.  As the blobs bob through the air, the sprites' malformed limbs struggle to move, their ragged wings are frozen, and their tiny mouths work slowly, as if chewing with their vicious teeth.

Every hint of green is gone from the landscape and brown blades of grass are all that can be seen stretching to the horizon.  From the darkness of that line, the sky opens up in shades of crimson and orange, streaked with clouds of saffron.  Against the sky, small figures flit to and fro, back and forth, some huddling in groups so large they blot out the sunset hues.  Closer to the ground, sprites flitter by, their wings ragged, their bodies deformed, and their tiny mouths full of needle-like teeth.

title: [The Rift, Scatter]
description: Tall, glass-tiled spires crumble under the mighty grasp of a multi-eyed creature wreaking havoc upon a city beyond the nearby forest.  Even from this distance, terrified screams can be heard, oddly as loud as if they were originating from a few feet away.  A brutally cold wind rushes from the direction of the city, carrying with it the sounds of destruction.

Tall, glass-tiled spires crumble under the mighty grasp of a multi-eyed creature wreaking havoc upon a city beyond the nearby forest.  Even from this distance, terrified screams can be heard, oddly as loud as if they were originating from a few feet away.  A searing hot wind rushes from the direction of the city, carrying with it the sounds of destruction.

title: [Manor House, Bedchamber]
description: Belonging to a child or perhaps to a halfling member of the manor's staff, a small bed lies collapsed in the room's northeast corner.  The room's floorboards appear intact, but sag in several places, and cobwebs fill the corners.  Soot from the room's small fireplace has been blown out across the hearth and covers almost half of the floor.

title: [Manor House, Study]
description: Devoid of furniture, it's unclear how this room was originally used.  From its size and the lack of windows it was probably either a study or servants' quarters.

title: [East Woods, Hollow Tree]
description: It is dark and cozy inside the trunk of the tree, the curving wooden walls provide a feeling of warm security against the dangers of the night.  A thick growth of moss has crept within the trunk, forming a soft, spongy carpet the entire length of the hollow space.  An opening at the end of the trunk leads out to the woods.

title: [Monastery, Pool Room]
description: If nothing else, the monks that occupied this monastery must have been a clean lot.  A huge shallow basin, lined with pink marble, occupies almost the entire area of this room.  The basin is obviously a bathing pool though it now stands empty of water, with a layer of dirt and refuse lining the bottom.  A small privy stands in one corner and a short stone wall affords some privacy there.

title: [Inside the Privy]
description: This room is fairly simplistic in its design, as many rooms of this sort are.  Bare brick walls, blackened with ages of damp and mildew, look upon an unassuming privy hole in the center of the room.

title: [Cattleya Street]
description: To the north, the path begins a slow climb up a hill toward a small hut with a thatched roof.  A banana tree laden with immature green fruit sits just off the pathway, next to a small pool of stagnant water.  Tall island grass and reeds have grown up around the tiny pond, taking advantage of the moist conditions.  A colorful yellow water bug propels itself across the surface of the murky water.

To the north, the path begins a slow climb up a hill.  While torches have been placed here to light the darkness, it is hard to see much of the pathway.  A banana tree laden with fruit sits just off to the side, next to a small pool of stagnant water.  Tall island grass and reeds have grown up around the water, taking advantage of the moist conditions.

title: [Cattleya Street]
description: The coral wall on either side of the path ends abruptly, as if the builder suddenly abandoned the project and went on to something else.  A pile of broken coral and miscellaneous building materials lies to one side of the pathway, and a stack of unused clay flowerpots rests beside it.  Beyond this point the sandy path widens and splits in two, going around a tall palm tree that has grown up in the middle of the passage.

title: [Heleconia Way]
description: Colorful corals have been used to build a short but stout wall on each side of the pathway here.  Upon the wall, a number of flowerpots planted with daisies, petunias, and chrysanthemums sit in a menagerie of color.  Oblivious to passersby, small bees fly among the pots, jumping from flower to flower in an exotic pollination ritual.

title: [Heleconia Way]
description: Bright red, orange, and white orchids grow wild along the street here, adding color to the mostly green flora.  The remains of an old bamboo hut, its walls crumpled in by time, can be seen off in the distance.  The scent of the sea wafts through here giving the area a fresh, clean aroma.

title: [Heleconia Way]
description: A large palm tree has fallen across the pathway, preventing any further progress to the south.  Clumps of dark green grass grow in the middle of the path threatening to overtake the passage.  A long-legged sea bird stands in a nearby pool of rainwater, one leg tucked up underneath its wing.

title: [Anthurium Way]
description: A small hut looms closer as the sandy path continues to climb upward toward the top of the hill.  A large piece of driftwood, its surface smooth and laden with small wormholes, lies across the pathway, almost blocking further progress.  Small, immature palm trees dot the slope, attempting to get a stronghold on the sandy soil.

A large knothole in the driftwood serves as a holder for the torch brightening this section of the trail.  Small, immature palm trees dot the slope, attempting to get a stronghold on the sandy soil.

title: [Anthurium Way]
description: Cresting the top of the hill, the path continues turning west past an abandoned thatched roof hut.  Makeshift flowerboxes have been placed at the entrance to the hut, each brimming with a combination of withered flowering plants and tall weeds.  A broken-handled hoe leans against the hut seemingly holding the structure from collapsing to the ground. description: The four glaes doors of the passengers' cabins open off of this short hallway.  The white and maroon glaes doors are set in the starboard bulkhead and the golden and black doors pierce the port bulkhead.  The ladder leading to the upperdeck is at the forward end of the hall.  From here you can go forward.

title: [Glaesen Star, Maroon Cabin]
description: Large, maroon silk starfish cover most of the gold quilt on the bunk, picking up the matching tones in the maoral paneling.  With its head against the outer bulkhead and a brassbound, maoral seachest against its foot, it's difficult to get to the far side of the bunk.  Maroon glaes-shaded lamps hang in gimballed wallmounts to either side of the bunk's head.

title: [Glaesen Star, Golden Cabin]
description: The gold-and-blue plaid comforter covering the bunk is highlighted with threads of gold, and stands out against the walnut paneling of the cabin.   A pair of golden glaes-shaded lamps bathe the cabin with a warm glow.

title: [Glaesen Star, White Cabin]
description: Pure white squares embroidered with snowflakes alternate with sky blue squares on the quilt that covers the bunk in this cabin.  Set against the starboard bulkhead, and surrounded by the silvery haon of the paneling behind it and the cupboards at its head and foot, the bunk looks roomy even for giantman passengers.  White glaes-shaded lamps hang from gimballed wallmounts near the head and the foot of the bunk.

title: [Glaesen Star, Master's Cabin]
description: Crowded with a bunk, a large seachest, a small seachest, and a small cherrywood desk and stool, this cabin leaves little room for movement.  It is a frightful mess, besides.

title: [Glaesen Star, 1st Mate's Cabin]
description: Little more than a closet with a bunk and a sea chest in it, still it does afford some privacy for the ship's first officer.

title: [Glaesen Star, Pilot's Cabin]
description: A large, fel chart table dominates this cabin, although bare of even a scrap of parchment at the moment.  A maroon rolton wool blanket covers the canvas mattress and a chart cabinet joins the seachest at the foot of the built-in bunk.

title: [Glaesen Star, Captain's Cabin]
description: A maoral desk built to giantman proportions dominates the center of the cabin, while a quilt sewn of diamonds of maroon, gold, black, and white silk covers the large bunk along the port bulkhead.  A circular, oaken table takes up the starboard third of the cabin, serving as either a chart table or for dining as needs dictate.  A single, small window in the port bulkhead and another in the starboard bulkhead are shrouded with curtains that match the quilt.

title: [Glaesen Star, Galley]
description: Crowded with heavy work tables, the mass of the brick fireplace, and two large barrels, this room leaves little space for anyone to work.  Pots and pans hang from the deckbeams, and knives and other utensils are hung in racks along the bulkheads.

title: [Glaesen Star, Beakhead]
description: Oaken gratings form most of the "deck" of this tiny triangle in the very bow of the ship.  The polished grey of the ashwood bowsprit angles up and forward from the base of the fo'csle bulkhead, reaching well beyond the prow and the figurehead that adorns it.

title: [The Portable Water Hole]
description: Oilcloth and canvas panels are strapped to monstrously large sea thrak ribs to create a weather-friendly roof that is loose enough to allow breezes to enter, yet tight enough to protect against rain.  Several of the ribs are yellowed with age, while others display tiny fractures that are mended with wide strips of rawhide.  A narrow corridor runs the length of the wagon with barely enough room to travel between the four booths housing tidy tables, the narrow entryway, and the bustling kitchen.

title: [Glaesen Star, Foremast Shrouds]
description: The triangular sweep of shrouds, laddered with ratlines, tapers from their base beyond the fo'csle bulwark, past the fore yard to end at the fore topcastle above.  Angled from the chain wales outboard along the hull to the formast above, the tilt of the shrouds, and the ratlines, make this a secure perch above the fo'csle deck.  From here you can climb down the shrouds to the fo'csle deck, or climb up the rigging to the topcastle.

title: [Glaesen Star, Fore Topcastle]
description: This tiny, battlemented platform is perched high above the fo'csle deck, where the lower mast ends and the topmast begins. A lubber's hole provides access to the rigging below.

title: [Glaesen Star, Aftercastle Deck]
description: Running almost a third of the length of the ship, this castle deck wears the same crenellated bulwarks and maroon glaes trim as the fo'csle castle deck. The ship's wheel stands aft of the mizzen mast and forward of the bonaventure mast, where the helmsman can keep an eye on the ship's main sails and any shifts in the wind.  From here the aftcastle ladder leads down to the upper deck.

title: [Glaesen Star, Mizzenmast Shroud]
description: The triangular sweep of shrouds, laddered with ratlines, tapers from their base beyond the aftcastle bulwark, past the lateen-rigged mizzen yard to end at the mizzen topcastle above.  Angled from the chain wales outboard along the hull to the mizzen mast above, the tilt of the shrouds, and the ratlines, make this a secure perch above the aftcastle deck.  From here you can climb up the rigging to the topcastle, or climb down the shrouds to the aftcastle deck.

title: [Glaesen Star, Mizzen Topcastle]
description: Perched high above the aftcastle castle deck, this tiny platform is battlemented like a miniature tower.  The lower mast ends here, but the topmast begins here and reaches higher.  A lubber's hole provides access to the rigging below.

title: [Glaesen Star, Mainmast Shrouds]
description: The triangular sweep of shrouds, laddered with ratlines, tapers from their base beyond the aftcastle bulwark, past the main yard to end at the main topcastle above.  Angled from the chain wales outboard along the hull to the main mast above, the tilt of the shrouds, and the ratlines, make this a secure perch above the aftcastle deck.  From here you can climb up the rigging to the topcastle, or down the shrouds to the aftcastle deck.

title: [Glaesen Star, Main Topcastle]
description: This battlemented platform sways high above the upper deck.  The lower mast ends here, and the main topmast rises to the crow's nest and the topgallant mast beyond. This is as high as passengers are allowed to climb.  A lubber's hole provides access to the rigging below.

title: [Forward Maindeck Companionway]
description: A driftwood framed doorway pierces the forward bulkhead here with a mural covering the bulkhead to its right.  From here you can go aft.

title: [Glaesen Star, Beneath the Waves]
description: Huge, bevelled panes of colorless glaes replace the hull timbers to either side of the keel.  From the deck planking to the deck beams above, the ship's bow is a giant window opening on the world beneath the waves.  Several small driftwood tables are scattered about the room.  Atop each is a green glaes-shaded oil lamp which casts a dim light, giving the room the illusion of being an extension of the realm beyond the panel.  Set in the wall near the driftwood bar is a glaes-topped driftwood bar.

title: [Glaesen Star, Black Cabin]
description: The shimmering ebon expanse of the satin comforter covering the king-sized bunk in this cabin contrasts sharply with the oak paneling.  With the huge bunk in here there is little deck space left to stand.  A pair of black glaes-shaded lamps hang above the head of the bunk.

title: [Maindeck 'Midships]
description: Canvas hammocks suspended from the deckbeams sway in time to the ship's movement:  sleeping accommodations for the crew and the less fortunate passengers.  Empty hammocks of the onduty watch have been bundled and stowed tight to the deckbeams, and beneath each crew member's berth a small seachest is lashed to the bulkhead.  The center of the deck here is taken up by the two large hatches leading to the hold below.  From here you can go forward or aft.

title: [Temple, Wedding Chapel]
description: Light filters in through delicate leaded glass windows to sparkle upon an immense white granite altar bedecked with bridal roses. The scent of roses lingers softly in the air, wrapping around you and bringing a pleasant smile to your face.   Many a happy couple has stood and pledged their troth before this simple shrine, and a feeling of joy seems to linger in the air.

Moonlight filters in through delicate leaded glass windows to sparkle upon an immense white granite altar bedecked with bridal roses. The scent of roses lingers softly in the air, wrapping around you and bringing a pleasant smile to your face.   Many a happy couple has stood and pledged their troth before this simple shrine, and a feeling of joy seems to linger in the air.

title: [Copper Avenue, Dead End]
description: Copper Avenue comes to an abrupt end as it approaches the mountain.  The sound of the water almost drowns out the shouts of the dockworkers to the north.  A small footbridge leads across the water into a large tunnel in the side of the mountain.  The mouth of the tunnel is open, but the spires of an iron portcullis peek down from the top, able to barricade the tunnel if necessary.

Copper Avenue comes to an abrupt end as it approaches the mountain.  The sound of the water almost drowns out the shouts of the dockworkers to the north.  A small footbridge leads across the water into a large tunnel in the side of the mountain, flickering torch light illuminating its opening.  Spires of an iron portcullis peek down from the top, able to barricade the tunnel if necessary.

title: [Lakavelli's Magic Shoppe]
[Lakavelli's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a wide faenor-trimmed table and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Wooded Glade]
description: Slender winnet and barabok trees edge the clearing, their wiry trunks twisting and twining in an impenetrable lattice of dark and sandy woods.  Leaf-clustered branches spread overhead in a lushly-woven canopy of shifting greens and browns, casting your surroundings in a kaleidoscope of shadow and pale light.  A knobby pebble path emerges from a gap in the trees to your east, stretching between sunken beds of flowering herbs, and dwindling to an end at the doorstep of a small wooden cottage.

Slender winnet and barabok trees edge the clearing, their wiry trunks twisting and twining in an impenetrable lattice of dark and sandy woods.  Leaf-clustered branches spread overhead in a lushly-woven canopy, casting your surroundings in a kaleidoscope of shadow and pale moonlight.  A knobby pebble path emerges from a gap in the trees to your east, stretching between sunken beds of flowering herbs, and dwindling to an end at the doorstep of a small wooden cottage.

title: [Island Oasis, Terrace Room]
description: The chamber is more garden than house, with polished wood-plank walkways winding through heavily foliaged beds.  Overhead, the ceiling is painted to represent a cerulean blue sky with heavy white clouds drifting across its surface. From the back, the splash of a waterfall adds its gentle song to the chirp of birds just outside windows, which cover most of the walls.  A walkway leads through a collection of wicker chaise-lounges, into a stand of huge palms which serve as a living screen.

title: [Island Oasis, Natural Pool Room]
description: Polished stone borders the clear water of a pool, its surface rippled by natural currents of an underground spring.  The water flows off at the back of the chamber, where it falls through a grate, down into the sea in a breathtaking torrent which sends rainbows arching from its spray.  Opposite the pool, a graceful wooden bridge spans the pool, giving access to an intimate grotto.  Expansive windows offer a panoramic ocean horizon framed by hanging baskets of draping ferns.

title: [Aquamarine, Cul-de-sac]
description: A crooked path weaves through the maze of boxwood nooks, bringing you to the curved wall of stone, familiar for its fortress-like enclosure.  Dangling from a series of pulleys above, a thick rope hauls a large passenger basket up to a rocky ledge.

A crooked path weaves through the maze of boxwood nooks, bringing you to the curved wall of stone, familiar for its fortress-like enclosure.  Dangling from a series of pulleys above, a thick rope hauls a large passenger basket up to a rocky ledge.  Several flickering, wall-braced invar sconces run the length of the apparatus, lighting the way.

title: [Canyon Wall, Rocky Ledge]
description: A stunning view of Kharam-Dzu spreads out below the ledge, the intricate play of the city's canyons and tunnels like a giant labyrinth.  Carved into the stone here is a simple troglodyte dwelling surrounded with flowering planters and a doorway trellis almost totally disguised by a prolific entwining cypress vine.  Small curtained windows display a variety of wares, beckoning customers to enter.

A stunning view of Kharam-Dzu spreads out below the ledge, the intricate play of lights that run along the canyons and tunnel openings outlining a giant labyrinth.  Carved into the stone here is a simple troglodyte dwelling, its small curtained windows displaying a variety of wares and beckoning customers to enter.

title: [Cliff Wall, Pathway]
description: The high hedges channel soft breezes along the path.  They stir the dirt path just enough to erase any trace of footprints.  An earthquake shifted part of the cliff away from the rest, cracking a chimney in the face, which further funnels the wind along this path.

title: [Cavern, Entrance]
description: The crack opens into a large underground cavern with rock walls.  There is no visible source of light, but something glows faintly in the background.  The glow brightens just enough to illuminate an archway guarded by two statues, a halfling wizard and a giantman warrior.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: At this junction of the dizzy flight of steps, the way splits.  To the northeast, the steps continue to climb toward a platform cut into the cliff wall.  This appears to be an entrance into a large dwelling perched atop the ramparts.  To the south, the steps pass over a chasm between the cliff face and a beautiful building constructed on the pillar rising from the foot of the precipice.

At this junction of the dizzy flight of steps, the way splits.  To the northeast, the steps continue to climb toward a platform cut into the cliff wall.  This appears to be an entrance into a large dwelling perched atop the ramparts.  To the south, the steps pass over a chasm between the cliff face and a beautiful building constructed on the pillar rising from the darkness of the canyon floor.  Torches stuck into gouges in the wall offer enough light to make a fairly safe climb.

title: [Rough Path, Canyon Wall]
description: The path doesn't end so much as fade away.  The canyon wall towers overhead, hundreds of feet high.  A jumble of boulders lies at the base of the wall.  A few scraggly plants struggle to survive in the stony soil, and a lizard of some sort sits on a rock, basking in the sun.
