title: [Rolaren Street]
description: This quiet street is lined with tanik trees, their leaves rustling gently in the breeze.  An elderly couple sits quietly on a bench, holding hands and smiling.  Nattily-dressed dwarves wander in and out of one small shop.

title: [Rolaren Street, Dead End]
description: The street ends here at the canyon wall, which towers over your head.  Set into its base, you see a gleaming mithril gate.  Two dwarven guards clad in gleaming mithril armor stand at attention, their eyes fixed straight before them.

The street ends here at the canyon wall, which towers over your head.  Set into its base, you see a mithril gate.  Two dwarven guards clad in mithril armor stand at attention, their eyes fixed straight before them.

title: [Ora Street]
description: Traffic is light along this tree-lined street.  A bespectacled old dwarf stands before a granite statue, lecturing a group of children.  They giggle, jump and scurry about.  Seated on a bench across the street, an elderly dwarf smiles at the young.  Perhaps a hundred feet to the east, the canyon walls tower overhead.

The street is nearly empty, quiet in the night air.  A granite statue casts faint shadows in the dim light, waiting for the sun to rise and wake the birds that are its constant companions.  Stars twinkle overhead, winking and blinking in the black sky.

title: [Ora and Dragonswing]
description: A large stone building abuts the canyon wall.  A brass bell hangs above the wooden door, and the babble of children's voices carries from inside.  Behind the building is a small, grassy area filled with ladders, rocks, slides and a swing set with three leather seats.

title: [Golvern Street]
description: Several burros are tied to a long modwir post just off the side of the street.  Though most doze peaceably, one pair of the beasts nips and snorts at each other.  The clacks of their hooves off the cobblestones echo off the tunnel walls.  Dwarves wander by on their way in and out of various shops and small homes.

title: [Golvern Street]
description: The street is drilled into the walls of the canyon.  Just outside the great tunnel leading into the rock, several small homes skirt the street.  They are all freshly-whitewashed, and some have small shrubberies planted out front.

title: [Golvern Street]
description: As you wander among the small shops lining this cobblestone street, the ear-splitting curses of a spluttering dwarf assault your ears.  He stands in front of a cart, thrashing his arms in the air and berating his bored-looking burro.  The other dwarves who amble by afford him a wide berth.

title: [Dragonspine and Golvern]
description: A troupe of dwarven musicians entertains the crowds at this busy intersection.  The dwarves gathered around clap appreciatively, some singing along in clamorous, off-key voices.  Other dwarves wander by about their business, many headed to or from the town gates to the north.  One huffs and puffs with a large wheelbarrow full of rocks.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Golvern and Dragonseye]
description: The street runs along the edge of a large, well-tended rock garden.  Massive boulders, tiny pebbles and all sizes of rocks in between are piled up in interesting shapes.  Dwarves wander about amongst them, pausing to admire one mound or another.  The garden extends several hundred feet to the north, ending at the town walls.  The River Muagh lies just to the west.  One family has set up a picnic on the river bank.

The street runs along the edge of a large, well-tended rock garden.  Massive boulders, tiny pebbles and all sizes of rocks in between are piled up in interesting shapes.  Late visitors wander about amongst them, pausing to admire one mound or another.  The garden extends several hundred feet to the north, ending at the town walls.  The River Muagh lies just to the west.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Gate]
description: The gateway into Pig Puddle Lane is more a bunch of old planks leaning up against each other.  They creak and sway a bit with every breeze, and most people hurry under them with a cautious glance upward.  A halfling boy astride his pet goat regards the scene with a yawn.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Mud Wallow]
description: A particularly large and smelly piebald pig tromps about a pool of filth.  Passers-by give both pool and pig a wide berth.  It eyes them hungrily, whuffles a bit then continues to snuffle about in the muck, searching for edible morsels.  The few run-down dwellings in the area all have sturdy fences about their front doors.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Circle]
description: In the center of this intersection, rooted in the mud, is a stunted, gnarled tree.  It doesn't have any leaves, so you can't identify its type.  The white dove alight on one limb seems oddly out of place here, as does its soft, warbled song.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Circle]
description: Hunched in front of a low stone wall, a tubby old dwarf hawks his wares.  The sign says "Fresh Rabbit," but the lumps of meat on the spit look to be neither of those.  On the opposite side of the street, a mud-caked elf snores fitfully against an old crate, clutching a bottle with a distant, dreamy smile.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Circle]
description: Someone has erected a monument here.  At least, it might be a monument.  It might also be a huge pile of dirt.  Running about its base are a trio of rag-clad young humans waving sticks overhead, apparantly engaged in a nonstop round of "Knights and Goblins."  Seated on a crate across the way, an old matron keeps one eye on her small, leather book and the other on her budding heroes and monsters.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Circle]
description: Old wooden shacks close in to either side of the line of mud which passes for road.  An old, blind beggar works the crowd, weaving skillfully among all the people, dogs, mules and mounds of refuse.  Rowdy, loud laughter rolls down the street, too.  Somewhere nearby, there's a party.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Alley]
description: This narrow lane is more an alley, closed in by two and three story squats bunched together on both of its sides.  The stinking puddles of filth on the ground look to be mostly rainwater.  Somewhere on a rooftop above you, something chitters and scrambles about.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Alley]
description: Down the walls of one old, dark brick hovel, something is growing.  It appears to be some kind of fungus, flourishing here in the wet, dark and filth.  A skinny, pockmarked elf youth sleeps on a pile of old rags, chuckling at his dreams.

Down the walls of one old, dark brick hovel, something is growing.  It appears to be some kind of fungus, flourishing here in the wet, dark and filth.  A skinny, pockmarked elf youth reclines on a pile of old rags, glassy-eyed and giggling.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Alley]
description: The doorways here are all barred, and the dark windows are shuttered.  On one hovel's front stoop, several young human toughs glare at all passers-by.  Opposite them, a skinny brown mutt roots through one of the many overturned trash barrels which decorate the street.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Dead End]
description: Only the gods and the flies know just what's in the noisome pile of filth which blocks further progress down this alley, and perhaps it's best left that way.  Water drips from one overhanging balcony above into a spreading pool of brown mud.  Rats scramble about on errands, red eyes fixed forward on some unknown rat-goal.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Circle]
description: Jutting out of an enormous iron garbage bin is the equally prodigious backside of a rag-clad giantman.  You can't tell what he's rooting about for, but his odd, high-pitched giggles indicate he's found it.  His bare feet squish in the muddy excuse for a street.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Circle]
description: A mixed group of ragamuffins, elven, human and halfling, collect lumps of mud and small rocks.  Their leader, a red-headed, mud-caked elven girl perhaps nine years old, points to the southeast with excitement, urging her friends to hurry.  An old, piebald mule tied to a post regards the scene with disinterest.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Circle]
description: The street is more a shallow mud pool than a road, and it's lined on either side by beat-up old shacks.  They lean against one another for support.  Sitting on her front stoop, an aging, stringy-haired halfling regards you with a grin and a wink.  At her feet crawls a grandchild, or perhaps a great-grandchild, tittering with toddler glee as he tugs on her foot-hair.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Dirt Road]
description: Foot traffic is sparse here, and the road is more dirt than black mud.  Mud-spattered wood shanties tilt at odd angles.  One is surrounded by a small fence, inside which a scramble of dogs wrestles and barks in a cloud of dust.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Dirt Road]
description: By the side of the road is an old, half-rotten oxcart.  The bench is now splinters, the wheels are all gone, and it's propped up on uneven crates.  A spotted hound sleeps fitfully in the darkness underneath, occasionally waking to shake off the gnats.

By the side of the road is an old, half-rotten oxcart.  The bench is now splinters, the wheels are all gone, and it's propped up on uneven crates.  A spotted hound sleeps fitfully in the shade underneath, occasionally waking to shake off the flies.

title: [Pig Puddle Lane, Dirt Road]
description: The road ends here in a cluster of ramshackle buildings, one an abandoned tavern.  Its faded sign hangs at an angle, but you can still make out the name, "The Bedbug Inn."  Weeds have grown up through the floorboards out front, providing lunch for a fat, flop-eared hare squatting there.

title: [The Whining Elf, Bar]
description: Woven mats are nailed over the broken front window to keep out the dust of the street.  A scattering of filthy straw serves as a floor covering.  Behind the bar, glasses are stacked haphazardly in the rusted sink.  Giantmen, miners, and dwarves lean against the battered bar, casting a cursory glance at new arrivals.  Barely visible through the rising dust and smoke is a dark curtain, over which hangs a small handwritten sign.

title: [Old Manor, Living Room]
description: Passing between the charred and blackened pillars of a once graceful marble archway, you feel a sense of unease touch your very soul.  Muted moonlight trickles between the tumbled remains of this once elegant foyer, outlining scorched and broken boards and rafters.

Passing between the charred and blackened pillars of a once graceful marble archway, you feel a sense of unease touch your very soul.  Muted sunlight trickles between the tumbled remains of this once elegant foyer, outlining scorched and broken boards and rafters.

title: [Old Manor, Dining Room]
description: Squeezing past a collapsed archway, you gaze upon an immense oak table stretching the length of the room.  Ornately carved dragons form the table legs, their claws giving the illusion of melding into the floor.  Eerily, the table is still highly polished and unscathed by the destruction around it, as if nary a flame had licked upon it.  You can't help but wonder why the impoverished residents of the area never carted it off.

title: [Old Manor, Kitchen]
description: An ancient black iron kettle lies overturned on a scorched hearth, providing a nest for rodents of various sizes.  The walls here are burned nearly through and collapsed in places, giving view to the tangled remains of a garden outside.

title: [Old Manor, Study]
description: Where once palatial bookcases lined the walls, rats now scurry behind blackened modwir boards.  Piled high in a corner, some torn and waterstained volumes slowly rot away from this world.  A rotting board creaks softly underfoot, and you briefly ponder the safety of these ruins before moving on.

title: [Old Manor, Bedroom]
description: Atop some battered stairs, you find the blackened remains of the master bedroom.  Scorched and looted of its past grandeur, all that remains is a carved window seat, covered with scraps of burnt grey velvet.  Gazing past the broken glass window frame, you look down upon the twisted ruins of a small garden.

title: [Old Manor, Closet]
description: Stumbling blindly into near pitch blackness, you find yourself in a tiny closet. As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you notice a thin beam of moonlight shining through the door, centering on some boards that comprise the remains of the closet floor.

Stumbling blindly into near pitch blackness, you find yourself in a tiny closet. As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you notice a thin beam of light shining through the door, centering on some boards that comprise the remains of the closet floor.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: Dust is the primary inhabitant of this warehouse.  The boards sag all around you, as if it were will alone that kept them from collapsing.  Soft squeaks can occasionally be heard from the dust's neighbors, the rats.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse, Entry]
description: Stacks of boxes form a narrow corridor around you, looking more than a bit unstable in their piling.  A light layer of dust covers them, as if this place had not been cleaned in some time.

title: [Main Hallway]
description: Hallways march off in different directions like the points of a compass.  Hanging from the center of the main hallway's ceiling is a massive chandelier of twisted wrought iron.  Hundreds of candles burn brightly, casting a soothing yellow glow throughout the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [West Hallway]
description: Along the walls, columns carved out of the grey stone reach from floor to ceiling.  Thin white lines painted on the columns give them the illusion of solid marble.  The tops of the columns are shaped like stylized palm leaves, fanning outward to reach toward one another across the ceiling of the corridor.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Fianne's Beds and Bedding]
description: Narrow lancet windows and hundreds of tiny candles flood Fianne's stylish bed shop with light.  Pallets heaped with enormous pillows stand beside neat rows of beds in a wide variety of styles and finishes.  Fianne's discreet but attentive service and the pleasing surroundings of her store make for a pleasurable shopping experience.

Narrow lancet windows and hundreds of tiny candles flood Fianne's stylish bed shop with warm golden light.  Pallets heaped with enormous pillows stand beside neat rows of beds in a wide variety of styles and finishes.  Fianne's discreet but attentive service and the pleasing surroundings of her store make for a pleasurable shopping experience.

title: [Lotsa's Large Beds]
description: An almost forgotten end of the hall holds very large beds, stacked one atop the other.  Teetering uncertainly, piles of mattresses hug the walls for support while frames lean over, criss-crossed beside them.

title: [Flavian's Firemongers]
description: This spacious showroom glows with the heat and warmth rising from several sample firepits, the red coals and burning embers within them popping and crackling occasionally.  The rich aroma of burning pine logs floats lazily in the air, enveloping Flavian and his customers in a homely bluish haze.

title: [Flavian's Firemongers West]
description: Despite wide-open windows, the room air is dry, smoky and hot.  It is enough to make anyone wonder why the shopkeeper did not see fit to simply display the wares instead of demonstrating them.

title: [Bejinda's Baubles]
description: White pine tables, gracefully simple, stand against the grey stone walls.  Baskets of trinkets and other decorative fairings sparkle atop the tables.  Above the tables and their wares are iron brackets bearing candles to light the room.  Pink bows are tied to several of the brackets, softening their austere appearance.

title: [Thoughtful's Dead Fishes]
description: Every vertical surface in the room is covered with stuffed dead fish.  Some bright, some faded -- almost every type of fish ever seen in the local waters, immortalized under a thin veneer of shiny polish.

title: [North Hallway]
description: Two narrow passages branch off towards small shops.  Large, circular patches of soot cover the ceiling high above the torches lining the walls.  Several torches have burned out, leaving the area a patchwork of light and shadow.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Crenzen's Country Crafts]
description: A fine dust floats up from Crenzen's workbench and drifts around his shop on a breath of breeze, before settling softly upon the simple yet elegant wooden beds he crafts here on the premises.  The woodworker's love for nature's bounty, and his respect for the natural beauty of wood, make his wares a joy to behold.

title: [Emalinne's Bejeweled Garden]
description: Silvery light filters through a skylight above, washing the stone walls in pale, gentle hues.  Exquisite tapestries line the walls, each more vibrant and colorful than the last.  Swaying gently in the breeze created by passing shoppers, the tapestries are reminiscent of a garden on a late summer's day.

title: [Worthy Foes Remembered]
description: Various martial trophies are displayed on the walls between the arched stone vaulting.  Candles on a brace of chandeliers provide adequate light, with reflections off the polished weapons and shields providing a kaleidoscope of colors.  The faint smell of leather oils and metal polishes fills the room, vaguely reminiscent of a barracks or armory.

title: [Orbean's Outlooks]
description: Soft golden candlelight flickers and reflects from countless showroom windowframes which line the walls of Orbean's glazing gallery.  In the center of the store, a series of faux walls displays his wares in a variety of home-like settings, allowing customers to amble unhurriedly between them while window shopping.

title: [East Hallway]
description: The thick stone walls are still light grey, except where thin, rust-colored lines trail downward from iron brackets on the walls.  Some brackets hold thick yellow candles, while others are empty curls of metal.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [You Got Me Floored!]
description: Floors!  Floors!  Floors!  You have never seen so many styles of floors in all your life!  Polished pine boards, gleaming marble and painted tiles vie for space in the crowded room.  Even the floor of the shop is covered in bits and pieces of sample products.

title: [You've Also Got Me Floored!]
description: Spilling over from the shop to the west are more floor samples.  Slabs of granite, chunks of slate and long boards of finished and unfinished wood products are jumbled in a colorful display of inventory that defies classification.

title: [Arienne's Artifacts]
description: This room is piled high with wooden tables of all sizes and shapes, each one decorated with a unique and esoteric material.  Small pathways wind among the items, providing just enough space for customers to view the wares.  Yellow candles flicker fitfully in the wall sconces as their light dances across the table surfaces.

title: [MoonSpinner's Glaesine Windows]
description: A broad skylight emits pale moonlight that hits the various window displays scattered through this room.  As the light refracts through each stained glaes panel, it sends a rainbow of color cascading towards the next.

A broad skylight emits pale golden light that hits the various window displays scattered through this room.  As the light refracts through each stained glaes panel, it sends a rainbow of color cascading towards the next.

title: [Within These Walls]
description: Dripping tallow candles cast a flickering yellow glow over the merchandise in Pollunk's store, the cool air and absence of any window lending the impression that his showroom is underground.  The walls, floor and ceiling are lined with a fascinating mosaic of wall materials, each glinting sample expertly interlocked with the next to form a seamless, cave-like interior.

title: [Corryn's Board and Panel]
description: Polished gold candelabras and elegant crystal chandeliers lend plenty of light to the many three-walled mock-up rooms that comprise this large establishment.  Each room displays how well the proprietor's products integrate with other stylish home furnishings.  A large music box fills the room with cheery sounds as its windup key slowly turns.  Several clerks in matching aprons dash this way and that, each with a customer in tow, while rattling off the features and specifications of the merchandise.

title: [South Hallway]
description: Damp air coming from the stone slab walls leaves the hallway refreshingly cool.  Iron-work lanterns are bolted to the wall along the hall's length, fashioned in a geometric style and set with amber crystal panes.  They give off a golden glow which makes the stone seem more welcoming.

Damp air coming from the stone slab walls leaves the hallway refreshingly cool, a welcome relief from the hot tropical sun.  Iron-work lanterns are bolted to the wall along the hall's length, fashioned in a geometric style and set with amber crystal panes.  They give off a golden glow which makes the stone seem more welcoming.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Abidaserous's Authentic Rugs]
description: A huge, crudely lettered sign greets all who enter with the banner, "Close-out sale!  Prices slashed!  All rugs 75% off!"  Deep piles of brightly patterned carpets stand around the chamber, some with the upper-most rugs turned back to reveal others lying beneath them.  The heavy tribal pieces are thick and give off a unique odor.  And each has its own pattern, a unique design composed of thousands of pieces of wool thread hand-knotted to a tapestry backing.

title: [Abidaserous's Backroom]
description: Stylish rugs are piled into mountains of vivid color, their patterns mixing like a bountiful feast for the eyes.  A gorgeous Sheruvian prayer rug hangs on the wall next to an exquisite golden silk weaving.  These are obviously the highest quality carpets Abidaserous offers, and the price tags correlate the assumption.

title: [Wilma's WallHangings]
description: Stylish wall hangings are hung upon several polished wood partitions.  Ornate, high-backed chairs surround small oval tables stacked with books full of hand drawn examples of even more wall hangings.  Aromatic smoke drifts from a small brazier in the corner, lending the shop a pleasant, relaxing atmosphere, but the incense is not so hazy as to choke the customer.

title: [Wharfer's Walls]
description: Walls stand everywhere, great hulking stone partitions next to finely executed brattices that appear to be lighter than parchment.  Walls stand next to walls behind other walls.  As Menshal Wharfer's advertisement admonishes, if you need a wall, this is the place!

title: [The Mother Lode, Lobby]
description: Cheerful arrangements of flowers brighten up the corners of this rustic Inn.  A small red couch faces the front desk, providing a spot for weary travellers to rest before seeing their room.

title: [The Mother Lode, Hallway]
description: Mining lanterns have been transformed into soft lighting fixtures on either side of the doors to the rooms.  Well-scrubbed oak tables stand at the ends of the hallway.  A lace doily and vase is on one table, while the other is bare.

title: [The Mother Lode, Bedroom]
description: Moonight from the window filters through the sheer red curtains, silhouetting a katana balanced on its edge on the sill.  A thick down comforter covers the low bed.  A pine table is on the opposite side of the bed, while a simple pine wardrobe is on the near side.

Light from the window filters through the sheer red curtains, silhouetting a katana balanced on its edge on the sill.  A thick down comforter covers the low bed.  A pine table is on the opposite side of the bed, while a simple pine wardrobe is on the near side.

title: [The Mother Lode, Bedroom]
description: A large braided rug covers most of the hardwood floor.  Blue muslin curtains hang on either side of the window, draped back by small decorative hooks.  A small carved footstool, looking more like a toy than a piece of furniture, rests against the end of the Giantman-sized bed.  An over-sized armoire nearly fills the opposite side of the room.

title: [Thurl's Leaf and Drink]
description: A thin cloud of smoke hovers throughout the shop.  Shelves fill almost every inch of wall space, most overstocked with tins of tobacco.  Bundles of drying tobacco hang above a dark wood counter.  A window behind the counter allows a small amount of moonlight into the room, but what does enter scatters in the haze to create a pale silver glow.

A thin cloud of smoke hovers throughout the shop.  Shelves fill almost every inch of wall space, most overstocked with tins of tobacco.  Bundles of drying tobacco hang above a dark wood counter.  A window behind the counter allows a small amount of light into the room, but what does enter is diffused in the haze.

title: [Hedgerows, Bluebottle Lane]
description: The Hedgerows neighborhood is lovingly maintained by a local landscaping crew that participated in creating an idyllic area with flowering plants and trees everywhere.  A florid arch marks the entry to the formal gardens, the flowers on it different colors depending upon the season and which vines are blooming.  Traffic streams across the avenue, many people passing through the arch on their way into or out of the gardens.

title: [Hedgerows, Bluebottle Lane]
description: Bright blue tulips abound along the sidewalks paralleling the road.  Bees buzz around happily, collecting nectar to create the honey the area is known for.  In one tree overhead, the nest for the bugs hangs, having been attached to one of the more stout branches.

title: [Hedgerows, Bluebottle Lane]
description: Low squared-off bushes front the properties alongside the roadway.  Bright pink blooms spot the dark green shrubs, a counterpoint to the golden marigolds lining the walkways to the front doors of houses in this part of the neighborhood.  An occasional swingset stands in yards with homes owned by families with smaller children.

title: [Hedgerows, Ladybug Lane]
description: Verdant hedges provide a fenceline for the homeowner's properties within the neighborhood.  Each house is landscaped with blooming flowers and thick groundcover surrounded by meticulously cut grass lawns.  Large oaks rise over the bungalows, outstretched limbs providing a protective cover for the homesteads.

title: [Hedgerows, Ladybug Lane]
description: One rebel resident of the Hedgerows did his entire yard in gravel, complete with a large rock garden on the west side of the house.  Nearby houses try to drown it out in a symphony of flowers, plants, and trees.  A treehouse clings to a nearby bough, overlooking the roadway.

title: [Ladybug Lane, Cul-de-sac]
description: Brilliant rainbows arc in all directions around a sculpture consisting of hundreds of crystals that act as tiny prisms.  Surrounding the sculpture, six white canvases stretch between poles, capturing the color and creating a living, moving painting of light.  Tourists from all over the lands come to sit and watch the kinetic symphony.

title: [Hedgerows, Ladybug Lane]
description: A tulip field spreads out to the southwest, row upon row of solid colors neatly organized into a quilt of living color.  Small insects buzz about the delicate flowers, pollinating and feeding upon them from hop to hop.   Gardeners carefully tend to the plants, cautiously watering each individual stem.

title: [Hedgerows, Mosquito Lane]
description: Small, brightly-colored bungalows sidle up against each other, though not quite close enough to be crowded together.  Saturated primar cover just about every house, at once both extremely loud and quite cheerful.  Birds flit back and forth from tree to tree, scolding each other, while others sing happily.

title: [Hedgerows, Mosquito Lane]
description: Decorative ironwork graces a park filled with gleeful children.  The animal and plant sculptures serve as the foundation for a large playground surrounded by well-manicured grass.  Bright paints and patterns add a fantasy element to the faithful representations on the lawns.

title: [Hedgerows, Mosquito Lane]
description: Wind chimes hang in doorways up and down the thoroughfare, the breeze creating a cacaphony of jangling sound as it travels through the neighborhood.  Small insects buzz about, sailing from flower to flower in search of the perfect nectar for food.  The residents of the neighborhoods have larger sets of chimes near their doors, probably used to notify them when a visitor has arrived.

title: [Hedgerows, Dragonfly Lane]
description: Some owners have taken to gardening exotic mosses in their front yards.  Wide swaths of several shades of green stripe the grounds, giving the scene a bit of an artistic feel.  A small stream fronts the properties on the north side of the road, short bridges spanning the water.

title: [Hedgerows, Dragonfly Lane]
description: Songbirds warble in the deciduous trees, their cheerful melody carrying on in the gentle breeze.  Carefully manicured lawns and expansive flower beds accentuate the regal trees, the colors of thousands of leaves adding to the idyllic scene.

title: [Hedgerows, Dragonfly Lane]
description: A small stream flows by the roadway, gently turning an old water wheel that transfers the water into a sluice.  The water travels down and spills out into a placid lilypad-covered reflection pond.  A stair-stepped set of falls returns the water to the stream at the far end of the pond.

title: [Dragonfly Lane, Cul-de-sac]
description: Families in this cul-de-sac grouped together, bringing in souvenirs from more tropical areas, planting date palms, banana trees, and coconut palms.  A sandbox nestles between two houses at the end of the street, remnants of tumbled sandcastles piled within its confines.  A few scrub pines dot the area, creating a slightly comical look to the street.

title: [Hedgerows, Butterfly Lane]
description: A wall of colorful tapestries, drying in the open air, hangs out back of a small bungalow.  A waft of wind blows through, rippling the edges of the fabric, creating a rainbow of colors and patterns.  Nearby, a dog barks loudly, trying in vain to catch the material flapping over its head.

title: [Hedgerows, Butterfly Lane]
description: The street splits around a colorful gazebo, then meets again on the other side.  The structure is carved from several kinds of decorative woods, all sealed against the weather, and carved by skilled artisans.  All kinds of fantastic animal reliefs run playfully around the stand, so detailed that the wooden representations appear almost real.

title: [Hedgerows, Butterfly Lane]
description: Butterfly Lane takes its name from the handcrafted mosaic stained glass found throughout the avenue.  Bright and cheery colors, just like those of the road's namesake, are inlaid into the surface of the street, set into benches on the sidewalks, and splash vivid hues about from the lamps hanging off the fronts of houses.

title: [Thistleberry's Hut]
description: An odd combination of pungent and acrid smells lingers thickly in the cramped confines of the hut.  Occasional sharp twinges sting your nose and send ripples down your spine.  Spherical glass pots hang from the ceiling between bunches of drying grass.  Viny tendrils spill over the rafters, moving gracefully with slight air currents drifting in and out of the open doorway.  Lines of shelves stretch wall-to-wall behind a wooden counter, displaying scads of vari-colored jars along their lengths.

title: [Pebble Court, Granite Way]
description: A cart has broken down in the road here, one of its wheels collapsed.  The two giantman drovers don't seem too worried, however.  They're far more concerned that their cargo, several split and half-spilled ale casks, not go to waste.  It looks like they're going to be here a while.  To the south is an entrance to the park.

title: [Pebble Court, Granite Way]
description: Traffic forks about some obstacle in the middle of the road.  It's a mule, standing there peacefully, gnawing on some weeds sprouting up between the cobbles.

title: [Pebble Court, Granite Way]
description: A hodgepodge of homes lines the street.  Most are stoutly constructed of grey stone and modwir, a practical dwarven style, but others are obviously home to halflings or elves.

title: [Pebble Court, Granite Way]
description: A dwarven cart driver pushes on towards the northwest, but looks back over his shoulder with an evil glare.  You wonder if the broken eggs spattered over his cart, cargo and beard have anything to do with that.

title: [Pebble Court, Agate Way]
description: One side of the street here is walled off with a high, wooden fence.  A couple of holes have been drilled at about eye-height for a halfling.  High-pitched giggles from the other side indicate some mischief is about to begin.

title: [Pebble Court, Firestone Lane]
description: From somewhere down the street, you hear the clatter of mule hooves on cobblestones, followed by muffled dwarven cursing.  Sitting on the front porch of a nearby stone home, an ancient dwarf stares into the distance, a vacant smile on her face.

title: [Pebble Court, Park]
description: The trees here are trimmed neat as a halfling prince's toes, and even the grass looks well-combed.  Paths inlaid with polished grey stone crisscross the park, themselves lined with wood benches.

title: [Pebble Court, Granite Way]
description: An old and especially grumpy-looking dwarf glares up at a modwir tree, from which a tubby cat glares down.  From a nearby window, a giantman child chuckles at the scene.

title: [Pebble Court, Granite Way]
description: On either side of this quiet, tree-lined street are neat stone homes, their shutters painted green and red.  An old spotted hound regards you from his porch.

title: [Pebble Court, Geode Lane]
description: A group of mixed dwarven and giantman children sit in a circle on the grass by the side of the road.  One runs around, kicking each of the others in turn, yelling something that sounds like "Dwarf, dwarf, elf!"  A chase ensues.

title: [Pebble Court, Granite Way]
description: An apple tree by the side of the road displays a ripe, red bounty.  A trio of halflings have decided to start the harvest.  Happily, they brought a stepladder.

title: [Pebble Court, Agate Way]
description: The sweet smell of cream pie wafts from a nearby windowsill.  Just below it, a large black dog is chained to a post, regarding all who pass by with a bored expression.

title: [Pebble Court, Agate Way]
description: The street curves around an enormous fel tree growing right in the middle.  Bright ribbons, yellow, red and green, hang from its branches, stirring with every breeze.  To the east is the park entrance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Pebble Court, Geode Lane]
description: The street narrows here, wide enough for only a single cart.  Unfortunately, two carts headed in opposite directions have met in the middle.  The dwarven drovers glare red-faced at one another, hurling imprecations in their guttural tongue.  Their mules stand by placidly, occasionally munching on the shrubs by the side of the road.

title: [Pebble Court, Park]
description: A field of roses, red and yellow, wafts gently with the breeze.  Among the blooms are several statues of black marble, one for each of the light-aligned Arkati.

title: [Pebble Court, Park]
description: Blue and orange tulips have been planted along the edges of a small pond.  The waters are dark and still, reflecting and enhancing the blooms' beauty.

title: [Pebble Court Park, Gazebo]
description: The gazebo is polished brass, gleaming brightly as a halfling at breakfast.  Delicately carved benches of white modwir are set in a semi-circle, surrounding a small, raised stage.  The gazebo walls are lined with small, clay pots, each of which is home to a single red rose.

Polished to a bright shine, the brass frame of the gazebo reflects the sunlight with a brilliant gleam.  Carved benches of white modwir are set in a semi-circle, surrounding a narrow, raised stage.  A small copper-rimmed barrel sits to one side, its base encircled by a ring of wildflowers.  Tall, clay pots that line the walls are each home to a single red rose.

title: [Pebble Court, Agate Way]
description: The street bends about an enormous boulder, nearly 20 feet high and a bit more around.  It's impossible to say how it got there, but everyone seems to give it a wide berth.

title: [Pebble Court, Agate Way]
description: There's little traffic here, by foot or by mule, and the homes are quiet, quaint sorts of houses.  The peace is disturbed, however, by some shouting from the southeast.  One grumpy old codger sits on his porch, glaring in that direction and mumbling to nobody in particular.

title: [Pebble Court, Agate Way]
description: A pair of hugely fat, monstrously drunken dwarves shout at each other from a distance of perhaps five feet -- as close to each other as their girths will allow.  Though it's not clear what their argument is about, it involves a lot of arm flailing, spluttering, spitting and the occasional kick to the shin.  Now and again, one or the other stops to drink from the small keg they share.

title: [Pebble Court, Agate Way]
description: The pedestrian and mule traffic here circles about a small fountain in the middle of the intersection.  The fountain itself is green and black marble, with a statue of a dolphin standing on its tail.

title: [Pebble Court, Firestone Lane]
description: A group of children - dwarves, human, elves and others - scamper about in the middle of the street, playing an endless game of tag.  Passers-by give them a wide berth and a wider grin.

title: [Brewery, Burlitok's Showcase]
description: Innumerable shelves full of flagons, steins, mugs and glasses of every possible description ring the room, ascending from floor to vaulted ceiling in a mezmerizing myriad of shape and color.  The sweet acrid smell of cooking ale twinges your nose, coaxing you seductively from your trance and beckoning you further into the building.

title: [Brewery, Kitchen]
description: Sweltering heat radiates from huge copper vats which fill the room.  Suffocating waves of humidity wash over you with each breath you take.  Occasional whiffs of steam hiss, forced out between loosely-jointed pipes above your head, mussing your hair and singeing your ears.  A set of stout wooden steps disappears through the ceiling.

title: [Brewery, Still]
description: A tremendous copper drum juts from the floor at the room's center, tapering to a rounded peak near the ceiling to form a massive brandy still which takes up nearly the entire room.  From atop, a thin metal tube descends in tight coils and disappears into a smaller barrel to one side.  Beads of condensation collect at the end of a thin spout protruding from the barrel's front, pause for one tense second, and then drop lightly into a clear glass jug.

title: [Brewery, Tasting Room]
description: A row of brass-bound wooden barrels lines the southern wall, fitted with shiny copper taps which gleam cheerily in the yellow flicker of lantern light.  Set into the room's southwestern corner, a triangular bar supports mugs and bottles of shimmering drink -- just begging you to belly up.

title: [Brewery, Store Room]
description: Casks, kegs, barrels and large crockery jugs crowd the room, stacked high among the eaves as far as you can see.  A few shards of light slant in from above, spotlighting sparks of dust as they knife to the floor.

title: [Eldaria's Magic Shoppe]
[Eldaria's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the cherrywood floor is interrupted by a withered yellowing plant.  Halfway to the polished haon ceiling, an antique wall hanging hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A long mistwood counter and a painted red cedar rack are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Marienna's Market, Foyer]
description: The tiny foyer opens up into a small shop, the surrounding smooth walls cut with arches leading into even smaller alcoves.  Half-curtains of sheer lace generously allow the moonlight to spill in from the front windows, while several invar sconces add illumination to brighten the darker corners.  A small flight of switch-backing stairs carved right into the rockface climbs up along one wall.

The tiny foyer opens up into a small shop, the surrounding smooth walls cut with arches leading into even smaller alcoves.  Half-curtains of sheer lace generously allow the sunlight to spill in from the front windows, while several invar sconces add illumination to brighten the darker corners.  A small flight of switch-backing stairs carved right into the rockface climbs up along one wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Marienna's Market, West]
description: Mannequins, grouped together as though gossiping, stand in front of the window, wearing headwear and fashions designed especially for fashionable women.  An armoire, a set of hooks, a rack and a shelf are neatly stocked with some of the featured clothing in a variety of colors and sizes.  Carved into the eastern wall is an opening leading to a small alcove.

title: [Suniel's Alcove]
description: Four mannequins, each in a different pose, have been carefully arranged along two adjoining walls.  Each is dressed and accessorized in fashionable wedding garb from head to toe.  An intricate wooden sign hangs on the wall, flanked by two invar sconces.

title: [Marienna's Market, North]
description: The narrow stone hallway leads back to a more private area of the dwelling, fragrant with the scents of a busy kitchen.  Invar sconces light the way in the dim passage.

title: [Suniel's Pantry]
description: Shelves filled with provisions and lined with baskets and jars crowd this part of the hallway, passing through a small pantry.  A thick maoral door posted with a small birch bark sign framed with dried oak-leafed branches stands open, and reveals some steps that traverse downward.

title: [Marienna's Market, East]
description: Displayed on a low case set along the front window, fashionable headwear for gentleman has been artfully arranged.  A half-curtain of wispy lace allows in thin beams of moonlight, hazy with motes of dust from the volcano ash.  Other racks, shelves, tables and counters contain various items for the discriminating male.

Displayed on a low case set along the front window, fashionable caps and hats for gentleman have been artfully arranged.  A half-curtain of wispy lace allows in thin beams of sunlight, filled with dancing motes of dust from the volcano ash.  Other racks, shelves, tables and counters contain various items for the discriminating male.

title: [Golden Helm, Long Corridor]
description: The hallway appears brighter and wider than you expect, due to the high vaulted ceiling.  Three heavy wood wheels, heaped with candles of varying heights, are suspended from the ceiling by blackened iron chains.  A complete suit of mithril armor stands guard beside the steps.

title: [Golden Helm, Bar]
description: Two soft horsehide couches are set before a cozy stone hearth.  From behind the rosewood bar, a bald giantman grins perpetually.  Great hooded candles are set on low tables along the walls, providing a soft, reddish light.  On the wood-paneled walls, two paintings are hung next to a great vultite claidhmore.

title: [Golden Helm, Hearth Room]
description: An immense circular hearth fills the center of the room.  A roast sizzles on a spit over the fire.  The juices drip into the coals, popping and hissing as they land.  Sturdy oak tables are set throughout, surrounded by chairs wide enough for the most ample of patrons.  A pleasant breeze drifts through the open windows set high in the whitewashed wood-and-stone walls.

title: [Golden Helm, Narrow Corridor]
description: A tapestry carpet in red and gold runs the length of the hall.  Several elaborate iron sconces hold thick beeswax candles.  Beneath the narrow window at the hall's end is a small maoral table with an exquisite floral arrangement placed neatly on it.

title: [Golden Helm, Bridal Suite]
description: The room is suffused with a warm amber glow from the multitude of candles arranged in the recesses cut into the stone walls.  Sheer saffron-colored drapes surround the large four-poster bed.  The scent from a vase filled with jasmine and ferns gently perfumes the air.  A thick, ivory colored wool carpet covers the floor.

title: [Golden Helm, Bedroom]
description: Rose petals are strewn across the stone floor, their delicious scent heightened with your every step.  The bedposts are each carved into the shape of a rose stem.  Folded linen towels, a pitcher of warm water, and a ceramic basin are on the small rosewood nightstand.

title: [Golden Helm, Bedroom]
description: A fine fishing net hung from the ceiling has been transformed into a comfortable hammock filled with several oversized pillows.  An overturned oak cask serves as the end table.  Seafaring memorabilia fill the oak shelves to the left of the hammock.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Lobby]
description: Thick and windowless marble walls enclose this rather spacious lobby, which is liberally decorated with the mounted heads of both exotic and mundane beasts.  The floor is covered with fine bearskin rugs and various specimens of antique dwarven stone furniture.  Overhead, a massive candle-lit chandelier adequately illuminates the area and provides for the impressive shadows cast by the various stuffed beasts arrayed about the room.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Shop]
description: Two heavy-set dwarven guards flank the entrance of this large, vault-like room.  A reinforced steel counter and screen near the front blocks off your access to most of the room, but beyond it you can see shelf after shelf loaded with weapons, armor, jewelry, and trinkets of all kinds.  Some of the goods look well used and rather plain, while others display an extravagance typically reserved for nobility.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Office]
description: A large glaes-trimmed desk dominates this small but well-kept office.  Papers and documents of all kinds are neatly stacked and organized on shelves that run the entire length of the walls.  On the ceiling, a large glass skylight allows the moonlight to flood the room, casting eerie shadows across the walls.

A large glaes-trimmed desk dominates this small but well-kept office.  Papers and documents of all kinds are neatly stacked and organized on shelves that run the entire length of the walls.  On the ceiling, a large glass skylight allows the sunlight to flood the room, reflecting beautiful rainbows of colors through the various crystal ornaments that hang near it.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Hollowed directly out of the mountain, this office is little more than a formalized cave.  The walls are cold and damp, and the floor is uneven.  An old mining cart holds stacks of bundled paper, and rough plank benches provide somewhere moderately comfortable to sit.  Guttering torches hang in wall brackets, darkening the ceiling with soot.

title: [Golvern Street, Rock Garden]
description: Four enormous pillars frame the block, their red-veined blue glaes contrasting sharply with the gold of the cobblestones.  An elven bard leans against one, gently strumming a mandolin and singing in a low, soothing voice.  A mithril-bound wooden gate leads out into the city proper.

title: [Rock Garden, Circle]
description: A wide, three-way wooden bridge arches over a small pond.  Huge, white water lilies float on the clear waters, and a school of golden fish cavorts below.  On a tiny bench, a young dwarven priest ignores the scene, nose buried in a leather-bound tome.

title: [Riverbank, Stone Path]
description: Across an expanse of well-tended grass, a ferry makes its way down the river to the west.  Shrubs are planted on each side of the path, pruned in the shape of miniature pillars.

title: [Rock Garden, Circle]
description: Sprouting from the golden glaes cobblestones is a fountain of black marble.  In its center are four dragons of carved ebony, upright, wings spread, claws extended and ready to tear.  From their wide-spread maws spout streams of water in a rainbow of reflected colors.

title: [Rock Garden, Circle]
description: The street here is paved with golden glaes, stout buildings of red and grey granite lining either side.  The honks, bleats and occasional squawk coming from one such tell you that someone is learning the tuba.  To the southeast is the edge of a small pond.

title: [Rock Garden, Boulders]
description: Three enormous blocks of red and grey granite have been carved into an abstract sculpture here.  Water flows down their sides, gathers in a small pool, then burbles off to the east.  Small goldfish make their way up and down this aquatic sidestreet.

title: [Rock Garden, North Wall]
description: The interior of the great city wall is lined with granite statues, all of dwarven or giantmen heroes.  A group of children plays among them, scampering about in a game of 'Dwarves and Orcs.'  An elven matron is seated on a bench opposite, keeping one eye on her book and the other on the heroes, past and future.

title: [Rock Garden, North Wall]
description: The interior of the north wall has been inset with a spectacular mosaic.  Red and gold glaes tiles form an abstract pattern suggestive of the sunset.  To the west, the river gurgles along opposite a low stone wall.

title: [Riverbank, Stone Path]
description: Just past the blocks of red and blue granite lining the path, a pair of picnic tables rest in the shade of an enormous fel tree.  An older human couple sits at one, holding hands and talking in low voices.

title: [Riverbank, Rocky Shore]
description: The river laps up against great grey and black rocks strewn about the shore.  Small birds flit about them and squabble like aging healers.  Someone has left a fishing pole propped up against a folding wooden chair.

title: [Riverbank, Rocky Shore]
description: Across the river, you can just make out the roofs and tents of the bazaar.  The distant hum of the crowd blends with the gurgling river.  The rocks of the shore extend out into the river, a stone finger pointed west.

title: [Riverbank, Rocky Shore]
description: A sharp jumble of grey and black rocks, as high as a halfling is tall, makes for a treacherous trip to the shore.  Nonetheless, one old dwarf has braved it, mumbling about near the riverbank with a bucket and small spade.

title: [Riverbank, Stone Path]
description: The path is lined with large rocks, eye-high to a dwarf, of alternating blue and red granite.  Someone has recently planted a row of modwir saplings among them.

title: [Rock Garden, North Beach]
description: The beach here is more sand than rock, though a couple of grey stone behemoths still provide a perch for a small flock of chattering birds.  Where the sand meets the grass, a stone-inlaid path leads to the southeast.

title: [Rock Garden, Shady Path]
description: A stand of tall modwir trees shades this stone-inlaid path.  An opening to the west leads to the beach.  A child's laugh drifts on the wind from that direction.

title: [Rock Garden, Dockside]
description: A small dock juts out from the beach.  The dinghy tied alongside thumps against a stone pillar in rhythm with the motion of the waves.

title: [Rock Garden, River Beach]
description: A dwarven head, all beard, bluster and sand, protrudes from a mound in the sand.  He glares up at his daughter and winks.  She scampers about in a circle, laughing and waving her spade.  A stand of modwir trees stands at the edge of the beach to the east.

title: [Swimming Hole, Rocky Path]
description: Large, water-smoothed stones lie neatly to form a path.  The stones range in color from subdued blues to fiery reds.  A pair of trees flank the path, breaking the moonlight.
Large, water-smoothed stones lie neatly to form a path.  The stones range in color from subdued blues to fiery reds.  A pair of trees flank the path, spreading shade throughout the area.

title: [Swimming Hole, Water's Edge]
description: A massive pool spreads out before you.  Flowing down several tall rocks, a quiet waterfall pours fresh water into the pool.  A massive slab of granite lies partially submerged, providing a gentle slope into the water.

title: [The Ample Larder]
description: The shop is devoid of any frivolous amneties.  A simple marble-topped counter dominates the room.  Assaulting the nose are the odors of a variety of meats, some cooked and some not, assaults the nose.  The smell of salt is also quite strong in the shops, obviously used in curing stores of meat.

title: [The Rising Tart]
description: A fine-grained wood counter separates the ordering area from the display and kitchen area.  A layer of flour seems to cover the entire kitchen except for the display and counter, which are meticulously clean.  A marble cutting board stands ready for use next to the display case, while pots of steaming coffee resting on grates above a wood fire flank the other side.  Large canvas bags of coffee beans slump against walls behind the counter.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Deck]
description: The deck is bordered by neatly trimmed evergreen hedges, a miniature forest even in the midst of town.  There are some chairs set in cozy groupings, and baskets of flowers swaying from the eaves of the Rest.  Tall iron posts on either side of some swinging doors support glowing lanterns.

The deck is bordered by neatly trimmed evergreen hedges, a miniature forest even in the midst of town.  There are some chairs set in cozy groupings, and baskets of flowers swaying from the eaves of the Rest.  Tall iron posts on either side of some swinging doors support simple lanterns.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Lobby]
description: Several sturdy chairs sit grouped in a corner of this dusty lobby.  A low murmur of conversation hangs in the air as various travellers pass by, occasionally stopping a moment to chat about the weather or share the latest gossip.  A group of sweating dwarves tow a heavy chest towards the door, grumbling as they strain at the tow ropes.

title: [Paspartu Moving Co., Office]
description: Precariously balanced crates and boxes line the walls of the office, marked with jagged dwarven scrawls.  Groups of dwarves wander in and out, slapping each other on the back and laughing as they drag more boxes in and out.  A mangy grey cat lies curled up in a corner, lazily peering at you with a mildly curious expression.

title: [Mud Baths, Stone Circle]
description: The tunnel crew drilled through to the open air above the baths in Stone Circle, letting light stream through and brighten up the cavernous neighborhood.  The surface of the roadway, although solid stone, was carved by artisans to resemble a flagstone road.  Some stones even bear swirling designs to further dress up the street.

title: [Meeting Hall, Clerk's Office]
description: A heavy stone desk dominates the room.  A lantern hanging above it does little to illuminate the desk surface; at best the lantern holds back the darkness from completing its conquest of the room.

title: [Eldaria's Outfitting]
[Eldaria's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a sturdy white cedar ceiling, a snarling war griffin painting hangs on one of the chipped red brick walls.  A large oak table and a splintered cargo crate sit in opposite corners while a verdant elderberry bush rests on a weathered cobblestone floor.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: Neat rows of tanik trees obscure the high walls of this roomy courtyard, their leaves draped across the rather rocky and otherwise bare earthen ground.  Squat monolithic stones sit to either side of the winding pathway that leads to the doors of a rough rock-hewn temple, their surfaces engraved with bold symbols.  A smaller structure of stone and iron stands to the east, partially obscured by the trees.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: A small shrine is set between a gap in the neatly-ordered rows of tanik trees planted along the walls.  The building is somewhat squat compared to its counterpart to the west, but has obviously been well-crafted.  A square arch of solid iron connects the door of the same metal to the highly polished granite walls, and the domed roof is coated with a finish of gleaming gold.  Two statues of dwarves holding crossed axes flank the entryway into the building.

title: [Wizard Guild, Shop]
description: Sunken into the sheer rock wall are several shelves and a display case.  A few feet away from the back of the shop stands a brass counter and a hooded lantern.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Scaffolding]
description: This scaffold rises against the ruined chamber's southern wall, much of which has been chipped away to reveal a thick vein of rainbow glaes.  If anything, the destruction of the room below looks worse from this height.  Large shadows shift unnaturally upon the ceiling, a disturbing sign that this mine is not wholly abandoned.

title: [Canyon, Stone Stairs]
description: A narrow set of stone stairs, carved into the reddish rock of the canyon, leads upwards.  A few shacks have been built along the stairs, precariously mounted on rock ledges and niches.  Small lizards sun themselves on the stairs, skittering away from passing feet.

title: [Canyon, Gecko Ledge]
description: A broad ledge extends around the curve of the canyonside, overlooking the road and the river below.  A few hardy trees have taken root in the shallow soil, providing a perch to a host of birds who cry out as travellers pass below.

title: [Canyon, Gecko Ledge]
description: A faint breeze blowing up from the river adds a hint of moisture to the air, but the craggy rocks and sparse trees on the ledge are dry.  Several small lizards cling to the rock wall of the canyon, their faded brown color almost blending into the reddish stone.  A steep trail winds up the canyon wall.

title: [Canyon, Gecko Ledge]
description: A narrow trail climbs northeast, angling precariously up the canyon wall.  Several small cactus plants grow in the dry soil, their blooms a brilliant red in the sunlight.  The sounds of loggers and adventurers passing on the road below occasionally break the silence.

title: [Canyon, Gecko Ledge]
description: The ledge ends in a huge rock outcropping that forms a solid face of stone, etched with striations of red and brown.  A few small homes are set back against the canyon wall, taking advantage of what little shade is offered.  A huge lizard suns himself atop the outcropping, slowly flicking his long tail.

title: [Canyon, Rocky Trail]
description: The trail curves upward towards the top of the canyon ridge, winding past reddish stone boulders and small houses arranged among the cacti and dry trees.  The river glistens far below, its calm waters silvery in the bright sun.

title: [Canyon, Siren's Path]
description: The trail winds along the south side of the ridge, curving through patches of sparse trees and shrubs as it follows the curve of the canyon wall.  Small sand-colored lizards scurry along the nooks and crannies of the stone wall.  The gates of Kharam-Dzu are visible through the trees some distance to the south.

title: [Canyon, Siren's Path]
description: The mist-covered moors and the dark sea beyond are visible far in the distance past the eastern edge of the canyon.  Scrubby bushes and cacti surround small cottages nestled against the canyon wall, where primitive paintings of several fierce siren lizards are etched on the red stone.

title: [Canyon, Siren's Path]
description: The trail ends in a set of stone stairs carved into the canyon wall, leading up to the ridge above.  A cluster of flowering cactus at the edge of the trail provides a home to several small green lizards which crawl among the spiny plants, searching for insects.

title: [Canyon, Iguana Circle]
description: The path winds along the relatively flat top of the ridge, circling around a huge pile of craggy, reddish boulders.  Dozens of lizards of a variety of colors and sizes crawl and skitter around the rocks, resting or hunting for food among the cacti and tufts of dry grass.  A rocky trail leads down along the canyon wall.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, northwest, down

title: [Canyon, Iguana Circle]
description: A steep slope covered with impassable craggy rocks and thick gnarls of cactus plants drops off to the east.  The vista of foggy moors and the dark sea far in the distance provides an odd contrast to the arid, sun-scorched ridge.

title: [Canyon, Dragon's Ridge]
description: A ridge of red stone, arching like the back of a sleeping dragon, runs along the east side of the trail, blocking the view of the sea in that direction.  Cacti and aloes cluster along the ridge, some blooming in splashes of color against the dry stone.

title: [Canyon, Iguana Circle]
description: The canyon wall falls off into a steep cliff.  Several small houses perch precariously near the edge of the precipice, enjoying a view of the canyon and the river and misty mountains beyond.  Lizards skitter in the dry grass, climbing onto the pile of stones on the other side of the path to enjoy the sunlight.

title: [Canyon, Iguana Circle]
description: A greenish, four-foot lizard sprawls on a large rock by the path, eyeing passersby as if they were oversized bugs.  Cactus plants as tall as a human grow here along the sunny ridge, their colorful flowers attracting a swarm of bees.

title: [Canyon, Dragon's Ridge]
description: Sparse grasses and rocks cover the expanse between the red stone ridge and the steep trail that leads down the canyon wall to the west.  Several large spiny lizards wander along the top of the ridge, scurrying after bugs or reclining lazily in the sun.

title: [Canyon, Dragon's Ridge]
description: The trail turns sharply, winding around the end of the ridge of red stone that forms the backbone of the canyon ridge.  Cacti and flowering plants arranged among the shacks and cottages frame a view of the town of Kharam-Dzu far below to the south.

title: [Canyon, Dragon's Ridge]
description: A row of small houses are set along the east side of the red stone ridge, facing the view of the mist-shrouded sea far in the distance.  Piles of grey and red boulders line the edge of the canyon where it drops off to the moors below, and a set of stairs carved into the stone lead down to the south.

title: [Teras Isle, Sapling Thicket]
description: The new growth trees are thick with tropical underbrush, however an opening in the heavy scrub where the path connects with the logging road is already being established through them.  Obviously, either wildlife or two-legged travelers are coming this way on a fairly regular basis.  To the west, the forbidding wall of Greymist stands dense and mysterious.

title: [Teras Isle, Forest Edge]
description: The path ends at Greymist's feet, where a clearing marks the demarcation between forest and the younger saplings.  This portion of the tropical woodlands appears to be a finger of trees stretching south from the greater body of Greymist.  The belt of jungle stands along the edge of cliffs, which overlook the sea.  The distant sound of the surf provides a soft background of thunder, as waves buffet the rocky escarpments.  The trail narrows and winds into the jungle foliage.

title: [Teras Isle, Forest Trail]
description: The trail twists and turns, winding around tropical vegetation that grows with lush abandon.  Flowers cluster about the feet of palms and bloom from vines climbing the trees' trunks, with leaves so large, they could shelter a person from a heavy downpour.  The narrow track dwindles toward the south, where the verdure becomes thicker and the flowers more extravagant.

title: [Glade]
description: Banyan trees and verdant flowering vines ring the cobbled flagstones of a small glade.  Half obscured by foliage on the glade's far side stands a tall, stone wall that frames an arched, vultite-banded door.  The vultite is not the door's only guard.  Perched on a stone outcrop above is a large, black-plumed hawk.  His demeanor appears as menacing as his impressive size and talons, as he surveys the glade's perimeter with a predatory gaze.

title: [Jungle Path]
description: A narrow path loops through the thick jungle, its progress impeded by leaves as large as a halfling and trailing vines that hang down from above.  The heat hangs over the thick verdure like a curtain, so heavy it feels like it should be visible.  Visibility is limited to the area within a few feet about, however unseen insects raise a din in all directions.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: The crease of a small valley marks the last dip before the rise of the volcano.  Mist filters down through the branches above and pools between various jagged rocks that have tumbled together at the lowest point of the defile.  Large, sloppy nests crown many of the rocks, but the inhabitants are nowhere to be seen.

title: [Greymist Wood, Volcanic Slope]
description: A small waterfall rains down from a low cliff above.  The air is humid, fed by spray that spatters across the wide rubbery leaves of the mistwoods.  The creek bed gathers what moisture manages to make it to the ground into a small but fast moving stream that meanders off into the wood.

title: [Greymist Branch]
description: A wide branch extends east from the bole of the ficus tree, its girth as wide as a road.  Fringes of liana vines give it a veiny look, as if the smooth surface of the tree is covered with skin stretched over its lattice of blood vessels.  Night birds dart among the verdure, squawking and filling the canopy with shadowy movement.  A tangle of vines hangs down from higher branches, providing a busy highway to long streams of ants and other insects.

Bright birds dart among the verdure, squawking and filling the canopy with melody and movement. title: [Greymist Branch]
description: The branch extends through the canopy like a moon-dappled thoroughfare, edged with a complex pattern of vines inset with orchids on either side.  Beams of moonlight penetrate the foliage here and there, dappling the fig tree's smooth bark.  Around the branch's sides, the forest floor is lost in darkness.

Rays of sunlight penetrate the foliage here and there, dappling the fig tree's smooth bark.  Around the branch's sides, the forest floor can be glimpsed far below, overgrown with mounds of bromeliads and forest cucumbers.

title: [Greymist Branch]
description: The bough divides into smaller branches, which begin steep arcs up toward the life-giving sky above the forest canopy.  Trailing roots from clinging tank bromeliads give the fig branches a mossy appearance in the moonlight.  One monstrous specimen has sprouted off the main bough's edge, sporting long spiked leaves and huge flowers.

Trailing roots from clinging tank bromeliads give the fig branches a mossy appearance in the green-tinged light.  One monstrous specimen has sprouted off the main bough's edge, and a myriad of water insects can be seen within the well in the plant's center.

title: [Stormbrow Gallery, Lobby]
description: Sunlight filters in throught the gates, glittering off a wide staircase that leads upward, spiraling round and round beneath the enormous, glass dome ceiling.  The room is quite spacious, and though sparsely decorated, exudes a sense of elegance and respect.

The moonlight adds an ethereal glow to the torchlight in the room.  A wide staircase leads upward, spiraling round and round beneath the enormous, glass dome ceiling.  Even at night, the sparsely decorated room exudes a sense of elegance and respect.  A seemingly endless blue-black sky glitters with the hundreds of white starstones that dangle from the ceiling far overhead.

title: [Volcanic Slope, Rock Terraces]
description: A large formation of rock slopes up the hillside, overhanging a dark, surging torrent of water rushing beneath it.  Spray from the stream wets the stone, nourishing patches of moss and intermittent clumps of plants proffering small flowers.  The expanse of rock works its way up the hillside in stepped terraces, broken here and there by low scrub brush.

A large formation of granite slopes up the hillside, overhanging a surging torrent of water rushing beneath it.  Spray from the stream wets the stone, nourishing patches of moss and intermittent clumps of plants proffering small blue flowers.  The expanse of rock works its way up the hillside in stepped terraces, broken here and there by low scrub brush.

title: [Volcanic Slope, Stream Overlook]
description: To the north, the granite rock tilts steeply up necessitating a climb, while to the northeast, the way follows the course of the dark, rushing sluice.  Small pools of water dot the face of the stone terrace, collected from the ever-present spray.  Moonlight glints off the pools' surfaces, showing occasional ripples that betray the presence of denizens within their limited domain.

Small pools of water dot the face of the stone terrace, collected from the ever-present spray, and gulls stalk their edges in search of small crustaceans.  The querulous birds create a din with their raucous cries.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southwest, west, up

title: [Volcanic Slope, Seven Falls]
description: The overlook approaches a series of seven immense waterfalls cascading down the mountainside to the east.  As the ledge nears the cataracts, the air is saturated with humidity from the rain of spray.  Ferns grow to lavish size, rooted in patches of earth, and palms wave huge fronds dripping with condensation.

title: [Volcanic Slope, Waterfall]
description: At the foot of the torrential seventh waterfall, spray creates a continuous downpour, showering the imposing ferns and palms growing here and making footing uncertain on the slippery rock.  Moonlight plays off the mist generated by the moisture-laden air, a silvery haze that bathes the scene in a dream-like ambiance.  The noise of the falls is deafening, a low roar that reverberates off the stone cliffs beneath the torrent.

Rainbows waver in the moisture-laden air, appearing first one place, and then another as ocean breezes shift the spray raining down from the falls.  The noise of the falls is deafening, a low roar that reverberates off the stone cliffs beneath the torrent.

title: [Volcanic Slope, Risky Footing]
description: The slope is barely passable, so steep is its incline.  Deep cracks in the granite offer a foothold to a few hardy plants able to withstand the high winds of an occasional squall blowing in from the ocean.  To the east, a panoramic moonlit view of an impressive series of seven waterfalls cascading down the craggy mountainside makes the hazardous climb seem worth the effort.  Below, an equally dramatic view of a geyser field, with its rich, undulating concentric rings of color, can be seen.

title: [Volcanic Slope, Abyss]
description: Where granite gives way to the native basalt of the mountainside, any further movement upward is blocked by a deep slash.  It sunders the peak's side in a grievous wound that penetrates so deeply, the bottom is lost in darkness.  Nothing grows on the lips of the abyss other than a few patches of moss.  Mist drifts on air currents rising from the depths, illuminated by moonlight playing over the fog's insubstantial undulations.

title: [Volcanic Slope, Stand of Palms]
description: After branching off from the granite formation to the east, the trail dead ends at a shadowy stand of palms.  The trees are densely planted, with immense, spiked fronds that do as much to block further travel as the boles.  A thick growth of jungle undergrowth crowds at the foot of the palms, betraying the presence of fertile earth nestled in a pocket of the lava rock.

After branching off from the granite formation to the east, the trail dead ends at a stand of palms.  The trees are densely planted, with immense, spiked fronds that do as much to block further travel as the boles.  A thick growth of jungle undergrowth crowds at the foot of the palms, betraying the presence of fertile earth nestled in a pocket of the lava rock.

title: [Hog's Pen]
description: This rugged tavern is a single great hall, windowless and choked with smoke from its blazing hearth and the long pipes favored by many of the local dwarves.  Tables and benches are scattered about, clumped here and there in bunches where a large group of miners or a logging team has staked a claim.  A row of barrels set on end near the fire and tended by a gruff bearded fellow seems to serve as a bar.  Around it, rain and ale have softened the dirt floor to mud.

title: [Hog's Pen]
description: Here at the farthest end of the hall the fire is just a hazy glow, long shadows lie across the floor, and the smoke paws you like a drunken mercenary.  The dark figures bent together nearby sit here for just that reason and scowl at your approach as though they owned the sawdust under your boots.  They're an ugly lot.

title: [Teras Isle, Hardened Lava Bed]
description: A small canyon runs down the mountain side.  Hardened lava fills it almost completely, providing a natural road that is welcome after the harsh rock below.  The air is thick with the smell of sulfur and clouds rise fitfully from somewhere above.  This is one bed that nobody is likely to be sleeping in.

A small canyon runs down the mountain side.  Hardened lava fills it almost completely, providing a natural road that is welcome after the harsh rock below.  The air is thick with the smell of sulfur and yellow clouds rise fitfully from somewhere above.  This is one bed that nobody is likely to be sleeping in.

title: [Teras Isle, Grasslands]
description: Shallow rolling hills and lush, tall meadows occupy this wide stretch of land.  The wind blows quietly, causing the tall grass to wave about you, dipping and swaying as in a carefully choreographed dance.  The dancers crowd down the hills toward the sea.

Shallow rolling hills and lush, tall meadows occupy this wide stretch of land.  The wind blows quietly, causing the tall grass to wave about you, dipping and swaying as in a carefully choreographed dance.  The dancers crowd down the hills toward the sea, turning from green to yellow to grey as they pass away, as if wiping off grease paint at the end of a long night.

title: [Teras Isle, Grasslands]
description: The hills flatten into the earth and the wind whistles bitterly across the ground.  The grasses are thin here, and hang together in fitful clumps for shelter from the wind.  The very spirit of life seems to lose hope as it approaches the forlorn cliffs below.

The hills flatten into the earth and the wind whistles bitterly across the ground.  The grasses are yellow here, and hang together in fitful clumps for shelter from the wind.  The very spirit of life seems to lose hope as it approaches the forlorn cliffs below.

title: [Teras Isle, Moor]
description: A desolate plain stretches away across the island.  Windswept shrubs and tufts of hardy grass cling to the otherwise barren ground.  The constant howl of cold air from the eastern cliffs beats down all but the hardiest life here, including any two-legged intruders.

title: [Teras Isle, Moor]
description: Sky, sea, and soil blend together in a monotonous haze of darkness.  The only breaks in the dreary sameness are the occasional sulfurous mist that drifts down the volcanic slopes to the north and the jagged black line to the east that marks the cliffs known as the Dark Palisade.

Sky, sea, and soil blend together in a monotonous haze of grey.  The only breaks in the dreary sameness are the occasional sulfurous mist that drifts down the volcanic slopes to the north and the jagged black line to the east that marks the cliffs known as the Dark Palisade.

title: [Dark Palisade, Lovers' Leap]
description: The desolate moor gives up life to a jagged cliff of jet black volcanic rock and the grey sea beyond.  Cold wind carries the spray of the waves below against the rocks and howls up the face of the cliff below.  It draws a mournful wail from the dark stone as it hurtles onto the moor, blowing the tenacious shrubs into drawn and flat shadows of their normal shapes.
