title: [Dark Palisade]
description: Dark black cliffs march south in a long wall valiantly holding off the angry storm-blown sea of the eastern shore.  To the north, the brooding volcano rolls down into the sea, its sides marred by the streaks of lava flows seen from afar.  Some are little more than smudges of soot and fantastic rock formations, others still crawl and hiss their way unwillingly into the breakers.

title: [Dark Palisade, Fissure]
description: Black volcanic rocks rise abruptly from the sea forming a wall against the furious tide.  To the east, malignant clouds blot the horizon in a roiling storm front.  Several fissures split the dark rock nearby, one looks as if it is dormant.  The largest spits an almost constant geyser of boiling steam and black ash.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: The tunnel stretches away in either direction as far as the eye can see, which is not a long ways at all back into the gale that blows down from the east.  To the west, the passage slopes ever downward.  If you were to set a wizard's crystal sphere upon the ground, it is easy to imagine it rolling before the wind forever.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: A single crack mars the side of the tunnel here.  It must surely have appeared in a fairly recent trembling of the island floating here at sea, for the wind does not seem to have smoothed its rough edges.  You might be tempted to run a finger over those rough edges, but for the skeletal hand wedged between them.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: The tunnel widens and narrows as it bores inland and slightly down.  The unpredictable wind has carved ripples and swirls along the smooth rock surface, and what few imperfections remain are smoothed over by a slick film of sea foam and moss.  Eastward the roar of the surf can be heard faintly above the howl of the wind.  A pale glimmer marks where the tunnel mouth sucks air from the stormy sea.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: A thin divider of smooth volcanic rock splits the tunnel here for a few feet.  Somehow this bit of stone has managed to survive in the face of constant blasting air.  The moss that covers the tunnel toward the mouth to the east quickly gives up in the howling depths to the west.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: While the rampaging wind and fecund moss prevent a close inspection, the cliff rock seems to be of a hardness approaching glaes.  The wildly vacillating shape of the tunnel itself suggests that it might once have been a series of bubbles trapped when the earth vomited up this island long ago.  If so, the wind and sea have long since broken through the rock between the bubbles, carving them into a single passageway.

title: [Dark Palisade, Tunnel Mouth]
description: The tunnel flares out into a wide slippery mouth yawning at the sea.  A pair of long stalactites hang from above like the fangs of a great snake, and the wind whistles into the cave with a sibilant hiss.  Below the surf claws at the cliff face, slowly rending the rocks with bestial ferocity no less terrifying for the eons it will take to tear away the island's flesh.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: The wind is cold, and not the sort of cold that can be staved off with a thick woolen cloak and a flask of brandy.  It's a cold that radiates from the bone marrow, slowly seeping outward until, finally, even the skin turns numb.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: In the roof of the tunnel is a dark hollow.  The wind swirls and eddies in a furious vortex, leading you to the conclusion that there must be some passageway above.  But there is no way to reach the hollow or climb through it over the featureless wind-blown stone.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: Cold glassy walls close in on either side and the wind whistles between with increased ferocity.  The floor drops rapidly to the west.  For a moment it occurs to you that travelling down is much easier than travelling up.  There is no sound but the screaming of the evil wind, and somewhere, almost lost beneath it, the beating of your heart.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: The tunnel seems oddly warm here despite the vicious gale ripping in from the sea behind.  From somewhere far ahead a dull red glow pulsates unevenly in the perpetual gloom.  The wind rushes forward anxiously, but perhaps this path was never meant to be taken by mortals.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: Westward, a pale red circle gleams like the moon reflecting in a pool of blood.  The walls are dry as bone and warm to the touch.  The floor is rougher than elsewhere, black and broken like the stone of an old hearth.  Perhaps more than wind and wicked souls have passed this way.

title: [Luukos' Gullet, Overhang]
description: Howling wind bursts out into a vast cavern deep within the bowels of the island.  A cataclysmic struggle rages below you, throwing up as much light as the noonday sun, and far more heat.  A river of lava flows through, pooling in a natural cauldron at the center.  Waves pour into this elemental stew, instantly turning into steam and joining the whirling winds above.  The chamber is capped with a great stone grate of sorts, stone masonry with dozens of man-sized holes through which the steam passes.

title: [Luukos' Gullet, Quiet Niche]
description: Wide overhanging stalactites shelter this quiet spot.  Thick moss grows heartily along the walls and ceiling.  A damp breeze blows through, as soothing as the gale outside is unwholesome, and every now and then a drop of crystal clear water falls from a tuft of moss into a perfectly round natural basin in the floor.  The smooth surface of the little pool ripples for only a moment, and then returns to a calming stillness.

title: [Luukos' Gullet, Slick Ledge]
description: The ledge is wet and hot to the touch.  Just holding on is a chore, and blasts of steam slap against the rock as if hoping to tear all life away and hurl it into the vengeful maelstrom.  Down below a dark opening seems to lead to a tunnel from the crashing surf, for every now and then a great wave crashes in, only to be vaporized almost instantly as it meets the lava flow.

title: [Luukos' Gullet, Outcropping]
description: Miraculously, a jagged bit of rock extends out into the abyss forming a wide, if somewhat curved and rough, shelf.  Searing wind, steam, and the odd chunk of molten rock hurtle upward on three sides of this hellish oasis.  Even with the bit of shelter the outcropping provides, there are few solid handholds here, and the only beings likely to want to stand here would have to be immortal, fire-proof, or suicidal.

title: [Luukos' Gullet, Narrow Hollow]
description: Bursts of hot gas, disturbed in their upward flight by the outcropping just beneath you, have charred a shallow indentation in the stone.  It's just enough room to squeeze into, although it takes quite a bit of squirming to keep from sliding off into the abyss.  Someone has carved a message near the base, but it is difficult to make out the charred letters.

title: [Luukos' Gullet, Wide Ledge]
description: By the standards of the "path" below, this ledge is a vast expanse of land stretching a luxurious ten feet in either direction.  The heat of the fiery cauldron still brings sweat to the brow, and the fumes choke anyone fool enough to stand.  With a start, you notice a huge stone snake head staring at you.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Antechamber]
description: This chamber has been formed by a huge air bubble trapped inside of gleaming black volcanic glass.  Two lifelike statues of black ora tower against the far wall, one slightly smaller than the other.  You can hear muffled sounds coming from a hallway to the north and there is a ghastly red light glowing from the south.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Alcove]
description: Dark red light emanates from the obsidian walls and ceiling, and the scent of thick, cloying incense fills the room.  Six high-backed chairs are arranged in perfect symmetry around a circular marble table.  You feel a sudden dread, as if you shouldn't be here at all, and glance about apprehensively.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Hallway]
description: Chisled into the obsidian walls of this Hallway of Souls are intricate carvings depicting scenes of bloody rituals, torturous deaths, and pain-stricken faces twisted in horror.  Odd noises escape through a small barred window set into a heavy cell door here.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Chamber]
description: One entire wall of this circular chamber is made of thin clear glass, and through it you can see the fiery cauldron of Luukos' Gullet far below.  A large multi-faceted crystal orb lies cradled in a marble stand directly in front of the window, and a long black marble altar stands next to the orb.  From far away, you can hear the sounds of chaotic chimes ringing discordantly.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Altar]
description: You are standing before the Altar of Sacrifice.  It has been fashioned of green-veined black marble, and a pair of manacles are fastened to each end.  The surface of the altar is quite glossy, yet the floor is sticky with dark red stains.  Feeling a bit nervous, you wonder if you should leave before someone mistakes you for the next sacrifice.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: Along the edge of the chamber a great circle of statues stands shoulder to shoulder.  The statues stare forward unblinking, each almost identical to the next.  Odd that the sculptors could recreate their work a hundred fold so perfectly.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: The silent sentinels gaze blankly across the boiling chamber, steamy sweat pouring down their brows and pooling about their wide, glistening feet.  The southern wall of the chamber is slick with water, and a thin white cloud billows across the roof, sharp drops of scalding rain sizzling on the floor in every direction.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: Here, at the far end of the chamber from the odd membrane in the east wall, two statues lean together, their bases shattered.  Apart from these two, the statues marching away in either direction seem unharmed.  A splotch of what appears to be dried blood covers the chest of one.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: The constant roar of steam passing through the chamber all but deafens you.  Looking out toward the center of the great room it is impossible to see clearly across for all the columns of steam.  Still, in the raging mist you can make out the dim shapes of the far rim.  A trick of refracted light makes it look as though one of them is stumbling toward you.  It must be a bit of heat stroke.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: The outer rim curves southward to an odd shiny depression on the east wall and westward into a hazy fog of steam.  The walls echo with the sibilant hiss of steam, and somewhere just at the edge of mortal senses, a more sinister sound slips across the chamber.  Older than the liquid stone thrown up from Elanthia's heart and colder than the Dark Moon circling above, the faintest echo of Luukos' forked tongue echoes out of your imagination and plays across your soul.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: A vast chamber lies before you.  Throughout the room, columns of steam roar from floor to ceiling, simultaneously in turmoil and motionless.  The whole place appears to sit like a sieve across the expanse of the great volcanic cavern known as Luukos' Gullet, and matching holes in floor and ceiling force the steam into momentary liquid pillars before it finds the vent of the fissure above.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: A clear glaes window sits in the floor here.  Peering through its hazy thickness yields a startling view of great clouds of steam howling from the churning chaos below.  Some priest of Luukos must have liked the view, but then that's not surprising.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: Water sweats from the ceiling, disappearing between the flagstones of the floor.  No doubt any that seeps all the way into the chamber below is vaporized quickly enough and recycled.  Now and then, a mischance causes one of the columns of steam to waver and a cloud of scalding vapor billows across the room.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: At the center of the chamber, the combined heat given off by the steam columns is almost unbearable.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: A section of the stone ceiling has broken away, revealing a web-like lattice of black glaes beneath.  With a shudder you try to imagine the unholy spider that could spin a web of unbreakable volcanic glass across a hundred foot chimney filled with fire and steam.  At least there is the hope that such an abomination, its labor complete, would have perished from the strain.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Steam Chamber]
description: The flagstones of the floor are hot to the touch.  In such a place, empathy for the plight of plucked turkeys and roasted roltons before a feast comes unbidden.  You shake yourself from your momentary reverie to notice the uncanny stare of one of the snakeman statues fixed in your direction.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Damp Valve]
description: Water pours down the walls in rivulets and puddles on the floor.  The pressure feels greater here than in the depths of the deepest dwarven mine.  The whole room almost seems to throb.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Dusty Passage]
description: Dusty maelstroms in miniature swirl across the floor, settling over a scattering of rodent trails.  A horde of motionless serpents crawls the walls and ceiling, trapped by some slave's brush.  Unable to strike, spit, or coil around intruders, they stare petulantly and slowly shed their painted skin.

title: [Temple of Luukos, Cell]
description: Two dessicated corpses are propped up against one wall, the remains of clothing draped around them.  Their arms are raised high above them, locked into manacles set into the wall.  The floor is covered with grime and rubble, and out of the corner of your eye, you swear you can see the floor moving.  Looking closer, you realize the movement is due to the hundreds of large rats scurrying about inside.

title: [Luukos' Gullet, Collapsed Vent]
description: A natural chimney twists upward through various large and small caves toward a crack of light far above.  Below, a jumble of debris and masonry marks where the chimney has been, fortunately, cut off from the steamy chaos of Luukos' Gullet.

title: [Cottage, Main Room]
description: This small stone cottage might have been spared the destructive wave of fire, were it not for the wooden roof, which must have exploded in a fiery blaze of heat.  Overhead, charred rafters balance precariously on their moorings.  Great hunks of cinder blanket the room, obscuring whatever furnishings might still remain beneath.

title: [Cottage, Bedroom]
description: A foul smelling, sodden mass near the center of the room was probably once a bed.  The weight of the soaked mattress eventually became too much for the bed frame, which has completely collapsed.  Wispy tendrils of moonlight filter in through the canopy of singed beams overhead, flickering over an odd assortment of toadstools that have now taken root in the dirt and soot covering the old mattress.

A foul smelling, sodden mass near the center of the room was probably once a bed.  The weight of the soaked mattress eventually became too much for the bed frame, which has completely collapsed.  Wispy tendrils of light filter in through the canopy of singed beams overhead, flickering over an odd assortment of toadstools that have now taken root in the dirt and soot covering the old mattress.

title: [Cottage, Kitchen]
description: Rusted buckets are everywhere, probably the remnants of a futile effort to save this small cottage from the fire.  Although the fire barely touched this room, the subsequent exposure to the elements all but destroyed it.  Shattered dishes and broken pots are strewn around the room, as if left by some overgrown, petulant child.

title: [Fhorian Village, Storage Shed]
description: Though the storage shed was barely touched by the fire, this room is in shambles.  The limb of a large tree outside, apparently broken off during a storm, now juts downward from a gaping hole in the ceiling.  Sacks of grain have been ripped open, their contents combining with years of rain, to form a thick, sticky paste on the floor.

title: [Fhorian Village, Storage Shed]
description: Slender beams of moonlight reflect softly off the huge earthenware crocks that line the walls of this room.  Most of the containers are still intact, though the lids are nowhere in sight.
Slender beams of light reflect softly off the huge earthenware crocks that line the walls of this room.  Most of the containers are still intact, though the lids are nowhere in sight.

title: [Blacksmithy, Workroom]
description: The fire that ravaged the workroom did surprising little damage other than to the structure itself.  The ceiling is completely burned out leaving only the debris from the beams on the floor.  The walls are charred black and the bricks are cracked from the intense heat -- but the work objects of the room remain intact.

title: [Blacksmithy, Forge]
description: Designed to handle the heat of fires that would melt even the hardest of metals, the forge is mostly intact.  The rest of the room is not.  The giant bellows was mostly wood and leather, and is charred and unusable.  Even the balanced chainfall used to operate the bellows will no longer perform its function.  Ages of rain falling through the roof have rusted it and frozen it in place.

title: [Blacksmithy, Sales Room]
description: Most of the items for sale in this room lie in a heap upon the floor.  Although the fire did not destroy many of the items, it did destroy the wooden shelves and the display case that housed them, thus dropping them into unordered piles on the floor.  There is a stack of spearpoints in the corner -- their shafts burned away.

title: [Fhorian Village, Meeting Hall]
description: This wooden building was utterly destroyed by fire.  The ceiling caved in completely, and now crunches beneath your feet.  The vines that seem to be everywhere have nearly overtaken this wrecked structure, spiraling up around the remaining supports, and crisscrossing overhead to form a living roof.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: Most of the buildings in this ghost of a village have been ransacked and burned.  Here and there, a few structures have managed to survive the combined assaults of flame and nature's fury, but none remain completely unscathed.

title: [Mercantile, Display Room]
description: Blackened and charred hulks, the remains of the counters display cases that filled the room, are all that's left of some merchant's fine wares.  Barrels of salt have burned and melted into piles of sooty slag.  Metal tools and implements have melted together into heaps of useless scrap.  The destruction here was total.

title: [Mercantile, Display Room]
description: The finest silks and linens were once sold at this counter, as evidenced by a few charred wooden spools, wrapped in horribly burned remnants of fabric.  Only a small portion of the great counter remains, and even that is burnt almost beyond recognition.

title: [Mercantile, Back Room]
description: Worktables and chairs were reduced to kindling in the great fire, and are now little more than blackened sticks of wood.  Ruined barrels line the room, their contents of flour, sugar, and salt, now mixing with soot to form a black, sticky paste on the floor.

title: [Inn, Main Room]
description: This room is where the fire seems to have done the most damage.  Only the great size of this room prevents it from being impassable as the remnants of chairs, benches, and wall tapestries line the floor.  Even the decorative armor that lined the walls has been turned mostly to a slag of metal by the great heat generated by the fire.

title: [Inn, Dining Room]
description: The ceiling of this room has been badly damaged and the second floor of the inn entirely burned away.  Gaping holes in the ceiling and the walls and the shattered windows have exposed the interior to the ravages of the elements and the creeping invasion of vines and other small plants.  The tables, chairs and other small pieces of furniture all bear marks of damage from both fire and weather.

title: [Temple, West Hall]
description: The holiness of this temple did little to preserve it from the ravages of fire that swept through the village.  The roof has been badly damaged and is falling in at many places.  Charred tatters are all that remain of the tapestries that once graced this room.  An ebony door sags from its hinges on one wall, and a vine covered doorway is barely visible to the northwest.

title: [Temple, Altar]
description: The destruction here was total, and unforgiving.  The stone altar that still stands in the center of the room is covered with ash, and there are no clear signs of what lord or lords were once honored here.

title: [Temple, East Hall]
description: The fire that swept through the hall left little behind that is recognizable.  A few burned and ruined pews, some singed tatters of tapestries, and a few lumps of charred wood left in niches around the walls are all that remain.

title: [Constabulary, Back Room]
description: Someone or something has thoroughly searched this room.  The tall storage cabinet standing in one corner has been broken into and ransacked, and the cot that stood along one wall has been overturned and broken into several pieces.

title: [Constabulary, Hallway]
description: This short hallway is marked by two small grates that allow a dim light to filter in, and two iron-bound doors on opposite walls.  The poorly circulated air is stuffy and carries a slightly sour odor.

title: [Constabulary, Office]
description: This solid stone structure withstood the fire that destroyed the rest of the village.  However, it is obvious that the place has been ransacked.  The weapons rack on one wall has been broken open and is now empty while the desk in one corner has been thoroughly searched and overturned.

title: [Constabulary, Cell]
description: Here lie the skeletal remains of a long dead occupant, still locked into heavy chains.  Whatever crime the poor, wretched soul committed, whatever justice was meted out, the final result was imprisonment until death.

title: [Constabulary, Cell]
description: There is no comfort in this small, dank cell.  A pile of rotting straw in one corner provides the only bedding, and a single narrow slit high on one wall allows a solitary shaft of pale moonlight to pierce the gloom of the cell.

There is no comfort in this small, dank cell.  A pile of rotting straw in one corner provides the only bedding, and a single narrow slit high on one wall allows a solitary shaft of pale sunlight to pierce the gloom of the cell.

title: [Teras Isle, Fhorian Village]
description: Close proximity to the coast seems to do very little to moisten the dry dust and cinder laden air that now burns the back of your throat.  Here at the intersection of the three major paths that cut through the village, you are surrounded by the charred remains of this once beautiful community.

title: [Small House, Living Room]
description: The heat from the great fire must have been very intense here, for the structure that remains is little more than a burned out shell now.  Moonlight pours through gaping cracks in the walls and ceiling, illuminating the dust particles that fly into the air with each movement.

The heat from the great fire must have been very intense here, for the structure that remains is little more than a burned out shell now.  Light pours through gaping cracks in the walls and ceiling, illuminating the dust particles that fly into the air with each movement.

title: [Small House, Kitchen]
description: The inside of this room has been completely gutted by flames.  Nothing remains except for a few blackened pots, now deformed by the intense heat of the fire.

title: [Small House, Bedroom]
description: Voracious flames attacked this room as well, blackening the walls and ceiling, and turning most of the furniture into crumbling cinder.  A small mattress has been slashed open, its stuffing spilling out next to the smashed remains of a wooden rocking horse.  The smoke covered faces of ceramic dolls, crushed beneath some terrible force, stare up woefully from the ashes that cover the floor.

title: [Fhorian Village, Storage Shed]
description: Soft tendrils of moonlight poke through the cracks in the wall, illuminating thick curtains of cobwebs hanging from the rafters.  A pile of straw in one corner hints that someone may have lived here at one time -- but that must have been years ago, judging from the heavy layer of dust that covers everything.

Soft tendrils of light poke through the cracks in the wall, illuminating thick curtains of cobwebs hanging from the rafters.  A pile of straw in one corner hints that someone may have lived here at one time -- but that must have been years ago, judging from the heavy layer of dust that covers everything.

title: [Fisherman's Guild, West Hall]
description: A pile of burnt and crumbling logs is all that remains of the broad stairs that once led to a second story of this large building.  Only the stone foundation and walls of the first floor survived the devastating fire.  Most of the ceiling is gone, exposing the inside of the building to the weather.

title: [Fisherman's Guild, East Hall]
description: The thick layers of soot, ash, and the collected debris of the passing of time, all but obscure the intricate mosaic set into the stone floor of this large hall.  The sign of the fish is everywhere, incorporated even into the stones of the building's foundation.

title: [Fisherman's Guild, Office]
description: The ceiling has collapsed in this room, and the long row of wooden cabinets that once held the guild records for generations past has nearly been destroyed by the fire and exposure to the elements.  The heat here was so intense, that glass from the window looking out from this room melted, running down the wall to form a puddle on the floor.

title: [Fhorian Village, Storage Shed]
description: This room must have housed the armor as well as the extra blades.  You can see shelves to the west which have labels attached to them.  Looking closer you see that they identify the size and strength of the armor each shelf was to hold.  The weapon rack that would house all the swords is empty.  Nothing has been left behind that could be of any value to you.

title: [Fhorian Village, Storage Shed]
description: The room here is empty except for the vines which reach out everywhere.  You can see where the plant emerged from the floor of the shed and spread out to the walls and ceiling as if looking for something.

title: [Teras Isle, Beach]
description: Dim moonlight bathes the beach in its glow, causing portions of the beach to shimmer like a masterfully cut gem.  The gentle, rhythmic breaking of waves against rock can be heard coming from the sea.

Sunlight breaks through the clouds and ash above in bright streams, bathing the area in shadowed light.  Tiny crustaceans skitter across the beach, appearing and disappearing near the rocks of the sea.  The gentle, rhythmic breaking of waves against rock and sand echoes through the cove, interrupted only by the occasional call of a sea bird.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A pair of damaged fire pots flank the remains of a bridge that once connected the balcony to the west with this section of the temple.  Flashes of silver can be seen beneath it as sea creatures swim rapidly through the flooded rooms below.

description: A series of marble pillars runs the length of the hall, offering support to both ceiling and wall.  Elaborately designed archways are open between the pillars, allowing a clear view of the southern hall, and each is carved with intricate wavy patterns and designs.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A set of descending stairs leads to the northwest, toward the center of the ruins.  Two marble pillars, seemingly in good condition, support the ceiling and form an archway in the southern wall.  The strong smell of the sea is carried in by a breeze that swirls, almost violently, through a window along the eastern wall.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Sections of the eastern wall have been carved out around an arched window, forming permanent shelves.  None are currently used, and each is covered with a thin layer of moisture and mold.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The sound of crashing waves reverberates loudly here, and a thin coating of moisture clings to every surface.  The air is thick with the smell of the sea, and natural light streams into the hallway from the north.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The hall to the north has completely collapsed, fallen long ago into the depths below.  Several large pillars still rise from the surface of the water to support the ceiling above.  Splotches of a thick, dried white substance stain the area, and the calls of several sea birds echo from a nearby nest.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The walls are slick with moisture and, aside from the windows to the east and south, are completely unadorned.  A large marble pillar, partially eroded from the water that streams down it, marks the end of the eastern passage as the hall turns north.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The head of a carved stone sea serpent lays near the base of the northern wall, but the rest of the statue is missing.  Sea spray occasionally flies in from the collapsed southern wall as large waves crash into the temple outside.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Drops of water fall from the ceiling with a barely audible splash, joining the tiny streams that flow through the intricately carved grooves in the floor.  A single arched window, its edges worn from time and the elements, rests along the southern wall.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Small stone stands, measuring no more than a few inches high, line the western wall, but most are no longer occupied.  The shattered remains of clay pottery still sit before one, and another is still adorned with a hammered bronze fire pot.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The remains of a large mosaic remain inset into sections of the wall, including portions that have deteriorated and fallen to the north, blocking access.  An elaborately carved stone causeway descends to the west, forming a stable path to the balcony below.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Aside from the water that has flooded the area, the room is plain.  A single iron sconce remains attached to the wall, and the remains of another rests below the surface of the water.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Water flows gently to and fro, splashing against the walls with a barely audible crash.  Small bits of foam and debris float idly on its surface, bobbing up and down across the small waves.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A spiral staircase climbs up to third floor of the temple, and is flanked on either side by a large stone statue carved to resemble a large water droplet.  The flooded water reaches to the statues' middles, where wavy patterns have been formed by years of erosion.  A single tapestry, soaked with moisture, hangs from the northwestern wall, and a rusted iron bar rests opposite it.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: From the submerged floor below, water laps gently, echoing through this roofless chamber.  An armless statue of a woman gazes upon a collapsed section of wall, soot marring her otherwise flawless ivory visage.  Bleached bones lay in the shadow of the statue.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: A mottled pattern of mold clings to the decorative etchings on broken pedestals.  Crushing several marble statues is a sizable block of stone from the roof, their extremities strewn across the floor.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Through a series of holes in the wall, the wind howls with great ferocity.  Bits and pieces of shell have broken free from a sculpture when it was flung into the westernmost pillar in the chamber.  A faint yellowish grey tinge covers the stone tiles and blocks in streaks.  The frame of a painting sticks out of a pile of rubble.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Yellowed parchments peek out from underneath a collapsed column and the cabinet that once held them has been smashed to pieces.  A decorative urn has had a large chunk punched out of its body, bleeding fine-grained sand onto the floor.  A gaping hole in the eastern wall looks out onto the endless blue-grey sea.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Numerous statues have lost their limbs and heads from falling debris due to the collapse of the roof.  The remnants are covered in soot and some crushed beyond recognition.  Tiny shards of colorful pottery lay before a ruined archway in an array of faded blues, greens, and reds.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Open sky looms overhead with mere fringes of the ceiling still intact.  Fallen mortar and blocks of stone have left deep impressions in the floor, some have created holes that peer down into the level below.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: A slender marble arm sticks out from a pile of rock and dust in the middle of the chamber.  Stoic faces gaze up at the sky from the floor, the magnificent statues that they once belonged to are now merely random debris scattered around.

title: [Ruined Temple, Nexus]
description: A single stone stand rests in the center of the balcony, and a smooth stone statue, masterfully carved to resemble a single droplet of water, is placed on top of it.  Water gently flows back and forth about the area, making a soft splash as the waves contact the stone stand.  Two stone causeways, one wide and one elaborately carved, ascend from the balcony to the east and west, and each is supported by a series of marble pillars.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A break in the debris of the west wall allows access to the parallel hallway.  Above a gap leading to a wide stone causeway, the remains of a large mosaic still cling to the eastern wall, though most are badly marred or burned.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A collapsed archway prevents passage through the southern portion of the hallway, despite the still standing support structures.  Daylight streams in through the window along the western wall, large portions of which have been removed.  The passage continues to the north, and a stable archway, supported by carved marble pillars, offers access to the eastern hall.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Toppled, cracked, and empty fire pots line the base of the eastern wall below a tattered tapestry, creating a solemn memorial to the more prosperous days of the temple.  The floor of the western portion of the hallway, seen through the debris that has been piled in the archway along the wall, has completely collapsed, and is replaced only by the crashing sounds of the waves below.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Two large pillars still offer sturdy support to the ceiling above, and mark the end of the hallway directly to the north, as the floor beyond them has collapsed and fallen into the sea below.  A thin portion of the floor forms a bridge to the northeast, where the hallway continues on.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The ruined hall continues north and south, the environment oddly undisturbed, save for the occasional drop of water that falls from the ceiling.  A pair of clay pots rests at the base of the wall, each filled to the brim with water.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Water streams down from the ceiling above in quickly paced drops, splattering before gaining momentum and running to the east through the grooves carved in the stone floor.  A short set of descending stairs, half submerged below the high water level, leads to the northeast, while to the south, a single pillar has collapsed, but does not impede travel in that direction.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The shattered remnants of a large clay vase rest on a shelf carved into the northern wall, the shards adorned with painted waves.  Some descending stairs rest at the base of an elaborately carved archway along the eastern wall, flanked by a pair of long extinguished fire pots.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Torn pieces of cloth are strewn about the floor, stained and soaked.  Two pillars form an archway in the southern wall, and the northern wall has been inverted as if hit with a large, blunt object.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Sturdy pillars rise from the floor to support the ceiling above, forming an archway that leads to the south.  A pair of burnt tapestries flanks the archway, rusted iron poles and decimated cloth strips their only remnants.  Tiny grooves have been carved into the floor, and small streams of water flow gently through them to the east.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A stone bridge has collapsed to the east, as well as portions of a balcony that overlooks what is left of the temple's entrance below.  A pair of bronze fire pots have been overturned and are heavily banged and dented.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Tiny streams of water trickle through grooves carved into the floor, gathering to form puddles that pour over the staircase to the water below.  The walls are slick with moisture, and small drops of water occasionally fall from the ceiling above.  A toppled bronze fire cauldron rests near a marred stone sea serpent statue, both of which have been blackened and stained with smoke.

description: The sounds of the sea echo through a window along the southern wall, its edges worn from years of exposure to the elements. title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Arched windows adorn the southern and western walls, each weathered with time. title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Arched windows offer a view of the sea to the north and west, set on either side of a large marble statue placed in the corner of the room.  Small streams of water trickle gently down the slick walls, flowing to the south through the carved grooves in the floor.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A pair of rusted iron sconces flank the doorway that rests at the top of half-submerged ascending stairs.  The room is otherwise unadorned, and there is no evidence to suggest it ever was.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A pair of large stone statues, carved to resemble large droplets of water, rests on either side of the spiral staircase that leads to the floor above. Ruined tapestries cling to the walls, soaked with the moisture that has claimed dominance over the room.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Rotted pieces of wood float around haphazardly, drifting to and fro gently across the surface of the water.  Portions of the walls are faded or white, bleached over time by the salt of the sea.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Constant exposure to the brine of the sea has encrusted the bases of several pillars with salt.  Cracked pottery has been bleached and worn well from the elements, piled in a small area around a leaning marble column.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Multi-colored glass shards glimmer in the moonlight beaming down from above.  A handful of jagged pieces still cling to the arched window frames that look out onto the sea.  Snaking through the floor is a maze-like network of fine cracks, though several of the tiles have been completely destroyed.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: One of the ornamental sculptures that had adorned the roof lies broken in half on the ground. title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Broken statuary has been imbedded in the walls and floor, wrenched from the small alcoves that housed them and flung about by some great force. title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Numerous tiles from the toppled roof lie scattered around the floor.  Only a single statue remains in the area, the rest having been flung out to the sea through holes in the walls.  Splintered pieces of wood have been gathered into a heap in one corner of the room.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Small chunks of the bas-reliefs are missing, though they remain in relatively good shape despite the obvious surrounding destruction.  Vivid tapestries are now merely narrow strips of faded silk fluttering gently in the sea breeze.

title: [Teras Isle, Underwater]
description: Strong currents twist and spin rapidly, stirring up sand in a shifting curtain.  Weak shafts of lights splice through the surface of the water, flickering as debris swirls wildly about them.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Only a small path remains clear among the great ruin of the roof.  Ornamental metalwork lies in twisted clusters, with sharp spikes hidden among some of the larger areas of detritus.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Through the narrow corridor flanked by towering columns, the wind howls like some haunting specter. title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Along the corridor, stones and chunks from the collapsed roof makes maneuvering difficult.  Faint splashing can be heard from points all around.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Fallen debris creates an incredibly rocky landscape on the puckered floor.  A collapsed alcove resides in the corner with a glimpse of a statue's head within the rubble.  The adjoining ornamental arches have also given way, knocking over the nearby carved pillars.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: A mountain of rubble blocks passage to the east, rising nearly to the top of the remaining walls.  While the debris appears packed together at the base, traversing the upper portion is hazardous.  The damaged floor wears a visible slant in one area, with seawater from below pooling in the corner.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: A trio of paths converge at this point, winding through the fallen stones and tiles of the ceiling.  Snapped chair legs, backs, and seats have been randomly thrown around the area.  Some portions of the wood have been charred, and streaks of ash stain much of the marble floor.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: A pair of columns lean heavily against each other, pulled from their original position and no longer supporting the ceiling.  Along the base of the wall, the floor has been punctured, allowing glimpses to the watery floor below.  Yellowed bone fragments occupy a cracked wooden box nestled among some of the smaller debris.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: To the east, the entire wall has collapsed, preventing passage into the area beyond.  Mixed into the rubble are cracked pottery shards, bits of rotten wood, and scraps of metal.  Half of a fringed tapestry hangs beside the toppled stones, the image faded beyond recognition.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Along the base of an enormous pile of debris is a jagged gash in the floor, running the width of the corridor.  Overturned candelabras have rusted over, while some candles reside in a dark corner.  The gentle sound of water splashing against the temple's stonework fills the cool air.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Large splinters of wood cover the cracked floor originating from a pair of tables, which are now nothing more than crushed legs underneath the weight of a toppled column.  An armless statue watches from the remains of a niche, its head barely peeking out of the rubble.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Green stains from algae cling to the whimsical curves that adorn the crumbling walls.  Blackened bronze pots are filled with soot and fine-grained debris that has accumulated over time.  A large chunk of the roof stands in the center of the hallway, leaving only narrow paths around the impediment.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Pooled in various depressions along the hallway are puddles of murky water that have accumulated from rainfall.  Smashed religious relics lie in ruin among the chunks of stone and mortar, barely recognizable in their decimated forms.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: A single copper urn remains upright on the floor, while its counterparts have been smashed as a segment of the wall fell into the hall.  Faded chips of paint offer a mere glimpse of the vivid images they once formed on the stones.  A humanoid skull sits in the shadow of a massive pillar that is missing its top half.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Standing between a pair of columns is a marble statue of a graceful woman.  Her billowing robes have been blackened by flame and a stump remains where her right arm broke off.  Tiny shards of colored glass lay at her feet, blown in from further along the corridor judging by the irregular pattern they form.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Fire has ravaged this entire section of the temple, the stonework charred heavily along the floor and walls.  All the wooden furniture has been reduced to ash that has long since been blown out to sea.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Intricate carvings along the walls have been blackened and filled with soot from a great fire.  One particular bas-relief depicts a religious procession led by a richly garbed priest.  The other carvings have been smashed by debris that fell when the roof was destroyed.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: A crushed skeleton pokes out from below a fallen pillar.  The ornate moldings that once adorned the elaborate ceilings lie scattered around the area, imbedded in grooves and cracks in the floor.  A few twigs stand out in the ruin, set atop a still standing arch where birds have made a nest.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Bleached bones lie beneath a collapsed archway, a victim of the devastation from long ago.  The shattered windows have left shards of glass glittering dangerously on the floor.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Daylight streams in through a window along the northern wall, revealing dark scorch marks along the stone walls.  The floor is completely submerged below nearly a foot of water, and several large pieces of rotted wood float about haphazardly.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The hall continues onward with little change, outside of the smoke stains that grow more dense along the walls and ceiling.  Resting below the surface of the water are several shards of pottery, their edges worn and smoothed from a combination of tide and time.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Portions of the northern wall have collapsed, and cold sea water flows freely through them.  Seawater sprays about as it crashes into the walls, making them slick, as well as forming small beads of water on the ceiling.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Dark stains have been splattered around a rusted spearhead that has been imbedded into the northern wall.  Despite the freely flowing water to and from the east, the passage has been blocked by the shattered remnants of collapsed statues.  An arched doorway remains open along the southern wall, the door itself having long since rotted away.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A rusted iron sconce has fallen from the wall, resting below the surface of the water, near the base of the doorway in the northern wall.  Small pieces of debris drift back and forth with the current, and bits of foam line the walls where sea meets stone.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Two large holes in the wall mark the one-time home of the rusted iron bar that has collapsed and fallen into the seawater that flows through the area.  A marble stand rises above the water, its surface scratched, chipped, and burned.  Three large portions of broken pottery, faded and weathered, rest at its base.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Dense smoke stains mar the walls and ceiling as it continues onward, and a portion of the northern wall has collapsed.  An iron sconce hangs on the southern wall, nearly rusted to the point of collapse.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The passage comes to an abrupt stop at the base of several shattered statues that prevent travel to the west.  Despite the obstruction, water ebbs and flows onward in both directions.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Shadows creep across the surface of the water, seemingly moving of their own volition as its waves rise and fall.  Streams of daylight, as well as a fresh sea breeze, enter through an arched window in the northern wall.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: More intense waves of water crash loudly against the walls, and the sea can be seen stretching for miles to the east.  The entire eastern wall, as well as a small portion of the floor, have long since collapsed and fallen into the watery depths below.  Despite the missing wall, the ceiling above is firmly supported by several wide pillars.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The sounds of the sea echo fiercely through the hallway, and a chilled breeze swirls through the area.  The walls are scorched and burned more severely here, and several portions of them are covered by a thick layer of ash.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The arched doorway along the wall has been blocked off with heavy stone slabs, preventing access to the northern portion of the hall.  The odor of the sea grows stronger here, despite the lack of windows.  Darkness stretches onward, as well as back, and is disturbed only by the occasional drip of water from the ceiling.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The hall continues along its dark, damp, and cold path with little change.  Carved grooves in the surface of the floor provide secure footing, despite being submerged below the water's surface.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The ceiling has collapsed to the west, blocking further travel in that direction.  Gentle trickles travel down the debris, streaming until they soundlessly meet with the water flowing across the surface of the hallway.

title: [Lava Flows, Basalt Span]
description: A man-height wide at its narrowest point, hairline fractures form a lacework of cracks in the time-worn basalt, marking this arch as the oldest intact formation in the valley.  They also seem a sure sign that it will not remain so much longer.  Below, the main lava channel is alight with molten rock that has found its way down from the lava fountains along the southern ridge.  From here you can go down the span to the northern side of the channel, or down the southern end of the arch to that bank.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Ravine's Edge]
description: A trail follows the bottom of a steep incline.  The jumble of rocks cloaking the slope above makes the track hazardous, and here and there, boulders fallen from above obstruct its progress.  On the narrow shelf's north shoulder, the ground falls into a deep ravine, its bottom lost in darkness.

A trail follows the bottom of a steep incline.  The jumble of rocks cloaking the slope above makes the track hazardous, and here and there, boulders fallen from above obstruct its progress.  On the narrow shelf's north shoulder, the ground falls into a deep ravine, its bottom lost in shadow.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Third Tier]
description: As the deep ravine edging the path turns in toward it, the trail dwindles into nothing.  A pile of boulders edges its demise, throwing irregular shadows across the trail's remnants.  Wasps buzz idly in clouds over the stones, darting in and out of crevices and soaring out over the ravine on drafts of wind.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Ravine's Edge]
description: The trail winds between large rocks and sharp stone rubble.  As it proceeds toward a dead end to the southwest, the sheer drop into the ravine on the north shoulder crowds closer, adding to the precarious nature of the walk.  Drifting clouds of smoke roll over the edge of the bluff above, like a waterfall cascading in slow motion.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Third Tier]
description: The trail halts at a pile of rocks, which slides away over the lip of the ravine as though frozen in time.  Overhead, wasp nests cling to the bluff, huge, ominous constructions full of vehemence.  A half-desiccated carcass lies cradled within the stones, its rib bones adding a sculptural quality to the jumble.

The trail halts at a pile of rocks, which slides away over the lip of the ravine as though frozen in time.  Overhead, wasp nests cling to the bluff, huge, ominous constructions full of vehemence.  A half-desiccated carcass lies cradled within the stones, its bleached rib bones adding a sculptural quality to the jumble.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Chimney Flue]
description: Hot ash swirls in a violent vortex that continues to rise up the narrowing flue.  A small ledge of crystal provides some protection from the tempest, as well as pulses of abnormal light.  A strange sense of power permeates the chimney, swirling and eddying with the currents of the tempest.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: The rise of the intense heat caused the ceiling to cool last, resulting in gigantic stalactites and stalagmites to form as the slowly running fluid of rock from the ceiling dripped from above.  Some of the drips never made it to the cavern floor, and they look like huge mushrooms turned upside down suspended from the ceiling, the rock cooling as it trickled down the stem and forming the bulb, which thickened with each new layer.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Here you see a dazzling display of mineral deposits.  The lava flow in this cavern must have been somewhat calmed or slowed for the metals and minerals to have separated by their weight.  This would be a miner's paradise as you see veins of gold, lead and even some silver ribboned into the walls.  Minerals have even begun the formation of crystaline structures, you can actually see the birth of rubies, diamonds and other precious gems, as the crystals will grow in time to form future treasure.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Boulders the size of small huts are melted into the wall frozen for eternity, their slow arduous journey from the bowels of the earth now ended.  Steam escapes from around some of the boulders giving them the appearance of bleeding, as lighter elements are forced through the cracks in the wall with the great pressure of the steam.  To one side, a pile of rubble and rocks cast into a heap by the passage of magma takes on an eerie silhouette within the shroud of drifting smoke and fog.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: A strange formation of stalactites and stalagmites fills this cavern.  The resemblance to the enormous teeth of some monstrous animal is uncanny, leaving you with the impression that they could snap forward and swallow you whole.  You hope that the resemblance to sharp fangs is just a coincidence, and not a foreboding of things to come.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: A lava flow blocks the passage to the southwest, yet you can see the cavern continues further on the other side.  The pouring stream of fresh lava builds a wall of heat that would turn back all but those of great resolve.  The ash shifts beneath your feet the closer you edge towards the lava flow.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Circle of Stone]
description: Huge boulders ring a small, circular area, with a cliff face to protect the far side.  The stones shield the spot from the oppressive heat, making it seem almost temperate compared to the raging fury on the other side of the barrier.  In stark contrast to the rough, blasted surroundings, a statue stands in the center of the clearing, formed of pale grey marble.  Its form is a model of strength and noble symmetry.

title: [Tunnel]
description: Large boulders contort a meager excuse for a path into a helter-skelter thread winding among the rocks.  Little can be seen other than the shoulders of tall outcroppings crowding around a small open tract of loose shale.  The ambient light is barely adequate for navigating hazardous crevices and sharp protrusions, and overhead, shadows cluster in deep rents and folds of stone.  Reddish light flickers in from a jagged crevice leading out of the tunnel, while smoke creates coiling shadows within its beam.

title: [The Edge]
description: The trail curves sharply to the northeast, circling jagged stone perimeters and sidling along gullied rents.  Loose shale creates a downward slide south of that, where large, irregularly configured knives of stone stick up out of the scree here and there as the decline disappears into the gloom.  A low hissing can be heard, the sound of steam escaping from unseen fissures elsewhere in the cavern.  It rises and falls in volume, like gusts of wind sighing around a closed window during a storm.

title: [The Neck]
description: Where the tunnel curves into a dogleg around a massive, striated formation of rock, it widens to form an alcove.  The walls are richly veined, with bulbous protrusions adding depth to the designs.  Ground fog drifts in ragged clouds across the floor, the eddies herded by undetectable fingers of wind, giving the chamber the look of a lacy collar encircling a stone neck.

title: [Fangthryn Cavern]
description: Shadows seem to congregate here in the northeast corner of the cavern, as if plotting to overtake and defeat the luster of the scarlet floor slabs.  Drifting fog moves through the patches of darkness, giving them an appearance of movement and life.  The most dramatic and deeply toned are cast by the four towering columns grouped around the well at the chamber's heart.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Fangthryn Cavern]
description: The silhouettes of four large pillars in the cavern's center tower up from drifting patches of low-lying fog like colossal sentinels guarding the chamber.  Occasional thumps find their way in, low and heavy in timbre, and muffled by distance.  These echo hollowly, bouncing from the stone walls as if they are panicked birds trapped inside a room.

title: [Fangthryn Cavern]
description: The vast space of the cavern is broken by four immense, spiraling pillars, which stretch between the shadows cloaking the ceiling and the perfect slab floor beneath.  Frayed shapes composed of ground fog undulate around the feet of the columns and across the blood-red floor, like wispy phantoms engaged in a slow-motion dance.  A circular well occupies the center of the chamber, surrounded by the columns as if guarded by them and its bottom lost in darkness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, northwest

title: [McKyren's End, Well of Night]
description: Within the circle of columns lies a well, its bottom invisible in the darkness that overtakes its depths a short distance beneath its rim.  The rim is level with the floor slabs, offering no break between the floor and the fathoms of empty air beyond.  A repeating pattern of symbols is worked in mosaic around the hole.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Fangthryn's Gullet]
description: A large chamber stretches away into gloomy shadows, its ceiling high above and lost to sight in the murk.  The vivid slab floor is tinted a deep scarlet, and all across it, ragged fingers of fog drift with seemingly aimless nonchalance.  On the southern wall, a tunnel opens and into its mouth pour the floor tiles, like a ruby rivulet of liquid stone seeping into a sieve.

title: [McKyren's Folly]
description: The perfection of the beautiful ruby floor is broken here in the southwest corner of Fangthryn's Cavern.  Tiles are marked with savage rents and discolored with dark stains.  A particularly violent disruption leaves broken pieces of the floor slabs protruding from the rock of the wall, as if they were impelled into it by some sort of explosion.  Where the tiles are unaligned, gaps reveal a fine-grained, black sand lying beneath.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [McKyren's End, The Craw]
description: As the corridor proceeds to the north, the color of the tiled floor darkens from rosy-pink to a more vibrant shade in the red spectrum.  The gradation is very gradual and even, and considering the size and irregularity of the slabs, an impressive construction.  A pronounced change in the trail's direction is punctuated by a sharply edged, triangular wall of stone sitting in the center of the turnabout.

title: [McKyren's End, Ruby Road]
description: As the tunnel splits into three different directions, the luminous slab floor creates a glowing 'Y' in the gloom.  Overhead, the surface of the ceiling stone is as irregular as the tiled floor is smooth.  The deep pocks and crevices within the rock there are occasionally populated with small pairs of glowing eyes, which blink and stare a moment before abruptly disappearing into the darkness.

title: [McKyren's End, Heaven's Rounder]
description: The tunnel curves around an outcropping of granite.  In the low light, tiny flecks of mica embedded in the salmon-colored slabs composing the floor twinkle demurely.  A few wisps of ground fog drift along the corridor, their undersides tinted with a blush of ash rose reflected off the rock beneath them.

title: [McKyren's Road]
description: A steep slope ends at the edge of a raised path of stone slabs.  Each slab is irregularly shaped, yet fits perfectly into its neighboring tiles, and the surfaces are smooth and level.   This was obviously constructed, since the rock composing it is both a different type and color from the adjacent walls.   The color, a light pinkish red, is a luminous contrast to the gloom and grey stone surrounding it.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Lower Eye]
description: The air appears to be a little cooler here.  The glassy molten walls seem thicker, although you can detect spots where the density varies from color.  You can almost sense the flow of lava pulsing behind the scorched rock, judging from the discoloration on the surface of the wall.

title: [Stone Tunnel]
description: Thick stone walls have been fortified with steel beams, making this tunnel as much of a fortress as an ingress.  Its entrance bears a raised portcullis, allowing travelers to come and go freely, but serving as an inconspicuous sentry in case of need.  Torches are mounted on alternating beams, burning brightly to join the moonlight entering from the opening.  As the tunnel spirals downward, the torches cast shadows on the walls as the corridor ends abruptly at a heavy iron door.

Thick stone walls have been fortified with steel beams, making this tunnel as much of a fortress as an ingress.  Its entrance bears a raised portcullis, allowing travelers to come and go freely, but serving as an inconspicuous sentry in case of need.  Torches are mounted on alternating beams, burning even as the daylight shines in.  As the tunnel spirals downward, the light from outside fades and the corridor ends abruptly at a heavy iron door.

title: [Lobby]
description: This square room seems to have been carved out of solid rock, as evidenced by the smooth, hard walls.  A simple, deep brown rug covers the center of the floor.  A mural has been painted on one wall, covering it from floor to ceiling with a detailed image of the Eye of V'Tull.  Two granite benches sit against the adjacent walls, and a refreshment cart stands in the corner.  A sign hangs over a carved stone stairway, and a rounded arch is carved in the fourth wall, nearly hidden by deep blue curtains.

title: [Kharam Dzu, Departure Annex]
description: This room is sparse, having no seating or amenities.  Wall-mounted torches provide illumination for the room's only decoration, a portrait hanging on an otherwise bare wall.  A sign hangs near a carved stone stairway.

title: [Teras Travel Office, Lobby]
description: Modest attempts have been made to make this place seem upscale:  Swathes of red velvet are hung with silver nails as a ceiling border, and a pair of iron candelabrum are bolted to the floor to either side of the giant, red velvet davenport.  The burning candles help counter the lingering fish smells.

title: [Queen's Ransom, Fitting Room]
description: Enclosed by rose moire silk-covered walls, the shop features a plush satin rosewood divan in the center of its cream marble floor.  A platinum-leafed mirror hangs under the silk-draped ceiling.  Right near the front is a tall glass wall display and a circular crystalline table.

title: [Queen's Ransom, Odds and Ends]
description: A framed gown sketch hangs on one of the rose moire silk-covered walls, and a silk-draped ceiling with a twinkling chandelier rises overhead.  A set of bronze masked nobles statues sits in one corner of a lustrous cream marble floor.  There is a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest on one side of the shop and a crystalline vanity table on the other.

title: [Sulien's Armory]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An elegantly carved oak armoire sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Sulien's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An intricately carved ebonwood stand sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Treeva's Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a large oak table on one side of the shop and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest on the other.

Beneath a sturdy white cedar ceiling, an antique wall hanging hangs on one of the patterned white walls.  A gold-trimmed ebonwood chest and a large oak table sit in opposite corners while an ivory elven noble statue rests on a cream-colored ceramic tile floor.

title: [Triage Tent]
description: A central pole supports a high canvas ceiling and burlap-lined walls.  Numerous clean but simple cots are lined in rows on one side of the tent, and stacks of woven cotton blankets and shreds of linen litter the other.  A few squat oil lamps hang from natural wood staves, providing the room with dim but focused lighting.

title: [Triage Tent]
description: The walls of the tent ripple from a faint breeze that blows through the area.  Several more simple cots are placed throughout this side of the tent, and in the back is a stack of curious-looking long boxes.  Some linen mats are placed along the ground in an effort to prevent seepage.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Reception Area]
description: Encased in polished oak walls, the tidy office is fitted with a limestone floor that has alabaster striations mixed with slate blue veins.  Several rugs in matching hues compliment the floor, as do the Vornavian silk drapes framing the large picture windows that face the street.  Numerous oak benches line the walls, while cushioned chairs surround a desk set in the middle of the room.  Beyond the desk, a well-lit corridor leads further into the building, and is lined with books and bulletins boards.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Corridor]
description: Framed in oak and set with a long tapestry rug, the corridor is lined with bookcases and bulletin boards that are filled with reading materials.  Standing opposite one another, with brass sconces to illuminate them, are a pair of matching doors fitted with slender brass plaques.  Further down the corridor are another set of doors, while to the south, a reception area can clearly be seen with its large desk set in the center.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Corridor]
description: Several carved mahogany chairs are positioned against the walls of the corridor in an impromptu seating arrangement that is divided by slender tables topped in linen.  Treats and morsels are set upon trays, and a carafe of wine with glasses rests beside them.  Twin oak doors framed by brass wall sconces are set to either side of the corridor, and display slender plaques as to their purpose.  To the north, the corridor ends in a steel-banded door, while to the south the corridor leads back to the reception area.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Corridor]
description: Oak paneling rises from the limestone floors covered in a tapestry-weave royal blue runner down the stretch of corridor, which ends in a steel-banded door.  A pair of brass sconces fitted with glass globes are affixed to the wall to either side of the door, the candles within burning softly to illuminate the area.  To the south, the corridor stretches towards the distant reception area, the entire length lined with comfortable furnishings and bookcases.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Archon's Office]
description: Positioned before a brass-framed window, a long rectangular desk is supported by carved mahogany legs.  Twin high-backed chairs stand before the desk, while an enormous leather chair fitted with wide armrests rests behind.  Framed in polished linden and tacked to the western wall is a map of the entire Vornavian Coast, while upon the eastern wall a map of the Cairnfang Forest rests, framed in oak.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Clerk's Office]
description: Bare of any papers, a plain oak desk is positioned diagonal to an unadorned high-backed chair behind it.  Other chairs line the northern and eastern wall nearest the desk where long bulletin boards are lined with neat rows of tasks to be completed.  A large armoire and armor stand are set side by side upon the western wall beneath a worn coat-of-arms banner.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Gallery]
description: Occupying the entire western wall of the room is an enormous stained glass window framed in emerald green velvet curtains.  Beneath the window, and illuminated from above by a sea glass chandelier, is a small display case filled with statuettes, artifacts, and tiny jewels.  Floor to ceiling wall shelves on the eastern and western walls are also set with various pieces that are too large for the case, while a pattern divan is set in the center of the room.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Lounge]
description: Supported by a whitewashed ceiling and polished oak panels, the small room is tidy and neat.  A frosted glass globe is suspended from the ceiling by brass fixtures above clusters of mahogany tables.  Chairs set with blue cushions occupy the space around the tables, providing plenty of room for people needing a moment's rest.  Small potted plants occupy each of the room's four corners, while the Vornavis Baronial flag adorns the north wall.

title: [Market Bridge Bakery]
description: Loaves, cookies, pastries and cakes crowd the display cases, and the scents of spices and oven-fresh goods fill the air.  The worn oak planks of the floor and the ivory patina of the plaster walls suggest that this is a business of long standing in the port, while the faint trail of floured barefoot prints to and from the kitchen door attest to the natural talents of the staff.  However, it also leaves room for speculation as to how many items never reach the display case.

title: [Ouslanders Garb]
description: The tidy shelves of this shop hold an array of foreign clothing, offering everything from sporrans to burnooses.  Behind the counter, the spectacled, Giantkin proprietor waits patiently.

title: [Ouslanders Garb]
description: All of the clothing and accessories in this room of the shop appear to be from warmer climes.

title: [Beltheine's Flowers]
description: Garlands of wildflowers decorate the walls of this tiny shop.  Wooden buckets brimming with flowers are scattered about the floor.  Scents both delicate and heady drift through the air.  A wooden worktable sits across the back wall, covered with flowers, ribbons, and tools.

title: [Ye Olde Sweete Shoppe]
description: The odor of cooking chocolate hangs so heavily in the air that you can almost taste it.  Voices carry from the kitchen in a constant exchange of instructions, comments, and quips.  Occasionally, the swinging door leaps open as a white-aproned Halfling or Elf brings out a pan of fresh morsels to stock the displays.

title: [Dargeur's Armors]
description: Leather and metal armor of all shapes and sizes covers the walls of this establishment.  Oil lamps hang from the ceiling, dangling on rusted chains.  A brawny half-elf leans upon the wooden counter, eyeing the customers from half-closed eyes.

title: [Dargeur's Armors, Upper Room]
description: Glancing around the interior of the room reveals several sturdy looking armor stands.  Various types of armor, from leather to plate, rest atop the stands for display.  Polished shields have been hung from the walls and seem to stand guard over the room.  Somewhere nearby the distinct sound of a hammer striking an anvil can be heard.

title: [Solhaven Arms]
description: Polished wooden cases line the room, containing a wide assortment of weapons.  Echoing through the shop is the sound of a hammer striking metal.  A stocky Dwarf stands nearby, smiling to herself.

title: [Solhaven Arms]
description: This small side room is crowded with racks of two-handed weapons and polearms.  That ubiquitous penchant for avoiding the logical has manifested itself here:  of course the main room has the small weapons in it, and this closet is stuffed with weapons that you couldn't even heft in here.

title: [Solhaven Arms, Forge]
description: A great firepit occupies the center of the forge.  Tools of all shapes and sizes lie strewn about.  Near the fire, a blacksmith holds a glowing metal rod to an anvil, pounding it with a hammer.

title: [Galnuir's Archery]
description: Finely crafted bows of all shapes and sizes hang upon the walls of this sparsely furnished shop.  A simple wooden counter stands in one corner, with a rack behind.  A small table and chair sit in front of the fireplace.

title: [Solhaven Town Hall]
description: The Hall lobby is packed with people as merchants, fishermen, hunters and townsfolk alike mill about, doing their business.  A bust of the Baron of Vornavis occupies a nearby niche.  A wide staircase leading upwards is lined with gilt-framed portraits, and a brass plaque hangs upon the opposite wall.

title: [Solhaven, Courtroom]
description: Warm diffused light peek through long slotted windows set between plush tapestries embroidered with the seal of the Baron of Vornavis surrounded by emblems of the Guild Houses.  A grand podium wrought of solid fel wood and ornately carved with pictorials of Koar predominate the center of the room flanked by guardsmen who stand at attention while court is in session.

title: [Solhaven, Debt Collector's]
description: This room seems hardly large enough to contain the activity within it.  Accountants and record clerks carrying towering sheaves of parchment scurry about as residents mill about asking questions.  A tall counter sits opposite the door, the town clerk perched imperiously upon his stool behind it.

title: [Solhaven Registrar's Office]
description: Thick ledgers in orderly rows fill bookshelves along all four walls.  Several chairs are set against one wall for those waiting to rest their bones.  A counter splits the office in two, separating the waiting area from the registration enclosure.  A large desk sits in the middle of the enclosure with an elderly clerk ensconced behind it.  A sign is posted on the counter.

title: [Solhaven, Upper Town Hall]
description: The bustle of the milling crowds below hardly troubles the quiet of the upper hall.  Sunlight streams in from a large window by the wide staircase leading downward, illuminating motes of dust.  Thick carpets of rich aquamarine and cerulean tones line the hallway, muffling the tread of the occasional prosperous merchant or adventurer who has business with the town officials.

The bustle of the milling crowds below hardly troubles the quiet of the upper hall.  Pewter sconces line the hall and a wide staircase, their highly polished surfaces reflecting and amplifying the flickering light of tall beeswax candles.  Thick carpets of rich aquamarine and cerulean tones line the hallway, muffling the tread of the occasional prosperous merchant or adventurer who has business with the town officials.

title: [Solhaven, Citizenship Office]
description: A long counter inlaid with polished seashells divides the room, creating small waiting areas dotted with comfortable-looking armchairs.  On the far side of the counter, a few desks groan under piles of unfiled papers.  The walls are hung with portraits of finely dressed gentlemen and ladies, the wealthy burghers whose industry built Solhaven to its current prominence.

title: [A Quiet Garden]
description: Two young yew trees stretch their wiry, twisted limbs toward the sky, their thick, needled boughs casting tranquil shadows across the courtyard.  A faint chill hangs in the air here, and the surroundings appear oddly still, not a single sound of anything living breaking the silence of the garden.  A low-set grey granite building is built between the twin yew trees, its mute and solemn architecture broken only by the large arch allowing entry.

Two young yew trees stretch their wiry, twisted limbs toward the sky, their thick, needled boughs illuminated wanly in the moonlight.  A faint chill hangs in the air here, and the surroundings appear oddly still, not a single sound of anything living breaking the silence of the garden.  A low-set grey granite building is built between the twin yew trees, its mute and solemn architecture broken only by the large arch allowing entry.

title: [Temple of Eternity, Foyer]
description: A pair of ebonwood doors loom to the south, their surfaces inlaid with abstract patterns of malachite.  Faint drafts waft in from outside, lending a slightly chilly countenance to the air.  The surroundings are made of drab grey granite polished to a fine luster.  Small designs of twining ivy wrap around the borders of the simple architecture, adding a decorative yet solemn touch to its uniform appearance.

title: [Ebondrift, Shadow Strand]
description: Entry through an ebonwood arch muffles unwelcome noises of the street.  Directly opposite, a shallow pool reveals water darkened by the black slate slabs of its inner construction.  Rising east and west out of the pool, two enormous metal sea serpents sinuously twist and intertwine in a never-ending dance for superiority.
