Smoothly polished flagstones provide even footing around the open court, while tall hedges of hemlock, cut at uniquely sharp and opposing angles, lend an air of privacy.

title: [Ebondrift, Shadow Strand]
description: Slowly flowing northwest, a small brook babbles melodiously under an arched river-stone bridge.  The polished flagstones bridge the span then give way to blackened cobblestones.  Tall hedges create a living wall to the southeast broken only by three archways carved in silver, gold, and coral.  Engraved in the lintel of each arch is a short phrase and a small sign is planted in the grassy lawn between the paths.

title: [Ebondrift, Shadow Strand]
description: Cascading walls of water in colors of red, white, grey, green, and black enclose this translucent causeway.  A thin crystallized barrier keeps the water from rushing onto the concourse and completely destroying it.  Each different colored wall connects seamlessly to the adjoining one, without blurring the colors.  Prisms of light dance from one wall of color to the next then escape up into the sky.

title: [Ebondrift, Destruere Strand]
description: An assortment of sharpened black scimitars rests on an elaborate wrought iron rack, off to one side of the red-veined white marble street.  A tall muscular warrior stands nearby, eyeing the strangers as they pass and nodding cautiously to the residents.  Rows of red marble benches are placed along the entire length of the strand, with tall lush green topiaries lining the other side.  An occasional break in the greenery allows for a walkway to the houses built back off the strand.

title: [Ebondrift, Destruere Stand]
description: Tall buildings uniformly line both sides of the tessellated pavement.  Each building has a shadowy entrance with a guard at the door.  Behind the length of the buildings is a sea garden with colorful rocks, sea shells, and carved driftwood.  Several privately enclosed altars have been nestled into the gardens for the personal use of the residents.  A centrally located merchant sits in front of a gold trimmed aviary with a view of the water behind him.

title: [Ebondrift, Insidious Street]
description: Industrious spiders have worked their magic in this shadowy path.  Delicate spider-silk art drapes the graceful willows like a bridal veil.  An impressive web has been spun across a gated entrance to a small green discouraging any visitors.  Bubbling softly in the middle of the park is an obsidian fountain.  A liveried servant leans on his broom as he takes a break from keeping the arachnid artists at bay.

title: [Ebondrift, Insidious Street]
description: Giant black marble lions with snarling visages resting on solid silver blocks flank the blackened cobblestones.  At the base of one of the pedestals is a tiny green lizard stalking a small brown bug.  The sea breeze purrs through the area rustling the leaves of the willow trees almost musically.  A yellow marble chateau with black ora trim rises up majestically behind the leonine statues.

title: [Ebondrift, Insidious Street]
description: A strange chill from the sea blows through this deeply shadowed corner.  Faint rustling and scrabbling can be heard from the underbrush.  The trees lean over the blackened cobblestones, their branches almost touching each other.  Lost in the shadows, a sole guttering lamp fights vainly to illuminate the path.  Through a locked scrollwork gate, a dark mansion of black marble stands barely visible.

title: [Ebondrift, Insidious Street]
description: Fighting for domination of the street are twin grey slate-shingled houses.  The blackened cobblestones seem to cower under the baleful glare of these two weathered matriarchs.  Sprawling beside each house is a large barred workshop, the doors to both are secured with several sturdy-looking padlocks.  A half-drawn shade covers one of the lower windows of the left house.

title: [Ebondrift, Insidious Street]
description: Blackened cobblestones curve sharply around the silver-veined marble walls surrounding this enclave defended by two armed warriors.  Onlookers pause to stare through an elaborate gate only to be hurried along by the menacing guards.  It is not entirely clear if the guards are there to keep the onlookers out or to keep someone inside the walled inclosure.  Behind the gate, a spired palace rises majestically toward the sky.

title: [Ebondrift, Suasion Strand]
description: Alternating slabs of pale and deep green feldspar line the curling, tentacle-like extensions of the strand as they funnel out.  Two long but narrow, scarlet marble plant-holders are crowded with variants of colorful tropical blooms, their heavy fragrances mixing in an indefinable but cloying perfume.  Set on the four corners of each planter, squat jade censers emit steady streams of myrrh-scented smoke, while a lovely young woman attendant sprawls upon the ground nearby, keeping languid watch.

title: [Ebondrift, Destruere Strand]
description: An ornately beveled slate walkway circles around a brown pedestal.  On the pedestal a fire continually roars to life, and then diminishes again like a great snapdragon, filling the strand with sparks of fiery light.  Across from the pedestal slopes a path leading to a row of darkened stores.  The rest of the street is made of dark green speckled stones, some of which are small, and others are half covered with moss and heather.  Beyond the stores a multitude of houses can barely be seen.

title: [Ebondrift, Destruere Strand]
description: Clumps of thistles almost hide the entrance to several discreet homes placed far back from the road.  The strand is lined on both sides with tall black walnut trees, allowing little or no light into the area.  Freshly painted white lattice arches span over the road.  The entire area is made up of elaborately orchestrated modules of flower beds and gardens, neatly tucked into every section and connected together by a labyrinth of ebon trellises.

title: [Ebondrift, Destruere Strand]
description: Circling to the east is a well-maintained grey cobblestone road.  Lining the street at each end are decorative borders of chiseled black tentacle stars.  In the southern corner sprawls an iron kraken statue, draped by one of the many weeping willow tree branches that line the strand.  The street is littered with dead willow branches that have fallen to the ground and found refuge in the cracks of the stones.  Encircling the statue is a cobbled roundabout walkway, showcasing several private homes.

title: [Ebondrift, Suasion Strand]
description: The feldspar flagstones of the strand here are red in tone.  Immediately catching the eye, a circle of heavy iron chains encloses a black fel weapon tree fitted with various types of whips, flails and daggers in purposefully designed slots.  Flanking opposite sides of the weapon tree, twin circles of thinner steel chain bound cultivations of startlingly contrasting white and red bleeding heart blossoms.  Providing howled warnings of intruders is a trollish lookout, manacled securely to a stout iron post.

title: [Ebondrift, Suasion Strand]
description: An arc of shifting colors of light hangs mesmerizingly suspended in midair above the strand.  A series of uniformly sized globes of pure silver sit atop height-graduated pedestals of black marble around the outer perimeter of the clear feldspar-flagstoned area.  Upon a black ora flat about three feet high and six feet wide sits a large, shallow glass disk, in a manner allowing it to tilt at different angles.  Elaborate silver-leaf scrollwork chains and spirals along the surface edges of the flat.

title: [Treeva's Outfitting]
description: Patterned white walls rise from a cream-colored ceramic tile floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a brilliant peacock painting, and a painted nightscape ceiling completes the picture.  A long mahogany rack and a large oak table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [A Dark Building]
description: Cobwebs liberally hang from the corners of the room, and the lingering smell of dried herbs and sickly sweet flowers hangs in the air.  Collections of misshapen candles lend a wavering, moody light to the area, the faint glow illuminating the numerous boxes that lay open amid stacks of old, mildew-ridden books.

title: [A Dark Building]
description: Dark iron racks are set against the walls, numerous garments hung from their hooks.  Open chests lie next to them, and a thick coating of dust coats just about everything, the tiny motes dancing about erratically in the faint illumination.  The planks of the floor are cracked and weathered, groaning with a long, drawn-out creaking sound with every footfall.

title: [Shadows and Symbols, Foyer]
description: Lingering odors of sweet herbs and acrid resins hang in the air, commingled with thick smoke rising from misshapen candles spaced around the room.  Many of them are clustered around a skeletal spiral of black wood at one corner of the room, the tiered shelves attached to it etched with disfigured faces and twisted forms.  They lend a wavering, moody light to the area, their faint glow illuminating several displays covered in stacks of old, mildew-ridden books.

title: [Shadows and Symbols, Sanctum]
description: A high, vaulted window arcs up the northern wall, its glass clouded and punctuated by blots of accumulated grit.  Sunlight streams through in fractured, dim beams, illuminating the large counter that stands underneath it, its gilded edges lustrous and its glass panes crystal clear.  Numerous herbs and plants are placed haphazardly upon many shelves near the ceiling, and an intoxicating mix of pungent aromas wafts through the area.

title: [Dark Alley]
description: The alley is narrow, passing between two large stone buildings whose eaves almost touch far above.  Oddly shaped cobblestones have been laid at an angle, sloping towards a trough that is littered with small scraps of leather and broken feathers and runs towards the market.  Large crates, some broken, line the walls.

title: [Market Bend, Black Foot Alley]
description: Well-kept granite residences line both sides of the alley.  Several plainly dressed merchants, each struggling to carry a large crate filled with goods, seem to be slowly and carefully working their way through the mess of pedestrians towards a small alley that breaks off to the west.

Well-kept granite residences line both sides of the alley, their facades illuminated by torches affixed to either side of their doors.  A line of gaunt river rats picks their way through the refuse on the street towards a small alley that breaks off to the west.

title: [Market Bend, Black Foot Alley]
description: The alleyway bends from south to east and narrows as an almost triangular wooden building juts into it, ending at a small granite fountain that must have once stood at the center of the road.  A large woman with thick whiskers on her face stands in the doorway of this peculiar building, glaring.
The alleyway bends from south to east and narrows as an almost triangular wooden building juts into it, ending at a small granite fountain that must have once stood at the center of the road.

title: [Market Bend, Black Foot Alley]
description: Three large carts have been abandoned in the center of the alley and now serve as a playground for a number of merry children whose laughter echoes over the sound of hurried footsteps.  Roughly constructed stone houses are packed closely together along the sides of the way.  Another alley breaks off to the northeast.

Roughly constructed stone houses are packed closely together along the sides of the way, while another alley breaks off to the northeast.  Three large carts, abandoned in the center of the alley, house a forgotten ball and doll, their owners long since retired to bed.

title: [Market Bend, Whiptail Alley]
description: The alley curves smoothly from southwest to southeast, the buildings curving with a grace that is otherwise absent in the narrow passage.  Stones of many colors and sizes compose the structures, revealing a hasty construction that probably met some past need.  Either flung wide open or snapped tightly shut, slatted shutters reflect the mixed mood of pedestrians progressing along the cobblestones.

title: [Market Bend, Whiptail Alley]
description: Mingled scents of local leather shops and home cooking waft through the alley on the slightest breath of air.  Elegant sconces flank most of the doors, with fresh candles inside to light against the dangers of dusk.  Travellers in the narrow street clutch purses or packages close to defend against the shadier characters among them.

Mingled scents of local leather shops and home cooking waft through the alley on the slightest breath of air.  Elegant sconces flank most of the doors, with burning candles inside to light against the dangers of the dark.  Seedy characters linger in the darkened corners of the alley, their faces carefully shielded from illumination by the moonlight.

title: [Market Bend, Red Dog Plaza]
description: Paved with large, crudely cut blocks of granite, the floor of the plaza is bumpy and littered with debris.   A large stack of crates in the southeast is ringed by empty liquor bottles and discarded cigar stubs, and the rotting stench of fish mixes with the scent of stale beer and tobacco.

The bumpy floor of the plaza is paved with large, crudely cut blocks of granite.  The stench of rotting fish wafts up from a grate in the center of the plaza, yet this does not seem to bother the large number of sailors and merchants that have gathered around a large stack of crates to the southeast.

title: [Market Bend, Augur's Yard]
description: Large crowds gather around a small square of dying grass in the center of this courtyard.  A number of bearded men, each equally grubby and yelling unintelligibly, stand upon crates scattered in the square.  At the base of each granite residence that surrounds the courtyard, a bedraggled man or woman sits, trying to attract attention with a pouch of stones, a deck of cards or a glass ball.

Trampled and dying grass covers the small square at the center of the courtyard, its weeds yellow in the soft moonlight.  Discarded bottles are scattered amongst crates that are arranged in odd clusters throughout the area.  At the base of each granite residence that surrounds the courtyard sits an empty rocking chair or cushioned crate.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, northwest

title: [Market Bend, Whiptail Alley]
description: Balconies hang over the alley, compounding the cramped feeling created by the narrow passage.  While the doors are not flung open to welcome the passing crowds, occasional calls from above catch the attention of recognized locals.  An occasional splash of color can be spied along the rooftops, marking the perimeter of gardens tended in the only available space.

Balconies hang over the alley, the residence they cling to leaning precariously over the streets to compound the cramped feeling of the passage.  An occasional splash of color can be spied along the moonlit rooftops, marking the perimeter of gardens tended in the only available space.

title: [Market Bend, Ten Stone Alley]
description: Stone buildings rise steeply on either side of the alley, their doors opening directly onto the street.  Most are built of the same granite that composes the central stones laid throughout the passage.  A turn in the alley creates a small pocket of open space in which pairs and trios of residents occasionally stop to gossip before hurrying away on business.

Stone buildings rise steeply on either side of the alley, their doors opening directly onto the street.  Most are built of the same granite that composes the central stones laid throughout the passage.  A turn in the alley creates a small pocket of open space in which moonlight illuminates the cobbles in glittering silver hues.

title: [Market Bend, Ten Stone Alley]
description: A sudden twist in the alleys creates a natural dam as market-goers and residents struggle against the crowds to turn the corner.  Occasional exclamations of pardon or alarm echo from the buildings crowding in upon the street.  Three granite stones mark the center of the passage, their edges raised slightly to provide pedestrians with an additional challenge.

Three granite stones mark the center of the passage, their edges raised slightly to create oddly shadowed bumps on the street.  Close-knit houses create a natural dam at this end of the alley where residents have strung clotheslines from the upper stories.

title: [Yugreckol's General Store]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a large oak table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [The Bronze Boar]
description: Old wooden floorboards spread throughout the bar, and a long wooden bartop sits off the side near the entryway.  Several stools line the bar, some of their cushions torn from years of use.  A faded sign hangs behind the bar underneath a large bronze boar's head, listing the establishment's drinks.

title: [Yugreckol's General Store]
[Yugreckol's Outfitting]
[Yugreckol's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is an ora-bound large walnut trunk on one side of the shop and a large oak table on the other.

title: [Baker's Shop]
description: Smooth tile flooring stretches from one wall to the other of the small quaint shop, and the rich scent of baking wafts from a back room.  A variety of breads and other pastries fill the shelves and baskets set along the walls of the bakery.  A slender wooden counter stacked with parchment paper sits off to the side with a small, but noticeable sign.

title: [Forest Path]
description: A dirt road cuts through the small glade, running north and south from a large ebon gate at the edge of the forest to the outskirts of a small village.  The woods are thick with life, but silent.

title: [Velathae, South Sunrise Road]
description: An old dirt road runs through a gap in the post and rail wooden fence that encircles the town, where it forks to the north, east, and west.  Splotches of sickly plants sprout from the ground in a vain attempt at life, their stems and leaves drooping and slumped.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Velathae, South Sunrise Road]
description: Moonlight filters through the clouds above in weak streaks, casting a silvery light upon the area.  Dark shadows dance and swirl about the muddy road, disturbed only by the occasional dark creature that flies through the streams of light.  Pungent odors waft from the spilled contents of a toppled fruit cart that rests near the fence to the south.

Weak streams of dim sunlight filter through the clouds above, creating shadows that dance and jump about the road.  A toppled fruit cart rests near the fence to the south, its contents spilled and mashed into fluids that stain the ground beneath.

title: [Velathae, South Sunrise Road]
description: The beginnings of a stone fence encircle a small plot of land to the north, and tied stacks of hay are turning brown with rot where they stand.  Resting alone in the center of the hay is a grimacing scarecrow adorned with a rotting straw hat and strips of tattered cloth that stream wildly with the howling wind.

title: [Velathae, South Sunrise Road]
description: The muddy road follows a wooden post and rail fence as it turns sharply from the east to the northwest.  Untended fields stretch out to the southwest, filled with patches of maize, pumpkins, beans, and weeds that each struggle for dominance.  The stench of decay lies in the air, and carrion birds caw with reckless abandon from somewhere nearby.

title: [Velathae, West Sunrise Road]
description: The southwestern section of the fence is marred with splintered rails and a large gap, but there is no sign of its missing portion.  Tiny rodent skeletons rest at the base of an oak tree that towers above, directly beneath a clearly visible, partially tattered nest in one of its many bare branches.  A river winds almost diagonally to the town here, a small loading dock jutting into its turbulent midst.

title: [Velathae, West Sunrise Road]
description: Stiff, cold gusts swirl through in a wild dance, lifting shriveled leaves and tossing them haphazardly about the road.  A single farmhouse stands nearby, and a small barn or shed is being constructed beside it.  A small wooden boat bobs up and down on the otherwise still surface of a small pond, its surface splotched with a black mold.

title: [Velathae, West Sunrise Road]
description: The road continues to the north and south, partially covered with light fog, and flanked by the occasional home or barn that rests beside it.  A small mound rests on the opposite side of the fence, adorned with a marble, sunburst-carved marker.  Blooming before it is a single white blossom, its bright petals providing a stark contrast to the darkness of the area.

title: [Velathae, West Sunrise Road]
description: Deep marks in the mud lead from the road to a collapsed wagon pushed near a rotting shed and marred with deep grooves, ash, and water stains.  Opposite the wagon sits a pair of well-kept houses, freshly painted and trimmed with polished wood.  Innumerable footprints line the street to and from both the north and south.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Velathae Meadow, Mill]
description: An overgrown trail leads to an old stone mill that rests atop a small mound to the east.  Patched and faded sails, secured by thin strips of leather ties, rotate in slow circles, despite the failing breeze.  Heavy bags of grain and flour, most of which have rotted and torn, are piled at the base of the structure.

title: [Velathae, West Sunset Street]
description: The road continues with little notable change.  Small, thatch-roofed houses line the plots of land to the east and west, most accompanied by a small storage shed or garden.  A wooden fence has been raised before three houses along the strip, and one of its posts has been crafted to hold a single lantern.

title: [Velathae, West Sunrise Road]
description: Dilapidated homes lean or bend awkwardly, and thorny, dark green bushes line the eastern side of the road before them.  The fence here has been recently mended with fresh wood and wire, and shows no signs of being weathered by time or elements.

title: [Velathae, West Sunrise Road]
description: Brick and wood homes have been built on the eastern side of the road, turned to face the large meadow that rests to the north of them.  Several large barrels of apples line the fence, although large insects and worms can be seen skittering and wriggling about around them.  The road here is paved with the cracked and shattered remnants of smooth stones.

title: [Velathae, West Sunrise Road]
description: An overgrown garden rests to the west, tangled with weeds and vines that throttle the few pumpkins that manage to grow there.  Two small farmhouses stand south of the garden, turned away from the road to the west.

title: [Velathae, North Sunrise Road]
description: Fog swirls and eddies about an apple tree planted where the fence changes course from east and west to northeast and southwest.  Several logs have been neatly piled near the base of the tree, stacked to form a sort of pyramid.  Opposite the tree is a single trunk, a rusted axe embedded into its surface.

title: [Velathae, North Sunrise Road]
description: Thick fog rolls in from the northwest, stretching toward and grasping at the village to the south of the road.  Bare trees poke out through the top of the fog as they climb the hills in that direction, their limbs dark and lifeless.

title: [Velathae, North Sunrise Road]
description: The break in the fence and the broken lantern post mark the end of the road to the south.  The path that leads north to the orchard has become overgrown with the thick, blighted foliage that creeps ever closer to the town.  A tipped-over wheelbarrow has been shoved off to the side of the road, its wheel chipped and cracked.

title: [Apple Orchard, Entry]
description: Rows of apple trees, their lush, leaf-covered branches arching overhead, stretch out as far as the eye can see.  Moss and leaf litter cover the ground below, and the stench of rotting apples permeates the air.

title: [Apple Orchard, Pressing Shed]
description: A shed crafted from rotting boards sits alone in a small clearing under the shade of a large apple tree.  A trio of ravens caw noisily from their nest among the shed's exposed roof beams.

title: [Apple Orchard, Skull Hollow]
description: In the center of this section of the orchard stands a blackened hollow tree, a splintering sign nailed to what is left of its trunk.  The tangled, charred branches of the trunk reach out like skeletal arms, with only the filtered moonlight providing any deliverance from the illusion.

In the center of this section of the orchard stands a blackened hollow tree, a splintering sign nailed to what is left of its trunk.  The tangled, charred branches of the tree cast shadows in strange, chaotic patterns all about the hollow, causing the light to play tricks on the eyes.

title: [Apple Orchard, Squirrel Cove]
description: Lightning appears to have struck an apple tree here, causing a large, blackened limb to fall heavily to the ground.  A family of tiny ground squirrels have taken up residence in the fallen limb, their noisy chatter coming from within.

title: [Apple Orchard, Seedlings]
description: A rustic wooden fence blocks further travel to the north.  Tiny young apple seedlings have been tethered to the fence in a crude attempt at an espalier.

title: [Apple Orchard, Necessary]
description: Tucked among the tree branches is a humble wooden shed, its door adorned solely by a carving of a crescent moon.  A large pile of hay appears to have been piled just outside the shed, its purpose unclear.

title: [Apple Orchard, Fish Toss]
description: Set beneath the spreading branches of a laden apple tree, a booth nailed together from weathered wooden boards attracts the young and old alike.  Countless narrow-necked, small glass bowls glint brightly in the lantern light, lined up in precise rows on the top of a picnic table occupying the center of the booth.  Intermittent breezes stir up the long, pale yellow-green grass stems and ripple the water at the top of each of the fishbowls.

Set beneath the spreading branches of a laden apple tree, a booth nailed together from weathered wooden boards attracts the young and old alike.  Countless narrow-necked, small glass bowls glint brightly in the sunlight, lined up in precise rows on the top of a picnic table occupying the center of the booth.  Intermittent breezes stir up the long, pale yellow-green grass stems and ripple the water at the top of each of the fishbowls.

title: [Apple Orchard, Matriarch]
description: Here in the center of the orchard, a massive apple tree, perhaps the genetic parent to the rest of the orchard, stands regally amid the moonlight.  A rope ladder disappears into the leafy branches overhead.

Here in the center of the orchard, a massive apple tree, perhaps the genetic parent to the rest of the orchard, stands regally amid the sunlight.  A rope ladder disappears into the leafy branches overhead.

title: [Apple Orchard, Clearing]
description: At the center of a small clearing stands a single apple tree.  Its limbs reach out to cover an odd collection of items arranged in concentric circles around its roots.  A pile of apples lies at the base of the tree, with every variety of fruit represented in the diverse collection.  In a thick band around the apples is a narrow pile of weapons, surrounded by a large pile of rocks.  Circling the rocks is a narrow band of jewelry, and around this is a deep pile of silver coins.  Rising high at the edge of the clearing is a model of the Ebon Gate, with some thick grey smoke rolling behind it.

title: [Apple Orchard, Scorched]
description: The south-facing sides of the trees here are dotted with burns and singed spots.  Despite the damage, their limbs are laden with ripe fruit, and a small barn owl circles overhead, seeking a juicy target.
The south-facing sides of the trees here are dotted with burns and singed spots.  Despite the damage, their limbs are laden with ripe fruit, and a blue jay circles overhead, seeking a juicy target.

title: [Apple Orchard, Lava Cistern]
description: Some scorched and barren spots of land where an occasional fireball has found its mark dot the landscape.  Like searching fingers, tendrils of smoke from the fire-damaged apple trees and a pile of charred clothing drift lazily in the air.  In the center of the orchard, a circular patch of land holds a badly scarred oak table not far from an odd-looking contraption made of clear glaes.  Three individuals are seated comfortably within the lava cistern.

title: [Apple Orchard, Pond]
description: Glistening in the pale moonlight, a murky pond is home to a family of noisy ducks, paddling along in a neat row.  No other forms of life are detectable in or around the water, giving the area a silently eerie ambiance.

Glistening in the pale sunlight, a murky pond is home to a family of noisy ducks, paddling along in a neat row.  No other forms of life are detectable in or around the water, giving the area a silently eerie ambiance.

title: [Apple Orchard, Soggy Skulls]
description: In the midst of this small clearing stands a long table topped with six evenly matched troll king skulls.  A fist-sized hole has been bored into the top of each skull, and the skulls appear to be lined with some sort of slimy bladder.  The spongy ground squishes with each footfall, an unpleasant boggy scent oozing to the surface through the mud.

title: [Apple Orchard, Wagon]
description: A large, sturdy oak wagon loaded with fresh hay appears to have been left amid the trees.   Broken leather traces trail in the dirt in front of the wagon.

title: [Apple Orchard, Stream]
description: Swiftly flowing water passes by, the current strong enough to send up a cold mist of water droplets from the points where rocks poke their heads up above the stream's surface.  Though a bit muddy around the banks, the center of the stream flows bright and clear.  The otherwise peaceful panorama is broken by laughter-filled shouts, cheers, and mocking cries coming from upstream and down.  A narrow footpath winds along the western edge of the watercourse.

title: [Apple Orchard, Seclusion]
description: Under the spreading boughs of an apple tree, a sturdy rock bench offers a secluded spot for private conversations in the moonlight.
Under the spreading boughs of an apple tree, a sturdy rock bench offers a shady spot for picnics or a secluded area for private conversation.

title: [Apple Orchard, Eel Squeals]
description: Torch light casts long wavering shadows, which dance eerily beneath the branches.  Centered between two rows of fruit trees, gurgling and splashing sounds rise from an open tub that looks something like an oversized wine-press.  A closer look reveals an odd contraption consisting of a copper-lined vat with a series of tightly spiraled copper rods sunk deep into its liquid contents.  Attached to a circular armature supported by the copper rods, four T-shaped handles are evenly spaced around the ring.

Mottled shadows speckle the area as diluted sunshine slips between leaves and branches.  Centered between two rows of fruit trees, gurgling and splashing sounds rise from an open tub that looks something like an oversized wine-press.  A closer look reveals an odd contraption consisting of a copper-lined vat with a series of tightly spiraled copper rods sunk deep into its liquid contents.  Attached to a circular armature supported by the copper rods, four T-shaped handles are evenly spaced around the ring.

title: [Apple Orchard, Skull Swimmers]
description: Vertically faced limestone boulders define the edge of the orchard, making further progress to the north impossible.  A swiftly moving stream, surfacing from an underground water source, burbles out of the rock and flows out in sheets from behind a rusted metal grate set into the rock itself.

title: [Apple Orchard, Petals]
description: Among the fruiting trees in this section of the orchard, some are still in flower, causing a snowy cascade of petals to rain down on the heads of passersby with each gust of wind.

title: [Apple Orchard, Madame Tasaria]
description: Sprawled beneath a towering tree, with its boughs home for numerous feathered and furry creatures, rests a massive ebonwood chair and a much plainer oak chair with a round carved table nestled between them.  Well-trimmed grass with a smattering of buttercups ripples lazily on a scarcely felt breeze.  Two piles of rotting apples rest not far from a boulder that vaguely resembles a frog wearing a wide-brimmed hat.

title: [Velathae, North Sunrise Road]
description: The homes lining both sides of the road here are run down due to obvious lack of care, overrun with creeping growths and thorny bushes.  Tall stalks of yellow and brown grasses obscure the view of the ground surrounding the road, and thick, darkly colored vines tightly clutch the remains of the structures.

title: [Velathae, North Sunset Street]
description: A wide intersection has been cleared to the north, allowing access to and from the outskirts of town.  Small, incomplete stone fences line the road as it splits in an attempt to bar access to the area's small gardens, yards, and homes.  A wooden hut stands to the south, contrasting oddly with the stone architecture that surrounds it.

title: [Velathae, North Sunrise Road]
description: Sturdy-looking wood and brick houses line the southern portion of the road, each adorned with its own fence and lantern post.  Sturdy posts support a flat roof over a small patch of grass riddled with worn walking tracks and surrounded by a variety of barrels in various stages of repair and decay.

title: [Velathae, North Sunrise Road]
description: Jutting out of the ground at an unusual angle, a wooden lantern post marks the end of the fence, as well as the street.  A failing wooden bridge connects the road to the southeast, providing passage over a violently rushing stream.  The water below is murky and dark, and jagged rocks break through its surface.  A sour stench emanates from the small body of water, and tiny bubbles foam along the bank, popping with unnatural clarity.

title: [Velathae, Covered Bridge]
description: Loud scratching noises emanate from the ceiling, and tree limbs can be seen swaying in the wind through the missing portions of the structure's covered roof.  A cold breeze howls as it swirls continuously through the length of the bridge, causing the thick layers of spiderwebs along the windows and in the corners to ripple.  The walls are coated with a slimy layer of moisture, and are disturbed only by the skittering insects that wriggle from one dark hiding place to another.

title: [Velathae, East Sunrise Road]
description: A winding path cuts through the dense woods that strangle the light of a nearby lantern post, turning away from the shadowed, rotting wooden bridge to the northeast.  Unnatural shrieks and cries echo from the trees nearby, but the thickness of the foliage prevents finding the source of the noise.  Pairs of pale yellow and dark red eyes gleam occasionally from the light of the lantern, but vanish quickly as they dart to and from different portions of the forest.

title: [Velathae, East Sunrise Road]
description: A series of two-story houses dots either side of the road here, though most have fallen into disrepair.  Plants have long since broken through the paths and walkways that line the unkept yards, and doors and shutters hang off their rusted hinges.  Spiderwebs cover many of the windows and porches, and a number of the roofs have notable holes.

title: [Velathae, East Sunrise Road]
description: Several well-maintained buildings line the western portion of the road, but dilapidated homes, abandoned and left to the elements, rest to the east, accessible through gaps in the post and rail fence.  The forest opposite the town creeps steadily closer here, but remains unnaturally still.

title: [Velathae, East Sunrise Road]
description: The road is notably marred with the grooves of wagon wheels and the footprints of beasts of burden where it connects to the street to the west.  A number of lantern posts are placed about the junction, each placed to cast light on a different portion of the area.

title: [Velathae, East Sunset Street]
description: A makeshift side-street has been carved into the terrain to the east by abundant travel from both beasts of burden and heavy wagon wheels.  The mud is thick and soupy, and the plant-life that once thrived here has been trampled into submission.  Directly across from the intersection, through a massive black gate, is a brick path that leads to the entrance of a large temple.

title: [Velathae, East Sunrise Road]
description: A strong odor emanates from a large stack of hay heaped along the fence to the east.  Long-rotted fruits and vegetables have collapsed upon themselves and each other, staining the hay darkly with shades of red, orange, and brown.  A bushel of seemingly ripe apples stands on the opposite side of the street, next to a red brick house with a recently swept walkway.

title: [Velathae, East Sunrise Road]
description: The sound of violently rushing water is somewhat choked by a thick, dark forest to the east.  Animal cries echo from the woods from time to time, piercing the still air with high-pitched shrieks.  A perfectly set stone path leads from the western portion of the road to a well-maintained brick house, along with a small shed and barn.

title: [Velathae, East Sunrise Road]
description: A murky pond rests on the opposite side of the fence, its surface still and undisturbed.  South of the pond, the remains of a stone fireplace rest on a small plot of land marred with an unusual series of scorch marks.

title: [Velathae, South Sunrise Road]
description: The makeshift road is little more than thick, well-traveled mud, rife with the deep grooves of wagon wheels and the slopped prints left by passing boot or shoe.  A wooden fence follows the road to the south, turning sharply from the west to the northeast.  Trees bare of leaf or fruit are scattered sparsely between the few houses and barns that occasionally dot the street to the north.

title: [Velathae, South Sunrise Road]
description: Large sections of the fence have collapsed, the wood rotted and broken.  Five small houses have been built on plots of land next to one another, turned toward the south.  Each looks like the rest with a small fence, a cobblestone walk leading from road to porch, and a small flower garden placed in the right side of the yard.

title: [Velathae, South Sunrise Road]
description: Weak streams of moonlight break through the thick, gloomy cloud-cover above, casting a dim light on the small splotches of withered grass that strangle the road.  Dead leaves are scattered about the area, damp with the chilly moisture that clings to the air.

Thin streams of dim light break through the thick, gloomy cloud-cover above.  Small splotches of brown grass strangle portions of the road, but have long since withered and passed.  Dead leaves are scattered about the area, damp with the chilly moisture that clings to the air.

title: [Velathae, South Sunset Street]
description: The road opens to the east and west, and is paved near building entrances with chipped stone.  Compactly placed houses, shops, and structures line the street, many adorned with painted signs hanging from rusty hinges above their doorways.

title: [Velathae, South Sunset Street]
description: Black iron gates bar entry into some of the more respectable buildings to the south, serving as a barrier between road and lawn.  A produce stand sits between two small shops to the north, but is void of any fruits or vegetables.

title: [Velathae, South Sunset Street]
description: Both sides of the road are densely lined with buildings, several of which have been abandoned.  The yards and entranceways into several of the structures are overrun with weeds and tall grasses.

title: [Velathae, South Sunset Street]
description: The compact lines of stores and houses open for a small alleyway that ascends toward the heart of the village.  A large family of crows has nested along the rooftops near the side-street, and the shrill calls pierce the air consistently.  The tower on the hill can clearly be seen to the northeast, portions of its length shrouded in fog.

title: [Velathae, South Winter's Ring]
description: Large manors crafted of granite and adorned with varnished wood rest atop several small mounds near the base of Tower Hill.  Extravagant gardens, filled with trimmed trees and bushes pruned to resemble various animals, fill the large plots of land between the homes and the cobblestone road.

title: [Velathae, West Sunset Street]
description: Smoothed stone and granite, with a polished wood trim and a fresh layer of paint, forms a large storefront on the southwestern corner of the street.  A series of shops and stores flank it to the north and east, dotting the road in an orderly fashion.  No signs adorn the doors or walls, however, and no single shop appears to be entertaining a large number of customers.

title: [Velathae, West Sunset Street]
description: The street quickly becomes crammed with shops and houses of several shapes and sizes, many of which have nearly been built one on top of the other.  Yards and pathways are nearly nonexistent in this section of the street, having apparently been sacrificed for displays, wagons, wheelbarrows, and banner-covered stands.

title: [Velathae, West Sunset Street]
description: Granite buildings with painted, wooden trim line the dirt road on either side.  This portion of the street is in good condition with well-manicured grass, small gardens, and paved pathways.

title: [Velathae, Craftsman's Wey]
description: Despite the massive trees that block the natural light from above, a healthy, fiery red glow bathes the area.  A large, open-air forge stands to the west, and the hissing, clanging, and banging often associated with metal-working fills the air.  Damp piles of hay are strewn about before the homes and shops here, and several water-filled barrels line the walls of the structures.

title: [Velathae, West Sunset Street]
description: A large, stone-clad building sits back from the road, a sign hanging above its door.  The clanging of hammer on metal rings from somewhere to nearby, and thick clouds of smoke and steam rise from a rooftop to the north.

title: [Velathae, North Winter's Ring]
description: Polished brass lantern posts mark the alley that leads back down to the northwest.  Fences crafted of stone and brick line the street, adorned with brightly painted signs labeled with shop or family names.

title: [Velathae, North Sunset Street]
description: Tower Hill looms darkly to the southeast, its fog-swirled base visible through an alley that leads to the heart of the village.  A massive tower, shadowed and hidden by mist, stretches upward from the apex of the hill.  The air is chilled by a crisp, damp wind, and the muddy road is marked with puddles that have formed in the grooves and footprints associated with frequent use.

title: [Velathae, North Sunset Street]
description: A thick line of fir trees stands along the southern portion of the road, planted so compactly that they form a natural wall.  A gravel path cuts through a small gap in the barrier, leading to an old manor on a hill.

title: [Velathae, North Sunset Street]
description: The road continues with little change.  Small stone houses and shops line the street, trimmed with wood and labeled with family or shop names on signs.  A large manor on a small hill has fallen into disrepair, and is slowly failing in its struggle against the elements.

title: [Velathae, North Sunset Street]
description: Heavy wear on the road indicates that it is well-traveled, despite the unusually large amount of overgrowth on its sides.  Tall, brown corn stalks sway gently as they bend with the wind, concealing several small buildings to the south.

title: [Velathae, North Sunset Street]
description: Dark orange and blood-red blossoms dot the overgrown pasture to the north, and thin, sinuous vines cling to the saplings that have started to grow there.  Well-maintained homes that serve as modestly sized shops rest on the opposite side of the road, each clearly labeled with a sign.

title: [Velathae, North Sunset Street]
description: A pair of large, stone memorial statues flank a narrow rutted muddy road leading to the graveyard.  The statues depict figures kneeling in humble supplication, and the shattered remnants of a silver-edged onyx sword lie in the path.  To the north, an overgrown path leads to a dark, unmarked building.

title: [Velathae, North Winter's Ring]
description: Brightly colored banners hang in the windows of the various shops here, all of which are turned to face eastward.  Manicured gardens adorn the yards of the homes, while tall trees, their leaves overhanging a wooden park bench, provide a place for rest and shade.  A small sidestreet, partially paved with stone, leads away from the area, back down toward the northeastern section of town.

title: [Velathae, East Sunset Street]
description: Dark shadows crawl along the failing fence that continues along the eastern side of the road, struggling as if to break free from the confines of the graveyard.  A tall tree looms behind the fence, twisted and warped as it turns toward the muddy street.  Thick auburn sap oozes from it in several places, and occasionally drops from one of the claw-like limbs that hang over the fence.

title: [Velathae, East Sunset Street]
description: A small path winds sinuously away from the muddy road, forking to head to the temple to the south, or behind the fence that marks the eastern edge of the graveyard.  Several wooden planks are missing from the fence, offering a fair view of the dark stones and small mounds that adorn the other side.  Several small homes line the opposite portion of the road, many of which are in pristine condition.

title: [Velathae, East Sunset Street]
description: Several abandoned shops line the western portion of the road, directly across from a neglected inn.  The windows are dark and dusty, and tightly linked chains ensure that the doors remain shut.  A large sign hangs from a single chain above the building, creaking loudly as it sways with the wind.

title: [Velathae, East Sunset Street]
description: Small shops and houses line either side of the street, each adorned with a single lantern post.  The road becomes less traveled to the north, comprised of thick mud with large sprouts of dark vegetation.  Carrion bird calls echo noisily from nearby rooftops, but there is no other sign of bird or nest.

title: [Velathae, East Sunset Street]
description: Thick clouds of flies swirl menacingly about the street corner, zipping from one stand to another.  Buildings crafted of stone and wood line the muddy street, cut off from the road by rusty iron fences.

title: [Velathae, South Sunset Street]
description: The peak of Tower Hill can be clearly seen through an alley to the northwest, and the tall silhouette of its tower looms in darkness and shadow.  Fog and mist swirl menacingly around the base of the hill, however, obscuring much of it from view.  The area is still, and an unusual silence hangs in the air.

title: [Velathae, South Winter's Ring]
description: A small alley descends to the southeast, leading away from Tower Hill and the town's center.  As the road declines, so does the quality of appearance and craftsmanship of the buildings that surround it.

title: [Velathae, South Sunset Street]
description: Buildings densely line both sides of the street, except for the few plots of undeveloped land that are scattered between.  Thorny vines and thistles slink forth from the tall grasses that have overrun many of the small yards, climbing both tree and stone.

title: [Velathae, South Sunset Street]
description: Time-weathered wagons and element-battered stands run the length of the street, their limply hanging banners faded and torn.  Black iron gates form a barrier between homes and the street, many adorned with thick, rusted steel barbs.

title: [Velathae, West Winter's Ring]
description: A small, seemingly abandoned well stands near the entrance to an alley which cuts through the row of buildings to the south.  Despite the relative closeness of the buildings here, each appears to be well-maintained and cared for.

title: [Velathae, Alley]
description: Tall buildings tower on either side of this small alley, covering it in shadow.  A large stack of marred crates rests near the end of the street, and several unmarked doors line the walls.

title: [Velathae, West Winter's Ring]
description: A small walkway leads from the road to the east toward the base of Tower Hill.  A small number of houses are scattered through the area, but several large shops, most of which are decorated with colorful banners and signs, line the street near the intersection.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Velathae, Banker's Wey]
description: A darkly stained, non-functional stone fountain rests at the back of the small cul-de-sac, marking the end of the road.  Small display stands line the edge of the street, growing more densely compacted the closer they are to the village bank.

title: [Velathae, West Winter's Ring]
description: Brass lantern posts have been evenly set into the ground along the street and are lit to provide a little extra light.  Brick and wood shops of differing sizes and shapes flank either side of the road, their facades adorned with large display windows.  A wooden archway, sealed with a heavy, iron-bound door carved and painted to resemble a black gate, is set into the base of the hill.

title: [Velathae, Garden]
description: The street opens into a small, untended garden in this small niche.  Several healthy blossoms of vibrant red, orange, yellow, and blue have bloomed here, and soft, green grass covers the ground.  A row of tall oak trees forms a natural barrier to the north, marking the end of the path in that direction.

title: [Velathae, Pond]
description: The path continues to a small, tranquil pond that rests behind one of the shops to the south.  Bull frogs croak loudly from somewhere unseen, and bright orange and white fish swim happily beneath the surface of the water.  A dense line of trees combine with a thick series of rose bushes to surround the outer edges of the pond, cutting it off from the rest of the village.

title: [Velathae, Winter's Ring]
description: The paved cobblestone road continues to the east and west, clean and clear of any sort of debris or adornment.  Well-crafted and well-maintained houses line the base of Tower Hill to the south, and a single path leads up toward it, through a thick layer of fog.

title: [Velathae, East Winter's Ring]
description: Elegant shops of various shapes and sizes line either side of the road, many adorned with large windows designed to display their wares.  Several well-maintained houses stand behind or next to the shops, and many of the homes and storefronts are marked by matching, polished brass signs.

title: [Velathae, East Winter's Ring]
description: A dirt pathway, lined with scorched stones, breaks from the cobblestone road to the east, ascending Tower Hill.  Several luxurious-looking houses rest on either side of the path, at the hill's base, and a series of two-story shops dot the opposite side of the street.

title: [Velathae, East Winter's Ring]
description: Standing upon a massive mound is a large manor, raised as if to challenge the looming presence of Tower Hill itself.  The manor appears to be long abandoned, and has been lessened in grandeur by time and the elements.  A half-open, rusty iron gate allows access to the grounds, though the path is now teeming with uncontrolled plant life.

title: [Velathae, South Winter's Ring]
description: A small path turns north from the road, climbing Tower Hill through an unusually dense layer of fog.  Two-story shops and homes rest on either side of the path, as well as directly across from it.

title: [Base of Tower Hill]
description: The grassy hillside rises steeply to the east, dotted with moss-covered stones and hillocks.  A narrow track follows the curve of the hill in an upward spiral to the southeast.  Another path, little more than a deeper shadow in the grass, winds northeast toward a dark cut in the hillside.

The grassy hillside rises steeply to the east, dotted with moss-covered stones and hillocks.  A narrow track follows the curve of the hill in an upward spiral to the southeast.  Another path, hardly more than a shadow in the grass, winds northeast toward a cut in the hillside.

title: [Tower Hill, Path]
description: A hint of wan light silvers the many large stones that litter the grassy hillside.  A narrow track winds around the hill, spiraling downhill to the northwest and more steeply uphill to the east, where it disappears amongst a stand of nearly leafless hawthorn trees.  Dark, regular shadows mark the outlines of rooftops in the town below.

Sunlight dapples the many large stones that litter the grassy hillside.  A narrow track winds around the hill, spiraling downhill to the northwest and more steeply uphill to the east, where it disappears amongst a stand of nearly leafless hawthorn trees.  From this slight elevation, the dark rooftops of the town laid out below are easily visible.

title: [Tower Hill, Path]
description: A few brittle, dry leaves cling to the branches of several hawthorn trees.  The trees themselves are twisted and bent, yet have established a solid roothold along the rocky hillside.  The vast array of stars above is partially blocked by an outthrust ledge further up the hillside.

A few brittle, dry leaves cling to the branches of several hawthorn trees.  The trees themselves are twisted and bent, yet have established a solid roothold along the rocky hillside.  Sunlight glints off the edge of a stony ledge further up the hillside.

title: [Tower Hill, Hilltop]
description: A flattened granite boulder sits tumbled to the side of the path near the top of the hill, and a great hollow has been carved out of its exposed underside.  Further up the hill to the north, a black obelisk thrusts up against the night sky beside the bulk of a great circular tower.  The worn track spirals steeply downhill to the southwest and disappears around a tangle of hawthorn trees.

title: [Tower Hill, East Obelisk]
description: A black basalt obelisk is imbedded in the hilltop and stands as a shadow against the night sky. Thick clusters of clover dot the grassy hillside and sprout along the faint path that descends around the hill to the south.

title: [Tower Hill, North Obelisk]

title: [Tower Hill, South Obelisk]

title: [Tower Hill, Hilltop]
description: A round granite boulder sits square in the center of the path near the top of the hill, the blocky carvings inscribed on its surface half worn away by exposure. The worn track spirals downhill to the northwest through pools of shadow along a steep fall of stones imbedded in the hillside.

Further up the hill to the east, a black obelisk thrusts up against the bright sky beside the bulk of a great circular tower.  The worn track spirals downhill to the northwest over a steep fall of stones imbedded in the hillside.

title: [Tower Hill, Path]
description: Large stones, nearly boulders in size, lie exposed and imbedded in the hillside, and a narrow path crosses them in several places in its spiral around the hill.  Long tendrils of dusky moss trail down the sides of a small knoll farther up the hill and off the path.  Far below, shadowy rooftops reflect faint silvery light and scattered windows are alight with a warm golden glow.

Long tendrils of dusky moss trail down the sides of a small knoll farther up the hill and off the path.  Far below, the rooftops of the town form a patchwork of dark and light and glisten in the sunlight.

title: [Tower Hill, Path]
description: Grass grows thickly around and in places over the large granite boulders that litter the hillside.  Downhill to the northwest, the vegetation sheers away to expose a great shadowy cut in the earth.  A narrow track runs along the top of the cut, following a more gentle slope downhill to the northeast.  The track curls around the hillside to the north as it ascends and disappears around a mossy knoll.

title: [Base of Tower Hill]
description: A tumble of rough granite boulders forms a craggy cliff along the north face of the hill.  Deep shadows fill the crevices between boulders and outcroppings.  A worn track follows the curve of the hill to the southwest, spiraling steeply upward.  High above, the top of a round stone tower can just be glimpsed at the crest of the hill.

title: [Tower Hill, Hilltop]
description: A low granite boulder stands in the middle of the path near the top of the hill, and its surface is covered with the blackened lines of old carvings. The worn track spirals steeply downhill to the northeast and disappears behind a shadowy cliff face.

title: [Tower Hill, Path]
description: The north face of the hill is dominated by a craggy cliff of mottled granite boulders.  The worn track passes beneath a stony ledge, spiraling uphill to the southwest and downhill to the east on either side.  Shadows cast by rocky outcroppings make footing treacherous and the narrow path nearly invisible.

The north face of the hill is dominated by a craggy cliff of mottled grey granite boulders.  The worn track passes beneath a stony ledge, spiraling uphill to the southwest and downhill to the east on either side.  Sunlight reflects from the tiny shards of mica imbedded in the exposed granite and glitters like thousands upon thousands of tiny diamonds.

title: [Tower Hill, Path]
description: The path grows increasingly stony as it ascends to the west, where silvery light highlights a tumble of exposed boulders.  The slope to the south is dark with dry, thorny vines, and the narrow track winds down to the base of the hill just shy of the lowermost tendrils.  A dense fog blankets the grass and obscures much of the town below.

The path grows increasingly stony as it ascends to the west, where sunlight bounces off a tumble of exposed boulders.  The slope to the south is dark with dry, thorny vines, and the narrow track winds down to the base of the hill just shy of the lowermost tendrils.  A light fog hovers over the grass and spreads out across the town below.

title: [Base of Tower Hill]
description: A thick blanket of fog nearly obscures the path downhill to the east and blurs the edges of the large homes that stand sentinel at the base of Tower Hill.  The path curves northwest as it ascends the hill and is studded with small mottled stones.  Larger stones and boulders dot the grassy hillside, barely visible through the shadows within the dense thicket of briars that darkens the steep western slope.

Thin tendrils of fog swirl along the path downhill to the east and soften the edges of the large homes that stand sentinel at the base of Tower Hill.  The path curves northwest as it ascends the hill and is studded with small mottled stones.  Larger stones and boulders dot the grassy hillside, visible even through the dense thicket of briars that darkens the steep western slope.

title: [Tower Hill, Hilltop]
description: In the center of the path near the top of the hill rests an irregular granite boulder with lines of dark moss tracing old carvings across its surface.  Further up the hill to the west, a black obelisk thrusts up against the night sky beside the bulk of a great circular tower.  The worn track spirals steeply downhill to the southeast alongside a shallow gully.

title: [Tower Hill, Path]
description: The narrow path continues to spiral about the hill, ascending to the north above a dense thicket of thorny briars, and descending to the southwest among the hawthorn trees.  Mossy stones litter the grass, bedded down amongst thick patches of clover.  Below, the rooftops of homes, shops, and manor houses are silvered by the night and half-shrouded by the ever-present fog.

title: [Base of Tower Hill]
description: Fog lies heavy on the ground and obscures the southern path into the town below. High above, at the crown of the hill, the bulk of a round stone tower cuts a wide shadow across the starry night sky.

title: [Tower Hill, Path]
description: Pale stones litter the grassy hillside and gleam with the faintest of reflected light.  A dense thicket of briars covers the lower eastern slope in a thorny tangle, and dry runners and tendril vines encroach on the path.  Further up the hill, the rounded side of a tall tower looms against the starry sky.

title: [Kamajen's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a stained mahogany ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the red dragon-inlaid walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a life-sized granite maiden statue rests on a polished marble floor.

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: Stained and torn murals and tapestries line the wall as the path ascends upward, and the strong scent of blood and rot reaches down from above.

title: [Cavern Home, Outlet]
description: Granite forms the walls, floor and ceiling of this small room, but the granite has been sculpted so that there are no flat surfaces or right angles in any of it.  A gelatinous trail creeps along the ceiling from the northeast, stopping just short of the misshapen panel on the southwest wall, and bursts of energy travel up and down the trail, crackling loudly and casting an electric blue glow around the room.

title: [Tanzania's Gems & Jewelry]
description: Thick, garnet-colored carpeting extends from the main room into this quiet nook.  Several small tables are clustered in the center of the room, while long shelves hang from the walls, displaying a wide array of trinkets.  Warm light flickers from a small bronze chandelier hanging directly above the tables.

title: [Kharam Dzu, Arrival Annex]
description: This torch-lit room is enclosed by smooth, stone walls.  Deep blue curtains cover a rounded arch, next to which hangs a large sign.  On the opposite wall hangs a portrait, providing the room's only accent.

title: [Company Store, Dry Goods]
description: A light dusting of flour covers the floor where a bag has burst from being knocked off of a shelf.  A slight lad busily cleans up the mess, sweeping the white powder into a dustpan and from there into a trash bin.  A young mother, making one heck of a ruckus, is angrily chastizing a tearful child while she searches for the silvers required to pay for the wasted victual.

title: [Gallery, Above the Isle]
description: A circular balcony fashioned of brilliantly polished mithril surrounds the entire room.  Daylight streams through the domed ceiling above, though the vision below is far more ominous.  Ascending from far below is a model of the Eye of V'tull, its cone rising through the center of the balcony's ring.  Its edge is close, just on the other side of the balcony's rail.

title: [Pelt & Mandible, Workroom]
description: The air in this room is heavy with the smell of chemicals.  Behind a stained counter stands a large vat, the obvious source of the majority of the odor.

title: [Company Store, Pawnbroker]
description: Several lanterns hang from the ceiling, each brightly glowing.  The light shines most intensely on several tables lined in a neat row across the room.  A simple door leads into the pawnshop's main room.

title: [Marienna's Market, Loft]
description: The airy retreat features a small sleeping alcove, curtained with gauzy spidersilk, that looks out on a room painted realistically to resemble the canopy of a forest.  Overhead, a large round opening lets in the daylight, the rendered tree tops arching to meet the sky.  Off to the side, a cage filled with a couple of love birds dangles over a small rock-lined waterfall that functions as a bathing area.  A large window leads out to a tiny balcony.

title: [Company Store, Jewelry Resales]
description: This torch-lit vault is stocked with a myriad of sparkling and otherwise decorated items.  The many containers make the room feel more like a small warehouse than a jewelry shop.

title: [Kamajen's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a stained mahogany ceiling, a snarling war griffin painting hangs on one of the red dragon-inlaid walls.  A small brown box and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a hanging suit of full plate armor rests on a polished marble floor.

title: [Teras Isle, Underwater]
description: The water twists and turns with renewed intensity, tearing impetuously at anything caught in its path.
