title: [Aelfwine's Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is an ora-bound large walnut trunk on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: The burned-out remains of a small house stand on the west side of the path here.  Remains of door hinges and latches can be seen in the ashes, but almost all of the wood that once made up the house has been burned away.  Curiously, the pine and fir trees nearby show no signs of having been burned.

title: [Aelfwine's Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is an ora-bound large walnut trunk on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Wierdling's General Store]
description: Painted emerald green walls rise from a wide-plank glossy tanik floor.  Just above a multicolored giant toy rolton hangs a pair of cast iron sconces, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling completes the picture.  A brass treasure chest stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: The breaking of twigs and scurrying of small animals can be heard but not seen on the valley floor, which is covered with a thick, unmoving fog.  The crashing waves of the shore are now far off and cannot be heard, but the smell of salt air is still noticeable through the strong scent of pine.

title: [Wierdling's Outfitting]
description: An antique wall hanging hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls, and a painted nightscape ceiling rises overhead.  Some potted luminescent toadstools sits in one corner of a solid plank ebonwood floor.  There is a iron-bound ebonwood chest on one side of the shop and a twisted dark metal rack on the other.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: Many fallen trees cross the path here, and occasional snakes can be seen writhing and working their way between the fallen pines.  The air is nearly completely still, and muffled footfalls disturb the forest life which warily watches the path.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: A large, broken pine stands here, creaking loudly in the occasional breeze that blows high overhead.  The pine was apparently struck by lightning long ago, as the bark is scorched and the tree is split clean through to the root.  Many eyes watch from the forest, the observers taking special care not to be noticed.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: A tree stand is situated just off the path here, providing comfortable temporary lodging for hunters who frequent these woods.  The broken tips of many arrows litter this area, and the trees nearby bear the dark bloodstains of many gutted game animals.  Empty, broken flasks litter a small ring of stones used to contain fires lit in the tree stand.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: A blasted mound of earth occupies the center of the path here, and many travelers have worn paths around both sides of the mound.  The earth has been disturbed by something erupting through the surface, something large and strong.  Small boulders lie around the mound, as if casually tossed aside.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: A hillock of grape vines stands just off the south side of the path here.  Thousands of bees and flies circle busily, feeding on the thousands of fermenting grapes.  Grape vines snake through the bushes and climb the trees.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: The path takes a sharp bend here, ascending toward the coast and descending into a deep pine-filled valley.  The valley is cold and a thick fog gathers over the forest floor, secluding the thick pine needle carpet from view.  A chill is in the air, and the cold is accentuated by the dampness.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
description: The hollowed-out stump of a huge, ancient pine tree pokes through the top of the layer of fog covering the ground here.  Inside the stump, wood pulp provides sustenance to a variety of mushrooms and thousands of insects burrow busily through the decaying wood.  The ground near the stump is soft, indicating that the roots of the once-magnificent tree are also decaying away.

title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
description: Large mushrooms cover the ground in a miniature forest, as if mimicking the pine trees above them.  Their skin is soft and spongy, covered in a thin layer of clear slime created by the low fog.  Several have been toppled by the careless movements of someone or something, exposing the fluted surface beneath the cap.

title: [Desert Wind Music]
description: Mismatched slabs of stone and marble make up the walls of this small, windowless shop.  The creaky pine floorboards have been covered with a worn goat hide rug, while an array of gold and copper banners hang from the ceiling.  In the back of the room a display of fine-crafted ayrs sits along the wall.

title: [Alisis' Outfitting]
[Alisis' General Store]
[Alisis' Magic Shoppe]
description: Smooth sandstone walls rise from a patterned hardwood floor.  Just above a white vanilla orchid-filled vase hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a paneled haon ceiling completes the picture.  A heavy lead glass display case stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Alisis' Outfitting]
description: Beneath a paneled haon ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A heavy lead glass display case sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the hardwood floor.

title: [Repository, Facades]
description: Carved into the moldings of the high ceiling is a multi-tiered image depicting levels of commerce, including raw materials mining, production, sales, tax, and use.  The pale grey-blue granite floors are clean and polished, bearing a number of angled counters with small replica facades that vary in size, color, and style.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Repository, Roofing]
description: Although the ceiling is high, it is difficult to see its painted surface due to the roof models hung from above.  Bright sunlight filters through the tall windows, illuminating silvery flecks in the pale grey-blue granite flooring.

The roof displays hang lower than during the day, due to the necessity of chandeliers to illuminate the area.  Odd shadows are cast in pools, each one defined in part by the model above, while modified to irregular dimensions by the candelabra below.

title: [Repository, Flooring]
description: Pale grey-blue granite flooring extends beyond the counters to the southeast, while pale blue walls rise upward to set the tall room with a cool color scheme.  Shoppers peruse small floor samples displayed on the counters, occasionally checking the color or pattern of the mockup against their own clothes.

title: [Grey Moon Manor, Courtyard]
description: Behind the entrance gate is a moonlit courtyard paved with polished cobblestones in varying hues of white, grey, and blue.  The building beyond the courtyard is an imposing grey marble structure.  Creeping vines bearing stark white roses find root in flowerbeds at the manor's base and overrun the lower walls.  A break in the floral cacophony of the walls allows for an arched black willow door.   Shaded by a large weeping willow is a varnished ebonwood bench and a gurgling white marble fountain.

Behind the entrance gate is a sunlit courtyard paved with polished cobblestones in varying hues of white, grey, and blue.  The building beyond the courtyard is an imposing grey marble structure.  Creeping vines bearing stark white roses find root in flowerbeds at the manor's base and overrun the lower walls.  A break in the floral cacophony of the walls allows for an arched black willow door.   Shaded by a large weeping willow is a varnished ebonwood bench and a gurgling white marble fountain.

title: [Repository, Ceilings]
description: Artful renditions of miniature ceilings are displayed on velvet-topped glaesine counters, while clerks stand at attention, ready to assist the nearest eager customer.  The pale blue-grey granite floor comes to an abrupt halt at a sweeping staircase to the north.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary Pawnshop]
description: Canvas curtains on two windows have been pulled back to allow light into the room, supplemented by rogue beams of light peeking through tears in the tarpaulin that serves as a roof.  A rusty wire supports a small sign hanging from the center support post.

Four oil lanterns hang from the plank walls, their repeated use leaving long, blackened stains on the tarpaulin roof overhead.  A rusty wire supports a small sign hanging from the center support post.

title: [Repository, Sign Room]
description: The pale maple floor's wide planks extend in all directions and pale ivory walls allow available light to bounce about best.  Three golden easels each contain the room's catalog, while sample signage is hung high against the walls, above the arches leading to other shops.  A broad, semicircular staircase leads down, its oak banister lacquered to a high gloss.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Sitting Room]
description: This might have once been a very comfortable sitting room, but the sharp teeth and jagged claws of some beast didn't seem to care much for rest.  A dark plush carpet, now torn and slashed in many places, is doing a poor job of covering the floor, and the bone walls are bare and badly scratched as well.

title: [Bonespear Tower, West Hallway]
description: The hall ends at a gruesome doorway constructed completely of teeth.  Only the polished ivory femur used for a handle stands out, the rest of the door is nothing more than a mass of fangs and molars.  This passage won't soon bring a smile to anyone's face.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Small Library]
description: What must have been a library is now only a mass of shredded paper, tattered scrolls and aged books.  The ancient wooden bookcases that line the walls from floor to ceiling are empty save for a few ruined texts, and most of their shelves have collapsed from rot and decay.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Bedroom]
description: Little of value remains in this bedroom -- it looks as if a tornado struck here.  All of the drawers of the now-empty modwir dresser have been ripped out and thrown about the room.  The framework of a bed is still intact, but the mattress and blankets have been shredded to bits.  An iron chest, hit by what must have been a massive fireball, has melted half into the floor.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Secret Passage]
description: Whatever disaster that might have befallen the rest of the tower clearly missed this area.  The structure within this hidden passage is made of the same crushed bone as the rest of the edifice, but it and the rest of this hallway is undamaged.  This small tunnel was well hidden from intruders.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Secret Passage]
description: Several sconces remain intact on the walls, but they no longer illuminate this hallway.  The passage is so well preserved however, it would take very little to make this area usable again.  The question does remain however as to what this hall might have been used for in the past.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Secret Passage]
description: The quiet in this narrow tunnel is eerie and unnatural.  Even footsteps are muffled, and in an area where one would suspect considerable echo, there is nothing but dead silence.  A huge steel door is wide open, and there is a small hole in it where the lock or latch should be.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Vault]
description: Curiously, unlike every other area in the keep, bone was not used to build this room.  The walls and ceilings are made of thick wooden planks, and have been further fortified by wide bands of iron.  Whatever valuables that might have been stored here were plundered from this vault long ago however.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Bedroom]
description: Oddly, this room somehow managed to escape the fury that swept through the rest of the tower, and the bed, furniture, and bookshelf are all dusty but completely undamaged.  Lying on the unscathed mattress is a skeleton with its arms crossed peacefully across its chest, the bony form still fully dressed in elegant garb.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Dining Hall]
description: This once impressive dining hall is capped by a towering arched ceiling that rises a full twenty feet overhead.  Attached to the ceiling by thin tendrils of rope are hundreds of assorted skulls that are surrounding a badly chipped crystal chandelier.  A second chandelier has fallen and smashed into the huge banquet table in the center of this room.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Kitchen]
description: A wide variety of broken and shattered cooking utensils cover the floor, and they present a very sharp and dangerous obstacle to those attempting to pass.  An old table with legs made out of what look like the bones of a giant has been pushed up against one wall near a badly dented iron stove.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Storage Area]
description: There is the slight tinge of a putrid rotting odor hanging in the air of this storeroom, but enough time has passed so that the smell is no longer offensive.  The floor is covered by trash and debris that reaches over a foot deep in some spots, but all of it is nothing more than unrecognizeable junk.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Pantry]
description: A number of wooden shelves line the walls of this tiny room, but other than a few lidless jars of some putrid, greenish substance, all of them are empty.  There is a rancid odor to this pantry, but thankfully it's quite faint.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Storage Shed]
description: A thick, but now ruined door must have originally been placed here to guard something, but whatever it might have been is long gone.  This room is completely empty, but oddly, it seems considerably colder than the rest of the tower.  One of the reasons could be the huge gaping hole in the floor.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Lever Room]
description: A gigantic metal lever is inset into the wall, but it seems to have no apparent use.  It does however make a very nice footstep to help crawl back up to the next floor.

title: [Temple of Industry, Rock Garden]
description: High-walled stucco terraces shield the granite walk from the sun and salty wind.  Each plot boasts arrangements of stone and hardy plants.  Silvery cacti peek from the crags and nooks formed by intersecting stones, their occasional crimson-petaled flowers and blushed violet fruits breaking the monochrome.

High-walled stucco terraces shield the granite walk from the sharp-breathed night breeze.  Each plot boasts arrangements of stone and hardy plants.  Silvery cacti peek from the crags and nooks formed by intersecting stones, their occasional crimson-petaled flowers and blushed violet fruits breaking the monochrome.

title: [Repository, Wall Panels]
description: The pale grey-blue granite floor is bifurcated by free-standing displays containing wall samples, tall enough to hide the far wall from view.  Above, the ceiling is painted with elaborate works, containing images of interior decorations and merchants plying their trade.

title: [Willow Grove]
description: A rough trail winds down a rocky slope from the bridge above, passing through a stand of willows.  The trees' lacy fronds move slowly at the prompting of a light breeze off the river.  They stand together, growing more dense the closer one gets to the bank.  The path meanders between the trunks, running at an angle from the swift current of the water with its constant susurrus and sparkling reflections of sunlight.

A rough trail winds down a rocky slope from the bridge above, passing through a stand of willows.  The trees' lacy fronds move slowly at the prompting of a light breeze off the river.  They stand together, growing more dense the closer one gets to the bank.  The path meanders between the trunks, running at an angle from the swift current of the water with its constant susurrus and twinkling reflections of moonlight.

title: [Willow Walk]
description: As the trail zigzags through dense growths of willow trees, it becomes more clearly delineated, changing from rough gravel to smooth river stones skillfully laid in a handsome pattern.  Over the tree line above, the gables of a large building can be seen, the rich sienna of its timbers peeking through the silvery green of the willow branches in places.  A small sign stands next to the paving stones of the path.

As the trail zigzags through dense growths of willow trees, it becomes more clearly delineated, changing from rough gravel to smooth river stones skillfully laid in a handsome pattern.  Over the tree line above, the gables of a large building can be glimpsed in the bright moonlight, the rich sienna of its timbers peeking through the silver-grey of the willow branches in places.  A small sign stands next to the paving stones of the path.

title: [Willow Walk]
description: A dense stand of tall willows creates a natural arch over the trail as it passes between their rough-barked boles.  As river breezes play through the branches hanging in graceful swags on either side, they sway in a nearly constant dance.  Birdsong is a constant background chorus to the soft rush of the river's current, the water masked by the willows but present in both sound and the rich loamy smell of its banks.

A dense stand of tall willows creates a natural arch over the trail as it passes between their rough-barked boles.  As river breezes play through the branches hanging in graceful swags on either side, they sway in a nearly constant dance.  The songs of frogs is a constant background chorus to the soft rush of the river's current, the water masked by the willows and darkness, but present in both sound and the rich loamy smell of its banks.

title: [Willow Walk]
description: The path widens and the pattern formed of variegated river stones grows more complex and beautiful.  Flowers appear on either side, camping at the foot of the tall willows in thick clumps where the tall, arching white and purple flowers of hostas compete with multicolored feathery plumes of astilbe and dark brown stems of cinnamon ferns.  Ahead, the vertical pattern of a palisade is visible through a dense fringe of hanging willow boughs.

title: [Willow Grove]
description: A tall wooden palisade is formed of living trees planted so closely together, their trunks touch and their leafy crowns intertwine.  The wall extends quite a ways to either side save for one spot, where there is a gap several feet wide.  Branches meet and interlace over the opening, forming a natural, leaf-covered arch.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Ancient Trees]
description: Here in the shadow of the mountainside, ancient conifers crowd a narrow trail.  At one end, the sunshine-glimmering deep blue Lake Eonak beckons, while at the other end a grove of trees stands dark and tall.

Here in the shadow of the mountainside, ancient conifers crowd a narrow trail.  At one end, the silvery moonlighted shimmer of Lake Eonak beckons, while at the other end a grove of trees stands dark and tall.

title: [Repository, Containers]
description: Racks and shelves line the perimeter, filled with containers of every size.  The trunks and larger items are placed near the bottom, while baskets and such reside above.  Set in rows amid the pale maple floor, a variety of cases and displays await perusal.

title: [Repository, Floor Furnishings]
description: Strategically placed blocks force shoppers into a circular motion as they examine the floor samples.  The pale-hued maple floor is freshly polished and not yet dulled in the high traffic areas.  The walls are painted a soft periwinkle and the ceiling above is a plain white, both enlivened by the sunlight coming through the windows on the southern wall.

Strategically placed blocks force shoppers into a circular motion as they examine the floor samples.  The pale-hued maple floor is freshly polished and not yet dulled in the high traffic areas.  The walls are painted a soft periwinkle and the ceiling above is a plain white.

title: [Repository, Wall Fixtures]
description: Tall ivory ceilings are covered in a variety of wall fixtures, placed high enough to allow everyone in a crowd a decent view.  The pale maple floor is decorated with a rich crimson runner.  Leading up to an oak counter, the runner's hue matches the waistcoat of the clerk behind it.

title: [Dralen's Combat Gear]

description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a large oak table and a small brown box.

title: [Djynni's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the red dragon-inlaid walls.  A white marble shelf and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a polished marble floor.

title: [Garnet Leaf Table]
description: The circular black oak table is polished to a high sheen, its surface glimmering with reflected light.  A set of high-backed chairs surrounds the table, each padded with deep red velvet upholstery.  The rounded edge of the table is bordered with inlaid garnets, forming a pattern of leaves.

title: [Djynni's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the red dragon-inlaid walls.  A white marble shelf and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a polished marble floor.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Adventurer's Guild]
description: Set a slight way off the var, this manor is quiet and secluded, kept private by tall box hedges.  A neatly trimmed lawn complete with manicured topiaries leads up to a lapis-tiled grey granite building.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Alearyl Hall]
description: High, corbeled arches give way to elaborately frescoed ceiling partitions, each glorified in hues of majestic purple, grey, and blue.  The floor is highly polished, matching the blue-grey granite common among other Ta'Illistim architecture.  A massive, maoral desk consumes a great portion of the room's far end and beyond it stands an iron-bound door along the southwest wall.  Two guards carefully watch those who pass through the hall.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Alearyl Hall]
description: The pale stucco ceiling is trisected by exposed maoral rafters, each carved with intricate detail.  The dark blue wool runners lead from the entrance to a richly-hued maoral desk.  A blue-grey granite fireplace is located on the south wall, opposite a large bay window.  An oval mirror graces the otherwise bare mantle.  A crimson velvet settee faces the fireplace and a pair of matching chairs are positioned carefully near the desk.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Alearyl Lounge]
description: The lounge walls are draped in heavy velvet curtains, occasionally spread apart to reveal a rich maoral paneling beneath.  The white marble floor leads up to a long silvery runner, where an elongated sapphire velvet settee lines the western wall.

title: [Ta'Illistim Alchemy Consignment]
description: Drifting warmth from the west invades the bearskin rug-covered floor of this homely room.  The stone walls are of a slate grey and offer a cold appearance.

title: [Ta'Illistim Alchemy Emporium]
description: Enclosed within the back recesses of the shop, a silk-covered table stands against a wall.  A brightly burning torch positioned above the table clearly displays its goods.

title: [Ragnoz Bumbledown's Furrier]
description: Bundles of furs and skins are piled haphazardly to the ceiling.  Bones of all sizes and shapes are stacked upon large shelves along one wall.  A long counter sits at the rear of the shop.

title: [Sorena's Emporium, Consignment]
description: Caught in perpetual twilight, the narrow passageway carved from rock and dirt is roofed over with thick, tangled roots.  Twining among the roots is an equally tangled series of interconnected glass tubes, each carrying liquids of varying hue and density.  A slate slab is balanced, somewhat precariously, atop several empty, stained casks that line the eastern wall.

title: [Sorena's Emporium, Used Goods]
description: The burrow's passage ends with an unmasked, earthen wall.  Root tendrils hang down from the ceiling, like forgotten streamers left in the wake of a party.  At the center of the rounded chamber, a stark white table stands, its pure white cover a clear contrast to the carved dirt walls.

title: [Temple, Altar of Lorminstra]
description: An ethereal light shines down through several stained glass windows, illuminating a black marble altar.  Simple tapestries line the stone walls, and simple wooden benches line solemnly before the altar.  An old dwarven woman kneels before the altar, praying softly under her breath, while silent acolytes wander quietly about, lighting candles and incense.

title: [Marienna's Market, Balcony]
description: A shelf has been carved out of the surrounding rockface and serves as a small balcony overlooking much of Kharam-Dzu to the east and south.  Towards the north, the lush jungle of growth climbing the foothills almost detracts from the angry volcano, its towering peak often shrouded with misty clouds.

A shelf has been carved out of the surrounding rockface and serves as a small balcony overlooking much of Kharam-Dzu to the east and south.  Towards the north, the angry volcano is backlit at night with a fiery glow created by surrounding lava flow rivulets.

title: [Company Store, Public Storage]
description: The noises of the busy store are somewhat muted.  This room provides access to the company's storage facility, where lockers may be rented for personal use.  Padded benches line the walls for the ease and comfort of customers awaiting their turn.  A large opening in the wall provides access to the company lockers.  A heavy curtain that has been hung across the opening provides any needed security.

title: [Company Store, Public Storage]
description: Quieter than the rooms to the west, this room provides access to the company's storage facility, where lockers may be rented for personal use.  Padded benches line the walls for the ease and comfort of customers awaiting their turn.  A large opening in the wall provides access to the company lockers.  A heavy curtain that has been hung across the opening provides any needed security.

title: [Weryn's Outfitting]
[Weryn's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Thistleberry's Hut, Consignment]
description: Unrecognizable aromas hang in the air, although fainter than in the front of the shop.  A scuffed manifest lies attached to a short counter by a tarnished metal ring.  Cupboards line the back wall, their doors marred by dents and random scorch marks.

title: [Thistleberry's Hut, Repository]
description: Three torches hang upon the back wall, illuminating a cluttered storage table directly beneath.  Items are stacked upon it with no real degree of neatness or organization, allowing and demanding patrons to rummage for themselves.

title: [Rocky Trail]
description: As the trail climbs higher, the modwirs are left far behind, exposing a windswept escarpment.  Though one might expect a path traversing its face to be steep and treacherous, great care has been taken in keeping the route even and the incline gradual.  Scattered detritus indicates that rockfalls are common, yet the path is clear of debris.  Large rocks, all of the same approximate size, are spaced evenly along the outer rim to prevent erosion or, perhaps, to prevent travelers from a dangerous misstep.

title: [Rocky Trail]
description: Having meandered slowly upward to this point, the trail comes to an abrupt end at the foot of a narrow, rounded sheer vertical cliff.  A rough-hewn stone pillar stands mere inches from the rock face in a small clearing here.

title: [Stone Stairs]
description: This shadowed cleft in the cliff face widens as it cuts deeper into the rock.  Clever stone workers have taken advantage of the natural feature by carving a circular staircase into the rock chimney.  Reminiscent of the sound made by blowing across the neck of a wine bottle, deep whistling tones reverberate through the stone tube as occasional gusts of wind are funneled down the narrow opening.  Air moves up and down the chute as if the stone, itself, is breathing.

title: [Chimney Top]
description: Emerging from the stone chimney, the view of the Locksmehr River valley below is spectacular.  To the east, the town of Wehnimer's Landing is clearly visible, as are the sparkling waters of Darkstone Bay.  Off to the north, one can see how the forest gives way to the coastal cliffs and black sands.  Movement here is severely limited, with the only real choices being back down the stairs or across the jagged chasm to the west via a narrow rope and wood suspension bridge.

title: [Bridge]
description: Gaps in the boards below reveal a dizzying drop to the jagged chasm floor.  The bridge sways with each footfall, and periodic shifts in the wind cause minor buffeting.  To the east, the chimney rock looms large against the sky.  The west end of the bridge is secured to a relatively small, flat mesa occupied by an unusual structure.  Rough-hewn stone pillars, far larger than the marker below, form a large circle around a central wood and stone building there.

title: [Courtyard]
description: Within the ring of massive stone pillars that comprise this courtyard, the air is unnaturally calm and the atmosphere serene.  Fenvaoks, normally seen at much lower altitudes, flit through the air, chirping merrily.  Small shrubs form a ring inside the pillars, and a lush carpet of grass fills the area.  Lining a series of spoke-like pebbled paths, each bracketed by wrought iron benches, rows of flowers extend from the courtyard to the triskele building at the circle's hub.

title: [Grey Moon Manor, Entrance Hall]
description: The mild scent of roses is carried in through the front door of the chilly entrance hall.  The corridor is subtly lit by smoky glaes sconces mounted on the grey marble walls.  A finely woven carpet of sturdy black and scarlet wool covers the floor and runs the length of the hall.  Placed flush with one wall is a tall, lacquered black walnut table bearing a basalt vase filled with white roses.  Fitted to the wall above the table is a circular eahnor plaque.

title: [Guardians of Sunfist, Office]
description: Meager furnishings are neatly arranged in this sparse, utilitarian office.  Though plain in appearance, the desk and chair are polished and well-tended.  A single translucent glaes skylight focuses moonlight onto a circular stone set into the floor in the center of the room, right in front of the desk.

title: [Guardians of Sunfist, Tasks]
description: Maps cover the walls of this cluttered office, some the detailed work of expert cartographers and others crude sketches with barely identifiable markings.  A slate-topped table occupies the center of the room, illuminated by a single translucent glaes panel skylight.  Scattered on shelves and boxes around the room's perimeter are numerous weapons, bits of armor, and artifacts, each tagged or neatly labeled with its location of origin and a date.

title: [Forest, Crystal Path]
description: A flagstone path, swept clear of snow and ice, winds through the silent, snow-covered forest.  Icicles hang in sparkling rows from the branches of the trees and the eaves of the cottages arranged between them.

title: [Forest, Crystal Path]
description: Frost covers the moss and vines hanging from the branches of the trees on all sides, glittering with multicolored reflections in the winter light.  The scents of fresh snow, pine, and burning firewood fill the area.

title: [Forest, Crystal Path]
description: Snow-covered pine branches grow close along the path, sending shimmers of falling frost to the ground as you pass.  A wind chime of crystal prisms has been hung high in a tree, twinkling merrily as it rings softly and reflects shards of colorful light on the snow.

title: [Forest, Snowflake Path]
description: Pines ring a small clearing, their branches covered with white pillows of snow and their feet snuggled with homey cabins.  A brisk wind plays havoc with the smoke drifting out of stone chimneys over the homes, tossing the fragrant clouds into zigzag patterns which drift in and around the needled boughs.

title: [Forest, Snowflake Path]
description: A brisk, cool breeze blows across the path, sending swirls of powdery snow into spirals around the trees.  Squirrels scamper among the branches, dislodging crystals of frost that glisten as they fall.

title: [Forest, Snowflake Path]
description: A natural bower of snow-laced pine branches arches over a small stone bench surrounded by a clump of bright purple iceblossoms.  The brisk air is filled with the scents of pine and fresh snow, and a hint of incense wafting from a cabin nearby.

title: [Forest, Snowflake Path]
description: The path winds along a sloping hillside, the patterns of ice and snow in the branches of the trees glistening in the cold, wintry moonlight.  A white owl roosts on a branch near the path, blinking in the softly falling snow as he scans the forest for prey.

title: [Forest, Iceblossom Path]
description: A tiny, foot-wide stream crosses the path, its free-flowing water indicating that it is probably fed by a hot spring nearby.  Squirrels and brightly colored snowbirds dart out of the woods to drink from the stream, disappearing into the snow-covered pines as quickly as they came.

title: [Forest, Iceblossom Path]
description: The path circles a centerpiece, carved of ice and never-melting in the frigid climes.  A huge tree is carved from the floe, each branch and twig perfect in detail.  It stretches glistening boughs over the roofs of cabins built around the glacial roots at its base, their thatched roofs shadowed with the delicate trace of its branches.

title: [Forest, Crystal Path]
description: Bushes of holly grow in the shade of the snow-covered pines, their leaves frosted with sparkles of ice and their bright berries glowing red against the patterns of green and white.  Low snowbanks line the sides of the walk, broken by small paths dug out to lead to cottages back among the trees.

title: [Forest, Iceblossom Path]
description: The forest opens out into a snow-covered clearing.  Wisps of smoke rise from the small cottages that are set back from the path, surrounded by gardens of iceblossoms and winter roses.  A few small pines dot the clearing, their branches glistening with fallen snow.

title: [Forest, Iceblossom Path]
description: The path winds through a thicket of firs, with small trails leading off to homes set deep among the trees.  Little snow has reached the ground here, but the branches around and above you are covered with glistening patterns of frost and ice.  A white ermine pokes his head up from behind the low stone wall, almost invisible against the patches of snow.

title: [Forest, Iceblossom Path]
description: Iceblossoms grow wild along the low stone wall that bounds the path, their pale blue and purple flowers adding a splash of color to the forest.  Frost covers the glazed windows of the cottages, and a layer of fresh snow glistens in the moonlit spaces between the trees.

title: [Forest, Snow Sprite Path]
description: The path curves along a low hillside dotted with frost-covered firs and pines.  An outcropping of stone forms a niche that holds the remains of an outdoor campfire, and rows of glistening icicles hang from the rock, reflecting winter light in sparkling patterns.

title: [Forest, Snow Sprite Path]
description: A sculpture of a winged sprite, carved of pure glaes crystal that almost appears to be ice, stands atop a pillar at the end of the low stone wall that runs along the path to the northeast.  The air is filled with the scent of pine and burning wood from the fireplaces of the small homes scattered through the forest.

title: [Forest, Crystal Path]
description: A grey squirrel skitters along a branch overhead, chittering loudly at passersby.  Hundreds of tiny icicles hang from the snow-covered branches, glittering in the wintry light as the trees move slightly in the breeze.

title: [Forest, Snow Sprite Path]
description: Frost covers the windows of snow-covered cottages beneath the trees, glistening in crystal patterns with the light that filters through the branches.  Winter wildflowers and iceblossoms poke through the canopy of snow, speckling the sloping ground with bright spots of color.

title: [Forest, Snow Sprite Path]
description: Icicles hanging from the trees form crystalline prisms, coloring the snow with shifting splashes of rainbow light.  An owl flits between the branches, its call echoing in the quiet wintry air.

title: [Forest, Ice Gardens]
description: The trail leads through a wonderland of silvery reflection.  A garden arch, contrived of stone, is covered with the lacy tendrils of iceblossoms and snow-pansies.  Crocuses lift delicate flowers above the carpet of snow, in vivid shades of violet, gold and pink.  The quaint houses built within the garden stand in the midst of the improbable greenery, much like the blossoms themselves.

title: [Forest, Ice Gardens]
description: A riot of exuberant iceblossoms runs rampant over a lattice-work of stone, their defiant and delicate blooms hanging in great bouquets.  In the center of the hardy profusion, a rare moon-flower lifts its single, massive flower to the skies, as if seeking blessings from the sky.  Small icicles hang from the petals like lace.  The exterior of the garden is bounded by a rock wall, ringed by small, well-tended cottages.

title: [Forest, Ice Gardens]
description: A stone bird-bath is circled by hardy ice-tulips, their blooms braving the cold and snow in vigorous tones of red, yellow and blue.  Local avians flock to the bath, their bright colors and lively chatter bringing life to the freezing climes.  Houses circle the colorful garden, their shutters painted in bright colors which echo the striking blooms of the ice-tulips.

title: [Sunfist Courtyard]
description: Enormous cobbles are fitted into the hard, cold ground to create a circular courtyard that houses a large stone-worked tower.  No windows adorn the face of the structure, which is broken by heavy modwir door, though the peak displays archer slits beneath the shelter of a thatch roof.  Dark shrubs, devoid of leaves, ring the cobbles in a well-manicured and tight-knit circle that is only broken near the southern end where a trail leads away from the tower.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Foyer]
description: Square-cut heavy stone blocks rise from the hard-packed dirt floor to the dark ceiling fashioned of thick modwir planks and is completely devoid of windows or furnishings.  Iron bracketed torches flicker sporadically in the arctic winds that managed to escape the security of the front door, their icy tendrils also setting a bronze brazier at the heart of the room to flickering.  A circular staircase hugs the wall, its peak disappearing above, and twin arches lead deeper into the tower.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, War Room]
description: Dark smudges blacken the upper portion of the round room's walls and obscure the ceiling in hazy soot that is broken only by the presence of heavy chains that support enormous torches.  Beneath the flickering torchlight, the room is militaristically tidy and filled with battle maps, planning tables, and detailed job charts.  A steady flow of foot traffic at all times of the day rushes to and from the eastern arch.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Office]
description: Shielded lanterns dangle from exposed rafters by slender bronze chains and provide ample illumination for the windowless office.  Floor to ceiling bookcases hug the circular walls and house hundreds of books, scrolls, maps, and tomes, which are arranged in tidy order and kept dust-free.  A single desk is ringed by sturdy oak chairs and are arranged to face the foyer to the west.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Common Room]
description: Cozy and warm, the common room has a circle of overstuffed leather armchairs and low couches arranged around an enormous stone-worked fireplace.  Rising from an opening in the rough modwir floor, the circular staircase pauses at a landing built against the wall before continuing to ring the room until it reaches a trapdoor positioned in the ceiling.  A door in the western wall leads into the barracks while a wide arch heads into the kitchen.

title: [White Haven, Locksmith's Den]
[White Haven, Tivas's Lockshop]
description: A series of blast marks and acid scars decorate the reinforced walls of this small building, and the door has been carefully positioned to keep explosions within the room.  Three glaes workbenches are bolted to the floor near a wood-burning stove that keeps the room warm enough for delicate work.  A plaque fashioned from the blade of a drake falchion hangs on one wall, some sturdy iron-banded chairs nearby.

Three glaes workbenches are bolted to the floor near a wood-burning stove that keeps the room warm enough for delicate work.  A plaque fashioned from the blade of a drake falchion hangs on one wall.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Kitchen]
description: Utilitarian at best, the small kitchen houses a single table and a smattering of chairs.  Empty wall brackets display why the room's only illumination is from the light that spills in from the common room, while a small sign is tacked into the arch.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Barracks]
description: Dimly illuminated by shielded lanterns, the barracks are tidy and quiet.  Several cots, some occupied and others not, are arranged in the center of the room, while footlockers are lined against the outer walls.  Warm air radiates off of the smooth wall that the barracks share with the common room and several denizens have taken to hanging their clothing against its warmth while they slumber.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, The Green]
description: Thick undergrowth limits travel in most directions.  The deciduous canopy closes thickly overhead, blocking much of the moonlight from reaching this tight clearing.  Blinking yellow eyes appear here and there in the foliage, remain for a moment, and disappear.  A narrow path winds off to the west, while to the east the trees have tightened to form a shadowy green tunnel.  A hill rises to the north, and a switchback ascends the steep slope.

title: [Guardians of Sunfist, Outpost]
description: Utilitarian in design, the foyer is tidy, well-kept, and illuminated by copper lanterns strung between several shuttered windows.  Twin sets of double doors face one another, one leading to the path beyond and the other leading into a courtyard that is open to the sky above while remaining protected by the walls of the building on all sides.  Garment hooks to the left of the entry are arranged beneath a set of wide plank stairs leading up to the watchtowers, and open door to the right leads into the office.

Utilitarian in design, the foyer is tidy, well-kept, and illuminated by the light streaming in through a variety of open-shuttered windows.  Twin sets of double doors face one another, one leading to the path beyond and the other leading into a courtyard that is open to the sky above while remaining protected by the walls of the building on all sides.  Garment hooks are arranged beneath stairs leading up to the watchtowers, and an open door to the right leads into the main office.

title: [Outpost, Western Corridor]
description: Iron lanterns illuminate the dim corridor from their positions between several windows with tightly closed shutters along the eastern wall.  Several scouts and runners jog past, despite the hour of the day on their way from the foyer to the office that lies beyond an open door.

Sunlight streams through open windows, their shutters folded back to tack advantage of the daytime illumination, along the eastern wall of the corridor and they offer a perfect vantage point of the practice courtyard beyond.  Several scouts and runners jog past, on their way to and from the foyer, and the office that lies beyond an open sturdy oak door.

title: [Outpost, Western Corridor]
description: Iron lanterns illuminate the dim corridor from their positions between several windows with tightly closed shutters along the eastern wall.  The sound of quiet talking comes from the open door to the west and is punctuated by random snoring.

Sunlight streams through open windows, their shutters folded back to tack advantage of the daytime illumination, along the eastern wall of the corridor and they offer a perfect vantage point of the practice courtyard beyond. title: [Sunfist Outpost, Corridor]
description: Iron lanterns illuminate the dim corridor from their positions between several windows with tightly closed shutters along the southern wall.  Steam trickles through the open door to the north accompanied by the scent of soap and sandalwood.

title: [Outpost, Eastern Corridor]
description: Iron lanterns illuminate the dim corridor from their positions between several windows with tightly closed shuttlers along the western wall.  Trickling in from the open door is the cinnamon-laced aroma of morning porridge left to simmer on the hearth, the bouquet of coffee left to boil for too long, and the sound of bakers quietly working on the next day's breads.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Practice Yard]
description: Moonlight casts everything in the dirt-covered yard in a silver and blue light, which is outlined in large white stones.  Wooden dummies, sparring squares, and low benches are arranged in small groups to promote friendly skirmishes and practices throughout the yard and small wooden water basins are set within easy reach of all.  Cordoned off from the rest of the practice yard are two rings, each decorated with different colored tiles.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Main Office]

Two desks are pushed together, one large and the other small, while a series of wooden chairs are set in a ring about them.  The entire eastern wall is covered a bookcase that is heavy with scrolls, books, tomes, and the occasional odd artifact, which is kept under a protective glass.

title: [Outpost, Watch Tower West]
description: Framed on three of four sides by wide open windows, the tower is bare of all furnishings and connected to the rest of the building by a thin corridor leading east and wide plank stairs leading down.  Each window provides a vantage point for a different area around the building and has shutters wrapped around them that can be pulled tight for protective shielding.  A thin pipe collects water from the roof and deposits it into a copper-banded oak barrel at the center of the room.

title: [Outpost, Tower Corridor]
description: Narrow and devoid of furnishings, the corridor passes between the two watch towers and houses a pair of windows.  One window gazes down upon the entry to the building, while the other one faces the wide practice courtyard.

title: [Outpost, Watch Tower East]
description: Framed on three of four sides by wide open windows, the tower is bare of all furnishings and connected to the rest of the building by a thin corridor. A thin pipe collects water from the roof and deposits it into a copper-banded oak barrel at the center of the room.

title: [Hearthstone, Balcony]
description: Lining the edge of this balcony, which overlooks the main lobby below, a polished oak railing glows in the soft moonlight emanating through windows high on the southern wall of the lobby.  Rich burgundy carpet underfoot softens the echo of voices drifting on the air.  To the east a fieldstone staircase curves down out of view, an alcove tucked into the wall at the top step.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Armory]
description: Arranged to be the most effective in storage, the armory houses a bounty of weapons, armors, and shields in a variety of styles and sizes.  Each is neatly stored upon high or low shelves dependant upon the race the pieces were designed for, while a series of dusty oak work benches set in the center of the room holds polishing, mending, and etching kits that are at the disposal of any to use.  High above, brightly burning orbs are anchored to the ceiling within wrought iron cages, and a door that leads to the corridor beyond.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Dining Hall]
description: Three of the dining hall's four tables are covered with benches and chairs that have been put up for the night, though several remain available around a lone table left in place for late night dinners.  The soft sound of bakers working in the kitchen to the north drifts towards this end of the room, while torchlight from the corridor beyond the open door creates a pool of illumination on the polished floorboards.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Kitchen]
description: Baking coves line the eastern walls of the kitchen above three hearths, two of which are banked for the night, while a third houses the morning's porridge.  Several bakers work white-washed preparation tables, kneading and mixing the next day's bread as they quietly converse.  Neatly dividing the cooking area from the dining room is a bird's-eye maple serving table with several dishes still upon it for late night visitors.

Baking coves line the eastern walls of the kitchen above three hearths, three of which are roasting meats for the evening meal, while the third houses the morning's porridge.  Neatly dividing the cooking area from the dining room is a bird's-eye maple serving table with several dishes arranged for easy serving.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Wash Room]
description: White-washed walls wrap the room from the orange and blue terracotta ceiling to the cobalt blue and white tile floor.  Wash basins are arranged on low tables on one side of the room, clothes-lines strung above them, while the other side of the room houses painted privacy screens around copper and steel bathtubs.  A series of wrought iron hooks rest near the open door, which are directly opposite an oak and iron water pump.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Barracks]
description: Copper lanterns, shielded so as not to disturb those that slumber, frame the open door that leads into the corridor.  Several bunkbeds are arranged against the back wall, and the opposite wall houses an alternating pattern of footlockers, with hooks above them, and bookcases.  Many of the bunks are occupied with prone shadowy figures, while others lie empty.

Sunlight creates pools of light where it streams into the barracks from the open door that leads into the corridor.  Several bunkbeds are arranged against the back wall, and the opposite wall houses an alternating pattern of footlockers, with hooks above them, and bookcases.  Several people wander in and out of the room, their voices jovial as they banter with one another.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Barracks]
description: Separated from the other side of the barracks by a pair of oak-framed cotton mattress bunkbeds, this end houses a pair of weathered desks framing a riverstone fireplace.  A small rug rests upon the floor, its worn expanse covered with several wicker-backed polished maple chairs arranged in conversational groups with small tables set between them.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, War Room]
description: Illuminated by dozens of copper-wrapped glass lanterns, the room is a constant bustle of traffic that flows in and out of the office.  A worn track in the polished oak floors forms a triangle around the room from the carved mahogany desk, a series of waxy parchment maps covering the western wall, and the open sturdy oak door.  Several wooden chairs are made available for the scouts and runners that briefly visit.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: Towering granite shelves have been carved into the library's very walls, lined with ancient texts and tomes in meticulous order.  Smaller receptacles occupy the interior area, with plush runners outlining the paths between and dulling the sound of footsteps.  Arranged in perfect circles around glaes-topped tables are stout leather armchairs, able to accommodate wizards of all girths.

title: [Wizard Guild, Repository]
description: Reinforced steel shelves and racks provide adequate storage and easy access to items required by guild members.  A bespectacled, red-robed dwarf carefully catalogs the inventory between attending to the needs of his customers.

title: [Rock Stairs]
description: The trail winds gently upwards, with an occasional stairstep so subtly crafted that they appear almost natural, yet too perfect to be other than the handiwork of skilled stonemasons.  The occasional dressed boulder marks an unmistakable path from the boulder field below.

title: [Ascent]
description: The craftsmanship of skilled stonemasons is evident everywhere as the path winds its way upward.  Although the trail is steep at points, each step is carefully carved from the dense stone, and the occasional handhold affords the heavily burdened a measure of safety.  The view in either direction is restricted by the continually twining path, but a warm, sweetly scented breeze flows downward from the unseen summit.

title: [Hilltop]
description: This rugged hilltop commands a sweeping vista of the whole of Vaalor.  To the east, the Mistydeep River winds like a silver ribbon past the citadel at Ravelin to the great city of Ta'Vaalor.  To the west, the distant, snow-capped peaks of the DragonSpine are nearly lost in purplish haze.  A sturdy fortress dominates the summit here, crafted from dressed stone and massive oak planks.  Clumps of sweetly scented delphinuris grow on dozens of earthen mounds surrounding the structure.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Parade Grounds]
description: Sturdy palisades enclose a square of neatly packed dirt, perhaps twenty yards on a side.  Each corner is guarded by a stout tower, providing both a secure room at the base and a defensive platform above.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Command Post]
description: Four small lanterns overhead cast a ruddy glow over this compact room, augmenting the slanting sunbeam projected from a large crystal overhead.  The room is dominated by a table covered with maps, many pierced with red-tipped pins.  Superintendent Draelox and several other officers stand near a small woodstove in a corner, their stern expressions matching the tone of their soft mutterings.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, War Room]
description: Ranks of benches fill the center of this square, low-ceilinged room, facing a large slate slab leaning against one wall.  Nearby, Taskmaster Galine flips through a sheaf of dispatches on a compact table, giving assignments to the regular flow of combatants to address each report.

title: [Weryn's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Sylvarraend Herbals]
description: Moonlight glimmers through the glaesine windows, each framed with a swath of pale yellow gauze.  The monir planked flooring is polished to a dull sheen.  Lining the walls are shelves holding bottles and flasks of all sizes, each carefully labeled with a small tag denoting its contents.

title: [Outpost, Courtyard]
description: Cobblestones encircle a narrow stone well and pave the courtyard set inside the walls of the palisade.  On opposite sides of the courtyard are two graceful stone and wood structures, identical but for vibrant silk banners of gold and silver hung from the eaves of the buildings.  Gold banners float above a small hut on the western side of the courtyard and silver banners flap softly over a small building on the eastern side of the courtyard.

title: [Outpost, Office]
description: Spartan enough to make a Vaalor elf proud, the interior of the office is empty but for a single cot, a collapsible field desk, and a chest opened to reveal numerous pigeon holes filled with scrolls, maps, and other papers.  A banner hangs on one wall, opposite two large windows made of double arches and set with a wide wooden sill.

title: [Outpost, Taskmaster's Post]
description: The taskmaster stands before a wide map and is the center of a maelstrom of arriving and departing scouts and fellow members of the Guardians of Sunfist.  Two large windows formed from double arches are set into one wall of the room, while several shelves lining the walls opposite are covered in both spent and new candles.  A massive axe is leaned on its head in one corner, ready at a moment's notice for use by its owner.

title: [Zul Logoth, Moss Tunnel]
description: Lacy, phosphorescent moss clings tightly to the small stalactites lining the tunnel, but some of the heavier clusters dangle like banners in the air.  The path has been unnaturally widened, allowing ample room for carts to transport supplies along the route.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Moss Tunnel]
description: Along the bend in the tunnel, a single giant luminescent toadstool has been placed.  The glowing fungus radiates a cheerful white light upon the nearby stone, illuminating the rough surface and casting strangely shaped shadows upon the walls and floor.  A strong scent of loam emanates from the toadstool's engraved bronze pot.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Moss Tunnel]
description: Tiny rocky debris has been swept to the side into accumulated piles.  Constant foot traffic has smoothed the floor, revealing glimmering specks of mica and quartz in the stone.  A faint, yet not unpleasant, fungal aroma hangs in the air, mingled slightly with the fragrance of hearty dwarven ale.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Moss Tunnel]
description: A blackened iron gate cuts off passage through a hole in the tunnel to the west.  Darkness shrouds the area beyond the blockage, though water can be heard dripping from somewhere on high.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Zul Logoth, Moss Tunnel]
description: Dominating the view to the north is a substantial opening in the tunnel leading to large cavern.  Niches have been carved into the rocky walls, tall enough to house a giantman, and each indentation holds a luminescent toadstool.  The combined luminescence of the fungi brighten every corner and crevice, banishing all shadows from the vicinity.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Mossy Courtyard]
description: Well-tended lawns of silvery red moss cover much of the open expanse, radiating outward from a circular courtyard bordered by small boulders of polished black granite.  Ringing the outer perimeter, several stalagmites have been hewn into pedestals that support highly detailed statuary captured in poses of battle.  An immense invar portcullis, flanked by armored, dwarven guards on either side, serves as the entrance to a stark grey limestone edifice.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Ingress]
description: A lone sentinel wrought of glossy white marble stands before the invar portcullis, with stoic eyes fixed on the path ahead.  Suspended above the stone figure is a large banner stitched in silver.  Giant luminescent toadstools form a half-circle around the entrance, shedding their soft, bluish-white light upon the reflective stone walls.  An enruned archway partitions the entrance from the rest of the edifice to the northwest.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Juncture]
description: Heavy footsteps can be heard, echoing off the polished stone floor, from the many branching halls within the building.  Low murmurs of conversation occasionally arise, though the participants remain unseen.  A grand mural has been rendered in bas-relief upon the inner wall, depicting the battle of Sunfist in magnificent detail.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Hallway]
description: A white, eostone-inlaid door occupies the western wall, flanked by a pair of small, potted luminescent toadstools.  The hall curves slightly in this area, and the normally pale grey walls have taken on a faint greenish tint from the glowing fungi.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Hallway]
description: Immaculately tidy, the hall is empty of disruptive furnishings to its simple, clean lines.  A simple eostone inlay graces the nearby white stone door with a decorative touch.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Hallway]
description: Simple wool runners cover the polished stone floor before a pair of carved double doors, muffling the footsteps of individuals walking past the area.  Mounted above the portal is a burnished steel plaque, flanked by a pair of oversized axe heads.  A particularly colorful, tall toadstool takes up residence in a nearby niche along the inner wall, its bright blue cap mottled with dark green spots.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Hallway]
description: A smaller corridor branches off to the east, illuminated by luminescent moss-covered globes suspended from the ceiling.  The portion of the mural displayed in the main hall depicts the dwarven and giantman camps on separate portions of Sunfist after nightfall, their campfires highlighted by glittering quartz shards.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Hallway]
description: Mirror-polished granite encompasses the entire hall with the exception of a mural occupying the western wall.  Predominantly dwarves and giantmen pass through the vicinity, acknowledging each with a curt nod before moving on with their business.  A white rune-etched stone door has been left open, allowing a clear view of the office of the Taskmaster, hard at work.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Corridor]
description: Narrower than the other halls in the edifice, this corridor is lit by glassy globes affixed to the ceiling at regular points, each sphere housing phosphorescent moss in blues and greens.  A stark grey stone door resides in the bend of the outer wall as it curves to the north.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Stone Edifice, Training Station]
description: Racks of training weaponry and armor reside in shallow alcoves built into the stone walls.  The brightly lit outer cavern is clearly visible beyond a massive iron gate.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Hall of History, Old Age]
description: Relics from the founding of the First Legion of Khazar are exhibited in this chamber, set neatly upon simple stone pedestals.  Several historical tapestries hang upon the plain white walls, along with a large vivid portrait.  The displays are softly illuminated by giant luminescent toadstools set into the corners of the room.  Propped up on a sturdy glaes stand is an immense granite tablet that has been engraved with all known names of members of the First Legion.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Hall of History, New Age]
description: Painted across the three walls of this chamber is the picturesque peak of Sunfist at sunrise, noon, and sunset.  Faded scrolls documenting the early days of the Guardians of Sunfist have been carefully preserved under glass on a long steel table.  Some old rolaren weaponry from the early days of dwarven and giantman cooperation rest carefully on smoky glaes racks.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Office of the Grandmaster]
description: Finely woven tapestries hang upon the mottled purple and green slate walls, documenting the many battles against the Grimswarm.  A glaes-shelved steel bookcase holds an array of texts to one side, while a padlocked, steel-braced footlocker occupies the other.  The office is spacious enough to house twin leather-covered barrel chairs in the corner, a few strides away from a pair of carved double doors.  Mounted above a polished marble-topped desk is the preserved head of one very large and ugly troll on a burnished bronze plaque.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Office of the Superintendent]
description: Austere in its decor, the office houses only the essential items for day-to-day operations.  A simple steel desk is home to a large tome, which contains the names of current members and their ranking.  Only a single luminescent toadstool resides in a plain brass pot in the corner, offering up its soft light and accentuating the drabness of the white walls.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Arena of Stone]
description: Solid walls hewn from subterranean rock enclose the arena, ensuring anything within its confines stays inside.  Notably, a massive iron gate stands before a large granite block archway, the only way in to the stone edifice from this portion of the cavern.  Deep hollows have been created in certain sections of the perimeter, and within their shadows, the savage eyes of monsters seek escape from their prisons.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east and west, although a slight amount of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on either side are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

title: [Office of the Taskmaster]
description: Scouts with reports constantly run in and out of the office, dropping off report scrolls into a wide bin on a massive granite desk.  Maps of the Dragonspine and Elanthia as a whole have been mounted up on the walls, riddled with colorful tacks pinpointing current locations of enemy activity.  A covered halberd rests in the corner of the room, beside a hammered rolaren tower shield.
location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Wizard Guild, West Quadrant]
description: A series of large openings punctuate the rocky wall on the western side of the molten river.  Growing along the cavern floor, clusters of tall crystals shine with a translucent reddish hue, reflecting the lava's fiery glow.  A pair of sturdy glaes bridges span the massive fissure, leading to the rest of the guild.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [The Elven Hold, Map Room]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [The Elven Hold, War Room]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [The Slipper Shop]
description: Occupying a single small room, large glaes-paned windows allow daylight to flood in, setting off the gem-like highlights of the fine fabrics of this tiny shop's inventory.
Occupying a single small room, large glaes-paned windows allow moonlight to flood in, setting off the gem-like highlights of the fine fabrics of this tiny shop's inventory.

title: [Wooden Bridge]
description: A small trail emerges from the brush at the foot of a wooden bridge that spans a creek.  Hidden in places by shadowy growths of ferns, the creek reflects the moonlight with rippling sparkles, and fireflies hovering in the foliage around the bridge add the magic of their flickering light.

A small trail emerges from the brush at the foot of a wooden bridge that spans a creek.  Hidden in places by dense growths of ferns, the creek is clear and its current looks strong.  Growths of moss and other water plants add splotches of green to the mottled tones of the stone bed beneath the babbling water.

title: [Priestly Purchases]
description: An elaborate stained glass window has been set high into the ceiling here, depicting a large golden crown upon a field of white.  The daylight streaming in cloaks the chamber in a pleasantly bright amber glow, illuminating the small glaes-paneled case set below the masterful work of art and several chests lined up in a symmetrical pattern with the rest of the room.  A tattered robe hangs behind the wall nearest the case, its handsome design barely visible amid the rips and stains upon it.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Niche]
description: Smooth pale stone walls create an oval space just large enough to accommodate a few patrons at a time.  Other than the subtle sheen of polished stone, there are neither embellishments nor furnishings to distract the eye from a sigil-carved round window, which catches the eye immediately upon entering.

title: [Temple of Industry, Entryway]
description: The entry of Eonak's temple is a low, expansive chamber resting beneath a ceiling of steel-reinforced ironwood girders.  Sooty and dark, the complex interplay of metal and wood colludes to support a windowed central dome.  Motes of ash filter through the sunlight streaming in, giving breadth and depths to the shafts of brilliance illuminating the temple interior.  Unlit braziers mark brown-carpeted walks to the east and west.

The dancing light of brightly blazing braziers reveal brown-carpeted walks to the east and west.

title: [Tyramia Hollow, Bridge]
description: A lane picks up at the foot of a carved wooden bridge spanning a swiftly coursing creek.  Tall sycamore and oak trees leave the lane in shadows, providing a perfect habitat for tall clumps of ferns and immense rhododendron bushes.  To the south, the road disappears into the darkness.  However, the scent of wood smoke betrays the possibility of dwellings hidden from sight.

title: [Priestly Purchases]
description: The low ceiling of this small establishment is painted a pure white, its immaculately polished surface inlaid with golden runes in a circular pattern.  Ivory tiles are set into the floor, leading north toward a large brazier set upon a raised circular ledge that continually casts the scent of lotus to the air.  Dark wooden shelves line the walls, filled with various potions and other items of religious interest.

title: [A Weathered Shack]
description: Long modwir shelves lined with various potions, tools, and the unidentifiable remains of plants dominate one side of this relatively large shack.  A simple counter sits near the rear of the room directly in front of a thick wooden door.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Courtyard]
description: A tall hedge covered with fragrant blossoms surrounds a luscious pool, whose surface ripples and reflects the sun in long bright streaks.  A statue of Cholen, poised in mid-gesture, stands on rocks in the center of the pool.  A tiled walkway leads through cedar arches to the Bard Guild, and a magnificent carved teak open-air antechamber stands on the opposite side of the pool.  Carved into the arch over the antechamber, and painted in gilt and crimson, are the words "Cholen's Temple."

title: [Fane of the God-King, Garden]
description: Lofty elder trees spread their branches toward the night sky to either side of a yellow-bricked path, which extends from a pair of white stone columns to a high, gold-rimmed archway leading into the temple.  Rising above dewy banks of amaranth and cinquefoil, the edifice is a massive confection of gold and blanched stone.  Phosphorescent globes spaced about the base of the temple set its aureate windows aglitter.

Lofty elder trees cast their cool shadows on the yellow-bricked path extending from a pair of white stone columns to a high, gold-rimmed archway that leads into the temple.  Rising high above banks of lush amaranth and vivid cinquefoil, the edifice is a massive confection of sparkling gold and blanched stone.  Crystal windows ranging in shades from amber to flax glisten in the daylight.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Orchard]
description: The veil of leaves above parts toward the outer edge of the grounds, flooding the grove with pure sunlight.  Nurtured by natural sustenance, a scattering of miniature lemon trees release an ambrosial citrus fragrance in the air.  The ends of a few branches are carefully pruned on an angle, a reverent gesture toward the Lady's plentiful gifts.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, Gatehouse]
description: Worn smooth by years of booted feet, a path of cobblestones leads the way through the gatehouse.  Steepled over the path are walls fashioned from timeless black basalt, scoured nearly smooth by the cold mountain wind.  Draped from the walls are some sapphire blue banners adorned with silver heraldry.  Beneath the banners, a massive black glaes portcullis pierces the wall, opening into a desolate, deserted courtyard.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Passage]
description: A broad faewood rises into the enveloping canopy, nesting a modwir-paneled edifice in the midst of its branches.  Extending from the trunk, a spiral of steps wreathes the length of the tree, ending before an arched side entrance.  Columns of warm ginger-gold light stream through the leaves, casting a shifting dappled effect on the peaked roof of the temple.

Extending from the trunk, a spiral of steps wreathes the length of the tree, ending before an arched side entrance.  Dark silver shadows are projected from the leaves silhouetted against the moonlight, casting a shifting dappled effect on the peaked roof of the temple.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, Courtyard]
description: A wide trail stretches across the barren courtyard from the portcullis to a low-slung keep, which bears a strong resemblance to a squatting toad.  The trail ends at a long vaulted passageway, opened like some unwholesome maw providing entry to the keep.  Reaching into the sky above the keep is a spindly tower, which points toward the mountain air like the finger of some forgotten, skeletal god.

title: [Imaera's Temple, Sanctuary]
description: Elongated modwir panels are secured into a spacious semi-circular room that fans around one half of the outside tree.  Three glass-paned windows look out over the grove, illuminating the walls with tessellated bronze and copper light.  Raw silk cushions sit before an ornate faewood carving fitted against the entirety of the back wall, conforming seamlessly to the living tree trunk behind it.
