Three glass-paned windows look out over the grove, illuminating the walls with a pale lunar glow.  Raw silk cushions sit before an ornate faewood carving fitted against the entirety of the back wall, conforming seamlessly to the living tree trunk behind it.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, Entry Hall]
description: A long vaulted passageway leads to the keep's interior through a long hallway lit by flickering torchlight.  Glass cases filled with wanted posters line the walls of the passage, while a finely woven rug of blue and gold covers the cobbles.  The center of the rug has been worn threadbare by years of tromping feet, and the trail of worn and raveled cloth leads straight to a black basalt archway covered with a blue silk tapestry.

title: [Ta'Illistim Gaol, Vestibule]
description: More glass cases line the walls in this small room.  A few benches devoid of any cushioning serve as uncomfortable resting places for those waiting for an audience with the city guardsmen.  A heavy tanik door stenciled with a crescent moon over an eight-pointed star leads into an office, and on the opposite wall is a set of sturdy brass-bound oak doors.  A massive glaes portcullis leads into the prison proper, while a black basalt archway opens into the entry hall.

title: [Deep Forest, Ancient Modwir]
description: A huge modwir has elbowed out all competition, and now dominates the trees around it with an air of haughty demeanor.  It stands taller than any of its neighbors, and a thick carpet of rust-colored needles obscures its foot.  Here and there, large roots protrude up out of the ground cover, gnarled and knobby, like the backs of ancient sea creatures breaking the surface of the waves before diving back into the depths.

title: [Temple of Koar, Grand Narthex]
description: Sparkling from above, a multi-tiered chandelier of brass-swirled crystal orbs imbues the narthex with sunny brilliance.  Panels of white birch gleam in the pale stone walls, each incised with the outline of a golden crown.  Across from a mosaic-tiled high golden archway, a velvet-draped marble stairway as wide as a city street rises toward a sprawling indoor plaza.

title: [Temple of Koar, Radiant Stair]
description: Moonlight streams through the darkened windows, spitting sullen amber shards across the snowy velvet runner cushioning the stairs.  Bolstering the feeble light are a series of white crystal globes spaced at intervals to either side of the street-wide stairway.

Long shafts of daylight, lent warmth and amber hue by the huge stained glass windows set in both bordering walls, infuse the stairway with blinding brilliance.  Beneath the streaming radiance and the additional glow provided by white crystal globes to either side of the street-wide stairway, the snowy velvet runner cushioning the stairs reveals a wealth of prismatic hues.

title: [Lorminstra's Memorial Garden]
description: Rows of memorial markers ranging from rough-cut granite slabs to polished glaes obelisks crown the resting places of those of Lorminstra's followers who have finally fallen short of her grace.
Stark beneath the night sky, rows of memorial markers crown the resting places of those who have finally fallen short of Lorminstra's grace.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Gardens]
description: Majestic oak trees sway in the breeze over a well-manicured emerald green lawn.  Dominating the center of the garden, cascading waters flow from a towering marble fountain.  Stylized garden beds, brimming with lavender and roses, create a sweet scent that drifts gently in the air.  In a stately fashion, a pair of elegantly carved drake statues, one of ebon and one of gold, flank the approach to a wide, gold-flecked stone door.

title: [Solhaven, Light Tree]
description: The branches of the ancient linden tree twist about themselves, offering numerous locations throughout for comfortable seating.  Five-petaled golden flowers and verdant leaves gently rustle against the soft bark of the tree, and the sweet fragrance of nectar permeates in the air around you.

The branches of the ancient linden tree twist about themselves, offering numerous locations throughout for comfortable seating.  Five-petaled flowers shimmer softly with a golden glow and verdant leaves gently rustle against the soft bark of the tree.  A soft, gentle hum can be heard emanating from within the core of the tree.

title: [Garden of Reflection]
description: Two guardsmen, jeddart-axes at the ready, stand just within the blackened mithril gates of a towering, grey stone wall surrounding an elaborate garden.  Inside the wall, a large inner courtyard surrounds a central fishing pond overlooked by a guard tower flying a black flag.  A tall, finely detailed statue forms the center of a fountain that rises out of the pond to dominate the courtyard.  A cobbled pathway leads up to a massive structure with multiple pillars and some dark steel doors.

title: [Fasthr's Lance, Yard]
description: Bordered by a well-maintained but spartan lawn, the training yard's hard riverstone tiles lead up to a whitewashed stone tower.  Moonlight creeps through the branches of a weeping willow tree bending over the eastern half of the courtyard, which is severed from the street by a stygian steel gate.  Numerous training dummies with battered bodies litter the yard, posted on solid oak stakes.

Bordered by a well-maintained but spartan lawn, the training yard's hard riverstone tiles lead up to a whitewashed stone tower.  Its eastern half partially shaded by a weeping willow tree, the narrow courtyard is severed from the street by a stygian steel gate.  Numerous training dummies with battered bodies litter the yard, posted on solid oak stakes.

title: [Forest Path]
description: Heading north from an ebon gate, a dirt path leads toward the Feywrot Mire.  A thick fog rolls through the area with will-o'-wisps scattered throughout and flickering like small lanterns beyond the treeline.  In the distance, the sound of fanfare can be heard.

title: [Fasthr's Lance, Anteroom]
description: The tower's anteroom is ringed by an encircling stone ramp that climbs to the Pike's apex.  Lit by blazing torches set in blackened iron sconces, the floor of the room centers around a circular tile inscribed with a stylized tower shield.

title: [Fasthr's Lance, Armory]
description: Crowded by a series of weapon racks, the chamber is cradled by the curve of a stone ramp as it climbs toward the top of the tower.  To the south, a gap in the inner wall leads to a small enclave, from which wafts occasional breaths of heat and a rich floral scent.

title: [Fasthr's Lance, Infirmary]
description: The ramp scaling the tower comes to its end, framing a cozy infirmary.  Lined with downy beds, the careful organization of the room provides ample space to maneuver.  Across from a black steel stairwell leading up to a gap in the tower rooftop, a carved riverstone fireplace has been placed to lend heat to the cold stones encompassing the chamber.

The ramp scaling the tower comes to its end, framing a cozy infirmary.  Lined with downy beds, the careful organization of the room provides ample space to maneuver.  Across from a black steel stairwell leading up to a gap in the tower rooftop, a carved riverstone fireplace and a fired clay basket of sticks have been placed to lend heat to the cold stones encompassing the chamber.

title: [Fasthr's Lance, Aegis Shrine]
description: The stone walls of the shrine are bare and spartan, following the natural curve of the tower.  Banks and branches of candles cast their light upon an obsidian altar, which drinks the luminescence in and glistens darkly in response.  Above, the ceiling is painted with a simple but lifelike effigy in the shape of an armsman.  The candles, incense, and limited means of egress conspire to imbue the room with dry heat and the pungent aroma of morning glory.

title: [Lyeonia Hall, Vault]
description: Thick cobalt blue rugs line the tidy room from wall to wall, and muffle all sound.  Portraits, covered in heavy drapes, occupy the thick limestone walls, while various chests and coffers are set sporadically about the room.  A narrow accounting desk is set to one side with a tall oak stool tucked beneath it, and is topped with a journal, inkpot, and quill.

title: [The Great Hall of Dreadnaught]
description: The domed cathedral ceiling of this great hall is crafted from the finest stained glass.  Just below the canopy, a frieze depicting significant events in Elanthian history rings the upper palisade.  A massive glass griffin sculpture stands in the center, its outstretched wings nearly touching each wall.  An elaborate red carpet connects the entrance of the sculpture with some swinging ebonwood doors and an archway.

title: [Market Bend, Ten Stone Alley]
description: Brightly illuminated lanterns crisscross the narrow street overhead, suspended from strands of twine stretched taut between buildings.  Granite stones can be spotted under their soft glow, marking the way east and west.  Debris from the day's market traffic litters the streets, the lighter pieces tumbling about in the slight salt-scented breeze.

Traffic wends through the alley, pedestrians paying no attention to propriety when making their way through the throngs.  Granite stones can be spotted occasionally through the sea of life, marking the way east and west.  Lanterns crisscross the narrow street overhead, suspended from strands of twine stretched taut between the buildings.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Antechamber]
description: The antechamber is a circular room open on one side to the courtyard, allowing the sunlight and scents of flowers to stream in.  Grand arched doorways are positioned along the curve of the wall, one to the west and another to the northwest.  A teak bench sits opposite the open side.  Overhead, a large chandelier hangs from the center of the high ceiling, fitted with hundreds of candles.

The antechamber is a circular room open on one side to the courtyard, allowing the sunlight and scents of flowers to stream in.  Grand arched doorways positioned at two points on its curve, and a teak bench sits opposite the open side.  Overhead, the ceiling is high and domed, and a large chandelier hangs from the apex, fitted with hundreds of candles.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Clearing]
description: The path divides at the edge of a clearing serenaded by a waterfall.  The water cascades over the edge of a granite bluff guarding the north edge of a small lake, its confluence fed by a stream which meanders away into the forest.  Water birds feed serenely on the lake's bank, their elongated legs giving them an exaggerated gait, as if they are moving in slow motion.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Tents]
description: Three tents share a firepit here.  Large enough to bunk ten or twelve people each, the tents appear to have seen better days.  The westernmost tent has been patched so many times that the original fabric is no longer discernible.  The northern tent was once gaily striped, but now is so faded that it is striped in dull grey.  The easternmost tent is a sun-bleached, drab green.  Standing near the firepit is a tall pole with a shield strapped to the top of it.

title: [The Griffin Claw]
description: Wooden chandelier rings with bronze torches hang from massive link chains and offer faint illumination.  Multiple high-backed bar stools line the cherrywood bar, while racks of crystal wine glasses and goblets are suspended from above.  Handcrafted black oak tables surrounded by royal blue cushioned chairs are placed around the room.  On the northern wall, opposite the archway, a wooden platform supplies an ample stage for various performers.

title: [Dreadnaught Common Area]
description: Expertly crafted from emerald-veined marble, a large fireplace provides a home for a pile of burning logs.  A finely tooled mantel is topped with a long black blade on an ebonwood stand.  Above the mantel, firelight dances eternally across a large silver banner.  Long black leather couches sit on each side of the fireplace, creating a conversation area around an enormous and exquisitely carved emerald table.  Evenly spaced ruby candelabra complement the firelight, and a small cherrywood bar stands in one corner.

title: [Hallway]
description: Lush deep red carpet stretches the length of the hall's floor, and portraits of the House's founders line the granite walls.  A small engraved plaque is hung at eye level for all to see.  Nestled in the center of the hall, an ebonwood balcony overlooks the Hall of Dreadnaught and its dominating griffin sculpture.  At the far end of the hall, a winding staircase leading to a heavy black iron door gives access to the tower, while a spiral stairway leads down to the ground floor.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Hall of Light]
description: Iron torches, lining the length of the domed hall, bathe the room with a soft, warm glow.  The white marble floor is covered with plush woven rugs and aged silk tapestries hang from golden cords on the rear wall.  Erected in the center of the room, on a slighty raised platform, a golden statue of an intricate luminescent globe rests upon mithril supports.

title: [Public Baths, Entrance]
description: Expansive pure white walls supported by tall ivory columns stretch to the east and west, covered with numerous black tapestries trimmed with deep green.  A large marble fountain stands in the center of the room, its soft trickling sounds echoing about you.  Rose petals are scattered liberally across the floor, and the sweet scent of perfumes and oils occasionally drifts in from somewhere nearby.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Watchtower]
description: Flying high at the tower's apex is a black-crested flag.  The stones ringing the tower's perch are tall enough to offer some protection from the elements and other assaults.  Spaced between the stones are slits wide enough for lookouts and archers to easily assess the surrounding ground.  Sturdy ebony barrels are strategically placed between the slits, giving easy access to arrows in times of siege.  The rotating ballista dominates the area with its ominous presence.

title: [Cavern Home, Junction]
description: A northwest/southeast corridor crosses a northeast/southwest corridor.  The gelatinous trails along the ceiling also cross, and bursts of energy coming from different directions sometimes pass without colliding.  At other times they arrive at the junction point simultaneously, doubling their illumination power for just a moment before continuing along the ceiling once more.  The rippled walls and ceiling cast no shadows, nor do they reflect the light in any great quantity.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Landing]
description: Illuminated by twin glass orbs, a hanging tapestry covers one wall of the second floor landing.  A detailed nightscape sits forever frozen within its expertly woven fibers.  A dimly lit hallway heads off in opposite directions.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Counter]
description: A polished counter of lacquered black oak curves along this darkened corner of the tavern room.  Circular plates of silver have been set into the surface of the wood, their etched faces glimmering against the dark hue of the oak.  The frequent clanking of tankards and loud cheers from the tavern seem muffled and distant in this isolated section of the inn.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, West Hall]
description: The lively sounds of clinking glasses and conversation grow quiet here, as a heavily carpeted hall runs from east to west.  The sweet scent of burnt incense lingers in the passage, its aroma mixing with the faint odors of old wine and wood polish.

title: [Charging Boar Room]
description: Walls of dark granite paneled in polished pine encase this simple yet austere chamber.  A large tapestry depicting a charging boar hangs along one wall, opposite a roaring hearth.  The musky scent of burning wood clings to the air in the room, mixing with the musky scent of chrysanthemum petals rising from a bowl atop a small table.  An elegant bed of highly polished wood lies near the center of the room, its dark linen snugly tucked.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, West Hall]
description: The crimson carpet bends here, forming a sharp elbow in the hall.  The sickly-sweet scent of dying flowers is strong, its odor mixing with the vague smell of burnt incense.

title: [Mountain Peak Room]
description: Walls of dark granite paneled in polished black oak encase this simple yet austere chamber.  A large tapestry depicting a skyline of jagged mountain peaks hangs along one wall, opposite a softly glowing hearth.  The musky scent of burning wood clings to the air in the room, mixing with the sharp scent of pine rising from a bowl atop a small table.  An elegant bed of highly polished wood lies near the center of the room, its dark grey linen snugly tucked.

title: [Bright Berry Room]
description: Walls of dark granite paneled in light ash encase this simple yet austere chamber.  A large tapestry depicting a berry-laden bush hangs along one wall, opposite the gently undulating flames in a stone hearth.  The musky scent of burning wood clings to the air in the room, mixing with the sweet scent of freshly crushed berries rising from a bowl atop a small table.  An elegant bed of highly polished wood lies near the center of the room, its light green linen snugly tucked.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, East Hall]
description: Thick red carpet coats the wooden flooring, muffling the sound of heavy footfalls as patrons pass through the hallway.  Glowing orbs, perhaps the size of a clenched fist, illuminate the corridor at ten-foot intervals.  The sharp scent of wood polish lingers in the air.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, East Hall]
description: Plush red carpeting runs east to west through the hallway, its crimson hue highlighted by the steady glow of glass orbs set within silver sconces on the walls.  Silence fills the passage, the activities of guests masked behind the sturdy oak doors leading to private rooms.

title: [Black Oak Room]
description: Walls of dark granite encase this simple yet austere chamber.  A large tapestry depicting an ancient black oak hangs along one wall, opposite a roaring hearth.  The musky scent of burning wood clings to the air in the room, mixing with the fresh scent of pine rising from a bowl atop a small table.  An elegant bed of highly polished wood lies near the center of the room, its somber green linen snugly tucked.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, East Hall]
description: The hallway ends here before a large stained glass window.  A pale glow filters through the heavily tinted glass, sending weak shafts of light across the red carpeting.  Miniscule flakes of dust twirl slowly in the dim rays of light.

title: [Timber Wolf Room]
description: Walls of dark granite paneled in polished redwood encase this simple yet austere chamber.  A large tapestry depicting a snarling timber wolf hangs along one wall, opposite a warm hearth.  The musky scent of burning wood clings to the air in the room, mixing with the sweet scent of jasmine rising from a bowl atop a small table.  An elegant bed of highly polished wood lies near the center of the room, its dark brown linen snugly tucked.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Chapel]
description: The hallway opens into a circular chamber, its vaulted ceiling spiraling into the darkness above.  Elongated lancet windows shed pale shafts of light across the contents of the room.  An unadorned low wooden altar appears to be the focal point of the chapel, its short rectangular surface bordered on each side by a rosewood stand bearing a white ceramic bowl.  The heavy odor of dying flowers fills the room, its sweet scent apparently rising from the twin bowls.

title: [Wraithenmist, Maze of Mist]
description: The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible to even see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible even to see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Vestibule]
description: An austere anteroom of pale-ivory walls that meet a simple white marble floor contains few clues about the nature of this temple, aside from the garlands of fragrant roses hanging along the walls.  A flower blooming from a red heart is painted in loving detail, recognized as Oleani's symbol.  Stray petals of red and white lie on the floor, their scent released as they are crushed underfoot.  A heart-shaped archway leads out to the esplanade, while a short corridor leads north into the temple.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Prayer Garden]
description: On this side of the temple, tall hedges ring a small prayer garden, and white marble benches are scattered here and there for private moments of quiet contemplation.  Pink water lilies float in a small pool next to a slate-lined walkway leading behind the temple.  A wooden gate leads to the esplanade, while an arched modwir door leads into the temple.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Dragon Fountain]
description: Tiled in small, pale blue glaes squares, the interior of the fountain is just deep enough for one to submerge completely beneath the water.  A spray of water jets from the dragon's mouth, cascading down his scaly hide to land musically upon the surface of the pool.  The cool water laps gently at the sides of the fountain, glimmering in the sunlight.

Tiled in small, pale blue glaes squares, the interior of the fountain is just deep enough for one to submerge completely beneath the water.  A spray of water jets from the dragon's mouth, cascading down his scaly hide to land musically upon the surface of the pool.  The cool water laps gently at the sides of the fountain, glimmering in the moonlight.

title: [Galieca's Teas and Coffees]
description: Crafted from white oak, the paneled walls of the shop contrast with darker wood trim that accents the room.  Rich blue gauzy curtains frame the glaesine windows, filtering the sunlight to a pale glow.  The walls are lined with shelves filled with packets and canisters of tea and coffee, while a rhimar-lined glass case built into the front of the counter holds various flavorings and treats.   Mugs, teacups, and silverware are tucked in a padded crate resting on the floor next to a narrow stairway.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Sanctuary]
description: An expansive rotunda opens to form a bright, airy room, illuminated by long, narrow windows.  Tall pillars of gold-flecked white marble stretch upward toward the domed ceiling that hovers above the benches facing a carved alabaster altar and a rose quartz baptismal font.  A delightful fresco serves as a colorful backdrop in the nave.  A modwir door leads to a prayer garden and, towards the back of the rotunda, a gold-trimmed haon door leads to the oratory.  A simple maoral door leads to the priest's vestry.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Vestry]
description: Dark rosewood panels line the walls of this office furnished with a matching rosewood desk and chair.  A large stained glass window faces the esplanade, underneath which sits a low bookcase lined with many dusty tomes.  Several hooks on the wall near the door provide a handy place to hang vestments.

title: [Library Aies, Courtyard]
description: The intricate ironwork gates open upon a large formal courtyard, filled with regimentally neat beds of flowers.  Several gardeners toil in various areas of the vast garden, weeding and mulching around the plantings.  The wide paved stone walkway parts to pass on either side of a large octagonal granite fountain.  A pair of mithril doors, framed by intricate carvings, stand sentinel in the massive granite facade of the library.

The intricate ironwork gates open upon a large formal courtyard, filled with regimentally neat beds of flowers.  The wide paved stone walkway parts to pass on either side of a large octagonal granite fountain.  Shuttered lanterns posted at the points of the octagon illuminate the path.  A pair of mithril doors, framed by intricate carvings, stand sentinel in the massive granite facade of the library.

The intricate ironwork gates open upon a large formal courtyard, filled with regimentally neat beds of flowers.  Several gardeners toil in various areas of the vast garden, weeding and mulching around the plantings.  The wide paved stone walkway parts to pass on either side of a large octagonal granite fountain, while an offshoot path meanders around the side of the building.  A pair of mithril doors, framed by intricate carvings, stand sentinel in the massive granite facade of the library.

The courtyard is large and formal.  At its center is an octagonal fountain, from which paved paths and walkways radiate out in a symmetrical, florally inspired pattern.  The library overlooks the open space, cradling it between its main building and two extended wings.  Shuttered lanterns posted at the points of the octagon illuminate the garden, bathing flowers and stone alike in a bluish glow.  A marble colonnade separates the courtyard from the var beyond.

The library overlooks the open space, cradling it between its main building and two extended wings.  A marble colonnade separates the courtyard from the var beyond.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Knowledge]
description: The library's massive entry hall is fully panelled in rich, dark maoral.  Pale creamy marble covers the expansive floor, punctuated occasionally by a small golden tesserae set at cross-angles with the tiles.  Large antique tapestries cover the wall behind the main knowledge keeper's desk, illuminated by the sunlight flooding in from intricately worked glaesine windows at each end of the hall.

The library's massive entry hall is fully panelled in rich, dark maoral.  Pale creamy marble covers the expansive floor, punctuated occasionally by a small golden tesserae set at cross-angles with the tiles.  Large antique tapestries cover the wall behind the main knowledge keeper's desk, illuminated by the flickering glaesine globes placed throughout the chamber.

title: [Library Aies, Octagonal Hall]
description: Directly opposite the archway, a large coraesine door punctuates the otherwise unrelieved monir panelling.  Blue-grey marble covers the floor, emblazoned in the center with a detailed mosaic depicting the House Illistim coat of arms.  A sapphire and silver banner hangs from the ceiling.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]
description: The Hall of Being stretches endlessly onward with no end in sight, impossibly long for a building of the library's size.  The endless maoral panelled walls are unembellished save amber glaesine wall sconces, which are evenly spaced down the corridor, providing dim illumination.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Oratory]
description: Niches filled with flickering candles and tiny braziers releasing curls of incense smoke add to the solemn peace of this tiny chapel.  Dark rosewood benches contrast sharply with the surrounding pale walls.  A carved rose quartz catafalque stands at one end of the room, upon which sits a coffin adorned with deep red roses.  Hanging on the wall behind it is a magnificent Oleani tapestry.

title: [Silvergate, Front Desk]
description: You are standing at a massive and well-polished desk made of ancient modwir.  A sheet of clear glass covers part of it and tucked neatly underneath is an elegantly penned scroll.  Standing behind the desk is the concierge, a cheerful and well-dressed man.  Hanging on the wall behind him you see a small key rack.

title: [A Twist of Roses, Antechamber]
description: White marble floors and walls veined with pale pinks create an immaculate antechamber of stark simplicity, and three jewel-inset arches provide the only break in the walls.  Centered with precision, an ebon marble rose caught in full bloom is inlaid into the floor, its thorny green marble stem pointing towards the exit.

title: [Solhaven Chandler's Shop]
description: This sprawling shop is piled to the rafters with useful items.  Dust-covered bolts of sailcloth line one wall, and backpacks hang in rows from ceiling hooks, dangling just overhead.  A dusty counter runs the length of the room, piled high with various dry goods.  A heavyset half-Elven woman lounges behind the counter.

title: [Solhaven Arms, Upper Room]
description: All manner of weapons have been neatly hung along the walls for display.  Deadly looking blades and maces gleam silently as they hang, and seem to beckon you towards adventure.  A polished fel counter sits in the center of the room, and is strewn with packages awaiting pickup.

title: [Tearlach's Smokeshop]
description: The rich, pungent smell of tobacco permeates the air in this tiny shop.  The gray stone walls are carefully hung with antique tapestries, each displayed from its own rod and decorated with dangling amber tassels.  Several overstuffed chairs are scattered about the room.

title: [Valina's Herbs and Tinctures]
description: Sunlight streams in through a clear glaes skylight, bathing the room in a warm and comforting glow.  Cots covered with starched white sheets are lined up in neat rows along one wall.  Alongside each cot, a small table holds bottles and jars of various potions and tinctures.

Moonlight streams in through a clear glaes skylight, bathing the room in a cool silvery glow.  Glaesine lamps provide dim illumination by which the healers work their art.  Cots covered with starched white sheets are lined up in neat rows along one wall.  Alongside each cot, a small table holds bottles and jars of various potions and tinctures.

title: [Vornavis Exchange, Solhaven]
description: This wood panelled room is as elegant as the bank lobby, and carpeted in the same plush burgundy.  Travelling merchants are busily exchanging their foreign currency.  A clerk is seated behind a nearby desk, waiting patiently to assist the next customer in line.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Brass sconces on either wall light this red carpeted hall.  An incredibly ugly vase sits on a table along the north wall.  Upon the south wall is a hanging depicting the founding of Solhaven.  A wide marble staircase leads to the lower floor of the inn.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Cubiculum]
description: The granite passage forks out from this cell-like room, arcane cuneiform still visible on the walls, though much of the gilt and imbedded gems that once embellished the ancient tomb have been stolen or washed away.  Near the ceiling, square lucernarios open to the street, providing a bit more light and a slight breeze of fresh air.

title: [Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of iron that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point.

Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point, the moonlight gently illuminating the interior of the tower.
tags: peer trapdoor =~ /Clumps of dirt make the travel here uneven and bumpy/

title: [Ta'Illistim, Tower of Light]
description: An ivory-hued pool ripples quietly within an upraised platform -- its edges swept with a runic pattern that intertwines in a thin circular border.  The peaked ceiling is also inscribed with a series of sigils, their pale sapphire hue resonating with a faint light every few moments.  Polished white marble walls gleam faintly with the pulsating light, and several elven guards stand at the threshold of a set of ivory spiral stairs leading further up.

title: [Nexus]
description: Arches of different colors branch off at eight points of the compass.  The slate floor is bare but for a sleek black marble counter in front of three prosperous-looking gnomes dressed in checkered fustian livery.  Above all hangs a bright crystal chandelier.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, out

title: [Showroom]
description: Large bay windows to either side of the door display a variety of goods dyed with the products of this establishment.  A prismatic chandelier sheds a rainbow of light across the thick aubergine carpet.  Items of clothing in rich shades are displayed next to bottles of the dyes that brought them to that color on several glass shelves and a long display counter.  The arch to the back of the room is hung with sheer curtains in the same color as the carpet.

title: [Troll's Head, Barroom]
description: Stone walls give off a cool respite from the heat reflected off rock outside.  A large boulder has been outfitted as a bar, its surface carved down into a semblance of a level counter.  Stone tables are surrounded by flimsy wooden stools.  Obviously, the priority in this establishment does not rest with fly-by-night furnishings fashioned from wood.  A figurehead mounted above the bar appears to be the moth-eaten, stuffed head of a troll.  Its dusty countenance is disgusting.

title: [Sylvarrglin Moving Company]
description: Unfurnished save one polished maoral desk placed in the center of the floor, the moving company's sparse offices speak of quiet efficiency.  A clerk sits on a chair behind the desk, peering down her spectacled nose at all who enter.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Trail]
description: The trail winds through ash and sycamore trees, their feet cloaked with underbrush.  The sycamores' bark is mottled in a yellowish grey, with irregular patches peeling from the trunks in curling sheets, which resemble parchment.  Mourning doves, hidden from sight in the thick foliage, coo to one another occasionally in their distinctive style.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Courtyard]
description: A black marble walkway leads southeast from the ebon gate, flanked on either hand by sparkling snowbanks and the random intricacies of naked thrakwood bushes flocked with the white of a clinging snowfall.

title: [Massive Tower, Nexus]
description: Wooden planks reinforced with bands of steel form a circular platform high into the sky.  A tall ladder is bolted to the side of the tower, leading down toward the ground far below.  An arched roof overhead provides shelter from the elements, and the tower branches off into four main sections from this point.  The surrounding landscape is visible for miles, the horizon blurring into a blend of land and sky.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Public Baths, Foyer]
description: Sweeping, graceful arcs in the domed ceiling spread from one ivory column to another, only enhancing the beautiful patterns incised along each fluted support.  An intricate circular mosaic of an ancient willow graces the deeply polished marble floor, its trailing vines and tiny leaves rendered in immaculate detail.  Three hallways lead away from the foyer, the subtle but undeniable scent of varying flowers drifting in from each.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, southwest, out

title: [The Lost Home, Foyer]
description: Tall columns of dark marble rise above you, supporting the high, vaulted ceiling.  The black-tiled floor is covered with a large, thick forest-green carpet.  On the far side of the foyer a fire is roaring in a massive basalt fireplace, sending waves of welcome heat into the room.  Several comfortable looking chairs are pulled to the side of the fireplace, close enough to enjoy the fire without getting too warm.

title: [The Lost Home, Patio]
description: A great oak stands in the middle of the enclosed patio, its spreading branches providing both shade and protection from the elements.  The Lost Home's two wings wrap around either side of the area, enclosing a few quaint tables from the walkways beyond.  Across the lawn, a small pond is fed by a narrow brook that encircles the massive tree.

title: [The Lost Home, Bar]
description: Set before an archway leading to the Lost Home's kitchen, a slim granite bar provides ample room to order food.  The soft, green grass is perfectly manicured, right up to the counter's blue mosaic tile base.  A sweeping, majestic oak's canopy extends beyond the deep, overhanging roof to provide ample shade.

A sweeping, majestic canopy from the oak in the patio's center extends beyond the deep, overhanging roof.

title: [The Lost Home, Front Desk]
description: The large marble desk sits in a quiet alcove set off in a corner of the foyer.  Neat stacks of paper sit on the desk bracketed by a large ink well and several long, clean quills.

title: [The Lost Home, Small Office]
description: Four small columns of lustrous marble mark each corner of the expansive office, while sweeping crimson curtains drape across the long, arched window set into the southern wall.  Rays of rippling golden light shine upon the interior of the sparsely decorated office, its glare softly diffused by the silk of the curtains.  A large black desk is set in the center of the room, its surface covered with various neatly piled stacks of paper, and a haphazard arrangement of used quills.

A large black desk is set in the center of the room, its surface covered with various neatly piled stacks of paper, and a haphazard arrangement of used quills.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Rocky Shore]
description: Fog drifts off the slate-grey surface of Lough Ne'halin in thick clouds like ghostly behemoths.  A few lights twinkle through the mists from the scythe-shaped shore stretching around the lake's western shoulder.  The booming of bull-frogs echoes across water, erupting intermittently from within tufts of grass along the bank.  A trail winds through the reedy grass which grows to the lake's edge.

title: [Temple of Phoen, Courtyard]
description: Stretching from the flowerbeds along the esplanade to the walls of the temple, the courtyard wears a lush carpet of clover beneath the night sky.  The coiled domes of beehives stand near the temple's walls.

Stretching from the flowerbeds along the esplanade to the walls of the temple, the courtyard wears a lush carpet of clover.  Boasting more diminutive workers than the flowerbeds, the area is abuzz with life and purposeful activity to and from the coiled domes of the hives near the temple's walls.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Amaseloth Viaduct]
description: The gently curving bridge rises high over the city, its glaesine abutments suspended above the ground without visible attachment.  Caeruil Arch spans to the northwest and beyond it, The Keep.  Silvery white marble blocks compose the walkway and at the arch's crown, a pair of crystal peacocks perch with wings outstretched as if readying for flight.  The octagonal granite keystone and its nearest neighbors are carved in intricate detail.

Silvery white marble blocks compose the walkway and at the arch's crown, a pair of crystal peacocks perch with wings outstretched as if readying for flight.  The octagonal granite keystone and its nearest neighbors are carved in intricate detail.

The curved ends of the bridge rise to a long, flat walkway, whose marble columned sides and white span are held aloft on bracers of carved silvery blue stone.  Overhead is a mosaic of sapphire and silver.   Periodic lanterns along the bridge light the area with a diffuse blue glow.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Quadrangle]
description: A cloistered lane leads to a foliated yett, its ornate leafwork reflective of the young trees that shelter the way, and painted a deep sage green in an attempt to blend in.  Beyond the gate is a small quadrangle of chevroned gold and white bricks fronting a domed white marble temple.  Moonlight is seemingly absorbed by stonework that glows with a ghostly lunar pale, and flickering torchlight illuminating the entrance is reflected in the metallic accents.

Beyond the gate is a small quadrangle of chevroned gold and white bricks fronting a domed white marble temple.  Sunlight illuminates the light stonework and glimmers warmly as it reflects off the metallic accents.

title: [Fayhlia's Fineries, Central Hub]
description: Overstuffed chairs and ottomans dot this sitting area, providing a small refuge from bustling customers and a visual onslaught of merchandise.  A small table laden with refreshments has been placed off to the side, near a brace of candles that warmly illuminate the room.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest, out

title: [Fayhlia's Fineries, Northwest]
description: Paned windows of rose-colored glass impart a cheery glow at this corner of the shop as sunlight streams through.  Several small imperfections in the surface create thin beams of pure white light that slice across the room.
Paned windows of rose-colored glass create pale pink blocks of light on the floor.  Silhouettes of tree branches dance to their solitary rhythms, contrasting with the pale moonglow.

title: [Fayhlia's Fineries, Southwest]
description: Small orbs of crystal dangling on fine silver chains drape in a staggered swag along the top of the large window here.  Sunlight touches them, splashing dabs of brilliant color upon every surface within reach.

Small orbs of crystal dangling on fine silver chains drape in a staggered swag along the top of the large window here.  Moonlight touches them, making them sparkle and wink in the stark night illumination.

title: [Fayhlia's Fineries, Southeast]
description: A large paned window opens onto the street, a dual view for both the customer and the window shopper.  The busy street, hypnotic with passersby, provides a wealth of people-watching, and the colorful array of fine garments on display draw looks of interest from the townsfolk.

title: [Fayhlia's Fineries, Northeast]
description: Large tapestries line the walls in this part of the shop, disguising the doorways to storage and work areas.  The bright panels of gold-threaded fabric portray the elves of Ta'Illistim working with their magical skills.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Crafters Courtyard]
description: Shaded by venerable hawthorn trees, the walkway extends northward to an open-air stall beneath a portico.  Reaching out beneath the trees like the spokes of a wheel, walkways connect a score of workshops to the central portico, where an elven attendant waits behind a counter.  A tall gatehouse pierces the courtyard's southern wall and marks the entrance to the compound.

title: [Ta'Illistim Forging Supply Shop]
description: A wide haon counter bisects this portico.  Standing near the gap in the length of the counter, a tall elf with weathered features and broad shoulders looks ready to assist those wishing to purchase items from the inventory displayed beneath the counter's glaes top, or to collect silvers from aspiring weaponsmiths wishing to use one of the numerous workshops joined to the portico by paved walkways.

title: [West Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the northwest.  High, vaulted ceilings vanish into the darkness high above, dimly lit by flaming sconces that line the walls of carved basalt.  Dark tapestries hang on the walls, though in the dim light it is difficult to make out the images woven into them.

title: [West Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the northwest and southeast.  High, vaulted ceilings vanish into the darkness high above, dimly lit by flaming sconces that line the walls of carved basalt.  A gentle breeze suddenly sets the flames dancing for a moment, then stillness returns.

title: [West Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the northwest and southeast.  A single, tall window is set in the wall, throwing shadows on the opposite wall as the trees outside move gently in the breeze.

title: [West Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the north and southeast.  The high vaulted ceiling lowers here, supporting a small chandelier filled with burning, cream-colored candles.

title: [East Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the northeast.  High, vaulted ceilings vanish into the darkness high above, dimly lit by flaming sconces that line the walls of carved basalt.  Dark tapestries hang on the walls, though in the dim light it is difficult to make out the images woven into them.

title: [East Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the northeast and southwest.  High, vaulted ceilings vanish into the darkness high above, dimly lit by flaming sconces that line the walls of carved basalt.  A pale haze of smoke drifts through the still air.

title: [The Colorful Lounge]
description: A rough-woven carpet, comfortable and perfect for lazing upon, covers the hardwood floor of this lounge.  Lit from below by candle sconce's, several bright banners advertising gatherings and festivals from around the lands hang from the vaulted ceiling.  Cracked and worn, a battered begging bowl sits in a place of honor on the mantel of the large marble hearth, framed by a heavy slate blackboard and a fan-shaped message board backed by pale gold muslin on either side.  A modwir keg rests near the hearth, ready to provide refreshment, while a simple wooden wastebasket is set near an arch.

The hardwood floor is covered with a comfortable, rough-woven carpet, just perfect for lounging on.  Several bright banners hang from the vaulted ceiling, each advertising various famous gatherings and festivals that have been held throughout the lands.  Sitting on the mantel of the large marble hearth is a battered begging bowl, cracked and worn yet sitting in a place of honor.

title: [East Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the northeast and southwest.  A single, tall window is set in the wall, allowing a single wide beam of light to illuminate the dark flagstones.

title: [East Wing]
description: The corridor stretches away to the north and southwest.   The high vaulted ceiling lowers here, supporting a small chandelier filled with burning, cream-colored candles.

title: [East Wing]
description: The corridor suddenly ends in a blank stone wall set with a single burning torch.  Two long tapestries hang from either side of the hall filled with images of battle and bloodshed.  Centered on each tapestry is the woven image of an elven warrior with long silver hair.

title: [Public Baths, Starling Hall]
description: A deep blue arch forms the majority of the southwestern wall, its softly curving form accented with pale silver leaves.  Dark sapphire blue silk curtains drape across its interior, hiding anything beyond in a haze of shimmering jewel-like glints.  The sweeping, iridescent blue wings of a dark starling stretch across the top of the arch, and the beautiful painting is further enhanced by a border of dark silver.

title: [Public Baths, Hawk Hall]
description: A broad silver archway leads further southeast, its wide gap filled with a variety of shadowy silken swaths.  An immaculate mural of a hawk has been painted above the very apex of the arch, its pale wings, sharp eyes, and curved beak adding a subtly regal ambiance to the surroundings.  A long velvet rug spills out from the interior of the arch, its dark hue complimenting the lustrous, fine silver hue of its subtle ridges.

title: [Public Baths, Hall]
description: The graceful, ridged form of a dark slate grey arch flows out of the northern wall like a cascade of water forever frozen in time.  A vivid painting of a starling and a hawk flank either side of the arch, a length of dark blue ribbon held aloft by both their talons.  A rounded dark velvet carpet pools outward from the arch, while soft silken curtains shroud its interior from view.

title: [Red Room]
description: Shades of red, from the lightest pink to the deepest carmine, cover every surface.  Red marble tiles cover the floor, nearly obscured by rows of display cases holding dyes in bottles ranging from a few ounces to a couple of gallons in size.  In front of each bottle, there is a small swatch of fabric dyed the color of the contents.  A massive orb glows the color of day from a knotted silk net tied to the ceiling.

title: [White Room]
description: Dazzling in its stark simplicity, the room's white is relieved only by the bottles of dye and matching fabric swatches displayed on its white marble counters.  A massive glowing orb reveals every shade to its utmost depth of color as it hangs suspended from a fragile knotted silk net attached to the ceiling.

title: [Metallic Room]
description: Footsteps ring on the steel plate floor, the noise reverberating off of all of the metal surfaces.  Outside of the fabric swatches in front of the bottles of dye on the copper shelves, nothing soft or yielding is present in this room.  A large orb hangs brilliantly from a braided mithril and faenor cord.

title: [Mixing Room]
description: Carefully pouring ground dye mixes into clear glass bottles, several gnomes work with unhurried efficiency.  One gnome dips a brush into a thick glue, brushes it across the front of full bottles, then hands them to the gnome next to him to label.  Light pours in from the west, adding to the light provided by two large chandeliers dangling from the ceiling.

title: [Storage Room]
description: Metal shelving filled from edge to edge dominates this otherwise stark, dimly lit room.  The gleam from candles in tall brass candlesticks set in the corners reveals bell jars, desiccation jars, and other secure storage containers neatly labeled on the shelves.

title: [Grinding Room]
description: Several mortars and pestles sit on small round tables, their grinding areas stained with color.  Gnomes sit at some of the tables and use the tools to grind barks, flower petals, and other raw materials into a paste.  Tall jars of alcohol diluent sit on shelves lining one wall, while the opposite wall holds a sluice and sink.  Bright white orbs hang pendulously from the ceiling.

title: [Green Room]
description: Slashes of a variety of shades of green, from chartreuse to emerald, mimic the canopy of a densely packed forest.  Shelves made of deadfall branches, their bark still in place, jut out at odd angles from the walls.  A clear golden orb hangs suspended from the ceiling by braided birch bark cords.

title: [Orange Room]
description: Pale tangerine walls offset sunset-hued plush carpeting.  Several display counters show off dyes of various colors underneath a pale yellow light held emitted from orbs hung from the ceiling with slim gold cords.

title: [Blue Room]
description: The deep midnight blue ceiling blends and lightens on the walls, gradually shifting to a soft icy blue carpet on the floor.  Dye bottles with their matching fabric swatches shine brightly on counter tops under a warm yellow light emitted from orbs netted in slender mithril cords.

title: [Garden]
description: Slate flagstones make a winding path through a small garden to a glaes-paned door.  Red cedar trees flank the door, while clematis vines wind their tendrils around the grey bricks of a low slate-roofed building.  In the garden itself, various dye plants grow in abundance.  A horse apple tree shelters a planting of beets, while yarrow, burdock, and coreopsis grow in rows on both sides of the path.  Along the path, perky dandelions shove themselves between staid hollyhocks.

title: [Temple of Tonis]
description: Massive maoral doors leading into the temple are plated with sheets of beaten gold and laden with embossed pegasi.  Accent blocks of milky quartz flecked with azurite edge windows and archways, creating a translucent design amid the more opaque bricks of white marble.  Towering pale haon winged horses stand upright, with their front hooves braced against the walls, ribbing the length of the building in a series of buttresses.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Foyer]
description: White marble extends floor to ceiling, nearly unadorned except for a border of lapis lazuli chevrons that work their way around the circumference of the small dome overhead.  Gold scrollwork edges a narrow azure blue carpet that continues into the main hall.

title: [Temple of Phoen, Courtyard]
description: Before you stands the Temple of Phoen.  Sunlight flashes from the facets of the golden, glaes-capped dome, and a sense of strength and security seems to emanate from the massive sandstone walls that support it.  The cylindrical form and dome of the temple echoes the shape of the beehives scattered around it in the clovered courtyard.

Before you stands the Temple of Phoen.  The facets of the glaes-capped dome are clearly visible even by starlight, and a sense of strength and security seems to emanate from the massive sandstone walls that support it.  Echoing its form, the pale shapes of beehives stand scattered around it in the clovered courtyard.

title: [Brother Aemis' Clerical Supply]
description: The austere surroundings are softened only by a single tapestry hung on the back wall of the shop.  A heavily carved maoral counter rests in front of the tapestry, tended by a tonsured clerk in dark brown robes.  The unremitting dullness of the chamber is allieviated only by a birdcage resting atop the counter, within which a bright yellow canary sings cheerfully.

title: [Solindago Anox, Entrance]
description: Built on an incline, the tunnel is fashioned from a combination of cobblestones and sandstone blocks that stretch between a massive stone arch to the south and some towering wrought iron gates to the north.  Large pavers of blue and white are surrounded by gold moss and purple carpet stonecrop, whose tiny flowerheads are favored by local hymenopteran species.  Illuminated by a strategically placed lantern, a silver sign hangs above a door, while a gift shop sits open, spilling a pool of light onto its entry.

A stone tunnel leads from the main gates to the park itself, a wide slit in its top offering ample natural lighting.  To the west is a heavy ironwood door set between large glaes-paned picture windows that offer a view into a well-stocked gift shop.  To the east, a natural piece of ebonwood has been fitted into a door space marked by a silver sign.

title: [Solindago Anox, Office]
description: Clean white stucco walls run down to hand-tooled ebonwood wainscoting and up to brushed silver ceiling tiles all around this simple room.  A large rolled-edge mahogany counter separates the entrance from a narrow hall leading to various administrative offices.  A heavy rolled velvet rope stands in the way of further progress, a painted sign stating boldly, "Under Construction."

title: [Ta'Illistim, Tower of Chaos]
description: An ivory-hued pool ripples quietly within an upraised platform -- its edges swept with a runic pattern that intertwines in a thin circular border.  The peaked ceiling is also inscribed with a series of sigils, their pale sapphire hue resonating with a faint light every few moments.  Polished white marble walls gleam faintly with the pulsating light, and several elven guards stand at the threshold of a set of ivory spiral stairs leading further up.

title: [Gift Shop, Counter]
description: Wide, dark-stained modwir counters line both sides of the room, each bearing a multitude of signs and wares.  Plush carpeting offers visitors comfort in contrast to the hard ground outside.  A large sign hangs on the paneled wall off to the side in an obvious ploy to garner attention.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Rose Garden]
description: Tall cypress trees ring the rose garden, ascending like silent sentries that provide a leafy baffle of privacy.  At the base of the perimeter a good variety of rose bushes have been planted, their intoxicating fragrance thickly scenting the air.  A lush cushion of green grass carpets the garden, leaving ample space for impromptu gatherings.

Tall cypress trees ring the rose garden, ascending like silent sentries that provide a leafy baffle of privacy.  At the base of the perimeter a good variety of rose bushes have been planted, their intoxicating fragrance thickly scenting the air.  Tiny white oil lamps have been strung on ropes and woven amid the branches, producing a twinkling star-like backdrop.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Upper Cloister]
description: A covered walkway paved with dark blue slate circles a skylit atrium in the center of the building.  A low greystone wall bolstered by a row of graceful black marble pillars ensures that inattentive guests will not step out into the empty space.  A large pane of stained glass framed in dark oak hangs between the pillars across from a heavy, black ash door on the opposite wall.

title: [The Handmaidens Room]
description: This room is decorated in a mad profusion of cheerful pastels.  Yellow curtains cover the large bay window opposite the door, and a thick pink rug covers the floor.  The large four-post bed features oversized pillows of pale green and blue above an elaborately embroidered comforter.  An elegant crystal vase on each night table holds a small bouquet of crocuses.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Upper Cloister]
description: A covered walkway paved with dark blue slate circles a skylit atrium in the center of the building.  A low greystone wall bolstered by a row of graceful black marble pillars ensures that inattentive guests will not step out into the empty space.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Wedding Bower]
description: High thuja hedges screen the city beyond the temple grounds from view, creating a small sanctuary in the bustling seaport.  Leading away from a gold-trimmed haon door, a white silk runner surrounded by verdant grass extends toward a rose-covered trellis that shelters a beautiful white marble statue.  A slate-lined walkway leads out of the bower, while a small grove of tanik trees leads to a pair of barely concealed cottages.

Sculpted rose bushes ring the bower, their thin trunks adorned with violet ribbon streamers.  A white silk runner covered with scattered rose petals of all colors extends towards a trellis sheltering a statue of Oleani and Phoen in a passionate embrace.  A small grove of tanik trees barely conceals two tiny cottages from prying eyes.

title: [Warrior Guild, Sentry]
description: From this vantage point, an impressive view of the guild and its ample grounds can be observed.  Several courtyards, neatly outlined in crisscrossing walkways bespeak of the arduous task of maintaining such crisp surroundings.  The guild's two stories and multitude of small square windows break up the otherwise stale appearance of the dark grey stone.  A short wooden bridge over a pristine moat leads back to the city.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Altar]
description: Set back into a shallow fresco-painted nave with wreaths of red and white Elanthian snow roses ringing the base, the altar clearly serves as the central focus of the sanctuary.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Baptism Font]
description: The tall structure sits on a slightly raised platform with steps descending into a small sunken pool.  A shallow basin set into the top is filled with warm water for blessing newborns, the run-off spilling down one side of the font in a quiet waterfall, filling the pool below.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Tree Grove]
description: The tanik trees provide a dense cover for a charming stone cottage and a pretty wooden cottage, affording lovers with romantic hideaways far from prying eyes.  Trimmed hedges of red and white rosebushes line the walks leading to each door.

title: [The Pig and Whistle]
description: Fresh rushes have been strewn across the stone floor, laced with herbs that help to mask the smell of too many bodies pressed into such a small space.  A fireplace in the side wall houses a small but cheery blaze, and polished wooden benches are scattered around the room.  Along the rear wall of the tavern, an ornately carved maoral bar holds various barkeeping implements and an engraved silver sign.

A fireplace in the side wall houses a small but cheery blaze, and polished wooden benches are scattered around the room. Covered with a tattered blanket, a narrow archway is set in the wall next to an ornately carved maoral bar holding various barkeeping implements and a carved wooden sign.

title: [Malwith Inn, Landing]
description: A simple wood stairway leads up into the inn, while the landing is formed from large stones.  Steps of the same rock as the landing lead down into the inn's basement.  A lone lantern hangs above the landing, trying desperately to brighten the area.

title: [Warehouse, Clerk's Office]
description: Although the addition of a cheerful daisy bouquet and a knotted rag rug help give the room a homey touch, the splintery edges of the pine shelves and the crates pushed together to form a desk make it quite clear that this is still a warehouse.  A stack of grimy forms is in danger of toppling right off a makeshift table and onto the sawdust-littered floor.  Feeble rays of sunlight, filtering through a parchment-paned window, illuminate lethargic motes of drifting dust.

title: [Kai's Temple, Gateway]
description: A crimson gate bearing the silver clenched fist of Kai stands open to Eastbridge Lane, large guards standing on either side of the gate carefully scrutinizing all who enter.  A path of pale marble stepping stones leads into the temple grounds, bordered on both sides by pairs of large, sturdy oak trees.

title: [Kai's Temple, Lawn]
description: A meticulously manicured lawn embraces the front of the temple.  The landscaping consists of cleanly clipped hedges and neat circular beds of crimson and white daisies placed symetrically on each side of the marble path.  Everything has sharp, concise lines and an almost military look about it, including the heavy oak doors leading into the temple.

title: [Kai's Temple, Entrance]
description: Crimson spidersilk covers the walls, reaching up into the high vaulted ceiling, and hammered silver frames each doorway.  Crossed silver spears hang on each wall, each one engraved with runes of strength.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Castle View]
description: A clearing opens between the scrub trees and thick water-loving grasses which crowd the lake's edge.  Rising up from the turf on the clearing's western edge is a bluff, its shoulders cloaked with willow, pine, oak and redbud trees.  A line of taller oaks stands on the ridge of the bluff like a dense crown, their foliage poking up from the drifting fog.  Across the water to the east, the spires of Castle Anwyn rise out of the mist.

title: [Temple of Eternity, Hallway]
description: The subtle image of a smooth and completely expressionless face is carved into the south wall, composed of mute grey granite which adds to its somber appearance.  A weathered black tablet is set beneath the carving, flanked by clusters of tall pillar candles.  Two hallways branch off to the left and right, the eastern cast in shadow, and the western illuminated by a soft, gentle light.  A pair of arched ebonwood doors open to the north, their dark surfaces inlaid with malachite patterns.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Tower of Fate]
description: An ivory-hued pool ripples quietly within an upraised platform -- its edges swept with a runic pattern that intertwines in a thin circular border.  The peaked ceiling is also inscribed with a series of sigils, their pale sapphire hue resonating with a faint light every few moments.  Polished white marble walls gleam faintly with the pulsating light, and several elven guards stand at the threshold of a set of ivory spiral stairs leading further up.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Bluff Face]
description: A ring of cottonwood trees shelters quaint houses nestled beneath their boughs.  Here and there, beams of light break through the mist, shining down in stark rays which coax drops of dew to glisten.  A bluff rises from the sandy loam, its face incised with a course of steps cut into the granite in a lazy curve that offsets the steep cant.  Above, a rooftop or two can be glimpsed through the thick mantle of trees.

title: [Garden of the Champion]
description: Topiaries shaped to resemble warriors engaged in combat surround the courtyard.  At the center of the garden and towering over the sculpted combatants stands a bronze statue the size of a giant, a brass plaque set into a granite boulder at its feet.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Entry]
description: Three massive turrets stand side-by-side, their stone grey walls marked with random slit windows.  Spilling forth from the narrow vents, lush vinca ivy and crimson trumpet vine flowers trail down in slender tendrils, giving the illusion of bloody streaks from a distance.  Towering doors of brushed steel have been propped open, revealing a dimly-lit narthex leading into the temple.

title: [Highpark, Gatekeeper's Arch]
description: A cobbled walk meanders through an imposing arch.  Across the arch's top are living quarters featuring multiple chimneys and windows with diamond-shaped panes, some tinted rich shades of ruby and blue.  Trees frame the stone building and high stone walls stretch away to either side.  The bottom of an iron portcullis is visible at the top of the archway.

A cobbled walk meanders through the shadowy confines of an imposing arch.  Across the arch's top are living quarters featuring multiple chimneys and windows with diamond-shaped panes, some tinted rich shades of ruby and blue.  Trees frame the stone building and high stone walls stretch away to either side.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Narthex]
description: Just inside the doors, the elaborate detail work in this vestibule becomes evident.  Each wall has been painted with a lush monument symbolizing fealty to Eorgina in the Willing, the Unwilling, and the Scholar.  Shaped like ornate crowns of solid silver and amply set with precious gems, small mounted altars hold a trio of candles, lit and providing a soft glow.  An openwork black iron divider of thorned vines with an arched portal leads farther inside the temple.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Sylvar Pointe]
description: Surrounding the wrought iron gate, a tall arbor covered with twining lavender roses cascading in shimmering falls of color frames a pea-gravel covered trail.  An intricately carved stone bench rests beneath a nearby tree.

title: [Highpark, Caretaker's Bungalow]
description: Following the gentle swell of a hill, a cobbled walk skirts a wooded grove that surrounds a charming bungalow.  The residence's sculpted roof is covered with multi-hued tiles and flowering vines, and green shutters frame its windows.  Where the home's front walk divides from the cobbled promenade, a wooden pole stands.

title: [Highpark Lane]
description: The cobbled walk travels through lush green lawns dotted with the stately forms of venerable oaks and sycamores.  Here and there, the rooftops of large residences are visible, their privacy guarded by extensive gardens, shrubs and rock walls.  Birds of all types are plentiful, as are squirrels that dash from tree to tree in bounding leaps.

The cobbled walk travels through lush moonlit lawns dotted with the shadowy forms of venerable oaks and sycamores.  Here and there, the bright windows of large residences are visible, their privacy guarded by extensive gardens, shrubs and rock walls.  The night songs of crickets and frogs provide a constant serenade.

title: [Highpark Lane, Gardens]
description: Highpark Lane approaches a heavily wooded area to the east, where the dark trunks of ancient trees punctuate the woodland landscape beneath a canopy of green.  The carefully tended lawn is dotted with several teak benches, and statuary stands in reverent attitudes here and there.

Highpark Lane approaches a heavily wooded area to the east, where the dark trunks of ancient trees punctuate the woodland landscape beneath a shadowy canopy of green. title: [Highpark, Woodland Lane]
description: Woodland Lane branches off of Highpark Lane with a small pond marking the demarcation.  From the pond's center spurts a fountain, its diminutive arc creating a gentle cascade of falling water.  To the north, as the lane travels between noble residences, twin rows of graceful Illistim maples provide a leafy canopy overhead.

title: [Highpark Lane, Hill View]
description: The lane curves from a heavy canopy of trees to the west, and veers around the base of a tall hill to the east.  Gardens to either side offer a profusion of blooms that scent the air with a heady perfume.  Farther up the elevation, tall white columns and towering trees accent the hillside, alternating with gardens and terraced waterfalls, as well as beautiful villas and palazzos.

title: [Highpark Lane, Hill View]
description: The gardens surrounding the lane are spectacular, with different types of blooms creating artistic patterns, while butterflies and bees dance over the flowers.  Waterfalls course through carefully designed beds and finally fall into lily-covered ponds, adding the tranquil sound of their journey to the surrounding ambiance.

title: [Highpark, Terraced Garden]
description: A terraced garden stretches away from the lane, its central nave covered with gravel and bordered on each side by a perfectly groomed lawn.  At the far point of the promenade is a circular garden guarded by the slender figure of a marble nymph.  The alluring fragrance of lilies growing at her feet reaches out to the lane.

title: [Highpark, Ridge Ramble]
description: The Ramble threads between low stone walls holding the prolific blooms of garden beds at bay. title: [Highpark, Ridge Ramble]
description: The low walled lane travels around the perimeter of a large ornamental pond, its border a scalloped edging of smooth stone.  Lily pads dot the calm surface of the water and dragonflies dart back and forth on their translucent wings.  Peacocks stroll on a lawn in the distance, their progress punctuated by displays of plumage.

title: [Highpark, Terrace]
description: Climbing the hill in a gentle spiral, the lane passes a terrace ornamented with a host of sculpture and marble columns.  Large sienna-toned tiles form a stage for the handsome host, and huge terra-cotta pots hold ornamental shrubs and flowers.  Residences ring the piazza, their facades as genteel as the terrace they border.

title: [Highpark, Nob Hill]
description: The imposing homes dotting the slopes of Nob Hill display the height of elven architecture, with imposing facades and sculpted gardens at their foot.  Fountains are plentiful, throwing water droplets into the air from a host of fanciful forms.  The cobblestone lane climbs to the south, rounding the hill as it goes.

title: [Highpark, Fairview Circle]
description: The lane approaches a circular orangery, offering a filigreed pattern of low, trimmed hedges.  Forming an intricate swirl, the bushes are immaculately manicured and the crushed white gravel surrounding the bed accents their form.  Houses ring Fairview Circle, their facades as aristocratic as the landscape.

title: [Highpark, Niima Fountain]
description: A gravel path approaches a majestic fountain to the south.  It is both large and masterfully carved, its marble figures lithe and graceful.  Dolphins soar through the spray of surf as the beautiful figures of sea nymphs cavort with them.  At certain points, larger figures surface above the tumult, their imposing stature marking points of observation around the impressive fountain.

title: [Highpark, Fairview Circle]
description: A long row of terracotta pots line the circular lane as it traverses the large residences on its perimeter.  Small ornamental maple trees are planted in many of the pots, their lacy red foliage a nice contrast to the flowering plants occupying the other containers.

title: [Highpark, Fairview Circle]
description: An ornamental pond occupies the northeast edge of the sculptured gardens, its surface almost covered with water lilies.  From its center, a statue of a fish spouts a fountain of water, throwing off rainbows in the light.  A row of statues opposite it carry on the aquatic theme, displaying forms of leaping dolphins and curled seahorses.

An ornamental pond occupies the northeast edge of the sculptured gardens, its surface almost covered with water lilies.  From its center, a statue of a fish spouts a fountain of water, its gentle patter accenting the moonlight.  A row of statues opposite it carry on the aquatic theme, displaying forms of leaping dolphins and curled seahorses.

title: [Highpark, Woodland Lane]
description: The lane travels between two rows of large maple trees, obviously planted at least a century or two ago judging by their height and expanse.  While Woodland Lane is cobbled, the stones are smooth and very uniform, giving the appearance that each one was sculpted to mesh with its neighbors.  Mounds of large-leafed plants crowd around the foot of the trees, their tall stalks bearing lilac-colored blooms.

title: [Highpark, Woodland Lane]
description: The rows of huge maples lining the lane culminate where it circles, ringing some sculpted hedges.  Fantastic animal shapes cavort in leafy poses -- a unicorn, an elephant and a rearing lion -- their antics attended by an audience of distinguished looking residences sitting on the outside perimeter of the cobbled road.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Sylvar Pointe]
description: Thick hydrangea bushes in varying hues of pink, blue and lavender line the trail as it winds among the trees.  The boughs above whisper musically as the wind brushes along the edge of the nearby cliffs, occasionally permitting rays of sunlight to break through their deep green canopy.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Sylvar Pointe]
description: A small stone birdbath resides in the center of the clearing, its statuary carved in the fanciful image of a playful drake swooping down into the water contained within its bowl.  Fat yellow bumblebees whir about the nearby butterfly bushes and deep red verbena.

Several lanterns hung from the boughs of a nearby tree cast dim light across the clearing. description: Plush grass follows the decline of a gentle slope, dotted here and there with small weathered boulders. title: [Ta'Illistim, Sylvar Pointe]
description: The carefully tended garden is ensconced in a small hollow near the cliff's edge.  Through small crevices and in the low bowl of the hollow itself, a myriad of flowering plants tumble over one another in their haste to garner sunlight and water.  A small trail leads to the edge of the precipice.

A small trail, barely visible in the moonlight, leads to the edge of the precipice.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Sylvar Pointe]
description: The breathtaking view from the edge of the precipice is nothing short of spectacular.  Spread across the valley to the southeast, cultivated farmlands form a gently contrasting checkerboard of green, while the thickly forested areas of Wraithenmist and Gyldemar are visible to the north and east.  Just beyond the northern edge of Wraithenmist, the Lake of Shadowed Sorrows glimmers on the horizon.

Spread across the valley to the southeast, the twinkling lights of crafters' huts and the township of Sylvarraend dot the dark landscape, echoing the glimmer of constellations in the night sky.  Just beyond the northern edge of the Wraithenmist, mist rolls off the Lake of Shadowed Sorrows, drifting up through the dark sky in ethereal wisps.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Great Hall]
description: A towering statue of a woman extends the full height of this open central turret, head tilted up as though gazing at the exposed heavens.  Forged skillfully, the metal robes gather in clothlike folds, the surface brushed to resemble a velvet-like texture.  Spiral staircases on both sides of the imposing figure wind their way up the adjoining turrets, entwined with brilliant trumpet vine flowers.  A large, carved ebonwood screen sits directly behind the statue and an arched portal leads out to the narthex.

title: [Huge Tower, Nexus]
description: Wooden planks reinforced with bands of steel form a circular platform high into the sky.  A tall ladder is bolted to the side of the tower, leading down toward the ground far below.  An arched roof overhead provides shelter from the elements, and the tower branches off into four main sections from this point.  The surrounding landscape is visible for miles, the horizon blurring into a blend of land and sky.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Arboretum]
description: A well dressed but well armed guard stands before a pair of elegant wooden doors, one trimmed in gold and the other colorfully painted.  He bears a friendly expression on his face, but his eyes remain vigilant and alert.  A gleaming silver sign hangs between the doors.

A well dressed but well armed guard stands before a pair of elegant wooden doors, one trimmed in gold and the other colorfully painted.  She appears to be relatively amiable, but her eyes remain vigilant and alert.  A gleaming silver sign hangs between the doors.

title: [Maellyn's, Fabrics]
description: Numerous rolls of bright fabrics on racks take up most of the space in this small shop.  The remaining area is taken up by sundries, rolls of trim, and drawers filled with small accessories.  Pins, needles, and buttons are carefully sorted into small racks, as are spools of thread and skeins of yarn.  A tiny desk almost hides the diminutive halfling shopkeeper from view.

title: [Surname Registry]

A tiny stream winds its way along and through the path, its trickling cadence mingling with the soft rustles of the leaves overhead.

title: [Veythorne Manor, Gardens]

title: [Veythorne Manor, Gardens]

description: The Celebration Hall stands before you, its wide red-carpeted steps leading up to a pair of ornately embossed golden doors. Tucked close in the shadow of the Celebration Hall, an ivy-covered arch pierces a neatly trimmed hedge.

title: [Celebration Hall, Patio]
description: Here tables are tucked into ivy-shrouded alcoves, with soft candlelight and the muted music from the ballroom creating an intimate atmosphere.
