title: [Grand Ballroom]
description: A trio of exquisite chandeliers hang from the crystal dome, ablaze with hundreds of candles, and silvered moldings and elaborate tapestries decorate the walls.  The room is a sea of colors and sounds as dancing couples glide across the highly polished dance floor and others chat animatedly with friends and family.  In the far corner, a small band diligently plays current and local favorites, while through a nearby doorway a cluster of tables awaits those seeking a quieter alternative.

title: [Celebration Hall, Grand Foyer]
description: Rich golden brocade covers the walls, its ivy and rose pattern drawing the eye upward to where an elaborate mural, depicting scenes from various points in Solhaven's history, covers the ceiling.  The red velvet carpet continues its journey from the steps straight towards a graceful archway, its length lined by small limestone columns, each clearly intended to hold a small statue or bust, but all currently still empty.

title: [Scents Galore]
description: A petite sylvan woman moves nimbly about between a white marble-topped counter and the west wall of the shop.  Behind the counter, every inch of wall space is covered with narrow shelving that holds scores of small, brightly colored bottles.  The shelves even line the broad windows that flank the shop's entrance, displaying dozens of the crystal containers to passersby.

title: [Salters' Workyard]
description: Separated by narrow walkways, shallow felwood vats fill most of the high walled workyard.  Wider walkways fill the space between the workyard walls and the vats on all but the north side, where the brine-filled vats are lined up snug against the whitewashed wall of a warehouse.  Seawater, in various stages of evaporation, fills the handsbreadth-deep vats to different levels.  A wooden trough extends from a central leather-bellowed pump, evidently for pumping up water from the tidal pools beneath the yard.

title: [Hall of Patrons, Corridor]
description: The walls of the corridor are unadorned except for a pair of brass wall sconces, used to illuminate the area.  On either side of the corridor, a maoral door and an oak door stand ajar and at the end of the hall is a highly polished linden door.  An arch to the southwest opens into the rotunda and silver-veined marble covers the floor.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Catacombs]
description: At the far end of this subterranean granite tunnel, a darkened opening resembling a gaping maw seems to beckon, while a nearby trickle of light provides a welcome refuge.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Catacombs]
description: The north-facing granite wall features a diagonal rent in the otherwise solid surface, the likely result of an ancient earthquake.  Water trills from the opening, collecting along the floor in a narrow trough cut over time.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Catacombs]
description: Streaks of tufa stone striate the granite walls, evidence of previous tectonic disturbance.  Small pebbles crunch underfoot and create tiny dam-like obstructions for the slow rivulets of water that run along the floor.  Discolored oak posts brace this part of the passage in an attempt to prevent the ceiling from caving in.  The openings of several old burial tombs cut into the wall are filled with earthen debris and bone remnants.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Catacombs]
description: A low opening yawns like a gaping mouth at the junction of the tunnel.  It resembles a typical burial niche, and nothing distinguishes it aside from a pair of faded and torn standards serving as sentinels.  Granite walls glazed with moisture glitter in the dim light, the water enhancing the micaceous surface.

title: [Catacombs, Underground Dromos]
description: Aside from the far granite wall that bears an opening leading to the catacomb tunnels, the rest of this room is lined with pale travertine carved into displays of elven life and practice, their small figures engaging in a variety of tasks, worship, and repose.  Pink marble rosettes inlaid near the ceiling and floor document the archaic local flora, and spigots of glaes protuding about waist-high feed slow streams of water to a tiny hole in the floor.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Catacombs]
description: The dank corridor ends suddenly at a thick greystone wall that contrasts with the natural granite surroundings.  A metal torch sconce bolted to the stone has been exposed to the dampness for so long, it is covered with deep crimson-hued rust.  Streaks from the corrosion stain the wall below, like small rivers of dried blood.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Catacombs]
description: A narrow, down-sloping corridor travels beneath the city, part of the timbered foundations of the buildings above revealed and heavily braced with iron fittings.  Roughly-hewn granite walls have been blackened in spots, the result of eons of seeping moisture.  Every few paces, small arcosolia form gaps in the solid surface of the stone, some filled with remains of broken amphorae.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Catacombs]
description: Further passage is blocked by a formidable monir door, bound with thick iron bands and fitted with a hasp locked with a large iron padlock.  Odd and out of place, it appears to be much newer than the catacombs themselves.  A metal torch sconce is mounted on the stone wall beside the doorframe, though it is bereft of any light source.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Being]
description: The Hall of Being stretches endlessly onward with no end in sight, impossibly long for a building of the library's size.  The endless maoral panelled walls are unembellished save amber glaesine wall sconces, which are evenly spaced down the corridor, providing dim illumination.

title: [Library Aies, Hall of Kings]
description: The white marble floor of the Hall of Being transitions abruptly into polished black granite, relieved only by a richly woven Ta'Loenthran carpet in the center of the gallery.  Portraits of rulers long dead line the walls of the chamber, each illuminated by a pair of glaesine candle globes mounted on either side of its frame.

title: [East Woods, Tunnel]
description: Twisted tunnels bend off in several directions, some passages too narrow to allow anything bigger than a small rodent to squeeze through, others big enough to admit several people walking side by side.

title: [West Wing]
description: The corridor suddenly ends in a blank stone wall set with a single burning torch.  Two long tapestries hang from either side of the hall filled with images of home and family.  Centered on each tapestry is the woven image of an elven woman with piercing, pale-blue eyes.

title: [East Woods, Tunnel]
description: Scratch marks cover the walls of the tunnels, signature marks of creatures intent on expanding this underground haven.  The floor of the tunnel seems to be composed of a mixture of dirt, pebbles and crushed bits of animal bone.  No doubt the carnivorous animals living in the woods have used the tunnels as a handy dining chamber for many years.

title: [Highpark, Nob Hill]
description: Where the cobblestone lane turns a corner, an imposing marble statue guards the curve.  High above on its pedestal, the muscular figure of a man battles a rearing steed, its mane, tail and curled forelegs creating lyrical harmonies of curve and balance.  Houses watch the frozen tableau, their facades as timeless as the eternal struggle they observe.

title: [Highpark, Nob Hill]
description: Rounding a large garden, the lane passes through a promenade of columns, athletic statuary posed on each pillar.  The silent figures stand in attitudes of action, as if frozen during some long-ago event.  Just inside the perimeter of marble guards, hedges have been trimmed into tall, thin fingers of green, their forms as elegant as the sculpture they escort.

title: [Highpark, Nob Hill]
description: A double row of tall Illistim cypress trees climb the hill to the north, their progress followed by noble houses and artistic gardens.  The edges of the lane are bordered by carved stone balusters topped by large, stone spheres.  Their surface is an old, mottled pattern echoed in the stones paving the lane.

title: [Tyramia Hollow, Mossy Walk]

To the southwest, a large pond can be seen with moonlight reflected on its surface.  To the east, a group of quaint cottages are nestled at the foot of a tall, tree-covered hill.  Lights in the windows of additional buildings can be glimpsed twinkling within the forest farther up the hill's elevation.

While the ground is too rocky to support much in the way of gardens, the moonlit view of the surrounding valley and the shadowy forests covering the landscape more than compensate.

title: [Tyramia Hollow, Hilltop]
description: The hillside is steep and dense stands of pines block most directions.  A few hardy dwellings brave the brisk winds and difficult terrain, their rooflines as lofty as the landscape.  As the trail edges through an obstacle course of boulders, its whole length is protected with rope and wood handrails, and the residences it connects are shored up with heavy pilings.  The view of the moonlit countryside is spectacular.

As the trail edges through an obstacle course of boulders, its whole length is protected with rope and wood handrails, and the residences it connects are shored up with heavy pilings.  The view of the surrounding countryside is spectacular.

title: [Tyramia Hollow, Horizon View]
description: Perched on the edge of a vast chasm, a few dwellings brave the winds and uncertain terrain to take advantage of a view that would equal any. The moons fill the surrounding valley with their soft light, while pine boughs swaying at the prompting of the breeze frame the panorama with rustic elegance.  Dwellings in this remote aerie are large and rugged, braced by heavy pilings and stone chimneys.  Handrails connect the trail leading from one dwelling to another.

In the far northern distance, sunlight glints off of the distant towers of Ta'Illistim, while pine boughs swaying at the prompting of the breeze frame the panorama with their rustic elegance.  Dwellings in this remote aerie are large and rugged, braced by heavy pilings and stone chimneys.  Handrails connect the trail leading from one dwelling to another.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Crates lie shattered upon the ground, the splintered wood only adding to the blanket of garbage and other debris scattered upon the cobblestones.  Dark sloping roofs crowd in on both northern and southern corners, their surfaces rotted and weathered by time's passage.  Thick moisture clouds the air here, and the pungent salty scent of the sea is readily noticed.  An alleyway is just visible among the crates, between two of the buildings on the north side of the Way.

title: [Candle Shop]
description: Filled with many burning candles, a pair of large bay windows flank the doorway.  The white walls are stained a sooty yellow-grey near the ceiling, and the floor is composed of green slate and blue riverstone blocks.  A red brocade curtain leads west, standing perpendicular to the glaes-topped counter at the rear of the room.

Light streams through a pair of large bay windows flanking the doorway.  The white walls are stained a sooty yellow-grey near the ceiling, and the floor is composed of green slate and blue riverstone blocks.   A red brocade curtain leads west, standing perpendicular to the glaes-topped counter at the rear of the room.

title: [Aulidie's Pottery, Showroom]
description: A fine layer of white pottery dust covers every flat surface in this shop.  Tall vases filled with wilted yellow ferns flank the doorway in a failed attempt at elegance.  Lanterns cast their warm yellow light across the shelves of pottery and blown glass behind the counter.  A slight breeze blows through a window set high in the east wall, cooling the shop.

A fine layer of white pottery dust covers every flat surface in this shop.  Tall vases filled with wilted yellow ferns flank the doorway in a failed attempt at elegance.  The only window is narrow and set high on the western wall, but sunlight shafting through still brightens the room slightly, and a light breeze drifting through eases the heat of the room.  Shelves filled with pottery and blown glass line the wall behind the sales counter.

title: [Butcher's Shop]
description: Some slabs of freshly butchered meat hang from hooks in the back.  A long counter sits off to the side, its surface somewhat clean though noticably used to present bloodied meat during the day.  The front windows of the room are pulled open, but a couple brass lanterns have been placed out and lit to provide comfortable lighting.

Slabs of a variety of freshly butchered meat hang from hooks in the back and along the sides of the room.  A long counter sits off to the side, its surface bloodied from the day's use.  The front windows of the room are pulled open to allow the sun to shine through.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Foyer]
description: Situated at an angle to either side of a polished oak door that leads to the street is a set of low tables covered with vials of dyes.  A long glass front cabinet stands in the center of this quaint foyer and is flanked by arches, on the left and right, which lead further into the shop.  Behind the cabinet, a long hallway terminates in a set of oak steps and is illuminated by evenly spaced wall sconces.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Hallway]
description: Brass-framed wall sconces set with white tallow candles line the long expanse of this hallway, providing it with soothing illumination.  A cotton runner, dyed in the traditional blue and silver of Solhaven Bay, covers the polished oak floor that leads to a set of steps to the north and the foyer to the south.

title: [Solhaven, Dark Tree]
description: The branches of the ancient black willow tree twist about themselves, offering numerous locations throughout for comfortable seating.  Graceful black leaflets attached to long dark green stems shimmer a shadowy black as they rustle against the rough bark of the tree.  A faint rattling sound can be heard emanating from within the core of the tree.

The branches of the ancient black willow tree twist about themselves, offering numerous locations throughout for comfortable seating.  Graceful black leaflets attached to long dark green stems rustle against the bark of the tree, and a very fine pollen lingers in the air about you.

title: [Solhaven Hall, Portico]
description: Four granite pillars carry the weight of the portico roof, their pale rose stone echoed in the screening wall enclosing the complex.  Behind the wall, surrounding a clear dome, spiral finials perch atop partially obscured buildings.  Clusters of flowers and trees can be seen just beyond the silver-gilt gate.

title: [Grocer's, Secluded Corner]
description: Here in this secluded corner you find a small table covered with a red checkered tablecloth.  It is kept spotless and clean.  Gathered fabric covers portable screens that have sectioned off this area from the sales area of the store, and serve double duty by muffling your conversation.  Your vantage spot here allows you to spot anyone approaching your table.

title: [Wraithenmist, Maze of Mist]
description: The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible to even see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible even to see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Fishing Shack]
description: A small wooden counter with various shelves underneath is the only adornment to this cramped shack.  Various fishing poles have been hung on the walls, and the counter shelves hold lures, weights, chests, and other fishing items.  A withered looking elf mans the counter, muttering to himself on occasion.  An opening lies on the east wall, through which a smoky aroma with an undercurrent of seared fish wafts.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Attic]
description: A dusty skylight admits a faint glow of moonlight to the cramped attic passageways, and a draft from some crack in the wall sends dust-motes glimmering in the dim beams.  Boxes, crates, old paintings and rolled carpets fill the attic, and a space has been cleared for a few old pieces of furniture to serve as a sitting room.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Auditorium]
description: The Performance Hall is a grand chamber filled with rows of cushioned benches facing a stage at the far end.  The stage has generous proportions -- heavy indigo curtains flank it on either side.  A row of lanterns placed along its lip are hooded on the sides facing the audience, with all their illumination directed toward center-stage.

title: [Bard Guild, Covered Walkway]
description: Cedar arches stand in a row, spanning a tiled walkway that ends before an imposing teak door.  Vines covered with fragrant blooms cling to trellises on the sides of the arches and send foliage-covered tendrils climbing over the curved tops.  On each side of the walk, large terracotta urns are planted with bougainvillea and jasmine, which spill over the edges of the containers in cascades of blossoms.

title: [Clagg's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-veined black marble counter and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Gemcutter's, Back Room]
description: This small room seems to be some sort of closet.  A black robe is draped from a tall rack in the corner.  You see a sturdy cabinet with a lock on it.

title: [Cafe Dumont]
description: The fragrance of brewed coffee and tea wafts through the air of the cafe, the aroma of floral accents mix quite pleasantly with the rich, bitter scents.  A long mahogany counter stretches along the western wall, its surface covered with various brewing contraptions.  The off-white sandstone tile extends across the floor, giving the room a more spacious feel.

title: [Solhaven, Abalone Street]
description: The crowd bustles with activity, shoppers entering and leaving a modest storefront where a large wooden boot hangs above the door.  A set of stairs to the right of the building lead up to a landing where a bright blue canvas slipper adorns the open door.  You are struck by the incongruence of all these races living together peacefully.  You can barely hear the sounds of the Market Square, carried inland on the ocean breeze.

title: [Solhaven, Slipper Shop Landing]
description: An open doorway dressed up with blue silk drapes lets into the building above the Cobbler's Shop, the oversized slipper nailed to the door proclaiming it as a related business.  Sheltered by the overhanging roofs of both buildings, the landing is a quiet refuge from the noise and crowds of the street below.

title: [Fane of the God-King, Garden]
description: Following the curve of the temple yard, a yellow-bricked walk proceeds beneath an arching bower heavy with fiery rose-marrow blooms.  Clinging to the outer wall is a stone longhouse that, despite age, is neatly kept.  Reflections off of the windows of the nearby fane cast pools of golden light amidst banks of low-growing flaeshorn dotting the lawn.

Following the curve of the temple yard, a yellow-bricked walk proceeds beneath an arching bower heavy with fiery rose-marrow blooms.  Clinging to the outer wall is a stone longhouse that, despite age, is neatly kept.  Banks of low-growing flaeshorn dot the lawn, reduced by the darkness to little more than verdant shadows.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Emerald Room]
description: Sheer emerald green curtains drape along the sides of the four poster bed covered with a matching spread and plump pillows.  Vultite shaded oil-lit lamps shed their light upon a dark monir table and chairs by a window.  A marble fireplace carved with fanciful sprites fills one wall and adds warmth to the room.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Muted light from the brass wall sconces glints off of a mithril frieze on the north wall showing a mounted warrior battling hoards of trolls.  On the south wall is a gilt-framed portrait of the founder of the Inn.

title: [Garden of Contemplation]
description: Silvery moonlight cascades over the garden, gilding everything within the walls.  Beds overflowing with fragrant herbs and flowers line the borders of this small garden.  The high stone walls, constructed of smooth grey-blue granite, are nearly covered with tendrils of creeping fig.  A small wooden bench serves as a place for quiet rest and thought.

Beds overflowing with fragrant herbs and flowers line the borders of this small garden.  The high stone walls, constructed of smooth grey-blue granite, are nearly covered with tendrils of creeping fig.  A small wooden bench serves as a place for quiet rest and thought.

title: [Hall of the Arkati, Alcove]
description: Small niches are set into the white plastered walls at regular intervals from floor to ceiling.  Many of the niches hold small white votive candles, while others house small statues of Koar, Phoen, Kai and Eonak.  A narrow monir door, heavily carved with a scene depicting Koar upon a massive throne, occupies the center of the wall.

title: [Hall of the Arkati, Upper Hall]
description: Pale mistwood pillars rise on either side of this hallway, their smoothly curved boles rising gracefully to support the low ceiling in a spreading web of interlocked branches.  A single, perfectly round window allows a beam of moonlight to illumine an intricate tapestry woven in pale greens, yellows and ivory.  To the west, the hallway slopes downward towards a brighter section.

Pale mistwood pillars rise on either side of this hallway, their smoothly curved boles rising gracefully to support the low ceiling in a spreading web of interlocked branches.  A single, perfectly round window allows a shaft of sunlight to fall on an intricate tapestry woven in pale greens, yellows and ivory.  To the west, the hallway slopes downward towards a brighter section.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: The red carpeted hallway ends here with doors in each of the walls.  In either corner sits a marble planter, each with a small orange tree planted in it.  Wildflowers are arranged around each tree.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Topaz Room]
description: Striped snowcat pelts decorate the walls, their tawny and black striped hides meshing nicely with the abundance of trailing plants twining from gold-plated containers hanging on the walls.  A low platform piled with a variety of furs creates a comfortable bed.  Honey-colored tallow candles flicker in their cast iron holders, their tiny shades of beaded topaz glowing with a golden light.

title: [Schoolhouse, Foyer]
description: Black-speckled white tiles have been inlaid into the floor, giving a polished sheen to the foyer.  A small plaque that reads "Office" hangs on the western wall next to a door, and a wooden board littered with pieces of parchment, notes, and other announcements takes up the eastern wall.

title: [Hearthstone, Foyer]
description: Dark flagstone floors extend in a gleaming river of darkness beneath thick, handwoven crimson rugs in this spacious foyer.  To the north, banners of purple, blue, green, and yellow flutter from a balcony railing some fifty feet overhead.  A granite archway sweeps along the length of the western wall, and a magnificent fieldstone staircase curves upward to the east.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Lakeview Bluff]
description: The elevation of the cliff offers a panoramic view of the lake, with the mist-cloaked castle hulking at the far end and a pencil thin tower rising out of thick fog to the north.  Oaks dominate the ridge, with pine trees tucked around the feet of the taller trees with their lacy foliage of needles.  The scent emanating from cottage hearths mixes with the aroma from the pines in a fresh, spicy perfume.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shrine]
description: Fluted white marble columns enclose the area in a wide circle, marking the edges of the building itself.  The stark white of the surroundings is broken only by the massive circle of vivid lapis lazuli upon the floor, its center inset with ivory in the shape of a simple dagger.  A large statue of a slender elven woman stands to the north, the dagger she holds upraised in her hands bathed in the soft, pale moonlight filtering through the large oculus in the domed ceiling.

Fluted white marble columns enclose the area in a wide circle, marking the edges of the building itself.  The stark white of the surroundings is broken only by the massive circle of vivid lapis lazuli upon the floor, its center inset with ivory in the shape of a simple dagger.  A large statue of a slender elven woman stands to the north, the dagger she holds upraised in her hands bathed in the golden light filtering through the large oculus in the domed ceiling.

title: [Registrar's Office, Enclosure]
description: Everything in this small room is covered in a thin layer of dust.  Bookshelves piled high with recordbooks line the walls, leaning precariously.  An elderly clerk sits behind a tremendous hardwood desk, shuffling papers about restlessly.  A small sign is propped up on the corner of the desk.

title: [G.E.M.S. Embassy, Courtyard]
description: Beautifully landscaped, this courtyard is surrounded on three sides by a low stone wall and on the fourth by a half-timbered grey stone house.  A copse of deringo trees grows near the wall, shading a low stone bench.  A mottled grey and brown stone walkway leads from a single arched opening in the stone wall.  It meanders across the wooded grounds and melds with three grey stone steps leading to the simple carved oak door at the front of the house.

title: [Marble Springs, Shard]
description: Four sets of stone steps descend into this alabaster-tiled depression in the center of the neighborhood.  A massive shard of gold-veined quartz protrudes from the center of the depression, its faceted tip seeming to glow with a pale light under the dark night sky.  A natural spring gurgles about its base, forming bubbling fountains and small pools which dapple the area.  Small ferns and delicate mosses flourish in small cracks between the silvery, moonlit streams of water.

Four sets of stone steps descend into this alabaster-tiled depression in the center of the neighborhood.  A massive shard of gold-veined quartz protrudes from the center of the depression, its faceted tip pointing upward to the west.  A natural spring gurgles about its base, forming bubbling fountains and small pools which dapple the area.  Small ferns and delicate mosses flourish in small cracks between the silvery streams of water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Approach]
description: Magnificent beneath a triad of jeweled domes, the plaza is a sprawling forest of crystal columns.  Inspired by the daylight streaming through massive stained glass windows spaced along the length of the plaza, the spires wax effulgent.  A raised marble dais visible at the northern end of the plaza supports an altar, laved from above by a circular shaft of sunlight.

Magnificent beneath a triad of jeweled domes, the plaza is a sprawling forest of crystal columns.  Quickened by the moonlight streaming through massive stained glass windows spaced along the walls, the spires shimmer with a placid lambency.  A raised marble dais visible at the northern end of the plaza supports an altar bathed in wan moonlight.

title: [Temple of Industry, Gallery]
description: Dimly lit, the gallery looks out to the north over a significant drop, a northeasterly ramp providing a more pleasant form of egress to the hall below.  Carpeting pads the gold-veined granite floor, its chocolate hues echoed in the wool padding a raised alcove to the south.  Set into the display is a segmented steel arm.

title: [Temple of Industry, Gallery]
description: Providing ample view of a lower-story hall to the north, the gallery extends to the eastern wall before declining into a sharp northwesterly slope.  Inlay in the earth-hued eastern wall picks out the image of a large golden anvil.  Smoke's dry odor lingers heavy on the air, accompanied by the biting tang of hot metal.

title: [Temple of Industry, Junction]
description: An arch of fluted silver gleams in the northern wall, marking the intersection of the southeastern and southwestern paths.  Visible through its argent borders is a sloping corridor leading into a muraled chamber.  To the south, the floor stones march into a low tunnel beneath the entryway's platform.

title: [Shrine of the Sword]
description: Filtered through the smoked glass skylight above, the sunlight illuminating the spacious chapel falls in mournful hues that contrast with the painted riot of colors adorning the muraled walls. Extending from the floor to the ceiling of the northern wall is a silver plate that brightly reflects the form of the sword-cloven stone cenotaph below it.

title: [Temple of Industry, Subterrain]
description: Bronze braziers provide splashes of light that fitfully spark across the gold-veined granite floor.  Crags and notches pit the walls, lending an unfinished look to the hallway.  Heat and smoke war for dominance in the dry air, which is sharpened by a metallic tang.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Entrance]
description: A tall archway of spiral-wound twigs frames the entrance to the thriving grove.  Two ancient faewood trees stand at either side of the arch, like consecrated idols marking the path of their venerated guardian.  The trees emerge from rich layers of soil, florid with wild blooms and expanding groundcover.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Courtyard]
description: Grey stone cobbles run the length of the courtyard, meeting the rough protective walls.  Small shrubbery and ornamental trees line the interior of the walls as they gently curve towards the tower.  A small path cuts a more direct route to the entrance past a grand fountain.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Fountain]
description: A magnificent fountain stands nobly in the center of this clearing.  The ring of yew trees provide certain shelter to anyone caring to spend some time listening to its flows.  Glancing around you can spy the occasional devotee sliding past on the exterior circle, while a monk or two sit in careful meditation at the fountain edge.

title: [Solhaven, Guardhouse]
description: The solemn decorations lend an air of austerity and functionality to the main guardroom.  The room is busy with traffic of towns guardsmen loitering about in between their shifts.  A rack of polished weapons stands beside a large podium that dominates the center of the room.  Upon his high perch, the Sergeant-at-Arms pores over the everyday duties of law enforcement.  A darkened stairwell proceeds ominously down from beyond a steel gate.

title: [Solhaven, Conch Street]
description: Conch Street runs southeasterly here, closer to the foot of the cliff.  Many wagons line the street, making it difficult to walk amongst them.  The wagon guards glare openly as pedestrians wander through the area.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Dunes]
description: Dunes crowd the northern perimeter of a clearing, with cottages perched in their eddies and upon their crests.  Candles in the windows are lit against the perennial dusk rendered by the drifting fog.  Thick scrub grass grows around the bases of the stilted buildings, flourishing like a dense carpet.  A line of trees border the villa to the west.  The smell of the lake is damp and loamy, and rich with the sound of frogs and crickets.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Delivery Service, Front Counter]
description: A curved modwir counter cuts the room in half.  In front of the counter, a polished expanse of wood flooring spreads out into an open waiting area.  Behind the counter can be seen a series of wood shelves and pigeonholes stacked with a wide variety of boxes, bags and letters.  A canvas curtain suspended from the ceiling forms the back wall of the room.

title: [Delivery Service, Back Room]
description: Boxes and bags clutter every corner of this small back room.  A pine counter juts out from one wall, taking up most of the small amount of space remaining in the center of the room.  The air is redolent with the smell of ink and dust.  A wide canvas curtain covers the opening leading back to the front counter.

title: [Morgannis' General Store]
[Morgannis' Weaponry]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a glass-covered box case on one side of the shop and a long carved oak counter on the other.

title: [E and S's Fine Furs]
description: Beneath an exposed pine rafter ceiling, a curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the refurbished driftwood walls.  A heavy white granite counter and some hammered copper display hooks sit in opposite corners while a plush black bear fur rug rests on the limestone floor.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Courtyard]
description: Surrounded by a tall, neatly trimmed hawthorn hedge is an enclosed cobblestone courtyard.  A small riverstone bench sits off to the side under an oak tree.  Climbing roses planted in large stone urns creep up the wall and twine together over the wide ebonwood door.

Surrounded by a tall, neatly trimmed hawthorn hedge and shaded from the sunlight by tall trees is an enclosed cobblestone courtyard.  A small riverstone bench sits off to the side under an oak tree.  Climbing roses planted in large stone urns creep up the wall and twine together over the wide ebonwood door.

title: [Bacl's Magic Shoppe]
[Bacl's General Store]
description: An Arkati pantheon painting hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls, and a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling rises overhead.  A scarred ship's figurehead sits in one corner of a varnished dark oak floor.  There is a glass-topped mistwood counter on one side of the shop and a set of carved felwood shelves on the other.

title: [Landrai's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling, a trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case and a series of low oak shelves sit in opposite corners while a grey-veined white marble fountain rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [House of Gnomish Goods]
description: Refurbished driftwood walls rise from the driftwood floor.  Just above a stuffed feather and tar pelican hangs a iron-hooked split oak oar, and an exposed pine rafter ceiling completes the picture.  A flexible willow woven basket and a slender driftwood counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Timeless Treasures]
description: Enclosed by painted white plaster walls, the shop features a plush black bear fur rug in the center of its limestone floor.  A trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs under the white stucco ceiling.  Right near the front is a heavy white granite counter and a set of carved felwood shelves.

title: [Dhask's Stolen Goods, Foyer]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, a curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the refurbished driftwood walls.  A brass treasure chest and a plank-covered barrel table sit in opposite corners while a bronzed drake sculpture rests on a warped pale driftwood floor.

title: [Katee's Kupboard]
description: Beneath a domed white stucco ceiling, a multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A long brass clothing rack and a set of carved felwood shelves sit in opposite corners while an oak framed clear glaes aquarium rests on the dark oak floor.

title: [Ravenswing Imports]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, a curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the knotty oak-paneled walls.  A series of low oak shelves and a staved-in treasure chest sit in opposite corners while a miniature Solhaven Bay model rests on the dark oak floor.

title: [Silent Whispers]
description: A multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls, and a dark and light oak ceiling rises overhead.  A woven Vornavian silk rug sits in one corner of a varnished dark oak floor.  There is an invitingly soft cluster of dark velvet throw pillows surrounding a low felwood table on one side of the shop and a set of carved felwood shelves on the other.

title: [Bacl's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A heavy wooden desk and an antique sailor's trunk sit in opposite corners while a glass-fronted bookcase rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Vestibule]
description: The polished mahogany of the high, arching ceilings in this chamber is a stark contrast to the alabaster stone of the reinforcing ribbed vaults.  Dangling from the center vault is a gleaming chain of silver links, suspending a softly glowing globe of crackled glass.  A silver-threaded tapestry hangs next to a spindly black willow table that is pushed against the wall.  Opposite the entry door, the area widens considerably to allow space for a dramatic staircase of silver-flecked white marble.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Great Hall]
description: The vaulted ceiling of the hall rises to a spectacular height, and the smooth stonework is punctuated by elongated oval skylights that admit slanting rays of moonlight.  Natural light combined with the candles burning amid dozens of filigree sconces set into the walls causes the ivory-veined grey marble floor to gleam.  Soft velvet curtains in various hues of blue and grey drape the northern wall and are tied back in the center to display a polished granite arch.

Soft velvet curtains in various hues of blue and grey drape the northern wall and are tied back in the center to display a polished granite arch.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Dining Hall]
description: The northern wall of this hall is entirely occupied by a massive picture window that affords a dramatic view of the Manor grounds.  The remaining walls are covered with soft alabaster silk, a stark contrast to the gleaming pitch black marble floor.  A silver refectory table spans the length of the room from the east end to the west, with several long cream suede benches lined up neatly on either side.  Towering silver candelabrum, each holding dozens of burning white candles, stand in each of the four corners.

A silver refectory table spans the length of the room from the east end to the west, with several long cream suede benches lined up neatly on either side.  Towering silver candelabrum, each holding dozens of unlit white candles, stand in each of the four corners.

title: [Bacl's General Store]
[Bacl's Outfitting]
description: Refurbished driftwood walls rise from a water-stained light pine floor.  Just above an old lobster pot hangs a circular fishing net, and a dark and light oak ceiling completes the picture.  A brass treasure chest and a simple wire frame mannequin stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Library, Collected Lore]
description: Three walls of this room are occupied by massive floor-to-ceiling bookshelves of gleaming mahogany.  In the middle of the room, a tall podium holds a large catalog.  The area is lit by a massive glass globe filled with darting fireflies, perhaps in an attempt to protect the library's precious contents from fire.  Sunlight falls in slanting rays from the passage created by a spiraling wrought iron staircase.

Three walls of this room are occupied by massive floor-to-ceiling bookshelves of gleaming mahogany.  In the middle of the room, a tall podium holds a large catalog.  The area is lit by a massive glass globe filled with darting fireflies, perhaps in an attempt to protect the library's precious contents from fire.  Moonlight falls in slanting rays from the passage created by a spiraling wrought iron staircase.

title: [Bard Guild, Concert Chamber]
description: Graceful oak columns rise and bend inward to a central boss, transforming this half-hexagonal room into a perfect amphitheatre, illuminated by pairs of tall, thin windows in each of the three outer walls.  Long pennons flutter down from the uppermost beams, their silken lengths woven in subtly shaded crimson and vermillion hues and bordered in gold.  The floor at the south end is raised slightly, creating a stage for a soloist or chamber ensemble.

title: [Bard Guild, Gardens]
description: Light green pinnately compound leaves frame drooping clusters of pale lavender flowers, as thick wisteria snaking along an arched gateway disguises the framework of the structure.  Amid the now blossomless lilac bushes, tall stalks of hollyhocks and gladiolas climb, creating a flowering curtain of pinks and reds.

All that remains of the wisteria vines snaking along an arched gateway are paling green leaves and dangling brown-green seed pods.  Pink hollyhocks mingle with red and violet gladiolas, each racing toward the sky in competition with bowing sunflowers.  Straggling bushes of black-eyed susans and purple cosmos fill the gaps between the hardy stems.

Leafless wisteria vines winding around an arched gateway sport several crisp brown seed pods and a handful of purple-blossomed clusters, one last attempt to flower before winter comes.  Sunflowers dominate the garden beds, though the weedlike growths of black-eyed susans and multihued cosmos threaten to overtake them.

The naked framework of an arched gateway is wrapped with brown branches of wisteria, looking more dead than alive.  Several other bushes nearby repeat this same sober scene, a single red mitten caught upon one of the grayish branches.

Pale chartreuse wisteria fronds snake along the framework of an arched gateway, the wiry tendrils and thin budded stems fluttering like wisps of wind-tossed hair.  Full rounded bushes of lilacs add their cloying fragrance to the immediate surroundings.

Warmly lit, the shop is cozy and smells of fresh coffee.  Several mugs sit atop a wood stove, that fills one corner, its metal black as night.  A mistwood counter is filled with a wide assortment of flavorings and accessories.  A shelf, fitted with small bins, holds several packets of coffee.

title: [Practical Arcana, Sundries]
description: A variety of dried herbs hangs from a sturdy maoral beam ceiling, their faint, subtle scents mingling with one another pleasantly.  A large empty bronze birdcage hangs in one corner of the smooth grey stone walls, a few stray feathers shifting within its confines from pleasant drafts of air flowing in from a linen-draped window.  An expansive circular fel table stands in the center of the varnished maoral plank floor, a linen-lined woven willow basket set atop it.

title: [Practical Arcana, Enchantments]
description: A linen-draped window is situated upon the eastern grey stone wall, its simply-designed curtains billowing gently with every faint draft of wind from outside.  A large iron candelabra stands in the center of the room, its dark candles casting waves of fiery scarlet light across the lustrous maoral beam ceiling and the maoral plank floor.  A long carved fel counter stands along the northern wall, a bronze-chased fel rack affixed above it.

title: [Malwith Inn, Conference Room]
description: A number of high-back chairs flank the table, while a larger leather chair rests at the head of the table.  Set to one side of the room is a mahogany podium.  A brass chain runs the length of the room, glass lanterns hanging from it at regular intervals.

title: [Malwith Inn, Bedroom]
description: A simple bed occupies one corner of the room.  A small chair occupies the corner opposite the bed.  A pair of oil lamps light the room.  One lamp is set directly above the bed, its light making the bed look particularly inviting.  The other lamp is set next to the door.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Dye Wares, Dye Room]

title: [Ta'Vaalor Dye Wares, Workroom]

title: [Ta'Vaalor Dye Wares, Gardens]

title: [Ta'Vaalor Dye Wares, Dye Room]

title: [Ta'Vaalor Dye Wares, Dye Room]

title: [Ta'Vaalor Dye Wares, Supplies]

title: [Ta'Vaalor Dye Wares, Workroom]

title: [Lofty Peaks Room]

Plush, snow white carpet compresses softly underfoot, and the white matches the paint on the walls and ceiling.  The combination brilliantly illuminates the spacious walnut bed, with its purple bedspread and pillows, and the walnut chairs, with their purple padded seats and backs.  On the east wall, a brass eagle splays its wings wide, and a panoramic painting adorns the opposite wall.

Shadowy outlines of flora mix with evening primrose, night phlox, pink soapwort, and vesper irises, the night flowers filling the garth's expanse with luminous petals and haunting scents.  A lilac tree and an aloeas tree cast shadows in their corners, and tiny stone trails wend off the main pathways, leading to scattered benches amongst the garth.

To the west, the hillside rises, dotted with small stands of whitethorn trees.  They stand at an angle to the hillside, coaxed into a vertical stance by the light.  Homes huddle in a grove of pines back-lighted by the grey lake to the east.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Awyllion Hedge]

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Aspen Copse]

Grass has reclaimed the ground from the pine needles, and it grows in a lush green carpet studded with small mushrooms.  A few cottages ring the clearing, their edges blurred by the mist drifting off the lake.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Asrai Dunes]

Within the protection of the beach and bluff sit a few cottages, constructed in a quaint style that melds gracefully with the dramatic landscape.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Merrow Beach]
description: The trail peters out, overtaken by sand and thick clumps of gorse bedecked with yellow flowers.  Thistle claims ground in spots, its regal blooms adding splashes of purple to the scene.  Beach houses stand before the lake, their faces turned to the water to capture the misty panorama.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Lakeview Bluff]

Wild flowers add tiny dots of color to the landscape, their pin-points of color peeking cheerfully out of the drifting fog.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Aspen Thicket]

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Pine Bluff]
description: The bluff drops away in a sheer cliff, offering a spectacular view of the lake over the tops of trees in the lee of the hillside below.  Oaks grow tall along the hillside, reaching up hundreds of feet into the air.  At their feet, cottages nestle in the protection of the trees, bordered by thick beds of ferns and rhododendrons.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Lichen Trow]
description: The trail turns, blocked by a stream which falls over the cliff in a vocal waterfall.  Oaks lean over the precipice, as if they are watching the water's progress.  The edge-row of cottages thins out somewhat, bullied from the area by thick forest.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Caerphily Creek]

He snorts to himself once, mutters something under his breath, then returns to work.

title: [Cavernfast, Tunnel]
description: A low-roofed passageway hewn from solid rock twists quickly out of sight.  Braziers wrought of mithril shed pools of light in the gloom, while curiously they emit no smoke.  The walls and floor are quite uneven, however, the surfaces are satiny smooth to the touch as if each one has been polished with care.

title: [Cavernfast, Grotto]
description: A squat cavern is ringed with carved granite beasts, which consist of a wolf, a lion, and a bear, that sit between the mouths of tunnels leading away into the underground gloom like silent sentries.  The fantastic statues are exquisite examples of stone cutting, each one displaying a lifelike demeanor.  Almost below a level of hearing, the low susurrus of rushing water provides an undercurrent of sound in accompaniment to flickering mithril braziers along the stone walls.

title: [Cavernfast, Hot Springs]
description: The ceiling arches high over a set of three interlocking circular pools.  Light shines up from beneath the pools' churning water, sending sparkling reflections off a mosaic of crystal embedded in the stone above.  The aqua water shimmers in the light, as if trying to outdo the crystals, and glistening droplets lofted by the water's agitation dance in the air above like tiny sprites.

title: [Cavernfast, Mithril Workshop]
description: The huge chamber is filled with detritus of all kinds, from large complex contraptions to a thick conglomeration of bits and pieces, all of which defy identification.  Chains in a variety of thicknesses hang in a loopy tangle from the ceiling, snarled with an array of ropes and pulleys.  A long workbench covers the far wall, strewn with tools of every description.  The most notable thing about the whole mess is that everything, barring the rope, is made of mithril.

title: [Cavernfast, Mithril Trench]
description: The low ceiling of the tunnel is flecked with mithril, which glistens in the shadowy twilight of the labyrinth like precious jewels.  The Ne'halin river emerges from its own course through the mountain and runs along beside the travel path, its dark swells revealing a strong current.  Large stones break the water's rush, spaced evenly across the cataract.  Their tops are rough to provide a safe footing on the wet granite.

title: [Cavernfast, Mithril Overlook]
description: A small courtyard sits beside the river, giving a lovely panorama of the carved stones zigzagging across the confluence, and the starry host of twinkling braziers that follow the water's course through the caverns.  Groups of dwarves pass by, falling into single-file to cross the stones almost without breaking stride.

title: [Cavernfast, Mithril Workshop]
description: The floor in this part of the workshop is clear, leaving a large open area.  Deep ruts are worn in the stone, implying years of use as well as some respectable weight resting there.  The southern wall is empty of the heavy carving on almost every available surface elsewhere in the tunnels of Cavernfast.  A pair of chains flank the wall, hanging down on either side of the bare area. Their diameters are easily as thick as a dwarf's belly.

title: [Cavernfast, Mithril Workshop]
description: The chamber's ceiling is high above, lost in shadows from which hang ropes and chains like vines drooping below a thick forest canopy.  Across the eastern wall sits a low workbench, its top overlaid with golden oak.  The wall above the bench is covered with tools, and around each one a silhouette is carved, marking its place.  Even the pegs on which the implements rest are fashioned seamlessly of granite, implying that the whole face of the wall was hewn away, leaving the small pegs extending.

title: [Riddled With Runes]
description: Enclosed by curving paneled dark mahogany walls, the room features a velvet-lined glass display case resting on a dusty thick wool rug at the center of its dark oak floor.  Evenly spaced tall carved maoral bookcases ring the room, various detailed taspestries hanging between each at regular intervals.  Faintly scented smoke dances among the thick rafters of the mahogany-beamed ceiling.

title: [Riddled With Runes]
description: Enclosed by paneled dark mahogany walls, the room features a bare silver-inlaid dark oak floor with an elaborate bronze brazier set in each corner.  Set flush into the rear wall, a faded ancient mural interrupts the flow of long marble shelves that sweep the perimeter of the room, the occasional wicker basket hung from below.  Aromatic smoke drifts lazily from each brazier, curling among the beams of the ceiling.

title: [Cavernfast, Mithril Trench]
description: The Trench turns, each subtlety of the curving face of rock lovingly adorned with elaborate spirals and interlocking designs, rendered by hands so skilled, one would think the unforgiving rock was as pliant as canvas.  Colors range from dun brown to rich sienna, and greys so alive, they defy their humble origins of black and white.  Mithril flecks in the stone are ever-present, catching the light shed by the braziers lining the walls like minute stars.

title: [Cavernfast, Rubblestone West]
description: The avenue passes through an open area where the ceiling reaches high overhead.  Rubblestone Pool borders the walk on the east, and beside it, a bank of lush ferns crowd into a spotlight created by a single ray of sunlight shining down from a crevice above.  Small groups of dwarves stroll around the Pool, talking quietly in a heavy dialect that sounds like all consonants and no vowels.

title: [Cavernfast, Mithril Clinch]
description: The cavern path hooks here, earning it the epitaph of 'The Clinch'  A subtle waft of incense, exotic and musky, clings to the air, underscoring the antiquity of these tunnels.  This effect is amplified by an arresting design carved into the south wall, the meaning of its intricate swirls and spirals lost in time.

title: [Kelesia's General Store]

A thick off-white carpet sits in one corner of a varnished dark oak floor.  There is an elegant silver jewelry rack on one side of the shop and a Vornavian silk-lined display case on the other.

[Valtina's General Store]

title: [Cavernfast, Rubblestone Crook]
description: A lake touches the edge of the walk, extending into a shadowy pool rippled by concentric wavelets prompted by drops of moisture falling back into the arms of their origin.  A rim of jumbled rock forms a frame around the lake, and lights cast by braziers on its opposite shore send reflections dancing across the dynamic surface.

title: [Avantos' Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A slender driftwood counter and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Cavernfast, Mithril Circle]
description: The tunnel widens into another of Cavernfast's charming courtyards, this one dominated by an exquisitely fashioned fountain.  Water arcs above a statue of a brace of fawns, falling over their slim forms and into a pool ringed by a mosaic-covered rim.  A glance into the pool reveals its bottom is covered with a glittering carpet of coins.

title: [Cavernfast, Ne'Halin River Turn]
description: A granite bridge traverses the headlong rush of River Ne'Halin, its arched form tall and elegant.  A row of bas-relief carving follows the bridge's curve on either side, depicting herds of antelope leaping and galloping along.  The two herds stampede in opposite directions like streams of wagons passing on two sides of a road.

title: [Cavernfast, Ne'Halin River Way]
description: River Ne'Halin courses swiftly beneath an arched bridge constructed of beautifully veined granite.  The bridge is wide, although the handrails are quite low.  Two carved lions stand sentry on each side of the span's entry, their expressions alert, one with a full mane and the other, obviously a lioness.

title: [Cavernfast, Rubblestone South]
description: The dark surface of Rubblestone Pool undulates in response to an endless parade of rivulets, each concentric ring chasing the one before it in ageless courtship.  Legend holds that the pool is bottomless, and a glance into its depths doesn't lend any evidence to the contrary.

title: [Cavernfast, Stonestep Clinch]
description: 'The Clinch' is a busy intersection, garnering its name from an elaborately carved set of steps giving access to the north.  Rock benches offer ease to pedestrians wishing to spend idle moments contemplating either Rubblestone Pool to the south, or the rampaging River Ne'Halin coursing its subterranean canal to the northeast.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cavernfast, Gurglestone Edge]
description: The tunnel opens to offer a view of River Ne'Halin.  Bordering the water is a small courtyard set with a group of low tables and chairs.  They offer a lovely spot to dine accompanied by the river's song.  To the north, the graceful silhouette of an arched bridge spans the current, its sides a filigree of stonework.

title: [Cavernfast, Rubblestone East]
description: The Gullet converges with the blossoming tunnel, which opens to meet Rubblestone Pool.  Ne'halin River's near presence adds its chorus, as well as a brisk current which sends an intermittent spray of water over the walk.  The mithril braziers burn seamlessly, rendered immune to the occasional mists by thick crystal panes held securely in the lamps' filigree.

title: [Cavernfast, Ne'Halin River End]
description: A large courtyard overlooks Stonestep Clinch.  On the plaza's north edge, a low granite wall serves as the only boundary preventing a plunge down into the dark water of River Ne'Halin.  A mosaic inset with colorful stones covers the courtyard's floor, depicting an intricate pattern of knot-work that circles a central spiral.  A full yellow moon sits in the nucleus of the design, reigning proudly in its own firmament of tiny stones.

title: [Cavernfast, Riverwalk Point]
description: The tunnel opens, offering a view of River Ne'Halin, which lends its chorus to the carved walls in a gentle harmony.  The water glistens in the soft lamplight, its roiling surface reminiscent of a great serpent arching its back just beneath the surface of the swift river.

title: [Cavernfast, Gullet Rock Turn]
description: The rough floor of the tunnel bleeds away from colored stones inset ingeniously in the rock, to a carved pattern of stepping stones.  As the corridor twists and turns, the patterns carved into the walls change, flowing from spirals that hint at ocean waves, to a more spherical design, which is its own logic and reason.  The light from the ever-present mithril braziers set high on the walls enhances the changing patterns, giving them depth and drama.

title: [Cavernfast, Gullet Rock Walk]
description: The Gullet turns sharply, its contortion made more pronounced by the wealth of carving upon it.  The patterns collide in an echo of waves bludgeoning against rocks on a rugged shore.  The floor is remarkable, a rich mosaic composed of colored stones, which portray an ocean floor.  The subject is startling in its incongruity with the caverns hewn deeply within the granite cliffs, yet they are breathtaking in combination with the mystery and movement imbued in the carved walls.

title: [Nindy's Nook]
description: The centerpiece of the room is a wrought copper altar, which is housed upon a cerulean tile mosaic floor.  Flanking the altar on either side are brightly lit sun-shaped scones, their flickering luminosity casting a golden glow on the room.  Set within the high, pallid birch ceiling is a broad skylight, angled perfectly above the altar, and a copper-framed glass case is pressed up against one of the muslin-draped walls.  Near the entrance is a sturdy azure mithril counter, placed below an intricate brass-framed mirror.

title: [Cavernfast, Gullet Rock Walk]
description: The tunnel leans in a northeasterly direction, its wall carvings coiling into eddies of closely rendered designs.  High in the shadowy ceiling (and the ceiling is the tallest here in all the caverns), a dwarven artist, perhaps longing for a view of open skies, has carved a flight of birds in bas-relief.  The avian images whirl and turn in lifelike abandon.  Dim light afforded at that height lends distance to the birds, making them seem as real as if they are traversing the actual firmament.

title: [Cavernfast, Gullet Rock Walk]
description: 'The Gullet', as dwarven locals are frequently heard to dub it, becomes both narrower and taller than the tunnels in other parts of the citadel of Cavernfast.  The wall carvings assume a likewise elongated appearance.  Elegant swirls begin in compact rings, burgeoning into a wave-like pattern, which bears north in an unbroken cascade.

title: [Observation Platform]
description: The rotating chair swivels easily around, showing great views of the surrounding area through vertical-slitted windows that traverse the walls.  All manner of gadgets presents themselves for manipulation.  A crystal eyepiece mounted on a spring arm can be raised and lowered on a whim by use of a horizontal and vertical cranks and a lever made of invar.

title: [Cavernfast, Ne'Halin River Turn]
description: The tunnel constricts, becoming little more than an alleyway.  Its length is hung with brightly patterned banners, swaying one after another in a festive parade of color.  Fantastic beasts decorate some, rendered in the strict conventions of posture and vantage point.  Doors sit beneath each device, the sills painted in matching tones.

title: [Dakris's Furs, Workroom]
description: Lifting back the leather curtain, you enter the furrier's workroom.  Scraps of pelts, untanned hides, and tools for scraping, dressing and joining skins are spread across a workbench.  Several stools with rush seats are pushed up against the wall.  A half-finished rabbitskin robe is draped across one of the stools.

title: [Hearthstone, Pub]
description: Quieter than its neighbor to the west, the pub is filled with comfortable oak tables and chairs.  Muted moonlight from a large leaded glass window on the north wall highlights the gleam of polished oak flooring.  Deep green, plastered walls provide a backdrop for several murals depicting life in a country village.  A large fireplace on the western wall promises warmth on the chilliest of winter nights.

title: [Blacksmith, Shop]
description: Scattered haphazardly around the room are various weapons and items for sale.  Most patrons of Iron Jack's find it easier to order from the sale list written on a chalk board hung beside the sales counter than to rummage through the room.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Fern Path]
description: The trail rounds an extensive growth of ferns.  Their vivid green fronds arch in all directions, like an army on the march with scimitars raised.  Overhead, the limbs of birch mix with those of dense pawpaw trees, creating slanting beams of light which shine through the shade in distinct rays and highlight the delicacy of the ferns' leaves.  Although hidden by foliage, the sound of the waterfall can be heard close at hand.

title: [Green Suite, Bath]
description: The white marble forming the tub is veined with traces of green.  Silver spigots loose a steady stream of water into the tub at both ends.  Several silver towel racks line the wall, a series of trays with hot coals set into the wall behind them.  Small soap trays are attached to the tub at two of the corners.

Slender candles light the room, pushing the darkness away from the tub.

title: [Tiger Court, Garden]
description: The garden is covered in cats.  They come in all shapes, sizes and colors, making the small plot of land a sea of particolored fur.  They rub against each other or bathe in the dirt, busily lazy in the warm sun.  The plants have certainly seen better days, however, as each bears a mark of some feline's tender mercies.

description: The faint scent of rum permeates within the yellowed wooden walls, and each corner of the room is framed with a russet birch beam that runs the length of the planked ceiling.  Hung from the beams are several hammered copper suns, their thin rays chiming quietly at random intervals.  A variety of goods spill out from an antique mottled brass chest which sits open upon the dusky wooden floor, while multitudes of empty flasks are stacked in one corner below several tiers of some thick mithril shelves.

[Melorra's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the stark stone block walls.  A white marble shelf sits in one corner while a well-armed stocky warrior statue rests on a black-checked white tile floor.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard S]
description: You find yourself at the south end of the Guild's massive courtyard.  A cobbled path leads from the portcullis on the southern wall, circumnavigates a gushing fountain to the north and leads up the steps to the Guild Hall.  A pair of foot-worn dirt paths leads northeast and northwest through the otherwise manicured lawn, paralleling the Guild walls.

title: [House of Gnomish Goods, Gadgets]
description: A fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of striped throw pillows sits in one corner of the wooden floor.  There is a series of low oak shelves on one side of the shop and a plank-covered barrel table on the other.

title: [House of Gnomish Goods, Garb]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a wrinkled parchment gown pattern hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A long brass clothing rack and a variegated copper jewelry tree sit in opposite corners while a thick off-white carpet rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Woodland Path]
description: Tiny golden, white, and purple violets grow up through the crevices between the riverstones of a meandering path, while hostas line its edges.  Lilacs flank the hostas, and taller shrubs and trees grow in orderly succession along the path's length.  Soft burbles in the distance indicate the source of the forest's verdant fecundity.

title: [Curlew Brook, Lower Slope]
description: Dappled sunlight filters through the branches of the ancient trees that dot this stretch of the riverbank, making the pure whites of scattered wildflowers growing amid the grassy lawns between the trees all the brighter.  The raked gravel path curves around a circular, granite open-air hearth, with a stack of split cordwood stored in a small wooden shelter close to hand.

Silvery starlight filters through the branches of the ancient trees that dot this stretch of the riverbank, making the pure whites of scattered wildflowers growing amid the grassy lawns between the trees all the brighter.  The raked gravel path curves around a circular, granite open-air hearth, with a stack of split cordwood stored in a small wooden shelter close to hand.

title: [Curlew Brook, Waterfall View]
description: A path, its gravel neatly raked in narrow furrows, comes to an end here along a bluff overlooking the Mistydeep River.  This vantage point provides a perfect view of the falls, where the entire breadth of the river cascades over a wide, stone escarpment, frothing the blue-green waters below.

title: [Wyvern Plaza]
description: Broad, shallow stairs of alternating flint and slate lead down toward the river and up toward the top of the bluff.  Terraced gardens line the sides of the stairways, their flowers and dwarf fruit trees exquisitely espaliered and cultivated.  Between the two sets of stairs, a large plaza paved in checkerboard squares of flint and slate surrounds a sculptural fountain.  Four curved benches, placed at the points of the compass, provide an opportunity to sit and watch elven society meander by.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southwest, northwest, up, down

title: [Ravelin, Riverside Dock]
description: Thick rope supported between each wooden piling creates a railing for this small river dock.  Several wooden barrels are stacked underneath a large fish-shaped sign hanging from a weathered thanot shop.  A small wooden ladder secured to the edge of the platform leads down to a boat mooring.  Fishermen move about carrying boxes of supplies and baskets of fresh fish from the day's catch.

title: [Riverside, Boat Dock]
description: Below the dock, a smaller raft-like platform floats on the river, while many large barrels keep the mooring afloat with several thick hemp ropes tying it firmly in place.  White froth churned up by the moving river dances about the edge, occasionally disturbed by small fish swimming underneath.  A few crates and barrels are stacked ready to be loaded on to one of the small fishing dories secured to the landing.

title: [Erulk's Fishing Gear, Entry]
description: Woven mats of patterned cotton are scattered across the floor between crates and cases of fishing gear on display, creating a soft covering that still shows off the wood beneath.  A chandelier-style lamp with a trio of frosted glaes orbs is suspended from a thick faenor chain above the polished linden counter in the center of the room.  Tall wicker barrels filled with a wide variety of rods are tucked between two large arched windows that allow the cool river breeze to circulate throughout the shop.

title: [Limne Var]
description: Stretched along the bank, a large hoarbeam building dominates the river's edge.  Amaranth, pansies, and fire lilies fill the beds to each side of its fel door, while swathes of wisteria festoon its beams and lintels.  Bending down to greet their cousins, baskets of ivy and petunias overflow on windowsills.  Boisterous conversation carries from the terrace to the river side of the building.

title: [Lilly's Tavern]
description: Silvery hoarbeam panels cover the walls of this large central room.  A few tables sit across from the bar, lit with small chandeliers suspended from the ceiling.  Above the bar, a large painting hangs directly opposite an archway.  The clanking of tankards and the sometimes loud conversation of patrons make this tavern a lively place.

title: [Lilly's Tavern, Patio]
description: Red brick is inlaid in a circular pattern starting at the center of the patio where a large brick firepit stands.  Semi-circular benches surround the pit, shaded by potted trees, offering an inviting place to sit and rest.  Fragrant jasmine is planted in four beds that occupy each corner of the patio, while a beautiful glaesine fountain sits near an arched doorway leading back inside the tavern.

title: [Curlew Brook Bridge]
description: The turbulent water of a small creek chatters endlessly below this graceful span, creating tiny waterfalls and whirlpools as it makes its final descent towards the Mistydeep River.  From this vantage point, the dark forms of fish are barely visible, lurking in the shallows among the pale reeds growing along the banks.
