From this vantage point, a few colorful fish are visible lurking in the shallows among the pale green reeds growing along the banks.

title: [Lavandula Terrace]
description: Slate and flint steps go up and down the hillside, interrupted here by a terrace slightly smaller than the one below.  Hardy creeping phlox with cheery periwinkle and pink blooms lines the edges of the light grey slate square in front of an unimposing fel cottage.  Slightly musty, earthy, and ammoniated smells coming from the cottage's door are somewhat mitigated by the large tubs of lavender in bloom sitting athwart it.
paths: Obvious paths: east, northwest, up, down

title: [Furrier]
description: Rough-hewn fel walls rise to an unfinished vaulted ceiling giving this small room an airy feeling.  Hooks of wrought-iron hang from a sturdy fel beam that acts as the main support for the ceiling above.  Fine furs hang from the hooks, while bundles of various hides are stacked around the perimeter of the room.  A large stuffed bear greets visitors by the front door.

title: [Collema Var]
description: Aspens line the immaculate slate walkway as it passes before several small bungalows bedecked with flower boxes overflowing with lobelias and begonias over ivy-wound porches.  Their leaves rustle and shimmer in the slight breeze from the river as contented bees bustle to and from the nectar-laden flowers.

title: [Itarille Seregon, Front Room]
description: Silvery hoarbeam rafters support an intricate reed fan system over the center of the room, its wide blades turning slowly to circulate air.  Armor stands arranged throughout the small shop are set to face either each other, the counters, or the shelves, which display leather wares and fashions.  Glaesine windows framed in dark thanot stand open to the sunlight, which glints off of the vaalin latches and hinges set into the dark wood.

title: [Fortingall Marae]
description: Soft murmurs from elven voices drift from the open windows of low, screened-in villas lining the street.  The aspens lend privacy to their front gardens, coming together to form a circular court at the walkway's end.  At the apex of the court, a two-story modwir building with several wide windows welcomes patrons.  Birds twitter from the branches of the ancient yew tree standing in the center of the marae, yet not a single stain mars the benches beneath its outer branches.

title: [Jidrael's General Shop, Entry]
description: Golden linden floorboards stretch from the arched modwir entry to the thanot panel walls, which are interrupted by double-wide windows thrown open to admit the cool river breeze.  Frosted globes are suspended from vaalin chains throughout the shop, illuminating the wares displayed in baskets, cupboards, and tables.  A long rope dangles a sign in front of a set of stairs opposite a divided door that leads outside.

title: [Jidrael's General Shop, Bedroom]
description: Sparsely furnished, the small room houses a riverstone hearth in the far corner that is flanked by glass-fronted cupboards.  The curtained four-post bed occupies the far wall beside a golden linden nightstand and a faenor-banded leather footlocker.  Beneath a frosted globe chandelier, set at the center of the room, is a small, round table with two armchairs draped with cashmere blankets.

title: [Traders' Wey]
description: One building dominates the area, its imposing fel doors and wide, shuttered windows drawing as much attention as the two elven guards in navy and grey livery that greet customers and open the heavy doors.  Commercial establishments, their doors now closed tightly until the new day, make up the rest of the block.  Small redwood planters containing topiaries demarcate the boundaries between shops.

One building dominates the area, its imposing fel doors and wide, shuttered windows drawing as much attention as the two elven guards in navy and grey livery that greet customers and open the heavy doors.  Commercial establishments, their wares spread on portable carts and tables in front of them, make up the rest of the block.  Small redwood planters containing topiaries demarcate the boundaries between shops and help to control both noise and traffic flow on the wey.

title: [Ravelin Bank, Foyer]
description: Polished hoarbeam floors stretch uninterrupted from wall to wall, their natural grain accenting the rustic walls.  In the center of the room, an intricate pattern of mahogany is inlaid into the wooden floor, adding a bit of flair to an otherwise plain room.  To one side, a pair of bamboo and reed couches face each other across a glass-topped tree stump coffee table.  A tall linden arch in the back wall leads further into the structure.

title: [Ravelin Bank, Teller]
description: Sturdy, black granite forms the back wall housing the bank's vault, which has a brown-clad elven guard standing next to it.  A long oak counter with two tellers at their windows sits before the vault.  A dozen glaes globes hang from the ceiling, illuminating the entire room with green-hued light.

title: [Artemisia Terrace]
description: Knee-high knot gardens line the flint pebbled walkway to a long, low building with tall windows that glint in the starlight.  Terraces of grapes, their vines tethered to thin wires, climb up the hillside, while small mounds of artemisia and lavender march in perfect symmetry to the edge of the lower terrace.  A wrought iron bench, its back made of woven birch branches, sits perpendicular to the building, allowing those who rest to admire the river vista of the lower escarpment and village spread below.

Knee-high knot gardens line the flint pebbled walkway to a long, low building with tall windows that glint in the sun.  Terraces of grapes, their vines tethered to thin wires, climb up the hillside, while small mounds of artemisia and lavender march in perfect symmetry to the edge of the lower terrace.  A wrought iron bench, its back made of woven birch branches, sits perpendicular to the building, allowing those who rest to admire the river vista of the lower escarpment and village spread below.

title: [Kreldor's Locksmithy, Salesroom]
description: Thin strips of polished rosewood and birch are inlaid along the walls creating an intricate design.  Some rustic wooden chairs are set about the room on rugs of colorful spun wool.  A pair of carved shelves is fixed to the back wall, each holding various locksmithing tools.  Hung from each wall are pairs of faenor sconces that burn brightly with scented candles.  Several tall windows of tinted glaes allow cool air to flow through the building.

title: [The Ravelin, Steps]
description: Dotted by creeping phlox and primroses, the slate steps become more steep as the bluff's natural slope increases to a nearly vertical rise.  Juniper and ginkgo trees cling to the cliffside just below a large defensive embankment.

title: [Ravelin Meadow]
description: Sentinel modwirs stand guard over a waterproof canvas and silk structure, their boughs carefully pruned to frame it artfully.  Riverstones surrounded by a well-manicured lawn make a path to its entrance.  Unbound by containers, drifts of amaranth, columbine, delphinium, and hollyhocks show off perfect blooms to passersby.

title: [Natulcien's Healer Hall, Shop]
description: Stretched between ancient modwir trees, the ceiling is fashioned of a sturdy canvas and silk blend.  Permanent eastern and western walls support shelves and drying racks that house herbs, tinctures, and poultices alike, while a linden platform lifts the floor off the ground and is covered with lush rugs.  A set of steps leads down into a garden towards another canvas covered platform.

title: [The Ravelin]
description: Hardy creeping phlox covers the ravelin, making it look more like a flower garden than a redoubt.  Eastwards, the ravelin pushes forward to overshadow the river's gentle arc.  Steps of dark slate slash downward to the village, flanked by fragrant juniper bushes twisted by the constant wind.

title: [The Ravelin, South Wall]
description: Dark waters of the river flow smoothly and quickly southward again.  Sitting opposite the basalt protective wall, a medium-sized building emanates the smells of baking bread and cooking food.  The occasional crimson-clad soldier wanders over to the mess hall.

Dark waters of the river flow smoothly and quickly southward again.  Sitting opposite the basalt protective wall, a medium-sized building emanates the smells of baking bread and cooking food.  Steady streams of crimson-clad troops move in and out of the mess hall.

title: [The Ravelin, Southeast Wall]
description: Completing its eastward arc, the river once again returns to a generally southerly direction.  Inside the chest-high perimeter wall is a large sward of immaculately-kept grass bordered with grey slate walkways.  Near it, a large armory with a spectacular view of the golden walls of Ta'Vaalor rings with the sound of equipment repair and maintenance.

title: [The Ravelin, North Wall]
description: Flowing from the north and into a gentle easterly curve, the river hugs the bluff it carved in ages past.  Sturdy barracks of the same rock as the bluff are rimmed by the tall defensive basalt walls surrounding the ravelin's perimeter.

title: [The Ravelin, Northeast Wall]
description: Flying proudly in the constant breeze, the standard of Ta'Vaalor hangs on a tall vaalin pole near the perimeter wall.  Flanking the flag, lines of catapults with neatly arranged piles of ammunition take advantage of the dip in the wall's height to defeat any hostile approach from the river.

title: [The Ravelin, Point]
description: At the bluff's farthest reach east, the ravelin's commanding position is made clear in the view from the perimeter wall.  The Mistydeep's green-blue waters meander from the northern forests to the marble walls of Ta'Vaalor in the south.  Near the wall, a signal tower rises thirty feet on basalt blocks with steps carved into them.  Atop the tower, a stack of wood is ready to be lit at any moment.  A pair of vigilant elven recruits stand guard over a small, lit brazier with tar-soaked torches nearby.

title: [Natulcien's Healer Hall, Garden]
description: Orderly rows of herbs and flowers line a bright white riverstone walkway that ambles between the shop and the healer's pavilion.  Filigreed eahnor lanterns suspend frosted globes along the walkway, which has benches sporadically placed among the lush flora.  A birdbath fashioned of moss green marble rests at the center of the garden beneath the cool shade of the surrounding modwir trees.

title: [Natulcien's Pavilion]
description: Moss green and bright white walls flutter gently in the river-borne breeze that flows freely through the raised platform room.  Comfortable cots, set with light blankets and soft silk pillows, line the structure's two permanent walls, while a third is set at the back near a canvas wall bound to faenor anchors.  Rafters stretch between the walls and dangle dozens of frosted globes over the entire room providing it with constant illumination, while a tightly woven canvas and silk canopy stretches above it.

title: [Itarille Seregon, Work Room]
description: Polished fel walls house windows that stretch along the entire expanse of the eastern wall and reach from polished floor to raftered ceiling.  Glaesine panes swing into the room along the top portion of each window to admit a river-borne breeze that cools the stuffy air of the room, as well as relieves it of a portion of the stench created by the curing leather.  Cobbler's benches rest beneath the windows, while wide book cases lined with wares frame the double-wide archway leading into the front room.

title: [Jidrael's General Shop, Commons]
description: Frosted globes dangling from vaalin chains set into the ceiling sway slightly in the cool river breeze that passes through the small shop from the long open windows set into each of the room's three walls.  Decorative and functional wicker chairs offer perches for waiting customers and are arranged in casual patterns amongst the trunks and counters displaying the shop's wares.

title: [Kreldor's Locksmithy, Workroom]
description: Candle fixtures wrought of faenor hang from the high fel beamed ceiling illuminating a long birchwood counter.  Placed against the back wall is a worktable scattered with various tools, vials, and wedges for opening locked containers.  Two large windows flank a narrow ladder that leads up to a loft area.  A lush verdant fern in a large ceramic pot is placed in the far corner, its leaves falling over onto the patterned floor.

title: [Kreldor's Locksmithy, Loft]
description: Partially opened boxes and crates of supplies lie about a large workbench that dominates the small loft.  The surface is cluttered with various molds, tools, and implements for fixing small items.  A brazier with banked coals sits to the side under a domed window.  Covered with a worn homespun blanket, a small cot is set up in the far corner of the room.  At the end of the bed is a large iron-bound trunk with a sturdy padlock.

title: [Curlew Brook, Shore]
description: A neatly raked path winds through stands of young willows and white birches that flank the wide Mistydeep River to the east and Avocet Creek, babbling down the last stretch of its narrow course.  The path divides around a lens-shaped pool, home to a school of brilliant orange and silver fish.

title: [Curlew Brook, Shoreline Path]
description: Wandering closer to the Mistydeep River, the path is marked off by neat rows of rocks bordering raked gravel.  A few willows and other water-loving trees dot the bank.  Clumps of wildflowers and grasses grow freely, progressing from low sedges nearest the river to honeysuckle and other shrubs on the rising land to the west.

title: [Curlew Brook, Shoreline Path]
description: Fine gravel crunches underfoot, leaving faint footprints in the neatly raked path that wanders alongside the Mistydeep River.  Mature oaks and maorals dot the riverbank, while inland is a grassy sward, dotted with tiny white and yellow flowers.  As the trail winds northward, it leads upwards into a stand of trees.

title: [Curlew Brook, Lower Slope]
description: The ground rises steeply here, affording scenic vistas of the Mistydeep River to the east.  A gravel path, its surface carefully raked, curves between stately, widely spaced hardwoods.  To the west, a tranquil babble announces the presence of Avocet Creek, leaping downward through its boulder-strewn channel.

title: [Curlew Brook, Swimming Dock]
description: Crafted of wide modwir planks, this dock juts out into the deep waters of the Mistydeep, allowing swimmers easy access to the deeper flows of the river.  A dragonfly perches on the narrow boardwalk leading westward, back to shore.

Crafted of wide modwir planks, this dock juts out into the deep waters of the Mistydeep, allowing swimmers easy access to the deeper flows of the river.  A narrow boardwalk leading westward, back to shore, shimmers slightly in the starlight.

title: [Temple of Eonak, Landing]
description: This simple granite platform extends out from the south wall, supported by several granite arches anchored into the wall.  A winding stair spirals down to the floor of the sanctuary sixteen feet below, and a grey marble opening allows exit into a tunnel in the wall.  From this overhead vantage many aspects of the temple, such as the ledge, the fire ring, the fire sea, the ceiling, the anvil, and the battle axe, show aspects not apparent when viewed from the temple's floor.

title: [Long Corridor]
description: A long, narrow corridor extends east and west.  It is an unpretentious corridor, with no carpeting or wall coverings to alleviate the boredom of a granite floor, shored granite walls and a shored granite ceiling.  A giant toadstool occupies a brass pot, though the light cast by the toadstool is hardly ample to illuminate the entire corridor.  A heavy iron gate occupies a spot in the north wall, and a dim opening yawns in the corridor's east end.

title: [Lilly's Tavern, Kitchen]
description: Cooks busy themselves with their duties, checking the oven and stirring large pots on the stove.  The aroma of fresh baked bread drifts through the air, mingling with the scent of spices.  A shelf rests against a far wall filled with jars of herbs and kitchen instruments.  Near the entryway leading south, a large counter sits with plates of hot food that have been ordered by the patrons of the tavern.

title: [Lilly's Tavern, Terrace]
description: This part of the patio overlooks the river below and is covered by a latticed wooden shade.  Large potted plants sit near the supports, planted with climbing vines of honeysuckle that grow upward covering most of the shade.  A sturdy vaalin railing has been erected, allowing a breathtaking vantage of the river and the countryside below.  A small wrought-iron and wooden bench rests against the back of the building, partially covering a fresco that has been painted on the wall.

title: [Riverside, Fishing Pier]
description: The rope railing continues down this part of the dock, stretching out farther into the river.  Several coils of rope lay forgotten next to a crude wooden bench placed at the end of the pier.  Fish jump about in the water taunting those standing along the water's edge casting their lines out in the river.

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Nature's harmony is undisturbed as the river rolls along its course.  Breezes whisper amidst the trees on either side of the embankment while the river gurgles in quiet counterpoint.  To the southwest, a well-built dock overhangs the water's edge and numerous boats jostle each other as they try to slip free of their rope moorings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Erulk's Fishing Gear, Gallery]
description: Pieces of well-used fishing net draped over wide fel rafters create a spotted canopy for a long crystal aquarium.  Dozens of stuffed fish stare blankly out over the dock from a wide window above their wooden display case.  The sound of water rhythmically lapping at the pilings drifts in though a large archway at the back of the room.  Hanging just to the left of the arch is a large thanot-framed painting.

title: [Erulk's Fishing Gear, Porch]
description: Heavy fishing rope sections off a small porch area at the back of the shop.  Refreshing drinks sit on a small birch table with fish-shaped legs next to an intricately knotted hammock that stretches from the side of the building to a tall piling.  The moist river air cools the area as the water beneath moves with hypnotic rhythm.  Tiny river birds dance in the air as they snatch up the various insects drawn to the area.

title: [Landrai's Outfitting]
description: A woven floral tapestry hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls, and a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling rises overhead.  A potted palm tree sits in one corner of a varnished dark oak floor.  There is an aqua-hued seaglass display on one side of the shop and a long brass clothing rack on the other.

title: [Landrai's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling, a multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case sits in one corner while an elegantly dressed maiden statue rests on the dark oak floor.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Fern Path]
description: A break in the trees to the northeast offers a view of the waterfall cascading over the rocks and into the clear, aquamarine water of the lake.  Cottages stand along the path, turned to take advantage of the lake's panorama.  Ferns grow right up to the doors of the homes in thick masses, surrounding them with a verdant carpet and framing the paths which give them egress.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Oak Grove]
description: The trail winds through a stand of stately oaks, their lowest branches high above even the tallest of giantmen.  Rhododendrons crouch at the feet of the mighty ones, their foliage a green so dark, it appears black in shadows.  The ground is covered in a deep carpet of leaves, which the elements have rendered into a subtle and beautiful mottle of colors.  A few cabins blend seamlessly with the landscape, nestled within the protection of the oaks.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Spiny Seahorse Table]
description: The tabletop in this cozy nook is patterned in detailed glaes mosaics.  Small grey seahorses swim through a blue-green glaes sea.  A small oil candle casts glimmering light across the tiny glaes chips.
The table in this cozy nook is patterned in detailed glaes mosaics.  Small grey seahorses swim through a blue-green glaes sea.  A small oil candle casts glimmering light across the tiny glaes chips.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Bar]
description: A huge mirror hangs behind the well-stocked cherry bar that runs the length of the rear wall of this ornately decorated room.  Over the bar is a modwir sign etched with mithril inlaid letters reading "Girvahk's."  Comfortable chairs and floor throws are scattered about in small clusters, perfect for sitting and relaxing.  A fire crackles merrily in a large stone fireplace opposite the bar.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Museum]
description: Weapons of various types and origins are mounted on the walls to the north, west and east in this magnificent museum.  Shields bearing coats of arms and personal crests from places near and far are on display.  A glaes-bound display case dominates the center of the room.

title: [Schoolhouse, Classroom]
description: The heavy stench of smoke and ozone tears at your eyes.  Long wooden tables fill the center of the room, their surfaces covered with beakers, oil burners, and other vials filled with multicolored liquids.  At the front of the classroom, an elderly man sits behind a heavy desk and behind him a slate stone board with today's potion assignment scrawled out.

The lingering stench of smoke and ozone fills the air.  Long wooden tables sit in the center of the room, their surfaces mostly clean, save for a few scorch marks and holes that appear to have been eaten by acid.  At the front of the classroom, a heavy desk is completely clean as well as the slate stone board that hangs behind it.

Starcharts, miniature parchment models of constellations, and a variety of telescopes line the walls of the small classroom.  Children sit quietly in their seats playing with brass astrolabes as they follow along with the teacher at the head of the class.  Several small windows are inset into a wall, allowing just enough room to view the outside.

title: [Lake of Fear, Ferry Saloon]
description: Tiny lanterns create pools of light beneath the striped awning, dimly illuminating several wooden benches.  Towards the stern of the ferry, a few crates have been set on end with a plank laid overtop as a rough, but practical bar.  Beyond a brightly polished brass railing, a few benches are clustered on the foredeck.

title: [Ayniya's Imbeddables]
description: Laboriously cut from the stone that the cottage rests upon, this small cellar is crowded with stacks of assorted woods and a workbench covered with sawdust and woodcrafting tools.  A diminutive elven woman busies herself, alternately waiting on customers and working on several partially completed pieces.

title: [The Stream]
description: Water rushes swiftly over the smooth stones at the bottom of the water, torchlight from the courtyard casting golden tracks across the surface.  Trout sway their fins back and forth as they maintain their positions under the shadow of a nearby tree.  The water feels cold and refreshing and is loud enough to drown out nearby sounds.  A turtle considers you from head to toe from the top of an especially large stone sticking out of the middle of the stream.

Water rushes swiftly over the smooth stones at the bottom of the water.  Trout sway their fins back and forth as they maintain their positions under the shadow of a nearby tree.  The water feels cold and refreshing and is loud enough to drown out nearby sounds.  A turtle considers you from head to toe from the top of an especially large stone sticking out of the middle of the stream.

title: [Plateau, Abandoned Road]
description: Reduced to little more than parallel depressions in the turf, the abandoned road follows the northern bank of the stream.  Continuing to the west, all signs of the road are lost in the tall grasses.

title: [Plateau, Abandoned Road]
description: A rocky spur of Zeltoph Mountain reaches down from the north, forcing the road tight against the stream's bank.  Beyond the spur the road turns northeast, where strangely symmetrical formations are just visible above the intervening ridge.

A rocky spur of Zeltoph Mountain reaches down from the north, forcing the road tight against the bright stream's bank.  Beyond the spur the road turns northeast, where strangely symmetrical formations are just visible above the intervening ridge.

title: [Plateau, Abandoned Road]
description: The last signs of the ancient road are swallowed up by the grassland, but northward, against the backdrop of Zeltoph Mountain, the angled lines of peaked roofs and crenellated turrets can be seen.

title: [Castle Varunar, Approach]
description: Looking north you see a great castle.  Once a bastion of justice on the caravan route, it now appears empty and abandoned.  A sturdy iron-banded fel wood drawbridge sits lowered and spans a large ditch that surrounds the castle.

title: [Castle, Outer Drawbridge]
description: You are on an iron banded, fel wood drawbridge.  Looking east and west you see the defensive ditch that surrounds the castle.  In the ditch you see remnants of broken siege engines, rusted shields, and the occasional bit of sun-bleached bone.  To the north you see the barbican.

title: [Castle Varunar, Barbican]
description: The stone barbican surrounds you, with a massive portcullis standing at each end.  The walls are covered with scorching and brownish stains that might be blood.  Above you, numerous murder holes have been cut into the ceiling and you can imagine the destruction that might have rained down on any invader unlucky enough to find themselves trapped between the closed gates.  To the north you see the inner drawbridge spanning the castle moat.  To the south you see the outer drawbridge.

title: [Castle Varunar, Moat]
description: You find yourself on the drawbridge that spans the castle moat.  Below you, scum covered water guards the castle walls from approach.  To the north you see a massive steel-barred gate that is standing open on broken hinges.  To the south you see the barbican.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Gate]
description: This is the heart of the outer castle wall.  The stone blocks that surround you have been expertly hewn and fitted with dwarven craftsmanship.  You can almost feel the weight of the 40-foot tall walls that tower above you.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: A large killing field opens up before you.  The castle builders must have had defense on their minds when they created this area between the inner and outer castle walls.  Tattered bits of armor and scores of broken arrows litter the large dirt yard.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Wooden stairs that must have once lead to the ramparts are now lying in ruins on the ground.  Almost intact, perhaps removed by decision rather than assault or catastrophe, the stairs present an odd puzzle.  Strewn about the room are numerous rotted canvas and leather slings filled with fist sized rocks.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Small depressions in the dirt around you give the area a strangely pock marked look.  Scores of melon-sized rocks litter the ground around you, giving the impression that perhaps an angry god once hurled heavy stones against the castle walls from the heavens.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Just south of you, numerous iron cauldrons have been stacked against the outer wall.  The flame-blackened bottoms of the cauldrons show the brutal lengths the defenders would go to while guarding the castle.  Oddly, you notice depressions in the dirt where other cauldrons may have sat until just recently.

title: [Bastille, Keeper's Office]
[Stockade, Keeper's Office]
description: Sharply contrasting with the grey stone walls, lush burgundy carpeting runs from wall to wall.  An elaborate desk stands opposite the heavy oak doors that separate this haven from the prison proper.  Bright with color, a collection of wall hangings decorates the office, placed just below small beveled glaes windows set high up on the walls.  Only a light drizzle of candlelight filters down from a chandelier meant to brighten the second-level loft, which is set above the northern end of the office.

title: [Stockade, Storage Room]
[Bastille, Storage Room]
description: Flickering in the slight draft that flows by, torchlight stretches down to the earth, where the dirt floor quickly absorbs the bright invasion.  The small storage room is filled with boxes and crates stacked against its walls.  On the far wall, behind the stairway, a rusting door leads into a tiny cell.  An eerie series of sounds drifts in from further down the hallway, where darkness has taken over.

title: [Bastille, Keeper's Sky Parlor]
[Stockade, Keeper's Sky Parlor]
description: A banister of dark oak lines the southern edge of this carpeted loft, allowing only a glimpse of the keeper's office below.  Providing the loft with a sweeping view of Ta'Vaalor, three large windows take up the entire northern wall.  The two adjacent walls display shelves that overflow with books.  Glinting in candlelight shed from an ornate chandelier, a solid gold plaque has been set into the carpet at the head of the stairs.

title: [Stockade, Dead End Corridor]
[Bastille, Dead End Corridor]
description: A strong draft blows down the hallway, extending its dank fingers into a gloom disturbed only by flickering torchlight to the east.  A haphazard stone wall has been erected at the end of the hallway.  The stones lay at odd angles from each other, as if the mason was either in a hurry or not a master of his craft.  Wafting through a gaping hole in the wall, the strong smell of decay is accompanied by sounds of bone-splitting cracks and low moans.

title: [Stockade, Abandoned Cell]
[Bastille, Abandoned Cell]
description: Damp and drafty, this cell is virtually a dark cave.  So little light filters in through the empty doorway that it is nearly impossible to determine by sight where the cell ends on any side.  Only the remains of a broken and battered door lying sideways at the entrance indicate that this cell once held prisoners.  Chittering and scraping sounds echo from the darkest part of the cell.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: From here, the castle's keep rises high above the walls of the inner ward to the northeast.  You notice arrow loops have been hewn into the stone walls of the inner ward.  Set along rim of the inner walls, the arrow holes seem to stare down at you with an air of menace.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: As you look across the inner ward, gritty dirt gives way to a living granite platform that rises thirty feet above your head.  The sheer granite incline ends in another set of walls and appears to be some sort of inner keep.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: The empty expanse of the outer ward stretches before you.  Along the once well-kept walls weeds now grow at the base.  A stack of barrels leans precariously against the wall.

title: [Lucre Dahcre Chamber]
description: Tall mahogany bookcases frame this room, lending their warmth to the elegantly simple space.  Deep leather-upholstered couches and chairs have been gathered around a massive granite fireplace in which cherrywood logs are laid.  A silver looking-glass hangs above a mahogany bar along one wall, flanked by twin blue banners set with three orange chalices.  At the apex of the limestone arch leading into this room, a blue-edged topaz medallion glitters in the warm firelight.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: You see an abandoned merchant's stall leaning against the outer castle wall.  Tattered remnants of once-colorful canvas hang from the framework of rough hewn fel wood.  Inside the stall are broken shards of clay pottery and several smashed display cases.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Events Hall]
description: Decorating the walls of this passageway are a few tapestries depicting Silverwood events of the past.  One piece in particular seems dedicated to some kind of death-by-cookies game, while others are a simple representation of the sharing of knowledge.  An oak arch inlaid with silver scrollwork stands at the end of the hall, and a heavy pine door with a wrought iron handle interrupts the wall between a framed bit of aged parchment and a silver filigree-framed portrait.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Arena Room]
description: A layer of sawdust covers the floor of this rather bare area.  A few long benches, sitting on risers against the wall, provide seating for spectators.  There are no windows, and the singular door is reinforced on the inside with heavy steel rivets.  At one end of the room is a large, plain oak cabinet.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Blue Room]
description: Constructed entirely in the round, the walls of this room are covered in deep blue watered silk.  The ceiling overhead is draped with sheer silver gossamer, and from the center of the swathes hangs a pale blue mithglin chandelier.  Large velvet pillows in shades of white, blue, silver, and grey have been scattered about the cozy space, providing a comfortable place to rest.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Awards Hall]
description: The northern wall of this rather long hallway is lined with plaques and framed squares of parchment, with clear glass sconces strategically placed to allow for perfect illumination.  Opposite the display is a massive stone doorway inlaid with silver scrollwork.  Thick carpeting is designed to muffle even the heaviest of footsteps, giving this area a somewhat hushed, reverent atmosphere.  Marking the termination of the hallway is a pair of stained glass doors.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Quiet Garden]
description: A pair of stained glass doors open directly into the garden, where a well-manicured carpet of verdant grass is surrounded by a circle of stately haon trees.  The strong trunks and layered green leaves create a quiet area of insulated serenity.   Moonlight glints on the waters of a perfectly round pond at the center of the area, the surface dotted with glowing white votives.  Daisies sprout at the base of an elaborate polished marble statue.

A pair of stained glass doors open directly into the garden, where a well-manicured carpet of verdant grass is surrounded by a circle of stately haon trees.  The strong trunks and layered green leaves create a quiet area of insulated serenity.   Sunlight glints on the waters of a perfectly round pond at the center of the area, the surface dotted with soft purple mournbloom petals.  Daisies sprout at the base of an elaborate polished marble statue.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Map Room]
description: The curving walls of this room are painted with an intricate mural that depicts the sprawling world of Elanthia.  A circular couch scattered with soft pillows sits in an outward-facing fashion, allowing one to view the mural while relaxing.  Overhead, an elaborate light fixture illuminates both the mural and the room.  A mithglin sign has been affixed to the interior side of a massive stone doorway.

title: [West Wing Corridor]
description: This corridor is quiet, and the decorations here are minimal.  A soft carpet woven with several hues of complementary summery shades matches the lacquered golden haon of the walls.  A red iron door stands between a pair of triple-pronged candelabrum affixed to the walls, and opposite is an ora-inlaid golden mithril door and a grey-green vultite door.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Cleric Room]
description: Silver and crystal girandoles reflect the flickering flames of hundreds of beeswax candles.  On the floor in front of a plain altar, several crewelwork prayer rugs invite deep meditation.  Antique alms boxes and collection plates fill a tall etagere.  Covered in soft white velvet, a circle of oversized pillows are piled onto a fine black sable rug.  Affixed to the wall above a brushed silver table is a white vultite sign.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Paladin Room]
description: Grey marble floors are cool underfoot, and the room is illuminated by a large silvery vultite fixture hanging from the ceiling.  Against the far wall, a trio of small steps leads to a nondescript clear glaes altar.  A pair of crossed white ora broadswords hangs above a resplendent golden tapestry, directly opposite a pair of crossed black ora broadswords hanging above a majestic shadowed tapestry.  A silver mithril sign is affixed to the wall above a simple white table.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Warrior Room]
description: Long wooden racks holding several armors for display stand opposite the doors, while a variety of weapons are affixed to the plain stone walls.  Several long ebonwood benches, all padded with natural linen cushions, are arranged around a large map of Elanthia that has been painted on the floor.  A vultite sign is affixed to the wall above a sturdy ironwood table.

title: [West Wing Corridor]
description: This corridor is quiet, and the decorations here are minimal.  A soft carpet woven with several hues of complementary springtime shades matches the sage green silk covering the walls.  An oak door stands between a pair of triple-pronged candelabrum affixed to the walls, and opposite is a folded bamboo door.

title: [East Wing Corridor]
description: This corridor is quiet, and the decorations here are minimal.  A soft carpet woven with several hues of complementary autumnal shades matches the polished cherrywood of the walls.  A golden haon door stands between a pair of triple-pronged candelabrum affixed to the walls, and opposite is a scorched monir door and an oak door inlaid with jade vines.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Ranger Room]
description: Detailed maps are painted onto the walls of this room, the stone varying in hue to delineate vegetation, terrain, and water.  Occupying much of the space is a circular hunter green couch, perfect for a comfortable discussion in the artistic surroundings.  The hardwood floor is inlaid with an enormous compass rose, decorated around the edges with various flora and fauna.  A thanot-framed sign is affixed to the wall above a petrified modwir serving tray.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Rogue Room]
description: Delicate tendrils of light fade into shadows as they reach for the dark corners of this room.  A large, perfectly square ebonwood table is surrounded by a set of long benches covered in soft grey velvet.  A low glass display counter runs the length of one wall, and above the counter is a vaalin-framed sign.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Bard Room]
description: Streaming from a central point in the ceiling are lengths of sheer silk in a variety of bold colors.  The silk is embroidered with musical notes in fine golden thread.  Several stands hold scores of music for both instrument and voice, and a crystal display case is filled with practice instruments.  Opposite the rehearsal area is a beautifully carved maoral bar with a deep green marble top, and affixed to the wall behind the bar is a silver-framed sign.  Some bar stools provide a comfortable place to rest.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Atrium]
description: Pearly moonlight streams in through the glass walls and ceiling, picking pale blossoms out of the shadows formed by the lush vegetation.  The rich fragrance of tropical blooms rises in the night air, along with thin wisps of mist from the wide oval pool.  Occasionally, the chirping or clicking of a nocturnal insect adds music to the quiet setting.  Barely visible in the corner is a spiraling silver staircase, and a pair of glass double doors lead outside to the grounds.

Thriving in the direct sunlight, lush vegetation and a myriad of exotic blooms bedeck the solarium in tropical elegance.  In the center of the room is a wide oval pool.  A panoramic view of the manor grounds lies beyond the glass walls of the space, and a spiraling silver staircase is partially hidden behind a cluster of palm fronds in the corner.  Framed by an arch of ivy bearing crimson trumpet blossoms, a pair of glass double doors leads outside.

title: [Silverwood Garden]
description: A carpet of tussocky green grass is surrounded by tall cypress trees.  Moonlight filters in through the branches, and an octagonal white gazebo sits in the center of the area.  Surrounding the gazebo is a flourishing multicolored flowerbed boasting dozens of floral varieties.  Rather apart from the trees that encircle the space, a stately mahogany stands alone next to a bench and a burbling grey marble fountain.

Surrounding the gazebo is a flourishing multicolored flowerbed boasting dozens of floral varieties.  Rather apart from the trees that encircle the space, a stately mahogany stands alone next to a bench and a burbling grey marble fountain.

title: [Silverwood Garden, Treehouse]
description: A wide platform, free of railings or restraints, has been erected among the strong branches of this tree.  A few soft sage linen cushions are tossed casually about the smooth surface, and layers of vibrant green leaves smattered with tiny white flowers provide the only walls.  Rays of moonlight slip through the twisting limbs, causing patterns of light to dance across the area with the slightest breeze.

A few soft sage linen cushions are tossed casually about the smooth surface, and layers of vibrant green leaves smattered with tiny white flowers provide the only walls.  Rays of sunlight slip through the twisting limbs, causing patterns of light to dance across the area with the slightest breeze.

title: [Silverwood Garden, Gazebo]
description: Cream linen cushions striped in hues of terra cotta and sky-blue cover the benches that line the walls, save for a small doorway leading back into the garden.  The open sides of the gazebo are draped with sheer gossamer netting, through which the shadows of eager moths are visible.  A faceted crystal lamp hangs from a silver chain, the lit pillar candle within casting a warm glow over the area.  Centrally placed, a low white table painted with vines and flowers bears refreshments.

Cream linen cushions striped in hues of terra cotta and sky-blue cover the benches that line the walls, save for a small doorway leading back into the garden.  The open sides of the gazebo are draped with sheer gossamer netting, allowing sunlight in and keeping the bees out.  From a conical white ceiling, a faceted crystal lamp is suspended from a silver chain.  Centrally placed, a low white table painted with vines and flowers bears refreshments.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Observatory]
description: A short wrought iron railing encloses this space, which is little more than a flat tower roof.  Open to the night sky above, the expanse of the heavens appears without limit.  A polished oak table holds a few charts, which are open and held down with glass paperweights.  A long divan covered in pale blue linen provides a comfortable place to rest, and a copper-banded spyglass sits upon a silver stand, ready to observe the night sky.

A short wrought iron railing encloses this space, which is little more than a flat tower roof.  Open to the sky above, the sun shines unhindered on every available surface.  Several large books sit closed upon a polished oak table next to a stack of rolled-up charts.  A long divan covered in pale blue linen provides a comfortable place to rest.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Parlour]
description: Walls covered in black watered silk blend seamlessly with a curving black willow bar.  The light in this room is low and the atmosphere is intimate, with warmth emanating from the flames in a gold-flecked onyx fireplace.  Scattered on the rug in front of the fireplace are a few red velvet-covered cushions, and a large grey sable couch is placed against the opposite wall.  Hanging a safe distance from any seating area is a multicolored dart board.

title: [East Wing Corridor]
description: This corridor is quiet, and the decorations here are minimal.  A soft carpet woven with several hues of complementary wintry shades matches the lacquered white monir of the walls.  A soulstone-inset door stands between a pair of triple-pronged candelabrum affixed to the walls, and opposite is a rose-carved white willow door and a black ironwood door.  The hallway terminates here, where a polished mahogany arch leads further into the manor.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Library Foyer]
description: Opposite the entry arch of this spacious room is a curving mahogany desk.  Dozens of pillar candles, placed in clusters on outcroppings of the rough stone walls, cause fickle patches of light and shadow to dance about the area.  Affixed to the wall behind the desk is a large silver-framed sign.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Wizard Room]
description: The very air seems alive as traces of static streak between the dark blue glaes lamps hanging from the ceiling.  A mottled marble worktable covered with wands and potions stands against one wall, next to a black willow podium bearing an ancient tome.  A safe distance from the work area, a grey suede divan and a soft black sable couch are arranged around a silver-threaded silk-tasseled rug.  Affixed to the wall above a silvery tray is an engraved electrum sign.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Empath Room]
description: A series of life-size sketches hang on the walls, each detailing the body and the various types and degrees of wounds that can be sustained.  Bandages and herbs are neatly stacked on a long monir table, while a large book sits open next to them.  Several velvet chairs face a cozy alabaster fireplace, and a blue wool rug is soft underfoot.  A silver-framed parchment sign is affixed to the wall above a white willow tray.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Sorcerer Room]
description: Four torches, burning with eerie blue flames, are anchored to the floor in each corner by onyx intaglio demons.  A sleek black marble table raises bubbling alembics, odd crucibles, and spell books within easy reach.  Opposite the table is a small lounging area, featuring a low witchwood serving table centered on a fluffy white polar bear rug scattered with oversized black velvet cushions.  Highlighted by scarlet despanal mosaic tiles, a polished obsidian sign is affixed to the wall.

title: [Small Estate, Garden Shrine]
description: A pure ivory arch houses a simple statue of a smooth-faced youth -- both white and black rose bushes flanking its sides, while thorny vines of crimson roses crawl over the apex of the structure.  Three round bowls are set before the downturned gaze of the youth, arranged in a triangular pattern with the uppermost bowl tinted a deep carmine.  The dark, tranquil waters of a pond sparkle behind the statue, the glimmering sapphire shards of starlight playing across its surface wanly.

A pure ivory arch houses a simple statue of a smooth-faced youth -- both white and black rose bushes flanking its sides, while thorny vines of crimson roses crawl over the apex of the structure.  Three round bowls are set before the downturned gaze of the youth, arranged in a triangular pattern with the uppermost bowl tinted a deep carmine.  The dark, tranquil waters of a pond sparkle behind the statue, the glimmering golden jewels of sunlight playing across its surface in soft waves.

title: [Room of Last Rites]
description: Two toadstools in brass pots flank a long, low, stone slab, their dim light pooling over the hard slab.  The scent of embalming chemicals permeates the room, though it is heaviest near a metal cupboard affixed to one wall.  A tarnished metal sign hangs next to the cupboard.  The lack of much else in the room seems to cause even the slightest of noises to echo loudly off the granite walls and encourages one to speak in whispers.

title: [Silverwood Garden, Fishing Hole]
description: A short dock extends partway into the serene waters of a small pond.  Miniscule waves lap against the pylons, stirred only by the most gentle of breezes.  Moonlight sparkles on the water, and the tall grasses surrounding the pond sway in unison with the flitting of the fireflies.  On the shore just beyond the dock, a small fire pit containing a well-maintained blaze is surrounded by granite slabs.  A few paces away is a small wooden shack.

A short dock extends partway into the serene waters of a small pond.  Miniscule waves lap against the pylons, stirred only by the most gentle of breezes.  Sunlight sparkles on the water and the tall grasses surrounding the pond sway in unison with the flitting of the dragonflies.  On the shore just beyond the dock, a small fire pit containing a well-maintained blaze is surrounded by granite slabs.  A few paces away is a small wooden shack.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Grove]
description: A clustered grove of young aspen trees shelters a small marble shrine.  Garlands of flowers in varying hues of red are draped from the trees, and red petals are sprinkled about the soft carpet of grass underfoot.  Fireflies dance through the leaves of the trees, causing tiny patches of illumination to come and go like the twinkling of the overhead stars.

A clustered grove of young aspen trees shelters a small marble shrine.  Garlands of flowers, all in varying hues of red, are draped from the trees and extend to the soft carpet of grass underfoot.  Butterflies dance merrily about the blossoms and birds sing from the topmost branches, luxuriating in the warm sunlight that bathes the area.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Fishing Shack]
description: Many sizes of pots and pans hang on the walls and rest on the shelves that are mounted on all four walls of the room.  Various cooking ingredients ranging from salt to packages of herbs are haphazardly placed wherever they fit.  A large hole has been cut in the middle of the shack floor, and the opening has been lined with darkened stones, creating a firepit where a pitted iron spit stands over a small fire.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Looking to the northwest you see the castle's keep rising high above the walls of the inner ward.  Sitting at the base of the granite inner walls is an old hay wagon with a broken axle.  You notice several arrow shafts imbedded in the old buckboard's sides, giving it the look of a monstrous wooden porcupine.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: The dirt and rock at the base of the inner wall seems to have become home to some small rodent.  Pieces of bright metal, glass, and seed husks surround what looks like a mouse hole in the stone wall.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Gate]
description: To the west a massive gate stands open.  The gate is a full four feet thick and fashioned from iron-banded fel wood.  Four hardwood locking bars lean against the wall, their tops forming a stable platform for a sparrow nest.  Oddly, no signs of forced entry are in evidence.  Just inside the gate you see a stone ramp leading up towards the inner walls.

title: [Castle Varunar, Tunnel]
description: Two sturdy walls and the granite hillside protect access to a massive stone ramp.  The ramp stretches upwards and stops in front of the gates that protect the inner ward of the castle.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: You see a massive stone ramp leading down, its base worn smooth by countless feet and wheels traveling it over the years. The inner ward walls tower above you, giving a feeling of both isolation and security.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: The burnt remains of some wooden stairs are scattered about the area.  A battered wooden platform that may have anchored stairs leading to the walls ramparts sits at the bottom off the outer walls.  At the base of the platform is a broken weapons rack, seemingly fashioned to hold swords and shields for the defenders on the top of the walls.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: To the southwest the castle's keep rises high above the inner ward walls.  The keep's hot oil gutters and spouts seem to have become home to the pigeons flying overhead.  Pieces of straw and twigs block every spout, making them useless for their intended purpose.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: A fierce battle appears to have taken place here.  On the ground is a broken shield, the head of a waraxe still imbedded in it.  The walls show the sign of a fire, the scorch marks rising well above your head.  The wall is chipped in many places, and a shattered arrow lies at your feet.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Noting the steep slope to the inner ward, the broad dirt stretch to the outer wall, and the ramparts with battlements on both sides, it seems that the outer ward is a well-designed trap.  Attackers caught between defenders on both walls with no cover and uncertain footing would find themselves in nothing but a killing field.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: A small pool of water lies at the base of the granite inner walls.  A steady drip of water coming from a crevice in the rock face feeds the pool and might indicate an underground spring.  Next to the pool, a weathered watering trough sits overturned and useless.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Stone stairs to the ramparts have been swept away from the wall four feet above the ground, only to resume their upward journey fifteen feet up the wall.  A pile of masonry and a massive cracked boulder sitting at the base of the wall give evidence as to what happened.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: A stack of wagon wheels leans against the outer wall, the wood seemingly infested with termites.  Several rotting wooden shacks and storage bins form a circle around the wheels, giving one the impression this was once a storage depot of some kind.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Bundles and stacks of straw are scattered about the area making footing uncertain at best.  Most of the piles leaning against the wall are rotted with age, their shape held together more by habit than the frayed cord securing them.  Oddly, a few of the hay stacks seem almost fresh from the fields outside the castle gates.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: The broad expanse of dirt before you slopes up to the north face of a hewn granite rock incline.  Atop the incline rise the sturdy stone walls of the inner keep.  Ancient masons seem to have planned every bulge and outcropping to impede any attack on the inner ward walls, and yet offer no protection to the attackers from the defenders on the top of the walls.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: To the southeast the castle's keep rises high above the inner ward walls.  Skillfully placed stone and mortar give proof that both the inner and outer walls of the castle were constructed to stand the test of time.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Scattered about the area you see piles of broken weapons and armor.  Tarnished and nicked from battles past, many crests are represented, both attacker and defender.  Curiously, some items seem to be newer, without rust or stain.  A jumbled pile of shattered shields is pushed against the outer wall, their numbers so many it might represent the life's work of an armorer.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: High above you a bat is careening in crazy arcs.  Suddenly, the bat folds his wings and falls in a screaming dive.  As the bat dips from view below the outer walls, you hear its shrill cry.

High above you a peregrine falcon is circling in lazy spirals.  Its keen eyes ever vigilant for the slightest movement of prey, it seems to look down on the countryside as a king might his kingdom.  Suddenly, the hawk folds his wings and falls in a screaming dive.  As the hawk dips from view below the outer walls, you hear the shrill cry of its victory.

title: [Castle Varunar, Outer Ward]
description: Against the outer wall, the blackened silhouette of stairs leading up to the ramparts is all that remains of the access to the top of the wall.  Charcoal and half-burned lumber litter the ground at the base of the wall.  In one blackened plank a dozen iron arrowheads still remain as witness to the ferocity of a battle once fought here.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: On the ground you see thousands of sparkling glass bits.  Inside a wood framed building you see an odd-looking chair with long steel rails where the arms would be.  A rack with a dozen six-foot long blowpipes lies next to it.  You also see two large brick ovens that have fallen into disrepair.  To the southeast, you see a stout wooden door leading into a castle tower.

title: [Castle Tower, Southeast]
description: In the tower room you find a pile of scattered leaves swirling in a soft wind that blows through the arrow loops.  High above your head you see an open trap door with the ends of a broken ladder protruding from it.  Even standing on a giantman's shoulders you couldn't hope to reach it.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: Just to the north you see a small windowless log building. The front wall of the structure has been knocked down by some tremendous force.  Inside you see many shelves lining the log walls.  On the shelves are scores of broken clear and blue bottles, their contents now dry and useless.  Hanging from the overhead beams are bundles of desiccated herbs.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Winding Path]
description: Tall oaks slowly give way to a thick growth of hemlocks.  The thick, scaly trunks of the conifers peek through the foliage here and there, their color a brown that appears more purple-grey when the light changes.  To the south, the trail angles toward an immense oak, which is just visible through foliage and a couple of cottages standing along the way.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: A weathered stone building stands just south of you.  Through the open archway, you see many racks of what were once exquisite tapestries now faded with age.  Chiseled into the stone over the arch are numerous holy symbols and icons.

title: [Castle Varunar, Chapel]
description: An intricately carved siege door stands next to a massive stone arch, having once protected the entryway to this place of prayer.  A pair of stained glass windows frames a simple oak table which stands against the south wall.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: A small wooden framework covered in tattered canvas lies against the south wall.  Inside you see a small smelter and bits of verdigris-covered material.  A low workbench with a very small anvil and a flat tipped hammer on it sits next to the smelter.  A wooden barrel filled with rainwater lies at the end of the workbench.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: Built along the south wall is a large wooden open-air structure.  Underneath its planked roof you see rows of steel cauldrons with long copper coils on top of them.  Underneath each cauldron is a shuttered brazier with numerous adjustment slots on the covering.  The smell of sour mash permeates the area.  Sitting just east of the cauldrons you see a rack that must have once held casks, but is now empty.  To the southwest, you see a stout wooden door leading into one of the castle towers.

title: [Sorcerer's Isle, Scree]
description: Large rocks jumble together to form a small breakfront along the river's edge, washing up on the shore for eons.  Gnats and mosquitoes swarm in thick clouds above each pool of stagnant water cradled within the haphazard barrier.

Large rocks jumble together to form a small breakfront along the river's edge, washing up on the shore for eons.  Dragonflies and other winged insects flit from the pools of stagnant water cradled within the haphazard barrier to the sun-warmed stone surfaces.

title: [Hall of the Arkati, Lower Hall]
description: Here the hallway ends its long descent, amid pillars of cold, dark basalt, the tops of which are lost amid the shadows far above.  The only light to relieve the cold darkness glimmers from higher up the passage, to the east, as faint as the memory of summer at mid-winter.  In that dim light, gems set into a massive vaalorn door glint coldly, casting an unearthly light on a dark-hued tapestry.

wayto.20430:
;e 
	fput "open door"
	while line = get
		if line =~ /That is already open\./
			break
		elsif line =~ /There doesn't seem to be any way to do that\./
			if GameObj.right_hand.type == "gem"
				fput "put ##{GameObj.right_hand.id} in vaalorn door"
				break
			else
				echo "In order to get past this door you must sacrifice a gem.\n Place a cheap gem in your right hand and unpause the script (;unpause) to continue."
				pause_script
				wait_until{GameObj.right_hand.name !~ /Empty/}
				fput "put ##{GameObj.right_hand.id} in vaalorn door"
				break
			end
		end
	end
	fput "go door"

title: [Castle Tower, Southwest]
description: Upon entering this small guardroom you notice several squirrel nests lodged into the arrow slots.  An oak trapdoor has been set into the room's ceiling but someone has nailed numerous planks over it to block passage.  Beneath the trap door, a broken ladder lies on the floor now useless.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: The east and north sections of the inner wall meet here.  Set between the two walls, a stout watchtower rises several stories over the inner ward grounds.  A sturdy wooden door hanging on its rusted hinges leads into the tower's interior.

title: [Castle Tower, Northeast]
description: Several wooden weapon racks have been attached to the stone floor of this small guardroom.  Rows of arrow slits have been expertly cut into the walls and offer a view of the northwest outer ward far below.  Above, a small wooden hatch probably leads to the tower's upper levels.  An old ladder leans against the east wall, many of its rungs broken or missing.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: Bits of rotted tack and harness litter the area around you.  To the north, the castle stables sit in the shadow of the northern walls.  A pair of large barn doors leading into the stable's interior stand open just enough for someone to squeeze by.

title: [Castle Varunar, Stables]
description: Bales of rotting straw litter the ground around you.  Tattered pieces of saddles and riding gear hang from iron pegs set into the stained wooden walls.  To the north, a darkened passage leads into the stables proper.  Above the passage, strange mystic symbols have been etched into the wood.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: A stout wooden structure lies just to the north.  Judging from the soot-stained chimney and rusted iron ingots stacked just outside the door, it was likely the castle smithy at one time.

title: [Castle Varunar, Smithy]
description: The metallic tang of steel still seems to hang in the air here.  Lit only by a guttering torch, the shadows leap and dance in the room's corners.  The forge and bellows seem to be in good repair, but covered with a very thin film of dust.  The anvil is covered with rust, almost hiding the years of hard service.  Ingots and blanks for various weapons are neatly stacked up against the wall, as if awaiting a smith's return.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: A large rectangle of charcoal in the dirt lies just to the south.  In the center of the rectangle you see the charred remains of barrel staves and small iron tools.  A cooper's bench stands to one side with a small brazier next to it.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: A large earthen kiln sits just off the path to the south.  Next to the kiln, a wood covered lean-to with four potter's wheels under it has been recently set up.  You also notice a stout wooden door leading into the northwest castle tower.

title: [Castle Tower, Northwest]
description: The remnants of a small table and several chairs lie strewn about the stone floor.  A wooden weapons rack has been torn from the wall and now lies shattered against it.  Weaving amongst the debris are many sets of muddied boot prints.

title: [Castle Varunar, Inner Ward]
description: A large stone building sits along the western wall.  Atop the rectangular structure, several old banner poles sway slightly in the wind, their cloth standards long since gone.  A set of massive double doors stands open leading to the building's interior.

title: [Castle Varunar, Great Hall]
description: Lighted torches line the entire length of this great hall.  A giant oak table surrounded by chairs sits in the center of the hall.  Numerous plates and mugs sit on top of the table showing recent signs of use.  Two massive fireplaces sit at opposite ends of the room, the ashes of many fires still in evidence inside them.  Piles of fresh straw have been neatly arranged against the walls, seemingly as makeshift beds.  Faded banners hang from the ceiling timbers covered by years of dust and fire soot.

title: [Castle Varunar, Stables]
description: Deep hoof prints left in the soft dirt give clues to the size of the animals once housed here.  A massive wooden training post sits anchored in the center of the room.  A worn circular path around the training post shows it had been in use for many years.

title: [Castle Varunar, Stables]
description: Giant hoof prints criss-cross the area in random patterns.  Racks of once colorful tournament lances have been broken off at the hilt and trampled.  Faded battle standards hanging from the walls seem to have been chewed off above where only a giantman might reach.

title: [Castle Varunar, Stables]
description: A partially buried hoof rasp lies in the center of the room, posing a tripping threat.  Currycombs, brushes and buckets litter the floor around you.  A rack with once-colorful mane and tail ribbons stands against one wall, its contents now faded and torn.

title: [Castle Varunar, Stables]
description: Massive pieces of rusted iron barding lay strewn about the area.  Giant helms, pauldrons, and greaves lay stacked in corners seemingly ready for use.  A lone torch sputters in its sconce giving the room an eerie light.

title: [Castle Varunar, Stables]
description: Charred bales of straw lay stacked in a far corner.  Soot has covered the ceiling with a smoky blackness and the walls have been horribly scorched.  The shoulder high stall doors along the northern wall all seem to have been broken open with great force.  The wood around the door latches has been splintered and huge shod hoofprints mar the surface.

title: [Castle Varunar, Stables]
description: Rows of rotting leather harnesses and rusted bits are arranged on the stained wooden walls.  A pile of mildewed saddle blankets has been tossed carelessly in the corner and a decomposed saddle rests on one of the many stall doors.

title: [Castle Varunar, Chapel]
description: You find yourself in a place that was once a solemn and dignified place of prayer and meditation.  Now cobwebs and dust cover the eonake altar that lies on its side and the pews have all been turned over and splintered.

title: [Castle Varunar, Chapel]
description: In the priest's quarters you find a rush covered pallet pushed against one wall.  A small writing desk with a burned-out candle and a simple chair are the only other furnishings in the room.  On the north wall a shadow of a long since removed holy symbol has been left in the plaster.

title: [Small Wonder, Sacrifice Booth]
description: Less than half the size of Brother Welton's tent, this roofless, black canvas booth is dominated by a polished brass brazier.  A brass-bound felwood torch burns brightly in a black iron torchholder just to one side of the brazier, and a black leather oilskin hangs by a golden cord from the nearest tent pole.

title: [Pets No More]
description: The empty eye sockets of dessicated animal heads stare from several shelves of this crowded room.  Apparently organized by creature type, the shelves, table and counter are laden with dried limbs, fanged skulls and various and sundry other body parts.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Clearing]
description: A huge white oak towers above, dwarfing the surrounding hemlocks and sycamores.  Its widely spreading branches reach out around it in an expansive diameter.  The top must reach up more than 130 feet.  The bark is a pale shade of grey, deeply fissured with age.  A stair is built against it in matching oak wood, wrapping around the massive trunk in an elegant spiral.  It leads up into the lower branches where a platform is visible.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Tree Branch]
description: A polished platform is positioned within the embrace of a couple of the host oak's substantial branches.  It gives access to a door leading into the tree's interior.  A round window is beside the door, its oak sill polished to a deep golden color.  Lobed leaves of the huge tree drape elegantly around the entrance,  its frame carved with a border of oak leaves and acorns.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Fern Amble]
description: Primroses compete with ferns alongside the trail, as it meanders beneath a grove of red alder trees.  Their ovate leaves flutter in a teasing breeze which sets them to shimmering in the gentle light.  Cabins sit in the crevices between branching trails, the paths leading to their doors edged with more of the colorful primroses.

title: [Schoolhouse, Hallway]
description: Silence permeates the long corridor, and shadows restlessly flicker along the black-speckled white tile that stretches down the hallway.  Artwork created by the students hangs neatly on the walls, the only testament that someone comes here.

The sound of children fills this portion of the hallway, the noise drifting out of the classrooms as well as from those darting along the corridor.  The black-speckled white tile continues here, adding an echoing quality to the narrow egress, and artwork created by the students hangs neatly on the walls.

title: [Schoolhouse, Classroom]
description: The benches are settled in the center of the room, and off to the side are racks of a variety of instruments.  A large bay window inset into the eastern wall is closed for the night.  Pale moonlight filters through the thin glass into the classroom, leaving only the shadows to play at night.

Rows of benches fill the center portion of the classroom, some of them out of line as the children filling them move about restlessly.  A mature dark-haired man sits at the front of the room, attending to the parchment stacked on his desk.  In the back of the classroom, piles of satchels and bags are left strewn about the floor.

The benches of the classroom have been pushed off to the side, and rows of chairs are left in the center.  The children sit neatly in the chairs, each holding a different instrument as they pay close attention to the woman standing behind a music stand.  A large bay window inset on the eastern wall is open to allow the sounds of nature and sunlight to enter the classroom.

title: [Schoolhouse, Hallway]
description: Small footlockers line both sides of the corridor, some of them having been accidently left opened.  The faint smell of smoke and ozone lingers in the hallway like a stain on the air.  Scraps of parchment drift lazily along the black-speckled white tiles of the floor.

Small footlockers line both sides of the corridor, some of them having been accidently left opened.  The faint smell of smoke and ozone drifts out from one of the classrooms.  Children dot the hallway here and there, some talking in groups while others are running off to their next class.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: The remains of a broken crate litter the floor, the rusty nails making movement quite dangerous.  Dim light makes seeing the hazards in your path even more difficult.  The boxes to either side of the narrow hall teeter slightly, proving that their stacking was haphazard at best.

title: [Schoolhouse, Hallway]
description: The lingering scent of cooked food and freshly cut grass wafts throughout the hallway.  Scuff marks mar the otherwise pristine black-speckled white tile floor, coming and going from the door that leads to the playground and the arch that leads into the lunchroom.

The faint scent of cooking food and freshly cut grass wafts throughout the hallway.  Children run along this end of the hallway, coming and going from the door that leads out to the playground and the arch that leads into the lunchroom.  Dirt and sand cover the black-speckled white tile floor and fingerprints stain the otherwise pristine walls.

title: [Schoolhouse, Lunchroom]
description: An arch inset in the southern wall leads back to the hallway.  Wooden benches and tables are placed all over the large room and bits of food and parchment litter the floor underneath the benches.

An arch inset in the southern wall leads back to the relative silence of the hallway.  Wooden benches and tables are placed all over the large room and dozens of children sit gossiping about the daily activities while eating their meals.  Bits of food and parchment litter the floor underneath the benches.

title: [Schoolhouse, Playground]
description: A wide field of grass extends out from behind the schoolhouse, some patches of dirt exposed from the excess trampling of feet.  Various playground equipment shine in the moonlight, from seesaws to climbing bars and even a large sandbox.  The eerie silence of the night encompasses the area, a ghostly visage constrasting to the usual reckless abandon during the day.

A wide field of grass extends out from behind the schoolhouse, some patches of dirt exposed from the excess trampling of feet.  Various playground equipment dart the lawn, from seesaws to climbing bars and even a large sandbox.  Dozens of children play with reckless abandon, their cares of daily school life forgotten for a period of time.

title: [Ilyra's Fashions]
description: The delicate fragrance of melting beeswax drifts through the room.  The thick yellow candles, resting in small iron wall sconces, cast a soft flickering glow across the room.

title: [Ilyra's Fashions]
description: The walls are hung with blush-colored satin, which drapes and puddles on the floor.  A large gilded mirror stands in one corner.  A plum velvet curtain hangs opposite the mirror.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Grand Ballroom]
description: Velvet-covered divans and settees rest comfortably against the white stucco walls, leaving the golden linden dance floor free of clutter.  Heavy draperies decorate the double archway that leads into the foyer, as well as the long expanse of the raised oak stage.  Frosted glass globes fitted with tiny candles dangle from the vaulted ceiling to lend the room soft illumination and hang thickest over a pair of decorative serving tables.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Art Gallery]
description: Thick emerald green curtains of soft Vornavian silk stand parted to allow silver moonlight to trickle through the glass-paned bay windows, which are fitted with window seats covered in periwinkle blue cushions.  Pewter wall sconces, hung between framed portraits, run the length of the western wall of this arched gallery, while an enormous kraken sculpture stands alone opposite them upon a curved pedestal.  Suspended to the right of a double archway is a delicate glass picture.

Thick emerald green curtains of soft Vornavian silk stand parted to allow golden sunlight to trickle through the glass-paned bay windows, which are fitted with window seats covered in periwinkle blue cushions.  Pewter wall sconces, hung between framed portraits, run the length of the western wall of this arched gallery, while an enormous kraken sculpture stands alone opposite them upon a curved pedestal.  Suspended to the right of a double archway is a delicate glass picture.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Lounge]
description: Shelves of colorful bottles line the rounded wall centered within a large circular oak bar.  A variety of crystal drinking glasses hangs upside down in rows from a rack above.  High-backed dark leather chairs scatter about the room, turned away from the etched glass doors to focus on a large riverstone fireplace.  A basket of sticks sits to one side, with a well used dart board hanging above.  Placed under a large arching window, a huge leafy green fern hangs over the edge of the ceramic pot to caress the soft ivory wool carpeting.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hot Springs]
description: Sunlight streams though the branches of four weeping willow trees that provide a canopy for the natural pond.  An abundance of verdant ferns and colorful wildflowers circle the edge, broken by a flat, table-like rock and a small cobblestone pathway that leads back to the garden.  Wisps of steam rise up from the naturally heated pond glistening as rays from above hit the surface.  Situated about the bottom are several stones, perfect for sitting and relaxing in the mineral rich warm water.

Moonlight filters though the branches of four large weeping willow trees that provide a canopy for the small pond. Verdant ferns and colorful wildflowers circle the edge in shadow, only broken by a flat, table-like rock and a small cobblestone pathway that leads back to the garden.  Wisps of steam rise from the naturally heated pond, lit by dimly glowing orbs set above the edge. Situated about the bottom are several stones, perfect for sitting and relaxing in the mineral rich warm water.

Moonlight filters though the branches of large weeping willow trees, planted to provide a canopy for the small pond.  An abundance of verdant ferns and colorful wildflowers circle the edge in shadow, only broken by a flat, table-like rock and a small cobblestone path that leads to a pair of etched glass doors.  Wisps of steam rise up from the naturally heated water lit by dimly glowing orbs set above the waters edge.  Situated about the bottom are several stones, perfect for sitting and relaxing.
