An abundance of verdant ferns and colorful wildflowers circle the edge, only broken by a flat, table-like rock and a small cobblestone path that leads to a pair of etched glass doors.  Wisps of steam rise up from the naturally heated pool, sending soft ripples across the surface.  Situated about the bottom are several stones, perfect for sitting and relaxing in the mineral rich warm water.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Library]
description: Deep armchairs covered in midnight blue velvet are scattered about, creating a striking contrast to the paneled walls of golden oak.  A matching velvet couch, flanked by a pair of oak end tables, sits before a large riverstone fireplace with a basket of sticks nearby.  Moonlight streams through the etched glass windows framing a ceramic urn of wildflowers.  Large pewter wall sconces provide adequate light, and shelves filled with a variety of books line the wall at the back of the room.

Deep armchairs covered in midnight blue velvet are scattered about, creating a striking contrast to the paneled walls of golden oak.  A matching velvet couch, flanked by a pair of oak end tables, sits before a large riverstone fireplace with a basket of sticks nearby.  Filled with wildflowers, a painted ceramic urn rests between two etched glass windows framed in sheer white silk.  Large pewter wall sconces provide adequate light for reading, and shelves filled with a variety of books line the wall at the back of the room.

title: [Captain's Rest, Hallway]
description: Brass lamps hang on the well-polished modwir paneled walls.  Blue carpeting in a pattern reminiscent of waves in the sea runs the length of the hall.  Hanging on the wall opposite from a modwir door is a picture of a sunset over a small island.

title: [Captain's Rest, Wheel Room]
description: Upon the east wall is a large carved wheel from a ship.  The spokes are carved in fanciful representations of sea creatures.  The large bedstead is covered in a thick blue and gold quilt.  A fireplace fills one wall, with a hand carved model of a sailing ship on the mantle.  Wide windows look out over the bay outside.

title: [Captain's Rest, Hallway]
description: Well-polished brass lamps cast light upon the modwir-paneled walls and blue carpeting.  In one corner a large potted plant sits in a brass planter.  Upon the one wall without a door, a collection of cutlasses hangs, ranging in size from a blade small enough for a child to hold, to one so large a giantman would have difficulty holding it.

title: [Captain's Rest, Compass Room]
description: A spacious four poster bed covered with a blue and green comforter sits across from a fireplace.  The mantle of the fireplace seems to be made of a large piece of driftwood.  Upon this mantle sits a highly polished, vultite cased, ship's compass.  A polished oaken table with a mithril inlay of the compass points sits under the open window.

title: [Captain's Rest, Common Room]
description: The age blackened beams and worn floors of this Common Room show the many years this inn has harbored guests.  A long wooden bar sits along the north wall with bottles of every shape and size behind it.  Ships' officers occupy several oaken tables discussing their trade in muted voices.

title: [Captain's Rest, Upstairs Hall]
description: Hanging on the modwir paneled wall, flanked on either side by polished mithril lamps, is a large painting.  It shows two ships locked in battle.  One, a privateer by its flag, appears to be on the verge of sinking.  The details of the fighters and ships are magnificently rendered upon this canvas.

title: [Captain's Rest, Sextant Room]
description: Four chairs with their backs carved in the shape of sea serpents surround a large oak table.  Under glass covering the top of the table is a large chart of the western coast of the continent.  Sitting in the center of the table are a mithril and brass sextant and a polished brass folding telescope.  A bed sits to one side of the room covered with blue and gold bedding.  Upon the walls hang several pictures of famous sailing ships.

title: [Captain's Rest, Upstairs Hall]
description: The green carpeted hall comes to an end here.  A large fishing net with glass floats is draped artfully along the one wall not occupied by a door.  Several pieces of driftwood appear to be stuck in the net.

title: [Captain's Rest, Crows Nest]
description: The walls are paneled in oak for about a height of three feet.  Above that a mural is painted on all four walls simulating looking out over an ocean from a great height.  To the east a few islands are visible in the distance.  On the west wall several dolphins cavort.  The only breaks in the mural are the door and a wide window.  The white gauzy curtains on the window seem to blend into clouds on the mural.  A large bed with a sky blue bedspread sits in one corner.

title: [Captain's Rest, Sail Room]
description: A large four poster bed with white curtains and a white bedspread dominates the room.  The walls are covered in sailcloth, with several pictures of ships at sea breaking up the monotony.  Across the room from the bed is a mithril table with two chairs under a white curtained window looking out over the bay and its busy quays.

title: [Captain's Rest, Upstairs Hall]
description: Polished mithril lamps shed light along the green rug leading to a fel door at the end of the hall.  Across the hall from a linden door, on a small stand, is a twin-masted sailing ship in a clear bottle.  The loving care that went into building this model is evident in all the tiny detail.

title: [Captain's Rest, Chart Room]
description: A large bed covered with a thick blue comforter sits with a beautifully rendered chart of the local coastline hanging over its head.  Several other charts are mounted on the other walls.  A nice view of the bay is visible through a large window framed by blue curtains.  A wooden table with the design of compass points carved in it and blue upholstered chairs with sit under the open window.

title: [Captain's Rest, Sea Chest Room]
description: A large sea chest with an exquisite inlay of pieces of various colored woods giving shape to a fully rigged sailing ship on its lid sits under a wide window overlooking the bay.  Across from the sea chest is a large four poster bed with a green bedspread.  Several pictures of sailing ships cover the walls.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: The floor of the warehouse creaks and groans underfoot.  A thin layer of dust coats everything, and packing straw collects in almost every corner, nook, and crack.  The boxes and crates part to allow passage to the east and north from here.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the north and east.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: The floor of the warehouse creaks and groans underfoot.  A thin layer of dust coats everything, and packing straw collects in almost every corner, nook, and crack.  The boxes and crates part to allow passage to the north and west from here.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the north and west.

title: [Grand Dais, Altar of Crowns]
description: Illuminated by a circular shaft of sunlight blazing through a skylight above, the high altar is a tapered block of golvern draped by snow-pure silk.  Interlocking circles and arcs of gold inlay cleave the marble floor, spreading from the altar like ripples across a pond.

Pooling moonlight trickles through a skylight above, its feeble radiance catching on the edges of the high altar.  The tapered block of golvern is draped in snow-pure silk.  Interlocking circles and arcs of gold inlay cleave the marble floor, spreading from the altar like ripples across a pond.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: Boxes bearing stamps from virtually everywhere are stacked to dangerous heights in a seemingly haphazard manner.  The boxes have been pushed aside here, making room to proceed both north and south.  To the east, a curtain occludes a small alcove.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: Boxes bearing stamps from virtually everywhere are stacked to dangerous heights in a seemingly haphazard manner.  The boxes have been pushed aside here, making room to proceed both north and south.  To the east, a curtained opening occludes a small alcove.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the north, east, and west.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: This tight, north-south hallway is dark and dank.  Musty smells from the warehouse below waft up though obvious gaps in the floorboards.  Sawdust and discarded bent nails litter the floors.

title: [Cafe Dumont]
description: The tile on the floor gradually changes over from an off-white sandstone to a floral-patterned white sandstone.  Several benches and comfy-looking chairs are positioned throughout the room to provide patrons of the cafe a relaxing place to rest and have a drink.  A domed stained glass skylight and several windows allow the soft glow of the moons to enter the cafe.

The tile on the floor gradually changes over from an off-white sandstone to a floral-patterned white sandstone.  Several benches and comfy-looking chairs are positioned throughout the room to provide patrons of the cafe a relaxing place to rest and have a drink.  A domed stained glass skylight and several windows allow the warm rays of the sun to enter the cafe.

title: [Cafe Dumont, Patio]
description: A short, latticework iron fence encloses the patio, entwined with several rose bushes and jasmine vines that grow along its length.  The perfume of the flowers dance through the air, mingling with the salty scent of the nearby bay.  A few tables and cushioned chairs are scattered throughout the patio in little groups, offering room for many patrons to have pleasant conversation and respite.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Court]
description: Diminutive bergamot trees spring from the soft ground, graduating to the shady, abundant forms of aromatic faewood trees.  A hazy mist lingers around the silvery tree trunks, obscuring what lies beyond their lush foliage.  The verdant grove canopies the greenwood below with fully outstretched branches.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Pond]
description: The dense crowns of hawthorn trees back the area in variegated green-swept tones that contrast with the paler grasses blanketing the ground.  Twin brooks flow at opposite bends, pooling together in a shallow pond filled with tall spires of water chestnut.  A section of the bank is overgrown with velvety creeping mosses, offering a entreating alcove for reflection.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Woodland]
description: Striking viridian trefoil splays spiny white flower-heads that loll from bowed stems.  Trampled umbrage defines a northerly pathway that winds crookedly through myriad downcast branches.  Antiquated faewood roots have curled and pulled upward from the surface of the earth, looping together in tangled knots.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Thicket]
description: A flock of vibrant copper trumpetvines climb a thicket of dried branches that are strewn on matted sward.  Occasionally, a shiver from the leafy coverlet overhead drops a stray faewood fruit that lazily bounces across the miry terrain.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Hillside]
description: Spills of emerald green angelica and valerian caper down a hillside, flowering with lace-like ivory crests.  Tender seedlings sprout from the dark soil that divides established herbage.  Somewhere nearby, flowing waters murmur a quiet accompaniment for the delicately trilling songbirds.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Highwalk]
description: Sheltered from the radiance of the clerestory windows by an overhang of carved marble, the highwalk rises over the rear portion of the prayer plaza.  Banners of forest green silk unfurl from the overhang, each embroidered with the stylized image of a graceful white swan.

Sheltered from the moonlit radiance of the clerestory windows by an overhang of carved marble, the highwalk rises over the rear portion of the prayer plaza.  Banners of forest green silk unfurl from the overhang, each embroidered with the stylized image of a graceful white swan.

title: [Prelate's Quarters, Antechamber]
description: Framed by seamless walls of gold-veined white marble, the antechamber is well-appointed but modest.  Sunlight filters in from a mullioned glass window in the northern wall, forming golden puddles on a woven spidersilk rug.  An oaken coatrack stands beside a white illthorn door leading out to the temple.

Framed by seamless walls of gold-veined white marble, the antechamber is well-appointed but modest.  Moonlight filters in from a mullioned glass window in the northern wall, forming golden puddles on a woven spidersilk rug.  An oaken coatrack stands beside a white illthorn door leading out to the temple.

title: [Hall of Colonnades]
description: Dominating the room is a multi-tiered ivory dais channeled with a fluted marble colonnade and ornately gilt capitals.  Small beams of sunlight stream through the panes of stained glass windows that are inset into the gabled ceiling.  Lying in the center of the room, a round tasseled carpet portrays a golden scroll in the center of a silvery mist.

Dominating the room is a multi-tiered ivory dais channeled with a fluted marble colonnade and ornately gilt capitals.  Small beams of moonlight stream through the panes of stained glass windows that are inset into the gabled ceiling.  Lying in the center of the room, a round tasseled carpet portrays a golden scroll in the center of a silvery mist.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Rowan Copse]
description: The supple earth underfoot slopes downward into a low-set copse bordered by a circle of flourishing rowan trees.  Weedy grey-green grasses reveal silvery overtones as they undulate in a light breeze, revealing a glimpse of orange-blushed pomes cradled within.  At the center of the ring, a bed of sweet-scented heliotrope surrounds a carved modwir altar.

title: [Garden of Making]
description: Shaded by the willowy bulks of linden trees, the enclosed glade is dark and choked with primal greenery.  Mimicking the rising trees, a series of spiraling metal constructs rises from the verdant earth, forming a rough circle that guards the stunted form of a thriving faewood tree.

Shaded by the willowy bulks of linden trees, the enclosed glade is dark and choked with primal greenery.  Mimicking the rising trees, a series of spiraling metal constructs rises from the verdant earth, forming a rough circle that guards the stunted form of a charred faewood tree.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Harvest's Vigil]
description: The grouping of linden trees meanders away at a sharp turn, leading to a hearty bed of pennyroyal and Imaera's lace.  Standing watch over the area is an immense pear tree, with heavily drooping side branches that yield speckled yellow-green fruits.   An uneven dirt path winds through short jade-hued grasses, ending before an oak and emerald reliquary cloistered within a second cropping of flowers.

title: [River Tower West, Pay Master]
description: The first level of the tower is lit by torches mounted into the log walls.  The dirt floor has been packed down by years of human traffic.  A long table, covered with tariff payment vouchers, is set to one side.  A cache of weaponry is stored here for the defense of the city.

title: [Temple of Industry, Jetspire]
description: The iron-shot granite walkway encircles a towering black glaes crystal that juts from the earth like an angry black talon.  Bordered to the west by the beginnings of wild greenery and to the east by an unforgiving, craggy landscape, the spire marks an otherwise invisible boundary.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Courtyard]
description: The great ring of yews wind their way around to the north.  The landscapers have taken great care to stagger their growth, from tallest in the north near the tower, to smallest in the south by the gate.  It is almost as if they were telling a story of time and life, slowly growing and maturing as they lead the way to the temple.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Courtyard]
description: Yew saplings crisply define the exterior edges of the path here.  Closer to the gate entrance are stalks just barely the size of a halfling wrist, while the trunks closer to the north are thicker than a giant.  The care with which these trees are pruned suggest the fanatical devotion of the temple followers.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Entrance]
description: The eldest of the yews here have grown into a great canopy, almost blotting out the sky.  Great shadows play through their branches, dancing over the tower steps.  The dim lights on the rough exterior walls give a very somber tone to the entrance here.  A small path parts the wall of foliage, carrying the faint sound of trickling water.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Nave]
description: The somber entranceway is poorly lit, leaving large shadows to consume the room corners.  A far wall is lined with boots and sandals, probably left by worshippers paying proper respect to the temple.  Small pegs are provided for visitors to leave their cloaks at the door.  You snatch a quick glimpse of a monk in a dark gray robe scurrying into the main temple.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Great Hall]
description: The great hall of the temple vaults about your head.  The soft shuffle of feet whisper gentle prayers to the gods. Here and there decorative niches hold sculptures depicting great mages and prophets.  To the north you glimpse the heart of the temple, the main worshiping chamber, and above you an ornate double stairway curves upward to a balcony overlook.  Beneath the stairs the hall slopes up, curving around the central chamber.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Balcony]
description: The air is thicker up here, hazy with incense and smoke.  The movement of worshipers below in the great hall meld with the spiraling mosaic pattern on the floor.  From this vantage you can see the monks performing acts of devotion in the main chamber of the temple, and the occasional visitor approaching the altar to leave a few silvers in donation.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Hall of Time]
description: The passage here ascends slowly, hugging the interior walls.  The whole hall has been decorated in a continuous fresco.  The first few feet are nothing but blackness, but as the slope rises great hideous winged beasts emerge from the darkness.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Hall of Time]
description: The frescos have been painted by masterful hands, and surely this work could not have been completed in one artisan's lifetime.  A new element has been introduced into the motif of a large hole, or tear in the sky.  From it pours thousands of monstrous creations, of the like which you have never seen.  Further down the hall you see the imagery of a tremendous battle, and the final outcome of a barren wasteland.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Hall of Time]
description: The wall paintings show the barren lands giving way to familiar figures, forming and shaping the lands, and recreating the world in their own image.  The figures seem to be grouped into two sides of this passage, one depicted in warm lush tones, the other in darker more muted colors.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Hall of Time]
description: As the passage curves around you see groups of elves building great cities and knowledge.  Sylphs, dwarves, halflings and humans are also introduced into the composition for the first time.  Great societies are shown flourishing under the watchful eyes of the gods.  Yet as the hall slopes upwards, there seems to be a splitting of the harmony, as different groups are blocking themselves off from one another.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Hall of Time]
description: The fresco takes a dark turn here, and the paintings are worked with horrific detail.  A dark woman stands atop a ledge summoning hoards of undead while clutching a tattered tome to her chest.  The armies lay waste to lands and cities, slaying all in their path.  It is at the far corner of the hallway that you glimpse a small group of elves summoning a horrific magic upon a devastated keep.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Hall of Time]
description: The pictures of war continue here, but not nearly to the degree of the lower levels.  Elves with skin as pitch as coal battle elves on mighty ships, dwarves and giantkin wage fierce battles in the foothills, and large gorilla-like beasts stampede towns with merciless force.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Hall of Time]
description: It does not seem as if you could climb any higher, yet the hall continues.  Strangely the frescos seem to have been left unfinished.  There is the outline of a great army just sketched into the fresh plaster here, but no hint of the tools or craftsmen that are working on them.  Certainly this can not be all there is to this masterpiece.

title: [Heart of the Temple]
description: Large brass pillars surround this central chamber, reaching up to the high vaulted ceiling.  Intricate mosaics decorate the floor with a complex spiraling pattern.  Numerous monks sit in quiet prayer, entranced by the thick incense floating skyward.  In the center of the room stands a raised dais supporting an intricate altar, and above you glimpse several worshippers peering down over the balcony.

title: [Temple of Jastev, High Altar]
description: The gray stone altar seems very plain in comparison to the rest of the temple.  Small offerings have been left on top to help with the daily costs and maintenance.  While all are welcome to approach the altar to show their devotion, this is probably not the proper place to dally or converse.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Chamber]
description: These dim chambers serve as the private offices of the temple's monks.  Dark gray robes hang limply from tarnished brass hooks fixed to the wall.  A small urn burns some relaxing incense in the far corner.  The only luxuries are a hard wooden bench running the distance of the far wall, and a simple wooden table.  Near the back of the chamber sits a small wooden staircase.

Lurking beyond a brass crested arch, the dim chamber serves as a sanctum for the monks of the temple.  Violet-hemmed grey robes hang limply from a series of tarnished brass hooks affixed to the western wall.  Within a small crystal urn in the far corner, some grey-green wormwood incense incense burns and fills the air with its cloying scent.  Near the back of the chamber sits a small wooden staircase.

title: [Chamber of Prophecy]
description: The stillness here is eerie.  The walls and floor are composed of highly polished brass reflecting upon itself and playing tricks with your eyes.  In the center of the room stands an ornately carved brass bracket, supporting a perfect silver sphere.  This does not seem like that type of place one would want to be caught by the monks.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, West Alcove]
description: Along the curved wall of this crescent-shaped room, a panoramic image of a furious battle has been frescoed from floor to ceiling.  Across the room, paned windows allow sunlight to cascade across the scene, adding depth and movement, as if the images were alive.

Along the curved wall of this crescent-shaped room, a panoramic image of a furious battle has been frescoed from floor to ceiling.  Across the room, paned windows allow moonlight to cascade across the scene, adding depth and movement, as if the images were alive.

title: [Fasthr's Lance, Crown]
description: Raised high above the green hillock that Fasthr's Lance occupies, the crenellated tower rooftop facilitates a panoramic view of Solhaven and Cairnfang Bay.  Incised shield patterns mark the top of each crenellation.  Striking yet higher, a dark ora lance hoisting a black ensign stitched with a snow-white shield proclaims the tower's allegiance.

description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, and light filters in through a large horizontal notch cut into the northern wall, a ballista aligned in front of it.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a grouping of arrow slits surround the central horizontal window.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Courtyard]
description: A stand of oaks, stark and grey-limbed but bejeweled with scores of diamond blue icicles, shelters a small fountain and the pond that it feeds.  Lifeless beneath the glaze of ice and rime, the fountain awaits the resurrection of spring.  The main walkway continues southeast toward the peak-roofed silhouette of the temple, but a narrower walk splits off and heads south through the snowbanks.

title: [Temple, Garden of Silence]
description: Creeping ivy spreads across the dappled granite that makes up the temple walls enclosing this peaceful little garden, where small patches of lilies of the valley add a faint touch of brightness to the silent grey-green surroundings.  An ancient yew tree, its huge trunk gnarled and bent over a curved stone bench, stretches its limbs across the enclosed courtyard.  Its tapered leaves shift and seem to rustle in the errant currents of wind, but there is no sound, nor any sound of birds or buzzing insects.

title: [Memorial Garden, Fools' Corner]
description: Flanked by twin statues of Cholen, this stretch of the path leads through a crowd of small, white marble markers, each bearing an inscription.

title: [Memorial Garden, Monument]
description: Set beneath the ancient gaze of several gnarled oak trees, this small section of the garden houses a somber, still feeling that pervades the chilly air.  Numerous rows of simple granite markers are set into the ground, and a small granite obelisk pierces the surroundings with its tall spire.  Snow dusts the grass lightly, the errant currents of winds sending it in a soft, mournful dance before it settles once again.

title: [Small Airship]
description: A small arched door leads in to a small cabin located on-deck, its roof traced with twining patterns of stone-grey ivy carvings.  A short distance away, the sharp drop of the stern is guarded by curving railings of ornate design, and specks of silvery-bluish light peek from underneath the ship from the many scales of pure veniom plating its underside.

title: [Small Airship, Cabin]
description: A large window bordered with crimson eahnor allows an unfettered view of the surroundings on nearly all sides - the massive bow of the ship being directly in front of you.  A large pattern is inscribed upon the mute grey wood of the deck, the contours of the silver coalescing into an arcane design.  A semi-circle of comfortable velvet cushions surrounds a translucent dome set into the center of the design, its surface humming faintly with power.

title: [Small Airship, Below Deck]
description: The small winding staircase comes to an end here, revealing the luxurious, spacy room that spreads out before you.  A low-set maoral table stands in the middle of the room, its reflective surface mirroring the gentle wind-like patterns incised upon the walls.  Soft crimson carpets hide nearly all of the lustrous grey wood, their dark tones matching the curving contours of the dark velvet couch set before the table.

title: [Courtyard of Remembrance]
description: Alabaster walls crafted of decorative marble provide a short divider that encases the small cobblestone courtyard, secluding it from the rest of the temple's grounds.  Four black marble benches are poised at cardinal points of a compass rose painted in gold upon the ground, and at its center is a pedestal topped with an oversized golden blown-glass orb.  The only plants that mar the stark serenity of the area are flowers left at key points against the decorative walls.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Courtyard]
description: The steep pitch and low eaves of its white tile roof make the Temple of Lorminstra appear to almost grow out of the snowbanks of the winter tableau that surrounds it, and the temple's black basalt walls seem to recede into the shadows, adding to the effect.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Entry]
description: Oil lamps topped by frosted glaes globes hang from the vaulted ceiling, casting a soft golden radiance that is quickly devoured by the dull black basalt of the entry's floor, walls and ceiling.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Hallway]
description: The white robes of the priestesses and the pearl grey habits of the mendicants drift like benign spectres against the limitless black of the temple's walls and floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Hallway]
description: Just southeast of the hallway's bend, a crimson velvet curtain fills a doorway in the corridor's northeast wall.

title: [Chamber of Sacrifice]
description: The rough cut basalt blocks that form the walls of this small chamber seem to soak up the light, leaving nothing for your eyes to settle on except the large, crimson cloisonne brazier in the center of the room and the square of open sky above.  A brassbound felwood torch burns steadily in a gold wall bracket to the right of the brazier, and a crimson leather oilskin set with small gold keys hangs from a hook below the torch.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Hallway]
description: A golden light is just visible to the southeast, the only apparent goal in this corridor of darkness and moon-like spheres.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Hallway]
description: A pair of mendicants stand to either side of the hall, chanting softly and gently swinging censers from side to side.  Pale gold bands along the sleeves of their habits flash and fade in the hallway's subdued lighting in time with their movements.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Chamber]
description: A small chamber stretches north from the door, its deep black walls resembling a starless midnight sky.  Against the north wall rests a white marble dais, the brightly glowing stone a beacon of light in the dark surroundings.  A few candles burn in the room, and a silence fills the chamber like a fog.  An ancient wooden stand is positioned upon the dais, a field of translucent, crackling mana completely encasing the silver chalice that rests atop it.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Hallway]
description: Barely discernable in the dimly lit blackness, two hallways intersect here.  The main northwest-southeast hall is crossed by one running at right angles to it, but just southeast of the intersection the main hallway opens out into a brightly lit nave.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Hallway]
description: The hallway makes a 90 degree bend here.  A small brass lamp hanging from a chain illuminates the corridor's turning and a small door in the southwest wall.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Courtyard]
description: A high, snow-covered hedge screens this area from the memorial garden to the west, and a flagstone path stretches from the temple to a two-storied building in the courtyard's southeast corner.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Hallway]
description: A polished ebon door set with golden hinges and a golden latch fills the end of the corridor.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Chamber]
description: Reflected in the chamber's polished jet floor tiles, a fel-inlaid haon desk takes up about a third of the room.  The Lady High Intercessor of Solhaven's Temple of Lorminstra is seated behind the desk, the mitre on her head, and the shoulders and sleeves of her robes, bedecked with gold symbols of ecclesiastical office.  Several scrolls lie partially unrolled on the desk before her, and a gold filigree inkwell and matching sand shaker stand to one side along with a pair of quills.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Courtyard]
description: Hidden from the public eye by the temple and high hedges, garden plots border the path beneath the night sky.  The pretext of perpetual winter has been allowed to lapse in this confined area where Lorminstra's servants engage in the more mundane activities of everyday life.

Hidden from the public eye by the temple and high hedges, a priestess wearing a coarse-woven, shorter version of her clerical garb labors in a garden plot to one side of the path.  The pretext of perpetual winter has been allowed to lapse in this confined area where Lorminstra's servants engage in the more mundane activities of everyday life.

title: [Temple of Lorminstra, Courtyard]
description: Decorated in the same faux winter setting as the rest of the temple courtyard, the building nestled in the corner of the compound is half-timbered and set with numerous evenly spaced small windows.  It appears likely that it is a residence hall for the temple's clergy.

title: [Clergy Hall, Common Room]
description: Priestesses and monks exchange greetings and mingle in the residence hall's common room.  A pair of long tables with attached benches run most of the width of the room, serving as dining or work tables as the needs of the clergy dictate.

title: [Clergy Hall, Storeroom]
description: Leather sacks are stacked high against one wall, the words -- POWDERED GLAES -- and -- BORTHUM MINING CO -- stenciled in block letters across the sides of two open sacks resting on the floor.  Long-handled sifters and rakes hang from pegs opposite the door.

title: [Clergy Hall, Corridor]
description: Doors face each other across the hallway, a half-dozen total down the length of the corridor.  Small windows set high in the center of each door soften their otherwise austere appearance.

title: [Clergy Hall, Corridor]
description: The whitewashed walls of the hallway continue, a door set into each of them, opposite each other on both the right and the left.

title: [Clergy Hall, Corridor]
description: Starlight shines through the multi-paned window at the end of the corridor, brightening the hallway for the inhabitants of the last two cells, placed one next to the other against the far wall.
Daylight shines through the multi-paned window at the end of the corridor, brightening the hallway for the inhabitants of the last two cells, placed one next to the other against the far wall.

title: [Small Airship]
description: The sharp sides of a small cabin on deck loom nearby, casting a slight shadow on this side of the ship.  The deck holds an immaculate polish, the grain of its deep grey wood coated with a flawless shine.  Several curved silver charms hang from the roof of the small cabin nearby, the wind occasionally causing them to clang against one another to produce a beautiful cascade of melodic tones.

title: [Small Airship]
description: Trailing designs of creeping stone ivy decorate the walls of a small cabin located on-deck, and triangular windows trimmed in ornate crimson eahnor allow one to gaze unhindered at the surroundings from within.  Well-polished mahogany railings guard against any plunge below, their surfaces chased with delicate, twining patterns of mute green-grey hue.

title: [Small Airship, Bow]
description: The two decks converge here to form the narrow point of the bow, and below glittering scales of veniom sparkle with a silvery-blue light of their own.  The sky spreads unhindered for miles around you, and a massive bowsprit extends from beyond the uppermost point of the deck - its surfaced wrapped in ornate designs of dark green ivy.  The deep grey deck curves gently to either side, its fine glossy finish still glinting with reflected light.

title: [Small Airship]
description: Veins of pale grey creep along the walls of a small cabin on deck, resembling slivers of quicksilver eternally slithering across the deep grey wood as light traverses their warped surfaces.  The railing curves slightly here as it approaches the sharp contours of the bow just a short distance away.

title: [Small Airship, Bar]
description: A small bar takes up the end of the cabin, its top crafted of a sleek, highly-polished black marble.  Above, a large emblem bears the image of an ancient willow tree, its silhouette adding a touch of somber elegance to the area.  Several plush crimson velvet couches are placed along the sides of the cabin, and small tables for two are spaced evenly at its center.

title: [Small Airship, Kitchen]
description: Soft amber light drifts down from above from several silver-chained dark-paned oil lamps, their diffused light traveling in gentle waves across the cozy surroundings.  A small but suitable hearth has been crafted out of the far southern wall, and large, functional counters of wood are heaped with fresh vegetables and a variety of herbs.  Simple black iron pots dangle from hooks above, clanking together gently once in a while to form a slow, rhythmic melody.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Water Reeds]
description: The path curves around the boggy edge of Moonlight Pool, its edge marked by tall water reeds.  Bull frogs and lesser amphibians sing a mixed chorus from the protection of the grasses.  Cottages built along the curved bank sit contemplating the mirror-like surface of the water, dotted intermittently with loons swimming at the far end.

title: [Palatial Gardens, Gazebo Bower]
description: The path is lined with solid, white stepping stones that stand in vivid contrast against the verdant green carpet of grass.  Thick clusters of flowering trumpet vines reach toward the skies as they cling to the high stone wall that surrounds the gardens.  Beneath a copse of shade trees, a circular gazebo stands with fluted white marble columns and a glistening gold tiled roof, providing a quiet niche for prayer and contemplation.

title: [Stone Gazebo, Quiet Retreat]
description: A small rosewood bench rests in the center of the stone platform.  Dangling from a slender brass chain, a glaesine-paned lantern flickers softly with candlelight.  Several ivory tiles, each accented with a golden globe, are inset into the floor to provide focal points for meditation.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Pool of Thought]
description: Parallel rows of benches face a large pool edged in white stone.  The pool's design is graceful and pleasing to the eye.  Marble steps surround it, offering different views of its eloquent nuances.  On the armrest of each bench is carved a sphere, the deft carvings accented in gold leaf.  Overhead, on the high, arched ceiling, the image of an ebon drake spreads its wings.  At each corner of the chamber rests a globe astride a carved marble column.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Corridor]
description: Ivory sconces house flickering beeswax candles that cast an unsteady light into the narrow corridor.  Resting on each end of a long rosewood table, smoking brass censers emit the heady scent of myrrh and sandalwood into the air.  Running the length of the hallway, a thick rug, embroidered with threads of blue, teal and gold, quiets each footstep.

title: [Sanctuary of Journey]
description: Towering columns stand sentry, surrounding a large rotunda.  On an entablature above, a sculpted frieze displays a journey of trials, sorrows and victories.  Steeply angled gold-flecked blue marble steps, in the center of the room, lead to a massive free-standing altar at the summit.

title: [Altar of Illumination]
description: Resting on a tiered platform covered in relief work, an impressive altar of mountain-quarried stone stands in the middle of the chamber.  Blue granite spheres sit on each of the main compass points.  Within each banded globe is a flame, constant and resolute.  A vast, carved scroll floats above the altar, offering no clue as to the source of its suspension.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Vestry]
description: Suspsended from the ceiling, a wrought iron chandelier dimly lights the archway with its soft, evocative light.  Clerical robes and vestments hang from brass hooks lining the walls on both sides.  Several pairs of leather sandals rest on a low wooden rack on the floor.  A small prayer book has been left, perhaps forgotten, on the rack with the humble sandals.

title: [Chamber of Vestments]
description: Spanning the rear wall are cabinets filled with neatly folded vestments and shelves lined with leather-bound books.  A solid oak prie-dieu stands in one corner for prayer and meditation, while a simple cotton-tufted pallet lies on the floor for needed rest.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Feast of Light]
description: A mahogany banquet table stretches nearly from wall to wall, embellished with polished mithril tableware and fine crystal goblets.  Matching high-back chairs rest in front of each place setting, and at the head of the table, an unusually grand seat is embellished in gold filigree.  At each end of the table, an elegant candelabra with tall branching arms bathes the room with candlelight.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Temple, Right Hand Way]
description: A narrow slitted window rises high on the western wall, rays of sparkling sunlight filtering through to lend an ethereal glow to the room.  The gracefully arched wings of a genderless statue set in front of the window cast faint shadows across the brightly-lit chamber, and the figure's face bears no sign of emotion.  A pale granite arch opens in the east wall, while a small alcove to the south leads to a well-lit chamber.

The gracefully arched wings of a genderless statue set in front of the window cast faint shadows across the brightly-lit chamber, and the figure's face bears no sign of emotion.  A pale granite arch opens in the east wall, while a small alcove to the south leads to a well-lit chamber.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Morning Alcove]
description: Hanging across the rear wall of the alcove, a heavy tapestry woven in vibrantly rich colors is illuminated by the filtered light from an arched glaesine window.  It displays a panorama, a vista that shows an immense range of mountains, with deep dells and resplendent waterfalls overseen by vast and lordly peaks.  Overhead, the ceiling is marked with the pattern of immense wings.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Gallery]
description: Dangling from long, slender chains, frosted luminaries dispense a soft golden glow throughout the narrow corridor.  Along the stone walls, oil paintings of regal quality are lined up side by side in succession, each telling its own story.

title: [Pasha's Pavilion, West]
description: Minimal light filters through the tiny clerestory windows at the base of the squat, semi-circular dome above.  The red and orange swirl-patterned tile floor blends into a continuous alternating design of blue and ivory chevrons, just a few feet from the archway leading east.  Four rows of ivory columns fill the area, ending at a broad patchwork yierka-hide curtain across the back wall.  In the center of the room is a long buffet table, containing a variety of desserts.

Torchlight streams down, set near the clerestory windows at the base of the squat, semi-circular dome above.  The red and orange swirl-patterned tile floor blends into a continuous alternating design of blue and ivory chevrons, just a few feet from the archway leading east.  Four rows of ivory columns fill the area, ending at a broad patchwork yierka-hide curtain across the back wall.  In the center of the room is a long buffet table, containing a variety of desserts.

title: [Public Baths, Arch]
description: A marble arch leads further westward, its deep black surface polished to a lustrous shine and topped with a large lion cast from gold, its mouth open in a proud, eternal roar.  Thick knotwork patterns of the same bright hue run down along the borders of the handsome structure, stopping at its base.  Three circular mosaics adorn the floor, depicting eagles in flight, warhorses, and stags in strong, vibrant colors.

title: [Public Baths, Arch]
description: Candles line the walls, each ensconced within recessed niches that allows their soft light to fill the room with a warm, wavering glow.  Fanciful mosaics span the gaps between the niches, depicting scenes of nature and other whimsical artistic musings.  Delicate trails of emerald ivy tangle around an ivory arch to the east, interspersed with carved roses and other beautiful flowers.

title: [Public Baths, Hall]
description: Rich geometric mosaics of varying colors arc across the high vaulted ceiling of this long hallway, cloaked in soft muted shades by the golden oil lamps hung throughout the room.  Black tapestries trimmed with dark green silk billow gently between the thick ivory columns aligned in neatly ordered rows.  Interweaving patterns of gold are inlaid into the pure white floor, forming a myriad of ornate shapes with its graceful, arcing loops.

title: [Public Baths, Hall]
description: An elegant grey marble arch opens up the northern wall, its surface swept with whirling, opalescent patterns of pearly white vaalin.  An elaborate mosaic of a huge willow tree is set upon the floor, its sagging boughs and thin vines reaching the edge of the room.  Pale mistwood has been inlaid around the design in a thick knotwork border, the rich varnish bringing out its dark muted hues perfectly.  Ivory columns flank the arch, their rounded forms swirled with an intricate spiral of golden leaves.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: White limestone mixes with the tower's dark foundation from its base to its crown and is a marked sign of renovation to the ancient premises.  Against the outer wall, a stone stairway spirals upward towards four landings and is wrapped by dark ebonwood banisters.  Above the stairway, daylight trickles across the eight crenellated points, outlining new and old stone work, some of which glints with foreign metal.

White limestone mixes with the tower's dark foundation from its base to its crown and is a marked sign of renovation to the ancient premises.  Against the outer wall, a stone stairway spirals upward, its course illuminated by bracketed torches and interrupted by four landings.  Above the stairway, the roof of the tower has been removed to expose the night sky and all eight crenellated points have been repaired.

title: [Fane of the God-King, Shrine]
description: Nestled between a halo of blossoming lilies and the bright wall of the compound is an altar of roughly carved stone, the space before it littered with offerings.  Grass grows green and tall behind the tiny shrine, but the area leading up to it is worn down to dark earth.

title: [Temple of Koar, Narthex West]
description: Culminating in an alcove, the western end of the high-ceilinged narthex centers around a sculpture of polished brass.  Set atop a mosaic-tiled dais, the statue is many times taller than a living man.  Candles set in alcoves about the room lend their unified light to the metal, setting it brightly aglow.

title: [Temple of Koar, Narthex East]
description: Candle flames dance in myriad alcoves spaced about the curved eastern end of the narthex.  Beneath a ceiling patterned in gold-inlaid white birch stands the polished sculpture of a scholarly man just past his middle years.  Lit from behind, the statue casts a long shadow down the large, high-ceilinged hall.

title: [Faeilythe's Fashions, Entryway]
description: Pale mistwood walls are polished to a fine sheen, bringing out the deeper grey of the burls and knots of the wood.  White-painted oak frames the front double windows and the door, each inset with diamond-paned clear glaes, letting in beams of brilliant sunlight.  A passageway to the north side of the shop leads out to a garden portico.

Pale mistwood walls are polished to a fine sheen, bringing out the deeper grey of the burls and knots of the wood.  White-painted oak frames the front double windows and the door, each inset with diamond-paned clear glaes, letting in beams of soft moonlight.  Oil lamp torches light a passageway to the north side of the shop, leading out to a garden portico.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest, out

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Crystal Stair]
description: A south-climbing white stone staircase ascends into a low portion of the ceiling through an arch studded with cabochon crystals.  Standing guard before the high-rising steps are a pair of blazing brass braziers.  Multi-toned gold carpeting proceeds underfoot, shot through with crown patterns in deep bronze hues.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, West]
description: Large silk cushions in alternating shades of white and yellow are spaced evenly across the marble floor.  Overhead, the illuminated ceiling depicts the sinuous body of a golden drake, yearning jaws striving for its own tail.  Between a pair of marble pillars supporting a banistered balcony, a patterned velvet carpet proceeds toward an ora-bound honey oak door.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, West Stairwell]
description: Walls of textured stone encircle the pale marble stairwell at the center of the room, which climbs into a gap in the ceiling.  Glowing steadily, a phosphorescent orb crowning a wrought brass sconce lends soft light to the chamber.

title: [Faeilythe's Fashions, Portico]
description: Limestone has been carved into rectangular blocks and stacked to enclose this garden, with several small arched openings set about mid-height into the walls.  Each of the cut-out niches holds a lush flowering plant and affords a tiny glimpse beyond, into the back alley and yards of neighboring buildings.  Several mistwood columns support a latticework covering overhead, from which drapes thick clusters of fragrant wisteria, attracting honeybees dancing amid the filtered sunlight beams.

Limestone has been carved into rectangular blocks and stacked to enclose this garden, with several small arched openings set about mid-height into the walls.  Each of the cut-out niches holds a lush flowering plant and affords a tiny glimpse beyond, into the back alley and yards of neighboring buildings.  Several mistwood columns support a latticework covering overhead, from which drapes thick clusters of fragrant wisteria, and which patterns the slate patio with a moonlit checkerboard.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, East]
description: Overseen by a gold-banistered raised walkway, the eastern portion of the plaza is a sea of gold and white cushions.  The evenly spaced seating allows for a carpeted aisle leading up to an ora-bound honey oak door in the stone wall.  Worked in intricate detail, the illuminated dome above depicts an elderly figure with a flowing white beard, his bearing still powerful despite the weight of years.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, East Stairwell]
description: Gently lit by a phosphorescent orb set into the ceiling, the small chamber centers around a gilt-trimmed pale marble stairwell.  Walls of textured marble encircle the room, broken only by an ora-bound honey oak door.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Font of Purity]
description: The watchful eyes of a heroic crowned figure stare down from above, casting their gaze upon a tiered fountain fashioned in the shape of a rearing dragon.  Beyond the statue, a golden stairway marches up a steep incline to the dais.  Incised crowns adorn the ashen marble tiles of the floor.

title: [Faeilythe's Fashions, Footwear]
description: Left slightly ajar, the paned double window allows the fragrant scent of the wisteria framing the cottage to drift in on the warm daytime breeze.  Petals of purple and white occasionally flutter to the floor and onto the furnishings, prompting the clerks to scurry over with their tiny pocket brooms.

Left slightly ajar, the paned double window allows the fragrant scent of the wisteria framing the cottage to drift in on the balmy night air.  Moonlight softly illuminates the fine fashions displayed, to a background of soft music and merry laughter heard on the gentle wind.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Highwalk]
description: Stones in alternating patterns of ivory and snow white marble form a walkway held aloft by crystalline pillars and protected by a banister of twisted gold.  Bas-relief carvings of ornate crowns adorn the rear wall of the temple, which curves to follow the path of the highwalk.  Below, the plaza is a sea of bright stone punctuated by metallic-hued carpets and evenly spaced cushions in alternating hues.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Highwalk]
description: Packed with stone benches, the stone steps leading to the back wall are framed by a bas-relief of a broken circlet full of shattered jewels.  The highwalk curves before the lowest seats, its view of the plaza and dais below obscured only by the occasional column supporting the walk's marble overhang.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Highwalk]
description: Large cushioned stone seats form a semicircle atop the ascending steps bordering the highwalk.  A nearby honeywood cart adorned with gilt boasts several refreshments.  Placed higher than the swan-marked pennants of emerald silk suspended from the overhang above, a golden sunburst on a field of crimson hangs at the apex of the walk's curve.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Highwalk]
description: The highwalk runs past a series of stone benches set upon steps climbing to the back wall of the temple.  Runners of verdigris silk, bordered by fleecy designs in white lace, shield the stones of the walkway.

title: [Grand Dais, Eye of the Empress]
description: Standing guard beside an amber-inlaid white illthorn door is the tall bronze statue of an armed woman, her features striking but far from beautiful.  Behind her stone dais, an illuminated scene of battle rages on in a clash of metallic golds and livid reds, the painting curving to follow the statue's small enclave.

title: [Faeilythe's Fashions, Cloaks]
description: Diamond-paned glaes windows afford a view of the busy sunlit street, and the passersby occasionally stopping to gaze at the wares arranged here.  Garments have been arranged on a variety of displays, some draped with accessories for that extra flair.

Diamond-paned glaes windows afford a view of the quiet evening street, and the rare passersby stopping to gaze at the wares arranged here.  Garments have been arranged on a variety of displays, some draped with accessories for that extra flair.

title: [Prelate's Quarters, Library]
description: Shelves packed with books line the walls of the octagonal chamber, alternating with racks full of scroll tubes.  Sitting before one of the bookshelves is a bronze-bound aged ivory chest.

title: [Prelate's Quarters, Office]
description: Dominated by a glass-topped desk of silvery modwir, the chamber is small and relatively unadorned.  A single chair of matching make sits before the desk.  Banners of lustrous white cloth hang from the ceiling, softening the harshness of the stone walls.

title: [Venquinor House, Balcony]
description: A braided bronze railing guards the edges of the wooden balcony, which is separated from the rest of the sanctum by a painted paper screen and a series of short steps that provide the balcony proper with sufficient elevation to see over Vornavis's western wall.  Resplendent in the sunlight, the graceful city spreads beyond the dark stone barrier.

A braided bronze railing guards the edges of the wooden balcony, which is separated from the rest of the sanctum by a painted paper screen and a series of short steps that provide the balcony proper with sufficient elevation to see over Vornavis's western wall.  Slumbering in the pale moonlight, the graceful city spreads beyond the dark stone barrier.

title: [Cleric Guild, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel stretches on, the sharp incline coming to a stop here.  A chill hangs in the air like a fog, and pale shifting blue light filters in from the north.  The ripples play along the walls in gentle patterns, softly flickering in and out of sight from time to time.  Seashells of many varieties line the path here, each lovingly polished to a lustrous shine.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shrine]
description: Formed from the surrounding stone, the rounded walls and slightly cramped ceiling of this tiny chamber drip quietly with collecting condensation.  Rows of flickering candles resting on natural ledges cast a warm light throughout the room, softly illuminating a statue of a young girl rising fluidly up from waves of carved rock upon the southern wall.  Ensconced by the perpetually frozen waves is a shallow pool, continually fed by the sea below.

title: [Watchtower, Commons]
description: Various benches are set about the room, their expanses covered with repair and polish kits, while curved chairs sport neatly folded woolen blankets in a shade of royal blue.  Standing at opposite ends of the room are two nearly identical doors, differing only in the grain of wood of which each is fashioned.  Set at a safe distance from a downward spiraling staircase is a slender ladder bound to the smooth limestone wall, which leads to an ironbound trapdoor set into the ceiling.

title: [Watchtower, Beacon]
description: Enormous windows take up each of the four cardinal points in this plain limestone room.  A small pot-bellied stove stands opposite a small round table and a pair of weathered chairs.  Dangling from the oaken rafters is a pair of tiny courier pigeon carriages, their denizens cooing softly in their sleep.

Enormous windows take up each of the four cardinal points in this plain limestone room.  A small pot-bellied stove stands opposite a small round table and a pair of weathered chairs.  Dangling from the oaken rafters is a pair of tiny courier pigeon carriages, their denizens cooing softly each to the other.

title: [Watchtower, Recovery]
description: Comfortable couches line the western wall beneath a window framed in whitewashed oak.  A pair of panel-sided cabinets rest side by side, their tops covered in aromatic candles.  A linen-lined white barrel stands near the door leading into triage, its lid tilted to the side.

title: [Watchtower, Triage]
description: Running from floor to ceiling on the western wall is a series of whitewashed cabinets with etched glass fronts.  Standing directly beside them is a short writing desk covered with an orderly pile of papers and journals.  Wide examination beds, four in all, occupy the center of the room and are covered with crisp white linens, while a pair of river reed baskets hang around the arch leading into the central foyer.

title: [Watchtower, Armory]
description: An armor stand is set back against the wall between a pair of long oak weapon racks.  Monstrously large iron-bound chests stand open in the center of the floor, their insides filled with miscellaneous gear.  A row of heavy wall pegs support coiled cords, triggers, and springs, while a series of oak shelves is filled with rags and tar kits.

title: [Watchtower, Meeting Hall]
description: Taking up the entire expanse of the eastern wall is an enormous linen map surrounded by linden framed cubby-holes hung upon the limestone.  At the center of the room is an oversized meeting table with oak benches provided for seating.  An alcove in the northern wall fitted with a low serving table discreetly hides the kitchen entryway.

title: [Grey Moon Manor, Lounge]
description: Built in a circle and enclosed by gleaming ebonwood-paneled walls, this room offers a comfortable and informal setting.  Several sofas, overstuffed chairs, and lounges have been scattered in a rough circle around a low glass-topped table.  Three-pronged iron candelabra dot the walls, holding natural beeswax candles with steadily burning flames.  Set into the wall and barely noticeable is a shadowy grey arch, and opposite is a narrow staircase.

title: [Grey Moon Manor, Dark Stair]
description: A sharply curving staircase has been carved from the natural rock at the foundations of the manor.  The staircase descends from a shadowy grey arch at the top and ends abruptly at a still sheet of water, broken by several upraised stepping stones.  There is no light in the immediate area, but a somber glow from across the water illuminates the way enough to allow for only slightly perilous passage.

title: [Market Bend, Casey's Club]
description: Sunlight peeks under the single door to provide scant illumination for the empty and windowless room, while above the high ceiling is lost in darkness.  Green felt-covered tables house ash-filled shells, which adds to the scent of stale tobacco smoke and spilt beer.  A fresh smattering of rushes covers the floor around a highly polished modwir bar and several sturdy oak bar stools.

Swirls of tobacco smoke eddy about the high ceiling of this windowless room.  A highly polished modwir bar surrounded by several sturdy oak bar stools, does brisk business along one wall of the room.  Inconspicuous guards are perched at either end, their eyes inspecting the crowds with an unrevealing air.

title: [Pasha's Pavilion, South]
description: The noise of the rotunda is drowned out by the roar of a gigantic roaster at the far end of the ceramic-tiled room.  A plethora of spitted goats sizzle and sear in the sweltering heat and flame of the open grill.  Between turns at the fire, a trio of Tehir women chop vegetables and prepare small doughy pockets upon makeshift tables to either side of the pit.

title: [Pasha's Pavilion, East]
description: The red and orange tiles from the west give way to a mix of black and ivory diamond patterns, leading up to a dark fel bar along the eastern end.  Colorful tapestries line the perimeter of the room, covering the walls in a wash of yellow, orange and green.  Sprouting from between the wall hangings at regular intervals are tall red candles in copper sconces, while a pair of large braziers hang from the ceiling, dispensing an overbearing musky odor into the air.

title: [Tidewater Warehouse]
description: Man-sized bolts of various weaves of canvas are stacked beneath a haphazard assortment of folded tarps and weather-worn sails.  Standing beneath a small window at the end of the aisle is a small table strewn with fids, leather palms, sail needles and a splicing hammer.

title: [Candle Shop]
description: A plethora of varied sconces decorate the dingy white walls, occupied by tall colorful tapers.  A noxious odor of bergamot and orange blossom waft from a pair of oversized braziers on either side of a large glaes and fel case.  Between the curtain to the east and the display to the west, a broad red wool runner covers the creaking fel floor.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Small puddles gather in shallow depressions in the ground, the cobblestones beneath their surfaces barely visible in the clouded, dirty water.  Buildings press closer here, imparting a more cramped feeling that's further enhanced by the sharp angles and uniform construction of the buildings.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: A few windows are inset high into the walls around you, their surfaces bearing untold years of dirt and other accumulated grit.  Crates are stacked next to or in front of some of the more weathered-looking doors here, and numerous bits of garbage are liberally piled in a haphazard fashion around them.  Ragged stains that are clearly not from water or mud mar the ground here, the only thing clearly visible through the covering of refuse.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Tendrils of mist creep along the ground like writhing serpents, cloaking the bits of garbage and other debris scattered across the cobblestones in a hazy veil of grey.  The walls of buildings loom overhead, leaving only a meager slice of pale moonlight to barely illuminate the surroundings.  The street takes an abrupt turn here, the cramped feeling more pronounced in this curved section.

Tendrils of mist creep along the ground like writhing serpents, cloaking the bits of garbage and other debris scattered across the cobblestones in a hazy veil of grey.  The walls of buildings loom overhead, leaving only a meager slice of sunlight to shine down upon the dark surroundings.  The street takes an abrupt turn here, the cramped feeling more pronounced in this curved section.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Consisting of the narrow spaces between dark houses and other structures, the Crooked Way stretches out into half-lit patches of ground alternating with deep shadows on every side.  The faint trickling sound of water through the cracked cobblestones is intermingled with the scurrying of rats and hurried footfalls in the darkness.  A dilapidated arch, its wooden surface warped and weathered, leads out to a somewhat brighter street to the west.

title: [Solhaven, Southbay Road]
description: The cries of the merchants hawking their wares in the South Market are distant here, echoing about the area in strange patterns of sound.  A huge pier juts out into the sea to the northwest, the large roofs of warehouses built upon it looming up into the sky.  A dilapidated archway stretches across the entrance to a winding street to the east, its pathways clouded by darkness.

The cries of merchants hawking their wares in the South Market are distant here, echoing about the area like faint memories of sound.  A dilapidated archway stretches across the entrance to a winding street to the east, the path beyond occluded by an oppressive shroud of darkness.  Opposite it, a dark alley snakes behind a ramshackle warehouse, the cobblestones littered with broken glass and refuse.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Splintered boards and shards of broken glass smatter the off-white cobblestones, somewhat blurred by the veil of dark mist undulating slowly across the ground.  A few thin trails of colorful flower-dotted vines hang down from ledges of high-set windows, adding a much-needed touch of color to the bleak and dreary atmosphere.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: The road slants sharply here in a zig-zag pattern, leading to a strange structure half-cast in shadow further northeast.  Swirls of grey mist dance along the glassy surfaces of stagnant black pools upon the ground, and faint ripples play across them with every ambiguous sound that echoes about the surroundings.  Moonlight drifts through small gaps in the walls between buildings, breaking up the large patches of darkness in an uneasy fashion.

The road slants sharply here in a zig-zag pattern, leading to a strange structure half-cast in shadow further northeast.  Swirls of grey mist dance along the glassy surfaces of stagnant black pools upon the ground, and faint ripples play across them with every ambiguous sound that echoes about the surroundings.  Sunlight streams through small gaps in the walls between buildings, breaking up the large patches of darkness in an uneasy fashion.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: A large house, with its sharply-sloped roof and arched windows, breaks the monotonous construction of the other tightly-packed buildings directly north.  The heavily blackened timbers, viciously warped wooden beams and shattered glass bespeak of some sort of cataclysmic damage to the structure, and its doors are barred with rusted slabs of iron.  A strange silence pervades the area, broken only by the wind whistling sharply through the winding alleyway.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Mist trails from somewhere to the northwest, and the area is unusually dark, even the faint beams of pale moonlight drifting in from between the closely-spaced buildings seem diminished by the gloom.  Faint scurrying sounds echo in the shadows, accompanied by the soft pattering sounds of dripping water.

Mist trails from somewhere to the northwest, and the area is unusually dark, even the faint beams of sunlight streaming in from between the closely-spaced buildings seem diminished by the gloom.  Faint scurrying sounds echo in the shadows, accompanied by the soft pattering sounds of dripping water.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Potted plants are set upon the ledges above, their flowers blending in with the multi-colored window frames that watch over them.  Cracks slither along the walls of the many buildings that enclose the area tightly, though the air seems clearer and less heavy here.  Moonlight drifts through from above, banishing nearly all patches of shadow, though the faint sounds of scurrying and occasional footsteps in the darkness beyond betray any sense of comfort.
