Cracks slither along the walls of the many buildings that enclose the area tightly, though the air seems clearer and less heavy here.  Sunlight streams through from above, banishing nearly all patches of shadow, though the faint sounds of scurrying and occasional footsteps in the darkness beyond betray any sense of comfort.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Small whirlwinds of dust and other debris randomly pick up and die again as stiff breezes blow through the twisting alleyway.  The peaks of buildings loom far too close for comfort here, their walls providing a narrow pathway that barely allows room to walk through.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: The road makes another abrupt turn here, and several abandoned buildings stand tightly packed against each other to either side, their windows shattered and their interiors dark and lifeless.  Boards haphazardly cover their splintered doors, though most have fallen off from years of shabby upkeep.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: The overhangs of the large buildings to both the north and south cast dark shadows across most of the ground, shrouding the numerous piles of trash and other refuse in darkness.  A rough ditch has formed in the middle of the street, and a few muddied cobblestones lie scattered along its edges.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Fragmented bones and other talismans of warding hang in the clouded, gritty windows above, bearing testament to the superstitions a place such as this might breed.  Rivulets of water trickle steadily between the cobblestones and rank odors waft through the air, their sources shrouded in patches of hazy shadow.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked Way]
description: Spiderwebs hang loosely from the ledges of windows, their silken threads tossed about by errant currents of wind that periodically howl through the narrow street.  Crates are stacked haphazardly along the walls, their forms casting crooked shadows across the ground.

title: [Solhaven, The Crooked End]
description: The twisting path ends in a cramped rounded cul-de-sac, a dark iron gate leading beyond the zig-zag of alleyways.  Numerous stains from water dripping across its surface create a winding, strange pattern across the iron, and flakes from a half-hearted coating of paint are gathered underneath it.  The vague forms of run-down buildings are visible just beyond the gate.

title: [Royal Court, Burzost Boulevard]
description: The wide road of the boulevard is flanked by broad footpaths and the shells of many run-down buildings.  Once these footpaths must have catered to a brisk pedestrian trade but now they only serve a few rats and drunks, both using the ruins for shelter.

title: [Royal Court, Burzost Boulevard]
description: Cobblestones have been piled high, forming a crude but sturdy barrier that blocks the road.  Several gaps have been made in the wall, large enough for anyone on foot to pass through, but too small for even the smallest of wagons.  A large sign, once colorful but now faded, points west to where scraps of faded cloth can be faintly seen fluttering.

title: [Royal Court, Malwind Markets]
description: This large open yard is littered with the remnants of fallen stalls and shops.  Crumbling stone walls are all that remain of some of the larger stores, their glass windows shattered and strewn on the street.  There is little wood left, no doubt gone to feed the fire-pits that lie within the shells of the ruined buildings.  Scraps of cloth, once colorful but now torn and faded, flutter from old flagpoles overhead.

title: [Royal Court, Burzost Boulevard]
description: A pair of large statues support a heavy marble block over the boulevard, forming a great stone arch.  To the southwest you can see the beginnings of a once prosperous market district, while to the southeast the fallen buildings were clearly once fine and majestic residences.  Troughs, once used to water all manner of riding beasts, lie clogged with dirt and ash along the edge of the road.

title: [Royal Court, Rysus Road]
description: The remains of many collapsed buildings line the wide road, rubble and overgrowing weeds covering the worn cobblestones.  Several of the old residences have been pulled down, leaving vacant weed-filled lots in their place.  Amongst the rubble stand small mounds of stone, primitive shacks built by the inhabitants as protection against the elements.  A rusty fence, bent under the weight of time and the thick vines that cover it, opens to the south.

title: [Royal Court, Kestrel Lane]
description: Tenacious overgrowth has all but obscured a rusted iron fence and the small park confined within.  Moldy wooden planks lie strewn about vegetation tall enough to hide the predatory lowlifes that claim this territory.  The narrow, muddy path winds its way eastward, interrupted only by the decaying body of a fallen modwir tree.

title: [Royal Court, Anodheles Way]
description: Deteriorated and littered with scraps of decaying seaweed, the roadbed splits off into two directions near a faded felwood sign.  Cobblestones sprout from the dirt surface as if they had been shaken from the rear of a bouncing wagon.  A boardwalk is visible to the northwest and off to the northeast long thin arms encompassing a cylindrical object can be seen.  A pair of malevolent eyes watch your every move from the shadows of the faded, deleterious, worm-eaten ruins of houses.

title: [Royal Court, Burzost Square SE]
description: Barnacle encrusted scraps of lumber are all that remain of the boardwalk around this southern part of the square.  Once thriving, this entertainment section is now an allectation for other sport.  Malcontents and ne'er-do-wells loiter between the abandoned buildings.  A hairy dwarf begs for silvers from those who venture too close.

title: [Royal Court, Anodheles Way]
description: Moonlight shines through the swaying, sparse canopy and glimmers softly as it dances across darkened puddles.  Faint echoes of scratching and scurrying seem to originate from a decrepit wishing well embraced by the spindly limbs of a weeping willow.

Shadows play across the muddy puddles that darkly reflect the swaying, sparse canopy overhead.  Faint echoes of scratching and scurrying seem to originate from a decrepit wishing well, embraced by the spindly limbs of a weeping willow.

title: [Royal Court, Burzost Square NE]
description: Flood lines mark the broken walls of the remaining buildings and attest to the competence of those who chose to build here.  Although a beautiful area, likely once envied by other neighborhoods, the subjacent nature of the ground to the surrounding water makes it unsuitable to inhabit for long.  The boardwalk stretches to the south and west.  A tiny kitten, carrying a captured rodent, struts across the promenade.

title: [Royal Court, Burzost Square NW]
description: A faint smell of wood smoke drifts from boarded up openings of an abandoned tavern.  Pride of ownerships shows in few local shanties, slightly increasing the quality of life in this area.  Time spent removing the boardwalk and surrounding buildings has resulted in expansive green space and wildflowers.

Faint streaks of light pierce the gaps in the boarded up openings and single window of an abandoned tavern.  Pride of ownership shows in the few local shanties, slightly increasing the quality of life in this area.  Time spent removing the boardwalk and surrounding buildings has resulted in expansive green space and wildflowers.

title: [Royal Court, Burzost Square SW]
description: Abruptly and without warning, the boardwalk ends at a red painted wooden wall with a small sign on it.  Over the wall are various mounds of used building materials with a faint trail winding beside and between the piles.  Broken lanterns and rusted tools mock the labor that had been intensive in the revitalization of this banlieue.  Off the boardwalk, wooden staves mark off lots, but squatters have appended the "for barter" signs to the walls of their shacks for further protection from the elements.

title: [Royal Court, Anodheles Way]
description: A scant few sparkles on the shadowed ground reveal shards of stained glass scattered in front of an abandoned cafe.  A twisted brass stool lies in a heap in the middle of the road, having apparently been thrown through the second story window.  Only the building's boarded up facade remains, as the red bricks of its other walls have long since fallen to the unforgiving ground.

Shards of stained glass gleam in the sunlight, scattered in front of an abandoned cafe.  A twisted brass stool lies in a heap in the middle of the road, having apparently been thrown through the second story window.  Only the building's boarded up facade remains, as the red bricks of its other walls have long since fallen to the unforgiving ground.

title: [Royal Court, Anodheles Way]
description: As the wind whistles past dilapidated shacks and shanties, it carries a dank, musty odor from the south.  Many of the cobblestones have been removed from the street, leaving behind a treacherous, ankle-twisting path to navigate.

title: [Royal Court, The Palace]
description: The weathered remnants of a once prosperous gambling hall lie in ruin amidst this forsaken lot.  Stubborn weeds sprout pervasively from gaps in the distant crumbling stone wall.  Debris from the surrounding area has been amassed into a makeshift mountain of refuse.  A large faded sign hangs precariously from a single rusted chain before the gigantic heap, serving as either a welcome or a warning.

title: [Top of the Heap]
description: The summit of this mountain of debris offers a fantastic vantage point to view the entire Royal Court.  While bird droppings cover most of the miscellaneous scraps and rubble here, they are especially concentrated around a rather large and grubby nest.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Entry]
description: Dull dark mahogany panels the entryway of the establishment, the wood probably once rich but now dusty and unpolished.  Plain egg-and-dart wainscotting adds some definition and design to the otherwise boring walls, splintering in several spots where it remains intact.  A flight of crooked wooden stairs leads up to a small landing, and double-width lintelled doors brace the hallway on each side.  Paralleling the staircase is a narrow corridor leading toward the kitchen.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Landing]
description: The small, square hallway offers barely enough space to turn around in, and as a result, the boards here are well worn.  The wooden railing bows out slightly, probably from the frequency of hand traffic and people leaning their weight against the wooden slats while trying to get into their rooms.  A haon door is set on one side of the stairway landing and an ebonwood door is on the other side.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Black Room]
description: Unlike the rest of the tavern, the room is immaculately kept, its polished, ebonwood-paneled walls glowing with a rich sheen.  Iron stands filled with midnight-hued candles add a warm light, as the thick, closed indigo velvet curtains filter out any other illumination.  A vase brimming with fresh mournblooms sits on a table next to a featherbed made up with silver satin sheets.  Ruby port fills a thick leaded glass decanter and two small tulip-shaped flutes invite guests to relax with a postprandial drink.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Grey Room]
description: Pale haon wood is burnished to a silvery hue and brushed with touches of gold, giving it an antiqued appearance.  Heavy storm grey brocade curtains are fastened with silk ties down the middle, keeping the outside light at bay.  Ora bowls of all sizes are filled with white candles, creating a decorative element around a large white wrought iron bed swathed in soft grey silk.  Tuberose stalks stand in a tall vase upon a round table that also offers the occupants half-full snifters of crystalline pear brandy.

title: [Dark Alley]
description: Worn and irregular cobblestones line the narrow dark alley.  A few of the stones are uneven and have been uprooted from where they were set.  Trash and debris flow freely through the passage, an obvious statement of the neighborhood's condition.  A filth-covered door is inset into the wall of the eastern building and a small wooden sign hangs crookedly above it.

title: [The Inn of the Krawling Kraken]
description: Mahogany paneling runs the length of the room, from the floor to the gold-leafed edge of the domed ceiling.  Long, lavish red velvet curtains on golden hooks spill down to barely caress the polished oak floorboards to the north.  Numerous votive candles in glass holders spread a soft illumination throughout the room.  A long plush velvet divan is pushed against the eastern wall while a carved rosewood table with a vase of red and purple orchids sits opposite it.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Foyer]
description: Heavy red velvet curtains hang against the southern wall, effectively blocking the public eye from the inner sanctum.  Brass wall sconces, polished to a golden sheen, line the walls, their candles smoldering slightly from the light breeze that passes from beneath the curtains.  Plush red rugs with long black tassels overlap one another and hide the rough oak floorboards that creak slightly.  Riotous laughter can be heard from the west while soft music enters the foyer from the east.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: The sharply-angled roofs of a few long warehouses mark the beginning of the Bonding Pier, its creaky planks stretching out into the bay.  Sailors unload their wares continually from moored vessels, and crewmen scramble to haul them into the numerous warehouses nearby.  To the southeast the pier merges into the Southbay Road.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: The long, rickety wooden planks that make up the pier branch off both north and west, with another path leading toward more solid ground to the southeast.  The waves lap at the long supporting timbers of the pier, and gulls intermittently find their tops as a temporary perch as they circle lazily about the area.  The sea stretches for miles to the west, a wavering, unending sheet that mirrors the star-dotted blackness of the night sky beyond the phosphorescent breakers of The Fang.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: Numerous long structures dot the more northern ends of the pier, while nothing but sea and the coast stretch for untold miles opposite of it.  Shifting shadows play across the weathered wooden planks of the pier, and the sharp steps of a few travelers occasionally break the silence that hangs in the air.  Several ships are moored at the end of the pier here, their outlines vaguely illuminated in the pale moonlight.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: Pale blue crabs cling to the submerged half of the pilings supporting the pier, their skittering forms clearly visible as they attempt to catch the tiny fish lingering just below the water's surface.  Tiny slivers of shell line the miniscule gaps between the planks underfoot, completely still and softly illuminated in the pale moonlight.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Eatery]
description: Thick indigo velvet curtains have been opened to admit light from street lanterns and the moons, allowing diners to actually see what they are eating, which may be a mistake considering the neglected surroundings.  Although some of the food aromas are enticing, the wafting scent of mildew threatens to spoil the appetite.  Serving wenches move quietly between the tables, balancing stacks of plates along both arms.

Although some of the food aromas are enticing, the wafting scent of mildew threatens to spoil the appetite.  Serving wenches move quietly between the tables, balancing stacks of plates along both arms.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Tavern]
description: Blue-grey smoke fills the room to the rafters, making what little illumination that exists appear soft and hazy.  Heavy indigo velvet curtains are pulled tightly together and a small hearth glows with sanguine embers, yet fails to throw off any heat into the room.  Set along the back wall in the shadows is a counter that matches the other dark furnishings in the room, blending altogether in a seamless caliginosity.  Small groupings of tables and chairs are scattered at a discreet distance from each other.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Hallway]
description: Barely wide enough for one person, the busy hallway runs from the kitchen out to the tavern and eatery.  Oil lamps glow dimly and do little to dispel the shadows.  Somewhat disorienting is the fact that the swinging door at the far end doesn't sit square in the jamb, giving the illusion that the building is slightly tilted.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Kitchen]
description: Perhaps the brightest room in the building, the kitchen is exceptionally well lit and overly warm from the blazing dual brick ovens.  Greasy spills dot the clay-tiled floor, having left their stains behind in the absorbent surface.  Crates of fruits and vegetables stack up against the walls, and choice meats drain over a blood-filled pan, from their ceiling hooks in a small dim alcove to the east.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Pantry]
description: A curtain of hanging meats guards the opening of the pantry, their gamey smell overwhelming this small space.  Racks of shelves are filled with delicacies and food stuffs infrequently used and requiring a measure of protection from the extreme heat of the kitchen.  A small arc mars a section of the wooden floor as though something has been repeatedly swiveled, wearing a tiny groove into the boards.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: The long ends of warehouses make up the west side of the pier, their high windows clouded and darkened to near blackness through years of minimal upkeep.  The sound of small waves crashing gently against the pilings of the docks overlaps the quiet sounds of moored ships rocking faintly in the darkness.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: The South Market Pier is visible to the north, its tarred pilings jutting out far into the pristine, sparkling waters that make up Solhaven Bay.  The peaks of small waves roll and crash into one another, creating a small webbing of white, foamy bubbles that spreads across the surface of the waters below.  The large, sharply-peaked roofs of numerous rectangular warehouses loom to the west.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: The shadow of a nearby stilted warehouse imparts a gentle shade from the pale light of the moons above.  The sea beneath is a canvas of sparkling blackness, while further to the west an even larger warehouse reaches toward the star-dotted sky.  A few large ships are moored alongside the docks, their sails furled and their forms still save for the rocking of the waves.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: The pathway of rough wooden planks curves sharply south here, and the pier stretches out to the southeast toward a prominent and expansive warehouse.  Workers occasionally run back and forth from its entrance, the sounds of their footsteps echoing across the dimly-lit pier.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: Barnacles have colonized the lower edges of the pilings that support the pier, and the flashes of small silver fish are visible in the moonlight.  Pieces of broken shells litter the tops of the large timbers, apparently from gulls taking up a perch there to feast on a meal of shellfish.  The docks are completely bare, and the cluster of warehouses in the middle of the pier cast strange shadows across the planks.

title: [Solhaven, Bonding Pier]
description: Large wooden doors mark the entrance of an expansive warehouse, the crest of the Mercantylers' Guild engraved prominently upon their dark surfaces.  Only a few travelers or workmen pass by on their way in or out, their footsteps the only sound interrupting the rhythmic sound of the sea lapping at the pier.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Commons]
description: The room is a bit quieter than the main bar serving area, though noisy cheers and raucous laughter can be heard coming from the bar to the southwest.  Long benches and rectangular tables seat high-spirited patrons intent on serious drinking and various card games of chance.  The clatter of clay tankards and the smell of good ale provide some small comfort to the steady stream of wayfarers who pause here to meet and greet one another.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: An impressive chandelier made of spun glass hangs from the ceiling, highlighting a long winding staircase leading up to the second floor.  Plush red carpeting with dark oak runners line the mahogany paneled hallway as it stretches north.  Faint laughter and the sounds of off-key singing can be heard from the commons down the southeastern corridor.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: Here, at the top of the staircase, one has a commanding view of the area below.  The banisters sweeping down to the lower floor are intricately carved in a leaping fish motif and polished to a high luster.  A mahogany paneled hallway stretches off to the north, while the west wall across from the staircase is almost completely occupied by a large oak door.

title: [The Seascape Room]
description: The soft light from the room's only candle gives the chamber an intimate feel as it illuminates the polished white oak walls and floors.  A fine pattern of seashells has been intricately carved across the northern wall.  Sitting in the corner is a large modwir bed fitted with sea-blue linens and a sandy-hued quilt patterned with leaping fish across its surface.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Bar]
description: Tables and chairs of deeply polished mahogany lend a simple elegance to this area.  A polished oak bar spans the length of the room across from the large granite fireplace that dominates the south wall.  The barkeeper presides merrily, ensuring everyone gets a share of attention from the pretty serving wenches and the handsome lad behind bar.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Dining]
description: A couple large rugs woven in shades of light and dark crimson have been placed carefully to overlap most of the oak floors in this room.  A dark hallway can be seen heading off to the northeast, while the sounds of an industrious kitchen can be quite audibly heard coming from the southeast.  Serving wenches wander the room, carrying trays of food and drink to various patrons at nearby tables.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Front Desk]
description: A long, polished mahogany desk takes up most of the northern space in the room, its front surface carved with a bas-relief of a large kraken with tentacles that reach to the outer edges of the desk.  A series of slots and pigeon holes line the wall behind the surly innkeeper, a few of the room keys visible inside their recesses.  A plush sanguine runner travels the length between the foyer and front desk, its soft material covering the rough oak floorboards.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Restaurant]
description: A single large tapestry hung against the eastern wall matches the simple decor of the hard wood benches and tables that populate the room.  Loud and raucous noises can be heard emanating from behind the kitchen doors, much to the laughing delight of some of the customers and the chagrin of others.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: The hall stretches north, carpeted in richly hued crimson along the floor and set with evenly spaced, engraved wall sconces made from polished brass.  Lighting from the candles illuminates the long winding staircase leading up to the second floor.  Smells of richly cooked food waft through the area each time a passing patron walks in from the dinning room.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: A large oak door marks this hall's southern end and is situated next to a long, winding staircase that leads down to the lower level.  Polished mahogany paneling covers the western wall and the floor is covered in a fine, plush red carpet that muffles the sound of passing patrons.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: The hallway ends abruptly, further passage blocked by the silken folds of long blue curtains and a couple stacks of crates that are pushed up against the walls.  A painting hangs on the western wall, its canvas covered with vibrant hues swirled together to form an image of a large kraken besieging a mariner's vessel.  The plush carpeting continues to the northern end of the corridor and underneath the curtains.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: The room is dominated by a huge marble statue to the west, set upon a raised platform of white washed stone.  Dark paneled walls reflect the moonlight cascading down from an open skylight in the high vaulted ceiling onto the base of the statue.  A thick burgundy drape cleverly conceals an alcove across from the statue and some long blue silk curtains offer passage to the south, back to the inn proper.

The room is dominated by a huge marble statue to the west, set upon a raised platform of white washed stone.  Dark paneled walls reflect the sunlight cascading down from an open skylight in the high vaulted ceiling onto the base of the statue.  A blue velvet drape cleverly conceals an alcove across from the statue and some long blue silk curtains offer passage to the south, back to the inn proper.

title: [The Sitting Room]
description: The walls of the room are hung with indigo-colored velvet drapes and a thick, plush carpet that covers the floor from wall to wall.  A couple of sturdy lounge chairs flank a generous sofa that sits up against the far wall.  On the sofa and chairs, a few white, lace-covered pillows add a splash of light to the room's deep blue, like stars in a night sky.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: The hallway sprawls out, extending to the north and the south.  The golden glow of candlelight from the overhead chandelier throws puddles of light against the polished mahogany walls and on the carpeted floor.  A single engraved oak door sits nestled flush against the eastern wall next to a small ivory statue of an imp playing a miniaturized lute.

title: [The Scaled Room]
description: The light is low and intimate in the chamber, intruding through a window shadowed by the overhanging eves outside and a thick red drape within.  Across the walls, a fine pattern of fish scales has been painted with delicate color and a light touch.  A heavy mahogany bed sits in the corner, fitted with beige-colored linens and a bright green quilt.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: The hall stretches off to the northwest and southeast, covered in a fine, red plush carpet.  A finely carved mahogany railing offers a good view of the common room below, showing bustling activity as people wander to and from the bar.  An ivory-inlaid oak door sits nestled between a pair of small paintings along the eastern wall.

title: [The Pine Room]
description: A generous pine bed occupies the far wall, opposite a matching pine armoire inset with an oval mirror.  Beside the bed, the fury hide of some unlucky sea creature provides a soft, irregularly shaped rug.  Polished oak walls support a trio of brass engravings behind a glass display case.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: Twin hallways meet at an odd intersection of sorts, mirroring each other almost perfectly as they both head off at right angles to each other leading south.  Where the two hallways join together an iron-banded oak door sits almost hidden inside a shadowed archway.

title: [The Cozy Room]
description: The room is painted a deep russet color, edged with polished oak around its shuttered window, floor and ceiling.  A large bed occupies most of this small area, barely leaving room for the bedside table and oak armoire situated against the opposite wall.  The linens on the bed and a small fur rug in deep green tones give the room a homey charm.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: A carved oak door stands against the outer wall of the mahogany paneled passageway, framed in a finely carved fel.  The nearby railing offers a good view of the room below as people travel about the great room.

title: [The Trophy Room]
description: A huge trophy hangs over the room's large oak-framed bed.  The sea thrak hangs from its board in a silent vigil, glass eyes staring unperturbed, as if there was something on the opposite wall the great beast might want to eat.  On the bed, soft green linens and a thick wool blanket provide a cozy place to rest.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: A staircase can be seen off to the south end of the polished mahogany hallway.  Sporadic bursts of laughter and raucous singing can be heard coming from somewhere below.  A quick glance over the oak railing shows a few people wandering aimlessly from place to place.  A wide oak door has been set into the west wall where the hallway makes a turn to the northeast.

title: [The Sailor's Ease]
description: The walls of the bedroom are painted a deep shade of blue.  Pushed up against the north wall is a massive oak bed with an old sea chest, replete with carvings, positioned at the foot of it.  An over-stuffed armchair occupies a quiet corner.  A window opposite the bed lets in moonlight, which shines through the red curtains and gives the room a soft rosy glow.

The walls of the bedroom are painted a deep shade of blue.  Pushed up against the north wall is a massive oak bed with an old sea chest, replete with carvings, positioned at the foot of it.  An over-stuffed armchair occupies a quiet corner.  A window opposite the bed lets in sunlight, which shines through the red curtains and gives the room a soft rosy glow.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: The mahogany paneled walls of two hallways meet at right angles in this room, giving the illusion of extra space in this area.  A small sitting area, consisting of a single, long stone bench has been set up near the base of a huge statue.  The marble statue appears to be gazing down at the floor near the northern corner of the room.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: Dark paneled walls along the western side of the hallway provide a striking contrast to the huge marble statue to the east.  The scarlet carpeting is worn in several places, showing the scuffed wooden floorboards underneath.  A blue velvet drape cleverly conceals an alcove across from the statue and some long red silk curtains offer passage to the south, back to the inn proper.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: Stacks of crates are piled along the paneled mahogany walls of the corridor, leaving just enough room to barely squeeze by.  Brass sconces holding thin crimson tapers cast a soft illumination upon the bare, rough oak floorboards.  Loud creaking from the floorboards echoes down the passage with each footfall of a passing patron or worker.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Front Room]
description: Sunlight slants across the room and illuminates several bottles of dye that are on display in this room.  The light reflects off of the bottles, creating a colorful prismatic spray across the oak floorboards and walls.  Several shelves are neatly hung upon the walls near a sturdy whitewashed door, while a low table and bench rest beneath the bay window set into the southern wall.

Torchlight slants across the room and illuminates several bottles of dye that are on display in this room.  The light reflects off of the bottles, creating a colorful prismatic spray across the oak floorboards and walls.  Several shelves are neatly hung upon the walls near a sturdy whitewashed door, while a low table and bench rest beneath the bay window set into the southern wall.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Front Room]
description: Sunlight trickles through white lace curtains and reflects off of several bottles arranged in tidy rows upon a long table set under the window.  Wide bookcases line the western wall, their shelves filled with bottles and vials of various shapes and sizes, while a carefully arranged oak bench sits at an angle to the northeastern wall.

Moonlight trickles through white lace curtains and reflects off of several bottles arranged in tidy rows upon a long table set under the window.  Wide bookcases line the western wall, their shelves filled with bottles and vials of various shapes and sizes, while a carefully arranged oak bench sits at an angle to the northeastern wall.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Glossy ebonwood banisters, lacquered and etched with mystic runes, wrap the stairwell as it climbs from the base of the tower to the highest landing.  A wide shelf juts outward from the limestone tower walls over an arch that leads to a repaired room.  Gone are the torches of yore, their scorch marks upon the smooth walls the only testament to their existence.  In their place are strange globes holding dancing lights of lime green, which flicker and sputter sporadically.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Polished linden floors are covered with thick woven rugs displaying archaic battles of an arcane nature.  Floor to ceiling cases lined with books cover the cylindrical room and hide the walls that support the tiled ceiling.  A small round table rests at the heart of the room, hiding the opponent in the flooring's battle scene, flanked by crushed black velvet settees.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Bright white steps mix with chipped and dented black stones in this renovated section of the tower.  Climbing further up the walls of the tower, the stairs disappear beyond a wide landing above.  Below, orbs cast an eerie green illumination upon an arch set into the smooth walls.  A series of small archery windows lined in silver gaze out upon the waters of the bay and the sprawling city below.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Shifting in hue, the banisters along this section of the stairway transition from a dark natural hue to a bleached appearance, even though the wood is the same.  The archaic runes that decorate other sections seem brighter here beneath the glow of strange orbs caged in black wrought iron.  A copper tiled overhang guards the landing from the elements.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Eight crenellated points ring the crown of the tower and are set with archaic devices that pulse in an odd, hypnotic pattern of green and purple lights.  Dropping from the landing, the banister-wrapped stairs disappear around a curve in the tower's walls and are illuminated by orbs of light.  Resting in the shadows of the crown is a small building with copper and silver flashing.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Pristine and tidy, the small room has walls of stucco that are a brilliant shade of white.  A large marble fireplace, riddled with gold veins, rises in the northern corner of the room and casts rippling orange lights upon a pair of armchairs that have been positioned close by.  Near the door is a curtained arch with a low counter topped in black marble set before it.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
[Solhaven, Departures]
description: Bare of all furnishings, the room is an exact contrast to the one through the curtained arch.  Where the other is blindingly bright, this one is completely black from ebonwood flooring to raftered ceiling.  A single frosted globe is suspended from the ceiling over a strange series of golden interlacing circles and casts an eerie greenish glow upon the dark walls.

title: [Faeilythe's Fashions, Trinkets]
description: Crystal clear displays, cases and counters, their sides done in a diamond pattern that matches the front shop windows, contain a variety of trinkets and other accessories to make your wardrobe complete.  A gold velvet curtain blocks the entrance into a private back room.

title: [Niima's Temple, Widow's Walk]

Off to the southwest, the sparkling sands and vertical pilings of the Kraken Sands glint in the sunlight.

title: [Niima's Temple, Widow's Walk]
description: Along the south side of the walk, the visible Fisherman's Quay is surrounded by a flurry of daytime activity. title: [Midrian's Dyes, Courtyard]
description: Squashed between the shop's tall walls and a three-story townhouse is a courtyard covered in creeping ivy.  Granite cobblestones cover the uneven floor, their greyed surfaces displaying signs of regular bleaching.  Dyeing stalls are built into the eastern and western walls, while a stone washbasin fitted with a cast iron pump rests to the north.  A sturdy whitewashed door is framed in solid oak, its long sides holding in place a pulley system that supports a labyrinth of clotheslines.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Showroom]
description: Brass sconces are hung upon the oak walls of this windowless room, their soft light filtered through the frosted glass globes that rest upon them.  Velvet upholstered chairs are situated to either side of a low oak table, which is covered with a pale blue linen cloth and a silver serving tray.  Opposite the table setting is a colorful mannequin adorned with swatches of vibrant fabric and flanked by a pair of linen-lined bookcases displaying multicolored bottles, jars, and vials of dyes.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Kitchen]
description: Lining the entire northern wall is a long row of shelves set over a series of cast-iron stoves, where a young woman bustles about, quietly talking to herself.  Copper and steel pots simmer, steam, and bubble upon the stoves, while nearby a vinegar distillery gurgles softly.  A wide oak table rests beside a door leading into the garden and is topped with pestles, mortars, and dried plants.  Opposite the door, exposed rafters display various dried herbs, plants, and barks above several casks and barrels.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Garden]
description: Crushed white seashells create a slender track through the garden from the kitchen door to the back wall, where a large teaberry bush blooms.  Green and red planters filled with monkeyflowers surround purple crocus plants potted in lapis-hued planters.  Opposite the potted selection is a lower garden filled with plump beets, vines of purple eggplant, and rows of star-shaped nightshade wrapped in a vibrant border of yellow gorse.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Stairway]
description: Polished brass picture frames line the walls of a circular staircase that leads to a darkened landing above.  Hand carved railings, fitted into polished oak slabs, show signs of recent polishing and are strung with a thin cord of rope suspending a small oak sign.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Large Stall]
description: Reserved for larger projects, this particular stall is long and fitted with an enormous tin tub.  Wooden paddles, each baring residual traces of different dyes, are fitted into a long oak rack, which takes up the entire facing of the brick wall at the rear of the stall.  Buckets of water stand beside a small step stool set at the edge of the tub, while a series of low shelves house neatly stowed tools.

title: [Venquinor House, Entry Hall]
description: Dulcet-hued honey oak frames the tidy, riverstone-tiled antechamber, lent depth by the roseate luminescence filtering in through the panes of some stained glass windows framing the front door's silver-inlaid bulk.  The ceiling rises into a gentle dome, the base of which is encircled by a pattern of downy, snow-colored feathers against a verdant backdrop.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Waterfall]
description: The waterfall sends a spray of mist across the clearing at its base each time the breeze gusts.  A bluff of granite cuts off the trail on the north, its pitted surface rich with moss and ferns growing in crevices.  Cabins are tucked in a semi-circle beneath a grove of pecan trees to the west.  The lake stretches away to the east, a mirror to catch the reflection of the rising sun each morning.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Moonlight Pool]
description: The trail veers close to the bank of the lake, drawn by a spectacular view of the falls just across a narrow arm of Moonlight Pool.  A few carved stone benches are positioned along the bank, offering a place to sit and regard the beautiful cascade.

The trail veers close to the bank of the lake, drawn by a spectacular view of the falls just across a narrow arm of Moonlight Pool.  A few carved stone benches are positioned along the bank, offering a place to sit and regard the beautiful cascade.  A couple of cabins are built on the path's eastern shoulder, their view of the lake unencumbered.

title: [Ebondrift, Piacular Plaza]
description: Rising majestically from the sea-like flooring of the area, a spiring clock tower, formed of blue-grey granite, dominates the plaza. Around the base of the tower are set three freestanding cubic plaques of bronze, silver and gold.  Walkways fan out from the square in seven directions: northeast, northwest, east, west, southeast, southwest and south.

title: [Ebondrift, Lower Clock Tower]
description: Unvarnished paneling of coastal pine covers the interior walls, bas-relief carved sea creatures curving up from its surface.  At random points, raised ebonwood designs -- images of objects or animals or plants sacred to specific dark gods -- have been added.  Filling one side of the room is a granite pool fed by a slanted wooden sluice.  Movement of the seawater in the sluice turns a large fel wheel, which in turn connects to a series of metal rods rising upward through a wide circular hole in the roof.

title: [Ebondrift, Upper Clock Tower]
description: This room is fashioned as something of a circular deck, with a wide hole cleaving out much of the middle of the floor and leaving walking space only nearer the walls.  Through the open portion of the floor, metal rods rise and fall in constant motion, pushing several huge gears.  Those gears in turn power other rods and smaller gears, some connecting to the causeways which slide animated figures out onto the display platform of the tower, some powering the actual workings of the timepiece.

title: [Ebondrift, Clock Tower Steeple]
description: A series of two-dozen cast-iron bells, in sizes ranging from halfling height to giant height, fill this steeple chamber, leaving little room for walking.  Metal rods, pushing up through fitted openings in the floor, are attached to these bells.  The ceiling tapers up toward the tower's uppermost spire point, its interior painted a glossy black and embellished in silver-leaf with images of the stars of the Elanthian constellations, the mariner's directional guide since first he ventured out upon the seas.

title: [Ebondrift, Clock Tower Balcony]
description: The balcony is fitted to what must be called the back of the circular clock tower, as it sits on the side opposite the platform upon which animated figures mark the passing of the hours.  From this vantage point, the view provided of the port of Solhaven is simply spectacular.  Upon the granite wall supporting the suspended gallery, bas-relief depictions of the dark gods are carved and outlined in a variety of metal leaf-work.  The salty tang and cool dampness of sea breezes blow freely through the air.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Liabo Garden]
description: Apple trees ring the perimeter of this small garden, their boughs filled with singing birds and laden with fruit.  Bushes of boxwood have been pruned uniformly and sit squarely between each trunk.  Dark, loamy cultivated beds filled with the showy blossoms of tuberose, bergamot, gardenia and jasmine create an almost overwhelming perfume.  A white marble statue in the center of this retreat serves as a focal point for meditation.

title: [Temple, Alcove of Light]
description: The low-set ceiling and the clusters of softly-glowing beeswax candles impart an intimate ambiance to this small chamber.  A thin, stylized carving of a faceless figure reaches out from the eastern wall, its arms spread as if in a gesture of welcoming.  A simple, unadorned white ora altar stands beneath the statue, an open book lying upon it.  The granite that forms the walls and ceiling is nearly pure white, its flat surface awash with rippling, warm amber waves from the candlelight.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Wall Walk]
description: Fresh air and a daylight are a startling contrast to the dark and heavily-incensed interior of the turret.  A crenellated wall walk runs along this side of the triple turrets, connecting them.
Fresh air and a starlit sky are a startling contrast to the dark and heavily-incensed interior of the turret.  A crenellated wall walk runs along this side of the triple turrets, connecting them.

title: [Temple, Hall of Death]
description: The hall widens and the ceiling rises in a gentle arch to form a tomblike chamber, its curving south wall cradling a pair of arched mistwood doors etched in vinelike patterns of malachite and silver.   A stylized yew tree is carved into the smooth granite of the north wall, its gnarled branches almost lifelike in detail, and the floor is inlaid with grey tile that forms interlocking symbols of eternity.  An ancient silver sickle hangs mounted on a moss-green stone plaque above the doors.

title: [Temple, Inner Sanctum]
description: A heavy granite slab dominates the northern wall, its mottled grey surface rough and unadorned.  Standing before the slab, a low altar at her feet, is a life-sized grey marble statue of a woman, her voluminous outstretched wings flowing up nearly to the ceiling then sloping down in a cascade of intricate feathers to her sides.  Rows of tall pillar candles cast the chamber in a dim, shifting glow, the wavering candlelight doing nothing to drive off the faint chill that pervades the utterly still air.

title: [Temple, Chamber of Eternity]
description: The walls and ceiling of the darkened chamber form a solid dome of black granite that seems to absorb all light except for the tiny glimmers of thousands of tiny white gemstones embedded in its surface, swirling in a spreading spiral like an endless expanse of distant stars.  The only source of the sparks of light reflected from above is a faint flicker from a silvery crystal ball which stands on a dark stone pedestal in the center of the chamber.  Dark-cushioned couches line the silent, curving walls.

title: [Temple, Left Hand Way]
description: Featureless, smooth walls of dark grey granite enclose the darkened hallway.  Three black pillar candles set into recessed niches do little to drive back the cloying shadows that embrace the passage in shifting darkness.  A faint light filters in through the grey granite arch in the inner wall, and the vague outline of a small alcove leads into a dark chamber to the south.

title: [Temple, Alcove of Darkness]
description: A single large pillar candle rests upon the glossy surface of a small black ora altar, its flame dimly illuminating the stark contours of a looming, stylized figure carved from the granite of the surrounding walls.  One arm of the statue is extended, its finger crooked as if beckoning toward the darkness beyond.  The shadows shift and waver as the meager candlelight flickers, revealing a small book lying open upon the altar.

title: [Huge Tower, West Point]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, and light filters in through a large horizontal notch cut into the northern wall, a ballista aligned in front of it.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a grouping of arrow slits surround the central horizontal window.

title: [Huge Tower, South Point]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, and light filters in through a large horizontal notch cut into the northern wall, a ballista aligned in front of it.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a grouping of arrow slits surround the central horizontal window.

title: [Huge Tower, East Point]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, and light filters in through a large horizontal notch cut into the northern wall, a ballista aligned in front of it.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a grouping of arrow slits surround the central horizontal window.

title: [Huge Tower, North Point]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, and light filters in through a large horizontal notch cut into the northern wall, a ballista aligned in front of it.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a grouping of arrow slits surround the central horizontal window.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Willows]
description: A thicket of willows edges the lake, their elongated branches dipping seductively into the water.  Loons swim in and out of the camouflage of the willow leaves, their unique song harmonizing with that of frogs and crickets.  Houses sit on a ridge above the boggy feet of the trees, their backs nestled into a stand of aspens.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Falls View]
description: A clearing on the bank of Moonlight Pool offers a superb view of the falls across the lake.  The bank is carpeted in dense grass, and a large willow growing next to it arches over the water with long draping branches skimming the lake's surface.  Cabins sit peacefully in the clearing, silhouetted by light reflected off the lake.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Fern Amble]
description: The path branches, leading north toward the lake and another arm leading toward the sound of a stream gurgling to the northeast.  A monstrous oak is visible guarding the trail to the west.  Thick banks of ferns surround the crossroads, their fronds waving languidly in the breeze.  A couple of cabins sit in the midst of the ferns, small patches of flowers planted around them.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Brookside]
description: A brook trickles through a clearing, its crystal water polishing the smooth stones in its way.  Cottages sit in a circle around the clearing, sheltered by a canopy of sycamores.  Their dotted white trunks provide a striking contrast to the green of their leaves and the mossy banks of the stream.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Trillium Trail]
description: Trillium plants bloom profusely in the deep shade beneath tall black oaks.  The trees stretch graceful limbs across the path leading through the hollow, a few cabins nestled into the lee of their reach.  Brightly painted shutters on the homes add a festive accent to the native colors.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Tall Trees]
description: A tall stand of black oaks shelter the cabins built at their feet.  Red bud and dogwood trees grow around the feet of the taller woods, their leaves a graceful second canopy beneath the taller oaks.  Thick hedges of holly create a hedgerow to the north, bedecked with bright red berries.

title: [Noralgar Hollow, Stream Bank]
description: A ridge rises on the opposite bank of a stream rushing through the forest.  Oaks crowd around it, as if nurturing it and protecting it from harm.  Boulders, mottled with lichen and rich with veining, frame the singing brook on each side.  Quaint cabins dot the nearer side of the watercourse, sheltered by the oaks and serenaded by the stream.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Wall Walk]
description: The grey stone wall looks out over the ground below, where the whole of Lornon Avenue stretches out, spanning from the crimson arch of flames at one end to the gate at the west wall of Vornavis at the other.  The added advantage of being perched on a hill also offers a view of the bustling city.

The grey stone wall looks out over the ground below, where the whole of Lornon Avenue stretches out, spanning from the crimson arch of flames at one end to the gate at the west wall of Vornavis at the other.  Flickers of light from the city beyond parallel the sky full of stars above.

title: [Venquinor House, Kitchen]
description: Lit by the unsteady commingling of verdant and opaline light trickling through some colored glass windows set into the western wall, the kitchen is a large chamber bounded by riverstone and honey-hued wood paneling.  The rich, hearty scent of smoke melded with that of roasting boar wafts from a gaping stone-trimmed hearth opposite the windows.

title: [Venquinor House, Dining Room]
description: The low wooden eaves of the roof reflect wetly from the polished surface of a blond oak dining table carved from a massive single slab of wood at the center of the chamber.  Climbing through a high arch in the northern wall, some rounded riverstone steps ascend to the second level of the manor.  Mosaic tiles dance over the surface of the arch in interlocking patterns of opal and emerald tesserae.

title: [Venquinor House, Upper Hall]
description: Situated at the top of some rounded riverstone steps, the hallway is long and lushly carpeted.  Its northern wall is dominated by a muraled alcove, the vivid greens and shadowy blues of which provide a contrasting backdrop to a wide-mouthed dark jade jug.  At the hallway's end stands a pair of stained glass doors, the semi-translucent crystal panes adequately concealing the chamber beyond.

title: [Venquinor House, Sanctum]
description: Fanciful whorls grace the riverstone slabs enclosing the spacious chamber, the patterns differing only slightly on each of the four walls.  Opposite  some arched stained glass doors, the eastern wall is largely cut away to reveal an open-air balcony beyond a heron-marked painted paper screen.  Sprawling and heavily cushioned, a curtained four-poster bed draped in swathes of verdigris silk rests by the northern wall.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, East Turret]
description: Sunlight streams in from the small arched opening that leads west and out onto the roof, reflecting brightly against the white wall of the turret and illuminating the two small niches.
Moonlight streams in from the small arched opening that leads west and out onto the roof, reflecting brightly against the white wall of the turret and illuminating the two small niches.

title: [Andelas' Temple, Pond Courtyard]
description: The stone walls surrounding this courtyard have been built with numerous small shelves jutting out at various heights, while the center of the courtyard is occupied by a crystal clear pond teeming with a school of brightly colored fish.  A monir-planked catwalk spans the pool, bisecting it and providing ample opportunities for nimble-pawed fishing in the moonlight.

The stone walls surrounding this courtyard have been built with numerous small shelves jutting out at various heights, while the center of the courtyard is occupied by a crystal clear pond teeming with a school of brightly colored fish.  A monir-planked catwalk spans the pool, bisecting it and providing ample opportunities for nimble-pawed fishing.

title: [Andelas' Temple, Meadow Yard]
description: Carpeted by dense growth of wildflowers and tall grasses, the air above the blossoms is filled with fluttering butterflies, buzzing bees and darting of swallows, flycatchers and sparrows.  Outcroppings of rock allow for various sizes and heights of resting places, and a small oak tree provides an ample amount of shade.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Adytum]
description: The solemn surroundings are more befitting the priests and priestesses who dedicate every hour of their lives to the temple, than a mere trespassing worshipper.  Lit with several oil lamps set in iron sconces, rows of onyx benches stand in a circle around a central altar.  Steel grey vestments chased with crimson-threaded flames hang from several hooks along the walls.  Three arched openings lead to smaller alcoves off the main chamber.

paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Eorgina's Temple, West Turret]
description: An openwork iron staircase rises up in a sharp spiral, ascending the levels of this small turret.  The outer wall has been painted a dark hue that contains a mottled shading of black with touches of indigo, more like a violent storm than the pinnacle of midnight.  Towards the ceiling it fades to a dusky grey.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Monk's Cell]
description: Stark in furnishing, the room sits as a fitting tribute to a simple man devoted to a single mission.  Aside from a neatly made cot at one end, nothing else in the room gives away the ownership or the presence of a keeper.  At the far end of this barren retreat is a black velvet-shrouded altar set with a broken skull and a sharply-honed dagger.  Silver gilded candles on either side have been lit, and reflect in the mirror set directly behind the tiny shrine.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Lornon Garden]
description: Hawthorn trees ring the perimeter of this small garden, their crimson berry-like fruits bright against the dark glossy foliage.  Bushes of heliotrope have been pruned uniformly and sit squarely between each trunk.  Dark, loamy cultivated beds filled with the showy blossoms of nightshade, wolfsbane, mezereon and hellebore create an almost overwhelming perfume.  A small, grey granite statue in the center of this retreat serves as a focal point for meditation.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, West Turret]
description: Candlelight from each of the niches flickers softly, creating dancing shadows on the wall, almost too subtle to be seen against the dark surface.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, East Turret]
description: An openwork iron staircase rises up in a sharp spiral, ascending the levels of this small turret.  The walls have been painted a pale hue that contains a mottled shading of cream with touches of silver, more like moonlight shining on a field of snow than the flames of a white-hot inferno.  An arched doorway leads out to the garden.

title: [Solindago Anox, Crosspaths]
description: Three paths lined in white gravel that gleams with bits of crushed shell lead to the north, west and east.  The zoo's front entrance can be glimpsed through a massive stone arch.  An enormous circular planter sits in the center of the crossroads.  Cleverly built into the edge of the planter, wooden benches offer a pleasant place to sit and enjoy the colorful blooms.

Three paths lined in white gravel that gleams with bits of crushed shell lead to the north, west and east.  The zoo's front entrance can be glimpsed through a massive stone arch.  An enormous circular planter sits in the center of the crossroads.  Cleverly built into the edge of the planter, wooden benches offer a pleasant place to sit and enjoy the evening air.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, East Turret]
description: One of the three niches along the turret wall has been draped with pennants from a recent festival, their colors still bright against the neutral white paint.  Dots of confetti litter the ground and a couple of curled streamers undulate in the light breeze.

title: [Sacristy of Darkness]
description: Soot-hued walls ring the small alcove, lit only by a single iron oil lamp mounted near the ceiling, the illumination washing across the white marble inlaid overhead.  As the flickering light shifts and scatters, finely detailed illustrations etched in the blackened surface almost seem to dance as they encircle the room.

title: [Sacristy of Tyranny]
description: Five tapestries surround the small alcove, each depicting some of Elanthia's most notorious tyrants.  Behind them, crimson walls appear almost blood-like in hue, owing to the dim light afforded by a single iron oil lamp mounted on a central pedestal.  Ebonwood benches rest in front of each woven horror, offering a place for people to sit and contemplate the grandeur of each image.

title: [Sacristy of Domination]
description: Small renderings of each of the Arkati have been painted on the walls that ring this room, all gazing upward at the impressive fresco overhead.  Set at the center of a raised circle of black slate, an ornate grey mistwood throne carved to resemble an elegant tangle of thorned vines dominates the setting.  A row of torches behind the throne cast an uneasy, wavering light across the chamber, elongating the sharply-curved barbs into distorted shadows that creep across the floor.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, East Turret]
description: White votive candles sit in all of the niches along this outer wall, which is painted a pale hue, and create a warm and sunny glow more typically symbolic of the Liabo Pantheon.  The faint scent of incense is present here, but there is no trace of ash remaining as a clue.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, East Turret]
description: Through the veil of blooming trumpet vines draping down from the opening in the central ceiling, the massive statue of Eorgina climbs ever upward in the central turret below.  Two more niches are nestled into the pale wall.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, East Turret]
description: Several more niches grace the wall here, and below one in particular, many followers have offered gifts of flowers as they have knelt to pray.  A small, hand-tied bouquet of red roses have been placed under one niche in particular.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: A wide doorway paned with exquisite stained glass images of brilliantly feathered birds flying across a background of variegated greenery ushers visitors into the immense rainbow-whorled, leaded glass dome that houses the aviaries.  Two Elanthia ironwood trees stand as sentinels to either side of the entrance, their bark providing a home for several varieties of delicate orchids.  More orchids are cultivated in the well-kept planters surrounding the trees.
