Two Elanthia ironwood trees stand as sentinels to either side of the entrance, their bark providing a home for several varieties of delicate orchids.  More orchids are cultivated in the well-kept planters surrounding the trees.

A wide doorway paned with exquisite stained glass images of brilliantly feathered birds flying across a background of variegated greenery is barred shut for the evening.  A string cordon around the door blocks entrance into the immense glaes dome that houses the aviaries.  Two Elanthia ironwood trees stand as sentinels to either side of the entrance, their bark providing a home for several varieties of delicate orchids.  More orchids are cultivated in the well-kept planters surrounding the trees.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: Crushed white shells encircle an octagonal patio fashioned of dozens of bricks imprinted with the names of past donors to the zoo.  At the heart of the patio is an enormous bronze sculpture of a fiddler crab, a matching placard resting within the gaze of its beady eyes.  At the junction of the patio and the pathway, a brass-edged golden linden counter sells postcards that commemorate the visit.

The plaintive noises of animals begging for food is punctuated by the shrill, delighted squeals of the youngsters playing with them in the petting zoo just beyond the gate.  Sunlight sparkles off an immense glaes dome that lies to the north.
Occasionally a sleepy animal call can be heard from the simple petting zoo enclosure that lies just beyond the gate.  Moonlight gleams off an immense glaes dome that lies to the north.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, Wall Walk]
description: The wall walk along the triple turrets continues here, a weathered wooden fence running parallel and blocking off the rest of the roof.  A glimpse over the top of a flame-shaped gate set into the fence reveals an elaborate labyrinth garden ringing the open central turret roof.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: A simple split-rail fence overgrown with climbing pink rose vines borders the walkway.  Through a break in the fence, a glimpse of well-manicured grass dotted with picnic tables and shade trees can be seen.  Nodding in the slight breeze, the heavy pink roses perfume the air with their sweet scent.

A simple split rail fence overgrown with climbing pink rose vines borders the walkway.  Through a break in the fence a glimpse of well-manicured grass dotted with picnic tables and shade trees can be seen.  Nodding in the slight breeze, the heavy pink roses perfume the air with their sweet scent.

A simple split rail fence overgrown with climbing pink rose vines borders the walkway.  Through a break in the fence a glimpse of well-manicured grass dotted with picnic tables and shade trees can be seen outlined by the moonlight.  Nodding in the slight breeze, the heavy pink roses perfume the evening air with their sweet scent.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, West Turret]
description: Near the floor, the wall tint is a blackish-grey that lightens upwards to a dusky hue the color of rain clouds as it reaches the ceiling.  The gradual shading suggests a subtle shift in the Pantheons, as represented by two small niches.  To the east, a small opening leads out onto the roof of the temple.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, West Turret]
description: Along the outer edge of the spiraling stairs, crimson trumpet vine flowers drape down in delicate tendrils from the opening in the ceiling of the central turret.  A couple of niches dot the wall, their votive candles flickering softly.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, West Turret]
description: The height of the turret affords a magnificent view of the central temple, and the massive statue of Eorgina based there,  still looming overhead at this level.  The tiny niches in the wall are miniature in comparison, as befitting a Queen and her minions.

title: [Eorgina's Temple, West Turret]
description: A soft breeze causes the lit votives to flicker briefly, threatening to send the niches lining the dark-hued outer wall into darkness.  The tiny flames struggle for a moment, then grow stronger, sending out a warm glow.

title: [Niima's Temple, Foyer]
description: Scallop shell sconces created from translucent alabaster add little illumination to the small passage between the doorway and the main temple.  Wistful paintings of Niima, pictured both in humanoid form and as a figurehead on great sailing ships, border the walls just below the ceiling.  Streams of blue and green light inside bathe the nave just beyond the foyer.

title: [Natural Oddities]
description: Verdant green borders contrast with the white gravel of the path as it winds its way east and away from the main thoroughfare.  Fine mesh netting is bound to various tall oak poles, creating a safety screen between visitors and a dense green-black jungle that looms to the east.  Occasionally, the distinctive chattering and calls of primates echo through the air.

A wide grassy field protected by a large enclosure sits to the west of the path, and a large piece of transparent glaes serves as a window to the world within the large habitat.  A subtle breeze blows through the enclosure, stirring the grasses and leaves on the trees that rise up from the ground.  An ebon-feathered cockatrice can be seen moving about the field.

A wide grassy field protected by a large enclosure sits to the west of the path, and a large piece of transparent glaes serves as a window to the world within the large habitat.  A subtle breeze blows through the enclosre, stirring the grasses and leaves on the trees that rise up from the ground.  An ebon-feathered cockatrice can be seen lying within the center of wildflowers.

title: [Niima's Temple, Chancel]
description: Set off from the main nave by a mistwood banister, the haon benches here have been cushioned with seats of plush blue-green velvet, indicating a more elite seating during services.  On the far wall, a wave has been skillfully painted in the changing colors of the sea complete with a white foamy crest.  Above the roiling water, an indigo starry sky adds a bit of surreal depth to this end of the temple.  A white alabaster altar stands at the center, raised up slightly on a round white marble dais.

title: [Niima's Temple, Altar]
description: From this vantage point, the painted backdrop for the nave and the row of blue and green glaes clerestory windows are the most dramatic uses of color in the white limestone temple.  A border of leaping and frolicking silver dolphins chases along the walls, some extended out slightly and serving as sconces, disguising the many candles that illuminate the room.  The shell-shaped alabaster altar is quite ornate in comparison to the rest of the temple.

title: [Niima's Temple, Stairwell]
description: Enclosed limestone spiral stairs lead upward along this corner towards the top of the temple, inlaid with a centered pattern of frolicking dolphins.  A haon-linteled archway leads out to the garden.

title: [Small Mammals]
[Small mammals]
description: The gravel-lined path bordered with fences overgrown with night blooming jasmine vines winds between two caged enclosures.  On one side of the path, a silvery mithril-barred enclosure houses a small bronze-clawed firecat.  Opposing the mithril enclosure is a glass-enclosed frozen tundra habitat.

The air is perfumed with the heavy scent of jasmine emanating from the open blooms along that cover the low fence bordering the path.  On one side of the path, a silvery mithril-barred enclosure houses a small bronze-clawed firecat.  Opposing the mithril enclosure is a glass-enclosed frozen tundra habitat.

title: [Niima's Temple, Chantry Chapel]
description: Small, dark and lit only by black iron sconces mounted on grey stone walls, the small chapel is austere in design and furnishings.  Two short columns of benches leave room for a rosewood catafalque covered with a simple square of white linen.  Providing a backdrop to this stark scene is a large tapestry rendered in muted hues, illustrating demise at sea.

title: [Niima's Temple, Stairwell]
description: Halfway up this spiraling staircase, an opening has been cut into the wall, revealing the nave and altar below.  At this height, the clerestory windows are almost eye level, and it becomes apparent that they are each a mosaic of blue and green translucent glaes.

title: [Niima's Temple, Bell Tower]
description: Overhead, a large brass bell is suspended from a timber beam.  Rope threaded through a series of pulleys used to make it swing out and ring has been securely tied off with a large fisherman's knot.

title: [Small Mammals]
description: This habitat is structured in two layers.  Giants of the forest, their straight grey-brown barked trunks arrowing towards the sky, grow on the lower layer.  Emerald green treeferns, their leaves as tall as a giantman, obscure the view of the trees.  Thick, woody lianas vines grow throughout the greenery, giving the agile servaline genet an avenue to explore the treetops.

This habitat is structured in two layers.  Giants of the forest, their straight grey-brown barked trunks arrowing towards the sky, grow on the lower layer.  The upper layer of ferny growth is cast into deep shadow by the overhanging trees.  Thick, woody lianas vines grow throughout the greenery, giving the agile servaline genet the opportunity to find a resting place in the treetops.

title: [Small Mammals]
description: The cobalt-spotted leaper is housed in an airy habitat circumscribed by a sturdy fence that rises quite high into the air to prevent the powerful animal from escaping.  A low, rocky wall slopes southward to meet the jungle-like trees and vines that thrive in the moist earth.  Rocky ledges and slopes rise into peaks, forming a ridgeline to the north.

The cobalt-spotted leaper is housed in an airy habitat circumscribed by a sturdy fence that rises quite high into the air to prevent the powerful animal from escaping.  Rocky ledges and peaks, rising high in the north, slope down to the deep shadows cast by jungle-like trees and vines.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: Thickly needled pine trees border the path, overhanging the walkway that branches off to the northwest to the extent that it looks like a tunnel through the greenery.  The white gravel that lines the path is covered with a fine layer of pink sandstone dust from the rocky rise to the north.

Thickly needled pine trees border the path, overhanging the walkway that branches off to the northwest to the extent that the moonlight can barely filter through.  The white gravel that lines the path is covered with a fine layer of pink sandstone dust from the rocky rise to the north.

title: [Niima's Temple, Widow's Walk]
description: At this angle and height, the only view afforded is that of the causeway leading to and from Niima's Isle and the rooftops of the immediate South 'Haven neighborhood.

title: [Ye Olde Crusty Shoppe]
description: Tiers of bronzed lobster lanterns banish all the shadows from the tiny gift shop.  A particularly brightly lit corner houses crustacean-themed artwork in the form of a giant statue and mosaic.  Numerous tacky souvenirs lay sprawled out upon a rickety counter, adjacent to a pair of warped tables and a dusty stack of crates.

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen, Booth]
description: A large brass crab hangs on the nearest wall of this small, cramped booth, its pinchers raised menacingly toward some unseen enemy.  A variety of crude carvings border the table haphazardly in a vain attempt to imitate the crustacean, though it's quite obvious the artist was lacking in talent.  A small oil lamp hangs upon the low ceiling, imparting a sense of intimacy in the small booth.

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen, Booth]
description: A brass-framed painting depicting a shark swimming through the ocean's depths is hung on the wall of this small booth.  Several gold-hued fish border the edges of the quaint little table set between the two benches of the booth, though some have been pried off as evident by the fish-shaped outlines punctuating the oddly-numbered patterns.  Two oil lamps are suspended from the edge of the small booth to impart ample light upon the area.

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen, Booth]
description: The low ceiling is covered with a detailed painting of a nymphish young woman clad in draping seaweed, a bright smile upon her face as she rises up amid the large waves.  A border of pink clam shells are inset upon the sides of the table, some a bit more chipped than others.  Dark blue velvet provides a comfortable seating in the cozy little booth, though a few stains are visible upon its soft surface.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Grand Foyer]
[Wehnimer's Museum, Grand Lobby]
description: White marble columns, set halfway into the walls, serve as both decoration and structural support for the high ceiling.  Set between them are some colorful velvet settees that offer respite for weary patrons.  The cool marble floor is interrupted by a pale gold carpet that leads up an expansive staircase.  In the center of the western wall is a green marble arch, while the eastern wall sports a white marble arch.  Across the room from a gold marble arch, a large platinum plaque and a rectangular white sign are displayed beside the oaken double doors that lead outside.

You are in the grand entry hall of the Wehnimer's Museum.  This building houses much ancient and historical lore, artifacts and antiquities.  The museum complex consists of galleries bedecked in fine works of art, wings devoted to historical artifacts, a library of rare manuscripts, a wing devoted to the natural history of Elanthia, and a Hall of Magic and Technology.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen, Booth]
description: A low ceiling arches over the booth, its surface painted with a slightly peeling rendition of a kraken pulling a large ship underneath the waves.  Dark crimson leather lines the twin benches that face each other, and a half-hearted attempt to mend the various tears on them imparts a ragged look.  An iron porthole is set near the table, bits of rust showing around the large bolts of the circular window.

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen, Booth]
description: The use of green in this room is astounding to the point of being appalling.  A massive sea turtle is painted in vivid color and detail across the arcing ceiling.  A sea green-paned oil lamp suspended overhead casts an uneasy, dim light that resembles the rippling waves of the sea.  Dark verdant leather covers the long benches, bits of stuffing showing here and there from several tears.

title: [Andraiah's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is an elegantly carved oak armoire on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Sea Troll's Kitchen, Counter]
description: A huge length of driftwood serves as the counter, its surface unpolished and quite rough.  Stools padded with leather offer comfortable seating, though the material is slashed in some places and the legs look like they've been mended more than once.  Shells and various other nautical trinkets hang along the walls, cast in a moody light from several kraken-oil lamps suspended over the counter.  The smell of cooking food wafts from the doors of the southernmost wall.

title: [Gryphon Holding, Barbican]
description: Dark grey stone blocks arch overhead in a barrel vault that supports the tower above, and brass lanterns hang high in the corners, glowing in warm invitation.  The stone floor is barely visible beneath a thick layer of heavily tamped sawdust and sand.  A narrow passage continues northward through an arch leading toward a verdant bailey.

title: [Penitentiary, Entry]
description: Hulking granite walls securely enclose the room.  A large duty desk, with a rickety oak chair behind it, sprawls along one wall.  A faintly sour smell drifts into the room through a large, barred gate to the south, and an iron portcullis on the north wall offers access to the courtyard.

title: [Penitentiary, Warden's Office]
description: Warmth infuses the room as it radiates from the fire crackling in the marble fireplace.  Large, walnut bookcases fill one wall from floor to ceiling, stuffed with titles from every imaginable topic.  An imposing desk sits in the back of the room, its dark walnut finish gleaming with the flickering firelight.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Crag]
description: A grey and moist sea of mist envelops the crag, making it quite impossible to see more than an arm's length or two.  The moist air makes the small, granite mountain top slick and treacherous, but also adds a vibrancy to the blue-grey hued rock.  Occasional icy blasts of wind make the mist swirl hypnotically.

title: [Aunt Marnie's Solace]
description: A wizened human woman sits behind a weathered bar, watching the small stage set up in the corner.  Groups of musicians take turns performing, their soft music passing over a scattering of dancing couples.  A heavy, salty breeze enters through the open windows.

title: [Chapel]
description: Soft light through the open double doors illuminates the whole of this small chapel.  Plain stone walls are decorated with bundles of local herbs and dried flowers, and a cloth-covered altar rests towards the back of the structure.

title: [Aunt Marnie's Solace, Patio]
description: Standing about seven feet tall, the tops of the four wrought iron torches burn ferociously, emitting a thick black smoke.  Seven stone benches fill the cobblestone patio, each grouped with a small round table.  Manicured hawthorn bushes line the rounded area, providing a bit of privacy and quietude from the traffic of the plaza.

Seven stone benches fill the cobblestone patio, each grouped with a small round table.  Manicured hawthorn bushes line the rounded area, providing a bit of privacy from the traffic of the plaza.  Overhead, the sound of insects and birds drown out any sense of quietude the hedge would have otherwise offered.

title: [Kai's Temple, Hallway]
description: Crimson marble floors are inlaid with diamond-shaped tiles of silver, and the same silver tiles are placed at regular intervals in a border near the ceiling.  Beautiful hand-painted tapestries depicting feats of strength, athletics and fighting skills alternate with portraits along both sides of the hall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Kai's Temple, Priest's Chamber]
description: Plush crimson carpet muffles footsteps and helps preserve the quiet of the room.  A simple bed is pushed against one wall, and a polished ebonwood nightstand sits next to it.  Silver candelabras are affixed to either side of the entrance, each holding three tall candles.

title: [Kai's Temple, Warrior's Chapel]
description: Weapons of all types adorn the walls, most fashioned from gleaming silver.  A silver-threaded crimson prayer mat covers the floor at the far end of the chapel, surrounded by votives that are replaced by acolytes when they burn out.

title: [Kai's Temple, Altar]
description: Muted silver spidersilk adorns the walls, flowing softly from the arched ceiling to the crimson marble floor.  A simple altar fashioned from solid silver commands attention from the center of the room, with several prayer mats placed around it in a rough circle.

title: [Kai's Temple, Athlete's Chapel]
description: Hand-to-hand combat is depicted through the statuary in the room, each figure a work of art in itself.  One statue, somewhat larger than the others, shows Kai standing triumphantly over a warrior, Kai's foot firmly on the warrior's back.  A pair of tattered runner's sandals hang from a peg on the wall next to a shelf with a flask of spring water sitting on it.

title: [Kai's Temple, Storage]
description: Shelves have been built into the walls from floor to ceiling, and are heaped with supplies of all sorts.  Parchment and ink take up several shelves on one side of the small room, while cleaning supplies take up shelves on the other side.  Everything is neatly organized and easily accessible.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: Water falling over rocks echoes from the enclosures to the northwest, occasionally drowned out by a feline scream.  Several brown pinecones have fallen from their parent trees and bounced down the rocky hillside, coming to rest along the borders of the white graveled path.  A glimpse of a tall tower with a staircase spiraling around it can be seen to the northeast.

The sound of water falling over rocks echoes from the enclosures to the northwest.  Several brown pinecones have fallen from their parent trees and bounced down the rocky hillside, coming to rest along the borders of the white graveled path.  A tall tower outlined by the light of the moons rises into the sky to the northeast.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: Waves of yellowed grass cover the savannah habitat to the west.  A smudge of green growth marks where a watercourse cuts through the dry landscape.  Similar earthy tones can be seen opposite the savannah, viewed through the leaded glass wall of the immense dome that occupies the center of the zoo.

Waves of yellowed grass cover the savannah habitat to the west.  A smudge of green growth marks where a watercourse cuts through the dry landscape.  Similar earthy tones can be seen opposite the savannah, viewed through the translucent glaes wall of the immense dome that occupies the center of the zoo.

Waves of grass that cover the savannah habitat to the west are ocean-dark in the dim light of the moons.  A smudge of leafy growth marks where a watercourse cuts through the dry landscape.  The moonlight reflects dimly off the glaes wall of the immense dome that occupies the center of the zoo.

title: [Petting Zoo]
description: Three paths split off from the entrance, the stone ground covered with bits of hay that has strayed from the animal pens.  Children run around the area in a frenzied chaos as adults look on in amusement.  An iron gate offers easy access to the rest of the park outside.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: Sunlight falls in bands across the crushed seashell pathway that curves in a gentle arc from south to northwest, illuminating tiny animal-shaped ornaments in the thuja hedges that surround an iron gate.  Soft bleats, barks, and mooing can be heard from beyond the entry, which is marked with bold lettering across its expanse that reads, "Petting Zoo."  A silvery green woolly hedgenettle grows along the northwestern edge of the pathway, its spear-shaped flowers dappled in violet petals.

Verdant green borders contrast with the white gravel of the path.  The dense green-black of jungle growth looms to the southwest.  Occasionally the distinctive chattering and calls of primates echo through the air.  A wide open space, the colors indistinct in the moonlight, can be glimpsed to the northwest.

Verdant green borders contrast with the white gravel of the path.  The dense green-black of jungle growth looms to the southwest.  Occasionally the distinctive chattering and calls of primates echo through the air.  A glimpse of the sandy colors of the savannah can be seen to the northwest.

title: [Primates]
description: Long vines crisscross throughout the habitat to the south and dense foliage provide ample coverage for the creatures that lurk within.  Beams of sunlight filter through the thick canopy, highlighting the grassy floor.  A white furred uakari can be seen amongst the bushes on the ground, while a bright yellow baboon sits high in a tree.

Long vines crisscross throughout the habitat to the south and dense foliage provide ample coverage for the creatures that lurk within.  Beams of moonlight filter through the thick canopy, highlighting the grassy floor.  A white furred uakari can be seen amongst the bushes on the ground, while a bright yellow baboon sits high in a tree.

title: [Savannah View]
description: Tall, straw-colored grasses cover a long expanse of flat land, its area unmarked by trees.  The tops of a few large boulders can be seen, their sides tickled by a multitude of hollow yellow stems as the wind blows through the hot, dry area.  The grasses roil and fall with constant motions, giving the place an illusion akin to a flaxen sea.

title: [Savannah View]
description: In the distance, the distinct forms of hyenas can be seen resting beneath a massive, gnarled tree.  Thickets of fingergrass obscure your vision, broken only by the rotting remains of giant cyprus and dying coconut trees.

title: [Primates]
description: Numerous trees and leafy plants fill the enclosure to the south, forming a thriving jungle surrounded by walls of stone.  A small waterfall cascades down the back wall and flows into a stream that heads towards the south wall of the habitat.  Brief glimpses of movement disturb the foliage, and a silver-backed black gorilla can be seen through the leaves.

title: [Primates]
description: A shallow pond sits in the center of the dense jungle habitat, its surface sparkling brightly from the sunlight that strikes off it.  Several bushes fill the floor of the stone enclosure, though a few patches of dirt can be glimpsed between the grasses.  A capuchin monkey plays among ground while a fuzzy grey gibbon sits upon a stone ledge nearby.

A shallow pond sits in the center of the dense jungle habitat, its surface sparkling softly from the moonlight that strikes off it.  Several bushes fill the floor of the stone enclosure, though a few patches of dirt can be glimpsed between the grasses.  A capuchin monkey plays among the ground while a fuzzy grey gibbon sits upon a stone ledge nearby.

title: [Primates]
description: Several long branching trees make up the primary focal point of the enclosed habitat to the west.  A few of the branches are bare, while several more have bushy leaves that rustle in the wind.  Glimpses of a spider monkey and a light brown lemur flash between the foliage of the enclosure.

title: [Outside the Aviaries]
description: Water-smoothed pebbles of all colors are jumbled together to form a path that winds around the glass dome that encloses the aviaries.  Several tiny footbridges arch over the bends of a stream that meanders back and forth alongside the path.  Lush grass and several plantings of green bamboo add to the peaceful atmosphere created by the slow-moving water.

Several tiny footbridges arch over the bends of a stream that meanders back and forth alongside the path. Filigreed iron lanterns suspended from tall posts reflect gold glimmers off the water, adding to the peaceful atmosphere.

title: [Outside the Aquarium]
description: White crushed shell mixed with gravel lines a walkway around a raised, rock-edged pond.  A pale limestone building faced with blue and green glazed pottery tiles sits behind the pond.  Shadows fill the dim doorway that leads into the aquarium.

title: [Underwater Experience, Entrance]
description: A few short, wide stairs lead down into a wide, circular room.  A wide walkway runs along the perimeter of the area, leading visitors around a massive underwater-themed mural.  Large signs and plaques are imbedded into the walls in various places, offering informative additions to the art.  Two ramps curve off in opposite directions to the south of the room, leading further into the building.

title: [Outside the Aviaries]
description: Two supple canver trees have grown together over the path, their crowns having met and intertwined to form a lush green arch.  Clumps of their distinctive pink-throated white flowers bloom among the branches, occasionally drifting down to carpet the ground.  The greenery along the path contrasts vividly with the golden brown tones of the desert aviary visible through the leaded glass wall of the dome.

Clumps of their distinctive pink-throated white flowers bloom among the branches, occasionally drifting down to carpet the ground. The edges of the path are bordered by square, glass-paned lanterns hanging from low stakes.  The lanterns cast long rectangles of light along the path, revealing the contrast of the golden brown tones of the desert aviary within the dome and the pink canver blooms and green grass outside the dome.

title: [Aviaries, Entrance]
description: A long stone ramp leads down into a glass-domed enclosure, the stacked slate walls rising to support the clear, curving roof.  Bird tracks of various sizes and shapes are inlaid into the floor, wandering along a path that leads deeper into the structure.  A squat, tilted bronze-faced sign is placed near a set of wide double doors that lead out.

title: [Outside the Aviaries]
description: The high tower rising to the north and the rounded glaes dome of the aviaries to the south create a deep canyon that remains shadowy and cool throughout the day.  From this vantage the strange dichotomy of the dry, desert-like aviary existing next to the thickly grown jungle environment within the dome is readily apparent.

The high tower rising to the north and the rounded glaes dome of the aviaries to the south create a deep canyon that is shrouded in shadows.  From this vantage the strange dichotomy of the dry, desert-like aviary existing next to the thickly grown jungle environment within the dome can barely be made out in the dim moonlight.

title: [Butterfly Garden]
description: Brilliantly colored nectar flowers nod slowly in the shifting air currents, raising their heads toward the sunlight.  Woody shrubs interspersed with flowering lilies and azaleas form a loose ring around the garden.  A shallow oval pond at the edge of the garden keeps the air moist and features a wide, sandy border, perfect for the puddling of butterflies.

Woody shrubs interspersed with flowering lilies and azaleas form a loose ring around the garden.  A shallow oval pond at the edge of the garden keeps the air moist and features a wide, sandy border, perfect for the puddling of butterflies.

title: [Aquarium, Ocean Oddities]
description: A thick ironwood frame surrounds a tall, rectangular tank that has one side to the room's western wall.  The aquarium sits upon a massive, flat-cut tree trunk, a few of its blunted roots left to stretch out across the floor like winding tentacles.  Large, dark forms can be seen moving within the water, though the container itself is not lit.

title: [Aquarium, Under the Sea]
description: A wide tunnel has been constructed to allow passage through the enormous aquarium, thick glass surrounding it on all sides, save for the dark carpeted floor.  Fish of all kinds pass above and beside you, swimming alongside visitors as they walk past.  A short metal handrail follows the curve of the glass walls on both sides.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Aquarium, Roof of the Reef]
description: A wide, cylindrical aquarium sits in the center of this dimly lit, round room.  Intense blue-green lamps, placed directly above the big tank, shine directly down upon the water.  The focused lights illuminate the many brilliantly colored corals that make up the living reef, showing off their flashy, fluorescent qualities.  A circular mahogany bench surrounds the attraction, offering a place to rest and get a good view.

title: [Aquarium, Under the Sea]
description: The water-surrounded tunnel continues, following a sharp curve.  A group of thin silver fish hovers near the turn, darting around the watery space as if they were controlled by one brain.  Occasionally, a larger fish will swim in close to the school, causing the little creatures to scatter, though they quickly regroup.

title: [Aquarium, Under the Sea]
description: Large porous stones create a sizeable structure filled with narrow crevices and gaps on one side of the aquarium's segment.  Fish, large and small, dart in and out of the rocky outcroppings, and large crustaceans work constantly to clean its edges.  A small saw-nosed shark rests on the ceiling portion of the glass, offering a clear view of its wide, flat underside.

title: [Solindago Anox]
description: Well grown fiddlehead ferns border the western edge of the gravel path, their lacy, palm-like fronds waving with the passage of each visitor.  Several of the young, coiled fiddleheads can be glimpsed among the leaves, covered with chaff.  An offshoot of the main walkway winds in a serpentine pattern up to the entrance of a large circular hut.

title: [Reptile House, Entrance]
description: Wide skylights let sunlight into the room, giving it a strong, natural illumination.  Built into the walls are numerous small terrariums, their clear glass sides flush with the wooden surface that surrounds them.  A wide variety of little reptiles and amphibians fill the enclosures, milling about or warming themselves on heated rocks.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Hall of Summer]
description: The entire room is nearly dominated by a long, rectangular pool sheltered under a clear glaes ceiling admitting brilliant sunlight and the gardens outside.  Yellow-gold tiles create a whimsical sunburst mosaic along the bottom of the pool, and upon the benches that ring the apron.  Water feeds in through several waterfall-like openings lining the sides, creating a soft hypnotic rush.

The entire room is nearly dominated by a long, rectangular pool sheltered under a clear glaes ceiling admitting the soft moonlight.  Yellow-gold tiles create a whimsical sunburst mosaic along the bottom of the pool, and upon the benches that ring the apron.  Water feeds in through several waterfall-like openings lining the sides, creating a soft hypnotic rush.

title: [Reptile House]
description: Two large habitats are built into the walls on either side of the room.  One is filled with angle-cut grey rocks, housing a basking tuatara.  The other is a small pond planted with water-rooted trees and filled with a few large stones, home to a large monitor lizard.

title: [Reptile House]
description: Upon the eastern wall, a rectangular glass cage contains sparse patches of grass and stone, within the center of which rests a large, coiled cobra.  Built into the wall on the side is a tropical terrarium, its sides criss-crossed by horizontal branches of varying widths.

title: [Reptile House]
description: In the center of the room is a completely enclosed glass aquarium attached to a large, round vivarium.  The tank water is murky, the shallow water covering a muddy base.  The ground-covered portion of the enclosure is swampy and populated by numerous water-loving grasses.  A few coils of a huge anaconda can be seen along the sides of the glass, the rest of the creature obscured by the darkness.

title: [Reptile House]
description: The room looks down on a kidney-shaped pit, within rests a lethargic komodo dragon.  The massive lizard is perched on a boulder-like rock, surrounded by gravel and a small, clear-watered pool.  Occasionally a thick, forked tongue slips from the creature's wide jaws, and the reptile blinks its eyes.

title: [Creepy Crawlies]
description: The walls of the room house a variety of small habitats and enclosed environments for the creatures that call this place home, and a prominently displayed sign reads, "Do Not Touch!"  A bronze sculpture of a strange animal takes up the center of the room and had been carefully roped off with red cordon to prevent visitors from touching.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Stables]
description: Behind the small wedding chapel off to the southwest sits two parallel rows of stables.  Wooden walls have been pristinely whitewashed and the thatched roofs are expertly maintained.  One of the east side azure-shuttered doors has been left open and a small, brown-spotted dog rests lazily in the ensuing shade.

One of the east side azure-shuttered doors has been left open and lantern light illuminates the stall with a golden glow.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Stables]
description: Behind the small wedding chapel off to the southeast sits two parallel rows of stables.  Wooden walls have been pristinely whitewashed and the thatched roofs are expertly maintained.  One of the west side azure-shuttered doors has been left open, and a soft whinny can be heard coming from within.

title: [Outlands, Rockspawn Willow]
description: Too shaded for grass or cattails, a lavender carpet of sun-dappled shadesilk blossoms covers the bank to the water's edge.  Willow leaves touching the water create a border of tiny wakes in the surface of the Rockspawn as it flows westward.

title: [Small Mammals]
description: The path angles around two sides of the triangular, glass-fronted linsang exhibit.  On the opposite side of the trail a verdant complex of leafy trees and thickets of shrubs is bordered by a shallow spring.  A mesh of glaes wire demarcates the civet's enclosure.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Garden]
description: White riverstones create a slender pathway through the tall grasses that lead both northeast and southeast towards various small structures, situated around a small pond.  Set at the heart of a small garden, a simple bench is arranged to face the quiet waters of the pond.  Glass lanterns arranged upon copper poles rest at various points along the path, though they are dormant now.

Set at the heart of a small garden, a simple bench is arranged to face the quiet waters of the pond. Glass lanterns arranged upon copper poles rest at various points along the path offering soft illumination for the area.

title: [Canines]
description: A massive enclosure houses two separate terrains -- an arid, desert-like area strewn with sparse grasses and a lush rainforest area.  The desert habitat has been split further into two individual parts, one serving as a home for jackals and the other for foxes, each equipped with a sleeping den as well.  Heavy foliage provides ample cover for the bat-eared foxes that nimbly weave beneath the forest canopy.

title: [Canines]
description: A raised fence overlooks a woodland plain enclosure serving as the home to numerous types of foxes.  The foxes keep a safe distance away from others not of their kind, which is not a problem in the sprawling expanse.  Gentle breezes ruffle the grass and foliage, stirring the furred inhabitants.

title: [Canines]
description: A granite observation ledge overlooks a wild, wooded environment, offering visitors a spectacular view of several canines.  Running through the center of the habitat is a tall barrier, neatly disguised as a row of thick trees interspersed with heavy overgrowth.  On one side, wolves curiously people watch, while on the other side, dholes wander about their business.

title: [Elanthian Fauna]
description: The well-lit tunnel slopes down towards a thick, leaded glass wall.  Hard-packed earth, littered with large stones fills most of the space on the other side of the barrier.  Enormous tunnels butt right up against the viewing surface, offering a look at a juvenile roa'ter in its underground home.

title: [Elanthian Fauna]
description: Two completely different landscapes are bisected by the winding zoo path, contained within thick iron fences.  A snowy hill stands behind a frozen field, the chill white terrain serving as a habitat for an arctic manticore.  Across the way, conifers intermingle with young yew and haon, while the distinctive sap of the tanik pervades the exquisite replica of the three-toed tegu's natural habitat.

title: [Griffin's Roost]
description: Two layers of metal fencing separate the trail from the edge of a steep cliff.  Extremely tall, thin posts topped with glowing glass orbs are strategically placed along the barrier, each radiating a nearly translucent web-work of faint red lines.

title: [Griffin's Roost]
description: Two layers of metal fencing separate the trail from the edge of a steep cliff.  Extremely tall, thin posts topped with glowing glass orbs are strategically placed along the barrier, each radiating a nearly translucent web-work of faint red lines.  A long winding staircase leading up into a tall stone tower is flanked by handrails painted in bright yellow.

In the distance, beyond the trail, a mammoth nest can be seen, built in the crux of two flat stones that are braced to lean against each other.  A pair of adult griffins fly back and forth to the spot, attending to the structure itself and occasionally disappearing within.

title: [Griffin's Roost, Tower]
description: Offering a panoramic view of the surrounding habitats, the granite tower is protected from the elements by a rippling blue canvas sail.  To the north, the enclosure is filled with a small forest that descends into a red-walled canyon, while a series of constructed sandstone cliffs stretches upward in the distance.  Perched atop a nearby column of rock, a lone griffin stands sentinel, keeping a watchful eye on both the staircase to the west and the steps to the east.

The high-reaching granite tower offers a magnificent view of the surrounding habitat, a series of constructed sandstone cliffs at the center of a red-walled canyon.  Perched atop a nearby column of rock, a lone griffin stands sentinel, keeping a watchful eye on its territory.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Guardian Ring]
description: Interrupting the riverstone path is a plain dirt practice ring surrounded by weathered posts.  Benches and water troughs are set upon the perimeter, which is interrupted at the northern point by a set of steps leading to a small porch.  Pole torches, unlit and quiescent, are set at even intervals between the sparse furnishings, while a slender silver triangle clangs melodically against the porches support post.

Benches and water troughs are set upon the perimeter, which is interrupted at the northern point by a set of steps leading to a small porch.  Pole torches burn brightly from where they are set between the sparse furnishings, and offer cheerful illumination to the area.

title: [Hearthstone, Rose Garden]
description: Dappled moonlight falls on slate pavers underfoot.  Iris beds, their normal colors turned to various shades of grey under the moon's illumination, edge a shallow pool in the center of the garden.  An ancient willow overhangs a limestone wall to the south, its branches rustling in the warm breeze.  Benches nestle in the graceful curves of the wall.  Climbing roses frame the windows and doors of the western manor wall, their sweet scent drifting on the breeze.
