Iris beds, in shades of white to the deepest purple, edge a shallow pool in the center of the garden.  An ancient willow overhangs a limestone wall to the south, its branches rustling in the warm breeze.  Benches nestle in the graceful curves of the wall.  Climbing roses frame the windows and doors of the western manor wall, their sweet scent drifting on the breeze.

title: [Aviaries, Crosspaths]
description: Slate stone walls open wide to reveal a massive, sprawling high-domed structure.  Two distinct paths separate at this point, one leading up a steep path and the other heading towards a grassy trail.  At the center of the fork is a tall post with two white-washed wooden arrows tacked to its top.  The west-facing arrow reads, "Tropics Trail" and the east-facing one is marked with the words, "Exotic Outlands."

title: [Tropics Trail, Entrance]
description: Curtains of heavy leather strips section off the entrance to this large open space, making sure none of its avian residents would find easy passage out.  The air here is hot and humid, and the sound of running water can be heard over the din of numerous, varying bird calls.  A stone-lined path winds its way through heavy, tropical plant growth, edging around a stand of massive palms.

title: [Exotic Outlands, Entrance]
description: A wide expanse of grasslands opens up from a sectioned off trail leading into and out of the aviary.  Cut through the brush, the trail is uneven and littered with stones.  A domed glass ceiling can be seen, high overhead, its segmented panes connected at gentle angles.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: A small but thick grove of eucalyptus stands to one side of the path, a flock of red-tailed black cockatoos clinging to its branches.  Birds constantly fly to and from the trees, switching places and starting loud, raucous disputes about choice perching spots.  Rolling hills of heavy flaxen grasses stretch on around the area, fully surrounding the trees.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: A small herd of emu can be seen in the distance, stalking through the grassland with their heads held high.  Rich red clay dirt is underfoot, and the dry surroundings are sparse and weather-beaten.  A few wide-trunked bottletrees dot the landscape, clinging to life in the arid environment.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: Star-shaped white waxflowers cover scrubby bushes, their shiny surfaces reflecting available light.  Parsnips and rattlepods lie low to the ground, their forms hovering beneath the towering forms of white cedar and finger cherry trees.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: The rocky path continues here, leading to a ring of aloe palms.  Each of the spike-leafed plants hosts towering sets of bright red flowers, their soft scent filling the area with a sweet but musky smell.  Scarred openings on the elongated leaves ooze a viscous, green substance, globs of which lay drying in the dirt beneath.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: A huge candlenut tree sticks up out of the grass, a lone sentinel of arboreal life in a dry, desolate place.  The tree's wide leaves are teardrop-shaped and lobed, clustering together to give the plant a spreading crown.  Clumps of grape-like, rubbery brown nuts hang from various branches, their surfaces glistening with oil.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: Black fig trees line the shallow banks of a dried up river, fuzzy leaves weighing down thin branches so much they droop under the burden.  Lush clumps of lemon myrtle grow beneath, dotting the ground with tiny yellow flowers and dark green foliage.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: Spear, black and bears-ear thistles form a thick, spiny barrier along both sides of the path.  Sedge and rat-rush cluster around spindly banksia trees, mottling the ground with shadows cast by their silvery, oval-shaped leaves.  Birds chatter loudly from their unseen perches, somewhere high in the greenery.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: A thin brown snake hangs in loose coils from a leaning eucalyptus tree, causing a group of triton cockatoos to screech continually, obviously agitated.  Seeming completely undisturbed, the serpent basks, remaining unmoving and unperturbed.  Small sickle and fishbone ferns cling to the base of the tree, their curled fronds winding into its lower branches.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: An umbrella thorn acacia spreads its wide, flat-topped crown across the path, creating a large spot of shade.  The tree itself is covered in long, straight spines and smaller, hooked spines, both which grow side by side in erratic patterns.  White puffball flowers dot the ends of gnarled branches, hidden within the leaflets that sprout from long central ribs.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: A roughly constructed lean-to offers some shade and a place to rest, veering off to one side of the gravelly path.  A few round-bodied kiwi birds scamper around in the shade, poking at the ground with their long, spindly curving beaks.  They take care to keep out of the way, warily eyeing their surroundings and dashing off at the slightest disturbance.

title: [Exotic Outlands]
description: A towering palm-like tree sits in the center of the path, its side marked by a narrow, scarred slit near the top.  An attentive banana-crested hornbill darts about the area, completely consumed by a search for food.  The large bird stalks through the grass and soars low to the ground, scooping up whatever it can find that may be edible.

title: [Tropics Trail, Stream]
description: The stone-lined path follows a narrow, crystal clear stream as it flows over dark, river-worn stones.  Birds of all varieties congregate on the sandy banks, bathing themselves in shallow pools.  Flying free overhead, the feathered creatures soar through the dense cover provided by groves of thickly planted rainforest trees.

title: [Tropics Trail, Fountain]
description: The path widens around a huge fountain that has been built around a towering golden griffin statue.  Water sprays from the feather tips of the beast's outspread wings, pouring down into three tiers of carved stone basins.  Surrounding the walkway is a grove of short gnarled trees, each home to a host of bromeliads and flowering orchids.

title: [Tropics Trail, Waterfalls]
description: A network of shallow streams converge in three places here, each join spilling down over large angular rocks.  A small wooden bridge arcs over a wide space in the resulting river, its high handrails the perch of many small birds passing through.  Hanging over the structure is a single palm tree with a thick, scaly brown trunk, its web-like fronds dropping onto the planks.

title: [Tropics Trail, Park]
description: A break in the heavy foliage opens into a wide, stone terrace.  Numerous benches and tables sit in circles around a pebbled drinking well, offering a place to sit and rest.  A small flock of sun conures hop across the stone floor near the outskirts of the area, searching for anything of interest left behind by visiting guests.

title: [Tropics Trail, Ascent]
description: The path continues upwards here, climbing alongside a tall rock wall.  At a higher vantage point, the activity going on in the lower and middle branches of the surrounding trees can be more easily seen.

title: [Tropics Trail, Ascent]
description: Tiny, razor-edged plant fronds drape over the edge of the cliff, posing a hazard to taller visitors.  The view from this elevation allows glimpses of jewel-bright birds flitting through the lower branches of the canopy.  Raucous bird calls ricochet along the rock wall, merging with the sound of rushing water.

title: [Tropics Trail, Secluded Grove]
description: Lustrous, deep red rosewood trees reach toward the glass roof of the aviary.  Their trunks form a ring, screening this clearing from the trail leading down the cliff.  Cascades of vines snake among the trees, drooping down like snakes.  Showers of raindrops fall from above periodically as birds find new perches in the branches, making the jade green leaves sway and release the moisture.

title: [Tropics Trail, Rope Bridge]
description: Far below, a crystalline stream burbles over its rocky bed, the vivid blue of the water cutting through the verdant green of the thick, tropical plants.  A refreshing updraft sweeps along the face of the cliff, bringing with it the scent of rich earth.  Swinging slightly with the breeze, a sturdy plank and rope bridge offers passage across the chasm to the northwest.

title: [Tropics Trail, Overlook]
description: Spearing through the upper reaches of the canopy, the trail's peak offers a bird's eye view of the lush aviary.  Treetops shiver with the movement of the hundreds of birds that call the canopy their home.  The humid air is rife with the scents of flowers, but contains an underlying tang from the constant decay of vegetation in the forced heat of the dome.

title: [Tropics Trail, Canopy]
description: A grove of spiny black palm trees has sprouted, the rapidly growing trees dying and reseeding themselves until they have grown into a maze of thorns.  The live trees grow together densely, supporting the fallen trunks of their dead brethren at bizarre angles.  Tiny nests among the thorns and the occasional flash of showy scarlet and plum plumage show that a charm of hummingbirds has taken advantage of the natural defense.

title: [Tropics Trail, Exit]
description: A shadowy archway in the rock wall reveals a narrow stairway that has been cut through the rock, spiraling down towards the entrance of the aviary.  Clusters of pale lavender spider lilies, their angular petals edged in a vivid amethyst, grow at the base of the archway.  Lacy networks of vines drape across the face of the rock, displaying showy white and yellow striped morning glories.

title: [Gift Shop, Toys]
description: The dark panels on the wall of the room are each carved with the image of an animal found in the zoo.  Long glass display cases are positioned throughout the area, filled to the brim with a variety of souvenirs.  A large sign hangs from the ceiling off to the side in an obvious ploy to garner attention.

title: [Gift Shop, Trinkets]
description: This small room is at the back end of the shop and is sparse with furniture.  A few tables are placed here around the edges of the room, each holding a woven river reed basket.  A large sign hangs sits off to the side in an obvious ploy to garner attention.

This small room is at the back end of the shop and is sparse with furniture.  A few tables are placed here around the edges of the room, each holding a woven basket.  A large sign hangs sits off to the side in an obvious ploy to garner attention.

title: [Petting Zoo]
description: A snow-white lop-eared rabbit hops about the fenced area off to the side, visiting the edge every now and then, where the children stand at watching it play.  The habitat has short grass spread throughout and a few bushes perfect for hiding.  A burrow can be seen near the middle, obviously the den for the creature.

title: [Petting Zoo]
description: A hay-ridden path circles around a ring-tailed lemur's fenced-in area.  A few small potted trees are placed inside, allowing the creature to climb when it gets the urge, and a small round den is positioned near the center of the habitat.

title: [Petting Zoo]
description: A fenced habitat sits adjacent of the path, a small section covered with grasses while another portion is littered with rocks and a round den that is set into the corner.  A fuzzy fat baby rolton romps about the play area, wandering now and then over to the fence where children stand gawking.

title: [Hearthstone, Walkway]
description: Beams of moonlight trace patterns across yet another brick walkway near an old fieldstone wall that meanders along the eastern edge of the manor property.  Honeysuckle vines cling to the ancient wall, lending fragrance to the gardens.

Beams of light trace patterns across yet another brick walkway near an old fieldstone wall that meanders along the eastern edge of the manor property.  Honeysuckle vines cling to the ancient wall, lending even more color and fragrance to the gardens.

title: [Big Cats]
description: The cougar's habitat has been carefully fenced to include a section of a rocky outcropping, a thicket of pine and maoral trees and a wide pond fed by a slow moving river.  Crags in the rock, as well as the broad, spreading branches of the trees give the tawny cougar a variety of perches.  Stalks of fuzzy cattail sprout along the edges of the watercourse.

title: [Big Cats]
description: A slide of loose shale and rock, dotted with larger boulders, stems from a steep rocky wall and covers the eastern section of the leopard habitat.  Slightly muddy water runs in a wide arc around the exhibit, acting as a natural moat.  Sycamores and oaks spread their branches over the water, their roots securing the earthen river bank from further muddying the water.

title: [Hearthstone, Rose Room]
description: An oak framed double bed rests along the north wall, crisp white linen sheets and a soft knitted cotton spread adorning its feather mattress and pillows.  Glowing lanterns rest on nightstands at bedside, spreading their cheerful glow around the room.  Under a small, open window in the west wall is a loveseat.  Cotton curtains patterned in rose and pale green flutter in the breeze which carries the sweet scent of roses to fill this room.

An oak framed double bed rests along the north wall, crisp white linen sheets and a soft knitted cotton spread adorning its feather mattress and pillows.  Unlit lanterns rest on nightstands at bedside, ready to spread their cheerful glow at night's fall.  Under a small, open window in the west wall is a loveseat.  Cotton curtains patterned in rose and pale green flutter in the breeze which carries the sweet scent of roses to fill this room.

title: [Grizzly Bears]
description: A thick iron fence looks down into the large habitat of a grizzly.  Sun-bleached rocks and boulders lie scattered on the floor, providing a natural playground while several pine trees provide ample shade.  A number of the trees show great slash marks across the trunks.

title: [Big Cats]
description: Long-leaved grasses, in all hues from pale flaxen to deep emerald green, sweep across the meadow that comprises the largest section of the Anodhelesian tiger habitat.  A watercourse curves around the base of a rocky outcropping that rises toward the west.  Widening into a naturally slate-lined pool, the river deepens, partially dammed by fallen logs.  Live oak trees, draped in lacy, grey-green moss, provide a shadowy retreat.

title: [Griffin's Roost]
description: The main trail begins to climb, riding up alongside a shallow gorge.  Thick metal handrails follow the sides, offering a handhold as well as some protection from wandering off the edge.  Hard-packed ground, made from red dirt and small pinkish rocks, leads the way upwards towards a tall, spiraling tower.

The main trail begins to climb, riding up alongside a shallow gorge.  Thick metal handrails follow the sides, offering a handhold as well as some protection from wandering off the edge.  Hard-packed ground, made from red dirt and small pinkish rocks leads the way upwards towards a tall, spiraling tower.

title: [Polar Bears]
description: A snowy blanket covers the polar bear habitat, creating a winter wonderland that is perfect for the arctic creatures.  An icy platform juts into a pool of clear blue water, with an overhang trimmed with glistening icicles.  A pair of polar bears playfully splash each other in the frigid waters of the pool.

title: [Cave Bears]
description: An area of heavily wooded terrain, the natural home of cave bears, has been replicated in wonderful detail, enclosed within reinforced fence of wood and metal.  Obscured by dense foliage is a rocky cave mouth, serving as a shelter for the cave bear from the prying eyes of the public.

title: [Polar Bears, Underwater]
description: Short ramps lead down to the glass side of a huge pool, offering an underwater view of the polar bear habitat.  Two of the creatures slide through the watery habitat, moving smoothly, as if they are in flight.  Turning and rolling, the creatures appear to be enjoying their aquatic escapades.

Short ramps lead down to the glass side of a huge pool, offering an underwater view of the polar bear habitat.  Two of the creatures slide through the watery habitat, moving smoothly, as if they are in flight.  Turning and rolling, the creatures appear to obviously enjoying their aquatic escapades.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: A light sifting of dust rains down on your head from the rafters above.  Light scratching and soft squeaks hint at a rodent infestation, and the fine wood dust on the floor speaks loudly of termites.  The corridor of boxes seems to open to the east.

title: [Savannah View]
description: Gently rolling hills are completely covered in dense brush, dried-out bamboo and broken bits of volcanic rock.  Far in the distance, feline forms can barely be made out, moving periodically, silhouetted against the horizon.

title: [Savannah View]
description: A shallow, oval-shaped water hole can be seen in the distance, large herds of velnalin, antelope, wildebeest and zebra congregating around its sides.  The sparse groundcover has been stamped down beneath the constant traffic of heavy, hoofed feet, and the dirt-covered ground is so dry it has cracked into angular plates.

title: [Savannah View]
description: Patches of succulents crowd a stand of ironwood trees, their needle-like leaves casting fragmented shadows down upon the cropped-grass ground.  Fern-like mimosas sit clumped into wide, tall bushes, and a wide expanse of deep purple ornamental grasses dot the area.

title: [Primates]
description: The territory inside the stone-enclosed space to the south is devoid of the dense foliage that the habitats to the north provide.  While a few bushes and trees have been planted here and there, it is mostly a wide open space with a small pond off to the side.  Several pot-bellied orangutans can be spotted lounging by the pond, whereas a group of chimpanzees sit around the trees.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Main Hall]
description: Walls painted a shade of blue like that of a summer sky adrift with wispy clouds surround this rotunda.  The detail is so exact and refined that when combined with the wavering light from a row of tiny windows, shadows deepen and highlights change, giving the illusion of movement.  Were it not for the four white marble columns that meet the ceiling in bracing arches, the setting could be in the heavens.  Towards the back wall, a lapis lazuli altar is balanced on the wings of three golden pegasi.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Western Apse]
description: Stifling heat is nearly overwhelming in this small room, the result of hundreds of tiny votives lit and displayed in tiny glaes holders set into low ironwork frames.  Almost every square inch of wall space here has been tacked with squares of parchment curling with humidity and fading.  On a simple table is a stack of fresh parchments, an ink bottle, and a quill, for those wishing to leave a prayer of need or thanks to the Messenger.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Eastern Apse]
description: On a small, square dais covered with a rug of azure velvet sits a massive ornate throne carved from mahogany.  The headrest is fashioned into a golden crown set with sparkling jewels of all hues, and the wide armrails are crafted to resemble ornate treasure chests.  A semi-circle of smaller, similar thrones face the platform, though the atmosphere is more of brotherhood than worship.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Nave]
description: Along the backdrop of the painted sky, deep azure lapis lazuli veined with milky quartz and flecked with pyrite is carved into a simple scroll-shaped altar top.  Three gold pegasus statues sit back to back, balancing the richly hued stone slab upon the upper curves of their wings.  Thin rivulets of water stream forth from the open jaws, and fill a ringed trough surrounding the raised platform beneath their hooves.

title: [Aloreain's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls.  An oval-shaped speckled marble counter sits in one corner while a handblown double-heart bottle rests on the mahogany floor.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Hall of Spring]
description: This side wing of the temple features a clear glaes and white iron structure that can serve as both conservatory and greenhouse.  A meandering path of slate surrounded by crushed riverstones wanders in and among towering tree-like ferns and raised beds of exotic flowers.  Benches placed here and there amid the lush flora create tiny nooks for private conversations and quiet meditation.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Garden Bower]
description: Knee-high hedges of heliotrope softly scent the air, as its profuse collection of purple flower spikes dip and sway atop silvery green foliage.  Ringed with a backdrop of glossy boxwood that stands several inches taller, the multi-layered barrier gives the garden a slight arena-like atmosphere.

title: [Aloreain's Outfitting]
description: Blue watered silk walls rise from an enameled hardwood floor.  Just above a pile of striped throw pillows hangs a pearl-handled filigreed mandolin, and a mosaic tiled ceiling completes the picture.  A wicker basket and a bamboo rack stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Stable Stall]
description: A fresh dusting of hay along the dirt floor sweetly scents the air, clashing with the pungent smell of horse sweat, musty oats, and manure.  A small dark lantern sits off in one corner and woolen blankets drape over the low railing that separates this stall from the next.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Garden]
description: Tall cypress hedges afford the garden a certain amount of privacy from neighboring buildings, their graceful peaks softly swaying with each little breeze.  A large trellis cumbersome with jasmine vines arches over a slate path leading to a small wedding chapel.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Wedding Chapel]
description: Small and cozy, this petite wedding chapel has served for many intimate celebrations of love.  Vases profuse with flowers stand to either side of the round white alabaster altar lightly streaked with rusty veins.  Carved into the shape of a kneeling pegasus with its head bowed and wings almost flat, the smooth stone serves as a surface upon which ceremonial items can be placed.  Thin ledges about midway along the walls are lined with white candles that contribute their soft lighting.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Garden Bower]
description: A simple half-ring of boxwood underscored by a smaller row of fragrant heliotrope sets the garden off slightly from the temple and creates a formal setting for celebrations and peaceful meditations.

title: [Aloreain's Armory]
description: A midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs on one of the polished oak walls, and a glossy modwir plank ceiling rises overhead.  A scaled model of Hearthstone sits in one corner of a dappled celadon marble floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop.

title: [Temple of Tonis, Stable Stall]
description: A pair of mourning doves nestle up in the rafters, their soft cooing sounds soothing the animals living here in the stable.  An assortment of brushes and a bucket of soapy water sits near the siderail that separates this stall from the next.

title: [Subterrain, Crucible]
description: Reeking of hot metal and smoke, the chamber centers around a tremendous steel-cased crucible reigning over a circular center island.  Molten metal surrounds the isle, pooling in an enormous basin.  Floor stones surrounding the lake of protometal are cracked and blistered, their centers incised with a hammer and anvil device.

title: [Subterrain, Altar of the Broken]
description: The cool, muted hues of a mural frame the warped mass of a twisted veil iron altar perched at the sloping corridor's end.  Low-burning torches cast sullen light on the narrow carpeted path leading to the altar.  The walls to either side are formed of rugged, unfinished rock.

title: [Subterrain, Altar of the Smith]
description: Like an incandescent beacon, a pure eonake altar gleams from the hallway's end.  On the wall above, a gold hammer and anvil is worked in rich bas-relief encompassed by an aureate sphere.  The hanging artwork's sunny-hued form reflects mistily off of the altar below, casting pale golden heatshimmers into the searing air.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Dyers]
description: This room is dank and damp, and smells of mold and chemicals.  Many vats containing dyes of different colors are crammed into the small space, with barely enough room to maneuver between them.  The ceiling is damp and sports brilliantly colored mosses.  The floor includes a network of trenches that drain any spilled dyes into a single vat in the rear of the room.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Smithy]
description: The back yard is not large, and not very well tended.  Long grasses grow near the high pinewood fence that surrounds the yard.  A huge glaes trough, easily as long as a giantman, sits in the middle of the yard.  The ground near the trough sports no grass, and the soil is charred and scorched.  A low, wide barrel of water sits next to the trough.  To the right of the trough is a shining mithril anvil, surrounded by blacksmith tools.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Alteration Room]
description: This room is well stocked with all varieties of cloths, trims, and decorative gemstones, all placed on low shelves throughout the rear of the room.  A long, narrow workbench stretches nearly the length of the room, and is covered with a variety of tools for leather working, sewing, woodworking, and metal etching.  Several small kegs under the table contain a variety of metal scraps and thin wires.

title: [Mercantylers' Exchange Booth]
description: Natural oak paneling and an ornately carved oak desk lend this small booth an air of refinement.  The exchange clerk seated at the desk looks attentive as he waits to assist the next patron.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary Pawnshop]
description: Weathered planks and threadbare canvas combine to create the most abject structure in the caravansary.  Even the bins that the pawned items are tossed into look like they're reused feed bins discarded by the caravansary stable.

title: [Goodun's Cheap Used Stuff]
description: The interior of the wagon is hung about with a variety of what are obviously used weapons and a few pieces of armor that have seen better days.  These are evidently samples of this merchant's wares rather than her full inventory, and you're left to rely on the merchant to find out what's available.

title: [Sarreth's Weaponry]
[Sarreth's Outfitting]
[Sarreth's Combat Gear]
description: A blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and a modwir beam ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of striped throw pillows sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is a gilded maple table on one side of the shop and an aqua-hued seaglass display on the other.

title: [Mercantylers' Hall, Registrar]
description: Shelves full of ledgers clutter this small office. The dust is extremely thick on some of the ledgers suggesting that they may not have been looked at in years, if not ages.  The working area of the office is separated from the rest by a blue silken curtain.

title: [Registrar's Office, Booth]
description: There is a small cleared area within the shelves full of ledgers, just large enough to fit a small desk.  An old clerk sits behind the desk peering at some columns of figures in the dim light thrown by a small smoky oil light.  A small hand lettered sign sits leaning up against the lamp.

title: [Hagga's Hut]
description: The hovel, sewn from the skins of countless felines, reeks of decaying meat and the acrid smell of blood.  There are no windows; a torn leather flap provides the only way in or out.  A small cooking fire centered in the room provides a dim illumination, and a dried mat of what appears to be krolvin skin is stretched out on a rack very close to the ground.  A large variety of bone and skull fragments are strewn haphazardly around the rack.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Track]
description: Winding its way through the high grass, the faint animal track is surrounded by tall, scarlet sirenflowers that bend and dip in the light seaward breeze.  Citrus trees speckle the landscape, where several roltons lazily munch the sweet greenery.   Off to the east a small encampment is visible, while to the west the land gives way to abandoned farmlands.

title: [Zzentar's General Store]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth granite walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the hardwood floor.

title: [Tarakan's Outfitting]
[Tarakan's General Store]
[Tarakan's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a raised fel panel ceiling, a pair of crossed bones hangs on one of the mottled grey marble walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while an open-mawed greater vruul statue rests on the black marble floor.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Lore Circle]
description: Neatly trimmed grass surrounded by bright white riverstones creates a quiet clearing set between two pathways.  Enormous boulders worn smooth at their tops are set around a sea glass ring and covered with thick blankets for comfort.  A pair of copper lanterns are set into the support poles of a small cottage, while a slender track leads around behind.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Glade]
description: Set upon a tripod of brass, a long telescope is positioned towards the heavens and is the focal point of this small clearing.  Several charts designating various celestial bodies and their positions in the heavens are pinned to the riverstone cottage's wall, while someone has tacked a rough schedule of classes to the door.  A slender track leads away from the clearing towards the Lore Circle.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Pond]
description: High grasses wave gently in the light breeze that travels through the area, their slender tips dipping to touch the riverstone path that leads away from the pond's edge.  Enormous lily pads speckle the pond, which is teeming with a variety of fish that can be glimpsed beneath the clear waters.  A pair of benches is set to the right of the shore and frame a pair of steps leading into an open front kitchen, while a low clothesline rests opposite them airing various articles of clothing.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Kitchen]
description: Open on two sides, the kitchen is supported by wooden posts and sports a polished oak floor.  Large and small river stones form the other two walls, one of which is fitted with enormous baking ovens and a large hearth.  An enormous dining table, surrounded by a motley assortment of oak benches, stands at the center of the room beneath a candelabrum of frosted sea glass globes.  Near the rear of the room is a single oak door that is flanked by glass-front cabinets, while at the front is a set of steps.

title: [Qitha's Combat Gear]
[Qitha's Armory]
description: Beneath an ebonwood beam ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Manor House, Second Floor]
description: This landing overlooks the first floor foyer and the curving stairway that ascends from it.  From here, short corridors lead to the north, east and south.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower Dungeon]
description: A set of stone steps descends from an iron trapdoor in the ceiling near the chamber's east wall.  A single barred door is set into the wall opposite the steps, evidence that the builders of the tower did not intend to entertain many prisoners.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower Cell]
description: Carved out of the rock beneath the tower, this room is barely large enough to be referred to as such.  Not even a halfling could lie down in the small amount of flat space that exists for a floor, and the walls slope upward and outward so that it would be difficult to sit and lean against one of them.  A thin layer of moldy straw covers the bit of floor beyond the sweep of the door.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower Dungeon]
description: A crank with a rope and bucket attached stand directly over a large hole cut into the chamber's floor.  However, by the odor drifting up from the hole one would surmise that the well has been fouled for some time.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower Roof]
description: A battlemented rampart rings the slate-shingled pyramid of the tower's roof.  From here the dilapidated manor house stands a stone's throw to the south, and the diminutive ruins of the village cover the gentle slope of the hillside to the southwest.  The hills to the north grow into foothills before the snow-capped bulk of mountains farther north, while to the east lie the hills and river valleys of the borderlands.  South of here, the manor's hill descends into the rolling prairie common to the outlands.

title: [Outlands Manor, Horse Stall]
description: The ground is strewn with the shredded remnants of a saddle and other tack.  The wooden saddle tree is most of what has survived, along with the straw padding and the rusted metal buckles and rivets.  Every bit of leather has been chewed from the saddle.

title: [Outlands Manor, Well]
description: Although water is visible down here, none of it can be reached because of the mass of wooden shingles that fill the bottom of the well.  Clearly someone made the effort to collect all of the shingles fallen from the roofs of the manor and the stable and throw them down here.  Reduced to a mass of rotting, waterlogged wood, the shingles fill the well to several inches above the level of the water.

title: [Manor House, Servants' Stairs]
description: Along the east wall a stairway descends to the ground floor of the house, while another stairway along the south wall leads up to the manor's attic.  Both sets of stairs look weak, and a few of the steps are actually missing.

title: [Manor House, Second Floor]
description: Unusually dark due to the double layer of boards that have been nailed over the windows, the floor and walls of the corridor appear to be in very good shape aside from a layer of dirt and the usual cobwebs.  The hallway ends at a haon framed doorway, and two doors -- one of oak and another of yew -- are evenly spaced along the corridor's east wall.

title: [Manor House, Conservatory]
description: Overturned planters and the desiccated remains of uprooted plants litter the floor of this room.  The unboarded windows have been broken out on the east and west walls, and shards of glass cover the floor nearby.  Through a haon doorway in the room's northwest corner a corridor is visible.

title: [Manor House, Second Floor]
description: Light shines into the end of this hallway where boards lie scattered beneath a window.  The boards have been clawed and gouged, but whether they were broken in from the outside or pulled loose from the inside isn't clear.  A chestnut door and a birch door face each other across the hallway just a few paces from the corridor's east end.

title: [Manor House, Bath]
description: A large wooden tub sits in the center of this room, wearing a thin coat of plaster dust.  Several small ceramic jars lie on the floor, their contents taken or devoured by insects or something else.

title: [Manor House, Storeroom]
description: Small and windowless, this room was likely used for storage, although no container and nothing of value is left in it at this point.  A thin chain hanging from the ceiling, and bearing a hook at its end, is at a convenient height to hang a lantern from.

title: [Manor House, Second Floor]
description: The windows along the corridor have all been broken in for some time, the floorboards beneath each of them having warped badly.  A pale green door fills the north end of the hallway, and a peeling blue door is set in the east wall opposite the middle window.

title: [Manor House, Bedchamber]
description: Given the size and placement of this room, it was likely the bedroom of the lord of the manor, but none of the furniture remains.  A torn bed sheet lies along the wall beneath one of the empty window frames, the only clue to the room's prior use.

title: [Manor House, Bedchamber]
description: A four-poster bed stands against the room's south wall between a pair of boarded up windows.  The bed frame is worm-ridden, and the curtains that once screened the bed have been torn down and lie stained across the empty frame.

title: [Trading Post, Office]
description: This office is simple in decoration, but the furniture and art in the room are of fine quality.  The chairs and desk are sturdy and functional.  The floors are refinished and the windows sport new glass and fresh paint.

title: [Ranger Guild, Lost]
description: The dark night air presses in all around you.  Dense clouds of fireflies float about the woods, littering them with pockets of flashing light and making it more difficult to get your bearings.

You wander deeper into the dark woods then stop.  The area you've wandered into is completely devoid of light.  Looking down, you find that you can barely make out your own form.  Even the fireflies that seem to swarm in the rest of the woods are nowhere to be found.

Roots threaten to send you sprawling to the ground as you stumble about in the dark.  Clouds of fireflies taunt you with light, but never give enough to see anything by, let alone the trail you're looking for.  An owl hoots in the distance, then the woods are deathly silent again.

A light breeze moves through the trees, bringing a welcome change to the still, unending darkness.  The trees are widely spaced in this part of the woods, which does nothing to help in finding the trail.  A startled squirrel races across your path, and then the woods are still again.

A solitary shaft of moonlight breaks through the foliage above, almost blinding you with its brightness.  A look around in the unexpected light reveals that you are in a small clearing.  Searching about the clearing turns up no sign of the trail continuing.  A lone firefly dances into the clearing, zipping in front of your face a few times as if mocking you, before disappearing into the dark woods.

The sound of a stream fills your ears as you wander about in the dark.  You continue making your way through the trees, swatting away the occasional firefly, when you suddenly find the stream.  You shake off your now-soaked foot and mutter to yourself as you continue searching for the trail.

Thin rays of moonlight stab through the darkness.  In the light they provide you can make out signs that others have been here before.  Peering closer to examine the footsteps, you blink as you recognize your own footprints going off in several different directions.

Fireflies zip about in the chill night air, small motes of light that do nothing to help you see where you are.  Peering about you can't even tell which way you came from.  The dark forest presses in about you, deathly silent and foreboding.

Dead leaves rustle and twigs snap as you plod on through the darkness.  Occasional clouds of fireflies flicker by further off in the woods like passing torches.  A fallen branch laying across your path almost trips you and it almost seems the light will never come again.

A cold, damp fog presses in all about you.  Barely able to see your own nose, you quickly lose your sense of direction.  Looking at the forest about you tells you nothing, as every tree looks like the last one you peered at.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Andraiah's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-veined black marble counter and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [House Sovyn, Crystal Garden]
description: The flowers, trees and plants in this area of the garden seem to be made of colored crystals which chime as the wind rustles through them.  A crystal tower rises above the garden.

title: [House Sovyn, Paladin's Lounge]
description: Lustrous silvery-grey mistwood walls rise to meet a vaulted ceiling with ironwood beams lending a sense of austerity and devoutness.  Prismatic battle standards representing each of the Arkati line the walls leading to a massive black glaes altar set against the back wall.  Slightly translucent, the altar reflects the light cast by numerous candles placed upon its broad base.  Adeptly crafted wooden stands and racks, displayed at orderly intervals, present a diverse collection of armors and weapons.

title: [Lost In The Woods]
description: It is difficult to see any great distance through the dense foliage.  The deep layer of fallen leaves makes it impossible to see any resemblance of a trail.  The scent of oak rides on the gentle breeze.

A small pool of water has collected in a low spot of the forest.  Several oak leaves sail across the puddle, pushed by the rare draft that slips through the trees.  Tracks of raccoons and deer are scattered around the soft mud bordering the water.

A grey squirrel rustles up in a tree, dropping acorns on to the forest floor.  Velvet-textured moss covers the base of the oak trees' trunks and across the bare spots of the ground.  The calmness of the air is eerie, the moonlight filtering through the branches above.

A large tree fell here recently.  A few saplings have already taken hold in its place, fighting for the spot the mighty oak once occupied.  The layers of brown leaves on the ground crunch under your feet with every step.  The forest seems to stretch on endlessly in every direction.

The trees are all starting to look the same.  Each direction looks exactly alike, trees and more trees merging into a combination of drab, natural colors.  The old forest is made up completely of oak trees, their dominance choking out any other plant growth that attempts to develop.

The ground under the fallen leaves is rather uneven, caused by the thick roots of the oaks and occasional rocks that protrude through the forest floor.  Vines hang down from lofty branches, stealing what little light passes through the ceiling of oak leaves before it reaches the ground.

This deep into the expansive forest, there are no signs of civilization visible.  Majestic oak trees are staggered randomly, stretching as far as the eye can see in all directions.  Piles of leaves almost cover the jagged rocks that poke through from the ground underneath.

Finding the way through the woods is difficult.  There are very few landmarks to navigate by, the large oak trees blending together in an array of browns, reds and greens.  Chitters of squirrels echo through the forest, along with the crackling of branches as they scurry through the highest limbs.

The air near the ground is still despite the gentle breeze rattling the leaves on the highest of branches above.  The few clouds visible through the small openings in the leafy canopy are slowly reshaped by the wind's endless touch.  The hoot of an owl in the distance breaks the silence of the forest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Woodlands, Forest Path]
description: Branches cross overhead, shading the path as the forest becomes thicker.  Despite the heavy growth of trees, the path seems well-kept and the underbrush has been trimmed back, revealing occasional small houses set among the trunks. Looking through the trees, you see the edge of a rocky ravine falling off just to the north, and the path continues to the northeast.

title: [Woodland Glade, Pool]
description: A small pool dominates the clearing, casting reflections off its mirror-like surface.  Trees arch over it, their boughs creating enough shade to define the light into bright beams, which strike the surface of the water like magical energy flowing down in a stream from above.  Ferns crowd the water's edge, stretching in a lush green carpet from the bank, up to the doors of cabins built discretely within the trees around the glade.
paths: Obvious paths: southwest, west, up, out

title: [Academy, Front Porch]
description: A pair of towering dreamstone-studded doors appear at the top of the marble steps, engraved with the seal of Rone Academy.  Towering modwir trees shade the steps, making this a comfortable place to sit and relax.

title: [Moonshine Manor, Foyer]
description: Stained oak walls rise from the edges of a mirror-finished black marble floor up to the vaulted ceiling, their smooth expanses decorated with intricate tapestries.  Chandeliers dangle from above to accent the lighting offered by the deep bay windows, while the garbled sounds of revelry trickle into the foyer from a candlelit hallway.  A cheerful halfling host greets everyone that enters the polished ebony double doors, and servants scurry past on their way to the kitchen hidden under a spiral staircase.

title: [Moonshine Manor, 'Shiner Lounge]
description: Plush leather seats and small side tables are arranged in a broad half circle on the edge of an expansive dance floor, positioned for a clear view of the trio of halflings playing music upon a raised platform at its far end.  A golden brocade curtain hangs on a stained oak wall to the west and flaps gently as the occasional breeze forces it aside, revealing a balcony beyond.  The shelves of a voluminous library are easily discerned through a narrow ebony archway to the north.

title: [Moonshine Manor, Library]
description: Shelving and cabinets crammed with tomes and scrolls of all shapes and sizes take up every available inch along the smooth, lacquered walls.  Luminous candles cast reflections off of the glossy top of a curved cherrywood desk that manages to fit in the very center of this accumulation of knowledge.  A luxurious, silk cushioned chair is wedged between the desk and a massive wooden bookcase along the northern wall.  Occasionally, soft notes drift among the stacks through the narrow ebony archway.

title: [Moonshine Manor, Balcony]
description: Polished to a sheen, the dark slate veranda is surrounded by black lacquered, plowed handrails inlaid with elegant gold scrollwork.  Strategically placed, oil-filled lanterns are hung to provide comfortable lighting in the evenings yet remain unobtrusive during the day.  A series of silvery mithril posts extend from the handrails to a crosshatched cedar overhang extending from the roof above.  Between the center posts, a rusted invar telescope aims southwest, partially blocking the view of the courtyard below.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Back Yard]
description: The unpainted stone wall of the building bounds the yard on one side, and a tall wooden fence on the other.  A large trash bin rests against the fence, and clumps of weeds and unmowed grass are scattered around a few squatters' shacks that occupy the corners of the unkempt lot.

title: [Wayside Inn, Garret]
description: Quiet laughter and subdued conversation punctuate the otherwise peaceful atmosphere of this little room tucked beneath the garret of the inn.  The smoke-blackened wooden beams meet at an angle, cradling a brass fixture with candles that bathe the room in a soothing glow.

title: [Baker's Shop, Alcove]
description: Somewhat dimmer than the main tea room, the recessed alcove provides a quiet place for intimate conversation.  A colorful floral painting hangs on the wall in a plain wood frame.  The soft murmurings of the popular tea room and bakery are just barely audible in here.  Plush cushions look inviting and the fresh picked wildflowers in a vase add color as well as charm to this out of the way rendezvous.

title: [Uxbri's Flammable Firewood!]
description: A massive pile of split logs dominates the back of the small tent, and the pleasant smell of freshly chopped wood fills the air. Sawdust and chips of wood cover the floor, and small footprints lead out of the tent.

title: [Meadowlands, Gates]
description: A wide dirt trail, worn by the wheels of passing wagons, leads up to a large heavy wooden gate.  A stone wall curves to the north and south, enclosing an expanse of green pasture and rustic wooden buildings.  Tall wild grass grows on both sides of the trail, and clusters of bright wildflowers grow around the base of the wall.

title: [Meadowlands, Shepherd's Way]
description: Thatched cottages stand along the sides of the well-kept dirt road that runs along the inside of the stone wall, surrounded by patches of flowerbeds and small vegetable gardens.  Several docile roltons roam the grass beyond, grazing peacefully in the sunlight.

title: [Sleeping Dragon Pub]
description: A huge, elaborate wooden carving of a peacefully sleeping dragon stretches on the shelf behind the long, brass-railed bar from one end to the other, dominating the room.  The pub is all dark wood and polished brass fixtures, and the cozy booths are upholstered in well-worn red leather that must have once been luxurious.

title: [River Tower West, Guard Room]
description: This story of the watchtower is dimly lit only by the sunlight from the arrow slits by day or by a few oil lamps at night.  The oak flooring creaks slightly as you walk about the room.  The alert guard on duty is peering north through one of the slits toward the bay.

title: [River Tower West, Roof]
description: You are atop the northwest guardtower that watches over the waterway into Wehnimer's Landing.  Across the river to the east, you see the matching tower with its four guards watching the boat traffic and the threatening waters of Darkstone Bay, which lies to the north.  A few errant vines climb along the south side of the tower.

title: [Andraiah's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-veined black marble counter and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Wehnimer's Historical Society]
description: This room is tiny, and looks suspiciously like it might have once been a broom closet.  A spindly half-round table serves as a desk, though all it supports at the moment is the remains of a mincemeat pastry.  Genealogical charts paper the walls, some of the family trees more convoluted than an oxbow-riddled river.

title: [Tiger Court, Garden]
description: Neatly-kept cottages circle a small landscaped garden, its beds brimming with orange tiger-lilies and roses of various hues.  A sleek tabby cat stalks through the lilies, its eyes flickering green at every movement of the blossoms in the breeze.

title: [Tiger Court, Cul-de-sac]
description: A low stone wall circles the cul-de-sac, occupied by several cats of various sizes and colors who have found comfortable places to lounge in the filtered sunlight.  Gaps in the wall lead up to small cottages surrounded by patches of trimmed grass and colorful flowerbeds.

A low stone wall circles the cul-de-sac, occupied by several cats of various sizes and colors who have found comfortable places to lounge in the cool night air.  Gaps in the wall lead up to small cottages surrounded by patches of trimmed grass and colorful flowerbeds.

title: [Cothinar Gardens, Rose Garden]
description: Rose bushes fill the garden with pure whites, brilliant reds, golds, and blues as dark as night.  They are planted in geometric beds around the stone benches, which provide a place to sit and rest.  The bright blossoms of violet plants, beds of snapdragons and lilies, jasmine trees and other types of smaller flowers line the stone wall, and lilac bushes grow along the shaded bowers that extend off from the sunny garden.

Rose bushes fill the garden with whites, reds, golds, and blues.  They are planted in geometric beds around the stone benches, which provide a place to sit and rest.  The blossoms of violet plants, beds of snapdragons and lilies, jasmine trees and other types of smaller flowers line the stone wall, and lilac bushes grow along the bowers that extend off from the moonlit garden.

title: [Cothinar Gardens, West Bower]
description: Beds of marigolds and lilies line the base of the modwir bower that arches over the path, and blue blossoms of morning glory dot the latticework.  Flagstone paths lead to the doors of the garden homes, and a stone bench provides a resting place under the cool bower.

title: [Cothinar Gardens, Shaded Bower]
description: Bushes of jasmine line the base of the dark wood bower that arches over the flagstones, filling the air with a heady scent.  Mournblooms and lilies stand along the side paths that lead to the quiet yards of the homes around the garden.

title: [Cothinar Gardens, North Bower]
description: A vine-covered latticework bower arches over the grey flagstones of the path, shading a carved stone bench and a small marble fountain that trickles merrily in the filtered light.  Side paths lead off to the small manicured yards of garden homes.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, History Wing]
description: This is the wing housing the Historical Society of Elanthia and its artifacts.  A tall partition blocks off the area where an upcoming exhibit ins in the process of being installed.  Centered in this massive anteroom is a low onyx pedestal, upon which sits the Society's newest acquisition.  Next to an ornately-carved archway, there is a discolored area on the wall where a large sign or portrait was removed.

Centered in this massive anteroom is a low onyx pedestal, upon which sits the Society's newest acquisition.  Next to an ornately carved archway, there is a discolored area on the wall where a large sign or portrait was removed.

Tapestries on the stark white walls depict various scenes of carnage and mayhem from Wehnimer's Landing's sordid past.  A black plaque with white writing hangs in the center of the north wall, its contents the focal point of the room.  Blending into the western wall, a white marble arch leads to the lobby.  A rustic gnarled oak cabinet sits off in one corner, dwarfed by a ruined wooden rolton with a dilapidated sign on it that rests beside the moderately sized display.

title: [Wehnimer's Gallery, Foyer]
description: The black marble floor is polished to a high sheen, in contrast with the pearl grey granite columns lining the room.  Four archways lead to different wings of the Gallery.  Bare spots, with slightly brighter paint than the rest of the wall, indicate where items have been removed from above three of the arches.  The graven image of a female human face hangs over the last arch.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest, out

title: [Wehnimer's Hall of Magic]
description: This hall houses many curious and esoteric devices that appear to control much power.  Some are famous items of lore and legend, while others hint at origins and powers you dare not even guess at.  A narrow, spiral staircase leads up to a book-lined gallery on the second floor.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Study]
description: This gallery overlooks the Hall of Magic and Technology.  Robed scholars, wizened researchers and curious browsers clamber noiselessly up and down step stools to retrieve and reshelve the thick, dusty volumes that line the walls from floor to ceiling.  A few lecterns are placed around the circular library. At the far end, a tall, grey, bespectacled figure, obviously the head librarian, peers down at you, ready to pounce at the slightest noise.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Nature Wing]
description: The Natural History wing is in the process of being completed.  A few crystal cases contain some unfamiliar specimens.

Surrounded by dark paneled walls, this room houses several specimens as well as a large glass case in the center of the lacquered wooden floor.  Gold-framed paintings on all four walls depict a variety of different climates and terrains.  An oak-framed brass plaque hangs above the green marble arch that leads back to the lobby.

title: [Wehnimer's Fine Art Wing]
description: This is the Main Gallery of the Fine Arts wing.  Installed here is a unique collection of art objects from the far corners of the world.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Vlad Wing]
description: This wing is sumptuously overdecorated in a style that could charitably be referred to as tasteless.  Blood red velvet curtains line the walls in between the canvases, and ornate, overwrought frescoes of scantily clad, overly endowed peasant girls cavorting in an idyllic mountain setting at twilight decorating the ceiling.

title: [Museum Member's Suite]
[Museum, Member Lounge]
description: This reception area is restricted to use by members, patrons, donors and the elite of Wehnimer's Landing, to gather and entertain like-minded culture mavens.  The marble floors and walls are highly polished, reflecting the limpid light that filters through the stained glass skylight overhead.

In the middle of the ceiling, a large crystal chandelier descends to illuminate the inlaid wooden dance floor in the center of the room.  Various stained glass skylights dot the ceiling in an artfully haphazard fashion, each one a different scene of upper class society.  Along the northern wood-paneled wall, a long cloth-covered table is laden with refreshments.  Against the opposite wall, several plush velvet settees rest on the green marbled flooring that runs the edge of the room, offset from an intricately patterned silk curtain in the corner.

title: [Museum Gallery, Northwest Wing]
description: There is nothing in this room except dust and empty space.

title: [Museum Gallery, Northwest Wing]
description: There is nothing in this room except dust and empty space.

title: [Ryhn's Magic Shoppe]
description: Mottled grey marble walls rise from a speckled black marble floor.  Just above a sphere-topped black marble fountain hangs a pair of crossed bones, and a pebble textured ceiling completes the picture.  A narrow glass-topped table and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Museum Gallery, West Wing]
description: In the center of this brightly colored room, a small section of rail tracks sits empty.  Several bare spots along the walls appear to have been previously occupied by exhibits no longer in evidence.

title: [Museum Gallery, East Wing]
description: There is nothing in this room except dust and empty space.

title: [Museum Gallery, Northeast Wing]
description: There is nothing in this room except dust and empty space.

title: [Museum Gallery, Northeast Wing]
description: There is nothing in this room except dust and empty space.

title: [Museum Gallery, East Wing]
description: There is nothing in this room except dust and empty space.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Courtyard]
description: A short wall of rough grey-blue stone lines the entire expanse of the courtyard.  Leading towards the carved haon door of the manor, some short boxwood hedges line the flagstone path.  Affixed to the wall of the rather imposing structure is a gilded plaque, and flowerbeds at the manor's base boast colorful batches of delphinium, dragonstalk, and bluebells.  Partially hidden by a large fern is a donation bin.

title: [Inside Tree, Narrow Tunnel]
description: Dark walls stretch upwards to create a narrow, rounded tunnel.  Slime pulses out from the walls, the thick ooze dripping down to coat thousands of small wiry roots that twitch and move of their own accord.  The pale, worm-like roots currently have a tenuous grasp upon your body, and the same cilia-like structures above stretch down toward you, as if vying for a grip.

title: [Inside Tree, Narrow Tunnel]
description: The air is thick with the scent of sap, and the ichor that drips constantly down the walls is thicker than before.  The thin tendrils of living root surrounding the tunnel squirm and writhe around you, as if disturbed by your presence.  The wooden tentacles grip you more firmly now, each holding you tightly as the next slithers down quickly to take you into its proverbial arms.

title: [Inside Tree, Narrow Tunnel]
description: Bright light filters in from above, the beautiful rainbow sheen of the slime offset by the pungent, acrid smell that wafts through the tunnel and invades your senses.  The roots around you move more slowly now, their forms appearing more rigid and wooden than the fluid, tentacle-like structures below you.  Each wraps around various parts of your body tightly, the pressure from their dutiful grasp nearly painful.

title: [Temple of Eonak, West Sanctuary]
description: Towering columns chiseled from the granite rock itself leap upward to support a crystal-encrusted ceiling forty or more feet overhead.  Thick, sienna velvet carpeting extends from north wall to south wall in this cavernous sanctuary, and benches placed in rows march toward the altar that stands at least a hundred feet to the east.  All around, fire billows brightly along a ledge twelve feet up, the licking flames displaying no effect on the russet, woven mithril curtains that adorn the walls.

title: [Wraithenmist, Maze of Mist]
description: The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible even to see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

The silvery mist is so thick it is impossible to even see the trees nearby.  The very air glows faintly, as if the mist were a light source on its own, instead of merely reflecting the light from whatever stars might shine above this desolate place.

title: [Kutta's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and an ora-bound large walnut trunk sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Liabo Circle, Shaded Path]
description: The path curves through a grove of willow trees.  Some snug wooden homes have been built beneath their long, flowing leaves.  A gentle breeze from the west stirs them into whispering motion.

title: [Liabo Circle, Meditation Garden]
description: Mother-of-pearl paths converge here in a large circle.  The stones glow softly, evidence of the magic needed to work such into uniform cobbles.  Simple benches of black marble line the circle.  In its center, a polished obelisk of silver-veined black marble reaches toward the sky.  The air is thick with sweet floral scents.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Liabo Circle, Cholen Garden]
description: A troupe of marble troubadours performs here, their melody frozen in stone.  Small wooden benches face the statues.  Some sorcery is at work here, for you can hear the fading echoes of the performers' song.

title: [Liabo Circle, Eonak Garden]
description: Large blocks of black-veined red granite form a semicircle here.  Each has been carved with images from ancient history -- drakes aloft battling ur-daemons, Arkati walking the land as teachers, the peoples of the land beginning their civilizations.  In the center of the stones is a small steel and brass fountain.

title: [Liabo Circle, Jastev Garden]
description: Statues of black-veined grey marble line the softly glowing path.  Each of them depicts a lean, sullen individual deep in meditation.  Some glamour is at work here, for their stoney eyelids lift on occasion, staring for a moment in your direction.

title: [Liabo Circle, Wooded Path]
description: The path wanders through a leafy glade, meandering about like a preoccupied child.  A few small buildings crouch among the trees.  From one, you hear faint strains of a lyre.

title: [Liabo Circle, Kuon Garden]
description: A riot of vegetation has overgrown the area.  Creeper vines cover the tall trellis arching over the path.  Roses, orchids, tulips and a dozen other types of flowers grow to either side, a cacophony of floral life.  The path itself appears to be mother-of-pearl.

title: [Silvergate, 2nd Floor Hallway]
description: Plush, dark green carpeting underfoot complements the stained oak wainscot of this light and airy landing.  Along one wall you see a heavy oak sideboard.  Two crystal vases with arrangements of fresh cut flowers adorn each end of the sideboard and their reflections in a mirror above fill the room with their color.  The delicate scent of the flowers intermingles pleasantly with the smell of freshly polished woodwork.

title: [Hearthstone, Reading Room]
description: More a large alcove than a room, this nook is lined on two walls with shelves reaching from the floor to the ceiling.  On the north wall, a large window and window seat, complete with soft cushions and pillows, invite you to sit and browse the collection of old favorites lining the shelves.  One shelf holds a collection of the Elanthia Herald, some brittle with age, but all obviously read often.  A lap robe sits folded on the seat, ready to warm those who sit here on a cold winter day.

title: [Hearthstone, Master Suite]
description: Living in this room would be easy, with sofas and chairs arranged into intimate groups.  The hard wood flooring, worn over the years by the footsteps of those long gone, still retains its beauty with deep green area rugs softening the hard flooring and dampening footsteps.  Cabinets line the eastern wall of the room, shelves lined with mementos of the many who have passed through these rooms.  A cool breeze filters through open windows which open to a large balcony.

title: [Iashara's General Store]
[Iashara's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an ebonwood beam ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the varnished ebonwood walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a bamboo rack sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Hearthstone, Master Bath]
description: Fit for the Lord of the Manor, the walls of this bath are lined with red cedar planks at their base and topped with clean white plaster.  The centerpiece of the room is an enormous claw-footed tub which stands at the east wall of the room.  Black glaes faucets match the racks which hold thick terry towels, large enough to comfortably wrap two halflings.  The cedar in the air mixes with the scent of herbs drifting through an open window, creating a delightful treat for the senses.

title: [Hearthstone, Linen Closet]
description: Serving the various needs of the manor, this roomy closet is filled with all sorts of linens.  Shelves are neatly stacked with sheets and towels for the living quarters, tablecloths for the pub and clean cloths for the bar.  A supply of accessories for the bath, including lightly scented bars of soap, fills one shelf.  In one corner of the room, a steep stair, resembling a ship's ladder rises to a hatch door in the ceiling.

title: [Hearthstone, Roof]
description: High above the manor gardens, the roof slopes converge here, forming a small area perfectly pitched for sitting.  Raised above the slate surface, a roof hatch provides a somewhat comfortable back rest.  A warm breeze brushes the cool stone, bringing with it a hint of aromatic herbs and roasting meat.  Voices drift on the air, but they are distant and but a whisper of sound that does little to disturb this peaceful retreat.

title: [Hearthstone, Guest Room]
description: Comfortably furnished, this guest room is a small suite in itself.  Rich burgundy carpet and curtains are highlighted by the white plastered walls.  A large canopied bed rests against the west wall, covered with a quilted coverlet and a ruffled bed-skirt.  A small writing desk rests on the north wall complete with lightly scented note paper, an ink-well and a quill pen.  At the window, two comfortable chairs sit next to a small table with a small bouquet of fragrant herbs freshening the air.

title: [Hearthstone, Rose Balcony]
description: Resting high on the west wall of the manor, the source of the pleasant scent in the air is spread along the limestone railing at the edge of the balcony.  Climbing roses peek through the railing and draw the eye to the sight of the garden below.  Comfortable lounging chairs have been drawn up to the railing's edge and a table and chairs stand ready to hold an informal repast.

title: [Hearthstone, Hall of Legends]
description: Deep green draperies rustle between the tall leaded glass windows that line the western wall of this spacious room.  Overstuffed sofas and chairs covered in burgundy leather have been arranged to provide several casual, comfortable conversation areas for the most renowned residents of the lands.  Overhead, a massive wrought iron and crystal chandelier sways gently from a heavy chain attached to the high, polished maoral ceiling.

title: [Hearthstone, Game Room]
description: In vivid contrast to the rest of the manor, this room shows definite signs of wear, though the effect is not at all unpleasant.  Battered tables, some covered with green felt, have been dragged about the room to suit various purposes -- from a lively game of cards in one corner, to an odd game involving dice and shots of whiskey in another.  An old style dart board hangs upon the wall.

title: [Hearthstone, Moneychanger]
description: Deep green walls and dark oak furnishings give this small room an air of gracious sophistication.  A pretty elven teller smiles graciously as she conducts transactions with various customers, her hands nimbly counting out silver coins one moment, and filling out a promissory note in an elegant hand the next.

title: [Hearthstone, Gemcutter]
description: Though not much larger than a closet, this tiny shop is a maelstrom of activity.  Behind the counter, a diminutive clerk works constantly to wrap and package gems for shipment to the furthest reaches of Elanthia, as the gem dealer herself deals with a steady stream of customers.

title: [Shimeria's General Store]
[Shimeria's Weaponry]
[Shimeria's Magic Shoppe]
[Shimeria's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a mosaic tiled ceiling, a midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the black marble floor.

title: [Hearthstone, Herb Garden]
description: Herbs of all types and colors are spread before you, sure to delight the most discriminating chefs and empaths, even as they delight the casual visitor to this garden.  Laid out in rectangular beds edged by walkways, the colors and textures intermingle in a seemingly untamed maze.  Stone benches are spotted throughout the garden, and in the center of the maze of walkways stands a marble statue.

title: [Galann's Combat Gear]
[Galann's Weaponry]
[Galann's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a pearl-handled filigreed mandolin hangs on one of the smooth granite walls.  A gilded maple table and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter sit in opposite corners while a pile of striped throw pillows rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Orzel's Outfitting]
description: Celadon marble walls rise from a dark-stained oak floor.  Just above a thin gold-edge black runner hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A vine-carved mahogany table and a Vornavian silk-lined display case stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Hearthstone, Gardener's Shack]
description: A gentle breeze drifts through from the garden, carrying with it the sweet, lingering scent of herbs mingled with the distinctive perfume of roses.  Deep green tendrils of Imaera's Lace cling to the weathered boards of this small shack, occasionally loosening a cascade of delicate white florets onto the battered counter set up near the middle of the room.  An ancient gnome clad in stained work clothes shuffles among the pots and baskets, fussing over a selection of cuttings and whistling a merry tune.

title: [Hearthstone, Legends' Bar]
description: An antique mahogany bar gleams softly in the light cast by hurricane lamps placed at either end.  Near the large window to the west, a long, narrow table displays a wide variety of treats favored by the more elite citizens of the lands.  On the eastern wall, your attention is drawn to a handsome long mahogany shelf bearing a collection of colored crystal goblets.  In the shadow of its forerunner, a short mahogany shelf holds a single cut glass goblet.

title: [Old Manor, Blasted Room]
description: This room has been reduced to splinters and ash by some awesome force.  Broken glass covers the floor, a ragged tapestry hangs from the wall, and thick boards lie snapped like twigs among the wreckage.  Gazing across the devastation, it slowly dawns on you that this room was untouched by the fire.  Something very powerful did this, or perhaps someone.

title: [Geyser Flats, Lower Basin]
description: A faint trail winds through a series of indigo blue pools, each one surrounded by irregular rings of color ranging from russet to gold to brilliant white.  Here and there, deep pockets of boiling mud churn endlessly, spurting out dollops that stain the lips of rock around them brown.  The landscape is entirely devoid of plant life, other than a fringe of jungle on the far eastern edge of the flats.

A faint trail winds through a series of black pools, each one surrounded by irregular rings of moonlit tone ranging from dark grey to silvery white.  Here and there, deep pockets of boiling mud churn endlessly, spurting out dollops that stain the lips of rock around them.  The landscape is entirely devoid of plant life, other than a fringe of shadowed jungle on the far eastern edge of the flats.

title: [Geyser Flats, Jungle's Edge]
description: A rock formation blocks travel to the south.  It is composed of striated layers that give it a sculpted appearance, with the wind as its creator.  To the south, the jungle quickly overtakes the brightly hued rock, led by creepers and vines taking the offensive with their snaky tendrils.

title: [Geyser Flats, Columnar Basalt]
description: The trail stops at the foot of a ridge formed of columnar basalt.  Rectangular fingers of stone reach up toward the sky like square tubes of a primitive pipe organ, their dark surfaces tinged in places with bright sienna.  Crevices in the stone make climbing the ridge possible, however easier trails lead off in other directions.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Front Desk]
description: The front desk is primarily mistwood, inlaid with various other woods.  A bowl of fruit near the edge of the desk tempts you with its sumptuous variety of perfect apples and grapes.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: The steps are steep and they twist up the cliff's face in a lazy S-curve like the trail of a snake climbing a desert dune.  Along the cliff-side of the flight, knobs have been carved in the form of sand devil heads that support a rudimentary handrail crafted of teak.  The rail passes through the sand devils' bared teeth, leaving one to worry that the monsters will at some point grow tired of their burden and spit the rail out.

title: [Geyser Flats, Plateau]
description: Beyond the top of the bluff, another flat, stone plateau surrounds geyser holes and vivid blue pools of water.  Steam rises from some of the reservoirs, marking the location of hot springs.  The stone underfoot is stained with bright bands of color, dyed by the constant barrage of minerals carried in the clouds of condensation, drifting across the vista like an indistinct herd of ghostly behemoths.

Vivid even in the moonlight, the stone underfoot is stained with bands of color, dyed by the constant barrage of minerals carried in the clouds of condensation, drifting across the vista like an indistinct herd of ghostly behemoths.

title: [Cobblers' Co-Operative, Lobby]
description: Several tables have been placed around this perfectly square room, each supporting a different pair of meticulously crafted footwear.  A tall display case stands against one wall, displaying the tools of the cobbling trade behind its glass doors.  The faint scent of leather touches every corner of the room.

title: [Vestibule]
description: Well-secured, iron sconces hold the torches that light this room.  Muffled voices and the clinking of tools come from beyond a steel reinforced archway.  A grey wooden door leads to the office of the foreman, and the registrar's office lies behind a dark brown wooden door.

title: [Office of the Foreman]
description: This office has been designed with an eye toward function over aesthetics.  The floor is hardwood with a plain black rug covering much of its middle.  A very wide wooden desk sits near the back with a few pieces of scrap leather on its top.  A simple iron corona hangs from the center of the ceiling, holding several pillar candles, which cast ample light on the room.

title: [Cobblers' Co-Operative, Hallway]
description: A soft, deep red carpet runner muffles any footsteps along the corridor.  Simple, austere crown molding is the only decoration along the clean, bone-hued walls.  A steel reinforced archway leads to the front of the building.

title: [Geyser Flats, Geyser Pool]
description: A large geyser pool dominates the area to the west, with vivid stripes of muted colors radiating out from the deep blue of the water in complex patterns.  Small puddles have collected within indentions in the rock, and they sparkle in the sunlight like jewels.  The flat vista stretches out in all directions with nary a plant in sight, other than the jungle gathered at the perimeter of the geyser flats like an attentive audience.

Small puddles have collected within indentions in the rock, and they sparkle in the moonlight like jewels. title: [Geyser Flats, Fumarole]
description: The trail ends at a mound of silica-stained rock with a jagged fissure at its crown.  From the opening erupts a loud hissing vent of steam and gases, topping the fumarole like a plume on a fancy hat.  Pieces of petrified tree trunks litter the ground beyond the steam vent, victims of the geothermal violence.

From the opening erupts a loud hissing vent of steam and gases, topping the fumarole like a plume on a fancy hat.  Pieces of petrified tree trunks litter the ground in the moonlight, victims of the geothermal violence.

title: [Teras Isle, Jungle]
description: Large buttress roots descend from a fig tree, dividing the path and diverting it in and out of pockets within the roots.  Around the base of the offshoots, plants cower like small creatures seeking shelter within the lee of a giant's foot.  A chatter of birdsong provides a backdrop, punctuated with the voices of other creatures hidden in the rampant foliage.
