Around the base of the offshoots, plants cower like small creatures seeking shelter within the lee of a giant's foot.  The chirping of crickets provides a backdrop, punctuated with the voices of other creatures hidden in the rampant foliage.

A large banyan tree blocks the trail, forcing it to meander through a maze of tall ferns and other foliage.  Vines hang down from the branches above, a tangled curtain adorned with clumps of orchids and other flowering jewels.  Small clumps of broad-leafed plants grow on the jungle floor, fed by water run-off from the giants spreading their canopies overhead.

The trail twists through a stand of tall ferns.  Their spiky fronds wave languidly, tickled by the touch of a light breeze.  Overhead, the thick jungle provides a constant hum, the serenade of the teeming denizens living in the vastness of the treetops.

A growth of large plants almost blocks the trail, the dense foliage competing for light in a riot of growth.  The trail winds beneath some of the largest of the crowd, which hover over the way as if they are striving to overtake the path and convert it to their own purposes.

Tangles of vines and creepers edge the path, creating a wild-looking lace on either side.  Small lizards and insects of all shapes and forms dart through the undergrowth, making a soft rustle and hum with their hurried progress.

The trail twists through a stand of tall ferns.  Their spiky fronds wave lazily in the touch of a breeze.  Overhead, the thick jungle provides a constant hum with its serenade of chirps, clicks, hums and calls from the vastness of the treetops.  The air is thick with the smell of thick loam saturated with the steady drip of moisture from intermittent tropical showers.

A wild tangle of vines and creepers hang over the path, creating a haphazard web on either side.  Small lizards and insects of all shapes and forms dart through the jumble, making a soft rustle with their hurried progress.  Tree frogs peer out from the foliage here and there with huge, scarlet eyes.

A large clump of umbrella plants almost block the trail, their five-fingered leaves competing for light in a riot of growth.  The trail winds beneath some of the larger leaves, which hover over the way like parasols held over a royal's head.

A large banyan tree stands in the trail's way, forcing it to meander through a maze of tall buttress roots.  Orchids cling to the wall-sized roots, decorating the smooth skin with their showy blooms in all shades of color between white and rosey-pink.  Small clumps of broad-leafed plants cluster around the foot of the tree, fed by water run-off from the giant standing overhead.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Stormbrow Hall of Dedication]
description: Torches held by wrought iron sconces hang evenly spaced on this room's continuous, circular wall.  The marble floor is polished to a superior sheen, which reflects the torchlight to further brighten the room.  In the exact center stands a low and wide marble platform, bearing the full weight of a large stone slab.

title: [Gallery, Memorial Room]
description: Polished to a high sheen, the marble walls of this alcove reflect the light from the dozens of flickering candles set upon a multi-tiered shelf.  A mutilated red granite statue stands to the left of the shelf.  A wooden plaque hangs near a heavy curtain.

title: [Gallery, Rotunda]
description: This large, circular room is surmounted by an elaborately decorated dome.  Frescos cover the ceiling with images of battles and celebrations alike.  A massive dragon skeleton hangs overhead, suspended by unseen means.  Over three tall archways leading to metal-adorned vestibules, a bleached dragon skull is mounted, its sightless eyes staring at its comrade.

title: [Wind Tunnel]
description: The wind speaks with a passionate voice, the voice of the damned souls that have been borne here from the swirling storm off-shore.  Throughout the years the unnatural tempest has been known by many names.  Sailors call it the Felstorm, or simply "the Squall", and you remember a mendicant preacher once mumbling something about "...the breath!  The foul breath of Luukos..."

title: [Outpost Tunnel]
description: The warm air hangs still in this subterranean corridor, surrounded by the hill on all sides.  Torches mounted along the walls merely illuminate the way, as there are no decorations or furniture to cast their light on.  The tunnel forks, leading toward a tall stone door to the northeast and a square stone door to the northwest.  A round steel hatch claims an unusual place in the tunnel's ceiling.

title: [Canyon Ridge, Garden]
description: Hiding among the lush transplanted tropical plants and prickly cactus are a wide variety of lizards.  Multiple species of iguanas, anoles, geckos and other reptiles scurry about, basking in the sun or munching on leaves and bugs.  They seem to have little fear of the two-legged creatures visiting their home, regarding you with a total lack of care.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, up, down

title: [Canyon Ridge, Overlook]
description: This wide stone ledge extends out from the canyon wall, overlooking the gates of the city that spreads out below to the south.  The river cuts a ribbon between the blocks of buildings and hedges, and the blue waters of the sea past the docks are visible in the distance.  Boulders of red and grey stone are scattered along the ledge, making fine seats from which to enjoy the view.

title: [Canyon Ridge, Crags]
description: The ledge opens out into an outcropping of craggy red stone overlooking the expanse of forest below.  The river forms a silver ribbon far below, and the mists of the wilderness beyond blur the horizon.  Flowering plants and bushes grow thick against the canyon wall, their fragrance filling the dry air and attracting buzzing bees and insects.

title: [The Hog's Pen, House of Lords]
description: Several large sows wallow happily in the muck and filth, secure within the sturdy fence of oak slats that keeps out predators and poachers alike.  The pen sits flush against the wall of the tavern, and while getting thrown through the window above might get you in, none of the sows looks up to tossing you back out.  The solid mistwood door is bolted from the outside and some semi-literate swineherd has managed to carve "Haus uv Lords" above.

title: [Ghorsa Prison, Entry Hall]
description: A massive bronze seal lies embedded into the polished grey stone floor.  Standing opposite a wide, mithril-bound arch, a monstrous steel gate within the eastern wall gleams like a gaping maw leading into the depths filled with society's most malevolent souls.  Watchful eyes gaze out of a small adjacent small guard station, meticulously monitoring all the comings and goings.

title: [Ghorsa Prison, Warden's Office]
description: A life-size invar statue watches vigilantly from a darkened corner, flanked by fully stocked weapon racks.  Tiny potted cacti with bold yellow flowers sit along each windowsill, offering a splash of color to an otherwise drab office.  Neatly stacked with parchments and scrolls, the varnished mahogany desk of the Warden faces a mithril-bound arch that offers a clear line of sight to the very back of the prison.

title: [Outer Courtyard]
description: This raised stone plateau offers a panoramic view of the wilds of Teras Isle.  The Eye of V'Tull stands sentry over the trees of Greymist, the Fhorian Village, and the gates of the town of Kharam Dzu proper.  A round steel hatch leads down through the stone floor.

title: [Geyser Flats, Mud Pots]
description: The flats slope downward to the south with gentle eddies of rock that grew from erupting underground furnaces.  A few pits cluster beside the trail to the west, full of steaming muck.  Every so often a trapped bubble of steam escapes the clutches of the mud, making a loud plopping sound as it bursts, and spraying the pit's perimeter with a shower of mud.

title: [Superintendant's Office]
description: A single stone bench is the only furniture, yet upon each wall hangs a painting depicting a different battle scene.  The floor is bare and clean.

title: [Taskmaster's Office]
description: Several rush lights hang from the high ceiling which tops this perfectly square room.  Thick wooden beams support the ceiling at the corners and in the exact midpoint of each wall.  In the middle of the room is a heavy desk, built to completely surround the wooden beam that rises right through its center up to the ceiling.

title: [Geyser Flats, Placid Pool]
description: A faint trail circles the edge of a particularly large pool, its surface as quiescent as a sheet of glass.  The edges of the pool encircle it with unnaturally even delineation, sweeping around the water as though cradling it.  Mist drifts across the landscape, moving in slow eddies like ships on a striated ocean.

title: [Geyser Flats, Terraces]
description: The level plain of the flats is broken by a series of terraces.  Their edges are uneven, displaying the brightly-hued bands of multiple layers of sediment that have created this terrain.  In the bright sunlight, shadows cast by overhanging rock are stark and the light-colored hue of the unsheltered stone almost sparkles in the glare.  To the west, the terrain slopes down toward a large geyser pool.

title: [Twin Canyons, Outcrop Chamber]
description: Several large cracks in the outcrop intersect here, forming a very large chamber that opens to the sky like a chimney allowing a small circle of the silvery night sky to be seen.  Chattering noises seem to be coming from the walls of the chamber, which are heavily set with shadows and deep cracks.  Warm air and wisps of steam wafting up from cracks in the floor make this area comfortably warm while piles of refuse litter the floor making it obvious something lives here.

Several large cracks in the outcrop intersect here, forming a very large chamber that opens to the sky like a chimney, allowing sunlight to shine down.  Chattering noises seem to be coming from the walls of the chamber, which are heavily set with shadows and deep cracks.  Warm air and wisps of steam wafting up from cracks in the floor make this area comfortably warm while piles of refuse litter the floor making it obvious something lives here.

title: [Twin Canyons, Rockface Cavern]
description: Several cracks in the rock outcrop intersect here forming a star shaped cavern.  Grooves from some sort of animal claws mark the well-worn floor and an unpleasant odor hangs in the air.  Lack of light limits visibility but sounds echo in from every direction.  Loud chattering can be heard from nearby though there is not any visible movement.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Landing]
description: The cliff trail comes to an abrupt halt at a sheer drop off.  It seems the ledge continues onward after about a forty yard gap.  Cut into the mountain side, by means that you cannot imagine, is a perfectly round opening which is large enough to enter.

title: [Geyser Flats, Geyser]
description: A raised platform of stone with a steaming hole of simmering water in its center blocks off further progress to the south.  Standing in a semicircle beyond the mound is a grove of stark, pointed pikes, the remnants of trees now petrified by a rain of silica erupting from the depths of the cavity over countless years.  Underfoot, deep rumbles can occasionally be heard, the restless growls of underground water pressure threatening to emerge like a dragon from its den.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Gate House]
description: You are in a cylindrical chamber carved from the stone of the mountain.  Prominent in the center is a large, stone chair with an iron chest next to it. Against the east wall is a raised platform, about 20 feet high, with a wooden battlement on top.

You are in a cylindrical chamber carved from the stone of the mountain.  Prominent in the center is a large, stone chair with an iron chest next to it.  Against the east wall is a raised platform, about 20 feet high, with a wooden battlement on top.

title: [Swimming Hole, Shallows]
description: The water is barely ankle-deep where it laps against the shore, but quickly becomes deeper to the east.  The pebbles beneath the surface are easily visible.  Small fish dart between larger rocks while searching for food.  A flat rock leads out of the water.

title: [Pauper's Crystal Lounge]
description: Dark modwir veneer walls enclose the spacious room, while sturdy wooden beams cross the ceiling, support against the island's volcanic protests.  A low wooden table sits between two plush leather couches resting in one corner.  Another corner hosts a copper-banded keg with a heavy slate blackboard hung on the wall above it.  Along one wall stands a tall mistwood bookcase and a wide modwir-framed window.  In the center of the room is a gold-threaded navy blue rug illuminated by a crystal chandelier.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Battlement]
description: You are on top of the battlement platform.  It seems this defensible position was actually used to protect a large, wooden wheel which juts halfway out of the east wall, rather than to cover the person sitting in the chair below.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall]
description: Thick tiles of square glaes form a straight line along the middle of the floor here, a dark red glow emanating from the lava that flows within the channel.  Waves of vaporous heat blur the air slightly, the temperature almost too much to bear in this slightly cramped hall.  Slabs of iron sit reverently in small shelves carved into the rock, along with various other metals of different make and hue.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shrine]
description: The ruddy crimson light emanating from a lava pocket covered by a circle of glaes bathes the golden anvil that serves as an altar in a glow not unlike that of a forge.  Cast in heavy iron, a statue of a thickly muscled man wearing a leather apron stands behind the anvil, his right hand holding a huge hammer ready to strike an unseen slab of metal.  The dark red light from the lava below plays across the statue's gleaming surface, illuminating the man's determined and headstrong expression.

title: [Phaythe's Weaponry]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  An iron-banded black wicker trunk and a large white wicker table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Adjusting to the coolness and dim lighting of this cavernous warehouse, the vastness of the space isn't immediately apparent.  One long aisle stretches out to far back wall, and wooden partitions along its length segment the cave.  Directly to the west stands an open indigo thanot door leading into a small boxy office.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: The office is a flurry of activity, as several workers come and go with bills of laden requiring approval and signatures.  Occasionally one will pause to ask a question or two, receiving rapid instructions, then rush off to perform their duties.  A long counter separates the front of the room from a network of warehouse access passages in the rear.

title: [Silversi's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by natural modwir walls, the shop features a white vanilla orchid-filled vase in the center of its ebonwood floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the stars painted ceiling.  Right near the front is a large carved haon display.

title: [Cylla's Outfitting]
[Cylla's Magic Shoppe]
description: Red silk-covered walls rise from a grey-speckled white marble floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a glaes-skylit ceiling completes the picture.  A large carved haon display and a large carved haon counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Luminescence's Magic Shoppe]
[Luminescence's General Store]
description: Natural rosewood walls rise from a simple rosewood floor.  Just above a fragrant pink jasmine plant hangs a simple fauna tapestry, and a domed ceiling completes the picture.  A large white wicker counter stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Juergen's General Store]
description: Beneath a moon and stars painted ceiling, an Elanthia map painting hangs on one of the midnight-hued ebonwood walls.  An iron-banded ebonwood chest sits in one corner while a white vanilla orchid-filled vase rests on the ebonwood floor.

title: [Herachio's Magic Shoppe]

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Small signs, large signs, tall signs, short signs -- signs of all kinds are propped up and mounted, giving shopkeepers a bountiful selection for advertising their wares.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Tall wooden walls that just stop short of meeting the ceiling of the cave create a long, narrow corridor riddled with several openings.  Each darkened doorway leads into a room that features a variety of merchandise.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: All manner of baskets, trunks, chests, and display cases reside here, just waiting to be purchased and toted off to their new home.  Each grouping has been carefully arranged appealingly, and features notations on what other styles are available.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Tapestries, paintings, and sconces have been mounted along all the wall space available, giving buyers the best demonstration of the way they'll look and operate when placed in shops.  Spread open on a central table are several books that hold samples of the colors and styles available.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Scraping sounds echo as containers and various construction elements are moved about, being assembled to fill orders, or pushed aside to accomodate arriving merchandise.  An occasional large *thunk* is heard as something drops soundly on the ground, and the entire cavern reverberates.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Miniature shop replicas sit upon a long counter display, each one with a different style of roof.  Several samples of the various materials available are displayed nearby, offering some suggestions about the choices possible.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Torch-like oil lamps sputter and flicker at this end of the cave, making the tall wooden partitions appear to jump and dance as their shadows change.  The air is a bit musty this far back, as the ventilation is more limited this distance away from the main door.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Artistic renderings of stone, brick, clay, and wood storefront facades are mounted along the walls.  Each painting represents a different style and smaller parchments nearby show the same feature with alternate roofing options.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Samples of several floor coverings have been laid out in small blocks along the ground, giving purveyors an idea of what choices are available.  Some domestic wares created locally seem to be popular, but several imported options merit curiousity.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Taking up the entire end of the cave are several displays stacked with materials for the various types of ceilings that can be ordered.  Clearly noted with description and price, the only tough decision left is picking out the perfect match.

title: [Warehouse, Erantok's Emporium]
description: Stripes of all shades and materials display here in strips that run floor to ceiling.  Wall coverings of every medium and hue butt up against each other, ringing the room in a riot of color.  The ability to touch and examine each sample is important for the discerning customer.

title: [Company Store, Permit Office]
description: This room is relatively dingy, its grey walls and stone floor unadorned.  A simple table stands near the back of the room, and  line the entire north wall.  A petulant dwarven clerk mills about.

This room is relatively dingy, its grey walls and stone floor unadorned.  A simple table stands near the back of the room, and some tall steel filing cabinets line the entire north wall.  A petulant dwarven clerk mills about.

title: [Mud Baths, Pool]
description: A continuous, circular stone wall surrounds this pool, which is filled with smooth, warm mud deep enough to sink a dwarf to the neck.  Beneath the mud, the wall slopes gently, ending below the pool's terraqueous floor.

title: [Meeting Hall, Ramp]
description: This section of the ramp is well lit, most of the light flooding in from the room above.  Sturdy handrails made of black iron snake down along the walls.  Lanterns hang at regular intervals from a chain that droops overhead.  Cool, slightly damp air flows through the room.

title: [Meeting Hall, Ramp]
description: The ramp continues, the slope becoming almost treacherous and making the handrail a welcome aid.  The air flowing through the tunnel increases in speed as the ramp narrows slightly.  A low-hanging lantern provides an annoying obstacle to all but the shorter races.

title: [Meeting Hall, Ramp]
description: The tunnel flares wide as it opens into another room at the bottom.  The handrails curl around into the new room for a few feet before looping into a circle and ending.  More low-hanging lanterns line the entryway, kept constantly in motion from too many close encounters with heads.

title: [Meeting Hall, Amphitheater]
description: This underground structure is impressive in its sheer size.  Nearly twenty levels comprise the seating area, each level having seating for hundreds.  A small podium, dwarf-sized, resides on a modest stone platform at the lowest level of the room.

title: [Cobblers' Co-Operative, Hallway]
description: A soft, deep red carpet runner muffles any footsteps along the corridor.  Simple, austere crown molding is the only decoration along the clean, bone-hued walls.

title: [Cobblers' Wares]
description: Behind a long, marble-topped counter stands a storage unit that encompasses the entire wall.  The top third of the unit is comprised of shelves containing boxes of many sizes.  The remainder is made entirely of wide, shallow drawers labeled with the names of various animals.

title: [Dragonsbreath Sapphire Workshop]
description: The scent of dye and leather lingers in this spacious workshop.  Sturdy wooden worktables are arranged around the area, each paired with one of several cobbler's lasts.  The floor is pale hardwood, left uncovered for ease of sweeping up scrap materials.  A long tool rack hangs on the wall opposite the door, next to which stands a glaes-bound barrel.

title: [Bridge of Tall Steps]
description: The stair passes over a yawning abyss, its floor occasionally obscured by low-flying wisps of cloud.  At the steps' conclusion stands an imposing arched door, offering entrance into a towering edifice with walls rising in ivory colored grace to a cantilevered roofline high overhead.  On the handrail, a small sign is mounted, announcing this to be The Aerie, a famous theater owned and maintained by the local Bardic Guild.

title: [Bard Guild, Auditorium Lobby]
description: The Guild Auditorium is an architectural marvel, balanced upon the top of a graceful pillar that blossoms as it rises from a narrow circumference at its base on the canyon floor.  Constructed in light-toned cantilevers, the auditorium is both expansive with its high ceilings, and at the same time, gives the impression that it was built using clouds as its gist.  From the lobby, a row of three vaulted arches gives access to the auditorium.

title: [Bard Guild, Loggia]
description: Fronting the graceful exterior of the Teras Isle Bard Guild, the loggia is a long gallery open on the west to the vast oceanic panorama.  Overhead is a series of wooden arches, like ribs cloaked with dense growths of bougainvillea and jasmine.  Large terracotta planters are set along the promenade, all filled and overflowing with a riot of blossoms in red, pink and white.

title: [West Bank, Pier]
description: Crates and barrels are stacked along the end of the pier, waiting to be moved to the barges docked along the pilings.  Fishing nets ornamented with colorful floats have been strung up to dry in the fresh air, and a collection of anchors and driftwood decorates the row of homes built along the pierside with a nautical theme.

title: [A Large Crate]
description: The crate is large, but not quite large enough for comfort.  The air is musty and you suddenly have a problem catching your breath.  You long for the fresh air from outside.

title: [Rainbow Tent, Entry]
description: Heavy iron brackets secure some sturdy wooden stemples that lead down a nearly bottomless hole in the center of the room.  Several brightly colored footprints and splatter marks painted upon the wooden floor lead from the stemples to the tent entry, with one footprint bearing seven differently hued toe marks.

title: [Rainbow Cavern, Orders]
description: Massive stalactites and stalagmites create a pathway to a rickety wooden counter, behind which stands a sulking dwarven merchant.  A sizable iron sconce illuminates some bright green moss covering the stone walls of the cavern, and an unidentifiable, quite putrid odor threatens the nostrils of unsuspecting victims.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Forest Glade]
description: Bathed in pale moonlight, this glade is full of tall grass and brightly colored wildflowers.  Ancient trees are visible to the north and the sound of flowing water can be heard from the south.  A crisp, cool breeze ripples the grass in front of you.

Bathed in bright sunlight, this glade is full of tall grass and brightly colored wildflowers.  Ancient trees are visible to the north and the sound of flowing water can be heard from the south.  A crisp, cool breeze ripples the grass in front of you and carries upon it a strong scent of pine.

title: [Hedgerow Gardens]
description: A florid arch is flanked by a pair of topiary sculptures resembling standing hippopotami.  Bright pink roses are worked into the fringe of the tutus on the large animals, a whimsical take on their dexterity.  A great number of visitors pass through the archway, the white gravel path crunching loudly as the awestruck walk over it.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Bazaar Cantina]
description: Thousands of glasses, flutes and mugs hang inverted from a wooden rack that is nestled beneath the canopy.  Below them, the bar itself runs nearly the width of the square, its shiny laquered top mottled with shapes of light cast from colored lanterns lining the canopy's edge.  Occasional puffs of steam escape a large covered kettle set onto a hearth behind the counter, condensing in a film of sparkling droplets upon brass-handled taps which flank the brick.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Lakefront]
description: The trees around you are thinner here, and you find yourself standing before a large, tranquil lake.  Bright silvery moonlight dances beautifully upon the water.  Several candles can be seen floating in the distance, their pale flames barely visible.  The shrill cry of a bird suddenly pierces the silence as it flies by with a large silvery fish in its beak.

Several candles can be seen floating in the distance, their pale flames barely visible.  The shrill cry of a bird suddenly pierces the silence as it flies by with a large silvery fish in its beak.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Lakefront]
description: Several hand-carved golden oak benches lie just before the shoreline, their wood badly weathered from time and long use.  The two benches are positioned perfectly to provide a view of the no doubt breathtaking sunsets and sunrises visible over the tranquil lake.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Halcyon Hills, Forest Glade]
description: The grass along the path is tall and full, occasionally trodden at the edges of the path.  Wildflowers grow in several places amidst the grass and you even see several small holes, likely the burrows of some small animal or other.  A plume of bluish grey smoke is visible rising from the chimney of a small log cabin to the east.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Halcyon Hills, Forest Glade]
description: Located roughly in the center of the glade is a small log cabin.  It seems to be made predominantly of oak, with cedar and mahogany trim.  A tall stone chimney protrudes from the roof, a wisp of grey smoke drifting from the top.  The smell of scented wax comes from the cabin's general direction.  Written above the door are the words, "Mourner's Cabin."
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Marienna's Market, Garden]
description: A thick round of grass-covered earth sits inside a wooden frame attached to an elaborate pulley and rope system, designed to roll into the opening like a plug.  The top of this hillock has been worked to create a small garden, the bordered flower beds edged with a variety of fragrant herbs.  A slight whiff of sulphur occasionally scents the air here, sending up a puff of steam from a partially hidden hot spring.

title: [Hedgerow Gardens]
description: Exotic cacti from more arid far-away lands are part of the collection in the west ell of the Hedgerow Neighborhood Gardens.  The landscaping closely resembles those distant ecosystems, complete with enclosures for animals.  It seems the original owner left instructions in his will that the grounds would be kept as a living natural museum for all to enjoy.

title: [Hedgerow Gardens]
description: The white rock path leads through a short-hedge maze, twisting and turning around itself in a confusing fashion.  Dainty red flowers bloom on the walls of the squared-off bushes, a perfect counterpoint to the marble sculptures and fountains that hide in the puzzle.  Visitors can lose themselves for hours within, although help lies close by from the gardeners tending to the constant pruning that keeps the attraction in shape.

title: [Hedgerow Gardens]
description: Exquisite rose bushes of every known variety line the carefully manicured rows.  Crushed white gravel paths are defined with white trim boards, keeping the rock from straying too far away.  Couples drift idly along, stopping frequently to sniff the aromatic buds.  Beds of peonies, gardenias and carnations add extra variety, as do the daisy and delicate orchid plants.

title: [Rainbow Cavern, Storage]
description: Carved into the solid rock walls, deep shelves surround this small area and hold many glass jars of dye.  A crude torch that provides soft, golden light is fastened to the wall by large iron brackets.  Rusted nails and wooden splinters litter one corner of the room where a broom and dustbin lie.

title: [Rainbow Cavern, Wisket Storage]
description: Destroyed metal mining tracks, bent and twisted from being dismantled long ago, clutter one corner of the cavern.  On the opposite wall, however, are piles of neatly stacked wiskets tiered to display vials of dye and other various materials upon them.

title: [Rainbow Cavern, Excavation]
description: Heat rises from the floor and mixes with the stale air, creating a dense humidity that can nearly be swum through.  This room is virtually untouched and still possesses pickaxes and the like hanging from the hard surface of the cavern walls.  Several excavation holes filled haphazardly with dye-filled drinking vessels litter the ground and make it fairly difficult to navigate the area, yet not impossible.

title: [Rainbow Cavern, Quartz Mine]
description: Glowing light from several torches subtly illuminates fragments of rainbow quartz that pepper the cavern walls.  Across from the arched entry are a few toppled fruit crates that serve as displays for various bottles of dye.

title: [Rainbow Cavern, Old Mine]
description: Some overturned mining carts, each supporting several jars of die, neatly line the rock wall at the back of the cavern.  The light from dozens of wax candles faintly flickers against the jagged rock walls, causing elongated shadows to gyrate slowly in circles about the room.

title: [Suniel's Wine Cellar]
description: Directly in the center of the cellar is a wooden table with various refreshments artfully arranged across its smooth surface.  Invar sconces illuminate the filled wine racks that line the stone walls, showcasing their contents proudly.

title: [Mourner's Cabin]
description: The walls of this small cabin are made from hand-carved golden oak.  Polished cedar and mahogany trim adds character to the otherwise simple appearance.  A small fire burns within a rough granite fireplace, the half-consumed logs filling the air with the pleasant scent of applewood.  Dozens of candles rest atop a large wooden table, a small apple crate, and some golden oak shelves.  Moonlight streams in through the cabin's single window, bathing the room in a pale silvery glow.

description: The northwesternmost corner of the glade is surrounded on three sides by oak saplings and thick brush.  Further to the north, the forest becomes thicker.  Older, even ancient, trees are visible through the sparse foliage.  A carved granite gravestone rests just before the tree line, a line of short rose bushes planted on each side.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Forest Glade]
description: The sound of chirping crickets fills the air and the strong scent of pine drifts on a warm breeze.  Beautifully colored leaves adorn the trees and the ground underfoot.  A small log cabin is visible to the south.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Winding Trail]
description: A trail winds out of the soft shadows of the glade, widening as it heads to the northeast where tall poplars can be glimpsed in the night's murk.  Where the poplars begin, the track widens into a lane.  To the south and east, the trees of the glade stand silent and still, and the darkness beneath their canopy is pierced here and there by shafts of moonlight.

To the south and east, the trees of the glade stand silent and still, and the light beneath their canopy is colored a gentle tone of green.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Avenue of Trees]
description: Rows of poplar trees line both sides of a wide lane, their tall, graceful forms standing like sentries.  The way curves gently from the north to the east, disappearing into the embrace of night's shadows.  Beyond the poplars, one can glimpse a moonlit hill to the northwest.

The way curves gently from the north to the east, and thick beds of mossy flowers grow between the double ruts, busy with the floating colors of butterflies.  Beyond the poplars, one can glimpse rolling, wooded expanses and a hill to the northwest.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Lakefront]
description: Small waves roll slowly toward you, gently striking the grass at the lake's edge.  Other than the gentle lapping of the waves and the distant chirping of crickets from the north, no sound penetrates the tranquility of this lakefront.  A single candle lies on the ground before you, its wick long burned to dust and its golden beeswax polished smooth by the water.  Dozens more float in the distance, their tiny flames all dancing in the same rhythm.

Splintered walls of rock create a deep chasm where once an old trail existed.  Below, a tumble of boulders are all the remains of what was once part of this peak.  An arching stone bridge hugs close to the rocky climb, connecting up with a prominent ledge.

title: [Memory Peak, Rocky Trail]
description: Small rocks and rounded dusty pebbles make this trail a bit hazardous, but the ghostly illusion of the white ice dome off in the distance serves as a reward for a journey completed.  A small cavern entrance provides a bit of shelter.

Small rocks and rounded dusty pebbles make this trail a bit hazardous, but the blinding brightness of the white ice dome off in the distance serves as a reward for a journey completed.  A small cavern entrance provides a bit of shelter.

title: [Memorial Cavern]
description: The narrow entrance opens up into a small, dry cavern.  Many niches are carved into the solid rock walls, and stone biers ring the roughly circular floor.  Candles set into elaborate mithril sconces illuminate the area, but the ceiling is high enough to be lost in darkness.  In the center of the cavern is a large stone altar that is chiseled into the shape of an anvil.

title: [Memory Peak, Outlook]
description: Turning sharply, the trail shifts to offer a view of Remembrance Ridge, an overlook that leans out perilously over the severe drop to the forest below.  To the north, moonlight illuminates palely as it touches something reflective.

Turning sharply, the trail shifts to offer a view of Remembrance Ridge, an overlook that leans out perilously over the severe drop to the forest below.  To the north, sunlight glints brightly as it touches something reflective.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: Clearly out of place in this temperate climate, a glistening dome of ice invites a closer look.  The massive structure resembles a giant faceted diamond.  Moonlight glances off the surface, softly illuminating the building.

Clearly out of place in this temperate climate, a glistening dome of ice invites a closer look.  The massive structure resembles a giant faceted diamond.  Sunlight reflects off the surface, creating prism-like rainbows regardless of the angle.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: Frost-covered trees greet visitors to the garden, each of their leaves lightly dusted with a glittering layer of snow.  Fragile icicles dangle from the branches, many long enough to reach the ground.  A lone wooden bench faces the tallest of the trees and looks to be an ideal spot for contemplation.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: A grand winding staircase rises up from the forest and leads to an observatory.   Each step is made from crystal clear ice, yet they don't seem to be slippery.  There are no hand rails or walls, but the staircase is wide enough to be quite safe.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: Decorative crescent openings in the ceiling grant a view of the sky above.  Moonlight filters through the openings, softly illuminating the chamber.  A small white owl rests nearby, alert but unafraid.  Its song is repetitive, but reassuring.

Decorative crescent openings in the ceiling grant a view of the sky above and create a pretty pattern of shadows upon the floor as the sunlight overhead filters through.  A small white bird trilling a pleasant song is perched nearby, quite at ease in one of the slivered vents.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: A sturdy rope bridge leads from the observatory to the pond, its elevated vantage allowing an excellent view of the northern part of the enclosure.  Several colorful gardens are visible, each small but well-tended.  Amidst one of the flower beds, a silver cat playfully chases a butterfly.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: Nestled between two small drifts of snow is an oval pond bordered by riverstone and miniature roses.  Candles float across its surface, their gentle illumination dancing amidst the rippled water.  Slender silver fish dart back and forth, occasionally stopping to nibble an errant leaf.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: Spanning the observatory and fountain is a delicate arch formed from layered opalescent moonstone.  Each piece has been handcrafted, many of them actually cut to curve over the others.  Hummingbirds flitter overhead, their tiny forms darting to and fro in a harmony of movement.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: A tall fountain rises above the frost, crafted in the image of a dozen roses set in a crystal vase.  Loose petals made from iridescent crimson silk dusted with fire opal dewdrops float on the water's surface.  Scented honey-colored candles illuminate the shrine, their soft aroma hinting at floral overtones.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: A flagstone path bisects the small stream and continues down a gentle slope.  A glance downward reveals a large clearing dominated by a sizeable ice fountain.  Slender trees adorned with silver chimes line the path, the soft tinkle of the metal on metal pleasant and soothing.

title: [Dome of Memories]
description: Tiny yellow and white flowers blanket both sides of the small stream cascading across this ice-covered field.  A rainbow of butterflies hover about the flowers, their movements creating an everchanging portrait of color against the snowy white backdrop.  A pair of curved wooden benches face each other, allowing for soft conversation or peaceful meditation.

title: [Hidden Canyon, Switchback]
description: A sharp switchback turns here as the path negotiates a steep climb, the earthy banks along the inner side slowing eroding and exposing gnarled roots from ancient tree growth towering above.  Tiny pebbles on the narrow path make walking along the incline a bit of a challenge.

title: [Hidden Canyon, Switchback]
description: Breaks in the surrounding forest canopy offer glimpses of solid dark expanses above and below, with only the occasional soft moonbeam to guide a steady foot along the twisting path.
Breaks in the surrounding forest canopy offer glimpses of the canyon floor below and the sky above, lightening the dark cover created by the trees that guard this twisting path.

title: [Hidden Canyon, Switchback]
description: Slender aspens and birches stand sentry to the taller haon and monir trees, marking the change from meadow to forest at this juncture with the switchback path.  Varying lengths of moonbeams glow softly like pale candles, lighting the way as the dirt road climbs up from the valley floor.

Slender aspens and birches stand sentry to the taller haon and monir trees, marking the change from meadow to forest at this juncture with the switchback path.  Varying lengths of sunbeams light the way as the dirt road climbs up from the valley floor.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Valley]
description: A wide expanse of verdant meadow extends out to a silhouetted riparian buffer ringing the canyon and obscuring the trail weaving alongside a meandering creek.  The stillness of the night air allows the soft babbling sounds of the water to wash over the field, while the starry sky above intrigues even the most novice astronomer.  Several marble arbors are lit with oil lamps, providing refuge from inclement weather or merely a peaceful setting for quiet contemplation.

A wide expanse of verdant meadow extends out to a riparian buffer that rings the canyon, obscuring the trail weaving alongside a meandering creek.  From the path opening here, there is a view of an enclosed field full of wildflowers and dotted with marble arbors that provide several peaceful settings to inspire relaxation and introspection.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Valley]
description: Stretching from canyon wall to canyon wall, tall grass waves in the gentle night air like a dark ocean.  Several marble-columned arbors stand discreetly distant from each other, their flickering oil lanterns adding a touch of warmth to the peaceful settings for those gathering here.

Stretching from canyon wall to canyon wall, tall grass waves in the soft breeze like a verdant ocean.  Butterflies flit among the myriad of blossoms that play hide and seek amid the slender blades.  Purple clover, golden aster, blue larkspur, and red monkeyflower dance as bees land on their heads.  Several marble-columned arbors stand discreetly distant from each other, providing peaceful settings for those gathering here.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: The lush riparian growth accompanying the slow creek tapers off to a small stand of chaparral, as the thinning stream slips into a narrow crevice in the wall of rock that surrounds much of the canyon.  Three glorious waterfalls spill forth from the plateau above, each uniquely different.  Silvery moonlight is reflected from each, like the sparkling facets of a pure diamond.

The lush riparian growth accompanying the slow creek tapers off to a small stand of chaparral, as the thinning stream slips into a narrow crevice in the wall of rock that surrounds much of the canyon.  Three glorious waterfalls spill forth from the plateau above, each uniquely different.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Arbor]
description: Grey-green serpentine rock streaked with white quartz and flecked with silvery mica is carved to form a low three-sided wall resembling a leafy bower.  Ivy-twined poles at the four corner points shoot up to suspend a canopy of sheer gossamer, and the fabric shimmers with a ghostly glow in the moonlight.  Two baskets of draping fragrant jasmine add just the right touch to the peaceful setting.

Grey-green serpentine rock streaked with white quartz and flecked with silvery mica is carved to form a low three-sided wall resembling a leafy bower.  Ivy-twined poles at the four corner points shoot up to suspend a canopy of sheer gossamer.  Two baskets of draping fragrant jasmine add just the right touch to the peaceful setting.  From this vantage point, several other arbors are visible across the wide meadow, as is the narrow ridge of trees that hides the ascent out of the canyon.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Valley]
description: Pale sandstone cliffs encircle the valley floor, ghostly in the moonlight, and plumed with a dark crown of trees running along the ridgeway.  The sound of several waterfalls echo in the darkness, but the sound is somewhat soothing.

Pale sandstone cliffs encircle the valley floor, plumed with a crown of trees running along the ridgeway.  Trails and ledges climb down the steep slopes, dotted with thick clumps of tenacious brush that clings to the less than hospitable soil and provides a refuge for the local fauna.  Three waterfalls spill forth, each more glorious than the next.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Arbor]
description: Pink marble columns streaked with white quartz, black obsidian, and flecks of silvery mica hide beneath a lattice roof thickly covered with honeysuckle vines.  Sheltered by the trees that hug the creek at the base of the cliffs, the small arbor hides from the moonlight, yet still gazes out over the meadow domed with a star-filled sky.  The susurrus of rushing water nearby marks a small trailhead to the south.

Pink marble columns streaked with white quartz, black obsidian, and flecks of silvery mica hide beneath a lattice roof thickly covered with honeysuckle vines.  Sheltered by the trees that hug the creek at the base of the cliffs, the small arbor is protected from the bright sun much of the day.  The susurrus of rushing water nearby marks a small trailhead to the south.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trailhead]
description: A small clearing gives way to a narrow southeasterly trail that traces along a rushing creek.  Rounded stones in a myriad of hues line the bed of the waterway, some built up in spots to create small burbling fountains.  Moonlight drifting down through the leafy canopy overhead playfully sparkles on the glistening protrusions.

A small clearing gives way to a narrow southeasterly trail that traces along a rushing creek.  Rounded stones in a myriad of hues line the bed of the waterway, some built up in spots to create small burbling fountains.  Sunlight drifting down through the leafy canopy overhead playfully sparkles on the glistening protrusions.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: The trail splits here, crossing over the creek by way of an arrangement of small stepping stones, framing the shallow sloping banks hiding under bordering trees.  Wintergreen and watercress grow in abundance amid the thick moss buffering the twin shores.  The outer trail continues under the riparian tunnel ringing the canyon, while the inner trail moves off towards Archer Falls.

title: [Archer Falls, Basin]
description: Relentless pounding fury fills this pool at the basin of Archer Falls.  Cooling spray can be felt even at the farthest reach this close to the trail, the direct result of the arching white cascade.  A jutting ledge at the top of the falls forces the roaring water to fan out, extending like a well-tuned bow for which it has been named.  A small rock shelf from a parallel cliff wall can be reached in a short climb, promising a magnificent view.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: The sound of Archer Falls is almost deafening, its cascade visible in part through breaks in the trees.  The creek turns here, widening and picking up speed as it courses alongside the trail.  A decaying tree trunk that once blocked its path has created a tiny pool that spills over the lichen-covered wood in a silvery curtain.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: Black-striped silvery white bark from beech trees shimmers in the moonlight, with their leafy crowns interlacing above as they lean in towards each other from the opposing stream banks.  A solitary owl hoots from its nearby perch, breaking the hypnotic stillness created by the rushing water.

Curls of black-striped silvery white bark from beech trees reveal the warm brown wood beneath, their leafy crowns interlacing above as they lean in towards each other from the opposing stream banks.  A pair of otters, their oily fur sleek from playing in the creek, romp from stone to stone.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Arbor]
description: Standing out from the main trail, columns of grey-blue marble streaked with pyrite and serpentine support a pale haon cross-beam roof.  Spiraled cypress trees stand tall, extending out like wings from two sides of the arbor.  Nearby, the soft sound of Leaping Falls serves as a backdrop to the view of the starlit sky extending out above.

Standing out from the main trail, columns of grey-blue marble streaked with pyrite and serpentine support a pale haon cross-beam roof.  Spiraled cypress trees stand tall, extending out like wings from two sides of the arbor.  Nearby, the soft sound of Leaping Falls serves as a backdrop to the view of the open meadow extending out in front.  Soaring hawks dive and turn, riding the thermals rising up at the canyon walls.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: Curving back under the trees that line the creek, the trail resumes its faithful path after snaking out into the meadow towards a grey-blue marble arbor.  Leaping Falls can be viewed through the birches and aspens that crowd along the waterway.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: A branch of the trail parts company here with the creekside, crossing over a small wooden bridge, while the other remains faithful and continues to run along the cliff base.  Moonlight fills the small clearing on the other side, where a ring of jumbled rocks have fallen from above.

A branch of the trail parts company here with the creekside, crossing over a small wooden bridge, while the other remains faithful and continues to run along the cliff base.  Sun breaks out in full on the other side, in a small clearing ringed with a jumble of stones.

title: [Leaping Falls, Basin]
description: Tall and graceful, this triple-step waterfall cascades from tier to tier, moving down the cliff wall in gentle leaps.  Rock shelves extend out, catching the thin streaming spray in a shallow pool that spills over the downsloping side.  Twice more the falls are snagged, until it washes down the remaining canyon wall, to constantly renew the clear basin.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: At this point in the trail, halfway around the valley floor, the forested switchback wedge that leads into this remote cul-de-sac is barely visible, even with all three moons full and bright.  The sandstone cliffs enclose the wildflower-filled field like a coliseum.  Tree-sheltered trails lead off in two directions, leading back the way you came, or onward to complete the circle.

At this point in the trail, halfway around the valley floor, the forested switchback wedge that leads into this remote cul-de-sac is barely visible.  The sandstone cliffs enclose the wildflower-filled field like a coliseum.  Tree-sheltered trails lead off in two directions, leading back the way you came, or onward to complete the circle.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: Circling perfectly here is a small stand of aspens, the undersides of the spade-like leaves a soft silver in the moonlight.  At the center, a large river stone sits, its top flat like an altar and holding many offerings from those who have visited.  The trail continues behind the grove, running alongside the creek that rings the valley floor.

Circling perfectly here is a small stand of aspens, their green and golden spade-like leaves fluttering in the breeze.  At the center, a large river stone, its top flat like an altar and holding many offerings from those who have visited.  The trail continues behind the grove, running alongside the creek that rings the valley floor.

title: [Archer Falls, Ledge]
description: Not as narrow a precipice as it seems from below, this rock shelf can easily hold several people and is directly across from the widest point of the arching waterfall.  Down below, foamy water churns in a deep basin, then runs off into a creek that encircles the canyon floor.  Above, the fine mist picks out a pale moonbow that forms from the soft lunar light.

Not as narrow a precipice as it seems from below, this rock shelf can easily hold several people and is directly across from the widest point of the arching waterfall.  Down below, foamy water churns in a deep basin, then runs off into a creek that encircles the canyon floor.  Above, the fine mist picks out a colorful rainbow that intensifies underneath the bright sun.

title: [Leaping Falls, Boulders]
description: A series of boulders work to create steps to this small crown, the top of which is covered with lush moss, thriving heartily from the near constant moisture in the air.  Level with the last tier, the view of the clear pool below provides an excellent vantage to watch errant swimmers ducking in and out of the moonlight.

A series of boulders work to create steps to this small crown, the top of which is covered with lush moss, thriving heartily from the near constant moisture in the air.  Level with the last tier, the view of the clear pool below provides an excellent vantage to watch errant swimmers.  Beyond the tops of the trees, the vast meadow stretches out like a green sea, broken only by the decorative arbors placed here and there for gatherings.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Arbor]
description: The trail breaks at this junction, circling a white marble arbor veined with pale pink granite and vibrant carnelian.  Tightly closed cream-hued passionflowers are partially hidden amid their lush green foliage as they climb the four corner pillars and creep along the open-weave ora mesh above.

The trail breaks at this junction, circling a white marble arbor veined with pale pink granite and vibrant carnelian.  Cream-hued passionflowers with deep purple centers climb the four corner pillars and creep along the open-weave ora mesh above.  The full blossoms release their exotically sweet and comforting scent.  Following the path of the sun, they welcome the golden rays that light up their pollen-coasted pistils like tiny golden charms.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: A small riverstone cairn sits alongside the trail here, but, rather than serve as a burial mound, the rocks provide a bier for the recently succumbed and mourned.  Trees and brush have been cleared away, creating a small amphitheater for the grieving in attendance.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: Rushing water from nearby Gladiator Falls creates a soft roar, muffled by a baffle of tall, speckled alders lining this well-worn trail.  Pale violet lady slippers flourish at the base of the taller trees, their delicate blossoms gently shivering at the slightest breeze.  The trail splits here, with part of the path heading southwest to the waterfall.

title: [Gladiator Falls, Basin]
description: Only found by way of a narrow break in the surrounding trees, the round clearing provides an impressive setting for the wide, crescent-shaped waterfall.  Stones ring the basin, like seats in an arena, covered along the top with thick moss encouraged by the perpetual misty spray.  Jutting out from the rockface behind the cascading water, a wide ledge creates just enough shelter for those who dare to wander close.

title: [Gladiator Falls, Cave]
description: Deafening thunder from the torrents of water makes conversation difficult here, yet provides an awesome display of the raw power of Gladiator Falls.  Sound echoes against arched walls hollowed by the elements.

title: [Contemplation Canyon, Trail]
description: Several young bay laurels grow upon the creek bank, their pungent spicy scent released as squirrels and birds rustle the leaves.  Spore-dotted ferns arranged in knee-high clumps follow the meandering route of the trickling flow.

title: [Forest, Wooden Bridge]
description: An arched wooden bridge has been constructed to provide safe and dry passage over the rushing creek that winds through the center of this forest.  A footpath starts at the base of the bridge and meanders through the forest heading north.

title: [Forest, Wooden Bridge]
description: A small patch of moonlight peeks through the lush forest canopy overhead, creating a beam of light right at the base of an oak tree.  Dozens of wildflowers are illuminated by the beam, blooming thicker here than most other places in the forest.  Built over a wide rushing creek is a small wooden bridge.

A small patch of sunlight peeks through the lush forest canopy overhead, creating a beam of light right at the base of an oak tree.  Dozens of wildflowers thrive in the beam, blooming thicker here than most other places in the forest.  Built over a wide rushing creek is a small wooden bridge.

title: [Forest, Dusty Path]
description: Lazily winding between the tall trees is a dusty path covered in footprints and animal tracks.  The muted sounds of birds chirping and the wind rustling in the trees drifts through the area.

title: [Peaceful Meadow, Forest Edge]
description: The forest opens up here to an enormous meadow stretching as far as the eye can see.  Tall green grass sways softly in the wind, and the stars overhead twinkle in the moonlight.
The forest opens up here to an enormous meadow stretching as far as the eye can see.  Tall green grass sways softly in the wind, and the clouds overhead move lazily across the sky.

title: [Peaceful Meadow, Creek]
description: Scampering quickly across the meadow, a sleek cinnamon-colored rabbit rushes towards a thicket.  Several small boulders, perfectly sized to sit on and relax on a sunny afternoon, are scattered about the meadow.  The soothing sound of creek water rushing over a bed of pebbles wafts through the air.

title: [Peaceful Meadow, Boulder]
description: Moving slowly across the meadow is a busy trail of shiny black ants.  They wind around blades of grass, pebbles, and twigs towards a small anthill built adjacent to a boulder where people often rest.

title: [Peaceful Meadow, High Grass]
description: As a gust of wind moves through the area, it picks up fallen leaves and dozens of flower petals, creating an amazing rainbow of color that swirls about high up in the air.  The grass here is high, above the knees of the average giantman, and a luscious green in color.

title: [Peaceful Meadow, Oak Tree]
description: Standing alone in the center of this peaceful meadow is a gigantic oak tree.  Wildflowers have grown haphazardly throughout the grass creating an array of colors that spreads across the entire meadow.  Off in the distance a small group of tawny deer can be seen grazing, with an enormous buck keeping watch.

title: [Meadowlands, Shepherd's Way]
description: A fat rolton, looking much cleaner and less vicious than his less domesticated brothers outside the fence, rests in the sun by the side of the road, munching happily on the thick grass.  The aroma of roasting meat wafting over from a nearby cottage doesn't seem to interfere with his appetite.

title: [Meadowlands, Shepherd's Way]
description: A row of bright sunflowers, as tall as a human, grow along the stone wall, turning their brilliant yellow petals to the light.  Two young roltons scamper in the grass near the trail, leaping and bounding in a pile of white fluff.

title: [Meadowlands, Shepherd's Way]
description: The trail ends here in a grassy mound that rises into a plateau of pastureland spreading out to the south.  A narrow cobblestone path winds east into a cluster of small wooden buildings and thatched cottages.

title: [Meadowlands, Pasture]
description: An expanse of field extends to the south, bounded by a low wooden fence that winds and curves through the rolling grasslands.  The pasture grass is cropped short by the grazing herds of rolton that wander here and there.  Several cottages are set near the path, surrounded by small picket fences to keep the roltons out of the flowerbeds.

title: [Meadowlands, Pasture]
description: A small stream bubbles through the corner of the pasture, surrounded by several small cottages set near the place where it passes under the fence.  A shepherdess rests on a rock downstream, dangling her toes in the gurgling water as she watches over her wooly charges.

title: [Meadowlands, Pasture]
description: An expanse of green field lies all around the path, dotted with the white fluffy bodies of grazing roltons.  Several thatched cottages stand by the wooden fence that bounds the area.  A small pack of sheepdog puppies scamper in the grass, fighting over a scrap of cloth.  A cobblestoned path leads north into a small village.

title: [Meadowlands, Village]
description: A large chateau stands beneath the branches of an ancient oak, enjoying the shade of its expansive boughs.  Children run pell-mell around the structure, dodging dogs and geese.  A number of doors leading into chambers within the stronghold claim small gardens fronting them, full of roses and day-lilies.

title: [Meadowlands, Shepherd's Way]
description: A quaint cobbled road is bordered by a fieldstone wall and cabins spaced along its way.  Generous poplar trees shade the thoroughfare, and lush yew bushes edge its perimeter.  On either side, the cabins are shingled with slate tiles.  The buildings are well-fashioned and tidy, and project a prosperous image.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Meadowlands, Village]
description: A large structure rises from the sea of prairie grass like an immense ship sailing the wide ocean.  The perimeter of the structure is studded with doors, their surfaces polished to luster.  A couple of other large edifices lift towers nearby, creating an island in the midst of the vast meadowlands.

title: [Meadowlands, Village]
description: A cluster of houses is surrounded by lush fields, their patchwork perimeters bounded by borders of dark green trees.  The buildings are charming, thatched roofs and bright colored shutters characterizing them.  Rock chimneys spout wispy clouds of smoke, the masonry of the flues well-wrought and the rock obviously quarried from nearby.

title: [Meadowlands, Pasture]
description: Prairie grass nourishes the rolton grazing across the expanse of green.  The herds stretch to the horizon, moving across the meadowlands in wandering, wooly clumps.  The prevalent white of the fleeces is dotted with black specimens here and there.  Cabins dot the countryside, spaced generously apart as if grateful for the ample province.

title: [Meadowlands, Rolton Pens]
description: Scrub hawthorn branches have been fashioned into corrals for milling herds of roltons, their bleats echoing off a fringe of buildings circling the pens.  The animals bare their formidable teeth at each other, frightened into confrontation by their confinement.  A few lanky youngsters hang from the rungs of the fences, eyeing the animals and commenting on the quality of their fleeces.

title: [Meadowlands, Field]
description: The grass grows longer here, as if the uneven ground and scattered rocks make it less appetizing to the grazing roltons.  Patches of wildflowers and colorful weeds grow here and there among the stones.  The ground rises sharply to the east into a low hill.

title: [Meadowlands, Grassy Knoll]
description: Thick green grass covers the hilltop, much to the delight of a stray rolton who wanders lazily amid the cottages and berry bushes, munching happily.  The higher ground here affords a view of the surrounding fields and pastures and the woodlands beyond.

title: [Meadowlands, Prairie]
description: Grasslands grow in a golden sea of verdure to the horizon.  The prairie is omniscient, its largess nourishing roving herds of rolton.  In the foreground, a few cottages rise from the waving field of grasses, their thatched roofs meshing seamlessly with the fields.  Stands of trees cut through the plush expanse where streams meander through the prairie grass, hidden but for their plume of vegetation.

title: [Meadowlands, Village]
description: The lane passes a large building which commands a circular square in front of it.  Doors ring the perimeter of the structure, revealing its interior to be a catacomb of residences.  People pass in and out of its fastness, calling out congenial greetings to one another.

title: [Meadowlands, Field]
description: Fields of tall grass extend to the east, past the low stone wall that bounds the field.  Deep green clover covers the ground, speckled with blossoms of pink and white, and a few scattered trees provide a little shade around a cluster of rustic cottages.

title: [Meadowlands, Field]
description: A heavy forest bounds the area to the south, bordered by a low stone wall that stands along the edge of a deep, tree-shaded ravine.  Several cottages stand in the shade near the wall, surrounded by clumps of white and yellow wildflowers.

title: [Meadowlands, Overlook]
description: A flat bluff offers a spectacular view of the surrounding countryside.  Homes perch upon the majestic hillside, their faces pointed toward the far horizons.  Prairie grass grows up to the cabins' doors, a rich carpet of green that reigns supreme on the meadowlands' rich soil.

title: [Meadowlands, Glade]
description: A few birch trees huddle together to create a small glade, their silvery trunks reflecting the gold of the expansive meadow grass surrounding the oasis of shade.  Cabins lurk beneath the trees, their shingled roofs stained moss-green with dew from the boughs.  Trails leading up to the doors of the residences are won from the prairie grass by constant surveillance, and are perilous at best.

title: [West Bank, Pier]
description: Seagulls perch on the heavy stone pilings, ruffling their feathers and diving into the river after the small silver fish that roam around the pier in glistening schools.  Several homes have been built on the riverside along the pier, their small yards ornamented with fishing gear and brightly colored banners that flap in the fresh breeze.

title: [West Bank, Pier]
description: The wooden pier extends to the north, set on heavy stone pilings rooted in the riverbank.  Merchant barges are berthed along the pier, loading and unloading a variety of crates and barrels.  A group of gaily dressed workmen bustle around a large canvas tent, which seems to be in the process of being taken down or put up.

title: [West Bank Pier, Tent]
description: Poles, ropes, and huge sheets of brightly-colored canvas lie scattered about the dock.  A group of giantmen, wearing sleeveless leather vests and well-worn pants, move about, working industriously to put up the immense tent.  Performers gather to practice among the hustle and bustle, perfecting their acts for an upcoming show.

title: [Rampant Rat Table]
description: On the wall hangs a painted wooden crest depicting a rat rampant.  Teeth bared, the rat balances precariously on its hind legs.  Hanging slightly askew, the crest is surely meant as a jest.

title: [Small Cottage, Library]
description: Bookcases, reaching almost to the ceiling, line one entire wall of this room.  On the opposite side a reading chair and small table sit by a large picture window that looks out on a small grassy clearing among the trees.  You look down and see a scattered trail of tart crumbs that seems to lead from the chair to the bookcases and back again.

title: [Small Cottage, Courtyard]
description: Thick woods surround this courtyard, extending a feeling of security and tranquility.  An outdoor grill made of clay bricks sits to one side, and several modwir chairs sit around a table on the other.  A varied assortment of relaxing sounds drifts in from the woods, and the quiet pool just a short distance out from the cottage.  You find yourself thinking how wonderful it would be to just come here and relax at the end of the day.

title: [Small Cottage, Quiet Pool]
description: You find the water of this quiet pool suprisingly warm, and at its deepest point no more than about six feet.  The water is just clear enough for you to see the sandy bottom, and a number of small but colorful fish in the pool with you.  At the far end is a small shallow area covered with lily pads, many in full bloom, their white and pink blossoms imparting a refreshing fragrance to the air around you.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Riverbank]
description: The trees along the riverbank thin, forming a small glade ringed with cottages at the water's edge.  The grass is lush there, a deep green carpeting sprinkled with the occasional pastel blossom.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Glade]
description: Grand cottages have been erected along the borders of the glade.  They quite obviously belong to the rich or noble, such is the quality of their construction.  People stroll along a cobblestone walkway that proceeds north and east.  Lining the walkway, split log benches offer a comfortable resting spot from which to enjoy the soothing drone of the river.  At the center of the clearing, a carved wooden statue of a water sprite stares back at you.

title: [Ravenswood, Gates]
description: A thick forest of fel, pine, and yew trees lies in both directions down the winding, well-kept path.  A few cottages stand along the border of the dark woods, situated so as to take advantage of the patch of sunlight here.  Wildflowers grow among patches of grass, and clinging vines cover the wrought-iron fence that surrounds the area.

title: [Ravenswood, Forest]
description: A glimmer of sunlight can be seen to the northeast, but the forest here is dark and thick, and little light seeps through the heavy canopy of trees.  The air is heavy with the scent of jasmine growing among the small houses that stand scattered through the woods, and a raven cries somewhere in the distance.

title: [Ravenswood, Forest]
description: The heavy iron fence that borders the area winds to the west, covered with masses of thick green vines.  Closely spaced trees form a dark canopy of leaves over the path, and patches of lilies of the valley form fragrant splashes of white in the shade.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Moonlight streams through the stained glass panels of the half-roof rising on both sides.  The center is missing, leaving the hall open to the sky.  Heavily polished walnut supports arch gracefully from the sides of this oval chamber to meet in pairs high overhead.  Tiers of silver and black benches march down and forward to confront a sterling silver dais backed by a huge canvas banner.  Torches mounted on long poles stretch out from the supports and over the benches, their flames flickering brightly.

title: [Ravenswood, Winding Path]

title: [Ravenswood, Winding Path]

On closer examination, they appear to be grave-markers, though any inscriptions have long since been worn away.  The path continues along the iron fence to the northeast, and a narrow trail leads into a dark glade to the east.  A small clearing lies to the south.

title: [Ravenswood, Dark Trail]

title: [Ravenswood, Winding Path]

Ancient yews and gnarled oaks bend over the path, and the faint call of some forest bird in the distance is the only sound.

title: [Ravenswood, Dark Trail]

title: [Ravenswood, Streambank]

title: [Ravenswood, Winding Path]

title: [Ravenswood, Winding Path]

title: [Ravenswood, Streambank]

title: [Henty's Depot, Floor Displays]
description: Tiers of shelves line the walls, supported by both mundane and peculiar brackets.  One particular clear glaes fixture has been roped off, keeping smudges and any unfortunate accidents from occuring.  That shelf has been filled with water and several colorful fish swim inside it.

title: [Henty's Depot, Wall Displays]
description: Stone, glass, and wooden slabs are displayed in towering wrought iron racks.  A listing of prices for the materials lays upon a rather plain counter in the shadow of the display.  In the corner, obscured by the racks are a pair of cherrywood armoires.

title: [Warehouse, Platform]
description: The solid oak platform sits in the middle of the warehouse floor, an island in the middle of a swirling sea of activity.  From here you have a wonderful view of all of the activity going on in the warehouse.

title: [Warehouse, Storage Room]
description: The storage room is surprisingly quiet, though compared to the warehouse itself it would almost have to be.  A long wooden counter stretches across the entire length of the room, restricting public access to the main storage area.  At the end of the counter is a low, wide platform that is used to facilitate the loading and unloading of leathers and furs.

title: [Brass Tower, Second Floor]
description: The floor and walls of this bare landing are blackened and rippled, as though they had been subjected to intense heat.  A small window with half-melted edges looks out onto the jetty and back towards the eastern crossing.

;e 
elements = {
	'air' => {	'grey orb' => 505,
			'blue orb' => 914,
			'white orb' => 912 },
	'fire' => {	'blue flame' => 908,
			'scarlet flame' => 519,
			'white flame' => 906 },
	'earth' => {	'blue crystal' => 520,
			'black crystal' => 510,
			'violet crystal' => 909 }
}

direction = {
	'air' => 'north',
	'fire' => 'west',
	'earth' => 'south'
}

result = nil
['air','fire','earth'].each { |element|
	truth_table = elements[element].values.find_all { |spellnum| Spell[spellnum].known? }
	if truth_table.size == 3
		result = element
		break
	end
}

if result.nil?
	echo 'You do not know enough spells to get into the workshop.'
	exit
end

2.times{ move direction[result] }
elements[result].each{ |pillar, spellnum|
	if !Spell[spellnum].affordable?
		echo 'Waiting for mana'
		wait_until{ Spell[spellnum].affordable? }
	end
	Spell[spellnum].cast(pillar)
}

description: Behind the oak bar, many rough-hewn pegs contain a variety of clay tankards while matching shelves in one corner are filled with wooden platters.  A narrow doorway leads out to the grill, from which a variety of mouth-watering smells emanate.  The bar itself is quite high and ornately carved with random scenes of bountiful harvest.  Curiously, there are no stools, though the counter has a smooth lip which appears perfect for leaning.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Tavern]
description: The rough-hewn wooden floor is strewn with stale rushes and bits of half-eaten food.  The air is thick with the smoke from cigars and pipes.  The tavern room is crowded with all manner of rough-looking elves, a few dark elves and dwarves mixed in for good measure.
