title: [Small Estate, Foyer]
description: Long, thin ivory columns encircle the room, marking the borders of a round disc of pure white marble, its surface streaked with veins of pale crimson.  A deep crimson rose serves as a central mural upon the lustrous marble, its dark petals crafted of thick stained glass.  A sweeping staircase adorned with rich velvet rugs leads further up, while hallways branch off to the east and west.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Small Estate, Landing]
description: The white marble tile is partially obscured by a round carmine rug, its curves matching the interior of the room and the slightly domed ceiling above.  A circle of ivory doors surround the area, each traced with a different trailing pattern of ebony.  A pair of stained glass doors leads out to a quaint balcony, their panes spilling a soft carmine light from beyond the threshold.

title: [Small Estate, Balcony]
description: The leafy tops of young trees peek out from under the thick ivory-hued railings that edge the balcony, and the view of the small pond below and the accompanying shrine is only enhanced by the subtle crimson oil lamps hung around the area.  The silhouette of the guardrails forms intertwined loops and arcs, converging into a single downwards-turned dagger that points to the very heart of the garden below.  Faint trickles of wind lightly caress the area every few moments.

title: [Small Estate, Hallway]
description: The hallway stretches onto the east, its crimson-hued walls lined with a variety of ornate ivory doors trimmed with swishing patterns of glossy ebony.  Small candles are held in gold-chased sconces, their flames lending a heavy, moody amber glow to the area as they flicker behind delicate glass panes.  Long velvet carpets line the floor, their faint glossy sheen reflected in the lustrous golden locks upon the doors.

title: [Small Estate, Hallway]
description: Darkness envelops the long, winding hallway, only a few sputtering candles casting their dark crimson light into the clinging shadows.  The vague outlines of many paintings interspersed between the ornate ivory doors can be glimpsed in the gloom, their edges traced with delicate silver filigree.  Long velvet curtains tinted a deep shade of carmine compliment the matching velvet rug lining the floor, their golden tassels tied tightly to block any view of the outside world.

title: [Wizard Guild, Conveyance]
description: The soft music of running water fills the still air, and the smooth crystalline walls of the chamber ripple with the movement of the flowing rivulets trapped behind them.  Faint runic traceries glint on the surface of the transparent walls and run their entire length and breadth.  Stretching across the floor are sinuous silver lines that whorl and spiral about each other in fanciful runes and geometric shapes, ultimately forming a vast circle.

title: [Small Estate, Dining Room]
description: A long ebonwood table spreads from one end of the room to the other, its surface decorated with silver candelabras and other assorted finery.  Many matching chairs are lined up in precise order along the table, with the largest being at the northern end -- a deep crimson ruby set atop its spired back like a crown.  Intertwined threads of painted ivy run along the walls in fanciful patterns, coalescing above a pair of large glass doors that lead outside to a cozy patio.

title: [Small Estate, Patio]
description: A circle of flat grey stone serves as a quaint little sitting area, and numerous velvet-padded wrought-iron chairs arranged in half-circles offer a comforting respite.  Young shrubs and bushes encircle the area, while a rock formation to the northwest houses a miniature waterfall that trickles pleasingly every few moments.  Crimson-hued candles huddle in the shadow of the balcony above, casting their moody light across the area in rippling waves.

title: [Small Estate, Gardens]
description: A small trail winds its way through the gardens, the twisting pathway marked by flat circular stepping-stones tinted a pure white hue.  Flowers of every breed and hue imaginable blossom along the edges of the path, their vivid color painting an intricate cascade of beauty across the verdant green surroundings.  The soft lapping of water can be distinguished further north, and through the haze of green, one can faintly glimpse the black waters of a small pond.

title: [Wizard Guild, Branch]
description: Three passages meet in this branching hallway.  To the northeast stands a slender archway of pink-flecked granite that flickers occasionally with a hazy reddish aura.  A white marble arch is set into the northwest wall, ornately carved and shot through with meandering veins of gold.  The corridor continues to the south, framed by polished oak paneled walls.

title: [Loci Workshop, Confluence]
description: Small and square, the stone walls of this chamber are oriented so that each corner is at a cardinal direction.  Four pillars occupy the ground midway between the center of the room and each corner, each balancing on the merest point, standing on a base formed of an inverted, four-sided pyramid.  A dim, green-tinged white glow emanates from the semi-translucent base of each pillar, as if the pyramids were formed of some kind of luminescent crystal.

;e open_regex = /^You open|^That is already open\.$|^There doesn't seem to be any way to do that\.$|^What were you referring to\?|^I could not find what you were referring to\./

put_regex = /^You (?:attempt to shield .*? from view as you |discreetly |carefully |absent-mindedly )?(?:put|place|slip|tuck|add|hang|drop|untie your|find an incomplete bundle|wipe off .*? and sheathe)|^A sigh of grateful pleasure can be heard as you feed .*? to your|^As you place|^I could not find what you were referring to\.$|^Your bundle would be too large|^The .+ is too large to be bundled\.|^As you place your|^The .*? is already a bundle|^Your .*? won't fit in .*?\.$|^You can't .+ It's closed!$|^You can't put/

sack_name = UserVars.day_pass_sack
sack = (
   GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.noun == sack_name} ||
   GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name == sack_name } ||
   GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name =~ /\b#{Regexp.escape(sack_name)}$/i } ||
   GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name =~ /\b#{sack_name.split(' ').collect { |n| Regexp.escape(n) }.join(".*\\b")}/i }
)
close_sack = false
if sack.contents.nil?
   open_result = dothistimeout "open ##{sack.id}", 10, open_regex
   if open_result =~ /^You open/
      close_sack = true
   else
      dothistimeout "look in ##{sack.id}", 10, /In the .*? you see/
   end
end
empty_hand
$mapdb_day_passes.keys.each { |id|
   if $mapdb_day_passes[id][:expires] < (Time.now - 10)
      dothistimeout "_drag ##{id} drop", 2, /^As you let go|^You drop/
      $mapdb_day_passes.delete(id)
   end
}
pass_id = $mapdb_day_passes.keys.find { |id| $mapdb_day_passes[id][:towns].include?("Wehnimer's Landing") and $mapdb_day_passes[id][:towns].include?('Icemule Trace') and $mapdb_day_passes[id][:expires] > (Time.now + 10) }
if pass_id
   dothistimeout "get ##{pass_id}", 10, get_regex
elsif UserVars.mapdb_buy_day_pass.to_s =~ /^(yes|true)$|\bimt,wl\b/i
   move 'go corridor'
   fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?
   dothistimeout "ask halfling for wehnimer", 10, /says to you/
   result = dothistimeout "ask halfling for wehnimer", 10, /don't have enough|quickly hands you/
   if (result =~ /don't have enough/) and $go2_get_silvers
      [ 'out', 'go gate', 'southeast', 'southeast', 'northeast', 'southeast', 'south', 'west', 'south', 'east', 'east', 'south', 'south', 'east', 'north', 'north', 'go archway' ].each { |dir| move dir }
      dothistimeout 'withdraw 5000', 10, /carefully records|through the books/
      [ 'out', 'south', 'south', 'west', 'north', 'north', 'west', 'west', 'north', 'east', 'north', 'northwest', 'southwest', 'northwest', 'northwest', 'go gate', 'go door' ].each { |dir| move dir }
      fput 'unhide' if hidden? or invisible?
      result = dothistimeout "ask halfling for wehnimer", 10, /says to you|don't have enough|quickly hands you/
      if result =~ /says to you/
         result = dothistimeout "ask halfling for wehnimer", 10, /don't have enough|quickly hands you/
      end
   end
   if result =~ /quickly hands you/
      if GameObj.right_hand.noun == 'pass'
         pass_id = GameObj.right_hand.id
      elsif GameObj.left_hand.noun == 'pass'
         pass_id = GameObj.left_hand.id
      end
      fput "look ##{pass_id}"
      move 'go corridor'
   elsif result =~ /don't have enough/
      echo 'error: You are too poor to buy Chronomage day passes.  Turning off buy_day_pass setting.'
      sleep 3
      UserVars.mapdb_buy_day_pass = 'no'
   end
end
if pass_id
   result = dothistimeout "raise ##{pass_id}", 10, /whirlwind of color subsides|pass is expired|not valid for departures|As you go to raise your pass, you realize|Raise what/
   dothistimeout "_drag ##{pass_id} ##{sack.id}", 10, put_regex
else
   $mapdb_day_passes.clear
   UserVars.mapdb_find_day_pass = 'yes'
   $restart_go2 = true
end
fill_hand
if close_sack
   dothistimeout "close ##{sack.id}", 2, /^You close/
end

timeto.8634:
;e open_regex = /^You open|^That is already open\.$|^There doesn't seem to be any way to do that\.$|^What were you referring to\?|^I could not find what you were referring to\./

if UserVars.mapdb_use_day_pass == true
   $mapdb_day_passes ||= Hash.new
   unless DownstreamHook.list.include?('mapdb_day_pass_monitor')
      last_id = nil
      month_num = { 'Jan' => 1, 'Feb' => 2, 'Mar' => 3, 'Apr' => 4, 'May' => 5, 'Jun' => 6, 'Jul' => 7, 'Aug' => 8, 'Sep' => 9, 'Oct' => 10, 'Nov' => 11, 'Dec' => 12 }
      hook_proc = proc { |s|
         if s =~ /^Bold calligraphy states simply, "This <a exist="(-?[0-9]+)" noun="pass">pass<\/a> entitles the original purchaser to one \(1\) day of unlimited travel between the towns of (.+?) and (.+?), commencing/
            last_id = $1
            $mapdb_day_passes[last_id] = { :towns => [$2,$3] }
         elsif s =~ /^Bold red block letters spelling out "EXPIRED" appear to have been stamped across the face and reverse of the <a exist="(-?\d+)" noun="pass">pass/
            $mapdb_day_passes[$1] = { :towns => [], :expires => Time.now }
         elsif s =~ /^\[Your pass will expire on \w+ (\w+) *(\d+) (\d+):(\d+):(\d+) ET (\d+)\./
            if last_id
               $mapdb_day_passes[last_id][:expires] = Time.at(Time.new($6, month_num[$1], $2, $3, $4, $5, "-05:00").to_i)
               last_id = nil
            end
         elsif s =~ /quickly hands you a Chronomage day pass/ # fixme: xml
            UserVars.mapdb_find_day_pass = 'yes'
         end
         s
      }
      DownstreamHook.add('mapdb_day_pass_monitor', hook_proc)
      UserVars.mapdb_find_day_pass = 'yes'
   end

   if (UserVars.mapdb_find_day_pass == 'yes') and (bounty? !~ /^You have made contact with the child/) and ((bounty? !~ /provide a protective escort/) or (bounty? =~ /WAIT/))
      if (sack_name = UserVars.day_pass_sack)
         sack = (
            GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.noun == sack_name} ||
            GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name == sack_name } ||
            GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name =~ /\b#{Regexp.escape(sack_name)}$/i } ||
            GameObj.inv.find { |obj| obj.name =~ /\b#{sack_name.split(' ').collect { |n| Regexp.escape(n) }.join(".*\\b")}/i }
         )
         if sack
            close_sack = false
            if sack.contents.nil?
               open_result = dothistimeout "open ##{sack.id}", 10, open_regex
               if open_result =~ /^You open/
                  close_sack = true
               else
                  dothistimeout "look in ##{sack.id}", 10, /In the .*? you see/
               end
            end
            if sack.contents
               $mapdb_day_passes.keys.each { |id|
                  unless sack.contents.any? { |obj| obj.id == id }
                     $mapdb_day_passes.delete(id)
                  end
               }
               sack.contents.find_all { |obj| obj.name == 'Chronomage day pass' }.each { |pass|
                  next if $mapdb_day_passes[pass.id]
                  dothistimeout "look ##{pass.id}", 10, /^Bold calligraphy states simply|^Bold red block letters spelling out "EXPIRED"|^I could not find/
               }
               UserVars.mapdb_find_day_pass = 'no'
            else
               if $mapdb_last_day_pass_message.nil? or ((Time.now - $mapdb_last_day_pass_message) > 5)
                  $mapdb_last_day_pass_message = Time.now
                  echo "Failed to find contents of day_pass_sack: #{sack_name}; go2 will not use Chronomage day pass travel."
               end
            end
            if close_sack
               dothistimeout "close ##{sack.id}", 3, /^You close/
            end
         else
            if $mapdb_last_day_pass_message.nil? or ((Time.now - $mapdb_last_day_pass_message) > 5)
               $mapdb_last_day_pass_message = Time.now
               echo "warning: Failed to find day_pass_sack: #{sack_name}; go2 will not use Chronomage day pass travel."
            end
         end
      else
         if $mapdb_last_day_pass_message.nil? or ((Time.now - $mapdb_last_day_pass_message) > 5)
            $mapdb_last_day_pass_message = Time.now
            echo "warning: day_pass_sack is not set; go2 will not use Chronomage day pass travel."
            echo "Specify the location of your Chronomage day passes with #{$clean_lich_char}vars set day_pass_sack=CONTAINER"
         end
      end
   end
   if $mapdb_day_passes.any? { |id,h| h[:towns].include?("Wehnimer's Landing") and h[:towns].include?('Icemule Trace') and h[:expires] > (Time.now + 10) }
      0.8
   elsif UserVars.mapdb_buy_day_pass.to_s =~ /^(yes|true)$|\bimt,wl\b/i
      8.8
   else
      nil
   end
else
   nil
end

            if $mapdb_last_day_pass_message.nil? or ((Time.now - $mapdb_last_day_pass_message) > 5)
               $mapdb_last_day_pass_message = Time.now
               echo "warning: Failed to find day_pass_sack: #{sack_name}; go2 will not use Chronomage day pass travel."
            end
         end
      else
         if $mapdb_last_day_pass_message.nil? or ((Time.now - $mapdb_last_day_pass_message) > 5)
            $mapdb_last_day_pass_message = Time.now
            echo "warning: day_pass_sack is not set; go2 will not use Chronomage day pass travel."
            echo "Specify the location of your Chronomage day passes with #{$clean_lich_char}vars set day_pass_sack=CONTAINER"
         end
      end
   end
   if $mapdb_day_passes.any? { |id,h| h[:towns].include?("Solhaven") and h[:towns].include?('Icemule Trace') and h[:expires] > (Time.now + 10) }
      0.8
   elsif UserVars.mapdb_buy_day_pass.to_s =~ /^(yes|true)$|\bimt,sol\b/i
      8.8
   else
      nil
   end
else
   nil
end

title: [Spitfire Alley, Gunner's Lane]
description: A billboard proudly proclaims the grand opening of a now-closed treasure shop, its owner driven out of business by the numerous false maps sold to him, resulting in some really unhappy customers.  One of those fake maps is tacked to the sign, with some comments questioning the merchant's ancestry written in red across the face.

title: [Registrar's Office, Booth]
description: You've entered a space which is wedged between two rows of filing cabinets and sectioned off by a mule-printed wool curtain.  Inside is a scratched modwir desk with a halfling clerk sitting behind it, peering over the mounds of paper that surround her.  She giggles to herself once, waves at you, then returns to work.

title: [Southeast Tower, Armory]
description: An enormous table, its granite top cut to resemble a snowflake, dominates this crowded room.  Pushed into the corners are several weapons lockers, and a wide variety of maps hang from the cold stone walls.

title: [Flashfeet's, Sacks and Satchels]
description: The back room is filled with carryalls of all sizes hanging from a variety of hooks and racks.  Flashfeet has used some regional materials for the making of many and put them on display by the dressing room.

The floor is completely covered with an assortment of animal furs, each layered on top of the next like the scales of a snake.  A series of hooks and racks are affixed around the room, displaying assorted totes and carryalls. A wide fieldstone fireplace sits in the back of the room with a basket of sticks next to it.

Dark, rich, wooden floors contrast the jewel-toned tiles adorning the walls, reflecting a myriad of colors.  Centered on each tile is a metal rod bearing all manner of satchels and sacks.  Spaced evenly throughout the room, dark wooden tables have been neatly stacked with assorted pouches, cases, and kits.  A jovial giantman clerk tends to a wide fieldstone fireplace along the back wall next to a basket of sticks.

title: [Flashfeet's, Dressing Room]
description: The plain but functional dressing room contains a floor-to-ceiling mirror and a small padded bench.
The plain but functional dressing room contains a floor-to-ceiling mirror and a small leather-cushioned bench.

title: [Twisting Tunnels]
description: A maze of tunnels leads away from this small chamber in all directions.  The low ceiling, poor lighting, and sudden twists and turns make it impossible to see far enough in any direction to get your bearings.  Some passageways lead only a few feet and dead end, while others twist and turn in odd directions before opening into another chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, up

title: [Southwest Tower, Roof]
description: This tower commands a view of the South Gate trail, but few if any pass through its shadowy maw.  To the north and east, the city of Icemule Trace is lit by the warmth of candle and hearth fire, but surrounded by the cold darkness of the city walls.  From somewhere below the tower comes the rhythmical pulse of the windmill blades as they turn in time with the ubiquitous glacial winds.

This tower commands a view of the trail as it leaves the South Gate, passes the Behlayr and Ice Forest neighborhoods, and then heads toward Wehnimer's Landing.  To the north and east, the tower provides an excellent view of the city walls and of the city of Icemule Trace.  Directly below the tower, the blades of the windmill turn in lazy rhythm in time with the ubiquitous glacial winds.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: The view to the south is dominated by the great temple of Icemule Trace, which bathes the Temple Burrow in silvery light as the moon's beams refract through cut ice.  At this late hour, only a few temple monks move through the streets in the service of their own patron gods.

The view to the south is dominated by the great temple of Icemule Trace, which bathes the Temple Burrow in bands of color as sunlight refracts through cut ice.  Even from this height, the bustle of pilgrims to and fro fills the streets with the quiet murmur of prayer.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Ledge]
description: The guards at the top of an imflass-chain ladder stamp their feet in a vain attempt to fight off the biting cold.  A single torch set in an unadorned iron sconce provides only scarce light, causing shadows to flitter about the area.  Near the torch, a thick imflass door has been fixed securely into the ice and bears a prominent mithril plaque.  To the west, a suspended rope bridge crosses a narrow chasm.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Bridge]
description: Four sections of iron-shod rope, each consisting of several lengths wound around another, offer dire passage over an ensured death below.  From an icy ledge to the east, the plankless bridge extends over the chasm and has been securely tethered to both sides of a circular opening to the west.  Hooded iron sconces offer limited torchlight on either end of the bridge.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Corridor]
description: Rounded walls, ceiling and floor of slick, solid white ice make this otherwise simple corridor quite hard to navigate.  The subtle glow of a torch to the west provides enough light to see the outlines of an iron-shod wooden door to the south and the imflass bars of a cell door to the north.  One end of the hallway stretches farther to the west, while the other ends in a circular opening that leads to a suspended rope bridge uneasily spanning a narrow chasm.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Office]
description: The slick, icy floor provides an unstable purchase to this tiny, cramped office.  The uneven walls and ceiling are formed of a mix of transparent and milky white ice reinforced with heavy iron strips.  Three iron sconces holding flickering torches are spaced evenly throughout the room, all hooded so as to prevent any melting ice from extinguishing the flames.  A mithril-legged, short wooden desk and a matching chair face a thick imflass door fixed securely into the western wall.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Corridor]
description: Placed within a hooded sconce and set low upon the southern wall, an unfaltering torch provides ample light to the center of the passageway.  A cell to the north, sealed by an iron-barred cell door, looks terribly uncomfortable, its icy confines providing barely enough space to hold a single humanoid captive.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Corridor]
description: Light dimly filters in from the east, revealing the difficult terrain of the hallway.  Three cell doors line the walls here, one set in each wall.  Formed of hammered plates of mithril and imflass, the western door is intermittently covered with cryptic runes.  The wrought mithril bars of the northern cell door have been wickedly barbed to prevent any stray hands from reaching through.  Finally, a solid door of riveted iron has been set into the ice on the south side of the corridor.

title: [Bard Guild, Auditorium]
description: The walls and ceiling of the large auditorium are crafted of thin beams of honey-colored oak, all assembled in an elegant design calculated to enhance the room's acoustics.  Rows of benches march down the floor's gentle descent, toward a stage at the far end of the hall.  Indigo blue runners muffle footsteps, matching dark blue velvet curtains framing the stage.  A row of lanterns sits across the stage's lip, like gargoyles guarding a tower's heights.

title: [Thirsty Penguin, Hall]

description: A group of elven children have found some fun in a stack of barrels stored here.  They've tipped several of the containers on their sides and mounted up to play cavalry.  Between shouts of 'Hai Sabrar!', they growl, laugh and argue about who gets to be 'Taki.'

title: [Hops Alley, South End]
description: Beneath the backs of several imposing storehouses is a group of cozy homes.  They're quite nice, if a bit out of the way.  Each is trimmed with intricately carved wood, which is painted in merry shades of yellow and green.  Oil lamps light up the whole area, set atop wrought-iron poles.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Alchemical Workshop]
description: Set high up in the outside wall, a single narrow lancet window allows silver-hued natural light to flood the interior of the workroom.  A solid, nearly immovable workbench occupies the majority of the floor space.  Several workstations are set up around the granite workbench, each neatly fitted with a translucent glass alembic, a crucible, and a silver gem lens assembly.

title: [Alchemical Workshop]

Several workstations are set up around the granite workbench, each neatly fitted with a translucent glass alembic, a crucible, and a silver gem lens assembly.

title: [Southeast Tower, Barracks]
description: The cold stone walls of this upper room are broken only by a simple banner bearing the word "Glory," which ripples in the frigid wind coursing through the hole leading through the ceiling to the roof.  A legion of beds stand at attention in the barracks, ready to give comfort to the weary and the wounded.  At the head of the stairway is a large cabinet designed to hold bandages and herbs for the cure of the wounded.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: What little floor there is to this room surrounds a huge bubbling pit of thick red paste.  Deep within this man-made spring, something is causing the mixture to swirl in a slow lazy circle, perhaps to keep the contents from hardening.

title: [Twisting Tunnels]
description: A maze of tunnels leads away from this small chamber in all directions.  The low ceiling, poor lighting, and sudden twists and turns make it impossible to see far enough in any direction to get your bearings.  Some passageways lead only a few feet and dead end, while others twist and turn in odd directions before opening into another chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, northwest, down

title: [Vault]
description: The chamber is filled with obsidian rubble, pieces strewn in every direction.  The walls are scarred and cracked, most of the stone blackened from what must have been a fire of tremendous magnitude.  The unpleasant scent of burnt flesh lingers within the room.

title: [Fearling Pass, Ridge]
description: To the north, a large lake spans across the view, its dark expanse both eerie and still, while in the opposite direction, a treacherous path climbs up from meadow-like fields in the distance.  Directly below the ridge, a fetid bog sends her foggy tendrils slithering upward, where they wrap around the edges of a small shack.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Watch Room]
description: Chill winds ripple in the glassless windows of the watch room from all directions, their icy tendrils biting into any exposed skin they can find.  A single lantern sways from the bronze chain it is anchored to, its flickering light casting strange shadows upon the thatched ceiling.

title: [Behlayr, Modwir Street]
description: Two tall doric columns of ice mark the gateway to the Behlayr neighborhood, a colorful banner draped between them proclaiming the purported healing qualities of the mithril fountain in the central square.  Silver strands spiral down around the columns, lending a hint of color to their otherwise stark white facades.  The rest of the town stretches out to the north, its chimneys trying to provide some semblance of heat to the inhabitants.

title: [Northern Fortress, Great Hall]
description: Set with oak double doors in each wall, this large room is lit by oil-lamps that hang from the ceiling.  A stone fireplace rests in one corner, with a basket of sticks nearby.  Around the fireplace, thirteen portraits of battle-arrayed persons have been hung, while a large collection of paintings adorns the remaining walls.  Bearskin rugs cover the floor, comfortable leather couches line the walls, and there is a sturdy wastebasket adjacent to the fireplace.

title: [Northern Fortress, Chapel]
description: Dominating this somber chamber, a large altar on the west wall sits below a trio of tall, stained-glass windows that allow sunlight to bathe the room in a myriad of colors.  Next to the larger altar is a smaller one made using simple lines that complement the dark stone of the wall.  This particular altar is dedicated to the Pantheon of Liabo, while the larger, more prominent altar is dedicated to Koar.  The surface of the floor is kept meticulously clean and is fashioned from polished, stark white marble.

Dominating this somber chamber, a large altar on the west wall sits below a trio of tall, stained-glass windows that softly splash the room with dim but colorful moonlight.  Next to the larger altar is a smaller one made using simple lines that complement the dark stone of the wall.  This particular altar is dedicated to the Pantheon of Liabo, while the larger, more prominent altar is dedicated to Koar.  The surface of the floor is kept meticulously clean and is fashioned from polished, stark white marble.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Wooded Path]
description: The path winds between drifts stacked up against the trunks of tall pines, their boughs covered with thick pillows of snow.  The lodge, a towering shadow among the southern stand of trees, sends out aromatic smoke from its hearths, as well as the mouth-watering smell of baking pastries and roasting meats.  Lights twinkle through the trees to the north, and more drifting smoke can be glimpsed above the tree line in that direction.

title: [Uxbri's Fragrant Firewood!]
description: A massive pile of split logs dominates the back of the small tent, and the pleasant smell of freshly chopped wood fills the air.  Sawdust and chips of wood cover the floor, and small footprints lead out of the tent.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rickety Shack]
description: Creaking and shifting incessantly, the elm wooden walls and roof, and even the rotting doorway, of the shack appear to be hanging on to the very edge of total collapse.  A short jagged-edge table stands in the center of the room, with two rickety chairs framing its length.  Along the rear wall, a makeshift chimney is filled with soot and burnt, decayed remains, and the air is filled with an overwhelming amount of dust and a sharp, rancid stench.

title: [Lydrift's Weaponry]
[Lydrift's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gilded maple cabinet and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: Two ancient banners stand guard over this passageway, their crimson silk unmoving in the still air.  Each of the long banners has been embroidered with the holy symbol of Oleani in golden thread, the workmanship intricate and precise.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: The slate-tiled floor is weathered and cracked with age, but still in good repair.  Cobwebs covered with dust reach across the ceiling, but there doesn't seem to be any sign of their arachnid owners.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: Polished golden rungs have been affixed at regular vertical intervals from floor to ceiling for no apparent reason, as the low ceiling has no opening through which to ascend.  Each rung is firmly embedded into the solid rock.  Faint scraping sounds can be heard from above, muffled but steady.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: A low moaning reverberates off the hard stone surfaces of the ossuary, interspersed with quiet shuffling noises.  The darkness and shadows engulfing the area only serve to emphasize these dread sounds.

title: [Lydrift's General Store]
[Lydrift's Outfitting]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Ondreian's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by varnished ebonwood walls, the shop features an open-mawed greater vruul statue in the center of its black marble floor.  A pair of crossed bones hangs under the vaulted ceiling.  Right near the front is a glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Eahlstan's General Store]
description: Beneath a mistwood beam ceiling, a brilliant peacock painting hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A silk-covered dress mannequin and a gilded maple table sit in opposite corners while a gold embraced lovers statue rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Paupers, Vault]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove toward the rear of the vault.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and rests open on a stone counter.

description: This is a secluded alcove toward the rear of the vault.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and rests open on a stone counter.

title: [Paupers, Vault]
description: Light from several torches flickers over silver sconces fastened to the walls.  Legend has it that this heavily carpeted, soundproofed vault once successfully protected a king's ransom from an attempted siege by rampaging barbarians.  Few have attempted to breach the security of the members' steel-reinforced storage lockers in modern times, for tales of the consequences abound and are not for the faint of heart.

title: [Paupers, Vault]

Few have attempted to breach the security of the members' steel-reinforced storage lockers in modern times, for tales of the consequences abound and are not for the faint of heart.

title: [Lydrift's Outfitting]
[Lydrift's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Paupers, Hot Tub]
description: Silky smooth, aromic cedar planks and benches form this intimate hot tub.  You feel yourself relaxing in the steamy air as the warmth of the water soothes your weary spirit.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Snow Field]
description: A snow-covered meadow is ringed by pines, the deep green of the boughs almost black in contrast to the glistening white snow.  The snowdrifts covering the clearing undulate like a frozen sea.  Sprigs of frozen grass break through the surface here and there, and within the trees lights twinkle where houses are nestled cozily among the protective foliage.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest, west

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Bluff Grotto]
description: A narrow trail meanders along the base of a bluff.  The granite face is deeply pocked and coated with ice, giving it a sparkling sheen.  In one deep pocket, almost a small grotto, a few hardy ferns and lichens brave the demanding climate, fed by a constant rain of water drops melting from the snow higher up the bluff.  The cottages nestled in the pines along the path bask in the secluded charm.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Field East]
description: Snow mantles the meadow in drifts and gullies, dotted with the tops of boulders here and there.  The pines standing guard on the perimeter of the field are spotted with snow.  They sway faintly, while gusts occasionally launch sprays of snow-dust up in clouds which are quickly dispersed in the cold wind.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Snowy Path]
description: The snow-covered meadow is bordered on the north and east by a thick stand of pines.  Here and there, enough space is hewn from the trees to accommodate cottages or sheds.  Large walls of firewood are laced through the trunks between the houses, cut and stacked neatly.  A trail leads away to the east, twisting and turning so that it is quickly lost to sight.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Field North]
description: The meadow stretches almost to the feet of an imposing bluff on the northwest perimeter, its base guarded by a thick border of pines.  Cottages are built within the trees, most facing out toward the snow field and the distant silhouette of Pinefar Lodge where pinpoints of light shine merrily from its many windows.  Snow flurries cross the drifts, luring up cascades of ice particles which move like drifting banks of fog.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Pines]
description: The trail splits, wandering away through the thick needles in three directions.  Snow drifts lay in thick patches along the way, prevented from obscuring the route by a row of stones placed on each side.  A few cottages are visible within the trees, snuggled in the protection of the boughs.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Pines]
description: What little trail remains ends at the foot of a tall bluff.  Overhead, the ridge is heavily forested in pines, their trunks looking very tall and stately with fore-shortening.  A stair has been carved into the granite of the bluff.  The course winds up the sheer face, breaking up the altitude with its lazy zigzag.  Just at the foot of the steps, a ring of boulders marks where campfires have burned.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Pine Bluff]
description: The edge of the bluff looks like it could be the edge of the world, with the distant slopes of Pinefar Mountains stretching away majestically.  There is a fairly clear view of the Lodge presiding over its snowy lawn with aplomb.  The pines resume close to the precipice in a thick growth that protects the cottages built around their feet.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Four Trails]
description: A small cluster of cottages stands at the intersection of four trails.  The paths are marked with boulders stacked along their shoulders.  Snow almost covers the markers, leaving only the tops of the stones visible like the bald heads of dwarves crowning a silvery ring of hair.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Clearing]
description: The trail dwindles away, soon overtaken by snow.  Tall pines crowd closer around cottages almost buried in snow, pine needles and shadows cast by the trees' overhand.  Chimneys over the peaked roofs of the buildings send out merry columns of smoke which dance in the gusts of wind.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Clearing]
description: A large boulder stops the path, straddling its course.  Buildings stand in a loose circle around the clearing which accommodates the mammoth rock.  At the foot of the stone, a small patch of hyacinths accent the snow with the vivid purple of their blooms.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Clearing]
description: A triad of white birch trees graces a clearing ringed with log cottages.  A few leaves still cling to the elegant branches, pirouetting in the gusting wind.  The bark curls off the trunks like parchment, accented with darker rings and a faint dotted pattern.  Light from some of the cottages casts a glittering reflection on the snow within the muted light of the mountainside forest.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Pine Glade]
description: A small clearing is ringed with large boulders, their backs on the west guarded by a tall bluff.  Trees stand on the outside perimeter, as though trying to look over the shoulders of the giants.  In the center of the clearing is a small pool, ringed with small rocks of the same stone as their massive counterparts.  The clearing has an otherworldly feel, sheltered as it is from the gales.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Bluff Walk]
description: Trails wind up and down through the drifts of snow mantling the bluff, the routes circling around trees and skirting large boulders.  Cottages sit along the way, their brightly painted shutters adding merry splashes of color to the white, green and grey palette of the mountains.  Wood smoke mingles with the spicy pine perfume in a heady incense.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Bear Bluff]
description: The trail makes a lazy circle around a cluster of houses tucked on the edge of the bluff.  Pines give them shelter from the wind and the mountains give them timeless grandeur on which to gaze.  Next to the trail, a pine log has been carved in the shape of a bear, its paw lifted in welcome.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Overlook]
description: The trail loops back on itself, turned by a thick stand of pines.  Cottages cluster to either side, their roofs carpeted with a thick mantle of long needles.  Drifts of snow rise on either side of the trail, and a deep bank is piled up at the start of the heavy forest, as if the precipitation is trying to invade the rough-barked shield wall of the woods.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Overlook]
description: Further back from the bluff, the trail becomes more a carpet of needles than snow.  Cabins built here are deeply shadowed by the expansive pine boughs, set in a perennial half-light with a distinctive green cast.  Candles twinkle in their windows, looking more like will o' the wisps than substantial light in the snowy gusts of wind.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Overlook]
description: A massive pine stands in a clearing ringed by a thick carpet of needles which defies encroachment by snow.  Smaller cousins ring the old one, like the members of a court attending their sovereign.  The lowest branches of the behemoth tower over the roofs of a few cottages snuggled around its feet.  The buildings look like toys in comparison to the stature of the ancient pine.

title: [Pinefar Preserve, Bluff Walk]
description: At the trail's end, a stream gurgles beneath a sheath of ice adding an undercurrent of melody to the song of birds in the pines.   The water breaks the frozen coating in places, those spots marked by a silvery spray as the current leaps over and around submerged rocks.  Pines stand on either side of the confluence, as if guarding it as it meanders away toward the edge of the bluff.

title: [Zzentar's Magic Shoppe]
[Zzentar's Combat Gear]
[Zzentar's General Store]
description: Smooth granite walls rise from an enameled hardwood floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A wicker basket and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: Shelves resting against the redwood walls display an extensive assortment of reading materials.  Several circular communal reading tables occupy the center of the room with six chairs placed around each table.  A heavy layer of sawdust covers the floor, effectively eliminating the sound of passage.  A rectangular skylight allows moonlight to stream liberally into the room, illuminating the tables, shelves, and a rather stern-looking librarian seated at a corner desk.  Several torches also burn brightly.

title: [Lalyia's Magic Shoppe]
description: A blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A handblown double-heart bottle sits in one corner of an enameled hardwood floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop.

title: [A Nalfein's Kiss]
[Jiarine's Outfitting]
[Jiarine's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the mahogany floor is interrupted by a serene golden wyvern fountain.  Halfway to the skylight-set ceiling, a noble elf maiden portrait hangs on one of the textured black silk walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case and a large cherrywood cabinet are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Gnarled Trees]
description: A narrow trail winds through a thicket of gnarled trees, leading further down the cliffside into an open area.  A few cabins and cottages nestle among the trees, which provide a bit of shelter from the stiff bay winds.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: The cliff drops off steeply, affording a view of the dark sand and rocky bayside below to the small houses perched along its edge.  The slope rises sharply to the south into a stand of gnarled trees along the clifftop.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Gnarled Trees]
description: The trail winds downward through the trees, past an ancient, wind-twisted trunk that leans across the path.  The sound of the bay crashing against the rocks at the foot of the trail can be heard from below.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: A wide ledge runs along the curve of the cliffs, dotted by huge rocks and driftwood that has fallen from the slopes above over the years.  The blue water of the bay stretches into the distance, speckled with the colorful sails of passing ships.  A rocky trail winds down through the rocks to the bay.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: The ledge winds around a niche in the cliffs, the shacks set among the rocks somewhat sheltered from the constant wind by the curve of the land.  Weathered trees line the edge of the cliff above, their branches swept back over the merchant road.  A steep trail leads down the cliffside.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: Scattered trees and scrubby bushes have taken root on the wide ledge, their branches slanted inwards toward the cliffside by the pounding winds from the bay.  The blue waters of the bay extend off to the horizon, dotted by whitecaps and the sails of passing ships.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: The wide ledge ends in a steep cliff that drops off into a desolate vista of uninhabitable rocky shore stretching off to the west.  A path winds down to the shore to the north, and a set of narrow stone steps has been carved into the rock, providing a precarious ascent to an outcropping of rock above.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Rocky Slope]
description: Windswept trees line the trail as it winds up the cliffside, sloping down to the east and rising in a steep path away from the bay.  The wind whistles through the branches, filling the air with a faint howling.  Small cabins and cottages have been built along the trail, tucked into sheltered niches in the stone.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: Ancient trees rooted in the cliffside shade the rocky ledge with windswept branches, home to the nests of fenvaoks and other cliffside creatures.  A grizzled weasel-like creature scurries among the roots, and something that looks like a bat flies swiftly by.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Rocky Slope]
description: A trail winds up the cliffside, ending at a jumble of rocks that shields this drier patch of ground from the surf-pounded waterfront.  Hardy grasses grow in clumps along the foot of the cliff, and screeching fenvaoks call out from their nests in the rocks above.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Rocky Slope]
description: A niche in the cliffs shelters a sloping field of scattered rocks and dry brush.  Grasses rustle in the constant wind sweeping in from the bay, and seabirds soar overhead, their plaintive cries echoing from the cliffs.  A steep trail winds up the cliffside between the rocks.

title: [Hidden Tunnel]
description: You find yourself in a small roughly hewn stone room.  Moss and lichen carpet the walls and floor, giving the area a musty scent.  In the south corner of the room you see some moss covered stairs heading down into the gloom, the sound of dripping water echoing up to you.  A rusty iron ladder leads up through the ceiling into darkness.

title: [Castle Varunar, Keep]
description: You are in a small circular stone landing.  Dripping copper colored stains adorn the walls looking as if someone had thrown buckets of blood on them.  A cut-stone spiral staircase wraps around the circular walls leading further up into what must be the castle keep.  A rusty iron ladder leads down a passage cut into the floor.

title: [Daingneach Onoir, Entrance]
description: Massive walls of pure white granite bear numerous scars from both recent and long past assaults.  Towers stand sentinel to either side of an open modwir gate and raised portcullis, providing a suitable post for any guard.  Four flaming sconces frame the imposing entrance, and an intricate gem-inlaid crest is mounted proudly above it.  A narrow alcove near the northern tower reveals a granite staircase leading under the fortification.

Massive walls of pure white granite bear numerous scars from both recent and long past assaults.  Towers stand sentinel to either side of an open modwir gate and raised portcullis, providing a suitable post for any guard.  Four unlit sconces frame the imposing entrance, and an intricate gem-inlaid crest is mounted proudly above it.  A narrow alcove near the northern tower reveals a granite staircase leading under the fortification.

title: [Onoir, Court of Chivalry]
description: Moonlight filters through the branches of an ancient elm located in the center of this aesthetic courtyard, reflecting upon the surface of a waterfall fountain along the main cobblestone path.  Carefully tended wildflowers, grasses, and pathways comprise the remaining area, accented by a solitary wooden bench.  The soothing chirping of crickets and the occasional hooting of owls fill the air, a peaceful counterpoint to the stout granite towers equipped with ballistae in each corner of the courtyard.

Sunlight filters through the branches of an ancient elm located in the center of this aesthetic courtyard, reflecting upon the surface of a waterfall fountain along the main cobblestone path.  Carefully tended wildflowers, grasses, and pathways comprise the remaining area, accented by a solitary wooden bench.  The melodious songs of birds and the occasional chatter of squirrels fill the air, a peaceful counterpoint to the stout granite towers equipped with ballistae in each corner of the courtyard.

title: [Onoir, Great Hall]
description: Moonlight filters through the iridescent panes of six stained-glass windows spaced evenly along the cylindrical walls of this commodious hall.  Rows of low wooden benches flank a sturdy podium mounted upon a solid marble dais, facing a mosaic-tiled section of floor that portrays a gallant knight in full battle regalia.  Carved wooden lions grasp black and red crosshatched banners overhead, while flickering torches in wall-sconces drive back the shadows from a trio of archways leading to other areas of the castle.

Light cascades through the iridescent panes of six stained-glass windows spaced evenly along the cylindrical walls of this commodious hall.  Rows of low wooden benches flank a sturdy podium mounted upon a solid marble dais, facing a mosaic-tiled section of floor that portrays a gallant knight in full battle regalia.  Carved wooden lions grasp black and red crosshatched banners between unlit torches vigilantly waiting in their sconces over a trio of archways leading to other areas of the castle.

title: [Onoir, Granite Cavern]
description: Simple torches cast light upon the roughly hewn white granite walls, revealing numerous scorch marks and a patch of soot that stands out in one corner, oddly resembling a large, humanoid silhouette.  Ash has collected in the deeper depressions of the floor and lies in small piles on a set of granite steps leading up to the garden.  Clear of all dust and debris, a large wooden bucket rests idly beneath a crack in the wall.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Fenvaok's Roost]
description: An outcropping of huge, jagged boulders extends from the cliff, home to the nest of seemingly hundreds of screeching fenvaoks.  The stones are cluttered with ragged nests of weeds and branches, and the huge birds soar to and fro, bringing food to their young and viciously defending any attempt to approach their haven.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overhang]
description: This huge outcropping of stone hangs out over the precarious ledges below.  A few gnarled trees have found enough dirt to take root near the dark mouth of a cave set into the cliff, from which emanates a somewhat acrid odor and a faint sound of fluttering wings.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cave]
description: The rough, shadowy cave smells of musk and sea air.  Lining the stalactite-riddled ceiling are an uncountable number of bats, their small furred bodies crowded together for warmth and companionship.  Thousands of beady black eyes stare down at you, shining in the low light.

title: [Lillas' Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a low wrought iron table on one side of the shop and a heavy wooden desk on the other.

title: [Moonshine Manor, Plur's Pub]
description: Finely dressed elven maidens serve patrons seated at small wooden tables pushed against the walls.  Padded brass stools surround a massive circular oak bar where barrels and casks of spirits are protectively guarded by a black-clad halfling barkeep.  A derelict table occupies the dimly lit corner to the southeast opposite a candlelit hallway to the west, while a heavy cedar double door leads outside.

title: [Moonshine Manor, Garden Pond]
description: Bluegrass lawns and colorful flowerbeds surround an enormous clear water pond, which stretches away from a short wooden fishing dock to a twisted mithril fence that curves in a gentle arc around the garden.  A slender glaes obelisk rises from the center of the pond to tower over the area.  A heavy cedar double door provides entry to the manor's interior, where the sounds of idle conversation and laughter contrast harshly with the garden's quiet and meditative atmosphere.

title: [Moonshine Manor, Dim Corner]
description: Cast in shadows and ostracized from its heartier brethren, the table in this corner of the pub shows signs of receiving more attention from a knife than from a polishing rag.  Bound with thin strips of barely useful iron and thoroughly soaked in spilled ale is a rickety construct that bears a vague resemblance to a chair.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Waterfront]
description: Surf pounds against the uneven, slippery rocks that border the bay, and sea-spray dampens the path.  Fenvaoks swoop low over the water, diving for meals, and roost in their nests on the cliffside that winds off to the west.  A rocky trail leads up the uneven slope to the ledges above.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Waterfront]
description: The ancient hulk of a merchant schooner, shipwrecked many years ago, lies far offshore, tatters of its sails and ropes still fluttering in the wind from its broken mast.  A dozen seagulls perch on and around a pile of boulders, squalling at visitors as they pass.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Waterfront]
description: The cliff rises steeply to the south above a wide swatch of dark sand.  Seaweed has been strewn among the rocks by an exceptionally high tide, and now lies drying in the sun as gulls search it for tidbits.  A row of cabins is nestled against the cliff, interspersed with a few gnarled trees.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Waterfront]
description: The path ends at a jumble of rocks, fallen from the cliff ages ago and now covered by lichens and surrounded by scraggly beach grasses.  The bay surf pounds against the shoreline in a cloud of mist that does not quite reach the homes set back against the sheltered cliff.

title: [Kreean's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a plain wooden table and a long varnished counter.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Orchard]
description: Grey cobblestones meander beneath well-tended orange and peach trees.  Lining the path, brilliantly colored flowers perfume the night air with heavy scents.  Crickets chirp from their hiding places, and moths flutter aimlessly about.  Wooden steps climb to an enclosed porch attached to a two-story villa.

Grey cobblestones meander beneath well-tended orange and peach trees.  Lining the path, brilliantly colored flowers perfume the air with heavy scents.  Birds sing in the branches above, and tiny butterflies flit from blossom to blossom with careless abandon.  Wooden steps climb to an enclosed porch attached to a two-story villa.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Landing]
description: Three portholes look out over the orchard and send trickles of moonlight down the staircase.  A framed display of knots hangs on the wall next to an old brass lantern.  The floorboards are buckled and warped, though braided throw rugs cover the worst patches.

Three portholes look out over the orchard and flood the staircase with sunlight.  A framed display of knots hangs on the wall next to an old brass lantern.  The floorboards are buckled and warped, though braided throw rugs cover the worst patches.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Path]
[Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
[Karazja Jungle, Hut]
[Karazja Jungle, Stone Ruins]
[Karazja Jungle, Ruins]
[Karazja Jungle, Mound]
[Karazja Jungle, Lost Garden]
[Karazja Jungle, Bamboo Grove]
description: The path is so obscured by jungle foliage that following it requires as much guesswork as woodcraft.  Gigantic leaves droop low over the narrow pathway, ferns and tall jungle grasses intrude from both sides.  Long strands of silky gossamer from tiny wind-traveling spiders are strung throughout the foliage, shining brightly in the sunlight.

Water drips from the leaves of the massive trees looming overhead.  Their overhanging branches block out all but a few stray motes of sunlight.  The earthy smell of decomposing leaves competes with the sweet scent of the yellow flowers growing in the jungle canopy overhead.

The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a troll raising a spear in triumph has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.

The trunk of a once-massive dead fel tree is enshrouded by the cable-thick shoots of a strangler fig.  Near the top, the greyish fig tree explodes in a halo of green leaves and auburn seed pods.  A few bucket orchids have attached themselves to the fig shoots, their pale yellow blossoms dangling like diseased organs.

The path underfoot can barely be distinguished from the jungle on either side.  Wide-leafed fronds stretch over the pathway, allowing only a few stray beams of sunlight to filter through.  The resilient underbrush on either side of the path springs back quickly as you pass.

The air, redolent with a cloyingly sweet smell, is still and humid.  The jungle undergrowth closes in on all sides, forming a nearly solid wall of green that ripples unnaturally.  The branches of tall trees loom overhead, trailing lianas over the pathway like the stingers of a jellyfish.

Thick vines cross the path, hindering passage but not preventing it.  Large pitcher-shaped plants grow on one side of the pathway.  Their bluish-grey flowers drip a smelly, viscous fluid onto the leaves.  A stand of tall bamboo trees rattles in the breeze.

The jungle, dark and impenetrable, looms in on all sides.  The path is nothing more than a line of slightly less dense foliage.  A few easily dodged liana runners are strung across the path.  A cloyingly sweet smell wafts through the area.

The thick jungle foliage gives way to a fairly open area dotted with blocks of stone and bits of debris, clearly the remnants of some ancient building.  Part of one wall remains standing, though it leans precariously.  Vines grow in profusion, covering the blocks of stone and creeping up the wall.

The shards of large earthenware vessels, some still containing the husks of old cloves of garlic, are lined against a collapsed, vine-enshrouded wall.  Two small bones dangle from a wooden peg set into a niche in the wall.  The niche is encircled with two wavy lines of some foul smelling, maroon-colored paste.  The jungle foliage encroaches on the ruins.

A semi-circle of stubby riverstone columns are huddled beneath a leafy canopy of vines.  A thick layer of wax, the residue of hundreds of guttered candles, covers the tops of the columns.  The smell of cinnamon and sweet bay leaf hovers in the air.

An open space in the jungle reveals a pair of collapsed stone buildings.  The weed-dotted walkway of carefully laid, flat riverstones is strewn with bits of rubble from the crumbling structures.  One building remains partially intact, two of its walls still standing.  Faint symbols are visible on the lintel above the doorway.

A marble statue of a reclining person, moss-covered and enshrouded by thick lianas, occupies the center of this small clearing.  The head of the marble figure has been replaced with a coconut, painted to express an obscene leer.  The jungle, noisy and oppressive, looms in on all sides.

A massive, vine-wrapped fel tree overhangs the faint pathway.  Skulls hanging from leather cords attached to the upper branches rattle together in the gentle breeze.  The thick undergrowth is spotted with bird droppings.

The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a crouching beast has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.

The ground rises here, forming an oval mound.  The foliage is as thick and dense as elsewhere, but clearly not as old as in other parts of the jungle.  The mound is pockmarked with small depressions, as if attempts had been made to burrow into the mound at some point in the distant past.  The high-pitched humming of gnats can be heard throughout the area.

The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a grinning face has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.

The jungle undergrowth has encroached on the ruins of this building.  Two of the walls have collapsed.  A third bows under the weight of thick lianas and rot.  Flat stones in front of what once was a fireplace have been ripped up and overturned, as though someone had searched for something underneath.

Although the jungle has inexorably overgrown this small area, it is still possible to discern it was once a formal garden.  A fountain stands to one side, the water in the basin filthy and stagnant.  The thorny runners of rose bushes have pulled down a rusted metal trellis.  A grey marble bench has been tipped over and damaged by some heavy object.

A heavy thicket of blackberry briars crowds out the other undergrowth.  Bits of fur and crude cloth are snagged on the briar thorns.  Overhead, the thick jungle foliage looms menacingly.  Vines, thin as spiderwebs, hang down from the branches.

The remnants of a stone walkway, now moss-covered and slippery, end abruptly at a solid wall of thick jungle vegetation.  Vines as thick as a giantkin's wrist twist around the tall trees, climbing upward and out onto the branches.  Some small flowers are illuminated by a stray patch of sunlight.

The heavy underbrush thins out slightly as the pathway passes through a stand of tall bamboo trees.  The trees sway in the breeze, rattling and scraping against each other like dry bones.  Patches of open soil appear, revealing a few prints of bare feet in the moist dirt.

The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a bird in flight has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.

On one side of the faint pathway is a rotting jumble of wooden beams, partially covered with leafy lianas and thick, woody vines.  The remnants of a stone kiln, now covered with bright green moss, can be seen through the jungle foliage.

The ground of this triangular-shaped jungle clearing is covered by a series of large flat stones tightly joined to create a sort of courtyard.  Long, waxy-leaved vines grow in profusion, stretching between the few riverstone pillars still standing.  A pair of moss-covered, oblong boulders are arranged side by side near the center of the courtyard.

Heavy vines enshroud the trees, forming a ragged canopy above the faint path as it wends its way through the dense jungle growth.  The canopy is thick enough to block most of the sunlight, making it difficult to determine the time of day.  Thick green leaves droop down into the pathway.

Bright yellow flowers grow in the jungle canopy overhead.  The lower branches of the trees droop menacingly above the overgrown pathway, their pliant leaves swaying in the breeze.  Ferns grow in profusion in and around the path.  A few large stones, covered with reddish mosses, peek through the ferns.

The triple canopy jungle blocks out nearly all the sunlight, leaving the area in a constant state of near darkness.  Short ferns with palmate leaves edged like daggers grow in profusion at the base of the tall trees.  Flowering vines drape from the lower limbs of the trees.  Fungus grows thick on the vines, giving them a green hairy appearance.

Looming out of the thick jungle are the ruins of a great stone hall.  Careful craftsmanship is apparent in the way the stones forming the walls have been joined together.  Though the roof is gone, the remaining three walls seem quite sturdy.  In the center of the structure is a fire pit surrounded by flat oblong rocks.  On one wall is a crude painting.

The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a dismembered body has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.

Bamboo grows tall and thick, forming a nearly impassable barrier.  Pale rays of sunlight filter through the bamboo leaves.  The fast-growing bamboo has encroached on the pathway, making it nothing more than a narrow track.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Ship's Wheel]
description: At the far end of the room, an oversized ship's wheel conceals a wooden podium.  Hard benches placed in rows line the walls, facing a dais.  Carved seagulls rest in the rafters, and moonlight from a large round window set into the ceiling filters into the room.

At the far end of the room, an oversized ship's wheel conceals a wooden podium.  Hard benches placed in rows line the walls, facing a dais.  Carved seagulls rest in the rafters, and light from a large round window set into the ceiling filters into the room.

title: [Port Valley, Streambank]
description: A single, massive ironwood tree stretches toward the sky from the near bank, attended by a ring of weeping willows.  Birdsong floats from their branches, blending with the gurgling of the waters into a peaceful song.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Cemetery]
description: Dirt ruts run westward out of the arch towards the center of the cemetery.  Old tombstones are scattered to either side, offering no sense of organization.  Several old marble tombs, partially obscured in growth, tower over the smaller headstones like silent sentinels and are silhouetted against the moonlit, sparkling waters of Maelstrom Bay beyond the edge of the bluff.

description: Eight large round tents are set in the center of a clearing, formed into two lines and separated by three large bonfires.  Blue and buff banners fly from the top of every tent, occasionally snapping in the breezes of the night.  A large white tent is set slightly off to the side, and its entrance is flanked by two pike-wielding sentries wearing Torren armor.

Set in a clearing cut from the surrounding woods is a simple cemetery.  The graves are arranged in orderly lines and riverstones marked with the names of those who rest beneath them serve as plain headstones.  Nearby are barren spots in the earth, hardpacked and stained by an encampment in the past.

title: [A Rough-Cut Track]
description: A ragged swath has been haphazardly cut through the undergrowth, leaving the remnants of brambles and bushes behind to snag the incautious.  The track clears to the south where a break in the trees beckons, though the nighttime sky pales in comparison to the twinkling lights alive on the track as lightning bugs put on a remarkable show.

title: [Felinium's Fur, Workroom]
description: Heaps of straw are strewn across the stone floor, while piles of hides requiring more scraping to remove the fur and loose bits of flesh from the skins have been dumped into the corners of the workshop.  Off to the side of the stained counter, two enormous vats partially sunk into the ground contain limestone and bleach.  Various implements of the trade can be found on pegs circling the room and in crates and other containers.

title: [Grassland Path]
description: The thick vegetation retreats as the path grows wider and the underbrush gives way to towering trees which block out patches of moonlight with an expansive canopy of green.  The calls of animals and birds fill the night air, interrupted by the occasional distant roar of a troll to the south.  As the path continues to the southeast, a trail of beaten dirt emerges from the closely shorn grass.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Porch]
description: A sturdy railing surrounding the porch supports some trailing vines that grow along its length.  Windchimes dangle from the wooden roof that shades the veranda.  A rope swing hangs from the ceiling, swaying gently with a passing breeze.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Foyer]
description: A wooden staircase rises to the second floor, its railing painted a pristine white.  Ivy vines have been trained to follow the balustrade, providing a verdant contrast to the paleness of the banister.  To the north, a hallway leads further into the building.

title: [Forest Clearing]
description: The trail opens into a wide clearing flooded by moonlight allowed by a break in the massive trees that circle a stucco and timber built building.  A high, thick wall separates the building from a buffer space of broad green lanes that holds back the shadows of the forest.  Giantwomen sentries flank a large gateway offering entry through the wall and to the building within.

title: [River's Rest, Forest]
description: Moonlight on the winding path between the trees only emphasizes the depth of shadows beneath the canopy of leaves.  There are few landmarks by which to find your way, but the spicy scent of dried oak leaves and the somnolescent murmur of owls make the meandering journey pleasant.

Dappled sunlight on the winding path between the trees only emphasizes the cool green shadows beneath the canopy of leaves.  There are few landmarks by which to find your way, but the spicy scent of dried oak leaves and the constant birdsong make the meandering journey pleasant.
Fallen leaves crunch underfoot as you wander without direction through the woods.  The light slanting through the trees gives the forest a serene, yet somber cast.

The trek through the trackless forest seems to have no end.  A downed oak, its decaying trunk as thick as a small town's streets are wide, sprouts an array of fungi in subtle and beautiful colors.  Despite this proof that for every life the forest claims, it sustains many more, it seems a waste that such a magnificent tree has fallen to rot.

A light breeze stirs the treetops above you, but the air closer to the forest floor is still.  Small red mushrooms, their caps vivid against deep green moss, adorn the bases of the vine-wreathed oaks and modwirs surrounding you.  Fallen leaves obscure any hint of a trail, and no path between the trees seems preferable to another.

Leaves beside the trail appear to have been disturbed recently, and closer examination shows the faint tracks of a predatory cat, perhaps a puma, pressed into the softer mud beneath the fallen foliage.  You see no sign of a struggle, though, and if the cat was hunting it seems likely the prey was lucky this time.

The trees give way to rushes around a small pond, giving you an unobstructed view of the limitless expanse of sky above you.  Water-striders dimple the pond's mirror-bright surface and cling to the slender leaves of irises growing along its mossy banks.

Dappled sunlight on the forest floor and a nearby stand of oak trees look familiar, but the sun has stayed in its proper position in the sky and proves that you aren't yet lost enough to go in circles.  The soporific drone of bees attending to the flowers at the base of towering trees combines pleasantly with birdsong, the mellifluous music of nature making the heat and exertion more tolerable.
The scent of damp earth implies a nearby pond or stream, but the countless trees obscure your view.  Leaves rustle at your approach as small creatures flee your imposition on their territory.

Leaves on the forest floor are hidden among tussocks of grass as the stately old-growth modwirs give way to willows, their lighter greens brilliant in the sunlight.  A nearby outcropping of native rock would be about knee-high on an average human, and judging by the smooth polish of its top, it has seen much use as a seat.

Situated across the small opening at one end is a defensive line of Torren guardsmen, occasionally set upon by random enemy forays.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Bilge]
description: Dark and cramped, this narrow passageway is awash in foul, briny water.  The air is fetid.  The poor footing of the slimy and slippery deck is exacerbated by the extreme tilt of the ship.

title: [Tunnel]
description: A constricted tunnel curves away into dark shadow.  Roots hang from the dirt ceiling and walls, mimicking the cob-webs secreted in various protected nooks and crannies.  The walls are very uneven, as though they were cut in haste.

title: [Tunnel Dogleg]
description: The passageway snakes through the ground, roots dangling from its walls like a beard.  Occasional squeaks sound from the shadows in the floor and walls, as small creatures protest the disturbance.  A glow lights the tunnel to the southwest, silhouetting the corridor's fringe of rootlets.

title: [Minaret, Balcony]
description: The silvery moonlight reveals an expanse of blackberry brambles cut by a serpentine path lying directly below the balcony. The roof of the Stone Eye Inn glimmers above the trees to the northwest, while the dome of the Pavilion of the Bells reflects pale starlight to the southeast.

title: [Outpost, Courtyard]
description: A large dirt courtyard is enclosed by a stucco and timber building that wraps around the open space hugging the large, thick wall that guards the outpost.  A covered walkway serves as protection from the elements to those passing in between doorways and archways that open directly on to the courtyard.  A row of sun-bleached orc skulls arc over a large gateway set into the wall, gazing downward on those coming and going with frozen grins and dark, lifeless eye sockets.

title: [Outpost, Infirmary]
description: Drying herbs hang from long, thin poles stretched across the ceiling of the infirmary, while several shelves along the wall offer up potions and tinctures of various size and type.  A basin of fresh water is placed at the head of a wide wooden bench that rests against the back wall of the room.  Fresh straw is spread across the earthen floor and tracked partly out the doorway into the courtyard outside.  Gaps in the straw reveal dark stains in the dirt floor.

title: [Outpost, Taskmaster Post]
description: A constant stream of recruits, scouts, and messengers flows in and out of the room, creating an air of hectic business.  The taskmaster stands in the center of the room, a conductor to the organized chaos, issuing orders and directing assistants to continually alter a large map set on the wall.  Beneath the map is a pigeon hole cabinet filled with scrolls of paper.

title: [Outpost, Courtyard]
description: Men and women of various races cross back and forth through the courtyard, sparring under the watchful eye of a stout dwarf standing atop a large wood block.  The covered walkway extends along the border of the courtyard, providing shade and shelter to several archways and doorways that open out on to the courtyard.  Along a wall that extends westwards towards the main gate are lined a series of dummies built to resemble orcs, goblins, and other fiends.

title: [Outpost, Office]
description: Arrow slots are the only windows in the spartan room, decorated only with a simple cot, table, and a large wood chest.  Several tanned krolvin skins are stretched and hung on the walls, providing the backdrop for a weapons rack and a modwir plaque.  The superintendent, a striking and scarred giantwoman, stands in the center of the room directing her attention from visitors to the men and women training in the courtyard.

title: [Outpost, Spring Room]
description: Numerous steps, cut into the dirt floor, lower the room significantly in contrast to the courtyard outside.  A coolness pervades the room, the source of which is a gurgling flow of water from a bamboo pipe into a retaining pool, offering an accessible source of fresh water inside the walls of the outpost.  Large casks that line the room are filled with fruits and vegetables, while large chunks of cured meat hang from metal hooks attached to the ceiling.

title: [Minaret, Refuge]
description: Tiles on the walls, ceiling, and floor of this circular room form incredibly intricate geometric patterns which center on the large statue of a blood eagle in the middle of the room.
