description: A stiff breeze rattles the bamboo walls of this cramped room, creating a slight whistling noise as the room sways.  There isn't much decoration in this room except for a centrally located table and a long shelf that has many vials sitting atop it.

title: [Marsh Keep, West Parapet]
description: A rotting wooden ladder hangs over the side of the parapet, leading several feet down towards the courtyard before ending abruptly with much of the journey down left to go.  A stone window built off a ledge next to the parapet offers a glimpse into the interior of the keep.  Several portions of the crenellation have fallen away, leaving gaps in the top of the wall and a view of the keep's surrounding earthworks below.

title: [The Warren, Bramble Clearing]
description: The scent of blackberries is thick in the air as the wall of brambles recedes to the southwest, revealing a well lit crowded neighborhood of rough, ramshackle buildings.  Moonlight reflects from the Tempest River to the northwest, giving sight to the sound of the swift-moving north fork of the river.  Several goats curled up next to stacked packages, sleep quietly by the path, resting from a day's work.

The scent of blackberries is thick in the air even as the wall of brambles recedes to the southwest, revealing a crowded neighborhood of rough, ramshackle buildings.  Light reflects from the Tempest to the northwest, giving sight to the sound of the swift-moving north fork of the river.  Small boys traverse the path leading goats laden with bulging sacks toward the neighborhood.

title: [Marsh Keep, Southwest Parapet]
description: Broken pieces of wood along with several rusted bands of metal cover the parapet at the southwest corner.  Visible to the west is a hill rising up out of the mist, and beyond it, the Great Western Sea.  The sound of distant troll screams and roars float in over the parapet, from the marshes beyond.

title: [Beacon Hall, Entry Hall]
description: Burled red oak paneling reflects the warm lamplight in this entry area.  On the east wall crossed longswords hang above a shining gold plaque.  An antique wooden door provides an exit out to the courtyard.

title: [Beacon Hall, Common Room]
description: Several coats of arms hang from the dark modwir walls in this softly lit room.  The south wall displays captured banners and armaments from a variety of military campaigns.  A large fieldstone fireplace dominates the north wall.  A massive oaken table sits surrounded by a horde of oak chairs in the center of the room beneath a black wrought iron chandelier.  Despite the presence of war paraphernalia, a sense of peace pervades the room.

title: [Beacon Hall, Story Room]
description: This expansive room is carpeted from wall to wall with soft lamb's wool that has been dyed a rich burgundy.  A large hearth in the rear lends a faint but warm light to the area.  A large, comfortable chair resting on an exquisite, hand-woven throw rug faces the hearth.  Soft pillows of every size are scattered about the floor.  The walls of this room are not adorned with any portraits, but the walls themselves are expertly painted murals.

title: [Beacon Hall, Display Room]
description: A long gallery of white marble shot with reddish veins extends along nearly the entire length of Beacon Hall.  Several arches on the west wall provide a splendid view across Maelstrom Bay.  A soft breeze filters through open windows, carrying a hint of sea salt and meadow flowers and causing three crystal chandeliers overhead to tinkle musically.  On the east wall, imposing glass display cases contain replicas and artifacts of historical significance.

title: [Beacon Hall, Terrace]
description: Lush foliage and scented blooms surround the terrace, providing a colorful frame for a magnificent view of the bay.  Sunlight sparkles off the distant waters.  Thick vines burst through an open canopy overhead, blanketing the area in a cloud of pale purple flowers.  Feathery ferns rim brick walkways, and red-blossomed trees enfold a stone bench, an elegant statue, and a sculptural fountain.  A large gazebo provides ample space for a band and dancers to gather.

title: [Beacon Hall, Dining Room]
description: The dining room is grand and spacious.  A huge, round, ebony table fills the center of the room.  Many comfortable chairs surround the table.  Beautiful tapestries adorn the marble walls on all sides of the room.  An elaborate chandelier hangs regally over the center table.  The light from torches in the corners of the room dance off the chandelier, making the room sparkle brilliantly.

title: [Beacon Hall, Mentoring Room]
description: Latticed windows open out over the bay, providing an inspiring view.  A small table and a few comfortable chairs offer a quiet and intimate setting for personal instruction.  A shelf along one wall contains a variety of bound guides and treatises, and a large slate hangs on the wall opposite.

title: [Beacon Hall, Game Room]
description: In the middle of this room is a large gaming table complete with equipment for playing a variety of games.  An enormous bar that appears freshly stocked dominates the west wall.  The darkly stained modwir walls are covered with an assortment of armaments and flags.

title: [Beacon Hall, Dragon Fountain]
description: An enormous stone dragon's head emerges from the dark center of a large hole, dominating this round chamber.  Water pours out of the dragon's gaping maw, creating a swift waterfall that empties into the hole below.

title: [Beacon Hall, Water Lagoon]
description: The hole from which the waterfall emerges is far, far above.  Providing the only source of outside light, the opening frames the noble head of the immense stone dragon that is barely visible above.  The dragon's scaled body glistens under the fine mist from the waterfall, and its majestic wings stretch out against the walls of this cavern.  The large, powerful legs of the creature disappear beneath the rippled surface of the lagoon.

title: [Beacon Hall, Dock]
description: A well-built stone pier juts out into the bay at the foot of a long stairway carved from the face of the cliff.

title: [Beacon Hall, Rock Room]
description: This room appears to be unfinished.  Although it is encompassed on all four sides by stone walls, it lacks a ceiling, and sunlight streams in unhindered.  The floor is made up entirely of small rocks and pebbles, which crunch loudly underfoot.

title: [Beacon Hall, Lecture Room]
description: Tall stone walls rise high overhead in this vast room.  The immaculate granite floor contains small grooves that improve footing, betraying the room's former use as a gymnasium.  Intricately designed domed windows in the ceiling allow sunlight to stream in during the day while dozens of large brass oil lamps along the walls provide illumination at night.  Several rows of benches face the lectern standing at one end of the room.

title: [Beacon Hall, Lighthouse]
description: Leaded glass windows spiral upward along the marble walls of this high tower.  A catwalk supporting a complex, crystal-lensed beacon is visible at the top.  In the center of the room a glowing orb rests on an elaborately carved pedestal.

title: [Beacon Hall, Hallway]
description: This hallway is paved with pale gold flagstones.  Sunlight flows through the thick translucent quartz skylights above and reflects off the flagstones, bathing the white tile walls in an even, golden glow.  The west wall supports two large mosaics: a silver-framed panel with a silver plaque on it and a gold-framed panel with a gold plaque on it.

wayto.22225: ;e multifput('pull silver panel','push gold panel','pull silver panel')

title: [Beacon Hall, Office]
[Beacon Hall, Officers' Chamber]
description: Crowded bookshelves line three of the walls.  From massive tomes to small pamphlets, each text competes for space in which to display its recognizable or not-so-recognizable title.  In one corner a carved teak chair sits behind a matching desk.

Majestic and spacious, this oval room is enclosed with mahogany wainscoting.  An arched bay window resides opposite a carved willow door, providing a sweeping view of Maelstrom Bay.  The focal point of the room is a claw-footed circular table of grand scale, surrounded by ten plush high-backed chairs.  A horizon of elaborate wrought iron sconces provides function and finish to the room.

title: [Beacon Hall, Study]
description: This dark, quiet room was designed for comfort and contemplation.  Bookshelves and desks create nooks in each corner of the room beneath small but bright chandeliers.  An enormous roaring fireplace takes up most of one wall, its mantle carved from the trunk of a single tree.  Facing the fireplace is a huge overstuffed sofa flanked by comfortable chairs and sturdy end tables.

title: [Beacon Hall, Passage]
description: A dim corridor stretches into the distance, poorly lit by a single guttering lamp.  Glistening rivulets of condensation run down the rough stone blocks of the walls and soak into the packed dirt floor.  A cluster of slimy mushrooms growing next to a low doorway is the source of the musty odor that pervades the area.

title: [Beacon Hall, Kitchen]
description: A small army of halfling chefs bustles about this large kitchen, oblivious to anything not concerning cookery.  Clinging to the highest rung of a ladder, one of the small cooks hangs precariously over the open door of a huge brick oven.  A white-aproned chef diligently kneads a large mound of dough on a rectangular butcher block counter standing in the center of the ceramic tile floor.  The tiny cooks proudly hand over their delicious fare to the elven pages steadily arriving from the dining hall.

title: [Beacon Hall, Staircase]
description: This long, cramped, wooden staircase connects the kitchen with the rooms above.  The servants use it to transport meals, dishes, linens and other assorted odds and ends between the two floors so as not to be seen on the main staircase.  The construction is rather shoddy, and several of the boards creak loudly with the passing of footsteps.

title: [Beacon Hall, Storage Room]
description: Cupboards, shelves and bins completely fill this room, each overflowing with every type of clothing, armor, weaponry, and trinket imaginable.  Signs hang from the ceiling over separated areas: "Goat Festival," "Halcyon Days Festival," "Auction," and "Odds and Ends."

title: [Beacon Hall, Lofty Room]
description: A vaulted ceiling rises high above this large, unfurnished room.  A number of crates and barrels, most still sealed, are stacked about the room.  They bear labels indicating their contents to be books, scrolls, maps, and assorted scholarly paraphernalia, obviously intended for the Archive library but not yet unpacked.  The few open containers give off a satisfying smell of leather and parchment, and literary riches can be glimpsed within.

title: [Beacon Hall, Waiting Room]
description: A panoramic mural of Maelstrom Bay covers the walls of this long hallway.  Beneath the mural sit soft leather benches dyed a deep burgundy.  Plush velvet draperies frame the north entrance to this hallway, and proudly displayed at the opposite end is a silver shield bearing the coat of arms of the Beacon Hall Archives.

title: [Beacon Hall, Archives]
description: Bookcases cover all the walls of this room and even extend outward from the walls in several places.  All are full of massive tomes, registers, books, pamphlets, ledgers, and all other manner of written record.  The carpet here is a plush burgundy, muffling the footsteps of those who tread among the volumes.  Several tables lit by small reading lanterns nestle among the bookcases.  Toward the back of the room, a heavy glaes door stands out in contrast to the warm hues of carpet and wood shelving.

title: [Beacon Hall, Indoor Garden]
description: This spacious garden offers a quiet refuge.  Cobblestone paths wind among beds of rare flowers, ornamental plants, and healing herbs.  The ceiling high overhead is one huge pane of frosted quartz, allowing the sunlight to shine in liberally while trapping the heat.  Two stone benches sit across from each other down the main pathway.  Ancient arched trees provide a shady spot for contemplation.

title: [Beacon Hall, Longship]
description: A richly embroidered, tasseled canopy, stained from salt spray and faded from long exposure to the elements, stretches over the cockpit, providing welcome shade from the sun.  There is an aura of immense age about the longship.  The decks of dark thanot are sunbleached and heavily grained.  The top of the tall mast is difficult to see against the bright sun.  Standing on the aftdeck, one hand on the tiller, is the longship captain.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Cemetery]
description: The center of the cemetery is marked by a statue of robed woman on a pedestal surrounded by dirt ruts that circle her once, then split away to the east.  Clusters of lilies grow around the base of the pedestal and fill the area with a sweet, rich aroma.  Headstones of varying sizes and makes populate the grass expanse up to the edge of the bluff to the north, some nearly invisible behind tall grasses and weeds.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, northwest

title: [Marsh Keep, South Parapet]
description: Slitted holes in the floor offer a view of the inner portcullis below, in addition to a larger square opening next to which lies the rusting remains of an iron cauldron.  Beyond the parapets' crenellations, the marsh spreads out across the horizon.  In between patches of fog, a small cluster of buildings appear to the southwest and much farther away, a tower with a blue roof marks the location of Maelstrom Bay.

title: [Marsh Keep, Southeast Parapet]
description: Algae partially covers the surface of an overflowing rain barrel set in the corner of the stone parapet.  Along the side of the crenellated wall, small stone stepping blocks are placed sporadically, allowing for a better view of the surrounding land.  Seated on the edge of the parapet is the lower half of a skeleton, as if its owner had taken a rest overlooking the courtyard, still partially dressed in rotting armor.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Cemetery]
description: The edge of the bluff and the river beneath it cut back to the south, providing the buried dead a serene overlook of the bay beyond the island of River's Rest and the wide flowing south fork of the Tempest River.  Sunken graves dot the area, occasionally spotted with a wood marker, and interspersed with marble and riverstone crypts of varying size and ornateness.  A ring of small willows grows in the center of the graves around a patch of emerald green grass.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Cemetery]
description: Majestic, towering trees that merge into the canopy of the jungle to the south, stand over the long neglected and ruined section of the cemetery.  Dark green moss and vines cover broken statuary, obscure headstones and crypts.  The further south the section goes, the more it disappears into the creep of the forest, leaving under the shaded growth unfathomable bulges of vibrant plant life which fade away into the greenness of the jungle.

title: [Marsh Keep, East Parapet]
description: Stone steps lead down to the courtyard below, beginning at the point where the parapet extends from the wall of the keep, and running south until turning west.  From between the crenellated granite walls of the parapet, the view of the surrounding fens and marshes goes on for some while, partially covered in patchwork blankets of fog before disappearing completely in a shroud of grey and white.

title: [Millah's Fen, Lookout Hill]
description: Stars fill the night sky, their light reflected faintly by a sea of fog surrounding the hilltop.  A soft glow far to the south marks the location of River's Rest and silhouettes a lone tower.  Intermittent bursts of light illuminate an omnious keep to the east, while the silence of the night air carries the sound of a distant sea to the west.  Weathered and moss covered, a stone chair is set facing the west in the center of the hilltop.

An island above the swirling fog, the top of the hill offers an endless view of the surrounding geography.  Far to the west, a blue strip represents the Great Western Sea, while to the east, an ominous stone keep emerges from the fog.  Farther to the south is a blue-roofed tower and beyond it, the minarets and towers of River's Rest.  Weathered and moss-covered, a stone chair is set facing the west in the center of the hilltop.

Stars fill the night sky, their light reflected faintly by a sea of fog surrounding the hilltop.  A soft glow far to the south marks the location of River's Rest and silhouettes a lone tower.  Intermittent bursts of light illuminate an ominous keep to the east, while the silence of the night air carries the sound of a distant sea to the west.  Weathered and moss covered, a stone chair is set facing the west in the center of the hilltop.

title: [Pond Burrow, Square]
description: A large cavern is cut into the hill, its floor and ceiling crafted of smooth rock with a pronounced pattern of striations.  Fanciful trees fashioned from the same gorgeous stone sit in monumental urns around the perimeter, each leaf carved in minute detail.  A generous round oak door on the cavern's west wall is surmounted by a sign reading simply 'Tavern', and the noise of revelry emerges from behind it.

title: [Pond Burrow Tavern]
description: The tavern is a generous room set with long tables and benches.  A few more private tables are nestled in the back, each one with its own tapestry curtain.  Candles burn merrily, giving the room a warm golden glow.  In the corner sits a small stage where a few instruments are leaned against tall stools.  You also see a long modwir sideboard with the tavern menu on it and the tavern door.

title: [Pond Burrow, Pond Tavern Way]
description: Tavern Way passes the front of Pond Burrow's mead hall.  Cheerful pools of light fall from its shuttered windows, glowing on the walk.  Its entrance can be seen a little further north.  As the paved walk rounds the southern corner of the building, it narrows into a gullet-like tunnel notable for the row of lanterns hung down its length, all carved in the shape of flying bees.  They appear to head purposefully down the corridor in search of nectar.

title: [Pond Burrow, Honey Tunnel Turn]
description: The tunnel angles toward the distant sound of revelry, music and laughter mingled in a fluctuating buzz.  Soft light from bee-shaped lanterns overhead falls on two round doors each set in a small alcove.  An attractive pattern of tiles paving the walk mimics octagonal sections of a hive.

title: [Hoosegow, Tickler's Chamber]
description: Centrally located in the room is a small brick oven.  Beside the oven is a wooden rack holding various iron and steel implements.  To one side is a sturdy wooden table.  Firmly set at regular intervals into the thick stucco walls of the room are four sets of manacles.  The room is lighted by a few ceramic oil lamps hanging from the low ceiling.

title: [Fleet Captain's Dock]
description: This wooden dock rests firmly on a half-dozen ancient, black stone pilings.  Although covered with barnacles and knots of mussels, it's still apparent that the pilings are fluted like the pillars of an old temple.  On either side of the dock the banks of the creek are thick with reeds and cattails.  The tidal creek flows by sluggishly.

title: [Fletcher Shop, Back Room]
description: Several large candles illuminate this small backroom with a flickering light.  You are able to make out the shapes of many bows hanging on the walls, some as large as a giantman, each an intricately carved work of art.  Bundles of arrows are propped in the corners, and a row of small barrels along one wall holds various types of crossbow bolts.

title: [Pond Burrow, Honey Tunnel Way]
description: The tunnel narrows, as well as branching.  Occupying the space on the west is a carved panel, which divides the egresses to two other passageways.  An involved scene is carved upon it in bas-relief.  The lantern overhead hovers at the end of the chain that supports it, fashioned in the image of a large flying bee.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Taj Court]
description: The court is ringed by buildings painted in a rich palette of color.  Shutters on some are painted contrasting hues which are as vivid, yet blend harmoniously with the whole.  Large terra-cotta urns hold a riot of blossoms beside many of the doors, providing yet more pattern to the visual feast.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Faraf Way West]
description: The 'Way' is a narrow alley-like thoroughfare which winds through rows of houses like a snake.  It is paved in an attractive type of paving stones.  Their color is a sienna so rich, it is reminiscent of a crimson moon rising out of the thick atmosphere at sunset.  The smell of sandalwood is strong, drifting from a row of spice shops interspersed between the residences.

title: [Khan'Kel Bazaar, Tel'Afall Lane]
description: The lane turns back on itself, creating a small enclosed court crowded with buildings.  Heat bakes the paving stones, lifting from them in a shimmering haze.  At the apex of the turn, a set of tall, wrought-iron gates guard the entrance to a stately residence.  Tall lebbek trees growing on either side of the gate throw a bit of welcome shade in that corner of the avenue.

title: [Pond Burrow, Mead Tunnel Walk]
description: Mead Tunnel Walk is rendered aromatic with the smell of mead wafting from a brewery, which is obviously located somewhere nearby.  A few doors find a home in the walls, their owners undoubtedly fond of the drink.  Halflings who pass occasionally sniff the air with appreciation and nod, as if judging the quality of the air to be satisfactory.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Passageway]
description: A long glass display case full of fishing equipment takes up most of one wall.  Artificial bait, hooks, and fishing weights line the shelves and dangle from fishing line creatively draped from hooks within the case.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Broom Closet]
description: Wooden bins lining the walls store various items used for cleaning and repair.  Hanging pegs hold brooms, mops, and various gardening tools.  A few buckets and watering cans on the floor are the only evidence of disarray in the otherwise spotless closet.

title: [Wizard Guild, Scribe's Workroom]
description: Sunken into the ground, it is cool here where the scribes concentrate on their scrolls.  Several earthen chairs have been carved out of the ground and a slab of solid riverstone has been placed on a large mound of dirt in front of the chairs.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Mess Hall]
description: A long oak trestle table rests in the center of the room, with matching benches set along either side.  Dishes have been laid out with precision, each place setting identical to the next.  Paintings of long-forgotten sea captains hang from the whitewashed walls.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Galley]
description: An island built in the center of this kitchen supports a deep sink and a marble countertop.  Pots, pans, and utensils hang from hooks attached to the ceiling.  A large oven set into the wall releases its heat outside, keeping the room relatively cool.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: The curving, erratic path of the guild's stone walls has been allowed to continue, the only compromise to practicality being a series of rectangular niches lined with shelves.  Hundreds of scrolls and volumes compete for the available space, sheltered safely beneath the unfinished round of the ceiling.  Benches and desks are scattered in a semi-circle, each equipped with an oddly shaped bit of quartz that sheds a gentle glow.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Chart Room]
description: An enormous table supports a detailed map of the known parts of Elanthia, with various charting tools strewn about.  Padded chairs surround the tabletop, their seats high enough to provide even a halfling with a clear view of the surface.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Bunk Room]
description: Two rows of narrow padded shelves line the walls, one above the other, much like the bunks on a ship.  Glass bottles with wooden model ships line the shelves.  Fluffy pillows and thick blanket are piled here and there on the floor.

title: [Pond Burrow, Cookie Promenade]
description: A breeze rounds the turn of the walk, carrying the aroma of baking pastries.  The Promenade is paved with an attractive pattern of tiles, its light and dark contrasts creating an octagonal motif.  Alternating mosaics depicting tarts, cookies and cupcakes alternate every few feet along the corridor's length.

title: [Pond Burrow, Cookie Cul-de-sac]
description: The cul-de-sac turns within a cobblestone circle, its walls a frieze of carved images.  One doorway occupies the circle, sitting proudly in the midst of the ornamentation.  The sill around it is likewise sculpted, its image that of a large cookie which surrounds the whole door.

title: [Top of the Eye, Tables]
description: Small ebonywood dining tables are situated such that every diner has a magnificent view of the countryside:  River's Rest, the river below and the Citadel of Elanith above.  Oaken frames supporting massive panes of glass make up the walls and ceiling of the circular dining area.  Bustling servants seem to be at your shoulder at your slightest whim to satisfy your every need.

title: [Pond Burrow, Mead Tunnel Walk]
description: The walk meanders along, its flagstones bathed in warm circles of light cast by lanterns hanging along the roof.  The aroma of brewing mead spices a comfortable breeze traveling the tunnel.  Doorways to either side of the passageway are painted in bright colors, interspersed with an attractive border of flowers carved into the stone between them.

title: [Pond Burrow, Mead Tunnel Walk]
description: The passageway turns, its lanterns changing shape as they march down tunnels in different directions.  Scrolled shells give way to lanterns crafted in the shape of large walnuts.  A stone plaque is attached to the wall between a couple of doors, helpfully offering directions.

title: [Pond Burrow, Honey Tunnel Way]
description: A branch in the tunnel is marked by a fountain mounted on the wall.  The water emerging from the tangle of carved bees seems to be moving slowly, until one realizes it is honey.  The corridor is home to a couple of doors, their lintels crowned with sculpted beehive boxes.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Path]
description: The path is so obscured by jungle foliage that following it requires as much guesswork as woodcraft.  Gigantic leaves droop low over the narrow pathway, ferns and tall jungle grasses intrude from both sides.  Long strands of silky gossamer from tiny wind-traveling spiders are strung throughout the foliage, shining brightly in the sunlight.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Stone Ruins]
description: A marble statue of a reclining person, moss-covered and enshrouded by thick lianas, occupies the center of this small clearing.  The head of the marble figure has been replaced with a coconut, painted to express an obscene leer.  The jungle, noisy and oppressive, looms in on all sides.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Ruins]
description: On one side of the faint pathway is a rotting jumble of wooden beams, partially covered with leafy lianas and thick, woody vines.  The remnants of a stone kiln, now covered with bright green moss, can be seen through the jungle foliage.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: The path underfoot can barely be distinguished from the jungle on either side.  Wide-leafed fronds stretch over the pathway, allowing only a few stray beams of sunlight to filter through.  The resilient underbrush on either side of the path springs back quickly as you pass.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: The heavy underbrush thins out slightly as the pathway passes through a stand of tall bamboo trees.  The trees sway in the breeze, rattling and scraping against each other like dry bones.  Patches of open soil appear, revealing a few prints of bare feet in the moist dirt.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Karazja Jungle, Hut]
description: The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a dismembered body has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Pond Burrow, Honey Tunnel Way]
description: The long corridor's length is marked by the pools of light cast by distinctive lanterns.  Halflings amble along passing through the successive spotlights, their voices animated and high-pitched.  A faint odor of brewing mead alternates with that of baking pastries, carried on a breeze which plays through the tunnels.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Hut]
description: The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a troll raising a spear in triumph has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Karazja Jungle, Stone Ruins]
description: The thick jungle foliage gives way to a fairly open area dotted with blocks of stone and bits of debris, clearly the remnants of some ancient building.  Part of one wall remains standing, though it leans precariously.  Vines grow in profusion, covering the blocks of stone and creeping up the wall.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: The triple canopy jungle blocks out nearly all the sunlight, leaving the area in a constant state of near darkness.  Short ferns with palmate leaves edged like daggers grow in profusion at the base of the tall trees.  Flowering vines drape from the lower limbs of the trees.  Fungus grows thick on the vines, giving them a green hairy appearance.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Stone Ruins]
description: An open space in the jungle reveals a pair of collapsed stone buildings.  The weed-dotted walkway of carefully laid, flat riverstones is strewn with bits of rubble from the crumbling structures.  One building remains partially intact, two of its walls still standing.  Faint symbols are visible on the lintel above the doorway.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: The air, redolent with a cloyingly sweet smell, is still and humid.  The jungle undergrowth closes in on all sides, forming a nearly solid wall of green that ripples unnaturally.  The branches of tall trees loom overhead, trailing lianas over the pathway like the stingers of a jellyfish.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Ruins]
description: The shards of large earthenware vessels, some still containing the husks of old cloves of garlic, are lined against a collapsed, vine-enshrouded wall.  Two small bones dangle from a wooden peg set into a niche in the wall.  The niche is encircled with two wavy lines of some foul smelling, maroon-colored paste.  The jungle foliage encroaches on the ruins.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: Heavy vines enshroud the trees, forming a ragged canopy above the faint path as it wends its way through the dense jungle growth.  The canopy is thick enough to block most of the sunlight, making it difficult to determine the time of day.  Thick green leaves droop down into the pathway.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Stone Ruins]
description: Looming out of the thick jungle are the ruins of a great stone hall.  Careful craftsmanship is apparent in the way the stones forming the walls have been joined together.  Though the roof is gone, the remaining three walls seem quite sturdy.  In the center of the structure is a fire pit surrounded by flat oblong rocks.  On one wall is a crude painting.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Emerald Lagoon]
description: A horseshoe-shaped lagoon of brilliant emerald green water is bordered by a stunning white sand beach.  Dense jungle growth surrounds the lagoon on all sides.  The chatter and trill of unseen creatures comes from somewhere deep in the jungle.  Sunlight reflects off the surface of the still lagoon, causing a myriad of sparkles.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Stone Ruins]
description: The ground of this triangular-shaped jungle clearing is covered by a series of large flat stones tightly joined to create a sort of courtyard.  Long, waxy-leaved vines grow in profusion, stretching between the few riverstone pillars still standing.  A pair of moss-covered, oblong boulders are arranged side by side near the center of the courtyard.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: Thick vines cross the path, hindering passage but not preventing it.  Large pitcher-shaped plants grow on one side of the pathway.  Their bluish-grey flowers drip a smelly, viscous fluid onto the leaves.  A stand of tall bamboo trees rattles in the breeze.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Hut]
description: The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a crouching beast has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: The jungle, dark and impenetrable, looms in on all sides.  The path is nothing more than a line of slightly less dense foliage.  A few easily dodged liana runners are strung across the path.  A cloyingly sweet smell wafts through the area.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Hut]
description: The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a bird in flight has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: A heavy thicket of blackberry briars crowds out the other undergrowth.  Bits of fur and crude cloth are snagged on the briar thorns.  Overhead, the thick jungle foliage looms menacingly.  Vines, thin as spiderwebs, hang down from the branches.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Hut]
description: The remains of a small grass-roofed, daub and wattle hut are nearly hidden by the dense jungle undergrowth.  The dilapidated state of the hut's roof is evidence that it has been abandoned for some time.  A crude sketch of a grinning face has been painted on the side of the hut in some sort of maroon paste.  The doorway has collapsed, becoming nothing more than a frame for a white cluster of spider webs.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: Water drips from the leaves of the massive trees looming overhead.  Their overhanging branches block out all but a few stray motes of sunlight.  The earthy smell of decomposing leaves competes with the sweet scent of the yellow flowers growing in the jungle canopy overhead.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Lost Garden]
description: Although the jungle has inexorably overgrown this small area, it is still possible to discern it was once a formal garden.  A fountain stands to one side, the water in the basin filthy and stagnant.  The thorny runners of rose bushes have pulled down a rusted metal trellis.  A grey marble bench has been tipped over and damaged by some heavy object.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, northwest

title: [Karazja Jungle, Ruins]
description: The jungle undergrowth has encroached on the ruins of this building.  Two of the walls have collapsed.  A third bows under the weight of thick lianas and rot.  Flat stones in front of what once was a fireplace have been ripped up and overturned, as though someone had searched for something underneath.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Karazja Jungle, Ruins]
description: A semi-circle of stubby riverstone columns are huddled beneath a leafy canopy of vines.  A thick layer of wax, the residue of hundreds of guttered candles, covers the tops of the columns.  The smell of cinnamon and sweet bay leaf hovers in the air.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: A massive, vine-wrapped fel tree overhangs the faint pathway.  Skulls hanging from leather cords attached to the upper branches rattle together in the gentle breeze.  The thick undergrowth is spotted with bird droppings.

title: [Pond Burrow, Rum Tunnel Turn]
description: Rum Tunnel Turn is a quiet corner with brightly painted doors creating a patchwork of color around its bend.  In each direction along the promenade, stone benches are placed, their seats bare inches off the paving stones.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Sacred Path]
description: Piles of stones covered with moss and vines litter the ground.  The arches of ancient buildings lie partially hidden by the jungle growth.  Fragments of bone lie in heaps throughout the rubble.  The pathway itself, however, is tidy and well-swept.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Sacred Path]
description: The path wanders through the ruins of old stone buildings, now moss-covered and hung with vines and leafy lianas.  Rough, dark red stones and small white bones are arranged in a crude pattern beside the well-swept path.  The jungle foliage has been trimmed back to preserve the width of the path.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Sacred Path]
description: The path swerves sharply around a low, grassy mound.  The mound is covered with strange, spiky ferns.  The jungle foliage has overgrown the crumbling ruins on either side of the tidy path, but has been cut back to keep the pathway clear.  On one side of the path a series of rough, dark red stones and small white bones are arranged in a crude pattern.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Sacred Path]
description: The path follows the perimeter of a low mound covered with strange, spiky ferns.  The crumbling ruins on either side of the tidy path are partially hidden by the jungle foliage.  The undergrowth has been cut back to keep the pathway clear.  On the side of the path is a crude pattern made of rough, dark red stones and small white bones.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Sacred Path]
description: A line of wooden spikes has been set into the ground on either side of the path.  Impaled on each spike is a skull or partially decomposed head.  Flies buzz in a noisy cloud around the heads.  The rank odor of decaying flesh mixes with the sweet smell of the flowers that grow on the lianas that cover the stone ruins.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Stone Idol]
description: A large stone idol dominates this small clearing in the jungle-covered ruins.  Directly in front of the idol is a long slab of native riverstone.  The front of the idol is covered with tacky gore.  Flies swarm everywhere.  The stink of putrefaction and death casts a pall over the area.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Mound]
description: The ground rises here, forming an oval mound.  The foliage is as thick and dense as elsewhere, but clearly not as old as in other parts of the jungle.  The mound is pockmarked with small depressions, as if attempts had been made to burrow into the mound at some point in the distant past.  The high-pitched humming of gnats can be heard throughout the area.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Bamboo Grove]
description: Bamboo grows tall and thick, forming a nearly impassable barrier.  Pale rays of sunlight filter through the bamboo leaves.  The fast-growing bamboo has encroached on the pathway, making it nothing more than a narrow track.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Overgrown Path]
description: Bright yellow flowers grow in the jungle canopy overhead.  The lower branches of the trees droop menacingly above the overgrown pathway, their pliant leaves swaying in the breeze.  Ferns grow in profusion in and around the path.  A few large stones, covered with reddish mosses, peek through the ferns.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Beach]
description: Seashells dot the sand in an ever-changing abstract pattern influenced by the small waves which roll up onto the beach.  Farther into the bay, larger waves break against a hidden reef.  The slow, monotonous waves provides a peaceful counterpoint to the frenetic darting of the shore birds.

title: [Karazja Jungle, Beach]
description: Clumps of green seaweed have washed ashore, providing a few small crabs temporary shelter from the hungry birds circling overhead.  The sand of the beach sparkles in the sunlight.  To the west, out beyond a reef, is Maelstrom Bay and the great western sea.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Attic]
description: Tendrils of ivy creep into the room through the wrapped bamboo walls and stretch from floor to ceiling.  Hanging from the ivy are several small buckets that carry miniscule amounts of water that most likely drip from the ceiling when it rains.  Along the western wall are several overturned crates and barrels holding various items of importance.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Attic]
description: This small room smells very musty, and its builder did not have enough sense to equip it with any windows.  He did, however, decide to build some handy shelves along the perimeter to hold the many vials of dye spotted throughout the room.  The eastern wall of the room is made from natural slate rock and seems to be untouched by modern tools except for a solid staircase that emerges from its corner.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Basement]
description: The most prominent thing about this room is the long staircase that winds upward towards the sky.  Each step is crafted from the natural rock of the cavern, and no two steps are entirely even.  The rock walls are much eroded, and water trickles around several small cubbies created from years of water damage.  Several vials, conveniently filled with multi-colored dyes, are neatly placed within the cubbies.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Attic]
description: Even the slightest breeze causes a flurry of dust to scamper across the room in delicate spirals.  No decorations are apparent other than a solitary bucket that sits upside-down near the northern wall of the room and a small table.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Basement]
description: This room is damp, and mold grows between the natural cracks in the rock on both the walls and the ground.  Dripping water slowly trickles down the mossy wall and disappears through a small hole in the rock floor.  There are several overturned yellow and orange crates along one wall that serve as display units for many different dyes.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Basement]
description: Two small sconces sit upon the wall, delicately nailed to the rock.  They send flickers of light dancing around the room and hiss occasionally when small droplets of water fall upon them.  A pair of grey stones sits in the middle of this dank room, leaving plenty of space for perusal of the wares.

title: [Timor's Storage, Hallway]
description: You are in a dimly lit hallway.  The torches on the walls flicker and fade casting all manner of shadows about the hallway.

title: [Pond Burrow, Rum Tunnel Lane]
description: The corridor angles, its bend creating a corner where rests a short bench.  Halflings occasionally seize the opportunity to stop, sit and devour a pastry, before continuing along.

title: [Pond Burrow, Tart Tunnel Walk]
description: Tart Tunnel Walk boasts polished stone tiles set into its ceiling and walls.  Larger tiles pave the walk, each one decorated with an elegant design incised upon it.  The illumination is soft, shed from angular lanterns hung along the length of the corridor.

title: [Pond Burrow, Tart Tunnel Way]
description: The tunnel branches in several directions, its juncture marked by a circular stone set into the floor, its surface masterfully carved.  It depicts the heavens above-ground, constellations and moons rendered with tiny crystal chips inset into the rock.  Somewhere nearby, burning incense adds its exotic flavor to the air.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Pond Burrow, Tart Tunnel Way]
description: Tart Tunnel Way is rendered true to its name by the mouth-watering aroma of baking pastries, which wafts from one or more of the round doors clustered at this bend in the corridor.  Small groups of halflings stroll around the curve, smiling as they catch a whiff of the delicacies browning in nearby ovens.  On one wall is a carved panel depicting a bas-relief still-life of berries, scones and tarts.

title: [Pond Burrow, Tart Tunnel Branch]
description: The tunnel branches, its divergence marked by a stone bench set between a group of round doors.  Carved stone flowers cluster around the legs of the settle, each petal perfectly rendered.  The lanterns overhead evolve from angularity to an ornate spiral, which marks the row of lamps marching along the ceiling to the southwest.

title: [Pond Burrow, Rum Tunnel Lane]
description: Rum Tunnel is decorated with the beginning of a mosaic which extends to the southwest, its surface a continuous panorama of color.  A great battlefield is depicted, with armies ranged across the hills in clashing splashes of color and motion.  The lamps above light the tableau, shedding illumination from spiraling profiles which mimic ocean shells.

title: [Pond Burrow, Rum Tunnel Lane]
description: The Lane widens into an octagonal alcove before angling toward the southwest.  The paving stones are beautifully laid within this circular area, in an interlocking pattern of octagons punctuated with a host of tiny mosaic bees.  In the center of the design sits a larger bee, the queen of the hive.

title: [Pond Burrow, Tart Tunnel Walk]
description: The corridor bends sharply, the annex where diverging tunnels meet adorned with a large bas-relief panel.  Round doors fill the remaining walls, their sills richly carved with stone filigree.  An urn sits beside one of the doors, inhabited by a delicate fern carved from granite.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Bridgeover]
description: Cobblestones begin at the bridge's foot, escorting the avenue along its path, which winds between a dense cluster of immaculate cottages.  Grouting the stones, green moss grows, adding the contrast of its verdant color to the stones' grey palette.  At various points along the road sit carved statuary, depicting rabbits, toads and other small woodland creatures.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Bridgeover]
description: The cobblestone avenue rings a courtyard, where large terra cotta urns hold small, decorative trees and cascades of flowering vines.  Tables and chairs are set beneath a trellis covered with grapevines.  Houses sit nestled in the garden setting, adding as much charm as the flowering ornamentation.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Bridgeover]
description: Bridgeunder Lane follows the perimeter of the central courtyard, its outer shoulder adorned with a row of cottages.  A dense bank of hostas lines the walk, sending up tall stalks studded with lavender flowers.  Overhead, a single majestic magnolia tree adds the perfume of its blooms to the breeze.

title: [Hummingbird Pond, Bridgeover]
description: The lane dog-legs, edging the triangular courtyard.  Competing ovens within the cluster of homes lining the road send out aromas that would coax the most satiated mouth to water.  Groups of halflings stroll through the gardens, stopping to greet friends and admire the manicured grounds.

title: [Boreas Hills, Mistral Court]
description: Homes line the street here, each sitting on its own small plot of land.  Tidy wooden fences surround several of them, ivy growing up and around the slats, giving the whole area a very picturesque look.

Homes line the street here, each sitting on its own small plot of land.  Tidy wooden fences surround several of them, ivy growing up and around the slats.  In addition to the illumination from the moon, several lanterns sit on fence posts here and there.

title: [Boreas Hills, Etesian Terrace]
description: Water trickles down from the mountain above, gently cascading into a pond here before continuing its way through the hills in the form of a small stream.  Houses sit around the pond, small paths leading from them to the main road.  A small wooden bridge continues the roadway over the stream.

Water trickles down from the mountain above, gently cascading into a pond here before continuing its way through the hills in the form of a small stream.  Houses sit around the pond, small paths leading from them to the main road.  A small wooden bridge continues the roadway over the stream, lamps strung along it to light the way.

title: [Boreas Hills, Etesian Terrace]
description: The hill rises up high enough here to provide an unobstructed view of the meadow below.  Several tall mahogany trees dot the landscape as the hills continue to grow into the mountain.

The hill rises up high enough here to provide an unobstructed view of the meadow below bathed in moonlight.  Several tall mahogany trees dot the landscape as the hills continue to grow into the mountain.

title: [Hale Hall, Corridor]
description: Several doors covered with various varieties of vividly painted plants and berries adorn the otherwise stark hallway.  At the end of hall mounted on the wall is a statue of unknown origins.

title: [Boreas Hills, Sundowner Way]
description: The road continues to slope upwards, gently curving to the northeast.  A cascade of rocks has tumbled down from the mountain above, and several small bushes and plants have begun to take hold amongst them.

The road continues to slope upwards, gently curving to the northeast.  A cascade of rocks has tumbled down from the mountain above, and several small bushes and plants have begun to take hold amongst them.  The moonlight throws the rocks into sharp contrast to the surrounding landscape.

title: [Boreas Hills, Sundowner Way]
description: Several large boulders sit here and there amongst the homes, a variety of moss and lichen growing upon them.  The road curves gently around a large modwir tree, a few of its roots reaching towards the road.  Several of the cobblestones tilt upwards, having been dislodged by the roots.

Several large boulders sit here and there amongst the homes, the moss and lichen growing upon them muted by the moonlight.  The road curves gently around a large modwir tree, a few of its roots reaching towards the road.  Several of the cobblestones tilt upwards, having been dislodged by the roots.

title: [Boreas Hills, Sundowner Way]
description: Slate stairs set into the mountain lead up to the ridge above, while an iron railing gives those venturing upwards something to hold onto.  Several thanot trees grow nearby, ivy winding their way around them and eventually up onto the railing.

Slate stairs set into the mountain lead up to the ridge above, while an iron railing gives those venturing upwards something to hold onto.  A few lamps have been hung from the railing to provide lighting for the stairs.  Several thanot trees grow nearby, ivy winding their way around them and eventually up onto the railing.

title: [Atrium, Clerk's Office]
description: A broad mahogany desk occupies the center of the elegantly furnished marble chamber.  Scrolls are stacked in neat piles upon the desk and arrayed in an orderly fashion on the shelves.  By the silk-curtained window, there stands a potted palm its leaves rustling softly in response to the soft breeze flowing off the sea.

By the silk-curtained window, a potted palm stands, its leaves rustling softly in response to the soft breeze flowing off the sea.

title: [Atrium, Hallway]
description: A lilac-embroidered curtain hangs on one wall, providing access to a small alcove.  More curtains can be seen farther down the hallway.

title: [Atrium, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Zephyr Lane]
description: The trees of the ridge rise up to great heights, obscuring all vision of the hills below.  Small bushes of wild thanot are strategically placed around private gates to complete the illusion of a mountain glade.

The trees of the ridge rise up to great heights, obscuring all vision of the hills below.  Small bushes of wild thanot are strategically placed around private gates to complete the illusion of a mountain glade.  Small lanterns illuminate the surroundings, casting leaping shadows.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Zephyr Lane]
description: The path begins to ascend the ridge steeply here, layered grooves in the shale bricks providing traction in inclement weather.  Bushes and shrubs hide small gates of iron, steel, and wood that lead to the manors beyond.

The path begins to ascend the ridge steeply here, layered grooves in the shale bricks providing traction in inclement weather.  Bushes and shrubs hide small, latern-illuminated gates of iron, steel, and wood that lead to the manors beyond.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Gregale Way]
description: A variety of colorful bricks have been used to create the path, resulting in a breath-taking mosaic that strays close to the ridge's edge.  An ornate invar rail protects the passersby and affords an unobstructed view of the hills below.  An alcove paved with small octagonal stones has been carved into the mountain, and a beautiful fountain wrought into the side trickles with a constant stream of fresh mountain water.

A variety of colorful bricks have been used to create the path, resulting in a breath-taking mosaic that strays close to the ridge's edge.  An ornate invar rail protects the passersby.  An alcove paved with small octagonal stones has been carved into the mountain, and a beautiful fountain wrought into the side trickles with a constant stream of fresh mountain water.  Two large iron braziers cast a warm glow over the area, providing light and heat.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Norte Court]
description: The path begins to climb again sharply, vibrant extrusions of colorful rock dotting the way where the soil has been eroded away.  The trees are much smaller and wispy here, standing silent watch over private gates and paths.

The path begins to climb again sharply, vibrant extrusions of colorful rock dotting the way where the soil has been eroded away.  The trees are much smaller and wispy here, standing silent watch over illuminated private gates and paths.

title: [Isle Dyes, Foyer]
description: Reddish tiling spreads across the floor in pleasant contrast to the white stucco walls.  A trio of curving arches to the west open up into the showroom, while a simple arch to the north leads out into an open-air courtyard.  Just adjacent, a large bamboo desk has been commandeered by a massive collection of papers and half-full dye bottles.
tags: meta:mapcategory:Dyer's Tents:Isle of the Four Winds
meta:mapname:Isle of the Four Winds - Dyer's Tent

title: [Isle Dyes, Showroom]
description: Dark bamboo tables and chairs sit on the reddish tile flooring that rises up into stucco walls of white.  Dangling from hooks set in the stucco, wrought iron lanterns supplement the natural light streaming through several windows to amply illume the showcase of dyes.  Tiny bottles sit on shelves along the walls, and swatches of fabric lay across the tables.  Several garments, expertly dyed in intricately colored patterns, dress up the walls above the shelves.

title: [Isle Dyes, Public Workroom]
description: Scattered over the tile floor, several sturdy bamboo tables take up the entire length of the room.  Each table is set with various tools and ingredients for creating dyes, their surfaces covered in variegated hues of powders and liquids that have yet to be cleared away.  Several individuals congregate around the table near a large side window, alternating their attention between peering at the colored smoke outside and grinding away at bits and pieces of ripe, red teaberries with mortars and pestles.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Gregale Way]
description: Rows of tall boxwood have been formed into all manner of topiary fauna from throughout the lands here.  Two of these topiary beasts stand at attention flanking each manor's entry, ready to greet visitors.

Rows of tall boxwood have been formed into all manner of topiary fauna from throughout the lands here.  Two of these topiary beasts, illuminated by lanterns, stand at attention flanking each manor's entry, ready to greet visitors.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Norte Court]
description: The path ends here, carved amongst great shelves of brilliant sunset-hued layered rock.  A sheltered outcropping supports a small family of trees.  Beautifully carved statues formed from the local rock guard the ornate gates of invar and manicured private grounds.

The path ends here, illuminated by several large ornate lanterns and carved amongst great shelves of brilliant sunset-hued layered rock.  A sheltered outcropping supports a small family of trees.  Beautifully carved statues formed from the local rock guard the ornate gates of invar and manicured private grounds.

title: [Healer, Storage Closet]
description: This tiny room has floor to ceiling shelves filled with bandages, salves, bottles of medicines, and various other things a healer might use.  Overhead hangs a brass lantern providing light to the area.  A small table rests against the only shelf-less wall, with a spindly, pale blue-cushioned oak chair in front of it.  Upon the table is a small brazier, with a light green liquid bubbling gently in the cauldron upon it.

title: [West Guardtower, Interior]
description: Racks of weapons line three walls while a long wooden table takes up the fourth.  The bench is covered with rags, some blackened with a foul-smelling oil, brushes, and various picks and grips.  A nearby barrel is filled with chainmail links.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Yard]
description: Standing on the left side of the gilded gate is a sandstone pillar which is heavily scarred from years of weather and decorated with numerous hashmarks.  To the right of the gate is a crude, yet effective-looking oak guillotine.  A heavily barred steel door leads into the prison itself.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Entry Hall]
description: Austere and barren, the room is meticulously clean and the hardware on the imposing gate gleams.  A single wooden bench rests against one wall with an oil painting affixed over it.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Hallway]
description: A single torch burns in an cast-iron sconce giving off a wan light.  The floor crunches underfoot as it's littered with the remains of various small rodents in a state of decay.  A trail of blood leads into one of the cells.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Gregale Way]
description: The path sharply turns here before ascending, again set with an ornate invar guardrail.  The trees part near the ridge's edge to reveal a view all the way to the ocean with breath-taking effect, to the benefit of the estates here and those passing by.

The path sharply turns here before ascending, again set with an ornate invar guardrail.  The trees part near the ridge's edge to reveal a moonlit view all the way to the ocean with breath-taking effect, to the benefit of the estates here and those passing by.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Euros Plaza]
description: A small burbling brook runs parallel to the path here, set into the leeward side of the ridge.  A view of three-quarters of the island can be seen from here.  Colorful rocks protrude from the rich black soil, contrasting the iron and wood gates of residences.

title: [Knit It]
description: The driftwood boards that make up the walls of this small shop have been strewn with lengths of colorful silks and satins, giving the room a bright patchwork feel.  Several sticks of incense have been lit around the area, blending the scents of magnolia, rose, and gardenia.  In the corner of the room, crates of pastel and jewel-tone yarns sit open, their contents spilling onto the floorboards below.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Euros Plaza]
description: Dotted with a variety of small trees, thanot, wild boxwood, and other bushes, the top of the ridge affords a view of the entire island.  Ancient thanot bushes arc gracefully over the top of ornately carved sunset-hued stone benches that dot the edges of a small area set with carved paving stones.  Carved from local stone, a miniature of the island sits in the middle, the sunset colored rock casting the entire sculpture in a warm glow.

Ancient thanot bushes arc gracefully over the top of ornately carved sunset-hued stone benches, each set with a subtle lantern, that dot the edges of a small area set with carved paving stones.  Carved from local stone, a miniature of the island sits in the middle, the sunset colored rock casting the entire sculpture in a warm glow.

title: [Boreas Hills, Mistral Court]
description: The street ends here where several homes are snuggled into the mountainside.  More homes rest on either side of this small square, while a small marble fountain sits in the middle, water cheerfully cascading down the tiers to pool at the bottom.

The street ends here where several homes are snuggled into the mountainside.  More homes rest on either side of this small square, their windows bright with light. A small marble fountain sits in the middle of the square, the water silvery in the moonlight.

title: [Firefly Villa, Merchant Lounge]
description: Stained glass windows, each decorated with wild tropical blooms, seem dark and faded.  Sconces upon the walls house tiny copper-sided lanterns, their faces depicting the cut-out images of fireflies, damselflies, and dragonflies that cast a warm glow upon the plush white carpeting that blankets the room.  Scattered in an informal pattern about the room are soft divans, plump couches, and robust armchairs.  Next to the library's entryway, a carved double-wide archway leads into the hallway beyond.

Comfortable chairs arranged in tidy rows all face the northern section of the hall where a podium is set upon a dais.

title: [Alerr's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide knotted oak counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide knotted oak counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Warcamp, Approach]
description: A dirt path leads over a rise of earth and down towards a collection of mismatching tents and huts.  The rotting stench of the encampment's inhabitants lingers in the air, mixed with the aroma of cooked flesh and burning wood.  A heavy grey haze of campfire smoke hangs over the warcamp and drifts down behind the rise of land, creating a pocket of concealment from the eyes of the nearby Grimswarm.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Foyer]
description: A simple shell-pink rug lies across a polished maple floor, inviting customers into the cozy foyer of this well-maintained establishment.  The mild scent of lavender and mint drift through the air, wafting from the potpourri censers laid about the room.  Several people mill about the area taking note of the framed drawings of various housing exterior options hung along the walls.

title: [Alerr's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide knotted oak counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Etaenia's Jewels, Salesroom]
description: A few oak cases display some of the jeweler's selection of finished pieces, while more sit on racks atop the cases.  A blue, green, and purple rug sits to one side of the room, a couple of chairs with a small table between them resting upon it.  Across from the chairs is a large mirror allowing patrons to admire their new purchases on themselves.

title: [Melorna's Boutique]
[Island Boutique]
description: Large windows stand to either side of the shop's entry, each displaying different mannequins dressed in the latest fashions.  The glass-front display cases stand in the center of the room, their mirror-finished shelves displaying various wares.  Tiers of candles line the back wall around an ivy-painted arch, while two corridors lead into different sections of the shop.

Two driftwood-framed windows stand to either side of the entry, each displaying a mannequin dressed in the latest fashions.  Several display cases reside in the center of the room, the gems and jewelry pieces in each are illuminated by a lustrous chandelier that hangs from the slightly raised ceiling.  Two corridors lead into different sections of the shop, and between them, an ivy-painted arch is flanked by potted palms that lend their exotic scents to the room.

title: [Melorna's Boutique]
[Island Boutique, Accessories]
description: Glaesine orbs dangle from the ceiling and cast rainbow swirls upon the various wares on display upon the wide oak shelves that line the walls.  Tiny hooks house chains and pendants, while jewelry trees arranged on long tables display earrings, bracelets, and rings.  A plum-hued carpet stretches from this section of the shop into the central foyer.

Glaesine orbs dangle from the ceiling and cast rainbow swirls upon the various wares on display upon the wide driftwood shelves that line the pale violet walls.  Gem-inlaid jewelry trees shaped like tropical flowers are arranged on long green tables, displaying items that glitter in the colorful light.  A plum-hued carpet stretches from this section of the shop into the central foyer.

title: [Brimzstone's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a low skylight-set ceiling, a painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls.  A wide knotted oak counter and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a stuffed octopus rests on a colorful mosaic floor.

title: [Herbalist, Salesroom]
description: The acrid smell of cooking acantha fills your nostrils the moment you step inside the cottage.  Various herbs and flowers hang drying from a line that has been strung back and forth across the room.  Wicker baskets of all shapes and sizes have been laid out across the counter, offering all types of remedies.

title: [Herbalist, Greenhouse]
description: A riot of plants fills this room, taking up nearly all of the space on the tile floor.  The walls and ceiling are made of large panes of glass that allow plenty of light to enter, though the view to the outside has been all but obscured by the luxuriant growth.  Small paths wind among the plants, allowing access to them all.  In the center of the room is a small tiered marble fountain with water trickling from the top and down the sides, to pool in the basin below.

title: [Brimzstone's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a smooth marble ceiling, a silken sea-themed tapestry hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls.  A plain wooden table and a wide knotted oak counter sit in opposite corners while some woven linen pillows rests on an intricate patterned floor.

title: [Cendadric's Collectibles]
description: An elegant, flower-patterned rug covers most of the floor, reaching almost all the way to the ivory silk-covered walls.  Hanging from the walls are exquisite antique paintings and weapons, and a bookshelf against one wall displays a collection of well-worn books.  Rosewood tables lined up in the center of the room display various weapons, armors, arcane items, and other goods.

title: [Warcamp, Outside]
description: A beaten trail narrows considerably and leads to a hut built of thick, sturdy boards.  The makeshift wall closes in and surrounds the hut, offering no entry in to or out of the hut save but a large door at the termination of the path.  The air is thick with the odious stench of death from the bodies of captives tossed to various sides of the path, now the feeding ground of rodents and other hungry beasties.

title: [Brimzstone's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an etched seaglass ceiling, a woven floral tapestry hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls.  A plain wooden table and a wide knotted oak counter sit in opposite corners while some puffed raw silk pillows rests on a swirled sea glass floor.

title: [The Lighthouse, Lounge]
description: The living quarters for the keeper of the lighthouse now is transformed into a comfy den for weary fishermen to rest their sea legs and grab a bite to eat.  Bulky fishing nets with glaes floaters hang from the wall.  A faint odor of sea salt and fish invade your senses as fishermen and merchants walk by.  A large oaken table rests along the north side of the lounge.  An arched opening in the east wall serves as the entrance to the stairwell.

title: [Memnole's Cottage]
description: Sparse and spacious, the cottage has three windows set into the center of each of its walls and though it has an entry there isn't a door.  Bamboo floorboards maintain a bright glossy sheen that easily reflects the filtered sunlight throughout the area and even reaches to the center of the room where a patterned prayer blanket rests.  Small shrines located in each of the room's four corners are lit by various candles, their flames sporadically spluttering.

title: [Warcamp, Outside]
description: Cages filled with creatures of all sizes are stacked against the wall of a hut spaced away from its neighbors by numerous yards.  Next to the cages is a small pile of former cage occupants, the remains of sacrifices and divinations.  The air around the hut carries a suggestion of herbs and spices and appears to emanate from cracks in the hut's walls.  Wind chimes constructed of finger bones of various races fill the air with a morbid clattering.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: The glossy terracotta tiles harmonize with the green trim around the windows and the door.  A white wicker settee is flanked by lush ferns on wrought iron stands.  Along the back wall a row of bamboo cabinets support a small forest of potted plants.  The air is damp.

title: [Warcamp, Shaman's Hut]
description: A blood-covered slab of stone sits in the center of the hut directly between the entryway and a bone and hide altar.  Crudely fashioned cages hang from hooks in the ceiling and birds of varying species fearfully gaze out from behind the thin bars.  The air is thick with the scent and smoke of burning herbs in randomly placed braziers, creating a scented haze that fills the room.  The floor crunches underfoot, carpeted with cast off carcasses and the remains of numerous sacrifices.

title: [Swilling's Combat Gear]
[Swilling's Weaponry]
[Swilling's Armory]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide knotted oak counter and an oversized sea chest sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Sadie's Lounge]
description: Wicker chairs covered in brightly colored fabric are grouped together around a couple of frosted glass tables.  Elegant palm trees sit in each corner of the room, their massive leaves draping carelessly over the tables.  A wicker bar is angled in the corner, though empty at the moment.

title: [Terrangil's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a sturdy bamboo-rafter ceiling, a painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a long brass clothing rack sit in opposite corners while some puffed raw silk pillows rests on a colorful mosaic floor.

title: [Marble House, Arcane Sales]
description: The shop opens up into a vast space.  Numerous trinkets and potions can be seen scattered throughout the many holding containers lining the silk-draped walls.

title: [Peny's Magic Shoppe]
[Peny's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the sea glass floor is interrupted by a leaping dolphin statuette.  Halfway to the skylight-set ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the blue-speckled sea glass walls.  A shell-lined bamboo counter and a floral-etched ceramic case are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Tigerlily Bowery]
description: Walls covered in warm brown panels rise from the coral orange tiles that spread across the floor and are only interrupted by wide windows that are framed in cerulean gauze drapes.  Standing opposite the entry is a roped-off arch, which has a set of stairs leading up.  Twin counters stand in the center of the shop and flank a workbench, where various bows are being crafted.

title: [Snowleaf's Outfitting]

description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide knotted oak counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Arybella's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a warped treasure chest on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Jenieca's Magic Shoppe]
[Jenieca's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide knotted oak counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Easy Living, Walls]
description: The driftwood plank floor here has been covered with scattered sand, as if someone tracked it in from the beach.  Each of the four walls has been panelled and covered with different materials giving the room a motley quiltwork feeling.  Groups of suntanned customers mill about the room, searching through sample books and pointing out various designs.

title: [Easy Living, Doors]
description: A variety of doors have been set into the thick whitewashed walls, each created from a different material.  Several of the doors stand open, customers examining their doorknobs and craftsmanship.  Along one of the walls stands an expansive saltwater lobster tank, the googly eyes of the creatures staring out into the room.

title: [Jadall's Outfitting]
[Jadall's General Store]
[Jadall's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A torn sailcloth hammock and a splintered cargo crate sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Easy Living, Flooring]
description: A set of ornate palm frond chairs have been set along the side wall of the shop, beneath them, a thin woven sea grass mat.  Along the opposite wall, a striking mural has been created of a sinking pirate ship, its billowing masts painted a shimmering white hue.  Tall palm trees inhabit the corners of the room, each placed in a shell-trimmed terra cotta pot.

title: [Easy Living, Windows]
description: The interior of this shop is alive with the sunlight streaming in from the multitude of windows set into the surrounding walls.  Round windows, square windows, and bay windows have all been placed next to each other, creating walls of frosted and various-hued glass for light to shine through.  Several of the windows have been opened, letting the sounds and scents from the ocean beyond drift into the room.

title: [Easy Living, Bedding]
description: The surrounding air is heavy and thick, permeated with the salty scent of the ocean.  The far wall has been used as a large display, highlighting the assortment of native woods and barks available for bedding purchases.  Hanging from the silk-draped ceiling is an assortment of colorful sea stars, each dangling at various lengths from a cord of dried sea grass.

title: [Easy Living, Seating]
description: Stacks of wooden benches and driftwood chairs line the side walls, rising up toward the sea grass ceiling.  Along the back wall, a makeshift beach scene display has been created, complete with sand and seashells.  Placed along the display are various beach chairs and loungers, each covered in a bright-colored fabric.  In the center of the room is a row of sofas and armchairs, browsing customers seated in each to test its plushness.

title: [Easy Living, Warmth]
description: Heat radiates fiercely from the numerous fireplaces and stoves displayed along the far wall.  An open bay window above the display allows for smoke and heat to escape to the outside air.  In the center of the room, a large fire pit has been built, surrounded by samples of the rock and stones available as purchase options.  The crackling sound of burning wood echoes through the room as the smokey scent from the fires blends with the salty smells of the sea.

title: [Easy Living, Floor Coverings]
description: A colorful ocean scene wallpaper draws the eye up to the bright walls and seashell-adorned ceiling of the shop.  Strung across the room from west wall to east wall are thick-braided sea grass ropes, knotted at each end to a rusted grappling hook.  Laid across the expanses of the ropes is an array of large colorful rugs and mats, each woven into a different design.  From the speckled sea glass ceiling hang smaller rugs cut into whimsical shapes and creatures.

title: [Easy Living, Wall Coverings]
description: The rough sandstone walls of the room are alive with an array of various objects and artifacts strewn from nails and lined up along pine shelves.  Sets of brightly-woven tapestries and wind-blown flags hang haphazardly from the ceiling, each displaying an ornate image.  An old fisherman's net has been thrown across a tall bamboo counter, exposing an assortment of stuffed fish and dried sea creatures for purchase.

description: Beneath a cracked slate ceiling, a white surrender flag hangs on one of the thick slate walls.  A shell-lined bamboo counter and an aqua-hued seaglass display sit in opposite corners while a wooden ship's wheel rests on a smooth slate floor.

title: [Crisostomo's Armory]
