title: [Aaryna's General Store]
[Aaryna's Weaponry]
description: A wall-mounted blowfish hangs on one of the blue-speckled sea glass walls, and a low skylight-set ceiling rises overhead.  An ornate bottled ship sits in one corner of a swirled sea glass floor.  There is some carved haon pegs on one side of the shop and a long mistwood counter on the other.

title: [Jaidden's Weaponry]
[Jaidden's Outfitting]
description: An oak-plaqued stuffed trout head hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls, and a billowing silk ceiling rises overhead.  A well-armed stocky warrior statue sits in one corner of a smooth slate floor.  There is a iron-bound ebonwood chest on one side of the shop and a floral-etched ceramic case on the other.

title: [Isela's Armory]
[Isela's Combat Gear]
[Isela's Weaponry]
[Isela's General Store]
description: Enclosed by warped driftwood walls, the shop features a carved ebonwood dinghy in the center of its sand floor.  A woven black fishing net hangs under the driftwood ceiling.  Right near the front is a wide knotted oak counter and a splintered cargo crate.

title: [Kitathas' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A long mistwood counter and an oversized sea chest sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Tiervah's Outfitting]
[Tiervah's Magic Shoppe]
[Tiervah's Armory]
[Tiervah's General Store]
description: Blue-speckled sea glass walls rise from a woven seagrass floor.  Just above a tropical floral arrangement hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a low skylight-set ceiling completes the picture.  A floral-etched ceramic case stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Cloakhe's General Store]
[Cloakhe's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An aqua-hued seaglass display and a wide knotted oak counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Graveyard, Top of Gate]
description: You find yourself hanging from the ornate ironwork of this gate, the top of which consists of rows of sharp iron spikes pointing straight up.  You might be able to vault over them, but that is best left to the acrobats.

title: [Beldrin's, Backroom]
description: This small, bare room seems to have been no more than a storage closet in earlier days.  The addition of some faded wood paneling and a rickety desk and chair has converted it to a makeshift office.  A dusty, gold-framed portrait of a portly human in a ceremonial snowcat vest hangs askew above the desk, and a surprisingly heavy oaken door is set in one wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry Hall]
description: A dimly lit hallway leads north into the shadows and east into a darkened chamber from which quiet sounds of whispered conversations and laughter drift in.  A black-clad giantman stands guarding the hallway, his deceptively friendly smile glinting in the torchlight as he looks you over.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: The hall is panelled with dark wood and hung with heavy tapestries that dull the sounds of footsteps.  Illuminated only by the glow from the torches to the south, the passage continues north into darkness.  A draft of cool air occasionally wafts in from a narrow stairway that leads up through an opening in one wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Upstairs Hallway]
description: The narrow hall is dimly lit by torches set into brass sconces on the walls, and carpeted with a thick woven rug that muffles your footsteps.  Several portraits are set in rich wooden frames and mounted on the walls.  Their eyes seem to follow you as you move, in what is probably just a strange trick of the light.

title: [Slark's Outfitting]
[Slark's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Mellindya's Combat Gear]
[Mellindya's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Warcamp, Outside]
description: A great hut stands within a clearing unto itself in the encampment of the Grimswarm.  Twin red and black banner poles flank its entrance, while bodies lashed to the walls with cords of leather decorate its exterior.  Pale grey curls of smoke drift from the top of the hut, spiraling towards the smoke haze above the warcamp.  Next to the hut, suspended upside down on a wood rack is the rotting corpse of a troll, pierced through the heart with a massive boar spear.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Lighthouse Path]
description: A somewhat unsullied brass anchor adorned with barnacles hangs from a sturdy rolaren stand.  Wooden planks attached to the anchor form directional signs pointing northwest and west.  The lighthouse can be seen on the top of the hill to the northwest.

title: [Lighthouse Path]
description: A path leads steadily up this grassy hill towards the lighthouse.  About halfway up the path rests a sheltered bench, a brass plaque embedded in the middle of the backrest.  The view from here is spectacular, allowing one to see out across the bay all the way to the ocean.

title: [The Lighthouse]
description: Standing before you is the newly renovated lighthouse.  The lighthouse has been fashioned from the timbers of several large ships that have met their fate by either grounding on sand bars or even worse, meeting the dreaded reef.  The smell of salted air flows inland from the mouth of the bay as a few pelicans glide slowly out to sea.  A heavy polished door with the Mist Harbor emblem carved into it serves as the entrance.

title: [The Lighthouse, Lounge]
description: What used to be an old lighthouse storage room has been renovated into a lavish Mist Harbor lounge equipped with all the comforts of home.  In the corner, a potbelly stove provides a source of heat for the room along with a few cooked goodies on its griddle.

title: [Lighthouse, Gift Shop]
description: Delicate curtains frame the large windows, allowing only small rays of light into the store.  Vibrantly colored hand-sewn quilts adorn the white walls giving the room warmth while the plush blue carpet keeps the sound of clattering footsteps down to a minimum.  A wooden toy chest is pushed under an ivory table which has a wicker basket perched on it.  A velvet-lined box is carelessly propped against the open door.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: Curving off from the main circle of the bazaar, the shuttered stalls and night-shrouded shops lining this section of cobblestoned street are interspersed with stands of silver-barked birch trees and carefully manicured beds of white roses.  One trellis of flowers is marked with a triad of lit lanterns, their gentian glaes shades punctuating the pale wall of roseate blossoms.

One trellis of flowers is marked with a triad of lanterns, their gentian glaes shades punctuating the pale wall of roseate blossoms.

title: [Medi's Olde Wooden Shack]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and a painted red cedar rack sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: The cobblestone road flows around a single birch, its silver trunk thrust up through the middle of the street amidst a rounded profusion of flowering roses.  Chimes and bells hang from the tree's boughs, suspended at varying lengths on argent chains.  Beneath, the blooms are dappled in light and shadow, turning some petals blindingly white and shading others to grey.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: Amidst the crowded storefronts, a small niche of precious space has been reserved for a stone statue, its face turned to silver in the starlight.  The base of the carving is hidden amidst a riot of green leaves and large white roses, the foliage carefully manicured to not intrude on the cobblestone byway.

Amongst the crowded storefronts, a small niche of precious space has been reserved for a stone statue.  The base of the carving is hidden amidst a riot of green leaves and large white roses, the foliage carefully manicured to not intrude on the cobblestone byway.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: The road bends to avoid a gracile stone tower, its slender spire topped with a ring of peacock blue silk pennons.  A larger white silk banner is placed centrally within the cluster, embroidered with an oversized Ta'Illistim peacock and scroll.  A pale blue light leaks out of arrow slits in the tower, the glow diffuse and hazy. Around the base of the tower are flowering beds of white roses, growing in abundance, though manicured to avoid spilling into the lanes of passage.

Around the base of the tower are flowering beds of white roses, growing in abundance, though manicured to avoid spilling into the lanes of passage.

title: [Firefly Villa, Corridor]
description: Round walls fitted with floor to ceiling stained glass windows form the east and north intersection of the corridor.  From one direction flows a plethora of blue hues, while from the other are deep plums and violets.  The hues converge upon an alabaster fountain that spills into a small pond, its depths filled with several species of fish from around the island.  Glaesine orbs decorate the ceiling, their glittering hues creating a prismatic effect on the surrounding area.

title: [Firefly Villa, Front Desk]
description: Polished paneling reflects the light the candles that are housed within wrought iron wall scones, their warm glow providing ample illumination throughout the small lobby.  Tall and wide, an alcove recessed into the northern wall housing a plethora of cubbies is guarded by a circular teak and cedar desk, while a set of spiraling stairs leads to the second level.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: A pair of birch saplings is set into a bed of white roses, their fragile, spindly boughs a meager barrier between the dark night sky above and the pale flowers below.  Across the cobblestones from the young trees, a few larger buildings are interspersed with the collection of smaller shops that have grown up around them.

A pair of birch saplings is set into a bed of white roses, their fragile, spindly boughs barely shading the flowers below.  Across the cobblestones from the young trees, a few larger buildings are interspersed with the collection of smaller shops that have grown up around them.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: The cobblestone road truncates in a small plaza, marked on two sides with a collection of shops and bluish-grey stone emporia.  The third face of the square is taken up entirely with booksellers, their permanent wooden stalls painted white and shuttered closed for the evening.  Bright blue silk awnings shade the carrels, each canopy marked with the silver peacock of Ta'Illistim.

The third face of the square is taken up entirely with booksellers, their permanent wooden stalls painted white, but their placements within those seemingly random.  Bright blue silk awnings shade the bookbinders and resellers, each canopy marked with the silver peacock of Ta'Illistim.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: An ancient stone arch rises over the dimly lit street, devoid of any associated architecture.  Climbing roses cover its bluish-grey surface, twining over and around the masonry in sinuous green and white patterns.  Newer buildings crowd up to the older construction, juxtaposing freshly cut, sharp angles against the softened, time-worn stone of old.

Climbing roses cover its bluish-grey surface, twining over and around the masonry in sinuous green and white patterns.  Newer buildings crowd up to the older construction, juxtaposing freshly cut, sharp angles against the softened, time-worn stone of old.

title: [Firefly Villa, Tree]
description: Arched in four directions, the redwood tree is hollow and polished to a lustrous warm, reddish glow.  Tiny orbs set into the distant ceiling provide ample light for any that wish to traverse the stairway, while sconces set on the right side of each entry provide illumination for the pathways that lead through the vibrant gardens that ring the inn.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Firefly Villa, Tree]
description: Arched in four directions, the redwood tree is hollow and polished to a lustrous warm, reddish glow.  Tiny orbs set into the high ceiling provide ample light for any that wish to traverse the stairway, while sconces set on the right side of each entry provide illumination for the catwalks that lead to the various balconies that ring the inn.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: A sprawl of tiny, dimly lit stalls and larger, more ornate stone shops abut one another, crowding both sides of the street.  A few determined birch trees dot the bazaar, bringing a touch of green and silver to the almost uniformly bluish-grey stone scheme.  One particularly tenacious tree has grown to a staggering height, its top towering over the rooflines.

A few determined birch trees dot the bazaar, bringing a touch of green and silver to the almost uniformly bluish-grey stone scheme.  One particularly tenacious tree has grown to a staggering height, its top towering over the rooflines.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: One stretch of the roadside is taken up by a series of overly tall buildings, their multiple storied bluish-grey stone facades standing out against their shorter, more conventional neighbors.  Though pennons are hung from silver poles atop the grander structures, the lesser buildings aren't without ornamentation themselves.  In one window, high up, a pale blue light burns cleanly, tinging the cobblestones below.

Though pennons are hung from silver poles atop the grander structures, the lesser buildings aren't without ornamentation themselves.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Mzaarine Bazaar]
description: A cluster of immature birch trees surrounds an engraved stone plinth, their pale, silvery bark contrasting with the darker grey of the unlit monument.  Nearby, commercial buildings, each one crafted from the same bluish-grey stone as its fellows, crowd against one another.  A few determined shops remain open, continuing to compete for the nighttime attentions of potential customers and passers by.

A cluster of immature birch trees surrounds an engraved stone plinth, their pale, silvery bark contrasting with the darker grey of the monument.  Nearby, commercial buildings, each one crafted from the same bluish-grey stone as its fellows, crowd against one another.  They fight for the precious space along the street-front and for the attention of both potential customers and passers by.

title: [Firefly Villa, Corridor]
description: Mint green whorls decorate the dark plum carpeting that spans the length of the hall, their elliptical designs complimenting the golden linden paneling of the walls.  Glaesine orbs nestle within wrought iron sconces decorated to resemble luna moths are anchored to the ceiling, as well as around a carved doublewide archway that leads to a bustling tavern.  On the opposite wall rests a pair of double doors that have been left open to allow the heady scent of dog roses to drift in.

title: [Rogue Guild, Shop]
description: The rich wood of the wall paneling glows in the light of a large chandelier.  A number of tables, racks and cabinets fill the room, displaying an impressive selection of wares.  An oak door opens in one wall.

title: [Firefly Villa, Garden]
description: Thick foliage blankets the area and nearly eclipses the enormous earthen planters that are attached to the thick brick wall by sturdy wrought iron hangers and anchors.  Dog roses, varying in color from bright pink to soft white, perfume the air as they bloom within the verdant cluster.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lounge]
description: Thick tapestries and richly panelled screens divide this spacious room into a dimly lit maze of pathways and corners, providing a measure of privacy to the candlelit tables arranged artfully throughout the room.  A quiet murmur of muted conversations and clinking glasses flows through the room.

title: [Rogue Guild, A Dark Niche]
description: This shadowed corner, set in an oddly angled wall behind a tapestry, contains only two plain chairs and a small niche in the wall.  The stone walls are chilly, and the shadows are deep.

title: [Firefly Villa, Landing]
description: Spilling into the room from the northeastern corner is a resplendent staircase that culminates in mahogany-inlaid newel posts crafted of white birch.  Nearby, a frosted ebon glass door leads to the gentlemen's bathing facility, its polished surface beaded with sweat.

title: [Firefly Villa, Landing]
description: Rich plum carpeting converges upon the landing from the western and southern hallway sections, though they terminate just before reaching the landing.  A spiraling staircase is flanked by mahogany-inlaid newel posts crafted of white birch, while opposite stands an enormous polished copper mirror.

title: [Rogue Guild, A Curtained Table]
description: Thick brocade curtains shield this quiet table from the rest of the room, providing a measure of privacy and muffling much of the sound from outside.  A small oil lamp in the center of the table illuminates the richly-panelled wall and the shimmering thread of the curtains.

title: [Firefly Villa, Porch]
description: Wide banisters ring the porch on three sides, their railings cluttered with verdant, thickly corded vines that are dappled with delicate flowers.  A pair of painted glass doors leads into the inn, their smooth surfaces painted with bright purple lettering.

title: [Luna Rest Tavern, Kitchen]
description: Bustling with activity, the kitchen is a display of ordered chaos.  Bakers linger around counters, taking turns kneading dough and checking the brick ovens that pigeon-hole the northern wall.  Arch cooking fires housing roasting meats stand under the attention of chefs, who turn the meats evenly, while also ensuring that nearby cauldrons retain their warmth.  An enormous serving counter houses the various dishes and drinks that are being prepared for waiting customers.

title: [Rogue Guild, A Private Nook]
description: Rich tapestry covers the screens that shut this quiet table off from the room, and a flickering candle provides barely enough light to make out the carved modwir table and chairs and the figures of anyone who might happen to be hiding in the shadows.

title: [Firefly Villa, Landing]
description: Polished alabaster descends from the winding stairs at this corner of the corridor and mimics the frothy flow of waves spilling forth upon the smooth teak flooring.  Decorative mother-of-pearl balusters are evenly spaced to match each of the wave-shaped steps as they ascend to the landing above, while near at hand they culminate in a pair of banisters fashioned into the semblance of fishermen casting their nets.

title: [Firefly Villa, Landing]
description: Polished alabaster rises from the winding stairs at this corner of the corridor and mimics the frothy flow of waves cresting upon the plum carpet.  Decorative mother-of-pearl balusters are evenly spaced to match the wave-shaped steps as they descend to the landing below, while near at hand they culminate in a pair of banisters fashioned into the semblance of paired mermaids holding urns above their heads.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: A dark, windowless door is set into the stone wall at the end of the hall, bordered on both sides by heavy tapestries that keep the chill from the stone to a minimum.  A narrow hall leads off to the west, lit by the dim glow of a single torch at its end.

title: [Firefly Villa, Corridor]
description: The shadows of damselflies, fireflies, and dragonflies dance across the ceiling, their images created by the decorative cuts in the bodies of the lanterns that are strung in a straight line down the hall.  Large vases, housing exotic flowers, stand upon either sides of a paneled white birch door and an ornate haon door, while a rich plum carpet muffles all sound and keeps the passage quiet.

title: [Firefly Villa, The Purple Room]
description: Transitioning from lilac to indigo and all the hues in between, the painted walls rise from the cool white marble floor tiles and disappear into the star-spangled darkness of the ebon ceiling above.  White-swaddled chairs are arranged around a glass and wrought iron table near a set of double doors fitted with painted glass panes, while a lace-draped featherbed occupies a nearby wall.

title: [Firefly Villa, West Balcony]
description: Polished rails of golden linden ring the balcony and follow the length of the catwalk as it traverses the open air towards a large tree.  Trailing honeysuckle vines, their delicate white blooms perfuming the air, decorate the walls of the inn and create delicate wreaths over the magnolia-etched and glass-paned doors.

title: [Firefly Villa, The Saffron Room]
description: Sky blue walls are accented with saffron yellow silk fans, each painted with elaborately detailed boughs laden with cherry and orange blossoms.  Pale yellow curtains fashioned of translucent silks drape in artful folds from both the glass-front doors leading to the balcony and the white birch bed that is decoratively carved in the semblance of a fruit tree.  Positioned kitty corner to a paneled door which leads to the hallway beyond is a low teak table surrounded by tassel-edged cushions and bamboo mats.

title: [Rogue Guild, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard before you is roughly square in shape, its borders a melange of textured stone and wooden walls made up of the back and side walls of the surrounding buildings.  The ground is paved with irregular slabs of dark stone interspersed here and there with patches of bare dirt or tufted grass, and a few weeds and bushes have taken root along the walls.  The courtyard is old but well-kept, and a patch of sunlight in the center nourishes a lone tree.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: A slight draft from the west stirs the tapestries that cover parts of the stone wall.  Faint torchlight from the west provides enough illumination to make out the geometric patterns on the well-worn carpeting that muffles any footsteps.

title: [Firefly Villa, South Balcony]
description: Polished rails of golden linden ring the balcony and follow the length of the catwalk as it traverses the open air towards a large tree.  Trailing wisteria vines, their delicate purple blooms perfuming the air, decorate the walls of the inn and create delicate wreaths over the mahogany and glass-paned doors.

title: [Firefly Villa, The Green Room]
description: White stucco walls, infused with dried ferns, support a latticework ceiling of mahogany that has a myriad of tiny multi-hued glass globes dangling from it.  Heavy green curtains hang from a copper curtain rod and separate the pint-sized bed from the equally as compact chair and table arranged near the middle of the room.  A mahogany door, its surface painted with a moon-lit mural, stands opposite from a pair of glass-paned doors that leads to the balcony beyond.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: A chill draft blows up from the narrow stairwell at the end of the hallway.  A lone torch set in a brass sconce near the stairs illuminates the bare stone of the walls, which are uncovered by insulating tapestries here.

title: [Rogue Guild, Basement]
description: The heavy wooden boards of the floor are worn smooth by centuries of passing feet and scored by the marks of thousands of objects being dragged in and out of storage over the years.  The rough, unadorned stone walls form an irregularly-shaped chamber that extends to the east and south, and a heavy trapdoor is set into the floor near the western wall.

title: [Firefly Villa, The Azure Room]
description: Large and spacious, the room is bathed in soothing colors that range in hue from azure to dark blue.  Pale drapes of saffron silk frame the etched glass doors that lead to a balcony, while the eastern and western walls are lined with a trio of canopy beds in matching colors.  At the heart of the room is an oblong ebonwood table that is surrounded by six chairs.

title: [Firefly Villa, Corridor]
description: Copper lanterns hooded with wide bowl-shaped lids traverse the length of the hall.  The shadows of catfish, sunfish, and eels swim across the ceiling, their images created by the decorative cuts in the bodies of the lanterns that are strung in a straight line down the hall.  Porcelain vases housing exotic flowers stand upon either sides of a sturdy ebonwood door and an etched cherrywood door.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
description: The low tunnel, barely high enough for a dwarf to stand in here, seems to open into more spacious passages to the east and northwest--though it is impossible to see very far in the darkness.  The faint glimmers of some light in the distance illuminate the passage just enough to see its direction.

title: [Firefly Villa, North Balcony]
description: Polished rails of golden linden ring the balcony and follow the length of the catwalk as it traverses the open air towards a large tree.  Trailing dog rose vines, their bright pink blooms perfuming the air, decorate the walls of the inn and create delicate wreaths over the white birch and mahogany doors.

title: [Rogue Guild, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Twin brass sconces hold dimly glowing torches on either side of an artfully carved dark felwood door set into the north wall.  A faint draft ruffles the heavy brocaded curtains that cover the end of the hall, sending a shiver of cool air along the passage.

title: [Firefly Villa, The Grey Room]
description: Jeweled tones, those of sapphire, emerald, and ruby decorate the walls in wide streaks of paint that are interspersed with grey and black in mimicry of the walls of a mine.  Wrought iron lanterns dangle from the ceiling over a bed crafted in the image of a wide mine cart, its interior stuffed with a feather mattress. The floor is decorated with smooth sandstone and has a set of iron rails imbedded into it, which terminate at glass-paned doors on one end of the room and a paneled ebonwood door on the other.

title: [Firefly Villa, Lounge]
description: Rounded walls fitted with floor to ceiling windows are draped with pale silk curtains to give the lounge a soothing, airy feel that is only accented by the spacious placement of the furnishings.  Low tables are set with refreshments and surrounded by a couple of ebonwood divans that promote social circles, while round bamboo chairs are set at the edges of the room for those that wish the space for solitary repose.

title: [Etaenia's Jewels, Used Goods]
description: Thin green, blue, and purple linen curtains frame square windows on each of this spacious room's walls.  A number of oak tables have been scattered in no apparent order, surrounded by threadbare green rugs.  Stacks of crates sit in the back of the room, marked in black paint.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Display]
description: Slabs of the finest marble and granite line the edges of this opulent display room.  Gilded gold candelabra stand like guards at each corner, the light from their candles casting a soft glow across a display of polished woods.  A well-dressed woman wanders the room with a porcelain tray offering tea and pastries to customers.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Akaelos']
description: The curving marble walls of the expansive, circular chamber enclose a dozen immaculately-kept worktables at which an equal number of meticulously-groomed halfling and human draftsmen labor at their inks and papers.  A tall dark elf, his waist-length black hair intricately braided and his gem-clasped robes shifting in the light from the glaes skylight above, moves about the tables, whispering instructions to the draftsmen.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Nazgir's]
description: The walls of this spacious workshop are set with panels of fine woods ranging from pale haon to richly toned ebonwoods, inset with a variety of patterns in jade and ivory to illustrate the skill of their craftsmen.  The elegantly clad dwarven artisan moves from table to table, a constant grumbling emanating from his squat, dark figure as he issues instructions to apprentices engaged in carving finely-made doors.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Estates]
description: This luxurious office is panelled in fine cedar that fills the room with its woodsy scent.  Finely-carved tables are set here and there, bearing models of a variety of elegant rural manors and lodges.  A tall, red-haired woman in a forest-green riding habit, a hint of elven heritage evident in the curve of her ears and her haughty bearing, glances over a leather-bound registry as she nods instructions to the workmen who hurry in and out of the room by the rear entrance.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Alphel's]
description: A warm scent of wood polish and herbal incense fills the cozy workroom, and the golden light of half a dozen hand-blown glass oil lamps illuminates the richly panelled walls.  Alphel, a stout, middle-aged human clad in finely made, but casual cotton tunic and leather trousers, mutters instructions to his clerks as he returns his attention to polishing a slab of fine golden haon.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Alcove]
description: This tiny alcove is small but well-kept.  The smooth walls have been coated with a robin's-egg blue paint in contrast to the round sea foam green rug that covers the entire floor of the area.  In the center of the room, a silver-caged parrot whistles loudly, sporadically cocking its head and ruffling its feathers to visitors.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Kelsene's]
description: The whitewashed brick walls of the tidy office are arranged with numerous small paintings of a variety of modest buildings of wood and stone.  A smiling half-elven woman, her dark hair swept up in a neat snood, oversees the room from a spacious modwir desk, arranging neat stacks of parchments and sketches as she hums quietly to herself.  A narrow stairway leads down.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Dunner's]
description: A small barred window near the ceiling illuminates the room with a smattering of light.  The stone walls of the basement are stacked with all manner of wood and metal panels, along with bins holding a fascinating variety of metal bits and hardware.  A middle-aged, bespectacled dwarf glances over the inventory, pushing his felt cap back on his head as he scratches his greying beard and rummages through the papers in his hand.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Cabins]
description: This wood panel-lined office is small, but well-kept and cozy, and several leather-covered chairs invite customers to rest while waiting.  Dusty, but well-groomed young men hurry in and out of the office, taking whispered orders from the leather-clad sylvan woman who shuffles through paperwork at the counter, glancing up with her bright green eyes.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Tooma's]
description: A brawny, bare-chested giantman, a massive tool belt strapped around his waist, works busily in a small area, sorting heavy planks of a variety of woods.  Various sheets of plans and orders have been tacked up on the rear wall of the backroom, where a wooden table supports a brass-banded ale barrel.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Side Hall]
description: The warped floorboards creak loudly under the weight of wandering customers in the narrow passage of this drafty hallway.  Hanging from the low ceiling in brass pots is a trio of plants, long dead from lack of water and attention.  Mottled shafts of light sneak in from the grime-covered window at the end of the hall, illuminating the dust-covered picture frames lining the walls.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Osby's]
description: The rough showroom is stacked to the eaves with scrap metal, scorched bits of wood, and other salvaged materials.  Scurrying noises in the shadows indicate that the scrawny, unkempt half-elf who oversees the operation may not be the only inhabitant of the room -- though he seems to be the only two-legged one.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Coggin's]
description: The lean, oily-looking human standing behind the low counter glances up from polishing his locksmithing tools and pushes his dark, greasy hair back from his face as you enter.  Disorganized stacks of wood and metal doors rest against the walls, most with their hinges broken or skillfully dismantled.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Halki's]
description: The large but ill-kept office is covered in mud and scattered straw, and stacks of wood, branches, and mud bricks are everywhere.  A makeshift counter stands near the center of the structure, where an apprentice wipes her hands on her voluminous aprons as she muddles through a stack of parchments.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Hekko's]
description: The floor of the room is inches deep in mud, straw, wood, and bark chips, and dried leaves that have blown in through the paneless window.  A filthy, leathery-skinned dwarf, his dirty-blond hair twisted into a long rat-tail of a braid down his back, chips at a rough wood plank with a crude chisel, grumbling through his beard as he works.

title: [Rogue Guild, Office Anteroom]
description: This small room serves as a waiting area for those requesting a presence with the guildmaster.  A few chairs and a table sparsely furnish the otherwise cramped space.  One darkly clad elf sits slumped over asleep, oblivious to your presence.

title: [Melorna's Boutique]
[Island Boutique, Female Attire]
description: Painted silk screens are set before wide oak window, blocking the view of the shop from anyone that might peep in from outside.  A long copper rack takes up the space of one entire wall and is filled with hanging garments, while the other walls house a variety of baskets and chests.

Painted silk screens are set before a wide driftwood window, blocking the view of the shop from anyone that might peep in from outside.  The walls are the pale blue of the sky, and several colorful plaques set into the painted wood are shaped like indigenous birds.  In the center of the room, tall faenor racks display various female clothing, while a long counter at the back of the room displays those garments not suited for hanging.

title: [Marble House, Consignment]
description: A large woven tapestry dominates the eastern wall, illustrating an elven mage clasping an intricately carved amulet.  Tucked into a corner is a sorting bin filled with sands of varying color and refinement.

title: [Marble House, Used Emporium]
description: Nearing the back of the shop, the displays begin to offer less polish and reveal more usage.  Despite their appearance, their craftsmanship shows many more years left before their expiration.  A witchwood pentagonal table stands neatly centered along the back wall.

title: [Wisteria Winery, Stemware]
description: Ringed in viridian-hued stucco walls, the floors of this portion of the shop are covered in a thick carpet of deep plum.  Golden orbs illuminate the shop; their ends are bound to wrought iron hangers, and their light reflect against the surfaces of the various glasses displayed upon the shelves that ring the room.

title: [Wisteria Winery, Vessels]
description: Various glass-front cabinets ring the small room, their shelves laden with an amalgamation of drinking vessels in a wide range of sizes, colors, shapes, and materials.  Opposite the displays is a beautiful fresco, its detailed decorations occupying the entire wall, that depicts the arkati Cholen reclining against a fountain.  Brilliantly glowing orbs dangle from the ceiling, their unwavering light dispelling any shadows from the surrounding area.

title: [Wisteria Winery, Cafe]
description: Open to the air, the cafe is built upon a cobblestone court that is wrapped on one side by a high wall and its other two sides by the sides of the winery.  Twin arches lead back inside, while colorful awnings are stretched across the area to provide protection from the elements for the shoppers that lounge at the various tables and chairs that are arranged in social circles.  A long bar allows customers to sample the various beverages that the winery sells, as well as complimentary snacks.

title: [Wisteria Winery, Bulk Products]
description: Wall to wall shelves house a variety of crates and casks, their sides labeled with the various vintages held within.  Brightly glowing frosted orbs are suspended from wrought iron posts that connect to the ceiling, their light strong enough to read by, while a narrow passage lined with a pale blue runner connects this room to the other portions of the shop.

title: [Caitria's Magic Shoppe]
[Caitria's Outfitting]
description: Glazed bamboo walls rise from a swirled sea glass floor.  Just above a braided seagrass rug hangs a silken sea-themed tapestry, and an etched seaglass ceiling completes the picture.  A bamboo rack and a shell-lined bamboo counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Krisstal's Practical Magic]
description: Beneath an etched seaglass ceiling, a tiny sand bottle display hangs on one of the blue-speckled sea glass walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table sits in one corner while a potted palm tree rests on the sea glass floor.

title: [Aveysong's Magic Shoppe]
description: A decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls, and a low skylight-set ceiling rises overhead.  A grey-veined white marble fountain sits in one corner of a gold-speckled marble floor.  There is an elegantly carved oak armoire on one side of the shop and a gold-veined black marble counter on the other.

title: [Chellsie's Outfitting]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A twisted sandstone sculpture sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is some carved haon pegs on one side of the shop and a salt-crusted sandstone case on the other.

title: [Berrigan's Weaponry]
[Berrigan's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Warcamp, Warchief's Hut]
description: Captured banners and the heads of the men they once belonged to ring the walls of the warchief's hut.  A throne is situated in the center of the room in the forefront of a rack displaying trophies of war, some rotting, some not.  The remains of meals and broken tankards litter the ground, staining luxuriant captured rugs strewn across the floor of the hut.  Several grotesque piles of body parts are scattered across the tent.

title: [Exttior's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide knotted oak counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Nindon's Magic Shoppe]

A jam-stained locked oak box with tiny chocolate fingerprints and a locked cherrywood chest etched with sylvan runes sit in opposite corners while a bookcase with various tomes and scrolls stuffed on the shelves rests on a black and white checkered marble tile floor.

title: [Gnomish Wonders, Items of War]
description: Beneath a black marble-tiled ceiling with a few cobwebs in the corners, a pair of crossed serrated rolaren claidhmores with deathstone pommels hangs on one of the mica-flecked black marble walls.  A locked invar-banded crate etched with dwarven runes and a locked imperial blue trunk etched with elven sigils sit in opposite corners while an antique suit of battle armor on a white marble pedestal rests on a black and white checkered marble tile floor.

title: [Waves of Time, Azure Waves]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A shell-lined bamboo counter and an aqua-hued seaglass display sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Waves of Time, Argent Waves]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A shell-lined bamboo counter and an aqua-hued seaglass display sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Tiervah's Outfitting]
[Tiervah's Weaponry]
description: The broad sweep of the seagrass floor is interrupted by a potted palm tree.  Halfway to the seagrass ceiling, a framed lighthouse painting hangs on one of the blue-speckled sea glass walls.  An oversized sea chest is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Tiervah's Outfitting]
[Tiervah's General Store]
description: Beneath a woven seagrass ceiling, a silken sea-themed tapestry hangs on one of the blue-speckled sea glass walls.  A long mistwood counter and a pink-edged open clamshell sit in opposite corners while some puffed raw silk pillows rests on a woven seagrass floor.

title: [Isle Designs, Facades]
description: The entire western wall has been made into a giant bay window which reveals an expansive view of the Isle and sea beyond.  The splintered driftwood wall directly across from the window is the backdrop for a large saltwater aquarium that stands against it.  The water of the aquarium casts a dancing reflection across the room as streams of light shine in through the window.

title: [Isle Designs, Containers]
description: A braided sea grass floor spreads across the room in shades of muted greens in a sharp contrast to the pale beige bamboo stalks that line the walls and ceiling.  From the walls jut out several polished display stands offering a selection of items for sale.  Hanging from the bamboo above the displays are groups of carved native masks, each painted in a popular regional style.  Customers point and converse about the masks, noting their authentic qualities.

title: [Isle Designs, Walls]
description: This area of the building has been made to mock a scene at a relaxing beach.  Several layers of fine, white sand cover the floor, dotted with seashells and dried seaweed.  In the center of the room, an oversized red and white umbrella has been forced into the sand and is surrounded by sandcastles and tiny bright red crabs.  From the fishnet-covered walls protrudes a set of driftwood shelves, the only sign that there are items for sale.

title: [Isle Designs, Floor Displays]
description: Two giant palm trees rise from pots at the back corners of the room, their glossy leaves just brushing against the ceiling.  Between the trees a faded hammock has been tied at each end to both trunks.  Around the room heaps of silken pillows are scattered between rolled up rugs and tall statues, all haphazardly displayed for purchasers perusal pleasure.

title: [Isle Designs, Roofs]
description: Layers and layers of colorful seashells have been plastered onto the walls, leading up to a low bamboo ceiling.  Spotted chitons and spiraled nautiluses join the array of shells that draw the attention of the passing customers.  Spindly wooden pedestals rise up next to the walls, each displaying a sample of roofing material for sale in the shop.  The room is further lit by jars of twittering fireflies that have been placed on various shelves around the area.

title: [Isle Designs, Wall Displays]
description: Thick sandstone pillars rise from the sandy floor at selected intervals, supporting the weight of the heavy terra cotta roof.  The shop wares are displayed proudly along the dark-stained walls that frame the room and have also been hung randomly along the pillars.  From the ceiling hang hollow bamboo wind chimes which jingle harmoniously when the ocean air blows in from a rounded window on the far wall.  Next to the window, a cotton tapestry has been placed, displaying the crest of Four Winds Isle.

title: [Isle Designs, Ceilings]
description: Sets of lit torches are placed in sconces about the room, lending light to the otherwise darkened, windowless room.  Splintered wooden treasure chests are piled up in the corners, their treasure yet to be revealed.  Along the far back wall a huge black skull-and-crossbones pirate flag is displayed, its edges roughly torn from abusive use.  Below the flag a colorful, one-eyed parrot is perched on a detailed ceiling sample display.

title: [Isle Designs, Signs]
description: A large ceramic bowl of tropical fruit stands on an iron table on the far side of the room, attracting a host of buzzing insects to the area.  From the direction of the table wafts the scents of coconut and lime, drifting across the room on a subtle breeze.  Propped up against the whitewashed plank walls are collections of signs and notices, surrounded by cans of colorful paints and oils.  Several craftsmen sit along a workbench on the eastern wall, diligently at work with hammers and paintbrushes.

title: [Isle Designs, Lookout Tower]
description: Cut out openings along the walls allow for the ocean breeze to spill into the room, bringing with it the scents of saltwater and tropical blooms.  Several carved benches and observation lenses have been placed next to the openings, affording a stunning view of the island and sea below.  Set into the floor, sandstone bricks have been placed meticulously, creating a swirling seashell pattern.

title: [Knit It, Backroom]
description: This room is a total mess!  Bundles of yarn and bolts of fabric are strewn across the floor and counters, while an array of knitting and sewing supplies lay about haphazardly.  At the far end of the room, a sleepy gray cat lays across a bench, her eyes grazing across the milling customers.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
description: The tunnel here is reinforced with heavy wooden boards that seem to be crawling with all sorts of vermin.  A foul-smelling pile of blankets and rags in the corner and a lingering scent of something unwashed gives the impression that someone may have been using the niche as a hideout.

title: [Mist Harbor, Courtroom]
description: Spartan in design, a prisoner's berth sits before the magistrate of Mist Harbor.  The magistrate himself is seated in a raised platform some ten feet overhead.  The courtroom looks downright foreboding due to the pair of nooses which hang on either side of the bench.

title: [Citizenship Office]
description: Fine oak panels carved with a floral pattern make up the walls in this small but quaint little office.  A dark walnut desk sits in a back corner sandwiched by two short filing cabinets, each adorned with a potted plant.  A couple of polished brass lanterns keep this room brightly lit and an old worn throw rug covers the floor.

title: [Haether's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An intricately carved ebonwood stand and a plain wooden table are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Sunken Shipwreck Table]
description: Painted onto the smooth, worn surface of the driftwood table is the image of a sailing ship resting on the bottom of the sea.  Pale blues and greens surround the once proud vessel and coral and kelp grow around it.  The ship's mast rises out of the table, and a small nautical flag hangs from it. The high-backed chairs are padded with plush blue cushions.  A single small fish is crudely engraved into the otherwise perfect surface of the table.

title: [Troisia's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath a high arched ceiling, an intricate knot-worked wall-hanging hangs on one of the golden brocade walls.  A gold-veined black marble counter and a carved mahogany box sit in opposite corners while a large potted fern rests on a parquet golden oak floor.

title: [Atrium, Annex Hallway]
description: Polished black marble peeks out from beneath the edges of a richly appointed ivory velvet carpet which stretches down the expanse of the hall.  A trio of elegant beeswax candles impressed with tiny seashells sits upon a lilac wood shelf, and a single window at the far end of the hall lets in sunlight and an ever-present, albeit faint, hint of an ocean breeze and salty air.

title: [Sornila's Weaponry]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  An iron-banded black wicker trunk and a large white wicker table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Warcamp, Mess Tent]
description: Large cooking fires run the length of the tent, sending plumes of smoke up to an opening in the peak of the ceiling.  Chunks of meat, some still resembling their former possessors, roast on thick iron spits and fill the tent with a nauseatingly sweet aroma, accompanied by the sound of fat sizzling as it drips into the flames.  Bones and pieces of flesh litter the floor, evidence of a combination of poor tableside manners and animalistic carnage.  In the shadows of the tent, something is feeding.

title: [The Lighthouse, Specialty Shop]
description: Hundreds of bundled scrolls have been neatly placed on wooden shelves that line the shop's walls.  Discarded pieces of armor and clothing lie in a pile behind the counter.

title: [Lockup, Sergeant's Office]
description: An imposing rolltop desk rests in front of an oversized chair.  A headsman's axe rests in one corner of the room in front of a podium with a large volume on it.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Playroom]
description: A chain cage is suspended from the ceiling above a pit in the floor.  Oily smoke rolls from out of the pit and has blackened the walls and ceiling.  A nearby rack has all the accoutrements a professional torturer would need.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Hallway]
description: Hanging from one of the overhead oak beams is a cargo net with various hooks and needles affixed at every loop.  Luckily, it is high enough so you cannot see what or whom is in it, yet the pool of dried blood beneath attests to its grisly work.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Hallway]
description: A whipping post constructed of aged oak is affixed to the far wall with shackles hanging from the top.  Carelessly looped over the post is a cruelly-barbed leather whip.  A pair of torches belch smoke which lazily drifts out the barred window.

title: [Warcamp, Outside]
description: Three beaten paths break off in a northerly direction, curving around a number of poorly built huts and tents.  A pile of broken bones and rotting flesh compete with a pile of steaming offal for the most nauseating odor available.  Over the top of the tents, a tall wooden flagpole marks the center of the warcamp just ahead, while a broad dirt path leads south to the sole entrance and exit of the encampment.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Warcamp, Outside]
description: A campfire burns in the center of a small nexus of paths surrounded by several makeshift tents.  Spits of meat, some with fur and hoof still attached, cook over the fire, casting a contrasting aroma to the foul air of the encampment.  A flagpole rises over the tops of the huts and tents to the west, marking the center of camp.  The beaten earth of the warcamp is littered with ragged bits of cloth.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Warcamp, Outside]
description: In the center of the warcamp is a wide area bordered by the many ragged tents and huts of the Grimswarm.  A towering wooden flagpole is situated at the north end of the assembly area and is flanked by a series of iron spikes driven into the ground, topped with sun-bleached skulls.  Lying so much like a forgotten rag doll, a body has been discarded in the middle of the open space, its limbs sprawled and twisted at unnatural angles.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Warcamp, Outside]
description: The makeshift wall of broken limbs and trees that surrounds the warcamp cuts in and around a large supply hut set farther away from the main encampment.  Several barrels rest outside the hut's entrance and a large crate lies broken nearby, its contents spilling out onto the ground.  A shallow, filthy ditch running alongside the path leading up to the hunt smells like a pitiful attempt at a latrine and serves as the breeding ground for yellow-stained, writhing maggots.

title: [Warcamp, Supply Hut]
description: Wind whistles through cracks in the walls of the poorly built hut and threaten to extinguish the flame of a dented bronze lantern hanging from the ceiling.  Various odd-sized crates and barrels, many of them speckled with dark stains, are stacked haphazardly throughout the room, forsaking any sense of organization.  Several table legs lean against a massive stone chest placed in the back of the room and along the walls, hanging from pegs, are numerous dented cups and nets of broken dinner plates.

title: [Warcamp, Entrance]
description: The entrance to the warcamp consists of nothing more than a large gap in a wall built of broken trees and shrubs haphazardly stacked upon the other.  In the turned up earth by the entryway, a bloody child-sized hand reaches up toward the sky, a forgotten or discarded prize of the Grimswarm.  Inside the entrance, the path separates into three directions, wrapping around several poorly constructed huts.  To the south, a path leads to a small rise in land, blanketed in a haze of campfire smoke.

title: [Warcamp, Captive's Hut]
description: The air inside the hut is a stagnant, unbreathable stench formed by the presence of sweat, blood, death, and feces.  Light cut through cracks in the walls, illuminating little, serving as a cruel reminder of a world those prisoners within once belonged to.  What floor is visible is soiled and serves as at least one source of the rancid air and is composed of parts and pieces of former prisoners ground into the soil by more recent victims of the Grimswarm.

title: [Coraxe's Weaponry]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a carved mahogany box on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Aradhul Road, Dark Woods]
description: Narrow shafts of light strike through the thick canopy, doing little to break the unnatural darkness of the woods.  Running from the south to the northwest is a faint footpath, occassionally marked by upturned stones of regular size and shape.  Beyond the footpath, hidden in the veil of darkness, is the noise of the forest's inhabitants, sounding foreign and hostile in this dimly lit wood.  Underfoot, moist earth gives way easily, while the air grows thick and heavy with humidity.

title: [Aradhul Road, Dark Woods]
description: The canopy overhead thickens, leaving the faint trail leading north nearly impossible to find.  To the southeast, it is more visible until it curves out of sight behind a stand of great moss-covered trees.  To the east stands a stone pillar, upon which rests a granite tablet, clear of the otherwise ever present growth of the woods.

title: [Aradhul Road, Trail]
description: Framed by a patchy bed of undergrowth, the trail continues northwest toward the woods and traces in a southerly direction toward a ruined stone wall.  A statue, nearly engulfed in vines, lies prone nearby, splattered with the droppings of some unknown creature of the woods.

title: [Aradhul Road, Stone Wall]
description: Stretching away into the woods and disappearing into the dim light of the forest, is a vine-covered stone wall.  Little of the wall remains as tall and true as it once did, resembling now more a stone berm subject to the whims of the woods, with great trees and low-slung plants growing upon and over it.  Beyond the north side of the wall, a trail disappears into the trees.

title: [Aradhul Road, Trail]
description: A cluster of massive trees casts a dense shadow over this part of the forest, their gnarled roots protruding from the ground and creating a tangled maze which encroaches on a forgotten stone structure.  From between the roots and trunks of these behemoths, a single empty window glares out over a vine-covered stone wall.  Nearby stands a lone stone column, its height nearly overcome by vines and broad, verdant leaves.

title: [Aradhul Road, Trail]
description: The muted illumination of day is all that the forest canopy allows, in contrast to the south, where a veritable wall of light shines down upon a ruined pave stone road, emerging from a trail leading northeast.  Pale moss hangs from branches overhead, trailing toward the earth and swaying in a barely felt breeze.

Muted light is all that the forest canopy allows, in contrast to the south, where a veritable wall of moonlight shines down upon a ruined pave stone road, emerging from a trail leading northeast.  Pale moss hangs from branches overhead, trailing toward the earth and swaying in a barely felt breeze.

title: [Aradhul Road, Ruined Road]
description: Waist-high weeds sprouting along the old road, some interspersed amongst the paving stones, are joined by scrub bushes and the occasional towering tree.  A darkness hovers over the road as it leads to the north and into a thickly-canopied forest.  Barely visible over the weeds is a roughly-hewn granite tablet.

title: [Aradhul Road, Precipice]
description: Wrapped securely around the base of a weathered a stone column is a thick rope leading downward, which disappears over the precipice edge and out of sight.  Directly opposite the column is the shattered remains of another, the pair of stone sentinels guarding the entrance to a broken bridge that ends abruptly after only a few feet.  Further ahead and in the ravine, a broken section of the stone bridge stands alone, reachable only by flying creatures or those who wish to attempt a dangerous leap.

title: [Wall of the Ravine]
description: Sans the small ledge upon which you perch, the face of the ravine wall is completely smooth and offers little purchase to maneuver.  A thick rope leading upward vanishes over the tantalizingly close precipice of the ravine above, beyond which the top of a column is just visible.  Below, various birds float on rising thermals around a large rope leading downward, black and brown specs against the thread of river at the bottom of the ravine.

title: [Wall of the Ravine]
description: The wind sweeps across the surface of the wall, tugging at a small bush which clings to a stone plaque carved out of the living stone.  Below, the swiftly moving waters of the river Anguindel create a permanent muted roar that reverberates up the walls of the ravine.  Meanwhile, above, a large rope leading upward sways back and forth in the wind.  Besides climbing the rope, the only other possibility is leaping to the ravine floor below.

title: [Floor of the Ravine]
description: Flowing swiftly by the bank, the fast-moving river sweeps past, carrying debris and floatsam away and out of sight.  A cool breeze blows constantly through the narrow confines of the ravine, tugging at the leaves of a brown weed clinging to the surface of a small ledge.  Piled up at the base of the ravine's walls are small drifts of sand, intermixed with broken limbs and large stones.

title: [Temple of Eonak, East Sanctuary]
description: A river of fire extends around the walls to converge in a sea of flame underneath the gigantic altar.  The blaze's red cast reflects off the russet mithril curtains and the crystal-encrusted ceiling, bathing the room in a warm, flickering glow.  Long benches provide places to sit and quietly contemplate if one does not feel distracted by the crackling fire all around.  The room has been arranged so that all attention is directed toward the gigantic altar and the rising wall just behind it.

title: [Mist Harbor, Vineyard]
description: Trellises laden with verdant grapevines stretch outward from the gate in a roughly triangular shape towards the distant cliffs.  Tufts of pale yellow grass, surrounded by darker, moist grasses, rise beneath each of the vines and lift their blade-like ends towards the plump purple grapes that ripen in the sun.

Trellises laden with verdant grapevines stretch outward from the gate in a roughly triangular shape towards the distant cliffs.  Tufts of pale yellow grass, surrounded by darker, moist grasses, rise beneath each of the vines and lift their blade-like ends towards the plump purple grapes.

title: [River Rapids]
description: Turbulence heaves the water into a nightmarish beast, smashing against the rough rock walls, before rolling over itself in a roaring fury.  It is extremely difficult to maintain balance and equilibrium in the maelstrom, and the strong current threatens to suck you away to a watery demise.  The only refuge lies on the floor of the ravine, either to the the north side or the south side of the river.

title: [Floor of the Ravine]
description: The constant dull roar of water echoes loudly, drowning out all ambient sound.  Past flooding is evidenced by faint high water marks on the ravine walls, which rise high above both banks of the fast-moving river.  Aside from debris washed up on the river bank, only scraggly scrub brush has survived to flourish in the immediate area.

title: [Wall of the Ravine]
description: Rising from below is the sound of the rushing river, its roar echoing through the ravine.  Dangling over the ledge is the end of a thin hemp rope leading upward that hangs from high above.  It sways back and forth in the wind which gusts through the narrow confines of the ravine.  Scrub brush clings to the wall of the ravine, much of it brown and light olive green, and providing perches for the occasional small bird or curious rodent.  From here, the ravine floor is only a jump away.

title: [Wall of the Ravine]
description: Wind, strong enough to tug at clothing, whistles as it gusts through the deep ravine.  Apart from the small ledge upon which you perch, the stone wall offers little purchase to all but the hardiest plants.  A thick hemp rope leading upward disappears over the ledge above, while a thin hemp rope leading downward stretches towards the ravine floor.  Not far below, birds of prey float serenely on the rising winds, framed against the further depths of the gorge and the flowing river at its bottom.

title: [Aradhul Road, Precipice]
description: Two stone columns stand side by side on the edge of a precipice, marking the termination of a broken road through the grassy area.  From between the two columns, a stone bridge extends outward only a few feet before ending abruptly into an empty space, offering only a view of deep gorge with a thin blue ribbon of a river at the bottom.  Tied to the base of one column is a thick hemp rope leading downward, which disappears over the edge of the precipice.

title: [Aradhul Road, Broken Road]
description: The broken road continues to the north, its cobblestones growing closer and more uniform, in contrast to the southwest where it takes a more roughshod appearance interrupted by small plants and trees growing from between the stones.  Bordered by brush and tall brown grass, the great trees of a forest are visible to the south, but only isolated oaks and maples offer any shade or places to rest.

title: [Aradhul Road, Broken Road]
description: Emerging from the forest floor is the uneven remains of a wide, cobbled road leading to the north.  Small bushes and tall grass grow from large cracks between the paving stones, while a majestic oak interrupts an entire section of the road; the work of an acorn between stones from centuries ago.  The surrounding trees of the forest continue to grow sparser in number, and the haunting sounds of the wood's inhabitants diminish in volume and occurrence.

title: [Aradhul Road, Trail]
description: Intermixed amongst the carpet of fallen leaves are scattered stones that increase in number to the north.  In contrast, the great trees of the forest thin out along the same direction, leaving only a darker woods to be traversed to the south.  Standing alone, not far off the trail, is a solitary boulder surrounded by scrub brush.

title: [Aradhul Road, Forest Trail]
description: Broad trees dominate this section of the forest, growing so thickly as to obscure the lay of the land.  A few stray boulders lie scattered across the forest floor, covered by mosses and lichens that help them blend with the surrounding flora.

title: [Aradhul Road, Forest Trail]
description: Trees tower above, light forcing its way through the thick canopy overhead.  An unusual, blue-hued moss grows on several mounds found just off the edges of the trail.  The green shrubbery that carpets the rest of the forest floor turns brown near the moss, and nothing else grows on the odd, elongated mounds.

title: [Aradhul Road, Forest Trail]
description: The trees loom dark and foreboding, the canopy so thick here that barely any light trickles through.  Several layers of rotting leaves cover the trail, cushioning the sound of anyone or anything that walks this stretch of forest.

title: [Aradhul Road, Forest Trail]
description: The thick forest closes in on the trail, threatening to overcome it, but never quite succeeding.  High overhead, the branches entwine with vines, creating a lush, green canopy.  Light filters through, dappling the trail and shifting with each movement of leaf or branch above.

title: [Aradhul Road, Forest Trail]
description: The forest floor is carpeted with several layers of leaves, the remnants of decades of autumns, and the perfect fodder for the thick undergrowth of greenery that fills every space not occupied by a massive tree.  Through this dominating wood, the trail cuts its way north and south, resisting nature's takeover.

title: [Aradhul Road, Small Glade]
description: The trail widens here into a small glade, and a few hardy flowers have taken advantage of the extra light and grow in small clumps along the edges.  The dense forest quickly closes in just past the glade's perimeter, however, and its towering, vine-draped trees grow so closely together that they discourage wandering from the path.

title: [Aradhul Road, Forest Trail]
description: Vines drape from branches of thickly clustered trees, their tiny pink flowers adding a splash of bright color to the more sedate hues of the forest.  Myriad vines loop over the trail for several feet, creating a colorful, partial tunnel.

title: [Aradhul Road, Forest Trail]
description: Tall trees press in on the narrow trail, threatening to overtake it and return the forest to its completely natural state.  Enough light filters through the thick canopy of leaves, branches, and vines to aid in the growth of dense greenery that carpets the forest floor.

title: [Aradhul Road, Rocky Trail]
description: The high, rocky walls of the ravine loom above the trail, and a gigantic rock, dislodged from high above, blocks passage to the south.  The ravine walls widen to the north, yielding to a thick forest.

title: [Aradhul Road, Rocky Trail]
description: The high, rocky walls of the ravine loom above the trail.  Numerous bits of rock and rubble have fallen onto the trail, creating a dangerous situation for anyone moving too quickly.  A gigantic rock has dislodged itself from high above and blocks the entire trail to the north.

title: [Aradhul Road, Rocky Trail]
description: A sheer cliff effectively terminates the trail to the south, with the top branches of an oak below protruding above the drop off.  Twisted bits of rusted metal lie discarded at the edge, a support frame for a lift system, if the decaying strands of rope and chunks of pulleys are any indication.  Far off, a dark ribbon of water cuts across the landscape, where the fortress of Ta'Vaalor can be seen.  The trail leads northerly, away from the cliff's edge and toward a rocky rise far in the distance.

title: [Aradhul Road, Rocky Trail]
description: A small but sheer cliff rises sharply up, effectively preventing northward movement.  A trail leads roughly south, a thin ribbon cutting through the thick forest of towering trees.  Layers of fallen leaves carpet the forest floor, providing a rich growing environment for the flora clustering about each tree grasping for bits of light that filter through the forest canopy.  A towering old oak dominates the area near the cliff face, and almost hidden beneath its spread of branches rests a twisted and broken metal lift.

title: [Aradhul Road, Trail]
description: Nearly hidden amongst fallen leaves of browns and yellows, remnants of other autumns, the trail continues along a straight path on a north-south axis.  Overhead, the beams of moonlight are sporadically broken by the flight of the forest's winged inhabitants about the thick canopy overhead.  Their calls, shrieks, and whistles only rarely break the silence of the woods.  By the side of the trail stands an ivy-covered stone column.

title: [Aradhul Road, Trail]
description: Tall hardwoods surround and frame a wide dirt trail that wanders northward, allowing only shafts of moonlight through a thick canopy of limbs and leaves.  Littering the forest floor are the dead and dried foliage of yesteryear, accompanied by the occasional odd bush.  Somewhere, a creature chitters angrily, and its violent outburst echoes through the forest, creating a sensation of emptiness.
