title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: A subtle design is worked into the west wall, employing the contrast between rough and polished stone to convey a warrior locked in combat with a bear.  In the soft light of the wall-mounted flames the image is just barely visible, more of an apparition than a carving.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: A high concentration of fine graphite scales has given the marble in this room a rich ebon color.  With their cold, glassy sheen the walls are like slabs of black ice, lit only by the occasional flickering flame.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: The marble walls start black as night on the western side, then fade ever so gradually to dusky grey, and finally become pure white at the eastern end.  A water chute is cut right down the center of the floor, sending its stream through a small opening in the southern wall.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: Tiny grains of quartz give the marble walls a pearly luster, and the stark white tones are moderated by the golden light of several shimmering flames set into niches.  Not even dust can find purchase in the glowing purity of these chambers.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: Cut into the gleaming white walls are small hollows where bright flames burn, though no soot marks the stone.  Your presence is multiplied through shadows which caper around you in a silent ring.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: Solid white marble walls rise on all sides, tilting slightly inward as they approach the ceiling.  The stone has been cut and polished carefully to showcase the fossilized shells of ancient freshwater snails.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: Water rushes quickly off to the southwest through a channel cut deep into the floor.  The shifting currents form intricate patterns which are magnified and reflected on the polished marble walls all around you.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: A sculpted white marble fountain stands in the center of this room.  Kneeling on a dais rising from the pool of water is a willowy cleric holding an alabaster ewer.  Water streams forth from the vessel, splashing over a fallen warrior draped across the platform.  Overflow from the fountain has been channelled off to the south.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: Thick streams enter this room from both the east and the west, meeting in the center where they tumble into a deep sinkhole set against the southern wall.  You cannot see any bottom to the pool, though the roiling water makes it difficult to see much of anything.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: You can hear the gurgling of water somewhere behind a wall, but the exact source is difficult to pinpoint due to the hard, echoing marble.  Burning torches send shadows leaping about in a wild dance.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: The unfinished nature of this room sets it apart from all the rest.  Scaffolding covers one rough marble wall, still awaiting use.  One can only guess at the fate of the artist and of the others involved in the construction of this vast temple.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: One of the fire niches in this room is broken, and you can see some of the inner workings.  A thin copper pipe protrudes from the cracked niche and is ruptured several inches from its end.  At that break a small flame dances, leading you to believe that these pipes must tap into some natural gas deposit.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: The canted white walls loom overhead, their intersections shadowed in the flickering light.  No imperfections are visible in the cool, reflective marble, seemingly untouched by time.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: The chokingly thick air leaves you gasping for breath and dripping wet.  Forced to turn sharply to the east, the water leaps up against the southern wall in a frothing wave.  The only thing preventing the stream from breaching the wall is a battered sheet of metal guarding the corner.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: The stream covers most of the floor, moving more slowly now that it has spread out.  Drops of water slide down the pale green marble walls like tears.  From the west comes the muted sound of water falling into a deep pool.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: Beads of condensation slip down the wall, joining forces as they intersect.  Eventually, they reunite with the rippling flow that covers the floor.  The stone which surrounds you is slightly warm to the touch.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: A steady trickle of water emerges from a crack in the pale green wall and slides down the stone until it joins the stream on the floor.  The air is so humid you can feel the moisture accumulate in your lungs.  There is no choice but to wade through the wide, shallow stream.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: The air is laden with moisture from the broad, sluggish stream coursing along the floor.  Condensation drips from the ceiling and beads the walls.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: A fountain of water cascades from a carved spout in the western wall.  It pools in a shallow depression in the floor, then flows away to the south.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: Water streams out of a clay jug that forms part of a larger carving in the marble wall.  It collects in an oval basin, but instead of pouring gracefully down from there, the liquid trickles unevenly off the broken spout and clings shyly to the yellow-streaked stone as it descends.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: The stream continues to huddle against the eastern wall as it glides along.  You can feel the weight of the air, thick with moisture and stale with time.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: Water drips from the ceiling and the walls are slick with condensation.  Traveling steadily along the floor, the stream has cut its own channel over the accumulated years.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: A slight curve in the tunnel brings the water straight across the floor until it hits the wall on the opposite side and unwillingly shifts its course.  The ground is slippery and traversing it requires attention and care.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Effluentorium]
description: An abrupt turn to the west sends the stream churning up against the southern wall.  A metal backsplash protects the stone from this angry onslaught, though even the metal has worn thin with time.  Spray from the collision fills the air.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: The marble here is deep green from an admixture of hornblende.  The color varies in intensity and tone, which the sculptor has used to great effect.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: Detailed carvings adorn every wall, bringing the grace of life to cold marble slabs.  The scenes float effortlessly between the flat and the sculptural.  In one mural, a hollow-eyed woman reaches out with a fully dimensional arm to touch a young child depicted on an adjacent wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: Whole portions of the walls have been hacked away here, with only a thin crust of sulfur left to indicate the reason.  Every last deposit has been played out, and no effort was made to restore the appearance of the chamber.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: Bright flames burn cleanly in wall niches, bringing a little warmth to these stony chambers.  Sculpted out of the floor in the southeast corner is a frog with a wide open mouth.  Flecks of mica in the green marble catch the light, winking like fireflies.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: Some color has worked its way into the pristine white marble.  Tendrils of green creep through the southern wall and have been cleverly incorporated into the large relief carving there as blades of grass.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Tanthuz]
description: A few faint streaks of yellow mar the snowy walls, though clearly they are nothing more than superficial remnants of an extinct vein.  Every sound trails an echo in these stony rooms, the unyielding marble refusing to absorb anything from such brazen interlopers.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Occipitum]
description: Scored into the western wall are two deep vertical grooves, spaced about three feet apart.  They glisten slightly, as though wet.  The scarlet stone under your feet is tinged with black and is cool to the touch.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Occipitum]
description: Bands of snowy white creep through the red marble in this room, making it a bit brighter than the others.  The perfectly polished surfaces throw light around in bewildering patterns.  Movement just at the edge of your field of vision distracts you, and you cannot be sure if it is something to fear or merely your own transformed reflection.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Occipitum]
description: Your eyes cannot detect even the slightest flaw or crack in the high sheen of the polished red marble which encloses you completely.  A sconce carved from the wall itself cradles a dancing flame, the flickering light playing tricks on your sense of distance and scale.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Occipitum]
description: A robed wizardess is carved deeply into the blood-red marble on the east wall.  She is casting a spell, and black lines of energy explode from her hands to create a protective sphere all around her.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Belvedere]
description: Hollowed out from red marble with a large opening to the surface, this chamber is infused with life and seems to breathe restoration.  All around you can sense the watchful mountain, immobile but alert.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Amygdala]
description: Variegated bands of color traverse the grey marble walls in deep convolutions.  The ceiling is high and slightly domed, causing sounds to echo softly before fading away.  Narrow benches carved directly out of the floor are set in a circle around an octagonal depression.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Belvedere]
description: Open to the outside world, this room is filled with clean, brisk mountain air and the soft moonlight gives a much less sinister cast to the cool red marble of the walls and floor.  From here you can look out over the treacherous rocks of the Gorget Trails and the brilliant green of the Emerald Forest.

Open to the outside world, this room is filled with clean, brisk mountain air and the flood of daylight gives a much less sinister cast to the cool red marble of the walls and floor.  From here you can look out over the treacherous rocks of the Gorget Trails and the brilliant green of the Emerald Forest.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Occipitum]
description: The deep red marble which forms these chambers has a wonderful visual depth to it, created by the commingled tones of crimson and rusty brown which dapple the stone in a variety of patterns.  Some areas give the impression of newly-dissected flesh, while others remind you of smoldering embers.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Occipitum]
description: Slick walls of red marble shine with flecks of garnet, now an inextricable part of the rock itself.  Flames gutter then flare from the wall sconces, causing your shadow to alternately cower and loom against the bloodstream stone.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Occipitum]
description: Carved so deeply into the red marble of the west wall that the lines appear black is the image of a sorcerer with arms outstretched to either side.  Arcing veins in the marble show the power he gathers from his surroundings and focuses out through his eyes.  No matter where you are in the room, those gouged black eyes are watching.

title: [Temple Wyneb, Occipitum]
description: Highly polished red marble surrounds you on all sides, the carved surfaces dancing in time with a flickering wall-mounted flame.  Reflected red light falls in a bloody wash across your skin.

title: [Graveyard, Under Crypt]
description: A bewildering series of tunnels through the rock greets you.  While not shaped by clever craftsmen, the channels do not appear natural.  Trails of slime coat the ground and lead off in several directions.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Graveyard, Under Crypt]
description: A bewildering series of tunnels through the rock greets you.  While not shaped by clever craftsmen, the channels do not appear natural.  Trails of slime coat the ground and lead off in several directions.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: The dried blood that covers almost every inch of this vault raises a silent scream within you.  All of the corpses have been hacked into small pieces and the various parts were packed into the slots made into the walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: Again the bodies have been cut up to fit the holes.  Nothing of value has been left to the dead.  Some skulls show signs that the teeth have been chipped out and are now missing.  They must have been made of gold and taken for their value.  Bile forms in your mouth as you think about the evil that could have done this.  These poor tortured souls will never be able to rest in a crypt like this.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: Even as decomposed as the bodies are, you again see evidence of the atrocities of this crypt.  Mutilated corpses, hacked to pieces, have been stuffed into the wall pockets.  Even then, some would not fit.  Overstuffed as the holes were, arms and legs have fallen from the notches to land on the floor to decay.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: Body parts fill the notches.  People have been hacked up to fit the slots here instead of the slots being cut to fit the people.  The person responsible for this atrocity must himself have no soul.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: Bodies drape from the wall slots and they fill the crypts to overflowing.  Eyeing the arms and legs hanging from the opening at odd angles, you murmur a silent prayer for the dead entombed here.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: Rows of small niches line the walls, each one tightly packed with assorted body parts.  You are not sure if any slot holds an entire body, or just parts from several bodies.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: The crypts, though not carved neatly are exceedingly large and spacious.  At first you think this might be the room used to house giantmen, but looking inside the hollowed out wall you find out the truth.  To save time and money many bodies are now stuffed together as if it were a mass burial.  Anything of value has been taken from the poor dead.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: Again, the row upon row of small crypts brings bile into your throat.  Though decomposed to various degrees, the strange placement of the bodies in the crypts begins to give you a sense of what this area is all about.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: This area must be one for the poorest of the lands.  The wall notches are very deep here, allowing multiple bodies to be placed into each slot.  Blood has dried on the cave walls where it has run from the openings.  Some bodies seem to be missing fingers and others teeth.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: A dried blood trail leads to the south.  In the crypts you see maggots working on the rotting flesh of the bodies.  The bodies of the dead are plump and swollen.  These people have not been entombed very long.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: More of the wall has been carved to hold the dead, and the rock from the excavation litters the floor from the new drilling going on.  Looking into the notches you notice that all of the crypts are empty.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: This cavern is caked with dried blood which coats the floor and walls in this area drinking in all the light.  Every cave looks like the last as you struggle to find your way around inside them.

title: [Minion Quarters]
description: This cavern is caked with dried blood which coats the floor and walls in this area drinking in all the light.  Every cave looks like the last as you struggle to find your way around inside them.

title: [Castle Dungeons, Guard Room]
description: You find yourself in what used to be a guardroom.  Empty ale tankards and empty plates still lie on a heavy oak table.  Rusted iron rings holding corroded lumps that were once keys hang from various pegs in the north wall.  A set of moss-covered stairs lead up into the gloom.

title: [Castle Varunar, Keep]
description: A small room interrupts the spiraling stone stairs.  In a carved-out niche in the rock, a small torch sputters softly.  A small table and a single chair are the room's only furnishing.  In the flickering light you notice numerous bloody handprints stain the walls.

A small room interrupts the spiraling stone stairs.  In a carved-out niche in the rock, a small torch sputters softly.  A small table and a single chair are the room's only furnishings.  In the flickering light you notice numerous bloody handprints staining the walls.

title: [Castle Varunar, Keep]
description: Along the rounded keep walls you see numerous cloth banners hanging from iron nails.  Many of the once-proud standards have been shredded by what appears to be giant animal claws.  You also notice bits of rotting hair and bone stuck amongst the seams in the stone walls.  Above and below you, the spiral stairs continue into the gloom.

title: [Castle Varunar, Keep]
description: The spiral staircase abruptly ends here.  This cramped room appears to be the very top of the castle keep.  A pair of rusted iron manacles has been bolted to the stone walls.  A small bed of blood stained rushes is the only other evidence that anyone has ever been here.

The spiral staircase abruptly ends here.  This cramped room appears to be the very top of the castle keep.  A pair of rusted iron manacles has been bolted to the stone walls.  A small bed of bloodstains are the only other evidence that anyone has ever been here.

title: [Wizard Guild, Scribe's Workroom]
description: A thin layer of parchment dust coats the stained wooden planks of the floor.  Several scrolls and books have stacked up in the corner due to the haphazard organization of the shelves that line the walls.  A few high-backed leather chairs surround a large table in the center of the workroom.

title: [Castle Dungeons]
description: A flickering torch set on the slimy stone wall lights your way through this dank dungeon.  The smell of mold and rotting food still permeates the air.  The sound of dripping water draws your attention to the open cell door.

title: [Castle Dungeons]
description: A flickering torch set into the wall casts dancing shadows all around you.  Damp straw trampled into the floor muffles the ambient sounds of the area.  The sounds of chittering rodents seem to echo up and down these lonely halls.

title: [Castle Dungeons]
description: The dim hallway comes to an abrupt halt here.  A side passage leading northwest fades into the flickering torchlight.  A slight creaking noise draws your attention to an open cell.

title: [Castle Dungeons]
description: This area of the dungeon appears to have been occupied by the foulest of the castle's enemies.  No torches light the dank halls, the only light coming from a softly glowing lichen growing on the slimy stone walls.

title: [Castle Dungeons]
description: The soft light of glowing lichen on the walls reveal numerous bits of rusted chain on the ground.  To the north, a reinforced cell door lies open giving access to the room within.
The soft light of glowing lichen on the walls reveals numerous bits of rusted chain on the ground.  To the north, a reinforced cell door lies open giving access to the room within.

title: [Castle Dungeons]
description: The darkened hallway comes to a dead end here.  The skeletal remains of a humanoid lay propped up against the west wall.  A stout wooden cell door appears to have been torn off its hinges and thrown to the ground.

title: [Castle Dungeons, Cell]
description: The flickering light from the hallway casts an eerie glow in the cell.  On the floor you find splintered wooden spoons and bowls.  In the shadows something on the far wall catches your attention.

title: [Castle Dungeons, Cell]
description: A short bed hewn out of rock sits in the center of the cell.  Complete with a stone pillow, the bed is no more than five feet long.  A rusted iron spoon lies on the floor, the handle almost worn away.  The glow from the hallway causes a glint on the wall above the stone bed.

title: [Castle Dungeons, Cell]
description: You find yourself in a small cell.  A sleeping pallet that is ten feet long lays along the north wall covered with straw now decomposed and black.  Lying in the corner you see a battered, oversize iron cup and plate.  A sudden flare from the torch in the hall highlights something reddish on the wall.

title: [Castle Dungeons, Cell]
description: Three sleeping pallets have been hewn out of stone along each of the cell walls.  Etched into the stone above each bed are similar, yet very different runes.  One set thin and very precise, another stronger but less artistically drawn.  The third set imparts a feeling of foreboding and distress.  Set in the center of the room you see a stone pedestal.

title: [Castle Dungeons, Cell]
description: Everything here seems to be half the expected size.  The sleeping pallet is only three feet long and covered with rotting straw.  A small spoon and cup are lying on top of the pallet partially covered by the decaying straw.  In the dim light of the lichen you notice something on the wall above the pallet.

title: [Castle Dungeons, Cell]
description: A six-foot long sleeping pallet leans against the north wall.  Oddly, the rushes that cover it seem almost fresh.  Along the east wall is a mildewed pine table, its poorly-cured wood no challenge for the dampness of the dungeon.  On the west wall you see some faint white scratches.

title: [Axedar's Weaponry]
[Axedar's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wicker basket and a gilded maple table sit in opposite corners while an open-mawed greater vruul statue rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Lalyia's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a pile of striped throw pillows rests on an enameled hardwood floor.

title: [Lalyia's Outfitting]
description: Blue watered silk walls rise from an enameled hardwood floor.  Just above a pile of striped throw pillows hangs a blue watered silk tapestry, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Steia's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by knotty pine walls, the shop features a pile of striped throw pillows in the center of its celadon marble floor.  A midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs under the tiled ceiling.  Right near the front is a jewel-inlaid caddy and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Tese's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A carved haon armoire and a silk-covered dress mannequin sit in opposite corners while a vibrant pink bougainvillea plant rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Betyar's Weaponry]
[Betyar's Magic Shoppe]
description: Knotty pine walls rise from a sawdust strewn pine floor.  Just above a wooden statue of Rone Wehnimer hangs a blue watered silk tapestry, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  An etched brass bin and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Kivsha's Weaponry]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A gilded maple table and a jewel-inlaid caddy stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Akivas' Weaponry]
description: Polished oak walls rise from a polished oak floor.  Just above a twisted sandstone sculpture hangs a silken sea-themed tapestry, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A wicker basket and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Vivaldi's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath a modwir beam ceiling, a rainbow colored flag hangs on one of the knotty pine walls.  An etched brass bin and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sit in opposite corners while a scaled model of Hearthstone rests on a sawdust strewn pine floor.

title: [Vlinch's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by glossy mistwood walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its plank floor.  A pair of crossed bones hangs under the beam ceiling.  Right near the front is a glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Aethor's Magic Shoppe]
description: A faded treasure map hangs on one of the celadon marble walls, and a mistwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  A woven Vornavian silk rug sits in one corner of a glossy mahogany floor.  There is a glass-topped mistwood counter on one side of the shop and a flexible willow woven basket on the other.

title: [A Narrow Passageway]
description: A narrow passageway is roughly cut through the granite rock, and the edges of the passageway's floor are covered with a thin layer of dust, although the center appears relatively clean.  Still, with no lighting sources other than the small bit of lighting that intrudes from the ends, it is difficult to see the exact condition of the area.  At one end, the passageway widens out into a short hallway.  At the other end, dancing firelight flickers beyond mithril curtains.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Tap Room]
description: Smooth grey stone rises from the unadorned flooring to form a curving dome ceiling.  At the center of the ceiling is an invar cage filled with glowing mushrooms that gives the room a soft greenish glow.  Bisecting the room evenly in half is a polished grey marble bar, its surface covered with several copper-bound oak barrels set with iron spigots.  A smooth granite archway offers passage to the east.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Kiln]
description: A massive black iron kiln occupies the majority of the space in this grey-walled room, its ambient heat causing the surrounding air to warp and waver.  Dwarven workers steadily cart in malt from a reinforced invar arch to be roasted in the giant oven.  As the malt finishes roasting, it is moved south by even more workers.  The nutty aroma of the grain is nearly overpowering.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Office]
description: Promotional scrolls for many of Bluerock Brewery's signature beers and ales have been tacked carefully upon the bleached stone walls.  Neatly furnished, the tidy office features a glaes-paned curio cabinet, an immaculately clean desk, and a sturdy high-backed chair.  The faint aroma of roasted barley lingers in the air, mingling with a distinctly earthy scent originating from somewhere unseen.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Brewhouse]
description: Two orderly rows of large copper kettles span the length of this massive room, carefully monitored by dwarven workers clad in white smocks.  A network of steel-braced tubes feeds liquid in from the east into each kettle for boiling.  Fragrant dried hops are stored in a pair of giant bins and are added as needed to each kettle.  Kegs, barrels and casks are filled and transported below via an intricate pulley system.  The word "EXIT" has been painted in red letters above a pair of steel double doors.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Storage]
description: Rows of large barrels, kegs and casks lying on their side fill most of the expansive room, the wooden containers nestled into hollow, stacked stone racks.  An almost thin mist swirls close to the smooth floor, and a slight chill pervades the air.  A few dwarven workers wander around the storage area, checking on the various stock.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Mash Tun]
description: Lined up against the grey north wall is a row of copper mash tuns.  A series of white tubes feed each tun with fresh water, while another set of steel-braced tubes carry the wort westward to be boiled.  Attending each tun is a stoic-faced dwarf who carefully monitors the grist, the mashing and lautering processes.

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Millroom]
description: In an attempt to maximize productivity, the steam generated by a blackened iron furnace powers several mills through a series of wheels and gears.  Sweat drips down the faces of dwarves tending to the furnace's fire, though distance does little to lessen the intensity of its heat.  Tall steel hoppers are kept filled with malt from the north, in preparation to be milled.  A series of grist cases house the already milled grain.

title: [Municipal Building, Lobby]
description: Dusty, grey stone tiles surround a slightly tarnished silver pick-and-shovel seal inlaid on the floor.  A handful of green-speckled yellow giant toadstools gather dust along the walls, set into polished brass pots.  Dwarves of all shapes and sizes go about their business in one of the building's numerous offices.  A prominent faux-oak door resides in the north wall, while some stone steps rise to the east.

title: [Muncipal Building, Second Floor]
description: Sparsely furnished, the entire second floor consists of a small landing lit by a pair of giant luminescent toadstools.  A single padded chair sits up against the wall next to a grey steel door, offering a seat to anyone waiting to see the Clan Leader of Zul Logoth.

title: [Clan Leader Griva's Office]
description: Spartan but livable, this small office appears to double as a sleeping room.  A wide steel desk dominates the center of the room, and behind the desk a comfortable padded chair resides.  In the far corner, a metal cot has been pushed up against the wall, and the coverings on the cot are in disarray, as if someone has slept there recently.  Framed portraits of several dwarves occupy the back wall, but the other walls are barren.  A grey steel door provides exit.

title: [Zul Logoth, Clerk's Office]
description: Looking more like a forgotten nook in the tunnel than an office constructed for transacting government business, the clerk's cramped quarters is merely a fifteen-foot-square room with unpainted granite walls, floor and ceiling.  Exposed timbers shore up the ceiling timbers that bend precariously in the middle.  A warped desk with an unpadded metal chair behind it rests near a steel door.  Cabinets overflow with documents, and a post board near a steel door holds notices long outdated.

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Tunnel]
description: Light from the outer caverns filters through the translucent mushroom cap, playing off bits of crystal that have been suspended from the ceiling.  The surroundings are quite drab in comparison to the exterior, though a hint of color can be glimpsed further down a steep tunnel.

title: [Fashionable Face Fur]
description: Detailed busts of notable dwarves and their beards rest upon a simple ledge that runs the length of the far wall.  Beside a cushioned, steel-framed chair, a polished marble stand supports a shiny metal tray neatly lined with an assortment of grooming tools.  The chamber is cast in a cheerful light by the glowing toadstools situated at each corner.

title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Tavern]
description: Small humus pots suspended from the ceiling cast donut-shaped pools of light across the stone floor of this cramped tavern.  The scent of pipe tobacco mixes with the odor of stale ale, and a smoky haze envelops the entire room.  Behind a low granite bar, the proprietor gazes out mistrustfully at the patrons gathered at the strangely shaped tables, his eyes darting every so often to the cash box that he keeps within easy reach.  A sign on the bar lists the fare available.

title: [D.H. Cobbling Outlet, Foyer]
description: An enormous bronze medallion bearing a rugged boot in low relief has been inlaid into the grey stone floor of the building's foyer, greeting prospective patrons to the facilities.  Hallways branch off in three directions, the darkened corridors lit by luminescent toadstools of similar size and coloration.  The scent of leatherworking emanates strongly from the north.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Gooseberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Paupers, Annex]
description: Two huge toadstools in stone pots illuminate a large, comfortable room.  Dusky brown granite benches line two of the marble walls, facing each other across the sapphire carpet.  On one wall, a brass arch allows exit to the corridor outside, while on the other wall a curtain provides entrance to the locker area.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east and west, although a modest amount of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on either side are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

title: [Rockslinger's, Dark Hallway]
description: A dark hallway stretches east and west, although a fair amount of light intrudes from the eastern end.  No carpet covers the hard granite floor, and footsteps echo loudly.  Strangely, the walls on either side are constructed from sheet metal, as if the section was not originally excavated for its current purpose.  The odor of mushrooms pervades the entire area.

title: [Gooseberry Room Locker]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Archway]
description: Under the watchful eye of one of the store's assistants, hardworking dwarves continually haul carts filled with furniture in and out of a large invar-braced archway.  A bright orange banner announces, "Cort's Emporium," and is suspended by wires fastened to three limestone stalactites.  The massive cavern echoes with the murmurs of business, though the noise is partially muffled by two man-made stone walls that partition the emporium into three distinct areas.

title: [Virilneus' Weaponry]
[Virilneus' Armory]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  Some invar-braced shelves and a small invar-inlaid table sit in opposite corners while a gilded dwarven miner statue rests on a rough stone floor.

title: [Boker's Weaponry]
[Boker's General Store]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from a smooth onyx tile floor.  Just above a woven rolton wool rug hangs a dwarven miner portrait, and a simple stone ceiling completes the picture.  A small invar-inlaid table and a twisted invar rack stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [D.H. Cobbling Outlet, Corridor]
description: Secluded from the main workshop area, this corridor is quieter than the rest of the building, though no less spartan in decor.  Two sturdy chairs have been placed to one side, creating a makeshift waiting area.  Along the western wall, thick glass windows set around a simple white stone door offer a view into a large office.

title: [Office of the Registrar]
description: Muted green paint covers the walls from edge to edge, and a chalkboard hangs off to one side.  From the vantage point of the office's simple steel desk, there is a clear line of sight to the building's foyer, allowing observation of all those who come and go.  A wrought iron lectern stands next to a small bookcase housing several large tomes.  Suspended from one corner of the ceiling is a hammered brass bowl with verdant hanging moss spilling over its sides in lacy clumps.

title: [D.H. Cobbling Outlet, Corridor]
description: A series of colorful promotional scrolls for the establishment has been tacked up on the stone walls.  To the east, a pair of large, thick windows looks into a rather cluttered office.

title: [Office of the Foreman]
description: Several labeled boxes have been stacked up in the corners of the office, kept out of the way of the foreman's daily routine.  An iron-studded chest sits against the side of a brass-accented desk, secured by a giant steel padlock.  Pelt and hide samples rest atop the highest tiers of a metal shelf, while the lower levels display a few pieces of children's artwork.

title: [D.H. Cobbling Outlet, Stock]
description: A wide steel counter runs along a parallel section of the western wall that has been fitted with sliding drawers housing a variety of skins, pelts, hides, and other cobbling supplies.  Thick inventory lists have been bound together in a book that rests on a table off to one side.  The mingled scents of leatherworking, tanning, and dying drift in from several directions.

title: [D.H. Cobbling Outlet, Tannery]
description: Hides from a variety of animals lie in piles upon a badly stained counter.  Several vats in the rear of the tannery contain noxious liquids that fill the air with odoriferously offensive fumes.  Splatters cover the stone walls in bizarrely aesthetically pleasing patterns.

title: [D.H. Cobbling Outlet, Hallway]
description: Walls of solid grey stone are illuminated by giant luminescent toadstools with pale, blue-spotted caps, planted in large brass pots.  Along both sides of the hallway, private workshops are available, each space marked off by a carved gemstone.

title: [Dread's Outfitting]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from a rough stone floor.  Just above a leaping dolphin statuette hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A small invar-inlaid table and a twisted invar rack stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Floors]
description: Ceramic, clay, glass, and metal tiles in a variety of color and shapes are displayed in an orderly fashion along a span of the cavern wall.  A smock-clad dwarf sits on an iron stool beside the arrangement, watching for the first sign of a customer with questions or in need of assistance.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Door Decor]
description: Flush against the cavern wall, towering iron-worked racks are stocked with display cases and stands on all three tiers.  A pulley-rigged scaffold hangs beside the racks, ready to move an item chosen by a customer via a system of ropes and levers.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Facades]
description: Stacked one upon another, a variety of chairs have been arranged according to size and style on the lowest level of the display rack.  A measuring string has been hung from a stalagmite, marked off with the average heights of numerous humanoid races.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Signs]
description: A red-bearded dwarven engraver works tirelessly in a large alcove, honoring requests for his handcarved signs and plaques.  Stacks of metal sheets and stone slabs flank the partially curtained opening.  Wrought iron racks house numerous miniature potted luminescent toadstools, providing ample illumination.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Sitting Room]
description: Sandwiched between two rising grey stone walls is a small sitting area furnished with smooth granite benches.  Local merchants congregate near the walls in tight circles, discussing what savings and deals are available on the merchandise in the emporium.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Permits]
description: A few smooth stalagmites are carved with a spiraling pattern of small niches.  Tiny potted toadstools rest within the little shelters crafted for them, lending their pale blue luminescence to the overall ambience of the cavern.  Neatly lined up against the eastern wall is a carved stone desk, complete with inkwell and quills.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Containers]
description: An enormous number of tables, most crafted from metal and the rest created from imported woods, stand side by side against the southern wall.  A small sign propped up on each table notes what materials were used and the name of the artisan that crafted the piece.  A sturdy cart stands by to help transport the customer purchases.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Ceilings]
description: Haggling dwarves carefully inspect the wares for sale, creating quite a ruckus in this corner of the monstrous cavern.  Numerous catalogs filled with both elaborate and simple designs lie open on stands beside a clerk station.  A secluded area blocked off by a large iron partition provides a more remote setting for private negotiations.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Walls]
description: A parchment chart complete with examples of all available metals and stones for custom craftwork has been displayed prominently against the cavern wall.  Occasionally, one of the emporium's assistants will block off a material when it runs out of stock.  The cap of a nearby giant toadstool glows a soft white, illuminating every detail and flaw of the sample materials.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Wall Displays]
description: Roaring laughter booms over a stone partition, a reminder of just how large this furniture warehouse is.  Keen-eyed dwarves walk by, in search of spectacular additions for their shops.  A particularly appealing display has drawn the attention of several customers, rushing in to get their fill.

title: [Cort's Emporium, Floor Displays]
description: Potted toadstools in a variety of sizes and shapes fill the air with their loamy aroma.  The fungi are inspected carefully by the emporium caretakers, taking pride in their work.  Massive racks house tables and stands crafted from stone and faux-wood.

title: [Lewk's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A twisted invar rack and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a rough stone floor.

title: [Notta's General Store]
description: Beneath an ale keg mosaic ceiling, an etched invar mining mural hangs on one of the dark invar-traced walls.  A giant invar-bound chest sits in one corner while an overturned mining cart rests on the black marble floor.

title: [Dread's Outfitting]

title: [Dergan's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a simple stone ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the rough grey stone walls.  A massive granite chest sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the grey stone floor.

description: Plain wooden walls rise from a rough stone floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  Some invar-braced shelves and a slender silvery glaes display stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Notta's General Store]
description: Beneath an ale keg mosaic ceiling, an illuminated Zul Logoth map hangs on one of the dark invar-traced walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while some large invar-bound ale kegs rests on the white marble floor.

title: [Notta's General Store]
description: Beneath an ale keg mosaic ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the dark invar-traced walls.  Some invar-braced shelves sits in one corner while a large granite boulder rests on the white marble floor.

title: [Clunk's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a simple stone ceiling, a mounted silver mining pick hangs on one of the speckled granite walls.  Some mithril-braced shelves and a small invar-inlaid table sit in opposite corners while a large granite boulder rests on a speckled granite floor.

[Clunk's Weaponry]

title: [Clunk's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a simple stone ceiling, a pair of crossed invar axes hangs on one of the speckled granite walls.  A slender silvery glaes display and some invar-braced shelves sit in opposite corners while a large granite boulder rests on a speckled granite floor.

title: [Virilneus' Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a pair of crossed invar axes hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A twisted invar rack and a giant invar-bound chest sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a rough stone floor.

title: [Virilneus' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A carved stone cabinet and a giant invar-bound chest sit in opposite corners while some potted luminescent toadstools rests on a rough stone floor.

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Chamber]
description: Rising nearly to the ceiling, stacks of empty crates and boxes create makeshift columns around the chamber.  A riot of color coats the stone floor like a melted rainbow.  The variegated ground continues throughout the encircling tunnels.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Alcove]
description: Splotches of bright color stain the surrounding stone from floor to ceiling with only a few uncovered areas offering a glimpse of the natural grey hue.  A variety of notices have been placed around the alcove, most notably a stone plaque and a big hand-painted sign.  Hanging off the back of a chair is a dye-covered apron with dirty gloves shoved in its pockets.

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Tunnel]
description: Relatively drab in relation to the adjacent tunnels, this area has been fortunate in not suffering as many dyeing mishaps.  A single giant luminescent toadstool lights the way for customers, shedding ample light to view the different characteristics in the available colors.

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Tunnel]
description: Streaks of color run across the walls, and some droplets of dye have even stained the tiny resident fungus living here.  Several empty boxes balance precariously on a wobbly, three-legged stool.

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Tunnel]
description: A messy splash of orange and yellow adorns the low ceiling, while splotches of dark green and burgundy cover the walls.  Scratches and scrapes mar the colored stone, the result of efforts to remove the dye.  The faint odor of ale hangs pleasantly in the air.

title: [Multicolor Mushroom, Tunnel]
description: Chaotically splattered across the walls, various colored dyes have dripped down the stone, intermingling with one another to a uniform brown near the floor.  A few swathes of canvas are piled in a corner, the remnants of a futile attempt at cleanup.

title: [Municipal Building, Hallway]
description: Several nondescript pieces of stone sculpture stand between the doors that run along this corridor.  The faint smell of loam and cigar smoke lingers heavily in the air, originating from one of many offices in the area.  A threadbare curtain occupies the wall at the end of the hall.

title: [Zul Logoth, Registrar]
description: A badly lit cubbyhole serves as an office for the Zul Logoth registrar.  A lone toadstool situated in one corner appears to be badly malnourished and gives off a weak light.  Papers are strewn across a metal desk in the center of the room, and more papers protrude from the half-closed drawers of several cabinets against the back wall.  With space occupied by the toadstool pot, the desk, and the cabinets, there is barely enough room for the overweight dwarven registrar to sit behind the desk.

title: [Zul Logoth Citizenship Office]
description: The only furniture in this tiny room is a tall-backed granite chair behind a smooth granite desk.  Displayed upon the wall is a pick-and-shovel insignia.  Practically covering the entire surface of the desk is the Zul Logoth citizenship book.  Closer inspection of the book reveals thousands of pages listing the names of the dwarven citizens of Zul Logoth, as well as the names of those of other races to whom the town has awarded partial citizenship. The toadstool in the corner provides the only illumination in the room.

title: [Zul Logoth, Demon Permit Office]
description: Rough granite walls and an uneven floor reveal the haste with which this office was built.  Overhead, two splintered beams do little to instill a sense of safety.  An ink-stained oak desk rests in the center of the room, covered in piles of parchment that occasionally spill onto the floor.

title: [Municipal Building, Hallway]
description: Dingy white stone walls meet dark grey tiled floor, creating a rather drab backdrop to a few sparse steel-framed chairs.  Most of the doors along the hallway have identifying signs tacked on or next to them, though a few are missing.

title: [Zul Logoth Deeds]
description: Detailed maps of Zul Logoth's tunnels adorn the smooth grey stone walls that enclose this office.  A nondescript granite desk is covered with piles of paperwork and an empty silver stein.  Draped over a high-backed chair is a thick red wool coat, which contrasts strongly with the drab surroundings.  Several shelves along the back wall house a collection of polished rocks.

title: [Surname Registry]
description: Metal bins stacked in uneven piles threaten to topple over onto the flagstone floor.  The curling labels affixed to each bin indicate some form of organization, but the torn and crumpled papers inside do not inspire confidence.  Three of the larger bins have been pushed together and topped with a plank of wood to create a sort of desk.

title: [Zul Logoth Real Estate]
description: Stacks of paperwork litter the massive iron-studded desk, granite shelves, and faux-wood stand that occupy this small office.  Several gold-edged plaques adorn the smooth grey stone walls that enclose this tiny space.  A half-eaten mushroom sandwich rests on the seat of an armless canvas chair.

title: [Zul Logoth Cartage]
description: Hung in even rows along the smooth grey stone walls are numerous charts and maps of Elanthia rendered in vivid inks.  In the corner, some potted miniature toadstools sit upon shelves, casting their soft white luminescence over the entire office.  A thick leather-wrapped tome lies open upon a glaes-topped desk abutting the far wall.

title: [Iznori's Windows]
description: Display windows adorn the metallic walls, offering views of the sea, the stars, or the sky, depending on what painting has been placed behind it.  Between customers, a cheerful dwarven woman lovingly polishes each window pane, admiring her reflection before moving on.

title: [Gabarm's Walls]
description: Unadorned, save for a potted luminescent toadstool and a brass-accented table, the room appears surprisingly spacious.  A massive book lies open on the table, displaying available materials and finishes for walls.

title: [Yashon's Chairs]
description: A variety of benches, chairs, and other seats are simply displayed in rows in this small shop.  Hanging above a stone counter is a painting of an old dwarven woman sitting upon a rocking chair.

title: [Headmaster's Office]
description: A plush rug lies before a deeply varnished desk, a welcoming sign with its warm, earthy tones.  Standing in the corner, a tall luminescent toadstool has been fringed with strands of brass beads around its cap.  A stout ametrine-inlaid cabinet complete with an impressive metal padlock on its doors neighbors the massive glowing fungus.  Hanging behind a high-backed chair is an invar-framed oil painting.

title: [Jail, Passage]
description: Highly polished stone walls and floor reflect the dim torchlight here, making it seem more than it is.  Painted iron doors studded with gems indicate the entrances into two more prisoner cells.  A set of low steps leads up toward the exit of the prison, while some steep stairs lead lower into darkness.

title: [Jail, Passageway]
description: The passageway ends at three extravagant-looking doors.  In the north wall, a gilded crimson door bears a plaque that reads, "Warden's Office," while to the east is a heavy silver door and to the west a heavy golden door.  The latter two doors are obviously cell entrances, evidenced by the heavy locks securing them from the outside.  Some steep stairs lead up to the higher parts of the prison and eventually to the exit.

title: [Jail, Office]
description: Set deep into the back of the mine, the office of the Warden is marked by a large portrait of himself and polished gems set deep into the walls of the room.  A long oak desk is covered with various papers, and tall quills are placed carefully in the holders.  To the right of the desk, a large keg of ale is within reach of the warden, while a huge mug sits on top of the desk.

title: [Zul Logoth, Iron Walkway]
description: Flanked by thick columns of polished, black iron is a slightly raised walkway that leads to the end of the cavern.  The natural rock has been smoothed away, leaving behind a flat surface upon which a heavily detailed bas-relief has been carved.  A pair of immense, double doors wrought of pure white marble accented in mithril have been set deeply into the wall, surrounded by the ornate etchings.  Standing guard beside the entrance to the Zul Logoth Warrior Guild is a large, armored dwarf.

title: [Zul Logoth, Winding Tunnels]
description: Tunnels branch off in every direction.  Tiny, white-flecked fungi grow in clusters along the rocky floor.  Heavy footsteps echo from somewhere deeper in the underground network.

Several small puddles reflect the light of the resident phosphorescent moss.  Water occasionally drops from the ceiling, landing with an audible *plop*.  The air is slightly stagnant throughout the area.
Part of the wall has been chipped away at, an apparent attempt at creating yet another tunnel.  Slender stalactites hang low, covered with glowing, mottled green-blue moss.

A faint scent of salt clings to the air, a result of the natural deposits in the rock and dripping water.  Grooves in the floor, obscured by the darkness, create a hazard for those wandering these tunnels.
Diffuse light emanates from the bluish-green moss thriving within the confines of the tunnels.  Roughly scrawled upon the rocky walls are several arrows, each pointing to a different passageway.
Snaking paths have been cleared through the rock, crisscrossing at this juncture.  A faint coat of slime covers several of the rocks here.
Clusters of reddish crystals sparkle among the rocky walls.  Several of the stalagmites have had their tops hewn off, with the rubble strewn across the uneven floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Zul Logoth, Winding Tunnels]
description: Shadows lurk around every turn, with little light to illuminate the correct path.  Only a few patches of glowing moss offer any luminescence to navigate by.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Wizard Guild, North Quadrant]
description: Rising just few inches off the ground is a wide, circular platform surrounded by several short stalagmites.  A series of evenly-spaced curtained archways line the nearby cavern wall, with metallic runes inscribed into the rock around them.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldron Room]
description: Dominating this small chamber is an enormous blackened iron cauldron, occupying nearly half the space available.  Glowing red coals radiate oppressive heat from the pit situated below the cauldron.  A thick, soot grey curtain has been draped across the large hole leading back into the main cavern.

title: [Wizard Guild, South Quadrant]
description: Metallic runes etched into the cavern's rock gleam faintly red in the presence of the hot lava flowing far below.  Occupying a clearing among the stalagmites are a handful of short, glaes-topped stands arranged in a rough circle.  Archways covered with thick, woven curtains are spaced regularly along the wall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Storeroom]
description: A multitude of shelves line the walls here, spanning from floor to ceiling and completely stocked with alchemic ingredients.  Glaes shards have been imbedded into the floor, creating a dazzling pattern beneath the light of a few giant luminescent toadstools.  Draped across the entrance to a short tunnel is a grey-threaded curtain.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: Faint silvery streaks run along the dark walls and ceiling, with a few mottled specks of luminescent green.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A heavy, woven crimson curtain drapes across the archway leading back to the main cavern.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard SW]
description: The footpath continues to cut through the verdant lawn, curving gently from north to southeast.  To the northeast sits a fountain and set of stone benches at the courtyard center.  A tall, spindly poplar lends some sparse shade where you could, if you were so inclined, sit and watch most of what goes on within the Guild walls.

title: [Astrallea's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Stormwild Hall, Reception Room]
description: Overhead, a gem-inlaid crystal dome allows sunlight to stream in and illuminate the room.  Ivory-cushioned armchairs are scattered in conversational groups.  Centered on the polished marble floor is a crimson-bordered ivory rug.  Tall, silver candelabrum rest on each end of the long, carved rosewood buffet table against the north wall.  A strikingly lifelike mural adorns the walls, seamlessly incorporating an elegant marble archway and some sliding maoral doors into the scene.

title: [Stormwild Hall, Grand Ballroom]
description: Gilded rosewood-framed mirrors on the eastern wall reflect a panoramic view of the sunlit garden seen through a line of tall glass doors across the room.  Sparkling crystal chandeliers cast pinpoints of prismatic light at the stylized pattern of crimson and ivory squares of the polished marble floor.  An elaborate marble archway in the south wall faces an enormous marble fireplace across the length of the room.  The archway is flanked by a carved teak bar and a low teak stage.

An elaborate marble archway in the south wall faces an enormous marble fireplace across the length of the room.  The archway is flanked by a carved teak bar and a low teak stage.

title: [Stormwild Hall, Garden]
description: A few pear trees can be seen across a plush expanse of lawn bordered by marble statues.  An arched teak bridge crosses the fish-filled stream that winds though a variety of flowering plants and past a small dock.  Glass oil lamps sit atop ornamental iron poles.  Lovely carved teak benches rest beside each pole.  Some fieldstone steps descend into a rocky outcropping and a carved stone staircase rises to a terrace.  Honeysuckle vines run rampant over the rocks and an octagonal stone cabana house.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: The long rows of bookshelves that line the adjacent halls meet here at the corner of the library.  A few cushioned armchairs are scattered about the area, each paired with a small table.  A pair of deep niches are set into each wall, the tomes and scrolls heaped within them streaked with wan beams of colored light from the arched stained glass windows.  In the corner, a narrow archway leads into a small alcove, while a pair of gilded columns marks an entrance to the central atrium.

title: [Aelfwine's Magic Shoppe]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a plain wooden table are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Maxiel's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a verdant elderberry bush in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest and a large oak table.

title: [Workshops, Nexus]
description: Six narrow sections of wall stretch upward to meet at the center of an expansive vaulted ceiling, each situated between a pair of matching arches and bearing a single spindly silver sconce.  The surface of the ceiling seems to shift subtly, its appearance bearing a striking resemblance to the outdoor sky.  Five arched entries lead away from this nexus, each into a smaller workshop, while the lone granite archway set into the southwestern wall leads out into a stretch of hallway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south, northwest, down

title: [Elliania's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by painted emerald green walls, the shop features a small potted boxwood shrub in the center of its glossy tanik floor.  A snarling war griffin painting hangs under the nightscape ceiling.  Right near the front is a wide faenor-trimmed table and a large oak table.

Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, a snarling war griffin painting hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and a large oak table sit in opposite corners while a small potted boxwood shrub rests on a wide-plank glossy tanik floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Storage]
description: Large wooden cupboards line the walls of the expansive room, some revealing their contents with doors ajar while others remain tightly shut, the occasional padlock or two securing their contents.  Rows of tall, shelved cases fill the remainder of the room, barely allowing for passage between their overflowing shelves heavily packed with a wide assortment of of objects of various shape and size.  Leading west, a stone archway is visible between a set of cases, while a thick carven oak door is set in the opposite wall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Storage]
description: Shelves upon shelves round the walls of this roughly circular room, each tighly packed to near overflowing with bottles and jars of various size and shape.  The center of the room is filled with an expansive worktable bearing a number of mortar and pestle sets, among other equipment.  A curved archway with a thick carven oak door interrupts the otherwise endless shelving and offers a means of exit.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A large elemental rune is carved above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Alchemical Workshop]
description: An archway gives entry to this room, which is enclosed by expanses of stone blocks.  Instead of windows, sculpted iron sconces perch high on the walls, each tri-limbed fixture shedding a wealth of amber light from a score of tawny-hued candles.  Opposite the entry is a carved ebonwood workbench laden with a variety of alchemic implements, austere in its meticulous arrangement.  An elaborately woven tapestry rug is the only aesthetic relief offered in this otherwise somber chamber.

title: [Maxiel's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Aelfwine's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is an ora-bound large walnut trunk on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Aelfwine's General Store]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Dreadnaught Officers' Lounge]
description: Frosted glaes sconces provide a warm glow throughout the lounge, and a soft scarlet carpet lines the floor from wall to wall.  Slanted across the room's center is a giant upholstered L-shaped couch that faces a black marble bar.  Behind the bar is a large golden plaque.  Polished to a high sheen, an ebonwood piano stands to one side waiting to be played.  Sculpted gargoyles and griffins wind across a black marble fireplace.  Twisted blue steel winds into the shape of a stand near the fireplace.

title: [Wizard Guild, Atrium]
description: Several tables, chairs, and low bookshelves are arranged throughout the atrium, spread across the wide tile floor.  Individual figures sit absorbed in their studies, while small groups of mages hold muted discussions all about the hall.  The atrium walls are speckled with reflected light and stretch high above, interrupted by the open overlooks of the second and third floors, to culminate in an arched glass ceiling.  At each corner of the atrium, a pair of gilded columns lead back to the book-lined halls of the library.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: The long rows of bookshelves that line the adjacent halls meet here at the corner of the library, their contents muffling the soft murmur of voices that hovers on the air.  Colored light streams in through several arched stained glass windows set high in the walls, painting vibrant highlights across the faces of the wizards who gather here.  A pair of gilded columns marks an entrance to the central atrium to the southeast.

Faint beams of tinted light from the arched stained glass windows paint the wizards who gather here even at this hour in muted color.  A pair of gilded columns marks an entrance to the central atrium to the southeast.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: This long stretch of hall bears little more than three rows of towering bookshelves.  A number of staggered breaks in the expanse of book-laden shelves allows one the opportunity to move between rows, and occasionally a half-height bookshelf provides a potential place to rest some tomes.  Small globes of pale golden light hang from the ceiling at regular intervals, casting a soft but even glow throughout the hall.

title: [Meadow]
description: The forest ends at the edge of a tranquil meadow.  Against the dark shadow of the trees, the meadow grass is a sea of gold with wildflowers clustering among thick brambles.  A stream cuts across the sward, its edges bordered by boulders and tall cattails where bends in its course create a marshy terrain.

The forest ends at the edge of a tranquil meadow.  Against the dark shadow of the trees, the meadow grass is a silvery sea in the moonlight.  A stream cuts across the sward, its edges bordered by the black silhouettes of boulders and tall cattails where bends in its course create a marshy terrain.

title: [Deep Forest, Secret Garden]
description: The canopy overhead thins out enough to allow sunlight to play across the forest floor.  In its benevolence grow a host of plants, from tumbles of blackberry vines to flowering lilies and wild roses.  Small woodland violets dot the green with multicolored, jewel-like blossoms, and huge clumps of ferns ring the rampant verdure like hosts welcoming visiting family members.

title: [Library, Alcove]
description: Small clusters of colored orbs clinging to the walls beneath the pale arched windows cast the alcove in soft scarlet and buttery yellow light.  The polished surface of the oak table in the center of the small room gleams with ruddy highlights, and the velvety cushioning of the two armchairs positioned around it shimmers faintly with a golden sheen.  A plush tapestry rug covers the floor with rich reds and earthy browns separated by bright threads of gold.

title: [Library, Alcove]
description: Small clusters of colored orbs clinging to the walls beneath the dark arched windows cast the alcove in soft azure and austere white light.  The polished surface of the mistwood table in the center of the small room gleams with silver highlights, and the velvety cushioning of the two armchairs positioned around it shimmers faintly with a pale blue sheen.  A plush tapestry rug covers the floor with white wisps and deep blue swirls separated by bright platinum threads.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Caear Courtyard]
description: The illuminated domes of Ta'Illistim Keep rise overhead, each one tiled and sparkling with an abundance of mosaic decoration.  Before the keep, the var widens to a half-moon shaped courtyard, which in turn is bordered by the edge of the city green.

The domes of Ta'Illistim Keep rise overhead, each one tiled and sparkling with an abundance of mosaic decoration.  Before the keep, the var widens to a half-moon shaped courtyard, which in turn is bordered by the edge of the city green.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Air]
description: The surrounding walls are completely translucent, allowing one to gaze freely across the landscape that flows to the ends of the horizon and beyond.  Wispy curls of mist continually swirl and eddy about in mid-air, their sinuous forms holding a pale silvery glow within the soft puffs of cloudy air -- its unfettered light never fully revealed as they whoosh back and forth.  A soft melody trickles in further east, the gentle humming sounds rising and falling in pitch.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Fire]
description: The crystalline walls are melted into frozen rivulets in this chamber, and held within them are roaring flames that slither along the walls like sinuous serpents of an endless inferno.  Engulfing the entire chamber and held at bay by a small measure of translucent crystal, the heat from the fire washes across the chamber in hazy waves, blurring and contorting the air about the room.  A set of steps descends down through the center of the room's floor.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Nexus of Elements, Steam]
description: The area is in a constant state of shifting haziness as whorls of stifling hot steam eddy in thick clouds and rise toward the ceiling.  The surrounding walls are slightly curved, allowing droplets of moisture to accumulate upon the wavy patterns incised upon their crystalline surfaces.  At the far end of the chamber is a swirled triple-tined vent, its interior releasing howling bursts of steam every few moments.  Identical steps lead upward into both west and east walls.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Water]
description: Waves of pale cerulean wash over the surroundings, the walls holding currents of water that flow in twisted rivulets, the torrent held back by the translucent crystal.  Sparks of dark luminescence briefly flare to life amid the swirling streams of water, fading in and out of existence like the dark eyes of an aquatic beast.  A faint roaring sound echoes in from the west, and droplets of watery mist dance in the air.  A set of steps descends down through the center of the room's floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, down

title: [Nexus of Elements, Fire]
description: Three massive pillars of flame rise up to the south, their faceted glimaerstone surfaces awash in blazing infernos of differing hues.  Shallow steps ascend toward the pillars, and the walls are swept with sinuous patterns reminiscent of the raging storm of fire that courses all around you, its furious intensity controlled by the surrounding walls of crystal.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Lava]
description: The entirety of the room resembles a blackened heart underscored with veins of pure fire, the cracked and parched stone overhead roiling with the fury of an inferno.  The slick crystalline walls appear to hold the scorching lava at bay, and no heat appears to emanate from its surface.  Upon the far wall, a bubbling fount of magma continually reforms and collapses, white-hot lava spewing from it at random intervals.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Earth]
description: The surrounding walls are tinted a deep black, imparting the illusion of being within the depths of a cavernous chamber.  Faintly seen along the edges of the blackness are crystalline spokes, their deep violet hue barely glimpsed in the hazy gloom.  A pulsating luminescence filters in from the north, and the faint hum of power echoes from the same source.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Nexus of Elements, Earth]
description: The walls of the small chamber curve inward deeply, their surface a teeming mass of dark obelisk-shaped crystals whose tips hold a deep golden sheen.  The far northern wall harbors a group of large crystals, their varied hues shining dimly in the faint light as they hum with deep reverberations of power.  Tracings of energy race along the faceted edges of the crystals, their facets pristine and flawless.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Mud]
description: Thin rivulets of russet-hued earth flow around you, the curvy channels formed from the translucent crystal walls.  A grouping of thin pillars whose interiors roil with dark, bubbling mud are positioned at the far wall, their surfaces incised with flowing patterns contrasted with straight, angular designs.  Faint bubbling noises echo through the room, the percolations rebounding off one another to form a light, airy melody.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Lightning]
description: Complex groupings of pale blue orbs spin through the area swiftly, their soft luminescence banishing the darkness from the room.  Positioned in the middle of the room is a massive pillar of glowing light, its surface continually spawning and absorbing the miniature spirals of glowing orbs that whirl overhead.  Deep hums of power accompany the slow, rhythmic pulsings of the pillar, its surface darkening then flaring to brilliance once again.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Air]
description: A triad of pale orbs hover in mid-air, their interiors awash in a rippling silver glow as they whisk back and forth, conjuring forth an ever-renewing mist which swirls with a life of its own toward the west.  Soft hums echo from each of the orbs' surfaces, each distinct melody flowing into one another to form a haunting melody that hangs over the area like a thick fog.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Water]
description: A massive onrush of flowing water falls from far above, the raging torrent of white-swirled blueness crashing upon a triad of large marble raindrops.  Shimmering waves of mist rise from the base of the waterfall, dancing in and out of the shards of light reflected by the crystalline walls.  The roar of the falls is nearly deafening, and ribbons of cerulean light wash over the glossy floor and ceiling.

title: [Drogur's Guild Pins]
description: Various etching tools line the walls of this small but well-kept stand.  In the very back, an obviously bored clerk stands behind a finely polished modwir counter.  Behind the counter, boxes and boxes of pins are stacked to the ceiling, and various bits of metal can be seen coating the ground.

title: [A Small Leather Pavilion]
description: Several battered wooden crates with the Warrior Guild insignia stencilled on them have been placed in this pavilion.  Warriors mill about examining wares, debating relative merits of weapons, and haggling with clerks over prices.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard SE]
description: This corner of the courtyard offers a quiet spot from which to survey the impressive yard and imposing buildings housing the association of warriors.  Windows here offer a dim view into the interior of the building, where chandeliers hanging from high ceilings illuminate the carved wood paneling inside.  The promenade proceeds along the building's side to the north and leads off southwest to the front gate.  An arm of the cobbled walk also extends northwest, leading to the front steps of the Guild Hall.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: This appealing rest spot sits directly before the steps leading to the Guild Hall door.  A pair of statues watches over the entire courtyard, including the nearby stone benches and bubbling fountain.  The benches invite you to sit and the fountain encourages you to stay.  Several fireflies hover over the fountain, their light reflecting off the clear water below.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Guild Hall, Main Hallway]
description: Massive obsidian columns line this hall and support a ceiling decorated with scenes of classic battles.  The walls are thickly hung with trophies and weapons of war mingled with the preserved remains of many a gruesome creature.  An arabesqued carpet leads you north down the hallway.  The heavy iron door leads back out to the courtyard.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard W]
description: Shadows from the two-story Guild Hall creep across the lawn at this section of the courtyard.  A worn path leads south and east where it connects with the fountain and benches at the courtyard's center.  You are also treated to a reverse image of the expansive stained-glass window of the Halls' auditorium.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard E]
description: Standing in the shadow of the great Guild Hall, you can spy into the eastern ground-floor windows, the closest of which belongs to the Guild Masters' office.  The second floor window has a thick film of dust, appearing neglected.  A converging set of dirt footpaths scar the plush, grassy lawn, leading east to the East Lawn and woodshed, west to the courtyard center and south to other parts of the courtyard.

title: [Warrior Guild, East Lawn]
description: Walking along this path that stretches across the East Lawn, you can smell the poignantly sweet scent wafting from the trellis draped with flower vines.  The trellis obscures the view of the pugilism ring that sits alongside the eastern wall of the Guild Hall.  South of the path sits the woodshed.

title: [Warrior Guild, East Lawn]
description: The paths from the north and west break into a large, well-worn spot in the middle of this expansive part of the East Lawn.  Obviously, this bare patch was created by the many guild denizens who commit their robust daily practice here.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Shed]
description: Beams of moonlight break through the knot-holes and gaps between the rickety boards, creating ghostly presences with the flitting dust motes.  Stacks of raw wood in various stages of processing are arranged as neatly as possible for their uneven shapes.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ringside]
description: Rows of benches line up before the boxing ring, letting a pretty sizable crowd sit comfortably and cheer the combatants as they practice their fisticuffs.  The Eastern Lawn and woodshed can be seen to the south.

title: [Warrior Guild, Pugilism Ring]
description: The shade from the Guild Hall, northern wall and hedge to the south makes this ring an ideal place to be physically active.
