Only during the high noon hours does the ring become entirely saturated in sunlight.  The canvas floor is a bit battle-worn, with old bloodstains splotched here and there.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Shed]
description: A dense mat of sawdust and woodchips carpet the ground, giving your footing a soft cushion to walk upon.  Pleasant, woodland scents fill your nose and gives the shed an industrious air.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Shed]
description: This section of the shed is darker than the rest.  It seems someone has made an attempt to patch the numerous holes with tar and and shingles, making a waterproof area.  Most of the chopped wood is stacked here in cords.

title: [Guild Hall, Main Hallway]
description: The long hallway stretches south toward the hall's entrance and north, elbowing to the east.  The obsidian columns that line the west wall skip a space where the double doors lead into the Guild Auditorium.

title: [Guild Hall, Auditorium]
description: This room serves as a meeting place for when the entire membership is addressed.  The ceiling arches above you to the full two-story height of the Guild Hall, and the dangling candled chandeliers offer sufficient lighting.  Rows of spartan pews stand in neat ranks, with a carpeted aisle between.  At the north end sits a studious podium atop the dais.  A stained glass window depicting the Guild's coat of arms covers the full height of the southern wall and casts a ruddy hue upon the many fixtures.

title: [Guild Hall, Main Hallway E]
description: This part of the hallway is narrower than the main hall, and the regularly spaced columns discontinue.  Massive flagstones of somber colors floor the hallway.  At intervals along the heavy stone walls are ancient suits of armor interspersed with paintings of famous battles along with portraits of mighty Warriors of renown from many nations and times.  A wide staircase leads up, while narrow stone steps lead into the basement.

title: [Guild Hall, Basement]
description: You stand at the bottom of a narrow stairwell, in the dank, musty and dark basement of the Guild Hall.  A doorway leads west, though the door itself seems to have been removed from its hinges.

title: [Guild Hall, Second Floor]
description: A cast-iron chandelier sways slightly above you; two of the five candles are missing and the other three are wickless, disfigured globs of melted wax.  Swathes of cobwebs cover the chandelier, spotted here and there with dried insect carcasses.  A set of stairs lead to the floor below.

title: [Guild Hall, Masters' Office]
description: You walk on thickly padded carpet in this finely decorated, spacious room.  A jade marble lion guards near the door, and similar lion statues pose as endtables amongst the other furniture.  A couple of thrak hide couches and equally opulent armchairs are arranged in functional stances.  A trio of desks and a hefty conference table are the only indications that this place is more office than lounge.  Spanning the south wall is a window comprised of diamond-shaped sections of leaded glass.

title: [Guild Hall, Dark Chamber]
description: The walls in this dark and gloomy room are painted black.  A dim light flickers from a tank full of squirming, serpentine bodies in one corner.  Against one wall is a set of shelves acting as an apothecary: several bottles of various shapes and sizes are lined up neatly there.  Sawdust is scattered on the floor, forming a thick carpet.  Something smells odd here.

title: [Guild Hall, Workshop]
description: Splotches of dye, melted metal and remnants from sheath patterns sully this otherwise pristine and expansive work area.  A raggedy straw broom stands in the corner next to a dustbin, an old rag draped over its handle, ready for any further spills.

title: [Guild Hall, Basement]
description: In this dank and musty room sits a row of tubs filled with ice and a large, vault-like metal door.  A rivulet of water is leaking from the room behind the door, trickling down the drain in the center of the room.

title: [Guild Hall, Cold Storage]
description: Huge blocks of ice are stacked in the southeastern corner of the room, forming a corridor that leads west, then south from here.  Several fragments of chipped ice are underfoot, making your way somewhat slippery.  Several pairs of ice hooks hang from nails along the wall to aid in moving the blocks of ice.  A large, vault-like door leads back to the Guild Hall basement.

title: [Guild Hall, Cold Storage]
description: Huge blocks of ice are stacked in the southeastern corner of the room, forming a corridor that runs east and south from here.  Several pairs of ice hooks hang on nails along the wall to aid in moving the blocks of ice.

title: [Guild Hall, Cold Storage]
description: Huge blocks of ice are stacked in the southeastern corner of this large room, forming a corridor that leads north then east from here.  Several ice hooks hang on hooks along the wall to aid in moving the blocks of ice.

title: [A Small Leather Pavilion, Back]
description: More crates and boxes are stacked high back here. A few warriors sit or lean on the boxes, waiting patiently, sharpening weapons, polishing armor, or just talking amongst themselves.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entrance Hall]
description: Streaks of sunlight from the narrow slits in the heavy, whitewashed stone walls provide the only light in this cool, darkened hall.  Dust motes dance in the gleam where the slivers of light strike the polished, well-worn stone floor of the hall which extends east and west from the entry.

Streaks of moonlight from the narrow slits in the heavy, whitewashed stone walls provide the only light in this cool, darkened hall.  Slivers of dim light strike the polished, well-worn stone floor of the hall which extends east and west from the entry.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: Only the heavy limestone walls of this spacious chamber seem to match the simple, unadorned halls outside the door.  A warm glow emanates from ornate lamps set in the corners, their fragrant oils filling the room with a subtle scent of exotic spices.  Thick layers of carpets woven in geometric patterns cover the floor, which bears no furniture but for piles of cushions upholstered in rich satins and silks, and flowing silk curtains striped in red, blue, and gold cover one wall.

title: [Warrior Guild, South Hall]
description: The series of vertical slits in the thick stone wall emit beams of sunlight, transforming the hall into an alternating pattern of dark and light.  Ancient weapons and crests hang along the inner stone wall, their polished surfaces reflecting glimmers of light.

The series of vertical slits in the thick stone wall emit beams of moonlight, transforming the hall into an alternating pattern of dark and light.  Ancient weapons and crests hang along the inner stone wall, their polished surfaces reflecting glimmers of light.

title: [Warrior Guild, SW Corner]
description: Steep stairs have been hewn out of the rough limestone walls, leading up to an open hatchway in the ceiling.  Sunlight streams in, illuminating the staircase dramatically and casting angular shadows on the smooth stone floor.

title: [Warrior Guild Roof, SW Corner]
description: A grand view of Liabo Plaza unfolds before you.  The long string of temples flow to the east as worshippers and pilgrims make their way among the massive tributes to the gods.  Further off in the distance you can see Baron's Bridge crossing Vornavis Canal leaving access to South Market.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, down

title: [Warrior Guild, South Hall]
description: The series of vertical slits in the thick stone wall emits beams of sunlight, transforming the hall into a pattern of dark and light -- as well as providing access for defense against any invaders.  Ancient weapons and crests hang along the inner stone wall, their polished surfaces reflecting glimmers of light.

The series of vertical slits in the thick stone wall emits beams of moonlight, transforming the hall into a pattern of dark and light -- as well as providing access for defense against any invaders.  Ancient weapons and crests hang along the inner stone wall, their polished surfaces reflecting glimmers of light.

title: [Wizard Guild, Twisting Passage]
description: Flickering sconces set high atop rough outcroppings along the tortuous corridor light your way, but poorly.  Though the cavern twists and doubles back on itself, the floor slopes perceptibly to the north, leading deeper below the ground.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Wet Cave]
description: The crack leading into this cave is narrow and pointed at the bottom, but it widens toward the top to allow the entrance of even the largest of beasts.  A cold, black rivulet cuts a deep channel across the cave floor and tumbles out onto the trail outside.  Tree branches and a collection of other odds and ends, both from nature and civilization, have been woven clumsily into a huge nest that straddles the brackish water.

title: [Warrior Guild, SE Corner]
description: The hall turns at aright angle, becoming darker to the north, following the corners of the sturdy limestone fortress.  A sheet of sunlight streaks in through a slit set high in the wall, illuminating the narrow stone staircase that leads up along the wall to the second floor.

The hall turns at a right angle, becoming darker to the north, following the corners of the sturdy limestone fortress.  A sheet of moonlight streaks in through a slit set high in the wall, dimly illuminating the narrow stone staircase that leads up along the wall to the second floor.

title: [Warrior Guild Roof, SE Corner]
description: The town hall stands proudly to the southeast, her mighty door sheltering politicians and official clerks of the city.  Beyond that the town jail holds some of the worst trash in all the realms.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, down

title: [Warrior Guild, East Hall]
description: The hallway is dark and cool here, illuminated only by a faint glow from the wide wooden archway set into the inner wall.  Pleasant smells of cooking fires and slow-roasted meats meld with the faint scent of sea air and polished stone.

title: [Warrior Guild, Mess Hall]
description: This large room is filled with long wooden tables and benches.  The high stone walls are stained dark by the appetizing smoke from the cooking fires tended by the white-smocked apprentices who work behind the huge wooden counter at the far end of the room.  Cooks hurry in and out of a heavy steel door in the far wall, bearing armfuls of frozen meats and preserved foods.

title: [Cold Storage]
description: Huge blocks of ice are stacked in the southeastern corner of this large room, forming a corridor that leads north then east from here.  Several ice hooks hang on hooks along the wall to aid in moving the blocks of ice.

title: [Warrior Guild Roof]
description: The central expanse of the roof opens to a large and well-maintained training courtyard.  Fine grit covers the worn limestone flooring providing adequate traction for exercising.  A short hedge encircles the out perimeter here, masking the outer walkways from the central fountain.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Warrior Guild Roof, NW Corner]
description: The hustle and bustle of north market mills below you.  Merchants cry their wares, as travelers from all reaches of the lands examine the merchandise.  Further in the distance you can see Market Bridge spanning Solhaven Bay to Marshtown.

title: [Warrior Guild Roof, West Side]
description: Shops and houses are scattered along the busy lanes to the west, opening out onto Solhaven Bay.  The breathtaking view of the water brings a small shred of tranquility to the otherwise bustling town.

title: [Warrior Guild Roof, South Side]
description: Below you stands the massive portcullis guarding the entrance to the warrior guild.  Vornavis Canal stretches from east to west, as the East Bridge provides the gateway to the southern most parts of town.

title: [Warrior Guild Roof, East Side]
description: The roughly cut stone walls provide shelter from the city streets below.  Yet leaning over you can still see the daily mayhem which goes on in even the quietest neighborhoods.  The grunt and strain of trainees and their masters can be heard over the length of the roof and mixes with the crowds below.

title: [Warrior Guild Roof, NE Corner]
description: Here you have a clear view of North Gate, as people scurry in and out in the distance.  Cairnfang River pours her mighty load over the Cascade of Tears emptying into Solhaven Bay.  Breathing in the view you find the light scent of flowers drifting up from the gardens below.

title: [Warrior Guild Roof, North Side]
description: Wandering down the north side of the roof you can see the roof to the Solhaven Inn.  Cheers of merriment echo from inside as the air carries scents of smoked meats to your nostrils.  The short trimmed hedge opens to the south to the main roof courtyard.

title: [Warrior Guild, East Hall]
description: Only a scattering of light reaches the cool stone from the shaded street outside.  A longbow and a sheaf of arrows stand ready in a niche next to the slit in the stone wall.
Only a scattering of moonlight reaches the cool stone from the street outside.  A longbow and a sheaf of arrows stand ready in a niche next to the slit in the stone wall.

title: [Warrior Guild, East Hall]
description: Sounds of grunts, cheers, and the occasional loud thump emanate from beyond the wide stone arch set into the inner wall.  The vertical slit in the cool stone wall looks out on the street through a gap in the green hedges outside, affording a glimpse of clear sky.

Sounds of grunts, cheers, and the occasional loud thump emanate from beyond the wide stone arch set into the inner wall.  The vertical slit in the cool stone wall looks out on the street through a gap in the green hedges outside, affording a glimpse of twinkling stars in the night sky.

title: [Warrior Guild, Gymnasium]
description: The well-equipped gymnasium carries the salty taste of sweat to your nose.  Long lifting benches line one wall, while tumbling mats are neatly stacked in the far corner.  Large lifting stones, as well as more sophisticated contraptions of stamina seem to be well worn and crafted.  A large pugilism ring for combatants to test their agility and strength dominates the center of the room.

title: [Warrior Guild, Pugilism Ring]
description: Light from an unseen source above casts harsh shadows of the occupants of the ring on the battle-worn canvas floor.  Old bloodstains and other unidentifiable marks splotch the canvas here and there.

title: [Warrior Guild, NE Corner]
description: A chill draft sweeps in from the dark stairwell that leads down into the stone floor at the intersection of the walls.  Precious little light reaches this corner of the hall, and the air is cool and slightly damp.  An ancient rolaren shield, its surface etched with the visage of some helmed warrior of ages past, is mounted on the inner wall.

title: [Warrior Guild Basement]
description: Steep stairs have been hewn out of the rough stone walls, and lead up out of the basement.  Pitch-covered torches are set in sconces along the wall, providing light.  An unusual wet cracking sound can be heard faintly coming from the south.

title: [Warrior Guild, North Hall]
description: The hall is dark and quiet here, the silence broken by the echoes of the footfalls of patrolling guards.  The inner stone wall bears a large tapestry, its ancient threads illuminated by a pair of dimly-burning oil lamps on either side.

title: [Warrior Guild, North Hall]
description: A pair of large, ornate double doors, carved of fine mahogany in an elaborate geometric pattern, dominate the inner wall.  A pair of fine brass urns stand to either side of the doors, and two slits in the stone outer wall provide a limited view of a neatly-kept yard outside.

title: [Warrior Guild, Auditorium]
description: Rows of benches descend in a semicircle leading up to the main stage.  The heavy curtains are currently closed, leaving nothing but a small lectern on stage.  Perhaps this auditorium is used more for lectures and teaching than it is for plays and performances.  As you glance down the isles of seating you notice a thick layer of food substance caked on the floor.

title: [Warrior Guild, Stage]
description: Finely finished oak floors the stage, well worked and buffed by hand.  The  is firmly anchored to the floor.  The heavy curtain is slightly parted giving you a quick glimpse of a row of metal stage doors near the rear.  Offstage to the right you can see another row of wooden stage doors.

title: [Warrior Guild, North Hall]
description: The hard stone walls carry you forward down the hallway.  Dimly lit here, it is difficult to make out any details of the area.  Ahead you see a flickering firelight dancing on the walls, licking strange shadows down the hall.

title: [Warrior Guild, NW Corner]
description: The hallway takes a sharp turn and continues down the wall of the fortress.  A single torch set in the corner provides ample light.  Precariously steep steps have been carved from rough stone leading down to the basement.

title: [Warrior Guild Basement]
description: Steep stairs have been hewn out of the rough stone walls, and lead up out of the basement.  Pitch-covered torches are set in sconces along the wall, providing light.  An odd hissing can be heard from the south, coming at sporadic intervals.  Wet footprints lead up the stairs, and disappear.

title: [Warrior Guild, West Hall]
description: The dark stone walls collect the moisture from the air leaving discolored spots.  A cool draft drifts though the small slit window, revealing a thin view of the courtyard and town outside.

title: [Warrior Guild, West Hall]
description: Long curved grooves scar the floor, leading to the edge of a massive steel door.  The hinges are slightly warped, no longer providing the proper fit needed to allow the door to swing freely.  Two small torches stand proudly on either side, leaving the hall ceiling to slowly blacken with their soot.

title: [Warrior Guild, Workshop]
description: Splotches of dye, melted metal and remnants from sheath patterns sully this otherwise pristine and expansive work area.  A raggedy straw broom stands in the corner next to a dustbin, an old rag draped over its handle, ready for any further spills.

title: [Warrior Guild, West Hall]
description: Darker here, the hallway continues along the exterior wall.  Small bits of sawdust lay about sweeping past in the drafts.  A small scuffle can be heard just through the door on the interior wall, and the faint scent of something odd drifts past your nostrils.

title: [Warrior Guild, Dark Chamber]
description: The walls in this dark and gloomy room are painted black.  A dim light flickers from a tank full of squirming, serpentine bodies in one corner.  Against one wall is a set of shelves acting as an apothecary: several bottles of various shapes and sizes are lined up neatly there.  Sawdust is scattered on the floor, forming a thick carpet.  Something smells odd here.

title: [Warrior Guild Basement]
description: Shelves and racks line the walls, and all sorts of general supplies lie about in boxes, crates, and barrels.  The floor here is freshly-swept.

title: [Warrior Guild Basement]
description: Heat radiates quite noticably from the upright wooden saunas which line the wall, and the hissing of water being poured on very hot rocks comes from them every so often.  The air is damp, and smells of an odd mix of basement, hot steam, and sweat.  Wet footprints in assorted sizes lead north from the saunas.

title: [Warrior Guild Basement]
description: The not-unpleasant scent of slowly rotting wood permeates this corner of the Guild basement.  Piles of rotten boards lie here, slowly mouldering into a wet pulp.  The floor squishes underfoot, covered in damp sawdust and splinters.

title: [Warrior Guild Basement]
description: The rough walls are covered with bits of wood and particles of sawdust in mute testament to the violence perpetuated on lumber here.  A large bin, clearly labeled "Firewood", sits empty against one wall.  Several even larger bins sit against the opposite wall, filled to overflowing with stripped branches, awaiting someone to bash them into usable chunks.

title: [Warrior Guild Basement]
description: A draft comes from somewhere, chilling the air to the point where breath might be seen.  Huge metal tubs, each large enough to easily cover a brawny giantman completely, line the walls.  Each tub is filled almost to the brim with freezing cold water, from which chunks of ice poke up, cracking and shifting as they melt.

title: [Warrior Guild Basement]
description: Stacks and stacks of cheap wooden boxes have been sealed and placed neatly against the rough stone walls to be smashed before discarding.  The floor crunches underfoot with splinters and bits of metal in testament to the hundreds of warriors who have spent hours smashing these discarded boxes to bits.

title: [Cold Storage]
description: Huge blocks of ice are stacked in the southeastern corner of this large room, forming a corridor that leads north then east from here.  Several ice hooks hang on hooks along the wall to aid in moving the blocks of ice.

title: [Teorainn Dale, Old Nest]
description: Although time and weather have ravaged the old nest it's obvious some large bird or small beast went to a great deal of work to weave together this collection of small branches, twigs, and clumps of dried moss.  The bones of some small creature lie scattered among the detritus on the floor of the nest.

title: [Cold Storage]
description: Huge blocks of ice are stacked in the southeastern corner of this large room, forming a corridor that leads north then east from here.  Several ice hooks hang on hooks along the wall to aid in moving the blocks of ice.

title: [Wizard Guild, Gardens]
description: The smooth dome of the guild simply recedes to form a circular wall around a sprawling garden, and the sprawling greenery dark and lush beneath the moonlit sky above.  A series of weathered stones wind between the erratically placed beds of herbs and flowers, their grey surfaces overgrown with lichen and moss.

The smooth dome of the guild simply recedes to form a circular wall around a sprawling garden, leaving the lush greenery open to the sky above.  A series of weathered stones wind between the erratically placed beds of herbs and flowers, their grey surfaces overgrown with lichen and moss.  Mushrooms thrive in the shade of the building, their spotted caps bright against the rich black soil.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard lawns are well kept and beautifully landscaped.  Many varieties of night-blooming flowers are planted in beds bordering the temple walls, and tall cast iron lamposts are placed evenly along the onyx flagstone path to provide light at night.  A high stone wall separates temple grounds from the rest of the town.

The courtyard lawns are well kept and beautifully landscaped.  Many varieties of night-blooming flowers are planted in beds bordering the temple walls, and tall cast iron lampposts are placed evenly along the onyx flagstone path to provide light at night.  A high stone wall separates the temple grounds from the rest of the town.

title: [Wizard Guild, Catwalk]
description: The sturdy stone floor narrows suddenly, becoming not much more than a slender bridge between the library to the west and a massive steel door to the east.  It is unclear whether the chasm is the product of design or nature, but neither option is comfortable to contemplate as you move along the walkway.  Improbably slender railings only seem to emphasize the echoing depths of the abyss beneath you.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: The ever-present cracks in the surrounding dome are much wider here, joined by a scattering of jagged holes and pinprick openings which admit faint moonlight.  On the whole, it looks as if what stands above is held up more by hope than any actual support.  Torches held aloft by stalagmites cast steady light on the racks of alembics and other equipment lining the walls, which are scarred and in places have melted like candle tallow.

The ever-present cracks in the surrounding dome are much wider here, joined by a scattering of jagged holes and pinprick openings which admit bars of sunlight that seem almost solid in the thick atmosphere.  On the whole, it looks as if what stands above is held up more by hope than any actual support.  Torches held aloft by stalagmites cast steady light on the racks of alembics and other equipment lining the walls, which are scarred and in places have melted like candle tallow.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cavern]
description: The twisting corridor splits into two passages, one of which veers suddenly downwards.  A spiralling stair has been carved into the stone to aid the unwary traveler, but each step varies from its cousins in width and height, making for uneasy purchase.  Intaglio carvings adorn the walls, the smoothness of the stone attesting to their use as easy handholds as well as decoration.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Gate]
description: An ornate black gate stands open, welcoming Ronan's followers.  An onyx slab engraved with a large silver-edged black sword is centered on each half of the gate, and onyx flagstones form a path through the courtyard.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Courtyard]
description: Huge trees loom over silver-trimmed ebonwood benches that are placed here and there in pairs, with their thick foliage blocking all but faint slivers of moonlight from touching the ground.  A peaked obsidian arch flanked by two guards gives entrance to the temple itself, and a stone-walled koi pond sits in one corner.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Entrance]
description: Silver-veined black marble floors and polished ebonwood walls give an impression of night, with tiny silver stars affixed to the ceiling to complete the effect.  An intricately worked spidersilk tapestry hangs on one wall, bordered by cast iron candelabra, and a plaque hangs on the other.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Gardens]
description: Climbing roses nearly cover the trellis they twine about, and deep green ivy thickly covers the outside of the temple and surrounding stone wall in this area.  Exotic ferns are mixed in with beautiful deep hued flowers of many varieties.  Here and there, the dark colors of the flowers are broken up with splashes of snowy white iris and snapdragons.  Brightly colored butterflies flit about, adding their charm to the scene.

Climbing roses nearly cover the trellis they twine about, and deep green ivy thickly covers the outside of the temple and surrounding stone wall in this area.  Exotic ferns are mixed in with beautiful, deep-hued flowers of many varieties.  Here and there, the dark colors of the flowers are broken up with splashes of snowy white iris and snapdragons.  Brightly colored butterflies flit about, adding their charm to the scene.

title: [Wizard Guild, Narrow Tunnel]
description: Intaglio carvings cover the walls of the narrow stone tunnel, which rises upward toward a bright opening to the east.  Steps barely visible to the eye are hewn into the floor of the tunnel, offering some purchase for those wishing to pass through its dark length.  The air is disturbed by a faint breeze flowing westward back toward the caverns.

title: [Wizard Guild, Auditorium]
description: A breathtaking artificial sky covers the domed ceiling of the hemispherical cavern, its wispy white clouds painted onto the cerulean-hued enamel with consummate skill.  The rough-hewn walls are a dramatic contrast to the delicacy of the celestial mural, a solid reminder that the chamber is deeply rooted in stone.  Arcs of granite benches surround a central platform with an ironwood lectern set atop it.

title: [Wizard Guild, Narrow Passage]
description: A baleful red light along the wall emanates from the vivid mural of Krolvin ships, their sails aflame and brilliant in the gloom.  You catch the faint scent of mineral salts beneath the sharper odor of something burning.

title: [Wizard Guild, Bath]
description: The rippling surface of the large central bath casts back the warm radiance of three glowing orbs high above, the colors of the ornately tiled walls dazzling in the bright light.  Low benches along the walls bear fat white silk cushions and an assortment of towels.  A smaller basin near the entrance holds cool water to refresh bathers as they leave the warmth of the main pool.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Wizard Guild, Nexus]
description: Bright sunlight streams into the stone room through a partially collapsed vaulted dome ceiling, the rubble of which lies piled against the north wall of the room.  Along the edges of the ceiling hang vines and tree roots, noting the encroachment of a jungle, whose leafy green treetops are visible through the breached roof.  A small water fountain lies dormant in the center of the room, surrounded by small stone benches.  The shrieks of birds and the occasional trollish roar filter in from the outside.

Moonlight streams into the stone room through a partially collapsed vaulted dome ceiling, the rubble of which lies piled against the north wall of the room.  Along the edges of the ceiling hang vines and tree roots, noting the encroachment of a jungle, whose dark treetops are visible through the breached roof.  A small water fountain sits dormant in the center of the room, surrounded by small stone benches.  The shrieks of unseen birds and the occasional roar of a troll filter in from outside.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west, down

title: [Wizard Guild, Storage]
description: A sturdy stone stairway provides access into the circular storage room of equal dimensions to the floor above it.  Dust is everywhere, and illumination comes from several torches flickering weakly along the walls.  Periodically, the light of the flames is reflected off the eyes of small animals in the shadows.

title: [Wizard Guild, Acid Workshop]
description: The stone room is absent of any sign of the devouring jungle.  The only sign of disrepair is a sizeable hole in the ceiling and the associated rubble on the floor beneath it.  Illuminated by the moonlight entering through the celing are the floor stones, revealing multiple random discolorations and a workbench of matching appearance.  Empty glass jars and beakers line several wood shelves along the walls.

title: [Wizard Guild, Earth Workshop]
description: A small star-shaped window high on one wall offers the only evidence that the room is above ground.  Long brown feathery roots dangle from the ceiling and pry apart the stone walls through available cracks.  A large crack is located in the center of one wall.  Placed in the center of the room is a workbench covered in a light dusting of dirt from periodic sprinkles of earth from the ceiling.

title: [Wizard Guild, Water Workshop]
description: Three large stone windows make up the expanse of the southern wall, and through them the hot humid air of the jungle outside flows in.  Moss covers much of the surface area, dotted with small white flowers, and fed by a small pool of water created by a constant dripping from a crack in the wall.  Only the floor space leading up to and around a workbench remains uncovered.

title: [Wizard Guild, Fire Workshop]
description: The light in the room is provided by three torches set into rusted iron sconces mounted on the stone walls, though stars twinkle through and moonlight enters from a sizeable hole in the ceiling.  A single window, its glass long absent, provides the entry for a waterfall of brown and green vines that crawl across the floor to the base of a workbench.  Randomly located throughout the room are black singe marks accompanied by the faint smell of ash.

title: [Wizard Guild, Air Workshop]
description: The majority of the ceiling in the room lies in pieces alongside its walls.  As a result, the room is flooded with moonlight and a great sense of openess.  The only shadow is found by a workbench, provided by the star-silhouetted leaves of trees outside in the encroaching jungle.  Several abandoned bird nests line the walls of the room, attesting to previous occupants.

title: [Wizard Guild, Store Room]
description: Thick wood timbers support the walls of the round circular chamber and are each decorated with a brightly burning torch in a sconce.  Multiple shelves line the walls, bowing underneath the weight of dozens of jars and containers.  A polished slate table sits in the center of the room laden with several stone mortars.

title: [Long River Table]
description: Near the center of the dining hall, you find this table leaning slightly due to a loose board in the floor.  A sign hangs on the wall near the rather large table closest to you.

title: [Bent Creek Table]
description: Well known for its size, this round table is worn from the many gatherings of large crowds of customers wanting to enjoy each others company during their feasts.  Placed on the wall is a small sign bound in a leather frame.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Walkway]
description: Tall marble pillars stand along the west side of the hallway, along a small open area that forms the center of the temple.  There is no obvious access to the open area, but you can see that it is tiled with crystal squares alternating with silver ones, and an elaborate onyx bench sits in the center, as though for a privileged someone to sit and stargaze in the evenings.

title: [Wide River Table]
description: Placed near the southern end of the room, this table sits in a quiet corner near the kitchen door.  The height of the table has been lowered for the benefit of some of the smaller customers.

title: [Running Creek Table]
description: Sitting close to the entrance of the room, this wooden table is covered with a soft white cloth, set with fresh picked flowers in the center.  Unlike the others in the room, these chairs are made with padded leather cushions.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Room of Drakes]
description: Magnificent murals of the great drakes are on every wall and the ceiling.  The murals are so vivid they appear to follow all movement with their eyes.  Thick red carpet covers the floor, and a single ebonwood table sits against one wall.

title: [Clear River Table]
description: Placed closer to the wall than the others, this table is in one of the quieter spots of the room.  A large fern hangs from the rafters above the table while several others cover the ledge of a nearby window.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Library]
description: Brightly lit by the hundreds of candles that line the rafters, the small room is tidy and lined from floor to ceiling with shelves.  Each shelf holds a variety of items used for scrying, as well as several tomes of lore.  A simple desk is set in the center of the room and has a plush chair set behind it.  A quaint white oak door stands slightly ajar and leads to the Lore Circle, while a dark pine door leads to a small clearing at the back of the cottage.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Barracks]
description: Large and square, the room has durable walls built of oak and fitted with small glass windows.  High above, through a series of rafters, the ceiling of sailcloth is bound tightly to the walls and muffles all outside sounds.  Cubicles marked by small divider screens line the walls and are fitted with rush-filled box beds, footlockers, and wardrobes.  Some of the cubicles house comfortable chairs that display individual character, while others are sparse and uninhabited.

title: [Manor House, Attic]
description: Cobwebs fill every corner of this attic, and dust, mold and bat droppings cover the floor.  Several holes in the roof allow moonlight into this part of the attic near the stairway leading up from the manor's second floor.

Cobwebs fill every corner of this attic, and dust, mold and bat droppings cover the floor.  Several holes in the roof allow sunlight into this part of the attic near the stairway leading up from the manor's second floor.

title: [Manor House, Attic]
description: The attic extends north beneath the peak of the manor house's roof.  Within the shadows lie broken furniture, empty sacks and scattered pieces of dust-covered clothing.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Kitchen]
description: Your nostrils catch the smell of fresh baked bread and cakes as soon as you enter.  The counters are loaded with pots and pans of all size while the southern counter contains a variety of cool drinks.

title: [Sleepy River Table]
description: Almost out of view from the others, this table is placed on the most northern side of the room.  The chairs and table here are some of the largest you have seen in the lands.

title: [Crispy Tart Table]
description: This rather plump table is bordered by a folded crust pattern carved into the wood.  Small strawberry shaped chairs surround the table in a circle.

title: [Frozen Tart Table]
description: A window high overhead seems to be stuck open a bit, letting a chilly breeze descend over the booth.  A single, red rose sits frozen inside a small bud vase in the center of the table.

title: [Mushy Tart Table]
description: This round table has seen better days, as it's sagging deeply in the center.  You make out what seem to be very faint tooth marks on one side of the table where something has obviously tried to take a bite.

title: [Glazed Tart Table]
description: It is obvious that this long, wooden table has seen quite a few tarts in its time, judging from the thick glaze of frosting covering its top.  Etched into the glaze on the table are the barely legible words, "Kai ate here."

title: [Blueberry Tart Table]
description: This bright blue table is painted up to appear as a giant blueberry tart.  It seems to be calling to you to take a bite.

title: [Burrowing Owl Table]
description: The tabletop is formed of a smooth driftwood, marked by sand-worn grooves and wormholes along the edges.  The edges of the table are smooth and thick, inviting you to absently rub it, furthering its gently polished gleam.

title: [Horned Owl Table]
description: A long, intricately carved horn is the centerpiece of this table.  The horn rests on a small black lacquered pedestal.  The chairbacks are decorated with small panels of ivory carved to represent different flowers.

title: [Winking Owl Table]
description: The table is lit by a pair of candles, placed in cylinders of hammered tin.  Each cylinder has the outline of an owl punched into the tin with an awl.  As the candle flickers, the patterns twinkle and wink at you.

title: [Fat Thrak Table]
description: The lamp on the wall behind you casts your shadow onto the rough wood surface of the table.  A bit of washcloth is stuck to a large splinter sticking straight out from the table's edge, promising a nasty cut should you accidentally lean into it.  The fading thrak on the surface of the table is so fat, the image can be seen on either side of your shadow.

title: [Kittens and Thraks Table]
description: Under the table, a rough wood box holds a mother cat and her three kittens safely out of the way of the patrons.  To accomodate the box, the chairs have been pushed a bit farther back from the table than usual.  Nearly invisible among the usual jumble of chicken bones and bread crusts on the floor is a bowl of milk.

title: [Galloping Thrak Table]
description: The wall behind the table is cluttered with memorabilia from past Pennant Chase events.  A high-backed chair resembling a throne has a variety of initials carved into it, with some of the initials viciously crossed out with deep, chiselling slashes.  A painting of thraks running diagonally across the table top catches your eye.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entry Courtyard]
description: A small, crystalline pool edged with profuse ferns and seasonal wildflowers offers a spot of serenity in the otherwise busy entrance to the guild proper.  Impressive in size and architectural detail, the fortress looms just ahead, while the manicured courtyard and outdoor areas beyond rest placidly in its grand shadow.  A slate walkway and well-defined paths meander further into the grounds.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Crate parts, cart wheels, and odd tools litter the floor.  While not the finest of materials, they could certainly come in handy for emergency repairs while shipping contraband.  It would perhaps be best not to dwell on the reasoning behind the extra chains and shackles stored amid the grain sacks and other strange bits.

title: [Guild Master Haurce's Office]
description: Woody vines twist and turn along the redwood walls of Guild Master Haurce's office, forming shelves and benches as if commanded into those shapes by unknown magic.  Windows placed in three of the walls allow moonlight to filter liberally into the room, while torches blaze in the corners to supplement the light.  A small desk constructed from rough-hewn sheets of burl oak rests against one wall with a wooden stool sitting next to it.  Many footprints are visible on the dirt floor.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Quiet Bluff]
description: Stout cedar poles support grassy thatching to shade this bluff.  A short cedar fence wraps around three sides of the bluff, keeping the unwary or perhaps the inebriated from falling to the rocks below.  Maelstrom Bay stretches out to the west, and the thick dark forest confronts the Bay's waters to the north and south.  Reclining chairs are strewn haphazardly about the bluff, and a small table accompanies each chair.  A windowless redwood building sits nearby, and a steep ramp ascends to the northeast.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: This well constructed redwood platform rises over one hundred feet into the air, considerably higher than most of the surrounding forest.  The platform has been painted black to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off reflected light from below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  The soft breeze causes the platform to sway somewhat.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tub Room]
description: Condensation drips from the ceiling beams and runs down the redwood walls to disappear into a drain in the far corner, leaving the floor slick with moisture.  A spacious tub has been dropped into a hole in the redwood floor, and hot seawater swirls and foams within.  A metal vat is securely bolted against the wall with a pipe and a chain hanging down just above the tub.  Wide steps lead into the tub's churning waters.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Hot Tub]
description: You step down into the hot, swirling seawater, its warmth gently massaging your muscles and relaxing your mind and body.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Guild Shop]
description: A huge banyan tree has been encouraged to grow to provide the ceiling and walls that enclose the well-lit shop.  Sunlight streams in through the gaps left between many of the trunks, each fitted with a sinuous piece of glass that blocks inclement weather.  Thick, mossy turf provides a cool green carpet under your feet, broken by two small clusters of stiff and fibrous vines.  One is grown into a humanoid shape and serves as a mannequin while the other has become a flat-topped pedestal.

A huge banyan tree has been made to provide the ceiling and walls that enclose the well-lit shop.  Moonlight streams in through the gaps left between many of the trunks, each fitted with a sinuous piece of glass that blocks inclement weather.  Thick, mossy turf provides a cool green carpet under your feet, broken by two small clusters of stiff and fibrous vines.  One is grown into a humanoid shape and serves as a mannequin while the other has become a flat-topped pedestal.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Arcane Studies]
description: Opaque mist forms the basis of this rotund chamber.  It has no physical walls nor any structure that lends it solid form.  Passageways created by the parting of mist open and close within a moment's notice at the beckoning of the Arcane Masters who buzz around the chamber at an almost frenzied pace attending to their tasks.  The world away from this room is completely obscured, and your existence is likely obscured from the world, with the exception of an opening in the mist directly in front of a rune-carved door.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Magic Workroom]
description: Torches mounted on brass poles hazily illuminate this testing room.  The walls, ceiling and floor are made from planks of sanded birch, but the wet floor planks are spread half an inch apart, perhaps to let something pass between them.  Several small cages line the west wall, a large cage sits next to the east wall, and an open cage resides against the north wall.  The odor of drenched wood somewhat masks the lesser stench of animal ordure.

title: [Cleric Guild, Landing]
description: Walls made of polished and lacquered wood gleam a rich golden brown in the lantern light.  Whorls and swirls of darker grains weave through the whole, joining shadows and sun in an intricate dance.  In the center of the room stand two statues, one male and one female, backs turned but still looking over their shoulders, each watching the other.  They stand upon a wooden base with words carved into the surface.  The soft, rich scent of incense drifts through the air, tickling at the nose.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [The Blue Lobster, Wine Bar]
description: A dim light glows off refined oak-paneled walls, giving the winery a cozy feel.  Footsteps echo upon a varnished dark oak floor, at the center of which stands a glaes-topped dark mistwood bar.  Soft watery motes of light emanate from an ultramarine blue glaes aquarium, which offsets a gold-whorled waterfall wine rack.  A driftwood and aspen framed painting has been hung between the east and west corridors, which are blanketed by a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling embroidered with soft grey vines.

title: [Shannivar's Outfitting]
[Shannivar's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a domed white stucco ceiling, a midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  Some wrought-iron hooks and a series of low oak shelves sit in opposite corners while a thin gold-edge black runner rests on a white limestone floor.

Beneath a domed white stucco ceiling, a snowy forest glade tapestry hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  Some wrought-iron hooks and a series of low oak shelves sit in opposite corners while a thin gold-edge black runner rests on a white limestone floor.

title: [Spenster's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a heavy lead glass display case on one side of the shop.

title: [Orainissa's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Illistim Warrior Guild, Foyer]
description: A grand, double staircase leads up to the administrative offices of the Warrior Guild of Ta'Illistim.  Mica-flecked blue granite floors lead to fine, maoral-paneled walls, each bedecked with a suit of armor.  To the east, the guild's distinctive task offices are plainly visible through a wide marble arch and easily accesible to all guild members.

title: [Warrior Guild, Task Offices]
description: Starkly furnished, these offices serve as the center of task disbursement by the lauded taskmasters.  Fully open, square windows provide sufficient illumination to filter in during the daytime hours.

Starkly furnished, these offices serve as the center of task disbursement by the lauded taskmasters.  Fully open, square windows provide sufficient illumination as muted moonlight filters in after dark.

title: [Shannivar's Outfitting]
description: A painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls, and a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of striped throw pillows sits in one corner of a white limestone floor.  There is a series of low oak shelves on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Shannivar's Magic Shoppe]
description: A painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls, and a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling rises overhead.  Some puffed raw silk pillows sits in one corner of a white limestone floor.  There is a white marble shelf on one side of the shop.

title: [Extus' Outfitting]
description: A multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs on one of the stark stone block walls, and a dark and light oak ceiling rises overhead.  A series of thinly woven rugs sits in one corner of an ash grey granite floor.  There is a heavy white granite counter on one side of the shop and a set of carved felwood shelves on the other.

title: [Cymantha's General Store]
[Cymantha's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by rough white stucco walls, the shop features a bronze peg-legged cat statue in the center of its dark oak floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the white stucco ceiling.  Right near the front is a beveled glass-covered case and a slender driftwood counter.

title: [Warrior Guild, Second Floor]
description: The carpeted staircase with its impressive marble balustrade leads up to an ample hallway, its ornate gilded lamps and ceiling rosettes completing a grand initial view of the upper floor.

title: [Extus' General Store]
description: A multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs on one of the stark stone block walls, and a dark and light oak ceiling rises overhead.  A series of thinly woven rugs sits in one corner of an ash grey granite floor.  There is a cedar and oak footlocker on one side of the shop and some wrought-iron hooks on the other.

title: [Extus' Outfitting]
description: A multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs on one of the stark stone block walls, and a dark and light oak ceiling rises overhead.  A series of thinly woven rugs sits in one corner of an ash grey granite floor.  There is a heavy lead glass display case on one side of the shop and a set of carved felwood shelves on the other.

title: [Warrior Guild, Open Courtyard]
description: This part of the courtyard affords another angle from which to survey the impressive surroundings.  Slate-framed windows here permit a slight view into the interior of the grey stone structure, where ornate lamps hanging from vaulted ceilings illuminate the spacious insides.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Cymantha's General Store]
[Cymantha's Magic Shoppe]
[Cymantha's Outfitting]
description: Rough white stucco walls rise from a varnished dark oak floor.  Just above a plush black bear fur rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling completes the picture.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Cymantha's General Store]
[Cymantha's Weaponry]
description: The broad sweep of the dark oak floor is interrupted by a well-armed stocky warrior statue.  Halfway to the white stucco ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the rough white stucco walls.  A plank-covered barrel table and a plain wooden table are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Warrior Guild, Master Courtyard]
description: A verdant, neatly maintained area of the courtyard is a testament to continuous and dedicated upkeep.  A couple of carved stone benches with polished marble inlay offer a temporary respite from the arduous training atmopshere palpable throughout the guild grounds.

The verdant, neatly maintained area of the courtyard is even more striking during nighttime as fluttering torches help suffuse light, but also create swaggering shadows all around.  A couple of carved stone benches with polished marble inlay offer a temporary respite from the arduous training atmopshere palpable throughout the guild grounds, even after dark.

title: [Warrior Guild, Training Arena]
description: Upon entering the gates that lead to and from the courtyard, the nexus of the training area is posed to offer all manner of warrior training.  The variety is plainly visible in the rows of apparatus and entrances to separate training courts.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hedge Courtyard]
description: Meticulously trimmed greenery creates thick, verdant walls around the courtyard, their perfectly symmetric sides much like a master artisan's finished work.  Every so often, a guild member yielding gardening tools appears to trim and prune as needed to maintain the living walls in pristine shape.

title: [Demjorian's Weaponry]
[Demjorian's Combat Gear]
[Demjorian's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Warrior Guild, South Courtyard]
description: Cobbled stones of varying hues ranging from beige to tan and even slight russet tones edge the lush lawn, providing a pleasant change from the uniformity in color of nearby courtyard areas.  A budding artist has fashioned a row of sinuous plant sculptures depicting mythical beasts which, like all others in existence within the guild grounds, are carefully tended.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Warrior Guild, Oak Tree]
description: An immense oak tree dominates this area of the courtyard, its massive, all-encompassing branches creating a complex swirl of dappled shadows as sunlight pierces through.  Faintly visible on the burled trunk, a creeping patch of velvety moss appears to be slowly making its way towards the treetop.

An immense oak tree dominates this area of the courtyard, its massive, all-encompassing branches creating a complex swirl of shades as moonlight pierces through.  Faintly visible on the burled trunk, a creeping patch of velvety moss appears to be slowly making its way towards the treetop.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Kemaris' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a domed white stucco ceiling, a cracked ceremonial mask hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table and a white marble shelf sit in opposite corners while a glass-fronted bookcase rests on a black-checked white tile floor.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Shed]
description: The shed is fairly dark, except for the faint light that bursts inside through the gaps between the oaken boards.  A heady smell of decaying wood, coupled with persistently floating sawdust make lingering inside a less than pleasant proposition.  Stacks of raw wood in various stages of processing are arranged in stacks of various heights and organized according to their basic shapes.

Dark, except for the faint moonlight that streaks inside through the gaps between the oaken boards, this structure offers no comfort other than the heady smell of decaying wood.  Stacks of raw wood in various stages of processing are arranged in stacks of various heights and organized according to their shapes.

title: [Karamilla's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls.  Some hammered copper display hooks and a Vornavian silk-covered table sit in opposite corners while a thick off-white carpet rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Cysaegir, Top of Pedestal]
description: The air thickens from this vantage point on the pedestal, where alternating shades of paled purple, pink, and white light reflect from the disk above, struggling against the glare of the golden sun.  Like fingers of a blind man, hazy mist traverses the ground to obscure the form of a woman.  Loud creaking sounds, emanating from the warped rocking chair she rests in, are muted significantly by a droning sound like that of a thousand agitated cinder wasps.

The air thickens from this vantage point on the pedestal, where alternating shades of paled purple, pink, and white light reflect from the disk above, enhancing the pale light of the moon.  Like fingers of a blind man, hazy mist traverses the ground to obscure the form of a woman.  Loud creaking sounds, emanating from the warped rocking chair she rests in, are muted significantly by a droning sound like that of a thousand agitated cinder wasps.

title: [Crayaligus's Weaponry]
[Crayaligus's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A heavy white granite counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Second Floor]
description: On opposite ends of the corridor, covering the windows are wooden shutters carved in lacy patterns that allow a trickle of sunlight into the room.  A gilded mirror hangs above an ebonwood table laden with food and drinks.  Plush flowered carpeting runs the length of the hallway, and colorful, semi-circular doormats occupy the space at the foot of several locked doors.

On opposite ends of the corridor, covering the windows are wooden shutters carved in lacy patterns that allow a trickle of sunlight into the room.  A gilded mirror hangs above an ebonwood table laden with food and drinks.  Plush flowered carpeting runs the length of the hallway, and a colorful, semi-circular doormat occupies the space at the foot of an ebonwood door.

title: [Citizenship Office]
description: Translucent pale blue curtains embroidered with tiny flowers are tied back from the windows, and golden sunlight fills the room.  Reflecting the sun's ray from each corner are brass flowerpots.  A deep blue plush rug woven with images of peacocks rests in front of a desk with elaborately carved and gilded legs.  An oil painting done in vivid colors hangs on the wall behind the desk, providing a colorful backdrop for the clerk sitting there.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Town Clerk]
description: The silver sconces that line the chamber's walls at regular intervals are replicated in a mirror image on the surface of the highly polished black marble floor.  Snow white velvet blackwork curtains are drawn tight, effectively blocking all light from the small egg-shaped window behind them.  Cater-cornered to the ivory inlaid door stands an elaborately carved ebonwood desk set in the center of plush, layered blue carpets.  Stacks of ledgers and parchments are placed neatly atop a footstool near the table.

title: [Warrior Guild, North Courtyard]
description: From this vantage point, the balcony and office windows on the upper floor are visible, hinting at a glimpse of the inside.  A converging set of cobbled paths traverse the verdant lawn, leading south to the guild's own massive oak tree and the woodshed, and branching out towards the workshop and other parts of the grounds.

title: [Kemaris' Outfitting]
description: Beneath a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling, a fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  Some hammered copper display hooks and a Vornavian silk-lined display case sit in opposite corners while a pile of striped throw pillows rests on a white limestone floor.

title: [Kemaris' Weaponry]
[Kemaris' Magic Shoppe]
[Kemaris' General Store]
description: Beneath a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling, a snarling troll king mask hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A brass treasure chest and a cedar and oak footlocker sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Warrior Guild, Side Courtyard]
description: Stout oaken trellises provide much needed support to the silver-backed vines which partially cover the high perimeter walls of the guild.  A square patch of hardened soil bordered by identical slate pieces offers an ideal place to spar or practice other combat skills with fellow warriors.

title: [Warrior Guild, Workshop]
description: Obviously proud of the work done in the premises, the Shop Master has set up a large glass-topped marble case in which samples of exemplary sheath-making are displayed against a contrasting background.  Although far from impeccable, the work area is uncluttered and well-ventilated as the always-open windows allow for any strong odors to quickly find their way to the outside.

title: [Crayaligus' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A heavy white granite counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Reformatory, Office]
description: Specifically aligned, three chairs rest in front of a lightly carved desk.  Arranged side by side on the desktop, miniature portraits of a child and a woman in her middle years are on display in ivory frames.  In the far corner, standing roughly three feet high, a plainly made wooden horse bears the burden of holding a brass-riveted saddle.  Smaller wood sculptures of a wolf, a caribou, and a snow leopard carved in amazing detail surround the horse in a semi-circle.

title: [Reformatory, Tribunal Chamber]
description: Brass sconces flank the doorway and are mounted along the walls at regular intervals providing adequate light in the chamber.  Perched atop a dais three steps high, and polished to a mirror finish, rests a massive ebonwood bench that is lightly carved with vines.  Most of the back wall is comprised of a bookcase crammed with thick, leather-bound tomes pertaining to the law.  A featureless metal door stands almost hidden behind the bookshelf.  Gold runners cover the floor between symmetrically arranged padded chairs.

title: [Crayaligus' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A heavy white granite counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Reformatory, Cell Block]
description: At regular intervals burning torches held in place by chains keep the shadows at bay.  On a peg flanked by a reinforced eahnor door and a reinforced faenor door, hangs a single key that can be used to unbolt each cell in this block.  Located in the middle of each door is a slot large enough to pass a tray of food or other similarly sized item through to the inmate.

title: [Reformatory, Gallery]
description: Metal grating makes up the catwalk that encircles the guard station.  Overlooking the antechamber below, sentries armed with short-bows easily patrol the cellblocks from this strategic vantage point.  From behind thick, clear glass, other guards are plainly visible as they perform various duties, including the oftentimes tedious task of paperwork.  Rectangular slots run the perimeter of the glass.  The niches are just wide enough to allow arrows to be fired from behind the safety of the glass wall.

title: [Reformatory, Cell Block]
description: Streaks of soot from the burning torches blacken the walls and ceiling.  The flickering light from the torches generates a series of dancing shadows along the walls and floor.  On a peg flanked by a reinforced eahnor door and a reinforced faenor door, hangs a single key that can be used to unbolt each cell in this block.  Subdued reverberations of boots on metal and distant murmurs and chuckling from an unknown speaker break the otherwise oppressive mood of the corridor.

title: [Reformatory, Cell Block]
description: Several torches have been allowed to burn out near the end of the corridor.  The light from the remaining ones causes a series of odd shapes and shadows to dance along the walls and ceiling.  Every so often, the flames crackle and burst to twice their size.  Heavy breathing seems to emanate from the darkened corner at the end of the hallway.  On a peg flanked by a reinforced eahnor door and a reinforced faenor door, hangs a single key that can be used to unbolt each cell in this block.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Annex]
description: The sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.  The aromatic fragrances of tuberoses fill the air from where they overflow from within stamped brass flowerpots.  Several of the tall stalks are bent over the side of the pots, as if the clusters they bear are too heavy.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Locker Annex]
description: Only diverse in their coloring, almost perfect specimens of verbena is crammed into embossed brass flowerpots.  In one of the pots, a lone salmon-hued blossom stands out.  The sides of the polished white marble floor are visible beneath the plush, powder blue runner that runs the length of the corridor.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Shed]
description: Sawdust and woodchips litter the floor and seem to have accumulated in odd piles around the less dirturbed corners of the room creating a fragile landscape.  A clearly discernible path made from stepped upon debris makes its way to a huge stack of wooden boxes located on the far wall.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Shed]
description: This part of the structure appears slightly smaller than the previous room and perhaps, even more confining, as the oaken planks that create the makeshift walls have been assembled in thick double rows.  Every bit of precious space is optimally utilized by those who regularly labor here.

title: [Ariebaela's Archery Nook]
description: Located at the back of the shop adjacent to a carved wooden counter, a thick, leather-bound tome rests in the seat of a rocking chair.  Draped across the back of the rocker is a forest green lap blanket made of thick wool.  Fluttering from the open window of the cottage are delicate silk curtains embroidered with crossbows, arrows, and bolts in iridescent thread.  The gentle breeze causes wood shavings to scatter across the floor of the otherwise pristine shop.

title: [Piaere's Boutique]
description: Variegated leaves from the neighboring flora have been affixed and sealed upon the wooden floor in an orderly fashion, like the footsteps of nature.  Artfully arranged in three semi-circles, slender-legged tables and stands present beautifully crafted clothing and accessories.

title: [Piaere's Boutique, Atelier]
description: Elevated just above the main boutique floor, this spacious atelier beholds the beauty of its arboreal environment.  Partially finished designs inspired by the stunning backdrop are suspended from a network of cords high above.  A stand of posed mannequins have been clothed in completed outfits beside a crowded sewing table.

title: [Inside the Disk, Waiting Room]
description: Blinding flashes of light cycling from pure white to bright pink to deep amethyst make it virtually impossible to see what lies beyond the oval-shaped glass.  The air crackles and shimmers with pure energy.  Multicolored mosaic tiles are inlaid in the flooring to form a trapezoid before the disk.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Entry]
description: Figurative patterns created from multicolored tiles form a mosaic on the floor.  Colors in all shades of the rainbow illustrate a scene of a male aelotoi dressed in a crimson tunic as he bows gracefully to a woman seated on a sapphire throne.  Tucked in the corners of the room, elaborately carved ebonwood tables flank the arched doorway that leads deeper into the building.  Decorating a large oval-shaped window, delicate lace curtains billow gently on a breeze.

title: [The Blue Lobster, Wine Library]
description: Light pours in through a domed stained glaes ceiling depicting Solhaven Bay, and shines brightly on a varnished dark oak floor. Built into refined oak-paneled walls are a series of vine-carved oak shelves, which hold various dust-covered wares.  A glass-fronted black witchwood bookcase stands alongisde a heavy black ebonwood desk inlaid with tendrils of rolaren grapevines.  A conjoined rings framed painting seems to watch over the room.

Light pours in through a domed stained glaes ceiling depicting Solhaven Bay and shines brightly on a varnished dark oak floor.  Built into refined oak-paneled walls are a series of vine-carved oak shelves, which hold various dust-covered wares.  A glass-fronted black witchwood bookcase stands alongisde a heavy black ebonwood desk inlaid with tendrils of rolaren grapevines.  A conjoined rings framed painting seems to watch over the room.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Junction]
description: Wide shelves follow the curve of the platform as they rise from floor to ceiling along the western and eastern edges.  Transparent gossamer silk panels line the backs of the shelves to allow sunlight to filter through to create natural illumination that shimmers across the vials of dye stored there.  Silk banners line the sides of a short rope bridge, forming a colorful corridor to and from a tidy workroom to the north.

Wide shelves follow the curve of the platform as they rise from floor to ceiling along the western and eastern edges.  Transparent gossamer silk panels line the backs of the shelves to allow moonlight to filter through to create natural illumination that shimmers across the vials of dye stored there.  Silk banners line the sides of a short rope bridge, forming a colorful corridor to and from a tidy workroom to the north.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Workroom]
description: Short worktables are arranged in rows around the edge of the platform, allowing the center to be kept wide and open for foot traffic as costumers and workers travel between the steps leading to the dyeing room and the colorful bannered corridor that leads into the main shop.  Mannequins fitted with beautiful wings of silver wire and gaily painted gossamer silk are draped in layers of fabric.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Dyeing Room]
description: Oak barrels stand in a neat row against the edge of the platform, well away from the steps that lead deeper into the shop.  Above the barrels, a clever pulley system is operated by a tiny wheel secured into the rough bark of the ancient tanik tree and attached to ropes that dangle over the platform's edge.  Colorful banners, each splattered with various colors of wayward dye splotches, form a taught roofing system that protects from the elements while allowing the outside air to easily pass through.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Private Room]
description: Carved butterflies create a beautiful border for this large oval mirror, their bodies raised and life-like.  Saffron yellow wood dyes worked into the wood give the device and warm sunny coloring that is preserved behind clear polish.  An oddly formed tripod supports the device and also bears the carved talents of the original artist.

title: [Urgaen's Pawnshop, Backroom]
description: Neatly stacked crates abut the stone walls, partially hidden beneath folded, vibrant linen throws.  Nary a speck of dust can be found, despite the plethora of stored items in this room.  Several tables have been conveniently arranged in a row, far across the room from a small curtained archway.

title: [Raechaer's Alchemical Supplies]
description: Natural recesses in the stone display various crystal figurines in an assortment of shapes and colors.  A rock formation that is topped with a square piece of glass is obviously serving as a counter.  Mullein torches cast flickering light along the walls, bathing the floor beneath them with a soft glow.  Concealing one of the shop's stone walls is a series of dupioni silk tapestries.

title: [Raechaer's Alchemical Supplies]
description: Mullein torches cast flickering light above a table that is holding an assortment of very interesting items pertinent to the art of alchemy.  Piles of large, leather-bound tomes take up space in three of the four corners of this oddly shaped chamber.  Blocked by a rocking chair with an overstuffed pillow as a cushion, the wall bears a hole of considerable size.  From within the breach, greenish light waxes and wanes rhythmically.

title: [The Blue Lobster, Wine Cellar]
description: Granite steps lead underground to this cold, dimly-lit room that has a cavernous dark stone ceiling with redwood rafters.  Just alongside a brass-hinged modwir treasure chest, a series of oak wine casks are laid out in rows upon a wine-stained pale green limestone floor.   A gilded grey ash framed painting hangs alone on richely polished driftwood walls inlaid with blue-speckled sea glass.  Tucked away is an old lobster pot, which sits forgotten in a corner.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Aquamarine Room]
description: Lighter blue walls offset thick royal blue carpeting.  Upon one wall is a mural depicting a beautiful seashore scene with a sun setting over a sea as seen from a white sand beach.  The bed and chairs in the room are covered in royal blue velvet.  The table seems to be made entirely of mithril.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Star Room]
description: Deep grey walls sparkle with glittering stars, reflecting the soft white light of glowing orbs situated in each corner.  Pristine white silky sheets cover a large sleighbed that is nearly overshadowed by a magnificent crystal sculpture.  An oil painting rests above the bed, depicting a peaceful evening illuminated by shooting stars.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Registrar]
description: A collection of strange and exotic creatures in magnificent detail crowd the surface of a polished oak table.  Sunlight produces a spectrum of colors as it filters through several of the hand-blown glass figurines that are perched on the table directly beneath the window.  Apparently used for storing, the overflow of stacks of paper and ledgers rest atop of a lacquered bench.

A collection of strange and exotic creatures in magnificent detail crowd the surface of a polished oak table.  Moonlight reflects off several of the hand-blown glass figurines that are perched on the table directly beneath the window.  Apparently used for storing, the overflow of stacks of paper and ledgers rest atop of a lacquered bench.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Office]
description: Pale lilac curtains are tied back to display half a dozen identical flowerpots, which rest on the ledge of the bay window.  Each pot overflows with beautiful specimens of bluebells, dragonstalks, and other flora.  A watering can is in the corner of the window, partially hidden by the curtains.  A small writing table serves as a desk for the foreman of the place.

title: [Cobbler's Cobby, Storage Room]
description: Bound by thick cords, spotted leopard pelts lay in a heap outside of an overturned coffer.  On a countertop in the rear of the room, clear jars are filled with an assortment of various-sized brass studs.  Displayed on the opposite end of the counter are shiny buckles that can be used to adorn almost any style boots or shoes.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Workroom]
description: The stench of noxious liquids wafts through the area.  In the far reaches of the workroom, a tanning pit overflows with pieces of bark and hides.  Containers filled with various types of liquid are within easy reach of the vat resting in the opposite corner.  Thick cords encircle the danger zones to keep someone from accidentally falling inside.  Several scrapers lay beside piles of skins with a great deal of fur remaining on them.  Flies buzz loudly above a heap of decaying flesh stuffed in a barrel.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Ruby Room]
description: Brass wall-mounted sconces cast light upon the deep-red silk-covered walls.  A setting of chairs with a table, all made of dark modwir wood inlaid with vultite, rest next to a brass fireplace, filling the dark room with warmth.  A large featherbed covered with a snowcat fur throw and dark-red velvet pillows invites the weary traveler.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Hallway]
description: A bronzed statue of a woman with her bare foot extended and staring down at a smiling male with one hand behind her calf and the other holding a shoe up for inspection is lifelike in size.  An empty crate is pushed against the wall, branded on its side in huge block letters are the words, "live specimens."

title: [Solhaven Inn, Black Opal Room]
description: Two ebony chairs sit to either side of a matching table.  An elaborately carved mithril lamp hangs over the table.  A large bed sits on a black pedestal and is covered with a matching coverlet.  Spread on the floor in front of a roaring fireplace is a rug made from the pelt of a black bear of tremendous size.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Diamond Room]
description: Windows strung with beaded crystals cast a myriad of rainbows on light haon walls.  Sheer iridescent panels of silk block off the soft white featherbed centered in the room.  Window seats padded with white puma hide covered cushions afford views of the leafy treetops, perfect perches from which to read tomes.  On a small table, several flickering candles give off a soft glow and the faint scent of jasmine.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Sapphire Room]
description: Tapestries of rich hues of blue dominate the walls of the room, creating an illusion of a waterfall as they drape to the floor.  A sea of cushions in shades of cerulean and azure are piled high before a lapis lazuli fireplace lit with a warming fire.  A collection of seashells lines the mantle, some grains of sand still clinging to them.  A menagerie of carved sapphire animals prance along one of the window sills, catching the light.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Domed Chamber]
description: Curved walls of polished ebonwood support a large glass dome ceiling and form a circular room.  Thick black cushions are scattered across the floor, providing an inviting area to rest.  Telescopes are set up in three places for those who like to stargaze, and a small curtained niche to the south offers privacy for personal prayer.

title: [Warrior Guild, Esplanade]
description: A pleasantly wide walkway guides your steps as the carefully tended foliage and flowers provide a tranquil ambiance, even this close to all the training action.  A large, sparkling pool beckons from beyond an arched trellis which is densely covered by sinuous vines.  To one side, a stone wall with carved niches offers clean towels as well as storage space for garments and equipment.

title: [Warrior Guild, Swimming Pool]
description: The walls of the rectangular pool are tiled with blue and white marble.  A colorful griffin-shaped mosaic at the bottom is clearly visible through the pristine and inviting water.  Several spots on the otherwise tranquil surface show signs of turbulence as an underground spring continually feeds into the pool.

title: [Swimming Pool]
