description: The pleasantly cool water is brisk and refreshing.  The large pool affords ample room for swimming or simply relaxing after a hard day of training.

title: [Warrior Guild, Steam Room Entry]
description: A robed elven attendant stands behind a solidly build counter elegantly topped with a mosaic depicting the seal of the warrior guild.  Behind him, expansive windows afford a view of the gardens just beyond.  Two barrels flank the counter, one tightly lidded, but emanating a subtle fragrance noticeable by all who walk past.  The other is open and half-filled with smooth stones waiting to be put to good use.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hall of Arms]
description: Solemn paintings depicting guild masters of ages past line the panelled walls, their collective eyes seemingly appraising each step taken past them.  Ornate gilded frames and polished brass plaques bring a touch of added elegance and inspire a closer look at the display.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hall of Arms]
description: The hall of arms ends here, with each parallel wall subtly converging into a semicircle marked by a heavy wooden door with dark metal hinges and reinforced with darkened studs.  The flickering light emanating from the sconces on the empty walls barely reaches the door, giving it a slightly foreboding appearance.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hall of Armor]
description: The expansive hall appears as a long, uninterrupted passageway into the guild building.  Arched columns spaced at regular intervals are the only distraction from the solemn displays of antique elven armors that grace the hall with their presence.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hallway]
description: Along the cavernous hallway, an immense mural, its hues vivid as gemstones, details the arduous training involved in mastering each of the guild skills.  Much detail prevails on the wall-canvas, from the determined stance of trainers to the shining pride in the eyes of a warrior when the pinnacle of a skill is achieved.

title: [Warrior Guild, Cartography Room]
description: Ample and well-illuminated, its partially open windows allowing constant and a much-needed flow of fresh air, the map room provides room for quiet study and research.  Myriads of maps, historical battle accounts, and biographies are neatly stacked on stout floor-to-ceiling shelves and cabinets.  Oversized tables provide a proper surface on which to pore over the treasure of information available at members' fingertips.

title: [Warrior Guild, Greatroom]
description: Numerous weapons, most in pristine, gleaming condition have been affixed to the walls of this vast chamber, creating an atmosphere of utmost warrior pride.  A deep sense of camaraderie is apparent in the various groups that sit and stand about, animatedly discussing topics with varying levels of enthusiasm.  A massive stone fireplace dominates the far wall, its crackling and popping sounds adding a subtle touch of relaxation among all present.

title: [Warrior Guild, Second Floor]
description: The polished floor, elegant in its simplicity, leads along paneled walls appointed with framed artwork depicting Ta'Illistim landmarks and historical battle scenes.  Well-spaced sconces provide additional illumination when needed.

title: [Illistim, Guildmaster's Office]
description: The Guild Master's office is large, dominated by a marble-topped desk and an elegant chair inlaid with marble accents.  An assortment of parchments, some with partially visible maps and diagrams indicate possible campaign plans.

title: [Warrior Guild, Second Floor]
description: The sounds of muted conversations emanate from behind many of the thick doors that line the path, an attestation to the always ongoing activity within the guild.  At the end of the corridor, a marble pedestal holds the formidably forged bust of an elven warrior.

title: [Warrior Guild, Balcony]
description: The expansive courtyards with their manicured lawns and well-delineated walkways present a testament to the discipline and perseverance of its members which can be better appreciated from aloft.  The view from this vantage point extends from the traning arena and swimming pool areas to many of the beautiful vars and landmarks of the shining city.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: A small black marble building is set against the walls of the courtyard, its diminutive form shaded by a large willow tree overhead.  The willow's vines sway slowly every few moments, obscuring the dark walls of the building as stray winds pass by.  A pair of golden doors lead into the small structure, their surfaces engraved with a detailed rendition of keys.  The very air seems to muffle all sounds, imparting a strange pervasive silence to the area.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Courtyard]
[Maezneris Villa, Courtyard]
description: Ringed in cobblestones, the courtyard is a combination of carefully placed stones and sprawling lawns.  Spindle-limbed dogwoods and cherry trees dot the landscape, their bright pink and white blossoms catching the sunlight.  Upon the far end of the courtyard, a sprawling villa is nestled amid a verdant garden, while opposite an ornate gate leads to the streets of the city.

Ringed in cobblestones, the courtyard is a combination of carefully placed stones and sprawling lawns.  Spindle-limbed dogwoods and cherry trees dot the landscape, their bright pink and white blossoms catching the moonlight.  Upon the far end of the courtyard, a sprawling villa is nestled amid a verdant garden, while opposite an ornate gate leads to the streets of the city.

Ringed in cobblestones, the courtyard is a combination of carefully placed stones and sprawling lawn.  Spindle-limbed dogwoods and cherry trees dot the landscape, their bright pink and white blossoms catching the sunlight.  At the far end of the courtyard, a sprawling villa is nestled amid a verdant garden, while opposite, an ornate gate leads to the streets of the city.  Dappled with golden sunlight through the trees, a foliage-lined pebble path leads through the garden to the back of the building, while a glass-paned white birch door offers entrance through the front.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shrine]
description: A solid black marble altar sits to the south, nestled within a small arched alcove of ivory.  Many candles sit on the various ledges within the small space, their warm light casting the statue of a woman behind the altar in a soft, enveloping glow.  The woman stands firmly with an air of both grace and seriousness, though her downturned eyes give her a slightly somber look.  Delicate snowblossoms are strewn across the floor, their pale white hue reminiscent of winter's winds.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Prayer Niche]
description: Little more than a closet, this niche offers privacy for prayer.  A cushiony black spidersilk prayer mat is centered on the floor, and a heavy black curtain closes the niche off from the outer chamber.  A thick beeswax candle gives off a warm glow that fills the niche with soft light.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Altar]
description: The silver-veined black marble floor has been polished to a high shine, and not a speck of dust can be seen anywhere.  The high ceiling is of ornately carved onyx, and the walls are draped in black velvet and spidersilk tapestries.  The tapestries depict aspects of Ronan's world, from one showing Koar and Lumnis cradling twin infants to another painted with a scene of a battle with Sheru, Ronan's long-time enemy.  A black marble altar sits beneath the tapestries for those wishing to make offerings.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Antechamber]
description: Black lambswool carpet covers the floor, cushioning every footfall and muting most sounds, creating a sense of suspended time and reality.  Incense permeates the air with its fragrance of night-blooming jasmine and musk, while its small wisps of smoke dance in sensual abandon.

title: [Akarnam's Fletchings]
description: Thick woolen rugs cover much of the floor, helping to insulate the precious heat generated by the nearby fireplace.  Stocked on handcarved shelves are a variety of supplies necessary for fletching, each item labeled clearly and displayed neatly.  A small window in the western wall offers a glimpse of the torchlight glow upon the blanket of snow on the snowy trees surrounding the cabin.

Thick woolen rugs cover much of the floor, helping to insulate the precious heat generated by the nearby fireplace.  Stocked on handcarved shelves are a variety of supplies necessary for fletching, each item labeled clearly and displayed neatly.  A small window in the western wall offers a glimpse of the torchlight glowing upon the blanket of snow on the snowy trees surrounding the cabin.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Art Room]
description: The paintings hanging on the wall are not paintings of the ordinary type.  They seem to portray a series of visions, each one containing creatures and beings not known to Elanthia.  They are hauntingly beautiful, and somewhat disturbing, but they seem to hold a message that cries to be heard.

title: [Temple of Ronan, Coffin Room]
[Temple of Ronan, Night's Vigil]
description: The walls of this small room are draped with black velvet and silver spidersilk.  Hundreds of votive candles are scattered about the room on the polished ebonwood floor, forming a vague circle around a central marble platform.  On the platform rests a crystal coffin in which lies a beautiful young woman.

Polished onyx arcs overhead to form a high-domed ceiling, its surface studded with diamonds in the patterns of the constellations of the night sky.  In the center of the chamber stands a marble pedestal, where a tall black candle provides the sole source of light.  Along the far side of the room, a silver-edged sword of carved jet hangs halfway down the wall.

title: [Captain's Rest, Anchor Room]
description: Propped in one corner is a large black anchor with a section of thick chain wound on the floor around it.  Across from the anchor is a wide bed with a blue coverlet over it.  The blue curtains framing the open window have anchors embroidered along the edge.  On the west wall is a large painting of a ship in a tropical lagoon.

title: [Warrior Guild, Office]
description: This well-appointed office provides all the necessary implements to conduct guild business.  By the orderly look of the desk and clean slate board, it is clear that this working area is currently vacant, perhaps to be used by visiting guild officials from other cities.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hall of Armor]
description: The hall stretches far ahead into the recesses of the building, its end marked by a slightly darkened space far away.  Sets of ancient elven armor, elevated and displayed on marble pedestals appear as an endless, mute procession of warriors of auld.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hall of Armor]
description: The hall continues here, a seemingly endless expanse of stately granite and graceful columns.  Impressive in their craftmanship and state of preservation, antique full plate armor displays recall bygone days of monumental battles and victories.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hall of Armor]
description: The hall ends in a large circular room which encompasses military portraits as well as a magnificent collection of blunt weapons displayed inside a glass-topped case.  Wide windows, their shades partially open, allow a succinct look into the guild grounds and its many courtyards.

title: [Warrior Guild, Cold Storage]
description: A lone oil lamp in the center of the basement adds no warmth, though its light reflects mysteriously from the glistening, wet walls.  In the dim light available, a faint outline on the wall hints at a possible alternate way out.

title: [Akarnam's Bows]
description: A plethora of archery equipment hangs from wrought iron hooks along the plank walls, including enormous leather quivers stocked full of arrows.  Behind a sturdy pine worktable, a stout dwarven bowyer plies his craft with great dexterity, creating yet another quality bow to be sold.  The aroma of woods mingles pleasantly with the fragrant smoke emitted by smoldering logs in the small fireplace opposite a faded green door.

title: [Warrior Guild, Basement]
description: Further inside the frigid subterranean portion of the guild, the rough floor appears slick with moisture.  The uneven surface helps in maintaining a steady footing as one moves across the spacious, albeit low-ceilinged, stone chamber.

title: [Warrior Guild, Basement]
description: Dark and chilly as can be, the basement is also quite ample in dimensions and noticeably appropriate for storing perishable provisions in the niches, shelves, and hooks that have been installed throughout.

title: [Warrior Guild, Cold Storage]
description: Frightfully cold air floats all about, the temperature low enough to effect a hazy steam from mere breathing.  Several enormous metal tubs, almost completely filled with ice, have been lined up against the icy wall.

title: [Warrior Guild, Basement]
description: Frigid air permeates this chamber, no doubt a result of both its subterranean location and the tubs of ice placed here.

title: [Warrior Guild, Basement]
description: A lone sconce sheds minimal light about the chamber.  The room appears mostly bare, though in the darkness, it is difficult to discern much of anything.  Curious, zapping noises emanate from a tank on a not-too-distant corner, followed closely by flashes of light.  A small set of shelves resides near the stairwell leading upward and out of the darkness.

title: [Warrior Guild, Darkened Landing]
description: A solitary iron sconce perched above the heavy door provides barely enough illumination to make out the way down to the basement.  Beyond the first few flagstone steps, there are persistent and deeper shadows and the vague outline of a mortared stone wall.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entryway]
description: Massive fel and modwir trees tower over the vaalorn-banded gate barring the path.  There looks to be a considerable grove within the enclosure, the trees dense enough to cover whatever might be beyond them.

title: [Warrior Guild, Western Grove]
description: A small stream cuts across the clearing, but is easily crossed.  Silvery fish dance in the shallow depths of the water, darting downstream in a rhythmic flash of color.  One of the groundskeeper's children sits nearby, happily off in her own world.
A small stream cuts across the clearing, but can be easily crossed.  The distorted reflection of the moon drifts serenely off the surface of the water, disturbed only when somebody strolls past.

title: [Warrior Guild, Fisticuffs]
description: A roped-off clearing looks to be the perfect spot for testing your brawling skills.  There is ample room on all sides for spectators.  Soft grass should cushion most of the falls, although it will do little to soften a well-timed uppercut.

title: [Warrior Guild, Western Grove]
description: Row upon row of trellises line this portion of the grove, each overgrown with grape vines.  A solitary squirrel nibbling on the fruit seems undeterred by the constant parade of heavily armed men and women strolling nearby.  The small vineyard is well tended and looks to be more than just a hobby for somebody.

title: [Warrior Guild, Western Grove]
description: The clearing is dominated by a row of large wooden workout wheels.  The contraptions are almost art-like in their construction, but clearly are designed to take a beating.

title: [Warrior Guild, Southern Grove]
description: Several long narrow tables fill the clearing, each granting an excellent view of the nearby tackling range.  The mannequins used for practice are far from ordinary however, each has been masterfully crafted into the image of a different creature.

Several long narrow tables fill the clearing, each granting an excellent view of the torch-lit tackling range.  The mannequins used for practice are far from ordinary however, each has been masterfully crafted into the image of a different creature.

title: [Warrior Guild, Southern Grove]
description: The turf is scarred badly here, perhaps the result of practice gone awry.  One of the groundskeepers is nearby, but somebody will have to wake her before anything gets done.  She looks to be snoozing quite comfortably under the shade of one of the larger trees.
A nearby owl disturbs the silence of the evening, its song a never ending quest.  Sentries wander by from time to time, most heading in the direction of the Citadel.

title: [Warrior Guild, Central Grove]
description: A slightly elevated wooden platform surrounded by a ring of tall trees looks to be an ideal spot to rest or chat.  The sound of swords clashing can be heard nearby, followed by hearty laughter.  One of the Citadel staff stands just off the platform, perhaps waiting to deliver a message to the training administrator.

A slightly elevated wooden platform surrounded by a ring of tall trees looks to be an ideal spot to rest or chat.  A small cat, comfortably sprawled across one of the numerous branches, looks down upon the area.

title: [Warrior Guild, Eastern Grove]
description: Tall, unshorn grass accompanied by a wide variety of trees fills this portion of the grove.  A trio of young apple trees planted in a triangular fashion look to be a few seasons shy of providing fruit.  A bit of sunlight manages to filter through the heavy cover, but it is losing the battle.

Tall, unshorn grass accompanied by a wide variety of trees fills this portion of the grove.  A trio of young apple trees planted in a triangular fashion look to be a few seasons shy of providing fruit.  A soft breeze gently caresses the overhead cover, revealing slivers of the moon from time to time.

title: [Warrior Guild, Eastern Grove]
description: Elegantly carved and decorated wooden benches surround the ancient fel tree centered in this portion of the grove.  The tree looks fairly healthy, but clearly age and animals have taken their toll on its proud form.

title: [Warrior Guild, Storage]
description: The groundskeepers evidently utilize this area as storage.  Piled in large stacks are wooden planks, the weather and climate slowing damaging the supplies.

title: [Warrior Guild, Eastern Grove]
description: The trees are a bit more sparse in this area, particularly to the east, where a small, tranquil glade can be seen.  This area is fairly quiet, the serenity disturbed only when one of the groundskeepers wanders by.

title: [Warrior Guild, Southern Grove]
description: A diagonal pattern of small trees has been recently planted here, each of the rows bearing a different type.  Colorful round flagstones allow easy passage in all directions.  The Citadel is just visible to the southwest.

title: [Warrior Guild, Southern Grove]
description: A glance to the north or south reveals nothing but a wall of very tall trees.  Sunlight angles in from overhead, creating long shadows across the grassy pathway.  A simple rope swing dangles from one of the thicker branches, oddly out of place in this training center.

A glance to the north or south reveals nothing but a wall of very tall trees.  A simple rope swing dangles from one of the thicker branches, illuminated by soft moonlight angling in from overhead.  It seems a bit out of place in this center of martial training.

title: [Warrior Guild, Southern Grove]
description: A simple but sturdy wooden bridge arching over a small stream leads to the Guild Citadel.  Two elven sentries bearing pikes stand on either side of the building.  Neither appears terribly worried about intruders, as they seem to be engaged in a very animated conversation.

A simple but sturdy wooden bridge arching over a small stream leads to the Guild Citadel.  Two elven sentries bearing pikes stand on either side of the building.  It's hard to tell in the dim light, but one of them appears to be sleeping on his feet.

title: [Warrior Guild, Citadel]
description: The size of the citadel is quite impressive, but not nearly as impressive as the craftsmanship put into the building.  Intricate etchings of mythical beasts adorn the doors, each unique and clearly done by a different hand.  An elven sentry stands nearby, keeping a close eye on those entering and departing the guild.

title: [Citadel, Chamber of Remembrance]
description: Adorning each of the walls of this high-ceiling room is a weapon, a shield, and a set of armor. All look well maintained, but clearly used.  There is a small brass placard beneath one of the longswords.

title: [Citadel, Office]
description: A leather chair sits behind the desk centered in the room.  On the other side of the desk are three more chairs.  Portraits hang on the wall, depicting battles both grand and small.  One of the pictures isn't a battle scene however, it looks to be a rendering of the grove prior to the guild's construction.

title: [Warrior Guild, Springs]
description: Steam rises from several natural hot springs scattered about the area.  River stone benches surround the small pools, allowing one a brief respite from the searing heat of the water.

title: [Warrior Guild, Spring]
description: The bubbling water of the spring is hot enough, but the scalding steam rising upward is augmented further by a heated ring of rounded metal stones.  Cursing can be heard nearby, the tone quite angry.

title: [Warrior Guild, Glade]
description: A small pond surrounded by tall grass is the perfect spot for meditation and thought.  The sun reflects off the surface of the water, disturbed only slightly by the small afternoon breeze.  A solitary frog sits amidst an army of lily pads, content to bask in the daytime heat.

A small pond surrounded by tall grass is the perfect spot for meditation and thought.  The moonlight reflects off the surface of the water, disturbed only slightly by the gently evening breeze.  A few fireflies flitter over the pond, evidently in no hurry to reach their destination.

title: [Warrior Guild, Storage]
description: Boxes of all sizes and shapes are stacked neatly, presumably used for storing fruit.  It's doubtful anybody would miss a few, if one needed them for anything.

title: [Warrior Guild, Storage]
description: As branches fall from the numerous trees of the grove, the staff moves them to this portion of the clearing.  Several mounds of twigs are scattered about the field, perfect for kindling, whittling or guild use.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A cheer can be heard through the windows, coming from somewhere deep in the grove.  One of the walls bears a large discolored square mark, perhaps a spot where a tapestry or banner once hung.

title: [Citadel, Storage]
description: This room is used as a storage area for tools and supplies.  There is a huge bin in one corner, half-filled with dried leaves and small twigs.  A tool rack hangs from one wall, a varied assortment of items upon it.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A pair of wheelbarrows have been left in the hallway, partially blocking the corridor.  Both are filled with leaves.  It doesn't appear anybody is in a hurry to claim them.

title: [Citadel, Meeting Hall]
description: A podium sits atop a slightly elevated platform, and looks down on several rows of simple wooden benches.  A large window behind the podium illuminates the room quite well.
A podium sits atop a slightly elevated platform, and looks down on several rows of simple wooden benches.  A large window behind the podium allows a glimpse of one of the evening moons.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A halfling walks past, shivering from head to toe.  He nods a quick greeting, then hurries off towards the grove.  Shattering noises and an occasional grunt or groan can be heard to the east.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: Lush potted plants hang from the ceiling, thriving from the sunlight filtering through the numerous windows of this hallway.  A glass enclosed pedestal stands near the middle of the hall, a shattered talon-hilted longsword within it.

Lush potted plants hang from the ceiling, thriving from the sunlight that filters through the numerous windows during the day.  A glass enclosed pedestal stands near the middle of the hall, a shattered talon-hilted longsword within it.

title: [Citadel, Workshop]
description: The workshop is meticulously maintained, clearly run by somebody with a great deal of pride in what they do.  An assortment of leatherworking tools are carefully hung on the walls, outlines just visible around them for ease in replacing them once done.  There is a faint odor in the air, a bit acrid, but not unpleasant.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: This portion of the hallway is extremely long.  The corridor is well-lit, the light of day streaming in through numerous evenly spaced windows.  A large tapestry hangs on the inner wall.

This portion of the hallway is extremely long.  A tall caretaker is carefully lighting sconces, the illumination of the corridor growing with each new light.  A large tapestry hangs on the inner wall.

title: [Citadel, Commons]
description: Numerous tables and benches fill the room, more than enough to handle even the largest group of hungry warriors.  Several of the Citadel caretakers roam the chamber, keeping the room in order.  A table near the back holds ample helpings of food and drink.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: There are no windows or openings in this corridor.  Flickering torches give a bit of light, but barely enough.  There is no draft in the hallway, but this area is quite cold.

title: [Citadel, Vault]
description: As cold as this chamber is, you'd think you were in Icemule, not Ta'Vaalor.  Stairs lead downward into the darkness.

title: [Citadel, Icehouse]
description: A single sconce illuminates the room, but it is woefully inadequate.  A row of wooden tubs is lined up against one wall, the water looking anything but comfortable.

title: [Citadel, Darkroom]
description: There is but a single candle burning, and all it reveals is a room no larger than a closet.  A shelf holds several clear glass bottles, odd shapes writhing and twisting within them.

title: [Citadel, Ice Storage]
description: Blocks of ice are stacked in every corner of this room.  Water pools beneath them as they slowly melt in the just-above freezing temperature of the room.

title: [Citadel, Ice Storage]
description: There is little room to move about this room, the blocks of ice stacked floor to ceiling nearly fill it to capacity.

title: [Warrior Guild, Portico]
description: A tiled walkway leads from the main entrance across a well-trimmed, half-oval lawn towards three large arched entrances of a white marble building.  The columns supporting the covered walkway are carved with the forms of beautiful maidens, their hands uplifted to touch the ceiling while their delicate feet dangle from the base.

title: [Warrior Guild, Walkway]
description: A gentle breeze blows past the ornately tiled walkway bearing the light fragance of flowers and warmth that is reminiscent of childhood days of playing in the forests of Elanthia.

title: [Warrior Guild, Exedra]
description: A row of semi-circular benches has been placed in a recess to the side of the walkway.  This vantage provides an encompassing view of the front of the magnificient marbled guild complex.  Trimmed hedges and topiaries encircle the benches, separating the area from the lawn.

title: [Warrior Guild, Steps]
description: The walkway ends at the foot of an expansive flight of marbled steps that is ten meters wide at its base and tapers to six meters at its apex.  At either side of the steps are carved marble lions crouched on top of sculpted foundations.  Atop the steps are three arched entrances.  The ornate center entrance is flanked by the two smaller arched openings leading into the great guild complex.

title: [Guild Hall, Vaulted Foyer]
description: A solid tanik-wood desk sits underneath a towering vaulted bay-window that opens on the splendor of the garden and pool beyond.  Sunlight shines upon the flowering vines that intertwine the pillars to form a thin veil along the walls.  The tiled hallway runs transverse to the entrance.

title: [Guild Hall, West Hallway]
description: Scenes of battle in a gilded frieze stretch along the walls, each pair of combatants cleverly arranged so that some protrusion--a spear, a raised fist--touches the ceiling.  Below the frieze and evenly spaced apart, pairs of weapons crossed over burnished shields hang on the white marble walls.

title: [Guild Hall, Dark Chamber]
description: The walls in this dark and gloomy room are painted black.  A dim light flickers from a tank full of squirming, serpentine bodies in one corner.  Against one wall is a set of shelves acting as an apothecary: several bottles of various shapes and sizes are lined up neatly there.  Sawdust is scattered on the floor, forming a thick carpet.  Something smells odd here.

title: [Guild Hall, West Wing]
description: The western hallway turns northward at this junction.  Adorning the walls are suits of armor of various design.  The arched openings facing the esplanade provide a splendid view of the swimming pool.

title: [Guild Hall, Basilica]
description: This large meeting hall is oblong in plan, with a high central barrel-vault ceiling lit by a clerestory.  Between each window of the clerestory is a massive marble pillar, six on each side of the room.  A wide aisle parts rows of high-backed wooden benches and leads down to the central podium.

title: [Guild Hall, East Hallway]
description: Gilded figures pose athletically in a frieze that runs along the walls.  Their exaggerated broad shoulders press against the ceiling, muscles straining to keep the roof in place.  Beneath the frieze, luxurious crimson velvet tapestries hang, contrasting nicely with the white marble walls.

title: [Guild Hall, Dressing Room]
description: Through a vestibule, the entrance gives way to a lavishly decorated room.  Abundant lanterns hanging overhead accentuate the lighting provided by the clerestory.  Along the walls are niches for storing clothes.

title: [Guild Hall, Ready Room]
description: In this room, jars of oils and towels are neatly stacked upon the shelves lining the walls.  Here, one can oil oneself before exercise or scrape off the sweat and dirt afterwards.

title: [Guild Hall, Vestibule]
description: This arched hallway allows passage between the frigidarium and the dressing room.  Excessive traffic through the hall has worn a smooth trail down the middle of the dirty floor.

title: [Guild Hall, Clausum]
description: Other than some wooden shelves mounted at eye level, this room is rather stark and empty.

title: [Guild Hall, Frigidarium]
description: Four semi-translucent screens surround a pair of ice tubs recessed in the floor of this round, domed room.  Small round windows and an oculus at the top of the dome keep the room perpetually bathed in light.  Marble steps skirt the tubs and are textured to prevent slipping.  A dolphin-shaped golden spout continually gushes fresh water through a basin of crushed ice, which spills into the two tubs, keeping the bath water cold and brisk.

title: [Guild Hall, Tepidarium]
description: Warm air radiates from the sauna room to the south while cooler air blows from the frigidarium to the east and the circular rose windows above.  Clean, white towels are neatly stacked upon marble shelves that line the wall.  In the center of the room are some circular benches, offering a place to sit while toweling dry.

title: [Warrior Guild, Esplanade]
description: This walkway is covered with hand drawn tiles depicting abstract shapes.  The esplanade leads west to a large swimming pool.  Some topiaries and shrubbery flank the entrance of the hippodrome to the north.

title: [Warrior Guild, Swimming Pool]
description: The oval pool stretches nearly the entire width of the guild properties.  Its water is pristine and pleasantly cool.  Gold carved water spouts spaced every few meters provide an endless supply of fresh water from some underground source.

title: [Guild Hall, Caldarium]
description: Hollow tubes of glaes that run along the walls carry hot steam from subterranean furnaces and distribute it throughout room.  A pair of private saunas stand behind a long, fel-wood bench.  The perfect place to rest your weary muscles.

title: [Warrior Guild, Esplanade]
description: This walkway is covered with hand drawn tiles depicting abstract shapes.  The clear blue waters of the large swimming pool invite you to take a dip. Shadows from the western wall of the guild harbor some flowering ivy as they work their way towards the sun.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hippodrome]
description: Flora of bright greens dashed with red and white fill this oblong garden, its fragrances drifting by in the warm breezes.  Each plant and shrubbery has been meticulously placed to form the ancient runes of Strength and Purity.  Small deciduous trees provide shade to escape the hot sun.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hippodrome]
description: Here in the far side of the garden, a small shed sits next to a wall of ivy and shrubbery.  Adjacent to the shed is a stockpile of stripped branches.

title: [Warrior Guild, Garden Shed]
description: This sturdily built shed is made of fel wood over a granite foundation.  Though it looked small from the outside, the interior is rather ample and allows easy access to the tools and containers kept here.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hippodrome]
description: The garden is filled with topiaries, clipped hedges and geometric beds of flora.  Small shade trees provide opportunistic resting places to sit and idle the hours away, submerged in contemplation of nature.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hippodrome]
description: The garden is filled with topiaries, clipped hedges and geometric beds of flora.  Small shade trees provide opportunistic resting places to sit and idle the hours away submerged in contemplation of nature.

title: [Warrior Guild, Hippodrome]

title: [Warrior Guild, Garden Shed]
description: The wooden shed is cramped, stuffy, and cluttered with leatherworking equipment.  The pervasive scent of tanned hide and hot metal assaults your nostrils.  The floor is dirt, packed hard by the tramplings of many workers and spotted with dark oil stains.

title: [Warrior Guild, Garden Shed]
description: In this part of the shed, stacks of wood boards in various stages of processing are piled up in neat rows against one side of the room.  Wood chips and splinters litter the rest of the floor and the smell of freshly cut wood pervade the air.

title: [Guild Hall, West Wing]
description: Running north and south, the marble tiled floors and luxurious decorations reflect the affluence of the guild.  An arched entrance flanked by marble columns leads to the Guild Master sanctum, while the hallway terminates at a pair of gilded mithril gates to the north.

title: [Guild Hall, Guildmaster Sanctum]
description: The Guildmaster office is roomy and tastefully decorated.  Paintings of previous Guildmasters hang on the wall above the mantle of a stone fireplace.  The opposite wall curves inward, its numerous windows providing a view of the beach and ocean.  Supple leather chairs provide comfortable seating to enjoy the view.  A black marble desk sits in front of a bookcase filled with ancient tomes of lore.

title: [Guild Hall, Wooden Deck]
description: The sturdy wooden deck hangs over a sand dune that slopes down to the ocean surf where the unblemished white sands of the beach frame the azure sea.  Unhindered for miles, the view is breathtaking.  A cool sea breeze blows past, providing relief from the tropical humidity.

title: [Guild Hall, Drizzsdt's Office]
description: Daylight spills through tall arched windows, infusing this office with radiant warmth.  Though spartanly furnished, it provides a welcome retreat for all who enter.  Rows of oak shelves, arrayed with tomes, trophies, and mementos, bracket an enormous stone fireplace above which hangs a striking oil portrait.  In the center of the room, offering a convenient gathering place for discussion and banter, sits a long scarred oaken table surrounded by high-backed chairs.  A large oak desk rests opposite the fireplace.

title: [Guild Hall, West Wing]
description: Beyond the pair of gilded mithril gates is a large open field that is the guild's training grounds.  The guild has spared no expense in providing all the necessary facilities for the tutelage of its members.

title: [Warrior Guild, Palaestra]
description: This large, open space is surrounded by a covered, circular walkway used for track exercises.  Its center is split into several courts, each one devoted to a particular piece of training equipment.  Rows upon rows of tackling dummies line the nearest court.

title: [Warrior Guild, Palaestra]
description: This section of the courtyard has been devoted to rows of workout wheels.  Surrounding the courtyards is a covered walkway, its roof supported by colonnades.  A few splatterings of gray bird droppings have dried to an almost porcelain hardness upon the meticulous brickwork.

title: [Warrior Guild, Palaestra]
description: This section of the courtyard houses the guild pugilist arena.  Surrounding the courtyards is a covered walkway, its roof supported by colonnades.  A few stray weeds struggle to emerge from the cracks between the bricks.

title: [Ariasha's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an elegantly arched fel ceiling, an old elven war banner hangs on one of the white brocade walls.  A carved oak table and an elegantly carved oak armoire sit in opposite corners while a serene golden wyvern fountain rests on a dark mahogany floor.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Men's Clothier]

A muted crimson carpet spreads across the stone floor, and the wood-paneled walls are painted a subdued grey.  A pair of young elven clerks work diligently, organizing the wares by type, color, and size, and politely greeting customers as they enter the shop.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Women's Clothier]

title: [Warrior Guild, Second Floor]
description: Windows lining every wall of the expansive upper story provide ample light and a good view of the guild's grounds.  The view is the only feature of note, as the room is bare of furniture or decoration.

title: [Warrior Guild, West Hall]
description: Maces, hammers and clubs line the walls, each set off against its twin.  A three-headed flail crosses hafts with its double, and a simple duo of wooden truncheons is fastened beside it.  A lone quadrelle disrupts the pattern.  The tiles echo the pattern of the weapons along the walls, their diagonals interrupted by square-set tiles every few feet along the floor.

title: [Warrior Guild, West Lawn]
description: The grass grows lush and green, bordered by well-kept shrubbery that is bounded in turn by a low stone wall.  A weathered woodshed stands several paces away from a solid oak door that leads into the Guild proper.  Several large vertical wheels similar to those on sailing ships are set up along the southwestern side of the lawn.

The figures along the westernmost length of the hall are clad in full leather, while the armor on those to the east is fitted with metal studs or worked cuirbouilli leather.  The gear is elegant in its simplicity, but some of the leathers seem to be overdue for an oiling.

title: [Dozing Seahorse Table]
description: A shabby blue cloth stained with rings from tankards covers a heavy wooden table.  Rickety chairs are placed haphazardly around it with scuffed marks on their legs. title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: A wide swath of bare earth stretches north from the gate to the guild house, its surface packed hard from the tread of many feet.  On the far eastern side of the clearing is a rolton tethered to a stake.  A circle of grass around the creature is neatly cropped, the only visible effort made at landscaping.

title: [Airiella's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A large cherrywood cabinet and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Airiella's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A large cherrywood cabinet and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Warrior Guild, Dark Chamber]
description: The walls in this dark and gloomy room are painted black.  A dim light flickers from a tank full of squirming, serpentine bodies in one corner.  Against one wall is a set of shelves acting as an apothecary: several bottles of various shapes and sizes are lined up neatly there.  Sawdust is scattered on the floor, forming a thick carpet.  Something smells odd here.

title: [Warrior Guild, Great Hall]
description: An enormous woven rug covers the wide stone floor at the Great Hall's central point.  Suits of armor line the walls, ranging in kind from tailored leathers to gleaming plate.  A particularly fierce pair of empty forms stand guard outside a brass-hasped monir door upon the western wall.

title: [Warrior Guild, Masters' Office]
description: Broad windows open to the night air face the West Lawn, giving the spacious office an expansive feel despite its low-beamed ceiling.  Paintings of former Guildmasters hang on the wall behind a solidly built pinewood desk and flank a pair of glass-fronted bookshelves near the door.  The three padded leather chairs are, like the desk they surround, utilitarian but beautifully crafted.

title: [Warrior Guild, Lounge]
description: Groups of low sturdy chairs cluster around a circular firepit ringed with native riverstone.  One whitewashed wall is decked with banners of various Houses and orders, while the wall behind the bar bears beautifully preserved hunting trophies.  The bar itself is only a few long planks atop barrels, but serves its purpose well enough.  Citrus-scented candles burn near the windows to chase away vagrant mosquitoes seeking their own liquid refreshments.

title: [Warrior Guild, Basement]
description: Wine-casks, ale barrels, and sacks of flour fill the corners of the room to the rafters.  Although the narrow chamber is packed to capacity, there is order to the stored goods and all is clearly labeled.  A large bin near the door holds fresh locally grown apples.

title: [Warrior Guild, Great Hall]
description: The northern end of the Great Hall has been set up as an auditorium of sorts.  A roughly hewn podium stands a giantman's length away from an enormous stone fireplace, while dozens of benches are scattered around to the sides of the room.  A hunting horn made out of a polished mammoth tusk is fastened above the mantle.

title: [Warrior Guild, Basement]
description: Rows of weapons too damaged for further use await reforging, their edges gleaming dimly in fitful torchlight.  A door set flush with the wall to the north appears to be coated with pitch, and the limestone walls on either side of it sweat beads of moisture.

title: [Warrior Guild, Cold Storage]
description: Blocks of ice fill bins on either side of the narrow chamber and keep the dressed deer carcasses hanging from the ceiling cold.  Water trickling from the bins as the ice slowly melts drains into a small hole in the center of the floor, leaving the limestone floor slick.  A pair of mallets near the door stands at the ready to break up larger blocks of ice when necessary.

title: [Warrior Guild, East Hall]
description: Wooden mannequins wearing sets of chain mail armor stand in shallow niches along the north wall, each posed in an attitude of respectful attention.  Whether plain or ornately wrought, the suits of armor share one characteristic: their obvious age.  Terra cotta tiles pave the floor, their regular tessellation as formal as the mannequins' dignified poses.

title: [Warrior Guild, East Hall]
description: The arched door to your east stands open, admitting a breeze that stirs the humid air.  The whitewashed walls bear water stains that someone has tried unsuccessfully to hide behind a potted fern.  A utilitarian set of steel armor stands nearby, its surface blooming with the first signs of rust in the damp atmosphere.

title: [Warrior Guild, Baths]
description: The confluence of warm and cool air from the row of steam rooms to the east and frigidaria to the west leaves the white tile floor slick with condensation.  Beautifully rendered mosaics wrap around the walls, depicting figures engaged in a half-dozen different styles of hand-to-hand combat ranging from giantkin wrestling to the intricate dancelike steps of the southern elves.

title: [Warrior Guild, Frigidarium]
description: The featureless room holds nothing but a tub the size of a coffin.  The tub is half-filled with crushed ice, making the air cold enough to fog your breath.

title: [Warrior Guild, Steam Room]
description: The air is almost uncomfortably hot and steam roils around you with every movement.  Just large enough to fit one long wooden bench, the room is designed to accommodate only one person at a time.  Near the door is a bucket of water and a brazier containing smooth stones, their surfaces split from rapid heating and cooling.

title: [Warrior Guild, Woodshed]
description: Sawdust thickly coats the packed earth floor of the woodshed.  A pyramid of dry logs stands against one wall, while newly cut boards awaiting the hands of a cabinet-maker or carpenter are propped along another.  Woodworking tools hang from pegs above a makeshift bench.

title: [Warrior Guild, Workshop]
description: A large, but apparently unused forge dominates the southwestern quadrant of the room, its surface still sooty from fires long since extinguished.  Pegs on the east wall hold tools in varying states of disrepair, most rusted but still intact.  The floor is oddly free of dust.

title: [Warrior Guild, Woodshed]
description: Dark streaks on the south wall reveal where a leak in the roof had once been.  An untidy pile of broken tools beneath the workbench contributes to the atmosphere of neglect in the rear portion of the shed.

title: [Warrior Guild, Workshop]
description: The pungent odors of dye and tanning supplies are strong despite the row of open windows along the front of the workshop.  The floor is covered with a palimpsest of dye-stains, marking the room's purpose as clearly as the thick smell.  A pair of workbenches near the door holds a variety of leatherworking tools.

title: [Warrior Guild, East Lawn]
description: Lawn is perhaps a misnomer for this expanse of stubbly grass and fine dust.  An array of straw-stuffed dummies ranging from halfling-height to somewhat taller than a giantman is lined up along the easternmost side of the clearing.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ringside]
description: Rows of rough wooden benches surround three sides of the pugilism ring.  A large oak tree, its branches arching over the ring, is hung with lanterns to provide light to spectators and combatants alike.

title: [Warrior Guild, Pugilism Ring]
description: The padded canvas floor of the pugilism ring is pulled taut by a series of ropes and has some spring to it still, but scuffs and stains reveal that it has seen much hard use.  Lanterns hanging from the branches of a nearby tree illuminate the ring.

title: [Blue Table]
description: The table is covered with a soft blue cotton fabric embroidered with a swirling wave design which runs along the edge.  A pure white water lily gently floating in the half-full crystal bowl on the table is its only decoration.

title: [Green Table]
description: A green silk cloth embroidered along the border with intertwined hunter green vines and golden leaves is carefully draped over the table.  A simple crystal vase arranged with Imaera's lace and wildflowers is placed on it for decoration.

title: [White Table]
description: A sparkling crystal butterfly graces the table which is covered with a crisp pure white linen cloth.  The fabric is meticulously embroidered along the edges with dainty snowflake designs.  Several folded napkins trimmed with delicate lace are neatly placed on the table.

title: [Black Table]
description: An etched silver lamp illuminates this dark corner.  The soft satin fabric covering the table is delicately embroidered with silver runes and the surrounding chairs are upholstered with soft black velvet.

title: [Skinny Thrak Table]
description: The table edges here are sharply beveled, as though someone has been whittling away at them.  Etched into the table top are some of the most emaciated thraks you have ever seen.  Their sides draw in together at the waist, giving them a waspish look.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: You are standing on a small stone ledge which once supported the great beams which held up the wooden floor of this room.  All of the flammable parts of this tower have been destroyed, however, leaving the walls stained with black streaks of soot and smoke and the tower a gutted hulk, open from the dirt floor well below you to the circular opening which was once the roof high above.

title: [Khazar's Hold, Trading Post]
description: A potbellied iron stove sits in the center of this building, spreading heat throughout the store.  The black chimney stretches upward and through the roof.  Animal skins and woven tapestries hang on the wall, and thin red carpet covers the floor.  A broken ship's wheel leans against the wall in one corner and a small iron anchor in another corner.  The trading post branches off into four directions, one for each specialty.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Upstairs Hall]
description: A worn red carpet covers a narrow strip of the hallway's hardwood floor from end to end.  The exposed floor shines as if polished daily, and no cracks or crevices appear anywhere in the length of the hallway.  A low, narrow table placed between two doors on the left and opposite the center door on the right sports a vase of fresh flowers.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Purple Stall]
description: Fitted against the brick wall at the back of the courtyard, this cozy stall has a short privacy screen crafted of oak.  Faded paint tints the walls a soft purple hue, which matches the variegated sides of the tin tub at the center of the stall.  Sturdy shelves hold empty vials, trimming shears, hemp bindings, and various other tools used in the dying process, while a ring of empty buckets rests beside the tin tub.

title: [Narcis Hold, Courtyard]
description: Sheltered by a tiered curving wall choked in vividly luminous moss, the courtyard's view of the night sky is rent by the branches of a weeping willow.  The ancient tree casts its drooping branches over a ring of hooded statues.  Winged and faceless, the metallic creatures loom over a path of smooth cobbles proceeding toward a dark stone hold.  Sweetgrass and banks of bleeding-hearts are little more than swaying silhouettes bordering the walkway.

Sheltered by a tiered curving wall choked in pale moss, the courtyard rests in the shade of a weeping willow.  The ancient tree casts its drooping branches over a ring of hooded statues.  Winged and faceless, the metallic creatures cast their stygian shadows over a path of smooth cobbles proceeding toward a dark stone hold.  Blue-green sweetgrass and banks of bleeding-hearts border the walkway on either side.

title: [Narcis Hold, Foyer]
description: Looming overhead is a dome of ebonwood and carmine crystal, reminiscent of a whelk's spiral shell.  Shards of ruby light filter through the smooth expanse of glass, gathering in nebulous pools about a central fountain fashioned into the conjoined forms of a bevy of nymphs.  Myriad white candles encircle the basin.  A rainbow glaes arch breaks the wall to the northeast, while double modwir doors to the south mute the bustle from the street beyond.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: Walls of boxes labeled "Picks" and "Lantern Parts" are piled three and four high, making a corridor that leads north and west.  The crates have certainly seen better days, as their boards are warping and their corners are coming apart.  A sagging arch opens in the south wall, away from the warehouse proper.

title: [Mikare's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table and a Vornavian silk-lined display case sit in opposite corners while a woven Vornavian silk rug rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [Mikare's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a miniature wooden gallows rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [Mikare's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table and a set of carved felwood shelves sit in opposite corners while a woven Vornavian silk rug rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [Tidepool Table]
description: Crafted completely of glaes, the table's center contains a sunken aquarium full of creatures and plants.  Sea urchins, corals, and anemones wave slowly from the rocky bottom and sides, while tiny, colorful damsel fish and basslets dart between them.  A single starfish has attached itself to the tabletop from the bottom, splaying its legs in the general directions of the driftwood chairs placed around the remarkable display.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: This room seems to provide a waiting area for several common workshops.  Bits of rope and rusted nails clutter the floor, likely escapees from the work rooms.  A sagging arch leads back into the warehouse.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: The warehouse suffers from a lack of light and ventilation.  Square outlines in the dust on the floor suggest that crates were here in the not-so-recent past.  Tiny pawprints track through the layers of dirt, leading in all directions.

title: [Locksmithing Workshop]
description: Long benches and tables line the walls.  Covering them are tools of all sizes, as well as long pieces of metal.  Thin shavings cover the floor as do little bits of different ores.  A set of skeleton keys hangs from a rack on one wall, glimmering in the low light.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: Heaps of boxes take up most of the floor in this tiny space.  The only way out seems to be the corridor of boxes to the west.  The rats, however, have created another option.  A hole opens in the wall to the east, surrounded by bits of grain, shavings of wood, and other pieces of a rat's collection.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: A trail of grain leads off to the east, along with a wide track of rather large rodent footprints.  Nearly covered by large crates is a door marked "Storage" in the north wall.  A thick layer of dust coats everything, tickling cruelly at your nose.

title: [Aydan's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Heust's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Heust's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Heust's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Storage Room]
description: This seems to be a storage area of some sort.  Tools for crating and uncrating goods sit in racks around the room, as do planks of wood and bins of nails.  A few rats scurry about in the shadows, disturbed by your presence.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court]
description: Lanterns hang from rope-suspended hooks, lighting the room.  A pair of sturdy-looking dwarves lean casually against the wall, appearing to simply be relaxing for a moment.  Their keen, alert gazes belie this, however.  A couple of stocky chairs sit around a makeshift table made from a crate, two mugs and various playing cards littering its surface.

title: [Wondrious's General Store]
description: An oil-filled copper sconce hangs on one of the rough white stucco walls, and a domed white stucco ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of striped throw pillows sits in one corner of a white limestone floor.  There is a set of carved felwood shelves on one side of the shop and a spacious grey slate counter on the other.

title: [Windpanguss' Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by refined oak-paneled walls, the shop features an elegantly woven reed mat in the center of its dark oak floor.  A trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs under the light oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a slender driftwood counter and a set of carved felwood shelves.

title: [Mrunk's Combat Gear]
description: Enclosed by rough white stucco walls, the shop features a plush black bear fur rug in the center of its dark oak floor.  A fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs under the white stucco ceiling.  Right near the front is a set of carved felwood shelves.

title: [Baelog's Weaponry]
description: Refined oak-paneled walls rise from an ash grey granite floor.  Just above a stuffed grizzly bear hangs an ornately rendered clan crest, and a dark and light oak ceiling completes the picture.  Some wrought-iron hooks and a hammered copper hanging rack stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Ayl's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling, a brilliant peacock painting hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls.  A set of carved felwood shelves and a long brass clothing rack sit in opposite corners while a plush black bear fur rug rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [Baelog's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, an oil-filled iron sconce hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A dented iron footlocker and a series of low oak shelves sit in opposite corners while a plush black bear fur rug rests on an ash grey granite floor.

title: [Baelog's Armory]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, a large Aenatumgana painting hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  Some wrought-iron hooks and a long carved oak counter sit in opposite corners while a well-armed stocky warrior statue rests on an ash grey granite floor.

title: [Midrian's Dyes, Green Stall]
description: Splattered dyes decorate the brick wall at the back of this stall, their dark hues forming an irregular drip mark that pools where the wall and granite cobblestones meet.  An oak-handled cotton mop, riddled with colored dyes, rests in the back corner opposite a tidy shelf painted a bright grass green.  At the center of the stall, a low stool stands beside a tin tub amongst a scattering of empty wooden buckets.

title: [Tlandro's General Store]
description: Beneath a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls.  Some hammered copper display hooks and a Vornavian silk-covered table sit in opposite corners while a thick off-white carpet rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [A Ceramic Tile Teleporting Ring]
description: Sunlight glints off of the cobalt blue and ebon tiles set into the slightly raised ground.  Large white stones form a perfect circle around the tiles, except where they are split to allow passage into the practice yard.

title: [Odd-shaped Driftwood Table]
description: Pieces of driftwood have been carved to resemble the broad wavy leaves of a mermaid's fan plant.  Each piece has been lashed to the next to form roughly a semi-circular table that tapers into what can only be the stem of the plant at the base of the table.  The driftwood appears to have been dyed a deep green color to give the carving a more natural appearance.

title: [Willow Hall, Courtyard]
description: The songs of birds living in the palisade fill the air of the cozy courtyard.  In the center stands a sculpture of Phoen and Oleani.  A walkway of round modwir disks leads from an archway in the palisade, and divides around the statuary, ending at the entrance to a wooden building.  The structure's walls are carved to mimic the living trees of the palisade, and are rendered with beautiful detail.

Soft moonlight bathes the courtyard in its silvery light, spotlighting a sculpture of Phoen and Oleani standing in the area's center.  A walkway of round windak disks leads from an archway in the palisade, and divides around the statuary, ending at the brightly lit entrance to a wooden building.  The structure's walls are carved to mimic the living trees of the palisade, the effect more convincing in Lady Night's gentle illumination.

The songs of birds living in the palisade fill the air of the cozy courtyard.  In the center stands a sculpture of Phoen and Oleani.  A walkway of round windak disks leads from an archway in the palisade, and divides around the statuary, ending at the entrance to a wooden building.  The structure's walls are carved to mimic the living trees of the palisade, and are rendered with beautiful detail.

title: [Forest Path]
description: The dirt path is lined with tall black willow trees, which are decorated with colorful streamers and pennants.  A colorful wooden kiosk stands in the center of the path.  The sound of music fills the air coming from the tent, which is crowded by a group of street performers.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Kizun's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling, a curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls.  A set of carved felwood shelves and a long carved oak counter sit in opposite corners while a plush black bear fur rug rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [Saisha's General Store]
description: Honey gold oak walls rise from a golden blonde oak floor.  Just above an iron candelabra hangs a peacock feather fan, and an oak beam ceiling completes the picture.  A narrow glass-topped table and a narrow glass-topped table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Braided Seaweed Rope Table]
description: Dried seaweed in every shade of green has been braided into thick strands of rope and coiled from the center in a dizzying spiral design to create the top of the table.  Each of the six helix rope legs appear to be made solely of the braided sea plant, but most likely consist of a wooden leg core that has been wrapped with the carefully crafted rope of rainbow green.

title: [Tlandro's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A cedar and oak footlocker sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Tlandro's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A heavy white granite counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Crayaligus' Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A heavy white granite counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Orainissa's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Orainissa's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court]
description: Several crates stacked against the north wall serve as low tables for the short folk that work here.  A group of dwarves stand about a box, holding the hand of a lone elf down on one of the crates.  Given the worried expression the elf is wearing and the flashing blade held by one of the dwarves, it is easy to guess that a game of mumbletypeg is going on.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court]
description: Dwarves wander through the room, walking easily but rapidly to their respective tasks.  Delectable, mouth-watering smells drift in through the door in the north wall.  Whatever's cooking smells strongly of garlic.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: This narrow hall branches to the north, west and southeast.  It seems quieter than other areas, perhaps because of the office of an important personage at the end of the corridor.

title: [Chamber of Prophecy]
description: Eerie stillness lingers on the air, heavy as the scent of wormwood incense drifting up from the chamber below.  Walls and a floor composed of highly polished brass reflect the dim luminescence washing off of a perfect silver sphere, its myriad reflections causing strange and dizzying tricks of the light.  The orb stands atop an ornately wrought brass bracket at the center of the chamber.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workshop]
description: Workbenches and boxes of tools dominate the room.  Bits of wood and metal have been scattered about, forgotten leavings of past projects.  By the look of the benches and the care taken of the tools, it is obvious that fine craftsmen work here.

title: [Willow Hall, Great Room]
description: The huge, columned room functions as the meeting room of Willow Hall.  Linden, haon and modwir squares form the floor, skillfully laid so the multi-hued woods blend together.  The walls are richly carved with woodland scenes, and the columns are tree trunks left untouched.  Rows of benches face a raised dais with a podium and a few chairs.  Through a fieldstone arch flanked by two stained-glass windows, one can glimpse a moonlit garden.

The huge, columned room functions as the meeting room of Willow Hall.  Linden, haon and modwir squares form the floor, skillfully laid so the multi-hued woods blend together.  The walls are richly carved with woodland scenes, and the columns are tree trunks left untouched.  Rows of benches face a raised dais with a podium and a few chairs.  Through a fieldstone arch flanked by two stained-glass windows, one can glimpse a garden.

title: [Redwing Spire, Anteroom]
description: Glistening stained crystal windows ring the room, casting small pools of crimson-tinged moonlight amidst larger, brighter ones unsullied by intruding hues.  Walls of alabaster are polished to a white-golden shine, their surfaces nigh as smooth as the slabs of mirror-finished marble that comprise the floor.  Beneath a tall red-lacquered arch, the sinuous rise of a long stairway begins, sprouting as if something organic from the curved walls as it rises.

title: [Redwing Spire, Murre View]
description: Bathed by sunlight gushing in through a crystal dome in the ceiling, the procession of golden-veined marble stairs is supported by a thin frame that makes it seem suspended in air between a tremendous window in the northeastern wall and a fountain with a glass basin that rings the opposing.  The window looks out on the bustling corner where Murre and Eider meet, while the basin is filled with a different sort of life: numerous koi flicking through its depths like falling gold and silver coins.

Bathed by starlight winking in through a crystal dome in the ceiling, the procession of golden-veined marble stairs is supported by a thin frame that makes it seem suspended in air between a tremendous window in the northeastern wall and a fountain with a glass basin that rings the opposing.  The window looks out on the dark corner where Murre and Eider meet, while the basin is filled with life: numerous koi flicking through its depths like falling gold and silver coins.

title: [Redwing Spire, Landing]
description: Twists of silver lace spin through the glass of the dome overhead, forming a pattern reminiscent of a whelk's shell that casts twisting shadows over a crescent-shaped landing sprouting from the tower wall.  Stairs glide up and down from the landing, carved of the same gold-veined white marble as the landing.  A velvet rope prevents further progress upwards.  Twin columns of alabaster match the material and hue of the walls.  They border a stained cherrywood door in the western wall.

Twists of silver lace spin through the night-darkened glass of the dome overhead, forming a pattern reminiscent of a whelk's shell that casts twisting shadows over a crescent-shaped landing sprouting from the tower wall.  Stairs glide up and down from the landing, carved of the same gold-veined white marble as the landing.  A velvet rope prevents further progress upwards.  Twin columns of alabaster that match the material and hue of the walls.  They border a stained cherrywood door in the western wall.

title: [Narcis Hold, Gloaming Walk]
description: Set at intervals down the length of the stone hallway are a trio of recessed alcoves, each boasting a smoking censer atop a pedestal of whorled glaes.  Three of the niches are home to well-preserved tapestries.  Shafts of radiance spill through slits on the western wall, blazing bright through the wisps of incense smoke.  Near the end of the walk, a series of stone steps spirals up into the ceiling.

title: [Narcis Hold, Terrace]
description: A lattice-worked mistwood awning expands over the terrace entry, the crisscrossing slats entwined by a thicket of climbing vines that twist into a canopy of deep green foliage.  Lace-like ivory blossoms cling to the reedy limbs of five persimmon trees surrounding a silvery marble refectory table centered on the pale stone floor.  On alternating sides of a narrow path, angular glass lanterns and azalea bushes lead to a tranquil pond nestled in a bed of rain lilies.

title: [Narcis Hold, Master's Chambers]
description: Dominated by an expansive four-poster bed draped by clouds of burgundy gauze, the cavernous suite has ample room for a sprawling circular table etched with a map of Elanith.  Stained crystal windows in the western wall spit shards of carmine and indigo light onto the red-veined black tiles underfoot.  Steps etched out of the marble travel up to a recessed archway in the northern wall, which houses a modest stone altar and accompanying statuary.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Meeting Room]
description: Polished to a gleaming shine, an enormous pale oak table sits in the center of the room, surrounded by high-backed chairs accented with blue velvet.  Placed under a silk-draped window on the western wall, a large sideboard supports a silver and glass tray.  A tapestry map of Solhaven, woven from fine Vornavian wool, hangs upon the northern wall.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: A single lantern hangs from the ceiling, casting a very dim light around the room.  A few scratched cases contain odd memorabilia, and several roughly sketched maps hang from the wall.  Almost hidden in the shadows of a corner is a desk, a comfortable if ratty chair pulled up behind it.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court]
description: A rat peeks out of a small hole in the wall.  It seems quite well-fed and happy, obviously dining on the leftovers of the guild.  Upon seeing you, it chitters at you scoldingly and runs back into his bower.

title: [Rogue Guild, Shop]
description: Relatively bright lanterns spill dirty light over the wares on the tables in this room.  Items from Tonis-Knows-Where have been placed on display, resting on cheap velvet.  Several assistants amble about, adjusting the merchandise.

title: [Trading Post, Dry Goods]
description: Backpacks, sacks and cloaks are folded neatly onto shelves behind the counter.  A few flasks filled with colored liquid decorate the crossbeams overhead.  Flickering candles add a little light to the otherwise dim, windowless room.  Heat billows in from the wood burning stove in the foyer to the east.

title: [Trading Post, Jeweler]
description: A tall counter stretches across the center of the room, a latched swinging door being the only route to the area behind it.  The red carpeting is somewhat worn on a path from the counter back to the center of the trading post.  A long table behind the counter has piles of different gems on it, sorted by size, color, and type.  The pass through the mountains is visible out of the window to the east.

title: [Trading Post, Furrier]
description: The thin carpeting is mostly covered with a plush bearskin rug.  A few small skins cover the otherwise bare wooden walls.  The rock barrier of the mountainside is the only thing visible out of the window.  A stout dwarf works diligently behind the counter, measuring and cutting skins of all kinds.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Gathering]
description: Several rows of beribboned benches rest on an immaculately manicured lawn.  Running through the center of the gathering area, a small aisle leads up to a dais, which stands four steps high.  The stage is neatly tucked between two towering beech trees that have colorful streamers tied to some of the lower branches.  Dark blue and thick, a swathe of fabric draped over the podium on the platform has a single star on its center embroidered in shimmering white thread.  High above, stars twinkle in the night sky.
