The stage is neatly tucked between towering beech trees that have colorful streamers tied to some of the lower branches.  Dark blue and thick, a swathe of fabric draped over the podium on the platform has a single star on its center embroidered in shimmering white thread.  In the distance, tiny pine trees dot the snow-capped mountains.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: The split rail fence is interspersed with shrubs bearing small leathery leaves, pinkish urn-shaped flowers, and red berry-like fruits.  Some of the railings are beribboned in a rainbow of colors.  At the entrance, twin woodcarvings depict teams of brawny individuals separated by a long rope which forms the top of a doublewide gate.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: Tiny shrubs bearing small pinkish flowers and white berries encircle the perimeter of a dilapidated two-story building.  As if painted by the hand of a child, the image of a lopsided mug topped with foam decorates the door.  Attached to a braided rope, a rusty bucket rests on the lip of a well.  Slumped against its side is a tattered doll.  The branches of a dead tree droop over the thatch roof, blackened pieces of its bark littering the ground.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Barroom]
description: Mismatched barstools showing signs of disrepair face a stained and badly damaged bar, which stands at the back of the taproom.  Hanging on a peg behind the bar is a loaded heavy crossbow, and a quiver filled with bolts leans against the wall.  Soot streaks blacken the walls where torches that provide some illumination to the room are chained.  A narrow staircase leads to the second floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, out

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Hallway]
description: Standing off to one side of the hallway is a tarnished brass spittoon that is tucked partially beneath an oval-shaped table.  Lining the corridor are brass, steel, and copper-inlaid doors with tiny ribbons hanging from their doorknobs.  Some creaky stairs lead back down to the barroom.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: With hands on hips and decked out from head to toe in a red and blue plaid kilt, hat, and scarf, a faceless mannequin stands near the door of a red-thatched cottage.  Clusters of blue, red, and black trafel mushrooms crowd together between the feet of the dummy.  White smoke wafts through the chimney hole on the roof of the hut, where a wooden female figurine wears bulky skirts.  She looms above the smokestack with a ladle, as if stirring a huge cauldron.

title: [Kilarkien's Clothing Shop]
description: Dangling from the ceiling, a crystal wind chime twirls gently filling the air with its melodious tinkling.  Neatly folded scarves rest on the corner of a long glass counter.  In each corner of the pristine shop stands a smartly dressed mannequin.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: Carved from a thick piece of wood and set atop the gate of a split rail fence, a female figure is scrunched down atop an upside-down shield, and her hands tightly grip the shield's rim.  A scarf, wrapped around the neck of the statue, flies up and spreads out behind her, as if caught in a strong gust of air.  The figure's wind-blown hair, bulging eyes, and wide open mouth impart a whimsical appearance.  Farther down the road, a tree stump has pushed aside a section of the fence.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: Slumped against metal poles, straw-stuffed figures wearing hats that are slightly askew are erected way out in the middle of a pumpkin patch.  Catching the wind, cloaks draped around the scarecrows flutter wildly on the current of air.  Every so often, the hump of some furry broad-backed critter ambles idly in the field before falling out of sight.

title: [A Fur-Draped Tent]
description: The inner lining of the tent is leather, wrapped one layer upon the next, and insulated by heavy pelts placed here and there.  Bowed beams arch overhead, creating a frame and supporting the structure as tufts of animal fur in tawny hues peek out from between the leather layers.  A richly toned wildcat fur drapes the opening in the front of the tent, providing a means of exit as well as a barrier against the outside.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: The land slopes upward, and bare patches of dirt show through the overgrown grass that has a smattering of purple racemes peeking out across the pasture.  Dwarfed bramble dots the landscape, and thorny rosebushes are intertwined within the gaps of a split rail fence.  Propped atop the gate of the fence, the wooden statuette of a hulking male figure clutching a thick log tilts slightly to the left.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Slope]
description: Thick foliage of lush winter greenery serves as a backdrop for a magnificent wood carved statue of a hulking male figure clutching a thick log.  Stacked handaxes are neatly piled up behind an arrangement of benches and tables in a roped off clearing.

title: [The Tattered Tartan Tent]
description: Strips of tartan in numerous styles and colors are sewn haphazardly together and backed by worn leather to form the walls of this slightly tattered but reasonably cozy tent.  A bedroll is pushed into a corner, and strips of sinew and suede criss-cross the tent's ceiling, creating a makeshift rack from which several pouches, fetishes, and talismans dangle.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: Little more than pieces of wood nailed together, a small rectangular shack burps smoke that drifts up through a hole in its roof.  Loganberry plants trail up the sides of the hovel and partially obscures the doorway.  Swinging back and forth on its freshly oiled hinges, the gate of the split rail fence is bedecked with a garishly painted woodcarving of a muscle-bound male hefting a huge hammer over his head.

Loganberry trails up the sides of the hovel and partially obscures the doorway.  Swinging back and forth on its freshly oiled hinges, the gate of the split rail fence is bedecked with a garishly painted woodcarving of a muscle-bound male hefting a huge hammer over his head.

title: [A Patched Tent]
description: Thick oak poles support this once fine tent.  Showing the wear of time, the inside of the tent is patched in a multitude of places.  Mismatched lengths of canvas, leather, and cloth have been sewn into the fabric of the tent to help keep the elements out.  Various bits of weaponry are haphazardly shoved into a wooden barrel that sits next to a black pedestal table.  An aged wooden weapon rack upon a tightly-woven wool rug sits off to one side.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: A low mist covers the ground, drifting across the soil like searching fingers.  Several paces from the hard-packed dirt road, standing approximately eight feet high, an obelisk with numerous strange runes and designs carved within its surface rises from the haze.  Several smaller stones encircle the pillar, and flowers that still bear their roots surround these smaller rocks.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Meadow]
description: Tall trees stand sentinel on both sides of the road, blanketing it with a thick layer of browned pine needles and other foliage.  Colorful streamers hanging from the branches of the trees dance wildly on the breeze.  Clumped beneath a few of the trees are mushrooms sporting mottled white egg-shaped caps.  Underneath this miniature forest of mushrooms, a white powder coats the ground.  A gated main entrance leads to the fairgrounds.

title: [A Sturdy Tent]
description: Crafted of sturdy canvas with solid oak supports, the tent's walls are lined with coarse linen woven in intricate black knotwork patterns and back-dyed in subdued hues of blues, greens, and reds.  A silver-worked modwir trunk holds numerous armbands, and a small tanik case displays various aemikvai.

title: [A Sturdy Tent, Darkened Corner]
description: Crafted of sturdy canvas with solid oak supports, this back corner of the tent is partially obscured from the main area by numerous swathes of knotwork-patterned linen.  Dusty and dark, the corner's only accoutrements are a simple bedroll and a small fel trunk with a candle perched on its flat lid.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: Placed in the front yard of a quaint, loganberry-covered cabin, a three-wheeled wagon serves as a planter and has orderly rows of moonflowers.  Needle-shaped leaves from the surrounding pine trees blanket the ground.  Tall and wide, a haystack with a huge gap through its middle stands at the side of the small structure.

title: [Inside The Haystack]
description: Sunlight streams in through gaps of the straw, providing some warmth and illumination.  The air is sweet and fragrant and the faint sounds of tiny critters are barely audible.  The hayrick seems a perfect spot for relaxing.

title: [An Empty Cabin]
description: A fire blazes from the interior of an old pot-bellied stove.  A single chair is pulled up to a rickety table.  Untouched, a plate of food is pushed to the table's center.  Dust covers the floor, and cobwebs crowd the corners of the empty cabin.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: Drippings from several melted candles are congealed on the bottom of a cairn, which is constructed from an assortment of brightly hued smooth stones and situated between two sassafras trees.  Pale yellow curtains adorn the windows of a blue-thatched stone cottage.  Flanking both sides of its doorway are twin steins with open lids painted in a deep crimson.  Prickly brambles with thimble-shaped fruits have been carefully planted and nurtured along the front and sides of the stone hut.

title: [Merkarne's Gift Shop]
description: The single torch on the back wall dimly lights the smoky interior of the shop.  In the center of the floor, a throw rug with a pattern of overlapping spheres adds a nice touch to the room.  A long wood counter with a sign reading "Don't be shy!  Step right up and order!" is nailed to the front of it.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: Nestled between a stand of fir trees, water flows through breaks in the ice of a partially frozen brook of water, which runs alongside the two-story building.  Loganberry clings heartily to the entire north side of the edifice, and its over-ripened fruit litters the surrounding ground.  Soft candlelight spills out from the doorway, casting a hazy glow over a rolton that is calmly nibbling at the berries of a shrub that stands beneath the window of the tavern.

Nestled between a stand of fir trees, water flows through breaks in the ice of the partially frozen brook of water, which runs alongside the two-story building.  Loganberry clings heartily to the entire north side of the edifice, and its over-ripened fruit litters the surrounding ground.  Standing beneath the window of the tavern, a wood carved rolton is positioned to give the illusion of the statue eating berries from a shrub.

title: [Hairless Rolton Tavern, Taproom]
description: Sunlight enters through the brocade curtains with diamond cutouts, creating a series of identical dimmed patterns on the polished dark-stained floor.  Roltons in whimsical poses are carved into the wood panel that covers the barroom, illuminated by brass lanterns, which are scattered throughout the room.  Hanging above the wall behind a semi-circular bar, with half-moon barstools surrounding it, is a stuffed caribou head with honey-colored glass eyes.  Carved with leaves and vines, a spiral staircase leads up to the second floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, out

title: [Hairless Rolton Tavern, Hallway]
description: Standing on opposite corners of the corridor on plush emerald green carpeting are identical brass flowerpots with intricate designs etched into their surface.  Gilded scrollwork decorates the long table set in the middle of the hall.  Three doors with swirled royal blue, crimson, and mulberry motifs line the hallway.  The spiral staircase leads back down to the taproom.

title: [A Dirt-Floored Stall]
description: The wooden plank walls of this modestly sized stall are covered with a variety of pelts and skins.  Some are painted with rustic symbols, while others are fixed with small talismans in various animal shapes.  Set up near the back of the stall is a low counter with a three-legged stool behind it.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Fairground]
description: Nuts enclosed in prickly burs surround the bole of a large beech tree.  Some of the burs are split open revealing their moldy insides.  A piece of rotting wood with a medium-sized boulder holding down one corner lies near the tree.  Irregularly shaped, the board does little to cover a huge gaping hole in the ground.  The mewling sounds of small animals emanate from within the opening.  Dangling from one of the branches of the tree, a translucent skin turned inside out blows on a breeze.

title: [A Lofty Peaked Tent]
description: The scent of leather and tanning oils hangs heavy in the air within the tent, unable to be banished by the sage bundle burning within a large clam shell toward the back.  Overhead, suits of armor are hung in various stages of creation, like empty skins left by shedding snakes.  In a half-moon at the center of the area are some leather straw-stuffed mannequins.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Caber Toss]
description: All that remains are stumps that create a potential hazard as the surrounding area is practically devoid of trees, of any size.  Mounds of timber, covered by moldy canvas and held by chains are stockpiled in several spots behind a table.  To the south are several more clearings, each with its own set of spectator benches.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Caber Toss]
description: While half of this clearing is still cluttered with the stubs of long-ago chopped trees, the remainder has been carefully cleaned of stumps, roots, and other impediments.  Tiered modwir benches overlook runways that are outlined in white paint and extend the length of the hazard-free section, ending abruptly at the edge of a deep crevasse.  A pyramid-like arrangement of logs rests on the other side of the chasm.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Caber Toss]
description: While half of this clearing is still cluttered with the stubs of long-ago chopped trees, the remainder has been carefully cleaned of stumps, roots, and other impediments.  Tiered cedar benches overlook runways that are outlined in white paint and extend the length of the hazard-free section, ending abruptly at the edge of a deep crevasse.  A pyramid-like arrangement of logs rests on the other side of the chasm.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Caber Toss]
description: Scraped clean of snow all the way down to dirt level, a long narrow lane is delineated by long stripes of white paint set with white-painted pebbles.  A chasm lies at the far end of the runway, and a row of yellow warning flags has been hammered into the ground about two giantman-strides short of its edge.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Eastern View]
description: The vast range of the Dragonspine Mountains is visible in the distant east.  The valley beneath is heavily forested with mighty aspens whose leaves shimmer and glisten in the winds that swirl down from the distant heights.  Amid the silvery forest, the shadowy form of a grove of seven massive modwir trees can be discerned, translucent and wavering as if a mirage.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Sandpit]
description: A mass of cut lumber, covered by canvas and held by thick rope, is stockpiled in several spots behind a table.  Runways outlined with blue paint lead towards the edge of a sandpit.  Logs arranged in a pyramid-like fashion rest on the other side of the sand trap.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Chasm's Edge]
description: Numerous stumps dot the hilltop's landscape, though they are surrounded by not only full-grown trees, but also by a handful of saplings.  Mounds of timber, covered by black canvas and held by chains, are stockpiled in several spots.  Runways outlined with white paint are visible through the trees further up.  To one side, the edge of the tree growth ends abruptly at the edge of a deep chasm.  Logs arranged in a pyramid-like fashion rest on the other side of the gorge.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Aspen View]
description: At the base of the hill, a vast forest of silver-barked aspens stretches far into the distance towards the Dragonspine mountain range.  The dim, shadowy form of a stand of seven huge trees, their heights stretching as high as the mountain foothills to the east, shimmers and distorts as the winds cascade down from the distant range, rustling the surrounding woods into a chaotic, swaying mass.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Aspen Path]
description: A vast forest of aspen trees, silver-barked with leaves of shimmering gold, stretches out from the hillock to the distant Dragonspine mountains in the east.  The shadowy forms of seven mighty modwir trees rise from amidst the wood, towering over the terrain.  Their translucent forms waver and shimmer in the perpetual winds blasting down from the mountain heights.

title: [Aspen Forest, Glade]
description: At the base of Jirkirl's hill, a glade of frost-covered heather exists in stark contrast to the huge forest of aspens which surrounds it.  Trickling down from the crags of the hillock, a shallow creek of snow-melt makes its way out into the clearing, winding towards the trunks of the wood nearby.  The fading remnants of a footpath follow the tiny rivulet into the forest.

title: [Aspen Forest, Ancient Path]
description: With a floor of frost-covered leaves several lengths deep, this forested area looks like it has not been disturbed for years untold.  Mighty aspens cover the mist-shrouded land, their trunks stretching high overhead.  Scarcely a breath of wind is detectable though small patches of sunlight dance upon the scene, bespeaking powerful winds near the tree tops.  A winding furrow creasing the fallen leaves suggests an ancient path, long unused, may lay below.

title: [Aspen Forest, Gate]
description: An immense wall of frost-covered deadwood stretches across the misty forest.  The masses of branches have been stacked and woven together into an impenetrable barrier.  An overgrown path leads to a gate in the wall which has been framed by two mighty aspen trees. The portal has been constructed from a solid sheet of modwir and is covered with living vines which have spread along the surrounding walls, rendering it useless.  Clearly, this has not been opened in hundreds of years.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Caber Toss]
description: While half of this clearing is still cluttered with the stubs of long-ago chopped trees, the remainder has been carefully cleaned of stumps, roots, and other impediments.  Tiered elmwood benches overlook runways that are outlined in white paint and extend the length of the hazard-free section, ending abruptly at the edge of a deep crevasse.  A pyramid-like arrangement of logs rests on the other side of the chasm.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Caber Toss]
description: While half of this clearing is still cluttered with the stubs of long-ago chopped trees, the remainder has been carefully cleaned of stumps, roots, and other impediments.  Tiered maple benches overlook runways that are outlined in white paint and extend the length of the hazard-free section, ending abruptly at the edge of a deep crevasse.  A pyramid-like arrangement of logs rests on the other side of the chasm.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Caber Toss]
description: While half of this clearing is still cluttered with the stubs of long-ago chopped trees, the remainder has been carefully cleaned of stumps, roots, and other impediments.  Tiered walnut benches overlook runways that are outlined in white paint and extend the length of the hazard-free section, ending abruptly at the edge of a deep crevasse.  A pyramid-like arrangement of logs rests on the other side of the chasm.

title: [A Dirt-Floored Stall]
description: From the support posts overhead, a myriad of trinkets and totems dangle, some on braided cords and others on lengths of suede.  Feathers, gems, and carvings work in tandem to create a motif found on the walls as well as in the form of masks and ceremonial attire.

title: [Hairless Rolton Tavern, Parlor]
description: Pale stones of assorted sizes comprise the hearth, which is the heart of the room.  Pure white with sharp fangs exposed, a polar bear rug lies stretched out directly in front of the fireplace.  Strategically placed to accent the multicolored floor tiles that are patterned to form the image of a rolton, matching end tables inlaid with lapis lazuli stand beside high-backed chairs.  A silver serving cart with mugs of coffee and hot chocolate rests in a corner.

title: [Hairless Rolton, Dining Hall]
description: The center of the dark-stained parquet floor is covered with a white polar bear rug.  Every so often soft chimes emit overhead from a heavy crystal chandelier as it twirls gently from the chains securing it to the ceiling.  Scattered around the room to provide some privacy are some tables adorned with lacy, antique white tablecloths.  At the back of the room, an overburdened serving cart with several empty mugs and dirty dishes partially blocks the doorway to the kitchen.

title: [Hairless Rolton, Kitchen Entry]
description: You find yourself in a narrow hallway that leads from the dining hall to the kitchen.  Scattered around the hallway are several serving carts, their tops showing off the remains of partially eaten food.  A long counter is set against one wall, just below a small window that looks out from the kitchen.  Savory-smelling smoke rises through the window.

title: [Hairless Rolton, Trophy Room]
description: The prisms from a multifaceted crystal chandelier, which twirls gently from the chains that secure it to the ceiling, clack together and create a melodious jingle.  As the crystal prisms spin overhead, light catches and reflects like sunbursts from the numerous brass plaques that hang at regular intervals throughout the chamber.  Delicate crystal decanters in various shapes and sizes adorn the mantle above the fireplace.

title: [Hairless Rolton, Keg Room]
description: Huge labeled kegs line up on both sides of the room, effectively blocking the windows behind them.  Above the casks are shelves stacked with mugs.  An enormous table bordered by mismatched chairs that have surely seen better days dominates the center of the room.  Clean straw and nutshells compete in an effort of covering the stone floor.  Leaking its contents on the floor, a keg in the corner gives off a strange hissing sound.  On the opposite side of the room, twin barrels overflow with freshly roasted nuts.

title: [Hairless Rolton, Mulberry Room]
description: Dark purple carpeting patterned with vines and leaves in gold spreads from wall to wall.  Piles of tasseled pillows are placed near the fireplace.  Opaque lilac netting drapes elegantly from the top of the canopy bed and is tied back with a white, braided cord to display the mulberry-colored leaf-embroidered coverlet.  Soft pools of light emanate from the tinted globes of oil lamps and reflect off the polished surfaces of matching end tables that flank the bed, enhancing the cozy atmosphere of the bedchamber.

title: [Hairless Rolton, Crimson Room]
description: Soft pools of light emanate from the tinted globes of oil lamps and reflect off the polished surfaces of matching end tables that flank the bed, enhancing the cozy atmosphere of the bedchamber.  Shimmering yellow netting drapes elegantly from the top of the canopy bed and is tied back with a blood red, braided cord to display the crimson heart-embroidered coverlet.  Blood red carpeting patterned with hearts in gold spreads from wall to wall.  Piles of tasseled pillows are placed near the fireplace.

title: [Hairless Rolton, Blue Room]
description: Sheer blue netting drapes elegantly from the top of the canopy bed and is tied back with a white, braided cord to display the royal blue butterfly-embroidered coverlet.  Soft pools of light emanate from the tinted globes of oil lamps and reflect off the polished surfaces of matching end tables that flank the bed, enhancing the cozy atmosphere of the bedchamber.  Dark blue carpeting patterned with butterflies in gold spreads from wall to wall.  Piles of tasseled pillows are placed near the fireplace.

title: [A Lofty Peaked Tent, Armor]
[A Lofty Peaked Tent]
description: Here, metal scraps and parts of armor lay in disrepair across a scarred oak table that takes up a large part of the available space.  Set on the outer edge of the table in presentation are suits of armor and a variety of pieces meant for sale.  Behind the table is a stool and a plethora of metalworking tools.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Meadow]
description: An enormous boulder bearing an uncanny resemblance to a frog wearing a hat sits off the side of the road.  The rock is completely coated in a slimy green fungus.  Gooseberries line up along the edge of the hard dirt-packed road, and numerous yellow and red berries have been trampled into the ground.

title: [Transport, Oval Room]
description: The compartment of this small, white, egg-like device is just large enough for a single passenger.  Traveling in relative silence, as if thrown from its point of origin, the conveyance is completely opaque, except for a transparent panel in the floor.  Though thick and quite solid, the crystalline floor allows a clear view of the landscape below.  Affixed to the wall near the entry, a small golden sigil, made up of several conjoined gears, intimates gnomish origin.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Meadow]
description: An oval pattern in the ground has been cleared away, and an ice sculpture of two males, each grasping the forearm of the other in apparent friendship, is set in its center.  Tables and benches are scattered around the meadow, and vases with a single snow pansy are placed on the tabletops, serving as centerpieces.  The meadow is speckled with plants bearing a wooly, whitish down on their flower heads.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Meadow]
description: Frost covers the ground, and icicles cling to the branches of trees.  Multicolored streamers have been tied around many of the tree trunks, creating a festive atmosphere.  Brambles covered with thimble-shaped fruit in shades of red, white, and black add a splash of color to the countryside.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Meadow]
description: Canvas is pulled tightly between two trees, and beneath the shelter stands a long stone pedestal.  Indecipherable runes and designs etched into the structure are even harder to make out as the loganberry that covers the sides allows only glimpses here and there.  A smattering of golden aster stalks dot the landscape as far as the eye can see.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Meadow]
description: Placed strategically to provide a panoramic view of the surrounding meadow, wooden benches are scattered about.  The middle plank is missing from one of the benches, and from the gap, a thornberry bush thrives.  Its thorny vines are intertwined through the rest of the wooden frame.  Shoved behind a tree, the crumbled remains of a stone structure are unidentifiable, except for what looks to be an eyeball staring heavenward.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Meadow]
description: A natural canopy overhead, formed by the growth of towering trees, creates a perpetual shade.  Devoid of leaves, the boles of two trees are twisted together.  Their branches, eerily like arms, seem to consciously cover the fissure set in the core of its gouged trunk, as if trying to hide a rising scream or stifle a sneeze.  Suspended from the lower branch, a broken wind chime bounces erratically with every gusting breeze.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Firkin Room]
description: Overturned, small wooden tubs are positioned alongside chairs encircling a long sideboard that has the hilt of a dagger deeply embedded within its surface.  Along the back wall, a dart board hangs above a warped cask.  Placed in the middle of a slightly battered pedestal is a leather-bound black book.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Tabac Room]
description: The sweet smell of tabac permeates the room, and wisps of smoke drift lazily in the air.  Very few scuffmarks mar the surface of the polished wood floor, upon which padded chairs and tables are deliberately arranged around a dais that is three steps high.  A wooden podium rests in its center and is the focal point of the room.  Carved from wood and made to resemble a bear's paw is a box filled with clay pipes and set on the mantel above the fireplace.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Bar]
description: A smattering of mismatched stools are pulled up to a stained bar, which is, for all purposes, a slab of wood that looks to have taken multiple beatings.  Long scratches, deep nicks, and warped sections mar the bartop, and the display of drinks and food atop it does little to hide the destruction.  Behind the bar, there are more nicks in the wall, as if someone has shot several arrows or a handaxe or two in its direction.  Several torches send flickering light and moving shadows scattering through the area.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Pilum Room]
description: Moss green carpeting with badly worn patches spreads from wall to wall in this bedchamber.  Wicker end tables flank a small wicker-framed bed that has multihued spheres embroidered on the coverlet.  In one corner of the room, propped against the paneled wall, is a life-sized stuffed polar bear.  One the opposite wall, a pilum is hung on metal brackets.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Mace Room]
description: A pair of crossed leather-wrapped maces hang above a hand-carved modwir sleighbed.  On the right side of the bed, a blanket is draped over the back of a rocking chair.  Piled in front of the partially bricked-up fireplace are blackened logs and a box of tinder.  Tiny footprints from some kind of rodent are visible through the ashes that have been scattered across the hearth.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Dining Area]
description: Resting on an elevated section of the faded wood flooring, a serving cart appears ready to topple over from the weight of its burden.  Thick layers of sawdust mixed with straw cover the floor completely in some places.  Strategically placed to offer a modicum of privacy, as well as to hide gaps in the floorboards, a tall serving counter is centered amidst a score of wobbly tables with stained and discolored tablecloths.

title: [A Fur-Draped Tent]
description: The arching support of the beams overhead are adorned in this area by small, beaded totems - some made of carved bone and others of various woods.  A raised firepit occupies the heart of the space, the smoke it creates escaping through a cleverly created flue amid the leather canopy above.  Figures and sigils of a stylized nature have been painted onto the leather walls in thick, darkly pigmented pastes.

title: [Vendaic's Tent, Private Quarter]
description: Piggybacked to the main body of the tent, the room is small with a slopping ceiling of weathered leather and rawhide.  Near the entry flap is a simple basket-covered table and a plain wooden bench, while several sleeping furs are neatly arranged near the outer wall.  A hanging lantern casts odd shadows on the floor, which is covered by a thick patterned wool blanket.

title: [Vendaic's Tent, Common Room]
description: Birch trees bend into a gentle arc at the tent's wide ceiling, the thin lengths wrapped with suede and rawhide to create a weather-tight seal.  The central pole supports the center of the tent, where a wide opening is positioned over a deep fire pit and is filled with a view of the celestial bodies above.  Towards the back, a slender tent flap leads further into the tent, while several leather bags and a series of woven seagrass containers lie in ordered chaos throughout the room.

Birch trees bend into a gentle arc at the tent's wide ceiling, the thin lengths wrapped with suede and rawhide to create a weather-tight seal.  The central pole supports the center of the tent, where a wide opening is positioned over a deep fire pit and allows streams of sunlight to slant across the room.  At the back, a slender tent flap leads further into the tent, while several leather saddlebags and a series of woven sea grass baskets lay in ordered chaos throughout the room.

title: [The Plaid Cloth]
description: Swathes of tartan cloth lay draped across a large worktable that has been fitted into the northern wall, their vibrant lengths illuminated by brass lanterns.  Various forms stand guard beneath wall-mounted wooden shields decorated with the different symbols of the giantkin clans.  Large oak containers rest back to back in the middle of the room, their lids flung open to display various pelt and hide garments.  A wicker basket holds hammered brooches near the tent's entry.

Various mannequins stand guard beneath wall-mounted wooden shields decorated with the different symbols of the Giantkin clans.  Oak trunks rest back to back in the middle of the room, their lids flung open to display various pelt and hide garments.  A wicker basket holds hammered brooches near the tent's entry.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Slope]
description: Peering down the snow-covered hill, a natural obstacle course of trees and other shrubbery dots the landscape.  Meandering through the trees are several rutted paths devoid of snow.  Some of the trails end abruptly at the bases of trees, where the debris of shattered shields still litters the ground.  A makeshift awning constructed from pieces of wood with canvas pulled tightly over its surface protects the piles of shields from inclement weather.  On the edge of the slope rests a long table and chair.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Small Valley]
description: Decumbent shrubbery covers the ground beneath the tall trees like a lush blanket.  The surrounding area is littered with needles, pine nuts and other detritus.  Churned snow and mud is thoroughly mixed along the rutted trail that leads up the mountain.  Here and there, the pathway veers off in another direction to avoid fallen trees.

title: [Jirkirl's Hilltop, Open Field]
description: A number of pine benches are nestled between snowbanks at the edges of a barren stretch of ground.  Scattered about the ground are long sections of stout rope, many of them now frayed and rotting.

title: [Forest Path, Kiosk]
description: The kiosk isn't very large, with no entries of any sort to gain entrance inside the small stall.  Behind the wyrmwood counter, a shifty-looking goblin leans against the back wall.  A lantern hanging from the each side of the counter dimly lights the area with a ghoulish green light.

title: [Paradise Realty]
description: A long bamboo counter covered with neatly stacked piles of deeds stretches across the back wall.  Pictures of island properties hang above the desk in a nice straight row along the wall.  Baskets of fresh cut island flowers adorn the few tables where a couple of buyers skim through books on the local environs.

title: [Teslya's Deed Exchange]
description: A virtual riot of color adorns three of the walls in this cubbyhole of an office.  No rhyme or reason accompanied the brush strokes of the artist, but whatever they were attempting, it simply does not come together.  The remaining wall is covered with framed paintings and an oversized certificate on each side of the large wooden door.  A simple desk and chair set is planted in the exact middle of the room.

title: [Island Movers]
description: A faint, dry breeze from an open window sends dust bunnies scurrying across the floor in mock races.  Behind a desk strewn with travel manifests, shipping logs, receipt books, and mounted behind a potted sunflower is an enormous blackboard.  A small sign is tacked to the front of the desk.

title: [Isle Dyes, Courtyard]
description: Walled with heavy white canvas that plummets down in straight lines from the supporting poles, the dyeing area is large, wide, and airy.  The roof overhead is also made of canvas, though it is raised several feet higher than the walls on separate poles to allow sunlight to filter in.  Billowing in the passing breeze, light drapes, of a sheer white variety that is a lovely contraposition to the blue tile flooring, serve as dividers between the courtyard and the individual dyeing stalls.

title: [Mist Harbor, Southern Gates]
description: Twin towers rise up on either side of the wrought iron gates, the terra cotta tiles of their roofs standing out in dark contrast to the muted yellow paint that decorates their faces.  Stretching east and west of the entry is a tall stockade fence, while a wide dirt pathway disappears into the jungle.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Western Harbor, Approach]
description: Thick blades of beach grass rise upon either side of the cobblestone pathway as it gently curves away from a large stone wall and down toward a quaint harbor.  Sunlight glitters off of the dark blue waters, where boats can be seen bobbing safely from their moorings.

Thick blades of beach grass rise upon either side of the cobblestone pathway as it gently curves away from a large stone wall and down toward a quaint harbor.  Pale moonlight glitters off of the dark blue waters, where shadowy objects can be seen bobbing up and down.

title: [Forest Path]
description: Covered by colorful lichen, the remains of a fieldstone walkway line the path.  Barely visible through the foliage, a passage leads toward a cemetery.  Faint glimmers of will-o'-wisps dance around in the surrounding swamp's forest, though they seem to stay well clear of a massive fallen tree.

title: [Hall of the Arkati, Chamber]
description: The musty smells of damp earth and moldering stone clash with the acrid smoke from guttering censers scattered throughout this narrow space tucked between the foundations of massive columns.  Someone has hung some old tapestries in the gaps between the footings, but their decaying and moth-eaten fabrics do little but reinforce the shabbiness of the area  The only furnishing is a slab of ochre sandstone, from which hangs several wooden amulets.

title: [Galinroe's Weaponry]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A bamboo rack and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Jozeline's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a low skylight-set ceiling, a painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls.  A wide knotted oak counter and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a stuffed octopus rests on a colorful mosaic floor.

title: [Agec's Magic Shoppe]

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Approach]
description: Standing before the tall iron fencing is an old boarded-up hut.  Some dried-out bramble sits in a heap, covering a pile of old shovels.  A rusted-out iron gate leads north farther into the cemetery, and on the eastern side of the trail is a passage heading toward the Feywrot Mire.

title: [Willow Hall, Treehouse]
description: Built from darkly stained planks, this treetop observatory is built between two large oaks, spanning across the grassy trail below.  The steeply pitched roof overhangs the platform to provide shelter for a round maoral door.  An old sylvan doorkeeper is perched precariously on the wooden railing.  A small brass bell is mounted besides the door, allowing visitors to announce their presence.

title: [Isle Dyes, Sunflower Shades]
description: Set in the sturdy structure to the south, a large window looks out from the back of the shop into the stall, a large sunflower-filled window box just below its lower panes.  Bright yellow sunflowers with sienna middles create a striking contrast between the two shades, further highlighting the yellow and brown hues of dyes filling the rows upon rows of buckets lined up against the western and northern white canvas walls.

title: [Isle Dyes, Sunset Shades]
description: Visible through a large window set in the stucco structure to the south, the stall's contents consist only of rows and rows of buckets.  The buckets show off dyes that range from the lighter shades of orange to the darker shades of red.  Obviously too full, their contents have smashed together, causing some vials to shatter and send dye dripping down in haphazard patterns on the blue tile flooring.

title: [Isle Dyes, Courtyard]
description: High overhead, a white canvas ceiling is supported by thick steel poles adjacent to shorter poles that hold up the lower canvas walls divided into side-by-side dyeing stalls.  Several feet of open space remain between the ceiling and the top of the walls, allowing both light and air to suffuse the area.  Sheer white drapes separate each stall from the main of the courtyard.  Nestled in the center of the blue tiled courtyard, a small fountain burbles quietly.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Isle Dyes, Ocean Shades]
description: Buckets float in the air several feet above the blue ceramic tiling, their weights supported by twisted ropes attached to the canvas ceiling.  Hanging several feet higher, papier-mache fish swim through the air via nearly indiscernible wires tied to the ceiling.  Creating an ocean of color, the white canvas walls are accented by intermittent wavy stripes of the various shades of blue dyes bordered by thickly painted black lines.

title: [Isle Dyes, Verdant Shades]
description: Shiny steel buckets strung by thin twisted ropes hang down from the top of the wall supports to rest against white canvas of the northern and southern walls.  Spattered with a wide range of green shades, the lower half of the western wall shows off a vibrant green landscape which, though filled in with brown, red, yellow, and blue paints, is primarily colored with the green dyes in the buckets.

title: [Isle Dyes, Underlying Shades]
description: Shiny steel buckets rest against stark white walls of canvas to the north and south, their weights chiefly supported by thin ropes strung to the top of the walls.  Anything but plain, the eastern end of the stall looks as though a battle by dye recently ripped across the canvas wall.

title: [Isle Dyes, Blossom Shades]
description: Hanging down from the top of the white canvas walls, buckets attached to thin twisted ropes dangle in the air just above the blue tile flooring.  Tiny flowers, each a pink or purple shade, hang from nearly indiscernible wires tied to the ceiling.  Complementing the ceiling decor, the white canvas walls are dyed pink and purple in several spots, where thinly painted black lines form simple flowering shapes around the color.

title: [Isle Dyes, Beyond Shades]
description: Stark and lacking in decor, the canvas walls of the immense stall are a pristine, clean white, and the area immediately opens out into the courtyard.  In the center of the stall, a fragrant, lithe faewood tree rises up out of the blue ceramic tile flooring.  The tree's permanent presence is further embellished by the elaborately worked bamboo and glaes table that neatly surrounds the tree, where the grey-tinged trunk grows right up through the center of the table.

title: [Mist Harbor, Southern Walk]
description: Dark foliage, their broad leaves glistening with collected humidity, rises on either side of the wide dirt path that winds its way through jungle.  In the distance, the sound of macaws and wild animals can be heard echoing through the canopy, their harsh calls punctuated by the annoying buzz of mosquitoes and black flies.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Mist Harbor, Southern Walk]
description: A tall fence continues to run southward, separating the dirt pathway from what lies beyond it.  At the top of the fence, scratch marks can be seen just along the rim.  Swarms of flies float in and out, searching through the dark foliage that creeps along the ground.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Annex, Twilight Hall Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A scarlet velvet pennant edged with silver and deep blue hangs between a heavy, white muslin curtain and a scarlet linen curtain.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Western Harbor, Pathways]
description: Curving around dunes riddled with sea grass, the pathway leads up a hill toward the walls of Mist Harbor at one end and down to the arched entry of a small harbor.  Tiny buildings evenly spaced upon a single cobbled street are painted with white stucco, which reflects the bright light of the day.

Unsavory aromas rise from an odd-smelling crooked white shop built into the lee of the pathway.

title: [Western Harbor, Entry]
description: Sunlight glints upon the cobbles of the street as it narrows slightly into a winding pathway that leads through the dunes.  Here and there persistent sea grass breaks through the stones in an attempt to reclaim their birthright.  An enormous ivory arch, crafted from the jawbone of a seathrak, houses an oak sign at its peak.

title: [Western Harbor, Seathrak Way]
description: Bejeweled and blinking fireflies drift amongst the various cottages that line the cobblestone street.  Tidy picket fences, each sporting a wrought iron lantern at their gates, separate each home's yard from the other, which causes them to look identical to each other.  The only exception in uniformity is a small store that is built nearest the arch crafted of a seathrak's jawbone.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Jineve's Cookery]
description: Framed by two windows, the front door is painted a deep navy blue and has hinges of wrought iron that are plated with decorative scrollwork.  A large display case crafted of steel and glass displays a variety of local fishes, neatly filleted for convenience, while a plethora of sea grass baskets house a mixture of cooking aids.  An archway leads through the store to the backyard, its opening allowing the scent of cooking fish to drift inside.

title: [Jineve's Cookery, Backyard]
description: Surrounded on all sides by tufts of wide-bladed beach grass, the backyard's center is filled with fine grains of white sand that glisten in the sunlight.  Burning merrily in the center is a crackling fire that is built within a small pit and ringed by blackened stones.  An open archway leads into a small stucco-faced store.

title: [Western Harbor, Misted Cottage]
description: Coiled brambles, supporting dusky dog roses from thorn-riddled limbs, cling to the sturdy slats of the white picket fence that encircles the yard.  Wild crab grass blends in rustic grace with tall blades of blue-green sea grass and surround a simple pathway of crushed seashells.  Marking each end of the pathway is the cottage's closed white door and a wrought iron-hinged gate.
location: the Misted Cottage, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Western Harbor, Seathrak Way]
description: Cobblestones laid in concentric bands spread across the plaza from the four avenues that meet here and wrap around an enormous sandstone fountain.  Glass-sided lanterns hang from wrought iron posts at each intersection, their glaesine panes sparkling in the ambient light.

paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Western Harbor, Seathrak Way]

title: [Western Harbor, Docks]
description: Transitioning seamlessly from cobblestones to wooden planks, the street and dock meet with little to no fanfare.  Sturdy pilings are fitted with wooden railings along the expanse of the dock to prevent any mishaps, while the streets are lined with glass-sided wrought iron lanterns.

title: [Western Harbor, Docks]
description: Pilings rise on either side of the dock's platform and act as anchors to the railings that shield travelers from the open water on either side.  The southern railings are draped with fishing nets that block the view of the rocky shore immediately below, while the northern ones are left open to provide an unobstructed view of the open harbor. title: [Western Harbor, Pier One]

location: Silken Mist on Four Winds Isle

location: Silken Mist on Four Winds Isle

A slight, almost imperceptible breeze comes from the direction of the larger tunnel.  Along the walls, a string of torches disappears around both bends of the tunnel.  Visible to the south is a tunnel entrance which opens into a larger cavern with a shaft of light coming from the ceiling.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Nexus]
description: A single shaft of light comes from the ceiling of the cavern, assisting the paltry light offered by a single torch.  The air is damp and cool, scented with the moistness of earth.  The room has the appearance of being carved from stone and is the meeting place of several tunnel mouths.  Several chairs sit beside a crate and behind them, set against the wall, are some canvas-covered boxes.  A large tunnel entrance leads to the north, while another leads west, and a third, smaller opening to the south.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Tunnel]
description: The light of a single torch illuminates the small chamber, in contrast to a larger room visible through a tunnel entrance to the north, with a visible shaft of light extending down from its ceiling.  Two passageways break off from the chamber, one continuing south and a larger one to the east.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Tunnel]
description: The string of torches continues down the narrow tunnel, pinpoints of light that disappear behind a bend in the tunnel made invisible by shadow.  From the ceiling hang hundreds of roots from plants only a few feet above, their feathery tendrils glistening with beads of water collected from the damp air.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Vault]
description: The tunnel dead-ends into a vaulted chamber constructed of enormous blocks of granite and thick oak timbers.  Across the stone floor is a light layer of grit tracked in from the tunnel to the northeast, which leads to a large iron-bound door set into the west wall of the vaulted room.  Two torches flank either side of the door, burning brightly, while their smoke stains the ceiling above them a sooty black.

title: [The Stone Eye, Basement]
description: Damp and dark, the room is constructed out of large blocks and thick oak timbers.  Lined up on one wall are a series of wooden crates stacked upon each other, while on the opposite wall are numerous iron-bound casks.  Water trickles from nearly invisible cracks in the walls, creating pools of water in several spots on the granite floor which reflect light from a handful torches set against the wall.

title: [Saisha's General Store]
description: Honey gold oak walls rise from a golden blonde oak floor.  Just above an iron candelabra hangs a peacock feather fan, and an oak beam ceiling completes the picture.  A narrow glass-topped table stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Khirdahn's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A dovetailed oak table sits in one corner while a well-pruned lemon tree rests on a russet oak floor.

title: [The Warren, Broad Way]
description: The path from the northeast widens into a large sandy dirt street flanked on either side by miscellaneous buildings constructed of wood and the occasional stone block.  Uneven wood plank sidewalks line the buildings which serve as homes and businesses.  Men, women, and children of many races, crowd the sidewalks, creating a lively atmosphere and filling the air with boisterous noises.

The path from the northeast widens into a large sandy dirt street flanked on either side by miscellaneous buildings constructed of wood and the occasional stone block.  Uneven wood plank sidewalks line the buildings which serve as homes and businesses.  Torches line the street, providing uneven lighting and flickering shadows.  Men and women crowd the sidewalks, creating a lively atmosphere and filling the air with sounds of revelry and commerce.

title: [The Warren, River Walk]
description: Uneven, dark cobblestones emerge gradually from the sandy soil street to the southeast to pave the river walk as it heads west.  The north fork of the Tempest River flows swiftly to the right of the walk, interspersed with the first of many of a row of small docks and accompanying river craft.  Men and women move back and forth from dock to storehouse carrying crates and sacks.

Uneven, dark cobblestones emerge gradually from the sandy soil street to the southeast to pave the river walk as it heads west.  The north fork of the Tempest River flows swiftly to the right of the walk, interspersed with the first of many of a row of small docks and accompanying river craft.  Despite the dark of night, men and women move back and forth from dock to storehouse carrying crates and sacks.

title: [The Warren, River Walk]
description: Docks extend out from the river walk, offering safe mooring for numerous river craft away from the turbulent current of the north fork of the Tempest.  Built upon one particular dock is a wooden structure, from which emerge rich aromas of fried seafood.  The river walk is paved with uneven cobblestones scarred by deep set ruts.  Large wood buildings line the street with wide, open loading bays offering glimpses of stacked crates and barrels inside, while dangerous-looking men stand sentry outside.

title: [The Warren, The Sea Rat]
description: The heavy odor of grease and frying fish hangs over the narrow rectangular room set with several mismatching tables and chairs.  Salt-encrusted rope and netting decorate the walls, in addition to a large stuffed rat situated above the entrance.  Cracks in the floorboards reveal the sight of the rushing waters of the Tempest River, while a counter at the far end provides a place to order one's meal.

title: [The Warren, River Dock]
description: Jutting out into the Tempest River, the dock is built of mainly uneven planks of wood.  Several kingfishers sits atop mooring posts, watching the expanse of the swiftly moving river for possible meals.  Silently, river craft with large white sails proceed past the dock, returning from or setting off on business ventures.

Jutting out into the Tempest River, the dock is built of mainly uneven planks of wood.  Lights from the warehouses and torches reflect off the swiftly moving dark waters of the Tempest.  Silently, ghost-like river craft with large white sails proceed past the dock, returning from or setting off on business ventures.

title: [River's Rest, Tempest River]
description: The violent force of the current carries you forward, as the banks of the river swiftly pass by to the right and left.  The cold river water surrounds you with floatsam in the form of leaves, twigs, and the occassional clumsy rolton.

title: [The Warren, Broad Way]
description: The broad street continues east to west, wide enough to handle two passing wagons, but not much more.  Children run back and forth across the street from one boarded sidewalk to the next, leaping over an open sewage trench that runs lengthwise down the road.  A ramshackle wood storefront sits at the center of the street.

The broad street continues east to west, wide enough to handle two passing wagons, but not much more.  Several children, irregardless of the time of day, run back and forth across the street from one boarded sidewalk to the next, leaping over an open sewage trench that runs lengthwise down the road.  A ramshackle wood storefront sits at the center of the street.

title: [The Warren, Sem's Salvaged]
description: Open crates are stacked on open crates and barrels, filled with miscellaneous items from weapons to women's clothing.  Sem leans at the back of the store, carefully cleaning his fingernails with a large dirk.  A sign hangs above his head, "All items legally salvaged," the reading in apparent contrast to the mint and fine condition of much of the merchandise.  In the corner, rests a small crystal ball set atop a crate of hay, the object of fascination for children wandering in and out of the shop.

title: [The Warren, Broad Square]
description: A square established by the intersection of four streets creates a large open space filled with various vendors hawking goods and services.  The square is unevenly paved in dark stone that continues up a street to the north and appears to sink into and under the sand-colored dirt prevalent throughout the rest of the neighborhood.  A large, shattered water fountain in the center of the square provides drinking water and adds a cheerful background gurgle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [The Warren, The Gallows]
description: The street dead-ends into a cul-de-sac surrounded by wooden buildings in various states of disrepair.  A large gallows stands at the end of the cul-de-sac, and behind it sits a gateway guarded by two tall men in mismatching armor.  Men and women gather by a ragged stall and fill the air with raucous laughs and profane language, while a group of dirty children race excitedly about chasing a large dock rat.

The street dead-ends into a cul-de-sac surrounded by wooden buildings in various states of disrepair.  A large gallows stands at the end of the cul-de-sac, and behind it sits a gateway guarded by two tall men in mismatching armor.  Men and women gather by a ragged stall and fill the air with raucous laughs and profane language, while a group of dirty children sleep quietly curled up next to a large sleeping dock rat.

title: [The Warren, Wesl's Stall]
description: The proprietor of the stall stands behind a counter, polishing it with a rag attached to a hook, which in turn is attached to his wrist.  The stall is large enough to offer a minor semblance of privacy and several crates are stacked around it as impromptu seating.  Behind the tender, several shelves are decorated with a collection of bottles of various size and color.

title: [The Warren, Mora Way]
description: Deep ruts cut through the center of the street as it winds its way to the southeast.  A mishmash of architectural philosophies wage an ongoing battle in the form of different shacks, homes, and buildings constructed on either side of the street in miscellaneous materials.  One large stone house sits in ruins on a lot suffocated by large brambles.  The flow of activity is less than to the north where a large square predominates, but numerous men, women, and children pass up and down the street.

Deep ruts cut through the center of the street as it winds its way to the southeast.  A mishmash of architectural philosophies wage an ongoing battle in the form of different shacks, homes, and buildings constructed on either side of the street in miscellaneous materials.  One large stone house sits in ruins on a lot suffocated by large brambles.  Under the darkness, the street is mainly empty but for the occasional man or woman, in contrast to a busier square to the north.

title: [The Warren, Way to Creyth]
description: The street widens, and set before it is a statue of an elf standing slightly askew.  Behind the statue, set between two large brick columns, is a large elevated riverstone slab accompanied by a bench placed directly behind it of the same material.  The yellow sandy composition of the street is sporadically decorated with spots of dark red and black.  Against one of the columns, an old elven pike leans against one of the columns.

The street widens, and set before it is a statue of an elf standing slightly askew.  Behind the statue, set between two large brick columns, is a large elevated riverstone slab accompanied by a bench placed directly behind it of the same material.  The yellow sandy composition of the street is sporadically decorated with spots of dark red and black.  An old river rat sleeps slumped over against one of the columns, an old elven pike cradled in his arms.

title: [The Warren, Ketain Way]
description: What appears to be the derelict remains of a sailing vessel rests half-consumed by sand and brambles on the south side of the street.  On the north side, numerous wood-built buildings of varying design and elevation swing northward to join with the busy Broad Way.  Hand-pulled wagons, laden with canvas-covered boxes, sit in the center of the street, while merchants argue and barter adjacent.  Under the shade of the ruined vessel, children crowd around a circle filled with marbles.

What appears to be the derelict remains of a sailing vessel rests half-consumed by sand and brambles on the south side of the street.  On the north side, numerous wood-built buildings of varying design and elevation swing northward to join with the busy Broad Way.  Several hand-pulled wagons, laden with canvas-covered boxes, sit to one side of the street.  Occasionally, large rats run back and forth from the brambles to the other side of the street heading north.

title: [The Warren, Lefante Way]
description: The cobblestone road curves to the northeast to run parallel with the river where several docks with large river craft are moored.  Many of the buildings along the street are made of mismatching stone blocks cunningly crafted to fit and join with odd-shaped stones.  Two statues flank a gateway set before a large two-story stone and timber house, and mirroring the statues are two tall giantmen guards.  Opposite the house is a modest wood home guarded by a single old and bent Tehir.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Storage]
description: Torch light casts shadows across the cavern that stretch onwards to the west.  Single drops of water fall from the ceiling into a small puddle on the cavern floor offering a resounding plinking noise every so many minutes.  The chamber is haphazardly filled with various containers and crates.  Against one wall are three small wine casks set beside a makeshift weapon rack with muddy tracks leading from one to the other, then out of the cavern.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Storage]
description: The haphazard depository of goods and items continues in this westard chamber with a number of crates and boxes.  On top of one stack is an open straw-packed crate offering the curious a glimpse inside.  On the floor, well away from other items, is a single scorched box.  Across the room, above a dark stain on the cavern floor, a rotting severed hand hangs from a piece of string tied to a spike hammered into the wall next to words scratched into the stone surface.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Tunnel]
description: Two torches spaced a distance apart provide the light for sure passage down the tunnel as it curves slowly to the southwest.  A slightly luminescent moss covers the ceiling of the tunnel and is decorated in pinpoints of moisture that reflect the torchlight like so many distant stars in a night sky.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Tunnel]
description: Patches of luminescent moss grow along the length of the ceiling of the tunnel, the slight glow emanating from the moss overpowered by the presence of a single, bright burning torch.  A cord of rope lies forgotten and unused, half buried in the floor of the tunnel.  Going back and forth along the edges of the tunnel floor are a series of small paw prints.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, End Point]
description: The height of the tunnel lowers considerably as it comes to an abrupt end with a dark soil wall.  Light floods the area from a narrow circular opening at the end of the tunnel and is accompanied by the smell of wet animal fur.  Numerous paw prints cover the floor, criss-crossing every which way, along with scratch marks in the walls.  To the northeast, the tunnel widens, and the flickering light of a torch can be made out from behind a dark bend.

title: [River's Rest, Rabbit Hutch]
description: Sunlight streams through the entrance of the hutch and onto piles of comfortable-looking straw.  Fluffs of rabbit fur litter the small room filled with the overpowering stench of animal refuse and sweat.  A half-eaten pickle lies near a bowl, and a krolvin skull sits nestled in one corner of the hutch.  The rabbit's chamber is surprisingly well-built from a hodgepodge of materials, from wood to stone, complete with a miniature riverstone vaulted ceiling.
