title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Tunnel]
description: The tunnel widens as it proceeds eastwards with several torches set along its path, providing the light for passage.  A light green lichen covers the floor of the tunnel, except where a pathway has been beaten down by countless feet.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Nearly a cavern unto itself, the tunnel widens considerably into a large chamber illuminated by four torches set along its length.  Two alcoves have been cut into either side of the tunnel, one with stone steps leading upwards, and another with a ladder disappearing into the ceiling.  Somewhere in the darkness, crickets chirp contently.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Tunnel]
description: As the tunnel continues to the northwest, it begins to widen considerable, while doing the opposite to the south.  A metal hatch is set into the side of the tunnel's north wall, and two torches flicker in sconces placed to either side of the hatch.  Reflecting the uneven torchlight is a metal object set into the wall adjacent to the hatch.  On the opposite wall hangs the skeleton of a krolvin, pinned to the wall by a large pike.

title: [Targon's Tavern, Backroom]
description: The room is small by human standards, but the perfect size for a dwarf patron or barkeep.  Stacks of crates line one wall and rows of barrels line the other.  A light sprinkling of sand covers the floor on the far side of the room and trails off in the direction of the door leading back towards the bustling sounds of the tap room.  A stuffed rolton head hangs from one wall, an expression of shock and surprise eternally captured on its face.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Tunnel]
description: A cool breeze, laden with the scent of river reeds and mud, flows into the tunnel from the east.  In addition to the gentle wind, the tunnel eastwards appears to have a source of light other than torchlight.  Meanwhile, to the southeast is a dark sloping tunnel entrance absent of light and the source of a slow, steady roar.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Under River]
description: The air, thick with moisture, cools considerably as the tunnel leads downwards into the darkness.  A slow, loud roar fills the tunnel, emanating from its ceiling.  Dim light from the tunnel entrance to the northwest is reflected off of pools of water collected on the tunnel floor, which stir occasionally with unseen inhabitants.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel, Opening]
description: Sunlight floods into the tunnel from a bright opening silhouetted with the dark lines of tall reeds and stacked crates.  A cool breeze tugs at the reeds at the opening of the entrance and stirs dead leaves and grasses tracked into the tunnel from outside, before disappearing deeper into the tunnel.  From nearby comes the sound of a large river, as well as the sound of foot traffic over wooden boards.

Moonlight floods into the tunnel from a bright opening silhouetted with the dark lines of tall reeds and stacked crates.  A cool breeze tugs at the reeds at the opening of the entrance and stirs dead leaves and grasses tracked into the tunnel from outside, before disappearing deeper into the tunnel.  From nearby comes the sound of a large river, as well as the sound of foot traffic over wooden boards.

title: [River's Rest, Underbridge]
description: Tall reeds and river grasses lean over and crowd the path as it winds its away through the diminishing space between the wooden structure and the underside of the bridge.  A large opening, a darkness framed by reeds, beckons right at the point where passage any further would result in collision with the drawbridge's underbelly.  At the beginning of the path, next to the wood structure, the earth has been beaten into a hard surface.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Under River]
description: A constant roar originating from the ceiling on the northwestward end of the tunnel renders all other sounds mute.  The tunnel floor, a mixture of stone, mud, and pools of water, offers a slippery purchase for those wishing to proceed eastward.  On one wall hangs a rusted iron lamp with a single thick candle dutifully burning away at the surrounding darkness, reflected in the still pools of water.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel, Opening]
description: Thick green and brown vines cover large stone blocks mortared together to fashion three sides of the small chamber, while a fourth side, free of vegetation, descends into a dark tunnel leading west.  A narrow stone archway, the entry point for the innumerable vines, offers the only illumination into the room with sunlight cascading in and across a vine and leaf-strewn stone floor.  A rickety chair sits to one side of the small chamber next to a larger archway leading south into an adjacent room.

Thick green and brown vines cover large stone blocks mortared together to fashion three sides of the small chamber, while a fourth side, free of vegetation, descends into a dark tunnel leading west.  A narrow stone archway, the entry point for the innumerable vines, offers the only illumination into the room with moonlight cascading in and across a vine and leaf-strewn stone floor.  A rickety chair sits to one side of the small chamber next to a larger archway leading south into an adjacent room.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnel, Storage]
description: A series of steps leads down from a large stone archway into a long, narrow chamber built under the earth.  Large timbers line the walls and support the earthen ceiling above a dirt floor.  A broken goat cart lies discarded and dust-covered in one corner, joined in the opposite corner by several empty crates.  The roars of jungle trolls reverberate faintly from the direction of the ceiling.

title: [Marsh Keep, Secret Study]
description: Two rectangular windows offer light to the small, dust-laden study.  A desk is placed against one wall, atop of which rests a tattered journal, and bookshelves line the wall opposite.  A small, jeweled chest sits beneath the window, a lock lying shattered on the ground beside it.  In addition to the broken lock, several glass jars lie smashed across the faded carpeted floor.

title: [A Derelict Hovel]
description: Thin shafts of light seep between the rough wooden planks that form the walls of the hovel.  A broken glass window, now boarded up, allows for a faint breeze to drift through, stirring up small dust devils.  Near the back wall, a pile of canvas sacks and twine form a makeshift bed.

title: [Erikai's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the oak floor is interrupted by a stuffed grizzly bear.  Halfway to the oak beam ceiling, a colorful Icemule map hangs on one of the blue plaster walls.  A narrow glass-topped table and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Ysabet's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a large Aenatumgana painting hangs on one of the pale ivory plaster walls.  A large brass-bound chest and a rough oak crate sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a bleached oak floor.

title: [Wondrous Wizardly Wares]
description: Enclosed by smooth white plaster walls, the shop features a polar bear rug in the center of its oak floor.  A large Aenatumgana painting hangs under the oak beam ceiling.  Right near the front is a narrow glass-topped table.

title: [Helden Hall, Green Ash Tree]
description: As you get closer to the base of the large green ash tree, you grow amazed at the size.  The roots are spread out and they push through the circular area of earth surrounding it.  This area feels almost sacred - the leaves rustling in the breeze bring to mind the voices of the gods.  The shade and comfortable grasses are inviting, and you are tempted to sit and enjoy the peacefulness.

title: [Helden Hall, Memorial Garden]
description: Roughly hewn stone benches edge the small, semicircular memorial garden which borders the northern side of a green ash tree.  Resting at the foot of the tree is a highly polished granite block imbedded with a massive, raven-hilted claidhmore.  A single vine of blood-red passionflowers twines about the block and blade, and various other plants and flowers cluster about the area, basking in sunlight.

title: [Balgamar's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a long varnished counter and a lacquered wooden shelf.

title: [Balgamar's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Citadel, Balcony]
description: Little more than a shelf extending from the side of the Citadel, the balcony is hidden by a low wall with several arrow slits.  Metal quivers attached to the wall await arrows, while a glimpse through the arrow slits reveal the land to the east of the Citadel.  Small flares of fire come and go on the pathway below, while further away, a series of hills give way to a wide vale.

title: [Citadel, Workshop]
description: Long and wide, the room is divided by many worktables and bookshelves.  Hot air stirs about the area, rustling papers and the canvas coverings over small and large cages.  Absent is dust with much of the room appearing as if it was only recently abandoned.

title: [Citadel, Workshop]
description: Black scorch marks create a sporadic circle that fills the open floor space of west side of the workshop.  Within the circle, the floor is covered in claw marks and scratches, which end abruptly at the black marks, leaving the remainder of the stone flooring in pristine condition.

title: [Citadel, Study]
description: Hot drafts of air flowing underneath the door of the study create a soft whistling sound that grows and diminishes in intensity with the arrival and departure of every warm breeze.  A dust-laden crystal chalice sits on top of a desk covered with papers and a small bronze astrolabe.  Behind the desk is a narrow stone door.

title: [Citadel, Balcony]
description: Barely more than a shelf extending from the side of the Citadel, the balcony is protected behind a low wall equipped with metal quivers and several arrow slits.  The breadth of the Citadel complex is laid out to the north, with the nearby gardens and the alchemist building, beyond which the armory and the garrison stand in a stoic line.  Randomly, the wind carries past the balcony the animal screams of the distant zoo.

title: [Citadel, Stairwell]
description: Moonlight filters in through an arrow slit in the wall, shedding light on a stone spiral staircase that descends into darkness below.  An old wooden chair sits at the top of the stairwell, its seat rotted through, next to glass bottle knocked over on its side.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Landing]
description: Smooth black stone walls run north from a spiral staircase that winds upward and out of sight.  Several chairs and tables lie stacked to either side of the hallway, forcing a narrow passage between them.  Behind the makeshift barricade, skeletons in timeworn uniforms and rusting armor lie sprawled across the ground in a mess of broken and discarded weapons.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Yellow light illuminates the corridor from a shining golden orb affixed to the wall, the first of many orbs that line the corridor like brilliant beads to the north and to the east.  Dust particles float through the air, stirred by recent passage, glittering in the yellow light and slowly drifting toward the floor.  Slung into the space between the floor and the wall is a coil of rope.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Broken clay jars line both sides of the corridor, emptied of their contents centuries before.  Beside a steel door lies a bundle of cloth and coils of rope covered in dust.  Over everything run small rodent footprints helter skelter in no obvious pattern or design.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Cell]
description: Lining the walls of the dungeon cell are five skeletons still chained to the wall by heavy iron manacles.  Their skulls have all been crushed by some heavy object and slash marks cover their ribcages and limbs.  Threadbare tunics and blankets lie at the feet of the skeletons, ravaged by time and rodent teeth.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Lining the walls of the corridor are weapon racks, absent of their intended inventory, coated in layers of dust.  Beneath the racks are placed simple wood benches, most in the process of falling victim to dry rot and several disappearing into small piles of sawdust.  Scattered across much of the floor are empty green and brown glass bottles, many crushed, covering the floor with sharp-edged broken pieces.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Three rows of skeletons, dressed in rotting armor and tunics, lie face down in the direction of the south corridor.  Many skeletal hands still grasp weapons or clutch shields, while other gear has fallen amongst the rows of dead.  Behind the dead near the corner of the corridor turning northwest is an armored skeleton pinned to the wall by a spear.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Cell]
description: Two skeletons lie just inside the doorway to the cell, overspill from the violence that had occured outside in the corridor.  Beyond the two remains, the cell is mainly empty, with just a few patches of musty hay spread haphazardly around the floor.  Four chains with manacles are attached to the wall just below a small carving in the stone.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Dressed in elaborate robes, a skeleton lies in the corner of the corridor.  A heavy wood spear lies across its lap, its point driven through the skeleton's ribcage.  Scorch marks surround the skeleton in uneven concentric circles, ending only where the corridor turns west and to the southeast.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Skeletons litter the floor of the corridor, lying in three approximate rows with the fewest falling to the east and all facing the south corridor.  Interspersed amongst the remains are rusting weapons and shattered shields, leaving little free space to step through towards the east.  Mice scurry back and forth between the skeletons from nests built of the remains of tunics and cloaks.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Benches, weapon racks, and other odd pieces of wood are stacked atop each forming a makeshift barrier that blocks all but one side of the corridor, where it apparently was breached.  The area behind the barrier is littered with abandoned and broken weapons, smashed helms and shattered shields.  Three skeletons lay stacked one atop the other, their dull white bones separated only by rotting leather armor.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Drafts of warm air flow through the corridor, alternating in directions for no apparent reason.  Keys hang from a thin metal ring hung on a wood spike set into the wall next to a steel door.  Meanwhile, a trail of shattered swords and broken shields lead away to the east.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Cell]
description: Old musty hay is spread across much of the floor of the dungeon cell, obscuring lengths of chains and manacles attached to the wall.  A tin bowl lies overturned in the middle of the floor, its contents long lost to the passage of time.  Nearby the bowl, a wood stool lies with its three feet pointing up at the ceiling of the cell.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Corridor]
description: Placed in the corner of the corridor is a square table set with plates, glasses, and utensils, all coated with thick layers of dust.  Chairs lie on their sides or back by the table joined by a single skeleton still grasping a spoon in its bony grasp.  Underneath the table sits a bucket.

title: [Infirmary, Patient Room]
description: This spartan room has been half-heartedly ransacked.  The narrow bed has been turned on its side, the small nightstand lies in pieces, and the cushion of the stiff-backed wooden chair has been ripped open.  The wind whistles through the cracked pane of the small, round window set high on the wall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: Shards of crystal make up the walls, their glimmering facets pulsing through a range of brilliant hues every few moments.  Warped, mirrored reflections play across the slick surfaces of the walls, while a large pale sphere stands like a sentinel in the center of the room.  A wreath of sharp obelisk-shaped spires ring the sphere, and shrill notes of ethereal beauty echo forth from its interior as a silvery incandescence billows across its surface.

title: [Cleric Guild, River's Rest]
description: Onyx columns gleam in the light of myriad beeswax tapers which surround two central statues.  Each of the figures is cut from pale stone, as is the inscribed base on which they stand.  There are no windows, but the high arc of the domed ceiling keeps the chamber from feeling too enclosed.  An aged oak door is set between two onyx columns, and deep blue carpets, their patterns almost obscured by constellations of jasmine petals, muffle the steps of passing priests.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Embarkation]
description: This small grassy area barely encroaches on the swamp.  A black wrought iron gate stands partially open, supported between two walls over which a thick privet hedge towers from the other side.  The brackish swamp water appears undisturbed as it extends back into the cypress forest, and dragonflies skim the water's surface, looking for a meal in the oppressive humidity.  A long bridge stretches out into the mists to the north.

title: [Island]
description: A dry area nestles among the cypresses here with black water all around waiting to engulf it should it sink any lower.  Farther away humid fog blankets the area, making it impossible to see any significant distance into the cypress forest.  A narrow isthmus of reed-choked soil leads off to the southwest, and small, stepping stone hillocks dot the water to the north.  A long bridge extends out into the mist to the south.

title: [Training Area]
description: A large flat area extends to the northwest populated by majestic oaks and stately magnolias.  Training areas have been cordoned off to allow instruction in weaponry, defensive maneuvers, and various forms of bodybuilding.  Several sets of heavy sandbags cluster under a nearby oak.  Although most of the area appears dry and firm, the footing on a nearby leaf-covered patch appears less than trustworthy.  To the northwest, two figures stand as if awaiting the arrival of someone.

title: [Relaxation Garden]
description: A large garden spreads out on a higher patch of land.  Randomly placed flowering bushes compete with blooming shade trees and organized flower beds to fill the area with color and scent.  Narrow, well-maintained paths wind through the serene landscape, occasionally passing by the metal rocking chairs set under each shade tree.  Bees busily harvest pollen, buzzing rapidly from flower to flower, and a small family of ducks noisily roots in the underbrush, searching for a next meal.

Narrow, well-maintained paths wind through the serene landscape, occasionally passing by the metal rocking chairs set under each shade tree.  Torches set every few yards brightly illuminate the garden, allowing the flowers to display their colors at night.

title: [Infirmary]
description: Sunlight intrudes easily between the warped boards and roof slates of this shack to illuminate various medical items, a good thing because the windows are so grimy as to be almost opaque.  A mannequin leans against a corner with nearly its whole figure swathed in bandages.  Against the far wall an assortment of cabinets hold medicinal ingredients of various shapes, sizes and potencies.  Several cots in remarkably clean condition occupy spaces here and there, and a ladder drops into depths unseen.

title: [Meeting Cavern]
description: A huge salt cavern stretches deep underground.  Shadows cast by a hundred wall-mounted torches play across the off-white walls.  Rows of gleaming white stone benches with padded silver cushions cascade down to a spacious marble dais over which a huge banner hangs.  Plush emerald carpet covers the floor between the rows of benches.  Despite the many torches, the air is cool and dry in here.  An iron ladder affixed to the east wall leads up through a hole in the cavern's roof.

title: [Guild Master Rosemary's Office]
description: The inside of this office is in remarkable shape considering the appearance of the building surrounding it.  Rough-cut, cedar paneling covers the walls and supports several paintings depicting various marsh scenes.  Two windows, although heavily covered with grime and bugs, allow light to filter in.  A varnished cedar desk and matching chair huddle in one corner, with an unlit torch affixed to the wall just above.  The cedar floor displays heavy wear from the passage of many footsteps.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy Lobby]
description: The intricate marquetry of wood from the foyer continues in the spacious lobby, including a narrow pattern of lilies created from white ash set into dark maple that wraps around the walls of the circular room.  Five wood-framed arches lead off from the room to separate patios, allowing a slight breeze to flow through the room carrying with it the scent of honeysuckle.  In the center of the room rests a cushioned bench wrapped around a dark wood pedestal.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Empath Guild, Storage Room]
description: Four torches set into stands in the four corners of the room illuminate the narrow rectangular chamber and its dirt floor.  A strong smell of mildew fills the room and several mushrooms sprout downwards from the ceiling.  The room is empty but for a large wood closet and dust bin.

title: [Training Area]
description: A large flat area extends to the southeast populated by majestic oaks and stately magnolias, and a small honeysuckle vine clambers over one of the oaks to fill the air with a sweet aroma.  In other directions patchy bluegrass covers the ground for several yards until it slopes down into the impassable black swamp waters.  Various forms of exercise and training equipment reside in several sections, and two weeping willows stand a short distance away with a leather table resting in the shade of each.

title: [Empath Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy West]
description: A thin cast iron railing separates this riverstone-paved octagonal patio from a field of blooming wildflowers bordered on a far edge by a line of great oaks and magnolia trees.  Centered in the patio is a polished wood workbench that is accompanied by a weathered yellow wood cabinet covered in simple carvings of phases of the Elanthian moons.  A wood chair sits off to one side with several dried red and gold-brown leaves resting on its arms and seat.

A wood chair sits off to one side with several dried red and gold-brown leaves resting on its arms and seat.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy Southwest]
description: A weathered dark wood cabinet sets against a thin cast iron railing that separates the octagonal patio from a field of wildflowers.  Set in the center of the riverstone-paved area is a polished wood workbench.  Along the railing, a strand of honeysuckle twirls and weaves and fills the area with a sweet aroma.  Attracted by the scent, several bees buzz back and forth along the blossoms of the colorful vine.

Attracted by the light, several moths flutter over the blossoms of the colorful vine.  Several lamps strung along the edge of the patio provide light for nocturnal activities.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy South]

Centered in the patio is a polished wood workbench that is accompanied by a weathered red wood cabinet covered in simple carvings of local fauna.  Just beyond the railing, a wood rack sits with several poles hung with browning herb leaves and stalks.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy Southeast]
description: The octagonal patio is paved with dark riverstones and separated from a surrounding field of wildflowers by a thin cast iron railing.  A polished wood workbench rests in the center of the patio, while a weathered dark wood cabinet sits against the railing, covered in detailed carvings of various perched and flying native birds.  Beyond the railing, a single large oak tree grows in the nearby field, offering a large shadowy expanse beneath it to rest.

Yellow light floods the patio from a source inside the building.  A polished wood workbench rests in the center of the patio, while a weathered dark wood cabinet sits against the railing, covered in detailed carvings of various perched and flying native birds.  Beyond the railing, the shadow of a single large oak tree looms over the nearby field.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy East]
description: The octagonal patio is paved with dark riverstones and separated from a surrounding field of wildflowers by a thin cast iron railing.  A polished wood workbench rests in the center of the patio, while a weathered light wood cabinet sits against the railing, covered in detailed carvings of various herbs and flowers.  In a crack in the floor, a small resilient daisy blooms.

A polished wood workbench rests in the center of the patio, while a weathered light wood cabinet sits against the railing, covered in detailed carvings of various herbs and flowers.  In a crack in the floor, a small resilient daisy blooms.

title: [Empath Guild, Store Room]
description: The smell of mildew pervades every area of the small rectangular room.  Light is provided by three torches set into stands, but only enough to dimly illuminate a worktable and a series of shelves set above it.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Library]
description: Long shelves hold stacks of rolled parchments while studious empaths sit at small desks in between the shelves, intently concentrating on the unrolled parchments before them.  Interestingly, the majority of the shelves appear to contain information on honing one's will, meditation, and combat prowess rather than healing arts.  Thick emerald carpet effectively muffles the sound of footsteps, and the muted lighting from the small small table lamps contributes to the atmosphere of quiet contemplation.

title: [Aroma Therapy]
description: Wide sheets of dark green canvas hung high in the trees effectively shut off the sunlight to cast this small glen into near darkness.  Candles of all shapes, sizes and colors sit on stumps, tables, benches, rocks and other supporting items.  Over half the candles burn odorlessly, their flickering flames presenting a tapestry of shining stars.  Occasionally a scented candle sputters to life, filling the glen with its unique scent before it dies out and another candle flares to take its place.

Wide sheets of dark canvas hung high in the trees effectively shut off the moon and starlight to cast this small glen into near darkness.  Candles of all shapes, sizes and colors sit on stumps, tables, benches, rocks and other supporting items.  Over half the candles burn odorlessly, their flickering flames presenting a tapestry of shining stars.  Occasionally a scented candle sputters to life, filling the glen with its unique scent before it dies out and another candle flares to take its place.

title: [Potion Garden]
description: Herbs and ingredients are scattered haphazardly around this small garden.  Bottles lean precariously against one another in one corner.  Several wooden tables of simple construction compete for space with the larger herb bushes, and many plants that appear to be suspiciously non-herbal seem to have established themselves in various nooks and crannies.  A narrow brick path winds through the area.  Several torches stand sentinel around the area, waiting to be put to use when night falls.

A narrow brick path winds through the area.  Several torches stand sentinel around the area, blazing brightly to illuminate the garden.

title: [Stronghold, Storage Room]
description: Broken containers litter the floor of the storage room, the debris consisting of wooden planks as well as pieces of stone.  Large piles have been heaped against the walls, forming a rugged landscape that slopes down to a valley where the path winds between them.  Little light intrudes here, adding to the illusion of a mountainous terrain.

title: [Stronghold, Armory]
description: The armory is strewn with debris, huge pieces of stone littering the floor as if an explosion had occurred.  Dust covers everything in a thick mantle, only giving way to a thin path.  It winds between the heaps of rock like a meandering creek.  Across the walls stretches a panorama, faded with time and almost obscured in the gloom, but breathtaking, nonetheless.

title: [Stronghold, Stone Grove]
description: The tunnel threads its way through a series of rock columns.  Each is carved in the image of a tree trunk, with finely rendered bark, branches and an impossibly complex pattern of leaves overhead.  A view through the colossal boles underscores the remarkable fact of their existence.

title: [Warrior Guild, Main Gate]
description: A light veil of snow covers the flowering heaths and willows of the guild courtyard, except for a few small patches located underneath the protective overhanging branches of some fel trees.  In these patches, the sedges peek out to seek the rejuvenation of the day's sun.  A carefully swept stone path leads from the main gate towards a columnar complex with walls formed from megalithic slabs of black rock.

title: [Guild Hall, Guard Room]
description: The room is dimly lit by several torches hanging on the walls.  A wooden table and a few scattered chairs are the only furnishings in the drab room, except for a rack of weapons on one wall which provides ready access for the defense of the guild.

title: [Guild Hall, South Hall]
description: The hallway abruptly ends in an enclosed space, sparsely furnished and decorated with simple wooden carvings of birds.  A soft, warm limestone, deep yellow in color, forms the mantel and framework of a large stone fireplace.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entrance]
description: Just inside the doorway, a hallway slopes downward on either side.  Gold sconces on the walls provide steady lighting but little heat to the interior.  The rock walls look as if they had been painstakingly carved from solid granite blocks.  Everywhere, the walls and ceilings show deliberate, broad cuts made by some inconceivably large instrument.

title: [Warrior Guild, Dolmen]
description: The base of the guild complex is sunken some ten feet below the ground, where a huge black ring-wall of coralline limestone frames an ornately arched doorway.  The great arch is delved in the stone wall, closed at either end with mighty doors of iron and mithril.  They are wrought and poised upon their huge hinges, posts of steel driven into the living stone, so that when unbarred, they could be moved easily by a single man.

title: [Guild Hall, North Hall]
description: The hallway slopes sharply downward as the passage meanders to the north.  The rough-hewn rock walls are bare of decoration except for the gold sconces placed at regular intervals along the hallway.  The air is still and cold.

title: [Warrior Guild, Stone Path]
description: Here in the middle of the guild courtyard, the path widens and slopes downward towards the guild complex.  Once, it had been filled with groves of fruitful trees, watered by streams that flowed from the nearby mountain.  Now the way is paved with flagstones, dark and hard, their borders lined with long rows of menhirs joined by heavy chains.  The grounds on either side of the stone path are stark and featureless, but for odd mounds where the snow has blanketed a shrub or hedge.

title: [Warrior Guild, Icy Path]
description: This narrow path winds through the snow-covered hedges and bare trees, its surface packed by the stomping of many heavy boots.  The ice has been shaken from the hedges where the path opens out into the main courtyard, and a faint aroma of roasting meat drifts from the large canvas tent that has been erected in a clearing between the trees.

title: [Warrior Guild, Mess Tent]
description: The oiled canvas walls of this expansive tent do little to keep out the chill of the arctic wind.  Hungry warriors sit hunched over the wooden tables, most clustered around the center of the tent, where a blazing fire-pit provides a bit of warmth.  Constructed over the pit is a massive spit bearing the carcass of some huge beast, which sizzles and drips fat into the fire, filling the tent with smoke and the appetizing aroma of roasting meat.

title: [Guild Hall, North Hall]
description: The hallway descent tapers at this depth and leads into a long gallery that ends in an undecorated tunnel.  The rough cut rock walls are barren with the exception of gold sconces placed at intervals along the entire hallway.  The air is still but is at a comfortably cool temperature.

title: [Guild Hall, North Hall]
description: The floor levels out at this narrow point and terminates at a low opening in the rock face.  A blinding light floods through the orifice, obscuring the view of the area beyond.  Curiously enough, a slight warm breeze seems to be issuing from the opening as well.

title: [Guild Hall, Cavern of Light]
description: Subterranean tunnels, burrowed deep beneath the frozen wastes, lead off in several directions from this central cavern.  Around the fringes of the gallery, stalactites and stalagmites meet to form huge pillars which craftsmen have wrought into totems depicting faces of ancient warriors and creatures of all species and sizes.  In the center of the chamber, a gigantic crystalline deposit rises from the floor towards the crystal skylight at its summit.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest, out

title: [Guild Hall, Cavern Passageway]
description: A large mural is etched on the stone wall here, drawn in charcoal outlines and mineral-colored pigments.  Crystalline deposits in the walls and ceiling emit diffused warmth and light throughout the passageway.

title: [Guild Hall, Cavern Passageway]
description: The hall is long and wide and filled with golden sconces and torch lights.  The floor is paved with stones of many hues and engraved with branching runes and strange devices.  The pillars are richly carved, gleaming dully with mithril and gold.  Many woven tapestries hang upon the walls, and over their wide expanses march figures of ancient legend.  Upon one, where the light illuminates the brightest, a young man upon a white horse is blowing a great horn, his yellow hair flying in the wind.

title: [Warrior Guild, Miniature Garden]
description: In the center of the cavern is a bubbling mineral pond surrounded by multitudes of cultivated flora flourishing from its nutrient-rich waters.  As the plants grow, their shoots and roots are carefully pruned and used to decorate the stone troughs that border the walking paths.  Raked sand beds and man-made waterfalls complete the miniature landscape.

title: [Warrior Guild, Miniature Garden]
description: A fountain made from a large rock jutting out of a white basin dominates the garden here.  Water pours from small, fish-shaped golden spouts on the side of the rock, trickling down over the edges of the overflowing basin to irrigate the flora.  A stone bench framed by verdant hedges provides seating to enjoy the tranquil atmosphere.

title: [Warrior Guild, Miniature Garden]
description: The walkway comes to a quaint, arching wooden bridge that spans a rivulet upon which lilypads and water hyacinths float serenely.  Golden fishes swim to and fro in the waters, oblivious to the carefully engineered environment that surrounds them.

title: [Warrior Guild, Miniature Garden]
description: Water trickles along the rocks, among the medley of flowering azaleas and red fall berries that litter the garden landscape, combining to soothe the senses and offer a meditative repose from the hard physical labours of the gymnasium.  A well-groomed sandy walkway meanders throughout the garden.

title: [Guild Hall, Cavern Passageway]
description: A smooth stone along one wall forms a lip over a yawning hole crowned by a small carved arch.  To either side of the hole are two suits of armor, one crafted of steel, the other of brass.

title: [Guild Hall, Guildmaster Sanctum]
description: A collection of thin and translucent dripstone formations twist to form variegated stone flowers that gleam brilliantly from the light magnified by the large deposits of crystals in the vaulted chamber.  Underneath, a large granite semi-circular desk sits alongside large iron braziers that bear hot coals to warm the room.  Furs are spread across the floor in luxurious splendor.  A gilded coat of arms of the Warrior Guild hangs prominently behind the desk.

title: [Guild Hall, Cavern Passageway]
description: A large painted panel shows the dramatic skill of the artist and his intimate appreciation of the cavern's quirks, shown to good effect in one corner where a single line of deer heads in profile is painted just above a ledge.  The ledge is worked into the composition as a river, through which the beautifully drawn herd is swimming, antlered heads uplifted against the current.  The crystalline deposits in the walls and ceiling gleam with a warm and welcomed light.

title: [Guild Hall, Cavern Passageway]
description: The wall of this passageway is taken up by a frieze of four immense bulls.  Three are in file with the fourth facing them, its huge horns extended across the empty space.  All along the remaining walls, there are seemingly random arrangements of smaller animals of assorted shapes and sizes.  More of the curious crystalline deposits in the walls and ceiling emit diffused warmth and lighting throughout the passageway.

title: [Warrior Guild, Workshop]
description: Splotches of dye, melted metal and remnants from sheath patterns sully this otherwise pristine and expansive work area.  A raggedy straw broom stands in the corner next to a dustbin, an old rag draped over its handle, ready for any further spills.

title: [Guild Hall, Sloping Passageway]
description: The long narrow passage slopes sharply northward.  The lack of crystal deposits in the walls makes the passage colder and dimmer than other parts of the networked tunnels.  The walls are damp and slippery with an overgrowth of lichen.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ice Falls]
description: The mouth of the cavern passage leads from behind a waterfall into a frozen lagoon.  Once-lush vegetation is now glazed over with a coating of ice that has sealed it in a timeless prison.  A frozen sheet of ice hangs like a curtain over the outer surface of the waterfall, while beneath, the water still cascades freely down into the lagoon, its natural forces unabated by the arctic conditions.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ice Lagoon]
description: While natural rock formations enclose the lagoon and screen the arctic winds, the ambient temperature still remains below freezing.  Though the surface of the pool is mostly frozen, there exists a circle of broken patches, which act as tubs used to take invigorating ice baths.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ice Cave]
description: Located near a waterfall, the small cavern chamber is opened to the sky through a large fissure.  Acting as an air vent, it allows the chill of the arctic winds to howl downward creating a dull, resonant din throughout the room.  Stacked neatly against the walls are blocks of ice that have been chipped from the frozen lagoon beyond.

title: [Warrior Guild, Gymnasium]
description: This vast gallery has been arduously excavated from solid granite.  Gigantic stalactites and stalagmites have been enhanced with granite blocks to form massive pillars that uphold the cavern's roof.  Fissures in the ceiling provide pathways for the arctic winds to ventilate the cavern, but the crystalline deposits in the stone surfaces seem to echo the warmth and light, keeping the temperature comfortable.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Door]
description: The stage door's frame is propped up with a system of sturdy wood supports, allowing it to take all the abuse you can give it.

title: [Warrior Guild, Metal Door]
description: The stage door's frame is propped up with a system of sturdy wood supports, allowing it to take all the abuse you can give it.

title: [Guild Hall, Arena]
description: The ground in this cavern chamber fans out in a semicircle and slopes down in even steps to the level area at the bottom.  Long wooden benches have been bolted onto each step, providing comfortable seating for those viewing the action in the ring below.

title: [Guild Hall, Pugilist Ring]
description: At the base of the cavern, a perimeter of timber linked with stretched hide ropes has been constructed to cordon off the arena.  Within the boundaries, sand is scattered around the floor to provide cushioning and easy clean-up after the matches.

title: [Warrior Guild, Gymnasium]
description: At this end of the gallery, a large fissure in the wall permits water to pour from an elaborate aqueduct, down the side of a rockface, and into a semi-circular basin.  Granite benches are placed nearby along with stacks of towels and jars of oil for the convenience of the members.

title: [Warrior Guild, Dark Chamber]
description: The walls of this dark and gloomy room are plated with polished obsidian, ghostly reflections dancing across their glossy black surfaces.  Dim light flickers from a tank full of squirming serpentine forms in one corner.  Along one wall is a set of shelves that serves as an apothecary, stocked with numerous bottles and vials of varying shapes and sizes.

title: [Warrior Guild, Thermal Springs]
description: The grotto is humid and foggy from intermittent bursts of steam that erupt from small cratered geysers scattered throughout the chamber.  A solid rocky platform on one side provides safe passage and a repose to bathe in the sultry atmosphere.  Several curtained recesses among the geysers act as saunas, providing a place for quiet meditation and intense, soothing heat.

title: [Warrior Guild, Sauna]
description: In this recess among the thermal geysers, a wooden bench provides comfortable seating for those who prefer the heat of the invigorating steam bath.  A brazier filled with incense is heated in a nearby bubbling crater pool, providing a sweet aroma that fills the niche.

title: [Guild Hall, Assembly]
description: A large, circular depression has been dug in the center of the room, white sand piled upon its banks.  Two sarsen pillars stand at a break in the sand.  Steps lead down between them into the depression where a solid marble podium stands.  Surrounding the podium is a double ring of cut bluestone benches which provide seating for assemblies.

title: [Warrior Guild, Miniature Garden]
description: At the center of the garden, a small woodshed stands among some intricately pruned miniature trees and shrubs.

title: [Warrior Guild, Garden Shed]
description: The shed is made of wood and mud.  Sturdy timber posts are braced at the ceiling by thick roof beams.  Boughs are woven through the posts to complete the walls of the shed where mud has been used to seal in the gaps.  The roof is pitched and covered with thatch.

title: [Warrior Guild, Garden Shed]
description: In this corner of the shed, a stock of firewood is kept and constantly plundered to help keep the guild warm and lit.  The wood is organized by piles, some of which need breaking down into smaller pieces before they can be useful.

title: [Warrior Guild, Garden Shed]

Stacked neatly against the walls are blocks of ice that have been chipped from the frozen lagoon beyond.

title: [A Brown Tent]
description: Heavy brown fabric stretches between polished ironwood poles to form this tent.  Bare and unadorned, the area is lit by a single torch in each of the four corners.  A jagged sign is pinned to the wall above a wooden white table.

title: [Inside Oak Tree]
description: Deep in the hollow of this ancient tree, a few carved wooden stools are clustered around a fine-grained oak slab that serves as a table.  Soft light streams in through a large knothole, softly illuminating the area.  Sequestered from the hustle and bustle of the town square, this quiet chamber offers a cozy haven for weary caregivers.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: A cobblestone hearth has crumbled and fallen along the southern wall, directly across from the remains of a massive wooden bed.  Aside from the rotted wooden door, the room is otherwise empty and unadorned.

title: [Zanthie's Wagon]
description: The interior of the pale green wagon is haphazardly decorated with swathes of multicolored fabric to cover the otherwise bare walls.  A set of rickety old oak racks stand in the middle of the room holding a selection of wares.  In the corner of the room a makeshift fire pit has been built, a pile of applewood logs crackling within it.  The ceiling has been festooned with holly, giving the wagon a festive ambiance.  A large oak-framed sign leans against one of the walls.

title: [Rogue Guild, Buyer]
description: Light filters in through the door, leaving this small room mostly in shadow.  A large desk takes up most of the space.  The remaining bits of floor have inventory bins lined against the walls, leaving only a strip to move in.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court]
description: A door opens in the south wall.  The floor before it has been swept clean of all dirt and wood shavings, baring usage-worn planks to the eye.  Dwarves wander through the area, paying little attention to anything but their own concerns.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court Center]
description: This area is somewhat brighter than the others, lit by four large lanterns.  Many of the dwarves congregate here, sitting at several large tables made of crates.  Dice, cards, and other amusements have been spread across the surfaces, providing a convenient place to congregate.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court]
description: Laughter spills into the room through an arch to the southeast, carrying over the constant murmur of the guild.  Lanterns hang from hooks, providing enough light to see by and enough shadows to sneak through.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lounge]
description: A number of crates and kegs have been stacked here.  One crate has been undone, displaying a load of mugs and steins, and one keg has been opened to fill them.  Tables and chairs fill the room, and soft sofas line the walls, providing a nice place to relax.  A group of dwarves sits in the corner, laughing over jacks of ale.  A makeshift dark booth and a a cozy rudimentary booth have been partitioned off by stacks of crates.

A number of crates and kegs have been stacked here.  One crate has been undone, displaying a load of mugs and steins, and one keg has been opened to fill them.  Tables and chairs fill the room, and soft sofas line the walls, providing a nice place to relax.  A group of dwarves sits in the corner, laughing over jacks of ale.  A makeshift dark booth and a cozy rudimentary booth have been partitioned off by stacks of crates.

title: [A Makeshift Booth]
description: Crates stacked over nine feet high make for a cozy little booth.  The wood and cargo muffle the sounds from the lounge, creating a nice place for conversation.  A large box serves as a table.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: Several padded couches sit along the walls here, creating a perfect place to rest a tired - or sore - head.  Strange thumping and thudding noises come from behind the two doors here, and the floor has been stained by several drops of blood.

title: [Rogue Guild, Court]
description: A trio of dwarves stands in the center of the area, having a spirited conversation.  Their voices get louder and louder, and one begins smacking a sap into the palm of his hand rhythmically.  Perhaps the conversation is not going well.

title: [Abandoned Warehouse]
description: A large crate was murdered by a swarm of rats in this room, spilling its grainy innards across the floor.  The rats remain, eating happily from the pile of food on the floor.  They seem wholly unconcerned with your presence.

title: [Shed]
description: Slivers of light trickle in through cracks in the ceiling and walls, casting odd shadows within this cramped interior.  A few rusty tools hang on one wall, clearly neglected for many years.

Burning torches just outside this shed allow a few slivers of light to trickle in through cracks in the ceiling and walls, casting odd shadows within this cramped interior.  A few rusty tools hang on one wall, clearly neglected for many years.

title: [Alley]
description: This narrow alley is dark, dingy, and not a place for the weak of heart.  Shards of glass and limp weeds are embedded in the dirt underfoot, and crumbling walls press close on either hand.

title: [Alley]
description: This portion of the alley is barely wide enough to accommodate a wagon and looks more like a dump than a path.  Several pigeons perched overhead are using a toppled barrel for target practice, its iron surface completely covered with the birds' "gifts".

This portion of the alley is barely wide enough to accommodate a wagon and looks more like a dump than a path.  The pigeons that perch overhead during the day must be using a toppled barrel for target practice, its iron surface is completely covered with the birds' "gifts".

title: [Alley]
description: A drunk is sleeping one off, a large splintered crate apparently his home for the day.  The area is littered with empty wine bottles, most of such poor quality they aren't even labeled.
A drunk sits within a large splintered crate, a bottle in one hand.  He is alternating between drinking and singing.  Clearly, he is not a member of the Bard's guild.

title: [Alley]
description: A pair of dogs feast on an unidentifiable lump of something, growling viciously anytime anybody gets close.  What sounds like an argument is bellowing forth from several of the buildings, confined mostly to yelling and screaming.  An occasional flowerpot sails across the sky, usually missing its mark and shattering against a wall.
A dwarf looms in the shadows, picking her teeth with a small dagger.  She is garbed in expensive elven-crafted clothing, but wears no jewelry.  Her eyes are wary, but her posture relaxed.

title: [Rooftop]
description: The roof is mostly level, although weather has taken its toll on some portions.  The building provides a good vantage of the alleyway below.  A few sparse clouds float aimlessly overhead, partially blocking out the harsh sun of the day.

The roof is mostly level, although weather has taken its toll on some portions.  The building provides a good vantage of the alleyway below.  A few sparse clouds float aimlessly overhead, partially blocking out the evening stars.

title: [Alley]
description: The alley ends in a T intersection, a boarded up warehouse to the north.  What sounds like footsteps can be heard above, but a glance up reveals nothing.

title: [Alley]
description: Buildings encroach the alley, blocking further passage.  Most are securely boarded up, evidently abandoned eons ago.

title: [Rooftop]
description: A plank in horrible condition leads the way to another rooftop.  It's warped, rotting and cracked in several places.  It's a long fall if you slip.

title: [Rooftop]
description: A slender plank precariously offers a path to the adjacent rooftop.  It would be wise not to drink too much before attempting the task, as it's going to take a great deal of concentration to cross safely.  There is a very large, very visible stain of some sort on the alley floor directly beneath the plank.

title: [Rooftop]
description: Several fat pigeons have made a home in one corner of the roof, taking over most of the shingles in the area.  They scatter slightly when approached, but otherwise appear used to the constant intrusions.

title: [Warehouse]
description: Most of the windows are boarded up, shrouding the interior in darkness and shadow.  Empty crates and discarded sacks have been pushed out of the way and piled in one corner of the room.

title: [Warehouse]
description: What must have been an office at one time is nothing more than a storeroom now.  Cleaning supplies hang from one wall, oddly out of place in this filthy building.

title: [Warehouse]
description: A staircase leads down, the steps cracked but probably sturdy enough to use.  A small rat sits atop one of the steps, an odd glimmer in its eyes.  It doesn't seem startled by your presence.

title: [Warehouse]
description: Doors have been removed from the smaller rooms surrounding the perimeter of this floor.  Training dummies peer out from several of the rooms, odd expressions painted upon their faces.

title: [Warehouse]
description: Two well-dressed elves keep a close eye on the area.  The elder of the pair gestures at different spots about the chamber, perhaps discussing renovations or repairs.
Moonlight filters in through the few un-boarded windows, the scant illumination augmented by several sconces.  A small child sits in one corner, counting out silvers.

title: [Specialty Shop]
description: Two sconces cast flickering shadows through the room, hardly large enough for the wooden counter and the dour shopkeeper hovering over it.  Although the shop appears shabby and unkempt, its keeper has an air of prosperity that his ragged clothing cannot quite mask.

title: [Warehouse]
description: A small corridor leads to another group of doorless rooms.  Training mannequins can be spotted in each chamber, patiently awaiting their turned to be used and abused.

title: [Warehouse]
description: The walls of the hallway look bleached a bit, as if pictures may have hung upon them at one time.  There is nothing but dust and memories furnishing the corridor now.

title: [Warehouse]
description: A threadbare rug manages to partially cover a massive blood stain on the floor.  Evidently it was easier to cover it than try to clean it.  Grunting, groaning and an occasional thud can be heard emanating from somewhere nearby.

title: [Alley]
description: A few shattered crates and empty barrels are the only thing of note here, all of them empty and discarded.  A horrible attempt to mimic a birdcall can be heard coming from above.

title: [Alley]
description: The alley comes to an abrupt end, the tall facade of a brick building blocking the way.  Unlike most of the buildings, though, this one has a door.

title: [Workshop]
description: The interior of this sizeable workshop is tidy and organized, mostly due to the pair of guild apprentices cleaning up the place.  A row of cluttered toolbenches awaits those wishing to get a bit of work done.

title: [Workshop]
description: Sizable windows allow plenty of sunlight into this portion of the workshop.  Notes hang on the walls, the scrollwork precise and neat.  Tool chests and small crates contain ample supplies to handle most smaller jobs.

title: [Inn]
description: A pair of heavily armed sentries guard a sturdy iron door reinforced with faenor.  The entryway is barred and locked.  There is a sign just above the door.

title: [Hall]
description: The hallway ends, and a much larger open area can be seen just to the east.  There is a great deal of activity and conversation going in the next room, the glint of silvers flashing back and forth from time to time.  The heady aroma of home cooking seeps out of the guild kitchen.

title: [Guildmasters Office]
description: A single window looks out onto the roads of Ta'Vaalor, revealing a wide street and the bustle of people as they go about their daily routine.  There is an odd tinge to the window, as if it has been treated with something.  Folks wander by the window, but oddly, nobody ever seems to look in.

title: [Hall]
description: Fairly narrow, the hallway is still ample enough for two folk to walk side by side.  There are rooms on either side, with most of the doors opened.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Inn]
description: Quite a contrast from the squalor of the tunnels below, this comfortable common room looks well-furnished.  Several tables and chairs allow folks a comfortable place to sit and chat.  Large portraits adorn the walls, most depicting the more famous buildings of Ta'Vaalor.

title: [Inn]
description: Windows on all sides of this sitting room look out into a small courtyard.  Two leather chairs, both with small adjoining tables can be seen within the garden.

title: [Conference Room]
description: Centered in this chamber is a large round table surrounded by chairs.  A slender elven woman sits at the table, taking notes.  She looks up as you enter, than goes back to her work.

title: [Office]
description: This room is clearly an office.  A heavy wooden desk sits in one corner, a chair on either side.  A single bookcase is pushed up against one of the walls, most of the shelves empty.

title: [Entry]
description: This small entryway is scented with the aroma of fresh loam, no doubt from the muddy boots and gardening shoes lined up on a wooden rack against one wall.  Opposite the collection of shoes, a long, simply carved oak cloak rack supports a wide variety of brushed wool cloaks in all the colors of the autumn forest.

title: [Grand Entry]
description: A grand entry and marble tiled floor beckons you deeper into the building to explore the luxuries contained therein.  Double doors lead to the courtyard, and a sweeping staircase leads up to the second level.  Cream colored, gold-veined marble composes the top of a spindle-legged occasional table that stands near the entryway.

title: [Hall]
description: A polished wooden staircase curves downward from this wide landing, the checkered pattern of the marble tiles below visible at its base.  A pair of statues reside on thick pedestals on either side of the staircase, one an elegant crystal unicorn, the other an intricately carved wooden dragon.  Facing each other and striking similarly aggressive poses, the statues appear to be passing judgment on all those who ascend the stairs.

title: [Courtyard, Rose Garden]
description: A colorful variety of roses surround the tiled pathway that leads to the central gazebo.  A few honeybees dart in and out of the petals, unbothered by the multitude of folks enjoying the warm sun.

A colorful variety of roses surround the tiled pathway that leads to the central gazebo.  Several fireflies hover over the plants, their illumination providing an evening light show for the courtyard's guests.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Cobalt Salon]
description: High above, the vaulted ceiling is a domed expanse of brilliant blue, a mosaic crafted from a multitude of tiny glaes squares.  The tilework continues down the walls, stopping halfway to meet smoothed silvered stonework.  An immense ogee arch is flanked by two smaller doors.  Daylight streams through the well of an alabaster staircase.

High above, the vaulted ceiling is a domed expanse of brilliant blue, a mosaic of millions upon millions of pieces of tiny glaes squares.  The tilework continues down the walls, stopping halfway to meet smoothed silvered stonework.  An immense ogee arch is flanked by two smaller doors.  Starlight streams through the well of a stone staircase.
