Daylight streams through the well of a stone staircase.

title: [Library Aies, Alcove]
description: Alongside the building, a round alcove of paving stones is bordered by manicured beds of pansies in hues of silvered blue.  Their color is matched in the metallic surface of a small plaque and attendant door, which are set into the library's wall amidst an arched mosaic of glaesine tiles.

longside the building, a round alcove of paving stones is lit by shuttered lanterns and bordered by manicured beds of pansies in hues of silvered blue.  Their color is matched in the metallic surface of a small plaque and attendant door, which are set into the library's wall amidst an arched mosaic of glaesine tiles.

title: [Aies Apartment, Archival Salon]
description: The stone stele that conceals most of one wall is itself partially hidden behind the cover of a paneled screen.  A domed glaes case sits near a wooden arch, while a low table is overshadowed by a carved pillar and wooden statue.  The polished plank floor and high silver gilt-paneled ceiling reflect the multicolored daylight coming in through an arched mosaic of glaesine tiles, which wraps around the silvered rectangle of a slender door.

The stone stele that conceals most of one wall is itself partially hidden behind the cover of a paneled screen.  A domed glaes case sits near a wooden arch, while a low table is overshadowed by a carved pillar and wooden statue.  The polished plank floor and high silver gilt-paneled ceiling reflect the multicolored moonlight coming in through an arched mosaic of glaesine tiles, which wraps around the silvered rectangle of a slender door.

title: [Aies Apartment, Reading Room]
description: The room is small and square, appointed with a polished wooden floor and a high, silver gilt-paneled ceiling.  Gaps in the argentate are set with windows of cobalt glaes, the light from which illuminates the chamber's single desk and chair with a faintly bluish cast.  One wall is affixed with a series of books, each chained to their case with a ringlet and delicate length of links.

The room is small and square, appointed with a polished wooden floor and a high, silver gilt-paneled ceiling.  Gaps in the argentate are set with windows of cobalt glaes, the pale light from which illuminates the chamber's single desk and chair with a faintly bluish cast of diffuse moonlight.  One wall is affixed with a series of books, each chained to their case with a ringlet and delicate length of links.

title: [Servant's Quarters]
description: Sparse but comfortable living arrangements await the guild's servants at the end of the duties.  Several people apparently share this room, as there are four sets of neatly made beds and wooden chests of drawers, one occupying each corner of the small room.  The southern wall bears a mirror set into an oaken frame, greeting entrants with their own reflections.

title: [Servant's Quarters]
description: This is evidently a common area for the servants and maids.  The only furnishings are a few simple but comfortable chairs surrounding a small wooden table.  A member of the guild's hired help passes through occasionally, carrying loads of linens or empty sacks.  Several oil lamps adorn wall mounted sconces, lending a flickering illumination to the setting.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, out

title: [Hallway]
description: Uniformed maids and plainly dressed apprentices come and go through a simple wooden door in the south wall, which apparently leads to the servants' quarters.

title: [Servant's Quarters]
description: A young half-elven maid unhurriedly folds clothes on a neatly-made bed in the corner.  Three other beds occupy the other corners, each with its own small dresser nearby.  A tiny, round window on the west wall allows a bit of sunlight into the room.

Four beds occupy the corners of this small room, each with its own small dresser nearby.  Three are neatly made and empty, their owners presumably busy keeping the guild in order.  A small mound and faint snoring indicate the last to be occupied.  A tiny, round window on the west wall allows a bit of moonlight into the room.

title: [Servant's Quarters]
description: Part living quarters, part laundry storage, this room boasts piles of soiled linens and clothing between two simple beds.  A small dresser alongside one bed holds a ball of yarn and some knitting needles.

title: [Hallway]
description: An elaborate wood and rope carving hangs on the otherwise nondescript wood-paneled walls.  Clearly crafted by elven hands, the piece looks somewhat out of place in its austere surroundings.

title: [Hallway]
description: Unremarkable wooden walls are interrupted at the corner by a pair of wooden shelves.  The lower of the two holds a few glass figurines housed in a small wooden curio, while a flourishing pot of beautiful wildflowers rests above it.

title: [Hallway]
description: Several tables shaded by umbrellas are visible through a latticed partition in the north wall that looks out into a sunlit garden area.  Though most of the tables are unoccupied, intrepid songbirds occasionally flit down to forage for crumbs left by previous diners.

The view through a latticed opening in the northern wall reveals a moonlit dining area set amidst a well-tended garden.  Two heavily cloaked figures sit at the table that is farthest removed from your vantage point, apparently having a rather clandestine meeting.

title: [Hallway]
description: A small black cat dozes off to one side, half obscured by a large brass planter containing a young sapling.  Evidently conserving his energy until the evening hunt, the feline's tail occasionally twitches in his sleep as the light from a narrow window falls across his upturned stomach.  A heavy canvas drapery hangs in a doorway to the south, allowing some measure of solitude to those beyond.

An elegantly molded brass planter sits to one side of the hallway, the young elm sapling within surrounded by its own shed leaves.  A heavy canvas drapery hangs in a doorway to the south, opposite a narrow window that looks out into a moonlit garden.

title: [Library]
description: Shelves of books line the walls, many appearing much older than the guildhall itself.  Thick carpeting absorbs the whispered voices of those present and muffles your every step into silence.  A heavy canvas drape is suspended across an open doorway in the northern wall, allowing easy access into the room while protecting it from the distraction and noise of passersby in the hallway.

title: [Hallway]
description: A small pile of linens from the wine room to the south has been piled against the wall here, presumably awaiting retrieval by a preoccupied servant.  Mounted above them is a brass sculpture of a snake that is wrought in such a manner as to appear to have emerged from the wall.  The snake's coils form a solid cylinder in which a bouquet of fresh wildflowers has been placed.

title: [Club Room]
description: Displayed on glass shelves behind the long cherrywood bar is an impressive array of wines and spirits.  Centered in the wall behind the bar is a small window, through which a narrow ray of sunlight strikes the floor.  A young elven steward moves constantly around the area, doing light cleaning and occasionally filling a glass or restocking a small silver tray near the entrance with a variety of light refreshments.

Displayed on glass shelves behind the long cherrywood bar is an impressive array of wines and spirits.  Centered in the wall behind the bar is a small window, though it is too dark outside to see through.  A young elven steward moves constantly around the area, doing light cleaning and occasionally filling a glass or restocking a small silver tray near the entrance with a variety of light refreshments.

title: [Trophy Room]
description: Little more than an alcove, the walls and floor of this small room are almost completely obscured by all manner of trophies.  Pelts from a wide variety of creatures run the gamut from luxurious fur to brittle scales, creating a patchwork montage with no discernable pattern.  Some of the more exotic specimens have been used in various sorts of crafting, including an opalescent buckler laced together from myklian scales.  Against the back wall, a small wood and glass case contains several ki-lin horns.

title: [Hallway]
description: A staircase leading down to the cellar is flanked on either side by oaken pedestals topped with decorative statuary.  Framed portraits and landscapes done in a variety of styles line the outer wall.  While each piece of art is aesthetically pleasing in its own right, the ensemble as viewed together seems somewhat mismatched.

A staircase leading down to the cellar is flanked on either side by oaken pedestals topped with decorative statuary.  Framed portraits and landscapes done in a variety of styles line the outer wall.  While each piece of art is aesthetically pleasing in its own right, the ensemble as viewed together seems somewhat mismatched.  A small crystal oil lamp hangs from a hook at the top of the stairs, illuminating the descent.

title: [Cellar]
description: Several elegant silver sconces filled with scented oil illuminate this generously sized cellar.  Alcoves lead off in all directions, most serving as some type of storage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Hallway]
description: The southern half of the guild's lounge is visible through the open doorway to the east, although it appears primarily empty at this time of day.  Directly south of the lounge entrance, a small round window allows a few rays of sunshine to slip through the decorative wrought iron that protects the glass from the outside.

The southern half of the guild's lounge is visible through the open doorway to the east, and occasional cheers and jeers can be heard within.  Directly south of the lounge entrance, a small round window looks out through a decorative wrought iron covering into the darkened city streets.

title: [Storage]
description: A wide array of cleaning tools and supplies hangs from a wall rack, at a height suitable to all races.  A large bin sits in one corner, a few stray leaves and twigs at its base.  Off to the west, rows of mannequins have been set up for training.

title: [Cold Room]
description: This chamber is cold and dark.  A single candle is the only light in the room, but it is bright enough to reveal large haunches of rolton and venison.  A wide selection of game birds hang from hooks along the wall as well.  Training dummies stored to the southwest stare blankly at the meats.

title: [Wine Cellar]
description: The temperature of this chamber is a bit cool, but not unpleasantly so.  Several rows of wine racks fill the room.  While most of the bottles are of elven vintage, there are a few other rare labels as well.

title: [Root Cellar]
description: The root cellar is huge, only one portion of it actually used for storage.  Crates, barrels and sacks are piled in one corner, most containing dried fruit, grains or other food products.  A few dark alcoves are just off to the northeast.

title: [Game Room]
description: Several small tables are scattered about the room, topped with all manner of games to those in the mood.  A very expensive looking chess set is displayed in one corner, a tile game played with carved ivory pieces in another.

title: [Hallway]
description: An open arch to the east leads into a lounge area.  Although many of the guild's members sleep through the day, the lounge is never empty.  During the evening hours it is far livelier, with the sounds of laughter and conversation drowning out all but occasional bits of music that drift into the hallway, filling the occasional lull.

title: [Lounge]
description: Several overstuffed couches beckon to those wishing a bit of rest and relaxation.  Small groups of guild members are scattered about the lounge, speaking in hushed tones.  A large golden harp rests in one corner, unattended for the moment.  A narrow window set high in the eastern wall allows a tiny beam of sunlight to glint off the glasses set on the bar.

Several overstuffed couches sitting beneath a narrow, high-set window beckon to those wishing a bit of rest and relaxation.  Numerous tables are already occupied by other guild members, chatting and laughing in small groups as they enjoy a cold beverage.  Most of the conversation seems to center around personal exploits and favorite "fishing holes."  A young woman softly strokes a golden harp in the corner, the soft music soothing and pleasant.

title: [Hallway]
description: The corner of a playing card peeks out from underneath the edge of the runner carpet, one of the few signs of untidiness to be found in the meticulously kept building.  Serving girls pass by occasionally with trays of drinks in their hands, though none appear to be in much of a hurry and they often take a moment to smile slightly as they stroll along.

title: [Hallway]
description: The northern wall of this passage boasts a window almost a dozen feet long.  Set high enough that those outside are unable to see in, the window allows generous amounts of sunlight to fall upon the opposite wall, where multitudes of wildflowers occupy a series of deep mahogany planters.  Roses, carnations, and baby's breath mix with tulips and lilies to create a rainbow array of color and fragrance.

The northern wall of this passage boasts a window which is almost a dozen feet long and set high enough that those outside can see nothing but the hallway's ceiling.  The pinpoint twinkle of stars interrupts the otherwise featureless night sky visible through the glass.  Multitudes of wildflowers occupy a series of deep mahogany planters on the opposite wall, waiting for the morning sun and filling the corridor with their sweet fragrance, somewhat cloying in the still night air.

title: [Hallway]
description: A small semicircular occasional table sits to one side of the hallway, its polished surface almost completely obscured by the large and ornately painted globe atop it.  A dark green runner carpet suppresses the footfalls of the occasional passerby.

title: [Hallway]
description: A delicate silver mobile dangles from the ceiling, tinkling softly from a stray breeze drifting in through an open window.  A narrow wooden table opposite the window holds a vase of wildflowers which stir gently in the draft.

title: [Hallway]
description: A mismatched pair of rogues stand to one side discussing various aspects of guild training.  One of them, a stocky dwarf with an impressive beard, busies herself at cleaning a filthy window without seeming to make much progress, while the other, a tall sylvan who appears to be favoring one foot, seems content to lean against the wall.

A mismatched pair of rogues, outlined in the dim moonlight forcing its way through a dirty window, stand to one side discussing various aspects of guild training.  One of them, a stocky dwarf with an impressive beard, busies herself at cleaning the filthy window without seeming to make much progress, while the other, a tall sylvan who appears to be favoring one foot, seems content to lean against the wall.

title: [Hallway]
description: A trophy case decorates the corner of the hallway, tall enough to rest flush against the ceiling.  A glance inside is rewarded with the glint of precious metal from the varied and numerous trophies within.  Many of the trophies appear to date back quite some time and were earned for skills that few self-respecting rogues would possess.

title: [Hallway]
description: A small window in the western wall offers a view of a delightful little pond.  Several swans glide aimlessly across the water, content to bask in the warm sunlight.
A small window in the western wall looks out across a darkened pond.  A heron steps carefully along the shore, glancing here and there into the water near its feet.

title: [Hallway]
description: A small alcove set into one wall is sectioned off from the hallway by a thin muslin curtain.  Through the partially drawn curtain, you can see a low felwood table at which two men in black leather armor are seated.  They comfortably chat in low voices, apparently unconcerned with your presence.

title: [Courtyard, Gazebo]
description: Sunlight filters in through the gazebo's slatted ceiling and creates a series of shadowed stripes upon the wooden floor.  A few birds hop about on the nearby grass, hoping for handouts.

Moonlight filters in through the gazebo's slatted ceiling and creates a series of soft shadowed stripes upon the wooden floor.  A cat has managed to climb on top of the gazebo's roof and is napping quietly up there.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Courtyard, Pond]
description: A waterfall cascades down into a small pond, creating ripples on the water's surface.  One of the groundskeepers stands nearby with a bucket of fish food in his hands.

A waterfall cascades down into a small pond, creating ripples on the water's surface.  A cat gingerly sticks its paw into the water, evidently trying to make a meal of one of the large fish swimming around.

title: [Courtyard, Veranda]
description: Three tables sit beneath a simple thatched roof and provide a pleasant place for a snack.  A mandolin leans up against the guild wall, unattended momentarily.

title: [Courtyard, Shed]
description: A small wooden shed sits against the outer wall of the courtyard, mostly obscured by a carefully tended wall of ivy working its way across a lattice.  The ivy seems to have spread across the shed's roof and several tendrils dangle in front of its door.

title: [Shed Interior]
description: It would be difficult to squeeze more than a few people at once into the cramped interior of this shed.  Apart from the door out and a small counter-like shelf, this room is otherwise barren.

title: [Studio]
description: This neat and well organized workshop is quite ample.  Tools are hung carefully on the walls, and the floors are clear of debris.  There isn't a speck of sawdust to be seen.

title: [Hall]
description: A large hand-woven cotton tapestry dominates the northern part of this corner, the colors somewhat flamboyant against the unobtrusive earth tones of the wooden walls.  The tapestry is either relatively new or meticulously preserved, and would likely fetch a high price in the marketplace.  A slight breeze from the south occasionally stirs the lemon-colored fringe along its bottom edge.

title: [Hall]
description: A pair of cushioned chairs bracketing a small table offer a great spot to sit and relax.  The eastern wall consists of a floor-to-ceiling wrought-iron screen adorned with intricate scrollwork, providing an excellent view of the courtyard.  Songbirds occasionally emerge from flowering bushes to engage in an airborne dance above the garden.

The eastern wall consists of a floor-to-ceiling wrought iron screen adorned with intricate scrollwork, providing an excellent view of the courtyard.  Songbirds occasionally emerge from flowering bushes to engage in an airborne dance above the garden.

The eastern wall consists of a floor-to-ceiling wrought-iron screen adorned with intricate scrollwork, providing an excellent view of the courtyard below.  A cool breeze, heavy with the scent of blooming jasmine, springs up occasionally to rustle the gardens.

A cool breeze, heavy with the scent of blooming jasmine, springs up occasionally to rustle the gardens.

title: [Hall]
description: An interesting sculpture crafted entirely of tusks and horns dominates this corner of the hall.  The piece of art flows up from the floor to the ceiling like some overzealous thorned vine, and must have taken a great deal of time to create.

title: [Siren's Wood, Path]
description: Towering oak and maoral trees line a verdant path, their leafy boughs casting deep shadows across the mossy ground.  A single stone bench, the grey stone tinged green from the verdant plant growth, is nestled into a tiny hollow beside the path.  Opposite the hollow is a white marble statue surrounded by a bed of crimson dragonstalks.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: A tall chair sits behind a heavy wooden desk covered with parchments and maps.  One of the documents is a bit stained, perhaps from coffee or tea.

title: [Hall]
description: Several thick leather chairs are arranged in the corner around a small wooden table.  Although currently unoccupied, the presence of several half-empty glasses of wine indicates that the area was only recently vacated.  The inner wall of the corridor is replaced to the south by a wrought iron railing that seems to look down into an open garden of some sort.

Several thick leather chairs are arranged in the corner around a small wooden table.  The rich smell of the leather reaches you on a cool breeze from the south, where the corridor appears to be open to the outside somehow.

title: [Decrepit Captain's Table]
description: Fashioned from various bits of bric-a-brac, this once fine captain's table has been repaired, replaced, and refinished like a patchwork quilt. One leg has been substituted with a splintering baluster, while another has been fitted with a pockmarked chunk of white coral on the end to make up for its short length. Spilled tankards, careless daggers, and greasy foods render the wood a rich dark mahogany, dotted with nicks and gouges that house an array of sticky, unsavory substances within their crevices.

title: [Dining Room]
description: Long tables covered with crisp white linens fill the room in several orderly rows, with eight place settings carefully laid out on each side.  Elegant crystal glasses and gleaming silverware sparkle in the candlelight, giving the room quite a formal, dignified air.  A pair of swinging doors in the southeastern corner lead into the kitchen.

title: [Rogue Guild, Delivery Area]
description: Enticing, savory aromas drift through a set of steel-braced double doors flanked by potted, luminescent toadstools.  Stacked nearby are several crates and boxes filled with recent food deliveries that have yet to be unpacked.  Cook's assistants occasionally wander by, carrying trays of food to other areas.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lower Hall]
description: Deep, azure glaes has been crafted to resemble the flowing cascades of a waterfall in miniature.  The artful sculpture resides within a small nook hung with phosphorescent moss that casts a mysterious glow upon the volcanic glass.  A dark stairway stands in the corner of the hall.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Hall]
description: Stark and unadorned, the corridor turns a sharp corner into the adjacent hall.  The nearest source of light lies many yards to the north and northwest, leaving much of the area swathed in shadows.  Small seams run down and across the surrounding polished black marble, marking the edges of each perfectly cut block.  A dark stairway is visible just beyond a large, arched alcove built into the eastern wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lower Hall]
description: Clear glaes windows have been inset along the reflective black marble walls of this long hallway.  In the spaces between, polished brass pots house the giant, luminescent toadstools used for lighting.

title: [Rogue Guild, Storeroom]
description: Orderly stacks of labeled boxes and crates stand alongside fully stocked shelves of tools and other daily supplies required by guild members.  Tacked to the wall beside the door is a lengthy inventory checklist.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: A pair of giant, luminescent toadstools occupy a large alcove opposite the eastern branching corridor.  The oversized fungi have faintly mottled caps that shed a diffuse bluish light upon the polished black marble.

title: [Rogue Guild, Antechamber]
description: Reflective black marble spans as far as the eye can see, stretching down long corridors and into shadow.  Occasional footfalls can be heard, resounding against the stone floor.  Rising at the center of the antechamber is a polished grey column, glimmering with a hint of gold against the dark decor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, up

title: [Tunnel]
description: Roughly hewn steps lead far beneath the brewery along this steep, sloping tunnel.  A soft glow creeps into the darkness from a large opening at the bottom of the stairs.

title: [Rogue Guild, Daggerstalk Nook]
description: Shadows cling to the surrounding walls, running down the stone like wet black paint.  In contrast to the dark surroundings, a glaes mosaic table offers a splash of color with its vividly hued ornamentation.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lounge]
description: Spanning half the length of the southern wall is a gleaming gold-speckled bar and thick glaes shelves lined with colorful bottles.  Short, reinforced invar stools have been stacked neatly in the corner should need of additional seating arise.  The majority of the lounge is dominated by an assortment of padded chairs and tables occupied by guild members sharing laughs and drinks.

title: [Rogue Guild, Trollfear Table]
description: Several mismatched chairs have been gathered closely around a polished glaes-inlaid table.  A nearby giant glowing toadstool sheds a soft white light, gleaming off the bottles lining the wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Genkew Booth]
description: A round glaes-inlaid table occupies much of the space in this quiet booth.  The cushy, leather-covered bench smells faintly of ale, lingering from drinks spilled in the past.  A red sphene toadstool charm has been tacked onto the back wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Hall]
description: Tiny flecks of cloudy quartz crystal in the floor pick up the greenish hue of the light shed by the nearby giant toadstools.  Carved into the ceiling is a faint design vaguely resembling runes, though it is far too symmetric to be anything but decorative.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Hall]
description: Shallow carvings adorn the black marble, creating mesmerizing designs of light and shadow in the presence of strategically placed luminescent toadstools.  The corridors meet at a t-junction, where a huge carved red jasper has been set into the gold-sheened lintel above a pair of ornately carved white granite doors.

title: [Guild Master's Office]
description: Rich, amber-hued marble and burnished copper fixtures accent the spacious office of the Guild Master.  A collection of hefty gem shards serve as paperweights upon a curious-looking desk.  Mounted prominently on the north wall is a coiled, roa'ter skin whip, while a gold-framed oil painting hangs on the opposite side.

title: [Rogue Guild, Corridor]
description: Square glaes windows line the walls of this wide corridor, framed with a thin border of gold against the black marble.  Faint murmuring can be heard from beyond a dark lacquered door.

title: [Rogue Guild, Shop]
description: Hanging from stout iron rings jutting from the ceiling are a handful of sturdy invar cages housing phosphorescent blue-green moss.  The faint light illuminates the wares displayed on shelves draped with canvas, and very little else in this small room.  A scarred, grey-bearded dwarf leans nonchalantly in the corner, sharpening his dagger.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Hall]
description: Smooth marble walls speckled with mica that glimmers slightly in the ambient light form a sharp curve in this section of the hallway.  Situated in the corner are several heavy pots filled with lichen and toadstools, creating a tiny subterranean garden that is luminescent in varying shades of blue and green.  A shadowed alcove harbors the small landing to a dark, descending stairway.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lower Hall]
description: A portion of the ceiling has been replaced by thick sheets of clear glaes that allow a glimpse into the surrounding rock laden with raw rubies.  The bright illumination provided by giant, glowing toadstools highlights the deep, sanguine hue of the gemstones.  Beyond a simple, polished granite archway is a dark stairway leading to the floor above.

title: [Rogue Guild, Corridor]
description: Spidery quartz veins riddle the marble wall from top to bottom and run the length of the corridor.  Toadstools held in iron mesh baskets near the ceiling create a faint greenish light that refracts against the crystal, forming muted prisms upon the smooth floor.

title: [Rogue Guild, Ruby Corner]
description: A portion of the northern and western walls have been replaced by translucent glaes panes, revealing glittering gems in their raw state.  Blood red rubies of varying sizes lie deeply imbedded in the rock, tantalizing and beyond reach.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workshop Entrance]
description: Shiny steel racks and hooks are laden with a wide assortment of locksmithing tools, meticulously arranged by size.  To the west, erected glaes walls partition off a series of individual workshops for guild members to practice their craft.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lower Hall]
description: Several tiny crystal charms dangle from the speckled cap of a nearby luminescent toadstool, glimmering in the soft white light.  A trio of onyx orbs have been suspended above the small landing to a wide black marble stairway.  The distant sounds of training can be heard originating from the grand, descending passage.

title: [Rogue Guild, Descent]
description: Sloping downward in two different directions, the passageway walls are draped in fuzzy blue-green moss, lighting the way with their luminescence.  A massive, rusted iron safe with its door pried open sits in the corner and currently is home to some tiny, glowing toadstools.  A clamor can be heard from beyond the tunnel to the west.

title: [Dark Cavern, East]
description: Clearly marked along the cavern floor is a wide path, outlined in reflective white stones that stand out in the darkness.  The grunting and other noises of intensive training can be heard throughout the area, amplified by the acoustics accompanying the incredibly high ceiling.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Dark Cavern, Nexus]
description: Shouts echo within this enormous cavern, though the exact sources are unknown due to the pervading darkness that overpowers the illumination of resident luminescent moss and fungi.  The shadows here have no discernable edges, they merely blend with each other to create varying degrees of dark.  A few of the surrounding stalagmites have been hewn to create stone stumps for seating.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Dark Cavern, Northwest]
description: Permeating the area is a sweet, unidentifiable scent that mingles with the slightly musty cavern aroma.  A steel cart rests to one side, covered in some spots with pinkish goo, and wheel marks run all over the floor.

title: [Dark Cavern, West]
description: A short tunnel to the west leads to several darkened alcoves carved out of the surrounding rock.  Tiny shards of quartz crystal around the opening to the passageway glimmer in the dim light.  Several knife marks scar the nearby cavern wall.

title: [Dark Cavern, Southwest]
description: Thin striations of muted crimson along the cavern walls are barely visible in the darkness.  A handful of small niches have been bored out by hand, housing colorful luminescent moss that flows out of the holes.

title: [Dark Cavern, South]
description: With only a few guild members engaged in moderate training, this portion of the cavern is relatively peaceful in comparison to the rest.  Deep alcoves run along the wall, blocked off by thick iron bars.  In the distance, glimmers of precious metals and the sparkle of gems can be seen.

title: [Dark Cavern, Southeast]
description: A monstrous pile of dingy grey salt lies out of place at the edge of the cavern, though a noticeable trail of crystals connects the mound to a small tunnel nearby.  Six steel mining picks lean against the wall, and a small encrusted wheelbarrow awaits beside them.

title: [Rogue Guild, Dead End]
description: A wall of natural rock abruptly cuts off this short tunnel, its numerous jags and cracks cast in light and shadow by the abundant luminescent moss growing here.  Several pronounced fissures run along the edge of the dead end, and a faint draft can be felt from somewhere nearby.

title: [Dark Cavern, Northeast]
description: Pale purple moss clings to the naturally rough rock along the wall, flowing like a fuzzy, lavender waterfall to the ground.  It sheds a very weak light, only enough to illuminate the space a few feet away.

title: [Dark Cavern, North]
description: Loose debris adheres to a sticky trail leading west and to one particular spot beneath a square-shaped opening in the wall.  Within the shallow niche, a large ceramic bowl rests upon a metal sheet affixed to a rope from above.  A small steel tube juts out of the rock near to the contraption.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Patches of soft, pale blue moss cling to the tunnel walls, creating barely enough illumination to navigate the winding passageway.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: aintly discernible within the pervading shadows is a skeleton propped up against the tunnel wall.  Something lies within its bony grasp.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Denser clusters of luminescent moss light up this portion of the tunnel with greater intensity than the surrounding areas, though it is still quite dark.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Darkness pervades the area, hiding potential hazards such as jagged rocks and holes in the floor.  The air is slightly dry and cool.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: A few tiny, glowing mushrooms have sprouted along the tunnel floor, standing out sharply against the darkness.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Flecks of red dot the walls, casting off a subtle luminescence.  Nearby, a dagger has been jammed into a fissure in the stone to its hilt, with bits of bluish moss dangling from it.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Heavy footsteps can be heard overhead, along with deep, gruff voices.  Several empty crates have been stacked in the corner beside odd bits of metal.

title: [A Concealed Room]
description: Crates, boxes and pieces of dusty, broken furniture are stacked along the walls of this seemingly forgotten storage room.  A simple desk and chair sit next to a narrow door.

title: [A Damp Tunnel]
description: The tunnel smells slightly of mildew and seawater.  Moisture seeps from the walls, forming small puddles on the floors.  At the far end, light seeps down from between cracks in a wooden trapdoor.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry Hall]
description: This once elegant foyer retains the vestiges of its former beauty.  A deep crimson rug lies across the darkened rosewood planks, softening visitors' footfalls.  Dark-red velvet curtains hang from dust-covered windows, preventing passersby from looking in.  The front door has been nailed shut, rendering it useless as an exit.  A wide staircase curves up to the railing at the second floor landing.

title: [Rogue Guild, Narrow Hall]
description: A rosewood railing runs along this portion of the hall allowing a view of the foyer below.  The soft, woven rug makes all footsteps silent.

title: [Guild Shop]
description: Brass sconces provide the only light in here except a few stray rays of sunshine filtering through the boarded window.  The shopkeeper cleans his nails with a broken lockpick while keeping a watchful eye on the merchandise.

title: [Meeting Room]
description: Two of the walls are covered with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves filled with old dusty books and several figurines.  The one large window has been boarded up, making it impossible to see out - or in.  A large moth-eaten tapestry, its colors faded, covers most of the dark rosewood floor.  Beautiful brass and crystal sconces illuminate the room.  All the original furniture has been removed, replaced by a podium and several rows of comfortable chairs for use in meetings.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lounge]
description: The lounge has been nearly restored to its former beauty with dark rosewood paneling lining the walls and a variety of inlaid woods on the floor.  Mirrored shelves filled with bottles sit behind the scarred but polished bar.  Brass stools with red leather seats line the front of the bar.  Large windows overlooking an overgrown courtyard fill the room with sunlight.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sitting Room]
description: Rodents and moths have diminished the beauty of the large patterned rug covering most of the floor, causing bits of the flooring to peek through.  The walls are cracked and stained and the curtains covering the large windows droop sadly from their mountings.  Few pieces of furniture remain, leaving the room barren.  Arches lead north to the dining room and back out to the corridor.

title: [Rogue Guild, Corridor]
description: Footsteps echo through the long empty corridor.  The bare floor and faded, water-stained walls do nothing to muffle any sound.  A large carved arch leads to a sitting room, the courtyard visible through the windows beyond.

title: [Rogue Guild, Dining Hall]
description: A long, polished mahogany table surrounded by mismatched chairs dominates the room.  A huge pair of ornate ebony and brass candlesticks sits on the center of the table.  Smells of cooking food drift through the room from an old swinging door.  Two large portraits, one older than the other, of former residents gaze down from opposite walls.

title: [Rogue Guild, Pantry]
description: A large set of shelves covers one wall, filled with cobwebs and dust-covered table settings.  An ornate wrought iron lantern broods over the room, casting a sickly glow through grimy glass panes.  The floor is curiously scratched in a pattern before the shelves.

title: [Rogue Guild, SW Courtyard]
description: The flagstones, though swept clean, are cracked with many missing altogether, weeds filling the empty spaces.  A dilapidated trellis leans against the wall, pinned in place by the plants running rampant on it.  Ivy claims the rest of the available space on the wall, tendrils making their way in through the broken panes of a set of glass doors.

title: [Rogue Guild, South Corridor]
description: The walls are faded and water stained, the scuffed floor bare. The sound of your footsteps echo in the empty corridor.  A large gilt mirror hangs over a narrow table of inlaid wood, gold, and ivory.

title: [Rogue Guild, SE Courtyard]
description: Weeds grow up through the cracked flagstones.  Once well-tended flowerbeds have grown into a profusion of flowers.  A rusted wrought iron bench and a large marble urn squat stolidly along the ivy covered wall, like a pair of aged friends sharing a patch of sunlight.

title: [Rogue Guild, Courtyard Center]
description: The large statue in the center of an overgrown flowerbed was once the focal point of the courtyard.  Now, missing its head and one arm, and streaked with the indignities left by generations of birds inhabiting its various sheltering spaces, it stands as a bleak reminder that the days of elegance and affluence for this place are long over.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Rogue Guild, NW Courtyard]
description: The once well-tended flowerbeds surrounding the courtyard have become choked with weeds, although the flowers continue to battle for their place.  The sound of water can be heard splashing nearby.

title: [Rogue Guild, NE Courtyard]
description: The eastern wall is completely covered with vines.  The sound of running water draws your attention to a fountain, half-concealed behind the vines, thickly coated in soft cushions of moss and algae.  The north wall, once of glass, is now little more than a metal framework with a few glinting shards here and there.  Sounds of activity from the rooms beyond filter out into the courtyard.

title: [Rogue Guild, Ballroom]
description: The once grand ballroom has been turned into a training area.  Tattered velvet curtains cover the shuttered windows.  An enormous chandelier provides ample illumination, the tinkling crystals providing background music for the guild members working at their tasks.

title: [Rogue Guild, Ballroom]
description: The marble floors of the former ballroom are covered with training mats.  Heavy velvet curtains and shuttered windows exclude any light from the outside, but the tinkling glass chandelier provides ample light for the members to work at their tasks.

title: [Rogue Guild, Conservatory]
description: Neglect has turned this once well-tended conservatory into a jungle.  Birds, finding their way in through the broken windows, flutter in the flora while guild members train on mats laid on the gravel paths below.

title: [Rogue Guild, Conservatory]
description: Tangled vines and overgrown shrubs provide a home for the stray birds and small mammals that have made their way through the broken glass into the conservatory.  The singing and chattering provide background noise for the members training on the mats laid out on the gravel paths below.  A large fig tree has broken its way through the ceiling.

title: [Conservatory Roof]
description: Iron strips provide a grid for walking between the panes of glass that form the conservatory roof.  In one area, the strips have been bent and twisted where a tree has forced its way into the sunshine.  From the street below you can hear the muffled sound of voices and the distant hurly burly of commerce.

title: [Rogue Guild, Roof]
description: The rooftops of the city can be seen over the low wall of the roof.  Weeds grow in the corners where years of dust and dirt have accumulated, creating small impromptu gardens.

title: [Rogue Guild, Roof]
description: A low wall encircles the roof affording a measure of privacy from anyone who happens to glance up.  Weeds and wildflowers growing in the cracks ruffle slightly in the breeze.

title: [Rogue Guild, Narrow Hall]
description: A thick, beautifully woven rug lines the floor of the hall, muffling the footsteps of anyone who may be about.  Flickering shadows cast by the brass sconces add to the difficulty of discerning if one is alone or not.

title: [Rogue Guild, Master's Office]
description: A dozen overgrown green plants hang from the walls of this small chamber, their spidery vines draping themselves over a tall bookcase and trailing down the faded walls.  The only other furniture is a simple desk and chair standing in the center of the chamber.  A large potted palm partially conceals the boarded window.

title: [Rogue Guild, Narrow Hall]
description: Beautiful brass sconces provide flickering light, casting eerie shadows on the walls.  An intricately woven rug runs the length of the hallway, muffling members' footsteps.  A marbled vase sits on a small table set against the wall.

title: [Guild Buyer]
description: Crates overflowing with odds and ends line the walls.  In the middle of the room is a desk with a smoky oil lamp and a large tattered ledger on it.

title: [Rogue Guild, Narrow Hall]
description: Flickering shadows from the brass sconces dance along the walls.  An intricately woven rug, flawed only by a large dark stain, runs the length of the hallway, muffling members' footsteps.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workroom]
description: A large bed has been pushed to one side to make room for rows of cluttered toolbenches lining the walls.  Brass lanterns hang over each bench to provide ample light for the delicate work done here.

title: [Comfortable Nook]
description: This cozy room is the size of a large linen closet.  Thick carpets cover the floor.  Plump pillows and cushions are scattered carelessly about.  Three of the four walls are covered with faded draperies.  The fourth wall is unadorned, just a bare wooden surface covered with knotholes.

title: [Quiet Alcove]
description: Padded maroon leather chairs surround a dark rosewood table.  Heavy curtains provide privacy and muffle the sounds of the bar outside.

title: [Rogue Guild, Billiard Room]
description: A large billiard table takes up most of the available space at this end of the lounge.  A rack of cues sits along one wall and a brass scorekeeping device hangs on another.  Large curtain covered windows look out onto an overgrown courtyard, filling the room with bright sunlight.

title: [Silvermule, Back Alley]
description: The overhanging roof of the Silvermule Gaming Hall shades a narrow alleyway that forms a niche between the uneven dark stone back walls of the establishment and opens to the north.  A few empty crates and barrels have been stacked against the stone, and it is hard to tell if they are waiting to be disposed of or filled with something.

title: [Rogue Guild, West Courtyard]
description: The courtyard widens into an irregularly-shaped ground, bounded by the uneven back walls of the buildings to the north and south.  The ground is soft, and covered with a layer of snow and mud and the tracks of hundreds of passing boots.  The building to the west, unlike the others, seems to have been built facing in on the courtyard, and its small door is guarded by a pair of neatly-trimmed fir trees.

title: [Rogue Guild, Offices]
description: The narrow, quiet hallway is carpeted in a runner of dark, richly woven wool that muffles the sounds of footsteps.  A small, ornately carved table bears a fine ceramic vase that holds a single graceful iceblossom, and a mahogany plaque hangs on the wall above it.  Heavy silken tapestries in muted patterns line the corridor, insulating against the cold outside.

title: [Rogue Guild, Center Courtyard]
description: The rough wooden wall of an old warehouse, broken only by the outline of a simple wooden door, bounds the north side of the courtyard.  The frosty ground is hard-packed and muddy around the several small tables and chairs that have been arranged near the stone wall of the gaming hall on the south side, where a small well provides a convenient source of water.

title: [Rogue Guild, Warehouse]
description: This small warehouse has been piled to the rafters with a variety of barrels and crates that look to contain an endless variety of goods from many ports -- everything from spices to bolts of cloth to fine brandies to scrap metal and dried oats seems to be stored here.  An open area has been cleared to the west.

title: [Rogue Guild, Storage Cellar]
description: The low roof and winding tunnels of the cellar give the impression that it was probably an ancient halfling residence, burrowed long ago.  The curved walls are stacked with crates of glassware and foodstuffs, and a mouthwatering aroma of stewing meat, spices and garlic emanates from the wooden arch to the east.

title: [Rogue Guild, Shop]
description: Brightly-burning oil lamps hang in the four corners of the room, shedding a cheery light over the room.  Shopkeepers bustle about, tending to their wares with careful attention.  A graceful wooden arch opens in the north wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Buyer]
description: A large skylight fills the room with a cheery glow.  Sitting in the center of the room is a large desk, covered in a fine silk cloth.  Around the desk are a number of small bins containing a wide variety of items.

title: [Rogue Guild, Offices]
description: A single elaborately carved brass oil lamp on the east wall illuminates the hall with a soft glow.  The richly colored tapestries that cover the walls are broken by an opening in the west wall draped with a heavy grey silk curtain.  A pleasing scent of incense and spice wafts in from the arch at the north end of the hall.

title: [Contemplation Chamber]
description: A beautifully woven tapestry depicting a view of the great mountain Aenatumgana covers the north wall of the low-ceilinged, tranquil chamber.  Silken mats cover the floor, and a low enameled table holds a bowl of fragrant incense and an iron brazier that warms the room against the chill draft that blows through the bamboo curtain in the west wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Masters' Garden]
description: An open garden has been cleared between the buildings, bounded by a fence of dark polished wood.  A few scattered iceblossoms bloom in the corners of the enclosure, but the main expanse of the garden is a square of snowy, open ground surrounding a few strategically placed stones.  The frost-dusted dirt has been raked into geometric patterns around the stones, and several small benches provide seating from which to comtemplate the patterns.

An open garden has been cleared between the buildings, bounded by a fence of dark polished wood.  A few scattered iceblossoms bloom in the corners of the enclosure, but the main expanse of the garden is a square of snowy, open ground surrounding a few strategically placed stones.  The frost-dusted dirt has been raked into geometric patterns around the stones, and several small benches provide seating from which to contemplate the patterns.

title: [Rogue Guild, Master's Office]
description: Silken tapestries woven into hypnotic patterns line the walls of the serene office, suffused with the glow of hand-blown glass lamps set on small tables in each corner.  The centerpiece of the room is a low desk constructed of polished ebonwood in a simple, elegant design, and cushioned mats are arranged on the floor in place of chairs.  A large window consumes most of the north wall, looking out on the peaceful garden outside.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Courtyard]
description: The wood and stone back walls of the surrounding buildings form a spacious, elongated courtyard that extends to the west through the middle of the block.  Most of the snow has been cleared away by the constant passing of trampling feet, and a few hardy evergreen vines add spots of green to the grey and brown of the frosty walls.

title: [Icemule Trace, Rooftop]
description: The nondescript rooftop is covered by a blanket of snow broken only by the quickly fading outlines of several sets of footprints leading off to the north.  An old ladder propped against the back of the building leads down into a narrow courtyard.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workshop]
description: The crates and boxes stacked at this end of the modest warehouse appear to hold mainly metal parts and hardware, judging by their labels.  Rows of lockpicking and metalworking tools hang from racks along the west wall, where a row of workbenches has been set up in a cleared area.

title: [Rogue Guild, Meeting Room]
description: The burrow widens and deepens into a natural auditorium here, with rows of dirt benches set up in a semicircle leading to a small stage at the south end.  The walls are stacked with boxes overflowing from the storage outside, and hung with rough woven tapestries that help keep out the chill of the surrounding earth.

title: [Rogue Guild, Bar]
description: The tunnel opens out into a wide room, dimly lit by the flickering light of candles that burn on the dozen small oaken tables that have been set around the room, with a variety of cloth-covered crates and half-barrels serving as chairs.  A private curtained booth and a dark booth are set into one wall, and a long oaken bar runs along the north end of the room.

title: [Rogue Guild, Curtained Booth]
description: The booth has been carved out of the wall of the burrow, and fitted with rough but confortably padded benches and a small table.  A dark curtain muffles the hustle and bustle of the bar outside.

title: [Rogue Guild, Curtained Booth]
description: The booth has been carved out of the wall of the burrow, and fitted with rough but comfortably padded benches and a small table.  A dark curtain muffles the hustle and bustle of the bar outside.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Pantry]
description: Bags of flour, potatoes, onions and herbs stand in this spacious pantry.  Large containers of dry food have been sorted and stacked among the shelves in groups.  A few pots and pans hang from the surrounding walls as light from a nearby window reflects off of them, sending rays of light throughout the pantry.

title: [Inn Pantry, Storage]
description: Wine casks, pickle barrels and produce crates have been arranged in this small, tidy room like furniture.  A book, with a sage leaf as a bookmark, rests on an overturned lime carton.  Large burlap bags of flour lean against one wall.  At the rear is a surprisingly sturdy oak door.

title: [Inn, Cubbyhole]
description: This narrow area is lined with unfinished cedar.  Motes of dust drift down an air shaft.  An agile person might be able to shinny up the air shaft.

title: [Inn, Rooftop]
description: You stand at the very edge of the roof at the back of the inn.  Red glazed, barrel tiles make the footing risky.  Moonlight glints off the spire of a minaret to the northwest.  A breeze carries the slightly tangy smell of the distant bay.  To the east, entirely surrounded by thick brambles, is a dingy, stucco building that appears long abandoned.  For the stalwart, a rope bridge leads over the brambles to the roof of the abandoned building.  A narrow air shaft leads down.

title: [Rogue Guild, Rooftop]
description: Although the roof tiles look disordered and broken a meticulous inspection shows them to be carefully arranged to give the appearance of deterioration.  The roof overlooks a grassy courtyard in which figures can be seen engaged in rigorous guild exercises.  A rope ladder leads down.  A rope bridge offers a route to the roof of the River's Rest Inn.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry Hall]
description: Glazed ceramic tiles with an ornate indigo design cover the lower third of the sand-colored walls in this hallway.  Larger tiles rim the peaked arches that lead to the east and west.  On the wall, in a humble oak frame, is an ancient map.  A sturdy door leads south.

title: [Rogue Guild, Portico]
description: The air is cool beneath the portico.  The walkway, made of cream-colored octagonal tiles, retains that coolness.  An exquisite brass lantern hangs from the portico rafters.  To the south the moons shine brightly on a well-tended green lawn and a salmon-colored awning under which rogues of all sizes and races practice their skills.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: Thick rugs of bright colors and ornate designs cover the floor of this room, which is devoid of furniture.  A diaphanous curtain of coral beads screens a narrow arch leading to the north.  A placard hangs on the wall beside a thick, iron-banded door.

title: [Rogue Guild, Master's Chamber]
description: This wide chamber somehow looks both sumptuous and businesslike at the same time.  Stout monir beams cross the vaulted ceiling.  At one end of the chamber, facing the door is a long worktable.  In a small, arched recess behind the worktable is a prayer rug.  Wide windows covered with ornate brass grills are open to the air.

title: [Rogue Guild, Guild Shop]
description: The ceiling of this small room is stained with soot from the oil lamps that illuminate it.  Arranged around the room are a variety of goods and wares from every corner of western Elanthia.  A shop assistant dozes in a shadowy recess in the back of the room.

title: [Rogue Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Plush cushions lie in ordered rows on luxurious carpets facing a low dais.  Tendrils of grey smoke rise in sensuous spirals from incense burners placed at either end of the dais.  A pair of crossed waraxes hang on the cream-colored plaster wall at the rear of the room.  Brass lamps hang from hinged hooks on the wall.  Rolled bamboo blinds let moonlight filter in through arched windows, casting the room in a cool blue light.  Two massive green glazed urns, tall as giantkin, stand between the windows.

title: [Rogue Guild, Library]
description: Shelves of books line three of the walls of this tranquil room.  The fourth wall is covered by a large, faded tapestry.  In the center of the room is a tall, pigeonholed scroll rack.  Comfortable chairs are scattered haphazardly throughout.  Large candles of fine beeswax scented with winterberry provide a soft, even light.  In an alcove by the door the guild librarian slouches in a chair, apparently asleep.

title: [Rogue Guild, Canteen]
description: This small, congenial room has been set aside as a haven for guild members weary from training.  A small bar angles out from the wall.  A soft breeze, redolent with the scent of blackberries, wafts in through the open window.  An angry-looking parrot hops about inside a large bamboo cage hanging from the ceiling.  A simple monir sideboard holds refreshments.

title: [Guild Canteen, Storage Alcove]
description: Crates, cartons, oaken boxes, and iron-bound coffers are stacked along the walls.  The containers bear the labels and insignia of the various inns, cartage companies, Houses, museums, temples, and public agencies from which they were filched.  Some are quite old and covered with dust, while others are clearly recent acquisitions.

title: [Guild Canteen, Snuggery]
description: Strewn with comfortable pillows, this small room invites relaxation and quiet talk.  A canopy of fine silks covers the ceiling and drapes in graceful folds down the walls.  On the low table is an enameled box and a candle in a brass holder.

title: [Guild Canteen, Quiet Nook]
description: An ornate, latticed window dominates this quiet corner of the canteen, bathing the area in cool moonlight.  The sound of the river can be heard through the thick brambles outside.  A small figurine stands on a damask-covered table.

title: [Rogue Guild, Portico]
description: The tiled walkway is cool in the shade of the portico.  A few bamboo mats and rugs are scattered around a wooden trash barrel.  An exquisite brass lantern hangs from the portico rafters.  A small, hand-lettered sign hangs on the wall.  The portico extends south.  To the southeast is a salmon-colored awning.

title: [Rogue Guild, Portico]
description: The tiled walkway here is somewhat scuffed and worn, evidence of frequent foot traffic.  A graceful arch outlined in decorative tiles leads west.  The smell of garlic, olive oil and roasting meat wafts from the arch.  To the east is a salmon-colored awning.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: Ornate brass oil lamps illuminate the long hallway.  The tiled floor is partly covered with simple rugs.  Heat emanates from the kitchen door.  The smell of garlic and roasting meats fill the hallway.  A framed painting hangs on one wall.  The hallway continues south.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: Ornate brass oil lamps illuminate the long hallway.  The tiled floor is partly covered with simple rugs.  The smell of garlic and roasting meats fills the hallway.  A small tapestry hangs on the wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Storage Closet]
description: This large closet is used to store cleaning supplies.  Mops, shovels, brushes, buckets are all arranged in careful order on shelves and racks.  The room smells of harsh soap and detergents.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: The tiled floor is partly covered with simple rugs.  The flickering light from the ornate brass oil lamps reflects off a brightly polished tower shield which hangs on the wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Courtyard]
description: A small shrine has been erected in the corner formed by the courtyard walls.  Sheltered from any breeze, the sweet smell of burning incense lingers in the air.  The ivy which clings to the walls has been trimmed away from the shrine.  To the northeast is a salmon-colored awning.

title: [Rogue Guild, Courtyard]
description: The grass here grows thick and soft.  A slight indentation can be observed in the stucco courtyard wall.  Beyond the wall birds can be heard singing.  To the north is a salmon-colored awning.

title: [Rogue Guild, Courtyard]
description: A salmon-colored awning covers the center of the courtyard.  The moonlight filtered through the awning casts everybody in a strange orangish light.  A simple monir table serves the Training Administrator as a desk.  From here the Administrator keeps a calm, disinterested eye on the activities in the courtyard and the portico.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Rogue Guild, Courtyard]
description: The lawn here is thin.  Patches of sandy soil, scuffed up by violent exercise, are visible.  Small lizards dart in and out of the ivy which grows profusely up the stucco walls.  To the northwest is a salmon-colored awning.

title: [Rogue Guild, Courtyard]
description: The lawn is thick and very green here.  A grey riverstone fountain abuts the courtyard wall.  Fragrant, blue, pantaloon-shaped flowers bloom around the base of the fountain.  Ivy grows up the cream-colored stucco walls.  To the west is a salmon-colored awning.

title: [Rogue Guild, Portico]
description: Many of the tiles that make up the portico walkway here are scratched and broken.  Against the wall is a bench on which drowsy footpads rest.  The air is tinged with the slight smell of sweat.  An exquisite brass lantern hangs from the portico rafters.  To the southwest is a salmon-colored awning.

title: [Public Lockers]
description: You are standing in a small stall whose facing wall is filled with an array of small, secured lockers.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and is sitting on the counter in front of you.

title: [Marble Tunnel]
description: A grey marble tunnel leads from a black door toward a shadowy arch at its opposite end.  The air is cooled by the richly veined stone walls, their surface a high polish which reflects the light shed from sconces hanging in a row like flickering sentinels.  A plush runner traverses the hall, woven in muted tones of grey, a lighter shade than the stone.  The contrast gives the wool of the rug an attractive, albeit subtle, silvery sheen.

title: [Mesmere Bungalow, Round Chamber]
description: Curved marble walls enclose an expanse of patterned floor, its mosaic a striking composition of black, white and grey.  Across the elaborate floor decoration, plush rugs create glowing islands of color in shades of red and gold.  Large pillows, matching the tones in the rugs, one a myriad of color, another in bright red and blue and a third in red accented with a diamond overlay, lie in luxurious piles interspersed with low tables crafted of polished ebony.

title: [Mesmere Bungalow, Study]
description: The study is a circular chamber, its walls a darker shade of grey than the room above it.  However, the stone is as richly veined and polished.  One wall defies the curved sweep, its expanse flat to accommodate floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, filled with the pattern of color created by the leather-bound spines of countless books.  Two leather armchairs sit before a central fire pit.  The study's domed ceiling is ornamented with a mosaic depicting the night sky, bejeweled with its heavenly bodies.

title: [Behlayr, Modwir Street]
description: Wisps of snow swirl down the street, creating wave-like patterns in the heavier packed snow on the ground.  Small footprints trail back and forth across the roadway, with snowballs splatted all over the ground, some obviously having hit their mark.  The delighted squeals of children echo around, the fierce battle still in full scale elsewhere in the neighborhood.

title: [A Ransacked Shed]
description: Moonlight sneaks through various cracks in the ancient wood of this shed, allowing you to see the wreckage within.  Loose grain covers the floor, perhaps reason for the strong stench within this small enclosure.  One huge scratch mars the inside of the door here, deeply splintering the wood.

title: [Behlayr, Modwir Street]
description: The Behlayr neighborhood resembles a boom town, with buildings along its roads carrying a definite flavor of logging design and functionality.  Middle class families moved into many of them, upgrading the look and style of the area as well as adding the air of civility.

title: [Behlayr, Maoral Street]
description: Copper flashing on the rooflines protect their buildings from water seeping in from the outside.  Many of the owners have staved off the elements damaging the copper and kept the brilliant shine by polishing the copper and then letting a clear sheet of water freeze over it.  Moonlight further accents the tones on the metal with its yellow beams reflecting off the surface of the flashing.

title: [Snowfields, Sculpture Court]
description: A wide field opens out to the northeast, filled with soft wet snow gently rolling over small hummocks unbroken by the ravages of the storms that cross the open lands near the Trace.  Residents have taken advantage of the generous snowfall to create elaborate snow sculptures that dot the expansive flats.  Some of the ersatz craftsmen have built basic snowmen, while others have made fantastic scenes of heroic knights battling magnificent dragons.

title: [Snowfields, Sculpture Court]
description: The makeshift valley is filled with elaborate and unusual shapes and creations of snow, continuing up the side of the slope to the northeast.  Several small children push a great ball of snow around, gathering it in preparation for the creation of another snow-creature.  A small plaque dedicates the area to the young and the young at heart.

title: [Snowfields, Sculpture Court]
description: A few homesteads dot the inclines surrounding the snow-covered meadow.  The owners joined in the fun, creating ice sculptures in their yards and snow creatures on the rooftops.  Very little wind gets over the rise, keeping the artworks in good shape until they are taken down by someone to make room for a new creation.

title: [Behlayr, Monir Street]
description: A line of slender trees to the west side of the avenue is bent almost double from the weight of fresh powder.  Massive clumps fall with a great crash when a heavy breeze knocks part of the mass loose, quickly replaced by yet more snow.  The windbreak holds back a good part of the brunt of storms racing across the landscape.

title: [Behlayr, Tanik Street]
description: Cobblestones make up the road surface at the western end and progressively get larger as the street advances to the east, eventually reaching flagstone size.  Snow, sleet, and ice is packed firmly between the rocks, making the roadbed rather solid, similar to a beam joint used in housing construction.  Skates and sled runners can hardly make a dent in the hard surface, making high speeds very easy to reach.

title: [Behlayr, Monir Street]
description: Snapped in two and frozen solid to a fence, a street sign lies forgotten, unreadable through the many layers of opaque ice.  Sled tracks mar a sizeable hill built by the unceasing winds, the neighborhood children taking advantage of the steep slope.  Hints of gold paint flicker from the housing set back from the road.

title: [Behlayr, Maoral Street]
description: Tall conifer and pine trees dwarf the houses dotting the landscape, dropping massive cones everywhere.  Fallen needles and sprigs are so thick in some places that it resembles a heavy grassy carpet found in more temperate climes.  Some of the lower, heavier branches are missing, perhaps having become fodder for the many fireplaces in town.

title: [Behlayr, Modwir Street]
description: A large dog wanders around the front yard of one of the houses, returning often to its small igloo home to get out of the fierce weather.  The yard itself bears the brunt of the animal's attempts to run free, many large holes pockmarking the otherwise well-kept grounds.  Even the white fence marking the property line is heavily scratched up from the rampant digging.

title: [Behlayr, Modwir Street]
description: Houses line both sides of the avenue, reaching out to the west in a line of silent sentinels trying to maintain a thin veil of civilization in this inhospitable environment.  White picket fences surround each yard in a further attempt at politeness and a more genteel way of living.

title: [Behlayr, Modwir Street]
description: Wooden modwir planks can be seen through the ice sheathing the roadway, giving the street its name.  Each of the streets in the Behlayr neighborhood reflect the heritage and available materials used in or around the buildings that inhabit the area.  Even the orderly way the streets are laid out resemble the clean lines of an evergreen.

title: [Behlayr, Maoral Street]
description: Orange mud breaks through the icy surface of the road in several places, the copper tailings used as the foundation of the streets giving the mud its odd cast.  In other places, the thick sheet of ice has melted into the ground creating a slippery mire, dangerous to navigate.  The houses lining the roadway avoid the heavy foot traffic by the simple virtue of the walkways fronting the properties they occupy.

title: [Behlayr, Maoral Street]
description: A small pathetic looking pine tree stands in the corner of one yard, struggling to survive despite the severe windburn and the evergreen bushes crowding it on two sides.  Once pristine white snow gathered on the branches is now almost black from the dirt, smoke, and grime blown around on swirling winds.  The fine soil in which the tree was planted has since degraded to an icy sludge from the traffic passing near it and the animals digging around its base.

title: [Behlayr, Maoral Street]
description: Heated fog rolls in on the breeze from the southwest, blown apart quickly as it follows the contours of the ground.  The source of the strange mist is a carefully crafted mithril fountain in the middle of the Behlayr Square.  Moonlight glints cheerily off the curved edges of the exquisite geothermal wonder, further making a harsh environment seem less hostile.

title: [Behlayr, Maoral Street]
description: Aged copper roofs create a striking difference with most of the rest of the Trace, the multi-shades of green creating an odd cast in the ice sheathing them.  To the southeast, a large mithril fountain billows steam into the air, marking it as a major heat source.  The fountain attracts visitors from all over to marvel at its geothermal waters as well as its beautiful silvery and golden construction.

title: [Behlayr, Mithril Fountain]
description: A steaming mithril fountain bubbles happily in the middle of the square, heated by thermal waters from deep within the earth.  Playful sprite statues throw water from buckets, the liquid arcing into the air and then falling into the confines of the basin with a noisy splash.  Animals wander in from time to time to soak in the heat before returning to the hostile weather of the Trace.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Behlayr, Monir Street]
description: Gusts of wind spray walls, fences, and plants with a fine dusting of snowy ice crystals.  From underneath a nearby drift, a small stream of water trickles, flowing out into the street and freezing into a solid sheet of black ice.

title: [Behlayr, Monir Street]
description: A flattened muddy patch of snow trampled by several people shows signs of a small group huddled together, trying to stay warm in the mists from the nearby spring.  The fountain is a popular gathering place for the locals to enjoy a leisurely exchange of news and stories before wading home through tall drifts.

title: [Behlayr, Monir Street]
description: A large round mound of hand-packed snow partially blocks the pathway on the eastern side of the road.  Two smaller companion balls of ice and debris lie nearby, an unfinished snow creature left by children called home for a meal.  Two lumps of coal and a small stick protrude out of the smallest of the spheres to create a crude face.

title: [Behlayr, Monir Street]
description: A sparkling flash of light scampers across the ground, reflecting off a large icicle hanging from a nearby tree branch.  Smaller icicles cling to the tree's other branches, transforming an otherwise unremarkable fir into a brilliant outdoor living crystal chandelier.

title: [Behlayr, Tanik Street]
description: Just like the trees on the west side of the neighborhood, a large earth, ice, and snow berm provides a windbreak against the fierce storms that roll across the frontier.  In some places on the outer slope, icicles have grown upwards due to the constant wind, giving the hill a set of frosty teeth.

title: [Behlayr, Tanik Street]
description: Dark patches in the ice pack hint at deep holes underneath, and some of the flagstones have broken apart where the permafrost shattered from the heavy weights travelling over it.  Frozen ruts filled with sludge thrown from wagons and heavy sleds lend further to the heavy gray color of the top layer of snow lining the roadway.  The picket fences standing further back from the road are a much lighter color, having avoided much of the dirt thrown back from passing traffic.

title: [Behlayr, Tanik Street]
description: Several cords of wood from the nearby forest are piled in a shelter to keep them dry.  The local house owners pick up fuel for their fireplaces from this central storage point, frequently adding to the stores when they return from trips into the wilds.

title: [Wizard Guild, Gardens]
description: This pocket garden is bounded by the granite wall of the Guardian Keep and the three towers of the Wizard Guild.  Fragrant wisterias climb the limestone blocks of the large, squat tower to the west, while the top of the slender northeast tower is nearly blocked from view by the thick-leafed magnolia overarching this courtyard.  The third tower rises between the two, neither as low as the one nor as slender as the other.

title: [Wizard Guild, Foyer]
description: Upward-sweeping arches of stone, impossibly slender yet seemingly ageless, rise overhead to meet around a slender shaft.  Between the stonework, panels of stained and clear glass allow starlight to stream into this roughly triangular room.  The outlines of the three towers of the guildhall are clearly visible, as well.

title: [Wizard Guild, Shaft Base]
description: You stand atop a platform of flame-cut granite fashioned into a perfect circle and positioned beneath a shaft, matching in shape and stone, extending far overhead.  Several guild wizards pass through the foyer below in quiet conversation.

title: [Wizard Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Concentric rings of benches funnel down to a large, circular area.  Two rows of low-backed chairs ring the central expanse in which three cushioned stools are set in a row before a long, low writing-desk.  A small lectern faces the stools, providing speakers a place to address gathered lords and guild members.

title: [Wizard Guild, Reception Hall]
description: Brightly shining wall sconces contrast with the inky blackness of the narrow slit windows around the circumference of this ample, circular room.  The center of the room is dominated by three statues on a gleaming white marble pedestal, around which are clustered several inviting tables.  Stewards come and go regularly, clearing away used crockery and refreshing the food and drinks on sideboards lining the walls.

title: [Wizard Guild, Groundskeeper]
description: Neatly ordered gardening tools hang on pegs along one side of this cramped room, most of which is occupied by long tables on which various flora, exotic to mundane, grows beneath rows of strangely flickering globes.  Alongside the pegs stands a wooden broom closet, while the far corner of the room is occupied by a battered desk and similarly time-worn chair.

title: [Quando's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a gold and crimson wyvern tapestry hangs on one of the golden brocade walls.  A carved oak table sits in one corner while a serene golden wyvern fountain rests on the oak floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library]
description: Tall bookcases are set in long aisles perpendicular to the circumference of this large room, allowing the light from the narrow windows to filter even to the center of the room.  Scholars move silently among the stacks, occasionally pulling down a dusty tome to examine at one of the reading tables.  An unusual black tome rests on one of the tables, apart from the other volumes.

title: [Wizard Guild, Library Alcove]
description: This small alcove off the main library appears to be dedicated to holding rare or dangerous volumes.  The bookcases here are mostly secured behind heavy vaalor-banded doors, the thick metal mesh allowing only cursory glimpses of the tomes secured within.

title: [Euthea's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is an elegantly carved oak armoire and a plain wooden table.

title: [Raskar's Outfitting]
[Raskar's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a maoral beam ceiling, an old elven war banner hangs on one of the dark brocade walls.  A iron-bound ebonwood chest and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a stuffed spotted relnak rests on a sanded pine floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Shaft]
description: Vaalorn sconces cast a steady, bluish light over this circular room.  A wide walkway rings a shaft bored clean through the granite of the tower, allowing access to any of the Guild towers at this level.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, west, up, down

title: [Wizard Guild, Alchemy Wing]
description: Pungent, noisome odors and the soft bubbling of viscous potions fill the air.  Radiating in all direction from this central platform, stairs descend to stone workbenches strategically positioned near narrow slit windows around the room's perimeter, each equipped with various alchemical devices.  Several large training cauldrons are placed in the center of the platform.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Wizard Guild, Shaft]
description: Vaalorn sconces cast a steady, bluish light over this circular room.  A wide walkway rings a shaft bored clean through the granite of the tower, allowing access to the two Guild towers at this level.

title: [Dolchai's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An elegantly carved oak armoire and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Librarian]
description: Teetering stacks of dusty manuscripts and crowded bins of scrolls make this room feel smaller than its true dimensions would suggest.  At the center of this ancient clutter is an enormous, carved wood desk piled high with stacks of papers, leaving only a small area clear of parchment or dust in the center.

title: [Wynterr's General Store]
[Wynterr's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An elegantly carved oak armoire sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Alchemy Workshop]
description: Intricately carved wooden screens provide some privacy for this spartan workspace.  A polished granite workbench, positioned near a narrow slit window in the curving stone wall to the north, holds neatly arrayed flasks, tongs, and other tools of the alchemical trade.  Stone steps lead upwards to a small platform to the east, in the center of the room.
