description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-veined black marble counter and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Alchemy Workshop]
description: Intricately carved wooden screens provide some privacy for this spartan workspace.  A polished granite workbench, positioned near a narrow slit window in the curving stone wall to the north, holds neatly arrayed flasks, tongs, and other tools of the alchemical trade.  Stone steps lead upwards to a small platform to the south, in the center of the room.

title: [Wizard Guild, Shaft Top]
description: The shaft reaches its highest point here, capped by a stone dome.  A narrow causeway is poised over open air, leading to a polished faenor door.

wayto.18054: ;e 40.times { sleep 0.1; break if GameObj.loot.any? { |obj| obj.name =~ /#{Char.name} disk$/ } }; unless GameObj.loot.any? { |obj| obj.name =~ /#{Char.name} disk$/ }; disk = Spell[511]; wait_until { disk.affordable? }; disk.cast; end; move 'down'

title: [Wizard Guild, Essence Chamber]
description: Dazzlingly bright, this room is suffused with moonlight focused through hundreds of prisms in the narrow windows around the perimeter.  The light is focused on a dazzling, multi-faceted crystal poised on a twining vaalorn pedestal at the exact center of the space.  Inlaid in the polished alabaster floor, an eahnor circle connects four large feystone cabochons set at the cardinal points.  A polished faenor door leads out.

Dazzlingly bright, this room is suffused with sunlight focused through hundreds of prisms in the narrow windows around the perimeter.  The light is focused on a dazzling, multi-faceted crystal poised on a twining vaalorn pedestal at the exact center of the space.  Inlaid in the polished alabaster floor, an eahnor circle connects four large feystone cabochons set at the cardinal points.  A polished faenor door leads out.

title: [Wizard Guild, Supplies]
description: Heaps of trunks, cartons, and chests are tucked between large cases around the perimeter of this ample, circular room.  As the torchlight plays upon their surfaces, the warding runes upon their bindings glow softly.  A long, low counter is set in the midst of the clutter, on which rests a collection of pens, inkpots, and ledgers.

title: [Wizard Guild, Master's Office]
description: Heavy, watered silk curtains of rich crimson trimmed with gold frame the tall windows here.  A large desk occupies the center of this small, circular room, its well-polished ebony surface fairly gleaming in the light from delicately wrought invar wall sconces.  Shelves line the walls, filled with an odd assortment of dusty tomes, miniature portraits, and arcane devices.

title: [Wizard Guild, Storeroom]
description: Hardly more than an alcove off the supply room, this cramped space is dominated by a wide plank table at its center.  Affixed to the wall behind the table is an oak shelf lined with myriad bottles and jars.  An acrid mix of smells hangs heavily in the still air, filtering down from the herbs and various dismembered body parts drying on hooks overhead.

title: [Wizard Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Traces of silver along the curved arches of the vaulted ceiling mutely reflect the illumination from a large pool of magma in the center of the spacious chamber.  On the north side of the hall the formal elegance of the platform and chairs arrayed around it emphasizes the rawness of the rough-hewn stone and the primordial fire of the lava.

title: [Phadayls' General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An elegantly carved oak armoire and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Phadayls' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A large cherrywood cabinet and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Geyser Flats, Lower Basin]
description: Dark bands of color weep down the southern slope of the Geyser Flats.  A black pool sits at the center of the concentric rings of tone, its surface as still as a mirror.  Mist sweeps from the surface of the water, betraying its elevated temperature.

Vivid bands of sienna color weep down the southern slope of the Geyser Flats.  Contrasting the rust hues is a pool of deepest blue.  It sits in the center of the concentric rings of color, its surface as still as a mirror.  Mist sweeps from the surface of the water, betraying its elevated temperature.

title: [Wynterr's General Store]
[Wynterr's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Wynterr's General Store]
[Wynterr's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Alchemic Nexus]
description: This octagonal stone chamber is lit by eight flickering torches, one positioned at each corner.  Although the air seems still, it changes subtly from cool to warm, from moist to dry, then back with no obvious pattern.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest, down, out

title: [Wizard Guild, Steps]
description: The narrow channel feels as enclosed as a chimney and is almost as sooty.  The rock walls around you are uncomfortably warm to the touch, and the widely spaced torches shed little light on the seemingly never-ending steps.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Wizard Guild, Private Room]
description: Despite its spare architecture and dearth of furniture, the small chamber nevertheless has a sumptuous feel due to the thick patterned carpets lining the floor and the elegant lines of the central table and bookcase.  A pair of padded benches run along either side of the table, making it suitable for almost any use.

title: [Lisera's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a high arched ceiling, a trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  An elegant silver jewelry rack and a heavy lead glass display case sit in opposite corners while an alabaster bathing maiden statue rests on a glossy black ebonwood floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Scribe's Workroom]
description: Hundreds of scrolls fill carved stone shelves along each wall of this workroom.  The only source of light comes from two dancing flames that rest just above the polished onyx table.  Stacks of parchment sit in the corner by a few barrels of ink.

title: [A Spacious Tent]
description: Layers of yellow and green fabric make up the walls of this expansive tent.  Several illuminated lanterns sit precariously on wooden blocks, providing adequate lighting for the area.  A long oak table lined with tall-backed chairs dominates the tent, and rows of seats stretch back to the far walls on each side.  The thick scent of burning applewood logs provides a comforting warmth to the room.

title: [Wizard Guild, Masters' Chamber]
description: Banks of candles, giving off a great deal of light but shed very little heat, illuminate a magnificent antique desk and colorful tapestries.  The bookshelves along the walls contain titles pertaining to leadership as well as magecraft, a subject especially relevant to guild masters.  A small aquarium, its vivid blue striking amidst the warm colors of its surroundings, rests atop the desk.

title: [Laisric's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Gem Sales]
description: Several velvet-draped tables rest solidly upon a gleaming wooden floor.  Elven guards, strategically placed near them, watch over the tables' precious contents, suspiciously eyeing every patron who enters.  A pair of guards flanks the sole exit, an arched opening leading south.

title: [Burghal Caravan, Sew What]
description: The entryway to this shop is akin to a being at the hub of a series of interconnected pipes.  Dimly lit narrow tunnels extend in several directions, and all emit a cacophony of sounds, both machine and organic.  A thick layer of glaes pebbles covers the ground and reflects tiny motes of light that radiate from rows of glimaerstones attached to the arched ceilings.  Hanging from the ceiling in the center of the room is a curved sign that reads the same no matter which angle it is viewed from.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest, out

title: [Vairwoth's, Ephemeron]
description: The small tent is isolated by luxurious lengths of amaranthine and plum-hued bourde washed with a very slight, silver luster.  Covered glass domes that house tiny, flickering gold lights illuminate the surroundings and spill their radiance across the surface of a darkly lacquered wooden counter.  A line of caged metal dress forms are bolstered by a thin-paneled platform and fitted in sumptuous, glimmering fabrics.

title: [Heart of Hearts]
description: A single wooden table straddles the center of the wagon, flanked on its ends by two metal sconces.  Gauzy scarves are knotted around the sconces, which are capped by metal-shaded lanterns.  Vibrant red rugs cover the planked floor.  Demarcating this space from another further back is a suspended silk tapestry with a long slit down the middle.

title: [Heart of Hearts, Cubby]
description: Filling most of this inner sanctum is a pallet, swathed in soft bedding and heavy with overstuffed cushions.  Candles of red and white burn steadily, pooling molten wax into small silver dishes and casting flickering light on the knotted back of a suspended silk tapestry and a polished silver mirror.

title: [The Wrap Around]
description: Pleated silk walls fall in graceful lines from floor to peaked ceiling to create a cozy tent that is light and airy.  White birch partitions offer customers changing spaces near the rear of the tent, as well as supports for various display pieces.  Several armoires stand upon braided rugs dyed in extremely bright colors near a beaded tent flap that leads further into the tent, while a set of clothing racks frames an opening leading out.

title: [The Wrap Around, Work Room]
description: Saffron silk sheets alternated with azure line the walls in this section of the tent, which is separated from the showroom by a beaded tent flap.  Copper lanterns fitted with stained glass windows twirl from their anchor in the rafters and create a prismatic spray of bright light that dances upon the ceiling and walls.  Beneath the dazzling display is a ring of plump tangerine cushions and a low maoral table with carved floral legs.

title: [Shades of Velathae]
description: The wagon's interior is sparse in decoration, leaving the focus on its wares.  The numerous and varied merchandise spreads across a long slab of obsidian resting on two upturned wine barrels, a silk-covered crate, and a series of teak and onyx shelves.  Hanging from the bent birch poles that give the canvas covering its shape is a piece of silver-chased vellum.

title: [Vithalan's Wagon, Interior]
description: Extraordinarily capacious, the wagon's interior has high sides inlaid with sheets of dream, panther, and beetle agates.  The floor is highly polished fel, and an elaborately embroidered curtain sections off a small area towards the front.  A male erithian mannequin and a female erithian mannequin stand on either side of a dawn agate counter.

title: [Skin Deep]
description: The modwir walls of the wagon are stained with an assortment of colored inks.  Splashes of red and blue mix with greens and other hues to form a colorful mess.  Dozens of glass-paned lanterns hang from ceiling beams and hooks on the walls, providing an ample amount of light within the wagon.

title: [Skin Deep, Backroom]
description: The modwir walls within this small enclosed room are cleaner than the remainder of the wagon.  Small splotches of pink and red ink are the only blemishes on the polished modwir surfaces.  A small table and two chairs sit in the middle of the area.  Glass-paned lanterns hang from overhead beams and bronze hooks on the wall.

title: [Wizard Guild, Storage Room]
description: A rough-hewn pine floor supports a tall wooden cabinet against one of the room's four white walls.  Set off to one side is a large dust bin, built from the same unfinished wood as the room's floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Acid Workshop]
description: This room is rather warm and humid, though no source of climate control is apparent.  In the center, circumscribed by continuous, yellow-green walls, sits a pitted wooden workbench.  The domed walls rise from the stone floor to a round opening in the very top of the ceiling, which allows a few beams of stray moonlight to enter.

title: [Wizard Guild, Air Workshop]
description: This room is moderately cool, and is neither dry nor humid, though no source of climate control is apparent.  In the center, circumscribed by continuous, pure white walls, sits a lightweight wooden workbench.  The domed walls rise from the stone floor to a round opening in the very top of the ceiling, which allows a few beams of stray moonlight to enter.

title: [Wizard Guild, Fire Workshop]
description: This room is warm and dry without being overbearing, though no source of climate control is apparent.  In the center, circumscribed by continuous, deep crimson walls, sits a charred wooden workbench.  The domed walls rise from the stone floor to a round opening in the very top of the ceiling, which allows a few beams of stray moonlight to enter.

title: [Wizard Guild, Water Workshop]
description: This room is cool, its air moist, though no source of climate control is apparent.  In the center, circumscribed by continuous, pale ultramarine walls, sits a slightly warped wooden workbench.  The domed walls rise from the stone floor to a round opening in the very top of the ceiling, which allows a few beams of stray moonlight to enter.

title: [Wizard Guild, Electric Workshop]
description: This room is slightly warm, and its air a bit dry, though no source of climate control is apparent.  In the center, circumscribed by continuous, vivid yellow walls, sits a scorched black workbench.  The domed walls rise from the stone floor to a round opening in the very top of the ceiling, which allows a few beams of stray moonlight to enter.

title: [Wizard Guild, Earth Workshop]
description: This room is moderately heated, and is neither dry nor humid, though no source of climate control is apparent.  In the center, circumscribed by continuous, deep azure walls, sits a rough wooden workbench.  The domed walls rise from the stone floor to a round opening in the very top of the ceiling, which allows a few beams of stray moonlight to enter.

title: [Wizard Guild, Pantry]
description: One white half-circle wall encloses this room and its rough-hewn pine floor.  A sturdy wooden shelf hangs by itself on the wall.  A marble-topped table serves as a centerpiece, while a store room clerk monitors the room's goings-on.

title: [Wizard Guild, Observatory]
description: Most of the spacious chamber is taken up by a massive brass orrery, the various moons and planets crafted from enamelled metal.  A silver telescope is pointed upwards towards the heavens, its surface holding a pristine shine.  Detailed and precise paintings of the constellations adorn the walls.  A large fissure in the stone ceiling provides the telescope an unobstructed view of the heavens.  Steps descend into a very narrow cleft cut in the rock.

title: [Wizard Guild, Passage]
description: Steam fills the narrow passage and obscures the view.  From somewhere to the west comes muffled sounds of splashing and an occasional peal of laughter.

title: [Wizard Guild, Hot Springs]
description: A dim light somewhere illuminates the heavy steam in the room that shrouds everything from view and makes the room and nearby passage warm and humid.  The sounds of a slow bubbling and an occasional splash can be heard close by.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Courtyard]
description: An imposing single-story building flows up from the black sands.  The massive blocks of ebony marble shot with crimson veins taper as they rise from the base to the top, as if this is only the first story and meant to support something much weightier.  Two bronze urns reside next to open black wrought iron gates, golden flames leaping from the bowls.  An insignia occupies the marble face above the gates, and a gold plaque protrudes from the wall to the right of the building's opening.

Two bronze urns reside next to open black wrought iron gates.  An insignia occupies the marble face above the gates, and a gold plaque protrudes from the wall to the right of the building's opening.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Foyer]
description: This small, simple foyer is elegantly paneled in polished dark walnut.  Crimson carpet spreads from wall to wall and extends off to the west.  Clusters of silver tubes sprout from the walls, entwining in serpentine fashion before ending in circular candleholders.  Long black candles extend from the holders and burn with steady flames nearly as black as the candles themselves, yet the light cast by the flames readily illuminates the area.

wayto.18926: ;e loop { wait_until { Spell[704].affordable? }; result = cast(704, 'insignia'); break unless result =~ /Spell Hindrance/ }

title: [Guild Master Baire's Office]
description: Guild Master Baire's office gleams from floor to ceiling as the result of an obviously good cleaning.  Not a speck of dust resides anywhere on the crimson carpet, and the walnut paneling has been buffed to a soft sheen.  Free-standing sconces in each corner illuminate the office well, casting their glow upon the walnut desk, chairs, and several spacious bookcases.  A few potted plants lend a refreshing bit of greenery to the surroundings.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: Musty old tomes and ancient writings compete with newer works and essays for space on the shelves of this library.  Ten shelves rise from floor to ceiling in each dark walnut bookcase, and ladders provide access to the higher shelves.  The crimson carpet carries the feel of extra padding, totally muffling the passing footsteps.  Brass candelabra grace each walnut desk, illuminating private places for study and contemplation, while a stern-looking librarian presides over this repository of knowledge.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Arcane Studies]
description: Opaque mist forms the basis of this rotund chamber.  It has no physical walls nor any structure that lends it solid form.  Passageways created by the parting of mist open and close within a moment's notice at the beckoning of the Arcane Masters who buzz around the chamber at an almost frenzied pace attending to their tasks.  The world away from this room is completely obscured, and your existence is likely obscured from the world, with the exception of an opening in the mist directly in front of a rune-carved door.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Amphitheater]
description: Rows of chairs cascade down to face a white seashell-shaped enclosure and the open sea beyond.  The half seashell stands as high as two giantmen and opens toward the audience, protectively housing a crimson marble dais.  Behind the dais, suspended from the seashell's roof, a huge banner moves gently in the wind.  Black sands radiate the day's accumulated sunlight to provide a soft, warm floor, and torches ringing the amphitheater burn brightly, providing more than adequate illumination.

Rows of chairs cascade down to face a white seashell-shaped enclosure and the open sea beyond.  The half seashell stands as high as two giantmen and opens toward the audience, protectively housing a crimson marble dais.  Behind the dais, suspended from the seashell's roof, a huge banner moves gently in the wind.  Black sands absorb the sunlight to provide a soft, warm floor, and torches ringing the amphitheater stand ready to provide illumination should presentations outlast the sun's rays.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: This sturdy pine platform rises fifty feet into the air, considerably higher than most of the surrounding terrain.  The platform has been painted black to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off reflected light from below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  A gusty sea breeze causes the platform to sway somewhat precariously.

title: [Unknown]
description: Two ships lock in close combat, grappling lines tangled in each other's rigging.  Krolvin warriors leap from the right hand warship's deck to engage the defenders in the huge ship on the left.  Blood flows freely as the fight seesaws back and forth, neither side gaining advantage.  The ships yaw slightly in the rough seas, and black clouds gather ominously on the horizon.  Despite the pitched battle, no senses other than sight seem to function.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Garden]
description: A jungle atmosphere pervades this dimly lit garden, and only a few random rays of light intrude here and there from windows on the south and west walls.  Vines creep up the walls and across the ceiling, trailing tendrils as if waiting to ensnare the unwary.  Crickets chirp noisily somewhere deep under the abundant plant life.  A trail winds through the foliage, and several benches are unobtrusively placed to provide restful spots for quiet contemplation.

Vines creep up the walls and across the ceiling, trailing tendrils as if waiting to ensnare the unwary.  Bees flit from blossom to blossom, buzzing softly as they look to harvest the abundant pollen.  A trail winds through the foliage, and several benches are unobtrusively placed to provide restful spots for quiet contemplation.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Magic Workroom]
description: This austere room is amazingly clean.  Not a speck of dust appears anywhere in it.  In fact, the only items in the room are securely bolted, tacked or nailed down.  An iron table and a large chest in the far corner both lean toward the center of the room, and what is left of the crimson carpet appears to have been shredded in the same direction, revealing the marble floor underneath.  Light filters in from a few holes in the black marble walls to glint off a twisted metal sign.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tub Room]
description: Condensation drips from the ceiling and runs down the black marble walls to disappear into a drain in the far corner, leaving the floor slick with moisture.  A spacious tub has been carved directly into the marble floor, and hot seawater swirls and foams within.  A metal vat is securely bolted against the wall with a pipe and a chain hanging down just above the tub.  Wide steps lead into the tub's churning waters.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Hot Tub]
description: You step down into the hot, swirling seawater, its warmth gently massaging your muscles and relaxing your mind and body.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Dark Chamber]
description: An acrid, sulfurous scent taints the air as thin tendrils of yellow-brown smoke rise from the glowing coals of an ornate iron brazier.  Dense mist merges with the smoke to obscure most of the room's dimensions and details, yet occasional swirls in the haze at floor level allow brief glimpses of a dark outline.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Annex, Dynamic Convergence]
description: With the appearance of having been created by a madman, no two walls in this odd chamber are the same height or length.  Splotches of gray paint in varying tones coat the walls unevenly, causing further disorientation.  As if this were not enough, a dizzying array of archaic runes has been scrawled across every flat surface, including the floor and ceiling.  Crooked doorways provide the only relief from this visual assault.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up, down

title: [Annex, Equipment Room]
description: Amid the cobwebs of this dark and musty storeroom are a number of lockers and cabinets, some secured by large padlocks or ominous runes.  Disorganized piles of equipment lie strewn across shelves and heaped in corners with seemingly little effort given to care or cleanliness.  An unadorned free-standing closet, missing its door, holds brooms, some rusty iron dust pans, and other cleaning supplies.

title: [Annex, Reagent Room]
description: Dwarfing the large worktable in the center of the room, row upon row of pitted steel shelves line the walls.  Each wall shelf, as well as several additional cabinets and shelving units, is filled to near capacity with a diverse array of cork-stoppered flasks and bottles.  Though most are meticulously labeled, the lettering on some has long since faded.  Mortar and pestle sets, funnels, droppers, and assorted laboratory utensils are conveniently located on the tabletop.

title: [Annex, Evil Eye Workshop]
description: In sharp contrast to the entry chamber, this cubicle is both uniform in dimension and serene in atmosphere.  Sand-colored walls stretch upward to a glass-paned vaulted ceiling that funnels moonlight directly onto the wrought iron workbench below.  Aside from a few assorted pieces of alchemical equipment, the room's only distinguishing feature is a vividly painted mural depicting a grisly scene in larger-than-life proportions.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Sitting Room]
description: A large underground lake spreads onward into darkness, its tranquil waters undulating softly with every tiny ripple that seeks to disturb the solace.  Pale white sand borders the edges of the water, providing a welcome respite from the rocky ground of the area.  A variety of glowing fungi has colonized the blackness of the high ceiling in small patches -- casting the illusion of being underneath a sheer alien sky.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Antechamber]
description: Dominating the center of the chamber is a circular white marble fountain.  A majestic peacock with a colorful glass fanned-tail stands atop a center stone with water trickling down the sides into a pool surrounding the base.  The pale floor is broken by darker stones that create walkways leading to a wide velvet-draped arch and a large opening.  Moonlight passes through a clear crystal dome and blankets the room in a pale light.

Dominating the center of the chamber is a circular white marble fountain.  A majestic peacock with a colorful glass fanned-tail stands atop a center stone with water trickling down the sides into a pool surrounding the base.  The pale floor is broken by darker stones that create a walkway leading to a wide velvet-draped arch and a large opening.  Sunlight shimmers as it passes through a clear crystal dome above.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, The Argentate]
description: Rectangular in shape, the chamber's ceiling is a soaring vault of reflective silver-gilt mosaic.  Beneath the glassy mirror is an open expanse of polished stone flooring and a half-moon rostrum, the surface raised three stairsteps above the rest of the room.  Atop the dais is a large silver chair inlaid with sapphires.  Down a step is a solid silver throne.  A carved mistwood door, paneled in silver plating, blends into the long wall of the hall, and a wide velvet-draped arch is recessed opposite the platform leading back to the main area of the keep.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Pewter Salon]
description: Well-lit and spacious, the salon is a busy hub of activity.  Elves and visitors to the city go about their business down the various hallways.  An immense ogee arch leads back to the entrance, while along a different wall a guard protects a mistwood door.  Several benches are placed about the area with various topiary set between.  The ceiling is accented with lacy fan vaulting, the pieces overlapping above in a feathered pattern of argent stone.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Council Salon]
description: Built in tiers, the council chamber rises in three stages -- stone, glass, and tile.  Its lowest register has a silvery stone floor and wall that is set with a pair of doors.  Above that, a ring of windows stack one atop another, paned in alternating clear and blue glass.  At the dome, a mosaic covers the ceiling, depicting the formal crest of House Illistim.  A round table and upholstered seats take up the majority of the floor, though ample space is present in a ring around the furniture.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Vaults]
description: Long, narrow passageways lead away from the stone-walled cavity, each one passing beneath the graceful bend of a glaes-tiled arch.  Winding its way upwards in a tight spiral is a silver staircase, its steep path enclosed within a cage of equally argent metalwork.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Leading deeper into the keep, the hallway is paved with alabaster stone striated with silver veins.  A portrait hangs on one wall opposite a polished stone archway.  Shadows cast from the flickering crystal lamps above dance across the smooth rock.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Hanging from a vaalin chain, a beautiful crystal lamp sways above, the cut glass of the panes send motes of fragmented light across the alabaster stone.  Set into the wall opposite a white marble pedestal is an ivory silk-draped archway.  Centered in the hall floor is a beautiful mosaic crafted from tiny crystals.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Silver-flecked, alabaster tile extends down the hallway set in a complex pattern.  A cushioned mistood bench rests against the wall next to a potted rosebush with green tendrils lush with white flowers.  Recessed to one wall is a carved mistwood arch framed by the climbing vines.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: An elaborate labradorite-topped mistwood railing surrounds the well of a spiraling silver staircase, which descends from the center of the room into some lower, deeper chamber.  Alabaster tile set in a circular pattern covers the floor, each piece accented with natural silver striations.  The deep sapphire draping of an ornate archway contrasts with the surrounding stone.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.
The narrow stone passageway is entirely silvery grey -- floor, ceiling, and walls alike -- save for a peacock blue silk curtain.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Citizenry]
description: A mosaic frieze, placed high up near the blue-lacquered wooden ceiling, depicts argent peacocks on a gentian blue band.  The birds, in pairs and triads, strut around the room, each group separated from the next by a silver tower with a fluttering pennon.  On a lower plane, a labradorite-capped mistwood counter partitions the room into distinctly public and private space.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Genealogy]
description: A pierced silver lantern hangs from the blue-lacquered wooden ceiling, suspended on an argent chain.  Below, the stone floor is covered with a woven rug, which matches the blue glaes set into one high clerestory window.  A gentian blue velvet chair, a cushioned mistwood settee, and a small table set with a vase of orchids form a conversation triangle in the middle of the room.

title: [Office of Arrearages and Debts]
description: A pair of silver lanterns hangs from the blue-lacquered wooden ceiling, suspended on matching argent chains.  Below is a neatly arranged mistwood desk with silver-gilt cabriole legs and a polished labradorite top.  A carved wooden screen, inlaid with a strutting peacock, separates the reception area from a larger space, filled with less impressive desks, that are visible behind it.

title: [Office of Records and Documents]
description: An ornately carved mistwood desk occupies the center of the small, square room, set atop a carpet of sapphire velvet.  Behind the desk, a velvet and cloth-of-silver hanging takes up most of the back wall, stretching from the stone floor to the blue-lacquered ceiling.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Chamber]
description: Cavernous, high walls surround you, arcing upwards into darkness.  Lurid crimson torchlight ripples across the slightly damp stone walls, casting a dark scarlet sheen across the surroundings.  Several well-polished tunnels lead away from the central chamber, and dark velvet rugs flanked by intricate iron candelabras trail in their wake.  A complex, circular design of sigils loop and arc across the center of the room, their intricacy rather weathered by the passage of time.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: Incarnadine sigils wrap around the circular chamber in a tight embrace, their luminescent surfaces casting a bloody light throughout the surroundings as they hum and pulse with power.  A triple-band of the angular sigils forms a tight circle in the middle of the floor, the designs there casting a steady pale violet glow as the rest of the room is intermittently cast in darkness by the wavering symbols around you.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Chamber]
description: The tunnel ends abruptly here, and the polished appearance of the surrounding rock takes on an even deeper luster in the brighter light.  A dark ebonwood door, a thin steel door, and a crystalline door are inset into the curved northern wall, their surfaces awash in the rippling light of many candelabras set throughout the small chamber.  Blackness shrouds the upper regions of the room in a murky haze.  Only brief glimpses of the ceiling are caught when the flames flare strongly.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Scrying Room]
description: Glittering sparks of crimson and cerulean surround you in this circular room -- the entirety of the walls are crafted from a deep purple crystal that arcs downward in an elliptical pattern of spires toward the center of the chamber.  A dark orb sits atop a pedestal of black onyx, its slick surface mere inches from the central crystal spoke jutting from the ceiling.  Slivers of incarnadine shot with violet tracing arc through the rift between the two, sending whirring hums of power echoing about you.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: A triad of heavy wrought-iron chandeliers hang from thick chains, casting their gloomy light across the massive marble table that dominates the entire room.  Many chairs surround the rectangular table, each uniform and simple in design.  Dark crimson banners flutter along the high walls, their silken surfaces bearing the design of a transparent hand upon a field of crimson, the starry void of the night shining through the hand.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Shop]
description: A variety of wrought-iron candleholders allow ample lighting to filter into the small chamber, and judging from the jagged edges of the walls, the room appears to be recently constructed.  Small tables and other various display cases are situated throughout the room, showcasing a variety of useful items.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Office]
description: A dark triple-horned skull hangs over the door, its fanged maw gleaming with reflected light from the numerous candles placed throughout the room.  Rich rugs cover the floor, and a dark ebonwood desk is set along the northern wall, its surface riddled with a variety of carefully arranged paperwork and random bits of magical paraphernalia.  A few tapestries are hung from the wall, each bearing the insignia of the guild.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cavern]
description: The chambers open up into a vast, yawning expanse, and the dark waters of an underground lake spread onward into the darkness.  A constant rhythm of drip-drops continually echoes through the massive chambers, the unseen stalactites above dutifully carrying on their eternal cycle of growth.  A small upraised path winds its way through the lake, the faint torchlight that flanks it appearing as fireflies in the deep blackness.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, The Bonewalk]
description: Rings of lurid scarlet torchlight illuminate the surroundings in stark detail -- flanking the rocky path are a variety of large bones, seemingly melded into one another to form a grisly, spiked caricature of a twisted spine.  The skeletal remains appear to be animal at the beginning of the path, though the ones further along have a distinctly humanoid appearance.  Far ahead, a circle of blue flames casts a ghostly light upon a small island further to the south.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Island]
description: Ringed by a variety of splintered bone shards, a circular ivory building covers the entirety of the small island -- its surface slick and gleaming with the ghostly blue light of the surrounding torches.  A pair of arched doors leads into the structure, its surface carved with intricate designs of scrimshaw that form complex sigils that wreath the entire building in three distinct bands.  A vague rhythmic hum ripples outward from the building, its presence more felt than heard.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Laboratory]
description: A large ebon coffin sits atop an altar of yellowed bone, its slick surface awash in the light of hundreds and hundreds of thin pillar candles that surround it on every side.  Lustrous steel tables are placed throughout the room, a variety of potions, chalks, powders, and various empty bits of glassware set atop them.  Dark stains ring the floor, mingling with the charred rings that also vie for space in the small chamber.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: Rows upon rows of tomes and grimoires line shelves built into the cavernous wall itself, and rickety ladders are positioned discreetly to the side.  A variety of small reading tables are spaced evenly throughout the room, each harboring a tiny silk-shrouded oil lamp upon their lustrous black surfaces.  A small alcove lies to the east, the rippling candlelight from within only a small beacon in the sea of desklamps.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alcove]
description: A variety of candles are placed upon an ancient reading desk, its surface marred with ink, stubs of wax, and ageless dust.  Placed upon the desk is a scarred leather journal, its pages cracked and yellowed by the passage of time.  Deep crimson rugs cover the floor, and a solemn silence fills the small chamber.

title: [Alchemy Workshops, Crux]
description: The long hallway ends in a semicircular niche, which in turn branches off into small portals leading in various directions.  Each entry bears an identical carved sigil above the dull black frame, indicating the uniform purpose of the alcoves beyond.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage]
description: A large niche deeply recessed into the stone walls holds a myriad of shelves, most laden with lidded jars and tightly stoppered flasks.  Next to it, a stout wooden ladder offers the obvious means to reach even the highest-stored items.  Further back into the cavernous room, numerous tall cabinets offer a glimpse of the vast stores within.

title: [Alchemy Workshop]
description: Smooth black stone walls with circular windows and low ceilings create a chamber of comfortable proportions.  Ample enough to carry out one's work, yet small enough to keep focused on the tasks at hand.  A sturdy workbench sits at the very center of the room, fully equipped with the necessary apparatus to pursue alchemical transmutations.  Low, black-painted wrought iron lamps cast enough illumination to glint off the translucent still on the workbench.

title: [Alchemy Workshop]
description: Smooth black stone walls with circular windows and low ceilings create a chamber of comfortable proportions.  Ample enough to carry out one's work, yet small enough to keep focused on the tasks at hand. Low, black-painted wrought iron lamps cast enough illumination to glint off the translucent still on the workbench.

Low, black-painted wrought iron lamps cast enough illumination to glint off the translucent still on the workbench.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage]
description: One side of the room is occupied by a long granite counter which holds several stone mortars, while the other side looks almost chaotically cluttered.  Innumerable vials, bottles, and all manner of containers vie for space and attention on black-painted shelves, which seem to blend into the walls of the same hue.  At first glance, the contrast of porcelain, glass, metal, and bone of varying colors gives the impression of magically floating stock which may collapse at any time.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Stone Bridge]
description: The stone bridge is smoothly cut and has weathered its age well with few cracks.  It spans the gap between the east and west ledge easily.  Two large, hemp ropes on either side run tautly up to slots in an overhang above.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Landing]
description: The downward side of this trail rests at the pivot of a giant, stone draw bridge and continues upward to the east.  The ledge is narrow here, and there is an overhang above which limits your view.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Ledge]
description: The trail winds up the mountain eastward, and down westward.  At this section the ledge is in terrible shape.  Large, fresh cracks run over the side and small chunks of rock continue to tumble away as you walk on it.  This looks dangerous!

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Slope]
description: You are at the base of a slope which runs straight up the mountain, leading to a point where the trail turns and climbs westward to the mountaintop.  The slope is very steep but does not appear too difficult to run up.  The way continues down from here.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Ledge]
description: You are on a thin, rocky ledge that continues up the mountain to the west.  A slope provides a precarious descent to the trail leading down below you.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Ledge]
description: You are on the narrow ledge trail of the mountain.  The path up continues to the west and down to the east.  Far above you can see what appears to be a gigantic gash in the face of the mountainside, looking somewhat like a cave created by an explosion from within.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Staircase]
description: The trail up the mountain ends here at the base of a sheer, 50-foot cliff face.  In front of this is a series of four stone pillars that seems to be some sort of unusual staircase.  There are also some strange markings on the mountain wall.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Cliff Top]
description: You are on a narrow ledge heading west.  The east side stops at a cliff which drops about 50 feet before the trail continues west again.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Stream]
description: The mountain trail ends here, opening into a wide area that provides a good place to rest.  Progress to the west ends with an exposure of several thousand feet.  You notice a wooden beam trellis which runs from this point up the side of the mountain to quite a distance above you.  On one side, a freshwater mountain stream tumbles out of an opening into a pool.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lift]
description: This is an open-air, wooden box which is suspended on a beam trellis that is precariously attached to the side of the mountain.  There are plenty of openings which afford a great view, but the cab itself is covered (probably to guard against falling rocks).

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lift Apex]
description: You are on a small shelf on the face of the mountain, very near its summit. The air is terribly misty and above you lurks the bottom of a cloud, looking strangely unnatural this near.  The view of the lands below is spectacular and frightening at the same time.  The side of the mountain from this point up is completely hidden behind an opaque wall of fog descending in plumes from the cloud above.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lost in the Fog]
description: You are in a dense fog bank and can see absolutely nothing.  You  realize that you can probably back out of here easily enough.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, The Summit]
description: You emerge onto a stone landing which looks like an island in a sea of cloud.  Somehow it is suddenly night, and the sky above is sparkling with thousands of tiny stars.  The Great Moon Liabo hangs silently in the sky, its surface shrouded by the clouds of its atmosphere.  A tiny black point against this backdrop, Tilaok, can be seen in its orbit around Liabo.  A large opening leads into the mountain at this height.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Moon Chamber]
description: You are in a vast, domed enclosure cut from the native rock of the mountain.  The floor is perfectly smooth but the vaulted ceiling is chiseled in an array of gothic designs.  In the center of the room sits a single onyx altar.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Hot Spring]
description: You are in a natural cave of the mountain.  The walls are coated with a glowing fungus providing significant lighting.  Bubbling in one corner is a small pool fed by a hot spring.  The water quickly wanders across the chamber floor in a shallow stream and then vanishes into an opening on the west wall.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Though there is no less light, the garden seems visibly darker.  The plants have turned a deep dark green with blooms black as night.  In stark contrast to the surroundings, a statue of a grand white stallion stands tall over a small rock bound pond.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Underneath a pair of twin cherry blossom trees you see a long bed of pure white trillium blooms just now taking on a pink tinge.  A solitary stone bench has been placed between the trees offering a perfect spot to sit in quiet reflection.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Only a few carefully selected plants inhabit this portion of the path.  Most of the area is occupied by a circular rock garden.  Bordered by silvery stones, the white sands of the garden have been drawn with a pictogram of the goddess Lorminstra.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: As the pathway curves inward, you notice the sunflowers have grown tall as giantmen in the warm brilliant light of the sun.  Adding to the majestic scene, four brightly colored dragonflies hover just above the flowers, surveying their domain.

Though night has fallen, the warm promise of the dawn fills the air in this portion of the garden.  Sunflowers as tall as giantmen line the inward curve of the path.  Adding to the majestic scene, four brightly colored dragonflies hover just above the flowers, surveying their domain.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: You come upon a silent oak tree, resilient and strong, patiently extending its reach towards the sun.  Scattered about the ground, a blanket of acorns and twigs adds an ungraceful crunch to your step.

You come upon a silent oak tree, resilient and strong, patiently extending its reach towards the stars.  Scattered about the ground, a blanket of acorns and twigs adds an ungraceful crunch to your step.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: A small stream flows across the path with only two unsteady looking foot stones set in the water to allow crossing.  Beneath the surface, numerous gold and silvery fish dart about exploring their watery abode.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: The leaves of the trees take on the colors of Autumn as you walk along the path.  From bright yellow to orange, deep red, auburn, and brown, the colors dance from leaf to leaf in your presence.

The leaves of the trees lining the path take on the colors of Autumn so vividly that their hues are visible even in the moonlight.  From pale yellow to orange, deep red, auburn, and brown, the colors seem to dance from leaf to leaf.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Shadows overtake this corner of the garden lending a somber mood to the atmosphere.  A circle of red willow trees droop towards each other as if brooding over some unfortunate twist of fate.
Deeper shadows overtake this corner of the garden lending a somber mood to the atmosphere.  A circle of red willow trees droop toward each other as if brooding over some unfortunate twist of fate.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: More of the elegant topiary extends along the path in the form of three small nymphs.  The trio are poised over a mirror-like pond and you can tell by their expressions that they are viewing something quite humorous.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Flowers dominate the path leading to a magnificent emerald green topiary of the goddess Oleani.  A sweet unidentifiable scent hovers about the lovely shrub, tugging at memories buried deep in your subconscious.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Shining from the skies, a single beam of light falls upon a fountain shaped in the form of a natural waterfall.  Here, a quiet breeze crosses in front of you carrying with it a scent of kylan berry.  Sparkling in a dance of light, the small pool at the waterfall's base teases you with thoughts of gold.

Shining from the skies, a single beam of moonlight falls upon a fountain shaped in the form of a natural waterfall.  Here, a quiet breeze crosses in front of you carrying with it a scent of kylan berry.  Sparkling in a dance of silver light, the small pool at the waterfall's base teases you with thoughts of gold.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Lining the path, rows of yellow flowers shine brightly in the light as a flurry of bees dart about amongst them.  As you watch the flurry of activity, your eyes are drawn to a rose covered trellis.  Resting against it, you see a long wing tipped staff.

Rows of flowers lining the path are bright in the moonlight against their dark foliage.  Moths wheel and flutter about a rose covered trellis, drawing your eye there.  You see a long wing tipped staff resting against the trellis.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: A stiff breeze surges about you, swirling from every direction.  You can feel the undeniable presence of essence flowing along with the wind intertwined in a dance of commanding power.  Standing like a presiding presence over the powerful gusts, a statue of Koar dominates.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: The taller plants in this section have been carefully placed away from the center leaving a full view of the sky.  The lush surrounding greenery offers a quiet semblance of serenity, perfect for watching the stars.  An ornate pedestal has been set up in the middle of the path.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: The light along the path suddenly diminishes as if the night had descended to rest in this very spot but despite the sudden darkness, you feel as though nothing could ever cause you harm in this place.  Fresh hoof tracks mark the edge of the path.

This part of the path seems darker even than the cloudless night would account for, yet despite the shadows, you feel as though nothing could ever cause you harm in this place.  Fresh hoof tracks mark the edge of the path.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: A soft almost imperceptible glow radiates from this portion of the garden making you feel at ease with all the world.  Just to the left of the path, you catch a glimpse of a small tiered fountain hidden behind the foliage.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Brilliant light dances upon everything here, and yet the light does not wash out the colors, but rather enhances them in a magical way.  Every plant and flower seems to be a bit larger and a bit healthier than anything you've ever seen.  Indeed, the longer you stay here, the better you feel.

Brilliant torchlight dances upon everything here, and yet the light does not wash out the colors, but rather enhances them in a magical way.  Every plant and flower seems to be a bit larger and a bit healthier than anything you've ever seen.  Indeed, the longer you stay here, the better you feel.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Here, the garden is more like an arena, with several statues of Kai engaged in a variety of athletic activities upon a garden of multicolored sands.  All carved in pure white marble, they each suggest a promise of eternal youth.  In all cases, Kai is bare handed and often he is shown locked in combat with fearsome beasts the likes of which you have never seen.

Here, the garden is more like an arena, with several statues of Kai engaged in a variety of athletic activities upon a garden of multicolored sands which gleam like snow in the moonlight.  All carved in pure white marble, they each suggest a promise of eternal youth.  In all cases, Kai is bare handed and often he is shown locked in combat with fearsome beasts the likes of which you have never seen.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Resplendent with a variety of coral, this part of the garden resembles a calm beach.  Lapping up onto the beach is a sea-water pool in the middle of which is a statue of Charl carved out of a large chunk of coral.  He appears to rise out of the water on a wave and with his trident raised, he is acting as the fierce protector of the seas.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Beautiful, stylish landscaping covered in flowers of all kinds and varieties characterize the garden here.  Numerous sweet smells continuously waft by, soothing your body within the folds of their fragrant grace.  In an almost healing way, you drink in what seems to be the promise of eternal peace.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Serious and stately, this part of the garden is decorated with a number of fine statues, each of them depicting a scene from Elanthian history and mythology.  A black obsidian monolith catches your attention, as much for its striking beauty as for it being so different from the other elegant works here.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: You can hear the sound of stringed instruments, lutes and voices all blending into a series of merry songs.  The garden here is designed with several varieties of grape vines.  Beyond this is a small wine press with a narrow channel extending from it to a nearby vat.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: Sunlight shines through several branches of a tree, warming everything it touches.  Swaying gently in a breeze, a large garden of roses moves like a red blanket caught in the wind.  Small birds can be seen chasing one another through the branches of the trees, while bees drink the nectar from the roses.

Moonlight filters through several branches of a tree, limning everything it touches with silver.  Swaying gently in a breeze, a large garden of roses moves like a red blanket caught in the wind.  Nocturnal birds can be seen chasing one another through the branches of the trees, while moths circle in apparently aimless paths to avoid them.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: A large chunk of iron shaped into an anvil is set carefully in the midst of some white sand.  Beyond that is a slight incline decorated with pebbles and rocks of varying colors and sizes.  After a moment, it dawns on you that the rocks are arranged to form a picture of Eonak.

title: [Path to Enlightenment]
description: You are standing under a covered walkway that extends in a wide circle surrounding a vast garden.  Small trees, plants and flowers artfully adorn the area which is landscaped around several fountained terraces.  Nearly taking your breath away, this part of the walkway is adorned with a brightly tiled mosaic of Tonis.

title: [Healing Chamber]
description: Simple but comfortable cots line the walls.  At one end is a medical station with a cabinet containing herbs, potions and other medical supplies.  Low windows which are cracked open to allow a cool breeze to pass through the room, give the place a fresh aroma of flowers and plants.  Birds can be heard chirping in nearby trees.

title: [Meditation Chamber]
description: Muted light, the sharp scent of incense and a deep silence fill this austere place.  Except for some hardwood benches lining the walls facing inward and a candle lit altar in the center of the room, the place is bare.  You feel contemplative as your mind fills with images of the holy struggle to release the poor tormented souls of the undead.

title: [Grandmaster's Chamber]
description: A variety of plants and murals decorate the light modwir paneled walls here.  One wall is covered entirely with books while another wall, directly behind Grandmaster's desk is almost entirely made of glass stretching from floor to ceiling.  Where the modwir paneling is visible, it is intricately carved with scenes of the Lords of Liabo at rest, play or in battle.

A variety of plants and murals decorate the light modwir paneled walls here.  One wall is covered entirely with books while another wall, directly behind Grandmaster's desk is almost entirely made of glass stretching from floor to ceiling and revealing the moonlit foliage outside.  Where the modwir paneling is visible, it is intricately carved with scenes of the Lords of Liabo at rest, play or in battle.

title: [Small Cottage, Bedroom]
description: A beautiful crystal skylight provides the illumination to this cozy little bedroom and must provide an excellent view of the stars at night to anyone lying in the large, soft feather bed situated directly beneath it.  To one side sits an antique modwir nightstand accented in polished brass with a small mirror above.  A large, plush black bearskin rug takes up most of the remaining floorspace.

To one side sits an antique modwir nightstand accented in polished brass with a small mirror above.  A large, plush black bearskin rug takes up most of the remaining floorspace.

title: [Small Cottage, Sandbar]
description: This sandbar, formed by some long forgotten flood, separates the small pool from the cold, deep water of the Locksmehr River.  The wind blows steady here bringing with it occasional sounds from the distant town.  A boat, the exposed wood broken and rotting, lies mostly buried in the sand, providing its inhabitants with a place of refuge.

title: [The Black Sands]
description: Midnight blue canvas stretched across the wagon's four walls is supported by slender bamboo reeds to create a domed ceiling that is painted with silver and gold stars.  Tiny glass shards, each dangling from a different support, depict the various constellations of the Northern Skies and twinkle lightly in the light of several nearby candles.  A narrow cot rests beside a pot-bellied stove at the rear of the wagon, while a rocking chair rests beside a small ebonwood display counter.

title: [Stryos Home, Interior]
description: The cottage is just as spartan on the inside as it is on the outside.  A small cot sits against one of the walls, while a table and a single chair rest against the opposite wall.  A pair of bookshelves is set against the wall across from the door leading out to the courtyard.

title: [Cobblestone Courtyard]
description: Set back from the well-lit streets of the marketplace, the courtyard is very dark.  The only source of light is coming from an intricate metalwork door set in the whitewashed wall of a small cottage.  The light coming through the door illuminates the start of a cobblestone path that leads towards the back of the cottage.

Set back from the bustling market, this small courtyard is much more quiet.  An intricate metalwork door is set in the whitewashed wall of a small cottage while a cobblestone path leads around to the back where you see a small plume of smoke rising in the air.

title: [Stryos Home, Smithy]
description: The ground floor of the smithy is one large room with a makeshift door leading deeper into the forge.  Hammers and tongs hang from the walls while chisels and other tools lay arranged neatly on wooden benches around the room.  Four grinding wheels of differing coarseness, two sturdy anvils, and three quenching barrels are spread around the stone floor.  Braziers in each corner of the room glow brightly, casting shadows around the room.  A cobblestone path leads back to the front of the house.

The ground floor of the smithy is one large room with an open back wall.  Hammers and tongs hang from the walls while chisels and other tools lay arranged neatly on wooden benches around the room.  Four grinding wheels of differing coarseness, two sturdy anvils, and three quenching barrels are spread around the stone floor.  Unlit braziers stand in each corner of the room.  A cobblestone path leads back to the front of the house.

Four grinding wheels of differing coarseness, two sturdy anvils, and three quenching barrels are spread around the stone floor.  Braziers in each corner of the room glow brightly, casting shadows around the room.  A cobblestone path leads back to the front of the house.

title: [Forest Path]
description: A moss-covered stone building stands nestled in a grove of wyrmwood trees, which displays a dilapidated wooden sign just above the stone grey arch.  Positioned in a sweeping arc, several benches rest, offering a scenic view of the swamp ahead.

title: [Balgamar's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Geltrude's Cottage, Garden Path]
description: The beautiful array of flowers planted in this garden holds nearly every color of the rainbow.  Obviously cultivated by a skilled hand, each flower blooms in colorful brilliance.  Lantern light filters in from the street, throwing shadows of several dogwood trees across the rough flagstone path, which winds its way through the lush garden grass towards a quaint white-washed cottage with blue trim.  A carved wooden bench rests under the nearest tree.

title: [Geltrude's Cottage, Parlor]
description: Moonlight illuminates a large bay window, casting shadows on the floor near a glass-paned door.  Several decorative woven grass mats hang on the walls, while a white wooden door stands beside an oak-framed painting depicting a jungle landscape.  Rustic wood flooring stretches from wall to wall, uninterrupted save by a low driftwood table that rests between two fluffy couches.  An oil lamp on the table sheds honey-colored light on the room, throwing the corners into shadow.

title: [Geltrude's Cottage, Hallway]
description: The walls in the hallway are painted sky blue and the thin rug is the color of pale beach sand.  Portraits hang at even intervals on both sides, spaced between a purple oak door, a white wooden door, and a blue driftwood door.  At the end of the hall, a wide rectangular arch opens up into the next room.  Scented oil lamps mounted in elaborate iron wall sconces light this windowless space, the faint smell of an ocean breeze pervades the area.

title: [Geltrude's Cottage, Kitchen]
description: The dark plank flooring is worn in many places by frequent use and surrounded on all sides by pale yellow-painted walls.  A recessed brick fireplace faces the arch leading back out, while a long wooden counter holds a wash basin, a bread box, and two built-in cupboards.  Lit beeswax candles rest on the spindly-legged table, casting a warm glow on the room, and a fat orange tabby cat sleeps on one of the matching chairs.

title: [Geltrude's Cottage, Bedroom]
description: Tasteful paintings hang on the wall, each one depicting a beach scene at a different time of day.  A thick blue rug covers the pale plank flooring, while a solid oak bed stands against the far wall.  Pale yellow curtains flutter in the cool breeze let in from the open window.  Crickets and the rustling of leaves can be heard faintly from outside.  An overstuffed blue chair rests between an antique willow armoire and the blue driftwood door leading out.

title: [Graceful Goldenrod Table]
description: Brass lanterns with amber panes of glass cast a soft, golden light across the table.  Stalks of goldenrod are handcut into the glass, casting thin, wavering shadows.

title: [A Violet and Verdant Courtyard]
description: Pallid moonlight streams through a bamboo trellis replete with blue crown passion flower vines wound around the engraved posts.  Neatly tended beds of dendrobium orchids flank a short walkway lined with crushed coral.  A small white cottage with peach-tinged eaves sits at the end of the path, a wreath of dried protea hangs from the blue-washed door.  Encircling the rear of the lush property is a smooth teakwood fence festooned with dainty garlands of hibiscus.

title: [Knotted Kerria Table]
description: A rather twisted miniature kerria leans to one side in its terra cotta pot.  The slender green stems of the kerria have been trained to grow around one another forming loose knots.

title: [Nocuous Nightshade Table]
description: The table is dimly lit by candles hidden behind paper lantern covers.  Nightshade flowers are pressed into the thick paper shades, casting hazy shadows across the tabletop.

title: [Safia's Abode, Cottage Path]
description: Shrouded in night's shadows, a bamboo cottage and its surrounding palm trees allude to a haven of safe comfort.  A narrow path of crushed shells, its pale hue standing out in the midst of the darker soil it passes through, leads from a wooden gate to the cottage.  Dimly lit by a single lantern, a porch-like area houses several tall posts and a wicker chair.  The lantern's flame casts splinters of illumination into the dark, at odds with the scent of orchids hangs heavily in the humid air.

As if growing up out of the tropical environs, a simple bamboo cottage is crafted from natural woods and surrounded by tall, arching palm trees.  A narrow path of crushed shells, its route passing through rich, dark soil planted with bumbleebee orchids, bird's nest ferns, birds-of-paradise, tall white lillies, and colorful dahlias, leads from a wooden gate to the cottage.  Below the leaning palms, a porch-like area boasts fishing nets that hang from several tall posts and a wicker chair that faces the street.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Festival Bank]
description: Blue-green moss creeps along the upper walls of the structure, which is leaning very slightly to one side.  Where windows once looked out, boards now cover the spaces, and dust, mud, and cobwebs sweep across amlost every surface.  The only clean space is a makeshift teller's cage and a polished silver sign set up in one corner.

Blue-green moss creeps along the upper walls of the structure, which is leaning very slightly to one side.  Where windows once looked out, boards now cover the spaces, and dust, mud, and cobwebs sweep across almost every surface.  The only clean space is a makeshift teller's cage and a polished silver sign set up in one corner.

title: [Western Harbor, Ferry Dock]
description: Gently lapping at the docks, the waters of the harbor occasionally splash up onto the smooth expanse.  Bright white buoys set at even intervals protect the pier from any damage that may occur during the ferry's docking process, while the opposite corner houses a series of benches that have been built against the railing.  A colorful awning of grey-whorled purple stretches over one corner and provides shelter from the elements.

title: [Tendie's Promise, Deck]
description: Painted a uniform bright white hue, the small ferry is ringed by polished brass railings and has a smooth floor of interlocking teak and cedar boards.  Stretched across the stern is a grey-whorled purple awning that creates a small lounging area for guests and visitors.  Near a wide captain's wheel at the vessel's bow, a shell-shaped protective structure covers a ladder that leads downward.

title: [Tendie's Promise, Lounge]
description: Encircled on three sides by polished brass rails, the small lounge provides an excellent view of the water, as well as a clear view of the deck and captain's wheel.  Benches extend across the open space near the front of the awning-covered area, while a small golden linden bar topped with delicacies and treats stretches from port to starboard across the stern.  Dangling from the purple oilcloth that shelters the lounge is a series of glowing glass globes, each flickering a different color and hue at random intervals.

title: [Take a Dip]
description: Despite attempts at sprucing up the dilapidated structure, the shop remains dingy and smells of decaying wood.  Several rugs are placed about the soiled floor, for both the comfort of the shopper and the protection of the tables set about to display the wares.  A large colorful banner seems woefully out of place amongst the faded wooden walls.  Colorful crates, overflowing with sand and beach toys, fill the corners and makeshift shelves line the walls.

title: [The Fallen Corsair, Deck]
description: Weathered ironwood planks, which are in very poor shape, make up the deck of the ship.  A trio of tall masts spread out around the deck; however, they remain without sail and are not in any sort of working order.  Ironically, various birds have overrun the crow's nest, and feathers drift over its edges.  A short flight of steps leads down to a rusty-hinged wooden door, while on the opposite side of the deck, a ship's wheel is tied off to the railing.

title: [The Fallen Corsair, Cabin]
description: The cabin floor is littered with empty bottles of different sizes; the majority of the clutter being on both sides of a rusty-hinged wooden door.  Along the eastern wall, a driftwood credenza rests under a large stained glass window that looks out over the deck.  Resting in the center of the cabin, a small bed stands guard over the room, which is quite a mess.

title: [The Last Breath Halted]
description: Polished walls of ebonwood gleam mutely in the light from evenly spaced lit torches within the inside of the wagon.  A large arrangement of violet delphinium blossoms rests atop a low black marble table and provides a powerful musky scent that fills the space.  Arranged in a circle around the table, a group of mannequins is posed as if in the midst of conversation.  A placard rests against the delphinium-laden vase.  Ornately carved wooden slats over the windows prevent any view outside.

title: [Forest Path]
description: The ground is dark and wet, as patches of thick peat are scattered across the area.  Rotting vegetation can be seen in the dense muck under the bridge leading further into the swamp, which has a large wooden sign displayed before the entryway.

title: [Artiminus' Combat Gear]
[Artiminus' Weaponry]
[Artiminus' Magic Shoppe]
[Artiminus' Outfitting]
[Artiminus' Armory]
[Artiminus' General Store]
description: A snarling troll king mask hangs on one of the knotty pine walls, and a raised fel panel ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of striped throw pillows sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is a jewel-inlaid caddy on one side of the shop and a gilded maple table on the other.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Duckweed Haven]
description: A partially beached shanty boat is anchored to the shoreline with sturdy hemp lines.  Its painted facade is a patchwork of faded mint green and exposed metal.  The floating plantlife surrounding it appears to have not been disturbed for quite some time, with tiny shoots and runners wending their way into crevices near the vessel's waterline.  The available light reveals at least a dozen pairs of eyes within the floating duckweed.  Heading south, a rickety bridge heads toward an ebon gate.

The tops of armor-like, reptilian backs can be seen protruding motionlessly from within the floating duckweed.  Heading south, a rickety bridge heads toward an ebon gate.

title: [Icemule Trace, House Clerk]
description: The white marble walls and floor are softened by a pair of tapestries and a blackworked woolen rug.  One tapestry is woven with the image of the exterior of White Haven, the town's first Great House, and the other depicts a gathering of adventurers in Town Center preparing for a quest.  Some bookshelves against the wall hold a library of books and ledgers, and a low desk stands in the center of the room, behind which stands the house clerk.

title: [Raging Thrak Inn, Rooftop]
description: Dwarven loggers tirelessly haul crates of lumber along the cobblestone road below, moving along the street between the bathhouse and local bank.  The ancient oak tree of Town Square stretches up to the southeast.

title: [Lockers, Antechamber]
description: A simple wooden chair and a short square table are the only furnishings in this bare room.  The open ceiling shows the warehouse roof high above.  The sounds of workers moving crates in the warehouse below can be easily heard through the thin floors.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Rusted buckets, some so corroded that their bottoms have decayed into a red-brown mesh, lie scattered around a copper-chained bilge pump.  Strands of thick white cobwebs coat the tangled mass and are pocketed with darker cocoons of spider eggs.  A particularly hairy grey spider scurries from the mass toward a pile of rotting straw that protrudes from one of the cells.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]
description: Clumps of rotted straw lie scattered across the decking that stretches from the inner hull to the wide, wrought iron slats of the cell's rusty bars.  Black rings fixed to the walls with thick iron staples are evenly spaced along the bulkhead and fitted with manacles.  The stench filling the cramped space is heavy with mold and decay.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Dragonfly Inks]
description: Splintering through shuttered windows, silver slivers of moonlight blend with wavering candlelight to illuminate a long teak counter standing before a montage of chairs and sofas.  Heady incense permeates the air, easily overwhelming the less obtrusive scent of ink.  Even in the low light and plethora of shadows, the contrast between the menagerie of tile spreading out underfoot and the white-washed walls is readily apparent.

title: [Shrine of Heroes]
description: Snow white vultite walls tower high overhead in this eight-sided room, their enormous size dwarfing only slightly the magnificent granite statue that stands in the center of the structure.  Softly colored light filters in from huge stained glass windows set into each wall, creating a kaleidoscope of color dancing across the rich grey slate floors.

title: [A Spring In Your Step]
description: The floor of the tent has been covered with patches of dark green moss, while a copious amount of vines drapes down from the tent's wooden support beams.  An old tree stump has been positioned in the center of the area, its surface covered with colorful bracers.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]

title: [A Spring In Your Step, Backroom]
description: More a maze than a workshop, surely a hundred or more vines hang from the ceiling, many of them reaching to the floor and coiling about.  The only clear area is a small opening among the vines in the middle of the workshop, where a number of chairs and a table have been setup.

title: [Stumbling Pebble Bar II]
description: Dried, cracked boards mingle with newer knotted pine planks as they spread across the floor from the swinging oak doors to the white oak bar.  Several half-cask chairs are arranged in circles around the room, their backs weathered and cracked, while plump couches face a fireplace that looks as if it has seen better days.  A scattering of cracked peanut shells litters the floor around an oversized bowl that is set upon a faded blue rug.

title: [Flimgrimy's Fishing Finds]
description: Large and small plaques clutter the walls of the shop displaying a variety of mounted fish species and leaving no room for anything else, as evidenced by the cloaks and longcoats that are discarded on the floor beneath a window.  Various cases, shelves, and cabinets house a motley assortment of fishing gear, while a counter set in the center of the store holds lures and lines.  A faint track of mud and seaweed discolors the floorboards, its trail distinctly leading to and from the door.

title: [The Firebird, Gangway]
description: Beneath a low ceiling of mosaic jeweled tiles, the gangway is an expansive chamber with a wood-paneled floor adorned with flourishes of red brass and brighter scarlet lacquer.  A gold-threaded rug proceeds from a portal in the eastern hull of the ship, a wide arch framed in gilded fireleaf.  Glimaerstones set in heavy, spiraled sconces cast steady light upon the ostentatious chamber.

title: [The Slaughterhouse]
description: Cracked and peeling paint decorate the walls of the small shop, their curled ends littering the rough floor amid a layer of scattered sawdust.  One long counter stretches across the room, easily dividing the shopping space from the work area.  Implements of the butchering trade, such as razor strops, black iron rib cutters, and knives, dangle from black iron hooks, which stand over sanguine filled buckets.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]

title: [Tendie's Promise, Engine Room]
description: Small portholes spread across the walls of the engine room, each providing a different view of the exterior of the ferry.  Tiny boxes, heavily guarded by robed sailors, are arranged against the wall at the back of the room and generate a strange gurgling, humming sound.  Bright white globes provide the small space with ample illumination.
