description: Surrendering to the descent of the terrain, rock-strewn soil tumbles and scatters along the natural rock steps leading to the powdery sand of the beach.  Dense shadows cling to the outskirts of the dark jungle looming to the north, and the ever-present resonations of nocturnal creatures occupying the labyrinth battle against the lapping sounds of the ocean along the shore.  Moonlight glitters off the endless span of blue water greeting the coastline, rippling with the rhythmic approach and retreat of the tide.

description: The trees have been cleared out here to create space for a large bamboo changing hut. title: [Saewehna Jungle, Lagoon]
description: Moonlight barely illuminates the murky depths of a vast lagoon stretching out before the tumble of water rushing down from the plateaus above.  The nocturnal melody of the jungle serves as a striking companion to the surprisingly quiet sound of the bi-level falls cascading from the lowest outcropping to feed the pool.  Deep shadows help to almost completely conceal the presence of a cave hidden behind the ripple of the liquid curtain.

Plumes of mist rise into the air constantly, casting glistening dew upon everything within close proximity.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Cave]
description: Lapping effortlessly at the moss and algae enshrouded walls of the enclosure, the murky water ripples lazily in ebbs and surges.  Dusky shadows within the cave enhance the absolute darkness of the night outside, and the hushed music of nocturnal creatures accompanies the melodic sounds of the falls in the background.

title: [Saewehna Lagoon]
description: The water expands all around in a blanket of rippling, near-black liquid that changes in hue as moonlight glistens upon it.  The sounds of nocturnal wildlife are accompanied by the rush of the waterfall, and foam collects on the surface of the water as the influx of liquid is fed into the pool from above.  Water laps at the shoreline constantly, wearing down the stones that cling to the edge of the soil stubbornly.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Waterfall]
description: Dense shadows complicate travel along the path edging a rocky plateau.  Moonlight reflects upon the mist cascading down from the top of the falls, casting prismatic glimmers in a striking contrast to the oppressive darkness of the jungle at night.  Slick with condensation, the outcropping levels out to accommodate exploration, while the path provides a way to the next level of the waterfall.

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Waterfall]
description: The natural beauty of the multilevel waterfall is striking from the vantage point of this topmost plateau.  Winding in from the northwest, the crystalline water of the river cascades down over the ledge to pool up and overflow from the next level, then empties into the mist-shrouded lagoon at the bottom.  Travel is only possible on the western side of the water, as the terrain thins considerably on the eastern side where it surrenders to the coastal cliffs that plunge sharply to the beach.

title: [Saewehna Jungle, River]
description: Massive trees frame the river cutting its way through the jungle, their limbs laden with a dense canopy of leaves and creeping vines that is permeated with hazy shafts of moonlight.  The riverbed gradually gives way to moss-covered ground, and shadows dance across the rich soil to create brief, insubstantial images.  The dampness infused into the air from the river accentuates the ever-present mist overlaying the island, leaving a glistening dew upon everything it touches.

Trees densely covered in leaves and creeping vines surround the river as it meanders through the thickening jungle.  The riverbed of rocks gradually gives way to passable travel along either side of the foamy water, and the dampness infused into the air accentuates the ever-present mist overlaying the island.  An occasional flash of silver can be seen within the river as fish traverse its depths.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, River]
description: The slowly ascending landscape begins to give way to the incline of a magnificent mountain.  Though darkness enhances the ever present ethereal mist inhibiting a clear view, the shrouded image of the massive formation is somewhat discernable to the scrutinizing eye.  The distant glint of fireflies dancing among the shadows in the northern foothills creates pinpoints of faint light, while the surface of the river lazily moving northwest gleams wetly in the light of the moon.

The slow ascent in the landscape is prevalent here as the dense jungle gives way to the gradual incline of a magnificent mountain.  Ethereal, overlaying mist inhibits a clear view, though the shrouded images of the massive formation are discernable to the scrutinizing eye.  The path of the river continues northwest despite the change in landscape, and glimpses of the foothills further north can be seen.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Wilds]
description: Thickets of shrubs, ancient trees, and clinging liana vines accentuate the untamed jungle.  Amongst the shadows, gnarled tree roots descending into the soil resemble crippled fingers clawing fiercely at the dirt as they tangle over each other in a struggle for space with the plants.  The faint sounds of nocturnal creatures break the oppressive silence of night, and shafts of moonlight cast subtle illumination as they reflect from the surface of rainwater collected within dead tree limbs.

Large, gnarled roots descend into the rich, leaf-covered soil from each of the tree trunks, their lengths protruding here and there as they tangle over each other in a fierce struggle for space amongst the overgrowth of plant-life.  Small depressions in the remains of long-dead tree limbs collect rainwater for the multitude of insects drawn to the humid environment.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Wilds]
description: The broken, decayed form of a large palm frond serves as an architectural twist of nature as it forms a lean-to for the inhabitants of the jungle.  Leftovers from the leaf-cutter ants that make their meal of the vegetation, several piles of fallen leaves are scattered about the ground.  Clusters of wildflowers make their home beneath the shadows of the frond, their coloring muted in the darkness of night.  Shafts of moonlight hazily illuminate the jungle as a light night breeze whistles through the trees.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, River]
description: Continuing its journey through the congested trees and vegetation of the jungle, the natural stream of the moonlit river cuts through the rich soil with ease.  Giant water lilies float passively within the current, and the muted amethyst blooms of water hyacinths rest within the shadowed protection of the ribbed water lettuce leaves.  The chorus of crickets calling to each other escapes from large stands of bamboo that cluster along the banks on either side in thick clumps of grassy reeds.

paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon, Shore]
description: The salty scent of the ocean drifts in on the air circulating through the trees that frame the expanse of lagoon shoreline.  Leaves and various plants sway with a cool evening breeze as they crowd for space between the trunks and bamboo shoots in the shadows.  Damp from the occasional splash of water, several large rounds of grey stone serve as a path to a decorated bamboo hut flanked on either side by flickering torches.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon]
description: Lines of ivory foam cling to the edge of the shoreline, collecting against the soil and reflecting the muted light of the moons.  The trees framing the lagoon enhance the darkness of night as the branches of a few extend enough to cast shadows over the glistening black surface of the water.  Occupying the majority of the shore, a decorated bamboo hut appears to be closed for the evening, but the flickering light of torches illuminate a pathway leading around the lagoon.

Lines of ivory foam cling to the edge of the shoreline, intermingling with the strands of flora that flourish on the shore of the lagoon.  The trees framing the lagoon provide some respite from the heat of the sun as the branches of a few extend out over the water to cast shadows over the surface.  A decorated bamboo hut occupying the majority of the shore can be seen as well as a pathway providing a means to travel around the lagoon.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon, Shore]
description: Shafts of moonlight allow a brief glimpse of cliffs to be visible through the trees as the terrain thins further from the lagoon border.  Fireflies occassionally flit back and forth over the moss and clusters of flowers creating the shoreline, adding their brightly flashing light to the flickering of the torches that flank a large bamboo hut fashioned with a wide counter.

A brief glimpse of the cliffs can be seen through the trees as the terrain thins further from the lagoon border where moss and clusters of flowers create a lush shoreline.  Offering a slight reprieve from the heat, the trees manage to provide enough of a canopy to cast shade over a large bamboo hut fashioned with a wide counter.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon]
description: The pale forms of clouds and the pinpoint lights of a myriad of stars are mirrored in the night-darkened water, drawing attention to the sheer black hue of the liquid in comparison.  Flitting across the water, the occasional firefly flashes a brilliant spark of light to break the shadows near the shoreline, before disappearing once more into the darkness of night.

Sunlight sparkles upon the surface of the water, drawing attention to the various hues that bleed together within the depths of the lagoon.  Hues ranging from almost translucent mist blue at the surface to dark midnight blue further down give the aqueous body depth and vibrancy.  The shoreline glistens with constant dew from the lapping water as it splashes against the soil.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon, Shore]
description: Creating a splash of glimmering color beneath the surface of the dark water, a school of tiny silver fish dart back and forth near the shoreline of the lagoon to nibble at algae, then shift away when the water laps too roughly.  Fireflies flicker in and out near the fragrant flowers dotting the expanse of shoreline, while the shadow-encased trees and shrubs of the jungle serve as an eerie backdrop to a decorated bamboo hut flanked by flickering torches.

A school of tiny silver fish dart back and forth near the shoreline, shifting away when the water laps too roughly at the edge of the lagoon, then moving quickly back to nibble at algae when the current is lulled once more.  Several fragrant flowers dot the moss-covered soil that makes up the expanse of shoreline, while the rich verdant hues of the trees and shrubs of the jungle serve as an exotic backdrop to a decorated bamboo hut.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon]
description: Moonlight breaks through the branches of trees further north to illuminate the glass-like surface of the lagoon with glistening brilliance, while the depths dance with shadows.  Gentle breezes drifting through the area create ripples upon the water, mingling with the constant, yet languid, current brought on by the waterfall that feeds it.  An occasional screech of a nocturnal bird or rustle of a bush on the nearby shoreline pierces the quiet of the alcove.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon]
description: Ripples created by the waterfall feeding the lagoon provide enough motion to keep the glistening black liquid moving almost constantly as it laps in one direction or another.  Reflecting from the mirror-like surface of the water, moonlight plays across the lagoon in a neverending dance of pale beams, while deeper below, the shadows shift with the current.  The melody of the nearby waterfall is only occasionally broken by the call of a nocturnal creature.

Ripples created by the waterfall feeding the lagoon provide enough motion to keep the deep blue liquid moving almost constantly as it laps in one direction or another.  An occasional piece of flora drifts in on a ripple of foam, its glistening surface reflecting the sunlight illuminating the lagoon.  Though the rushing melody of the nearby waterfall is prominent in this location, the faint chatter of local wildlife can still be heard from time to time.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon]
description: Mosquitos buzz as they skim the surface of the water in the cool night air, taking a reprieve from the sweltering heat present during the day.  Shadows dance across the black surface of the water, broken only by moonlight glistening here and there on the rippling liquid.

The occasional bloom floats along on the constantly lapping current of the lagoon, swept into the cove by the waterfall's motions.  The depths of the water are so extensive that it is impossible to touch the lagoon bed, and the liquid becomes so dark of a blue further down that it cannot be seen either.  Only the random flash of silver scales as a fish darts breaks the shadows.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon]
description: Moonlight filters in through the branches of nearby trees on the shoreline, breaking apart the shadows that drift across the black surface of the lagoon.  The occasional vague shape shifts beneath the water, too dark to be properly seen as it makes its way through the lagoon's depths.

Sunlight filters in through the branches of nearby trees on the shoreline, broken into brilliant shafts that illuminate the vivid blue surface of the lagoon.  A few stray flowers float in the water, drifting around aimlessly as the current shifts them to and fro, and the occasional silvery fish nibbles at the underside.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon, Shore]
description: Eroded by the lagoon, damp soil tumbles into the water with the effortlessly lapping current, and small plants flourish from the constant source of hydration at the shoreline.  Moonlight dances over the thick, verdant carpet of moss and grass extending from the shore to the backdrop of towering trees and thick vegetation, helping to alleviate the heavy shadows of night encasing them.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Lagoon]
description: No fish can be seen darting beneath the surface of the slowly rippling water as the darkness of night renders the cool depths of the lagoon a dark black hue.  Providing the only available light in the area, moonlight streams down through the pale clouds drifting across the night sky and casts sparkling illumination upon the water's surface.  A cool night breeze occasionally circulates through the area, causing the water to ripple with light and shadow as the wind engages the liquid in an ethereal dance.

The occasional fish darts through the slowly rippling water, the flash of silver scales as it moves a bright contrast to the deep blue of the lagoon.  Though the lack of trees ensures no shelter from the sun in the midst of the lagoon, the cool temperature of the water alleviates the heat to a tolerable level.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, River]
description: Jutting forth from the muddy banks of the murky river, tall stands of heliconias sway in the current.  Clumps of grass congest the flow of the water, their tapering surfaces glistening as moonlight reflects from the iridescent beads of water clinging to them.  A fairly large collection of water grasses has created a floating meadow on the eastern side of the river, the feathery tops of the plants barely muting the symphony of the nocturnal insects living within.

Jutting forth from the muddy banks of the river, tall stands of heliconias sway in the current.  Clumps of grass congest the flow of water, their tapering surfaces beaded with iridescent droplets as insects drink from the tiny pools of liquid.  A fairly large collection of water grasses has created a floating meadow on the eastern side of the river, the feathery tops of the plants enshrouding a host of living creatures within.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Wilds]
description: The murmuring of the falls echoes from the east, mirroring the mellow babble of the northern river as it joins the eerie melody of nocturnal creatures rustling about the wilds.  Shadows cling to the densely clustered vines dangling from the sweeping branches of high-reaching trees, their leafy spirals swaying slowly in the occassional nighttime breeze.  Thin shafts of muted moonlight penetrate the hazy mist of the jungle canopy, creating wavering shadows that shift with each movement of limb or leaf.

The murmuring of the falls echoes from the east, mirroring the mellow babble of the northern river as it joins the diverse melody of the jungle inhabitants rustling about the wilds.  Densely clustered vines dangle from the sweeping branches of high-reaching trees, their leafy spirals sprouting blooms of amber, apricot, and carmine flowers.  A family of spider monkeys hops from one tree to the next, their curious chatter resonating within the hazy mist of the jungle canopy.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Tree Limb]
description: A particularly large limb extending from the trunk of the tree provides a comfortable perch to settle upon and observe the vast expanse of shadow-filled jungle both below and before it.  Enshrouded by the rest of the majestic being's vine-tangled limbs, the area is bestowed a reprieve from the heat by the rustling leaves and the chill of night.  The whisper of the evening wind blowing through the secluded retreat occasionally accompanies the low murmur of nocturnal creatures moving about the wilderness.

A particularly large limb extending from the trunk of the tree provides a comfortable perch to settle upon and observe the vast expanse of jungle both below and before it.  Enshrouded by the rest of the majestic being's vine-tangled limbs, the area is bestowed a reprieve from the heat by rustling leaves.  The whisper of the wind blowing through the secluded retreat is the sole interruption to the ever-present sounds of wildlife.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Coastal Cliff]
description: The shadowy form of the mountain rising in the north dominates here as the jungle terrain thins to the edge of the coastal cliffs.  Moonlight shimmers on the dark surface of the ocean below the cliffs, and only a small portion of the southern expanse of beach is discernable through the dark shadows brought by the night.  The salty scent of ocean breeze teases the senses, and the wind whistles eerily through the few defiant trees and patches of grass still clinging to the rock-laden soil.

The view of the mountain rising in the north dominates here as the jungle terrain thins to the edge of the coastal cliffs.  A breathtaking view of the ocean below is limited to the southern expanse of the beach as the prominent curve of the northwest coastline hinders further sight.  The salty scent of ocean breeze permeates the cliff, and the wind dances over the few defiant trees and patches of grass growing within the rock-laden soil.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Wilds]
description: Framed by massive, variegated leaves of deep emerald hue, the elongated stalks of draping ivory lilies extend proudly forth in scattered groups around the trunks of jungle trees.  The steady drone of crickets and other nocturnal insects echoes within the jungle, seemingly from all sides at once.  A flash of muted color can occasionally be seen from beneath the large blooms of the lilies, as moonlight reflects from the backs of frogs that call it their home.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, River]
description: Moonlight accentuates the dense haze of mist permeating the area with its ethereal, smoky presence.  Cool, damp breeze infused into the climate by the rushing water of the river combines with the welcome respite from the sun as night takes its domain in the dense jungle.  Shadows dance upon the landscape, rendering the foothills and the rising mountain in the north almost indiscernible in the foggy surroundings, with only the thinning plant-life to indicate the change in terrain.

A dense haze of mist permeates the area with its ethereal, smoky presence.  Cool, damp breeze infused into the climate by the rushing water of the river provides a welcome respite from the humidity of the jungle as the thick vegetation surrenders to the rise of the mountain in the north.  Glimpses of the foothills are obscured within the foggy surroundings, with only the thinning plant-life to indicate the change in terrain.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Clearing]
description: Sky and ground open out from the solid foliage surrounding the clearing.  Moonlight streams in, unfettered by the diffusing leaves of the jungle canopy, accompanied by fresh floral-scented breezes that regularly sweep through the area.  Lush ground cover swathes the clearing floor with soft, cushioning grasses, an open invitation to rest beneath the starry night sky.  Delicate flowers sway gently, their tightly furled buds silhouetted in the dim light.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Swamp]
description: Shadows encase the thickening plant life in the outskirts of the swamp, the struggling vegetation growing denser as the muddy soil begins to dry out to a more normal semblance of jungle terrain.  Pockets of bubbling muck still occupy a few of the more water-saturated areas, even as lengths of fallen vines attempt to obscure the vicious combination of mud and water.  Further southeast, the sounds of nocturnal life echo loudly in a stark contrast to the dreary bubbling of the swamp.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Coast]
description: The remains of broken shells and shattered wood litter the shoreline, providing a home for countless scavenger creatures to rest in during the night.  The surf takes its toll on the constantly shifting sand of the beach, yet the beauty of the ocean's moonlit horizon remains.  Hazy shafts of moonlight glint off of the splash of pink barely visible beneath the murky ocean water farther out in the waves, calling attention to the presence of a massive coral reef.

Quickly moving reptiles and rodents move between the broken remains of shells and wood washed up on the shoreline as they scavenge for food, before scurrying back to their homes between smaller boulders and debris.  The surf takes its toll on the constantly shifting sand of the beach, yet the beauty of the ocean's horizon remains.  Farther out in the waves, the water's hue changes from deep blue to a vibrant splash of pink as the top of a massive coral reef can be seen.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Coast]
description: The shadows of night provide a dark background to the expanse of sand surrendering to the ocean's grasp as its foamy waves rush forth and retreat rhythmically on the shoreline.  A flock of pelicans rest upon a large boulder, their bodies still but for the occasional shift of feet as they huddle together in the moonlight.  Collections of seaweed cling to the debris cluttering the beach, and moonlight reflects from the dark surface of the ocean as the sound of waves crashing filters in on the evening breeze.

The vibrant plants and trees of the jungle provide an exotic background to the expanse of sand surrendering to the ocean's grasp as its foamy waves rush forth and retreat rhythmically on the shoreline.  A flock of pelicans gather upon a large boulder, only moving from their resting place to dive into the water and retrieve fish in their large gullets before returning to their perch.  Collections of seaweed cling to the debris cluttering the beach, and the cry of seagulls accompanies the crash of waves.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Wilds]
description: Moonlight highlights the labyrinth of plants and trees punctuated by masses of vines hanging from the dense canopy.  Exotic, nocturnal flowers dot several of the malachite tendrils as they weave their way through the shadows in the vegetation, and the nighttime calls of various creatures are joined by the muted sounds of the ocean.  The gradual change in the terrain is clear as travel further south is restricted to a steeply descending path.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Cellar]
description: Several half-filled sconces sputter and flare, fighting in vain to stay alit.  They shed just enough light to reveal several small alcoves within this ample cellar.  A large sewage grate partially covers an opening leading somewhere below.

title: [Channel]
description: Years ago, this must have been a sewage drain-off channel, but somebody has gone to the trouble of flooring the passage with inexpensive cobblestones.  Tall folks will have to stoop a bit to get around, but not uncomfortably so.

title: [Channel]
description: The passage slowly curves and leads to a rusted iron ladder that leads back up.  Something heavy must have fallen from above, as the cobblestones at the base of the ladder are cracked badly.

title: [Basement]
description: Several elves stare at you, not terribly impressed at your entrance.  One of them drums his fingers impatiently on a small table, apparently waiting for something.  A rather solid door is just visible beyond the group, while a visible tunnel leads off into the darkness.

title: [Sewage Drain]
description: The stench of this passage is overpowering and quite unpleasant.  To make matters worse, the moss on the ceiling and on the floor seems to undulate from time to time.  Footing is precarious at best, making any fall in here possibly one's last.

title: [South Crossing, Riverbank]
description: The breeze stirs intermittently, bringing with it the smell of roasted acorns from the kitchen of a nearby home.  Not far to the south, the grasslands begin to give way to a thick forest.

title: [South Crossing, Wooded Path]
description: Wispy mosses dangle from the trees, clinging to their branches like cobwebs.  Some of them hang quite low, causing the people walking this path to navigate around them.

title: [South Crossing, Grassland]
description: Sparse trees spring from the plains.  They grow more densely to the south, forming the boundary of Trollfang forest.  The path continues on in that direction, quickly disappearing into the woodland darkness.

title: [South Crossing, Forest]
description: Birds of various species flit through the trees, weaving amongst them with agile grace.  Every so often, one will alight on a branch or rooftop for a moment before fluttering off.  They chirp and caw ceaselessly, filling the forest with their chatter.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Grassland]
description: The landscape is in transition.  Not far to the south, the fertile plains quickly surrender the riverbottom to a dense forest.  It seems to have mattered not to the villagers, however.  The rows of buildings proceed on in both directions without interruption.

title: [South Crossing, Forest]
description: A small ridge rises against the edge of the path.  Its rocky surface provides a foothold for the multi-colored lichens and moss that grow upon it.  Amplified by the forest, the sound of rushing water can be heard from somewhere nearby.

title: [South Crossing, Forest]
description: The path moves away from the river to the west, wandering haphazardly through the trees.  Darkness permeates the forest, for little illumination is able to filter through the leafy canopy.  Only the areas cleared for homes recieve any light.

title: [South Crossing, Riverbank]
description: The river swells as it strikes a massive boulder in midstream, forming eddies along each bank.  A deep pool is created as a result of the conflicting flows cutting into the streambed.  Despite the depth, the gravel and mosses at the bottom of the pool are clearly visible.  Nourished over the centuries by the river it grows next to, a gnarled old oak towers above.  Dangling from one of its limbs is a knotted rope.

title: [Crossing, In the River]
description: The swirling waters of the river have created a deep swimming hole here, lined on the banks with small wildflowers and carpeted with waving green water plants.  Fish swim about your legs, darting away at the slightest move towards them.  The water is briskly chilly, giving you prickly goosebumps all over.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Grassland]
description: To the southwest, the towering spire of Melgorehn's Reach looms above the plain.  Its peak is cloaked with clouds, hiding it -- and its secrets -- from view.  Pedestrians pause in their wanderings to gaze up at the famous landmark from which this village draws its name.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Grassland]
description: The plain rises and falls, gently rolling in a series of broad knolls that stretch off into the distance.  Visible beyond the outskirts of the village, large herds of roltons graze upon the grass.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Grassland]
description: The wind blows by, howling, and its touch sends waves rippling across the grass.  To the east, a line of trees follows the Locksmehr River as it slices through the plain.

title: [South Crossing, Grassland]
description: The grass is worn thin by the villagers' traffic, leaving a wide patch of dirt at the center of the homes here.  A dog tethered to a fence post barks at all who pass, its exuberant enthusiasm indicating it is more interested in being friends than protecting its domain.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Riverbank]
description: People of varying races stroll along the path, enjoying the quaint charm of this hamlet.  They walk alone or in groups, occasionally stopping to speak to a passerby.  The river picks up not far to the south, its surface breaking into a rolling boil as it enters a long riffle.

title: [Unknown]
description: Thousands of undead move past, slowly advancing toward an outnumbered band of elven defenders perched atop a far off rise.  A lone figure in black behind the undead horde stands with arms upraised, urging the army forward relentlessly.  Streaks of lightning flash constantly among the roiling dark clouds above, leaving slowly fading crimson trails.  The land is parched and dead with innumerable cracks running through the barren ground and around the boulders.  No senses other than sight seem to function.

title: [Mistral Hall, Back Lawn]
description: A rolling green lawn is hedged by neatly trimmed bushes and a low wall of the native stone.  The sound of the river provides a peaceful counterpoint to the occasional breeze.

title: [Mistral Hall, Deck]
description: A low, wooden railing surrounds the rectangular deck without obscuring the view.  Sometimes shrouded in mists, sometimes crystal clear, the waterfront provides a place for never-ending reverie.

title: [Mistral Hall, Northeast Room]
description: The exterior walls are made of the same mesh that screens the entry to the Hall, while the interior walls are constructed from moveable matting.  A three-tiered table stands against one screen wall, each tier filled with a variety of potted plants and flowers.

title: [Mistral Hall, North Room]
description: The walls are fixed in position, anchored by sturdy furnishings and a large watercolor painting.  Curtains of beads flutter in the windows, their chiming mixing with the sounds of the guests and the water below the house in a pleasant murmur.

title: [Mistral Hall, Banquet Hall]
description: What used to be an old lighthouse storage room has been renovated into a lavish Four Winds Hall Lounge equipped with all the comforts of home.  In the corner a potbelly stove provides a source of heat for the room along with a few cooked goodies on its griddle.

title: [Mistral Hall, Screened Porch]
description: Water lapping against the thick beams of the pier provides a soothing, rhythmic sound.  Wooden benches line the walls within the porch, painted in red and blue.  A banner is festooned along the wall of the house, together with fine fishing nets filled with seashells.

title: [Mistral Hall, Prayer Room]
description: The window is wide and low, providing an excellent spot to be at peace and enjoy the scenery.  Silk pillows in vivid colors are stacked around the room, enabling guests to arrange themselves in the comfort of their own choice.

title: [Mistral Hall, Entrance]
description: At the end of the pier, fashioned from timbers of several large ships that have met their fate by either grounding on sand bars or even worse, meeting the dreaded Krolvin, stands the lighthouse, home to the Four Winds Hall.  The smell of salted air flows inland from the mouth of the delta as a few pelicans glide slowly out to sea.

title: [A Long Pier]
description: Greyed by weather, the thick planks of the pier are roughly cut.  A trail has been worn smooth along the center of the pier, the surface sanded by the passing of many feet.  Clumps of water lilies float on the water's surface to either side of the pier, their fragrance filling the air with serenity.

title: [Monastery, Meditation Garden]
description: Two sides of the interior wall of the monastery border the meditation garden with a large wooden door set into the east wall, flanked by two narrow arching windows.  The meditation garden is divided into four small reflecting pools bordered by closely sheared emerald green grass in the shape of squares.  Simple pebbled paths cast a yellow contrast against the grass and the blue of the sky reflected on the still waters of the pools.  Worn stone slabs are nestled into the grass facing the pools.

title: [Monastery, Memorial Garden]
description: Set at the center of the memorial garden is a smooth riverstone obelisk, surrounded in a circle of yellow pebbles with paths that issue off in four different directions.  Four squares of bright emerald green grass envelop the circle and are divided by the four exiting pathways.  At the edge of the pebbled circle, where grass meets stone, benches are placed facing the obelisk.  A solemness radiates from the riverstone memorial accompanied by the quiet prayers of the occassional monk seated upon one of the nearby benches.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Monastery, Meditation Garden]
description: Covered in leafy ivy vines, a riverstone wall runs along one side of the meditation garden, enclosing it against the inside of the monastery.  A series of five large arching stone windows gaze out onto the garden from the interior of the monastery, while simple pebbled paths encircle four small reflecting pools bordered by closely sheared emerald green grass in the shape of squares.  Worn stone slabs are nestled into the grass facing the pools.

title: [Monastery, Meditation Garden]
description: A tall riverstone wall, overrun with dark green ivy vines, runs the length of the meditation garden, enclosing it against the inside of the monastery.  A single narrow arch disrupts the wall of ivy and stone and from it runs a simple pebbled path which encircles four small reflecting pools bordered by closely sheared emerald green grass in the shape of squares.  Worn stone slabs are nestled into the grass facing the pools.

title: [Monastery, Meadow]
description: Bordered to the northeast by trimmed rose bushes is a meadow littered with red, yellow, and the occasional blue-petaled flowers.  Long stalks of gold-green grass reflect the sunlight, evoking an image of a rippling golden pond.  The meadow runs up against the green-veined riverstone wall that extends around the monastery.  A path cut into the tall meadow grass runs along the wall up to a narrow riverstone arch.

title: [Monastery, Meditation Garden]
description: Bordered on two sides by the riverstone interior wall of the monastery, the meditation garden is divided into four small reflecting pools bordered by closely sheared emerald green grass in the shape of squares.  Simple pebbled paths cast a yellow contrast against the grass and the blue of the sky reflected on the still waters of the pools.  Worn stone slabs are nestled into the grass facing the pools.

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: From here, buildings can be seen, all constructed of wood and stone, as the path begins to fork.  The fence continues to follow along at the edge of the path, splitting itself off into different directions to follow the walkway.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A wreath hangs askew on one of the fence posts nearby, and the ribbons hanging from it are frayed and torn.  A lone goat, having strayed from the crowd, lingers suspiciously close to the fence, but seems content to stare off into the meadow, as if pointedly ignoring the tattered ribbons.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Underfoot, shallow ruts in the path mark the trail as one frequently traveled by wagons, and the grass beyond the fence following the path is neat and short.  A trip of goats off to one side, meandering out in the meadow, are the most likely architects of the tidy landscaping.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Gaily flowered decorations trail along the fence as it stretches along either side of the path.  A hint of color in the grass is a bright blue ribbon caught in the blades, apparently having fallen away from one of the wreaths.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A split-rail fence rises from the ground, the wood greyed by age and exposure, but still quite sturdy as it borders the path.  On every other post, brightly flowered wreaths hang, and beneath, wildflowers rise from the earth, as if striving to become a part of the decorations.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Got Your Goat]
description: Starlight dances along the hinged wooden rails of this small, portable pen that has been situated on a slightly bumpy knoll of grass and dirt in the meadow.  Gnawed bits of rope dangle from equally gnawed planks, and several rusty cow bells, battered and dented, hang along the perimeter rails.  A rickety upturned box and a teeth-marked tin pail are underneath a handpainted sign that reads, "Gynny."

Sunlight dances along the hinged wooden rails of this small, portable pen that has been situated on a slightly bumpy knoll of grass and dirt in the meadow.  Gnawed bits of rope dangle from equally gnawed planks, and several rusty cow bells, battered and dented, hang along the perimeter rails.  A rickety upturned box and a teeth-marked tin pail are underneath a handpainted sign that reads, "Gynny."
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Marking the apex of a gentle curve in the wheel-rutted dirt road is a long wooden hitching post, adorned at its ends by wreaths of bright flowers and ribbons that flutter in the slightest breeze.  Beyond the post, green grass stretches along the sides of an eastward path, and in the distance, the peaks of roofs rise against the sky.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Back of the Wagon]
description: You're riding atop a soft cushion of straw in the back of a large and sturdy wagon.  Piles of hay are stacked all around you in a semi-organized fashion, along with a few other packaged goods.  Behind you on the seat of the wagon, the back of the driver's head, which is topped with a muss of brown hair, is clearly visible.  In front of you, the view out the back of the wagon is fairly uninhibited, though at times, the passing scenery seems to waver.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Path]
description: Rising from the fences lining the road, an archway constructed of woven willow branches and bedecked with streaming cotton ribbons and fresh flowers greets those heading into town.  From the peak of the arch, a glass lantern with panes of blue, red, yellow, and green dangles, the hues illuminated from within by a candle that flickers fitfully from time to time.

Rising from the fences lining the road, an archway constructed of woven willow branches and bedecked with streaming cotton ribbons and fresh flowers greets those heading into town.  From the peak of the arch, a glass lantern with panes of blue, red, yellow, and green dangles unlit.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Path]
description: The path veers northward, and off to the side at the heart of the fork is a simple, but skillfully built sign edged in scrollwork and supported by a pair of painted wooden posts.  Tall tufts of grass and flowering weeds have grown up at the base of the posts, and a large beribboned and flowered wreath hangs from the lower edge of the sign.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: On either side of the road, buildings big and small rise like solemn sentinels, the wood from which they are constructed greying with age.  Several have covered porches under which sit rocking chairs, their seats and backs padded with cushions in various shades and hues, some plain, some patchwork, and some patterned.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Bits and pieces of split-rail fences can be seen standing between each of the buildings, separating the interiors of town from the meadow and pastureland that lies beyond.  Just off the side of the road, a large building sits, its windows curtained with flower-patterned cotton.  The clothesline that stretches from an upper window to a parallel window of the house next door seems to indicate that these are homes shelter neighbors on good terms.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Pitchfork Pub]
description: The spacious interior of this renovated barn bears a bustling tavern and kitchen.  A tanik plank ladder climbs up the back wall of the barn, leading upwards to the loft.  Mounted on the wall above the battered haon bar is a three-pronged matte steel pitchfork.  The hard-packed earthen floor is covered with a thin layer of straw.  A rectangular haon notice hangs from one of the posts of the building.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Pitchfork Pub, Loft]
description: A tall wrought iron railing runs along the edge of the loft.  Some bales of golden hay are arranged in a circle around the middle of the balconied loft.  Glass-paned lanterns hang from the beams overhead and provide a gentle illumination in the loft.  At the back wall, a tanik plank ladder leads back down into the tavern.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Tim's Corncobs!]
description: Sweet-smelling smoke permeates the air, creating a light haze throughout the building.  Wide windows peer out at the town's street, their frames glossed over with a thick lacquer.  Leaning up against the glossy, gnarled wooden walls are several rustic benches positioned across from a long counter laden with merchandise.  A framed painting of an aged man with white stubble and a twinkle in his blue eyes is the only hanging decoration in sight.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: The area opens up here, a large opening breaking the line of buildings and houses, and a well-trodden path leads through the opening.  Looking down between the buildings, a field opens up beyond the short meadow walk of the path.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Elmhart's Bridal, Storefront]
description: Red cedar beams support a high ceiling that is patched up with misplaced pieces of colorful gates and doors over the slightest warping.  Bolts of pale-colored fabrics stand behind a marble-topped yew corner counter filled with small trinkets and accessories.  A hanging clothing rack and a carved mahogany shoe ledge run the full length of the store.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Elmhart's Bridal, Greenhouse]
description: Panels of transparent glass comprise the ceiling and adjoining walls of the flourishing greenhouse.  A natural cedar jewelry case resides over a slew of vividly flowering terra cotta planters.  Some stone pottery vases and delicate glass-capped floral arrangements are strewn across an aged wooden island at the room's center.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: In this corner of the town's center, a stately building stands, longer than it is tall.  Wooden supports line the edge of the porch, upholding the overhang, which is trimmed in scalloped woodwork.  The panes of glass in the windows are whorled, obscuring the view of the building's interior, though a carved sign hangs above the doorway, while another smaller note dangles from the door handle on a bright green ribbon.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Sections of split-rail fence create an enclosure with openings that lead to the very heart of the town.  While wreaths and greenery decorate the posts and rails of the fence, a small cart sits off to one side, looking slightly out of place with its gilded frame, wheels, and handles.  Atop the cart are several varicolored bowls, and the shelf beneath is littered with freshly cut flowers.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Set back from the festivities, a tall, sloping arch has been constructed of wood wrapped in willow vines and adorned with ribbon streamers and a variety of brightly hued flowers.  From the center of the arch, a swing hangs down on thick lengths of heavy rope, and the ground beneath it is bare of grass, scuffed by the many feet of people who have swung upon it.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Tucked into this niche, away from the center of town, is a bench that has been carved from a segment of a massive tree trunk.  The bark along the top has been shaved away and sanded until a shallow depression for the seat has been created.  In a half-moon of intricately woven knotwork, the back of the bench rises, created from supple willow branches.  Off to one side is a bird bath, a glass basin perched securely atop an iron stand, with ivy-patterned prongs holding the bowl in place.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Write Stop, Entry]
description: Dark oak walls enclose the brightly lit room, offering plenty of light to the cramped entryway.  A large mahogany counter stands before an iron-hinged oak door, which has a granite plaque hanging from the doorsill.  A gold-edged, scarlet rug barely covers the dusty floors of the wagon, which branch off to the east and west.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Write Stop, Office]
description: Hanging down from an open-rafter ceiling are several oil lamps that offer the room wavery illumination.  Pushed up against the northern wall is an oak desk, which is cluttered with random documents and papers.  Along the floor, stacks of books offer little room to traverse through the wagon, other than a path from the desk to the oak door.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Bonfire]
description: Several split log benches sit in a circle around a massive patch of scorched earth, a place where many a fire seems to have burned.  The grass along the edges is singed and brown, fragile enough to break underfoot, while the air is haunted with the distinct scent of wood smoke.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Sections of split-rail fence create an enclosure with openings that lead to the very heart of the town.  Sitting very near several of the openings are large, iron-bound barrels full of water.  Smaller buckets sit stacked beside each, apparently kept in the interest of safety as even here, the scent of wood smoke can still be caught on breezes that drift across the circle's interior.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: A shingle-roofed stone well occupies this small corner of the square, a single wooden bucket hanging from the hand crank designed to lower it.  The upper edge of the stones are festooned with garlands of greenery and flowers, and a ring of multihued flower petals litter the ground in a complete halo around the well.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Rose bushes, neatly pruned and tended, bearing flowers in shades of red, orange, and pink line the edge of the road.  The full blooms add a classical hint of decor to this otherwise plain and dusty road.  Banners fluttering in the air can be seen nearer the center of the town, and the faint murmur of voices and laughter can be heard.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Leanney's Shop, Entry]
description: Quaint and tidy, the rustic shop has exposed beams and knotty oak paneling.  Thick rugs of braided linen are spread across the floor, making it impossible to determine what color the creaking boards are beneath the explosion of color.  A long glass-front counter spreads across the expanse between the two corridors that lead deeper into the store, while the white birch door leading to the street is fitted with painted rose-colored glass.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Here at the edge of town, the road widens and its grass borders have grown taller.  Meadows stretch out behind the fence that runs parallel to the trail, disappearing against the horizon in a haze of green and cool pastels.  Grapevine wreaths streaming ribbons and boasting a colorful array of flowers hang from each of the fence posts, and greenery drapes the rails.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Beezer's Barn, Main Floor]
description: The smell of fresh hay permeates the area, the source of which lies in the hayloft at the top of a narrow wooden ladder.  Here on the main floor, several stalls house a variety of farm animals brought in for the night.  Moonlight filters through the window above the double barn doors, illuminating the room with a silvery glow.  Hanging oil lanterns light up a rusted metal shelf along one wall that holds a variety of farm tools.  In the back, a small wooden door leads deeper into the barn.

The smell of fresh hay permeates the area, the source of which lies in the hayloft at the top of a narrow wooden ladder.  Here on the main floor, several stalls lay barren, their occupants put out to pasture.  Sun let in from the window above the double barn doors illuminates a large swath of the hay strewn wooden floorboards, and motes of dust dance delicately in the ray of light.  A rusted metal shelf along one wall holds a variety of farm tools.  In the back, a small wooden door leads deeper into the barn.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Beezer's Barn, Tack Room]
description: A long wooden table encompasses much of the far wall, its surface covered with sawdust, wood shavings, and a small metal tray with a yellow tag.  The smell of wood smoke lingers here, as if some burning had taken place.  Dozens of pegs dot the wall above the table, each one home to a tool of the trade.  Resting beside the narrow wooden door leading out is a large metal crate filled with spare lumber.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Sections of split-rail fence create an enclosure with openings that lead to the very heart of the town.  Each post of the fence bears a flowered wreath, and greenery strewn with full and half-open blossoms is draped along the railings.  Here and there, tall poles tower above, supporting banners that move with even the most subtle of winds.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Dunstan's Farm Depot]
description: Glimpses of the starry sky are visible through high windows.  Hanging from the rafters are a number of drying animal hides.  The strong earthy scents of the straw-covered dirt floor, stacked bales of hay, and damp wood permeate the air.  Wrought-iron hooks have been affixed to the barn walls, displaying the various merchandise for sale.

Sunlight filters in through high windows, highlighting fine floating dust and other particulate matter.  Hanging from the rafters are a number of drying animal hides.  The strong earthy scents of the straw-covered dirt floor, stacked bales of hay, and damp wood permeate the air.  Wrought-iron hooks have been affixed to the barn walls, displaying the various merchandise for sale.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: The center of town opens up, the structures further apart than they are at the road's edge.  A tall slender building rises from a foundation of smooth stones to a roof of steep peaks and gables.  Around the perimeter of the house, a small garden has been cultivated behind a wood and wrought iron fence with a swinging gate.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A squat house with arced shingles sits on this side of town center, its visage dowdy, though in good repair.  Stones trail one after another from the bottom of the house steps, moving toward the openness of the square as a neat pathway bordered by small, purple flowers.  Off to the side of the house is a short, ironwork fence, and inside the fence is an equally drab-looking, old, grey goat.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Sections of split-rail fence create an enclosure with openings that lead to the very heart of the town.  Set back from the fences is a square wooden table draped with a checkered cloth.  Atop the table, a shallow, cushion-lined tray sits beside a small paper sign, and behind the table is a short, unoccupied stool.

Sections of split-rail fence create an enclosure with openings that lead to the very heart of the town.  Set back from the fences is a square wooden table draped with a checkered cloth.  Atop the table, a shallow, cushion-lined tray sits, and behind the table is a short stool occupied by a young woman.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Set back and away from the hustle and bustle of the town's center, this fence-edged area is a grassy sanctuary away from the dirt and mud of the streets.  A tall beribboned maypole is silvered by moonlight, as many of the ribbons encircling it are made of bright satins.  Just slightly behind the maypole sit the judges, who yawn behind raised hands as they wait for the next person brave enough to venture the climb.  On the opposite side of the pole is a scoreboard.

A tall beribboned maypole shimmers slightly in the sunlight, as many of the ribbons encircling it are made of bright satins.  Just slightly behind the maypole sit the judges, who chat idly as they wait for the next person brave enough to venture the climb.  On the opposite side of the pole is a scoreboard.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Dunstan's Farm Depot]
description: An old blue blanket has been thrown across several bales of hay, serving as a make-shift table.  To the left, a broken milking stool has been placed in front of several overturned milk urns.  The aroma of fertilizer and loam drifts into the barn from the yard outside.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Dunstan's Farm Depot, Yard]
description: Big cross-braced doors lead into the red barn, though one of the doors hangs slightly crooked.  A dilapidated stone well sits near the white-washed fence that borders the property.  On the opposite side, a rusted-out plow overgrown with weeds and wildflowers has been partially covered by a dirty black tarpaulin.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: The sweet scent of honeyed berries and floral fruits wafts through the air, the aroma seeming to originate from a small, modest store tucked between two larger buildings.  The store's roof is thatched, and a sooty brick chimney rises from the center.  Planters of bright morning glories and hyacinth sit at the ends of each of the steps that lead up to a narrow porch enclosed by decorative railings.  A scalloped banner hangs from one of the railings, its decoration simple, but colorful.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: This side of the gate opens up into a large expanse of meadow, with tall green grasses and a dappling of vibrant wildflowers.  A scent that is green and fresh lingers in the air, touched by the faintest hint of the surrounding flowers.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Flowers]
description: Although somewhat dusty, the shop is otherwise tidily kept, its interior lit with simple lanterns that hang from several beams in the ceiling.  A single wide row of wooden racks stretches across the center of the floor, its upright fixtures holding up baskets filled with various flowers.  On the far wall, just behind a long counter, a sliding panel is affixed in the open position.  Windows placed high up on the walls allow a glimpse of the starlit sky outside.

Although somewhat dusty, the shop is otherwise tidily kept. On the far wall, just behind a long counter, a sliding panel is affixed in the open position, allowing a view of the field of flora sprouting into bloom outside.  Windows placed high up on the walls allow sunlight to stream into the shop to bathe the wares in a pale golden glow.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Flowers, Fields]
description: A small section of dirt backs up to a pale green structure, its area taken up by a large wheelbarrel, several shovels, and a short bench.  Stretching out beyond it, a large patch of dark fields rolls out toward the horizon.  The pale starlight that shines down from the blanket of a night sky fails to illuminate what lies in the fields, but the strong fragrance of flowers filling the air hints at the growth that most certainly resides there.

A small section of dirt backs up to a pale green structure, its area taken up by a large wheelbarrel, several shovels, and a short bench.  Stretching out beyond it, a field filled with flowers rolls out toward the horizon.  The verdancy appears to be cared for, given its distinct lack of weeds and generally trim edges, yet the plethora of flora springs up willy-nilly and without any true organization or cultivation.  The result is a mishmash of brilliant color encased in wild-looking growth.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: From a nearby building, smoke puffs out of a stonework chimney at regular intervals, and the scent of roasted meat is strong in the air.  A pair of chairs made from oak and woven willow branches sits on the building's porch, and a small stall has been erected in front, covered by a simple oilcloth roof.  Though the road continues northwardly, a small meandering trail leads off to the southeast.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [A Small Garden]
description: The short and stocky building housing the local smithy rises up from this verdant garden.  Lamp light shines from the windows of the building.  Slightly off the path resides a large wrought iron sign with ivy growing around its legs.  Small, spherical bushes line the cobbled walkway leading to the entrance of the building.

The short and stocky building housing the local smithy rises up from this verdant garden.  A red brick chimney puffs clouds of thick, black smoke.  Slightly off the path resides a large wrought iron sign with ivy growing around its legs.  Small, spherical bushes line the cobbled walkway leading to the entrance of the building.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Immuron Ironworks, Sales]
description: Numerous tables positioned around the room show a display of the Ironworks' finest wares.  The center of the room is dominated by a large glass-topped counter which houses a number of wooden blocks.  Thick red carpets cover the polished stone floor of the main room.  The sound of hammers impacting on metal echoes from the nearby forging area.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: A broken-down wagon blocks half of the roadway as it sits catawampus near the fence.  One of its back wheels has been removed and is lying beside it, several of the spokes splintered and broken.  Many of the baskets in the wagon have shifted to one side, the fruit and vegetables within barely covered by a square of burlap.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Widdley's Handcrafts]
description: A large green and blue cotton banner hangs from the beamed ceiling overhead.  Rich blue carpeting covers the stone floor of the shop, and a number of chairs are grouped in a circle at one edge of the area.  Tanik-framed paintings hang on the walls between the rectangular windows.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Set slightly off the main road leading through town, this rounded cul-de-sac has just enough room for a wagon to enter and turn around to exit.  A small house with a thatched roof and wood-framed windows is nestled at the rear, and a small hitching post is planted near its door.  Both of the front windows are open to the air, the ruffled hems of their white curtains visible.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Near the steps of a tin-roofed building is a small hitching post and just on the other side is a trough of murky water.  Between the supports that rise to the roof on the building's porch is a hand-painted banner that simply proclaims, "Welcome!"
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Hragon's Colorant, Foyer]
description: The wooden walls of the foyer are stained with an array of bright colors that reflect the light provided by the steel sconces set into them, affording more than adequate lighting.  Strategically positioned to ensure you cannot miss seeing them are several display cases that show various pieces of Hragon's extraordinary work.  Two multicolored carpets extend towards opposite directions, leading you to other areas of the shop, while a bright yellow door allows you back out to the street.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Fences line the sides of this pathway, their presence moderately unobtrusive in the setting of dark green grasses, wildflowers, and sprawling fields beyond.  Though it is obvious this path is frequently used, it has not suffered great abuse, and the trails of wagon wheels are bordered and separated by swathes of lush grass.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A wild rose vine has staked its claim on a portion of the fence here, trailing down and around the wood, brightening the lackluster rails with flowers of deep crimson.  The fragrance of the blossoms fills the air, sweet and heady, with the slightest hint of spice
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: The fence splits here, opening the path up into a massive field that stretches out to the horizon.  Its length is lined with row after row of green plants, except for a small section in the middle, in which stand several small tents and booths.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Clusters of large green leaves, somewhat triangular in shape, cover the fields to the southwest.  In the other direction, colorful meadowland stands before a loose arrangement of far-off buildings.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Wildflowers and dandelions grow up on one side of the dusty road, creating a canvas of color that complements the green and pale crimson rhubarb fields on the other side of the road.  The dirt on the road is soft and slightly mushy, almost muddy, and various footprints clearly mark the ground.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Residing in the middle of the dirt road, a massive mud hole prevents easy passage through the area, though small patches of grass along one edge of the road allow for a dry method of navigating the slick, dirty mess.  The mud pools just slightly into the rhubarb fields, but it seems to dry up just a few paces in.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A long, wooden fence lines the road going north to south, creating a defined border between the road and the nearby land, which grows wildly.  On this side of the fence, the fields are swamped with rhubarb, though the underlying rows speak to the systematic cultivation of the plants.  One of the fence railings is lower than the rest.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Lining the road like a king presiding over his land, the fence separating the road from the western lands is well-kept.  A sheen of bright white paint covers the posts and rails, and the construction seems to be fairly new.  Even the grass beneath it is trimmed back.  The rhubarb on the other side of the road, however, is teeming with wild growth.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Opposite the rough wooden fence that separates the neighboring land from the dirt road, the rhubarb fields are filled with spring growth.  The pale crimson stalks are glossy, almost lustrous, in the moonlight, and the large, lush leaves are green with life.  A narrow path between two of the rows of rhubarb leads further into the field.

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: At the edge of the road, a rough wooden fence separates the land to the west from the road itself and the rhubarb fields to the east. Several paint brushes lie on the ground next to one of the posts, their brushes plastered over with dried white paint.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Neat rows of flowering rhubarb plants line the nearby field.
