location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Clustered together near one side of the wide dirt road is a pile of rocks built into a precarious tower that threatens to topple over at any moment.  Leading up to the pile is a scattered trail of rocks that crosses the road and disappears into the field of rhubarb.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Loose pebbles and rocks litter the dirt road, which is bordered by small stands of dandelions and wildflowers.  To one side, the fields are cultivated with rows upon rows of rhubarb.  The rhubarb stalks, barely visible below the wide leaves, show off a pale crimson hue.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: As the road takes a turn northward, this curve is left without the clutter of buildings, and the view into the pasture beyond the split-rail fence bordering the town is left unobstructed.  On the other side of the fence, a herd of cows mill about idly, some munching on bits of grass, while others have settled on the ground beneath one of the few trees that dot the landscape.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Rickety Shed, Cramped Space]
description: The inside of the shed is quite cramped with little room to move around.  A scuffed-up coat rack has been pushed into the back of the shed, while a large monir chest lies in the middle of the floor filled with various wares.  Along the western wall, a series of iron hooks have been affixed to the wall.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Green grass and tiny flowers in a myriad of hues line the well-worn path that leads away from town proper.  Ruts from wagon wheels bite deeply into the ground, and the grass between the trenches has turned brown from the abuse.  A wide-brimmed straw hat hangs from one of the fence posts bordering the path, a dusty blue ribbon tied into bow adorning it.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A grape vine grows here, supported by a thin lattice of unfinished wood.  Large, golden-hued grapes are plump on the vine, and standing close to them reveals a scent so luscious and sweet that it is almost overwhelming.  The vines are heavy enough that they droop near the ground, and the taller stalks of grass get lost among the wide leaves.  Nearly hidden by a cascade of leaves, a gilt-toned statue stands at the end of the lattice.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: The grass has been worn thin in a small strip that leads up to the doors of a structure that could only be a distillery.  With every breeze that stirs the air, the scent of hops, too-sweet grapes, and malt drift through this part of the meadow.  A broken wagon wheel leans against the side of the building, ruined and abandoned for so long that a jasmine vine has begun to grow along the spokes.  Nearby is a sign made of aged barrel planks, and off a ways in the meadow is a crosseyed black cow.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Broken Wheel Distillery]
description: Dark oak walls enclose this front room, the knots in the wood barely visible beneath the rich coloring of the varnish.  Overhead, banded oak barrels line racks that are well supported by thick beams, and another single barrel rests beside a set of double doors.  Burnished brass handles adorn the doors, and the corners of the nearby counter are capped in the same material.  Propped on top of the barrel is an embossed parchment sign.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A mesh of hemp twine strung between a series of stout posts supports a vibrant green vine bearing clusters of dark red grapes.  Though small, the grapes are plentiful and plump, ripe for the picking.  Beneath the canopy of leaves, a silvered statue is set on a stone base.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Spring Chicken]
description: The walls of the tent are covered in feathers, all of various origin and color, and the strong smell of tar permeates the area.  Dozens of wire birdcages have been suspended from large rusty fishhooks that hang from the tent's apex.  A long wooden counter juts into the center of the room, and an overturned crate rests near the tent's flap.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: The sounds of town beyond the gate are faint here, replaced instead by the whispering of occasional breezes through the meadow.  Wild roses, buttercups, and hyacinth grow freely here, along the gate posts, near the fence's edge, and intermittently throughout this stretch of grass-blanketed land.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: A fence borders the road that stretches from the meadow and deeper into town, separating the hard-packed dirt rutted with wagon trails from the verdant fields that lie beyond.  With little regard for the wildflowers or the picturesque quality of the landscape, a roan cow plucks clump after clump of grass from the ground, chewing with a slow, purposeful disregard.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A path has been created by those passing to and fro, through the tall grasses and wildflowers, to a heavy-limbed pear tree sitting in the distance.  Beneath the tree's limbs, a few fireflies dart through the air, leaving bright trails before they disappear again into the leaves.  Flattened and broken around the base of the trunk, the grass is a cushioned seat which is silvered by the moonlight that strikes the backs of the green blades.

A path has been created by those passing to and fro, through the tall grasses and wildflowers, to a heavy-limbed pear tree sitting in the distance.  Beneath the tree's limbs, a small area of shade is created, offering shelter from the bright sun above.  Flattened and broken around the base of the trunk, the grass is a cushioned seat, which has been recently utilized if the open book left behind is any indication.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Smarten Up, Entry]
description: The cheerful interior of the wagon features bright yellow walls painted with vividly clashing violet wildflowers.  Strung from wooden beams, garlands of fresh and dried spring flowers give the wagon a sweet floral scent.  A rickety oak table has been erected in the middle of the room, with a small sign propped up against it.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Smarten Up, Workshop]
description: Small and messy, the floor of the room is littered with an array of colored cotton threads and pointed silver needles.  Numerous overstuffed beanbags are placed around the room, each one covered with floral-patterned fabric.  A large oak table dominates the center of the room, and shows signs of years of use.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Wildflowers dot the vibrant green of this open meadow, and fireflies and starflies dance together just above the faces of the blossoms.  The grass is tall enough here that it almost reaches knee-height, and it whispers as night breezes brush through the blades.

Wildflowers dot the vibrant green of this open meadow, and butterflies of all hues flutter through the air, occasionally alighting upon one blossom or another.  The grass is tall enough here that it almost reaches knee-height, and it whispers faintly as breezes periodically brush through.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Pretty-Up With Paint]
description: Taking up most of the room in the booth, a white linen-covered table is arranged with a palette of paints and several different brushes.  Several different patterns are painted around the walls of the booth, ranging from a vibrant green vine to a red bird depiction.  The open-air construction of the booth allows the sweet fragrance of strawberries to drift inside.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: The meadow stretches out in all directions, left wild and green, brushed with streaks of color in the form of flowers that have taken root here and there.  So far from the town, the buildings are little more than distant shapes, unrecognizable and faint.  Amid this field of nature's creation, there is but a single man-made object, but it has been crafted in such a way as to blend with the surroundings, rather than detract from them.  Set among the blossoms and the tall grasses is a painted wooden statue.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Purposefully arranged maize walls rise in the meadow beyond a tall willow branch arch, but not much else can be clearly discerned of them from here.  A sign on a stout post sits beside the arch, marked with heavy-handed writing.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Brightly colored streamers of thin paper are draped from one row of corn to the next in front of the maize archway.  A thick layer of dried corn husks underfoot provides a pale yellow path directly to the entrance of the maze.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Streamers of brightly colored paper hang from the top of the festive archway to stalks of corn forming the boundaries of the maze.  The pale green corn stalks line the pathway leading into the maze.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: A few stray streamers of brightly hued paper peek out from beneath the layer of bleached corn husks on the ground of the maze.  A vast field of corn is visible in the gaps between stalks in this row of maize.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Small lengths of twine and a few nails are scattered on the ground next to the newly constructed ramp.  Pale green corn stalks line the path leading towards the ramp.  A single streamer of blue paper is wrapped around the base of a corn stalk.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Small bits of twine and scrap lumber rest in a pile next to the maize ramp.  A small portion of one row of corn, scythed to the ground, accommodates the hastily constructed ramp.  The green of fresh corn stalks continue on in vast rows.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Glimpses of Grawood are visible between the stalks of corn along the edge of the field.  Bleached yellow corn husks cover the ground between the live stalks.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Two rows of corn stalks run together at this point of the maze, forming a verdant intersection.  Between two stalks of corn, a three-tined modwir pitchfork is driven into the ground, its tip pointing towards the sky.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: The pale yellow and green corridor of corn stalks takes a turn to the southwest, as it nears the edge of the field.  Numerous dried corn husks cover the dirt underfoot.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Numerous rows of corn stretch onwards, forming a pathway to the north.  Dried corn husks litter the fertile dirt underfoot.  The neck of a dark green glass bottle pokes out from between two stalks of corn.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: A small oak-hafted steel sickle gleams wickedly from its position discarded on the ground in the vermillion corn husks beside a pyramid of stacked crates and a wooden ladder.  It is obviously a well cared for farm implement, but someone seems to have left it lying here for someone to possibly injure themselves on.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: The thick carpeting of corn husks crunch softly underfoot as you make your way through the winding maze.  Flowers have been strewn across the field, littering the ground with patches of color.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Some of the leaves of a nearby sheaf of corn have been peeled back and tiny yellow and white kernels peek through the obscuring strands of corn silk.  Someone has come through and helped themselves to a few of the cobs of corn as is evidenced by the discards lying on the ground along the path.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: The cornfields stretch out in several directions with no discernible end in sight.  The ground has been trampled heavily so that it provides absolutely no clues as to which direction would be the best to travel in.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: The slender rows of heavily burdened cornstalks begin to give way to huge bales of hay that have dried out in the noonday sun.  Garlands of flowers have been festooned across the sides of the hay bales, giving them a more festive appearance.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: A slender hay rake leans precariously against some tall haystacks that lead somewhere deep inside the maze.  Or they could lead right back to the beginning, it is hard to get one's bearings in a place like this.  The only thing that is certain is that there is a lot of corn and hay as far as one can see.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: This section of the maze is absolutely crowded.  The walls of corn are planted so closely together that they are actually blocking out some of the light and it is darker here than it is in the rest of the maze.  Any attempts to move forward will have to be made very carefully to avoid damaging the cornstalks.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Someone has tied a blue cornflower-embroidered cotton handkerchief to one of the cornstalks here.  It is uncertain whether or not the person in question will ever find this particular place in the maze again to get their handkerchief back, but it is said that cheaters never prosper.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: All about you fresh ears of corn lie nestled within blankets of yellow silk sheathed in smooth, green, leafy husks.  The bountiful richness and generosity of nature is evident in every direction one could care to look.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Several newly woven straw hats with colorful ribbons tied around them rest beside a small bundle of yellow straw by the side of the path.  It would seem that someone either started a project and forgot about it or abandoned it altogether as there is a half made hat lying neglected in the straw.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Tall bales of hay secured by ropes made of sturdy hemp stand clustered thickly together, preventing you from seeing what lies beyond them quite effectively.  The smell of dried grass is almost overpowering.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Fluttering streamers of brightly colored blue and white paper are wrapped around the stalks of corn here in fanciful spiral designs that only wrap around the stalk up to waist height.  Apparently, someone has also actually taken the time out of their day to braid the yellow silk tufting from the ears of corn.  The braiding also stops at around waist height.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Prickly bits of dried grass poke under any loose clothing and lightly scrape over exposed flesh as you maneuver down the narrow corridor the tightly packed hay bales provide here.  The massive bales of hay lean precariously inward and sway slightly as if they are going to topple downwards onto your head.  Thankfully, they are securely lashed into places by ropes made of sturdy hemp.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: The tall corn seems to whisper softly as the stalks rustle against one another in the breeze.  The hushed sounds this stilted shuffling produces overhead and off to the sides seems almost seem sinister in origin until they are held up in comparison to the music and laughter coming from the nearby town.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Cheerfully bright flowers have been stuck into the hay bales at odd intervals to bring color to the maze.  They do nothing much to provide landmarks to go by, but the occasional flash of blue or yellow could be enough to lift one's spirits if they were trapped in the winding corridors of hay and corn long enough.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: The variety of fragrant grasses in the hay leaves an almost perfumed smell in the air.  The sun-bleached bales of hay are too densely packed to climb on top of, though it is apparent from some damage to one of them that someone has tried.  It is even possible to see where they landed on the soft corn husk strewn ground.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Large stacks of hay dominate the landscape as far as the eye can see.  Well, save for where it is possible to see stalks of corn.  The grayish-yellow hay is bound tightly together in thick, heavy bales and smells of a variety of sweet grasses that have slowly baked in the sun.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: There are small ears of corn and large ears of corn here.  There is corn with red silk spilling out of it, and corn with yellow silk coming out.  There is even old corn with withered brown silk.  One thing that remains fairly constant, however, is that fact that the rows of corn remain too dense to see through and too tall to see over.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: The smell of the soil here is heady and rich and the ground is slightly damp.  Rows of corn are arranged in a neat and orderly fashion, lined up like soldiers standing shoulder to shoulder on a battlefield.  Their sashes of yellow silk hang limply from their husks, damp and lifeless.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Towering stalks of corn wrapped in thick green leaves sway overhead in the slight breeze.  Thin yellow ribbons fly from the tops of a few of  the stalks, waving like proud banners.  The wind gusts gently, pulling at the yellow silken threads attached to the corn husks.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Here and there the thick green leaves are pulled away from the golden corn hiding inside.  Insects circle around the pale yellow treasure, buzzing quietly as they alight and then drift away on the warm, gentle breeze.  Broken corn husks sway in the wind, dangling limply from the places where they are still barely attached, and a small break in the maize wall leads to a field beyond.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A gold and dark blue ribbon has been tied around the corner post of the fence, and a cluster of small, pink tea roses has been fixed at the knot's center.  At the base of the post, full sunflowers have been laid, intermingled with a varicolored assortment of rose cuttings.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Tiny, white flowers with delicate, rounded petals punctuate the clusters of dark leaves on the strawberry plants which line the rows of the field.  A few have fallen away from the plants and tumble across the ground if caught by the wind.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Fireflies dart here and there beneath the branches of a well-pruned apple tree, and the a tawny tan and white cow standing beneath the limbs seems not to notice.  Darkness obscures the animal's face, but it snorts from time to time, like an old man that dreams during sleep.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A wooden gate frozen open on rusted hinges allows passage from the meadow path to the field.  Underfoot, the grass is a soft cushion to each step, and brightly hued dandelions dot the green here and there.  Looking off into the distance, the blocky and peaked forms of booths and tents rise against the sky.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Leading to a field with plowed rows of dark soil topped by low-growing plants of deep green, the path opens up, and the fences splay in opposite directions to enclose the space.  Looking out over the land, an odd form rises here and there, the silhouettes of booths and stalls.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A lone cow grazes on the opposite side of the fence that borders the path, snatching up clumps of verdant grass and chewing with a deliberant slowness.  Its tail swishes back and forth occasionally, batting at flies, while its mouth continues to placidly chew, chew, chew.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Wide rows lined with leafy green plants stretch out to the horizon, the soil of each dark and fresh, as if recently tended.  Tiny, white flowers accent the green of the plants, and from beneath the saw-edged leaves, ripe strawberries can be glimpsed.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Like verdant canopies, dark-leafed strawberry plants line the rows carved into the field by plow and hand.  The soil is remarkably free of weeds, and the small paths in between the rows show signs of travel.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: A crosswoven basket sits at the end of one of the rows, empty and abandoned, with a pair of stained gloves draped over the handle.  Nearby, a small spade has been left lying between two plants, as if someone had begun to harvest, but was interrupted.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The branches of a pear tree droop low as they hang over the fence, laden with large, ripe fruit.  A certain sweetness lingers in the air, and a dusting of small, white blossoms litter the ground beneath the tree.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: This small segment of the field has been left empty, the dirt untouched and spotted with patches of grass.  From nearby, voices can be heard, and the canopies and banners of booths and tents fan out to occupy the remainder of the field's heart.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: In this small patch of open field, most of the earth has been tilled except for a small section, a grassy path that leads over to a large dunking booth.  A banner is held aloft over the path and reads, "Afraid to get wet?!  Come take your turn in the booth!"
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Dunk-For-All]
description: Centered in the area, a bright blue dunking booth is surrounded by a collection of tables heaped with stacks of stitched hide balls.  The majority of the booth is made up of a massive tank filled with murky water.  High above the water is a bucket, which can only be reached by way of a slick wet ladder, and positioned to the side of that is a red-painted target.  Several petite women mill about the area, obviously keeping watch over the game and a small ticket collection barrel with a large sign leaning up against it.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The sounds of voices and laughter drift on the air, easily carrying across the mostly open field.  From somewhere nearby, an angry buzzing can be heard, like a score of hornets trapped in a closed jar.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Settled among the various small tents and stalls scattered around this part of the field is a large glass dome atop a round pedestal flanked by a board-topped wine barrel.  The dome is shaded by a canopy painted a misty, midnight blue, speckled with sparks of white paint.  A placard sits between the pedestal and barrel on a short, three-legged stool.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A small wheelbarrow has been left near a tall round haystack, a pitchfork laying prongs-down inside.  Beside the haystack is a paper sign pasted onto a board that is supported by a heavy post in the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A dark brown cow can be seen in the pasture beyond the fence enclosing the field, hovering near a calf that stands wobbly at her side.  Closer still is a russet-hued cow that occasionally sticks its head through the rails of the fence to dine on the lush grass at the field's edge.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Tiny orange ladybugs have congregated on a nearby fence post and along one of the rails, with the occasional bug flitting off and out of sight.  A few have abandoned their high perch to sit on the leaves of the strawberry plants lining the rows of the field.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The sweet scent of citrus tinges the air here, emanating from a leafy green tangerine tree.  Fruit hangs among the dark green leaves, bright temptations that seem of less interest to the buzzing bees than the tree's blossoms.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Widdley's Handcrafts, Woodworks]
description: Sawdust and wood shavings cover the floor of this woodworking studio.  Projects in various stages of completion cover most of the available surfaces.  A two-legged chair sits upside down on top of a modwir table on one side of the room.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Widdley's Handcrafts, Metal]
description: Small piles of metal shavings have been swept into one corner of the room.  A jeweler's bench rests against one wall of the room below a pair of glass-paned lanterns.  A miniature forge rests on the flat stone floor next to a rack of hammers.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Immuron Ironworks, Forge]
description: The center of activity in this bustling area is the large forge against one wall of the room.  Anvils are placed around the room, each supported by a base of solid modwir.  Apprentices and journeymen work the forge with practiced skill.  A rack of aprons hangs next to the door.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Hragon's Colorant, Mixing Room]
description: Sturdy shelves line the walls from floor to ceiling of this cramped space, covered with tinctures, books, and various jars holding different colored powders and ingredients.  Several tables bearing silver cauldrons filled with assorted colors are clustered together in the center of the room.  The wooden floor is surprisingly clean and creaks slightly under your footsteps.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Hragon's Colorant, Exchange]
description: Several attendants tend to various customers throughout this bustling room, answering question after question and fulfilling orders.  A long wooden shelf is attached to the far wall with neatly organized flasks sitting atop it.  A small glass case is located along the west wall, a variety of vials proudly displayed within.  Along the east wall sits a large table, all manner of dyes resting upon it.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Pitchfork Pub, Dining]
description: Glass-paned lanterns hang from iron hooks along the wall.  A long hand-carved sideboard rests near a group of large tables.  Rows of haon plank benches rest in front of every table, their wooden structures supported by iron-banded barrels.  A thin dusting of bleached yellow straw covers the hard-packed earthen floor of the tavern.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Several small buildings populate this area, and an ironwork fence stretches from the far end of the row to the other, creating one large front yard for the buildings.  Each has a path that leads from the door to a corresponding gate in the fence, and the area enclosed has been cultivated into a garden of raised planters full of snapdragons, tall stalks of foxglove, as well as other colorful blooms, while small, white flowers on low-growing creepers serve as ground cover.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: A blocky building walled with squared stones and roofed with drab grey-green tin sits off to the side of the road, interrupting the fence that creates a perimeter for the town.  The split-rail barrier picks up on the other side of the building and travels on, though several lengths of heavy chain are draped across the upper rail nearest the stone wall.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Storefronts and houses line the street's edge, their porches and railings decorated with flowered wreaths and colorful ribbons.  Banners hang in sweeping scallops from a roof's edge here and there, and multihued lanterns hang from tall wooden posts, casting a spray of colored light across the ground as small candles flicker within.

Storefronts and houses line the street's edge, their porches and railings decorated with flowered wreaths and colorful ribbons.  Banners hang in sweeping scallops from a roof's edge here and there, and multihued lanterns hang from tall wooden posts, unlit.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Country Cottage, Kitchen]
description: The smell of baked goods and cinnamon pervades this small room.  Honey-hued wood-paneled walls with several red-curtained windows rise from the black and white tiled floor.  A large oak table sits in the middle of the room, while a wood stove burns in the corner.  Various baked goods, a clear glass candy jar and a spacious wicker basket rest on an antique white counter.  A whitewashed wooden door leads back outside, while a wicker door leads deeper into the cottage.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Country Cottage, Parlor]
description: Dark wood paneling on the walls creates an atmosphere of opulence even amidst the modest furnishings of this room.  A threadbare woolen rug lies beneath an overstuffed red velvet divan and its low black table counterpart.  Tall bookshelves line the inside wall and a tri-fold wicker door stands between them.  A sewing basket rests on the table beside a pale ceramic soap dish.  Near the back of the room, an iron-banded oak trunk holds a variety of baskets and cases.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Tucked against the fence at the road's edge is a whitewashed building, framed on each side by taller structures.  On the opposite side of the road, a small area has been fenced in to enclose a single russet-hued cow.  The animal is tethered to one of the fence posts, and it wears a pink-checkered bonnet with a bow tied around its neck, a feat that no doubt it did not accomplish alone.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Bread Basket, Bakery]
description: The scent of warm, freshly baked bread envelops you as you enter the tidy shop.  The stifling heat from the oven is subdued by a gentle spring breeze that wafts through an open door leading out into a tiny herb garden.  Piping hot baked goods are neatly arrayed on some oak shelves around the room, and there is a cloth-covered table sitting in the corner.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Bread Basket, Herb Garden]
description: The breeze stirring the night air is cool and carries the scent of fragrant kitchen herbs.  Pools of silver moonlight thread through the branches of the trees, and the filtered light makes patterns on the soft green grass.  A large gray rock is positioned by an oak door leading into the bakery.

Delicate floral notes are carried on the cool breeze.  Billowy white tufts of dandelion weeds occasionally drift in the air around you.  An abundance of herbs and flowers are planted here, making the garden colorful and fragrant.  There is an inviting patch of soft green grass by the door to the shop.  A large gray rock with a bowl-like indentation on top sits in a patch of warm sunlight.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Square wooden planters filled to overflowing with pansies in a variety of colors stand beside a set of thick modwir steps leading to the general store.  A pair of rocking chairs sit on the store's porch, while garlands of greenery and flowers are draped from the edge of the roof.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [General Store, Porch]
description: Warped and faded to grey, the raised decking is uneven and rickety.  A sagging awning shields the storefront from foul weather, though several patches attest to past inadequacies.  At the back of the porch, the store wall is set with a single door bracketed by two large windows.  Neatly lettered signs cover much of the wall's surface, often masking holes or gaps in the boards.  A wooden swing, suspended by iron chains, hangs at one end of the porch, while a cluster of rocking chairs sits at the opposite end.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [General Store]
description: Wooden shelves droop beneath the weight of assorted goods all arranged in tidy rows.  In the center of the shop, a glass showcase holds a small selection of flatware, while the remainder of the merchandise is displayed on counters, on barrels, in crates, and miscellaneous other containers.  A tall ladder is available for reaching the upper shelving.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Passing through this section of town finds the air saturated with scents both sweet and savory.  A bright yellow building seems to be at least partially the source, as light from within the building offers a view of dining patrons.

Passing through this section of town finds the air saturated with scents both sweet and savory.  A bright yellow building seems to be at least partially the source, as people can be seen coming and going from its front door, releasing flavorful aromas each time they pass.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Nanetta's Cafe, Dining Room]
description: The sound of crickets and late night revelers drift occasionally through an open window.  Yellow checked curtains rustle lightly with each passing of the cool evening breeze.  Cozy scrollworked iron tables are tucked against the walls, leaving a clear pathway to the cashier's counter.  A menu board, handwritten in delicate script, presents the daily specials.  The sweet aroma of freshly baked pies drifts through an open doorway near the back.

Yellow checked cafe curtains flutter across an open window with every passing breeze.  Cozy scrollworked iron tables are tucked against the walls, leaving a clear pathway to the cashier's counter.  A menu board, handwritten in delicate script, presents the daily specials.  The busy clattering of dishes can be heard through an open doorway near the back, accompanied by the humming of a jaunty tune.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Nanetta's Cafe, Pastry Kitchen ]
description: Wide wooden countertops, freshly scrubbed after a long day's baking, await the bustle of work that will accompany sunrise.  An open cookbook has fallen to the floor.  A large window with an extra wide sill fills the back wall.  Fragrant evening breezes occasionally send yellow checkered curtains grazing the tops of pies left overnight to cool.  A punched tin pie cupboard set near the open doorway is stocked with desserts favored by locals and visitors alike.

Cluttered wooden countertops are dusted with flour and several rounded balls of dough rest upon each, ready to be rolled into the pastry chef's next sumptuous creation.  An open cookbook has fallen to the floor.  A large window with an extra wide sill fills the back wall, with yellow checkered curtains occasionally grazing the tops of pies set there to cool.  A punched-tin pie cupboard set near the open doorway is stocked with desserts favored by locals and visitors alike.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A wide path splits off from the town's main road, leading toward the field in the distance.  Though the sounds of daily life can still be heard, they are muted, allowing one to feel surrounded by the wildflower-strewn meadow that sweeps out behind the fences running parallel to the path on each side.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: The moons above shed pale light on the path, and a slight breeze stirs the air from time to time, making a cool spring evening even cooler.  From their hiding places in the thick grass, tiny flowers shiver with each breath of wind.

The sun in the sky overhead is bright and makes the air warm, with a slight breeze keeping it from being uncomfortably so.  Flowering weeds flourish at the path's edge, tiny blossoms of violet, white, and pink peeking from amid the thick, green grass.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: The end of the dirt pathway disappears beneath a blanket of grass growing within an opening in the fence, which allows passage to the field on the other side.  A large basket brimming with pulled weeds rests near the break in the fence, and a checkered handkerchief has been hung on one of the rails as if to dry.  Near the field's center, the peaks of tents can be seen.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A break in the fence allows passage from this corner of the field back to town proper.  The lack of grass and the presence of deep ruts in the dirt indicate this as a frequently used route for both people and wagons.  Underfoot, the ground is soft and freshly turned, as indicated by the scent of plowed earth still lingering in the air and the rows that stretch out as far as the eye can see, dotted here and there with green sprouts just breaking ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Settled among the booths, tents, and stalls in this area of the field and under the protection of a square oilcloth umbrella sits a small cloth-draped table.  A sign made of parchment dangles from the edge of the umbrella.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [In The Weave]
description: A slanted oilcloth awning provides a minimium of shelter to this wide booth, which is left open on three sides.  Along the raised counter, there sits a small water-filled vase and a woven straw basket.  Between them is a small, hand-painted wooden sign.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The rows of the field arrest abruptly at the edge of this small patch of dirt, the soil here left untouched and unturned.  Sprigs of grass and weeds stand out here and there against the dark hue of the earth, their colors vibrant like those of the surrounding tents and booths.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Beyond the enclosing fence, the land spreads out even and clean toward the horizon.  Little interrupts the green, though barren, landscape aside from the occasional tree, boulder, or semblance of a hill rising far in the distance.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Beneath the bottom rail of the fence bordering the field sits an old wooden bucket, with a long-handled ladle abandoned within.  Blades of tall grass have invaded the container, shooting up through cracks in the wood like spindly fingers.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The narrow pathway of grass that traverses the edge of the field is bright and lush, growing up in tufts at the base of the fence posts.  Dandelions, with their bright yellow faces, peek up out of the green carpet, interrupting the continuity of color.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Nestled in the corner created by the fence at the edge of the field is a leafy green tangerine tree, laden with fruit.  Beneath it, tiny purple flowers have sprung up, their delicate petals shivering with each passing breeze.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The rows of planted field stretch out, their even lines seeming to draw together to a point against the distant horizon.  Small stalks unfurling tender leaves peek here and there from the dark soil, as if reaching toward the sky.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Several open air tents and booths stand on this fallow piece of ground, the untended soil rife with flowering weeds and sparse patches of grass.  Overhead, banners of cotton with blocky letters proclaiming games and wares flutter here and there from support poles.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Near the fence on a pole that rises barely eye-height to the average human is a figure fashioned of dried wheat.  Its simplistic design suggests a feminine intent, and at the ground at the base of the pole is a wooden bowl brimming with a variety of ripe fruits.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The untilled soil here at the center of the field is of a lighter hue than that of the rows, having been longer exposed to the air and elements.  It creates a dusty floor for a scattering of tents and booths and manages to grow little more than ragged tufts of grass.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: A wagon has been left here, out of the way and off of the main road through town.  It doesn't appear to be disabled and is tied to a hitching post.  Great heaps of straw fill the wagon, stalks sticking out from beneath a plaid blanket spread across them to keep the wind from carrying them away.  Some of the straw, however, has fallen from the open gate on the back of the wagon to pile on the ground.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: A tendril of dark-vined jasmine has taken root at the base of one of the nearby fence posts and wound its way upward, twisting and knotting itself along the rails.  The vivid yellow flowers that populate the plant release a thickly sweet scent into the air that overpowers everything else nearby.  Even the wildflowers that grow in the expansive meadow beyond the fence offer no competition.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: Though grass grows tall along the path's edge, reaching nearly to the bottom rail of the fence, it is absent along the middle of the trail.  Instead, there is a mash of muck, mud, and straw mixed in a sloppy mess.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Meadow]
description: The trail leading into the field ahead is so soft that passing wagons have created narrow furrows filled with murky water.  Footprints can be seen in the dirt off to either side of the miniature lakes, created by people trying to avoid wet and dirty footwear.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Stretching across the length of several large fields, tall green artichoke plants fill the eye with their voluminous growth.  At this corner of the field, the harvest of the plant has already started, as evidenced by the short, headless lengths of stem attached to the main stalks.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A wide dusty path makes its way along the edge of a field full of artichoke plants, and a smaller, narrow trail leads off from the main path into the field itself.  Emitting the light aroma common to most vegetation in spring air, the artichokes appear dull under the pale moonlight.  To the southwest, across a meadow embraced by shadows, the glow from several buildings lights up the otherwise dark sky.

A wide dusty path makes its way along the edge of a field full of artichoke plants, and a smaller, narrow trail leads off from the main path into the field itself.  Emitting the light aroma common to most vegetation in spring air, the artichokes nearly gleam with their green color in the bright sunlight.  To the southwest, across a meadow, several buildings are just barely visible.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Along the edges of the outer fields, the artichoke plants have already been harvested, their missing heads anything but inconspicuous.  The center fields lay fallow, recently so judging by the soil that seems to have been recently smoothed down.  As if to draw attention to the location of the rather humble enterprise of a wooden tub that takes up but a small area of this empty field, a large red kite, which is attached to a white-painted sign stuck into the ground, flies overhead in the moonlit sky.

Along the edges of the outer fields, the artichoke plants have already been harvested, their missing heads anything but inconspicuous.  The center fields lay fallow, recently so judging by the soil that seems to have been recently smoothed down.  As if to draw attention to the location of the rather humble enterprise of a wooden tub that takes up but a small area of this empty field, a large red kite, which is attached to a white-painted sign stuck into the ground, flies overhead in the sunlit sky.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Off to the west, meadow-like areas stretch toward the horizon, their colorful hues a stark contrast to the fields full of green artichokes that sprout up in the opposite direction.  The dusty path in front of you weaves its way through the vegetables, which grow up in long stalks.  Cut to leave some of the stems intact, the heads have been sliced off of the artichoke stalks.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: As if housing a massive floral endeavor, the broad field of green to one side is filled with gigantic buds.  The artichokes are not quite ready to burst into maturity, but the petals that wrap up around the heart seem to be slightly loose, indicating the impending bloom of the plant.  Opposite the field, a bunch of wildflowers grow up alongside the dusty path, their colorful blossoms and growth throwing a subtly sweet scent into the air.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Moonlight streams down from above, sending slivers of pale light through the area.  A combination of sounds rings through the air, from the buzzing of insects to the cooing of birds.  Darkness creeps in around the edges of the bare field, which is lit with small lanterns that throw off splashes of illumination.  Adding some life to the night are several nearby open-air booths and tents.

Sunlight streams down from above, warming the air.  A combination of sounds rings through the air, from the buzzing of insects to the chirping of birds.  A small anthill appears in the midst of the bare field, which is otherwise embraced by ripe, green artichoke plants.  Adding splashes of color to the brown soil and nearby green sea of artichoke fields are several open-air booths and tents.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: At the edge of the outer fields, the artichoke plants are sparser, and it is apparent that the center fields have been cleared away with the intention of leaving it fallow for at least a short time.  The plants that do rise up resemble healthy, almost-ripe artichokes.  Standing in front of the growth, several booths and tents stand atop the recently smoothed soil.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Grey-green stalks rise up in straight lines from the rich, brown soil toward the sky.  Their reach toward the heavens, however, seems to have been interrupted, given the obvious cuts that the plants have sustained; their heads are missing, but the stems remain.  Several triangular artichoke leaves litter the ground.  Making its way toward the center of the fields, a narrow, dusty path is marked at the edges with small red tags.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Strewn with small cuttings of green, the small path is otherwise dusty and filled with small ruts.  A small wheelbarrow stands off to the side of the path, its front wheel leaning up against one an usually short artichoke plant's stalk.  Beyond the contraption, dozens of other artichoke plants, which have been relieved of their heads, block any view of the horizon.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Several colorful booths and tents are scattered throughout the empty fields, which lie in the center of the otherwise verdant growth of artichokes.  At one corner of the area, particularly bright displays of purple flowers pop out of several artichoke plants.  The scents of the flowers, which are mutedly aromatic, drift through the night air.

Several colorful booths and tents are scattered throughout the empty fields, which lie in the center of the otherwise verdant growth of artichokes.  At one corner of the area, particularly bright displays of purple flowers pop out of several artichoke plants.  The scents of the flowers, which are mutedly aromatic, drift through the air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The scent of freshly watered soil and warm spring air winds through the air.  Ripe and ready to pick, the artichoke globes here are tightly wrapped with their triangular petals.  Green foliage, which is abundant in its growth and volume, perks up all around each tall stalk, and the result is a field akin to a miniature artichoke jungle.  A narrow path leads into the center of the verdure, while a wider, dusty path wraps around the edge of the field.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Three slender trees grow up beside the artichoke field, their limbs graced with only a handful of pale green leaves.  Their willowy builds bend slightly with passing breezes, unlike the artichoke stalks, which seem to have hardened themselves against the wind, in the neighboring field.  Underfoot, the soil from the field, which is a rich, brown color, splatters across the dusty trail that edges several like fields.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Almost as tall as an average human, the stalks of artichoke grow upright in the field, which is better accessed via a narrow path that leads toward the center.  Small buds dot the artichoke stalks, and although their petals are tightly wrapped around the hearts, they do not seem quite ready to harvest.  Off to the side of the field, several thin tree stumps are ringed with tiny mushrooms.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A burst of brilliant foliage draws attention to this small stand of artichoke plants that seem to be the jewels of the otherwise bland field of green that they reside in.  Large purple flowers burst out in a bright purple floral display couched in the silvery green foliage of the artichoke plants.  This particular area of the field has obviously been cultivated for display rather than harvesting for food.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Dozens of globe-shaped flower buds, huge in size, are nestled within the field of artichoke plants to one side of the dusty path.  The artichokes are a grey-green color, and the petals of the bud are still wrapped tightly around the heads.  A narrow path leads into the heart of many rows of the same plants, while the main path you are on continues along the edges of the fields.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: To the north, several fields with crops are interspersed with unkempt and fallow fields.  Opposite that view, artichoke plants spread out as far as the eye can see, their neatly ordered rows of tall foliage bending about to create a natural latticed pattern over the narrow path that leads into the field.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Country Cottage, Bedroom]
description: All four walls are painted a pale, spring lavender and the floor is completely covered with a plush cream-hued rug.  Beneath a wood-framed pastoral painting rests a fluffy feather bed, which is covered with homespun linens.  At the end of the bed, an oaken sea chest takes up residence, while on the far wall an antique mahogany armoire sits beside a set of darkly stained wooden shelves.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Nanetta's Cafe, Wine Cellar]
description: Though dimly lit and moderately chilly, this storage cellar is free of dust and appears well maintained.  A sturdy modwir table is covered with a crisp white linen tablecloth.  Beside the table, a single burning wall sconce illuminates a neatly carved sign.  Filling the remainder of the space, a large solid oak rack holds row upon row of hand labeled wines.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Leanney's Shop, Women's]
description: Tall and short mannequins are arranged in descending order along the back wall of the shop, and are kept just far enough away from the open window to prevent fading from the moonlight that trickles in.  In one corner of the shop a mirror has been set within a tripod so that guests may view themselves, while the other holds a black iron display rack filled with bonnets, hats, and shawls.

Tall and short mannequins are arranged in descending order along the back wall of the shop, and are kept just far enough away from the open window to prevent fading from the sunlight that trickles in.  In one corner of the shop a mirror has been set within a tripod so that guests may view themselves, while the other holds a black iron display rack filled with bonnets, hats, and shawls.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Leanney's Shop, Men's]
description: Held in place by thick brass fixtures, a series of brass poles ranging in height and width are affixed to two of the shop's three walls and display a variety of wares designed to please the male shopper.  An enormous bay window, wreathed in green linen, stretches across the third wall and allows silvery moonlight to illuminate the shop, while the fourth wall is dominated by an enormous archway that leads to the foyer.  Several trunks housing boots and shoes are arranged beside a table heaped with hats.

Several trunks housing boots and shoes are arranged beside a table heaped with hats.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Beezer's Barn, Hayloft]
description: Huge piles of hay lie scattered all over the dirty wood floor of this loft.  A hook and pulley system high overhead serves to bring bales of hay to the main floor.   Coils of rope and several other tools hang from pegs on the far wall.  Two oil lanterns on either side of the open window light up the room, while the sound of chirping crickets drifts in from outside.  A clear space on the floor right near the wooden ladder is set up with a low three-legged stool and a large woven mat.

Coils of rope and several other tools hang from pegs on the far wall.  An open window lets in the warm breeze from outside stirring the heavy scent of fresh hay that suffocates the air.  A clear space on the floor right near a narrow wooden ladder is set up with a low three-legged stool and a large woven mat.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [General Store]
description: Originally a storeroom, this small shop expansion still smells of newly cut wood.  Counters have been improvised from long, wide wooden planks set atop empty barrels, and raw, unstained shelving occupies one wall.  Metal racks display wares on two additional walls, with uncrated merchandise stacked below.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Neat and tidy rows stretch toward the horizon, with just enough room to walk between the raised mounds of dirt from which small, green plants are emerging.  The fence stretches along parallel to the rows, greyed with age and abuse from the sun.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [In The Weave]
description: From the edge of the awning, several pieces of cloth dangle, fluttering on the slightest breeze.  Some simply look to be spare strips of fabric, while others are actually pieces of ribbon.  Along the front of the counter, a swag of beads threaded on lengths of string has been hung, and a long wooden table sits beneath.  On top of the counter, a shallow wooden box lid serves as a makeshift container for a variety of wares.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: On the other side of the wood-railed fence, a russet-hued cow lingers absently, having wandered away from the rest of the herd.  It stoops to snatch at patches of grass now and again, but otherwise mills about the area with a fairly sedate demeanor.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: From somewhere nearer the center of the field, disembodied laughter can be heard, and the outline of booths and tents in the distance interrupt the straight line of the horizon.  A stake driven into the ground at the end of one of the rows is painted a bright blue on its flat top.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: The upper rail has fallen from a section of the fence nearby, and a cluster of flat, fan-shaped brown mushrooms has grown where the wood is nearest the ground.  From town, the faintest sounds of music and voices carry on the wind, so far away as to seem as the whispers of spirits on the air.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: A large stump sits in the corner of field, its roots still embedded in the earth, while its flat top is smooth and faded.  Still, though the sun has paled the wood, ring upon ring can be seen in the woodgrain, marking the stump as all that is left of a once large and aged tree.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Write Stop, Western Wing]
description: Along the western wall of the wagon, a small fel table sits by a spacious ebonwood shelf.  A pile of dirt has been swept up into the corner of the wagon, as if someone tried to tidy up the room, but failed to complete the task.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Write Stop, Eastern Wing]
description: Resting along the eastern wall, a pair of criss-crossed iron shovels have been affixed to the wall by a thin piece of steel.  A wooden box and crate have been placed in the center of the room; both have been filled with various wares.  A large oil painting illustrates an aerial layout of the Grawood Farmstead.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Smarten Up, South Nook]
description: The south end of the wagon has been painted in muted green shades and clusters of ferns and crocuses have been propped up on the end of a set of rough oak shelves.  An oversized varnished oak couch sits snugly between a recess at the far wall of the wagon, the vibrant color of its cushion faded in the middle.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Smarten Up, North Nook]
description: The north end of the wagon has been painted in vibrant pink shades, with vases of tulips and purple lilacs precariously balancing on ledges and small tables.  A row of over-plumped modwir chairs sits in the far corner, topped by numbers of multi-colored cushions of various shapes and sizes.  A set of makeshift wooden racks and a tall wicker basket have been propped up in the middle of the room.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Broken Wheel Distillery]
description: Half of this area has been dedicated to a variety of copper equipment, from great vats to coils of tubing that rise above, and sectioned off with a stout dark oak railing that supports panes of glass that reach to the rafters.  The mechanisms here don't seem to be in use at the moment, but from time to time, someone moves behind the glass, checking this or adjusting that.  In the space left for visitors, there is a long fel table with a grape-embroidered runner draped across it and a polished dark oak bottle rack close by.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Broken Wheel Distillery]
description: Shelves line the rafters, held in place by heavy wooden braces to support the oaken barrels lined up neatly atop them.  Each of the barrels has a broken wagon wheel branded on the outward facing end, along with a date that, from this distance, isn't distinguishable.  A giant copper vat sits on the far side of building among several other smaller containers, with both straight and coiled tubing running between them.  On the opposite side of the structure is a long ebonwood table with a gold-edged runner and a black iron bottle rack.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Mermaid Table]
description: Dangling from the ceiling is the prow from the hull of an old Elven ship.  Swaying slowly in circles from the chains holding it aloft, the prow is crafted to resemble a mermaid rearing above the waves.  As the prow rocks back and forth, it kicks up a slight refreshing breeze.

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Listing about aimlessly on the other side of the fence, a tawny tan and white cow has settled beneath the branches of a well-pruned apple tree.  Despite the cool beneath the shade of the tree, the cow's tail whips back and forth, swatting at flies that disturb its rest.
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Mystic Table]
description: A beautiful oil painting of an intricately designed water fountain dominates the wall near this table.  Depicted in the portrait are three females, obviously of Elven heritage, standing back to back with their arms upraised.  A lightning bolt arcs from the fingertips of each female and connects high in the air, where the water plummets and cascades down into the base of the fountain below.

title: [Pegleg Table]
description: One of the four table legs has been utterly destroyed in some past bar fight.  As a replacement for the missing leg, three mismatched pieces of linden wood have been attached to the table with rusted nails.  The makeshift table leg is shorter than the original three and is resting on a square piece of maoral wood, making the table tilt alarmingly.  As a centerpiece, a single wilted daisy droops over one side of a broken mug, which now serves as a vase and has water seeping slowly from its jagged crack.

title: [Ant Hill Table]
description: On the inner side of one of the table legs, a small nest is visible.  Dozens of ants scurry about on the floor as they indulge happily in spilled brew and ale from the previous messy patrons.  Serving as a most unique centerpiece, a piece of amber has been cut into the shape of a star and holds the fossilized remains of several unknown tiny creatures.

title: [Jeweled Dagger Table]
description: A spotted and torn spidersilk tablecloth covers most of the numerous dings and pockmarks on this table.  Embedded deep within the center of the table is a dagger with only the pommel and hilt visible.  Engraved on the pommel of the dagger in a spidery script is the name Hagatha, the proprietor of the tavern.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shop]
description: Black iron candelabras are set below dark mahogany shelves, the candleflames sputtering softly.  A large crystal-paned counter is set against the western wall, its interior lined with velvet to cushion the beautiful wares inside.  Small chests are aligned in neat rows upon the floor, their gilted edges warping any light into strange patterns.

title: [Cleric Guild, Library]
description: Bookcases, stacked to overflowing with tomes and scrolls and other readables, fill this large room.  The air smells of the pleasant must only present in libraries, but no dust collects on the carefully maintained shelves.  Protected lanterns hang at regular intervals from the ceiling, shedding plenty of light to read by.  A carved wooden sign hangs just before the door.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Candles cover every available space on the tiered walls, filling the room with golden light.  Tiny bits of silver hang from the high ceiling, glimmering like stars around a large golden ball.  Craters and seas have been beaten into the sphere, creating a replica of the moon Liabo.  Soft pillows made for kneeling sit in the center of the floor, making this a perfect place for reflection.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Delicate arched niches have been carved out of the walls.  In each sits a small, beautiful statue of one of the Lords and Ladies of Liabo, looking out over those who have come to pray.  A number of kneeling pillows and padded benches have been placed strategically around the room, and a censer of soft incense hangs from the ceiling.

title: [Cleric Guild, Halls of Lessons]
description: The warm golden lacquered wood of the walls fades away into a dull, muted grey in this small chamber.  Orbs of the same drab color are set into runic patterns upon the floor, their crystalline surfaces glinting softly in the flickering light.  A statue of a man to the northwest stares quietly into the distance, as if gazing at something only he could see.  Set before the statue is a dark stone altar, its edges delicately carved and embellished, adding a tiny hint of beauty to the somber surroundings.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Annex]
description: Twin sconces are set opposite one another on the north and south walls here, their dim flames casting long shadows down the hallway in both directions.  The floor is composed of carefully chiseled granite blocks, each one set against the next at a slight angle, and the walls are polished marble blocks from floor to ceiling.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Tapestries hang over the wood paneled walls.  They depict a number of scenes, from a brilliant star in the sky to the rocky slopes of Thanatoph to a gently rolling sea.  Oil lamps burn in the corners of the room, providing soft light and a soothing scent.  Several multicolored pillows have been placed in the center of the room.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Thin woven runners with long, thin scenes on them hang between rows of niches carved into the walls.  Small, beautifully carved statues sit in each nook, depicting each demigod represented in the pantheon of Others.  Tasseled kneeling pillows dot the floor, and long benches make a comfortable place to sit and pray.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: Dark ebonwood panels line the walls of this small room, their mottled surfaces dimly illuminated by several large pillar candles.  The statue of a man bedecked in black chain-mail is located within a small arched alcove, the white marble around him a stark contrast to the dark surroundings.  The man's face is stony even for a statue, and a grimly determined expression has been chiseled upon his face.  A simple black altar sits before the shallow niche, an ivory kite shield lying upon its surface.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: A single candle burns fitfully in the corner of the room furthest from the door.  The light it sheds is hardly adequate to brighten the room past an eerie glow, leaving the bulk of the area in creeping shadows.  A small sphere hangs from the ceiling, seeming as ominous and foreboding as the moon it represents.  Four black velvet pillows sit in the center of the room.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Sanded, unpolished wooden planks cover the walls.  The room seems neither hot nor cold, bright nor dark, simply an extension of existence.  Grey cotton pillows have been piled in the center of the room, provided for kneeling and contemplation.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: The room, curved back upon itself like a short oval, is nearly claustrophobic.  Into each curved wall has been carved several niches.  From these perches look the Lords and Ladies of Lornon, peering down on all those who have come to pray.  The room is devoid of pillow or bench, leaving nothing but the floor to sit or kneel on.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: The high walls of this room are completely covered with the carved renditions of many rows of bookspines, making the surroundings resemble the shelves of some vast library.  Situated in one corner is a life-sized statue of a man sitting upon a high-backed chair, looking as if the thousands of stone books were but a paltry collection to him.  A grey altar sits before the man, looking very out of place amidst the scholarly surroundings.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: The golden wood paneling is broken only by two arched niches carved into the wall.  In each sits a masterfully carved statue of a woman, one touched by insanity and the other with beautiful feathered wings.  Grey pillows rest on the floor, and padded benches line the quiet room.

title: [Cleric Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Annex, Hallway]
description: Inlaid into the ruddy mahogany flooring of this broad corridor, bands of dark, medium, and light wood form paths to three exits set with stone of corresponding colors.  On the north side of the hallway, interlocking squares of white ash lead to a marble arch, and a strip of smokey-grey haon leads to a granite arch on the south side.  A line of dark ebonwood separates the two, terminating before the onyx-inlaid arch at the hall's west end.

title: [Annex, Antechamber of Lornon]
description: Dedicated to the Arkati of the Pantheon of Lornon, the atmosphere of this room is dark in all aspects.  Myriad black candles drip blood-red wax as they burn, filling the room with more heat and smoke than actual illumination.  A round ebony table inlaid with nine golden seals sits between two doorways.  As occasional drafts stir the heavy air, their resultant ripples create the illusion of macabre faces and writhing figures that quickly dissolve back into the veil of haze.

title: [Annex, Antechamber of Others]
description: Statues, figurines, and other sculptures fill this room, each representing one of the unaligned or lesser deities of Elanith.  Though not gaudy, the sheer variety of colorful hues in the decor lends the area a quiet exuberance which refuses to be classified as either dark or light.  The sense of presence here is not as commanding as that of the Lornon and Liabo antechambers, yet one can easily perceive an underlying, sometimes chaotic, energy in the air.

title: [Annex, Antechamber of Liabo]
description: From the whitewashed walls and alabaster tile floors, to the wide skylights and vast array of ivory beeswax candles, everything about this room is light.  Gossamer silk panels undulate gently as they ride the shifting currents of air that pass through two narrow, slit windows, the breeze slowing just enough to allow candle flames to flicker without being extinguished.  Bracketed by two wide doorways, a pale yellow pine table occupies a place of prominence.

title: [Annex, Alchemical Storage]
description: Brimming with bottles, canisters, jars, and containers of all sizes, rows of thick shelving nearly obscure the pale white paneling on every wall of this small cubicle.  A rectangular worktable occupies the center of the room, making maneuvering difficult.  Assorted mortar and pestle sets, clean and ready for use, are scattered amidst miscellaneous glassware and other equipment atop the table.

title: [Annex, Equipment Room]
description: Considering the amount of cleaning equipment stored here, one might expect a great deal of dust and disarray, yet not a single item seems out of place.  A stout open-front locker holds brooms, dust pans, and other janitorial tools, each hung or stacked neatly within.  Along each wall of the spacious room, equally sturdy lockers and cupboards store cauldrons, alembics, and large pieces of equipment.  Each item is carefully nestled in its own clearly labeled partition.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Annex, Dogma Workshop]
description: Looking more like an altar than a surface for practice of the alchemical research, the top of the workbench is carved from a block of solid white marble and stands on an elevated platform in the center of this triangular room.  Crystal prisms, set into the walls near the room's apex, splinter daylight into its constituent colors while channeling it into a faceted orb that glows brightly above the workbench.  Staggered shelving on each wall holds assorted items of interest.

Looking more like an altar than a surface for practice of alchemical research, the top of the workbench is carved from a block of solid black onyx and stands on an elevated platform in the center of this triangular room.  Crystal prisms, set into the walls near the room's apex, gather and amplify moonlight, channeling it into a faceted orb that glows brightly above the workbench.  Staggered shelving on each wall holds assorted items of interest.
