title: [Cleric Guild, Solhaven]
description: The walls are made of stones tumbled smooth by the ocean and winds.  Torches held in polished steel rings illuminate the area, shedding cheerful light over the two statues in the center of the room.  Carved from solid granite, a teenaged girl with a mischievous grin rests her hand on the arm of a bearded man with a fish's tail.  They stand on a sea-blue pedestal with words carved into the surface.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cleric Guild, Aquarium]
description: A natural bubble of clear glaes formed long ago by an errant lava flow caps off a long underwater stone tunnel.  All around you is the majesty of the ocean, perhaps twenty feet from the surface.  Seaweed caresses the sphere of glaes from the sandy floor, giving many small crustaceans a place to hide and hunt.  Schools of brightly colored fish swim around just outside, darting curiously about the natural aquarium.  One slow, persistent snail oozes up the rock, keeping the surface clean.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shop]
description: Dark silver filigree patterns flow across the wall, imitating the churning waves of the sea.  A gilted crystal-paned counter stands in the middle of the room, surrounded by several large open birchwood chests.  Numerous shelves line the closely-spaced walls, their surfaces draped with luxurious lengths of velvet to highlight the wares they hold.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Bubbly blue-tinted glass sits in large window panes, giving the room an oceanic feel.  Silken hangings in shades of blue and green wave in a slight breeze, keeping the room in constant motion.  Hanging from the ceiling are several shining bits of silver, laying out the sailors' guiding constellations with the moon Liabo in the center, guiding the way.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Statues carved from dazzling coral decorate the walls of the room, each one in the likeness of a god or goddess of Liabo.  Pearls, abalone and seashells shine out from between each statue, while a large shelf of varicolored coral serves as an altar.  A flame burns behind a thick blue glass lantern, washing the room in dancing ocean-colored light.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: A shallow alcove of stone to the northwest harbors a statue of a gaunt man with heavy-lidded eyes, his hand resting upon the hilt of a longsword.  A black altar stands before the statue, an open tome resting upon its immaculately smooth surface.  Throughout the ceiling, glistening white shells have been inlaid into the rock, causing them to twinkle like stars as the candles placed throughout the room flicker softly.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Study Hall]
description: Resembling an octopus in shape, the study hall has eight narrow tunnels branching off in a variety of directions and two large globes anchored into the stucco ceiling offering cheerful illumination.  Five of the tunnels are curtained for privacy, while the remaining three remain open for public use.  A braided rug rests underneath a carved soapstone table that has a mosaic-inlay of colorful tiles and is surrounded by comfortable linden chairs topped with deep blue cushions.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Frescoes of mermaids have been lovingly painted onto the walls and ceiling of this sea green room.  Each holds in her hand a different symbol dangling from a pearl-studded chain, representing each of the gods that belong in the Pantheon of Others.  Several lounges sit in strategic places about the room, inviting rest and relaxation, as well as worship.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Small statues carved from whalebone hang from leather cords about the room.  They swing in a slight breeze, twisting and turning to see all who have come to pay worship to the Others.  Pillows of various colors and materials provide respite to the knees from the rough stone floor.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: A high ceiling rises in a curving upwards arc, the stone tinted a soft shade of white reminiscent of summer clouds.  Subtle engravings mark the white stone, their simplistic wavy forms looking like currents of gentle wind.  The flowing patterns of air coalesce around the statue of a winged man with a boyish grin on his face standing to the southwest.  A mottled blue and misty grey altar stands before the man, an open tome resting upon its whorled surface.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Piles of splintered wood litter the floor, each plank bearing the name of a ship long ago destroyed.  Some have been singed by fires at sea, others punctured and broken by harpoons and other projectiles.  Sitting amid the piles are a few bones, looking disconcertingly as if they came from elves, humans and dwarves.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: The stone walls have been painted the deep, deep blue of the water far below the surface.  The room is silent as the depths, and no breeze dares disturb the quiet.  A small pile of midnight blue pillows rests on the floor, inviting to those who seek a bit of peace.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Black sand covers the floor, creeping into the crevices of each rough pillow placed upon it.  Backlit by small votive candles are statues of the Lords and Ladies of Lornon, all the more sinister for their obscured features.  The shadows thrown by the figurines are long and eerie, dancing erratically over the floor as if taunting all who would enter.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: Only a single candle provides light in this cramped chamber, and the very air seems to reject your presence with a startlingly cold chill.  Huge tentacles carved from stone fade in and out of the darkness as the candle flame flickers softly.  As the shadows and light dance across their surfaces, it gives the impression of being within the writhing, living mass of some otherwordly creature.  A statue of some horrible beast stands to the southeast, a squat obsidian altar crouching before it.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: The silence here is profound.  Two statues, one of a winged mermaid and the other of a wild-eyed woman gazing up at the moon, sit in the two back corners of the room.  A small pile of fish tails, broken driftwood dolls, and other symbols of sailor wife curses sits before the mermaid, whose look of beautiful impartiality barely pays them notice.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemic Chamber]
description: Fitted into place and supported by golden linden wood beams, the ceiling is fashioned from an enormous hemisphere of thick, clear blown glass that allows the sunlight to completely fill the tiny workroom.  Flanking the tunnel-like entry, which is cordoned off by a white Vornavian silk curtain, are a pair of frosted glass lanterns.  A carved golden linden workbench holds a tidy array of alchemy devices, as well as a small copper brazier.

title: [Cleric Guild, Storage Tunnel]
description: More a glorified closet than a storage room, the small room has a low ceiling fitted with a single brass lantern.  Brooms are arranged in a hap-hazardous pile in one curving corner, while cleaning rags and polishing cloths fill a deep blue urn to overflow.  Dustpans and brushes are scattered indiscriminately around a rattan dust bin that shows signs of recent repair and an overpowering scent of mildew fills the air.

title: [Cleric Guild, Storage Tunnel]
description: Shielded lanterns are suspended from the ceiling at safe distances from the glass-front cupboards that house a variety of powders, dried goods, and chemicals used in the alchemical processes.  A low linden wood workbench is set beneath the cupboards and is maintained by the watchful eye of the elderly storage clerk.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemic Library]
description: Textured stucco walls form the small storage space and are painted with colorful fish that swirl through a forest of dark seaweed.  Opposite the entry is a small desk and floor mat that are set before a floor to ceiling bookcase riddled with books, scrolls, and vellums.  A carefully shielded brass lantern looks out of place amongst the more colorful sea glass globes that dangle from the linden wood rafters, its cheery glow creating a prismatic spray of light.

title: [Cleric Guild, Icemule Trace]
description: The icy walls sparkle in the sunlight, glimmering with silvers and golds.  The light caresses the two ice statues standing, backs turned but looking over their shoulders, in the center of the room.  Both are female, but one is something less than humanoid in its form.  They stand on a base of ice, words carved into the surface.  The air is crisp and cold, smelling of melting glaciers and gently falling snow.

The icy walls sparkle in the moonlight, glimmering with silvers and blues.  The light caresses the two ice statues standing, backs turned but looking over their shoulders, in the center of the room.  Both are female, but one is something less than humanoid in its form.  They stand on a base of ice, words carved into the surface.  The air is crisp and cold, smelling of melting glaciers and gently falling snow.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest, up, out

title: [Cleric Guild, Shop]
description: Pale grey-blue masonry surrounds you in this rather small shop, its architecture beautiful in a simple way.  Ivory patterns flow across a crystal-paned counter, and the wares within sparkle in the ample light.  Small gold-studded chests line the walls, each shadowed by the numerous cherry-red shelves above.

title: [Cleric Guild, Observatory]
description: Higher than even the tallest spire of the temple, this clear ice chamber looks out over the city of Icemule Trace.  Even the floor is transparent, leaving no angle of the view obstructed.  This close to the heavens, and to mortality, it is easy to feel the touch of the gods upon you, blessing or damning as they will.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Cheery sunlight filters through the crystalline ice walls, lending the room a happy feel.  Brightly woven carpets cover the floor, placed on sheets of oilcloth to protect from the inevitable collections of moisture.  A large bas relief of the moon Liabo has been carved into the ceiling.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: The ice that makes the walls of this room has been sculpted by a master's hand.  Into the frozen surface niches have been formed, and from the bottom of each nook rises a statue representing one of the members of the pantheon of Liabo.  All is carved from the single, immense sheet of ice that makes the room itself.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: Surrounded by a circle of arctic flowers and plants placed lovingly in pots of sparkling blue crystal, a statue of a woman clad in robes of leaves stands to the northwest.  A blue-tinted glow filters down from high above, and the air swims with the scent of blooming flowers.  In front of the statue is a wooden altar, draped carefully with long, twining vines and delicate iceblossoms.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Rippled walls of ice, the surface as clear as a flawless diamond, enclose the grand hallway that ushers one into the training annex.  Nature's hand has shaped the walls, as minute changes of temperature alternately let the water of the walls flow and refreeze to create the abstract patterns on display.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Swirls and vines have been etched into the icy walls, looking something like shooting stars and comets.  A frozen fountain sits in the corner of the room, the movement of the water that created it barely evident beneath the surface.  A runner of woven blue provides a safe walking spot on the icy floor.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Twelve small statues, each tinted a different shade, sit in niches in the walls.  They look out over the room, some glaring and some kind, examining each supplicant who has come to pray.  A round rug in a deep shade of aqua covers the floor, providing a bit of warmth and protection from the cold.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: A white ivory altar stands to the south, set upon a circular tile of lapis lazuli that emanates a faint glow from the reflected sunlight streaming through the thick icy walls.  A subtle border of daggers alternating with owls is engraved upon the floor, following the circle in a gentle spiral.  The statue of an athletic elven woman is situated behind the altar, her form slightly shadowed by the niche of ice arcing over her.

A white ivory altar stands to the south, set upon a circular tile of lapis lazuli that faintly emanates a pale blue glow from the reflected moonlight streaming through the thick icy walls.  A subtle border of daggers alternating with owls is engraved upon the floor, following the circle in a gentle spiral.  The statue of an athletic elven woman is situated behind the altar, her form slightly shadowed by the niche of ice arcing over her.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: The walls of this small chamber have all been frosted, giving the light a hard and cruel feel.  It is difficult to look about without squinting, and the chill here seems deeper than in other places.  No rugs or carpets cover the floor, forcing anyone who would walk to do so with great care.

title: [Cleric Guild, Library]
description: Glossy ice walls enclose the small room, while thick pistachio green woolen rugs line the floor, giving it a homely feel.  A grated fireplace sits to the east of the room, crackling as applewood smoke drifts lazily into the air.  Insets have been carved into the icy walls, their ledges holding dimly lit lanterns.  Several pine shelves line the walls, stacked with well organized books and scrolls, and a large oak table dominates the remainder of the room.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: The ice in this room has no ornamentation or carving.  Silver-grey rugs run the length of the room, lending a stark and lifeless quality to the area.  The floor coverings do little to absorb the sounds, leaving each noise to echo about the hard walls.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: The pantheon of Lornon fills one wall.  Small statues of Eorgina, Luukos, and their cohorts glare out from their niches, judging all who would come before them.  The air in the room is bitingly cold, each breath steaming before you.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: Walls of dark-hued ice ascend in a curving arc to form a narrow circular chamber, the sunlight filtering through in fractured, hazy waves.  A dark red altar stands near one of the walls, a quietly menacing statue carved out of the surroundings sitting behind it.  Faint shadows play across the thick ice around the statue, distorted and blurred by the crystalline facets, though at times the darkness resembles something vaguely feline in form.

Walls of dark-hued ice ascend in a curving arc to form this narrow circular chamber, the wan moonlight filtering through in fractured, hazy waves.  A dark red altar stands near one of the walls, a quietly menacing statue carved out of the surroundings sitting behind it.  Faint twinges of light emanate from the thick ice around the statue, distorted slightly by the crystalline facets, though at times the sparkles resemble a luminous slitted eye.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Two frosted statues have been carved out of the back wall of the room, seeming to melt out of the ice.  One is of a woman with hair blowing wildly about her.  The other appears to be a large pair of feathered wings, two impassive eyes looking out from just above where the wings cross.  Other than the statues, however, the room is made of plain ice.

title: [Cleric Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Clouds of misty air roll out of the corner of the passageway, their presence caused by the existence of water warmed to the point that it flows freely over the wall of ice, in a steady, gentle sheet.  The water disappears through a narrow gap between the floor and the wall, with no sound betraying how far the water might fall once below the walkway.  Several brightly blooming flowers are planted in clay pots that hang from the ceiling, enjoying the benefit of the mist-warmed air.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Wing]
description: Icy walls, veined with traces of silver and gold, flow seamlessly from the entry of the training annex into the alchemy wing.  The walls have been caught at the moment of melt when the formation of water droplets causes a mirror-bright sheen to coat the ice.  Oddly, despite their liquid appearance, the walls are dry to the touch.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Wing]
description: Glimpses of the wintry landscape outside can be seen through the wide picture windows that form the outside walls of the alchemy workshops.  Positioned in a half-circle around this wing of the guild, the workshops are well-appointed and welcoming.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Alchemy Workshop]
description: Positioned within an arc of gracefully proportioned picture windows, this workshop affords a restful view of Icemule Trace's perpetual winter.  The chilly outside landscape contrasts with the comfortable ambient heat within the guild.  Dominating the center of the room, a gold-veined marble workbench, fitted with a silver gem lens assembly, a crucible, and a clear glass alembic, resides in splendor.

title: [Alchemy Workshop]
description: Positioned within an arc of gracefully proportioned picture windows, this workshop affords a restful view of Icemule Trace's perpetual winter. title: [Alchemy Supplies]
description: Stretching around three sides of the room, a long wooden shelf houses all manner of jars, beakers, bottles, droppers, rods, and other alchemical supplies.  The fourth wall is dominated by an enormous slab of slate replete with obscure numbers and symbols, along with vague drifts of chalk dust where old notes and formulas have been rubbed out.

title: [Cleric Guild, Broom Closet]
description: A room of modest proportions, its design is clearly more functional and less decorative than the rest of the guild.  Boasting little in the way of ornament, the only point of interest is a glass hurricane lamp mounted high on the wall.  Within the bulb of the lamp, a pool of silvery-blue liquid resides, giving rise to a steadily burning, brilliantly white flame.

title: [Alchemy Workshop]
description: Positioned within an arc of gracefully proportioned picture windows, this workshop affords a restful view of Icemule Trace's perpetual winter.  The chilly outside landscape contrasts with the comfortable ambient heat within the guild.  Dominating the center of the room, a gold-veined marble workbench, fitted with a silver gem lens assembly, a crucible, and a clear glass alembic, resides in splendor.

title: [A Twist of Roses, Nonpareils]
description: Dark amethyst marble floors are veined with black and silver that twist and turn to resemble roses entwining with harps.  In one corner, a silver bench sits next to a marble fountain, and along the other wall, twin shelves of ebon marble reside above a lavender-veined black marble counter.  An elaborate Loenthran tapestry covers the wall behind the fountain.

Inset into the pristine pink-veined white marble floor is a brilliant peacock encircled by black roses on a field of sapphire blue.  A crystalline jewelry case rests upon a black marble pedestal next to a matching counter bordered in diamonds.  A small gold plaque hangs next to a lustrous white marble arch.

title: [River's Rest, Underbridge]
description: Tall cattails and water grasses take up much of the space beneath the drawbridge above, and beyond them the Tempest River flows swiftly.  Wavering shadows in the shallower waters indicate potential meals to the enterprising fishermen, while the soothing sound of moving water -- a chorus of gurgles and chuckles -- fills the air.  A cast iron fish sits forelonely before a rickety shack nestled against the underside of the bridge and the bank.

title: [Cooper's Shack]
description: This tiny shack is littered with tools of the cooper's trade, including mallets, planes, and sand paper.  A small pile of tapered and beveled oak staves sits in one corner of the floor, while a random collection of metal hoops lies in the other.  A small fire burns in a pit at the center of the shack, its smoke winding past an empty rack as it rises through a small hole in the ceiling.

title: [Charcuterie Weyr]
description: Two glass-paned cases square off, facing each other across the shop.  Their contents not withstanding, the room is almost entirely white -- whitewashed stone walls, a white tiled floor and a white marble-topped bar set in a recessed space along the back wall combine in a cool, clean aesthetic.

title: [Rathain's Armory]
[Rathain's General Store]
description: Beneath a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A small brown box and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a weathered cobblestone floor.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Garden]
[Maezneris Villa, Garden]
description: Dwarf evergreens lend their shade to the delicate twists and turns of the garden.  Large boulders draped with pink-budded fetterbushes stand out amid white-striped lily turf and crimson monkey grass along the northern edges of the pebble path, while a narrow streambed trickles into a koi pond lined with tufts of dwarf bamboo.  Splashes of color generated by the flowering presence of azaleas and crimson ginger blossoms create interest near some smooth round stones.

Dwarf evergreens lend their shade to the delicate twists and turns of the garden.  Large boulders draped with pink-budded fetterbushes stand out amid white-striped lily turf and crimson monkey grass along the northern edges of the pebble path, while a narrow streambed trickles into a koi pond lined with tufts of dwarf bamboo.  Flanking a series of smooth stone steps, bright azaleas and crimson ginger blossoms bloom on one side, while a stone-lined bed of colorful flowers dominates the other.  Resting on the edge of one pale step is a small earthenware bowl.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Dawn Embrace]
description: Lacquered golden bamboo walls stand out from the polished white birch floor and bind the swathes of soft orange linens that decorate the high ceiling.  Centered beneath a gold-wrapped frosted glass orb is a long bamboo weapon's rack framed by porcelain white vases filled with young bamboo shoots and painted with a swirl of yellow butterflies.  Wide cushions are arranged around a low table, which is set beneath a framed parchment painting.

Lacquered golden bamboo walls stand out from the polished white birch floor and bind the swathes of soft orange linens that decorate the high ceiling.  Centered beneath a gold-wrapped frosted glass orb is a long bamboo weapons rack framed by porcelain white vases filled with young bamboo shoots and painted with a swirl of yellow butterflies.  Wide cushions are arranged around a low table, which is set beneath a framed parchment painting.

Centered beneath a gold-wrapped frosted glass orb is a long bamboo weapons rack framed by porcelain white vases filled with young bamboo shoots and painted with a swirl of yellow butterflies.  Wide cushions are arranged around low table, which is set beneath a framed parchment painting.

title: [Velathae, West Sunset Street]
description: The muddy ground is covered with a variety of tracks and grooves, testament to the heavy traffic that passes through.  Several large shops have been built around the intersection, and a number of small wagons and stands have been arranged in position to best peddle wares.  Lanterns have been hung with care where the streets cross, as well as near the entrance to each store.

title: [Broken Ship's Door Table]
description: A broken ship's cabin door sits atop five uneven driftwood legs to make a rickety table.  Painted on the door is a boat with a ragtag halfling at the helm barking orders to a stuffed toy crew.  The young girl seems unconcerned that her ship is aground in a sunlit glade or that a group of forest gnomes is watching her from the trees nearby.  Someone has scribbled "Sophie" on an unframed picture of a hermit crab that is tacked to the wall above the table.

title: [Charcuterie Weyr, Lounge]
description: A marble slab tops the stand-up bar, behind which is a wall of racked bottles.  The space is separated from the rest of the shop by a set of three short steps, which lead down into the half-moon shaped cutout.

title: [Pagination, The Stacks]
description: The building is cylindrical and two stories, with a mistwood staircase spiraling upwards in the center of the room.  Matching railings rim the second floor, which overlooks the shelves and cases built into the curving lower wall.  The single arched doorway is framed by two octagonal windows, each of which is paned in sapphire glass.

title: [Shadowed Alcove]
description: Motes of dust can be seen floating through the streams of broken moonlight filtering through a small, grimy window.  A thick mat of reeds covers the rough wooden floor, herbs and dried flowers mixed in to mask other unsavory odors.  Piled up about a polished maoral table is a wide variety of boxes, chests, and trunks.  Tucked to one side is a rounded whiskey barrel bound with strips of rusted iron.

Motes of dust can be seen floating through the streams of broken sunlight filtering through a small, grimy window.  A thick mat of reeds covers the rough wooden floor, herbs and dried flowers mixed in to mask other unsavory odors.  Piled up about a polished maoral table is a wide variety of boxes, chests, and trunks.  Tucked to one side is a rounded whiskey barrel bound with strips of rusted iron.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Guard Chamber]
description: The walls are lined with glass-fronted cases, within which bristle clusters of sharpened and gleaming arms.  In the middle of the room a life-sized statue of a fully armored woman stands atop a tall plinth.  Above her is a dome of mosaic glaes, the silvered tiles of which reflect the mailed top of her head and the bronzed crown upon it.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Ballroom]
description: A wide stone staircase, laid with a sapphire runner, descends to the herringbone-patterned dance floor.  The arched opening at the top of the stairs sits well beneath the ceiling, with its elaborate silver-ribbed fan vaulting, though the staircase itself is not steep, but merely a long, gentle incline.  At the far end of the ballroom, high up, the heavy stone wall is cut away in favor of a series of stained glass windows.  A few silver-gilt chairs and tables rest under the blued lunettes.

Laid with a pure alabaster, a wide stone staircase, descends to the herringbone-patterned dance floor.  The arched opening at the top of the stairs sits well beneath the ceiling, with its elaborate silver-ribbed fan vaulting, it is not steep, but merely a long, gentle incline.  Bright silver and gold streamers drape down from above, their lengths adorned with crystal droplets.  A few silver-gilt chairs and tables rest under shimmering translucent draperies of silk that billow down the walls.

title: [Pagination, Reading Room]
description: Beneath a domed ceiling of mosaic glaes tiles, the upper floor of the shop is given way to a ring-shaped reading room of blue velvet settees and overstuffed ivory leather chairs.  In the middle of the room, a mistwood staircase spirals downwards to the ground level, with matching carved mistwood railings blocking any inadvertent drop-offs.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Public Lounge]
description: Lengths of viridian linen, bound to the high ceiling by a gold-wrapped frosted orb, create a swirl of fabric that stretches outward to the lacquered bamboo walls.  Opposite a small marble fountain, a mahogany sideboard stands on the birch flooring, and an ornate plaque, displaying a vellum ceremonial fan, hangs on the wall above.  Scattered in small social circles, and set at a distance from the room's various doors, are several settees and divans that provide places to recline.  To the north, a private hallway leads into the back of the villa.

title: [Aies Apartment, Bedchamber]
description: A bed sits centrally in the rectangular room, splitting it down the middle as the spine of a book and leaving two exposed pages of dimly lit, shadowed wooden floor.  At the foot of the bed is hung a high painting, its oil surface relucent with candlelight thrown up from the mantle of an inset fireplace.  Next to the fireplace is a silver wire basket of sticks.  A screen, wooden-framed with panels of silver-on-sapphire leather, sits behind the bed's head.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Twilight Rest]
description: Sky blue linens create a gentle swirl of color across the high ceiling, only to be bound in place by lacquered bamboo walls.  Soft illumination filters through the room from a gold-wrapped frosted orb suspended at the center of the room.  Framed by a pair of agate-inlaid vases, filled with fragrant white magnolia and orange blossoms, is a low table surrounded by cushions.  Mounted to one wall, a framed linen robe is artistically displayed behind a pane of protective glass.

title: [Wyrwood Retreat, Approach]
description: A neat, white gravel path lined with rowan trees leads from the wrought iron gate to a circular walk around a large space with a solitary wyrwood tree growing in the center.  A neatly lettered sign has been placed just outside of the tree's reach.  On the far side of the walk is a peak-roofed golden oak lodge.  Unlit oil lamps atop sturdy poles are placed around the compound, and a row of targets waits along the eastern end of the southern wall.  Chips and scorch marks on the brick wall give testimony to frequent practice sessions.
location: Wyrwood Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Wyrwood Retreat, Entryway]
description: This open, airy room has smooth, polished floorboards that chirp whenever weight is placed upon them.  Bramble-carved ironwood benches rest beneath the windows in the northern wall, framing the doorway that leads to the meditation garden at the center of the lodge.  Wrought iron sconces supporting unlit oil lamps are set into the walls around the room.  A row of coat hooks is set to one side of a pair of sturdy ironwood doors leading back out to the front porch.
location: Wyrwood Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Ta'Illistim, Warrior Guild]
description: The moat is curiously narrow under the bridge, affording a decent amount of walking and resting space.  The ground is littered with small pebbles, most pounded firmly into the sturdy, albeit moist ground, by heavy foot traffic.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Warrior Guild]
description: The moat is a mere trickle under the bridge, its width no greater than the span of a dwarf's leap.  The sandy ground is held firm at the moat's edges by massive retainer stones of grey slate.

title: [Wyrwood Retreat, Inner Garden]
description: Open to the sky, the peaceful garden at the center of the lodge is filled with carefully pruned miniature glowbark trees and neatly trimmed grass.  Beds of crimson sirenflowers that rustle with every movement frame the doorways leading to various rooms.  Unlit glaes lanterns atop sturdy poles are set along the white gravel paths that lead to a thick meditation mat beside a rough boulder in the center.  A spring bubbles up from a rocky knoll in the northeast corner, flowing down to fill a small pool.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
location: Wyrwood Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Rusted buckets, some so corroded that their bottoms have decayed into a red-brown mesh, lie scattered around a copper-chained bilge pump.  Strands of thick white cobwebs coat the tangled mass and are pocketed with darker cocoons of spider eggs.  A particularly hairy grey spider scurries from the mass toward a pile of rotting straw that protrudes from one of the cells.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Tucked between two of the cells, and well out of reach, is a copper-chained pump system mounted into a bucket-like sump in the floor.  A long, cast-iron lever stands motionless despite the sound of gurgling water that occasionally sloshes up out of the sump to wet the pitch-slathered deck.  A slight warping in the wooden planks and watermarks on the oaken bulkheads bear testament to the ravages of water within the area at some point in the past.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Wyrwood Retreat, Kitchen]
description: Pots and pans, cooking utensils, and bundles of herbs hang from racks to either side of a black iron stove and a large double sink on the south wall.  Oak cabinets line the west wall.  A sturdy worktable takes up the center of the tiled floor, and a wrought iron chandelier with unlit oil lamps hangs above it.  Barrels of bulk food supplies are lined up beneath the windows framing the doorway in the east wall.  To the north are two bramble-carved ironwood benches placed on either side of a matching table.
location: Wyrwood Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]
description: Clumps of rotted straw lie scattered across the decking that stretches from the inner hull to the wide, wrought iron slats of the cell's rusty bars.  Black rings fixed to the walls with thick iron staples are evenly spaced along the bulkhead and fitted with manacles.  The stench filling the cramped space is heavy with mold and decay.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Bisecting the narrow companionway between the rows of wrought iron cells is a large wooden framing post marred by nicks and scratches down its rough expanse.  A black iron ring supports the manacled form of a rotted skeleton draped in tattered clothing that might once have been an Imperial Navy uniform.  Foul odors fill this section of the ship, made worse by the damp, sea-laden air.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Floor-to-ceiling bars form a latticework of wrought iron cells along the port side.  Large, brackets bolted to the bulkhead and planks overhead hold the iron bars in place and have been covered in tar to prevent rusting.  Occasionally, an enormous rat scurries between sealed barrels marked with large black X's; some even sit lazily in open sight, unperturbed.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Bottom Deck]
description: Crammed with banded barrels and crates that are stacked up to the planking overhead, this small area reeks with the odor of rot and waste.  The sound of waves slapping against the outer hull drowns out all other noises.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Moist air laden with a mixture of rust, rot, and salt fills this section of the companionway.  A wide brush slathered with pitch lies on the floor next to a bucket of glossy black tar.  The ends of tar-soaked strips of oakum protrude from the hull where they have been crammed between planks, while even more gaps remain to be caulked.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Mess Hall]
description: Grime-covered portholes allow a modicum of light to sift in, revealing a fine haze of dust that drifts down through cracks in the warped deck overhead.  Wrought iron chains, each ending in black metal lanterns, dangle from exposed oaken beams over a long table that is bolted to the deck.  Flanking the table are two rough benches heavily scarred with claw marks.  Scattered upon every surface are half-eaten, moldy chunks of bread, fish, and eel.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Dust motes, dancing in the slanted rays of light with each creak of the gently rolling ship, drift down from the exposed oaken beams supporting the decking overhead.  Hanging from a hook on the splintered portside bulkhead is a single brass lantern, its flickering light casting odd shadows across the crooked deck planks.  Standing next to the lantern, in obvious need of repair, is a misshapen harpoon rack.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Warped planks give this section of the deck an uneven cant that is echoed in the fitted wooden boards of the bulkheads.  Tacked to the forward bulkhead by seven iron spikes is an enormous spotted walrus skin.  In one corner of the compartment, a large knot in the wood has been burrowed out by claw and fang to create a small rodent nest.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship]
description: Faded green paint peels from the wooden housing protecting the rough, square-shaped hatch that leads below deck, by way of some wooden stairs.  Tepid water forms a small puddle in the hatch cover, which lies discarded against the hemp stays of the main mast.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Main Mast]
description: Heavily wrapped trusses secure the lower yardarm to the tall, rough wooden mast.  Frayed hemp brails dangle from the unfurled mainsail and shift across the deck in the light, easterly breeze.  High above, nearly lost in the shadows of the topsails, is a dilapidated crow's nest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Ballista]
description: Bolted to the deck by thick iron pins is a sheet of blackened, wrought iron.  The long sheet extends from the 'midships stays to the wooden bulwarks, which are interrupted by a heavy wooden ballista.  Weathered copper plates cap the carved railing on either side of the ballistae, the corroded metal leaving a verdigris trail down the sun-bleached wood of the railing.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Wizard Guild, Alchemy Cauldron]
description: Set slightly apart from the bustle of activity in this wing, a serviceable iron cauldron stands ready for use by apprentice alchemists, suspended from the massive oak beams overhead by a wrought iron chain.  Below it, coals glow with an orange-red heat, wafting the acrid odor of burning charcoal upwards.

title: [Khazi's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the stone floor.

title: [Wyrwood Retreat, Practice Room]
description: This open, airy room has a smooth, polished floor that is covered by thick mats at the north end.  A large oak storage chest and a bramble-carved ironwood bench rest beneath the windows in the western wall, framing the doorway.  Wrought iron sconces supporting unlit oil lamps are set into the walls around the room.  Matching suits of armor are displayed on the east wall, and an ironwood rack holding a bow, a sword, and a shield hangs on the south wall.  Practice dummies stand in a row at the south end of the room.
location: Wyrwood Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Wyrwood Retreat, Barracks]
description: This open, airy room has a carved ironwood bed placed in the southeast corner of the smooth, polished floor.  A sturdy chest rests at its foot, and a wide shelf hangs on the south wall above the headboard.  Three identical beds are placed in a row on the other side of a doorway framed by two windows, each with a chest and shelf.  Wrought iron sconces supporting unlit oil lamps are set into the walls, and the north side of the room has a clear path to the dart board hanging on the east wall.
location: Wyrwood Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Meazernis Villa, Patio]
description: Lacquered bamboo dyed a warm red hue spreads across the simple patio to create an even floor, while matching poles are laced together on two sides to form narrow privacy walls.  High above, a lattice of woven bamboos creates an open roof that houses hundreds of tiny silver lace vines that create a natural canopy of verdant and white hues.  Painted screens of delicate rice paper frame a glass-paned white birch door that leads into the villa, while smooth round stones lead into the garden beyond.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Foyer]
description: Polished white birch flooring spreads northward from a glass-paned white birch door, its smooth face preserved beneath a clear varnish.  Tall and colorful, a linen mannequin stands opposite a wide porcelain urn that is filled with sand and painted with geometric patterns.  To the left and right of the entry, raised bamboo racks housing sandals, slippers, and shoes rest beneath hooks designed to house outer garments and similar small items.

title: [Cutters Tent]
description: Bright yellow canvas has been draped across thin iron poles, which also intersect directly in the center of the ceiling.  Displaying the goods for sale is a tiered table on one end of the tent, while on the other is a stand with makeshift shelves.  A tattered thick cotten rug with a faded image serves to smooth out the otherwise rough ground.

title: [Small Stuff, Attire]
description: Brilliantly aglow with a dazzling array of lanterns, the clothing section is spotless.  Some intricately carved oak stands line the east and west walls.  Several racks on either side display tiny articles of clothing.  The deep crimson rug edged with intricate gold threading continues in from the south maintaining the central aisle from which to browse the accessories.  An ornately gilded mirror stands proudly against the north wall, oddly out of place.

title: [Small Stuff, Workroom]
description: Brilliantly aglow with a dazzling array of lanterns, this area is extremely cluttered.  The walls of this space are nearly completely filled with bins of all shapes and sizes.  Various doll parts, from eyes to arms to legs and torsos, fill every bin.  An unfinished doll, missing her head, sits atop a large table that nearly fills the center of the room.

title: [Zenaxa's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a rainbow snail mosaic ceiling, an illuminated Zul Logoth map hangs on one of the pale sandstone walls.  A carved stone cabinet sits in one corner while a glazed ceramic snail planter rests on the invar-accented floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Annex]
description: Twin sconces are set opposite one another on the north and south walls here, their dim flames casting long shadows down the hallway in both directions.  The floor is composed of carefully chiseled granite blocks, each one set against the next at a slight angle, and the walls are polished marble blocks from floor to ceiling.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Cleric Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Arcane Studies]
description: Dramatically striated layers of reddish sandstone have been eroded to form this narrow chamber.  Soft beams of starlight filter in from high overhead, where the stone walls converge to a narrow slit.  The old rivercourse creates a narrow passageway to the south.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Winding Passage]
description: The dry rivercourse narrows here, forced into a channel between two granite intrusions.  The old riverbed descends steeply as it rounds the corner, falling away to the southeast.

title: [Alchemical Supplies]
description: An archway from the main chamber opens into this side passage, fitted out as a small shop.  Sealed boxes are stacked along the walls and fitted into natural ledges along the sandstone rock face, barely allowing passage around a large oak table that dominates the center of the room.  A pitted steel shelf is fastened along one wall, its rusting surface bending perceptibly under the weight of the various jars stored there.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Closet]
description: Hardly more than a narrow alcove, this cramped space is almost entirely taken up by a battered oak closet along one wall and a dented steel dust bin at the far end.  Emanating from a narrow cleft at the end of the alcove, the soft stirring of wings and high-pitched squeaks overhead suggest that a small colony of bats has taken up residence.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Stonemasons have adapted a natural widening in the cavern to create a moderately sized, nearly circular room.  A large brazier at the center dispels the pervasive dankness of the caverns.  Clusters of comfortable chairs are dotted around the brazier, surrounded by tottering piles of tomes.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldrons]
description: The low ceiling of this cavern is supported by a minor maze of sandstone columns, creating numerous alcoves where students of alchemy hunch over steaming cauldrons.  The irregular but insistent drip of water on stone from a far corner echoes with unusual clarity against the hard stone.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Winding Passage]
description: Nearly spherical gouges in the sandstone walls mark where strong eddies in an ancient, underground stream carved around a massive granite intrusion along the eastern face before descending further to the northeast.  A flickering light shines through a roughly triangular opening at the back of one of the gouges.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Nexus]
description: The ceiling of this large, circular chamber carved in the ochre-hued sandstone narrows as it rises to a narrow aperture directly overhead.  A complex cluster of lenses and prisms at the apex collects the starlight from above and sends it down in soft beams to the seven workshops along the periphery of the room, each set apart from the others by makeshift partitions of heavy silk rugs slung over wood frames.  The symmetry of the room is broken only by a roughly triangular opening in the eastern wall.

paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Winding Passage]
description: The passageway here appears to be a natural waterway, now dry, carved through the porous sandstone over long years by the relentless flow of an underground river.  A few steps have been carved at steeper portions of the descent towards the northwest.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Deep Alcove]
description: Carved from the soft sandstone by an eddy in an ancient underground river, this alcove has been adapted for use as an office.  The sparse but luxurious fittings look out of place among the unfinished rock; the exquisite parquetry desk of mahogany and ivory could be in a museum or palace, as could the hand-knotted tufted silk carpet on which it sits.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Winding Passage]
description: The old riverbed widens here, and as the room widens, so too does the sandstone ceiling lower until the dry channel becomes far too short for anyone to follow its southward course.  A streak of milky quartz cuts through the pale orange stone, its pale whiteness glowing dimly with an unnatural light.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Shop]
description: A natural rock shelf in the cavern has been converted into an impromptu shop.  Crates of newly-sawn pine form a neat line, displaying a modest collection of clothing.  Smaller boxes perched along alcoves in the rock contain an interesting assortment of wands and rods.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Lower Landing]
description: Torches set in simple iron sconces cast their flickering light across this small chamber.  Although its construction of heavy timbers and stone appears solid, its builders wasted no effort on ornamentation.  The top of a domed cistern is visible in one corner, its granite top pierced by a narrow opening.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Upper Landing]
description: The scents of freshly dug earth and ozone mingle unpleasantly in this cramped room.  The low ceiling is supported by roughly hewn planks supported by adze-cut posts, which also serve to brace the earthen walls.  The solid granite floors appear to be the natural bedrock, pierced by a staircase winding downward.  In stark contrast to the rough surroundings, a gleaming eahnor archway is set in one wall, flanked by a pair of stone panels.

title: [A Shadowy Corner]
description: The darkness here is almost tangible, muffling sound and sight.  No breath of wind disturbs the heaviness.  The floor is clean-swept, and a pair of square, stone panels, one of basalt and the other of chalcedony, are mounted on the rough boards of the barn's wall.

title: [Rustybeard's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by polished oak walls, the shop features a scaled model of Hearthstone in the center of its oak floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the golden oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a jewel-inlaid caddy and a gilded maple cabinet.

title: [Janlyn's Armory]
[Janlyn's General Store]
description: A curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the varnished ebonwood walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A bronzed drake sculpture sits in one corner of a speckled black marble floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter on the other.

title: [Scoti's Weaponry]
description: A portrait hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A bronzed drake sculpture sits in one corner of an enameled hardwood floor.  There is a gilded maple cabinet on one side of the shop.

title: [The Everlasting Wand Vault]
description: A midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A bronzed drake sculpture sits in one corner of a dark-stained oak floor.  There is an engraved copper bin on one side of the shop and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on the other.

title: [Solice's General Store]
description: Knotty pine walls rise from a dark-stained oak floor.  Just above a twisted iron candlestick hangs a twisted iron sconce, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A sooty brass urn and a bloodstained marble slab stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Aradhul Road, Bridge]
description: Thick limestone blocks form the middle section of a bridge that once stretched across the ravine below.  Wide, deep cracks, as well as numerous gaps where the stone has completely disintegrated, mar its surface.  Though still sturdy, large sections of the support columns have broken off and now litter the ravine floor below.  Each end of the bridge is completely missing, leaving jumping to either the north side or the south side of the ravine as your only option.

title: [Under the Moat]
description: Clouds of dust swirl about the narrow tunnel, its breadth barely enough to contain one body at a time.  Sharp pebbles and small pieces of slate litter the ground while thick dust obscures the view of what lies ahead.

title: [Empath Guild, Foyer]
description: Frescoes in a healing motif cast moonlit shadows over the foyer's pale limestone walls.  Semicircular in nature, the foyer boasts a slightly domed ceiling and two large glaesine skylights.  Small beds and tubs of healing herbs and flowers touched by starlight line the pale wood floor, and a large vine-limned archway leads west to a hallway.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Hall]
description: Wide blue-washed sandstone floors stretch down the hallway, covered down the middle with a light acantha green carpet.  A carved apple wood staircase curves upwards, and vertical matching apple wood moldings occur along the walls at regular intervals with limestone-potted sweetferns at the base of each.  A slender doorway pierces the wall opposite the staircase, while a large vine-limned archway leads east to a foyer.

title: [Empath Guild, Apothecary]
description: Slender shafts of moonlight from the narrow windows play along the colorful collection of jars and bottles on the shelves that line the wood-paneled walls.  A glass-topped maoral table abuts one wall, its glossy surface nearly obscured by stacks of boxes and crates, each stamped with an exotic pictograph.

title: [Ilera's Magic Shoppe]

title: [Warrior Guild, Metal Door]
description: A thick metal door sits here, evidently an afterthought.  Its construction is not up to elven standards, but it looks serviceable enough.  There is a large dent in the center of the door.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Door]
description: The large wood door's frame is propped up with a system of solid and well-anchored supports, allowing it to take all the abuse you can give it.

title: [Warrior Guild, Metal Door]

title: [Warrior Guild, Wooden Door]
description: Solidly constructed and built to last, a door stands between two thick branches.  It doesn't lead anywhere, but looks perfect for smashing open over and over.  A lone owl sits perched nearby, content to call out from time to time.

title: [Empath Guild, Upper Hall]
description: Canted ceilings of green-tinged glaesine sheets rise high overhead, held in place with verdigris copper mullions, and a few intrepid vines wind across the outer panes, having clambered up from the cloister columns below.  Luminous moonlight drifts through the vines and ceiling, highlighting a pale acantha green limestone floor with blue-washed linen carpets.  An apple wood staircase curves downward, and an array of shadowy viridian ferns clusters along the walls, almost obscuring a narrow door.

title: [Empath Guild, Closet]
description: This narrow room is thoroughly unremarkable.  Its wooden plank floor is heavily worn, though immaculately swept.  A large dust bin stands near the door, while a shallow supplies closet occupies the far end of the room.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Hall]
description: Indoor roses and pots of healing herbs line the apple wood-molded walls.  Expansive blue-washed sandstone floors are covered with light acantha green carpets, and five doors lead out of the main training hall.  Apart from all the doors, a dimly lit alcove is inset into one corner.

title: [Ornim's General Store]
description: A decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and a paneled haon ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a buffed cherrywood floor.  There is an ora-bound large walnut trunk on one side of the shop and a long mahogany rack on the other.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Sitting just off an expansive training hall, the alcove itself is also quite spacious, despite being a bit dim.  Scattered large  hunker among myriad smaller cauldrons, pots, and other implements, the clutter setting apart each larger piece from its neighbors and providing a modicum of privacy.  Multitudes of scuffmarks indicate years of cauldron shuffling with little regard for the blue-washed sandstone floor.  Ensconced in one dank corner, a woth flower flourishes.

title: [Velvette's General Store]
description: Smooth sandstone walls rise from a weathered cobblestone floor.  Just above an elven bowman statue hangs a fused sun and moon wall-hanging, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling completes the picture.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a Vornavian silk-covered table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Velvette's General Store]
description: Enclosed by smooth sandstone walls, the shop features a handblown double-heart bottle in the center of its cobblestone floor.  A midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs under the nightscape ceiling.  Right near the front is a brass treasure chest and some wrought-iron hooks.

title: [Velvette's General Store]
description: A round invar-framed window hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls, and a sturdy white cedar ceiling rises overhead.  A glazed ceramic snail planter sits in one corner of a weathered cobblestone floor.  There is a painted red cedar rack on one side of the shop and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on the other.

title: [Empath Guild, South Foyer]
description: A full-ceiling fresco of a lush medicinal garden tended by robed figures complements the pots of herbs lining the pale wood floor.  Pushed against one wall is a many-drawered apple wood apothecary cupboard topped with slate blue sandstone.  Twin pots of calamia and pennyroyal flank a glass door, thriving in the slightly humid air.

title: [Empath Guild, North Foyer]
description: A shuttered window at the terminal end of the northern portion of the foyer lets in traces of moonlight.  A potted valerian plant sits beneath the window, its pale pink petals translucent in the ambient light.  Carved with entwining cothinar and valerian blossoms, an oak door stands open, and frescoes of men and women practicing healing arts are painted on the slightly domed ceiling.

title: [Empath Guild, Office]

Matching bookshelves line one wall, filled with neatly organized scrolls, books, and parchments.  An unusual, potted plant occupies one corner by itself, nothing kept within its reach.

River water washes the smoothed ovals, sending up a constant susurrus that gently soothes.  The occasional swarm of miniscule gnats buzzes nearby with an annoying whine.

River water washes the smoothed ovals, casting a temporarily glistening sheen over each with every tiny wave.  Slender shadowy fish dart close, hovering near the sandy bottom, while searching for a winged snack.

title: [Mistydeep, South of Ravelin]
description: From this vantage point, the island appears silent and brooding, its lofty central stone spire looking down on an eclectic collection of dense trees and plant life.  The surface of the edifice reveals the handiwork of ancient masons as windows and platforms emerge from the tower's face, skillfully hewn from granite.  Details are obscure, but the imposing structure exudes an aura of desolation.  At the island's rim, a mottled brown lizard suns itself on a shelf of bedrock.

From this vantage point, the island appears silent and brooding, its lofty central rock spire overlooking a dense cluster of trees and plant life.  A thin shroud of fog enfolds the edifice, yet does not extend into the woods below.  Shifting shadows unveil gaping windows and jutting platforms skillfully hewn from the granite.  Details are obscure, but the structure exudes a haunting aura of desolation.  A ghost-white owl perched on a high branch lifts its head with a seeming challenge of, "Whooo!"

location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, South of Ravelin]
description: Silent and inscrutable, the river stretches languorously in all directions.  A packet boat appears, its crew bustling efficiently across its decks, carrying goods and passengers along the watery causeway.  Overhead, an eagle soars with wings outstretched and eyes intent on the area below, perhaps in search of a future meal.  The current pulls gently to the southeast, but seems in no hurry to get there.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Sorcerer's Isle, Forest]
description: Slight whiffs of decay from a ground covering of fallen leaves mingles with the thick scent of green wood, punctuated by the cinnamony spiced aroma of a bay laurel bush.  Birdsong is loud from above, greeted by a softer chorus of crickets hiding in the underleaf.  The earth has been tamped down in a couple of directions, winding off deeper into the forest.

title: [Blighted Forest, Treetop]
description: High in the branches of the oak, the thick growth of limbs, intersecting and crossing, offers an easy passageway between the trees.  The boughs are wide and easily traversed, and the moonlight is brighter here.  Far below, the dark maw of a chasm bordered by the narrow ledge of an overlook is occasionally visible through breaks in the dense foliage.

High in the branches of the oak, the thick growth of limbs, intersecting and crossing, offers an easy passageway between the trees.  The boughs are wide and easily traversed.  Far below, a dizzy chasm bordered by the narrow ledge of an overlook is occasionally visible through breaks in the dense foliage.

title: [Twilight Hall, Auditorium]
description: Twin twilight blue carpets cascade down the aisles among tri-sectioned rows of cushioned, mahogany benches.  Suspended above, a glass ceiling reflects and refracts starlight, sending it scattering to every corner of the room.  At one end of the auditorium lies a crescent-shaped dais of silver-veined alabaster in an alcove flanked by three large marble columns, each housing scarlet owl sconces, which cast a warm glow.  The banners of Twilight and the CHE hang in tandem from the translucent ceiling.

title: [Twilight Hall, Great Hall]
description: A huge hall stretches before you, a collection of artwork on display.  The high walls of cherry mahogany reach upwards to a vaulted ceiling made of marble the color of shadows on a cold winter's evening.  A tiled floor of fine Lysierian slate etched with a magical pattern catches your eye.  You feel drawn towards a pulse of power coming from somewhere nearby.

A tiled floor of fine Lysierian slate etched with a magical pattern catches your eye.  You feel drawn towards a pulse of power coming from somewhere nearby.

title: [Twilight Hall, Mystic Library]
description: Comfortable chairs line the walls of this library, which is filled with rows of shelves littered with musty vellum tomes and illuminated manuscripts.  Warm and brightly lit, this is the perfect place to hide from a cold, damp and otherwise dreary night -- suitable for both research and contemplation.

Comfortable chairs line the walls of this library, which is filled with rows of built-in bookshelves littered with musty vellum tomes and illuminated manuscripts.  Warm and brightly lit, this is the perfect place to hide from a cold, damp and otherwise dreary night -- suitable for both research and contemplation.

title: [Twilight Hall, Back Porch]
description: The polished black marble floor reflects the dim glow of several orbs of light that look like faint suns suspended in the black night sky.  Several tables have been arranged around the room, covered with black silk tablecloths.  The chairs are made of black-stained tanik wood cushioned with jet black velvet, which would be hard to see if not for the candles placed on some of the tables.

Across from the tables is a coraesine door, next to which is a scribed kakore dart board depicting an elaborate summoning circle that has been set into the wall above a copper owl decoy.

title: [Twilight Hall, Warble's Parlor]
description: The west end of the great hall opens up into a bright, airy parlor.  As you step into the room, your eyes are immediately drawn to an ancient elven harp set up on a small dais.  A plush snowcat rug covers the floor in front of a white marble fireplace, and white cushions made of the softest Arachnian silk lie scattered about the room, inviting you to relax and enjoy yourself.  A spiral staircase in one corner leads both upstairs and downstairs.

title: [Twilight Hall, Magical Workshop]
description: Crystal towers ward the four corners of the workshop.  Mana crackles and hums as it arcs between the orbs placed atop each, sending out tempestuous tendrils of energy writhing to and fro.  A table, littered with dozens of odd-shaped tools and potions, shimmers in the pyrotechnic display.

title: [Twilight Hall, The Weaving Room]
description: Mystic patterns form in the air before you, whispering to you of secret places and powers untold.  Stepping further into the room, tendrils of mana seem to form before you, each ringing with a tone of magic.  Reaching out with your senses, you feel compelled to weave the tendrils together into something greater, something that defines you.  A spiral staircase leads both upstairs and downstairs.

title: [Twilight, West Tapestry Room]
description: This is a small antechamber that leads to the House Lockers.  An ornate tapestry takes up one entire wall, and there are several chairs scattered about the room.

title: [Twilight Hall, Manny's Kitchen]
description: Warm and inviting, the fragrance of freshly baked bread lingers in the air of this spacious kitchen.  A small boy sits near the fire slowly turning a series of steel spits, while the Head Cook and her assistants bustle with the activity required to feed the membership.  Pots and kettles line the walls, and canisters of pungent spices stand atop the long counters.  An ebonwood pantry nestles amid the counters and various kitchen accoutrements.

title: [Twilight, Chamber of Darkness]
description: Dark and cavernous, your eyes take a moment to adjust to the minimal light of the chamber.  Shadows huddle in far recesses, cloaking mysteries that have never seen the light of day.  A quiet stillness pervades the chamber, allowing your senses to rest in peace.  In the center of the chamber stands a velvety black malachite altar that pulses with ebon light, while an unlit brazier stands behind it like a brooding sentinel.  A spiral staircase leads upstairs.

title: [Twilight Hall, Founder's Hall]
description: The hallway is panelled in a rich, dark wood and illuminated at one end, drawing your eyes to an exquisite painting.  A spiral staircase leads both upstairs and downstairs.

title: [Twilight, Kyrion and Warble's]
description: Warm and relaxing, the room looks quite comfortable -- a small wooden table and two soft chairs sit next to a large bay window that looks out over the lights of town.  One wall is completely taken by a fireplace framed by a marble mantelpiece, and you can see a cauldron simmering over bright orange flames within the hearth.  Piles of neatly organized maps rest neatly on one arm of a long sofa, and a broken harp string is draped carelessly over a wooden cabinet that stands next to it.
