title: [Twilight Hall, Manny's Room]
description: At first glance, this room appears to be nothing more than a warm and comfortable study.  Materials are strewn about in various piles, and a small unmade bed lies in a corner next to a wooden footlocker.  A tiny potted fern sits next to a wall relief of a shackled demoness with deep red eyes that seem to follow your every move.

title: [Twilight Hall, Kyrion's Refuge]
description: Tall vine-covered walls rise around the lush setting of the Refuge.  A stone path wends its way in sinuous patterns through verdant greenery that fills the area. Bushes trimmed in the shapes of various animals both real and legendary line the path, with benches placed in secluded areas for conversation and contemplation. A small artificial waterfall to one side cascades into a pool that beckons one to slip into its cool embrace.

title: [Twilight Hall, Grotto]
description: The pool is deep enough here to cover the shoulders of a halfling.  Enclosed on all sides by stone, the damp wall shimmers from the light of dozens of candles sitting on outcroppings of varying heights.  An effusive glow comes from the water, further lending to the gentle ambiance of the grotto.  Ledges line the edge of the pool, offering a convenient place to kick back and relax.

title: [Twilight Hall, Neighborhood]
description: The path angles away from the Hall for a small distance, until it opens upon a tree-lined square surrounded by quality acreage and four fieldstone longhouses, each with several unique doors.  At the center of the square, a fountain topped with a statue of a man gesturing as he casts a spell cascades into its marble pool.  A wide spiral staircase can be seen descending around the base of the fountain.

title: [Twilight Hall, A Wizard's Room]
description: A soft, warm glow fills the room, generated by floating orbs of light that seem to recede from you no matter which direction you approach from.  Comfortable furniture and tomes of magic fill every nook and cranny, and it becomes obvious the glowing orbs were created for the sheer pleasure of reading.  The most striking impression, however, is the ceiling.  It appears as a breathtaking surreal vista of the night sky, with magnificent comets and brilliant stars seeming to pulsate down at you.

title: [Twilight Hall, Rose Garden]
description: Roses in full-bloom entwine themselves around ornate trellises, their petals shifting softly in the whispering breeze.  The pathway spirals inward, its edges lined with countless bushes, each offering up a unique flower unlike any other in the garden.  Lilies, tulips, roses and daisies all combine to offer up a heady aroma that soothes the soul.  In the center of the garden stands a large gazebo, inviting you to stay a while.

title: [Twilight Hall, Gazebo]
description: Light and airy, the gazebo's tall ceiling has a large, slow-moving fan that is powered by an intricate pulley, rope, and gear system off to one side, and several cherry wood-framed silk screens, painted with natural scenes, help block some of the elements from reaching the gazebo's interior.  From this vantage point, the moon-shadowed garden surrounding the gazebo reveals a carefully crafted pattern designed to restore harmony and balance.

Light and airy, the gazebo's tall ceiling has a large, slow-moving fan that is powered by an intricate pulley, rope, and gear system off to one side, and several cherry wood-framed silk screens, painted with natural scenes, help block some of the elements from reaching the gazebo's interior.  From this vantage point, the sunlit garden surrounding the gazebo reveals a carefully crafted pattern designed to restore harmony and balance.

title: [Twilight, Kaikeyi's Bedchamber]
description: The dim lighting provided by numerous candles puts you immediately at ease, and you gaze around the room at the cozy furnishings.  A large bed dominates the center of the room, and a luxurious bearskin rug lies at its foot providing protection for your bare feet from the coolness of the floor.  A fragile modwir desk takes up one corner of this cozy bedchamber.

title: [Twilight Hall, Tarin's Room]
description: A menacing gargoyle is the first thing you see as you enter this sparsely furnished room.  The mein creature is perched on a pedestal near the door, and you can almost feel its baleful glare like an icy touch.  Black and silver banners drape the walls in a pleasing manner, lending a breath of nobility to the room.

title: [Twilight Hall, Frayo's Room]
description: Warm colored light shines through stained glass windows set in the tall circular walls.  Fragrant trails of incense linger with the smoke from an eight-candle chandelier.  A magnificent shrine to the goddess Lorminstra dominates the center of the room, her statue standing with hands outstretched to meet the fallen.  A snifter of fine cognac rests on a rosewood desk near the shrine.  Standing at the back of the room is a regal four-posted bed.  A sense of warmth, peace and order gently surrounds you.

title: [Twilight, Rayyne's Hideaway]
description: The crystalline walls of this spherical chamber glow softly with a subtle radiance, and a hint of perfume permeates the air.  Fresh black orchids are strewn across the floor and around a hot tub set off behind a spidersilk screen.  The mistress's eclectic interests become apparent as you survey the room - sumptuous gowns, leather pants, ancient tomes, and numerous objects d'art.  Nestled among comfortable cushions scattered about the room are a magnificent orb and a lustrous thanot box.

title: [Twilight Hall, Graeval's Room]
description: The high-ceilinged room is bright and cool with a fruity aroma.  A low haon-topped table, a brown leather sofa and two overstuffed blue chairs sit before a cozy fire in a stone fireplace.  In one corner is a neatly made bed with oaken wine casks as corner posts and an elaborately carved haon headboard depicting young maidens harvesting grapes from vines entwined about long rows of fences.  There is a small orchard in pots in front of a wide window through which streams sunlight and a pleasant breeze.

title: [Twilight, Lower Environs]
description: Illuminated by eight freestanding copper fire pits, these environs are meticulously clean and dry.  Light from the pits dances about the area, providing a warm, almost cheerful, glow.  The faint sound of flowing water echoes through the cavern, although no obvious source exists.  Carved into the bedrock are numerous chambers, many carefully fitted with secure frames and doors for privacy.  In the center of the cavern, a wide column rises up to the ceiling and beyond, a spiral staircase carved into its bulk.

title: [Twilight Hall, Rylandor's Den]
description: Rich, bone-white carpeting serves as a foundation for this luxurious and inviting den.  A grand bookcase dominates the right wall, storing an impressive collection of tomes.  Situated against the left wall are an antique desk and a liquor cabinet.  A lifelike statue of a hooded figure stands in the center of the room, seemingly scrutinizing all who enter the room.  Against the far wall a plush, black leather couch offers respite to weary feet.

title: [Twilight Hall, A Healer's Haven]
description: As a place to escape from the outside world, the dominating theme of this room is comfort.  A large soft bed waits for its owner's return.  Colorful, yet tastefully selected room furnishings compete with each other for your attention.  An inviting spotted puma throw lies in front of a modest fireplace.  You suspect this is a pleasant place to pass some time and are tempted to do so.

title: [Twilight Hall, Krakii's Room]
description: Carved into the very bedrock of the town, this room has obviously been crafted by skilled dwarven hands.  A small shrine sits almost unnoticed near the door, and the sleeping quarters are squirreled away in the back, almost hidden behind a craggy stalagmite.  Most visible, however, are a fireplace burning what looks like a young forest, a surprisingly well-stocked bar and several implements of death and destruction hanging within easy reach.

title: [Twilight Hall, Tens' Study]
description: The soft light in this study faintly illuminates a large coiled golden serpent that has been inlaid into the grey slate floor.  The serpent spirals gently inward from corner to corner, its massive head rising from the floor in the center of the room to provide a suitable base for a black glaes-topped worktable.  A small stone fireplace is set into the far wall of the study, surrounded by comfortable leather chairs and ottomans, and a crystal globe stands in the far corner.

title: [Twilight Hall, Chamber of Light]
description: As you enter the chamber, your eyes are drawn upwards to the cathedral heights of the crystalline dome.  A warm luminescence cascades about you, its hues dancing and shifting in a rainbow of patterns that leave you with a feeling of tranquility.  A fresh herbal scent lingers from the multitude of lush, verdant plants that hang along the walls.  A glimmer of understanding washes over you as you notice a simple stone altar resting in the center of the chamber.  A spiral staircase leads downstairs.

title: [Twilight, Kyrion and Warble's]
description: Thick heavily stitched hangings cover the windows, leaving this room bereft of natural light.  Dozens of candles in wall sconces and silver candelabra cast a soft glow across the room.  A large four-poster bed with a hanging silk canopy occupies much of the room, with an altar sitting in one corner.  A fine bow is mounted on one wall in a place of honor, above a nightstand containing several scrolls dotted with musical notes.

title: [Twilight Hall, Labyrinth]
description: Several identical passageways intersect here.  An uneasy feeling overtakes you as you begin to realize that this maze wasn't necessarily designed to keep you from finding your way in.  Perhaps it was made to prevent the escape of something within.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Twilight Hall, Mystic Pool]
description: A shallow, shimmering pool in the center of the floor of this dim, darkened room casts a reflection on one wall which seems to contain a message of some kind.

title: [Twilight Hall, Summoning Area]
description: A tinge of ozone lingers in the air as you look around this dimly lit room.  Scorch marks and rust-colored stains, possibly from experiments gone awry, adorn the area.  Your attention is drawn to a mysterious circle etched into the center of the floor, and your mind whirls as it tries to interpret the significance of the design.

title: [Twilight, East Tapestry Room]
description: This is a small antechamber that leads to the House Lockers.  An ornate tapestry takes up one entire wall, and there are several chairs scattered about the room.

title: [Twilight Hall, Lockers]
description: Several sturdy lockers line the walls here, decorated with elegant golden leafwork and intricate etchings.  Your locker has been removed from the shelf above and sits ready for you on a sturdy counter.

title: [Half Moon Table]
description: The black silk tablecloth is embroidered with very small silver half moons.  On the table is a silver plate shaped into a half moon which holds a flickering candle.

title: [Twilight Hall, Oven]
description: Roomy enough to hold a whole pig for roasting, the fit inside the oven is a bit snug for anything much larger.  Feeling the heat still radiating from the floor, you're glad the oven has been allowed to cool for a while.

title: [Golden Star Table]
description: A golden plate in the shape of a star serves as a base for a small candle which illuminates the table.  The tiny gold stars embroidered on the black silk tablecloth catch the candle light and reflect it back in a warm glow.

title: [Ronan Table]
description: Unlike the other tables, you notice this table doesn't have a candle.  The black silk tablecloth is embroidered with black swords which are only visible by their texture.  On the table is a figure of Ronan, all dressed in black and with eyes that reflect the light of the nearby tables.

title: [Black Sword Table]
description: A black imflass plate shaped in the form of a sword serves as the base for the candle.  The black silk tablecloth is embroidered with small silver swords.

title: [Sheru Table]
description: This is the darkest table in the room, not only because it's lacking a candle, but because it is the furthest away from any source of light in the room.  The black silk tablecloth is plain and devoid of embroidery.  On the table is a figure which represents Sheru, a black furred jackal's head with yellow eyes that shimmer with a light of their own.

title: [Beacon Hall, Locker Entrance]
description: This small, austere room is the entry point for the Beacon Hall lockers.  Two curtains are drawn over the openings to the storage area.

title: [Beacon Hall, Locker]
description: Rows of lockers line the shelves along the walls of this compact space.  Your locker has been removed from the shelf above and sits ready for you on a sturdy counter.

wayto.18888: ;e room = Room.current.id;fput 'go opening'; if ( room == Room.current.id ); fput 'close locker';move 'go opening'; end

title: [Cavern]
description: The sound of dripping water echoes off of the rough walls of the cave.  Large torches burn wildly, causing shadows to dance across the uneven stone surfaces.  A few steps lead up to an old altar that stands against one wall.  In the other direction, the light fades away into a deep, dark cavern.  Small mirrors are scattered along the wall of a large shaft that leads upward into blackness, and one large mirror is suspended just above the rock floor directly underneath the shaft.

title: [Dark Passage]
description: Total darkness surrounds you.  The walls and floor of the cavern are smooth and cold.  The only thing visible are the torches that are on the walls near the distant altar.

title: [Cavern, Altar]
description: An old, dusty altar is set in the center of this small raised area.  The wall behind the altar is bare except for a row of five rickety levers connected to a thick rope that leads upward.  Each lever has been painted a different color: yellow, blue, brown, red, and green.  The torch light flickers ominously across the walls and pillars that brace the heavy stone ceiling.

wayto.13441: ;e number = { '1' => 'first', '2' => 'second', '3' => 'third', '4' => 'fourth', '5' => 'fifth' }; result = dothistimeout 'look altar', 10, /^There is a strange grid on the altar.  Five rows are labeled with numbers and five columns are labeled with colors.  A red glow illuminates/; lever_hash = Hash.new; lever_hash['yellow'] = number[result.slice(/Yellow [0-9]/).slice(/[0-9]/)]; lever_hash['blue'] = number[result.slice(/Blue [0-9]/).slice(/[0-9]/)]; lever_hash['brown'] = number[result.slice(/Brown [0-9]/).slice(/[0-9]/)]; lever_hash['red'] = number[result.slice(/Red [0-9]/).slice(/[0-9]/)]; lever_hash['green'] = number[result.slice(/Green [0-9]/).slice(/[0-9]/)]; for lever,position in lever_hash; loop { result = dothistimeout 'pull ' + lever + ' lever', 3, /^You pull/; break if result =~ /#{position}/ }; end; move 'go step'; move 'go passage'; move 'go opening'

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: Total darkness engulfs this deathly cold room, yet the air feels charged with electricity.  At random intervals blue electricity crawls from the four walls to meet in the floor's center before disappearing.  In those moments the room is eerily illuminated, presenting obsidian surfaces polished to a mirror-like finish and with no apparent seams.  The constant magnified thump of a slow heartbeat is the chamber's only sound.

title: [River's Rest, House Clerk]
description: Rough planks of axe-hewn wood cover the walls of this small shadowed office.  An old carpet lies before a scarred wooden counter, the pattern unrecognizable.  Standing on uneven legs, a crude bench rests against the wall next to a broken crooked door.  Hanging from the far wall is a patchwork blanket sewn from sail material.  A rusted anchor stands in the corner, bits of coral still stuck to its surface.

title: [Mist Harbor, Vineyard]
description: Verdant foliage tumbles across the short wall of the vineyard, its lush tendrils seeking purchase in the dirt and stone that line the pathway.  Here and there, dragonflies flicker in and out of deep shadows cast by the large stone-faced building that towers over the area.  A blue and red-paned lantern hangs lightless to one side above an ornate bronze plaque.

Verdant foliage tumbles across the short wall of the vineyard, its lush tendrils seeking purchase in the dirt and stone that line the pathway.  Here and there, fireflies flicker in the deep shadows of the exotic and domestic plant life that threatens to consume the large stone-faced building that towers above the area.  A blue and red-paned lantern provides ample light to see by and also illuminates an ornate bronze plaque.
tags: meta:mapname:Isle of the Four Winds - Cleric Guild

title: [Dark Elf Table]
description: Pushed into a far corner, this is one of the darkest tables in the room.  A pair of framed scrolls hangs on the wall behind this table, each one marked with images of the noble Houses of Ashrim and Faendryl.

title: [Shadowguard Table]
description: The center of this table is intricately carved into a battle scene.  An elven man weilding a veil iron sword leads an army against a horde of arch liches.  The glass covering protecting this magnificent illustration helps bring the scene to life.

title: [Darkstone Table]
description: An immense painting of Darkstone Castle looms over this table like a menacing sentinel.  The grey skies surrounding its dark walls are pierced by wild lightning streaks racing from the epicenter of the mana storm hovering over the castle parapets.

title: [Talbot Table]
description: A small dagger thrust into the wall supports a brass plaque.  On the table beneath the plaque stands a small statue of a halfling warrior.

title: [Drake Table]
description: This table sits under a towering stained glass window depicting a craftsman's vision of a Great Drake locked in combat with an Ur-Daemon.  Sunlight shines through the brightly colored panes, imposing their image upon the teak surface.

title: [Barking Rolton Table]
description: This table is situated at the far end of the room, but the windows still provide a wondrous view of the lovely town of River's Rest.  Carved over the table are roltons in various poses.

title: [Blood Eagle Table]
description: The scent of pine at this table is nearly overwhelming.  The chairs are constructed from wooden table legs, etched with images of screeching blood eagles.  There are some markings scrawled on the table top, but you cannot make them out.

title: [Calm Krolvin Table]
description: You note that this table is made from driftwood, which still seems a little damp.  As you glance around the room you notice that the walls have been painted with a beached warfarer sloop.  On its deck are several calm-looking Krolvins, gazing serenely at a boarding party.

title: [Clammy Cave Table]
description: This table-top is hewn from local granite set with glittering stones.  The walls and ceiling here have been painted in dark, muted tones of blue and grey.  The entire effect is like sitting in a cave, though one with comfortable chairs.

title: [Peg-Legged Krolvin Table]
description: This table seems fairly stable, considering it has but three legs, one edge braced against a wall.  Over your head is a painting of a dwarf, a halfling and a mule walking into a bar.  Somehow, you suspect there's a tale behind that.

title: [Sandy Breezes Table]
description: The floor beneath you is covered with sand.  You think you can hear the sounds of the ocean gently rolling in the distance.  The ceiling is painted with a summer night in the heavens above River's Rest.

title: [Lazy Falls Table]
description: If you strain, you can almost hear the sound of a gently flowing waterfall amidst the hustle and bustle of the restaurant.  The walls here are painted a light blue and adorned with hanging flower pots.

title: [Snapping Crab Table]
description: The modwir table-top is carved with images of crabs.  Most are scurrying about and snapping their pincers.  One chubby fellow in the center, however, almost seems to be grinning.

title: [Clumsy Kobold Table]
description: In the center of this monir table is a statuette of a kobold, facing the wall with a vacant grin.  The table itself is carved with images of kobolds falling over themselves, sticking each other with javelins, trying to walk three-abreast through a door just two kobolds wide, and so on.

title: [Drunk Kobold Table]
description: This banged up table sits by itself in a lonely corner of the room.  Many discarded containers are scattered about.  The haphazard area around the table looks slimy with spilled drink, and some of the refuse seems to crawl around on its own.

title: [Dilapidated Pier Table]
description: Like the pier that is its namesake, this table is made from old, weather-beaten wood with knot holes so large you fear you may drop your drink through one.  Carved on the top of the table is a picture of a few townsfolk throwing someone off a pier.

title: [Beacon Hall, Vault]
description: A cabinet spans one wall from floor to ceiling, while numerous shelves and containers clutter the other walls and line the floor.  A trunk and a chest fight for space in one corner, and a large tome sits atop a lectern, looking very out of place.

title: [Northern Fortress, Museum]
description: Filled with shelves of old books and diagrams of historical battles, this hall smells of dust and old parchment.  Illuminated by three narrow windows set side-by-side into one wall are several tapestries and frescoes that liven up the otherwise bare stone walls.  Providing a means of rest and relaxation, comfortable couches sit back-to-back on the varnished, oak-planked floor.  A polished brass plaque has been affixed to the wall.

Filled with shelves of old books and diagrams of historical battles, this dimly lit room glows faintly by moonlight that filters through the windows on the far wall.  Tapestries and frescoes liven up the stone walls, yet the chamber smells of dust and age.  Providing a means of rest and relaxation, comfortable couches sit back-to-back on the varnished, oak-planked floor.  A polished brass plaque has been affixed to the wall.

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: Thick, woody, dark green vines make up the walls, floor and ceiling of this misshapen chamber.  Weak shafts of sunlight squeeze their way between the vines to dimly illuminate the area.  Blackened tendrils pulse and writhe on the floor as sparkling discharges of crimson energy keep time to a distant heartbeat, racing along the tendrils to converge in the center of the living floor.  The chamber sways and groans back and forth, as if it was high in a tree somewhere being buffeted by a brisk wind.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemy Nexus]
description: Wind whips through the open air stone room, the scent of the sea thick in the air and accompanied by the sound of crashing waves.  Five platforms extend from the immediate area and beyond them in all directions lies an endless expanse of dark water.  A glimpse over the edge of the platform reveals its location atop a great stone tower anchored in the sea, hundreds of feet above the surface of the water.  In the center of the platform stands a pillar, behind which descends a staircase.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage]
description: Far cooler than the outdoor platforms above, the room is dimly lit by two feeble candles placed on two large wooden stands opposite each other by opposing walls.  Much of the wall space is covered in large wooden shelves and a series of cabinets replete with many small wooden drawers.  A few inches of dust cover much of everything, including the floor, revealing a number of tiny clawed footprints.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Test Platform]
description: The area is composed of a stone platform, extending out from the main tower.  A stone workbench is situated in the center of the area and is accompanied by a rusting metal pedestal.  Moonlight casts dark shadows across the floor from the workbench and the pedestal.  Several large wooden cages sit neatly stacked to one side of the area.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Test Platform]
description: The area is composed of a stone platform, extending out from the main tower.  In the center of the floor rests a slightly damaged workbench.  The floor surrounding the workbench is scorched with black marks which radiate out from the center to the edges of the platform.  The skeleton of a small winged creature lies partially destroyed and scattered to one side of the area.  The shine of the moons floods the area with a strong white light.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Test Platform]
description: The area is composed of a stone platform, extending out from the main tower.  In the center of the floor rests a stone workbench and what remains of metal container sits next to the edge of the platform.  Burned into the floor are dark lines which form a pentagram surrounded by three smaller circular designs.  Moonlight floods the area, creating a surreal layer of luminescent silver across all surfaces.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Test Platform]
description: The area is composed of a stone platform, extending out from the main tower, and is mostly bare except for a stone workbench set in the center of the room and a series of broken metal cages strewn across the floor.  Moonlight reflects off the cages in luminescent lines of silver.  Part of the platform has collapsed into the pitch black sea below, the edges of the ruined stone floor marked with scorch marks and dark stains.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Test Platform]
description: The area is composed of a stone platform, extending out from the main tower, and is mostly bare except for a stone workbench set in the center of the room.  The ocean below is completely dark, noticeable only by the distant sound of waves crashing against the base of the tower.  Moonlight floods the area.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Store Room]
description: Dust covers everything in the chamber with a translucent dullness, the exception being a worktable set in the center of the room and a single long shelf placed on the wall behind it.  A single candle situated atop a cast iron stand offers just enough light to reveal a well-trod path through the thick dust covering the floor to the worktable.

title: [Sorcerer's Guild, Guild Shop]
description: The elegant decor of the foyer extends here, as does the use of the black candles that light the room.  Crimson carpeting spreads from wall to wall and softly cushions each footstep.  The north wall, paneled in dark walnut like the others, holds a large banner.  A young clerk stands discreetly in a small alcove off to one side, behind the mannequin displaying wares for purchase.  Upon a shelf set into the southern wall an array of wands, rods and other small items awaits your inspection.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Courtyard]
description: White limestone blocks punctuated by burled oak window frames form sturdy walls for this guild hall.  A roof composed entirely of driftwood presents interesting contours and twisting patches of light and shade atop the hall, while double doors of bamboo and lattice construction stand open, inviting entry.  Above the doors a painted insignia looms ominously, and a burled oak plaque mounted next to the doors announces the ownership of the hall.  Torches stand next to the doors, illuminating the entry.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Foyer]
description: Intriguing driftwood wall carvings stand out against the cool white limestone of this open foyer.  A soft warm wind drifts through the openings between the thatch roof and wall tops.  The bare limestone floor reflects the sunlight that shines through the front windows to illuminate the entire room.  Hallways lead northwest and southwest, and double doors open to the east.  Several torches await the coming of night.

title: [Guild Master Austeare's Office]
description: A framing of thick bamboo holds heavy canvas sheets stretched tightly across the support work to form this small office.  Here and there slits in the canvas allow the sunlight to filter through, and the cant of the double roofed canvas is enough to prevent rain from streaming in through the openings.  A simple driftwood desk occupies a corner with a wicker chair behind it while several other wicker chairs lazily pose around the limestone floor.  Torches await the onset of night.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Amphitheater]
description: Tiers of lattice benches encircle a small dais in this spacious amphitheater.  A matching lattice covering supported by sturdy bamboo poles extends over the entire area, filtering the moonlight while allowing a warm breeze to waft gently through.  The amphitheater appears to have been painstakingly carved from a massive limestone shelf.  Steps lead down from the main entrance to a pair of small steps at the north end of the dais.  Torches brightly illuminate the area from advantageous points.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: This center of knowledge also seems to serve as the center of traffic for the Guild.  Smooth, cool limestone flooring leads off to the north, northwest, northeast and west, while a ramp leads steeply upward to the south.  This windowless room holds thousands of manuscripts on magic, history, geography, and a myriad of other subjects.  Easy chairs scattered about provide places to rest and read, each accompanied by a standing brass lamp.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: This sturdy burled oak platform rises fifty feet into the air, considerably higher than most surrounding Solhaven buildings.  The platform has been painted black to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off light from the city below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  The soft warm breeze causes the platform to sway a bit.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Arcane Studies]
description: Opaque mist forms the basis of this rotund chamber.  It has no physical walls nor any structure that lends it solid form.  Passageways created by the parting of mist open and close within a moment's notice at the beckoning of the Arcane Masters who buzz around the chamber at an almost frenzied pace attending to their tasks.  The world away from this room is completely obscured, and your existence is likely obscured from the world, with the exception of an opening in the mist directly in front of a rune-carved door.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Magic Workshop]
description: Something has badly battered this burled oak panelled room.  Many of the wall and ceiling boards are smashed and twisted, showing signs of massive impact and allowing moonlight to stream into the room.  In other spots short boards have been nailed over holes or used to secure the broken panelling.  The limestone floor is pitted and scarred, and here and there pieces of metal are imbedded in the stone.  In stark contrast to its damaged surroundings, a shiny iron chest squats near the center of the room.

title: [Unknown]
description: A large, well-dressed adult troll stands in front of a long black slate mounted on the east wall, alternately marking on it with a piece of chalk and gesturing at the group of young trolls gathered on benches in front of it.  Two doors lead out of this austere room, one north and one south.  A spacious cage resides in the northeast corner with a cramped cage beside it.  Moonlight streams in from large windows covered with opaque white strips of metal hung in a series.  Silence pervades the area.

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: The cedar planks and supports containing this small room creak ominously, as if bearing a huge weight.  A thriving colony of sea lichen blankets the floor, and a single guttering torch casts a pale illumination in this hot, salty room.  Strange pulsations and rings of reddish light move underneath the lichen, inward from the walls to meet at the room's center.  The constant magnified sound of a slow heartbeat reverberates in the chamber.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage Room]
description: Curving walls are fitted with felt-lined shelves, each housing a variety of jars, canisters, and bins that are labeled in precise detail as to their contents.  Low counter tops ring the room beneath the shelves and provide clean spaces for measuring, grinding, and a variety of other alchemy tasks.  A scribe's desk is set near the intersection of the two storage rooms and has a tall stool before it.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage Room]
description: Floor to ceiling shelves of refurbished driftwood line the limestone walls and are held in place by wrought iron anchors.  Brass lanterns dangle from the ceiling upon matching chains and provide adequate illumination for viewing the contents of the shelves.  A brass-banded knotted oak footlocker that houses rags, cloths, and dustpans is set between a narrow closet and a large dust bin.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Study Hall]
description: Curving subtly, the smooth limestone walls create a circular room fitted with tiny alcoves.  At the center of the room is a large, round sandstone table that is ringed by backless armchairs fashioned of embossed leather.  Shelf-lined walls glimpsed at the far end of the room bespeak storage shelves illuminated by grass lanterns, while moonlight can be seen trickling from beneath the ebon curtains adorning each alcove.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemic Room]
description: Moonlight slants through the driftwood-framed windows that break up the stark white monotony of the limestone walls.  Orderly rows of alchemy devices placed upon a white-washed oak workbench gleam in the golden light and provide ample illumination for the tiny alcove.  A dark ebon curtain is framed by brass lanterns, which currently burn brightly.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemic Room]
description: Moonlight slants through the driftwood-framed windows that break up the stark white monotony of the limestone walls. A dark ebon curtain is framed by brass lanterns, which currently burn brightly.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Corridor]
description: Smooth limestone walls connect the library and alchemy rooms, their expanses capped by driftwood rafters fitted together by blackened wrought iron bands.  Dangling above the smooth, polished floors is a series of coned globes filled with oil that serve to illuminate the austere passage.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tub Room]
description: Condensation drips from the ceiling and runs down the burled oak walls to disappear into a drain in the far corner, leaving the floor slick with moisture.  A spacious tub has been set on the oak floor, and hot seawater swirls and foams within.  A metal vat is securely bolted against the wall with a pipe and a chain hanging down just above the tub.  Wide driftwood steps lead into the tub's churning waters.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Hot Tub]
description: You walk up the driftwood steps and lower yourself down into the hot, swirling seawater, its warmth gently massaging your muscles and relaxing your mind and body.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Relaxation Deck]
description: Moonlight bathes this redwood deck, coolly illuminating the chairs and recliners scattered across the plank surface.  Torches inset in the deck blaze brightly, trying to offset the moon's coolness with their warmth.  The waters of the bay serenely lap at the beach directly below, and a soft, warm breeze blows gently over the deck.  Several red, black and silver umbrellas stand or lean at various points, no longer needed now that the sun has retreated for the night.

Sunlight bathes this redwood deck, warming the chairs and recliners scattered across the plank surface.  The waters of the bay serenely lap at the beach directly below, and seagulls wheel lazily, eying the water in anticipation of the next meal.  Several red, black and silver umbrellas stand or lean at various points on the deck, shading those who disdain exposure to the sun.  Torches inset in the deck railing quietly await the coming night.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tub Room]
description: Condensation drips from the ceiling and runs down the ironwood walls to disappear into a wide drain grate in the far corner, leaving the floor slick with moisture.  A spacious brass tub has been set into the ironwood plank floor, and hot water swirls and foams within.  A metal vat is securely bolted against the wall with a pipe and a chain hanging down just above the tub.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Hot Tub]
description: You slowly lower yourself into the hot, swirling water, its warmth gently massaging your muscles and relaxing your mind and body.

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: The walls, floor and ceiling of this chamber are solid, seamless, unbroken ice.  Illumination arises from the glowing floor.  There, underneath the ice, veins of crimson energy flow from the walls toward the center of the room.  The rivers of energy pulsate, matching the deep thumping of an unseen beating heart.

title: [Unknown]
description: A huge blood red sun shines malevolently over a cracked, dusty land.  A few bushes and scrub grasses fight for survival.  The remains of a large tree trunk stand just to the west, and a black hole looms to the east.  The landscape is dominated by hillocks of burnt ochre stone, and a stiff wind stirs the dust into heavy, tight cyclones.  The view wavers as if heat was rising from this purgatory, but nothing is felt, nor heard, nor smelled, nor tasted...only seen.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Foyer]
description: Thick white polar bear fur covers the floor leading off to the east and west.  The snarling heads of arctic wolverines adorn the ironwood walls, and long slabs of mammoth tusk ivory form floorboards and headboards along each wall section.  Two freestanding candelabras carry ten candles each to illuminate the room.  In one corner a winding staircase leads downward, and frigid air intrudes through a pair of double doors.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Courtyard]
description: A squat structure built from thick ironwood stands just ahead, its double doors open.  Warm, moist air wafts out to freeze solidly on the trees in this courtyard.  Ivory bars gleaned from mammoth tusks are placed in between the ironwood beams and siding, breaking up the monotony of dull brown wood with polished white rectangles.  To the left of the squat structure a four-story tower rises, and a chimney extends thirty feet up from the tower's roof, belching steam that freezes to fall as gentle snow.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Meeting Cavern]
description: Sharp stalactites hang menacingly from above in this enormous basalt cavern, and twisted nooks and recesses in the walls form mysterious dark passages.  Large pipes extend from floor to ceiling in four areas of the cavern.  A raised white marble dais occupies the north wall beneath a huge banner, and torches burn brightly along the smoother portions of the surrounding walls.  Covered by white polar bear fur, the floor supports rows of benches in tiers rising from the dais to the back of the cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Den]
description: Dark walnut paneling and open beam construction make this room seem more spacious than it really is.  White polar bear furs and brown grizzly hides cover the floor, presenting comfortable places where one can just flop down and rest.  Trophy heads from tigers, pumas, and other fierce local beasts adorn the walls, appearing very much alive in the flickering firelight.  Two massive mammoth tusks leap out from the wall above a huge white sandstone fireplace that provides the room's only illumination.

title: [Guild Master Stark's Office]
description: Small brass lanterns mounted in the walnut paneling cast a dim glow around this small office.  An ironwood desk with accompanying chair occupies one corner, and several straight-backed chairs cower against the wall in the opposite corner.  Interlocked strips of ivory and ironwood, polished to a high sheen, cover the floor from wall to wall and echo any footsteps.  Austere and serious are words that might be applied to this office.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemy Nexus]
description: Shelves line the east and west walls while entrances to the alchemical workrooms fan out to the north and south.  The ceiling and floors pulse in a slow, deliberate rhythm, their edges concealed by, or possibly composed of, an opaque black mist.  A circular work surface, fitted with mortars at each compass point, occupies the center of the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest, up

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: Rows of dark ironwood bookcases stretch from floor to ceiling, each shelf heavily laden with books and other assorted reading materials.  Small desks nestle between the bookcases to provide quiet places for study and contemplation.  A single brass oil lantern glows on each desk, and these islands of light provide the only illumination in this windowless room.  The thick polar bear fur carpet effectively muffles the sound of footsteps, and a stern-looking librarian keeps a close watch on the patrons.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Arcane Studies]
description: Opaque mist forms the basis of this rotund chamber.  It has no physical walls nor any structure that lends it solid form. title: [Sorcerer Guild, Magic Workshop]
description: The surfaces of this room glow brightly as if something is disturbing the essence of the materials themselves.  The ironwood planking and mammoth tusk ivory swirl and blur, making it difficult to see the actual outlines of the walls.  An unseen, unfelt wind ripples the white polar bear fur carpet, and the ceiling appears to expand and contract.  The outlines of robed figures suddenly appear as dark spots on the walls only to fade into the bright glow.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: The summit of the tower spreads out in a large, round platform.  The platform has been made from black marble to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off light from the city below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  A large pipe rising from the platform's floor belches steam thirty feet above the platform.

Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Alchemical Workshop]
description: Concentric rings of muted color ripple inward from the walls, compressing to a point in the center of the room before disappearing.  Hovering around a foot off the ground, a block of an unknown, matte black substance provides a stable work surface.  Overhead, a narrow skylight allows a spear point of natural light to enter the workroom and scatter into dazzling motes when it hits the floating workbench, illuminating a striated glass alembic, a crucible, and a platinum gem lens assembly.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Supply Closet]
description: Cave-like, with a low ceiling and a slightly uneven floor, this space is tucked both behind and beneath the curve of the staircase.  A dust bin resides in the shortest part of the room, while the taller area houses a sturdy, yet utterly mundane, broom closet.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Guild Shop]
description: Thick redwood paneling serves to keep the chill from the cold basalt walls from seeping in.  The faintly glowing pipes running along two walls prevent the bitter cold beyond the walls from being noticeable unless one rests against one of the many stalagmites or stalactites.  A mannequin of ivory rests atop one of the numerous polar bear fur rugs in one corner.  In the center is a lone stalagmite, squared off at the top with several small objects resting in the grooves cut for them.

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: Archaic, sanguine runes blanket the black granite surfaces of the chamber, glowing with an eerie crimson light.  The air is electric with energy, almost too cloying to breathe as an ever-present hum cycles in volume, building to deafening crescendos.  Intermittent waves of crimson flow forth from the heart of the floor, radiating outwards through the shadowy stone floor and into the walls.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Workshop]
description: Striations of cinnabar crystal are clearly visible along the lower portion of the walls and all along the floor.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A striped brown and grey curtain leads back out to the main cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Landing]
description: A trio of giant luminescent toadstools resides upon the landing, casting each third of the area in a slightly different hued light.  Thin veins of crystal weave across the stone walls, creating fanciful patterns against the darker rock.  The floor is punctuated by a few stout stalagmites around the perimeter.

title: [Unknown]
description: Beneath a crimson sky, a lush jungle extends as far the eye can see with vibrant, deep cerulean foliage.  Skeletal parrots watch the movement below from atop their leafy perches, especially the struggle of some poor unfortunate creature being devoured by a carnivorous pink and yellow flower.  A raging green waterfall tumbles off a steep cliff nearby, the viridian water teeming with bony fish.  A pair of glowing eyes peer out of a hollow tree stump.  The bizarrely picturesque area is disturbingly absent in all other sensation.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tunnel Nexus]
description: Slivers of azurite crystal have been inlaid into a dizzying spiral pattern upon the cold stone floor.  The slightly arched ceiling has been carved with a swirling design that faintly resembles flowing runes.  Against the western wall, a set of onyx-inlaid doors are flanked by two recessed alcoves that house stairways leading to the lower level.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tunnel]
description: Light filters in from above, pushing back the darkness in the tunnel to the west.  The walls are rough and uneven, though the stone floor has been intentionally smoothened.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, West Rise]
description: Reflective flecks of quartz and mica glimmer along the small tiles lining the web of walkways along the western rise of the cavern.  Lacy, glowing bluish-grey moss clings to the edges of the several large holes, highlighting the openings that lead to the guild's alchemical workshops.  A faint odor of sulfur and salt lingers in the air.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storeroom]
description: Tidy rows of shelving line the walls here, spanning from floor to ceiling and completely stocked with alchemic ingredients.  A pair of giant luminescent toadstools shed a soft white light in opposite corners of the storeroom.  Shadows linger in the area beyond a short tunnel.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Workshop]
description: Striations of cinnabar crystal are clearly visible along the lower portion of the walls and all along the floor.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A striped brown and grey curtain leads back out to the main cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Workshop]
description: Striations of cinnabar crystal are clearly visible along the lower portion of the walls and all along the floor.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A striped brown and grey curtain leads back out to the main cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Workshop]
description: Striations of cinnabar crystal are clearly visible along the lower portion of the walls and all along the floor.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A striped brown and grey curtain leads back out to the main cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Shadow Cavern]
description: Lacking any luminescent fungi, the only illumination comes from the cavern walls that are densely covered with glowing moss in shades of blue, green, and occasionally, crimson.  The less intense light casts a complex pattern of subtle, crisscrossing shadows upon the rock floor from the stalactite and stalagmite formations.  Several branching paths have been outlined in glassy, reflective stones.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Workshop]
description: Striations of cinnabar crystal are clearly visible along the lower portion of the walls and all along the floor.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A striped brown and grey curtain leads back out to the main cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, South Rise]
description: Visible in the darkness, numerous small chambers have been carved into the walls to create private training areas.  Some of the cavern's glowing moss dangles over several of the curtains draped over the man-made openings.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, North Rise]
description: A particularly large stalagmite has been incised with incarnadine sigils in separate, distinct rings.  The floor slopes gently upward towards the cavern's perimeter, leading to a series of curtained openings at regular intervals along the wall.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldron Room]
description: Dominating this small chamber is an enormous blackened iron cauldron, occupying nearly half the space available.  Glowing red coals radiate oppressive heat from the pit situated below the cauldron.  A dark sepia-hued curtain has been draped across the large hole leading back into the main cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage Room]
description: Storage space has been bored out of the stone walls, and various nooks have been fitted with iron-braced shelving.  A goodly number of supplies stock the shelves, replenished by the assistants that regularly pass through.  In one particular corner, a sturdy invar cabinet stands beside a few empty crates.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: Numerous glaes-paneled shadow boxes line the smooth stone walls, housing petrified toadstools, large uncut gems, and antique relics.  A plush, sanguine rolton wool rug lies at the foot of a polished black granite desk with burnished brass accents.  Situated in the far corner is an immense, mithril-traced chest with no visible lock or means to open it.  The faint aroma of brimstone lingers in the air, wafting from a hanging invar censer.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tunnel]
description: Faint striations of crimson are visible within the stone walls, highlighted by the luminescence of giant toadstools.  Some large carved stone doors stand at the end of the tunnel, right beside a peculiar sphene chip mosaic.

wayto.19001: ;e loop { wait_until { Spell[704].affordable? }; result = cast(704, 'mosaic'); break unless result =~ /Spell Hindrance/ }

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Numerous fluted pillars of inky black marble line the uppermost walkway that runs along the perimeter of the circular meeting hall.  Nondescript stone benches have been arranged in concentric circles, each tier slightly higher than the last.  A prominent lectern stands upon the small dais at the bottom level.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Antechamber]
description: Hewn from the surrounding rock, the antechamber is spacious with smooth, polished walls, floor, and ceiling.  A quartet of dark granite pillars lines the walkway leading further into the guild.  Erected between two of the columns is a shiny, obsidian obelisk adorned with shimmering gold.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tunnel]
description: Running along the center of the tunnel is a row of potted, luminescent toadstools.  The fungi cast a cheerful white light, illuminating a pair of pale blue granite doors and the grey marble door standing across the way.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Lounge]
description: Faceted chips of sphene and quartz have been inlaid across the walls and ceiling, creating a fanciful pattern of colors across the drab stone.  Heavy emerald green woolen curtains partition the lounge into several cozy nooks, replete with gem-inlaid settees and leather-cushioned chairs.  At the center of the room is a thick-legged bronzed metal table offering an array of food and refreshments.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: Tidy rows of well-kept tomes line the orderly series of stone shelves that tower overhead.  Cushioning the footfalls of perusing sorcerers are plush, vermilion runners that line the wide paths between the stacks.  Numerous chocolate brown armchairs have been arranged in cozy circles around glaes-topped tables lit by miniature luminescent toadstools.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Guild Shop]
description: A profusion of luminescent green and blue moss clings to the rocky ceiling, a vibrant sea of light that brightly illuminates every nook and cranny.  Tidy reinforced steel racks and shelves hold an abundance of sorcery materials available to guild members for the right price.  In a bare corner of the shop, a vibrant wall scroll has been nailed up alongside a painted sign.

wayto.18995: ;e loop { wait_until { Spell[704].affordable? }; result = cast(704, 'scroll'); break unless result =~ /Spell Hindrance/ }

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Arcane Studies]
description: Opaque mist forms the basis of this rotund chamber.  It has no physical walls nor any structure that lends it solid form.  Passageways created by the parting of mist open and close within a moment's notice at the beckoning of the Arcane Masters who buzz around the chamber at an almost frenzied pace attending to their tasks.  The world away from this room is completely obscured, and your existence is likely obscured from the world, with the exception of an opening in the mist directly in front of a rune-carved door.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Courtyard]
description: A bright white edifice stands in the center of the grassy courtyard.  Thick marble columns support the building's wings that sweep away, out of sight, to encompass the glass-domed center portion, matched by tall junipers that repeat the arc in living green.   Torchlight flickers eerily through the dome from within.  Flames from glistening brass sconces mounted on the fluted marble columns light the crimson, black and silver insignia mounted over a massive door of polished dark walnut.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Foyer]
description: This long hallway extends in a gentle arc to the northeast and northwest.  Silver chandeliers hang from the ceiling, the flames from their white candles reflecting brightly off the mirrored walls.  The walls duplicate the chandelier' appearances, giving the effect of a huge room full of chandeliers diminishing in all directions.  A mirrored postern blends virtually seamlessly into the wall, leaving double doors to the north and a massive door to the south as the only intrusions on the radiant effect.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Relaxation Room]
description: Overstuffed chairs and sofas rest on plush silver carpeting in this elegant resting room.  Several large paintings illuminated softly by nearby lanterns hang on the walls.  A fire burns merrily in the spacious fireplace, its mottled grey granite a soft contrast to the surrounding dark brown walnut paneling.  A refreshment cart in the corner offers several tasty and refreshing selections.

wayto.19029: ;e loop { wait_until { Spell[704].affordable? }; result = cast(704, 'oil painting'); break unless result =~ /Spell Hindrance/ }

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: This sturdy ironwood platform rises fifty feet into the air, considerably higher than most of the surrounding terrain.  The platform has been painted black to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off reflected light from below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  The soft warm breeze causes the platform to sway a bit.

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: The room shifts and heaves, making it difficult to stay standing on the slick floor.  The $-13494M, floor, and ceiling contract and expand, stretching and then snapping back to form an irregular sphere.  The surfaces are mottled and hot, looking and feeling more like raw flesh than anything else.  Veins of glowing crimson liquid run down walls, under the surface, to enter a sucking wound in the center of the floor.  The liquid moves to the sound of a beating heart and barely illuminates the cramped chamber.

title: [Unknown]
description: The bustle of crowds making their way between secular centers of town that converge here carries people along with its momentum.  The granite and marble facade of the First Provincial Bank stands solidly, a strange-looking guard armed with pike and crossbow posted at the door.  A number of well-dressed reptiles congregate outside.  Dwarves, elves, halflings and humans move in the crowd, but there are also more snakelike creatures, gnomes and furry, catlike sorts, although no one seems to take notice.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Massive white marble pillars support a glass roof arching over this spacious circular meeting hall.  Sunlight streams liberally in through the glass to warm rows of plush black velvet seats facing the raised crimson dais.  Narrow windows set in each of the walls have been opened to allow fresh air to circulate throughout and maintain an even temperature.  Sparkling silver carpet cascades down the aisles between the rows of seats, ending at the dais steps.  Sconces on each pillar wait for nighttime use.

Massive white marble pillars support a glass roof arching over this spacious circular meeting hall.  Moonlight streams liberally in through the glass to light the plush black velvet seats facing the raised crimson dais.  Narrow windows set in each of the walls have been closed to trap the heat and maintain an even temperature.  Sparkling silver carpet cascades down the aisles between the rows of seats, ending at the dais steps.  Sconces on each pillar are lit to brightly illuminate the hall.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemic Nexus]
description: This octagonal stone chamber is lit by eight flickering torches, one positioned at each corner.  Hovering only a few inches above the striated marble floor, a pale grey mist carries the faint scent of blended herbs.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest, down, out

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: Light maple paneling compliments the sparkling silver carpeting in this stately library.  Long, heavy, white tables with silver footrests extend down the center of this expansive room, and silver chandeliers provide ample lighting.  Dozens of tall bookcases carry much of the written knowledge of the lands, including many volumes in foreign tongues.  At the north end of the room, a stern-looking librarian keeps a careful eye on those studying from his vantage point at a small wooden desk.

title: [Guild Master Grift's Office]
description: A huge silver chandelier centrally located over the massive marble desk brightly illuminates this rectangular office.  The light shimmers off the silver carpet and reflects off the white marble walls.  A bookcase stuffed with tomes of all sizes and colors extends from floor to ceiling along the back wall, and several comfortable chairs nestle together in one corner, perhaps to facilitate quiet meetings with Guild members.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Arcane Studies]
description: Opaque mist forms the basis of this rotund chamber.  It has no physical walls nor any structure that lends it solid form. The world away from this room is completely obscured, and your existence is likely obscured from the world, with the exception of an opening in the mist directly in front of a rune-carved door.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Magic Workroom]
description: Items are haphazardly strewn all over this room as if someone had taken a large stick and stirred the room's contents.  The walls are pitted and cracked, and the silver carpet pitches and rolls unevenly, evidence of localized seismic forces at work.  Sunlight streams liberally through the cracks in the walls.  A heavy iron table lies on its side, and extinguished torch stands recline uselessly in a corner.  The only item still standing upright is a squat iron chest.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage Room]
description: A light grey tile floor supports a tall wooden cabinet against one of the room's four white walls.  Set off to one side is a large dust bin, painted as white as the walls, making it barely noticeable.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Abyran Workshop]
description: This circular room has been painted in gradational shades of purple, while the floor is polished black tile.  A scaly cloth-covered workbench sits in the center, directly beneath a round, convex window.  Hanging on the northern side of the room is an unusual mirror.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Shien Workshop]
description: This circular room has been painted a faint hazy blue, while the floor is comprised of pearlescent grey tile.  A blue gossamer cloth-covered workbench sits in the center, directly beneath a round, convex window.  Hanging on the northern side of the room is an unusual mirror.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Grik Workshop]
description: This circular room has been painted a dusky red, while the floor is comprised of matte brown tile.  A leather-covered workbench sits in the center, directly beneath a round, convex window.  Hanging on the northern side of the room is an unusual mirror.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Aishan Workshop]
description: This circular room has been painted a deep crimson, while the floor is dull black tile.  A coarse cloth-covered workbench sits in the center, directly beneath a round, convex window.  Hanging on the northern side of the room is an unusual mirror.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Verlok Workshop]
description: This circular room has been painted a dull black, while the floor is comprised of matching tiles with red speckles.  A red feather-trimmed workbench sits in the center, directly beneath a round, convex window.  Hanging on the northern side of the room is an unusual mirror.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Imp Workshop]
description: This circular room has been painted light grey, while the floor is a mottled white tile.  A wrinkled cloth-covered workbench sits in the center, directly beneath a round, convex window.  Hanging on the northern side of the room is an unusual mirror.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Pantry]
description: One white half-circle wall encloses this room and its grey tile floor.  A sturdy wooden shelf hangs by itself on the wall.  A marble-topped table serves as a centerpiece, while a store room clerk monitors the room's goings-on.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tub Room]
description: Condensation drips from the ceiling and runs down the white marble walls to disappear into a drain in the far corner, leaving the floor slick with moisture.  A spacious tub has been carved directly into the marble floor, and hot water swirls and foams within.  A metal vat is securely bolted against the wall with a pipe and a chain hanging down just above the tub.  Wide steps lead into the tub's churning waters.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Hot Tub]
description: You step down into the hot, swirling water, its warmth gently massaging your muscles and relaxing your mind and body.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Guild Shop]
description: A narrow silver carpet runs down the center of this small shop, dividing it into two halves.  On the grey marble floor of one rests a mannequin made from fine platinum wires, while the other section contains a platinum tray resting upon a mahogany stand.  Several lamps hovering in midair illuminate the room, drifting slowly about.  A fine silk banner covers part of one sparkling, white quartz wall.  The other three are decorated only by the gilt trim at top and bottom.

wayto.19007: ;e loop { wait_until { Spell[704].affordable? }; result = cast(704, 'banner'); break unless result =~ /Spell Hindrance/ }

title: [Summoning Chamber]
description: Bands of brilliantly glowing light, each constantly in motion in ever-changing patterns, define a perfect sphere centered on a latticed yellow crystal.  A platform of some unfamiliar stone underlies the crystal, though neither it nor the crystal have any visible means of support.

title: [Unknown]
description: Elven archers in the livery of Vaalor stand astride an enormous marble arch.  Their arrows target a bilious green airship, but each is vaporized by a dull grey beam before reaching its target.  Below the aerial combat, hordes of animated orcs spew forth from a dark cavern, engaging in a vicious battle with two-headed centaurs defending a hillock of ice topped by an obsidian plinth.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Magic Workroom]
[Sorcerer Guild, Small Chamber]
description: The walls and ceiling are formed from dramatically layered sandstone carved from the powerful erosive force of water.  Simple brass sconces amply illuminate the spacious chamber, adding warmth to the already faint musty smell in the air.  A long wooden table rests against the northern wall with a carved flat shelf residing just above it.  Along the eastern wall is a smooth panel of rock while a swirling mist resides in the far corner.

Dramatically layered sandstone, carved away by the powerful erosive force of water, lines this small chamber, somewhat longer than it is wide.  One end is demarcated by a smooth panel of rock, while the other end is obscured in a swirling mist.

wayto.18744: ;e loop { wait_until { Spell[704].affordable? }; result = cast(704, 'rock'); break unless result =~ /Spell Hindrance/ }

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Workshop]
description: This small work area is partioned away from the rest of the large, circular chamber by some ill-assorted heavy silk rugs draped over wooden poles.  The center of the cramped space is dominated by a marble-topped workbench, on which rests a collection of alchemy equipment.  A shimmering beam of starlight, directed from the narrow aperture above the central chamber, shines on the white marble.

A small oak bookcase, filled with a copious number of tomes, scrolls, and manuscripts, is pressed against the far wall, and some oak chairs sit to the side to provide a location for a somewhat comfortable read.
