title: [Training Cauldron]
description: Tucked away amid the sandstone columns of this cavern, this small alcove is dominated by an enormous cast iron cauldron that hangs from a heavy hook set in the ceiling.  The distant drip of water in the distance marks the passing of time.

title: [Beacon Hall, Magical Workshop]
description: A strange orb in the center of the room glows softly, bathing everything in a fuzzy, ethereal light.  Shelves containing old potions, scrolls and mortars fill one wall.  Some barely discernable runes cover the opposite wall.  Next to the orb's pedestal a heavy table partially hides a large chest.

title: [A Derelict Hovel]
description: Thin shafts of light seep between the rough wooden planks that form the walls of the hovel.  A broken glass window, now boarded up, allows for a faint breeze to drift through, stirring up small dust devils.  Near the back wall, a pile of canvas sacks and twine form a makeshift bed.

title: [Protective Draperies, Entry]
description: Uncountable bolts of cloth, representing just about every fabric known to Elanthians, rise ceiling high in the center of this luxurious tent.  Layers of deeply piled rugs cushion every step, but provide a precarious foundation for the racks that are on display.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Portside]
description: The Spitfire's deck is bustling with activity.  This has got to be the fiercest looking gang of three-foot tall pirates you've ever seen!  Halflings are scurrying about, yipping back and forth in their distinctive dialect.  One of the crew pushes past and clambers up the backstays, disappearing into the rigging above.  Overhead towers the magnificent mainmast, bedecked with rigging and sporting a huge black flag emblazoned with a tart over crossed bones.

title: [Protective Draperies]
description: A dark-stained oak table with elaborately carved legs nestles against the back wall of the tent and hosts an array of sewing supplies.  Several trunks, each one propped open to display its contents, guard numerous bolts of fabric in the center of the space.

title: [Spitfire, Forward Deckhouse]
description: A bunk sits on one of the walls of this tiny cabin.  Across from it, a bench holds a number of tools, each stowed in its wooden partition, and kept company by stale tart crumbs.  The tools vary widely, with most being specific to shipboard repairs and maintenance.  Over the bench hangs an image of the Spitfire, made entirely from tiny pieces of inlaid wood.  Likely, the ship's carpenter is an artist as well.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Portside]
description: A brisk breeze blows across the port rail, carrying with it the smells of the bay.  A couple of burly halflings elbow -- or some might say 'knee' -- by, muttering something that sounds like "don't much like tha cut 'a his sail, tha bloomin'..."  They soon pass out of hearing and disappear down the companionway to the 'tween deck.  Next to the rail, narrow stairs lead up to the poop deck, where sailors are busy checking lines and swabbing the deck dry.

title: [Spitfire, Poopdeck Portside]
description: The tall mizzenmast's sails are furled, and a couple of halflings are busy in the rigging, checking for wear.  From the mast, a spanker boom traverses the poopdeck's promenade and juts out over the stern rail.  The spanker boom is secured over the beautiful ship's wheel, a masterpiece of polished wood.  Chatter can be heard from the saloon skylight, located just aft of the coach house.

title: [Stars of the Sea]
description: Sunlight streams through several port holes and the elongated aquarium placed before them, casting watery waves upon the plank floor.  Squat glass cases have been festooned with brightly colored shells, augmenting the ambience of an underwater cove.

An elongated aquarium runs along the entire length of the eastern wall, its dark waters highlighted by flitting phosphorescent flecks.  Above squat glass cases, flickering nacreous sconces illuminate the displays.

title: [Spitfire, 'Tween Deck Hatch]
description: A hatch conceals stairs leading down to the 'tween deck.  The stairs shine with polish, and modwir handrails on each side are supported with brass hardware.  Lanterns are fixed to the walls inside the hatch coaming, their wicks protected from windy days at sea by clear crystal panes.  Laughter and conversation drift up from the dim interior downstairs.

title: [Spitfire, Companionway]
description: The shallow hallway quickly widens to the north, giving access into 'tween deck compartments.  Anyone much taller than a halfling is almost immediately endangered by the dropped ceiling of deckbeams, which begins at the entrance of the 'tween deck dining saloon.

title: [Rustaye's Good Weapons]
description: The air practically reeks of weapon oil, and every surface gleams with it -- not, judging from the state of the weaponry, that it was applied in time to do much good, but apparently Rustaye has a philosophical approach to things, or else perhaps he believes that any amount of damage can be concealed with sufficient grease.  An orange-tinged hatch on the east wall allows egress.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck]
description: Here at the foot of the towering mainmast sits a halfling clad only in a loincloth of dingy white cotton.  Thick piles of wood shavings lie scattered all around him as he focuses on the task of carving complex patterns into the wood of a nearby coffin.  Occasionally, he traces his small fingers over the intricate designs and smiles to himself.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Portside]
description: The forward deckhouse sits just behind the foremast, two lifeboats lashed topside-down on its roof.  Raucous laughter can occasionally be heard from the crew's quarters inside the deckhouse, mixing with the melody played by a group of minstrels strolling the wharf below the Spitfire's rail.  Sitting forward of the mast, a forehatch gives access to cargo areas below deck.  A narrow flight of stairs leads up to the forecastle deck, and there is a narrow door leading into the forward deckhouse.

title: [Spitfire, Forward Deckhouse]
description: Bunks line the walls of the deckhouse.  Beneath each bunk sits a highly polished, wooden sea chest with shining brass hardware.  The bunks are strung with heavy hemp cording, and a blanket rests at the foot of each, neatly folded.  A small window on the forward bulkhead offers light, amplified by the pristine white walls.

title: [Spitfire, Forecastle Portside]
description: The forecastle deck offers a splendid view of the buildings lining the wharf, a jumble of different facades sporting all manners of color and tone.  Brightly painted signs hang from the fronts of some, emblazoned with fanciful images and names.  Lines stretch from the rail to groups of pilings along the edge of the wharf, holding the Spitfire securely at dock.  A polished flight of stairs leads down to the main deck.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Starboard]
description: A couple of halfling sailors are kneeling on the deck, discussing the condition of the "trunnels" in their colorful burr.  This section of the main deck offers entrances into the deckhouse.  A delicious scent wafts out, indicating the presence of the galley inside.  Smoke curls from a black smokepipe extending out of the roof of the deckhouse galley.

title: [Spitfire, Deckhouse Galley]
description: The galley spans the aft end of the deckhouse, with a door leading out to starboard.  A work counter fills the north wall, and cabinets are built above and beneath it.  A stove sits opposite, its smokepipe extending through the roof.  Large kettles bubble on the stove's black, iron grill, filling the galley with the aroma of a hearty stew.  Obviously, these sailors eat well, at least while they're in port.  Hanging on the wall is a cargo list.

title: [Spitfire, Forward Deckhouse]
description: A bunk and a wooden worktable almost fill the tiny cabin.  The bunk is standard issue, strung with hemp and adorned with a blanket.  On the worktable is an assortment of large needles and spools of heavy thread.  Bulky canvas, folded as neatly as the blanket, sits beside the table, waiting to be mended.

title: [Spitfire, Mainmast Shrouds]
description: The Spitfire's rigging is anchored solidly with dead-eyes and screws sunk into the ship's sides.  Above, the shrouds angle towards the crow's nest, high above the deck.  Creaks and groans are audible as the yards move on the mast, shifted by the loll of the ship on the bay's gentle swells.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Starboard]
description: "Ahoy t' deck!" comes a call from the rigging high above where a crow's nest can be seen perched among the yards of the mainmast.  The breeze blowing in from the open sea carries off the rest of the garbled message.  A group of thickly muscled sailors works intently, polishing railing and checking tack for wear.  One, a particularly robust halfling, oversees their efforts, barking orders in her loud, raspy voice.

title: [Spitfire, Coach House]
description: The coach house contains the more luxurious accommodations on the Spitfire.  This short hallway is paneled in rich teak with plush carpet runners underfoot.  It opens into a large area -- a dining saloon by the look of it -- toward the bow of the ship.

title: [Wycrassine's Salvaged Rugs]
description: Colorful rugs, many with complex tapestry patterns, line the wall from floor to ceiling -- not that the ceiling is very high, as this is, after all, the Spitfire.  At the very top of one pile, a striped grey kitten snoozes peacefully, content in her supremacy over the balding halfling standing far below.  Rungs have been nailed to the wall beside the rugs to assist the proprietor in reaching the top of the stacks.

title: [Spitfire, Poopdeck Starboard]
description: Open sea stretches into the distance from the mouth of the bay.  The aroma of hemp from the backstays competes with the smell of tar from the rigging and the ocean's brine.  Just 'fore the poopdeck is the quarter boat, hanging from its arched white support arms.  Off the starboard rail, a small fishing boat tacks toward open sea, leaving the echo of a sea chantey drifting across the waves.  There is a group of halflings lounging on a raised platform in front of the ship's wheel.

title: [Spitfire, Quarter Boat]
description: The longboat is constructed of polished white planks traversed with butter-yellow oak ribs.  Diffused light permeates the canvas tarp covering the boat -- and you -- creating a cozy enclosure, albeit a low-ceilinged one.  A rope ladder drapes over the edge of the boat.  The halfling sitting here appears to be quite at home.  He bends over a small object, totally engrossed, while his hands work over it so rapidly it's hard to follow their progress.  His busy eyebrows dance in league with his flying fingers.

Diffused light permeates the canvas tarpaulin covering the boat -- and you -- creating a cozy enclosure, albeit a low-ceilinged one.  A rope ladder drapes over the edge of the boat.  The halfling sitting here appears to be quite at home.  He bends over a small object, totally engrossed, while his hands work over it so rapidly it's hard to follow their progress.  His busy eyebrows dance in league with his flying finge

title: [Darkstone Bay, Shipside]
description: In one direction, the view is completely obscured by the wooden planks of a large ship, the Spitfire, which is anchored alongside the dock area of the bay.  A rope ladder hangs down from one of the covered stowaway boats that is cinched to the side of the ship.  In every other direction, chilly, dark blue water spreads out all around you, and small waves send you bobbing along the surface.  Across the bay, several buildings are visible in the distance, and further out, the open sea is a balmy blue.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Starboard]
description: The main deck narrows just aft of the tall foremast, where the deckhouse begins.  Barrels are stacked and secured against the rise of the forecastle deck.  A slatted door leads into the deckhouse, and from the squeaks, squeals and halfling giggles coming from inside, it's a good bet the door leads into crews' quarters.

title: [Spitfire, Forward Deckhouse]
description: A couple of halflings occupy the bunks here in the starboard deckhouse.  They look up and smile at the group clustered in the room's south end, when the singing gets loud enough to distract them.  One reads a small, leather-bound book, while the second seems absorbed in the leather strips he's braiding into a belt.  Nothing in the room is out of place, even though its inhabitants are at leisure.

title: [Spitfire, Forecastle Starboard]
description: The deck of the forecastle displays an intricate pattern of inlaid woods.  Deep mahogany contrasts with lighter-hued maoral wood and pine, crafted into an image of a mariner's compass.  Off the starboard rail, a shapely sloop tacks toward the mouth of the bay, needing no help in the brisk breeze.  The cries of seabirds overhead mingle with the bright melody of the minstrels strolling the wharf.

title: [Spitfire, Plank]
description: Jutting out slightly over the sea, this small niche of the boat is perfectly rounded.  Several empty crates are piled around a large, black-roped net.  Centered at the edge of the ship, a gap in the railing is filled in with a thick, wide plank that stretches a way's out over the ship's edge to hang over the water in the bay below.

title: [Spitfire, Forward Deckhouse]
description: This part of the deckhouse is crowded with halflings, talking and laughing among themselves.  One, a deeply tanned sailor with shocking red hair, sings a chantey so full of ribald references, it would make a dwarf blush.  She accompanies her song on a small lute and her mates laugh and comment on the lyrics, adding a harmony each time she sings the chorus.

title: [Spitfire, Forecastle Deck]
description: The forecastle deck overlooks the jib-boom, which juts out of the bow with its figurehead mounted beneath it.  Catheads protrude through the railing to starboard and port, and a small pawl bitt boasts a shining brass ship's bell.  A couple of burly halflings, their trousers rolled up to the knees, wield large brooms, scrubbing the spotless deck with sand sloshed in buckets of salt water.

title: [Spitfire, Jib-boom]
description: Perched here on the jib-boom just behind the bowsprit cap, one has a close-hand view of the beautifully crafted figurehead.  Gentle eddies of sea water caress the ship's bow, but beyond the harbor mouth, whitecaps stretch away to the horizon.  Where open sea begins, flying fish cavort, leaping from the crests of the waves.

title: [Spitfire, Crow's Nest]
description: The small platform of oak surrounds the towering mainmast.  A waist-high maoral railing circles the crow's nest, providing a handhold in rough seas.  The view is spectacular, a panorama of multi-colored rooftops, with curls of smoke dancing up from the residences and shops.  The ship below looks like a miniature, and the people milling about its decks, like wind-up toys.

title: [Spitfire, Coach House Hatch]
description: A maoral hatchcover stands open, revealing a carpeted stairway leading down to the coach house cabins.  Down the side of the coach house, a row of round life-buoys hang, each one bordered with rope and bearing an insignia of a tart over crossed bones.

title: [Spitfire, Companionway]
description: Richly grained paneling lines the corridor bulkheads and the deck is carpeted with a plush runner in vivid tones of melon, marigold and indigo.  Brass lamps with opalescent glass throw a warm glow over all.  A blue door and a green door lead into cabins open to starboard and port, while a carved modwir door hangs at the hall's end.

title: [Spitfire, Coach House Cabin]
description: The bulkheads of the cabin are polished rosewood, and a beautiful floral rug carpets the deck.  The feminine ambiance of the cabin is startling in comparison to the rest of the ship's seafaring decor.  Hanging on the bulkheads are paintings, showing ladies of style and leisure shopping to their heart's content -- all short of stature, of course.  Near the back of the room is a door to a cedar closet and another door to a walk-in closet, both propped open to allow easy access to their interiors.

title: [A Small Closet]
description: The smell of cedar is strong within this small room.  This is probably due to the thick planks of the reddish-grained wood lining three of the four closet walls.

title: [Spitfire, Captain's Cabin]
description: The cabin is not only roomier than any other, but also the most richly appointed by far.  A heavy modwir desk sits opposite a generous -- although short -- bed carved with fanciful sea serpents roiling in turbulent seas.  A damask comforter covers the bed's white linen sheets, and a variety of patterned rugs carpet the deck in tones of crimson and powder blue.

title: [Spitfire, Ship's Wheel]
description: The grand ship's wheel is a beauty, inlaid teak, modwir and maoral woods creating a complex pattern around the circumference.  Each of the wheel's spokes is tipped with a semi-precious stone, alternating amethysts, dreamstones and moonstones.  A glance inside the binnacle box, which supports the wheel, reveals a ship's compass and brass binnacle lamp.  The binnacle bell mounted on top of the box shines in the light, its pristine polish a testament to the care lavished on this vessel.

title: [Spitfire, Tartbelly Bar]
description: The long cabin is paneled in polished modwir and shining brass lamps hang from the ceiling, their reflective surfaces adorning the dark interior like jewelry.  Along the portside bulkhead is a low bar, finely crafted in the same richly veined wood and being polished by a halfling.  Heaping baskets of tarts are spaced at regular intervals along it.  In the chamber's center sits a small wooden platform, looking for all the world like a performance stage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south

title: [Spitfire, Coach House Pantry]
description: The pantry is small, apparently leaving most of the real preparation of victuals to the galley on the main deck.  A polished maple table sits against the bulkhead, along with a couple of barrels.  Racks of utensils line the bulwarks and a large stack of baskets takes most of the remaining space.  These are filled with tarts and various other pastries.  The business of sailing the Spitfire must work up a considerable taste for sweets.

title: [Stars of the Sea]
description: A thick padded bench rests before a looming aquarium, offering an ideal vantage to observe its watery world.  Sunlight illuminates a magnificent statue that gazes out a nearby porthole.

A thick padded bench rests before a looming aquarium, offering an ideal vantage to observe its watery world shadowed by night.  Clutched within the unliving hands of a statue, a single candle illuminates this otherwise darkened hold.

title: [Spitfire, 'Tween Deck]
description: The main gathering area of the 'tween deck quarters features a long wooden table surrounded by low chairs occupied by a halfling, a ruddy sailor and a chess player, obviously members of the Spitfire's crew.  The thick trunk of the mainmast cuts through the center of the table, disappearing up through the roof.  The ceiling is so low, it's impossible for all but shorter races of folks to stand upright.  Bunks line both sides of the room, and to starboard, a low, narrow flight of stairs leads down.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, northwest, down

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold Stair]
description: The stairs leading down into the hold are narrow, brushing the shoulders of anyone who tries to pass in a group.  Running down each side is a smooth modwir railing, polished by the many hands of past crew and passengers.  Glowing lanterns hang at regular intervals along the stairwell, casting a warm yellow glow on the steps.

title: [Spitfire, 'Tween Deck]
description: In the back of the upper section of 'tween deck, the light is dimmer, getting less illumination from the open hatch at the aft end of the room.  The bunks along the walls are grouped in sets of four with slated wooden screens dividing them, and a neatly folded square of blanket lies at the foot of each one.

title: [Spitfire, 'Tween Deck]
description: Bunks along the outside bulkhead crowd the aisle, competing with the low table for floor space.  Each bunk boasts a brightly colored blanket at its foot, the bright, alternating colors of wool lending a cheerful atmosphere to the room.  The room opens up a little toward the ship's bow.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: The hold is primarily taken up by cargo stacked meticulously to the ceiling.  Aisles leading east and west circle the central blockade created by stacks of barrels and crates.  Along the Spitfire's sloping hull, brass lanterns are mounted, shedding puddles of warm light across the deck.

title: [The Lorikeet's Aviary]
description: In lieu of wall coverings, the cabin is festooned with hanging panels of multicolored feathers.  Here and there a bit of mahogany peeks out in the form of a frame around a doorway or a porthole, but for the most part the room is a riot of avian color.  Several metal containers rest on the floor, almost blocking access to a narrow arch.

title: [Head Over Heels, Cordwainers]
description: The room has been set up to serve as a showcase of the goods available within.  Glass topped cases and gilded racks have been filled with pairs of boots and slippers, all of different design.  Satin-trimmed banners over the arches at the back of the room depict a boldly outlined slipper and a stylized boot.  One wall is hung with a framed sign.

Set back in a small alcove, the shop is crammed with Glass topped cases, carved mistwood boxes, and gilded racks.  Each display is filled with various materials for creating all manner of footware.  Satin-trimmed banners over a a pair of openings at the back of the room depict a boldly outlined slipper and a stylized boot.  A small framed sign is hung over a low polished table.

title: [Choc-o-Lots]
description: Reeking of the sweet scent of chocolate, the small shop is warm and inviting.  Several upholstered chairs are set about the room, paired to tables with cloth for patrons to sample wares at in comfort.  The shelves are lined with the shop inventory and a large glass-topped counter displays several heaters for sale.  An archway leads out of the shop.

title: [Blooming Gorgeous, Entry]
description: Walls of pale jade green stenciled with a glossy black floral pattern complement the varnished oak floor of this cozy room.  The scent of flowers and fresh earth permeates the air, and tables stacked with vases full of a variety of blooms take up most of the space in the area.  In the corner of the room a small, cluttered counter is home to a brass bell and a small gold-lettered sign.

title: [Blooming Gorgeous, Salon]
description: Bright magenta walls and a floor covered with numerous overlapping rugs of various flowery designs make the tiny workroom seem small and intimate.  A collection of multi-colored cushions have been haphazardly placed on the floor.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  The bulkhead intersects the passageway, making it dogleg to the north.

title: [Stashers and Slashers, Foyer]
description: Dark wood paneling lines the walls of the foyer, offset by bright white porcelain plates affixed firmly to the wall by steel bracketing and lit by candle-filled lamps dangling overhead.  Standing against the wall opposite the open stained-glass hatch is a tufted brown leather couch, which is flanked on either side by low wooden endtables.

title: [Spitfire, Fur Closet]
description: It is much colder in this small closet than it is in the rest of the ship.  The cooler temperature is likely a boon to the lush fur garments hanging from the long wooden racks which rest against two of the walls and the compartmented display hanging from a third.  A series of shallow copper troughs filled with ground charcoal run around the baseboards of the room underneath the racks.  Light filters in from the opaque paper-shaded window of the steel hatch, providing just enough brightness to illuminate the closet.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: The cargo along this part of the aisle shifts in composition.  Bulky crates with straw sticking out of corners bear unfamiliar stencils.  Curiously, most have been marked over with black paint, but a few still remain with the legend "Solhaven" topped by a colorful heraldic crest.  The passage doglegs to the north, where it meets the bulkhead.

title: [Spitfire, Verda's Veils]
description: Shiny brass lanterns hang on the wood paneled walls, casting warm reflections on the polished oak plank floor.  An entire wall is filled with wooden shelves containing rows of mannequin heads, each with a stylishly coifed wig, modeling circlets, hairbands, and other such adornments.  The merchandise on each shelf is secured against the pitching of the ship by a cunningly carved railing.  Near the companionway door, two circular metal racks display a collection of veils.

title: [Kirilla's Home of Reflections]
description: Pale blue silk panels drape from a silver ring set at the top center point of this small tent.  The space inside the ring is open to the air, and sunlight is reflected in a shining collection of mirrors set around the tent.  A flap of blue silk leads to the back section of the tent, but the opening it makes is almost barred by a sign placed squarely in front of it.

title: [Kirilla's Home of Reflections]
description: This small section of Kirilla's tent is crowded by a selection of mirrors, each leaning against one of several chests placed strategically about.

title: [The Lorikeet's Aviary, Workroom]
description: The room is bare and simply appointed, with a planked mahogany floor and a single long bench that runs the length of the chamber.  A parchment sign is tacked on the wall just to one side of the only doorway.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  A cabin is nestled among the stacks, with a carved maoral door to give access.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  A cabin is nestled among the stacks, with wooden doors providing access.

title: [Swords 'n Boards]
description: Cramped quarters only allow for sparse furniture.  A narrow wooden table stands near a solid black wooden door, its surface covered with small weaponry.  Near the back, a rickety ladder leads through a rectangular hole in the ceiling.  Partially falling apart with rot, a long water-damaged rack encompasses one full wall and houses shields of various sizes and styles.

title: [Swords 'n Boards, Crawl Space]
description: Not quite a room, the ceiling is barely high enough for a man to stoop and not hit his head.  The crawl space stretches off to the west where the ceiling lowers and the end is lost in the dim and dusty air.  The only light filters up from a rectangular hole in the floor.  The layer of dust on the floor around the hole has been disturbed, wiping some areas cleaner than the rest.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  Between two of the beams, an alcove has been created by the stacked inventory.

title: [The Companion's Companion]
description: The frayed canvas material of the tent is barely discernible amongst the many strands of vines and clinging moss that adorn most of the walls and ceiling of the canopy.  The soil has been compacted to offer a relatively dust-free and smooth walking surface with minimal maintenance.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.

title: [A Cubby Hole]
description: Tucked out of the way of foot traffic and prying eyes, this dark spot is filled with broken boxes and opened chests.  A shadow of constant movement hovers above an upended crate in the corner.

title: [Back to Basics]
description: Plain wool tapestries hang over the small dusty windows of this cramped room.  Poorly painted walls and a plain wooden floor leave little doubt that this room was constructed with basic materials.  Dust-covered shelves house cans filled with everyday items, while several pieces of cut materials lay strewn about in an untidy manner.  A dim light filters through one of the dusty windows.

title: [Tallytoe's Salvage]
description: Salt-stained, thickly woven cotton carpets the ground with the image of the stork of Torre -- now a very bedraggled, tired-looking stork indeed.  A heavy chest to one side and a solid-looking shelf on the other pin the makeshift floor covering in place, though sections of torn fringe on every edge still wait to trip up the unwary foot.  Directly opposite the exit, a mildewed wooden sign with prominently painted lettering hangs from a nail on the wall.

title: [Spitfire, Thimbel's Threadworks]
description: This large cabin is warm, well-lit, and quite comfortable.  A fine selection of hand-tailored clothing is displayed upon a low wooden table in the room's center, and dozens of hats and other miscellaneous accessories line the shelves along the walls.  The slight scents of pipe tobacco and tanned leather mingle together to give this cabin a pleasant aroma.  An occasional quiet, high-pitched squeal from the east mars the otherwise tranquil setting.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: A large stack of crates, boxes and barrels blocks further progress, forcing the aisle to turn back upon itself.  From one of the larger barrels sitting to the side, a small flicker of light peeks out from cracks marring its wooden slats.

title: [Garthlan's Wares, Entry]
description: Plain wooden planks form the bulkheads of this room.  Several crates are piled up in the corners with any stray markings scratched or burned off hastily.  Oily smoke from a pair of lanterns provides dim lighting and more than a few shadows.  To the east and west small cramped corridors lined with boxes and bales lead away.

title: [Blargo's Blanks]
description: Intricate scrollwork adorns a large teakwood table placed in the center of this tiny cabin.  An unfinished shelf lines one wall at eye level to the average sized halfling.  Wood chips and shavings litter the floor, while an unused broom is propped against one wall.  A carved wooden sign is the only decoration.

title: [Chortel's Chuckles]
description: Garishly painted in a nightmare of orange and yellow, this cluttered and claustrophobic closet of a room is filled with an amazing conglomeration of puzzles, tricks and novelties.  A dented tin tub dangles from the ceiling, a badly frayed rope the only thing keeping it from plummeting to the floor.  On one wall, a small wooden shelf hangs between two flickering oil lanterns, each gathering filmy cobwebs that have turned grey with many layers of collected dust.

Garishly painted in a nightmare of orange and yellow, this cluttered and claustrophobic closet of a room is filled with an amazing conglomeration of puzzles, tricks, and novelties.  A dented tin tub dangles from the ceiling, a badly frayed rope the only thing keeping it from plummeting to the floor.  On one wall, a small wooden shelf hangs between two flickering oil lanterns, each gathering filmy cobwebs that have turned grey with many layers of collected dust.

title: [Just a Lil' Nip, Entry]
description: Built into the curve of the ship, the cabin is narrow and compact.   Fishing nets, filled with drying or dried flowers, are tied to the rafters, the fragrance of each bloom filling the air with a heady, cloying aroma that is almost overpowering.  Strapped to one wall, and carefully bound in place, is a bunk laden with heavy wool blankets, while underneath is a series of six metal buckets filled with tools.

title: [Vellum?  Damn Near Killed 'Em!]
description: This small cabin is furnished with a pair of woven blue and white rugs that cover the planked flooring.  A lacquered modwir bookshelf is pushed up against the starboard wall next to a glass wind lantern and a riveted brass port hole.  Tiny scraps of vellum partially cover the discolored portions of the floor next to an ink-stained white oak desk.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  A couple of cabins are nestled among the stacks, with carved doors to give access.

title: [Don't Be Snotty]
description: The cramped cabin smells of mold and seawater, with heavy pieces of dark wooden furniture dwarfing the contents of this tiny shop.  A tall oak dresser stands nearby, with pieces of fabric peeping out of an open drawer.  Against one wall a splintered maple table stands alone, while a wooden chest and a polished brass trunk encroach on the middle of the room.  Between the furniture a warped wooden door leads out.

title: [The S. S. Saulty's Ship Shop]
description: Gruff-looking sailors greet customers as they step in.  To the northwest, rapscallions pick over weapons, armor, and shields, and, to the west, scallywags admire some trinkets.  Through a barnacle-covered arch, there seems to be some sort of bar.

title: [The S. S. Saulty's Sea Bar]
description: Sailors belly up to the carved monir bar, bellowing salty sea ballads.  They seem a little less bloodthirsty than the bunch watching the merchandise.  Grudgingly, they move aside to let other customers pass.

title: [Lured In]
description: The hold space is made to feel small with its low, concave ceiling and the chaotic arrangement of items.  A tin bucket is on its side in the middle of the floor, just next to a wide, red-patterned rug that is home to an assortment of fishing poles.  Nearly blocking the hatch leading out, a short table with stunted, uneven legs seems to defy all sense of the real world by standing completely upright.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Tasty Retreat]
description: Deep blue paint speckled with green and white adorns the wooden floor, walls, and ceiling.  Faint silhouettes of leaves and tropical flowers frame the path to the south.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  A cabin is nestled among the stacks, with a carved door to give access.

title: [Spitfire, A Seaward Compartment]
description: In this small space, low-hanging beams athwart the ceiling meet the curved outer wall of the Spitfire's hull.  At its base, the wall is punctuated by a series of discolored brass scuppers.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Entry]
description: The low space between the decks is here completely filled with piles of fresh-sawn lumber.  All manner of woods are here, neatly stacked and bound: mundane woods, like pale boxwood and black ebony, as well as rare magical woods, from grey hoarbeam to russet-toned ruic.

title: [The Lost Fletcher, Entry]
description: Stretched between two poles is a large woven hammock, which dominates one corner of the small room.  A table is placed to one side and a chest is pushed underneath, material showing from inside the partially closed lid.  Swaying from side to side as the ship rolls with the smallest disturbance of the water, a simple lantern lights the cramped space.  Hung with a striped blanket, a narrow archway leads deeper into the quarters in one direction while a small doorway gives access in another.

title: [The Lost Fletcher, Arsenal]
description: Pieces of sailcloth hang from the criss-crossed pattern of rafters above, their striped patterns decorating the small space.  Several racks of bows are hung from the walls, a wide variety available to choose from.  Several barrels stand to the side, arrows and bolts filling their hollowed bellies.  A fine selection of archery accessories are displayed on a narrow wooden counter, its length dominating the space.  A small doorway leads back towards the entry.

title: [The Lost Fletcher, Supplies]
description: Filled with boxes and crates of all shapes and sizes, this small storage room is cramped and hard to maneuver in.  Several racks of goods are displayed along the back wall, while a barrel is filled with supplies ready for use rests underneath.  Scratched from years of use, a crudely made worktable is piled with a variety of raw materials and tools.  A blanketed archway leads back towards the entry.

title: [Glass Works, Front Room]
description: A splintered oak table and a heavy thanot counter rest along the far wall to either side of a painted black arch.  Tiny fragments of light reflect off the goods on the tables, appearing as stars on the black velvet that hangs off the ends of the glass panes above and covers the walls.  A wooden hatch leads back to the cargo hold.

title: [Treasure Hunt, Seaside]
description: The gentle sounds of waves breaking on a light-colored sand beach fill the air.  A series of small dunes dot the edge of the beach, marking the perimeter.  A cracked and aged wooden signpost leans haphazardly to one side, and the wall into which a hatch is set is a magnificent mural of a wide-open ocean dotted with white clouds.  Brilliant sunlight bombards the beach here through a portal cut into the ceiling.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  Between two of the beams, an alcove has been created by the stacked inventory.

title: [Scents of the Hills]
description: A trio of small bronze portholes streams sunlight into the tiny cabin, illuminating the collections of scented merchandise scattered throughout the room.  The rustic wooden plank flooring is fully cleared and swept clean, save for a carved rosewood box, an aged driftwood crate, and an iron-studded steel chest.

title: [Pies-R-Us]
description: Several pink-painted tables have been carefully placed around the room, each with a matching pair of chairs pushed beneath them.  Colorful pink-framed paintings of flowers adorn the whitewashed walls along with pink shelves holding various knick-knacks.  A white door with a painted pink frame leads out of the shop.

title: [Reading Room]
description: Cross-beamed and wainscotted, the room is rich with the aroma of wood oils and the dry, woody scent of preserved timbers and parchment.  A necessarily ample array of illumination is ensconced upon the darkly panelled walls, alternating with stuffed, deck-to-overhead bookcases.  The scattered small reading tables are not without their own sources of lighting.

title: [Taninky's Treasures, Toast]
description: A single porthole, crusted with salt and lime scale on the outside, allows a bit of weak sunlight to filter into this cramped space.  An overstuffed blue and yellow sofa is pushed against the far wall, and a large spread of refreshments covers the top of a peeling white table.  Odd assortments of feathers, ribbons, and dried flowers hang from the low ceiling.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Spitfire, Sticki's Magicks]
description: The bustling octagonal apartment is small and cramped for its level of activity.  Young halflings in robes run about, carrying all sorts of wands and rods in various shapes and sizes.  A small table swathed in black velvet sits at the center of the chamber, home to a small black modwir coffer that seems to be the nexus of all the activity.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: Water barrels, wine barrels, bales of cotton -- all sorts of cargo make up the walls of the aisle.  From supporting timbers spaced at regular intervals, lanterns sway gently in response to the calm waters of the harbor.  Two cabins interrupt the stacked inventory, with carved doors to give access.

title: [The Broken Glass]
description: One large brass oil lamp, aft, supplies light for the entire cabin.  A single ironwood counter extends from bulkhead to bulkhead, separating customers from salespeople.  Squat, wide, and heavily polished, a freestanding ironwood cabinet resides in front of the counter, displaying merchandise for the discerning buyer.  Behind the counter, salespeople bustle noisily about, and, in the far corner, a halfling frowns over an immense stack of ledgers.

title: [Trolling the Depths, Ballast]
description: A damp chill permeates the bloated timbers framing the small pile of scrap and detritus in the ship's rancid bowels.  The tang of salt hangs heavy in the air, rising from pools of sloshing water that lap at the warped edges of an overturned hoarbeam table.  Also revoltingly present is the stench of old pitch, used in ineffectual attempts to stem the trickle of water through seams in the inner hull.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold Alcove]
description: The barrels and crates have been cleverly stacked to create a niche off the main thoroughfare winding around the cargo hold.  Brass lanterns are hung on the supporting beams, and the light shining through the lamps' amber glass bathes the small enclosure in a golden glow.  A couple of small doors are framed by the stacked cargo.

title: [The Workery]
description: The mildly sweet scents of water lily and jasmine suffuse the air with their freshly laundered scents.  Intricately embroidered wall hangings cover the polished bulkheads, and star-cut brass oil lamps hang from the beams above, swaying lightly with the movements of the ship.  Halfling clerks in sunny-colored aprons flit around the trunks of merchandise, ready to assist customers.

The mildly sweet fragrances of water lily and jasmine suffuse the air with their freshly laundered scents.  Intricately embroidered wall hangings cover the polished bulkheads, and star-cut brass oil lamps hang from the beams above, swaying lightly with the movements of the ship.  Halfling clerks in sunny-colored aprons flit around the trunks of merchandise, ready to assist customers.

title: [Parlay's Playthings]
description: The floor of this small area is covered with a colorful carpet, woven to depict the scenery of the bottom of an ocean.  The flooring is completed with sand, seaweed and coral.  Hanging from the ceiling is a tiny hammock stuffed with toys and a small driftwood shelf rests near the exit.  Large fake palm trees rest in one corner, their branches reaching down to partially conceal an overturned crate.

title: [The Companion's Companion, Eats]
description: Large palm fronds line the walls, giving the small alcove a slightly crowded feel.  Pushed together as if to make more shopping room, a pale-colored natural wood block, a tiered silvery modwir stand, and a metal-hooked spinewood rack offer a variety of containers and provisions for the discerning companion owner.

title: [The Companion's Companion, Play]
description: Twining vines creep along the walls, creating a pattern of overlapping verdant leaves dotted by the occasional splash of color, courtesy of tiny yellow and crimson flowers blooming even when indoors.  A bare wall at the back of the room is elaborately painted with shadowy animal silhouettes that are depicted in spirited poses among lush flora.

title: [Spitfire, Thimbel's Threadworks]
description: Polished wooden walls and shelves give this cabin an ambiance that promotes lingering to examine the merchandise.  A long marble-topped counter, crafted of the same well-polished oak as the floor-to-ceiling shelves, cuts off the cabin's back half.  Behind the counter, a canvas flap presumably leads into the back of the shop, and an occasional raised voice from behind it gives more weight to the assumption.

title: [Tallytoe's Salvage]
description: Staves, polearms, and other long, stick-like objects protrude from an old oak bin to lean against the rum-stained wall.  Treasures, trinkets, and trash glint inside a cracked porcelain basin, which has been carefully positioned to cover most of a rather suspicious-looking dark brown stain on the rug.  From the top of a rickety walnut coat rack, the unblinking yellow glass eyes of a molting stuffed owl stare at passing shoppers.

title: [Chortel's Storage]
description: It's awfully dark in this tiny space, not to mention the smell is dank and dusty.  A large wooden crate propped up against one wall is all that keeps this room from being entirely empty.  Water annoyingly drips down from above, the steady tapping noise excruciating.

title: [Garthlan's Gear]
description: This tiny area is less of a room and more of a clear space in the passageway.  A single dim lantern hangs from the wall over several crates and boxes.  A few ragged, vermin-chewed tapestries lie rolled up against the western wall of the corridor.

title: [Garthlan's Weapons]
description: The corridor opens out into a somewhat larger space that gives you room to turn around a bit and stretch, albeit carefully.  The ever-present crates and boxes litter the room's walls and corners.  To one side a space has been cleared, and a sturdy modwir table and a black lacquered arms rack have been set up with a few surly halfling clerks lounging around to help potential customers.

title: [Garthlan's Armor]
description: The corridor makes a dogleg turn here, leaving a somewhat cleared area in the corner.  While most of the crates in this area seem to be of normal quality, a few open and empty ones seem to be made of much nicer material.  An almost empty ale barrel drips slowly onto the ground with a *PLOP* and gives the area a decidedly sour odor.  Several pirates bustle around a lacquered black armor rack and a sturdy shield stand set up near the bulkhead.

title: [Garthlan's Picking Gear]
description: This room seems to be the least cluttered area in this part of the ship.  One could even go so far as to say it was neat.  A few crates stacked carefully against the wall appear fairly new and in good condition, aside from the scorch marks that removed their identifying marks.  Along the ceiling, a series of steel hooks holds various toolkits and sundry items, while a set of plank shelves line the wall behind a cloth-covered counter.

title: [Tropic Treasure, A Shore Thing]
description: Fine white sand dotted with small dunes obscures the wooden floor, reinforcing the illusion of a tropical beach.  A white cotton rope hammock has been tied between two support beams decorated to resemble palm trees.  Painted on a nearby wall is a vivid oceanscape complete with a bright yellow sun.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Monkey Barrel]
description: Weatherworn barrels have been sealed shut and half-buried in sand, their dark lids forming a wide smile, but one has been left accessible.  A few banana peels have been tossed aside around a support beam made to look like a palm tree.  Crashed into the base of the faux tree is an odd makeshift boat created from an enormous barrel.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Hot Stuff]
description: Black sand outlines a winding path leading to a bizarre sight.  All other nearby furnishings are dwarfed by a giant fake volcano standing in the middle of this area of the hold.  A tall pile of obsidian marks the only navigable ascent up the clearly manmade structure.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Hot Sauce]
description: High above the floor, the top of the strange volcano is riddled with various vents, though the gaping volcano mouth is the most prominent and disturbing feature of this structure.  The air is thick with the pungency of hot peppers, and occasional bursts of smoke diffuse the spicy scent everywhere.  Steep, though passable with effort, the side of the volcano is the only apparent path.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Paradise Found]
description: Painted upon the smooth walls is an expansive mural depicting a horde of glistening treasure.  The white sand that graces the floor in the rest of the shop is present here.  One central spot in the chamber features a reclining, woven rattan chair and a bright red, standing umbrella with a plush green rug underfoot.

title: [The S. S. Saulty's Ship Shop]
description: A few sailors browse over the goods in the room but appear to be spending more time keeping an eye on the customers.  A carved monir seaman's trunk has been placed next to a long wooden armor rack, which has been hung with a rum-splashed sign.  Some shield hooks overlook a tall metal shield stand, and a velvet-draped sword table is equidistant from both exits.

title: [The S. S. Saulty's Sea Trinkets]
description: Sharp-eyed sailors range themselves around this corner of the room, appearing to relax but not taking their eyes off of browsing visitors -- best not try to double-cross this lot!  An important looking sign perches on an easel near a round wooden table sprinkled with a few trinkets.

title: [Serviette Etiquette]
description: The room is dominated by a battered trestle table set haphazardly with an assortment of good quality but mismatched silver and tableware.  The table cloth is covered with gravy stains and scraps of rotted meat, and splotches of potatoes mar the walls and floor, perhaps remnants of previous meals or food fights.  Off to one side sits a water-stained wooden seachest beside a stained maple sideboard.

title: [Treasure Hunt, Thar Bluffs]
description: A whistling wind cuts through this elevated area.  Near the west wall, the sand and clay ground drops away abruptly into masterfully recreated cliffs.  The waves painted below are done to perspective, making the beach at the base seem many hundreds of feet down.  A variety of gaunt sand-hugging miniature trees and scrub dominate the area, and the occasional rock festooned with moss complete the scene.

title: [Treasure Hunt, Safe Harbor]
description: Gentle hills of clay and sand form a semi-circle that overlooks a perspective on a small port set against the east wall.  People line the streets going about their daily business, and the wharf looks quite busy with merchants.  Ships in the harbor seem frozen, small figures climb about in the rigging and on deck.  From somewhere the far away clop of horse on cobblestone and the occasional ringing of a ship's bell dance through the air.

title: [Treasure Hunt, Skull Point]
description: The pebbly sand here runs right into the northern wall.  The mural continues where the ground stops, climbing up to an ominous and cavernous outcropping that looks remarkably similar to a giant dark skull.  Two giant palm trees dominate this part of the island, their fronds reaching towards the faux sky.

title: [Treasure Hunt, Mount Topp]
description: The mountain is little more than a bare rise of gravelly sand, giving the view of the rest of the island.  In the center, a rocky outcropping represents the peak and appears to be made of solid rock.  Miniature evergreens climb and dance throughout the snowline, which stands about head high on a human.  Interspersed amongst the conifers are a variety of woodland animals.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Glass Works, Auction Room]
description: Short wooden stools are scattered fairly evenly around the cabin, making it hard to approach the glaes podium near the far wall.  Two particularly short halflings, one wearing an eyepatch and the other missing both a leg and an arm, stand guard beside the podium.  They appear to be, at once, both vigilant and sleepy.

title: [Glass Works, The Fly Trap]
description: Positioned somewhere near the center of the room, a translucent glass orb rests on a sturdy, four-legged oak stand that wobbles on the uneven floorboards.  The glass panes above are covered with filth.  An old wooden crate sits in one corner, covered in a thick layer of dust.

title: [Glass Works, The Fish Bowl]
description: A massive glass-paneled aquarium stands against the wall of this cabin, stretching from the door of this room all the way through to meet itself on the other side of the location that it started its journey from.  The room is bare of everything else except the aquarium and a small halfling pirate who stands leaning against one of the four glass panes accessible from the inside of the room.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Bowyer]
description: Amid piles of unfinished lengths of wood, several workbenches nestle in a veritable sea of thin wood shavings.  Clamps, planes, presses and other tools of the bowyer's trade stand in neat array on the workbenches.  Tucked into the few remaining spaces are various hooks, displays, and racks filled with the final product of the craftsmen's exacting labor.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Arcana]
description: The air here is dense with fine sawdust that creates an almost magical aura around the lanterns set high on the ship's beams.  Puffs of air from a tar-slicked chute in one corner keep the motes in continuous motion, although more than a little has settled on a felt-lined ironwood rack and a wide-slatted grey modwir bin.  A few beetles scurry through the sawdust on the floor, leaving tiny trails in their wake.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Workshop]
description: Various chutes, pipes, and conduits open out into this room, conveying an occasional load of rubbish.  The floor is cleverly constructed of tightly spaced wood lattice, allowing the smaller bits to fall into the fetid bilgewater below while keeping the larger detritus available for sorting.  A frayed rope ladder dangles down from some unseen vantage overhead.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Landing]
description: You break your long journey upward at a small landing, hardly more than a few planks wide.  Great stacks of lumber surround you, the sweet smell of the freshly sawn boards a refreshing change from the dank sewer below.  A small breeze comes from somewhere nearby, though the source seems hidden.

title: [Taninky's Treasures, Trinkets]
description: A gleaming crystal chandelier set with dozens of tiny candles brightens this windowless room, casting dancing beams of light over a wide array of metallic and gem-crusted wares.  A long silver display table is flanked by a twisted wire tree and a skinny modwir cloak rack.  The smooth plank floors are partially covered by a fluffy pink sheepskin rug scattered with a few turquoise silk pillows.

title: [Taninky's Treasures, Togs]
description: Spotlessly clean and minimalist in decor, this room is brightened by the sleek canary silk that covers all four walls.  A plain haon wardrobe stands against the far wall, and a polished oak table rests upon a white rabbit fur rug in the middle of the room.  The northern wall is fitted with a smooth white shelf piled high with folded garments.

title: [Taninky's Treasures, Trash]
description: Seeing the wares for sale this room is truly difficult, as the only light source is a pair of guttering oil lamps mounted on opposite walls of the closet-like space.  A stack of crates, nailed shut, are stacked haphazardly in the corner and covered in dust and cobwebs.  An open box is on its side in the middle of the room, with some contents peeking out of the torn flaps.  A rickety old ladder is used as a makeshift clothing rack.

title: [Pies-R-Us, Ingredient Room]
description: A round white table with pink painted legs is carefully placed in the center of the room.  Artfully arranged on the table are several different ingredients for making pies.  Hanging on the wall is a delicate pink sign.

title: [Pies-R-Us, Machine Room]
description: The walls in this room are white and embellished with pink-framed paintings and knick-knack lined pink shelves.  Placed by itself in the center of this room, looking awkward and out of place on a bright pink rug, is a large metal machine with lots of levers and buttons protruding from it at odd angles.

title: [The Workery, Textiles]
description: Multicolored fabric bolts in variegated finishes and textures stream along the perimeter of the ship's stowage area, trailing off before a beaded sewing room curtain.  Oil lamps hanging from the bulkheads suffuse the room with a rich amber glow, spilling out across a woolen tapestry carpet laid down to minimize the creaking of the boards underfoot.  A well-kept leather textile case is opened atop some cloth-filled cabinets, adjacent to a fully covered wall of broad, fabric-stacked shelves.

title: [The Workery, Sewing Room]
description: The deck above forms a low ceiling, but the room is comfortable for those who don't have to duck.  A dozen sewing tables are set about the room, occupied by halflings busily accepting patterns from the salesclerks and sewing clothing, their small fingers moving faster than the eye can follow.

title: [The Workery, Patterns]
description: The modwir-paneled walls outfitting the spacious storage area are polished to a faint silvery gleam and house a brass-faced porthole that provides a glimpse of the water outside.  Incandescent oil lamps hanging along the bulkheads illuminate a pair of vivid cyan seascape tapestries that frame the sides of a beaded sewing room curtain and provide plenty of light to inspect a neatly labeled sewing pattern cabinet.

title: [Trolling the Depths, Things]
description: A vile conglomeration of dank water and dilute tar coats the wall of the unassuming chamber in the ship's ballast.  Though the floor is marginally dry, the pervasive dampness has soaked into and rotted heaps of old cloth and what appears to have been a collection of old cabbage.  Dim blue light wells up from the ground beneath the mouldering scraps.

title: [The Broken Glass, Blowing Room]
description: Three smoky brass oil lamps, mounted on the bulkheads, hazily illuminate this cramped cabin.  A counter extends from one wall, turns at a right angle, and connects to another wall, barring passage and allowing only a small area in which to stand.  Behind the counter a young halfling leans over a spinning wheel, intently polishing the tips on a glittering glass circlet.  A far table contains a fire-making mechanism of some sort, lit, and a rack on the wall holds several long pipes.

title: [Stashers and Slashers, Weapons]
description: Hanging from the ceiling is a dimly lit chandelier which casts flickering light and long shadows over the area.  Lining the two opposing dark-paneled walls of this long, narrow space are a series of upturned hooks displaying several greataxes and naginatas, while a tall wooden weapons stand takes up the entire back wall, brandishing a neatly lettered sign and a number of smaller weapons for sale.

title: [Stashers and Slashers, Attire]
description: Bright sunlight streams through the three portal windows which dot one side of this long, narrow space, falling on the items hung from a series of upturned wood hooks running along the dark paneled wall opposite the windows.  A glass-fronted dark wood wardrobe takes up the entire back wall.

title: [Stashers and Slashers, Bags]
description: The crowded nature of this small dark paneled nook is exacerbated by a claw-footed large wooden table taking up most of the floor space, while several spindly protruding wood poles extend perpendicular out of the wall opposite the table.  Larger bags dangle from the poles, while the table is laden with rows of smaller pouches and purses.  A two-toned blue jute runner leads south to the foyer.

title: [Blooming Gorgeous, Multi Bloom]
description: The small, western nook is dominated by a large table of sanded oak atop intricately carved legs.  A collection of glass vases has been arranged in a circular pattern on top of the table, displaying a colorful array of many varieties of flowers.

title: [Blooming Gorgeous, Single Bloom]
description: The small, eastern nook is dominated by a large table of sanded oak atop intricately carved legs.  A collection of glass vases has been arranged in a circular pattern on top of the table, displaying a colorful array of many varieties of flowers.

title: [Head Over Heels, Boots]
description: Polished mahogany planks create a pleasant contrast to the vividly-hued hunting and feasting themed tapestries mounted on the walls.  One tapestry nearly covers the entirety of a narrow portal.  Discreet glass-shaded lanterns provide a constant, if flickering, illumination to appreciate the woven details.  Set in the middle of the otherwise empty floor is a brass-trimmed box with a display boot resting upon it.

title: [Spitfire, 'Tween Deck]
description: A crusty old halfling huddles on a low stool, industriously mending a bright red sock.  His face is so deeply creased and lined, it brings a prune to mind.  Behind him hangs a modwir door adorned with a masterful carving depicting a halfling with a spyglass in hand, perusing the far horizon.  A curling feather on his hat sweeps down and circles the shiny brass doorknob.

title: [Any Port in a Storm]
description: Rough haon walls line this rather small shop.  A few nondescript wall decorations here and there lend a little to the room, but not all that much.  Its only true redeeming quality would be the haon table and the oak table which flank the two sides of the shop.

title: [Spitfire, Walk The Plank!]
description: The walls and floor of this large cabin are crafted of paneled oak, their surface stained in places by years of exposure to salt-water and the elements.  A cool breeze drifts in through several open, circular portholes.  A large salt-stained table rests against the far wall, and several hats and bandanas hang from some rusted steel hooks beside it.  A weathered driftwood strongbox sits quietly underneath the hooks.

title: [Spitfire, 'Tween Deck]
description: The floor here is polished to a high shine, though it still shows scuff marks in swirling patterns.  Either the crew uses this area to spar, or they spend the long weeks at sea relieving the monotony with lively dances.

title: [Spitfire, 'Tween Deck]
description: Without bunks and table taking up space, this lower level seems spacious.  The ceiling is higher, offering anyone taller than a halfling the chance to stand erect.  A few chairs are scattered about, and a wooden washtub is pushed against the wall.

title: [Spitfire, Walk The Plank!]
description: The scents of salt water and brine are almost overwhelming in this room.  A colorful tapestry adorns one of the walls, its intricate weaves showing a black-sailed ship coasting away from a burning merchant vessel.  The ship's flag portrays the infamous skull and crossbones of a pirate cutter.  A large iron-banded strongbox lies on the ground beneath the tapestry.  You also see a wide black steel table with some maps and tools atop it, and some large chests on the ground beneath it.

title: [Spitfire, Walk The Plank!]
description: A small fire burns quietly within a weathered stone fireplace, its meager warmth doing little to combat the otherwise chill breeze that stirs throughout the room.  Two brightly polished steel cutlasses are mounted upon the mantle above it, their curving blades crossed beneath the image of a leering skull carved into the stone.  Opposite the fireplace are a tall polished oak weapon rack and a wide polished oak armor stand.

title: [Spitfire, Coach House Cabin]
description: Alternating light and dark woods panel the bulkheads of the cabin.  On the deck is a thick piled rug, woven with an intricate image of a battle -- an apropos setting for the weaponry and armor on display in front of a large mural painted directly on the wall.  The bunk and any furnishings that would accommodate lodging here have been removed, making room for the business of commerce.

title: [Luscious Libations]
description: A polished rosewood bar spans one side of the room, padded stools placed in front of it.  Behind the bar are shelves containing a large variety of drinks while hooks and racks above the bar hold an assortment of glasses.  A rich plum rug covers the floor, tall tables surrounded by stools scattered about it, and tattered flags hang from the walls.  A glass-paneled cabinet features a collection of bottles filled with colorful liquids.

title: [Delectable Drinks]
description: This small room looks as though it normally serves as a large closet.  Shelves line the walls, having been hastily draped with scarves of varying colors.  Beneath the shelves is a table made from what might have once been the door to this room propped on a couple of barrels.  Tacked to the front of the table is a hand-written sign.  A faded royal blue rug sits on the floor, the edges scrunched up against the walls.

title: [The Magic Tart, Entry]
description: Lengths of white canvas have been hung along the walls to hide the planks of the ship from view, which would allow visitors to forget they are onboard were it not for the slight swaying.  A wide trestle table has been set with a large steel tray that slides from side to side in a precarious manner.  The smell of fresh-baked pastries pervades the shop, as do over-excited halfling children.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [The Magic Tart, Tea Room]
description: Some extremely tiny wire-framed tables and chairs crowd near an oak plank table set with a large steel tray and cups of hot herbal tea.  The white canvas hung along the walls is painted with a trompe l'oeil depicting a green meadow dotted with a variety of wildflowers and miniscule jam fingerprints.  Children occasionally dart behind the unsecured canvas while shouting to their parents to guess where they are.  Their adult compatriots drink their tea with a look of savaged patience.

title: [A Candlelit Closet]
description: Rows of candles set halfway up each wall of this closet do nothing to ease the close confines.  Yelps and groans issue from visitors as they reach for the weapons arrayed on the flame-etched rack above the candles.  Shoppers have better luck with an icy blue rack and a heavy golden rack arrayed beneath the burning tapers.

title: [Baker's Good Baked Goods]
description: The scents of oven-baked bread and fresh chocolate fill the air inside this large shop.  A low, brick stove, located directly in the room's center, lights the area with a ruddy crimson glow.  Opposite the stove, a large table displays a fine selection of recently.

title: [A Candlelit Closet]
description: Repetitive apologies fill this half of the closet, as patrons bump into each other trying to reach some heavy stone hooks above the fat tallow candles that light the interior.  A gold-washed emerald green rack provides both an interesting centerpiece and insurmountable obstacle to those who have flattened themselves against the back wall.

title: [Baker's Good Baked Goods]
description: Behind a long oak-topped counter stand three short halfling-sized mannequins in one corner of the room.  Each of the three is dressed up to resemble a cook or perhaps a pastry chef, and an interesting variety of tools adorns the counter before them.  Oddly, the faces of all three mannequins are covered with jam, fruit, and chocolate.  It seems almost as if a food fight occurred here...recently.

title: [Baker's Good Baked Goods]
description: Two large tapestries adorn the walls in this section of the shop, each depicting the same halfling in two completely different settings.  Beneath the tapestries rest a brick-lined granite tart kiln, its top covered with a sheet of mithril upon which rest several fresh-out-of-the-oven tarts.  You also see a large wicker bin with a hastily written sign on it.

title: [Baker's Good Baked Goods]
description: Dozens of pots, pans, trays, and cooling racks hang from the paneled oak walls, and the scent of freshly baked pastries becomes even stronger.  A wide jam-stained counter rests against the far wall.

title: [The Magic Tart, Tea Room]
description: A steady stream of piratical-looking halflings march through this area of the bakery, purchasing packets of spinach tarts.  Their presence awes the visiting children, who clutch their parents' hands while goggling at the ship's natives.  An oak plank table bearing a large steel tray and cups of hot herbal tea separates the pirates from the youthful landlubbers.

title: [The Magic Tart, Bakery]
description: A battery of white-clad halfling bakers mans the wide oven that crouches against the back wall.   Each possesses a wood-handled, wide spatula which they use to retrieve trays of tarts from the warm depths of the oven.  Curious children tug on the harried halflings' tunics, asking an enormous array of questions regarding tart ingredients, magic, ship-building, and bakery headgear.

title: [Tasty Tarts]
description: Various sets of footprints wander through flour that has been spilled on the floor, leading up to a wooden counter.  Behind the counter is a large, footed metal oven that gives off heat and a pleasant scent.  Cabinets hang on the walls holding baking supplies, bowls, cups, and utensils.  In the middle of the room is a crimson cloth-covered table artfully arranged with tarts of various shapes and sizes.

title: [Spitfire, Forward Deckhouse]
description: An old halfling sits on one of the bunks that take up most of the room in the deckhouse quarters.  His attention is fixed on a piece of wood he's whittling, and he gives interlopers no notice.  Small items of a personal nature are attached to racks above most of the bunks, offering an insight into the sailors who sleep here -- a hat, a couple of carvings relating to favorite gods -- each has a sense of significance, since so little here deviates from uniformity.

title: [Methais's Home, Living Room]
description: A large bearskin rug covers most of the floor, with polished haon flooring showing between it and the cherrywood wainscoting.  A pair of relaxing-looking overstuffed chairs and an ottoman face a big ol' comfy couch with a pillow at either end.  A spiral staircase leads upstairs from the southeast corner of the room, and on the other side of the front door a wide window looks out onto the intersection of Nerite Lane and Eastbridge, lit by the glow of the streetlamps.

title: [Rogue Guild, Wine Cellar]
description: The dim light from a torch casts a flickering light over the murky room causing dancing shadows to play over a rack of dusty wine bottles sitting against one wall.  Two large wine casks on the opposite wall nearly fill the rest of the room.  Sitting in the center of the bare floor is a small table.

title: [A Dank Tunnel]
description: The air is cool and damp, smelling slightly of mildew.  The sound of small scurrying feet and faint squeaks echo through the tunnel.

title: [A Dank Tunnel]
description: Spider webs dangle from the ceiling of the damp tunnel.  The walls are slightly green and glisten with moisture.  Water trickles from a crack in the tunnel wall and pools on the floor.

title: [A Dank Tunnel]
description: A light draft blows through the tunnel, bringing a smell of mildew.  The walls and floor sweat with moisture.

title: [A Dank Tunnel]
description: The tunnel seems to dead end here.  The sounds of someone moving can be heard overhead.  A large stack of empty crates has been piled against the wall.  In the ceiling above the stacked crates is a rusty grating.

title: [Galnuir's Archery, Workroom]
description: A scratched table sits against one wall, containing jars of feathers, lengths of wood for creating bows, and fletcher's tools. Through the cracks of the rack, the bowyer can be seen moving about the shop beyond.  Partly concealed behind a stack of crates is a rusty floor grating.

title: [A Dusty Storeroom]
description: A jumbled collection of junk and treasure clutters the room.  Dusty, unframed paintings are propped against tables piled high with delicate vases, silver platters, golden candlesticks.  The corners are jammed with a collection of mismatched shields and weapons.  A life-sized stuffed rolton is posed as if about to charge.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: The entrance to this carefully engineered tunnel is marked with an arched oak crossbeam supported by stout oak bracing columns.  A gourd-shaped ceramic oil lamp hangs from the crossbeam, illuminating the tunnel with a strange, shimmering light.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: The light is dim in this section of the tunnel.  The braces and crossbeams, although carefully placed, are simple and utilitarian.  The air is dank and musty.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: The ceiling of this section of the tunnel is covered with an oily smudge, the consequence of the flickering, ceramic oil lamp hanging from the cross beam.  To the northeast is a small alcove.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: The tunnel turns slightly here.  The light in this section of the tunnel is dim.  To the northwest is a flickering light.  To the south, a steady natural light.

title: [Mushroom Farm]
description: This small alcove is filled by rows of wooden racks, each containing several trays of mushrooms growing rich loamy soil.  A large sign is nailed to the first rack.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: Sunlight filters in through a thick, frosted window set high on the wall.  To the north is a carefully engineered tunnel.  A knotted rope leads up through a hole in the ceiling.

title: [al'Khalili Coffeeshop, Alcove]
description: This tiny, undecorated alcove is concealed behind a partition.  The aroma of strong coffee fills the area.

title: [A Small Passageway]
description: This is a small room, featureless except for a note tacked to the wall.  Some narrow steps lead down.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: There is just enough light to enable you to make out the sturdy wooden beams and braces that shore up the tunnel.  An empty torch bracket is attached to one of the braces.  Narrow steps lead up.  The tunnel to the west is completely dark.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: It is too dark here to see anything.  The tunnel is damp and smells musty, although there is a slight hint of air coming from the west.  The floor of the tunnel is firm but uneven.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The light here is very faint, but enough to enable you to see the wooden beams and braces that shore up the tunnel.  One of the braces is cracked and has been reinforced with iron slats.  To the east the tunnel is completely dark.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Light filters down through a square opening in the ceiling, illuminating motes of dust.  Handholds set in the tunnel wall lead up to the opening.

title: [Timor's Storage, Secret Closet]
description: This tiny room is completely devoid of adornment.  In the floor is a square opening, through which a series of handholds can be seen.  A narrow passage leads out.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: The tunnel ends abruptly here.  The tunnel ceiling has caved in.  A pair of broken braces displays the hack and chop marks of a broad bladed axe.  A frayed and moldy bit of rope is knotted around the middle of one of the braces.

title: [Backstage]
description: Dusty stacks of boards, crates, and piled tapestries fill the corners of the cramped, dark room.  A cracked mirror resting against one wall reflects the dim light through a layer of sooty grime.

title: [A Narrow Passage]
description: This small, dark space between the buildings allows barely enough room to squeeze through the gap in the rough walls.  Sounds of the city street echo from beyond an outcropping in the stone.

title: [Courtyard]
description: A tall, yellow brick wall totally encloses this grassy area.  The expanse of wall is only interrupted by a pair of open gates.  A neatly cropped, dark green privet hedge rises about five feet, following the wall around its entirety, above which evenly spaced torches burn to brightly illuminate the area.  Centered in the lawn is a glowing silver portal.

title: [Empath Guild, Hub]
description: Huge green hedges ring this large open area.  The hedges rise nearly fifteen feet and intertwine tightly, preventing passage through them.  At all eight points of the compass, however, openings wide enough to walk through appear in the hedges.  A torchlit marble fountain in the center of the area sprays a steady stream of water upward, falling back to cascade down several tiers to the large pool at the bottom.  Near the northeast corner, a glowing silver portal stands.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Guild Master Laurel's Area]
description: The grass in this area is heavily trod and has a few patches missing.  A round wooden table seems to be the focus point of several wooden chairs, and a canvas covering has been stretched between four poles to both shade the area from the sun and protect it from rain.  A single freestanding torch placed a bit out from the overhang provides ample light.

title: [Training Garden]
description: The acre of lawn extends both north and west, bordered by tall thick hedges with southern, southeastern, and eastern exits.  Chestnut and walnut trees shade several sections of the area.  Quiet instruction, often punctuated by the ring of metal on metal, takes place under several trees, with the focus appearing to be the improvement of physical and combat abilities.  In contrast to the rounded deciduous trees, two upright sugar pines stand near the western hedge, with a long table under each pine.

title: [Training Garden]
description: A roughly rectangular acre of moonlit lawn spreads out to the north.  Tall dark green hedges define the area's border, with the closest exits being openings in the southern and eastern directions.  Various workstations for the improvement of martial arts, weaponry, and bodybuilding occupy positions under spreading walnut and chestnut trees.  Several unlit torches accompany each station.  Nearby, sandbags lie haphazardly piled under one particularly gnarled chestnut tree.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Aroma Therapy]
description: A tight rattan mesh arcs overhead to form a nearly impenetrable dome supported by the tall hedges all around.  The dome's thickness reduces this glade to near darkness.  Hundreds of steel cylinders, one foot in diameter and polished to a mirror-like sheen, support a single candle each at heights ranging from ground level to above a giantman's head.
