Fifty of the candles are of various shapes and sizes, only one of which is lit at any one time.  The rest are tall white candles that blaze brilliantly.

title: [Library]
description: The tall hedges hem in this long, narrow area.  Thick poles deeply implanted just in front of the hedges support a roof of rough-hewn timbers.  A thick layer of grey gravel winds among tall bookshelves situated to form quiet nooks with lamp-lit desks for study.  Interestingly, the majority of the shelves appear to contain information on honing one's will, meditation, martial arts, and weaponry rather than healing arts.  Openings allow exit to the north, east, and west.

title: [Relaxation Garden]
description: Rounded light grey shrubs randomly placed provide a counterpoint to the dark grey hedges that surround this peaceful enclosure.  Metal rocking chairs lounge at various points across the area, with one blazing torch accompanying each chair.  Crickets and frogs call happily from underneath the protective foliage.  Openings carved through the dense towering shrubs lead north, northwest, and west.

title: [Infirmary]
description: An array of small cabinets huddles under a wooden overhang in this slightly constricted area.  Dark green hedges tower overhead, standing uncomfortably close to the torch-lined walkway that winds throughout.  A mannequin, barely recognizable under all the bandages, splints, and tourniquets, leans against the hedge in one corner, and a few white canvas cots stand side-by-side in another corner.  Someone has neatly trimmed openings in the hedges to the north, west and south.

title: [Meeting Garden]
description: A level expanse of lawn holds rows of padded silver chairs, all of which point toward a raised marble dais.  Behind the dais, banners fly from each of four flagpoles, and torches burn at strategic points to illuminate the entire area.  Tall dark green hedges surround the meeting garden and rise to block the line of sight into adjacent areas.  Openings have been cut through the hedges in the western, southwestern, and southern directions, with each opening flanked by a pair of columnar junipers.

title: [Potion Garden]
description: Tall dark green hedges border this area, blocking the view of the surrounding countryside.  Openings lead to the west, south, and east.  Several low stone tables hold a variety of bottles, beakers, ingredients, and herbs.  Lit torches stand beside each bench, and a soft carpet of closely cropped bluegrass blankets the entire area, providing a comfortable cushion on which to sit or scamper barefoot.  Bright silver canvas has been pushed under some of the hedges.

title: [Empath Guild, Nexus]
description: Finished in crisp white monir paneling trimmed with mistwood, the walls of this chamber are set with a series of open doorways.  Miniature trees and petite flowering shrubs fill large red clay pots that are spaced evenly around the room.  Tall candles in golden sconces illuminate the area, casting long shifting shadows on the numerous plants below.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Empath Guild, Pothinir Workshop]
description: A large round skylight bathes the room in pale moonlight, washing over the broad monir workbench and flowing outward.  Covering the top of the workbench is a thick slab of blue-veined marble, pitted and marred in several spots.  The walls are plain and bare, except for a stylized painting of pothinir grass, underscoring the utilitarian nature of the area.

title: [Empath Guild, Haphip Workshop]
description: A large round skylight bathes the room in pale moonlight, washing over the broad monir workbench and flowing outward.  Covering the top of the workbench is a thick slab of blue-veined marble, pitted and marred in several spots.  The walls are plain and bare, except for a stylized painting of a haphip tree, underscoring the utilitarian nature of the area.

title: [Empath Guild, Ephlox Workshop]
description: A large round skylight bathes the room in pale moonlight, washing over the broad monir workbench and flowing outward.  Covering the top of the workbench is a thick slab of blue-veined marble, pitted and marred in several spots.  The walls are plain and bare, except for a stylized painting of ephlox moss, underscoring the utilitarian nature of the area.

title: [Empath Guild, Reagent Storage]
description: Brimming with bottles, canisters, jars, and containers of all sizes, rows of thick shelving nearly obscure the pale white paneling on every wall of this small cubicle.  A squat oval worktable occupies the center of the room, making maneuvering difficult.  Assorted mortar and pestle sets, clean and ready for use, are scattered amidst miscellaneous glassware and other equipment atop the table.

title: [Empath Guild, Calamia Workshop]
description: A large round skylight bathes the room in pale moonlight, washing over the broad monir workbench and flowing outward.  Covering the top of the workbench is a thick slab of blue-veined marble, pitted and marred in several spots.  The walls are plain and bare, except for a stylized painting of calamia fruit, underscoring the utilitarian nature of the area.

title: [Empath Guild, Bolmara Workshop]
description: A large round skylight bathes the room in pale moonlight, washing over the broad monir workbench and flowing outward.  Covering the top of the workbench is a thick slab of blue-veined marble, pitted and marred in several spots.  The walls are plain and bare, except for a stylized painting of bolmara lichen, underscoring the utilitarian nature of the area.

title: [Empath Guild, Acantha Workshop]
description: A large round skylight bathes the room in pale moonlight, washing over the broad monir workbench and flowing outward.  Covering the top of the workbench is a thick slab of blue-veined marble, pitted and marred in several spots.  The walls are plain and bare, except for a stylized painting of an acantha plant, underscoring the utilitarian nature of the area.

title: [Empath Guild, Equipment Room]
description: Considering the amount of cleaning equipment stored here, one might expect a great deal of dust and disarray, yet not a single object seems out of place.  A stout open-front locker holds brooms, copper dust pans, and other janitorial tools, each hung or stacked neatly within.  Along each wall of the spacious room, equally sturdy cabinets and cupboards store cauldrons, alembics, and large pieces of equipment.  Every item is carefully nestled in its own clearly labeled partition.

title: [A Stone Chamber]
description: A single oil lamp hanging from the high vaulted ceiling illuminates the small oval chamber.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Firmly bolted to the wall at one side of the room is a small, cast-iron ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Blackberry Room]
description: A chandelier with black crystal drops hangs in the center of the room.  The light gleaming from the dozens of small candles is reflected back from the smooth, black granite floor.  Plump leather chairs are arranged on either side of a highly polished modwir bookcase.

title: [Blackberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Blackberry Locker Room]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Dark Shrine, Chapel]
description: Here, surrounded by dark frescoes presenting frightening images of terror, foul beasts and macabre rituals, confronted by the huge, ghastly statue that dominates the center of the chamber, the sense of evil is a palpable force that threatens to smother and consume all that it can.

title: [Dark Shrine, Chapel]
description: Here, the large round chamber that forms the main body of this dark and dreadful chapel opens onto a passageway that leads to the west.  The huge statue that dominates the center of the chamber faces to the south, its face turned away from you.  To the northeast a large stone chair occupies another part of the chamber, and to the east, beyond the terrible statue, an arch leads out of the chamber.

title: [Dark Shrine, Wide Passageway]
description: A plain stone passageway has been cleanly carved from the solid rock, and leads to the east and west.  The featureless stone is grey, and the surface is abrasive.

title: [Dark Shrine, Vestry]
description: Time has worked its worst on the large wooden trunk and larger wooden cabinet that stand against the east wall.  The wood has deteriorated badly, suffering from dry rot and the ravages of worms.  Metal hooks are mounted every foot or so at eye level around the room.

title: [Dark Shrine, Secret Room]
description: Row upon row of tall stone jars stand against the walls of this room.  A strong odor hangs in the air, sickeningly sweet with a subtle bitter, acidic quality.  The fetid odor makes your bile rise, and it is hard to breathe.

title: [Dark Shrine, Altar]
description: The low stone altar is covered with dark stains.  One corner of the altar has been broken off, and several of the hideous faces and figures carved into the stone walls have been smashed.  Large iron braziers, covered with rust and corrosion, stand at each end of the altar table.  A cracked brass gong hangs from a wooden brace along the north wall, facing an ancient tapestry which hangs directly opposite.

title: [Dark Shrine, Chapel]
description: A mosaic pattern set into the floor depicts the image of a horrible beast, and more hideous figures are carved into the stone around an arch that leads to the east.  Whatever dark rituals were once performed in this evil place seem still to resonate, filling the chamber with dread.

title: [Dark Shrine, Chapel]
description: In long ages past, some dark, evil priest once sat upon the large stone chair that occupies this part of the chamber like a throne.  Or perhaps one of the Dark Lords themselves, or one of their dark servants, presided over the evil that was performed here.

title: [Dark Shrine, Wide Passageway]
description: A plain stone passageway has been cleanly carved from the solid rock, and leads to the east and west.  The featureless stone is grey, and the surface is abrasive.

title: [Dark Shrine, Large Chamber]
description: Like a huge pair of eyes, two large, round windows look out over the eerie rough terrain far below.  The openings look out on a panorama of rocky desolation.  Huge, jagged mountains rise up all around, snow capped peaks high above ice covered slopes, strewn with large boulders.  The cold wind that blows in through the openings bears as much desolation as the view.  There is no scent of green trees and running sap, no odor of wildlife rising from the slopes outside.

title: [Dark Shrine, Short Hallway]
description: Three doors lead off from this short, featureless hallway.  The doors to the east and west are plain wooden doors, but the door at the south end of the hallway is a large bronze door, framed with stone.

title: [Dark Shrine, Storage Room]
description: Several tall jars lie on their sides in a heap along one wall next to a stack of heavy disks.  Along the opposite wall is a collection of large ceramic urns, which reek with a fetid sweet odor.

title: [Dark Shrine, Library]
description: Fire has destroyed most of this room.  Charred shelves filled with ashes and the remains of countless volumes of books and scrolls line the walls.  Several tall desks occupy the center of the room, like the stumps of lightning struck trees.  The brass lamps suspended from the ceiling on long chains are covered with soot and a patina of green and grey corrosion.

title: [Dark Shrine, Burial Vault]
description: Dark skeletal figures lie in silent repose, stacked one upon the other in tiers of niches carved out of the stone walls.  Their musty odor assails your senses, and adds to the oppressiveness of the chamber.  A low stone slab occupies the center of the chamber, like a raised dais, but there is nothing on it except for a thick layer of dust.

title: [Moot Hall, South Corridor]
description: Rich merlot carpet muffles footsteps through the southern corridor of Moot Hall.  Two long wooden benches sit on each side of a carved wooden door, while a lone giantman guard stands watch over a modwir arch.  A small wooden placard hangs on the wall above an ivory-handled door.

title: [Moot Hall, Chamber of Justice]
description: Two high-backed, elaborately carved chairs face the imposing, burnished oak bench where members of the official Town Council convene to decide matters of solemn importance.  A narrow stairway leads up to a low balcony that surrounds the chamber, providing ample seating for interested visitors to observe the proceedings.

title: [Moot Hall, Observation Balcony]
description: Several rows of hardwood benches line the balcony, each row a bit higher than the previous one in order to provide a view of the proceedings below from every seat.  A polished oak railing forms the front barrier of the viewing area, and a narrow stairway leads down.

title: [Moot Hall, Council Chambers]
description: The walls of this cozy little room are lined with shelves laden with leather-bound volumes of legal and cultural reference.  Deeply-cushioned leather chairs and bright lamplight provide a comfortable place for study and thoughtful reflection.

title: [The Twilight Parlor]
description: Thin, flowering vines creep along the stone walls in this underground space.  Overhead, the root system draping down from the ceiling is twisted into an elaborate chandelier that illuminates the richly appointed quarters.  Set atop a fel and willow floor, a pair of dark-hued divans is arranged around a low table.  At the base of a spiral stone staircase, a gold-edged mirror is dark rather than reflective.

title: [The Twilight Parlor, Bedchamber]
description: Pure alabaster lines spread out within the dark, mottled stone walls, where candelabras adorned with white candles highlight the spiderweb-like patterns.  A curtain of climbing vines spreads across the ceiling and, despite the underground setting, is dotted with tiny crimson and violet blossoms.  A plush rug of dark blue partially spreads over the fel and willow flooring.  In between a carved willow writer's desk and a stone pedestal holding a small basin, four-poster bed is lavished with soft blankets.

title: [The Twilight Parlor, Star Nexus]
description: Crumbling stone walls reveal wet earth behind them, from which vines and roots spring forth with clingy tendrils.  Darkly colored fel flooring is inset with a large, perfect circle of pale willow wood in the center of the room.  The ceiling rises up in a small, golden dome dotted with glowing specks of black, like dark constellations against a sunlit sky.  A jeweled chest resides against the wall opposite a curved stone arch.

title: [Marroux and Haert, Chirurgeons]
description: One slightly tilted table is placed in the center of the room, located over a metal grating inset into the slate-tiled floor.  Glass-fronted cabinets line the walls.  As if an afterthought, several uncushioned and wobbly-looking stools sit near the sagging frame of a wooden door, arranged haphazardly together.

title: [Moat, Bottom]
description: Touching bottom, and feeling your lungs crying for air, you suppress panic as you try to swim towards the surface.  Sticky muck sucks at your feet, and black, eyeless creatures scuttle along the floor of the moat.

title: [Moat, Underwater]
description: The cold and pressure of the depths here are unbearable.  In a fit of pure terror and blind panic, you frenziedly claw your way upward, towards the light, warmth and air on the surface.

title: [Moat, Whirlpool]
description: A black, cold feeling of panic tightens in your chest and throat.  You cannot see, you cannot breathe, you can only hear the rapid beating of your own heart as the treacherous whirlpool draws you into the lower depths of the foul moat.

title: [Prion's General Store]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, a sphere-hilted mounted sword plaque hangs on one of the stark stone block walls.  Some hammered copper display hooks and a heavy white granite counter sit in opposite corners while an oily black kraken statue rests on an ash grey granite floor.

title: [Katirena's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling, a sphere-hilted mounted sword plaque hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A brass treasure chest sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Heust's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Fennik's Weaponry]
description: The broad sweep of the dark oak floor is interrupted by a plush black bear fur rug.  Halfway to the white stucco ceiling, a fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs on one of the rough white stucco walls.  A set of carved felwood shelves is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Willow Hall, Garden]
description: Wildflowers of every color abound, their rich aroma filling the air.  A willow tree stands proudly in the center of the beds, its leafy garlands caressing the ground and swaying gently in the breeze.  To the west is a crystal blue pond, and beyond that sit two wooden benches and a table, providing an inviting spot to sit and relax in the warm sun.  A small cottage sits back in the southwest corner with a gazebo opposite it.

title: [Willow Hall, Gazebo]
description: The vines clinging to the sides of the wooden gazebo are thick enough to enclose the gazebo in soft shadows.  Faint illumination falls through the living lattice, creating a dappled pattern of moonlight on the wooden plank floor that is lighter than the darkness cloaking a bench running the circumference of the walls.  Night sounds of crickets in the ivy serenade the intimate enclosure.

The vines clinging to the sides of the wooden gazebo are thick enough to shade the enclosure from the sun's heat while yielding an appealing dappled pattern of light on the wooden plank floor.  The interior is cool and secluded, and a bench runs around the seven walls opposite the entrance.

title: [Willow Hall, Sun Room]
description: The vaulted crystal ceiling of the glass-enclosed room soars over massive hand-hewn oak beams.  Large clay pots planted with colorful wildflowers and greenery, and baskets of ivy hanging from the beams frame a breathtaking view of Willow Hall's garden.  The south wall is solid stone with a cascade of water falling over it into a pool at its base.  White wicker chairs and tables invite one to gaze up at the celestial beauty of the night sky overhead.

The vaulted crystal ceiling of the glass-enclosed room soars over massive hand-hewn oak beams.  Large clay pots planted with colorful wildflowers and greenery, and baskets of ivy hanging from the beams frame a breathtaking view of Willow Hall's garden.  The south wall is solid stone with a cascade of water falling over it into a pool at its base.  White wicker chairs and tables invite one to bask in the warm sunlight streaming into the chamber.

title: [Willow Hall, Octagonal Alcove]
description: The hall ends within an octagonal alcove, each of its squared wall panels offering a painted mural.  The murals depict eight varieties of trees, and a gracefully curved scroll painted at the foot identifies the kind.  A round window peeks from among the boughs of the western tree, offering a view of the sparkling river coursing along the perimeter of Willow Hall's grounds.  Five doors are nestled in the base of tree trunks on the walls, crafted of the same wood as the painted renditions.

title: [Willow Hall, Veranda]
description: Wide fieldstone steps lead past a terra-cotta strawberry pot onto a veranda sheltered by latticework intertwined with ivy vines.  Patterns of shadows chase across the floor as sunlight filters through the emerald leaves.  A myriad of colorful flowers, planted in window boxes and hanging baskets, exude a fragrant perfume, born on a gentle breeze that rustles through the ivy and sets a wind chime tinkling.  A pot of blooming violets sits on a table placed next to a generous woven grapevine swing.

title: [Willow Hall, Corridor]
description: The wide corridor is carpeted with a thick wool runner, its length covered with a complex pattern of leaves in rich tones of green.  A strip of dark flooring runs along each side, throwing reflections off its polished surface in response to alternating windows and sconces.  The carpet muffles steps, lending the hallway a serene hush.  At the corridor's end, two doors face each other, flanking a large painting hanging on the wall between them.

title: [Willow Hall, Fireside Room]
description: This rustic room is a cozy retreat from the Great Room.  The worn modwir floor is covered haphazardly with fur rugs and fluffy pillows made from the hides of creatures native to Wehnimer's Landing.  The rough-hewn walls are covered with a multitude of portraits, sketches, and hand carved graffiti.  In the center of the room, a ring of comfortable modwir armchairs surrounds an immense riverstone fire pit.  Scattered rays of moonlight filter into the room through a round pane glass window that glimpses out onto a leafy forest glade.

This rustic room is a cozy retreat from the Great Room.  The worn modwir floor is covered haphazardly with fur rugs and fluffy pillows made from the hides of creatures native to Wehnimer's Landing.  The rough-hewn walls are covered with a multitude of portraits, sketches, and hand carved graffiti.  In the center of the room, a ring of comfortable modwir armchairs surrounds an immense riverstone fire pit, above which a willow leaf embossed scroll is set.  Scattered rays of sunlight filter into the room through a round pane glass window that glimpses out onto a forest glade.

title: [Willow Hall, Roof Garden]
description: On the flat roof of the Great Room is a garden, ingeniously crafted to resemble a natural meadow.  A light breeze ripples the long grass, causing moon shadows to flicker across their rippling surface.  Higher stories of the hall border the southern edge of the expanse, and a row of bungalows can be seen lining the eastern section.  Bright lights shining from the buildings' windows cast shadows behind a trio of malachite benches holding court in the surrounding sea of grass.

On the flat roof of the Great Room is a garden, ingeniously crafted to resemble a natural meadow.  A light breeze ripples the long grass, intermittently hiding patches of wild flowers.  Higher stories of the hall border the southern edge of the expanse, and a row of bungalows can be seen lining the eastern section.  A curling ribbon of fragrant smoke lifts from the roof of the west wing, wafting past a trio of malachite benches holding court in the surrounding sea of grass.

title: [Willow Hall, Pub]
description: In contrast to the expansive magnificence of the Great Room, this intimate chamber exudes cozy comfort.  Windows overlook a moonlit garden to the east, and in the room's center, tables and chairs flank a large, stone fireplace with some mounted antlers above the mantel.  A counter extends across the entire length of one wall, laden with bowls and trenchers filled with the harvest of land and sea.

In contrast to the expansive magnificence of the Great Room, this intimate chamber exudes cozy comfort.  Windows overlook the garden to the east, and in the room's center, tables and chairs flank a large, stone fireplace with some mounted antlers above the mantel.  A counter extends across the entire length of one wall, laden with bowls and trenchers filled with the harvest of land and sea.

title: [Willow Hall, Pearsall's Study]
description: Simple furnishings in the cozy room reveal the spare taste of its inhabitant, just as the low ceiling suggests the individual's height.  A small sofa's sole decoration is an embroidered willow tree on its back, and opposite that, a cleanly designed desk is piled high with papers and manuscripts.  Two stuffed chairs face an iron stove with an odd chamber above the firebox.  A hinged door on its front shows that it is an oven, perfectly sized for baking any manner of delights including tarts.

title: [Willow Hall, Adit's Study]
description: Books line the walls of the cozy room, where comfortable armchairs are gathered on a stone flagged floor.  Specimens of rock, samples of wood and a variety of plants pressed in glaes decorate the bookshelves.  The amazing collection of artifacts and items are carefully arranged by subject and type, obviously the work of a lifetime.  A red thrak rug offers a comfortable resting spot to enjoy the warm fire and read in the flames' soft glow.

title: [Willow Hall, Glen Room]
description: A pile of boulders stands high against the room's far wall, their assembly ingeniously designed to mimic nature's random beauty.  A pool ripples at the stones' feet, fed by a spray of water arching from the top of the slope, and then cascading down its rocky face.  The surface of the pool roils and steams, its source apparently from the heated depths, and it sends clouds of steam drifting up through the boughs of three willows growing around its perimeter.

title: [Willow Hall, The Hot Pool]
description: The hot water contained in the pool seems almost unbearable at first touch.  However, within moments, the temperature mellows to comfortable, and shortly thereafter, it's positively luxurious.  Stone steps leading into its deeper center make perfect places to sit at whatever depth one prefers, ranging from barely waist deep for a halfling to chin deep for a giantman.

title: [Willow Hall, Hall of Lockers]
description: The chamber is more of a wide corridor than what one would consider a traditional room.  Its long expanse of side walls is paneled with richly grained oak, and hung with a number of large canvasses.  On the far wall hang two emerald-colored curtains, one obviously newer than the other, partitioning off the alcoves behind.

title: [Willow Hall, Armory]
description: The Willow Hall armory is a generous chamber with glistening blades neatly arranged along the uppermost levels of built-in wooden shelves around its walls.  Suits of leather and armor, mostly battle-worn from years of use, hang from pegs interspersed among the banks of shelves.  The many items donated by members of the Hall testify to the valor and honor common to the clansmen who once owned them.

title: [Willow Hall, Northwest Garden]
description: Crystal panels have been cleverly joined to form an impressive as well as expansive greenhouse.  The largest of the panels forms the doorway, and through the glass, you can see greenery and flora of many varieties.  The rich smell of humus and soil mix with the perfume of flowers from within.  By the entrance to the greenhouse stands a shack with stacks of pots along its side.

title: [Willow Hall, Greenhouse]
description: Beneath the crystal ceiling of the greenhouse, the air is heavy with humidity.  Small droplets of condensation drip down constantly in a light shower from above.  Numerous rows of potted plants, flowers and herbs sit on neatly aligned shelves, stretching along both sides of the walkway that leads through the building.  Large bags of potting soil as well as neatly labeled pouches of seeds occupy the far end of the area.  Several rare plants are labeled and squared off in one corner.

title: [Willow Hall, Kerebus' Shack]
description: The aroma of exotic incense fills the room, mingling with verdant smells from outside.  Smoke from a still-burning censer curls in chaotic wisps, and several long strands of thread suspend rows of mushrooms to dry near the ceiling.  A number of odd plants potted in humanoid skulls sit on almost every available surface throughout the chamber.

title: [Willow Hall, The Dwarf Burrow]
description: The burrow is surprisingly spacious, although its low ceiling suggests its inhabitants are of a diminutive stature.  Along the perimeter of the roof, small round windows admit diffuse beams of moonlight as well as fresh air from the garden outside.  Over in one corner, sheltered by a wooden screen, sits a carved monir tub and opposite it, a snug little bed completes the lair's cozy comforts.

title: [Willow Hall, Library]
description: Willow Hall's library is a cheerful room despite the dark chestnut paneling and like-toned floor to ceiling bookshelves, largely due to the soft moonlight pouring in through windows across the west wall.  Leather-bound books ranging from light brown to deep burgundy are arranged along the shelves, the pattern of their colors taking on a jewel-like appearance.  Sitting on a cherry wood stand is a large open journal.

title: [Willow Hall, Parliament Room]
description: The floor of the expansive chamber is crafted of dark, mahogany planks.  In the corner, a rectangular glass terrarium occupies an oak table, surrounded by several potted plants.  The interior of the container is cleverly lit, throwing an irregular pattern of reflected light across the rich tone of the floor.  Against the far wall rests a large, feather bed, and the ceiling and walls have been skillfully painted with a mural depicting crisscrossed modwir branches covering a starry night sky.

title: [Willow Hall, Willow Tree]
description: The bole of the monstrous willow is surrounded with a wealth of hanging garlands.  They obscure the existence of a small enclave at the base of the tree near some louvered swinging doors, both curtained off by the tiny silver-backed leaves.  Constantly shifting spots of sunlight filtering through the boughs are hypnotic.  High up in the branch system, a circular construction is barely visible encircling the willow's trunk.

The bole of the monstrous willow is surrounded with a wealth of hanging garlands.  They obscure the existence of a small, shadowy enclave at the base of the tree near some louvered swinging doors, both curtained off by the tiny silver-backed leaves.  Soft moonlight filters through the boughs, leaving the silhouette of the branches as stark, black lines.  High up in the tree top, a circular construction is barely visible in the night's cloak of darkness.

title: [Willow Hall, Tree House]
description: The tree house is a simple, round wooden platform.  Interlaced willow branches form a wall about four feet high around the perimeter, concealing its dwellers from anyone below.  From above, soft moonlight bathes the aerie with its benevolent illumination.  Several benches sitting in a scattered array create an inviting rendezvous destination for a small group informally inclined.  To one side, a polished brass telescope is mounted on a pedestal.

From above, warm sunlight bathes the planks of the floor with a dappled pattern. title: [Willow Hall, Classroom]
description: Oak desks and chairs arranged neatly in groups fill the room.  A huge slate in the front dominates all, its surface still covered with chalk scrawls left from a previous day's lesson.  In the corner is a large basket filled with oversized scrolls, just beneath a large map of Elanthia hanging on the wall.  Along the window ledge sit seedlings of various herbs growing in small clay pots, each with a different student's name printed on its front.

title: [Willow Hall, Willow Room]
description: The large windows in the Hall's office offer a view of the moonlit garden outside.  Three desks positioned beneath serve the Chairman, Secretary and Treasurer.  Papers are heaped and scattered on their surfaces, indicating a preference for spending time in the wilds to being confined to a dreary desk.  A long cherry wood table stands in the room's center, surrounded by willow chairs, and occupying the east wall is a curious-looking hammered ora door, crafted in the shape of a standing fish.

A long cherry wood table stands in the room's center, surrounded by willow chairs, and occupying the east wall is a curious-looking hammered ora door, crafted in the shape of a standing fish.

title: [Willow Hall, Den]
description: Entirely windowless, the cozy den is illuminated by a cheerful fire, its smoke carried away by a polished copper hood suspended from the ceiling.  Wingback chairs with ottomans are clustered about, affording a place to converse or simply doze.  A mural depicting the known areas of Elanthia dominates the entire northern wall.  Three doorways of aspen, teak, and willow, occupy the southern wall, while three more doors are to the east.

Three doorways of aspen, teak, and pine, occupy the southern wall, while three more doors are to the east.

title: [Willow Hall, Jungle Room]
description: Resembling an exotic jungle encampment, the room's atmosphere is heady with the perfume of flowers growing on the trunks of trees around its perimeter.  Camp chairs and a folding table occupy what looks like a small clearing, and a hammock stretched between trees serves as a bed.  Illumination is provided by a round skylight and a brazier lamp fashioned in the image of a fire.  The ceiling has been painted with a representation of the night sky, with the circular skylight portraying the moon.

title: [Willow Hall, Desert Room]
description: This room has been decorated to resemble a tent, its walls draped with black felt to the floor, hiding the real door and walls.  The ceiling is cotton, held high at the center by a vertical pole.  A brass brazier burns at the pole's base, the smoke rising through a small hole at the very peak.  Large cushions are scattered about, their arrangement easily accommodating either lounging or sleeping.

title: [Willow Hall, Bayou Room]
description: The room is decorated to resemble a primitive swamp-hut, with rough-sawn planks comprising the walls showing gaps where they have shrunk.  Green beard moss hangs from the corners in thick, curly tangles.  Within a cauldron hung on a crane in the fireplace, a thick aromatic concoction bubbles, filling the room with the mouthwatering aroma of stew.  A narrow bed with a patchwork quilt provides a place to sleep, and a rough table and chair offer a place to sit.

title: [Willow Hall, Sunrise Room]
description: The entire eastern wall of the room is paned with glaes panels from floor to ceiling.  The view is mostly of the willow grove surrounding the hall, but in a gap, the eastern horizon is visible.  Each morning the rising sun's light is free to stream through the gap and play on the wall opposite, illuminating a magnificent tapestry of a likewise glorious sunrise.  Against the north wall sits a canopied bed, and next to it is a small stone fireplace.

title: [Willow Hall, Daenalan's Study]
description: The walls are lined from floor to ceiling with ornately carved bookshelves that are filled to overflowing with tomes on various subjects.  A white-washed ladder leans against one wall, set on a rail to slide as required.  A willow wood desk, piled high with scrolls and tomes, dominates the center of the room.  Intricate candlelabras flank the desk and illuminate the walls, revealing a statue of Lumnis sitting on a shelf.  Some cushioned chairs placed about the room provide a comfortable place to sit.

title: [Willow Hall, Pirate Cabin]
description: The room is decorated to resemble a cabin aboard a Krolvin-style sailing vessel.  It is floored with planks of teak, and brass portholes adorn the modwir walls, allowing shafts of sunlight to penetrate the interior.  A captain's bed almost fills the room's center, while a charting table is situated against the far wall.

title: [Willow Hall, Gaming Lounge]
description: The room is paneled with exotic woods, and the floors are covered with plush-woven carpets.  Potted palms occupy cozy corners, and an overhead lantern illuminates one well-done painting.  Several gaming tables, covered with green felt, are bathed with overhead stained glass lamps, and dealers and croupiers are at the ready.  Against the far wall is a polished willow wood dart board, and a brass spittoon rests under a palm.  Oddly enough, a spotted pink thrak resides in a suspended cage near the dart board.

title: [Willow Hall, Roof Pub]
description: Tucked against the wall of the building is a small enclosure topped with a tin roof and open on two sides.  Therein sit four stone boxes, all with fires built in them and game turning on spits above.  Tonight's choices appear to be bear, velnalin, salmon, and sausages, offered with unhusked corn cooked directly on the coals.  There is also a distinctive bar, featuring a tub containing a large block of ice.  Shaved ice surrounds the block, and brightly colored drinks occupy a tray close by.

title: [Willow Hall, The Butts]
description: On the west side of the north wing's roof stands a wall where several slices of tree trunk are affixed.  Pinned to these are three archery targets painted blue, green, and red, each with concentric rings of white, black, blue, red and the bull's eye of gold in the center.  Opposite the targets stands a willow wood rack providing storage for archery equipment next to a makeshift cart wheel table.

On the west side of the north wing's roof stands a wall where several slices of tree trunk are affixed.  Pinned to these are three archery targets painted blue, green, and red, each with concentric rings of white, black, blue, red and the bull's eye of gold in the center.  Opposite the targets stands a rack of equipment.

title: [Willow Hall, North Wing Roof]
description: This long expanse of roof runs the length of the east wing of the Hall bordering a row of small bungalows.  Each bungalow has a door unique from that of its neighbors, fashioned from differing varieties of wood.  In front of the cottages are small, tile-topped tables with wooden chairs where one can sit outside and enjoy the pleasant sunshine.

title: [Willow Hall, Githlander's Room]
description: A bank of windows faces a large driftwood bed covered in exotic furs.  To the side of the bed sits a matching driftwood desk and chair, ornately carved.  One wall is covered with a large tapestry, its vivid colors and intricate detail competing for the viewer's eye with a massive, stuffed polar bear in the opposite corner.  An expansive stone fireplace offers a cheerful fire to give light and warmth to the chamber.

title: [Willow Hall, Faegil's Room]
description: A gentle, fresh breeze blowing through an open arched window plays a quiet lullaby across the strings of an ancient harp, and riffles some papers lying upon the nearby workbench.  A few leaves have blown in, and they lie upon a thick bearskin rug stretched out across the stone floor.  An armor tree stands beside a large, stone fireplace, and against the ash-paneled wall opposite the fireplace stands a large, ebony-framed bed.

title: [Willow Hall, Rasti's Room]
description: The rustic furnishings occupying the generous room could easily adapt to use in the wilds.  A gentle breeze from an open, crystal skylight above rustles papers piled on a travel-scarred campaign desk which commands an expansive view of the starry night sky.  Nearby, an assortment of campstools circle a low table, while across the room, a simple wooden platform covered with thick furs offers a comfortable place to sleep.

title: [Willow Hall, Genysis' Room]
description: The room is airy, caressed as it is by a gentle breeze scented with the fragrance of a potted jasmine plant beneath the open window.  Light oak wall panels add to the sense of openness.  A puma-hide rug lies at the foot of a four-posted bed dominating the room's corner opposite the window.

title: [Willow Hall, Beryl's Salon]
description: A huge, diamond-paned leaded glass bay window provides the room with a spectacular view of the gardens outside.  Sunny and airy by day, at night the pale light of the moon and stars flickers magically over the black-veined, grey marble floor and walls.  Rainbows of light dance over a collection of black velvet chairs encircling an ebony table, before striking the diamond-dusted obsidian fireplace in a dazzling display.  Against the far wall sits a small credenza, over which hovers a softly glowing orb.

title: [Willow Hall, Walnut Room]
description: The room has been furnished in Spartan style.  In one corner stands a bed of woven willow boughs, covered with a woolen blanket of forest green monogrammed with the initials "WH".  Opposite is a small red-plaid sofa facing a generous stone hearth.

title: [Willow Hall, Companion Park]
description: This broad expanse of open land is fringed by a variety of trees and shrubs.  Shaded by majestic oaks is an inviting picnic area with rough-hewn benches, tables, and a blackened grill.  Draped by sweet-smelling wildflowers and fed by a tributary of the Locksmehr River, a small clear lake laps at a sandy bank.  A sturdy wooden dock juts a short way into the water, and a large steel bucket sits in the lake's shallows, tethered to a nearby tree trunk.

title: [Willow Hall, Rowan Room]
description: The room has been furnished in Spartan style.  In one corner stands a bed of woven willow boughs, covered with a woolen blanket of forest green monogrammed with the initials "WH".  Opposite is a small red-plaid sofa facing a generous stone hearth.

title: [Willow Hall, Wisteriaa's Room]
description: Intertwining ivy and wisteria blossoms frame large, stained-glass windows, their panes radiating a rainbow of color across the room.  The foliage sweeps across the remaining walls revealing numerous, half-hidden niches holding potions, exotic plants and specimens.  A sylvan rug covers the floor in front of a black onyx fireplace, its richly patterned surface topped with a soft pyramid of silk pillows.  However, it is the hearth that draws one's eye with its intricate carvings of dragons in various poses.

title: [Willow Hall, Ramladu's Den]
description: The den is inhabited by a wealth of polished armor, weapons, and shields.  Against the wall is an opened steel cage with a slab of raw meat inside.  Lit torches protruding from the walls flicker from time to time, shedding a deep tone of light across the walls that is as vivid scarlet as fresh blood.  Against one of the dark stone walls stands a rolaren weapon rack and an iron shelf.  Opposite hangs a large painting, its colors jewel-like in the low light.

title: [Moot Hall, Storage Hall]
description: You are in a darkly lit hallway which runs north-south.  On the east wall is a curtained opening, and to the south you can see what looks like an intersection leading out of the storage area.

title: [The Broken Stein, Backroom]
description: Barely larger than a closet, the small room uses a single candle set within a niche as its sole source of illumination.  Boxes and crates are arranged to create a makeshift desk against the bricks of the eastern wall, while the western side has been left free of any debris that would impede movement to the oaken door.
tags: meta:mapname:Isle of the Four Winds - Rogue Guild

title: [Warehouse, Makeshift Kitchen]
description: More a large closet than a kitchen, this room is small and cramped.  An old pot-bellied cookstove splattered with grease rests in the corner, its tin pipe disappearing through a hole in the roof.  Dented cookware hangs from nails hammered into the exposed rafters above.  Crates, barrels, and boxes marked with illegible scrawl are stacked in every nook.  A scarred wooden table riddled with knife marks is littered with cracked pottery and other worn cooking utensils.  With its doors hanging open on bent hinges, an old wooden icebox drips water from the melting ice inside.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the east, south, and west.

title: [Star Coral Table]
description: The glaes mosaic on the tabletop gleams in the soft light of the oil candle.  Closer inspection shows the details of a grouping of star coral surrounded by blue-green glaes waters.

title: [Beaded Anemone Table]
description: A small lamp flickers light across the mosaic tabletop.  Detailed in the tiny glaes chips is a beaded anemone, its tentacles gently adrift in the blue-gray sea.

title: [Spotted Sea Hare Table]
description: Candlelight dances across the glinting mosaic tabletop.  The tiny glaes mosaics form the image of a spotted sea hare grazing a bed of turtle grass in bright blue waters.

title: [Netted Sea Star Table]
description: A black-armed sea star, nestled in clear blue waters, is depicted in the glaes tabletop.  A clear, blown-glaes oil lamp casts soft light across the mosaic.

title: [Red Rock Urchin Table]
description: A bright red urchin rests upon the seabed, its prickly spines seeming almost real in the mosaic's careful detail.  The tiny glaes mosaics cover the tabletop, shining in the candlelight.

title: [Sea Feather Table]
description: The tabletop is covered in the tiniest of glaes mosaics.  Pale purple sea feathers float gently in deep blue-green waters, the glaes chips seeming to move before your eyes in the dancing candlelight.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Approach]
description: Wide cobblestone steps fall in a gentle progression from the white picket fence that separates Mist Harbor proper from the Eastern Harbor to the streets below.  Following the curve and contrast of the winding stairs are tile-inlaid planters, the vibrant vegetation filling them displayed in a rainbow pattern.  Lamp posts wrought in the image of shepherd's crooks, their quiescent windows glinting in the sunlight, are evenly spaced amid the plants.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Crane Lane]
description: White picket fences, their thick and thin slats entangled with vines laden with niveous violet-striped clematis and red-throated saffron hibiscus, encircle the yards of the houses that line the cobbled street.  Shell-lined pathways wind their way through the verdant lawns that the fences encircle and allow easy passage from the street to the cottages beyond, some of which have signs proclaiming them to be shops.  Lamps, their glass windows glinting in the sunlight, dangle from wrought iron shepherd's crooks that line the streets.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Crane Lane]
description: Lining the sidewalks, the windows of the glass lanterns that dangle from wrought iron shepherd's crooks glitter in the sunlight.  Enormous terra cotta urns set at the base of each pole are filled with star-shaped lavender clematis, their wide, dark green vines twining about the slender crooks.  Standing out amid the verdant lawns and sprawling villas that line the cobblestone street is a palm-thatched bamboo shop that has an elegant painted sign dangling over its front door.

title: [Island Armor]
description: Potted palms in each of the four corners add a splash of green to the otherwise pale brown veneer of this polished bamboo paneled room.  Mannequins of various statures stand along the walls boasting the newest armor styles, and an elaborately carved gold and green marble counter dominates the back of the room.  Shelves have been built into the wall behind the counter, each one holding samples of the various armor accessories up for sale.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Crane Lane]
description: Sunlight slants across the cobblestone street and illuminates the windows of the edifice that has an elegant painted sign dangling over its entry.  Lost in the shadows of the large building, a small alley stretches to the south and offers a glimpse of the street below.  Entwined with sunset-hued plumerias and lined with benches, a white picket fence creates a protective barrier that prevents pedestrians from falling down the sheer cliff on the other side.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Alley]
description: Dark despite the time of day, the alley is crowded with boxes, barrels, and rope-tied cloth bags.  Doors line the brick walls of the buildings that rise on either side of the cobblestoned path, their faces unmarked and plain.  A lone lantern stands next to a small black entryway, its flickering flame casting long shadows in the confined space.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Pelican Lane]
description: Thick, wrought iron fencing crafted of gracefully twisted poles surrounds the pristine courtyard of the town theatre.  Loops and whirls rise above the elegantly appointed gate and support a sign fashioned in the image of theatre masks.  Disappearing to the north, a small alley positioned alongside a large building connects Pelican Lane to Crane Lane.

title: [Island Arms]
description: Polished green and black marble walls enclose this spacious room.  Sharply arched windows open up to the lush greenery outside and allow a fragrant island breeze to freshen the air within the shop.  Glass display cases rest on the cool green marble floor at sporadic intervals, while pewter oil lamps hang on the walls between the windows.  Taking up residence at the back of the room is a large bamboo lacquered counter.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sea Turtle Lane]
description: Slender ebon veins riddle the marble face of the reed-thatched building located along the northern edge of the cobblestone street, while golden sunlight reflects off of the elegant bronze sign that is bolted to the structure's walls.  Overlooking the buildings of the lane below, the southern edge of the street is covered with lush lawns and a series of cultivated exotic flowers.  Several shepherd's crook lamp posts run in a solid line from east to west, their dormant lanterns glistening in the sunlight.

title: [Shear Delight, Beach Room]
description: Viridian-hued tapestries adorn the walls of this opulent salon, each depicting a humanoid figure in various states of repose.  A woven rug of green, gold, and blue wool runs the length of the floor, toward a pale driftwood hallway flanked by twin interior bronze arches leading to adjacent rooms.  Potted exotic plants line the walls between the tapestries, their green and purple leaves an inviting splash of color, while a tall oak podium stands near the front of the room.

Just beyond the bow, where the railings meet in a horizontal arc, is the top of a dusky blue figurehead.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Courtyard]
description: Structures of stone and glass spread out to the north and east.  Grey granite walls support arching glass domes that reflect the sunlight brilliantly.  Several chimneys belch steam into the frosty air to create a dense fog over the entire area.  A silver-framed glass door beckons from the first granite building to the west while a small iron door in the marble wall to the east allows exit to the streets of Icemule Trace.  Save for a small sign on the wall, this area is barren.

title: [Foyer]
description: A glass ceiling allows the sunlight to penetrate this small foyer.  The accumulation of ice and snow on the glass panes softens the illumination.  Large iron pipes in each corner run from floor to ceiling, gurgling and hissing with the sound of passing steam and radiating warmth into the room.  Colorful trails of arrows applied to the stone floor lead off in different directions.  Two unlit torches flank a large sign mounted on the wall.

title: [Guild Master Henna's Office]
description: A small office populated by several species of indoor plants and several pieces of small furniture nestles just inside the marble arch.  An iron pipe extends from floor to ceiling in one corner, radiating heat into the room and gurgling happily every so often.  A desk, chair, and several bookcases gather together in the opposite corner as if afraid to come to close to the hot iron pipe.  Torches light the room, their flames reflecting off the white tile floor.

title: [Relaxation Garden]
description: A stone block path winds among brass pots containing floribunda roses, rounded azaleas and brilliant firebushes.  Several iron tubes radiate heat into the room to raise steam from the flowerbeds and give the room a humid yet pleasant atmosphere.  Tight groups of orange marigolds thrive in the moist conditions.  The frosted glass above passes enough sunlight that the torches along the wall are not necessary.  Metal rocking chairs occupy prominent positions in this quiet garden.

title: [Library]
description: Ceiling-high shelves crammed full of books, parchments and scrolls fill this small library.  Interestingly, the majority of the writings address the honing of one's will, meditation, martial arts and weaponry rather than healing arts.  The shelves press so closely together that there is no space to sit down.  Rather, upright lecturns allow places for standing reading.  Two large iron pipes gurgle and hiss as they heat the room, and several bright oil lanterns hang from the ceiling rafters.

title: [Infirmary]
description: Rows of small cabinets stacked against the wall serve to hold an emergency supply of healing herbs.  A mannequin covered in bandages and tourniquets leans haphazardly in one corner, and a pair of cots stand ready to receive the wounded in another corner.  Glass plates in the ceiling allow sunlight to pour through, and creeping vines, ivies and philodendrons cover the white tile floor, the walls, and anything that fails to move regularly.

title: [Potion Garden]
description: Powdered herbs, beakers, bottles and other paraphernalia lie scattered among potted chrysanthemums, violas, pansies, and carnations on long tables.  The dirt floor is littered with plant cuttings and fertilizer, and it is difficult to tell if this room is used more for preparing potions or for growing plants.  Several long, thick strips of glass allow sunlight through the ceiling, and unlit torches hang near hot iron pipes in each corner.  The scent of pollen mixed with manure fills the humid air.

title: [Meeting Dome]
description: Tall pillars of stout polished pine rise skyward to support a web of steel.  The steel, in turn, supports a dome composed of large panes of stained glass, each of which bears the insignia of the Empath Guild.  Rows of emerald green benches stand on thick silver carpet to surround a tall round dais in this spacious circular room.  Along the perimeter herb bushes in bright brass pots lend a tangy scent to the air.  Above the herbs wall-mounted torches await nightfall.

title: [Training Garden]
description: A huge room spreads out to the north.  Pillars set in the marble floor rise to support the glass ceiling.  Stations have been set up next to each pillar, and training in martial arts, weaponry and bodybuilding occupies each station.  Several sets of sandbags huddle next to one nearby pillar.  Huge iron pipes glow redly, radiating moist heat into the room.  Small trees in wooden planters break up the white monotony of the marble floor, pillars and ice-encrusted glass.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Aroma Therapy]
description: Water flows from the tops of various rock formations to cascade down into pool after pool before eventually disappearing from sight.  A brightly burning candle floats in each pool, their flames like miniature volcanoes among the rocks.  Small baskets hang down from the windowed ceiling, each basket containing one candle of a unique shape and size.  No more than one basket candle is alight at any one time.  Steam issues from fissures in the rocks, adding a warm fog to the room.

title: [Training Garden]
description: The trees are thicker here and the pillars fewer.  Training in the martial arts, weaponry and bodybuilding occurs here as to the south, but the trainees seem better skilled.  The glass ceiling appears to admit ample light, but a torch rests in a sconce on each pillar in case cloud cover dims the illumination.  Iron pipes shiver and shake with the force of the steam flowing through them.  Despite the many footsteps that traverse this area, the floor is remarkably clean.

title: [Empath Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy Supplies]
description: A reflective glass dome roofs over this section of the training annex, admitting the full brightness of the day.  The northern wall of this room, backing on the hallway of the training annex, boasts an expansive display of shelves containing a wonderland of potions, reagents, and materials.  Arcing in a half-moon arrangement around the southern section of the room, the entries to the alchemy workshops beckon.

description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a small carved haon table on one side of the shop and a large black wicker display on the other.

title: [A Derelict Hovel]
description: Thin shafts of light seep between the rough wooden planks that form the walls of the hovel.  A broken glass window, now boarded up, allows for a faint breeze to drift through, stirring up small dust devils.  Near the back wall, a pile of canvas sacks and twine form a makeshift bed.

Shadows creep along the rough wooden planks that form the walls of the hovel.  A broken glass window, now boarded up, allows for a faint breeze to drift through, stirring up small dust devils.  Near the back wall, a pile of canvas sacks and twine form a makeshift bed.

title: [Empath Guild, Foyer]
description: Lustrous ceramic tiles radiate from a gilded marble plaque in concentric rings in a spectrum of soft pastel hues.  Plush runners flank the wide corridors of the entryway to the Ta'Illistim Empath Guild.  Sunlight filters in through tall windows, brightly illuminating the hall.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Floral bursts rendered in vibrant threads adorn the plush runners traversing the corridor.  Flush against the walls, several slender mistwood tables hold freshly picked bouquets.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: A neatly tended courtyard is visible beyond the square glass panes of a pair of whitewashed doors set into the eastern wall.  Along the opposite wall, a tapestry depicts the healing hands of Imaera cradling the world of Elanthia.

title: [Empath Guild, Courtyard]
description: Ornamental fruit trees flank the large glass-paned doors that lead into the hall.  A pair of marble benches rest beneath the shady arbor.  Nearly obscured by the trees is a small greenhouse, its steamed windows a stark contrast to the vivid colors of the courtyard.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Annex]
description: Twin sconces are set opposite one another on the north and south walls here, their dim flames casting long shadows down the hallway in both directions.  The floor is composed of carefully chiseled granite blocks, each one set against the next at a slight angle, and the walls are polished marble blocks from floor to ceiling.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Tasselled runners embroidered with a lovely floral motif conform to the gentle curve in the corridor.  Adorning the walls between recessed niches are a series of hand-painted murals depicting well-known healers of the past.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Rays of golden sunlight shine through the glass-paned doors leading to the hall's inner courtyard.  Opposite the doors, book-lined shelves are visible beyond a marble archway.  Hushed voices break the calming silence of this section of the corridor.

Rays of silver moonlight filter through the glass-paned doors leading to the hall's inner courtyard.  Opposite the doors, book-lined shelves are visible beyond a marble archway.  Hushed voices break the calming silence of this section of the corridor.

title: [Empath Guild, Library]
description: Rising shelves upon shelves display the Guild's extensive collection on empathic lore, lovingly kept in good condition by a trio of librarians.  A pair of simple lacquered tables and surrounding padded chairs offers an opportunity for research or relaxation.  The particularly ancient texts and tomes are housed within tall glass cases.

title: [Empath Guild, Courtyard]
description: Showy beds of dragonstalk with their brilliant flame-hued faces line the cobblestone walk.  A neatly manicured lawn of lush grass at the center of the courtyard attracts the occasional local avian.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: As the corridor curves gently, the ivory-toned walls display several remarkable murals.  Each tapestry depicts a region around Ta'Illistim, ranging from the snowy Gossamer Valley to the bustling city itself.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Beyond a corbelled marble arch, a spiralling stairway rises to the upper levels of the hall.  Flowering vines complete with dainty curled tendrils have been painted along the walls, framing the archway.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Evenly spaced windows line the inner wall, offering a bird's eye view of the hall's lush courtyard.  Pale olive green and ivory tiles form a simple checkered pattern along the floor, curving southward in both directions.

Evenly spaced windows line the inner wall, offering a bird's eye view of the hall's darkened courtyard.  Pale olive green and ivory tiles form a simple checkered pattern along the floor, curving southward in both directions.

title: [Empath Guild, Laboratory]
description: Tarnished silver tables feature numerous beakers, cauldrons, mortars and pestles in the midst of concocting potions, salves and tinctures.  A faint tang of magic lingers in the air, mingling with the numerous fragrances and odors of ingredients, some pleasant while others are bearable at best.  The heat from a large oven infuses the room with a distinctive, uncomfortable warmth.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Rows of closed nondescript doors line the corridor, with the notable exception of a prominent mithglin-inlaid door adorned with a wreath of acantha.  Ivory-toned walls wonderfully compliment the vivid runners on the smooth marble floor, accentuating the beauty of the floral motif.

title: [Empath Guild, Greenhouse]
description: Lush domestic and exotic floras thrive in the humidity of this greenhouse, their verdant forms outstanding against the fogged glass panes.  Vibrant blooms scent the moist air with their heady perfume, overwhelming the more subtle fragrance of the surrounding herb beds.  A simple stone path winds through the greenhouse, leading to a secluded area.

title: [Empath Guild, Pool]
description: Cool water flows gently down smooth stones into a quiet pool surrounded by dense vegetation.  Blush pink lilies drift languidly across the calm water, while the glimmering scales of colorful fish are visible below the surface.  Silk-padded benches ring the pool, offering a peaceful place for rest and meditation.

title: [Empath Guild, Courtyard]
description: Neatly cultivated beds of acantha and woth scent the air with its delicate perfume.  The slender cobblestone walk that surrounds this quaint courtyard culminates in a raised patio set against a backdrop of flowering ivy.

title: [Alchemy Workshops, Foyer]
description: A row of small windows line the white-washed walls of the small entry room, their clear glass panes bringing profuse sunlight inside.  The tranquil views of the verdant courtyard outside only add to the serene atmosphere within.  Several identical narrow passageways lead toward the interior of the cottage.

The small windows that line the white-washed walls allow luminous moonlight to bathe the small entry room.  Even in the dark, the tranquil views of the lush courtyard outside only add to the serene atmosphere within.  Several identical narrow passageways lead toward the interior of the cottage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest, out

title: [Empath Guild, Storage]
description: Unadorned, pristine white walls provide a striking background against the polished teak floor.  Tall, whitewashed cabinets stenciled in pastel colors depicting fresh healing herbs provide ample space to store all manners of supplies.  Adjacent to the entrance there is a large dust bin, surrounded by a subtle layer of fine brownish powder.

title: [Empath Guild, Courtyard]
description: A bubbling fountain burbles merrily south of the cobblestone walk.  The lilting warble of songbirds echoes from above the hall, creating a peaceful duet with the flowing water.  The neatly tended window boxes filled with fragrant herbs line the courtyard windows.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy Workshop]
description: A variety of potted ferns thrive on the white-washed window sill, their numerous branches reaching almost to the floor in a cascade of green.  The only other source of color emanates from a rustic wall hanging depicting a quaint pastoral scene.  A scarred workbench, neatly laid out with various odd-looking apparatus, rests in the middle of the chamber.

title: [Empath Guild, Storage]
description: White-enameled racks and evenly spaced shelves cover every available wall.  Facing south, a pale elven clerk stands at alert behind a wide marble-topped counter and welcomes those in pursuit of new stock or needed replenishments.

title: [Empath Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Sheer curtains billow to life from the occasional night breeze, glimmering in the dim torchlight.  Silk banners line the ivory walls, prominently displaying the names of past Guildmasters of the guild in flowery script.

Just beyond an open window, a pair of small grey doves tends to their nest, cooing quietly.  Silk banners line the ivory walls, prominently displaying the names of past Guildmasters of the guild in flowery script.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: A single winding stairway with rose-carved alabaster banisters rises to the peak of the hall's highest tower.  A velvety blue sapphire runner spills like a waterfall down the steps, pooling to a crescent-shaped landing.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: A splendid ring of windows around this spire affords a panoramic view of the hall, inner courtyard, and bustling var below.  This cozy aerie has been decorated with a neatly kept desk and distinctly elven furnishings.  Spaced intermittently around the desk are fanciful crystal sculptures, sparkling in the sunlight.

A splendid ring of windows around this spire affords a panoramic view of the torchlit hall, inner courtyard, and quiet var below.  This cozy aerie has been decorated with a neatly kept desk and distinctly elven furnishings.  Spaced intermittently around the desk are fanciful crystal sculptures, glistening in the moonlight.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: A pair of recessed golden doors interrupts this bend of the upper hall.  A single crescent moon has been painted above the doorway, and its immediate surroundings are completely devoid of decoration.

title: [Chamber of Healing]
description: Swirls of lavender incense rise from bejeweled censers set against the soothing pale blue walls.  A row of softly padded cots stand before a glaesine-accented counter featuring all manner of salves, potions, and tinctures.  Clad in pure white robes, several attendants bustle about the chamber.

title: [Dark Grotto, Long Stairway]
description: Huge steps have been carved into the stone wall of the cavern forming a stairway of gigantic proportions.  No creature that you have ever seen has had the size or length of leg to negotiate stairs of this size.  Looking out over the cavern far below, you can see tall spires of stone that look like small splinters of rock from this distance.

title: [Dead Plateau, Interior]
description: The flat surface of the plateau winds among the cracks, moving in a haphazard fashion and often doubling back until even the position of the sun is no help in discerning one's location.  Dark, wide crevices loom dangerously in all directions, and often pebbles dropped or kicked into them fail to return the sound of striking bottom.  The cold wind howls across the landscape as a chill, mocking reminder that the elements here do not suffer travelers in their domain for long.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

description: Moonlight glints off the myriad particles of gemstone within the plateau's surface, promising untold riches to whoever might find the source of even larger gems in abundance. The cold wind howls across the landscape as a chill, mocking reminder that the elements here do not suffer travelers in their domain for long.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron]
description: Set within a semi-private circle of smaller cauldrons, pots, pans, and various unusual implements, a copper-based training cauldron squats on claw feet.  Other cauldrons with similar privacy are scattered about the dimly lit alcove, and a few large gouges score the floor where the cauldron was dragged.

title: [Griedlgecha Lost Mine]
description: Someone has excavated a hole approximately twenty feet wide, ten feet deep and roughly circular in shape out of the solid rock.  The miner's whereabouts is not apparent, however, and just how long ago this enterprise took place is difficult to judge.  The tools strewn around the pit are not rusted in the least, although they do show signs of considerable wind erosion on their wooden parts.  A few piles of rubble remain, but no gems.  The wind has long since removed the operation's dust.

title: [Kharag 'doth Dzulthu, Tunnels]
description: The smooth walls of the large mining cart, so high it's nearly impossible to see over the tops, are grimy from years of use.  Spots of rust mark the metal, the rivets surrounded by clouds of deep red which drip down the panels.  A metal bench is mounted around the cart's sidewalls to serve as rudimentary seating.

title: [Mist Harbor, Vineyard]
description: Hugging the guild's walls, the path winds its way through a veritable a cornucopia of tropical blossoms.  Bright blossoms of blue and green mingle with their red and orange brethren, while complicated vines of flaeshorn berries tumble across the cinnamon bark-covered ground.  Strong fragrances fill the air and carry with them heady notes accented by a light sweetness.

title: [Vineyard, An Arbor-roofed Shop]
description: Thick vines of white and purple grapes wind their way through a wooden arbor, their knotted limbs form a tight weave that is laden with broad leaves.  Sheltered within the arbor, and protected from both the weather and the heat of the day, is a small open-air shop.  Long counters topped with green and purple oilcloth line the back of the shop, while the front is dotted with small baskets.

title: [Rathburne's Weaponry]
[Rathburne's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath a high arched ceiling, an intricate knot-worked wall-hanging hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  A polished maoral table and an elegantly carved oak armoire sit in opposite corners while a serene golden wyvern fountain rests on a whitewashed pine floor.

title: [Mist Harbor, Vineyard]
description: Cream-hued limestone walls glimmer in the golden sunlight, the new mortar that surrounds them dark against their incandescent coloring.  A carved limestone staircase rises from the crushed cinnamon bark path that winds its way to the north east and provide egress to the top of the guild.

Cream-hued limestone walls glimmer in the silvery moonlight, the new mortar that surrounds them dark against their incandescent coloring.  A carved limestone staircase rises from the crushed cinnamon bark path that winds its way to the north east and provide egress to the top of the guild.

title: [Cleric's Guild, Shrine]
description: Large and round, the shrine is built at the top of a tower and surrounded by an alternating pattern of limestone pillars and arching windows.  Rising from the heart of the room is the sculpted image of a blooming tree that houses a resplendent statue of Jaston.  Encircling the arboreal structure is a low altar that is pockmarked with bird's nests.  Dozens of birds have made this place their home, their soft song filling the air.

title: [Mist Harbor, Vineyard]
description: Following the curve of the pathway that encircles the vineyard, a high stone wall creates a protective barrier that prevents pedestrians from falling off of the sharp drop of the cliffs.  Sunlight dapples the surrounding area and highlights the colorful awnings that decorate the verdant foliage to the north.

title: [Geldir's Combat Gear]
[Geldir's Armory]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is an intricately carved ebonwood stand and a plain wooden table.

title: [Geldir's Magic Shoppe]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An engraved pine case and a gold-veined black marble counter are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Geldir's Outfitting]
[Geldir's Armory]

title: [Mist Harbor, Vineyard]
description: Bending eastward, the protective wall that encircles the vineyard disappears into the verdant foliage.  Draped in wisteria and roses, a latticework bamboo arch provides entry into a jungle-wreathed area that is pock-marked with colorful awnings and vibrant flowers.  Hidden in the foliage is an ornate bronze plaque.

title: [Empath Guild, Entrance]
description: Wisteria and rose vines drape over a latticework arch of bamboo.  Their fragrance is nearly overwhelming, yet there is an underlying chemical tang in the air.  Large, rounded stones form a path to and from the arch, creating a V shape.  Moss surrounds the stones, and ferns line the path.
tags: meta:mapname:Isle of the Four Winds - Empath Guild

title: [Empath Guild, Infirmary]
description: Colorful mosaics depicting tropical fauna have been laid out in a large square.  One half of the square has been made into an examination and rest area, with hammock-like beds stretched from surrounding palm trees to the central pole.  The other half holds supplies on bamboo shelving units, each item labeled and neatly arranged.  Silk rectangles run from the surrounding palms to the central pole, shading the area.  Set off in a corner is a small closet containing cleaning paraphernalia.

title: [Empath Guild, Broom Closet]
description: Thin shafts of sunlight trickle in through the open door of the closet to illuminate a series of bamboo shelves lined with cleaning supplies.   A large dust bin sits cater-cornered near several brooms and mops resting inside a large steel bucket.

Thin shafts of moonlight trickle in through the open door of the closet to illuminate a series of bamboo shelves lined with cleaning supplies.   A large dust bin sits kitty-corner near several brooms and mops.

title: [Vineyard Path]
description: Wandering between boulders the height of a giantman and even thicker, the path of stones branches into four arcing lines.  Ferns are interspersed with bird of paradise plants, their heads nodding in the breeze.  Dragonflies bring their colorful display, hovering over geometric, yet curvilinear, drawings on the boulders.
