title: [Relaxation Garden]
description: Coral trees display their vivid red-orange blossoms as they drape over mistwood rocking chairs at the edge of the garden.  A single spray of water fountains from an otherwise calm pool, sending ripples across its water.  Beneath the surface, koi wander lazily in flashes of gold, orange, and white.  A simple meditation maze frames the pool, wandering in a path defined by bromeliads and anthuriums.

title: [Teaching Amphitheater]
description: Rows of sturdy, plain wooden benches terrace downward toward an open stage of worn boards.  Arbors covered in bougainvillea frame the stage, and a single podium stands in the middle.  To one side, a modest cot and a cabinet of remedies stand ready.

title: [Wynterr's White Wedding]
description: Beneath a sparkling crystal dome, a gallery of wedding portraits hangs on one of the white birch walls.  An antique rosewood dowry chest and a stately armoire sit in opposite corners while a pure white aisle runner rests on a silver-tinged marble floor.

title: [Vineyard Path, Crossing]
description: Four spiraling paths curve around large, rounded granite boulders that sparkle with flecks of mica and feldspar.  They burst from a circular mosaic depicting the image of Kuon tending a garden.  Small votives glow from nooks and crannies on the faces of the boulders.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Psystahldar's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Psystahldar's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Scents of Thyme]
description: Large trees line the perimeter of the garden, providing shade and scent.  The leaves of bayberry, allspice, and nutmeg crown them, while jasmine and vanilla vines climb through their bowers.  Yarrow, lavender, and rose each take their places toward the center where the sun strikes more often, and small coriander plants add their spicy tang to the mingled scents.  Slender candles, each born of a different shape, are suspended in the air by mysterious means.

title: [Vineyard Path]
description: To the northeast, a bark and canvas shelter peeks through a grove of mistwood trees threaded with grey-green moss.  Ferns dot the edges of the tree bark strewn path, while thanot and barberry shrubs create a sense of privacy, screening the areas beyond.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Memory and Remedy]
description: Rectangular beds are arranged in neat rows and raised a couple of feet for ease of access.  Each bed contains several specimens of herbs, with pewter label tags in front of each.  Bees buzz about stalks of star anise, hazel alder, and chervil.  Specimens such as grains of paradise, blue vervain, and starwort lend their colorful blossoms to the overall beauty of the garden.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: Several bamboo arbors come together to make a circular dome.  Covered in bougainvillea and blue butterfly vine, the arbors provide protection from the elements to the small office below.  Tendrils of foliage drape across the front of a small desk of teak, which gleams from care.  Upon the desk sits a small teapot with a teacup and saucer.  Behind it, a rocking chair with a light blanket in plaid matching the colors of the flowers, sways gently with the breeze.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron Curve]
description: Several small groves branch off from this crook in the path, while on the inner curve, bright orange and cream birds of paradise watch the comings and goings from where they grow within the verdant foliage.  Crushed bark on the path lends a musty, woody smell to the area.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron Room]
description: Set upon the polished stump of a once-massive tree, a big black cauldron stands ready to use.  Spidersilk drapes from tree to tree overhead, preventing extra ingredients from adding themselves to the mix.  Wisteria vines curl themselves up and through the dense stand of mahogany.

title: [Enscribed in Vines]
description: Bark and canvas sides hold up a thatched roof, into which vines of stephanotis have charmingly woven themselves.  Sturdy shelves, backed with oilcloth, hold row upon row of books, scrolls, and pamphlets, while a large table partially blocks the passageway to the east.

title: [Bark-Strewn Path]
description: The spicy scent of cinnamon fills the air, accompanied by the gentle scent of gardenia.  White flowers sprout between large ferns that line the bark-strewn path.  A single large, rounded boulder sits to the northern side of the path, obscuring the structure behind it.

title: [Empath Guild, Break Room]
description: A flimsy silken swath draped between the expansive branches of mahogany trees shelters this small clearing.  To one side, a table of refreshments tempts one to partake, while opposite, several wicker chairs surround an umbrella-topped wooden table.  Masters and students mill around, mingling in the congenial breeze provided by large fans suspended from the trees.  To the north, an arch leads into a warren of workrooms.  To the south, the offices of the masters await.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Empath Guild, Workroom]
description: Silver crucibles, contorted alembics, and stone mortars and pestles align themselves neatly across the surface of a well-polished redwood workbench.  Several other trees surround the area, and a small cluster of violets peeks from between the slightly rotten roots of the sawed-off tree.

title: [Empath Guild, Workroom]
description: Silver crucibles, contorted alembics, and stone mortars and pestles align themselves neatly across the surface of a well-polished redwood workbench.  Several other trees surround the area, and a small cluster of begonias peeks from between the slightly rotten roots of the sawed-off tree.

title: [Essential Stores]
description: Several boulders have been gouged into a stairstep pattern, creating the eastern wall of the structure.  Upon their surfaces, herbs, reagents, and supplies of every type are organized and labeled, while a lithe sylvan apothecary, dressed in light blue chainsil, busies herself keeping everything just so.  One particular shelf has ingredients yet to be ground or distilled, and before it stands an ebonwood work table with several mortar and pestle sets ready to do the job.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Room]
description: Protected beneath a bright awning of indigo and vermilion, the area is encircled by wild flowers and verdant foliage.  Several wooden dummies, each padded and tall, are spread throughout the area and poised in different aggressive positions and flanked by large posters in bamboo frames.  Near the southern end of the clearing, a pair of painted screens creates a secluded area that is clean and private.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Sprawling Lawn]
description: Well-manicured lawns dotted with majestic weeping willows and lush rose bushes are demarcated by trimmed hedges.  A tall hawthorne hedge, broken only by an ivy-lined marble walkway, separates the lawn from the grounds beyond.  A stately manor caps one end of the lawn, the exterior of dark granite and ash-veined black marble polished to a gleaming luster.

title: [Tigerlily Avenue]
description: Bright orange terra cotta tiles decorate the houses that line the southern edge of the street, while bright white paints create a uniform look to each of their facades.  Shutters, in a plethora of colors, decorate the homes and stand open to the sunlight.  Positioned at the end of a stone-lined walkway, a pale coral-tiled office sits in the middle of a manicured lawn of verdant green jungle grass.

Bright orange terra cotta tiles decorate the houses that line the southern edge of the street, while bright white paints create a uniform look to each of their facades.  Shutters, in a plethora of colors, decorate the homes and are closed to the cooler airs of the night.  Positioned at the end of a stone-lined walkway, a pale coral-tiled office sits in the middle of a manicured lawn of verdant green jungle grass.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Foyer]
description: Full-length windows fill the spaces between the pairs of stately pale white marble columns deeply veined with ebon that flank the oversized cherrywood double doors.  Across from the entry, an elaborately carved door sits off to one side of a wide staircase leading to a carpeted landing above, then further up and out of sight.  The sound of splashing water in a small marble fountain echoes across the foyer.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Quiet Path]
description: Blanketed in azalea and wild lilac bushes, the cobblestone path forms a gentle curve that hugs the landscape and ambles through an intricate wrought iron gate.  Thin blades of grass, coached into artful tufts, are bright green in the sunlight and speckled with tiny violets the hue of periwinkle feystones.  A slender post dangles a dormant lantern, which creaks lightly as it sways gently in a seaward breeze that is warm and inviting.

Strong white light spills onto the cobblestone pathway as it follows the gentle curve of the landscape and ambles through an intricate wrought iron gate, its source a lantern dangling from a slender post.  The illuminating glow gives life to the dark azalea and wild lilac bushes that blanket the area, as well as tiny violets the hue of periwinkle feystones that mingle with thin blades of beach grass.  Rising from the north, the seaward breeze is soothing and carries with it the soft sound of waves touching to shore.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Bridge]
description: Spanning the distance between the cobblestone paths, the bridge arches high over a small stream that is speckled with water lilies.  Bright orange and white koi swim through the clear waters at one end, while the other creates a melodic sound as it passes through rocks and reeds.  Lampposts mark the center of structure, their glaesine windows reflecting the sunlight in a myriad of colors upon the smooth wooden planks.

Spanning the distance between the cobblestone paths, the bridge arches high over a small stream that is speckled with water lilies.  Silvery moonlight sparkles upon the clear waters briefly illuminating dark shadows at one end, while the other creates a melodic sound as it passes through rocks and reeds.  Lampposts mark the center of structure, their glaesine windows shedding round pools of light upon the smooth wooden planks.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Quiet Path]
description: Colorful skeins of silk arch across the cobblestone pathway as it makes its way towards a bridge at one end and the Great Hall at the other.  Tiny sea glass charms are woven into the edges of the fabric and reflect golden sunlight upon the wisteria that has become tangled into their lengths.  A light, tugging breeze disturbs the glaesine orbs that dangle from above, causing them to click quietly together.

Colorful skeins of silk arch across the cobblestone pathway as it makes its way towards a bridge at one end and the Great Hall at the other.  Tiny sea glass charms are woven into the edges of the fabric and reflect silvery moonlight upon the wisteria that has become tangled into their lengths.  Glaesine orbs house hundreds of tiny sparkling lights to create a playful and bright illumination for the area.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Great Hall]
description: Slanting across the Great Hall's entrance, golden sunlight reflects off of the glass panes set within its doors and creates a prismatic spray of light that dances in the area.  Creeper vines, festooned with golden flaeshorn berries and bright red flowers, shroud the building's peak and fill the air with their sweet scent.  From somewhere in their depths, a morning dove coos a soft song, while a lark trills in accompaniment.

Glittering lanterns rise to either side of the Great Hall's entrance, their warm glow drawing cicada and moths alike, as they illuminate the bend in the cobblestone path.  Though shrouded in shadows, the peak of the building is sensed by the slice of stars in the night sky that is missing and the absence of the shore sounds that its large presence blocks.  A quiet song lifts on the air, its tune sweet enough to lighten the darkness.

title: [Great Hall, Foyer]
description: Tangerine tiles spread across the floor of the foyer to the various paths that converge here, their edges bright white and their centers painted with dark green ivy vines.  Chiseled marble columns rise into the domed ceiling and are laden with wisteria blooms and vines that climb out of enormous earthen pots at their bases.  A pair of doors faces each other across the cool tile expanse, one fitted with a blue cobalt window and the other a rose one.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest, out

title: [Great Hall, Confections]
description: Lined up beyond the glass counter is a wall of baking racks that are cooling their delectable treats, while a small spit, fitted into a riverstone fireplace, turns a slow-roasting leg of lamb.  Chilled fruits are arranged within the display upon slabs of rhimar, while tureens of soup and vegetables are kept warm by glowing drakar slabs.  An open frosted glass door leads into the foyer beyond, where the sound of a soft lute can be heard playing a sweet tune.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Small Park]
description: Heavily laden with sweet, clean-scented honeysuckle vines, a trellis arches over the pathway to create a tunnel that opens into three sections.  Enormous vases mark each area and are painted with cobalt patterns that mimic the rolling of waves.  Carefully cultivated flowerbeds are segmented by smoothed stones, while blown glass feeders offer a tantalizing treat to lapis and emerald hummingbirds.

Enormous vases mark each area and are painted with cobalt patterns that mimic the rolling of waves.  Carefully cultivated flowerbeds are segmented by smoothed stones, while blown glass feeders reflect their colors in the glow of copper lanterns.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Small Park]
description: The cobblestone path widens, becoming a large rectangular common area.  Wrought iron benches have been placed along the perimeter of the platform and flanked with tall ceramic vases of flowers.  At the center of the commons is a large rose garden filled with hues ranging from white to pale lavender.  A pair of short stone steps leads down to the east toward a small reflection pool.

Arranged for a rewarding view of the rose garden, wrought iron benches occupy various corners of the garden, with one resting beneath a tall lamppost that dangles a large glaesine orb.  Silvery moonlight glitters off of the white cobblestones set in the path, as well as a pair of short stone steps that leads to a wishing well.  Cedar chips scattered upon the ground prevent the massive amounts of roses from becoming cloying, while a light breeze brings forth the faint scent of the nearby ocean.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Wishing Well]
description: Periwinkle violets wink in the golden sunlight as they mingle with the verdant ivy that encircles the stone base of the wishing well, their petals glistening with moisture.  Though the roof is missing, the arms rise from the plump body and still hold aloft a pulley that suspends a hemp-tied bucket over the glittering waters at its base.

Periwinkle violets wink in the silvery moonlight as they mingle with the verdant ivy that encircles the stone base of the wishing well, their petals kissed with dew from the night air.  Though the roof is missing, the arms rise from the plump body and still hold aloft a pulley that suspends a hemp-tied bucket over the glittering waters at its base.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Reflection Pool]
description: Bedecked with water lilies and their pads, the reflection pool is small and lined in cobalt tiles that give the cool waters a deep blue hue.  Lanterns housed in the boughs of an ancient oak tree illuminate various points along the pathway and reflect on the smooth surface of the water beneath them.  A row of sirenflowers bows their head as they sway in the gentle seaside breeze, occassionally chiming as they do, in reverence to the sunlight above.

Lanterns housed in the boughs of an ancient oak tree illuminate various points along the pathway and reflect on the smooth surface of the water beneath them.  A row of sirenflowers lifts their oddly shaped heads to the moonlight above.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Small Park]
description: Pale pink and white petals lightly rain upon the cobblestone pathway from the ancient limbs of a dogwood tree that rises from one corner of the garden.  A raised platform, polished to glitter brightly in the golden sunlight, spreads from flowerbed to flowerbed to create a charming outdoor dancing space, while sea glass charms strung from skeins of silk dangle beside dormant lanterns above.

Pale pink and white petals lightly rain upon the cobblestone pathway from the ancient limbs of a dogwood tree that rises from one corner of the garden.  A raised platform, polished to glitter brightly in the silvery moonlight, spreads from flowerbed to flowerbed to create a charming outdoor dancing space, while illuminated paper lanterns, strung from skeins of silk between sea glass charms, dangle above.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Garden]
description: Sunlight tickles the gossamer wings of hundreds of butterflies as they flutter to and from the deep, velvety purple petals of the butterflyweed that is planted in a wall beyond the tea and dog roses lining the cobblestone path.  Dormant lanterns sway gently in the breeze, their glaesine windows reflecting golden motes of light onto a nearby umbrella tree.  A carved alabaster bench can be glimpsed beneath the shelter of the curving boughs that brush the tall grasses surrounding it.

Hundreds of fireflies dance and flit between the pools of lamplight that flank the cobblestone path, their tiny jeweled wings blinking in and out of existence as they move on the gentle sea breeze.  Glittering moonlight sparkles on the dew-kissed petals of tea and dog roses that lade the air with their heady fragrance and upon the elliptical and glossy leaves of a nearby umbrella tree.  A carved alabaster bench can be glimpsed beneath the shelter of the curving boughs that tickle the tall grasses surrounding it.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Garden]
description: Riotous color rises on either side of the path, which forks slightly to the northeast, from the plethora of exotic flowers that sway in the sunlight.  Hummingbirds, tiny and emerald-winged, flit back and forth as they drink from the nectar of nature's bounty and tiny rabbits nibble the pearly white Imaera's lace that rings the dormant lampposts set just off the speckled cobbles.

Luna moths shimmer in the silvery moonlight as they alight upon the exotic flowers lining the pathway which forks slightly to the northeast.  The pale, ethereal creatures stay clear of the golden pools of lamplight that illuminate the speckled cobbles and pearly white Imaera's lace growing at their bases.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Gazebo]
description: Nestled amongst creeping trumpet and wisteria vines and drawn back from the beaten path, the gazebo's copper ceiling reflects sunlight upon the polished white birch dance floor.  Benches are arranged in a semi-circle around its smooth steps to create a quiet resting area to relax in.  The ebb and flow of the distant ocean punctuates the chorus of birdsong, while a gentle breeze is warm with the day's heat.

Nestled amongst creeping trumpet and wisteria vines and drawn back from the beaten path, the gazebo's copper ceiling dangles painted paper lanterns in the shape of large orbs over a polished white birch dance floor.  Benches are arranged in a semi-circle around its smooth steps and create a quiet resting area to relax in.  The ebb and flow of the distant ocean punctuates the quiet chirp of crickets and cicada, while a soothing breeze cools the air.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Quiet Trail]
description: Sloping gently downward towards the beach below, the pathway is a transition of squared cobblestones mixed with glittering sands and tall sea grasses.  Wild dog roses release their heady fragrance into the air, while plump bumblebees buzz and sip at their petals.

Sloping gently downward towards the beach below, the pathway is a transition of squared cobblestones mixed with glittering sands and tall sea grasses.  Bamboo-poled torches flicker in the persistent sea breeze that also sets the wild dog roses to rustling from their home off in the nearby dunes.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Beach Path]
description: Sheltered from the full fury of the sea by a ring of rocks, the cove's small beach is quiet and glitters with the golden sunlight that filters through the puffy white clouds above.  Tall dunes swallow the path as it ambles upward, their edges covered in high beach grasses and wild dog roses.

Sheltered from the full fury of the sea by a ring of rocks, the cove's small beach is quiet and illuminated by dozens of torches.  Moonlight flickers across the tips of the tall grasses that line the path as it ambles through the dunes and past wild dog roses towards the summit.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Temple]
description: Pale periwinkle wisteria vines drape across the smooth white marble of an aged temple as it rises suddenly across the pathway and blocks further progress to the north.  Painted windows shimmer as they reflect golden sunlight into the pools that ring the temple's base, their waters speckled with anemones and water lilies and bisected by a pair of smooth marble steps etched with the image of frolicking sea otters playing with dolphins.
