Painted windows shimmer as they reflect silvery moonlight into the pools that ring the temple's base, their waters speckled with anemones and water lilies and bisected by a pair of smooth marble steps etched with the image of frolicking sea otters playing with dolphins.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Niima's Temple]
description: Painted into the domed ceiling is a mosaic of the oceans and mists that surround the island, while below, a wall of aquariums is filled with a plethora of the local aquatic life.  Colored sunlight tickles the smooth diamond-shaped tiles that cover the floor, their source the wide windows that flank the steps leading out.

Candles perched in high niches are shielded with blue sea glass globes that reflect the light in watery hues across the domed ceiling and mimic the rolling of waves as they flicker.  Below, a wall of aquariums is filled with a plethora of aquatic life local to the island.  Colored moonlight tickles the smooth diamond-shaped tiles that cover the floor, their source the wide windows that flank the steps leading out.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Secluded Beach]
description: Cradled against a cliff facing is a brilliant white silk pavilion, its peak blindingly bright in the sunlight.  Tiny pockets in the surrounding walls hold small nests which local birds flit to and from as they sing their carefree tune.  The warm, salty air is tickled with an off-shore breeze that is laden with the heady fragrance of roses.

Cradled against a cliff facing is a brilliant white silk pavilion, its peak glittering in the silvery moonlight.  Fireflies cavort in the shelter of the wall, their jeweled wings casting a prismatic spray upon the white sands of the beach, while the cool, salty air is tickled with an off-shore breeze that is laden with the heady fragrance of roses.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Pavilion]
description: Copper lanterns sway from the support poles of the tent and cast warm illumination upon the polished teak floors that have been cleared for dancing space.  Painted ivy trails down the white walls of the pavilion, while bright blossoms are painted into the fabric of the ceiling in an attempt to bring the jungle inside.  A ring of silken cushions lines the walls, though a path has been cleared to leave access to the flap leading out.

title: [Great Hall, White Chapel]
description: Deep cobalt blue tiles stretch across the floor, their glossy expanses decorated with white trilliums that provide a delicate accent to the white walls and high ceiling.  Twin alcoves flank the altar, one trimmed in carved wildlife and the other in verdant ivy bands.  An enormous stained glass window in the shape of an inverted diamond occupies the back wall, its image that of a young couple gazing up at the sun as they kneel in prayer.

title: [Groom's Waiting Room]
description: Silver and ebon-veined marble tiles spread across the floor towards walls that are painted with scenes of the wild hunt.  Standing before a wide open window is a full-length mirror, while a glass-covered wrought iron table nearby houses a set of playing tiles.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a set of polished linden stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble fauna-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

title: [Great Hall, Ebon Chapel]
description: Golden tiles mix with ebon as they stretch across the floor to meet with the linden walls that are accented with ebonwood columns that spiral upward to a sanguine dome ceiling.  Wrought iron wall sconces ring the upper reaches of each carved support and are fitted with dark green, white, and pale yellow tallows, which spread golden illumination through the area.  An enormous stained glass window is the focal point beyond the ebon marble altar and is framed by twin alcoves, one lined in gold and the other lined in silver.

title: [Bride's Waiting Room]
description: White gossamer drapes flutter lazily in the light seaside breeze that drifts through the open birch windows that they frame and is accompanied by the spill of golden sunlight.  A full-length mirror stands beside a glass-covered wrought iron table that is covered with roses in nearly every hue of the rainbow and still has ample room for storage.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a series of silvery ash stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble ivy-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

White gossamer drapes flutter lazily in the cool seaside breeze that drifts through the open birch windows and is accompanied by a spill of silvery moonlight.  A full-length mirror stands beside a glass-covered wrought iron table that is covered with roses in nearly every hue of the rainbow and still has ample room for storage.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a series of silvery ash stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble ivy-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

title: [Great Hall, Ballroom]
description: Honey-colored oak floors glow with a deep, rich varnish as they stretch to the arched white walls framed in golden linden molding.  Dangling over the center of the floor, and glowing brightly with dozens of candles, is a copper chandelier fitted with mother-of-pearl and sea glass shards that create prismatic swirls upon the stucco ceiling.  A series of hammered verdigris leaves rings the pillars that frame the entries to the north and south, while carved trilliums decorate the passage to the foyer.

title: [Great Hall, Groom's Shop]
description: Stretching the expanse of one wall is the bas-relief mural of a traditional wild hunt.  The verdant pigments painted into the piece's terrain are echoed in the smooth floor tiles, while the warm browns are accented by the mahogany flooring.  Cherrywood tables and racks are placed throughout the shop, displaying their wares, and copper lanterns suspended from above offer ample illumination by which to shop.

title: [Great Hall, Bridal Shop]
description: Daylight pours through the faceted panes of the stained glass dome ceiling of the bridal shop, cascading the room in a plethora of warm, colorful light.  Finely etched silver and gold accents are throughout the shop, including an exquisite armoire and table upon which fine silken wares are displayed.  A gentle melody floats throughout the room, its origin indiscernible, creating a serene atmosphere.

Moonlight pours through the faceted panes of the stained glass dome ceiling of the bridal shop, cascading the room in a plethora of colorful light.  Finely etched silver and gold accents are throughout the shop, including an exquisite armoire and table upon which fine silken wares are displayed.  A gentle melody floats throughout the room, its origin indiscernible, creating a serene atmosphere.

title: [Albatross, Main Deck]
description: Sunlight glints off the polished rosewood and mahogany decks.  A heavy dark mahogany door banded with ornate gold filigree leads inside the riverboat, while the deck wraps about it all.  To the northwest, a large foredeck is visible, and to the aft, the large paddlewheel can be seen.  Carefully piled silk rope sits next to a gaily beribboned mahogany gangplank leading off the boat, an iron ring peeking through the layers.

title: [The Griffin's Cage, Entry]
description: A trio of large oil lamps hangs from ceiling of the wagon, which provides light over an ebonwood crate.  Along the western wall, an elaborately carved red oak door leads to the front of the wagon, while on the opposite side of the wagon, a purple velvet tapestry leads to the back.

title: [The Griffin's Cage, Back Room]
description: The back of the wagon is quite cramped with various ironwood barrels that line the red oak walls, as well as a lacquered rosewood mirror.  A purple velvet tapestry stands between a small bed and an old card table along the western wall, with a dart board that hangs over a red oak display cabinet.

title: [The Griffin's Cage, Front Seat]
description: Standing just ahead, two horses have been harnessed to the front of the wagon.  A cushioned rosewood seat rests before an elaborately carved red oak door, which leads back inside the wagon.  Just over the top of the seat, a purple and white awning is affixed to the red oak of the wagon, which helps block out the light of the sun.

title: [Albatross, Gambler's Rest]
description: Darkly paneled walls are adorned with silver dice and gold playing cards, while alabaster floors are visible beneath runners of plush, royal blue carpeting.  A cherrywood bar runs the length of the room, amply stocked with shelves of various alcoholic beverages and accouterments.  An open arch to the southwest leads to the prow of the riverboat, and a wrought iron spiral staircase climbs up to the next level.

title: [Silvers Aweigh Spirits]
description: Sunlight filters through the heavy, leaded crystal windows that span floor to ceiling on the port and starboard sides.  A gold-accented, circular mahogany bar sits in the center of the dark green marble floor, and a silver and gold buffet table is pushed against one wall.  A heavy tapestry partially blocks the hallway toward the prow, and a door leads to the aft.

title: [Albatross, Staff Quarters]
description: Narrow and spare, this hallway has several doors on either side for the crew.  An unusually heavy, stone door sits at the far end, while a plain door that has a detailed schedule listing tacked onto it rests on the opposite end of the hallway.

title: [Albatross, Foredeck]
description: Sunlight dapples the sweeping foredeck of the riverboat.  Mahogany decking, which is lined with brass railings, is inlaid with a giant rosewood albatross, and is large enough for a pavilion to be erected on its expanse.

Sunlight dapples the sweeping foredeck of the riverboat.  Mahogany decking lined with brass railings has been inlaid with a giant rosewood albatross and is large enough for dancing or even for a pavilion to be erected on its expanse.  An open arch leads into main cabin, and the deck wraps about it to the starboard and port.

title: [Albatross, Cashier]
description: White alabaster and dark mahogany flooring are cleverly conjoined into the image of a giant roulette wheel.  Heavy tapestries hang from the walls, each depicting gamblers winning at different games.  Some shallow steps lead down into the roulette pit that are position between a gold-trimmed rosewood door and an expansive mahogany archway.

title: [Albatross, Gambling Library]
description: Tall mahogany bookshelves cover the wall of the library, leaving only space for the mahogany archway.  Resting in the center of the room is a green felt-covered table surrounded by a number of cushioned chairs.  Hanging from the ceiling is a chandelier with bejeweled dice strung from the branched arms.  Overlooking the deck, some elevated glass panes allow for sunlight to cascade into the library, which rests just above a vivid lapis lazuli globe.

Tall mahogany bookshelves cover each wall in the library, leaving only space for the mahogany archway.  Resting in the center of the room is a green felt-covered table, which is surrounded by a number of cushioned chairs.  Hanging from the ceiling is a chandelier with bejeweled dice strung from the branched arms.  Overlooking the deck, a gold-framed glass porthole allows for sunlight to trickle into the library, which rests just above a vivid lapis lazuli globe.

title: [Albatross, Merchant Lounge]
description: Several tapestries are displayed on the walls, each depicting one of the various gambling games aboard the Albatross.  Resting on each side of the rosewood door are a series of gold sconces, which illuminate the room.  Scattered throughout the lounge are a number of soft divans, offering a comfortable atmosphere.

title: [Albatross, Roulette Pit]
description: Richly paneled walls and lush crimson carpeting are illuminated by myriad candles behind hunter green glass, but the focal point of this pit is the elaborate roulette wheel on a polished mahogany table.  The numbers chart, betting sign, and rules poster are all framed in gold and hang from the rosewood walls in easy view of all gamblers.

title: [Albatross, Captain's Taproom]
description: Leaded crystal windows line the fore and starboard walls, and a lacquered rosewood bar stands at a diagonal in one corner, its gilted carvings sparkling in the daylight.  A pair of crystal doors leads to a small starboard balcony, and there is an arch in the portside wall.  Darkly hued chestnut marble covers the floor, its alabaster and gold veins forming an albatross at the center.

title: [Albatross, Upper Balcony]
description: Cheerfully festooned gold railings enclose the open air balcony, and a large portion of the surrounding area is visible from this vantage point.  Daylight reflects off the waters far below, and the expanse of the foredeck is visible.  A pair of leaded crystal doors leads inside.

title: [Albatross, Patrons' Hallway]
description: Elegant beeswax candles hang from the ceiling in hunter green glass holders, their light dappling the richly carpeted hallway and casting shadows along the rosewood walls.  Solid gold frames a heavy door at the end of the hallway, and silver filigree outlines another on the port side.  A heavy, richly appointed tapestry muffles the sounds from the bar down the hall.

title: [Albatross, Wheel of Fate Suite]
description: The suite spans the width of the mid-level deck, situated at the fore of the riverboat with large floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the main deck below.  Hammered gold runners hold elegant rugs atop ebon marble floors, and ornately carved cherrywood walls reflect the lustrous glow of the sun.  A few steps down into a sunken room lead to an immense, richly curtained bed piled high with luxurious bedding.

title: [Fortune's Mistress Suite]
description: This cozy suite on the port-side of the mid-level deck has large windows with views of the surrounding area and the waters below.  Richly appointed tapestries adorn the walls, and the polished mahogany floor is inlaid with rosewood dice and fortune symbols.  A silk-draped featherbed is on a raised platform near the windows, where it bathes in the rays of daylight.

title: [Albatross, Boutique]
description: Gold and alabaster wind in sinuous loops across a dark chestnut marble floor, and gilted carvings of elegant men and women gambling and gamboling cover the rosewood walls of this boutique.  A small marble-topped table sits near the arch leading out, and a mahogany cabinet is against one wall, a heady aroma wafting from its crystal doors.  Set out in the center of the boutique is an elegant display case, the panes of glass each etched with an image of an albatross in flight.

title: [Albatross, Upper Hallway]
description: Dark chestnut marble veined with alabaster and gold stretches the length of the hallway, and dark mahogany walls are elaborately carved in relief with aristocratic scenes of gambling, drinking, and hunting.  A darkened lounge is visible to the port side, and a sapphire-inlaid cherrywood arch to the starboard leads into the Let It Ride tables.

title: [Let It Ride, Sapphire Room]
description: Small windows along one wall permit a view of the lower decks and the sunlight-drenched waters far below.  Richly hued chestnut marble flooring sparkles as if dusted with gold, and rosewood paneling polished to a luminous glow encloses the room.  However, the focal point is a tile table sparkling with sapphires.  A dealer stands behind the table, and a sign is propped up on it.

title: [Let It Ride, Diamond Room]
description: Small windows along one wall permit a view of the lower decks and the sunlight-drenched waters far below.  Richly hued chestnut marble flooring sparkles as if dusted with gold, and rosewood paneling polished to a luminous glow encloses the room.  However, the focal point is a tile table sparkling with diamonds.  A dealer stands behind the table, and a sign is propped up on it.

title: [Albatross, Captain's Lounge]
description: Plush carpeting, dim lighting, and a low ceiling create an atmosphere of cozy sophistication.  A dark leather couch and a pair of wingback chairs cluster together to allow for intimate conversations away from the hustle and bustle of the rest of the riverboat.  Rosewood and mahogany doors are barely visible along the tapestry-covered walls.

title: [Albatross, Dart Room]
description: The mahogany flooring here is scuffed, especially a several yard area directly in front of a gold-edged rosewood dart board set with thin sapphire rings.  Comfortable couches and chairs are scattered about at safe distances from the dart board and its flight path.  A scrap of vellum has been nailed to the wall.

title: [Albatross, Belowdecks]
description: This cramped space holds a few ratty bunks.  An oil lamp swings from the ceiling and illuminates a work table where various needles and other instruments lay covered in a thin layer of dust.  Upon the walls are pictures drawn by some homesick sailor.  Some are of sea creatures and an old town, but most of them are of women.  A trapdoor above one bunk leads abovedecks.

title: [Albatross, Belowdecks]
description: Primarily used for storage, the narrow room is cluttered with various items.  Rolled-up documents and maps are haphazardly placed along the shelves that line the wall, which are hard to make out with the poor lighting.  A linen-covered driftwood crate rests against the back wall, while a jewel-studded ironwood chest is pushed up against a large pile of old canvas rags.

title: [Albatross, Hold]
description: The only source of light comes from a lamp that is hanging from the ceiling, which is stained with soot.  In the center of the room, a ring of various sized crates, boxes and barrels creates a temporary arena.  The bare wooden floor is slightly water-damaged and stained a dark red, with several planks of wood differing from the rest.

title: [Cavernhold, Main Hall]
description: A low rampart of earth arcs gracefully along the walls of this, the northern, end of the Main Hall.  Several spheres of clay and mud rest in ceramic cups along the top of the low mound of dirt.

title: [Glowing Intersection]
description: Clumps of an odd fungus cling to the walls and ceiling of this room and glow with a dim greenish-gray light.  Passages lead off in several directions, each one black and silent.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Cavernhold, Main Hall]
description: This side of the large Main Hall is quite unremarkable.  The Gnolls tend to leave much of their home in a natural state and this part of the chamber appears to have been untouched by hand or tool.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: Tiny rivulets of water trickle slowly down the walls of this narrow corridor.  The dim light that is created by the patches of fungus that grow on the ceiling seems to dance in the small drops of moisture as they slowly inch their way to the floor.

title: [Cavernhold, Dead End]
description: This tiny corridor ends rather abruptly here.  A large curtain of flowstone cascades silently from the northwest wall in the form of a milky ribbon of creamy white rock.

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: This passage is short and narrow.  It is also lacking the growths of the strange fungus that you've noticed elsewhere making the tunnel quite dark.  Down the passage to the southwest, however, can be seen the dim light of another chamber.

title: [Cavernhold, Deep Canyon Room]
description: The thundering roar of crashing water pounds through the blackness of a deep canyon that cuts through this room.  Spanning the chasm and the unseen river below is a narrow natural bridge of grey and red rock.

title: [Cavernhold, Natural Bridge]
description: Great plumes of water billow from the deep canyon in the form of a silver mist which coats the surrounding rock in a thin film of shimmer dew.  The wet stone is beautiful to view as the moisture has released the vibrant natural colors.

title: [Cavernhold, Guard Post]
description: Scores of torches mounted in carved sconces line the top of a low stone wall the prevents any further travel to the west.  The muted conversations of Gnoll guards hang in the air like the smoke of the flickering light sources.

title: [Cavernhold, Main Hall]
description: This is the southern end of a large, and very dark, chamber.  The dim light cast by the several growths of odd fungus that cling tenaciously to the ceiling of this room does little to illuminate the area.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Cavernhold, Main Hall]
description: This is the center of the large room that serves as the Entrance Hall to the cave system known as Cavernhold.  The ceiling in this area is slightly higher than the surrounding area, but it is still no more than six and a half feet above the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Cavernhold, Entrance Corridor]
description: This long corridor of black basalt is relatively wide, about five feet, but the ceiling is only slightly more than four feet above the floor.  The walls of this chamber appear to be a natural tube or tunnel as they are completely devoid of the usual markings left behind when tools carve stone.  A thick layer of dirt and loam covers the floor and has been worn smooth and level by the passing of countless feet.

title: [Cavernhold, Main Hall]
description: This is the eastern edge of the large Main Hall.  The floor slopes slightly downward as it runs toward the dark passage that leaves the room to the southeast.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: This long and narrow corridor runs roughly southeast to northwest.  It is dimly lit by clumps of a strange glowing fungus that grow on the walls and ceiling.

title: [Cavernhold, East Guard Chamber]
description: A yawning chasm breaches the floor of this nearly circular chamber.  Spanning the deep crevice is a tiny suspension bridge which leads to a well fortified guard chamber on the other side.  In the dim light cast by flickering torches mounted on the far wall you notice the fleeting gray shades of several gnollish sentinels.

title: [Cavernhold, Guard Post]
description: This narrow ledge lies between a deep chasm to the west and a high wall that blocks further passage to the east.  Spanning the chasm is a narrow suspension bridge.

title: [Cavernhold, Lower Passage]
description: A maze of stalagmites makes travel in any direction other than northwest quite impossible.  Far above you can be seen a narrow suspension bridge that spans the high canyon walls that loom above you.

title: [Cavernhold, Lower Passage]
description: A maze of stalagmites prevents travel in any direction except to the southeast.  Looming above you is the steep, and quite unclimbable, wall of this narrow underground canyon.  Spanning the breach far above you is a narrow suspension bridge.

wayto.20012: ;e fput 'open door';while line = get;if ['You open the nearly invisible stone door.', 'That is already open.'].include?(line);fput 'go door';break;elsif line == 'It appears to be locked.';empty_hands;fput 'get lockpick';fput 'pick door';fput 'stow lockpick';fill_hands;fput 'open door';fput 'go door';break;end;end

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: This passage twists slightly to the right as it moves up a steep incline.  Obviously a right handed individual would have a difficult time wielding a weapon if trying to advance through here.

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: Of all the passages that you've travelled thus far, this is the only one that appears to have been created by hand.  It is masterfully crafted and every attempt has been made to make it appear as natural as possible.

title: [Cavernhold, Twisting Passage]
description: This passage twists violently as it runs in a general west to northeast direction.  You are struck with the sudden fear that nearly anything could be waiting around the next turn.

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: This corridor runs northeast to southwest.  A large room is clearly visible at the southwest end.

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: This corridor is very narrow and short.  Obviously, ease of passage between rooms does not seem to be its primary purpose.

title: [Cavernhold, Dark Intersection]
description: This intersection of three passages is quite dark.  One small patch of the strange glowing fungus grows on the ceiling in the center of the room.

title: [Cavernhold, Sloping Passage]
description: The floor of this passage is pitched at a significantly steep grade.  Large amounts of dirt have been hauled in to this area in an effort to lessen the slope, but it still requires significant effort to move from one end of the room to the other.

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: The main corridor runs northeast to southwest while a smaller passage heads to the east.

title: [Cavernhold, Store Room]
description: This large cavern appears to have been a mine at one time, but is now used for storage.  Wide bands of green copper ore create wavy patterns on the walls.

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: This short passage is remarkably straight as it runs from east to west.

title: [Cavernhold, Wide Passage]
description: This passage is very wide and the compacted condition of the floor seems to indicate to you that it is well travelled.

title: [Cavernhold, Bustling Chamber]
description: This chamber is bustling with activity.  A large area dedicated to the making of clothing can be seen to the northwest while the preparation of hides can be seen occuring to the southeast.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Cavernhold, Clothworks]
description: This part of the chamber is dominated by two looms and three pedal driven spinning wheels.  Piles of shopai fleeces are scattered among the dyeing tubs and machines.  Earthenware pots of foul smelling dye rest on stone shelves.

title: [Cavernhold, Hideworks]
description: This part of the cavern is used to convert hides into armor and other useful items.  All the tools necessary for the working of hides are stored on low stone workbenches.  Standing beside a creek that flows through the back of this chamber is a large tub used for tanning.

title: [Cavernhold, Wide Passage]
description: This passage is actually large enough to be considered a room in other parts of the cavern, but here it is merely a connection between two larger chambers.

title: [Cavernhold, Woodworks]
description: This room is obviously the woodworks.  Workbenches, lathes, saws, planes and other woodworking tools are scattered about the area.  Furniture, barrels and other wood items in different states of repair rest on the benches.

title: [Cavernhold, Rutted Intersection]
description: The floor of this intersection has been rutted by traffic that apparently is coming from the north and moving along the southwest passage.  The smell of sawdust comes from the room to the south.

title: [Cavernhold, Rutted Passage]
description: The deep ruts in the floor of this tunnel indicate that it has been used as a thoroughfare for some heavy vehicle.  The width between ruts is constant and narrow which might be indicative of a small cart or wagon that makes regular trips to and from the rooms that lie to the northeast.

title: [Cavernhold, Rutted Passage]
description: The floor of this passage becomes deeply rutted as it moves from the southwest to the east.  Apparently something of considerable weight has made several trips through here.

title: [Cavernhold, Curtain Room]
description: The slow movement of water and the gradual deposition of minerals has formed a curtain of pure calcite which splits this room into three passages.

title: [Cavernhold, Living Area]
description: This room is cluttered with the everyday items used by the Gnolls.  A large number of beds, tables, chairs and trunks are scattered about the room.

title: [Cavernhold, Pearl Intersection]
description: Water drips from the ceiling here and falls into a small pool in the center of this large intersection.  The combination of dissolved minerals and the agitation caused by the falling water has allowed a large number of cave pearls to form.

title: [Cavernhold, Well Trod Passage]
description: The dirt floor of this passage has been packed to a hard and smooth finish by the passing of countless feet.

title: [Cavernhold, Intersection]
description: A large globe hangs in the center of this room.  Within the globe is a large patch of the glowing fungus.  A thin sheet of metal is wrapped around most of the globe, effectively blocking and reflecting the light on to one wall of the room.  On this wall is a vein of odd colored rock which gives this intersection a mottled appearance.  Obviously the Gnolls come here to study and enjoy this interesting formation.

title: [Cavernhold, Long Passage]
description: You occasionally reach out and touch one of the walls of this long passage to reassure yourself that you are still moving along a tunnel.  The inky blackness that shrouds both ends of the tunnel greedily swallows what little light the glowing fungus casts.

title: [Cavernhold, Shrine]
description: Carved from a pocket of obsidian and quartz is the shrine dedicated to the Mountain Father and his Sons.  The altar is a plume of polished obsidian.  Clusters of spiked quartz crystals protrude from the walls and small ledges hold offerings.

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: This narrow passage is very quiet and hushed.

title: [Cavernhold, Loud Intersection]
description: Several passages meet at this point.  The northwest passage seems to lead to a room from which the loud banging of metal on metal can be clearly heard.  The other two passages are dark and silent.

title: [Cavernhold, Smithworks]
description: This smithhall is used for smelting and forging base metals and turning ore into items of beauty.  Four forges and two smelting kilns are in the room as well as eight large anvils.

title: [Cavernhold, Loud Corridor]
description: The loud banging of metal on metal can be heard coming from the room to the southeast.

title: [Cavernhold, Long Passage]
description: You strain your eyes to take in every bit of the dim light cast by the strange glowing fungus as you move along this confining passage.  You can make out the intersection of three tunnels, but no light seems to be coming from any of them.

title: [Cavernhold, Long Passage]
description: A faint light comes from what seems to be a room to the south.  The two passages that lead to the north, however, are dimly lit by the glowing fungus.

title: [Cavernhold, Dead End]
description: You are walking along a dark passage.  Small clumps of fungus light only a small area around your feet.  The rest of the passage is dark and silent.  The passage abruptly ends, the passage to the northwest having been buried in a cave in.

title: [Cavernhold, Column Passage]
description: A large column of creamy stone, tinted with shades of red, stands in the center of this passage.  It is the result of a large stalagmite and stalactite slowly growing together.

title: [Cavernhold, Living Quarters]
description: This room is filled with tables, chairs, beds and small bags of personal belongings.  Since the Gnolls prefer to live communally, it doesn't surprise you to see so much crammed into such a small chamber.

title: [Cavernhold, Corridor]
description: This corridor is unremarkable in its features.  It runs from northeast to southwest.

title: [Cavernhold, Jewelworks]
description: Seven large workbenches nearly fill this chamber.  Attached to each bench is a small forge and on every work surface can be seen the tools necessary for the creation of jewelry.

title: [Cavernhold, Sculpted Passage]
description: This is apparently the entrance to an area that has been mined.  Small amounts of ore can still be seen in the walls.  It has been sculpted to best display the twists and turns of the parent rock.  The Gnolls always leave these small traces of ore in place as tribute to the Mountain Father and this simple, yet appropriate, homage to their deity is beautiful to observe.

title: [Cluttered Intersection]
description: This room has been set aside for the storage of the many tools used by the Gnolls during their mining operations.  Picks, wheelbarrows, shovels and hammers are just some of the various types of hardware that are scattered about in this area.

title: [Cavernhold, Mine Shaft]
description: A large vein of bright copper ore runs through the walls of this room.  An wheelbarrow and a pick indicate that this shaft is currently being worked by the miners, though none are present at the moment.

title: [Cavernhold, Mine Shaft]
description: A thin vein of ore is visible here.  The miners may still be working this shaft, but there are no tools or wheelbarrows here.

title: [Cavernhold, Storage]
description: Furniture, pots, pans, mugs, bowls, barstock and ore are kept here.  Most of these items are either stacked or placed in barrels on the floor.  A set of shelves is carved into the west wall on which are placed particularly fragile items.

title: [Cavernhold, Long Passage]
description: The echo of your footsteps is a sure indication that this is indeed a long tunnel.  The dim light cast by the glowing fungus is quickly swallowed by a thick curtain of darkness to the south.  To the northwest, however, can be seen a brighter room.

title: [Cavernhold, Living Area]
description: This room is a maze of beds, trunks, tables and chairs.  Most of the furniture is made of stone with the remainder being fashioned from wood.

title: [Cavernhold, Tight Passage]
description: The walls of this passage suddenly swing in towards each other.  The resulting crevice is so narrow, that you must turn sideways to pass through.

title: [Cavernhold, Musterhall]
description: You are at the north end of a big cavern.  A natural platform of rock stands a full ten feet above the floor of the chamber.  The shape of the chamber is such that anyone standing on this platform can speak in a normal tone of voice and be heard quite clearly throughout the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest

title: [Cavernhold, Sloping Passage]
description: The floor of the northeast end of this passage is considerably higher than that of the southwest end.  Made of packed dirt, it is difficult to tell if it is natural or if the Gnolls have brought in quantities of dirt to create this slope.

title: [Cavernhold, Wide Intersection]
description: Three large tunnels come together here.  The floor is decidedly compacted, a sign that all the passages are well travelled in this area.

title: [Cavernhold, Kitchen]
description: A gaping crevice in the ceiling of this chamber provides a natural chimney to the outside, thus making this room the ideal choice for use as the kitchen.  Several hard clay ovens can be seen and the smell of baking lichen bread eminates from each one.  Cauldrons of shopai and mushroom stew bubble noisily over the fire pit that burns near the chimney.

title: [Cavernhold, Bubbling Room]
description: A small stream bubbles out of the rock here and flows down the corridor to the southeast.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Cavernhold, Huge Arch]
description: The prominent feature of this room is a huge natural arch that cuts through the thick rock layer of the north wall.  Through this arch you can see a small part of what seems to be a tremendous chamber.  Away from arch, to the southeast, can be heard the quiet gurgle of slowly flowing water.

title: [Cavernhold, Huge Chamber]
description: This is the southern end of what is perhaps the largest underground chamber you have ever seen.  In the dim light of the cavern, you can make out the faint shoreline of a large lake of calm black water to the north.  You can also see a collection of barrels and vats to the northeast.  To the northwest, you notice a strange light.

title: [Cavernhold, Damp Passage]
description: This narrow passage is damp and smells of fungus.

title: [Cavernhold, Mushroom Farm]
description: This room is broken up into two sections.  In the smaller area to the north, waste from the kitchen, bedding from the Shopai stables and other wastes are composted into a rich loam.  This loam is then spread over the rest of the cavern where it provides nourishment for a wide variety of mushrooms.

title: [Cavernhold, Damp Passage]
description: This narrow passage is damp and smells of fungus.

title: [Cavernhold, Stream Passage]
description: A small, shallow stream runs down the center of this short passage.

title: [Cavernhold, Dining Room]
description: This large chamber is apparently used to feed the gnolls who inhabit these caverns.  Seven ridges of level stone run the length of the room and serve as tables, stone benches and chairs flanking each.

title: [Cavernhold, Musterhall]
description: This is the south end of a large chamber.  Further to the north, you can see a raised platform of rock which apparently is used as a dais.  Little else can be seen here.

title: [Cavernhold, Bent Passage]
description: This passage seems almost unnatural as it bends sharply, connecting to another passage to the south and leading to a room to the west.

title: [Cavernhold, Shrine]
description: Sculptured copper, nickle, iron and lead ores are shaped to best display the many convoluted layers, folds, and twists of rock that make up the walls of this chamber.  The altar of this shrine is a large cylinder of burnished bronze topped by a burning oil lamp and the walls of the room are pockmarked with scores of small niches to hold the offerings.

title: [Cavernhold, Living Chamber]
description: This is the chamber of the Great Gnoll, the political leader of the Gnolls of Cavernhold.  Hanging on the back wall of the room are charts and maps of many areas outside of Cavernhold, some of which are quite unfamiliar to you.  Scores of keys hang on finely crafted key racks which are firmly mounted to the west wall of the room.  A small bed, a large table surrounded by twelve chairs, a huge trunk and an armor stand make up the furnishings of this chamber.

title: [Cavernhold, Shopai Stable]
description: This is the room used as the stables for the small herd of shopai that the Gnolls raise and tend.  It is fenced to prevent the beasts from wandering the underground complex.  A small stream runs down the center of the passage to the north and disappears under the wall to the east.

title: [Cavernhold, Smelly Passage]
description: This passage carries the definite odor of animal dung.

title: [Cavernhold, Stalagmite Corner]
description: A large stalagmite grows slowly in the center of this three-way intersection like a stone sentinel.  Though the light of the passage is dim, the dripping water that has created this formation forms a glistening coat that reflects the available light into fascinating patterns.

title: [Cavernhold, Lichen Farm]
description: This part of the cavern is damp, bright and warm.  The dampness is caused by a myriad of rivulets of water that flow down the sides of the room.  The light and warmth are provided by five stones, firmly embedded in the rock wall, that emit a warm glow.  Under this light is growing a large patch of lichen and moss.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Cavernhold, Brewery]
description: This part of the chamber is used to make mushroom wine.  The brewery has a large press, cauldrons for boiling the mushrooms, filters, barrels and casks.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cavernhold, Lake Shore]
description: Bright green sand arcs gracefully around this shore of the large underground lake.  The dim light of the cavern prevents you from seeing the distant northern shore.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Cavernhold, Lake Shore]
description: This is the southwest shore of the underground lake.  No wind exists in this underground realm, so the waters are calm and placid causing interesting rippled patterns to form on the soft sand of the beach.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Cavernhold, Marina]
description: This is the western shore of the large underground lake.  A large assortment of hardware is scattered about the area.  Coils of rope and heavy line hang from hooks on the walls.  Pulleys and shackles can be seen in the many crates that rest against the several stone workbenches that sit in darkened recesses.  This room is obviously used to maintain the small fleet of tiny boats that make up the Gnoll fishing flotilla.

title: [In a Tiny Boat]
description: You are bobbing along in one of the tiny fishing boats used by the Gnolls.

title: [Cavernhold, Lake Shore]
description: This is the northeast shore of the lake.  A small stream runs silently across the sands of this area and effectively stops progress to the south.  The shore itself seems to be well travelled, though.

wayto.19992: ;e if GameObj.loot.find{|item| item.noun == "door"};fput "go door";else;fput "push stone";fput "stand" until standing?;fput "go door";end

title: [Cavernhold, Lake Shore]
description: This is the eastern shore of the large underground lake.  A small stream exits the lake here and disappears under the wall to the southeast.  The quiet gurgle of the tumbling water is wonderfully relaxing.

title: [Cavernhold, Large Chamber]
description: You are in center of this large chamber.  The lake lies to the north while the brewery and lichen farm are easily visible.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Cavernhold, Lake Shore]
description: This is the southeastern shore of the underground lake.  Several sand castles, in various stages of completion, are scattered about and indicate to you that this area must be a favorite with the younger gnolls.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Cavernhold, Lake Shore]
description: The ambiance created by the lapping of the waves on the green sand of the shore is relaxing and soothing.  The faint light cast by the strange glowing fungus is reflected in odd and ever-changing patterns onto the dark walls of this, the north, side of the lake.

title: [Cavernhold, Lake Shore]
description: This is the northwest shore of the lake.  Sitting in the shadows of a small recess is a heavy table of blue-black stone, while scattered about are the many tools necessary for the cleaning and preparing of fresh fish.

title: [Courtyard]
description: Red brick walls heavily covered in thick tendrils of dark green ivy block passage to the east and west.  To the north a shining silver portcullis intrudes on the expanse of wall, flanked by brightly burning sconces.  Here and there throughout the courtyard small trees stand in simple brick planters, and stone animals peer out shyly from behind them.  The courtyard extends a few yards to the south, dropping sharply away to present a view of the rest of the Guild.

title: [Library]
description: Stone benches surround a long oval table in the center of this room.  Torches burn brightly and illuminate the table for reading or study use.  Small vents near the floor allow the ocean air to circulate, taking the torch smoke out through several chimneys in the ceiling.  The walls are covered from floor to ceiling with shelves crammed full of scrolls.  Interestingly, the majority of the shelves appear to contain information on honing one's will, meditation, and combat prowess rather than healing.

title: [Guild Master Caraway's Office]
description: The stark white limestone walls of this small office brightly reflect the moonlight pouring through the windows and the light coming in through the northern arch.  A low bamboo table occupies the center of the room, and several bamboo chairs cluster around the table.  Two bookcases follow the eastern and western walls, while an arch cut in the limestone wall allows egress to the north.  The floor is barren save for a circular throw rug immediately below the table.

title: [Hub]
description: Three stairways lead from this small plateau.  A short stairway leads straight up while a terraced stairway and a winding stairway snake downward.  To the north a retaining wall of heavy white quartz boulders holds back the upper level.  Honeysuckle cascades liberally over the boulders to fill the area with a sweet scent.  At ground level tall beds of snapdragons and gladioluses wave in the sea breeze that gusts in from the waters of the canal visible to the south.

title: [Relaxation Garden]
description: Climbing roses clamber up the northern wall of this expansive garden, their large, fragrant blooms reduced to whites, and greys in the moonlight.  Topiary animals frolic among hybrid tea roses, and sizeable rocks, their tops flattened to resemble stone end tables, sit beside metal rocking chairs accompanied by burning torches.  A winding stairway ascends steeply to the northeast, while a stone stairway drops away quickly to the southeast.  Flickering lights dance from a shaded nook.

title: [Aroma Therapy]
description: A raised circular platform of white limestone dominates this little nook, surrounded closely by sheltering gingko trees.  Fifty candles of different shapes and colors cluster in concentric circles on the platform.  Every so often one dies out and then another magically springs to life.  On the perimeter, hundreds of long white candles burn brightly, their flames reflecting off the gingkoes to bathe the area in a light green glow.

title: [Potion Platform]
description: The small platform clings precariously to the side of the canal wall.  A stone stairway leads upward while a wooden stairway slips down into a recessed cavern below.  The wall, the stairways and the canal's waters underneath encompass the platform.  Long, winding orchid vines sporting dark flowers entwine around the platform's railing, and narrow workbenches support bottles, herbs, powders, and ointments piled haphazardly.

title: [Meeting Cavern]
description: Slightly raised above the canal's waters outside, this deep limestone cavern extends several hundred feet back before tapering to a rounded point.  Rows of polished ironwood benches with emerald green seat cushions and backs line either side of the wide aisle that leads to the dais at the cavern's pointed end.  Torches mounted high on the wall above each bench serve to illuminate the silver carpeting, the white limestone dais, and the huge banner that hangs from the cavern's ceiling.

title: [Training Garden]
description: A long terrace snakes around the side of the cliff to the east.  Light grey ice plant cascades down the northern wall from above, clinging to the white limestone outcroppings.  To the south the ground drops steeply away, tumbling over the wall to the canal below.  Various stations have been set up to allow training in weaponry, martial arts, and bodybuilding, and several sets of sandbags rest under a tall gingko tree.  Far to the east, two figures stand as if awaiting someone.

title: [Infirmary]
description: A canopy of low gingko trees shades this small area, their branches intertwining to cast a mottled carpet of dark and light patches on the turf below.  A life-size human mannequin swathed in several layers of bandages, splints, and tourniquets leans against one of the tree trunks.  Several empty cots offer places for treatment of the badly wounded.  Wooden cabinets hold a small emergency supply of medicinal ingredients in various shapes, sizes, and potencies.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Empath Guild, Corridor]
description: Slender spaced knotty pine planks bear signs of recent white washing and run from cobblestone floor to open rafter ceiling.  Candelabra fashioned of wrought iron are positioned at even intervals down the length of the corridor and frame wooden archways covered with dark green curtains for privacy.

title: [Training Garden]
description: A long terrace snakes around the side of the cliff to the west.  Light blue ice plant mixed with dark green ivy trails down the northern slope.  To the south the ground appears rather unsafe, large chunks of it missing, perhaps now down in the canal directly below.  Several eucalyptus trees anchor the remaining edges of the plateau.  Various forms of exercise equipment reside in several sections, and two pepper trees stand a short distance away with a leather table resting under each.

title: [Empath Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemic Workroom]
description: Standing opposite the dark green curtain-lined archway is an enormous window that looks out upon the guild's colorful gardens and is framed by white shutters.  Positioned beneath the window is a white-washed cedar workbench that runs from wall to wall and houses several alchemical devices.  A small riverstone hearth is built high up in the eastern wall, while the western wall houses a long storage cupboard.

title: [Empath Guild, Corridor]
description: Slender spaced knotty pine planks bear signs of recent white washing and run from cobblestone floor to open rafter ceiling.  Candelabra fashioned of wrought iron are positioned at even intervals down the length of the corridor and frame wooden archways covered with dark green curtains for privacy.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemic Workroom]
description: Standing opposite the dark green curtain-lined archway is an enormous window that looks out upon the guild's colorful gardens and is framed by white shutters.  Positioned beneath the window is a white-washed cedar workbench that runs from wall to wall and houses several alchemical devices.  A small riverstone hearth is built high up in the eastern wall, while the western wall houses a long storage cupboard.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemic Storage]
description: Drilled into the brick walls are floor to ceiling shelves, their expanses spreading north on both walls toward the library.  Frosted glass-front cupboards frame a small closet which is hung with a dark green curtain that hides its contents.  A copper and oak footlocker is set at the curve of the wall and has rags, cloths, dust pans, and several brooms propped up inside it.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemic Workroom]
description: Standing opposite the dark green curtain-lined archway is an enormous window that looks out upon the guild's colorful gardens and is framed by white shutters.  Positioned beneath the window is a white-washed cedar workbench that runs from wall to wall and houses several alchemical devices.  A small riverstone hearth is built high up in the eastern wall, while the western wall houses a long storage cupboard.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemic Storage]
description: Dark and light bricks line the walls from floor to ceiling and are illuminated by copper oil sconces hung from decorative wrought iron hooks.  Glass-front cupboards etched with acantha leaves line the three walls above cedar counter tops, which have storage drawers beneath.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Empath Guild, Antechamber]
description: A gleaming white marble slab rises from the center of the antechamber, adorned with golden script.  Wide corridors branch out to the south, where the quiet activity of the guild members can be heard.  Hanging from the walls are a series of tapestries depicting great empathic figures in history.

title: [Empath Guild, Corridor]
description: Giant linked rings of brass have been inlaid into the pale grey marble floor, gleaming under the illumination of the toadstools lining the corridor.  A heavy, moss green curtain has been draped across the carved archway to the east.

title: [Empath Guild, Library]
description: Plush carpeting in a burnt sienna hue muffles the footsteps of guild members as they peruse the library's extensive collection.  Each towering shelf has been equipped with its own rolling ladder for easy access to even the highest of stored tomes.  Polished granite tables have been arranged in the central area along with comfortable padded chairs for quiet reading and studying.

title: [Empath Guild, Corridor]
description: Carefully imbedded into the walls are tiny shards of local gemstones in a spiraling pattern that runs from floor to ceiling.  A pair of blue-toned luminescent toadstools flank the rails of a winding stone stairway.

title: [Empath Guild, Annex]
description: A trio of archways lead away from the half-moon annex, partially obscured by velvety curtains.  The grey marble floor has been inlaid with a repeating diamond design, alternating in color between shades of red and blue.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: Dominating the office of the Guildmaster is a gold-flecked white granite desk occupied by a variety of important paperwork.  An elegantly carved bookshelf holds numerous thick tomes and a handful of colorful glaes figurines.  Hung on the opposing wall is a vivid landscape of the snow-capped DragonSpine mountains rendered in fine oil paints.  A small iron-wrought stand holds a lavender ceramic teapot, kept warm by a heated plate.

title: [Empath Guild, Atrium]
description: Rising overhead, a magnificent crystal dome offers a wonderful view of the quartz-veined stalactites of the outer cavern.  Several benches are interspersed among the clusters of giant, luminescent toadstools, each group emitting light in a slightly different hue.  Empaths continually wander in and out of the area, taking as much time as they need to relax or catch up with a friend.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Empath Guild, Corridor]
description: On the ceiling above, the various local flora of Zul Logoth have been artistically rendered into a mesmerizing design.  Cheerful conversation emanates from beyond the carved arch to the west.

title: [Empath Guild, Infirmary]
description: A multitude of shelves and cabinets line the smooth wall, filled to the brim with healing supplies.  Neat, linen-draped cots form two rows down the length of the infirmary, each station equipped with a utile, polished metal stand.  Residing in each corner is a giant luminescent toadstool, the glowing fungi providing more than adequate illumination for the delicate work performed here.

title: [Empath Guild, Quiet Chamber]
description: Rather plain in comparison with the rest of the guild, the chamber features uniform cream-hued stone.  Soft mats and cushions are available in a small alcove for empaths wishing to meditate, or simply enjoy some peace and quiet.

title: [Empath Guild, Storage]
description: Neatly organized shelves hold the extensive supplies required by the guild for everyday activity.  Clean linens are stored in one area against the far wall, with crates and boxes of dried herbs located beside them.  Each section has its own placard that indicates what goes where.

title: [Empath Guild, Fountain Cavern]
description: Water burbles happily down the many tiers of the enormous fountain in the center of the cavern, echoing off the distant ceiling and walls.  Radiating outward, woven verdant runners create distinctive paths against the pale stone floor.  Heavy curtains mark entrances to the guild's training rooms, each one embroidered with gold thread.

title: [Empath Guild, Crystal Chamber]
description: Numerous large, clear crystals climb along the smooth stone walls, rising in distinctive tiers.  A cheerful white light is cast by a series of luminescent mushrooms set in brass pots along a narrow ledge.  Curtained archways branch off from the chamber, leading to individual training rooms.

title: [Empath Guild, Stone Gazebo]
description: Tidy beds of spotted mushrooms encircle a stone gazebo in riotous color.  A few stalagmites rise up in the background, the stone formations carved with fanciful, swirling patterns.  Thick, woven crimson curtains hang across the archways that line the cavern's walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Empath Guild, Storeroom]
description: Several tiers of  line the walls here, spanning from floor to ceiling and completely stocked with alchemic ingredients.  Clusters of colorful crystals sprout forth from the ceiling, glistening in the light of a giant luminescent toadstool.  A gazebo can be glimpsed beyond a short tunnel.

title: [Empath Guild, Quiet Alcove]
description: Sprawling patches of luminescent, fuzzy moss cling to the surrounding walls, bathing the area in a soft, greenish-blue glow and muffling the sounds emanating from the main cavern.  Brightly colored sphene charms dangle from low-hanging stalactites, each carved into a detailed toadstool.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron Room]
description: Dominating this small chamber is an enormous blackened iron cauldron, occupying nearly half the space available.  Glowing red coals radiate oppressive heat from the pit situated below the cauldron.  A thick, dark russet curtain has been draped across the large hole leading back into the main cavern.

title: [Empath Guild, Workshop]
description: Faint etchings of medicinal plants and fungi adorn the pale stone walls.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A heavy crimson curtain drapes across an etched stone archway leading back to the main cavern.

title: [Empath Guild, Workshop]
description: Faint etchings of medicinal plants and fungi adorn the pale stone walls.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A heavy crimson curtain drapes across an etched stone archway leading back to the main cavern.

title: [Empath Guild, Workshop]
description: Faint etchings of medicinal plants and fungi adorn the pale stone walls.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a stone workbench.  A heavy crimson curtain drapes across an etched stone archway leading back to the main cavern.

title: [Vanity Fair, Powder Room]
description: Pale white marble tiles line a long counter installed with a frosted glass basin at one end, the shelves underneath stocked with folded cotton cloths monogrammed in silvery thread.  As if an invitation to relax, a pillow-topped chaise lounge covered in pale silk sprawls out in front of a full-length mirror.  Soft light streams through a round window and onto a glass-topped cherrywood vanity neatly arranged with bottles and brushes.

title: [Vanity Fair, Comfort Room]
description: Narrow shelves adjacent to a pair of white ivory basins protrude from an austere, grey-papered wall, one holding a neatly folded stack of plush cotton cloths easily within arm's reach.  A large, silvered glass mirror hangs above a dark walnut vanity of polished lacquered wood, closely matching the color of a leather-topped bench sitting off to one side.  Thick carpets patterned with scalloped quatrefoils muffle the sounds beyond the flora-carved door.

title: [Now is the Write Time]
description: An imposing mistwood writing desk paired with a tall, straight-backed chair is arranged in front of a large window, a rolling cart laid out with a silver tea set parked nearby.  Thick with dust, the shelves inside a large cabinet are stocked with bins of parchment, stacks of note cards, and assorted ornate glass bottles.  A fluffy white cat peeks out from a white wicker bin filled with discarded stationery.

title: [Brumas' Toy Wagon, Dark Embrace]
description: The wagon is rather small and could only house a handful of occupants, at least comfortably.  One corner of the floor is covered in colorful stuffing and red paint as if it were the aftermath of a toy onslaught, while a tiny red music box rests upon a stand and fills the wagon with an eerie dirge.

title: [Wizard Guild, Private Office]
description: A map of Icemule Trace and its surrounding wilderness hangs above a low bookshelf, its ornate frame a contrast to the otherwise simple surroundings.  A large desk holds pride of place in the center of the room, a pair of comfortabe chairs arranged in front of it.

title: [Now is the Write Time, Storage]
description: Partially concealed behind a parchment screen, the polished hardwood floor is littered with crumpled paper beneath a spindly-legged escritoire piled high with vellum and near-empty ink wells.  Sleek feathers and ostentatious plumes hang from the ceiling by nearly invisible silk threads over a small mistwood worktable in one corner.

title: [DeArchon Home, Front Room]
description: The front room of the residence is modest, with a hearth along one wall, windows along another, and a half-circle of leather-backed chairs facing a woven blue area rug.  Above the fireplace hangs a shield bearing the DeArchon family crest and a pair of crossed silver stilettos with ornate handles.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Abandoned Hut]
description: The interior of the hut isn't very spacious, and the shelter looks to have been abandoned quite some time ago, leaving cobwebs and spiderwebs scattered everywhere.  Along the western wall, countless numbers of shovels lean up against the boarded-up window.  A dusty ironwood rack rests on the eastern wall, and in the center of the hut a decayed wyrmwood coffer is filled with various wares.

Along the western wall, countless numbers of shovels lean up against the boarded-up window.  In the center of the hut is a decayed wrotwood coffer.

title: [Felthrop's Wagon]
description: Roughly hewn wooden walls encapsulate the room, their surfaces chipped and scratched from countless impacts with the weapons hanging from the hooks in the sloped ceiling.  A curtain of faded red velvet serves to separate the shop from the backroom, its matted surface hanging all the way to the floor.  Resting beside the door leading back outside is a low oak table, while a dented footlocker stands opposite.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spiders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Cleric Guild, Vestibule]
description: Elaborately wrought statues guard the perimeter of the vestibule, set before a series of vibrant woven tapestries.  Giant luminescent toadstools have been arranged carefully at the heart of the chamber, casting their soft light upon the stoic faces of the statuary.  Suspended from the ceiling is a simple crimson banner embroidered in golden thread.

title: [Cleric Guild, Corridor]
description: Austere, moss green runners flow like verdant rivers upon the polished limestone floor.  The wide corridor splits to the east, where muffled chanting can be heard.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: Upon smooth, polished limestone walls hang beautifully illuminated prayer scrolls encased in glass.  A varnished ebonwood desk basks in the reddish glow from the window directly behind it.  Thick leather-bound tomes line the shelves of a stout iron-wrought shelf in the corner, topped off by a slightly tarnished brass reliquary.

title: [Cleric Guild, Corridor]
description: Fine dwarven masonry is on display at this small juncture between floors of the guild.  A steep ramp descends below via a wide tunnel, its curved ceiling inlaid with a colorful mosaic of local gemstones.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shrine]
description: A harmonious blend of stone and metalwork sweeps across the shrine, present in the walls, domed ceiling, and supporting columns.  Each material's surface has been polished to a high gloss, resulting in the reflected light obscuring the borders between them.  An elaborate eostone altar stands across from a burnished invar gong, connected by a path of etched brass medallions inlaid into the smooth, pale limestone floor.

title: [Cleric Guild, Storage Area]
description: Supplies and materials needed by the guild are stored within this small, stone-walled room.  Along the perimeter, thick glaes shelves are neatly organized with stock, while a sturdy invar cabinet stands beside a squat table in the corner.  A small iron-studded door leads out to the main hall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cavern]
description: Carved from the natural rock of the roughly circular cavern is an arcade leading to the numerous training areas of the guild.  Luminescent moss clings to the stalactites above the protective crystalline dome overhead.  The floor has been partitioned into several immaculately maintained rock gardens featuring stones in a dizzying variety of colors, sizes, and shapes.

title: [Cleric Guild, Rock Garden]
description: Fine-grained limestone in hues of desert yellow, pale blue, and moss green lie in spiral-shaped garden beds.  Small nuggets of polished granite outline several of the borders between colors, emphasizing the fanciful patterns created by the stones.

title: [Cleric Guild, Annex]
description: An expansive mural rendered in bas-relief upon the limestone wall depicts scenes from the Ur-Daemon war.  The intermittent bell chimes echo throughout the annex, hardly muffled by the plush rug spanning the floor.  Fragrant incense wafts in from the adjoining alcoves.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [Cleric Guild, Dark Alcove]
description: Simulacra of the pantheon of Lornon have been skillfully etched into the smooth limestone walls.  Arranged about the alcove are several gleaming brass censers, their tendrils of smoke forming lacy patterns that dissipate quickly in the air.  A handful of simple prayer mats encircle a carved black marble altar.

title: [Cleric Guild, Grey Alcove]
description: A pair of images has been rendered upon the pale limestone walls of the alcove.  Suspended from the ceiling are diminutive censers that slowly release the fragrance of the burning incense within.  A carved grey marble altar dominates this small, enclosed space.

title: [Cleric Guild, Light Alcove]
description: Inset upon the walls of the alcove are detailed simulacra depicting the pantheon of Liabo.  Bejeweled brass censers sit nestled in niches, wisps of pale smoke lazily drifting into the air.  Standing at the forefront is a carved white marble altar surrounded by woven prayer mats.

title: [Cleric Guild, Western Alcove]
description: Bored into the surrounding rock walls are several rough holes, serving as entrances into more private areas of study.  Visible beyond gaps in the affixed curtains are glimmers of colorful glass and black iron.  Shards of crystals have been imbedded into the stone underfoot, creating sparkling paths amid the drab grey.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cauldron Room]
description: Dominating this small chamber is an enormous blackened iron cauldron, occupying nearly half the space available.  Glowing red coals radiate oppressive heat from the pit situated below the cauldron.  A thick, moss green curtain has been draped across the large hole leading back into the main cavern.

title: [Cleric Guild, Storeroom]
description: Numerous stone shelves line the walls here, spanning from floor to ceiling and completely stocked with alchemic ingredients.  A few patches of silvery moss have sprung up in the corners of the room, bathed in the light of a giant luminescent toadstool.  Beyond a simple granite archway is a short tunnel, lined with crystal growths.

title: [Cleric Guild, Northern Alcove]
description: A series of curtained archways run along the slightly curved wall, each adorned with a single, faceted gemstone.  Tall, smooth pillars have been carved out of the rock between each portal, with rainbow-hued pebbles arranged at the base of each column.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Cleric Guild, Workshop]
description: Small flecks of quartz crystal shine along the wall.  Though small, the room is equipped with an iron rack and a rough stone workbench.  A simple archway leads back out to the main cavern.
