title: [Cleric Guild, Annex]
description: White marble columns shot with thin crimson veins ascend toward the ceiling, their colossal forms arranged in a circular pattern.  Four main halls branch off in the cardinal directions, the gaps of the towering columns serving as an entranceway toward each.  A huge disc of pure crimson eahnor is inlaid into the floor, its surface bearing elaborate, looping designs of lustrous gold across its entire circumference.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest, out

title: [Cleric Guild, Shop]
description: Rows of shelves line the curved, circular walls of this chamber, each displaying wares and other assorted fineries.  Crystal-paned cases hold other treasures within their faenor-bound frames, their sparkle enhanced by the numerous oil lamps positioned in precise locations in the small shop.  The faint scent of lilacs drifts in on errant currents of wind through the open door.  Several chests line the floor, and a small round table is set in the precise center of the room.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Annex]
description: Twin sconces are set opposite one another on the north and south walls here, their dim flames casting long shadows down the hallway in both directions.  The floor is composed of carefully chiseled granite blocks, each one set against the next at a slight angle, and the walls are polished marble blocks from floor to ceiling.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Apothecary]
description: Flickering candlelight from the wall sconces lining the room plays along the colorful collection of jars and bottles on the shelves that line the wood-paneled walls.  A glass-topped maoral table abuts one wall, its glossy surface nearly obscured by stacks of boxes and crates, each stamped with an exotic pictograph.

title: [Spirit Hall, Meditation Room]
description: Flows of water trickle down opposite of each other on the tall, gold-veined white marble walls.  Small pools located at the base of the waterfalls ripple quietly, fed by the streams.  An elaborate statue of faceless spirits ascending toward the ceiling within a shrouding veil of roiling mist dominates the center of the room, its features cast in an illuminated glow from the twin arched windows above.  Prayer mats of alternating black and white are arranged in a circle around the statue.

title: [Cleric Guild, Spirit Hall]
description: Recessed niches provide a space for nearly each of the Lesser Spirits, those of light upon one wall, and those of darkness on the other.  Massive marble columns topped with golden capitals line the hallway, ornate velvet banners of white and black hung between them.  Prayer mats are arranged in a comfortable grouping around the base of each niche, the gaze of the large and expertly-chiseled statues directed at those who come to pray.

title: [Spirit Hall, Chamber of Lessons]
description: Neatly ordered rows of columns form the circular chamber, banners of black bearing white shields hung between them.  Within the recesses of an arched niche is a towering statue of a man, his grim form knelt down in a vigilant prayer.  A small altar draped with a black velvet cloth is set before the statue, its white surface appearing pale and somber within the embrace of the faint candlelight.

title: [Lornon Hall, Meditation Room]
description: A single glassy black pool stretches across the floor, its mirror-like surface unbroken by any ripples.  Dim light does little to illuminate the hall, the candle's wavering flames casting the surroundings in a moody glow.  Dark velvet banners flutter above, stitched with the image of the deep crimson Lornon moon in each of its phases.  A silence hangs over the area, broken only by the occasional soft footstep upon the unadorned marble floor.

title: [Cleric Guild, Lornon Hall]
description: Arched niches trimmed in dark gold house the likenesses of the Lornon Arkati, each brought through in striking detail through black marble.  Ornate prayer mats line the floor beneath the every statue's cold and fixed stares.  Candles placed behind each stone depiction serve only to cast wavering shadows across the silent halls and highlight the statue's dark faces.

title: [Lornon Hall, Chamber of Lessons]
description: Scores of viciously slashed black silk banners flutter silently upon the walls in this large, round chamber.  The domineering presence of a statue to the south casts a long, foreboding shadow across the flawless white surface of the floor.  A feral snarl is etched upon the man's features, and his heavily-muscled form is captured in mid-attack, his scimitar raised upwards in a slashing arc.  A small, cloth-draped altar stands beneath the statue.

title: [Grey Hall, Meditation Room]
description: Mute grey silk swaths span the lengths of the marble columns in this hall, hiding the sheer white splendor of the surrounding architecture beneath layers of tranquil grey.  Stylized designs of polished moonstone arc across the floor, their sharp angles and dramatic curves weaving an almost crazed, yet beautiful pattern across the stone.  A soft, dim luminescence flickers in from the east, casting a pale, unearthly light across the hall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Library]
description: Highly burnished mahogany wood, accented with pale pine molding, lines the walls of this small library.  A two-column portcullis bookcase stands against the far wall, overflowing with tomes, scrolls, and manuscripts.  A heavy oak table, surrounded by some plush-cushioned oak chairs, provides an ideal location for a comfortable read.

title: [Liabo Hall, Meditation Room]
description: The rows of thin, arched windows set high into the walls cast slices of pale illumination onto the polished marble floor.  Four small ivory fountains are set into the walls, their sparkling waters lending a soft, trickling echo to the surroundings.  Black banners bearing the phases of Liabo line the gaps between the windows, the pristine white moon softly glowing with the reflected moonlight.

title: [Cleric Guild, Chambers]
description: An expansive stained-glass window takes up nearly the entire eastern wall, multi-hued facets of light twinkling through its numerous panes.  Banners liberally cover the walls, each trimmed with crimson and gold tassels upon their silken edges.  A massive onyx desk lies in the center of the room, its surface lustrous and obviously well-kept.  The subtlest hint of burning incense drifts through the surroundings.

title: [Cleric Guild, Grey Hall]
description: Two statues gaze down from the eastern wall, each separated by a fluted marble column.  One is a robed figure whose head is hidden in the folds of her robes with feathered wings folded at her sides, while the other is a depiction of pure madness, her hair flowing wildly about her crazed face.  Arcing patterns of moonstone and silver wind their way across the smooth white floor, interwoven with one another in a tranquil dance in the center, and a more frenzied fashion toward the edges.

title: [Cleric Guild, Liabo Hall]
description: Large niches house statues of nearly every Arkati, each carved from pure white marble.  Prayer mats are set beneath each cyclopean statue's gaze, and banners flutter softly along the walls between the niches.  Candles flickering within each niche cast the surroundings in a soft glow, the intimate ambiance enhanced further by the subtle scent of lilacs and roses.

title: [Liabo Hall, Chamber of Lessons]
description: Banners of vivid crimson silk span the gaps between the pristine, fluted white columns, and the hall ends abruptly in small, round chamber.  A small, flawless altar rises from the unadorned floor, its base wrought with bold silver knotwork.  Behind the altar is a cyclopean statue of a heavily-muscled man, his fluid stance a masterful depiction of his competence in combat.

title: [Cleric Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Wing]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Cleric Guild, Closet]
description: This narrow room is thoroughly unremarkable.  Its wooden plank floor is heavily worn, though immaculately swept.  A shallow supplies closet stands near the door, while a large dust bin occupies the far end of the room.

title: [Cleric Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Wing]
description: A slight chill touches the air of this long, grey stone hallway, its austerity a sharp contrast to the opulent woods of the hall to the south.  Stout columns support the barrel-vaulted ceiling; on each is affixed a torch mounted in wrought iron, their flickering light and dusky soot mingled on the pale stone overhead.  No tapestry or ornament relieves the starkness of the stone blocks, pierced occasionally by a door on either side.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Workshop]
description: In this amply sized workroom are mingled the chill of stone and the faint but acrid odors of sulfurous potions.  The unadorned walls transition smoothly into a perfect dome, pierced by a large crystalline skylight.  Directly beneath the skylight stands a black basalt workbench, on which rests an array of instruments and artifacts needed by an alchemist.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Workshop]
description: In this amply sized workroom are mingled the chill of stone and the faint but acrid odors of sulfurous potions.  The unadorned walls transition smoothly into a perfect dome, pierced by a large crystalline skylight.  Directly beneath the skylight stands a pale grey marble workbench, on which rests an array of instruments and artifacts needed by an alchemist.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Wing]
description: The long, grey stone hallway extends out of sight in either direction.  Long ranks of torches, set on columns supporting the barrel-vaulted ceiling, flicker and smoke erratically.  The only break in the plain-cut stone walls is a pair of doors, one on either side of the hallway.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Wing]
description: The hallway reaches its end here at a small shrine carved into the grey granite of the northern wall and lit by scores of small candles.  A pair of doors on either side of the hallway are the only other relief in the stark stone of the hall, which extends out of sight to the south.

title: [Cleric Guild, Courtyard]
description: A bower of trees looms high overhead, the verdant canopy contrasting sharply with the pale alabaster columns that reach up into their leafy depths.  Carved stone benches rest in between the circle of pillars and are all angled to provide an ample view of the fountain that dominates this courtyard.  At one end of the court sits a large marble building, its wide porch and ornamental carvings standing out in stark relief from the lush backdrop.

title: [Cleric Guild, Foyer]
description: Vaulted ceilings frame this wide gallery, set with skylights of polished glass.  An intricately woven carpet covers the white stone floor, a brilliantly plumed peacock staring up imperiously from the woven silk.  The foyer narrows on either side, bearing torch-lit hallways that lead further into the guild.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Teaching]
description: High vaulted windows line the walls of this large room, letting the light fall in muted tones on the sinuous contours of the teaching hall.  Wide steps hewn from silver-flecked marble provide both walkway and seating, leading down to a sunken dais in the center of the circle.  A thin ornamentally carved podium sits atop the dais, situated so that is easily viewed from anywhere within the circular hall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Lornon Garden]
description: Thick boughs of surrounding trees encroach upon this large garden, giving it an air of perpetual darkness despite the light that filters through the leaves.  Purple nightshade blossoms grace the verdant carpet, edging small meditation platforms that rest in the four corners.  In the center, a series of square markers hewn from rough marble surround a painted bronze sculpture, each small block of stone incised with the symbol of a different Lornon Arkati.

title: [Cleric Guild, Liabo Garden]
description: A wide, mosaic-tiled pool of water holds court in the center of the garden, the gentle babbling from the fountain that rises from its center breaking up the reverent silence that permeates the clearing.  A circle of wide marble columns rings the expanse, each one holding aloft the stone likeness of a Liabo Arkati.  Viridian leaves frame pale white moonflowers that edge the pool, mimicking the color of the plush, pristine white prayer mats that are carefully placed around the grounds.

title: [Cleric Guild, Neutrality Garden]
description: This small garden is a study in contrasts, one side a blooming riot of color, the other an austerely pale space.  In the midst of the artfully untamed foliage is a statue of Zelia, her wild-eyed presence perfectly at home in the chaos.  Bordered by pale green ferns tipped with white, the other side of the garden bears the steady presence of Gosaena, her gaze impassive, as she surveys the clearing.  A tiled path cuts directly in between the two, leading to a column-flanked arch.

title: [Cleric Guild, Spirit Garden]
description: Despite being smaller than the other gardens, this tiny clearing holds a reverence all its own.  A fountain bearing a tall obelisk sits in the center, water roaming down its sides musically.  Soft mats for meditation have been placed carefully around the grounds, each one embroidered in various symbols of the spirits.

title: [Cleric Guild, Northwest Hall]
description: Brass fixtures line the walls, each bearing a dimly lit torch that illuminates the path down this narrow hall.  A wide square doorway is set in the center of one wall, its massive modwir doors protecting the space beyond.

title: [Cleric Guild, Library]
description: Large arched windows cover the entire expanse of the far wall, shrouded in curtains of heavy linen, dimming the room.  Plain stone tables have been placed at regular intervals across the tiled stone floor, each bearing a cylindrical glass lamp that casts ample light over the workspace.  Either side of the room bears floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, each holding dusty tomes and well-worn scrolls.  Despite the guild members that study here, the library retains an air of reverent silence.

title: [Cleric Guild, Northeast Hall]
description: A detailed fresco stretches the length of this hall, detailing a view of the Shining City.  Each carefully depicted locale is separated by a dimly lit torch set in a brass sconce.  A plush narrow runner embroidered in touches of gold, lines the marbled floor, providing a soft footfall for travelers within the guild.

title: [Cleric Guild, Chambers]
description: A pair of stained glass windows illuminates the small chamber with motes of soft color, paler tones of the peacock-crested banner that stretches in between them.  A desk crafted from thick slabs of midnight-hued marble sits imposingly in the center, its surface orderly and pristine.  Censers of polished bronze hang from tall stands at either side of the room, filling the small chamber with an earthy fragrance.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hallway]
description: Polished marble walls enclose this small room and gleam in the torchlight that filters in from either hallway.  The area is devoid of ornamentation, serving only as a passageway to other areas of the guild.

title: [Training Annex, Courtyard]
description: A fountain flows into a large marble basin in the center of this airy courtyard, dimming the sounds of nearby training with its musical cascade.  Tall stands have been integrated into each wide flower bed, bearing a hanging lantern that serves to cast a gentle light over the tree-shaded grounds.

title: [Training Annex, Masters' Court]
description: A steady hum resonates through the torch-lit avenue of columns, fed by the murmurs of students and masters as they talk along the open-air walk.  Glimpses of the gardens beyond can be seen from within the gallery, echoes of the lush foliage that lines the street and breaks up the paleness of stone.  At either side of the walkway, a path branches off leading to specialized training areas.

title: [Training Annex, Western Path]
description: Soft crunching sounds fill the air as various guild members make their way to the long stone hall that houses the workrooms.  The length of the hall has been set with five doors, each one bearing a different symbol, and a vine-covered arch.

title: [Training Annex, Iris Workroom]
description: Lit from above by a stained glass skylight, the room is clearly utilitarian in nature.  The only decor in the sparse marble room is the skylight itself, the colored glass patterned in the form of an iris.  A plain stone workbench takes up most of the space, an amber glass alembic sitting upon its pitted surface.

title: [Training Annex, Lily Workroom]
description: Small pillars of matte alabaster support a domed ceiling of thick glass that casts thin rays of light over each surface.  A crucible of porcelain sits in one corner, its inside pitted and stained with use.  A small workbench of similarly hued stone dominates the center of the workroom, its worn surface faintly etched in a pattern of graceful lilies.

title: [Training Annex, Ivy Workroom]
description: Arched windows are set into the far wall, allowing the pale fingers of light to brush each contour of the workroom.  A transparent glass alembic sits on a small granite workbench that is in one corner, the glass glinting in the light.  An unusual lattice frames the doorway, its loose key pattern allowing the slender tendrils of ivy to wind up its length.

title: [Training Annex, Orchid Workroom]
description: Muted light streams in from the large windows set into one wall, illuminating the intricate pattern etched into the stone walls.  The long graceful stems of orchids have been painstakingly carved into the soft marble, each delicate blossom rendered in striking detail.  A marble workbench sits directly in front of the windows, its surface scratched from use and bearing an amethyst glass alembic.  A granite crucible sits within reach of the workbench, the dark stone striking against all of the pale marble.

title: [Training Annex, Modwir Workroom]
description: A large striking modwir tree spreads across one wall, each leaf actually a small window of stained glass that allows a soft glow to settle over the room.  The light tinges the porcelain crucible a pale green, the color darker in the many pits and chips in the well-used vessel.  A glass alembic rests on a sturdy wooden workbench that takes up most of the workroom, the color complementing the grain of the wood.

title: [Training Annex, Alchemical Shop]
description: Graceful pillars enclose this small room, each bearing a long column of shelves between them.  Myriad vials, jars, and canisters line every available inch of shelf space, giving the room a cluttered look despite the obvious care in arrangement.  An elegant marble worktable rests against the far wall, its gleaming surface graced with carefully arranged mortar and pestle sets, each one of them clean and ready for use.

title: [Training Annex, Eastern Path]
description: Crushed stone forms this plain path that cuts between the curtained training galleries, ending at a single gallery at the end of the walkway.  Tall, smooth pillars support thin curtains of various colors, giving a semblance of privacy to the otherwise open space.  To one side sit rooms swathed in green and white, while the other side boasts curtains of black and blue.  The room at the end is graced with twists of brilliant red silk, the layout paying homage to Lumnis' spheres of knowledge.

title: [Training Annex, Cauldron Room]
description: Swathed in curtains of verdant green, this gallery bears no ceiling, leaving it constantly open to the light.  A large iron cauldron dominates the center of the gallery, suspended over a firepit by a heavy trammel.  A bronze rack is pushed against the curtained pillars, bearing various implements needed for training.

title: [Training Annex, Equipment Room]
description: Large niches line the walls of this pristine marble room, each small alcove bearing numerous bronze hooks.  Cleaning implements hang from the hooks, all of them meticulously labeled and clean despite their purpose.  A large granite table dominates the center of the room with its top surface covered in cauldrons of various sizes and makes.  Along the lower shelf of the table rows of carefully placed alembics sit waiting for use.

title: [Foyer]
description: Expansive, rigidly perpendicular, and made of creamy white limestone, the entryway hints at quiet meditation and cool contemplation farther to the interior.  A double staircase, its steps centered between the three arches leading to the rest of the building, joins to itself in a landing rimmed with a golden baluster to the front.  Two wide, carved doors of white pine leading to the outside have been limned with golden paint to pick out the details.

title: [Western Corridor]
description: Limestone walls and columns support a barrel-vaulted roof of fossil-encrusted blocks.  Between the columns, glass-paned large windows line the western walls and provide a view of the well-manicured grounds, while woven reed prayer mats placed before marble-framed alcoves offer quiet places for contemplation.

title: [Western Corridor]
description: Glass-paned large windows stand between limestone pillars pockmarked with the images of past sealife.  Painted designs depict the image of well-tended vineyards, each artfully rendered to appear as if they are encroaching on the corridor, some even offer glimpses of globes of perfect near-ripe fruit under serrated leaves.   Tiles set into the ground amid the cobblestones are painted with grape clusters along the western wall, while opposite are woven reed prayer mats set before marble-framed alcoves.

title: [Western Refectory]
[Western Solarium]
description: Stained glass windows and a matching dome dominate this space.  The blocks of limestone for the floor here have been picked for their imprints of ancient flora, forever entombed in stone.  Each window in the walls depicts a field; one is strewn with wildflowers, another is an orchard with trees bearing fruit.  The dome depicts gentle curves and whorls in myriad shades of blue centered on the portrait of a gentle-looking man with long, curly brown hair.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Alchemical Workroom]
description: Glassless windows stand upon the outside world, the rolling greenery pockmarked with arbors laden with grapevines.  Set upon a cream-hued limestone workbench, a polished bronze crucible rests in circles of moonlight, while a blown glass alembic has been moved into the shadows of the nearby wall.  A dark steel gem lens assembly has been placed along the northern wall so that it can take full advantage of the silvery light that floods in through the surrounding windows.

title: [Alchemical Workroom]
description: Glassless windows stand upon the outside world, the rolling greenery pockmarked with arbors laden with grapevines.  Set upon a cream-hued limestone workbench, a polished bronze crucible rests in circles of moonlight, while a blown glass alembic has been moved into the shadows of the nearby wall.  A dark steel gem lens assembly has been placed along the northern wall so that it can take full advantage of the silvery light that floods in through the surrounding windows.

title: [Eastern Corridor]
description: Marching from the lobby to the end of the hallway, fossil-pocked limestone columns provide a framework for the panoramic windows and barrel-vaulted ceiling.  Marble-framed alcoves, each filled with a statue, rise within the bones of the corridor and have woven reed prayer mats positioned before them, which promotes silent contemplation.

title: [Northern Corridor]
description: Columns of aged limestone sparkle in the sunlight, while window between them provide views of the many grape arbors between the wings of the guild.  Tiles painted with feathers and crescent moons alternate with those of natural limestone on the floor, providing small rings of decoration around a pair of marble-framed alcoves.  Two small marble benches, each set on either side of a door, are topped with wide pillows that provide a quiet place for meditation.

title: [Alchemical Wares]
description: Botanicals, gems, liquids, and sundry animal parts cram the shelves of this tiny room.  Under one shelf is a table for sorting, while a tiny woman is barely visible behind a high counter separating the more expensive items from customers.  One tiny skylight provides some relief from the claustrophobic, crowded feel of the room.

title: [Landing]
description: Only wide enough for two or three people to pass each other uncomfortably, the landing gives a view of the magnificent foyer below.  A few small icons hang on the wall to each side of the door set in the middle of the wall.  Carpeting covers the floor, its plush pile dyed a pale eggshell color.

title: [Eastern Corridor]
description: Small and large cobbles stretch across the ground, their faces smooth and their sounds evenly rounded for a perfect fit.  Large windows of stained glass dominate the northern walls, while the southern ones are filled with marble-framed alcoves.  A line of woven reed prayer mats, each neatly positioned beneath an alcove, marches down the hall in both directions.

title: [Eastern Reflectory]
[Eastern Solarium]
description: Nearly round, the end of the corridor is framed in fountains pouring water into small bowls below.  The bowls drain quickly, creating continuous whirlpools within their embrace.  Above, a stained glass dome depicts a typhoon's might, with water feeding it from an enormous earthen jug held by a scowling, winged man.  Despite the forboding atmosphere, several scholars mill around on the grey marble floor.

title: [Master's Office]
description: Pristine in its simplicity, a golden oak desk sits in the middle of this somewhat spacious office.  To one side, an arched window looks into a large shrine, while the other side is taken up by a bank of files.  Behind the desk, a simple wooden chair and a cat bed are visible.

title: [Northern Corridor]
description: Out of place in the line of limestone columns, a small rectangular area houses a plastered window that completely obstructs the panoramic views that many of the other windows in the corridor have.  Set within the whitewashed anomaly, a simple pine door is fitted with rose-hued hinges and knob.  Upon the opposite wall, a pair of woven mats rest before twin alcoves that are framed in marble.

title: [Storage]
description: Several utilitarian shelving units hold various solutions and implements for cleaning.  One large bin, with brooms leaning against it, is right next to the door and obviously meant for trash.  The only light comes from a small skylight above, and the room is barely large enough to turn around in.

title: [Northern Refectory]
[Northern Solarium]
description: Murals of beautiful white horses fill the walls between the entrances to other rooms.  Above, a stained glass scene depicts an old shaggy-haired man with wings on his back, his feet surrounded by the dark, purplish-grey and green-tinged hues of a storming sea.  Plain white tiles underfoot have been painted with fanciful conch shells of various sizes.

title: [Alchemical Workroom]
description: Glassless windows stand upon the outside world, the rolling greenery pockmarked with arbors laden with grapevines.  Set upon a cream-hued limestone workbench, a polished bronze crucible rests in circles of moonlight, while a blown glass alembic has been moved into the shadows of the nearby wall.  A dark steel gem lens assembly has been placed along the northern wall so that it can take full advantage of the silvery light that floods in through the surrounding windows.

title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Cleric Guild, Library]
description: A narrow pool of ebon water bisects the library, an expansive room made more immense by the high, arched ceiling of dark crystal panes held in place by onyx and alabaster supports carved with symbols of the Arkati.  Tables and chairs cluster around the onyx-lined edges of the pool, and dozens of tall rosewood bookshelves overflowing with books fill the room.  The deep blue carpets are strewn with petals of lily, rose, and jasmine to add bright and fragrant counterpoints to the dark interior.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Sunlight from high windows touches the polished limestone walls, revealing veins of subtle color within them.  Prayer mats on the floor are simple in design, but luxuriously textured.  A small pool is carved into the native stone floor, its waters so still that the merest breath would distort the pool's mirror-bright surface.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Alabaster walls inlaid with bands of chalcedony house a host of bronze statues, each beautifully formed to resemble the deities of Liabo.  A flower-strewn altar, twin pillar candles each as tall as a halfling flanking it, stands at the center of the room.  Silken cushions cover the intricately tiled floor.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: The surroundings of the room have been tinted a soft aquamarine shade, and a large blue glaes-paneled lantern sways softly from above, casting a rippling oceanic light upon the chamber.  Faint stylized images of fish, whales, and other creatures of the deep are engraved on the floor, each encircling an altar of coral.  A statue of a man wielding a trident seems to flow out from the walls, his gaze over the area an unmistakably stern one.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Engraved brass oil lamps shed dim light and do nothing to offset the austerity of grey stone walls and thin reed mats.  Sharp pebbles are strewn across the floor, making kneeling a painful proposition, though perhaps that is the point.  A solitary window provides little distraction and gives a view only of the limitless gulf of the night sky.  The air seems unaccountably chilly.

A solitary window provides little distraction and gives a view only of the limitless expanse of the sky.  The air seems unaccountably chilly.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Effigies of the Lords and Ladies of Lornon tower above you, the foreshortening of their features giving their expressions an indefinable arrogance as they gaze down at those who come to worship.  The low stone altar at one end of the circular chamber and any offerings upon it look insignificant, and despite its bulk the massive slab seems to crouch abjectly at the feet of the nearest colossus.  It is cold enough to fog your breath.

title: [Empath Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Annex]
description: Twin sconces are set opposite one another on the north and south walls here, their dim flames casting long shadows down the hallway in both directions.  The floor is composed of carefully chiseled granite blocks, each one set against the next at a slight angle, and the walls are polished marble blocks from floor to ceiling.

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Lobby]
description: Sconces line the walls of the rectangular, granite-floored room, each set upon a narrow marble column that reaches up and supports a high ceiling.  A large torn banner is draped down one wall and set behind a simple black marble altar placed in the center of the room.  Five narrow archways, draped with dark red velvet curtains, lead off from the chamber into adjacent rooms.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Storage]
description: The circular chamber is built of dark granite with the exception of white marble used to outline the ribbing of a vaulted ceiling.  The room is mainly bare with only a few stacked crates flanked on one side by a large dust bin and on the other by a wooden footlocker.  An archway, outlined with the same marble as the ceiling, leads off into another room.

title: [Cleric Guild, Store Room]
description: Dark and small, the room is circular and built of granite, with a vaulted ceiling outlined with gleaming white marble.  A few torches placed in sconces throughout the room provide a paltry amount of illumination, their light reflected by jars and containers set upon several shelves.  Against one wall stands a worktable upon which several items rest.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy West]
description: A dark wood workbench rests in the center of the polished granite room.  Three beams of moonlight offer illumination to the chamber, coming from three narrow windows set halfway up one of the walls.  A large dead spider lies in the corner of the room, its legs curled up and over its body, just beneath a niche set into the wall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Southwest]
description: The floor and walls of the chamber are constructed of rough hewn granite.  A single round window is set high into one wall, and through it a solemn ray of moonlight pours through and onto a dark wood workbench.  An altar is set atop a granite slab against the wall beneath the window.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy South]
description: Three beams of moonlight descend from tall narrow windows set into the midpoint of a polished granite wall and illuminate a dark wood workbench placed in the center of the room.  The faint sound of flowing water fills the room from the direction of the windows and is accompanied by the sound of wind tugging on unseen leaves and branches.  A small altar rests in a niche in one corner.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Southeast]
description: Four thick candles surround a niche in the corner of the room and offer the only source of light other than three narrow windows placed halfway up the polished granite walls.  Moonlight streaming through the narrow windows reveals that the floor is carved with a pattern of squares scored from alternating directions.  A dark wood workbench sits in the center of the room.  From outside, the calls of water fowl accompany the slow languid sounds of a great flowing river.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy East]
description: Three narrow windows, placed halfway up the wall, provide the illumination for the polished granite-floored and walled room via three streams of moonlight.  A small niche in the corner is both the setting for a small altar and also the only decoration other than a dark wood workbench and assorted alchemic instruments.  The liquid sounds of a slow moving river carry in from outside through the windows, accompanied by a slight breeze rich with the aroma of wet earth and sweet smelling blossoms.

The liquid sounds of a slow moving river carry in from outside through the windows, accompanied by a slight breeze rich with the aroma of wet earth and sweet smelling blossoms.

title: [Cleric Guild, Aviary]
description: Gilded mesh encloses a piece of the sky, and you are surrounded by birdsong. Parrots flash their brilliant colors amidst the branches of potted trees, the birds' cries a raucous counterpoint to the trilling of plainer, but more eloquent larks.  The aviary's wire walls permit smaller birds to come and go, but even the fenvaoks seem content with their eyrie above the guild.

Gilded mesh encloses a piece of the night sky, and you are lulled by soporific birdsong.  Owls continue their low-pitched inquiry of the nightingales who sing amidst the branches of the potted trees, but the raucous parrots and fenvaoks are asleep.  The moons seem nearer and worldly matters much more distant from this eyrie.

title: [Woodlands, Blackberry Patch]
description: The trail bends from the north to the west through a sunny clearing that breaks the deep woods.  Tangles of blackberry bushes grow around the trunks of the scattered trees, their brambles extending into the small paths that lead to homes in the underbrush.  A flock of blackbirds have stopped to rest in the branches of a nearby oak, filling the clearing with their cries.
