title: [Haunted Pass, Dense Trees]
description: The path is choked with vegetation, offering little scenery other than the greenness surrounding the area.  A rotting tree trunk lies on its side just to the west and is covered in all sorts of fungi.  Through the foliage, a phantasmal grove of trees clumps together deep in the woods.

The path is choked with vegetation, offering little scenery other than the greenness surrounding the area.  A rotting tree trunk lies on its side just to the west and is covered in all sorts of fungi.  Through the foliage, a phantasmal forest of trees waver deep in the woods.

title: [Haunted Pass, Dense Trees]
description: Thick woods block most the view here, only allowing travel along the path heading northeast.  The soil is quite wet and covered with all sorts of foliage and wildlife.  A putrid odor wafts in from the path, which leads back out into the outer swamp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Broken limbs lie in scattered heaps across the soggy ground, their ends clawed and chewed upon by some unseen animal.  A narrow tree-enshrouded path leads further into a thick wooded pass, away from the swamp.  Sprouting out of their rotting expanses are tubes of wild mushrooms with cup-shaped heads and blue-green blades of wildrye.  A thin trail of stones winds its way through the slogging mud and provides a solid means of egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay.  Drooping willow trees, short and stunted, drape across the path and dangle their spear-shaped leaves upon the spongy ground.  A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky.  Thick roots, resembling the legs of an enormous spider, rise out of the soft, muddy ground and create arches that encircle the smooth barked monstrosity.  High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, west, northwest
Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Feywrot Mire, Western Walkway]
description: Ominous creaks from the cedar planks below are heard with every footfall.  The black water below is eerily still, without so much as a ripple disturbing its obsidian-like smoothness.  The walkway continues westward, but a broken handrail and bootprints on a hillock just beneath show where less prudent souls have stepped off to venture through the southern swamp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid stream along the eastern border.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves.  Ominous shadows trail across the spongy, softness of the landscape where enormous muddy bubbles rise and burst as underground gases escape from the bosom of the earth.  In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Splintered bark and broken limbs litter the viscous ground around a stunted black willow tree.  Discolored leaves precariously cling to branches, though a greater number lie scatted about the mud.  Upturned tufts of wildrye grass display their intricate root systems to the sky along edge of the watercourse, their blue-green blades barely touching the scum-covered liquid.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright and verdant in the dark landscape, a single juniper tree rises out of the murky bleakness of the swamp and stretches upward towards the grey sky.  Concentric bands of alternating stone and brown grass surround the twisted body of the towering, berry-laden beauty and manage to stave off the filth of the nearby sludge-like mud.  Despite the calm of the area, an invasive humidity makes the air weighed with dampness and an underlying scent of stench clogs the senses.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick tangles of thorn-heavy brambles lie in knotted clusters along the western border of the pathway that bisects the swamp.  Several puddles of stagnant water pockmark the thick carpet of dusky brown moss that spreads across the uneven ground.  A ring of half-rotted trees leans against each other, their splintered sides and barkless faces heavy with black mold and sludge.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Narrowing to an ultra thin track of solid ground, the pathway meanders through wide pools of stagnant water.  Duckweed and bladderwort create a verdant border to each of ovoid bodies and rainbow mold stretches across the stale surfaces.  Clouds of gnats thicken the air, their tiny bodies clinging to everything in their path.

title: [The Pious Panoply]
description: A trio of gold and bronze braziers shaped like crowns are set in a triangular formation on the floor of the tent.  The pure white canvas awning overhead is stitched with tiny silver runes.  Prayer mats and a marble altar sit at the far end of the tent.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Western Walkway]
description: The raised cedar walkway ends abruptly on three sides, each leading straight down into the muck.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Western Walkway]
description: Thick cedar planks have been fastened horizontally on raised supports, granting reasonably safe egress above the dark black water.  Bulging hillocks of vegetation and algal mats give the illusion of solid ground in some spots below.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: None of the ground here is dry, and wooden slats have been strewn across it in a token attempt to keep people from sinking knee deep in the muck.  To the east is a muddy path leading inland and to the west is a raised plank walkway.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The ground is littered with a thick layer of crisp brown leaves that crunch underfoot.  Downslope to the west, pools of murky water lie stagnant on the ground.  A perpetual, misty fog hangs in the air, blocking even an occasional glimspe of the starry black skies.

The ground is littered with a thick layer of crisp brown leaves that crunch underfoot.  Downslope to the west, pools of murky water lie stagnant on the ground.  A perpetual, misty fog hangs in the air, resisting the attempt of the sun's rays to burn it off.

title: [Wooden Works]
description: Suspended from the ceiling are two dimly lit candles which cast hardly enough light over the area.  A large wooden weapon stand lines the side of the wagon, barely leaving room to walk.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: Although an attempt at creating a solid walkway across the shore is apparent in the wooden slats haphazardly arranged in one of the muddier areas, the project was obviously abandoned where the limestone base appears to take over the sludge.  Devoid of a front wall and door, a small shack appears ready to fall at any moment, saved only by the massive bald cypress that the rear wall leans against.

title: [Abandoned Shack]
description: Three walls and a roof make up the excuse for a shack that leans against a large bald cypress tree with branches and roots heavily encroaching on the structure.  It appears as though something is slowly eating away at the walls, and the roof is in such disrepair that it has fallen in on itself.  There is no sign of any furniture.  Given its current state, the building is likely not very old, and it is also likely not to last too many more years into the future.

title: [Wasp Your Back]
description: Drab, mud-patched walls of various earthy colors, reinforced with woven reeds and grass, support a massive cracked wood shelf along the circumference of the misshapen structure.  Across from the entrance, a section of the hardened mud floor slopes sharply upward to a platform overhead.

title: [Wrought From Rot]
description: Heat and humidity saturate the air, and a single torch is mounted on a long length of rattan to better illuminate the interior of the tree.  Crooked wooden stands are nonchalantly placed against walls covered in moss and spiderwebs.  The floor is a soft, squishy combination of trampled swamp grasses and mud.

title: [Wrought From Rot, Ledge]
description: Humidity soaks you in a bath of sticky air at the top of the hollowed out cypress.  Mold grows in dense clusters on the ceiling and wars silently with a moss-covered wall for territory in the corners.  The scent of mildew is protrusive.

Humidity saturates the air at the top of the hollowed out cypress and mold grows in dense clusters on the ceiling, warring silently with a moss-covered wall for territory in the corners.  The scent of mildew is protrusive.

title: [Wrought From Rot, Nest]
description: Woven from rotten reeds and vines, then packed with leaves and grime, a massive nest is established between the thick, forked branches of the tree's largest bough.  Clustered branches and rotting leaves form a barrier around the nest, obstructing the view of both the ground and sky.  A faint, luminescent mold grows in spidery trails along the splitting bark of the bough and base of the nest, offering minimal visibility.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: Creating a narrow maze through this stretch of swamp, a dense stand of pond cypress trees dominates both the land and water areas.  Low-lying grasses cling to the available shore, their growth stunted by the overhead moss-hung branches that create a living ceiling.  Taking cover in the lack of light, dark shadows flit to-and-fro, noiseless and ephemeral in their flight.

Creating a narrow maze through this stretch of swamp, a dense stand of pond cypress trees dominates both the land and water areas.  Low-lying grasses cling to the available shore, their growth stunted by the overhead moss-hung branches that create a living ceiling.  Taking cover in the lack of light, dark shadows flit to-and-fro, noiseless and ephemeral in their flight as they dance around a cracked gravestone.

title: [After Thoughts, Amidships]
description: Moonlight trickles in from outside to provide a small measure of visibility.  A corroded copper ladder is revealed, recessed in the lone interior wall.  Beside the ladder, a deteriorated black ash door leads towards the bow.  The exterior walls are badly weathered, and the copper-framed windows set within them have not held glass in ages.  Flexing precariously underfoot, a wooden deck creaks and groans with each step.

Sunlight pours in through five large glassless, copper-framed windows set within the boat's badly weathered exterior walls.  A corroded copper ladder is recessed in the lone interior wall, leading up.  Beside the ladder, a deteriorated black ash door leads towards the bow.  The wooden deck creaks and flexes precariously underfoot.

title: [After Thoughts, Mess Hall]
description: Encircling a multitude of dilapidated chairs, mangled copper handrails hang futilely from a glassless-windowed circumference of wooden plank walls.  Dominating the center of the hall, a warped three-legged table intermittently teeters on the soft, rotted wood deck.  A pitted copper canopy overhead blocks out most of the sky.

title: [After Thoughts, Pilot Deck]
description: A section of the floor has fallen away, forming a ramp leading down to the main deck.  The hammered copper roof of the cabin is pitted and riddled with holes, supported by four massive pillars of weathered black ash.  The ship's wheel is almost nonexistant, just a remnant hub with fragments of what used to be the spokes

The hammered copper roof of the cabin is pitted and riddled with holes, supported by four massive pillars of weathered black ash.  The ship's wheel is almost nonexistant, just a remnant hub with fragments of what used to be the spokes.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: An algal mat covers the stretch of water just next to the shore, and further out, the water moves quickly, shifting and swirling, as the barely-there current carries it in a southwesterly direction.  Although clusters of cypress are visible further north, few trees are present here, the foliage instead dominated by wild brush.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: There is no apparent way forward through the fern shrouded trees here.  Clusters of swamp milkweed threaten to further choke the waterway.  Floating entanglements of moss carry debris and detritus with them as they journey northward from a raised hummock.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A musty smell of decaying plant life hangs heavily in the still air.  Slick, lichen-covered rocks make for hazardous travel along the main north to south route.  Tall, greyish-white trees block out much of the sky, and long-abandoned nests droop precariously from the unions of bare branches with the bark-stripped trunks.

title: [Tug-of-War, Witchwood Knoll]
description: Rows of witchwood benches are clustered atop a gently sloping knoll, offering a clear view of a span of trenched swampland below.  Bits and pieces of rope and clothing litter the area, each stained with blood, mud, and a multitude of unrecognized substances.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A mixture of ferns and wisteria vines make travel difficult for both the tallest and the shortest of those passing by.  The moist ground is home to a prolific and nearly impenetrable stand of ferns, some of the fronds reaching four feet at their apex.  Hanging from above, the hardy wisteria clamber upward, with their thick stems holding fast to every available trunk.  The pendulous racemes drape down across the pathways like living green curtains.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A proliferation of fiddlehead ferns flourishes here, each nestled snuggly against its neighbor.  Near the pathway most are small, their curling tops barely reaching ankle height of those making their way through the growth.  To each side, ferns of greater maturity are fully unfurled, reaching heights that would tower above the average gnome.

A proliferation of fiddlehead ferns flourishes here, each nestled snugly against its neighbor.  Near the pathway most are small, their curling tops barely reaching ankle height of those making their way through the growth.  To each side, ferns of greater maturity are fully unfurled, reaching heights that would tower above the average gnome.

title: [Tug-of-War, Aspen Knoll]
description: Rows of aspen benches are clustered atop a gently sloping knoll, providing a clear view of a span of trenched swampland below.  Bits and pieces of rope and clothing litter the area, each stained with blood, mud, and a multitude of unrecognized substances.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: A large copper still is perched upon a stand of iron grating near a cleared and rock-lined fire circle.  Wooden buckets filled with rainwater have capped off spigots near their bases and rest on three flat, low-cut stumps nearby.  Coils of hammered copper tubing encircle the still's base and a stack of firewood awaits the next brewing.  Beyond the apparatus is a seedy-looking tavern, and to the east is an enormous ancient banyan.

A large copper still is perched upon a stand of iron grating near a cleared and rock-lined fire circle.  Wooden buckets filled with rainwater have capped off spigots near their bases and rest on three flat, low-cut stumps nearby.  Coils of hammered copper tubing encircle the still's base and a stack of firewood awaits the next brewing.  Beyond the apparatus is a seedy-looking tavern, and to the east is a diseased banyan.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Under the Banyan]
description: Diffuse starlight filters down through the canopy overhead, dappling the grassy hillock at its base in shadows.  An open space around the foot of the tree is festooned with flags and rimmed with blazing torches.  Beyond the ring, the ground slopes away and down, bisected by paths cut through the ground-cover and into the moist earth.  Here and there the roots of the looming banyan force the trails to twist sharply, their protrusions forming inescapable obstacles of skyward-reaching wood.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Black Banyan, Trunk]
description: The airy, open chamber is multi-leveled, arising organically out of a wind-carved pocket within the monumental trunk of the tree.  A similar pocket leads out from the room, and several of the heavy boughs are wide enough to act as paths in their own rights.  A single burning lantern hangs from the ceiling, illuminating a staircase leading further up into the canopy and a spiraling ramp leading downwards towards the base of the tree.

title: [Black Banyan, Westerly Limb]
description: A mass of woven ropes, akin to a loose net, forms a protective tunnel around the heavy bough.  Openings in the mesh provide porthole views beyond the edge of the tree and down the western slope of the hill it sits upon.  A bit of graffito scratched is scratched into the banyan's bark, within easy reading distance of a natural arch leading into the interior of the tree itself.

title: [Black Banyan, Westerly Limb]
description: The oversized limb separates from the smaller branches around it, extending outwards and on its own past the bulk of the banyan's canopy.  Without other offshoots to anchor to, the walls of rope netting end, replaced by rough-hewn railings of moldering wood.  A detritus of fallen leaves coats the flat walking surface in a slick of vegetal decay.

title: [Canvas Closet]
description: Two of the rough wooden walls of the shack lean slightly inward, braced to keep from collapsing entirely by a system of improvised levers and joists.  The canvas ceiling overhead dips downwards in the middle, burdened by what appears to be a sloshing liquid weight.  Set out of range of any potential drips are two roughly hewn crates.  A skewed opening leads out to the front of the shop and a canvas curtain leads out the back.

title: [Canvas Closet, Holler]
description: A bare space has been cleared out of the surrounding bramble and branch, though around the edges the vegetation has already grown back in threatening tangles and bursts of spikes.  One side of the small clearing backs up against the exterior of a temporary shack, the interior of which is accessible through a canvas curtain.

title: [Black Banyan, Westerly Limb]
description: The end of the limb, and the end of the line, is marked with a rough-hewn railing.  It's shape recalls a finer and foreign balcony, though its materials are base and local.  A single lit lantern hangs over the edge, illuminating a small, fractional circle of the vast blackness of open space that surrounds the tree.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern]
[Rumrunners' Tavern, Grand Foyer]
description: Despite a hard-packed dirt floor and a heavy haze of tobacco smoke hanging in the air, this tavern sports a cheery decor.  Brightly painted posts hold up a thatched grass roof and checkered cloths and candles decorate several tables tucked beneath the eaves.  A well-stocked bar is flanked with an assortment of barstools.

Despite a hard-packed dirt floor and a heavy haze of tobacco smoke hanging in the air, this tavern sports a cheery decor.  Brightly painted posts hold up a splintered timber roof and checkered cloths and candles decorate several tables tucked beneath the eaves.  Dim lighting emits from beyond the far side of the room.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, out

title: [Bilkie's Emporium]
description: The interior of the shack is as gaudily cheerful and brightly colored as the exterior.  The walls are studded with glittering tourmalines and glimaerstones, and slick, shiny bits of shells dangle from long colored ribbons from the corrugated tin roof.  A few chinks in the facade of conspicuous grandeur can be spied here and there.  Slender needles of light seep inside from narrow cracks between the lacquered wall planks, and several spatterings of tiny rust spots dot the roof.

title: [Bilkie's Wheel of Whatever]
description: Striped with metal and gem inlays, the inner sanctum of the shop is even more ostentatious than the outside.  Swirling patterns of jaspers and agates are nearly lost in the glitter of faceted stones caught in the bright lantern light.  Some shaggy furred cushions in a jarring mix of styles and colors are scattered about the wagon, divided by a plum-hued runner that leads from the entry to the prize wheel itself.  A gleaming platinum stand edged in alternating bands of colored enamel inlay displays a pair of ornate silver boxes to one side of the wheel, and a gem-encrusted stone pedestal stands on the other.

title: [Under the Big Top]
description: Bright pink canvas walls soar high overhead, and rows of pink-dyed reed mats form walkways around the perimeter.  An elevated platform in the center of the room is filled with painted wooden cutouts of people and animals placed in a formation resembling a dance.  A pair of tall poles with a thick rope strung between them forms a narrow canopy over the top of the stage, each pole topped with a small platform from which a rope ladder hangs to the ground.  Just inside the flap, a simple wooden cart houses an assortment of goods for sale.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The decayed skeleton of a large cat rests half in and half out of a small brackish pool beside the main path.  Its jaw is frozen in a silent scream, and bits of leathered skin cling tenuously to its bones.  An odd growth of fungi clutters the surrounding area.

The decayed skeleton of a large canine rests half in and half out of a small brackish pool beside the main path.  Its jaw is frozen in a silent scream, and bits of leathered skin cling tenuously to its bones.  An odd growth of fungi clutters the surrounding area.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Bent and trampled grasses mix with fallen pine needles carpeting the conspicuous path.  A large black gum towers nearby, its foliage aflame with yellow and scarlet highlights.  The lower limbs have deteriorated, leaving vacant dens for squirrels, racoons, or other arboreal dwellers.

title: [The Crossing]
description: Tall swamp grasses have been trampled flat, creating a small open field.  To either side of the clearing are long aisles separated by bales of hay, each one ending with a large painted target.  Several logs have been placed about the area, their surfaces cut with an indentation perfect for sitting.  A winding dirt path leads away from the gathering space, back towards the main festival area.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: A neatly tended garden, oddly out of place in the otherwise marshy environment, flourishes within a tall, wire-fenced area.  Bright ribbons decorate the fence posts and wind through the wire enclosure.  A leaf-stuffed scarecrow, draped in a pink floral dress, sports a oversized lady's hat with furling ribbons dancing in the lightest breeze.

A neatly tended garden, oddly out of place in the otherwise marshy environment, flourishes within a tall, wire-fenced area.  Bright ribbons decorate the fence posts and wind through the wire enclosure.  A leaf-stuffed scarecrow, draped in a pink floral dress, sports an oversized lady's hat with furling ribbons dancing in the lightest breeze.  Protruding through a blanket of peat moss are some pallid grey fungi.

title: [Divine Delights]
description: Floating lightly through the air, the aromas of vanilla bean and melted chocolate are quite evident inside the small wagon.  Soft amber silk brightens the walls, and the wooden floor bears an intricate design of glazed cobalt-patterned tiles.  The space is kept tidy and arranged simply, with spatial emphasis placed on a large golden ivory marble counter at the back.  Flanking the curtained entrance is a broad silk-lined shelf and a two-tiered oak stand.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: An outdoor forge adds unwelcomed heat to the already oppressive humidity.  A rack of iron tools sits between two black gum trees, and some long-handled bellows hang suspended beside the stone forge.  Rounded wooden casks are topped off with water, and a small shed rests beneath the boughs of the trees.

title: [To the Hilt, Entrance]
description: The entrance, poised in one corner of the wagon, opens up into a view of the entire wagon.  Taking up most of the space in the wagon's entrance are two wooden mannequins locked in battle.  The carved wooden human ranger is frozen with his short sword outstretched just above the swamp goblin's head.  Distinct paths lead to the other three corners of the wagon, and a silver-framed blue wooden door stands against the wall immediately adjacent to the entrance, leading to a partitioned space.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [To the Hilt, Back Room]
description: This sparsely furnished section of the wagon has been partitioned off by a darkly varnished panelled wall interrupted only by a silver-framed blue wooden door.  A simple wooden bench rests against the wall underneath the three tall, rectangular windows beside a small round wooden table.  The shape of the windows causes long, blocky shadows to be cast across the floor, punctuated by stripes of pale moonlight.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Ale Room]
description: Brightly painted wooden posts and multicolored checkered tablecloths help to diminish the murky darkness created by the thick cloud of tobacco smoke hanging in the air.  Several tables are pushed in the corners beneath the eaves of the thatched grass roof, and grimy metal signs are nailed to each wall.  A trio of wax-covered empty bottles rest on the sill of the open window, each glass holding a half-melted candle.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Spittoon]
description: The hard-packed dirt floor around the table is marked with dozens of sets of overlapping footprints, and a slight haze of tobacco smoke lingers in the air.  Wooden posts suspend colorful glass lanterns and hold up a thatched grass roof, beneath which a family of birds nests.  An overflowing tarnished brass spittoon leans precariously against one wall, threatening to overturn.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Gator Haze]
description: A thin haze of tobacco smoke hangs in the air, dispersed slightly by the occasional cool night breeze coming through an open window.  The once bright paint on the wooden posts holding up the thatched grass roof is chipping and faded, carved over with hundreds of names and initials.  A similarly carved rickety cabinet stands in one corner of the room, its shelves overflowing with empty bottles of spirits.

A thin haze of tobacco smoke hangs in the air, dispersed slightly by the occasional warm breeze coming through an open window.  The once bright paint on the wooden posts holding up the thatched grass roof is chipping and faded, carved over with hundreds of names and initials.  A similarly carved rickety cabinet stands in one corner of the room, its shelves overflowing with empty bottles of spirits.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Long tendrils of grey-green moss drape gracefully from the overhead branches of an ancient cedar.  An artistic touch has been rendered with the twisting of red silk ribbons into the tendrils, like a grey-haired matriarch with beribboned braids.  Beneath the living curtain, chiseled-stone statues stand sentinel at the corners of a raised wooden platform.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Cedar Clearing]
description: Draped with soft blankets of moss that flutter to-and-fro of their own accord, spindly cedar trees ring the area.  Their branches stretch out overhead, creating a brittle web across the dark sky.  In the center of the clearing, the ground is slightly lumpy, though firmly packed, and riddled with a light dusting of ashes.  Several blackened cedar stumps jut out of the ground in front of a particurlarly wide arc of grey-green moss.

In the center of the clearing, the ground is slightly lumpy, though firmly packed, and riddled with a light dusting of ashes.  Several blackened cedar stumps jut out of the ground in front of a particurlarly wide arc of grey-green moss.

title: [Dollhouse, Entry]
description: The varnished mahogany walls enclosing the area are accentuated by the elegant ebonwood chairs set about the wagon.  A single chandelier casts illumination upon the center, highlighting the soft lamb's wool area rug occupying the floor.  A claw-footed table of mahogany rests on the rug, a tall-backed upholstered chair on either side.

title: [Picked Apart]
description: The faint odors of alcohol and decay linger in this ramshackle space. The walls are covered with mounted heads and antlers, and on one counter an antlered rabbit rears on its hind legs.  Next to the odd rabbit is a small crate. A battered toolbox is tucked under the counter.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Cedar Grove]
description: Cedar trees spread all around, their ancient, cracked limbs sticking out at every angle imaginable.  Thin rivulets of a black, sticky substance wind through the grove in a snake-like path, slithering out from somewhere below a small wooden shack.  The thin stream moves toward the clearing to the south, but at its edge, it veers off into a more dense area of cedar before disappearing from sight.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Continuations of the dwarf cypress grove to the north stretch along the cracked mud pathways.  Two large trees grow beside a small painted structure, with cotton clotheslines strung taut between their branches.  Two pair of overalls, an oversized red-checkered frock, and some frilly undergarments flap in the moonlight, as if dancing to silent music with every passing breeze.

Continuations of the dwarf cypress grove to the north stretch along the cracked mud pathways.  Two large trees grow beside a small painted structure, with cotton clotheslines strung taut between their branches.  Two pair of overalls, an oversized red-checkered frock, and some frilly undergarments flap in the sunlight, as if dancing to silent music with every passing breeze.

title: [Gurm's, A Dance with Flagons]
description: Brightly dyed strips of canvas comprise the walls of the conjoined tents.  Woven together and oiled against the elements, the sharp tang of their sealant is fresh and strong in the air.  A circular oak display rings the tentpole, littered with flagons crafted from wood and metal.

title: [Dollhouse, Display Room]
description: Varnished, glistening mahogany walls enclose the area in the warm reddish-brown hue of the wood's natural stain, which is easily illuminated by the flickering sconces dotting them here and there.  Two long shelves line the eastern wall, each one perfectly sanded and sealed in heavy lacquer.  A tall chair rests in the corner with an upholstered footrest positioned before it, and on the opposite end, a large oak chest overflows with a variety of unkempt male dolls.

title: [Dollhouse, Visions]
description: The central focus of the room is a large silver-backed mirror held aloft by two gnome-sized dolls at the far rear end of the wagon.  Two intricately carved wardrobes take up the walls, one on each side, and their doors are flung open wide to allow any patrons to peruse the wares stored within.  You also see an oak carved wardrobe.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Small shrubs of dwarven cypress have been trimmed back to demarcate an obstacle-free line of travel.  Wooden planters with fresh coats of blue and white paint line the walkways to small buildings beside the path.  The quaint flower plantings within them, however, might look a bit cheerier were they not filled with the carnivorous blooms of glistening sundews.

title: [Burning Down the House]
description: The strong stench of burning wood permeates the air, and a deep layer of gray ash covers the floor completely.  Flames, fueled by a strong and unknown magic, blaze up and down along all four walls while thick black smoke clouds the ceiling above.  Scattered haphazardly throughout the shop are various sturdy rhimar chests displaying an assortment of shields within.  Easily discernable near the flames is a large rhimar case that also displays wares.

title: [Beyond Words]
description: Shelves full of books line two sides of the compact booth, which is fashioned from unfinished cypress wood, and a pocketed wall-hanging holds various painted cards.  Plastered around the sale items are colorful posters depicting both exotic and mundane locations, each marked with a different signature.  A small counter situated in the center of the stall holds a large basket of quills.

title: [Gurm's, A Storm of Gourds]
description: Protected by bright walls of woven canvas strips, the conjoined tents are warm and marginally dry.  A single mat of coarse, woven wool, frayed at the edges but just as colorful as the tent, sits before a coffer of blond wood.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Small pathways, not much wider than a bootprint, wind their brown and muddy scars through the stubbled grasses.  A low screened-in gazebo is surrounded by patches of varicolored bromeliads.  Tucked beneath the boughs of a sprawling runner oak, the structure provides respite from the buzzing of nighttime insects.  A deeper and more trodden set of bootmarks head south toward an enormous ancient banyan.

A deeper and more trodden set of bootmarks head south toward a diseased banyan.

A deeper and more trodden set of bootmarks head south toward a diseased banyan.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Wagons of many colors and descriptions have dropped their traces here in the wheel-rutted mud beside the main pathway.  Some boast fine wood paneling and massive iron banded wheels, while others have simple canvas stretched over their arched frame structures.  The aroma of roasting meats and vegetables over the open firepits mingle with the sounds of baying dogs and men and women hawking their wares.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Vacant Cabin]
description: Strewn around this small cabin are pieces of mangled furniture and piles of portraits, damaged both by time and the elements of the sea.  A small porthole, barely large enough to provide a suitable light source, sits on a section of the wall that is laden with algae and barnacles.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Bright banners of red, green, and yellow draped beneath wall-mounted torches mark the entrance to a large cedar-planked building.  Potted bromeliads, in a variety of colors, are tucked to each side of the broad wooden stairs.  Sturdy handrailings, festooned with silk ribbons, invite patrons inside for respite from the nighttime chill and fierce, biting insects.  To the west, the sound of laughter filters from an enormous ancient banyan.

Potted bromeliads, in a variety of colors, are tucked to each side of the broad wooden stairs. Sturdy handrailings, festooned with silk ribbons, invite patrons inside for respite from the climate and insects.  To the west stands a diseased banyan.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Breezy Gazebo]
description: Old, weathered wood creeks slightly in the wind.  Six tall pillars sit in the corners of the gazebo, holding an old shingle roof aloft.  A cool breeze passes through the latticework half-walls of building, chilling the air slightly.  Wooden benches line the walls, except for the entrance, providing a place to rest in the shade.  A small refreshments table sits in the center of the room with a scattering of refreshments atop it.

Old, weathered wood creeks slightly in the wind.  Six tall pillars sit in the corners of the gazebo, holding an old shingle roof aloft, providing some shade from the sun.  A cool breeze passes through the latticework half-walls of building, cooling the air slightly.  Wooden benches line the walls, except for the entrance, providing a place to rest in the shade.  A small refreshments table sits in the center of the room with a scattering of refreshments atop it.

title: [The Tossing of the Ring]
description: Resembling a repurposed and aging granary, the small structure has rounded walls of rough oak that display signs of past water damage.  Swollen boards mingle with newer ones where the more rotted pieces have been replaced, while a roof of fresh thatching sits above.  In the center of the small space, an enormous crate is filled with blown glass bottles and has a small steel pail resting beside it.  A dirty-faced human child hangs out near a high wooden stool and watches over everyone that enters and leaves the granary.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Tall tufts of drying grasses tickle the deeply furrowed, grey bark at the base of a stately black gum.  The vibrant, purple leaves of the gum confirm the autumnal grip on the land.  Cheery music and the smells of frying food drift in on the occasional breeze from nearby.  Several colorful wagons, each painted with various deformed animals, create a semicircle around the gum.

title: [The Goblin Oddity, Giftshop]
description: A stubby goblin huckster sits behind a short wooden counter looking over a large pile of toys haphazardly tossed into an oversized iron tub.  A single oil lamp dangles from the ceiling, which gives off a putrid smell, as if it were burning swamp water instead of actual oil.  A large poster depicting several deformed animals dominates the western wall.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Treehouse]
description: Painted panels of leftover planks of wood have been nailed together to form the floor of this cramped treehouse.  Draping canvas overhead provides some shelter from the elements.

title: [The Goblin Oddity, The Gak]
description: Poor lighting offers very little in terms of visibility in the cramped room.  Clumps of wool litter the floor leading up to a rusted iron cage, which contains a two-headed albino gak.  A large sign hanging over the cage reads, "Noos feedun dees gak.  Two heads fight if dees fed wrong!"

title: [Inside the Hut]
description: The thickly layered walls of dried grass and reeds slope up to a point just above the level of a tall giantman's head.  A carved wooden lantern hangs from the apex, suspended on a chain of carved bamboo links.  The entire construction, though sturdily planted in the ground, sways and whistles whenever a particularly strong wind blows across the swamp.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: Neither trees nor brush add greenery to this large mud-flat at the apex of multiple pathways.  Deep rivulets and gouges mark the path of rainfall where it journeys from the higher ground inland, down towards the open water.  Fastidiously moored in the intransigent mud, a dilapidated boat with a twisted rope drooping down from its interior provides both respite, and an invitation for yet more revelry.

title: [Dilapidated Party Boat]
description: Grand in its day, the party boat is in complete disrepair.  Most of the white paint has flaked away, and the exposed wood is mildewing.  A busted string of lights enclose the main area that once served as a dance floor.  The wooden floor sags and creaks even with the lightest of footsteps, providing a shaky barrier from the swamp underneath.  A thick, twisted rope provides both mooring and a means to venture back to the muddy road.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Limestone Strand]
description: At the bottom of the slightly sloped land, a narrow path leading inland converges on to the stretch of mud-embraced shore.  Black ash trees, their trunks as thin and spindly as spider legs, congregate in the shallow water with several pond cypress, where swamp ferns claw their long fingers at anything within reach.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The heavy scent from a cluster of swamp magnolias is reminiscent of vanilla and spice.  Tiny dried berry clusters litter the ground beneath the smooth, grey, multi-lobed trunks.  Fallen, creamy white flowers, now brown and shriveled at the edges, lay among a bed of dried, scattered petals.

title: [Turn It Around, Showroom]
description: Dark mahogany covers the walls and floors of this well-crafted wagon.  Several shelves hang against one wall, their surfaces padded with rich ebon velvet.  A pair of etched glass cases is centered in the room upon a thick fur carpet.  Suspended from the ceiling are several glaes lanterns, their light casting a pale glow over the area.  A silver-framed sign hangs next to a thick wooden door banded with strips of hammered copper.

title: [Turn It Around, Workroom]
description: Several padded chairs are placed about the room upon a thick, dark fur carpet.  Displayed around the small area is a series of wooden sculptures, each one a unique beast of unrecognizable origin.  A large iron-bound trunk secured with a thick metal lock rests against the far wall.  Flanking a thick wooden door banded with strips of hammered copper is a pair of glaes sconces, their light basking the room in a soft glow.

title: [Foxfire Manor, Antechamber]
description: Fetid, cloudy water has consumed the floor of the manor house, rising to devour the first few steps of a carved wooden stairway.  The stairs themselves are blocked by a pile of white bricks that have fallen from the collapsed ceiling.  All around, the manor's walls creak and groan in protest, as if mourning their own slow death.  A pair of warped double doors, long-since stripped of brasswork and jeweled adornment, open onto the remains of a ballroom to the east.

A pair of warped double doors, long-since stripped of brasswork and jeweled adornment, opens onto the remains of a ballroom to the east.

title: [Foxfire Manor, Drowned Walk]
description: The cracked foundation of the manor is evident in the dizzying tilt of the walls in what was once a ballroom.  A peacock-shaped chandelier, plucked clean of its crystalline plumage, hangs at an angle from the low ceiling.  Its base is scarred from numerous attempts to pry it free.  With the floor lost to several feet of water, the path from a set of warped double doors in the west to a huge shattered window of smoked glass in the eastern wall is a series of granite stepping stones.

title: [Foxfire Manor, Yard]
description: Glass from a huge shattered window glistens from the wet grass of the yard.  The parts of the manor's back lawn that have not been drowned by the encroaching bog are lush with overgrown grass and flowering, black-trunked trees, the latter of which have grown into a grove around the ruins of a stone well.  Other trees, less cultured and more wild, grow in abundance to the north, fusing into a dense and foreboding wood.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A tangle of twisted trunks with smooth, light grey bark mark the stands of wax myrtles along the pathway.  Their aromatic olive green leaves lend a pleasant fragrance to the area and the pale blue berries have attracted numerous wildfowl, judging by the variety of feathers scarttered beneath the thicket.

A tangle of twisted trunks with smooth, light grey bark mark the stands of wax myrtles along the pathway.  Their aromatic olive green leaves lend a pleasant fragrance to the area and the pale blue berries have attracted numerous wildfowl, judging by the variety of feathers scattered beneath the thicket.

title: [Farmer's Only]
description: Dirt and grime line the wooden floors of this small hovel.  Barely attached to the far wall is a large metal rack where a variety of farming tools hang upon.  In the center of the area sits a large, battered mithril strongbox that appears to have been opened ages ago.

title: [Frippery in the Fen, Cool]
description: Brightly colored silk in a variety of cooling hues wraps about a slender oak pole that stands centered in the area pushing up the white cotton ceiling.  A tall oak mirror stands in one corner between a curtained arch and a silk-screened partition that creates a semi private dressing nook.  Three mannequins capture the focus of the room, their forms centered on a dark carpet around the support post.

title: [Frippery in the Fen, Salon]
description: Secluded from the rest of the pavilion, the spacious workroom is well furnished.  A thick carpet of dark wool covers the floor, a pattern of swirling brown, grey, and black shades give it a rich texture.  Large cushions crafted from brightly patterned silk are scattered about the floor by a carved modwir bench.  A large oak board rests upon a tripod next to a curtained arch, a fanciful pattern of leaves carved into its wooden frame.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The scent of honeysuckle and cypress plays upon each passing breeze that gives the branch-bound, feathery, draping moss an eerie life of its own.  Animal tracks and bootprints overlap in the soft earth, though it would be hard to tell who was following who.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: Water ash ranging from small shrubs to grown specimens twenty feet tall dominate this stretch of ground.  Small sections of bark have been cleanly incised from the trunks, in too calculated a pattern to have been done by area creatures.  A small muddy canvas tent stands open beneath the trees.  Kettles of boiled potions rest beside a rock-lined firepit, wisps of steam occasionally escaping from beneath their heavy lids.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Healer's Tent]
description: Blanket-wrapped pallets of dried mosses and lichens serve as the only resting spots for the wounded and infirmed.  Smoldering bundles of herbs waft their smoky tendrils of fragrances from tin bowls, plates, and cups placed beside each makeshift bed.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A collection of shrub-like water ash lining the pathway lends a distinctive pungency to the area.  Small, wafer-like, winged samaras litter the ground where they have dropped from the branches, having failed in their mission to be carried on the wind to populate elsewhere.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Deep furrows through the grassy terrain wind past a line of small rectangular structures with wooden latches on the doors.  An old slash pine, its trunk gnarled and bent to the forces of time, grows almost horizontally due to its deformity.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Privvy]
description: The stench in the dark cramped space is so bad that even the flies have succumbed, judging from the layer of tiny black bodies beneath your feet.   A wide plank has been laid across the back, a suitable hole cut out of the seat.

title: [A Pocket Full]
description: The scent of leather pervades this room, mixed with lantern oil, and a faint flowery scent.  A darkly stained oak crate crammed with goods rests on the floor near the front, while a small cherry oak dresser with open drawers stands against the wall to one side, below an etched metal sign.  The area is lit with several flickering lanterns set along the rustic log walls, between two of which, a row of hooks displays more wares to be sold.  At the back of the wagon, a small archway affords further entrance, while opposite, an open doorway housing a set of steps leads back outside.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: A string of brightly colored lanterns are strung between two gnarled two gnarled slash pines.  Lit from within by flickering candles, they add a splash of color and a soft glow to an otherwise drab area of scrub trees and dying grasses.  A shaky table has been set up on the grass, topped with a pyramid of murky white glass milk bottles.  Nearby, a pile of brick-colored balls rests on the ground, and a mustachioed huckster paces back and forth between the table and the pile of balls.

A string of brightly colored lanterns are strung between two gnarled slash pines.  Lit from within by flickering candles, they add a splash of color and a soft glow to an otherwise drab area of scrub trees and dying grasses.

title: [A Pocket Full]
description: A red and gold woven rug extends from the small archway at the front of the room to the complementing tapestry hanging at the back, as if the rug travels seamlessly along the dusty plank floor and up to the ceiling.  On either side of the runner, shop wares are displayed on various surfaces.  A darkly stained pine table stands opposite from a low etched metal bin, each illuminated by flickering lanterns that adorn the walls above them.  Nearby, a row of brushed metal hooks displays some longer garments.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: A large fallen tree lays beside the path, swathed in a blanket of feathery, tendriled moss.  All along its now horizontal bulk, silk ribbons of silver and green are entwined with the moss draped branches, and tiny bells dangle from each ribbon's bow.  A cutout of a painted wooden rolton looms on the other side of the path near a basket of rolton tails and an unshaven huckster.

All along its now horizontal bulk, silk ribbons of silver and green are entwined with the moss draped branches, and tiny bells dangle from each ribbon's bow.  A scattering of pallid grey fungi coats the pathway.

title: [The Hair Appeal, Entry]
description: Loose knotty oak boards, grey and cracked with age, hang off-kilter from the wall supports and allow moonlight to spill upon the raised boards of the floor.  Exposed rafters hold up a thatched roof that has large holes where antiquated straw has rotted away.  Debris piled upon the floor between posts defines were aging walls once stood, while chains strung between the old supports dangle woven baskets that hold wares.

title: [Feymist Inn Lobby]
[Feymist Inn, Lobby]
description: Large bouquets of swamp blossoms and wildflowers in crystal vases are set about the room, atop several polished oak stands.  The elegance of the furnishings are negated by the massive head of large gator, jaws fully agape, mounted above a two-way stone fireplace.  The bustle of dining patrons can be heard from a grouping of tables to the north while others mingle near a set of etched glass doors leading out to the porch.

title: [Feymist Inn, Porch]
description: Comfortable seating is abundant on this airy porch, with reed woven chairs and sofas covered in floral print pillows.  Some low tables hold a few light refreshments for guests and visitors.

title: [Feymist Inn, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Heavy creaking arises with even the lightest step upon the stairtreads and hallway planking, making a serrupticious rendevous in the adjoining inn rooms unlikely.  Bright copper sconces provide the only illumination, both day and night, in this windowless space.  Glass knobs reflect the dim, flickering light, inviting guests into each of four carved wooden doors.

title: [Feymist Inn, Cypress Retreat]
description: A plush dark green rug covers the majority of the plank flooring.  Spanning across the far wall, a wide four-poster bed carved from thick cedar is dressed with pale green and white bedding.  Issuing a shadowy, flickering illumination, copper sconces are lit with dim flames, several of which are clustered around a narrow door.  Behind a tall armchair and a rustic table, lacy curtains are pulled across a section of the solid wall, as if a window once existed in the framework.

title: [Feymist Inn, Sawgrass Retreat]
description: A plush sky blue rug covers the majority of the plank flooring.  Spanning across the far wall, a wide four-poster bed, carved from wood and twined with sawgrass, is dressed with dark azure and white bedding.  Issuing a shadowy, flickering illumination, copper sconces are lit with dim flames, several of which are clustered around a narrow door.  Above a tall armchair and a rustic table, the ceiling is charred to a blacker than midnight hue.

title: [Feymist Inn, Black Gum Retreat]
description: A plush pale grey rug covers the majority of the plank flooring.  Spanning across the far wall, a wide four-poster bed carved from black gum wood is dressed with periwinkle and white bedding.  Issuing a shadowy, flickering illumination, copper sconces are lit with dim flames, several of which are clustered around a narrow door.  Above a tall armchair and a rustic table, the ceiling is warped inward in odd curving patterns.

title: [Feymist Inn, Magnolia Retreat]
description: A plush pale pink rug covers the majority of the plank flooring.  Spanning across the far wall, a wide four-poster bed carved from magnolia wood is dressed with vibrant red and white bedding.  Issuing a shadowy, flickering illumination, copper sconces are lit with dim flames, several of which are clustered around a narrow door.  Behind a tall armchair and a rustic table, the outline of a door, minus a knob and hinges, is barely discernable in the framework.

title: [The Witch's Light]
description: Surrounded on three sides by low counters, the stall has an awning of violet that is dingy and faded at the edges.  Long, blackened iron chains dangle from the supports, displaying a wide variety of glass wares, while canvas sheets are arranged upon the smooth plane of the counter to display candles and matches.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Domed canvas tents, brightly striped in yellows, reds, and blues have displaced much of the natural vegetation here.  Wire cages of chickens and turkeys resting between the tents seem to be responsible for both the noise and the odors permeating the area.  A pig wrangler stands with arms crossed watching some greased pigs corralled behind a chain-link fence.

Domed canvas tents, brightly striped in yellows, reds, and blues have displaced much of the natural vegetation here.  Wire cages of chickens and turkeys resting between the tents seem to be responsible for both the noise and the odors permeating the area.

title: [Frosted Landings]
description: Swathes of grey and violet fabric overlap to create a domed pavilion that has air vents high in its ceiling.  Polished lacquered supports are wrapped in copper chains that bind the layers of the walls together, while conical censers fill the air with tropical fragrances that stave off the less savory aromas of the swamp.  A large, felt-backed panel displays a variety of wares in the center of the room.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: A large clearing beside the path is marked with signs deterring visitors from venturing too closely.  Heavy iron stakes protrude from the ground, each attached to an equally heavy chain.  The circles of packed earth surrounding each iron anchor pin show the pacing range of the animals normally staked there.  Several sleek brown dogs with massive heads and jowls are bound within the clearing, some slumbering peacefully, while others circle restlessly in the quiet night.

title: [Hodgepodge Hole]
description: The interior of this small wagon is undecorated save for a few multicolored streamers that hang from the ceiling.  The cramped room is stacked with a haphazard selection of overflowing wooden crates of various shapes and sizes, and an upturned box serves as a makeshift counter in the corner of the room.

title: [Bring Your Own Magic]
description: A few battered lanterns are mounted on the smooth fel walls of the interior of the wagon.  Threadbare crimson and gold banners are hung from the crossbeams overhead.  An ascending line of polished brass doorknobs is attached to the far wall.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Small, boarded-up sheds serve as makeshift barns along this relatively cleared stretch of ground.  The sounds and smells of domestic animals filter from within the ramshackle structures.  A wire-enclosed chicken coop is perched high up on stilted supports, offering some protection from the wildlife marauders.  Eyes peer out occasionally from the branches of some spreading oaks, marking the positions of predators hoping to secure a nighttime meal.
