A wire-enclosed chicken coop is perched high up on stilted supports, offering some protection from the wildlife marauders.  Some spreading oaks offer some shade, but provide little respite from the humid air and stench.

title: [Baked Up A Treat]
description: The cozy interior of the wagon has been painted in warm autumnal hues and features a selection of comfy looking overstuffed armchairs.  Trays of steaming hot drinks and baked treats are crammed onto a small, rickety oak table that stands in the middle of the room.  Lazy smoke drifts up from a makeshift fireplace full of gently crackling applewood logs, creating a homely atmosphere.

title: [From Hair to There, Entry]
description: Whitewashed walls stenciled with flower and leaves are complemented by layered russet drapes, and lightly glowing frosted glass lanterns supply a constant source of dim light.  A small fireplace piled with logs provides enough warmth to give the wagon a cozy, warm feel.

title: [The Secluded Smith, Entryway]
description: Sunlight shines down through the circular opening in the top of the tent, casting bright illumination upon a massive portable anvil resting in the center of the area.  Pulled back at the edge, the flap to the east is secured by a dagger, while the one to the west features a flamberge.

title: [The Secluded Smith, Small]
description: A simple pallet takes up space near the back of the tent.  The remainder is occupied by a battered wooden table.

title: [The Secluded Smith, Big]
description: Stacks of crates fill most of the area, and the smell of metal is prominent.  A large iron weapon rack rests against the clutter, displaying a selection of wares.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Broken limbs lie in scattered heaps across the soggy ground, their ends clawed and chewed upon by some unseen animal.  A narrow tree-enshrouded path leads further into a thick wooded pass, away from the swamp.  Sprouting out of their rotting expanses are tubes of wild mushrooms with cup-shaped heads and blue-green blades of wildrye.  A thin trail of stones winds its way through the slogging mud and provides a solid means of egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid stream along the eastern border.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay.  Drooping willow trees, short and stunted, drape across the path and dangle their spear-shaped leaves upon the spongy ground.  A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick tangles of thorn-heavy brambles lie in knotted clusters along the western border of the pathway that bisects the swamp.  Several puddles of stagnant water pockmark the thick carpet of dusky brown moss that spreads across the uneven ground.  A ring of half-rotted trees leans against each other, their splintered sides and barkless faces heavy with black mold and sludge.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Narrowing to an ultra thin track of solid ground, the pathway meanders through wide pools of stagnant water.  Duckweed and bladderwort create a verdant border to each of ovoid bodies and rainbow mold stretches across the stale surfaces.  Clouds of gnats thicken the air, their tiny bodies clinging to everything in their path.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves.  Ominous shadows trail across the spongy, softness of the landscape where enormous muddy bubbles rise and burst as underground gases escape from the bosom of the earth.  In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Strange fumes create a haze in the air as they explosively escape from the putrid ground and fill the air with an aroma akin to rotting eggs.  Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Toppled on its side, an enormous banyan tree stretches across the pathway and lies its head into the stagnant waters of the nearby stream.  Mold and sludge have claimed most of the verdant canopy, while its roots lie exposed to the elements and still cling to large clumps of moist earth.  A series of tiny black capped mushrooms grow in the dark shelter of the fallen tree.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky.  Thick roots, resembling the legs of an enormous spider, rise out of the soft, muddy ground and create arches that encircle the smooth barked monstrosity.  High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees.  Standing in the center of a pool of cloudy water is a hollowed tree stump that is covered in orange and brown shelf fungi.  Several patches of land offer a better trail through the deep muck that covers the ground, but avoiding the muck seems impossible.

Thick tangles of thorn-heavy brambles lie in knotted clusters along the western border of the pathway that bisects the swamp.  Several puddles of stagnant water pockmark the thick carpet of dusky brown moss that spreads across the uneven ground.  A ring of half-rotted trees leans against each other, their splintered sides and barkless faces heavy with black mold and sludge.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Fungal tubes rise out of the leaf-covered ground, their twisted stems curving away from the rotting nutrients of the swamp's muddy banks.  Bright green mold-covered tree limbs lie in a protective ring about the russet brown protrusions and display signs of hooves, beak, and claw marks across their warped lengths.  Sprouts of bright green swamp privet break through the dismal grey and brown of the landscape, their spindled limbs mildly spotted with layered and waxy, lime green blubs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Splintered bark and broken limbs litter the viscous ground around a stunted black willow tree.  Discolored leaves precariously cling to branches, though a greater number lie scatted about the mud.  Upturned tufts of wildrye grass display their intricate root systems to the sky along edge of the watercourse, their blue-green blades barely touching the scum-covered liquid.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.

Narrowing to an ultra thin track of solid ground, the pathway meanders through wide pools of stagnant water.  Duckweed and bladderwort create a verdant border to each of ovoid bodies and rainbow mold stretches across the stale surfaces.  Clouds of gnats thicken the air, their tiny bodies clinging to everything in their path.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright and verdant in the dark landscape, a single juniper tree rises out of the murky bleakness of the swamp and stretches upward towards the grey sky.  Concentric bands of alternating stone and brown grass surround the twisted body of the towering, berry-laden beauty and manage to stave off the filth of the nearby sludge-like mud.  Despite the calm of the area, an invasive humidity makes the air weighed with dampness and an underlying scent of stench clogs the senses.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.

title: [Amidst the Tents]
description: Numerous canvas tents of varying sizes, shapes, and colors nearly fill this small, flat area.  Some of the tents are separated by mere inches, making it difficult to navigate between them.  A weathered wooden sign stands beside a centrally located large wire basket, filled with yet more tents.

title: [Amidst the Tents, Clearing]
description: The ground here seems dry, flat, and largely free of sticks and rocks.  While there are some tents erected here, they are not so numerous as the closely clustered stand of tents directly west.  Comparatively, it looks like there is plenty of space for more.

title: [To the Hilt, Small]
description: Pale moonlight streams through the three long, narrow rectangular windows along the wall, falling in dim blocky stripes on the items displayed on a sectioned wooden shelf which runs the length of the wagon on the wall adjacent to the windows.  Out of reach of the light is a cowering swamp goblin mannequin, his face turned away from the room and locked in an expression of agony.

title: [To the Hilt, Large]
description: Hanging from the ceiling is a dimly lit chandelier which casts flickering light and long shadows over the area.  Lining the two opposing dark-paneled walls of this long, narrow space are a series of upturned hooks, while a tall wooden weapons stand takes up the entire back wall.

title: [To the Hilt, Medium]
description: Not wider than a hallway, a glass-topped weapons display case takes up most of the available space in this cramped section of the wagon.  Several upturned hooks dot the wall above the case, paired into sets to hold weapons parallel to the ground.  Sconces holding flickering candles separate each pair of hooks, casting dancing light over the metallic blades.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Gaily decorated wagons tilt to one side or the other within the uneven ruts on the muddy pathway.  Banners proclaim the wonder of goods sold within, and several have floral arrangements and streamers of ribbons wound around their beckoning entrances.  Towering past the tops of all nearby tents and wagons looms a tall bell-topped pole marked incrementally in black paint.  A large wooden-hafted mallet rests against the pole, with a burly muscular huckster looking on.

Gaily decorated wagons tilt to one side or the other within the uneven ruts on the muddy pathway.  Banners proclaim the wonder of goods sold within, and several have floral arrangements and streamers of ribbons wound around their beckoning entrances.  Jutting out from the soft ground are some pallid grey fungi.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: One of the few heavy, stone structures in the area has been erected in a well tended clearing.  Its mortared exterior of stacked grey stone holds equispaced niches across the front and sides.  Set within the niches are blocky, stone statues of various dieties casting chiseled and sightless stares upon those passing by.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Temple]
description: Blood red candles burn softly within chiseled niches, flickering an eerie, crimson glow across the grey stone walls.  A raised altar is centered in the space, draped with white linen, and surrounded by tiny, carved totems and statuettes.

title: [Whatever Will Be, Show Room]
description: Silvery moonlight filters through the three portal windows which dot one side of this long, narrow space, falling on the crystal balls displayed on a shallow velvet-lined shelf running the length of the wagon below the windows.  A dimly lit chandelier hangs overhead, casting flickering light and long shadows over the area.  A glass-fronted dark wood wardrobe takes up most of the back wall, save for the space occupied by a crimson velvet drape.

Silvery moonlight filters through the three portal windows which dot one side of this long, narrow space, falling on the crystal balls displayed on a shallow velvet-lined shelf running the length of the wagon below the windows.  A dimly lit chandelier hangs overhead, casting flickering light and long shadows over the area.  A glass-fronted display counter takes up most of the back wall, save for the space occupied by a crimson velvet drape.

Bright sunlight streams through the three portal windows which dot one side of this long, narrow space, falling on the crystal balls displayed on a shallow velvet-lined shelf running the length of the wagon below the windows.  A glass-fronted display counter takes up most of the back wall, save for the space occupied by a crimson velvet drape.

title: [Whatever Will Be, Back Room]
description: The rear quarter of the wagon has been sectioned off by a crimson velvet drape to provide a cramped private space.  Across the floor is a sprawl of pillows of all shapes and colors.  Amidst the pillows is a small round wooden table beset by squat wooden stools.  Moonlight streams in through a stained-glass skylight in the wagon's ceiling, bathing the area in a dim multicolored glow.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: A broad, flat piece of ground has been wrestled here from the surrounding vegetative incursion.  Well-tended and planted with a border of colorful flowers, there is room here for many to gather on red and white benches.  Vendors have taken advantage of the open space with the placement of small booths and kiosks, and the aromas of baked goods perfume the humid air.

title: [Lovely Livery]
description: Golden mistwood poles provide support for overlapping swathes of blue and silver silk that create the ceiling and walls of this large pavilion.  Embroidered throw rugs cover the ground, with a few stray blades of grass poking through here and there where the coverings meet.  Gold lanterns pierced with sunburst patterns host tiny cobalt beeswax candles, casting flickering light over a spindly silver table.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Lovely Lacings]
description: Thick curtains of amethyst velvet are draped from ebonwood partitions, creating the ceiling and walls of this pavilion.  Electrum sconces are bolted to the wooden supports, softly illuminating dozens of lengths of fabric suspended from above.  A small parchment sign is propped up on an electrum-gilded ebonwood table that sits at the center of the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Feywrot Mire, Trail of Hexes]
description: The main path widens here as bootprints converge from several points of origin, most showing the direction of travel to be northward towards a large banyan.  A smaller number lead downslope toward the deeper swamp.  The tracks alone would not be disturbing, were it not for the very large, reptilian, claw-tipped tracks overlaying some of the bootprints leading toward the swamp.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Trail of Runes]
description: The scent of peat and decaying leaves drift upwards from nearby swamp waters, wafting on currents of humid air.  Toward the outer areas, a stand of moss-bearded trees keep silent watch on their surroundings.  Knees protrude around them like knobby, gnarled daggers piercing the glassy surface of the waters.

title: [The Bearded Dome]
description: Various exotic flora in pots and planters have been arranged to mimic the natural environment beneath an expansive domed canopy.  Lined with smooth river stones, a winding path spirals inward from a verdant vine-patterned flap to the tent's center.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Trail of Spirits]
description: The humidity clings to the exposed skin of any passersby, leaving fine beads of moisture condensing like a sheen of sweat.  Neither the heat nor the dampness seem to have curtailed the growth of a spreading expanse of flowering nightshade.   A collection of hooded pitcher plants flourishes nearby, encroaching slightly on the established pathway.

title: [Calantha's Caravan]
description: The front of this caravan hosts a series of neatly arranged racks and shelves all boasting ladies' garments.  Checked cloths in bright hues cover two prominently placed tables, beneath which lies a half-hidden, battered wooden dress form.  A silver tray rests atop a glass display case, and matching silver sconces are bolted to the oak walls.  Stray beams of moonlight filter through the open window, and the occasional humid breeze wafts in the faint scent of the swamp.

title: [A Stony Cottage]
description: The anemic floral decor of the cottage is washed in silvered light that streams through a glass-paned bay window.  A mild brume hangs heavy in the air, nearly obscuring some provincial elm cabinetry that fully lines the back wall.  Herb-filled baskets and vials of oil are strewn about a flat-topped cypress tree stump, serving as a workspace.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Ring of Cypress]
description: Tall and spindly trees rise from the spongy, leaf-strewn ground, stretching upward to blend into a wall of sickly brown.  The air is still and sticky, leaving a layer of moisture clinging to any exposed skin.  Several hillocks and mounds of brown dirt are visible in the nearby outer swamp.

title: [Swamp Stamen]
description: The shack has whitewashed walls and a bare, swept dirt floor.  A pair of turned wooden poles stretches across the sides of the space.  One hanging curtain, cut from canvas, leads out the front, and a second hanging drape, cut from leather, leads out the back.

title: [Swamp Stamen, Clearing]
description: A square of dirty canvas has been laid over the muddy ground, though in places, the wet underneath has caused blooms of moisture to appear on the concealing fabric surface.  A leather drape, hanging listlessly in the back wall of a whitewashed shack, leads into the small shop.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Rotary of Runes]
description: A few dilapidated buildings, with doors ajar and swaying from rusty hinges, are tucked beside the pathway.  Creeping vines swaddle the wood-planked exteriors and porches, and several runners have managed incursions at the rooflines.

title: [Mychus' Wagon]
description: Dart boards of all sizes and colors hang from the ceiling and form crowded stacks in two corners of this cramped wagon.  A woven cotten rug painted with concentric black and red circles covers the floor.  In the center of the vehicle is a large display counter with an important looking sign on it.

title: [Blacksmith's Courtyard]
description: An enormous brick forge occupies the center of a barren courtyard, fed by a triad of bellows manned by laboring apprentices.  Scattered among the coals are a number of brightly glowing incarnadine crystals that pulse with each gust of air.  Some charred ceramic crucibles stand in a lopsided pile near a long wooden trough filled with stagnant water, and chunks of ore and melted slag are scattered around the courtyard in large heaps.  On one side of the courtyard, a rusty iron water pump drips slowly into a deep moss-covered well.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A looming cypress holds dominion over the converging pathways, with knobby knees encircling the buttressed base.  Like a matriach from ages past, the graceful giant is draped in a centuries-old gown of grey-green moss.

A looming cypress holds dominion over the converging pathways, with knobby knees encircling the buttressed base.  Like a matriarch from ages past, the graceful giant is draped in a centuries-old gown of grey-green moss.

title: [Illustrated Tent]
description: The tent is imprinted with colorfully exaggerated depictions of carnival acts.  Between elaborately scrollworked borders, a riot of tumblers, jugglers and dancers vies for space with actors, jesters and mimes.  In contrast to the gaudy figures, the lower border of the tent is frayed and threadbare.  A faint fetid odor of decomposition here nags the olfactories; it seems to originate from a corner of the tent occupied by a heavily trussed iron trunk strapped with bolted chains.

title: [Magically Delicious]
description: A thick layer of muddied sawdust covers the area of this small run-down wagon.  A single open-faced glass case case has been pushed up against the far wall.  Below the glass case are shards of glass in all shapes and sizes that glitter just barely in the torch light.  Two single torches, one on either side of the doorway, are the only light provided.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Bald Cypress Arc]
description: A dense copse of trees hugs the water's edge, while a small hole has worn through the limestone shore's crumbly base to form an inland pool ringed with swamp rose bushes.  The limestone then rises up at a low slant, the formation immediately covered with a thick coating of brownish-black mud, with a barely-there path cutting through it and leading inland.  Bridging over the swamp's expanse of water, a raised wood plank walkway makes its way through into the darkness.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Eastern Walkway]
description: Splintered planks of cedar allow precarious travel over the dark waters flowly sluggishly beneath the raised pilings.  Some vegetation threatens to claim its own foothold here, with prolific swamp ferns poking up from below.  Leading further out across the waters, the walkway continues to the east.

title: [Talisman Tent]
description: Billowy blue fabric forms a loose tent structure, with a small opening at the top to allow both fresh air and moonlight to stream in.  A single long, steel table is topped with compartments, each holding a different set of items, arranged in a maze-like fashion.

Billowy blue fabric forms a loose tent structure, with a small opening at the top to allow both fresh air and sunlight to stream in.  A single long, steel table is topped with compartments, each holding a different set of items, arranged in a maze-like fashion.

title: [Holly, Wood, And Vine]
description: Beams of white and red oak arch overhead forming the roof of this octahedral pavilion.  Large panels of gold and silver cotton are hung from the wooden framework, enclosing the space within the structure.  Garlands of holly and liana vine dangle from the oaken beams above and drape over a birch arch.  A carpet of pale green moss covers the floor of the pavilion.

title: [Cypress Grove]
description: Bent boughs of large cypress trees tower overhead, providing a shaded clearing.  The grove is enclosed on three sides by the massive rooty knots of the cypress trees that form the natural boundries of the area.  Liana vines drape the oak pavilion and wrap around the white birch arch leading back in to the structure.  A soft carpet of moss covers the ground, interspersed with patches of pale blue fungus.

title: [The Hair Appeal, Counter]
description: Gaping holes in the ceiling are edged with black slime where the thatching has rotted away and allow splotches of moonlight to trickle into the dank room.  Roughened oak boards form the walls, though they display heavy signs of water damage and in places appear to be decomposing.  A long rough counter acts as guardian for the open door that rests off-kilter to its frame.

Roughened oak boards form the walls, though they display heavy signs of water damage and in places appear to be decomposing.  A long rough counter acts as guardian for the open door that rests off-kilter to its frame.

title: [The Hair Appeal, Workshop]
description: Fresh thatching fills the holes in the ceiling where the old hatching has rotted away, while newer wood in the walls keeps the wind and humidity from outside at bay.  A single lantern suspended from the ceiling provides dim illumination and outlines the shape of a fur-laden sleeping pallet in one corner and a tarnished copper mirror in the other.  Though still warped and creaking, the floorboards display signs of recent repairs.

title: [Feymist Inn, Dining Room]
description: Hanging on the near wall, just above a two-way stone fireplace, the eyes on a grimy, bent miner's portraiture glare out across the room.  Several groupings of diners are seated at long wooden tables and around a small, circular bar, while busy waitstaff bustle past every so often, laden with trays and steaming dishes.  The bright colors and rich decor do little to hide the stains that have spread across the wallpaper and the ceiling.

title: [Mighty Banyan Table]
description: Sturdy oak chairs, topped with floral print cushions, provide ample seating around a long wooden table.  Small glass tiles form a mosaic centered upon the surface, depicting a sprawling, ancient banyan.

title: [Feymist Inn, Kitchen]
description: Cast iron kettles of soups and stews hang from heavy hooks above the embers in a large open fireplace.  Bread dough, covered with clean linen cloths, rests upon long wooden counters, rising in preparation for the next baking.  Assorted spices, in square metal tins, are neatly arrayed in wall-mounted racks.  Despite the bright light that floods the central area, the kitchen's corners are couched in darkness.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A half-buried carcass of a large, wild pig protrudes from beneath the leaf litter.  Deep, reptilian, claw-tipped prints leading away, with the drag marks of a heavy tail between them, leave little doubt as to what sealed this porcine's fate.

A half-buried carcass of a large, wild pig protrudes from beneath the leaf litter.  Deep, reptilian, claw-tipped prints leading away, with the drag marks of a heavy tail between them, leave little doubt as to what sealed this hog's fate.

title: [Round 'Em Up, Barn Interior]
description: Pale golden straw covers the dirt floor of the small barn, while bales are stacked here and there about the area.  A row of stalls are built into the outside walls, their bolted gates are each painted a different color.  Leather straps, blankets, and tools hang from pegs stuck into the rough wooden planks that enclose each pen.  A pair of wooden shelves are built alongside a sliding wooden door at the back of the building.

title: [Round 'Em Up, Raceway]
description: Bales of hay line twin split-rail fences that run the length of the area creating a long corral.  Colorful pennants painted with comical roltons fly from posts set in the ground at regular intervals.  A bright awning can be seen farther down the raceway.  Leading into the barn, a sliding wooden door stands partly open.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Ring of Runes]
description: A thick stand of swamp sumac has claimed ownership of this moist, sloping ground.  The smooth, grey bark and verdant growth give little indication that this foliage should be avoided.  The pathway circles widely around the stand, to prevent all but the foolish from errantly brushing up against the greenery.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Ring of the Hexes]
description: A thick cover of native grasses have overtaken the moist ground on the downward slope off the narrow path.  Leading down to the edges of the outer swamp, an abundant ground cover of maidencane grows to the height of a man and sways gently with any perceptible winds.  To the inside of the path, several buildings on raised platforms take advantage of a clear patch of earth.

title: [Trolling the Swamp, Foyer]
[The Eyes Have It, Foyer]
description: Woven twigs and dark green vines splotched with blood-red blight form the pliant walls of the longhouse.  It is difficult to tell if supporting stone lurks somewhere beneath, or if the writhing, rasping greenery is all that separates indoors from out.  Crooked candles, their wax the color of old bones, glare from nooks in the living walls, sullen candleflames dangerously close to dangling vines.  Other crannies house censers leaking cloying, heady smoke.

title: [A Vision of Beauty]
description: Gold-washed walls sparkle from a spiraling floral glitter design, and ropes of faux jewels create sparkling curtains that cover the windows inside the wagon.  Two mannequins pose as if in the middle of an animated conversation.  At their center, a grandiose bouquet features ostentatious silk flowers, shimmering ribbons and an oppressively perfumed odor.  A stool and chain-link collar lay tucked in the back corner.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Trail of Hexes]
description: A few brightly painted structures, some raised above the moist soil, beckon visitors with signage on the upslope of the path.  To the downslope side, the knobby knees of a grouping of pond cypress have effectively thwarted the plans of any builders to locate here.

A few brightly painted structures, some raised above the moist soil, beckon visitors with signage on the upslope of the walkway.  To the downslope side, the knobby knees of a grouping of pond cypress have effectively thwarted the plans of any builders to locate here.

title: [Deserted Cottage, Approach]
description: Bright green and blue will-o'-wisps dance about the muck-lined pathway leading toward the wooden cottage, appears quite weathered and its windows are boarded-up with mismatched wood.  Branches dangle from the thatched roof, most likely due to the grove of yews surrounding the cottage.  The signs of an old fire mar the ground on the western side of the cottage.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Spirit Way]
description: The path here grows narrow, nearly imperceptable in spots, waging a loosing battle with the prolific encroachment of skunk cabbage from all sides.  The dense, and not so fragrant, ground cover seems determined to renounce the right of passage from those who seek egress here.

The path here grows narrow, nearly imperceptible in spots, waging a losing battle with the prolific encroachment of skunk cabbage from all sides.  The dense, and not so fragrant, ground cover seems determined to renounce the right of passage from those who seek egress here.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: Slender water oaks are abundant along the pathway, with a few leveled stumps indicating where some were harvested for fuel or timber.  Broken acorns crunch beneath the feet of those passing by and litter the browned grasses beneath every tree.  Wild turkey droppings and deer tracks among the fallen acorns indicate they are a favored food source for the wildlife here.

title: [Hang'em High]
description: Thick fog roils through this wooded area of the swamp, obscuring potential pitfalls for secure footing.  Strung up between some dead branches is a bright banner tied with equally colorful streamers at its ends.  A battered human pinata hangs high up on a nearby tupelo tree.  Leading back to the rest of the festival is a long muddy path.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: Fetishes and totems dangle high in the branches of the stately water oaks.  Bundles of incense and herbs with charred edges have been laided out in orderly arrangements atop flat rocks placed in circles.  Grim-faced statuettes, lit from within by blood red candles, rest upon each rock, as if guarding the half-burnt offerings.

Fetishes and totems dangle high in the branches of the stately water oaks.  Bundles of incense and herbs with charred edges have been laid out in orderly arrangements atop flat rocks placed in circles.  Grim-faced statuettes, lit from within by blood red candles, rest upon each rock, as if guarding the half-burnt offerings.

title: [Brush With Death, Of Immortals]
description: Velvet jade curtains drape down from above, encasing the area in a vibrant green hue.  Candle-laden fixtures hang from the tented ceiling, illuminating the tent, save for a shadowy velvet curtain.  Showcased in the center of the area, a large painting housed in an ironwood frame sits on a gilded easel.

title: [Brush With Death, Studio]
description: Soft indigo walls, bare of any ornamentation, encase the area in pale color.  Gracing each wall, cut-outs in the tent allow sunlight to stream in, and conflagrant candles scattered throughout the area provide even more light.  Just next to a trio of large easels and an assortment of vividly colored pillows, an elaborately carved table bears neatly laid out painting supplies, including a palette stained with oils.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The bleakness of the shrub-covered landscape is accentuated by a large pile of debris heaped to the side of the pathway.  A brutish-looking, large, mangy dog is chained beside the pile, though the need for guarding such refuse seems largely unwarranted.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: One very large tent of green canvas stretches across the entire space overhead, offering abundant shelter from the elements.  The front and side flaps are rolled up and secured with leather ties, leaving the swamp in full view.  Sturdy, hand-scraped oak poles support the weight of the heavy fabric, giving even the tallest guests plenty of headroom inside.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The collection of stilt-raised buildings and platforms have not hindered the expansion of greenery here.  A grouping of striped pitcher plants silently await the arrival of living meals, their coloring and scent luring in victims from both above and below.

title: [Small Canvas Tent]
description: Dense canvas provides a dim interior for this space that is little more than a skeletal framework of thin stanchions.  The floor of the tent is amply hay-strewn as a hedge against the perpetual moist conditions of the boggy locale.  A pattern of barely discernible stains in the fabric of the tent has all the characteristics of blood spatter.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A dense ground cover of saw palmetto makes for difficult navigation of the faint pathway leading east to west.  Sharp spines protrude from elongated petioles that support the silvery green, fan-shaped leaves.  A brave soul has attempted to make the site more welcoming by staking brightly colored posts, each topped with a grinning gargoyle finial, among the shrubs.

title: [Ornate Wagon]
description: Floridly colored and brass-trimmed, the wagon stands in bright contrast to the dull umber of the dismal miasma.  Its garish ornamentation belies the mundane nature of the wagon.  Shelves of preserves and pickled foods line its walls.  Netted shanks of cured pork share the ceiling with dangling loops of the dark, salted flesh of other, unknown sources.  A ragged orb pressed against the face of a jar of pickled giblets looks alarmingly like an eye.

title: [Belted My Way]
description: The strong smell of vanilla tobacco smoke permeates the air of this small area.  Situated in the center of the wagon is a large coat rack that hangs a variety of belts.  A glass-beaded curtain serves as the only entrance and exit to this small wagon.

title: [Hang'em High]
description: Hanging lanterns cast a gloomy light on the area, the dim illuminating highlight bits of metallic confetti littering the foliage of some shrubs growing to the east.  A few scraggly trees have had their spindly branches tied with streamers in an attempt to add an air of festiveness.

Sunlight highlights the colorful confetti littering the foliage of some shrubs growing to the east, particularly the small bits of metallic paper.  A few scraggly trees have had their spindly branches tied with streamers in an attempt to add an air of festiveness.

title: [Hang'em High]
description: A three-legged stool has been placed at the base of a tall aspen tree along with a gnarled walking stick.  The aroma of peat mingles with a distinct mustiness of rotting wood.  Insects flit about, seeking suitable sustenance in this swamp, whether it be animal or adventurer.

title: [Hang'em High]
description: Some branches have been noticeably sawed off of the trees in the area, culminating in several piles a distance aways.  Just beyond that area is a small wagon with lit windows that emanates the sounds of merriment.

Some branches have been noticeably sawed off of the trees in the area, culminating in several piles a distance aways.  A few workers labor tirelessly, whittling the wood down to pointed sticks.  Parked just beyond them is a small wagon with a dingy blue roof.

title: [Hang'em High, Willow Tree]
description: A lone black willow tree stands among an otherwise drab landscape.  Creaks and croaks can be heard from all around, their sources obscured by the blanket of mist roiling through this part of the swamp.

title: [Hang'em High, Oak Tree]
description: Most of the trees in this clearing are dead, save for a swamp white oak tree.  Their spindly figures rise up from the thick mist like specters from the past.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Bald Cypress Arc]
description: Several discarded, broken mining tools lay in a heap near the edge of a steeply graded slope, a rust-colored circle of mud, devoid of plants, splaying out around them.  The remainder of the shoreline is crowded with black gum, which spill into the water to mix with larger stands of bald cypress trees draped with gray-green moss.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Bald Cypress Arc]
description: In the midst of the bald cypress trees littering the shore and the shallow, murky water, a single, massive buttonwood rises up, its cracked trunk thick, its many bare branches reaching in every direction.  Faint and distant, the sound of slowly dripping water drifts through the swamp.  A young boy sits on a rhimar chest on the bank, his gaze locked on a murky dark pool.

In the midst of the bald cypress trees littering the shore and the shallow, murky water, a single, massive buttonwood rises up, its cracked trunk thick, its many bare branches reaching in every direction.  Faint and distant, the sound of slowly dripping water drifts through the swamp.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Misty Shore]
description: A steady stream of bubbles breaks the water's surface here, only occasionally interrupted by a violent frothing as something below thrashes frenziedly.  Like strands of dead hair drifting from pond cypresses, long tendrils of moss hang down in massive curtains, their tangled masses wavering back and forth of their own accord and blocking any clear view deeper into the swampland.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Misty Shore]
description: Barely lit by the moonlight that spreads its arms over the swamp, thin white mist swirls and eddies around the shoreline, moving at the same pace as the current of the water.  Phantasmal tendrils wrap their skeletal fingers around the bald cypress grove that makes its home in the black water, clenching the trunks in a close grip before fading away and rising up elsewhere.

Barely lit by pale motes of sunlight that dance through the swamp, thin white mist swirls and eddies around the shoreline, moving at the same pace as the current of the water.  The mist thickens into a fog as it moves out over the rippling water, so thick further away that it completely blocks sight of anything that may lie in the distance.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Seven Hexes]
description: A huge collection of charms and fetishes dangles from the bald cypress branches overhanging this spot.  Pale mist covers the shoreline, disappearing abruptly at the water's edge.  Lily pads cover the surface, their petals overlapping each other, their blossoms a pale purple color that is especially vivid in the dank surroundings.

title: [House of Ebon and Ivory]
description: The wagon's interior is quite open in the center, with the walls splashed in a soft shade of off-white.  Flanking the back wall, an ivory shrine stands illuminated by a haze of pale light, and toward the left is a more dimly lit onyx shrine.  A mosaic of white marble and jet completely blankets the floor in bold, contrasting colors.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Misty Shore]
description: Steady waves lap against the shore, the noise loud and startling in the quiet swamp.  Black gum trees grow up just off-shore, with several fallen trunks surrounding the tempestuous, leaf-strewn water.  Further out, the dark water is completely still.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Duckweed Haven]
description: Slime-ridden plant life, duckweed, and fallen trees cover the water here, creating navigational barriers in almost every direction.  The result is brackish, standing water laced with a repugnant odor that smells like a cross between sulphur and a well-used animal's burrow.  Glistening in thin, feeble shafts of moonlight, the water appears to be as thick as grease, its waxy texture leaving a gooey residue on the nearby shore.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Green Shoreline]
description: Dotted with a plethora of tiny holes, the muck at the edge of shoreline appears solid.  Miniscule rivulets of water cut spiderweb-thin patterns through the dirt, exposing the limestone base underneath.  Overhead, the branches of cypress trees spread far and wide, their drooping limbs dripping with thick moss.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: The trees thin out here, leaving a large expanse of water between the shore and the next spot of solid land.  In between, lumps of dead, leafy refuse spot the water, shifting occasionally in the visible current.  At the edge of the shore, a large black stone rests beneath a black gum tree, the duo surrounded in a wide radius by nothing but the corpses of insects and small animals in various stages of decay.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Bald Cypress Arc]
description: Crawling over the shoreline, creepers seem to be slowly choking the life out a collection of white orchids, several of which already dangle, dead, within the grasp of the vines.  Barely moving, the water, black as night, stands still amid the bald cypress growth.  Small cooing sounds flit through the air from an unknown source.

title: [Belly of the Burghal]
description: The cabin sits at a crazy, tilted angle, turning walls into floor and ceiling and ceiling and floor into walls.  Upended shipping containers protrude from the sludge of mud and wet filth that has seeped into the chamber, the continued suck and draw of which threatens to eventually consume the vessel entirely.  A single hatch in the metal cladding of the crashed airship is the only viable entrance or egress, though even that is partially askew.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Eastern Walkway]
description: Pilings as thick as an average man's waist support the weathered planking of the walkway.  The black water beneath is glassy enough to see a clear reflection if you lean over the side.  Strangely enough, the eyes blinking back at you do not appear to be your own.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Eastern Walkway]
description: The crumbled end of the walkway has collapsed into the swamp below, with one piling uprooted and tipped on its side, and leaving no clear path further into the swamp.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Lily's Cradle]
description: An eerie quiet pervades the swamp.  Not even a hint of a rustle of life comes from beneath the poision ivy vines and shoreline brush or the overhead branches.  In the water, bald cypress trees form a loose semi-circle around the shore, the water within completely still.  Splinters of moonlight from above streak down on the black water to illuminate the single, ghost-like water lily that floats on the otherwise shadowy, unreflective surface.

An eerie quiet pervades the swamp.  Not even a hint of a rustle of life comes from beneath the poison ivy vines and shoreline brush or the overhead branches.  In the water, bald cypress trees form a loose semi-circle around the shore, the water within completely still.  Splinters of sunlight from above shine down on the brownish-black water to illuminate the single, radiant water lily that floats on the unreflective surface.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Bald Cypress Arc]
description: A gnarled tangle of creepers suffocates the little dry land in the area.  Breaking through the barrier of vines that float over the top of the water, bald cypresses rise up toward the heavens, their limber branches laden with thick, draping moss, their trunks surrounded by knobby knee growths that look like stunted stalagmites rising from the depths of the swamp.

title: [Close Yer Robe, Porch]
description: The wood plank flooring has rotten through in several places, leaving large holes in the surface and making walking here treacherous.  A dilapidated porch swing hangs from the listing tin roof that is so laden with rusty holes that it does not protect from the elements at all.  The paint on the railing has peeled almost completely, leaving the bare wood showing from beneath.  A layer of mold and grime coats every surface, including a trio of steps that leads down, and the frame of the open doorway that offers entrance.
