The paint on the railing has peeled almost completely, leaving the bare wood showing from beneath.  A layer of mold and grime coats every surface, including a trio of steps that leads down and the frame of the open doorway that offers entrance.

title: [Close Yer Robe]
description: Rotten wooden walls surround this dusty space.  Thick layers of cobwebs coat the windows and two hanging lanterns, dampening the light cast by each.  A series of shelves adorn the walls, their contents glittering dully in what little light comes through the dust and grime.  Tilted off its hinges, a black door leads into another room, though the view through the gaps affords only darkness.  The doorway to the porch remains open to the elements, and stray gusts of wind carry with them the stench of the swamp.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Bald Cypress Arc]
description: Trapped underneath the fallen trunks of three bald cypress trees, rough stonework breaches the water far from shore, with no indication of what lies beneath the water's surface.  Skirting the edge of the black, muddy banks, small ripples of water swish back-and-forth in violent measure.  The rapid movement fills the air with a soft, repetitive noise akin to nails scratching on flesh.

title: [Abandoned Church, Nave]
description: The interior of the church is overrun with moss and vegetation that has crept in through the entrance and the various rotted wood that mars the structure.  Upon the eastern side of the church, swamp water seeps in from the outside.  Old pews are used to display wares, which rest on grey linens.  A silk tapestry hangs from the rafters, displaying the Pantheon of Liabo.  A short flight of steps leads up to the pulpit.

title: [Abandoned Church, Pulpit]
description: Once able to overlook the entire church, sections of the roof have since collapsed and block the view.  Through the holes in the roof, the darkness from outside pours into the church.  Several old crates are scattered across the floor nearby a short flight of steps that lead back down to the nave.

Once able to overlook the entire church, sections of the roof have since collapsed and block the view.  Through the holes in the roof, the darkness from outside pours into the church.  Several old crates and boxes are scattered across the floor nearby a short flight of steps that lead back down to the nave.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Rotting Grounds]
description: Golden trumpet pitcher plants poke their heads out of the mass of ferns that covers the shore and then spreads out like a blanket over the water.  In between the verdant fronds, the brackish water is filled with the debris of dead leaves and rotting plant matter.  A sharply pungent aroma permeates the air, adding a layer to the prevalently damp odor of the swamp.

title: [Abandoned Tavern, Taproom]
description: Cobwebs hang from the water-damaged ceiling of the tavern, which has partially collapsed.  Puddles of filthy water and mud are scattered across the floorboards, each brimming with life that floats upon their surface.  The bartop is covered in several layers of dust, with the abandoned bottles of alcohol barely visible underneath it.

title: [Abandoned Tavern, Cellar]
description: Half of the cellar has sank into the Feywrot Mire, with the majority of the dank room flooded with muck and water.  A foul smell is heavy in the air.  Upon the areas that are still traversable, a stacked pile of old casks dominates the cellar.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Miner's Mark]
description: Meandering by with sluggish gurgling, the brackish water is filled with a thick, reddish-black muddy sludge reminiscent of coagulated blood.  A slight current pulls the mire around black gum trees and further out into the swamp, cutting a swath of deep color across the water's surface.  Surrounded by golden trumpet pitcher plants, a small wooden slab sticks out of one of the more solid lumps of shoreline.

title: [Abandoned Stronghold, Rotunda]
description: The stone structure, perhaps once serving as a military garrison, has been claimed mostly by the Feywrot Mire.  Old stairwells leading below are completely filled with swamp water and muck, offering no chance to explore the depths of the fortification, but a pitted iron ladder hangs from the ceiling leading up.  A rusted iron armor stand rests in the center of the room, with weapon racks surrounding it upon each wall.  Seemingly out of place, a corroded iron footlocker is pushed up against some rubble near the exit.

The stone structure, perhaps once serving as a military garrison, has been claimed mostly by the Feywrot Mire.  Old stairwells leading below are completely filled with swamp water and muck, offering no chance to explore the depths of the fortification, but a pitted iron ladder hangs from the ceiling leading up.  A rusted armor stand has been knocked over, and several weapon racks have been picked clean of inventory.  Shards of iron litter the floor throughout the stronghold.

title: [Abandoned Stronghold, Turret]
description: The top of the stronghold is no more than a crumbling crenallation, a shadow of its former glory.  Overlooking the Feywrot Mire, the view isn't as spectacular as it could be, given the overgrowth of the swamp blocking much of the scenery.  Several dog-faced gargoyles are perched on the turret, as if they were mounted to protect the stronghold.

title: [Rods Springs N' Blades]
description: Brightly colored safety ropes surround a central trapdoor, attempting to prevent the less wary from falling through it.  Polished modwir planks form the walls, floor and ceiling of the boarding cabin.  Coils of ropes and a pile of harnesses fill a corner of the sparse room, and a sturdy steel door leads into another area of the craft.  An iron-edged modwir sign rests against a nearby wall.

title: [Rods Springs N' Blades - Works]
description: This room is left bare except for a work table and a few chairs scattered about the area.  A few sconces adorn the walls, casting illumination upon the surroundings, and a sturdy steel door serves as the exit.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Cave]
description: Several musty crates have been pushed to one corner and covered with a mold-ridden cloth.  Pockmarks and holes dot the walls, their interiors alive with the gurgle of hidden water flow.  The stone floor is blanketed by a thick layer of dust, interrupted only by the passage of unseen vermin.  Resting near the cave mouth is a wooden chest, its lid hanging by a single hinge.  A stone opening leads deeper into the cave, flanked on both sides by torches stuck into the floor.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Passage]
description: The narrow stone passage is lined with several openings.  A half-collapsed passage, and a twisting side tunnel lead off to either side, while a stone opening and a rusted metal drainpipe stand at each end.  Oddly, the space is dimly lit by stumpy candles resting in sconces that line the stone walls on both sides of the passage.  A single high shelf adorns the stone wall between two such sconces.

The narrow stone passage is lined with several openings.  A half-collapsed passage, and a twisting side tunnel lead off to either side, while a stone opening and a rusted metal drainpipe stand at each end.  Oddly, the space is dimly lit by stumpy candles resting in sconces that line the stone walls on both sides of the passage.  A single high shelf adorns the stone wall, situated above a low table and between two such sconces.

The narrow stone passage is lined with several openings.  A half-collapsed passage and a twisting side tunnel lead off to either side, while a stone opening and a rusted metal drainpipe stand at each end.  The space is dimly lit by stumpy candles resting in sconces that line the stone walls on both sides of the passage.  A single high shelf adorns the stone wall, situated above a low table and between two such sconces.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Pipe]
description: Lit by the candlelight that filters in from the mouth of the drainpipe, the floor is revealed to have long gone dry.  The curved metal has begun to rust, revealing the mottled stone and earthen surface underneath.  One particular hole in the curved wall gapes like an open mouth in the dim lighting.  The other end of the pipe terminates in a landslide of rocks, dirt, and debris.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Limestone Strand]
description: The peat in most of this spot has been trampled away, exposing the sand and limestone beneath.  In one direction, however, the reeds and grass grow taller, and a narrow passageway leads through their arching verdancy.  At the edge of the black water, a large, heavily charred stump is nearly obscured by the moss hanging from the black gum tree branches overhead.  In comparison, not a single strand of moss drapes over the black ash trees that dot both land and water.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Primal Stand]
description: Several black gum trees and bald cypresses lean to one side or another, their branches caressing the swampy water and the limestone shoreline.  Several of the trees are clearly very old, their massive trunks covered in knots, their branches shot through with char, while others are little more than saplings growing up amid the tall brush.

title: [The Skeptic]
description: Faded walls of rotting timber are haphazardly covered in areas with dusty green silk draperies.  A cracked, foggy glass window looks outward into the darkness of the swamp.  In complete contrast to the dilapidation, lush carmine carpet covers the floor from a carved-arch doorway to the next wagon.  Displaying a series of wares, a rich hazelnut case and a polished brass rack reside in the two far corners.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: Standing among clumps of wildly tall, arching ferns, the ancient trees that rise up toward the sky all bear char marks.  The thickness of the brush makes it difficult to see in any direction, and it is impossible to tell where the waterline resides.  Echoing through the area, quiet dripping sounds emanate from somewhere on the shore.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Beyond the Brush]
description: The wild overgrowth here is briefly interrupted by the end of a faint path, which leads through the dense brush and toward the din and glow of the festival grounds.  The trail continues deeper into the mire, flanked closely by a wide variety of coarse vegetation.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: Thick reeds hug the shore, blurring the line between liquid and solid.  A wing, not fully stripped of its tan spotted feathers, floats half in and half out of the shallow dark water.  A collection of owl pellets nearby displays its collection of tiny desiccated bones poking out of the disintegrating scat.  A white-washed, flat-bottomed barge has run aground, mired helplessly just a few feet from shore.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: The brackish water flows past the shoreline so slowly that floating debris makes nearly imperceptible progress.  A swath of flattened reeds and grasses leads from the water's edge to a raised berm of debris.  Remnants of a single broken eggshell are all that mark this as a now abandoned empty nest.

The brackish water flows past the shoreline so slowly that floating debris makes nearly imperceptible progress.  A swath of flattened reeds and grasses leads from the water's edge to a raised berm of debris.  Nestled just to the side of the detritus, a weathered plank footbridge leads over a narrow span of water.  Remnants of a single broken eggshell are all that mark this as a now abandoned empty nest.

title: [Frosted Landings, West]
description: Lacquered bamboo poles provide structural support for the various layers of violet and grey silk that create the walls and ceiling of the domed pavilion.  Tiny copper lanterns provide soft illumination for the area and illuminate the silvery whorls that decorate the cedar panels of the floor.  Sitting alone in the center of the room, a small display case offers a view of the wares for sale.

title: [Frosted Landings, East]
description: Shades of violet silk enshroud the ceiling and walls of the western section of pavilion, while the eastern walls are banded with misty grey chainsil.  Dark bamboo supports help the distant ceiling to maintain its conical form, while frosted globes of blown glass dangle throughout the area and illuminate the room in an eerie white glow.  Surrounded by copper censers, a cloth-covered circular table displays a small selection of wares.

title: [Enchant It Yourself]
description: Dented bronze and glass pane lanterns hang from thick overhead beams of darkened fel.  Threadbare azure and silver banners are hung on the walls of the wagon and a dingy grey carpet covers most of the floor.  A legless statue sits in a corner, arranged so its lifeless gaze rests on a series of reinforced mannequins and a row of steel pegs.

title: [From Hair to There, Showroom]
description: The walls of the east wing are neatly lined with shelves containing a collection of glass vases and rows of glass hooks.  The walls of the wagon have been whitewashed, and stencilled with colorful autumnal leaves and flowers.  A varnished oak counter has been tucked into the corner of the room.

title: [From Hair to There, Alcove]
description: Draped in deep plum velvet swathes of fabric, and scattered with multicolored overstuffed cushions, the alcove serves as a vibrant area for creative work to take place.  Cotton threads and flower petals are strewn across a thick oak desk and the surrounding floor space, and half made garments and flower arrangements lay haphazardly around the room.

title: [Jangling Junker, Midship]
description: The first striking thing noticeable about this mid-sized ship is the sheer amount of junk it is capable of carrying.  A thin maze contorts through towers of old furniture and refuse that lean precariously against each other for support.  Overhead, lines have been drawn from mast to mast in order to hang discarded remnants of armor and old pots and pans that jangle together as the ship rocks on the current.  Claustrophobic paths lead towards the bow and stern.

title: [Sloop, Ocean Voyage]
description: Beneath the single mast, the deck of the ship is scrubbed clean.  A large illegible plaque rests above the captain's quarters with a bleached white skull hanging from it.  Stretching from one end of the ship to the other, coils of ropes sit neatly beneath cleats.

title: [Black Banyan, Crown]
description: At the crown, the topmost boughs of the banyan brush the sides of the platform, cradling it in a dense tangle of wildly growing branches.  Burning torches are affixed to the rope railing that marks off the edge of the drop, beyond which is the ground, far below.  A spiraling staircase in the center of the landing leads back down into the heart of the tree.

title: [Black Banyan, Overlook]
description: A truncated limb, growing out from the bulk of the tree, forms a balcony extending into open space.  The ledge's edge is bounded with a net of woven ropes.  Hanging over the abyss below is a single lit lantern.  A pocket in the banyan's trunk leads back into its woody interior.

title: [Dilapidated Party Boat, Bar]
description: A curved oak bar commands the far side of the party boat, clearly a place for libations and celebrations.  A scalloped, tattered banner frames the bar in faded colors of red and white, and stools of questionable integrity provide unstable seating.  A railing squares in an area for people to congregate away from the bar while taking in the soggy scenery of the swamp.  To the left of the bar, an oval door leads into the wheel room.

title: [The Wheel Room]
description: The wooden beams above sag with the soggy burden of age and abandon.  At the center of a room, a ship's wheel hints at the boat's former grandeur with its copper-covered handles; the once lustrous metal is now dulled by a grimy patina.  Dirt-covered windows provide only a hazy view of the outside, and damp cushions provide an awkward seating arrangement on the wood floor.  A rickety oval door leads back to the party boat.

title: [Rods Springs N' Blades - Sharp]
description: Several display tables occupy the room.  Drawings of various ideas and contraptions adorn the walls and a pile of crates fills the farthest corner.

title: [Rods Springs N' Blades - Point]
description: Only a series of display cases and a work table covered in designs occupy this room.

title: [Rods Springs N' Blades - Blunt]
description: A variety of crates are stacked to the side of the room, taking up the majority of the space to walk.  Several display racks are pushed to the side, displaying a variety of weapons.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Tunnel]
description: The passage is almost completely dark, only illuminated by the light from the candles that filters in through the mouth of the tunnel.  A faint trickle of water can be heard from somewhere in the back of the room, the sound reverberating in the small space.  Just within the dim pool of light, a slatted wooden crate rests on its side, its contents threatening to spill out onto the stone floor.

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Cavern]
description: The wall of fallen rocks terminates at a small underground pool.  Murky and stagnant, the water smells faintly of rotting meat and sewage.  A high stone ceiling rises above the cavern, and patterns of light reflected off the pool dance on its pebbled surface.  The large space is illuminated by glowing green florescence in the water.  A niche in the wall contains several lumpy shapes.  The only way out of this room is a small opening high above the rockslide.

title: [The Skeptic]
description: Overhead, spiderwebs cling to the ceiling, which is hung with two tarnished, three-piece chandeliers.  Several platinum, free-standing racks take up the center of the wagon's space, their metal as shiny and bright as the vividness of the carmine flooring they stand on.  On every side, the walls of the wagon appear old and unkempt, including a door framed by a gooey black substance.

Overhead, spiderwebs cling to the ceiling, which is hung with two tarnished, three-piece chandeliers.  Several platinum, free-standing racks and a hazelnut armoire take up the main of the wagon's space, their metal as shiny and bright as the vividness of the carmine flooring they stand on.  Save for the area directly around an oval archway, the walls and a door, which is framed by a gooey black substance, appear old and unkempt.

Overhead, spiderwebs cling to the ceiling, which is hung with two tarnished, three-piece chandeliers.  Several platinum, free-standing racks and a hazelnut armoire take up the main of the wagon's space, their metal as shiny and bright as the vividness of the carmine flooring they stand on.  The walls and a door, which is framed by a gooey black substance, appear old and unkempt.

title: [The Skeptic's Retreat]
description: Providing bright, sunshine-like illumination, several golden sconces hanging around the wagon hold white candles cased in glass.  A series of pale and dark green rugs is spread atop the rich carmine carpet, and over those, several chairs and cushions provide spaces for repose.  Matched to the green rugs in color, silk drapes over the walls and frame a door, and the ceiling is painted with various religious symbols.

title: [The Affluent]
description: Next to an oval archway, several wooden shelves are lined with folded shirts and tunics.  A large cabinet displays a selection of pants, and another set of sunken shelves displays a variety of vests.  Standing in the center of the room, a selection of jackets and coats hangs from a rack resting atop the lush ebon bearskin rug covering the flooring.  A shoe trunk rests in the corner.

Next to an oval archway, several rune-carved shelves are lined with folded shirts and tunics.  Shuttered light filters through several foggy windows, illuminating a hazlewood cabinet and a set of hazelwood shelves with a dim glow.  Standing in the center of the cobweb-hung room, a rack rests atop the lush spotted owl rug that partially covers a faded crimson carpet.  A shoe trunk rests in the corner, surrounded by sticks of incense that emit a sharp, bitter orange aroma.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Overgrown Path]
description: The overgrown path ends abruptly at the edge of a stone basin containing a large shimmering pool of clear, dimly luminescent water.  Beyond the edge of the pool, the mire stretches out into the far distance, thick with rolling fog and creeping sounds.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Pool]
description: Ankle-deep cool, clear water fills the area, lapping lightly at the edge of the basin.  Worked in the same stone as the surrounding basin, an elaborate statue dominates the center of the pool.  The gentle babble of running water disturbs the otherwise quiet and calm nature of this place.  Starlight overhead blankets the night sky.

Ankle-deep cool, clear water fills the area, lapping lightly at the edge of the basin.  Worked in the same stone as the surrounding basin, an elaborate statue dominates the center of the pool.  The gentle babble of running water disturbs the otherwise quiet and calm nature of this place.

title: [Wasp Your Back, Buzzly's Den]
description: Aimlessly constructed walls and an uneven floor of hardened mud form an unusual living space.  To the northeast, the floor tapers into a corner that disappears from sight as it slopes perilously downward.

title: [Tug-of-War, Elm Knoll]
description: Rows of elm benches are clustered atop a gently sloping knoll, providing a clear view of a span of trenched swampland below.  Bits and pieces of rope and clothing litter the area, each stained with blood, mud, and a multitude of unrecognized substances.

title: [Tug-of-War, Elm Field]
description: Blocking the sky with their interwoven canopies, a number of twisted and gnarled trees have grown to form walls around a field of swamp grasses and wildflowers.  Thick rattan posts support burning torches, which cast flickering light over a pair of long, shallow trenches divided by a 10-foot wide pit.  The remnants of previous battles lie scattered in and around the trenches, primarily broken sections of thick, rotted rope.  Just behind the pit, a yellow and red sign is prominently placed at the edge of the field.

title: [Tug-of-War, Willow Knoll]
description: Rows of willow benches are clustered atop a gently sloping knoll, providing a clear view of a span of trenched swampland below.  Bits and pieces of rope and clothing litter the area, each stained with blood, mud, and a multitude of unrecognized substances.

title: [Tug-of-War, Cottonwood Knoll]
description: Rows of cottonwood benches are clustered atop a gently sloping knoll, providing a clear view of a span of trenched swampland below.  Bits and pieces of rope and clothing litter the area, each stained with blood, mud, and a multitude of unrecognized substances.

title: [Tug-of-War, Cottonwood Field]
description: Blocking the sky with their interwoven canopies, a number of twisted and gnarled trees have grown to form walls around a field of swamp grasses and wildflowers.  Thick rattan posts support burning torches, which cast flickering light over a pair of long, shallow trenches divided by a 10-foot wide pit.  The remnants of previous battles lie scattered in and around the trenches, primarily broken sections of thick, rotted rope.  Just behind the pit, a green and red sign is prominently placed at the edge of the field.

title: [Tug-of-War, Aspen Field]
description: Blocking the sky with their interwoven canopies, a number of twisted and gnarled trees have grown to form walls around a field of swamp grasses and wildflowers.  Thick rattan posts support burning torches, which cast flickering light over a pair of long, shallow trenches divided by a 10-foot wide pit.  The remnants of previous battles lie scattered in and around the trenches, primarily broken sections of thick, rotted rope.  Just behind the pit, a green and yellow sign is prominently placed at the edge of the field.

title: [Calantha's Caravan, Work Space]
description: The cramped area at the rear of this caravan has a single cushioned folding stool positioned in front of a wall-to-wall oak counter spread with organized boxes of wares.  Above the counter is a recessed alcove stocked with bits of chalk, a spool of measuring cord, and a pinking iron.  A miniature silver crown chandelier is suspended from the ceiling on a short chain, casting flickering candlelight on a collection of rose pink silk pillows.

title: [The Bearded Dome]
description: Brimming with moss and vines, artfully stacked rocks flank either side of the winding path.  The rocky formations house a number of shadowy niches created by the naturally occurring gaps between the stones.  Twisted branches from small trees arc overhead, darkening the area with its foliage.

title: [The Bearded Dome]
description: An assortment of small trees in boulder-shaped planters have been placed in this section of the tent; their branches strewn with vines, among other things.  The path curves along a water-filled stone basin to the north.  Upon the artificial pond are lily pads that serve as perches for a few tiny frogs.  Soft croaks punctuate the overall serenity of the area.

title: [The Bearded Dome]
description: Thick green moss blankets most of the boulders and smaller rocks in the nearby vicinity.  The path terminates at a small thatched-roof hut that is partially obscured by a tall shrubs and leafy trees.  A roughly carved totem depicting a bearded humanoid stands guard over the structure.

title: [The Bearded Dome, Hut]
description: A rickety wooden table and a woven mat that has seen better days serve as the only decoration in this sparse tent.  The thatched roof obscures all view of the dome above, though windows within the stone walls offer glimpses of the artificial environment created within the confines of the larger tent.

title: [Lovely Lacings, Underskirts]
description: A pair of freestanding ebonwood shelves take up most of the room in this area, placed opposite from one another and piled with garments.  Several mismatched electrum lanterns are strung from chains above both, all cradling flickering amethyst candles.  Pushed between one shelf and the velvet drapery wall is a single oak crate with the lid half wedged off.

title: [Lovely Lacings, Ribbons]
description: Two carved ebonwood tables stand side-by-side here, pushed up against the amethyst velvet walls of the pavilion.  On top of each table are intricate electrum jewelry trees, draped with a variety of colorful fabrics.  Nestled between the leg of one table and the edge of a plush throw rug is a lidless cloth-lined box.

title: [Lovely Lacings, Sleeves]
description: This portion of the pavilion is crammed full of wooden dress forms, oddly bare except their arms.  An ornate electrum crown chandelier is suspended from the apex of the ebonwood poles that support the heavy velvet walls and ceiling, bathing the area in a soft, candlelit glow.  One dress form is tilted slightly, propped off-balance by an abandoned piece of chalk beneath its base.

title: [Lovely Lacings, Buttons]
description: Lengths of heavy amethyst velvet hang down from the ceiling in this part of the pavilion, draping nearly to the floor.  Attached to the ebonwood supports, small frosted glass globes provide a soft glowing illumination, drawing attention to the wares pinned to the swathes of fabric.  A few stray buttons are scattered on the ground, long ago discarded underfoot.

title: [Lovely Livery, Doublets]
description: Two sturdy silver stands, devoid of any extraneous ornamentation or embellishment, stand in the center of this room.  Suspended from the mistwood supports are frosted glass globes tinted a pale silver hue that match the overlapping throw rugs on the ground.  Small votives glimmer inside the glass spheres, banishing encroaching shadows.

title: [Lovely Livery, Gowns]
description: Tall mistwood armoires carved with an all-over vine pattern are set at opposite ends of this room, their doors thrown open to display various dresses in sumptuous fabrics.  Partially hidden in shadow, a heap of discarded garments and a wooden dress form are piled behind a silver-framed glass mirror.

title: [Lovely Livery, Bodices]
description: The mistwood support poles bracing the silken ceiling and walls are fitted with silver hooks to display the shop's wares.  Two tall standing candelabra flank a matching silver rack, creating a soft glow that illuminates the merchandise.

title: [Lovely Livery, Skirts]
description: A veritable forest of mistwood support poles fills this area, each outfitted with a descending spiral of pegs upon which wares are displayed.  Winding through the pathway between the shafts are overlapping runners in silver and blue silk, neatly covering the ground.  A silver-trimmed wood trunk is shoved up against one silken wall, overflowing with chemises, petticoats, and other feminine underpinnings.

title: [A Game Of Throwns, Red Range]
description: Creating a narrow corridor, large bales of hay line both sides of the hurling range.  A pair of modwir poles flying deep, crimson silk streamers flanks a rounded red target.  Even from this distance, a whimsical alligator can be seen in the center, with rings radiating out from its body.

title: [A Game Of Throwns, Blue Range]
description: Creating a narrow corridor, large bales of hay line both sides of the hurling range.  A pair of modwir poles flying deep, cerulean silk streamers flanks a rounded blue target.  Even from this distance, a cute skunk can be seen in the center, with rings radiating out from its body.

title: [A Game Of Throwns, Gold Range]
description: Creating a narrow corridor, large bales of hay line both sides of the hurling range.  A pair of modwir poles flying brilliant, golden silk streamers flanks a rounded bright yellow target.  Even from this distance, a curled snake can be seen in the center, with rings radiating out from its body.

title: [A Game Of Throwns, White Range]
description: Creating a narrow corridor, large bales of hay line both sides of the hurling range.  A pair of modwir poles flying brilliant, alabaster silk streamers flanks a rounded white target.  Even from this distance, a large swamp spider can be seen in the center, with rings radiating out from its body.

title: [A Game Of Throwns, Green Range]
description: Creating a narrow corridor, large bales of hay line both sides of the hurling range.  A pair of modwir poles flying deep, verdant silk streamers flanks a rounded green target.  Even from this distance, a comical beaver can be seen in the center, with rings radiating out from its body.

title: [A Feast For Bows, Red Range]
description: Large bales of hay line both sides of the archery range.  An oak pole towers above the rounded red target, flying a deep crimson pennant.  Even from this distance, rings can be seen circling the bull's eye in the center.

title: [A Feast For Bows, Blue Range]
description: Large bales of hay line both sides of the archery range.  An oak pole towers above the rounded blue target, flying a deep cerulean pennant.  Even from this distance, rings can be seen circling the bull's eye in the center.

title: [A Feast For Bows, Gold Range]
description: Large bales of hay line both sides of the archery range.  An oak pole towers above the rounded yellow target, flying a shimmering golden pennant.  Even from this distance, rings can be seen circling the bull's eye in the center.

title: [A Feast For Bows, White Range]
description: Large bales of hay line both sides of the archery range.  An oak pole towers above the rounded white target, flying a brilliant, alabaster pennant.  Even from this distance, rings can be seen circling the bull's eye in the center.

title: [A Feast For Bows, Green Range]
description: Large bales of hay line both sides of the archery range.  An oak pole towers above the rounded green target, flying a bright verdant pennant.  Even from this distance, rings can be seen circling the bull's eye in the center.

title: [The Goblin Oddity, The Rolton]
description: Boxes and crates are piled on top of each other, cluttering the small room.  Nestled into the northern wall is a bent iron cage housing a multi-horned tusked rolton.  A fierce smell emits from the rolton's cage.  A large sign hanging over the cage reads, "Wolton bites!  Eats fingurs."

title: [The Goblin Oddity, The Burgee]
description: Spanning the entire room is a wide algae-stained glass tank filled with brackish water.  Within the depths of the liquid is an enormous peat-covered burgee.  Strewn across the floor are the decaying remains of fish heads and other various sea creatures.  A large sign hanging over the tank reads, "Noos tap da glass!"

title: [The Goblin Oddity, The Urgh]
description: Hanging from the ceiling is an oversized birdcage contains a miniature winged black urgh.  Below the cage, a scattering of filth lines the floor.  A small ladder is propped up against the northern wall, but all the rungs are broken.  A large sign hanging from the birdcage reads, "No open da cage, or urgh flies aways."

title: [The Goblin Oddity, The Thyril]
description: Taking up most of the room, a wide iron cage harbors a severely deformed thyril.  The bars of the cage are bent and twisted, as if the thyril has tried to escape from its prison.  An oily substance seeps out from the cage and into a puddle on the floor.  A large sign hanging over the cage reads, "Thyril meen!  Claws sharp!  No pets!"

title: [Frippery in the Fen, Heat]
description: Standing against one wall, a trio of colorful mannequins displays their bright and vivid wares.  A central pole carved of white oak stands tall creating a peaked ceiling, a large narrow mirror hanging from its length.  A wooden partition of slatted modwir creates a small dressing space, several discarded items draped over the top.

title: [Frippery in the Fen, Neutral]
description: Placed in each corner of the canopied area, three mannequins stand as sentinels, their muted garb elegant, yet demure.  A pair of ebon silk partitions creates a circular dressing space centered with the tall oak pole holding the cotton roof in place.  A large ebonwood mirror rests near the entrance, several lengths of material wrapped around the stand.

title: [Tome Alone]
description: Octagonal lanterns hang from the tanik beams of the roof, illuminating the interior of the wagon.  Ink stains almost every surface imaginable, creating a colorful assortment of drips, drops, splatters, and in some places, doodles.  An ink-stained modwir desk, bolted to the floor, shows an assortment of books on its flat surface.  Mounted on the wall is a hammered mithril and ora bin, proudly displaying a number of tubes and cylinders.

title: [Abandoned Church, Chancel]
description: Unlike the rest of the church, the chancel is restored almost to its former glory.  Varnished wood paneling encloses the room, with religious relics displayed upon it.  A glossy stone floor leads up to a gold-inlaid ironwood lectern and branches off toward the east and west.  To the north of the chancel is an ornate crown-shaped altar carved from white oak, which creates a dominating presence in the church.  Behind the altar is a stained-glass mosaic of the Great Drakes, their forms barely visible due to the lack of moonlight.

title: [Close Yer Robe, Storage]
description: This room is dark save for what little light manages to flicker forth from an oil lantern hanging from the ceiling.  The glass is sooty and almost completely obscured by dust and cobwebs, casting strange shadows on the walls.  Grimy dressers and wardrobes clutter the edges of the room, their contents open to the air.  A plank from the floor sits askew, allowing a draft to seep up from below through the hole, and the black door leading out is tilted off its hinges.

title: [Close Yer Robe, Cellar]
description: Shadows reign in this subterranean room.  The only light filters down from above, barely illuminating the rungs of a rickety wooden ladder that leads down from a hole in the ceiling.  The dirty floor is littered with refuse and scraps of metal, making walking around dangerous with the dim state of the area.  The smell of decay emanates strongly from one corner, beneath what looks like a pile of stained rags.

title: [Round 'Em Up, Raceway]

title: [Round 'Em Up, Raceway]
description: Set halfway down the racetrack, a colorful awning provides a place for spectators to comfortably watch, several wooden benches are placed underneath.  Bales of hay line the course ensuring those racing stay on course.  To the east, a long red ribbon can be seen, its color marking the finish line.

title: [Round 'Em Up, Finishline]
description: Colorful pennants fly along the raceway, comical roltons painted upon each one.  A wide red ribbon is stretched across the track, each end tied to the post of a split-rail fence.  A large colorful awning can be seen to the west, its bright material drawing attention to the starting line and a view of the large barn wall.

title: [Trolling the Swamp, Smoke Room]
[The Eyes Have It, Smoke Room]
description: Candlelight and censer smoke come together in a heady rush at the center of the longhouse, crawling in gold-washed clouds over a raised, circular platform of raw planks bordered on all sides by seething muck.  Trailing ends of broken vines and strips of hanging bark dangle from the edges of a gaping hole in the ceiling, through which the moonlight skies beckon.  The uncertain luminescence does little to throw back the gathered shadows.

description: Suspended over frothing swamp water by ropes of braided vine, the tiny platform of packed mud and wood sways precipitously, like a ship tossed in a storm. title: [Trolling the Swamp, Masks]
[The Eyes Have It, Masks]
description: Hanging from the walls are masks great and small, the products of a rough but talented hand.  To a one, they are possessed of a primal, terrible beauty, looking like living creatures of vibrant lacquer and ornamental wood.  Talismans dangle from the ceiling from braided lengths of hair, catgut, and leather, ranging from corroded coins to tiny skulls and bundles of bones.

title: [Trolling the Swamp, Madstones]
[The Eyes Have It, Madstones]
description: The air is heavy with the scent of rot and death, the overpowering odor rising from sucking mud that threatens to consume the narrow pathway of log planks hugging the living walls of the longhouse.  Madstones and bezoars clack together over a partially-submerged chest in reach of the path, the ebony construction warped and its silver barding tarnished.

description: Toppled on its side, an enormous banyan tree stretches across the pathway and lies its head into the stagnant waters of the nearby stream. A series of tiny black capped mushrooms grow in the dark shelter of the fallen tree.

A large pine table bolted to the deck sits at the center with a heavy chair behind it, while a large bunk fills the deck space beneath the grimy stern windows.

title: [Erythro Island, Beach]
description: The cold waters give way to the long shoreline of the island where the wind has died down into a small breeze.  Further up the beach the land transforms into a thick wooded forest, where large foot prints lead down from the woodland's edge to the water upon the shore.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Floor-to-ceiling bars form a latticework of wrought iron cells along the port side.  Large, brackets bolted to the bulkhead and planks overhead hold the iron bars in place and have been covered in tar to prevent rusting.  Occasionally, an enormous rat scurries between sealed barrels marked with large black X's; some even sit lazily in open sight, unperturbed.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Tucked between two of the cells, and well out of reach, is a copper-chained pump system mounted into a bucket-like sump in the floor.  A long, cast-iron lever stands motionless despite the sound of gurgling water that occasionally sloshes up out of the sump to wet the pitch-slathered deck.  A slight warping in the wooden planks and watermarks on the oaken bulkheads bear testament to the ravages of water within the area at some point in the past.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Liette's Magic Shoppe]

[Liette's Magic Shoppe]

Beneath an etched seaglass ceiling, a cherrywood framed oil portrait hangs on one of the blue-speckled sea glass walls.  Some stained driftwood shelves and a Vornavian silk-covered table sit in opposite corners while some puffed raw silk pillows rests on a swirled sea glass floor.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: The edge of the forest grows thick, as if nature's way of keeping out intruders, or perhaps imprisoning something within.  Passage is possible, but the narrow gaps keep movement slow and cautious.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: Dense ironwood trees rise up into the reddish sky, their thick branches blanketing the ground in natural shadows.  The roar of an animal can be heard from the darkness beyond.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: The tops of trees sway as if something large moves through the woodlands beyond.  Deep foot prints mark the ground nearby.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: Flies buzz around a pile of bear droppings and the sound of peculiar birds squawk in the trees high above.  The density of the forest begins to break up and more than a few worn paths curve throughout.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: Decayed corpses lie in piles scattered about this part of the woodlands, their gruesome bodies still intact and laid down as if resting, waiting for the moment they will wake.  Despite the compactness of the forest, a cold chill from the ocean still finds its way through the trees.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: A chorus of mournful wails eerily fill the forest, their cries sounding forlorn and distant.  Birds take to the sky, dark silhouettes against the ruddy sky.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: The walls of the tunnel are unnaturally smooth and their surfaces covered in dark blood.  Small radiant red orbs hover throughout the underground passageway, their scarlet light bathing the area in a crimson glow.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: The tunnel's walls appear to have been faintly colored by dark crimson brushstrokes, their surfaces grainy and covered with lumps.  An eerie crimson glow infuses the tunnel.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: Pools of blood coalesce along the bottom of the tunnel's walls, small bubbles rising up and popping on their surfaces.  Hanging upside-down  from the ceiling are a number of bats, their sleek black wings folded protectively around their bodies.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: Tortured faces periodically appear within the bloody surfaces soaking the walls.  Motes of crimson light hover about the area.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: Tiny blood red spiders crawl along the walls, skittering about in a hurry.  Drops of blood drip from the ceiling, soaking into the ground.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: A bat flies overhead, its tiny beady red eyes matching the hue of the tunnel's walls.  Tiny hand prints appear along the tunnel, pressing out from the blood wall before disappearing.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: Dark shadows move underneath the layer of blood covering the walls, their large forms resembling worms burrowing through the earth.  The very ground here shifts slightly, as if something is moving underneath.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: Large blood-red blobs begin to protrude from the sides of the walls, causing the tunnel to narrow sharply. The blood soaking the area churns along the ground.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: The crimson glow is dim here as light from a nearby opening begins to offer new illumination.  The walls glisten with countless amounts of blood, the red liquid endlessly crawling down the walls.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: A large opening in the passageway allows some light to shine within, pushing back the crimson glow of the tunnel.  The amount of blood has greatly diminished as much of the walls hold their natural earthy tone.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: The blasted ground is covered by a lattice of crimson veins, all zig-zagging in different directions, but each one coming to a point near a large tunnel burrowed into the side of a wall.  Globules of blood drip from the tunnel's wide opening, quickly absorbing into the dirt.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: Large rocks are piled at the bottom of a wall, a skeletal body barely visible underneath.  The blood red veins along the ground move in closer, creating a crimson web as it stretches to the north.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: A thin fog hovers at the bottom of the crater, drifting about slowly even with no wind present.  Periodically among the mist, ethereal faces appear, their mouths open in silent screams.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: The veins along the ground seem to pulsate with life, each one leading off in many different directions and disappearing into the rocky surroundings.  A bizarre crimson slime clings to part of the walls, slowly crawling upwards.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: The crater's bottom stretches far and wide, the air eerily still and stagnant.   Strange blood red veins cover the entire ground.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: The rocky trail is the fullest here, its path solid and unmoving as it spirals along the walls of the crater.  Every few moments a small stone falls down from above, skipping across the jagged earthen walls before landing at the crater's bottom.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: The earthen walls are engulfed in shadows, the crater's bottom not far away.  A skeletal hand sticks out of the crater's side.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: Dark clouds still stretch out above the crater's opening high above, bathing the area in deep shadows.  The narrow trail is unstable at best, made all the more dangerous by the engulfing darkness.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: Narrow and uncertain, the trail curls around the crater's interior as loose specks of dirt shift along the walls like moving sand.  Thick shadows cling to the walls, drastically lowering the temperature.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: Jagged rubble creates dangerous obstacles along the winding trail within the crater.  Periodically, dirt shifts from above and crumbles down the crater's walls.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: The rocky trail is precarious here as it winds along the inside of the crater.  Clouds from above cast much of the area in shadows.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater]
description: The crater's rim dips now, creating a descending path that begins to move down into the earthen bowl itself.  The wind slowly subsides as the rocky trails leads down.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: A dip in the rim creates a rocky trail that leads down into the basin.  The earthen perimeter ends at a flight of polished stone stairs that lead up to a huge sandstone keep that looms high in the air, towering above the crater.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: A set of polished stairs leads up to a thick stone wall that encompasses a towering sandstone keep.   A thin layer of frost clings to the sides of the walls.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: The wind wails about strongly, muffling the sounds of the environs.  Cracks run along the fractured ground, making an uneven path around the rim.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: High overhead, dark storm clouds break up the reddish-orange sky.  The wall's perimeter stretches on, providing an angled view of a courtyard down below.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: Among the high clouds, the silhouette of griffins can be seen soaring overhead.  Their shrieks penetrating the arctic air.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: Blocks of alabaster have been stacked here along the length of the wall, their placement resembling the rough beginnings of golem sentries.  A tiny flutter of snowflakes drifts in from a nearby storm.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: The high wall continues to wind around the keep, providing a view of both the thick forest and crater to the southwest, as well as the arctic ocean and storms to the north and east.  The shrieks of griffins squawk from above.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: The body of a frost golem has toppled over, a huge gaping hole in its chest.  The construct's body has crushed a part of the stone wall.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: The view of the rest of the island is blocked by the towering granite keep that rises up from within the center of the walls.  To the north dark clouds churn above the murky arctic waters.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: A freezing wind sweeps in from the ocean, chilling this area of the wall.  A thin layer of ice cakes the walkway, making travel precarious.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: This section of the wall lingers in darkness, trapped between the dark storm and the shadow of the keep.  Booming thunder echoes from the north.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: The stone wall has completely collapsed here making any further travel around the keep impossible.  A fraying rope hangs down the side of the wall and lowers into the open courtyard below.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: Old bones are spread about, many of them covered in teeth marks.  Gusts of wind will blow across the rim, scattering the bones even further.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: Loose debris covers the ground, ranging from broken shards of metal to clumps of dirt and rock.  Resounding thunder from above shakes the rim.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: The rim is narrower here, providing a closer glimpse to the bowl below but also offering precarious footing.  Winds continue to pick up.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: The head of a glaes golem has been wedged into the ground, its eyes hollow and cold.  Old stains have discolored the side of the construct's face.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: The wind begins to pick up here, howling across the rim and stirring dirt and pebbles as it does.  The forest is still visible from here and a few trees waver slightly.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: Storm clouds churn overhead and seem to be thickest over the actual crater itself.  Bolts of crimson lightning blast into the basin, striking beyond what the eye can see.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: Along the rim's perimeter, piles of animal bones leave little room for fast movement.  A small wind blows across the broken ground.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: Jagged glaes shards jut out from the cracked ground and red lightning crackles overheard.  A massive crater stretches out beyond the rim, a drop reaching hundreds of feet.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: The ground has turned a dull grey and little foliage remains as the dark of the forest is left behind.  The sky above still holds a ruddy hue, broken up only by billowing black clouds.  A dirt trail leads across the broken landscape to the rim of a massive crater.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: What trees are left have all been blackened and warped, their trunks seemingly scorched and their branches arched downward as if sagging from a heavy burden.  Up ahead the forest completely fades as the rim of a crater comes into view.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: The area begins to open wider now, the trees becoming more sparse.  A natural trail is revealed, leading further east as the forest diminishes.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: Clusters of trees surround the trail as it winds its way along the landscape.  Light from the reddish-orange sky shines through openings within the canopies above.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: An ironwood tree lies snapped in two, its other half leaning over and blocking most of the area.  Thunder can be heard bellowing in the distance.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: Shadows move beyond the trees, their large forms shaking the ground.  With each passing shadow, birds erupt from a nearby tree and take to the sky.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: Between breaks in the trees, the flash of silver can be seen as large steel constructs move about, the ground reverberating as they stomp.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: Trees become sparse here as the area opens up into a backdrop of jagged rocks and dirt.  The dirt trail continues eastward.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: The trail begins to ascend here, winding up a hillside which is more dirt and rock than grass.  A massive crater comes into view, its wide rim far off to the northwest.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: The path is completely devoid of plant life here, the earthen trail turned dark as if scorched by fire.  The elevation continues to climb slowly.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: To the west, the tops of the trees in the forest can be seen, a stark contrast to the blackened hillside and scorched trail ahead.  Tiny pillars of flame rise up along both sides of the path, dancing about as if with a life of their own.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: Clusters of red mein shards jut out from the ground here, dark blood sliming their surfaces.  The trail continues its upward climb.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: Despite the elevation, the air here remains warm, almost hot.  Small fires still dance along the sides of the path as if living candles.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: The trail ends at a plateau which stretches out wide, its surface littered with blackened rocks and scorched dirt.  To the north and east lie miles and miles of ocean, their waters murky and black and glistening from the reddish-orange sky above.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: The plateau's surface is smoothed out, yet retains a dark obsidian hue.  A number of crimson portals hover in the air nearby, the light within each glowingly only faintly.

title: [Erythro Island, Nexus]
description: The highland is dominated by a ring of shimmering portals, each one guarded by a pair of towering white marble gargoyles.  Storm clouds churn overhead, crimson lightning dancing throughout.

title: [Stone Keep, Courtyard]
description: Stone rubble from the wall above lays in scattered chunks around the courtyard, the rocks layered with a solid coat of ice.  A frayed rope leads back up to the keep's perimeter.

title: [Stone Keep, Courtyard]
description: Huge blocks of granite occupy this portion of the courtyard, turning the area into an almost maze-like field to maneuver through.  To the north the keep stretches high above.

title: [Stone Keep, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard opens up more here and the air is quite frigid as it remains dominated by the shadow of the keep.  Set into the southern wall is a massive portcullis that has been caked with dried blood and frozen shut with frost.

title: [Stone Keep, Courtyard]
description: Standing in the shadow of the stone keep is a wide opening, where perhaps once doors were, leading inside.  Around the circular walls of the keep are rows of perched black granite gargoyles, frozen in time and eyes cast watchfully downward.

title: [Stone Keep, Hall]
description: The air is no less cold inside the keep as a gust of arctic wind continually blows through the large opening.  One entire section of the hall has been blocked by fallen stone leaving only one stretch remaining.

title: [Stone Keep, Hall]
description: Further into the keep the icy temperature is less jarring but the wind can still be heard from nearby.  The walls of the hallway are devoid of any decorations and look as cold as the air outside.

title: [Stone Keep, Hall]
description: Old sconces line the walls, an eerie white light causing them to glow.  The faint wailing of ethereal spirits can be heard nearby, or perhaps just the wind whistling past.

title: [Stone Keep, Hall]
description: Scorch marks blacken the stone walls here and more than a few piles of bones litter the ground.  A soft crimson light shines up ahead.

title: [Stone Keep, Hall]
description: In stark contrast to the rest of the keep, the temperature here is warm and comfortable.  The very walls are bathed in a crimson light, originating from a source further down the hall.

title: [Stone Keep, Hall]
description: In a lattice design along the walls, large veins spread out and glow with a unnatural crimson light.  The glowing veins lead to the center of the hall, which has been completely engulfed by a massive blood red tunnel leading down.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: The walls of the tunnel are covered in slimy blood and veins, looking more like the inside of an intestine than a passageway.  A pale red light faintly shines out from the web of veins.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: Tiny black bugs skitter up the tunnel, oblivious to your presence.  The blood-covered tunnel continues to descend.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: Periodically the slimy walls shake, almost violently. With each tremor, copious amounts of blood burst out from the ground, splattering like miniature geysers.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: The veins along the walls are larger now, pulsating with a crimson light within.  The walls still glisten with blood.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: The blood tunnel winds down further before finally stopping and opening up into an enormous cavern.  Along the last portion of the passageway are rows of razor-sharp teeth, protruding out from the walls.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: The blood cavern spreads out wide, leaving the tunnel behind.  Pools of murky liquid cover the ground and glowing crimson veins still run along the length of every wall.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: Crimson motes of light float around the cavern, illuminating the area in a supernatural crimson glow.  The cavern's walls are compromised of slick blood and misshapen flesh, complete with a wavy pattern of veins.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: From out of the murky pools of dark liquid along the ground, small black maggots burst forth.  The bugs skitter about and crawl up the walls creating a patchwork of black and blood red.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: Glowing, pulsating red veins crisscross along the walls and ground.  Drops of dark red, almost black, blood drip from the ceiling, creating swirling pools of cloudy liquid.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Cavern]
description: The area of the cavern is huge, with lumpy flesh-covered walls stretching in every direction into darkness.  The constant drum of a heart beat echoes in the chamber, its reverberation close and almost deafening.

title: [Scribe, Front Room]
description: The walls of Jenkin the Scrivener's office are honeycombed with scroll and book shelves, all empty.  A thin layer of dust covers the room.  An elegantly penned note hangs from the upper edge of a writing desk in the middle of the room.  Through the archway north, a very large screw-like contraption can be seen.

title: [Scribe, Press Room]
description: A large wooden contraption takes up most of this room.  It resembles a grape or clothes press, with a heavy chain and padlock preventing anyone from raising the upper part of the press.  Beneath a workbench are several large wood blocks carved with words and pictures.  On top of the workbench are several smaller blocks similarly carved.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Crude symbols have been scratched into the rocks along a tunnel wall here.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The ground is bumpy, full of jagged stones and misshapen clods of dirt.  A bat hangs from a wooden rafter, its dark wings folded tightly around its body.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Loose gravel crumbles along parts of the walls, exposing many small cracks along the dirt and rock.  A shattered lantern hangs from a splintered wooden rafter.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Dried blood stains have formed a large smear in the ground, surrounded by shattered pieces of glass.  Shadows flicker in the distance, originating from the faintly-lit sconces along the walls.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: A cavern nexus extends out, with many different tunnels leading in every which direction.  The ground is worn and flat, firmly matted beneath frequent travel.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest
Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Brass sconces line the walls, their dim torch light casting flickering shadows down the tunnel.  The ground is rough and downward sloping.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Huge piles of rubble rest along the sides of the cavern walls, with the occasional cluster of pebbles rolling loose.  Two sconces have been set into a wall, their flames burning dull.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The cavern tunnel is dark, lit up only but the single flame of a single torch.  Dust and cobwebs lay heavily about the corridor.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel curves dramatically here, twisting in and out of darkness.  Small fiery embers flitter up from torches set along the walls.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The dark hallway is narrow, hugged tightly by jagged walls of earth and stone.  Torchlight causes shadows to dance along the walls like incorporeal puppets.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The underground channel descends, as the heat of the torches work to fight off the cold air of the greater depth.  Small embers of fire twirl up from the torches as the flames rise and ebb.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tapered walls give way to a greater area, as the distance between torches stretches, expanding the cover of darkness.  Two old barrels sit to the side of the tunnel, their labels faded, but depicting an image of a skull and bones.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The channel here is wide and large enough to fit a wagon through.  The thick lines of wooden wheels in the dirt are clear evidence of its plausibility.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The extensive tunnel stretches far, with small brass sconces lighting the way in both directions.  Propped against a wall is an old wagon wheel, with two missing wooden spokes.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The fractured remnants of an animal's skull lie amidst a pile of dusty bones in a corner of the tunnel, where it opens into a wide turn.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The cavern is spacious, with huge wooden rafters running along the stony ceiling above.  A row of crates, barrels, and bolts of cloth line an entire length of a wall.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Huge in size, the underground chamber is set with blazing torches along every wall.  Old wagons have been pulled to one side of the pathway, all of them in need of serious repair.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: A narrow path winds through darkened rocks, their edges jagged and jutting out dangerously.  The walls of the burrow glisten slightly, their surface slick with moisture.  Strange, glowing green lichen clings to the walls, creating an eerie viridian glow throughout the area.
