title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The air in the dark cavern is heavy with humidity, as tiny rivulets of water trickle down between cracks in the rocky walls.  The sound of lapping waves can be heard nearby.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: A single torch has been wedged into a crack in some rocks, its orange light causing the water along the walls to glint with a fiery glow.  Small waves from the sea come rushing through a large gap up ahead as the cold black water blankets the ground.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The ground is smooth and flat here, clearly traveled frequently.  The area is dimly illuminated by a few lit sconces set into the dirt walls.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: A broken cask rests up against a tunnel wall, old ale stains along its shattered casing.  A faint, hazy smoke lingers in the area.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Two sconces hang here, one unlit and leaving much of the area in darkness.  Of the portion of the wall that is lit up, the misspelled message  "Breware"  has been smeared in blood.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Along an earthen wall, the skeletal remains of a humanoid are partially visible, half-buried within the hard-packed dirt.  High above, a wooden rafter appears to be cracking along the ceiling.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Shadows hug the walls of the tunnel, broken up only by the dim spheres of torchlight stretching down the corridor.  An old rodent skull lies to the side of the path, partially crushed in on the side.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Webs engulf the rafters along the stone ceiling, tiny black bugs trapped within their netting.  A few sconces along the wall are broken, casting much of the tunnel into darkness.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The ground is irregular here, cluttered with rusted debris, broken glass, and old blood stains.  A corpse is slumped up against a wall, garbed in a tattered and dirty Wehnimer's Militia uniform.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: At the edge of this warren, only a single torch burns, its light barely pushing away any darkness.  The faint sound of rodents skittering about can be heard close by.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The underground tunnel twists sharply here, turning right before a dirt-packed wall broken up by jagged rocks.  Faint light glows from both ends of the passage.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: A giant spider web dominates a corner of the tunnel, its silk glistening against the light from nearby torches.   Trapped within the spider's snare, is a humanoid form.
A giant spider web dominates a corner of the tunnel, its silk glistening against the light from nearby torches.  Trapped within the spider's snare, is a humanoid form.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The walls here are thick, formed mostly of rock.  Beads of water slowly drip down the walls, causing them to glisten from the pale torchlight.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Half-formed cobwebs cling to the far corners of the tunnel ceiling, collecting more dust than bugs.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Part of the tunnel has collapsed here, as evident by the pile of boulders blocking part of the path.  From beneath the rubble, the bony fingers of a skeletal hand can be seen.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The walls are comprised of packed earth, supported along the tunnel by solid oak beams.  The sound of scattering rodents can be heard from within the shadows.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel is narrower here, with the earthen walls more jagged along their surfaces.  Darkness continues to dominate a majority of the area.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Tiny, beady-eyed rodents scamper about the uneven ground.  The marmots gnaw and snap at insects darting between cracks.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The faded light of nearby sconces causes a number of cobwebs among the rafters to shimmer slightly.  Trapped among the silk, a tiny black bug squirms uselessly to try to avoid the shared fate of the insect husks next to it.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Shadows creep along the dirt-covered walls, threatening to engulf the pale light given off from the few sconces set about.   A pair of old, tattered gloves lies off to the side of the passage.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Empty wooden crates line an entire wall of the tunnel, discolored labels marking them as property of the Wehnimer's Landing Museum.  Because of the partial blockade of chests, the passageway is narrower here.

title: [Guttin' Goods, Stock Room]
description: A number of featureless and weathered mannequins clutter two corners of the backroom, their bodies sporting an array of fishing attire and accessories.  A few empty ale mugs and some grimy dice rest on top of a stack of unmarked crates.

title: [Guttin' Goods]
description: Two circular windows provide an ample view of the dark wharf outside, with a handful of dockworkers laboring late into the evening.   Moonlight from the open doorway casts a sliver of silver light across the shop's floor, while dim lanterns supply a sufficient brightness to the area.  A scruffy half-krolvin shopkeeper leans upon a driftwood counter and seems to doze off more than once.  The weak scent of sea salt lingers in the shop.

Two circular windows provide an ample view of the wharf outside, with dockworkers loading and unloading a handful of ships in port.  Sunlight from the open doorway brightens the shop, light glinting off of an assortment of equipment lining a wide corner shelf.  A scruffy half-krolvin shopkeeper stands behind a driftwood counter, conversing with some customers browsing about.  The weak scent of sea salt lingers in the shop.

title: [Begetting Besiegers, Basement]
description: Narrow wooden steps lead down from the trapdoor in the ceiling, ending in a wide underground chamber.  Old rusty sconces cast a dim glow along the earthen walls, creating thick pockets of shadows that partially conceal a flimsy wooden door.

title: [Underground Arena]
description: Crude wooden benches ascend in a semicircle around a smooth dirt arena where old blood stains have darkened the ground in many patches.  Lit torches are scattered about the room casting flickering shadows along the stone walls.  A pile of dismembered siege miniatures have been haphazardly left in a corner.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel here is almost entirely engulfed in darkness, and the walls are jagged and stained.  An old, musty smell hangs heavily in the air.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel here is almost entirely engulfed in darkness, and the walls are jagged and stained.  An old, musty smell hangs heavily in the air.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: While most of the tunnel is shrouded in darkness, this section is aglow from the orange light of several torches set into the earthen walls.  The passageway is warm from the burning torches, and half a dozen troll skeletons litter the ground.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entry Courtyard]
description: A sprawling cavern unfolds beyond a pair of white marble double doors, harboring numerous stone structures amid a network of walkways.  Row upon row of neatly tended giant luminescent toadstools enclose the courtyard and at the heart of the open space, a bed of soft, bluish moss lies at the base of a brilliant silvery marble monolith.  Interspersed between the glowing fungi are a few polished iron statues of warriors in various battle poses.

title: [Warrior Guild, South Walk]
description: Hefty blocks of clear glaes run alongside the walkway with carved out depressions that house loam and delicate, lacy moss.  Behind the giant cubes are a trio of dwarven figures wrought from cream-hued granite, clad in steel, invar, and mithril.

title: [Warrior Guild, Central Walkway]
description: Tall iron framework columns line the walkway with clusters of glowing moss clinging to the metal supports.  A squat stone building stands slightly off the path, a granite tablet erected near the door.

title: [Warrior Guild, Workshop]
description: Tacked to the walls are a variety of local animal hides interspersed with several wrought iron hooks.  The acridity of tanning agents assaults the sense and is only mildly relieved by a pair of open windows.  Giant luminescent toadstools shed a bright white light, providing more than adequate illumination for guild members to practice their craft in this spacious workshop.

title: [Warrior Guild, North Walkway]
description: Silvery blue moss clings to a wrought iron fence surrounding a silvery blue travertine building, the profusive growth standing out against the dark metal.  An etched white quartz tablet has been erected nearby and cobbles of bright white border the adjacent walkway.

title: [Warrior Guild, Coldhouse]
description: Glossy silver marble lines the hallway's floor, walls, and ceiling to create the illusion of an all-encompassing mirror as a result of its highly reflective surface.  The air is markedly cold, frosting some of the metal crates in the corner.

title: [Warrior Guild, South Walk]
description: Raucous laughter and mirthful shouts sound from somewhere close, but the nearly identical stone structures in the area make it impossible to identify the source.  Someone has taken it upon themselves to place several colorful sphene luck charms within the mossy tops of the proximate cubical glaes planters.

title: [Warrior Guild, South Walk]
description: A slender limestone tablet and a long red slate building stand quite a distance away from the main walkway, boundaried by several clusters of luminescent toadstools.  Decidedly warmer than other parts of the cavern, steam rises from a pipe jutting out of the ground against the far wall.

title: [Warrior Guild, Saunas]
description: A network of reinforced pipes runs along the ceiling, dripping with condensation that pools on the crimson marble floor below.  The heat is quite noticeable, as is the humidity.  A steep ramp equipped with solid glaes railings leads down towards the saunas.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: Deep grunting and shouts of encouragement can be heard coming from the northeast, towards the inner courtyard.  The faint odor of sweat mingles in with the aroma of loamy earth that gives rise to the variety of flora flourishing here.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: Artificial trees spread across the broad courtyard, wrought of shining steel with variegated foliage.  All across the expanse, dwarven attendants clamber up ladders in an attempt to reaffix hordes of fallen leaves.  Myriads of colorfully flecked toadstools cluster around the intersections of paths, marking them clearly even at a distance.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Warrior Guild, Central Walkway]
description: Giant blue-speckled toadstools cast a cheerful light over the wide walkway, and a cluster of gold-hued moss clings to the iron columns on either side.  The faint aroma of loam hangs lightly in the air, along with a trace of fragrant cigar smoke.  An inscribed marble tablet marks the sandstone-inlaid path heading towards an immense granite edifice.

title: [Warrior Guild, Edifice West]
description: Suspended from the muraled ceiling are a series of fringed banners exquisitely embroidered with the names and likenesses of Zul Logoth's greatest warriors.  The panoramic image from above reflects clearly on the polished marble floor underfoot.  Cloves and other spices lightly scent the surroundings, emanating from further within the edifice.

title: [Warrior Guild, Central Walkway]
description: Swept clear of any debris, the column-lined walkway leads further into the guild to an expansive clearing far to the east.  Detailed statuary stand off to the side, fully clad in armor like stone soldiers preparing for battle.

title: [Warrior Guild, Lava Chamber]
description: Far below the surface cavern, deep trenches have been cut into the stone to reveal radiant flows of lava that fill the chamber with its oppressive and powerful heat.  Sturdy glaes channels run alongside the molten rock, flowing with water that helps regulate the temperature to a level that is only barely tolerable.  The system creates an enormous amount of steam that is ventilated through pipes jutting out of the walls and ceiling.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: A pair of giant luminescent toadstools mark the trail leading to a drab stone shed, set far back from the beauty and bustle of the training courtyard.  Silvery green moss dangles off the eaves of the roof, though several large clumps have fallen off and now currently lie on the ground.  Deep ruts indicate the heavy use of the path by carts laden with material.

title: [Warrior Guild, Stone Shed]
description: Permeating the shed is the scent of rotting wood, emanating from piles of the stuff stacked against the walls.  Though cramped, the space is organized into small work areas for guild members who venture in here.  A few tools lie on a thin iron rack in one corner, next to a giant luminescent toadstool.

title: [Warrior Guild, Inner Courtyard]
description: Adjacent to the swept pathway are a series of granite-blocked alcoves that offer privacy to those training in the inner courtyard.  Numerous hedges run neatly across the area, a strong earthy aroma rising from their loamy homes.  Long shadows stretch out from the nearby metal trees like crooked fingers.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: A small shack surrounded by a plethora of gardening tools and supplies stands off to one side, partially obscured by shrubbery.  Workers wheel carts to and from the building, creating small ruts in the stone pathway.  The sound of intense training can be heard from somewhere nearby.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Warrior Guild, Inner Courtyard]
description: Along the path, roughly hewn blocks of tawny granite create semi-private alcoves for training.  The stone walls are cleverly obscured by a series of squawroot hedges and stalagmites covered in a profusion of glowing moss.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: Barrels of foliage line the cavern walls along with reinforced ladders, both necessary in the upkeep of the artificial trees that reside within the courtyard.  A few beds of deep blue moss have stray leaves sticking out of their fuzzy masses.

title: [Warrior Guild, North Walkway]
description: Keeping guard over the walkway are several marble statues garbed in some burnished mithril armor.  A narrow path branches off towards a thin steel marker and subsequently, a small limestone shed.  Colorful fungus abounds in carefully tended beds that border the expansive courtyard to the east.

title: [Warrior Guild, Limestone Shed]
description: A thin layer of rocky debris blankets the floor, but distinct boot tracks mark the most heavily used areas of the shed.  Musty odors and the scent of oil hang in the air.  Secured against the wall is an iron tool rack, fully equipped with implements needed by guild members.

title: [Warrior Guild, Dark Basement]
description: Flecks of mica glitter within the walls of black granite blocks, though shadows cover most of the area.  Only a single, small luminescent toadstool offers illumination in this slightly dank chamber.  Faintly visible, a set of stone shelves holds a variety of unmarked vials and bottles, while a large clear glaes tank flashes below.

title: [Warrior Guild, North Walkway]
description: Set against the nearby cavern wall are several stone buildings, each marked by tablets for storage of metal, stone, and foodstuffs.  Someone though, has taken to filling one of the interiors with a profusion of colorful fungi and parasitics, perfuming the air with a distinctive earthy fragrance.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard Nexus]
description: Carefully tended beds of glowing moss in blue, green, silver, and even spots of red radiate outward from the nexus, between the numerous walkways of the courtyard.  A smattering of unnatural metal trees enclose the area along with their equally fabricated foliage in a riot of colors.  Sitting on a hewn stalagmite base is a small keg and a sign.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: Moss-covered ladders lean up against the stout trunks of the metal trees in the area, with barrels and tools near-at-hand.  Tumbled pieces of glaes have been hung from several of the branches as decorative ornaments.  Set behind some of the giant toadstools toward the wall is a large pile of rocks, most likely removed from somewhere else within the cavern.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: A sphere of rainbow glaes sits within a wide green marble bowl, and cool, clear water burbles merrily out of the fountain.  Tiny pink-spotted, cream-hued toadstools and deep verdant moss encircle the fixture, the contrast in colors yet another example of the surprising attention to aesthetic detail shown throughout the guild.  Five smoothly cut openings have been created in the neighboring cavern wall, each portal curtained off by bright, embroidered canvas.

title: [Warrior Guild, Courtyard]
description: Clashing metal and loud thuds can be heard from beyond a dark tunnel that branches off the path running along the courtyard's perimeter.  Heaps of discarded debris are continuously carted away from amassed piles contained within reinforced bins of iron and steel.  Amidst all the noise, the sound of flowing water can be heard from somewhere close by.

title: [Warrior Guild, Tunnel]
description: Glistening luminescent blue moss clings to the rough ceiling and walls all around, bathing the area in a soothing blue light.  Sounds of training and shouting can be heard from beyond a dark tunnel.  Then passageway branches off in two directions, each tunnel lined with doors.

title: [Warrior Guild, Wood Doors]
description: Within this small cave, the frame of a stage door has been propped up with a system of sturdy steel supports, allowing it to take any and all abuse.

title: [Warrior Guild, Metal Doors]
description: Within this small cave, the frame of a stage door has been propped up with a system of sturdy steel supports, allowing it to take any and all abuse.

title: [Warrior Guild, Edifice South]
description: Behind glaes panes covering a handful of small niches are fragments of weaponry and armor from battles of yore.  Several intact pieces stand alongside their shattered and battered brethren.

title: [Warrior Guild, Edifice North]
description: Dwarven figures carved from gold-speckled marble stand in silence along the corridor, along with several impressive weapons encased within clear glaes.  Each display features a scroll detailing the history of the artifact, previous owners, and the historically important battles during which it was wielded.

title: [Warrior Guild, Edifice East]
description: Thin streams of smoke drift out of a pair of marble double doors set into the eastern wall, smelling strongly of cloves.  The polished marble floor has been buffed to a mirror-like sheen, with the tiny flecks of silver within each tile glimmering under the illumation of giant toadstools.  A trio of eostones have been inlaid into the ornate lintel over the doorway to the Guildmaster's Office.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: Fragrant, spicy smoke is visible in a thick cloud that hangs heavily in the air, originating from a thick, half-smoked cigar resting upon a jewel-studded tray on an enormous brass-accented desk.  A well-worn trollskin mantle hangs from a wrought iron stand in the corner beside a mithril claidhmore and rolaren axe.  On the opposite wall, a solid blue marble sideboard features an assortment of potations favored by the Guildmaster.

title: [Warrior Guild, Stone Shed]
description: Dingy white stone walls and a slightly darker hued floor do little to lighten the drab atmosphere within this small shed.  Hanging from the ceiling is a small inked sign, suspended over a large metal bin.

title: [Warrior Guild, Stone Shed]
description: A layer of splinters and dust covers the greyish stone floor along with several work tables and tools.  Posted on the southeast wall is a small inked sign.

title: [Warrior Guild, Coldhouse]
description: Drawing closer to a set of heavy rhimar-lined doors, the air grows more frigid to the point that a thin sheet of ice crystals have formed upon the silver marble floor.  A two-tiered rack holds all sizes of fur-lined gloves for guild members to use in this cold place.

title: [Warrior Guild, Cold Storage]
description: Within this cramped rhimar-lined chamber, an incredible amount of ice resides.  Various shapes and sizes of the frozen stuff have been neatly stored in separate areas within an assortment of boxes and shelves.  The biting cold is intense and lingering too long in this room would be a bad idea.  A set of doors in the west wall offers escape from the chill.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ice Cellar]
description: A handful of hearty luminescent toadstools illuminate the darkness of this cellar, revealing the ice-slicked floor and frosted metal rails against the walls.  Glistening, semi-frozen moss hangs across a darkened archway that houses a wide staircase to the upper floor.  Occasionally, an attendant garbed in a heavy cloak wanders into the cellar to lay bundles of fresh towels on two stone racks.

title: [The Red Wagon]
description: Sturdy wooden walls enclose the interior of this wagon, their surfaces sloshed with varying hues of red paint.  Overhead, a mosaic of a blue sea, complete with a large ship manned by a handful of halflings, is painted on the ceiling.  Several collections of daggers and swords hang on the walls, and a small writing desk covered with artistic sketches sits in one corner.  In the center of the room is a large table carved with a rough map and topped with an assortment of items.

title: [Solano Hall, Transport Room]
description: Pale purple walls surround this small room that is little more than a spacious closet.  Leaning up against one wall, a small table stands beside a curved grey doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling purple and grey portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Myriad toadstools have been etched into the metal, their various shapes and sizes creating a representation of a lush, subterranean garden.

title: [Solano Hall, Waterfall]
description: This cavern unfolds from the entry gate to rise high into the air, culminating with a curved stone ceiling.  A waterfall cascades down the cavern's center, splashing on a few plateaus before hitting a set of narrow stone steps and disappearing with them into a narrow fissure in the floor.  An ascending set of stairs carved into the rockface leads up beside the falls, and multihued toadstools in pots rest on the steps in even intervals.  Each toadstool reflects off small specks of mica in the walls, illuminating the cavern with a glittering rainbow.

title: [Solano Hall, Geode Landing]
description: The walls are devoid of mica, their rough dark grey surfaces illuminated by several large, glowing toadstools that sprout directly from the roughly hewn stone floor.  A huge geode, split in half and filled with clear lacquer, serves as a bench, and a stone shelf hangs on the wall within arm's reach.  A descending stone staircase allows passage down through a hole in the floor.  Carved directly into the rock, a round window peers out onto the cavern below, and a western passage leads toward the sound of rushing water.

title: [Solano Hall, Rainbow Landing]
description: A steep set of stone steps arrives from above, hugging the wall and curving to rest on the circular stone floor.  Although the walls shimmer with rainbow flecks, the main attraction is on the floor.  The center of the floor is perfectly flat and covered by a shimmering quartz mosaic.  The gems have been carefully cut and fitted so that, in the muted light, the mosaic appears almost as one solid gem, shifting from color to color.  A wooden black table laden with shiny trinkets sits beside a western passage.

title: [Solano Hall, Game Room]
description: Lit by a single small glowing toadstool that rests atop each of several tables, the room is dimly lit and scented faintly of patchouli and mildew.  The mica chips in the curved rock walls only sparkle faintly in the varied lighting, the rainbow hue of the toadstools adding a variety of color to the drab room.  Scattered atop the smooth stone floor are a few padded stone benches, each one paired with a carved marble end table.  From the eastern passage, the sound of falling water echoes softly.

title: [Solano Hall, Merchant Landing]
description: This cavern forms a spacious room with a flat floor.  Two wide-gated, opposing tunnels to the north and south, lead off to unknown locales.  Wheel ruts in the floor indicate that wagons once moved through the tunnels.  The tracks also lead to the west through a tunnel from whence the sound of rushing water emanates.  A curved stone bench hugs the wall between the tunnels, flanked by two potted toadstools.  A glass-paned window offers a view of a collection of gems displayed in a small niche in the eastern wall.

title: [Solano Hall, Water Garden]
description: Emerging from a hole in the wall, the descent of the waterfall slows abruptly, caught on ledges that jut from the wall, before flowing to the floor.  Rivulets wander through fine crevices, feeding pale toadstools, mushrooms, moss, and fungus, while a serpentine bench winds throughout.  Though white is the primary plant color, all the hues of the rainbow appear in speckles, resembling dollops of whipped cream dotted with jellied candies.  The rivulets join near an octagonal stone receptacle to plunge into a hole in the floor.

title: [Solano Hall, Night Sky Landing]
description: Particles of mica in the black walls gleam softly in the ambient light of several toadstools, representing the stars in this rock-bound galaxy.  Thin veins of gold and silver ore resemble comet trails in the stone, and occasional pieces of quartz look like larger cosmic bodies.  Stone benches placed in secluded areas allow peaceful contemplation of the faux night sky.  In the center of the room, a roughly hewn fire pit allows for firelight to illuminate the walls to create a brightly glittering, starry night sky.

title: [Solano Hall, Pond Lounge]
description: A slight cant to the floor diverts the waterfall into a small pond, its waters swirling counterclockwise until they spill out over the south edge and rush down the cavern's slope again.  Brightly colored fish swim in the pond, clustering where the water flow is slowest.  Several blue marble benches rest near a shelf bearing food and drinks, and a pink granite receptacle sits unobtrusively to the side.  Two sapphire toadstools cast their light into the area and streak the cavern with deep blue glow.

title: [Solano Hall, Alcove Landing]
description: A small, level landing fits snugly into a rock alcove.  Shaped like an artist's palette, the landing has been carefully leveled, and a brilliant mosaic of clear, blue, and yellow quartz spells out a message on the floor.  An amber toadstool in a stone pot illuminates the area with a soft glow, its light playing off the mica flakes in the nearby wall.  The sound of rushing water permeates the area, and an oblong stone reflecting pool rests against the far wall.

title: [Seamist Hall, Front Lawn]
description: Meandering through a rolling lawn of thick green grass, a decorative stone path leads from a white steel gate up to a large riverstone manor.  Tall modwir trees grow throughout the grounds, shading the building beyond.  Thick heliotrope bushes dotted with beautiful purple blossoms flank some steps leading up to the front porch, and add bright color to the verdant surroundings.  Hanging from carved wooden poles, colorful unlit lanterns line the walkway, the bases of which are surrounded by rings of bright lilies.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Transport Room]
description: Pale pink walls surround this small room that is little more than a spacious closet.  Leaning up against one wall, a small table stands beside a curved petal pink doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling iridescent portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Sprawling cherry blossom branches have been etched into the metal, their flowering lengths mingling near the top, reminiscent of a garden bower.

title: [Great Hall, Gift Shop]
description: Golden filigree leaves spiral up the columns of the quaint shop and reach for the domed ceiling which is painted with a view of the night sky.  Silver constellations wink as the lamp light reflects off of them, while tiny chimes dangling from the peak create a melodic tune that is soothing and pleasant.  Several shelves are lined with cards and matching envelopes, while a small table near a white birch door houses boxes and ribbons.

title: [Etesian Villa, Courtyard]
description: Surrounded by a wrought iron fence, an expanse of green lawn spreads away from the open gate.  Pruned box hedges hug the fence, offering privacy for the grounds.  Painted the pale blue hue of a sunlit tropical sea and capped with a grey shingle roof, the villa is set far back from the wey, at the edge of the grass.  Its window boxes contain a variety of local blossoms, and cultivated flower beds flank the entrance to the building.  Floral scents perfume the air, and a set of crystal wind chimes lends a touch of music to the breeze.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Hallway]
description: Stretching north from the hallway entrance, the white birch-paneled corridor leads into the more private areas of the villa.  On the western wall, an oak-framed landscape painting hangs beside a pale green birch door, while on the opposite wall, a rounded oak arch leads into a dimly lit room.  Running up the center of the pale birch floorboards is a muted burgundy rug with a faint golden pineapple design.  Polished crystal sconces set into narrow niches in the wall supply the windowless hall with ample candlelight.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Game Room]
description: Lit by a single candle that rests atop each of several tables, the room is dim and faintly scented with fresh linen and patchouli.  A plush gold rug covers the birch floor and muffles the sounds of footfalls.  Scattered atop the rug are a few soft ivy-patterned sofas, each one paired with a carved cherrywood end table.  Set in one cream-hued wall, a rounded oak arch leads out of the room, the opening flanked by palms set in dark green marble planters.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Office]
description: The pale birch floorboards are covered by an almost wall-to-wall woven tapestry rug that depicts the terrain of the Elven Nations like an expansive cloth map.  Resting beneath a large birch-framed window is a spindly linden desk and its matching padded chair.  Flanked by potted ferns, a pale green birch door leads out of the room, while a gold-wrapped orb of glimaerstone hangs from the ceiling and further lights the room.

title: [Etesian Villa, Foyer]
description: Clean rosewood floorboards meet crisply painted walls, the pale green ivy design complementing the wood accents around the room.  Oil lanterns dot the wall at even intervals, illuminating the area with a soft golden glow.  Flanking the entry door on one side is a polished rosewood bin sitting between two benches, while on the other side, a wide oak table holds a variety of objects that glitter in the light.  Stretching deeper into the cottage is a long dimly lit hallway, and a gold-fringed woven tapestry hangs on the wall beside a narrow set of stairs.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Private Lounge]
description: Surrounded in pale birch-paneled walls, this room is lit by a series of ensconced oil lanterns that dot the paneling at even intervals.  A wide glass-paned window further illuminates the room, bathing a linen-draped cherrywood table that rests before it with ample sunlight, glittering off the contents with bright golden light.  In one corner, a low stone fireplace faces a semi-circle of settees, offering a place to rest and regroup.   On one wall, paintings of local flora and fauna hang above a linen-draped cherry oak sideboard laden with food, while a glass-paned silvery birch door leads out.

title: [Etesian Villa, Landing]
description: Carpeted by a muted burgundy woven rug, the small patch of solid ground here at the top of the stairs is bordered by a rosewood-paneled wall that boasts a curved ebonwood arch, a pale linden door, and a curved golden doorway.  Through the former, the mingling scents of tobacco and alcohol exude in an invisible cloud.  Flanking the doors are two ensconced gold oil lanterns that easily illuminate the small space.

title: [Etesian Villa, Transport Room]
description: Crimson walls surround this small room that is little more than a spacious closet.  Leaning up against one wall, a small table stands beside a curved golden doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling red and gold portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Intricate wyverns have been etched into the metal, their sinuous lengths intertwined, creating a complex scrollwork pattern.

title: [Etesian Villa, Office]
description: Pale blue walls painted the color of a sunlit, tropical sea surround this small room.  The northern wall sports a pair of glass double doors that lead out onto a balcony.  Gauzy linen curtains frame the doorway, the creamy white material complementing the color scheme and alluding to wave caps on the ocean.  A sun-bleached driftwood desk rests against one wall, its matching driftwood chair boasting an aquamarine cushion, while a white mithril chandelier hangs from the ceiling.  Across from the balcony, a pale linden door offers an alternative exit.

title: [Etesian Villa, Game Room]
description: A plush green rug with an ivy motif covers the floor, and several tables are scattered at one end of the room, each illuminated by a low, tallow candle.  Framed paintings of local wildlife dot the ivory walls, their contents shadowed by the dim lighting.  Across the room from the gaming tables, soft gold sofas are arranged in a circle, with several potted ferns placed between them.  The scents of tobacco and alcohol linger here, dispersed only by drafts entering through a curved ebonwood arch that serves as the only exit.

title: [Etesian Villa, Hallway]
description: This long hall is carpeted by a dark, burgundy and gold rug that stretches from the hallway entrance at one end to a carved rosewood arch at the other.  Paintings of buildings in Ta'Vaalor hang on the cream-hued walls, illuminated by ensconced candles that flicker in the slightest breeze.  From the east, the scent of food emanates from a gold-edged ebonwood door, while from the west, the aroma of wine wafts in through an open doorway.  The scents mingle, creating an atmosphere of quiet opulence.

title: [Etesian Villa, Lounge]
description: Surrounded by wood paneling, this small room offers a place to sit and relax.  Several plush rose pink chairs are arranged in a half-circle, facing an arched stone-lined fireplace, a basket of sticks resting nearby.  A long marble counter against one wall holds a variety of refreshments, the wine bottles gleaming in the light from the candelabra perched on the shiny surface, as well as from a panoramic window set in the outer wall.  The hallway can be glimpsed through an open doorway, and a rounded ebonwood arch provides an egress to the north.

title: [Etesian Villa, Bistro]
description: Large enough to encompass the whole back half of the villa, this room is light and airy, with floor-to-ceiling windows across the northern wall.  A variety of glowing orbs dangle from the ceiling above the many tables.  Between two of the windows, a pair of glass double doors lead outside, while on the wall opposite, a carved rosewood arch and a rounded ebonwood arch offer additional exits.  Set slightly away from the eastern wall, a long mottled marble counter holds a variety of refreshments.  The scent of roasting meat emanates through a swinging door leading to the kitchen.

title: [Etesian Villa, Kitchen]
description: The air is thick with the scents of various dishes being prepared.  A large chunk of meat roasts on a spit over an open flame, while several pots simmer on the stove.  Hot and noisy, the room bustles with activity as wait staff and chefs vie for position among the tight walkways and in front of equipment.  Offering exit from the room are a gold-edged ebonwood door and a swinging door, the latter of which is used often by staff coming from and going into the bistro.

title: [Etesian Villa, Balcony]
description: Wrought iron railings shaped into two-toned spirals of light and dark surround this small, rectangular balcony.  White wicker chairs and benches face the garden down below and offer a place to rest under the shady overhang of the villa's roof that protects much of this space from the elements.  Within arm's reach, a lattice rose trellis leans up against the side of the building, the scent of flowers lingering heavily in the air.  Two potted palms flank a pair of glass double doors that stands ajar.

title: [Etesian Villa, Garden]
description: A set of steps leads down from a pair of glass double doors, culminating at a cobblestone path that winds through this lush garden of flowers that bloom in every shade possible.  Twin topiaries shaped like wyverns flank the entrance to a section dedicated to roses, one trellis leaning up against the villa to display a variety of blossoms.  The sweet scent of flowers fills the air, and a thin layer of petals carpets the grass.  Centrally located at the end of the path, a circular reflecting pool mirrors the blooms surrounding it.

title: [Seamist Hall, Front Porch]
description: Standing to either side of a pair of stained glass doors are two white marble urns filled with a variety of blooming flowers.  A richly woven mat runs the length of the pristine white floor, stopping just before some porch steps.  Several wind chimes hang from the porch, catching the smallest breeze, while the sunlight glitters off the contents of a small wooden table covered with gold silk.

title: [Seamist Hall, Foyer]
description: Centered in the light oak floor is an exquisite circular mosaic of colorful sea glass.  A large ship's wheel hangs from the ceiling, illuminating the foyer with frosted glass globes suspended from copper chains.  To one side of the stained glass doors stands a hall tree displaying several hats of various styles.  The model of a large sailing ship rests on the floor between a velvet-draped archway and a curved ocean blue doorway that lead deeper into the manor.

title: [Seamist Hall, Transport Room]
description: Ocean blue walls surround this small room that is little more than a spacious closet.  Leaning up against one wall, a small table stands beside a curved ocean blue doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling seafoam white portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Seashells of many varieties have been etched into the metal, each one overlapping another to form a pattern reminiscent of the scales of a fish.

title: [Seamist Hall, Central Lounge]
description: Crafted from modwir, a circular bar dominates the center of the room, several potted ferns placed about its base.  Scattered throughout are clusters of plump cerulean cushioned chairs and sofas, creating a vibrant contrast to the thick ivory carpet that covers the floor.  A pale modwir bin and a small ceramic basket of sticks rest next to a large stone fireplace built opposite from a velvet-draped arch.  Copper sconces hang on the walls, their etched globes ready to be lit, while a pair of carved oak doors leads out.

title: [Seamist Hall, Back Porch]
description: Sheltered by a slanted roof, the back porch of the manor is enclosed by a white railing.  Wicker baskets of tropical plants are suspended from the beams above.  Comfortable enough for two, wooden porch swing hangs to the side, colorful pillows covering the seat.  A flagstone path leads away from the building, meandering through beds of bright flowers contrasting with the rich verdant grass and the seascape beyond.  A pair of carved oak doors leads back inside, flanked on both sides by potted ferns.

title: [Seamist Hall, Day Room]
description: Draped in pale silk, tall arching windows look out over a wide, verdant lawn with blooming flowerbeds that create a kaleidoscope of color.  A few chairs circle an unfinished needlework in a large circular frame.  Several sofas cushioned in shades of pastel are placed about the room, a brass tea cart resting nearby.  Fragrant arrangements of fresh roses are set about the room, filling it with their sweet scent.

title: [Seamist Hall, Smoking Room]
description: Several groups of dark leather chairs and sofas are placed about a large stone fireplace, a carved bin of sticks nearby.  A modwir sideboard with a crystal tray rests under a large velvet draped window, which looks out over an expansive lawn filled with a variety of citrus trees.  Edged with golden fringe, a plush burgundy carpet covers the polished floor, potted trees contrasting with the dark material.  A carved mahogany door leads into a dimly lit room.

title: [Seamist Hall, Game Room]
description: Lit by a single candle that rests atop each of several tables, the room is dim and faintly scented with sea breezes that make their way in from a single small curtained window.  A plush blue rug covers the hardwood floor and muffles the sounds of footfalls.  Scattered atop the rug are some soft white arm chairs, a few paired with a driftwood end table.  Set in one pale blue wall, a carved mahogany door leads out of the room, while on the other, white-framed paintings of local flora and fauna are displayed at even intervals.

title: [Seamist Hall, Dining Room]
description: Dominating the room is a large modwir table, deep burgundy cushioned chairs lining either side.  A long glass-topped sideboard laden with food and drink stands between two silk covered windows, a golden runner draped over its length.  Hanging on the opposite wall is a huge tapestry, the rich colors blending with those woven into the plush carpet that covers the floor.  Several marble urns filled with a variety of silk tropical flowers are placed about, so as not to detract from the scent of delicacies.

title: [Seamist Hall, Gathering Hall]
description: Chairs, sofas, and divans are scattered about the room, focusing on an ornate modwir podium.  A large brass cart rests beside a huge velvet-draped picture window, a seat built into the wall giving a perfect view of the rolling green lawns outside.  Frosted crystal globes hang about the room, suspended from copper hooks set in the walls.  Covering most of the wooden floor, a plush ivory carpet contrasts with the rich colors of the room.

title: [Seamist Hall, Garden]
description: Several stands of beech, walnut, and mahogany grow about the garden, centered upon a huge white marble fountain.  Decorative paths of flagstone wind away from the elegant stone manor, meandering through fragrant blooming flower beds, with one branch leading to a secluded oak gazebo.

title: [Seamist Hall, Gazebo]
description: Oak rafters arch towards a domed peak, with wooden shingles placed between, keeping out most forms of weather.  Benches are built in against the walls, with a small circular table centered on the floor of the gazebo.  Potted flowers hang from hooks in the windows, each opening giving a picturesque view of expansive gardens in one direction and the open ocean in the other.  A bird feeder dangles from a nearby tree, while a carved bird house stands on a post just outside.

title: [Seamist Hall, Back Lawn]
description: Meandering through the lawn and a meticulously manicured flower bed, the flagstone path moves about a grey marble reflecting pool filled with large goldfish.  Flowering bushes and bright blossoms grow about, their color reflecting off the stone.  Nestled in a secluded verdant nook, a colorful woven hammock hangs between two giant twin oak trees.  The lawn drops away at the western edge, where a set of stone steps lead down toward the beach.

title: [Seamist Hall, Beach]
description: Wave upon wave of crushing surf constantly batters the beach, which is more pebbles and stone than sand.  In the distance, barges, sailboats, and other seaworthy vessels float atop the water, near the piers to the north and south.  A set of stone steps leads away from the beach, toward an elegant estate.

title: [Seamist Hall, Surf]
description: A dark color, the ocean is muddled with rough undercurrents that send waves crashing on to the shore.  A shadowy stretch of beach is barely visible a short distance away, its length spreading out like a black blanket lit by lights shining forth from the seaside city of Solhaven.

A balmy, clear color, the ocean is muddled with rough undercurrents that send waves crashing on to the shore.  A stretch of rocky beach is clearly visible a short distance away, its length spreading out on either side to show off the seaside city of Solhaven.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Entry Garden]
description: Nearly spilling over their knee-high granite borders, beds of colorful flowers of myriad varieties line a cobblestone pathway leading to a pair of rustic ironwood doors, the entrance to a large, granite-faced lodge.  The lodge's upper floors of massive, rough-hewn oak logs sport small balconies backed by large sheets of glass.  Hedges of laurel and boxwood march across the building's front.  Their branches, while not blocking the views from any windows, have an air of wildness about them.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Common Room]
description: Highly polished wood floors are covered with woven wool rugs, providing splashes of color in the large, chandelier-lit foyer.  A burled maple doorway resides in the eastern wall, and a sweeping grand staircase leads to the second floor.  In the opposite corner, a dimly lit hallway leads to the interior of the lodge.  Several burnished leather sofas and chairs, facing a low stone hearth, invite rest, while a a wide gold-chased table is placed between them.  Beside the entry doors a small golden depository sits against the darkly paneled wall.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Hallway]
description: Completely paneled in polished pine planking, the walls hold elaborate antler sconces.  Several doors lead off to the east, and the nearest one rests ajar, revealing shelves of linens and cleaning supplies.  A carved pine door leads to a dimly lit room, while a faint glow emanates from a curved mottled green doorway.  The granite floor is polished to a gleam, its mica flecks sparkling as the candles gutter and flare.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Transport Room]
description: Gold-trimmed, dark green walls surround this small room that is little more than a spacious closet.  Leaning up against one wall, a small table stands beside a curved mottled green doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling green and gold portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Intricate foliage has been etched into the metal, the vines intertwining to form a complex lattice pattern.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Game Room]
description: Lit by a single candle that rests atop each of several tables, the room is dim and wreathed in a thin veil of smoke that obscures the darkened corners.  A plush burgundy rug covers the hardwood floor and muffles the sounds of footfalls.  Scattered atop the rug are a few grey velvet settees, each one paired with a carved mahogany end table.  On one side of the room, a carved pine door leads out into the hallway, while opposite, a polished satinwood archway offers entry to the bar.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Barroom]
description: Walls of cherry-stained satinwood surround deep leather chairs with claw-footed tables alongside.  The eastern wall is completely taken over by shelves of liquor, from the common to the exotic, arranged in neat rows behind a long wooden bar, while tall carved-legged stools offer a place to sit at the bar.  A stuffed brown otter stands on a pedestal in one corner, its fur a bit tattered where numerous hands have rubbed its belly.  An ivory chandelier illuminates the area, and a red satinwood archway leads to a dimly lit room.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Landing]
description: Dark red satinwood paneling covers the bottom half of the walls, while the top half is painted a pale cream hue.  Sconces of polished brass hang on the wall, and a hammered tin ceiling displays an elaborate scene of hunters cornering their quarry.  A long runner of animal hides pieced into a repeated compass rose pattern ends at each of the three doors opening off of the area, while the staircase is left bare for its craftsmanship to shine.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Office]
description: Barely decorated, this small office is encapsulated by ivory and pale blue striped walls, and is utterly cramped with furniture.  An expansive oak desk that looks to have barely fit through the door, its matching oak chair, and a tall bookcase have been placed so as to allow the best use of the space.  One wall is dominated by a square calendar marked with barely legible notations.  The opposite wall sports a glass-paned door, which serves as the only exit.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Gecko Room]
description: This spacious room is dominated by several oak-framed divans covered in quilted sepia suede.  Two overstuffed chairs flank a heavy, brass-studded side table under a panoramic curtained window.  The pale yellow walls are painted in a pattern of ochre-colored geckos climbing towards the ceiling, interrupted to the south by a wide oak door.  One delicate gold chandelier hangs from the intersection of two beams of oak underneath exposed rafters.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Sitting Room]
description: Vivid lace coverlets gird the muted furniture in the room, adding a touch of color to the room.  Airy, cream-hued curtains have been tied back from some windows with rose-tufted sashes.  A plush couch holds a pale green hue, and a blown-glass vase of wildflowers sits on a low table next to one of the polished knotty pine walls.  A brass-inset door leads back out to the landing.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Library]
description: Leather-bound books neatly stacked on built-in shelves line the walls of this room.  Close to the window sits a scrivener's desk and tall chair, while a few small reading tables are fronted with leather chairs.  To one side, a dessert table holds a tray of drinks.  Two opposite walls of shelves are interrupted by a burled maple doorway and a set of double doors carved with fanciful figures from Elanthian history.  A dimly lit hallway leads deeper into the building.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Restaurant]
description: Opening onto a vista of gardens and forest, floor-to-ceiling windows expand the space of the dining area.  A long maoral sideboard against one wall boasts refreshments.  Snowy white linens and fine porcelain adorn rosewood tables, some out in the open, while others are more private, behind square wooden columns holding the enormous exposed beams of the rafters.  Stuffed hawk-owls and eagles peer down from their perches in those rafters, while a woven runner carpets the hallway from the restaurant into the library.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Back Lawn]
description: Providing both a rustic and elegant backdrop to a stately lodge, tall birches grow along a large expanse of finely-trimmed, emerald green lawn bordered by a thick pine forest.  To the east, the trees are more sparse, the ocean just barely visible through them.  A long, rectangular reflecting pool stands in the center of the lawn, bordered by two thin strips of brightly hued flower beds.  Resting on the lip of the pool is a small earthenware bowl that holds a handful of birdseed.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Kitchen]
description: Bustling kitchen staff work in organized harmony, rotating about cooking stations dedicated to everything from roasting whole animals to piping the frosting on desserts.  The smells of baking bread, roasting meat, and sweet fruit compotes permeate the area.  Wide double doors make up the west wall, allowing the wait staff entrance to the restaurant.

title: [Guardian Keep, Bailey Gate]
description: The slope of the lawn creates a natural depression around the bailey gate, where a broad circle of paving stones is bordered by some square-trimmed boxwood bushes.  The cobblestone path divides the lush, green lawn, heading north toward a thick copse of trees and southwest to the stable grounds.

title: [A Snow-Covered Path]
description: The interwoven canopy of snowy boughs creates a tunnel effect on a narrow, secluded path that winds northeast towards a gate within a grey stone wall.  Fallen pine needles from the coniferous forest pad the trail with a fragrant carpet that both muffles footfalls and adds traction to the snow-covered ground.  The sound of wild songbirds in the trees occasionally trills through the area, and the scent of wood smoke beckons from further down the path.

title: [A Weathered Shack]
description: Long modwir shelves lined with various potions, tools, and the unidentifiable remains of plants dominate one side of this relatively large shack.  A simple counter sits near the rear of the room directly in front of a thick wooden door.

title: [Burga Hall, Outer Yard]
description: The grey stone of the outer wall is a sharp contrast to the deep green pine of the surrounding trees.  Narrow lancet windows are set on either side of the black gate set in the wall, peering out like unseeing eyes.  Strands of ivy vines obscure the darker stones, smoothing the rough edges with the natural softness of their leaves, while adding another touch of green to the drab landscape.  Snow blankets the ground in pure white drifts, and a meandering path leads to the southwest through the copse of trees.

title: [Burga Hall, Courtyard]
description: A cobbled path, leading from the black gate to the porch steps, breaks the monotony of the white-encrusted landscape.  The path's stones are a multi-hued mosaic that repeats a colorful abstract pattern along its length.  The walkway is free from ice and snow, proof of a groundskeeper who keeps it clear.  Iceblossoms and frostflowers add their pale colors to the flower beds that hug the wall of the low, wide building.  Branching from the main path, a long snow-packed trail leads into the trees at the side of the hall.

title: [Iceland Skate Center]
description: A towering building built of ice stands tall at the end of a snow-packed trail.  Icicle-covered trees hang heavy over the structure, every breeze causing a tinkling sound to emanate from above.  Two detailed ice statues, depicting both male and female halfling skaters, stand on either side of an ice-covered arch.  Beside the entrance, a large wool-lined cart is piled high with wintery supplies.

title: [Iceland Lobby]
description: Though the rink is enclosed in walls of pure ice, drakar torches emanate a subtle heat that keeps the area warm enough for comfort, but not hot enough to melt the ice.  The upward curving walls support a huge translucent dome-shaped roof through which the sky is clearly visible.  The sunlight beating down through the ice refracts and casts dappled shadows on the rink below.  Hugging the rink's wall beside the entrance is a carved felwood skate bin, while opposite, a winding staircase leads up.

The upward curving walls support a huge translucent dome-shaped roof through which the sky is clearly visible.  The moonlight streaming down through the ice refracts and casts dappled shadows on the rink below.  Hugging the rink's wall beside the entrance is a carved felwood skate bin, while opposite, a winding staircase leads up.

title: [Iceland Mezzanine]
description: The balcony wraps around the entire structure and offers a full view of the rink below.  From here the skaters gliding in circles around the ice would look like toys on a fancy music box.  Lining the walls are several potbellied stoves that sit on brick platforms between cozy aqua blue sofas.  A descending staircase hugs the wall opposite the railing.

title: [Iceland Rink]
description: The smell of warm tarts and hot popcorn fills the air, and bright cheery music sets the pace for any skaters in the area.  The floor is solid ice and surrounded by a safety railing.  Up above, a mezzanine overlooks the entire area, where onlookers can relax on sofas near wood-burning stoves.

title: [Burga Hall, Porch]
description: Long and rectangular, this room encompasses about half of the front facade of the building.  The hardwood floor is kept free from debris and snow by an absorbent rug resting by the door leading out.  With stone bricks comprising the bottom half of the walls and wood planks making up the top, the room has a rustic feel, amplified by the wrought iron lanterns that illuminate the area from their perch in niches along the walls.  Near the entry, a white wooden table holds a variety of glittering objects.

title: [Burga Hall, Foyer]
description: Dark oak-paneled walls encapsulate the room on all sides, broken by several ports of entry.  A set of soft burgundy arm chairs face each other across a muted gold area rug that covers the center of the ebonwood flooring.  Against the nearby wall, an oak sideboard provides various refreshments for those waiting in the foyer.  In the eastern wall, an archway leads to a dimly lit room, while in the western wall, a carved oak door and a curved frost white doorway are separated by potted ferns.  Tendrils of cold emanate from the cracks around a set of glass double doors.

title: [Burga Hall, Back Lawn]
description: Snow coats the ground across the lawn, yet a variety of indigenous wild flowers bloom within carefully ringed cultivated areas.  Snow lilies and pansies take up residence alongside larkspur and ice tulips.  The pale hues of the landscape create a glittering ice garden that sparkles in the sunlight like gold.  In the center of the lawn, an octagonal granite fountain flows with a soft bubbling sound, and a small earthenware bowl rests on the lip.  Set into the outer stone wall of the building, a set of glass double doors reveals the foyer within.

Snow coats the ground across the lawn, yet a variety of indigenous wild flowers bloom within carefully ringed cultivated areas.  Snow lilies and pansies take up residence alongside larkspur and ice tulips.  The pale hues of the landscape create a glittering ice garden that sparkles in the moonlight like silver.  In the center of the lawn, an octagonal granite fountain flows with a soft bubbling sound, and a small earthenware bowl rests on the lip.  Set into the outer stone wall of the building, a set of glass double doors reveals the foyer within.

title: [Burga Hall, Transport Room]
description: Ice blue walls surround this small room that is little more than a spacious closet.  Leaning up against one wall, a small table stands beside a curved frost white doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling white and green portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Myriad snowflakes have been etched into the metal, each one different from the last, much like their icy inspirations.

title: [Burga Hall, Tavern]
description: The area is lit by panoramic windows that take up the top half of the exterior walls, while the bottom is paneled in a cherry oak that lends warmth to the room.  The paneling is broken only by a carved cherry oak door and a rounded black oak archway, as well as several ensconced lanterns.  At one side of the room, an expansive wooden bar holds a variety of concoctions, and behind it a colorful banner hangs on the wall.  Scattered around a plush forest green carpet are tables and chairs stained a slightly lighter shade than the paneling.

title: [Burga Hall, Game Room]
description: Lit by a single candle that rests atop each of several tables, the room is dim and wreathed in a thin veil of smoke that obscures the darkened corners.  A plush forest green rug covers the hardwood floor and muffles the sounds of footfalls.  Scattered atop the rug are a few black velvet settees, each one paired with a carved cherry oak end table.  The only break in the dark, matte gold paint of the walls is a rounded black oak archway that affords a glimpse of the tavern.

title: [Burga Hall, Lounge]
description: The chamber is octagonal in shape, with padded stone seats at the base of each of the floor-to-ceiling windows that peer out from the exterior walls.  Heavy tapestries edged with gold fringe hang on the darkly paneled walls between the windows.  Opposite these, a simple stone fireplace resides in one wall, flanked by ensconced torches set at the level of the mantel.  On opposing sides of the hearth, a rounded archway and a carved dark oak door lead out of the room, the light from the flames not penetrating to illuminate what lies beyond.

title: [Burga Hall, Chapel]
description: Dozens of thick beeswax candles cast a pale yellow glow across the room, creating a soothing atmosphere.  Several thick, velvet meditation mats have been placed around the room, providing a comfortable place to pray and commune with the gods.  Brackets affixed to the darkly paneled walls hold bouquets of fragrant lilies entwined with dark green strands of ivy.  A small stone and oak altar stands beneath a stained glass window that portrays the environs of Icemule in a variety of blues and greys.  A carved dark oak door leads out of the chapel.

title: [A Long Pier]
description: Grey and cracked, the thick planks of the pier are roughly cut.  The structure creaks and groans as the water laps at the pilings, and the gentle breezes brush against it as they traverse the area.  Clumps of water lilies float on the water's surface on either side of the raised wooden platform, their sweet fragrance filling the air with a heady scent.  The pier stretches out deep into the water to the east, finally culminating at a lighthouse.

title: [Mistral Hall, Entrance]
description: At the end of the pier stands a tall white lighthouse, its circular base supporting the gradually diminishing upper levels.  The scent of the sea flows inland from the mouth of the delta, borne on breezes that displace the surface of the water, causing endless ripples to fan out and lap around the thick wooden pilings that hold the entire structure above water.  Planters of pale driftwood rest on the pier against the outer wall, flanking the entry, their floral contents nearly overflowing with a rainbow of colors.

title: [Mistral Hall, Porch]
description: The front, rounded wall of the semi-circular room is crafted from fine fishing nets stretched taut within a driftwood frame that also houses the entry door.  Standing against the flat back wall is a weathered grey table, while a carved wooden sign hangs above.  A white archway leads to the other half of the bottom level, while a set of narrow stairs heads upward through a rectangular hole in the ceiling.  Water lapping against the pilings below provides a soft, rhythmic sound, and the sea breezes permeate this open room.

title: [Mistral Hall, Banquet Hall]
description: White driftwood walls climb to a generous height, surrounding this semi-circular room.  Several open porthole windows offer a view of the area below, and allow faint breezes into the hall.   In the center of the room, a long darkly stained table is surrounded by padded wooden chairs.  Several sphere-shaped, green paper lanterns dangle from the ceiling, their light casting a variety of verdant shadows on the floor.  An ascending spiral steps resides near the back wall, and a narrow staircase leads down.  A curved pale blue doorway offers entrance to the next room.

title: [Mistral Hall, Transport Room]
description: Pale blue walls surround this semi-circular room that appears to take up considerably less than half of this floor of the lighthouse.  Leaning up against the straight wall, a small table stands beside a curved pale blue doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling sunny yellow portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  River reeds and water lilies have been etched into the metal, their shapes intertwined to form a complex pattern.

title: [Mistral Hall, Game Room]
description: A wood-framed window in the outer wall is wide and low, providing a view just above the water level.  Silk pillows in vivid colors placed around the curved wall of the semi-circular room enable guests to arrange themselves in comfort, while the flat inner wall contains a narrow white archway that leads out, as well as several dimly lit tables complete with matching chairs.  Between the tables, potted plants offer a light floral scent to the room which complements the salty breezes from the porch beyond the archway.

title: [Mistral Hall, Lounge]
description: Only comprised of half of this upper floor, the space is semi-circular, and a watercolor painting hangs a smidge off-center on the flat wall beside a narrow white archway that leads to the next room.  Curtains of beads flutter in the open windows along the curved wall, their faint clicking mixing with the sounds of the water below in a rhythmic harmony.  Several wicker sofas with plush cushions rest around a sky blue rug in the center of the floor, and a tall white bookshelf displays a few tomes and sea glass knick-knacks.  A set of spiral steps leads down.

title: [Mistral Hall, Conservatory]
description: The rounded exterior wall is made of the same fine netting that encloses the porch downstairs, allowing the salty breezes to permeate the semi-circular room.  A variety of plants take residence on a tiered wooden table that runs along the netted wall, allowing the fauna ample sunlight.  Two low padded benches rest against the interior wall, flanking a narrow white archway.  Standing beside a set of spiral stairs are two potted palms and a stone planter filled with colorful flowers, their faint scents adding a subtle tropical ambiance to the room, while a small sea glass fountain sits on the floor nearby.

title: [Mistral Hall, Office]
description: Light breezes waft in through an open window, occasionally ruffling papers on a dark driftwood desk that stands, along with its matching chair, beside the curved pale ivory wall.  Oak-framed paintings of local flora and fauna are scattered on the opposite wall, their contents depicted in vivid hues that add sporadic splashes of color to the off-white room.  A rounded oak arch in the flat wall offers entrance into the other half of this circular level of the lighthouse, while a set of spiral stairs leads down.

title: [Mistral Hall, Chapel]
description: Light and airy, this half-circle room has been converted into a small shrine.  Woven meditation mats are spread across the hardwood floor, offering a place for restful repose.  The curved, pale green painted wall sports an open window and thin, sheer ocean blue curtains that flutter in the occasional breeze.  A low oak and seashell altar stands beneath the window, opposite from both a rounded oak arch that leads to the next room and a narrow set of stairs that heads up through an opening in the ceiling.

title: [Mistral Hall, Upper Deck]
description: A low metal railing surrounds the circular topmost level of the lighthouse without obscuring the view of the surroundings.  In the center of the space, a large fire pit rests in an iron retaining bowl to prevent the signal fires from spreading to the weathered wooden planks of the deck.  A bundle of thick wooden sticks rests in a basket nearby, and several fire tending tools reside in an iron rack.  Sitting atop a low table near the railing is a small earthenware bowl, while a narrow set of stairs leads downward through a rectangular hole in the floor.

title: [A Stony Path]
description: A path of finely cobbled river stone winds northwest towards a narrow building perched on a slight rise in the landscape.  Twisted black pine trees lean over the pathway, their limbs entangled like the strands of a spider's web.

title: [Welkin Hall, Entrance]
description: Broad stone steps lead up towards a narrow building constructed of marbled quartz.  Thin ribbons of grey, blue, and pink streak the stones, giving an almost festive appearance to the facade broken only by a dwarven statue that stands guard beside a steel-banded door.  High above, arched windows peer out over the landscape like unseeing eyes, the glass reflecting minimal light from the sky.

title: [Welkin Hall, Common Room]
description: The timbers of the lofted ceiling are exposed in repeating arches down the center of the stone room.  The large area is split at the northern end by several screens.  Natural light filters in from above through lancet windows, glittering across the contents of a wide oak table.  A pine-framed oil painting hangs above the stone hearth in the eastern wall, and in front, a group of settees are arranged around a burgundy and gold rug.  On the same wall is a carved linden arch and a curved crimson doorway, while opposite, a set of glass double doors leads outside.

title: [Welkin Hall, Back Lawn]
description: A path of crushed seashells leads away from a set of glass double doors in the building's exterior and meanders through the lush green swath of cultured lawn.  Several stone benches rest beside the path, flanked by fanciful topiaries pruned in the shapes of local wildlife.  At the end of the path, a circular stone fountain provides relief from the heat for an array of colorful birds.  In a concentric ring around the fountain, vivid flowers bloom within a bed bordered by dark blue sea glass bricks.

title: [Welkin Hall, Transport Room]
description: Stone grey walls surround this small room that is little more than a spacious closet.  Leaning up against one wall, a small table stands beside a curved crimson doorway that leads out of the room.  Nearby, a young attendant stands ready to serve.  The focal point of the room is a swirling black and red portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Clusters of stars have been etched into the metal, several of them spouting tails like comets.

title: [Welkin Hall, Game Room]
description: Lit by a single candle that rests atop each of several tables, the room is dim and faintly scented with sawdust and incense.  A plush gold rug covers the hardwood floor and muffles the sounds of footfalls.  Scattered atop the rug are a few soft burgundy sofas, each one paired with a carved linden end table.  Set in one oak-paneled wall, a carved pine arch leads out of the room, while on the other, ebon-framed paintings of the local flora and fauna are displayed at even intervals.

title: [Welkin Hall, Oriel Chamber]
description: This northern portion of the common room is separated from the main by several folded screens of dark oak and golden silk.  Resting against the wall is a long pine table, coupled with several high-backed padded chairs stained a dark chestnut hue.  Recesses with scalloped arches are set in even intervals within the walls, each sporting a black iron sconce, with tall candles exuding faint curls of smoke.  Tucked in one such recess is an oak door, while opposite, another reveals a stone staircase that blends with the wall.

title: [Welkin Hall, Landing]
description: Stone walls give way to dark oak panels on the upper half, amber-paned oil lanterns lighting the narrow landing with a soft, golden glow.  Two doors stand at opposite ends, each one intricately carved.  The deep golden linden door to the left bears the image of an erupting volcano inlaid with ruby, while the mahogany door to the right presents a hulking pyrothag outlined in black deathstone inlay.  Opposite the doors, a stone staircase leads down into the belly of the building.

title: [Welkin Hall, Chapel]
description: Tracery windows of rose-tinted crystal form the backdrop of the chapel's simple stone and pine altar.  Recessed niches along the walls hold vases of flowers and other offerings left by pilgrims who have long since continued on their way.  A woven burgundy rug traverses the stone floor from the oak door to the altar, leading visitors through the small shrine.

title: [Welkin Hall, Library]
description: Reddish mahogany bookcases obscure the smooth ebonwood walls that resemble the featureless visage of the famed pyrothag.  Stretched out across the floorboards is a plush, burgundy rug that reaches nearly to the carved molding where the floor and walls meet, leaving a border of dark flooring exposed.  Several overstuffed divans occupy much of the open floor space, with a simple writing desk resting beneath the only window in the room.  A mahogany door leads out to the landing.

title: [Welkin Hall, Office]
description: The soft golden hue of a linden door is matched by the linden panels that cover the lower half of the walls, while a pale ivory paint colors the top half.  Several ensconced torches hang at even intervals, just above the divide in color.  The molding is finely carved with swirls and eddies, each groove inlaid with fiery scarlet and deep crimson gems, which catch the light to resemble liquid lava.  A sturdy linden desk and chair set stands opposite a wide glass-paned window, while a black-framed painting hangs directly above.

title: [Ruined Temple, Dais]
description: Gentle waves ebb and flow across the short dais, crashing into the carved staircase that leads to the floor above.  Several large metal pots, etched with intricate wavy designs, rest at the base of the staircase, rusted and worn where submerged.
