title: [The Bank of Kharam-Dzu, Alcove]
description: A few dwarves trickle into this alcove to conduct transactions with their portfolios at teller windows along the south wall.  Piles of papers have been stacked upon a long grey steel counter nearby, with clerks constantly stamping and sorting through the organized chaos.

title: [House Sovyn, Foyer]
description: This spacious foyer is enhanced by a large glass skylight which reflects colored lights about the room and among many of the plants.  Comfortable chairs near a pinewood bar invite you to relax before returning to your duties.  Against one wall, a small walnut counter sits beneath a blackboard, and a silver arch, a green arch, and a white arch lead out of the foyer.

title: [House Sovyn, Workshop]
description: In this room you feel energy and power flowing all around you.  You are amazed that you can see the courtyard from the inside, while from the outside you cannot see in.  There are myriad crystal shelves and cabinets containing many rare magic items, strange powders and colored vials.  A large crystal workbench with a red stone imbedded in it rests in the center of the floor.  The moonlight that surrounds you is coming from the walls and the high windows in the tower.

In this room you feel energy and power flowing all around you.  You are amazed that you can see the courtyard from the inside, while from the outside you cannot see in.  There are myriad crystal shelves and cabinets containing many rare magic items, strange powders and colored vials.  A large crystal workbench with a red stone imbedded in it rests in the center of the floor.  The light that surrounds you is coming from the walls and the high windows in the tower.

title: [House Sovyn, Khyle's Room]
description: The floor and walls of this peaceful room are covered with white marble veined with silver that sparkles from the light of an open window.  Upon a desk under the window sits a variety of reading materials, a painting of Amaltea in a heart-shaped frame and a small silver framed painting.  Two steps lead up to a landing which supports a large, four-poster bed with white silk sheets and pillows.  A tapestry hangs on the opposite wall of the bed.

The floor and walls of this peaceful room are covered with white marble veined with silver that sparkles from the moonlight of an open window.  Upon a desk under the window sits a variety of reading materials, a painting of Amaltea in a heart-shaped frame and a small silver framed painting.  Two steps lead up to a landing which supports a large, four-poster bed with white silk sheets and pillows.  A tapestry hangs on the opposite wall of the bed.

title: [House Sovyn, 1st Floor Hallway]
description: A plush, sea blue carpet runs the length of this hallway.  The walls are done in a patterned paper that reminds you of sea foam.  Two giant seashells flank the staircases.

title: [House Sovyn, Derek's Room]
description: This spacious but cozy room is lined with bookcases containing tomes on every aspect of Elanthian life.  A wooden four-poster bed covered with a white quilt stands against the back wall, a massive misty glaes trunk at its feet.  Several paintings stand displayed on a modwir nightstand next to the glowing fireplace that brings a sense of warmth to the room, and a small shrine stands near the door.

title: [House Sovyn, Hallway]
description: A plush, dark brown carpet runs the length of this hallway to a pair of statues which stand flanking the staircases.  The walls are paneled in oak and lightly stained so the grain is still visible.

title: [House Sovyn, Pond]
description: Winding through patches of herbs and flowers, a narrow footpath comes to an end at the edge of a small wooden dock, which extends out over a crystal blue pond.  Several trees surround the pond, shading most of its shores.  Large lily pads float across the surface of the water, providing ample resting spots for any nearby frogs.  Nestled underneath a tall oak tree is an ornate wooden bench flanked by a bed of sovyn bushes.

title: [House Sovyn, Library]
description: Floor to ceiling bookshelves of highly polished rowan wood and stacked with ancient tomes line the walls of this room and the balcony above.  Well-lit window seats offer a comfortable place for reading one of the many volumes lining the shelves.  Upon a pedestal in one corner sits an enormous globe, while centered in the room is a massive linden wood table with matching chairs.

title: [House Sovyn, 2nd Floor Hallway]
description: Soft spring green carpet runs the length of this hallway.  The walls on either side are painted with scenes of inviting forests.  Miniature trees in gold pots flank the staircase.

title: [House Sovyn, Blue Suite]
description: This suite for house members is decorated in cool shades of blue.  A sea blue couch runs the length of one wall, with a long low glass table supported by two giant shells in front of it.  Several comfortable chairs are grouped around the table providing additional seating.

title: [House Sovyn, Ruriko's Room]
description: The elegance of this room reflects the personality of its owner.  The walls are done in a soft white silk patterned paper.  An ebon wood bed rests against the far wall while under a circular window an ancient ebon wood cabinet sits with a crystal and gold butterfly mobile on it.

title: [House Sovyn, Sune's Room]
description: The sweet scent of cothinar flower and a brilliant, gold light assail your senses.  In the center of the room is a comfortable-looking, carved rowan bed, draped in white spidersilk hangings and stacked high with emerald silk pillows.  Across the room, over a stone fireplace, your eyes are drawn to a painting hanging above the mantle.  On a far wall, in front of a window, a cothinar plant sits atop a table.  Across the ceiling, a glowing mural spans from wall to wall.

title: [House Sovyn, Bede's Room]
description: Elaborately carved oaken doors open up into this small bedroom.  Most of the room is taken up by ancient tomes.  A glint of silver from a scroll amongst the tomes catches your eye.  Above a massive hearth hangs a venerable golden rolaren scabbard, the size of a claidhmore.  An adjacent alcove holds a silk-draped altar.

title: [House Sovyn, Dining Room]
description: Soft laughter and the sounds of silver on china are heard as people gather for meals.  Delicious smells fill the air as meals are served by smiling footmen.  The tables are set with fine china and crystal and the polish of the tables creates an air of relaxation among the exotic, delicious food.

title: [House Sovyn, Kitchen]
description: This warm inviting room is filled with the wondrous smells of flavorful dishes.  A huge open hearth fireplace and brick oven dominates one wall with smells of freshly baked bread filling the air.  Bright copper pots and crystalline vessels hang by hooks above a large counter.  On a small side table, plates of fresh food wait to be prepared.

title: [House Sovyn, Nursery]
description: You hear the soft sounds of a lullaby being sung nearby.  In one corner a rocking chair rocks as if it has just been vacated.  Walls of a soft blue, painted with scenes of unicorns, rabbits and deer frolicking, catch your eye and you swear that one of the deer winked at you.  Small cribs line one wall with a changing table sitting by the window.  A huge toy chest, overflowing with colorful toys to delight any youngster, draws your eye from the corner of the room.

title: [House Sovyn, Rooftop Garden]
description: A carefully cultivated carpet of rich grass grows, high on top of House Sovyn.  A multitude of different-sized flowers grows amidst low trees giving you the sense of being in the middle of a small forest.  Unobtrusive benches are placed around the garden allowing one to sit and relax.  Directly in the center of the roof several large stone pillars sit in a circle and a small covered stairway in the corner leads back down into the house.

A carefully cultivated carpet of rich grass grows, high on top of House Sovyn.  Brilliantly colored flowers grow amidst low trees giving you the sense of being in the middle of a small forest.  Unobtrusive benches are placed around the garden allowing one to sit and relax.  Directly in the center of the roof several large stone pillars sit in a circle and a small covered stairway in the corner leads back down into the house.

title: [House Sovyn, Temple of Light]
description: This small open-air shrine is dedicated to all the Gods and Goddesses of Light.  Twenty-one pillars circle the inside of the shrine.  Each pillar is engraved with the symbols of a different god and a scene depicting the sphere of control for that individual god.  At the foot of each pillar is a small offering bowl.  Resting in the center of the pillars is an altar made from the tree stump of a lightning-struck oak.

title: [House Sovyn, Green Suite]
description: Stepping into this room is like stepping into a jungle.  Exotic trees and plants abound, and you only catch glimpses of secluded groupings of benches and chairs among the greenery.

title: [House Sovyn, Leianna's Room]
description: A soft glow of candlelight casts shadows throughout the room, blurring the lines between reality and illusion.  An intricately carved oak bed dominates one wall, piled with midnight blue and grey silk pillows.  Across the room, a deep grey chaise lounge sits invitingly next to a small oak table.

title: [House Sovyn, Sinn's Room]
description: Cool air surrounds you, permeating your being.  Candles on a seven-sided altar provide the only light in this dim room.  Shadows cast by the flickering candlelight shift in a macabre dance over the floor-to-ceiling bookshelves lining the walls.  Papers and opened tomes are strewn on a desk in organized disarray.

title: [House Sovyn, Hugo's Room]
description: Paintings of trees and flowers hang on the brightly painted walls, although some outlines of what look like animal hides still show through the new paint.  A mountain snowcat hide rests in a place of honor by a stone fireplace and a huge weapon rack hangs on the wall above.  A small altar with the symbol of V'tull painted on it is one corner, and in another rests a giant four-poster bed complete with royal blue drapery.  A haon dresser sits beside the bed holding small items.

title: [House Sovyn, Sun Room]
description: Large glass panes form the walls and roof of this room, providing ample sunlight during the day and a perfect spot for the blossoming plants to grow.  The ground is covered with bricks and several tables are placed among the foliage.

Large glass panes form the walls and roof of this sunny room, providing a perfect spot for the blossoming plants to grow.  The ground is covered with bricks and several tables are placed among the foliage.

title: [House Sovyn, Hallway]
description: A vibrant red carpet lines this dim hallway.  The only light comes from two large brass braziers flanking the staircase.  Flickering shadows turn the silk patterned paper on the walls into shimmering pools of red.

title: [House Sovyn, Music Room]
[House Sovyn, Ballroom]
description: Strains of soft music are heard from one of the many splendid music boxes on display as you enter this room.  The highly polished oak floor reflects light from crystal shaded lamps hanging from the high ceiling, while comfortable chairs and couches are grouped around a beautiful golden harp.  Musical instruments are displayed on top of a cabinet, and a splendid set of bagpipes hangs above it on the wall, just waiting for a spirited player.

An elegant, spiraling crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling in the center of the room, illuminating the highly polished oak floors beneath.  Positioned in the corner across from the entryway is a series of comfortable chairs and couches grouped around a beautiful golden harp.  Musical instruments sit atop a long wall mantel, while a splendid set of bagpipes hangs above it, just waiting for a spirited player.  Another mantel along the opposite wall displays an assortment of ornate music boxes.

title: [House Sovyn, Brown Suite]
description: This suite is tastefully decorated in rich shades of brown.  A golden brown couch runs the length of one wall, with two tables flanking it.  On each table sits a vase with flowers in it.  Numerous chairs are spread around the room to provide additional sitting space, making this a fine place for quiet conversation.

title: [House Sovyn, Eillie's Room]
description: This cozy bedroom smells of sweet incense with an undertone of chocolate.  The lovely rosewood and maoral floor is uncovered, while the walls are liberally draped with silk from the palest green to the deep verdant hues of the forest.  A large comfortable bed rests in a corner next to a full length mirror.  Above the bed hangs a large painting.

title: [House Sovyn, Stormy and Jynxd's]
description: The sheer simplicity of this room seems to welcome you with open arms.  A comfy leather couch sits against one wall, with a portrait next to it.  In one corner, you see a stack of well-thumbed anatomy books next to a small shrine.  In the other corner is a statue.

title: [Stormy and Jynxd's Bedroom]
description: The theme of simplicity is carried over in this bedroom with its white-washed walls and sturdy oaken beams.  A large bed graces the center of the room, while one wall is dominated by a huge mural and the other is dominated by a sparkling crystal aquarium.

title: [House Sovyn, Cru's Room]
description: You are in a rectangular stone room which contains a glowing cobalt obelisk emanating a soft humming sound.  Under an intricate stained glass window is a statue of a half-elf cleric on horseback.  On the far side of the room stands a luxurious bed covered with soft furs and jewel-colored silken pillows.

title: [House Sovyn, Cavern]
description: This large subterranean cavern is lit only by torches set in sconces spaced evenly around the perimeter of the cave.  Natural crystals in the walls refract the flickering light creating beautiful rainbow patterns.  Water pours from an opening high above the ground, forming a waterfall, and splashes into a stream that winds its way between huge stalagmites that rise from the ground to meet large stalactites hanging from the ceiling way above you.  The light is too dim for you to see across the stream.

title: [House Sovyn, Cavern]
description: Rough stones cover this end of the cavern, encircling the deep pool of water.   Off to one side the stream widens into a bubbling mud pool.  Steam and bubbles indicate the presence of thermal heat generated by hot springs nearby.  The lichen on the rocks lighten the area and turn it into an inviting relaxing retreat.

title: [House Sovyn, Hot Springs]
description: The hot water from the natural springs bubbles around you and along with the rhythmic gurgling of the stream, relaxes you, putting you completely at ease.

title: [House Sovyn, Mud Pool]
description: This small area off the Hot Springs is darker, the walls slick with the condensation coming from the steam arising off the mud.  The thick mud oozing over you at first makes you squirm, but then the heat and mud seeps into your body relaxing you.  The bubbling mud seems to revitalize you, bringing a smile of contentment to your face.

title: [House Sovyn, Underground Vault]
description: Oil lamps hang from the tips of stalactites in this small natural cavern, sending shadows scurrying across the rough-hewn stone as they sway.  Some intricately carved chests are nestled between the matching stalagmites and appear rooted to the stone.  Rich brocaded tapestries of green and silver cling to the eastern and western walls, adding a touch of color and warmth to the otherwise stark vault.

title: [House Sovyn, Temple of Darkness]
description: The darkness is oppressive as you step behind the waterfall into a small cavern.  The rock walls are completely black from being scorched by some untold intense fire.  A large body-sized onyx altar dominates the center, liquid still fresh on its surface.  The absence of any gods' names or visages shows that the disciples of these gods respect their desire for anonymity.

title: [House Sovyn, Game Room]
description: The air of friendly competition is felt in this room as people gather around the tables to watch and play.  Games from every land stand ready or in boxes, while stacks of cards, piles of colored stones and dice wait on the many shelves lining the walls.

title: [House Sovyn, Red Suite]
description: This suite is decorated completely in pure white.  The floor is strewn invitingly with large soft white pillows covered with fresh blood red rose petals -- the scent of roses is intoxicating.  In the center, a large circular white marble hearth stands burning merrily.  The light from the fire turns everything in the room into a pure flaming red.

title: [House Sovyn, Benerio's Room]
description: The conflicting tones of black and white assail your senses as you gaze around the room.  Your eyes are drawn to a sculpture in the corner that seems to be turning.  The cool onyx and white ora floor is offset by a warm snowcat fur rug in front of an onyx bed.  Along one wall stands an altar in contrasting patterns of black and white ora.

title: [House Sovyn, Jeulen's Room]
description: This small room is sparsely furnished.  A small bed with a straw mattress is in one corner and a plain wooden table with chairs in another.  Various personal effects, none of which seem particularly interesting, line a small shelf over the table.  In the far corner sits a small stone altar.

title: [House Sovyn, Ravenstorm's Room]
description: Decorated in relaxing shades of green and gold, everything in this room is scaled to giantman proportions.  The first thing you notice is the large ornate fireplace sending the odor of burning white birch throughout the room.  The plush forest green carpet muffles your footsteps as you walk in and notice the plants growing in all four corners.  A large solid bed rests up against one wall near a solid oak desk.

title: [House Sovyn, Tvarr's Room]
description: A mural depicting symbols of the changing seasons covers the curving wall of this circular chamber.  The floor is tiled in a swirling circle of half black and half white that matches the painted symbol on the door, lending a sense of peace and balance to the room.  A subtle scent of incense rises from a low table near the door.

title: [House Sovyn, Library Balcony]
description: The atmosphere on this balcony is quiet and contemplative as people relax with their favorite novels.  The shelves are continued here as an extension of the numerous works held below.  Comfortable chairs are spread across the balcony so that you may read before climbing the stairs to the main library.

title: [House Sovyn, Vault]
description: This small cave is brightly lit by some sort of glowing fungus which covers all the walls.  A path has been worn out of the stone floor by repeated use.  You also see a curtain leading to a small alcove and a lever on one wall.

title: [House Sovyn, Lockers]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove toward the rear of the vault.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and rests open on a stone counter.

title: [House Sovyn, Vault]
description: This small cave is brightly lit by some sort of glowing fungus which covers all the walls.  A path has been worn out of the stone floor by repeated use.

title: [House Sovyn, Lockers]
description: This is a secluded alcove toward the rear of the vault.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and rests open on a stone counter.

title: [Dreadnaught Alliance Courtyard]
description: Secured by a massive stone wall, this spacious courtyard is a welcome retreat.  A deep fire pit encircled by black stones fills the area with warmth.  An old, dried-up cobblestone well sits alongside a stone bench.  Posted near the gigantic drawbridge is an oak signpost staked into the ground.  A massive gnarled oak tree with grey threadlike moss hanging from its branches rests in the midst.  A winding cobblestone path guides travelers to the torch-lit stairs, the entrance to the Dreadnaught tavern, and beyond.

title: [The Dreadnaught Tavern]
description: Polished hardwood floors cover this fine tavern as four carved griffin columns support the massive structure.  A long, curved bar stretches around the room.  Hanging near the stone fireplace and a wood holder is a shield-shaped dart board.  Several card and gaming tables encircle a glossy pine dance floor.  Nearing the posterior, an enormous griffin's head carved of stone rises from the ground.  The griffin's open mouth serves as an entranceway into the tower.  You also see an oak bin and a sign.

title: [The Nightwolve's Den]
description: Interlocking grey stones stretch from wall to wall of this chamber, complimenting the thick crimson velvet drapes that frame the open windows.  A bloodwood desk with an oversized chair sits in one corner.  A black wolf skin rug is stretched out on the floor, with two identical chairs placed on either side.  Facing the marble fireplace, a black leather couch provides a comfortable place to enjoy its warmth.  Hanging above the mantle is a small tapestry.  You also see an oak bin and a griffin-shaped dart board.

title: [The Shadowguard's Lair]
description: This spacious windowless lair has been constructed from unpolished black obsidian to absorb light.  A single miniature griffin-shaped torch is positioned to light the entryway, but little else.  An overwhelming darkness fills the room, providing the illusion of infinite space.  Almost blending into the darkness, an elongated leather couch sits across from a wide ebonwood desk with a tall leather chair.  You also see a small black pit and a small griffin-shaped dart board.

title: [The Onyx Griffin Hunting Lodge]
description: Resembling a naturally formed cave, most of the walls of this great room are clearly unfinished, while the floor is covered with a massive bearskin rug.  Off to one side sits an elongated hide couch and a towering bone desk that have been crafted for function instead of style.  Mounted on the wall is an expansive plaque with stuffed heads of beasts gathered from all corners of the lands.  The entire aft wall has been sculpted into the head of a griffin, its slit-eyes reflecting light.

title: [Knights of the Talon Chamber]
description: Casting shadows high onto the walls of this ominous chamber, immense dark blue flames rise up from a griffin-shaped deep fueled gully.  A black mithril circular table with an elaborately hand-painted white war griffin rests on a raised platform in the center of this raging fire.  Just out of reach of the swirling flames, twelve high back stone chairs have been lightly scorched over time.  An elongated black tapestry ripples from the heat waves cast recklessly across the room.

title: [Temple of Reunification]
description: This pure golden ora-plated temple holds eight glorious tapestries bearing the crests of the Great Elven Houses.  The centerpiece of the room is a slender mithril case securing an ancient elven crown atop a gold pillow, which is encircled by carving on the floor below that reads, "For The Day Eight Houses Become One."  In front of the open window overlooking the Elven Empire, a white stone table surrounded by eight seats has been masterfully hand-crafted and polished to a reflective sheen.

title: [Commander Dragorth's War Room]
description: A slab of black marble forms the base for a tall black fireplace, and a golden mantle stands opposite a large leather couch.  In the center, a long table covered with maps is encircled by several leather chairs.  Behind the table, a heavy hatch leads into the Dreadnaught vault.  Tall, open doors lead to a balcony.  Mounted on a railing is a spyglass aimed to survey the surrounding area, while an oversized telescope is pointed towards the stars.

title: [The Great Dreadnaught Vault]
description: Reinforced walls crafted from hardened steel and coated in bright gold expand the interior of this vault.  Flickering candles reflect light off the war chests overflowing with silver and gems and onto several portraits displayed in the rear.  An antique bookcase extends along the western wall adjacent a thick glass case with an intricate lock displaying artifacts.  A vintage oak wine cabinet with an assortment of liquors is perfectly displayed for all to see.

title: [Cell]
description: A damp chill rises from the stone floor.  Your eyes slowly adjust to the darkness that embraces you, revealing a small, cramped cell.  The faint glint of moisture glimmers on the walls, and the soft rustlings of animal life fill the musty air.  In the near absence of light you can barely make out an iron door leading out from the room.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Small, unrecognizable creatures scurry underfoot, retreating startled to the shadows to glare out with beady eyes.  Several torches shed an eerie, pale blue light over the roughly carved obsidian walls.  A crude table and benches are set in one corner of the room, opposite the passageway leading out of the cavern.  Set off to the side is a small alcove, almost invisible in the deep shadows.

title: [Small Niche]
description: The cubicle is dominated by a large, shimmering portal.  It seems to float in mid-air, the surface rippling and undulating like a black sea tossed by a fierce storm.  Light reflects off the rugged obsidian walls and low ceiling, giving them a silvery cast.

title: [Guarded Entryway]
description: Two tall, lean figures, their features obscured by heavy dark cloaks, stand before a door forged from solid black ora.  Their eyes glint violet from beneath the deep cowls, as if daring you to test their skill with the Dhe'nari whip-blades they carry in their gloved hands.  Opposite the sentinels, a tunnel disappears into the darkness of the caverns.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Foyer]
description: Black obsidian walls, polished to a sheen that nearly matches that of the tall silver mirror that stands at the west end of the foyer, rise to the vaulted ceiling thirty feet above.  A gracefully curved staircase of black marble winds along the walls, leading upwards into the higher reaches of the tower.  Dark banners emblazoned with symbols of the Dhe'nari castes hang high on the walls, and a set of double doors carved of black ora opens to the south.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: The open staircase hugs the wall, providing a dizzying view up into the heights of the tower.  The stair stops at a small landing at which several doors are set into the stone wall, then continues up in a steep spiral.  The glossy obsidian steps are each set with a slightly raised rolaren symbol that provides a safe grip on the slick stairs.

title: [Igrak's Room]
description: This room has a spartan feel.  A modwir washstand occupies one corner, a small writing table the center of the room under the window.  A dark blue rug is the only covering on the cold flagstones.  Two fel-hafted spears crossed under an Iylari roundshield serve as a wall decoration.

title: [Rasulis' Room]
description: The vaulted dark mahogany ceiling of this room rises above black marble walls and a thick black carpet, framing a large fireplace by the north wall and bookshelves upon the south.  Several comfortable leather armchairs rest before the fire, facing a portrait hung above the mantel, while a large four-poster bed rests nearby.  The glaes windows are shielded by long velvet curtains, providing privacy for the occupants.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Bathroom]
description: Oil lamps at the four corners illuminate the bathing chamber with a warm light.  Soft rugs cover the floor, keeping the obsidian dry and safe to walk on despite any water splashed from the huge bathtub.  Towels, soaps and scented oils sit in convenient spots about the room, ready for use by any bathers.

title: [Morlain's Room]
description: Light from flickering candles drives back the long shadows in this room.  Thick hunter green curtains rustle against partially open bay windows, billowing in a light breeze.  The walls are adorned with large bookcases containing all manner of foreign tomes and official township documents.  Beside the canopied bed are several comfortable reading chairs and a mahogany credenza with a map engraved on its surface.

title: [Shiliara's Room]
description: Dim torchlight reflects from numerous weapons that serve as both decoration and ready defense.  Ancient claidhmores and sharp swords hang from positions of honor around the room.  Below each weapon is a plaque naming the warrior who once carried it and the manner of their demise.  A solid modwir bed is pushed into one corner, leaving the rest of the room free for practice.  The floor itself gleams in polished patterns, worn by years of bare feet practicing the forms of the Dhe'nari martial arts.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Passage]
description: A single, unwavering torch illuminates a long, roughly hewn stone hallway.  Flecks of ore and crystal glimmer out from the natural rock walls, and coarse rockdust litters the floor, causing footfalls to crunch softly.  Dark passages lead off to the south and the west, and some rough stairs lead up into yet more gloom.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Passageway]
description: This hallway is stunningly decorated with a mural of silver beaten into the glossy black walls and ceiling.  The scene depicts a fantastic battle of great dragons and powerful Ur'Daemon, each figure a silver silhouette on a field of obsidian.  Several torches mounted on the walls burn with a strange blue flame, sending an eerie glow of scintillating light reflecting across the room.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Council Room]
description: The room is a perfect circle carved from the obsidian of the walls and polished to a mirror smoothness.  Blue light dances on the domed ceiling some forty feet above, reflecting from the magical torches burning in their sconces on the walls.  Three steps lead up to the dais in the center of the room, and a heavy, intricately carved door opens into the wall opposite the entrance.

title: [Chamber of the Obsidian Council]
description: A glaes table sits in a semicircle around the edge of the dais.  Behind the center of the table looms the deep obsidian throne of the Highlord.  Four smaller chairs, one of onyx, one of clear glaes, one of rolaren and one of black ora sit two to either side, making up the five chairs of the Obsidian Council.  An aura of power blankets the room, as if the strength of those who owned the chairs had imbedded itself into the very obsidian.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Hallway]
description: Silvery rolaren sconces are set at regular intervals along the walls, fine banners representing each Dhe'nar caste hanging between them.  Dominating the east wall is a richly-embroidered silk tapestry depicting three Dhe'nar nobles in a stylized battlefield.  Set into the stone next to the tapestry is a small mithril plaque.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Antechamber]
description: The thick puma fur carpeting and heavy velvet lining on the walls deadens nearly every sound in this small chamber.  Dark candles flicker quietly in the two onyx sconces mounted on either side of the room, and against either wall sits a dark mahogany bench covered with black velvet cushions.  A heavy velvet curtain hangs from an exquisitely crafted black ora arch.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Chapel]
description: Dark silken tapestries shroud the walls of this circular room.  From them the eyes of Noi'sho'rah, Tahlad, and other great leaders of the Dhe'nar stare down on you in silent appraisal.  A massive obsidian altar stands in the exact center of the room.  Dark candles burn in onyx sconces set at regular intervals around the room.  Extending six feet out from the altar lies a perfect circle of beaten copper, inset into the smooth floor.

Dark silken tapestries shroud the walls of this circular room.  From them the eyes of Noi'sho'rah, Tahlad, and other great leaders of the Dhe'nar stare down on you in silent appraisal.  A massive black altar stands in the exact center of the room.  Dark candles burn in onyx sconces set at regular intervals around the room.  Extending six feet out from the altar lies a perfect circle of beaten copper, inset into the smooth floor.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Barracks]
description: The scents of sweat and oil fill the air.  Gambesons and padded shirts hang over the ends of the bunks that line the walls.  Between the beds, racks are filled with every manner of weapon, gleaming and ready for immediate use.  At the far end of the room, rows of dark leather armor perch on stands, each with a shield hanging behind it from a hook in the wall.  Next to the door, a large workbench sits, with tools and whetstones arranged on it.

The scents of sweat and oil fill the air.  Gambesons and padded shirts hang over the ends of the bunks that line the walls.  Blood-stained war banners and a few rather grisly trophies hang from the ceiling, in mute testimony to the prowess of the warriors that reside here.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Armory]
description: All manner of weapons hang from racks and hooks, each polished and ready for immediate action.  Sets of dark leather armor stand on wooden racks, and a row of polished shields is set along one wall.  A variety of whetstones and leatherworking tools are arranged on a long wooden bench that provides a convenient place for repairs.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Dungeon]
description: Black iron braziers line the walls of the spacious chamber, their glowing coals faintly illuminating the well-oiled shackles and racks of instruments set along the rough stone walls.  A tilted wooden table equipped with heavy leather straps and brass fittings stands in the center of the dark-stained floor.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Forge]
description: A stifling heat emanates from the massive stone forge that dominates the center of the chamber.  Ingots of rolaren, invar, and dark ora stand in neat stacks, ready for use.  The ruddy glow of the coals casts flickering shadows along the rough-hewn walls, where half-finished swords and maces cool in the darkness.  A set of dwarven hammers and tongs, well-kept and well-used, lean against the forge.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Den]
description: Large bookcases, filled with ancient tomes all bound with dark purple seals, stretch from wall to wall.  In the center of the room is a large, circular fireplace, its iron curtain protecting the plush fur throws that are laid out before it.  Chairs set about two large lamp-lit mahogany tables provide a perfect place for late night studies.  About the room rest several large trophies, and a large portrait hangs above the bookcases.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Dining Room]
description: Silver plates, urns, and utensils glitter from the stunningly crafted shelves and cases lining the walls.  An immense, deeply polished mahogany table dominates the center of the room, covered in a rare black spidersilk lace cloth.  Blue fire torches line the walls, their sconces wrought from pure gleaming silver.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Kitchen]
description: Servants bustle about this crowded kitchen, covered in flour, sugar, blood from the huge sides of meat roasting, and other ingredients.  Heat from the huge ovens fills the room, as do the wonderful scents of the meals the cooks are preparing.  Trays of pastries and platters of meat sit on a shelf near the door, just waiting for someone to carry them to their destination.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Greatroom]
description: The warmth radiating from the smokeless blue fires of an enchanted hearth make an excellent counterpoint to the storm-lashed sky the window displays.  Stuffed leather chairs and couches sit about the room, giving the room a homey feel.  Servants in cloaks with deep hoods wander in and out occasionally, carrying trays loaded with exotic culinary delights.  Flashes of lightning highlight the intricately carved motif that covers the western wall, throwing odd shadows across it, and a crystal-paned ebon marble case sits nearby.

Servants in cloaks with deep hoods wander in and out occasionally, carrying trays loaded with exotic culinary delights.  Flashes of lightning highlight the intricately carved motif that covers the western wall, throwing odd shadows across it, and a crystal-paned ebon marble case sits nearby.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Changing Room]
description: Warm, humid air swirls about you.  Smooth obsidian benches have been carved from the walls, serving as shelves for a few neatly folded silken robes.  A large silver mirror hangs from the wall, coated with a light frosting of steam.  A smoked glaes door sits at the end of a short curving passageway, while a stairway leads downward, away from the portal.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Steam Cavern]
description: Wisps of steam curl about the cavern, rising from the natural hot springs in the center.  Benches carved from the walls hold towels and folded robes, and several pairs of soft sandals rest beneath them.  A few blue fire torches flicker from the walls, giving the room a gentle glow and illuminating the stairway upwards.

title: [Chamber of Remembrance]
description: This room is small, lit only by a single blue torch.  A black velvet cloth hangs over a small arch leading into the main chapel, its soft fringe brushing the obsidian floor with a whisper.  Several baskets of herbs sit in the corner.  Opposite the archway opens a black thanot door, runes covering the surface like spiderwebs.

title: [Meditation Chamber]
description: Darkness cloaks this chamber, lit only by the almost nonexistent glow of the tiny brazier in the corner.  No sound intrudes from the outside, filling the room with a silence so thick as to be nearly tangible.  Several small black pillows sit in the floor, dented in the center by the knees of those who have come to remember.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Natural Spa]
description: Hot water surrounds you, almost too warm to be comfortable but relaxing nonetheless.  A ledge has been carved below the waterline, providing a convenient place to sit and relax.  Steam rises from the surface, the moisture plastering your hair to your skull and making you sweat.

title: [Underground Garden]
description: The rough walls of the natural cavern are coated in a glowing green moss.  A trickling stream of steamy water fed by underground hot springs flows through the center of the cavern, feeding the odd indigenous mushrooms and plants found in this humid garden.  In an open bower grows a lush carpet of thick blue moss, providing a comfortable resting place for those wishing to relax and enjoy the strangely beautiful flora.

A trickling stream of steamy water fed by underground hotsprings flows through the center of the cavern, feeding the odd indigenous mushrooms and plants found in this humid garden.  In an open bower grows a lush carpet of thick blue moss, providing a comfortable resting place for those wishing to relax and enjoy the strangely beautiful flora.

title: [The Rift]
description: Even for a giant, the body laying on the ground before you is huge.  It lies face down, a pool of blood widening slowly around it.  The giant's outstretched arms clutch a battle axe in one hand and a thin veil iron circlet in the other, as if to keep hold of them even in death.  Fortunately, the pack of wild dogs ripping at the body doesn't seem to care about them, only about their dinner.

title: [The Rift]

A second, older poster next to the first has the picture of an old, one-eyed dark elf with the number "12000" below it.

title: [The Rift]
description: A large snow-filled valley with rough sloping sides opens up before you.  On the ridge tops from one end to the other stand two main groups of creatures.  The north ridge holds huge clans of ice trolls standing ready with large slabs of ice, while on the south ridge groups of frost giants mutter at each other, holding equally large slabs.  In the center of the valley a lone storm giant stands, arms up to signal the racers.

title: [The Rift]
description: Climbing a small hill, you now look over a long valley filled with warriors.  A huge giantman in plate-mail stands at the front of the vanguard, holding a battle axe in each hand.  His skin is rotted and mildewed, and the hollow eye sockets drop bits of goo and small bugs.  The entire host of undead soldiers shifts anxiously behind him, as if waiting for a command from their chieftain.

title: [The Rift]
description: A long field stretches before you, covered by dark clouds.  The field is lined with rows and rows of long metal poles, each of which is situated near a stone door. title: [Wizard Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]
description: Clumps of rotted straw lie scattered across the decking that stretches from the inner hull to the wide, wrought iron slats of the cell's rusty bars.  Black rings fixed to the walls with thick iron staples are evenly spaced along the bulkhead and fitted with manacles.  The stench filling the cramped space is heavy with mold and decay.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Ranger Guild, Entry Path]
description: Crowding around tall palm and mango trees, vines bloom in a variety of tropical hues.  Buzzing insects swiftly dart into the flowers and away again with their pollen and nectar cargo.  The sweet smell of ripe fruit pervades the thick, humid air above a path of crushed cinnamon bark.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Hillside Path]
description: Above the planks of a swollen and broken fence, a swarm of black flies hover in the air.  A small cleared space develops into a muddy path leading upward, its track washed with pebbled gravel and littered with large green leaves.  The fence itself stretches on towards the south.

tags: meta:mapname:Isle of the Four Winds - Wilds

title: [Siren's Wood, Pearlwort]
description: The pearlwort carpeting blends with a thick blanket of pachysandra, its glossy emerald leaves a stark contrast to the pearlwort's delicate white flowers.  Bright blue mournblooms trail from several ironwork posts surrounding a white marble statue.  A quartz-inlaid white marble bench sits beneath a nearby hawthorn tree.

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: Cord-like vines dangle across the cinnamon bark path that winds its way through the verdant jungle.  Tiny streamlets slip across the crimson-colored ground, their crystal clear waters tugging at the shaggy bark pieces in an unsuccessful attempt to draw them towards the larger body of water that can be heard but not seen.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: Oppresive enough to make breathing hard, the air's humidity releases itself in fat drops of condensation on jungle plants' leaves.  No surface is completely dry, not even the bark underfoot.  Tiny splashes plink on the edge of hearing, their rhythm a counterpoint to the ribbits of bright, motley-colored frogs under the leaves of ferns and on the trunks of trees.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: Shield-sized leaves fall across the eastern edge of the path, their wide expanses creating dark shadows all about.  Water, collected from somewhere high above, cascades across the glossy expanses of each verdant leaf and eventually trickles towards the mossy carpet of the jungle where it forms smaller pools.  Though not visible, the faint chirp of a cricket fills the air with its soft melodic song.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: Thick blades of blue-green grass rise around the crushed cinnamon bark path, their dark expanses creating shadows that stretch across the nearby trees.  Stretching their gnarled boughs towards the heavens, the nearby trees create a viridian canopy that is darkened by cord-like vines and colorful tropical blooms.  A clearing can be glimpsed beyond the trees clustered around the eastern edge of the path.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: Startling white against the dark green foliage, a jasmine vine weaves a sinuous path through several trees to create a thick screen of brilliant white blossoms that partially obscures the clearing on the other side.  Exotic scents collide as the heady perfume of the flowers mingles with the earthy warmth of the crushed cinnamon bark path that winds through the jungle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: Shield-like fronds stretch across a cinnamon bark path, their broad expanses glistening with plump dew drops.  A chorus of tree frogs fills the air with their strange croaking and the occasional sound of splashing bespeaks of nearby water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Hillside Path]
description: The hillside vegetation is mainly scrubby bushes and weedy thistles, with the occasional stand of isolated bamboo.  The path zigs and zags back and forth across the hillside, avoiding, with switchbacks, a steeper climb.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Hillside Path]
description: Along the muddy path, which is littered with small, pebbled gravel, are several flourishing stands of bamboo.  The woody stalks crowd close together, their clustered leaves forming brief fountaining spots of green on the otherwise rock-strewn slope of brown and grey hillside.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Hillside Path]
description: Pale brown and grey gravel is washed over the path, intermixed with the occasional leaf and broken branch.  Thick swathes of bamboo grow wild over the hill, crowding the path with their sturdy stalks.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Hillside Path]
description: Bamboo grows in heavy stands, all but obliterating a view up or down the hillside.  The path, narrow and washed with gravel, meanders through the woody growth.  The only sight above is a slit of sky and around, a sea of impenetrable bamboo.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Hillside Path]
description: A thick forest of brown and green bamboo obscures everything but a narrow, graveled path.  Large leaves, half-trampled and rotting, litter the path.  Amid the swaying foliage, the air is scented lightly with salt and an undertone of something wet.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Canopy Approach]
description: The onset of the jungle wilderness is sudden, making the nearby existence of civilization seem a fantastical concept.  Green dominates the entirety of the rainforest setting, with a thick leaf canopy formed by the verdant growth of tall trees filtering any light into that color as well.  The drone of insects provides a subtle natural music, low and buzzing.  In the distance a haze of fog nearly obscures the view of the coast.

title: [A Winding Trail]
description: Winding and steep, the trail moves from the jungle floor towards a ridge of gnarl-limbed zebrawood trees.  Bamboo and wire fencing is used to hold back the multiple tangles of tropical vines that threaten to clog the walking area.  At the bend, a cluster of rocks has been piled in an odd arrangement.  Tucked back behind a thick stand of trees is a moss-covered stone keep.

Winding and steep, the trail moves from the jungle floor towards a ridge of gnarl-limbed zebrawood trees.  Bamboo and wire fencing is used to hold back the multiple tangles of liana, sweet pea, and calabash vines that threaten to clog the walking area.  At the bend, a cluster of rocks has been piled in an odd arrangement.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Beneath the cover of huge tree roots, sandy colonies of ants dot the vegetation.  Carved channels in the fallen leaves and jungle floor debris lead from one pyramidal nest to another.  The brown piles are damp from the heavy mist that overlays the entire island.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Crushed leaves and broken grasses mark the passage of beasts, demarcating the line between the interior of the rainforest and the rest of the island.  Banyan, rosewood, and teak tower into the sky, hung with liana vines suspended downward from the limbs above.  Closer to the earth, ferns cluster.  The smell is damp and musty, ripe with the odor of decaying vegetation, a testament to the constant regeneration of the deep forest.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Tall rosewood trees rise high up above the forest's thick canopy.  To the south, a group of slick boulders form a shallow tunnel.  Dense groups of leafy ferns grow between the wide trunks.  The thick air lies heavily on the damp vegetation.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan Base]
description: Clusters of bright fungus dot the soft ground surrounding an enormous banyan.  The huge lattice-work trunk creates numerous hollows and nooks.  Sparse clumps of vegetation creep about the base of the tree in a feeble attempt to thrive.  To the north, a group of lichen covered boulders rise from the earth in a pyramid-like shape.

paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: A thin mist floats close to the treetops here, offering but a hazy glimpse of the leafy canopy above.  Humid air envelopes everything like a blanket, causing the dampness to cling to the vegetation.  The ground is spongy, covered in layers of rotting greenery.  One particularly massive rosewood tree shows signs in its outer bark covering of many types of fungal infestations.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: The winding, lattice-work pattern of the bark makes for easy climbing, providing several nooks comfortable for sitting.  Twisted tree-roots hang down from the branches above, creating a skeletal canopy.  A light mist swirls down from the thick, leafy roof.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: Leaning out away from the tree, a thick twisted branch creates a comfortable perch.  A line of black beetles marches along, following the bark's pattern.  Visibility is clouded with the heavy mist that thickens towards the upper limbs.  Patches of soft moss grow over much of the visible surface, making it difficult to move about.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: Deep lacerations in the tree and tufts of dark fur caught in the uneven bark mark the area as a resting place of some large cat.  Several liana hang down from the branches above, swaying slightly back and forth.  A fresh scent fills the air, a distinct change after the decay below.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: Cloaked in a wet mist, there is very little visibility in the upper limbs of the giant banyan.  A slick layer of moisture coats each surface, dripping down from leaf to leaf.  Fat slugs make their way between clumps of fungus growing up the side of the tree.  The irregular pattern of the branches makes several places suitable for resting.  Thick vines cling to the trunk as they twine about on their way to the ground below.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stepped Valley]
description: A sea of tall grasses wilts in the hot, humid air.  North and south the jungle rises upon an upland ridge, far too steep and straight to climb.  This valley appears the result of an ancient cirque, likely formed as over time the elements of nature restructured the mountains beyond.  A step-like series of ledges grant access to the northwestern highlands, while the vegetation clears somewhat to the southeast, revealing the shallows of a saltwater river.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Shallows]
description: Beds of aquatic grasses contribute to the lush surroundings of these saltwater shallows.  Creatures adapted to the watery habitat pursue the natural order of their lives, resulting in an environment not without hazards for land-based interlopers, even at water's ebb line.  A steep drop-off in terrain marks a descent into the depths of a separate freshwater river.  Crossing this second watercourse is only possible via a climb up some snarled banyan roots to access higher ground on the opposite shore.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stepped Valley]
description: Though higher than much of the surrounding valley, this small glade stands lower than the distant jungle.  Foothills of various heights mark the crumbling edge of a towering mountain.  The only access across the fast-moving depths of a freshwater river to the northeast is a climb down some snarled banyan roots.  The cirque's slope continues through dense vegetation.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Vines, bushes, and other small greenery form a tight thicket, making travel all but impossible.  Some of the branches above sway in a light breeze, allowing a few errant beams of misty light to penetrate the area.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Weaving the tops of several trees together, the branches of an ancient and oversized banyan tree stretch across the sky.  Tendrils of mist slide in and out among the leaves above, blocking all light from penetrating into the lower levels of the forest.  Smaller trees sprout up between stands of rising ferns, collecting beads of moisture on limb and frond.  The smell of decay and mold fills the area.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Foothills]
description: Sloping gently, the terrain shifts gradually, edging into the rainforest of the mountain's foothills.  Smaller trees take the opportunity to reach upward, crowded at their bases with thick ferns.  Exotic blooms break through the greenery, splashing the plants with color.  To the south, the mountain looms, its peak shrouded in mist.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: Whether it is raining or not, occasional droplets of water fall from the trees above, splattering on the moist, leaf-covered ground below.  The sound of rushing water can be heard nearby, but no river or stream is apparent in the near vicinity.  A small clearing is visible in the foliage, but branches and vines make it impossible to tell where it leads.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Foothills]
description: Jagged piles of rock dot the ground in unintentional imitation of the mountain rising to the south. The ground hardens a bit as it slopes toward the peak above, losing some of the damp quality so characteristic of the rainforest environment.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Giant rosewoods tower above, their branches tightly entwined to create a thick canopy.  The very tops of each tree are obscured by the leafy beeches that stand just below.  Orchids, and other less beautiful blossoms, grow high up on the trunks of many of the trees.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Branches from a giant banyan tree to the southwest dominate the canopy ceiling, tying the upper level of vegetation together.  Very little light breaks through the woven roof and thick mist that shelters the forest.   Underneath, the ground is littered with debris dropped from above.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: The ground is littered with piles of moldering leaves.  Wood is discarded atop the piles, ranging in size from twigs and sticks to an entire tree limb.  A swathe of beaten-down foliage cuts through the surrounding trees, leaving felled vegetation all around.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Blooming flowers in a multitude of colors adorn a thicket of deep green brush.  The ground beneath the plants is damp from mist and percolating groundwater.  Small animal tracks are frozen in the soft ground, creating a fanciful pattern.  Nearby are small piles of animal droppings.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Dozens of orchids hang from a cluster of beech trees, the dangling blooms cascading downward in a sweeping curtain of color.  Bees and butterflies by the score visit the blossoms, gathering pollen to continue the cycle of life.  The beeches that offer the flowers a home themselves stand sturdy and strong, their massive trunks buttressed firmly against the earth as if to mark their own sure position in the natural order of the rainforest.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Several types of mangroves share space in this small area.  Moisture on many of the leaves gathers in small pools, dripping down to the ground when the liquid becomes overly burdensome.  The trees' intricate roots cluster together to make footing hazardous, yet at one point a small break in the natural support systems grants relatively easy access to a sandbar to the east.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Sandbar]
description: Unusually dark sand, almost black in color, spreads out in all directions.  Whatever minerals spawned the night-hued grains, their properties combined to produce a unique landmark.  A high eastern promontory blended with a low northern shoreline make the sandbar's terrain equally unique.  Everywhere the island mist moves in waves as tidal as the ocean's currents.  The collected cloud of vapors hides most of the sea view, and oftentimes its shifting density obscures the jungle clearing to the west.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: The salty smell of the sea perfumes the air, indicating the likely proximity of the ocean.  However, giant cedars stand sentinel around the perimeter here, effectively blocking any view of the nearby waters.  The trees lend their own pungent aroma to the briny tang of the air.  Small white flowers grow in delicate sprigs on many branches, while the mostly unripe fruit pods attract the occasional group of macaws to feed.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Corpse Copse]
description: What distinguishes this portion of the jungle is the abundant growth of rafflesia, many of the fungi in bloom with their enormous flame-hued flowers.  Lying low to the ground, the parasitic plants attach to the root systems of the multitude of liana vines growing up the trunks and limbs of a tight stand of rubber trees.  The stench given off by the rafflesia blooms is pervasive, similar to that of rotting flesh and attracting flies by the hundreds.

The stench given off by the rafflesia blooms is pervasive, similar to that of rotting flesh and attracting flies by the hundreds.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Thick green vegetation provides very little visibility over any distance, making it hard to navigate.  Beech and rosewood trees rise high up into the sky.  A thick mist swirls about the arching branches, adding to the hazy darkness of the forest.  The sound of bubbling water comes from the east.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Partially covered, the trunk of a thick rosewood tree peeks out from the choking embrace of young banyan roots. Sturdy liana vines twine about several other trees, reaching for the rich canopy above.  Scrubby bushes rise up at irregular intervals, locking the hot, decaying air down below the dense cover.  Clusters of fungus dot the forest floor.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Foothills]
description: Continuing from the west, an eroding line of boulders outlines the end of the deep jungle.  Moisture gathers at the top of the rock formation and trickles down a timeworn path.  The small fall of water ends in a pool-like basin.  The fine mist from above falls gently, covering the area with constant precipitation.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Large mango trees grow along the sides of the slow moving river, their branches hanging heavily toward the water below.  Leafy green ferns crowd around the trees, thick and abundant along the banks.  Several flowering plants add color to the waterway, each blossom a bright spot.  A faint scent of salt air drifts from the east, giving hint to the unseen ocean.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: A freshwater river flowing through the area provides a natural habitat for many types of marine life, which co-exist in a chain of predator and prey.  Drooping trees lean over the water's edge, their roots snaking out into the course.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Shack]
description: Constructed of twigs lashed together with braided strands of seaweed, the hut offers little protection from any harsh weather.  Mud-spattered tarpaulins, likely used to protect the goods during rainstorms, are thrown back over fishing tackle and other sundries set out on one wobbly table, a somewhat lopsided open crate, and a much weathered oversized chest.  Simple sand serves as the floor, while a hodgepodge of roughly planed timbers interspersed with dried grass make up the roof.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Sandbar]
description: At this end of the sandbar, all views of the surrounding sea remain concealed beneath the persistent island mist.  Rock material abounds, jutting dangerously out of the ground in many places.  A series of irregular stones, each double the size of a human fist, form an oval around a shallow depression in the dark sand.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Sandbar]
description: At this point the mist is thinned sufficiently by ocean breezes to allow for a bit of a sea view to become visible, but even so the sight-diffusing vapors float just above the breakers not far from shore.  The eastern bank of the sandbar, as a raised promontory, offers access to the initial depths of the waters below without the separation of any sort of natural shallows.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Sandbar]
description: The northern shore, the lowest point on the sandbar, accesses the sea via wave-washed shallows.  Coastal waters brim with a multitude of smaller marine life.  Salty breezes coming off the water cool the temperature to a less uncomfortable level than those potentially in the jungle or the valley, despite the density of the island mist.  With the unusual dark sand characteristic of the entire area soft, if moist, underfoot, the setting is prototypically serene.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Towering and visually dominating, a huge beech tree stands watch over the forest.  Its buttressed roots fan out about the trunk, creating bridges and archways, some large enough to walk or crawl under.  A rich green moss covers the sturdy liana vines that climb down the tree and hang from the branches.  Collecting into pools on the large leaves of the jungle plants, moisture from the ever-present mist thickly coats each visible surface.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Fresh salt air travels downstream from the unseen ocean, mingling with the smells of mango and fresh greenery.  Following the flow of the river, trees laden with globular green and red fruit line the water's edge in clustered stands.  Between the trees are patches of tall bamboo, fighting for space.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Bright green pitcher plants are interspersed between the trunks of cedar trees that rise along the banks of the river.  The plants' vibrant purple and white flowers hang down, their wide petals collecting moisture from the misty air.  Small foot and tail tracks are evident in the sandy earth lining the water's edge.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Ceiba Glade]
description: Rising in majestic splendor, a huge ceiba tree towers over the river.  Its trunk is quite wide, anchoring into the ground with low, buttressed roots.  Vibrant white and pink flowers bloom in the canopy, attracting birds and insects with their color and fragrance. The fresh scent of sea air drifts in from the east, giving evidence of the ocean beyond the jungle.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Marsh's Edge]
description: Water from a southerly stream collects into a stagnant marsh, trickling in slowly.  An abundance of reeds, ferns, and other water plants line the soaked ground, providing cover and burrow space to insects and lizards.  The muddy pool is coated with a layer of green, mossy algae.  Colorful water flowers stand out around the outskirts of the wetlands, a bright contrast to the overall brown and green hues.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Sandy earth outlines the river, mixing with the sea to create a thriving saltwater marsh.  A variety of crabs skitter about the water's edge, leaving tiny dotted tracks.  Small fish, snails, and oysters can be seen in the clear shallow water.  Tall leafy plants enclose the marsh, only hinting at the ocean beyond.  A mango grove thrives nearby, giving shelter to the long-legged birds that call the marsh their home.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: Thick stalks of bamboo rise up to pierce the canopy, creating a thick and near impenetrable wooden wall.  Long curare vines cling to the bamboo, climbing up to the jungle ceiling above.  The vines' furry green leaves weave the upper branches together tightly, dimming further any light that might penetrate through the dampening mist.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Cliffside]
description: Thick vegetation grows right up to the sheer cliffs that separate the jungle from the ocean.  Rich salt air drifts down from the heights above and the crashing of waves echoes from the sea beyond.  Several tall durian trees rise up above the jungle, the faintly lingering, faintly sulphuric, scent of their fruit mingling with the coastal brine.

Several tall durian trees rise up above the jungle, the faintly lingering, faintly sulphuric, scent of their fruit mingling with the coastal brine.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stepped Valley]
description: Bounded on the north and south by steeply rising jungle highlands and on the west by a shallow freshwater pool, the valley here lies out straight only to the east.  Grasses and ferns dominate the landscape.  Thus, any travel eastward involves pushing through vegetation that grows over giantman height and is alive with a multitude of insects.

title: [Veiled Stream, Cascade]
description: A variety of roots and vines entangled around one another provide a solid grip for any missteps up and down the steeply rising ground, while also making way for the multitude of growth that springs up around the delicate cascade of water splashing its way down to a shallow pool much further below.  Further up the highland, trees converge on one another, alluding to a more dense coverage than the shallow veil of ferns that surrounds a series of wide and round rocks.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Pool]
description: Cradled by an inclined drop from the jungle above, the freshwater pool flows out to a more natural shoreline.  To the east lies the easiest access to the lowlands beyond the water's edge, while tall sedge grasses, with stalks towering double the height of a giantman, block egress to the south and west.  Some submerged stones climb up a gradiant and out of the pond, inching toward the main forest floor.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, River Descent]
description: A freshwater stream courses toward the distant coast, passing by a stand of towering purple-bloomed rosewoods that are festooned with parasitic strangler figs.  The small river is continuously active with whirlpools and spillways emerging and receding with liquid rapidity.  One shallow channel remains constant, clear liquid flowing steadily over its downwardly stepped bed of partially submerged stones.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stepped Valley]
description: The hot, humid air hangs heavy over the fields of grasses and ferns.  The enclosed nature of the valley, bounded on one side by jungle highlands and on the other by foothills, results in a noticeable thickening of the island mist.  Combined, these factors create a wavy unreality atop the stepped terrain.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stepped Valley]
description: Levelling out from the dramatic slope to the east, the valley is an endless sea of wild greenery, stretching west as far as the eye can see.  Several large banyan trunks lay at right angles to one another, felled by storm or time.  No other landmarks exist to pinpoint where in the wilds this spot might exactly be.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stepped Valley]
description: Though as verdant and overwhelmed by the growth of grasses and ferns as the rest of the valley, a raised plateau to the north does provide some means of visually pinpointing location.  A few large boulders litter the ground, perhaps washed down from the sloping sides of the tableland during harsh weather.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Highlands]
description: Raised above the level of the rest of the valley, the plateau is a haven for huge ferns and even a few of the larger jungle trees.  From this vantage point, a section of coastal cliff is plainly visible in the distance.  One fallen tree trunk forms a bridge of sorts to a small ridge in those cliffs.  To the south the sloping sides of the tableland provide a natural descent to the floor of the cirque below.

From this vantage point, a section of coastal cliff is plainly visible in the distance.  One fallen tree trunk forms a bridge of sorts to a small ridge in those cliffs.  To the south, the sloping sides of the tableland provide a natural descent to the floor of the cirque below.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Cliffside]
description: Rocky terrain replaces the verdant jungle upon this lonely seaside cliff.  Meandering saltwater breezes escalate to dangerous winds, whipping around the point with unbridled ferocity.  Steep and treacherous to the casual climber, the ridge offers no easily accessible route to the higher cliffs above or to the sea beyond.  To the southwest a fallen tree trunk extends a welcome, if haphazard, connection to a plateau planted squarely within the landscape of the stepped valley.
