title: [Monsoon Jungle, Confluence]
description: A tidal saltwater river, which runs from the central foothills of the the island to the coast, converges here with a smaller freshwater stream flowing on a pronounced course to the sea.  Lacking the strong current of its more powerful briny neighbor, the rivulet yet boasts numerous whirlpools, perhaps resulting from some hidden source or spring.  Clustered cinchona trees bow in a protective fashion over both waterways.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Interior]
description: The sheer vastness of this uncharted wilderness makes determining directional locations somewhat tricky.  The sound of rushing water to the west serves as the only constant sensory clue as to current position within the dense jungle.  Tightly clustered trees ascend to the sky, blocking visual detection of the sun, and a thin mist rises above the forest floor, distorting visibility with regard to recognizable landmarks.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: Wide leathery leaves cover the branches at this height.  The depressions in the center fill with water gathered from the damp air.  Beads of moisture adorn a web that is spread between two branches.  Clinging to the side of the tree is a small black and green frog, its tongue flicking about from time to time.  Several vines hang from some of the taller limbs.  Just above, the canopy of the forest opens to a mist that hides the sky from view, turning it a milky white.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan Viewshed]
description: Just above, the canopy of the forest opens to a thick mist that hides any glimpse of the island from view.  A few colorful butterflies brave the damp air, flying about the twisted vines.  Clear of decay, the air is fresh and cooler than that at ground level.  A slight breeze moves through the treetop canopy like a gentle caress.  Surrounded with a sense of solitude, the limbs make a perfect place to sit in contemplation.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: Just inside the canopied green forest, it looks and feels like a completely different world compared to the open grassy foothills just a few steps away.  The foliage is so thick, the sky cannot be seen.

Just inside the canopied green forest, it looks and feels like a completely different world compared to the open grassy foothills just a few steps away.  The foliage is so thick, the sky cannot be seen.  Due to the complete blockage of the sun, the temperature inside the forest is much cooler than the nearby hills.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: The sound of running water can be heard nearby, but not seen.  A short distance away is an apparent pathway into the nearby forest of canopied trees with hanging vines and branches.  In one particular spot, the grass has been trampled away, as if for many years, animals have used this path to enter the forest.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: A cacophony of insect sounds permeates the air, creating a melodic symphony of cheeps and chirps throughout the forest.  A small stream has wound its way down the mountain and cut a path through the forest here.  Several large stepping stones jut up from the water, making crossing the stream an easy event.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: The rushing water of the nearby stream is rhythmic and soothing as the water navigates through the forest.  Poking up through the water are several large stepping stones that can be used to pass across the stream.  Overhead, the foliage is thick and lush, the vibrant green leaves interspersed with dangling vines and branches.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: Despite the enormous amount of noise the forest makes, it is surprisingly peaceful.  Within earshot, the nearby river rushes through the trees, splashing over rocks and fallen limbs in its quest towards the ocean.  Insects chirp and squeak, their many voices coming together in a mishmash of sounds that somehow seem musical.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: A thick vine hangs from a tall tree nearby, its circumference larger than a giantman's arm.  Roots from the trees appear to have grown around the vine, entangling it forever in their tight grasp.  Closer inspection reveals a trail of ants traveling down the length of the vine into an intricate anthill they have built near the base of the tree.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: An odd howling noise can be heard from the trees above, but it is impossible to tell where exactly it is coming from.  Lack of moonlight from the thick foliage makes it difficult to observe details in the trees -- it looks just like a sea of green leaves and vines.

An odd howling noise can be heard from the trees above, but it is impossible to tell where exactly it is coming from.  Lack of sunlight from the thick foliage makes it difficult to observe details in the trees -- it looks just like a sea of green leaves and vines.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: Here at the edge of the river, the ground is soft and mushy, and a thin blanket of freshly fallen leaves covers many other layers of dead foliage in varying stages of decay.  Ideal for insects, the moist surface is teeming with life.  Ants scurry back and forth, and all sorts of worms wriggle about, digging holes throughout the damp ground.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Rainforest]
description: Stuck in the side of one of the trees at the river's edge is a short, stubby arrow adorned with grungy green parrot feathers.  It is difficult to tell how long the arrow has been lodged in the tree, especially when the dampness and constant droplets of water cause the dead wood to decay quicker than normal.  A few large stones serve as a pathway to the river's edge.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Landing]
description: Several rafts are tied to anchor on either side of the smooth oak dock that occupies most of the rocky landing.  Broad-leafed tropical plants display signs of recent cutting along the edges of the clearing, while a pathway of granite, pebbles, vines, and dirt arcs across the river towards the distant shore.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Covering the rolling foothills are blankets of lush green grass that flare with the color of thousands of wildflowers.  Nearby, a group of colorful blossoms burst out of the ground, their bright red petals edged in vibrant green.  Small tendrils of mist waft down from the hills, pooling gently in the dips and gulleys of the broad expanse.  To the south, a sheer cliff disappears into the valley below preventing all movement in that direction.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Dozens of brightly colored passionflowers paint the green foothills with a reddish hue.  Interspersed among the passionflowers are large patches of thick lavender-petaled flowers.  Though the hills are aromatic, the vast assortment of different flowers makes it difficult to isolate one particular scent.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Uneven patches of wildflowers and grass make the terrain here slightly difficult to travel.  There is no visible path through the foothills, though there is the occasional faint footprint in the dirt, possibly left by a previous traveler.  In the distance, a rather large mountain is visible, though the top is hidden by a shroud of misty clouds.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: The lush green hills are overgrown with deep red passionflowers and groups of tall heliconias.  The wildflowers are so dense, it is hard to move without ending up in an enormous patch of them.  Nearby, the grass has been flattened slightly, as if some sort of animal had been recently lying there.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Though still very far away, the rolling hills appear to end abruptly where a large mountain juts up from the center of the island.  The contrast between the rugged rock and trees covering the mountain and the lush green grass of the foothills is quite stark.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Underfoot, the grass is damp and the dirt is moist and squishy.  Every movement leaves a brief impression in the earth.  A large, oddly shaped rock seems out of place amongst the wildflowers and lush green of the grassy foothills.  The rock is the size of a small mammal and has all sorts of jagged edges and bulbous extensions.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: A light layer of dew covers the green foothills, causing the grass to shine whenever the moonlight hits it a certain way.  Every so often, an owl flies by, perhaps heading back to the woods from a hunt.

A light layer of dew covers the green foothills, causing the grass to shine whenever the sunlight hits it a certain way.  Every so often, a colorful parrot flies by, perhaps heading towards the heavily wooded area near the mountain.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Oversized fireflies flit about the grassy fields, their round bodies flickering off and on at random intervals.  In the distance, a mist-shrouded mountain towers over the center of the island, its peak barely visible in the moonlight.

Oversized dragonflies flit about the grassy fields, their iridescent bodies shimmering in the sunlight.  Colorful wildflowers dot the hillside, each attracting an assortment of flying insects seeking nectar.   In the distance, a mist-shrouded mountain towers over the center of the island.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: A broken wooden arrow lies on the ground, seeming quite out of place amongst the flowers and grass of the foothills.  The shaft has been ripped almost in half, several small slivers of wood barely keeping it in one piece.  Brightly colored parrot feathers adorn one end of the arrow and a crudely made arrowhead is attached to the other end.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: The hills here are completely devoid of trees or other foliage that would normally provide shade or protection from the elements.  The grass and flowers are vibrantly colored and lush, seeming to thrive in the moist atmosphere.  A lone pair of giant red heliconias nearby has grown tall, standing higher than the average giantman.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: At first glance, the foothills appear quiet and still, however, upon further inspection, a variety of insects and wildlife can be seen.  Overly large crickets occasionally jump to and fro amongst the grass and wildflowers, disappearing in the lush green grass every time they land.

At first glance, the foothills appear quiet and still, however, upon further inspection, a variety of insects and wildlife can be seen.  Overly large grasshoppers occasionally jump to and fro amongst the grass and wildflowers, disappearing in the lush green grass every time they land.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Looming in the distance is a large mountain that stands in the center of the island.  A cloud of mist surrounds the upper portion of the mountain, hiding it from view, while thick jungles ring it in a skirt of verdant hues.  Winding its way through rolling foothills is a twisting passage that leads to the distant peaks.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Hilly Pass]
description: Slipping in and out of the gently curving landscape, the river picks up a bit of speed as it leaves the dark hills of the south and heads towards the northern jungle.  The western bank is comprised of a sheer cliff of dark granite, while the eastern bank has been fitted with a small landing dock.  Arching over the water course is an aerial bridge crafted of rough granite and pebbles.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: In the distance to the north, a canopied forest of tropical trees and ferns can be seen.  Closer to the forest, the grass has grown much taller and the wildflowers are brighter and bigger.  Some of the flowers, when their petals are unfurled, have a span of several feet.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Moonlight kisses the heads of the thousands of wildflowers that dot the rolling hills, causing splashes of silvery amongst the shadowy depths of the grass.  Pale luna moths dance around the flowers, fluttering their wings as they stop to rest for a brief second before flying away.

Thousands of wildflowers dot the rolling hills, causing splashes of color amongst the vibrant green of the grass.  A few colorful butterflies dance around the flowers, fluttering their wings as they stop to rest for a brief second before flying away.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: There is no noticeable trail through the foothills, though occasionally, there are evident patches of flattened grass or footprints that are smaller than a halfling would make.  Every once in awhile, an oversized cricket jumps from the grass, chirping as it quickly hides again amongst the wildflowers.

There is no noticeable trail through the foothills, though occasionally, there are evident patches of flattened grass or footprints that are smaller than a halfling would make.  Oversized dragonflies buzz about the hills, flitting from flower to flower with ease.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: Lightly covering the hills is a barely visible layer of mist that swirls down from the huge mountain at the center of the island.  Throughout the fields are a myriad of wildflowers, growing in large patches over the green grass.

title: [Forbidden Hills, Grasslands]
description: The soft green grass mutes footsteps and other movements, and its vibrant green color is dotted with patches of deep red passionflowers.  Standing tall throughout the foothills are groups of angular red heliconias standing atop lanky green stalks.

title: [Guardians of Sunfist, Outpost]
description: Gnarled zebrawood trees rise upon either side of a wide-windowed bamboo and teak outpost stained with blood, their twisted limbs reaching towards the painted structure.  Thick blankets of rust-hued moss mingle among the roots of the trees and blanket the rocks of the landscape.

title: [Outpost, Courtyard]
description: Cobalt blue and buttercup yellow tiles mingle upon the round floor to create a sunburst mosaic that is outlined in grey mortar.  Directly opposite the entry is a circular golden linden staircase that disappears into a white stucco ceiling, which is hung with several hemp nets housing blown glass orbs.  An alternating pattern of open windows and oak-framed arches finishes the foyer.  One such arch leads to a small offset room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Outpost, Armory]
description: A wide window with gauzy curtains stands open to the errant jungle breezes, offering ventilation to this small room.  The cobalt blue and buttercup yellow tiles from the courtyard make their appearance here in the surface of a counter that stands toward the back, behind which a young man stands ready to serve any patrons interested in his wares.  Aside from the window and an oak-framed arch, the majority of the bright white wall space is covered with racks of combat gear, each piece polished to a brilliant shine.

title: [Outpost, Shop]
description: White walls surround this small room, broken only by an airily curtained window with a view of the jungle foliage, and a curved white arch leading back to the landing.  Potted tropical flowers lend their scents to the room, their petals vividly colorful against the pale flooring.  Taking up much of the floor space are a set of circular racks that houses a wide range of clothing.  A white marble counter near the back of the room displays an ornate jewelry box on its surface, while a young woman stands behind it, waiting to serve any interested patrons.

title: [Outpost, Landing]
description: Positioned beneath a domed ceiling, a circular golden linden staircase winds its circular path downward towards the lower levels.  Smooth walls, left plain and white, are interrupted only where arches provide egress.  The central arch emits a faint scent of tropical flowers.

title: [Outpost, Western Outlook]
description: Surrounded on three sides by windows, the small room is largely open to the elements.  Dark bars prevent anything from climbing in through the windows, and an oak-framed arch is the only means of exiting the area.  Two low stools flank a small card table, which has been set with a stubby candle and an oiled zebrawood vessel of water.

title: [Outpost, Eastern Outlook]
description: Three enormous windows surround a small walking space, while the final wall has an arch in it that leads to the second story landing.  Large bars prevent wild animals from finding their way into the building and also provide a modicum of protection against anything that might attack.  A low bench is positioned within the center of the room, but has been left largely unadorned.

title: [Outpost, Barracks]
description: Redwood-framed bunk beds are bolted into the northern wall, which is painted white and left utterly unadorned.  Shielded lanterns attached to each bed provide its occupant with enough light to read by without invading the larger darkness of the room.

title: [Outpost, Office]
description: Wide windows decorated with sheer gauze curtains surround the room, while squares of buttercup yellow and cobalt blue tiles create a checkered pattern upon the floor.  Positioned to face the windows and the oak-framed arch, a large ebonwood desk sits kitty-corner to the solid walls of the office.  Maps, diagrams, and bulletins decorate the teak-paneled walls beneath the guarded light of several copper lanterns.

title: [Outpost, War Room]
description: Devoid of curtains, the open windows of in this room are heavily guarded by thick bars of wrought iron.  Copper lanterns are arranged in a cluster along the exposed rafters of the ceiling, their steady glow providing continuous illumination for the ironwood table positioned in the center of the room.  Not a single chair, stool, or couch can be found in the room, though someone has left a small teak tray in the northeastern corner.

title: [Outpost, Kitchen]
description: Painted bright white, the northern wall of the kitchen is riddled with large and small ovens that have been built directly into the natural granite of the ridge the outpost sits upon.  Large windows, wide open to the elements, are covered with heavy bars, which are largely hidden by the various flora-heavy urns and vessels bolted there.  Several utilitarian stools are arranged before a long teak counter that is covered with warm dishes and filled tankards.

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: White-striated ivy vines twist their way through the verdant canopy, adding a touch of paler hues to the dark browns and greens of the jungle.  New growth twists across the crushed cinnamon bark path that bisects the area, while heart-shaped leaves create a framework that allows for a clear view of the tropical clearing to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle Approach]
description: Cord-like vines of green-black dangle across the richly scented, crushed long wooden table that winds its way through the surrounding jungle.  Orange, ebon, and white birds-of-paradise add a splash of color to the dark foliage, their leaf-wrapped heads turned towards the clearing in the east.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Alhan'aht River, Cascade Cliff]
description: Dense jungle, dark and quiet, spreads out both below and above you, the vast array of ferns, bamboo, palms, and figs but a dot among the other foliage.  Just below, a thick blanket of water cascades into a large pool, creating a delicate roaring sound as the water crashes down.  A variety of blooms surround the pool, providing splashes of vivid color illuminated by the moonlight.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Alhan'aht River, Cliff's Edge]
description: With very little warning, the path veers away from the riverbank just as the edge of a short cliff comes into view.  The nearby water tumbles neatly over the edge, though the path instead banks downward in a steep slope before it also seems to fall off over the edge.  A thick grip of vines rooted squarely and firmly around the base of several giant, gnarled trees spills over the edge of the cliff, just where the path itself ends.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Alhan'aht River, Blossom Pool]
description: Ferns and flora burst out of the bottom of the cliff face, and mossy vines hang down from above, their curling ends tangling in birds of paradise, torch ginger, and golden goddess blossoms.  The exotic plants, however, merely provide a fragrant border dwarfed by a dark pool of water that a heavy stream of water splashes into with an oddly distinct delicacy.  In the darkness, chittering and scampering sounds are clearly audible, and a pair of yellowed eyes stare out from a branch just overhead.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Alhan'aht River, Fern Drapes]
description: Careening almost violently over the stones in its path, the river crashes downstream, falling off suddenly in the nearby distance, though it could merely be the dense foliage creating an illusion.  A dull roar fills the air, though the overwhelming sounds of rushing water and insects at work is much more distinct here.  Lofty and wispy, stringy ferns attached to tall trees drop down over the path, their mossy green overshadowed by darker ferns that lean over the path from further up above.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Cor'rah, Breezeway]
description: The ever-present murmur of the river echoes here within the edge of the jungle walls, creating a slight relief from the stifling humidity as a cool night breeze penetrates the outer trees.  The dense canopy provided by the jungle rustles with activity as nocturnal creatures move about within the branches high overhead.  An occasional shaft of moonlight illuminates the surroundings, giving a glimpse of the inhabitants of the otherwise pitch-black environment.

The ever-present murmur of the river echoes here within the edge of the jungle walls, creating a slight relief from the stifling humidity as a cool breeze penetrates the outer trees.  The dense canopy provided by the jungle rustles with activity as brightly plumed birds of all sizes and species flutter from branch to branch, chattering to each other or hunting for food.  An occasional insect hovers near a flower or plant, and mosquitoes buzz as they seek their next victim.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Cor'rah, River Passage]
description: Thick foliage, dotted with exotic flowers ranging in hue from vibrant white to intense oranges and purples, covers the majority of the richly soiled ground.  Extending far above the dense carpet of moss, a mass of trees forms the imposing walls of the jungle, and the towering canopy of their widely spread leaves only enhances the darkness of night.  The distant murmur of a river is occasionally heard amongst the chirping of crickets and the rustling of leaves as nocturnal creatures roam their domain.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Alhan'aht River, Muddy Bank]
description: Moisture hangs in the air, creating a heavy thickness to the environment.  The light buzzing sound of bugs and birds creeps through the area, originating from every direction under the endless green jungle canopy.  On a thick gum tree next to the muddy riverbank, several small, green tree frogs sit in a neat row, the vivid colors around their eyes betraying their otherwise camoflauged sitting spot.  Somehow, through the heat and thick foliage, the path is still barely visible.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Alhan'aht River, Step Stones]
description: Moving along downstream, the current of the river is noticeably strong, tugging and pulling at the branches and hanging vines that hang down into it.  Several smooth grey rocks jut out of the blackened path, providing easy stepping stones through the otherwise leech-infested mud.  As if to provide handholds, bamboo stalks are intersperced alongside the path.  A strong buzzing sound emanates from all around to mix with the hypnotic sounds of the river.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Cloud Forest, Monkey Grove]
description: Tall evergreens grow thick throughout the area, letting almost no light through the verdant roof above.  Smaller broad-leafed trees, entwined by a variety of blooming vines, fill in the gaps between the larger trees, effectively locking in moisture and heat.  Occasionally, a few silvery gibbons swing overhead from limb to limb, ferrying themselves over a rushing river with hanging vines.  In the distance, the lively chatter and screeches of jungle life creates a cacophony of sound.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Mud Way]
description: Although there are several patches of moist soil, the path is primarily filled in with pools of deep black mud.  The mud itself is riddled with small brown specks, leeches, that lay in wait to cling to a porous surface.  Beyond the mud, the river quietly drifts past, and ferns of every shape and size lean over its murky water.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Alhan'aht River, Bamboo Corner]
description: Dense green shrouds the river path almost into obscurity, where ferns hang down in large clumps and shoots of growth pop up from the moist, mud-ridden soil.  Sailing along smoothly, the river streams past to one side, its calm surface barely marred by the current.  From high up in the canopy, far above the tall bamboo shoots that reach up into the cover of foliage, the sounds of birds calling out fill the air.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Cor'rah, Spider Monkey Stream]
description: Tall shoots of bamboo intermingle with the vast amount of trees surrounding the edge of the jungle.  A small stream trickles through the leaf-cluttered soil, its surface barely rippling as the humidity of the environment threatens to disperse its presence.  The occasional screech of a spider monkey amongst the canopy overhead is joined by the caws of exotic birds and the rustling of the underbrush as the inhabitants move within.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Cor'rah, Spider's Haven]
description: A large spiderweb, its shimmering strands of sticky silk spread wide between two large trees, is dotted with the web-wrapped bodies of various insects as they await their fate.  Several vines dangle from the canopy overhead, looped over branches and creeping along others as they claim their territory within the jungle.  A family of beetle grubs crawls in and around the length of a fallen log, and a swarm of mosquitoes buzzes about the stagnant water pooled within the opening.

title: [Cor'rah, Monkey's Arm]
description: The quiet hoots of nocturnal birds as they occupy the branches overhead echo against the sound of the river to the southwest.  Rustling leaves herald the presence of the numerous inhabitants of the jungle, and the brightly hued forms of nighttime flowers dotting the landscape contrast strikingly with the deep green of the trees.  The shade of the canopy further enhances the shadows of the area as moonlight barely filters through the leaves to illuminate the humid environment.

The screech of monkeys as they swing from branch to branch overhead echoes against the sound of the river to the southwest.  Rustling leaves herald the presence of the numerous inhabitants of the jungle, and the brightly plumed forms of birds dotting the landscape contrast strikingly against the deep green of the trees.  Ironically, while the dense canopy of leaves provides a welcome respite from the direct heat of the sun, it also captures and holds the humidity by blocking breezes as well.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Cor'rah, Root Lounge]
description: Travel becomes difficult as the blanket of foliage grows wildly across the ground.  Thick tree roots wind languidly over the floor, and the spindly branches of smaller shrubs extend to form obstacles for a traveler on foot.  Emerald green vines dangle from high upon tree branches near the massive canopy of leaves, various creatures of the night scurrying up and down their lengths.  The moonlight barely penetrates the oppressive darkness, and a cacophony of nighttime sounds echo constantly.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Cor'rah, Breezeway]
description: A large fallen log rests underneath the towering forms of several of its companion trees, its roughened jagged-edged body illuminated with pale moonlight that filters in through the breaks in the trees.  Crickets chirp incessantly amongst patches of moonflowers, their loud calls mingling with the occasional rustle of a nocturnal creature moving about the foliage.  The presence of an occasional breeze, wafting in from the nearby river, accentuates the cooler temperature of the jungle during the night hours.

A large fallen log rests underneath the shade of several of its companion trees, its roughened jagged-edged body covered in an array of vines and insects.  Butterflies flutter in and out of small patches of wildflowers flourishing near the edge of the jungle, their jewel-toned wings creating a subtle, yet distinctive, buzz in the humid air.  The presence of an occasional breeze, wafting in from the nearby river, alleviates the discomfort of the sauna-like surroundings.

title: [Cor'rah, Deep Jungle]
description: Heavy with humidity, the air swaddles the surroundings like a wet woolen blanket.  Moisture clings to the verdant vegetation crowding a nearly imperceptible animal path.  Overhead, enormous fronds create a thick canopy, further diffusing the already dappled light, thin dim streams of which offer the merest hint of illumination.  Deep shadows play along the ground, accompanied by soft scurrying sounds.  Cloying in the thick air, a strong perfume emanates from the abundant flowering shrubs.

title: [Cloud Forest, Stairway Falls]
description: Lazily etching its way over the ground, a small stream moves over multiple rock ledges resembling a stairway.  Thick ground ferns line the waterway, their long fronds hanging over the bank to gently caress the surface.  Air, thick with moisture, coats the plants with a glossy sheen.  Small purple fruits lay scattered on the ground about the stands of white-barked trees that give ample shade to the area.

title: [Cloud Forest, Placid Basin]
description: Scattered light filters though the branches of tall, black bean-laden trees that surround a small pond.  The bottom of the falls to the east feed into the basin, creating tiny ripples on the surface, where a swarm of bugs skates over the water in a dizzying array of patterns.  Home to a colony of small beetles, a fallen tree leans out into the water.  The scent of fermenting wood rises from the log and lingers in the thick, damp air.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Torrent]
description: A strange mix of buzzing insects, calling birds, and rushing water permeates the entire vicinty, weaving through the thick, humid soup that can barely be called air.  Just off the viscously muddy and foliage-overridden river path, the water of the river rushes by in a small torrent, its current quite obviously strong as it splashes over small rocks in the midst of its journey.  An especially large, gnarled tree swoops up into the air and curves back down again over the water.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Cloud Forest, Mudslide]
description: Constant rain and moisture have worn away the floor, allowing mud to flow freely through the area and down the slope to the west.  The thick, sticky covering makes it difficult to walk and gives off a foul scent.  Misshapen roots mingle and intertwine above ground, creating a series of archways and short tunnels to walk through.  Several clusters of tiny bell-capped mushrooms dot the terrain, and large black flies swarm about.

title: [Cloud Forest, Riflebird Outlook]
description: Rising up from the jungle floor, a lone honey bee tree towers overhead, its branches reaching high up into the canopy.  Huge buttresses support it at the base and keep the giant from toppling over.  The thick bark glistens with an amber sap that oozes out from the cracks.  Hanging from the underside of each high branch are immense honeycombs surrounded by clouds of bees.  A layer of mud coats the ground that slopes upwards to the east.

title: [Cloud Forest, High Crag]
description: Thick layers of vegetation cover the base of this steep, rugged mass of rock, making movement difficult over the hidden terrain.  Several trees with scaly bark stretch outward, leaning over the sharp descent to the forest below.  Only rare breezes blow through the area, giving an occasional moment's relief from the stifling heat of the humid forest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cloud Forest, Glow Worm Gully]
description: Thick, verdant tree ferns line the upper edge of this dank gully.  Both thick earth banks lean over, creating a dark, cave-like area.  Long strings of glowworms hang from above, giving off a soft luminescent light.  Tiny fungus gnats fly about from place to place, occasionally getting caught in the sticky threads.  The moist dirt easily gives way underfoot, releasing the scent of decomposing greenery.

title: [Cloud Forest, Still Pond]
description: Free from the constant cleansing thrust of a tidal current, the water of the pond abounds with a wide variety of aquatic life.  Golden and jungle perch share the liquid environment with short-finned eels, and freshwater algae produce colorful surface patches.  Deep croaks and high-pitched ribbits resound from beneath the shade of fruit-laden lilly-pilly trees.  The pond serves as a favored spot for the larger wildlife of the surrounding jungle to pause for a quiet drink.

title: [Cloud Forest, Giant Banyans]
description: In this cluster of two dozen enormous banyans, it becomes difficult to distinguish what set of woody tubers belong to each specific tree as the makeshift trunks entwine freely.  Spreading round crowns of elliptical leaves cover the area above with a thick yellow-green canopy.  Much further below, aerial-generated roots dig shallowly into the earth to produce a thin surface network.  On some of the largest of these strangler figs, scaly grey bark has fallen off to expose a smooth black inner core.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Cloud Forest, Lower Falls]
description: Watery cascades end their downward journey into a wide streambed that constricts into a much narrower channel in one direction.  That strait courses through a thin cleft in the coastal cliffs, presumably to the ocean beyond.  Silt built up on the eastern side of the broad pool, where the flow into the tight runnel is completely cut off, has created an alluvial delta.  The fertile triangle boasts a plethora of ribbits that emanate from within an unparalleled variety of bulrushes and cattails.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest

title: [Cloud Forest, Cliffside]
description: The high sandstone cliffs, which bar direct access to the western ocean, are just visible here amid the abundant flora.  Small shrubs and ferns tenuously hold on by shallow roots up the side of those bluffs, but elsewhere the greenery runs rampant.  Covered with decaying matter dropped by the plants that rise upward from the earth, the forest floor is dark and lacking in intense color.  Insects, however, thrive here, including many varieties of ants.

title: [Cloud Forest, Shelf Divergence]
description: Converging here in massive clumps above ground level, the tangled root systems of clustered trees result in hazardous footing.  Overhead, the leaf canopy filters out the faint light of the stars, making the sky darker than night itself and further complicating any visual detection of obstacles.  Masses of outwardly projecting rosewoods dangerously camouflage the edge of a sheer drop to the southeast, where the escarpment plummets vertically downward for an astounding distance.

title: [Cloud Forest, Southern Cliffs]
description: Amid the lushly verdant but unexpectedly treeless vegetation at this southernmost point of the rainforest, the spectacular sandstone cliffs of the western coast stand as a fully visible backdrop.  The roar of waves crashing unseen on the opposite side of the stone barrier provides a rhythmic cadence of constant sound, while the tang of saltwater saturates the scent and taste of the redolently humid air.  Densely packed ferns of every shape, texture, and hue dominate the surrounding landscape.

title: [Cloud Forest, Precipice]
description: Large boulders cropping up from under the camouflage of wild vegetation give evidence of the rockiness of the terrain at this southern edge of the forest.  The most massive of the exposed stones sits beside the fallen trunk of an uprooted tree, which serves as a perfect spot to sit and look out over a dizzying drop at the southwestern point of the area.  Woody liana vines coil around the surrounding upright trees, and brown mushrooms cluster close to their buttressed roots.

title: [Cloud Forest, Misty Lookout]
description: Reaching out over a sloping cliff is a triangular flat rock bearded with a layer of moist, green moss.  Looking over the edge, the forest below stretches out in full view with many unique rock formations jutting out of the green canopy.  The warm mist from the rainforest rises up with a hazy glow.  A grove of thick-leafed trees proudly display their bright flowers and sweet fruit.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Muddy Bank]
description: The river rages to the north of this small semicircular clearing, frothy water occasionally splashing against the muddy bank.  The shore is littered with various pieces of flotsam that have been rendered into unrecognizable lumps of wood.  A thick wall of tall trees stands imposingly to the south, seemingly barring any further passage into the dense jungle, save for two narrow muddy paths.  A blanket of mist and steam rising from the river obscures the tree canopy, giving the world an ethereal appearance.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Fallen Tree]
description: A muddy path snakes its way through the thick growth of brush and trees, providing barely enough walking room.  Any vision beyond ten paces is obscured by a dense wall of haze and fog.  Some vines hang lazily from trees, appearing as snakes in the mist.  To the southeast, a monstrous tree has been violently uprooted by some unknown force.  The resulting devastation of the fallen tree has opened up a narrow but treacherous trail that leads deeper into the misty jungle.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Wasteland]
description: A thick carpet of ash has turned this small area of jungle into a grey alien wasteland.  Bare and blackened trees stretch towards the hazy sky like scorched fingers, and fronds the size of giantmen lie scattered upon the ground, their surfaces dark and crumbling.  One large tree in particular has been completely split in two from root to top, and a wide circle of pitch black earth surrounds its ruined trunk.  A fallen tree limb arches over a stream, providing dry passage to the other side.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Crossroads]
description: Tendrils of silvery mist hover above the small stream that winds through this part of the jungle.  Like the tentacles of an octopus, the mist crawls along the ground, wrapping itself around the vine-covered trunks of the nearby trees.  Gigantic ferns uncoil their fronds, rivaling the size of the trees above them.  A large tree branch lies across the water, allowing dry passage to the northwest, while a natural rock bridge leads to the northeast.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Hazy Horizon]
description: The soft ground inclines sharply, reaching upwards until finally breaking through the thick plane of mist surrounding the treetops.  Surrounding the small circle of earth is a view of nothing but haze, giving the illusion of floating among a wide stretch of clouds.  Bright rays of moonlight are instantly broken into hundreds of rainbows in the white mist below.  Echoes of rushing water floats through the air, and the rocky protrusions of a natural stone bridge jut from the earth to the southwest.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Jungle]
description: Gigantic boulders have been scattered throughout the trees like pebbles, their shiny and damp surfaces covered with moss and lichen.  The thick haze plays tricks with the light and makes some of the more distant stones appear to be hulking giants ready to strike.  Weaving between the stony debris is a tiny stream that slowly flows to the east, its trickling barely heard over the sounds of the wildlife.  Tiny silver fish and tadpoles dart about within the stream, ceaseless in their movement.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Geyser]
description: An immense rocky outcropping rises from the ground, its surface covered in moss and vines.  A large hollow has been carved out from one side of the rock by a bubbling pool of boiling water.  A large gush of water occasionally bursts from the pool, slamming the top of the outcropping, leaving the water to drip down and form a small stream that flows east and southeast.  Steam roils forth from the scalding liquid, leaving the air hot and humid.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Serene Pool]
description: A large basin of clear water, fed by a stream trickling in from the northwest, has created a small clearing in the thick stand of trees.  The water ripples calmly, tendrils of mist rising from the surface and joining the larger hazy shroud in the treetops.  A single shaft of light has managed to pierce the fog, focusing its bright gaze upon the center of the pool.  An eerie silence dominates the small area, a stark contrast to the cacophony of noises that permeates the rest of this jungle.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Narrow Trail]
description: Giant fern fronds overlap the narrow trail, while heavy vines dangle low from the treetops, obscuring the path ahead and making movement in this area slow and difficult.  A hazy mist creeps along the muddy ground, disappearing into the heavy undergrowth filled with ferns and flowering shrubs.  The songs of wild birds fill the air from the canopy of trees high above, mingled with the occasional cry of some unknown creature.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Clearing]
description: Five giant pillars of smooth grey stone stand in the center of this circular clearing.  Deep white sand covers the entire area, which is free of the trees and vegetation that grow around the perimeter.  Unlike the rest of the jungle, this area is strangely quiet, with only the occasional cry of birds heard in the distance.  A dense canopy of mist lingers around the pillars, obscuring the sky above.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Shimmering Mists, Monkey Trail]
description: A hazy mist clings to the trees here, making it difficult to see beyond arm's length while sharp-bladed shrubs cling to the narrow path's edge, offering a painful surprise to anyone that strays too far.  Tangled vines drape from the treetops above, offering camouflage for snakes and small monkeys that chatter noisily while they swing from branch to branch.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Waterfall]
description: Water streams between large moss-covered boulders at the edge of a cliff, forming a small waterfall that cascades to the valley floor below.  Lichen-draped trees grow right up to the cliff's edge, blocking much of the view.  Birds glide above the misty treetops below, their screeches partially blocked by the sound of rushing water.  Purple and white orchids grow in large clumps near the base of the trees, while small frogs rest on rocks by the water.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Valley View]
description: Dirt crumbles near the cliff's edge as the trail comes to a sudden halt, giving a breathtaking view of the valley floor below.  A few shrubs and trees cling for life in the rocky soil, waiting for the next rain to wash them down the sparsely vegetated hillside.  Colorful birds of blue and yellow fly above the misty canopy of green below, their screeches resonating throughout the area.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Orchid Trail]
description: Soft grass grows underfoot as the trail between the trees widens and the misty haze lightens here making this part of the jungle brighter.  Shrub-sized clumps of amber and yellow orchids grow near the path intermingled with ferns and other vegetation.  Blue and white bumblebee orchids have rooted themselves in the decaying remains of a large fallen tree trunk, while flowering vines of purple and white drape from the branches overhead, splashing the area with vivid color.

title: [Shimmering Mists, Rock Face]
description: Devoid of the mist that covers most of the surrounding jungle, the sandy path ends abruptly in front of a sheer rock face that juts from the jungle floor.  Covered in flowering vines, it is a wall of deep green vegetation covered with white and purple blossoms.  Areas of the rock are clearly visible, as though someone or something had removed the growth.  High above, there appears to be natural cave openings weathered into the stone, but no way to access them from the ground below.

title: [Cor'rah, Humming Cloud]
description: Sticky and thick, the oppressive air is an unwelcome companion beneath the cave-like jungle interior.  Overhead, leafy branches overlap to create a broad living roof that filters out most of the moons' beams.  Humming loudly, a large cloud of mosquitoes constantly searches for its next unsuspecting victim.  Dotting the jungle floor, unusual piles of sticks and webbing clump beneath large fern fronds.

title: [Cor'rah, Dark Jungle]
description: Darkness blankets the jungle floor, far from the moonlight's reach.  Insects swarm over a fallen log, the smell of fresh, damp soil mingling with the earthy scent of rotting wood.  Both high above and on the ground, all manner of creatures battle for any space not already occupied by greenery.  Knobby, blossom-laden trumpetvines spread over the thick trunks of towering trees, creating a symbiotic relationship between tree, vine, and the insects that the heavily perfumed vines attract.

title: [Cor'rah, Fruit Trees]
description: The terrain becomes increasingly more difficult to maneuver through as the density of vegetation increases.  The moistness of the oppressive environment is evident in the humidity, a product of the large amount of rain needed to maintain the lush surroundings.  Palm fronds dip low from their tall trunks, mingling with the tall grasses sprouting forth from the damp soil.  Fallen fruit, rotting amongst the decaying leaves that litter the ground, aid in the fertilizing of the soil beneath.

title: [Cor'rah, Dense Jungle]
description: Trees, vines, creepers, bushes, and tall grasses create a thick tangle of vegetation.  Rattan palms stretch long stems toward the sky, competing with coconut-bearing palms and hardy banana trees.  Curious monkeys screech and play amid the variety of tree branches, clearly at home high above the jungle floor.  Bamboo edges the area, its strong, graceful shoots whispering softly in the sporadic breezes.  Carpeting the ground, a snarl of pothinir grass helps insulate the already stifling, humid air.

title: [Cor'rah, Ruined Jungle]
description: Barren by most jungle standards, the area has a charred and dead feel to it.  Tree trunks show their trial by fire with alligator-scale burn patterns running up their length.  Singed flowers and ash mix in the dark soil as the jungle begins to heal itself once more.  Hot, humid air barely circulates, and the oppressive atmosphere is heightened by the lack of jungle sounds.  Small glimpses of new life poke their way out of the ashen soil, a testament to the hardiness of the region.

title: [Cor'rah, Jungle Grove]
description: Creeping vines hang low, their lengths decorated by vividly hued orchid blossoms.  Coiled around a low-lying branch, poison green snakes lie motionless, their coloring providing nearly perfect camouflage until they slither away.  High overhead, two-toed sloths slowly but frequently make their way along a woody liana vine.  Infrequent breezes limp through the excessively humid air, the short-lived moments of relief from the oppressive heat a welcome torture.

title: [Cor'rah, Butterfly Glen]
description: Amid the fluttering of several stray hummingbirds, patterns of light and dark fleck the ground where the moonlight is able to penetrate the profusion of heavily branched trees.  Thin blades of blue line almost every inch of the trees and ground where thousands of butterflies rest beneath the humid air.  Delicate blossoms have twisted closed, waiting for the warmth and light of day to awaken them as others bloom vibrantly in the slightly cooler night air.

Patterns of light and dark fleck the ground where the sunlight is able to penetrate the profusion of heavily branched trees.  Waves of blue appear and disappear along almost every inch of the trees and ground as thousands of butterflies rest beneath the humid air.  With every beat of the butterflies' wings, the jungle appears to take deep cleansing breaths.  Flitting in and out, small hummingbirds raid nectar-rich blossoms high in the jungle canopy.

title: [Cor'rah, Jungle Atrium]
description: Shimmering moonlight streams down from a star-studded sky to cover the area with a gentle light.  Fallen trees ring the area, their loss creating an opening for sweetly scented breezes to sweep through.  Various shades of green compete with vivid colors exploding up and down the trunks of trees.  Low chirrups echo through the still air, the mating call of numerous frogs accenting the low chatter of unseen animals.  Cradled by sturdy branches, a small clouded leopard lazes beneath a shelter of leaves.

title: [Cor'rah, Jungle Thicket]
description: Though immersed in the darkness of night, the air retains a dense, moist heat.  No hint of the sky can be seen through the compact leafy canopy, and what little light sneaks through is barely enough to illuminate the slick vegetation and moist loamy ground.  Massive tree roots crisscross the jungle floor, their length mirroring the crosshatching of abundant, leaf-laden branches high above.  Soft dripping sounds echo eerily in the otherwise still air.

title: [Cor'rah, Rainforest]
description: Evidence of the regular bouts of rain that supply the jungle with much needed nutrients, several small pools of water have formed in the hollows of fallen trees and among the foliage.  Mosquitoes buzz around the surface of each one, and the occasional frog immerses itself under the liquid.  The rich soil of the jungle floor is moist and difficult to travel through, though the leaves scattered about the ground provide a bit of traction.

title: [Cor'rah, Creeping Jungle]
description: Fallen leaves dot the rich soil in piles of no certain pattern, their wet, decaying presence adding a musty smell to the stale and humid air.  Flowers bloom from creeping vines wrapped around the trunks of various trees, their exotic hues providing a splash of striking color against the lush, verdant surroundings.  An occasional butterfly or hummingbird flutters near them, partaking of the sweet nectar they provide, before moving on to the next.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Cor'rah, Jungle Copse]
description: Thousands of trees compete for space as far as the eye can see.  High overhead, small fruit bats glide continually from branch to branch, their movements giving a sense of rhythm to the jungle surrounds.  Bright light is at a premium here, the convergence of foliage far above casting deep shadows and blotting out much of the moons' pale beams.  Enormous ferns stretch out feathery blades, each leaf adorned with tiny drops from one of the jungle's many brief downpours.

title: [Cloud Forest, Clearing]
description: Towering over the area, a huge brush box tree creates a stunning green canopy dotted with snowy white flowers.  The flaring buttress arches up, creating a tunnel large enough to walk through.  Circling the base of the tree, several bird's nest ferns proudly display their yellow-green fronds, which fan over the sparse vegetation that carpets the moist forest floor.

title: [Cloud Forest, Upper Falls]
description: Sourced in the northern river, cascades of water slide past a narrow gully before falling further down to the delta basin.  The rocky promontory above protects this small cavern hollowed out of the highland by the channel.  Though sheets of water curtain the cave mouth, access points, one to the west up a ridge toward the coastal cliffs, and the other to the southwest across a splash-washed land bridge toward the lowland, make it possible for both predator and prey to roam this space at will.

title: [Cloud Forest, Northern Cliffs]
description: Jutting out of the massive sandstone rise that protects the coastline, a spur circles to the east around one edge of a spectacular river-sourced waterfall.  Above that lateral ridge, the cliffs themselves rise in majestic verticality.  Forest trees and underbrush, however, impede full sight of the scope of their grandeur.  Grey eucalypti, perfectly content to stretch long roots into the sedimentary rock of the environs, lend the uniquely crisp scent of their foliage to the moisture-laden air.

title: [Veiled Stream, Valley View]
description: Flowing with a quiet murmur, a small stream breaks free of a nearby pool, casually cascading over ground that quickly drops into a steeped valley.  From this vantage point, the valley's lush growth is visible in the moonlight, its wealth in life obvious not only in the spread of trees, but also in the sheer volume of squawking, buzzing, grunting, and rustling that fills the night air and echoes up the valley.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Alhan'aht River, Rooted Bank]
description: Firewheel trees and jambu spread their limbs, their foliage covered in colorful flora, their roots firmly planted near the edge of the river that tumbles by.  In one direction, moonlit sandstone cliffs rise up above the forest, their light color contrasting sharply with the darker shades of the night jungle.  To the other side, only ferns and trees are visible as they block out a full view of the sky.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Alhan'aht River, Coastal Gap]
description: Reflecting the moonlight with their pale color, spectacularly tall sandstone cliffs cause the rainforest to come to an abrupt dead-end, blocking out any further growth, save for the vines that climb up the cliffs and hang down with invitation to climb up.  The rushing river hurtles straight out through a single wide gap in the cliff, quickly disappearing out of sight.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Alhan'aht River, Southern Pass]
description: Widening perceptively to the south, the river flows at a steady pace to its destination in the north.  Rough muddy banks rise from the edge of the water course and are choked with verdant vines.  Several tendrils dangle from the trees above to create a colorful curtain that is laden with fragrant white jasmines.  The rise and fall of frogs chirping is punctuated by the steady hum of insects throughout the area.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Southern Pass]
description: Swiftly moving, the river cascades through the landscape, creating a soft musical sound as it passes by several tall river reeds.  The melodic sound of their hollow interiors clacking against each other echoes through the area and is punctuated by the soft sound of bird song and the delicate chirp of birds.  Curving slightly, the water smoothly circles around an enormous banyan tree that has taken root in the western banks.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Southern Pass]
description: Tiny whirlpools form in the dark waters of the river, their creation testament to its swift passage as it courses through the jungle on its way to the north.  Small channels along the muddy banks break away from the main body of the river to create minor tributaries that wind their way into the dark green jungle, only to rejoin the river further down.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Southern Pass]
description: Rocks along the southwestern banks create a barricade that directs the swiftly flowing river into a northerly direction and causes the dark waters to slightly foam as they collide with the smooth protrusions.  The banks rise on either side of the water course and grow less muddy to the east, while the western edge is riddled with heavy vines and rabbit's foot fern.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Hilly Pass]
description: Jungle plants grow sparse through this section of the river as it glides away from the slow rise of hills.  Large and small boulders pock-mark the river bank where the water disperses outward, its passage creating a soft burbling sound as it leaves the main tributary for the more wild, marshy land.

title: [Alhan'aht River, Hilly Pass]
description: Following the contours of the land, the river winds its lazy way through the hills as it makes its slow progress to its northern destination.  Blue, brown, and orange granite rises to either side of the water course to create a roofless tunnel that displays various wavy lines where the water has eroded the land to create its current home.

title: [Alhan'aht River, The Divide]
description: Roughly churning, the river carves a path through the smooth granite bedrock that is the foundation of the surrounding hills.  Dips and gullies cause the water to drop from various heights as it moves in a northern direction away from the large mountain that looms in the southwest.

title: [Alhan'naht River, The Divide]
description: Sharp angles and dark lines divide the Alhan into its two tributaries, the Alhan'aht, which continues its passage to the north, and the Alhan'naht, which continues its tumbling passage to the south.  Frothing as it leaves its sister, the river tumbles in white-capped brilliance through the rough rocks that line its banks.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
description: Moving at a swift pace, the river glides past the large and small boulders that create its rough banks.   Moonlight slants at angles through the rough canopy overhead and glistens upon the crystal clear waters, while verdant vines and broad-leafed ferns take root on the distant edges.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
description: Careening into the eastern banks, the river rises high against the smooth granite wall that causes it to bend to the south.  Mangroves and banyan trees clog the western rise, their verdant leaves creating deep shadows throughout the passage.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
description: The narrow passage of the river's northern edges widens here, causing the rough waters to become sluggish as they tumble towards the south.  Muddy banks rise upon either side, and while the eastern banks are choked with thick vines and wild shrub, the western banks are free of brush.  White-flowered arrowhead plants are painted with burgundy hues, their long stems surrounded by broad leaves as they make their home at the river's edge.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
description: Dark boulders rise out of the wide river along the southern end, their thick and sturdy angles neatly bisecting the water course in half.  The western edge continues to amble peacefully through the jungle, while the eastern edge picks up speed and rushes off towards the distant, thunderous sound of water falling from a great height.  A series of thick hemp nets stretches across the eastern passage, preventing travel in that direction.  The nets are clogged with logs, twigs, and other debris.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
description: Falling away from the foothills, the river tumbles through the forest.  A dense haze clings to the chillier surface of the water as it passes through the choking humidity of the jungle and draws the attention of small flying insects.  The delicate hum of the winged beasts fills the air.

title: [Alhan'naht River, South Wilds]
description: Flanked by congested trees upon the eastern shores, the river ambles through the thick jungle vegetation and murmurs softly as it passes.  Giant water lilies cling to the western banks, their amethyst hues reflected in the water.

title: [Alhan'naht River, South Wilds]
description: Clumps of tall grasses and slender reeds clutter the western shores of the river as it meanders through the jungle.  Dark trees blot out the sky above as they vie for space near the water's edge.  Feather-topped grasses, fan-limbed ferns, and vibrant heliconias create a dazzling display of color along the eastern shores as they too vie for domination over the river.

title: [Alhan'naht River, South Wilds]
description: Choked with broken pieces from the floating meadows of the north, the river narrows perceptively to the south and becomes clogged with thick grasses.  Large posts flank a narrow dock that sticks out into the wider parts of the river and allows easy passage to drier lands.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Choked Pass]
description: Gently curving, passage upon this section of the river becomes impossible due to the aquatic plants that rise in verdant strands from the soft mud of the river's bottom.  Ranging in hues from dark to light greens, brows to tans, and various shades in-between, the diverse flowers, ferns, and grasses of the area rise to meet the dangling limbs of the overhead trees and grow in tight clusters upon the water's surface.  Further to the southeast, the scent of the distant sea meets with the musty jungle scents.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Landing]
description: Rafts bob up and down on the river near the smooth wooden dock that connects the land to the swiftly flowing water course.  Above, the trees that cluster around the river have created a verdant canopy that is comprised of broad leaves, vibrant flowers, and colorful fruits.

title: [Jungle Clearing]
description: Large stones mark the border of the clearing and stand out brightly against the rich hues of the encroaching jungle.  Occupying one corner of the clearing is a series of tangled vines that have grown together in mimicry of a tree.  Coarse, round kiwifruits dangle from their spindled blossoms amid ruffled yellow flowers and bright white blossoms with yellow hearts.

title: [Jungle Clearing]
description: Growing from the soft, moss-covered ground is an organized row of palm tree saplings, their broad palms woven tightly together to create a miniature shelter within the clearing.  Bright white stones marking the jungle's border branch off to the north and south, while a small path through the moss leads eastward towards the dock.

title: [Jungle Clearing]
description: Tangled vines spill out of the jungle and past the bright white stones that create the border between the dense jungle and the moss-covered clearing.  Ruffled pink passionflowers mingle with gold yellow passionfruits along the lower edges of the cord-like vine, while broad leaves decorate the higher sections that cling to the nearby trees.

title: [Alhan'naht River, Landing]
description: Tethered to the dock, the surrounding river rafts rock gently back and forth as the water course ripples on its way to the southeast.  Smooth stones line the damp banks of the river on the western side, where they create a small decorative barrier between the jungle and the docks.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Mist Haven]
description: Thick vines hang down from overhead trees, their lengths tangled up with one another to create an extra curtain of green in the already dense jungle.  A heavy mist floats through the air, completely covering the jungle floor, as well as nearly obscuring the montage of mossy trees that clump together and create a barrier in all directions.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Shallow Cavern]
description: Dim moonlight filters in from above, barely illuminating the area.  It is clear, however, that each wall of the cavern is spliced with thick veins of serpentine.  A thin coat of serpentine dust covers both the ground and the vines that hang down through the overhead crevice.  Lack of light makes further progress into the dark cavern impossible.

title: [Maoral Hall, Dark Sanctuary]
description: The room is constructed of local maoral, washing its walls and floor in rich, dark red hues.  Thick pillars crafted from the trunks of living trees span the length of the hall from entry to dais, their looming forms standing guard to the tapestries hung between them, their leafy tops unseen, above the level of the thatched ceiling.  Piercing the gloom, a gilt-framed oculus directly above the dais casts a baleful eye of moonlight on a massive mahogany altar set upon it.  Several doorways lead to different rooms in the temple complex.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Jungle Path]
description: Winding its gentle way through the untamed foliage is a slender footpath covered in crushed, pearly white seashells.  An expanse of large white sailcloth gleams brightly in the sunlight and gently sways in the moisture-laden breeze off in the distance, while just west of here the gentle peaks of the rebuilt monastery can be seen.  Here and there along the path, rainwater collects in the gnarled, exposed roots of the majestic trees that form the leafy canopy above.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Ruins]
description: Bright yellow sunlight sparkles across crushed, white seashells littering the area before a set of broad stone steps that lead through a pair of columns into an open entryway.  A slender footpath, covered with the same powdering of shells, works its way deeper into the jungle and affords a glimpse of some vegetation-choked buildings.  Two painted blue urns rest to either side of a carved sandstone bench under the shelter of a canopy of banana tree limbs.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Courtyard]
description: Crushed white seashells spill into the small clearing from the slender footpath that winds its gentle way westward through the encroaching foliage.  Wild vines and broad-leafed vegetation have been cleared from a wide, cobblestone courtyard.  Copper-banded barrels line the court on opposing sides of a large stucco wall at the eastern end of this clearing.  A large sandstone archway sits at the center of the whitewashed wall, and a thin reed mat has been laid across the threshold.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Kitchen]
description: Built into the remaining three walls of a ruined building is an open kitchen.  A huge, sailcloth sheet has been lashed to the crumbling sides, replacing the long gone roof.  Fruitwood cupboards faced with glass panes line the walls on either side of a sandstone archway, while an enormous, stone cooking wall has been built into the southern wall of the ruins.  A wide driftwood counter sits upon huge sandstone blocks in the center of the room.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Ruined Entry]
description: Broad stone steps, cracked and broken where wild jungle vines have pushed their way through the seams, lead down to a small clearing littered with crushed white seashells.  Rising on either side of the steps are alabaster columns that have long ago lost the roof they once supported.  Standing in the center of a broken arch is an embroidered silk screen facing an oak panel across rough stone slabs.  The entry continues to the north where a wide courtyard can be seen in the distance.

title: [Monastery Grounds, A Thin Track]
description: Cord-like creeper vines trail across the slender game track that cuts through this section of undomesticated jungle.  Growing from vibrant green vines which wrap around broad trees along the path are bright yellow and pink wild roses.  Cockatiels and toucans occasionally fly through the area in a pageantry of color and noise.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Jungle Track]
description: Bleached bones, claws, and beaks lay scattered along this part of the game track near some white jasmine vines.  The blossoms fall to rest across the ground, and some vines have wound into the various body parts creating the atmosphere of a quiet impromptu burial ground.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Jungle Track]
description: Bits of faded, rotting wood litter the track, fallen from a trellis that has been consumed by the pale green honeysuckle vines that grow here.  Golden petals lay scattered about the ground, where they lay to rot in the hot tropic sun.  A thin track cuts through the thick tangle of foliage leading towards a small cemetery.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Cemetery]
description: Surrounded in a halo of sunlight, which breaks through the canopy above, is this quiet cemetery.  A series of broken grave markers covered in thick moss break through the wild grass at odd angles, their faces smooth and without ornamentation.  Resting upon a slender stone dais at the center of the cemetery is a carved green marble statue.  Water gurgles up around the base of the statue to create a stream that cuts through the jungle to the north and west.  A thin track leads into the jungle.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Ruined Entry]
description: Descending into a wide courtyard is a set of long steps, their sides adorned with golden-hued oak railings.  Crumbling walls painted with paneled mosaics line the old entryway only to fall away into ruined arches further to the south.  White censors strung from rod-iron poles give the air a strong musky scent as smoke pours from their shield-shaped openings.  The loud cawing of wild birds shatters the silence that hangs in the steamy, scent-laden air.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Courtyard]
description: A lush group of tropical trees encloses the clearing, their verdant leaves bowing gracefully to brush the tops of the ruined stone walls that litter the ground.  A small stream babbles through the mossy ground and feeds a placid pond that rests in the center, its surface glinting in the unwavering sunlight.  A carved stone bench sits in between tropical flowers that bloom in an array of hues, their blossoms a bright contrast to the blackened stone.  Some long stone steps lead out of the ruins, their surfaces worn smooth.

paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Monastery Ruins, Masters' Path]
description: Cracked cobblestones jut out of the ground at odd angles where a stream has eroded part of the courtyard on its meandering path to a pond at the center.  Ruined walls of sandstone ring the eastern and northern walls, broken only by a section of intact building where a window and an alcove have been refurbished.  Swaying in the gentle breeze is a rope bridge leading over the jungle paths to a cliff.

title: [Monastery, Masters' Bridge]
description: Leaves drift effortlessly about on a disturbingly cool breeze that travels across and under the bridge.  Long hemp cords bind the swaying bridge to tree branches high up in the canopy, and slender glass globes are tied to the rope hand railings.  The sound of rushing water filters across the path from a cliff that can be seen in the distance, while white cobblestones gleam in the sunlight from the courtyard that the bridge empties into at its other end.

title: [Alcove, Grandmaster's Workroom]
description: Books and scrolls lay scattered about this small stucco alcove.  A heavy oak desk rests near the far wall, jumbled papers and reports covering the desktop.  Near the entryway, an unstable bookshelf stands empty, leaning slightly on the uneven cobbles of the floor.  Sunlight filters through an open window, along with a mild breeze that carries the gentle sounds of the jungle.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Harmony Garden]
description: Dark green moss covers the ground in a thick, spongy blanket that gradually continues up some ruined sandstone walls dotting the area.  A brilliant red and yellow vivid heliconia plant stands proudly next to a wall to the south, its bright colors a refreshing reprieve from the dull greys behind it.  Situated in the middle of the area is a round sandstone table with a young banana tree climbing through a large hole at its center.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Peace Garden]
description: Supported by a bough of a cocobolo tree, a low-hanging swing creaks as a slight breeze pushes it over a bed of colorful flowers.  Warm sunlight filters through the leafy cocobolo, leaving checkered patterns of light to illuminate the mossy floor.  Every now and then a monkey or two swings from the branches of a nearby tree to the south, paying little notice to the goings-on below.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Cleansing Path]
description: Separated from the ruins of the courtyard wall is a pair of large sandstone blocks with enormous iron rings set into their centers.  The rings act as an anchor to ropes that traverse the jungle to the northeast and have been covered with thin wooden planks to form a bridge.  Vines of soft and dark green hang from the canopy overhead, where flying squirrels and monkeys play in the sunlight.  Almost as an afterthought, a carved stone bench rests off to one side, half buried in vines.

Separated from the ruins of the courtyard wall is a pair of large sandstone blocks with enormous iron rings set into their centers.  The rings act as an anchor to ropes that traverse the jungle to the northeast and have been covered with thin wooden planks to form a bridge.  Vines of soft and dark green hang from the canopy overhead, where giant fruit bats flutter by in the moonlight.  Almost as an afterthought, a carved stone bench rests off to one side, half buried in vines.

title: [Monastery, Rope Bridge]
description: Sunlight streams in slender shafts through the vibrant green canopy above to illuminate the whitewashed floorboards that have been lashed to long ropes in the creation of this swaying bridge.  The heady scent of passionflowers drifts on the same light breeze that a myriad of brightly winged butterflies use to travel through the jungle.  Enormous sandstone blocks offer anchoring points for this suspension bridge that terminates in a courtyard at one end and a freshly-cut jungle path at the other.

The heady scent of passionflowers drifts on the same light breeze that ruffles the wings of a myriad of brightly winged butterflies resting on the ropes.  Enormous sandstone blocks offer anchoring points for this suspension bridge that terminates in a courtyard at one end and a freshly-cut jungle path at the other.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Jungle Path]
description: The air is humid and sticky here, the leafy canopy overhead seeming to hold the moisture in along the path.  Brightly blooming flora lines the walkway, a smaller path branching off towards a raised wooden building that can be spied through the trees.  At the entrance to the building rests a low bamboo rack that sits on a thick woven grass mat, and is covered with a variety of footwear, presumably to store it as one enters the building.  A solid stone archway offers the shelter of the ruin, while a swaying rope bridge leads on.

title: [Monastery, Library]
description: This quiet space supports a number of well-oiled bookcases filled with thick volumes of both finished and unfinished works.  Lamplight illuminates the room, creating a soft glow perfect for intense study and concentration.  A large stained glass window dominates the west wall, its brilliant hues dulled by the lack of direct sunlight filtering through.  A solid stone archway stands open to the jungle.

title: [Monastery, Washroom]
description: The sound of various birds trill distantly from outside, muffled slightly by the sound of the stream that runs beneath this raised building.  A crude wheel lashed with carved wooden cups dips into a furrow built into the floor, catching the stream water within and turning slowly.  Channels of bamboo have been affixed to the thatched ceiling, the various holes drilled into them allowing the water from the cups to cascade down in a gentle raining shower to land in a large porcelain bathtub below.  A doorway leads out.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Clearing]
description: Wild roots and jungle plants surround the area, but only short grass and stone cover the ground directly below your feet.  Cobblestones jut from the grass in places and create a path leading to a flimsy rope ladder.  Below the ladder is a marble fountain and a nearby bench that faces a swiftly moving stream to the west.

title: [Monastery, Ruined Hall]
description: The most prominent thing about this room is the lack of any sturdy overhead protection due to collapsed stone walls and a falling archway.  A finely thatched roof makes for temporary protection from the weather, though a heavy storm would threaten its stability.  This portion of the library has been cleared of all books and shelving, though stone desks and wooden chairs are scattered about the room.

title: [Monastery, Library]
description: Warm sunlight filters through a highly detailed, large stained glass window set into the west wall, casting shadows about the room.  Highlighting the mars and scratches along the opposite wall, a soft glow showers some weathered bookcases built into the rough stone and a maple writing desk resting beside them.  A set of ascending steps rests in shadows to one side.

Silvery starlight filters through a highly detailed, large stained glass window set into the west wall, casting shadows about the room.  Highlighting the mars and scratches along the opposite wall, a soft glow showers some weathered bookcases built into the rough stone and a maple writing desk resting beside them.  A set of ascending steps rests in shadows to one side.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Dining Room]
description: Three trestle tables, created from abandoned ship hulls, rest upon a broad cobblestone courtyard under the protection of a series of wide canvas sails that gleam brightly in the sunlight.  Two sets of iron tubs, used to illuminate and heat the dining area in the evenings, lay dormant to either side of the northern and southern pathways that lead in and out.  Some gently descending steps reside to one side.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Herb Garden]
description: Thin rows of well-manicured plants spread out in even rows within a white picket fence.  Vines of shiny leafed sage and bushes of spiny-stemmed dill are only a few of the herbal varieties that fill the small garden.  A low and flat circular trough set to the side of the garden houses fresh fish that is being stored for later preparation.  Aromas from the nearby kitchen drift on the gentle air and fill the garden with the smell of roasting meats.  Nearby, a thin grass-lined footpath leads onward through the garden.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Garden]
description: Long reed poles hold the encroaching jungle at bay to allow for a small domestic vegetable garden to flourish in this clearing.  Carrots, beets, cucumbers, and potatoes are arranged in neat little rows in the center, while wire cages at the edge of the cultivated ground support beanstalks and tomato vines.  Four torches, crafted of split bamboo that nestle a miniature urn of oil, have been set at the cardinal points and lay dormant in the sunlight.  Set beside a thin grass-lined footpath is a rough wooden bench, inviting rest.
