Four torches, crafted of split bamboo that nestle a miniature urn of oil, have been set at the cardinal points and burn brightly in the darkness.  Set beside a thin grass-lined footpath is a rough wooden bench, inviting rest.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Cliff]
description: The plateau leads to a steep cliff that overlooks the dense jungle.  A swaying rope bridge connects the cliff to the monastery below as it stretches over the forest's canopy.  A parting in the leaves beneath the bridge reveals several motes of torchlight glistening from the forest floor.  Centered in the plateau stands a run-down citadel, the majority of its towers and walls cracked and broken.  An arched doorway, long bereft of an actual door, leads deeper into the stronghold.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Master's Hall]
description: A breeze circles in through the window, carrying with it a hint of fresh air and the suggestion of recent rainfall.  A cobblestone floor, adorned with mats and pillows for both decoration and use, shows little signs of wear and tear.  A glowing globe sits on a shelf near the window, directly beneath an extravagant tapestry.  The whistle of the wind enters through an arched doorway that stands open to the elements outside.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Stockroom]
description: In each corner of this compact room sits a barrel filled with an assortment of weapons.  Moisture drips from the ceiling, making a splish when the drops hit small puddles that nourish the plant life breaking through the cobblestone floor.  Shelving has been nailed into the walls, supporting a variety of dried fruits and herbs.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Chapel]
description: Sunlight filters in through colored glass windows that have been placed into the wall, fragmenting into a myriad of colors across the length of the floor.  Two candles stand near a decorative fountain in the center of the room, each casting a warm glow across the chapel.  An assortment of tapestries and banners has been hung along the perimeter of the room, fluttering occasionally in response to a draft.  Directly beneath each of the wall hangings sits a small altar and a plain velvet pillow.

Moonlight filters in through colored glass windows that have been placed into the wall, fragmenting into a myriad of colors across the length of the floor.  Two candles stand near a decorative fountain in the center of the room, each casting a warm glow across the chapel.  An assortment of tapestries and banners has been hung along the perimeter of the room, fluttering occasionally in response to a draft.  Directly beneath each of the wall hangings sits a small altar and a plain velvet pillow.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stone Tree]
description: Scratched into the bedrock is this hollow cavern that stretches below a great banyan.  A solitary candle on a simple altar lends illumination and shadows to the pockmarked and irregular formations surrounding the underground den.  An elaborate upside-down tree growing down from the ceiling has been shaped from the banyan's roots and mirrored in carvings that span the stone walls.  A light musk infiltrates as the air is stirred through the cavern, and a subtle but oppressive silence hangs in the air.

title: [Earthen Cave, Undertree]
description: A rough stone ladder descends from above near the very edge of the room.  The cave's chamber is walled with hard-packed soil, held in by a network of roots that crisscross the walls like the threads of a spider's web, two of which flank a narrow earthen passage.  A large bundle of roots descends from the center of the ceiling in a writhing tangle, some tips curled around glowing crimson globes, creating a macabre chandelier.  Set beneath the roots is a fire pit, while in the background, set into the wall, is a niche containing an ornamented skeleton.

title: [Shadowed Clearing]
description: Dense canopy surrounds this small clearing encasing it in cool dark shadow.  Thin white mist enshrouds a stained stone slab that is surrounded by tiny black gravel in the center of the clearing.  No living thing disturbs the silent grip that stillness holds on this secret, hidden glen.  Over the slab, three small orbs slowly hover, spinning around each other and casting a faint silvery light that mutes nearby colors into varied shades of pale whites, cool grays, and pitch blacks.  Between two trees is an arch of tangled boughs.

title: [The Offering]
description: Layers of palm fronds litter the uneven stone floor of the room, the thick fanned leaves muffling the sounds of the thatched temple from the world beyond.  A haphazard path of candles and incense, held within vessels of broken glass and shell, lead to an altar of greyed marble, its smooth unaltered surface a stark contrast to a weathered driftwood figure standing upon it.  Encircling the feet of the statue are several trinkets, some newly offered, while others have succumbed to the effects of the sea air.  An arch set into one wall leads out.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Tucked between two of the cells, and well out of reach, is a copper-chained pump system mounted into a bucket-like sump in the floor.  A long, cast-iron lever stands motionless despite the sound of gurgling water that occasionally sloshes up out of the sump to wet the pitch-slathered deck.  A slight warping in the wooden planks and watermarks on the oaken bulkheads bear testament to the ravages of water within the area at some point in the past.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [The Center of Stillness]
description: Three concave walls enclose this large, triangular room.  Leaded crystal windows form the points of the triangle, filtering in a dim grey light.  In the center of the room, the floor is stepped downward, forming an amphitheater with a long dark platform at the fore.  A pair of jet double doors in the south wall and a panel that rests slightly ajar in the north comprise the only breaks in the smooth dark walls, their surfaces faintly etched with stark blocky designs.  The air is perfectly still and carries a faint musky tang.

title: [Temple of the Howling Veil]
description: In the dark corners of this unearthed temple, a myriad of shadows surrender ancient walls made of time-shrouded obsidian.  Light itself almost seems devoured by the somber atmosphere present.  Carved in relief along the decrepit walls are various depictions of gods among the Lornon pantheon, all of which center toward a giant spherical idol of the dark moon itself.  A chilling wind blows discordantly throughout the hall from places unknown, while a black altar rests to one side, opposite a panel that stands slightly ajar.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry]
description: Murky shadows obscure the details of the room, though a sense of being watched is heavily prevalent.  A small halo of golden light, produced by the candlelight spilling under the oaken door, illuminates the edge of a set of wide stone stairs that leads downward into a dank darkness.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry]
description: Damp runnels of water trickle over the moist surface of the curved wall, with the occasional drip echoing in the chamber as it plinks into the stagnant water on the floor.  Several spiders have made flimsy webs, anchoring them between the ceiling and the upper curves of the walls.  The majority of the webs cover the bulbous, rounded dead end to the south end of the sewer.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Bisecting the narrow companionway between the rows of wrought iron cells is a large wooden framing post marred by nicks and scratches down its rough expanse.  A black iron ring supports the manacled form of a rotted skeleton draped in tattered clothing that might once have been an Imperial Navy uniform.  Foul odors fill this section of the ship, made worse by the damp, sea-laden air.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Whirlin's Wonderous Widgets]
[Whirlin's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by smooth mistwood walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its sea glass floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the skylight-set ceiling.  Right near the front is a vine-carved mahogany table and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest.

title: [Guild Shop]
description: Sloping slightly to the west, the floor here lacks the pooling water of other areas.  The northern wall is imbedded with a series of hooks in parallel rows while the eastern wall is entirely covered with improvised shelving.  A collection of old iron trunks is scattered across the room seemingly haphazardly.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Stretching in either direction, the wide and tall tunnel echoes noisily with every rustle or movement.  Every surface seeps with water which pools shallowly on the ground.  The walls are featureless except for a subtle crescent on the northern wall.  A slightly raised spot on the southern wall reveals the tips of a ladder peaking out of it.

title: [Antechamber]
description: Both the reek of the sewers and the humidity of the air are attenuated here.  It feels almost to be a prosperous business lobby above ground.  Two doors are guarded by a scarred knotty oak desk with an elderly secretary behind it.  She sits primly, not obviously doing much outside of occasionally holding a handkerchief to her nose.  Nearer the ladder, a couple of middling-worn sofas and a dog-eared coffee table are provided for visitors.

title: [Rogue Guild, Access Points]
description: Narrowing quickly, the huge tunnel deadends in a thick metal grate that completely covers one end.  Bits of paper and various other waste cling to the cross bars of the grate indicating that, at times, there is considerably more water here than now.  A rusty iron ladder leads up to a manhole above.

title: [The Broken Stein, Entry]
description: Brass lanterns decorate the dark walls and provide the small room with a dusky illumination that is just barely enough light to see by.  A series of cushioned brass stools stand before a polished driftwood bar that has a button-inlaid top, while glass shelves on the back wall support decanters, small barrels, and jars of various liquids.  Bands of moonlight spill through the open door that decorates a windowless wall.

Brass lanterns decorate the dark walls and provide the small room with a dusky illumination that is just barely enough light to make out the sparse furnishings.  A series of cushioned brass stools stand before a polished driftwood bar that has a button-inlaid top, while glass shelves on the back wall support decanters, small barrels, and jars of various liquids.  Bands of moonlight spill through the open door that decorates a windowless wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Illuminated by the flicking flames trapped within bronze lanterns, the sewer passage is largely free of debris.  Steel, iron, and copper pipes descend from the ceiling in knotted tangles only to disappear into the western wall.  Rising four handspans high, a small water barrier made of burlap sacks filled with sand encircles a large hole in the floor with a blackened iron ladder poking out of it.

title: [Rogue Guild, Dining Chamber]
description: Built into an unused sewer nexus, the cobble walls of the dinning chamber are painted stark white.  Cushion-topped stools surround a circular driftwood bar beneath the warm glow of frosted orbs that are suspended from the azure ceiling.  Private alcoves occupy each of the north, east, west, and south-facing walls, while a blackened iron ladder resting in the northwest corner leads to the upper levels.

title: [Dinning Chamber, North]
description: Shadows and candlelight vie for dominance as they dance across the domed ceiling of the alcove, their silent battle making visibility tenuous at best.  Uneven cobblestones cause the lone table to wobble awkwardly upon the floor, though the chairs seem to have little difficulty.  Rounded stones line the wide entry providing an excellent view of the bar, while some white chalk scriblings on a nearby wall stands out in the dark.

title: [Dinning Chamber, East]
description: Slight raised from the floor of the bar, the alcove is positioned beyond the yawning mouth of a stone-edged arch.  Bronze fixtures are fitted into the cobblestone walls providing the area, as well as the table and chairs, with ample illumination.  A scrap of paper has been hammered into the wall.

title: [The Broken Stein, Office]
description: Devoid of windows, the small office is sparsely furnished and has a single brass-sided lantern that provides scant illumination.  Stacks of papers rest upon the corner of an abused desk that is fashioned of dark-stained oak.  A small crate, turned on its side, appears to be the only seat available, while a wide open door leads into the small bar room to the east.

title: [The Colonnade, Courtyard]
description: A path of red and grey stones leads away from the gate and runs along the spiked iron fence that encircles the round courtyard.  Sprouting from the center of the circular path, lush flowerbeds filled with rare exotic foliage lend their heady perfume to the air.  A colonnade of black-veined grey marble columns supports an elaborate curved entablature and creates an imposing facade for this rounded marble edifice.

title: [The Colonnade, Lobby]
description: Bedecked in fine woven tapestries, the maroon silk-paneled walls surrounding this expansive room stretch upward to a domed ceiling.  To either side of the entrance, two small marble podiums stand opposite each other, each covered with a woven silk cloth.  Sweeping up toward the second level is a grand black-veined grey marble staircase, its railing carved with exotic flowers.  Set into an arched recess in the back wall, a set of double doors leads deeper into the theater.

title: [The Colonnade, Auditorium]
description: Opposite the set of double doors leading in, the stage stretches from one end of the room to the other, beyond the proscenium arch with its dividing burgundy curtain.  Facing the stage, row upon row of opulent rowan benches, covered in soft burgundy velvet cushions, stand upon the black marble floor.  Torches around the room serve to light the space, and can be snuffed or lit as needed.  The proscenium steps on either side of the stage are each flanked by a small oak door leading out of the room.

title: [The Colonnade, Hallway]
description: The hallway here is brightly lit, with oil lamps resting in elaborate pewter sconces along the walls on both sides.  A wooden stage door stands between two sconces leading stage left, while a dressing room door in the opposite wall is clearly marked with a gilded golden star.  At each end of the hallway, a polished oak door leads into the audience chamber.

title: [The Colonnade, Dressing Room]
description: One wall of this room is comprised of a silver-framed glass mirror that stands from the beige carpeted floor to the plain white ceiling.  Marble vanities rest against the non-mirrored walls, alongside racks overflowing with costumes and a single rowan bench.  Make-up cases and other beauty products litter the surfaces of the vanities, and bright oil lamps light the space with a brilliant glow.  The door back to the hallway can barely be seen between two undressed mannequins.

title: [The Colonnade, Backstage]
description: This small space is cramped, with props and scenery piled in haphazard stacks on either side of a narrow walkway.  The rope for the curtain stretches from ceiling to floor near the light switches, the pulleys glisten with oil to avoid squeaking, and the wooden lever is buffed smooth.  Providing access to the stage are two arches, while at the back of the room, a wooden stage door leads out to the hallway.

title: [The Colonnade, Balcony]
description: Where the staircase ends, its beautiful carved railings spread to each side, dividing the balcony from the open space above the lobby with twisting marble wildflowers and twining ivy vines.  Velvet ropes define the areas open to the public and those which require tickets.  A rowan door embossed with a silver plaque rests in the wall at one end, while an oak door embossed with a gold plaque stands at the other.

title: [The Colonnade, Box Seat Gold]
description: High above the auditorium, this box seat provides a perfect view of the stage and its heavy curtain.  Gold accents on the railings and thickly padded marble chairs sparkle in the lamp light as the flames flicker within their glass containers.  Serving trays rest on wheeled carts on the thick burgundy carpet near an oak door embossed with golden scrollwork leading back outside.

title: [The Colonnade, Box Seat Silver]
description: High above the auditorium, this box seat provides a perfect view of the stage and its heavy curtain.  Silver accents on the railings and thickly padded marble chairs sparkle in the lamp light as the flames flicker within their glass containers.  Serving trays rest on wheeled carts on the thick burgundy carpet near a rowan door embossed with silver scrollwork leading back outside.

title: [Dinning Chamber, West]
description: Dust and cobwebs, their fibrous skeins swaying each time someone passes by, decorate the cobblestones of the alcove's domed ceiling.  Flicker candlelight reaches outward from a small, dirty glass lantern that rests upon the scarred oak table, which is surrounded by stubby chairs.  The scent of fresh rushes mingles with the dust making the air heavy and thick.

title: [Dinning Chamber, South]
description: Small and crowded, the alcove has an excellent view of the bar, the ladder, and two of the other three alcoves.  Long-legged chairs, with high backs, surround the polished oak table, which also has incredibly tall legs.  Recessed niches house stubby candles providing enough illumination for the occupants, but not enough for outsiders to be able to identify those gathered.

title: [A Dark Warehouse]
description: Cramped and crowded, the small room appears to be a warehouse with brick walls and a knotty oak floor.  Stacks of boxes and containers are piled to the ceiling in many places and create a labyrinthine maze of packed goods.  Incredibly faint light leaks out from behind one particular short stack of wooden crates, while light from the alley also filters in through the open doorway.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Several off-shoot tunnels line the northern wall, solid iron gates blocking them off after just a few inches.  Small pools of stagnant water gather along the floor of the wide tunnel.  A soft plinking sound can be heard coming from one of the northern tunnels.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Rounded cobblestones are stacked with precision to create the smooth walls, which gently curve upward to create a domed ceiling.  Piles of debris are clustered along the southern wall, the faint scent of decay and mildew rising from them, though the northern wall appears to be largely clear where a sewer-capped ladder disappears into the ceiling.  Oddly deep, several claw marks mar the lower area of the rounded walls.

title: [Bard Guild, Courtyard]
description: Offering an excellent view of the harbor, the stone-lined walkway opens up into a large cobblestone courtyard.  Beds of bright flowers are planted about, splashing color over the pale grey stones leading up to an elegant whitewashed manor.  A pair of bright ceramic urns flank the staircase, each one filled with beautiful island blossoms.  Several varieties of orchid and fern trees surround the area, creating a colorful canopy.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Pools of prismatic sunlight spill through the open manhole that is recessed into the ceiling, its colorful illumination creating moving patterns upon the smooth, cobblestone walls.  Rising through the opening, a rusted ladder provides egress from the area and is surrounded by large flakes of rust and bits of discarded fabric.

title: [Bathing Annex, Catwalk]
description: Alternating teak and cedar boards rise upon the western edge of the very narrow room, while large stained glass windows form the eastern wall.  Curved walls lead away to the north and south, while a rusted ladder rises out of a large hole in the floor and leads to the sewers below.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Damp, musty air fills the tunnel and creates pools of steam along the seams of the wall where water has managed to collect.  Soot stains rise in long streaks up the wall, their dark fingers licking at the ceiling, while below it are the burned remains of a wooden shelf.  Someone has drawn a smiley face in the soot, which has resisted against all attempts to be cleaned.

title: [Bathing Annex, Catwalk]
description: Cobalt-hued panes blend with frosted white to create a beautiful stained glass window that occupies the entire northern section of the small crawlspace.  Teak and cedar boards, arranged in alternating patterns, rise from the wrought-iron reinforced floor and connect the slanted ceiling, their rich fragrance making the humid air almost overwhelming.

title: [Bathing Annex, Catwalk]
description: Beads of sweat, their plump bodies occasionally condensing into larger drops that slide down the wall and pool upon the teak floor, cling to the rectangular panes of glass that are fitted into the pewter-wrapped window.  Redwood boards rise upon the eastern edge and form the supports of the narrow crawlspace, which curves north and southward.

title: [Bathing Annex, Catwalk]
description: Pewter framework creates the narrow outline of the stained glass window, which depicts the image of a smiling nymph as she paddles towards a distant island.  Tight corners and cramped spacing allows for very little movement along the redwood and teak catwalk, though narrow bands of light to the east offer the hope that the space opens up closer to the light.

title: [Bathing Annex, Catwalk]
description: Suspended from heavy ironwood beams that are reinforced with wrought iron, a slender catwalk stretches across a frosted glass ceiling that is beaded with sweat.  Cobalt and mist grey panes form an elegant stained glass window above, their interwoven designs creating a compass rose upon a sea of blue.  Moonlight bleeds through the opaque panels and lends the area an silvery hue.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Much of the water flowing into the area cascades through the gates in the floor in a frothy rush, leaving the available footing covered with spray and as slippery as metal.   Recessed into the wall, a ladder pushes up toward a trapdoor.

title: [Office]
description: Three lines of shelving run the length of the room, ending just before a row of filing cabinets, all in dingy grey, lining the back wall.  Neat and tidy, file folders labeled in various colors rest atop the various shelves.  Although they look random, there must be a system to the way they are put on the shelves.  A small table near the door holds pots of ink and paint to add color to new file folders.

title: [Guild Master]
description: A claw-footed desk of mahogany takes up half the space of this dark-paneled room.  Light streams from a magelight next to the overstuffed, wheeled and leather-clad chair that sits behind the desk.  A much smaller wooden chair, with its seat slanting slightly forward, sits on the other side of the desk.  The office is remarkably clean of personal effects, with the exception of an ornate cigar box resting on the right back corner of the desk.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sewers]
description: Low ceilings fashioned of blocky cobblestones meet with the smooth stone walls, which are supported by a soft floor of dry dirt.  Tiny rivulets, fed by condensation upon the eastern walls, follow the tunnel to the north under the watchful gaze of some ring-bound torches.  A thick metal grate separates this section of the sewers from the others.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sewers]
description: Large squares of white cobbles form the walls and ceiling of the tunnel, while a dirt floor stretches to the north and south.  Devoid of ornamentation, the only decoration in this passage is a pair of matching torches that dispel the darkness of Mist Harbor's underbelly with their steady glow.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Tiny rivulets slip down the northern and southern passages and meet in the center of the tunnel's floor where they create a tiny pool.  Rounded, white pebbles form a small barrier around the pool that prevents it from spilling into the main walking area of the passage.  A ragged torch provides illumination for the immediate area, though it does little to illuminate the incline to the north.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Transitioning from packed dirt to smooth stones, the tunnel's floor matches its ceiling and walls, which are curved and stained with watermarks.  Thick, grey mortar fills the cracks between the stones, allowing the terrain to be flat and uniform.  Condensation at the center of the ceiling either drips with a soft *plink* upon the floor, or runs down the sides of the walls to pool in tiny rivulets that flow eastward.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Circular in shape, the cobblestone tunnel stretches in a straight, uniform line from east to west.  Curtains of wax descend from a shelf high upon the northern wall, where fat candles have been placed to provide illumination for the area.  The scent of sandalwood rises from the cluster of burning tapers and staves off the more unpleasant aromas of the sewers.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Puddles of flicking yellow light illuminate the eastern section of the tunnel, though it becomes fainter further to the west.  Here and there, the random sound of dripping water fills the air and echoes off the surrounding cobblestones of the wall, ceiling, and floor.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Dank and dark, this section of the tunnel is filled with shadows and runs heavy with the scent of rotting waste and refuse.  Thick grates to the north and south block passage into the darker depths of the sewer system, and also provide windows into the slop-filled gloom of the passage.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Brilliant yellow illumination trickles into the passage from the west, while to the east it perceptively darkens.  Fresh, white paint decorates the tunnel proving that some sort of maintenance takes place here on a fairly regular basis.  The odd sound of mechanical whirs mingles with the sound of running water, though their source is not evident anywhere in this section of the passage.

title: [Beneath Gardenia Commons]
description: Thin copper pipes rise out of the floor at the center of each of the walls of the nexus, their opposite ends fitted to glass lanterns that house blue-hearted orange flames.  Thick blocks of cement support an elaborate gear system that is surrounded by a circular scaffold system, while complex pipes, some clear and others steel, disappear into both the ceiling and the floor.  A moat of crystal clear water surrounds the entire contraption, but can be crossed where a small bridge leads from the cobblestones to the cement.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Light from the eastern section of the tunnel floods the area and illuminates each crack, crevice, and edge of the cobblestones that line the floor, ceilings, and walls.  Condensation along the northern wall pools into tiny rivers that descend to the west.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Rising from beyond a set of grates, the sound of rushing water fills the area and echoes off the cobblestones that form the ceiling, floor, and walls.  Putrid aromas fill the air and make the darkness of the tunnel seem all the more ominous.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Faint illumination allows the stone passage enough light to see by, while also creating large and small shadows upon the walls and floors.  Debris lines the edges of the tunnel without clogging up the main areas and a heaviness in the air lends the tunnel an oppressively dank feeling.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Storm drains in the ceiling provide soft illumination for the tunnel, their open grates spilling golden sunlight upon the worn cobblestones recessed into the ground.  Trailing vines clog the grates where the light filters through.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Russet and yellow lichen clings to the cobblestones of the walls, their feathery ends swaying back and forth under the inconsistent attention of the dank air that flows through the passage.  The constant sound of dripping water bounces off of the smooth stones and echoes through the area.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Gradually changing in grade from flat to dipped, the passage slowly becomes steep and the cobblestones begin to become less prevalent.  Tiny rivulets of water slip down to the south and create an echoing chorus as they tumble over pebbles and stones.

title: [Western Harbor, Sewers]
description: Thick beams of oak and pine create the bones of the passage, which suddenly terminates into a rounded wall of packed dirt to the south.  A steep ramp leads downward to a lower level, while a scattering of cobblestones creates an uneven ground.

title: [Sewers, Beneath the Slaughter]
description: Smelling heavily of carnage, the dank passage is illuminated by a single torch resting in a bracket beside a blackened wrought iron ladder that leads upwards towards the oak ceiling.  Sanguine stains darken the walls and packed dirt floor.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Eddies of the detritus of life have thrown themselves against minor flaws in the sewer's curvature.  Papers, bits of metal, and various scraps of organic matter array themselves on the snags of imperfect concrete.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Scents of garlic and herbs mingle with those of rotten food.  The water flows slowly past piles of food wastes in various states of decay.  A soft click-click in the darkness suggests that the piles are feasts for some.  Rising from a pile of fresh slop, a slippery ladder leads upward to the apparent source.

title: [Monkey Fist, Storage Closet]
description: Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond the a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Protected by a foot-high curving concrete barrier, an iron-bolted rusty ladder descends below the tunnel.  The sound of light metalwork filters up the shaft, echoing off the walls of the large tunnel and mingling with the ever present *plink* of dripping water.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workshop]
description: Smooth wooden panels give the small, circular room a finished look, while shelves make the space feel cramped and tiny.  Set beneath brass lanterns, a row of cluttered toolbenches provides several flat surfaces to work in.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Several narrow tunnels, each lined with concrete storm basins, branch off from the main passage in multiple directions.  Curtains of water fall with audible splashes into the various basins, the sound of their draining creating a roar that echoes through the area.  Descended at a sharp dip, a grated and brick-lined tunnel leads towards a well-illuminated nexus on a lower level.

title: [Rogue Guild, Training Nexus]
description: Bright and flickering, golden candlelight illuminates every inch of the nexus and dispels all shadows.  Smooth cobblestone walls rise into a domed ceiling that is incredibly distant from the uneven floor.  Training dummies and training mannequins are arranged in an alternating pattern around the circular room, though each is pulled far enough away from the wall to prevent candles that are perched on the high shelf from dripping on them.  Several entries provide a means of egress but only a brick-lined tunnel leads up.

title: [Rogue Guild, Training Nexus]
description: Several iron-grated drains are recessed into the uneven cobblestone of the floor and surround a raised platform that is covered in steel sheets.  Large alcoves lined in white and black stones are arranged around the north, west, and southern walls, their depths illuminated by candles from within.  Surrounding the eastern passage into the sewers is an old iron ladder, that leads up, and a rough oak table that is heavily scarred with jagged gashes.

title: [Rogue's Guild, Storage Closet]
description: Cobwebs and dust collect in the corners of the ceiling, though the floor remains free of debris.  The rack attached to the northern wall is laden with tools, while an open wooden bin provides a safe place for garbage to be placed.

title: [Rogue's Guild, Storage Closet]
description: Modular shelves stretch from the cobblestone floor to the rough oak ceiling, their wide surfaces covered with neatly packed items that are all carefully labeled.  A crate of tools rests near the exit.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Locks]
description: Flickering light from the north spills into this section of the tunnel, though its licking fingers do not invade the deep shadows to the south.  Rising along the eastern wall, and bolted into place by large iron brackets, is a blackened ladder that leads from the cobblestone floor and disappears into the wooden ceiling.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Gems]
description: Bright light spills into this short passage from the south, its brilliance illuminating every stone, corner, and crevice in the area.  A single ladder rises from the stone floor and disappears into the wooden rafters of the ceiling.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Bright light filters in from the north, its steady glow clearly illuminating the cobblestones of the floor, ceiling, and walls, while also casting the southern end in shadows.  Not a stitch of debris, dust, dirt, or cobwebs litters the floors or clogs the corners and the scent of fresh water mixes heavily with lavender in this section of the passage.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Thick iron rings are evenly spaced along the passage and hold aloft burning torches of straw and silk.  Four barred windows, positioned midway up the eastern wall, offer a view of other chambers in the sewer complex, though one seems to be darker than the others.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Health]
description: Glass globes housed in copper cages are suspended from the ceiling and provide ample illumination for this section of the tunnel.  Painted bright white, the walls, ceiling, and floor are all uniformly the same and a narrow cot appears to be the only furnishing.  A blackened iron ladder leads upward through a small trapdoor.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Sharply curving, the tunnel is sparingly illuminated from the north by a strange white glow.  Further to the east, the passage appears to be gloomy and dark, though the fouler stenches do not seem to invade this area quiet as much.

title: [Mist Harbor Proper, Sewers]
description: Faint illumination provides the passage with barely enough light to make out the unobstructed way through the tunnel.  Consistent and repetitive, the sound of dripping water echoes through the area.

title: [Sewers, Hub of Mistfortune]
description: Burning brightly in its bracket, a single torch provides enough illumination to see the various tunnels that branch off from this small nexus.  Packed dirt walls, floor, and ceiling make the change from the regular sewer system noticeable, while several surrounding lidless barrels appear to be filled with dirt.  A long wooden crate rests on its side, its top covered with a simple cloth.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Sewers, Under Lock and Key]
description: Roughly carved out of dirt, the terminus is surrounded on four sides by walls and has a small tunnel that leads towards a central nexus.  Spidery white roots decorate the smooth walls and the floor is pitted with oddly shaped rocks.  Four thick support posts mark the corners of the area, while a blackened iron ladder rises towards the knotty oak ceiling where a small trap door stands closed.  A waxed parchment is tacked near the ladder.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Cell]
description: Bitter and bleak, the air hardly moves in here except for a single vent in the center of the ceiling.  A thin shaft of moonlight is the only access to the outside through a vertical crack in the outside wall.  A small metal table is bolted to the floor as is a sturdy metal cot next to it.

title: [Western Harbor, Sewers]

title: [Sewers, Under the Fountain]
description: Brightly illuminated by copper lanterns, this section of the passage is filled with odd whirring sounds that are punctuated by strange pings.   Thick, black iron grates stretch across the floor over a moat of crystal clear water that has been trapped within an enormous basin lined with white tiles.  Brass and copper tubes rise out of the floor only to disappear into the ceiling, while the northeastern wall is covered in a waterfall that feeds the basin beneath.

title: [Western Harbor, Sewers]

title: [Sewers, Portal to Freedom]

title: [Sewers, Under the Scuttle]
description: Transitioning from cobblestones to knotty oak, the ceiling of the passage is largely hidden in shadows.  Smooth stone walls give way to a wall of packed dirt in the southeast, where a blackened wrought iron ladder disappears through a trapdoor above.  The scent of freshly baked bread mingles oddly with the overall dankness of the area.

A slight warping in the wooden planks and watermarks on the oaken bulkheads bear testament to the ravages of water within the area at some point in the past.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Silvergate, Member's Lockers]
description: Rows of lockers line the shelves along the walls of this compact space.  An old sturdy table is centered between two sets of shelves, and appears to be capable of holding the contents of any of the lockers you can see.  Your locker has been removed from its assigned niche and sits ready for you on an old sturdy counter.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]
description: Clumps of rotted straw lie scattered across the decking that stretches from the inner hull to the wide, wrought iron slats of the cell's rusty bars.  Black rings fixed to the walls with thick iron staples are evenly spaced along the bulkhead and fitted with manacles.  The stench filling the cramped space is heavy with mold and decay.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [The Secondhand Rose, Bloom]
description: Beneath a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling, a brilliant peacock painting hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls.  A set of carved felwood shelves and a long brass clothing rack sit in opposite corners while a plush black bear fur rug rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Alcove]
description: Scented candles in brass fixtures cast a faint, golden light in this small alcove.  The floor is covered with colorful rugs transported from distant lands.  A curtained opening dominates one wall.

title: [Enchantment Emporium]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A heavy white granite counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Spert's Outfitting]

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]

A long, cast-iron lever stands motionless despite the sound of gurgling water that occasionally sloshes up out of the sump to wet the pitch-slathered deck.  A slight warping in the wooden planks and watermarks on the oaken bulkheads bear testament to the ravages of water within the area at some point in the past.

description: Painted white plaster walls rise from a white limestone floor.  Just above a well-pruned lemon tree hangs a blue watered silk tapestry, and a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling completes the picture.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Fionne's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls, and a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a white limestone floor.  There is a low wrought iron table on one side of the shop.

title: [Adventitious Cache]
description: Painted white plaster walls rise from an ash grey granite floor.  Just above some woven linen pillows hangs a woven floral tapestry, and a dark and light oak ceiling completes the picture.  A jewel-inlaid caddy and a long carved oak counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Studious Pursuits]
description: An oil-filled silver sconce hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls, and a dark and light oak ceiling rises overhead.  An iron candelabra sits in one corner of an ash grey granite floor.  There is an open-front willow display case on one side of the shop and a claw-footed wide mahogany desk on the other.

title: [Paddys' General Store]
description: Beneath a platinum patterned ceiling, a locked metal tithing box hangs on one of the elaborate white marble walls.  An imposing swept-wing oak pulpit and an elaborate walnut prie-dieu sit in opposite corners while a plush red velvet carpet rests on a lacquered red oak floor.

title: [Paddys' General Store]
description: Beneath a platinum patterned ceiling, an immense oil painting hangs on one of the imposing marble walls.  An elaborate white marble counter and a carved walnut pew sit in opposite corners while a plush red velvet carpet rests on a lacquered red oak floor.

title: [Eilithyia's Weaponry]
description: A sphere-hilted mounted sword plaque hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls, and a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling rises overhead.  An elegantly woven reed mat sits in one corner of a white limestone floor.  There is a long carved oak counter on one side of the shop and a Vornavian silk-lined display case on the other.

title: [Dragonfly's Wing, Vault]
description: Emerald silk walls rise up to meet a domed sea glass ceiling covering the narrow room.  A large unframed painting covering the eastern wall and a jewel-toned fine wool rug laid upon a shell-inlaid ceramic floor provide additional depth to the small space.  A velvet-lined cherrywood display case and a velvet-draped table flank the rug, and a small potted lemon tree in the back corner fills the room with a fresh scent.

title: [Dragonfly's Wing, Salon]
description: A potted white rosebush set in one of the front corners provides a soft floral scent that greets you as you enter.  A domed sea glass ceiling curves gracefully over the oak-paneled walls adorned with bright tapestries, and a plush white carpet covering a pale grey marble floor leads to an ornately carved armoire at the back of the room.

title: [Zandie's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a dark and light oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a miniature wooden gallows rests on a varnished dark oak floor.

title: [Zandie's Combat Gear]

title: [Obscure Orris Table]
description: A light dusting of white powder covers the table and chairs.  White orris blossoms stand proudly in a narrow gold vase at the center of the table.

title: [Rustic Rose Table]
description: The weathered tabletop is carved with faint images of rose vines.  The etching is so skillfully done that even the dewdrops on the rose petals can clearly be seen.

title: [Scented Salvia Table]
description: A shallow yellow bowl on the table is filled with salvia-scented potpourri.  Two brass candlestick holders, carved in the shape of owls, hold chubby beeswax candles.

title: [Tantalizing Tulip Table]
description: Tall red and yellow tulips lean towards you as though beckoning you to join them.  The slightest breeze from passers-by sets them in motion, swaying gracefully.

title: [Willow Hall, The Grotto]
description: A grotto carved deeply into a stone cliff is hidden behind the cascading curtain of a waterfall.  A myriad of ferns, orchids, ivy and bromeliads hang from the walls, and a small crescent shaped pool has been cut into the moss-covered stone floor.  Muted sunlight passes through the waterfall, casting wisps of dancing white-blue light across the surface of the pool.

title: [Officers' Prize Closet]
description: The closet is well-lit, but so small that it leaves barely enough space to turn around.  An oversized trunk rests at the base of one wall, while shelves rise to the ceiling lining two more walls.

title: [House Brigatta, Entry]
description: The entry to House Brigatta is panelled and floored in dark oak.  An ornately carved table sits to one side with a small crystal vase standing upon it beneath a brightly polished silver mirror.  On the west wall, a series of shelves and pegs hold various cloaks and garb for the outer world.  To the east, a stairway heads up to the second floor.

title: [House Brigatta, Hallway]
description: This narrow hallway ends in a blank wall and at the other end a curtained opening.

title: [House Brigatta, Lockers]
description: This room is small and cramped.

title: [Willow Hall, Locker Alcove]
description: The alcove is intimate, with its soft light from a green-shaded lantern and deep-piled emerald rug.  An oak counter protrudes from its back wall with a matching stool facing it.  Over the counter are numerous oak lockers, each one's door polished to a high sheen.

title: [House Brigatta, Secret Hallway]
description: This narrow hallway ends in a blank wall and at the other end a curtain.

title: [House Brigatta, Lockers]
description: You stand in a small cramped room.

title: [House Brigatta, Common Room]
description: The main room of the house is large but cozy.  A pair of settees with matching footstools sit before a massive stone fireplace.  Along one wall, tall bookcases stand alternately with racks, each holding a goodly assortment of their proper objects.  Thickly woven tapestries cover the windows, enhancing the room's feelings of privacy and intimacy.

title: [House Brigatta, Lounge]
description: A large fireplace of rough-hewn stone, the twin of the one in the Common Room, fills one wall of this comfortable room.  Flickering light from the hearth reflects off a long, brightly polished claidhmore that hangs above the mantle.  Comfortable looking chairs surround several tables that are scattered about the room rest on the thickly-woven carpet.

title: [House Brigatta, Back Porch]
description: Shade from the tree to the north provides just enough relief from the sun to make this a perfect area for outdoor parties.  Surrounding trees and the walls of House Brigatta itself prevent the noises from the bustle of Wehnimer's from intruding.

Moonlight filters through the trees to the north illuminating the porch in a soft glow.  Surrounding trees and the walls of House Brigatta itself prevent the noises from the bustle of Wehnimer's from intruding.

title: [House Brigatta, Bedroom]
description: The walls of this room are almost obscured by trophies of the hunt.  Hides and heads of a score or more assorted beasts of the wild places are mounted to the wall or hung from the rafters.  A plain wooden bed rests between two windows roughly curtained with tanned skins.  The well-stuffed chair sitting before the stone fireplace completes the feeling of rough-hewn comfort.

title: [Willow Hall, Memorial Room]
description: Imprints of decorative seashells are scattered across the textured surface of sandcast walls, like shells dotting the sand of a beach.  A nicely worked red spidersilk rug covers the floor, which is tiled with rare ivory and scattered with a collection of large, colorful pillows for lounging.  A stained-glass window occupies the far wall, and opposite is a painted mural flanked by scented candles in sconces.

title: [Willow Hall, Clan Ceremonial]
description: Sunshine streams down through a crystal skylight over the circular room.  Benches carved with oak and maple leaf motifs are lined in a semi-circle around a raised platform, and a small set of spiral steps leads up to it.  Candles stand in elegant brass sconces imbedded with faceted amethysts, and a large mural stretches around the wall's circle depicting an immense modwir tree where the clan met long ago.  Black Swan castle sits on the mural's far horizon like an ominous black crow.

title: [Willow Hall, Reception Pavilion]
description: An expansive grand ballroom boasts velvet brocade draperies with gold tasseled cords and gilded candelabra, giving the chamber an elegant and festive ambiance.  Ornate columns circle the room and are reflected on the polished floor.  The decor is set into rich contrast with the verdant green of the gardens outside glimpsed from large, arched windows.

title: [House Brigatta, Hallway]
description: This small hallway leads from the Common Room to the interior of the house.  A luxurious wool carpet runner muffles the cold stone flooring and several doors lead to other rooms.

title: [House Brigatta, Sitting Room]
description: This room is bright and airy.  Varicolored crystals hang in front of the large windows and all the colors of the rainbow dance and flit about on every breeze.  A huge white bearskin rug from the far north stretches out before the polished stone fireplace and a straight-backed chair stands alongside it.  Beneath the windows, a long low couch reclines.

This airy room is softly illuminated by moonlight.  Varicolored crystals hang in front of the large windows and all the colors of the rainbow dance and flit about on every breeze.  A huge white bearskin rug from the far north stretches out before the polished stone fireplace and a straight-backed chair stands alongside it.  Beneath the windows, a long low couch reclines.

title: [House Brigatta, Raistlin's Room]
description: Deep wooden shelves cover the walls of this room.  The shelves are crammed with books all bound in a uniform night blue binding.  Where there are no bookshelves, elaborate tapestries covered with mythical beasts picked out in bright colors hang.  The only furnishings are a massive blackwood desk and chair and a curious green orb resting on a golden stand.

title: [House Brigatta, Alcove]
description: In this alcove, a massive bedstead nearly fills the space.  Several thickly stuffed feather mattresses piled upon each other peek out from beneath an embroidered quilt the color of the noon sky high atop a mountain.  Plump, well-fed pillows laze across the bed, some spilling onto the floor where they lie, intertwined, like satiated lovers.  A light floral scent emanates from a silver vial sitting atop the carved nightstand.

title: [House Brigatta, Banyan Tree]
description: It is noticeably cooler here than in the other parts of the garden.  A huge banyan tree keeps this area in a perpetual gloom.  There are various mosses clinging to the tree, and all the shrubs seem stunted.  A gardener's shed, almost hidden under a dense netting of moss and flowering vines, is nestled close to the western boundary of the garden.  Running along this side of the house are some doors leading into a kitchen, while a back porch can be seen to the south.

title: [House Brigatta, Observatory]
description: Looming under a verdigrised copper dome, a brass telescope features a bewildering array of various iron and mithril wheels, cranks, and pulleys designed to rotate the observatory.  Set high on the walls around a copper panel are intricate charts marking the paths of stars and moons in the night sky.  An armillary sphere dominates the rotunda, which is surrounded with several cabinets and racks.

An armillary sphere dominates the rotunda, which is surrounded with several cabinets and racks.

title: [House Brigatta, Shed]
description: The dirt floor of the shed is packed solid.  Hanging from several hooks on the walls are various tools used to maintain the splendor of the garden.  In one corner are several large sacks that, judging from the smell, contain fertilizer.  On shelves running along two of the walls are many bins containing small packets of seed.  There is a shallow rut from the door that ends at the eastern wall.

title: [Annex, White Haven Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A white velvet pennant edged with icy blue hangs between a heavy, white muslin curtain and an embroidered blue muslin curtain.
Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A white velvet pennant edged with icy blue hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [House Brigatta, Fountain Oasis]
description: A fountain sits in the center surrounded by pie-shaped beds of blossoming flowers with just enough space between them to allow one to wander the gardens.  To the west, a huge banyan tree looms, its overhanging boughs partially enclosing the area to form a quiet bower.  This partially shaded retreat provides a silent place of contemplation, where the only distractions are the quick flicks of motion as birds and honeybees flit from tree to tree, or flower to flower.

title: [House Sovyn, Locker]
description: With the curtain closed behind you, all sound from outside the locker area has been hushed.  The counter is topped with deep green baize which shows little wear.

title: [House Brigatta, Garden Bower]
description: The overhanging boughs of the surrounding trees enclose the area to form a quiet bower.  This shaded retreat provides a silent place of contemplation.  The quick flicks of motion as the birds and bees flit from tree to tree, or flower to flower, are the only distractions.  The only break in the warm embrace of the surroundings is a shaded path to the south.

title: [House Brigatta, Workshop]
description: The walls are slightly burned in spots where someone's apparently amateurish attempts at magic have gone awry.  Dead center in the room is a heavy marble slab scratched and blackened from the powerful spells which have been cast in the room.  The ceiling is covered with polished copper, the mirrored surface reflecting your movements.

title: [House Brigatta, Garden East]
description: The few trees planted here ring two rough-hewn wooden boards with sturdy legs.  Some cleverly trained vines amongst the tree branches form a trellis.  Brigatta members sometimes laze away the hours playing idle games of dice or cards here.

title: [Sylvanfair, Rogal-Keli Hall]
description: The trunk of this enormous tree is hollow, providing the House with a huge hall of living wood.  Natural knotholes and other openings in the trunk allow light to enter the hall, while layers of carefully arranged branches and bright autumn-colored leaves keep out the weather.  Birdsong fills the air, giving the hall a cheerful atmosphere.  A staircase spirals up around the inside of the tree.

Natural knotholes and other openings in the trunk allow moonlight to enter the hall, while layers of carefully arranged branches and bright autumn-colored leaves keep out the weather.  Crickets and other night insects fill the air with their songs, giving the hall a cheerful atmosphere.  A staircase spirals up around the inside of the tree.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west, northwest, out

title: [House Sylvanfair, Treetop]
description: Branches intertwine to form several large benches here, covered with moss and soft pillows.  There's just enough of a breeze to be refreshing, and the songs of the birds and the chattering of the animals that live in the tree provide soft background noise.  One branch, larger than the rest, arches off to the east.  A spiral staircase leads back down into the trunk of the tree, curving around a cunningly carved tangle of branches.

title: [Sylvanfair, Lilac Garden]
description: The air of this walled garden is filled with the heady scent of lilacs from hundreds of bushes.  Several lilac bushes near the main Sylvanfair tree twine together underneath a stairway leading up to a lilac door.  A large ironwood tree stands in the center of the garden, with a door in its side.

title: [Sylvanfair, Grove]
description: Enclosed by Sylvanfair's canopy and the surrounding foliage, this grove maintains a peaceful seclusion despite its lack of walls.  From a hollowed branch above, thin streams of water cascade down into a small pond.  Flat stones peek out just above the water's surface, several of which have been arranged to jut out at the edge as a makeshift dock, while others encircle a small fire pit nearby.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Workroom]
description: A large blackboard forms one wall of this room, held in place by the living wood of the tree.  The rest of the walls are covered with shelves containing various boxes and jars, and no few number of magical experiments in progress.  A large table of slate, stained and pitted, dominates the center of the room.

title: [Sylvanfair, Trophy Hall]
description: Your eyes are drawn to a large display case that looks as if it was formed by natural growth of the great tree's wood.  A colorful tapestry adorns one of the walls in a place of honor.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Library]
description: Smooth branches form huge bookshelves that line the walls of this chamber, filled with tomes and scrolls of all descriptions.  Branches and thick roots offer convenient places to sit, and small tables are available for quiet conversation and study.

title: [Sylvanfair, Sunrea Hall]
description: Sweet scents and curious aromas waft down to you from the drying racks of herbs far overhead.  Mossy benches provide a soft resting place for the ill and wounded, and bundles of warm blankets are stacked against one wall.  A very familiar-looking patient burrows a little deeper under his blanket, obviously quite comfortable.

title: [Sylvanfair, Galadriel's Hall]
description: Several beat-up wooden figures stand in the center of this chamber.  One of them has been dressed in a tattered black cloak and its head lolls drunkenly every time someone's weapon connects with a loud *THWAP* -- amazingly, the head hasn't fallen off yet.  Wooden and metal practice weapons are racked neatly against the walls, along with suits and pieces of stray armor.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Temple]
description: A large altar of rosewood stands near one wall of this small temple.  Niches in the wall display statues of the many gods and goddesses of Elanthia -- all deities seem to be represented, both Light and Dark.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Ballroom]
description: Slender branches arch and twine to form the walls of the ballroom, shutting out the outside while allowing a cooling breeze to enter.  The springy moss that covers the ground begs to be danced upon!  A large window stands open allowing a cool breeze to enter the room and giving access to a large branch outside, and a lilac-twined arch of leafy branches leads deeper into the tree.

title: [Sylvanfair, Orc's Head Bar]
description: The wood of the tree opens into a large gathering area, with dozens of places to sit formed by tree branches and moss-covered stones.  Next to the bar stands a graceful harp, apparently formed of the same wood as the walls.  Hanging on one wall is a polished walnut dart board carved in the image of an owl and off to one side a counter nestles amidst greenery.  The lilac-twined arch leads into the ballroom beyond the bar, and a modwir door leads outside.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Kitchen]
description: Here, just outside the tree, is a small walled-in courtyard where several tables and chairs are sheltered beneath the leafy branches.  Mouthwatering aromas of baked goods and other delights lead the way to a pair of large ovens placed safely far away from the tree trunk.  An elderly halfling woman smiles briefly at you before going back to her baking.

title: [Sylvanfair, Hot Spring]
description: A natural spring bubbles up from the ground here, captured by living wood to form an inviting pool.  It is shallow for several paces on the end nearest the doorway -- then the water deepens quickly.  Several vines hang down over the deeper end of the pool.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Pool]
description: The pool is crystal clear and you can even see the bubbles as they form at the bottom of the spring and drift lazily up to the surface with small popping noises.  The warmth of the water is relaxing, and you are tempted to stay and soak for a while.

title: [Sylvanfair, Meeting Room]
description: High, narrow windows provide light in this chamber without sacrificing privacy.  Couches formed of living wood line the walls, and each one is covered with a cushiony layer of soft leaves.  A bear hide rug covers the entire floor and you wonder how many pelts were sewn together to create it.

title: [Sylvanfair, Short Hallway]
description: This short hallway leads to the private lockers of the House members.  The floor is actually the smooth living wood of the tree, complete with the occasional burl or knothole.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Sylvanfair, Locker Room]
description: Long branches curl protectively around a narrow counter, and glossy leaves almost hide the locker that sits there.  A burl in one of the walls looks eerily like a staring eyeball.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Supply Room]
description: Light filters through the branches making up the walls of the Supply Room, filling it with a warm emerald glow.  Above you branches weave together to form a thick green ceiling covered with gently moving leaves.  Every so often the sound of child-like laughter floats down to you from somewhere above.

Moonlight filters through the branches making up the walls of the Supply Room, filling it with a soft gray glow.  Above you branches weave together to form a thick green ceiling covered with gently moving leaves.  Every so often the sound of child-like laughter floats down to you from somewhere above.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Alcove]
description: The leafy ceiling is low here, which doesn't leave much room to move about.  A thin green curtain leads to a small locker room.

title: [Sylvanfair, Dressing Chamber]
description: This small chamber is decorated with some soothing blue and white tapestries.  Several wind chimes suspended from the branches above fill the room with soft music.  A large footlocker stands beside a comfortable padded chair and an ornate, full-length mirror dominates one wall.

title: [Sylvanfair, Grimdahl's Room]
description: This chamber is contained entirely within the trunk of the great tree.  Several small glowing globes near the ceiling cast a dim light across a comfortable bed that stands in one corner of the room.  A handsome desk in the corner holds a crystal ball, and beside it stands a perch with a stuffed raven on it.

title: [Bowen and Diane's Room]
description: The wall farthest from the door is completely open to the gentle breezes from outside.  Looking closely you see that the wall, made of what appear to be translucent leaves, is shuttered to the side allowing it to be closed in case of bad weather.  The furnishings include a large oak rolltop desk with books and papers scattered over it, and a cozy soft beige couch and antique chairs for company.  The floor is covered with a forest green rug made from puma hides edged with the finest gold thread.

title: [Lady Lissa's Chamber]
description: The warmth of this chamber welcomes you, as the room is engulfed by the sun reaching through the intricately carved openings in the bark walls.  In one corner, a four-posted bed draped with a cockatrice feather comforter invites you to bask in the tranquility of your surroundings.  Below a painting on the opposite wall is an oak desk, covered with scrolls, colorful drawings and maps.  A rug covers the floor near a fireplace in the adjacent corner.

The serenity of this chamber welcomes you, as the room is engulfed by the moonlight reaching through the intricately carved openings in the bark walls.  In one corner, a four-posted bed draped with a cockatrice feather comforter invites you to bask in the tranquility of your surroundings.  Below a painting on the opposite wall is an oak desk, covered with scrolls, colorful drawings and maps.  A rug covers the floor near a fireplace in the adjacent corner.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Firbac's Room]
description: A blaze of sunlight welcomes visitors to this room, streaming in through expansive windows.  The floor is covered with a lush carpet of living grass, giving you thoughts of relaxing for a brief nap.  Growing things spring from every surface and hang from the ceiling.  The air is rich with subtle smells of exotic blossoms, leaving you feeling refreshed and renewed.

A flood of moonlight welcomes visitors to this room, streaming in through expansive windows.  The floor is covered with a lush carpet of living grass, giving you thoughts of relaxing for a brief nap.  Growing things spring from every surface and hang from the ceiling.  The air is rich with subtle smells of exotic blossoms, leaving you feeling refreshed and renewed.

title: [Sylvanfair, Rose Garden]
description: The scent of a hundred different kinds of roses fills the air here.  Bushes and vines grafted into the Sylvanfair tree bear magical blooms of every imaginable color, throughout every season.  A large branch arches off to the west.

title: [Davydd and Kerrithan's Suite]
description: Wide windows framed by twining gold and silver vines fill this room with light and fresh air.  Sweet rushes on the floor perfume the air with subtle fragrance.  A pair of desks -- one perfectly clean, the other cluttered with papers, inkwells, and pens -- stand side by side against one wall, surrounded by shelves lined with books.  A wide, canopied bed stands against the far wall, with an armor stand and weapons rack on one side and a rack containing a variety of musical instruments on the other.

title: [Sylvanfair, Heathyr's Room]
description: These spacious quarters are littered with arcane tomes, artifacts and implements of sorcery.  Centered against the far wall, an elegant round bed is draped by a lavish blanket of fire cat fur, with a dramatic painting hanging on the wall above it.  To the left is a modwir dressing table with an oval mirror mounted in its back and framed by two brass sconces.  A curtained window highlights the wall to the right and piles of books and scrolls are scattered below it.

title: [Sylvanfair, Morning Glory Room]
description: A large window framed by delicately veined morning glory leaves floods the room with light and fresh air.  The walls are covered with carefully cultivated morning glories of delicate violet shades.  A large bed covered with a puma hide blanket beckons from behind a thin ora screen in one corner, and an instrument rack holding a lute and a harp stands against the wall next to a large bookcase.

title: [Sylvanfair, Brutii's Room]
description: Built along branches of living wood, this suite provides a majestic view of the rose garden.  The plush puma hide rug softening your footsteps seems to accent the natural luster of the living wooden walls.  The room is lit by soft flickers of sunshine streaming through a large aquarium that sits next to a window on the south wall.  A grand canopied bed rests in an alcove on the north wall, which contains built-in shelves lined with various small sculptures and mementos of the McThain family.

title: [Sylvanfair, Oakladin Bedroom]
description: You are struck by the stark beauty of this chamber.  The oak walls are covered with beautifully formed ivy that catches the light to form intricate shadows.  Your gaze travels upward to a crescent-shaped leaded crystal window left open to the sky.  An impressive white marble bed rests beneath the skylight, in front of an imposing stone fireplace with a greatsword resting upon the mantle.

title: [Pixies Table]
description: On the polished modwir table stands a lamp made of two dainty silver pixies holding up a candle on their outstretched arms.  The flickering light casts colorful shadows through their stained glass wings.

title: [Tree Nymph Table]
description: A delicate brass lamp in the shape of a nymph changing into a tree stands in the middle of this table.  The lampshade is made of stained glass to resemble the tree's canopy.

title: [Sea Nymph Table]
description: Four stained glass panels surround a flickering candle on this round modwir table.  Two opposing panels depict the ocean, the other two show a nymph emerging from beneath the waves.

title: [Moonstone Butterfly Table]
description: A brass butterfly encrusted with moonstones rests on this modwir table.  A small sweet-scented candle is carefully placed between its colorful stained glass wings.

title: [Water Lily Table]
description: The brass base of this opaque glass lily is shaped into broad leaves.  The small candle inside the lily casts a soft light across the wooden table.

title: [Moot Hall, Orchard]
description: A large garden stretches out beneath the shadow of Moot Hall, where rows and rows of apple trees flourish in abundance.  In the center of the orchard stands a speckled dark grey granite fountain surrounded by hand-carved red oak benches.  Thick stone walls rise up behind the building, shielding the area from the rest of the town, and a carved wooden door leads back inside.

title: [Moot Hall, North Corridor]
description: The northern corridor of Moot Hall is quiet, with every little footstep muffled by the rich merlot carpet.  A silver-threaded tapestry depicting the shimmering water and cloudy skies of Darkstone Bay hangs on a wall near a carved wooden door.

title: [Fancy Modwir Table]
description: The polished surface of the modwir table reflects the warm light from the fireplace.  A fancy gold ivy leaf design has been carefully painted along the edge of the table and down the pedestal.

title: [Carved Tanik Table]
description: The pedestal of this beautiful tanik table resembles a tree trunk carved with vines and leaves.  The table surface is covered with intricate carvings of fauna commonly found in Elanthia.

title: [Moot Hall, Wedding Hall]
description: Lots of big, square windows give this room an open, airy feel, and let in a large amount of light.  Branches and flowers are draped over the windows, and piled around the plain wooden altar opposite the carved door.  Dozens of chairs sit in rows across the floor, with a long narrow table to one side.  On the wall above the altar hangs a double silhouette, a man's face on one side and a woman's on the other, each carved of dark wood and polished brightly.

title: [Elegant Maoral Table]
description: The dark maoral table is inlaid with a lighter tone of felwood in an elegant geometric design.  The surrounding chairs are made of the same dark maoral and are upholstered with red velvet.

title: [Sturdy Haon Table]
description: This thick table is constructed of solid haon wood with a rosewood finish.  The surrounding chairs are upholstered in burgundy leather with gold stud accents.

title: [Tiled Thanot Table]
description: Several chairs are casually scattered around this stained thanot wood table.  The tabletop is inlaid with light and dark polished glaes tiles.

title: [Black Swan Hassle, Field]
description: An open grassy field has been painted in panorama upon the walls of the wagon's front section.  Rendered along the perimeter are the blue-grey waters of a wide moat, with small hummocks in the background and a distant, dark forest.  A threadbare curtain embroidered with a ruined drawbridge hangs to the north.

title: [Green Henna and Eggs]
description: Four, shiny green walls enclose this small shop, which holds the heavy, thick scent of fresh paint.  Customers browsing the shop occasionally break into a fit of coughs when they get too close to one of the walls.  A green duck-shaped shelf has been nailed above a woven basket, filled with eggs and twigs.  Near the shop's exit, the painted green door has been recently splattered with yolk.

title: [The Eternal Encounter]
description: Giant, silvery cobwebs hang from the corners of this dark shop, as tiny glowing spiders weave more silk along the walls.  Stained, wooden shelves line one entire length of the shop, their surfaces cluttered with an assortment of detailed miniatures.  A wide lacquered sign hangs near a curved wooden doorway.

title: [The Eternal Encounter, Workshop]
description: Small silver, gargoyle-shaped sconces hang from the walls of the workshop, the angle of their light illuminating only the center of the room.  Among the light rests a sturdy oak worktable and a bin full of tiny broken miniatures.

title: [Linen or Leather]
description: Battered wooden boards line the floor of the wagon, covered in part by a mud-spattered green rug.  A sturdy monir rack hangs along one wall, while a dark mahogany wardrobe and a stained oak cabinet sit against the opposite wall.  A dented bronze hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [Animal Hides of Fury]
description: Trophies of the hunt hang in every available space on the four walls, making the large wagon seem small and cramped.  Tanned hides pile high on a central oak table.  Above the table, tools of the tanner's trade hang within easy reach.

Trophies of the hunt hang in every available space on the four walls, making the large wagon seem small and cramped.  Tanned hides are piled high on a central oak table.  Above the table, tools of the tanner's trade hang within easy reach.

title: [Something New]
description: A wide, plaited blue wool rug sits at the entrance to this expansive wagon.  A boldly painted sign declares the merger of the two stores, detailed with gleaming gold wedding rings at the bottom.  To the east, a decidedly feminine room holds glass wares.  The faint scent of metal travels in from the west.

title: [Picked Apart]
description: The faint odors of alcohol and decay linger in this ramshackle space. The walls are covered with mounted heads and antlers, and on one counter an antlered rabbit rears on its hind legs.  Next to the odd rabbit is a small crate. A battered chest is tucked under the counter.

title: [Ladies of the Night]
description: Large swaths of silk frame the interior of the circular tent in the mottled hues of the night.  From the high center, a chandelier of black sapphires glistens brightly.  In one corner, a raven-haired mannequin lounges casually against the wall.  Opposite the mannequin, a life-size silver wire figurine assumes a pose of feigned surprise.  In the center of the room, a slender doll woven from willow branches lies supine in a bed of colorful pillows.

title: [Forest Path]
description: The pathway is cut off by a copse of wyrmwood trees, preventing further travel through the dense thicket.  An earth-bermed pawnshop stands among the woods, the moonlight radiating off the will-o'-wisps fluttering before the structure.

The pathway is cut off by a copse of wyrmwood trees, preventing further travel through the dense thicket.  An earth-bermed pawnshop stands among the woods, the warm sunlight cutting through the vegetation to bake the ground just before the structure.

title: [Once A Pawn A Time]
description: Tightly packed earth held in place by rusted wire meshwork makes up the bottom of the walls, while the upper portions are composed of blocks of limestone that jut up into a brush-woven ceiling.  Several swamp goblins argue unceasingly as they rummage around behind a huge slab of limestone that serves as a counter.  Nearly obscured by the mud and filth caked on its surface and set behind a squat limestone barrel, a stiff curtain hangs from several crooked hooks.

title: [Once A Pawn A Time, Backroom]
description: Strong scents of peat and decay suffuse the small room, which is dimly lit by candles suspended between a handful of gaps in the ceiling.  Arranged in orderly fashion are four tables stocked with armor, weapons, arcane items, and other treasures.  Leaning against one of the earthen and limestone walls is a swamp goblin sales clerk, his gaze constantly shifting between the merchandise and a stiff curtain.

Strong scents of peat and decay suffuse the small room, which is dimly lit by sunlight filtering through a handful of gaps in the ceiling.  Arranged in orderly fashion are four tables stocked with armor, weapons, arcane items, and other treasures.  Leaning against one of the earthen and limestone walls is a swamp goblin sales clerk, his gaze constantly shifting between the merchandise and a stiff curtain.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Diseased Banyan]
description: Dim moonlight shines down, filtering through the shrivelled, broken stumps of limbs overhead.  Patches of shadow mingle and shift over small tracts of dying, diseased foliage that creep outward from the enormous blight-encroached banyan in vein-like tendrils.  Branches that once reached high into the sky now lay fallen and twisted among rotting heaps of debris at the base of the massive trunk, a startling contrast to the brightly colored flags that ring the diseased banyan.

Patches of shadow mingle and shift over small tracts of dying, diseased foliage that creep outward from the enormous blight-encroached banyan in vein-like tendrils. paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [All Things Fragile]
description: This corner of the wagon has been obviously graced by a woman's touch.  Gleaming, flora-scene pierced screens square to create a separate area within the large wagon.  Ecru lace curtains frame the wooden windows, and a woven tapestry rug sits in the center of the room.  A large wildflower bouquet lends a light fragrance to the air.

title: [Sacred Moons]
description: Dangling from the ceiling on a silver link chain, a white marble moon with diminutive star-shaped cutouts spins lazily.  The warm light from a lit candle placed inside the spinning sphere creates tiny stars that twinkle across the wagon's dark wooden walls.  A glass display case rests against one wall, and a circular archway has been cut into the back of the wagon.

title: [Delightful Diversions]
description: This room has been decorated in bright, vivid colors.  The corrugated walls create variegated stripes, down which are painted some tiny gumdrops, lollipops, and lots of bright jelly beans.  An bent iron chandelier hangs from the center of the ceiling, covered with the wax of dozens of multicolored candles.  A large toy chest sits against one wall beneath a stick figure drawing.  Near a splotchy dented door is a small round table on which sits an enormous candy dish and beneath which stands a red wicker basket.  A tall bookshelf supports containers of many shapes and sizes.
