title: [The Halfway Midway]
[The Halfway Midway, Pop It]
description: Dark foliage gives a tunnel-like feeling to the plank-lined pathway, though it is several degrees less dense to the southeast than it is to the northwest.  Rising on the air is the pleasant aroma of roasting meats and the sweet scent of confections.  Two oaks create an arch that leads away from the midway toward the misty shores of Feywrot Mire.

Dark foliage gives a tunnel-like feeling to the plank-lined pathway.  Rows of brightly colored inflated orbs have been tacked to a board placed just off the plank walkway.  A pile of sharp metal darts lies on a single raised plank that has been laid across two stumps to form a makeshift counter, while a dirty huckster lounges nearby.  Rising on the air is the pleasant aroma of roasting meats and the sweet scent of confections.  Two oaks create an arch that leads away from the midway toward the misty shores of Feywrot Mire.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Two-Faced]
description: Pristinely white walls make up the wagon's interior, and both the wooden ceiling and plushly carpeted floor are the same clean white color.  Hanging lanterns shaped like round globes flush bright candlelight around the area, illuminating a white door that nearly blends into the walls.  The only hint of color in the interior is in the masks hanging on hooks and crooks around the wall.

title: [Two-Faced, Niche]
description: Small globes of glass hang from the ceiling, the candles within them shedding bright light around the surroundings.  Some areas of the white walls are draped with bright red silks and pitch black satins, the fabrics occasionally woven together where they cross over one another.  A plush white rug spreads out beneath several cushioned chairs and a glass table.  The table seems to magnify the sizable dark red stain and nearby spatters, reminiscent of a spray of dried blood, on the carpet below it.

title: [I Do Eclair!, Front Counter]
description: Beneath a dusty banner stretched across the room, a set of glass display cases stand opposite a tall curio cabinet on rotting cypress floors that have been hastily whitewashed.  A row of hooks adorns the otherwise bare wall behind a long counter with tall hardwood stools clustered in front of it.

title: [I Do Eclair!, Back of Counter]
description: Empty plates and cups, most of them clean, are stacked on shelves beneath the counter.  Neatly labeled boxes and sacks of supplies are arranged on a wooden rack at the far end of the counter.  A bowl of milk, a blanket-filled wicker basket and a tangled ball of yarn occupy the farthest corner.

title: [Halfway Midway, Rolton Tails]
description: Oak planks lead to and from the small clearing, which has a firm ground covered with yellow and green moss.  Purple-edged canvas of faded blue is stretched between two banyan trees to create a protective awning, beneath which an unshaven huckster presides over a basket of rolton tails.  Anchored to a third tree is a cutout of a painted wooden rolton that has a painted black star where its tail should be.

title: [The Widow Hut]
description: Beams of sunlight stream in through large cracks in the shanty's crooked, rough planked walls, providing just enough light to see thick swathes of cobwebs hanging from nearly everything in sight.  Long strands of webbing hang down the side walls that are tied to rusty iron hooks from which dangle what appear to be crude wares.  A crooked planked door can been seen in the shadows of the back wall.

title: [The Widow Hut, Backroom]
description: The space is cramped and dark, with only a crude pad on the ground and a pile of refuse in the corner.  The air hangs thick with a musky stench, and crude symbols have been carved into the wooden slats of the hut, just visible behind swathes of cobwebs.

title: [The Evening's Heiress, Barroom]
description: Brass lanterns line the stone walls casting a dim light through the barroom.  Stale cigar smoke lingers in the air, mixing with the scent of strong spirits.  A polished oak bar runs the length of the room, offering a few refreshments to weary travelers.  Behind the bar hangs a thick burgundy velvet curtain that covers the doorway to a backroom.

title: [The Evening's Heiress, Backroom]
description: Crowding this small space are stacks of grimy crates and barrels that emanate an overwhelming odor of alcohol into the room.  Hidden among the crates sits a lustrous black leather couch, an obvious new addition based on the lack of dust.  A thick burgundy velvet curtain provides the only egress into the barroom.

title: [The Evening's Heiress, Dressing]
description: Empty liquor bottles have been strewn across the plank floor, a few of which have rolled underneath a sturdy oak wardrobe.  Along one wall sits a long oak bench that is cluttered with kohl sticks, powder vials, and a few pieces of clothing.  Heady perfumes have permeated the paneling of the room creating a flowery smell throughout the dressing room.  The sound of clinking glasses drifts up a flight of wooden stairs from the barroom below.

Empty liquor bottles have been strewn across the plank floor, a few of which have rolled underneath a sturdy oak wardrobe.  Along one wall a line of metal hooks have been secured above a long oak bench that is cluttered with kohl sticks, powder vials, and a few pieces of clothing.  Heady perfumes have permeated the paneling of the room creating a flowery smell throughout the dressing room.  The sound of clinking glasses drifts up a flight of wooden stairs from the barroom below.

title: [A Leg Up]
description: Hole-ridden and mud-stained carpeting spans from wall to wall, and the greyed floorboards beneath peek through the myriad of frayed openings.  The walls, likewise in a state of disrepair, must once have been a rich burgundy, but are now a washed-out hue that barely falls into the red family.  Here and there, scattered everywhere from the tabletops to the couch, are disembodied mannequin parts.  Eyeless heads stare out from the mantle, while limbless torsos rest propped in corners.

title: [A Leg Up]
description: The shabby staircase exits onto a long, narrow platform that is framed between a feeble, broken railing and mannequin foot-mounted wall.  Protruding into the walkway, the feet force travel to the far side of the hallway - the side which supplies a straight-down, stomach-dropping view over the railing of the lower floor of the shop.  Opposite the staircase, on the other end of the hall, is an archway leading further into the shop.

title: [Bits and Pieces]
description: A deep, smoldering fire pit at the center of the tent fills the air with an arid scent and an almost overwhelming warmth.  As its dying embers provide only minimal illumination, candles on crude wooden holders have been selectively placed at each display.  Overhead, lengths of sturdy twine have been strung, supporting a variety of dried or drying body parts, some more readily identifiable than others.   Underfoot, old and decaying boards crisscross the spongy-wet ground to create a passable walking space.

title: [The Halfway Midway]
description: Discarded food wrappers mingle with the muddy underbrush that flanks the narrow oak-planked passage.  Hawkers and hucksters can be heard, their distant cries of wares and games echoing off of the stagnant pools of water that flank the walkway.  Crickets and cicadas add their own chorus to that of the bipeds, the odd buzzing a strange counterpoint to the atmosphere of the midway.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [The Halfway Midway]
description: Stretching in several directions, several wooden planks are laid upon the ground to provide safe passage through the muck and mire.  Silver ribbons adorned with bells are tied to the low limbs of the surrounding trees, their slightly dented faces glint in the moonlight.

Stretching in several directions, several wooden planks are laid upon the ground to provide safe passage through the muck and mire.  Silver ribbons adorned with bells are tied to the low limbs of the surrounding trees, their slightly dented faces gleaming in the sunlight.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest, out

title: [Nanjir Business]
description: Ever-accumulating layers of thick moss from the surrounding foliage drapes over the edges of the mahogany roofing of this hastily constructed booth.  Long, vibrant silk tapestries with floral patterns of green, orange, and pink hang in billowing layers behind a half-sized stained cherry wardrobe and a polished rosewood bureau.  On the counter at the center of the booth rests a velvet-lined oak display case.

title: [The Halfway Midway, Mud Dippin']
description: Round pools of stagnant water are bridged by thick oak planks, which are nearly as wide as the puddles themselves.  Twisted vines and young saplings have been braided together with colorful ribbons to create a decorative railing to either side of the walkway.  A small dirty boy stands near a pile of mud-covered pails, his bare feet playing in a large puddle of mud that flows around the base of an iron water pump.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [The Halfway Midway]
description: Thick planks of oak, each speckled with their fair share of mud and grime, stretch across the spongy soft ground to provide a sturdy pathway through the ferns, duckweed, and muck.  Faded purple lettering decorates a sun-whitened blue banner that has been stretched over the pathway and is anchored to a pair of spreading oaks on either side.  Hammered into the soft ground, a lone sign decorated with gold paint is attached to a ribbon-wrapped post.

title: [Halfway Midway, Pig Wrasslin]
description: Young banyan trees mingle with spruce to create a melded backdrop of molten browns and greens, while their intertwined limbs create a tight canopy that provides protection from the elements.  A pig wrangler stands with arms crossed watching some greased pigs corralled behind a chain-link fence.

title: [Halfway Midway, The Ball Toss]
description: Surrounded by tangled vines and leafy ferns, a small stall occupies the clearing, its smooth expanse covered with a pyramid of murky white glass milk bottles.  A mustachioed huckster paces between the stall and a pile of brick-colored balls, which has been arranged upon the ground near the planks that lead to the main concourse.

title: [Halfway Midway, The Granary]
description: Nestled amid the foliage, and almost overrun by it, a small granary lists to one side and is topped with a thick thatch roof.  Oak planks lead from the main concourse directly to its entry, which is devoid of a door.  Gales of childish laughter echo through the area.

title: [Halfway Midway, Something Sweet]
description: Rising out of the waters of the mire, a small wooden platform claims this section of the midway as its home.  Moving between two painted stalls, a wide-eyed young girl attempts to hawk her wares to the passersby.  The sweet scent of sticky confections is incredibly heavy in the air.

title: [The Halfway Midway]
[The Halfway Midway, Token It Up]
[Halfway Midway, A Token Gesture]
description: Sparse foliage rises to either side of the thick oak planks that are laid upon the soggy ground.  Though devoid of trees, small bushes, decorated with baubles and bells, share their verdant hues with the mostly yellow landscape and thick grasses near the southern edge of the plank walkway stand up straight in the mud.  A wooden fence to the northeast blocks access to a slowly revolving carousel, but the haunting out-of-tune melody is inescapable.

Sparse foliage rises to either side of the thick oak planks that are laid upon the soggy ground.  A dirty elven boy slouches against a large box, and a pile of wooden tokens occupies a bucket sitting next to a large wooden frame.  Small bushes, decorated with baubles and bells, occupy the area around the frame, and share their verdant hues with the yellow landscape and thick grasses near the plank walkway.  A wooden fence to the northeast blocks access to a slowly revolving carousel, but the haunting out-of-tune melody is inescapable.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Halfway Midway, Eating Platform]
description: Thick planks of dusky oak create a sturdy platform that stretches across the clearing and protects guests from the sucking mud of the mire.  Colorful streams stretch through the thick boughs of the surrounding banyans, while colorful awnings provide a bit of shelter from the elements along the eastern edges.  Several tables and benches provide a common area for folks to gather and share the various foods offered by the local venders.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Halfway Midway, The Duck Bob]
description: Sheltered by the broad, leaf-laden limbs of an ancient oak, the small clearing is covered with thick blades of grass.  Several large bricks support an enormous wooden tub that is filled with water and wooden ducks.  Lounging nearby, a freckled young boy watches over the floating avian collection and randomly swats at some mischievous mosquitoes.

title: [The Halfway Midway]
description: Remarkably dry compared to the surrounding mire, the planks are almost not needed in this small grassy clearing.  Though no trees or bushes occupy the space, tents and stalls have been set-up and arranged in such a fashion to resemble a squatter's town.  Clotheslines and cook fires are prevalent near every entry, yet despite the domestic appearance, some stalls have been turned towards the walkway and offer various wares for purchase.  Amid the clearing, a hefty dwarf stands within a field of bright orange pumpkins.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Halfway Midway, The Old Stall]
description: Partially obscured by an azure canvas, an old ramshackle stall lies in disrepair upon the ground amid the low scrubs and creeper vines.  Planks which have rotted, some darkened and fire damaged, are neatly piled to one side of the ruins, while the other side has fresher looking pieces of timber and smoothed planks.  Stakes, which are now mostly concealed in the ground, mark where new construction might have been planned, but the overgrown grass covering the area tells those looking that a different tale unfolded.

title: [The Halfway Midway]
description: Towering wyrmwood trees rise to the southeast, but discontinue their progress to the east at the edge of plank-lined walkway.  Small bushes take up every available space in the absence of the colossal beauties, their tightly packed limbs no less verdant than their taller cousins.  The sound of laughter and the scent of roasting meats rises on the air, its source unknown.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Halfway Midway, Small Clearing]
description: Hemp rope marks the perimeter of this small clearing, while thick strands of duckweed float on a somewhat obscured water course.  Blankets of yellow-headed moss grow upon shale slabs that are partially buried into the soft ground and short tufts of grass grow everywhere else.  To the southwest, the dark shadow of wyrmwood trees gives the landscape a gloomy cast.  A tall lanky fellow stands beside a tray of assorted knives resting atop a few stacked crates and an open-lidded red wooden barrel.

title: [The Halfway Midway]
description: Stretched between two wyrmwood trees, a large banner of faded blue is painted with dark purple letters, while beneath is a small pathway of oak planks that leads through the grove.  Tall bushes clog the passage between the trees making it impossible to stray from the path.

title: [Forest Path]
description: Thick brush circles around a tall black willow, its branches draping over the entire area.  A pathway leading toward the east cuts through the dense foliage -- festival streamers and ribbons marring the peat moss that covers the ground.

title: [Halfway Midway, Wyrmwood Strand]
[Halfway Midway, Rock 'N Roll]
description: Tall strands of wyrmwood trees rise along the southern edge of the small clearing, their distant tops shrouded in creeper vines and a crown of verdant leaves.  Round boulders, mostly buried into the soft soil, rise across the landscape to create an uneven ground that is devoid of growth.  Wisps of mist rise from the shadowed surroundings, their ethereal tendrils cold and moist.

Tall strands of wyrmwood trees rise along the southern edge of the small clearing, their distant tops shrouded in creeper vines and a crown of verdant leaves.  An adolescent gnomish boy lounges atop one of the many large, round boulders, which are mostly buried in the soft soil and rise across the landscape to create an uneven ground that is devoid of growth.  Wisps of cold mist rise from the shadowed surroundings, their ethereal tendrils nearly concealing a pile of fist-sized rocks sitting near a plank ramp.

title: [Halfway Midway, Lost Baubles]
description: Discarded bottles and lost baubles decorate the tangled bushes that line the edge of the clearing, their smooth or rough edges catching enough of the ambient light to cause it to reflect through the canopy above.  Thick clusters of fuzzy green moss occupy most of the ground, though the western edge is decorated with scattered groupings of grass and wheat.  A pair of oak planks head toward the midway, its edges caked with mud.

Discarded bottles and lost baubles decorate the tangled bushes that line the edge of the clearing and hold court around their glassy lord.  The assortment of trinkets and glass is arrayed around an enruned shadowglass obelisk in an almost reverent display, their smooth or rough edges catching enough of the ambient light to cause it to reflect through the canopy above.  Thick clusters of fuzzy green moss occupy most of the ground, though the western edge is decorated with scattered groupings of grass and wheat.

title: [Halfway Midway, Boulders]
description: Long blades of grass rise from between the oak planks of the walkway that leads back to the midway, their edges thick with seeds.  Low clusters of brambles create a knotted fence around the perimeter of the clearing, while dangling vines weave through the canopy above.  Several large boulders are arranged according to size beneath the watchful gaze of a beribboned oak post.

title: [Halfway Midway, Ale of Beauty]
description: Stretched between two beastly oaks, a striped awning of purple and blue provides shelter for an ale-shaped wooden stall that is painted with a tiny man perched upon an ale keg.  A buxom beauty works behind the stall, her large eyes almost as big as her other attributes.

title: [Halfway Midway, Roasting Pits]
description: Surrounded by verdant greenery, the small clearing is devoid of grass and has a crackling cook fire set within a ring of stones at its heart.  Several burly men attend to the fire, their chests and faces glistening with sweat.  A dressed and spiced roasting velnalin slowly turns on a spit over the fire, its gristle popping noisily as it drips into the flames.

title: [Halfway Midway, High Striker]
description: Towering above the surrounding foliage, and reaching almost the height of a nearby banyan tree, is a tall bell-topped pole marked incrementally in black paint.  Smaller posts surrounding it are decorated with either black ribbons for failures or the blue ribbons of prize winners, their ends trailing to the muddy ground.  A large wooden-hafted mallet rests against the pole, with a burly muscular huckster looking on.

title: [Halfway Midway, Catfish Noodlin]
description: Arching vines dangle from the high limbs of the nearby banyan trees, their lengths laden with yellow moss.  Stretching beyond the simple plank walkway is a dark murky pool, its distant shores lost in haze and mist.  Sitting upon a rhimar chest, a young boy gazes intently into the cloudy depths with his back to a hastily scratched wood sign.

title: [Nocking Point]
description: Long, slender lengths of split willow rise and bow inward to form the subtly peaked frame of this small hut, their arrangement particularly suited to for flexibility and durability.  Overlying the structure, bundles of rushes and leaves have been thatched together to form the exterior, and the materials lend a clean, green note to the air.  Perfect spheres of frosted glass dangle from cords of rope draped from the supports, emanating a warm light that falls over the wares and surroundings.

title: [Cats of Poor Disposition]
description: Warped modwir boards, which form the walls of this rickety old shack, bend and crack eerily.  Freshly disturbed, packed brownish-red dirt forms an uneven, makeshift flooring.  A pile of torn fabric rests in the far corner of the shack, a piece of which somewhat resembles the face of a smiling feline.

title: [Tie Me Up, Showroom]
description: Bolts of fine red velvet have been hung from each corner of this shop, their material flowing haphazardly down onto the floor.  The scent of freshly tanned leather assaults your senses as piles of inventory are neatly arranged behind their various displays.  Along the far left wall, sits a lacquered fireleaf stand, and along the far right wall, sits a gnarled haon display table.  Closer to the entry way resides a large ebonwood stand and an velvet-lined display table.

Bolts of fine red velvet have been hung from each corner of this shop, their material flowing haphazardly down onto the floor.  The scent of freshly tanned leather assaults your senses as piles of inventory are neatly arranged behind their various displays.  Along the far left wall, sits a large ebonwood rack, and along the far right wall, sits a velvet-draped display counter.  Closer to the entry way resides a large ebonwood stand and an velvet-lined display table.

title: [At Face Value]
description: Vibrant patchwork curtains adorn the single window, the sill lined with little miniatures of different towns that glisten in the moonlight.  A ramshackle case is pushed along one side, the wares within neatly arranged despite the chaos of the room.  A small table sits in the center of the room, topped with mirrors of different sizes and shapes.  A well-used travel trunk sits on the floor near a a purple patchwork partition.

Vibrant patchwork curtains adorn the single window, the sill lined with little miniatures of different towns that glisten in the sunlight.  A ramshackle case is pushed along one side, the wares within neatly arranged despite the chaos of the room.  A small table sits in the center of the room, topped with mirrors of different sizes and shapes.  A well-used travel trunk sits on the floor near a a purple patchwork partition.

title: [At Face Value, Workshop]
description: Mirrors line the back wall of this small room, arranged in a circular pattern around a brightly painted sign.  A shelf displaying different beard trimming implements rests above a scarred wooden table that sits in one corner.  Some patchwork pillows have been strewn about the floor, the vibrant colors brightening up the space.

title: [My Mummy's Boudoir, Parlour]
description: Soft, cream-colored carpets cover polished floors beneath opposing velvet settees near the entry.  The curtains are drawn over shuttered windows, the only light flickering from tiny candles set within a large candelabra resting on a rosewood dressing table placed in front of a filigree mirror.  On the far wall, a pale linden armoire detailed with floral-patterned cloisonne stands open, partially concealing an opening leading further into the wagon.

title: [My Mummy's Boudoir, Wardrobe]
description: A lacquered rosewood wardrobe and matching glass-topped bureau stand sentinel at the opening to this dressing room.  The walls are covered with mirrors in all shapes and sizes reflecting the candlelight illuminating from glass globes strung from the ceiling on gilded chains.  A velvet-cushioned chaise lounge reclines in one corner next to a cream leather trunk with gold hardware.

title: [The Finest Hour]
description: Walls of silk bank this large tent, the inside well-appointed despite the temporary nature of the space.  Thick plush carpet covers the floor, the chocolate tones a perfect contrast to the vibrant hues of the walls.  A curving bronze chandelier is hung from the main tent pole, each sinuous branch lined with small tapered candles.  Sheer organza curtains partition the other areas of the large tent, and a crystal-beaded silk curtain leads into a small alcove.

title: [The Finest Hour, Alcove]
description: Quilted silk lines the walls of this small, intimate alcove, the colors pale in contrast to the vibrancy seen throughout the main part of the tent.  A button-tufted champagne silk settee rests in the center of the room, holding court atop a small raised dais.  A table sits nearby, a padded satin sewing basket resting on top of it.

title: [All That Glitters]
description: Rough wooden walls with knotty holes make up this small cramped wagon.  The inside is devoid of decoration, save a tiny window with crystal-beaded curtains.  A rusty-hinged travel trunk sits on the floor, near a beat-up wooden table that is using a stack of books to make up for the missing leg.

title: [Muck o' the Mire]
description: The canvas walls of the wagon have been waterproofed by painstaking oiling, though they also hold in the dank, humid air.  The floor is formed by a huge rectangular box filled with about two feet of gooey mud.  Shelves and hooks hang suspended from the roof supports, bearing the shop's wares.  The legs of a a sturdy wooden table stained with water rings are stuck deep in the mud near the side of the room, and a canvas tarpaulin leads to the rear of the wagon.

The floor is formed by a huge rectangular box filled with about two feet of gooey mud.  Shelves and hooks hang suspended from the roof supports, bearing the shop's wares.  The legs of a a sturdy wooden table stained with water rings are stuck deep in the mud near a narrow closet door, and a canvas tarpaulin leads to the rear of the wagon.

title: [Back o' the Muck]
description: The cramped, stuffy section of the wagon contains nothing except the mud on the floor and a few stools, their legs stuck in the muck so as not to fall over.  A mud-stained canvas tarpaulin leads toward the front and what should be fresher air.

title: [Zombie Snack Shack]
description: Charred planks provide the backdrop beneath the ribbons of swamp vines, which reach through the gaps peppering the walls that surround this small area.  Items are displayed haphazardly among the vines on the walls, as if they were odd artworks of the demented.  A few stools sit upon a tapestry rug spread out over the sandy ground.  Sitting unobtrusively upon one of the stools in the corner is a painted zombie gnome.

title: [Tied In Knots]
description: Shades of black, white, and grey dominate the modest wagon, giving it a tastefully elegant achromatic scheme, from the tall fel walls to the pallid marble flooring.  A pale ivory cedar bureau is paired with contrasting carved ebony shelves, mirroring an identical arrangement between an onyx-hued walnut chest and a niveous mistwood cabinet.  As an inviting touch, a lush spray of slender alabaster calla lilies in a crystalline vase is displayed on a glass-topped case at the front of the room.

title: [Booze and Brews, Mud]
description: Hanging from the ceiling is a dimly lit chandelier, which casts flickering light and long shadows over the area.  Lining the two opposing dark-paneled walls of this long, narrow space are a series of narrow haon shelves, while a multitiered glass-fronted case takes up the entire far wall.

title: [Kluttered Kingdom, Playroom]
description: The temperature inside the cramped wagon is hot enough to make the knotty pine walls sweat.  A faint scent of mildew clings to a pair of run-down seats that are pushed against the wagon walls.  Scattered across the deteriorating floor is a mess of defective crates, which creates a hazard to anyone trying to traverse this tiny space.

title: [On the Lighter Side]
description: Lengths of velvet hanging from the support beams above separate the large pavilion into several sections.  A make-shift floor of modwir tiles covers the ground creating an elegant patterned floor.  Large window openings in the walls allow sunlight in to brighten the area.  Draped in ivory silk, a large archway is flanked by a pair of tables.

Lengths of velvet hanging from the support beams above separate the large pavilion into several sections.  A make-shift floor of modwir tiles covers the ground, creating an elegant patterned floor.  Large window openings in the walls allow moonlight in to brighten the area.  Draped in ivory silk, a large archway is flanked by a pair of tables.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, northwest, out

title: [On the Lighter Side]
description: Lengths of gold, alabaster, and crimson silk wrap about the modwir poles that support the heavy ivory velvet of the pavilion ceiling.  A threesome of mannequins stand centered upon a thick carpet of exotic animal skins.  Standing to one side are a large mirror and several cushioned benches to assist customers in trying on and admiring the shop's extensive stock.

title: [On the Lighter Side]
description: Supported by tall modwir poles, the pale velvet of the pavilion drapes to the floor in soft waves.  Rich silk winds about each brace in rich ivory, crimson, and golden twists that are illuminated by a crystal lantern hung from a slender chain.  Thick animal skins give soft cushion to the hard floor and an area to display a group of mannequins.

title: [Time Will Tell, Accessories]
description: Mounted along each wall are gears, cogs, and dials of various shapes and sizes.  A row of ornate wooden houses dominates the upper half of the far wall forming zigzag-lines of large and small rooftops and dangling chained weights.  The center of the room is overtaken by a large cog turned on its side; the spaces between the teeth are easily large enough to accommodate even the stoutest dwarf.  Within the center of the cog is a large glass-covered dome.  A perfectly round wooden door leads to the next room.

title: [Time Will Tell, Workshop]
description: A long narrow workbench takes up the length of the room.  Tiny springs, gears, and cogs litter the visible workspace, while other areas are tented with velvet cloth.  A solitary clock is mounted near the door, and an empty coat hook below it.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.

title: [Face Off]
description: This small space is occupied by a simple overturned wooden crate next to a makeshift worktable.  A large lantern hangs from the ceiling to illuminate the room.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.

title: [Points to Death, Showroom]
description: A damp, musty smell seems to fill every corner of this little shack.  Dust motes drift and swirl in rays of moonlight that pierce the multitude of gaps between the warped wooden slats that comprise the walls and ceiling.  Floorboards creak and groan ominously, as if threatening to give way under the slightest strain.  With the exception of a deteriorating display case in one corner and a small door in the rear wall, the room is bare.

title: [Points to Death, Closet]
description: Very little light penetrates this dank, cramped storage closet.  Spare blades and handles for small weapons lay discarded on warped, mildew-covered shelves that cling precariously to the back wall.  Broken handles and rusty blades litter the dirty, moldy floorboards.

title: [Of Winged Things]
description: In an effort to keep the boggy surroundings at bay, planks of wood overlay the soggy ground and provide a mostly stable walking surface.  Pale blue-shaded lanterns hang at regular intervals along the support beams overhead, the flames behind the glass flickering fitfully from time to time.  Standing guard at either side of this area is a feminine blue aelotoi mannequin and a masculine grey aelotoi mannequin, while near the opening that leads further into the tent is a tiered oak jewelry display tucked to one side.

title: [The Spider's Ilk]
description: Hundreds of spiders are embroidered onto the dark fabric of the tent's interior.  A thin web of silver thread is woven through the entirety of spidersilk overhead.  Cobwebs hang between the modwir tent poles, and mummified insects cover the ground.

title: [A Fine Line Between]
description: Arcing above, a massive dome covers the central chamber of the tent, its height held aloft by large poles of polished ironwood.  Bronze lanterns with etched panes hang from each post.  The tent walls ripple as the dark velvet is caught by a light wind from outside.  Built between two of the supports is an oblong table covered with a length of black silk.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, out

title: [The Blackshire Emporium]
description: Black tallow candles on scrollwork iron sconces flank the entry, casting a tainted light across the interior of the wagon.  The matte dark purple walls, painted with glossy thin ebon stripes, reach from the black carpeted floor to the matching ceiling that arches overhead.  Small ebonwood shelves line the walls, their surfaces strewn with oddities and knick knacks.  An iron scrollwork table and chairs sits near the eastward passage, laden with refreshments to beckon shoppers further inside.

title: [It's The Thought That Counts]
description: A pair of elaborate bronze braziers flank the entry of the tent, illuminating the interior with a soft glow.  Threads of smoke drift upward from censers placed along the floor.  The right side of the tent is embroidered in numerous Liabo symbols leading towards a polished white marble altar, while the left side is adorned with Lornon symbols around a polished black marble altar.

title: [Beyond the Pale]
description: Strands of white, black, and grey chiffon have been draped across decorative silver hooks placed along the upper edges of the structure.  Rectanglar slats of polished oak are set into the floor in an exquisite chevron pattern, and pale ash shelves line the interior walls.  A dark mahogany armoire with elaborate carvings is filled with pale-colored ensembles, and a faint scent of lavender and coconut drifts through the room.

title: [Ancient Defenses]
description: A crooked, winding swath of blue paint cuts diagonally across the wooden floor like a river, dividing the room in half.  Above the blue paint, the room is decorated in dark hues resembling dead wood, while below the hues are light and green like a vibrant forest.  Two small fountains bubble in opposing corners of the room, while an odd pedestal table sits just off the center of the room.

title: [Linen or Leather, Storeroom]
description: Stacks of wooden boxes and crates line the walls and fill up most of the space in this cramped storage area.  One corner remains vacant, save for a lumpy padded cot and a cushioned bench sitting perpendicular to each other.  A tarnished brass lamp hangs on the wall barely a foot above the cot.

title: [The Imperial Mark]
description: A thick oak pole in the center of the pavilion, adorned with a series of hooks, supports the silken canopy overhead.  A large fel table runs the length of the northern wall, while a rough maoral rack stands at the eastern wall.   Along the southern wall rests a varnished beech display, with a polished oak stand by the western wall.

title: [Instrumentality]
description: Swathes of striped linen partition the interior into several sections grouped by wares.  While the shop is slightly cramped, there is still adequate space to navigate between inventory displays and reach other areas of the tent.  Straw-stuffed crates have been stacked beside an open iron-bound chest on one side of the path, while a cloth-covered table stands opposite them.

title: [A Canted Wagon]
description: The wagon straddles the edge of some subsurface rock, tipping it awkwardly to one side.  Sucking sounds from the noisome muck indicate the process is on-going.  With its axles leaning to within a hand's breadth of the mire's surface, the wagon looks as though it is being slowly devoured by the swamp.

title: [The Frozen Pioneer, Showroom]
description: Spherical glass lanterns are strung from the domed ceiling of the tent, lending a warm glow to the chilly room.  A frosted glass case sits in the center of the room, the base of it covered in a thin layer of dust from the dirt floor.  Off to one side is a many-armed coat rack.  A low humming noise can be heard coming from a tent flap.

title: [The Frozen Pioneer, Workroom]
description: A myriad of ropes and pulleys have been strung from the tent's framework in order to support an extensive rhimar contraption.  The icy temperatures within the tent cause your teeth to chatter.  A pile of shiny red sleds rests near a blanket of snow, offering a place to sit and admire the workings of the contraption.  Icicles cling to a tent flap that provides the only way to escape to warmer climes.

title: [A Pauper's Pittance]
description: Dusty mauve canvas haphazardly drapes from a dry-rotted wooden tent frame.  A myriad of patchwork from leftover fabrics and roughly sewn thread has been used to repair years of apparent neglect.  In the center of the room stands a stout headless male mannequin opposite a slender headless female mannequin.  The tent's flap has been tightly rolled and secured to the side of the entryway with a thick strand of frayed rope.

title: [Sweet Oblivion, Parlor]
description: Faded walls of lavender and amethyst silk provide a backdrop of a series of ivory-framed portaits, the pictures dotted inbetween pillars of chipped white marble.  Situated at the center of the room is a circular etched glass case displaying rich furs between the dirty surfaces, while several long pastel candy boxes showcase jewelry on stiff lace doilies.  A large filigree-set mirror sits at an angle along the western wall, the web-like cracks of the panes casting odd distorted images of the room beyond.

title: [Sweet Oblivion, Alcove]
description: A single wax taper set into a rounded porcelain bottle provides the only source of illumination to this tiny room, the flame curving sharply with the currents of air blowing through the corridor.  A quartet of stained glass bottles stands upright upon a badly warped ebonwood table, their labels ripped and covered in fingerprints of ink and other unknown substances.  Drawn upon the floor of the room is a circle of flowing chalk runes, the colors bleeding together along the burnt edges of wooden floorboards.

title: [Eye of the Hawk]
description: The heavy green suede ceiling of this roomy tent is held aloft by a series of thin, pliable tree limbs woven in a circular pattern through the more sturdy overall structure that is the main support.  A central pole peaks the tent, and several poles at the edges define the walls that enclose this area.  Bundled herbs hang from above, lending their scent to the air as they dry, while nearby white paper lanterns shed a warm, diffuse light over the surroundings.

title: [The Painted Talon]
description: Neatly arranged with a lineup of colorful miniature bottles, the entire back wall is fashioned from a set of polished ebonwood racks.  Well-featured in the foreground of the room are a wide-set maple wardrobe and a stately cedar closet stocked with fabric wares.  The walls are interspersed with scintillating bronze and copper tendrils woven into the dark woodwork, highlighting the warm glow of several glass-domed beeswax candles that are alight about the shop.

Well-featured in the foreground of the room are a wide-set spalted maple cabinet and a stately carved cedar stand stocked with fabric wares.  The walls are interspersed with scintillating bronze and copper tendrils woven into the dark woodwork, highlighting the warm glow of several glass-domed beeswax candles that are alight about the shop.

title: [Time for a Change, Display Room]
description: The front half of this large, festive tent has been sectioned off from corner to opposite corner, leaving a triangular display area.  A single pole stands in the center, supporting the peaked roof.  Twisted paper streamers of every imaginable color arc outward from the top of the pole to the uppermost sections of the walls.  A brightly painted table sits against the partition, and a large display stand sits along one wall.

title: [Time for a Change, Lounge]
description: Festive paper lanterns have been positioned around this rather large room, bathing the area in a soft glow.  Several patrons stand near an iron-banded wooden keg, conversing and showing off their recently-acquired wares while they enjoy a drink.  Thick mocha-hued rugs cover the floor and help absorb any unwanted sounds from the swamp outside.

Several patrons stand near an iron-banded wooden keg, conversing and showing off their recently acquired wares while they enjoy a drink.  Thick mocha-hued rugs cover the floor and help absorb any unwanted sounds from the swamp outside.

title: [Like Nobody's Watching, Entry]
description: The entry to the tent is cool and dark, offering relief from the elements outside.  The far wall is blank, save for a beaded curtain serving as the only break in the opaque black silk.  Arches to the east and west lead deeper into the structure, and a soft crimson carpet dampens the sound of footfalls on the floor.  Near the tent's flap is a metal rack that dangles scarves in myriad colors.

title: [Like Nobody's Watching, Atelier]
description: The opaque black silk walls give this room an oppressive air, as little light penetrates the fabric.  A row of three lanterns dangles from the ceiling, and scented smoke escapes the glass confinement along with a luminescence that illuminates the room below.  Off to the side, several chairs offer places to sit, while in the center, a low, expansive mahogany platform takes up much of the available space.  A beaded curtain leads out of the room.

title: [Die Harder, Arrow Meet Knee]
description: A vast assortment of broken arrows litter the floor of the area.  Hung along the walls are various paintings depicting monstrous creatures being shot in the knees with arrows.  Centered in the room is a large armor stand.

title: [Resist It, Ignite My Heart]
description: A bright crimson carpet lines the flooring of this room from wall to wall.  Centered in the room is a large armor stand.  Hung from the walls are various paintings depicting puppies being burned alive.

title: [Resistance is Futile]
description: A combination of straw and sand line the floor of this brightly lit wagon.  Bolted onto the walls near the arched ceiling are a vast amount of lanterns glowing brightly, as if powered by some sort of magical source.  Centered in the room is a large armor stand.  A wide white ash door leads deeper into the wagon.

title: [Resistance is Futile, Backroom]
description: Nearly rotten wooden planks line the flooring of this backroom's area.  Situated in the center of the room is a large wooden worktable with a sturdy leather chair resting behind it.  A wide white ash door leads back to the wagon's main area.

title: [Armor Abundance, Main]
description: Dim ambient light softly glows from various candles placed on the floor in the four corners of the room.  A large armor stand is centered in the area while a wall-hung rack rests behind it.

title: [Shocking Experiences]
description: Plush silver-hued carpeting lines the floor of this small wagon.  Hung along the walls are various metal rods of all sorts of shapes, sizes, and materials.  Centered in the room is a large armor stand taking up much of the area's space, while a large table is pushed into one corner.

title: [Nocking Point]
description: From the willow supports overhead, a myriad of vibrantly colored flowers have been hung out to dry, while the edge of this space is lined with narrow shelves full of glass jars containing various pigments.  The astringent scent of herbs and plants is pervasive here, and to the east, an arched passage leads further into the shop.

title: [Nocking Point]
description: Sections of feather-tied hemp dangle above, twirling idly in place as the air is stirred by the slightest movement or stray breeze like silent, varicolored windchimes.  Braided cord ties support a cloth-lined segmented box that hangs from the far wall, and near it, a battered metal tray is bracketed beneath by a pair of small, forked oak branches.

title: [Booze and Brews, Morning Room]
description: A grouping of darkly varnished chairs form a semi-circle around an elegant cast iron stove topped with a tall black cast iron kettle.  Beside the stove but separated by a few feet is a small wicker chest, its lid open to reveal its contents.  The heady scent of freshly brewed coffee permeates the air, mixed with the stale, sour scent of spilled liquor.

title: [Friendly Necessities, Shop]
description: The interior of this little shack is brightly lit and smells faintly of wet dog.  A small caramel-colored dog, surrounded by her little brood of sleeping pups, watches warily from a thick pallet of blankets off in one corner.  Along the back wall are a series of shelves and a row of rough-cut oak pegs.

title: [Sounds Around the Mire]
description: Metal pipes of various widths and lengths travel through the walls and ceiling of the wagon.  Tucked amind the crisscrossed mess is a rusted iron case.  Bits and pieces of jewelry and other adornments hang from the twisted labyrinth, displayed for all to see.  A cleared path leads through the mess to a small archway covered with a tattered blanket.

Metal pipes of various widths and lengths travel through the walls and ceiling of the wagon.  Tucked amid the crisscrossed mess is a rusted iron case.  Bits and pieces of jewelry and other adornments hang from the twisted labyrinth, displayed for all to see.  A cleared path leads through the mess to a small archway covered with a tattered blanket.

title: [Sounds Around the Mire]
description: Sheets of metal and piping are scattered around the small storeroom.  Boxes and crates of various sizes and shapes are filled to overflowing with springs, coils, bolts, and screws.  Several unfinished pieces of a mechanical nature are stacked next to a small archway, their purpose a mystery.

title: [Foot To The Floor, Front Room]
description: A rolling brass ladder is mounted on rails that the run the length of this long wagon, leading up to a trapdoor in the roof.  Boxes are stacked on the dusty floor nearly to the ceiling, alongside a large, dented metal bin.  An oak cabinet stands next to a threadbare green curtain leading further into the wagon.

title: [Foot To The Floor, Back Room]
description: Stacked boxes form two narrow aisles leading to the back of the wagon where a glass display case filled with an assortment of wares rests under a shuttered window.  A flickering lantern hangs from the ceilling over a low oak workbench topped with a black shoe form.

title: [Foot To The Floor, Wagon Roof]
description: A trapdoor is propped open, revealing a brass ladder leading down into the wagon's front room, while the flat roof has been enclosed with painted oak rails, providing a view of the surrounding marshland.  A heavy metal chest is propped open in one corner next to a large wooden rack, and a cushioned bench is pushed against the railing, with several footstools scattered around the area.

title: [Off The Chain, Sales Room]
description: A crude canopy of rough pine planks and tattered canvas stretches low overhead, providing only basic shelter to the wares housed in this open-air structure.  Jewelry dangle thick from a series of small iron hooks hanging from the planks, the long strands of glittering chains and beads strewn about in a cluttered and disorganized mess.  Behind a narrow row of cases is a crooked pine-planked door.

title: [Off the Chain, Supply Room]
description: Lopsided crates and discarded packaging paper is strewn about on the ground, cluttering the area terribly, the uneven flooring barely visible through the mess.  A lone canvas cot remains clear of debris, resting in the far corner of this crude shanty, below a single flickering lantern.  A crooked pine-planked door appears to be the only exit to this cramped space.

title: [A Dark and Dank Tent]
description: This tent smells of wet fur, mold, and other unidentifiable odors.  Three corners of the tent feature piles of dirty laundry and rotted, almost decomposing food.  In the less dirty corner, surrounded by candles, is a rotted wooden table.

title: [A Bright Orange Tent]
description: An edged weapons rack has been precisely positioned in the dead center of the opposite wall of this bright orange tent.  Flanking the orange tent flap are a two-handed weapons rack and a polearms rack.

title: [A Ragged Canvas Tent]
description: This ragged canvas tent doesn't really have much going for it.  The only attention-getting items would be a satchel rack and a cloak rack flanking the opposite corners of the far side of the tent.  A canvas tent flap leads the way out.

title: [Wrap It Up, Front Room]
description: The walls here are sparsely decorated with ragged ribbons and the tattered remains of some sort of flag.  A soiled basket rests in a corner directly below a row of crooked old nails protruding from the wall.  In the center of the room is a large padded post.  A dowel has been affixed horizontally towards the top of the assemblage, and above that is a round sand-filled bag which droops forward giving the structure a scarecrow-like appearance.  Hung crookedly on its hinges, a warped door leads into a dimly lit room.

title: [Wrap It Up, Resting Area]
description: The room is dimly illuminated by a single multi-wick pillar candle melted in place within a wide smudged glass column located in the center of a small chipped marble fountain.  The sound of the water's movement is light, but constant.  Several reed mats are scattered across the dirty floor.  Aside from the door you entered through, there is no other means of egress.

title: [Eye of the Hawk]
description: A small table sits off to one side in this area of the tent, its surface covered with spare parts - strings, nocks, and grips - as well as a cloth-lined segmented box and a battered metal tray.  A single glass-shaded lantern hangs over the table in addition to those of white paper, providing ample light for the space that is obviously dedicated to crafting.  A small stool with a raised back sits in front of the worktable, and a quiver of violet-fletched arrows dangles from it.

A small table sits off to one side in this area of the tent, its surface covered with spare parts - strings, nocks, and grips - of bows and several well-worn tools.  A single glass-shaded lantern hangs over the table in addition to those of white paper, providing ample light for the space that is obviously dedicated to crafting.  A small stool with a raised back sits in front of the worktable, and a quiver of violet-fletched arrows dangles from it.

title: [Sticks and Stones]
description: Much of the swamp vegetation has been cleared away, leaving a narrow pathway running behind the maroon wagon.  Plastered prominently on the side of the wagon is a faded and tattered poster, portraying a number of gemstones and their meanings.  A series of gold-painted pegs dangling an assortment of bags run in a line just below the poster.

title: [Sacred Moons, Behind the Wagon]
description: A tall stone pedestal has been placed within a wide circle of oversized flat-topped rocks that creates a natural seating area.  Displayed prominently on the platform is a black marble moon, held in place by silver pegs that border the edges of the cornice.  A wooden shovel lays on the ground next to a freshly dug hole, brown worms writhing in and out of the moist earth.  A circular archway leads back into the wagon.

title: [Dashing and Slashing, Lodge]
description: Roughly hewn walls of teak enclose the room, the darkly lacquered wood blending seamlessly against the stone blocks comprising the floor.  Dominating the western wall is a rectangular wood-framed painting hung low above a tiled slate fireplace, its screen wrought from iron and stylized with a large-muscled stag.  A cylindrical metal rack stands next to a tartan curtained arch leading into another room, the smell of cigar smoke and bourbon mixing with freshly burning wood.

Roughly hewn walls of teak enclose the room, the darkly lacquered wood blending seamlessly against the stone blocks comprising the floor.  Dominating the western wall is a rectangular wood-framed painting hung low above a tiled slate fireplace, its screen wrought from iron and stylized with a large-muscled stag.  A cylindrical metal rack stands next to a tartan-curtained arch leading into another room, the smell of cigar smoke and bourbon mixing with freshly burning wood.

title: [Dashing and Slashing, Study]
description: A polished teak trefoil arch, carved with an overlapping leaf design, separates this room from the lodge.  The scent of smoke is heavy here, emanating from cigars left on a circular dark leather table, its surface stained with moisture from several short crystal-cut glasses sitting half-full at its center.  Five high-backed blue velvet chairs encircle the table, each seat faded from use and spills along the arms.  Various trophies dominate the walls of this room, ranging from pairs of antlers and heads of bears to oddities like handkerchiefs and locks of hair.

title: [The Finest Hour, Menswear]
description: Brilliant reds and darker wine hues dominate this side of the tent, the room holding the faintest scent of spice.  Burgundy carpet covers the floor, complementing a dark mahogany wardrobe wardrobe that rests in a corner of the space.  The same polished wood was used to craft an elegantly scrolled rack that holds various footwear.

title: [The Finest Hour, Female Finery]
description: Panels of deep purple and bronze-threaded sapphire silk line the walls, a complement to the plush carpet woven to resemble peacock feathers that spreads across the floor.  An ornamental dress form sits in one corner, resting near a polished curving armoire.  A small compartmented counter holds various pairs of shoes, resting beneath a silver rack designed to look like spreading branches.

title: [All That Glitters, Storeroom]
description: Boxes are stacked high against the walls of this cramped room.  A small three-legged chair sits in one corner, an ugly crate next to it clearly being used as a table.  There is a fine layer of dust on the floor, barely covered by a plain braided rug.

title: [The Golden Rule]
description: Dappled sunlight streams in through the gaps in the leafy ceiling and glitters across the items on a shallow metal tray.  A hard-packed dirt floor sends dust into the air with every footfall, which dances in the sunbeams like tiny sprites.  Small golden trinkets decorate all four walls, and each one sparkles in the tawny light.

Dappled moonlight streams in through the gaps in the leafy ceiling and glitters across the items on a shallow metal tray.  Every footfall on the hard-packed dirt floor sends dust into the air, which dances in the moonbeams like tiny sprites.  Small golden trinkets decorate all four walls, and each one sparkles in the silvery light.

title: [Boil and Toil]
description: Crafted with a high, domed roof, the wagon has a large interior, which is filled with various items used in alchemy.  A stack of cauldrons dominates one corner, while several crates of jars, vials and flasks fill another.  Partially hidden by a large copper rack, a narrow door is set in the back wall.  A small cloth-covered opening leads out to a tented area next to the wagon.

title: [Boil and Toil]
description: Draped over the side of the wagon, a large piece of thick sailcloth creates a large tented area.  Several wooden boxes are piled against the wall with their lids partially removed.  A small basket filled with various pouches and sacks is tucked beside them.  Straw spills from a wooden crate, several sets of mortars and pestles can be seen tucked inside.  A cloth-covered opening leads back into the shop.

A small basket filled with various pouches and sacks is tucked beside them.  Straw spills from a wooden crate, and several sets of mortars and pestles can be seen tucked inside.  A cloth-covered opening leads back into the shop.

title: [Boil and Toil]
description: Crates, boxes and barrels are stacked and piles in the small backroom.  A worktable has been crafted with some boxes and planks of wood.  Several alchemist tools are set up on its surface.  They are surrounded by various bottles and packets and flasks filled with ingredients.

Crates, boxes, and barrels are stacked in piles in the small backroom.  A worktable has been crafted with some boxes and planks of wood.  Several alchemy tools are set up on its surface.  They are surrounded by various bottles and packets and flasks filled with ingredients.

title: [Futile Gestures]
description: Small glass lanterns hang precariously from buffed brass hooks, designed to provide enough light to examine wares carefully.  Wall panels painted a willow green hue complement the panels of rustic oak flooring, and a short glass-topped counter dominates the rear of the wagon.  Shelves of applewood and cherrywood are strategically dotted about the walls.

title: [Rune Carvers]
description: A pair of carved glimaerstone torches are mounted on the walls, their soft glow illuminating the interior of the wagon.  Worn through in places, a deerskin rug has been haphazardly tossed on the floor.  Beams of dark oak run the length of the ceiling overhead, supporting the roof of the wagon.

title: [Put A Ring In It]
description: A large sheet of waxed blue canvas is draped over a series of brass-banded tent poles to provide the shade at this small booth.  Numerous patches, in a wide assortment of colors, cover the surface of the canvas.  A few small weeds grow from the packed dirt floor beneath the covering.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Dilapidated Yard]
description: All around, large banyan trees and black ash hover like parents over children.  Lanterns lit with bright flames hang around the diliapidated fence, which is so ridden with rot, holes, and breaks in the wood that it can't rightly be called a proper enclosure.  Some distance across from a half-built barn are a shack leaning far to the left, a small, crumbling stone structure, and wooden shed.  Dark muck and puddles of mud riddle the ground, and a fine mist of what can only be spores hangs in the air.

title: [Wooden Shed]
description: Lined with thoroughly rusted mining, farming, and fishing tools, the shed's walls provide a stark contrast to the ceiling, which is strung with colorful coils of silk that barely hide the nests and spiderwebs that reside there.  Several elegant, cushioned chairs surround a small carved oak table.  Oddly, one corner of the structure seems to have been pushed away and taken over by a black ash tree's trunk, the ceiling in that area composed of its spindly branches.

title: [Stone Structure, Entry]
description: Jutting up from the ground, limestone foundations are topped with only the edges of what was once a thatched roof remain overhead.  Pieces of a broken table and shattered glass lie on the floor, scattered near the ladder leading down.  Arranged on a small ledge in the wall where several stones are missing are a wire brush, a comb, and a set of shears.  Blue and white-striped silks, brightly lit by a multitude of candles on the floor, are hung over the doorway in a festive manner.

Jutting up from the ground, limestone foundations in a state of disrepair reach toward the sky, and only the edges of what was once a thatched roof remain overhead.  Pieces of a broken table and shattered glass lie on the floor, scattered near the ladder leading down.  Arranged on a small ledge in the wall where several stones are missing are a wire brush, a comb, and a set of shears.  Blue and white-striped silks are hung over the doorway in a festive manner.

title: [Stone Structure, Underground]
description: The underground space is hollowed out for several feet in every direction from the centrally located wooden ladder.  Motes of moonlight drip down from above, several torches anchored into the ground providing extra light.  Next to a handful of broken shovels and bent pickaxes leaning against an area where the layers of limestone are especially visible, a collection of hair-related items and tools are heaped together in a chaotic pile on the ground.

title: [Lean-to Shack]
description: Rather than stand up straight, the walls here lean to one side.  The ceiling is partially missing, allowing tree branches to encroach on the man-made structure and moonlight streaked with falling dust to filter into the dimly candle-lit space.  Rusty needles and jars with labels that have been smudged to the point of being illegible are stacked in a small pile on the ground, next to a small wood-framed mirror.

Rather than stand up straight, the walls here lean to one side. Rusty needles and jars with labels that have been smudged to the point of being illegible are stacked in a small pile on the ground, next to a small wood-framed mirror.

title: [Half-built Barn]
description: Although nature has crept its way past the foundations, which are still somewhat intact, the construction of the barn was clearly never finished.  Even in an unfinished state, however, it appears to have served some function, given the trio of double-stacked racks on the wall holding the warped and rotting remains of pieces of tackle.  A handful of sacks overflowing with scrubbing brushes, sponges, and powder-filled jars hangs from the bottom rack.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, out

title: [House of Ebon and Ivory]
description: The wagon's interior is quite open in the center, with the walls splashed in a soft shade of off-white.  Flanking the back wall, an ivory shrine stands illuminated by a haze of pale light, and toward the left is a more dimly lit onyx shrine.  A mosaic of white marble and jet completely blankets the floor in bold, contrasting colors, leading to a glaes-framed doorway.

The wagon's interior is quite open in the center, with the walls splashed in a soft shade of off-white.  Flanking the back wall, an ivory shrine stands illuminated by a haze of pale light, and toward the left is a more dimly lit onyx altar.  A mosaic of white marble and jet completely blankets the floor in bold, contrasting colors, leading to a glaes-framed doorway.

title: [House of Ebon and Ivory, Nook]
description: Pleasant hints of lavender and sandalwood float lightly in the air of the neatly kept backroom.  The space is arranged very simply with emphasis placed on a swan-carved ebonwood armoire set against the back wall.  Pointedly fixed at either side of the glaes-framed doorway is a white silk-lined shelf and a two-tiered black oak stand.

title: [A Stony Cottage]
description: The anemic floral decor of the cottage is washed in silvered light that streams through a glass-paned bay window.  A curtain of mist hangs heavy in the air, nearly obscuring some provincial elm cabinetry that fully lines the back wall.  Herb-filled baskets and vials of oil are strewn about a flat-topped cypress tree stump serving as a workspace.

The anemic floral decor of the cottage is washed in gilded light that streams through a glass-paned bay window.  A curtain of mist hangs heavy in the air, nearly obscuring some provincial elm cabinetry that fully lines the back wall.  Herb-filled baskets and vials of oil are strewn about a flat-topped cypress tree stump serving as a workspace.

title: [Monumental Mementos]
description: The musty room is unusually cool.  Knotted pine walls are partially covered with somber-colored banners that hang loosely from roof to floor, adding an air of solemnity to the room.  A fine dust pervades the air and plays within a stream of light emanating from a rough-hewn oak door.  A large stone bench rests upon the solid floor.  Adjacent to the bench is a wide, solid set of shelves with items resting upon them.

title: [Monumental Mementos, Workshop]
description: Constructed from black-painted timber, the smooth walls bear a series of hammers and chisels of varying sizes.  The floor is littered with offshoots of soft limestone and pieces of rock.  At the back of the hut, rough blocks of veined stone rest beside a large bin overflowing with well-worn masonry tools.  An expansive stone workbench stands in the center of the room, beside an overturned chest with a canvas cushion that serves to provide seating.  A rough-hewn oak door leads out.

An expansive stone workbench stands in the center of the room, beside an overturned chest with a canvas cushion that serves to provide seating.  A small black marble tablet hangs on the wall beside the door that leads out.

title: [Shoddy Kiosk]
description: Multicolored layers of paint show through nicked edges and high spots on the kiosk's drab green surfaces, a few deep enough to reveal the grey, unidentifiable wood of its construction.  A plump brown spider has made her cobwebbed home in the small, domed roof of the shop.

title: [Small Pavilion]
description: The little circular pavilion houses a shallow marble box before an array of squat votives flickering solemnly on an ornate rack.  Heavy silk walls deaden sound and block external illumination, deepening the somber atmosphere.

title: [Castaways, Interior]
description: Patched walls of rugged canvas are secured by solid oak corner posts.  Intricate cast iron lanterns hang from each post, casting a warm glow over the large space.  A massive center post supports the gathered fabric of the ceiling.  Several nails protrude from the central support, holding various goods for sale.  A curtain is hung across the back of the tent, partitioning off some work space.

title: [Castaways, Workspace]
description: An anvil stands in the corner of this small workspace.  Various blacksmithing tools lie strewn about, cluttering the area.  A disheveled blanket roll rests rumpled in the corner.

title: [The Edge of Life, Inside]
[A Teak Shack, Pole Party]
description: Cramped and dark, the interior of this wagon is littered with bladed weapons in various stages of disrepair.  Barely visible amid the mess are two weapon racks and several shelves on the far wall.  A shoddy door is nearly buried behind a pile of discarded sword hilts.

title: [Behind the Wagons]
description: This comfortable space is used as gathering place for carnival workers when not performing.  The lush grassy lawn is somewhat matted down by heavy wagon traffic, yet still comfortable.  A small firepit in the center of the green provides a warm, welcoming light.

title: [Saa-weet Treats, Food Stand]
description: The turf around this little food stand has been worn down to dirt from heavy foot traffic.  A makeshift counter has been formed by using a plank of polished oak supported by stacked crates on both ends.  A red wagon is pulled up behind the stand, providing a safe place for the proprietor to stay.

title: [Small Stuff, Entry]
description: Brilliantly aglow with a dazzling array of lanterns, this tent is spotless.  Long wooden shelves run the length of the east and west walls displaying a magnificent assortment of expertly crafted dolls.  Below each of the meticulously displayed dolls is a wooden bin filled with the basic models.  A small display table sits just inside the doorway while a deep crimson rug edged with intricate gold threading creates a wide central aisle from which patrons can browse the wares.  Hanging from the ceiling is an ornate gilt sign.

title: [For His Protection, Showroom]
description: Beams of every kind of wood sustain the weight of the faded black canvas.  Patched in several places, the canvas has been converted into the walls and ceiling of the abundant enclosure.  Hanging from the ridgepole is a large metal sign.  Lanterns suspended from the beams above furnish the area with ample lighting.  Numerous stands, on top of the faded burgundy rug covering the dilapidated floor, form a circle in the center of the room displaying the wares.

title: [Straight to the Point]
description: Swathes of faded midnight blue silk line the weathered wood of the wagon's walls.  A tattered dirty rug covers uneven planks used to establish the shabby floor which is littered with rusted needles.  Glowing crystal orbs are haphazardly scattered throughout the room, providing barely enough light to see.  A broken glass display case, stained with a bit of blood on one side, occupies a bit of floor space along one wall.  Against the opposite wall, a bent wire jewelry tree has been settled on top of a rotted oak end table.

title: [Under the Rampart]
description: Dark and dank enough that the moisture seeps from the stone walls and cobblestone floor, this spot looks eminently defensible.  Portcullises, situated at the outer and inner ends of the walkway, are raised now, but are ready to be lowered at a moment's notice.  Trapdoors open from the ceiling, making the area even less hospitable to unwelcome visitors.

title: [Small Stuff, Attire]
description: Brilliantly aglow with a dazzling array of lanterns, the clothing section is spotless.  Some intricately carved oak stands line the east and west walls.  Several racks on either side display tiny articles of clothing.  The deep crimson rug edged with intricate gold threading continues in from the south maintaining the central aisle from which to browse the accessories.  Hanging from the ceiling is an ornate gilt sign.

title: [Small Stuff, Accessories]
description: Brilliantly aglow with a dazzling array of lanterns, this area is spotless.  The east and west walls are lined with small tables topped with dressed dolls modeling a wide variety of miniature accessories.  A deep crimson rug edged with intricate gold threading flows in from the south, ending in a wide central aisle from which to browse the wares.  An ornately gilded mirror stands against the north wall, oddly out of place.

title: [Above Elanthia, On the Web]
description: A vast spidersilk web sprawls out as far as the eye can see.  Millions of tiny spiders strengthen their craft, allowing the surface to be durable enough to walk on.  The bright sunlight is nearly unbearable from all the way up here.  Below, the only thing recognizable is Mount Aenatumgana's peak.  There is a thick rope of spidersilk leading toward Elanthia off one of the web's edges.

title: [For His Protection, Workroom]
description: Several male-build mannequins of all different heights are arranged in the back of the room.  A metal forge occupies the far side of one wall with bits of metal littering the nearby floor.  Various leather and metal working tools reside on a long table next to a tall wooden stool.  Numerous lanterns are strategically placed around the room specifically highlighting the work area.

title: [On the Lighter Side]
description: Hanging from the support rafters above, a large crystal lantern brightens the small area.  Soft light glints off of the metals and precious gems used in adorning the various items on display.  A group of mannequins are placed about the room to show off the shop's wares.

title: [On the Lighter Side]
description: Thick animal skins cover the modwir floor making a soft carpet that muffles the sound of footsteps.  Several crystal lanterns hang from poles that help to support the large pavilion, their bright glow illuminates the velvet shrouded alcove.  A trio of mannequins stand in the center of the room, their slender forms display various garments, jewelry, and weapons.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Eye of the Hawk]
description: Spherical white paper lanterns dangle from the limb-woven ceiling overhead, their exteriors painted with a variety of flora and fauna in a myriad of hues.  Along the tent walls, strands of rope hang against the suede in graceful scallops and are bedecked in an array of colorful feathers.  Underfoot, a round rug of woven cloth scraps occupies the heart of the floor and pads each footfall.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.

title: [Playroom]
description: While still decorated in a colorful motif, this room has been toned down a bit in comparison to the main shop room.  The room has lots of open space for play.  A slate board is mounted on one wall, covered in chalk drawings in a childish style.  Several cushioned mats in a variety of colors are scattered on the floor to sit upon, and a slightly smudged window lets a bit of diffused light enter the room.  A tall mirror with a bright purple frame leans precariously near a faded tacked-up curtain.

title: [Immortally Preserved, East]
description: Suspended from bamboo frames, a series of dark velvet drapes encircles the small room and muffles most of the exterior noises.  Wide panels positioned in the ceiling are open to allow air to circulate through the area, while also allowing natural light to illuminate the room.  A black lacquered lattice is suspended from the conical ceiling and displays a variety of chain-strung wares, the lockets at their ends spinning lazily as customers move past.

Wide panels positioned in the ceiling are open to allow air to circulate through the area, while carefully shielded lanterns provide illumination.  A black lacquered lattice is suspended from the conical ceiling and displays a variety of chain-strung wares, the lockets at their ends spinning lazily as customers move past.

title: [Immortally Preserved, West]
description: Lacquered black bamboo supports rise from the rug-covered floor in a straight line toward a ring in the ceiling, which gives structural integrity to the conical roof.  Glass-encased lanterns are arranged upon each post and filled with mirrors that reflect the sunlight about the small space.  Several portraits are displayed upon easels, while a centrally positioned display case offers a view of the wares that are for sale.
