Glass-encased lanterns are arranged upon each post, their interiors filled with white votives that fill the space with their warm glow.  Several portraits are displayed upon easels, while a centrally positioned display case offers a view of the wares that are for sale.

title: [Sticks and Stones]
description: The cleared dirt track leads behind the wagon, where a flaking gold-painted ladder leads up to the wagon's rooftop storage area.  Tall, dark, and spindly, branches from a brittle dead tree extend out toward the wagon and have been used as a makeshift display stand through the help of numerous hanging wooden boxes.

title: [Sticks and Stones, Wagon Roof]
description: A narrow, rickety railing runs along the perimeter of the wagon's roof, but judging by the state of disrepair it would be best to stick to the center.  Stacks of crates and boxes held down by leather straps make the roof difficult to traverse.  The top of the gold-painted ladder juts out from the back of the wagon, leading back down to the ground.

title: [Whatever Will Be, Tea Leaves]
description: Scattered candles cast a subdued glow over the brightly colored bottles that fill the various carved narrow haon shelves set along the rear wall of the wagon.  Beneath the shelves, an inclined tea leaf case boasts an assortment of teas.

Scattered candles cast a subdued glow over the brightly colored bottles that fill the various carved narrow haon shelves set along the rear wall of the wagon.  Beneath the shelves, an inclined tea leaf case boasts an assortment of teas, and a glass-fronted display case is filled with vibrantly hued glassware and other tea-brewing accessories.

title: [The Imperial Mark]
description: Ambient noise and light filters in from the rest of the pavilion to this quiet corner.  The floor has been left empty and clear in stark contrast to the rest of the pavilion.  The only adornment are some plush velvet cushions strewn about against the silk walls.

title: [Instrumentality]
description: A thick steel wire has been strung up between two of the tent posts, upon which hang a number of instruments.  Beneath the orderly display is a simple glass case illuminated by lit green and yellow votive candles.  A scratched wooden wardrobe doubles as a bookcase housing a number of music-related tomes and texts.  Nearby, a polished steel stand has been partially draped by a patchwork quilt, though most of its contents are visible from other areas of the tent.

title: [Instrumentality]
description: Long shadows occupy this section of the tent, cast by the tall poles supporting the colorful canopy.  Spanning several feet, a long wooden plank has been repurposed and painted into a wide blue-spotted shelf supported by empty ale barrels.  A polished brass tray rests atop a leaf-painted table along with an empty porcelain vase.  Beyond a rather hideously crafted iron rack, a rose-motif azure wool curtain obscures what lies to the north.

title: [Instrumentality]
description: Colorful, overlapping rugs create uneven footing in this roomy section of the tent.  Scattered around the area are half-finished instruments leaning against posts and spread out on work surfaces.  The smell of curing wood lingers in the air, mingling with a faint smoky fragrance.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay.  Drooping willow trees, short and stunted, drape across the path and dangle their spear-shaped leaves upon the spongy ground.  A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.  A narrow sinkhole has gathered much of the muck in the area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees.  Standing in the center of a pool of cloudy water is a hollowed tree stump that is covered in orange and brown shelf fungi.  Several patches of land offer a better trail through the deep muck that covers the ground, but avoiding the muck seems impossible.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Narrowing to an ultra thin track of solid ground, the pathway meanders through wide pools of stagnant water.  Duckweed and bladderwort create a verdant border to each of ovoid bodies and rainbow mold stretches across the stale surfaces.  Clouds of gnats thicken the air, their tiny bodies clinging to everything in their path.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid sinkhole along the eastern border.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Bisecting the narrow companionway between the rows of wrought iron cells is a large wooden framing post marred by nicks and scratches down its rough expanse.  A black iron ring supports the manacled form of a rotted skeleton draped in tattered clothing that might once have been an Imperial Navy uniform.  Foul odors fill this section of the ship, made worse by the damp, sea-laden air.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves.  Ominous shadows trail across the spongy, softness of the landscape where enormous muddy bubbles rise and burst as underground gases escape from the bosom of the earth.  In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Strange fumes create a haze in the air as they explosively escape from the putrid ground and fill the air with an aroma akin to rotting eggs.  Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright and verdant in the dark landscape, a single juniper tree rises out of the murky bleakness of the swamp and stretches upward towards the grey sky.  Concentric bands of alternating stone and brown grass surround the twisted body of the towering, berry-laden beauty and manage to stave off the filth of the nearby sludge-like mud.  Despite the calm of the area, an invasive humidity makes the air weighed with dampness and an underlying scent of stench clogs the senses.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Splintered bark and broken limbs litter the viscous ground around a stunted black willow tree.  Discolored leaves precariously cling to branches, though a greater number lie scatted about the mud.  Upturned tufts of wildrye grass display their intricate root systems to the sky along edge of the watercourse, their blue-green blades barely touching the scum-covered liquid.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Fungal tubes rise out of the leaf-covered ground, their twisted stems curving away from the rotting nutrients of the swamp's muddy banks.  Bright green mold-covered tree limbs lie in a protective ring about the russet brown protrusions and display signs of hooves, beak, and claw marks across their warped lengths.  Sprouts of bright green swamp privet break through the dismal grey and brown of the landscape, their spindled limbs mildly spotted with layered and waxy, lime green bulbs.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [Tug-of-War, Willow Field]
description: Blocking the sky with their interwoven canopies, a number of twisted and gnarled trees have grown to form walls around a field of swamp grasses and wildflowers.  Thick rattan posts support burning torches, which cast flickering light over a pair of long, shallow trenches divided by a 10-foot wide pit.  The remnants of previous battles lie scattered in and around the trenches, primarily broken sections of thick, rotted rope.  Just behind the pit, a green and blue sign is prominently placed at the edge of the field.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Toppled on its side, an enormous banyan tree stretches across the pathway and lies its head into the stagnant waters of the nearby stream.  Mold and sludge have claimed most of the verdant canopy, while its roots lie exposed to the elements and still cling to large clumps of moist earth.  A series of tiny black capped mushrooms grow in the dark shelter of the fallen tree.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.

title: [Outer Bailey]
description: High, thick basalt walls rise in every direction, demarcating the perimeter of the compound.  Outbuildings dot the area, some with the dim glow of candlelight reflecting through their windows.  A red sandstone keep rises from the center of the bailey, its doors directly opposite the portcullis and lit by brass torches.

High, thick basalt walls rise in every direction, demarcating the perimeter of the compound.  Outbuildings dot the area, the industrious sounds of the work going on inside echoing through the yard.  A red sandstone keep rises from the center of the bailey, its doors directly opposite the portcullis.  Grass and gardens grow between the numerous footpaths between outbuildings.

title: [Keep Entryway]
description: Massive ironwood doors, flanked by brass torches, guard the entrance to the keep, which could provide a defensible position for a last stand if the outer walls were breached.  Softening the look of the building itself are stands of amaranth and dragonstalk that have been planted along the walls of the keep.  An arched gateway stands on the east, guarding a curving path that follows the inside boundary of the rampart wall.

Stands of amaranth and dragonstalk have been planted along the walls of the keep, softening the look of the building.  An arched gateway stands on the east, guarding a curving path that follows the inside boundary of the rampart wall.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Wind chimes hanging from the branches of an old cottonwood tree create a pleasant metallic noise with each breeze.  The chimes look bright and new and the tree itself is well pruned.  A small pegasus statue stands facing the path under the tree with a small area for offerings on its pedestal.  The golden stone used to construct the statue is illuminated by a single candle placed in the offering bowl.  As it continues to the east, the path becomes stonier.

A small pegasus statue stands facing the path under the tree with a small area for offerings on its pedestal.  The golden stone used to construct the statue gleams brightly in the sunlight.  As it continues to the east, the path becomes stonier.

title: [The Keep, Entrance Hall South]
description: Sweeping to the top of the keep, the walls are covered in long, thin tapestries that end approximately six feet from the onyx and white marble floor.  The simplicity of the design coupled with the craftsmanship and choice of the materials lend the hall an ambiance of understated luxury.  The hall runs the length of the keep, ending in a grand staircase to the north.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Rugged stone and metal structures sprawl across the grass that borders the path.  The dominant feature is a statue of a broad-shouldered Arkati about to strike a blade resting on an anvil.  A series of torches planted on either side of the path illuminates the area, the light gleaming off the polished metal sculptures.

Rugged stone and metal structures sprawl across the grass that borders the path.  The dominant feature is a statue of a broad-shouldered Arkati about to strike a blade resting on an anvil.  The black of the rampart wall provides a foil for the polished structures of eonake, ora and other metals.

title: [The Keep, Grandmaster's Foyer]
description: The corner of this foyer allotted for the assistant is incredibly cramped, filled with bookshelves, map cases and loosely rolled scrolls, all arranged in no discernable order.  A shoddy desk, mounded with loose papers, encroaches on what little floor space is available.  Vividly woven in crimson, pure white and touches of cerulean blue, a luxurious figured silk rug adorns the polished floor boards.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Split Oak]
description: A huge oak tree, split in twain by lightning, lies rotting among several broken headstones.  The base of the charred tree has long since been sucked into the mud that threatens to devour everything in sight.  Carved into every available surface of the wood are initials and brief messages left behind by previous visitors.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Stone Column]
description: A white stone column towers over dozens of smaller headstones crowded on the side of this small hill.  The column appears to be much older than the surrounding grave markers, but is in considerably better shape.  A faint path leads around the column before curving to the northeast.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Trail]
description: Thick, putrid-smelling mud has overtaken this area, pushing stagnant water into opaque pools.  A trail of rather large four-clawed footprints, a shallow drag mark between the left and right, leads into one particularly large pool.  Nearby lies a broken head of a shovel and a rusty pickaxe.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Stagnant Pool]
description: Dirty, stagnant water stands knee-high to a gnome all around.  The upper half of a wooden coffin protrudes from a sunken grave, the lid nowhere to be found.  Inside, the torso of a headless skeleton rests in a grotesque position, one arm sticking out and waving with the slightest movement of the water.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Murky Pools]
description: A faintly greenish mist hovers over the area, making the already uncertain ground even more treacherous.  Murky pools of water stand in sunken graves all around.  Staring up at you from the bottom of one such pool is an algae-coated humanoid skull.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Convergence]
description: A large pile of stones supports a wooden signpost in an effort to keep it from sinking into the brackish water that pools all around.  The wooden slats that once stood out from the signpost to guide travelers now litter the ground, waterlogged and illegible.  Tall bunches of cattails hide half-submerged headstones that line the three paths that converge here.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Cypress Ring]
description: Several cypress trees have managed to take over the top of this small hill and form a protective ring around a sparse clearing.  Centered in the clearing is a single headstone which, judging by the dates chiseled into the stone, belongs to a young child.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Incline]
description: A gentle rise in the landscape toward the north has allowed most of the standing water to drain, leaving large stretches of semi-dry earth.  A partially decomposed rodent corpse stretches out from one patch of mud, the forelegs reaching as if the unfortunate animal died in a vain attempt to claw free.  A large swarm of flies buzzes around the corpse, continuing the cycle of life.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Gully]
description: Stunted, twisted vines line the slippery banks of this deep gully, the bottom of which is shrouded by a thick, insalubrious mist.  The upper portion of a large marble humanoid statue can be seen off to the east, one arm raised and holding the hilt of a bladeless sword.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Briar Thicket]
description: An impenetrable briar thicket surrounds you to the west, north, and east, blocking further exploration of this foul smelling mire.  A lone crypt, nearly lost in the mass of briars, is the only structure still standing amidst piles of broken headstones.

An impenetrable briar thicket surrounds you to the east and west, blocking further exploration of this foul smelling mire.  To the north, the underbrush has been cut back and a narrow pathway can be traversed.  A lone crypt, nearly lost in the mass of briars, is the only structure still standing amidst piles of broken headstones.

title: [Liktiken's Hovel]
description: No effort has been made to make this hovel inhabitable by any but those with the lowest of standards.  The wooden floorboards are so sodden and mired in the muck that they have grown a thick layer of mildew, creating a slippery hazard with every step.  Holes and cracks in the ceiling and walls have been covered with poorly cleaned animal hides and pieces of tin.  In the corner is a heap of moldering rags and scraps of fabric, and an overturned crate sits nearby, perhaps to serve as a table.

title: [Mask or Aid]
description: Serving as the sole source of illumination, moonlight streams in from a small open window, dust particles swirling through the brilliant rays.  A massive, moss-covered cypress tree with low hanging branches and deep hollows has burst through the uneven flooring damaged by a continuous assault of moisture from the surrounding swamp.  Two costumed goblins move hurriedly through the room, straightening the assembled costumes and replacing the dwindling inventory.

title: [Mask or Aid, Treetop]
description: Despite the tree's height, the view of the surrounding grounds from this vantage point shows little more than moss-covered treetops.  Knotted branches bend and sway with every step and the lack of four walls offers no security from a potentially fatal plunge.  A small bird's nest is perched on a branch amidst a thick cluster of leaves and moss, and deep hollows scar the trunk.

title: [Fen Furnishings]
description: This interior room of the wagon is bathed in dappled starlight from the many gaps between the lashed-together sticks that make up the walls.  A wooden floor stretches from one end to the other, and bulky shapes draped in musty burlap take up much of the floor space.  Near the wagon entrance, a stooped green goblin stands idly by, and near his head hangs a small black metal sign.

A wooden floor stretches from one end to the other, and bulky shapes draped in musty burlap take up much of the floor space.  Near the wagon entrance, a stooped green goblin stands idly by, and near his head hangs a small black metal sign.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Western Walkway]
description: Ominous creaks from the cedar planks below are heard with every footfall.  The black water below is eerily still, without so much as a ripple disturbing its obsidian-like smoothness.  The walkway continues westward, but a broken handrail and bootprints on a hillock just beneath show where less prudent souls have stepped off to venture through the southern swamp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.
