description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Toppled on its side, an enormous banyan tree stretches across the pathway and lies its head into the stagnant waters of the nearby stream.  Mold and sludge have claimed most of the verdant canopy, while its roots lie exposed to the elements and still cling to large clumps of moist earth.  A series of tiny black capped mushrooms grow in the dark shelter of the fallen tree.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Strange fumes create a haze in the air as they explosively escape from the putrid ground and fill the air with an aroma akin to rotting eggs.  Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Narrowing to an ultra thin track of solid ground, the pathway meanders through wide pools of stagnant water.  Duckweed and bladderwort create a verdant border to each of ovoid bodies and rainbow mold stretches across the stale surfaces.  Clouds of gnats thicken the air, their tiny bodies clinging to everything in their path.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves.  Ominous shadows trail across the spongy, softness of the landscape where enormous muddy bubbles rise and burst as underground gases escape from the bosom of the earth.  In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Strange fumes create a haze in the air as they explosively escape from the putrid ground and fill the air with an aroma akin to rotting eggs.  Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Splintered bark and broken limbs litter the viscous ground around a stunted black willow tree.  Discolored leaves precariously cling to branches, though a greater number lie scatted about the mud.  Upturned tufts of wildrye grass display their intricate root systems to the sky along edge of the watercourse, their blue-green blades barely touching the scum-covered liquid.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.  A narrow sinkhole has gathered much of the muck in the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick tangles of thorn-heavy brambles lie in knotted clusters along the western border of the pathway that bisects the swamp.  Several puddles of stagnant water pockmark the thick carpet of dusky brown moss that spreads across the uneven ground.  A ring of half-rotted trees leans against each other, their splintered sides and barkless faces heavy with black mold and sludge.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid sinkhole along the eastern border.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Fungal tubes rise out of the leaf-covered ground, their twisted stems curving away from the rotting nutrients of the swamp's muddy banks.  Bright green mold-covered tree limbs lie in a protective ring about the russet brown protrusions and display signs of hooves, beak, and claw marks across their warped lengths.  Sprouts of bright green swamp privet break through the dismal grey and brown of the landscape, their spindled limbs mildly spotted with layered and waxy, lime green bulbs.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Buzzly's Shack]
description: Rust-pitted nails and dried mud hold the decrepit wooden plank walls of this shack precariously together.  A constant buzzing of wings resonates throughout the small shack, and light filters through cracks, gaps, and knotholes in the planks, revealing the source of the noise to be a large wasp nest on the shack's roof.  The interior of the shack is unadorned except for a huge wooden door left to rot on the trampled grass floor.

title: [The Keep, Grandmaster's Office]
description: Airy and spacious, this comfortable room is a fitting office for the Grandmaster.  A few papers are stacked tidily on the corner of a broad mahogany desk.  A bay window overlooks the grounds, letting in a shaft of silvery starlight.  Pulled up to the desk is a chair fit for nobility, from its velvet upholstery to its majestic size.  Behind the chair a large heraldic crest hangs, the only adornment on the otherwise plain teak paneled walls.

title: [The Keep, Entrance Hall North]
description: Alternating squares of onyx and white marble cover the floor.  Tapestries march along the gallery on both sides, ending at a grand staircase at the north end of the hall that leads to an upper floor.  To the west a set of double doors, adorned with gracefully shaped brass handles, mark the entrance to the library.  The low, soothing sound of meditation chimes drifts through the hall from the chamber to the east.

title: [Library, Reading Room]
description: Several rows of shelving are bracketed at either end with small desks.  The north end of the room has a variety of chairs, desks, and couches set up for perusing the materials on the shelves.  An abstract sculpture stands at the center of the reading area and a large sign has been posted next to the set of double doors that lead back to the main hall.

title: [Second Floor, Main Hall]
description: Two staircases cross here, one set of steps upwards and one down.  The cramped space smells faintly of food and sweat and the passing of many people.  A mural runs across what would otherwise be a featureless wall at the back of the landing.  A thick iron door leads into a salle, while through a large open arch rows of tables and benches are visible.

title: [The Keep, Refectory]
description: Looking large enough to house hundreds of people at a time, the room still feels crowded by the closely spaced benches.  Long oak tables line the length of the room with matching lines of benches beside them.  A small podium stands against the western wall with a thick leather-bound book atop it.  Judging by the savory smells drifting from the south, the swinging door set in the south wall leads to the kitchen.

title: [The Keep, Kitchen]
description: A swinging door provides glimpses of the long tables and benches in the refectory each time it opens.  The walls of the kitchen are lined with counters, water tubs, and stone-lined ovens positioned to vent excess heat through the outer wall.  The floor is slightly slick from spilled food but the kitchen is otherwise clean.

title: [Salle]
description: Several racks of wooden practice weapons stand opposite the windows in the outer wall, illuminated by the moonlight coming through the windows.  Squares, circles, triangles, and a smattering of other odd shapes are demarcated in darkly stained wood at wide intervals on the honey-colored, polished hardwood floor.

title: [The Meditation Chamber]
description: Four rows of pews are arranged in a square, facing inward toward an unadorned altar holding a lamp lit with a steadily burning flame.  Soft gauzy fabric panels drape down from each of the corners of the room.  Suspended from the ceiling, a set of meditation chimes rotates slowly, filling the room with a rhythmic pattern of sound.

title: [Library, Scriptorium]
description: Light blazes from a chandelier hanging from the center of the ceiling.  A short row of tilt-topped desks sits directly below the light, while lining the walls are all the necessary tools for copying manuscripts, binding books, and making endpapers.  A granite sink and marble countertop stand along the west wall.

title: [Third Floor, Main Hall]
description: A fel balustrade keeps the unwary from falling over the edge of this balcony overlooking the grand entrance hall below.  A thick crimson carpet with gold fringe covers the hardwood floors.  Sitting opposite the balustrade is a small rosewood table flanked by a pair of cushioned chairs.

title: [Quartermaster's Office]
description: Hardwood planks extend from the salle into the office, only to snake underneath the rugs scattered on the floor.  Resting in a corner is a small wooden desk with an upholstered chair sitting behind it.  A large, white vultite shield hangs from the wall behind the desk.  Tall bookshelves, overflowing with records and books, stand against the eastern wall.

title: [Armory]
description: Piles of shields fill one corner of the room, while stacks of leather armors fill another.  The back wall is covered with racks of various weapons, while the side walls hold neat rows of stands stocked with heavier armor.

title: [Third Floor, Main Hall West]
description: The fel balustrade curves inward slightly, forming a smooth curve that ends beside the door set in the southern wall.  A golden tinged carpet with crimson fringe covers the floor, leaving thin edges of hardwood exposed.  Two paintings hang close together on the crimson wall, their golden frames complementing the carpet.

title: [Grandmaster's Quarters]
description: Warmth extends from the marble fireplace in the corner to every other point in the room, including the large, four-poster bed on the opposite wall.  A mahogany armoire and dresser set flank the fireplace, while a small window is cracked open to allow fresh air to flow through the room.

title: [Third Floor, Main Hall East]
description: Braided rugs cover the hardwood floor, although some signs of weathering can be seen where the wood remains uncovered.  A golden-framed painting shines from the crimson-papered wall beside a ladder that leads to a trapdoor in the roof.

title: [The Keep Rooftop, Northeast]
description: A sturdy wooden ladder emerges from the rock floor, allowing access back into the keep.  The tall parapet is reinforced here to ensure that access is not blocked by a lucky strike from a besieger's trebuchet, although the thick ramparts below make it unlikely that the precaution will ever be tested.  On the corner of the parapet, a thick pole holds aloft a black flag with a brilliant white shield emblazoned on it.

title: [Guards' Quarters]
description: Rows of wooden bunk beds fill the room.  At the foot of each bed stand two footlockers.  Small tables stand between each set of bunks, each with a lantern and a prayerbook neatly set atop them.  A long rug runs down the center of the room.

title: [Guards' Quarters]
description: Sets of bunk beds and small tables are lined up against the western and eastern walls of the room and take up fully half the space available.  In the remaining area are a variety of chairs, couches, and cushions scattered around haphazardly.  A long fireplace occupies the south wall, radiating its warmth far into the room.

title: [The Keep Rooftop, Northwest]
description: From the great height afforded by this vantage point, the dark expanse of the Lake of Fear reflecting the light of the stars, can be seen over the parapet.  The strong basalt ramparts below provide ample protection from whatever might emerge from the wilds.  A long forked pole rests across two hooks on the parapet.

title: [The Keep Rooftop, Southwest]
description: Fearling Pass, silvered in the moonlight, is easily visible through the key-shaped openings in the tall parapet.  The outer wall of the keep is only visible where torches atop the walls cast golden pools on the stone.  A rope rests on a hook pounded into the parapet.

title: [The Keep Rooftop, Southeast]
description: Key-shaped openings in the parapet allow a moonlit view of the lands to the southeast.  The fortress' polished basalt ramparts are visible only where lit torches cast pools of light on them far below.  A small stack of boulders sits in the corner, ready for use.

title: [Grandmaster's Chapel]
description: Light filters through a small stained glass window onto a simple altar covered in white samite.  A prie-dieu has been placed directly in front of the altar, holding a small prayerbook on the elbow rest.  The rest of the room has been paneled and floored in honey-colored oak that lacks any adornment.

title: [The Keep, Kitchen]
description: Large rock-lined ovens cover the western wall, their heat emanating into the room and making it slightly uncomfortable.  Nearby stands a small stack of wood, ready to stoke the fires within the ovens.  A long counter stands empty of food, a wide variety of knives and other kitchen utensils stowed in baskets and blocks along its back.  Hanging over the counter is a large copper pot rack.

title: [DeArchon Home, Hallway]
description: A long, dimly lit passageway extends past a circular stairwell.  Along the hall are ornate-framed paintings, each one depicting a variety of ships at sea.  The hall ends at an arched glass-paneled door.

title: [DeArchon Home, Upstairs]
description: The stairwell leads up to a wide upstairs hall.  A window is set into the wall at the further end of the hallway, draped over by a heavy blue curtain.

title: [DeArchon Home, Kitchen]
description: Three brick ovens are set into a wall, and a long dark oak table is centered in the kitchen.  A number of polished gold-inlaid plates are neatly stacked in a wooden rack near a tall pantry.

title: [DeArchon Home, Den]
description: A soft, red plush chair sits next to a claw-footed stand, just mere feet from a wide, neatly organized bookshelf. A small silver tray upon the stand houses a half-used plump brown cigar.

title: [DeArchon Home, Guest Room]
description: Dark brown walls enclose this simple guest chamber, where a single bed rests near a nightstand and a curtained window in the corner.  A small armoire and writing desk are positioned up against a wall, right beneath a high wooden shelf holding a number of leather-bound tomes.

title: [The Wellington Home, Courtyard]
description: Several tall, graceful willow trees grow around the airy courtyard, their draping branches hanging low over the fence.  Off to one side, a stack of old books sits next to a large circle of paving stones.  Bright cherry red double doors lead into the two-story gabled building, and set into a thick metal post near the orphanage is a scroll-worked brass plaque.  You also see a series of rope swings hanging from the trees.

title: [Festival of Frost, Grounds]
description: The candle-lit path leads to an expansive, circular cobblestone quarter.  In the center of the area rises a large sculpted ice totem surrounded by four dark rosewood benches.  Heavily-clothed townspeople move about, sipping hot drinks while chattering amongst themselves.  A trio of colorfully dressed halflings greet every passerby, offering a kind welcome and drawing attention to a huge frost-covered sign.

title: [Festival of Frost, Battlefield]
description: Large dunes of snow rise and fall across the field as a brisk wind rustles through the icy banks, sending glistening snowflakes floating about.  A number of old and weathered wagons lie scattered about the grounds, each one draped with a layer of frost.  The wooden remains of a battering ram barely peek out from a huge snow drift.

title: [Festival of Frost, Grounds]
description: A cluster of smooth wooden tables have been set out around the area, many of them being attended to by busy workers as they clear away leftover food and dirty plates.  The strong aroma of baked bread drifts out of the flap of a huge yellow tent.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Festival of Frost, Warm Treats]
description: The interior yellow walls of the tent are heavily adorned with colorful wreaths and rows of decorative crystal icicles hang from the ceiling beams, twinkling as light catches their surfaces.  A row of stone ovens have been set out in the back of the tent, the strong fragrance of baked goods permeating the area.  A line of simple wooden tables dominate the center of the tent.

title: [Festival of Frost, Shop]
description: Wooden plank walls keep in the warmth from a small fire pit that rests in the corner of this quaint shop.  A variety of trinkets and baubles are secured safely inside a wide display case, while a pair of bearskin-cloaked giantmen attend to customers from behind a long rosewood counter.  The light of a large bonfire outside glows through the shop's windows.

title: [Festival of Frost, Grounds]
description: The light of the sun warms the area, as the roaring bonfire from nearby casts a faint glow in the air.  Children dart about, throwing snowballs at each other before running back over to a snowy field.  Close by, a group of burly giantmen lug armfuls of firewood down a torch-lit trail.

title: [Festival of Frost, Bonfire]
description: Long wooden logs form a wide circle around a giant, roaring bonfire.  The heat of the flames has melted away most of the snow in the area, leaving behind only dirt and mud.

title: [Festival of Frost, Snow Field]
description: A field of frost-covered ground extends outward, generously dotted with large mounds of snow.  A tall wooden fence encloses the icy meadow and children run in and out of a giant ice castle, tagging each other with snowballs.

title: [Festival of Frost, Slush Hill]
description: A wide snowy hill stretches up over a large field, its icy surface glistening from the sunlight.  Varying sizes of deep footprints weave around the entire frosty crest.  Nearby, a group of young children laugh and play as they work tirelessly to construct a giant snowman.

title: [Festival of Frost, Slush Hill]
description: A wide snowy hill stretches up over a large field, its icy surface glistening from the sunlight.  Varying sizes of deep footprints weave around the entire frosty crest.  Nearby, a group of young children laugh and play as they work tirelessly to construct a giant snowman.

title: [Festival of Frost, Slush Hill]
description: A wide snowy hill stretches up over a large field, its icy surface glistening from the sunlight.  Varying sizes of deep footprints weave around the entire frosty crest.  Nearby, a group of young children laugh and play as they work tirelessly to construct a giant snowman.

title: [Festival of Frost, Slush Hill]
description: A wide snowy hill stretches up over a large field, its icy surface glistening from the sunlight.  Varying sizes of deep footprints weave around the entire frosty crest.  Nearby, a group of young children laugh and play as they work tirelessly to construct a giant snowman.

title: [Festival, Snowflake Stable]
description: The glow of the nearby bonfire can be seen from the edge of the field, which comes to an end at a long wooden fence.  Snow-covered trees dot the landscape, muffling the zealous cries of playful children in the distance.

title: [Festival of Frost, Frozen Pond]
description: The large field opens up into a grove of snow-covered trees, each ones' bare branches stretching out over the surface of a shimmering frozen pond.  A burly giantman with a tangled grey beard crouches near a tree, fileting a large fish with his jagged knife.

title: [Festival of Frost, Grounds]
description: A crowd of onlookers stand on the outside of half-walled arena, watching as a number of people skate across a stretch of ice.  A long, bright red wooden stand is set up nearby, where a burly giantman stands behind, hawking his wares to people passing by.  The scent of baking bread wafts in from nearby.

title: [Festival of Frost, Ice Arena]
description: A smooth landscape of hard ice stretches across the entire length of the circular arena.  Half-walls border the ring, providing both protection and a view for onlookers.  A crisp chill hovers in the air.

title: [The Wellington Home, Entrance]
description: Each length of the room is coated in pale colors, ranging from yellow to green to blue and lavender.  Along the walls are wood-framed illustrations, each clearly painted by children.  Off the eastern wall, a wide stairway ascends to the second floor.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, out

title: [The Wellington Home, Dormitory]
description: Stretching the width of the building, and painted in cool blue and green hues, the room is organized with several rows of neatly made bunk-beds.  Two trunks flank each bed for personal belongings, but otherwise the room is scarcely furnished.  A few chairs are scattered about, and a tall bookcase with a small selection of history books stands before the balustrade separating the stairway from the room.  A brightly painted door leads to a large washroom.

title: [The Wellington Home, Office]
description: The walls are a soft russet hue and decorated with canvas tapestries depicting colorful fields and forests.  A simple oak desk rests before a carved wooden chair, while a shelf full of clay art hangs on a wall next to a paneled wooden door.  Candlelight infuses the office with a warm glow.

title: [The Wellington Home, Class Room]
description: Brightly lit and painted in warm cream tones, the tidy room is filled with desks, all orderly arranged in groups.  A large chalkboard dominates the far wall, which has been covered in a clutter of writing.  A light grey-robed woman sits at a wide oak desk, flipping through the pages of a thick tome.

title: [The Wellington Home, Party Room]
description: The spacious hall is festively painted in bright colors, its high ceilings ringed with luminous flickering lanterns.  Vibrant paper streamers drape from the walls and some cheerfully decorated tables border an expansive polished walnut dance floor.

title: [The Wellington Home, Mess Hall]
description: Long bench-style tables stretch across the entire length of the room, each with stacks of plates and cutlery organized on each end in preparation of mealtime.  A slatted swinging door swishes as a number of older children in aprons move about assisting the cooks.

title: [The Wellington Home, Study Room]
description: Low modwir shelves fill the room alongside some tables with straight-backed chairs.  Lit candles illuminate a series of well-used books along the shelves.  In the center of the room is a raised platform, where a wooden pedestal stands unattended.

title: [Town Barracks, Inner Courtyard]
description: Stone walls wrap around to form a solid enclosure to the courtyard, the ground smooth and paved with dark cobblestones.  Barely visible beyond the thick iron gate stretches North Ring Road and an expanse of the palisades of Wehnimer's Landing.  A large two-story brick building dominates the far end of the courtyard, its roof topped with a black and grey flag.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Main Lobby]
description: A dark riverstone statue occupies the center of the expansive public space, its height drawing attention to a painted dome two stories overhead.  The pale stone floor and walls echo with the purposeful footsteps of citizens moving around the building, and with the brisk conversation of those who occupy the benches along the walls.  Two large windows flank the wide entryway, bathing the lobby in gentle golden light.

A dark riverstone statue occupies the center of the expansive public space, its height drawing attention to the dome that rises two stories overhead.  Silence hangs heavy on the night air, and the few citizens moving around the building do so with an air of dour resignation.  A few benches stand empty along the walls, which reflect the silvered moonlight that streams through the two entryside windows.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [ShadowGuard, South Courtyard]
description: The dank, musty smell of rotting vegetation pervades this area as death has taken hold.  Overgrown with weeds and uncontrolled, twisted plant life, the courtyard must once have been beautiful.  The crumbling remnants of a gatehouse tower, and occasional intact pieces of the southern wall, stand as a sad reminder of the former might of the fortress.

title: [ShadowGuard, Gatehouse Tower]
description: The bottom floor of the tower is strewn with the rotting remnants of an ancient wooden desk and several chairs.  The rusted remains of a large weapons rack sag against one wall.  The air is so damp the moisture is palpable, and moss covers much of the cracked stone walls and rotting furniture.  A dilapidated archway leads back to the courtyard.

title: [Griffin's Landing, Plaza]
description: Surrounded by thick wooden walls, a tall black obelisk marks the entrance to this small outpost.  At the center of the camp stands the King's Bane Saloon, overlooking a small, glistening pond.  To the east several flags on a pole dance in the wind above the Onyx Griffin Trading Post near a wide war wagon.  The eastern area is dominated by a series of tall stables.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Courtyard]
description: Though dead and withered, the crisp clean lines of the formal gardens are still clearly visible.  Bright white pebbled walkways cut a sinuous pattern through the decaying flora winding their way around the cathedral to the northeast.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Tower]
description: Several rusted-out metal cabinets lie overturned amongst piles of rubble, spilling a variety of antiquated weapons onto the dust-covered stone floor.  Deep cracks in the walls allow a slight breeze to enter, but the breeze does nothing to alleviate the heavy dampness in the air.  Strategically placed stones jut out from the curved walls to form a stairway leading to the level above.

title: [Shadowguard, East Courtyard]
description: Neglected gardens have overgrown their boundaries here, spilling out over the pebbled walkways.  Several rotting trellises, heavy with twisted blackened roses, have collapsed against the deteriorating walls.  A pair of glowing eyes peers from beneath the tangled mess.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Tower]
description: Circular stone walls surround a large pile of debris that dominates the center of the room.  The remains of a desk, chairs, and broken pottery make up the bulk of the pile, while a few rusting weapons lie discarded nearby.  A small stairway cut into the east wall leads upward.

title: [Shadowguard, North Courtyard]
description: Piles of stone and timber litter the courtyard.  To the south, crumbling walls extend from the rear of the cathedral, the skeletal remains of the keep that once stood here.  The outer wall has been reclaimed by nature to the east, while a small section still stands to the west.

title: [ShadowGuard, North Tower]
description: Dust lies heavily on the hard stone floor of the tower.  Curved walls rise high above to a rough plank ceiling.  An abandoned desk and two overturned chairs bear testimony to the tower's former use.

title: [Shadowguard, Central Courtyard]
description: The imposing facade of a once grand cathedral dominates the northern edge of this courtyard.  Formal gardens languish, overgrown and rotting, in a mockery of their former beauty.  Pebbled paths follow along the building's front, leading east and west.

title: [ShadowGuard, Cathedral Entryway]
description: Graceful arches soar overhead, supporting a vaulted ceiling covered in badly faded frescoes depicting random scenes from the history of House Vaalor.  Matching arches open to the east and west, leading from this large foyer to long dark hallways.  Fallen from their hinges, two massive doors hang askew, the opening between them leading back out to the courtyard.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, out

title: [ShadowGuard, Gatehouse Tower]
description: The stone walls of this level of the tower are badly cracked, with many of the gaps opening wide enough to offer views of the courtyard below.  Evenly spaced cross-shaped arrow slits mingle with the gaping fissures on the southern wall.  Several rusted and rotting weapon racks lean against the remaining walls.  Large arches leading out onto the southern wall are open to the east and west.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down

title: [ShadowGuard, Gatehouse Tower]
description: The roof of the tower has collapsed, and the remains litter the floor of this upper room.  Among the rubble grow a scattering of flowers, grasses, and a small sapling.  The northern wall of the room has caved in as well, giving a magnificent view of the surrounding forest and decaying cathedral.

title: [ShadowGuard, South Wall]
description: Tall battlements line both the north and south sides of this narrow walkway atop the wall.  Solid stonework here has withstood the ravages that destroyed most of the fortress.  Rusting weapon racks bear the only testimony to the passing of time.

title: [ShadowGuard, South Wall]
description: The narrow walkway terminates abruptly to the west, halting further progress along this portion of the parapet.  The northern battlements have crumbled into disorganized piles of stone and rusted metal, leaving an unobstructed view of the courtyard below.

title: [ShadowGuard, South Wall]
description: Crumbling and unstable, the southern portion of the wall that once surrounded the ShadowGuard falls away before you.  Thirty feet below, jagged stones that were once part of the wall jut upward at haphazard angles.  Loose rocks on the decaying flagstones make for hazardous footing on this precarious ledge.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Tower]
description: Crumbling blocks of stone stand precariously at barely half the height of the original walls.  Gaping holes and the fallen arches to the north and south combine with the jagged walls to give the room the impression of a grinning skull.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Wall]
description: The neglected battlements rise and fall in chunks along the dilapidated wall as it runs perfectly north to south.  Rusting helmets and the twisted mountings for a ballista are all that are remarkable here.  Far to the east, the sun glints off of water in the distance.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Wall]
description: The neglected battlements rise and fall along the dilapidated wall as it runs perfectly north to south.  The southern end of the wall ends abruptly with a long drop to the remains of a fallen tower below.  The thick evergreen forest that surrounds the keep's south side has encroached to the base of the wall, nearly obscuring the tower's remains.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Wall]
description: The neglected battlements rise and fall along the dilapidated wall as it runs perfectly north to south.  Random gaps in the battlements and loose stones underfoot increase the difficulty of traversing this section of wall.  Through the gaps to the east a distant river can be seen meandering through the forest.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Wall]
description: Shifting as it fell, the northeastern corner tower has come to rest against this section of wall, blocking any further travel north.  Entire sections of the battlements have fallen away into the forest below from the force of the impact.

title: [ShadowGuard, North Tower]
description: Two low archways, running east and west, are the only openings in the circular walls.  The western archway leads out onto the northern parapet, while through the eastern archway you can make out the dilapidated skeleton of what was once the northeastern tower.  An iron ladder has been bolted into the southern wall, dust adding to the thick layers of rust.

title: [ShadowGuard, North Tower]
description: Thick layers of dust lay undisturbed on the worn stone floor.  Empty iron sconces, evenly spaced around the room, still hang securely from the strong walls.  Rising up through a small opening in the floor, an iron ladder has been bolted to the southern wall and leads to a trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [ShadowGuard, North Wall]
description: The remnants of a ballista lay strewn about the base of an inverted keyhole embrasure.  The battlements to either side are neglected, yet mostly intact.  Nearly covered in layers of debris is the rusted blade of a broken sword.

title: [ShadowGuard, North Wall]
description: A huge gap yawns before you, the wall between here and the northwestern tower having completely collapsed.  Thirty feet below, the large sections of the wall lay imbedded in the soft earth of the courtyard.  Pieces of the wall continue to crumble at the slightest touch, and any further progress west is impossible.

title: [ShadowGuard, North Tower]
description: This uppermost portion of the tower shows very little deterioration, and the battlements around its circumference remain intact.  The expansive forest to the north has nearly reached the base of the wall sixty feet below you.  To the south lie the cathedral and the skeletal remains of the keep.  A trapdoor leads back down into the depths of the tower.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Tower]
description: Sprawled around the room are several wooden armor stands in various stages of decomposition and repose.  A few still remain upright, bearing their long-forgotten burdens proudly, while others have succumbed to the ravages of time and rot, depositing their charges unceremoniously on the rough plank floor.  A few cobweb-covered helmets hang from rusty iron spikes that have been driven into one wall.  A large archway in the northern wall leads out to the western battlements.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Wall]
description: This section of the crenellated parapet is in relatively good condition, unlike most other areas of this once proud fortress.  Inverted keyhole embrasures, evenly spaced along the western battlements, stand guard over the immense forest that looms just on the other side of the wall.  Loose bits of stone and debris crunch underfoot with the slightest movement.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Wall]
description: The forest to the west has encroached to the base of the western wall, tall trees standing like silent sentinels awaiting orders.  A lone oak has fallen over and sags against the wall, its dead upper branches barely clearing the top of the deteriorating crenels.  Ivy has begun its own assault, but has so far only managed to climb about halfway up the high wall.  Loose bits of stone mix with dead leaves in every available corner of the walkway.

title: [ShadowGuard, Northwest Tower]
description: Brittle, curling leaves mix with layers of dust and debris on the worn stone floor.  The moldy, rotten remnants of a wooden weapons rack sit next to a narrow, western-facing window.  Long, thin fingers of ivy cling to the inside edge of the window, invading the fortress inch by slow inch.  A stone stairway juts out from the circular tower walls and winds upward, disappearing through a warped hole in the rough plank ceiling.

title: [ShadowGuard, Northwest Tower]
description: Large sections of the northern and eastern walls of this uppermost room have long since fallen away, scattering rubble on the ground below.  Long, thick vines of ivy have worked their way inward through the missing sections and have started to spread along the western and southern walls.  A stone stairway leads downward through a hole in the warped rough plank flooring.

title: [Cathedral, Bell Tower]
description: Four stone pillars, one at each corner of the room, once supported the long-gone ceiling.  Broken heavy wooden beams lean precariously, having fallen from their supports.   A lone, rusting metal bracket hangs loosely from one of the timbers dangling a bit of rope, the only indication that a bell once hung there.  Bits of wood and stone litter the rough wood plank floor here.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Wing]
description: Fine, slightly faded tapestries hang from the walls along this hallway, depicting scenes of glory and honor.  The scenes flow from east to west, telling a story as they go.  Valiant elven warriors fight bravely near the eastern end, only to fall midway through and be anointed heroes in the westernmost tapestries.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Wing]
description: Dust, seemingly undisturbed for centuries, covers everything here.  Bits of plaster, fallen from the ceiling overhead, and numerous small stones litter the floor.  Tattered remnants of cloth droop forlornly from a rusted rod on the north wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [ShadowGuard, West Wing]
description: This dark stretch of hallway seems completely void of life.  The bare stone ceiling above has lost its former glory as all of the once fine plaster is missing.  Rusting iron sconces line the north wall, their emptiness a fitting testament to the absence of light in this desolate place.

title: [ShadowGuard, West Wing]
description: This room is oddly triangular, with the west wall running perpendicular to the hallway to the east.  A gaping round opening, centered in the flat west wall, holds the rusting framework of a once marvelous stained glass window.  A few colored pieces of glass cling to the iron framework like bits of flesh to bleached bones.

title: [ShadowGuard, Chamber]
description: Lines of rust on the hard stone floor and a few feathers mark where a bed once stood.  A set of polished vaalorn full plate, embossed with the insignia of the Sabrar, stands remarkably untouched by time on a stand just inside the door, a faint glow surrounding it.  Bits of wood give vague hints at the rest of the room's previous furnishings.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Wing]
description: Still-vivid frescoes depicting victorious elven warriors cover the ceiling of this magnificent hallway.  Light, in muted pastel tones, filters through the stained glass windows that line the southern wall.  A majestic statue of Koar dominates the northern wall.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Wing]
description: Sculpted columns of woodwork support the frescoed ceiling here.  Intricately carved to resemble a Vaalorian Legion shield wall, tiny figures support one another as they stretch towards the rafters overhead.  Time has started to eat away at the marvelous carvings, the wood beginning to rot in several places.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [ShadowGuard, Chamber]
description: Utilitarian furnishings make this bedroom nothing special.  A square wood writing table matches the unremarkable dresser and side table that sit near the plain square bed.   A faded parchment with what appears to be a guard rotation schedule on it is tacked to the wall above the bed.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Wing]
description: The frescoes adorning this portion of the wide hallway depict various key moments throughout the history of the Elven Empire.  An elegant teak hutch stands against the north wall as a poignant reminder to the opulence of the former inhabitants.

title: [ShadowGuard, Chamber]
description: A square wood writing table matches the stark dresser and side table that sit near the plain square bed.  A small signet stamp lies overturned on the writing table, the crest of the ShadowGuard garrison visible on its underside.

title: [ShadowGuard, East Wing]
description: This room is oddly triangular, with the east wall running perpendicular to the hallway to the west.  A large round stained glass window, centered in the east wall, is remarkably fully intact.  Brilliant pastel shades bathe the room as the sunlight filters through the magnificent image of a noble elven warrior.

title: [ShadowGuard, Chamber]
description: Rotting linens cover what once must have been a plush mattress in the far corner, the utilitarian cast iron frame nearly completely rusted away.  An armor stand and weapons rack, with the mark of the Sabrar, grace the near wall, while a small writing desk is the room's only other furnishing.

title: [The Onyx Griffin Trading Post]
description: Resting in the center of the office lies an enormous, matted, and blackened war griffin-crested rug.  An oak desk covered in disheveled piles of papers and order forms, sits in front of a large, ale-stained rates chart.  Several large shipping crates are stacked so high that they partially obscure a dust covered window.  Beside the window, three small booths have been established.

title: [The King's Bane Saloon]
description: Highly polished, interlocking planks create the masterfully designed flooring in the tavern.  Several pitch black mossbark stools line a fully stocked, elongated marble bar.  A marble fireplace, crafted in the image of a griffin perched on a mountain top, dominates the rear.  A small draft from an open window pulls small puffs of smoke from off the griffin's eye.  Three small steps lead the way down into a black sand roshambo pit.

title: [Griffin's Landing, Hidden Oasis]
description: An abundance of color fills the land surrounding the calm water disturbed only by a small waterfall that flows over the perimeter wall.  A short, partially concealed tunnel can be seen behind the flow of water.  A large wooden dock extends into the water, providing a dry walkway to a small island in the lake where Blubber's ice cream stand awaits.  A group of wide trees emerging from the water's edge support a small hammock and an oak swing.

title: [Little Man's Alehouse]
description: Mushroom lanterns hung along the damp walls light this dark compact room, illuminating the crushed peanut shells littering the floor.  Pint-size mushroom stools are arranged alongside a squatty mithril bar.  Several shelves display a supply of liquor as a severed orc's head, mounted above an invar plaque, glares ominously at the jovial scene.  A fire crackles and pops from a roughly chiseled hole in the far wall, while a short tunnel leads up and out.

title: [Griffin's Landing, Small Dock]
description: Dominating the center of the area is a long derelict elven airship docked on a wide landing bay.  Thick, black smoke rises above the trading post in the nearby plaza while several multi-level cottages are huddled near the Dreadnaught Alliance Embassy.

title: [Alliance Embassy and Forums]
description: The tall crystal dome of the ceiling captures the light, bathing the room in a bright glow.  The center of the room is dominated by a marble table, surrounded by a dozen chairs.  A staircase leading up to the small loft of offices, wraps around the base of the dome.  On the east wall, rows of benches are arranged in a crescent moon pattern around an oak stage that rises out from the riverstone floor.  A wide parchment, encased in glass, is mounted atop an ironwood podium.

title: [The Alliance Jail Cell]
description: A heavy mithril hatch secures the jail cells from the rest of the outpost.  The only source of light is a small griffin-shaped lantern sitting on top of a desk.  On the rear wall a large notice board is covered with warrants and wanted posters.  The port side is lined with two sturdy iron holding cells.  A collection set of chains and shackles are on display at the rear of the room, while almost hidden away in the far corner, three skeletons still dangle from their restraints.

title: [House Phoenix, Entry]
description: The floor of the main entry is of dark flagstone, deeply polished, the walls are of white marble, veined with crimson.  The walls are hung with brightly colored tapestries and filigreed oil lamps are set in bronze sconces to illuminate them.  Standing in even ranks along the walls are many types of armor from half a hundred eras and regions, each seeming to wait patiently for the trumpets of battle to sound, as they ever have and ever will.
tags: meta:mapname:Wehnimer's Landing - House Of The Rising Phoenix

title: [Phoenix Annex, Courtyard]
description: Within this serene courtyard, a variety of young trees and flowering bushes thrive along the flagstone path leading from the archway to the main building.  A small grove of cherry trees provides a shady retreat near some polished wooden benches placed along a grassy bank leading down to a small bubbling spring.  Nestled within the shade of the fruit trees sits a small cherrywood beehive.  A polished cherry dart board inlaid with a rising phoenix hangs from a willow tree.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Willow Tree]
description: This quiet, leafy bower seems remote from the courtyard below.  The gentle swaying of the tree in the breeze and the susurration of the leaves is relaxing.  Peering down through the willow branches you can spy the natural pool below.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Natural Springs]
description: The small spring is lined with a brilliant array of colorful stones.  Exotic plants, carefully arranged to provide privacy, grow in profusion along the bank.  A tall willow tree leans gracefully over the spring, as if granting its blessing on the swimmers.  The bottom of the spring is lined with fine sand, oddly warm to the feet.  Air bubbles rush up from below, tickling the bare parts of your skin.  A small waterfall trickles musically down a jumble of rocks, and a small wooden fishing dock juts out from a sandy bank.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Fishing Dock]
description: The natural springs surrounding this dock start off shallow, but quickly turn deep at its very center.  All around the edges of this small dock are spots to stick a fishing pole, and a weatherbeaten driftwood bench rests at the far end, closest to the deepest part of the spring.  Protected from the elements, a small fire burns, remnants of previous fish fries evident all around it.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Hyssopp's Niche]
description: A fine mist eddies about your ankles as you enter this quiet niche.  Well-tended herbs and flowers grow in abundance around a pure-white marbled bench, tickling the senses with the scent of hyssop, rosemary, mint and jasmine.  The sound of trickling water draws your eyes to a small grotto cut into a wall of gray rock glistening with moisture.  The grotto shelters a statuette perched upon an ivory altar covered with a pristine sheen of water that drips from an over-hanging rock.

title: [House Phoenix, Grand Hall]
description: The elegant Grand Hall appears to have hosted many a merry celebration.  Candlelight from faceted ruby and crystal chandeliers casts a warm glow over a grand cherry banquet table and matching gilded chairs.  Mirror-clad arched alcoves on one wall hold small tables for private gatherings.  Marble pilasters with gilded capitals depicting rising phoenixes frame elaborately figured silk tapestries flanking the great white marble fireplace on the eastern wall.  At the west end of the room rests a small bar.

title: [House Phoenix, Kitchens]
description: Here in the kitchens, a large oven warms the room and fills it with the scent of baking bread.  An ancient iron cauldron bubbles over an open fire, as rich steam billows forth to carry the aroma of rolton stew into the air as well.  The walls of the room are filled with shelves and cupboards stacked high with dried and preserved foods of all sorts.  Piles of fresh vegetables and slabs of finely marbled meats wait for the deft hand of the chef to prepare them.

title: [House Phoenix, Library]
description: The library of the House is a largish room, with walls completely hidden by bookcases.  A wide selection of reading material can be seen from a cursory glance.  Treatises on science and history stand next to ancient volumes on forest lore and magic.  One rather extensive section seems devoted to arms and armor and the many subjects dealing with the arts of war.  Locked glass-fronted cabinets hold rare tomes and fragile scrolls and even the odd clay tablet.  Scattered around the room are several chairs.

title: [House Phoenix, Second Floor]
description: A series of paintings hung along the walls here celebrate the founding officers of the House.  Two doors, one painted red, the other gold, lead to guest bedrooms.  To the south is a brightly painted door and eastwards, a solid oak door bars entrance to the Planning Room.

title: [House Phoenix, Planning Room]
description: An ornate circular table, surrounded by large, upholstered chairs dominates the planning room.  Hanging from the ceiling is a well-polished crystal chandelier.  Banners of red and gold, worked with the insignia of the House, hang from the walls.  An elaborately framed painting dominates one wall.

title: [Palma & Evynn's Room]
description: This is a room somewhat larger than most on this floor.  Soft pastel colors adorn the walls and brightly-colored curtains give a warm family atmosphere to the surroundings.  Nearly tripping over a child's rubber rolton, you note that room has been made for a child's bed to one side along with all the myriad items needed to keep one amused and clean.

title: [House Phoenix, Guest Bedroom]
description: This simple monastic cell is sparsely furnished.  A small bed with plain linen sheets, a single thin pillow, a rough wool blanket.  An unvarnished oak table is flanked by a pair of spindle-backed chairs.  A tall bookcase, filled with scholarly tomes and scrolls, is the only extravagance in the room.

title: [House Phoenix, Bedroom]
description: A rug of black wool bordered with gold tassles dominates the decor of this room.  Centered on the finely woven rug is a large, life-like image of a blazing phoenix.  Against one wall stands an ornate mahogany bed.  An empty pewter candle holder sits on the nightstand beside the bed.

title: [House Phoenix, Wine Cellar]
description: This room is used for storage of the House beverage supply.  Large casks, kegs and bottles of all sizes are stacked along the walls or in bins and on shelves.  You recognize labels from places both near and far.  Many labels are old and brown from age but the bottles are sound though covered with dust and cobwebs.  You are tempted to draw a sample or two but decide to wait for a better opportunity.  Some of the best quality vintages are stored in a locked row of bins to keep them from 'evaporating'.

title: [House Phoenix, Maruko's Chamber]
description: Tendrils of a strange scent assault your nose as you peer around a dimly lit stone chamber.  Fading embers from a fireplace are the only illumination and a cloud of incense forms arabesques above a brazier nearby.  Coarse granite shapes the walls and ceiling and darkly polished marble flooring reflects the feeble light.  A huge grey wolf stands poised near the door and a canopied bed looms near the fireplace.  Odd weapons and strange bits of armor lie scattered about the room.

title: [House Phoenix, Caverns]
description: The faint whisper of wings echoes through this dark, musty cavern.  A small natural pit holds a pile of debris and ashes.  The air is still and cool.

title: [House Phoenix, Lower Hall]
description: The few guttering candles provide barely enough light to avoid stumbling over the uneven tile floor.  The stone walls of this narrow hallway are cool and slightly damp to the touch.  The air, heavy and humid, smells slightly of mildew.

title: [House Phoenix, Gaq's Dungeon]
description: A few small logs burn in the firepit, casting strange shadows that dance against the uneven stone walls of the cavern.  The flickering light illuminates a crude painting on the wall.  A tiny rivulet of water trickles down the stone wall into a crude basin that has been hollowed out of the stone.  The only furnishings are a simple bed of maoral wood and a small matching table.  A statuette stands on the small table.

title: [House Phoenix, Hall]
description: The few guttering candles provide barely enough light to avoid stumbling over the uneven tile floor.  The stone walls of this narrow hallway are cool and slightly damp to the touch.  The air, heavy and humid, smells slightly of mildew.

title: [House Phoenix, Hall]
description: The few guttering candles provide barely enough light to avoid stumbling over the uneven tile floor.  The stone walls of this narrow hallway are cool and slightly damp to the touch.  The air, heavy and humid, smells slightly of mildew.

title: [House Phoenix, Hall]
description: The few guttering candles provide barely enough light to avoid stumbling over the uneven tile floor.  The stone walls of this narrow hallway are cool and slightly damp to the touch.  The air, heavy and humid, smells slightly of mildew.

title: [House Phoenix, Hall]
description: The few guttering candles provide barely enough light to avoid stumbling over the uneven tile floor.  The stone walls of this narrow hallway are cool and slightly damp to the touch.  The air, heavy and humid, smells slightly of mildew.

title: [House Phoenix, Alcove]
description: This alcove is plushly floored with thick carpeting that extends up the treads of a spiral stair to the next level.

title: [House Phoenix, Observatory]
description: Here on the highest level of the building, most of the walls and the roof seem to be formed of a clear glasslike crystal that allows an almost unrestricted view of the sky above and the surrounding townscape.  Various instruments of observation and study stand on a raised platform in the middle of the room.  To the south is a hallway.

title: [House Phoenix, Platform]
description: From this platform, you gain a magnificent view through the windows and skylight.  The town can be studied easily in relative comfort from this high vantage point.  The sun streaming in warms and relaxes those sitting beneath the skylight.

title: [House Phoenix, 3rd Floor hall]
description: This hallway ends at a door painted in pale colors.  North is the observation platform and additional rooms.

title: [House Phoenix, Wisraith's Room]
description: The furnishings in this chamber look comfortable and oft used.  On the east wall, a cozy fireplace beckons you to be seated on the comfortable chair in front of it.  A large bookcase and desk occupy one corner of the room, while a bed fills another.  The oak panelled walls are bare save for a broken staff hanging over the fireplace and white lace curtains around the room's window.

title: [House Phoenix, L'Greens' Room]
description: The bedchamber of Lord Lythe is comfortable and well kept.  A four poster brass bed, along with a small writing desk serve as the furniture here.  An ornate, hand-woven rug covers the floor in front of the bed and a silvered mirror hangs opposite the desk on one wall.

title: [House Phoenix, Waldo2's Chamber]
description: This room is decorated in muted earth tones, giving a feeling of peace and contentment.  Obviously, the owner wishes to relax, away from the strife and combat of the wilds.  A solid oak chair sits before an equally sturdy oaken desk.  A plain but comfortable bed is the room's only other furnishing.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Foyer]
description: This oak panelled room is bare, save for a portrait hanging on the east wall.  The smooth wooden floor has been polished to a high sheen, and your footsteps echo softly as you walk upon it.  Four silver sconces containing white candles are strategically placed on the walls, lending a soft glow to the surroundings.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Marble Hallway]
description: The marble walls of this hallway seem to glow with warmth as a sense of well being fills you.  Your troubles begin to feel far away.  This hallway is lined with a carpet emblazoned with the House Coat of Arms.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Quiet Temple]
description: The chamber is peaceful and serene, as if compelling one to speak in whispers out of respect for the holy patrons of this temple.  Large white marble pillars line both sides of the congregation area, a series of beautiful frescoes on the walls between them.  Though the room's scope and beauty is inspiring, the center of attention is a brilliant sapphire altar at the far end of the temple.  Heavy polished maple benches, trimmed in ivory, sit in ordered rows before the altar.

title: [Phoenix Annex, North Hall]
description: Your footsteps are muffled by a long embroidered rug lining this hallway.  A green crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, holding several flickering candles.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Guest Room]
description: The walls of this guest room are painted a cheery yellow and there is a light scent of cinnamon in the air.  A small window is cracked open just a bit, and the yellow silken curtains billow in the refreshing breeze.  A low bed with an elegantly engraved headboard lies against one wall next to a small wooden shelf.

title: [Phoenix, Krisenfest's Room]
description: This expansive chamber is roughly triangular, and features richly carved rosewood panelled walls which depict scenes of the Gods of Light.  An antique crystal chandelier hangs from a domed ceiling, illuminating the red-veined white marble floors and a sizable four poster cedar bed in one corner.  A fireplace flanked by two armchairs fills another corner, while a round malachite-topped cherrywood table surrounded by comfy red pillows stands before a huge shelf filled with books.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Catrissa's Room]
description: This spacious room is warmed by sunlight streaming in through a window facing east.  A large canopied bed covered by an emerald green down comforter lies against the wall directly beneath the window.  The oak floor is covered by a luxurious snow-white puma fur rug that almost looks as inviting as the bed.  In one corner stands a small bookcase filled neatly with several leather-bound books with esoteric titles.  Occasionally, you hear a faint sound coming from underneath the bed.

title: [Phoenix Annex, South Hall]
description: The hardwood floor is brightly polished and a thick white tapestry adorns one wall.  A flowering vine grows in a ceramic urn next to the wall, lending a pleasant aroma to the air.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Workshop]
description: A faint trace of residual magic tingles your fingertips as you cross the threshold of this workshop.  A domed window in the ceiling lets in bright sunlight that shines directly upon a well-worn and slightly charred desk strewn with various parchments and notes.  The walls are lined with shelves and cabinets which contain beakers, flasks, and decanters of multi-colored liquids that sparkle in the light.

title: [House Phoenix, Donation Room]
description: The brightly polished oak floor reflects the light from a pair of simple silver sconces attached to the wall.  A sweet soprano voice quietly singing an old folk song flows from an archway set in the northern wall.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Temple Hallway]
description: One wall of this small, well-lit hallway is decorated with a pair of magnificent paintings.  The other is almost completely covered with a grand tapestry depicting a battle scene.  In the flickering torchlight the figures on the tapestry seem to come to life.

title: [Phoenix Annex, Sanctuary]
description: This tranquil room has been consecrated and dedicated to prayer, contemplation and reflection.  Four rows of pews with kneelers give the room a sense of order and discipline.  Inscriptions, inlaid with silver, grace three of the walls.

title: [Road to Talador]
description: A worn dirt road winds through a thickly wooded area, the path wide enough to allow wagons to navigate freely.  A crisp breeze travels across the region as the remnants of winter still blanket many trees with snow.

title: [Talador, Crossroads]
description: The road branches off here into three directions, one leading north to the city gates, while the other two split to the east and west along the outer walls.  A wooden sign juts up from the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Talador, Exteriors]
description: The path is well worn here, with a mix of footprints and wagon tracks throughout the dirt.  Huge pine and fir trees rise up in the distance, dark green returning to their branches despite the faint evidence of snow.

title: [Talador, Farmlands]
description: Lush green swathes of grass have begun to slowly drive up from beneath the patches of snow nearby.  Far to the south and west runs an expansive forest congested with giant pine and fir trees, scratching at the skies above.

title: [Talador, Mine Road]
description: The path runs east across the city walls, moving far beyond Talador and then bends sharply to the northeast.  Plots of snow-covered pine trees tower above, while the northern mountains rise up in the distance.

title: [Talador, North Trail]
description: The northern trail to Talador is wide but cluttered with wagons stopped along each side of the road.  Many have opened up temporary shop, hawking wares to other travelers as they move by, while a number of them are being thoroughly inspected by city guards.

title: [Talador, Mine Road]
description: The path runs east across the city walls, moving far beyond Talador and then bends sharply to the northeast.  Plots of snow-covered pine trees tower above, while the northern mountains rise up in the distance.

title: [Talador, Mining Camp]
description: The old camp is deserted, the entire area partially concealed by overgrowth and covered in dust.  Derelict wagons have been abandoned throughout the site, their structures warped and damaged from rain and snow.  The great northern mountains loom up above the camp, their icy peaks scratching the sky or disappearing amidst low clouds altogether.

title: [Talador, Farmlands]
description: The road is still wide here, moving straight along old fields that are just now beginning to show the signs of rebirth.  An old faded barn sits at the bottom of a small hill, while some cattle graze nearby.

title: [Talador, Farmlands]
description: In the middle of an old field sits an even older well where vines and weeds have grown up, over and around it.  Some small farmhouses are settled into a thicket of trees not too far off.

title: [Talador, Farmlands]
description: A rickety wooden plow rests to the side of an old dilapidated barn where the walls have become weathered and warped from the elements.  Nearby, a mottled brown horse nibbles at a patch of thin grass poking up from some dirty snow.

title: [Talador, Farmlands]
description: The expanse of farmland opens up to the north, where dozens of homes and cottages have popped up amidst the fields and fences.  A donkey brays periodically and loudly nearby.

title: [Talador, Woodlands]
description: Only two small farmhouses are nearby, each protected by a low stone wall around its perimeter.  A field lies off to the side of one home but appears to have recently been burned.

title: [Talador, Woodlands]
description: The edge of the woodlands is thick and dark, with pine and fir trees intermixed as they stretch across the land.  Something in the trees rustles nearby.

title: [Talador, Woodlands]
description: A small dagger lies next to a gnarled pine tree, and the blade of the weapon is crusted with dried blood.  A strange wooden symbol hangs from a branch high up in one of the trees.

title: [Talador, Woodlands]
description: The trees here are thick, their heavy canopies blocking out light from above.  Freshly smashed into the mud and snow-covered ground is a series of huge footprints.

title: [Talador, Woodlands]
description: The ground is covered in undergrowth and littered with broken and jagged branches.  A fir tree stands among a cluster of pines, half of its bark missing or blackened.

title: [Talador, Woodlands]
description: The forest has grown darker, while the heavy branches of the trees seem to droop, almost scratching at the ground.  A small humanoid skull lies half-buried in the ground, a few white earthworms crawling through it.

title: [Talador, Farmlands]
description: Pale wisps of smoke curl up from the chimneys on a number of farmsteads that dot the land.  A large trail winds through the area, and a broken wagon wheel lays off to the side in a small ditch.

title: [Talador, Farmlands]
description: The fields and farms are sparse here, giving way to a worn-down dirt road narrowing to the north.  Further off, the walls of an ancient stone keep rise up.

title: [The Old Keep Road]
description: The road here has suffered the unmerciful wrath of nature over the years.  Recent travel has cleared a more narrow path through the center of the lane, but a great deal of foliage and weeds have flourished along both sides of the trail.

title: [The Old Keep Road]

Off to the northwest, you see an expansive war-torn battlefield.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: The field is vast, stretching out for miles and miles of blemished and broken lands.  Patches of wild grass and thin saplings struggle up from the ground, trying to flourish in the ground once soaked in blood.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: Remnants of war litter the battlefield, from warped pieces of siege weapons to the cracked and broken handles of weapons.  Weeds and foliage grow sporadically over the area.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: A partial skull of what appears to be an orc juts out from the dirt and grass, its surface bleached from long exposure to the sun.  A carrion crow circles overhead, squawking loudly.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: The area has been scorched and the ground blackened and cracked.  A cluster of trees rise up to the north, each seared dark from flames.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: Half-buried in the ground is an old faded and torn surcoat, its tattered cloth displaying a discolored triskelion.  Boulders dot the landscape, like stone knuckles ripping open the earth.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: A large wooden trebuchet has crumbled apart, its remains warped and stained.  A few bleached bones have been scattered nearby.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: A small cluster of rocks has been piled up next to a weathered silver cross in the ground.  Swathes of yellow-white grass spread out over the area.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: A large pine tree grows up from the patchy ground, a lone sentinel amidst a field of memories and decay.  From a branch of the tree, a silver-eyed crow looks on.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: The burnt husk of a wooden outpost stands dormant, tattered banners hanging lazily from its shell.  Patches of yellow, brittle grass sprout up around the station.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: An old carrion crow sits perched on top of a tarnished silver helm, its surface dented and caked with dried blood.  An cracked bone arrowhead lies off to the side.
