title: [The Old Keep Road]
description: The road here has suffered the unmerciful wrath of nature over the years.  Recent travel has cleared a more narrow path through the center of the lane, but a great deal of foliage and weeds have flourished along both sides of the trail.

title: [The Old Keep Road]
description: The old trail ends and opens up before a stout keep with ancient stone walls and battered rock parapets.  Above the keep a large banner flaps against the wind, the pennant depicting the image of a white square on a field of black.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Courtyard]
description: Thick stone walls wrap around the massive circular courtyard of the keep.  Knights in gleaming armor and tabards marked with Talador's crest dutifully march along the heavy ramparts above.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Courtyard]
description: Off to the side, almost up against one of the stone walls, two Taladorian knights vigorously practice at swordplay, the clanging of their metal swords echoing faintly.  High above, the Talador crest is displayed proudly upon a tall silver pole.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Courtyard]
description: This part of the courtyard is dominated in the center by a huge granite statue.  Far to the northeast, the snowy peaks of the great northern mountains can be seen.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Courtyard]
description: The walls of the courtyard come to end on both sides of a small stone gatehouse, its metal portcullis raised to permit travel.  Perched upon smooth stone pedestals on both sides of the gate are two black granite gargoyles.

title: [Doggoroth Keep]
description: Burly soldiers haul carts of crated grain through the area, dispensing them into the granary buildings nearby.  A scrawny human squire stands outside of a small shop, carving away at a wooden symbol with his knife.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Fletcher]
description: Old walls encompass the small shop, where a huge slab of stone stretches across the room, serving as a simple but serviceable counter.  A tall bald human leans on the counter, twirling an arrowhead between his fingers.

title: [Doggoroth Keep]
description: Plumes of heavy black smoke billow out of the three chimneys of the keep's forge.  Rising up next to the smithery is an enormous tower.

title: [Doggoroth, Round Tower West]
description: From the top of the tower, the scattered farmlands can be seen before they succumb to the massive woodlands that stretch for miles and miles to the west, broken up only by a narrow river bending through the forest.  A cold, icy breeze stirs through the cracks along the ramparts.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Forge]
description: The air is thick with smoke and heat, the very walls of the room almost hot to the touch.  Fires burn in the back of the forge, where brawny weaponsmiths tend to their work.  Hanging from a nearby wall is a dented mithril tower shield.

title: [Doggoroth Keep]
description: To the east lies a wide stone building tucked into the shadow of an enormous tower.  Knights and men at arms move throughout the area, hands never far from their weapons.

title: [Doggoroth, Round Tower East]
description: From the top of the tower, the surrounding woodlands give way to the walled city of Talador to the east and the great mountains and mines to the north.  A cold, icy breeze stirs through the cracks along the ramparts.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Barracks]
description: Rows and rows of simple cots line the expansive floor of the barracks, and every inch of every wall has been set with racks of weapons and armor.  A few small tables are set up in the corner, and a plump-bellied dog feasts upon some food scraps on the floor nearby.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Gatehouse]
description: Four heavily armored knights stand watchful guard before a large stone gatehouse leading further into the keep.  The metal portcullis has been lowered, blocking any travel beyond it.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Stone Ascent]
description: Four sides of smooth stone steps lead up to a wide platform, easily viewable from all areas of the inner keep.  All around, armored Taladorian knights stand guard.  Off to the side, a stone ladder leads up to an observation deck.

title: [Doggoroth, Observation Deck]
description: The deck is sturdy and very wide, allowing for comfortable standing room for hundreds of onlookers.  Rows of stone benches are also set about along the center of the deck.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Stone Dais]
description: The carved rock platform rises almost twenty feet off the ground, with wide stone steps descending around all four sides.  A stone arch stretches up even higher, with ancient dwarven sigils etched into its surface and an embroidered Talador banner hanging from its columns.

title: [Doggoroth, Observation Deck]
description: The deck is sturdy and very wide, allowing for comfortable standing room for hundreds of onlookers.  Rows of stone benches are also set about along the center of the deck.

title: [Doggoroth, Observation Deck]
description: The deck is sturdy and very wide, allowing for comfortable standing room for hundreds of onlookers.  Rows of stone benches are also set about along the center of the deck.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: The ground here is uneven, cluttered with lumps of hard dirt, jagged rocks and bone fragments.  A rusty hatchet lies next to a nearby boulder, its blade stained with dark splotches.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: A wagon has been overturned on its side and rotted over time.  A broken sword lies tarnished in the ground next to it.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: A stone half-wall lies partly collapsed around the exterior of an old stone tower.  Thick vines coil up the sides of the tower, stretching up and over its battlements.

title: [Old Stone Tower]
description: Sunlight gleams in through broken chunks and cracks in the walls of the stone tower.  The bloated carcass of a rodent lies next to a tarnished silver plate on the ground.  Once, a flight of stone stairs led to the top of the tower, but have since collapsed.

Moonlight gleams in through broken chunks and cracks in the walls of the stone tower.  The bloated carcass of a rodent lies next to a tarnished silver plate on the ground.  Once, a flight of stone stairs led to the top of the tower, but have since collapsed.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: More bones than grass cover the field, dotting the war-torn landscape as a tragic reminder of the past.  A warped and arrow-riddled shield leans up against a jagged boulder.

title: [Talador, Old Battlefield]
description: A huge pit opens up in the bleak ground and has been filled with hundreds of humanoid bones.  A large rodent scurries among the shadows of the ditch, gnawing on the old skeletal remains.

title: [Talador, Woodlands]
description: A huge pit opens up between some trees, and broken wooden spikes can be seen on all sides of the pit's walls disappear down into darkness.  Not far away, a strange bird squawks loudly.

title: [Talador, Woodlands]
description: A wall of dense trees blocks further travel into the forest, but a faint set of narrow footprints seems to disappear beyond the woodland barrier.  A strange wooden symbol hangs from a branch high above.

title: [Talador, Outside Gate]
description: The city's thick stone walls rise up before you, stretching far to the east and west.  Armored guards with crossbows man the walls, patrolling their vast length.  The dirt road ends before a huge steel-bound wooden gate and a number of merchants and their wagons wait on the side of the trail to be permitted within.

title: [Talador, Inside Gate]
description: Set into a thick stone wall is a huge steel-bound wooden gate that leads outside of town.  Crossbowmen make their rounds along the fortified walls, keeping a watchful eye on travelers outside and inside the city.

title: [Talador, Silver Lane]
description: The cobblestones of the long road have been worn and smoothed over time and use.  City guards move about the area, hands never far from the handles of their sheathed weapons.

title: [Talador, Pine Avenue]
description: A worn cobblestone road bends west, passing by a number of old stone shops and covered wagons.  Workers move about, hauling grain, metal, and lumber.

title: [The Splatter Pit]
description: The pavilion's walls are crafted of deep purple silk, shifting with the slightest breeze.  White banners hang from the walls, each one depicting a colorful and detailed depiction of a beautiful landscape, from crisp snowy mountains to lush river valleys.  A dark haired human with multi-hued eyes sits near some paint-splattered tables, cleaning some brushes in jars of water.  Behind him rises a tall wooden supply shelf.

title: [A Sliver of Silver]
description: Burnished oak planks comprise the walls of the wagon and ornate silver lamps are suspended from the ceiling.  Metal-plated chests are stacked in a corner and a silver-threaded black brocade curtain leads out of the wagon.

title: [Talador, Pine Avenue]
description: Local shops and taverns are mixed throughout the avenue, watched over by the city guards manning the walls to the south.  Citizens walk about on their business, idly chatting as they pass.

title: [The Bitter Bite]
description: An enormous stone hearth dominates an entire wall, where a roaring fire burns within, warming the entire area.  Above the hearth's mantle are ancient and battered shields, each one decorated in the symbols of every dwarven clan.  Tables and chairs are set up around the front room while uniformed barmaids meander about, refilling drinks or cleaning up empty plates.

title: [The Bitter Bite, Second Floor]
description: Dark wooden doors line both sides of the second floor hallway, each with rooms tucked away to provide comfort for guests.  The paneled walkway ends at a large bay window framed by blue velvet curtains.

title: [Caravan Consignments]
description: Natural pine encloses this compact space, from vaulted ceiling to rough polished floor.  A row of paned windows, set above a long brushed steel counter, makes up the full length of one wall.  Opposite the counter stands a small table, with two benches placed on either side affording a comfortable place to sit.  A narrow red door, flanked by a pair of tall cubbyholes, leads back to the world outside, while a golden oak arch on the other side of the room beckons customers to a small alcove in the back.

title: [Caravan Consignments, Alcove]
description: Serving a dual purpose, this little alcove offers a small amount of respite from the flurry of activity in the main room.  Tucked in one corner, a porcelain washbasin perched on a gold pedestal rests near a white cotton cloth on a small, brushed steel hook and a cedar waste bin.  Hung above the basin, a vaalin-framed oval mirror allows for a moment of vanity.  Reflected in the mirror's polished surface is a tall closet that stands just inside the golden oak arch framing the view of the room outside.

title: [Talador, Pine Avenue]
description: To the northwest and southwest the West Circle District opens up beyond a stone wall and a wooden postern gate.  City guards actively pace before the gate, checking citizens' credentials before allowing them to pass through.

title: [Palace of the Godking]
description: Thick walls of white leather circle around to form a huge pavilion, each wall emblazoned with the image of a large golden crown.  A sweet aroma drifts from some candles stacked on an altar, where three robed acolytes kneel in hushed prayer.  Large gold-inlaid racks line up on the sides of a circular white oak table.

title: [All that Glitters]
description: The thick black walls of the tent are covered in an assortment of large mirrors, their reflective surfaces capturing the plethora of gem-decorated inventory around the shop, causing the entire room to glitter.  In one corner of the tent resides a mirror-finished counter where a tall amethyst-eyed human paces anxiously behind it.

title: [Talador, Silver Lane]
description: Local merchants have set up a number of carts along both sides of the road, shouting to citizens and tourists alike, trying to peddle their wares.  Townspeople move through the streets, talking amongst themselves.

title: [The Motion Of The Potion]
description: An incredibly tangled assortment of copper pipes covers the ceiling of the wagon.  Some of the metal tubes pierce the sides and roof, vanishing through the wooden walls only to reappear in other places.  Many of the pipes connect to the glass cylinder in the middle of the wagon, feeding into its top, and dripping colorful liquid into various segments of the cylinder itself.  A large, polished mithril vat sits beneath the cylinder, containing an assortment of colorful liquids.

title: [Talador, Silver Lane]
description: To the northeast and southeast the East Circle District opens up, lined with shops and colorful pavilions.  Sunlight gleams off the armor of the city's guards while they patrol the area.
To the northeast and southeast the Eastern Circle District opens up, lined with shops and colorful pavilions.  Moonlight gleams off the armor of the city's guards while they patrol the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south

title: [Northern Fortress, Ready Room]
description: Sheathed with oak planking, the walls and floor give the room a rustic, yet purposeful air.  Each wall contains a double door leading to other areas of the keep, while hanging from high above are several large tapestries.  Well lit by oil-lamps dangling from the rafters, the chamber prominently displays a giant banner stretched over the southern doorway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Talador, East Circle]
description: The fresh scent of baked bread and honey waft through the area, drawing more than a few passerby's to stop and visit a small white stone shop.  A row of pigeons are perched on the rooftop of the shop, gently cooing and cleaning their wings.

title: [Patty's Cakes]
description: The small white-walled shop holds the sweet mixed aroma of cinnamon, flour and honey.  A trio of aproned halfling maids move hurriedly about the room, restocking the shelves in between taking orders at the stout wooden counter.

title: [Tots of Turamzzyr]
description: The walls of the wagon have been painted with vibrant blue, green and yellow paints.  One wall holds a bright red shelf, while another holds a bright blue shelf.  A sandy-haired halfling in a comical hat sits on a pile of pillows, carving a figurine out of a wooden block.

title: [The Turamzzyrian Sole]
description: Large clay pots of colorful dye are cluttered in the corners of this wagon, and some stained worktables are wedged in between them.  A series of hooks along one wall holds a variety of shoes, and a group of bins is filled with assorted supplies.

title: [Taste of Turamzzyr, Entrance]
description: Sturdy wooden poles, bound with lengths of thick rope, provide a robust frame for the many layers of oilskin that form the walls and canopy of this rectangular showroom.  The din of the festival is heard beyond an arched entryway leading out to the north, while a more humble atmosphere to the south is complimented by the delicate sound of clinking glasses.  A multitude of robust spices and herbs dominates the otherwise woody scent of the tent.  Near a painted wooden sign, a stained ash pallet is stacked high with wooden cases.

title: [Talador, East Circle]
description: The road bends to the northeast, meandering through clusters of stone and brick shops.  Off in the distance the snowy peaks of the northern mountains rise up to spear the sky.

title: [No Stranger Ranger]
description: The tent is musty and smells of animal fur and raw meat.  The walls are black, partially discolored in some areas, the fading portions mostly concealed by large wooden statues, each one carved to represent a growling bear.  A burly dwarf with a tangled red and black beard stands behind a stained oak counter, periodically checking his teeth in the reflection of a nearby display case.

title: [The Imperial Emporium]
description: A dashing blue and gold clad shopkeeper stands in the center of the pavilion, handing out ribbon-tied brochures to those customers willing to stop and listen to him.  Racks of scrolls and maps line the walls of the tent, broken up by a series of colorful canvas tapestries, each one detailing a different region of the Turamzzyrian Empire.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southwest, out

title: [Talador, Silver Lane]
description: One side of the road is dominated by a huge stone building where plumes of dark smoke billow up from a series of blackened chimneys.  The constant pounding of hammer on steel resonates from within the local blacksmith and weapon shop.

title: [The Northern Armament]
description: Walls of stone support the local weapon shop and have been partially blackened from soot and smoke.  A modest warmth rolls in from the blazing forges visible in the back area of the shop.

title: [Talador, East Circle]
description: A three-legged dog periodically barks from the wooden steps of a large brick store with a brown wooden awning, and occasionally a town guard will silence him with a scrap of food.  Tents dot the side of the road like a colorful forest.

title: [Conceal and Heal]
description: Posts of gnarled black oak hold up the rich burgundy walls of the pavilion.  The scent of dirt and oiled leather mingles in the air.  A one-eyed dwarf climbs on and off a stool as he rearranges an assortment of clothing on some metal shelves.

title: [Immensity]
description: The brown tent is enormous inside, with thick hide walls rising up well over the height of two giantmen.  Rows of oversized racks housing large weapons and shields stretch down the center of the area, and a red bear skin curtain provides an exit.

title: [Talador, East Circle]
description: A pair of bridled oxen move down the lane, hauling a dark-haired teamster and a wagon full of bricks.  Town guards stroll about casually, watching the visitors and townspeople as they pass.

title: [Heart to Tart]
description: Patterned walls of red and yellow squares spread out through the tent, held upright by carved white oak posts.  Wooden shelves, high and low, stretch the length of every wall.  A circular rosewood counter is centered in the middle of the room and holds an assortment of pastries and other treats.  Near the back sits a large hand-carved rosewood trunk.

title: [Battle of the Keep]
description: A half-circle of small worktables surrounds a short stool, where the name "Walward" has been carved into the seat.  Wood and metal shavings are scattered out from the tables, and a wooden clock ticks faintly above a series of sturdy wooden shelves.

title: [Talador, East Circle]
description: Vibrant-hued pavilions and merchant carts line the stone road, hawkers displaying their wares to tourists, citizens and town guards alike.  An armored knight stands to the side of the road, brushing down the side of his dapple grey horse.

title: [Smoke and Mirrors]
description: The tent's ceiling is high enough to accommodate the average giantman, yet the area's counter and shelves are just the right height for a gnome.  A thin cloud of smoke haze lingers near the apex, its vapors infused with mixed scents of blackberry and vanilla.

title: [Quick Prick, Front Room]
description: The pavilion's soft vermillion silk walls are held up by slender ebony poles and stir with the slightest of breeze or nearby movement.  Huge, orange and yellow pillows are positioned around the area, each one placed near a small stand and bowl of fresh fruit.  You also see a beaded crimson curtain and some velvet-lined shelves.

title: [Quick Prick, Back Room]
description: Wispy tendrils of flowery scented smoke drift across the vermillion silk walls of the back room.  Patrons sit patiently at a half-circle wooden counter, where three women with purple hair and tattooed arms show them a series of available designs to have inked to their skin.

title: [All Mine]
description: A one-armed dwarf sits on an old stool in the back of the wagon, smoke rings trailing up from the bone pipe clenched between his teeth.  He puffs lazily on his pipe as he watches the customers, rudely snorting at the sight of some of them.  The wagon is rather plain, except for a series of stained wooden shelves and the strong scent of tobacco and dirt.

title: [Conceal and Heal]
description: Squatted in a corner of the room, a silver-haired halfling is busily sewing some patches on some bags placed around his hairy feet.  Carved wooden racks run the length of the back wall, separated by a wide metal bin.

title: [Tots of Tyramzzyr]
description: Walls of bright blue, green and yellow hues enclose the colorful wagon, adding a jubilant warmth to the atmosphere of the area.  Nets are suspended from the ceiling's corners, each bulging with an assortment of toys and dolls.

title: [The Turamzzyrian Sole]
description: Burnished wooden shelves line the back walls of the wagon, each holding a variety of tailored shoes.  A carved ironwood table rests in the center, flanked by a pair of polished copper shoe racks.

title: [Taste of Turamzzyr]
description: Pine cases are stacked on pallets along either side of the tent's interior, leaving a moderate amount of walking space between them.  North leads to the tent's entryway, where the muted sounds of the festival can be heard, and south leads to the rear of the tent, where yet another grouping of pallets reside.  Positioned in the middle of the walkway, a carved pine wine list fitted with a wrought silver candle plate offers enough light to clearly see in either direction.

title: [Taste of Turamzzyr]
description: Mounted to the backmost wall of the tent, a carved oak wine list is prominently displayed over a reinforced sturdy wooden counter.  Dimly glowing lanterns, mounted on a thick wooden beam overhead, offer a comfortable measure of visibility, the flames within flickering indifferently as patrons walk by.  A multitude of cases are stacked on pallets in the corners and along either side.  The scent of spices and herbs mingles harmoniously with that of freshly cut wood.

title: [Talador, Silver Lane]
description: To the northwest the North Circle District opens up, and the stone road winds through a series of shops, tents, and merchant wagons.  The lane here is heavily patrolled by the armored city guards.

title: [Magic Might]
description: A thin haze of yellow smoke drifts lazily through the shop, originating from a crack in the back wall next to a closed door with a sign that reads, "Backroom."  Shelves line the other walls, each one occupied with a number of corked potions, categorized piles of wands and other trinkets.

title: [Talador, North Circle]
description: The northern road is bustling with activity, from merchants peddling their products to townspeople flowing through the area.  Stone and wooden shops dot the landscape and a cluster of homes can be glimpsed beyond them.

title: [Consumption Junction]
description: Wisps of green, yellow and orange smoke drift lazily about the pavilion, all eventually rising to seep through a small opening in the top of the tent.  Two grey canvas walls are nearly concealed by thick wooden shelves, each one sporting a variety of colorful bottles and smoking vials.  In a corner of the tent sits a twitchy-eyed halfling alchemist, coughing and wheezing as he mixes the contents of glowing beakers.

title: [Summer Shades, Southern Styles]
description: Soft white, yellow and orange walls enclose this area of the tent, accompanied by sand-colored pillows arranged neatly in every corner.  Copper metal racks run along the center of the room, while the aroma of cinnamon swirls slowly in the air.

title: [Rainbow's End]
description: This small but cozy wagon is infused with the scent of fresh paint.  From the base of one wall, across the ceiling, and then down the opposite wall, a grand rainbow has been painted in bright iridescent hues, creating a vivid arc of colors.  A silver-capped rack showcases a wide selection of shirts and dresses, and an ornate oak trunk displays a variety of leg wear.  Precisely-cut multicolored square cubes fill a silk-wrapped case, its lid propped open with a gnome-sized broom.

title: [Talador, North Circle]
description: Citizens and visitors roam about the curved street, stopping at each shop or wagon along the way.  Armored city guards move slowly through the crowd, their eyes sharp and alert.

title: [Mechanimal]
description: The dusty white walls of the tent are made of thick canvas and ornamented with a series of brass, silver and gold gears, each of varying sizes.  In the middle of the room is a small pen enclosed by copper-posted fencing.  A bronze-eyed burghal gnome kicks his feet while perched upon a metal stool, his nose flaring while he tinkers away on a mechanical toy.

title: [Recipe for Disaster]
description: The large wagon is made of discolored wooden boards, each wall covered by various scorch marks and faded stains.  Yellow and green smoke lazily drifts up from small vials along a large shelf, joined by an assortment of alchemical tools.  The faint glimmer of gems twinkles inside of a banded oak barrel.

title: [The Aura of Autumn]
description: The pavilion's dark green hide walls have been interwoven with golden symbols in the shape of grain sheaves and supported by polished ironwood posts.  A young sylvan woman, garbed in a simple brown robe, moves slowly about the area helping customers who are inspecting her inventory.

title: [Talador, North Circle]
description: Throngs of townspeople move through the area, stopping to chat when not going about their business.  Bright, huge pavilions line the streets like a colorful border, drawing visitors to them.

title: [The Smoking Arrow]
description: A thick haze of smoke forms rings near the apex of the tent and a strong mix of scented aromas permeate in the area.  A row of wax-stained tables form a large circle in the center of the tent, each setup with a number of candles or incense.  Along the walls of the tent runs a line of curved wooden shelves.  A narrow slit in the tent's ceiling allows some of the fragrant smog to leak out.

title: [Picknacks]
description: The walls of the small silk tent have been decorated with strands of tiny silver bells, tinkling merrily with every errant breeze.  Hanging from wooden posts are glass-paneled lanterns that drench the area with plenty of yellow light.  A large rawhide pack hangs open from a wooden rack, and is surrounded by a number of old oak chests.

title: [The Tunes of Talador]
description: A soft, soothing melody drifts throughout the huge tent, the song originating from a white-haired human minstrel, who sits cross-legged on a giant red pillow, plucking at the strings of his mandolin.  A number of customers browse the shop's wares along shelves and a countertop, while a few stop and place some coins in a tip jar near the musician.

title: [Talador, North Circle]
description: Two city guards, one burly, the other tall, lean against the outside wall of a brick-lined shop.  They both offer greetings to those passing by, sometimes snickering to themselves.  A large wooden sign hangs from the side of the store.

title: [Tokens of Talador]
description: The walls of the shop are littered with low shelves, high shelves, even colorfully painted shelves.  A tall, beak-nosed human stands watch behind a glass-top counter where he gleefully greets those who pass by.

title: [Festive Nights]
description: Colorful ribbons in a dazzling display of silver, blue, gold, and red loop over and around all of the tent's dark oak posts.  The black walls of the tent are embroidered with a series of bright multihued fireworks exploding amid a backdrop of stars.  A wild-eyed halfling sits beneath a series of netting in the corner, while building a pinata.

title: [Talador, North Circle]
description: A huge weathered stone temple casts a wide shadow across the road and half a dozen black birds sit quietly upon the rusted hammer-shaped symbol rising up from the building's roof.  Across the street a number of horses have been safely sheltered in the town stables.

title: [The Golden Artificer]
description: Discolored stained glass windows are set into niches along the ancient stone walls of the temple.  A dark-eyed raven is perched upon a wooden rafter near the ceiling, idly picking at its feathers when not staring down at the rows of benches and small stage below.

title: [Summer Shades, Northern Styles]
description: The tent exists of large canvas walls, each one a colorful blend of soft yellow, orange and white hues.  Sand-colored pillows occupy the corners, and rows of bronze metal racks stretch across the center of the room.  The fragrance of cinnamon drifts lazily through the area.

title: [Festive Nights]
description: Black canvas walls stretch out along the tent, each one emblazoned with the colorful display of exploding fireworks among tiny white stars.  Vibrant silver, blue, gold, and red ribbons hang across dark oak posts supporting the pavilion's ceiling.

title: [The Tunes of Talador]
description: A bald, elderly human man sits on an old stool in a corner of the tent.  His eyes are glossy and opaque, but his hands skillfully carve detailed etchings onto a half-finished instrument.  Along the walls of the tent are lacquered wooden shelves, each containing an assortment of supplies.

title: [The Tunes of Talador]
description: The minstrel's comforting melody can still be faintly heard near the back of the tent, the tune beautiful and serene.  A black velvet-draped table is in the center of the room, surrounded on both sides by two long ebony racks.

title: [The Imperial South and West]
description: Heraldic banners hang along every wall of the tent, each one displaying a series of rich colors and crests.  A velvet-lined case is positioned between glass-paned lanterns that wash the area in a soft glow.

title: [The Imperial East]
description: Heraldic banners hang along every wall of the tent, each one displaying a series of rich colors and crests.  A velvet-lined case is positioned between glass-paned lanterns that wash the area in a soft glow.

title: [The Imperial North]
description: Heraldic banners hang along every wall of the tent, each one displaying a series of rich colors and crests.  A velvet-lined case is positioned between glass-paned lanterns that wash the area in a soft glow.

title: [A Sliver of Silver]
description: The wagon is built of sturdy, burnished oak planks set with ornate silver lamps.  Various mannequins decorated in silver adornments stand posed along the sides of the room.

title: [The Bitter Bite, Lounge]
description: A small wooden stage occupies a corner of the room where a finely-dressed musician entertains the guests with a series of melodies.  A few small tables have been lined up around the edges of a scuffed wooden dance floor.

title: [The Bitter Bite, Reading Alcove]
description: Put away from the rest of the hall, the small alcove provides enough room for a stout bookshelf and two writing desks and a few wooden chairs.  Pale candles burn on a nearby stand, their glow providing a dim light to the area, while a pool of wax forms beneath them.

title: [Caravan Consignments, Loft]
description: Here, in the quiet space above the main room, the vaulted ceiling forms sloping walls that cradle the small loft in a comforting embrace.  A thick bedroll, with a pile of pillows shoved against a row of overturned crates that serves as a makeshift headboard on one end and a mass of rumpled blankets on the other, lies nestled in this cozy nook.  Running the length of the platform's outside edge, interrupted only by a gap for a sturdy steel-rung ladder, a low wooden railing protects against unwanted tumbles.

title: [All that Glitters]
description: Tall mirrors line the thick black tent walls, each one capturing the glittering sparkle of the gem-decorated inventory throughout.  In one corner of the tent is a silver-inlaid display case, and a lapis-crusted dark oak chest.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The earthen ground is caked with old dust and grime.  The walls are uneven and covered in jagged stones.  Dozens of tunnels lead off in every which direction, some of them entirely collapsed.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, southwest, out

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The old, dried husks of burnt dwarves lie blackened and scattered about.  The metal of their armor has rusted and faded with time.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: Great rocky boulders block off the rest of the tunnel, as the ceiling above has collapsed and littered the ground with stones.  Beneath the rubble, a skeletal arm is evident, the remains of an unfortunate victim of the mines.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: A rusted pickaxe has been driven into a nearby wall, its handle dark from age old bloodstains.  The tunnel descends sharply.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The walls of the mines are hard-packed and more black than brown.  A dryness to the air hangs like a heavy cloud.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: A choking thickness clings to the air of the mines, accompanied by the deep and bitter mountain chill.  The old skeletal remains of a humanoid jut out of the ground nearby.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The air is muggy and the walls are covered in dust, cobwebs, and dried blood.  Despite the sense of abandonment, a pair of gnarled footprints are visible in the ground.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: Through the blackness of the ancient mines, a low, unearthly moan emanates from further down the tunnel.  A cold draft of air brushes dirt and pebbles from the walls.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The crumbled form of a stone golem lies broken near a jagged wall, its surface dented and black as shadows.  A metal half-helm lies next to the golem, skull fragments visible within it.

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The tunnel descends sharply, the depths of the underground cavern blanketing the area in darkness.  Tiny claw marks move in all directions through the dirt.

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The tunnel comes to an abrupt stop at a wide field of toothed stalagmites, each clawing up from the ground in a variety of sizes.  At the top of the cavern is a host of large black bats, wings folded over their shadowy bodies.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The area is tightly confined as large jagged stalagmites jut up from the earth, their rough edges and sharpened points making for a dangerous obstacle to navigate through.  More than a few rocky spikes have been caked in dried blood.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The mines are cold, and filled with the scuffling sounds of creatures in the darkness.  A huge chunk of wall is missing nearby, either torn open by some monstrosity or collapsed over time.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: A dozen corpses, all rotting dark orcs, have been piled up near an old mining cart.  Wide, jagged cracks snake up the walls like lattice-work.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: The earthen ground is uneven at best, cluttered with rough stones, old metal scraps, and cracked bones.  Darkness hugs the tunnel like a billowing blanket of shadow.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: A ghostly wail is carried through the tunnel on a gust of icy wind.  From within the darkness of the cavern, a pair of red eyes appears periodically.

title: [Talador, Silver Mines]
description: An old broken war horn lies near a pile of bones collecting dust near a wall.  Thick cobwebs stretch and arc through the tunnel.

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The entire area is engulfed in darkness.  You cannot see a thing!

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The entire area is engulfed in darkness.  You cannot see a thing!

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The entire area is engulfed in darkness.  You cannot see a thing!

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: Darkness only faintly peels away as parts of the tunnel are illuminated by the presence of strange glowing white maggots crawling along the walls.  At the end of the tunnel, a stony ledge rises up.

title: [Talador Mines, Stone Ledge]
description: The stone ledge rises up about the darkness of the tunnel below, opening up into a wider chamber of blackness.  No light exists, save for the eerie pale glow from the slimy worms snaking up and down the cavern walls.  Out across the ledge and the open pit of shadows, another narrow ledge is visible.

title: [Talador Mines, Narrow Ledge]
description: Sleek, glowing white worms slowly inch along the walls, like slow moving stars on the backdrop of night.  The ledge is narrow and jagged and one side opens up into a pit of blackness, leading across the way to another ledge, while an old metal ladder leads down into a tunnel.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Thick wooden posts support the even thicker rock walls of the tunnel, each one covered in slimy glowing white maggots.  The ground is smooth and darkened from ancient blood stains.

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Pit]
description: The area is suffocated in darkness, save for the faint dim light caused by the glowing white worms slowly crawling along the jagged walls.  An icy chill hangs in the air.

title: [Talador Mines, Outcropping]
description: A small jagged outcropping juts out from the wall, darkness all around.  Tiny, glowing white worms slowly inch up the sides of the cavern.

title: [Talador Mines, Cavern Ascent]
description: A small jagged outcropping juts from the wall, darkness all around.  Tiny, glowing white worms slowly inch up the sides of the cavern.

title: [Talador Mines, Rocky Ledge]
description: A large outcropping extends from the cavern wall.  The air is chilled and engulfed in darkness, save for the glowing maggots crawling along the walls.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Stout dwarven skeletons lie half-buried under collapsed rubble.  An icy wind rushes through the blackness of the rocky ledge.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: The walls are broken and uneven, complete segments of earth and stone missing or having crumbled inward.  Ancient metal tools lie about, some caked in layers of dust or rust.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: The tunnel opens into a small cavern with a low ceiling.  The crumbled remains of a few small cots are pushed up against a wall, perhaps once an old resting spot for dwarven miners between shifts.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Huge, square footprints have created sunken holes in the ground.  A metal mining cart has been torn in half, each piece tossed against a wall on opposite sides of the chamber.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: A dented miner's helmet lies split open in a corner of the tunnel, a tiny rodent's corpse rotting away inside of it.  Darkness clings heavily to the area as only a few glowing worms are on the walls.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: A large parchment map has been tacked into a wall with the broken blade of a pickaxe, but the map's details have all faded with time.  A bucket has been overturned nearby, its wooden frame warped and rotted.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Huge, misshapen footprints are seen in the dirt ground of the tunnel.  Periodically, a few pebbles loosen and fall from the surrounding walls.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Jagged rock outcroppings rise sharply out of the walls, making the area dangerous to move quickly through.  Bats hang from the ceiling, breathing silently in their slumber.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: The bodies of humans and dwarves lie interspersed along the tunnel ground.  Their bodies have mostly rotted away, along with their tattered clothing and stained and dented armor.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Old metal carts have sat along the walls for hundreds of years, collecting both dust and grime.  Inside one cart is a humanoid skeleton, its skull half missing.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: An old toolbelt hangs from a rusted metal rack near a curved archway in the tunnel that has now been collapsed and blocked off.  Huge claw marks dig into the wall nearby.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Small bones are littered about the ground, strewn in the midst of old rusted pots and pans.  A wooden table has been turned on its side and two stout skeletons lean against it, large holes in their skulls.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: The ground has been torn apart, twisted cracks running through the area to drop into endless darkness below.  The walls are blackened from smoke and fire.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Half of a skeleton lies partially buried under rubble, his skull fragmented and caked with dirt.  The threadbare remains of a tabard hangs loosely to the skeletal torso, a faded triskelion on its chest.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Tiny shards of jagged rocks lie scattered about the ground, like a field of a thousand sharpened knives.  Periodically, the walls tremble and loose dirt and gravel fall from the ceiling.

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: The tunnel descends sharply, the depths of the underground cavern blanketing the area in darkness.  Tiny claw marks move in all directions through the dirt.

title: [Talador, Mine Road]
description: The path runs east across the city walls, moving far beyond Talador and then bends sharply to the northeast.  Plots of snow-covered pine trees tower above, while the northern mountains rise up in the distance.

title: [Talador, North Trail]
description: The northern trail to Talador is wide but cluttered with wagons stopped along each side of the road.  Many have opened up temporary shop, hawking wares to other travelers as they move by, while a number of them are being thoroughly inspected by city guards.

title: [Fitzwobbin's Figures, Show Room]
description: Some steel racks line the interior walls of the wagon leaving little space for anything else.  Small wooden cabinets support a fold out countertop against the back wall.  While a few iron rungs lead upwards to a circular steel hatch in the ceiling near the wagon's front.

title: [Fitzwobbin's Figures, Arena]
description: Standing atop the strange wagon, the view is impressive.  Several benches have been placed along the sides of the wagon.  Between them, an intricate painting of a gladiator's arena covers the wagon's flat top.  Two large pipes jut upwards from the rear of the wagon, providing a backstop for the low benches there.  A circular steel hatch leads back down into the wagon.

title: [A Stitch In Time]
description: Light streaming in through several windows illuminates dozens of bins that line three walls of this workspace.  Several dressforms have been pushed into one corner and securely lashed to the walls to prevent tipping.  Next to the entrance is a long counter piled with pattern books, measuring cords, and boxes of embellishments.  Several drawers of various sizes fill the available space below the counter.  Although the room is cramped, it is very organized and smells faintly of pine.

title: [Haute Hibernation, Foyer]
description: Dark stained wooden floors contrast sharply with two stark white silk screens partitioning off rooms to the east and west.  A low table is positioned between two leather chairs arranged in front of a tall cedar cabinet.  A rack fashioned from large antlers is mounted next to the entry door.

title: [Charleia's Charms]
description: The interior of the wagon is lined with crowded shelves full of glowing mushrooms, casting the area in a dim greenish glow.  Positioned near a blackened iron cauldron, an ebonwood bookshelf creaks under the weight of a multitude of dusty spell tomes.  A glass-panelled armoire displays a variety of crystals and trinkets at the rear of the wagon.

title: [Frequent Fragrance]
description: The walls of the huge pavilion are made of deep burgundy silk, stirring with the slightest of breeze or movement.  A soft, sweet aroma wafts through the open area as customers sample a variety of fragrances.

title: [Charleia's Charms, Alcove]
description: This cozy alcove is sparsely decorated with bundles of dried herbs.  A small cot covered with a patchwork quilt occupies one side of the area, while a three-legged wooden table dominates the other side.

title: [Charleia's Charms, Wagon Rear]
description: Moss-laden oak planks enclose the rear of the wagon, and the smell of various herbs is thick in the air.  A brass-bound ebonwood chest, its lid open wide, sits beneath a cobwebbed dark oak shelf.  Alongside the wall, an aged wooden stand displays an ornate carved jewelry box and a yellowed glass jar.

title: [Frequent Fragrance]
description: Walls of deep burgundy silk enclose the area, their surface shifting from the faintest movement from passersby.  A musky and spicy scent hangs heavily in the air.

title: [Frequent Fragrance]
description: Deep burgundy walls of smooth silk stretch across the inside of the pavilion.  There are few customers in this area of the tent, and more than half have faces contorted into a grimace.  The area is infused with the mixed odor of sweat, sulfur, and sea salt.

title: [Haute Hibernation, West Salon]
description: A large white reed basket filled with yarn sits next to an overstuffed plaid-covered chair in front of a glass display case.  A narrow, velvety black rug runs the length of the floor to an ottoman resting in front of a small hearth at the far end of the wagon.

title: [Haute Hibernation, East Salon]
description: A circular, milky glaes-paned window fills the entire end wall on this side of the wagon.  A dark leather sofa is stationed between a carved cedar chest and a long, brass-handled dark leather trunk.  A trio of glass globes set with tapered candles hangs above a polished ebonwood table.

title: [Silvergate, Jungle Room]
description: The warm humid air of this tropical retreat invites you to cast away your worries and cares.  Flowering vines creep up the carved posts of a four-poster bed which provides support for a canopy of rustling ferns.  Water trickles from a fountain, cunningly crafted to resemble a waterfall, and fills a small bathing pool near the fireplace.  Several colorful cushions are scattered on the floor near the hearth.

title: [Jungle Room, Bathing Pool]
description: The warm soothing water relaxes your muscles and the scents of rose and cedar intermingle in the air, leaving you with a renewed spirit.  How refreshing!  Fresh water constantly trickles in from the mouth of a small marble fish statue.

title: [Silvergate, Country Retreat]
description: Fresh as a country meadow, this cozy room welcomes you.  Pale green linens cover a brass bed, their color echoed in simple cotton curtains patterned with meadow flowers.  Painted carvings of herbs decorate the cream colored walls.  An armoire, crafted of rare varin stands in one corner, complementing the antique nightstands at bedside.  Opposite the bed, two cushioned chairs flank a brick fireplace.  A pot of fresh herbs, simmering over a small fire, fills the air with a fresh scent.

title: [Silvergate, Ocean Room]
description: Three curving walls of this chamber have been painted with fanciful scenes of merfolk and nymphs sporting among ocean waves and sunswept beaches.  A brilliant sunset depicted on the west wall cleverly frames an arched fireplace.  Midnight blue silk panels, embroidered with tiny silver stars and draped from the ceiling above, sway gently in a warm updraft, creating the illusion of a twinkling night sky.  Centered in the room, a feather bed hangs suspended from the ceiling on cotton ropes.

wayto.14674: ;e multifput 'unlatch blue door', 'open blue door', 'go blue door'

title: [Silvergate, Dragon Room]
description: Smelling the fragrance of fresh cedar, you glance up and notice that the ceiling of this simply furnished room has been paneled with the reddish wood.  A simple arrangement of flowering blossoms is displayed in a niche centered in one of the cream colored walls.  The window opposite the door is covered by a delicate carved screen, through which you hear the sound of chimes blowing in the wind.  Thick straw matting covers most of the floor, rising several inches above the entry to this room.

title: [It's Just a Formality]
description: Sturdy, polished teak poles driven straight into the ground support a thick, stretched canvas tent that encloses this space.  Candles of assorted colors occupy spherical lanterns hanging from several of the poles, their wavering lights casting a pale yellow luminescence upon the goods for sale.  Footprints on the ground mark a faint path between the northwest and southeast corners of the temporary establishment, while a neatly sewn flap leads out.  A sign on a thick wooden stake is posted prominently in the center of the area.

title: [It's Just a Formality, Workroom]
description: Along this wall of the expansive tent, loops of varying shades of flowers have been strung together across a partially closed curtain that leads to makeshift living quarters.  The customer traffic is less noticeable here, though the steady buzz of perusing shoppers and their companions can be overheard from the southeast.  A polished maoral stool stands off to the side of the space, a lit spherical lantern hung close to it providing ample lighting for detailed mercantile or textile work.

title: [Helden Hall, Buttery]
description: Stacked casks of mead and ale take up most of the space in this huge room dedicated to storage.  From the amount of stored food, one can surmise that either a war is coming or the members of the Hall have huge appetites.  A half-windowed door to the south gives a picturesque view of the livestock pens of the Inner Bailey.

title: [Helden Hall, Underground Cavern]
description: A frigid blast of air sends a chill down your spine, and the hair on the nape of your neck stands on end from the energies flowing around the cavern.  Light is coming from numerous phosphorescent crystals protruding from the floor and ceiling, in a multitude of colors.  The crystals are connected to each other by strands of pure energy that seem to emanate somehow from an underground stream that flows through here.  Carved into one stone wall is a stone counter, and a few stone bar stools cluster around it.

title: [Helden Hall, Hallway]
description: The sounds of revelry from the Great Hall are muted in this hallway. Flickering torchlight from the sconces on the walls produces shadows that dance along the stone floor.

title: [It's Just a Formality]
description: The tent walls buldge inward slightly as their fabric is caught up in a passing breeze outside.  Colorful silk streamers criss-cross between the tent poles, ending in an elegantly knotted cascade of fabric just above a rotund mannequin and a flimsy stand.  A strong scent of fresh flowers from some unseen source nearby lingers in the air.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Pool]
description: Steam rises from a large oblong pool as the water glistens in the sun.  Crystal oil lamps atop tall silvery poles rise from the polished river stones which cover the ground to the tall evergreen trees that enclose the area.  Small tables rest between pairs of dark wicker lounge chairs with deep green cushions.  A small channel leading off the pool flows to the door of a petite boat house, and a series of glass doors lead into the inn.

Small tables rest between pairs of dark wicker lounge chairs with deep green cushions.  A small channel leading off the pool flows to the door of a petite boathouse, and a series of glass doors lead into the inn.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Lockers]
description: Rows of lockers line the shelves along the walls of this compact space.  An old sturdy table is centered between two sets of shelves, and appears to be capable of holding the contents of any of the lockers you can see.  Your locker has been removed from its assigned niche and sits ready for you on an old sturdy counter.

title: [Silvergate, Office]
description: A tall leaded glass window offers a view of the bustling streets below.  A rose vine-carved pearwood desk sits atop a floral and bird motif silk rug.  The tufted ivory leather chair behind the desk matches the chairs around a polished oblong mahogany table.  Tall pearwood bookcases circle the room, filled with books and small treasures.  A miniature replica of Silvergate Inn is centered on the oblong table.

title: [Silvergate, Member's Bath]
description: Rosy surfaces gleam in the glow of a soft light.  Sunken in the floor is a luxuriously large marble tub, steam rising from the water's surface.  Sculpted in gold, a naiad rests in the corner, water from her jug ready to warm your bath.  A single wash basin will serve your needs should you have no time to tarry.  Large and small, soft clean towels are neatly stacked in a corner shelf.

title: [Silvergate, Marble Tub]
description: Immersed in warm and soapy water beneath a sculpted naiad holding her jug at an angle above the tub, you can't help but feel yourself relaxing.  Every so often you find your body sinking lower and lower into the water, your eyelids getting heavier and heavier.  You feel like you could stay in here for hours!

title: [Silvergate, Dianatrue's Suite]
description: A warm-hued, hardwood oak floor is polished to a lustrous glow, and matching thick ceiling supports frame a leaded crystal dome.  One wall, created entirely of intricately mortared pieces of flagstone, holds a massive fireplace with an oak mantelpiece.  Deep-cushioned wing chairs of wicker ring a small, cloth-covered table in one corner, and a four poster bed rests directly beneath the crystal dome.  A curtained archway leads to a balcony, and an alcove holds an indistinct shape in its recesses.

title: [Silvergate, Dianatrue's Balcony]
description: Wide and spacious, the balcony overlooks the treetops and boulevards of the town below.  Pairs of comfortable wing chairs and wrought iron tables are scattered along the flagstone floor and near the hewn oak railing.  One table holds a chessboard, while a few others against the wall are elegantly set as if for a formal dinner.  Inset into the middle of the balcony floor is a polished silver lion rampant ringed by lustrous silvery moonstone roses.

title: [Silvergate, Meditation Room]
description: Polished oak floors with an inlaid teak border add to the tranquility and elegance of the room.  Centered in the room is a large stone basin with fragrant white water lilies floating in crystal clear water.  Delicate white sheer drapes hang down from an elaborately carved teak canopy that spans the ceiling.  Meditation mats circle the water basin, and tiny crystal prisms hang at different heights from the canopy.

title: [Silvergate, Short Corridor]
description: Set off the main hallway and quiet, the corridor is well-lit by a small window to the east.  Small portraits line the white walls on either side of the doors.

title: [Lady Mistyrose's Playroom]
description: In the center of the room a gorgeous brass filigree swing sways slightly. The glass of a large bay window reflects a rosewood bedroom set, a beautiful painting hung over a polished marble fireplace and a breathtaking, solid silver puma which lounges on a bearskin rug. In one corner an antique table is covered with items used for mixing potions. You note several pairs of worn, mismatched bootlaces, and a wand for bubble making peeking out of an ancient elven fishing kreel.

title: [Silvergate, Sitting Room]
description: This elegant little sitting room is filled with fragrance and color from the fresh flowers arranged in crystal vases placed throughout the area.  Botanical paintings in gilt frames hang on the rosewood-paneled walls, while a soft floral rug cushions every step.  Two ivory damask settees with polished rosewood frames flank a low tea table, inviting relaxing conversation over drinks.  In the corner, a deep green raw silk cushion offers a comfortable resting spot.

title: [Silvergate, House Library]
description: Bookcases rise from floor to ceiling and nearly encircle the entire room.  Only a heavy oak door and two windows, each rising from a cushioned window seat to the ceiling, interrupt this overwhelming collection of knowledge.  Several comfortable chairs and ottomans are scattered throughout the room awaiting those who care to take a journey through the histories and literature of your Elanthian lands that line the shelves.

title: [Silvergate, Smoking Lounge]
description: Devoted to masculine pleasures, this dimly lit room is paneled in mellow cedar -- the scent of the wood mingles pleasantly with that of fine pipe tobacco.  The floor is cushioned by a patterned sisal rug, and a large library table surrounded by comfortable leather chairs provides room for a game of cards or for a pipe to be carefully packed.  Flanked by potted palms, an antique ship's bar stands against the far wall.

title: [Silvergate, Short Corridor]
[Silvergate, Officers' Wing]
description: The sun coming through a small oriel window set high on the southern wall illuminates the portraits which line the corridor.  The ash wainscotting is waxed and polished to a gleaming finish.

title: [Silvergate, The Retreat]
description: Thick draperies of heavy green silk cover the window, shutting out the bustle and haste of Wehnimer's Landing.  The walls, papered with a cream colored brocade, are hung with paintings of local landscapes.  Dozens of sweetly scented candles grace the mantle and flicker merrily from wall sconces.  A delicate bedside table is pulled up close to a large fluffy featherbed.

title: [Silvergate, Mystic Room]
[Silvergate, Mikalmas's Room]
description: The walls of this cozy room are shrouded in midnight blue gossamer.  Swaths of dove grey silk line the ceiling, drifting down into the corners of the room.  A low brass stand placed near the large bed holds a porcelain incense burner.   Against the opposite wall is a small, crow-footed table on which rests a crystal ball.  Candles, thoughtfully placed throughout the room, cast a soft and exotic glow.

title: [Silvergate, Mountain Retreat]
description: This small chamber has been lined with rough-hewn stones.  A deep pile of thick furs lies before a small fireplace.  A small rack of firewood fills the room with the pungent smell of freshly split wood.  Hung above the fireplace is a gleaming steel-bound shield, backed by a crossed axe and hammer.

title: [Silvergate, Ivy Rose Room]
description: This room looks like a garden.  Skillfully rendered cloud formations are painted across a sky blue ceiling.  Vines of ivy, intertwined with rare and exotic flowering plants, cling to the posts of a canopied willow-wood bed.  A mirror, nearly lost among the ivy, is like a doorway into a leafy universe.  The deep rug gives the impression of lush, carefully tended grass.  The light reflecting from a crystal mobile suspended from the ceiling scatters colors, like bright tropical birds, throughout.

title: [Silvergate, Room With a View]
description: An arched window offers a panoramic view of the town of Wehnimer's Landing.  Beneath the window sits a modwir table inlaid with fine gold tracery.  Four cushioned oak chairs are pulled up to the table.  Facing the window is an exquisite modwir daybed covered with decorative pillows made from fine, rare fabrics.  One wall is dominated by an elegant red-brick fireplace.

title: [Silvergate, Short Corridor]
[Silvergate, Members' Wing]
description: A small oriel window set high on the northern wall illuminates the portraits which line the corridor.  The ash wainscotting is waxed and polished to a gleaming finish.

title: [Silvergate, Mapmaker's Room]
description: Several leaded-glass windows allow a flood of light into the room, bathing the massive cartographer's worktable in bright light.  Scattered on the table are the tools and products of the mapmaker's trade.  A small, brass-paneled fireplace remains unlit.  An ornate bookcase takes up much of one wall.  The room is brightened by an exotically patterned rug covering the polished parquet floor.

title: [Silvergate, Boudoir]
description: An enormous antique armoire takes up much of one wall.  Nearby is a mirrored vanity table and a matching chair.  An elegant black-laquered four-poster bed, dramatically draped in swathes of crimson silk, fills one corner of the room.  A five-panelled silk screen sections off the back right corner of the room.

title: [Scuttlebug Tavern, Grey Room]
description: Cozy, yet practical, the tiny bedroom is devoid of decorations and houses a single featherbed that is covered with faded grey quilts.  Standing opposite the open driftwood door and resting beside the room's lone window is a slender oak dry sink filled with basic cleaning essentials.

title: [Scuttlebug Tavern, Red Room]
description: Cozy, yet practical, the tiny bedroom is devoid of decorations and houses a single featherbed that is covered with faded red quilts.  Standing opposite the open knotty oak door and resting beside the room's lone window is a slender oak dry sink filled with basically cleaning essentials.

title: [Bard Guild, Foyer]
description: Lush crimson carpeting spreads over the grey and gold flecked marble floor.  A pair of high-backed chairs sits to the side of a marble stairway leading up to the second floor, a wide banister landing visible from below.  Sounds of merriment drift from a high teak archway draped with rich velvet curtains, while a large flowering plant tumbles out of a stoneware pot and creeps into the long hallway that leads away from the foyer.

title: [Bard Guild, Lower Hallway]
description: Beautiful teak molding adorns the white walls of the hallway that leads further into the guild.  A pair of tall, arcing windows look out into a lush garden that is bright with blooming flowers.  Verdant ferns hang down over the polished marble pedestal that stands on display next to a wood framed archway draped with pale silk.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: Standing off to the side, a glaes mandolin sculpture rests on a wooden pedestal inlaid with thin strips of gold next to a carved mahogany desk.  A pair of velvet cushioned chairs flank a tall window curtained with layers of pale gauze.  Several potted plants are placed about the room, giving contrast to the white marble floor.

title: [Bard Guild, Cholen's Haunt]
description: Rows of crystal glasses hang from a rack above a carved teak bar that runs the length of the room, while twin arcing windows stand behind it and are draped in curtains of thick silk that mute the natural light.  A variety of inviting tables are scattered around a small wooden stage; shadows dance across the surface from flickering copper wall sconces hung about.  A large marble statue stands to one side of the archway and looms over the room, its face chiseled with an expression of approval.

title: [Bard Guild, Lower Hallway]
description: Blowing through the high, arcing windows, a gentle breeze fills the hallway, cooling the humid air.  A beautiful watercolor hangs next to a teak-framed archway, where a pale silk curtain is pulled to one side.  Gold flecks in the marble reflect the sunlight, making the floor sparkle.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: Rays of sunlight shine through the tall window, giving the wood trim a lustrous golden shine.  A wide writing desk is placed to once side, and a variety of instruments displayed on a rack leans against the wall.  Carved from dark mahogany, a gold-inlaid music stand is placed in the center of a bright carpet, while several sheafs of sheet music are haphazardly piled all about.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: Framed in gold, an oval mirror hangs at the end of the hallway, while underneath a crystal vase of flowers rests upon a carved mahogany table.  Twin arcing windows look into the beautiful garden and allow a mixture of floral-tinged scents to fill the air.  A pale silk curtain partially covers a teak archway, the light brown wood shining in contrast to the white walls and marble floor.

title: [Bard Guild, Master's Office]
description: Rich cerulean carpeting covers the marble floor of this spacious office, contrasting with decorative molding of light golden wood.  Placed as the focal point, a large mahogany desk stands centered behind a matching armchair.  A towering bookshelf filled with various items rests against the back wall next to a tall window draped in sheer gauze.  Fashioned of cut-glass a protective case sits to one side, housing a beautifully crafted lute.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]
description: Clumps of rotted straw lie scattered across the decking that stretches from the inner hull to the wide, wrought iron slats of the cell's rusty bars.  Black rings fixed to the walls with thick iron staples are evenly spaced along the bulkhead and fitted with manacles.  The stench filling the cramped space is heavy with mold and decay.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Plaitime's Home]
description: Knotty oak floorboards spread across the room to the surrounding walls of dark pine, which are sparsely decorated with ragged tapestries.  Resting in the corner, between the iron-reinforced door and the narrow ebon-curtained window, is an enormous granite fireplace with a pair of patched leather armchairs set before it.  Partially secluded from the rest of the room is a dirty pile of rags and a low table covered with a dingy cloth.

title: [Helden Hall, Bedchamber]
description: In the center of the room is a large canopy bed covered with a plush, crushed black velvet comforter with squared and rounded pillows.  On the floor before you lie several rugs made from various hides that have been sewn together with golden thread.  The walls have been covered with ancient pelts and claws.  In one corner of the room you see initials of the various warriors who once made this room their home away from home.

title: [Helden Hall, Bedchamber]
description: Blue and white wall hangings alternate with shields along the walls of this large room.  Two suits of armor bearing greatswords guard the golvern-banded door.  A simple cloth rug bearing Helden Hall's coat of arms covers the floor of the room.

title: [Methais's Home, Balcony]
description: The fresh air and moonlight on the rooftops of the city and the waters of Solhaven Bay to the west create a sense of serenity out here.  Twining ivy covers the wall, and climbing roses shroud the ivory railing.  Pale gardenias sit in the corners in elegant polished vases, their soft fragrance lingering in the night air, and maple leaves lie scattered on the balcony floor from a recent sea breeze.  A narrow set of steps descends from the north end of the balcony to a small garden on the house's north side.

title: [Methais's Home, Garden]
description: Shrouded in the shadow of the two story house on one side and the dense foliage of the boxwood hedge on the other three, the garden is lit only by the night sky.  Water gurgles from the top of the rounded mass that is the fountain at the garden's center, and ripples dimly break the jet surface of the basin's water that encircle its base.  A narrow set of steps climbs from the garden to the balcony, hugging the house's west wall.

title: [Methais's Home, Laboratorium]
description: Multicolored, noxious vapors fill the air above an an alchemical apparatus of twisted tubing and alembics that takes up almost half of the room.  To either hand, the walls are lined with cages holding a variety of animals and large insects--some common, some rare and a few that you've never even heard described before.  Gazing about the chamber, one has to wonder what insane individual would need such a bizarre assortment of equipment and fauna, and for what purpose?

title: [Methais's Home, Game Room]
description: A large table fills nearly half the room.  Sitting on the table is a detailed model of Teras Isle.  The town of Kharam-Dzu, the Fhorian Village, a volcano and lava flows--complete with club-wielding pyrothags--fills the tabletop.  At the far end of the table you can see a small ferry leading from the town to the Kiramon mines, and even a few miniature Kiramon poised near the mine entrance.  Winding its way across the landscape is what appears to be some sort of racetrack.

title: [Paupers, The Triple Chalice Bar]
description: The rich smell of many ales lingers in the air above the tables that are positioned around the room.  The smooth glaes top of a teakwood bar reflects the dim lighting of the room.  Behind the bar is a large mirror and racks filled with strange liquors imported from distant lands.  An elegantly framed portrait hangs above the mantle of a glossy obsidian fireplace.  Sounds of gambling and laughter come from a polished marble archway, and a colorful rosewood runestaff carved in the image of a barmaid serving two ales is mounted over the entry.

title: [Paupers, Game Room]
description: There is an aura of energy in this brightly lit room.  Empty glasses are scattered about on the various tables.  Cigar smoke drifts lazily through the air.  In the center of the room stands a soft felt-covered table, inviting you to try your luck with the roll of the dice.

title: [Paupers, Balcony]
description: Gazing out from the balcony you can see the southwest corner of the Town Square.  The bustle and clamor of the town seems blessedly far away.  A rose-covered trellis climbs up to the balcony from the grounds below.  The subtle smell of roses mixes pleasantly with the rich smell of ale from the pub.

title: [Paupers, Wide Hall]
description: This wide, carpeted hallway is quiet and peaceful.  At the end of the hallway are some wide double doors, above which is a rosette stained glass window.  Sunlight illuminates the glass, casting the hallway in bright colors.  An ornate winding staircase leads up, and a lapis-inlaid plaque hangs next to an ora-bound door.

title: [Paupers, Upstairs Hall]
description: Sunlight streams through a small dormer window, bathing the hallway in a soft, golden light.  An unlit brass lamp hangs above the winding stairs.  A small, ale-stained, sisal rug covers the floor.  The pleasant smell of ale and the sound of clinking glasses comes from the west.

title: [Paupers, Performers' Courtyard]
description: This small, quiet courtyard is bordered on the north by the main structure of House Paupers.  To the east are the ornate arches leading to the Hall of Lore.  To the south and west are tall, impenetrable hedges up which a flowering vine has grown.  A riverstone fountain chuckling pleasantly in one corner of the courtyard is shaded by a flourishing apple tree.

title: [Paupers, Hall of Lore]
description: Many of Elanthia's finest artisans have contributed their talents to create this large amphitheater.  Terraced seating comprised of blue cushions arranged on oak benches descends to the floor in concentric circles.  A raised speaker's podium occupies the center of the hall.  The walls of the amphitheater are adorned with paintings of elaborate landscapes and sweeping vistas.

Two wide marble terraces lined with blue and gold runners sink down to a polished ebonwood dance floor.  The top terrace opposite the arches leading out is partially enclosed by gilded railing, reserving space for musicians with music stands at the ready.  Low couches and plush chairs are scattered in small groupings among the terraces, inviting conversation.  Colorful silk and velvet tapestries adorn the walls, lending a festive air.

title: [Paupers, Guest Room]
description: The sunlight shining through the thick, leaded glass window casts a warm, relaxing light through the room.  An oak bedstead holds a thick feather mattress on which a plump, down-filled comforter has been folded.  A blue vase holds some freshly cut golden chrysanthemums.  A cinnamon-colored wicker chair occupies one corner.  On the wall is a framed oil painting.

title: [Storage Hall]
description: The hall is dark, lit only by a guttering torch over each of the two doors and a beam of light pouring through a small hole in the wall.  The obsidian walls are unbroken by decorations, and any noises echo loudly off the stone.

title: [Locker Storage]
description: This room is unremarkable in its plainness.  The walls are of perfect obsidian, unmarked and undecorated.  A single lantern lights the area with a dim glow.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Log Field]
description: The vast forest of oak and modwir trees stretches out in every direction, broken up only by a wide expanse of stumps.  The field ends at a thick gathering of trees that seems to spread out endlessly.  Nearby, a few wagons have been loaded with lumber and rest near a crate of weathered hatchets.

title: [Guardian Keep, Gatehouse]
description: Within the gatehouse, a deep shadow is cast by the surrounding granite walls.  Rows of iron sconces are mounted along each thick wall to hold flickering torches.  Above the torches, the walls are dotted with arrow slits, and high overhead, a series of murder holes can be spied.  A massive iron portcullis leads to the keep's formal courtyard, while shining eahnor gates exit to Amaranth Court.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Log Field]
description: The vast forest of oak and modwir trees stretches out in every direction, broken up only by a wide expanse of stumps.  The field ends at a thick gathering of trees that seems to spread out endlessly.  Nearby, a few wagons have been loaded with lumber and rest near a crate of weathered hatchets.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Log Field]
description: The vast forest of oak and modwir trees stretches out in every direction, broken up only by a wide expanse of stumps.  The field ends at a thick gathering of trees that seems to spread out endlessly.  Nearby, a few wagons have been loaded with lumber and rest near a crate of weathered hatchets.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Log Field]
description: The vast forest of oak and modwir trees stretches out in every direction, broken up only by a wide expanse of stumps.  The field ends at a thick gathering of trees that seems to spread out endlessly.  Nearby, a few wagons have been loaded with lumber and rest near a crate of weathered hatchets.

title: [Bard Guild, The Troubadour Pub]
description: The pub is a dark, cozy place redolent with the interwoven odors of ale, wine and stronger brews.  The mellow oak tones of floor, walls and ceiling are accented by rich oxblood-colored leather, which covers all the chairs occupying the room.  A long, low bar stretches across the back wall, and hanging just over it is a huge trophy, the snarling head of a massive black bear.
