title: [Troubadour Pub, Adagio Table]
description: The table is made of carved oak, its rim rich with bas-relief horns, fifes, lutes and various other more obscure instruments.  A lantern sits in the table's center, casting a warm, golden glow on the chairs clustered around the perimeter of the ring of light.

title: [Troubadour Pub, Nocturne Table]
description: Around the circular rim of the oak table is a richly carved motif of musical notes, phrases and accents.  They intertwine, blending into a softer rendering of a night sky occupying the interior surface of the tabletop.  A crescent moon sits in the center with a halo of finely incised beams extending from it.  Chairs cluster around, featuring sculpted backs and deep red leather seats.

title: [Bard Guild, Feast Hall]
description: Although its ceiling is the predictable Icemulian low variety, the Feast Hall is none-the-less a cavernous room.  Dark-toned beams support the ceiling, and a massive stone fireplace occupies the entire east wall.  Therein, a score of halflings could comfortably stand side by side.  Blocky oak furniture arranged in intimate groupings is illuminated by a number of rectangular lanterns sitting in the room's corners on wrought-iron legs.

title: [Bard Guild, Lower Hallway]
description: A short, low-lit hallway is lined with doors and openings, with heavy velvet drapes to the north that shield the corridor from the Feast Hall's din.  The walls of the corridor are paneled in dark wood, and a row of rectangular lanterns standing on either side of the aisle sheds soft light.  Each door is labeled.  A brass sign on an oak door reads 'Practice Room,' to the east is the 'Music Room,' and to the south is the 'Music Library.'
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, up

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is an oak-paneled chamber with a small hearth.  In the center sits a chair and accompanying music stand.  Opposite the hearth is a side table, offering a place to scribble notes or work on musical compositions.

title: [Bard Guild, Guild Office]
description: The Guild Office is an austere chamber, occupied by a massive oak desk and matching chair.  The only other furnishing is a large painting hanging opposite the door.  Though sparsely furnished, the office is paneled on all sides with polished wood, which radiates an opulent ambiance through its rich and glowing tones.

title: [Bard Guild, Landing]
description: The narrow staircase pauses at a landing where the stairs crook around a curve.  To the northeast, an arch takes the place of the carved panels decorating the other walls.  A pair of bas-relief masks hangs on the lintel of the arch, one with an exaggerated grin and the other a tragic grimace.

title: [Bard Guild, Upper Hallway]
description: A short, well-lit hallway runs from the Green room at one end to a backstage door at the other.  Strictly functional, it provides access to the necessities of theater.  A row of overhead lamps washes the hallway in light.

title: [Bard Guild, Music Library]
description: Oak shelves filled with music manuscripts stand tall on all sides.  In the room's center, a library table offers a place to sit and peruse the wealth of melody and lyric residing in those impressive stacks.  Wrought iron lanterns with delicate amber-colored paper shades shed a golden illumination, making the parchment of the tomes look like antique ivory.

title: [Bard Guild, Music Room]
description: Painted panels adorn the music room's walls, showing scenes of woodland vistas and country lanes all blanketed with a pristine covering of snow.  Overhead, the ceiling arches into a small dome, likewise decorated with a painted firmament.  A ring of chairs sits beneath the dome, with a music stand placed before each chair.  Large cushions are arranged around the grouping, providing comfortable seating to an audience.

title: [Bard Guild, Entry Hall]
description: Just beyond a heavy wooden door leading back out onto the street lurks a warm, if not exceptionally spacious hallway with walls and ceiling of raw timber graced here and there by golden musical notes.  Several oil lamps hang from the beams, providing small pools of golden illumination leading to a little shop occupying a nook in the western wall.  The sounds of music drift upward from the darkened depths of a broad curving staircase, occasionally punctuated by bursts of laughter.

Snow is packed tightly between thick wooden support beams, creating a cocoon of warmth inside the snowdrift.  Several oil lamps hang from the beams, providing small pools of golden illumination on the packed snowy floor.  The sounds of music drift upward from the darkened depths of a broad curving staircase, occasionally punctuated by bursts of laughter.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Pathway]
description: Winding away from the bustle of the busy Freeport, the stone walkway disappears under a driftwood gate.  A polished pewter-framed plaque is attached to one side of the entrance while a blackboard is hung on the other.  A vine-draped stone wall surrounds the garden beyond.  Tall verdant trees rise up from behind the barrier framing a beautiful manor house, the elegant greenery contrasting the stone and white washed facade.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Garden]
description: Greenery around a charming manor provides a backdrop for a colorful array of flowers taking shelter under a grove of assorted fruit trees.  Burbling brightly, a multi-tiered riverstone fountain is surrounded by three carved benches.  A path of round stones meanders up a small hill to the steps of a gazebo, then down to a stunningly azure pond.  The ever-moving focal center of the garden, a muster of vibrantly plumed peacocks struts amongst the verdure.

Bathed in soft moonlight, a large riverstone manor is surrounded by verdant greenery and a fragrant array of flowers and fruit trees.  Moonbeams bounce off of a burbling stone a multi-tiered riverstone fountain surrounded by three carved benches, and a path of round, grey stones meanders up a small hill to the gazebo steps, then down to a dark azure pond.  Occupying the ever-moving focal center of the garden, a muster of regal peacocks strut amongst the verdure, their colors eye-catching beneath the stars.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Gazebo]
description: Ivory marble inlaid with green and gold extends to the high, domed roof, contributing to an uncluttered, open feel.  Hanging from the rounded roof, a multitude of pots overflow with flowery growth, their tendrils draping down to mingle with morning glory vines twining up the gazebo's supporting colonnade.  Surrounded by verdant life and soft fragrance, several wicker chairs accommodate striking views of the garden and pond below.  A muster of blue peacocks strut about, their vibrant plumes swaying behind.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Pond]
description: Rambling through the sunlit garden, a grey stone path ends at the pond's bank, which is bordered with lush azalea, water lillies, multi-hued wisteria, and bamboo trees.  Soft colors line the deep blue water, as garden hues mesh on the reflective surface.  Ensconced by purple and ivory water lilies, floating lily pads blanket the perimeter, and tiny green frogs lightly skip from one padded perch to another.  A small dock bordered with weeping willows juts over one edge.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Entrance]
description: Pale stone steps lead up to an elegant riverstone manor, a woven doormat rests in front of a pair of stained glass doors.  An assortment of ceramic urns blooming with colorful flowers are placed about, the beautiful blossoms and greenery spilling over to blanket the steps.  Hanging to one side is a small brass bell, its polished surface shines brilliantly in the bright sunlight.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Foyer]
description: Oriel windows, graced with recessed seats, are framed in azure draperies of soft Vornavian silk that pools in placid folds upon the polished floors.  Climbing up to an open landing, an elegant stairway fixed with a decorative spindled railing looks over a pair of cozy linden chairs with a matching table between.  Resting in the center of the floor is a plush emerald green rug richly designed with the image of a peacock, while a blue silk banner hangs above stained glass doors.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Garden Retreat]
description: Colorful arbors laden with blooming plants are placed over the path that winds through the garden.  Benches are set to the side in semi-secluded nooks surrounded by shrubbery.  A clear glass roof peaks out above a verdant hedge row with a smoky glaes door placed between the thick bramble.  Beds filled with bright flowers cover the ground between blossoming trees, their heavy fragrance filling the air with a rich, sweet scent.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Evelith's Room]
description: The high peaked ceiling and walls are made entirely of glaes, magnifying the light that enters this plant-filled room.  Trilliums, aster, and chrysanthemums cluster along a winding path that works its way toward two large eucalyptus trees that support an oversized hammock.  Privacy is maintained with a climbing vine on each wall, with ivy framing the door and a trellis supporting wisteria.  Beneath the trellis rests a small font and various flowers seeking the shade provided.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Garden]
description: Surrounded by a grove of white oak, the clearing is shielded under a verdant leafy canopy above.  Several hewn logs are set around a riverstone fire pit, pale moss beginning to blanket the surface.  A pile of sticks is stacked neatly to one side sorted by size and thickness.  Set into a smaller niche, a polished modwir swing hangs from one of the tallest trees.  Moonlight filters through from the natural roof illuminating the area below.

Surrounded by a grove of white oak, the clearing is shielded under a verdant leafy canopy above.  Several hewn logs are set around a riverstone fire pit, pale moss beginning to blanket the surface.   A pile of sticks is stacked neatly to one side sorted by size and thickness.  Set into a smaller niche, a polished modwir swing hangs from one of the tallest trees.  Sunlight filters through from the natural roof illuminating the area below.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Upper Landing]
description: Resting between a pair of miniature orange trees, an elegant brocade silk divan is the perfect contrast to the terra cotta pots.  Hanging above, a large painting framed in linden shows a beautiful watercolor of the Cascade of Tears.  The polished floor is graced by a narrow, fringed runner and gleams in the light of a cut-crystal chandelier.  A sweeping staircase descends to the foyer below.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Meeting Room]
description: Polished to a gleaming shine, an enormous pale oak table sits in the center of the room surrounded by high-backed chairs.  A silver and glass tray is centered upon a large sideboard that is placed under a silk draped window on the outer wall.  Woven from fine Vornavian wool, a tapestry map of Solhaven hangs opposite a linden door, its surface stitched with precise detail.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Ballroom]
description: Velvet-covered divans and settees rest comfortably against the white stucco walls, leaving the golden linden dance floor free of clutter.  Heavy draperies decorate the double archway that leads into the foyer, as well as the long expanse of a raised oak stage.  Frosted glass globes fitted with tiny candles dangle from the vaulted ceiling to lend the room soft illumination.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Lounge]
description: Shelves of colorful bottles line the rounded wall centered within a large circular oak bar.  A variety of crystal drinking glasses hangs upside down from a rack above.  High-backed dark leather chairs scatter about the room, turned away from a curtained archway to focus on a large riverstone fireplace.  A basket of sticks sits to one side, with a well used dart board hanging above.  Next to sliding linden doors, a huge green fern hangs over the edge of the ceramic pot to caress the ivory wool carpeting.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Dining Room]
description: Crystal chandeliers hang from the ceiling, their positioning perfectly illuminates a trio of flowery tables set about the room.  Blue and green braided throw rugs decorate the polished linden floors, their patterns swirling about creating a fanciful pattern.  Framed by a pair of blooming rose bushes, a swinging door leads out of the dining area.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Art Gallery]
description: Mahogany paneling greets feather-patterned indigo damask halfway up the outer walls, while an enormous picture window of tempered glass occupies the inner wall.  Stylized rafters stretch in a gentle arc across the vaulted ceiling, the lacquered lengths supporting lanterns that create small pools of light over the various sculptures and statues that fill the gallery.  Wide open lanes provide egress to and from the area, and also make it easy to view the individual pieces of artwork that are on display.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Art Gallery]
description: Set upon an indigo background, the ebon feather-patterned damask that decorates the walls provides a complimentary backdrop to the many portraits that decorate the space.  Lacquered rafters form the bones of the vaulted ceiling and support the various lanterns that provide light for viewing.  Soft carpeting, in matching hues, stretches across the floor towards a wide opened arch that leads into a quiet garden.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Art Gallery]
description: Dangling from bronze chains, several frosted glass globes descend from the lacquered mahogany rafters to provide soft illumination for the various paintings that decorate the feather-patterned walls of indigo and ebon damask.  Opposite the displayed art, a picture window of tempered glass provides a view of the small garden at the heart of the gallery.  A decorative gold-accented loom occupies a space near the southeastern corridor and artistically displays a finished piece of cloth-of-gold embroidery.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Art Gallery]
description: Glass shelves supported by bronze fixtures spread across the outer wall, which is decorated with an inverted teardrop pattern of indigo and emerald damask.  Rib-like exposed rafters of lacquered mahogany stretch across the vaulted ceiling and provide an excellent anchoring point for the frosted globes that dangle throughout the air.  Gold foil decorates the ornate arch that leads into a garden, its polished expanse carved to resemble enormous peacocks.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Courtyard]
description: White trellises lean against the walls to either side of the arches set into the northern and southern walls of the art gallery, while fruit trees flank the picture windows that are fashioned of tempered glass.  Enormous planters, filled with tea roses, are positioned around a stone slab that rests upon the backs of peacock statues.  The focus of the small garden is a decorative bird bath that is surrounded by blown glass hummingbird feeders.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Partially covered, the polished linden floor shows at the edges of a cerulean carpet.  Several unique doors of different sizes and colors line the walls.  A small stream of water trickles down a rock formation built against the wall, patches of moss covering smooth stones in the basin.  A small marble fairy stands to one side, gazing at the waterfall.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Cote Room]
description: The flickering glow of candlelight gives this study a cozy feeling.  The walls and floor are decorated with skins and tapestries.  On one wall, a small metal birdcage sits near a large window that overlooks the gardens of Cairnfang Manor.  A tiny wooden desk sits in one corner, covered in books and bits of paper.  Old leaves, broken quills, and books litter the floor around it.  A strange scent hangs in the air.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Study Suite]
description: Sketches of herbs and plants decorate the cream walls, and a tan fringed rug tops the gleaming linden floors.  Swathes of beige gauze enclose an alcove, in which is tucked a quilt-covered bed.  Across from the sleeping alcove is a wall filled with bookshelves.  A book and paper-strewn desk rests to the one side of the door, and a dresser topped with a vase of lilacs graces the other side.  A multi-paned window overlooks the manor grounds.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Dancer's Rest]
description: The majority of the smooth hardwood floor is free of clutter, though several discarded pieces of brightly colored costumery peek out from beneath a bed shoved into one corner of the room.  Bolted to one pale yellow wall at approximately waist-height is a polished wooden rail that runs half the length of the room.  Opposite, the chamber is reflected in a double-paneled mirror that stretches from floor to ceiling.  Gauzy blue curtains tugged by a playful sea breeze frame an open window beside the bed.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Textured cerulean carpet extends down the hallway, covering the polished linden floor.  A cushioned fel bench rests against the wall next to a shiny brass canister, a leafy fern draping its long green leaves over the edge.  Several doors lead into various member rooms.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Winter's Heart]
description: Sunlight spills through the window of this cozy room, refracted into myriad tiny rainbows against the walls by the snowflake prisms suspended in front of the clear glaes panes.  A mahogany bed rests against the far wall, and a tall basin-topped table carved of the same dark wood is partially concealed by an ivory and rosewood folding screen.  Triangular planks of fel have been inlaid to form a starburst-patterned floor, its burnished shine reflected in the a tall oval mirror standing in one corner.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Ranger's Rest]
description: Two intricately carved overlarge arched windows provide the room with an open, airy feeling.  Long lengths of pale natural silks drape the arches in a loose frame that stirs with the slightest breeze.  Faint claw marks mar the sill as if large cats have exited through the windows.  In one corner, a large divan faces opposite a river stone fireplace, which is flanked by a pair of tall, freestanding wrought iron candelabra.  Tucked discreetly in the corner is a basket of sticks.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Squirrel Haven]
description: Sky blue washed walls surround the plush green carpeting of this nature-inspired room.  The ceiling is decorated with white fluffy clouds.  An oak tree-shaped bookcase stands in the far corner of the room, its branches covered sparsely with green felt leaves and hanging multicolored lanterns.  Along the opposite wall rests a lacquered oak bench topped with coppery velvet cushions.  Sprawled in the middle of the room lies a peach and white checkered blanket covered with fuzzy squirrel-shaped pillows.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Set upon a small decorative table, tiny goldfish swim about a small bowl, their small bodies darting and dancing about each other in the water.  Several potted plants are placed along the hallway between a series of doors.  The pristine white walls are a perfect background for the verdant foliage.  Polished linden molding continues along the ceiling, the golden wood adding warmth to the area.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Private Study]
description: Warm, brassy light spills from a carefully positioned sconce, pooling on the surface of the burled maple desk below it and casting mossy shadows on the spring green rug.  Partially obscured by an artfully draped linen swag, a darkened window takes up much of the west wall, with gliding pinpricks of light beyond it hinting at ships on the bay.  The bulk of a pale rose velvet armchair is tucked into one corner of the small study, beside a low bookshelf of carved cedar.

Sunlight streams into the small study from a broad window centered in the west wall, which provides a breathtaking view of Solhaven Bay only partially obscured by a low-hanging swag of artfully draped linen.  Lofted on spiral-carved legs, a narrow burled maple desk is positioned against one wall, while a low bookshelf of carved cedar rests against the wall opposite.  Tucked into one corner of the chamber is a pale rose velvet armchair, a braided spring green wool rug stretched out before it.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Deacon's Abode]
description: Modwir paneling and a vaulted ceiling give the room a sense of openness that is accented by the scarcity of furnishings.  An enormous desk presides over the center of the room, with a trio of chairs around it and a few along the walls within easy reach.  A large screen divides off a corner of the room, where a simple cot is propped against a heavy trunk.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Running down the length of the hall, the deep cerulean carpet continues along this side of the manor.  Ornate pewter sconces hang at regular intervals along the wall.  A small cushioned chair stands against the wall among the various doors that lead to private rooms.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Oravia's Room]
description: The walls and door are painted with a mural of a meadow and a bright blue sky.  Within the mural, along the far wall lies a red fox under a silver crescent moon.  A large, grass green, plush rug covers the wooden floor, continuing the feel of the outdoor scene.  Resting against the center of the left wall lies a neatly made bunk bed.  A huge display case sits opposite the foot of the bed on the right wall.  Overstuffed chairs can be found in either far corner of the room.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Desert Palace]
description: The light scent of orange blossom and patchouli rise from a copper burner to swirl throughout this richly colored room.  The center of the room is sunken and filled with lush silk-covered pillows and beautifully woven blankets.  Along the far wall, a collection of pottery and copper objects sit beneath a massive gold-framed oil painting.  Dim light flickers from the many candles set inside a large gilded chandelier that hangs from the center of the ceiling.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Framed in silvery mistwood, a beautiful painting of Solhaven covers one wall, the giant piece of art perfectly detailed.  An arched glass door leads out onto a balcony, its frosted panes etched with beautiful peacock feathers.  A pair of potted shrubs are placed to either side, their verdant hues a sharp contrast to the white silk walls of the hallway.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Cascade Bar]
description: Overhead, the flaring overhang of the manor's roof shelters half of this sprawling balcony, including a broad mahogany bar, from the depredations of weather and the drifting mist of the nearby Cascade of Tears.  The semicircular floor is a mosaic of irregularly shaped blue and green tiles arranged in a loose spiral and bound to the north by the curve of a low stone balustrade.  Below, flowers bloom amidst the verdant foliage of a garden perched at the water's edge.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Hanging from a copper stand, a beautiful golden birdcage sways back and forth, a pair of small canaries fluttering about inside.  Polished linden floors peek out from under a rich cerulean carpet crafted with patterns that swirl in upon themselves.  A white marble pedestal stands against one wall, a beautiful porcelain windflower displayed inside a clear glass case.  Several unique doors line the walls on either side of the hall.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Eiadh's Room]
description: Three large windows allow sunlight to flood this plainly furnished room.  A simple, frameless bed sits directly on the hardwood floor, across from a wooden desk and chair.  Several bows and quivers full of arrows line a rack along one wall, and a tall wardrobe sits in the corner.  The only decorative items adorning the room are a wall hanging of an elven crest and a framed paint-splotched hide.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Kilthal's Room]
description: Tall bookshelves line two walls of the cozy chamber, their shelves filled nearly to overflowing with books, scrolls and folios of documents set in orderly rows.  A carved linden door stands between them at one end of the room, opposite an expanse of glass providing an inspiring view of Solhaven Bay.  Drawing the sea indoors with its color, a plush ocean blue rug covers the floor.  A large oak desk is positioned centrally, with a cushioned leather chair drawn up behind it and backed by the massive window.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Kasia's Room]
description: Walls of pale grey silk enclose this serene space, matching the plush wintry carpet that spreads across the floor.  Sheer organza curtains undulate from an unseen breeze coming from the sunlit window.  A gracefully curving bed of intertwined pale willow branches rests on a dais in a corner, the aubergine silk coverlet a vivid contrast to the otherwise stark surroundings.  Plush chairs covered in plum-on-silver damask rest in front of an alabaster fireplace, their surfaces carved in swirling arabesque

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Beautiful linden molding adorns the white silk walls that stretch down the hallway.  Doors crafted in a variety of styles mark the private rooms of the manor's members.  Growing from a ceramic urn, a potted rosebush climbs up the wall, supported on a wire trellis.  Its deep crimson and verdant colors are a sharp contrast to the lighter hues in the area.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Shiril's Salon]
description: Elegant furnishings litter the room, providing a lavish retreat.  Plush scarlet carpeting lines the space between grey and blued river stone walls interspersed with fel panels and decorated with detailed paintings.  Lighting the salon, small crystal chandeliers are decked with scarlet despanal accents, and lofty bookshelves are filled with tomes, scrolls, and aged fine wines, rums, and brandies.  Arranged around a pale blue stained glass table are two cocoa-hued divans.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Songie's Rest]
description: Several large, crystal globe-capped sconces are evenly spaced throughout the floral-papered wall, providing soft luminosity for the quaint room.  Tiers of teak shelves rise in one corner, their lengths laden with heavy terracotta urns that are planted to overflow with all manner of flowers and herbs.  Golden sunlight spills through the red velvet-framed windows, providing nutrients for the vegetation and also dispelling all shadows from around a double-wide mahogany bed and a carved golden linden chair.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Charna's Room]
description: Exposed rafters stretch across the ceiling, their thick lengths laden with incredibly tiny copper lanterns and thick bundles of ribbon-wrapped larkspur.  Moonstone cabochons have been forced into the ebonwood walls at various heights and create the image of multiple constellations scattered about the room.  Though tidy, the room houses only a large pile of sleeping furs in one corner and a large sea grass basket in another.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Library]
description: Deep armchairs covered in midnight blue velvet are scattered about, creating a striking contrast to the paneled walls of golden oak.  A matching couch, flanked by a pair of end tables, sits before a large riverstone fireplace, a basket of sticks placed nearby.  Filled with wildflowers, a painted ceramic urn rests between two etched glass windows, their frames draped in sheer white silk.  Pewter sconces provide light for reading, and shelves filled with a variety of books line the back wall interrupted by a beveled glass door.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Cascade Vista]
description: Perched on the very edge of Solhaven Bay, the manor's back garden lies cradled in a lush riot of brilliant foliage.  Above, the endless cataract of the Cascade of Tears tumbles into the bay with a roar that vibrates the air even as it is muted by the abundant greenery.  Breezes waft curtains of fine mist through the garden, accumulating moisture upon the petals of myriad colorful blooming flowers as well as the canopy of leaves that shelters a large hammock strung between two spreading magnolia trees.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Attic Landing]
description: Spiraling up, the staircase leads from the hallway to a small attic room.   A thin layer of dust coats a large stack of boxes, chests and sacks stored against the wall.  Sunlight filters in through a small linden-framed window, tiny particles dancing in the air.  A series of footprints lead away from the area, their shapes and sizes indicate the variety of frequent visitors.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Attic]
description: Covered in white sheets, several pieces of large furniture are stored along the walls.  The sizes and shapes suggest beds, tables, chairs and a lumpy, misshapen sofa.  The pile's stair-like pattern leads up to a trapdoor in the ceiling.  Tiny prints in the dusty floor suggest that a family of mice have taken up residence in the small spaces and hidden nooks of the attic.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Attic Nook]
description: Sunlight beams down through a skylight set in the ceiling above illuminating three wooden chests bound with brass fittings.  Several mannequins stand tall showing off fashions from days long past.  Hanging next to a partially open window, a large steel-wire cage sways slightly to and fro.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Attic]
description: Racks of long forgotten clothing hang to one side of an iron-banded door.  Wigs in a variety of colors and styles sit upon mannequin heads lined neatly upon a wooden shelf.  An antique fel mirror rests against the wall, part of its glass exposed from under a thick white sheet.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Locker Annex]
description: Cleaner than the rest of the attic, the room looks to have been recently swept.  A plain wooden bench sits next to an archway curtained with a faded drape of linen.  Stacked next to an iron-banded door, a partially opened crate reveals several small pieces of artwork.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Attic Nook]
description: Stacked haphazardly about the room, trunks, crates and other storages boxes stand in an unorganized pile.  The layers of dust indicate that the items have not been needed for some time.  Several pieces of furniture are covered with white sheet, the various shapes hiding their identity underneath.  A slightly open window gives a view of the front gardens and the town of Solhaven.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Locker Annex]
description: Dried flowers hang from the rafters in this part of the attic, their fading scents fill the air with an earthy sweetness.  Swept clean the floor has been cleared of the clutter than fills the other attic rooms.  A small window to the east lights the room the panes of glass streaked with dust as if recently washed.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Locker Annex]
description: Filled to overflowing with books, a wooden sea chest dominates the corner of the small hall.  Several old paintings are propped against the wall to either side of an archway curtained with faded linen.  A worn carpet covers the floor, its surface threadbare and the once vibrant colors faded with age.

title: [Grey Ghost Table]
description: The walls surrounding this cozy booth have been hung with a sheer grey material.  Out of one floats the faintest image of a ghost, shimmering in and out as the light material ripples.  A table made of sanded aspen sits in the center, carved lightly with vaguely humanoid shapes.

title: [Bombastic Banshee Table]
description: A large oil painting done in tackily bright colors dominates the wall behind the table.  Staring out from the canvas is a slightly heavyset woman, dressed in clashing finery.  While the pose she has been painted in is meant to be provocative, it only serves to make her look further overdone and overbearing.  In her hand, she is wielding a large battleaxe.

title: [Fleeing Phantom Table]
description: Murals of the landscape around the Inn cover the walls, painted by an obviously talented artist.  In the corner of one is the tail end of a phantom, who is obviously fleeing for cover.  A table of rough-hewn modwir sits in the center of the chairs.

title: [Wrangled Wraith Table]
description: A tapestry hangs behind the table.  It depicts the Inn before its restoration, more specifically, a tiny room with a large pile of postprocessed marmot food.  Standing in the center of the room is a small group of adventurers, proudly displaying a wraith that they've caught.

title: [Xenophobic Zombie Table]
description: Shelves line the walls of the booth.  Sitting on them are a number of statues, knick-knacks and antique children's toys.  In the center is a large articulated zombie puppet, leaning back against the wall.  Although his face is meant to be carved as fierce, it looks more paranoid about the creatures surrounding him.  A thanot table stands in the center of the nook.

title: [Flustered Flibbertigibbet Table]
description: Tiny implike figures have been carved into the large maoral table.  Their faces run the gamut of emotions, but the largest one in the very center of the tabletop looks completely flustered.  His agitation is evident, even though the carving is static, and those around him nearly seem to be mocking him.

title: [Amicable Apparition Table]
description: A border of painted paper decorates the walls of this nook.  A repeating pattern runs the length of the papering, depicting a floating apparition.  Despite his dead state, he looks really quite friendly and chatty.  A haon table carved with the same pattern stands in the center of the booth.

title: [Religious Revenant Table]
description: A large painting of a revenant hangs on one of the booth's walls.  He is dressed in a priest's attire, including a ridiculously large mitre perched precariously on his head.  Around his neck hang a multitude of holy symbols, tangled and knotted with wear.

title: [Sloppy Specter Table]
description: Painted on the walls in a riot of color is a large mural.  It depicts a feast for the dead, attended by every form of undead known in the world.  Off to one side is a specter who has stuffed himself too full of a berry pie, and as a consequence is covered in fruit and juices.

title: [Shameful Shade Table]
description: Paper fans hang on the walls, covered in lovely painted designs.  One hangs slightly askew, however, and on its surface is painted a woman's shade.  She stands, hands clasped before her, looking shy and slightly ashamed of herself.

title: [Drooling Rolton Table]
description: A large painting hangs on the wall.  The painting shows a drooling rolton standing menacingly over the corpse of an infamous lord.  Behind this spectacle towers Melgorehn's Reach.

title: [Sneaky Kobold Table]
description: On the wall hangs a painting of a kobold lying in ambush behind a tree stump.  A short sword firmly clenched in his fist, the kobold scouts for easy victims.

title: [Soaring Blood Eagle Table]
description: A copper tablet hangs next to the table.  On the tablet is etched a huge blood eagle soaring high in the sky.  In its claws dangles a rather energetic halfling.

title: [Striking Cobra Table]
description: On the table stands a brass statue of a coiled cobra.  The cobra looks like it's ready to strike at any moment.  Yellowish fluid drips slowly from its mouth.

title: [Ghastly Revenant Table]
description: This is a very nice and quiet table, placed over in a far corner.  Strange that people seem to stay away from it.  Stranger still is the creepy feeling that someone is standing next to you, occasionally touching you.

title: [Tenacious Wolverine Table]
description: Someone with an artistic bent has carved a wolverine and an attacking fighter into the table.  The wolverine has bitten into the fighter's sword and doesn't seem to have any plans of letting go.

title: [Charmed Cockatrice Table]
description: Someone has left their gorgeous feathered boa draped over a chair.  One of the serving wenches casts furtive glances at it, seemingly quite enticed by the elegant fashion statement it makes.

title: [Naughty Monkey Table]
description: In the corner next to the wall stands a stuffed monkey.  Its brown fur is a bit on the mangy side, and its paw is stretched pleadingly towards you.  The effect is ruined somewhat by the monkey's frozen, mischievous grin.

title: [Hissing Basilisk Table]
description: On the table is a yellowed and sooty basilisk skull turned upside down.  A beeswax candle hisses cheerfully inside the skull, casting a warm glow on the nearby patrons.

title: [Spinning Spider Table]
description: The black-stained yew table is carved into the shape of a giant spider.  On the wall and part of the ceiling hang old fishing nets, no doubt meant to mimic spiderwebs.  A small figurine is bolted into the floor next to the table.

title: [Rival Thrak Table]
description: On the wall hangs a framed rendering of a fat warrior panting over a slain thrak.  The sweating, big-nosed warrior is all but hanging on his sword.

title: [Smelly Manticore Table]
description: From the ceiling hangs a small cluster of dried and shrunken manticore heads.  Smoke drifts lazily up from some incense sticks stuck into a sand-filled bowl.  The incense does help a bit.

title: [Stunning Grey Orc Table]
description: A very lifelike portrait hangs on the wall here.  The portrait shows an old, leering grey orc leaning on a gnarled thanot staff.  Above the orc's head hangs a radiant gas cloud.

title: [Hungry Ghost Wolf Table]
description: A well-made charcoal drawing of a ghost wolf is tacked to the wall.  Through the wolf you can see the crumbling remains of a once stout tower.

title: [Ugly Cave Troll Table]
description: The wall next to the table is covered by a tapestry.  The muted scenario shows a group of Faendryl elves being attacked by cave trolls.  The trolls look quite happy to have found some good grub.

title: [Pouncing Puma Table]
description: The chairs next to the table are draped with golden puma hide.  The soft hide is tastefully embossed with small circular shapes in various sizes.  The edges of the table are beautifully carved into the shape of hemlock leaves.

title: [Raiding Krolvin Table]
description: On the table stands a small, wooden model of a serpentine krolvin ship.  An intricately carved dragon's head sneers from the ship's bow.

title: [Beautiful Vereri Table]
description: A heavy, grey marble tablet hangs on the wall.  In bas-relief is carved the image of a hauntingly beautiful woman clad in tattered robes.  A large temple looms in the background.

title: [Savage Warcat Table]
description: On the wall hangs a large, exquisite warcat hide.  The soft, black fur is complemented by tapering, grey stripes.  In a crystal vase on the table stands a single, black rose.

title: [Guardian Keep, Courtyard]
description: A wide cobblestone walkway leads across a cultivated green lawn directly to the doors of Guardian Keep.  Flanking the walkway on either side are rows of meticulously trimmed hedges, expertly shaped to resemble a variety of creatures.  The keep itself soars three stories high, its crenellated granite walls anchored by an immense tower at its northwest corner.  To the east and west, a path leads to row upon row of dazzlingly colorful flowerbeds.  A massive iron portcullis exits to the gatehouse.

title: [Guardian Keep, East Garden]
description: The lawn rises and falls in gentle hills, and narrow paths wind around the natural slopes, looping among beds of pink and white carnations, crimson dragonstalks, lush hostas, and fragrant angelica.  Three large fountains adorn the garden:  to the north a Vaalor soldier stands at attention, his sword point down before him; to the south, a wyvern spreads its wings, its maw agape in anger; and centered on the main path, a traditional fountain with six tiers of golden bowls burbles quietly.

title: [Guardian Keep, East Garden]
description: The gentle rolling hills are dotted with small clusters of linden and bergamont trees, creating pockets of shade across the lawn.  Several smaller trails diverge from the main path, providing ample opportunity for a private, peaceful stroll.  The main path heads west toward the courtyard and southeast toward a small copse of trees.

title: [Guardian Keep, Orchard]
description: The limbs of the trees intertwine overhead, creating a thick canopy through which rays of sunlight filter.  The sweet, heady aromas of apple, cherry, peach, and bergamot flood the area.  A heavy iron fence closely borders the cobblestone path along its entire length as it snakes its way through the orchard, prohibiting any access to the trees or their fruit.

title: [Guardian Keep, Stable Grounds]
description: A sprawling riverstone stable stands in the shadow of the towering bailey wall, flanked by several large apple trees.  Rows of open-front stall doors face the lawn, and a large dirt paddock is enclosed directly in front of the building.  Attached to the east side of the stable is a smaller riverstone house, behind which is a low dormitory.

title: [Guardian Keep, Parade Grounds]
description: Several rows of wooden stands surround the large, closely clipped lawn of the parade grounds.  Centered between the south stands is a raised crimson pavilion, which houses several rows of plush seating and an opulently appointed throne for the king.  Scores of gold and crimson pennants strung from high poles surrounding the area whip proudly in the breeze.

title: [Guardian Keep, Postern Gate]
description: The slope of the lawn creates a natural depression around the postern gate, where a broad circle of paving stones is bordered by some square-trimmed boxwood bushes.  The cobblestone path divides the lush, green lawn, heading north toward a small, tranquil pond and southeast to the parade grounds.  The keep is festooned with brilliantly hued banners in crimson and gold, which hang near the top of the crenellated walls.

title: [Zellista's Outfitting]
description: A tasteful rune staff display hangs on one of the red brocade walls, and an elegantly arched fel ceiling rises overhead.  A wyvern painted ivory vase sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is a carved oak table on one side of the shop and an elegantly carved oak armoire on the other.

title: [Estrellaj's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a sturdy oak beam ceiling, an old elven war banner hangs on one of the textured ivory silk walls.  A iron-bound ebonwood chest and an intricately carved ebonwood stand sit in opposite corners while a tarnished brass urn rests on a glossy black ebonwood floor.

title: [Jubilae's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by textured blue silk walls, the shop features a serene golden wyvern fountain in the center of its golden oak floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the arched ceiling.  Right near the front is a carved oak table and a large cherrywood cabinet.

title: [The Art of Giving]
description: Enclosed by white brocade walls, the shop features a large potted fern in the center of its cherrywood floor.  A gold and crimson wyvern tapestry hangs under the beam ceiling.  Right near the front is a carved oak table and a large cherrywood cabinet.

title: [Sythion's General Store]
description: Beneath an elegantly arched fel ceiling, an old elven war banner hangs on one of the grey watered silk walls.  A gold-veined black marble counter and a twisted dark metal rack sit in opposite corners while a serene golden wyvern fountain rests on a glossy black ebonwood floor.

title: [Tyrrah's Armory]
description: Enclosed by textured red silk walls, the shop features a horse-mounted female statue in the center of its ebonwood floor.  A gold and crimson wyvern tapestry hangs under the arched fel ceiling.  Right near the front is a carved oak table and a gold-veined black marble counter.

title: [Guardian Keep, West Garden]
description: Neat rows of flowerbeds are arranged in uniform lines north and south of the cobblestone walkway in alternating rows of begonias, hydrangea, and aromatic lavender.  A phalanx of ancient willow trees stands sentinel along the path, each with an ornately carved wooden bench shaded beneath it.  Several smaller paths branch from the main walkway to allow further exploration of the garden.

title: [Guardian Keep, West Garden]
description: Over the top of the granite wall, the three towers of the Wizard's Guild can be seen.  Within the garden, a fourth tower looms, its crenellated crown rising over the others and dwarfing the handful of shade trees planted across the lawn.  The wide cobblestone path curves southwest toward a quiet pond and east toward the main courtyard.

title: [Guardian Keep, Quiet Pond]
description: The wide cobblestone walkway splits into two as it encircles a small pond then merges again into a single broad path.  Though the pond is perfectly round, clusters of cattails and other tall grasses have been planted around its banks, and the pond itself boasts several clusters of water lilies, their colorful leaves and pink and white blossoms bobbing gently on the water's surface.  A small wooden dock stretches out over the water, and several fancifully wrought benches surround the area.

title: [Guardian Keep, Grand Hall]
description: Two stories above, the vaulted ceiling is adorned by chandeliers of vivid fire-hued crystal.  A commingling of crimson and golden light falls in shattered patches on the snowy marble floor and columns, setting them brightly ablaze.  The hall ends in a large eahnor-banded archway framing twin linden doors, with a set of gold-flecked stone steps guarded by a pair of brass braziers to its right.  Nearly hidden in the splendor is a wooden door leading into the eastern wall.

title: [Guardian Keep, Grand Hall]
description: Resplendent banners of crimson and gold festoon the procession of columns to either side of the hallway.  At the center of the walk, a tremendous statue stands atop a tiered dais, haloed in the golden light of sconces adorning the nearby columns.  Sanguine-hued runners border sprawling walkways that delve into dark corridors to the east and west.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Guardian Keep, West Hallway]
description: Crimson and golden tesserae wink from the curved walls of the hallway, echoing the vivid hues of the lush runners carpeting the walk.  Lit by sullen torchlight, a tall an elven soldier statue at the hallway's end lifts its blade in a tireless salute.  Panes of stained glass in fiery hues blaze to either side of the entrance of a recruitment office, its fanfare a stark contrast to the plain entrance of the opposing armory.

title: [Guardian Keep, West Armory]
description: Torchlight reflects from the surfaces of chainmail and plate adorning stands spaced across the armory in a mock formation, the burnished armor magnifying the room's radiance.  Along the walls, teak shelves store a wealth of weaponry ranging from daggers to mammoth greatswords.  Sharp scents of metal polish and old metal war pungently in the air.

title: [Guardian Keep, Reserve Barracks]
description: Separated from the armory by a steel door reinforced by a series of stout diagonal bars, the barracks have reaped the full benefit of their occupants.  Not a bit of brasswork is less than radiant, nor is there even a hint of dust to mar the stones of the floor, which are worn to an almost glassy smoothness.  The curved walls are lined with some tidy triple bunk beds and matching brass-bound cherrywood footlockers, both spaced with martial precision.  Beneath a small window in the western wall, a simple oak table rests amid a crowd of wooden chairs.

title: [Guardian Keep, Recruitment]
description: Gold and crimson stained glass panes glisten from the walls to either side of the office's entrance.  Nearby, a curved teak desk rests in an otherwise spare corner, its expanse raised to look down upon a hard wooden chair set before it.  A series of crimson banners festoons the spotless walls, each banner marked with a different raptor's gold-edged silhouette.  Leaning against the desk is a sheathed sabre bearing a carved ivory hilt.

title: [Guardian Keep, East Hallway]
description: Sword aloft, a hulking Vaalor elf is remembered in statue at the end of the low-ceiling chamber.  Runners of golden and crimson velvet soften the tiled floors below, the hues reflecting in the burnished marble of the ceiling.  A lustrous mosaic-tiled arch gleams from the southern wall at the hallway's midpoint.  Near the corridor's end, the simple entrance to the armory and a swinging oak door heading into the kitchens stand opposite one another.

title: [Guardian Keep, Kitchen]
description: Beneath overtones of woodsmoke, the air of the kitchen is peppered with delectable scents of roasting meat and baking bread.  In stark contrast to the symphony of scents, the kitchen is largely utilitarian.  Beyond a series of wide-bellied cast iron stewpots, wide countertops boasting neatly bunched vegetables devour much of its space.  Huge recesses in the walls host hearths cooking spitted velnalins and gaks.  A swinging oak door in the north wall stands opposite a smaller doorway to the south.

title: [Guardian Keep, Dining Hall]
description: Polished oak tables of honey-hued oak span the length and breadth of the hall, flanked by solid benches cushioned by simple crimson upholstery.  Bright vermilion banners graced by raptors of golden embroidery flourish from either side of the vaulted ceiling, from which is suspended a cluster of brass chandeliers.  One end of the hall is occupied by a raised table clad in fire-hued cloth.  At the other, a recessed door leads into the kitchens.

title: [Guardian Keep, East Armory]
description: A trio of gigantic whetstones occupies a large portion of the stone chamber, which is bordered by teak shelves containing a variety of weaponry and armor accessories.   One edge of a teak table hosts a polished metal vise.  A break in the southern wall is guarded by a reinforced steel door leading out to the barracks.

title: [Guardian Keep, East Barracks]
description: Bordered by bunks and accompanying footlockers, the barracks are close and tight.  Military precision keeps the area free of mold and smelling of polish, with just the faintest undertone of dried sweetgrass rising from the mattresses adorning each bunk.  A blossoming potted dragonstalk clashes brightly with the spartan nature of the rest of the chamber.  Well-tended, the sole hint of vibrant life rests atop the table at the far end of the chamber.

title: [Guardian Keep, Grand Hall]
description: Shaped from shining white marble veined by streams of vibrant gold, tremendous fluted columns rise from the floor to support the second-story arched ceiling.  Punctuating the march of the columns are muscled figures of stone and suits of burnished armor.  The plush runners underfoot flow like crimson rivers, sheathing the cold marble of the floor.  Arches to the west and east lead to the citadel's barracks, while a set of doors opens onto the courtyard.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Spectral Mist]
description: Weeds, black and slick with some singularly foul form of rot, grow thick in the malodorous bogs that line the twisting trails.  The bone-grey fog eddies slowly through the bent, skeletal trees.  The listless breeze is tainted with the stink of decay.

title: [Miasmal Forest, Ghostly Trees]
description: Rotting reeds and marsh grasses mix with the turbid water to befoul the air with a noxious stench.  The sickly trees rising from the miasma look like skeletal figures reaching into the befouled mist.  The trails disappear into the thick chalky mist.

title: [Abandoned Cutter, Hold]
description: Little remains useable inside the abandoned cutter.  Any access to the rest of the vessel is barred by crumbling or destroyed portals and ladders.  All that remains is the hold which has been modified as a smuggler's hiding spot.  Chains hang from one bulkhead and torture implements sit patiently on a nearby table awaiting further use.  Humanoid bones litter the floor and a nauseating stench pervades the air of the hold.

title: [Beacon Hall, Gazebo]
description: The twinkling of countless shattered gems brightens the floor of this enchanting open air gazebo.  Simple low benches provide plenty of comfortable seating but do not detract from the view of the courtyard through the large open arches around them.  The domed ceiling, decorated with a large fresco, sparkles with inset gems in the moonlight.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Bisecting the narrow companionway between the rows of wrought iron cells is a large wooden framing post marred by nicks and scratches down its rough expanse.  A black iron ring supports the manacled form of a rotted skeleton draped in tattered clothing that might once have been an Imperial Navy uniform.  Foul odors fill this section of the ship, made worse by the damp, sea-laden air.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Officers' Prize Closet]
description: The closet is well-lit, but so small that it leaves barely enough space to turn around.  An oversized trunk rests at the base of one wall, while shelves rise to the ceiling lining two more walls.

title: [Beacon Hall, Attic]
description: Cobwebs stretch in intricate patterns across every nook and corner of the attic, and the smell of mildew hangs in the air like an invisible presence.  Layers upon layers of dust coat scattered shelves housing books with indecipherable titles, and high overhead and opaque with grime, a single, small octagonal window allows slight bits of light to trickle in.

title: [Beacon Hall, Private Room]
description: Heavy drapes are drawn aside, allowing ample light into the room.  Though lacking in personal touches, rich furnishings make this a welcoming retreat for visiting dignitaries and scholars.  A large desk near the window offers ample workspace, and the carved thanot featherbed promises comfortable repose after a long day.  A bouquet of fresh flowers graces the bureau, and a thick carpet covers the floor.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Annex, Cairnfang Manor Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  An ivory velvet pennant adorned with a golden peacock hangs near a heavy wool curtain.  Hanging from one wall is an ivory-framed dark marble blackboard.  A small mother-of-pearl bin is tucked in a nearby corner.

title: [Atrium, Kitchen]
description: Gold-veined ebon marble covers the countertops and a large island workspace that dominates the center of the room.  Ceramic crocks of all shapes and sizes overflow with fresh ingredients, exotic scents mingling with the tropical air that drifts through a pair of large windows.  A dark brick fireplace fills one wall, with several smaller ovens built into the side for baking.  Various utensils hang from steel hooks, their surfaces brightly polished.  A teak and bamboo dry sink stands open, its shelves filled with a variety of foods.

title: [Pool]
description: You are in a murky, cold pool of water.  Although it does not seem very deep, your feet do not touch bottom.  Beneath the surface, down about 7 feet or so, there appears to be a floor of solid rock.  A flat, narrow ledge of granite forms the shore.

title: [A Deep Mist]
description: A wall of dark sinuous mist enfolds itself around you, obscuring your vision.  The cold unwelcome blanket suppresses any hope of spotting a way out.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Drafix's Magic Shoppe]
[Drafix's Weaponry]
[Drafix's General Store]
[Drafix's Outfitting]
[Drafix's Combat Gear]
description: Enclosed by honey gold oak walls, the shop features a well-pruned lemon tree in the center of its gold oak floor.  A colorful Icemule map hangs under the stucco ceiling.  Right near the front is a heavy wooden desk and a narrow glass-topped table.

A mounted fish skeleton hangs on one of the painted black oak walls, and an oak beam ceiling rises overhead.  A well-pruned lemon tree sits in one corner of a honey gold oak floor.  There is a low wrought iron table on one side of the shop and a heavy wooden desk on the other.

Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the glossy onyx-inset walls.  A plain wooden table and a simple wooden shelf sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

A bundle of dried flowers hangs on one of the honey gold oak walls, and a pink stucco ceiling rises overhead.  A knotted woolen rug sits in one corner of a honey gold oak floor.  There is a lacquered wooden shelf on one side of the shop and a low wrought iron table on the other.

The broad sweep of the stone floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the glossy onyx-inset walls.  A plain wooden table and a giant invar-bound chest are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Drafix's Weaponry]
[Drafix's Magic Shoppe]
[Drafix's General Store]
