[Drafix's Combat Gear]
[Drafix's Armory]
description: Beneath a pink stucco ceiling, a pair of wooden snowshoes hangs on one of the honey gold oak walls.  A large brass-bound chest and a low wrought iron table sit in opposite corners while a bathing maiden statue rests on a honey gold oak floor.

Enclosed by glossy onyx-inset walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its stone floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a plain wooden table and a gold-veined black marble counter.

title: [The Swale, Plaza Garden]
description: Stacked stone bricks covered in creeping ivy create a wall around this grassy enclosure.  Pairs of wooden benches are scattered around the grounds, and a flourishing garden, filled with yellow daffodils and purple irises, produces a sweet aroma that wafts through the air.  A young sylvan woman, carrying a wicker rose-filled basket, wanders the garden, offering flowers to the seated couples.

title: [The Swale, Outskirts]
description: Caravans of wagons, and travelers on foot, trudge down a steep mountainside, their packs and carts full of wares to be sold at the market in town.  The formidable mountains stretch into the distance, blanketing the thinning landscape.

title: [The Swale, Plaza Center]
description: The center of town is bustling with tourists and residents, carts and wagons lining each side of the plaza.  Merchants from all over proudly display their wares and beckon you with obnoxious shouts.  From clothing to food, representations from the surrounding regions decorate the area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [The Swale, Plaza Northwest]
description: A cobblestone walkway forms a circle around a magnificent granite hawk statue that dominates the center of the plaza.  Visitors kneel around the sculpture and murmur hushed prayers, while others lay sticks and branches around its base.  Clay pots filled with blossoming foliage decorate the area, and small wooden benches offer a place of rest.

title: [The Swale, Plaza West]
description: Dozens of Kerria bushes have been cleverly manicured into decorative shapes, each symbolic of the surrounding regions.  People crowd around the floral displays, whispering about the artistic quality of the sculptures.

title: [Hall of Mages, Entrance]
description: The floor is made of white marble speckled with tiny flecks of gold and holds a lustrous shine.  A small copper plaque hangs on a wall near the large ornate double doors.  A large balcony opens up overhead, where dark blue tapestries hang from the polished banister.

title: [The Swale, Path]
description: Groups of visitors stumble past, raucous laughter and hollering coming from the west.  A drunken man is slumped against a building, humming a familiar tune in between his violent hiccups.  A weathered building with swinging wooden doors sits at the end of the walkway.

title: [The Swalery, Bar]
description: Tall wooden stools with criss-crossed backs are arranged in front of a polished cherrywood bar.  Geometric patterns of teak decorate the bar's surface, the names of outlying towns etched elegantly into the wood.  A grey-bearded dwarf tends bar, his oversized belly nearly knocking over the bottles of spirits that line the shelf.

title: [The Swale, Approach]
description: Just beyond the town's residential district, vast green pastures paint the landscape, and an occasional farmhouse ornaments the open view.  A dusty dirt path leads west and northeast, the cobblestones of the city barely visible.

title: [The Swale, Residential]
description: Picket fences and rows of shrubbery create home boundaries that line both sides of the street.  Housing both middle and upper class construction, this neighborhood displays a colorful representation of the town's diverse inhabitants.

title: [The Swale, Plaza Southeast]
description: A white oak fence, its slats enveloped in creeping ivy, surrounds a modest one-story building.  Small bones and cloves of garlic are draped around the doorframe, and a wooden sign hangs over the doorway.

title: [The Warding Way]
description: Glass display cases filled with colorful glass bottles line the walls of this small building.  Customers wander in and out, filling their totes and bags with various sundry items.  A large wicker basket is displayed on a table near the back of the shop.

title: [The Swale, Financial District]
description: Worn cobblestone stretches through the town, its path filled with hurried merchants and residents.  People come and go from the two buildings that dominate this end of the square, the town bank and the Swale Town Hall.

title: [Hall of Mages, Foyer]
description: The polished white marble floor is dusted with tiny motes of gold and leads up to a wide curving staircase with a smooth brass handrail.  Ascending along the wall beside the stairs are a number of gold-framed paintings, each depicting variations of Elanthia's magical spheres.

title: [Hall of Mages, Balcony]
description: A large marble balcony juts out over the foyer below, providing a clear view of the entrance.  From the polished railing of the indoor terrace hang woven tapestries depicting a golden hawk's head on a dark blue field.

title: [Hall of Mages, Long Hall]
description: Tucked behind the stairwell is a long hall with bare walls and a cold dark marble floor.  The passage ends at an iron-bound steel door.

title: [Hall of Mages, Workshop]
description: Marble walls and a matching floor keep the room chilled, while the alcove is devoid of any luxurious decorations.  A long wooden workbench is centered in the room, placed near a steel rack containing a variety of labeled beakers, bottles, scrolls, and wands.

title: [Hall of Mages, Hawk Hall]
description: Deep blue carpeting stretches down the long hall, ending at a wide gilt-edged door.  Above the door hangs an ornate golden sculpture in the shape of a hawk's head.  Curved arches are set into both sides of the passageway.

title: [Hall of Mages, Archives]
description: Carved dark oak desks are organized in rows throughout the enormous library, each one with a matching chair.  Upon every desk rests a small glaes orb where a dim light glows from within, illuminating the reading space at all hours.  Countless bookcases are filed around the room, each one housing hundreds of tomes, scrolls, and maps.

title: [Hall of Mages, Gateway Chamber]
description: The room opens up into a circular chamber with a golden knotwork design enameled into the sleek white marble floor.  Etched runes form patterns along the walls, broken up only by slender niches raised a few feet off the ground

title: [Mestanir Gate]
description: Constructed from polished riverstones, an ornamental arch stands as the symbolic gateway to Mestanir.  The gate is strictly decorative, no wall surrounds the town, and access is easily attained from any spot.  A multitude of small homes and buildings dot the small village.

title: [Northern DragonSpines, Icy Path]
description: Strong winds whip around the area, threatening to knock you off the edge of this formidable mountainside.  Continual snows have covered all recent traffic, either by man or animal.  A thick fog blankets the view over the eastern side of the DragonSpines, concealing the valley below.

title: [Idolone, Outskirts]
description: The stone street, leading from the center of town, seems to stretch on for eternity.  A small farmhouse decorates a lush green field in the distance.

title: [Barret's Gorge, Fourth District]
description: The smoke from cooking fires drifts lazily through the area, like tattered clouds carrying the crisp scent of fried pork and quail.  Simple brick and stone buildings line the dirt walkway, each set with square wooden signs.

title: [Mestanir, Eastgreen Street]
description: Carefully laid cobblestones form this narrow street, the tilework pleasantly complementing the wide expanse of greenery just off the path.  A few non-descript buildings along the east might be homes, the dwellings quite small and simple.  A pudgy black cat naps atop one of the rooftops, content to soak up the sun.

title: [Mestanir, Eastgreen Street]
description: The streets are oddly silent, certainly much too quiet with the sun halfway through its daily journey.  Visible in the distance, occasional villagers stride along the streets,  their pace hurried and with purpose.  Other than a few squirrels darting from tree to tree, the huge park to the west sits unused.

title: [Mestanir, Eastgreen Street]
description: Just off to the west, the impressive Fist of Koar dominates the center of the town green.  Crafted from a single massive piece of granite, its origins are unknown, but clearly the relic is far older than the town.  The grass surrounding the monument is neatly manicured and free of debris.

title: [Mestanir, Eastgreen and Temple]
description: Two cobblestone paths intersect at this vantage, a scattering of small residences and simple buildings surrounding the roads.  The temple of Koar is but a stones throw away, the facade of the large stone and tile structure built to face the town green.

title: [Mestanir, Temple Street]
description: Painstakingly constructed from tiny ceramic tiles and decoratively carved brick, the Temple of Koar boasts an impressive presence.  Meticulous care was given to the path directly facing the structure as well, the large cobblestones leading up to the temple replaced by a much smaller mosaic of colored tile.

title: [Mestanir, Dark Alley]
description: The narrow alley curves slightly, bordered by homes and buildings on each side.  The passage is dark, bathed in the shadow of the Temple of Koar nearby.

title: [Mestanir, Garden Lane]
description: A decorative stone wall surrounds the Temple of Koar, entrance granted within by a small postern gate.  A lush garden of ferns and wide-petaled flowers peeks out from just behind the wall, perhaps a place for quiet meditation or a morning stroll.

title: [Mestanir, Westgreen and Temple]
description: Most of the buildings along either side of the street are shuttered, their doors closed and windows mostly boarded over.  Several of the structures look deserted, a glance into the windows revealing nothing more than empty rooms and sparse furniture.  The path is empty of people, the villagers either indoors or elsewhere.

title: [Mestanir, Westgreen Street]
description: A small enclave of cabins circles a stone fountain just to the west, each of the wooden dwellings identical in shape.  The open lawns of each cabin are meticulously tended and vibrant.

title: [Mestanir, Eastgreen Street]
description: One of the few taller structures constructed within Mestanir sits just off the street, but the doors are closed and it doesn't appear to be open for business.  It might be a library or hall, but there are no signs hung from the exterior to lend a clue.

title: [Northern DragonSpines, Icy Path]
description: The mountain rises to the west while the cliff drops off drastically to the east.  As the path slopes upward, the layers of frozen snow and ice make the climb dangerous.

title: [Northern DragonSpines, Icy Path]
description: Wind and snow has painted intricate white designs against the mountain's rock wall.  The icy walkway continues upward and the return path has all but disappeared beneath the thick fog and snow.

title: [Idolone, Warehouse Row]
description: A large warehouse, painted blue and white, and decorated with small windows, sits on the northern side of the street.  Smaller, insignificant buildings flank each side of the dominant building.  The bustle of the busy square has grown quiet.

title: [Idolone, East Market]
description: Townsfolk move throughout the east market with a look of concern on their faces, seeming oblivious to your presence, while the merchants stand proudly behind each of their tables or within their stalls.

title: [Idolone, Central Market]
description: An assortment of tables, covered with dyes, pottery, and glassware, are placed at each corner of the market.  A stone building sits between the central stalls, but its door has been boarded up.  A small sign hangs crookedly on the structure's exterior.

title: [Idolone, West Market]
description: Numerous tables and stalls fill the street, and local townsfolk call out as passers byes wander through the market.  Pots of wildflowers and herbs offer a pleasant splash of color to the square.

title: [Idolone, Market Square]
description: The Bank of Idolone stands majestically at the top of the square, its white marble facade providing a perfect backdrop to the grand banner stretched across its gable.  The building appears to have been spared of any erosion or deterioration indicative of others in a coastal town.

title: [Idolone, Outskirts]
description: A well-tended path, lined with rows of wildflowers, extends to the northeast, ending at a small farmhouse.  A neatly tended flower bed provides a colorful home to a small, hand-painted sign.

title: [Holishant Farm, Kitchen]
description: The aroma of freshly baked bread wafts through this brightly colored kitchen and clusters of seaweed hang from the ceiling.  Bottles of unopened wine line the counters and fill boxes along the walls, each bearing a crest etched into the cork closure.  An open window allows natural lighting to flood the room.

title: [Barret's Gorge, Fourth District]
description: A huge stone statue is prominently displayed in the center of the road, its finely detailed features chiseled into the form of an armored knight with his longsword raised high.  In the backdrop, the large wall and gates separating the third and fourth district can be seen.

title: [Barret's Gorge, Fourth District]
description: The legendary Citadel of Barret's Gorge rises up in the distance like a colossal stone monolith, surrounded by four rings of fortified walls and secured gates.  Bystanders move about, many keeping their eyes forward and to themselves.

title: [Barret's Gorge, Fourth District]
description: Golvern-armored knights march through the area, their plate aglow from the sun's light.  The slated rooftops of homes form clusters throughout the sprawl.

title: [Barret's Gorge, Fourth District]
description: The sprawl stretches further out from the protection of the fourth district wall and its battlements.  Half a dozen horses are stabled to a post outside of a large grey brick tavern.

title: [The Demon Draught]
description: Old, grey brick walls comprise the foundation of the spacious tavern, where oak tables and chairs are set up around the common area.  A plump boar is set near a large red brick fireplace, the roaring flames roasting the pig and warming the tavern.  From behind a brass-railed countertop, a scar-faced bartender pours drinks for the guests.

title: [Demon Draught, Second Floor]
description: The floor is scuffed and the walls are bland, lacking any real kind of decoration beyond a few small lit sconces to provide a dim light.  A few wooden doors run along both sides of the hall, some of them looking worse for wear.

title: [Barret's Gorge, Fourth District]
description: The landscape is filled with homes, inns, taverns, and stables.  Knights and squires move through the avenue, all eyes to the south, while citizens hurry about on their daily business.

title: [Barret's Gorge, The Sprawl]
description: The ground is cracked, unused, and almost completely absent of flora.  There are no signs of shops or homes and bystanders avoid the area entirely.  To the south, the ancient and imposing Demonwall rises up to stand as the last bastion of civilization before the bleak lands beyond.

title: [Demon Draught, Feast Hall]
description: Long wooden tables and chairs run the length of the center of this hall, various spots still littered with old greasy plates and stains.  Stretched entirely across one whole wall is a faded tapestry depicting the image of two black towers on a field of dark green.  The sweet scent of cider wafts through from the kitchen in the back.

title: [Demon Draught, Wine Cellar]
description: Dark and cold, barrels and crates of wine suffocate most of the circular stone cellar.  Cobwebs hang high in the corners of the room, their silk webbing glistening from the orange glow of a sconce near the steps leading up to the main floor.

title: [Demon Draught, Rooftop]
description: To the west, the great Citadel of Barret's Gorge rises up like a giant black obelisk, its walls lined with soldiers and archers between parapets.  To the far south, the foreboding Demonwall stretches as far as the eye can see.  Down below, citizens move about their business, many keeping to themselves.

title: [Barret's Gorge, The Sprawl]
description: The ground is cracked, unused, and almost completely absent of flora.  There are no signs of shops or homes and bystanders avoid the area entirely.  To the south, the ancient and imposing Demonwall rises up to stand as the last bastion of civilization before the bleak lands beyond.

title: [Barret's Gorge, The Sprawl]
description: The ground is cracked, unused, and almost completely absent of flora.  There are no signs of shops or homes and bystanders avoid the area entirely.  To the south, the ancient and imposing Demonwall rises up to stand as the last bastion of civilization before the bleak lands beyond.

title: [Barret's Gorge, The Sprawl]
description: A huge flight of flat stone stairs ascends up to the top of the crumbling ramparts of the fabled Demonwall.  The wall itself stretches far and wide to both the east and west, each section disappearing further than the eye can see.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: A dry warm breeze moves over the wall's edge, bringing with it the faint stench of rotting flesh.  A flight of flat stone stairs descends down the side, leading to a cracked sprawl of land and Barret's Gorge to the north.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Rolling hills and mountains rise to the east, and far to the north lies an expanse of thick forests.  But to the south and beyond sits only a blighted wasteland, full of horrors and the unknown.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Sections of the wall's ramparts have crumbled here, long ago destroyed by calamity and war.  Far to the south, the tiny black forms of demonic creatures can be seen, like a thousand ants readying to march.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Archers stand partially concealed behind ancient parapets, periodically launching a volley of arrows down into the wastelands below whenever a hellish fiend approaches.  Nearby, the horns and cries of battle erupt almost endlessly.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Malformed, brutish creatures on black wings dot the sky.  They soar in and out of clouds, snarling and bellowing as they scout the area.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Gnarled, red-eyed ghouls ride upon the backs of large incarnadine hellhounds, bounding across the blasted wasteland beyond the wall.  A flock of carrion crows circles overhead, squawking with impatience.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Tattered knights shout as they rush along the wall, slashing at the countless beasts and fiends trying to scale up over the edge.  Vats of burning oil are poured upon the approaching demons, sometimes only fueling their rage.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Wounded knights and archers are dragged down off the wall, while others rise up to take their place.  The guttural, rasping howls of the demonic legion endlessly ripple across the battlefield.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: At the bottom of the wall, bodies are littered about, some of them knights, many of them demons.  The mass of corpses does little to stop the fiendish horde from their assault on the Demonwall.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Wispy trails of black smoke coil up in the distance, merging with the dark clouds overhead.  The land to the south is almost black itself, suffocated by the swarm of demons laying in wait.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: The footing along the wall is uneven, broken up by years of abuse and conflict.  The corpse of an archer lays with his back against a parapet, his entire face having been savagely ripped off.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Fresh, slick blood stains the walkway of the Demonwall.  Skeletal and knobby hands reach up over the edge, trying to gain a foothold before knights rush in, cutting the demonic creatures down.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: A low pale fog blankets the wasteland to the south, obscuring the true size of the enemy beyond.  Periodically, from out of the eerie mist, the forms of demon ghouls and blood red fiends come forward, shambling towards the base of the wall.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: The fighting is intense, as beasts of all gruesome form scale the wall, doing their best to push to the other side.  Armored knights are constantly locked in combat with them, their golvern blades all red or black with blood.

title: [The Demonwall]
description: Half of the walkway has crumbled here, preventing further travel to the east along the wall.  The hellish army uses the rubble for traction, easily spilling up and over onto the top, where a group of dwindling knights meet them head on.

title: [DragonSpines, Ice Plateau]
description: A generous ice plateau has formed at the top of the trail, and recent avalanches have left large boulders covering the area.  Swirling snow obscures the ground, making the footing quite dangerous.

title: [DragonSpines, Ice Plateau]
description: The ice deck continues to provide ample standing space and the rocks provide protection from a potential plunge off the mountainside.  Seemingly sturdy handholds and footholds are carved into the ice wall around you, leading up to another icy platform.

title: [DragonSpines, Ice Platform]
description: Reaching the top of the platform, the view is spectacular.  Jagged rocks form a sculpted landscape while fog and dense clouds partially cloak them.  A hidden crevice is nestled between the formed walls of ice and snow.

title: [DragonSpines, Ice Tunnel]
description: Walls of ice threaten to smother you as the path continues deeper through the extremely narrow frozen walkway.  The brutal winds outside occasionally whip through the ice tunnel.

title: [DragonSpines, Arctic Trail]
description: The ice tunnel opens generously, but the unrelenting winds continue to whirl around, creating a vortex of snow and debris.  A cave has been carved into the mountainside, possibly providing enough shelter from the inclement weather.

title: [DragonSpines, Arctic Trail]
description: The trail ends abruptly at an enormous boulder, blocking further travel. Beyond, the path continues its ascent up and over the DragonSpines.  Moss has grown in the nooks and crannies of the stone, adding a bit of color to an otherwise washed out view.

title: [DragonSpines, Arctic Ascent]
description: Another small platform of ice and snow has formed on this side of the boulder, but a small fissure, too wide to jump across, has formed across the traveled path.  The downward slope is decorated with broken and jagged rocks but the opposite side of the fissure is a steep wall.

title: [DragonSpines, Icy Fissure]
description: Partially concealed by snow and ice, old bones and frozen flesh are scattered across the floor of this fissure.  A sheer wall leads up and footholds of various sizes have been carved into the rock.  Imbedded in the wall's ice, a gold ring flashes briefly as light moves across.

title: [DragonSpines, Snowy Path]
description: A long snowy path opens, but the exposed area grants passage to the occasional surge of stinging gusts.  The terrain changes dramatically between packed snow and ice, and a fine powdery base, making travel risky.

title: [DragonSpines, Snowy Path]
description: The snowy path has become perilous, as wind and ice swirl about, often obscuring where the mountain ends and the drop-off begins.  Glistening icicles form along the frozen walls of the summit.

title: [DragonSpines, Snowy Path]
description: The hazardous trail winds narrowly around the mountain, the ground covered in thick ice and a heavy coat of snow.  Frozen piles of animal feces are scattered around the path.

title: [DragonSpines, Narrow Edge]
description: The jagged, icy trail ends at a dead-end, where only snow and rock await dangerously thousands of feet below.  The cold fog hugging the mountain has lifted slightly, revealing tiny snow-covered treetops in a deep valley beyond.

title: [Hall of Mages. Supplies]
description: An entire wall of the room has been covered by a massive bookshelf, neatly organized with a variety of ancient books, labeled tomes, and leather-bound compendiums.  A few colored bins have been set up throughout the area, each one containing a number of supplies.

title: [Idolone, Cobbles Street]
description: A more residential part of the city, houses now line the sides of the street.  The battles that rage on in the docks have not yet found their way to this part of town, but many residents are boarding up windows and pulling their belongings inside.

title: [Idolone, Cobbles Street]
description: A large modwir gate, built here more for decoration than protection, stretches from one side of the wide path to the other.  Slender oak poles topped with blue canvas flags flank each side of the gate's opening.

title: [Idolone, Dockside Way]
description: The rough wooden walkboards of the docks disappear here, and are replaced by dirt and grass.  In the distance, a large modwir gate stretches across the path.

title: [Idolone, Dockside Way]
description: Smoke and ash fills the air, even as the path leads away from the docks.  The buildings here seem less ransacked, but still show signs of destruction and abandonment.

title: [Idolone, Western Pier]
description: Ransacked buildings litter the docks, and on this end of town, citizens are running frantically through the streets shouting words of caution and alarm.  The pier continues to the northwest, stretching across the churning blue-green waters.

title: [Idolone, Northwestern Pier]
description: Incoming ships overwhelm the pier, completely dominating the surrounding waters.  Despite this pier's recent construction, the wooden planks and boards are marred with signs of battles and carnage.

title: [Idolone, Northwestern Pier]
description: Fishing gear litters the ground and the water surrounding the pier is full of dead fish and rotting flesh, some appearing to have belonged to more than just aquatic creatures.  Distress flares from origins unknown explode in the sky and light up the air around you.

title: [Idolone, West Dock]
description: Smoke seeps from the scorched wood on these structures, but there is no evidence of an active fire.  The more residential areas of town can be seen in the distance to the south, but this section of the docks is void of any profitable activity.

title: [Idolone, Middle Dock]
description: Abandoned buildings litter the docks with their broken windows and bashed in doors.  A wooden sign dangling on a single chain hangs crookedly above a burned-out door frame.

title: [Idolone, East Dock]
description: Multiple piers stretch side by side, accepting seafaring vessels from all over to these massive docks.  Dried blood stains the wooden planks on the ground and signs of recent battles are obvious with the accompanying stench of decay.

title: [Idolone, Warehouse District]
description: Both sides of the generous walkway are crowded with dark blue buildings, serving as storage warehouses for local exports and imports.  Large torn fishing nets lie haphazardly on the ground and rotten fish remain trapped inside.

title: [Idolone, Northern Pier]
description: Covered with barnacles and salt, this unstable pier offers a clear view of the nearby docks which are infested with triple=masted ships.  An old fishing pole lies on the ground next to an empty can of worms.

title: [Idolone, Docks Approach]
description: A large pier bounces roughly in the unsettled waters, its algae-covered pilings struggling to keep it secured.  Once crowded with local fisherman, the area is abandoned of any workers or shopkeepers.

title: [Idolone, Docks Approach]
description: Sea-washed buildings begin to fill each side of this modest boardwalk, many of them battered and broken.  Their walls show signs of deterioration and recent fires have destroyed any identifying signs or exterior furnishings.  A large pier dominates the landscape to the west.

title: [Idolone, Docks Approach]
description: Wooden planks emerge from the soft sand and form a suitable walkway to the upcoming docks and piers.  Worn from years of wind, rain, and salt, the wood creaks and moans with each step.  Assorted buildings and warehouses are visible to the west.

title: [Idolone, Rocky Path]
description: The path begins a steep ascent, and the rocks and boulders make walking difficult as loose stones tumble down the path.  The sounds and smells of a once bustling dock district have now been replaced by sounds of chaos and war.

title: [Idolone, Winding Path]
description: Following the coastline, the path winds in and out of large boulders, placed here to slow down the natural erosion.  In the distance, wooden piers jut out into the waters, triple-masted ships crowding the docks.

title: [Idolone, Sandy Beach]
description: Broken shells and various sized rocks litter the ground, partially concealing the sandy path that leads to the west.  An occasional breeze brings a mixed aroma of sea salt and fish, and the crashing waves produce a stinging sea spray.

title: [Mestanir, Westgreen Street]
description: Long shadows reach across the stone road, cast by the tall trees lining the border of the town green.  The dark tendrils waver in the slight breeze, the barely noticeable rustle of the leaves the only sound disturbing the silence of this otherwise quiet area.

title: [Mestanir, Westgreen Street]
description: A lonely cloud floats lazily above, the only flaw in an otherwise perfect sky.  A few sparrows take advantage of the pleasant weather, flittering from one rooftop to another, the small birds searching for the perfect perch.  Never tiring of their chase, the aerial dance continues for quite some time.

title: [Mestanir, Westgreen Street]
description: Several small houses line the end of this neatly paved street, the road abruptly ending at the base of small hill.  The homes are well tended, and very clean, but there is not a single window without a curtain covering the glass.  Carved into the nearby slope, a smooth trail leads upward to Koar's Crown.

title: [Mestanir, Westgreen and Garden]
description: Normally, this must be a busy intersection, all of the buildings fronting the street are clearly shops or offices.  A slowly tumbling leaf bears mute testament to the ominous silence of the area, commerce no longer a concern in this town.

title: [Mestanir, Westgreen and Mystic]
description: A tiny hut sits far off the road, a low fence surrounding the large courtyard that fronts the home.  The lawn is covered with leaves, and the small garden near the hut's porch is weed-filled and untended.  Occasionally, one of the shuttered windows cracks open just enough to reveal that the home is not deserted.

title: [Mestanir, Westgreen and Opal]
description: Just to the south, an arched wooden bridge crosses the Opalsand River.  More a stream than an actual river, the narrow band of blue water is flanked by wide borders of cattails and rushes to the north and south.

title: [Mestanir, Opal Lane]
description: Small, but well-cared for dwellings line both sides of Opal Lane, the homes offering a nice view of the nearby river.  A few small birds dart about the tall marshgrass behind the cabins, finding the thick vegetation a convenient spot to nest.

title: [Mestanir, Mystic Road]
description: Small homes line either side of the tiled street, the cabins simple in construction, but appearing to be comfortable enough for a small family.  A few squirrels skitter across the rooftops, their tiny claws clattering on the wooden shingles.  With the exception of the nervous animals scurrying about, the neighborhood is silent.

title: [Mestanir, Eastgreen and Garden]
description: Two giant ceramic urns rest just outside the temple walls, each of the containers adorned with a delicate ring of gold paint.  Both of the bone-white vases contain a tall healthy fern, the lush plants overwhelming in size.

title: [Mestanir, Eastgreen and Mystic]
description: Most of the homes along this street have huge yards, the residences well off the road.  Tall trees add to the privacy level, blocking almost all view of the houses behind them.  Sunlight peers through the heavy cover, casting long shadows on the cobblestoned path.

title: [Mestanir, Eastgreen and Opal]
description: The lazily flowing Opalsand river is just visible beyond the tiny cabins that dot this street.  Dragonflies dart along the water's surface, skimming along the stream with rapid beats of their long gossamer wings.  A quaint bridge crosses the small stream just to the south, the structure just wide enough for one or two people at a time.

title: [Wehnimer's, A Very Dark Alley]
description: Cloaked in pervasive shades of black and grey, nebulous shadows conceal the features of this covert back street.  Any hint of sunlight is mercilessly smothered by the close-set buildings to either side.  Underfoot, the worn cobblestones remain perpetually slick as moisture seeps from the walls, coalescing into thin rivulets of slimy water that feed both moss and algae.  A single sputtering torch looks oddly out of place where its wan illumination dances on the stark brickwork at the alley's dead end.

wayto.22444: ;e put "search";while line=get;if line=~ /(dead rat|strand of silver hair|broken lockpick|tarnished coin)!$/;put "search";elsif line=~/brick-covered trapdoor!$/;put "go trapdoor";break;end;end

title: [The Heart of the Art, Solhaven]
description: A sinuous passageway feeds into this surprisingly large marble alcove.  At the end of the chamber, where an enclosing wall should be, is an open view into the town center of the freeport of Solhaven.  The opening into the city defies all logic as the view would seem to indicate that this chamber is directly in the middle of the town, which would be impossible.  The impressiveness of this chamber relays that its current function betrays its true origin.

title: [The Heart of the Art]
description: This giant chamber is carved from a large hulk of marble and has been fashioned into the shape of a humanoid heart.  Passageways snake away from the chamber like arteries ready to carry freshly infused blood to distant parts of the body.  Hatchets overhang these arteries and swing across the openings at regular rhythmic intervals, restricting further movement outside of the central chamber to those with a quick foot and a fair amount of daring.
tags: peer passage =~ /^\[The Heart of the Art, Solhaven\]/

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Just out of the shadow of a silvery blue stone gatehouse, the cobblestones fan out into a wide var, which splits off in opposite directions.  Lush, blossoming foliage lines either side of a narrow walkway that leads into a flourishing garden.  An enameled silver sign is placed next to a crystal-paned lantern hung from a carved alabaster column.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Curving around a carved pillar, the var is lined with lanterns.  The cobblestone road leads past a set of ornate gates, with a beautifully manicured lawn visible beyond.  Meandering to a white marble building, a stone walkway is bordered by green shrubs, their thick branches creating a natural barrier.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Beautiful white roses adorn a natural wall that lines one side of the cobblestone var, alabaster columns rising up from the verdant foliage.  A smooth marble walkway splits the hedge, leading to a domed rotunda.  Opposite the thick greenery is a wrought-iron fence, which allows a view of a well-tended garden beyond its bars.

title: [Faendryl Embassy, Rotunda]
description: Capped with a rounded dome of stained glass, the smooth walls of crimson-veined alabaster are fitted seamlessly into place.  An intricate frieze adorns the rotunda between velvet-draped arches, each leading deeper into the consulate.  The floor is inlaid with concentric rings of heliodor surrounded by an eight-pointed star of despanal.  Hanging on the wall just to the side of the entrance is an an ebon plaque, its dark frame embellished with muted golden gilt.

title: [Faendryl Embassy, Assemblage]
description: Covered with a rich, cinereal wool carpet, the marbled alabaster floor melds smoothly with the walls, veins of crimson contrasting with their immaculate surface.  A large ebon marble fireplace dominates the room, a basket of sticks resting at its base.  A number of small meeting tables are set along the perimeter, and a dark sideboard has been placed to the side, its surface covered with various bowls and platters.

title: [Faendryl Embassy, Antechamber]
description: Striated with veins of crimson, the smooth alabaster walls are bare with the exception of the marbled coloring.  A rich, obsidian velvet carpet woven with golden whorls covers the floor.  The only furniture in the sparsely decorated antechamber is a pair of marble benches, placed to either side of a pewter-banded ebonwood door.

title: [Halfling Embassy, Lawn]
description: Surrounded by manicured lawns, the embassy is an artistic representation of a halfling ger rendered entirely in marble.  Ancient oak trees shelter the diminutive structure and create long shadows across the cobbled path that leads through the gates to the street.  Hidden amid the foliage and behind the trunks of the tower beauties, marble statues rendered in exquisite detail depict various historical scenes.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Festooned with passion vines, a latticework is constructed over the var.  The white flowers, with their star-shaped blossoms and pale blue centers, form a lantern-lit canopy above the cobblestones.  A small alabaster building stands to one side, while a tall pale stone building is surrounded by thick hedges to the other.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Polished cobblestones of the var glisten as the sunlight strikes their surfaces.  A thanot-beamed enclave stands to one side of the road, its silvery blue stone shimmering in the heat of the day.  To the other side, a tall, stone palisade encircles a secluded compound.  Flowering greenery grows about a crystal lantern that hangs from an ornately carved alabaster post.

title: [Aelotoi Embassy, Receiving Room]
description: A set of broad mosaic stone steps sweeps down into the airy enclave which reaches exceedingly low depths.  Positioned directly at the bottom of the stairs, a sunny flaxen carpet leads to a great haon receiving hall table lined with backless silk-tufted chairs.  An intricate celestial marquetry composes the majority of the vast flooring, balancing with the smoothly carved pale limestone walls.

title: [Aelotoi Embassy, Memorial Path]
description: The prolonged, cavernous pathway is formed from a vast deposit of eroded, blue-banded limestone bedrock.  Lavender-grey quartz springs from the crooks of the stone, glinting softly in the light of ornate thanot candelabras.  Exquisitely chiseled flowers, ranging from the mundane to the exotic, take shape from the lower section of the walls.

title: [Aelotoi Embassy, Meeting Room]
description: An installation of spalted maple sunbursts arcs across the high-reaching limestone walls, coalescing at the center of the ceiling in an elegantly layered, hanging sculptural piece.  Directly beneath the ligneous structure is a round, low-set rowan meeting table encircled by yellow-orange damask cushions.

title: [Aelotoi Embassy, Guest Quarters]
description: The spacious wood-floored room holds the faint, sweet scent of chamomile and milk soap.  Branching off from a central common space, each sleeping quarter is furnished with a four-poster fel bed dressed in a brightly colored quilt and a polished cypress cabinet filled with simple essentials.

title: [Clerisy Table]
description: Carved into the walls, this secluded nook melds into the stone.  The table is etched with the symbol of the Patriarch, its central pattern flanked by twin emblems of the Clerisy.  Crimson veins swirling throughout the alabaster complete the design, giving sharp contrast to the white surface.

title: [Agrestis Table]
description: Carved into the walls, this secluded nook melds into the stone.  The table is etched with the symbol of the Patriarch, its central pattern flanked by twin emblems of the Agrestis.  Crimson veins swirling throughout the alabaster complete the design, giving sharp contrast to the white surface.

title: [Emporion Table]
description: Carved into the walls, this secluded nook melds into the stone.  The table is etched with the symbol of the Patriarch, its central pattern flanked by twin emblems of the Emporion.  Crimson veins swirling throughout the alabaster complete the design, giving sharp contrast to the white surface.

title: [Armata Table]
description: Carved into the walls, this secluded nook melds into the stone.  The table is etched with the symbol of the Patriarch, its central pattern flanked by twin emblems of the Armata.  Crimson veins swirling throughout the alabaster complete the design, giving sharp contrast to the white surface.

title: [Rachis Table]
description: Carved into the walls, this secluded nook melds into the stone.  The table is etched with the symbol of the Patriarch, its central pattern flanked by twin emblems of the Rachis.  Crimson veins swirling throughout the alabaster complete the design, giving sharp contrast to the white surface.

title: [Faendryl Embassy, Consulate]
description: Rich obsidian carpeting covers the marble floor of this spacious office, contrasting with the alabaster walls.  Directly centered, an ebonwood desk with a matching armchair serves as the focal point of the room.  Bookshelves climb to the ceiling, their deep recesses filled with tomes, volumes, and scrolls.  A tapestry hangs from the wall emblazoned with the symbol of the Patriarch.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Linsandrych Var]
description: Neatly cut shrubbery grows on either side of the var, separating it from the magnificent landscaping that surrounds each embassy.  Meticulously raked sand gardens decorated with small twining trees surround a blue marble building.  A silver lantern rises through the greenery, marking a stone path that leads to a towering white stone embassy.

title: [Imperial Embassy, Antechamber]
description: Less than a foot past the entryway, the silvery stone comprising the embassy's exterior gives way to polished white marble shot through with veins of sparkling gold and blood-red corundum.  Mirroring bas-reliefs gleam from either wall, taking the forms of twin sunbursts on lacquered crimson fields.  Overhead, a chandelier set with shards of Mandis crystal and countless flickering candles shines down upon the the gold-fringed burgundy carpeting cutting a swathe northward.

title: [Imperial Embassy, Great Hall]
description: Columns of crimson marble, their indentations and ornamental corbels aglisten with gold leaf, support an arched ceiling broken only by a skylight high overhead.  Below it, a grand seat of crimson leather and blond wood sits atop a raised dais at the chamber's center.  Concentric patterns of black stone spread outward from the dais, breaking the uniform procession of red and gold floor tiles.  A semicircle of chairs faces the high seat, though all are smaller and none so evidently comfortable.

title: [Imperial Embassy, Office]
description: The intimate but well-appointed office is graced by a crescent-shaped desk of beautifully stained wood, its surface clear but for a quill, an inkpot, and a blue Vornavian rose.  Behind the comfortable chair seated at the desk, a silken banner depicting a spread-winged white swan on a field of verdant green graces the silvery stone wall with a splash of color.

title: [Halfling Embassy, Great Hall]
description: Vaulted ceilings are hung with a series of thick, beaded tapestries, their woven lengths adding a splash of color to the silver-veined white marble they rest against.  An enormous circular table crafted of bird's-eye maple is centered beneath a round skylight of stained glass, its surface covered with delicacies and treats.  Overlapping rugs bearing geometric patterns give a warm, welcoming feel to the sterile white of the room and support the weight of several high-backed armchairs.

title: [Halfling Embassy, Corridor]
description: Carved to resemble fabric, the marble of the walls and ceiling are crafted to represent the interior of a traditional ger.  Tiny niches line the long length of the corridor that gently curves to the northwest, and each tiny recess is filled with blown glass scones wrought in the image of burning flames.  Two carved marble flaps mark the walls, one leading into a wood-lined office and the other leading to the great hall.

title: [Halfling Embassy, Office]
description: Dark marble paneling strives to cover the sterility of the building's marble construction, though it is unable to obscure the ceiling and floor that are carved in mimicry of fabric.  Recessed into one curving wall, the fireplace displays dark scorch marks and is surrounded by comfortable armchairs flanked by low tables.  Gleaming in the ambient light, a suit of armor stands beside an ornate desk of bird's-eye maple, which has a small wooden chair set behind it.

title: [Halfling Embassy, Quarters]
description: Anchored by black iron bolts, dark blue goat hair sheets are hung from the walls and ceiling of the chamber and mostly obscure the marble of the structure.  Thick rugs of soft viridian stretch throughout the chamber and support a variety of fur-heavy wooden cots, while an enormous black iron basket, lined with copper and filled with a brightly burning fire, occupies the center.

title: [Burghal Chancery, Parlor]
description: The chamber is small and square, with a ceiling of silver-gilded crossbeams and a herringbone patterned wooden floor.  A recessed well in the center of the room contains a short flight of stairs leading downwards to a carved doorway.  Matching double doors lead out of the building.

title: [Burghal Chancery, Hall]
description: The subterranean cavity has bricked walls and an arched barrel vault ceiling.  Only the sheer scale saves the chamber from being confusable with a long, narrow hallway.  At one end of the room is a carved doorway and at the other a brick-framed portal.

title: [Burghal Chancery, Garden]
description: A dim light filters in through several brick-lined clefts in the ceiling overhead, dappling the underground cavern in alternating bands of light and shadow.  The meager illumination is enough to allow the growth of a garden, cultivated carefully into the appearance of a wild and naturally occurring place.  Paths wind through the vegetation and several statues are set out amidst the foliage.  An arched portal leads out of the open pocket.

title: [Erithi Embassy, Vestibule]
description: Rising high above, the peaked ceiling is patterned with white-tinged crystalline skylights and swathes of lush silk in warm earth tones.  Silvery blue marble walls flawlessly transition to teak floors that are raised platform style above a cultivated ground of soft mosses and smooth stones.  Melodically tumbling across painted river stones, a gentle brook lends its voice to the delicate sound of bird call that fills the air.

title: [Erithi Embassy, Gifts]
description: Wreathed in colorful swathes of silk, the small shop has been decorated to resemble the interior of a merchant's pavilion.  Baskets of wares hang from the cloth-covered walls, while a long teak-paneled counter separates the merchant from the customers.  A large censer sits in the far corner and fills the air with the delicate scent of sandalwood.

title: [Erithi Embassy, Receiving Room]
description: Thin panels of rice paper supported by bamboo frames encircle the room, their smooth faces painted with various scenes from Eloth Ra, while panels of polished teak form the raised floor.  Beneath a window swaddled in lengths of rose and azure silk rests a a burbling fountain fashioned of bamboo poles and brilliant white river stones.  Set within a ring of plump cushions, a low teak table is covered with a painted service set.

title: [Erithi Embassy, Garden]
description: Swathes of sky blue fabric stretch across the ceiling and are supported by white birch and rod that are carved into the semblance of tree limbs.  Hanging from each artfully wrought branches are gilded cages that houses a variety of song birds, while far below a floor of lacquered bamboo mimics a grassy meadow.  Fluffy cushions resembling clouds surround circular tables of warm cedar along the edges of the space and a small cast iron stove occupies the center of the room.

title: [The Sleeping Wood, Gardens]
description: A blanket of thick grass stretches outward, cradling the multitude of blooms nestled deeply within the rich soil.  Mist dances among the trunks of tall expansive trees, and the branches rustle with the movement of the natural inhabitants of this garden.  Tucked to the outskirts, a few moss-laden benches provide seating for visitors.  A narrow cobblestone walkway leads north and out of the garden, while a natural trail ventures further within.

title: [The Sleeping Wood, Gardens]
description: Continuous beds of flora native to this area provide a frame to the lush garden.  A moss-laden wrought iron bench is positioned beneath the two largest trees, which grow on seperate corners of a small clearing.  Evidence of the garden's wildlife inhabitants is easily found, and a modwir bowl of birdseed is set to the side for feeding local birds.  A path of natural riverstones leads from here to the center of the garden.

title: [The Sleeping Wood, Gardens]
description: A small stream runs through this section of the garden, and a moss-laden wrought iron bench is positioned to one side to allow visitors to rest near the moonlit water.  Starlight glistens off of the cobblestone pathways running between the lush flowerbeds growing in abundance throughout the area, and tall trees, branches spread wide in the moonlit sky, add to the shadows of night.

A small stream runs through this section of the garden, and a moss-laden wrought iron bench is positioned to one side to allow visitors to rest near the cool water.  Cobblestone pathways offer travel within the lush flower beds growing in abundance throughout the area, and tall trees, branches spread wide to provide shade, dot the landscape.

title: [The Sleeping Wood, Gardens]
description: Shadows encase the cobblestones encircling a butterfly garden composed of wildflowers and local flora.  Cool night breeze helps dissipate some of the strong scent of the thriving plantlife and rich soil so prominent in the area, while the resting forms of butterflies in varying hues and sizes dot the blooms in the moonlit garden.  Large trees frame the walkway, increasing the shadows hovering over the benches set out for visitors.

Cobblestones encircle a butterfly garden composed of a plethora of wild flowers and local flora.  The scent of the rich soil and the thriving plantlife is prominent, and butterflies of all hues and sizes flit to and fro in the sunlit garden.  Large trees frame the walkway, providing shade for a few benches set about for visitors.

title: [The Sleeping Wood, Silver Tree]
description: Shaped into the form of a flower in bloom, this center room is framed by smooth log pieces seamlessly fitted together.  Surrounded by an inlaid marble floor of leaf-patterned mosaic, a tall silver tree serves as the focal point.  Sunlight glints from its outstretched branches, each one a realistically knotted length of argent metal.  A path of natural riverstones leads back to the garden.

title: [Dwarven Embassy, Courtyard]
description: A wrought-iron fence encloses a small courtyard brimming with colorful blossoms in meticulously tended beds.  Smooth pillars stand at the corners of the embassy building; its facade constructed from gleaming white marble walls and accented with silvery blue stone.  The cobbled path leading directly from the entry gate to the building's steps is home to an enormous chunk of granite at its midway point.

title: [Dwarven Embassy, Antechamber]
description: Spacious and airy, the antechamber features several statuary of notable dwarven figures throughout history along the white marble walls.  To the east, an arch with a silver-traced keystone opens into a richly decorated chamber.  Woven moss green runners line the hall leading north, further into the embassy.  Inset into the wide-tiled floor, just before a pair of carved marble doors, is an immense medallion of invar wrought with intricate detail.

title: [Dwarven Embassy, Receiving Room]
description: Vivid tapestries depicting the snow-capped peaks of the DragonSpine adorn the wall opposite a pair of tall bay windows.  The well-lit chamber is furnished with a pair of matching settees set behind two glaes-topped tables, and several chairs crafted in the same motif are arranged at adjacent positions for additional seating.  A mithril-traced sideboard offers several distinctly dwarven refreshments.

title: [Dwarven Embassy, Hallway]
description: Rectangular tiles of blue-flecked white marble comprise the hallway's floor, lined with moss green runners embroidered with tawny whorls.  A blue sapphire-inset door resides in the eastern wall, while a set of tall silver-traced doors occupies the terminus of the corridor.  Within a modest recess nearest to the antechamber, a simple stone door has been partially hidden behind a velvety blue curtain.

title: [Dwarven Embassy, Office]
description: Vivid portraits of all the current dwarven clan leaders grace the white marble walls in two perfectly even rows.  The ambassador's desk has been masterfully inlaid with veins of opal and sapphire, a pattern reminiscent of the gem mines deep within the mountains.

title: [Dwarven Embassy, Meeting Room]
description: A long, granite-inlaid table spans most of the length of the meeting room, set with padded chairs along its perimeter at even intervals.  While the walls are bare, suits of ancient dwarven armor gleam in the room's four corners.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Floor-to-ceiling bars form a latticework of wrought iron cells along the port side.  Large, brackets bolted to the bulkhead and planks overhead hold the iron bars in place and have been covered in tar to prevent rusting.  Occasionally, an enormous rat scurries between sealed barrels marked with large black X's; some even sit lazily in open sight, unperturbed.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]
description: Clumps of rotted straw lie scattered across the decking that stretches from the inner hull to the wide, wrought iron slats of the cell's rusty bars.  Black rings fixed to the walls with thick iron staples are evenly spaced along the bulkhead and fitted with manacles.  The stench filling the cramped space is heavy with mold and decay.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Floor-to-ceiling bars form a latticework of wrought iron cells along the port side.  Large, brackets bolted to the bulkhead and planks overhead hold the iron bars in place and have been covered in tar to prevent rusting.  Occasionally, an enormous rat scurries between sealed barrels marked with large black X's; some even sit lazily in open sight, unperturbed.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Bottom Deck]
description: Crammed with banded barrels and crates that are stacked up to the planking overhead, this small area reeks with the odor of rot and waste.  The sound of waves slapping against the outer hull drowns out all other noises.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Moist air laden with a mixture of rust, rot, and salt fills this section of the companionway.  A wide brush slathered with pitch lies on the floor next to a bucket of glossy black tar.  The ends of tar-soaked strips of oakum protrude from the hull where they have been crammed between planks, while even more gaps remain to be caulked.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Mess Hall]
description: Grime-covered portholes allow a modicum of light to sift in, revealing a fine haze of dust that drifts down through cracks in the warped deck overhead.  Wrought iron chains, each ending in black metal lanterns, dangle from exposed oaken beams over a long table that is bolted to the deck.  Flanking the table are two rough benches heavily scarred with claw marks.  Scattered upon every surface are half-eaten, moldy chunks of bread, fish, and eel.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Dust motes, dancing in the slanted rays of light with each creak of the gently rolling ship, drift down from the exposed oaken beams supporting the decking overhead.  Hanging from a hook on the splintered portside bulkhead is a single brass lantern, its flickering light casting odd shadows across the crooked deck planks.  Standing next to the lantern, in obvious need of repair, is a misshapen harpoon rack.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Warped planks give this section of the deck an uneven cant that is echoed in the fitted wooden boards of the bulkheads.  Tacked to the forward bulkhead by seven iron spikes is an enormous spotted walrus skin.  In one corner of the compartment, a large knot in the wood has been burrowed out by claw and fang to create a small rodent nest.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship]
description: Faded green paint peels from the wooden housing protecting the rough, square-shaped hatch that leads below deck, by way of some wooden stairs.  Tepid water forms a small puddle in the hatch cover, which lies discarded against the hemp stays of the main mast.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Main Mast]
description: Heavily wrapped trusses secure the lower yardarm to the tall, rough wooden mast.  Frayed hemp brails dangle from the unfurled mainsail and shift across the deck in the light, easterly breeze.  High above, nearly lost in the shadows of the topsails, is a dilapidated crow's nest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Annex, Beacon Hall Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A crimson velvet pennant edged with ivory hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

wayto.22407: ;e room = Room.current.id;fput 'go curtain'; if ( room == Room.current.id ); fput 'close locker';move 'go curtain'; end

title: [Chancery of the Bowered Wood]
description: Laid out in millions of tiny glaes tesserae, the domed ceiling is tiled in silver and green, its pattern a canopy of forest boughs.  The mosaic flows down the walls as tree trunks, before stopping halfway to meet a register of wooden panels.  A carpet of woven silk is laid out, creating a soft, natural-looking floor.  Several open archways fan out to other parts of the chancery.  Paneled with wood, a large door stands across the room from a tiny one of modwir.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Chancery of Tooth and Claw]
description: Once beautiful, the marble walls and floor are scuffed and dulled from overuse.  Cages, with paths winding between them, fill the chamber.  Overflowing sacks of feed are stacked next to the barred containers with racks of harnesses and leads hang above them.

title: [Chancery of the Herbaceous Leaf]
description: Cabinets line the room, their wooden bulk nearly obscuring all hints of the marble walls they cover.  The ceiling is equally obscured, festooned as it is with clusters of drying plants, some completely brittle and others still verdant and fresh from the picking.  Bits of greenery are scattered over the floor about a low marble-topped table that sits in the middle of the chamber.

title: [Chancery of the Strewn Petals]
description: Tucked back behind the bulk of the building, a small oasis of blooming green stands out against the white marble walls that surround it.  Neatly tended gardenia, grown in a circular hedge in the middle of the garden, makes a hollow for a swathe of stargazer lilies.  Secondary beds, laid out symmetrically around the center planting, feature jack-in-the-pulpit and snapdragons, as well as columbine.

title: [Chancery of the Blooded Oath]
description: Windowless, and lit only by a few guttering torches, the area is dim.  The ceiling, high overhead, is a mass of shadowed fan vaulting, while the open space of the room itself is a mass of assorted dummies, pieces of training equipment and roped-off bout rings.  The walls are plastered with targets, the area about each dotted with countless nicks and scars.

title: [Chancery of the Purifying Flood]
description: The marble floor has been cut and resectioned, making way for a large rectangular pool.  A raised dais sits at the head of the basin, elevated above the water level and set with a carved jade and mahogany seat.  Overhead, a skylight opens the chamber to the elements.

title: [Chancery of the Purifying Flood]
description: Rimmed with marble, the pool is lined with an exquisite jade mosaic.  Several stone figures are placed along the edge.  The warm water within is a perfect, clear turquoise.  Overhead, a skylight opens up the larger chamber to the elements.

title: [Burghal Chancery, Office]
description: Dark wood panels the walls of this underground chamber.  Sturdy oak beams gracefully sweep downward from the vaulted ceiling, separating the myriad of bookcases along the walls.  A short desk and two squat chairs are the only other adornments in the room.  Several glowing orbs float just above the desk, providing ample light. A single hatch leads out.

title: [Dwarven Embassy, Broom Closet]
description: Stored neatly in wall-mounted racks are brooms and other various cleaning implements, while a wooden bucket sits in the corner.  Though slightly cramped, there is still enough room to move about comfortably despite a three-legged stool in the middle of the floor.

title: [The Hearth Room]
description: A half circle of high-backed chairs faces a pale stone fireplace, which dominates an entire wall of the great room.  Mounted high on the wall is the head of a giant red bear, its eyes hollow and dark while its razor-sharp fangs glisten with the faintest of light.  Banners hang from the vaulted ceiling, depicting each of the Giant clans.

title: [The Red Oak Parlor]
description: Wooden panels provide smooth footing for the tavern, and rows of large kegs line both sides of the room.  A circular red oak bar rests in the center of the parlor, its surface cluttered with a number of refreshments.  A black bear skin rug covers an area of the floor, right below a carved wooden dart board.

title: [Ta'Illistim, D'Karz Curraik]
description: Surrounded by a palisade of roughly hewn logs, the compound is simple with very little ornamentation.  An inverted wooden ship rests within the center of the manicured lawn, while a very large mast rises out of the western grasses.  A crushed seashell path provides clearly defined track between gates and the embassy, its edges flanked by torches that are supported by incredibly tall posts.

title: [D'Karz Curraik, Irkuk Quozlav]
description: Smooth fitted boards stretch from one end of the room to the other to create a finished ceiling that is hung with thick black iron chains that support bronze lanterns.  Large arches in the east and west lead deeper into the building, while in the center of the room a recessed pit is surrounded by roughly hewn banisters.  Large totems are on display, their carved faces a variety of animals, symbols, and plants.  An enormous modwir door leads out and stands on the opposite side of the room from a ladder that leads to the second floor.

title: [D'Karz Curraik, Krefka]
description: Tapering to a point in the western most section of the room, the walls are fashioned of fitted wood and the seams are made weather tight with a thick coating of tar.  Repurposed oar-slots are flanked with rough wooden shutters, while the open expanse is filled with colored glass that resembles froth-covered waves.  A round table surrounded by stools sits in the center of the room and is laden with delicacies.

title: [D'Karz Curraik, Kref]
description: Curving to the east, the narrow room has a packed dirt floor and an arched ceiling that gradually culminates to a point in the east.  A long, low counter stretches across the middle of the space and offers a glimpse of the wares that are on sale, while a plethora of bronze lanterns above offers ample illumination for the space.  Bits of colored glass create prismatic sprays upon the walls as they gently rotate upon the wire that they are hung from.

title: [D'Karz Curraik, Lutkra]
description: Walls of firmly packed earth encircle the room, their faces pock-marked with hundreds of tiny niches.  Long and short benches surround a rock-lined firepit, while a wooden table near the back of the room provides an array of refreshments.  An array of banners hangs from long posts upon the western side of the room, their long lengths dusting the firmly packed, earthen ground.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: The tunnel continues, seemingly without end, in both directions.  Shadows play off the rough rock walls, causing your eyes to dart about looking for enemies that may or may not be there.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: The path here turns south over a flattened stretch of earth which ends at the sight of a dark forest in the distance.  Scattered among the area are colossal bushes of thorns and vines.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Standing in the middle of the desolate meadow, a lone blackened tree hints of a land of darkness and woe.  Little grows here as the dark forest to the south seems to loom over the area with a mercenary grip on life.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Leaving the meadow to the north, the path becomes more of a small trail as it snakes its way to the southern forest.  Small burrows dot the landscape.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: From east to west, the expanse is covered with abandoned growth.  As the faint trail turns, it is almost blocked by shapeless woods and vines.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Dead black trees seem to stretch out trying to grab at any who get close enough, as vines dangle from the tops of them.  Little breeze can be felt as the air seems stagnant, making it hard to breath.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Aside from the black trees to the south, this area is barren of all life and plants.  Large grey patches of dirt cover the ground as the path sneaks its way between them.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Turning to the southeast, the path is littered with dead brush and twigs that cover most of the surrounding area.  Ghostly black trees, limbs sticking out like arms trying to grasp for air, line the path on both sides.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Pushing through the dark and decaying forest from the north, the path widens and progresses southward.  Tracks located on the eastern side of the path show recent movement of a large pack of animals leading out of the forest.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Just off the path, a huge boulder rests stained in dried blood.  Low trees, some of their branches scraping the ground, make the passage through here more difficult.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Thorn covered make their way across the path, making it challenging to travel.  Tall, almost haunting trees covered with oozing slime thrive so well in the area that they nearly block out any light from above.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Bending slowly to the west, the path is blocked by an enormous tree.  A large nest sits in the tree's upper limbs as vines run up its sides, looking to grasp whatever may have been resting inside.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Huge dead trees form a circle in the area, their trunks glistening with oily blood.  Most of the area has been trampled over, leaving nothing but broken twigs and branches.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Somber trees stand whistling in the slow moving wind that sweeps through the area.  Not far off the path rests an immense black tree towering over everything around it, its upward limbs racing in the wind.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Not much grows in this area aside from small bushes of tangled vines lying about.  Barren forest blocks your view in every direction.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: Standing in a pocket of trees, you can barely make out any landmarks in any direction.  Just to the southeast is a rugged hill sparsely decorated with gnarled black trees.

title: [Deadfall Forest]
description: The trail ends here at a wall of glistening black trees.  Dark roots peek up out of the blood-stained soil, snaking across the ground like lattice-work.

title: [Deadfall Forest, Blood Hill]
description: Black, misshapen trees sprout out of the hillside in pockets, glistening apples hanging from their skeletal branches.  The very ground is covered in pools of blood, still fresh and seemingly shifting ever so slightly.  From the vantage point of the hill, the wide base of the Zeltoph Mountain can be seen.

title: [Sagan's Alley, Hideout]
description: Warm, dry, and well lit, the pleasant ambiance of this mid-sized chamber belies its seedy, subterranean location.  Despite cobwebs in the corners, the floor is newly swept and all dust has been cleared from the makeshift furnishings, as if in readiness for the owner's arrival.  A small niche has been chipped from the plaster, and some of the lathing has been removed to form a shelf within.

title: [Dark Shrine, Wide Passageway]
description: A plain stone passageway has been cleanly carved from the solid rock, and leads to the east and west.  The featureless stone is grey, and the surface is abrasive.

title: [Dark Shrine, Wide Passageway]
description: A plain stone passageway has been cleanly carved from the solid rock, and leads to the east and west.  The featureless stone is grey, and the surface is abrasive.

title: [High Standards, Showroom]
description: The interior of this pavilion is open and spacious.  Several intricately woven carpets cover the floor and provide a homey feel to the shop.  The east and west walls are hung with numerous banners bearing heraldry from many nations, while a few larger flags stand on poles along the rear wall.

title: [Dust In The Wind, Clearing]
description: Underfoot, the lush soft grass has defied autumn's arid, bitter winds.  A simple large stone altar rests atop a wide chaldecony and dreamstone-inset plinth.  An eahnor-banded basket sits open beside a small marble bench, and several items dangle from a lone linden sapling nearby.

title: [Siren's Wood, Bubbler]
description: A polished marble fountain sits in the midst of a small clearing.  The deep green fronds of myriad ferns and other shade-loving foliage peek outward from the bases of the surrounding trees.

title: [Harmony and Dissonance]
description: A cluster of lanterns hang from the central pole, illuminating the interior of the spacious tent.  A long mistwood table runs the length of one silk wall, while directly opposite sits a carved peachwood stand.  The back corner of the tent is partitioned off by an amethyst-beaded curtain.

title: [Harmony and Dissonance, Corner]
description: Light filters in through the amethyst-beaded curtain to faintly illuminate this secluded corner of the tent.  The floor is free from clutter, save for a scratched wooden workbench and a battered applewood desk sitting next to each other.  A padded stool stands between the workbench and desk to create a tidy workspace.

title: [Points and Polish]
description: Thick poles of ebonwood hold up the walls and roof of this spacious pavilion.  A rich carpet of wool covers the ground, its surface woven into a detailed pattern of crimson and gold.  A few large racks stand to one side of some opened boxes and crates.  Several crystal globes hang from the ceiling, brightening the dark space.

title: [Siren's Wood, Riverbank]
description: Sunlight breaks through the trees above and glints upon the surface of the Mistydeep River.  A thick carpet of pearlwort grows along a wide riverbank, its tiny white flowers gleaming in the cool darkness of the forest.  A carved marble bench sits near the edge of the river.

title: [Siren's Wood, Phlox]
description: Mounds of periwinkle and woodland phlox crowd the path, leaving little room to walk without treading upon the plants as the crushed blossoms send fragrance into the forest air.  A row of tiny glaesine globes, each holding a miniature white candle, has been posted alongside the trail to illuminate the way.
Mounds of periwinkle and woodland phlox crowd the path, leaving little room to walk without treading upon the plants as the crushed blossoms send fragrance into the forest air.

title: [Silk Pavilion, Garden]
description: The bright white silk canopy of the open-air pavilion shields the area from the sunlight.  A series of terracotta pots fill the area, creating a makeshift garden.  In each of the terracotta pots grows a different flower, the varied blooms surrounding a semicircular bench with a rainbow-colored backdrop.

title: [Crimson Keeps]
description: Alternating black and crimson panels of silk make up the walls, just barely brushing the ground.  An elegant armoire stands behind a tasseled gold rug centered with a crimson-embroidered wyvern.  A small table stands near the tent opening leading out.

title: [Crimson And Gold]
[Crimson and Gold]
description: Sewn into the eastern wall of the tent is a large family crest that has been shrouded by a large black band.  Along the western wall a wooden stage has been erected, with a small notice hung next to it.  A group of mannequins have been posed to the side of the stage area, creating an attentive audience.  The faint scent of phlox wafts in through a small opening in the tent.
