Along the western wall a wooden stage has been erected, with a small notice hung next to it.  A group of mannequins has been posed to the side of the stage area, creating an attentive audience.  The faint scent of phlox wafts in through a small opening in the tent.

title: [Siren's Wood, Wolfsbane]
description: A quartz-inlaid white marble bench sits below paper lanterns and streamers in a pale rainbow of hues that have been draped from the low-hanging tree branches, creating a festive atmosphere.  The wind sighs through the trees, setting the streamers dancing to an unheard tune, and fluttering the leaves on sprigs of indigo wolfsbane that cluster around a white marble statue.

title: [Explorer's Outpost]
description: Polished wood-paneled walls surround this small room, their smooth surfaces broken only by the door leading out and a narrow arch leading further into the wagon.  Two low tables house a variety of relics and treasures, some still caked with dirt from whence they came.

title: [Lyra-Flyr Corral]
description: Set to one side of the bailey, near the hostelry, a small verdant corral is surrounded by a pale stone fence.  A beautiful maple stable sits towards the back of the enclosure.  High above the double sliding doors are a pair of morning doves perched on a stack of hay.

title: [Irregulars Barracks, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard is large and well-kept, and a small stand of haon trees periodically comes alive with the flashes of greenish light from a large colony of fireflies.  To the north, a marked off area for training is neatly arranged for drills.  Practice dummies and archery targets appear well-used but in good repair.  In the center of the yard, a brass-plated iron alarm bell hangs from an ash A-frame.  Near the double doors leading into the barracks, a single wooden bench sits beside a small table.

The courtyard is large and well-kept, and a small stand of haon trees offers shade where several recruits chat amicably.  To the north, a marked off area for intensive training is filled with recruits listening closely to a retired militia instructor.  Practice dummies and archery targets appear well-used but in good repair.  In the center of the yard, a brass-plated iron alarm bell hangs from an ash A-frame.  Near the double doors leading into the barracks, a single wooden bench sits beside a small table.

title: [Prestidigitorium]
description: White marble walls encapsulate this small entry room.  The interior of the building is blocked by a heavy oak door.  Twin torches are affixed to the wall on either side of the door and cast their light on the room, bathing the contents in a golden glow.  A low table near the entry is covered with a scarlet cloth, on which rests several small trinkets that glitter in the torchlight.  Wandering the room is a darkly robed illusionist, who scours the area with a harsh gaze.

title: [The Mad Mechanical Market]
description: Rusty gears and cogs line the rough pine-planked walls in an entirely random and chaotic pattern, all fastened together with mismatching rivets of various size and alloy.  A pair of lopsided glass cases lines the back wall below an uneven row of brass hooks.  A mechanized glowbark crossbow is mounted to a plaque in the back corner, though it doesn't appear to be for sale.

title: [Fogardruh's Wagon]
description: The combined smells of oil, steam, and molten metal assault the senses, and the distinct sound of a hammer on anvil resounds from beyond a wrought invar door located near the back wall of this dimly lit sales floor.  Racks filled with merchandise are attended to by a pair of young dwarven clerks dressed in blacksmith's garb.  Opposite the invar door, a forged glaes ramp leads out.

title: [Good Looks, Central]
description: Bumping out into the narrow passage along this piered tent is a a narrow table piled with some of the goods handmade by the merchant owner of this structure.  Sunlight flashes off the water, sending reflections up and into the rolled-up window openings cut into both sides of the walls.  Underfoot, the floor gives slightly as other customers walk from one end to the other.

Bumping out into the narrow passage along this piered tent is a a narrow table piled with some of the goods handmade by the merchant owner of this structure.  Moonlight flashes off the water, sending reflections up and into the rolled-up window openings cut into both sides of the walls.  Underfoot, the floor gives slightly as other customers walk from one end to the other.

title: [Winter Boutique, Entry]
description: Frosted willow green walls artistically painted with chains of entwined berries and twigs help create a cosy winter-themed atmosphere inside the small wagon.  Several vases filled with haphazardly arranged wildflowers are dotted about the room, their heady scent filling the air.  A large wooden sign is propped up against one of the walls.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.  A narrow sinkhole has gathered much of the muck in the area.

title: [Muck o' the Mire, Closet]
description: The air is hot and oppressive with a very stale smell.  A very large box raised on stilts holds some forgotten items high above the swampy floor.

title: [Treysen's Trappings, Caboose]
description: Narrow ebonwood planks line the interior walls and ceiling of this small wagon boxcar, either wall lined with a row of mannequins.  Three black iron lanterns hang overhead with glowing viridian soulstones clustered inside of their curved tines that cast a dark green light and thick shadows across the walls.

title: [Shoddy Silverware]
description: Matte black hardwood floors line the length of this small wagon.  Centered in the middle of the room sits an opened modwir box.  A plain modwir door marks the only entrance and exit of the wagon.

title: [Spidersilk Spectacular]
description: A brightly colored rug lines the length of this tent from wall to wall.  Streamers of black and silver spidersilk hang from the ceiling and walls all around.  Centered in the middle of the tent is a large modwir chest heaping with all sorts of garments and containers.  A narrow tent flap leads back out.

title: [Luxurious Loincloths]
description: A faint smell of tanned skins hangs in the air.  Hung from the ceiling all around are various garments of many shapes and sizes.  Situated in the middle of the room is a large modwir chest heaping with an assortment of loincloths.  A narrow tent flap leads back out.

title: [Write to the Point]
description: Dark mahogany wainscoting and white plaster walls encompass the main compartment of the wagon, the intricately carved border of each lacquered panel meticulous and exact.  Opposite a nacre-inlaid roll top desk situated beneath a large paned window, a tall bookshelf with elegantly scrolled feet stands guard over the well-appointed room.  Arranged in a loose semi-circle on an oval silk rug between the matched bookcase and desk, a quartet of velvet wingback chairs afford ample seating.  Centered along a short wall across from the entrance, a narrow etched glass door leads further into the shop.

title: [Write to the Point, Forecabin]
description: Ornately framed portraits hang on the white plaster walls, their unsmiling faces silently observing all that transpires.  Spaced evenly around the perimeter of the room, tall wrought iron candelabras offer adequate illumination even as they cast flickering, dancing shadows across the walls.  Resting against the wall across from the etched glass door leading into this cozy space, an aubergine velvet divan anchors a small seating area with a low mahogany table.

title: [Line in the Sand]
description: Latticed walls of supple birch encompass the circular dwelling, wide diamonds of rough spun canvas visible through the narrow wooden bands.  Underfoot, several richly detailed, plush rugs line the unfinished pine floor that fills the expanse.  Situated on opposite sides along the perimeter of the circle, an oversized oak chest and a weathered maple trunk overflow with goods.

title: [Fledgeling Magic, Entrance]
description: A slight sheen can be seen on the dark cherry stained oak flooring.  Globe shaped lanterns hang from the ceiling near the four corners of the room.  Opposite the entrance sits an ornate oaken door while archways rest on the two remaining walls.  In the center of the room lies a glass display case.

title: [On the Lighter Side, Workroom]
description: Large cushioned benches are scattered about the secluded, yet spacious workroom.  A thick carpet of rich furs cover the modwir tiles beneath them, the different hues and thicknesses patch together creating a mosaic of color.  Bright crimson, gold, and ivory silk adorns the support beams before draping to the floor in elegant pools.

title: [Rainbow's End]
description: This small but cozy wagon is infused with the scent of fresh paint.  From the base of one wall, across the ceiling, and then down the opposite wall, a grand rainbow has been painted in bright iridescent hues, creating a vivid arc of colors.  A silver-capped rack showcases a wide selection of shirts and dresses, and an ornate oak trunk displays a variety of leg wear.  Precisely cut multicolored square cubes fill a silk-wrapped case that has a lid propped open with a gnome-sized broom.

title: [Use the Pointy End]
description: Walls of roughly-hewn pine are lashed together with random bits of twine to form the interior of this broken-down shack.  A shaky-looking rack sits in the middle of the room, next to a long table covered in multiple nicks and dents.  A small counter crafted from multiple sized twigs sits at an awkward angle in the corner, oddly covered in a vivid purple doily.

title: [Ravaged Canvas Tent]
description: The heavy canvas tent is riddled with perforations and slashes.  Numerous older wounds have been stitched up, many of which have been reopened.  A wooden sign demanding that patrons refrain from testing blades on the fabric of the tent is itself pocked with knifepoint punctures.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Toppled on its side, an enormous banyan tree stretches across the pathway and lies its head into the stagnant waters of the nearby stream.  Mold and sludge have claimed most of the verdant canopy, while its roots lie exposed to the elements and still cling to large clumps of moist earth.  A series of tiny black capped mushrooms grow in the dark shelter of the fallen tree.

title: [Off the Beaten Trail]
description: Thick oak poles stand in each corner of the tent, holding the oilcloth canopy up overhead.  A round marble pedestal sits off in one corner of the tent, while a large mahogany map table occupies much of the central floor space.  An oilcloth flap hangs across the rear of the tent, concealing the back portion of the structure.

title: [Cutter Chaos, Showroom]
description: Muted lamplight reflects off the intricate network of wires running along the top of the wagon, suspending a mess of tin cans, greasy gears, and stale laundry.  Massive red arrows are painted on the east wall, all pointing at some uneven metal shelves tied with frumpy yellow ribbons.  In one dusty corner, a rusty metal contraption sits behind broken hat rack.  Piled up on the floor, stacks of boxes teeter precariously, occluding a direct path between the entrance and a stained patchwork curtain.

A small overhead window filters in sunlight, highlighting the intricate network of wires running along the top of the wagon, suspending a mess of tin cans, greasy gears, and stale laundry.  Massive red arrows are painted on the east wall, all pointing at some uneven metal shelves tied with frumpy yellow ribbons.  In one dusty corner, a rusty metal contraption sits behind broken hat rack.  Piled up on the floor, stacks of boxes teeter precariously, occluding a direct path between the entrance and a stained patchwork curtain.

title: [Portable Potables]
description: Weathered wooden planks form the slanted walls of the booth.  A rug of woven marsh reeds covers most of the central floor.  A small oak potion rack stands against one of the walls, with some white pine shelves nailed to the far wall.

title: [Untamed Mess]
description: Black, lifeless eyes stare out from the mounted animal heads that line the interior of the wagon.  A collection of stuffed birds has been strung from the low ceiling, their wings locked as if in flight.  Placed near a scarred table, a large bucket of viscera emits an overwhelming putrid odor through the cramped space.  A light breeze slithers in through the cracks of a boarded up window, creating a light knocking sound as the birds sway into the dark walls.

title: [Treysen's Trappings, Mid-Wagon]
description: Separating this wagon from the lead is a black wool curtain, the ends of the wagons cars left open to allow easy passage between them.  Gnarled black iron lanterns emit a pale green glow and hang above a row of mannequins that stand in various poses.

title: [Treysen's Trappings, Lead Wagon]
description: Separated from the other boxcars by a black wool curtain, this area appears to be more of a residence than a shop.  A small desk folds down off of one wall beside a padded cot, while opposite is a small glass cabinet filled with a variety of colored bottles.  The driver's seat of the wagon has been folded up to create a makeshift back wall to the boxcar, allowing the room to be secluded from the outside world.

title: [The Vexed Hexer]
description: The scent of smoldering ashes lingers within the humid room, emanating from melted lumps of wax centered upon the stone table dominating the area.  Warped wooden shelves line the windowless walls, leaving dusty books and scrolls leaning precariously towards the stained sanguine marble floor.  Scattered about the room are shards of crushed chalk, the powder mixed with unknown substances haphazardly spilled from wall to ceiling.

title: [Use the Pointy End, Office]
description: Dust covers the surface of an uneven wooden desk, the filth only disturbed by various designs and scrolls littering the top.  A three legged table, a stack of books serving as the fourth leg, sits in the corner, the odd fuschia doily covering it serving as the only splash of color in the room.

title: [Unconventional]
description: Natural disasters aspire to produce the sort of disorganized mess that is present within this small wagon.  Piles of gaudy costumes lie crumpled in a corner, and a large mithril letter "P" has been bolted to the far wall.  The single window in the wagon is broken, though no signs of shattered glass remain.  The plain white cloth covering a round tanik table is stained numerous colors, and assorted merchandise sits on the table, strewn between empty mugs.  An iron-banded oak keg with a brass spigot is set up amid a pile of empty bottles.

title: [Get A Grip]
description: Thousands of colorful glaes scarabs have been threaded into the woven canvas of the tent's roofing.  A large lantern hung from one of the tent poles provides illumination, the light scattering off the glaesine surfaces above.  Piled neatly in the far corner of the tent is an impressive array of broken locks, latches, keys, and other mechanisms.

title: [Quiver And Despair]
description: Set side by side in the center of the floor are a vaalin-banded heavy crossbow bolt trunk and a glaes-banded light crossbow bolt chest.  Immediately behind them rests a glass-topped arrow display.  The remainder of the wagon houses a few flickering lanterns, hung from beams overhead, and numerous archery targets that decorate the walls.

title: [Go Figure]
description: Polished sheets of steel surround the room making it nearly impossible to locate an obvious entrance or exit from the area.  Brass pipes, covered with silver valves and copper knobs, run lengthwise along the ceiling, bending sharply at the corners to continue down each wall.  Gnome workers in stiff white longcoats rush to and fro, some holding fancy tools and others with wooden blackboards, continuously attending to an enormous machine.

Polished sheets of steel surround the room, making it nearly impossible to locate an obvious entrance or exit from the area.  Brass pipes, covered with silver valves and copper knobs, run lengthwise along the ceiling, bending sharply at the corners to continue down each wall.  Gnome workers in stiff white longcoats rush to and fro, some holding fancy tools and others with wooden blackboards, continuously attending to an enormous machine.

title: [The Misted Grey, Entrance]
description: Layers of pale grey silk drape from a canopied oak frame to create the walls of this pavilion, broken only by a beaded ebon silk curtain.  A small black oak table stands centered on a thick wool carpet.  Frosted crystal globes are suspended from fine silver chains, their light illuminating the small area.

title: [The Misted Grey, Refuge]
description: Cushioned benches draped with dark silk are placed about the room.  Several chest and wooden boxes are stacked neatly, their open lids revealing various shades of rich materials.  The walls of the pavilion ripple as a light swamp breeze blows against them.

title: [Friendly Necessities, Porch]
description: A thin wooden railing encloses this small porch behind the shack.  A fine mesh net has been tacked all around to try and keep out bugs and other unwanted pests that live in the mire.  A plump white dog sleeps on an old pillow next to a bright yellow door.

title: [A Putrid Yellow Tent]
description: A rancid odor, befitting the visual decor, permeates the interior of this tent. A wooden box sits on the floor to the immediate right of the yellow tent flap.  Over in the far left corner, a iron box rests comfortably amidst a pile of dirty laundry.

title: [Pelil's Costumery]
description: Shimmering walls of gold silk stretch out, each supported by wooden posts to make up the front room of the tent.  Numerous costumes are on display, ranging from all manner of creatures and races and styles, each organized neatly throughout the area.  A shimmering gold silk curtain leads deeper inside the tent.

title: [Pelil's Costumery, Alcove]
description: This small back area of the tent is home to a slender cot and a large ornate armoire.  The dresser's doors are opened slightly, revealing a small peek at a vast assortment of costumes and accessories within.  A small desk is positioned near the center of the alcove, a number of buttons, cloth bolts, and sewing needles scattered across its surface.  A shimmering gold silk curtain leads back to the front of the tent.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Strange fumes create a haze in the air as they explosively escape from the putrid ground and fill the air with an aroma akin to rotting eggs.  Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid sinkhole along the eastern border.

title: [Clepsydra]
description: Twisting shadows fill the shop's every niche as several dripping candles flicker in the iron sconces that hang on each wall.  Thick velvet draperies cover the windows, blocking out the moonlight and adding to the oppressive feel of the room.  An engraved brass funnel hangs from the ceiling over a large stone bowl that sits adjacent to a nondescript black door.  A shallow copper pan has been placed on the floor near a lined black silk curtain.

The light of day filters through sheer white curtains that hang over the shop's windows.  Several large white candles flicker in the iron sconces that hang on each wall, filling the room with additional warrmth and light.  An engraved brass funnel hangs from the ceiling over a large stone bowl that sits adjacent to a shield-carved white door.  A shallow copper pan has been placed on the floor near a lined ivory silk curtain.

title: [Woods In the Woods]
description: The knotty pine-panelled room is nearly square.  The walls, however, are slightly crooked and canted, giving the space a ramshackle feel.  A narrow spiral staircase leads up through an opening in the ceiling.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Woods In the Woods, Upstairs]
description: The second story of the shop is nearly identical to the bottom level, to which the staircase leads.  A rickety ladder has been propped through a hole the ceiling leading to the third floor.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Woods In the Woods, Third Floor]
description: More knotty pine covers the skewed walls of this third-story room.  The ladder sticking out from the hole in the floor extends down to the second floor, and some uneven steps lead up to the topmost room of the shop.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Woods In the Woods, Attic]
description: While this room is virtually indistinguishable from those below it, only a peaked ceiling formed by haphazardly placed beams crowns the the pine walls.  The air is nearly stifling and smells of must and sawdust.  Some uneven steps lead down to the third floor.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Huff 'n' Puff, Entry]
description: Thick canvas walls fitted over a wooden frame create this quickly constructed space designed mostly to display handcrafted wares.  The open flap lets in both light and air, as well as the fetid odor of the swamp outside.  Hooks suspended from the thin rafters display a variety of pipes and bundles of dried tobacco.  A curtain draped partly across the back wall divides this boxy structure hastily assembled atop a floating wooden platform.

title: [Good Looks, Entryway]
description: Long and narrow, the canvas tent stretches out along much of the rickety pier, with rolled-up window openings cut into the cloth walls.  A thick support overhead holds taut the peaked roof and suspends small oil lamps giving off both illumination and the pleasing scent of lemon verbena.  Narrow tables break the flow the space here and there, moving toward the far end of the cavernous space.

title: [Act of Neutrality, Atrium]
description: Thin beams of bronze-leafed oak frame panels of etched glass, the half-circle ceiling curving down to meet circular windows set into the outer wooden walls.  A chiseled grey marble fountain dominates the center of a stone-pebbled pathway, carved into the form of a lithe elven maiden, her water-filled palms upraised to reveal blush pink water lilies.  Swathes of metallic chiffon frame the northern entrance, creating a hazy curtain between the two areas.

title: [Come To Heel, Showroom]
description: Candlelit globes flicker above ivory-hued silks draped from the top of the wagon, creating softly illuminated panels that gleam across the polished hardwood floors.  Silk slippers, velvet-lined fel chopines, and spike-heeled leather shoes are showcased on top of a silvered glass display case in the center of the room across from a spindly ivory-inlaid table, some woven reed baskets filled with vendible items stacked underneath.  A large window fixed with a plush velvet-cushioned seat is stationed next to a brass-handled door.

title: [Come to Heel, Reception]
description: A narrow, ivory wool carpet leads from a brass-handled black fel door through rows of carefully stacked boxes to a glass-topped lacquered fel desk in the rear of the wagon.  Behind the desk, a wing-backed red leather chair with a matching footstool is partitioned off behind a painted silk screen.

title: [A Head Above]
description: Thin lattices of bronze piping support walls of rich, absinthe silk velvet, the patina-streaked metal blending into the vibrant tones of green.  Nestled upon a feather-strewn yellowed glass case is a large leather-hinged hatbox, its contents scattered haphazardly amongst the coppery plumage.  Along the back wall, a curtain of gear-strung chains provides entrance to another room.

title: [A Head Above, The Rest]
description: Faded blue silks hang loosely from gauze-ribboned brass poles, creating a makeshift room.  Tiny cloud-shaped enamel candleholders strung from the ceiling, playing off a sun-shaped mirror sitting upon a serpentine front dark walnut vanity in the center of the room, have been molded into various shapes to form the illusion of a summer sky.  Tucked in a corner, a collection of round boxes has been stacked haphazardly around a large oxidized steel wheel.  Softly chiming with the barest hint of provocation, a curtain of gear-strung chains flanked by twin dark burnt velvet settees leads back to the other room.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky.  Thick roots, resembling the legs of an enormous spider, rise out of the soft, muddy ground and create arches that encircle the smooth barked monstrosity.  High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick tangles of thorn-heavy brambles lie in knotted clusters along the western border of the pathway that bisects the swamp.  Several puddles of stagnant water pockmark the thick carpet of dusky brown moss that spreads across the uneven ground.  A ring of half-rotted trees leans against each other, their splintered sides and barkless faces heavy with black mold and sludge.

title: [Pane in the Glass]
description: Scraps of tapestries and assorted linens cover the walls of this ramshackle tent, lending an a impressive array of colors to the otherwise sparse decorations.  Assorted boxes and crates have been indiscriminately arranged to assemble a makeshift storefront with a large frosted glass display case and an unfinished black cherry cabinet placed just behind the tent's stout ironwood support pole.

title: [Beer Hall, Tap Room]
description: Dim lighting and an attempt at cleanliness cannot hide that the beer hall has seen better days.  The floor slopes gently away from the entrance towards an obviously well-used dance floor.  A bank of polished copper taps lines the wall behind a freshly lacquered ebonwood bar, and new glassware sits upon a single shelf.  A refreshment table with frothy cold brew sits right to the side of the bar.

title: [Passion for Fashion, Front Room]
description: The walls of the room are painted a soft red and are illuminated by the soft glow of some ornate gold sconces evenly spaced along the walls.  At the front of the room is a long etched glass jewelry case that guards several female mannequins locked in alluring poses.  There is a slender emerald green arch with a wall-mounted statue of a beckoning female hand next to it.

title: [Passion for Fashion, Back Room]
description: Covering the perimeter of this circular room are some round red sitting pillows that rest upon a plush ivory carpet.  Mounted at the back of the room is a sinuous gold-framed mirror with a small tiered tray beneath it.  At the heart of the room is a button-tufted velvet chaise with a gilded side table.

title: [Pucker Up]
description: Mauve sillk curtains cover a large bay window, while numerous silver oil lamps flicker gaily, casting the entire shop in warm light.  A small oval table stands between a polished mahogany display and a black walnut display, supporting a few mirrors and an embossed white card.  A portrait in fine oils hangs on the back wall, depicting two elves in a tender kiss.

Mauve sillk curtains have been drawn back from a large bay window, allowing the light of day to illuminate the shop.  A small oval table stands between a polished mahogany display and a black walnut display, supporting a few mirrors and an embossed white card.  A portrait in fine oils hangs on the back wall, depicting two elves in a tender kiss.

title: [Corpses' Castoffs Boutique]
description: Dimly lit by a handful of funerary lamps, this chamber resembles a cross between a tomb and a corpse-looter's stash.  Dirt-caked and putrefaction-stained garments, as well as items bearing fresh bloodstains and slash marks, hang from wooden grave markers, while others are neatly arranged inside a rotted casket.  Several smaller items rest atop the casket lid that lies across the casket's foot.

title: [The Hairy Potter]
description: Earthy and lightly fragrant, the woody decor provides a perfect interior for this modest greenhouse.  A light coating of rich chestnut earth hides the floor, and variegated ivy has been cultivated to creep up all four walls.  Stretching across the room, a lacquered faewood pole, secured by braided ropes, is suspended from the ceiling and displays a vibrant collection of hanging plants.  A diminutive iron wheelbarrow is stuffed with various gardening items, and a wooden shelf is lined with soil-filled pots.

title: [The Hairy Potter, Storage]
description: Spades, trowels, and broken clay pots litter the storage room floor.  Small utility knives lay next to flower-filled baskets, and an array of half-filled glasses display various plant cuttings.  A gem-encrusted wheelbarrow is perched on a cloth-draped platform in the center of the room.

title: [Heavy Handed, Showroom]
description: Thick oak poles support this once fine tent.  Showing the wear of time, the inside of the tent is patched in a multitude of places.  Mismatched lengths of canvas, leather, and cloth have been sewn into the fabric of the tent to help keep the elements out.  Various bits of weaponry are haphazardly shoved into a wooden barrel, while an aged wooden weapon rack, sitting on a grungy wool rug, holds a variety of merchandise.  Hanging from one of the oak poles, a dingy curtain provides access to a small workspace in the rear of the tent.

title: [Heavy Handed, Workshop]
description: A small lamp sitting on an ornate wooden table provides just enough light to see clearly.  A small desk sits off in a corner and is surrounded by some rectangular fluffy pillows.  A dingy curtain leads back into the shopping portion of the tent.

title: [Crazy Gravy]
description: Peculiar absinthe green moss blankets the floor of the hut with an overgrown, wildly feathery texture.  Scores of crude bone dolls are hung from the high ceiling, their primitive faces staring down vacantly over the room.  The burgeoning groundcover forks across a dark-glazed clay vessel and around the base of a skull-footed ebony table, creeping its way up into the corners of the vivid, paint-splashed walls.

Peculiar absinthe green moss blankets the floor of the hut with an overgrown, wildly feathery texture.  Scores of crude bone dolls are hung from the high ceiling, their primitive faces staring down vacantly over the room.  The burgeoning groundcover forks across a dark-glazed clay vessel and around the base of a skull-footed ebony table, creeping its way up into the corners of the vivid, paint-splashed walls.  A carved stonework cabinet wrapped with sprouting vines is nestled away in the shadiest corner of the space.

title: [Playing Dead, Showroom]
description: Decorated in muted dark tones, the small showroom features an elegantly carved ebony coffin to one side and a velvet-draped table to the other.  A simple dark grey curtain partially obscures a doorway leading to the back of the wagon.  One of the candles has been snuffed out on the far wall, leaving a corner shrouded in shadow.

title: [Playing Dead, Workshop]
description: Stark white in decor, the workshop is a complete contrast to the dark showroom.  The walls and floor are glossy and pale, gleaming with the light of spherical lanterns hung from the ceiling.  A small workstation with neatly arranged tools have been covered with a thick cotton cloth.

title: [Robe N' Hood, Combat]
description: Hanging from the ceiling is a dimly lit chandelier which casts flickering light and long shadows over the area.  Lining the two opposing dark-paneled walls of this long, narrow space are two darkly varnished wooden racks, while a carved oaken display case takes up the entire far wall.

title: [The Squire In The Mire]
description: The scent of cologne lingers in the air, almost suffocating the musty stench of the surrounding bog on the other side of a forest green tent flap.  A dapper mannequin commands the central area of the room, and a long glass display case rests along a side wall.  There is a highly polished door at the back of the room.

title: [The Squire's Office]
description: Reams of various fabrics are mounted to the wall on thick iron dowels.  A large work table is covered with spools of leather and bits of various metals.  Several sconces give the room a warm candlelight glow.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Immortally Preserved, Entry]
description: Large bamboo-framed partitions divide the large pavilion into sections, which are each illuminated by glass-encased lanterns.  Heavy ebon drapes form the conical ceiling and offer a subtle, textural contrast to the thick rugs that are layered upon the ground.  Arranged in the center of the small space is a round table covered with a white cloth.

title: [Swamp Sparkles, Show Room]
description: Silver mesh drapes in swaths across the gold satin ceiling of the pavilion, the walls braced by shiny gold-painted rods.  A spindly copper earring tree branches over a highly varnished wood table.  Other wares hang from an array of thin copper hooks that dangle from the criss-crossed gold latticework above.  One corner of the pavilion has been draped off by a floor-to-ceiling swath of gauzy gold silk.

title: [Swamp Sparkles, Private Corner]
description: The far corner of the pavilion has been sectioned off by a gauzy gold silk drape to provide a private space.  Across the floor is a sprawl of luxurious silk and velvet pillows.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves.  Ominous shadows trail across the spongy, softness of the landscape where enormous muddy bubbles rise and burst as underground gases escape from the bosom of the earth.  In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.

title: [Fitzwobbin's Figures, Show Room]
description: Some steel racks line the interior walls of the wagon, leaving little space for anything else.  Small wooden cabinets support a fold out countertop against the back wall, while a few iron rungs lead upwards to a circular steel hatch in the ceiling near the wagon's front.

title: [Fitzwobbin's Figures, Arena]
description: Standing atop the strange wagon, the view is impressive.  Several benches have been placed along the sides of the wagon.  Between them, an intricate painting of a gladiator's arena covers the wagon's flat top.  Two large pipes jut upwards from the rear of the wagon, providing a backstop for the low benches there.  A circular steel hatch leads back down into the wagon.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, northwest

title: [A Bone to Pick]
description: Gritty limestone steps descend into this ancient mausoleum, where the floor is scattered with a variety of bones; some human, others not.  Near an alcove shelf, some pitted brass hooks are suspended from a far, nearly intact wall, rising adjacent to a dark tunnel leading to the north and deeper within.

title: [The Witch's Familiar]
description: A bubbling cauldron dangles from a hooked tripod crafted of heavy chains and thick iron posts.  A stooped and leafless skeleton of an old banyan tree hovers over the vessel.  Several half-empty potion bottles and some stained brushes are strewn across a large tree stump, which apparently is being used as a makeshift workbench.  A heaping rockpile is centered within a star-shaped outline, which has been burned into the soil.  Various symbols of the elements decorate lanterns that encircle the setting.

title: [Beyond The Banyan Tree, Bench]
description: A single lantern hangs from an iron post beside a cracked stone bench.  The loam is soft, yet firm enough to hold your weight.   Between the trail's edge and the bench, a faint outline of a wide white circle covers the ground.

title: [Cache Cabin]
description: A flock of lacquered ebonwood chests are strewn around the timeworn room, intensely contrasting against the ashen floor underfoot.  At the heart of the space, a wide green amber slab elevates a fauna-intaglio glaes casket littered with prismatic crystals.  An eerie pale sheen is cast over a faded driftwood sideboard, falling from an offering of half-melted beeswax candles gathered on the sides.

title: [Cache Cabin, Alcove]
description: The modest backroom area of the cabin is painted a pallid lunar blue hue and is outfitted with a wide glass window, giving the limited space a much larger feel.  The weathered room is chiefly empty, save for a stately silver-bound chest that is propped open by a primitive glaes dagger.

title: [Totally Totes]
description: Dark purple wooden panels line the walls of the small wagon, lavishly adorned with drapes of thick black velvet.  A silk-lined plush fur rug lines the polished oak floor, and a small fireplace has been inset into the rear wall, its applewood logs crackling softly.  A set of two gold and bronze pegs hold a selection of merchandise.

title: [Yeast Confections]
description: This rickety mossbark handcart leans slightly forward, threatening to spill its contents onto the ground if it weren't for the wheels being firmly entrenched in the marshy terrain.  A severely weathered red canvas hood provides the only source of protection from the surrounding elements for the handcart's cargo.  Resting atop the covered surface of the cart is a misshapen silver platter and an oblong pewter tray that have been piled high with an assortment of baked goods.

title: [Ilixil's Bestiary, Promenade]
description: Tiny blue cobalt cages line the walls of the sanctum, their crystal-studded bars infused with a pale violet light.  Prismatic reflections from the jewels cut through the lingering shadows of the chamber to reveal a circular dome overhead.  Underfoot, a tattered carpet softens the granite tiles of the floor, held in place by a polished stone rack and a shallow stone bowl.

title: [Here We Goat Again]
description: Moonlight streams from the rotten wooden slats of the roof.  Small stall doors line one wall, straw spilling over onto the wet, swampy floor.  Bags of feed are piled to either side of a pair of sliding barn doors.

title: [Bog Botanicals]
description: Warped and splintered planks of wood creak underfoot in this cramped, dilapidated structure.  Droplets of fetid swamp water drip intermittently from the sagging, rotting rafters and into several rows of crumbling stone planters overflowing with various marsh plants.  A rotted wooden trellis leans against the far wall opposite a battered door with rusted hinges.

title: [Sing Me an Epithet]
description: Surrounded by walls of long, woven swamp grass, the tent smells about as good as it looks.  The odor of skunks and slime pervades the small area with a noxious scent.  In the center of the room, a circular oak pedestal leans slightly to one side, yet still manages to display its wares to shoppers.  Against the far wall, a makeshift wooden counter seems to have been added as an afterthought.  The two exits are merely holes that appear to have been torn in the grass walls.

title: [Behind the Tent]
description: This small clearing behind the tent is bordered on one side by the tent wall and on the other three by tall reeds and grasses.  Several gum trees tower over the area, and strands of moss drape down from their branches like living curtains.  The ground is hard, with exposed sand and limestone peeking through the peat.  The scent of decay is heavy in the air, and the moonlight does little to brighten the area.

Several gum trees tower over the area, and strands of moss drape down from their branches like living curtains.  The ground is hard, with exposed sand and limestone peeking through the peat.  The scent of decay is heavy in the air, and the sunlight does little to brighten the area.

title: [Requiem]
description: In the center of this well lit area sits a small shrine.  Frosted globe lanterns line the walls, casting a soft glow over a long wooden counter, and the scent of burning candles fills the air.  A small gilded case rests atop a stone pedestal standing in one corner next to a large wicker basket.  Covering the floor is a well-worn black carpet edged with two thin white stripes.

title: [Straps and Things]
description: A single hooded lantern hangs from the roof of the wagon, casting eerie shadows behind a large wooden rack with each slight swaying motion.  Along one curving wall stretches a flat metal stand that has clearly seen better days.

title: [Blacksmith's Stall]
description: Three large, open air firepits flare and crackle in a line just outside the covering of a stone roof supported by a number of heat-blackened pillars.  Metal shavings and fallen droplets lie swept into a neat pile in one corner of the clear, hard-packed dirt floor.  Several aprons hang from a long iron peg pounded into a broad wooden pole.

title: [Take a Swig, Varietals]
description: Strange blue flames encased in cracked glass globes illuminate this cramped space.  Every surface is dusty, and clumps of grey-green moss cluster in the corners and on the edges of an uneven wooden counter.

title: [Secure Storage]
description: Smoke from a small fire burning underneath the edge of the lean-to drifts around a flimsy wooden rack then up into the sky.  Pale yellow lichen covers the walls and posts of the lean-to while a dirty green rug covers the floor.

title: [All Things Fragile]
description: This corner of the wagon has been obviously graced by a woman's touch.  Gleaming, flora-scene pierced screens square to create a separate area within the large wagon.  Ecru lace curtains frame the wooden windows, and a woven tapestry rug sits in the center of the room.  A large wildflower bouquet lends a light fragrance to the air.

title: [The Frilly Filly]
description: Several pieces of old cloth lay strewn about on the floor.  Broken and rotted crates are scattered about in a disheveled manner.  The faint odors of rotting wood linger in this decrepit space.

title: [Brace Yourself]
description: A layer of debris extends from the entryway to a set of swinging doors in the back of this cramped space.  Several broken windows provide glimpses of the trees and water outside, and the incoming rays of moonlight highlight motes of dust falling from the sagging, low patchwork ceiling.  A motley assortment of rusty iron stands lean haphazardly against the grimy, limestone walls.
