Several broken windows provide glimpses of the trees and water outside, and the incoming rays of sunlight highlight motes of dust falling from the sagging, low patchwork ceiling.  A motley assortment of rusty iron stands lean haphazardly against the grimy, limestone walls.

title: [Brace Yourself, Grobey's Spot]
description: Several rusty iron buckets hang from iron spikes, which have been driven crookedly into the chipped limestone walls.  Bits of leather straps litter the floor, and broken pieces of shields lay heaped in the corners.  Half a dozen planks, likely salvaged from the black waters outside, have been nailed together over some spare crates to serve as a makeshift workbench.

title: [Abandoned General Store, Front]
description: The narrow storefront is cluttered with several trunks that are stacked upon each other.  A long wooden counter wraps around the front of a door leading toward a small supply closet.  Two oil lamps are the only sources of light within the store, but they barely offer enough illumination to break through the darkness.

title: [Abandoned General Store, Closet]
description: The small, cramped room reeks of death and decay.  The skeletal remains of someone or something lie in a heap on the floor -- the right hand of the deceased is missing.  A number of iron shelves line the northern wall underneath a hole in the ceiling.  Leading to the storefront is a door, the frame of which is deeply scratched.

title: [Trollslayer's Closet]
description: The canvas walls of this large tent reflect the lanternlight, creating an oasis within the dreariness that is the Mire.  Near the tent flap, a brass wire bin stands, containing an odd mix of merchandise.  Further back in the tent, a modwir weapon rack bears an assortment of weapons, and at the back of the tent, some free-standing shelves hold a variety of garments and armor.

The canvas walls of this large tent reflect the lantern light, creating an oasis within the dreariness that is the Mire.  Near the tent flap, a brass wire bin stands, containing an odd mix of merchandise.  Further back in the tent, a modwir weapon rack bears an assortment of weapons, and at the back of the tent, some free-standing shelves hold several helmets and some armor.

title: [Winged Blades - Aelotoi Armory]
description: Broad swathes of subtly patterned, pale golden flyrsilk drape across each wall, and gathered lengths of gleaming, navy blue paeline in the corners provide a contrasting visual frame.  Indeed, the resident merchant has almost succeeded in completely hiding the cracked and rotting boards of the shop's walls and in showcasing the shelves and racks of armor and the weapon stand.

Broad swathes of subtly patterned, pale golden flyrsilk drape across each wall, and gathered lengths of gleaming, navy blue paeline in the corners provide a contrasting visual frame.  Indeed, the resident merchant has almost succeeded in completely hiding the cracked and rotting boards of the shop's walls and in showcasing the shelves and racks of armor and the ebonwood table.

title: [Ruined Office]
description: Complete with a plethora of disintegrating wooden beams overhead and entirely missing sections of wall, the building is in shambles.  Dirt, sludge, and cobwebs cling to every surface, the chill wafts of air constantly breezing through disturbing their sleep and creating a mist of dust that permanently swirls through the space.  In a shadowed corner, broken shards of glass scatter across a massive, rotting wooden desk overturned in haphazard fashion.

title: [A Teak Shack, Pole Party]
[A Teak Shack, Quiet Corner]
description: Narrow teak planks bound together by thick twine run the length of the wall.  In the rear of the room, a teak beaded curtain beckons entry.  A slightly lowered basin constructed around the floor is filled with sand and assorted seashells of all shapes and sizes.  A pair of evenly spaced palm trees leans over a simple teak weapon stand in the center of the room.

Narrow teak planks bound together by thick twine run the length of the wall.  In the rear of the room, a teak beaded curtain beckons entry.  A slightly lowered basin constructed around the floor is filled with sand and assorted seashells of all shapes and sizes.  A pair of evenly spaced palm trees leans over a long wooden footlocker in the center of the room.

The twine-wrapped teak plank construction of the walls and ceilings blends in with the sandy floor.  A low teak credenza with refreshments sits neatly by a beaded curtain.  A collection of lush palm fronds are stacked in the center of the room as a makeshift bed.

title: [A Teak Shack, A Quiet Corner]
description: The twine-wrapped teak plank construction of the walls and ceilings blends in with the sandy floor.  A low teak credenza with refreshments sits neatly by a beaded curtain.  A collection of lush palm fronds are stacked in the center of the room as a makeshift bed.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Closely positioned wooden columns help support the earth and ceiling of the small tunnel.  Carved into the limestone walls, several narrow ledges sport a variety of rings, some sparkling as they catch and reflect the light of two torches that are held upright by crude sconces and burn low in the dim space.  A boulder-cramped passageway creates a dead-end, though a light draft of air sweeps up from the small space beneath it.  Despite the presence of a trapdoor overhead, there are no means by which to climb up through it.

title: [A Haphazard Wooden Shack]
description: Assembled with obvious haste and lack of skill, the shack's walls barely keep any light and sound from filtering in, much less provide secure shelter from the elements.  A rotting oak table tilts to one side but still is somehow able to hold the wares displayed on it without falling over.  Beside it, a lidless and splintered haon chest holds more items for sale.  Almost as an afterthought, a sign has been tacked to one wall.

title: [Let It Burn]
description: Rickety wooden walls surround this small room, and they bear several layers of scorch marks, as if a fire had torn through the room and somehow left the walls standing.  A lantern hangs from the ceiling, the light shed from the clouded glass is barely enough to illuminate the center of the room, leaving the edges in deep shadow.  At the edge of the light, a long wooden rack rests on the blackened floor, its contents coated in a layer of dust.  A door and a ragged canvas curtain reside in walls opposite each other

Rickety wooden walls surround this small room, and they bear several layers of scorch marks, as if a fire had torn through the room and somehow left the walls standing.  A lantern hangs from the ceiling, the light shed from the clouded glass is barely enough to illuminate the center of the room, leaving the edges in deep shadow.  At the edge of the light, a long wooden rack rests on the blackened floor, its contents coated in a layer of dust.  A door and a ragged canvas curtain reside in walls opposite each other.

title: [Let It Burn, Storage]
description: Barely bigger than a closet, the back room is fit with several floor-to-ceiling shelves that house various random objects, from a human skull to a length of twine.  A threadbare carpet covers the dusty wooden floor, and despite its degraded state, it is obvious it was once an opulent decoration.  Affixed to the flame-marred wall, a sconce holds a taper candle that exudes an impotent glow.  A ragged canvas curtain leads out of the room and a single soot-stained window lets in absolutely no light at all from outside.

title: [Huff 'n' Puff, Center]
description: At the center of the canvas-covered barge, a large opening in the roof above affords the chimney from a wood burning stove a place to vent its sooty smoke.  More hooks dangle from the supports overhead, appropriately place near the fire, to help cure the bundles of tobacco.

title: [Huff 'n' Puff, Back]
description: The far end of the floating barge is sealed off with a thick curtain, hiding a cozy space from the main area and attempting to discourage customers from venturing any further uninvited.  Glowing brightly, a large brass oil lamp dispels some of the darkness this far from the flap opening directly opposite.  A roughly hewn oak rack suspended by tarnished chains swings overhead as the barge gently rocks in the shallow water, causing its wares to slide slightly as it rocks.

title: [Huff 'n' Puff, Studio]
description: Just beyond a thick curtain of heavy black velvet is a bi-level cubicle featuring a narrow sleeping loft with crude ladder along one side.  Underneath is a small work area lined with shelves holding all sorts of supplies, with the rest of the tiny room left open.  A crude window grimy with dirt obscures the view, serving mostly to let in light to brighten the space.

title: [Requiem]
description: Sunlight streams into the back of the booth through a cracked, but still beautiful, stained glass window depicting the various symbols of Liabo.  The multitude of colors cast garish shadows over the dusty shelves and trunks that fill this narrow room.  Atop one overturned chest rests a dented pewter jewelry box, its hinges forced open and lid hanging askew.

A single, guttering candle casts its feeble light around the cluttered, narrow booth.  Garishly colored shadows dance in the flickering light reflected from the stained glass window depicting the various symbols of Liabo.  Atop one overturned chest rests a dented pewter jewelry box, its hinges forced open and lid hanging askew.

title: [Good Looks, Back]
description: Here, a narrow rack breaks the slender width of the tent, hung with an orderly arrangement of wares.  The slight creaking and minute sway of the pier, combined with the gentle swing of the tiny suspended oil lamps on the central support overhead gives away that this structure is not entirely stable.

title: [Good Looks, Studio]
description: This end of the rickety pier has been covered with a thick puma fur rug, creating a small seating area for a select group of customers.  Rolled up canvas openings create breezy windows, admitting the sounds of the nearby swamp critters infiltrate the space.  A tilted worktable sits at a slight angle in front of a heavy canvas curtain blocking off the very end of the structure.

title: [Good Looks, Sleeping Quarters]
description: Sectioned off by a thick curtain of canvas, now tied back to let in light and air, the small sleeping quarters are compact yet comfortable.  A large windowed opening cut into the cloth flaps softly with the breeze, and the sound of chirping crickets is clearly audible.  Books are piled up near the pillow-side of the mattressed cot, a single oil lamp balanced on the top with a small box of matches placed nearby.

title: [Act of Neutrality, Parlor]
description: Muted gold-on-beige brocade lines the walls of the area, the designs highlighted by a horizontal row of glass candles arranged on an elongated driftwood dresser leaning along the farthest wall.  Several grey velvet benches are scattered across the middle of the room, each angled to face some lacquered wooden mannequins frozen in dance-like poses, the figures each facing an ivory mirror.  The oak-planked floor is covered with pale angora rugs, the aisles converging at a branch-inked vellum screen.

title: [Act of Neutrality, Sitting Room]
description: Several pin-tucked silk pillows are stacked on either side of a branch-inked vellum screen, the pale cushions surrounding a bronze-plated table set against the wall.  Bolts of gauzy fabric interweave from each corner of the room to link with a pierced golden lantern set high upon the ceiling, the remaining lengths forming a semi-sheer curtain gathering in folds upon the planked floor.  Set along the far wall is a pale glass-inlaid mosaic, the circular design a mix of floral and abstract shapes.

title: [Take a Swig, Special Vintages]
description: This room is very dark.  A three-legged stool is topped with a cluster of guttering candles, providing the only source of uneven light.  In the middle of the room next to the stool is a large modwir trunk with tarnished brass clasps.  Cobwebs dangle from the ceiling, and large shadows flicker in the corners.

title: [Take a Swig, Cups]
description: A sturdy mossbark rack is pushed against the far wall of this room.  A threadbare brown rug sits on the center of the uneven floor, underneath a molding grey armchair and a moth-eaten black velvet couch.  Despite the deteriorating surroundings, the scent of lavender lingers in the air.

title: [Wrought From Rot, Nest]
description: Woven from rotten reeds and vines, then packed with leaves and grime, a massive nest is established between the thick, forked branches of the tree's largest bough.  Clustered branches and rotting leaves form a barrier around the nest, obstructing the view of both the ground and sky.  A faint, luminescent mold grows in spidery trails along the splitting bark of the bough and base of the nest, offering minimal visibility.

title: [Kritter Kickin']
description: Severed animal heads in various stages of taxidermy hang from the ridgepole of this musty canvas tent.  Large racks of antlers, mounted on wooden posts, display an assortment of stiff leather boots.  Tanned leather goods and scraps of various hides lay piled upon a workbench.   Beside it, a large snapping turtle carapace has been turned upside down and filled with a collection of leather gloves.

title: [Here We Goat Again]
description: Old crates and boxes are piled up around the storage room of the barn.  Stacks of moldy straw and hay are scattered about.  The evidence of small rodents, snakes and other swamp creatures is clearly noticeable.

title: [Abandoned Church, Undercroft]
description: Circular stone walls covered in mold and mildew enclose the undercroft, each bearing a carved ledge.  Upon the ledges, sarcophagi rest, though their lids are removed, and whatever rested within has been plundered.  Leading up to the chancel, a torch-lined granite stairwell is the only source of light.

title: [Beer Hall, Dance Floor]
description: In contrast to the tap room, the dance floor is clearly illuminated by numerous silver lamps evenly spaced along each wall.   A mahogany dance floor covers the entirety of the area and dark scuff marks attest to the use it's seen over the years.  A small wobbly wooden table offers up a refreshing drink to those who have worked up a thirst dancing the day away.  A colorful silk curtain leads into a small recessed room.

title: [Beer Hall, The Nook]
description: Nailed haphazardly to a wall at the end of this narrow room is an old cork dartboard.  Sitting on a wide shelf that runs along one of the wooden walls, a small lamp gives off just enough light to illimuminate the numbers written in bold script on the cork board.  The shelf provides a secondary service, as it is just wide enough to allow a mug of beer to sit on it without chance of spillage.  A colorful silk curtain leads back to the dance hall.

title: [Pucker Up]
description: Tall end tables stand on either side of a cushioned window seat, and the aroma of fresh fruit fills the air.  Two polished wooden displays provide a focal point at the center of the room.

title: [Pucker Up]
description: A watercolor landscape hangs on the wall behind two wooden displays.  The image shows two figures engaged in a kiss near a twilit lake.  At the rear of the room, a cream lace curtain backed with apricot silk hangs neatly over the entrance to a small parlor.

title: [Pucker Up]
description: Silvery moonlight joins the glow from several wall sconces to fill the room with light.  Several cushions in different colors lay scattered about, atop a plush rug.  An elaborate puzzle box comprised of dozens of colorful woods sits on a a circular white table near a small framed notice.

The light of day shines through an arched leaded glass window, giving the room a warm radiance.  Several cushions in different colors lay scattered about, atop a plush rug.  An elaborate puzzle box comprised of dozens of colorful woods sits on a a circular white table near a small framed notice.

title: [Like Nobody's Watching, Men's]
description: Unlike the entry, this room is airy and well-lit with a variety of ensconced candles.  Wide windows are cut in the silk walls and protected by awnings so as not to let any rain enter the room, yet allowing plenty of moonlight.  A long black marble counter encompasses the center of the floor, its surface displaying a variety of footwear and a propped-up, discreet white wooden sign.  Against the back wall, several shelves hold clothing and accessories for men.

Unlike the entry, this room is airy and light, with wide windows cut in the silk walls and protected by awnings so as not to let any rain enter the room, yet allowing plenty of sunshine.  A long black marble counter encompasses the center of the floor, its surface displaying a variety of footwear and a propped-up, discreet white wooden sign.  Against the back wall, several shelves hold clothing and accessories for men.

title: [Like Nobody's Watching, Women's]
description: A soft golden glow suffuses the room from a set of glowing orbs that hangs suspended from the angled ceiling.  The walls billow slightly in the passing breezes outside, causing the golden light to create varied shadows on the black silk surfaces.  An armoire in the far corner contains several drawers full of women's clothing, while a long marble counter in the center of the room displays several styles of footwear and a propped-up, discreet white wooden sign.

title: [Die Harder, Broken-Hearted]
description: Littered along the floor are multiple hearts from various animals and vile creatures alike.  A strong scent of death and rotting flesh is stagnant in the air.  Centered in the room is a large armor stand, while a wooden chopping block has been pushed into one corner.

title: [Die Harder, Crushing Defeat]
description: Scattered about the floor are various bits and pieces of armor.  Centered amongst the mess in the room is a large armor stand, while a wooden worktable is situated nearby.

title: [Resist It, Suck It Up]
description: Jet black carpeting lines the floor of this room from wall to wall.  Centered in the room is a large armor stand.  Hung from the walls are various paintings depicting puppies being imploded alive.

title: [Resist It, Cold-Hearted]
description: Some cerulean carpeting lines the floor of this room from wall to wall.  Centered in the room is a large armor stand.  Hung from the walls are various paintings depicting puppies being frozen alive.

title: [Armor Abundance, East]
description: A thick layer of dust covers the barren floor of this nearly empty room.  The only two objects of notice seem to be a large armor stand pushed up against one wall and a wall-hung rack opposite it across the room.

title: [Armor Abundance, North]
description: Hard wood flooring compromises the entire area of this barren room.  The only two objects of notice are a large armor stand and a wall-hung rack stuffed to the gills with various armors for sale.

title: [Booze and Brews, Moonshine]
description: Lit only by the dim light flickering in from the chandelier to the west, shadows claim the majority of this corner of the wagon.  A series of padded stools run along the front of a long glass-topped bar, while a distinguished gnome watches customers from behind the bar.

title: [Robe N' Hood, Clothing]
description: No wider than a hallway, most of the available space in this cramped wagon is taken up by a glass-topped display case.  A series of upturned hooks dots the wall across from the case, the hooks evenly spaced to display an array of robes.  A narrow path leads around the case to the other half of the wagon, while a silver-framed maroon wooden door fills the western wall, leading to a partitioned space.

title: [Hood and Staff, Back Room]
description: This sparsely furnished section of the wagon has been partitioned off by a darkly varnished, panelled wall interrupted only by a silver-framed maroon wooden door.  A simple round wooden table rests against the wall underneath the three tall, rectangular windows beside a long wooden bench.  The shape of the windows causes long, blocky shadows to be cast across the floor, punctuated by stripes of bright sunlight.

title: [Portable Potables]
description: Many layers of rushes cover the floor from slanted wall to slanted wall.  Running the length of the eastern wall is a knicked up ash counter.  A crystal bead curtain leads further into the shop.

title: [Portable Potables, Workroom]
description: Light refracts through the crystal bead curtain scattering light and shadows across the small workspace.  A thick reed rug covers the wood plank floor, with a tidy wooden workbench stands against the rear wall.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest

title: [A Bone to Pick, Backroom]
description: This part of the mausoleum, for the most part, remains undamaged.  A faded and discolored tapestry stretches across a limestone wall, and old stains are caked into the stones of the floor.  A crude stool crafted from bleached humanoid bones sits alone in the center of the room.

title: [Winter Boutique, Showroom]
description: The largest section of the wagon has been kept clear of clutter and adornment.  A set of elegantly curved hooks have been attached to the frosted green walls, adorned with merchandise, they are the sole feature of the spacious area.  Each hook has a delicate gold-lettered sign attached to its braided handles.

title: [Winter Boutique, Workroom]
description: The small corner of the wagon has clearly been dedicated to sewing.  Scraps of brightly coloured linen, cotton, and silk are strewn about a large oak work table.  A small tart-shaped pin cushion is studded with needles, while lengths of thread dangle from the edge of the table.  A scattering of small cushions decorate the floor.

title: [Liktiken's Hovel]
description: The smell in this part of the hovel is positively rancid, though the origin of the stench is not readily apparent.  Bent nails protrude from the boards propping up the roof, and a variety of odds and ends dangle from them precariously.  Shoved against one wall are the remains of an old baby carriage, its wheels warped and its fabric canopy torn and threadbare.  Half of a hole-ridden barrel reaches out of the muck, its iron bandings rusted completely.

title: [Liktiken's Hovel]
description: An indistinct humming noise fills the air in this rear portion of the hovel, and the air is heavy with heat and humidity.  Strings of old, rusty fish hooks hang from one wall, while another is plastered with carnival posters, which are quite obviously covering what was once a large hole.  Atop a damaged crab cage in the corner is a small misshapen pot, and opposite is a slanted cot covered in molding blankets and pillows.

title: [Fledgeling Magic, West Wing]
description: Thin oak paneling covers the walls and ceiling, while globe shaped lanterns provide a soft illumination.  Silky black banners threaded with various runic symbols hang from the walls.  Spaced slightly apart a a cerulean mannequin and a maroon mannequin center the room.

title: [Fledgeling Magic, East Wing]
description: Thin oak paneling covers the walls and ceiling, while globe shaped lanterns provide a soft illumination.  Silky black banners threaded with various runic symbols hang from the walls.  Spaced slightly apart a a twilight mannequin and a terracotta mannequin center the room.

title: [Tug-of-War, Witchwood Field]
description: Blocking the sky with their interwoven canopies, a number of twisted and gnarled trees have grown to form walls around a field of swamp grasses and wildflowers.  Thick rattan posts support burning torches, which cast flickering light over a pair of long, shallow trenches divided by a 10-foot wide pit.  The remnants of previous battles lie scattered in and around the trenches, primarily broken sections of thick, rotted rope.  Just behind the pit, a red and blue sign is prominently placed at the edge of the field.

title: [A Fine Line Between]
description: Held up by smooth ironwood poles, the dark velvet of the tent drapes to the ground in soft ripples.  A pair of frosted crystal globes is suspended from the ceiling by bronze chains.  Crimson, verdant, and gold silk wind about each support before being knotted together and allowed to hang to the floor.  A trio of mannequins is centered in the room between the posts.

title: [A Fine Line Between]
description: Standing tall along a back wall is a large witchwood wardrobe, its doors wide open revealing several shelves and drawers.  A single frosted globe hangs from the dark velvet roof above.  It is positioned to illuminate a trio of mannequins standing in the center of the room.  Rich crimson and gold silk wraps about the ironwood poles supporting the canopy, their lengths pooling on the thick ebon carpet covering the ground.

title: [A Fine Line Between]
description: Small frosted globes hang from the domed ceiling by slender bronze chains.  Standing in the center is a trio of mannequins arranged in a circular pattern.  Lengths of crimson, ebon and indigo silk wrap about ironwood poles that hold up the thick dark velvet creating the canopy roof above.  Tucked in the back of the area is an iron-banded witchwood barrel, its surface stamped with undecipherable arcane runes.

Small frosted globes hang from the domed ceiling by slender bronze chains.  Standing in the center is a trio of mannequins arranged in a circular pattern.  Lengths of crimson, ebon, and indigo silk wrap about ironwood poles that hold up the thick dark velvet creating the canopy roof above.  Tucked in the back of the area is an iron-banded witchwood barrel, its surface stamped with undecipherable arcane runes.

title: [The Blackshire Emporium]
description: Swathes of ebony gauze cling to the walls, draped between the black iron sconces and accented with miniature feystone spiders with spindly legs.  Below, tables festooned with violet and black-striped banners cozy up to the walls, and between them stands a tall grey-barked tree laden with a variety of goods.  Here and there among the wares are sculpted silver vases and small tea candles in stained glass holders, the latter illuminating the crimson and lavender fleur-de-lis designs on the shades.

title: [The Blackshire Emporium]
description: A heavy black iron chandelier hangs from the support beams overhead, each of its many arms bearing a tallow candle.  Wirework mannequins lurk in the corners, casting raucous shadows across the walls, and in the center of the room is an ebon wire birdcage housing an obsidian raven.  A pair of matching ebonwood chests sit open beneath the birdcage, and elevated on carved ebonwood pedestals, velvet-lined glass cases display a variety of wares.

title: [The Blackshire Emporium]
description: This area at the rear of the wagon is separated from the rest by an opaque violet-on-black curtain, across from which is a narrow ladder that leads upward into a loft-styled bed.  Beneath sits a wing-backed aubergine velvet chair, and nearby is a pedestal table supporting a smooth, leather-covered journal and a raven feather quill.

title: [A Leg Up]
description: The hallway continues on, thin and cramped, made even more so by the wall of mannequin legs that jut out into the path.  Bent and raised as if poised for a dancer's kick-step, the legs are dark and stained, a fact that cannot be hidden by the wares upon them.  The hallway makes a sharp turn to the north here, preceded by a fraying carpet runner.

title: [A Leg Up, A Hand Out]
description: Strips of wallpaper hang limply from the walls, faded and moldy, and bits and pieces of plaster litter the floor, leaving voids in the ceiling overhead.  High on one wall is a display of mannequin hands, some shorn at the wrist, while others have a partial forearm.  All are poised, fingers gnarled, as if clutching at the air or whomever might stray too near their grasp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Fungal tubes rise out of the leaf-covered ground, their twisted stems curving away from the rotting nutrients of the swamp's muddy banks.  Bright green mold-covered tree limbs lie in a protective ring about the russet brown protrusions and display signs of hooves, beak, and claw marks across their warped lengths.  Sprouts of bright green swamp privet break through the dismal grey and brown of the landscape, their spindled limbs mildly spotted with layered and waxy, lime green bulbs.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Splintered bark and broken limbs litter the viscous ground around a stunted black willow tree.  Discolored leaves precariously cling to branches, though a greater number lie scatted about the mud.  Upturned tufts of wildrye grass display their intricate root systems to the sky along edge of the watercourse, their blue-green blades barely touching the scum-covered liquid.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright and verdant in the dark landscape, a single juniper tree rises out of the murky bleakness of the swamp and stretches upward towards the grey sky.  Concentric bands of alternating stone and brown grass surround the twisted body of the towering, berry-laden beauty and manage to stave off the filth of the nearby sludge-like mud.  Despite the calm of the area, an invasive humidity makes the air weighed with dampness and an underlying scent of stench clogs the senses.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay.  Drooping willow trees, short and stunted, drape across the path and dangle their spear-shaped leaves upon the spongy ground.  A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees.  Standing in the center of a pool of cloudy water is a hollowed tree stump that is covered in orange and brown shelf fungi.  Several patches of land offer a better trail through the deep muck that covers the ground, but avoiding the muck seems impossible.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.  A narrow sinkhole has gathered much of the muck in the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Splintered bark and broken limbs litter the viscous ground around a stunted black willow tree.  Discolored leaves precariously cling to branches, though a greater number lie scatted about the mud.  Upturned tufts of wildrye grass display their intricate root systems to the sky along edge of the watercourse, their blue-green blades barely touching the scum-covered liquid.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves.  Ominous shadows trail across the spongy, softness of the landscape where enormous muddy bubbles rise and burst as underground gases escape from the bosom of the earth.  In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Fungal tubes rise out of the leaf-covered ground, their twisted stems curving away from the rotting nutrients of the swamp's muddy banks.  Bright green mold-covered tree limbs lie in a protective ring about the russet brown protrusions and display signs of hooves, beak, and claw marks across their warped lengths.  Sprouts of bright green swamp privet break through the dismal grey and brown of the landscape, their spindled limbs mildly spotted with layered and waxy, lime green bulbs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid sinkhole along the eastern border.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees.  Standing in the center of a pool of cloudy water is a hollowed tree stump that is covered in orange and brown shelf fungi.  Several patches of land offer a better trail through the deep muck that covers the ground, but avoiding the muck seems impossible.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky.  Thick roots, resembling the legs of an enormous spider, rise out of the soft, muddy ground and create arches that encircle the smooth barked monstrosity.  High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright and verdant in the dark landscape, a single juniper tree rises out of the murky bleakness of the swamp and stretches upward towards the grey sky.  Concentric bands of alternating stone and brown grass surround the twisted body of the towering, berry-laden beauty and manage to stave off the filth of the nearby sludge-like mud.  Despite the calm of the area, an invasive humidity makes the air weighed with dampness and an underlying scent of stench clogs the senses.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Strange fumes create a haze in the air as they explosively escape from the putrid ground and fill the air with an aroma akin to rotting eggs.  Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick tangles of thorn-heavy brambles lie in knotted clusters along the western border of the pathway that bisects the swamp.  Several puddles of stagnant water pockmark the thick carpet of dusky brown moss that spreads across the uneven ground.  A ring of half-rotted trees leans against each other, their splintered sides and barkless faces heavy with black mold and sludge.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay.  Drooping willow trees, short and stunted, drape across the path and dangle their spear-shaped leaves upon the spongy ground.  A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.

title: [The Misted Grey, Insanity]
description: Rich dark grey silk shot with silver threading forms the walls of this small area.  A pair of mannequins stand next to a small silk-covered table in the center of a wide ebon carpet.  Large frosted crystal globes hang above, bathing the displays in a warm, pale light.

title: [The Misted Grey, Death]
description: Standing guard over the room are a pair of mannequins which flank either side of a long black oak table.  The carpet under their feet is a rich ebon wool, while the pale grey walls surrounding them are a fine silk.  Several frosted globes of crystal hold candles that cast dim light over the area.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Cavern]
description: Crumbling limestone soars overhead, spanning outward from a low, boulder-blocked passageway into an expansive cavern area that is largely wrapped in darkness.  Red spots, painted at various intervals, splatter across the walls, each centered with a long steel spike driven into the limestone.  Stretched between three adjacent spikes, a long coil of rope is draped with various hats.  At the very edge of the wan torchlight, where the ground suddenly drops away, the top of a narrow ladder is barely visible.

title: [Alchemist's Delight, Front Room]
[Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: The well-lit tent has several crooked columns of cauldrons that are likely supporting the dark blue canvas walls and ceiling.  A small opening leads to a separate room toward the rear.  To the immediate right of the entrance is a small neatly arranged area with a large rack, a display table and a wicker basket.  A mithril placard loosely attached to the wall also stands out.

The well-lit tent has several crooked columns of cauldrons that are likely supporting the dark blue canvas walls and ceiling.  A small opening leads to a separate room toward the rear.  To the immediate right of the entrance is a small, neatly arranged area with a large rack, a display table, and a wicker basket.  A mithril placard loosely attached to the wall also stands out.

Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.

title: [Immortally Preserved, Workroom]
description: Plump cushions of viridian and ebon velvet are scattered about the small, circular space, a great many of them hugging the thick walls of crushed silk.  Here and there, a frosted globe is suspended from the ceiling, providing the area with a soft, almost intimate, illumination.  Positioned within the center of the room is an easel-supported sign of painted canvas.

title: [Abandoned General Store, Attic]
description: The upper level of the store is hot and humid, with some daylight peeking through holes in the roof, but not enough to offer much ventilation.  Rafters are the only way to traverse the area, which isn't very spacious.

title: [Lost Passages, Under the Store]
description: Evidence of a fire chars the hardened and packed dirt floor just below a hole in the ceiling.  The remains of many creatures and species are piled on the floor, the rot adding an awful smell to the cavernous area.  A rusted iron tub is pushed up against the eastern wall -- a malignant sickness permeates the area and radiates into the air, which appears to be coming from the tub.

title: [Lost Passages, Butcher's Lair]
description: An assortment of metal tables are scattered across the room, some of them burdened with a number of tools, including bone saws, metal clamps, knives, and stakes, while others laden with vile chunks of flesh and various organs.  Wandering the lair is a one-eyed goblin scavenger, hunched over with a twisted expression on its face.  A pile of rotting carcasses lies in a heap against the western wall.

title: [Lost Passages, Bathed in Blood]
description: Several low shelves hang from the stone walls, displaying various containers of murky liquid.  A dim oil lamp hangs over a bloodstained wooden worktable that is situated in the center of the room, surrounded by pools of fresh gore on the floor.  A rotting corpse is slumped over up by the northern egress.

title: [A Teak Shack, Pole Room]
description: The absence of a ceiling allows the moonlight to come flooding in, lighting up a bright blue pool in the center.  Teak chairs surround the pool, each with a closed parasol attached to the top of it.  Seashells and crab husks are tied to the teak planks circling the room.  A bamboo male mannequin and a teak female mannequin stand neglected in the corner of the room.

The absence of a ceiling allows the sunlight to come flooding in, lighting up a bright blue pool in the center.  Teak chairs surround the pool, each with an open parasol attached to the top of it.  Seashells and crab husks are tied to the teak planks circling the room.  A bamboo male mannequin and a teak female mannequin stand neglected in the corner of the room.

title: [A Teak Shack, Pool Room]
description: The water is bright blue and clear.  Floating around the edges are small foam floatation devices.  A small wooden duck bobs up and down, floating peacefuly in the center.

title: [Fogardruh's Wagon, Workshop]
description: Numerous sections of hammered glaes, invar, vultite, and steel form concave walls, blending in a chaotic display of dwarven craftsmanship.  A grim, soot-covered dwarf works his hammer hurriedly along a slab of glowing orange metal, frequently changing its position on a massive anvil that resides in the center of the chamber.  Another dwarf beyond him works with a grinder and polisher, a blackened vise mounted on the wall to one side and finished hilts piled high in a bin to the other.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space. title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires. title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees. title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil. title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns. title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees. paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown. paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves. In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse. Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible. Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky. An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky. High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway. Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.  A narrow sinkhole has gathered much of the muck in the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]

description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees.  Standing in the center of a pool of cloudy water is a hollowed tree stump that is covered in orange and brown shelf fungi.  Several patches of land offer a better trail through the deep muck that covers the ground, but avoiding the muck seems impossible.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay.  Drooping willow trees, short and stunted, drape across the path and dangle their spear-shaped leaves upon the spongy ground.  A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves.  Ominous shadows trail across the spongy, softness of the landscape where enormous muddy bubbles rise and burst as underground gases escape from the bosom of the earth.  In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Fungal tubes rise out of the leaf-covered ground, their twisted stems curving away from the rotting nutrients of the swamp's muddy banks.  Bright green mold-covered tree limbs lie in a protective ring about the russet brown protrusions and display signs of hooves, beak, and claw marks across their warped lengths.  Sprouts of bright green swamp privet break through the dismal grey and brown of the landscape, their spindled limbs mildly spotted with layered and waxy, lime green bulbs.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright and verdant in the dark landscape, a single juniper tree rises out of the murky bleakness of the swamp and stretches upward towards the grey sky.  Concentric bands of alternating stone and brown grass surround the twisted body of the towering, berry-laden beauty and manage to stave off the filth of the nearby sludge-like mud.  Despite the calm of the area, an invasive humidity makes the air weighed with dampness and an underlying scent of stench clogs the senses.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Broken limbs lie in scattered heaps across the soggy ground, their ends clawed and chewed upon by some unseen animal.  A narrow tree-enshrouded path leads further into a thick wooded pass, away from the swamp.  Sprouting out of their rotting expanses are tubes of wild mushrooms with cup-shaped heads and blue-green blades of wildrye.  A thin trail of stones winds its way through the slogging mud and provides a solid means of egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky.  Thick roots, resembling the legs of an enormous spider, rise out of the soft, muddy ground and create arches that encircle the smooth barked monstrosity.  High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid sinkhole along the eastern border.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Narrowing to an ultra thin track of solid ground, the pathway meanders through wide pools of stagnant water.  Duckweed and bladderwort create a verdant border to each of ovoid bodies and rainbow mold stretches across the stale surfaces.  Clouds of gnats thicken the air, their tiny bodies clinging to everything in their path.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Strange fumes create a haze in the air as they explosively escape from the putrid ground and fill the air with an aroma akin to rotting eggs.  Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Toppled on its side, an enormous banyan tree stretches across the pathway and lies its head into the stagnant waters of the nearby stream.  Mold and sludge have claimed most of the verdant canopy, while its roots lie exposed to the elements and still cling to large clumps of moist earth.  A series of tiny black capped mushrooms grow in the dark shelter of the fallen tree.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.  A narrow sinkhole has gathered much of the muck in the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick tangles of thorn-heavy brambles lie in knotted clusters along the western border of the pathway that bisects the swamp.  Several puddles of stagnant water pockmark the thick carpet of dusky brown moss that spreads across the uneven ground.  A ring of half-rotted trees leans against each other, their splintered sides and barkless faces heavy with black mold and sludge.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Narrowing to an ultra thin track of solid ground, the pathway meanders through wide pools of stagnant water.  Duckweed and bladderwort create a verdant border to each of ovoid bodies and rainbow mold stretches across the stale surfaces.  Clouds of gnats thicken the air, their tiny bodies clinging to everything in their path.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Strange fumes create a haze in the air as they explosively escape from the putrid ground and fill the air with an aroma akin to rotting eggs.  Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid sinkhole along the eastern border.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.  A narrow sinkhole has gathered much of the muck in the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.
