title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Fungal tubes rise out of the leaf-covered ground, their twisted stems curving away from the rotting nutrients of the swamp's muddy banks.  Bright green mold-covered tree limbs lie in a protective ring about the russet brown protrusions and display signs of hooves, beak, and claw marks across their warped lengths.  Sprouts of bright green swamp privet break through the dismal grey and brown of the landscape, their spindled limbs mildly spotted with layered and waxy, lime green bulbs.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Splintered bark and broken limbs litter the viscous ground around a stunted black willow tree.  Discolored leaves precariously cling to branches, though a greater number lie scatted about the mud.  Upturned tufts of wildrye grass display their intricate root systems to the sky along edge of the watercourse, their blue-green blades barely touching the scum-covered liquid.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Narrowing to an ultra thin track of solid ground, the pathway meanders through wide pools of stagnant water.  Duckweed and bladderwort create a verdant border to each of ovoid bodies and rainbow mold stretches across the stale surfaces.  Clouds of gnats thicken the air, their tiny bodies clinging to everything in their path.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees.  Standing in the center of a pool of cloudy water is a hollowed tree stump that is covered in orange and brown shelf fungi.  Several patches of land offer a better trail through the deep muck that covers the ground, but avoiding the muck seems impossible.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright and verdant in the dark landscape, a single juniper tree rises out of the murky bleakness of the swamp and stretches upward towards the grey sky.  Concentric bands of alternating stone and brown grass surround the twisted body of the towering, berry-laden beauty and manage to stave off the filth of the nearby sludge-like mud.  Despite the calm of the area, an invasive humidity makes the air weighed with dampness and an underlying scent of stench clogs the senses.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]

Withered plants lie limply where they grow and are covered with fuzzy bits of white and black mold, while thin rivulets of muddy waters flow downward towards the distant watercourse.  Though not visible, the insistent hum of hundreds of mosquitoes can be heard from all around.

title: [Alchemist's Delight, Workroom]
description: The bustling workroom takes up a larger portion of the tent than appears from the salesroom.  Multiple workstations are set up around the edge of the room to make wares for customers.  More organized than the front room except for several columns of cauldrons, a simple workstation has been set apart from the others in an area with space for a small audience.  A large mithril pipe extending through the ceiling provides ventilation to the room, and a small opening leads back to the salesroom.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay.  Drooping willow trees, short and stunted, drape across the path and dangle their spear-shaped leaves upon the spongy ground.  A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky.  Thick roots, resembling the legs of an enormous spider, rise out of the soft, muddy ground and create arches that encircle the smooth barked monstrosity.  High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves.  Ominous shadows trail across the spongy, softness of the landscape where enormous muddy bubbles rise and burst as underground gases escape from the bosom of the earth.  In tandem to the popping sounds of the mud, the wind whistles through the rocks and carries with it a fetid stench.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick tangles of thorn-heavy brambles lie in knotted clusters along the western border of the pathway that bisects the swamp.  Several puddles of stagnant water pockmark the thick carpet of dusky brown moss that spreads across the uneven ground.  A ring of half-rotted trees leans against each other, their splintered sides and barkless faces heavy with black mold and sludge.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Toppled on its side, an enormous banyan tree stretches across the pathway and lies its head into the stagnant waters of the nearby stream. A series of tiny black capped mushrooms grow in the dark shelter of the fallen tree.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.

Sprouting out of their rotting expanses are tubes of wild mushrooms with cup-shaped heads and blue-green blades of wildrye.  A thin trail of stones winds its way through the slogging mud and provides a solid means of egress from the area.

Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Splintered bark and broken limbs litter the viscous ground around a stunted black willow tree.  Discolored leaves precariously cling to branches, though a greater number lie scatted about the mud.  Upturned tufts of wildrye grass display their intricate root systems to the sky along edge of the watercourse, their blue-green blades barely touching the scum-covered liquid.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky.  Thick roots, resembling the legs of an enormous spider, rise out of the soft, muddy ground and create arches that encircle the smooth barked monstrosity.  High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Vibrant, purple-headed swamp thistle creates an extravagant splash of color as it grows in tangle masses along the northeastern edge of the swamp.  Lance-headed spurs drive outward from the knotted bushes and pierce the leaves of a moon vine that has attempted to wed its fate to the dark, flowering bush.  A thickly corded spider web is built against the prickled stems of the species and is littered with dried-out insect carcasses.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Fungal tubes rise out of the leaf-covered ground, their twisted stems curving away from the rotting nutrients of the swamp's muddy banks.  Bright green mold-covered tree limbs lie in a protective ring about the russet brown protrusions and display signs of hooves, beak, and claw marks across their warped lengths.  Sprouts of bright green swamp privet break through the dismal grey and brown of the landscape, their spindled limbs mildly spotted with layered and waxy, lime green bulbs.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Broken limbs lie in scattered heaps across the soggy ground, their ends clawed and chewed upon by some unseen animal.  A narrow tree-enshrouded path leads further into a thick wooded pass, away from the swamp.  Sprouting out of their rotting expanses are tubes of wild mushrooms with cup-shaped heads and blue-green blades of wildrye.  A thin trail of stones winds its way through the slogging mud and provides a solid means of egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay. A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Moss-covered rocks rise into a high cluster upon the eastern edge of the pathway and are surrounded by thorn-riddled bushes that are devoid of leaves. Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Choked by black-leafed moon vines, several elephant ferns peak through the verdant foliage and stretch toward the dangling limbs of the banyan trees.  Shaggy strands of shredded moss drape in curtains across the murky pathway, their dusky brown tendrils fuzzy with white and black moss heads.  A series of blackened reeds create a dense barrier that separates the mud-soaked rocks of the landscape from the burbling, fetid sinkhole along the eastern border.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Surrounded by a ring of pallid stones, an enormous crater disrupts the verdant foliage of the swamp.  Muddy streaks, cracked and brittle, decorate the upper ridge of the cavernous expanse, while stagnant water pools at its base.  A series of rotted planks lie across the spongy, moss carpeting that lines the eastern edge and provides safe egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Stretched between the dark bodies of two leafless, black willow trees is a dust-riddled cobweb riddled with cocooned insect bodies.  Leaves and small twigs are also bound in the thickly corded structure, the organic debris displaying signs of severe rotting.  Discarded insect carcasses litter the soggy pathway, which has a sporadic placement of heavy boulders jutting up through the mud.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Stone Structure, Kitchen]
description: One wall is entirely missing from this room, the swamp oozing in from outside.  A wooden bowl holding brushes, combs, rust-edged tools, and colorful bottles sits in the middle of a shallow pool of mud.  Two lengths of blue silk drape down from the half-ceiling overhead, emphasizing the dull surroundings rather than beautifying them.  Broken white parts of a wash basin are partially buried in the mud.  A small circle of candles lends greater to brightness to the moonlight shining in from overhead.

Two lengths of blue silk drape down from the half-ceiling overhead, emphasizing the dull surroundings rather than beautifying them.  Broken white parts of a wash basin are partially buried in the mud.

title: [Stone Structure, Bedroom]
description: Several rusted coiled metal springs are scattered around the room, which is lit with a handful of candles on the floor and moonlight streaming from several holes in the thatched ceiling.  Underneath a broken window framed with tattered curtains, a makeshift table is pushed up against the wall, its length filled with pestles, mortars, liquid-filled bottles, jars of herbs and flowers, and small wooden bowls.  A small wood-framed mirror leans up against the far wall, surrounded by growth pushing up through the ground.

A small wood-framed mirror leans up against the far wall, surrounded by growth pushing up through the ground.

title: [Lean-to Shack, Roped Wall]
description: Massive gashes in the ceiling effectively render it obselete.  Leaning far to one side, the left-most wall is partially held up by a series of ropes looped through hooks in the wall and then tied to stone blocks located in the opposite corner.  The remains of a shelf hold several tarnished silver instruments, small envelopes, and bowls filled with dark-colored glop that has attracted a plethora of buzzing flies.  Illuminating the darkness is a small circle of candles.

title: [Half-built Barn]
description: A rickety wooden ladder leads up onto the beginning stages of a loft.  Under its shadow, a small table holds an assortment of tarnished silver tools and white cloths.  The pale stench of decay drifts in from somewhere nearby, mingling with the wet, moldy stink that rises from the black muck and sprouts of verdant growth covering the ground.  Leaning against one wall is a small wood-framed mirror illuminated by several torches stuck in the ground.

Leaning against one wall is a small wood-framed mirror.

title: [Half-built Barn, Loft]
description: Located on a handful of beams that are partially rotted through, the loft towers high over the unfinished barn, which glows with the light of candles and torches.  Moonlight glints off of the tendrils of spiderwebs, though much of the light is absorbed by the draping green moss that hangs all around.  From this vantage point, the loft has a sweeping view of the darkness surrounding the barn.

Located on a handful of beams that are partially rotted through, the loft towers high over the unfinished barn.  Daylight suffuses the bird's nests tucked into the higher areas of the foundations, and tendrils of spiderwebs mixed with draping green moss hang all around.  From this vantage point, the loft has a sweeping view of the immediate surrounding area before large clusters of banyans block further sight.

title: [Half-built Barn]
description: The stench of decay in this area is potent, hanging heavy in the air.  Moonlight shines brightly down from above and through areas of the barn that were never finished.  Tarnished silver tools and a collection of off-white cloths that don't look entirely clean are piled into a trio of buckets located in the center of the area.  Illuminated by a plethora of candles on the ground, dark green moss creeps over the wood, lending it some color.

Tarnished silver tools and a collection of off-white cloths that don't look entirely clean are piled into a trio of buckets located in the center of the area.  Dark green moss creeps over the wood, lending it some color.

title: [Half-built Barn]
description: Heaps of mud-caked, rotting timber planks are piled into one corner, where a row of candles burn with flickering flames.  Two buckets lie on the ground, their contents displaying tarnished silver tools and a handful of dirt-smeared cloths.  The far wall, many of its planks entirely missing, is strewn with spiderwebs caught in the brambles and growth that seeps in from the outside.  In the far corner, a wooden ladder leads down into the dark.

In the far corner, a wooden ladder leads down into the dark.

title: [Half-built Barn, Underground]
description: A large cavern opens up in this area, though the limestone walls seem to have caved in in areas, blocking any passages that my have once existed here, save for one small opening.  Splinters of buckets, pieces of shovels, shards of pickaxes, and scraps of other mining tools are splayed across the area, some on the floor and others forcefully stuck into the walls and ceiling as if some powerful force blew them to bits.  Behind a wooden ladder is a gear-covered contraption and several torches set into the wall.

title: [Underground, Cave-in]
description: Cramped in size, the cavern niche is entirely walled with limestone rubble, clearly the result of a massive cave-in.  Bits of mining tools poke out of the limestone, as if they were held by hands caught under the path of the earth when it fell.  A wooden bowl with several tarnished silver tools, several of them rusted through, resides on the ground.

title: [Bits and Pieces, Magicals]
description: A wide variety of skins stretched on simple wooden frames stand propped against the support poles in this section of the tent, continuing the macabre theme.  The temperature is lessened considerably by distance from the fire pit alone, but there is also a lingering weight to the air - something that seems almost to provide resistance to movement.  Despite the lack of heat, the effect creates a stifling atmosphere in this section of the tent.

title: [Bits and Pieces, Mundanes]
description: Several sets of free-standing shelves line the outskirts of this area of the tent, and a myriad of jars, canisters, vials, and tubs are arranged among them.  Though the contents of the containers are not obvious on first glance, the smell emanating from some of them is enough to keep the more curious at bay.  Old and discarded bones of various shapes and sizes litter the ground, their colors dull and dark from time and the accumulation of dirt.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Wide, flat shelf mushrooms grow in a spiral around several dozen of petrified blackgum spires.  The rippled fungi is striated with blue, white, and pink hues, each is curved away from the shaggy bark so that the ribbed underbelly of the mushroom displays the grey feather-like protrusions.  Stagnant puddles ring the churned earth where the roots of the dark trees lift out of the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright green fiddlehead ferns grow within the soft earth of the swamp, their feathery heads swaying when anything gets too near to them.  Tiny saplings rise out of the miniature forest of greenery and stretch their spindled limbs towards the heavens.  A thick fog blankets the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west

title: [Sunken Mausoleum, Undercroft]
description: Torches, each lit with a dark violet flame, are affixed upon the granite walls.  Standing in the center of the undercroft is a limestone sarcophagus, which is surrounded by piles of rubble.  The smell of dried blood wafts throughout the tomb, becoming more potent toward the tunnel.  Along the northern wall, a twisting granite staircase leads up toward the surface.

title: [Sunken Mausoleum, Crypt]
description: A glowing scarlet orb hangs from a rusted chain, staining the tomb's haze with its lurid glow.  Piles of torn flesh and shattered bones lie along the walls, their stench overwhelming.  Carved in rows along the walls are cryptic runes, and painted upon the floor are intricate sigils.  Corroded steel shackles dangle from the walls, some encrusted with bits of gore and flesh.  A tunnel leads toward the undercroft and a passageway leads to the catacombs.

title: [Sunken Mausoleum, Catacombs]
description: The entry to the catacombs is a narrow chamber, which is poorly lit by an oil lamp hanging from an ironwood rafter.  Imbedded into the granite walls are countless numbers of skulls, some with no jawbones, while others are cracked and destroyed.  A makeshift archway offers entrance into the necropolis, while a passageway leads into the crypt.

title: [Ancient Preparation Chamber]
description: Eight oblong sandstone mounds stand about this circular chamber like spokes in a wheel, and heavily verdigrised chunks of bronze protrude from the eroded sand at the head and foot of each mound.  Darkly stained channels carved into the floor run from each mass of sandstone to a deteriorated enamel sump in the room's center, and whatever treatment may once have graced the chamber's walls has been reduced to a grey powder that fills the corner where the floor and walls meet, leaving rough-carved limestone in its place.

title: [Ancient Passage]
description: Grey, time-worn limestone walls provide a grim atmosphere to this wide hallway.  The high ceiling and thick layer of pale silt covering the floor provide hints that the passage may once have boasted a smooth, plaster veneer.

title: [Ancient Passage]
description: Grey, time-worn limestone walls provide a grim atmosphere to this wide hallway.  The high ceiling and thick layer of pale silt covering the floor provide hints that the passage may once have boasted a smooth, plaster veneer.  A narrow crack in the northern wall starts just above the floor and climbs toward the ceiling from east to west.

title: [Ancient Passage]
description: Grey, time-worn limestone walls provide a grim atmosphere to this wide hallway.  The high ceiling and thick layer of pale silt covering the floor provide hints that the passage may once have boasted a smooth, plaster veneer.  A crack at the top of the north wall splits into three as it runs west along the ceiling.

title: [Ancient Maw]
description: A row of empty, verdigris torch brackets line the north and south walls, each trailing a stain of green almost to the floor.  Filling the western end of the hall from floor to ceiling is a collapsed archway that may have once resembled the mouth of an immense viper, with paired fangs rising from the floor.  The broken-off stubs of a second pair of fangs protrude from the upper jaw just ahead of two empty eyesockets.

title: [Necropolis, Apse]
description: Poorly lit lamps offer very little illumination at the entrance of the necropolis.  A recent cave-in has destroyed the stone bridge leading to deeper within, completely blocking it off.  A ruined black ora altar is tipped over by the egress toward the mausoleum.  The only hope of further progress is a stone ledge overlooking a chasm cloaked in darkness, which a splotchy goblin miner guards.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees.  Standing in the center of a pool of cloudy water is a hollowed tree stump that is covered in orange and brown shelf fungi.  Several patches of land offer a better trail through the deep muck that covers the ground, but avoiding the muck seems impossible.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Toppled on its side, an enormous banyan tree stretches across the pathway and lies its head into the stagnant waters of the nearby stream.  Mold and sludge have claimed most of the verdant canopy, while its roots lie exposed to the elements and still cling to large clumps of moist earth.  A series of tiny black capped mushrooms grow in the dark shelter of the fallen tree.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Halfway Midway, North Wall]
description: Dirty streamers adorn this eastern side of the prize wall.  A pulsing black heart rests atop the wall, sentry over the spoils below.  The ground around a long rickety counter is littered with torn ticket stubs.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Paupers, Annex Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A royal blue velvet pennant edged in silver hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

Rattan stools flank an ebonwood-topped driftwood bar resting on a large mat of pressed banana leaves, and a wide cushioned wicker armchair invites relaxation while enjoying libation.  Bright blue woven mats are placed before a dark gold flyrsilk curtain and a pale lapis muslin-covered opening.

title: [Accept the Inevitable, Showroom]
description: This fairly spacious room must take up the majority of the wagon.  Openings on two walls lead to smaller rooms, and a large display case sits squarely in the middle of the room.  Bright lanterns cast an array of sharp shadows, compensating for the complete lack of windows.  Neatly organized shelves line one wall, and a simple ladder leads up to an open mithril hatch in the ceiling.

title: [Accept the Inevitable, Office]
description: Maps and other papers are strewn about the crowded room, and a multitude of closed crates and boxes offer both places to sit and places to hide.  One almost uncluttered wall sports an open window looking out onto the street below, with a small wooden step stool positioned for a strategic getaway.  The center of the room is relatively unobstructed, and the peaked roof offers the greatest headroom there.

title: [Wear Me Out]
description: Elaborate silver sconces, affixed to polished oak walls, illuminate the spacious interior.  Several mannequins stand positioned next to some wooden racks, showcasing the offered wares.  Littered with clumps of dried mud, a dark crimson rug edged in golden filigree blankets most of the warped wooden flooring.  Tucked into the corner, a draped piece of dark velvet serves as a makeshift changing area.

title: [Wear Me Out, Dressing Room]
description: A calf-high sanded piece of wood, running the length of one wall, serves as a cozy bench to sit, or discard articles of clothing, on.  A tall gilded mirror, securely attached to the wall opposite the bench, adds a touch of grandeur.  Sets of five silver hooks, in horizontal lines, are strategically placed at several heights and allow customers of all sizes a comfortable perch to hang their potential purchases.

title: [Fusion Sanctum, Locus]
description: Curtains as red as rose petals, darkened by the oppressive damp, swathe the walls of the circular chamber in a display of moldering majesty.  The velvet draperies cannot muffle the sounds of trickling water from without, or hide glimpses of a rope leading up out of the depths.  They do, however, funnel and enhance the haunting whispers rising from a basin of green liquid at the chamber's center. Silver patterns are etched into the granite floor, spreading outward from the pool in concentric spirals.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [A Bubbling Hot Spring]
description: Shooting forth from a single hole in the stone floor of the pool, the spring pierces the surface and rises several inches before coming down in a shower of drops.  Mist wafts up from the warm water, though you can still see the entire garden through the hazy air.  Draining through a rectangular notch that is cut into the southern lip of the pool, the water cascades down a series of stone steps before turning westward and forming a small stream.

title: [Savagery, Tree-Shrouded Morass]
description: Within this secluded fen, the chirping of frogs is nearly the only sound to be heard as the surrounding trees block much of the artifical noise from the grounds beyond.  A break in the tree cover offers a glimpse of the sky overhead, and random clumps of thick grasses rise from the mire here and there along the path.  Nearby is an abandoned bird nest cradled in the fork of some tree branches, and further along is a woven basket hanging from a mossy tree limb.

title: [Savagery, Tree-Shrouded Morass]
description: The ground rises just a smidge here, leaving somewhat drier footing along this part of the path.  Nestled in a bed of dry grass near a half-hollowed tree trunk is a massive overturned tortoise shell, its undercarriage missing and interior thoroughly cleaned.  Overhead, a few stiff tree limbs reach from beneath shrouds of grey moss to snatch at passersby.

title: [Savagery, Tree-Shrouded Morass]
description: At the base of one of the trees set back from the path and on higher ground, a gnarled and raised root has been laid bare and bows over a shallow groove in the dirt.  On the opposite side of the path, where the ground is lower and the water higher, is a high patch of thick cattails.

title: [Savagery, Fern-Choked Den]
description: Rising at last to substantially higher ground, the path ends in this little den created in the embrace of close-pressing ferns.  Beneath the furls of greenery at the far edge of the space is a small straw-stuffed burrow in a hollowed tree trunk, which opens to face a small dancing bonfire.  On the opposite side of the burrow are a pair of logs for sitting, and between them is a tarnished bronze dish.

title: [Abandoned Tavern, Odds and Ends]
description: The room appears to be an old storage area, which surprisingly enough is below the cellar, but remains relatively dry.  Several oil lamps light the room, each hanging over a low wooden counter.  At the back of the room, a wyrmwood treasure chest is chained to the floor.

title: [The Loot Cellar]
description: A set of glaes-paned lanterns are hung from the rafters of the pavilion overhead.  The room is hollowed out from a nest of gnarled cypress roots.  A dusting of pale green moss covers the ground.  At the northern end of the room is a plank ladder leading to a reinforced modwir trapdoor.

title: [Fledgeling Magic, Workshop]
description: Oak paneling covers the entrance wall containing an ornate oaken door, while the remaining walls are still barren framework.  A large stack of paneling sits in one corner of the room.  A plain black banner hangs above a plain oaken workbench on the eastern wall.

title: [A Pocket Full, Roof]
description: Short wooden railings encapsulate this small open space on the roof of the wagon, with a glass-encased lantern perched atop each corner.  Open to the air, this room is susceptible to the changing weather and errant breezes.  Several squares of once plush carpet, now matted and stained by unknown fluids, are scattered around the plank floor for use as seats.  At the back of the room, an open trapdoor in the floor contains a wooden ladder that leads down into the belly of the wagon.

title: [Close Yer Robe, Closet]
description: This cramped space is cluttered with boxes and crates stacked from floor to ceiling.  Illuminated by a swath of glowing green mold, the closet is little more than an extra large vertical coffin.  One box has fallen over and spilled open, allowing its contents to be viewed, and despite the state of the room, the items appear to be in good shape.  The door leading out is barely visible in the gloom, its edges marked by an absence of glowing mold and a faint, stale draft from the other side.

title: [Fitzwobbin's, Inside the Beast]
description: Numerous pipes run in a confusing pattern over the walls and ceiling into a large iron box at the rear fo the chamber.  Two gears attached to the wagon's axles appear to be easily engaged with a nearby lever.  A small space in the center of the room serves as an obvious work area.

title: [Robe N' Hood, Back Room]
description: This sparsely furnished section of the wagon has been partitioned off by a darkly varnished, panelled wall interrupted only by a silver-framed maroon wooden door.  A simple round wooden table rests against the wall underneath the three tall, rectangular windows beside a long wooden bench.  The shape of the windows causes long, blocky shadows to be cast across the floor, punctuated by stripes of bright sunlight.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Diseased Pit]
description: The deep pit is filled with bilious green muck, which froths and bubbles.  Diseased banyan branches dangle into the pit, writhing about the slime-coated walls.  A thick mist blankets the ground, making the confined area hot and humid.  Colorful lichen covers several rocks lodged into the pallid soil.  A narrow passageway leads into the depths of the pit.

title: [The Golden Rule, Workroom]
description: Gold candles adorning the walls light this tiny interior room of the hovel.  No light filters in from outside, and the air is warm and stuffy.  The floor is obscured by an unraveling, faded crimson rug that doesn't quite cover all the dirt.  A narrow gold-handled door leads out.

title: [Treasure Trove]
description: Glittering mica in the walls reflects the glow from the candlelabra that dot the surface, creating a shimmering rainbow of color.  The stone floor is rough but level, providing a suitable surface on which to walk.  A section of the wall is carved out to make a shelf, and recessed lighting provided by small lanterns illuminates the contents.  Mostly hidden by the curvature of the walls, a jagged crack looms in one corner like a darkened maw, while the cave opening offers random gusts of fresh air from outside.

title: [Treasure Trove, Back Room]
description: Darkness reigns in this tiny cavern.  The only light is an ambient, faint greenish glow that seems to emanate from the rocks themselves, and flickering firelight emitted from a jagged crack in one wall.  Shadowy shapes loom in the periphery of vision that could be anything from a stalactite to a vicious cave dweller.

Darkness reigns in this tiny cavern.  The only light is an ambient, faint greenish glow that seems to emanate from the rocks themselves, and flickering firelight emitted from a jagged crack in one wall.  Just inside the edge of light is a dark stone shelf holding a stack of rectangular objects.  Shadowy shapes loom in the periphery of vision that could be anything from a stalactite to a vicious cave dweller.

title: [Atob's Wagon]
description: Tome-filled shelves cover the wagon's front wall, most of them within arm's length of a generously sized reach-through beneath the driver's bench.  The wagon's left wall is taken up with a row of hanging enchanter's robes, their hues ranging through the spectrum, and their folds embroidered with arcane symbols.  Almost hidden behind them, a canvas cot hangs, folded against the wall, and a similarly built worktable hangs from the wagon's right wall, its lacquered surface barren except for a rolaren-bound illthorn hourglass.

title: [Eye of the Hawk]
description: From overhead, the sun glares down onto this open meadow, gilding the tall blades of grass and wildflowers with hints of gold.  Encircling the meadow are a stand of hardwood trees, their leaves vibrant, green, and glossy under the sunlight.  In the distance, birds sing softly every now and again, and the chirp of crickets accompany their song.  As the occasional breeze passes, the scenery wavers for a moment, rippling like a mirage at high noon in the desert before stilling once more.

From overhead, the moons shine down onto this open meadow, gilding the tall blades of grass and wildflowers with hints of silver.  Encircling the meadow are a stand of hardwood trees, their boughs outlined in shimmering white under the moonlight.  All around, silence rules the glade, nary a bird nor cricket to be heard.  As the occasional breeze passes, the scenery wavers for a moment, rippling like a mirage at high noon in the desert before stilling once more.

title: [Olthos' Wagon]
description: Timepieces of all shapes and sizes line the shelves, cabinets, and tables in this uncomfortably cramped space.  A rhythmic ticking echoes hypnotically, threatening to send even the most sound-minded visitor into a disoriented trance.  Occasionally, the wagon's muted light takes on a deep red hue, the source not immediately apparent.  A small glass case bordered with sleek gold edges and a filigreed lock plate sits prominently atop an ornately carved fireleaf table.

Timepieces of all shapes and sizes line the shelves, cabinets, and tables in this uncomfortably cramped space.  A rhythmic ticking echoes hypnotically, threatening to send even the most sound-minded visitor into a disoriented trance.  A short maoral table and a long oak table are flush against one wall, while an elm table and a birch table are positioned against an adjacent wall.

title: [My Mummy's Boudoir, Sewing Room]
description: An empty mannequin is propped in the center of this small space, a basket filled with sewing tools at its feet.  The white-washed walls are scribbled with measurements and clothing sketches above a few pillows scattered around the polished rosewood floor.

title: [Halfway Midway, Carousel]
description: The carousel shudders from time to time, no more than the slight shiver of a slow gear or a momentary kink in the mechanics that twirl the massive ride ever onward.  Old carnival posters are stuck to the wooden floor between the slowly bobbing wooden carousel creatures, as well as the center column, their corners ripped and folded, some damaged beyond usefulness.  The glass globes on the lights overhead tink together occasionally, and the sound they create fits right in with the haunting melody of the carousel.

title: [Halfway Midway, Carousel]
description: Like a loose floorboard underfoot, the carousel creaks as it turns as the wooden planks comprising the floor are aged and wobbly after years of swelling and contracting with varying weather conditions.  The floor's red paint is markedly scuffed beside each brass-poled creature, and the painted scenes on the central column have faded to unflattering shades.  Though the ting-twang music is ever constant and the lights overhead cease to fade, the source behind them is anything but obvious.

title: [Accept the Inevitable, Trinkets]
description: Dust and cobwebs are everywhere in here, sitting undisturbed atop piles of crates and cartons.  Off to one side, a small polished maoral counter neatly displays a variety of items for sale.  Behind the counter is a stack of sealed coffers, each marked with a strange series of characters.  An aged but well maintained rug near the exit adds a bit of color to this otherwise drab room.

title: [Accept the Inevitable, Rations]
description: This room is stuffed floor to ceiling with a variety of trunks, chests, and other packages, all sealed and neatly but indecipherably marked.  In the center of the room, two short stacks are topped with some deringo boxes and some rowan crates, all of which are open.  Towards the back of the room, the tall stacks are neatly wrapped in linen.

title: [Halfway Midway, Carousel]
description: A scalloped wooden overhang encloses a dingy white ceiling whorled with gold flourishes accented by hints of color.  From somewhere within the central column of the carousel, a tinny, off-key melody filters into the air, while the column's exterior is decorated with scenes of carnival games, booths, and a variety of fantastical creatures.  Overhead, strings of glass-globed lights span out like spokes from the center of the carousel, shedding an amber light onto the bobbing wooden carousel creatures below.

title: [Darkness, Pit]
description: Large chunks of a stone bridge clutter the ground, as they must have fallen from above where the necropolis was blocked off.  Skeletal remains are piled up high, some still having flesh on the bone.  The rocky walls climb further than the eye can see.

title: [Halfway Midway, Carousel]
description: The heavily pigmented colors of the wooden floor and ceiling overhead retain much of their vibrancy, though it is obvious touch-ups have been applied where the color is ever so slightly off.  The hues add a cheery note to the ride, though buried beneath the light, plucky tune of the carousel music, there is a deeper, more halting sound, like the constant grate of metal on metal.  It is so low that it serves as little more than a background to the melody, a hint of sinister in the otherwise tinny tune.

title: [Within the Snake]
description: Although carved from solid limestone, the walls, floor, and ceiling at the eastern end of the passage resemble the soft curves of the inside of a serpent's mouth.  A pair of crimson fangs curving up from the floor are visible just beyond the archway that forms the gaping maw.

title: [Halfway Midway, Fairway]
description: Small boulders mark the pathway that leads into the area, their grey faces lost beneath yellow-tinged moss and the dust of frequent footsteps.  Where the path's end opens into a clearing, a tall wyrmwood tree stretches upward, and within its branches are small, hollow-reed windchimes that add flat, discordent accents to the out of tune melody from the painted wooden carousel nearby.  A creeping mist silvered by ambient light haunts the ground, and its grey fingers reach into the air as it is stirred by churning breezes.

title: [Clepsydra]
description: Twisting shadows fill the shop's every niche as several dripping candles flicker in the iron sconces that hang on each wall.  Thick velvet draperies cover the windows, blocking out the moonlight and adding to the oppressive feel of the room.  An engraved brass funnel hangs from the ceiling over a large stone bowl that sits adjacent to a nondescript black door.  A shallow copper pan has been placed on the floor near a lined black silk curtain.

title: [The Perfect Picnic, Gallery]
description: Soft layers of green-dyed angora wool cover the bottom half of the shop walls, the fabric pinned by a plethora of vibrant silken blossoms and stalks of grass.  Hanging from the blue-painted ceiling are several thin wires, the metal lengths suspending a large yellow glass orb, as well as fluffy bundles of white rolton fur serving as makeshift clouds.

title: [Western Harbor, Cemetery]
description: Dark shadows, created by the cliff above, lay across the tombstones and markers that line the simple, crushed seashell pathway as it winds its way through the cemetery.  Pale pink and white blossoms litter the ground, strewn haphazardly by the errant sea breezes which have tugged them free of the dogwoods that punctuate the four corners of the tiny lot.

title: [Wehnimer's, Schooner Docks]
description: Narrow bouyed catwalks spider out from the South Wharf, bobbing with the frequency of the waves in Darkstone Bay.  Several two-masted schooners are moored nearby.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Annex, House Phoenix Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A crimson velvet pennant edged in gold hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.
tags: meta:locker annex:House of the Rising Phoenix

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Schooner Docks, Bait Shop]
description: The smell of fish and salty sea air pervades the small building.  Several wooden crates of varying sizes are stacked haphazardly along the back wall near a long counter.  A large barrel holds some of the shop's wares, as well as the robust stench of worms and other bait.  Behind the counter, various goods are stacked upon some long shelves.

title: [Geltrude's Cottage, Playroom]
description: Purple walls display a variety of white-framed child's drawings done in a multitude of mediums.  A white wicker rocking chair rests in the corner beside a small driftwood bed.  The floor is covered with a plush lilac rug and a fine layer of sand.  Bookshelves on one wall hold several children's books and a handful of colorful shell and sea glass knick-knacks, while a copious oak treasure chest overflowing with toys sits beside a purple oak door.

title: [Twilight Hall, Lockers]
description: Several sturdy lockers line the walls here, decorated with elegant golden leafwork and intricate etchings.  Your locker has been removed from the shelf above and sits ready for you on a sturdy counter.

title: [Twilight Hall, Lockers]
description: Several sturdy lockers line the walls here, decorated with elegant golden leafwork and intricate etchings.  Your locker has been removed from the shelf above and sits ready for you on a sturdy counter.

title: [A Weathered Shack]
description: Long modwir shelves lined with various potions, tools, and the unidentifiable remains of plants dominate one side of this relatively large shack.  A simple counter sits near the rear of the room directly in front of a thick wooden door.

title: [Gairen Clearing, Compound]
description: An extensive row of tall sweetbrier hedges provides a delightful natural distraction from the thick briars that lie just on the other side of the encampment enclosure, the shrub's apple-like fragrance wafting faintly through the clearing.  A narrow water-filled trench wends its way through the area, delivering clear blue-green water to adjacent sections in the compound.  Concealed pathways fork off to the northwest and east, the latter direction following alongside the meandering reed-edged waterway.

title: [Gairen, Watering Hole]
description: Pristine blue-green water spills silently from the narrow trench into a sizeable stone-bordered hole, the final destination for the lake-sourced waterway.  Two black bear cubs lap thirstily from the pool while gnomes fill small buckets to take back to their homes, neither group disturbing the other at the hole.  A cluster of small dome-shaped dwellings, skillfully camouflaged with tree branches, leaves, and straw, blend with the natural surroundings such that they are nearly overlooked and unnoticed.

title: [Gairen, Dwelling]
description: Tucked beneath a dense canopy of willow branches and leaves, this small, but cozy dome-shaped dwelling serves as a home for one or two families.  Straw-stuffed cots and petite canvas sacks filled with duck feathers are neatly arranged on one side of this circular room, and a stone stove displays some long-handled copper pots, white steam coiling upward from their boiling contents.  Locked in conversation, a young gnomish couple sits at a simple oak table, oblivious to your presence.

title: [Gairen, Garden]
description: Completely secluded from the activity of the adjacent Lysierian Hills, peace and tranquility have made this robust and thriving garden their home.  Sectioned off into three quadrants, a colorful bed of fruit, vegetables, and flowers, blooms healthily and appears capable of sustaining a well-sized community.  Squat wooden benches rest beneath a magnificent weeping willow tree, the elegant curtains of drooped branches offering shade from the open sky above.

title: [Gairen, Treetop Perch]
description: Glancing outward, the expansive view of Lysierian Hills and Lake Marliese is breathtaking, the area quiet save for the rustling of branches and the occasional chirp of a cricket far off in the distance.  Scattered across the bluish black sky are twinkling constellations, creating slow moving patterns high above the shadowed floor below.  A small wooden perch has been nestled between a few of the sturdier branches, providing the perfect table for a remote, but intimate picnic.

title: [Amethyst Lounge]
description: This cozy lounge is furnished with several comfortable leather couches and matching armchairs, on which are scattered pillows woven of soft silks dyed in the muted amethysts, azures, indigos, and aquamarines of the sea.  A matching carpet softens the red sandstone floor, its dense pile luxuriously resilient underfoot.

title: [Grasslands, Airship Dock]
description: Beyond the wooden platform, the flat fields of the Grasslands extend in all directions.  The wooden palisade walls of Wehnimer's Landing rise up to the northeast, and the high peaks of Melgorehn's Reach cast a long shadow across a nearby lake.  Armored Chastonian soldiers and blue-robed mages patrol around the wooden platform.

title: [Paupers, Cubby]
description: This small antechamber to the locker area is lighted by a simple brass oil lamp.  The walls, crafted from smooth panels of yew wood, are bare of any adornment.  A plain cotton rug muffles your footsteps.

title: [Twilight Hall Annex]
description: The floor, made of unglazed octagonal tiles, is partly covered with a thick carpet.  A window, screened with intricately carved wood, is set high on the wall.  Set beneath the window is a heavy terra cotta urn containing a flowering shrub.

title: [Twilight Hall, Cubby]

description: The hallway floor is warped and uneven.  Ceramic oil lamps hang from the ceiling, bathing the hallway in a flickering light.

Piercing opposite sides are several high-set windows, partially shuttered with teak slats.  Underneath one window is a wide-bellied terra cotta stove with an enameled tea kettle sitting on top.  Alongside the stove is a small woodbox holding kindling and split logs, next to which is a large oak-topped butcher's block.  Haphazardly attached to the walls is a series of warped cupboards.

title: [White Haven, Foyer]
description: The crystalline white walls shed their light upon a dark marble floor, both hues echoed in the marbled arch that separates the foyer from the main tower.  Grand arches stretch across the foyer, one bearing a chiseled inscription.  Next to a long hallway that leads towards the ballroom, a doorless closet holds snow-soaked outer garments and muddy footwear.  A number of lounges provide seating to enjoy the ambiance.

title: [White Haven, Ballroom]
description: Shimmering, frost-covered glass walls enclose this soaring atrium.  Thick woven tapestries adorn the walls, each depicting a frigid wintery scene.  Small tables, each covered with snowflake-patterned lace and set with a gently flickering crystalline candle, are set around the edges of the room.  A large chandelier, draped with lengths of gauzy silk, hangs from the center of the ceiling.  A large stone fireplace surmounts one wall, with a thick polar bear throw lying on the floor in front of it.  Nearby, a glass door leads out into the garden.

title: [White Haven, Founders Hall]
description: A highly polished marble floor dances with reflected light from the shimmering crystal chandelier overhead.  Next to a large open fireplace sits a white basket filled with wood and kindling.  Nearby, several plush chairs and a carved huntboard add comfort and warmth to the huge room.  Covering the north wall is an elegant mural of White Haven's founders.  A sweeping staircase of carved white modwir gently curves as it ascends to the tower's upper floors.

title: [White Haven, Meeting Room]
description: The daunting austerity of this large chamber seems to demand quiet and civility.  A large, golden-edged kite shield bearing the House coat-of-arms is fixed to the wall immediately behind a large silver-grey full moon table surrounded by some high-backed polished leather chairs.  Two rows of long oak benches line the walls.  A polished gold chandelier hangs from the center of the vaulted ceiling which arcs high overhead in a circular dome supported by curved white-washed beams.

title: [White Haven, Stairway Landing]
description: A railing fashioned from crystal, relieved by golden flecks, binds the limits of the landing.  Prisms of light glint off the railing and bestow a colorful warmth to the carved modwir stairway.  Set in the corner is a water clock trimmed with polished metals that patiently marks the hours and minutes of each day.

title: [White Haven, Locker Entrance]
description: The walls are cool and damp.  Only the back of a mural mars the otherwise bleak appearance of the walls.

title: [White Haven, Library]
description: Hundreds of books on any imaginable topic are stored in this vast library.  Overstuffed chairs and a warm fire invite visitors to rest here with a good book, while a large polished haon table gives more studious visitors a spacious area for their research.  Vast windows allow ample light into the room, while providing a breathtaking view of the snowy landscape.

Hundreds of books on any imaginable topic are stored in this vast library.  Overstuffed chairs and a warm fire invite visitors to rest here with a good book, while a large polished haon table gives more studious visitors a spacious area for their research.  Vast windows allow moonlight into the room, while providing a breathtaking view of the snowy landscape.

title: [White Haven, Chapel]
description: A multi-faceted crystal orb appears to float above a small white marble altar in the center of the chapel.  Light radiates from the orb, reflecting off the vines and symbols inscribed upon that altar and filling the room with its soft illumination.

title: [White Haven, Greenhouse]
description: Roses of every color bloom beneath a crystal dome, forming an elegant border for the rows of herbs being tended by a halfling gardener.  Lilies, jasmine and lavender create an ordered riot of pastel around a circular stone path.  In the center of the path stands a bubbling font of pristine melt-water, its quiet sound a peaceful counterpoint to the garden's stillness.

Roses of every color bloom beneath a crystal dome, forming an elegant border for long rows of winterberries being tended by a halfling gardener.  Lilies, jasmine and lavender create an ordered riot of pastel hues around a circular stone path dotted with several white-washed wrought iron tables and matching cushion-padded chairs.  In the center of the path stands a bubbling font of pristine melt-water, its quiet sound a peaceful counterpoint to the garden's stillness.

title: [White Haven, Hot Springs]
description: Warm steam from a sapphire blue pool fills the room.  The cold from outside is blotted from memory as the radiant warmth begins to sink into your bones.  About the pool are lush plants, more suited to a tropical environment, that seem to thrive upon the warmth.  Lily pads float on the surface of the bubbling pool.

Slightly raised flooring of blackened cedar drops down to gemstone mosaic tile surrounding a bubbling pool.  Misty steam fills the air, the radiant warmth sinking into your bones.  Some low, rounded cedar ottomans cluster around a small stone-bordered pond, the lush vibrancy of potted sirenflowers offset by the pale water lilies floating on the pond's surface.

title: [White Haven, Pool]
description: The warm steam that rises from the warm swirling water makes it difficult to see details.  The shapes of the lush plants surrounding the pool fade from view from time to time as yet another cloud of mist forms and floats past.  The water of the pool is warm and comforting as it washes away the aches and pains of the last journey.

A mosaic of lapis and jade fragments tiles the floor in a spiral that elegantly frames the large hot spring, the gemstone design echoed along a burnt cedar bar that juts out from the water's edge.  Finer details of the lush, tropical plants surrounding the bubbling pool fade from view as steam mists into clouds and rises from the swirling, warm water.

title: [White Haven, Xyelin's Room]
description: Bright torches rest in polished gold sconces, casting a warm glow over the entire room.  Wide shelves line the side walls, stuffed with all manner of books along with various scribbled notes and scrolls.  An overstuffed leather couch sits before a large fireplace, giving a cozy place to rest or study.  A small rosewood altar rests before a large tapestry on the rear wall.

title: [White Haven, Hallway]
description: This hallway curves its way further into the house, bending with the architecture of the walls of the tower.  Bright pictures of the local environs grace the walls and dark modwir sidetables stand beside the various doorways.  Upon each table is a crystal budvase, holding a single perfect white rose.  A dark blue carpet quiets the footsteps of the occasional passerby.  Smells of baking a food waft through the air from a pair of carved haon double-doors.

title: [White Haven, Banquet Hall]
description: A long black walnut table dominates this hall and is surrounded by matching chairs, each engraved with twining vines along the back.  A sideboard of similar decor provides convenient storage for serving dishes, while a few tables of a more private nature are located near the back of the room.  White arabesque winds across the ceiling, the pattern centering on a twining gold chandelier.
