title: [White Haven, Kitchen]
description: Red brick ovens line the back wall of this enormous kitchen, permeating heat and succulent smells throughout the air.  A pair of short halfling cooks, both covered in flour and dressed in tall white hats and aprons, bustle about the area intently focused on their work.  A long white marble counter covered in pots, pans, and various utensils stretches through the center of the room, next to which is a vine-carved cherrywood pantry veined with icy blue glaes.

title: [White Haven, Music Room]
description: Even the heaviest steps fade to silence upon the plush silvery carpet that stretches from one wall to the other in this room.  Several small instruments are arranged on low tables, while comfortable chairs are scattered about for the comfort of listener and performer alike.  A wide window displays a clear view of the White Haven courtyard.

title: [White Haven, Guest Room]
description: Bright, delicate blossoms weave a living tapestry between small potted trees.  Between intricately embroidered silk screens rests a featherbed draped with spidersilk netting.  A beveled window frames a view of the courtyard.

title: [White Haven, Curiosity Room]
description: Scattered about the room are antiques, curiosities and knick-knacks from all corners of Elanthia.  Prominently displayed are a humidor, an oddly shaped tart and a picture framed by hardened vines.  A pitohui bird perches in a mithril cage suspended from the ceiling, keeping watch.

title: [White Haven, Guest Room]
description: Stone water nymphs seem to dance in a small pool fed by a miniature waterfall by the west wall.  Greenhouse-grown palm fronds frame the pool, resting on a thick carpet the color of grass.  A white iron bed and fan-backed rattan chairs blend into the scene, set beside a stone fireplace that is the only reminder of the chill temperatures beyond the walls of this cozy room.

title: [White Haven, Lounge]
description: The domed ceiling of this room is composed of transparent crystal, revealing the secrets and glory of the sky above.  Beamed supports brushed with gold leaf are fashioned to reflect the light rather than obstruct it, and darkly upholstered chairs offer a place to relax and observe.  Towards the back of the room is a snack-laden bar, in front of which is a row of padded silver bar stools, and a shelf with a trio of hand-painted mugs.

title: [White Haven, Upper Landing]
description: A wide hall carpeted in blue is brightened by small tables bearing fresh flowers and small carvings.  Four modwir doors painted yellow, blue, white and black line the walls.

title: [White Haven, Pacioli's Room]
description: Rich black walnut paneling and careful molding give this room a sense of luxury.  Light from a fish oil lamp shines upon a desk covered with runes and piled with books.  Built into the wall behind the desk are massive shelves holding hundreds of volumes covering all aspects of magic.  A white puma rug lays in front of a corner fireplace and hand tooled leather chairs are placed against the wall near a fireplace.  In an alcove is a humble bed which seems out of place amid the other luxurious furnis

Rich black walnut paneling and careful molding give this room a sense of luxury.  Light from a fish oil lamp shines upon a desk covered with runes and piled with books.  Built into the wall behind the desk are massive shelves holding hundreds of volumes covering all aspects of magic.  A white puma rug lays in front of a corner fireplace and hand tooled leather chairs are placed against the wall near a fireplace.  In an alcove is a humble bed which seems out of place amid the other furnishings.

title: [White Haven, Midorrii's Room]
description: A lustrous teak floor reflects the glow from the many candles flickering softly around the room, revealing the furnishings.  A large overstuffed leather chair and a white chaise lounge provide comfortable seating arrangement, while a large wrought iron bed piled high with quilts and comforters dominates one wall.  Another contains a built-in bookshelf filled with volumes on magic alongside lighter fare.  Above the bed is a stained glass window in a fleur-de-lis pattern.

title: [White Haven, Llyleth's Room]
description: Crystal walls act as a prism for light reflected from candles attached to the rounded walls of this room.  Light from the fireplace illuminates a bed that has been fashioned from a single tree, while the smaller branches are expertly bent and woven to fashion tables, chairs and the frame of a mirror.

title: [White Haven, Gwendolyne's Room]
description: The light shining through crystalline windows brightens an already cheerfully decorated room.  A comfortable over-stuffed loveseat beckons invitingly from a corner, near a small fireplace against the wall.  A woolly thrak hide rug lies in front of the fireplace and a pair of empty wineglasses stand nearby.  A fine portrait rests upon the mantle.

title: [White Haven, West Upper Landing]
description: The hallway comes to an end, the gold-flecked walls broken by a modwir door and an oak door along one wall, and a fel door on the other.  A small table bearing an elaborate flower arrangement decorates the third.

title: [White Haven, Sigurd's Room]
description: Several small braziers provide both warmth and light for this small, tidy room.  A variety of richly appointed tapestries adorn the walls, while plush pillows and throw rugs are scattered along the floor.  A pair of nautical flags is displayed upon one wall, while a clothed scarecrow and several chests occupy the room's corners.

title: [White Haven, Tivas's Room]
description: Several well-placed lanterns provide light for this spacious but simple chamber.  A simmering pot of aromatic mint leaves, fresh from the greenhouse, sits on a wood-burning stove.  Across the room a meticulously clothed daybed sits against a wall, opposite a modwir-framed painting.  Beneath the painting is a silver plaque.

title: [White Haven, Everan's Room]
description: Carved modwir paneling covers every wall of this luxurious chamber.  A thick white rug made from what must have been an enormous polar bear lies stretched between a small fireplace and an exquisite fruitwood sleigh bed.  One wall is dominated by a stunning tapestry stretched on an eonake frame.  In a quiet alcove sits a kneeler placed below a small relief of a thin blonde woman with an alabaster face.  From the side of her black and white robes hang a ring of keys.

title: [White Haven, Lockers]
description: A small oil lamp provides a bright light as it reflects from the walls.  Your arrival was anticipated, as someone has placed your locker on top of the counter for you.

title: [Twilight Tower, Courtyard]
description: You find yourself in a walled courtyard of an ornate stone tower.  Despite the lack of vegetation, the area is cozy, with rock formations carved into likenesses of bushes and trees.  The stony flora and walls provide much needed shade and shelter from the constantly blowing wind.  A red cinder rock walkway winds its way to a portcullis, through which you see a long, circular stairway leading up to the top of the tower.

You find yourself in a walled courtyard of an ornate stone tower.  Despite the lack of vegetation, the area is cozy, with rock formations carved into likenesses of bushes and trees.  The stony flora and walls provide much needed shelter from the constantly blowing wind.  A red cinder rock walkway winds its way to a portcullis, through which you see a long, circular stairway leading up to the top of the tower.

title: [Twilight Tower, Observatory]
description: The long circular stairwell leads to a large sitting room with a polished red stone floor shot with white jagged streaks.  A lacquered cherrywood bar is in the center of the room surrounded by plush white velvet benches, while similar coral red benches lining the edge of the room provide comfortable observation of the sprawling scenery out the large glaes windows.

title: [Twilight Tower, Subterranean]
description: At the lower landing of the longer of the tower's two intertwined spiraling stairwells is a large underground chamber.  Two sides of the chamber are composed of bedrock, while a glaes dome encloses the area from the remaining expansive cavern and the intense river of magma flowing nearby.  Light shimmers through the dome and reflects off of massive minerals embedded in the cavern walls.  A reflective black basalt altar joins the wall beneath some ancient runes, across from the stair and next to a stalagmite.

title: [Amethyst Lounge, Cubbyhole]
description: This narrow, cramped space ends abruptly at a curtain.

title: [Green Table]
description: Darkened with wood dye, the plank table is surrounded by polished benches.  Wrought iron monkeys dangle from the sea thrak bone ceiling supports, while tiny topaz bananas are sewn into the oilcloth and canvas panels.  A lantern, carved into the shape of a tree house, is set upon the far end of the table and fitted with tiny colored glass windows that cast a prismatic spray of light everytime the candles within flicker.

title: [Masters' Hall, South]
description: Overstuffed armchairs, upholstered with painted silk, and a matching settee form a conversation area in the corner of the room.  Set well off the rug, chairs surrounded by the accoutrements of weapon, shield and armor care, offer a place to repair items in comfort.  Aligned on the south wall, a buffet table frames one side of a vaulted archway that opens on to the entry hall.  The great rug on the hardwood floor muffles footfalls, and the atmosphere lends itself to a temporary respite from outside troubles.

title: [Masters' Hall, North]
description: Directly in front of a needlepoint tapestry, a large crystal globe is suspended from a strong silver chain.  Built in bookshelves of darkly stained ash line the walls, broken only to allow passage in and out of the room.  A long burled walnut table sits squarely in the center of the room with several high-backed ladder chairs around it.  At the head of the table is a more ornate chair which boasts scrollwork arms and a carving of a shield in the top slat of its back.

title: [Alchemist's House, Laboratory]
description: The stench of brimstone and sting of ozone hang heavy in the air of the laboratory.  A boiling alembic giving off noxious fumes sits over a brazier on a stained, deal-topped lab table.  Around the equipment are unstoppered vials of brightly colored substances.  It appears the alchemist was called away in mid-experiment.

title: [Onoir, Garden of Faith]
description: A small brook winds its way through this tranquil garden, its babbling chorus enhanced where it empties into a clear pond.  A miniature dock reaches out into the water, while climbing vines and ivies ramble over rock walls.  Central to the garden is a simple shrine, an unadorned block of black marble, residing on a moonlit court of polished flagstones.  An offering of wildflowers sits at the base of the block, and tall willows shade a long stone bench nearby.

title: [Onoir, Hall of Fellowship]
description: Smooth granite walls rise from a stone-tiled floor to a concave gilt ceiling far overhead.  A gargantuan tiered stone dais supports a massive white marble table in the center of the chamber.  Empty suits of full plate armor, each wielding a sword-shaped crystalline lantern, stoically stand guard in each corner, facing the dais.  The north wall bears an elaborate fresco of both muted and vibrant colors, and the walls to the east and west are decorated with long tapestries depicting acts of virtue.

title: [Table of Peers]
description: The smooth surface of the round table contrasts with the detailed, filigreed carvings along its circumference.  A depression in the table's center is filled with wax and supports several thick black wicks arranged in a circle.  A small marble sound block rests on the table, near one of the surrounding modwir chairs, and a quill, inkwell, and sheaf of parchment are placed in front of another.  Under the table are some short three-legged stools and a large modwir case.

title: [Onoir, Magical Workshop]
description: Bobbing overhead, brilliant glowing orbs illuminate the interior of this formidable room.  From the solid granite walls to the polished marble floors, the entire room boasts an incredibly sturdy architecture.  Two rows of shelves ring the perimeter of the room at mid-height, and solid iron hooks bearing large rhimar buckets have been secured on each side of the thick veil iron-bound mistwood door.  A bold sign is poised above the hooks.

title: [Onoir, Library]
description: Warm light illuminates the dark modwir bookshelves lining the walls of this inviting room.  Parchments and books of all shapes and sizes pack the shelves, while a dog-eared journal and an aged vellum scroll lie open on a low wooden table.  Cozy velnalin hide chairs rest beside a sturdy wheeled ladder that provides access to the topmost volumes.

title: [Onoir, Kitchen]
description: Cooks and apprentices dash around in a frenzy of activity, creating a tumultuous chorus with iron pots and pans, while scullery maids attend to the used cookware.  Steady shouts from one of the cooks punctuate the organized chaos, while assistants stoke the wood-burning stoves, and the wait staff gathers the final products of the frantic pace for delivery to the tavern.

title: [Onoir, Paladin's Pub]
description: Muted lighting from small barred windows inside the tavern adds ambience and illumination to the bottles stored behind a brass-trimmed felwood bar and a triple-tiered brass serving cart that sits nearby in one corner.  Waitresses pass sets of plush high-backed chairs placed around small round tables scattered throughout the room, as they carry trays of food and drinks back and forth through the teakwood swinging doors that lead to the kitchen.

title: [Twisting Tunnels]
description: A maze of tunnels leads away from this small chamber in all directions.  The low ceiling, poor lighting, and sudden twists and turns make it impossible to see far enough in any direction to get your bearings.  Some passageways lead only a few feet and dead end, while others twist and turn in odd directions before opening into another chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southwest, west, down

description: The terrain here is little more than a jumble of huge boulders and jagged rocks.  Everywhere you look, everything looks the same.

title: [Two-headed Thrak Table]
description: Oddly, the chairs at this section of the long table have no arms to them, making them appear smaller than they really are.  A single ivory die seems to be stuck in a knot hole on the table top, right between the two heads of the double-headed thrak painted there.

title: [Kaedra's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: A tall cedar tree stands in the center of a patch of leafy ferns.  Dotted among the plants are several types of colorful flowers that seem to attract honey bees, as several of them dart among the blossoms.  A section of the ferns has been trampled to form a thin trail that winds its way toward the center of the circle of trees.

A tall cedar tree stands in the center of a patch of leafy ferns.  Dotted among the plants are several types of colorful flowers that have closed their petals and bowed their heads.  A section of the ferns has been trampled to form a thin trail that winds its way toward the center of the circle of trees.

title: [Kaedra's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Highguard Keep, Landing]
description: Torches illuminate a row of suits of full plate armor that stand like sentinels along the landing.  To the west, a series of narrow mullioned bay windows that enclose a polished oak bench offer an expansive view of the remote trail that connects Wehnimer's Landing and Icemule Trace.  A few sheets of parchment and a scattering of mithril figures, arrayed for battle atop a painted map, rest upon a narrow table at one end of the landing.  A bookcase stands nearby, filled with leather-bound volumes and additional maps.
location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Highguard Keep, Great Hall]
description: Large enough to swallow a modest inn whole, the great hall is clearly the heart of the castle.  Braziers and a massive fieldstone hearth provide just enough light to reveal exposed ironwood beams high above the bearskin rugs and leather chairs scattered throughout the chamber.  Tapestries depicting scenes of battles and hunts add color to stone walls.  Pine boughs arranged on a T-shaped table that could seat a small army combine their fragrance with the pungent aromas of ale and roasted meats.  A grey granite throne inlaid with ironwood rises amidst a menagerie of trophy heads.
location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Highguard Keep, Rooftop]
description: Crenellated granite walls provide protection for archers, but offer little defense against the ever-present northern winds at this altitude.  From this vantage point, the lights of surrounding lodges and townships become tiny constellations mirroring the ones above you.  Though now home only to a pair of snowy owls that have built a nest in the lee of one wall, a discarded ballista bolt suggests the roof recently held weapons of war.  A tall flagpole stands firmly in the ironwood planking.
location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Highguard Keep, Bedchamber]
description: High ceilings and smooth, plaster-coated stone walls give this large room a surprisingly airy feel.  A smaller version of the fieldstone fireplace in the hall below keeps the bedchamber comfortable, as a north-facing window is shuttered tightly against the evening's chill.  Although a rough-hewn oak bed lavishly draped with furs dominates the room, a free-standing grindstone and a well-stocked weapons rack draw attention near the window.  Two small tables guard the bed, while an enormous mithril vault is built into the opposing wall.
location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Highguard Keep, Courtyard]
description: Constant activity in this spacious bailey keeps the swirling snow from blanketing the cobbled courtyard.  Wooden stables and storerooms cling to the perimeter walls, but the grey granite exterior of the compound's towering inner keep is bare except for an incised cornerstone.  Crenellated battlements top the keep, overhanging the steep structure like a beetled brow, and obscuring the stars behind them.  Tucked into a protected corner near the northern stables is a small fountain.  To the south, a snow-dusted marble statue presides over a row of archery butts.
location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Highguard Keep, Buttery]
description: This storage space is so packed with food that builders have added a wooden loft to hold the excess.  Cheese wheels, wine casks, salted meats, and barrels of vegetables would surely be enough to withstand a months-long siege, yet the freshness of the food suggests it's just the weekly supply.  Round wooden covers conceal a pair of brick-lined chambers dug into the frosty soil where perishables can be kept cold.
location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Jeril's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A narrow glass-topped table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Jeril's Weaponry]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the dark oak walls, and an oak beam ceiling rises overhead.  A bathing maiden statue sits in one corner of a russet oak floor.  There is a lacquered wooden shelf on one side of the shop and a narrow glass-topped table on the other.

title: [Jeril's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A narrow glass-topped table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Talondown Arena, Entry]
description: Despite its humble entrance between two stacks of crates, the arena's antechamber thrives with frenetic activity.  Champions push and shove each other for a glimpse of the latest information on a painted wooden leaderboard while seedy lenders prey on those recently divorced from their hard-earned marks.  All of this occurs beneath the low roof formed by the deck above, in an atmosphere tainted by the smoke of cigars and pleasure herbs.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Uneven slabs of dirt and ice float precariously down a twisting, crescent-shaped river of lava.  The chunks of rock remain intact, merely blackened as flames and fire lick their edges, but the slabs of ice form fast and evaporate just as quickly, releasing a torrent of steam and smoke in their hastened demise.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The ground rises in a sharp ascent as layers of mud and rock continuously shift upward, twisting and narrowing to form a wide-mouthed clay funnel.  From the brim of the ever-expanding cone spews forth blasts of fiery red lava, which spills down over the edges and pollutes the sky with heavy black clouds of smoke.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Giant swathes of serrated rock roll across the landscape like the waves of a tumultuous ocean, ascending high and then cascading down in a constant ripple of instability.  The sky itself is filled with nebulous pale green clouds, each one illuminated by spheres of cracking yellow energy within.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A fiery red-gold glaze is masterfully painted across the sky, the unnatural incarnadine clouds floating overhead looking like sinew and blood.  Spindles of fire twist and churn, spiraling down to burn across the ground, leaving long and winding tracks of scorch marks.  An amber haze drifts through the area, scattered to and fro by warm winds.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The ground is as black as obsidian, scorched and hardened over countless ages of intense heat.  A shimmering bend in the air stretches across the sky a few hundred feet off the ground, where smooth, thin plates of ice float along the horizon like slender frozen clouds.  Thin wisps of steam rise and fall along the edges of the flickering curve in the air.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A huge earthen monolith rises in the distance, jutting up from the ground to form a jagged cone of rock.  From the mountain's edges, huge boulders constantly tumble, slowly forming piles of scattered stones before they are swallowed up by fissures forming periodically along the ground.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Great nebulous clouds encompass the sky, each one's billowing black surface charged with dozens of arcing bolts of bluish-white lightning.  Enormous pieces of frozen rock fall from within the murky depths of the clouds, each time sending a shockwave of tremors along the ground upon impact.   Vein-like streams of water curve along the patchy ground, winding off into the distance.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The sky is a kaleidoscope of dark copper and bronze hues as a colossal fissure of fire churns among blackened clouds like a giant maw filled with flames.  Globules of lava descend from the red maelstrom, scorching the ground upon impact and smothering the landscape in coils of incandescent vapors.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The air is thick with soot and ash and the sky is nearly as black as a starless night, only periodically broken up by flashes of crimson fire streaking above.  Rocks can be heard colliding and breaking apart in the distance and tremors rumble faintly underfoot.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Reddish orange flames dot the horizon like a writhing fall of fire, a stark contrast to the huge ice-covered mountain that dominates a majority of the area here.  A bone-chilling wind rushes across the landscape, tossing loose pebbles about as it swirls past.  Occasionally, mammoth icicles break off from ridges along the arctic mountain, crashing and shattering on the ground below.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A giant lake opens up in the center of the area, one side of it being fed by streams of water flowing down from a cavernous mountain while the other side is filled by tubes of lava winding down from another jagged mountainous range.  The odd mixture of elements inside of the lake has created a huge cloud of steam that hangs low in the air as the contrasting forces collide.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Mammoth, twisting stalagmites mark the ground in a myriad of different sizes as if the surface was covered in toothed shards of earthen glass.  Small brown cyclones twist through the area in between the rocky pillars, lifting and depositing debris and dirt as they travel.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The sky is aglow with the heat and light from a giant raging inferno that rises above the peaks of a rocky mountain range.  Ribbons of orange, red, purple, and yellow hues that stretch across the distance are reminiscent of a sunset, albeit an eerie and unnatural one.  Heavy shadows are thrown across the craggy hills and rutted ground as the fiery radiance seems to be slowly expanding.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Great pits of lava spread out over the desolate landscape like a thousand burning red eyes of a great demon.  Scorching hot vapors coil up from the fiery quarries, billowing up into the sky to create a thick opaque blanket of smoke.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A steady downpour of stinging rain soaks the fragmented dirt and casts a thick veil of mist and fog that hangs low to the ground.  Enormous boulders decorate the soaked backdrop, their forms primarily obscured by the constant deluge from above.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Thunder echoes across the sky, not unlike the loud bellow of a wrathful god.  Small mounds of dirt are scattered along the ground, their jagged mouths emitting wild sprays of fire and lava, which fill the air with glowing hot embers.  Narrow bolts of blue, white, and greenish-yellow lightning dance along the horizon, releasing a surge of crackling energy with each strike.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The energy in the air is electric, with tiny bolts of white and yellow lightning dancing through the sky like the spindly legs of a thousand spiders.  The ground is a wide expanse of broken greyish-brown dirt, where tiny pebbles and stones float haphazardly above the surface.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The ground here is more spherical than flat, its surface littered with dozens of rugged craters.   Each earthen hollow brims with steam and iridescent reddish-orange fog.  An overpowering heat clings to the air, suffocating it while sending waves of shimmering energy across the sky.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Convulsing globules of fire and lava bleed down from the sky, bathing the area in a ruddy crimson glow while igniting the ground all around.  Thick clouds of steam roll across the blasted and uneven dirt, shrouding the area in a perpetual blanket of scorching fog.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Gargantuan spires of ice-covered rock jut up from the ground and their peaks disappear among rolling patches of purplish-black clouds.  Along the edges of the immense earthen pinnacles are thousands of icy bristles, branching out like the malformed vertebrae of an ancient demon.  A deep, chilling cold clings to the air.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Fire and ash mix in the crimson sky in a dark, suffocating cloud that blankets the horizon.  Slivers of fiery liquid occasionally drop down from overhead, falling like a faint shower of burning embers.  The glowing sparks throw countless tiny shadows along the ground.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The landscape is hidden beneath inches of sloshing water, sparsely broken up by earthen spikes and icy platforms that litter the surface.  The sky is an unbridled mesh of hues, ranging from dark blue to pale green as currents of energy ripple about.  Tiny flakes of snow descend from above, tossed about like glistening white feathers.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A narrow strip of land extends across a lake of gurgling lava, forming a treacherous bridge.  The low clouds glow with a sanguine hue as they reflect the molten rock.  Anvil lightning lights the clouds with bright flashes of orange before traveling straight down to strike the lake, sending lava splashing high into the air.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Tornadic winds bolster fluctuating conditions, with temperatures shifting drastically from freezing to scorching in a matter of seconds.  Statically charged meteors shoot across the sky, jagged white lights trailing in their wake.  Resounding booms of unknown origin create a slow wave of ripples across the unstable ground.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The ever-changing landscape ahead morphs from solid rock into a gushing torrent, the water just as suddenly evaporating into a monstrous spray of dense steam.  Fire bolts relentlessly pummel the surroundings, marring the ground with sunken craters that fling earthen debris into the wind.  Unstable columnar rotations are relentlessly dispatched from a cluster of low-hanging leaden grey clouds overhead.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Pebble-sized hailstones drop from puffy azure-grey clouds in a continuous deluge.  Icy piles of bluish white hail create a shifting maze across the landscape as fluctuating temperatures melt and refreeze the hilly formations.  Intermittent gusts tear through the accumulations, snatching up bits of ice that are then deposited on nearby piles.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Sizzling tongues of glowing red-orange fire unfold mid-air, feverishly licking at a half-melted wall of opaque white ice.  Deeply grooved furrows in the stony expanse drain the constant influx of water away from the glacial mass, disappearing down slivered zigzagging fractures in the terrain.  Intermittently, harsh winds rake over the land and cast the spindrift back into the ice mass with a muted whipping sound.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The earth repeatedly rolls itself into a series of mesas that rise to impressive heights before dissolving into nothing more than rubble.  Wave after wave of fiery golden flame blazes through the dry, scorched grass underfoot, the inferno ultimately dying in a raucously boiling lake with a high-pitched fizzle.  A sequence of electrical popping noises spike the air, overshadowed periodically by bouts of tempestuous thunder.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Heavy and oppressive, the air is as thick as mud and nearly as suffocating.  A nearby volcanic event illuminates the area in a brilliant mixture of deep scarlet and orange, with brief flashes of intense yellow.  Unusual geometric shapes of orange-brown earth protrude from the ground, their designs carved by the divergent weather conditions.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Shades of blue, indigo, and violet churn above in a vast nebula, while the pockmarked ground suffers a steady bombardment of hail.  Fierce winds gust relentlessly, driving the balls of ice into every surface with implacable force.  The air holds a frigid mist of slivers from shattered hailstones.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The endless transformation of the outlying territory is incredible to behold as land, lava, and sea materialize in and out of existence, warring with each other for superiority over the area.  One long clefted ridge of burnished obsidian remains untouched by the chaos and stretches farther than the eye can see.  Tucked below in its shadow, a barren valley runs the length of the imposing formation and is cloaked in an ethereal silver fog.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A swirling dark grey cloud churns across the open sky, its tumultuous flow producing violent shifts in air pressure.  Coin-sized balls of cloudy white hail intermittently pelt the heated earth and sizzle on impact, thin tendrils of steam rising from the ground at each landing spot.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The air is unnaturally still and crackles with intense bursts of electricity.  Luminous arcs of gold, violet, and azure traverse the sky like a bridge, wavering briefly before disappearing.  Pools of bubbling water appear along the rocky ground and then drain into the earth with a deep gurgling sound.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Grey and black clouds churn above, colliding against one another with rumbling crashes.  A network of lithic needles juts out of the ground like the teeth of a subterranean beast.  Winding among the protrusions, a jagged crack belches forth bursts of steam that rise to merge with the clouds overhead.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Fog swirls about the landscape, licking at the ground's rocky surface.  Intermittent flashes of light create an illusory effect as they reflect off the thick haze.  Loud explosions reverberate from all directions, furthering the area's disorienting nature.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A striking violet backdrop emerges from behind the storm-laden dark clouds that seethe above like a roiling nimbus sea.  The intense scent of ozone pervades the air, unmoved by the sharp fluctuations in wind direction.  Expanding violently across the sky, the unwieldy haze shifts and swirls, now and then erupting with slender forks of silver-white lightning.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Tiny pebbles are sucked into small cyclones and spit out as deadly projectiles, many nearby rock formations full of deep grooves as a result of constant and unrelenting pelting.  Irregular patches of ice blanket the ground, making advancement dangerous.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Towering formations of hardened molten rock dominate the horizon and canvas the ground in ominously unmoving shadows.  Steam spews from deep cracks embedded along the rocky ebon spires, releasing a silvery mist into the atmosphere with a distracting hiss.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Fire and ice battle for dominance as numbing gusts battle with sweltering temperatures from opposite directions.  As the winds whip through the area, a fine layer of frost forms along the ground but succumbs to the prevailing heat, leaving scattered puddles evaporating swiftly into the atmosphere.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A full panorama of the elemental destruction is laid out below the lofty aerial point situated atop a high peak.  The devastating geological carnage is in a continual state of changeover and metamorphosis, painting a variegated portrait of the battling raw, natural forces.  To the other side, oppressive waves of rippling fire course through a hidden vale, burning away the corporeal until nothing is left but ash.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The ground slopes sharply downward as a constant flow of mud erodes its surface.  At the bottom of the hill, a lake of bubbling mud is blanketed by a noxious miasma.  A spire of metamorphic rock rises from its center, accusingly pointed skyward.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Lining the mouth of a vast cave, raggedly formed stalagmites and stalactites lend the foreboding appearance of a feral animal baring a set of wickedly sharp teeth.  A thick, cinereous fog lurks at the base of the inlet, drifting its way toward a pocket of hole-riddled topography emiting shadowy steam from its depressions.  Tangible pressure builds in the atmosphere, unleashing rivulets of electricity that hiss and snap like an enraged serpent.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Reverberating from beneath the ground like the cry of war drums, rampant vibrations cause the sod below to quake and tremble with powerful force.  Unstable as it is, the terrain is regularly pried apart to reveal gullies and ravines brimming with scalding lava or solid ice, only to reform moments later without a trace of the disturbances left behind.  In the distance, colossal amalgams of hailstone and sleet plummet from the heavens, intensely crashing into an undulating lake of copper-red fire.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: The terrain is a thick quagmire of mud and crushed rock.  Bubbles rise to the surface with wet gurgles, sending malodorous vapor into the air.  Fiery jets shoot up from the depths of the muck, occasionally igniting the vapor with sickly virescent sparks.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A gritty brume blankets the ground, choking the landscape with particles of dust and crushed rock.  Twisting brown cyclones dance across the horizon in paths both erratic and unpredictable, cutting fresh wounds into the already scarred land.  Dividing the terrain is a deep but narrow chasm.  Molton rock drips over its sheer walls to a flowing river of lava far below, setting the strata ablaze in hues of crimson, gold, and bronze.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A melange of roots and soil are brutally ripped from the ground by gusting vehement winds, soaking the dirt-choked air with the unusually balmy aromas of wet clay and loam.  Sloping away from the area, a deep cleft in the land yields to a broad crevasse alive with a gurgling mudflow.  Seemingly swallowing the entire environment with a deafening buzz, crackling flares of high-charged energy wail against the highland.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Protrusions of craggy rock arise from gurgling lakes of lava.  The surrounding terrain is composed of flat rock penninsulas that extend into the fiery pools, their surfaces cracked in glowing red fractals.  Overhead, billowing clouds trap the heat like a smothering blanket.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Vibrations undulate through the ground, the charged pulses tearing up dirt and rock and crushing entire swathes of boulders as it travels outward in all directions.  Moments later the ground reforms, healing itself as giant stones claw back up to the surface, only to collapse again beneath each additional wave of crippling energy.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: A naturally formed bridge of rock and hardened dirt stretches out over a shadowy pit with no light escaping its depths.  Thick layers of frost cover the earthen bridge, leaving behind clusters of sharp icicles and entire strips of sleet.  The air is abnormally cold.  Tiny beads of moisture intermittently freeze in the atmosphere, then fall to the ground with a tattoo of percussive pops.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Dirt and stone shift chaotically here, the ground climbing and dipping like a banner flapping in a strong wind.  As the earthen ground is torn asunder, great plumes of smoke and steam briefly rise up in its wake, before once again being covered by rock and land.  A resounding thunderclap reverberates across the sky, the brief glow of yellow lightning flashing beyond toothy mountainous peaks.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Enormous columns of fire billow up from the ground in huge pillars of churning flames.  They bend and twist like fiery cyclones, their existence in a constant state of movement.  Each burning pylon grasps up at the sky, resembling colossal red fingers trying to scorch the heavens.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Frozen veins of lava weave across the ground like latticework, small threads of smoke still coiling up along their surface.  Clusters of icy crystal have formed along the edges of a circle of oval stones, motes of cerulean light fluttering about them like blue will-o'-wisps.  Heavy grey clouds swell overheard, occasionally releasing showers of fist-sized hailstones.

title: [Elemental Confluence]
description: Murky clouds bleed across the heavens like the tattered wings of a black drake.  Their amorphous surfaces crackle with energy as bolts of iridescent lightning streak down, tearing away rock and dirt with every powerful blast.  The ground trembles and hums relentlessly like the persistent beating of a heart.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel ends abruptly at a jagged wall that rises up to a stone ceiling.  Cobwebs shimmer from the light of a nearby torch, which also dimly illuminates a stained steel ladder leading up.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel twists to the north here, and then bends left and right, each passage disappearing into the darkness.  A few broken wooden arrow shafts litter the ground.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel ends abruptly at a jagged wall that rises up to a stone ceiling.  Cobwebs shimmer from the light of a nearby torch, which also dimly illuminates a stained steel ladder leading up.

title: [Alpine Forest, Clearing]
description: A perfectly round clearing is shielded from falling snow by a thick canopy of pine branches overhead.  A lone tree stump sits in the middle of the area, in front of a long black granite table.  Shielding the bottom of the tree trunks from view are two half-circles of thorny hedges, broken only by the entrance to the clearing and by a towering spiked gate.

	if line =~ /^You remove .+heavy iron key<\/a> from in your <a exist="(.+)"/
		container = $1
		break
	elsif line =~ /^Get what\?$/

		break
	end
end
status_tags
if container
	fput "unlock spiked gate with my heavy key"
	fput "put my heavy key in ##{container}"
	move "go spiked gate"
else
	echo "** You do not have the key! **"
	echo "You will have to do the puzzle on the table!"
	exit
end

title: [Alpine Forest, Rocky Trail]
description: A wide circle of rock is covered in ruts from wagon wheels, the most prominent trail leading to the closed door of a large carriage house.  Across the circle and opposite the gate, the trail meanders in northeast through the trees.

title: [Carriage House]
description: A smashed, splintered, and slightly burned carriage sits in the middle of the enclosed space.  A single wheel is left intact and leans against the western wall.  A tattered piece of paper, singed around the edges, is still nailed to the inside of the door.

title: [Rocky Trail]
description: The trail begins to curve around a large rock outcropping that rises taller than the tops of the trees.  Gravel crunches underfoot and the wind continues to howl high overhead.

title: [Rocky Trail]
description: A wide crevice splits the large rock formation midway down to the forest floor.  The trail narrows and turns sharply along the rock, and it becomes difficult to see what lies around the bend.

title: [Rocky Trail]
description: A sharp rise in temperature is welcome as the trail continues to hug the rock for a few paces, then curves again to head north.  The trees begin to thin, and the incline rises steadily underfoot.

title: [Rocky Trail, Orchard]
description: Away from the tall conifers of the surrounding forest, the temperature is comfortable and the air carries the heady scent of ripe fruit.  In the middle of a group of thriving saplings is a massive tree, its branches heavy with gleaming red clusters of apples.

title: [Rocky Trail, Incline]
description: The trail continues its sharp slope, and the loose rocks are slippery underfoot.  The surrounding air is almost balmy, and the trees and bushes on either side of the trail look more manicured than wild.

title: [Rocky Trail, Crabapple Grove]
description: The trail suddenly disappears into a maze of crabapple trees.  The sharp, sour scent of the tiny fruit fills the air, and the swaying braches make it hard to see very far ahead.

title: [Crabapple Grove]
description: The trail suddenly disappears into a maze of crabapple trees.  The sharp, sour scent of the tiny fruit fills the air, and the swaying braches make it hard to see very far ahead.

title: [Crabapple Grove]
description: The trail suddenly disappears into a maze of crabapple trees.  The sharp, sour scent of the tiny fruit fills the air, and the swaying braches make it hard to see very far ahead.

title: [Sheer Cliff]
description: Several yards away from the last of the crabapple trees is the base of a grey granite cliff that climbs high into the sky.  The face is not completely smooth, as several outcroppings that could serve as anchor points for hands or feet are visible.

title: [Mountainside, Cliff's Edge]
description: A dizzying drop to the crabapple orchards below is just a few paces away.  The areas at a lower elevation are obscured by clouds ringing the mountain, and not even the tallest tree breaks through the dense grey wreath.

title: [Mountainside, Cliff's Edge]
description: A dizzying drop to the crabapple orchards below is just a few paces away.  The areas at a lower elevation are obscured by clouds ringing the mountain, and not even the tallest tree breaks through the dense grey wreath.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, down

title: [Mountainside, Cliff's Edge]
description: A dizzying drop to the crabapple orchards below is just a few paces away.  The areas at a lower elevation are obscured by clouds ringing the mountain, and not even the tallest tree breaks through the dense grey wreath.

title: [Mountain Top, Cliff Trail]
description: A short trail, lined on either side by a short flowering shrubs, leads away from the cliff's edge and towards a short black willow gate.

title: [Mountain Top, Outer Courtyard]
description: A safe distance from the sheer drop of the cliff is a peaceful courtyard enclosed by manicured shrubs and trailing willow trees.  In the middle of the haven, spring water burbles out of the ground and flows into a flagstone pool that is filled with sleek blue fish.  Opposite the entry gate, a break in the outer ring of shrubs marks the start of a trail that is lined on either side with multicolored wildflowers.

title: [Mountain Top, Wide Path]
description: Open to the sky above, the wildflowers that line the path sway gently in the breeze.  Something large looms in the distance.

title: [Mountain Top, Wide Path]
description: Open to the sky above, the wildflowers that line the path sway gently in the breeze.  A large grey structure can be seen in the distance.

title: [Mountain Top, Wide Path]
description: Open to the sky above, the wildflowers that line the path sway gently in the breeze.  Tall grey walls enclose a massive grey structure, hiding the majority of the building from view.

title: [Li'aerion, Courtyard]
description: An expansive structure of grey stone stands rooted to the mountaintop, its foundation extending deep into the rock.  Inside the courtyard, the tall marble walls are nearly invisible under a riot of crawling green jasmine vines covered in fragrant blooms.  The lush flora of the courtyard is at odds with the climate, right down to the purple nightshade blooming along the edges of the steps.

title: [Li'aerion, Entrance Hall]
description: An immense circular room is enclosed with polished grey stone walls that rise up three floors to a dome-shaped ceiling of cut crystal.  Sunlight pours through the ceiling and breaks into shards of bright white light that shift lazily about the room, highlighting the central staircase and second floor landing.  The walls on either side of the staircase are covered with large, intricate tapestries hung from delicate bars of gold.  A sweet melody, faint but insistent, floats through the space without pause.

title: [Li'aerion, West Parlor]
description: A ceiling washed in deep blue and indigo is studded with sparkling diamonds of white, yellow, and pale blue.  Constellations form and scatter as the gems inexplicably shift positions, as though the domed ceiling were fluid rather than stone.  The gems reflect the light cast by the flames of white candles, clustered on a low silver oval table.  A large grey sheepskin rug is soft underfoot, dotted with some tasseled blue velvet pillows.  The walls are bare, save for a black silk tapestry on the eastern wall.

title: [Li'aerion, East Parlor]
description: The floor of this room is covered with a brilliant sunburst mosaic.  Tiles of gold, electrum, and copper fit together on the pale blue marble floor, mimicking the sun's rays streaming through a clear sky.  Candles that burn brightly from gold sconces on every wall bring the mosaic to life, the metallic tiles twinkling and reflecting in the jagged shards of mirror scattered across the ceiling.  Three walls are fitted with benches covered in canary silk, and a white silk tapestry covers the eastern wall.

title: [Li'aerion, Kitchens]
description: Polished white stone countertops laden with copper cookware are fitted along three sides of this room.  A wide copper vent extends from the ceiling, ending above a large fire pit and roasting spit.  Above the counters are shelves neatly filled with silver and gold serving trays, tea sets, plates, and goblets.  The center of the fourth wall is occupied by a small oak door, flanked on either side by wooden hooks hung with heavy linen aprons.

title: [Basement, Cells]
description: A row of three iron-barred cells, one next to the other, line the western wall.  Across from the cells is a table holding a whip and a few scattered shackles.  Dark spots on the cold stone floor appear to be smears of dried blood.  Faint light spills into the area from the top of a narrow staircase.

title: [Basement, Living Quarters]
description: Dust-covered beds, stacked three high, fill this small space so that there is barely room to maneuver.  A few threadbare rugs dot the cold stone floor.

title: [Basement, Living Quarters]
description: Dust-covered beds, stacked three high, fill this small space so that there is barely room to maneuver.  A few threadbare rugs dot the cold stone floor.

title: [Basement, Living Quarters]
description: A cramped sitting area with some faded chairs and a rickety table is made worse by a very low ceiling.  A few old torches flickering with odd greenish flames are clamped to the rough stone walls.

title: [Basement, Workrooms]
description: It is dark down here, and the air is stale.  The rough stone walls are fitted with candleholders that are covered with useless piles of melted wax.  Slabs of granite and marble are lined up against one wall, and a table covered with chisels and brushes sits next to a half-finished statue.

title: [Basement, Workrooms]
description: It is dark down here, and the air is stale.  The rough stone walls are fitted with candleholders that are covered with useless piles of melted wax.  Various half-finished carpentry projects litter the area, and a stack of uncut wood is piled in one corner.

title: [Basement, Workrooms]
description: It is dark down here, and the air is stale.  The rough stone walls are fitted with candleholders that are covered with useless piles of melted wax.  A long worktable pushed against one wall is covered with sewing needles, spools of thread, and measuring tools.

title: [Li'aeroin, Dark Stair]
description: A small doorway at the top of the stairs allows a little light to spill down the length of the passage.  The bottom of the narrow staircase is dark, with just enough light to see tunnels that branch off in two different directions.

title: [Li'aerion, Storage]
description: Plain whitewashed walls and a wood beam ceiling enclose this space, clearly utilitarian in nature.  Shelves fitted to the walls are stacked high with folded blankets of fur, accompanied by pillows of various sizes covered in soft and luxurious fabrics.  A few pieces of furniture sit covered in canvas drop cloths.  On the south wall of the room is a small oak door.

title: [Li'aerion, Upper Landing]
description: Sleek grey marble floors are covered at intervals with rugs in rich jewel tones.  Just to either side of the staircase, the spaces between intricately carved columns are draped with lengths of scarlet-swept ebon gossamer.  Recessed spaces on either side of the main corridor shelter a heavy grey velvet curtain and an onyx arch.  Enormous silver-dipped bone candelabrum hold blood-red candles that cast dancing lights over the floors and walls.

title: [Li'aerion, Eastern Salon]
description: Cozy and intimate, the walls of this small space are covered in dark green brocade silk.  A chandelier dangling green and white cut crystals throws dancing shards of light over the plush black fur rug and grey marble fireplace.  A soft green velvet couch and an oversized white velvet lounge are arranged around a sleek silver table inlaid with moss agate.

title: [Li'aerion, Emerald Suite]
description: Grey marble walls with veins of rich viridian enclose this rather spacious suite.  The ceiling is obscured by drapes of emerald-stitched grey brocade, rising to an apex around an elaborate mithglin chandelier set with silvery candles.  Looming large, a silver-swept mistwood bed is piled high with dark green pillows atop a charcoal-edged ebon blanket.

title: [Li'aerion, Western Salon]
description: Deep purple silk striped with onyx thread covers the walls of this luxurious room.  Black candles cluster on various surfaces, their violet flames casting an eerie light over the space and reflecting in the gleaming black marble floor.  A plum damask couch rests on the center of a thick sable rug.

title: [Li'aerion, Sapphire Suite]
description: Brocaded silk in a deep cobalt hue covers the walls, meeting with a sleek black marble floor veined in grey.  A canopied bed covered in blue and grey silks is flanked on either side by lacquered black willow nighstands, and the entire space is illuminated in patches by a smattering of candelight flickering behind filigree silver sconces.

title: [Li'aerion, Solarium]
description: Elaborately carved columns reach up to support a seamless, perfectly domed glass ceiling.  Sunlight spills freely into the large space, illuminating several intimate seating areas of soft chairs and couches.  A pair of heavy red silk curtains hang from ebonwood hooks on the eastern wall.  The western wall is covered in a vivid mural, and the north end of the sunroom is a small grey marble staircase.

title: [Li'aerion, Eastern Balcony]
description: This expansive balcony edges the eastern portion of the house.  A low wall separates the edge of the balcony from a dizzying drop down the mountainside, where sunlight is engulfed by deep canyons filled with jagged outcroppings.  The air is brisk, and the area is empty except for an elaborate platinum stand.

title: [Li'aerion, Upper Corridor]
description: The dark grey carpet of this hallway is soft underfoot.  The sleek grey marble walls are plain, save for elaborate rose gold sconces holding tiny candles.  A modest landing allows one to look down on the solarium below before the corridor continues around a slight curve.

title: [Li'aerion, Upper Corridor]
description: The dark grey carpet of this hallway is soft underfoot.  The sleek grey marble walls are plain, save for elaborate rose gold sconces holding tiny candles.  The corridor ends abruptly with an inky silk tapestry.

title: [Shallow Cave]
description: This cave is not deep or very tall, but it does offer some protection from the cold air and roving creatures outside.  It appears that someone attempted to scrawl a message on the rough walls with charcoal, but the letters have long since faded away.

title: [Dragonspine, Alpine Forest]
description: A trail winds its way through the trees, but the incline is steep and the ground underfoot is slippery with frozen pine needles and loose rocks.  The branches rustle far overhead, continuously knocking clumps of snow to the ground.

title: [Dragonspine, Mountainside]
description: A few towering trees cling to life on this windy mountainside, standing apart from the dense forest to the east.  Snow flurries dance through the air and the ground is uneven, making every step precarious.

title: [Dragonspine, Mountainside]
description: A wide precipice on the side of a towering mountain is buffetted by howling gusts of wind and clouds of snow.  Hidden partially behind a large boulder are the top rungs of a sturdy iron ladder.

title: [A Narrow Shaft, Ladder]
description: A few snowflakes dance through the air near the top of the ladder, and the freezing wind howls mercilessly.

title: [A Narrow Shaft, Ladder]
description: The smooth walls of this shaft are slick with ice, and the temperature is almost unbearably cold.  Wind howls down from the opening through the shaft, shaking the ladder slightly.

title: [A Twisting Tunnel, Shaft]
description: The curving of the tunnel walls stops suddenly in this tiny space that is flooded with light.  Far above, an opening can be seen that reveals a tiny round patch of sky.  A sturdy iron ladder, bolted into the cave walls, leads up.

title: [A Twisting Tunnel]
description: Twisting sharply, this section of the tunnel turns so that it is impossible to see what is around the bend.

title: [A Twisting Tunnel]
description: Twisting sharply, this section of the tunnel turns so that it is impossible to see what is around the bend.  The golden torchlight causes the walls of the tunnel, which are laced with flecks of mithglin, to sparkle.

title: [A Twisting Tunnel]
description: Twisting sharply, this section of the tunnel turns so that it is impossible to see what is around the bend.

title: [A Twisting Tunnel]
description: Twisting sharply, this section of the tunnel turns so that it is impossible to see what is around the bend.

title: [A Twisting Tunnel]
description: Twisting sharply, this section of the tunnel turns so that it is impossible to see what is around the bend.

title: [A Wide Tunnel]
description: The walls of this tunnel are smooth and lit by a series of rotting torches, each one burning with strange, thin golden flames.  The ground here is smooth, even, and free of debris.

title: [A Dark Cave]
description: The staircase ends abruptly in a large, round room that is freezing cold.  Torches clamped to the walls burn with odd blue flames, highlighting rusty shackles that are attached to the rough walls.  One set of shackles still holds a pitiful skeleton covered in scraps of tattered cloth.  A pointed archway in the wall leads out.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs are very slippery.  A dull light shines from the top of the staircase.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: A crumbling torch, affixed to the wall with iron clamps and burning with a strange white flame, illuminates the initial steps of a very steep staircase, unevenly cut from the rough stone of the tunnel.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: Pinpricks of light illuminate this part of the tunnel very faintly.  The ceiling above appears to have crumbled slightly, revealing miniscule patches of sky.  Water drips through the tiny holes to form stubby icicles.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: The ground levels out a bit as the temperature continues to drop.  Ice crunches underfoot.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: It is mostly dark in this tunnel.  The outline of a series of very wide steps is barely visible up ahead.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Crossroads]
description: The tunnel opens up considerably in this small room.  Three torches burn steadily, one in-between each archway leading a different direction.  A few uncut gems, stuck in the walls of the space, gleam dimly in the dancing light.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: It is mostly dark in this tunnel.  Around the corner, a faint light helps to illuminate a few giant spiderwebs draping from the ceiling.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: It is very dark in this tunnel.  Water drips from overhead, splattering on the ground and making it slippery.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Dead End]
description: It is pitch black in this part of the tunnel.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: It is very dark inside this tunnel.  The floor continues to rise as loose bits of rock crunch underfoot.  Around a slight bend, light casts eerie shadows on the uneven walls and low ceiling.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: It is very dark inside this tunnel.  The floor continues to rise as loose bits of rock crunch underfoot.  A faint light can be seen from the north.
