title: [A Dark Cave, Upper Landing]
description: The upward slope of the cave evens out here to create a stable, if somewhat narrow, landing.  Light from a guttering torch affixed to the wall shows a dark tunnel leading out.  A pair of iron spikes secure the top loops of a thick rope ladder with leather ties, which leads back to the lower portion of the cave.

title: [A Dark Cave]
description: It is too dark inside this cave to see where the ceiling is, but it's somewhere very high up.  A faint glow highlights the sloping floor of the cave, which rises at first in a gentle incline and then sharply into a strange mound that seems to form the back of the cave.  Fastened to the mound is a thick rope ladder with leather ties.

title: [Nautical Novelties]
description: Separated from the corridor by a low archway, the alcove houses neat little piles of nautical instruments.  Some sturdy wooden shelves adorn the wall behind a bowed modwir table, each topped with various wares for sale.  Opposite the desk is a heavy oak desk, upon which neatly folded maps are piled.  A single lantern hangs from the center of the ceiling, casting a dull glow down on the scene.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Underwater]
description: The temperature of the water feels as chill as a snowstorm, the slight current laden with no hints of warmth.  Much further below, the ocean floor is overwhelmed with coral rock formations that jut up from the surface, and while there are splashes of color dotted along it, the sand that is constantly stirred up from the floor partially obscures the view.  To one side, the beginnings of a wavering kelp forest wave back-and-forth, while all other directions give a majestic view of the dark blue sea.

title: [Killick's Kandies]
description: Mobiles made from colorful pieces of broken glass, seashells, and found bits of polished metal dangle overhead, fracturing the light cast by the oil lamps upon the walls.  Underfoot, a woven rope rug dyed a myriad of vibrant hues sits centered on the floor, and a table made of a broken ship's wheel occupies its heart, supporting a tarnished silver platter, a hole-filled piece of driftwood, and a chipped crystal candy dish.

title: [Inside the Shell]
description: Soft pearlescent pink walls slope up around you and the faint hint of previous alchemical workings flit across your senses.  High above, the thick wooden planks forming the ceiling outside are shrouded in darkness.

title: [Iceland Rink]
description: Some of the ice here is a bit choppy, and long streaks and circles show where people have practiced tricky turns in their skates.  The air is crisp and clean, but kept at a moderate temperature by the stoves on the balcony above.  The sound of organ music drifts in from somewhere nearby, lending background noise to the ambiance.

title: [Roll With It]
description: The musty air reeks from the yeasty stench of old beer mingled with snuffed out tobacco in this small space.  Some overturned shipping crates surround a small chalk-drawn circle, and a few scraps of paper litter the floor.  A splintered wooden shelf is mounted above a rotted wood plank on one wall, and a rickety display case is situated along the opposite wall.  A thick steel ring is nestled in the corner on the floor near the exit hatch, over which a large notice is posted.

title: [The Cultured Corsair, Gallery]
description: Layers of tattered ecru lace stretch across the walls of the room, barely covering the barnacle-encrusted planks composing the ship's frame.  The room is dominated by a bas-relief powder blue cabinet and a lacquered lavender dresser, each flanking a carved mahogany figurehead.  The mermaid maiden's arms are outstretched towards the ceiling, serving as makeshift racks for merchandise.  Woven mats of crisp sea grass lead north into another area, the room obscured by a curtain of twine and dried kelp.

title: [Figurine It Out]
description: Everything seems to be order in this shop, as it has been neatly arranged, except for some crooked wooden shelves which have been set into the east wall.  There are some large statues holding lanterns, which provide iillumination to the surroundings.  On the far wall a small painting hangs, prominate for all to see and in the center of the room is a cracked glass display case.

title: [Tasty Tart, Magical Munchies]
description: Strips of sail cloth are draped from ceiling to floor, covering the walls of the small space.  Sacks of flour are stacked to the side, tiny holes in the canvas allowing white powder to spill out and dust most surfaces in the room.  A splintered board is suspended across two crates, creating a makeshift counter.

title: [Fusion Sanctum, Locus]
description: Bright curtains, their composite fabric lit from within by swirls of shifting color, swathe the walls of the circular chamber.  The velvet draperies muffle what sound and light they can from without, seeming to funnel and enhance the haunting whispers rising from a pool of pink liquid at the chamber's center.  Bright brass patterns are inlaid into the rutilated golden marble of the floor, spreading outward from the pool in jagged streaks.

title: [Ilixil's Beastorium]
description: One flameless lantern hangs from the overhead, dousing the compartment in flickering blue light.  The planks underfoot have been painted a deep cerulean and are adorned with silver runic, though the patterns of the lettering appear totally random.  Along one wall is a spindly black rack made from polished ebony.  Sitting across it, a single glaesine bowl glistens and dances in the uncertain light.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: Through the water, the top edge of a large bed of kelp waves back and forth in the clear, dark blue waters of Darkstone Bay.  Blasting across the surface of the sea, a bone-chillingly cold wind sends saltwater spraying up in violent spasms.  As the mist from the wind's display continually rains down from above, it coats a pile of rocks that jut out from the ocean's surface.

title: [Waterlogged]
description: The stale air carries a fetid odor of mildew through the small cabin.  A candle has been placed inside a pinpricked metal orb that hangs from the low ceiling, radiating minute flecks of light onto the map-covered walls.  Arranged near the back of the room, some uneven wooden shelves have been secured over a short wooden stool.  Soft plinking sounds can be heard as water drips from the ceiling into rusted pails that have been scattered across the warped plank floor.

title: [Picks and Kits]
description: Polished planks of mahogany make up the walls of this small shop.  Sputtering torches placed in brass sconces are angled perfectly to shine light down on an ironwood display case.  An old ivory-inlaid sea chest rests in a corner, its lid opened and slightly askew.  Stacks and stacks of books form somewhat of an aisleway that ends with a large piece of colorful sailcloth partially obscuring what looks like a doorway leading into an old storeroom.

title: [It's In The Bag]
description: Woven reed baskets filled with spoils are strung from lengths of thick rope secured to rafters overhead, the aged wood carved with various marks and symbols.  A long counter constructed from an oak plank laid across a few overturned crates stands next to a heavy leather-bound trunk.  A collection of glass bottles, all empty and covered in dust and cobwebs, are lined up on the sole shelf mounted next to a sputtering iron lantern near a colorful twine hammock.

title: [The Reserve, Front Room]
description: A single black lantern illuminates dark water stains meandering across pale pink rose-printed wallpaper that has begun to peel at the seams.  Across from the entry, a large brass-framed porthole with milky green glass overlooks a battered driftwood wardrobe set upon warped floorboards.  A frayed hammock dangles over a pair of salt-stained mistwood trunks in one corner, opposite a makeshift table and two mismatched wooden chairs.

title: [The Reserve, Back Room]
description: Crowded with trunks stacked on wooden shelves and unopened oak barrels, a small space has been cleared in the center of the small room for a workbench.  A petite portrait hangs on the wall next to a curtained opening and a woven mat smelling of mildew covers the dusty plank floor.

title: [The Watery Wench]
description: A large, multi-colored rug covers the smooth pine boards that stretch across the floor.  Swathes of colorful linen tapestries line the walls, dappled with silvery beams of moonlight seeping through a small porthole.  A pair of female mannequins, one slender and one rotund, stand opposite a curtain-draped doorway.  The air has a vaguely perfumed scent, which doesn't quite cover the smell of the salty sea air.

title: [The Salty Sire]
description: Rough wooden boards march across the floor, warped in several places and coated in a thin layer of brine.  Wide tapestries line the walls, dappled with shadows from the moonlight seeping through a dirty porthole.  A pair of wooden mannequins, one short and one tall, stands opposite a pair of swinging doors.  The air is heavy with the scent of salt.

title: [Plunder and Pillage]
description: Stacks of broken crates lean haphazardly against the walls, threatening to crash to the ground with each sway of the ship.  A long plank rests atop two overturned iron-banded barrels, displaying a variety of implements and supplies.  A thick iron chain hangs from the ceiling, supporting a rusty iron lantern, and rows of rough pine shelves flank a narrow, multi-hued glass door.  Several thick coils of rope occupy one corner.

title: [Shaver Me Timbers]
description: A subtle musky scent slightly overshadows the smell of the sea air.  Showcased in the middle of the room are some large red chairs, and behind them, an apothecary's cabinet is mounted on the back wall.  A barrel stands in one corner beside a small curtained archway.  Some brass lanterns hang from the rafters, swaying every so often with the movement of the ship.

title: [Twobits' Office]
description: Cramped but cozy, the small room is set up with a cot, a rug, and a candle.  A portrait on the wall is the sole decoration.  A small curtained archway leads back to the main room.

title: [Spitfire, Hardy Hair Hair]
description: Small and cramped, this cabin is brightly lit by several hooded lanterns.  A carved modwir vanity sits along the ship's hull, flanked by two small tables.  Richly embroidered wool rugs cover the rough planking of the hold, providing warmth and color.  A full-length mirror stands at attention nearby, as if ready for the Captain's inspection.

title: [Huff and Puff, Pipes and Stuff]
description: Small and damp, this cabin has been turned into an impromptu store.  A varnished mistwood plank rests atop two wine barrels, displaying a nice assortment of goods.  An old cask near the back bulkhead gives off the strong odor of stale rum.

title: [Huff and Puff, Humidor]
description: This small compartment in the bottom of the vessel is warm and humid, perfect for keeping tobacco fresh.  Several barrels have been stacked in one corner, each stamped with the mark of the Southern Isles.  A single oil lantern hangs just above two open crates near the center of the room.

title: [Pillaged and Plundered]
description: Stacks of barrels and crates have been cleverly positioned to shield this area from prying eyes, creating a safe haven in the chaos of the cargo hold of the vessel.  A single oil lantern sits atop an overturned treasure chest, providing feeble light to the niche.  Several barrels lie scattered among random piles of pilfered goods.

title: [Lockit A Lot]
description: Decorated with colorful feathers and charms that dangle from the ceiling, the shop space is cheery and bright.  Unnaturally bright light blazes from a series of candles, the smoke wafting from them imparting the scent of lavender into the air.  A single loom spans the a large portion of the space, its length hung with lockets rather than the results of weaving.  Past the loom, a small, diamond-shaped hatch is nearly hidden by an extravagant drape of cotton streamers.

title: [Lockit A Lot, Living Quarters]
description: Vibrant blue paint covers the floor, while yellow paint splashes across the walls.  Feathers hang from above, interspersed with charms of all shapes and sizes.  Covered in a massive quilt, a tiny bed takes up one corner of the room, across from a large worktable scattered with jewelry-making tools and various melted-down candles.

title: [A Frayed Knot]
description: Planks of knotted driftwood have been carelessly nailed together, forming an uneven flooring that makes it difficult to maintain your balance.  Rusted nail heads have bled a brownish red color into the planks, giving the appearance of a long-ago battleground.  A large sail painted with obscure markings hangs on the back wall, and a variety of wares clutter the room, filling both the sturdy netting that hangs from the ceiling and the haphazardly stacked chests and trunks.

title: [Truefolk Treasures]
description: Assorted chests, barrels, and crates are piled around a short oak door, walling it off from the rest of the cargo hold.  One crate has been hastily pried open and a crooked wooden sign is posted above it, affixed to a large salt-stained chest turned on one end.  A narrow gap between two barrels leads out.

title: [Way Off Target]
description: The walls of this cramped cabin have been painted with floor to ceiling trees, and the wooden peg board on the wall opposite the hatch blends in with the brush-stroked bark of what seems to be a particularly large oak.  Overhead, a twilight sky speckled with white stars encloses the green tree boughs that reach up to the corners of the ceiling.  At the foot of one of the painted trees lies iron-bound chest, and nearby is steel box set atop a stump made of the remains of an old barrel.

title: [The Black Market]
description: Cobwebs cover every corner of this cramped little nook.  Little light seeps into the room from a small iron brazier in the corner, and a pile of random clothing on the rough wooden floor lies mostly in darkness.

title: [Chortel's Closet]
description: Each of the four walls of this tiny alcove bears the image of a grinning skull, crossed by a pair of broken longswords.  A single stool, with uneven and extremely wobbly legs, rests beside a ramshackle worktable crafted from a thin plank of wood lofted by a few crumbling bricks.  A pile of half-created toys litters the surface of the wood.  Appearing newer than anything else in the room, a tiny little notice hangs on a wooden door mostly hidden in the wall.

title: [Way Off Target]
description: Painted tree trunks stretch toward the ceiling in varicolored shades of brown and ivory, and against the deep blue firmament above are a trio of moons.  Moonlight in the form of silvery white paint dapples the foliage of the trees, and a thick hay-packed target has been affixed to the wall as if hung from one of the trees.  Off to one side of the suede-backed feather curtain is a slotted dark oak stand, and across the walkway is a faded velvet-lined box.

title: [Way Off Target]
description: Stretched across one corner of the room is a netted rope hammock lined with embroidered swathes of fabric in a variety of jewel-toned colors.  The ceiling overhead is awash in cobalt hues and tiny stars, though the constellation of the trident stands out from the rest.

title: [Lick of the Cat]
description: This clearing between stacks of burlap sacks and heavy crates is rife with the mingled odors of jute and oakum.  In the amber light of a brass lantern strung between the hanging ballast of iron-banded molasses barrels, a lean grimalkin laps avidly at a hardened puddle of the syrup.  Beyond the freight, a wayward belaying pin describes the same rattling arc in the back-and-forth influence of wind and tide.

title: [Sea Dogs Of War, Shipyard]
description: Dust and dirt are thick at the crevices where the floor meets the walls here, but the center is free from debris.  A cracked wheelhouse wheel is mounted above a small hatch on one wall of this traingularly shaped room and a wind-whipped section of a tattered mizzen mast sail occupies another.  A splintered wooden chute has been carved into the slope of the remaining wall.

title: [Bottoms Up]
description: Thick leather straps with large silver hooks on each end have been wrapped around several pieces of furniture, securing them to an adjacent shelf-lined wall.  A stained driftwood counter sits opposite a copper-banded cask, and a circular window offers a glimpse of the outside, filling the otherwise dark room with minimal moonlight.  Lingering in the humid, salt-charged air is a heavy aroma of alcohol.

title: [Sea Dogs Of War, Troops]
description: The tall, but cramped, musty room smells faintly of seaweed, fruit tarts, and rum.  A rigging line dangles from above, leading to a small crow's nest suspended by chains near the top of the room.  In one corner, among discarded bottles and jugs, is an enruned mithril chest, and in the opposite corner is a battered wooden coffer.  A small hatch has been cut into the side of the wall.

title: [Sea Dogs Of War, Crow's Nest]
description: This circlular suspended deck provides ample view of the room below it.  A single knotted rope crafted from rigging line is tethered over the side.

title: [Bejeweled]
description: Dozens of lanterns hang from the ceiling, holding dozens of flickering candles.  The light fills the room with radiance as it bounces off the gemstones adorning the jewelry on display.  A wooden treasure chest with brass hinges rests beneath the branches of a miniature white monir tree.  A three-legged stool sits near the door, upon which a singed parchment has been tacked.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold Alcove]
description: The walls of the alcove are comprised of various crates stenciled with incomprehensible inscriptions.  Toward the back of the enclosure, an especially large container has a series of curious glyphs on it that seem to shift and change if you stare at them long enough.  In one corner, a chipped barrel and a battered trunk have been tucked neatly beneath a chipped and weathered table.  A swaying overhead lantern sheds a pool of warm, yellow light down on a large treasure chest and a brass and modwir dresser.

title: [Tott's Trusty Travel Trinkets]
description: Although the area has a wide berth, its markedly low ceiling, barely high enough for a Giantman to stand, creates the impression of a cramped space.  Plush underfoot, an expansive red velvet rug covers the majority of the wooden flooring, its fabric matched to the velvet lining the shelves and glass cases set upon each wall.  Dappled light spills in through a small porthole that gazes into the ocean outside.

title: [Pi-Rate Customers]
description: The room is dark except for a single burning lantern held aloft by a thick rope.  Nestled into the far side of the room and attached to each side of the bulkhead is a sailcloth hammock.  A large cast iron bucket sits in the center of the room, filled to the brim with carved wooden ducks.  There is a single iron hook hanging above the bucket, with a few pieces of clothing on it.

title: [Swords 'n Boards, Crawl Space]
description: Not quite a room, the ceiling is barely high enough for a man to stoop and not hit his head.  The crawl space stretches off to the west where the ceiling lowers and the end is lost in the dim and dusty air.  The only light filters up from a rectangular hole in the floor.  The layer of dust on the floor around the hole has been disturbed, rendering some areas cleaner than the rest.

title: [Swords 'n Boards, Crawl Space]
description: The ceiling is extremely low, making it difficult for even a gnome to stand.  The dusty air is oppressive and makes it hard to breathe.  The narrow crawl space appears to end here with a blank wall of parallel wooden boards.

title: [Swords 'n Boards, Dead End]
description: The ceiling is barely high enough to accommodate standing, and indirect light filters through into this narrow space from a small crack in the wall, illuminating a pile of rat droppings in the corner.  The scent of mold is pervasive, and dust motes hang in the stagnant air, barely visible in the dim light.  Stale drafts of air drift in through a dimly lit passage.

title: [Swords 'n Boards, Hidden Room]
description: Short candles in glass jars are scattered around the walls in carved nooks.  The flickering light casts long shadows across the dusty floor, throwing the objects resting on a three-legged wooden table and a low wooden rack into sharp relief.  Tacked to the wall, a tattered parchment sign flutters in a slight breeze.  A musty pile of rags leans against a narrow shelf that sits slightly askew from the wall.

title: [Wunderusly Wavuble Majuck]
description: Makeshift walls formed by canvas-draped stacks of crates reflect the lantern light, creating an oasis within the otherwise dark cargo hold.  Near a gap in the canvas stands a small wooden bin that contains an assortment of wands.  Further back in this cargo hold-niche, a low canvas-covered box bears a few odds and ends, and against the back wall a tall modwir rack supports several wand harnesses.

title: [Sand in Yer Hammock]
description: Dark oak planks, stained by years of rough use and seawater, form the bulkheads and decking of this small cabin.  In a vain attempt to brighten the place up, an expanse of cream-colored silk has been draped across the stern bulkhead.  A set of rough modwir shelves against the forward bulkhead, a brass hat stand beside the cabin door, and a long wooden rack standing in front of the draped silk hold a neatly arranged variety of garments more commonly seen near the Sea of Fire.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Outer Edge]
description: Rough currents yank and pull you in one direction only -- back toward the inner area of Darkstone Bay.  All around you, the ocean swells rise up high, crashing down in churning splashes of sea foam and water.  Small bits of kelp float along the surface, and beneath you, the kelp beds are clearly visible through the dark, but clear, water.

title: [Picks and Kits, Storeroom]
description: A thick coat of dust covers everything in this rather dingy storeroom.  The area offers no clue to what it once housed, but it's apparent that spiders could be the current occupier, considering the intricate spiderweb covering the ceiling.  A sturdy wooden table sits smack dab in the center of the room.

title: [The Cultured Corsair, Workshop]
description: Pieces of various fabrics, hides, and adornments litter the planked walls of the room, the squares haphazardly grouped together with scrawled notes and bits of hempen rope.  A pale mint enamel-framed board leans against the left wall, the bottom buried beneath crumpled balls of parchment and vellum.  The right wall is hung with a silver-cast rack, the pole hung with a multitude of colorful bodices and corsetry.  A seashell-inlaid mirror dominates the back of workshop, draped in piles of half-sewn garments.

title: [Killick's Kandies]
description: In the back corner of this small alcove, a lumpy cushion of sorts is tucked in beside a miniature oak wine barrel and covered with a sea thrak-embroidered cotton blanket.  From the ceiling, intricate ornaments made of rainbow glaes glisten in the lamp light, casting bright fragments of color across the walls.

title: [Tasty Tart, Magical Munchies]
description: White powdered footprints pattern the wooden floor.  Barrels of fruit and sacks of sugar are piled about the small area, their contents spilling out over the floor.  A series of shelves crafted from bits of old furniture are hung on one wall, their random placement making a haphazard display.

title: [Tasty Tart, Magical Munchies]
description: Casks of exotic spices and kegs of liquid ingredients are piled around the room.  The rich smells of cinnamon, nutmeg and other seasonings fill the air.  Several crates of various sizes are stacked on top of each other to create an odd display.  Small powdered footprints lead in and out of the room, decorating the floor with a fanciful pattern.

title: [Pi-Rate Customers]
description: Thick planks line the walls, each intersection bolted with steel plates.  The end of the shop comes to a narrow point, a single blackened window in the center of it.  The bulkhead is lined with numerous sailing navigation wheels that are connected to ropes and pullies overhead.  A large rusted anchor is suspended in the center of the room, held aloft by the turnbuckles attached to the ropes.  A wooden hatch is propped open in the center of the room, with a sloppily painted skull and cross bone design.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Underwater]
description: Dark and cold, the saltwater is excessively clear and supplies a great deal of visibility.  To one side, the planks of a large ship curve down toward its bottom, and several small, heavy-paned windows peer out from its side.  The ocean floor is alternately covered in rocks and sand, with large fan-like plants, shells, and sealife adding color to the landscape.  The underwater wooden structure of a nearby dock, which is covered with barnacles and sea stars is just barely visible in the distance.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: The waters of Darkstone Bay are cold!  Splashing around here gives you a good look at the water line of the Spitfire, as the winds slowly push it toward the mouth of the bay.  Seagulls call and wheel overhead.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: Cold waters splash around you, catching you in the midst of waves that slosh about in the Darkstone Bay.  Grizzled workers move along the docks of Wehnimer's Landing, loading and unloading ships lined up along the water's edge.

title: [Reim Settlement, General Store]
description: Baskets hang from the ceiling over numerous bins filled with bolts of dusty cloth, empty flour sacks, and broken jars.  The windows are thick with accumulated soot and dirt, the letters painted on the glass announcing a sale on tea leaves faded and peeling.  Along the back wall, a tall counter with stools at one end separates the front room from some small living quarters outfitted with a narrow cot and a metal footlocker.

title: [Noble Affront]
description: A tall fel pole stands in the center of the pavilion, supporting the silken canopy high overheard, while a plush crimson rug covers the ground below.  A polished linden display runs the length of on side of the pavilion, while a carved mahogany rack stands along the opposite side.  The back portion of the pavillion is partitioned off by an amber-beaded curtain.

title: [Noble Affront]
description: Ambient light and noise filters through the amber-beaded curttain to faintly illuminate this portion of the pavilion.  The plush crimson rug continues under the curtain to cover the ground.  Some plush velvet cushions are strewn about the rug, to provide comfort when sitting.

title: [Against The Wind]
description: Moonlight flickers in through the rope net that has been draped over two tall casting rods, creating a makeshift tent.  The sharp odor of fish and sea air flows through the area with even the slightest breeze.  A series of rusted fishhooks have been strung haphazardly through the top of the netting.

title: [Naval A Salt]
description: A salt-stained rugs runs the length of the wagon, covering the warped wooden boards that comprise the floor.  A warped teak rack hangs along one wall, while a varnished oak table runs the length of the opposite wall.  A tarnished brass hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [Naval A Salt, Storeroom]
description: Boxes and crates are stacked all along the walls of this storage area, taking up most of the space of this small room.   The rear corner remains empty, except for a short padded cot and a cushion-covered bench sitting next to each other.  An old bronze lamp hangs low on the wall just above the cot.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: The ocean swells rise up high, crashing down in loud splashes of water and foam.  Small bits of kelp float along the surface of the dark waters.

title: [Darkstone Bay]
description: Cold water splashes up around you, and you are caught in the midst of waves that slosh against one another near the mouth of Darkstone Bay.  A single buoy floats in the water, its red paint faded and dull.  Figures moving along the docks are tiny from this vantage point, an indication that the nearest land is quite a swim away.

title: [What's Crackin'?]
description: Hanging from the ceiling are mobile lobsters, dangling like puppets ready for a show.  A large lobster-shaped display case is prominently featured, neighbored by a bowtie-wearing lobster statue.  A black shoe rack stands adjacent to a claw-shaped oak armoire.  A massive, hand-knotted lobster rug covers nearly the entirety of the oak floorboards.

title: [The Muse's Half-Note]
description: Makeshift walls have been erected inside the tent and laid with spools of soft, colorful fabric to help hide their appearance.  A fine selection of musical instruments hangs upon the walls as well as on the numerous display cases that sit atop slender marble and granite columns.  A young elven clerk sits upon a stool in one corner, occasionally tuning the strings of a lute.

title: [Bottoms Up, Backroom]
description: Bursts of swearing and intermittent laughter fill the area, the sound broken only by intermittent knocks from an adjacent room.  Completely covered with ale-filled mugs and decks of cards, a group of halflings sits around a grog-stained table, while another pirate stands guard at a paneled door, opening it occasionally to let a customer inside.  Tucked into one corner, a wooden crate partially obscures a wide hole that has been gouged into the wall.

title: [The Favorful Bar]
description: Some drunk rapscallion of the past seems to have amended the sign to read "The Favorful Bar" instead of "The Flavorful Bar."  Rather than objecting to the vandalism, the halfing bar maid seems to have embraced it, for some of the drinks are being sold in suspiciously familiar-looking white flasks, and large white shields have been stitched across the front of her taut, low-cut bodice.  A grizzled old halfling nurses a stein of tart rum as he leans on the polished maoral bar near a crate containing several souvenirs and leers enthusiastically.

title: [Furrfoot's Revenge, Barroom]
description: The room is lit by several brass lanterns that sway in time to the gentle rocking of the ship.  Cloyingly sweet cigar smoke hangs in the air, drifting in from a carved maoral arch that leads into a shady-looking casino.  A brass rod suspending a heavy black curtain with muffled sounds coming from behind it -- clearly inaccessible to the public -- is positioned near a long modwir bar at the back of the room.  A heavy scarlet curtain is draped over one of the walls, providing a dark wash of sanguine color to the bar.

title: [Furrfoot's, Casino]
description: Murky light splinters through the narrow casino area, where smoke drifts up in large puffs from the wide variety of patrons milling about.  Gambling tables are set up along the floor, bordering a heavy crimson curtain and a heavy jade curtain that are monitored by a pair of rough-looking halflings.  Despite the bleak appearance of the casino, from its stained walls to ragtag carpet, the tables and the dealers appear to be of the finest quality.  In a far corner, a carved maoral arch opens into a barroom.

title: [Furrfoot's, Black Drake]
description: Behind a prominent banner, small lanterns hang from the ceiling, illuminating a handful of tables topped with green felt.  An assortment of dealers are scattered between the tables, each carefully watching both the patrons and the dice rolls.  Amid the buzz of conversation and concentration, the clink of silvers is constant.  Several fishing nets are suspended on either side of a heavy azure curtain, their fishy scent clashing with the heady aromas of liquor, smoke, and the sweaty dwarf who stands guard.

title: [Furrfoot's, Lucky 7's]
description: Scrappy carpet only partially covers the floor, its threadbare edges only covering the entrance to the area and a small pathway up to a clerk's cage.  The remainder of the flooring is made up of moist, wooden planking that appears as if it might give way at any moment.  Pushed up against each wall, several dimly lit tables, with nary a chair in sight, are scattered atop discarded tickets.

title: [Furrfoot's, Dragon's Bones]
description: A single lantern fitted with panes of crimson glass hangs directly above the Dragon's Bones table, bathing its surroundings in a lurid red glow.  A prominately placed warning and disclaimer have been nailed to the wall directly opposite to a similarly hung payoff chart and large poster.  Above a heavy jade curtain is the head of a huge dragon made entirely of gleaming brass.

title: [Furrfoot's, Roulette]
description: Light is sparse in this small space, with the single illuminating point hanging just above a gambling table set with a rich mahogany roulette wheel.  Shadows wrap around the walls, and each corner is clothed completely in a darkness, though low, muddled conversation emanates from those areas.  Hanging heavily in the air is a haze of smoke that smells of cigars.  Barely legible in the dim light, a rules poster, a numbers chart, and a betting sign hang adjacent to a heavy crimson curtain.

title: [Furrfoot's, Conquest Wheel]
description: Placed throughout the area, several armchairs are the only indication of thoughts of comfort in the area.  Claiming a central spot on the rough plank flooring, an artfully stained wooden table is topped with an archaic conquest wheel.  An important notice is set just in front of the table, and above and behind the setup, a rules sign and a payoff chart are carved in precise detail.

title: [The Grumpy Ole Dwarf Bar]
description: A portrait of a scowling dwarf is hung above the long modwir bar flanked by two brass lanterns.  The bar itself gleams from a fresh polishing as evidenced by the damp cleaning rag left lying on top of it.  The multitude of liquor bottles and tapped kegs behind the bar are expertly secured for sea by sailors who obviously take their drinking seriously.  A ragged mop lies propped up by the exit to the main barroom.  At one end of the bar, an open doorway is shrouded in shadows and a smoky haze.

title: [Furrfoot's, Flying Darts]
description: Two iron lanterns hang on both sides of the dart board, offering poor lighting for the entire room, but illuminating the dart board perfectly.  Pushed up against the back wall, a polished wooden rack stands, its surface etched with a dart in flight.  From just beyond the doorway, the smell of cigar smoke and ale wafts into the room.

title: [The Cold Hold]
description: A layer of thin fresh ice covers the uneven walls and narrow floor in this small hold.  Hoarfrost glistens with a myriad of colorful reflections cast by the flickering flames of an oil lamp that dangles precariously overhead from a rusty length of chain.  The thick chain weaves along the ceiling, anchored in place with large wooden pegs, and supports the frozen carcass of a sizeable sea thrak.  Crooked stairs lead up and out, an icy wooden handrail the only aid in successfully navigating them.

title: [Can't Contain It]
description: This shop is small and cramped.  Some wooden storage boxes are strewn about the room, some still nailed shut and others on their sides, empty.  There are parallel rowas of vultite hooks on every wall, from which a number of backpacks, rucksacks, and other large containers hang out for display.  A battered old chest sits against the far wall.  The room is illuminated by several large lanterns mounted at the center of each of the room's walls.

title: [Fit To Be Tied]
description: Bare wooden planks serve as walls in this brightly lit, though sparsely decorated room.  Ropes of varying length and thickness hang from the ceiling, tied to the beams above with all manner of sailor's knots.  A sturdy modwir table holds a number of lengths of rope tied in various knots available for purchase.  Toward the back wall, the ceiling is clear of dangling obstacles, creating a slightly less cluttered workspace.

title: [Head Over Heels, Slippers]
description: The chamber is small, but elegantly appointed with cast bronze sconces and woven tapestries, each hanging depicting a scene in a garden-set party.  One tapestry nearly obscures a tall portal.  Set in the middle of the room, alone, is a bronze-trimmed box with a display slipper resting upon it.

title: [Haberdashery]
description: The low, constant creaking of the ship is the only sound that permeates the thick wooden walls of this small room.  Several shelves line the far wall, each one containing small garments for men.  A low opening leads to another room, and the only light penetrating the gloom comes from a single candelabrum set on an overturned crate in the corner.

title: [Haberdashery, Storage]
description: With little more space than a closet, this tiny alcove holds a series of floor-to-ceiling shelves with overflow stock that likely did not fit out in the main room.  Oddly, the garments in this room have a distinctly feminine flavor, which might explain why they are not out on display.  A low opening provides escape, while a tiny glowing orb has been set in the ceiling to give a speck of lighting to this otherwise claustrophobic space.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Rocky Pile]
description: Although somewhat slippery due to the mist that continually rains down on this spot, the rocks are formed in such a way as to provide easy stepping, standing, and sitting spots.  A small plaque is embedded in the middle of the rocks.  On either side of the island of rocks, which provide a fantastic view of both Wehnimer's Landing and the large expanse of water that is Darkstone Bay, are makeshift gangplanks, one leading on to a small and shoddy boat, the other to a small and weathered boat.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Shoddy Boat]
description: Dusky grey planks of wood form a small rowboat, though the oars seem to be completely absent from the scene.  Nearly rotted through, the bottom of the boat holds a healthy amount of putrid water, and several broken fishing wires have been carelessly tossed atop one of the plank benches.  Leading off of the entire contraption is a small gangplank.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Weathered Boat]
description: Spreading out in every direction, dark water sploshes violently up against the small wooden rowboat.  A pair of oars are stacked next to a small gangplank, which leads to a pile of slimy, wet rocks.  Perched on the edge of the boat, a bright red flag patterned with a furry-footed halfling flaps back-and-forth in the constant wind.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Underwater]
description: Surrounding you are tall clumps of green kelp, the growth so thick as to prevent further progress swimming the deep.  As the current sends the water swirling ever-so-slightly, the kelp dances to-and-fro, bobbing around in fanciful gestures.  The whole forest reaches up from the ocean floor, which is too deep to be visible, though large croppings of coral rock shoot up into sight at irregular intervals.  Splintering the light from above, brownish-green pieces of loose kelp float atop the water's surface.

title: [Sea Dogs Of War, Cannonade]
description: The lighting here is nearly non-existent, save for a small lantern high on the wall near the exit of a wooden chute and from a small opening in the ceiling.  The meager illumination dimly glows over some small wooden shipping crates, which are lined up against one wall in this crawl space of a room.  Marble-sized iron balls, covered in grit, grime, and rust, are trapped within the cracks of the dirty floorboards near your feet.  A rope ladder tied to an iron grappling hook is coiled on the floor.

title: [A Frayed Knot, Back Room]
description: A noticeable contrast to the front room, the walls and ceiling are planked with care, thick oak muffling every sound.  A pair of sputtering torches illuminates the area and casts dappled shadows across the room, while clothing hanging from a metal block and tackle sways with the gentle rocking of the ship.  A driftwood display with a trio of mounted fish hangs on the wall above a gigantic oyster, its upper shell stuck open.

title: [Sea Legs and Wings]
description: The briliant rays of a tiny alchemical sun suspended from the ceiling fills the tiny room with the lustre of midday.  Flourishing in the tropical light and heat is a tiny lemon tree with an enormous fat red parrot resting comfortably in its shade.  A silk screen painted with lush tropical vistas stands against the back of the room.

title: [Sea Legs and Wings, Atelier]
description: Screened from the previous room, the cramped work area is neatly maintained with a tiny bunk positioned over a minute desk on two substantial bookcases.  In the corner, a petite conch shell cauldron stands on blown glass legs.

title: [The Sartorial Scallawag]
description: Swaths of jewel-tone silks cover the rough plank walls of this small cabin, contrasting vibrantly against the dull wood.  A scrollwork table rests against the far wall, displaying carefully folded garments.  In one corner rests a carved armoire, the surface painted in a distressed teal hue.  A painted hatch leads back out.

title: [Faendryl Enclave, Courtyard]
description: Symmetrical rows of lor trees stand as silver sentinels along a gravel pathway that broadens into a circular courtyard.  In the center of the yard, a pair of trees have grown together into a single towering tree, echoing the lofty reach of the alabaster spire rising to their north.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Foyer]
description: Alabaster slabs thrust upward in the form of a lotus flower, presenting a series of concave walls and hidden conversation nooks.  Reaching twice the height of a pure elf, the tips of the carved stone petals intertwine to form a complex vaulted ceiling.  A despanal-veined pedestal casts a dull scarlet glow from the center of the room.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Dining Hall]
description: Sconces on the alabaster walls illuminate oil paintings depicting historically significant Faendryl and the officers of the Enclave.  A massive ebonwood dining table set for a formal meal traverses the length of the narrow room.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Great Hall]
description: Narrow stained glass windows pierce soaring despanal-veined alabaster walls in this expansive hall.  Each window's colorful design casts its own pattern on the barrel-vaulted ceiling to create a complex, kaleidoscopic play of light.  On the east side of the hall, an ebonwood lectern stands at the center of a small stage.  Art-lined alcoves around the room create conversation spaces while leaving a central expanse of inlaid stone open for dancing or large gatherings.

title: [Faendryl Enclave, Garden]
description: Shielded by verdant hedges, the spire's reflection garden adds a grace note of natural beauty to the building's austere architecture.  A circular pool surrounded by smooth white benches provides a serene focal point for the setting, while artfully shaped topiaries create a private reserve of fanciful beasts along the tranquil garden's periphery.  Flowering vines around a central statue add a note of welcome color.

title: [Mistydeep, Eastern Shore]
description: A narrow beach of dusky granite gravel provides a small gap between the river to the west and the encroaching forest, a dense thicket of young willows, and thorn-covered vines.  A brace of curlews wades through the edge of the river, digging through the mud of the shallows.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: Thrashing furiously against the current, large, gleaming fish leap from the water, occasionally flapping against the rocks in their attempt to push northward.  Indifferent to their plight, the Mistydeep River gushes onward, scrambling headlong over every obstacle in its path.  The resultant white water kicks up a sparkling spray that spatters the shore.  Within a small oxbow, a beaver dam takes shape as the sleek animals scurry industriously to and fro.

location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: While wider and slower to the north, here the Mistydeep River gathers itself to squeeze between steep, narrowing banks.  Gaining speed in its southward passage, the water surges over hundreds of rocky cascades.  Small pools eddy deceptively before overflowing into churning rapids.  Safe on the trunk of a fallen tree, a pudgy raccoon grasps some unknown morsel in its paws, dunking it daintily in the water between bites.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: Wild geese congregate midstream, honking noisily at anyone or anything that comes near.  Upstream, a tree-covered isle parts the waters, its lush shore creating a haven for fish and small animals.  To the east, a wide game trail leads from the riverbank into the untamed weald.  Rustling brush is accompanied by a quick glimpse of something brown, though it moved far too quickly to identify with surety.  Across the river, the shore bends gently south, with boulders of varying size extending into the water.

title: [A Weathered Shack]
description: Long modwir shelves lined with various potions, tools, and the unidentifiable remains of plants dominate one side of this relatively large shack.  A simple counter sits near the rear of the room directly in front of a thick wooden door.

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Entry]
description: Two elegant crystal chandeliers hang from the vaulted ceiling, while a set of deep bay windows, complete with thickly cushioned seats, flank an immense fireleaf door.  Moonlight streaming through the windows illuminates the polished blonde oak floor and a broad silk tapestry that covers much of the eastern wall.  A bas-relief panel, depicting a garden scene, graces the western end of the northern enclosure of the room.

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Library]
description: Well-oiled dark oak paneled bookcases form the walls of the spacious two story room.  Segmented floor-to-ceiling windows along the north wall provide a breathtaking view of the moonlit gardens.  The polished stained oak floor adds a stark contrast to the warm ivory rug, centered with an intricately carved ash table.  Several two-toned ivory and beige couches provide comfortable seating around a carved ivory limestone fireplace, which is centered along the western wall.  A spiral staircase leads up to the second floor walkway, providing access to the books above.

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Parlour]
description: Ivory crown molding joins cream-hued walls and the soaring vaulted ceiling.   An arched oak door stands to the side of a black marble fireplace, which is nestled into the western wall and has an ivy-etched mirror centered above it.  Facing the hearth is a plush floral-patterned couch framed by a set of petite lor end tables.  The northern wall boasts a series of floor-to-ceiling windows that look out onto the moonlit garden, broken only by a pair of multi-paned glass doors.  Along the eastern wall is a polished lor arch leading into the dining area.

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Kitchen]
description: Along the ivory-toned brick western wall is a massive black-enameled stove set within a carved ivory limestone backsplash, and flanked on either side by some tall oak cabinets.  The pure white marble northern wall features a three-sectioned window which illuminates the area with dappled moonlight.  A posh granite countertop, nestled under the window, houses a large sink with well-oiled oak cabinets underneath.  The eastern section of the area expands into a grand dining area featuring an enormous intricately carved lor table with plentiful seating.

title: [Twelve Oaks Manor, Garden]
description: Along the northern edge of the property, a waterfall chatters quietly in the night air as it tumbles into a wide deep pond below.  Dark, shadowy ferns and moss covered rocks that glow in the moonlight line the pond's edge and provide a soft backdrop to the surrounding oak trees.  A magnificent cherry tree dominates the western portion of the garden, and softly glowing globes have been woven throughout its canopy, providing light for several delicately carved stone benches throughout the tranquil setting.  A pair of multi-paned glass doors leads back into the manor.

title: [Thornfield Manor, Library]
description: Book-filled dark rich mahogany bookshelves line the walls from floor to ceiling of this enormous chamber.  Centered along the inner wall is a grey-swirled white marble fireplace, while two golden padded couches flank the hearth and a third emerald couch directly faces the fire.  Several gold chandeliers arch out from gracefully curved wall mounts at even intervals throughout the room.
location: Thornfield Manor, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Thornfield Manor, Gardens]
description: A walkway of crushed limestone glows in the moonlight as it winds its way through the manicured wilds of the gardens towards a grey stone manor in the distance.  Moss-laden trees take on a sinister feel in the gloom as they shelter rows of dark bushes.  Dark shapes writhe in the moonlight on either side of the meandering path.  Several bubbling fountains mark the convergences of paths rejoining the main thoroughfare.  Glistening in the moonlight along the eastern edge of the property is a large lake, complete with a small fishing dock.
location: Thornfield Manor, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Thornfield Manor, Entry Hall]
description: Light blonde ash parquet flooring warmly reflects the ambient light in this immense room.  Vaulted arches soar overhead, creating a vast open space that is accentuated by a brightly burning, elaborate vaalin chandelier hanging from the domed glass ceiling.  Dark cherrywood wainscoting separates the rich cream and forest green wallpaper from the ivory marble walls above.  A small side table sits along the west wall, while a sweeping staircase leading up to the living quarters dominates the eastern wall.
location: Thornfield Manor, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Thornfield Manor, Parlour]
description: Dark oak flat panel walls bring warmth and grandeur to this large parlour.  Blonde ash parquet flooring nicely accents the warm tones of the walls and adds a touch of cheer to the area.  Polished lor side tables guard each end of a cream silk brocade settee that sits opposite a low coffee table and welcoming stone hearth.  Several windows stretch from floor to crown molding along the eastern wall, and allow soft moonlight to grace the room.
location: Thornfield Manor, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Thornfield Manor, Dining Room]
description: Moonlight spills through three wide-set windows along the eastern wall that are flanked on either side by cream-colored cupboards.  Grey-swirled white marble countertops run along the base of the cupboards, while an ample marble sink takes up the center space under the windows.  A large stove is pleasantly situated in one corner, while a spacious dining area takes up much of the rest of the room.  An enormous lor table with ample seating for a large party is centered on a soft ivory rug that glows softly in the moonlight.
location: Thornfield Manor, inside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Ilynov Manor, Parlour]
description: Shadows play across the light golden oak flooring that is tastefully accented with various plush throw rugs.  Pale ivory wallpaper, patterned in rows of crimson dragonstalks, warmly reflects the light from the cut crystal chandelier in a soothing, yet cheerful, manner.  Along the southern wall, a white enameled stove accented in gold leaf gilding and a majestic cherrywood hutch flank an arched stained oak door that leads into the pantry, while a small table and two ornate lor chairs sit beneath a large window overlooking the east lawn.

location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Courtyard]
description: Moonlight shines over a stone wall, casting the tall, overgrown hedge lining a stately manor's courtyard into deep shadow.  A leaf-strewn brick path stretches between a rusty iron gate and the steps leading to the manor's doors.  Barely distinguishable in the blackness under the boughs of an enormous weeping willow sits a wrought iron bench.
location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Entrance Hall]
description: Two enormous bay windows, complete with cushioned seats, stand on either side of a pair of tall mahogany doors.  Cream wallpaper with thin, vertical crimson stripes is complemented by blonde oak wainscoting.  Two large, cut crystal chandeliers cast a warm glow over the flooring, which is of silver-veined onyx marble and centered with a pure white marble crest of House Vaalor.  Along the western wall, a winding staircase with a polished cherrywood banister curves upward toward the library, while a shadowed alcove along the eastern wall houses a set of carpeted steps leading downward.
location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Legion Hall]
description: This underground training area is framed by roughly hewn walls that have been carved out of the bedrock the fortress was built on.  One wall is covered with charts and maps, while another wall boasts a large sword display.  In the back of the room, a row of wooden training mannequins stands between a weapon storage rack and a pile of spare mannequin parts.  Several inches of clean, white sand cover a majority of the floor space.  A bamboo mat rests on the landing at the base of a set of carpeted steps that lead back up to the main floor.
location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Library]
description: In one corner, two overstuffed chairs sit before a marble fireplace, a petite table nestled between them on a plush cream rug.  Moonlight pours through a large window along the back wall, casting shadows over a small writing desk.  A carved cherrywood railing serves as the southern wall, providing a view of the dim hall below, and is only broken by the head of a winding staircase.  The remainder of the wall space is floor-to-ceiling walnut bookshelves.  A darkened hallway to the east leads to a dark mahogany door.
location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Bedroom]
description: A crystal chandelier, hanging from the slightly domed ceiling, casts a warm glow over this elegant chamber.  A tall, eahnor-framed mirror stands off to the side of a thickly cushioned settee, which sits before a black marble fireplace.  Cream wallpaper, patterned in diagonal lines of tiny crimson dragonstalks, covers the walls above rich mahogany wainscoting.  A four-poster mahogany bed, flanked by a vaalorn-inlaid wardrobe and a dark mahogany door, rests on the thick, plush crimson carpet and faces a tall, moonlit leaded glass window.
location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Pantry]
description: A row of oak shelves, holding a wide variety of food and stored goods, lines the walls of this rather large pantry.  Three globes, hovering soundlessly just below the teak ceiling, cast a warm, bright glow around this tidy space.  Nestled under the shelves, a white enameled stove sits between an onyx marble wash basin and an arched stained oak door, which leads back out to the parlour.  The floor, done in black and white marble tiles and inlaid with the golden wyvern of House Vaalor, is spotless.
location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Temple Burrow, Ice Chamber]
[A Small Icy Room]
description: Streaks of dirty ice intertwine with veins of purest crystal within the walls surrounding you.  The light shining through the striations forms odd shadows and unearthly glitters all around you.

title: [Beacon Hall Annex, Commons Park]
description: Shielded by a thick evergreen hedge, this broad expanse of lush green lawn provides a welcome respite from the chaotic world just beyond the arch.  Not many steps away, a large and elegantly drooping willow provides a shady resting place.  Further in and across the way, an open gazebo shelters a rope hammock, several comfortable looking pillows, and a wobbly tea cart.  A pebbled path meanders over to the far corner, leading to a large glass-domed sandstone building.

title: [Caytlin's Armory]
description: Beneath a sparkling crystal dome, a gallery of wedding portraits hangs on one of the white birch walls.  An antique rosewood dowry chest and a stately armoire sit in opposite corners while a pure white aisle runner rests on a silver-tinged marble floor.

title: [Atision's Weaponry]
description: Textured black silk walls rise from a glossy black ebonwood floor.  Just above a serene golden wyvern fountain hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a high arched ceiling completes the picture.  A iron-bound ebonwood chest and an intricately carved ebonwood stand stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Beacon Hall Annex, Gallery]
description: With floor-to-ceiling windows and creamy ivory walls, this room is a showcase of statuary and exhibits.  Stretching across one side, a long glass case protects an array of important and delicate items.  In contrast, displays of battle memorabilia command attention throughout the rest of the room, plush benches scattered between.  A spiral staircase affixed with a sign leads upward, while a guard stationed near a graceful arch prevents casual visitors from further exploration.

title: [Beacon Hall Annex, Loft]
description: A chandelier provides sufficient visibility while the light plays off the vaulted ceiling.  An iron balustrade spans the wide balcony overlooking the gallery below.  Heavy cherrywood bookshelves span the full length of the wall opposing the balustrade, their repository of texts accessible by a rolling ladder.  The stucco walls are embedded with fragments of colorful sea glass and striated clam shells.  A pair of red velvet chairs, separated by a modest low table, are stowed away at the far corner.

title: [Beacon Hall Annex, Lounge]
