Silvery moonlight and sweet scents spread through the room from the wide opening that the archway creates.

title: [Locus Lyceum, Clerk's Office]
description: Screens painted with orange lotus blossoms create a protective barrier around the eastern and northern curve of the room, while the western curve is fashioned of dark green bamboo poles.  A glass-topped white rattan desk is positioned catty-corner to the room's only true corner and is arranged so that the person sitting in the rattan chair can watch both the western and southwestern corridors with an unhindered view.

title: [Mist Harbor, Jungle Path]
description: At the end of the path through the jungle, a great wooden arch looms at the edge of a small clearing.  A large longhouse can be seen up ahead with an expanse of green lawn that circles the structure.  Several out-buildings recessed into the enveloping jungle are all but hidden from view in the thick foliage

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Courtyard]
description: Leading away from the arch, the dirt path moves around a long teak hall covered with flowering vines on either side.  A pair of stone wildcats flank the entry to the main hall, their stone skin adorned with a lattice of vines dotted with colorful jungle flowers.  Sounds of swords and shields bashing mingle with the general noises of camaraderie that drift from deeper in the compound.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Entry]
description: Placed to the side of the entrance, a suit of plate armor stands guard, while on the opposite side, a small gold plaque is affixed to the wall.  Hanging from bronze chains, a chandelier holds dozens of lit candles, their flickering lights illuminating the granite floor and the sandwich-board sign resting on it.  The room splits in two northerly directions, with short hallways that lead deeper into the structure, and between them a narrow flight of stairs heads up to the next floor.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Practice Room]
description: Rows of tackling dummies line the walls of the room.  Several wooden benches are placed in small clusters, providing a place to rest between exercises.  A rounded iron arch is set into the nearby wall, leading to a small office space which can be glimpsed through the opening.  Two small hallways lead away from this room, and a descending flight of stairs occupies the space between them.

title: [Caldarium, Pool]
description: Deep azure tiles line the floor and walls of the recessed pool creating a pattern that fans out from darkest to lightest.  The heated water coupled with the warm air caresses the skin, soothing the sorest of muscles.  Three white stone stairs lead up to the room above.

title: [Bathhouse, Caldarium]
description: Lined with tiny glass chips, their patterns on the floor create a bright mosaic whose colors sharply contrast the dark wooden walls.  A rounded stone basin stands to one side of a laquered oak door, its warm water glistening in the deep recess.  A large heated pool ripples along the length of the room, beautiful azure tiles coloring the bottom.  A crimson curtained arch leads out of the room, while three white stone stairs descends into an azure-tiled pool.

title: [Bathhouse, Tepidarium]
description: Lined with bronze, a circular fire pit dominates the room, a basket of wood placed to the side.  The wooden walls shine, their lacquered surface polished and gleaming in the moonlight.  Several stone benches line the walls between a crimson curtained arch and an indigo curtained arch, warm air circulating all about.

title: [Bathhouse, Frigidarium]
description: Tall glass windows allow sunlight to slip in through the thick foliage outside.  Stone steps lead down into a small pool, large enough for swimming.  An indigo curtained arch keeps the chilled air inside the room, cooling the water, while a polished oak door stands partially closed for the same reason.

title: [Bathhouse, Apodyterium]
description: A domed glaes ceiling arcs above, the roof is shadowed by trees from outside.  Stone benches line the walls, their length broken by a stained glass door and a polished oak door on the other.  Beside each door, several hooks hang above small nooks, the perfect place for storing belongings.

title: [Frigidarium, Pool]
description: Chilled water fills the deep stone pool that fits into the length of the room.  Large enough to swim laps, the pool adds cool refreshment to the other workouts available in the guild.  Two stone pillars carved into a pair of swords mark the steps leading back up.

title: [Bathhouse, Laconicum]
description: Steamy air swirls throughout the room, its wooden walls and a stained glass door glisten with condensation.  Several large bronze braziers scattered about glow with banked embers, water-filled ceramic urns evaporating humidly over them.  Carved stone benches lie to either side of a laquered oak door, and across the room are the entrances to several private saunas.

title: [Bathhouse, Central Atrium]
description: Continuing to the center of the atrium, the lattice work roof shades a grassy circle below.  Growing in the center of the area, a beautiful miniature red maple fans its hanging leaves over the ground.  The path continues on to the entrance of a lacquered wooden building.

title: [Bathhouse, Atrium]
description: Stepping down three stone steps, the jungle closes in, creating a garden walled in by verdant greenery growing about carved wooden columns.  A latticework of blossoming vines crisscrosses between, creating a fragrant ceiling for the walkway.  Sunlight streams through, patterning the ground below and illuminating a garden path leading deeper into the complex.

Stepping down three stone steps, the jungle closes in, creating a garden walled in by verdant greenery growing about carved wooden columns.  A latticework of blossoming vines crisscrosses between, creating a fragrant ceiling for the walkway.  Moonlight streams through, patterning the ground below and illuminating a garden path leading deeper into the complex.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Northeast Lawn]
description: Overwhelmed by the surrounding jungle, a large teak building disappears into the greenery.  A grouping of amber and chime trees grows on either side of the path, their trunks surrounded by bushes and huge leafy ferns.  Standing off to the side is a monkey topiary that seems to be hopping on one leg.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, North Lawn]
description: Standing majestically, two large dragon topiaries guard the back wall of the hall, their wings outstretched.  Several large canopy trees tower over the area, fireflies flit among the branches, and flower laden vines creep down their trunks.  A tall wooden gate breaks the thick hedge that encircles the guild compound.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Practice Ring]
description: Clear of greenery, a large bare circle is surrounded by crude wooden bleachers, tendrils of orchid vines twine about the legs.  Towering trees partially branch out over the area, blocking the moonlight.  Nearby, a hollowed stump buzzes with activity as a hive of honey bees go about their business.  A tall wooden gate leads through an expansive hedge wall that marks the perimeter.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Northwest Lawn]
description: Thick brush and shrubs act as a hedge between the Guild grounds and the dark of the jungle, its length broken by a large wooden shed.  A tiger-shaped topiary threatens to pounce from its position near the shed entrance.  Several red sandalwood trees grow along the path circling the guild hall.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Woodshed]
description: Discarded boxes lay scattered about the old storage shed, their contents long gone.  Bits of leaves and dead grass cushion the floor among rusting gardening tools and crushed clay pots.  A bag of seeds rests against the far wall, seeds leaking out from a hole chewed in the side.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, West Lawn]
description: Standing back against the jungle hedge is a large indigo and gold canvas pavilion, a pair of spiraling topiaries to either side of the opening.  Several balsawood trees tower above, shading the area, and moving slightly when an errant breeze catches the branches.  Ropes of flower laden vines cascade down the side of the hall and over an out cropping of rock nestles against its wall.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Guild Shop]
description: Crates and boxes stamped with the Warrior Guild insignia are stacked about the spacious pavilion, its canvas walls rippling as the jungle breeze catches them.  A large board across two barrels serves as a make-shift counter.  Iron racks filled with weapons and armor stand off to the side.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Southwest Lawn]
description: Several varieties of tropical canopy trees tower overhead, vines trailing down their thick trunks and buttressed roots.  A panther-shaped topiary stands to one side of a large wooden building, guarding the entrance.  Some flowering jungle shrubs continue between the structures, creating a natural fence about the guild's outbuildings.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Workshop]
description: Sawdust covers the wooden floor ready to absorb any spills.  Small cans of dye and paint are stacked in the corner while a variety of material swatches rest in a crate to the side.  Tools of all shapes and sizes hang from ordered hooks on the walls, clean and polished ready for use.  A scarred workbench dominates the far wall its surface marred from years of use.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, East Lawn]
description: Draped in flower laden vines, the north end of a wooden building is barely seen under the thick verdant blanket.  Covered in large white flowers, a row of elephant ear bushes line the path.  Several balsawood trees provide shade over the area, their outstretched branches mingling with the cedar tree to the south to create a thick canopy over the lawn.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Southeast Lawn]
description: Recessed into the jungle foliage, a crude wooden building continues to the north.  A tall tropical cedar tree shades the area, its buttressed roots settled against the walls of the structure.  A large lion topiary stands off to one side rearing up on its hide legs.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Woodshed]
description: Stripped branches of various sizes lay about the dirt floor in a haphazard pile.  A stack of cut logs lines the wall of the shed, a smaller basket of kindling to the side.  Slightly rusted, a variety of axes hang from between pegs in the wall.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Woodshed]
description: Piles of axe-cut boards are stacked against the wall, slightly warped and long forgotten.  A few pieces lean against the rest knocked out of place.  Stacked in the corner, several battered boxes filled with rusted woodworking tools gather dust.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Shop Backroom]
description: Piled with boxes and crates storing various weapons, materials and armors lay stacked about the small back area.  A large canvass tarp covers the form of an old iron forge, dust and cobwebs give testimony to its lack of use.  A large mithril sign hangs from a wooden post near the opening.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Dining Hall]
description: Twin tables run the length of the room parallel to each other, long wooden benches on the plank floor to either side of them.  Standing as host, a suit of black iron armor is positioned near the short hallway leading to the entry.  A large stone fireplace dominates the northern wall, a basket of sticks to one side and an archway to the other

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Kitchen]
description: Large enough to fit a whole beast, a huge stone fireplace fills almost the entire wall opposite the curtained archway.  Shelves of cooking supplies rest on the grey stone floor, against the wall on one side of the room, and a narrow wooden door is wedged between them.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Closet]
description: Shelves line the walls of this small closet, cleaning supplies and other items needed throughout the guild are stored here.  A wooden bin stands to one side of the narrow wooden door, with a tool rack on the other.  Dusty boxes and discarded items litter the floor.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Great Hall]
description: Open and airy, this large room is a gathering place for guild members.  Masters stand on the floor against the walls, waiting to help warriors in need of training.  Twin sets of bronzed armor stand to either side of a a steel-banded wooden door, bearing upright pikes.  Wooden benches are scattered about, offering places to rest after a session.  Regularly spaced roofline vents admit breezes and the raucous cries of jungle creatures, causing bright standards to flutter proudly from the overhead rafters.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Master Office]
description: Centered in this spacious room is a copper-inlaid table surrounded by high-backed chairs, a dark crimson carpet underneath.  Stacked with piles of parchment, a carved wooden desk rests against the back wall.  A suit of steel armor stands at attention to one side of a steel-banded wooden door, while a teak-framed portrait hangs to the other.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Office]
description: An ancient suit of vultite armor stands on the floor as sentry beside the arch to the office.  A wooden desk dominates the room, piled high with papers and scrolls, a sword laying across the top of it all.  A banner hangs from the back wall bearing the Warrior Guild Crest.  Set into the wall at the back of the room, two large alcoves house wooden stage doors in one and metal stage doors in the other, leading off to other rooms.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Metal Door]
description: Free from any decorations, the room is barren and empty except for a frame supporting a large metal stage door.  The walls and floor bear the scars of many years of exercises.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Wooden Door]
description: Free from any decorations, the room is barren and empty except for a frame supporting a large wooden stage door.  The walls and floor bear the scars of many years of exercises.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Darkened Room]
description: Very little light breaks through the darkness that envelopes the room, its windowless walls painted a pitch black.  The smallest glow flickers from inside a tank in the corner filled with murky water, ripples on the surface evidence of something inside.  Shelves neatly lined with jars and bottles cover the far wall, their contents unrecognizable in the gloom.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Wheel Room]
description: Placed along the far end of the room, a row of workout wheels groan and creak as their mechanisms turn ready to catch a guild member off guard.  Near the front of room, large sofas rest against the walls, offering respite from the rigors of training, and a small table near the southwestern hallway holds a cold beverage.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Cold Storage]
description: Layers of sawdust cover the floor and blocks of ice are stacked about the room, helping to keep them frozen in the chill underground.  Several frozen chunks of ice lay on the ground, having dropped away from the rest.  Sloping up to the arch, the north end of the room moves back towards ground level.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Ice Tubs]
description: Dark wooden walls keep out all light helping the air to keep its chilled edge.  Filled to the top with chunks of ice, rows of ceramic tubs line the opposite wall from the arch.  Layered over the smooth stone floor, shredded woodchips crunch under feet, absorbing any moisture that drips to the ground.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Cold Storage]
description: Stacks of tightly packed blocks of ice are nestled next to the earthen walls.  A variety of tongs and picks hang from cast iron hooks on the walls, in easy reach for moving the frozen water.  Peppered with sawdust, the frozen heaps insulate each other, keep them from melting.  Several large hunks of ice are scattered carelessly about the room.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Cold Storage]
description: Inside the door, the floor slopes downward into a partially subterranean room.  Near the walls are tightly packed ice blocks.  Sawdust covers the frozen piles, keeping them from melting.  A few uneven chunks are separated and placed haphazardly about the center.

title: [Bathhouse, Atrium]
description: Continuing around the main buildings, the garden path is lined with blooming flowerbeds.  Several carved marble benches are placed in secluded nooks in the greenery.  The vines above give shelter, cooling the area.

title: [Bathhouse, Atrium]
description: Moving along the smooth wood of the building, the walkway ends at a bench recessed in a nook carved into the wall.  Several flowering bushes grow to either side of the secluded area screening the area from the rest of the atrium.  Thick vines drape down from above creating a curtain of colorful blossoms and greenery.

title: [Fantas-Stick]
description: The large hollow has been carved into the interior of the beech tree's trunk.  The warm tones of the natural wood are brightened by the moon's light that streams through a small arched opening off to one side of the circular aperture.  In the far back, a table carved from the trunk resides comfortably, while a niche provides additional storage space.

The large hollow has been carved into the interior of the beech tree's trunk.  The warm tones of the natural wood are brightened by the sun's light that streams through a small arched opening off to one side of the circular aperture.  In the far back, a table carved from the trunk resides comfortably, while a niche provides additional storage space.

title: [Tapped Out]
description: A few loose boards have been strategically placed across branches to form the floor, and sheets of moss drape from above to enclose the small nook.  A thick limb juts up between two floorboards before twisting sharply and poking out through the moss.  A slight gap in the moss leads to a small alcove.

title: [Tapped Out, Alcove]
description: Long, draping sheets of moss lightly brush the outer edges of the loose boards that criss-cross the lower branches.  Snaking around most of the room, at just the right height upon which to relax, is a gently curving bough.  Nearly hidden in a shadowy corner is a slight gap in the moss.

title: [Sew Lovely]
description: Tiny pinpoints of pale blue light twinkle throughout the thatched roof, casting sparkling illumination across the interior.  Moving shadows created from hanging paper lanterns flit here and there, dancing and swaying subtly from the breeze coming through the archway entrance.  A trio of mannequins are nestled to one side of a beaded curtain and a small display case occupies the opposite wall.

Sunlight trickles through the thatched roof and archway entrance, casting dappled illumination across the wares.  A subtle breeze moves throughout the room, bring with it a bit of relief for the humidity and faint sounds of the jungle.  A trio of mannequins are nestled to one side of a beaded curtain and a small display case occupies the opposite wall.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: This dark, cavernous room smells like a slaughterhouse.  Bodies in varying states of extended decomposition, from mummies to bare bones, litter the floor.  A dim light comes from a pot set high on the wall.  There is a dark hole in the wall here, which seems to lead upwards while gloomy passages lead away in three directions.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Entry Way]
description: Arrow slits ominously line both sides of the wooden entryway leading from the outside to the inside of the Hendoran outpost.  Just wide enough to allow a wagon to squeeze through, the hard-packed earthen floor slopes inward guiding absent feet to the center of the space.  Overhead three trapdoors punctuate the length of the ceiling between a thick oaken gate on one end and a black iron portcullis on the other.

title: [Outpost, Outer Courtyard]
description: A pair of Hendoran soldiers stand at attention on either side of a black iron portcullis which leads outside the outpost.  Beyond them, the courtyard fills a space between the outer wooden wall and an inner wall made of stone, where a fortified keep rises behind it.  Above, imperial soldiers slowly walk the parapet of the outer wall, their eyes focused on the horizon.

title: [Outpost, Outer Courtyard]
description: Lines of archery targets line the interior side of the outpost wall and makeshift attack dummies, scarecrow-like figures bound to wooden stakes, join them as tools to keep the Hendoran martial edge sharp.  Several crates of wooden practice swords and shields are neatly stacked along the wall.  A squat building sits off to the side with several bales of hay placed nearby, along with a barrel of lye.

title: [Outpost, Outer Courtyard]
description: Guards flank the outpost's second portcullis, the entryway into the interior of the Hendoran's compound.  Both soldiers clutch halberds and gaze directly forward from under polished helms.  The inner wall, built of stone, looms up over the entryway with arrow slits running the length of the visible wall.

title: [Outpost, Outer Courtyard]
description: Four raised garden beds fill the courtyard with a wide crushed gravel path passing through vegetable staples to the Hendoran stables.  The whinnying and neighing of horses continually fill the air and accompany the sounds of uniformed auxiliaries moving about the gardens and in and out of storage sheds built along the wall.  Periodically, mounted Hendorans ride their horses southward to the main entrance of the outpost, while others return from the same direction and disappear into the stables.

title: [Abandoned Barn, Stall]
description: The lower half of the stall is made of crumbling stone.  Rust marks are all that is left of the iron gate that shut one stall from the next.  Molding hay lines the manger and fills the air with the scent of decay.

title: [Icemule Trace, Airship Hangar]
description: Massive in height and size, large gear assemblies and ropes are tethered off throughout the hangar.  A series of tall iron beams curves into a framework shaped like an open ribcage.  Several stacks of wood, fabrics, and assorted metals are piled up all around the hangar.  A long wooden beam and two barrels form a makeshift workbench, with a wooden bench and a slightly torn divan facing it.

title: [Outpost, Latrine]
description: The narrow interior of the building contains only a bench with several holes cut out along its length.  A strong odor of lye and hay emanate from the holes with just the slightest scent of urine and feces.  Discarded copies of a Wehnimer's Landing newspaper lay within arm's reach of the bench across the floor.

title: [So Shifty]
description: Smooth oak panelling frames the small room, and a dark wine rug spreads out across the flooring.  A curvy oak mannequin is nestled in the center with a squat oak table positioned nearby.

title: [The Blood Red Rose, Park]
description: Though neatly trimmed, the hedges and trees bordering the wrought iron fencing enclosing this small area may as well be dead, their foliage a dull brown hue, each leaf seemingly barely hanging onto its native branch.  A gravel lane leads up to a well-kept white building, though a second pathway splits off from it to circle around to the back of the structure.  Settled on either side of the gravel halfway down the path, two stone benches are flanked by rose bushes bearing vibrant red roses and verdant-hued leaves.

title: [A Winding Path]
description: The rich loamy scent of damp earth, strong but not unpleasant, hangs in the air, and dappled moonlight filters down through the towering trees.  All around, the chirps and calls of various birds can be heard, as can the telltale rustling of small animals scurrying through the brush.  Dense foliage threatens to overtake a winding path as it cuts a narrow trail through the encroaching forest to an old farmhouse a short distance away.

All around, the chirps and calls of various birds can be heard, as can the telltale rustling of small animals scurrying through the brush.  Dense foliage threatens to overtake a winding path as it cuts a narrow trail through the encroaching forest to an old farmhouse a short distance away.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Garden]
description: Secreted away amidst towering cedars and firs, this quaint garden has a simple, wild charm.  Decorative hedges line a moss-lined cobbled walk as it winds its way towards a short flight of steps that lead up to a white clapboard house.  On either side of the walkway, a quartet of evenly spaced raised planting beds teem with wildflowers.  Cutting through the grid of abundant color, a faint footpath leads to a side yard.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Porch]
description: Somewhat sheltered from the elements, the dark slate floor of this deep, covered porch runs the entire length of the humble abode.  Standing at the top of a short flight of steps leading down to the garden, a freshly painted crimson door invites guests inside.  Flanking the door, two pairs of scuffed utilitarian benches provide ample seating.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Side Yard]
description: Faint outlines of old raised planting beds, a neat pile of gardening tools, and tidy stacks of discarded placards hint at the former life of this space.  Now nothing but potted trees, hundreds lined up in methodical rows, grow in the expanse of this large yard.  Smaller cuttings and tiny tree starts cover the surface of a pitted worktable that rests up against the wall of the old farmhouse, between a plain wooden rack and a whitewashed split door.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Parlor]
description: A bright crimson door opens into a large space with old, weathered wood plank floors that sprawl out beneath a low ceiling with rough, exposed beams.  Neat rows of lightweight, folding cots are pushed up against three of the room's bare walls, each with its own cleverly designed swinging tray stocked with ample bandages and tinctures.  The fourth wall breaks from the ceiling at a steep angle, revealing a narrow staircase.  Opposite the stairs, in a gap between two fresh cots, a whitewashed split door leads outside.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Attic]
description: Wall-to-wall bookshelves enclose this space, their contents carefully ordered.  Across the room from a narrow staircase leading down, a heavy oak desk sits next to a modest cream linen chaise.  Under a small window overlooking the side yard below, a collection of scalpels, bamboo needles, and other implements have been laid out on a low steel table where they await their next use.

title: [The Blood Red Rose, Salesroom]
description: The entryway of the structure immediately opens up into a wide space.  Thick blood red carpeting streams across the floor, contrasting with the pristinely white walls, which are decorated with elaborate molding, and chandeliers dripping in black, red, and clear crystals create opulence within the spare, museum-like room.  Scattered between the various gold-inlaid display racks and stands, cushioned benches provide respite.  All but one door are shut and barred closed, and a rope hangs across the staircase leading upstairs.

title: [The Blood Red Rose, Contracts]
description: Like the entryway, this room is styled with molding-accented white walls, a crystal-decked chandelier, and, underfoot, plush, blood red carpet.  A glass case stands in the center of the area.  Pushed up against one wall, a large statue is situated in such a way as to block a partially boarded-up doorway.

title: [The Penitent Petitioner]
description: Tucked against a crumbling wall and sheltered by large squares of oiled canvas, the small enclosure is swept clean of debris and the rough cobblestones of the road are scrubbed completely clean.  Burning tallows rest upon stones that have been tugged free of the wall to make tiny shelves, their slender waxy bodies bound in place by the melted remains of previous occupants.  Two alcoves, one draped in azure and gold and the other in ebon and silver, are lined with prayer benches for the penitent.

title: [Covert Couriers]
description: Heavy coats of black paint cover the windows of the room, smeared with just enough strokes to guarantee dubious privacy to the shoppers while still allowing in minute trickles of light.  Despite the scented beeswax candles placed haphazardly around the room, an astringent, almost metallic, scent lingers in the air.

title: [The Solar Nook]
description: Constructed of stone and mortar, the small alcove is semicircular in shape and scrubbed until the stones glisten with a brilliant white gleam.  Golden light spills from the apex of the ceiling's curve where a metallic sun fashioned of glass and backlit by candles blazes amid an azure backdrop painted into the smooth stones.  A low altar, draped with a simple cloth, resides along the back wall with a simple pew set before it, while a thick azure drape leads into a small enclosure.

title: [The Nebular Nook]
description: Constructed of stone and mortar, the small alcove is semicircular in shape and scrubbed until the stones glisten like the surface of a black pearl.  Silver light spills from the apex of the ceiling's curve where dozens of stars fashioned of metallic disks blaze in the candlelight amid a backdrop of purples, whites, and blues painted to resemble a nebula.  A low altar, draped with a simple cloth, resides along the back wall with a simple pew set before it, while a thick ebon drape leads into a small enclosure.

title: [Sprite Club]
description: Floor tiles of alternating colors spiral outward from a central mosaic of a sprite.  A thick teal trunk and a slender silver strongbox are set against opposing walls.  Spheres of light are suspended magically overhead, each tented with colored silks.  Pinned to the wall by two steel spikes is a rugged red rucksack.

title: [A Moment In Time, Studio]
description: Diffused sunlight spills through silk-veiled openings in the ceiling and casts a muted haze against pale crimson, raised panel walls.  Knotty pine shelves lined with paintbrushes, stacks of canvas, and other painting supplies, stretch from the entrance to the back of the studio where a raised platform showcases a couple easels.

title: [Bank of Bloodriven, Vault]
description: Cast in the dim light of wall-bound sconces, the thick steel enclosure of the vault reflects only the barest of shimmers across the small space.  A circular door with brass-mounted handles is latched firmly, keeping the contents safely out of view.  Beside the vault, a musty odor lingers near a stack of splintered crates where spilled coffee, torn leaflets, and empty lunch sacks mark the spot frequented by the hired guards.

title: [Bank of Bloodriven, Basement]
description: Dank and dark do not begin to describe the omnipresent ambiance of gloom in this fetid space.  Small mud puddles along the periphery merge with larger ones sunken in the center, leaving little room for navigating safely around the boot-sucking moisture that threatens glisteningly underfoot.  What light reflects off the muddy surfaces comes only from a few scattered torches mounted within iron brackets imbedded in the carved grey stone walls.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Storage]
description: Shielded lanterns flicker with faint candlelight from their recessed positions within the four corners of the small storage room.  Heavy with dirt and discarded dried herbs, the uneven floor transitions from packed dirt near an oak and copper door to roughly hewn planks that support a series of storage shelves.  A thick curtain along the southeastern wall seems as though it might provide access to the floors above, but the heavy nails driven into its edges prevent further investigation.

title: [Bank of Bloodriven, Foyer]
description: Planks of black oak are pinned diagonally in place by rounded, contrasting pegs driven through the subflooring.  A hanging chandelier, sporting dust-laden cobwebs and burnt out stubs of candles, dangles precariously overhead by a single remaining chain.  Centered in the generous space of the foyer is a claw-footed table, draped in somewhat mildewed black linen.  Atop the table rests a cut-glass vase encircled by a ring of dried flower heads, wilted petals, and crinkled, browning leaves.

title: [Bank of Bloodriven, Teller]
description: Bars of tarnished brass line the face of the enclosed teller cage, with only a narrowed open space beneath for the exchange of notes and silvers.  A black walnut desktop serves as a writing space for notes and ledgers, but the amount of deep blue ink spilled upon the scuffed leather blotter casts doubt as to the wisdom of placing important papers on its surface.

title: [Bank of Bloodriven, Dim Passage]
description: Sandwiched between the mortared walls of the building's exterior and the wood-panelled uprights that give shape to the rooms within, this narrow passage is barely wide enough to squeeze through, even when pressed sideways against the grimy surfaces.  The air is stale, with a pervasive mustiness that assaults the senses.  Though some light filters in from tiny cracks in the closely pressed walls, it provides little illumination and does nothing to the eliminate the claustrophobic feel.

title: [Bank of Bloodriven, Hallway]
description: Dark planks of scuffed wood run the length of the hallway traversing the banks' interior.  Several broken spots along the floor's edged molding show evidence of nocturnal visitors in the form of scattered rat droppings beside each crack and hole.  Dust motes swirl with the occasional flutter of air through the hall, but the greater accumulations of debris in the corners lie largely undisturbed.

title: [The Art of Lore, Salesroom]
description: Little has been done to tidy up this small, decrepit basement, its dirt floor littered with broken bricks, shattered jars, and other debris.  A solitary iron cauldron burns, illuminating a quartet of mannequins and a note.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.  Putrid sewage floats in the runoff water gathered in the well.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: This section of road is almost entirely hard-packed dirt, although pits the size of small stones hold their shape here and there.  A nondescript building stands on the eastern side, its front porch leaning to one side, while an unstable pyramid of cobblestones stands adjacent.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Portable Water Hole, Kitchen]
description: Wrapped in canvas and oilcloth, the wagon's roof is supported by enormous sea thrak ribs that are anchored to the low oak walls.  A pot-bellied cast iron stove is positioned in a corner behind a long modwir plank counter, its chimney rising between oak and canvas for ventilation.  Various copper pots, steel ladles, and cast iron pans are neatly arranged on hooks set into the back wall, and a copper-banded wooden barrel is set nearby.

title: [Dilapidated Driftwood Table]
description: Tucked away in a remote corner, this table is actually supported on one side by the wall it leans against.  The table top appears to be the side of a wrecked dinghy, and its legs are simply a few warped pieces of driftwood.  The whole thing is sun-bleached to such an extreme that it almost seems to have been whitewashed.

title: [A Flash Of Strength, Reception]
description: Large windows draped with faded cotton allow muted moonlight to breach the dim receiving room.  A worn oak table and benches sit before an old stone fireplace, hot coals glowing from within the firebox.  Thick, dirty rushes mixed with bits of dried food and drink cover the scarred wooden floor.

title: [A Flash Of Strength, Additions]
description: Woven from silk, a soiled tapestry hangs from the wall, its once-brilliant design faded with age.  Shelves line the crude walls, their lengths filled with a wide variety of helms.  Bits and pieces of armor accessories are stacks inside an iron-bound trunk.

title: [A Flash Of Strength, Arms]
description: Barrels and casks of staves and polearms stand to either side of a large wooden door.  Shining blades are lined up on a stand of polished modwir.  Other objects of weaponry are stacked inside some large crates.

title: [A Flash Of Strength, Defense]
description: Worn carpeting barely covers the old wooden floor.  Candles shed a dim light over the room, pale beams reflecting off armor displayed on large iron racks and stands.  A variety of shields are carefully presented on tiered shelving.

title: [The Cover Up, Men's Room]
description: Dark and reflective, the surrounding walls are covered in smooth ebony planks that have been secured with silver-headed nails.  A marble-topped iron stand with a small crystal bowl flanks one side of the entrance, and a pair of well-dressed mannequins have been situated in front of a tri-mirrored wall, giving the illusion of a much larger collection of display models.  Sheer black lace hangs over a doorway leading to the back of the shop.

title: [The Cover Up, Women's Room]
description: The back of the shop has been decorated marginally more than the front room but still lacks any flashy or ornate enhancements.  Delicate, candle-filled sconces provide the majority of lighting, while a recessed, double-paned window allows the moonlight to bathe the mannequins in warm, natural glow.  A doorway leads back into the men's section of the shop.

paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Bloodriven Bowery, Front]
description: Grimy, smoky lanterns cast shadows in the front of the tiny shop, and the scent of wood shavings and oil lingers heavily in the air.  Several crates and barrels are stacked up against one wall, while a pair of mannequins display wares on the other side of the room.  A moth-eaten curtained partition leads further into the shop.

Muddy light filters in from the grime-caked windows in the front of the tiny shop, and the scent of wood shavings and oil lingers heavily in the air.  Several crates and barrels are stacked up against one wall, while a pair of mannequins display wares on the other side of the room.  A moth-eaten curtained partition leads further into the shop.

title: [Bloodriven Bowery, Back]
description: The back room is cluttered with various shipping crates partially concealed with stained canvas tarps.  A small area has been cleared out to display a set of rickety shelves and a warped pine rack.

The back room is cluttered with various shipping crates partially concealed with stained canvas tarps.  A small area has been cleared out to display a set of rickety shelves and a warped pine rack which has a dark leather sack hanging on one side.

title: [Bare Aggression]
description: Cedar shavings, strewn haphazardly around a raised square ring in the center of the hall, fail to mask the lingering odor of stale sweat, smoke, and whiskey that hangs in the air.  Several padded bags, roughly humanoid in shape, are suspended from a long wall near a crooked equipment rack.  In one darkened corner, bawdy patrons congregate around a low table surrounded by mismatched chairs, while some others crowd around an iron-banded keg, spiritedly demonstrating advanced jabs, kicks, and punches.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard comes to an abrupt end here, surrounded on three sides by the high walls of the keep.  A number of merchant stalls litter this area, notable for their shabby construction as well as the extreme number of impressive-looking stains and scorch-marks.  By inference, this must be where the merchants who sell more volatile wares set up shop.  The ground underneath is almost entirely bare of straw, resulting in rather muddy conditions.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer Grate]
description: Dim light filters down from above a crooked ladder, reflecting off the wet slime that coats the stone walls of this dank, fetid passage.  An old tunnel sweeper stands in front of a rusty sewer grate.

title: [A Two-Story House, Entryway]
description: The muffled sounds of passersby trickle through the heavy metal-strapped door separating the entryway from the outside.  A thick bristly rug sits on the dark slate tile just inside the door as a token attempt to corral the mud and dirt from outside, and some polished brass coat hooks line one wall.  A wide crystal-paned door to the side leads into a dark-panelled room, and opposite it is a curving stairway.  Behind the stairway, the tantalizing smell of cooking wafts down a narrow hallway.

title: [Accessories Of Crime]
description: Plush velvet carpeting spreads from the top of the staircase throughout this cozy sitting room.  A long settee upholstered in pale ivory silk sits near the small curtained window with a sleek ebonwood case resting on its wide sill.  A massive ebonwood bookcase built into the far wall frames a small marble fireplace, and the cheerfully crackling fire within casts a warm flickering light over the contents of a velvet-lined basket set out on a small accessory table nearby.

title: [Cut And Dried]
description: The formal living area just past the wide crystal-paned door is lined with dark mahogany wainscoting, and a plush velvet rug protects the polished hardwood floors.  A large bay window fitted with a wide seating bench sits catty-corner to a polished marble fireplace, and the aromatic scent of smoke wafts through a curving archway in the wall opposite it.  Framing the archway is a tall apothecary rack and a polished glass-topped case.

title: [A Two-Story House, Smoking Room]
description: Several thick armchairs provide comfortable seating near some accent tables.  The placement of an imposing marble hearth and the high windows suggests the room was once a dining area, but the permeating smell of aromatic cigar smoke and the etched crystal decanter of brandy on the mantlepiece indicate an alternate use to the room now.  A wide archway across from the windows leads back to a living area, while a pair of glass-paned doors opposite the hearth offers a glimpse of a cozy kitchen.

title: [A Two-Story House, Kitchen]
description: A long kitchen island topped with heavy butcher's block is flanked on one side with a row of upholstered stools, and on the other by a brick hearth wall.  Pale moonlight filters through the muslin curtains of the high-set window, reflecting silver light off the droplets of water clinging to the spout of the wrought iron hand pump in the heavy ceramic sink below.  Faint light can be seen down a narrow hallway, and beyond the row of stools are a pair of glass-paned doors.

A long kitchen island topped with heavy butcher's block is flanked on one side with a row of upholstered stools, and on the other by a brick hearth wall.  Warm sunlight and a cool breeze stream through a high-set window, setting its muslin curtains fluttering and reflecting brightly off the droplets of water clinging to the spout of the wrought iron hand pump in the heavy ceramic sink below.  Faint light can be seen down a narrow hallway, and beyond the row of stools are a pair of glass-paned doors.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Jagged granite walls appear to have been carved directly into the mountain creating a wide corridor stretching to the north.  The bottom spikes of an enormous iron portcullis stick out of the rocky ceiling.  Each wall is lined with flickering oil lanterns, hung on the walls and evenly spaced with a variety of suits of armor that stand at attention.  A thick, blood red rug stretches the length of the dark stone corridor and into the shadows beyond.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Foyer]
description: Branching in either direction, the long stone corridor arches outward in a slow curve about the area that is visible up a set of stone steps, a large steel suit of armor standing to either side.  Carved into the stone overhead is the word, "DUSKRUIN".  Another smaller dark passageway angles downward toward the bowels of the arena.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: A long row if crossbows line the upper wall over evenly spaced suits of armor that line the passageway, each positioned to hold its weapon as if on guard duty.  The hall curves with the arch of the inner arena, burning iron sconces lighting the way.

A long row of crossbows line the upper wall over evenly spaced suits of armor that line the passageway, each positioned to hold its weapon as if on guard duty.  The hall curves with the arch of the inner arena, burning iron sconces lighting the way.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Suits of armor in gilded silver, bronze and gold line the passageway as it arches about the exterior of the arena.  A well-worn red rug centers the stone floor between either row, while overhead hang a variety of weapons on display.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Leading up into the arena stands, a set of stone steps have shattered with long cracks splintering off into the walls and nearby floor with sand poured into the cracks, leaving the steps uneven.  A crimson banner hangs overhead emblazoned with a gold fringe and bold lettering.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Mounted along the wall are the heads of various beasts, ogres, trolls and undead, each carefully preserved as a trophy with a bronze plaque below.  In the low light, each cast long shadows down the rough stone wall, their false glass eyes glinting.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Intricately carved into the wall of the corridor is a depiction of a grand battle.  Fighters do battle with gnarled ogres and decaying undead, while other adventurers fire arrows or throw spells from other corners of the engraving.  Burning iron sconces are fastened to the wall at either side, their light emphasizing the deep grooves as shadows across the scene.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: A pair of oversized greatswords hang above a set of stone steps, leading up into the arena seating, the corridor lined with iron sconces that provide flickering light.  Other weapons of a wide variety are mounted to the back wall, serving as ominous decor.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Appearing less traveled, a few of the iron sconces lining the walls have burnt out, leaving dark patches along the narrow stone corridor.  Dust covers a few suits of armor, standing alone and forgotten in the shadows.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Tanned bear and wolf hides line the walls, the plaques below them declaring them as trophies slain by valiant combatants within the arena.  Otherwise the narrow corridor is unadorned as it arches about the exterior of the arena.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: To either side of a set of stone steps stands a large suit of armor, one in golvern and the other in vultite, each polished to a shine.  Above them, carved into the stone itself are large letters spelling out the word, "DUSKRUIN".

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Curving slightly, this narrow corridor of stone is lined with tattered banners behind battered suits of armor.  Thick animal hides of various sizes and species serve as throw rugs to adorn the otherwise grey stone.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Adorned with colorful banners and lined with burning iron sconces, this narrow stone passageway arches along the outer curve of the arena itself.  The cries and cheers from the crowd within the arena can be heard echoing throughout the hall.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Descent]
description: Forking in several directions, this tunnel appears to have been carved directly into the mountainside, the walls still baring the scars from the picks and tools used.  Flickering iron sconces provide an uneven light, causing shadows to dance lazily across the slate floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, up, down

title: [Duskruin Arena, Sands Approach]
description: Still visible beneath a thin layer of sand, dark stains mar the stone floor, the coloring that of dried blood creating a grisly pathway through the entrance to the arena itself, just visible ahead.  Bright torchlight illuminates the arena beyond, spilling through into the otherwise dark corridor.  A ramp leads slightly downward to another arena entrance.Still visible beneath a thin layer of sand, dark stains mar the stone floor, the coloring that of dried blood creating a grisly pathway through the entrance to the arena itself, just visible ahead. title: [Duskruin Arena, Descent]
description: Sloping downward, smooth stone tunnel ends at an expansive stone archway, the floor lined with black slate tiles.  Iron sconces line either wall, providing uneven lighting to the hall.  The air seems to hang thick with the metallic scent of blood, though a few workers mingle about the area with buckets and mops, keeping the floor clean.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Descent]
description: Sloping downward into the mountainside, the dim tunnel ends at an expansive stone archway that serves as the entrance to a bright chamber beyond. To one side, another tunnel appears to have once been started, but never finished, leaving deep gouges in the walls.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Dungeon]
description: Shackles and chains hang from the walls, with soiled mounds of straw heaped into the corners.  The air hangs thick with the scent of mildew and rot, with only a few lanterns hanging from the walls providing very dim lighting amid the stalls.  Some of the areas are sectioned off creating individual cells, presumably for the more dangerous denizens kept here.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Dungeon]
description: Expanded in a large circle, the room is filled with stalls and cells with thick steel bars.  Chains and shackles hang from the walls in large quantities, while straw coats much of the floor.  At the center of the room is a large platform secured at the corners with massive chains, the device able to be lifted to the arena above.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Southern Arc]
description: Hot, bright fires burn in iron iron baskets that have been mounted in regular intervals high on the walls of this large cavern.  Centered in the subterrane is a circular arena with a sand-covered floor.  The air carries the lingering scent of the oil used to keep the dust at a minimum.  Sloping rows of stone benches surround the floor in twelve sections, each allowing for a different spectator view.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Niveous Chamber]
description: Below an arched stone ceiling dangles a twisted chandelier dangling from a coiled iron chain.  Rough stone walls have been carved out and whitewashed, with the chamber clean and well kept.  Long shelves have been carved along the walls and are stocked with bandages, potions and other apparent remedies.  A long row of small beds line the opposite wall, each covered in white sheets.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Stygian Annex]
description: Long rows of shelves covered in various wares, weapons and equipment, line the entirety of the back wall behind a long polished granite countertop.  A large chandelier hangs from a coiled chain at the center of the room, its tongs holding glass orbs that glow with a white arcane light.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard extends into a rather grubby stretch of land liberally punctuated with banners, flags, and hand-painted signs that invite festival goers to sample every delight the retreat has to offer.  An insufficient amount of straw has been trampled into the muddy ground creating a slippery walkway through the maze of merchant stalls.

title: [The Mar and Scar, Threshold]
description: Iron sconces line the stone walls, barely illuminating the narrow entryway.  Within the center of the room, a glass-topped red marble counter is draped with a cloth that spills out toward the floor.  A dark beaded curtain on the northern wall leads toward the back of the structure, while two passageways fork off around the curtain.

title: [The Mar and Scar, Inked]
description: Upon the northern wall is an old rack -- its rollers seized-up and inoperative.  Oddly shaped tools lie rusted on a small metal table near the torture device.  Several cushioned divans surround a lacquered bloodwood mirror in the center of the room.

title: [The Mar and Scar, Incised]
description: Along the eastern wall of the darkened alcove, a crimson glass display case gleams faintly in the dim light.  A sanguine-hued rug spills out from beneath the case, resembling a splattered pool of blood.  Off in the corner of the room lies an iron maiden, locked open for display.

title: [The Mar and Scar, Pierced]
description: A bloodjewel chandelier dims the surroundings, giving enough light to see the inventory strewn everywhere.  Spread out across the floor of the cramped room are treasure chests, each filled to the brim with piercing rings, half-rings, studs, spikes, and bars.  Small circular holes, some with iron thorns protruding from them, riddle the stone walls.

title: [The Mar and Scar, Concealed]
description: Standing in the center of the room is a large treasure chest filled with relics old and new.  A smoky haze obscures the area, with the only source of light coming from a poorly lit chandelier dangling over the chest.  A rickety wooden ladder leads above.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This cozy little warehouse almost has a boutique-like feel to it.  Individual displays are separated by large hanging tapestries and are individually attended by smartly dressed assistants.  A light perfume hangs in the air, continually refreshed by occasional spritzes from an unseen source.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: Numerous neatly labeled bins line the walls of this well-tended establishment, displaying a myriad of trinkets, doodads, and kitsch.  Large paned windows have been thrown open to allow ample natural light and the comforting island breeze into the shop, though not a speck of dust or sand is visible anywhere.  Thick, immaculate rugs, in neutral earth tones, cover the center of the open floorplan, providing soft, secure footing as the shopkeeper busily checks and rechecks each bin repeatedly.

title: [Khloake and Dagger, Sheaths]
description: The unfinished walls of the room support a few torches giving off sufficient light to examine the shop's wares.  The smell of oiled leather mixes with their scent.  At the far end of the room, a row of hooks hang directly over a large wooden box lined with soft grey felt, and a multi-armed display stand is situated near the entrance to the shop's next area.  A small sign has been nailed to a dented and punctured wood door.

title: [Khloake and Dagger, Daggers]
description: The very faint scent of mineral oil lingers in the air of the sparsely furnished, torch-lit room.  A chest of dark ironwood drawers stands near the back wall, and off to one side, a tall display case reflects the firelight.  A neatly inked card is tacked to the wall.

title: [Under the Counter]
description: The clean floor is comprised of octagonal clay tiles, each one painted with some type of glass or bottle.  A chandelier hangs over the counter, casting its light over the area.

title: [Under the Counter]
description: The walls of this perfectly square room are painted a pale fawn hue and bisected by a strip of pristine white molding.  Decorative yet functional brass sconces hang in the center of each, casting a warm glow over a pair of mannequins that stand on either side of a tall oak cabinet.  A deep gold velvet curtain on the opposite wall leads to the store room.

title: [Under the Counter, Store Room]
description: Tall metal shelves line three out of four of the room's walls, with only the wall around the curtained exit not supporting storage.  A shop sign sits upon one of the shelves, while all around it are supplies: empty glassware, towels, and, with no apparent commonality, a stuffed honey badger.

title: [Skyfire, Showroom]
description: Swathes of thick material are draped from the slanted ceiling, creating a billowing canopy.  Several mannequins line the walls of the shop, their armor and weapons gleaming in the pale light from several flickering candles.  A variety of sashes are stacked on a long counter standing center in the small room.

title: [Skyfire, Showroom]
description: Bright carpets cushion the wooden floor, while colorful lengths of silk drape from the ceiling.  Several mannequins stand in a circle in the center of the room.  Beautiful tapestries cover the walls, their bright threads creating the symbols of the six Dai of the Erithians.

title: [Ode To Resistance]
description: The walls of this crude hut look as if they could collapse at any moment, their half-rotted planks held together with bent nails and frayed rope.  The lone back wall displays a rusted iron plaque hanging at a slant over a row of large chests, trunks, and crates.  A single lantern hangs precariously from one of the rafters, providing a dim, flickering light.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This well-stocked warehouse contains a vast array of keepsakes and collectibles.  Carefully organized and maintained, it is clear that the keeper considers this a labor of love.  Attendants loiter in various places, awaiting the queries of any potential customer.

title: [Antiques, Baubles, And Trinkets]
description: Stacks of wooden boxes and crates are piled high around the small room overflowing with a wide assortment of trinkets.  Various bits and pieces of curiosity are stuffed inside several dust-covered display cases.  The walls are lined with wooden shelves cluttered with a tangle of items.  Attendants wander in and out of the aisles, pausing to peer inside a container before resuming their search.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: Numerous baubles and trinkets fill nearly every available nook and cranny of the building.  Dark and musty, a slight hint of dust and mildew hangs heavily in the air.  Sturdy shelves and deep oak bins strive fruitlessly to contain the jumbled mess.  Several attendents move confidently among the items, seemingly knowing exactly where everything is.

title: [Drawing The Line]
description: Wedged between the two adjoining buildings, the cramped shop measures only a few spans wide, the claustrophobic aura enhanced by the thick beams supporting the ceiling.  In contrast to the drabness, light trickling in from the window set in the narrow door reveals an abrupt end to the packed dirt from outside and glints off various metallic wares displayed along the plastered walls.  A squat little stove, crackling with burning wood, serves to keep the few refreshments on top piping hot and the shop's patrons warm.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Smoke Screen, Back Room]
description: A fire burns within a stone hearth, adding an aromatic haze to the area.  Several old chairs form a semicircle around the fireplace, with a small table nestled in-between, forming a quaint gathering area.  Off to the side, a velvet-lined display case's contents are evenly spaced and elevated on an incline to enhance their presentation.  A small placard has been perched on the top of the case.

title: [Rock Solid]
description: The utilitarian interior of the wagon could generously be described as spartan.  Not a single sign of inhabitation graces the area.  An engraved bow rack, a carved runestaff display, and a large weapon stand are the only furniture within the bare confines.  An oil lamp rests in the middle of the floor, illuminating its sparse surroundings.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Skyhigh Curiosities]
description: Piles of modwir cases are displayed about the small room, their insides lined with soft velvet to cushion the various treasures nestled within.  Several glass boxes in front of an arched postern door show off a wide variety of curiosities through clear panes.  Although the containers are organized haphazardly, a pair of attendants seems to know exactly where each requested item is.

title: [The Viridian Coil, Hallway]
description: Dimly lit, this narrow hallway is lined by dirty oil lanterns that hang at irregular intervals down the hall.  Thick dust and cobwebs collect on the drapes, this area of the tavern seeming a bit more neglected than others.  A thick black oak door stands at the end of the hall, while a small bronze-banded door is set into a small alcove to one side.

title: [The Viridian Coil, Bedroom]
description: Set beneath a canopy of faded black linen curtains is a mid-sized four-poster bed with a high carved headboard of thick black walnut.  Twin nightstands rest to either side bed, while a large oval mirror with a twisted gold frame stands against one wall.  Long black curtains frame a large bay window that overlooks the square outside, though the view is mostly obscured by a layer of filth on the glass.

title: [The Viridian Coil, Master Suite]
description: A large twisted chandelier hangs from a coiled chain at the center of the dome-ceilinged room, the candles upon it flickering with a magical, eerie blue light.  Below a massive embossed golvern shield that serves as the room's primary decor, a large canopy bed spans the back wall.  A small sidebar with a slate countertop stands opposite a large stained glass window in the shape of a massive green serpent.

title: [Hangman's Broken Bridge]
description: The gibbets for which the bridge is named are barely visible just beyond its northern end.  Heavy timbers make up the bridge and stretch out over the Cairnfang River as it flows west to the bay, but end in jagged splinters halfway across, preventing passage across to the northern side.  A blackened executioner's sword is thrust point first into the faint remains of a sigil-inscribed circle that is visible just before the bridge's abrupt end.

title: [Abbey Stables, Caravan Master]
[Abbey Stables]
description: The center of the stables has been turned into a makeshift office by an old maplewood counter that demarcates the workspace of a harried caravan master.  Framed by horse stalls along either wall, the hay-strewn space is well-lit and breezy, the air kept fresh by a large window along one wall that lets in a crisp, cold breeze.

Motes of dust float gently in shafts of light streaming into the stable through great holes torn from the thatched ceiling.  The hard-packed floor is littered with molding straw, from which puffs of dust arise with one's every movement.

title: [Aznell's Armory, Rooftop]
description: The southwest corner of the Town Square expands below the rooftop, as dark alleys snake in between wooden shops and buildings.  Guards can be seen in a ballista tower nearby, eyes scanning the horizon.

title: [Moot Hall, Citizen Lounge]
description: Two windows, high above a small display case, are set into the far wall, their panels providing adequate sunlight which brightens the room.  The glow from silver candlebras complements the natural light from outside.  A half-circle bar occupies one corner near a few comfortable sofas.  In the center of the room is an oval forest green rug, surrounded by broad russet leather chairs.  An ivory-handled door serves as the exit, flanked by tall wooden bookcases.

title: [Baile Dragan, Gateway]
description: This long, covered passageway, entered at either end through carved ironwood gates featuring a pair of intricately carved dragons, runs between the road and a large inner courtyard.  The space is lit by rush lamps set into the whitewashed walls, and shadows flicker along its length.  A faint, though not unpleasant, musty odor permeates the night.  Sounds from outside are muffled by the walls and the enclosing darkness.  The faces of those who pass by are barely discernible.

title: [Baile Dragan, Courtyard]
description: In the center of the courtyard a white tower rises skyward, light flickering in the windows.  Mossy pathways meander among the quiet oak trees leading from door to door in the circular structure that encloses the area.  A small pond, its surface dotted with floating candles, is nestled near some flower patches.  Living sapling benches, formed by intertwining branches near a stone shrine, offer places to sit and enjoy the night air.  Somewhere nearby an owl hoots his nighttime refrain.

title: [Baile Dragan, Triskelion Hall]
description: This large, open room is filled with successively higher rows of polished ebonwood benches, supported at each end by heavy, dragon-shaped legs of cast silver.  The walls are hung with magnificent tapestries worked in silver thread on a black background.  Each life-sized panel depicts a scene of a mortal and a dragon in some sort of interaction.  At the front of the room is a large dais, behind which the Ord an Dragan standard is displayed.

title: [Baile Dragan, The Wyrm's Rest]
description: Hazy with smoke from the wood fire and redolent of ale and other spirits, this spacious room is a gathering place for local residents.  In the center of the room, a fireplace with an immense circular hearth provides wanted warmth in winter and a cook-fire year round.  Tables and benches run the length of the room on opposing sides of the fireplace, with more at either end, and the floor is strewn with fresh rushes.  Bundles of fragrant herbs and bottles of brew line the shelves behind the serving counter

title: [Baile Dragan, Office]
description: An enormous, brick-faced fireplace with an elaborate mantel is the focal point of this warm and inviting room.  Two grey wingback chairs sit before a large desk flanked by tall candle stands, each bearing a triple-wicked candle that shines brightly, allowing business to be carried on well past sundown.  Opposite the fireplace is a large ebonwood bookcase filled with maps and leather-bound volumes of all colors and sizes.  Windows on the inner wall allow an unrestricted view of the night sky.

title: [Baile Dragan, Hall of Honor]
description: Octagonal in shape, this spacious, domed room is notable for the inlaid silver outline of a large dueling circle on the floor, enwrapped on seven sides by double-wide ebonwood prie-dieux with flame red velvet cushions.  On the eighth side of the room against the wall, is an imposing black iron chair on an elevated platform.  The upper portion of each wall is hung with a thick woolen tapestry woven in brilliant colors.  Several pairs of silver-bladed dueling swords hang on either side of the entryway.

title: [Moot Hall, Rooftop]
description: Dark slate runs across the roof of Moot Hall, providing solid footing and an impressive view of the town square below.  To the west, the great oak tree in the center of town rises up, partially obscuring the western side of the bazaar.

title: [Circle of Trees, Entry]
description: The pathway to this secluded circle of trees is flanked by low burning torches set into the ground.  Encroaching on either side, the edge of the jungle creates a green tunnel through which only the barest glimpse of the vegetation beyond can be seen.  The ring of trees stretches to the east and west, and a bright glow beckons from the clearing in the center.  Nearby, a tall teak tree with a massively thick trunk looms overhead and a trail of evenly spaced grooves leads up into its height.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Several wide planks and boards have been affixed to the massive teak tree that rises even further above this level with its spreading branches.  Twin rope bridges stretch in opposite directions, heading to neighboring platforms, and allowing access to other areas within the circle of trees.  From here, a trail of evenly spaced grooves heads down to ground level.  Hanging lanterns made with green glass jars illuminate the shady area, adding even more green to the verdant space.

title: [In Sprite Of It All]
description: Simplistic in design, the interior of the room is lit by strategically placed holes bored into the walls, creating an intricate criss-cross pattern as sunlight streams through their small openings.  Yellow-tinged wood, splotched with pale green lichen clusters, adds a natural decorative adornment that compliments the mottled brown tones dominating the room.  An elaborate wing design has been burned into a thin wooden board, the piece hanging over an oversized trunk fashioned from rough-hewn beech.

title: [Circle of Trees, Clearing]
description: This clearing is ringed by trees of varying sizes that grow so close together in some places as to almost form a living wall, while vines create curtains in the open spaces.  The scent of wood smoke lingers in the air, emanating from a roaring bonfire surrounded by a ring of stones in the center of the space.  Adjacent, a woven grass basket rests on a flat stone, and a pile of iron buckets stands at the ready.  Flecks of ash dance in the shafts of moonlight that penetrate the thick jungle canopy, and winding trails squeeze between the trees in several directions.

title: [Felthrop's Tent, Sand and Storm]
description: Amethyst silk walls mark the circumference of this circular room.  Dotted along the edge, a series of display containers offer up wares for perusal.  In between these, torches rest on twisted wire stands, the flames glittering off the items for sale, and a hanging wooden sign resides in a prominent location.  A silver-beaded curtain leads deeper into the tent, and the scent of flowers lingers in the air.

title: [Felthrop's Tent, Fire and Ice]
description: An open window takes up the majority of the back wall, allowing ample moonlight as well as errant breezes to enter the room.  At opposing corners of the opening, a deep brawling bin and a ranged weapons crate rest against the amethyst silk wall.  In the center of the floor, an edged weapons rack displays additional wares, while a hanging wooden sign resides above.  Opposite the window, a silver-beaded curtain hangs in a doorway, the tiny silver orbs clicking together when disturbed by the wind.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: Warm breezes consistently sweep the area, bringing with them the faint scent of brine, and rustling the leaves of the nearby rosewood tree.  A woven rope hangs down from some unknown height and it sways gently with the slow, steady movement of the branches high above.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Dark bark encapsulates the trunk of the rosewood tree around which various platforms and ramps have been affixed to thicker branches.  Hanging liana vines add a touch of color to the otherwise green and brown landscape.  A strong, sweet smell lingers in the air here, a mixture of the liana blooms as well as the rosewood tree itself.  Mingled with the vines, a woven rope disappears below the platform, heading toward the ground far below.

title: [Keep Your Pants On]
description: The room is filled with the strong scent of leather as countless handmade belts are displayed on hooks, in a case, and color-coded on a table.  An ornately carved rocking chair sits in the western corner of the room with a pile of leather scraps littering the ground around it.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: A banyan tree towers over this area and several platforms can be seen up in the wide branches above.  Liana vines hang down so that they create a flowering curtain directly in the path.  A thin trail between the two closest trees leads into the clearing in the center of the ring.  The scent of flowers is heavy in the mist-laden air, and it mingles with the faint ocean fragrance brought in on gentle breezes.

title: [Aeia's Aromas]
description: The curving wagon walls have been painted a pale sage green, while overhead, dozens of tiny pastel candles flicker on a shelf along the soffit.  Next to the entrance, a quaint hand-written sign hangs over a small round table, and a stone wishing well stands in the center upon a daisy-shaped rug.  A knotted tree branch arches over the steps leading to the back garden.

title: [Aeia's Aromas, Garden]
description: Swaths of bright fabric drape from tall, evenly-spaced posts, weaving over and under one another to create a rainbow wall of cloth that encloses the circular space.  Colorful paper lanterns hang in the trees along the circumference of the garden, while a tall walnut tree stands sentry in the center, its branches a canopy over an ornate iron bench.  Dozens of small tealights flicker amidst the delectable offerings atop a long serving table covered with a floral muslin tablecloth.  Next to the steps that lead into the wagon, a verdigris seed bowl on a twisted iron stand offers a treat for winged visitors.

title: [Napporium, Foyer]
description: Large cushions are stacked against the walls of the foyer, each stack of a varying size.  Scattered throughout the foyer are a couple dimly burning metal sconces, offering light to a single orange hook, a single green hook, and a black mannequin.  A makeshift wooden arch offers entry to a second wagon connected by a series of overlapping planks.

title: [Napporium, Nap Room]
description: The room is dimly lit by a small glowing lantern on the back wall.  Filling the room and equally spaced apart is a soft black bed embroidered with a wand, a soft white bed embroidered with a rolton, a soft blue bed embroidered with a moon, and a soft red bed embroidered with a wagon.  Next to the arch leading to the first wagon are a small wooden nightstand with a few refreshments.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: A massive circular platform surrounds the giant cedar tree in the center of the room.  Branches support the plank from below and also create a dome overhead of leafy green.  The scent of cedar is strong, emanating both from the tree and the platform itself.  Curtains of vines hamper travel in both directions, though rope bridges lie behind it, heading off to other platforms to the east and northwest.

title: [Floral Frippery]
description: Multiple panels of colorful linen have been tied to the higher extensions of the trees, creating a makeshift enclosure.  Stray tree branches have invaded the walls, causing small tears in the fabric.  Creaking sounds can be heard often as the circular platform sways in the breeze.

title: [Trulee's Trinkets]
description: Nestled into the large trunk of a hollow cedar tree, this small space is surprisingly cool and inviting.  Several iron-latticed lanterns hang from the smooth walls, casting a warm glow around the room.  Along the back wall are a row of wooden pegs and a shallow niche.  The floor is covered in a thick layer of cedar shavings, the slightest disturbance sending their heady scent into the air.  Several depressions have been carved into one side wall, creating a ladder which leads upward.

title: [Trulee's Loft]
description: Mounds of thick, spongy moss cover the ground in this cozy loft.  A large, octagonal lantern hangs from the slightly domed ceiling and sways slightly with the tree's movements.  Several depressions have been carved into one side wall, creating a ladder which leads downward.  The strong scent of cedar permeates the air.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Platforms at varying heights reside in the branches of the great banyan tree, their surfaces well worn with years of travel.  The branches continue upward toward the thick, leafy canopy, their leaves blocking out the moonlight.  A series of small glowing blue globes illuminate the area with an eerie light.  Several liana vines dangle down from the higher platforms, adding their sweet floral scents to the air.  Twin rope bridges extend in two directions, offering passage to the west and northwest.

The branches continue upward toward the thick, leafy canopy, their leaves blocking out the sun.  A series of small glowing blue globes illuminate the area with an eerie light.  Several liana vines dangle down from the higher platforms, adding their sweet floral scents to the air.  Twin rope bridges extend in two directions, offering passage to the west and northwest.

title: [Circle of Trees, Treetop]
description: Many branches converge here at this space near the apex of the canopy.  Where several larger branches intersect, a platform with raised edges resides.  Up here the swaying of the trees is pronounced, and the platform moves with every breath of wind as the leaves that create the ceiling rustle gently.  Large gaps in the canopy here offer windows where moonlight streams through in thick beams, illuminating the wooden floor.
