title: [Devinely Yours]
description: Gnarled walls of unevenly hewed bark make up this small hole of a space in the banyan's interior.  Despite the cramped quarters, air flows freely through small slats in the wood, bringing with it the scents and sounds of the jungle.  Small dewdrop-shaped lanterns of glass hang from above, illuminating the delicate branch-woven furnishings and vine-wrapped sign.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Wide branches of a beech tree support this sturdy wooden platform.  The only passage away from this area is a woven ladder of natural fibers that hangs down toward the ground far below and a single rope bridge that stretches to a platform to the southwest.  No bridge connects to the nearest platform to the north, though the span seems small enough to jump.  A small gourd attached to the tree collects rain water, and a steady dripping cadence is generated from the water that overflows.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: A beech tree with wide branches reaches toward the thick green canopy above, adding its leaves to the tapestry of green.  A carpet of moss and flowers softens footsteps, and the steady cadence of gentle dripping adds percussion to the sounds of jungle birds in the branches high above.  A woven ladder of natural fibers dangles near the mighty tree, nearly camouflaged with the pale bark of its trunk.

title: [Treasure Hollow]
description: A small, but well organized shop, as everything seems to be neatly organized and in its place.  A large silver chest sits in the far corner, out of the way.  A small glass display case sits in the center of the room, to draw eyes to it and make it the most prominent item in the room.  On the wall opposite the chest is a polished wooden clothes rack from which a selection of items hang.

title: [Knothole]
description: This large hollow has been shaped from the interior of the beech tree's trunk.  Smooth and warm, the wood flows from floor, to wall, to ceiling in one continuous form.  The rich scent of warm resin is nearly intoxicating.  A row of beechwood pegs seemingly grows from one wall.

title: [Sprunkle's Spectacles, Interior]
description: The interior of this cramped wagon is the picture of utter chaos.  Despite several neatly placed shelves on the back wall, goods lay strewn about in a haphazard manner.  A small counter and a full-length standing mirror are the only things that appear to be where they belong.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: A cluster of rosewood trees grows here, growing so close together as to create a tangled mass of branches that seems to meld into one gigantic tree.  Winding around the massive trunk is a thin trail that leads through the underbrush towards a clearing.  The faint scent of wood smoke lingers in the area, and a layer of mist clings to the spongy ground.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: A teak tree rises up into the misty canopy above, its highest branches lost in the tangle of those of the neighboring trees.  Overgrowing the trunk, a layer of vines, reaches all the way down to the forest floor and creeps into the nearby vegetation.  Ferns dot the landscape and the trail is lost for a moment before picking up again to either side.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: The branches of the large teak tree here extend upward, heading into the canopy above.  Several clusters of vines dangle down to ground level from some of them, their thick stems woven together like a natural rope.  An expansive platform of mistwood perches here as well, a pile of rocks sits to one side to use for defense.  Twin rope bridges extend to other platforms in trees nearby to the southeast and the west.

title: [Summer Shades, Southern Styles]
description: Soft white, yellow, and orange walls enclose this area of the tent, accompanied by sand-colored pillows arranged neatly in every corner.  Copper metal racks run along the center of the room, while the aroma of cinnamon swirls slowly in the air.

title: [Quality Clothier]
description: Shelves lining the walls show an assortment of materials used in making the goods offered for sale.  A large oak counter sits blocking access to the front of the wagon and a curtained doorway.  To the left of the counter sits a wide rack and over to the right side, some mannequins are placed up against the wall.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: A massive cedar tree occupies this space in the circle of trees, its branches reaching out to meet those of its neighbors.  The scent of cedar permeates the area, mixing with the heavy fragrance of patchouli that lingers in the air.  Carpeted by leaves and shreds of bark, the path around the trees is hard to follow here.  Branching off from the main path, a thin trail leads towards a clearing in the center.

title: [Thimbel's Threadworks]
description: This large cabin is warm, well-lit, and quite comfortable.  A fine selection of hand-tailored clothing is displayed upon a low wooden table in the room's center, and dozens of hats and other miscellaneous accessories line the shelves along the walls.  The slight scents of pipe tobacco and tanned leather mingle together to give this cabin a pleasant aroma.  An occasional quiet, high-pitched squeal from the east mars the otherwise tranquil setting.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: The sky is completely eclipsed by the leafy canopy above that creates a cool shade down on the forest floor.  The aerial prop roots of the great banyan tree that occupies this space have grown indistinguishable from the main trunk, rising well above head level.  Several deep grooves in the roots seem to be sturdy enough to support weight and would serve as a hand and toe trail up the face of the trunk.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: The aerial prop roots of a great banyan tree have been used here to suspend several platforms at varying heights, while the main trunk rises even higher into the air.  Deep grooves between the roots offer glimpses of the forest beyond, and some of them contain small offerings like bundles of herbs or dried flowers.  A set of parallel woven ropes extends to the east, affording tremulous travel at this height, while a thin wooden ramp extends to the southwest.

title: [In The Rough]
description: Seemingly thrown together in haste, the walls of this small hut are lashed together with bits of string and sinew.  Lopsided windows dot two of the walls, while a narrow doorway stands opposite to the entry.  A threadbare carpet of once bright hues covers the packed dirt floor, and a low glass display case sits centered on the fabric.  Overhead, several blown glass orbs illuminate the room with a softly diffused light, giving the space more opulence than it deserves.

title: [In The Rough, Workroom]
description: Many spaces between the rough plank walls offer occasional breezes from outside.  Sitting in haphazard intervals around the perimeter of the room is a series of padded wooden chairs.  One wall houses a narrow doorway, while a small table graces the center of the space, complete with a large lit candle that flickers with each passing gust and causes the gems on the wooden surface to glimmer faintly.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: Moonlight dapples the ground between the leaves of the nearby beech tree, touching on the ground around the base.  The floor is uneven here as many roots poke through the soil, creating natural obstacles and pitfalls for those not watching where they are stepping.  Meandering toward the clearing in the center is a thin trail carpeted with fallen leaves.

Meandering toward the clearing in the center is a thin trail carpeted with fallen leaves.

title: [Vanity Fair, Sitting Room]
description: Propped in one corner, a gilt-framed, three-way mirror reflects cream-colored walls and a soft, pale green carpet that covers most of the polished hardwood floor.  A painted silk screen provides a colorful backdrop for a velvet-covered bench sitting askew beneath a lacquered rosewood table, the arrangement partially concealing a pair of doors adorned with gold nameplates.  Fresh cut flowers of the local variety fill a pink porcelain amphora, one of its delicate handles freshly fractured.

title: [Fronds and Enemies]
description: Earthy tones dominate the interior of this small wagon.  A plush rug woven in a twining vine pattern covers the floor, a small modwir rack resting in the middle of it.  A vivid tapestry in variegated shades of green and blue covers the back wall, the swirling colors highlighting a long branch that serves as a shelf.  A small stool rests near a worktable in the corner, the surface covered with bits of leather and cloth.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Two ramps meet up with a small platform here, perched in the branches of a beech tree.  Moonlight filters through the leaves, creating a dappled pattern on the rough wood flooring.  Some of the branches rising into the heights seem sturdy enough to climb, and several worn spots on the bark give evidence to that very use.  Globes of rose-colored glass dangle from a few of them, illuminating the dimly lit area with a rosy glow

Some of the branches rising into the heights seem sturdy enough to climb, and several worn spots on the bark give evidence to that very use.  Globes of rose-colored glass dangle from a few of them, illuminating the dimly lit area with a rosy glow.

title: [Thimbel's Threadworks]
description: Polished wooden walls and shelves give this cabin an ambiance that promotes lingering to examine the merchandise.  A long marble-topped counter, crafted of the same well-polished oak as the floor-to-ceiling shelves, cuts off the cabin's back half.  Behind the counter, a canvas flap presumably leads into the back of the shop, and an occasional raised voice from behind it gives more weight to the assumption.

title: [Napporium, Essentials]
description: The small room is circular in shape with a series of beams rising upwards to create a vaulted ceiling.  Hanging from the apex of the beams overhead is a blackened metal chain suspending a large crescent-shaped chandelier.  A wooden trunk filled with blankets sits next to a large woven basket with a selection of pillows.

title: [The Fretting Frond]
description: The wooden platform supporting this space juts straight out of the trunk of the nearby colossal teak tree.  Soft golden wavering light from the sun pokes down through the leaves above, casting shadows that dance playfully around this secluded area.  A long twisting branch crosses the center of the room with some sanded-down twigs in a neat row sticking out of it.  A triangular gap in the thick twisting foliage heads out to the main platform, while a narrow plank leads east.

The wooden platform supporting this space juts straight out of the trunk of the nearby colossal teak tree.  Milky silver streams of light from the moon drip down through the leaves above, casting shadows that dance playfully around this secluded area.  A long twisting branch crosses the center of the room with some sanded-down twigs in a neat row sticking out of it.  A triangular gap in the thick twisting foliage heads out to the main platform, while a narrow plank leads east.

title: [Tea-Lightful, Show Room]
description: Frames of thick bamboo create the makeshift walls of the shop, the wood covered by drapes of raw cream linen and tightly bound by hempen rope.  Stacked against the thick fabric confines are a pair of leather trunks, their lids locked in place alongside a doily-covered silk valise.  A vellum screen of fauna cut-outs separates the rooms of the wagon, the three-sided divider dyed shades of pastel green and lavender, matching the checkered paeline rug covering the floor.

title: [Tea-Lightful, Sitting Room]
description: A series of ivory-framed mannequins line the left side of the silk-draped room, the figures surrounded by tall bloom-laden vases and bowls.  Towards the center of the area, several pale wicker chairs encircle a glass-topped circular table, the surface etched with stylized birds in various positions of flight.  A cut-out vellum screen leads back towards the front room.

A series of ivory-framed mannequins line the left side of the silk-draped room, the figures surrounded by tall bloom-laden vases and bowls.  Towards the center of the area, several pale wicker chairs encircle a glass-topped circular table, the surface etched with stylized birds in various positions of flight.  A cut-out vellum screen leads back towards the front room, the exit flanked by a pastel enamel stove and a beribboned sea grass basket.

title: [Mitsoku's Niche]
description: This natural hollow is deeper than it is tall, and strings of lights with colorful shades draped along the walls illuminate the niche in an array of colors.  At the rear of the space near the ceiling, a small hammock stretches from one side to the other, little more than a vibrant scrap of cloth strung between two hooks.  Beneath is an elaborately carved oak counter, atop which rests a many-limbed jewelry tree, and a plush rainbow-hued rug cushions the floor.

title: [Broad Limb]
description: This massive branch reaches far into the beech's foliage, extending from the trunk at a perfect right angle for much of its length.  With the ground so far below, this horizontal alignment and the limb's great girth are a comfort to the non-sylvan visitor.

title: [Tree Stairway, Mossy Vines]
description: Glossy, oversized leaves sprout from the side of the thick-trunked tree at wide intervals, creating a stairway between the jungle floor and a platform above.  Moss-covered vines provide much-needed yet slippery assistance to cross the wide gaps.  Lush vegetation from the jungle floor reaches up toward you, including one particularly large pitcher plant.

title: [Balmy Blooms]
description: Dusky golden sunlight pours in from an arched glass window that forms nearly the entire back wall of the divided alcove.  Blossoming wildflowers and feathered greenery are softly strewn through the entire space, a few of the wayward blooms gathered in small offerings around a slender blue quartz reliquary.  Grown over with intensely verdant mosses, an ivory sculpture of Imaera and Jaston sits at the center of the room, the opaque planes of their eyes perpetually gazing up towards the sky.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: A large platform surrounds the trunk of a tall cedar tree here, and various intricate carvings of woodland animals decorate the smooth wooden surface.  The scent of wood smoke wafts on small breezes, though the origin is not clear from here.  The leafy canopy above provides shade for the area, while several yellow glass lanterns offer golden illumination.  In one direction, a set of parallel woven ropes offers tremulous support, while to the east a more sturdy rope bridge connects to a distant platform.

title: [Unlocking Nature]
description: Thatched walls surround this small room with a large opening set for the door and another for a window.  Growing across the latter are several layers of flower-laden vines that offer their sweet scent to the room.  The wooden floor is covered with a fine layer of pollen and flower petals, and a glass-topped wooden case rests in the center of the room.  Hanging from the thatched ceiling above is a woven vine net basket, its contents clearly visible through holes in the netting.

title: [Unlocking Nature, Loft]
description: A lofted platform creates this room, and curtains of vines surround the rough wooden floor on all sides.  A single low counter runs the entire length of the platform toward the back, and a simple woven mat rests on the floor.  Naturally occurring, a knothole in the cedar tree affords a glimpse of a dark interior, its rough edges offer tricky passage.

title: [Unlocking Nature, Knothole]
description: Dimly lit, this interior room is built directly into the trunk of the tree, its roughly hewn walls exuding the sweet smell of cedar.  The only light in the room filters in from a knothole in one wall, and a single small lantern set into a niche in another.  A woven grass rug covers the relatively level floor, and a bench has been carved directly in the wall adjacent to the lantern.

title: [The Hallowed Hollow]
description: The misshapen archway opens up to a surprisingly large space within the trunk of the tree.  Off to one side is a tall sturdy reed basket, and on the opposite wall is a long shelf.  Sconces have been carved into the walls, and a large pillar candle rests on each, providing soft flickering light.

title: [Leafy Platform, Powders]
description: Lofted high above the jungle floor, this platform is nearly obscured by a profusion of hibiscus and jacaranda.  Some moss-covered vines cascade over the edge of the platform, leading down.  A series of bright-colored bowls runs the entire length of the platform around the tree's trunk.  A knothole leads into a hollow in the tree.

title: [Illuminated Nook]
description: Phosphorescent moss illuminates the large hollow with a pale blue-green glow.  A bench runs around the perimeter of the hollow, providing a place to rest before the arduous climb back to the jungle floor.

title: [A Hungry Pitcher Plant]
description: Wet, fibrous walls form the sides of this dark cavity.  The base is curved and filled with a cold, thick liquid that also coats the walls, which are riddled with slimy indentations.  The smell of decay mixes with a pungent floral aroma, creating an overwhelmingly nauseating combination.

title: [Balmy Blooms, Nook]
description: The regressed nook is accented throughout with lush, jewel-toned flowers and vibrant green herbs.  A narrow grey stone bench wreathes around the perimeter of the room, highlighting a centrally placed woven silk tapestry of a sprawling elm tree with wide-arching branches.

The regressed nook is accented throughout with lush, jewel-toned flowers and vibrant green herbs.  A narrow grey stone bench wreathes around the perimeter of the room, highlighting a centrally placed woven silk tapestry of a sprawling catalpa tree with wide-arching branches.

title: [Don't Weave It Behind]
description: The rough interior of the tree's trunk forms the walls of this hollowed out room, and the smooth wood floor is covered with a fine layer of scattered pine needles.  Along the walls some knots of all shapes and sizes have been left protruding and turned into makeshift pegs upon which the various wares hang.  A narrow passage leads further into the interior of the tree.

title: [Don't Weave It Behind, Nook]
description: In the deeper interior of the tree a cozy nook has been carved out, and the rough wood that forms the walls has been smoothed and polished to a faint luster.  Pine needles have been woven together to form a roughshod rug upon the floor.  A leafy curtain hangs down from the ceiling across the passage leading back out.

title: [Treetop Carvings]
description: Everything inside this foliage-lined hut has been constructed on a smaller than normal scale.  A child-sized, painted wooden chair rests beside a multicolored table.  Above them, a vine-draped wire birdcage is filled with whimsical carvings.  A lacquered mahogany branch, suspended by silver wires, provides a precarious roost for a family of painted wooden sprites.

title: [Kakore's Deck]
description: A simple wooden deck rests atop several sturdy tree limbs.  The space is completely camouflaged by the surrounding foliage.  The leaves twist and sway lightly, creating a persistent gentle wave of flickering color.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Travel to the next platform is blocked by an open space, and the single woven rope bridge that heads to the northwest seems to end at this platform.  The view straight down is obscured by many crisscrossing branches of the rosewood trees that grow in a cluster below, their bodies so intertwined as to almost form one giant tree.  The faint scent of wood smoke lingers in the air, and the gentle rustle of leaves is the only sound.

title: [Oreina's Treetop]
description: A patchwork covering is perched precariously overhead, made of a myriad scraps of fabric and strung between branches with bits of twine.  The excess is left to fall in great swathes to enclose the round platform nestled in the cradle of several large branches, and miniscule tears and openings in the fabric allow in thin shafts of pale moonlight.  Smaller limbs and branches encircle the platform, while a narrow rope bridge leads deeper into the tree's canopy.

title: [Oreina's Treetop]
description: This small platform is left open to the elements, with nothing overhead except a few sparsely leafed branches and the expansive moonlit night sky.  Wedged in a nook created where the platform meets the supporting branches is a plushly stuffed cushion, and across the rest of the floor is an assortment of colorful cloth mats.  A rectangular silver tray sits off to one side of the cushion, and above it, a windchime crafted of bits of vibrantly hued glass and shiny metals hangs.

title: [Sapling Softskin Adornments]
description: Supported by branches that pierce the planks of the platform, the living walls of the hut are formed of woven rosewood limbs, twigs and leaves.  From the roof of the hut hang clusters of firefly-covered seed pods that provide a pale, golden-green light that fills the hut.  Beside the door rests a woven basket containing several items, while along the far wall sets of armor are draped over a low-hanging branch.  In the center of the hut an over-sized toadstool bears an assortment of animal head helmets.

title: [Softskin Adornments, Workshop]
description: Occupying a third of the hut's interior, the room is crowded with a workbench, a tall rosewood stool, and stacked bins of various sizes and shapes.  An assortment of tools lie scattered across the oaken bench top, while a row of bottles and jars are lined up neatly along the wall.

title: [Summer Shades, Northern Styles]
description: The tent consists of large canvas walls, each one a colorful blend of soft yellow, orange, and white hues.  Sand-colored pillows occupy the corners, and rows of bronze metal racks stretch across the center of the room.  The fragrance of cinnamon drifts lazily through the area.

title: [The Lapis Lounge]
description: A sofa and several chairs covered with pale blue velvet sit close to the hearth as if for a casual meeting of old friends.  The mantel of the marble hearth is covered with small items and tiny framed portraits.  Particularly notable is a statuette of a rearing stallion.

title: [Ondreian's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case sits in one corner while a plain cotton mat rests on the sand floor.

title: [String It Up, Entrance]
description: Several frosted crystal orbs are suspended from wooden hooks that have been fixed into the walls.  The air is cool, an earthy scent filling the spacious area.  Soft carpets of woven moss cover the ground under a small white oak table.  A carved spiral staircase leads higher into the tree.

title: [String It Up, Showroom]
description: Built to fit the interior of the tree, the room is circular in shape, with the staircase leading back downstairs in the center.  Several shelves have been cut into the walls of the shop.  Soft, verdant moss grows on the floor, giving the feel of rich carpeting.  Pale light streams in from a small opening above.

Built to fit the interior of the tree, the room is circular in shape, with the staircase leading back downstairs in the center.  Several shelves have been cut into the walls of the shop.  Soft, verdant moss grows on the floor, giving the feel of rich carpeting.  Pale sunlight streams in from a small opening above.

title: [String It Up, Workroom]
description: Perched between a trio of thick canopy branches, a small platform surrounded by flowering vines creates an intimate gathering space.  Several pillow-like piles of moss serve as cushioned seats.  A small table piled with various tools stands off to one side.

title: [Felthrop's Tent, Hidden Room]
description: Surrounded by earthen walls, this secret underground room smells of dirt and moisture, the air laden with dust and miniscule falling particles.  The only furnishings consist of a low bench and a large wooden chest with a broken lock.   Several candelabra have been stuck in the dirt walls, the candles casting their dancing light on the room, not quite eliminating the shadows at the edges.  Several wooden boards are set into one wall, creating a ladder of sorts.

title: [Abandoned Asylum]
description: A single, flickering lantern provides a gloomy light that dances off the rusty broken cell doors lining the dark stone walls.  The air is warm and uncomfortably moist in this cramped chamber.  A fetid stink of rotting garbage, soiled disregarded clothing and worse assaults you like a slap in the face.

title: [Underground Lair, Vestibule]
description: Thick tapestries cover most of the available wall space in this small room, serving to dampen the shouts and insane babblings from the adjacent asylum.  Interspersed among the tapestries are several vents, providing a reprieve from the foul smells seeping through a rough stone arch.  Although none of the cells have a clear view of this area, the feeling of being watched is hard to dismiss.  A pair of ironwood torches flank the frame of an ornate mahogany entryway, which sits flush within the cavern wall.
location: Underground Lair, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Underground Lair, Entry]
description: The air is clean and fresh on this side of an ornate mahogany entryway.  The vaulted ceiling, formed from the natural stone, shines with the light of luminescent rocks, and niches with lanterns have been placed around the spacious, circular room.  The overall effect mimics a star-strewn night sky and has an airy, open feel despite the enclosed space.  Luxurious rugs warm the stone floors, providing a cozy and inviting atmosphere.  A tiny wooden door leads off to the west and a columned arch provides access deeper into the lair.
location: Underground Lair, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Underground Lair, Manly Den]
description: This room is even larger than the entry, yet has one massive rug, the artistry of which is stunning but almost overshadowed by the large, masculine furnishings.  A pair of overstuffed dark wood sofas face each other with a mahogany coffee table between them that completes the conversational grouping.  Near a columned arch, an ironwood table rests against the wall with ornate weaponry displayed above it.  Well-worn leather chairs are placed haphazardly around the room in pairs, lending a lodge-like feel to the den.
location: Underground Lair, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Underground Lair, The Hoylette]
description: This small room has seemingly nothing terribly remarkable about it other than the lack of light and decoration.  The exceedingly low ceilings are the primary feature of the room, detracting from the pile of rags in the corner that seems to function as a bed and the pattern of runes on the floor.  Nearly hidden in the shadows is a tiny wooden door.
location: Underground Lair, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Underground Lair, Bedroom]
description: A huge pane of curved, smooth glass is set into the side of a large hill and overlooks the nearby volcano and landscape.  The night sky is unpolluted by the light of the town, and a vast number of stars are clearly visible.  An oversized bed in silver and black linens, which sits along the natural rock wall opposite the window, is framed by a pair of ebony nightstands.  Above the bed is a detailed painting of Mushroom Island, and vases of fragrant island flowers rest in small stands around the room.
location: Underground Lair, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Underground Lair, Spa Room]
description: Hundreds of lightly scented candles glow and create a spectacular sight, their drippings lining the walls and floor of this natural cavern.  Despite the smoke funnelling up a vent hole in the ceiling, the room remains steamy from a heated pool.  The gleam of the candles illuminates, but also creates flickering shadows on the walls that, combined with the wavy reflected water designs, are naturally mesmerizing and relaxing.  Benches, painstakingly carved and worn smooth, ring the edge of water's surface.
location: Underground Lair, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: A gravel and shell path winds down a gentle slope, running parallel to the Tempest River, whose waters can be seen glittering beyond a fringe of grass and cattails.  Overhead, an oilcloth banner spans the path, supported by a pair of garland-wrapped poles flanked by unlit torches.

A gravel and shell path winds down a gentle slope, running parallel to the Tempest River, whose waters can be seen glittering beyond a dark fringe of grass and cattails.  Overhead, an oilcloth banner supported by garland-wrapped poles spans the path and is illuminated by torches on each side.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: The gravel path divides here, one trail splintering off toward the river, while the other winds to the northeast and deeper into the heart of this narrow tract of open land.  Settled on a grassy diamond between the forks is an old pickle barrel, its iron bandings darkened with age and use.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: Ending abruptly, the pathway spills into a patch of well-kept grass that leads right up to the riverbank, where a platform supported by massive pillars stretches over the water.  A variety of picnic tables are strewn across the grass, while one central table, a large buffet, occupies the platform.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: A fence of heavy rope and short, stubby pillars borders the path as it leads onward.  Here and there at the base of random pillars, seashells and wildflowers peek out from amidst the grass.

title: [In A Pickle]
description: Pickle paraphernalia occupies almost the entirety of this cramped booth.  Several different mannequins line the back wall of the booth; to the right are a gnome and halfling mannequins, while to the left are their medium-sized and giantman counterparts.  A large green pickle-shaped sign stands between the displays.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: The throughway widens here to accommodate the wagons and stalls that have been parked and constructed in the grass beyond the short fence.  Sounds of laughter and singing filter through the air, and the scent of food teases the nose.

The throughway widens here to accommodate the wagons and stalls that have been parked and constructed in the grass beyond the short fence.  Fireflies and starflies dance through the air, which is scented with a hint of sweet jasmine.

title: [Brine There, Done That]
description: Huge cauldrons of vinegar and spices bubble fitfully here and there beneath the canopy of this tent, the smell and heat enough to bring a tear to the eye and sweat to the brow.  Closer to the front, display tables laden with jars, dishes, and a long segmented platter of food are carefully arranged and support a wide variety of treats upon which one might nibble.  Alongside the offerings is a hastily written sign.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: Opening up into a wide stretch of grass, the grounds are littered with wagons, booths, and stalls all hemmed into neat rows by a short rope and pillar fence.  Small breaks in the fence allow travel through the pathways, and old pickle barrels are provided as trash receptacles.

title: [With Relish, Supply Room]
description: Large oak barrels support a long, smooth plank creating a makeshift counter along the far wall, a glass display case hung on the wall behind next to a small sign.  A strong scent of vinegar wafts from a squat, green glass jar filled with pickles perched on the end of the counter, its metal lid turned over and used as a dish for toothpicks and spare silver coins.  A wooden rack, leaning slightly to one side and stained with various shades of green, blocks the curtained archway leading further into the shop.

title: [The Real Dill]
[Behind The Masque]
description: A multi-hued handwoven rug spans the distance between the entrance and the back of the wagon, which is rather short considering the modest stature of this wagon.  The light hue of the golden oak walls makes the space seem larger than it is, as does the tidy arrangement of tables on the perimeter.  On one table is a green-tinged smooth glass dish and a leaf-carved grey wooden platter, above which hangs a green willow-framed mirror.  Across the way, a stout pickle barrel rests beneath a set of green metal shelves secured to the wall by sculpted brackets.

Jewel-toned satin hangs along the walls in sweeping scallops in this front room of the wagon, and each peak between is accented by a masquerade mask adorned with ribbons.  Scattered around are several display stands of varying heights, and from overhead, a many-limbed chandelier illuminates the interior as tiny flames flicker behind the cut glass shades on each arm.

title: [Moomph Weaponarium]
description: An overpowering aroma of brine fills the tent, emanating from an unknown source.  Across the tent's ceiling hangs a large white banner, stretching from one wall to the other, and underneath it, multiple stands and tables full of weapons and armor.  A stack of pickle jars line one wall, serving as a stand for a square green placard with yellow lettering.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: Tiny flowers dot the grass on the opposite side of the rope and pillar fence that trails the edge of the path, their faces brief points of color seen when the wind moves the tall grasses momentarily.  From nearby, the sound of voices and music filter in, so faint as to seem almost a dream.

title: [Smuggled In, Legitimate Goods]
description: A large driftwood raft serves as flooring in this makeshift tent of dark sailcloth draped on rope-strung wooden poles.  A battered, steel-banded oak trunk sits next to a fluttering tent flap across from a pair of featureless mannequins.  A hammock of patched netting is strung from the poles in one corner, next to a small table.

title: [A Thin-Striped Violet Silk Tent]
description: Airy and light, the silk walls of the tent enclosing this area stir with the slightest breeze, and the peaked roof overhead is vented to allow in shafts of natural illumination to brighten the interior.  A thick carpet overlays the ground, creating an even surface for the display at its heart that supports a slender jewelry case and a set of narrow shelves.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: A sturdy oak cart sits near the pathway, shaded by an oilcloth umbrella in an alarming shade of bright green.  From the umbrella's pole hangs a sign with large painted words that read, "Fried Pickle Chips!"
A sturdy oak cart sits near the pathway, with a closed umbrella sitting nearby.  Draped from the front of the cart is a sign illuminated by torchlight, which reads, "Fried Pickle Chips!"

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: A peaked structure of wood and mesh stands off to the side of the path in the grass and supports a blanket of vines laden with cucumbers.  A small hand-painted sign sign sits beside the structure, and from nearby, the sound of music filters through the air.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [The Pickled Pirate]
description: Lengths of thin netting overlap across the weathered oak planks forming the walls of the shop, the makeshift displays held aloft by tarnished silver hooks.  Some overturned wooden barrels stand scattered amongst obscure relics of the sea, the anchors and bits of driftwood entangled in strands of seaweed that have been left to dry upon the salt-stained floor.  Jammed into the chaotic mix is a carved mahogany kraken, the creature's glass-inset eyes glinting alongside the tallow candles held within its tentacles.

title: [Put It In Your Pickle]
description: Pale canvas drapes down from a peaked roof of pine supports.  Planks of wood line the ground, creating a temporary floor.  A pair of smudged globes hangs from above, covering the small shop with faint golden light.  Stacked with items for sale, a large table dominates the center of the room.

title: [Fit To Be Pickled]
description: A garland of tissue paper pickles crisscrosses the space between the support poles of the tent, creating a colorful, if garish, display.  Assorted metal racks and shelves of silver and gold line the bright red satin walls, hung from the supports above, while a couple of tables sit below.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: Voices laughing, talking, and shouting create an additional layer to the hustle and bustle found here at the heart of the grounds as people pass by and through the rows of wagons and stalls.  The scent of pickle brine and fried foods drift through on the occasional breeze.

A whisper of voices, talking, and quiet laughter can be heard here, the hustle and bustle of the day having been subdued by the night as fewer people pass by and through the rows of wagons and stalls.  Overhead, a myriad of fireflies and starflies dance together against the black of the black sky.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Pickled Prestidigitation]
description: Heavy lengths of dark green velvet drape from the oaken supports of the peaked roof overhead to enclose this small area.  Glass-bowled lanterns are situated around the perimeter to provide adequate illumination, though the flames behind the glass seem to burn of their own accord with no oil visible in the bowls beneath.  Centered on the back wall of the tent is a slotted parchment display shelf with a massive half-skull bowl set atop it, while the heart of the space is occupied by a sturdy oaken pedestal.  A simple brass hook is affixed to the side of the shelf.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: Strung between nearby poles, small flags sway back and forth in the breezes that waft off the river, making a quiet flapping sounds as they move.  Below, the wagons and stalls are sparse here, leaving thick tufts of grass to grow up into a soft carpet of green.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: Situated in a circle, tall poles hold aloft a canopy of ropes laden with vibrant paper-shaded lanterns that sway gently in the breeze as it rolls off the nearby river.  Outside of the circle, a small band of string and pipe players create lively tunes for dancing, as onlookers gather near to hear the music.

Situated in a circle, tall poles hold aloft a canopy of ropes laden with vibrant paper-shaded lanterns to create a picturesque scene backed by the gentle whisper of the river.  Outside of the circle, a small band of string and pipe players weave together song after song, while on the other side of the Tempest fireworks burst into the sky, one colorful blossom after another.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: A small wooden shack sits near the river's edge, with a short dock that juts out into the water.  Cattails and grass have grown up around the base of the shack, and dragonflies dance along the surface of the water, occasionally landing to rest on a reed.

A small wooden shack sits near the river's edge, with a short dock that juts out into the water.  Cattails and grass have grown up around the base of the shack, and starflies dance along the surface of the water, leaving silvery trails of light in their wake.

A small wooden shack sits near the river's edge, with a short dock that juts out into the water.  Cattails and grass have grown up around the base of the shack, and starflies dance along the surface of the water, leaving silvery trails of light in their wake.  A foot-worn dirt path leads under the dock.

Cattails and grass have grown up around the base of the shack, and dragonflies dance along the surface of the water, occasionally landing to rest on a reed.  A foot-worn dirt path leads under the dock.

A small wooden shack sits near the river's edge, with a short dock that juts out into the water.  Cattails and grass have grown up around the base of the shack, and starflies dance along the surface of the water, leaving silvery trails of light in their wake.  Some green and white-checkered flannel blankets are scattered across the ground, and a foot-worn dirt path leads under the dock.

title: [A Small Wooden Shack]
description: The old timbers that form the walls and floor of this shack are greyed with age, but still strong, giving the structure stability against the rushing of the river, which can be heard beneath.  Along the back wall is a low counter, several stools visible on either side, and off to the side near a wood stove is a simple oak table.  An oblong river willow basket sits atop a low counter, edged in curled green satin ribbons.

title: [River's Rest, Festival Grounds]
description: The river curves around this small bit of land, the sound of its passing a quiet rush that provides a background of white noise.  Above that sound is the noise of people talking and laughing, and the air is filled with the scent of food and drink.

title: [Tempest Falls, Above the Falls]
description: A thick damp mist envelopes the space immediately adjacent to the falls, rising from the roaring crash of the Tempest waters as they plummet below.  Little can be seen through the enshrouding mist, which only breaks apart occasionally to reveal a glimpse of the small town situated on the egg-shaped island below in the river.  The roar of the falls is almost deafening, and the rushing of the waters shake the earth underfoot.

title: [Tempest River, Before the Falls]
description: A deep, constant rumble comes from the direction of the falls, and the swiftly moving waters of the Tempest flow toward the sound.  Tall reeds line the bank of the river, home to the occasional silently poised heron and the random splash of a startled frog or turtle.  Parallel to the river, an old overgrown dirt road leads to the east.

title: [Tempest River, River Road]
description: Thick grass and weeds obscure much of the old river road that winds its way to the east and west along the Tempest.  Insects buzz angrily amid the brush, disturbed by movement through the tranquil perches they've found in the tall assortment of grasses and weeds.  Burrs hang threateningly, distracting from what appears to be something constructed by the hand of man to the east.

title: [Tempest River, River Road]
description: Just visible above the overgrowth of the river road are the remains of a small river port, a mixture of skeletal stones and intact structures.  Jutting only a few feet into the river adjacent to the port are the remnants of an old stone dock, now silt-covered and the perching place of dark green moss.  Just beyond the port and commanding a view of the surrounding terrain is a prominent mound.

title: [Tempest River, Old River Port]
description: Nature has done much to reclaim the old river port set beside the Tempest, with vines clinging possessively to masonry and weeds obscuring foundations.  The visible port has the resemblance of a small village built around a narrow rectangular square.  Several obvious warehouses line the area closest to the river, while miscellaneous and harder to discern structures surround the other sides of the square.

title: [Tempest River, Old Warehouses]
description: The resilient architecture of riverstone has, for the most part, survived the decades-long assault of nature with a number of the some old warehouses still standing, albeit covered in vines both old and new.  Broken windows peer out like empty eye sockets, and open doorways linger like black, hungry maws awaiting a meal.

title: [Tempest River, Overgrown Square]
description: The square is recognizable only by the buildings which frame it and is otherwise obscured by the thick vegetation slowly returning the land to a more natural state.  In the middle of the ruined square is a monument rendered indistinct by the prevalent overgrowth.

title: [Tempest River, Rundown House]
description: Vines criss-cross the floor, invaders from outside having taken advantage of the lack of properly functioning windows and doors.  Beside a window sits a small maple desk surprisingly clear of the ongoing assault by nature elsewhere in the run-down home.  What other furniture remains is decayed and skeletal, echoes of a once former vibrant home, and as forgotten and abandoned as much of the port.

title: [Tempest River, Old River Port]
description: The broken dreams of long dead men, covered and reclaimed by the wild impulses of nature, stand barely discernible from the untouched growth of the land beside the river.  Trees and bushes intermingle with what might have once been statuary, fusing the art of nature with that of mortal hand.  An overgrown pathway, barely wider than a game path, leads away from the ruined port and toward a large bald mound.

title: [Tempest River, Mound]
description: A circle of brush surrounds the mound top like a monk's tonsure, leaving its crest bare but for a number of weeds and an old rust-covered catapult.  Over the top of the brush, one can spy the Tempest River as it disappears over the falls and the resulting cloud of ever-present cloaking mist.  Even further beyond, the sight of a turtle egg-shaped island and its odd array of businesses and homes can be seen.  Standing tall out of the weeds, the abandoned catapult points toward the town.

title: [Flinger Basket]
description: The walls and floor of the basket are woven with reinforcing strips of metal, tinted brown by decades of rust, the flakes of which have created a reddish brown stain underfoot.  Metal hooks are placed across the floor in neat orderly rows, perhaps once connected by rope or leather as a means to separate the basket's contents.  Scrapes in the rust along the walls imply that not all launches from the catapult were executed cleanly.

title: [Tempest River, Abandoned House]
description: Disarray and dust aptly describe the interior of the abandoned house.  What furniture remains lies up-ended and covered in a fine layer of filth, the sole exception being an oak writing table situated near a window that gazes out to the southwest and the rest of the old port.  Vines invade the house, reaching in through broken windows and wide-flung doors, as if the wilds outside are determined to overcome all trace of habitation.

title: [Herring Toss, Entrance]
description: Sheets of canvas are strung up on both sides of a wooden gate to provide privacy.  Painted on the canvas are a variety of brightly colored fish.  The sounds of splashing and laughter bubble out from behind the canvas.  A large sign is affixed to the canvas beside the gate.  An old crone is perched on a stool beside the sign.

title: [Bobbing for Pickles, Entry]
description: A small, rather shabby canvas tent has been erected in the middle of the otherwise tidy green lawn.  The sharp smell of pickle brine surrounds the tent.  An old crone sits on a three-legged stool beside the tent flap.  Beside the stool is a hand-painted sign.

title: [The Ol' Switcheroo]
description: Dilapidated wooden planks make up this small seedy-looking booth, and a halfhearted attempt to mask the shoddy workmanship with a thin coat of noxious green paint only serves to make the squat structure uglier.  A table bridges the gap between the outside and the proprietor inside, whose voice continually rings out as he hawks his game.  A large banner drooping across the top of the wooden booth displays "The Ol' Switcheroo" in splotchy red letters.

title: [Sew Lovely, Niche]
description: A pile of azure blue pillows are scattered about the small room.  Suspended from twisted ivory silk ropes, several paper lantern globes in various colors cast illuminating light.

title: [Cooper's, Secret Room]
description: This cool and pleasant room brings a calm smile to your lips.  It bears the clean, comforting scent of freshly worked wood, and the floor is covered with shavings of modwir, cedar, oak.  The walls are formed of long, vertical planks, fastened with pegs to the substructure and joined in a dovetailed, almost seamless fashion.  Great care and skill has gone into making this simple storage space.
location: Pan's Place, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [King's Table]
description: A large fel table is surrounded by several high-backed chairs.  The seats of the chairs are covered in rich purple velvet and the backs are carved with a cutout of a crown.  In the center of the table, a glass dome houses an ancient bejeweled scepter.

title: [Explorer's Outpost, Storage]
description: Barely larger than a closet, the storage space is packed with shipping crates, broken boxes, and even a few long, slender containers that could be coffins.  The wood-paneled walls are covered in cobwebs, and the floor is buried under a healthy layer of dirt.  A narrow arch leads back to the main room.

title: [Toy Soldiers, Front Room]
description: Teak walls burnished to a lustrous golden finish rise to a peaked ceiling made of the same to enclose this spacious area.  Underfoot, plush crimson carpeting spans wall to wall and front to back, and a series of gold-leafed shelves can be found upon the walls between golden sconces shaped like rearing wyverns.  An archway flanked by gilded brocade curtains leads further into the wagon.

title: [Toy Soldiers, Back Room]
description: The oil lamps held by the golden wyvern scones on the walls give off a warm aroma of cloves and vanilla in addition to a wealth of illumination.  Gold-framed glass cases sit on either wall, their lids propped open by hinged limbs locked into place.  At the rear of this space is a carved teak door with an elegantly filigreed handle.

title: [Queen's Table]
description: The diamond-shaped oak table has been inlaid with tiny pieces of silvery hoarbeam and polished to a high sheen.  A set of high-backed chairs surrounds the table, the spindles intricately carved with tiny crowns.  Beautiful red rosebuds have been placed in a plain vase in the center of the table.

title: [Toy Soldiers, Quarters]
description: On the back wall of this modestly sized room, a teak platform is affixed to the wall and outfitted with a variety of bedding materials to create a small, but cozy sleeping space accessible only by the nearby wall-mounted ladder.  Beneath, a desk is tucked into the niche and is covered by a gold-flecked brown leather blotter, with a blood eagle feather quill and inkwell stationed just above.  On the opposite wall are a gold brocade-cushioned chair with a high back and a glass-topped pedestal table.

title: [Knight's Table]
description: The square oak table has been intricately carved with a longsword and shield and painted in gold and crimson.  A thick piece of glaesine covers the carving protecting it from spills and damage.  Crimson velvet covers the padded seats of the chairs that surround the table, offering a comfortable place to rest.

title: [Siren's Wood, Ancient Clearing]
description: The path widens into a small area surrounded by ancient haon, thanot, and white ash trees.  A multitude of purple-edged violettas and daisies peek through the lush, verdant grass that carpets the clearing.  Two grey squirrels dart in and out of patches of sunlight looking for treats.

title: [Jester's Table]
description: The small circular table has been painted with a variety of purple-clad jesters dancing in a circle.  A small vase sits in the center, housing a single wilting daisy.  Low-backed chairs surround the table, the seats covered in a pattern of purple and silver diamonds.

title: [Excess Baggage]
description: Smooth oak planks, swept free of all debris, line the floor of the sparse little wagon.  A row of brass hooks lines the polished oak wall near the egress.  A fresh flower bouquet in a crystal vase sits atop a brass-reinforced glass showcase that is centered along the back wall, while a small display stand occupies the opposite wall.

title: duplicate of 13925
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, up

title: [Recollections]
description: Small pennants edged in gold threading flutter against a light breeze and create a rhythmic flapping sound that echoes off the haon-planked walls.  A wooden barrel is placed adjacent to a long counter that displays a ceramic bowl surrounded by a circlet of fresh wildflowers.  Fresh amaranth and blue violets lay scattered across the floor.

title: [Tannery, Foyer]
description: Several crossed wooden poles positioned together offer support to the structure.  A series of hooks hang from the ceiling, each with local creatures splayed and gutted.  Bleached by the sun, a wide wooden rack displays assorted clothing items.  Cresting the way back out is a massive bear head affixed to a wooden plaque.

title: [Siren's Wood, Convergence]
description: A quartz-inlaid white marble bench sits amidst a thick stand of haon that crowds thickly alongside the path, permitting little sunlight to permeate the shadows of the forest.  Tiarella and purple-edged violettas blanket the forest floor, surrounding a white marble statue with pillows of silvery pale color.  A row of tiny glaesine globes have been strung from a branch, each globe holding an unlit white candle, and gently sway over clusters of yellow daffodils.

title: [Inner Walkway, Entrance]
description: The wildness of the wood through the vine-covered archway gives way to an expansive flagstone walkway leading toward a massive limestone coliseum to the west.  Manicured lawns surrounded by impeccably maintained flower beds flank the promenade to the north and south while rows of flowering cherry trees guard the borders of the wood beyond.

title: [Gimme Shelter]
description: Several steel ribs span the width of the wagon, a beige canvas stretched between them to protect the interior from the elements.  Broken cogs and sprockets litter the gouged wooden floor, and a short wooden stand sits just inside the triangular flap.  A low bench juts out from the front wall and is strewn with patched cushions.  In the rear of the wagon, a cog-covered metal rack stands next to a squat steel door.

title: [Siren's Wood, River Walk]
description: A short wooden bridge arches over a burbling creek, joining the sections of the trail on either side.  Hostas and lush ferns grow along both sides of the bank, and various flowers in full bloom grow along the edge of this small clearing.  Brightly-colored butterflies and fat bees momentarily alight on the blossoms.  Swinging from an ironwork post is a glaesine lantern.

title: [House Colors]
description: This spacious pavilion is walled in panels of the various House colors of the Elven Nations.  Sunlight passing through the panels casts the contents of a modwir cloak rack and some free-standing shelves near them in altered shades, but the pavilion's pure white roof renders the interior even brighter than outside.  Away from the walls, the hues of the wares on a small brass table and an oaken garment rack are more vibrant and alive.

title: [A Formal Affair]
description: Shelves filled with fabrics, neatly labeled boxes, and glass canisters, line the wall behind a polished hardwood counter.  A dark walnut bureau is reflected in the silvered glass of a large oval mirror, its elaborately carved frame of leaves inlaid with pearly vaalin.  To one side of the counter, a metal rack is crowded with garments, and on the other, a low wooden shoe rack is angled in front of a cushioned bench.

title: [It's Fitting]
description: Swathes of gossamer in varying colors hang from the center of the ceiling and are secured to the walls just above the midline, creating a festive tent-like atmosphere.  Several mannequins line one wall, each holding an article of unfinished clothing that is held together with more pins than stitches.  A thick, deep blue carpet covers the floor, and a steel pole is horizontally attached to the rear wall by a series of sturdy brackets.

title: [It's Fitting, Dressing Room]
description: Beige silk wallpaper, handpainted with butterflies fluttering among a wide variety of flowers, lines the walls of the small area.  Soft, deep blue carpet stretches across the floor, and a crimson velvet divan is nestled in one corner.  A row of small silver hooks line one wall next to a floor-length mirror.

title: [Siren's Wood, Carnations]
description: A large old oak trunk, fallen alongside the path, is home to tiny ferns and abundant animal life.  Surrounded by a mixture of ferns and hostas, its decaying bark fills the area with an earthy scent.  Behind a quartz-inlaid white marble bench stands a single glaesine lantern that swings from a short ironwork post.  Rising in the middle of a ring of red-traced pink carnations is a white marble statue, standing proudly in the dappled sunlight.

title: [Siren's Wood, Wyvern]
description: A tall standard atop a stout metal pole has been pitched beneath a great thanot tree, its silken banner shifting and sighing in the day's gentle breeze.  Ferns and pale lavender phlox surround the base of the pole, and fragrant wild thyme has grown across the path, providing a lush green carpet underfoot.  A glaesine lantern mounted upon an ironwork post stands near a carved marble bench.

title: [Boots on the Ground]
description: The well-kept wagon is outfitted with a built-in cedar and oak rack that runs the length of the entire back wall.  Two cheery arrangements of feathery yellow-dotted fennel and goldenrod stalks flank a hammered copper mantle on the opposite side of the room.

title: [Walward's Eastern Emporium]
description: The inside of the wooden booth provides just enough space to allow shoppers to sample the wares set out upon a few low wooden shelves.  Tacked onto the far wall of the booth is a sign that reads, "Walward's Eastern Emporium."  A stout wooden stool rests just at the edge of the area, a pile of wood carvings littered around it.

title: [Protect and Serve]
description: A crimson and gold wool rug, woven with the image of a fortress, stretches across the floor of the wagon.  A low wooden bunk over a wooden drawer with a gear for a handle is built into the rear of the wagon, reinforced with two thick steel chains that secure it to the wall.  Brightly colored tapestries line the walls above neatly organized workspaces that hold bits of leather, assorted metal rings and plates, and other materials used in armor manufacturing.  Nearly hidden behind a diminutive armoire inlaid with copper sprockets is a small wooden hatch that leads outside.

title: [Siren's Wood, Black Roses]
description: A tiny break in the thick emerald boughs high overhead permits a patch of bright golden sunlight to stream downward onto the path.  Glistening dust motes dance in the sunlight, fading into nothingness as they pass into the shadows beyond.  Dappled in shadow is a white marble statue sitting amidst a bed of black roses.

A tiny break in the darkened boughs high overhead permits a beam of cool silvery moonlight to stream downward onto the path.  Shimmering fireflies dance through the shadows beneath the trees, their golden lamps dimming as they flit through the ray of moonlight.  Glowing softly in the moonlight is a white marble statue sitting amidst a bed of black roses.

title: [The Lady's Tears, Show Room]
description: Curtains of grey lace drape heavily across the arched windows of the shop, preventing the outside light from penetrating the room.  A quartet of alabaster mannequins dominate the ebonwood floor, the faceless models posed as though gazing upwards towards the jet-beaded chandelier set high above.  The faint scent of flora wafts from tall marbled vases at each corner of the shop, the dried rose and mournbloom petals scattered listlessly about the area.

title: [A Violet Silk Tent]
description: Shed from strings of translucent white paper lanterns dangling from the tent's supports, pale white light bathes the area, giving everything it touches a faint silvery sheen.  Swathes of royal purple satin hang scalloped along each of the violet walls, pinned at their apex by clusters of dark and glossy greenery.  Along one side of the space is a tiered glass display, while across the way sits a velvet-topped jewelry table, and a carpeted runner spans the width between.

title: [Tannery, Tunnel]
description: The wood of the walls and ceiling are carved like that of a tunnel, narrow with faux texturized rock.  A row of torches illuminate the room, each slightly more dim than the last.  Suspended by thin twine, a small shelf with assorted wares hangs on the wall.

title: [Tannery, Den]
description: Tanned and stretched hides are evenly spaced along the walls of the den.  A pile of soft furs are positioned in a circle around a small wooden table with refreshments on it.  Hanging from the ceiling is a chandelier crafted out of assorted bones.

title: [Inner Walkway, Tavern]
description: The flagstone walkway ends in an impressive cul-de-sac housing a limestone tavern.  Patrons stream in and out of the establishment amid near-constant chatter about the games.  Rows of mature cedar trees tower around the edge of the walk, creating a natural barrier to the wood beyond while filling the area with their intense aroma.

title: [The Gilded Longsword, Taproom]
description: Smoky oil lamps feebly attempt to light the interior of this windowless tavern.  Long shadows twist and turn across the floor, leaving one to question how clean the establishment really is.  Several tapped wooden kegs rest on permanent stands behind a well-oiled cedar bar that is remarkably clean.

title: [Inner Walkway, Bonfire]
description: Traffic flows around a row of stone benches that surrounds an expansive fire pit, while a large open-air pavilion sits snug against the walls of a limestone coliseum along the southern edge of the flagstone walkway.  Mature flowering plum trees line the northern edge of the walk, adding a soft fragrance and ample shade to the area.

title: [Pavilion]
description: Thick crimson canvas stretched over squared oak beams forms the ceiling of the hexagonal space, leaving the sides open to errant breezes.  A refreshment table at the northern end of the room is flanked by rows of padded chairs.  In the center, short brass poles supporting a thick velvet rope encircle the polished teak floor, which is laid in a checkered pattern of darker and lighter boards.

title: [Inner Walkway, Plaza]
description: The wide flagstone walkway opens up into an expansive plaza.  Bubbling fountains and decorative pots filled with indigenous flora mark the entrance to a massive limestone coliseum that dominates the area.  Small benches line the northern edge of the expanse, providing comfortable seating for those waiting to enjoy the spectacle.

title: [Coliseum Colonnade, Entry]
description: Large limestone columns flank the entrance to this grand venue, and rows of identical pillars march off in either direction to form a colonnade.  Inset into the smooth, perfectly polished white marble flooring is the crest of House Ta'Vaalor in opposing black marble.  Off to one side, a torch-lit limestone passage leads deep below the coliseum.  A crimson pennon hangs above a massive iron gate that leads into the main combat arena.

title: [Coliseum, Lower Nexus]
description: The bottom of a steeply angled limestone passage terminates in the northern wall of the large, elliptical chamber.  Polished brass sconces are evenly spaced around the room, casting their flickering light across the smooth stone floor.  Rough stone benches have been hewn into the walls between four hallways that lead deeper under the coliseum.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Inner Walkway]
description: A red and white tent sits proudly along the southern edge of the flagstone walkway.  Faint streaks stain the stones leading away from the tent's entrance toward a massive limestone coliseum to the east.  A row of flowering plum trees lines the northern edge of the walk, creating a civilized barrier against the wildness of the Siren's Wood beyond.

Brightly burning torches light the way to a red and white tent that sits proudly along the southern edge of the flagstone walkway.  Faint streaks stain the stones leading away from the tent's entrance toward a massive limestone coliseum to the east.  A row of flowering plum trees lines the northern edge of the walk, creating a civilized barrier against the wildness of the Siren's Wood beyond.

title: [Infirmary Tent]
description: Rows of cots flank the path between the open tent flaps and a partitioned area in the rear.  A small staff of elven medical personnel, clearly exhausted, move smartly between the cots, doing whatever they can to ease pains and heal wounds.  Muffled grunts can be heard coming from behind the partition, and from time to time a chirurgeon wearing Ta'Vaalorian livery enters from the back room to speak with one of the medical staff before returning to her patient.

title: [Inner Walkway, Hatchet Throw]
description: Irregular flagstones have been fitted to seamless perfection, forming a wide walkway leading from the east, which branches into two smaller paths.  A snooty Vaalorian woodsman stands near a wooden plank with a small vaalorn hatchet embedded in the surface forms a simple counter resting in the perpetual shade of the limestone coliseum.  A large circular piece of tree has been painted with several rings of varying colors and propped on a sturdy stand some distance away.

title: [Inner Walkway, Dagger Toss]
description: Tucked in the shadow of the coliseum, a strange booth dominates this area.  Puffs of steam and strange noises randomly erupt from the booth as tiny tin targets rise above the front panel of the stall and travel in a jumpy motion across the plank ledge to disappear once more behind the facing boards.  A well-balanced vultite dagger rests on a small stump near the odd contraption.  A tiny gnome occasionally peeks from behind the booth.

title: [Inner Walkway, Blacksmith]
description: Piles of wood and scrap metal clutter the open-air smithy that occupies this portion of walkway.  A sturdy rock forge and leather bellows sit beneath a brightly striped canvas awning bearing the golden wyvern of House Vaalor.  A heavy weapons rack and a sturdy armor stand proudly display the blacksmith's wares.

title: [The Gilded Longsword, Lounge]
description: Lacquered cedar walls sport a number of animal-head trophies mounted on wooden plaques next to dimly lit sconces.  A group of rowdy drunken gentlemen sit off in a corner at one of the circular oak tables, which are scattered about the room, using curved wooden benches for seating.  A grand chair made from the cured hide of a large animal rests near a large stone fireplace.

title: [Coliseum Colonnade]
description: The wide, smooth white marble floor continues in a northern arc, flanked on the southern side by dozens of limestone columns.  The sunlit trees of the dense forest can be seen through the columns.  Inset into the limestone of the northern wall are a narrow arch and a low arch.

title: [Coliseum, Viewing Room]
description: Tiered wooden bleachers rise from the smooth stone floor, providing an unobstructed view through a large glass-paned window.  Hanging on the back wall is a large banner featuring a golden wyvern.  A low arch leads back to the colonnade.

title: [Coliseum, Viewing Room]
description: Tiered wooden bleachers rise from the smooth stone floor, providing an unobstructed view through a large glass-paned window.  Hanging on the back wall is a large banner featuring the crest of House Vaalor.  A narrow arch leads back to the colonnade.

title: [Coliseum Colonnade]
description: The wide, smooth white marble floor continues in a southern arc, flanked on the northern side by dozens of limestone columns.  The sunlit trees of the Siren's Wood can be seen through the columns.  Inset into the limestone of the southern wall are an ornate faenor arch etched with elven runes and a wyvern-etched vaalorn arch, above which hangs a banner displaying the crest of House Vaalor.

title: [Coliseum, Northwest Corridor]
description: Polished stone walls reflect the light of a trio of vaalin-banded torches that has been inset into ornate brackets.  Centered over a brick-lined tunnel is a deep crimson banner that reads "Arena Entrance" embroidered in thick golden thread.  A golden banner over a crimson arch reads "Viewing Chamber" in elegant crimson embroidery.

title: [The Crimson Lounge]
description: Colorful, thick cushions have been piled on tiered slabs of stone that have been hewn from the rear wall of the small room.  The wall opposite the seating area contains a large glass window, which gives an unobstructed view of the arena below.  The remaining walls are hung in a multitude of tapestries displaying various family crests, broken only by a crimson arch, which leads back toward the nexus.

title: [Coliseum, Southwest Corridor]
description: Polished stone walls reflect the light of a trio of steel-banded torches that has been inset into ornate brackets.  Centered over a brick-lined tunnel is a forest green banner that reads "Arena Entrance" embroidered in thick indigo thread.  An indigo banner over a forest green arch reads "Viewing Chamber" in elegant azure embroidery.

The remaining walls are hung in a multitude of tapestries displaying various family crests, broken only by a forest green arch, which leads back toward the nexus.
