title: [Coliseum Colonnade]
description: Crimson and gold streamers wind around the limestone columns of the easternmost portion of the coliseum.  A square of pure black marble, centered with a golden crown, has been inset into the white marble flooring.  Lush crimson tapestries flank a gem-adorned vaalorn door, over which hangs a wide banner.

title: [Inner Walkway, Javelin Toss]
description: Crushed limestone forms a small path leading away from the central flagstone walkway here.  A large patch of manicured turf flourishes despite the omnipresent shadow of the coliseum.  Several humanoid dummies of varying sizes stand at the far end of the green, while a slender imflass javelin has been thrust into the ground nearby.  A retired legionnaire stands watch over the testing grounds.

title: [Amphitheater of Kings]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [Amphitheater of the Arkati]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [Amphitheater of the Fallen]
description: Smooth stone walls encase this sunken chamber and faint, dark red stains mar the scorched stone floor.  Near the ceiling on one wall is a large window, providing a glimpse of the wall-hung tapestries in the room beyond.

title: [Blacksmith, Coal Storage]
description: Dark and dusty, this small underground chamber holds large piles of coal.  Magical globes light a strange contraption formed of a cloth belt on metal rollers that leads from a small pile up to a trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [The Mage Dahcre Chamber]
description: High and airy, this elegant room seems designed for comfort and relaxation.  Several large cushions of the softest silk lie scattered before a white marble fireplace, above which is set a silver looking-glass framed by carvings of woodland sprites.  The carved sprites continue their frolic on a low bar to one side, which is flanked by twin blue and scarlet banners.  A moonglae opal medallion set above the entry arch glimmers in the light.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Private Locker]
description: Jade green marble veined with cream covers the small amount of floor space, while pale oak paneling forms a modest wainscoting.  A white-on-cream figured silk covers the upper portion of the walls.

title: [Cavern, Ritual Room]
description: The despanal-inlaid summoning circle dominates the center of the cavern.  Mottled veins of liquescent crimson stone bleed outward from the edges of the circle and snake toward the ceiling along the pale cavern walls.  Slick with condensation, hoary clumps of glowing lichen cast a murky green glow throughout the chamber.

The despanal-inlaid summoning circle dominates the center of the cavern.  Mottled veins of liquescent crimson stone bleed outward from the edges of the circle and snake toward the ceiling along the pale cavern walls.  The ophidian breaks in the rocks are continued through the side of the cave, where a small stream enters and exits the chamber with a subdued rushing sound that echoes off a small dock.  Slick with condensation, hoary clumps of glowing lichen cast a murky green glow throughout the chamber.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Lounge]
description: A low ceiling and an assortment of overstuffed chairs scattered throughout the room give the lounge an intimate ambiance.  An ornate Faendryl crest hangs above the massive black marble fireplace that dominates one end of the room.  Opposite the fireplace is a dart board fancifully painted with ravens and griffins.  A gleaming ebonwood bar accented with rhimar spans the length of the room, an open humidor left forgotten at one end.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Office]
description: The solid ebonwood desk and its ornate, high-backed chair dominate the room.  Expansive bookshelves flank the desk and line the walls to the ceiling in orderly rows, but the odds and ends tucked between the leather volumes that belie the rigorous order of the shelves.  Behind the desk hangs a massive tapestry map of Elanith with details picked out in fine silk thread.  Tucked in a corner near the desk is an overstuffed pillow.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Training Hall]
description: Various weaponry and armor are arrayed on racks throughout a wide room with vaulted windows of colored glass.  Demon and humanoid-shaped practice dummies await attacks from novices and veterans alike.  While the rest of the room contains signs of regular use, the central onyx-bordered circle is free of any clutter.  Tapestries hung between the windows depict military scenes in muted hues.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Solarium]
description: Curved, transparent sheets of crystal set at an angle into alabaster walls meet high overhead to enclose the top of the tower.  At the dome's apex, the crystal panes become a single lofty spire.  On one side of the crystalline chamber, a gilded arch opens onto a slender walkway that reaches into the sky without rails or supports.  Opposite the arch is a gold-chased telescope near a low table and scattered lounge chairs that invite stargazing.

title: [Workshop Toolbench]
description: The toolbench is fairly unmarred for the moment, its surface mostly clear of marks or scars.   Small files and drills lay stacked neatly at one end, while blank scraps are piled at the other.  The faint tang of oil hangs in the air, but it isn't altogether unpleasant.

title: [Golden Marble Table]
description: The square marble table's top matches perfectly with the marble in the top tier of the huge fountain that looms to the northwest.  Thin, multicolored strands course through the golden marble, causing the surface to sparkle in the light.  The table's top has been buffed to a fine sheen, and the edges and supports are exactly chiseled.  An umbrella with a grey-and-gold awning spreads out over the table in an attempt to shade the occupants from the sun.  A freestanding torch occupies a place near the table.

title: [Paupers, Sentinel Hall]
description: Several torches in silver sconces are placed about the walls.  Near an ora-bound door sits a supply rack filled with a variety of blades, pole-arms, and shields, and a small sandalwood bar with a gold-threaded tapestry hanging high above it rests in one corner.  The back wall holds three chiseled stone statues near a broad window overlooking the performer's courtyard.  In the center of the room stands a circular ironwood table with cushioned mahogany chairs positioned around it.

title: [Paupers, Office]
description: An opulent, gentleman's haven greets you as you enter the private control center of the House.  Leather-bound books, oil paintings and sportsman's trophies line the walls, the stuffed head of a fearsome black shambler dominating the wall over a large couch.  Easy chairs surround a richly appointed desk under a window.

title: [Paupers, Workshop]
description: Hanging tapestries that decorate the four corners of this room accentuate the vaulted ceiling -- the symbols for fire, earth, air and water are all represented in the various designs.  Jagged burns on the hardwood floor and several fingernail-sized gouges in the near wall offer evidence that suggests a powerful explosion, but from the looks of things it must have happened long ago.

title: [Paupers, Vault]
description: Light from several torches flickers over silver sconces fastened to the walls.  Legend has it that this heavily carpeted, soundproofed vault once successfully protected a king's ransom from an attempted siege by rampaging barbarians.  Few have attempted to breach the security of the members' steel-reinforced storage lockers in modern times, for tales of the consequences abound and are not for the faint of heart.

title: [Paupers, Spirits Cellar]
description: The smell of fermentation permeates this dusty sub-level of House Paupers.  Kegs of ale are stacked along the stone walls, forming a narrow aisle leading back to huge wine casks, some of which are as tall as a giantman.  Industrious spiders have constructed complex spiderwebs that hang from the rafters down to the casks of wine and kegs of ale.  Three glasses and several drained liquor bottles rest atop one of the kegs, suggesting a recent, spur-of-the-moment celebration.

title: [Paupers, Shadowy Corridor]
description: The only source of illumination amidst the dark passageway comes from two iron sconces on either side of a jagged opening in one wall.  Despite no evidence of fire, a soft, eerie yellow glow permeates the air about the sconces, providing a hazy light to a small portion of the hall.  Cloaked in shadows, a barely discernable archway lies opposite a worn wooden door.  Set into the wall at the furthest end of the corridor is a thick steel door covered in wards and runes.

title: [Pauper's, Private Library]
description: Bookcases, ornate tapestries, and paintings spread across the walls depict the history of the House of Paupers and the races of Elanthia, along with a row of high-hanging glaes orbs serving as the source of lighting.  A pair of small wooden footstools is tucked between the bookcases, and a pair of worn leather wingback chairs rests against the wall opposite the archway leading out of the room, next to which is a small granite bar.  A large rosewood desk envelops an entire corner of the library near a shadowy bookcase.

title: [Paupers, Toy Room]
description: Ocean scenes paint the toy box-lined walls, each open box stuffed with toys like treasure chests sunk upon the bottom of a deep blue sea.  Several brightly colored cushions are scattered about the floor, while a lacquered rocking chair rests upon a sand-hued woven rug in one corner.  Multiple driftwood shelves hang upon the wall, flanking a scorched ship's wheel mounted in between.  Judging by the layers of dust along the toy boxes, the halfling-sized wooden rabbit on rockers is a bit newer.

title: [House Brigatta, Memorial Garden]
description: A small flagstone courtyard sits among the flowers, statues occupying each corner.  With each stir of the air, the scent of lavender and sage from the surrounding flower beds fills the garden, and along the side of the house stands a row of blueberry bushes.  In the center of the courtyard sits a sapphire blue, ceramic receptacle and a long, wrought iron bench with silver inlay.  A square pedestal beside the receptacle bears a large copper plaque, and a garden path leads back to the lane.

title: [House Brigatta, Memorial Garden]
description: A small flagstone courtyard sits among the flowers, statues occupying each corner.  With each stir of the air, the scent of lavender and sage from the surrounding flower beds fills the garden, and along the side of the house stands a row of blueberry bushes.  In the center of the courtyard sits a sapphire blue, ceramic receptacle and a long, wrought iron bench with silver inlay.  A square pedestal beside the receptacle bears a large copper plaque, and a garden path leads back to the lane.

title: [Villa Brigatta, Atrium]
description: Rows of white granite columns echo the outside stylings, ringing the room and bracing the corridor leading off to the east.  At the center and beneath an open ceiling is a step-down area filled with comfortable settees.  To ward off the damp chill that comes with rain and cooler seasons is a free-standing white marble fireplace.  Blue star mosaic insets scatter across the pale travertine floor, and sky-hued gossamer curtains dance with the breeze.  A garden lush with native plants opens out to the north.

title: [Villa Brigatta, Thermae]
description: Enclosed on the southern end and open to columned views of the peristyle to the north, a sunken pool is ringed with blue tiles featuring rampant unicorns and graduated star mosaics on the bottom, forming various constellations.  Gossamer panels create a veil of privacy for the various lounging chairs placed around the perimeter.  Rosewood-barreled citrus trees thrive in the humidity, adding their intoxicating fragrance to the scent of lavender oil in the wall lamps.

title: [Villa Brigatta, Peristyle]
description: Ringed by a colonnade, fruit trees and other flora fill the tiered garden sinking down below the main level.  Each level has a carved stone bench placed near fragrant flowers or shady dwarf plane trees.  Colorful, trellised bougainvillea scales the villa walls in a riot of fuchsia, coral, and purple blossoms.  The edge of the cliff upon which the building is perched commands a stunning view of the Stormbrow volcano, and a small studio at the far end of the terrace creates a private retreat.

Each level has a carved stone bench placed near fragrant flowers or shady dwarf plane trees.  Two large torches flank the entrance of the villa, adding a soft illumination to the fragrant gardens.  The edge of the cliff upon which the building is perched commands a stunning view of the Stormbrow volcano, and a small studio at the far end of the terrace creates a private retreat.

title: [Villa Brigatta, Berkana's Haven]
description: Large open windows admit a soft breeze that stirs the white gossamer curtains framing them, and the skylighted ceiling admits the niveous moonlight.  A black marble fireplace on the east wall is banked with tinder, with a thick snowcat fur rug set before it.  Opposite the hearth is an ebonwood four-poster bed, its green comforter turned down to reveal onyx silk sheets.  Next to it is a matching night table upon which sits a vase of fragrant mournblooms.

title: [Brigatta Teras Annex, Lockers]
description: This small, hidden room has been painted dark cerulean blue and features whimsical designs of stars, crossed swords and staves, and prancing unicorns bordering the walls near the ceiling.

title: [The Revenant Rancher]
description: Bone-handled spades hang precariously from the roof of this shop, the faintest of breeze stirring them to clang about like an eerie metallic cacophony, reminiscent of windchimes.  Each wall is grotesquely ornamented by bloodied hooves, horns, or even lambskin tapestries splattered with dried blood and bone fragments.  An entire swathe of animal fur is draped over a bent wooden counter, which stretches out in front of some high maoral shelves.

title: [GHOUL Gaming Hall, Foyer]
description: In the center of this spacious foyer is a claw-footed gnarled oak pedestal, prominently featured amongst the drab surroundings of scratched oak flooring and the dull red velvet tapestries which cover every wall.  A rough woolen carpet is set in front of the maple door leading into the ballroom.

title: [GHOUL Gaming Hall, Ballroom]
description: The high vaulted ceilings of this ballroom are the only aspect of grandiosity to be seen in an otherwise meager setting.  Rows of rickety tables have tall silver wastebins set at each end, but lack any apparent seating.  A short wooden chair sits next to a glass-paned polished teak case on a small stage, opposite the maple door leading to the foyer.

title: [Darkness, Tunnel]
description: An entire stone railing juts up from the ground, climbing into the darkness above.  Patches of glowing toadstools offer very little lighting while traversing through the tunnel, giving guidance that the only pathway runs east to west.

title: [Darkness, Tunnel]
description: Fireflies flit about in the darkness; a small grouping of them has been caught in an intricate spider web.  A breach in one of the walls has become home to a spider the size of a giantman's fist.  The husks of its prey litter the ground and create a crunching sound underfoot.

title: [Darkness, Tunnel]
description: A large snake skin has taken up most of the walkway, causing you to hug close to the walls.  Jagged stones jut out at every turn threatening to rip open anything they come in contact with.  The faint sounds of something slithering can be heard in the distance.

title: [Necropolis, Nexus]
description: Several western tunnels lead off in different directions, all so poorly lit, it's difficult to see where they lead.  A shallow grave looks to have been recently disturbed, with piles of dirt displaced all around it.  Off to the east, a faintly glowing lantern illuminates the path.

title: [The Coventry, Hollow]
description: The tree opens up into an abstract circular space encased by craggy, natural wood polished to a golden finish, and a ramp carved directly into the oak climbs ever upward into the loftier hollow reaches above.  Flameless candles that nevertheless emit a brilliant incandescence light the upward journey from their niches above the ramp, while drifting through the air are small motes of light in varying hues of soft blues and greens, idly bobbing in place to fill the tree with muted shades of luminescence.

title: [Necropolis, Descent]
description: An old iron lantern hangs over a giant pile of rubble from a recent cave-in.  A steep ramp leading up is covered in encrusted gore, likely used to dump the dead that had no place in the necropolis.

title: [Necropolis, Crossing]
description: Two large statues stand guard over the northern entrance into the necropolis, facing the remains of a stone bridge that overlooks a vast abyss of darkness.  Each statue holds a rusted iron pike, which cross over each other like an archway.

title: [Necropolis, Hall of the Dead]
description: Upon the moss-covered limestone walls, shallow niches house a number of sarcophagi.  Iron sconces give off a pale green illumination, giving the hall an eerie presence.  Smeared trails of blood and gore lead in every direction.  Lengths of tattered cloth are scattered across the floor.

title: [Necropolis, Corridor]
description: Rivulets of water glisten on the walls, disappearing in and out of patches of moss that cling to the limestone.  Small piles of entrails shine wetly in the light of the torches set into several sconces placed around the room.  Drag marks in dust-caked blood lead from the north toward a crumbling stone archway.

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: Spiderwebs fill the corners of this room and cobwebs dangle over a crumbling stone archway, waving gently in the slightest breeze.  A large stone sarcophagus, its lid slightly askew, rests in the center of the room.  Faint scratching noises emanate from the sarcophagus, but the source of the sound is safely hidden in the deep shadows.

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: A headless humanoid statue sits on a throne atop a raised rostrum against the eastern wall.  Spiderwebs completely cover the statue, obfuscating its intended identity.  Cradled in the mass of webbing in the outstretched right hand is a bloody heart, which still looks fresh enough to beat.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: A ring of torches burns brightly around the room, yet the ceiling is lost in the darkness above.  Here and there, orbs of reflected torchlight shine back at you from above, but seem to blink in and out of existence.  Piles of cobweb-encased bones litter the floor, and the sense of being watched permeates the dusty air.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: A headless humanoid statue sits on a throne atop a raised rostrum against the western wall.  Spiderwebs completely cover the statue, obfuscating its intended identity.  Cradled in the mass of webbing of the outstretched left hand is a severed head, which still looks fairly fresh.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: An overturned sarcophagus lies along the western wall, its tenant spilling out onto the dusty stone floor.  Strips of cloth extend from the skeleton, as if small scavengers tried to make off with it.  The skeleton's mandible lies several feet away from its outstretched arm.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: A huge pile of bones dominates the center of the room.  Femurs, phalanges, tibias, skulls, and other various bones lay jumbled in a pile nearly the height of a giantman.  Deep teeth marks mar each bone, and most of the longer ones have been broken in half.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [The Pitchfork Emporium]
description: Rough wood serves as the floor, though clearly it has seen better days as it is covered in scratches and drippings of tar.  A giant cloth banner across the back wall, its message written in large print, and serves to draw attention to a polished oak stand that lies beneath.  Off to the side, a cracked wooden rack sits in a corner, while a bright faewood table stands out back near the entrance.

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: The torso of a skeleton is mounted to the eastern wall by a massive web.  The skeleton's limbs and head are nowhere in sight.  Drag marks in the dust covering the blood-stained stone floor suggest the remains may have been taken in different directions.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: A large bronze brazier burns in the very center of the room, causing the lichen on the walls to glow a sickly greenish color.  Small idols rest in shadowed niches evenly spaced around the room, their jeweled eyes focused on a deteriorated ivory coffin.
paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Feral Fashions]
description: Thick black canvas walls create a darkened interior that is only countered by an amber-paned lantern that illuminates the center of the room.  In the small dim beam of light a group of mannequins kneel surrounding a mangled carcass.  A cool breeze flutters in through a tent flap, creating the only relief from the overwhelming stench of rot that hangs inside the tent.

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: Urns of various sizes take up all available space in this room.  Scarabs, spiders, and beetles of all sizes scurry in and out of the urns, creating a nearly constant drone of scuttling sounds.  The chipped and broken pieces of dislodged lids lay scattered across the stone floor, crunching under your feet with every step.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: Torches mounted along the eastern wall cast a dim light that barely touches the other side of the room.  A mummified corpse, clothed in full battle armor, reclines in an alcove set into the western wall.  Cobwebs and dust coat the fallen warrior, obscuring the crest on his breastplate.  His helmet is clasped at his side by one gauntleted hand.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: Six large stone sarcophagi form a rough circle around the circumference of the dais in the center of the room.  The life sized image of a knight in full armor has been painstakingly chiseled into the lid of each sarcophagus.  The tattered, moldy remains of six banners stand in the center of the circle, the faded cloth waving gently in the slightest breeze.  A crumbling stone stairwell climbs up and out of the narthex.

title: [Necropolis, Ascendant]
description: Torches mounted in iron sconces encompass the room, casting a dim light that barely reaches the hewn stone of the ceiling.  Two mummified corpses, clothed in tattered robes, have been tossed into an alcove set into the eastern wall.  To the north is an expansive stone door which appears closed.

title: [Necropolis, Ascendant]
description: Lit torches ring this circular room, casting their glow on the dusty stone floor.  Looking closer at the stones you notice two concentric circles encompassing runes drawn in blood.  In the center of the circle lies an outstretched skeleton with a rusty dagger protruding from its breastbone.

title: [Necropolis, Ascendant]
description: Several torches ring this circular room, casting their glow on the dusty stone floor.  Looking closer at the stones you notice triangular runes drawn in blood which, linked together, also form a circle.  In the center of the circle lies an outstretched skeleton with a rusty dagger protruding from its skull.

title: [Necropolis, Vent Shaft]
description: A faint patch of light can be seen above, yet is not strong enough to illuminate the walls or floor.  Dank, musty air fills your nostrils and odd scratching noises emanate from the oppressive darkness.  The vertical incline has a slight slope that can be crawled upward.

title: [Necropolis, Ascendant]
description: The low, vaulted ceiling contains a myriad of cracks and fissures, the depths of which seem to be intensified by the dim torchlight.  From time to time, a hazy shower of dust falls from some of the larger cracks, threatening to bring the rest of the ceiling down on top of you.  To the south is an expansive stone door which appears open.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Broken limbs lie in scattered heaps across the soggy ground, their ends clawed and chewed upon by some unseen animal.  A narrow tree-enshrouded path leads further into a thick wooded pass, away from the swamp.  Sprouting out of their rotting expanses are tubes of wild mushrooms with cup-shaped heads and blue-green blades of wildrye.  A thin trail of stones winds its way through the slogging mud and provides a solid means of egress from the area.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: A single smoky torch is set on the eastern wall to light the path.  Several bones have been wedged into cracks in the walls, perhaps as an attempt to reinforce them for a bit longer.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: Smoke from burning torches lingers in the air, mixing with dust and causing the narrowing passage to feel more constricting.  Long curtains of cobwebs hang from the ceiling and walls, stirring slightly.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Dilapidated Yard]
description: All around, large banyan trees and black ash hover like parents over children.  Lanterns lit with bright flames hang around the diliapidated fence, which is so ridden with rot, holes, and breaks in the wood that it can't rightly be called a proper enclosure.  Some distance across from a half-built barn are a shack leaning far to the left, a small crumbling stone structure, and wooden shed.  Dark muck and puddles of mud riddle the ground, and a fine mist of what can only be spores hangs in the air.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: A dimly lit torch sits crookedly in a rusty iron bracket on the western wall, barely providing enough illumination to light the way.  Several large rodent skeletons lie in the shadows.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: The deeply shadowed corridor leads off to the north and south, with little distinction between the two.  A multitude of scuff marks on the dusty ground bear witness to recent travel through this area.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: The air is musty and stale, combining with close quarters and low light to give an oppressive feel.  Faint scratching noises come from all around, accompanied by the nearly imperceptible sound of unidentifiable breathing.  A narrow ledge can be seen along the western wall.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: A single torch sputters in its rusted sconce, providing just enough light to make way through this narrow corridor.  Thick, spongy moss clings to the limestone walls, muffling any sound.  A narrow ledge can be seen along the western wall.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: A slight breeze blows through the corridor, causing the shadows cast by twin copper-banded torches to dance on the moss-covered walls.  The sound of scampering and scratching comes from behind the pile of bones heaped in one corner.

title: [Wild Things, Euphoria]
description: White sheets of thick canvas hang from sturdy steel rods and cover the massive iron bars along the perimeter.  Filled with cattail and milkweed clusters, maoral boxes decorate the room, nearly hiding a small kennel and slatted crate that have been carefully tucked behind the planters.  Dangling precariously from a hook in the ceiling is a gilded bird cage, and a glass aquarium has been perched atop a sturdy table.

title: [Wild Things, Despair]
description: The back section is a near mirror image of the front area except for the ebon canvas sheets that add a darker ambience to the room.  Pots filled with black sand surround both a large box and a splintered crate, and a wrought iron hutch has been secured to the metal bars.  A large glass aquarium with an open lid rests on the ground.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: Wet, mashed bits of entrails glisten in the torchlight along the corridor's stone floor.  Congealing trails of blood lead southward.  A narrow ledge can be seen along the western wall.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: Twin sputtering torches provide just enough illumination to make out a figure on the eastern wall.  Hanging by his manacled hands is the decomposing body of a young male gnome.  Several stab wounds are visible on his chest and blood stains his dark robes.  A narrow ledge can be seen along the western wall.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: A faint draft moves through the area, carrying with it a barely perceptible odor.  The stone floor is covered with bits of tattered cloth and drying blood.  Piled on a large, flat stone in the center of the corridor is a heap of severed thumbs.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Passages]
description: An iron-hinged ebonwood door guards the northern end of the long hallway.  A cool draft pours into the area from somewhere close by -- the gust of air circulating the scent of sulfur into the passages.

title: [Maps Galore]
description: A tall wooden post centered in the middle of the area holds up the tattered and torn material of the tent's walls.  Sitting beside the tent post is a table with a variety of maps for sale upon it.

title: [Questing for Maps]
description: A tall wooden post centered in the middle of the area holds up the tattered and torn material of the tent's walls.  Sitting beside the tent post is a table with a variety of maps for sale upon it.

title: [Maphaven]
description: A tall wooden post centered in the middle of the area holds up the tattered and torn material of the tent's walls.  Sitting beside the tent post is a table with a variety of maps for sale upon it.

title: [Necropolis, Dark Sanctuary]
description: A towering sculpture in the likeness of Luukos dominates the sanctuary -- crafted from viridian marble, time has worn its way through the rock, causing severe damage.  Much of its left arm and shoulder lie strewn across the northern wall, entirely blocking off an archway.  Underneath the wreckage, a partially collapsed tunnel has been exposed.  A narrow chasm can be seen off to the west of an iron-hinged ebonwood door.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: The unstable walls have buckled in several places, depositing large chunks of stone along the path and nearly blocking the way ahead.  Mounds of dirt and rubble cause the route through the tunnel to be more circuitous in order to avoid possibly creating a cave in.

title: [Face Off]
description: Piles of brightly colored boxes stretch along the wagon walls.  A horseshoe-shaped counter rests in the middle of the narrow space.  A well-dressed rakish sylvan mannequin is posed to lean on the counter and is facing a winking human mannequin standing behind the counter.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: Large chunks of wall lay strewn about the corridor, making the way precarious.  A lone torch, sputtering in its iron sconce, provides just enough light to traverse the rubble.  The jagged end of a bone sticks out of the exposed earthen wall.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: Thin layers of webbing encase a small winged statue which lies against one wall.  One wing is fully outstretched, while the other has broken off and rests nearby.  Two empty depressions in the statue's face stare into the dark.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: A raggedly clothed skeleton lies facing one wall, a perfectly cut ruby loosely held in one hand.  The skeleton's other hand lies across its skull in a defensive gesture.  Scrawled in dried blood on the stone floor is a single word, "CURSED."

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: The tunnel is wider here and several stone pillars stand on either side.  Intricate webbing connects two of the pillars, and in the center sits an enormous spider.  Torchlight reflects in the beady eyes of the spider as two of its legs twitch and wave aggressively.

title: [Distinguished Arms]
description: The suede walls of the tent hang heavily to enclose this modest space, pooling on the ground to keep the air outside from seeping in.  From the ebonwood supports overhead, a handful of gold-bracketed lanterns dangle, their flames burning high within vented orb-shaped shades to provide an abundance of light.  At the edge of the space are several ebonwood displays of small arms, while the heart of the area is occupied by glass case.

title: [Hissyfit]
description: Beveled sections of the elongated wagon's walls are covered in dark bronze-scaled paneling, boldly outlining a small carved oak cage that sits below a series of rusted steel hooks.  In the center of the room, tall aromatic grasses and violet-tinged pitcher plants wreathe around a large open-mouth pit hollowed in the ebonwood flooring.  Permeated by a faintly metallic copper tang, a rich herbaceous undertone punctuates the stilness of the air.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: A section of the wall has been chiseled out and the dirt behind it removed to form a small rectangular niche.  Resting in the niche is an oblong pile of dusty rags surrounded by a ring of dried flower petals.  A tiny skeletal foot pokes out of one end of the pile.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: Moss clings to the limestone walls, muffling the sounds in the dim tunnel.  Several small niches have been seemingly randomly cut into the walls on either side.  Staring out from the shadowy depths of each recess is a shrunken head.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: Large chunks of moss have been torn from the limestone walls and strewn carelessly on the ground.  Bloody claw marks mar the limestone in the places where the moss has been torn away.  A jagged, torn fingernail is stuck in one particularly gruesome streak.

title: [Necropolis, Sunken Tunnel]
description: Forward progress is temporarily halted by a wide crevasse that spans the width of the tunnel.  Scuffs and claw marks are visible along the far edge.  The bottom of the crevasse is lost in the shadows.

title: [Clepsydra, Voln Chamber]
description: Painted murals cover all four walls of this chamber, showing images of a path winding through a forest to the edge of a clear pool.  Tall candelabras hold several white taper candles filling the room with their warm glow and a light fresh air scent.  In the center, a large ceramic vessel sits adjacent to a round white marble slab on a black pedestal.

title: [Necropolis, Narrow Ledge]
description: The narrow ledge is no more than a few feet wide, with just enough room to not become a victim to the depths below.  A wide crevasse leads toward a sunken tunnel, which can barely be seen from this distance.  To the west, a massive waterfall pours out from a breach in the wall.

title: [Necropolis, Narrow Ledge]
description: The deafening sound of a waterfall can be heard to the north.  The ledge ends abruptly, and the only way to continue is to leap into the depths below.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: Rushing water cascades from the darkness above, as far as the eye can see.  Luminescent toadstools offer some lighting around the underground lake.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: A graveyard of modwir gondolas has washed up on the shore of the underground lake.  The poor lighting offers no hint at how expansive the body of water could be, and the depth becomes too much to continue to wade through.

title: [From the Depths]
description: Irregular gaps in the plank walls and ceiling emit shafts of moonlight that form a webwork of shadows on the dirt floor.  A dirty counter, constructed of a warped board stretched between haphazardly stacked rocks, leans precariously against one wall.  Some corroded hooks have been driven into the back wall.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: The area is pitch dark with only a few glowing toadstools dotting the shoreline.  The vast lake stretches into an abyss of murky swamp water.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: Bits and pieces of debris bob in the eerie stillness of the underground lake.  The putrid scent of swamp gas rises from the water, a familiar smell of Feywrot Mire.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Taken With Tomes]
description: Dusty shelves filled with books line the wall behind a wooden counter crowded with stools.  Below a curtained window, an oil-filled lamp with a soot-smudged glass globe rests on a writing desk cluttered with parchment and ink-stained quills.  A stack of crates scrawled with various ports of call blocks the view into the rear of the wagon.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: Bits and pieces of debris bob in the eerie stillness of the underground lake.  The putrid scent of swamp gas rises from the water, a familiar smell of Feywrot Mire.

title: [Twinkle, Tulle, and Tartan]
description: Strands of tealight-hung rope weave in and out along the ceiling of the tent, the miniscule glass spheres twinkling like fireflies against the muted blue-violet silk walls.  A large ivory linden waterlily serves as a makeshift table in the center of the room, the blossom surrounded by several rounded faenor lilypads containing various wares.  Layers of bluish leather line the ground, the rugs sprinkled in a mixture of glittery confetti leaking from a chain-strung crystal bowl next to the exit.

title: [Mystic Arcanum]
description: Layers of plush silk carpets in shades of blue cover the ground in this area, and some felt-lined grey hoarbeam racks stand around the perimeter of the room.  A single candelabra illuminates a small grey hoarbeam table, and the faint mingled scents of beeswax and sawdust linger in the air.  A draped archway along one crystal-spangled velvet wall leads further into the shop.

title: [Mystic Arcanum - Back Room]
description: Crystal stars suspended on silver filaments of alternating lengths dangle from the indigo velvet canopy, catching and refracting light from nearby candelabrum.  A glass-paneled hoarbeam armoire stands open opposite a set of a set of grey hoarbeam shelves, both displaying a colorful collection of wares.  A draped archway, partially hidden behind the hoarbeam armoire, leads back towards the entrance to the shop.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: Bits and pieces of debris bob in the eerie stillness of the underground lake.  The putrid scent of swamp gas rises from the water, a familiar smell of Feywrot Mire.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: Jutting out to the north is a rotted wooden dock, surrounded by marooned gondolas.  A dim green glow can be seen under the surface of the water.

title: [Necropolis, Underground Lake]
description: Surrounding the southern end of the dock is a graveyard of modwir gondolas, which juts out into the murky dark water of the underground lake.  Incandescent moss lines the opening of a narrow rocky fissure.

title: [Necropolis, Abysm]
description: The scent of sulphur intoxicates the area, the fumes so thick they feel heavy on the air.  The cramped space is engulfed in darkness, and there is barely enough room to crawl up through the narrow tunnel.

title: [Another Life]
description: This cramped wagon is packed to the brim with all sorts of odds-and-ends.  A large coffin-shaped table rests in the center of the room piled with strange-looking ears, shoes and such.  A shabby wooden chest sits on the floor against the wall, heaping with oddball things.

title: [Necropolis, Abysm]
description: Through the plethora of small tunnels, motes of greens and blues waver in and out of existence.  The sharp incline is hard to traverse, but not impossible with several iron spikes to use as grips.

title: [Necropolis, Abysm]
description: Deep grooves mar the tunnel walls, giving just enough leverage to continue crawling through the tapered space.  Slimy residue glistens overhead from spiderwebs that expand across the ceiling of the tunnel.

title: [Necropolis, Abysm]
description: High above, though accessible, a glimpse of moonlight filters through a narrow fissure at the top of the cramped tunnel.  The smell of sulphur comes from deep below.

title: [Black Out]
description: These walls are lacking windows; only a faint amount of light is emitted by a rusted lantern fixed to the wall.  Against the wall is a dark armoire with an expansive black rug monopolizing the floor in front of it.

title: [Necropolis, Excavation]
description: The excavation site is just a mere niche into the side of a limestone cliff that overlooks a cerulean phantasmal forest.  Though quite the drop, it offers a vast spectacle of the Miasmic Verge.  Dangling down into the fissure, an old knotted rope could reach a section below.

title: [Phantasmal Forest, Approach]
description: The phantasmal forest is made up of cerulean-hued trees, their forms tangible, but translucent.  The ground is scorched, but there is no sign of a fire elsewhere.

title: [Phantasmal Forest, Approach]
description: Through the ghostly forest, a serpent skull-faced stone castle can be seen protruding through the treetops.  Varying colored motes drift to the ground throughout the area.

title: [Phantasmal Forest, Castle Gate]
description: The forest comes to an end at a massive black ora portcullis.  Fresh blood stains the stone walls of the castle entrance, and skeletal remains line the threshold of the courtyard, and whatever lies within.

title: [Castle of the Damned, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard is barren of vegetation, and the soil is stained with blood.  High above the stone wall is a serpent skull carved from the face of the castle.  A monolithic idol of Luukos is toppled over in front of a ruined black ora door.

title: [Swamp Carvings]
description: The bottom half of an old wine cask rests in the bed of this tiny cart, surrounded by some painted clay pots.  Each holds a collection of whimisically carved figures, nestled in cushioning sawdust.  Suspended by copper wires from the front of the cart is a carved wooden placard.

The bottom half of an old wine cask rests in the bed of this tiny cart, surrounded by some painted clay pots.  Each holds a collection of whimsically carved figures, nestled in cushioning sawdust.  Suspended by copper wires from the front of the cart is a carved wooden placard.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [A Slipshod Building]
description: The ramshackled building is visibly leaning too far to the right, its oaken walls drastically slanting in a precarious manner.  A clattering of loose planks dangles around wide breaches that are punched along the unstable ceiling above, the openings splashing streams of sunlight onto the crooked flooring.  Amid the clutter of cobwebs and dust, an unfinished dark pine cabinet sits next to a dented walnut and elm chest.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Standing alone within a wasteland of tumbled rocks and thick clumps of moss is an enormous banyan tree reaching toward the sky.  Thick roots, resembling the legs of an enormous spider, rise out of the soft, muddy ground and create arches that encircle the smooth barked monstrosity.  High in the tangled canopy are several enormous nests, their ragged edges cluttered with vulture feathers and rodent bones.

title: [The Tonsorium]
description: Old clawfoot benches line the walls down the length of the wagon.  Over their backs large, bevel-edged mirrors reflect to vanishing infinities.  A leather-padded stool occupies the center of the interior, encircled by a path of worn floorboards.  The ginger wisp of an odd shorn lock lies curled in an unswept corner.

title: [The Tonsorium, Rear Deck]
description: The short deck of lacquered floorboards is constrained by an ornate brass waist rail and, overhead, a red and white striped awning trimmed with golden piping along its scalloped edges.  Off to one side a brass ladder ascends the rear wall of the wagon to its rooftop.

title: [The Tonsorium, Rooftop]
description: A low brass rail ornaments the edges of the wagon's roof.  Polished to a glinting gleam and a mere six inches high, the rail's usefulness as a safety device is dubious.  From a pair of brass-trimmed vents drifts an aromatic air of barbershop smells: talc, oil of cloves, shaving soap.  The bracing scents are brief relief, soon corrupted by the noxious gases of the swamp.

title: [Castle of the Damned, Hallway]
description: The hallway has collapsed in all directions, cutting off access to the remaining passageways of the castle.  A section of the floor exposes a tunnel underneath the hallway, which is surrounding by icy bones.

title: [Castle of the Damned, Nadir]
description: The circular chamber has four unlit brazier surrounding an icy rhimar sigil.  At the north end of the room is a massive black ora door, which is a closed.  The chamber is bare of any other furnishings or relics.  A makeshift set of steps leads leading upward through a tunnel in the ceiling.

title: [Castle of the Damned, Chamber]
description: Blood stains the floor of the chamber, surrounding a raised platform in the center of the room.  A glowing violet mote floats above a colossal granite sepulcher.  A faintly glowing exit within the mist serves as the only egress from the castle, as the black ora door is completely surrounded by a magical barrier from this side of the chamber.

title: [Necropolis, Egress]
description: A thick blanket of mist stretches across the entire area, making it difficult to know what is ahead.  A putrid smell of swamp lingers in the cramped space, coming from an outward direction.

title: [Pie In The Sky]
description: A slight breeze of cool air floats in through a tent flap, providing a much-needed reprieve from the warmth inside the tent.  A set of large stoves rests in the rear of the tent, radiating waves of pastry-scented heat.  A long counter sits in the center of the room, beads of condensation forming on the glass.

title: [Halfway Midway, South Wall]
description: The prize wall is surrounded by balloons, though some are deflated or soiled with bird droppings.  Items hang on hooks and sit on a long rickety counter for perusal.  The ground is littered with torn ticket stubs.  A trampled dirt path leads back to the Midway.

title: [No Noose Is Good Noose]
description: Each plank that makes up the small interior has been painted a different hideously garish shade, the colors vividly clashing with the stark white painted floor.  Garlands of feathers adorn the back wall, the chartreuse plumes suspending a haphazard looking shelf.  A small rack shaped to look like a grinning mouth rests on the floor just above a sign that reads, "If you aint dead, you win!"

title: [Halfway Midway, South Wall]
description: Dirty streamers adorn this western side of the prize wall.  A large harbinger skull has been mounted atop the wall, its eyes watching over the spoils below.  The ground around a long rickety counter is littered with torn ticket stubs.

title: [The Gullet]
description: Carnelian-lensed lanterns flood the passage with the color of blood and serve to draw the walls inward.  Combined with the pale ribs and alternating expanses of smooth, wetly gleaming walls between them, the sense of being within the throat of a serpent is inescapable.

title: [Just a Pinch]
description: A set of crooked splintering steps lead out of this tiny one-roomed wagon.  A stained waern pelt rug is spread across the warped floorboards and a dusty glass case stands in the center of the area.  Leaning carelessly against the case is a misshapen pine crate supporting a lopsided poplar table.

title: [Ancient Passage]
description: The passageway widens to the west, where rows of columns are visible to the north and south, supporting the ceiling as it rises dramatically.  Ornately carved balustrades bracket the processional route which continues westward toward a massive, golden sandstone altar raised high on a dais.  To the east, the walls and ceiling close in rapidly, the passage shrinking to enter a dimly lit tunnel.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, Northeast]
description: A colonnade of giant, misshapen figures stand poised with raised appendages supporting the enormous chamber's cathedral-arched ceiling.  Besides abyran'sa and vathor, there are paired columns sculpted in at least half a dozen other demonic species.  Raised on a dais to the southwest, a massive stone altar is clearly visible.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, North Gallery]
description: Continuing from the southeast, the audience of demon-carved columns fills this portion of the hall facing the dais.  Although those recognizable as vathor and oculoth have been stretched and distorted in order to serve as support columns for the high-arched ceiling, other unnameable creatures have been carved in crouching poses with appendages folded double in order to fit into the same space.  Close against the west wall, a narrow set of marble stairs ascends the dais to the south.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, East]
description: Ornate balustrades define the hall's central aisle toward the east but end in the center of the room, where a double-arc of columns faces the dais that rests atop a semicircle of golden steps near the chamber's west wall.  Each column has been carved into a stylized species of demon that both supports the high ceiling and stands as a mute witness to whatever transpires at the stone altar atop the dais.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [The Jaded Jester, The Maw]
description: Sparse candlelight casts flickering shadows along the walls and floor of this musty smelling room.  An old, worn out tapestry hangs along a side wall, where a crack resembling a jagged, toothy smile disappears behind it.  A large wardrobe closet along the far wall stands open, and items of various colors and materials are haphazardly strewn within.  The light within the room is distorted by two mirrors, one an oversized wavy glass mirror and the other an immaculately polished mirror, each one facing the other.

title: [The Jester's Reflection]
description: The light here is reflected through the mirror, which creates wavy shadows on the walls.  Dusty wooden crates have been stacked into a corner.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, Southeast]
description: A colonnade of giant, misshapen figures stand poised with raised appendages supporting the enormous chamber's cathedral-arched ceiling.  Besides abyran'sa and vathor, there are paired columns sculpted in at least half a dozen other demonic species.  Raised on a dais to the northwest, a massive altar stone is clearly visible.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, South Gallery]
description: Continuing from the northeast, the audience of demon-carved columns fills this portion of the hall, facing the dais.  Although those recognizable as vathor and oculoth have been stretched and distorted in order to serve as support columns for the high-arched ceiling, other unnameable creatures have been carved in crouching poses with appendages folded double in order to fit into the same space.  Close against the west wall, a narrow set of marble steps ascends the dais to the north.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, South Wing]
description: Unremarkable in decor, this small hallway is lined with stone columns that lack the elaborate carvings of those previously seen.  A thick layer of dust conceals the floor, and an enormous collection of tangled cobwebs hangs from the ceiling.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, South Wing]
description: Unremarkable in decor, this small hallway is lined with stone columns that lack the elaborate carvings of those previously seen.  Unnatural screeches and moans echo through the dark corridor.  An empty sconce hangs on the wall.

title: [Barroom Brawl, Entry]
description: Dust-covered tables and broken chairs litter the room, along with some overturned crates, discarded peanut shells, and bits of broken glass that crunch underfoot.  Displayed on a long mahogany bartop is a small collection of weapons.  A ripped canvas curtain is draped behind the bar, and muddy boot marks lead up to a rough-framed opening in the far wall.

title: [Barroom Brawl, Back Porch]
description: Vandalism has clearly been a problem on this tiny, enclosed porch.  Moonlight reflects off of the shards of shattered glass beneath a broken window and, even in the dim light, an iron prybar can be seen resting beside some labeled shipping trunks.  Scorch marks along the walls, floor boards, and a blackened wood sign indicate that some have ignored the clear warning labels attached to each trunk.  A framed opening leads back to the main shop.

title: [Barroom Brawl, Bunkroom]
description: The wood planking on the walls in this tiny room has clearly seen better days, with odd color variations in the green, black, and grey mold creeping up the perpetually damp surfaces.  A pair of muddy boots rests beneath an unmade cot, and a small nightstand holds a few personal articles.  Overturned, empty liquor crates are scattered about and appear to provide the only seating.

title: [Protect and Serve]
description: A mud-smeared black and beige wool rug, woven with the image of heavily armored warriors, stretches across the floor of the wagon.  A low wooden bunk over a wooden drawer with a gear for a handle is built into the rear of the wagon, reinforced with two thick steel chains that secure it to the wall.  Dusty tapestries line the walls above neatly organized workspaces which hold bits of leather, assorted metal rings and plates, and other materials used in armor manufacturing.  Nearly hidden behind a diminutive armoire inlaid with copper sprockets is a small wooden hatch that leads outside.

title: [Protect and Serve, Wagon Yard]
description: A white-striped black canvas awning, supported by a pair of thin steel poles, stretches from the roof of the wagon, casting the thick muddy ground in deep shadow.  Several wooden crates are stacked to one side of a small wooden hatch.  At the edge of the yard stands a tiny portable forge with an iron anvil and a low worktable nearby.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, South Wing]
description: Unremarkable in decor, this small hallway is lined with stone columns that lack the elaborate carvings of those previously seen.  A putrid odor hangs in the air near a pile of bloodstained cloths with what appears to be the remains of a decaying scalp protruding from beneath.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, South Wing]
description: Unremarkable in decor, this small hallway is lined with stone columns that lack the elaborate carvings of those previously seen.  Jagged scratches mar the walls, the deep grooves indicative of claw marks.  The corridor ends abruptly at a collapsed tunnel.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, Dais]
description: Honey-colored flames dance above braziers at the four corners of the dais, illuminating the massive sandstone altar and the nine-rayed black marble starburst that form the dais' backdrop against the enormous chamber's west wall.  Beneath the high domed ceiling, and close alongside the dais, a narrow set of marble steps leads down to the south gallery.  A set of marble stairs hugging the west wall leads down to the north gallery, and a semicircle of golden steps descends east to the main hall.

title: [Ruinic Ruins]
description: The inside of the shop is no different from the outside.  It is rather run down and doesn't appear to be too safe.  It does, however, look like an active shop.  While there is a generous layer of dust on the ground, there are what appear to be impressions of fresh foot traffic.  Some dusty faewood shelves line the back wall, and in the far corner along the same wall there is a small sturdy steel table.  A large wooden sign is set on the wall between the shelves and the table for all to see.

title: [The Hair Appeal]
description: Gaping holes in the ceiling are edged with black slime where the thatching has rotted away and allow splotches of moonlight to trickle into the dank room.  Roughened oak boards form the walls, though they display heavy signs of water damage and in places appear to be decomposing.  A long rough counter acts as guardian for the open door that rests off-kilter to its frame.

title: [I Do Eclair!, Under the Floor]
description: Cramped and dimly lit, this small area is contained by lichen-covered stone walls and a swept dirt floor.  A hefty, dull black metal safe stands open across from a rickety wooden desk next to a set of steep stairs.

title: [Annex, House Brigatta Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A blue velvet pennant edged with white hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [Griffin's Keen, High Haven]
description: Outside this aerie haven, the muffled shriek of the wind rises like the distant cry of a grieving soul.  A long crack on one side of the room lets in shafts of pale sunlight colored yellow by clumps of topaz prisms.  There is very little debris in here, and against the far wall, a simple pallet and a stack of thick blankets give testimony to someone's assessment of the safety of this place.

title: [Shadowy Shark Table]
description: Dark curtains keep this dimly lit table isolated from the rest of the room.  The table itself is nothing special, just a sturdy haon frame with small stools set around it.  A large bleached pair of jaws hold a lantern, providing what little light there is.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [The Believer]
description: Narrow in width, expansive in length, the tented area is situated atop the impressively flat roofs of two connected wagons.  Providing illumination, tiny flames dance within glass stars that are suspended between the pale blue fabric walls.  An assortment of garments is displayed on silver racks that hang from the dark blue ceiling.

title: [Sehrgar's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by smooth white plaster walls, the shop features a polar bear rug in the center of its oak floor.  A colorful Icemule map hangs under the oak-framed ceiling.  Right near the front is some stained driftwood shelves and a heavy wooden desk.

title: [All Wrapped Up, Showroom]
description: The walls are almost completely covered trying to hide the decrepitness of the structure, but cracks in beams and holes in the wall can still be seen.  A variety of colors can be found in the stacks of bolts, from the bright greens to vivid reds and touching upon every shade in the rainbow.  Some crates sit in front of a large sales counter piled full of different clothing being offered up for sale.  Near piles of materials a wooden ladder sits in the corner extending upwards to the next floor.

title: [All Wrapped Up, Loft]
description: The loft provides a large working are with a rug covering most of the old timbers making up the floor.  Pillows are strewn about the room the room for seating, some alone, some in pairs, some tossed into piles.  In one uncovered corner a wooden ladder leading back down to the showroom area.

title: [The Brazen Bull]
description: An oppressive heat fills the room, bearing down on everything within the walls even as it rises from a rectangular grate in the center of the floor.  Over the grate hangs a series of rusted iron hooks, upon which the shop's wares are displayed.  A large brass-framed painting has been mounted on the wall opposite the door.

title: [Sehrgar's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an oak-framed ceiling, a painted leather mask hangs on one of the smooth white plaster walls.  A salt-crusted sandstone case and an oversized sea chest sit in opposite corners while a knotted woolen rug rests on a varnished oak floor.

title: [Sehrgar's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an oak-framed ceiling, a pair of wooden snowshoes hangs on one of the smooth white plaster walls.  A salt-crusted sandstone case and a low wrought iron table sit in opposite corners while a knotted woolen rug rests on a varnished oak floor.

title: [Xtra-Small to XXXtra-Tiny]
description: The interior of this tiny hut looks more than anything like a hollowed-out stump, with chunks of decaying wood placed to cover the gaps between the rotted boards and moss hung to obscure the corners.  In bright contrast, an oil lamp hangs from the ceiling, its multiple wicks producing a glow that fills the snapdragon blossom-shaped body of the lamp and spills over to light the center of the room.  Within the pool of light rest some free-standing shelves, a small modwir rack, and a tiny wooden bin, laden with an assortment of goods.

title: [Whether We Weave]
description: High walls of rosy hues encapsulate the small space within the tree, their smooth faces decorated with the dark rings of age.  Thick glass jars are tied to spindled poles that crisscross the ceiling and are filled with starflies, who provide a soft glow of illumination for the surroundings.  Thin shelves line the walls and display their wares, while a curtain of liana vines provides egress.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Black Waters]
description: Bowing low toward the swamp, a weathered plank footbridge crosses a narrow stretch of water.  The brackish water swishes softly against the shoreline, the ground covered in pumpkin vines, some attached to decaying shells of squash, that snake over the land in criss-cross patterns.  Several tall black cypresses tower overhead, their branches hanging down at awkward angles, much like disjointed limbs.  Through the trees, a small house is visible.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Carving House]
description: Despite its obvious age, the house is small and cozy, with colorful rugs lining the ramshackle floor.  A collection of paintings hang from the walls, which are freshly painted in pale greens bordered by fanciful vinework and inset with clean, ivory-curtained windows.  Two chairs sit in front of a merrily burning hearth, while, situated just under an embroidered sign, a long wooden table covered in an ivory runner displays a variety of knives.

title: [Whether We Weave]
description: Colorful ribbons stretch across the ceiling in woven patterns of blue, green, and pink, their ends bound to knots in the rosy-hued walls.  Long glass pendants encircle the room, their interiors producing a soft glow by which to see.  A long seat has been carved out of the surrounding wood, while a long table stands opposite.

title: [Higher's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A large black wicker counter and a large carved haon display sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Wounded for Wear, Foyer]
description: The floor is covered in a plush crimson carpet with a series of black stripes, and the walls of the shop are painted black, with splotches of red paint on them.  Nestled into the wall is a small dark hole that leads back to the swamp.

title: [Higher's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A large carved haon shelf and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Higher's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A large carved haon shelf and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Magical Mayhem, Salesroom]
description: Small candles scattered about the hovel illuminate the area allowing a full view of the wares for sale in the rundown building.  The aroma of the surrounding swamp drifts in through all the cracks and gaps in the hovel's walls.  Some decrepit shelving lines one wall showing off the different items for sale.  In front of the shelves a sturdy counter sits where people are helped with their purchases.  Across from the counter is a battered driftwood door that leads to a backroom.

title: [Magical Mayhem, Workroom]
description: A hearth sits across from the door with a large cauldron bubbling over the embers of a fire.  An aroma of swamp, overcooked vegetation, and boiling meat emanates from the pot and fills the room.  A chair and small table sit at the foot of a dilapidated cot over in one corner of the room, leaving the rest of the small space open and clear.  The dirt floor shows signs, like a game trail in the woods, of crossing the room showing the occupants' usual paths.

title: [Alchemist's Delight, Front Room]
description: The well-lit tent has several crooked columns of cauldrons that are likely supporting the dark blue canvas walls and ceiling.  A small opening leads to a separate room toward the rear.  To the immediate right of the entrance is a small, neatly arranged area with a large rack, a display table, and a wicker basket.  A mithril placard loosely attached to the wall also stands out.

title: [Underground Cavern, Ravine]
description: Thin shafts of moonlight shutter down from far above, dimly illuminating the narrow ravine, which is filled with stench-ridden mud.  A hole of blackness resides at one end of the passageway, while the other end is framed by a partially crushed, wood-framed doorway.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Stalagmites jut out of the ground, paired with stalactites that splay out from the ceiling.  The water-glazed formations are arranged in arcing rows, lending the appearance of multiple gaping maws spread across the distance between a doorway and a vast, murky lake.  Small pools of clear water reflect the sputtering flames of torches that send shadows scurrying about in their flaring, haphazard light.  Below a gaping hole at the southern edge of the lake, the water gathers into a churning river.

title: [Underground Cavern, Hidden Cave]
description: Water drips down from the ceiling in a light shower of rain, though the central space of the miniature cavern is protected from some of the damp by the cap of a large, mushroom-shaped rock formation.  An especially large stalagmite is encircled by a slender strip of empty space from which pale, flickering light creeps up and into the area.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Black Lake]
description: This stretch of the lake spans from the cavern shore to a large block of limestone floating atop the water's surface.  Though it appears murky and dark, the lake's water is strangely silky, like a mixture of oil and satin that moves of its own accord against your skin.  Small bubbles float up from the depths, creating a burbling sound that disturbs the otherwise placid.  Opposite where the water swirls down into a churning river, the lake streches out into darkness.

title: [Cavern Lake, Limestone Island]
description: Surrounded by the murky black water, the wide block of limestone that makes up the island bobs up and down slightly atop the lake's surface.  Overhead, there is only darkness, save for a shipshod rope hanging from the pitch black and the faint outlines of several massive stalacmites.  A squat tree stump sits between two ruined couches, tiny withering leaves clumped around the gnarled, dead roots that sprawl out into the lake.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Geyser]
description: The temperature in this area is much cooler than the previous cavern, and dampness coats everything in the reach of a slick opening in the ground.  An opening in the ceiling appears to be a pathway out.  Adjacent a gaping hole in the wall, a massive rockslide blocks passage to the northeast.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Black River]
description: Water rushes all around you, swiriling and splashing black liquid to and fro.  The current is particularly strong on the side nearest the open space of the cavern, visibly creating eddies that look as if they might suck you under.  The middle of the river, however, allows you to stay afloat and fight, though not easily, being pulled further downstream.  Opposite the slick rock ledge leading into the cavern, a rockslide rife with boulders and rocks of all sizes leads up to a massive hole in the wall.

wayto.24240: ;e echo "Waiting for current to carry you to the new room...";line = get until line =~ /sturdy ladder/

title: [Feywrot Caverns, Glowing Pool]
description: Glowing with a pale, luminescent light, a large pool practically gleams in the dark area.  Rock walls hug the vicinity, the ceiling low and dripping with tiny drops of greenish water.  Streaks of a bronze-colored mineral zigzag from a naturally formed arch to a length of rope hanging from a series of spikes set into the walls.  An oddly twisted door handle is nailed into the floor.

title: [Feywrot Caverns, Gnarled Roots]
description: Lit with splinters of illumination that spear down from the edges of the ceiling, the cavern is narrow and shaped like a tall cylinder.  Roots of every shape and size curl about the walls, completely covering them in a mass of brambles, the only area clear of them a natural stone arch that leads into luminescent space.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Along a narrow stretch of water leading out into the swamp, dark water swirls around, lapping at the extended, gargantuan roots of an enormous ancient banyan tree.  A dim, incandescent light emanates from somewhere below the surface, lending a strange glow to the liquid.  Overhead, tiny shapes flit from one bald cypress branch to another, their forms largely obscured by the webbed veil of moss that hangs heavily from the spindly branches.

title: [Feywrot Caverns, Spiral Columns]
description: Torches set into the walls brightly light the wide space, which is littered with small pools of water spread between clusters of stalagmites.  Overhead, varied stalactites drip water, creating drip-drop sounds to the effect of a natural musical instrument.  Spiraling around a flat, open space, almost like a clearing in this underground forest, several limestone columns are covered in crude carvings.

title: [Hatouk's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by glossy mistwood walls, the shop features a miniature rock-lined waterfall in the center of its oak floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the fel panel ceiling.  Right near the front is a gilded maple cabinet and a vine-carved mahogany table.

title: [Hatouk's General Store]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its strewn pine floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the vaulted ceiling.  Right near the front is a gilded maple cabinet and a gilded maple table.

title: [Hatouk's Weaponry]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a dark-stained oak floor.  There is a gilded maple table on one side of the shop and a gilded maple cabinet on the other.

title: [Helden Hall, Armory Passage]
description: This small dark stone passage leads to another large bedraggled brown curtain.  The torchlight flickers from a draft, while the faint pungent odor of polishing oil still reaches you.

title: [Ruinic Ruins - General Goods]
description: This large and dirty room is covered in a layer of dust and filth everywhere, and the only thing that seems to be untouched is a polished faewood wardrobe.  Some rusty steel hooks hang on the wall in the far back of the room.  The wooden floor is a maze of warped and bent planks, making the exploration of the room a bit unsafe.

title: [Helden Hall, Lissanne's Room]
description: A small alcove holds a window seat piled with silken cushions, its mullioned windows overlooking the far-off bay.  On the far wall is a double-sided haon armoire.  In the corner sits a wide brass bed heaped with snowy down pillows, soft linens, and a lush white fox fur coverlet.  Two large pillows sit on the thickly woven white wool rug before a greystone fireplace.  Above the brass-edged oaken mantel hangs a framed scroll.

title: [Helden Hall, Roblar's Room]
description: The first thing you notice as you enter this room is the lack of a bed.  In its place is a gigantic pile of furs on which the occupant apparently taks his repose.  Weapon and armor racks flank both sides of the room, evidence that this is definitely the room of a warrior.  A huge oak keg of ale rests invitingly in one corner of the room.  Exquisite tapestries depicting fantastic battles and mountainous highland scenes adorn the walls.

title: [Swamp Sparkles, Side Room]
description: The gold and silver mesh that comprise the walls drape outward to create a small nook in the side of the pavilion just large enough for a highly varnished wood rack.  Brilliantly colored gems are caught in the mesh, glinting in the dim light that filters in from the main area of the shop.

title: [Mellindya's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An ora-bound large walnut trunk and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Great Escapes, Showroom]
description: Swaths of pale blue silk hang loosely from the wrought iron frame of this three-sided pavilion.  Open on one side, the moss-draped shadow of the fallen tree along the Banyan Cirque provides a natural feeling to this otherwise pristine establishment.  Plush carpets of a deep indigo color cover the floor, while a long low table set against the far wall displays the shop's wares.  Small paper lanterns provide a warm ambiance and ample light in which to peruse the merchandise.

title: [Mellindya's General Store]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A painted red cedar rack and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Elven Enchantment, By Night]
description: Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, a brilliant peacock painting hangs on one of the plain baby blue walls.  A series of wire-framed mannequins and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a grey-veined white marble fountain rests on the hardwood floor.

title: [Nalatia's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, a snarling war griffin painting hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and a large oak table sit in opposite corners while a small potted boxwood shrub rests on a wide-plank glossy tanik floor.

description: Beneath a stained mahogany ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case and a small brown box sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a patterned hardwood floor.

title: [Coral Workshop]
description: Howling winds create a feint whistling effect as they blast through gaps in the walls of the small workshop.  Crowded with a grinder, polisher, and a workbench with a vise, this room is perhaps a third of the building's interior.  Besides the exit, an iron bound door pierces the center of the hut's one interior wall.  For whatever reason, the bases of the workbench, grinder, and polisher have each been inlaid with fragments of coral.

title: [Coral Forge]
description: A large, black iron anvil stands in the center of this chamber.  Within easy reach to either side of the anvil are a brick forge and a tempering trough.  Directly above the trough, suspended by a web of delicate mithril chains, hangs a teardrop-cut crystal easily the size of a giantman.  One corner of the room is taken up by a cistern inlaid with fragments of coral, and a leather bucket hangs from a hook on the wall next to it.  Heat from the brick forge fills the chamber.  Some discarded oilskins rest haphazardly in the corner.

title: [Tymseram's Weaponry]
description: A gold and crimson wyvern tapestry hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls, and a high arched ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a dark mahogany floor.  There is a iron-bound ebonwood chest on one side of the shop and a gold-veined black marble counter on the other.

title: [Apple Of My Eye, Build-A-Treat]
description: Iridescent red streamers dappled with globs of silver glitter hang from the ceiling and sway lazily back and forth.  Fresh apple fragrance mixed with a myriad of other scents lingers in the air, intensifying as customers rush past with their gooey treats in hand.  A propped-up wheelbarrow filled with ripe apples flanks one side of the tent's flap, and tablecloths embroidered with miniature apple leaves are neatly draped over both an oblong counter and a sphere-footed sideboard.

title: [Tymseram's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, an old elven war banner hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  A iron-bound ebonwood chest and a gold-veined black marble counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a dark mahogany floor.
