title: [The Coventry, Hollow]
description: Tiny sparks of light drift through the air, swirling up from the lower level in a lazy, multi-hued spiral to bathe the area in soft illumination.  Off to the side, a small arched window set above a narrow ledge offers a glimpse outside, and beneath the ledge is a natural niche in the wood.  The ramp underfoot continues its gradual climb upward.

title: [The Coventry, Hollow]
description: Set at intervals along the tree's enclosing walls are small squares of wood-framed glass, each displaying some manner of dried and pressed herb or flower, and set between each is a stout beeswax candle on an oak sconce.  Though the candles are flameless, they glow all the same, lit from within by a brilliance whose source is not readily evident.  About midway up this curve of the ramp, a crescent niche is carved into the wall, padded within by an embroidered cloth.

title: [The Coventry, Tree Top]
description: The spiraling ramp tops out at a wide landing crafted of reclaimed wood, and an enclosure has been build among the wide-spread tree branches, incorporating natural features to support the structure.  Overhead, luminescent orbs of silver and pale gold dance among the leaves of the limbs supporting the arched and latticed ceiling, from which swathes of argent-threaded cerulean silks are loosely draped.  A half-moon marled oak table top has been affixed to a low-reaching limb to serve as a display.

title: [The Coventry, Tree Top]
description: Cerulean silk drapes in wide swathes from the latticework ceiling above, and tiny motes of light dart in and out of the leaves of the limbs incorporated into the oaken walls enclosing this space.  Irreglarly cut shelves of marled oak are perched atop branches here and there to serve as displays, while a pair of woven grapevine baskets dangle from natural fiber cording fixed to the supports above.

description: The verdant drape of leaf cover here is thick, shading this section of the tree in a cool dimness.  Minute glowing orbs flit among the branches, illuminating the shade with a light that is neither harsh nor overly bright.  Tucked amid the limbs is a lavender velvet hammock with a square blackthorn trunk beneath, and a hand-stitched quilt is draped across the the back of the chair that sits off to the side.  A circular rug of wool cushions the floor underfoot, and above, silver chimes of stars sing quietly with the slightest breeze.

title: [Small Clearing]
description: A carved-wood lodge stands here, hidden deep within this expansive forest.  The walkway leading to the lodge has been recently cleared of snow.  A cozy porch stretches around the lodge.

title: [Guild Lodge, Front Porch]
description: Drifts of snow rest against the perimeter of the lodge, and icicles hang from the roof.  The porch has been recently shoveled, keeping the wooden planks of the floor free of snow.  The shelter of the lodge blocks the cold wind, leaving the air still and crisp.

title: [Guild Lodge, Foyer]
description: The smell of pine fills this rustic lodge.  Heat billows in from the north, which is a sharp contrast to the cold air coming through the door from the outside.  Small puddles of melted snow are spread across the hardwood floor, despite the small mat that lies by the front door.

title: [Guild Lodge, Hearth]
description: A caribou-antler chandelier filled with shimmering candles hangs from the center of the ceiling.  The sounds of muffled voices and quiet footsteps of others in the lodge are all that can be heard.  A well-crafted long bow and deerskin quiver hang on the wall above the mantel.

title: [Guild Lodge, Dining Hall]
description: Tall elegant candelabras shed flickering light on cabinets which hold fine dishes and silverware.  Tapestries hanging on the wall display scenes of mountain wildlife.  A varnished pine banquet table extending nearly the whole length of the room holds flowering bouquets and unlit candles.

title: [Guild Lodge, Den]
description: Comfortable couches and chairs are arranged around a long table, making for a relaxing atmosphere.  Maps are tossed about on the end tables by the furniture.  A colorful myklian scale display hangs on the wall of this quiet room, among other skillfully cut skins.

title: [Guild Lodge, Hallway]
description: Paintings of majestic forest scenes hang on the walls of the hallway.  Plush rabbit-fur carpeting covers the hardwood floor underneath.  A well-kept potted fir tree sits in the corner, adding a pleasant scent to the air.  Overhead an iron candelabra hangs, shedding light on the walls.

title: [Guild Lodge, Office]
description: Bleached-oak paneled walls enclose this quaint office, dampening the sounds of the bustling guild hall outside.  Light shines through a window onto papers piled on the Guild Master's desk.  A stuffed grizzly bear and sabre-toothed tiger posed menacingly stand in the far corners, and various skins hang on the wall between them.

title: [Ranger Guild, Workshop]
description: Skinning knives, axes and other tools hang on the wall.  Scraps of skins and dye litter the floor and a long workbench.  Heat blows in from the inside of the lodge, keeping it nice and warm for anyone who needs to work out here.

title: [Guild Lodge, Library]
description: Bookshelves stacked neatly with books and maps line the walls.  A black bear-skin rug stretches across the floor under inviting armchairs and round tables.  A window overlooks the cold, wind-blown forest scenery, the tall mountains in the distance looming over the snow-covered evergreen trees.

title: [Ranger Guild, Yard]
description: Ice sculptures carved into the shapes of local wildlife decorate the yard, nestled between small evergreen shrubs that line the area.  Tall cedars and other evergreens beyond the shrubs block the wind from the wide-open clearing.

title: [Ranger Guild, Pine Treehouse]
description: The dense branches of the pine shelter the treehouse from the relentless frigid winds.   The very sturdy platform has been crafted out of oak, the railings around it serving as backrests for those who choose to sit.  Gaps in the branches offer an excellent view of the guild's yard below.

title: [Ranger Guild, Shed]
description: The thick snow covering the shed blocks any light that would pass through the spaces in the walls.  Light coming through the door provides the only illumination.  Empty crates, excess lumber and racks of tools crowd the already cramped room.

title: [Guild Grounds, Clearing]
description: A ragged carpet of fog covers the forest floor.  A sparse game trail makes its way out from the underbrush and shortly opens up into a wide, well traveled pathway running northwards.  Deeper in the woods an enormous oak looms above both the path and the trees around it.

Dark night air fills the gaps between the trees here.  The only illumination is the far-off pinpoints of light that mark the presence of fireflies deeper in the woods.  Suddenly the forest is flooded with bright light as a line of torches burst into flame.  Making its way out from the underbrush and running past the torches is a path leading deeper into the darkness.

title: [Guild Grounds, Great Oak]
description: A circle of stunted trees surrounds what must be one of the largest oaks in the world.  The tree easily towers above the rest of the woods, its branches nearly lost to sight.  Empty torch holders rest near the base of the trunk, and a thick carpet of moss covers the enormous roots that spread everywhere.  A path leading out of the forest splits around the base of the gigantic tree, the forks curving out of sight.

A gigantic oak rises out of the dark night, surrounded by a pool of flickering light.  Burning torches stand in holders set near the base of the trunk, throwing eerie shadows about as they flicker.  In the light provided by the torches a path can been seen encircling the tree, and a faint light can be seen from either side of the fork.

title: [Guild Grounds, Great Oak]
description: A small part of the forest around the oak has been cleared away.  The ground around the trunk of the tree has been hard packed by the passage of others, forming a path that leads off around the tree.  An empty set of ornate torch holders sits behind a small patch of grass at the base of the trunk.

The bright light of torches illuminates the trunk of the oak and a cleared area around it.  The ground about the base of the tree has been hard packed by the passage of others, forming a path that leads off around the trunk.  The torches filling this part of the forest with light are of a high quality and rest in ornate holders.  A small patch of grass carpets the area before the oak.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Hallway]
description: Mismatched sconces erratically line the walls, their flickering candles cast oddly formed shadows toward the warped wood ceiling.  Muffled carousing voices carry themselves though the stuffy air from the various off-shoots of rooms lining the hall, and the smell of ale permeates the small space.  A few broken peanut shells litter the floor near the far end of the hall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Cellar]
description: Fruit in various stages of decay rests upon lopsided shelves.  An old, tarnished brass candelabrum hosts a plethora of flickering, tall pillar candles, brightly bathing the room with light.  The uneven floor slopes downward from south to north.  Kegs and casks are stacked in triangular formations at each corner of the room.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Ale Room]
description: Brightly painted wooden posts and multicolored checkered tablecloths help to diminish the murky darkness created by the thick cloud of tobacco smoke hanging in the air.  Several tables are pushed in the corners beneath the eaves of the thatched grass roof, and grimy metal signs are nailed to each wall.  A trio of wax-covered empty bottles rest on the sill of the open window, each glass holding a half-melted candle.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Spittoon]
description: The hard-packed dirt floor around the table is marked with dozens of sets of overlapping footprints, and a slight haze of tobacco smoke lingers in the air.  Wooden posts suspend colorful glass lanterns and hold up a thatched grass roof, beneath which a family of birds nests.  An overflowing tarnished brass spittoon leans precariously against one wall, threatening to overturn.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Gator Haze]
description: A thin haze of tobacco smoke hangs in the air, dispersed slightly by the occasional cool night breeze coming through an open window.  The once bright paint on the wooden posts holding up the thatched grass roof is chipping and faded, carved over with hundreds of names and initials.  A similarly carved rickety cabinet stands in one corner of the room, its shelves overflowing with empty bottles of spirits.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Great Room]
description: A large semi-circular bench surrounds a large fire pit in the center of the room.  A polished flared conical hood hovers above the pit from the rafters.  Thick stone pillars topped with candles stand in each corner, and intermittent shelves line the walls, displaying an assortment of odds and ends.  A well-stocked bar is flanked with an assortment of barstools.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Sinkhole]
description: Gloops and globs of odorous mud occasionally fall to the ground with a sloppy wet-sounding *splat* from the surface of the misshapen walls; Wet muck steadily oozes its way through the partially decomposed wooden planks that offer little to their purpose of restraining it.  Squat, rotted wooden posts are sunken into the grungey floor, some taller than others, and each are affixed to the ceiling via rusted iron chains.  Scant light peeking in from the main cellar's room provides the only illumination.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Muddy Nook]
description: Someone has attempted to cover the muddy floor with a large ragged cut of rough burlap.  The ceiling's warped rafters sag and bow toward the floor, the worst of which is propped up by a single cracked wooden post.  A dirt-covered lantern hangs low from anther beam, providing a dull amber glow over the area.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Storage]
description: Some warped, wooden storage boxes are stacked in disheveled columns toward the ceiling and partially conceal the damp, musty walls behind them.  The dank smell of mold and mildew hangs heavily in the air.  Muck, more than the sprinkled sawdust, make up the spongey floor.  A few overturned crates rest in the center of the room, visible only by the benefit of the scant light peeking in from the main cellar room's chamber to the west.

title: [Ranger Guild, Landing]
description: Bright moonlight filters down through the foliage above, giving plenty of light to see by.  Most of the platform's space is taken up by a large pile of overstuffed pillows.  Sturdy brass railings line either side of the platform to prevent anyone from falling.  At one end of the platform is a simple haon arch and at the other is a sturdy looking pair of modwir doors.

title: [Ranger Guild, West Lounge]
description: A soft melody played on a flute floats through the room, the ranger playing it pausing only to smile at those just entering the lounge.  Large windows set in the west wall give a beautiful view of the forest stretched out below the guild.  A small bar rests in one corner, with small tables clustered before it for those wanting to sit.  Potted plants stand to either side of the double doors leading out.

title: [Ranger Guild, Nexus]
description: Large and ringed with bay windows, this room leads to several others.  The walls are covered in dark felwood paneling, and sturdy wool tapestries depicting forest scenes cover the walls.  An arch in the west side of the room leads outside, with a coyote hide curtain in place to keep out the elements.  Large beeswax candles brightly light the room from their holders in the walls.  One of the tree's branches has penetrated the room and has been carved into stairs leading to the next floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Nexus]
description: The spacious and airy chamber is carpeted in soft coyote hide, and oil lamps set between the doors on all four walls provide a gentle illumination.  Tapestries and large paintings cover the walls between the doors and windows.  Stairs carved from one of the tree's branches lead down, and a nearby ladder leads up.

title: [Ranger Guild, Lookout]
description: Bright sunlight fills the room.  A large dome of clear crystal encompasses the room, keeping the elements at bay while providing an excellent view of the surrounding forest.  The sea of green below is periodically broken by field or stream, and in the distance one can make out Solhaven Bay and the bustling port around it.

Silver moonlight flows into the room.  A large dome of clear crystal encompasses the room, keeping the chill night air at bay while providing a view of the inky night sky.  The forest below is lit by the moons above and the occasional spark of a firefly.  A small lamp rests near the ladder, and pillows are scattered about for relaxing stargazing.

title: [Guild Grounds, Great Oak]
description: Feathery ferns and moss-covered roots fill this part of the forest.  Other than a path and the empty torch holders set at the trunk's base, there is no sign that anyone else has ever set foot here.  The path stretches off into the woods, curving to follow the tree's base.

Bright torches push back the night from their holders at the base of the oak's trunk.  The flickering light illuminates nothing more than the impressive sight of the behemoth tree towering into the darkness and a hard-packed path leading around the tree.

title: [Guild Grounds, Great Oak]
description: The lingering smell of smoke fills the area.  A thick patch of ferns nestled between the tree's roots almost obscure the sight of some burnt-out torches resting among them.  A well travelled pathway, ferns and the occasional wildflower crowding close to its edge, follows the base of the oak's trunk.

A warm pool of light fills the area, kindly supplied by a pair of torches that appear to have been freshly placed.  The bright eyes of forest creatures can be seen reflecting the light of the torches off in the woods.  In the ample light it is not very difficult to spot a path that runs along the base of the oak.

title: [Ranger Guild, Skinning Room]
description: The overwhelming smell of tanned hides permeates the room.  Several skins are stretched out along the wall, apparently waiting their turn to be cured.  Several worktables are scattered about the room, tools used for scraping and cleaning skins resting upon them.

title: [Ranger Guild, Storage]
description: Between the dust, cobwebs and dim light, it is difficult to make out more than the outlines of things.  The silhouettes of a few mops and brooms stand in one corner, and storage crates and supply boxes line most of the walls.

title: [Ranger Guild, Dining Room]
description: A long buffet table set near the double doors is heaped high with food, plates, and silverware.  Smaller tables and wooden benches are arranged about the room, providing plenty of seating.  Wrought iron candelabras on the buffet, individual candles on each table, and sconces on the walls illuminate the room with a bright golden glow.

title: [Ranger Guild, Kitchens]
description: The room is filled with delicious smells of simmering stews and baking bread.  Cooks and servants bustle about busily, looking a bit annoyed at your intrusion into their domain.  Several large ovens are lined up against a wall, and a convenient branch has been pressed into service as a shelf for pots and pans.

title: [Ranger Guild, Nursery]
description: Wooden boxes and planters filled with a lush garden of herbs and flowers take up most of the space in the room.  Glass walls encompass the room, keeping the room warm year-round and holding the elements at bay while providing a view of the night sky above.

title: [Ranger Guild, Hallway]
description: A long hall stretches out here.  At the far end you can make out a pair of double doors with a sign next to them.  The floor is covered with soft fur carpeting, and large windows let in a light night breeze and the sounds of crickets chirping.

title: [Ranger Guild, East Lounge]
description: The smell of the forest and a light breeze flow through the room.  Short walls separate the space from the rest of the guild, surrounding the room as waist-high railings.  The wooden roof is supported by a few sturdy posts, and a bar stands to one side of the doors, inviting stools arranged in front of it.  Tables are arranged close to the rails, leaving the center open for dancing and providing a view of the forest below.

title: [Ranger Guild, Trophy Room]
description: An ornate fireplace on the far wall dominates the room.  Standing guard over it is the Ranger Guild crest with a set of vesperti wings on either side of it.  Trophies from many a hunt line the walls here.  Comfortable-looking leather upholstered armchairs are arranged about the fire, offering a pleasant place to sit while recounting tales of the hunt.

title: [Fen Furnishings]
description: This interior room of the wagon is bathed in dappled sunlight from the many gaps between the lashed-together sticks that make up the walls.  A wooden floor stretches from one end to the other, and bulky shapes draped in musty burlap take up much of the floor space.  Near the wagon entrance, a stooped green goblin stands idly by, and near his head hangs a small black metal sign.

This interior room of the wagon is bathed in dappled starlight from the many gaps between the lashed-together sticks that make up the walls.  A wooden floor stretches from one end to the other, and bulky shapes draped in musty burlap take up much of the floor space.  Near the wagon entrance, a stooped green goblin stands idly by, and near his head hangs a small black metal sign.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Wrotwoods]
description: Several wrotwood trees completely enshroud a temple, choking the structure like a serpent subduing its prey.  Thick, inky ooze mars the ground in all directions but south.  Skeletal remains are half buried in swallow graves, each with no gravemarkers of any sort.

The already treacherous walkway becomes moreso as rising steam collects on the outcropping in a low-lying mist.  At points, any hope of viewing solid footing is lost beneath the grey, leaving only a miasma of haze that slithers over the edge and into the air.  The effect is bewildering, breaths of wind stirring spectral fingers in the air as if at any moment they could reach out and snatch away the ground underfoot.

title: [Enshrouded Temple]
description: The old abandoned temple appears to have been deserted for quite some time.  Several wrotwood trees have grown into the structure, shattering windows and destorying walls.  Dust-laden pews are the only remnants that resemble a place of worship, no other holy trinkets are recognizable in the debris.  Through several broken floorboards is a passageway leading down, surrounding by swamp water.

title: [Necropolis, Apse]
description: Poorly lit lamps offer very little illumination at the entrance of the necropolis.  A recent cave-in has destroyed a stone bridge leading deeper within the undercroft, completely blocking off access.  A ruined black ora altar is tipped over by the passageway leading up to the temple.  The only hope of further progress is a stone ledge overlooking a chasm cloaked in darkness, which a splotchy goblin miner guards.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Ballista]
description: Tapered logs lay in disorganized piles against the tall starboard bulwark, some dangling precariously over the edge of the deck where the bulwark is interrupted to allow the heavy wooden ballista free movement.  Erratic geometric patterns are carved in the aft-facing railings, while the support beams are carved to resemble avian shapes.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thick foliage obscures the surroundings, allowing very little moonlight to creep through the tall, black willow trees.  Standing in the center of a pool of cloudy water is a hollowed tree stump that is covered in orange and brown shelf fungi.  Several patches of land offer a better trail through the deep muck that covers the ground, but avoiding the muck seems impossible.

title: [Krolvin Warship]
description: Faded green paint peels from the wooden housing protecting the rough, square-shaped hatch that leads below deck, by way of some wooden stairs.  Tepid water forms a small puddle in the hatch cover, which lies discarded against the hemp stays of the main mast.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Tumbled stones, blocky and chipped, lie in a scattered heap along the sloping edge of the swamp and provide a durable barrier that keeps the sludge-covered watercourse at bay.  Drooping willow trees, short and stunted, drape across the path and dangle their spear-shaped leaves upon the spongy ground.  A tangled vine, riddled with thorns, rest in a knotted cluster around a thick growth of bright purple swamp thistle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Hallway]
description: A short hallway leads to a pair of carved doors.  The walls are covered with several paintings of famous or notable Rangers.  A plush carpet of coyote fur absorbs the sound of footsteps and pleasantly offsets the forest green walls.  The way to the doors is clearly lit by bright candles that line the walls.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Two colossal trees lie across the path and are draped in a blanket of shaggy moss that is browned and lifeless.  Enormous holes pockmark the upper arboreal body and provide a view of the rotted and hollowed interior, while the lower monstrosity is half-buried in the sucking muck that spreads across the ground.  A thick cluster of tiny black gnats hovers in the air above the twin masses, while a spider near the roots waits in the shadows.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Dotted with large, flat rocks, the bleak foliage of the swamp opens up into a muddy expanse speckled with large standing pools of stagnant water.  Yellowish-green clumps of bladderwort fill nearly half of the aquatic bays, while the other half houses a thin scum of rainbow-hued slime.  A pervasive dankness lies heavy upon the air and is accompanied by a wretched stench that is a gagging blend of rotting corpses and invasive mold spores.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Jagged rocks line the western edge of the pathway that winds its way through the swamp, while the eastern track slips away into the scum-covered watercourse.  Towering trees block the sky, offering very little light to penetrate through the flora.  Skeins of half-rotted vines drape in uneven lengths from the decaying monstrosities and are coated with slime.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Knee-high, greenish-black carpets of moss cling to fallen trees and rocks, their fibrous tendrils spreading upward towards the dank sky.  Stagnant pools, covered with frothing yellowish scum, fill the air with the pungent aroma of rot and decay.  An oppressive dampness lays heavy upon the area, and with the lack of natural lighting, it causes the air to be thick and chilled.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Enormous banyan roots rise out of the sucking ground, their wide arches creating tunnels through the swamp.  Several of the arching monstrosities are draped with heavy layers of half-rotted kudzu, which are tangled into knots around bird carcasses, rodent tails, and vacant bird's nests.  A blanket of heavy shadows spreads across the area from the massive trees and block all but a thin skein of ambient moonlight from reaching the dark soil.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rising above the muddy pathway and then dipping back into the earth, a thick stream of black sludge winds its way in a serpentine path around large petrified spires.  Floating orange fungus swirls past upon the dark current and clings to the slippery banks and the roots of the various dead trees.  Wide, elephant-eared ferns create a bright green splash of color that interrupts the dismal nature of the swamp.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Nutrient starved trees arc toward the dismal sky, their leafless and spindled limbs spreading outward in all directions and clogging the pathway.  Wild cords of thorn-edge vines weave between the rotting woods to create a fence that blocks passage between the towering giants.  Several animal corpses litter the ground beneath the laden brambles, their skulls and ribs pierced through by thorns that are as long as a rapier.  A narrow sinkhole has gathered much of the muck in the area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Rivulets trickle across the sloping ground of the swamp in a crosshatch pattern that leads from the higher tree-line toward the sludge-filled watercourse.  Gelatinous globs of bright orange mold spores spread in the thick mud between the faintly running water, which is pockmarked with globs of clear slime.  Several clusters of hardy swamp grass rise up from the landscape, their dark roots preventing them from being carried downstream.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Near black in hue, the verdant foliage of the swamp creates a thick barrier that is difficult to move through, though not impossible.  Rotting vines dangle from above, their thickly corded lengths laden with rotting leaves and shaggy strands of moss, while below the ground is comprised of a sucking mud that has a thin layer of water running across it.  Several nearby trees bend toward the path and lend the space an enclosed, almost claustrophobic feel.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Sloping sharply downward, the landscape falls away from the moderately level ground toward the debris-clogged watercourse that is tinged an off greenish-brown.  Barren trees are bent to the east, their spindled limbs rising like the bent fingers of withered corpses reaching for the heavens.  Random gusts of wind travel through the area, carrying with them the rich scent of loam, the pungent aromas of rot, and the fetid stench of decay.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Vine Way]
description: Black cypress trees intermingle with small banyans, their bark covered in blackish grey lichen that gives the appearance of rot eating away at the trunks.  Moss drips down from above, much of it showering the vines that sprout yellow and green pumpkins, several of them spotted with splotches of white mold despite their unripe status.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Pumpkin Patch]
description: Nearly hidden beneath the hanging branches of a large, towering banyan tree, a series of wide wooden barrels are filled with a variety of floating pumpkins.  Splayed out around the barrels is a web of vines blooming with ripe, orange pumpkins, several gigantic in size.  The dirt surrounding the pumpkins is well-groomed, with small worms and bugs visibly crawling about in the tilled earth, and a healthy pumpkin patch stretches far out into the misty haze of the swamp.

title: [Ranger Guild, Map Room]
description: Brightly lit from above by a large iron chandelier, this room's walls are lined with shelf after shelf of rolled up scrolls.  Several tables are scattered about the room, each covered with parchment maps and notes.  One of the tables is backed against the wall and has several sets of map-making equipment on it.  The wood plank floor is covered with crumpled balls of paper and ruined maps.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Warped planks give this section of the deck an uneven cant that is echoed in the fitted wooden boards of the bulkheads.  Tacked to the forward bulkhead by seven iron spikes is an enormous spotted walrus skin.  In one corner of the compartment, a large knot in the wood has been burrowed out by claw and fang to create a small rodent nest.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Wounded For Wear, North Wing]
description: The carpet is dyed black with trace amounts of indigo coloring.  Swaths of black fabric line the walls, affixed to the ceiling by black iron rods.  A single blackened steel chandelier hangs just above a platform in the center of the area.  A single strip of black carpet shaped like an arrow points to the door leading back out.

title: [Wounded For Wear, West Wing]
description: Mounted animal heads on carved wooden plaques line the walls painted completely red with a series of black splotches on this side of the shop, contrasting with the rest of the color scheme.  Carved out of the crimson carpet is a circular section with a short, faded mannequin sitting at the center.  A single strip of black carpet shaped like an arrow leads back to the foyer.

title: [Wounded For Wear, East Wing]
description: The walls of this side of the shop are painted an ebon hue with random splotches of dark red paint.  Plush crimson-colored carpet fills the shop with a lone white mannequin sitting on top of it.  A single strip of black carpet shaped like an arrow leads back to the foyer.

title: [The Brazen Bull]
description: A long metal table is the only piece of furniture in this sparsely decorated room.  A sharp and rusty lever has been mounted to its side.  Situated low on one wall is a dented metal hatch, the floor surrounding it dusty with iron shavings.  A large brass-framed painting hangs just above the hatch.

title: [The Brazen Bull]
description: A tall iron maiden stands near the wall at the back of the cramped room.  It has been propped open, its gruesome interior visible.  On the opposite wall, thick, dripping beeswax candles hang on either side of a large brass-framed painting.

title: [The Skeptic]
description: Several windows line this wagon, their panes covered in what appears to be dried, cracked mud.  Dull silver sconces hang from the walls, the candles in their grips emitting faint light and a musk-like scent.  Centered between the doorways on the far sides of the wagon is a delicately carved hazelnut table.  A long hazelnut shelf is nestled against one wall next to a brass rack, above which hang a cluster of spiderwebs.

title: [Ranger Guild, Workshop]
description: Wood shavings and sawdust cover the floor of this room.  Neatly hung about the walls are hammers, wood planes and various other wood-working instruments.  Large worktables are spread about the room, some with works in progress on them, others standing empty.

title: [Ranger Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Large to the point of almost being cavernous, this room could hold many people at once.  At the far end of the room is a small stage with a podium resting at the center.  Facing the stage are row after row of carved chairs.  Large beeswax candles shed plenty of light upon the room from a chandelier up above.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Heavy vines of half-rotted bittersweet chokingly coil about the spindled branches of ebon hawthorn saplings that valiantly try to find nourishment in the nearby soil.  Gurgling and splutter, the watercourse tugs at the landscape dislodging earth, roots, and rotted debris.  A constant creak echoes through the area, as larger trees surrounding the saplings sway due to the wet ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Broken limbs lie in scattered heaps across the soggy ground, their ends clawed and chewed upon by some unseen animal.  A narrow tree-enshrouded path leads further into a thick wooded pass, away from the swamp.  Sprouting out of their rotting expanses are tubes of wild mushrooms with cup-shaped heads and blue-green blades of wildrye.  A thin trail of stones winds its way through the slogging mud and provides a solid means of egress from the area.

title: [Ranger Guild, Library]
description: Softly lit by beeswax candles, the room is comfortably crammed with books.  Several bookcases stand at the back of the room, all of them filled almost to the point of bursting.  Reading tables are arranged around the space, some covered with stacks of books and scrolls.  Several potted plants lend a bit of atmosphere to the room and also help to brighten it up a bit.

title: [Ranger Guild, Office]
description: The small office is cozy and filled with maps and furnishing, but immaculately tidy.  Directly across the room from the door stands a large monir desk with papers, scrolls and various implements and ornaments all arranged neatly on its top.  A large fireplace dominates the wall to the right, the fire burning within providing plenty of light.  The walls are covered with maps, some depicting strange and faraway places, others very familiar areas.

title: [Ranger Guild, Squirrel Room]
description: Dimly lit, this room has a dank, musty smell to it.  In the dim light provided by the sole lamp one can make out row after row of small cages.  Peering inside the cage closest to the door reveals that the occupants are bushy tailed squirrels.  Further back in the room is a small desk with little scraps of paper and a sign on it.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Shaded Path]
description: There is only a thin layer of leaves covering the mossy ground, as if the path had been cleared not too long ago.  Vines dangle helplessly from high branches, some nearly reaching the ground.  Oak leaves frequently spiral down from the trees, adding to the sheet of leaves on the forest floor.  Off to the west, there appears to be a break in the endless expanse of trees.

title: [Upper Trollfang, A Shaded Path]
description: Branches of massive oak trees on all sides form a canopy over the hidden path, drowning out most of the dim moonlight.  Odd geometrical markings have been carved in the bark of some of the trees, and the cry of a hawk from a perch somewhere above announces your presence.  Heavy brambles and underbrush conceal the west end of the path.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cavern]
description: Stalagmites and stalactites are sporadically spaced within this large cavern.  Light illuminates the passageway to the northwest, casting long shadows on the ground from the various rock formations.  Patches of luminescent moss create tiny glowing points on the ceiling.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ranger Guild]
description: A distinct path cuts across the small cavern, leading to a massive iron gate framed by banners.  Every stalagmite in the area has been carved into an animal form, creating a menagerie of Elanthian fauna.  Towering, luminescent toadstools line the outer wall of the guild in alternating hues of white and blue.

title: [Ranger Guild, Stone Courtyard]
description: Tracts of loamy earth radiate outward in concentric circles, bisected by a smooth granite walkway.  Giant glowing toadstools have been carefully tended to, and their thick stems create natural partitions between paths.  A polished marble slab lies at the heart of the courtyard, surrounded by tiny pink-spotted mushrooms.

title: [Ranger Guild, Reflecting Pool]
description: Multicolored flecks of sphene have been inlaid at the bottom of a circular reflecting pool.  Several animal companions lounge along the pool's low stone edge, and occasionally, one takes a refreshing drink of water.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: A miniature garden of glowing toadstools occupies a recessed niche running the length of the wall behind a faux-mahogany desk.  Hung across from each other are an invar-studded crossbow and a muted green tapestry.  Colorful metal charms clink melodically against each other, suspended from a whimsical mobile in the corner of the office.

title: [Ranger Guild, Moss Bower]
description: Delicate, glowing moss has been cultivated in a spectrum of colors, growing along the latticework of an enormous arbor.  Rows of pure white mushrooms mark the curved path to the east.

title: [Ranger Guild, Storage]
description: Shelves, racks, and crates line the walls up to the ceiling.  A wide path runs to the back of the room, providing easy access to any supplies needed by guild members.

title: [Ranger Guild, Tunnel]
description: Dwarven-made walls blend seamlessly into the natural rock of the tunnel to the north.  Garlands of hammered gold and silver leaves and vines festoon the narrow passageway.

title: [Ranger Guild, Cavern Lounge]
description: Half-circle tiers rise from the ground, culminating in a cozy lounge replete with food and drink.  Padded chairs and mats are available at each level, along with several small tables.  The crystal dome overhead offers a lovely view out of the outer cavern with its glimmering gemstone veins.

title: [Ranger Guild, Stalagmite Grove]
description: Within the airy cavern, a clearing resides in the middle of a prolific number of stalagmites that rise over twenty feet into the air.  Only a few paths are navigable through the rock formations, each marked by a giant toadstool.  Portions of the ground have been stained in different colors, delineating the various training areas available.

title: [Lilting Lute Table]
description: A wide, bowl-shaped table of brown granite with a narrow extension sits atop two white marble supports in the southeast corner of the tavern.  Oval and flat, the bowl-shaped end appears perfect for holding a roundtable meeting, although those sitting at the extension end might feel slightly left out.  Deep gouges cut into the surface of the table run from the tip of the extension end down to the center of the bowl end.  A goodly number of stone chairs surround the table, providing ample places to sit.

title: [Suffering Shawm Table]
description: A long table dominates the center of the tavern.  Shaped from tan marble and mounted on two short, white marble pedestals, the table appears as a rounded rod that suddenly flares widely at one end while tapering to a point at the other.  The top portion has been flattened to keep plates and mugs from sliding off, however the overall impression is one of a long wind instrument suitable for a person of immense stature.  Several chairs surround the table.

title: [Meandering Mandolin Table]
description: Black obsidian shaped into a huge, flattened teardrop with a long neck perches atop two grey marble supports in the northeast corner of the tavern.  Four long channels cut from the end of the neck to the center of the teardrop and filled with a white mortar help bring alive the mandolin aspect of the table.  Strangely, though, the entire shape twists and turns, as if the stone mandolin is attempting to slide away from its accompanying chairs and ooze off to the southwest.

title: [Flighty Flute Table]
description: A cylindrical table sits near the southern wall of the tavern.  Its sienna marble surface is polished to a fine sheen, and two rectangular supports hold it aloft.  One end of the table flares, while the other end tapers down to a notched slit.  The most prominent aspect of the table, though, are the two wings that protrude, one each, from either side of the center of the table.  Several stone chairs crowd around the table, perhaps in an attempt to keep it from taking flight.

title: [Crooning Crumhorn Table]
description: A light brown granite table shaped much as the letter J lying on its side rests near the eastern wall of the tavern.  Two rounded, grey marble supports hold the table aloft, allowing a number of chairs to snuggle in closely.  The straight portion of the J carved into various rings, with the carvings cleverly suggesting rope wrappings and sections of wood.  The curved tip of the J has been painted black, and two bumps arise from the top surface of the table near that end.

title: [Prickly Piccolo Table]
description: A peculiarly long, thin stone table rests near the northern wall of the tavern, with ample chairs scattered on either side of it.  The table has been hewn from one lengthy piece of white marble, then rounded and mounted on two thick slabs to give the impression of a gigantic white piccolo resting in a stone holder.  The table is thin enough to accommodate close, quiet, intimate conversation with a person seated across.  Then, again, it is also narrow enough to serve as an excellent location for arm wrestling.

title: [Ranger Guild, Clearing]
description: Shadowed by the massive bough of a gargantuan oak tree far to the north, the clearing is well-tended by its caretakers -- the grass is green and lush, and several colonies of flowers spring forth in the sunny spots of the rather shady respite.  A soft carpet of leaves mingles with the tall grasses, and the soft winds that whistle through the area occasionally send them into a spiraling dance before drifting back to the ground.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: Deep furrows in the silvery bark of the massive oak tree wind their way along its trunk, forming strange, intertwined patterns upon the surface of the ancient tree.  Large roots sprawl along the ground, their bark riddled with a faint sheen of moss.  The rest of the area is covered in pale green grass, the tiny blades waving in the breeze slowly.

title: [Massive Oak, Cozy Crooks]
description: The central trunk ascends high into the sky, and a variety of huge branches arc off in all different directions -- each curved and sporting a thick cushion of leaves for relaxing and surveying the surrounding landscape.  Light filters down in soft waves, the harsh glare of the sun broken into refreshing spots of warmth mingled with patches of cool shade.  The faint trill of birds can occasionally be heard as they hop from branch to branch and disappear high up in the bough.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: Long tendrils of hanging moss drape from the higher branches of the massive oak tree, deep silvery specks hiding within their soft recesses.  Blades of long grass rustle underfoot, their diminutive green forms complemented by random patches of wildflowers and colorful weeds of every type.  Several roots rise high into the air here, allowing one to sit and gaze upon the scenery.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: A tiny stream flows through the forest of roots from the massive oak tree, the glimmering waters forming a small pool amid a circle of grey rocks.  Small wildflowers grow in between the gaps of the rocks, and the deep blackness of the pool is broken only by the faint ripples of the stream from above.  The hanging moss is particularly thick here, providing an intimate, tranquil atmosphere.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: The overhanging moss and drooping tree branches of the massive oak tree thin out a bit, allowing one to gaze down over the surroundings from atop the large hill.  Forests spread for miles beyond a small meadow at the base of the hill, and the landscape is dotted with clusters of wildflowers of every hue imaginable.  A few weathered grey stones peek out from the earth, offering up a pleasant place to sit and admire the view.

title: [Ranger Guild, Meadow]
description: Beneath the shadow of the large hill to the northeast, the meadow spreads onward toward a large forest to the east.  A variety of wildflowers spring from the pale russet-hued long grass, the surroundings rippling every moment as each bends to the will of the soft breeze that rushes past.  A circle of trees stands in the middle of the field to the east.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: A tangle of massive roots winds its way along the ground here, providing a shady haven speckled with spots of refreshing sun.  The area is a veritable garden -- flowers of every hue and type grow from the moss-laden ground, their florid hues set upon a backdrop of drab grey-greens of the large tree.  The girth of the tree provides a natural fence for the plants, their forms curving around the vivid petals in a gentle embrace.

title: [Ranger Guild, Ring of Willows]
description: A circle of twelve willow trees encompasses the area, their thick boughs providing curtains of shimmering leaves and a wealth of shady spots to relax.  Standing at the exact center of the willows, nearly hidden among their drooping vines, is a small hut, its thatched construction imparting an air of coziness.  Soft grass covers the area, and leaves float idly by on gentle currents of wind.  A small firepit is set outside the hut, a ring of grey rocks keeping any flames at bay.

title: [Ranger Guild, Shop]
description: Small wooden shelves line the walls, and several rustic chairs are set around a small table.  Hooks accompany the shelves, holding a few collars and other adornments, and the single window in the small hut looks toward the distant forest line.  The faint scent of wildflowers trickles in from outside, and pleasant breezes wash in from the open doorway.

title: [Ranger Guild, The Circle]
description: The gnarled bark of the massive oak is quite visible here, its huge boles and knots covered with a faint green coating of soft moss.  A variety of hanging moss has also made its home upon the trees branches, the tendrils of darker green swaying gently in the breeze.  Leaves litter the ground, their mottled brown hue mingling with the lush verdant surroundings.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Dust motes, dancing in the slanted rays of light with each creak of the gently rolling ship, drift down from the exposed oaken beams supporting the decking overhead.  Hanging from a hook on the splintered portside bulkhead is a single brass lantern, its flickering light casting odd shadows across the crooked deck planks.  Standing next to the lantern, in obvious need of repair, is a misshapen harpoon rack.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Warped boards bow outward along the companionway, showing signs of water damage.  Dark pitch fills the spreading seams and gaps between the planks where they have begun to pull away, and cobwebs fill the gaps in one dusty corner where banded barrels are stacked.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Chunks of orange and brown rust cling to the frame of the large round porthole that fills most of the port bulkhead, and layers of grime coat the surface of the glass, making it nearly impossible for any light to filter into the companionway.  Lumpy, canvas sacks lean against the open arch of the crew quarters, their tops overflowing with foul-smelling, dirty clothes.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Ranger Guild, Wooded Glade]
description: The forest opens into a wide, moon-lit glade, the mossy ground crisscrossed by shifting patterns of green formed by the network of branches and vines above.  The glade opens a bit wider to the south, and turns into a thick copse of oaks to the west.  The heavy undergrowth at the southwest part of the glade barely hides the outlines of a rough wooden building of some sort.

title: [Ranger Guild, Oak Grove]
description: A cluster of ancient oaks forms a quiet glade, their heavy branches and foliage concealing anything above from view.  Several carved wooden benches are arranged on the mossy ground between the massive trees, set by the banks of a bubbling spring that emerges from a niche in the forest floor and flows between the roots.  A sturdy wooden pavilion opens to the south, half-covered by bushes and flowering vines, and a wide ladder leads up the gnarled trunk of the largest of the oaks.

title: [Ranger Guild, Treehouse]
description: The sturdy platform is constructed between the branches of the great oak, bounded by heavy moss-covered railings and covered by a network of carved beams that blend with the tree's branches above to protect from the elements.  A narrow rope bridge, almost invisible in the network of hanging vines that wind around it, leads west into the branches of another tree.

title: [Ranger Guild, Platform]
description: From this small platform, a large expanse of pristine forest can be seen on three sides.  The occasional deer prances across the leaf-covered forest floor, oblivious to the observers in the tree house.  The small glade to the east is mostly hidden by the great oak tree which is connected to this scenic rest spot by the narrow rope bridge.

title: [Gittyna's Weaponry]
description: A painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls, and a sturdy bamboo-rafter ceiling rises overhead.  Some puffed raw silk pillows sits in one corner of a colorful mosaic floor.  There is a glass-topped mistwood counter on one side of the shop and a splintered cargo crate on the other.

title: [Ranger Guild, Pavilion]
description: The pavilion is open to the elements on the north and east sides, its arched entryways half-covered by flowering bushes and vines that grow into the interior, spreading across the rough panelled walls and winding around the heavy ceiling beams.  Wooden tables and benches are arranged in semicircles in a central meeting area, and a bar and serving table can be glimpsed through a shaded niche in the south wall.

title: [Ranger Guild, Bar]
description: The trunks of two living oaks make up the south corners of the irregularly shaped niche.  Expertly cut slabs of wood make up the walls between the trees, and a fresh breeze from the forest wafts in through the paneless windows, the scents of moss and fresh leaves blending with the aromas of strong ale and roasted meat from the bar and serving table along one wall.

title: [Iluna's Armory]
[Iluna's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by glazed bamboo walls, the shop features a potted palm tree in the center of its bamboo floor.  A painted native mask hangs under the skylight-set ceiling.  Right near the front is a long mistwood counter and an aqua-hued seaglass display.

title: [Massive Oak, Among The Leaves]
description: The surroundings are a veritable haze of green, as the young, thin branches sprout forth their bounty of beautiful leaves.  The intricate criss-crossing of the branches forms an intertwined webwork that makes itself evident further to the north -- there, a small dome arcs over the surroundings, providing respite and shelter from the elements.  A few curled branches within the dome provide comfortable seating, while others offer generous amounts of space to stretch out and stargaze.

title: [Iluna's Magic Shoppe]
description: Glazed bamboo walls rise from a glazed bamboo floor.  Just above a tropical floral arrangement hangs a Four Winds Isle map, and a woven seagrass ceiling completes the picture.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a vine-carved mahogany table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Iluna's Outfitting]
description: A carved whale tooth hangs on one of the glazed bamboo walls, and a woven seagrass ceiling rises overhead.  A tropical floral arrangement sits in one corner of a glazed bamboo floor.  There is a long mistwood counter on one side of the shop and an oversized sea chest on the other.

title: [Rone Academy, Alumni Hall West]
description: The room bustles with the day-to-day affairs of the Academy.  Clerics chant in somber tones to the west, nearly drowning out soft murmurings from the libary to the north.  An excited babble comes from the south, where a line of eager young applicants awaits admittance to the Academy.

title: [Ranger Guild, Clearing]
description: A high wooden fence, half-hidden by vines and underbrush, curves around the south side of the glade.  The forest plants have been trimmed back, forming a wide clearing that seems to serve as a combination exercise yard and archery range, judging by the worn patches of ground and the well-used targets mounted on some of the oaks.  An arched entrance leads into an open wooden pavilion at the west side of the yard.

title: [Ranger Guild, Treehouse]
description: The massive trunk of the tree supports this half of the treehouse, forming a solid wooden wall on the western side.  Strange chitters of small animals and the sounds of rustling leaves fill the air, adding to nature's ambience.  A light breeze ruffles the branches of the mighty oak, causing pockets of eerie moonlight to dance across the floor of the glade below.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck Nexus]
description: A cluster of glowing glimaerstones is set into the paneled wooden ceiling, encased in a globe of rainbow glaes.  They suffuse the nexus of two hallways with multihued light that awakens many hues in the grey planking of the deck.  A painted crimson door breaches one wall, standing opposite a painting of a slumbering seaside town.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Ranger Guild, Office]
description: The trunk of the massive oak tree has been hollowed out to form this small office.  Dim light peeks through the knot holes in the trunk of the great oak, in addition to the light produced by candelabras on either side of the Guildmaster's desk.  Bear-skin tapestries and mounted animal heads adorn the dark wooden walls of solid oak.

title: [Ranger Guild, Pavilion Roof]
description: Muffled footsteps and quiet voices from inside the pavilion resonate through the roof, blending in with distant cries of birds.  The moss-covered roof lends an unobstructed view of the entire glade area, free from the brambles and undergrowth of the forest floor.  Random carvings on the trunk of the majestic oak have been whittled by previous woodsmen leaving their mark on the area.

title: [Gittyna's General Store]
[Gittyna's Outfitting]
description: A silken sea-themed tapestry hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls, and a sturdy bamboo-rafter ceiling rises overhead.  A wooden ship's wheel sits in one corner of a colorful mosaic floor.  There is a long mistwood counter on one side of the shop and a floral-etched ceramic case on the other.

title: [Gittyna's Magic Shoppe]
description: The broad sweep of the mosaic floor is interrupted by an ornate bottled ship.  Halfway to the bamboo-rafter ceiling, a silken sea-themed tapestry hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls.  A cedar and oak footlocker and an oversized sea chest are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [A Narrow Path]
description: The surrounding trees thin somewhat and allow a glimpse of a clearing to the north.  The ground slopes down on either side of the path into an impassable tangle of brush.

title: [Ranger Guild, Clearing]
description: The dense trees give way to a large clearing, its grasses rippling like water in the breeze.  Constellations of wildflowers are bright within the verdant sea, but banners of viridian and gold flying from the central pole of a large pavilion to your north are more vivid still.

title: [Ranger Guild, Pavilion]
description: Open on all sides to the mild breeze, this tent is large enough to shelter many.  Zephyrs tease the tassels of numerous cushions scattered on the intricately woven rugs which cover smoothly packed earth.  A lectern carved from a tree stump stands at one end of the pavilion, its surface polished to a mellow sheen and engraved with twining vines.  A path leads west to a garden.

title: [Ranger Guild, Garden Path]
description: Herbs grow in riotous profusion along the path and the only evidence of design is the orderly grouping of the plants by use.  The cool, clean scents of mint and lavender perfume the air, while dittany and borage grow in the shade of a nearby oak tree.  The murmur of running water comes from somewhere to the west.

title: [Ranger Guild, Spring]
description: The natural spring has been roughly outfitted as a bath.  Flat stones upon which brilliant green lizards sun themselves ring the pool, the jewel-bright creatures eyeing you expectantly as if waiting for you to follow their example.  Sweetflags and rushes line the banks of the shallow runoff stream, following it west into impenetrable foliage.  The water is clear and the sandy bottom of the pool is a dazzling white in the sunlight.

title: [Ranger Guild, Glade]
description: This secluded spot is concealed both from the clearing to the north and the spring to the south by walls of close-growing bushes.  Ferns thrive in the humid shade of overarching oak trees, their tightly curled fiddleheads as smooth as carved jade against the rough dark tree trunks.  Snatches of conversation and laughter drift in on the breeze, but they seem somehow more distant than they could logically be.

title: [Ranger Guild, Lodge]
description: The path winds up to the lodge, which is built wide and low beneath a copper roof.  Unstained oak walls have been planed to display the natural grain of the wood, and darker modwir frames the entrance.  A single apple tree by the stone steps provides welcome shade.

title: [Ranger Guild, Front Porch]
description: Plain cotton cushions cover the sanded maoral planks in lieu of chairs.  Wind chimes of wood and beaten brass turn in the breeze and add their gentle harmony to the atonal, yet tranquil music of nature.  To your south, the pavilion rises above the treetops, its banners brilliant against the cloudless sky.

title: [Ranger Guild, Mews]
description: A discordant harmony of rustling and cawing issues from the low log building that dominates the clearing.  To the southwest, a larger edifice can be glimpsed through the trees, while banners flutter gaily to the south.

title: [Ranger Guild, Mews]
description: Rows of widely spaced perches and the faint scent of rotting meat would give name to this low structure's purpose, even if there were not nearly a dozen merlins, kestrels, and larger hawks resting upon the high poles.  A far wall is studded with pegs, each one hung with the finely crafted bits of leather that serve as jess and hood to a hunting bird.  Bars of sunlight slanting through the high narrow windows appear almost solid with dust from the hay-strewn floor.

title: [Ranger Guild, Path]
description: The passage of many feet has worn a shallow trough down the center of the path.  A gabled roof of verdigris-rimed metal rises above the treetops to the east, while to the west the trail widens into a roughly rectangular clearing.

title: [Ranger Guild, Clearing]
description: Bales of straw in ranks on the northern edge of the clearing prop up colorful archery targets.  Most targets are traditional concentric circles, but some have been embellished with whimsical caricatures.  None of the comically rendered faces are recognizable, thanks to the archers' accuracy.  An expanse of pale river sand spanning the length of the clearing makes arrows easier to find and keeps grass from overtaking the range.

title: [Ranger Guild, Foyer]
description: Modwir posts and beams are a darker accent to the white oak walls of this open room.  An undyed wool rug covers the sanded floorboards and benches of pine, teak, and modwir, elegant in their simplicity, rest near the door.  The clink of glasses issues from beyond the swinging doors to the west.

title: [Ranger Guild, Bar]
description: The high modwir-beamed ceiling gives the bar an expansive feel and ivy growing through cutouts in the window frames climbs along trellises affixed to the walls.  Woven rattan chairs are grouped informally around circular tables.  Potted mint plants atop each table are unusual, but highly practical substitutes for the more common cut flowers.

title: [Ranger Guild, Masters' Office]
description: A modwir desk is the only indication that this room is used as an office.  Large windows provide a view of the pavilion against a backdrop of verdant forest, and a windowbox holds herbs that scent the air as the breeze stirs them.  A thick bow-shaped perch, jesses and a hood hanging from it, stands in one corner of the room.

title: [Ancient Burrow, Ingress]
description: Crystallized trails of water line the sheer face of a stone hill enclosed by the town walls, glinting brightly above the heads of a pair of dark stone statues.  The cobbles of the road grow fewer as it approaches the yawning mouth of a burrow in the hillside, giving way to the crags of a stone floor several paces within.  Natural light manages little better before it is supplemented by the merry crackle of torches fed by pine pitch, the smell of which lingers on the wintry air.

Crystallized trails of water line the natural stone walls of the ingress.  Placed on either side of the barrier are a series of carved runes paired with rhimar sigils.  A shallow trough runs the length of the walls, cracked and barren of fluids.  Carved black marble stones create a curving path heading north, alternating with white marble inlays.

title: [Black Rose Sanitarium, Thicket]
description: The twin towering arched wrought iron gates give way to a uniform crushed shell path bordered on either side by overgrown black rose hedges and beds of red-gold sirenflowers, mingled throughout by ever-creeping vines of wisteria.  The path is circular along the iron fence, splitting sharply in towards the thicket in precise locations, marked by five tall alabaster pillars.  Converging at the center, the hedgerow paths form a pentagram encircling a clearing in which stands a black marble sanitarium, its seamless walls glowing in the moonlight.

The twin towering arched wrought iron gates give way to a uniform crushed shell path bordered on either side by overgrown black rose hedges and beds of red-gold sirenflowers, mingled throughout by ever-creeping vines of wisteria.  The path is circular along the iron fence, splitting sharply in towards the thicket in precise locations, marked by five tall alabaster pillars.  Converging at the center, the hedgerow paths form a pentagram encircling a clearing in which stands a black marble sanitarium, its seamless walls reflected in the sunlight.
location: Black Rose Sanitarium, outside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Black Rose Sanitarium, Intake]
description: Moonlight floods through the curved windows of the circular room, bathing the grand foyer's mosaic floor in ethereal light.  Various libations are offered atop an enormous alabaster desk, an unmovable relic of the former reception area.  Beside the desk sits a tall potted plant, its leaves twitching almost imperceptibly.  A series of painted murals cover the walls, reaching upwards to the domed ceiling.  Opposite the entry doors, the painted walls curve away to the north, forming a narrow circular hallway.

Sunlight floods through the curved windows of the circular room, bathing the grand foyer's mosaic floor in bright light.  Various libations are offered atop an enormous alabaster desk, an unmovable relic of the former reception area.  Beside the desk sits a tall potted plant, its leaves twitching almost imperceptibly.  A series of painted murals cover the walls, reaching upwards to the domed ceiling.  Opposite the entry doors, the painted walls curve away to the north, forming a narrow circular hallway.
location: Black Rose Sanitarium, outside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Ancient Burrow, Plaza]
[Ancient Burrow, Nexus]
description: Veins of natural minerals glitter in the torchlight illuminating the stone walls of the burrow.  Despite the torches' scant heat, immense icicles jut from the high ceiling, ornately carved into fanciful sculptures of sea beasts, including whales and sleek sharks.  A raised plaza sprawls at the lowest portion of the burrow's floor, the dark flagstones spiraling outward from a black marble statue.  A stained pine bench faces the monument, an old oaken tun at its side.

Cobblestones spiral outwards from a dark faceless statue in the center of the nexus.  Veins of assorted natural minerals glitter beneath the cavernous burrow's artificial glow.  Carved twice the height as the rest of the burrow, the ceiling is decorated with several suspended ice sculptures.  A carved ice bench sits facing the statue, with a rhimar-bound barrel next to it.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out
Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Ancient Burrow, Thaumaturgy Row]
description: Nestled between a round black and blue door and a glaes-paned steel hatch, a natural recess in the stone has been transformed into an open air patio crowded with tables beneath hanging lanterns.  To one side of the passage, a small wooden cart is laden with fish freshly caught from the Frostmain.  As the ground begins to slant upwards, the cobblestones of the subterranean road grow smaller but no less numerous.

Nestled between an ebonwood door and a glaes-paned steel door, a natural recess in the stone has been transformed into an open air patio crowded with tables beneath hanging lanterns.  To one side of the passage, a small cart with a broken wheel has been abandoned.  As the ground begins to slant upwards, the cobblestones become increasingly uneven.

title: [Ancient Burrow, Observatory]
description: The carved natural stone of the chamber is curved outward, creating a dish-like room.  Arching high overhead, thick glass plates are framed by rhimar supports, offering a view of the sky above.  The floor itself is entirely covered with large fur rugs layered together.

title: [Pebblegems Cafe]
description: Chiseled from the natural stone wall, a bar, its surface textured with smooth, multicolored pebbles, is lined with a row of small stools.  A sweet aroma hovers around the jars and canisters that fill an iron rack behind a low counter laden with trays of empty mugs.  An open archway to the west provides a glimpse of the cobblestone patio beyond.

title: [Two Tarts Trading Company]
description: Shelves filled with neatly labeled boxes cover the natural stone wall opposite a polished oak counter piled high with wrapped packages, a pair of oil lamps at either end.  Brightly colored ribbons are tacked to a rectangular piece of cork hung next to a glass display case crowded with delicate tea cups and tiny crystal figurines.  Underfoot, a rug of woven yarn patterned with posies covers the freshly swept dirt floor.

title: [The Patio]
description: Colorful, glass-paned lanterns strung overhead illuminate the natural stone walls and painted cobblestones.  Wooden tables surrounded by mismatched chairs take up most of the space, except for a large stove and supply bin in one corner with a pair of high-backed rocking chairs arranged in front.  Water trickles down the far wall, pooling into a shallow, carved basin.

title: [Ancient Burrow, Courtyard]
description: The burrow's northern wall is of dark stone, and out of its face has been carved the facade of an imposing keep.  Occasional pitting and rivulets worn out of the facade by the patient efforts of dripping water suggest that the stonework is ancient.  The cobbles of the walk to the entrance are alternating black and white, forming peculiar patterns.  Sculptures of walruses and seals flank the path.

The natural stone chamber slants upwards, opening up the area to a carved black marble keep.  Surrounding the keep are several carved rhimar sculptures, each representing a grotesque winged demon ready to take flight.  Alternating white and black marble tiles spiral outwards creating strange, rune-like patterns.

title: [Ancient Burrow, Wiley Way]
description: The natural stone ceiling overhead slopes downward as the underground road dwindles into a narrow corridor.  Nestled into the wall is an iron-bound spruce hatch framed by slim veins of black and white minerals that branch through the otherwise unremarkable stone of the wall.  Near a pair of cross-braced iron doors, a cylindrical skylight is carved vertically into the ceiling, offering limited lighting, but most of that duty is given over to pine pitch torches spaced along the way.  Hanging from one wall is a black tapestry embroidered with white snowflakes.

The natural stone ceiling overhead slopes down into a narrow corridor.  Nestled into the wall is an iron-bound door surrounded by slender veins of black and white minerals running up the surface of the stone.  A cylindrical skylight is carved vertically into the stone, offering limited amounts of lighting.  Stretching from wall to wall is a plush black rug peppered with embroidered snowflakes.

title: [Warehouse, Entry]
description: The layered slate walls of the cavern have been covered in thick bear hide, providing warmth as well as a way to muffle the sounds of workers loading stacks of leather and fabric into straw-filled crates.  Flanking a pair of cross-braced iron doors are racks of fur and dyes, the latter creating colorful designs upon the oak floorboards as they drip slowly across the grain.

title: [Warehouse, Nexus]
description: Flashes of color and the whiffs of tanned leather rush through the area as various workers and tradesmen jostle through the crowd to their destinations.   Set above the bustling area is a large wooden platform, framed by a number of crates, barrels, and piles of exotic fur.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Warehouse, Platform]
description: Rising above the bustling crowd is an oak-planked platform, the island set apart from the warehouse floor by a series of fur-covered steps.  From this height, a veritable sea of fabrics, containers, and shoes can be seen flowing in and out of the area.

title: [Warehouse, Office]
description: Propped against the far corner of the office is a rickety chair, the velvet-padded seat covered with various fabric swatches and topped with a toy penguin chick leaning upon the right arm.  Piles of fluffy straw are strewn across the room, while various cushions provide temporary seating amongst the chaos along the floor.

title: [Warehouse, West Wing]
description: Wide crystalline sconces illuminate the darkened areas of the hallway, each one cut into a large, iridescent snowflake.  The scattered shards of light highlight the thick, silvery furs covering the ground, muffling the sounds of footsteps.

title: [Warehouse, West Wing]
description: Crystal and ivory icicles decorate the ceiling above the hallway, the spiraled spears gently clinking together with the vibrations of the cave walls.  Additional sounds of metal tools, footsteps, and the throwing of objects echoes throughout the workshops.

title: [Warehouse, West Wing]
description: The cavern hallway ends with a silver-inset glass mosaic, the design a series of snowflakes, flurries, and various winter creatures set against a forest backdrop.  The metal sconces set along the walls are wrought into the shape of tapering tree branches, emphasizing the woodland theme.

title: [Warehouse, Storage Room]
description: The din of the open warehouse is muffled by several mammoth hides draped against the walls, the giant layers set behind a long wooden counter, preventing access to the public.  A riveted wooden platform sits towards one end of the counter, loaded with twine-tied bundles of fabric, neatly stacked and labeled.

title: [Warehouse, East Wing]
description: Thin lengths of rope are hung in a haphazard fashion across the ceiling of the the hallway, strung with small jars filled with lit votives in various stages of melting.  Droplets of wax from overfilled jars cover the worn flagstones, dotting the ground like freshly fallen snow.

title: [Warehouse, East Wing]
description: The walls of the corridor have been painted with a wintery mountain scene, the area covered with various creatures sharing space upon the white-inked fields.  Mammoths and snow leopards sit huddled on opposite ends of the walls, leaving yetis, rams, and caribou to populate the middle and bottom of the paintings.

title: [Warehouse, East Wing]
description: The end of the hallway is highlighted by a light-colored stone mosaic of a snowman, the creature inset with thin oak branches for arms and orange enamel for a nose.  The snowman sits upon a hill of ivory snow with a yellow-colored sun situated high above the scene.  A thin tile-inset rivulet indicates that the rounded statue would not survive for long.

title: [Soles of Discretion]
description: Carved from natural stone, the shop is dimly lit by a row of white ora candelabra.  A polished pine shelf is fastened to the wall above a round blue table with iron brackets.  An aged halfling woman stands behind a long wooden counter in the center of the shop.

title: [Soles of Discretion]
description: Bits of leather and other assorted materials are scattered across the floor.  Tools are stacked on top of boxes of goods against the walls of the shop.  Hanging from the ceiling is a single torch, offering some light to the wares on display in a row of shelves.  Positioned against the side of one of the shelves is a rhimar-bound chest, which appears to be locked tight.

title: [Soles of Discretion]
description: The walls of this end of the shop are completely covered with assorted dyes.  Several rows of vials for purchase are on display in a series of open cases.  A mop and a broom lean precariously against a low wooden crate, a small bucket of dye sitting behind it.

title: [Ancient Keep, Foyer]
description: Circular in shape, the floor is completely made from square-cut sections of black marble.  Large, blackened marble pillars line the walls, ending with a domed glass ceiling high overhead.  A narrow gap on the far side of the room leads to a sweeping stairwell with a mithglin-plated door beneath it.

title: [Ancient Keep, Ballroom]
description: A carved black marble stage extends out from a portion of the dark wood lining the walls.
