The floor is carved from the same black marble, but accented with white veins, creating a hard dancing surface.  Placed on the large stage is a collection of various instruments sitting next to their respective band member.

title: [Ancient Keep, Lounge]
description: Lengths of icy blue velvet are hung from iron bars fastened to the ceiling.  A low standing table rests atop a plush black carpet that fills the lounge.  Nestled into the corner is an angled armoire, its drawers pulled out and filled with refreshments.  Dim candelabras line the walls, each connected to the next by a thin gold chain.  Positioned on either side of the table are a large leather sofa and a large pillow-topped couch.

title: [Ancient Keep, Cellar]
description: The chamber's lighting falls short halfway across the cellar, as the shadows twist from the cast light of a lantern.  Rows of several strange apparatuses are barely visible in the shadows along the walls, each with a strange fluid leaking from them.  Moisture runs down the stone walls in several locations, using the natural contours of the stone as a ramp to the floor.  Looming just within reach overhead is a heavy trapdoor leading back to the chambers above.

title: [Ancient Keep, Office]
description: Long, twisting veins of mithril and rhimar entwine around each other across the circular room's ceiling.  Several rectangular cubbyholes line the walls, each containing an intricately carved ice sculpture within.  Presiding over the center of the office is a large mahogany chair cushioned with rich leather, with an elegant mahogany desk behind it.  Framed with etched rhimar, an oak-bound door leads back out.

title: [Ancient Keep, Council Room]
description: A massive circular table fills the room with some large padded chairs next to it.  Hanging from the domed ceiling above is a golden chandelier, illuminating the room.  The walls of the room are painted with a mural depicting Icemule at night, with hundreds of small candles near each burrow.  Sequestered beneath a carved marble arch is a steep stairwell, leading back to the foyer.

title: [Jocular Jack Table]
description: Assorted types of jacks decorate this booth.  The main wall displays an amberjack easily larger than the average halfling.  Along the dividers from the other booths are some other smaller jacks.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Crew Quarters]
description: Rusted iron hooks are set into the deckbeams overhead to support stained canvas hammocks.  Open hammocks trailing tattered blankets fill the portside bulkhead, effectively blocking the three brass portholes that are bolted closed.  Rat-infested heaps of filthy cloth occupy two of the room's corners and contribute to the foul odor filling the large space.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Mess Hall]
description: Grime-covered portholes allow a modicum of light to sift in, revealing a fine haze of dust that drifts down through cracks in the warped deck overhead.  Wrought iron chains, each ending in black metal lanterns, dangle from exposed oaken beams over a long table that is bolted to the deck.  Flanking the table are two rough benches heavily scarred with claw marks.  Scattered upon every surface are half-eaten, moldy chunks of bread, fish, and eel.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Curving slightly upward, the starboard section of the bulkhead appears to be unfinished.  Exposed wooden framing supports the fitted planks that form the skin of the ship.  The long companionway stretches aft, interrupted only once by a salt-encrusted porthole.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [The Fretting Frond]
description: The platform is uneven here, with segments of it covered in patches of greyish-white moss sluggishly eating away at the surface of the wood.  Countless leafy branches run like viridian veins above, beside, and beneath you, their sturdy forms serving as eager hosts to tendrils of curling vines.  Some large pegs holding colorful items protrude at odd angles from a low-hanging bough.  A faint scent of decaying organic matter reaches your nose.

The platform is uneven here, with segments of it covered in patches of greyish-white moss sluggishly eating away at the surface of the wood.  Countless leafy branches run like viridian veins above, beside, and beneath you, their sturdy foms serving as eager hosts to tendrils of curling vines.  Some large pegs holding colorful items protrude at odd angles from a low-hanging bough.  A faint scent of decaying organic matter reaches your nose.

title: [Snowberry Room]
description: A series of tapestries cover the walls, their slightly faded colors reflecting off of the polished grey marble below.  A braided rug protects the floor beneath a pair of long leather couches.

title: [Snowberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain, which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Snowberry Room, Locker Room]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Kaldonis's Smuggling Emporium]
description: The broad sweep of the carpeted floor is interrupted by a tiered alabaster fountain.  Halfway to the steeply angled ceiling, an ornate silver samite tapestry hangs on one of the hung silk walls.  A slender silvery glaes display and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Kaldonis's Outfitting]
[Kaldonis's General Store]
[Kaldonis's Magic Shoppe]
[Kaldonis's Smuggled Rubbish]
description: Hung silk walls rise from a thickly carpeted floor.  Just above a potted palm tree hangs a silken sea-themed tapestry, and a silk-covered ceiling completes the picture.  An aqua-hued seaglass display and a warped treasure chest stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Kaldonis's Magic Shoppe]
[Kaldonis's General Store]
[Kaldonis's Outfitting]
[Kaldonis's Smuggled Treasure]
description: Hung silk walls rise from a thickly carpeted floor.  Just above a bird of paradise-filled vase hangs a tropical bloom wreath, and a silk-covered ceiling completes the picture.  An elegant silver jewelry rack and an oversized sea chest stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Rone Academy, Walkway]
description: This stone walkway links the two different buildings of Rone Academy, a heavily reinforced oak rail protecting each side.  Carved into the stone walkway are different images of wild beasts, some long extinct from the realm of man and some still present.  The walkway proves as an excellent view of the Landing, and a scattering of students pause briefly to admire it, then move on.

title: [Rone Academy, Elanthian Library]
description: Ornately carved pillars punctuate each corner of this spacious library.  Students wander amongst the bookshelf-lined walls, their footsteps muffled by worn tapestry rugs covering the wood floor.  Moonlight filters in through a domed skylight in the ceiling, illuminating large antique tables.  Wrought iron railing borders a wide descending staircase in the center of the room.  On the north wall, an open doorway is flanked by an antique fel bookcase and a marble pedestal displaying a dark leather volume.

On the north wall, an open doorway is flanked by an antique fel bookcase and a marble pedestal displaying a dark leather volume.

title: [Rone Academy, Reading Room]
description: Adjacent to an open doorway, several gilt-framed paintings hang above a sideboard with an ornate silver tray on it.  Tall bookshelves line the walls with rolling ladders attached to accommodate access to the vast collection of aged volumes.  Centered around a finely carved thanot fireplace on the east wall, a comfortable leather sofa and some leather wingback chairs provide an inviting spot to read or converse.

title: [Rone Academy, Professions Hall]
description: This circular room underground has arches that lead off to several different professional areas.  Much of an apprentice's study occurs in the profession rooms with the Elders.  There is a colored arch for each profession, marked clearly so that you won't lose your way.

title: [Rone Academy, Wizard's Retreat]
description: A dim light is kept throughout this wide chamber, supplied by glowing orbs that sit atop white marble columns in each corner of the room.  Scrolls and pieces of parchment are strewn about on various maoral work benches.  Cabinets stuffed with magical potions and arcane objects line the walls.  Low murmurs can be heard from a group of students surrounding a small work table.

title: [Rone Academy, Rogues Hideaway]
description: There is nothing here except a blank stone wall and an iron strongbox on the floor.

title: [Academy, Bards' Conservatory]
description: This carefully designed chamber's acoustics make it perfect for singing, the high ceiling magnifying sound without disortion.  Straight-backed chairs next to sturdy, slanted music stands provide a place for the musicians to practice and perform.  A scattering of students work at composing stories, reciting poems or simply daydreaming -- all vital components of the bardic arts.

title: [Rone Academy, Hall of Warriors]
description: The scent of sweat and the occasional clash of metal upon metal is underscored by periodic thumps from the training mats.  The brightly lit room has been divided in half, the mats covering the stone floor on one side.  In the center of the padded area a target mannequin, the stuffing long ago beaten out of it, hangs limply off its post.

title: [Rone Academy, Sorcerers Chamber]
description: A sense of mingled dread and curiosity causes the students within to lower their voices to a respectful hush while perusing the tall bookcases that line much of the walls.  The rest of the space is taken up by anatomy charts and portraits of notable sorcerers, although the stone floor remains bare of everything except the remains of a few chalked symbols.  Standing near a long marble table is an apothecary's desk filled with dried or pickled bits of once-living things.

title: [Rone Academy, Ranger's Map Room]
description: The hallway leading into this open room is covered with hanging maps of the environs of Elanthia.  Notes are pinned to them in various places indicating where changes need to be made in the new maps.  Throughout the ceiling, clear tubes of glass carry the sun's rays from further above down through the soil to this room.  On a large circular table in the center of the room, parchments, pens and ink await the next student.

title: [Merchants Table]
description: The round wooden table has been inset with tiles, each one inscribed with the name of a famed merchant.  The chairs scattered about are a bit more ornate than those outside.

title: [Rone Academy, Cathedral Entry]
description: A wide corridor leads between the busy alumni hall to the east and the arch that serves as the entrance to the main cathedral to the west.  Murals depicting the icons of the Liabo and Lornon pantheons adorn the walls.

title: [Rone Academy, Cathedral]
description: Moonlight floats down through tall, stained-glass windows from the gabled ceiling of the Cathedral.  Elevated by a two-step platform, the altar is located in the middle of the rectangular cathedral and circled by wooden chairs padded with soft material for comfort.  The cream colored marble floor shines as if newly polished.  To the right of the altar is the ambo, where sacred scrolls are placed.

Sunlight streams through tall, stained-glass windows from the gabled ceiling of the cathedral.  Elevated by a two-step platform, the altar is located in the middle of the rectangular cathedral and circled by wooden chairs padded with soft material for comfort.  The cream colored marble floor shines as if newly polished.  To the right of the altar is the ambo, where sacred scrolls are placed.

title: [Academy, Regent's Office]
description: An overwhelming pile of clutter that threatens to bury a rather small enruned fel desk dominates the room.  An overhead candelabra composed of small glowing crystals emits a cheery light, illuminating the desk.  A small brass plaque is fastened on the far wall next to a dusty obsidian sconce, while a series of names are inscribed directly upon another.

title: [Rone Academy, Magical Workshop]
description: The acrid scent of one too many spilled potions permeates the workshop, competing with the faint wax smell from what seems to be hundreds of burning candles.  Their light eases the stark midnight black of the enchanting circle carved into the flagstone floor.  A mithril-bound workbench is bolted to the north wall, its surface covered with empty vials and beakers, scorch marks and a copy of an elementary text on enchanting.

title: [Rone Academy, Empath's Sanctum]
description: A pair of empaths prepare the examining table and work at replenishing a herb cabinet, pausing periodically to greet newcomers with a warm smile and a welcome.

title: [Rone Academy, Cleric's Vestry]
description: Marble flagstones separate walls lined with cabinets filled with vestments and shelves lined with prayer books, while a sky-lit cathedral ceiling provides excellent acoustics for the practice of liturgy and chant.  In the exact center of the room is a podium supporting a large volume.  Along one wall is a set of material-laden shelves and a fel prie-dieu.

title: [Rone Academy, Reception Room]
description: Tastefully decorated in shades of pure white, silver and gold, this room can easily be dressed up for special occasions.  Along one wall hang painted portraits of the many wedding couples, solstice festivals, and society dances.  A small stage in the corner provides a performance area for bards, and the entire area is lit by elaborate chandeliers.

title: [Rone Academy, Sundry Gardens]
description: Here a path meanders across a well manicured lawn to a few park benches near a spring fed waterfall and pool.  Along the path, small plots of healing herbs and strong trees grow.  A gentle breeze carries past the scent of chives, rose, and sweet smelling apple blossoms.

title: [Rone Academy, Waterfall]
description: The sound of cascading water muffles all other noises.  Gentle waves lap at the edge of the natural pool, thrown in concentric rings from the water tumbling off of the smoothed rocks.  Some stepping stones lead across one side of the pool to steps carved out of one side of the waterfall.

title: [Rone Academy, Slippery Rocks]
description: The stones are covered with wet moss, slippery as a greased rolton.  Clouds of mist from the crashing waters swirl about the ground.

title: [Sacred Grove]
description: The branches here have been trained to grow upward and inward, creating a living steeple of limbs and leaves.  In a zig-zag pattern beneath the peak, strings of spherical white paper lanterns dangle, though they are little more than decoration as dappled sunlight spills through the canopy.  A flat, woven basket of vines sits in the cradle of three limbs, and a pair of shelves are formed by densely braided branches.

The branches here have been trained to grow upward and inward, creating a living steeple of limbs and leaves.  In a zig-zag pattern beneath the peak, strings of spherical white paper lanterns dangle, filling the space with an abundance of warm, golden light.  A flat, woven basket of vines sits in the cradle of three limbs, and a pair of shelves are formed by densely braided branches.

title: [The Lost Home, Kitchen]
description: Silver-swirled squares of ebon tile cover the floor of this light and airy kitchen.  A pair of tall arcing windows across from a marble archway allows gusting breezes to flow through the room, countering the heat from a large enameled stove that rests against one wall.  Copper pots hang from a circular rack in the center of the room, their surfaces polished to a brilliant sheen.  Standing against the far wall is a huge mistwood dry sink, with several woven baskets of produce piled to either side.

title: [The Hunting Lounge]
description: A large leather couch and several leather-covered chairs sit on the rich mahogany floor, pulled close enough for friendly conversation but far enough back from the marble hearth for comfort.  Above the mantel hangs a large picture of a hunter moving silently through the deep forest.

title: [Sandstone Workshop]
description: Carved out of the bedrock, the smoothly finished stone walls in this room form a fitting backdrop for the various contraptions the dwarven crafters have constructed to aid them in their work.  Along the eastern wall stands a low workbench with rows of tool racks against the wall behind it.  Evenly spaced about the room are a grinder, a polisher and a vise, the base of each inlaid with small squares of sandstone.

title: [Rockslinger's, Public Locker]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of one's locker.

title: [Sapphire Workshop]
description: Embedded in the floor are crushed mermaid's-tear sapphires, laid to form the image of a boot with a large buckle within a circle of star-of-Tamzyrr diamonds.  Pushed against the walls are several work tables, which take up a considerable amount of space in the room.  Small pieces of metal and scraps of leather litter the ground surrounding a short glaes-bound barrel, its lid discarded beneath a free-standing tool rack in the center of the room.  Larger than the others, this workshop can accommodate several people.

title: [Cobbling Court, Foreman Office]
description: Deliberately arranged across the stone flooring to create a checkerboard pattern are sage green rush mats that are trimmed with a deep ebony border.  Along the back wall, an overburdened desk is practically buried under stacks of papers and ledgers.  Lost in thought, the workshop foreman stands in front of a fresco depicting a landscape of an ancient forest with snow-capped mountains in its distance.

title: [The Cobbling Court, Registrar]
description: Placed in opposite corners of the room, identical flowerpots overflow with remarkable specimens of petunias, from the deepest shade of purple to a pale pink.  Globed lanterns dangle from slim, wrought iron poles embedded into the stone floor.  The soft light from within the lanterns creates a dizzying dance of shadows along the walls.  A lone chair occupied with only a leather-bound tome rests directly beneath one of the lanterns.  Sticking out from between the pages is the feather of a blood eagle.

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Meadow]
description: Thick forest, interspersed with several varieties of plants and vines, encircles a large meadow.  Wildflowers add a kaleidoscope of color to the lush, green grass on either side of a cedar chip path.  Sunlight glints softly off Lake Eonak through the flora around a modest home on the far side of the meadow.  Melgorehn's Reach rises sharply into the blue sky above the home, the peak wreathed in clouds.
location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Entryway]
description: Rectangular panels of polished witchwood, set with several veil iron sconces, enclose three sides of the room, while the fourth is made entirely of glass.  An enormous window, with its wide bench, provides an unobstructed view of the majestic greens of Melgorehn's Reach and the multichromatic Lake Eonak.  Dark walnut flooring is softened by a thick silk rug, accompanied by several dark leather armchairs.  In a far corner, a set of straight ko'nag stairs lead downward, and through an open doorway a few bar stools against a countertop are visible.
location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Kitchen]
description: Light floods into the airy space through a wall of glass, through which can be seen the large waterfall that feeds Lake Eonak.  In the center of the room is a long, polished white marble counter, inset with a deep double-sided sink.  High above, globes are inset in the ceiling, and a series of leather padded bar stools are lined up against the counter.  Gleaming copper pots and pans hang along the back wall above an elegant mithril stove, and an open doorway leads back to the entry.  The entire western wall is also glass, complete with a floor-to-ceiling sliding glass door leading onto the deck.
location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Deck]
description: Lacquered dark walnut flooring stretches out from the kitchen and across the neatly manicured grass of the hilltop.  The large deck is built to incorporate a narrow brook that runs down the hill to the beach and blends with the sparkling surf of Lake Eonak in the distance.  Thick, dark forests ring the lake, framing its pristine beauty against the backdrop of the Reach's majestic peak.  Several low teak chairs with elongated seats sit snug against the house.  A sliding glass door leads into the kitchen, while a narrow set of stone steps leads down the hill to the beach.
location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Beach]
description: Smooth, pristine white sand gives way to a rippled, slightly darker counterpart as it stretches toward the water's edge.  The gentle lapping of Lake Eonak, along with the soft sounds of local wildlife, enhance the calming surroundings.  Brilliant sunlight glints off several glass windows of the house bordering the northern edge of the private beach.  A narrow set of stone steps hugs the hillside and leads to a deck.  Positioned a safe distance from the lake is a round firepit surrounded by blackened sand, and closeby is a cushioned loveseat suspended from weathered wooden beams by thick chains.
location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Bedroom]
description: Piles of sand lean against the base of the southern and western glass walls, which give a breathtaking view of Lake Eonak's sunlit surface.  The dark witchwood of the eastern wall is bisected diagonally by a set of straight ko'nag stairs.  A low, rectangular witchwood chest with square iron handles sits at the foot of a king-sized bed with a low, flat headboard, and is flanked by a nightstand that rests against the northern wall.  Joining the northern and eastern walls is a fireplace cut from ebon-veined brown marble.  A braided silk rug in muted tones stretches beneath a plush loveseat, positioned between the bed and a glass door that leads to a private beach.
location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Twilight Lodge, Clearing]
description: An ivy-covered riverstone lodge provides tranquil refuge in the darkness, light from its windows reflecting off the nearby towering silver lor tree and an eahnor-streaked waxing stone moon.  Across the clearing, a magnificent angel oak erupts from the ground, its many gnarled and twisted limbs embrace the glade, shielding it from the encroaching forest.  A braided hemp ladder hangs from the lor tree, and a glowbark dart board embellished with an astral rune is mounted on the oak.

title: [Twilight Lodge, Lor Treetop]
description: From a small platform high up in the lor tree, stars twinkle like countless pinpricks across an endless ebon sky, the view stretching from mountains to endless wooded plains.  A pair of great horned owls swoop through the trees, hunting for prey, their melodic hoots echoing throughout the forest at a hypnotic tempo.  Carved on the silver tree trunk are some ancient runes.  A tightly-woven hemp ladder hangs over the edge of the platform.

At the top of a tightly-woven hemp ladder, a small platform rises above the treeline, providing a spectacular view.  A pair of great horned owls tend to their young in a nest on a nearby branch.  Broken hatchling shells are scattered around the nest amongst fresh pellets and molted feathers.  Carved on the silver tree trunk are some ancient runes.

title: [Twilight Lodge, Great Chamber]
description: The great room of the lodge is illuminated by many cheerful sconces set in the riverstone walls.  The floor is a checkerboard of blue and white opalescent tiles that contrast with the exposed beams in the ceiling.  Covering the wall opposite the entrance is a mosaic of a scarlet owl flying through the night.  A short iron potbelly stove and plush couches are arranged before the mosaic, while a solid oak banquet table with glowbark trim is set conveniently near a kitchen door.

The great room of the lodge is illuminated by two skylights on the vaulted ceiling.  The floor is a checkerboard of blue and white opalescent tiles that contrast with the exposed beams in the ceiling.  Covering the wall opposite the entrance is a mosaic of a scarlet owl flying through the night.  A short iron potbelly stove and plush couches are arranged before the mosaic, while a solid oak banquet table with glowbark trim is set conveniently near a kitchen door.

title: [Twilight Lodge, Divination Room]
description: A four-tapered snowy owl chandelier hangs above the stage of a small, intimate amphitheater, where a low granite table rests.  Walls draped in twilight blue velvet curve to create a semicircular room with built-in tiered seating formed by several levels of steep steps.  Lavish silver-tasseled embroidered cushions lay casually around the dark carpeted floor on all levels, while two narrow staircases down the sides of the room provide easy access to the stage.

Built-in tiered seating is formed by several levels of steep, darkly carpeted steps casually strewn with lavish silver-tasseled embroidered cushions on all levels.  A four-tapered snowy owl chandelier hangs above the stage where a low granite table rests.

title: [Alabaster Bastion, Atrium]
description: The atrium is tucked into a hollow at the center of the building, forming a pocket of shelter surrounded on all four sides by walls of white stone.  The brittle stalks of dead Vines wrap and wind around the legs of a pair of marble benches, and threaten to choke the base of a stone socle.  Above, the view of the sky is unobstructed.  Above, the view of the sky is unobstructed, though the light of several alabaster-shaded lanterns casts a glow that hides all but the brightest of the stars.
location: the Alabaster Bastion, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Alabaster Bastion, Armory]
description: A large square in the center of the alabaster floor has been removed and replaced with a sand-filled pit, its edges carefully delineated with a single course of carved masonry.  Save for a border of open space around the practice area, the rest of the chamber is a maze of weapon racks and armor-laden mannequins.  An alabaster arch faces off across the room against an arched doorway, which leads eastward.
location: the Alabaster Bastion, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Alabaster Bastion, Bedchamber]
description: Cream velvet curtains surround the bed in the center of the chamber, suspended from a wyvern-shaped pewter fixture high above.  The fabric is a shade off from the alabaster walls and floor, but the same color as the leather of the oversized chair and footstool placed in one corner.  At the foot of the bed is a wooden trunk, the match to a campaign table set up, with no regard for traffic, in front of the door.  A single alabaster arch is inset into one of the walls.
location: the Alabaster Bastion, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Alabaster Bastion, Map Room]
description: The rectangular room, with its open expanse of alabaster floor and high pewter-gilded ceiling, is sparsely appointed -- a long and narrow table and a few chairs are the only pieces of furniture in the chamber.  The walls, however, are fully concealed by bookshelves, heavy under their burdens, and glass-fronted cases, filled to bursting with maps, charts and stacks of scrolls arranged into artful pyramids.  An arched opening along the western wall and an alabaster arch provide egress.
location: the Alabaster Bastion, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Alabaster Bastion, Bath]
description: The high-ceilinged room is paneled in pale cream, almost wheaten, slabs of polished alabaster.  A deep-bowled basin, its interior and jutting taps plated in pewter, stands against a slick alabaster wall inset with a door and an arch.  Tesserae in a blend of the same hues form a spiraling mosaic pattern on the floor.  Sectioning off one portion of the chamber is a metallic screen.
location: the Alabaster Bastion, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Tiny Cottage, Attic Corner]
description: Hidden behind a wall of wooden crates, this obviously neglected corner of the cottage attic is festooned with cobwebs and dust.  Dried bits of leaves are scattered across the floorboards like confetti.  Smeared scuff marks along the baseboard of one slanted wall lead toward a narrow, twisted opening between the crates.

title: [House Brigatta, Gaming Room]
description: Big umber leather-cushioned chairs are scattered about this rosewood-paneled room, some placed near a rough-hewn stone fireplace at the far end.  In one of the corners opposite the entry, a small felted gaming table stands near an oft-used, ebon-framed cork dart board.  A slight haze clouds near the ceiling, the rich scent of tobacco mingled with aged liquor adding a depth to the atmosphere of this comfortable setting.  An oak-framed glass curio off to one side holds various medals and awards won by Brigatta members.

title: [Master's Conservatory]
description: The hexagonal shaped room is enclosed with large panes of glass on five sides and has a domed ceiling made of smaller glass panes, carefully fitted together.  Lush foliage and tropical flowers decorate the room, adding to the illusion of being outdoors.  Most noteable are the orchids in shades of white, pink, blue, lavender and green.  Amid the flora and fauna comfortably cushioned rattan furniture has been placed to provide seating without disturbing the serenity of the room.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: A vast rolling sea of thick, heavy brambles lies before you, over six feet high, and an indeterminate distance deep.  The brambles are as black as pitch and covered with a thin sheen of ice that lends an evil gleam to the already vicious-looking thorns.

A vast rolling sea of thick, heavy brambles lies ahead, over six feet high, and an indeterminate distance deep.  The brambles are as black as pitch and covered with a thin sheen of ice that lends a chilling gleam to the already vicious-looking thorns.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: A frozen skeleton lies entwined in the brambles, apparently having failed in its epic struggle to combat enemies unknown while attempting to break free from the spiky plants.  A rusty handaxe sticks out of the brambles which have grown completely around the weapon.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Icy rocks litter the ground, and thick, spiky thorns jut in all directions.  A skeleton lies impaled on a particularly large thorn, lending credence to the danger inherent in the brambles.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Thick brambles claw vainly at the frozen ground, trying to gain any sort of purchase.  The spiky plants curve back over themselves again and again, making it impossible to determine exactly where they begin and where they come to an end.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The shrub has been hacked and cleaved here, a rusted longsword leaning against the growth.  Whoever attempted to clear a path failed miserably however, the snow-dusted skeleton evidence of the attempt.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The stiff swirling wind here has caused the snow to pile in a mound against some of the growth. Twigs, thorns, and decaying leaves all have fallen within this small snowdrift, creating an interesting piece of outdoor art.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The brambles here have taken on a comical pose, shaped like some overweight bear.  Spreading out from underneath the comically-shaped brambles, sinously curved appendages twist in every direction.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The footing here turns treacherous, as the snow has hardened to slick ice.  Mercifully, the brush has pulled back somewhat, making the trek here merely hazardous, instead of hopeless.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Snow falls lightly, the flakes dancing in the light breeze.  A glimmer of sunlight peeks through the clouds, reflecting gently off of the icy carpet.  The beauty of the moment, however, is marred by the burnt, black wall of thorns attempting to pierce anyone who comes too close.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The hedge seems a bit less dense here, but the thorns no less sharp.  It might be possible to pass through with extreme caution, but the decaying rodent within the brush seems to silently refute that.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: A cold mist covers the ground, moving silently through the brambles.  The path is treacherous, the thick, swirling fog hiding things unseen.  No direction seems to offer relief from the untiring thorns.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: There seems to be little escape from the spiked thorns of the surrounding area.  Small bits of shredded cloth and leather litter the ground, some caught in the growth, testament to others attempting to pass this way.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: A crumbling firepit is all but covered by the spiky branches here.  Old bones rest within the pit, long since picked clean by scavengers.  Clearly it has been a long time since anybody has used this spot to rest.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Only those with myklian-tough skin could wander this path unscathed.  The surrounding brambles offer no apology for their attack, nor do they seem to tire.  The jagged points of the brush are nearly unavoidable in their quest for flesh.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The view to the north is strikingly similar to one to the south, a solid wall of wooden barbs on either side.  Trudging forward in either direction is likely to be met with the same painful reward.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Passage in all directions becomes even slower as the thick snow carpeting the ground here makes walking difficult.  The area is absent of any life, and the only sound to be heard is the faint crunching of snow.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Only the brown of the shrubs breaks up the monotony of gray snow and even grayer skies filling this landscape.  Any wildlife has long since fled from this forgotten area, leaving no comfort of another living being.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: A wooden outhouse sits tangled in the vines, its door lying on the ground nearby.  The painted wood is chipped and peeling, the structure leaning dangerously from age.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The clouds overhead flash with lightning, echoed by their reflection in the pale snow.  A sharp crack of thunder soon follows, the sound quickly lost in the deep grove.  A glance about reveals no clues to safety.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The hedge here has long since died, the branches brittle and stiff.  Broken pieces of twigs litter the ground, leaving a path only those in the sturdiest of boots should trod, lest the caltrop-like thorns pierce one's feet.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Even the tallest of giantmen would have trouble seeing over the brush within this area.  The shrubs here have grown into a fortress of nails, their cover providing anything but safe haven.  A glance in any direction reveals little change in the scenery.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: A simple bench of stone sits within the brush, evidence of better times within this forest of nails and spikes.  It alone has resisted the weather and time, its hard surface immune to the brambles' never ceasing caress.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: A tiny flurry of snow swirls all around, its touch far softer than the unrelenting sting of the endless thorns.  The brambles twist together vertically to form a sword-like entity, pieces of frozen, unfortunate creatures stuck to its thorns.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Thorns, barbs, and tiny spikes encroach in every direction.  A pair of entangled vines impale two frozen corpses, still holding hands despite the test of time, brambles, and death.  Even the wind's voice through here is mournful and sad, a subtle reminder to the emptiness that lingers.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: A long abandoned wheelbarrow sits nearby, filled to the top with snow.  A light breeze ripples the shrubs, its touch anything but soothing.  The view south reveals the heaviest brush, but no path looks easy.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Relief is nowhere to be found as sharp spikes continue to thrust outward from the spiny bushes.  The ancient snow carpeting the ground here is anything but serene, it's color yellow from age.  A rotted canvas sack is stuck within the thorns, the slight breeze unable to free it from its prison.

title: [Underground Temple, Threshold]
description: Crowded with debris and irregular slabs of granite, the cramped temple entry preserves centuries of history, despite its apparent aging.  Sconces coated with a thick layer of dust emit a faint glow and line the moss-covered walls.  Ancient runic linework fills the center of the room and extends along the ground toward the south.

title: [Underground Temple, Subdued]
description: A steel-footed iron brazier rests in the center of the room, its hazy glow barely enough to illuminate the area.  Faceless stone idols stand shoulder-to-shoulder in a protective formation before the southerly exits.  Two sizeable spheres, one of fire opal and the other copper-hued, are mounted prominently on the south wall and are unmistakable representations of the Tilaok and Makiri moons.

title: [Underground Temple, Darkness]
description: Crumbling statues and a lack of sufficient lighting make travel through the temple challenging.  Overhead, an enormous sphere of polished grey moonstone, indicative of the moon of Lornon, hangs precariously on a single linked steel chain and spins erratically as currents of chilled air gust through this area of the temple.

Crumbling statues and a lack of sufficient lighting make travel through the temple challenging.  Overhead, an enormous enormous sphere of polished grey moonstone, indicative of the moon of Lornon, hangs precariously on a single linked steel chain and spins erratically as currents of chilled air gust through this area of the temple.

title: [Underground Temple, Scintillant]
description: White marble torches affixed along the walls emit a radiant glow and direct focus toward the center of the room.  Stationed atop a tri-tiered platform, a large white opal, representative of the moon of Liabo, is nestled within a gold-threaded white velvet blanket.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Dueling Sands]
description: Spikes protrude outward from the crumbling stone walls that encircle the arena.  A thin layer of sand covers the cavern floor, which has been stained with blood and littered with debris.  Long shadows twist and turn, cast from the flickering fires high overhead, adding to the considerably oppressive atmosphere in the arena.

title: [Jade Table]
description: Sitting in the center of a large patch of fresh mown grass, the Jade Table almost vanishes into the surrounding greenery.  The short legs are artfully carved in the likenesses of snarling pumas, rising up on their hind legs as they support the jade tabletop.  The table is so low that no chairs are needed.  Small comfortable cushions are scattered around the grass nearby, several stacked under the table itself.

title: [Fountain Table]
description: Carefully laid out tiles direct a small stream that flows out of the bubbling fountain nearby.  The Fountain Table is artfully crafted of copper rods in the form of a hand, fingertips carefully supporting the silvery white marble tabletop.  Several comfortable looking oak chairs stand nearby on the grass, pulled close to the edge of the fountain.

title: [Quilt Table]
description: Obviously the owner has a sense for the important things in life.  For those who simply want to enjoy the scent of the grass and the feel of the shifting breeze, a large patchwork quilt has been spread over a table, accompanied by a set of low chairs.  Though simple, there is a sense of luxury in enjoying the hushed sounds of birds singing in the oak and the quiet conversation from nearby tables.

title: [Oak Table]
description: A solid oak table is set on a section of carefully fitted tiles near the center of the lawn.  The top of the worn table is decorated with delicate rosewood inlay in the design of a stylized oak tree.  A group of leather-backed oak chairs sits nearby, patiently waiting for duty.

title: [Ta'Illistim Green]
description: At the southern end of the green, the expanse of carefully manicured lawn is broken up by a low pool, set flush to the ground and surrounded with a ring of cut stone socles.  Beyond the statuary, the grass continues until hitting a low silver fence.

title: [Ta'Illistim Green]
description: A double colonnade of carved marble birches, their stone boughs intertwined, creates a channel through the middle of the green.  On either side, the tended grass grows right up to the edge of the surrounding streets, stopped by the largely decorative barrier of a low silver fence.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Second Floor]
description: At the top of a wide staircase, a smartly dressed steward stands to one side of a corridor lined with ivory paper-covered walls and ebonswood wainscoting.  Ornate silver sconces hang on each side of a polished ebonwood door and a white monir door.  A narrow, cushioned bench rests beneath a glass lunette window dominating the far wall.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Kitchen]
description: Two large ovens occupy one wall opposite a wide-arched fireplace, a massive iron cauldron suspended inside.  In one corner, fragrant herbs hang from a tiered drying rack above a heavy worktable fixed with a hefty wooden chopping block at one end.  Steel-banded oak barrels are stacked beside a tall ice chest with a glass door.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: Headstones flank both sides of the gravel path here.  Weatherworn, the headstones in this area are obviously older than those which follow the fence enclosing the cemetery.  The gravel path crunches underfoot, but provides an easy route to follow.

title: [Dark Grotto, Long Stairway]
description: Huge steps have been carved into the stone wall of the cavern forming a stairway of gigantic proportions.  No creature that you have ever seen has had the size or length of leg to negotiate stairs of this size.  Details of the cavern floor far below are lost in the shadowy distance.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Foyer]
description: Scenes detailing the history of the Black Wolves Clan are proudly portrayed in magnificent oil paintings that line the walls.  The center of the ceiling houses a rounded crimson skylight that bears the silhouette of a howling wolf.  Moonlight penetrates the translucent image, casting the Black Wolves seal faintly onto the white marble floor below.  Bronze lanterns hang in pairs down the wide hallway, and a few armchairs have been arranged around a small table.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Back Yard]
description: Tiny motes of light flash aimlessly as fireflies gather about the landscape.  Two lofty trees stand on either side of the lawn as they guard over a freshwater pond between them.  An ancient ironwood prevails in the eastern half, while a stately haon tree spreads its boughs across the lawn's western side.  A stone path wanders through the yard, curving alongside a large fallen branch under the ironwood, before it reaches a low dock jutting over the pond.

title: [A Secluded Gazebo]
description: Nestled behind the pond, this covered gazebo offers a quiet retreat while still providing a grand view of the back yard.  Two wicker chairs and a loveseat rest inside the gazebo, letting guests find a natural setting to enjoy some solitude or have a friendly chat.  Copper lanterns hang from the shingled roof, their light swaying gently through the climbing roses and lattice, casting a soft amber glow across the pond while the soothing scent of lavender and the croaking chorus of toads rise from the surroundings.

title: [Defender Hall, Auditorium]
description: Directly across from the entryway stands a prominent rounded dais set off by an elegant tapestry on the wall behind it.  Ebonwood benches are staggered downwards to the dais curving in a semi-circle to provide a clear view of the speakers.  Trails of crimson carpet line the steps and aisles of a pale grey marble floor, granting quiet and safe travel through the auditorium.  Brushed silver oil lamps encircle the room and reflect their light off the thick glass panels that arch up to form a high domed ceiling.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Lounge]
description: Warm and spacious, the lounge offers a cozy retreat with a rich mahogany floor and a high-vaulted ceiling framed by honey oak walls.  A grand fireplace stands against the western wall, and moonlight streams into the room through a pair of wide arched windows that flank its chimney.  A small basket of sticks sits by the fireplace.  Oversized couches and roomy chairs are casually scattered about the room, providing plenty of comfortable seats, and a curved mistwood bar stretches out beneath the loft.

title: [The Loft]
description: Subtle scents of spice and oils fill the air.  There is a sense of seclusion to the loft even though the lounge below is just a good shout away.  A few pillows are strewn along the overstuffed caramel suede corner couch, and a silky shag rug of ivory wool tipped with silver complements the rich mahogany floor.  Across from an arched window is an oil painting with a pair of spiraled mithglin sconces mounted on each side and a small claw-footed table that has been carefully arranged below it.

title: [Black Wolves' Grand Ballroom]
description: Shades of sea green and soft white envelop this capacious hall.  Two outstretched chandeliers hang from the ceiling, their upswept arms decked in faceted crystals that cast a multitude of tiny reflections across the room.  Tall, narrow windows draped in gossamer are spaced evenly along the walls and accented by pale gold sconces.  A highly polished teakwood floor beckons dancers, while sofas and chairs covered in crushed velvet surround the dance floor.

title: [Black Wolves' Manor, Veranda]
description: A cool breeze blows through this covered patio hedged with fragrant rose bushes.  Tall stone columns support the roof, each with ivy twining up its base.  Benches of black granite have been set around the patio, and an ebonwood trellis draped in blue wisteria vines arches over a dark slate footpath.  The light of the night sky casts a gentle luminescence on the a small pond at the path's end, and thriving flower beds abound in this quiet area.

title: [Defender Hall, Primum's Office]
description: Eight ebonwood chairs surround a great round table of mithril-banded oak.  A round oak and iron wagon wheel set with sconces hangs from the center of the ceiling, keeping the office well-lit day and night.  The eastern wall is adorned with a bold tapestry hung just above an official-looking desk.  In a quiet corner of the office stands a small aquarium, the tropical fish milling about in their watery home, oblivious to the world around them.

title: [The Oubliette]
description: Dust motes dance in a beam of light that illuminates the seal of the Black Wolves which is set in the center of the rough stone floor.  The faint crackle of magic hovers over a tangle of broken weapons and shattered armor next to a long table placed under some low-hanging shelves.  A painted mural depicting a flight of dragons soaring through a twilight sky climbs the granite walls of the circular chamber, ending at an iron grate set high above.

title: [Dark Grotto, Long Stairway]
description: Huge steps have been carved into the stone wall of the cavern forming a stairway of gigantic proportions.  No creature that you have ever seen has had the size or length of leg to negotiate stairs of this size.  Details of the cavern floor far below are lost in the shadowy distance.

title: [Twilight Hall, Bleeds' Room]
description: Walls of gleaming obsidian arch seamlessly into the ceiling of this room to form a smooth, black dome.  Thousands of shiny silver points glimmer in the firmament above, all of them dwarfed in size by a large, eight-pointed star which shines at the zenith.  A web of filigreed silver emanates from the larger star to touch each of the smaller ones in turn, giving the appearance of a large spider's web arching protectively over the heavens.

title: [Lowest Environs, Cavern]
description: The walls are heavily laden with glowing blazestars of every known color reaching from roof to an unknown depth of the pool.  The waters, while still, are fantastically pure and reflect the light of the many sparkling gemstones.  Carved amongst them in the stone wall are recognizable hand holds leading to a solitary ledge.  On the far end of the caverns you see some flat rocks.

title: [Lowest Environs, Flat Rocks]
description: The light bounces in from the wider caverns, forming merry colored patterns everywhere you look.  A shifting sands mural has been skillfully rendered upon the walls, adding cheery atmosphere.  The floor is simply a collection of perfectly flat pillars of rock that seem to grow up from the endless abyss of deep water around you.  Although there seems to be no heat source, the temperature of the rocks is consistent and comfortable.

title: [Twilight Hall, Locker]
description: With the curtain closed behind you, all sound from outside the locker area has been hushed.  The counter is topped with deep green baize which shows little wear.

title: [Blooms, Strings, and Things]
description: The fabric walls of this small stall are only loosely tied to its wooden frame, the vibrantly hued material rustling with even the slightest breeze.  A short, three-legged table sits in the middle of this area, with a small tin bucket atop it, and a tall willow flower basket sits directly beside it.

title: [Blooms, Strings, and Things]
description: This section of the stall is completely enclosed in brightly hued fabric save the passage that leads to the front of the shop.  Along the back wall, a narrow counter occupies the space between two wooden supports, and a squat clear glass jar and a smooth clear glass dish share the display area.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Dust motes, dancing in the slanted rays of light with each creak of the gently rolling ship, drift down from the exposed oaken beams supporting the decking overhead.  Hanging from a hook on the splintered portside bulkhead is a single brass lantern, its flickering light casting odd shadows across the crooked deck planks.  Standing next to the lantern, in obvious need of repair, is a misshapen harpoon rack.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Ivory Tent, Interior]
description: The open expanse of the tent's interior is complemented by the airy quality of its layered ivory silk construction and peaked ceiling.  Gauzy swathes of golden mesh are scalloped along the upper edge of the walls, held in place at each peak by a spray of milky white lilies.  A lengthy buffet table dominates the left side of the tent, while the remaining space is occupied by half a dozen round tables set with chairs in front of a raised dais.  A myriad of winterberry ale barrels perched on oaken stands rest at the dais' edge.

title: [The Lapidary]
description: The wagon's interior walls bear a high gloss resultant of meticulous polishing and attentive care.  Luminous brass lanterns hang from the heavy struts overhead, shedding a warm amber light perfumed with vanilla in pools across the area.  Opposite the entry, a tall chest sits, and one of its drawers has been left open, with a small parchment note hanging from its golden pull.  Against a side wall is a rack that stands across from a full-length brass-framed mirror, and between the two is a door leading out.

title: [River's Rest, Winterberry Patch]
description: The precarious dirt path that leads down from the bank strays close to the water's edge before widening into a small patch of marshy earth framed on three sides by riverstones.  Within the confines of this rudimentary "garden" are several glossy-leafed bushes laden with clusters of blue-black winterberries, as if someone were merely trying to cultivate the look of a purposeful planting with the rocky border.  A fitfully guttering lantern hangs from the nearby post, shedding minimal illumination.

title: [Behind The Masque, Ladies]
description: Cut glass shades guard the tiny flames of the candles atop the lanterns along the walls, and this area of the wagon is filled with a warm amber light.  Off against the far wall sits a wardrobe filled to brimming with gowns, and to the side of it is a set of wrought iron hooks on the wall.  Opposite the wardrobe is a small set of shallow risers, which display a variety of footwear, and nearby is a circular table draped in velvet.

title: [Behind The Masque, Gentlemen]
description: The candles within the lanterns in this section of the wagon give off the faint aroma of cedar, and it mingles with the scent of leather in the air originating from the wares on display.  Against the side wall, a stately wardrobe stands with its doors propped open, and off to the left is a square pedestal table.  A wrought iron rack stands across the way on the opposite side of a carpeted runner that divides the space.

title: [Behind The Masque, Workroom]
description: Shelves line the walls of this small area of the wagon, laden with jars of brightly gleaming gemstones, vases of colorful feathers, and spools of satin ribbons in a variety of hues.  Overhead hangs several glass-shaded lanterns, filling the room with a warm, amber light, while piles of silken pillows ring the edge of the space, all centered around a single, tufted violet cushion.  Near the cushion sits a tiered sewing box and several trays of odd and intriguing adornments.

title: [The Lapidary]
description: A pair of lanterns with cut crystal shades hang directly over a delicately carved jewelry stand, the pristine light dancing over every reflective surface under its touch.  Further into the area, a doorless golden oak armoire stands off to the side - a hulking piece of furniture itself, it is dwarfed by the high ceilings of wagon.  Near the armoire, sits a tiered shoe rack, and just a few steps away, a drawn ivory marbrinus curtain leads into another section of the shop.

title: [The Lapidary, Workshop]
description: The oversized scale of the wagon persists even in this section of the wagon, clearly the front most compartment set just beneath the driver's bench.  Scalloped swags of beaded silk fringe decorate the step-cut ceiling at the far end, while a profusion of brass lanterns hang overhead to provide copious amounts of light.  Along the outer edge of the space, several small sofas and chairs have been placed, while an oval table occupies the heart of the area.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Curving slightly upward, the starboard section of the bulkhead appears to be unfinished.  Exposed wooden framing supports the fitted planks that form the skin of the ship.  The long companionway stretches aft, interrupted only once by a salt-encrusted porthole.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Alcove]
description: Dark-paneled walls give way to a curved expanse of glass, flooding the room with sunlight and illuminating the glittering mica in the marble floor.  Long silken banners hang majestically from the ceiling, eight to the left and eight to the right, beneath which are a series of tall black pedestals.  In the center of the room is a circular wooden bench, ideal for perusing the exhibits or enjoying the view through the window.  A small brass sign hangs next to a black marble arch that leads back to the lobby.

title: [A Winding Path]
description: Thick haon bushes, the silvery blue bark glowing in the summer sunlight, flank a pair of wrought iron gates.  Several nosegays of white flowers are tied to the ironwork with multicolored ribbons.  A wooden sign, painted gray and edged in deep blue, is affixed to one gate.

Thick haon bushes, the silvery blue bark barely visible in the light spilling from several nearby glaesine lanterns, flank a pair of wrought iron gates.  Several nosegays of white flowers are tied to the ironwork with multicolored ribbons.  A wooden sign, painted gray and edged in deep blue, is affixed to one gate.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Deep purple lavender crowds the borders of the walk, delicately scenting the air as passersby brush the plants' silvery foliage.  Fat bumblebees deftly avoid contact with the festivalgoers as they gleefully dance about the lavender's tall stalks.  A large boulder rests beside the path, a painted wooden sign affixed to its worn surface.

Deep purple lavender crowds the borders of the walk, delicately scenting the air as passersby brush the plants' silvery foliage.  Small torches, tiny glaesine globes atop slender ironwork poles, dimly light the path as it winds through the lavender's tall stalks.  A large boulder rests beside the path, a painted wooden sign sign affixed to its worn surface.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: The path widens abruptly as it meets the thick green grass of the meadow.  Occasional trees dot the landscape, colorful silken tents pitched among them like brightly hued flowers.  A carved stone bench sits beneath a nearby rose-covered arbor, providing a cool and shady resting place from the bright sunlight.

The path widens abruptly as it meets the thick green grass of the meadow.  Occasional trees dot the landscape, colorful silken tents pitched among them like brightly hued flowers.  A carved stone bench sits beneath a nearby rose-covered arbor, providing a quiet resting place from which to enjoy the shimmering night sky.

title: [Elaraeyn's Boutique, Atelier]
description: Filigreed floor-to-ceiling windows reveal a colorful walled-in garden, the flora tended in several terra cotta pots that line the perimeter of the shop.  The floor of the room has been scattered with various paeline pillows, the cushions accompanied by thick blankets of soft fur.  Set against the far wall is a carved silvered haon table, covered in various swatches of fabric and loosely rolled sketches of clothing and jewelry.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Sunlight shimmers on the surfaces of the tents pitched nearby, their thin silken walls billowing in the summer breeze.  A makeshift path, lined with small terra cotta pots overflowing with pale pink verbena, has been created between the colorful structures.

Starlight shimmers on the surfaces of the tents pitched nearby, their thin silken walls billowing in the evening breeze.  A makeshift path, lined with small terra cotta pots overflowing with pale pink verbena, has been created between the colorful structures.  Small glaesine globes swing from ironwork posts, dimly illuminating the area.

title: [Lofty Resonance]
description: Warmly lit by crystal lamps, the airy pavilion is filled with vibrant colors.  Rugs scattered over the ground are woven with jade, teal, and sapphire hues in elaborate knotwork designs.  A carved rosewood rack filled with instruments stands to one side.  Polished to a high sheen, a table ornately carved with flowering vines is centered on the carpets as a focal point in the large space.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: An ancient maoral tree towers above, its thick gnarled trunk decorated with beribboned garlands of roses, hyacinth, and blaeston flowers.  A small cart, painted in shades of blue and red, sits beneath the tree.

title: [Stylish Sights]
description: Burnished copper poles support the wide, overlapping swathes of vibrant marine-hued silk gauze that form this airy pavillion.  Near the center of the open space a mother-of-pearl inlaid dark green faenor table with elegantly scrolled legs on a pale golden oak parquet floor.  Standing some distance away from the walls of lapis, turquoise, and celadon silk, an ornately carved teak screen effectively sections a portion of the space into another room.

title: [Stylish Sights, Studio]
description: Quiet and comfortably out of the way, an ornately carved teak screen sections this small corner off from the larger room and affords some small measure of privacy.  Several low, tone-on-tone ultramarine damask divans form a close semicircle around a burnt bronze velvet wingback chair that faces the lacquered teak partition.  A gold-veined white marble table with clean, elegant lines rests in the center of the well-appointed seating area, and tucked in a corner a tall oval mirror framed with elaborate gold scrollwork stands watch over the secluded space.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: A hawthorn tree perches atop a small rise in the grassy meadow.  Its delicate white blossoms drift in the air, scenting the breeze with a faint fragrance.  A thick bed of pink and purple anemone surrounds the base of the gnarled tree.

A hawthorn tree perches atop a small rise in the grassy meadow.  Its delicate white blossoms glow faintly in the silvery starlight filtering down through the tree's gossamer branches.  A thick bed of flowers surrounds the base of the gnarled tree.

title: [Carry On, Showroom]
description: Swathes of pale blue satin drape from the tall crossbeams of the pavilion's ceiling to fall to the rug-covered floor in pools of cascading fabric.  An ornately carved altar with an unlit candelabra sits below a brightly colored tapestry of the elven House of Illistim.  Twin beaded curtains on the east and west walls of the main showroom lead into smaller areas of the tent.  A pair of iron-crossed racks displays pouches and sacks of various hues and embellishments.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: A large wine-hued silk tent occupies this relatively flat spot on the expansive meadow.  Small flowerpots have been placed at intervals around the tent's exterior, each boasting a different hued rosebush.  Flanking the tent's open entrance, twin pink rosebushes climb miniature trellises affixed to their pots.

Flanking the tent's open entrance, twin pink rosebushes climb miniature trellises affixed to their pots.  A glaes-paned lantern swings from a post outside the tent.

title: [Lumnea Festival Tent, Interior]
description: Providing a touch of elegance, a great wool carpet of a rich claret hue with gold accents covers the grass inside this large tent.  Several sturdy maoral poles support the silk structure, creating peaks and valleys in the ceiling.  The sound of the tent fabric fluttering in an occasional breeze is accompanied by the festive voices and music filtering in from the meadow.

title: [Carry On, Showroom]
description: In the center of the small room, a pair of sinuously curved ashwood armchairs is arranged on either side of a glass-topped oblong table, piled high with discarded books.  Rows of plain wooden shelves displaying elven-titled books, maps, scrolls, and parchments can be seen throughout the far corners of the room.  Adorning the walls are beautifully crafted backpacks hanging from a row of silvery-tipped pegs.

title: [Carry On, Workroom]
description: Swinging to and fro, several pale silver paper luminaries hang from the ceiling of the small workroom.  A tall stiff-backed chair and worktable rest along one side of the room, while a series of curved hooks decorate the other.  A pair of large potted toadstools stand sentry to the beaded curtain leading back into the main showroom.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: A thick stand of thistle has grown up beside the path, its deep purple flowers nodding in the summer breeze.  Butterflies and bumblebees compete for space amongst the flowers, alighting momentarily and then flitting about once more.
A thick stand of thistle has grown up beside the path, its deep purple flowers nodding in the evening breeze.  Silvery moonlight washes the plants in an ethereal glow.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Several tents are arranged in a semicircle, the brightly-colored fabric walls billowing in the day's breeze.  A worn stone bench, carved with nearly illegible runes, sits beneath a nearby tree.

Several tents are arranged in a semicircle, the brightly-colored fabric walls billowing in the night's breeze.  A worn stone bench, carved with nearly illegible runes, sits beneath a nearby maoral tree.  Glaes-paned oil lamps swing from small ironwork posts, casting dim amber light across the landscape.

title: [Cultured Cravings, Entry]
description: Panels of silk are arranged in layers around a central support ring to form a peaked roof that is swirled with color.  Each panel branches off into one of five directions in a solid color of either green, blue, yellow, violet, or crimson and forms fabric-swaddled tunnels that lead further into the shop.  A circular velveteen settee is set at the center of the room beneath frosted, mutihued glass globes that are suspended from twisted wrought iron poles.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest, out

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: An old stone cottage, long abandoned from its look, occupies this corner of the meadow.  The remnants of the cottage's thatched roof hang from the eaves, and its walls have been nearly hidden by thick patches of deep green ivy.  A large wild rosebush has claimed one corner of the structure, its clusters of yellow blossoms dripping from the cottage in large fragrant swaths.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [A Touch of Serenity]
description: Austere in its appointments, the only major decoration to the tent is a large, black wool carpet edged in gold silk fringe which covers the ground.  Shelves, chests, and cases are places about the room to best present their contents.  Numerous square, crystal-paned candle lanterns suspended from sturdy fel support poles provide a warm light as the heady scent of burning incense wafts though the air.

title: [Serenity, Work Alcove]
description: Small and intimate, this alcove is carpeted with a gold rug woven with black abstract patterns.  The only furnishings are a large fel cabinet and some sapphire silk cushions for seating.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: A small brook cuts across the meadow, running near the path as it winds along.  The water gurgles merrily as it tumbles over smooth stones and temporarily fills a small pool on its way to the nearby Mistydeep River.  An old silvery-hued wind chime, hung from the branches of a nearby haon bush, chimes gently in the breeze.

An old silvery-hued wind chime, hung from the branches of a nearby haon bush, chimes gently in the evening breeze.

title: [Lumnea Meadow, Glimaer Pool]
description: The brook tumbles into a small natural pool formed by piles of smooth rocks.  The water eddies and swirls about as it slips inexorably towards the tiny waterfall at the pool's far edge, where it finally spills over the rocks and continues its journey towards the river.  Sunlight glints off the surface of the water.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Thick blaeston bushes crowd the base of an ancient thanot tree as it spreads its leafy canopy across the path.  A small birdbath, little more than a concave stone basin, rests in a hollow near the base of the trunk.  Several tents are pitched in the shade of the old tree's boughs.

title: [Shrouds of Sophistication]
description: With the scent of sweet hyacinth lingering in the air, this area is awash in vibrant emerald silks from the pavilion walls to the ceiling.  Underfoot, a thick carpet of velvet has been placed, its hue a muted golden interspersed with threads of green and blue.  A series of glass-enclosed lamps hang from the support beams above, their rippled shades fracturing the candlelight within to cast an array of illumination across the carpet and walls.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Several tables, skirted in various colors and festooned with multicolored ribbons, have been set out in a semicircle.  Trays of edibles lie atop each table, constantly refreshed as elven maids scurry between them and a nearby covered wagon.
