Large glaes-paned lanterns hang from tall ironwork posts, illuminating the tables with a golden amber nimbus.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Cultured Cravings, The Wyvern]
description: Falling from the peaked ceiling in tailored pleats, the crimson silk forms smooth walls and pools elegantly on gold rugs.  Frosted glass lanterns dangle from golden chains over a glass counter, providing excellent illumination by which to view the wares, while a pendant lantern hangs over a wyvern-carved polished modwir table that is flanked by a pair of gold-cushioned chairs.

title: [Cultured Cravings, The Cut]
description: Lacquered bamboo poles coax the gold-veined onyx marbrinus silk panels into a peaked ceiling that supports frosted glass globes.  The smooth tent walls ripple slightly with the passage of customers and pool upon woven rugs designed in mimicry of marble tiles.  Occupying the center of the room is a carved golden linden table laden with refreshments, while several wicker-backed chairs and plush velveteen settees are arranged under the glow of dangling glass orbs in groups of three and four.

title: [Cultured Cravings, The Lute]
description: Falling from the peaked ceiling in tailored pleats, the violet silk forms smooth walls and pools elegantly on silver rugs.  Frosted glass lanterns dangle from silver chains over a glass counter, providing excellent illumination by which to view the wares, while a pendant lantern hangs over a polished white table, which houses additional wares.

title: [Cultured Cravings, The Rose]
description: Falling from the peaked ceiling in tailored pleats, the green silk forms smooth, ebon-veined walls and pools elegantly on onyx rugs.  Frosted glass lanterns dangle from faenor chains over a glass counter, providing excellent illumination by which to view the wares, while a pendant lantern hangs over a black lacquered table that houses additional wares.

title: [Cultured Cravings, The Oak Leaf]
description: Falling from the peaked ceiling in tailored pleats, the mustard yellow silk forms smooth walls and pools elegantly on forest green rugs.  Frosted glass lanterns dangle from eahnor chains over a glass counter, providing excellent illumination by which to view the wares, while a pendant lantern hangs over a polished red oak table.

title: [Cultured Cravings, The Peacock]
description: Falling from the peaked ceiling in tailored pleats, the dusky blue marbrinus silk forms smooth, silver-veined walls and pools elegantly on blue-green rugs patterned with peacock feathers.  Frosted glass lanterns dangle from the ceiling on silver chains over a glass counter, providing excellent illumination by which to view the wares, while a pendant lantern hangs over a dusky blue painted thanot table.

title: [Lumnea Meadow, Baerl Mystiaem]
description: Sunlight glimmers across the wide expanse of fragrant green grass.  Beds thick with flowers line the perimeter of the area, creating a haven for the bees and butterflies who feast among the colorful blossoms.

Moonlight shimmers across the wide expanse of the meadow, touching each blade of grass with a silvery sheen.  A large area of the grass has been sectioned off for dancing.  Hundreds of tiny glaesine-cupped candles, stationed upon slender ironwork poles, are scattered through the flowerbeds and around the trees that surround the meadow, providing the effect of a thousand fireflies dancing in the night air.  Opalescent silvery ribbons drift from the trees.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: A length of gray cloth edged in dark blue has been hung between two tall monir trees, forming a makeshift shelter from the bright sunlight.  Festivalgoers, clustered in small groups and conversing quietly, laze about on the thick green grass, sheltered beneath the canopy.

A length of gray cloth edged in dark blue has been hung between two tall monir trees, forming a makeshift shelter from the cool night air.  Festivalgoers, clustered in small groups and conversing quietly, laze about on the thick green grass, sheltered beneath the canopy.  Delicate glaesine globes dangle from small ironwork posts, casting their pale illumination in small circles.

title: [The Vine And Stem, Salesroom]
description: The interior of the wagon is richly appointed, its walls of golden oak rising from a floor carpeted in thick sage-hued rugs to a ceiling of sturdy beams.  At regular intervals, gilt-based lamps are stationed around the perimeter of the area, creating a warmly lit space in which to browse wares.  A single table occupies the majority of the floor space, its legs carved to resemble a majestic wyvern, while cases marked with the crests of the elven houses edge the walkway leading further into the shop.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: A long grey granite slab, speckled with bits of shimmering blue sapphire, rests atop a stack of smaller stones.  Numerous small candles burn atop the slab.  Scattered amongst the candles, small nosegays and flowers adorn the austere makeshift altar.  A small parchment lies in the center of the stone's flat surface.

title: [The Vine And Stem, Salesroom]
description: Gilt-based lamps burning here smell sweetly of jasmine and give off little to no smoke at all to pollute the fragrance.  Against one wall of the wagon sits a rose-carved ebony table, and against the opposing wall is a peacock feather-edged table, each with a neatly arranged display.  Above the tables hang corresponding silk banners, the fabric painted in a myriad of hues with the most skillful of brush strokes.

title: [The Vine And Stem, Salesroom]
description: Chairs with pale green cushions and padded arms have been placed around the room, their soft hue a compliment to the warmth of the wagon's oak walls.  Beneath the flickering flames of nearby gilt-based lamps, an oak leaf-carved table and a silver harp-inlaid table guard the outer edges of this space, leaving the center aisle open so shoppers can browse.  A silk banner hangs above each of the tables, their respective elven house crests painted in vibrant colors on the fine-spun fabric.

title: [Shrouds of Sophistication]
description: Luxurious velvet carpeting covers the floor of the pavilion.  To one side of the entryway stands a thick-framed mirror.  Rippled glass-shaded lanterns hover overhead, casting a warm aura of light about the area.  Against the very back wall, a pair of mannequins stand perpendicular to the silk, providing ample room to walk between and around each.

title: [Shrouds of Sophistication]
description: Dangling on gilded chains, lit crystal globes cast a spray of light across the area creating a glittering rainbow effect.  Flowing in from the main area of the pavilion, the velvet carpeting softens each step and the silken walls mute the noise outside.  A large gold-framed mirror stands against the back drape while to either side of it, a pair of elegant mannequins house various wares.

title: [Lofty Resonance]
description: Plush rugs in warm tones of amber, peach, and goldenrod cover the ground.  A shimmering aqua silk curtain is flanked by a small round table and a large carved rack.  The displays are carefully arranged to provide plenty of room for passage without disturbing the wares.

title: [Lofty Resonance, Workroom]
description: Lush carpeting and seating with large, colorful cushions provide a pleasant place to rest.  A small worktable covered with various tools sits to the back of the area.  The light silk walls of the pavilion flutter and billow occasionally in the breeze.

title: [Lofty Resonance]
description: Patterns of lavender, plum, and violet are woven into beautiful tapestries that adorn the walls in this area of the pavilion.  A soft carpet of ivory wool covers the floor.  Glowing crystal orbs hang from the ceiling, illuminating a rack and a stand that display a variety of musical instruments.

title: [Sharlatta's Frippery]
description: Long, draping walls of pale green silk cascade down from the tent's ceiling, where the material is held up in place by silver pole supports.  Covering the ground are plush layers of dark green rugs that run right up against the walls, and well-placed candles flood the area with light.  A long, pristinely clean glass case displays a selection of masks.  Atop the case's right edge, a silver plaque is perched over a neatly handwritten note.

title: [Sharlatta's Frippery, Trousers]
description: With one hand held out as if to greet someone, a statue of an elven lad is carved of smooth, pure white ivory.  He is dressed elegantly, with the richness of the carving depicting a fine high-necked cotehardie over hosen.  The statue's expression is completely obscured by the full-faced silver mask that covers all except his sapphire-inset eyes.  Opposite the masked lad, a tall ivy-painted ivory dresser is propped open.

title: [Sharlatta's Frippery, Gowns]
description: Silken walls of pale green brush against a slender ivory statue.  Composed of elaborately chiseled white ivory, a slender elven maiden attired in a sideless gown worn over a laced cotehardie is caught mid-step, her emerald-inset eyes twinkling from behind a golden mask that obscures the upper half of her otherwise reserved expression.  Opposite the masked maiden, a rose-carved ivory armoire is propped open.

title: [Sharlatta's Frippery, Shoes]
description: Several cushioned chairs are scattered across deep green rugs, providing ample spots for sitting.  Footstools padded with the finest fabric accompany the seating.  Shelves of polished thanot have been erected to form two adjacent areas, where one partition boasts slippers and feminine boots, while the other inlet is topped with footwear for men.  Near one particular footstool, a single beribboned shoebox litters the floor.

title: [Sharlatta's Frippery, Outerwear]
description: Hanging down from the silken ceiling are shining rows of silver hooks that line the pale silk walls.  Laid out upon a long thanot table is an array of gloves.  Several flowering plants are placed around the room for added comfort and subtle scent.

title: [Sharlatta's Frippery, Trinkets]
description: Complementing the dark green tones of layered rugs, pale green silk walls flow around the area like a cocoon.  Several glaesine shelves are spread with an assortment of jewelry and trinkets, their gems and metals catching the light and throwing it back against the tent's ceiling in brilliant displays of bejeweled color.  Placed below a colorful tapestry depicting a ball in progress is a polished thanot table.

title: [Wax Eloquent, Correspondence]
description: The front wall of the small square chamber is taken up by a narrow door and a single tracery window, which is paned in pale blue stained glass.  A matching silken rug covers the stone floor.  The counter that runs the length of the room is topped with a slab of labradorite, though a copious amount of dried wax covers its surface.

title: [Underground Temple, Core]
description: Leaning precariously to one side, a massive stone altar dominates the southern end of the temple.  Webs of cracks and crevices mar the stone beneath and render ancient floor carvings nearly indiscernible.  Partially concealed by the altar, a small tunnel leads down into darkness.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: A musty odor fills the area, a combination of the moist dirt that forms the walls and floors, and decaying bits of worm and rodent packed within.  Bits of bone and stone randomly litter the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Lily Manor, Courtyard]
description: Dappled moonlight illuminates the spacious courtyard of an elegant, two-story mist grey manor.  Cultivated beds of ivory stargazer lilies line the cobblestone walkway from the base of a gracefully arched gate to the ebonwood doors of the manor.  A sweeping expanse of ancient willow trees dots the landscape, their drooping boughs shadowing several scroll-worked marble benches.  A series of granite stepping stones winds around the side of the grounds.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Affording a bit of a glimpse ahead, a large chunk of one wall has fallen to the ground and smashed into shards and fist-sized stones amid the tiny pyramids of dirt.  The exit at the other end is clearly visible beyond the next weaving of the pass.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: At this end of the passage, a single torch aids the traverse from total darkness and around the small piles of dirt.  Brushing past, a small rat scurries along the floor and disappears into a small hole in the nearby wall.  The shiny carapace of a cockroach glimmers in the subdued light as it makes its way towards a more damp location.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Uncomfortably tight and barely able to support more than one traveler moving along, the narrow corridor is uncomfortably warm due to the close quarters and the number of flaming torches lighting the way.  Ruin walls have been worn almost completely smooth at the center, where hands and leather have rubbed against it, and small dirt piles litter the sides of the passageway.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Dragging footsteps and accidental bumpings are all that let you know others pass this way too, as the darkness encompasses the hallway completely.  The near-intimate groping of hands is quickly withdrawn as they make contact with flesh instead of ruin walls.  The dirt-limned floor muffles the steps scraping along the passage as shuffling continues in each direction.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Though several lit torches light the way close to the ruin walls of the corridor, the center of the wide passage remains shrouded in murk and littered with small dirt piles.  A small swarm of bats flit past, the raspy sound of their membranous wings echoing as they go.  In several locations, wood beams have been hammered together to create a brace where the walls have weakened.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Two lone torches light the way, casting little illumination in the hallway to dispel the darkness.  Rubble from the crumbling ruin walls scatters across the ground, some of it half-buried and tromped into the muck formed by water trickling down upon the piles of dirt.  The air is chilled and dank with the added moisture.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Boulder-sized clumps of earth have dislodged from the ceiling, creating a series of dirt piles blocking direct forward egress down the corridor, despite the unusually wide girth of the passage.  A broken cart leans precariously against one wall, its contents spilling out the back and down onto the ruin floor.  The abandoned supplies are covered in a thick film of dust, forgotten despite the frequent traffic in the passage.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Squat but wide, echoes ring out loudly in this mostly ruin rock hallway.  What little ambient light illuminates the way reflects off thin rivulets of trickle coming from the roots breaking through the earthen ceiling.  The crimson glow of vermin eyes flash every now and again, as the creatures meander from end to end of the passage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Turning this way and that in a horizontal undulation, the narrow walls and low ceiling contribute to the claustrophobic sensation of this winding connector.  Passing in any direction is difficult and made unpleasant by the piled mounds of dirt staggered along the edges of the walkway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: A deep rut treads the packed ground, centered in the path, caused by those trying to avoid the piles of dirt lining the walls.  Tendrils of smoke from oil torches curl along the ceiling, the dull layer of soot creating a matte coating overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Uneven floors slant underfoot, swerving with the curve of the passage.  Pebbly rubble mixed with a mounds of dirt adds a challenging element, and walls slick with moisture don't offer a secure handhold.  Rough gouges mar the way, revealing attempts to create some means to steady travel along this egress.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Pushed up against the wall between two dirt piles, the skeleton of a vermin-like critter is surrounded by a buzzing field of flies and crawling with ghostly maggots, its rent flesh exposed and torn from the belly of the tiny body.  A fallen torch, flame long extinguished, is half atop the small corpse, possibly the cause of death.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: As if the closing-in walls were not bad enough, a large chunk of the ruin's ceiling has fallen and smashed upon the floor, creating an obstacle to climb around or over in order to exit the tunnel.  Attempts have been made to chip away at the ruin's rubble, evidenced by the sharp gouges in the surface and piles of dirt lying around the base.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Small rocks fallen from a section of the crumbling wall spill out into the middle of the passage, making egress difficult for one, and especially complicated for more.  Small piles of dirt and pitted holes line the sides of the tunnel here.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: The ceiling of smooth rock, worn down from the constant moisture that seeps through the earth above it, drips with large droplets of water plinking down in an infrequent rain upon the dusty, packed earthern passage.  Small piles of dirt have created pockets of mud, some broken up by sliding footprints, making the pathway extremely uneven.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Funneled in dimension, this tunnel trespass is dusty from all the dirt stirred by constant movement and piles of dirt left along the sides.  At one end, a dim light from a larger area barely illuminates, while at the other is a darkened continuation.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Small piles of dirt line the edge of the tunnel, and a fine, powdery mist of dust fills the air.  Overhead, parts of tree roots emerge intermittently from the packed ceiling.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Several rows of tramped footprints have tracked the dirt along floor of the corridor, some scarred by ruts created from wheeled carts carrying supplies or diggers deeper into the cavern network.  A large spider skims quickly across a massive cobweb spun near the earthen ceiling.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Cramped and dark, the narrow hallway barely traverses more than a few steps, but the short journey is made more unpleasant by the piles of dirt and ancient smell of decay.  Uneven walls with rocky points bite into flesh and cloth when passing through the tight enclosure.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Long and echoing, the ruin corridor features a few torches brightly lit and sending up smoky wisps that stain the walls alongside each sconce.  The acrid smell of rancid oil hotly fills the stretch of this egress and does little to mask the additional odors of mildew and decay, as well as fresh turned earth evident by the small mounded piles lining the way.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Part of the ruin wall has sheered off and slid to the ground, blocking half of the passage and making it difficult to traverse.  The sharp edges once caught both flesh and cloth alike, judging from the rust-hued stains and threaded bits of fabric snagged.  Piles of dirt, like giant ant hills, run along the broken pathway sides.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Odd angles extend along this short passage and it becomes more obstacled than direct.  Due largely to the sides of rubbled ruins emerging from the walls, the earth here is tunneled around the protrusions.  The touch of steadying hands has worn the many surfaces down to a smooth finish, glazed slightly by the residual oils of flesh feeling the way.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Splintered wood ceiling beams, broken up by several large plant roots, threaten to cave in at any moment bringing down the crumbling ruins.  Small bugs crawl and slither in and around the plant tendrils, drawn by the moisture running along the root appendages.  The smell of mildew is very much present, likely from the decay created by insects feasting on the vegetation.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: No more than a couple of steps long, the corridor is well lit and relatively free of rubble or other signs of decay, except for small piles of recently turned over dirt.  Wooden beams support the earthen ceiling overhead, as large cracks run much of the length, caused by an encroaching root system.  Droplets of water trickle down the exposed tendrils, creating a slick path of mud beneath.

title: [Lily Manor, A Walled Garden]
description: Shadowed by modwir trees, a series of granite stepping stones leads into the garden, following the gently curving pathway of a gurgling stream.  Sparkling with dappled moonlight, the water trickles past clumps of verdant moss and wild orchids to disappear under an ivy-covered stone wall.  Terraced beds lush with foliage in varying shades of green edge the walls.  A seating area with polished ironwood benches is positioned near a mistwood-framed tea room with a multi-paneled double door.

title: [Lily Manor, Tea Room]
description: A quartet of arched vaalin windows affords a generous view of the moonlit garden.  Swathes of plum charmeuse frame each window in billowing pools of silk, the curtains caught and held in place by creamy enamel stargazer lilies.  Glass teardrop vases frame the shadowed room, providing a sense of symmetrical order amidst the simplistic furnishings.  An arrangement of high-backed mahogany chairs circle a low mistwood table, while an elaborate mistwood teacart rests in waiting against a patterned wall.

title: [Lily Manor, Foyer]
description: An ebony-edged plum carpet runner extends across the grey marble flooring to the base of a grand staircase.  Silver sconces cast flickering candlelight upon the varnished ebonwood walls enclosing the large foyer, and moonlight streams through the arched windows framing the doors.  Shadows play across an expansive multi-hued tapestry serving as a backdrop to some ivory silk-covered chairs, and a linen-covered table rests near a tall archway to the west.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Countinghouse]
description: Shadows dart in and out of this corner nook, and hushed whispers mix with the distinctive sound of clinking coins.  Raucous cheers from the arena make it nearly impossible to understand the mutterings.  A pair of black-gloved hands poke out from beneath a stone ledge, ready to accept your coins.

title: [Museum of Fashion History]
description: Unadorned ebonwood walls enclose the glass cases positioned at various points in the room.  Gathered across the arched glass windows on the eastern wall, plum linen drapes are pulled back with silver cords to allow moonlight to stream through and dispel the shadows of night.  Silvery undertones sweep the grey marble floors, designed to match the unlit silver sconces that line the walls.  The museum continues through the northeastern arch.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Serpentine coils of thick grey mist bend and twist through the lush forest, obscuring entire swathes of the crowded forest in a hazy shroud.  The distant call of a songbird echoes somewhere within the heavy canopies above.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Silken bands of ethereal mist bend and twist about the wooded area almost playfully, not following any natural wind or order of things.  Oft times the fog appears misshapen and thick, quietly resembling the gnarled bodies of large apparitions.

title: [Oak Tree, Large Branch]
description: A small platform with an opening cut in the center has been built on this hefty tree branch.  A twisted rope ladder leads down the opening, back to the meadow.  High above is a ragged hole in the tree with a gnarled rope hanging down.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: The gnarled rope has been knotted around a thick iron spike sticking out of a hole in the tree.  Little rays of moonlight that have managed to sneak past the thick green leaves that cover every branch spray down upon the tree, providing illumination to the hole.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: Though the moonlight provides illumination at the opening of this hole, as you climb up some wooden pegs visibility diminishes until it is completely dark.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: It is pitch black inside the tree now, and the only way to continue moving is to feel around for the next peg to grab on to.  Climbing up the tree this way is a daunting task, as several of the pegs slip under your hands and feet.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: From above, a rustling sound can be heard, then nothing.  A split second later, a rush of leaves and debris come flying down the hole.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: Up above, there is a tiny speck of light.  It is hardly visible and only the size of a pinpoint.  There are fewer wooden pegs now, making it more difficult to continue climbing.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: More light can be seen inside the tree now, which makes climbing a little easier.  Above is another knotted rope, though it is still too far up to reach.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: Dangling from a perch constructed at the tree opening above your head is a thick knotted rope.  Since the wooden pegs inside the tree have all but disappeared, this appears to be the only way to continue upwards.

title: [Oak Tree, Wooden Perch]
description: This well-constructed perch has been situated half inside the tree and half outside.  An ornate carved railing surrounds the edge in a half-moon shape, providing protection from falling.  From this height, the ground is not visible at all.  All you can see is green leaves and branches to all sides.  Off to one side of the perch is a sturdy oak ladder leading up to another platform.

title: [Oak Tree, Wooden Platform]
description: Built around the entire trunk of the tree, this platform is massive in size.  A wooden railing carved with an intricate knotwork design surrounds the entire platform.  A vibrant bluebird flies by, landing in a nest filled with babies begging for food.  Up above, the cloud-filled sky is finally starting to become visible.

title: [Oak Tree, Top of the Tree]
description: Atop this gigantic tree, an oak platform has been constructed.  A colorful array of flower petals is scattered over the floor, occasionally whirling about the air whenever a gust of wind rushes through the tree top.  Spread about the platform are several benches, providing ideal locations for contemplation and reflection.  Near each bench is a handcrafted wicker basket filled to the brim with petals.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Dense fog hugs the ground in a churning blanket of mist, allowing only for a scattering of moss-covered rocks to jut up out of obscurity.  The occasional sound of a branch snapping or leaves rustling emanates from beyond a thicket of trees that encircles the entire area.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: The area here is thickly condensed, caught between being suffocated by fog or trees.  Nearly every inch of the ground is masked by a churning sheet of fog, while the sky is shielded by a series of towering trees, their large branches spread out to form a netting of oaken boughs.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Long vines ring countless tree branches in the area, many of the twisting creepers hanging low, making quick travel very precarious.  A thin, almost translucent layer of mist hugs the ground, patches of earth and lush grass peeking out from beneath.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: The harmonious choir of songbirds sounds from within heavy canopies above, while eerie tendrils of fog float lazily amidst the trees.  Leaves rustle beyond nebulous curtains of mist, and the occasional snap of a twig can be heard nearby.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Bright patches of moss cling to the outer rim of a huge hollowed log that dominates the center of the woodland clearing.  The fragments of a family of rabbits, most half-eaten, can be spotted just within the entry of the fallen tree, indicating a predator left in a hurry, or will be back soon.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Small burrows dot the ground in gathered pockets, some of them collapsed, while others are overgrown with vines and dense foliage.  The flaky remnants of moulting scales from a serpent stretch along the top of a long tree branch above.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Wide trees jut up from the ground, their branches grasping at the sky like gnarled fingers scraping the heavens.  Nearly impenetrable canopies spread out like a blanket overhead, forming a majestic and natural dome that throws the forest floor into a sea of shadows and fog.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: The air here is heavy and choked with tenuous pockets of mist.  A slow, but cold wind stirs in the area, seemingly stuck in a contorted maelstrom, locking the wraithlike fog into an endless circular pattern.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: Deep shadows and curls of ghostly mist grip the edges of the dark forest here.  The trees have grown so thick that there is precious little room to navigate through some of the dense thicket.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: A few, tiny yellow eggs have are broken on the ground, several feet below an empty nest perched upon a tree branch.  Along the side of the tree's trunk appears to be several deep gashes, likely wrought by large teeth or tusks.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: A wide path of lush grass spreads out before gradually giving way to the crystalline waters of a small lake.  Beneath the bright surface of the pond, the periodic fleck of silvery fish can be seen swimming about.  Pockets of nebulous grey mist float lazily along the lake's surface and edges, occasionally broken up as spotted deer appear and bend their necks to lap thirstily at the waters.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: The lush forest expands wide in every direction, with each vantage point covered in lush growth and almost supernaturally bright wildflowers.  Faint moisture clings to the air and pockets of woodland animals can be intermittently spotted.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Splinters of sunlight peek in through the abundant canopy above, infusing the mist-shrouded woods with a pale amber glow.  The markings of hooves dot the ground among some broken twigs and trampled grass.

title: [Red Forest, Ring of Mist]
description: Ribbons of ethereal mist dance about the grove like a web of ashen silk, stretching and spiraling along branches and tree trunks.  The loud snort of a pack of boars echoes within the deep miasma, suffocating the area.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: Lush greenery curves to the south through the forest, bordered by a thick haze which blocks the view in all directions.  Heavy foliage blankets the ground, nearly entombing a fallen old grey tree.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: Odd and unnatural sounds echo throughout the heavily wooded area as a thick, foggy barrier threatens to smother the lines of trees all around.  Beyond the veil of mist and shadow, the unnerving howl of a wolf carries on the wind.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: A small pocket of trees stretch up from the ground, their bark stained a blood red hue, and dried black ichor clinging to their misshapen leaves.  Other plants and vegetation grow in the area, but have sprouted far away from the sanguine trees as if nature itself evades them.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: Patches of unsightly greenish-brown moss thrive here, coating the ground and trunks of nearby trees.  An enclosure of barbed vines has grown along the area, the vestiges of several unidentifiable creatures trapped within their bristly embrace.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: A patchy coat of swirling mist extends through the crowded trees, periodically shifting and peeling away to reveal tangles of vines and shriveled black leaves nestled amongst gnarled roots exposed along the ground.  Some branches have bent along the gloomy path, stretched out like wooden claws digging at the dirt.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: A small path opens up through the thicket of trees, the ground littered with dark leaves and tiny footprints.  Heavy brush and undergrowth portend to swallow up the narrow trail, while hazy curtains of mist dance along the edge of the woods.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: Majestic trees rise up all around, their branches curved and stretched like sharpened talons laying claim to the area.  Vines and roots run entwined along the ground, some of them stained dark with a reddish-black hue resembling that of twisted veins.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: Huge bear tracks weave through the forested area, leaving a wake of broken twigs and smashed shrubbery behind them.  A faint stench of decay permeates the area.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: The ground is a tangled mess of overgrown vines and other foliage, completely concealing the dirt with an interwoven layer of greenery.  The withering remains of a small rabbit rests within the shadow of a huge dark green bush.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: The indistinct echo of whispering voices carries through the area, seeming to originate in many directions all at once.  Gloomy columns of mist drift about, slowly twisting and reshaping in the slightest of breeze.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: The canopy of trees above is unyielding in both scope and lushness, the branches thick and far reaching while the leaves are abnormally large and vigorous.  Having clawed up from the ground, a mesh of roots has coiled outward to ensnare the body of a deer, which lies motionless and quiet.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: Very little light penetrates the green canopy overhead, and what few bits of illumination are allowed in only serve to cloud the area in a murky gloom.  A small slab of rusted metal juts up from the ground, almost swallowed up completely by dirt and foliage.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: Ominous rustling echoes from deep within the shadows tucked amongst the large trees.  Branches occasionally sway, stirred by an unfelt wind.  The forlorn whimpering of a dying animal can be heard faintly beyond the dark of the woods.

title: [Red Forest, Inner Weald]
description: An empty nest lies silent in a small crook where an elongated branch juts out from a bent tree.  Far below the branch stretches a rose bramble with sharpened thorns opening upward like a toothy maw.  Impaled upon several of the thorns are the lifeless bodies of small birds.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: A compact half-sphere of thick trees circles outward to eventually peel away and reveal the broken and scattered remnants of what appears to have once been a village.  Some wooden buildings remain intact with little overgrowth, while others have been left in useless piles of rubble, smashed or scorched.   Intermittent flecks of silver or golden light can be seen within the hazy mist that saturates the edge of the woods.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: Flat bone fragments have been bonded together and shaped into uneven stepping stones, which winds around a dilapidated stone statue and then leads further into the ruined settlement.  Lining the walkway of bones are a few ramshackle homes, where withered black flowers seem meticulously planted along window sills.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: The ancient ground here holds an almost ruddy hue, as if copious amounts of blood once stained the dirt and time itself could not fully cleanse it.  A withering field stretches along the eastern outskirts of the village, enclosed by broken segments of bones fashioned together to resemble a macabre fence.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: Verdant greenish-black hedges border a weathered path leading up to a two-story wooden edifice, which despite its worn down appearance, is relatively intact.  Just outside the building, a tall rusted sconce stands sentinel, its lit silvery-blue flame casting a sea of dancing shadows along a battered wooden door.

title: [Red Forest, Abandoned Home]
description: The interior of the building is an eerie specter of what it once might have been.  The walls are splashed with age-old stains and almost every piece of furniture lies broken and in ruin.  The only furnishing of real consequence is a long wooden dining table that holds a tarnished silver tray with several smashed tea cups.  A rickety wooden stairway leads up to a second floor.

title: [Red Forest, Abandoned Home]
description: The hallway ends abruptly as half of the ceiling has collapsed on the eastern side, piles of rubble opening up a view of the mist-shrouded dark forest beyond.  One wall hosts a few old wooden frames, each one missing the original portrait inside.  In their place, small child-like sketches have been scratched into the wall within the empty frames.  At the end of the hall is an open doorway with rusty broken hinges.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: Scattered bloodstained stones and flattened bones twist in a ghoulish mosaic along the ground, stretching out in a wide circle around a tall scorched tree.  The charred branches of the old oak spread out like shadowy latticework, the wooden limbs resembling sharp, gnarled fingers.  A few patches of brown grass jut out from some cracks within the grisly cobblestone ground, their slender tips speckled with dried blood.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: Near the edge of the village, a series of wooden homes now lie in ruin, reduced to useless rubble.  The vegetation of the misty forest beyond has long ago encroached upon the area, with vines and brush growing wild among the debris of the crumbled structures.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: A timeworn pavilion is centered in the middle of the area, the hide of the tent reduced to shredded remnants barely resembling much of a structure at all.  Old clay pots lay in a pile near the tent, many of them broken and their discolored fragments scattered about.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: Perhaps once a trading hub, the area here is littered with a wooden graveyard full of half-standing wooden stalls and the scattered wreckage of wagons and carts.  Along much of the wooden debris, old bloodstains still cling to the jagged pieces strewn about.  Nestled below the canopy of a small tree is a short wooden table, seemingly freshly painted and holding piles of rotting fruit and food.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: The dirt here is stained with a dark ruddy hue.  Small footprints leave a few trails and circles in the ground, but it appears whatever once blemished the ground happened long ago, the color of the earth having never returned to normal.  An old wooden wagon rests along the side of a dilapidated building, its wheels and sides overgrown with brush.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: A slow churning wall of ethereal mist swells along a stretch of the town, with the dark, indistinct silhouettes of buildings obscured beyond.  The scorched frames of wooden wagons lay undisturbed in the ground, relatively close together, as if positioned in some grim display of art.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: Small child-sized footprints weave in and out along the dirt around this part of the village.  Rising up in the center of the small open square is an old stone well that has crumbled in on one side, where a weathered bucket sits half-filled with black sludge.

title: [Red Forest, Derelict Village]
description: At the furthest edge of the village, a small field spreads out in an almost spherical shape.  The field is primarily matted dirt with patches of brownish-yellow grass sprouting here and there.  Some crude wooden pens sit empty in a row behind a weathered old outhouse.  Beyond the stretch of the field, a great wall of trees rises up as ancient oak sentinels.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: Rows upon rows of oak trees, towering just around twenty feet tall, expand along the stretch of land here.  The trees are oddly all bent, as if a powerful wind or force has pulled them inward, demanding their reverence.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: A blanket of crushed foliage spreads out underfoot, creating a large arena of snapped branches, broken sticks, and rotting stumps.  The ground is broken in some places, with clusters of dark roots pulled up from the earth and curled over, some withered and crumbling.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: Medium-sized craters dot the patchy ground while fragments of trees and branches are wildly strewn about.  Entire sections of the forest seem untouched in some areas, but each cluster of trees are bent low, their branches and leaves nearly brushing the ground, silent and subservient.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: Along the deep forest here, entire trees have been torn in half, while others are covered in huge gashes.  One cluster of trees has had their bark completely peeled off.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: The trees scattered around the open forest all reach to the sky in unnaturally even heights.  The carcass of a deer has been skewered by a large sharp branch as small rivulets of blood steadily drip from the corpse, coating a series of roots unearthed in the dirt below.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: A field of snapped and splintered branches spreads out in every direction like a wooden necropolis.  Huge circular tracks leave giant impressions along the cluttered ground.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: A masterfully woven tapestry of barbed vines extends between two oak sentinels like viridian latticework, where countless small woodland animals have been ensnared in their prickly embrace.  Small, razor-sharp thorns cradle each creature in an organic iron maiden, while blood slowly oozes from the tiny corpses and coats a network of gnarled roots below.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: A field of hollow stumps and broken trees litters the ground for miles, expanding out in a huge foliage wasteland.  Giant misshapen footprints can be seen along the dirt, some of their deep pits holding pools of stagnant water.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: A large tree has been ripped in half, its toppled branches and leaves still faintly rustling, as if gasping for life.  Splotches of black ichor stain the ground in large pools of shadow.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: An organic enclosure of flattened vines spirals up like a barbed shield, their edges encircling a cluster of oak trees, providing shelter from wind.  A myriad of twisted roots rises up out of the ground, resembling knobby fingers, before burrowing back into the dirt nearby.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: A path of broken trees and crumbled logs bends along the wooded area as if some immense force savagely tore through this stretch of land.  A haphazard layer of snapped branches and smashed, nearly powdered strips of bark hug the ground.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: The uneven ground is blanketed by wild undergrowth, with a disarray of dense shrubs and fern bending up as if in silent worship of the great towering oaks around them.  A thick canopy of vines overhead connects many of the trees, weaving among the tops of the huge branched sentinels.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: The ground is carpeted by a wide swathe of lush green foliage, the area consisting of countless small paths winding in and out of the dense woods.  Wildflowers border some of the trails, while thick patches of lichen hug the base of countless trees.

title: [Red Forest, Deep Woods]
description: The forest opens up into a large clearing with jagged stumps cluttering the landscape in every which way.  In the midst of the field of remnants, two large oak trees rise up above thirty feet tall, their huge branches extending out to properly display their dominance.  Each branch of the trees hold a razor-sharp edge reminiscent of claws stained with murky ichor.

title: [Red Forest, Abandoned Home]
description: The room is small and the ceiling is slanted just slightly as it stretches towards a tiny, shattered window.  In one corner sits a diminutive makeshift crib crafted out of yellowed sharp teeth and broken shards of glass, with a stained headless doll laying inside.  Upon a warped wooden nightstand rests a small metal-based crystal snowglobe, the water inside long ago going brownish-black, obscuring whatever miniature was within.

title: [Gingie's General Store]
[Gingie's Armory]
[Gingie's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by celadon marble walls, the shop features a handblown double-heart bottle in the center of its black marble floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the vaulted ceiling.  Right near the front is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and an etched brass bin.

title: [Helden Hall, Rabekka's Room]
description: As you enter the room, the first thing that strikes you is the obvious femininity of the surroundings.  Beneath the lace-curtained windows rests a white wrought iron daybed.  On a small table next to the bed sits a lamp and a bowl of chocolates.  In the corner you see a vanity and mirror.  A polar bear rug stretches across the room to a white marble fireplace with an engraved gold plaque hanging over it.  Scattered throughout the room are many trinkets and mementos.

title: [Helden Hall, Metadi's Room]
description: To this room of pale, aged oak, warriors who've fought in lands near and afar have turned here between wars to hone their blades, heal themselves, and prepare for that to come.  Near the door stands an ash armor rack and a haon map cabinet marked with a gryphon.  A fel bureau and desk rest opposite a large oaken bed piled high with blankets.  One wall holds a marble bookcase, and the other, a noble tapestry.  Some cat fur lies on a pillow and two bowls occupy a corner.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Salt, rust, and grime cover most of the portside wall's solitary porthole, although one spot has been smudged to relative cleanness to allow a small band of light to filter into the dusty companionway.  Rags litter the deck just beneath the porthole, some blackened with tar that has hardened to thumb-sized nodules.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Helden, 2nd Floor Corridor]
description: This passage is slightly narrower than the one just below, with stairs that continue up while the passage heads south and east.  A slight breeze seems to be coming from upstairs, causing the torch on the wall to flicker dangerously low.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, up, down

title: [Gryphonwind Ventures]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a faded treasure map hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls.  A wide knotted oak counter sits in one corner while some puffed raw silk pillows rests on the mahogany floor.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Moist air laden with a mixture of rust, rot, and salt fills this section of the companionway.  A wide brush slathered with pitch lies on the floor next to a bucket of glossy black tar.  The ends of tar-soaked strips of oakum protrude from the hull where they have been crammed between planks, while even more gaps remain to be caulked.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Crew Quarters]
description: Several hammocks hang from rusted hooks in the overhead beams, their sides collasped to allow for free movement between the large framing posts.  Each post bears marks of mistreatment, from deep cuts that have taken out sections of wood to ragged claw slashes down the sides.  Deep marks also mar the aft bulkhead where a series of charcoal hashmarks decorate the tar-caulked surface.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Helden, Lady Kythyn's Repose]
description: Paneled in sheets of mithril alloy, this room is of such large proportions only a giant could find it cozy.  One wall is dominated by three immense portraits, with a plaque below.  Against the opposite wall you see a simple executioner's axe lying cradled upon a shrine to Leya.  A wingback chair and footstool scaled to accommodate a gigantic frame sit beside a heavy alloy tower shield supported by three axes turned blade down.

title: [Helden Hall, Oramac's Room]
description: A large assortment of tapestries depicting ancient battles adorn the walls of this magnificent room.  A large bed stands in the middle of the room, covered with animal furs from around the realm.  In one corner is an exquisite desk made of the finest teak wood and fitted with obsidian latches, and in the other is a stone column covered in wood.  On the wall is mounted a rather well-used falchion with an engraved plaque below it.

title: [Helden Hall, Sean2's Room]
description: This room is somewhat stark in its simplicity.  The furniture is well-made yet strictly functional, reflecting an owner with an appreciation for fine craftsmanship.  Along the upper walls are various trophy heads, including one rather startled-looking cave troll.  The room is neat and orderly, with just a few personal touches to indicate that someone actually lives here.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Steeped in the pale glow of wisps of light clustering around several low-hanging drapery stalactites, the broad space is peppered with long rows of small dog-tooth stalagmites that pop up from the ground.  The maw-like divisions span between the edge of the cavern and a huge wooden palisade wall.  Settled near the palisade is an unnaturally flat boulder partially encircled by a trio of red velvet couches.  Riddled with the scent of death and decay, the air is crisp and cool.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Crew Quarters]
description: Rusted iron hooks are set into the deckbeams overhead to support stained canvas hammocks.  Open hammocks trailing tattered blankets fill the portside bulkhead, effectively blocking the three brass portholes that are bolted closed.  Rat-infested heaps of filthy cloth occupy two of the room's corners and contribute to the foul odor filling the large space.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Kuhayla's General Store]
description: Beneath a domed white stucco ceiling, a trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs on one of the rough white stucco walls.  A set of carved felwood shelves and a Vornavian silk-lined display case sit in opposite corners while a plush black bear fur rug rests on a white limestone floor.

title: [Helden, Anduril Family]
description: A huge fireplace takes up one wall of this room, and its blazing fire offers welcome warmth and light.  Three overstuffed chairs are arranged across from the hearth, under a cracked plaster ceiling.  The chairs are covered with ale-stained thrak hides but look comfortable nonetheless.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Slender wisps of light stream through the air between a tall, somewhat insubstantial wooden palisade and the heavily angled cavern wall.  Several of the glowing motes hover near the tips of various stalactites, as if drawn to them.  Central to the view is a large, rectangular platform topped with a variety of trees.

Slender wisps of light stream through the air between a tall, wooden palisade and the heavily angled cavern wall.  Several of the glowing motes hover near the tips of various stalactites, as if drawn to them.  Central to the view is a large, rectangular platform topped with a variety of trees.

title: [Underground Cavern, Mud Flats]
description: Splotches of dark-colored liquid slowly stream out from beneath both a tall tree-topped platform and a tall wooden palisade, converging into a profusion of mud that takes up residence here.  Couched in darkness, only the faint light of spectral-like threads floating in the air in the distance, and the occasional specter passing by on the other side of the palisade, provides a hint of illumination.

Couched in darkness, only the faint light of spectral-like threads floating in the air in the distance, and the occasional specter passing by on the other side of the palisade provides a hint of illumination.

title: [Helden Hall, Myrddinn's Room]
description: A large golden fire provides light for this armory, and each wall is covered with weapons and armor, the variety of which you've never seen before.  On the nearest wall hangs an immense claidhmore, slightly bloodstained and inscribed with the word "Deathbringer".  Below it stands a small shrine and offering plate dedicated to the war god Kai.

title: [Kuhayla's General Store]
description: Beneath a domed white stucco ceiling, a curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the rough white stucco walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a fishscale blue mermaid figurine rests on a white limestone floor.

title: [Helden Hall, Corridor]
description: You walk along this torchlit corridor, climbing a few steps at regular intervals.  At the end of the passageway you look back, and realize you must be in the northwest tower.  There are two doors in this corrider.  A plain wooden door is distinguished by fine workmanship and a beautiful finish enhancing the pattern of the grain.  Further down the corrider is a black glaes door, gleaming from regular polishing.

title: [Helden Hall, Yarx's Room]
description: This room radiates a warm and inviting atmosphere, a mood which is helped by the fire glowing in the large stone fireplace set in the middle of the far wall.  In front of the fireplace basks a large panther skin rug, its black surface shining in the firelight.  Across the polished oak floor is an extremely cluttered desk.  Next to the desk rests a large mahogany bed.

title: [Passion and Gunderin's Solar]
description: Glancing around this vast room, you see a huge dragon-shaped brazier to your right -- clearly the source of the warmth that envelops you.  A thick fur rug in the center of the hardwood floor looks so inviting that you are tempted to bend down just to feel its softness.  A soft leather sofa with oversized cushions and down-filled pillows stands next to the wooden door leading out, completing an invitation for you to relax.

title: [Kuhayla's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the limestone floor is interrupted by a well-armed stocky warrior statue.  Halfway to the white stucco ceiling, a fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs on one of the rough white stucco walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table and a set of carved felwood shelves are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Artiminus' Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by polished oak walls, the shop features a scaled model of Hearthstone in the center of its oak floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the golden oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a jewel-inlaid caddy and a gilded maple cabinet.

title: [Helden Hall, Eastern Passage]
description: This passage dead ends at a sturdy oaken door.  Looking closely at the door shows a handsome carving engraved upon it, featuring a longship with two fearsome conquerors standing at the helm.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Mess Hall]
description: Grime-covered portholes allow a modicum of light to sift in, revealing a fine haze of dust that drifts down through cracks in the warped deck overhead.  Wrought iron chains, each ending in black metal lanterns, dangle from exposed oaken beams over a long table that is bolted to the deck.  Flanking the table are two rough benches heavily scarred with claw marks.  Scattered upon every surface are half-eaten, moldy chunks of bread, fish, and eel.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Femea's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Hevalt's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Helden Hall, Antechamber]
description: The door leads into a pristine white chamber.  The overwhelming whiteness of the room reminds you of the glaciers on top of Glatoph mountain, and the snowshoes in the corner reinforce the feeling of being in a snow-covered chalet.  The grey stone floor is covered by a huge pure white bearskin rug.  A large stone hearth takes up nearly one wall and a narrow window lets in a muted light along with the scent of brine from the bay.  A small circular staircase leads up into the bedchamber.

title: [Helden Hall, Rooftop]
description: The view from the top of the castle is breathtaking.  As you step out onto the half-enclosed roof, you get the feeling of being on top of the world.  A Wehnimer's flag flutters in the breeze atop the east towers, and a large cannon stands at the ready, its barrel pointed toward the sea.  A large wooden tub sits in the center of the rooftop, filled to the brim with bubbling water.  Obviously the guards who man this post enjoy their comfort during peaceful times.

title: [Kalros's Weaponry]
description: A fringed crimson silk banner hangs on one of the refurbished driftwood walls, and a domed white stucco ceiling rises overhead.  A woven Vornavian silk rug sits in one corner of a varnished dark oak floor.  There is a plain wooden table on one side of the shop and a slender driftwood counter on the other.

title: [Hevalt's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [The Library]
description: Well lit and starkly furninshed, this room appears to be the perfect place to study in peace.  A single rectangular table, surrounded by plain looking chairs, sits perfectly in the middle of the room, while a giant glowing orb hangs from the ceiling, providing ample illumination.  The only other fixtures are a small storage cabinet and a single bookshelf that is populated with some light reading material.

title: [Dannyia's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A cedar and oak footlocker sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Crystalwood]
description: Dappled sunlight spills through the verdant leaves shading this quiet alcove, creating a kaleidoscope of shadow on the rough-hewn floor.  Tucked in between slender branches and gnarled knots, partially obscured by the pale blush pink blossoms of a climbing bougainvillea, several wooden shelves seem to almost grow out of the rosewood tree itself.  Near a rustic arched arbor laden with vividly colorful flora, a pair of woven palm frond baskets, one on either side of a simple rope ladder leading up to a raised platform, hangs from a sturdy limb and sways softly in a gentle breeze.

title: [Tolwynn's Treasures, Wanton]
description: Beneath a stormy grey marble ceiling, a panoramic war mural spans the entire length of the room's circular walls. Some curvaceous female warrior statuary rings the edge of the room, their oversized weapons braced against the crimson marble floor.  Flanking the entrance at facing angles are a stout iron weapon rack and a sturdy iron armor stand.

title: [Helden Hall, Hot Tub]
description: The hot water feels soothing against your skin as you enter the tub.  The bubbles surround your body, and you feel your troubles and worries melting away.  Your muscles begin to relax as you let yourself slide deeper still into the hot bubbly water.

title: [Femea's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Cosannie's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by glossy mistwood walls, the shop features a dusky blue cotton rug in the center of its plank floor.  A midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs under the beam ceiling.  Right near the front is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a glass-topped mistwood counter.

title: [Helden Hall, Mews]
description: Cool and slightly damp, the room is sparsely furnished.  Oil lamps hanging from brass wall-hooks compliment a small, sturdy table currently littered with scraps of leather and various leatherworking tools.  A large oak chest stands open on the floor next to the table.  Two square holes penetrate the wall opposite the door, a modwir T-perch placed within six feet of each one.

title: [Femea's Outfitting]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Oaken Room, Southern Corridor]
description: This southern corridor dead ends with a circular room made entirely of oak with three north facing doors.  Standing eight feet tall, a petrified oak door is flanked by an ironbound and an oak door.  Rough-hewn oaken walls surround you, each prominently displaying different types of well-used weapons ranging from claidhmores to falchions and halberds.

title: [Cleffknoat's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A bamboo rack and a vine-carved mahogany table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Helden Hall, Welan's Room]
description: The stone mortar and heavy woodwork of this large comfortable room gives the place a rustic feel.  Across from a large fireplace is a spacious bed that is covered with warm bearskins.  A tall, narrow window is set in the center of the opposite wall.  From somewhere in the darkness a gleam catches your eye and you turn to regard a miniature dragon which rests upon a small shelf.

title: [Helden Hall, Jehannum's Chamber]
description: The smell of incense hangs heavy in this smoky room, and scattered candles provide a dim flickering light.  Ash shelves flank a stone fireplace centered in the left wall, and a hammock is set up to the right.  A polished oak desk dominates the center of the room, and a glass display case stands just inside the door on the left.  In the far wall, two narrow windows running from floor to ceiling allow very little light in, but provide a bird's eye view of the streets below.

title: [Helden Hall, Dark Hallway]
description: The hallway appears to be a dead end.  There is almost no light here and the air smells of mold and rust.

title: [Helden Hall, Used Supplies]
description: Guttering torches flank a long, oak table which almost fills the entire room.  An arched doorway set in the stone wall behind the table leads into a darkened chamber lined with barely visible shelves.  An aria of snores and wheezes can be heard coming from the chamber.

title: [Helden Hall, Cavernous Corridor]
description: The light from the crystals to the east easily illuminate this cavernous corridor, displaying the roughly hewn walls of stone and a large boulder seemingly pushed up against the southern wall.  A small trickle of water from the stream to the east moves to the west, hinting at the subtle sloping of this corridor.

title: [Kalros's General Store]
description: Enclosed by refurbished driftwood walls, the shop features a woven Vornavian silk rug in the center of its dark oak floor.  A burnished blue steel shield hangs under the light oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a plain wooden table and a slender driftwood counter.

title: [Kalros's General Store]
description: Refurbished driftwood walls rise from a varnished dark oak floor.  Just above a woven Vornavian silk rug hangs a snarling war griffin painting, and a dark and light oak ceiling completes the picture.  A plain wooden table and a slender driftwood counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [House of Thorns, Atelier]
description: The polished surface of an ivory and rose quartz floor softly reflects the figure of a vaalin-traced ivory maiden statue, a central focal point to a long silver and glass semicircular display near the back of the room.  Lining wainscoted blush-painted walls is a series of full body dress mannequins set in poses that mimic those in an elaborate woven silk tapestry.  The sky motif in a dark walnut box beam ceiling lends a feeling of openness to the room.

title: [Helden Hall, Hallway]
description: Your footsteps echo on the stone floor as you walk along this hallway.  The north end stops at a large inscribed archway.  Torchlight flickers, causing the words inscribed on the stone to glow eerily.

title: [Crystalwood, Canopy]
description: Nestled among the boughs of the ancient rosewood and extending out over the alcove below, this circular platform serves as a quiet workroom removed from common distractions.  A sturdy railing with a deep ledge, wound through with climbing vines heavy with fragrant flowers, surrounds the space, a small gap where a simple rope ladder hangs down the only break in the protection it affords.  Thin, woven grass mats line the plank floor, and a large dip in a branch stretching out from the tree's trunk forms a passably comfortable seat.

title: [Underground Cavern, Cave Pools]
description: Nestled in the cavern wall, the expansive niche is burgeoning with a variety of cave pools, some a pale crystal blue hue, others deep sapphire, and just one a distinctive inky black.  An aven in the high ceiling above leads only to darkness, producing the effect of a vacuous hole above you.  Intermittent dripping sounds provide a staccato rhythm to the soft, constant chorus of sighs that echoes through the area.

title: [Helden Hall, War Room]
description: Every known book on history and warfare lines the walls of this huge room dedicated to learning.  Large oaken boards hold reduced-scale reproductions of great battles fought throughout history.  Ladders stretch to the ceiling as members attempt to gain every bit of knowledge held within the floor-to-ceiling bookcases.  Deep blue comfortable chairs are strategically placed about the room for reading, as well as for learning tactics through the manipulation of miniatures as they fight the battles over again.

title: [Boora's Outfitting]
[Boora's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath an ebonwood beam ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the celadon marble walls.  An oval-shaped speckled marble counter and an etched brass bin sit in opposite corners while a bronzed drake sculpture rests on a speckled black marble floor.

title: [Savina's Weaponry]
[Savina's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A series of low oak shelves and a plain wooden table sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Dannyia's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A cedar and oak footlocker sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Dannyia's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A cedar and oak footlocker sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Hanging down from the ceiling of a voluminous cavern are massive stalactites matched by equally sizeable salagmites that thrust up out of the ground.  Faintly glowing strands of light bob and weave through the air in lazy, meandering paths.  Flowing along from east to west, a fairly sizeable palisade wall blocks any view further into the central part of the cavern.  Oddly, the wall is somewhat insubstantial, as if it only partially exists in this time and place.

Faintly glowing strands of light bob and weave through the air in lazy, meandering paths.  Flowing along from east to west, a fairly sizeable palisade wall blocks any view further into the central part of the cavern.

title: [Helden Hall, Bedchamber]
description: As you enter this room, the first thing you notice is that it is incredibly plain.  The walls are adorned with only a painting, an old sabre, and an old stone fireplace.  Sitting in the middle of the room is an oak table surrounded by four chairs.  The most elaborate piece of furniture by far is the bed pushed into one corner.  It looks quite comfortable and well used.  Its posts are made of an unidentifiable wood that seems to have an unnatural sheen.

title: [Helden Hall, Brewery]
description: The smells of hops and honeyed brew tantalize your senses, making your mouth water in anticipation.  A small gnomish brewer draped in a huge apron anxiously bustles about checking the fermenting brew.  Large fermenting vats take up most of the room and strange vials and testing containers cover the large table, while sacks of grain and small kegs of finished brew occupy a corner.  The size of the vats attests to the thirst of the occupants of this house.

title: [Woody Nook]
description: A broad angle of limb forms a natural perch in the lower reaches of the beech's crown, though the ground is still an alarming distance below.  Yet, with its smooth bark, stately posture and oval leaves like soft green eyes, there is an air of comfort in the tree, as though being cradled in the strong arms of a friendly giant.

title: [Fleurs' Glowing Goods, Entry]
description: Enclosed by polished oak walls, the shop features a subtle arrangement of fragrant pink stargazer lilies accented by tiny white iceblossoms in the center of its oak floor.  A painted silk wall panel hangs under the golden oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a lacquered white rosewood cabinet.

title: [Leafy Crook]
description: The beech's dense canopy parts uncharacteristically above this slim elbow of branch to create a leaf-fringed opening to the sky. title: [Black River, Convergence]
description: The icy cold, inky black water is quick-moving on top but feels sluggish underneath, bringing a langorous chill to your bones. Sending you careening about, the current swirls in two different directions, one continuing upstream, the other branching off to one side, where a pale glow emanates from below the water, the outline of a grate vaguely visible in the otherwise nearly pitch black.

title: [Black River, Pool]

Suffusing shifting areas of the otherwise inky black water, a glowing grate and the dim, undulating luminesence of tiny black, sinuous shapes swarming around in the water illuminates your immediate vicinity.  A small ledge juts out from slick walls rising up in every direction.

A wind chime crafted from twigs, seashells, and bits of twine hangs in the open doorway.  Tucked into one corner is a triangular shelf with a woven banana leaf basket swinging below it.

description: Grime-covered portholes allow a modicum of light to sift in, revealing a fine haze of dust that drifts down through cracks in the warped deck overhead.  Wrought iron chains, each ending in black metal lanterns, dangle from exposed oaken beams over a long table that is bolted to the deck.  Flanking the table are two rough benches heavily scarred with claw marks.  Scattered upon every surface are half-eaten, moldy chunks of bread, fish, and eel.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Iyo Village, Fire Pit]
description: Scattered in all directions, open-faced huts surround this central clearing, which obviously serves as a gathering spot that is not completely choked with foliage and growth.  A large fire pit dominates the area, charred wood composing its innards.  Several short lines of faint red dirt radiate outward from the fire pit to the edge of the area.  Through the green ferns and tall jungle trees, the low clicks and whispering of hidden villagers is audible, and thin shafts of sunlight stream through from above.

paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Iyo Village, Hut]
description: Crafted with one back wall, which is covered with a brilliantly colored wall hanging, the hut is otherwise exposed to the elements on all other sides.  A hive-like roof of tightly bound palm fronds provides overhead protection, while the floor is merely packed dirt and mud.  Settled in the center of the floor is a crude metal casting device, and several molds lie on the ground next to it.  Several woven baskets filled with copper bracelets, necklaces, and belts are lined up against the hut's wall.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: A wooden signpost, topped with a carved monir owl and leaning to one side, marks the transition of a narrow footpath to a rutted, dirt lane dotted with small houses and buildings on the north side.  In one yard, overgrown, prickly bushes flank the entrance to a thatched-roof shop constructed of dark grey stone.  An empty cart with a broken wheel is parked next to a deserted roadside stand.

title: [Reim Settlement, Alchemist]
description: A long oak worktable, littered with crumpled parchments and empty flasks, sits beside an empty bookshelf, its contents strewn across the dusty floor planks.  On the opposite soot-darkened stone wall, a large cauldron, empty except for some shriveled spiders long dead, hangs in an unlit fireplace laid with a stack of dried wood.  Beneath a glaes-paned window sits a hefty faewood chest carved with strange symbols and wrapped with heavy, padlocked chains.

title: [Artiminus' Outfitting]
description: Mahogany paneled walls rise from a polished oak floor.  Just above a pile of striped throw pillows hangs a portrait of Darkstone Castle, and a glossy modwir plank ceiling completes the picture.  A jewel-inlaid caddy and a gilded maple table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Ondreian's Outfitting]
description: A rainbow colored flag hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of striped throw pillows sits in one corner of a dappled celadon marble floor.  There is a jewel-inlaid caddy on one side of the shop and an oval-shaped speckled marble counter on the other.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: A bucket attached to a frayed rope sits on a low stone well in the middle of this corner of the village square.  Carefully laid cobblestones run north and east past small shops.  A glimpse of a bazaar can be spied through the gap between two empty houses, their fronts identical but for the color of the doors.

title: [Iyo Village, Hut]
description: Layers upon layers of black-painted palm fronds create a sheltering roof, while thick tree trunks rising up out of the ground provide support.  One side of the hut is a solid wall, constructed of close-set bamboo poles and splattered with dried-up fruit, while the other sides are without walls.  The mud-packed floor is dug out in areas, where the holes are filled with the charred remains of small cooking fires, likely the cause of the smoky scent filling the air.

title: [Iyo Village, Hut]
description: Several long rectangular swatches of green cloth are fully laid out along the ground and covered in a layer of muddy tracks.  Overhead, the hive-shaped roof is crafted of palm fronds thickly matted together, though several have come loose from their binding and drape down from the ceiling.  Spreading out from the open hut, dense jungle sprouts up in most directions, though other huts are clearly visible through the foliage.

title: [Iyo Village, Fern Outskirts]
description: Crowded around a muddy path, thin and tall trees rise up through of layers of ferns and into the overhead cover of thick vines and greenery.  Stray beams of sunlight permeate the cover, allowing filtered light to soak the jungle growth with life.  Laden with humidity, the air is alive with the sounds of insects, birds, and the occasional clicking of voices coming from beyond the nearby open-faced hut.
