paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Iyo Village, Bamboo Forest]
description: Moist heat descends down in thick waves.  Countless bamboo stalks and large growths of foliage wall off the dense jungle to one side of a barely visible pathway of footprints cutting across the jungle.  On the other side of the path, several browned figures move in and out of open-faced huts, though a thin draping of ferns, which hangs down from several taller trees, blocks any clear view.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Empty stalls, vacated booths, and unfilled vegetable stands line both sides of the lane outside the plaza, remnants of a once-grand bazaar.  Laying in the middle of the cobblestones is a painted tin can next to a pair of forgotten sticks.  Carts and wagons, with no beasts to pull them, are parked in an open, grassy patch to the south.

title: [Myharl's Office]
description: The broad sweep of the celadon marble floor is interrupted by an ornate bottled ship.  Halfway to the modwir plank ceiling, an elaborate glowbark-framed portrait hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  A book-laden wyrwood-inlaid desk with a brass-framed glowing white orb on one side is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Gryphonwind Ventures, Vault]
description: Blue watered silk walls rise from an enameled hardwood floor.  Just above a pile of striped throw pillows hangs a pearl-handled filigreed mandolin, and a mosaic tiled ceiling completes the picture.  A wide knotted oak counter and a bamboo rack stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Multicolored cobblestones spiral out from an impressive stone fountain in the center of the plaza, the effect a dizzying array of colors from expert craftsmanship.  Snow-capped mountain peaks to the north create a picturesque backdrop for the lifelike statues surrounding the font's basin.  In each corner, tables and chairs are grouped together beneath green-striped white canopy umbrellas.

title: [Iyo Village, Star Apple Haven]
description: Scattered fruits lay across a smattering of footprint paths that lead in several directions.  Petite amongst the taller trees, several star apple trees drape over the path, their branches the obvious culprit for the spilled fruit.  Crawling with scurrying red and black assassin bugs, one muddy path leads to an open-faced hut, while other paths wander off in other directions through green jungle.

title: [Iyo Village, Aracari's View]
description: Settled high up on a trumpet tree's branches, the occasionally present aracari picks at his ebony feathers, simultaneously showing off his brilliant yellowed chest striped over once with a collar of crimson.  Green jungle closes in from all sides, save for the cleared area to one direction, where an open-faced hut is readily visible.  Rough, muddy paths of scattered footprints lead in several directions, and humidity sits in the air, obviously a comfortable friend of the jungle.

description: The jungle here is cleared away slightly, allowing for several shafts of sunlight to hit the muddy path.  Tufts of moss float just overhead, their loose lengths trailing down, though they fail to obscure the small hut in one direction.  Several large blooms of pink spring up around the base of one particularly thick and twisted twin-leaved rose tamarind covered in a mass of crawling red ants.

title: [Iyo Village, Hut]
description: The open-faced hut, which is topped with palm fronds, is home to a floor of thickly packed mud.  A series of thick, woven cloths, each dyed a deep green akin to the color of the surrounding jungle, are scattered across the floor in heaping piles, partially covering a series of white and red painted sigils.  Crawling along the cloth rolls at a quick pace, a thin line of red ants makes its way from one side of the hut to the other.

title: [Tolwynn's Treasures, Lust]
description: Beneath an arching dark mahogany ceiling, some gracefully posed caryatid columns stand braced against the silk-draped green marble walls, lending the room the air of a temple.  A resplendent jade Ivas statue stands central upon a tessellated green wisp-tiled floor, furthering the appearance.  An oversized glaes display case is positioned as altar, surrounded by some exquiste white jade mannequins posed in the midst of a variety of lascivious acts.

title: [Tolwynn's Treasures, Avarice]
description: A hole blown through a section of airship hull forms the entrance to this room, opening onto a scene of plunder.  A gem-inlaid black glaes ceiling evokes a starlit sky, complemented by the polished dusky glaesine walls.  Some scattered treasure chests rest upon a lushly green carpeted floor, surrounded by some voluptuous female pirate statuary.  In the center of them all stands a scantily clad pirate queen mannequin, positioned to leer at all who enter.

title: [Cosannie's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a mistwood beam ceiling, a portrait of Darkstone Castle hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a glass-topped mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while a thin gold-edge black runner rests on a mistwood plank floor.

title: [Cosannie's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a mistwood beam ceiling, a sphere-hilted mounted sword plaque hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a glass-topped mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while a thin gold-edge black runner rests on a mistwood plank floor.

title: [Iyo Village, Circle]
description: A path of footprints leads to and from a nearby hut, though they sink deeper and deeper into the path as the mud becomes a bog of water and dirt.  Leaning down from tall trees of light bark, ferns cover the path in green, and more than several have broken off and fallen to the ground.  Shattered vials of bright red litter the sides of the path.

title: [Reim Settlement, Tavern]
description: A dented, brass spittoon is installed at the end of a long oak bar carved with initials and peppered with cigar burns.  Around the taproom, mismatched, wooden chairs are bottom up on scarred tabletops in an uninviting manner.  A silvered glass mirror with a crack running through the middle hangs behind the bar.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Fire damaged buildings line the street next to a chandler's shop, its sign charred and the remains of the roof completely black.  Hardened grey wax spills out of the front door of the shop and on to the cobblestones.  A trail of discarded water buckets lead southwest towards the village well.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Across from a tall stone building with no windows, the forge fires have gone out in a blacksmith's stall.  Rusty horseshoes are nailed above the work shed, and a thick, green scum lines a shallow water trough near the anvil.  Weapons and armor in need of repair are stacked haphazardly in a cart out front.

title: [Iyo Village, Blackened Clearing]
description: With all loose brush pushed to the side, the small clearing is host to a tall metal stake that protrudes from the ground.  The stake itself is blackened, and the ground around it is charred a dark black color, where the grains of dirt have melted together in places.  Encircling this configuration is a ring of bright white sand.  Off to one side, a hut with red-painted walls is just barely visible.

With all loose brush pushed to the side, the small clearing is host to a tall metal stake that protrudes from the ground.  The stake itself is blackened, and the ground around it is charred a dark black color, where the grains of dirt have melted together in places.  Encircling this configuration is a ring of bright white sand, illuminated to a near glow by shafts of moonlight that slice down through the night.  Off to one side, a hut with dark walls is just barely visible in the shadows.

title: [Iyo Village, Painted Hut]
description: Built with walls of bamboo and a roof of palm fronds, the hut's door is oriented to face due south.  Shelves are lined with bottles and jars.  Standing in the center of the hut is a low table, which is littered with ashes, charred bone, and several bowls.  Vivid markings in red, white, and black are painted all around the hut, their alternating linear and nonlinear patterns flowing from the center of the ceiling, down the walls, and then across blood red sand floor.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: An irregularly shaped corral is fashioned from split-rail fencing behind a large stable on the south side of the village square.  The stable doors are wide open, but no animals are seen nearby.  A rusty pitchfork leans against a stranded wheelbarrow in the middle of the yard.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Thick, flowerless vines crawl up the sides of a two-story inn with yellow shutters and a balcony overlooking a plaza to the west.  On the inn's front porch, several chairs huddle together around a small stove in between a pair of spruce-carved doors with peeling green paint.  A tarnished brass bell hangs from a low branch of a lemon tree in the yard.

title: [Cleffknoat's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a gilded maple cabinet sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Cleffknoat's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  An engraved copper bin and an etched brass bin sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Iyo Village, Circle Hut]
description: Sticking up out of deeply dug holes in the ground, several thick tree trunks serve as supports for the palm frond roof.  Spread beneath the ceiling, a thin layer of dirty blue woven cloth covers the floor.  Several pots of clay are scattered along one edge of the hut's floor, though the majority of the hut is laden with what appear to be rusty, slipshod tools for crafting armor and weapons.  The open walls of the hut allow for a clear view of the village.

title: [Iyo Village, Circle]
description: Amidst the humidity, sunlight streams down here due to a partial break overhead in foliage.  The golden light lends extra warmth to the path where the mud is almost entirely dried up into caked dirt.  In one direction, the path leads directly to one of several open-faced huts, while footprints lead to a larger clearing on the other side.

title: [Reim Settlement, Inn]
description: A massive stone fireplace fills the eastern wall behind a long, pine-topped desk stacked with moldering texts and ledgers.  Overhead, a tiered chandelier of horns in all shapes and sizes is suspended above a wide staircase leading up to the second floor.  One corner of a bearskin rug has been thrown back revealing a dark hole in the floor.

title: [Iyo Village, Circle]
description: Especially slushy and slimy, a large pool of mud splays across the path, calling for care in footing.  Huts topped in palm fronds peek out from several directions, with the ever-present wall of jungle looming beyond them.  The surrounding trees bend over the pathway, their spread of branches and green shading the path entirely in shadow.

title: [Iyo Village, Circle Hut]
description: Covered with palm fronds that are strapped together with thick cords of vines, the hive-shaped hut has no true walls, instead supported by several thick tree trunks rising up from holes in the floor to the roof.  The ground is blanketed in woven strips of red-dyed cloth layered one atop another, creating a dry surface.  Stacked haphazardly all over the hut, crudely formed clay pots hold various materials, from dried scalps to hollowed-out skulls.

title: [Iyo Village, Circle]
description: Cleared of immediately surrounding growth, the muddy floor is still rife with new growth, where small spurts of green push up into the world.  Several huts are visible from the path, and the large number of footprints over the path here suggests that, despite the eerie quiet here, it is well-traversed.  To one side of the path, a wooden bowl lays empty, save for several fruit pits sitting at its bottom.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: From a towering gate in the north, rows of houses crowd both sides of a dirt road leading up to the village square.  The cobblestones at this end of the square are a faded yellow, though tiny flecks of gold suggest that it once was a dazzling, golden thoroughfare.  A small garden, filled with a few scraggly bushes and a timeworn stone slab, marks the entrance to the village plaza.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Nestled between shops that line the corner, a tall tower looks out over the village square.  A constant clicking emanates from behind a clockwork face at the top of the tower, although the hands appear to be stuck at three o'clock.  At its base, a small courier's post stands empty, a pile of undelivered messages in a metal bin near the door.

title: [Orenda's General Store]
description: Separated off from the main gallery is a smaller, private workshop, whose dark walnut-stained floor matches the straight beam ceiling above.  Set on the wainscoted walls is a long cork notice board with several order parchments attached.  A pair of rollers from a silver-edged lacquered bolt display have been removed and set on a marble-topped sturdy wooden worktable.  Underneath the worktable sits a series of white ash shoe forms, well-organized compared to the remainder of the room.

title: [House of Thorns, Studio]
description: Accenting the long window on the north wall is a rose brocade silk layered valance that pools down onto an ivory and rose quartz floor.  Along the wainscoted blush-painted walls is a long rosewood strip with a series of polished silver hooks, next to which stands a full-length three-panel mirror.  In the center of the room, just beneath the skylight in a straight beam ceiling, a round two-tiered display table draped with soft linen has been set up.

title: [Iyo Village, Outskirts]
description: A grouping of slightly squared, open-faced huts are just barely visible in one direction, and in the other direction, a path leads into denser parts of the forest.  Just barely audible above the constant, deafening buzzing of the insects is the faint sound of rushing water.  Thin sticks of bamboo have been whittled and laid out across several trees, a series of scalps displayed upon them.

title: [Iyo Village, Outskirts]
description: A grouping of slightly squared, open-faced huts are just barely visible in one direction, and in the other direction, a path leads into denser parts of the forest. title: [Giogionni's Weaponry]
description: An archaic map of the Wolves' Den and some heavy forged iron hooks hang on the darkened stone walls.  A sturdy weapons rack reaches from the worn stone floor to the hewn oak ceiling.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Prickly shrubs camouflage a large hole in one side of a cramped, one-room jail cell with iron bars fitted across the windows.  Cater-cornered to some sturdy, wooden stocks, a rough-hewn oak platform supports a podium hung with a faded banner.  A well-traveled path leads away from the square and into a thick copse of trees at the bottom of a steep hillside.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Spanning the gap between two standing stones on either side of a narrow pass, a towering gate cuts off the road leading out of the village.  A heap of rusty spears are piled next to an empty guard post stationed in the shadow of a steep hillside bestrewn with brushwood and boulders.

title: [Iyo Village, Outskirts]
description: A grouping of slightly squared, open-faced huts are just barely visible in one direction, and in the other direction, a path leads into denser parts of the forest.  Just barely audible above the constant, deafening buzzing of the insects is the faint sound of rushing water.  Thin sticks of bamboo have been whittled and laid out across several trees, two rotted bodies displayed upon them.

title: [Iyo Village, Outskirts]
description: A grouping of slightly squared, open-faced huts are just barely visible in one direction, and in the other direction, a path leads into denser parts of the forest.  Just barely audible above the constant, deafening buzzing of the insects is the faint sound of rushing water.  Thin sticks of bamboo have been whittled and laid out across several trees, a series of teeth on several strands displayed upon them.

title: [House Aspis, Courtyard]
description: Tall bushes perpetually reign in a noble, hushed twilight of their own shading.  Lovers and friends stroll here often, and you are reminded of those who have departed the lands but were much cared for.  The outer wall is breached with a superbly-tooled iron gate, surmounted by a miniature dragon wrought in extraordinary detail.  Set midpath between the outer wall and Aspis itself is a small shrine containing two figures.  A small ora plaque is visible to the right of the entryway.

title: [House Aspis, Garden]
description: Sweeping to the west, this large garden is filled with wonderful scents.  A narrow brick pathway winds around the plants like the coiled tail of a dragon.  Violets, daffodils, daisies, and other colorful flowers rise up from the rich black soil, and a wheelbarrow full of gardening tools and bulbs rests, almost hidden, behind some rose bushes.  Bordering the walls, sunflowers are in full bloom, obscuring the view of the outside world, and in a secluded corner of the garden lies a small marble alcove.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: A short distance from the village square, the trees are thicker and the houses sparse.  A low and sturdy building constructed of rough-hewn oak logs sits on one side of the lane, facing a large warehouse on the other.  A line of carts, stacked high with petrified wood, stretches past an empty grain bin and silo.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: The lane narrows into a footpath overgrown with dry grass at the edge of the village.  To the west, an abandoned, rocky field stretches out behind a crumbling, low stone wall.  The branches of a twisted apple tree, barren of fruit, shelter an overturned plow, the rusted frame hitched to an empty, rotting leather harness.

title: [House Aspis, Garden Trail]
description: A trellised arch of vines and flowers leads people along this trail to and from the cliffs, above the Locksmehr River.  The cries of gulls float on the breeze, along with the salt-smell of the Bay to the north.  The regal silhouette of an outdoor amphitheatre rises to the east.

title: [Den of the Dragon, Amphitheatre]
description: A garden trail leads up and west away from this exquisite open-air amphitheatre, and marble and silverwood terraced benches are broken into thirds by stairs.  Framing the stage is a dragon, its tail curling around the nearby orchestra pit and the spine rising against the backdrop of glistening waters beyond.  A small, velvet-roped walkway leads to elegant pews at the front, protected from the elements by argent tenting.

title: [Den of the Dragon]
description: Some open curtains of heavy, dark green velvet drape the vast stage, and argent tenting protects it and the closest pews from the elements without ruining the view of the rest of the audience.  Globes of ethereal, magical lights hang overhead, beaming their glows in strategic directions controlled by a series of overhead ropes and pulleys that disappear behind the dark, backstage curtains.  A shiny silver plaque adorns the front of a podium to the right of the stage and a walkway leads up and out.

title: [Underground River]
description: The water is fast moving and ice cold, bringing a chill to your bones.  You try but cannot feel the bottom and the current is forcing you to struggle to stay afloat.  It is too dark to make out your immediate surroundings.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: Animal pens fill the yards between stone cottages flanking the passageway to the village square.  Behind one home, a scarecrow in tattered clothing peeks out of an untended garden overgrown with sickly, black carrion flowers.  A pine tree, nearly seventy feet tall, has toppled over and crashed through the thatched roof of one cottage, its tangle of roots and earth blocking part of the lane.

title: [Pitfall Trap]
description: The pit is barren sans carved lengths of sharpened logs stuck into the ground.  The ground is stained with dried blood and other fluids pooling around a pile of impaled suits of armor in the exact center.  A frayed rope dangles into the pit from above, its excess length messily coiled on the barren floor.

title: [Reim Settlement, Village]
description: The lane ends at the entrance to the mill, the grand water-wheel motionless and the stream bed dry and rocky.  Behind it, a screen of grey willow trees loom over a pond, their gnarled branches reaching out to claim the small pools of muddy water scattered across the bottom.  A piece of tattered canvas lies beside a small toy sailboat, run aground near the shore.

title: [Underground Tunnels, Rubble]
description: The surrounding rubble is damp, with little pools of water scattered between and atop various boulders and clusters of rocks, as well as a spattering of dead fish.  Trickles of black water cascade down from above, sourced from the almost invisible flow of a water snaking into a volomnious black void overhead.  Abutting where the water above ostensibly falls in heavy sheets when the void is not present, the wall has eroded away, leaving an opening where the rock has fallen in on itself and now provides egress.

Pounding down from above, a rapidly rushing waterfall falls in heavy sheets, creating a shin-deep turbulent pool of water, large boulders and clusters of rock jutting from below the surface.  Before continuing on its way downstream in a miniature flood, the inky black water fades in color and visual texture to the normalized murk of the Locksmehr River.

Copious patches of luminous moss creep over the walls, the greenish light lending an eerie aura to the tomb.  To one side of the chamber, a wide space is centered with several burial pits.

title: [Ruined Catacombs]
description: Clearly in a state of distintegration, the catacomb's northern bank of tombs has completely crumpled, a veritable cave-in having crushed any skeletal remains.  Filling the other walls are sets of thirty-six shelf tombs, save for the western wall, which instead only has seventeen.  A collection of urns, some intact but most nothing more than broken shards, lie in a jumbled pile beneath the watchful eyes of a statue with the body of a mutilated human and the distorted head of a serpent.  Tinged with the odor of mold and decay, the air here is cold and dry, yet somehow also stuffy.

title: [Reim Settlement, Road]

Worn stone blocks form a makeshift wall to frame the entrance, the pieces chipped and caked with what appears to be dried sanguine-mixed mud.  A heavily dented greathelm leans against the right wall, a flash of yellowed bone hidden beneath the spear-pierced visor.

title: [Reim Settlement, Road]

The dusty path shifts with changes in the wind, covering random strips of fabric and shards of metal that have accumulated along the way.

title: [Underground, Ravine]
description: Steep earthen walls surround you, creating an almost suffocatingly narrow corridor of space.  Filtering down from very high above you, a pinprick of light gives just enough illumination for you to make out and avoid the tangle of sharp rocks spearing out from the sides of the ravine, as well as the hint of a vast cavern stretching up above you.

title: [Underground, Dead End]
description: Colonies of stiptic fungus populate the otherwise dark space, their luminescence the only source of illumination.  Cramped and narrow, the damp earth all around seems to press inward in an inconsiderate manner, its capacious stalactites and stalagmites creating considerable barriers to movement.  Further frustrating the outlook for any appreciable forward or backward progress, there doesn't appear to be any obvious means of egress, save for up a slide-like slope that is far too steep and slick to climb.

wayto.24804: ;e echo '** Please wait.  Waiting for the stain to show up **';line=get until line =~ /dark stains/;fput "get stain";fput "lie" if standing?;line = fput "search" until line =~ /descending slope/;dothistimeout 'go slope', 3, /You gradually make your way down the descending slope/;line = fput "search" until line =~ /opening/;dothistimeout 'go opening', 3, /You duck down low and half-crawl into the opening/;fput "stand" until standing?

description: A half-circle of steel-headed pikes surround each side of a guard encampment, the reinforcements left bloodied as they hang loosely bound by rusted wire.  Hunks of flesh and bone gather swarms of flies behind the barricades, the pieces contained within dented armor decorated with gore-splattered heraldry.  A single large vulture soars high overhead, heading further into the encampment.

title: [Reim Settlement, Road]
description: Overlapping layers of charred foliage lead up to a gypsy camp, the path highlighted by strings of half-melted candles hanging from skeletal black willow trees lining the entrance.  Shields of various shapes lean against the trunks of the willows, painted with dirt-covered sanguine symbols, several of which have been gouged and left incomprehensible.  The distinct sounds of crunching echo down the clay-packed pathway.

title: [Reim Settlement, Gypsy Camp]
description: Occupants of the camp have hung woven lattices of thick bloodied rope that drape from wagons and tree branches, the webwork strung with a variety of hand-carved fetishes.  Feathers, claws, and painted skins dangle along the lengths of hemp, the wards left unscathed despite the blackened ground beneath them.  Wisps of smoke rise high from the south, dancing away on the errant breeze.

title: [Reim Settlement, Road]
description: The scent of hot metal and flesh combines with the dry, dust-filled air to stifling heights, making it difficult to walk down this stretch of road.  Skeletal remains lay half-buried within the blood-soaked mud, weaponry still firmly clutched in flesh-robbed hands.

title: [Reim Settlement, Gypsy Camp]
description: The ashes blowing away from the smoldering cooking fire collect along the blood-soaked stones encircling the center of the camp, covering the rocks in layers of dark soot.  Plates and cups sit untouched against heavily notched logs, the food rotted away or dragged off into the unknown.  Several instruments sit ruined amongst the cutlery, crushed beneath both hoof and foot.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Reim Settlement, Gypsy Camp]
description: Racks of full-faced hides lay caked beneath a mixture of dirt and gore, the pelts' glassy eyes glancing outwards along the perimeter of the camp.  The forehead of each mammal has been anointed with a black-inked symbol, the scent of incensed oil rubbed into the uncombed fur.  Positioned squarely behind the racks is a small marble altar, its surface marred and covered with sanguine streaks.

title: [Reim Settlement, Gypsy Camp]
description: Half a dozen wooden poles have been uprooted from the dry ground, each one tightly knotted with a length of frayed rope.  Attached to the end of the restraints are the remains of various animals, some cleaned of all flesh, while others have been left in lumps of hide and hooves.  A rusted axe sits untouched amongst the dead grass, the outline of its former owner only a few feet away.

title: [Reim Settlement, Gypsy Camp]
description: Lacquered wooden and metal wagons fill the area, their once bright facades now faded from exposure to the harsh elements.  Several vehicles have been ransacked, their belongings tossed out across the narrow stairways, leaving splinters and shreds splayed along the perimeter.  A few wagons remain intact, however, each one dangling an oddly formed talisman above their doorway.

title: [Reim Settlement, Guard Outpost]
description: A small cart of crates leans against the remains of a tall wooden tower, the wares either rotted away or missing from the straw-filled containers.  The riveted tower doors have been barricaded from the outside, the signs of fire damage evident from the scorch marks grasping the windows above.  A reddish-black substance oozes from beneath the entrance, the trails puddling within the deep grooves of boot prints stamped upon the ground.

title: [Reim Settlement, Road]
description: The bare branches of willow trees stretch outward along the road, the appendage-like arms hanging lengths of rope and sinew.  Dozens of pairs of eyes have been carved into their dry trunks, rubbed with vibrant pigments resembling the color of freshly spilled blood.

title: [Reim Settlement, Road]
description: A duo of wrought iron gargoyles stand watch high above a towering gate, their onyx-inset eyes glinting alongside the fiery torches set beneath them, engulfing the pair in red-orange flames.  Steel-headed pikes and shattered arrows lay broken along the fortified stone walls, piled high alongside several yellowed skulls of various origins.  A faded oriflamme lays shredded across the metal gate, the elaborate embroidery stained in black and red.

title: [Reim Settlement, Wind Tunnel]
description: Gusts of dust and clay encircle a windy vortex, obscuring the view of most of the area.  What little is left of the surrounding foliage has bent towards the vortex in submission, leaving their thick, gnarled roots heaved upwards from the dry ground.

title: [Reim Settlement, Gypsy Camp]
description: The blackened field has been partially obscured by the number of wagons to the west, the scorched ground covered in a trio of summoning circles.  Set within the left and right circles are rounded iron cauldrons, filled to the brim with several bones coated in a tar-like substance, the thick liquid slowly travelling down the sides of the tubs.  The center cauldron lays crushed amongst the dead reeds, leaving dozens of small, life-like dolls splayed out within the puddle of gore.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: Wisps of ethereal energy flicker alongside the towering gate, caressing the air around it.  Starting from the gate, interlocking pavers of cobblestone spread northward, leading deeper into the depths of the courtyard.  On either side of the pavers, several trees of alternating colors and heights are planted in wooden boxes.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: The cobblestone pavers split into several directions, the path widening.  Strands of ivy creep across their stone surface, coming from the narrow cracks in between.  Looming in the distance is a massive fortification lined with statuesque carvings down its surface.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: The cobblestone paths leading from the north and south come together here, forming one path to the west.  Set near the center of the two paths is an ethereal lamp hung from a long iron post, offering heatless light.  Below, errant pieces of straw line the sides of the path, accompanied by small brown apple-shaped objects.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: A long wooden hitching post tied with several pieces of leather backs up to a large stable.  In front of the stable's painted doors, a shallow stone basin is filled with crystal clear water, and a few square hay bales are stacked nearby.  The cobblestone path continues on as it veers to the south.

title: [Reim Settlement, Stable]
description: Bales of hay are stacked to the ceiling along the walls of the stable, and a single stool sits underneath a leather harness hanging from a low beam that stretches from the east wall to the west.  A myriad of tools used to clean and groom animals hang in an orderly fashion on an iron rack.  Below the tool rack is a small shelf filled with iron ingots.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: The cobblestone pavers underfoot are a shade of charcoal, blackened from fire that swept through the courtyard, scorching the earth and rocks.  Carved from a solid mass of stone, a dark passageway leads down into an underground dungeon.  Mounted on either side of the cavernous opening is a pair of glaes-paned lanterns.  An open wooden crate filled with supplies sits near the entrance.

title: [Reim Settlement, Dungeon]
description: A single, narrow hole is carved directly overhead, casting a spotlight into the center of the dungeon.  Water trickles down the moss-covered stone walls, the drops echoing loudly amidst the sounds of strange clicking, hissing, and screams.  The stairwell narrows as it continues down, deeper into the dungeon.

title: [Reim Settlement, Dungeon]
description: The stairwell ends abruptly in a pit of cracked, moss-covered cobblestone, a crater amidst the otherwise smooth flooring of the dungeon.  A single torch with bits of dried blood on the marred handle is affixed to one wall.  Past the rubble, the dungeon opens up, but the sputtering torchlight gives no clues as to what may be found.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: Near the apex of the path's curvature, an ethereal lamp hung from a long iron post flickers heatlessly.  To the east, hollowed shouts can be heard, followed by a strange echo.  Empty suits of armor are stacked in a neat pile with a single blackened lance pinning them into the rough cobblestone pavers.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: The cobblestone pavers split into two paths, one veering to the north, as the rest continue in a circle to the southwest.  A series of lush, green, freshly trimmed topiaries in the shape of animals line the path leading north towards the massive castle.  Cresting the top of the topiaries is a small nest, long vacant of any avian.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: To the south, a large wall takes shape, growing in size.  Draped down the side of the wall, a long banner bearing the crest of the Reim family remains intact.  A large stone building can be seen in the distance along the road.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: The cobblestone path stops suddenly; continuing in its place are solid golden tiles leading up to the castle.  A massive castle spans as far as the eye can see with a towering gate beckoning entry.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: Looming overhead, a stone barracks crested by an iron-framed wooden sign fills the courtyard.  On either side of the barracks, racks are filled with assorted armaments and shields sloppily painted with faces.  The cobblestone path curves south towards a long flight of stairs.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barracks]
description: The inside of the barracks is strangely clean for being abandoned.  A long coat rack crests the nearby wall with a stout wooden desk beneath it.  A wooden plaque is attached to the front of the desk, with an arrow pointing down to the trash receptacle.  Leading deeper into the barracks, a widening hallway lined with officers' portraits beckons you further.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: Stone walls tower above the path leading up to a long stone stairway.  A carved ironwood planter box filled with freshly tilled soil sits by the stairway with a variety of oak-handled garden tools discarded beside it.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: Alternating in height, the stone walls of the barbican are carved with narrow slits set in equal distances apart.  Neatly piled next to each wall opening is a pile of bolts and arrows with thick, green fluid dried to the tips.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barracks]
description: The hallway opens up into a large, circular room with entrances to living quarters in all directions.  High overhead, a thick, glass dome framed with iron offers little light to the area, its surface thick with dust and grime.  A woolen rug bearing the crest of Reim covers a dark stone floor.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Reim Settlement, Barracks]
description: A row of beds covered with green woolen blankets lines the far wall.  Narrow cots are mounted above the beds with wooden supports.  In front of each bed is a low metal locker latched with a bulbous, iron lock.  Small tables are spaced between each sleeping area, all set with an assortment of neatly organized personal effects.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barracks]
description: A row of beds covered with blue woolen blankets lines the far wall.  Narrow cots are mounted above the beds with wooden supports.  In front of each bed is a low metal locker latched with a bulbous, iron lock.  Small tables are spaced between each sleeping area, all set with an assortment of neatly organized personal effects.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barracks]
description: A row of beds covered with crimson woolen blankets lines the far wall.  Narrow cots are mounted above the beds with wooden supports.  In front of each bed is a low metal locker latched with a bulbous, iron lock.  Small tables are spaced between each sleeping area, all set with an assortment of neatly organized personal effects.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: A small portion of the wall is being renovated, evidenced by a pile of cobblestones stacked near a gaping hole with a collection of tools next to it.  The pathway below narrows dangerously close to the wall with a trio of ropes affixed to either side as temporary railings.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: The makeshift railings continue along the narrowed section of the wall to the north and south.  The absence of a parapet allows the wind to howl across the cobblestones, sweeping the area clean.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: Rough, wooden planks line the inner wall creating makeshift parapets, while long sections of cobblestone pavers are stacked behind.  A featureless figure erected off of the corner of the wall looms outward, watching over the settlement below.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: The path lining the inner wall widens, and the evenly spaced parapets are all the same height.  Assorted ammunition is piled in oak crates situated between each low point in the sturdy, stone wall.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: The parapets are topped with helmets of various races, each helm painted with a mock face.  Sloping down and away from the steep stairs behind, the cobblestone wall widens dramatically ahead.  A row of oak buckets lines the base of the wall, each containing a long wooden ladle and filled with scum-topped water.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: The wall curves inward in the direction of the structured section of the barbican ahead.  Assorted iron spikes are affixed along the inner wall, each sharpened to a vicious point.  Growing over the wall, vibrant green vines with small, budding flowers shake slightly when the wind gusts outside.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: Wooden lattices are framed overhead to offer a small amount of shelter from the elements.  The barbican curves outward into a circular shape here, a lone wooden table with two straight-backed chairs arranged nearby.  Atop the table is the remains of a game,  the playing cards and jet-pipped ivory dice stacked alongside a half empty bottle of liquor.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: Affixed to the wall is a row of long iron spears, each twelve feet in length with viciously barbed heads.  Piled beneath the spears are folded woolen blankets with a pair of stoneware mugs sitting next to them.  The wall curves as it continues on, bending inward.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: The parapets continue their rising and falling, like that of the ocean.  Collected into circular patterns are spools of rope with spiked balls attached at the end.  A single large iron vat filled with oil rests atop two angled pivoting points, allowing for its contents to be dumped on those below.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: The wall opens up into a narrow passageway, leading out to a twisting windy vortex suspended in midair.  The fortifications here are sparse save the collection of large aegis shields lining the wall.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: A narrow roof jutting out from the stone wall offers little shelter along the precarious walkway.  Several pieces of the plank covering have fallen to the ground, the splintered remains kicked to one side.  Hung from small iron hooks is a collection of polished weapons, still ready for battle.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: A simple roof of rough planks extends inward, covering piles of blackened, powdery substances.  A long rectangular section of the wall is carved out and set with a ballista aimed down at a gate in the distance.

title: [Reim Settlement, Stable]
description: Either side of the stable is lined with small and large animal pens, all filled with fresh hay and outfitted with a feed trough.  Metal buckets hang beside the troughs, offering fresh grain and crystal clear water.  A glass-paned lantern is suspended from a thick beam overhead.

title: [Reim Settlement, Stable]
description: Several rows of stacked cages are placed evenly apart down one wall, and another is hung with a collection of hammers and rakes.  The floor is swept clean of any hay, revealing the Reim crest carved with intricate detail in the oaken floorboards.  The ceiling sweeps upwards, creating a breathtaking vault of assorted aged and knotted woods.

title: [Reim Settlement, Stable]
description: A large metal tank fills a corner of the stable.  Hanging from a spigot mounted on the front of the tank, is a dented pail filled to the brim with water.  Behind a narrow partition, several cots are set up, each equipped with a thick, cotton bedroll and a straw-filled pillow.

title: [Reim Settlement, Dungeon]
description: Hanging from a pair of racks on the wall, a series of stained and rusted tools have been abandoned.  A narrow gate lies on the ground beside the entrance, its hinges ripped from the wall.  Positioned beneath a narrow skylight is a single circular pit, filled with charred pieces of bones.

title: [Reim Settlement, Dungeon]
description: The dungeon slopes down and the path splits in two directions, one leading to a cell door, while the other leads further into darkness.  A streak of blackened fluid can be seen along both paths, and an eerie, incessant, tapping noise fills the hallway.  A narrow skylight is carved into the roof casting a spotlight on the intersection of the two paths.

title: [Reim Settlement, Prison Cell]
description: The cell is small with a simple cot that hangs from thin leather strips on the far wall.  A bucket collects the errant drops of water from a skylight overhead.  Braced with iron, a cell door leads back out of the cell.

title: [Reim Settlement, Dungeon]
description: The moss-covered cobblestone construction of the dungeon is painted a strange shade of blackened crimson, a stark contrast to the vibrant green moss lining the walls.  Sitting against one wall is a tall iron maiden with two trails of dried, blackened fluid just beneath the eyelets of the headpiece.  A wide iron-braced door is ajar outside a stone cell at the end of the hallway.

title: [Reim Settlement, Prison Cell]
description: A large iron door is swung open into the hallway outside the cell, while the cramped quarters beyond offer little comfort.  A light trickle of water fills the sunken floor of the cell, and a quiet sucking noise can be heard where the water exits on the far side.  A pair of skeletons lay face down in the shallow waters on the floor, their hands clasped even in death.

title: [Reim Settlement, Dungeon]
description: The wall curves inward to create a shallow cubbyhole, and a trail of wilted roses leads into a cell door.  A small bookshelf sits outside the door, filled with tattered and burnt books.

title: [Reim Settlement, Prison Cell]
description: A collection of book spines have been tethered together to create a noose which hangs from a candelabra high overhead.  A narrow and bleached skeleton hangs from it, a gold ring still around the figure's ring finger.  The cell is barren except for a small cot in the corner, and the cell door leading out.

title: [Reim Settlement, Dungeon]
description: A rusted iron grate sits low on the wall, a steady drip of water falling from its moss-rimmed surface.  A dark and daunting cell door is all that remains at the end of the hallway.  Bent iron bars protrude from either side of the cell, as if something ravaged its way from within.

title: [Reim Settlement, Prison Cell]
description: Iron lattice-like bars are bent into the hallway outside from either side of the cell door, as if something ravaged its way out of the cell.  Carved into the moss-covered cobblestone walls are a series of hash marks, the final one painted black and crested with a fingernail.

title: [Reim Castle, Entry]
description: A towering gate stands outside of the castle, while a gold-embroidered crimson rug leads deeper inside.  Perfectly spaced apart on the walls, a row of golden candelabras burn with heatless ethereal flame, casting a bluish white radiance across the entry.  Placed onto a marble podium in the center of the annex, a picture of a family clad with ornate royal jewelry and clothing proudly sits between a greatsword and embossed shield.

title: [Reim Castle, West Wing]
description: Framed with solid gold, an iron-bound door, carved from dark heartwood bars the way forward.  Above the door is a golden plaque, elegantly hung from two golden rods.  The plush carpet from the south continues to the west, leading down another wing of the castle.

title: [Reim Castle, West Wing]
description: A row of gold-framed windows are set into wide cubbyholes, each draped with gold-embroidered crimson velvet curtains.  In front of each window is a wilted flower in a ceramic vase bearing the crest of Reim.  Overhead, a diamond-crusted chandelier hangs dangerously low, with a small ladder next to it.

title: [Reim Castle, West Wing]
description: Hung from two identical bronze rods, a bronze plaque sits just above a collection of trays and tiered serving carts.  The crimson carpet dead ends at the wall beneath the plaque, while an embroidered white carpet continues to the north and south.

title: [Reim Castle, West Wing]
description: Some tables, carved from mahogany, complement low wooden benches sitting next to them.  Atop each table is a collection of neatly stacked playing cards accompanied by a pile of colorful chips.  The crimson carpet ends here, while polished planks of knotted and burled hardwood continue onward towards the servants chambers.

title: [Reim Castle, Servant Quarters]
description: A row of wood-framed beds line one plain white wall, each with a small metal locker placed in front of it.  A wooden clothing rack filled with serving uniforms hangs beside a plain wooden stand holding a porcelain wash basin and matching water pitcher.  In one corner, a floorboard has been pried up and leans against the wall.

title: [Reim Castle, Kitchen]
description: An assortment of burners sit atop small metal crates, an ethereal flame still emitting from their center.  In the center of the kitchen, a massive wooden U-shaped counter is covered in assorted spices, cutting boards, and food preparation stations.  The lacquered floorboards are covered with various rust-like stains and dirt smudges.

title: [Reim Castle, West Wing]
description: Lining the walls are several doorless chambers filled with cartons and crates of all shapes and sizes.  A row of wheeled serving carts lined up along one wall are immaculately clean.  Starting from the floor, a thin oak banister rises up and ascends the wall heading deeper into the wing.  The plush crimson carpet stops abruptly here, knotted and burled wooden planks continue onward.

title: [Reim Castle, Servant Quarters]
description: A low brass banister continues a foot off of the wooden planks of the floor.  A collection of narrow beds line the wall, each with a small metal locker in front.  A long, wooden clothing rack spans the length of the wall opposite the beds, and on it is a collection of black and white serving uniforms.

title: [Reim Castle, Mess Hall]
description: The wing opens up into a large mess hall.  Unfinished mugs lay scattered across sturdy wooden tables.  Each table has a small glass bowl of fruit, somehow still perfectly ripe.  Situated on the far wall of the mess hall is a long low counter clean of any clutter.

title: [Reim Castle, Pantry]
description: Row after row of trays, plates, and utensils are neatly organized on a collection of carved ironwood racks.  A hollowed chamber, lined with giant ice blocks, contains a collection of meats, cheeses, and dairy products.  Sitting opposite the hollowed chamber is a long pantry lined with assorted dry goods and jarred vegetables.  Some small, wooden carts remain half-packed with goods awaiting delivery.

title: [Reim Castle, East Wing]
description: On either side of an iron-bound door are wide, gold-trimmed banners cut from heavy silk and bearing the emblem of Reim.  The ceiling rises at a steep pitch from each wall, creating a center point for a massive ethereal chandelier suspended overhead.  The carpet covering the floor is bright crimson edged with elaborate gold stitchwork that continues throughout the wing.

title: [Reim Castle, East Wing]
description: Ethereal light surrounds a steel door leading into the royal court.  The thick, gold-edged crimson carpet continues down the hall shadowed by structural wooden beams overhead.  Elegantly carved gold banisters rise and fall along the walls in a wave-like motion.  A pair of carved wooden mantles hold a collection of paintings on either side of the door.

title: [Reim Castle, East Wing]
description: The wing splits into two grandiose corridors lined with suits of burnished armor and a collection of stone statues.  At the intersection, a carved marble pedestal with a faceless bust resting atop its surface is illuminated by a pair of ostentatious, gilded sconces.  Positioned on either side of the pedestal are marble benches with carved indentations.

title: [Reim Castle, Laundry Room]
description: A large cubby is carved into the side of the whitewashed wall, stacked high with crates of crisp linens.  Next to the crates, a large hamper is filled with soiled sheets and blankets.  A single clothesline is strung from wall to wall, a collection of towels hanging from it.

title: [Reim Castle, East Wing]
description: On either side of a wide corridor are a series of pale driftwood doors spaced evenly apart.  Embroidered on the carpet below is an intricate representation of a merchant vessel sailing across the sea of silken fabric.  At the end of the hallway, an arched double-wide door sits open, its carved hardwood adorned with golden, flora-filled scrollwork.

title: [Reim Castle, Guest Room]
description: Gold-framed mirrors hang from the tall ceiling suspended by long, gilded chains above a water-filled tub with a bottle of uncorked champagne bobbing near the petal-strewn surface.  Bolted to the ceiling and floor, iron bars line the entirety of the room.  A gold-framed portrait is hung from a mantle that presides over the crescent-shaped bed.

title: [Reim Castle, East Wing]
description: A portion of the hallway veers left, while the other dead ends into a carved gold door.  Cascading over an arched window is a series of looping red curtains that are held back by lengths of golden rope.  Softly burning ethereal candles are affixed to either side of the door, illuminating the chamber.

title: [Reim Castle, East Wing]
description: The chamber narrows artistically along a gold-covered lattice rug.  A row of narrow skylights shine light upon support beams below, casting shadows in a matching latticework pattern to the rug.  Draped with curtains, a carved gold arch leads deeper into the visitor's wing.  A servants bell hangs from a simple hook on the inside of the arch.

title: [Reim Castle, Guest Lounge]
description: A row of leather sofas sit opposite some plush divans, both stacked high with an obscene amount of decorative silk pillows.  High overhead, the ceiling is replaced with a stained glass image depicting an assemblage of stars and planets.  Wisps of ethereal energy travel along the rim of a carved marble fountain stationed in the center of the lounge.

title: [Reim Castle, Ebon Chambers]
description: A short flight of stairs leads into a sunken chamber of carved ebon marble.  The center of the room has a raised platform with a lacquered and padded X-shaped table.  Lining the walls is a variety of tools, whips, and chains of assorted lengths and sizes.  Beneath the table is a pile of brushes and a tub filled to the brim with oil.  Presiding over the table is a short wooden podium with an illustrated book on it.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: A carved steel door leads to the east wing of the castle.  The walls of this wing are painted a pristine ivory with decorative golden scrollwork gracing the top edges.  A row of wrought bronze candelabras burn with an ethereal light, their heatless flicker casting shadows on the walls.  Tiles of alternating exotic metals line the patterned floor of the entryway.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: Solid columns carved from natural blocks of pale stone split the chamber in two.  Elaborately carved into the first column is the king of Reim's face paired with the queen's stern visage.  A pair of narrow indigo silk banners are strung along lengths of gilded chain, cresting the columns.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: A small serving tray rests beneath an arched window, offering respite to those who pass.  Beside the window is a low marble bench with a variety of refreshments.  The natural lighting from the window illuminates the nearby wall, causing flecks of gold to shimmer in the light.

A low marble bench rests beneath an arched window, offering respite to those who pass.  Beside the window is a small serving tray with a variety of refreshments.  The natural lighting from the window illuminates the nearby wall, causing flecks of gold to shimmer in the light.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: Crescent-shaped walls bow outward into a small seating area.  Placed next to an arched window, some wooden chairs with silk-cushioned seats are arranged around a wooden table, its top a showpiece of marquetry craftsmanship.  A pair of ethereal lanterns strung high overhead fill the area with an eerie, bluish white light.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: One wall is lined with several racks of assorted weapons and armaments.  Hung from thin iron pegs above the racks is a collection of kite shields bearing the crest of Reim.  Covered in dents and nicks, an armored statue rests atop a pile of hay for sparring.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: The ceiling rapidly ascends into a point overhead, while the walls bow inward, distorting any sense of stability.  The walls are covered with blackened soot, a contrast to the otherwise pristine condition of the castle.  Ethereal light flickers errantly across the flooring, ceiling, and darkened walls.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: In the center of the chamber, the roof is collapsed, and the pile of melted refuse glows with ethereal light.  Damaged and now blackened, a ring of stone-carved runes circles the pile of rubble, each adorned with a foreign metal.  A solid stone block the size of a gnome lies cracked evenly in half, its innards carved out.

title: [Reim Castle, Throne Room]
description: The chambers open up to a massive circular room, and dominating the back wall is a glowing rhimar door.  Positioned evenly in front of the door is a pair of gold thrones.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: Along one wall, a collection of brass trumpets hang from elegantly carved wooden racks, and piled neatly underneath, an assortment of metal bracers engraved with musical notes is displayed in a glass case.  In one corner, a small table is laid out with cleaning supplies and various accessories necessary for the upkeep of musical instruments.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: Velvet drapes are drawn back from a gold-framed painting, and a row of ethereal candles in glass holders illuminate the artwork.  Placed in a small vase on a pedestal next to the painting is a single red rose in full bloom.  A pair of crimson silk banners fringed with golden tassels frame either side of the hallway.

title: [Reim Castle, Royal Chambers]
description: A trail of sooty footprints mars the otherwise perfect white marble leading up to a narrow window.  On either side of the window, lightless torches are hung evenly on whitewashed walls.  Carved into the wall surrounding the window is the depiction of a devolving man, one side of his body a soupy mess.

title: [Reim Castle, Narrow Ledge]
description: A narrow catwalk fastened to the side of the castle wall by iron chains wobbles with each errant breeze.  A narrow window leads back into the royal chambers of the castle.  A windy vortex swirls dangerously close to the edge, a visible torrent of wind leading away.

title: [Reim Castle, Vault Entry]
description: Solid gold walls and floors stretch outward into an enormous room.  A circular crimson rug bearing the crest of Reim fills the entirety of the floor.  Looming overhead, a massive golden vault door beckons entry further.

title: [Reim Castle, Treasure Vault]
description: A rectangular platform offers little visibility into the depth of the dimly lit chambers below.  Nearby, torches flicker along the walls, the ethereal flames casting dancing shadows across stacks of countless bars of gold branded with the emblem of Reim.

title: [Sea of Fire, Kanchoco Oasis]
description: Sand gives way to richer earth near the shining verges of the water, which begins not far from the base of a long ramp of hard-packed sand.  The shoreline is dappled in blinding light and stark shadow, the former from the persistant pounding of the sun, and the latter, a blessing from leaning date palms that have sprung forth from the fertile soil.  The trees are stunted little things, whipped at all times by the sere desert wind, but their shadows are cool and deep and welcoming.

Sand gives way to richer earth near the moon-silvered verges of the water, which begins not far from the base of a long ramp of hard-packed sand.  The trees are stunted little things, whipped by the icy night wind, but their shadows stretch long and black across the water.

title: [Sea of Fire, Kanchoco Oasis]
description: The low ridge overlooks a shimmering pool of crystalline water in the near distance.  No mere mirage is the pool: its freshness is a tantalizing perfume in the air, one accompanied by the dusky aroma of thriving sage and the sparkle of enthusiastic birdsong.  The life-giving pond waits down a long ramp of hard-packed sand worn away by the passage of many feet.

A low ridge overlooks a pool of water silvered by moonlight lurking in the near distance.  Its freshness fills the icy night air with perfumed sweetness, a scent accompanied by the dusky aroma of thriving sage and the croaking music of tiny frogs.  The life-giving pond waits down a long ramp of hard-packed sand worn away by the passage of many feet.

title: [Sea of Fire, Kanchoco Oasis]
description: Sun reflects in undulating shimmers off of the ruddy sand several paces away from the oasis's fertile shore, making a stark and blazing line between living soil and dead sand.  Just past the demarcation, a steep hillside rises in craggy majesty, overseeing the greenery with a pitted and impassive face.  A cleft splits its base, delving down into cool shadows.

Moonlight blanches the ruddy sand several paces away from the oasis's fertile shore, marking a stark and shining line between living soil and dead sand.  Just past the demarcation, a steep hillside rises in craggy majesty, overseeing the shadowed greenery with a pitted and impassive face.  A near-hidden cleft splits its base, delving down into impenetrable blackness.

title: [Kanchoco Cave, Entry]
description: Patterns of phosphorescent white moss climb the arched walls of the cave, dangling down from the ceiling in ragged, glowing curtains just beyond a ragged cleft that serves as a cave mouth.  Golden radiance, brighter but less steady, beckons in a tireless dance from a hairpin bend leading further down into the earth.  The drip of water is faint but ever-present, echoing off of the slick walls in a whispering pattersong.

title: [Tiruz's Caravans, Conductor]
description: Multitudinous yierkas fret and hiss from stalls along the walls of the open-air caravansary, a wide enclosure formed by loose trellises of silvered wood and shielded from above by aged canvas.  Standing beside a small fel sign, a tall blond man with a neatly trimmed goatee oversees the chaos, shouting over the cries of animals and customers alike.

title: [Sea of Fire, Desert]
description: Surrounding you is the apotheosis of all deserts, a wildly shifting sea of sands that swirl in pools of tawny and ruddy hue.  Sunlight pounds down from an open sky that is as blue as a jewel, reflecting in rippling waves off of the superheated grit.  Winds sweep down in stinging waves, blowing golden veils before them.

Surrounding you is the apotheosis of all deserts, a wildly shifting sea of sands that swirl in pools of silver and shadow beneath the starlit sky.  Cold moonlight stretches its icy talons down from a sky as black as a bed of jeweler's velvet.  Frigid winds scream by in stinging waves, blowing veils of pallid grit before them.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Sea of Fire, Sanctum Gates]
description: Black ora gates and high walls of sandstone erupt from the untamed desert, heralding a high spire with a wide compound at its base.  An immense serpent of bronze and copper clings to the tower, climbing up toward a windowed dome at its zenith.  Sunlight reflects off of windows of stained glass, and its heat awakens a faint odor of decay from the entire place.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Gates]
description: A towering black ora gate spans an opening between two massive sand-blasted walls, marking the southern perimeter of the open courtyard.  Huge slabs of bone white sandstone spread concentrically outward from a seal of bronze and copper branding the ground before the gateway.  Hot sunlight glints off of the disk's surface, outlining a tangle of serpents etched into its face.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: Decay has set in to the property at its furthest untended fringes, tarnishing the ornate brass frames of the windows and cracking the stone of the foundation.  One of the pillars sprouting up from the slabs of the courtyard leans askew, marred by a dark handprint that has dried to the sullen red of river mud.  The pathway bends suddenly to the northwest, guided by a winding trail of copper disks laid into the ground.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: A spire stretches into the sky above the pale compound, sandstone walls streaked with shallow grooves from the pelting of the wind-driven sand.  The tower's peak is barely visible from the courtyard, courtesy of the blinding sunlight.  Muffled moans emanate from the long, high-ceilinged building at the tower's base, drifting through one fractured window and echoing across the courtyard in a cacophony of echoes.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Stone Garden]
description: The sandstone landscape breaks abruptly, yielding to a small, sparse garden of sculptural stones.   The statuesque rocks display a striking tonal array, ranging from fiery copper to dark bronze and rich sanguine to clay red.  A few sparse wisps of cultivated greenery trail from earthenware planters set beneath a trio of arched stained glass windows.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: A semi-circular terra cotta veranda rests at the heart of the courtyard, offering brief respite from the sterile swathe of stone.  Wind occasionally rakes across the courtyard's slab floor, moaning in a low, muted cadence that carries with it the rasping slither of encroaching desert sand.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: Sunshine illumines the pale sandstone walls of the compound, heightening their pallor to a hazy ivory hue.  An intertwining pattern of chains and cables is artfully incised into the stone, coalescing at the center of the wall into an intricate coil.  The radiance of the walls is mirrored by the slabs underfoot, which are washed in burning white-golden light.

Moonlight radiates off of the pale sandstone walls of the compound, silvering their pallor and making them shine in the night.  An intertwining pattern of chains and cables is artfully incised into the stone, coalescing at the center into an intricate coil.  The light of the walls is mirrored by the slabs underfoot, which drink in and throw back the spear-sharp glow of the desert stars.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: Ascending nearly thirty feet above the courtyard, stone walls bar escape into the unforgiving sea of sand beyond, a reality betrayed only by the howling winds and gusts of torrid air that seep through small apertures within the stone joints.  Alabaster columns edge the walkway, each wreathed in unfolding layers of copper scaling at the bottom.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: Massive columns of alabaster flank a pair of bronze double doors and continue in evenly spaced intervals along the western pathway.  Each pillar is entwined by an immense serpent of bronze, polished to a burnished luster despite the chaotic dance of the desert winds.  Miniscule grains of airborne sand shimmer in the sunlight, quickened into stinging motes by its furious heat.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Antechamber]
description: Faded silken pennants trail from narrow patinated rods jutting outward over the bronze double doors of the entryway.  Walls of smooth sandstone stretch high above, stippled with reflective circles of hammered copper.  Intermittently gracing the tiled ground, diamond-shaped verdigris accents add tenuous slices of color to the neutral stonework.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: The adjacent complex looms over the courtyard and casts a foreboding shadow across the ground.  A thin serpentine pattern of flawless square-cut sapphires and peridots coils along the ground, leading off toward the southeast.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: Perched on low brass pedestals are nests of alabaster eggs, smooth and unblemished.  The gem-inlaid floor embellishments twine around the platform's base and then continue along to the next, connecting each with a flexuous bridge of fire opal poppies.  Wind hisses over the tiled stones of the yard, the pitch low and angry.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: Spiraling from the northwest, a blue-green floor pattern gradually widens to a breadth of two feet, encircling a cluster of medium-height stands.  Half-cracked and empty, colorless eggs cover the platforms, thin flakes of the sun-blanched stone dusting the floor beneath.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Courtyard]
description: Lurking at the end of the spiraling floor motif is an enormous brass serpent head, its fanged maw agape and saucer-like eyes flickering with viridian and malachite undertones.  The retaining wall of the yard is bare, except for the long and curving shadows cast by the serpent's fangs.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: The chamber opens up into a huge columned hall with a sequence of faceted domed ceilings.  Overhead, the searing desert sun blazes through the glass, sending innumerable coppery specks scattering across the tiled stonework floor.  A small desert ironwood panel rests inside of a niche embracing the pale sandstone walls.

The chamber opens up into a huge columned hall with a series of faceted domed ceilings.  Overhead, the radiance of the moons streams through the glass, sending innumerable platinum specks scattering across the tiled stonework floor.  A small desert ironwood ironwood panel rests inside of a niche embracing the pale sandstone walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: Stark white columns stretch up toward curved glass domes in the ceiling, each slender pillar adorned with rows of pale peridots and accents of bronze and copper leaf.  The floor is a mosaic of blue and green hues, the stones chiseled into the shape of a thick, shimmering scale.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: Narrow paneled windows provide an ample view of the courtyard's remnants and the vast desert beyond.  The sun's rays bathe the large dunes in a warm amber glow, the same light piercing through to halo the pallid columns in an eerie luminosity.  The tiled ground is chipped, resembling run down cobblestones.

Narrow paneled windows provide an ample view of the courtyard's remnants and the vast desert beyond.  The chill moonlight bathes the black dunes in swathes of silver, the same light piercing through to halo the pallid columns in an eerie luminosity.  The tiled ground is chipped, resembling run-down cobblestones.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: Banderoles of lustrous cloth spill from the ceiling in delicate cascades, each one marked with a stitched serpent in bronze thread.  They are faded by the sunlight creeping in through the faceted domes overhead, though once they must have been fine quality and untattered.  Sparks of light reflect off of chips of peridot laid into the floor in a sinuous spiral, projecting chrysochlorous glints onto the surrounding columns.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: A huge copper-paneled sandstone wall stretches from east to west along the northern edge of the antechamber.  Limned across every available space along the wall are ancient friezes, each painting depicting the image of a serpent-headed humanoid locked in a detailed and macabre ritual.  A low, guttural sound echoes from somewhere unseen, rising and falling like an ocean tide.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: Swathes of ebon silk, more akin to tattered ribbons than to banners of any sort, run the length of the sandstone walls like ragged fingers of shadow.  Loose grains of sand and broken pieces of turquoise lay in a scattered pile along the ground.  Whistling wind tears at the compound from outside, hissing shrilly in through a small crack in the glass dome above.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: Bands of malachite coil about pale stone slabs to bear an incredible resemblance to the winding body of great snake.  The meticulously positioned emblem creates an opaque green spiral, ending at a large gem cut into the triangular shape of a serpent's head.  Fastened between alabaster columns, a chain of dark silken pennons is outlined in an intricate pattern of ivory scales.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: Planters overflowing with Luukosian deathwort spill from the windowboxes overhead, the plants sallow and dry from poor care.  The hall's copper-paneled northern wall is dotted with flourishes made from tiny bronze scales, each one cut and pieced to form a part of a larger snaking spiral.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Privy]
description: Given that the air is heavy with the odor of things best long since buried, it is safe to state that the small privy smells somehow worse than death.  Stains mar the walls around a large latrine pit, the edges of which have been widened in an uneven and ragged fashion.  Nearby, a modesty curtain lies, stained and mildewed, torn free of its hanging rods.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Tavern]
description: Thin sheets of frost have chipped away at the wood comprising the building, the rotted planks and ice forming a blackened background to a trio of faded banners pinned up against the back wall.  A chipped bloodwood bar sits along the right side while a quartet of barrels serve as makeshift seating, their bottoms covered in dried blood and dirt.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Bailey Park]
description: An uneven stone wall serves as the village's southernmost border.  Tall conifers rise above it, their lowest branches brushing over the mortar dust along the wall's top edge.  A carved wooden dog sits at the corner as the road turns to the north.

An uneven stone wall serves as the village's southernmost border.  Frost-laden conifers rise above it, their lowest branches brushing over the mortar dust along the wall's top edge.  A carved wooden dog sits at the corner as the road turns to the north.

An uneven stone wall serves as the village's southern-most border.  Tall conifers rise above it, their lowest branches brushing over the mortar dust along the wall's top edge.  A carved wooden dog sits at the corner as the road turns to the north.

An uneven stone wall serves as the village's southern-most border.  Frost-laden conifers rise above it, their lowest branches brushing over the mortar dust along the wall's top edge.  A carved wooden dog sits at the corner as the road turns to the north.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Spire Base]
description: The hall comes to an end at the base of a huge sandstone spire, its second story balcony overlooking the regal disarray of the columned walk.  A gauze-wrapped corpse dangles from the balcony's edge, suspended from a length of black cord.  Still swinging, the corpse fixes the structure's entrance with a filmy, sightless stare.

title: [Sanctum Tower, First Floor]
description: Zigzagging serpent etchings coil their way down a pair of solid alabaster columns that ominously loom over the lofty room.  A vast expanse of pale sandstone squares repeats across the floor, leaving the section of the hallway completely void of any other notable ornamentation.

title: [Altar of the Undying]
description: At the end of a narrow bridge over a black and fathomless pit waits a low altar, long and flat.  But for a small space of encircling sandstone flooring, it is bordered by the pit on all sides.  Tiny lights, sallow gold and flashing crimson, wink from down below like fireflies, accompanied by an incongruous symphony of shuffling footsteps and uncertain groans.

title: [Stay Awhile and Glisten]
description: Surrounding the circular room are tall, marble pillars supporting a carved stone roof.  An iron-clad rack is positioned perfectly in the center of the room.  Suspended from one of the pillars is a small shelf containing assorted waivers.

title: [A Pirate Looks at Four Teas]
description: Painted with tropical foliage, teak planks span the walls of the bungalow.  The floor is replaced by a layer of white sand with a rusted rickety chest and a battered crate half submerged into it.  A tall teak table is positioned next to the entry with assorted teas on the surface.

title: [Museum of Fashion History]
description: Similar to the previous room, tall glass cases are positioned at various points within the room.  Lacking windows, the ebonwood walls are adorned with swathes of silvery gossamer that contrast nicely against the dark hue of the wood.  Silvery undertones sweep the grey marble floors, designed to match not only the gossamer, but also the flickering silver sconces that line the walls.  An arch leads back to the beginning of the museum.

title: [Lily Manor, Ballroom]
description: Elongated abalone-framed windows line the pale maple walls of this spacious ballroom, their surfaces etched with plumes of floral-accented tracery.  Ornate glass-beaded candle fixtures are suspended at even intervals across the barrel-vaulted ceiling, bathing the room below in a warm, soothing lambency.  An artful mosaic of opaline moonstone tiles forms a stylized stargazer lily that blossoms at the center of the stark ivory marble floor.

title: [Lily Manor, Event Hall]
description: Accompanied by the subtle scent of lemon oil, the burgundy-draped hall is attended by a dozen neatly arranged round oaken tables.  Matching chairs surround each one, providing comfortable seating from which to observe a raised maple stage at the west end of the hall.  Dulcet lighting emanates from four sets of candelabra suspended from the dome ceiling, casting soft shadows on the pale gold carpet.  A modest selection of refreshments rests upon a hazelwood sidetable.

title: [Idant's Caravans, Conductor]
description: The smell of unwashed bodies is strong and sharp in the tent, commingling with the acridity of hardened rolton hide from the walls.  Leaning on a small fel sign, a conductor wearing a dark bowler hat raises her voice above the stinking din, shouting out orders as wagons creak in the near distance.

title: [Inside the Wagon]
description: Sturdy candle-filled lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting a faint glow throughout the wagon.  A bowl of half-eaten stew rests on a small end table and emits an unpleasant aroma that offers insight to its continued existence.  Dark green ivy has been twined with long honeysuckle branches, the decorative union deliberately threaded and wrapped around the slats of two wooden benches.

title: [Dazh's Caravans, Conductor]
description: Sweat and horseflesh conspire to form a tangy musk around the open-air business, which is astir with dozens of patrons with dustcloaks and knapsacks full of clothing, all gathered around a high counter at the center of the area.  A small fel sign sits atop the counter.  Stalls with horses and the occasional yierka line the western wall, tended by a team of sweating and overworked grooms.  The clank of wagons departing and arriving is a constant addition to the din.
