title: [Bloodriven Village, Cesspool]
description: The floor of this putrid pit is quaggy and wet beneath about three feet of liquid sewage.  A few roots stick out from the tall dirt walls, covered in slick sludge.  A wet and rotting rope dangles over the side from above, where a shaft of light descends through a small overhead circle.

title: [Iceland Rink]
description: Jaunty music floats through the air, emanating from somewhere beyond the ice-hewn walls.  Many swirls and loops in the ice give testimony to skaters giving in to the music.  Several penguin chicks have been painted on the icy wall, lending a whimsical, childish atmosphere to this section of the rink.

title: [The Written Word]
description: Wave-edged light maple frames decorate the sides of a carved ebony bookcase displaying a variety of writing utensils and other sundry items.  A bookish elven clerk works tirelessly behind a dark maple counter, pulling sheafs of paper and covers from a cloth-lined chest.  Occasionally, bits of torn paper float lazily through the air and land on the floor.

title: [Smoke Screen]
description: The grey brick facade is in dark contrast to the aged and peeling wood lining the interior of this smoke-filled room.  A circular table, covered with a stained linen cloth, serves as a stage for a trio of filled candle votives, each casting their own dancing shadows across the floor.  Broken bottles of ale surround an unfinished oak cupboard that leans precariously to one side, and a collection of dusty trunks are strewn into one corner.  A hand-painted screen is propped against the wall.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Main Mast]
description: Heavily wrapped trusses secure the lower yardarm to the tall, rough wooden mast.  Frayed hemp brails dangle from the unfurled mainsail and shift across the deck in the light, easterly breeze.  High above, nearly lost in the shadows of the topsails, is a dilapidated crow's nest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Bare Aggression, Ring]
description: Marked off by a triple-strung border with posts at each corner, the cleanly swept surface gives way slightly, lending each step a slight bounce.  Two stools face each other from opposite corners, the overpowering odor of acrid sweat hanging around them like a cloud.  A well-used bucket rests next to each stool, one unceremoniously knocked over and lying on top of what appears to a bloody pair of handwraps.

title: [Crimson Raven, Foyer]
description: Walls and floor of polished cherry give this large, open room a rich, elegant feel.  Several glass cases hold examples of weaponry of all types, and bright light from wall sconces and ceiling-hung lanterns glitters off the blades.  Inlaid in hammered gold in the center of the floor is the outline of a huge raven, its wings spread wide and its talons extended to strike.  Rowdy shouts echo from the game room to the north, and from the east, the soft hum of conversation drifts in from the bar.

title: [Iceland Lake]
description: The floor is a solid slab of ice formed on a small lake and surrounded by several drifts of snow.  Shadows move in the deep waters below the cloudy surface of the ice.  Tall, snow-frosted trees dangle their branches over the ice, forming their own protective dome.  The air is crisp and clean, and faint songbirds can be heard over the sounds of the rink.

title: [Crimson Raven, Bar]
description: A polished cherry bar extends along the south wall of the room, behind which can be seen an impressive selection of wines and liquors.  Soldiers mill about, some leaning against the bar having a solitary drink, some gathered in conversation around a few tall tables, and some crowding around the arch to the game room, people-watching.  A large mirror over the back of the bar has been painstakingly cut into the shape of a raven, with shallower cuts picking out the detail of feathers, beak, and glittering eyes.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Crimson Raven, Game Room]
description: The north wall of the game room is made entirely of rough stone, its focalpoint a mammoth fireplace, over which hangs a crimson banner embroidered with the golden wyvern crest of House Vaalor.  The west wall boasts a dart board mounted next to a polished wooden rack, offering an opportunity for soldiers to let off a little steam in friendly, if fiercely competitive, games.

title: [Backsword Table]
description: A mithril backsword hangs on the bright, crimson-hued wall over the round oak table.  A beeswax candle in a hammered vaalorn holder casts a flickering glow over the table's surface, highlighting a detailed carving of a raven on its surface.

title: [Crowbill Table]
description: A rhimar crowbill hangs on the bright, crimson-hued wall over the round oak table.  A beeswax candle in a hammered vaalorn holder casts a flickering glow over the table's surface, highlighting a detailed carving of a raven on its surface.

title: [Jeddart-Axe Table]
description: A zorchar jeddart-axe hangs on the bright, crimson-hued wall over the round oak table.  A beeswax candle in a hammered vaalorn holder casts a flickering glow over the table's surface, highlighting a detailed carving of a raven on its surface.

title: [Claidhmore Table]
description: A vultite claidhmore hangs on the bright, crimson-hued wall over the round oak table.  A beeswax candle in a hammered vaalorn holder casts a flickering glow over the table's surface, highlighting a detailed carving of a raven on its surface.

title: [Fist-scythe Table]
description: A mithglin fist-scythe hangs on the bright, crimson-hued wall over the round oak table.  A beeswax candle in a hammered vaalorn holder casts a flickering glow over the table's surface, highlighting a detailed carving of a raven on its surface.

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: Rough walls of dark rock surround you to create a small chamber, darkness enshrouding the area like a haze.  Faint light can be glimpsed further north in the cramped tunnel, flickering amidst the blackness.  The air is slightly damp, the silence of the area being broken by the quiet sound of water dripping far off in the distance.

title: [Barakan's Desert Sands]
description: Enclosed by glossy mistwood walls, the shop features a woven rolton wool rug in the center of its strewn pine floor.  A pair of crossed bones hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a bamboo rack and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Barakan's Desert Sands]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a portrait of Darkstone Castle hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A jewel-inlaid caddy and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Barakan's Desert Sands]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A bamboo rack and an engraved copper bin stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: Large torches burn brightly on either side of the walls, illuminating the thin rivulets of water that trickle down silently from tiny cracks upon the ceiling.  Several twisting tunnels branch out in different directions from here, leading into the darkness.  The outlines of shallow footprints dot the earthen floor, trailing off into the winding corridors of stone.

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: Cool, moist drafts flow in from the north every few moments, the soft currents lending a deep chill to the air.  A single lit torch flickers above, the flame casting wavering shadows upon the encroaching walls of the chamber.  Large stalactites loom overhead, the craggy rock formations releasing tiny droplets of water to collect in shallow pools within the bare, lifeless earth.

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: A single row of stalactites line the ceiling, each large formation dripping water upon the corresponding arrangement of stalagmites at random intervals.  Curiously, the tips of each rocky growth are curved slightly, giving the pale objects the look of a fang rather than something of cavernous origins.  A faint scent of decay permeates the area, the smell wafting through the damp air.

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: The monotony of the dusty dirt floor is unbroken save for a few patches of the same dark rock that comprise the walls of the cramped chamber peeking up through some of the more worn sections.  The angle of the tunnel turns sharply here, only a single torch upon the wall lighting the way.  A foul stench rides on the drafts flowing in from the north, saturating the moist air with the smell of rot.

title: [Dark Cavern, Underground Lake]
description: The narrow passageway ends abruptly, the walls stretching out to create a yawning, expansive room.  A large lake spreads through the darkness of the cavern, the sounds of lapping water echoing from the distance belying the true size of the chamber.  A faint mist rises from the glassy surface of the lake, the fluctuating miasma holding the foul scent of rot as it trails along the ground.

title: [Great Western Sea, Schooner]
description: Two tall masts reach skyward, each bearing a large unfurled sail.  The salty sea air has smoothed and faded the blond wood of the deck and rails, although the ship's wheel maintains a rich honey hue, having been meticulously polished by an assiduous crew.  A long wooden bench runs along the sides of the schooner, offering both seating and shelter for objects stored beneath.  An iron chain as thick as a giantman's arm secures a heavy black anchor to the ship's bow.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: The tunnel splits off into a myriad of different winding corridors here, each appearing no different from the other.  There are wide, straight marks in the dusty floor leading off into a few of the twisting passageways.  Dark splotches accompany the trailing marks, nearly concealed by the color of the dirt they stain.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: The walls open up into a circular chamber, the dark grey rock dotted with deep pits and fractures.  The entrances to several different tunnels line the curving walls, each narrow passageway quite dark and featureless.  A skeleton hangs limply from a pair of manacles bolted to the ceiling, the lifeless bones liberally draped with a shroud of cobwebs.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: A veritable maze opens here, a myriad of passages cut from the cavernous walls stretching out before you.  There is a thick coating of dust covering the craggy ground, the faint outlines of footprints barely visible in the murky darkness of the room.  From somewhere beyond the range of sight, a soft shuffling sound is heard from within the twisting tunnels.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: Faint light filters in from the north, illuminating several dark green emeralds inset into the cavern walls.  The gems sparkle as the flickering rays play across their form, their color a sharp contrast to the mute tones of the surroundings.  A few stalactites cast shadows upon the floor, most short and unobtrusive to the cramped chamber.  The tunnel leads further north, the dust on the ground seeming quite well trodden.

title: [Dark Cavern]
description: The surroundings fade from the natural formations of a cavern to the smoothed, angular shape of a long hallway.  Emeralds set in sinuous patterns upon the wall glitter in the illumination cast from above.  Upon the north wall, a pair of massive bronze doors loom toward the ceiling, the gleaming surface of each engraved with interconnected patterns.  Two large sconces flank the entryway, the light from the flames reflecting off the lustrous surface of the highly polished floor.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Bow]
description: Carved with intricate geometric patterns, the weathered oak railing stretches aft on both the port and starboard sides.  Carved to resemble fish bones are evenly spaced support posts that keep the warped railing at about six handspans above the deck.  Just beyond the bow, where the railings meet in a horizontal arc, is the top of a dusky blue figurehead.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Fangs of the Serpent, Gateway]
description: The small plateau rests amidst an immense cavern lit by the ghostly glow of moss clinging to huge limestone stalagtites bearing down from the ceiling.  Answering stalagmites, sharp as a serpent's fangs, sprout out from the cavern floor.  To either side of the plateau is a precipitous drop into the darkness below, the only occupant of which is the howling wind.  At the center of the stony slab is an immense stone serpent head with massive ivory fangs bared.  Five crystal pillars encircle the statue.

title: [Sea of Fire, Lost Outpost]
description: A crumbling watchtower breaches up through the red-orange expanse of the desert like a broken finger.  Unremitting onslaughts from the sands and wind have dwindled the stone building down to a grey and pockmarked nub, and transformed its windows to dark and haunted eyes overlooking an insatiable and all-consuming landscape.  A doorway, little more than a gaping chasm, yawns from the base of the ruin.

title: [Sea of Fire, Lost Outpost]
description: Standing beneath the ominous shadow of a barely-standing watchtower, the outpost is a small expanse of crumbling buildings surrounded by a broken stone wall.  The sole identifying mark of the former occupants is a ragged banner, faded by the sun, clinging like a hungry banshee to the ravaged remains of a small shop.  Flagstones peek up from beneath the sand here and there, but the Sea's inexorable will has already drowned them and many other signs of human habitation.

title: [Lost Outpost, Watchtower]
description: Sand pools in the corners of the tower's ground floor.  It seeps in through chinks in the ill-made walls of stone, but the real flood of it pours in through the wide open doorway, accompanied by searing wind and stinging sunlight.  Although the stairway ascending to the second story is wrought from blocks of solid stone, it manages to look exceedingly treacherous and unstable.

title: [Lost Outpost, Watchtower]
description: All along the watchtower's crenellated rooftop are signs that struggle, and not the desert, ended its dominance over this stretch of the Sea.  The shattered remains of a wine bottle glint, green as grass, from a pile of fine sand in one corner.  An arrowhead is lodged in between two blocks of stone, although its shaft has been devoured by the elements.  Over the whole scene, the wild wind howls, low and mournful.

title: [Kanchoco Cave, Shrine]
description: A smooth-edged monolith is carved out of the raw stone of the cave's northern wall, geodic veins lending the pale rock bands of color: a sharp sky blue here; dusky gold there.  All around, the walls are pocked with niches, each one containing a tallow candle.  Their concerted light plays over a stylized sunburst etched into the forward face of the carving, its sole visible adornment.

title: [Sea of Fire, Singing Sands]
description: Whipped by the winds and punished by sunlight as hot as a forge-fire, the dunes are in constant motion, tossed as if waves on an actual sea.  A constant roaring thrum, like a tide about to crash, fills the air with deafening power, as if the so-called 'singing' sands are actually screaming themselves hoarse.  Nary a scrap of brush nor hardy cactus dares challenge their power in this place: there is sand, and only sand, all about.

title: [Sea of Fire, Singing Sands]
description: A deep valley, practically a ravine, darts between a pair of rumbling dunes.  The towheaded giants threaten to collapse in at any moment to crush the winding pathway of powder-fine sand.  In the middle of the fleeting trail, the constant shifting of the sands has revealed a bleached and fleshless bessho skeleton.

title: [Sea of Fire, Singing Sands]
description: The prickly tips of a saguaro's arm peeks out of a nearby dune, though there is no indication whether it is merely a disembodied limb or a helpless cactus buried whole.  Humming faintly and ever-blowing, the sands are not possessed of a uniform hue.  Ruddy, finer sand commingles with coarser, blonder grit, forming dazzling patterns like the swirls of paint on an artist's palette.

title: [Sea of Fire, Beneath the Hammer]
description: Sands laze shiftlessly beneath the shadow of a great tower of rock, stark and stern against the daylit sky.  Colorful variegations sweep across the rock spire's face from its base to its wider peak, lurid purples and flashfire reds swirling through the duller beige of the stone.  The inverted taper of the spire lends it the appearance of a great hammer that might come swinging down at any vindictive moment.

title: [Sea of Fire, The Hammer's Base]
description: The true and incredible scope of the hammer-shaped spire of rock is apparent when viewed from the ragged terrain at its base.  It stretches up into the sky, many times the height of a man, as colorful and beauteous as it is deadly.  Lying amidst the jagged stones is a pile of sun-bleached bones, though whether the remains are an offering or merely evidence of an unwary traveler is unclear.

title: [Sea of Fire, The Hammer]
description: A narrow pathway of sawtoothed stone curves up the base of the gargantuan spire, beginning at a rocky outcropping near the base and rising toward the formation's flaring head.  Although ragged and sharp-edged, the path ascends too evenly to be entirely natural.  It proceeds past colorful swirls on the hammer's face, and these, at least, are certainly not the work of a mortal hand.

title: [Sea of Fire, Head of the Hammer]
description: The crown of the rock formation is strangely flat, worn smooth by wind-driven grit.  Remnants of a campfire near the center suggest that the plane has been used as a place of safety, and recently, at that.  Just before the sheer edge drops off onto the swirling desert below, there is an incised copper disk incised into the stone.

title: [Subterrain, Pit]
description: Delving into the bowels of the earth, the pit is a stinking morass of unidentifiable muck that reeks like a herd of dead roltons, drenched in fish guts, rotting in the sun.  The walls of the pit are jagged and uneven, providing plentiful handholds that are firm, if a bit moist.  Fresh air swirling down through a wide hole above is the only thing leavening the incredible stench.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: Draping down from a quartet of cracked alabaster columns are several shredded ebony raw silk banners.  Their threadbare remains are like sinewy strips of decay-blackened intestine, curling and shifting with the currents of air wheezing through the hall.  The domed ceiling above lets a few streams of light through, the rest of its surface obscured by a constant blanket of sand scraping across it from the outside.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: Indistinct clawing noises scratch off of the surfaces of the surrounding columns, originating from behind a barred copper-inlaid door.  In the center of two obsidian pillars, a huge alabaster snake statue rears up from the walk, its narrow eyes carved from inky jet stone.  Sharp malachite chips are layered along its slender body to form an impressive coat of complexly winding scales.  A sickly, putrid odor drifts lazily through the hall.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: A row of curved windows positioned along the far sandstone wall delivers a breathtaking view of the deep silver, brown, and black of the desert's landscape in the distance.  Far beyond the inner walls of the sanctum, the shadow of a sandstorm churns violently on the horizon.  Dried trails of blood lead to a large copper-barred door, where a dampened sound savagely rattles from within.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: A chunk has been torn or blasted from an alabaster column, its once polished surface now marred with cracks and jagged bits.  Dried blood smears the ground along the tiled stone floor, tiny dark red flakes scattered about like crimson dust.  A terra cotta bowl resides in a corner of the hall, the depths filled with shreds of discarded selshis skin.

title: [Sanctum of Scales, Columns]
description: The ground here is uneven, the patterned floor smashed in various places, each cavity appearing in the shape of a massive footprint.  The bright desert sun sheens across the domed ceiling and bathes the area in a warm bronze glow.  Weak, unnatural moaning drifts in from further down the chamber.

title: [Sanctum Tower, First Floor]
description: Age-worn brass and copper spears are shackled inside of an elongated crystalline case in an elegant formation amid a varied assortment of ancient coins and tools.  Erupting in sporadic intervals from the periphery, a quivering hiss rises to a fever pitch and is quickly silenced by a reverberating thud.  A lengthy, gently curving path cuts cleanly through the leftover gritty rubble of a crumbling sandstone wall.

title: [Sanctum Tower, First Floor]
description: Mimicking the coloring of a sidewinder's skin, the gold-tinged stony floors are chiseled with an overlapping pattern of oblong keeled scales, occasionally punctuated with a gleaming ebonwood accent.  The rest of the corridor is empty, accentuating the dizzying effect of the precisely rendered design.

title: [Sanctum Tower, First Floor]
description: Drastically unfurling from the narrow halls, the arc-shaped room expands into a sizeable foyer.  Iron-caged lanterns, each alight with a sickly green radiance, are hung strategically in the outer most corners of the area.  A pair of wall-mounted alabaster serpent heads with glinting bronzed fangs leap out from either side of a polished acacia archway.

title: [Walk of the Unliving, Friezes]
description: Looming friezes of men and women with heavily scaled faces stare down from the high walls.  They are accompanied by writhing creatures of grey countenance and bent posture, portrayed with horrible eyes of flashing gemstone.  The walls curve overhead to form an arched ceiling, luminous soulstones suspended from swinging chains at the zenith providing the only sickly light along the walkway.

title: [Walk of the Unliving, Statuary]
description: Long beds of dark loam stretch to either side of the walk, filling the air with a damply fresh smell.  This is accompanied by undertones of another odor, sweeter and fouler, that of rot run rampant.  Greying limbs breach up from the earthen depths, planted there as if in grisly parody of a garden, grasping and twitching and never tiring.

title: [Sanctum Tower, First Floor]
description: Interleaved brass and copper ornamentation gleams from the edges of an arched niche along the western wall.  Nearby, the smooth facade of pale sandstone is marred by a crusted brown stain, as if something has slid down the wall into a heap, but the source of the blotch is nowhere to be seen.  A faint iron tang clings to the air.

title: [Sanctum Tower, First Floor]
description: Rough-textured sandstone blocks inlaid with gold and bronze glyphs crest the upper perimeter of the attenuated passageway.  Shredded tendrils of silk and linen are strewn about the floor, a few stray pieces entangled in craggy fissures undermining the integrity of the room's outermost barrier.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Second Floor]
description: The second floor opens onto a parlor outfitted with burnished acacia moldings that frame the high ceilings and baseboards.  Untouched by the elements, a peridot green wool-covered divan is adorned with a pair of ruched bronze silk pillows.  A colossal, perfectly articulated yierka skull stares out vacantly from above some riveted black ora doors.

title: [Sanctum, Hall of Making]
description: Flames blaze from twin casings of crystal to either side of the entry doors, green as grass and swirling in spirals both languid and unnatural.  They burn without heat in the cold chamber, revealing walls of black sandstone that embrace the circular interior like a mother's arms.  The air is still and heavy-laden with the sharpness of preservatives.

title: [Sanctum, Hall of Making]
description: Beneath a series of blindingly bright soulstones suspended from the ceiling on thick chains, there lies a long steel table affixed with cuffs at the side and bottom.  By its side, atop a small acacia wood stool, are arrayed a series of small knives, prongs, and other tools on a spread of clean linen.  The entire area is impeccably clean save for a single tiny stain that has sunk indelibly into the sandstone floor, reddening it.

title: [Sanctum, Hall of Making]
description: Lit by a lamp burning with cold viridian flame, a desk of black widowwood rests along the curved chamber wall, topped with tiered boxes of carved bone that hold tidy sheaves of neatly inked paper.  The characteristic fragrance of the widowwood is a muted, distant thing, chased away by the bitter acridity of preservatives hanging heavy on the air.

title: [Sanctum, Hall of Making]
description: To the north, a narrow opening breaks the curve of the walls, proceeding toward an alcove lit by a furious inferno of emerald radiance.  Shadows race and dance at the verges of the wide bar of light it leaves pooling on the floor, curling about the edges of a circular bronze seal set into the sandstone.  Overhead, the ceiling is patterned with gleaming copper scales.

title: [Sanctum, Hall of Making]
description: Crystalline chambers line the walls, each a pyre of virescent fire that swirls, unabating, as if desperate to escape its glass prison.  The walkway is very narrow and the ceiling high, lending to the impression that the translucent containers are pressing in from either side.

title: [Abomination's Womb]
description: Virescent flames are held back by the thick crystal of the northern wall, illuminating a massive, circular vat at the center of the high-ceilinged room.  The vessel is ringed by a star formed of five steel tables.  Sour air, almost noxious with the astringence of strange chemicals, settles heavily over the surroundings, dragging along a too-sweet aftertaste of rot.  Overseeing the entire scene is an unnaturally detailed statue of a scaled man, his features half-hidden in shadow.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Second Floor]
description: Desultory gusts of biting desert winds have half-ripped down a metal-woven tapestry hanging limply from scaled hooks strung on a beveled iron rod.  An enormous amount of structural damage has occurred to part of an outward-facing wall, scattering sandstone debris and a fine chalky powder throughout the hallway.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Second Floor]
description: Shadows drape a lacy fan of darkness over of the stony hallway, despite the addition of several copper-crested sconces burning tallow candles in the far corners.  A frenzy of primitive drawings done in brown iron gall ink are scrawled over the floor and threshold leading to the isolated balcony to the southwest.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Second Floor]
description: Looking out over the columned walk below, the tower's second floor balcony provides a view of the antechamber's regal decay in its grim totality.  Before the overlook sits a heavy striking cobra statue.  A length of black cord is knotted about its neck, trailing over the railing's edge and pulled tight by a weight from below.  The walkway curves past the statue toward the next level, its sandstone tiles blanketed by a gold and green runner of raw silk.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Second Floor]
description: Branching away from the primary hall, a small opulent alcove is recessed from the main walkway.  Glittering emerald plates are arranged in a forked tessellation along the trio of walls, their sunlit facets casting a deep viridian glow over the space.  A bronze helicoid reliquary is preserved in the back, just below a series of narrow clerestory windows.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Second Floor]
description: The ceiling is ravaged by a number of warped apertures that spill linear bands of sunlight over the tawny sandstone floor.  A broad squared hollow is worked into the inner wall, displaying choice pieces of ahdmir blue-glazed pottery.  In a tragic outcome, some of the artworks have been smashed to nothing more than a gritty dust.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Third Floor]
description: The southern wall of the tower is anchored by a massive bay window that looks out onto the red-blushed golden desert beyond.  Coiled serpents of brass and copper spiral around the entablature above, their slitted emerald eyes winking in the daylight that spills through the glass-paned frame.  Carpeted in viridian velvet, the passage curves down toward the tower's lower floors.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Third Floor]
description: Peridot and sandstone tiles weave across the floor in a patchwork design.  Entire swatches of ground are crusted with dried blood and shriveled bits of gore.  A small ebonwood table sits between two etched bronze candlebras, the light from the waxy candles casting a subtly shifting blanket of shadows along the back wall.  The hiss of the flames is constant and reproachful.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Third Floor]
description: Several stone fragments clutter the interior of an arched niche in the western wall, the sole remains of what appears to have been a painted tablet.  The abrupt length of hallway is otherwised untouched, from its walls of brass-adorned sandstone down to the runner of emerald velvet that proceeds in a sinuous fashion along the floor, inexorably curving upward to the tower's zenith.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Third Floor]
description: A half-circle altar of black ora rests before the windowed eastern wall.  Stray bands of sunlight steep the metal in a burnished golden glow.  Upon the altar rests a half-dozen yellowed eggs, each the size of a giantman's fist, cracked open to reveal bits of moulted cuticula inside.  High overhead, a turquoise-beaded black tapestry is jaggedly torn in half, the tattered remnants softly flapping like the wings of a great vesperti.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Third Floor]
description: Suspended from the ceiling are a series of stained bronze hooks.  Their gleaming chains creak slightly from the hot wind whistling through a rend in the sandstone walls.  Caged lanterns line the walkway leading up to a scaled bronze door, the deep viridian flames held within washing the chamber in a flickering dance of ethereal light.

title: [Sanctum Tower, Third Floor]
description: Charcoal fingers of ash paint a black graffiti over the sandstone walls.  It mars a mural in once-vivid ahmdir blue, a stark depiction of a humanoid with a bronze serpent head towering over a slithering sea of selshis bodies.  Broken lanterns litter the tiled floor, their shattered glass sparking with angry rainbows in the daylight blazing through a narrow window above.

title: [Reim Base Camp]
description: Makeshift shacks and tents, including a tall brown canvas tent, line the perimeter of the area, the rock-strewn ground covered in dirt and clumps of salt.  Small trails of smoke rise slowly behind the housing, the occasional spark of a cracking kindling shooting up toward the sky.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Brown Tent]
description: Off to one side of the tent, a set of straw-filled dummies face each other.  Each has been hastily dressed in wares to resemble the emperor and empress and stuck through with spears.  Nearby, an open crate and a pile of canvas sacks bulge with ransacked goods from the castle.

title: [Reim Base Camp]
description: A strong, chilling wind blows through the area, the gusts threatening to flatten a tall canvas tent and a makeshift shop situated along the cliff.  A wooden vault creates a makeshift wall between the other structures, its thick pine planks warped from continuous exposure to the harsh elements.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Wooden Vault]
description: Heavy metal chains enclose a number of warped wooden chests, the rusted lengths pulled taut by several large padlocks.  Crumbling vellum posters tacked onto the structure's support beams display a variety of rates and numbers, material splattered in faded ink and dried blood.  A vault guard stands near a massive golden gong, his eyes scanning the vault and its occupants closely.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Shop]
description: Thick sheets of oilcloth partially cover dusty shelves filled with unused merchandise, the various items covered in a fine sheet of dirt-laden frost.  A large glowing display has been set in the middle of the room, the container casting an eerie luminescence upon the darkened corners of the shop.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Armory]
description: Tightly bound bundles of dried herbs hang from the ceiling of the canvas tent, the plants spaced out between a pair of rusted iron lanterns that illuminate the small space.  A frayed, dark wool mat lays rolled against the back wall, as well as a number of totems and idols carved from bloodwood and oak.  The center of the area remains meticulously clean, the debris piled up to either side of the tent flap.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Tavern]
description: Broken glass bottles and glasses are strewn across the oak-planked floor, the green and brown shards brushed towards the walls alongside piles of melted slush.  The stench of fermented alcohol and sweat fills the room, mixing with the aroma of pipe tobacco and a familiar metallic twang.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Tavern]
description: Waterlogged oak planks have been scattered with a variety of animal pelts, their furs matted and caked in smells and substances unknown.  Rudimentary wooden chairs, bound in frayed lengths of sinew and leather, sit in a half-circle in front of a discolored fieldstone fireplace.  A stack of blackened crates serve as makeshift tables, each one covered in candles in various stages of melting.

title: [Rone Academy, Alumni Anteroom]
description: This lounge extends the entire length of one side of Rone Academy, taking up a good portion of the second floor.  A semi-circle of long, comfortable sofas faces a massive black marble fireplace along one wall, while another supports a long wooden table.  Several plump pillows and throw blankets suggest this is a comfortable place to work.

title: [Rone Academy, Alumni Quarters]
description: This narrow hall is lined with doors, each one presumably leading to the chamber of a senior member of the Academy.

title: [Rone Academy, Asilynne's Room]
description: The floor of this room is inlaid with a pentagram of teal and gold, the gold shining softly in the light of two large crystal-pane windows that take up the whole of one wall.  An azure and green chaise lounge upholstered in silk sits in a cozy corner near a huge ebonwood fireplace with brass appointments.  A cleverly arranged arch of shelves completes the room's furnishings.

title: [Rone Academy, Tiffilynn's Den]
description: The scent of jasmine wafts from candles burning at all corners of this room.  A tidy rune-carved study desk rests next to a handsome bookcase filled with volumes of lore and spells.  The thick black woolen rugs are arranged to provide two cozy resting areas, one containing a canopy bed with a feather mattress and black lace and satin fabrics.  The other has two overstuffed black leather sofas facing each other, a solid glass table between.  The walls are adorned with a gossamer fabric.

title: [Rone Academy, Karess's Room]
description: The scent of fragrant flowers fills this sunlit room.  A huge four-poster bed carved with a pattern of roses faces the tall arched windows, providing a view of the gardens beyond.  An oil painting of Karess and Commandant rests above the fireplace, surrounded by white candles.  In the far corner of the room a miniature waterfall fills a golden heart-shaped pool.  A mirrored ivory dresser and a satin-covered stool stand against the wall.

title: [Academy, Commandant's War Room]
description: Battle plans and charts are strewn across the room, competing with racks of armor and weapons.  The smell of leather, oil and sweat permeates the area.  The walls sport a series of portraits of family members at various stages of their lives, cumulating in a tremendous canvas depicting the entire clan clasping each other in rowdy affection.

title: [Academy, Michaellangello's Room]
description: The entrance to this room has been strewn with partially disarmed traps and tools of the trade, turning the first several steps into a bit of a maze.  A window along the back wall rises over a workbench, a small brazier and forge sitting next to a series of half-finished lockpicks.  A small cot takes up the eastern wall, and the only clear space on the floor is covered by a rug embroidered with a series of crossed lockpicks.  Hanging near the door is a portrait and a framed certificate.

title: [Rone Academy, Alumni Quarters]
description: The narrow hallway continues, leading past another half dozen private chambers.

title: [Rone Academy, Stormyrain's Room]
description: The scent of vanilla fills this softly lit room.  To the side a picture window stands open, its lace curtains swaying as a fragrant breeze swirls in from the garden below.  A music stand sits in one corner, an unfinished composition lying in its folds.  Beneath the window lies a large bed, several instruments laying haphazardly against its side.

title: [Academy, Adamantium's Room]
description: This well lit room appears quite cozy, giving the impression of being well lived in despite its orderly cleanliness.  A large, comfortable bed takes up the left wall while the right is dominated by a desk sitting beneath an elaborate painting.  A soft murmur of falling water flows through the room, although no source is immediately visible.

title: [Rone Academy, Avantos's Retreat]
description: Softly glowing white gems are ensconced along the walls of this room, providing a cheering light.  Nearly every wall is covered with carved fel scroll racks, leaving little room for a locked weapon case.  A burnished fel desk claims one corner, its surface covered with papers and a well-worn book.  Near the desk rests an inviting black leather armchair.

title: [Rone Academy, Shinoo's Room]
description: A collection of bright candles dominates the room, flooding it with light that reflects off of the flecks of gold within the marble floors.  A carved mahogany desk rests near one wall, while a four poster bed of the same wood is half-hidden by a white spidersilk canopy.  Above the door a message has been engraved in the marble.

title: [Rone Academy, Matiisse's Room]
description: The light from a single torch and a couple of candles barely illuminates this room, reflecting off polished maoral wood.  A double bed, an anatomist's skeleton and a picture are barely visible in the shadows.

The light from a single torch and a couple of candles illuminates this medium sized room decorated in rich maoral wood.  Across from an unmade giantman's double bed, a bookcase filled with books on healing arts takes up nearly the entire wall.  To the left of the bookcase a complete skeleton hangs, its jaw slack.  To the right a wood-framed picture hangs slightly off center.  Beyond, a window has been left open, its curtains dancing slightly in the breeze.

title: [Rone Academy, Garlandor's Room]
description: A large bed covered in glittering gold fabric dominates the room.  A large silver fist of Kai stands guard over the bed, while an iron-bound trunk sits at its foot.  Statues fill the maoral dresser on the west wall, all apparently handcrafted by a master.  A blue-curtained window looks out through the east wall, a view of the Voln Monastery and graveyard in the distance.

title: [Rone Academy, Alumni Quarters]
description: The narrow hallway comes to an end here.  Doors line two walls and a small stone table bearing a flower vase leans against the third.

title: [Rone Academy, Tarisse's Room]
description: This room is pleasantly bright and airy.  Along the western wall is a large stone fireplace with an ornate modwir mantle, flanked by four huge windows.  The floor-length silk curtains feather softly as a breeze carries the scent of jasmine and honeysuckle through the room.  A large four-poster bed dominates the center of the chamber, shrouded by white silk veils draping from its posts.

title: [Rone Academy, Ylandra's Room]
description: A vaulted black ceiling covered with tiny pinpoints of light gives a celestial aura to this room.  Vines crawl over the walls and plants are nestled close to one another throughout, while a tiny fountain formed of Terasian stones rests in one corner, its waterfall providing a musical cascade of sound.  Directly opposite the fountain is an instrument rack, music stands, and a small grouping of chairs.  A hammock rests in a shadowed corner, allowing an undisturbed view of the sky above.

title: [Rone Academy, Bestatte's Room]
description: The chamber is decorated with rugs in shades of deep red and purple, and accessories of silver are spread on the modwir desk against the south wall.  In the far corner is a large feather mattress covered with burgundy spidersilk sheets and pillows.  Beside the bed is a small glaes altar, the heady aromas of jasmine and sandalwood wafting up from the scorched silver bowl upon it.  Covering the ceiling is a shattered mirror, the soft glow behind it illuminating the room in colorful fragmented spectrums.

title: [Vaeyre's Sanctorium]
description: Dreamstones have been inlaid along the top of the grey stone walls in an irregular pattern of waves, barely visible above the towering ebonwood bookcases that dominate all four sides of the room.  Above the varied tomes, the ceiling has been studded with starstone in the outlines of the night sky.  A large witchwood desk rests in the center of the room.

title: [Rone Academy, Loraek's Room]
description: The only source of light in this darkened room is a faint glow from behind the crimson spidersilk curtains of a small open window.  A dark canopied bed dominates one corner of the chamber, and a dimly lit pool another.

title: [Rone Academy, Breeze's Room]
description: Set into one wall of this maple-panelled room is a fireplace with a large portrait hanging above it, and several inviting over-stuffed pillows scattered nearby.  A display case rests along the western wall while a bench cluttered with maps takes up the opposite side.  The remaining corner contains a large feather bed with daffodils and maple leaves carved into the headboard.

title: [Academy, Xanith's Bedchamber]
description: Ornate cobalt racks, hanging along the silver-painted walls, hold a variety of weaponry, and an elaborate tapestry sits between two such racks, depicting a well-muscled warrior and a fair empath maid.  A silver-draped four poster bed wreathed in pink resides in the center of the room, and a desk sits in one corner next to a bookcase crammed with tomes on battle tactics and chronicles of war.  Lining the floors are fluffy puma fur rugs, and a maoral worktable holds some unfinished weapons and a large wooden cupcake.

title: [Academy, Missoni's Laboratory]
description: Glass sconces descend from the ceiling on silver chains, casting light upon a polished grey marble floor.  Centered upon it, a flawless alabaster basin stands surrounded by a multitude of bookshelves crafted from varnished kakore.  Tomes, vials, and supplies cover every shelf, but the room is immaculate despite the clutter.  A carmine velvet stool is tucked behind a large writing desk made of the same russet wood, and a small disheveled pallet of firecat furs rests against the wall.

title: [Rone Academy, Kitchen]
description: The scent of freshly baked tarts wafts through the air of this enormous kitchen.  Along the back, cabinets have been stuffed to the brim with cooking utensils and ingredients.  A small group of students hovers around a large oven in the corner, pestering a jovial cook.  A long countertop lines the opposite wall, a few newly made dishes resting on its surface.

title: [Academy, Daeffodill's Study]
description: This small, cozy study seems to be carpeted in tart crumbs.  Throughout the room are empty potion bottles and hastily written scrolls.  The walls have been burned to various shades of soot, lending a slight burnt aroma to the air that competes with a faint scent of daffodils.  A short but wide workbench holds jars and bottles of ingredients of all sorts as well as a very large bright yellow silk-bound spell book.  A dainty overstuffed chair sits in one corner, half concealed within the chaos.

title: [Wehnimer's Garden, Trees]
description: As your eyes follow a cobblestone footpath into the trees, a small cottage is nestled snugly, barely discernible, among the foliage.  The vegetation grows so close to the building that it seems to be a part of it.  Flowers and vines cover the walls and roof, yet they grow in such a way that neither the wooden door nor the windows are blocked.
location: Inurtia's Cottage, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Burghal Enclave, Great Dome]
description: The high ceiling overhead is a dome, carved out of the overhanging rock itself.  Protrusions of glimaerstone in the tufa are organic and patternless, streaking the white stone with bands of green, gold, and lilac.  Several stout chairs surround a large vat centered directly beneath the dome.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Tykel's Arms, Rooftop]
description: Citizens pass by below, moving among the multistoried wooden buildings and shops.  A dark alleyway separates the weapon store from the local bathhouse nearby.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing, Rooftop]
description: The tops of buildings stretch out across Wehnimer's Landing, dwarfed by the wooden palisade walls rising up to enclose the town.  Below the edge, a network of cobblestone roads winds between closely-spaced shops.

title: [General Store, Rooftop]
description: Beyond the rooftop stretches the large intersection with South Ring Road, which many travelers and wagons still cross to reach the center of town square.  A few scorch marks run across the center of the old brown tiles.

title: [Reim Settlement, Weapon Shop]
description: Heavy lanterns suspended from thick chains hang from a tall ceiling illuminating display cases filled with dusty weapons on a wall.  Across from a metal workbench, bins filled with arrowheads, small knives, and other supplies are lined up in front of a long counter.

title: [Breakfast Nook]
description: Sunlight pours in through the wide windows at the front of the shop, its golden glow brightening the slate blue curtains and whitewashed walls.  Several round tables and oak chairs are arranged in social circles throughout the room, while to the back a long counter separates the kitchen from the dining area.  A large easel supports a sign that is cut into the shape of a frying pan, its smooth surface scribed with tidy white lettering on a black background.

title: [Daisy's Dinners]
description: Daisy-patterned curtains decorate the oak-framed windows that are positioned to either side of the shop's entry, the gossamer fabric loose and unfettered.  Bright white daisies are painted upon the cobalt blue stucco walls, the center of each housing glass globes filled with candles.  A long whitewashed counter encircles three of the shop's four walls and has comfortable stools set in front of it at even intervals.

title: [Gardenia's Gourmet]
description: Slate blue drapes frame the windows, blocking the glare of the sunlight that tries to spill into the tiny shop.  Pastries and treats fill the various glass-fronted cabinets that wrap the shop, while baskets filled with fresh breads, fruits, and vegetables are arranged upon the polished tile floor.

title: [Oleander's Defenses]
description: Slightly crowded, the shop is filled with armor-adorned mannequins that display the various wares sold here.  A short, low counter bisects the shop at the back, while a series of wide windows, each wrapped in silk, occupy two of the four walls and allow the island's breezes to cool the otherwise warm room.

title: [Cypress Sundries]
description: Whitewashed walls wrap the tiny room and are interrupted by enormous windows framed by thick shutters that can be opened to allow the cool island breezes to pass through.  Cabinets and cupboards housing various sundries are positioned between the windows, while a low counter stands before a double-wide arch.

title: [Rose's Arms Depot]
description: Framed in oak, a pair of windows flank the entry and allow the bright glow of the day to slant across the smooth tiles of the floor.  Sturdy racks, crafted of various woods dyed a warm golden hue, are neatly arranged throughout the shop and display the various wares sold here.  A thin counter, its sides wrapped in off-white skirts, stretches across the back wall.

title: [The Label Maker]
description: The small space is surrounded by the wooden plank walls of the wagon and taken up by several surfaces that display wares for sale.  A solid oak counter resides near the entry door, while a set of oak shelves sits beside a curtain that leads further into the shop.  Hanging on the walls are some assorted signs with bold writing, and between them a tall cabinet rests against the wall near a pair of flickering torches.

title: [The Label Maker, Back Room]
description: Surrounded by wooden plank walls, this small back room is nearly bare save for a circular wooden table and a plush purple armchair.  A worn pale cream carpet covers the wood plank flooring, and the matching walls are interrupted only by a hanging curtain that leads to the front room.

title: [A Tranquil Tent]
description: Violet marbrinus silk walls are veined with pale grey whorls and anchored to white lattice supports to create a large, airy tent that is infused with the scents of lemongrass, sage, and jasmine.  Lined along one wall is a series of quilted sleeping pallets decorated in bright tropical hues.  Several bins, each labeled with a tiny plaque, are arranged near a cord-tied central flap, which leads outward, and the center of the room houses a low table ringed by cushions.  A brazier upon the table burns dried leaves.

title: [Uxbri's Flammable Firewood]
description: A massive pile of logs dominates the back of the small tent, and the earthy aroma of freshly chopped wood fills the air.  Sawdust and chips of wood cover the floor, and small footprints lead out of the tent.

title: [A Mosquito Net Tent]
description: Supported by a single pole, the tent is comprised largely of drab olive mosquito netting and is vaguely transparent.  A crude oil lamp fashioned of brass is hung from the central post, while several chests lie at the tent's four corners and pin the netting into place.  Cooking equipment spills out of an oilcloth camping pack near the rear of the tent where an oilcloth and fleece sleeping bag is laid out.

title: [Lich's Landing, Specter Lane]
description: Armored death knights on hellish mares trot up and down the lane, their glowing red eyes scanning the horde of zombies and skeletons wandering about.  Flesh golems amble about, chains dangling from their torsos screeching as they are dragged across the road.

title: [Valyss' General Store]
description: Beneath a low skylight-set ceiling, a painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the glazed bamboo walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table and a bamboo rack sit in opposite corners while a twisted sandstone sculpture rests on a glazed bamboo floor.

title: [Krolvin Warship]
description: Slathered with dark patches of tar, the deck forms a rough triangle that encompasses the bow at the point and the port and starboard ballista housings.  Shadows play across the uneven deck planks, cast from the thick canvas sails overhead.  Rain barrels bound to the deck with rusted iron straps stand half full in the center, their lids stored or lost.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Ballista]
description: Variegated copper plates lay in haphazard piles upon the forward end of the interrupted starboard railing.  The corners of several plates show ragged holes where bolts have fallen loose and were never replaced.  Mounted at the center of the pile is a heavy wooden ballista, its rough surfaces scarred with claw marks.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Main Mast]
description: Heavily wrapped trusses secure the lower yardarm to the tall, rough wooden mast.  Frayed hemp brails dangle from the unfurled mainsail and shift across the deck in the light, easterly breeze.  High above, nearly lost in the shadows of the topsails, is a dilapidated crow's nest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Maeby's Weaponry]
description: Smooth mistwood walls rise from a sturdy planked floor.  Just above a potted palm tree hangs a tattered merchant permit, and a low skylight-set ceiling completes the picture.  A long mistwood counter and some carved haon pegs stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [The Thorn and Shadow]
description: The broad sweep of the marble floor is interrupted by some puffed raw silk pillows.  Halfway to the skylight-set ceiling, a detailed landscape painting hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls.  An aqua-hued seaglass display and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Tid Bits and Trinkets]
description: The broad sweep of the slate floor is interrupted by a series of thinly woven rugs.  Halfway to the oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls.  A brass treasure chest and a long carved oak counter are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [The Thorn and Shadow]
description: Beneath a smooth marble ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls.  An oval-shaped speckled marble counter and a long mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while some puffed raw silk pillows rests on a smooth slate floor.

title: [The Thorn and Shadow]
description: Blue-speckled sea glass walls rise from a swirled sea glass floor.  Just above a pile of striped throw pillows hangs a curl-edged vellum wall map, and a smooth marble ceiling completes the picture.  A long mistwood counter and a Vornavian silk-lined display case stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Warped planks give this section of the deck an uneven cant that is echoed in the fitted wooden boards of the bulkheads.  Tacked to the forward bulkhead by seven iron spikes is an enormous spotted walrus skin.  In one corner of the compartment, a large knot in the wood has been burrowed out by claw and fang to create a small rodent nest.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Chunks of orange and brown rust cling to the frame of the large round porthole that fills most of the port bulkhead, and layers of grime coat the surface of the glass, making it nearly impossible for any light to filter into the companionway.  Lumpy, canvas sacks lean against the open arch of the crew quarters, their tops overflowing with foul-smelling, dirty clothes.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Moist air laden with a mixture of rust, rot, and salt fills this section of the companionway.  A wide brush slathered with pitch lies on the floor next to a bucket of glossy black tar.  The ends of tar-soaked strips of oakum protrude from the hull where they have been crammed between planks, while even more gaps remain to be caulked.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Pilfered Plunder]
description: Beneath a knotted oak ceiling, a sphere-hilted mounted sword plaque hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A long mistwood counter and a cedar and oak footlocker sit in opposite corners while a large anvil rests on a sturdy planked floor.

title: [Excavated Artifacts]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a suit of silver-chased armor in the center of its planked floor.  A battered iron helmet hangs under the oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a long varnished counter and a series of low oak shelves.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Bottom Deck]
description: Crammed with banded barrels and crates that are stacked up to the planking overhead, this small area reeks with the odor of rot and waste.  The sound of waves slapping against the outer hull drowns out all other noises.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Grimy copper-banded barrels, dented and scarred from misuse, stand to the side of a series of iron-barred cells.  Each barrel is filled to overflowing with tattered and rotting garments, most of which are so faded that it is hard to discern their original hues.  One barrel lies on its side, pinned between a cell wall and another container, its contents spilled in a heap across the stained decking.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Cell]
description: Clumps of rotted straw lie scattered across the decking that stretches from the inner hull to the wide, wrought iron slats of the cell's rusty bars.  Black rings fixed to the walls with thick iron staples are evenly spaced along the bulkhead and fitted with manacles.  The stench filling the cramped space is heavy with mold and decay.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Lich's Landing, Specter Lane]
description: Rows and rows of dingy hovels and homes line the sides of the lane and a strong putrid scent weighs heavily in the air.  Zombies, ghouls and skeletons of all sizes move about the area, eternally locked in their master's undead theater.

title: [Blacksmith, Courtyard]
description: The blacksmith, a huge dark stone building, rises up from the end of the courtyard.  Huge plumes of thick black smoke rise up from the structure, darkening the air above.  Moving through the courtyard are rows of bedraggled zombies, dragging slabs of metal in their decomposing arms.

title: [Blacksmith, Entry]
description: Grisly zombies march by, dragging slabs of metal on the ground as they grind with screeching sounds.  Faint smoke fills the area.

title: [Valyss' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a billowing silk ceiling, a woven floral tapestry hangs on one of the white silk-paneled walls.  A gilded maple table and a gilded maple cabinet sit in opposite corners while some puffed raw silk pillows rests on a glazed bamboo floor.

title: [Valyss' General Store]
description: A painted native mask hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls, and a sturdy bamboo-rafter ceiling rises overhead.  A set of terra cotta jugs sits in one corner of a glazed bamboo floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and a long mistwood counter on the other.

title: [Maeby's Weaponry]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls, and a glass-tiled vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of a sturdy planked floor.  There is a rusted metal display rack on one side of the shop and some stained driftwood shelves on the other.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Gator Haze]
description: A thin haze of tobacco smoke hangs in the air, dispersed slightly by the occasional warm breeze coming through an open window.  The once bright paint on the wooden posts holding up the thatched grass roof is chipping and faded, carved over with hundreds of names and initials.  A similarly carved rickety cabinet stands in one corner of the room, its shelves overflowing with empty bottles of spirits.

title: [Booze and Brews, Mud]
description: Hanging from the ceiling is a dimly lit chandelier, which casts flickering light and long shadows over the area.  Lining the two opposing dark-paneled walls of this long, narrow space are a series of narrow haon shelves, while a multitiered glass-fronted case takes up the entire far wall.

title: [Linen or Leather]
description: Battered wooden boards line the floor of the wagon, covered in part by a mud-spattered green rug.  A sturdy monir rack hangs along one wall, while a dark mahogany wardrobe and a stained oak cabinet sit against the opposite wall.  A dented bronze hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [Muck o' the Mire]
description: The canvas walls of the wagon have been waterproofed by painstaking oiling, though they also hold in the dank, humid air.  The floor is formed by a huge rectangular box filled with about two feet of gooey mud.  Shelves and hooks hang suspended from the roof supports, bearing the shop's wares.  The legs of a a sturdy wooden table stained with water rings are stuck deep in the mud near a narrow closet door, and a canvas tarpaulin leads to the rear of the wagon.

title: [Let It Burn]
description: Rickety wooden walls surround this small room, and they bear several layers of scorch marks, as if a fire had torn through the room and somehow left the walls standing.  A lantern hangs from the ceiling, the light shed from the clouded glass is barely enough to illuminate the center of the room, leaving the edges in deep shadow.  At the edge of the light, a long wooden rack rests on the blackened floor, its contents coated in a layer of dust.  A door and a ragged canvas curtain reside in walls opposite each other.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Brilliant white string moss drapes heavily across the branches of several of the nearby cypress trees, effectively clogging their limbs and strangling their meager attempts to gain nutrients through photosynthesis.  Stretching upward at the base of each arboreal giant are clusters of tall wildyre that is mingled with feathery, fiddlehead ferns.  A thin rivulet of almost clear water twists a serpentine path in and out of the tufts of grass only to disappear into a channel that leads deep into the ground.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Bright and verdant in the dark landscape, a single juniper tree rises out of the murky bleakness of the swamp and stretches upward towards the grey sky.  Concentric bands of alternating stone and brown grass surround the twisted body of the towering, berry-laden beauty and manage to stave off the filth of the nearby sludge-like mud.  Despite the calm of the area, an invasive humidity makes the air weighed with dampness and an underlying scent of stench clogs the senses.

title: [Feymist Cemetery, Abandoned Hut]
description: The interior of the hut isn't very spacious, and the shelter looks to have been abandoned quite some time ago, leaving cobwebs and spiderwebs scattered everywhere.  Along the western wall, countless numbers of shovels lean up against the boarded-up window.  In the center of the hut is a decayed wrotwood coffin.

title: [Let It Burn, Storage]
description: Barely bigger than a closet, the back room is fit with several floor-to-ceiling shelves that house various random objects, from a human skull to a length of twine.  A threadbare carpet covers the dusty wooden floor, and despite its degraded state, it is obvious it was once an opulent decoration.  Affixed to the flame-marred wall, a sconce holds a taper candle that exudes an impotent glow.  A ragged canvas curtain leads out of the room and a single soot-stained window lets in absolutely no light at all from outside.

title: [A Haphazard Wooden Shack]
description: Assembled with obvious haste and lack of skill, the shack's walls barely keep any light and sound from filtering in, much less provide secure shelter from the elements.  A rotting oak table tilts to one side but still is somehow able to hold the wares displayed on it without falling over.  Beside it, a lidless and splintered haon chest holds more items for sale.  Almost as an afterthought, a sign has been tacked to one wall.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Passage]
description: Closely positioned wooden columns help support the earth and ceiling of the small tunnel.  Carved into the limestone walls, several narrow ledges sport a variety of rings, some sparkling as they catch and reflect the light of two torches that are held upright by crude sconces and burn low in the dim space.  A boulder-cramped passageway creates a dead-end, though a light draft of air sweeps up from the small space beneath it.  Despite the presence of a trapdoor overhead, there are no means by which to climb up through it.

title: [The Hair Apparent, Nook]
description: Cramped and close, as though added onto the building as an afterthought, this nook has very little room to move in.  Sitting in the direct center of the space is a hard wooden stool, the floor around it littered in various old hair clippings.  A tray of tools has been shoved into one corner, its surface covered in combs, razors, scissors, and other unidentifiable sharp instruments.  There is a barely noticeable whiff of burnt hair permeating the stuffy air.

title: [The Evening's Heiress, Barroom]
description: Brass lanterns line the stone walls casting a dim light through the barroom.  Stale cigar smoke lingers in the air, mixing with the scent of strong spirits.  A polished oak bar runs the length of the room, offering a few refreshments to weary travelers.  Behind the bar hangs a thick burgundy velvet curtain that covers the doorway to a backroom.

title: [The Golden Rule]
description: Dappled moonlight streams in through the gaps in the leafy ceiling and glitters across the items on a shallow metal tray.  Every footfall on the hard-packed dirt floor sends dust into the air, which dances in the moonbeams like tiny sprites.  Small golden trinkets decorate all four walls, and each one sparkles in the silvery light.

title: [Delirium Manor, Path]
description: Meticulously manicured grass and narrow rows of wildflowers line the edges of this path between the front gate and the manor.  Relatively open, this vantage point provides a clear view of the ground's enormity.  Anxious visitors scuttle up and down the pathway, some toward the front lawn area and others toward the front gate.

title: [Delirium Manor, Front Lawn]
description: Vibrant flowers fill small planters that have been arranged in orderly rows to guide visitors to and from an inviting manor.  Manicured grounds encircle the residence on all sides and are dappled with white-pebbled walkways and brightly painted outbuildings.  From this wide open vantage point, massive retaining walls surrounding the entire area are visible in every direction.

title: [Delirium Manor, Side Lawn]
description: A red and white candy-striped giftshop sits in the shade of a large, spreading oak tree, and a white-pebbled walkway leads toward an open door.  Tucked discreetly behind it down a gentle slope is a pink-bordered privy.  Surrounding both are painted flower boxes, though few blooms remain on the drying stems within.

title: [Delirium Manor, Side Lawn]
description: A whimsically decorated dollhouse, far too large to be meant for toys alone, sits in the shade of a gracefully draping willow.  A white-pebbled walkway leads toward an open door, and artistically painted shutters hug the pale blue clapboard siding.  The roofing is scalloped clay tiles, the color of gingerbread, with a feathering of white paint along the gables.  Nearby is a blue-bordered privy, tucked discreetly along a small path.

title: [Delirium Manor, Back Lawn]
description: A gently rolling slope of the ground levels out here near the rear of the estate, and the grass is not quite as green, nor as manicured, as the surrounding lawns.  Still, a pretty white trellis elegantly arches away from the stately back porch of the manor to the backyard gardens, with twining green vines wending their way through the latticework structure.

title: [Delirium Manor, Front Porch]
description: Welcoming chairs, both large and small, provide an inviting spot for houseguests to relax and enjoy pleasant conversation.  Small tables of children's books and colored wax sticks keep younger visitors busy while adults enjoy a cool beverage.  Some torn pages are tucked beneath the cushions of one of the larger chairs.

title: [Delirium Manor, Side Porch]
description: A small penned-off section on this airy side porch is lined with paper flooring.  Tiny bowls contain water, and an overturned dish of meat scraps has been left unattended.  Bits of fur collect in the corners, and a large animal bone has been gnawed clean, dressed only in tiny scrapes and toothmarks.  An occasional giggle from across the side lawn draws attention to a small child running gleefully, chasing a mischievous puppy.

title: [Delirium Manor, Back Porch]
description: A trio of hammocks webbed in white cotton sway gently with passing breezes.  Anchored by S-shaped hooks to the sturdy porch posts, they offer a relaxing spot for visitors and houseguests to enjoy the view.  Small tables placed beside them hold refreshments for young and old alike.  Wide porch steps lead down to an arched latticework trellis and offer access to the gardens beyond.

title: [Delirium Manor, Side Porch]
description: Painted wooden wagons large enough for up to three children are lined up against the manor's exterior wall, as though someone were opening a livery.  Chalk drawings in pastels and white have turned the plank flooring into a grand gallery of puppies, kittens, ponies, and a parade of small blue spheres marching across the floor.

title: [Delirium Manor, Front Gates]
description: Nestled between two white stone pillars painted with red striping is a grand wrought iron gate, masterfully designed with decorative metalwork throughout.  Iron letters arc above the framework and spell out, "DELIRIUM MANOR."

title: [Delirium Manor, Entry Hall]
description: Alternating tiles of black and white marble, though elegant in design, give a whimsical welcome with chalked barefoot footprints marching across every other tile.  Thick arrows scrawled with various words serve as directional guides to other areas, and a grand staircase leads to the manor's upper floors.

title: [Delirium Manor, Kitchen]
description: A medley of enticing aromas dance and mingle, filling the air with a fragrance that teases the palate.  Pots of soup burble on the stove, freshly baked breads await tasting on a wobbly sideboard, and pies cool upon the sill of an open window.  A trail of scraps and tiny pawprints leads into a curtained pantry.

title: [Delirium Manor, Nursery]
description: Beneath the eastern windows rests a yellow lace-ruffled cradle lined with soft and colorful fabrics.  A cushioned rocking chair carved in maple and teak are placed beside it.  An oval yellow woolen rug provides a soft surface upon which infants and toddlers can comfortably play.

title: [Delirium Manor, Dining Hall]
description: Dozens of tables clad in pristine white linens fill this open dining space.  Fine china and stemware garnish the tall tables, while wooden dishware and utensils serve as place settings on the smaller tables.  A basket of kittens is tucked in a corner, but none seem to be moving, and an odd smell emanates from within.  Wooden sideboards set with colorful platters grace the northernmost wall.

title: [Delirium Manor, Ballroom]
description: A painted wood-carved plaque hung above the entry proclaims this space to be, "The Ballroom."  Instead of a wide-open floor for dancing, the entire room is packed full of brightly colored balls.  Large ones, small ones, and a few so tiny they appear more like pebbles, cover the entirety of the wood paneled floor.  Two floor-to-ceiling windows have cracked and broken panes, marking where play apparently went out of control.

title: [Delirium Manor, Pantry]
description: Set beneath a narrow window, the shelving and racks in this little pantry are similar to any other.  The contents, however, are not.  Front and center is a basket of hands, though it is unclear whether they are real or manufactured.  Propped up heads, turned to face a panelled wall, are spaced across the lowest shelf.  Alongside the peculiar array are fruits, vegetables, and a few sacks of grain.

title: [Delirium Manor, Workshop Entry]
description: Dimly lit and musty smelling, this area is evidently not intended for guests.  The wide-open space appears to be roughly the size of the manor, but visible areas are neatly sectioned-off, each serving different functional purposes.  A massive chalkboard contains scrawled notes and drawings, most of which are half-erased.

title: [Delirium Manor, Basement]
description: The foul aroma of decay mingles with the heavy, earthy scent of the loose, moist soil underfoot, permeating the area with a nauseating stench.  Some small objects are scattered about, though hard to discern distinctly in the dim available light.  Some rest atop the soil, some poke out from beneath, and still others have been swept into small piles.  Small mounds of loosely packed dirt make the footing disturbingly treacherous.

title: [Delirium Manor, Painting Room]
description: An immense, seamless slab of polished amber and brown-speckled granite forms the primary horizontal work surface for this utilitarian room.  Buckets and palettes of paint in a rainbowed assortment are neatly labeled and set out for easy access.  A collection of glistening glass eyeballs stare up from the workbench beside a sign that reads, "Wet Paint."

title: [Delirium Manor, Storage Room]
description: Various sized baskets, crates, and boxes crowd the peripheral area.  Traversing the room's interior is difficult due to a large cluster of furniture.  A dozen human-sized dolls, all dressed in formal clothing and each holding a wine glass, are arranged in a seated position in padded rocking chairs.

title: [Delirium Manor, Upstairs]
description: A large, rectangular oil painting, framed in gold-leafed dried noodles, dominates the wall space at the top of the stairs.  Creaky floorboards sound an alert with the passing of each resident or guest.  A long, carpeted hallway extends off to the north and a shorter one leads to the south.

title: [Delirium Manor, South Hallway]
description: This small hallway is a bit quieter than the one to the north, with guestrooms for adult visitors tucked behind heavy teakwood doors.  Each door is slightly ajar, and each room appears abandoned.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Delirium Manor, Guestroom]
description: Rather austere and uninviting compared to the nearby childrens' rooms, this guestroom has only an adult-sized bed and one small nightstand for furnishings.  A narrow window latticed with iron bars is set high up on the exterior wall.

title: [Delirium Manor, North Hallway]
description: Diminutive doors painted with whimsical gnomes, fairies, and one oversized two-headed troll, head off in all directions.  A more austere dark mahogany door with a tarnished brass knob sits ajar at the far end of the hallway.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
