title: [Delirium Manor, Sewing Room]
description: An immense, seamless slab of polished black, silver-flecked granite forms the primary horizontal work surface for this utilitarian room.  An elderly elven seamstress, spectacles perched upon the bridge of her nose, works on the hem of a red-checkered sundress for the naked ragdoll beside her.  On closer inspection, it becomes clear that the seamstress is actually a life-sized doll, and that her sewing needle has not moved.

title: [Delirium Manor, Metalcrafts]
description: An immense, seamless slab of polished dark green, umber-striated granite forms the primary horizontal work surface for this utilitarian room.  A thick-walled, molded clay crucible rests upon an ash-filled forge.  Dirty canvas workgloves crafted with thick leather palms have been left on the granite worksurface, along with small cupels and tongs for handling heated metals.  Collections of hammered gears, hinged latches, and various fasteners are stocked and labeled in individual jars.

title: [Delirium Manor, Woodcrafts]
description: An immense, seamless slab of polished white granite with rust-colored inclusions forms the primary horizontal work surface for this utilitarian room.  A line of wooden horse heads with painted eyes and carved flowing manes rests upon the worktable.  Pull-toy dogs and donkeys are joined by pull-toy giraffes and sloths, all awaiting a final sanding.  Collapsed on the floor is a carved maple boy, joints splayed out with metallic springs.

title: [Delirium Manor, Alchemy Room]
description: An immense, seamless slab of pale polished granite shot with blue amphibole crystals forms the primary horizontal work surface for this utilitarian room.  Copper vats of greenish liquids emanate noxious vapors, pungent enough to burn nose hairs and make one's eyes water.  Racks of molded green candies are left to harden beside a stack of waxy paper squares.

title: [Delirium Manor, Girls' Bedroom]
description: Three small, pastel pink beds are lined up neatly against the far wall.  Lacy white curtains, slightly yellowed with age, flutter occasionally with errant breezes wafting through an open window.  A fuzzy stuffed pony protrudes from an open toy chest, set upon one corner of a floral patterned carpet.

title: [Delirium Manor, Girls' Bedroom]
description: Three small, pastel green beds are lined up neatly against the far wall.  Lacy white curtains, slightly yellowed with age, flutter occasionally with errant breezes wafting through an open window.  A fuzzy stuffed puppy protrudes from an open toy chest, set upon one corner of a floral patterned carpet.

title: [Delirium Manor, Girls' Bedroom]
description: Three small, pastel blue beds are lined up neatly against the far wall.  Lacy white curtains, slightly yellowed with age, flutter occasionally with errant breezes wafting through an open window.  A fuzzy stuffed kitten protrudes from an open toy chest, set upon one corner of a floral patterned carpet.

title: [Delirium Manor, Boys' Bedroom]
description: Three small wood-framed beds, each draped with a brown and gold plaid blanket, are lined up neatly against the far wall.  Blue cotton curtains, slightly frayed at the hems, flutter occasionally with errant breezes wafting through an open window.  A fuzzy stuffed elephant protrudes from an open toy chest, set upon one corner of a tartan plaid carpet.

title: [Delirium Manor, Boys' Bedroom]
description: Three small wood-framed beds, each draped with a blue and green plaid blanket, are lined up neatly against the far wall.  Blue cotton curtains, slightly frayed at the hems, flutter occasionally with errant breezes wafting through an open window.  A fuzzy stuffed monkey protrudes from an open toy chest, set upon one corner of a tartan plaid carpet.

title: [Delirium Manor, Boys' Bedroom]
description: Three small wood-framed beds, each draped with a red and black plaid blanket, are lined up neatly against the far wall.  Blue cotton curtains, slightly frayed at the hems, flutter occasionally with errant breezes wafting through an open window.  A fuzzy stuffed panther protrudes from an open toy chest, set upon one corner of a tartan plaid carpet.

title: [Delirium Manor, Master Bedroom]
description: This spacious master retreat is an eclectic mix of child-centric and adult-centric possessions.  A small herd of tiny wooden horses graze beside empty whiskey bottles on a green-quilted, four-poster bed.  Bold drawings in chalk and colored wax are scrawled across the walls.  A floppy, red-haired ragdoll dangles lifelessly on a noose hung from a trapdoor in the ceiling.  Upon the nightstand, toy soldiers stand guard beside crystal bowls filled with stale ashes and the macerated stubs of old cigars.

title: [Delirium Manor, Crawlspace]
description: Clouds of dust and dried rodent feces billow up with even the lightest passing footstep.  Nails protrude downward from the low, slanted roofline overhead, posing significant threat to the taller races.  Atop the wide-planked floorboards, a disfigured baby doll awaits a ride in a discarded pull-toy wagon lying half-buried in the filth and debris.

title: [Delirium Manor, Attic Landing]
description: Only this tiny square of floor space beside the trapdoor is suitable for standing.  The roof pitches steeply downwards from this point in all directions, and moving further would seem a hazardous venture.

title: [Delirium Manor, Crawlspace]
description: Clouds of dust and dried rodent feces billow up with even the lightest passing footstep.  Nails protrude downward from the low, slanted roofline overhead, posing significant threat to the taller races.  From a low-hanging rafter, a lynched jester hand-puppet dangles limply at the end of a string.

title: [Pinefar, Snowy Owl Room]
description: The light is low and intimate in the chamber, intruding through a window shadowed by pine branches outside and a linen drape within.  Across the walls, a fine pattern of feathers is painted with delicate color and a light touch.  A heavy, modwir bed sits in the corner, fitted with fawn-colored linens and a bright-hued quilt that offers most of the color in the room.

title: [Pinefar, Wolf Lair Room]
description: The bedroom is an intimate chamber, with its pine walls, over-stuffed armchair and polished plank floor.  The moonlight is dim owing to a pine tree outside which shadows the window with its thickly needled branches.  Opposite the chair, a modest bed sits beneath a group of engravings hung upon the wall in a precisely spaced row.

title: [Pinefar, Snowdrift Room]
description: Moonlight from a large, multi-paned window brings out the luster of the pine-paneled walls.  The window offers an expansive view of the forest, the conifers with their heavy mantles of snow standing on the ridges and inclines like so many soldiers at attention.  The bedroom is cheerful, sporting crisp gingham curtains, oak furnishings and a bounty of moonlight.

title: [Pinefar, Bridal Suite]
description: The walls of the parlor are hung with indigo-colored velvet drapes in deep, rich folds that make the chamber seem more like it's an exotic tent retreat rather than a sitting room in a range of rugged mountains.  A couple of chairs flank a generous sofa, and a bar sits against the far wall offering refreshments.  On the sofa and chairs, a few white, lace-covered pillows add a splash of light to the room's deep blue, like stars in a night sky.

title: [Pinefar, Bridal Bedroom]
description: The bedroom is as plush with velvet as the sitting room guarding its entrance.  The deep indigo has given way, though, to crimson as saturated and rich as blood.  A thick, white bearskin rug covers the floor, matching white, lace-covered pillows and snowy linens on the bed.  From behind the velvet curtains, a window offers a peek at a spectacular moonlit view of the mountains.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, War Room]
description: The room is bare but for a long conference table and a number of chairs pushed under it while not in use.  Situated in the middle of the table is a map of Wehnimer's Landing and nearby environs.  Neatly lined up on one side of the map are a set of miniatures depicting Hendoran troops and potential enemies.  Near a small window rests an empty gilded birdcage.

title: [Amalfya's Outfitting]
description: Honey gold oak walls rise from a honey gold oak floor.  Just above a bathing maiden statue hangs a peacock feather fan, and an oak-framed ceiling completes the picture.  A dovetailed oak table and a narrow glass-topped table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Upper Hall]
description: Two tall Imperial soldiers stand on either side of a set of large wooden doors engraved with a simplified version of the crest of North Hendor.  A hallway leads westward, while the wide stairwell offers an avenue by which to return to the first floor.  Next to each guard is a banner, one showing the crest of the Earl of North Hendor and the other stitched with the name of the House Andrews.

title: [Tramwal's General Store]
description: Smooth white plaster walls rise from a russet oak floor.  Just above a knotted woolen rug hangs a colorful Icemule map, and an oak beam ceiling completes the picture.  A long varnished counter and a large brass-bound chest stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Upper Hall]
description: A thick, but plain, carpet runs the length of the hallway, muffling sounds and offering some escape from the hard surface of the building's stone construction.  Two doors face each other, one to the south and the other to the north.  The northern door appears to have magical sigils carved into its surface and runes painted above the entryway.  The opposite, southern door is plain.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Upper Hall]
description: A narrow window offers a view of the inner courtyard below and in case of emergency, an archer's perch for the determined defenders of the outpost.  The hallway is divided by a thick brown bearskin rug that runs its length, separating two sets of doors.  A single Hendoran guard stands sentry beside the iron-bound wooden doorway.

title: [Amalfya's Weaponry]
description: Dark oak walls rise from a polished oak floor.  Just above a suit of silver-chased armor hangs a ruby-pommeled longsword, and a varnished oak ceiling completes the picture.  A dovetailed oak table and a narrow glass-topped table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Amalfya's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the oak floor is interrupted by a stuffed grizzly bear.  Halfway to the oak beam ceiling, a stuffed caribou head hangs on one of the pale oak walls.  A low wrought iron table is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Rooftop]
description: Stone ramparts line the entire perimeter of the rooftop, each section evenly spaced and fortified to allow equal protection and a staging ground for archers.  Rising from the center of the area is a crisp silver flag emblazoned with a silver phoenix and it flaps with the slightest of wind.  Beyond the highest point of the outpost, the grasslands stretch out far to the south before they disappear into the forest, and the palisade walls and buildings of Wehnimer's Landing expand to the north.

Beyond the highest point of the outpost, the grasslands stretch out far to the south before they disappear into the forest, and the palisade walls and buildings of Wehnimer's Landing expand to the north.

title: [Tramwal's General Store]
description: A peacock feather fan hangs on one of the smooth white plaster walls, and an oak beam ceiling rises overhead.  A bathing maiden statue sits in one corner of a russet oak floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and a narrow glass-topped table on the other.

title: [Tramwal's General Store]
description: Smooth white plaster walls rise from a russet oak floor.  Just above a polar bear rug hangs a midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry, and an oak beam ceiling completes the picture.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case and a dovetailed oak table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, South Ward]
description: Arched windows with narrow slits along each wall of this stone room provides ample line of sight on the environs surrounding the outpost.  Racks of spears and javelins are positioned near windows, and hooks jut out from the walls with quivers of arrows hanging from them.  Through the view of a window, a crisp blue banner embroidered with a silver phoenix flaps in the wind.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, North Ward]
description: Arched windows with narrow slits along each wall of this stone room provides ample line of sight on the environs surrounding the outpost.  Racks of spears and javelins are positioned near windows, and hooks jut out from the walls with quivers of arrows hanging from them.  Through the view of a window, a crisp blue banner embroidered with a silver phoenix flaps in the wind.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Feast Hall]
description: A number of tables and chairs are set against the walls of the hall, waiting the next meal or well attended meeting.  At the end of the hallway is a wide stairwell with two Imperial soldiers standing sentry at its base.  Hendoran military banners decorate the stone walls along with flags of defeated enemies, a ragged Nalfein banner among them.

title: [Outpost, Inner Courtyard]
description: An imposing stone tower stands at the center of the inner courtyard, taking up the majority of the space.  Similar to the build of the rest of the outpost, the windows of the tower are narrow and better designed for arrows and defense than to offer light and a scenic view.  A wing extends from the tower's north side and soldiers continually file northward back and forth from it.

title: [Outpost, Inner Courtyard]
description: The entryway into the inner courtyard is a mirror image of the entryway into the outpost but constructed of stone.  The use of stone amplifies the sounds of the busy outer courtyard creating the sensation of immersion in the Hendoran presence in the north.  Arrow slits line the walls of the entryway and trapdoors, portals for boiling oil, gaze down from the ceiling.

title: [Light of the Godking]
description: A warm halo of sunlight filters through the crystalline dome above, each facet of the glass casting a bright golden mosaic along the textured stone floor.  The smooth stone walls of the shrine are enameled with the image of a large golden crown.  A track of worn, ashen grey carpet begins at the double doors and divides the chamber until ending just before a wide stone dais.  Upon the raised platform is a high altar crafted from blood marble, its soft white surface speckled with sanguine motes.

title: [Outpost, Inner Courtyard]
description: Soldiers sit and stand about the courtyard.  Many are engaged in time wasting activities, reading pamphlets and letters, tossing dice, and whittling pieces of wood.  Others quietly polish their equipment or chitchat about the nearby town or loved ones back home.  A squat wood building, a smaller version of one in the courtyard is built at the edge of the space.

title: [Outpost, Inner Courtyard]
description: The thick aroma of grilled fish lingers in the air of the inner courtyard near a separate stone building immediately adjacent to the tower.  A covered well is placed in the center of the space and is accompanied by stores for food, such as sacks of oats, and other supplies constructed to hug the inner stone wall's surface.  Hendoran auxiliaries come and go carrying food into the keep or bringing back used plates and containers.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Library]
description: The room is small, but filled with a number of book-laden shelves.  Several simple wooden chairs, which fill the room with the scent of fresh construction, offer sitting spaces for those wishing to partake in the library's offering.  A writing desk is set to one side with a stack of clean papers, inkwells, and quills, a station for soldiers wishing to write home to loved ones.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Alchemist]
description: A thick wooden table sits beneath a wide wood-framed blackboard and dominates the center of the room, where it is surrounded by a number of locked chests and trunks, many of them labeled with the crest of the Hall of Mages.  Large curtains flank an arched rune-etched window, allowing for the quick extinguishing of light, while numerous candles in various states of melted usage perch from precarious places throughout the room.  The faint aroma of sulphur and herbs lingers in the air of the area.

title: [Irregulars Barracks, Mess Hall]
description: Six long tables flanked by benches span the length of the room, and the heavy aroma of roasted meat and vegetables permeates the air.  A large sideboard boasts an impressive array of foods and desserts, as well as a rhimar ice bucket containing the chilled beverages.  Hanging on the farthest wall are two paintings.  A pair of large double doors lead out to the courtyard.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, west

title: [Irregulars Barracks, War Room]
description: This is a large and spacious room, well-lit by numerous spherical iron lanterns hanging from the walls.  Dominating the room is a round red mahogany table, its lustre catching the ambient light and reflecting it.  Matching chairs surround the table, and the walls are papered with maps of the local wilds.  A smooth teak ladder in the west corner of the room disappears through a dark trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [Irregulars Barracks, Dormitory]
description: This room is oblong and spacious.  Below a gilt-framed detailed painting, a stone and oak fireplace dominates the north wall, providing warmth to the living quarters.  Overfilled bookcases line the western wall, and a few tables and chairs occupy the floor nearby.  Neatly arranged bunk beds form two rows along the northern wall, each with a heavy foot locker at the end, providing storage for those who reside here.

title: [Barracks, Banquet Hall]
description: Natural light pours through lancet windows set along the southern wall, transformed into myriad shades of color by the intricate stained glass mosaics of each.  Thick timbers run the length of the ceiling, adding contrast to the warm stone of the walls.  Opposite a long banquet table ringed with lacquered chairs is a small stage framed in grey velvet curtains.  The wide-planked fel floors are polished to a high gloss, reflecting light from wrought-iron chandeliers above.

title: [Irregulars Barracks, Offices]
description: Several mismatched desks with high leather-backed chairs sit in the center of this small room, arranged to face each other.  A large leaded glass window on the south wall affords a view of the courtyard.  A tall modwir cabinet containing several drawers stands to the side of a large brass door.

title: [Irregulars Barracks, Rooftop]
description: Abutted against the town wall, the roof of the barracks is at the perfect height to peer over the top of the palisade down to the western road and the forests beyond.  Faint sounds of waves emanate from the dark bay to the northwest, and the combined scents of salt and loam permeate the surrounding air.  A rough teak trapdoor leads back down into the barracks.

Abutted against the town wall, the roof of the barracks is at the perfect height to peer over the top of the palisade down to the western road and the forests beyond.  The sparkle of sunlight glints off the bay to the northwest, and the combined scents of salt and loam permeate the surrounding air.  A rough teak trapdoor leads back down into the barracks.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Grimy copper-banded barrels, dented and scarred from misuse, stand to the side of a series of iron-barred cells.  Each barrel is filled to overflowing with tattered and rotting garments, most of which are so faded that it is hard to discern their original hues.  One barrel lies on its side, pinned between a cell wall and another container, its contents spilled in a heap across the stained decking.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Caravan Consignments]
description: Natural pine encloses this compact space, from vaulted ceiling to rough polished floor.  A row of paned windows, set above a long brushed steel counter, makes up the full length of one wall.  Opposite the counter stands a small table, with two benches placed on either side affording a comfortable place to sit.  A narrow red door, flanked by a pair of tall cubbyholes, leads back to the world outside, while a golden oak arch on the other side of the room beckons customers to a small alcove in the back.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Rusted buckets, some so corroded that their bottoms have decayed into a red-brown mesh, lie scattered around a copper-chained bilge pump.  Strands of thick white cobwebs coat the tangled mass and are pocketed with darker cocoons of spider eggs.  A particularly hairy grey spider scurries from the mass toward a pile of rotting straw that protrudes from one of the cells.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Caravan Consignments, Alcove]
description: Serving a dual purpose, this little alcove offers a small amount of respite from the flurry of activity in the main room.  Tucked in one corner, a porcelain washbasin perched on a gold pedestal rests near a white cotton cloth on a small, brushed steel hook and a cedar waste bin.  Hung above the basin, a vaalin-framed oval mirror allows for a moment of vanity.  Reflected in the mirror's polished surface is a tall closet that stands just inside the golden oak arch framing the view of the room outside.

title: [Boil and Toil]
description: Crafted with a high, domed roof, the wagon has a large interior, which is filled with various items used in alchemy.  A stack of cauldrons dominates one corner, while several crates of jars, vials and flasks fill another.  Partially hidden by a large copper rack, a narrow door is set in the back wall.  A small cloth-covered opening leads out to a tented area next to the wagon.

title: [Smuggling Tunnels, Black River]
description: Water rushes all around you, swirling and splashing black liquid to and fro.  The current is particularly strong on the side nearest the open space of the cavern, visibly creating eddies that look as if they might suck you under.  The middle of the river, however, allows you to stay afloat and fight, though not easily, being pulled further downstream.  Opposite the slick rock ledge leading into the cavern, a rockslide rife with boulders and rocks of all sizes leads up to a massive hole in the wall.

title: [Pelil's Costumery]
description: Shimmering walls of gold silk stretch out, each supported by wooden posts to make up the front room of the tent.  Numerous costumes are on display, ranging from all manner of creatures and races and styles, each organized neatly throughout the area.  A shimmering gold silk curtain leads deeper inside the tent.

title: [Instrumentality]
description: Swathes of striped linen partition the interior into several sections grouped by wares.  While the shop is slightly cramped, there is still adequate space to navigate between inventory displays and reach other areas of the tent.  Straw-stuffed crates have been stacked beside an open iron-bound chest on one side of the path, while a cloth-covered table stands opposite them.

title: [Off the Beaten Trail]
description: Thick oak poles stand in each corner of the tent, holding the oilcloth canopy up overhead.  A round marble pedestal sits off in one corner of the tent, while a large mahogany map table occupies much of the central floor space.  An oilcloth flap hangs across the rear of the tent, concealing the back portion of the structure.

title: [Playing Dead, Showroom]
description: Decorated in muted dark tones, the small showroom features an elegantly carved ebony coffin to one side and a velvet-draped table to the other.  A simple dark grey curtain partially obscures a doorway leading to the back of the wagon.  One of the candles has been snuffed out on the far wall, leaving a corner shrouded in shadow.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Monira Bridge]
description: The pure white expanse of snow tapers off as it reaches a broad, briskly flowing tributary that divides the unsettled wilderness from the cliff-nestled cove below.  Forming a gracefully arcing passage to the front gates ahead, a high-peaked white monir moon bridge is ornamented with the intricate carvings of shifting lunar phases.  Gleaming waterways branch throughout the town, all surging toward the unfathomable mass of the Great Western Sea just beyond the shoreline.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Promenade]
description: The moon bridge descends directly into the heart of the inland port, bordering a vast red cedar dock established over an ample portion of the sea, adjoining firths, and rocky shoreline.  Aqueous particles linger heavily in the atmosphere, haloing each iron lantern in delicate, bubble-like glow that illuminates the walkway with golden light.  A frosty mist is pulled in from the outlying waters, adding a salty brine to the delicate scent of pine perfuming the air.

title: [Futile Gestures]
description: Small glass lanterns hang precariously from buffed brass hooks, designed to provide enough light to examine wares carefully.  Wall panels painted a willow green hue complement the panels of rustic oak flooring, and a short glass-topped counter dominates the rear of the wagon.  Shelves of applewood and cherrywood are strategically dotted about the walls.

title: [Friendly Necessities, Shop]
description: The interior of this little shack is brightly lit and smells faintly of wet dog.  A small caramel-colored dog, surrounded by her little brood of sleeping pups, watches warily from a thick pallet of blankets off in one corner.  Along the back wall are a series of shelves and a row of rough-cut oak pegs.

title: [Quiver And Despair]
description: Set side by side in the center of the floor are a vaalin-banded heavy crossbow bolt trunk and a glaes-banded light crossbow bolt chest.  Immediately behind them rests a glass-topped arrow display.  The remainder of the wagon houses a few flickering lanterns, hung from beams overhead, and numerous archery targets that decorate the walls.

title: [Get A Grip]
description: Thousands of colorful glaes scarabs have been threaded into the woven canvas of the tent's roofing.  A large lantern hung from one of the tent poles provides illumination, the light scattering off the glaesine surfaces above.  Piled neatly in the far corner of the tent is an impressive array of broken locks, latches, keys, and other mechanisms.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Dilapidated Yard]
description: All around, large banyan trees and black ash hover like parents over children.  Lanterns lit with bright flames hang around the dilapidated fence, which is so ridden with rot, holes, and breaks in the wood that it can't rightly be called a proper enclosure.  Some distance across from a half-built barn are a shack leaning far to the left, a small crumbling stone structure, and wooden shed.  Dark muck and puddles of mud riddle the ground, and a fine mist of what can only be spores hangs in the air.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest

title: [On the Lighter Side]
description: Lengths of velvet hanging from the support beams above separate the large pavilion into several sections.  A make-shift floor of modwir tiles covers the ground, creating an elegant patterned floor.  Large window openings in the walls allow moonlight in to brighten the area.  Draped in ivory silk, a large archway is flanked by a pair of tables.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, northwest, out

title: [Northern Fortress, Drill Hall]
description: Maple plank flooring, inlaid with walnut parquetry, employs areas marked off where sparring and formation training can be performed.  Tapestries depicting key battlefield tactics and maneuvers adorn the stone walls.  Hanging from the rafters above, a dozen brightly lit oil lamps illuminate the room.

title: [The Blackshire Emporium]
description: Black tallow candles on scrollwork iron sconces flank the entry, casting a tainted light across the interior of the wagon.  The matte dark purple walls, painted with glossy thin ebon stripes, reach from the black carpeted floor to the matching ceiling that arches overhead.  Small ebonwood shelves line the walls, their surfaces strewn with oddities and knick knacks.  An iron scrollwork table and chairs sits near the eastward passage, laden with refreshments to beckon shoppers further inside.

title: [A Fine Line Between]
description: Arcing above, a massive dome covers the central chamber of the tent, its height held aloft by large poles of polished ironwood.  Bronze lanterns with etched panes hang from each post.  The tent walls ripple as the dark velvet is caught by a light wind from outside.  Built between two of the supports is an oblong table covered with a length of black silk.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, out

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.

title: [Time is the Fire, Flames]
description: Patterns of wavering yellow, orange, and scarlet silk dance beneath the light of a hundred candles' flames.  The candles are arranged on spiraled shelves branching out from the carved tent pole.  Around the outer ring of the tent, a circular table holds a variety of polished hourglasses.

title: [The Painted Talon]
description: Neatly arranged with a lineup of colorful miniature bottles, the entire back wall is fashioned from a set of polished ebonwood racks.  Well-featured in the foreground of the room are a wide-set spalted maple cabinet and a stately carved cedar stand stocked with fabric wares.  The walls are interspersed with scintillating bronze and copper tendrils woven into the dark woodwork, highlighting the warm glow of several glass-domed beeswax candles that are alight about the shop.

title: [The Painted Talon, Gallery]
description: The wagon's heart opens to a hourglass-shaped room, with the high-reaching walls cloaked in jade and onyx brocaded silk.  Fluently leading customers to a spade-footed black willow display and a mirrored dark walnut bureau, a curved pathway continues towards some glass-topped cases placed under numerous shadowy landscape-painted canvases.  A flatwoven cloth-of-copper rug worked with tea roses separates the commodities from a pair of bronze-handled doors.

title: [Drinkin' Steins]
description: Wide wooden planks stained with muddy footprints stretch across the wagon floor.  Heavy taupe fabric drapes over high-arching, wooden bows, creating the illusion of spaciousness in the wagon.  Rows of velvet covered shelves displaying a collection of wares line the wagon sides.  A woven tapestry hangs over an opening leading deeper into the wagon's interior.  An iron-banded wooden cask sits beside a sturdy table near the door.

title: [Drinkin' Steins Alcove]
description: An illustrated poster of steins and stein parts has been mounted above a large sturdy workbench on the back wall which is half-covered with an assortment of steins in various stages of completion.  A messy pile of misshapen steins and other discarded materials have been tossed into the back corner of the wagon.  A variety of mismatched, well-used floor pillows are strewn about for patrons to sit on and enjoy.

title: [Woeful Wines, Work Room]
description: An oversized oil portrait of a grim old woman dominates this otherwise desultory workspace.  A trio of wooden benches are pointed at the portrait, almost in respect, while a multitude of candles, dead flowers, and other totems of affection litter the floor beneath it.

title: [Woeful Wines, Sales Room]
description: Decorated almost entirely in shades of black, this excessively decorated tent could almost be mistaken for a funeral home.  Death masks, somber portraits, and other grim mementos clutter nearly every available wall and surface.  Only a solitary display of champagne bottles, guarded by a somber sales clerk, betrays the fact that this is a shop at all.

title: [Bowties and Bourbon, Foyer]
description: Dominating the center of the room is a chiseled glaes fountain, the maiden's forms posed towards a stag-carved mahogany bar.  Curve-accented statues of alabaster and ivory each offer a view of the shop's wares, their flat silvered trays held aloft.  Brushed lion and tiger hides serve as elaborate runners, leading to merchandise held elsewhere within the shop.

title: [Come To Heel, Showroom]
description: Candlelit globes flicker above ivory-hued silks draped from the top of the wagon, creating softly illuminated panels that gleam across the polished hardwood floors.  Silk slippers, velvet-lined fel chopines, and spike-heeled leather shoes are showcased on top of a silvered glass display case in the center of the room across from a spindly ivory-inlaid table, some woven reed baskets filled with vendible items stacked underneath.  A large window fixed with a plush velvet-cushioned seat is stationed next to a brass-handled door.

title: [Delightful Diversions]
description: This room has been decorated in bright, vivid colors.  The corrugated walls create variegated stripes, down which are painted some tiny gumdrops, lollipops, and lots of bright jelly beans.  A bent iron chandelier hangs from the center of the ceiling, covered with the wax of dozens of multicolored candles.  A large toy chest covered in scribblings sits against one wall beneath a stick figure drawing.  A small table sits near a splotchy dented door.  Beneath it stands a red wicker basket with a crumpled note stuck onto the handle.  A tall bookshelf supports containers of many shapes and sizes.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Treasure Room]
description: The room is unlit and filled primarily with an almost tangible darkness.  Thin shafts of light leak in through narrow gaps in the wooden bulkheads, coming to rest on metallic objects and reflecting faintly onto neighboring items.  Mixed piles of unrelated objects - coins, gems, weaponry and armor - fill the entire chamber.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Instrumental Interlude, Den]
description: The sound of water flow is loud here, echoing in layers to form a constant ambient rushing noise.  The embers from a long dead fire are scattered across the stone floor, originating from a ring of stones off in one corner.  A rotting bedroll in another corner has been gnawed on by several generations of rats, their feces and bones littering the moldering cloth.  From a niche in the wall, a lone candle illuminates much of the small room, leaving only the tunnel leading out to remain in the shadows.

title: [The Idle Edge]
description: The wagon has limited lighting spaced out and focused to shine on a blackened counter and a sturdy rack while keeping most of the area in shadows.  A modwir sign sits against the counter half lit by one of the lights overhead.  There is a persistent musty smell coming through the curtained door at the back of the wagon.

title: [Bow and Prey, Tools]
description: This section of the pavilion is a bit cramped, with a scarred and stained oak table occupying nearly the entirety of the back wall.  A small wall-mounted case is fixed above the table, and across the way is a tiered oaken bow rack.  An aged parchment sign has been tacked to the lower edge of the wall-mounted case.

title: [Bow and Prey, Paints]
description: Lined up on shelves affixed to the supports of the pavilion are several vials and bottles filled with powdered pigments, while overhead hang drying bundles of herbs and flowers.  Against the far wall, a many-shelved oak cabinet sits with its doors propped open, and on one of its shelves is a carved maple tray.

title: [Bow and Prey]
description: Wooden planks span the interior of the pavilion to serve as a makeshift floor, while sparse furs of varying species act as a sort of carpeting.  Racks hung along the walls stretch pieces of sinew taut to dry, and others display a variety of disembodied feathered wings stretched wide.  In the air, the faint scent of rosin lingers.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Bow and Prey, Workroom]
description: A half-moon worktable sits in this central area of the tent, and behind it is a leather-cushioned stool with a slatted wooden back.  Displays of bowstrings and arrowheads hang from the support beams in ready-reach of the worktable, and a crate sits off to one side, half full of split pieces of wood, frayed bowstrings, and other sundry items.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Bow and Prey, Feathers]
description: Bundles of feathers hang from lengths of twine that zig-zag between the overhead beams, arranged according to color and length.  An aged parchment sign hangs above a peg-lined oaken display mounted on one of the pavilion's supports, and beneath the display is a small woven reed basket.

title: [Treasure Trove]
description: Glittering mica in the walls reflects the glow from the candlelabra that dot the surface, creating a shimmering rainbow of color.  The stone floor is rough but level, providing a suitable surface on which to walk.  A section of the wall is carved out to make a shelf, and recessed lighting provided by small lanterns illuminates the contents.  Mostly hidden by the curvature of the walls, a jagged crack looms in one corner like a darkened maw, while the cave opening offers random gusts of fresh air from outside.

title: [A Teak Shack, Pole Party]
description: Narrow teak planks bound together by thick twine run the length of the wall.  In the rear of the room, a teak beaded curtain beckons entry.  A slightly lowered basin constructed around the floor is filled with sand and assorted seashells of all shapes and sizes.  A pair of evenly spaced palm trees leans over a long wooden footlocker in the center of the room.

title: [Ruined Office]
description: Complete with a plethora of disintegrating wooden beams overhead and entirely missing sections of wall, the building is in shambles.  Dirt, sludge, and cobwebs cling to every surface, the chill wafts of air constantly breezing through disturbing their sleep and creating a mist of dust that permanently swirls through the space.  In a shadowed corner, broken shards of glass scatter across a massive, rotting wooden desk overturned in haphazard fashion.

title: [Blacksmith's Stall]
description: Three large, open air firepits flare and crackle in a line just outside the covering of a stone roof supported by a number of heat-blackened pillars.  Metal shavings and fallen droplets lie swept into a neat pile in one corner of the clear, hard-packed dirt floor.  Several aprons hang from a long iron peg pounded into a broad wooden pole.

title: [Sing Me an Epithet]
description: Surrounded by walls of long, woven swamp grass, the tent smells about as good as it looks.  The odor of skunks and slime pervades the small area with a noxious scent.  In the center of the room, a circular oak pedestal leans slightly to one side, yet still manages to display its wares to shoppers.  Against the far wall, a makeshift wooden counter seems to have been added as an afterthought.  The two exits are merely holes that appear to have been torn in the grass walls.

title: [Cache Cabin]
description: A flock of lacquered ebonwood chests are strewn around the timeworn room, intensely contrasting against the ashen floor underfoot.  At the heart of the space, a wide green amber slab elevates a fauna-intaglio glaes casket littered with prismatic crystals.  An eerie pale sheen is cast over a faded driftwood sideboard, falling from an offering of half-melted beeswax candles gathered on the sides.

title: [Monumental Mementos]
description: The musty room is unusually cool.  Knotted pine walls are partially covered with somber-colored banners that hang loosely from roof to floor, adding an air of solemnity to the room.  A fine dust pervades the air and plays within a stream of light emanating from a rough-hewn oak door.  A large stone bench rests upon the solid floor.  Adjacent to the bench is a wide, solid set of shelves with items resting upon them.

title: [Pucker Up]
description: Mauve sillk curtains cover a large bay window, while numerous silver oil lamps flicker gaily, casting the entire shop in warm light.  A small oval table stands between a polished mahogany display and a black walnut display, supporting a few mirrors and an embossed white card.  A portrait in fine oils hangs on the back wall, depicting two elves in a tender kiss.

title: [Like Nobody's Watching, Entry]
description: The entry to the tent is cool and dark, offering relief from the elements outside.  The far wall is blank, save for a beaded curtain serving as the only break in the opaque black silk.  Arches to the east and west lead deeper into the structure, and a soft crimson carpet dampens the sound of footfalls on the floor.  Near the tent's flap is a metal rack that dangles scarves in myriad colors.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Broken limbs lie in scattered heaps across the soggy ground, their ends clawed and chewed upon by some unseen animal.  A narrow tree-enshrouded path leads further into a thick wooded pass, away from the swamp.  Sprouting out of their rotting expanses are tubes of wild mushrooms with cup-shaped heads and blue-green blades of wildrye.  A thin trail of stones winds its way through the slogging mud and provides a solid means of egress from the area.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Broken limbs lie in scattered heaps across the soggy ground, their ends clawed and chewed upon by some unseen animal. title: [Line in the Sand]
description: Latticed walls of supple birch encompass the circular dwelling, wide diamonds of rough spun canvas visible through the narrow wooden bands.  Underfoot, several richly detailed, plush rugs line the unfinished pine floor that fills the expanse.  Situated on opposite sides along the perimeter of the circle, an oversized oak chest and a weathered maple trunk overflow with goods.

title: [Bowties and Bourbon, Vanity]
description: Alternating teak and linden-panelled walls frame a number of plaque-mounted trophies, the preserved creatures each displaying various types of wares hanging from closed jaws.  A tall onyx-framed mirror leans against the back of the shop, flanked by a pair of iron-banded oak barrels serving as makeshift displays.  Posed against the right wall is a smooth alabaster statue, her etched alum tray pointed back towards the entrance of the shop.

title: [Bowties and Bourbon, Chamber]
description: A half-circle of velvet-padded teakwood chairs surround a jet-lacquered table, the rectangular surface held aloft by a quartet of carved elven maidens.  The faint scent of bourbon and freshly lit cigars permeate the room, intermingling with traces of a light, floral perfume.

title: [Come to Heel, Reception]
description: A narrow, ivory wool carpet leads from a brass-handled black fel door through rows of carefully stacked boxes to a glass-topped lacquered fel desk in the rear of the wagon.  Behind the desk, a wing-backed red leather chair with a matching footstool is partitioned off behind a painted silk screen.

title: [Miasmic Verge, Outer Swamp]
description: Thickly knotted wildrye grass stretches across the landscape and fills every available space.  Blue-green blades gentle bend back upon themselves and, despite the hardy nature of the plant, display signs of browning upon their edges.  Upon the northern edge of the area, several tufts of grass have been uprooted, their worm-knotted roots exposed to the air.  Barely visible through foliage, an opening heading north can be seen, deep muck on both sides of it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west

title: [Instrumentality]
description: Colorful, overlapping rugs create uneven footing in this roomy section of the tent.  Scattered around the area are half-finished instruments leaning against posts and spread out on work surfaces.  The smell of curing wood lingers in the air, mingling with a faint smoky fragrance.

title: [Mikalmas's General Store]
description: Beneath a varnished golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Instrumentality]
description: A thick steel wire has been strung up between two of the tent posts, upon which hang a number of instruments.  Beneath the orderly display is a simple glass case illuminated by lit green and yellow votive candles.  A scratched wooden wardrobe doubles as a bookcase housing a number of music-related tomes and texts.  Nearby, a polished steel stand has been partially draped by a patchwork quilt, though most of its contents are visible from other areas of the tent.

title: [Stars Table]
description: Set deep under the spreading branches of the mighty oak, the Stars Table is constantly in deep shadow.  Small brass lanterns hang from long wires attached high in the oak, throwing patterns of swirling light across the top of the solidly built teak table.

title: [Wadsworth's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the black marble floor is interrupted by a sphere-topped black marble fountain.  Halfway to the golden oak ceiling, an ancient Tehiri ritual mask hangs on one of the smooth granite walls.  A beveled glass-covered case and a massive granite chest are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Cleodelia's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by refurbished driftwood walls, the shop features a multicolored giant toy rolton in the center of its honey oak floor.  A round mithril-framed window hangs under the skylight-set ceiling.  Right near the front is a bronze-framed clothing rack and a velvet-lined silver jewelry box.

title: [Cleodelia's Magic Shoppe]
description: A round mithril-framed window hangs on one of the refurbished driftwood walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a heavy lead glass display case on one side of the shop and a plain wooden table on the other.

title: [Cleodelia's General Store]
description: A candy-crafted ravenous kraken sculpture hangs on one of the refurbished driftwood walls, and a low syrup-flecked ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a heavy lead glass display case on one side of the shop and a long glass-topped counter on the other.

title: [Spider Temple, Escape Tunnel]
description: The low, narrow tunnel splits here with paths leading roughly east and southwest.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
description: A meshwork of veniom cables threads across the wooden bulkheads to either side of a sealed hatchway in the western wall.  Vivid blue-green light pulses through the frame of the hatch, accompanied by a persistent thrum that disturbs the air, like thunder without sound.  The light travels through the cabling, which bores into the body of the ship at points along the hull.

title: [Wadsworth's Weaponry]
[Wadsworth's General Store]
[Wadsworth's Magic Shoppe]
[Wadsworth's Armory]
[Wadsworth's Outfitting]
[Wadsworth's Combat Gear]
description: Smooth granite walls rise from a speckled black marble floor.  Just above a tiered alabaster fountain hangs an Arkati pantheon painting, and a varnished golden oak ceiling completes the picture.  A glaes-covered ebony display case and a brass treasure chest stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Wadsworth's Weaponry]
