[Wadsworth's Combat Gear]
description: Enclosed by smooth granite walls, the shop features a grey-veined white marble fountain in the center of its black marble floor.  An ornately rendered clan crest hangs under the golden oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a heavy lead glass display case and a giant invar-bound chest.

title: [Blacksmith, Scorched Hall]
description: The sound of hammers on anvils echoes down the hall, reverberating off of the scorched stone walls.  The air is heavy here and smoke trails past.

title: [Blacksmith, Scorched Hall]
description: The air shimmers from the heat, the stone walls are hot to the touch.  Clanging metal resonates from nearby.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
description: Daylight filters in through an ornate red bronze hatch in the ceiling, the ostentatious bronzework at odds with the simple, elegant care that has gone in to the stone-colored wood of the deck and paneled walls.  A spiraling stairway ascends up toward light and open sky.  Faint metallic whistling echoes down through the aperture, muted by distance so that it almost sounds like the music of woodwinds.

title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
description: An ornate red bronze hatch crowns the center of the upper deck, glistening from the polished greyish wood of the planking like a jewel in the sunlight.  Spiraling wooden steps proceed down into the covered main deck, their centers worn with the passage of many feet.  A ring of etched gold surrounds the hatch.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
description: An ornamental red brass grate in the ceiling lets in the occasional vivid glimpse of sky.  Sunlight streaming through its apertures awakens in the grey wood of the deck sparks of color that bring a fire's heart to mind.  Along the walls, a brass-marked claret door stands opposite a wing-marked carmine hatch.  Showcased on a wooden pedestal in the hallway separating them is an ancient astrolabe made of kelyn.

title: [Sold Souls, Salesroom]
description: Cabochon soulstones dangle from braided silver chains fastened to the ceiling, bits of emerald light glinting in their milky depths.  Bathed in their glow, a single branching ebony stand holds the only wares for sale on beds of night-hued velvet.  The sounds of the ship seem dimly muted, as if coming through swaddling cloth, though no such cloth exists to excuse the diminution.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
description: Framed by hanging curtains of burgundy velvet, a wide archway marks the forward end of the main deck.  It bears a rim of red brass and gold with a stylized phoenix of red lacquer at the zenith.  Nearby, a cross-hatched burnt sienna door breaks the paneled uniformity of the hallway's starboard wall.

title: [Marks of the Beast, Showroom]
description: Bone fetishes dangle from the wood plank ceiling, swaying slightly and clacking together in the heavy, incense-laden air.  Held aloft by a faceless stone idol near the entrance, a shallow bowl of polished flowstone holds glittering baubles within.  Beyond the stolid guardian is a tiered rack made of widowwood.  Like the golvern-inlaid hatch behind it, its flat surfaces are carved with leaping beasts.

title: [Marks of the Beast, Workroom]
description: Talon-shaped marks are etched into the warm red oak of the wall panels bordering a small golvern-inlaid hatch, the only means of egress from the small workroom.  A tidy worktable sits beneath a flameless lamp of rainbow glaes at the room's center.  Its surface is strewn with an odd hodgepodge of divination tools and articles of the jeweler's craft.  Carved wooden masks hang from one wall, worked to resemble the faces of a variety of beasts.

title: [The Firebird, Tip of the Talons]
description: Sprawling bay windows curve around the airship's forward bulkhead, providing an extraordinary view of the landscape ahead.  The windows are positioned immediately beneath the ship's massive avian figurehead, and its outstretched metal talons hang within view.  On the opposite wall, a bar of flame maple and golden oak panels is stocked with an impressive variety of liquors, spirits, and wines, the bottles backlit by a row of glimaerstone orbs.  Several stools sit before it.

title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
description: Shaded slightly by walls to either side supporting the port and starboard gangways, the upper deck is shielded from all but the strongest natural breezes, but not from the constant gusting of wind deflected by the whir of the propellers holding the ship aloft.  A towering blade assembly dominates the area, the crimson and golden lacquer adorning it vivid compared to the ash-colored wood of the deck.

title: [The Firebird, Fo'c'sle]
description: Rising above the ship's upper deck, but not so high as the towering metal blade assemblies that propel the craft and hold it aloft, the forecastle is a swathe of space shaped like an arrowhead, tapering to a point at the bow.  The gilded and burled railing, all wrought of ash-colored fireleaf, joins with the carved bowsprit at the absolute fore of the vessel.  To the rear of the deck, broad wooden stairs proceed down toward the upper deck.

title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
description: Covered by an arced ceiling of transparent glaes, the sternmost portion of the upper deck is shielded from the elements.  Several chairs and tables laze underneath the faceted dome, forming a small enclave away from the bustle of the rest of the ship.  Some smooth wooden stairs form a wide path up to the smaller quarterdeck.

title: [The Firebird, Quarterdeck]
description: The quarterdeck is a raised expanse toward the rear of the ship that looks out over the recessed upper deck.  Carved from smooth fireleaf and embellished with avian silhouettes, an ornate rail bearing a coat of gilt and red brass leaf surrounds the quarterdeck.  Luxuriant crimson pennants, each bearing a firebird in yellow embroidery, are strung between the propeller assemblies and the railing.  One strand of them flutters in the breeze, dipping low over some old wooden steps leading up to the aftercastle.

title: [The Firebird, Aftercastle]
description: Huge bronze cannons glare brightly from embrasures in the crennelated railing surrounding the sterncastle, guarding the rear of the ship like dogs on the watch.  A wheel embellished with gold and crimson lacquer stands at the center of the deck, carved of the same greyish fireleaf as most of the deck plankings, but polished to a glassy smoothness by the touch of many hands.  The raised deck provides an unobstructed view all the way to the bow of the ship.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
description: Lit from either side by a pair of glimaerstone lamps, the passage is split by a heavy red brass ladder leading down to the orlop.  The sounds of the weather deck overhead are muted by solid wood, but not entirely inaudible.  Everywhere there is a faint thrumming, as if the walls themselves were suffused with the life and pulse of a great beast.

title: [The Firebird, Orlop Deck]
description: Most of the narrow passageway is blocked by a heavy red brass ladder that proceeds up toward the main deck.  Veniom wires are inlaid into the wooden planks of the hull, pulsing occasionally with waves of sky blue light.  The steady pulses illuminate coiled lines and crates of cargo slumbering in the shadows.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
description: Crossed swords adorn one wall, still-honed edges gleaming dimly in the passway's half-light.  They hang opposite a brick-hued double door, the molding around which is marked with a pattern of interlocking feathers.  A faint acrid bite of wood polish lingers in the air.

title: [Covenants Kept, Entry]
description: Four hanging moons of colored glass hang from the overhead, lit from within to cast their commingled light on the shop foyer.  Statues, one dark and one pale, guard a trio of archways that lead off to the northeast, southeast, and east.  At the feet of each effigy sits a bowl holding a burning stick of incense, the heavy scent of which thickens the air.

Four hanging moons of colored glass hang from the overhead, lit from within to cast their commingled light on the shop foyer.  Statues, one pale and one dark, guard a trio of arches that lead off to the north, south, and east.  One of them holds a burning stick of incense, the heavy scent of which thickens the air.

title: [The Firebird, Orlop Deck]
description: A pile of braided lines blocks most of the southern hallway, aged but in good condition otherwise.  The smell of old, dry timbers is thick and sharp in the air.  What little illumination there is in the cramped space comes from sunlight burning through crevices and knots in the veniom-riveted planks forming the bulkheads.

title: [The Firebird, Orlop Deck]
description: The orlop terminates in a gilded red brass hatch in the northern bulkhead.  Fiery wings of gilt are painted onto the surrounding wood, spreading from the hatchway in a majestic span.  The crates and lines loading the orlop are cleared away from the entrance to allow easy access through the hatch.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
description: The northernmost stretch of the main deck dead-ends into a red-dyed sephwir hatch bordered to either side with spread-winged firebirds of gold leaf.  A set of initials are carved into the port bulkhead, the smooth and glistening wood around them testament to their resistance at attempted removal.

title: [Covenants Kept, Lornon Chamber]
[Covenants Kept, Black Room]
description: Swirling with tendrils of impenetrable vapor, the moon limned on the walls is so dark as to be nearly black, but bathed in a grim aura whose shade lies at the darkest vagaries of violet.  Far in the distance behind it, almost eclipsed by the moon's bulk, is another sphere that is but a small swirl of green and blue.  Laid out before the murals is a wide bed of black velvet.

title: [Covenants Kept, Grey Chamber]
[Covenants Kept, Grey Room]
description: Painted across the walls in vivid greens and blues is a shining sphere, whirling with shreds of white cloud and darkened by a partial eclipse.  The occluding body has left the surface of the world half in light; half in shadow.  A wide bed of grey velvet is spread out before the jewel-toned mural, light collecting on its folds in liquid pools.

title: [Covenants Kept, Liabo Chamber]
[Covenants Kept, White Room]
description: A tremendous mural dominates the bulkheads, portraying a silvery white moon at its gibbous zenith.  Two smaller moons, one dark and the other as red as flame, stand out against its pocked and riven surface.  Before the painting is spread a wide bed of white velvet, where neatly arranged wares have been laid out.

title: [The Firebird, Bowsprit]
description: A massive phoenix, wrought of fireleaf and plated with red brass and gold, spreads its wings beneath the bowsprit, screeching silent defiance at the skies.  Every feather is picked out in sheets of metal thinner than parchment.  Eyes of amber glare in the daylight, but their shine pales in comparison to the brilliance of a thousand and more glimaerstones set into the metallic plumage.  The gems collect the sun's fire and roil with greater radiance, wreathing the bird's form in flickering points of flame.

title: [The Firebird, Starboard Gangway]
description: The thin stretch of planking overlooks the lowered main deck on one side, and the Firebird's port propellers on the other.  All that stands between a clumsy passenger and a fatal topple over the side of the ship is fireleaf railing that is heavily gilded and bright with red brass ornamentation.

title: [The Firebird, Port Gangway]
description: The starboard gangway of the ship is a precarious path overlooking the bustling activity of the main deck, shielded from a drop overboard only by a red brass railing.  Whirring propellers, spreading from the hull of the ship like the wings of a bird, sing a high-pitched and metallic song, the pleasant drone of which denies the deadly nature of the blurring blades.

title: [Elderberry Room Locker]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Elderberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Elderberry Room]
description: Small-leaved vines with clusters of white flowers are painted around the arch leading back towards the main corridor.  Light green taffeta wallpaper covers the remaining walls, creating the impression that this is a garden retreat.

title: [Blacksmith, Slab Hall]
description: Massive bone golems stomp down the hall, carting huge chunks of metal in their arms.  The sound of hammers echoes nearby.

title: [Blacksmith, Slab Hall]
description: The shadowy forms of wraiths drift between large piles of metal slabs, consisting of mithril, glaes and vultite.  The heavy sound of feet stomping echoes down the hall.

title: [Blacksmith, Slab Hall]
description: The glimmer of fire can be seen in the distance, as the air waivers from the heat.  A line of bone golems meander towards the light, hauling huge metal slabs with them.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Rusted buckets, some so corroded that their bottoms have decayed into a red-brown mesh, lie scattered around a copper-chained bilge pump.  Strands of thick white cobwebs coat the tangled mass and are pocketed with darker cocoons of spider eggs.  A particularly hairy grey spider scurries from the mass toward a pile of rotting straw that protrudes from one of the cells.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Crystal Clove, Sovyn Shrine]
description: Beneath a high solid white ceiling set with a large circular skylight, a Liabo and Lornon painting hangs on one of the smooth white monir walls.  A tall light oak bookshelf and a wide light oak altar covered with a pristine white linen cloth sit in opposite corners while a large silver and white oval rug woven with a clasped-hands design rests on a silver-veined white marble floor.

title: [Crystal Clove, Arkati Armory]
description: A midnight-hued stained glass mosaic hangs on one of the weathered mistwood plank walls, and a tall wide-beamed ceiling rises overhead.  A pair of combat-locked statues sits in one corner of a distressed dark oak floor.  There is some polished black ash shelves on one side of the shop and some dark grey glaes display hooks on the other.

title: [Crystal Clove, Healing Touch]
description: A long beech mantel topped with various ointment jars and bandages hangs on one of the faewood-framed clear glass walls, and an arched glass ceiling rises overhead.  An oversized flower pot sits in one corner of a sandstone tiled floor.  There is a tall faewood cabinet on one side of the shop and a spacious silvery beech counter on the other.

title: [House Sovyn, Herb Garden]
description: A stone walkway weaves its way from the nearby pond and comes to an end at the foot of a large herb garden.  A narrow stone path loops around the garden, with several beds of herbs and flowers surrounding the outer perimeter.  At each corner of the garden, nestled within the plants, is an elegant marble fountain.  Inside the looping path and standing at the center of the garden is a towering faewood tree.  A trio of wooden statues stand at the base of the tree and are surrounded by numerous tiny flowers.

title: [House Sovyn, Empath's Lounge]
description: In this bright, airy room, a feeling of peace overcomes you.  Some soft comfortable-looking pillows are scattered across the floor near a window looking into the gardens.  Resting above the mantle of a fieldstone fireplace you notice an oddly compelling painting.  An old maoral wooden medicine cabinet stands in one corner of the room.

title: [Acantha Table]
description: Light filters through the greenery and onto the table.  A hand-painted pot with a flourishing acantha plant decorates the square marble top.  Soft embroidered pillows cushion the surrounding chairs.

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: Breaking around the shore of a broad forested island, two branches of the Mistydeep converge to resume their joint ramble southeastward.  Casting a long shadow across the water is a multi-turreted tower that reaches skyward.  The dusky granite, of which the tower is constructed, is so cunningly crafted that some portions appear carved from a natural rock formation.  Numerous narrow windows gape uncovered, revealing only darkness within.  Skirting the building, a tangled thicket keeps outsiders at bay.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: Tumbled from craggy hillsides now overgrown with trees, chunks of fractured shale and sandstone lie in jagged clumps along the west bank of the river.  A line of smaller rocks leads from the shore to one very large boulder that overlooks a particularly deep and clear section of river where large fish seem content to dwell.  As if to confirm the popularity of the site, fresh bear tracks and a few partially-eaten fish dot the surface of this particularly well-placed rock slab.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Imaera Table]
description: An ecru tapestry beautifully embroidered with a fruit harvest design covers this table.  A delicate hand-carved image of the goddess Imaera is upon it.  The cushions on the surrounding chairs are hand-stitched with images of plants and wild flowers.

title: [Praying Cleric Table]
description: The crisp white cloth looks even brighter as it reflects the light that floods through the glass walls.  A hand-carved figure of a kneeling cleric is on the table facing the sunrise, arms outstretched to embrace the morning light.

title: [Woth Flower Table]
description: A potted, blooming woth plant decorates the small square table.  The medicinal flowers brighten this corner of the room with their delicate violet petals.  The surrounding tapestry chairs are embroidered with leaves and flowers from the same plant.

title: [Healer Table]
description: Blue scroll embroidery runs along the edge of the white tablecloth.  A hand-carved miniature of a healer kneeling beside a wounded man to tend his wounds decorates the round table.  The tapestry upholstered chairs are also embroidered with the same scroll design.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Pushed up against the wall between two dirt piles, the skeleton of a vermin-like critter is surrounded by a buzzing field of flies and crawling with ghostly maggots, its rent flesh exposed and torn from the belly of the tiny body.  A fallen torch, flame long extinguished, is half atop the small corpse, possibly the cause of death.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Squat but wide, echoes ring out loudly in this mostly ruin rock hallway.  What little ambient light illuminates the way reflects off thin rivulets of trickle coming from the roots breaking through the earthen ceiling.  The crimson glow of vermin eyes flash every now and again, as the creatures meander from end to end of the passage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Two lone torches light the way, casting little illumination in the hallway to dispel the darkness.  Rubble from the crumbling ruin walls scatters across the ground, some of it half-buried and tromped into the muck formed by water trickling down upon the piles of dirt.  The air is chilled and dank with the added moisture.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Boulder-sized clumps of earth have dislodged from the ceiling, creating a series of dirt piles blocking direct forward egress down the corridor, despite the unusually wide girth of the passage.  A broken cart leans precariously against one wall, its contents spilling out the back and down onto the ruin floor.  The abandoned supplies are covered in a thick film of dust, forgotten despite the frequent traffic in the passage.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: As if the closing-in walls were not bad enough, a large chunk of the ruin's ceiling has fallen and smashed upon the floor, creating an obstacle to climb around or over in order to exit the tunnel.  Attempts have been made to chip away at the ruin's rubble, evidenced by the sharp gouges in the surface and piles of dirt lying around the base.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Small rocks fallen from a section of the crumbling wall spill out into the middle of the passage, making egress difficult for one, and especially complicated for more.  Small piles of dirt and pitted holes line the sides of the tunnel here.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: A musty odor fills the area, a combination of the moist dirt that forms the walls and floors, and decaying bits of worm and rodent packed within.  Bits of bone and stone randomly litter the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up, down

title: [Underground Temple, Excavation]
description: Miniscule snowflakes dance along frigid gusts that blow through the wide fissure.  Deep carvings along frosted walls are partially filled-in with snow and have transformed into magnificent natural bas-relief designs.  Piles of rubble and dirt signify a recent cave-in.

title: [DragonSpine, Icy Cliff]
description: A treacherous and impassible cliff, no more than two feet from the mouth of the cave, disappears into a wintery mix of fog and snow.  Eerie howls echo through the mountainous crevices and are unidentifiable whether from wind or some unfriendly foe.  Occasional breaks in the thick veil overhead allow warming rays of light to bleed through, but they are quickly snuffed by the heavy clouds and blinding sheets of falling snow.

title: [DragonSpine, Cavern Tunnel]
description: Despite evidence of a nearby lair, the steep tunnel offers welcomed protection against the brutal assaults from the powerful winds outside.  Preserved tufts of white fur matted with dried blood cling against the cave walls, frozen in time from territorial battles of the past.

title: [DragonSpine, Cavern Tunnel]
description: Solid sheets of ice makes for slippery traversing, but occasional snowy patches present alternate routes through the treacherous tunnel.  Faint light streams from the top of the perilous ramp and lends hope for safer footing.

title: [DragonSpine, Cavern Tunnel]
description: The upward path grows exceedingly steep and more dangerous.  Tracks in the icy floor lead downward, indicative of previous travelers who were unsuccessful in attempts to reach the top of the cavern.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Affording a bit of a glimpse ahead, a large chunk of one wall has fallen to the ground and smashed into shards and fist-sized stones amid the tiny pyramids of dirt.  The exit at the other end is clearly visible beyond the next weaving of the pass.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: At this end of the passage, a single torch aids the traverse from total darkness and around the small piles of dirt.  Brushing past, a small rat scurries along the floor and disappears into a small hole in the nearby wall.  The shiny carapace of a cockroach glimmers in the subdued light as it makes its way towards a more damp location.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Uncomfortably tight and barely able to support more than one traveler moving along, the narrow corridor is uncomfortably warm due to the close quarters and the number of flaming torches lighting the way.  Ruin walls have been worn almost completely smooth at the center, where hands and leather have rubbed against it, and small dirt piles litter the sides of the passageway.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Dragging footsteps and accidental bumpings are all that let you know others pass this way too, as the darkness encompasses the hallway completely.  The near-intimate groping of hands is quickly withdrawn as they make contact with flesh instead of ruin walls.  The dirt-limned floor muffles the steps scraping along the passage as shuffling continues in each direction.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Though several lit torches light the way close to the ruin walls of the corridor, the center of the wide passage remains shrouded in murk and littered with small dirt piles.  A small swarm of bats flit past, the raspy sound of their membranous wings echoing as they go.  In several locations, wood beams have been hammered together to create a brace where the walls have weakened.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Turning this way and that in a horizontal undulation, the narrow walls and low ceiling contribute to the claustrophobic sensation of this winding connector.  Passing in any direction is difficult and made unpleasant by the piled mounds of dirt staggered along the edges of the walkway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: A deep rut treads the packed ground, centered in the path, caused by those trying to avoid the piles of dirt lining the walls.  Tendrils of smoke from oil torches curl along the ceiling, the dull layer of soot creating a matte coating overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Uneven floors slant underfoot, swerving with the curve of the passage.  Pebbly rubble mixed with a mounds of dirt adds a challenging element, and walls slick with moisture don't offer a secure handhold.  Rough gouges mar the way, revealing attempts to create some means to steady travel along this egress.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Several rows of tramped footprints have tracked the dirt along floor of the corridor, some scarred by ruts created from wheeled carts carrying supplies or diggers deeper into the cavern network.  A large spider skims quickly across a massive cobweb spun near the earthen ceiling.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Cramped and dark, the narrow hallway barely traverses more than a few steps, but the short journey is made more unpleasant by the piles of dirt and ancient smell of decay.  Uneven walls with rocky points bite into flesh and cloth when passing through the tight enclosure.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: The ceiling of smooth rock, worn down from the constant moisture that seeps through the earth above it, drips with large droplets of water plinking down in an infrequent rain upon the dusty, packed earthern passage.  Small piles of dirt have created pockets of mud, some broken up by sliding footprints, making the pathway extremely uneven.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Long and echoing, the ruin corridor features a few torches brightly lit and sending up smoky wisps that stain the walls alongside each sconce.  The acrid smell of rancid oil hotly fills the stretch of this egress and does little to mask the additional odors of mildew and decay, as well as fresh turned earth evident by the small mounded piles lining the way.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Part of the ruin wall has sheered off and slid to the ground, blocking half of the passage and making it difficult to traverse.  The sharp edges once caught both flesh and cloth alike, judging from the rust-hued stains and threaded bits of fabric snagged.  Piles of dirt, like giant ant hills, run along the broken pathway sides.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Odd angles extend along this short passage and it becomes more obstacled than direct.  Due largely to the sides of rubbled ruins emerging from the walls, the earth here is tunneled around the protrusions.  The touch of steadying hands has worn the many surfaces down to a smooth finish, glazed slightly by the residual oils of flesh feeling the way.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Small piles of dirt line the edge of the tunnel, and a fine, powdery mist of dust fills the air.  Overhead, parts of tree roots emerge intermittently from the packed ceiling.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Funneled in dimension, this tunnel trespass is dusty from all the dirt stirred by constant movement and piles of dirt left along the sides.  At one end, a dim light from a larger area barely illuminates, while at the other is a darkened continuation.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: Splintered wood ceiling beams, broken up by several large plant roots, threaten to cave in at any moment bringing down the crumbling ruins.  Small bugs crawl and slither in and around the plant tendrils, drawn by the moisture running along the root appendages.  The smell of mildew is very much present, likely from the decay created by insects feasting on the vegetation.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: No more than a couple of steps long, the corridor is well lit and relatively free of rubble or other signs of decay, except for small piles of recently turned over dirt.  Wooden beams support the earthen ceiling overhead, as large cracks run much of the length, caused by an encroaching root system.  Droplets of water trickle down the exposed tendrils, creating a slick path of mud beneath.

title: [Victory Barracks, Dormitory]
description: A dozen military-style cots fill the dormitory, each outfitted with a single, firm pillow and a coarse wool blanket.  A wide, flat footlocker lies at the end of each cot, leaving just enough space to walk comfortably between them.  The quiet snores of the few off-duty guardsmen drift through the room.

title: [Victory Barracks, Corridor]
description: The corridor is barren of furnishings and wide enough for four soldiers to line up in formation.  Broad archways open to the east and west, and to the north, the corridor opens onto the dormitory.  A pair of golden wyverns is inlaid in the stone walls, flanking each archway, and a reinforced oak door to the south leads back to the courtyard.

title: [Victory Barracks, Armory]
description: The armory stretches to the left and right from the entry, the windowless space lit by lanterns hung at intervals along the walls.  Several steel weapon bins containing an assortment of weapons line the walls, while numerous sturdy leather dummies wearing various suits of armor stand single-file down the center of the room.

title: [Victory Barracks, Lounge]
description: A thick, crimson wool carpet spreads across the grey stone floor, anchored at its center by a wooden table with four sturdy chairs.  A low bookshelf stands beneath a half-open window, with an upholstered armchair nearby.  A few off-duty guardsmen mill about, playing cards, reading, or polishing their boots.

title: [Victory Barracks, Courtyard]
description: Pennants of crimson and gold adorn the fence which surrounds the single-story grey stone barracks.  The short-clipped grass is meticulously maintained, with nary a weed to be seen.  A wide, grey stone walkway leads from the gate to the barracks' reinforced oak door and precisely bisects the lawn into two practice yards, each filled with a number of soldiers practicing archery on targets or martial weapons on practice dummies.

title: [Mess Hall, Buffet]
description: Across the north face of the wall are several steel buffets, each holding a different type of food.  Elven cooks, dressed in crisp white uniforms, rush around replacing any foods that are close to running out.  A good number of soldiers flow through the area as they gaze over the selections, picking up foodstuffs from one buffet or another.

title: [Mess Hall, Dining Area]
description: Numerous long oak tables line this large open hall, neatly lined in two rows along the breadth of the room.  A fair number of soldiers can be seen, most sitting and enjoying a hearty meal, while a few stand as they quickly eat a small snack.  At the very north end of the room are a number of large buffets, hosting a variety of foods for any appetite.

title: [Blacksmith, Slab Hall]
description: Waves of heat assault the hall, warming up the dark stone walls.  Specters float among the hazy smoke, moaning eerily at the sight of intruders.

title: [Victory Gate, Battlements]
description: The view from atop the gate encompasses the rolling grasslands and Yander's farm.  The bridge below is silhouetted against the brilliant blue waters of the Mistydeep River.  Crenellated parapets guard the top of the walkway above the Victory Gate and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

Moonlight casts eerie shadows upon the walkway above the Victory Gate.  Crenellated parapets that rise and fall, give the impression of jagged teeth in the night and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

title: [Vermilion Gate, Battlements]
description: The view from atop the gate encompasses the cemetary and the Neartofar Forest in the distance.  The bridge below is silhouetted against the brilliant blue waters of the Mistydeep River.  Crenellated parapets guard the top of the walkway above the Vermilion Gate and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

Moonlight casts eerie shadows upon the walkway above the Vermilion Gate.  Crenellated parapets that rise and fall, give the impression of jagged teeth in the night and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

title: [Blacksmith, Slab Hall]
description: Heat rolls into the area, originating from the huge forges up ahead.  Bone golems carry metal slabs into the forges, returning empty handed to go deliver more.

title: [Amaranth Gate, Battlements]
description: Moonlight casts eerie shadows upon the walkway above the Amaranth Gate.  Crenellated parapets that rise and fall, give the impression of jagged teeth in the night and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

The view from atop the gate stretches as far as the eye can see.  The bridge below is silhouetted against the brilliant blue waters of the Mistydeep River.  Crenellated parapets guard the top of the walkway above the Amaranth Gate and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

title: [Blacksmith, Scorched Hall]
description: Thick smoke swirls down the hall, making it hard to breathe in this area.  The glow of forges can be seen from further away.

title: [Cat Table]
description: A carved, wooden cat has been nailed to the center of this otherwise unadorned square table.  The cat sits with head curled around to the back, bathing itself.  The carving is so poorly done that the cat is only barely identifiable.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Pan's Place, Low Room]
description: A low ceiling painted in exquisite natural colors adorns this room.  A skylight set with panes of clear mica lets in the light to nurture the plants and flowers that line the panelled walls.  Several unpretentious chairs face the warm, inviting hearth of a brick fireplace in the east wall.  Against the opposite wall, a leather sofa with plump cushions beckons, a tempting spot to doze in front of the fire while contemplating esoteric matters.
location: Pan's Place, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Pan's Enchanting Chamber]
description: The walls in this high chamber are painted pure white, but here and there they are scarred with burn marks, acid splotches and traces of powerful reagents and catalysts, as though some of the procedures undertaken did not turn out quite as expected.  The west wall is almost totally covered with a sprawling mural, a swirl of bright images.  A single titanium table stands in the middle of the room, heaped with scrolls and notebooks.
location: Pan's Place, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Pan's Place, Hidden Garden]
description: A constellation of candles in punched metal holders illuminates the narrow garden beside the cooper's shop and the brewery, dappling the grey field stone path and sparkling off the water of a winding stream.  The stream traces the course of the Locksmehr River in miniature, its banks verdant with native rushes and ferns.  A stately oak tree surrounded by a collection of exotic plants stands in the west where Wehnimer's Landing would be on the real river.  To the east, a somnolent buzz points the way to a hidden apiary.

title: [Pan's Place, Smuggler's Cavern]
description: The faint scent of sea air suggests the far end of this tunnel opens somewhere along Darkstone Bay, but only someone who knew the path well would brave the branching passageways.  A subterranean waterfall conceals a dogleg turn that widens out into a natural chamber.  Within the vaulted chamber, sealed display cases hold delicate treasures, while gold and silver baubles cover the floor in glittering drifts.  A dip in the floor holds a pool of coins that would be deep enough for swimming if the pit were filled with water.

title: [Bard Guild, Green Room]
description: Cast-off easy chairs dot the amphitheater's green room, providing comfortable seating for actors waiting to go onstage.  In the center are an oval table and several ladder-backed chairs, and along one wall sits a paint-spattered dressing stand next to several stacks of wooden folding chairs.  Last minute appearance checks are facilitated by a full-length mirror mounted beside the door.  A scent of greasepaint and dust lingers lightly throughout the room.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage]
description: The confined backstage area for the Jastev Amphitheater is fitted with the usual jungle-like tangle of ropes, pulleys and flats.  It offers access to the green room and a dressing room, as well as passage back to the Guild Hall via a covered walkway.  The ceiling is high overhead, cloaked with catwalks, scrims and drops, and other miscellany.  A collection of heavy ropes is controlled with a wooden frame mounted on the front wall, allowing the stage curtains to be easily opened and closed.

title: [Bard Guild, Covered Walkway]
description: The arched walkway spanning the distance between the Bard Guild and the Jastev Amphitheater is shielded by heavily carved wooden screens along its entire length.  The workmanship exhibited on the screens is masterful, depicting a series of scenes from well-known plays and musical performances.  Through the cavities, the gentle touch of a breeze enters, keeping the elevated walkway a comfortable promenade.

title: [Bard Guild, Dressing Room]
description: The dressing room is barely large enough to house a few furnishings.  A small dresser fitted with a mirror occupies one corner, opposite a teak clothing rack.  A small trunk and a chair complete the ensemble.

title: [Bard Guild, Antechamber]
description: The antechamber of the River's Rest Bard Guild is actually a closed porch.  It is constructed from heavily carved wooden screens on three sides.  The distinctively banded exterior of the three-story building provides the fourth wall, with alternating stripes of ochre and ivory stone providing a marked contrast to the near black of the wooden screens.  Set within a carved sill is an imposing door, its surface decorated with carving so fine and intricate, it would take hours to discover all its detail.

title: [Bard Guild, Cholen's Pub]
description: Cholen's Pub is a comfortable chamber of dark, polished teak walls and ceiling fans turning in lazy circles overhead.  A couple of tables are placed toward the back of the room, shielded with carved wooden screens for privacy.  However, most of the furnishings are small wooden tables set conveniently between comfortable-looking armchairs.  A pile of pillows is also provided for more relaxed seating.

title: [Bard Guild, Lyre Table]
description: The table is shielded from view by a masterfully carved teak screen, creating a private alcove that still offers glimpses of the rest of the pub.  The teak table, as beautifully carved as the sheltering screen, is accompanied by matching high-backed chairs with grey leather seats.  A palm sitting close by adds to the nook's seclusion.

title: [Bard Guild, Ocarina Table]
description: The small alcove created by an impressively carved screen is occupied by a heavy teak table that rivals the screen in its masterful workmanship.  A potted palm helps hide the table from view, its fronds swaying slightly at the touch of breeze created by an overhead ceiling fan.  Around the table's perimeter sit a number of high-backed chairs, their seats covered with grey leather.

title: [Bard Guild, Winding Stairwell]
description: The curving stairwell widens at the foot of a window, its view partially obstructed by heavily carved wooden screens.  Beyond the screens lies a panoramic vista of quaint rooftops and minarets, and in the distance, the sparkle of moonlight on water.  An arched doorway is discretely set in a small alcove produced by the stairway's turn, and from inside, the clink of glass and delicious aromas extend an invitation to come within.

title: [Bard Guild, Landing]
description: The landing is a convergence of two flights of stairs, where the turn of the steps has been enlarged to accommodate a large palm and a teak bench.  From a terra cotta urn standing in one corner comes the peaceful sound of bubbling water.  An arch occupies the east wall, through which one can see the upward slope of an elevated walkway.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: A flight of stairs opens into the office, a large, octagonal room occupying most of the building's third floor.  It has a high ceiling, rising into a dome painted with a representation of the sky.  Windows covered with wooden screens occupy most of the wall space.  Through the chinks in the intricately rendered patterns of the screens, truncated views of the town below can be seen.  A circular table sits in the chamber's center with high-backed chairs placed in a haphazard ring around its perimeter.

title: [Bard Guild, Music Library]
description: The Music Library is a small, somewhat dark chamber with no windows and floor-to-ceiling bookshelves.  A fan hangs from the high ceiling, its quiet swish picking up edges on some of the papers crowding the shelves and teasing them into a lazy flutter.  A few chairs attend a long, teak library table in the room's center.  The table's surface is cluttered with sheaves of music and an array of small flutes and ocarinas.

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is small and has a bare minimum of furnishings.  A low chair sits in the center of the chamber, with only a music stand and small table for companions.  Opposite the door hangs a painting depicting a young elven girl playing a lute.

title: [Bard Guild, Fest Hall]
description: The Bard Guild Fest Hall is an expansive chamber, tiled with dark grey stone beneath the dark teak paneling of the walls.  Overhead, the ceiling is high, allowing mid-day heat to rise above the chamber's inhabitants, and giving headroom to the double rows of massive palms potted in likewise monumental urns.  Teak tables and comfortable-looking black leather armchairs provide a minimal, and strikingly elegant, tableau.

title: [Bard Guild, Circular Chamber]
description: An expansive circular chamber provides an impressive entry to the Bard Guild, with a carved wooden door leading out.  The walls are decorated with narrow silk hangings, and the ceiling above is high, with ceiling fans suspended on long shafts floating like a flight of birds.  Tall palm trees potted in urns circle the room's perimeter, placed around the edge of a round rug woven in brilliant tones of red, gold, and indigo blue.  A carved lebbek arch sits between two ocean blue silk banners stitched with golden musical notes.

An expansive circular chamber provides an impressive entry to the Bard Guild.  The walls are decorated with narrow silk hangings and the ceiling above is high, with ceiling fans suspended on long shafts floating like a flight of birds.  Tall palm trees potted in urns circle the room's perimeter, placed around the edge of a round rug woven in brilliant tones of red, gold, and indigo blue.

title: [House Sovyn, Cleric's Lounge]
description: Quietness and meditation prevail here in this simple room.  A mural on the eastern wall depicts the gods of light while the west mural is dedicated to the gods of darkness.  Chairs are arranged about the room so that one can rest facing one's particular deity.  Standing in a corner of the room is an altar of modwir wood with two fragrant candles at either end and a golden bowl in the center.

title: [House Sovyn, Gilwen's Room]
description: The room is simply furnished with a four-poster bed piled with pillows and a spread of purple silk.  An amethyst vase filled with violets sits on the night table, beside a prayer book.  In a corner, a steaming bath smells of lavender and scented herbs.

title: [Mistydeep, Northern Strand]
description: Stretches of white water make boat travel more difficult, but not yet impossible on this section of the river.  The current rolls and splashes swiftly here, where leaves and foolhardy insects are quickly swept under the surface, then disgorged further downstream.  Undaunted, a beaver swims against the flow, a long stick clenched in its teeth.  A shallow u-shaped bend in the eastern bank bustles with activity as other beavers contribute to the dam-building project.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Sorcerer's Isle]
description: A mysterious monolithic tower of granite rises above the foliage of this large island at its axis.  The structure's apex, bulbous in shape, tapers to a point like an up-ended onion, while angular turrets are strategically placed at uneven elevations on each of its six sheer outer walls.  Tall trees obscure the base of the tower and any sign of entry.  Radiating outward, forest soon gives way to smaller brush and vines, while bulrushes sway in the current at the water's edge.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Sorcerer's Isle]
description: Rising from a thick section of forest at the island's core, what first appeared to be a startlingly uniform rock pillar can now be seen as a colossal hexagonal tower.  Six smaller turrets, each staggered at a different height around its circumference, peer eerily outward.  The woodlands here are wild and dense, with animal signs all around, yet the air is unnaturally silent.  Even the Mistydeep seems muted, as if preserving some long-forgotten secret.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, South of Ravelin]
description: A raucous raven call reverberates through the treetops, its point of origin hard to discern.  Directly southeast, a large island splits the flow of the Mistydeep River.  The western branch runs wide, swift, and deep while its other half progresses at a more leisurely pace, skimming small sandy shoals.  On both sides, clear pebbled basins provide hiding places for crafty fish at the river's bottom.  Far above, a dark granite tor rises sharply from the island's heavily-wooded heart.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, South of Ravelin]
description: To the northwest, a sprinkling of homes can be spotted among the assorted hardwoods, but here, the river glides past patches of pristine wilderness.  The howl of a wolf resounds somewhere in the distance, yet two egrets wading on stilt-like legs at the shore seem unperturbed.  To the south, a large shape looms in the midst of the river.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Along this stretch, the roots of several trees lie exposed where soil has been eroded by the river.  In the midst of one such root cluster, a turtle floats serenely, only its head and upper shell exposed.  Further along, a large oak tilts precariously out over the water, clinging desperately to its worn away foundation.  Some enterprising individual has taken advantage of the tree's situation by attaching a rope swing to one of the stouter branches.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Smoke from nearby homes drifts out over the water and flows along with the current.  A half-finished canoe, hewn from a felled birch, rests on wooden trestles near the west bank.  Another watercraft, bowl-shaped and fashioned from tightly woven rushes, sits nearby with a crudely-shaped oar leaning against its rim.  The slow-moving water creates little sound, allowing bird songs and various animal skitterings to be easily heard.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Here, the Mistydeep slows its pace as it meanders through a quiet community.  Homes blend in with the surrounding foliage as if part of the forest itself.  Propped in the fork of a tree, a fishing pole leans out over the water, its line and cork float bobbing gaily in the current.  On the other side of the river, a pebbled shoal gives way to a marshy area where dragonflies dart about a tall stand of cattails.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Upper Reaches]
description: Chutes of rushing water sluice over and around a jumble of broken bedrock, forming small cascades where fast-swimming fish seem to congregate, sleek noses pointed upstream.  Here and there, large outcroppings of rock provide platforms for fishermen of all types, including industrious bears.  To the west, nature has formed a stone-rimmed backwater perfect for a refreshing dip or enjoying a soothing soak in its gentle whirlpools.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, west, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Upper Reaches]
description: The water here is a pleasant dichotomy of quiet stillness and swirling agitation as a row of rocks dams the majority of the river's flow.  A few surging rivulets manage to break free, streaming in to fill this kidney-shaped depression.  A stone shelf beneath the rocky barrier allows those who perch there to experience leisurely water-massages.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Annatto Arch, Murder Hole]
description: Rough-hewn faces of limestone blocks line the room, smoothed underfoot by countless generations of pacing guards.  Positioned directly over the entrance to the Annatto Gate, a narrow cross-shaped opening in the stone floor affords a clear view of all those passing into the city.

title: [Annatto Arch, Stairway]
description: This cramped space is hardly big enough to allow two elves to pass each other on their way to and from the small chamber to the southwest.  A layer of black mold has imbedded itself in the limestone blocks of the walls and ceiling, adding to the dimness of the space.

title: [Annatto Bridge Tunnel, Passage]
description: This cramped crawlspace slopes upward toward the southeast.  Pinpoints of light leak into the area, outlining the stones used to construct the bridge and this passageway within it.

title: [Annatto Bridge Tunnel, Passage]
description: Oil was apparently spilled here at one time and never cleaned.  Speckles of dirt and tiny rocks roll beneath you, covered in the thick liquid.  The grimy slick makes the crawlway difficult to pass through safely.

title: [Annatto Bridge Tunnel, Spy Hole]
description: Small slits in the stonework look out onto the surface of the bridge, just at foot level.  Chalk markings on the wall beside the spy hole seem to be a tally of some sort, but the labels are partially rubbed away.

title: [Annatto Bridge Tunnel, Support]
description: Sloping down to the southeast, the tunnel narrows, barely allowing room for a single body to squeeze through.  The obstruction in the tunnel is smooth and curved, most likely one of the pillar supports of the bridge itself.

title: [Annatto Bridge Tunnel, Ladder]
description: This small landing provides storage and a rallying point above the ladder shaft.  Dark and small, a tunnel leads off to the northwest.  A ladder, running down a narrow, rounded hole, descends into inky darkness.  Stacks of rag-wrapped torches, their heads dipped into tar, are stored in piles around the perimeter of the landing.

title: [Annatto Bridge Shaft, Ladder]
description: Damp and slightly slippery from the humidity of the air this close to the Mistydeep River, the ladder rungs descend into darkness, while dim pinpoints of light are still visible on the landing above, at the top of the ladder.  The tang of water and rust permeates the air.

title: [Annatto Bridge Shaft, Base]
description: This small, round chamber is illuminated with eerie blue light that leaches into the room from beyond a stone arch.  A ladder stretches up into the darkness.

title: [Annatto Bridge Shaft, Ladder]
description: Faint blue luminescence reflects off the stone, emanating from a chamber just visible through an opening in the stone walls below.  The glow illuminates the iron rungs of the ladder, and shows the rust stains on the stone where the ladder is bolted into it.

title: [Fire Drake, Upper Level]
description: Rounded walls, obviously the interior of the drake's torso, enclose this space.  A sturdy platform that covers the majority of the chamber overlooks the room below.

title: [Orb Storage Room]
description: This room, occupying the base of the drake is built of heavy, rough-cut blocks of stone.  Overhead, a platform provides access to the mithril chamber.  The room is impeccably clean and illuminated with blue-tinged light cast by several small globes mounted to the walls.

title: [A Weathered Shack]
description: Long modwir shelves lined with various potions, tools, and the unidentifiable remains of plants dominate one side of this relatively large shack.  A simple counter sits near the rear of the room directly in front of a thick wooden door.

title: [A Small Clearing]
description: Thick-boled sycamores encircle this grassy clearing, their branches encroaching into the open sky overhead and casting dappled shadows, ever shifting in the breezes.  At the center of the clearing, a circle of stones traces a firepit surrounded by an assortment of logs stood on end, providing rough but functional seating.  A weathered shack crouches between two of the largest trees, its rough wooden shingles nearly matching their mottled trunks.

title: [Mistydeep, Ravelin]
description: Swelling in breadth and depth, the Mistydeep appears impassive and majestic.  A family of ducks floats single file along one shore while geese peck at morsels between the pebbles nearby.  Deer tracks lead from the forest to the river's edge in a confused mishmash, indicating common use.  Houses commingle with the woods at the western bank while, to the east, the opposite shore is less easily discerned.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, down
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Yander's Farmhouse, Living Room]
description: Glossy, golden linden floors reflect the silvery moonlight as it trickles in through the shutter-lined windows that adorn each of the small room's white-washed, knotted oak walls.  Multi-hued braided rugs are scattered in overlapping layers in the center and are held in place by two armchairs and a low divan.  A large fireplace adorned with a mahogany mantle is flanked by floor-to-ceiling bookcases, which house hurricane lanterns.

title: [Yander's Farmhouse, Yard]
description: Moonlight glitters upon cobblestones lining a small pathway that ambles through the rich foliage to and from a small farmhouse.  Butterflyweed, bright lavender and deep burgundy in hue, creates dark shadows against the brightness of the home, while glaesine bowls holding honey and nectar hang from a nearby umbrella tree.  Luna moths cavort about the area, their wings pale green and white.

Sunlight glitters upon cobblestones lining a small pathway that ambles through the rich foliage to and from a small farmhouse.  Butterflyweed, bright lavender and deep burgundy in hue, stands out against the bright paint of the home and holds court with several winged beauties, while glaesine bowls holding honey and nectar hang from a nearby umbrella tree.

title: [Yander's Farmhouse, Kitchen]
description: Cupboards line the eastern wall above a smooth granite counter that sparkles in the ambient light with flecks of mica.  Ebon and slate blue tiles create a checked pattern upon the floor, which is reflected in the glaesine globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Pushed against the opposite wall, and set beneath a tiny white oak-framed window, is a small cloth-covered table surrounded by wicker-seated chairs.  A pot-bellied, cast iron stove makes the room comfortably warm from its position near the open back door.

title: [Yander's Farmhouse, Loft]
description: Dyed a rich green hue, fleece pelts cover the floor from wall to wall and offer a soft, plush comfort beneath the steeply peaked roof.  Upon one side of the white-walled room is a luxurious feather bed covered with crisp white linens and a down comforter, while directly across stands a towering modwir armoire with painted doors.  At the foot of the bed rests a simple foot locker and several glowing glaesine globes dangle from the exposed rafters amid boughs of fresh and dried lavender.

title: [Yander's Farmhouse, Tiny Garden]
description: Clinging to the tall, stone privacy wall are the combined vines of white honeysuckle and purple wisteria, their mingled fragrance perfuming the sun-dappled garden.  Lush green grass covers the grounds from the wooden door to the small gardening shack in the back section, which is surrounded by blooming flowerbeds.  Stretched between two towering elm trees is a striped canvas hammock, and a white marble bird feeder is flanked by carved benches.

Clinging to the tall, stone privacy wall are the combined vines of white honeysuckle and purple wisteria, their mingled fragrance perfuming the moon-lit garden.  Lush green grass covers the grounds from the wooden door to the small gardening shack in the back section, which is surrounded by blooming flowerbeds.  Stretched between two towering elm trees is a striped canvas hammock, and a white marble bird feeder is flanked by carved benches.

title: [Blacksmith, Scorched Hall]
description: The hall turns here, opening up to give view to a massive chamber filled with rows and rows of forges.  An intense heat rolls into the room, causing the air to shimmer with a faint haze.

title: [Twilight Tower, Cubbyhole]
description: This narrow, cramped space ends abruptly at a curtained opening.

title: [Ebonstone, Wintertide Suite]
description: Glass icicles hang from branches of miniature evergreen trees growing in planter boxes on each side of a wall-to-wall glass window,  the effect creating a framed portrait of an artist-rendered view of the Manor grounds beyond.  Stretched out in front of a stone fireplace, a snowy white fur rug brushes against the tapered legs of a pair of overstuffed white leather chairs, each draped with a snowflake-patterned quilt.  A heavy slate blackboard hangs above a polished spruce-carved writing desk next to a curtained opening.

title: [Paupers, Sacrament Chamber]
description: Tarnished silver candelabra occupy each corner of the chamber, their fires flickering and casting dancing shadows in every direction.  One whole wall is constructed out of translucent glaes, and near the center of the room an old summoning circle has been carved into the floor, accented with dried bloodstains.  The skeletal remains of a humanoid are wedged firmly into a massive indent in one wall, and a cracked crystal shard rests at its feet.

title: [Silvergate, Receiving Room]
description: Rich rugs with exotic patterns cover the slate floor, and an overstuffed couch flanked by leather wing chairs is drawn up to the massive stone fireplace.  The walls are paneled in antique cherrywood and hung with fine tapestries depicting heroic battles.

title: [Silvergate, Workshop]
description: An array of crystals hangs from the ceiling of this room and dazzles you with a rainbow of lights.  As your eyes slowly adjust, you see that they are reflecting the light from the full height windows spaced around the walls of this tower room.  Blinking to clear the last of the stars from your eyes, you notice a circular workbench set in the center of the room.

title: [Silvergate, A Narrow Hallway]
description: You can barely see a dark opening in the wall next to you, although dim light filters in from underneath a door at the end of the hallway.  The air feels charged with powerful energies, and the musical sound of chimes rings distantly.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Office]
description: Gilt-edged frames filled with awards and commendations line the wall behind a large marble-topped desk.  Three crystalline chandeliers hang from the high ceiling, and a brass-banded trunk flanks one side of an ebonwood door.  Stretching from one side of the room to the other, a plush mountain snowcat fur rug covers the polished hardwood floor and offers a cozy respite.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage]
description: The backstage area is crowded with scenery flats and miscellaneous props and furnishings.  Overhead, a lattice of catwalks, from which hangs a number of ropes and pulleys, crisscrosses in a dizzy pattern.  Along one wall, beside the fly gallery and the pin rail, an open painted door leads into a vestibule.  A wooden door with a sign on it proclaiming it to be the dressing room nestles in the corner.

title: [Bard Guild, Vestibule]
description: The vestibule is just large enough to hold a small armchair and still allow space for a door on the west wall leading backstage, and one to the north which leads through a short corridor to the auditorium.  A rug covers the tiled floor, woven with a pattern of interlocking lyres.

title: [Bard Guild, Corridor]
description: Cloaked in shadow and muted by a thick carpet runner extending along its length, the long hallway features a vaulted ceiling and dark wood-paneled walls.  Its somber atmosphere is anything but quiet, however, as strains of music and snippets of melody create an impromptu backdrop.  Their tones are muffled and the rhythms are haphazard as musicians and singers practice their craft behind closed doors in adjacent chambers.  A sign on a mahogany door reads "Hall of the Ancient Instruments".

title: [Bard Guild, Fest Hall]
description: The expansive hall is a beamed chamber with paneled walls, their polished wood peeking out from behind a wealth of tapestries hanging on all sides.  Groupings of chairs and stools sit in an array, overshadowed by a large, circular sofa occupying the room's center.  An imposing carved marble bust overlooks all, perched on the pedestal created by the plush sofa's crimson velvet back-cushions.

title: [Bard Guild, Corridor]
description: Midway down the long hall, a carved wooden arch opens on the east wall.  From there, the chinks of plates and glasses give hints there is a pub at hand.  Delicious aromas of baking bread and roasting meat extend nigh-irresistible invitations to step inside.  Along the walls of the corridor are hung tapestries depicting groups of musicians performing in towns as well as serenading more pastoral denizens in woodland settings.

title: [Bard Guild, Corridor]
description: The hall stops before a large oak door, with a second almost identical door to the west.  To the east, a flight of steps descends a short distance to a landing below, where a brightly embroidered cloth banner over the doorway reads "Guild Office."

title: [Bard Guild, Entryway]
description: Halos of light shine from a sconce hanging overhead with ruby red glass enclosing its light source.  The entry is shadowed, its high ceiling lost in gloom and surrounded by dark wood walls with heavily carved bas-relief surfaces.  A stairway leads down with barely enough light to illuminate the carpeted stairs and curved wooden banister, and from below, strains of music drift up in disjointed fragments, like spirits climbing out of the depths.

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is small, its walls paneled in dark wood that enhances the quiet ambiance.  The scent of aged wood and years of polish hang heavily in the air, paired with a slight tinge of mustiness, the trademark aroma of older buildings.  Other than a small hearth with a carved mantel on the south wall, the chamber's only furnishings are a chair and a music stand with a lyre-shaped top.

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is small and cozy.  A hearth on the west wall offers the company of a cheerful blaze to musicians laboring to please the exacting expectations of their muse.  A chair and music stand provide the chamber's only additional accoutrements.

title: [Hall of Ancient Instruments]
description: The chamber is redolent with the ambiance of history and art.  Its tall, dark wood walls stand guard over two rows of pedestals facing each other, like queues of dancers lined up for a minuet.  On each of the stands rests a musical instrument, obviously all very old and exquisitely crafted.  Sconces are hung, positioned over the instruments and cleverly crafted to cast a soft halo of light around the priceless artifacts they spotlight.

title: [Bard Guild, Taproom Pub]
description: Dark wood walls and a low, carved ceiling create a cozy atmosphere in the Bard Hall's pub.  In the room's center is a hearth, open on three sides and filled with a crackling fire that provides both warmth and an aura of companionability.  Small lanterns placed on the few tables twinkle their low light like tiny beacons, reflecting off the highly polished wood of a long bar running the length of the east wall.

title: [Taproom Pub, Windrover Table]
description: The table is comfortably large and oval in shape.  Its top is beautifully inlaid with a pattern of wind instruments fashioned from the tiny bits of wood.  Beneath, the table's pedestal is carved in the likeness of a set of large panpipes, the longer of the tubes supporting the table's weight.  A small lantern sits on the top, throwing out a merry twinkle from its sapphire-tinted glass sides.

title: [Taproom Pub, Stringdancer Table]
description: The table is made of teak and its circular top is elegantly carved, depicting the curve of violin necks, the arch of lutes and other graceful instruments played by the caress of a bow.  Below, the pedestal flares as it nears the floor, decorated with black-tinted pegs, as though the structure would need a tuning now and then.  A lantern in the center of the top bears crossed bows above its lyre-shaped base.

title: [Taproom Pub, Drumsong Table]
description: The Drumsong table has been carved to resemble a large kettledrum, its head fitted with maple in place of skin.  Small drums of various types are depicted in a ring around the edge, all fashioned of tiny pieces of inlaid wood.  A lantern occupies the table's center, casting a cheerful glow through its ruby-stained glass sides.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: A massive teak desk occupies the center of an oval office, surrounded by tall book shelves filled with leather-bound volumes.  Beneath the desk, a rug covers much of the floor framed by dark slate tiles around its perimeter.  The rug features a pattern of musical notation running around its edges.  Windows punctuate the spaces between the shelves, opening to a view of the Bay in the distance.

A massive teak desk occupies the center of an oval office, surrounded by tall book shelves filled with leather-bound volumes.  Beneath the desk, a rug covers much of the floor framed by dark slate tiles around its perimeter.  The rug features a pattern of musical notation running around its edges.  Windows punctuate the spaces between the shelves, opening to a view of the night sky.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: The long hallway ends at a sturdy door bearing a plaque that reads simply, "Office".  From down the hall's length, the clink of pottery and glass from the pub combines with the faint sound of melodies, as a few musicians practice their craft.

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is small and has a bare minimum of furnishings.  A low chair sits in the center of the chamber, with only a music stand and small table for companions.  Opposite the door, a window opens to a western view, offering a vista of red-tile roofs and palms.

The practice room is small and has a bare minimum of furnishings.  A low chair sits in the center of the chamber, with only a music stand and small table for companions.  Opposite the door, a window opens to the night sky, showing the lights of the town through palm tree silhouettes.

title: [Bard Guild, Cholen Study]
description: The Cholen Study is furnished in a palette of greys and black.  A large area rug woven in a medium shade of grey creates a neutral field on which sits a collection of black leather armchairs.  Tapestries cover the walls, their images rendered in muted black and white values.  The only color intruding upon the calm -- and solemn -- ambiance is a hanging chandelier with amber-toned glass globes.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: The hallway passes an arched door propped open with a bronze statue of a conch shell.  A sign on the wall beside the arch announces the entry to the Conch Pub.  From inside the doorway, the sound of glasses combines with an appetizing aroma of cooking food, extending a pleasant invitation to enter.

title: [Bard Guild, Gallery North]
description: The gallery is a long, rectangular chamber with a high ceiling.  The only furnishings are a few teak benches, however the room is richly appointed with a number of large paintings covering its walls.  Vivid color combined with faultless technique and composition speaks eloquently of the quality of the works on display.  A deep-piled grey carpet covers the slate floor, muffling footsteps and providing a neutral backdrop to the canvases.

title: [Bard Guild, Gallery South]
description: The south end of the Guild Gallery echoes its counterpart to the north.  Plush grey rugs and a couple of benches give no competition to the large canvases on high, neutral-toned walls.  The works are mostly of monumental size and the tone and drama of their compositions impart a timeless quality to the room's ambiance.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: A deep-piled rug runs down the center of the long hallway.  The striking colors in its complex geometric pattern almost glow in contrast to the dark teak paneling the walls and ceiling.  Conch-shaped globes hang down from overhead, enclosing the warm glow of candles inside the lanterns.  Faint strains of music can be heard off and on, as musicians locked away in practice rooms rehearse.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage Entry]
description: A narrow hall leads from the Bard Guild to the public Performance Hall, its passage a dogleg from east to north.  Sconces mounted to the walls throw a flickering gold light across the hall's dark grey walls.  The only other ornamentation is a carpet runner that follows the passageway's crook.  A small flight of stairs leads to the backstage area.

title: [Bard Guild, Great Hall]
description: Large windows covering the east and west walls of the Great Hall stand open to catch the salt-scented breeze blowing in off the Bay.  The beaded ceiling above is rich-toned teak, and ceiling fans suspended from it turn at a lazy pace.  On the floor, woven rugs cover slate tiles, and piles of patterned pillows lie here and there for seating, each grouping of cushions accompanied by low teak tables.

title: [A Derelict Hovel]
description: Shadows creep along the rough wooden planks that form the walls of the hovel.  A broken glass window, now boarded up, allows for a faint breeze to drift through, stirring up small dust devils.  Near the back wall, a pile of canvas sacks and twine form a makeshift bed.

title: [Bard Guild, Green Room]
description: The walls of the green room are covered with likenesses of famous and not-so-famous performers, past and present, painted by a number of different artists.  Someone has constructed a makeshift makeup table against the back wall -- two crates and a plank are topped with little colored pots and a scattering of sequins, buttons, feathers, and other paraphernalia.  A long table sits in the center, surrounded by mismatched chairs.

title: [Bard Guild, Dressing Room]
description: The dressing room is little bigger than a crowded closet.  A small dresser fitted with a mirror occupies one corner, opposite a makeshift clothes rack.  A small trunk and a chair complete the room's furnishings.

title: [Bard Guild, Conch Pub]
description: The Conch Pub is a cozy chamber, with dark teak-paneled walls hung with oil and watercolor paintings.  A few tables sit in alcoves provided by standing screens crafted of teak and caned panels.  A long bar faces a wall of windows standing open to admit the Bay breeze.
