title: [Bard Guild, Bass Clef Table]
description: The Bass Clef table is large, echoing the octagonal shape of its sister table across the room.  It was carved of dark-toned teak wood and boasts a beautiful grain.  Around the deep edge is a pattern of carved lyres and tambour drums, their repeating motif accented with holly and ivy leaves.  A small lantern sitting at the table's center sheds a golden glow across the polished wood.

title: [Bard Guild, Treble Clef Table]
description: The Treble Clef table is octagonal in shape and sits nestled into a quiet corner of the Conch Pub.  Chairs sit around it, their backs carved with a pattern of interlocking bass and treble clef musical notations.  A similar pattern is carved on the tabletop, circling the perimeter of the eight sides.

title: [House Sovyn, Cubby]
description: This small antechamber to the locker area is lighted by a simple brass oil lamp.  The walls, crafted from smooth panels of yew wood, are bare of any adornment.  A plain cotton rug muffles your footsteps.

title: [House Brigatta, Kitchen]
description: Down a short corridor waits the bustling kitchen, busy with scullery maids and cooks preparing the daily meals.  Doors open at the far end lead out into the garden for harvesting herbs and vegetables, and the back wall is dominated by massive riverstone ovens, set with clay brick trivets, glowing with the fragrant fire from local applewood.  Cupboards and shelves are filled with neatly labeled supplies, and near the entry is a black cast iron stove and a polished copper kettle, for brewing various beverages.

title: [Blacksmith, The Forge]
description: Intense heat ripples like fiery waves through the chamber, as huge ogre zombies tirelessly bring hammers down onto the steel of weapons set out across dozens of forges.  Sparks fly from the metal as each zombie blacksmith continues its work.

title: [Blacksmith, The Forge]
description: Fires burn in the distance, steam rising from the hot metal of the blacksmith forges.  Ogre zombies toil away, the heat blistering their putrid undead flesh.

title: [House Brigatta, Secret Tunnel]
description: The tunnel is quite dry and has a hard dirt floor.  It ends against a blank wall with no way to get out.  At the other end is a curtained opening.

title: [House Brigatta, Lockers]
description: This room is small and cramped.

title: [Blacksmith, The Forge]
description: Steam billows up from the floor, the air filled with suffocating heat.  Ogre zombies lumber about, carting around crates full of weapons.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Boating Dock]
description: Colorful umbrellas tied to the polished railings have several tiny orbs attached to their edges, each glowing with a soft light that dispels the dark of the night.  Anchored at the edge of the docks, several whitewashed pedal boats gently bob up and down with the persistent nudging of the tide.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Crowded with boats, the moonlit waterway is bustling with activity as large and small vessels vie for space near the dock.   Long rows of white buoys protect the wood from anyone that might come in too fast, while a railing on the opposite side prevents pedestrians from falling into the water.
tags: meta:mapname:Isle of the Four Winds - Eastern Waterway

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Perfumed with the scent of tropical blossoms, the damp air of the waterway is slightly chilly.  Choppy waves pass by as they make their way toward the beaches that form a solid line of sand to the northeast, while to the southwest, docks surrounded by bright red buoys bob up and down in a lazy manner.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Small, white-capped waves glide through the waterway as they seek the distant beaches of the harbor.  Floating up and down on their wake, a series of blown glass globes creates a barrier that prevents boats from invading the swimming area and subsequently the distant beach.  High above, thin clouds are bathed in silvery moonlight, which trickles down to decorate the waters in glistening shadows.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Crashing waves send a salty mist into the air as they spend their fury upon the wall that rings the harbor.  Beyond the thick, brick barrier, the shopping district bustles with activity as people move in and out of a large warehouse.  In contrast to the busy streets beyond, the waterway calmly spreads outward towards the distant islands.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Breezes dance across the waters, their origins the distant surf that spends its fury upon the beach.  A series of blown glass globes stretches across the northern side of the waterway and prevents boaters from traveling into the swimming area.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Creating a narrow lane of passage, the waterway stretches beyond a series of blown glass globes toward the distant beach on the north side and crashes against the rough rocks of an island to the south.  Swimmers playfully splash in the waters on the other side of the floating orbs, some waving to the boaters, and others riding the waves back to land.

Creating a narrow lane of passage, the waterway stretches beyond a series of blown glass globes toward the distant beach to the north and crashes against the rough rocks of an island to the south.  Moonlight bounces off of the waves and casts strange shadows upon the tropical plant life that sways in the evening breeze.  Lone and forlorn, the soft coo of a cormorant dances through the air.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Seawater rocks and rolls, its peaks capped in foamy white, as it passes between the other islands and surges over a series of blown glass globes towards the distant beach.  Near at hand, several smooth rocks form a short sea wall around a blue modwir dock that provides access to the nearby island.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Bouncing on the tumultuous waves, a series of blown glass globes creates a small barrier that prevents swimmers from entering the traffic of the harbor and boats from invading the recreational area.  Multihued, scaly bodies churn the surface of the water as hundreds of fish rise from the depths to take part in a moonlit meal.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Moonlight glitters off of the smooth, round surface of the globes that are strung in a straight line that creates a barrier between the open harbor and the swimming area beyond.  Dark blue waters slosh over the tops of the glass objects, causing random pieces to occasionally slip beneath the surface.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Sprawling out in all directions, the waters of the harbor gyrate with small waves that have frothy white caps.  To the north the distant swimming area is surrounded by a series of blown glass globes, while to the east, west, and south small islands obscure the view of the outer barrier of Charl's Teeth.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Sunlight warms the moist tropical air of the watercourse and glitters off of the gently rolling waves.  Rocky shoals stand out against the verdant green of nearby islands and are surrounded by strands of seaweed that has been dislodged from the ocean floor.

Moonlight illuminates the watercourse, its silvery glow casting the rocky shoals that surround the nearby islands in dark shadows.  Heavy and moist, the tropical air is perfumed with the acrid scent of salt and the sweet fragrance of tropical fruits.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Sunlight highlights the puffy white clouds that stretch across the horizon in a golden sheen.  Clouds and sunrays are reflected in the rippling waters of the harbor, their white and gold hues flashing in and out as the waves jockey for position near the rocky shoals of the southern island.

Moonlight limes the puffy white clouds that stretch across the horizon in a silvery sheen.  Stars that twinkle in the sky are reflected in the rippling waters of the harbor, their lights flashing in and out as the waves jockey for position near the rocky shoals of the southern island.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Hugging the curving lines of the verdant island, the foam-capped waves vie with one another as they attempt to claim the glittering beaches.  High above, puffy clouds are gently pushed through the star-spangled sky by the light zephyr that moves through the area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Moonlight reflects off the gently rolling waves of the harbor, its silvery light glittering like thousands of winking jewels on the cerulean surface.  Beneath the waves, orange and white coral forms a thin ridge that follows the curves of the nearby island.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Stretching into the gently lapping waves, a long wooden dock allows access to the nearby highland.  Barnacles, their white faces tinged with grey, cling to the supporting poles of the dock, while long strands of seaweed are knotted into the buoys that surround it.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Terminating at the edge of Charl's Teeth, the waves of the harbor crash against the sides of the island to the north and the obsidian wall that blocks passage to the south.  Dark shards rise from the ocean floor, their jagged edges creating a dangerous barrier that is ringed with floating refuse.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Extending outward from the island, a long wooden dock runs parallel to the towering cliffs known as Charl's Teeth.  Waves, capped with frothy white foam, splash against the obsidian face to the south and the rocky shoals of the island to the west.

title: [Anemone's Perch, Docks]
description: Spindled roots arch down the ragged coastline where dozens of mangrove trees laid claim to the coastline.  Verdant and sprawling, the towering beauties provide shelter from the heat of the sun and act as a barrier to the seaborne winds.  Using the only space not crowded by vegetation, a dock surrounded by boats juts out into the rolling waters of the harbor, while a slender path winds its sinuous way through the giants and deeper into the island.

Verdant and sprawling, the towering beauties provide shelter from nocturnal insects and act as a barrier to the seaborne winds.  Using the only space not crowded by vegetation, a dock surrounded by boats juts out into the rolling waters of the harbor, while a slender path winds its sinuous way through the giants and deeper into the island.

title: [Anemone's Perch, Path]
description: Large and wide, the leaves of the mangroves provide a comfortable shade from the heat of the day.  Sunlight trickles through the wide branches and pools in pockets upon the manicured lawns of the island, creating shadows where the golden light is unable to penetrate the foliage.  A series of terracotta pots, filled with several varieties of anemones, line a slender path which provides safe passage between the island's dock and a sprawling villa.

Large and wide, the leaves of the mangroves provide an organic barrier to the nightly winds of the harbor.  Moonlight trickles through the wide branches and pools in pockets upon the manicured lawns of the island, creating shadows where the silvery light is unable to penetrate the foliage.  A series of terracotta pots, filled with several varieties of anemones, line a slender path which provides safe passage the between island's dock and a sprawling villa.

title: [Anemone Villa, Meeting Hall]
description: Polished teak floors gleam beneath a delicate patina of lacquer and reflect the golden sunlight that filters in through the room's linen-framed windows.  Positioned beneath an elaborate chandelier, a violet rug supports a claw-foot low mahogany table surrounded by armchairs and loveseats.  Occupying the eastern wall, a marble-mantled fireplace is surrounded by a whitewashed haon door on one side and a linden-edged white door on the other.

Polished teak floors gleam beneath a delicate patina of lacquer and reflect the warm glow of the elaborate chandelier.  A violet rug supports a claw-foot low mahogany table and is surrounded by armchairs and loveseats, whose backs are carefully positioned to face the linen-framed windows.  Occupying the eastern wall, a marble-mantled fireplace is surrounded by a whitewashed haon door on one side and a linden-edged white door on the other.

title: [Anemone Villa, Kitchen]
description: Frosted globes housing votive candles are strung from thin chains along the ceiling and provides a steady supply of illumination.  Bright white tiles create a colorful backsplash in the space between the counter and the cupboards that line the walls, their glossy faces painted with herbs.  Surrounded by high-back chairs, a long mahogany table is dressed with a bright white linen tablecloth and sits in the center of the room.  A painted pale blue door stands open near the kitchen's entry.

title: [Anemone Villa, Maiden's Refuge]
description: Golden sunlight spills through the large floor-to-ceiling window that occupies the northern wall.  Azure paint provides a gentle backdrop to the white curtains and bedspread, while polished cherrywood boards create a warmly hued floor.  A narrow rattan bed fashioned of beige rattan is positioned against one wall to provide ample living space.  Resting in a corner, beneath a drop lantern of polished glass, is a round rattan chair.

Silvery moonlight spills through the large floor-to-ceiling window that occupies the northern wall.  Azure paint provides a gentle backdrop to the white curtains and bedspread, while polished cherrywood boards create a warmly hued floor.  A narrow rattan bed fashioned of beige rattan is positioned against one wall to provide ample living space.  Resting in a corner, beneath a drop lantern of polished glass, is a round rattan chair.

title: [Anemone's Perch, Garden]
description: Casting long shadows across the garden, a spiraling wooden staircase leads to a bright white balcony that is wreathed in thick wisteria vines.  Terra cotta tiles create a patio in front of a pair of glass-paned doors that provides entry into the villa, while opposite, a slender shell-lined pathway ambles down the gently sloping lawn to a quiet beach.  Thick bushes of white and pink dog roses encircle the small garden and form a decorative barrier to the less domesticated plant life of the island.

title: [Anemone Villa, Balcony]
description: Crawling wisteria vines cling to the side of the villa and twine their way about the white banisters and railings that line the balcony.  Recessed into the verdant and violet foliage, a wooden bench is supported by wrought iron posts designed in the shape of enormous frogs, and is flanked by a pair of black iron filigree tables.  Glass-paned doors lead into the villa, while a spiraling wooden staircase leads into the garden below.

title: [Anemone Villa, Master Bedroom]
description: Vaulted ceilings decorated with swathes of painted silk are arranged to give the impression that the room opens to the sky.  Tropical plants, housed in enormous urns, give the space a natural feel that is reflected in the warm linens that cover the carved golden linden bed.  Candles housed within bird-shaped vessels provide ample illumination from their perch upon the decorative armoires and dressing tables.  Glass-paned doors in the southern wall stand open to the sunlit balcony.

Tropical plants, housed in enormous urns, give the space a natural feel that is reflected in the warm linens that cover the carved golden linden bed.  Candles housed within bird-shaped vessels provide ample illumination from their perch upon the decorative armoires and dressing tables.  Glass-paned doors in the southern wall stand open to the moonlit balcony.

title: [Anemone Villa, Tailor's Study]
description: Large windows topped in violet gauze and framed in white shutters stand open to allow the delicate fragrances of the garden beyond.  Mannequins, ranging in a broad spectrum of heights, are arranged throughout the room, their linen-covered bodies wearing the half-finished designs of the season.  A carved mahogany desk, topped with swathes of fabric, spools of thread, and leather-bound journals, is positioned kitty-corner to the room's exit, while an open round-topped door leads to the guest room.

title: [Anemone Villa, Guest Room]
description: Polished cherrywood floors stretch across the room to meet the white stucco walls that are decorated with various pieces of painted artwork.  Silver accents complement the pale blue and violet bedspread that covers the large bed, while several small storage units are hung from the walls and provide ample room for guests to store their belongings.

title: [Anemone Villa, Woodsman's Study]
description: Warm sunlight spills through the windows to cast its warm, golden glow upon the large workbench that occupies the entire northern wall.  Ornately carved cupboards house various pieces of seasoned woods, while nearby shelves are lined with tools used for woodcarving.

Moonlight spills through the windows to cast its silvery glow upon the large workbench that occupies the entire northern wall.  Ornately carved cupboards house various pieces of seasoned woods, while nearby shelves are lined with tools used for woodcarving.

title: [Anemone's Perch, Beach]
description: Combed and devoid of rocks, the beach stretches smoothly to the water, which gently laps at the shore in a series of slow, successive waves.  Large and small boulders, each painted bright white, creates a wall that keeps the encroaching jungle at bay, while a tall and wide bonfire in the center of the beach is surrounded by a ring of large stones.  Winding a sinuous trail through the foliage, a slender shell-lined pathway twines its way towards the distant villa.

title: [Isle of Species, Dock]
description: Brightly colored pennants are woven through the high, white fence that holds the wild foliage of the island at bay, their ends rising and falling with the gentle breath of the seaborne wind.  Several whitewashed pedal boats are anchored to the dock and bob up and down with the rhythmic pulsing of the waves.  Encrusted with sea shells, the path to the south leads toward a flagstone patio.

title: [Isle of Species, Gift Shop]
description: Square flagstones of blue, red, green, and yellow line the patio that is surrounded by closed, colorful umbrellas.  Twin booths, both bedecked in colorful pennants, stand side by side along the southern edge of the patio.  One is offering treats for the various animals of the island, and the other is offering gifts for visitors.

title: [Isle of Species, Circle Park]
description: Dipping into an enormous basin, the park is built within a crater and surrounded by concentric bands of stepping stones and an emerald green lawn.  Rising out of the smooth bottom are a trio of enormous palm trees, surrounded by brightly blooming passionflower bushes.  Moving quietly through the area, a lone janitor cleans up the refuse of the previous day and whistles a quiet tune.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Isle of Species, Patio]
description: Violet and grey-banded umbrellas rest within the center of the white wrought iron tables that are spread throughout the small patio and are surrounded by matching chairs.  Fragrant trees line the edge of the small area and provide shelter from the persistent seaborne breeze that causes their limbs to shift and sway.  Covered with trailing pennants of white, grey, and violet, a small shack, with a long wooden counter stretched across it, offers refreshments to guests and zoo workers alike.

title: [Isle of Species, Petting Zoo]
description: Large bales of bound hay create a small wall around the enclosure that keeps the patchwork rabbit inside, while allowing the jungle-like foliage of the island to trickle onto the emerald lawns.  Small, cobalt blue bowls offer water for the plump denizen, while a purple awning, stretched between two trees, offers the tiny creature protection from the elements.

title: [Isle of Species, Rookery]
description: Lofty mangroves, their spindle-limbed roots rising high out of the salty lake at the center of the enclosure, provide homes for several species of exotic birds.  Emerald green, cobalt blue, and bright white in plumage, the birds range in size from no larger than a fist to the size of a large shield.  Faint snoring sounds can be heard from the various species that are nestled in slumber throughout the rookery.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Isle of Species, Lemur Lofts]
description: Large and tall trees create a brown and green screen that separates the enclosure from the rest of the island.  Nestled at the junction of two branches, a large hut crafted of mud, straw, and branches provides shelter to the bright white lemur that wanders amid the bushes and grass at ground level.

title: [Isle of Species, Petting Zoo]
description: Surrounded by a low wooden fence, the enclosure has piles of pale, yellow hay in one corner that create a bed for the plump brown baby rolton that wanders about.  Large troughs provide the fat beast with plenty of water, and the emerald green grass that spreads across the ground offers a constant supply of food.  Zoo workers stand near the open gate, allowing patrons to pet the tiny creature, while also blocking it from escaping.

title: [Isle of Species, Slow Ones]
description: Surrounded by large and small boulders, the enclosure is filled with packed dirt and edged with bushes that are laden with verdant leaves.  Small stone basins, recessed into the ground, house water for the ponderous thick-shelled tortoise that wanders around.  A cluster of dead logs leans against an enormous boulder near the rear and creates a sturdy shelter for the enclosure's ancient denizen.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Pungent and arid, the tang of the salty sea fills the air, which is moist and humid.  Rolling waves created by the swift pull of the current slosh about the harbor and carry small tropical blossoms toward distant shores.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Verdant foliage pigments the eastern horizon as a small island stands out against the bright blue of the rolling waves.  Stretching outward from its purchase upon the fertile land, a long wooden dock supported by tall pylons is surrounded by dozens of boats and offers space for a ferry to deposit its passengers.

title: [Island Refuge, Dock]
description: Smooth ironwood planking juts from the shoreline to form this sturdy dock; hand carved pickets of roble runs its length, fitted with a seamless railing.  Extending down the center is a wide walkway of alternating blue and gold mosaic tiles, each handset into shallow grooves within the planking.  Set in slightly raised reliefs among the tiles are a series of musical notes, each elegantly carved from dark ebonwood.  Coats of clear varnish wrap both the dock and railing in a weathertight protective finish.

title: [Island Refuge, Verdant Approach]
description: A sculpted walkway of crushed white shells forms a gently curving path through the lush foliage.  Fragrant blooms of anthurium encroach along the edges, and blooming patches of dog roses trail off into the surrounding darkness.  Twisting rattan vines drape gracefully overhead, effectively blocking even the briefest glimpse of moonlight.  To the north the illuminated outline of a large estate rises from the hillside, and to the south a sturdy dock provides access to the waterway.

title: [Island Refuge, Manor House]
description: Perched upon a substantial stackstone base, the banyon planked exterior of this large estate fits well with the foliage covered hillsides surrounding it.  A manicured lawn fights off floral intrusion from the neighboring jungle, while broad teakwood decking entreats entry through the open double doors.  A cushion-topped swing, wide enough for two, is suspended from the porch roofing, and adjacent wind chimes give voice to the hilltop breezes.

title: [Manor House, Foyer]
description: The flooring underfoot in this large open foyer is inlaid with hundreds of polished tiles in varying hues of golds, reds, and browns.  A life-sized image of a golden harp dominates the center scene, encircled by smaller depictions of lyres, flutes, and mandolins.  Linen draped tables flank the entry doors, and several upholstered wingback chairs provide seating for waiting guests.

title: [Manor House, Music Room]
description: Fine damask upholstery covers the many matching chairs gathered in a semi-circle in the center of this mahogany paneled room.  Several scrollworked wrought iron stands hold musical scores on thick sheaves of parchment.  A large golden harp rests near a low red velvet hassock, a carved scene of sailing vessels and frolicking sea nymphs worked across its base.  Lyres, mandolins and other fine instruments rest in glass covered displays spaced throughout the room.

title: [Manor House, Romantic Retreat]
description: Matching crystal vases, each holding a dozen fragrant white lilies, adorn the side tables flanking the tall silk-draped four poster bed.  Banana plants and potted ferns, some as tall as an average man, lend a jungle lushness to the otherwise serene space.  Handknotted pale green carpeting with a musical motif covers much of the teakwood underfoot.  Floor to ceiling windows, left open to the cool evening breezes, provide moonlit views of the stepped terrace hillside overlooking the distant waterways.

title: [Manor House, Master Bath]
description: A substantial circular wall of rounded river rocks joined by smooth grey mortar provides privacy around this spacious bath.  No roof or overhead covering has been added however, leaving an open air feel and a view of the starry night sky.  A sunken tub, lined in smooth glass tiles of green and blue hues, commands the central location and provides occupants an unobstructed view while gazing upward from its depths.

title: [Manor House, Sunken Tub]
description: The blue and green mosaic tiles lining the tub are magnified beneath the water and sparkle as rays of silver moonlight pierce the shallow water.  Wisps of steam rise lazily around you, creating a foggy haze on the cut-crystal spigots and the polished silver spout.  Nothing but the distant sounds of katydids disturbs the quiet in this tropical retreat.

title: [Manor House, Veranda]
description: Light silken drapes are held overhead with silken cords and flutter in the evening breezes in this quiet outdoor space.  Open on three sides, the veranda provides a comfortable spot from which to enjoy the moonlit lushness of the surrounding hillsides.  A raised teakwood dance floor is tucked to one side, and low tables and rattan settees provide relaxing spots for outdoor dining.

title: [Manor House, Terrace Overlook]
description: Stepped landscaping forms flat grassy areas that graduate the incline of this steep hillside leading to the water's edge.  Small berms of mounded wildflowers spring up between each level area and the next one down.  From this vantage point, the rounded tops of surrounding hills are silhouetted against the night sky, and still waterways in the distance reflect pale shimmers of moonlight.  A pillow-topped white cotton hammock sways gently with passing breezes, strung between a pair of stately banyons.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Soft hoots and strange bleats echo across the rollicking water from the southern island, though no visible sign of their origins can be seen.  Trees dot the shores and dip towards the crystal blue waters as if pausing for a drink.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Gentle rollicking, the waves of the harbor jostle everything in their path.  Far below the surface, sea grass undulates and dances in the gentle pull and push of the current as it surges through the various islands on its way to the distant shores of the mainland.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Parting the waters to either side of it, a long wooden dock stretches outward from the island to the northeast and is ringed by buoys and boats.  High above, the clouds stretch from the eastern horizon and briefly obscure the pale glow of the moon.

title: [Bliss Island, Dock]
description: A short bollard has been painted green, standing out against the smooth, pale planks of a short pier jutting off the beach.  The dark waters glisten in the moonlight, and faint phosphorescence can be seen in the distance.  Further inland, a long cobbled pathway leads into lush tropical flora redolent of heady fragrances.

title: [Bliss Island, Garden]
description: Glossy leaves of indigenous flora shimmer in the moonlight, with closed blossoms punctuating the dark green foliage.  The slender trees and larger greenery rise out of moist loam, while smaller plants reside in neatly tended beds and painted pottery.  Despite the man-made nature of the garden, the area retains a distinctly natural feel to it.  A cobbled path lined with a thin border of jade sea glass bisects the tropical oasis.

title: [Bliss Island, Beach]
description: Lapping waters caress the peaceful beach, the surf creating a gentle rhythm like the heartbeat of the secluded island.  Scattered about are variegated seashells that have washed up onto shore over time.  Bathed in moonlight, a lone palm has been sent swaying in the tropical night, casting a dancing shadow against the pale sand.

Lapping waters caress the peaceful beach, the surf  creating a gentle rhythm like the heartbeat of the secluded island.  Scattered about are variegated seashells that have washed up onto shore over time.  Bathed in moonlight, a lone palm has been sent swaying in the tropical night, casting a dancing shadow against the pale sand.

title: [Bliss Island, Swimming Area]
description: Situated in a small cove, the dark blue waters of the swimming area bounce of the shore and ripple calmly through the secluded harbor.  A protective ring of rocks near the opening of the cove prevents larger sea denizens from entering the area and also keeps the tide from growing too strong.  Rhythmic and persistent, the surf crashes on the sands of the distant beach and creates undulating waves to float upon.

title: [Bliss Island, Path]
description: Secluded within a sizeable clearing encircled by a lush tropical garden is a quaint, green-shingled cottage.  A cobbled walkway leads up to the abode's front door painted deep viridian to match the shutters and trim.  Affixed to the top of a nearby signpost is a lifelike parrot statuette.

title: [Bliss Island, Great Room]
description: Spacious and bright, the great room has been furnished with suede-covered seating tooled with a delicate blue feather pattern.  Set inside a shallow recess along the northern wall is a lapis-inlaid door, while the west side has a glossy blue door.  The golden bamboo floor has been inset with diamonds patterns wrought from tanik.  Suspended from the tall ceiling is an enormous wrought iron chandelier with blue coral details, upon which numerous glass votives have been placed.

title: [Bliss Island, Master Bedroom]
description: Deep cerulean walls contrast the pure white moldings in this airy bedroom, while the decor mimics the vibrant blue in its fine detail.  A magnificent four-poster bed fitted with cornflower sheets stands opposite an expansive watercolor painting.  The flanking teakwood nightstands each house a glass vase filled with freshly picked flowers.  Framing a tall open casement window are sheer, sapphire-sheened drapes that flutter gently in the delicately scented tropical breeze.

title: [Bliss Island, Guest Bedroom]
description: Moonlight streams in through a window that affords a view of the beach and its glistening waters.  The soft white walls have been painted with stylized cerulean vines that are repeated in the motif of the dresser and nightstand.  A large hope chest rests at the foot of the bed, and a full-length mirror stands in the corner.

title: [Bliss Island, Kitchen]
description: A massive stone hearth dominates the kitchen, its glowing embers radiating warmth along the floor.  The high ceiling has been fitted with cerulean rafters, while open windows let in the slightly salty sea air.  Laid out upon a sea glass-inlaid countertop are several trays of food and beverages.  Alternating blue and white tiles have been inlaid into a square teakwood table, which has been surrounded by four matching chairs.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Following the curve the island, the waterway flows gently against the sandy beaches to the west and north.  Meeting a barrier of rocks that rise from the ocean floor, the waves bounce back upon themselves and create a choppy cross-current that disturbs the seaweed beds below.  Several long, slippery strands of kelp, that have been dislodged by the tide, bob up and down on the water's surface.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Slipping between two verdant islands, the waters of the harbor grow choppy and erratic.  Tiny whirlpools, created as the waters bounce off of the shoals of both landmasses, swirl in the channel and suck nearby debris into the briny depths below.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Following the angular arch of Charl's Teeth, the tenebrous nature of the ocean's waters allows it to slip past the ragged edges, into the great blue beyond.  The crushed hull of a small pedal boat sits wedged between the obsidian edges of the giant, volcanic-made structure, its bent and broken pieces testament to the danger of straying too close to the teeth.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Rising sharply out of the water, in mimicry of some ancient sea leviathan, the sharp apertures of Charl's Teeth block passage into the open sea.  Crashing defiantly against the pointed obsidian, the ocean waves spend their fury against the smooth faces of each unyielding spike without avail.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Spindle-limbed mangroves mark the shoals of the nearby island, their lanky boughs and verdant coloration oddly missing where the small landmass bumps against the harsh edges of Charl's Teeth.  Cool and gentle, the ocean waters gently roll against the combined organic structures.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Glistening in the ambient light, the tiny swells of the waterway roll in a rhythmic motion that is almost hypnotic.  Tiny white caps mark the waters that will grow into waves, while those lacking caps simply disappear into the dark blue depths.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Smooth, round rocks rise from the sea bed beneath the dark blue waters to create a barrier around a small cove.  Stretching across the face of the island, beyond the rocks, is a small beach filled with glistening white sands.  Passage into the cove is efficiently blocked by the large, stony boulders.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Following the curve of the small island, the waters of the harbor flow gently against the nearby shoals and ripple backwards with little care.  Passionflowers and palm leaves, blown free from the nightly winds that plague this side of the island, float on the slightly choppy sea with indifference and roam where the tide takes them.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Shadowed by the cliffs of the mainland, as well as the ominously dark shards of Charl's teeth, the small island rises out of the waters of the eastern harbor to claim the landscape.  Bright, green plants surround a single structure at the center, while lantern-lit pathways lead about the small island.  Lapping at the nearby shores, the tidal waters are becalmed in this section of the harbor.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Rhythmic and persistent, the ebb and flow of the tide as it courses over the southwestern beaches fills the air.  Bright white and glistening in the moonlight, the sands of the land mass fall away as they meet the sharp, jagged edges of cliffs that support Mist Harbor's eastern community.  Hearty vine plants trail down the edge, finding purchase in the various crags and cracks that riddle the rocky facing.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Flowing around the curve of an island to the southeast, the waterway opens up here; the water calms once away from the tidal fury that is characteristic of the various shorelines of the harbor.  Barely discernable, an odd coral formation glistens in the water's depths as the ambient light plays off of its skeletal structure.  Schools of bright yellow tangs dart in and out of the organic architecture as if playing hide and seek, their bright eyes wide and their demeanor skittish.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Jutting out from the main body of the island, the peninsula is surrounded by round rocks worn smooth by the constant attention of the tide.  Fierce and demanding, the surf hammers the thin arm of land, and in some cases, rushes over it to the other side.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Parting the waters to either side of it, a long wooden dock stretches outward from the island to the northeast and is ringed by buoys and boats.  High above, the clouds stretch from the eastern horizon and briefly obscure the pale glow of the moon.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Bliss Island, Great Room]
description: Spacious and bright, the great room has been furnished with suede-covered seating tooled with a delicate red feather pattern.  Set inside a shallow recess along the northern wall is a garnet-inlaid door, while the west side has a glossy red door.  The golden bamboo floor has been inset with diamonds patterns wrought from redwood.  Suspended from the tall ceiling is an enormous wrought iron chandelier with red coral details, upon which numerous glass votives have been placed.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Ranging in hue from pale blue to midnight black, the waters of the harbor frolic about in their search for the shores of the nearby islands.  Rising out of the dark depths, a sea turtle lifts its beak out of the choppy waters and floats upon the pulling waves.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Capped with white, the ocean waters bounce against each other as they seek purchase upon the nearby islands.  Occasionally, the frolicking waves collide, causing a spray of water to burst into the air, only to rain back down into the tide moments later.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Large boulders create a protective barrier around a pristine cove surrounded by white sands.  Slender pathways along the beach twine their way through the verdant canopy, where a small structure can be glimpsed amid the leaves.  Sufficiently blocking passage into the bay, the round rocks take the brunt of the choppy waters.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Rolling gently back and forth, the hypnotic pulse of the tide rises and falls against the nearby islands.  A cool breeze slips through the area, carrying with it the scent of wild flowers and fresh fruits.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Strange stones spread out from the island to the east and partially block the water course, their round and smooth surfaces speckled with sand and salt water.  To the west, a small swimming area is roped off by a series of blown glass globes, beyond which is a long beach whose sands glitter beneath the attention of the moon.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Moonlight illuminates the the pale sands of the distant beach where the roaring surf crashes with ferocity.  Separated from the main boating area, a small section of the harbor is roped off by a series of blown glass globes.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Built upon large and small stones, the wooden dock that stretches outward from the island is discolored by the rise and fall of the waves that crash against its smooth edges.  Beyond the manmade structure to the north, the island stretches eastward in a series of enormous, flat stones.  Waves rushing to the island crash against its side and send a salty spray into the air.

title: [Turtle Island, Docks]
description: Piled high with rocks, the island resembles a quarry that was lost at sea, rather than an actual land mass.  Roughened planks are nailed to long support poles to create a wide dock that is surrounded by several whitewashed pedal boats.  Rushing at the shore and splashing over the rocks into the body of the island, the persistent waves make walking through the island difficult.

title: [Turtle Island]
description: White-capped waves crash across the boulders that ring the central island, the cool water coursing across the smooth faces, only to disappear on the other side.  Smaller rocks mingle with dark round ones in the spaces between their larger brethren and are occasionally pulled from their perches by the rushing sea.

title: [Turtle Island]
description: Flat and smooth, the large boulder is soaked at even intervals by the constant effort of the rising tide.  Kelp and other forms of seaweed are tangled in the spaces between the rising boulders.  Ripped and torn, the aquatic plants still have seed pods clinging to their slick ends.

title: [Turtle Island]
description: Cracked shells, seagull feathers, and various other bits of flotsam collect in the depressions between the boulders.  Several pieces of debris manage to be dislodged as the rising water splashes across the face of the boulder, while others, carried by the tide, join the motley collection of refuge.

title: [Turtle Island]
description: Canted at an angle, the boulder dips precariously into the waiting ocean.  Several larger rocks, rounded from the abuse of the constantly rushing tide, prevent the perch from being lost to the briny depths below.

title: [Turtle Island]
description: Perched higher than many of its brethren, the boulder is drier than most, even though reptilian footprints moisten its face.  Ragged pieces of kelp, displaying clear signs of being gnawed on, are scattered about the area causing the enormous rock to be slippery in some areas.

title: [Turtle Island]
description: Flat and enormous, the round stone rests within kelp beds and is slick from the vegetation that has been squished by previous jumpers.  The edges of the enormous boulder are soaked from the constant attention of the surf, while the center is high enough to remain out of the water's reach.

title: [Turtle Island]
description: Unsteadily perched on smaller rocks, the boulder that rises out of the rushing waves is not nearly as smooth as its brethren.  The soft sound of pebbles skittering against one another can easily be made out every time the waves recede.

title: [Turtle Island]
description: Fashioned of dozens of rocks fused together by silt, sand, and dirt, the small island rises above the waterline and is surrounded by a halo of large boulders.  Mist, created by the consistent tidal pounding of the outer boulders, fills the air and moistly clings to everything in its path.  Water rings mark the edges of the island where the tide has risen beyond the outer pieces.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Strangely formed, the nearby island appears to be comprised of smooth stones, sand, and pebbles.  Silver moonlight slips through the puffy white clouds in the sky, while the dazzling stars of the heavens reflect off of the waters of the harbor.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Tidy and narrow, the thin dock that extends from the small island is painted grey and lined with dozens of frosted globes that glitter with a warm, welcoming radiance.  Small and large rocks decorated with orange, blue, and white pigments create an ornamental border that rises from the rushing waves and up the steep sides of the coast.

title: [Coral Island, Dock]
description: Hugging the edge of a tiny cove, the dock follows the narrow jetty that protects the inlet's waters from maritime traffic and the native aquatic life.  Several whitewashed pedal boats bob up and down with the rhythmic pulsing of the tide from where they are anchored to pillions along the edge of the wooden protrusion.  Meandering through the moonlight-dappled verdant foliage along the northern edge, a slender shell-lined walkway provides access to the distant villa.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Coral Island, Yard]
description: Pale moonlight trickles through the verdant foliage that surrounds the large manicured lawn, which in turn sprawls before a stone and white stucco villa.  Crushed shells, their mother-of-pearl bellies shimmering in the silvery light, decorate the slender walkway that travels between the villa's entry and the distant dock.  Large planters, crafted of dark green bamboo, are set beneath the building's windows, each supporting a wide variety of tropical flowers.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Coral Island, Living Room]
description: Polished white birch floors support the tongue-in-groove wainscoting that rises to mid wall before giving way to pristine white stucco.  Gauze-framed windows occupy the space to either side of a wide black oak entry, while the northern wall is decorated with a plethora of paintings that surround a black oak door.  The eastern wall houses a flagstone fireplace topped with a smooth black oak mantle.  Arranged in social circles at the heart of the room, a pair of white wicker chairs faces a two-cushioned loveseat over the broad expanse of a low glass-topped table.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Coral Island, Master Bedroom]
description: Cool blue stucco decorates the walls of the room above the tongue-in-groove wainscoting that is painted serene white.  Twin glassless windows, framed in sheer gauze, provide an excellent view of the sunlit garden while the opposing wall supports a black oak door.  A painted silk privacy screen is arranged in one corner and offers the occupants a discreet place to disrobe or freshen up.  Positioned beneath gauzy mosquito netting, a four-poster black oak bed covered with soft white linens is flanked on the right by a tall black oak table, while at its foot rests a decorative black oak cassone.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Coral Island, Kitchen]
description: Red stucco meets white wainscoting to create a warm and bright kitchen that is illuminated by the golden sunlight that spills through the glassless windows.  Standing on opposite sides of the room, an open black oak door leads to a small garden, while an open whitewashed door provides access to the villa's guestroom.  Positioned beneath an enormous lantern, a large cherrywood table topped with bowls and platters is surrounded by long wooden benches and small cherrywood chairs.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Coral Island, Garden]
description: Surrounded by a white picket fence, the garden has a spacious, manicured lawn.  Cultivated flowers climb trellises along the edge of the villa and frame a knotty black oak door.  Teak benches are recessed amid bushes near a white picket gate that leads to the beach.  Scattered throughout the garden are blown glass humming bird feeders and colorful witch-balls that cheerfully illuminate the area.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Coral Island, Private Beach]
description: Protected on three sides by high, rocky protrusions, the beach has brilliant white sands that fall away from surf that gently laps at the shore.  Several white wooden beach chairs are scattered across the area and positioned to face the swimming area.  A white picket fence stretches along the edges of the area creating a barrier between the garden, which can be accessed by a white picket gate, and the recreational area.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Tiny Cove, Swimming Lagoon]
description: Surrounded by a protective ring, the swimming area is safe from boats or large aquatic life forms.  Pulsing with the push and pull of the tide as it curls into a frothy surf that strives for the beaches, the water is cool.  Moonlight plays against the surface and obscures the depths below.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Coral Island, Guest Bedroom]
description: Large glassless windows surrounded by gauzy drapes decorate three of the rooms for green stucco walls, while the fourth houses an open black oak door that leads into the kitchen.  Two mosquito nets occupy the northeastern and northwestern corners of the room and are each suspended over a narrow knotty oak bed and a narrow black oak bed.  Sharing a space between the two beds, a long black oak table is draped with a fine white linen cloth and houses candleholders and vases on its smooth surface.
location: Coral Villa, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Seaweed beds at the bottom of the ocean cause the water to transition from crystal blue near the open water to cerulean near the edges of the small island that rises on the east.  A long wooden dock stretches out from the verdant expanse of land and allows mariners the ability to dock their boats along its buoy-lined face.

title: [Dawe's Island, Dock]
description: Most of the visible coastline is unapproachable black rock rising straight up from the water, but a driftwood dock attached to a small strip of sea-level land provides an entrance to the island's interior: a narrow valley lushly green with dense tropical foliage.  A huge waterfall crashing down from a northern cliff is split by a jutting promontory, sending a smaller tributory rushing towards the valley.  Nestled under the smaller fall is a large glass house.

title: [Dawe's Home, Ground Floor]
description: The vast, glass-walled structure has an open layout with no real division of rooms, except for a study on the eastern side set off by frosted glass walls.  A waist-high, long black marble koi pond lines the west side, and the warm-hued tropical hardwood floor gives way on the east to a recessed square pit bordered with cushions, providing a seating area.

title: [Dawe's Home, Kitchen]
description: A huge black marble island sets off the kitchen from the rest of the house, and hardwood stools lining three of its sides provide dinner seating for twenty.  The kitchen itself is well-equipped with a large steel sink, several ovens, and a stone fireplace, but the fixtures do not appear to have seen much use.

title: [Dawe's Home, Study]
description: This room is rendered semi-private by the frosted glass walls.  Warm-hued hardwood bookshelves are filled with a variety of knick-knacks and assorted treasures, and a large hardwood desk is covered with an assortment of maps and notes.  An ornately framed full-length mirror stands in one corner of the room.

title: [Dawe's Home, Loft]
description: Moonlight streams into the room from the skylights cut in the coral stone ceiling, casting a silvery hue on the tropical hardwood floor.  The enormous space is sparsely but elegantly furnished, with a black marble platform bed and matching vanity as the most prominent features.  A narrow coral stone staircase leads up to a small landing with a door opening out onto the roof, while a wider white spiral staircase leads downstairs.

title: [Dawe's Home, Roof]
description: The noise out here from the two waterfalls is almost overwhelming, but this area is actually sheltered by a coral stone overhang that takes up almost the whole roof.  The smaller fall crashes directly into a marble basin set into the coral stone, the overflow splashing on towards a pool below.   From here, you can also see a glass tunnel of sorts that appears to lead away from the house under the larger fall, which is an opaque white wall of water.

title: [Dawe's Home, Water Tunnel]
description: The noise in this long glass hallway is almost deafening from the endless water crashing onto the domed glass ceiling.  The view through the walls is distorted by the waterfall splashing down on all sides, but deep green foliage and dark grey rock is blurrily visible.  At the far end of the hallway is a glass door.

title: [Dawe's Island, Beach]
description: Moonlight illuminates the sandy beach that is tucked between the rocky cliffs of the coastline, leading towards the silvery expanse of water.  An enormous firepit is dug into the beach, and white wicker tables and chairs are scattered around.  Towards the interior of the island, a door provides entrance to a glass-enclosed tunnel that disappears under the white wall of a waterfall cascading from the cliffs.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: High cliffs separate the island to the south from the lapping waves of the ocean, their verdant tops riddled with flower-laden vines.  At the summit a bright orange bonfire creates a smear of color that illuminates the dark horizon.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Tropical blossoms litter the channel that stretches between the two islands in the harbor, their fragrant petals perfuming the air.  Bouncing up and down, the petals glide on the gentle waves as they are carried between the cliffs of one isle to the beaches of the other.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Casting shadows upon the gently churning waters of the channel, the northern face of the southern island is comprised of high cliffs and deep crags.  Overgrown vines dangle down its ragged face and are heavy with bright white and blue passionflowers.  A fruity aroma fills the air and mingles with the pungency of the salty surf.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Darkly ominous, Charl's Teeth overshadow the lapping waves of the harbor, though its dark presence does not seem to extend to the islands that rise out of the ocean on the east and west.  Moonlight lends its silvery glow to the small coral structures that lay upon the ocean floor where glittering anemones wave in the current.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Water swirls in tiny pools as the waves round the edge of the island and collide with the colossal, obsidian faces of Charl's Teeth.  Shattered shards and jagged rocks, comprised of both the glossy black volcanic glass and the shale from the nearby island, surround the tiny inlet and deny further passage to the west or south.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Curled and fuzzy, grey feathers speckle the surface of the gentle waters as they calmly rise to small peaks and dip into shallow valleys.  Delicate breezes skirt around the island to the south and add a slight chill to the dark, humid air.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Dock]
description: Blue-painted lengths of modwir lumber are laid flat to form the surface of the dock.  Tall, rounded maoral posts line the dock, and a pair of large wrought-iron rings is bolted to the moorings.  A small rowboat is tied up to one of the wrought-iron rings and is surrounded by several whitewashed pedal boats.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Beach]
description: A circle of colorfully painted chairs surrounds a stone-lined fire pit just above the tide line on this white sand beach.  Elaborately constructed sand castles, towers, wagons and gers are displayed across the surface of the beach.  Colorful crustaceans of assorted size occasionally make their way around the driftwood and seaweed that has washed up on shore.  A blue modwir dock extends from the beach and out into the waves.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Jungle]
description: Towering trees rise from the loamy soil underfoot to form a verdant green canopy overhead.  A bright green parrot and vibrant blue macaw hop from perch to perch along the branches.  One of the larger trees, home to a group of birds, displays a remarkable amount of bird droppings along its trunk.  A wide stream of swiftly flowing water is visible through a stand of trees to the east.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Clearing]
description: The small hill gives way to a sudden cutoff as it approaches the swiftly flowing stream below.  Verdant shrubs and brush grow from the cliff face below, nestled into the gnarled roots of the large, towering trees along the hill's edge.  Brightly colored pink ginger blossoms bloom from a number of niches in the tree roots.  A three-masted ship is beached next to the hill and the jungle has begun to claim the boat for itself.  The captain's balcony at the back of the boat is quite close to the cliff face.

title: [The Wave, Captain's Balcony]
description: The small balcony at the rear of the ship is constructed from painted modwir and maoral.  Enclosing the length of the balcony, a carved modwir railing provides a view of the verdant hillside nearby.  A woven acantha-fiber hammock is strung from a hook on the wall and the edge of the railing.  A glass-paneled lantern hangs from another hook on the wall of the ship, next to a glass-paneled bright green door.

title: [The Wave, Captain's Quarters]
description: An elaborately carved low maoral railing provides a view of the common area below the captain's loft.  A wooden plank stairway leads downwards, and pushed up against the hull of the ship is a brightly painted pink fel bunk bed, covered in an assortment of knitted quilts.  A pair of paintings covers the rear wall of the loft, framing a glass-paneled bright green door.  Glass-paneled lanterns hang from wrought bronze hooks in the beams overhead.

title: [The Wave, Common Room]
description: The hull of the ship is painted in a brilliant swirl of colors.  Blues and greens flow into pale whites as the designs on the hull rise upwards.  Numerous colorful pillows rest in a large pile at the center of the floor.  Along the side of the hull is a wooden plank stairway that leads to a small balconied loft above.

title: [Furryfoot Woad, Streambank]
description: Gentle babbling from the swiftly flowing stream fills the humid air along the bank.  A small pile of flat, rounded stones is stacked next to a carved granite bench that overlooks the stream.  Colorful blooms of assorted flowers provide contrast with the stark greenery of the jungle.  Glass-paneled lanterns hang from iron hooks attached to trees along the path leading to the stream.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Bright orange markers bob in the waters near the edges of a small island, their colorful faces warning small and large crafts of the dangers near its sloping cliffs.  Tiny, white-capped waves splash lazily against the stony faces of the cliffs, while pelicans lazily recline upon some of the larger stones that clearly jut out of the water.  Several boats gracefully slip through the waters on their way to and from the docks that stand out like fingers from the western shores.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Fingers of land rise from the ocean floor as the water surges around a small island, though no visible sign of landfall can be seen.  Churned by the proximity of the nearby docks on the west, the ocean is riddled with cross-waves that collide with one another and produce a cool, misty spray that rains down upon everything within its reach.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Sunlight slants across the crystal blue waters and brightly illuminates the floor of the watercourse as it makes its way around a small island.  Here and there, guests to the waters ride ferries or pedal boats either further out into the harbor or closer to the docks where others stand waiting.  A lone balloon with string still attached hovers near to the ocean and drifts where the wind wills it.

Moonlight slants across the crystal blue waters creating shadows in the watery depths that are only enhanced by the gentle lapping of the waves.  The sporadic call of a guard, from somewhere on the nearby docks, echoes over the water as he calls out the hours of the night.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Rocks rising on either side of the landmass form an impenetrable barrier that makes landfall on its dark, black sands impossible without the assistance of the dock that stretches out into the cresting waves.  Though no vegetation rises from the strange isle, a smear of purple on one of its hills appears to offer a bit of shade from the sun's insistent attention.

Rocks rising on either side of the landmass form an impenetrable barrier that makes landfall on its dark, black sands impossible without the assistance of the dock that stretches out into the cresting waves.  Small, glowing orbs create distant pools of light upon the hills of the strange island.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, northwest

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Various shades of blue comprise the waters of the sprawling harbor, their hues slightly diminished by the lack of sunlight to illuminate their depths.  Here and there, tiny silver-backed minions swim beneath the surface in a complicated ballet designed to confuse and outmaneuver the large, shadowy fish that follows them.

title: [Black Sands Isle, Dock]
description: Rocky and uneven, the ground of the small island is covered with black sand and very little vegetation.  Rising and falling with the tide, the waters of the ocean crash against the rocky shore and splash up on the dock that is surrounded by several whitewashed pedal boats.

title: [Black Sands Isle]
description: Stretching across the broad, flat expanse at the center of the island, a grey and purple awning provides shelter from the rough winds that rip through the area.  Colorful urns, filled with palm trees, tropical plants, and flowers, create a verdant wall on three sides of the protective structure and act as an anchor to the blanket stretched between them.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Black Sands Isle, Beach]
description: Large and small rocks jut out from the edge of the island into the swiftly moving surf, making it impossible to safely move out into the waters beyond.  Glistening in the moonlight, the fine black sand of the beach is cool to the touch.

title: [Black Sands Isle, Beach]
description: Visible signs of erosion cause the beach to be short, and the incline to the center to be steep.  Tiny white pebbles stand out in glaring contrast to the stark uniformity of the black sand that covers the ground.  Here and there, seagull feathers drift across the ground or are carried out to sea by the receding tide.

title: [Black Sands Isle, Beach]
description: Occupying the lee of the island, the black sand of the beach glistens under the bright golden sunlight that trickles through the clouds above.  Protected from the harsh winds that course across most of the island, the quiet of the beach is occasionally broken by the cry of a gull.

Occupying the lee of the island, the black sand of the beach glistens in the silvery moonlight that trickles through the clouds above.  Protected from the harsh winds that course across most of the island by a high barrier of rocks, the quiet of the beach is occasionally broken by the cry of a gull.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Cool and crisp, the dark waters have a shadowy cast to them that is enhanced by the silvery glow of moonlight that attempts to pierce the ocean's reflective layers.  Far below, flickers of yellow light dance through the current like tiny fireflies at the edge of a forested glade.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Swirling water rushes between the edges of the small island and the tall, ragged crags of the Teeth of Charl.  Large clumps of dark green seaweed speckled with brownish-white foam clog the tiny pass making it impossible for boats, or even small animals, to traverse the space between the mountains and the ring of protective cliffs.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Carved in the semblance of dolphins standing on their tails, the pylons that rise out of the water and support the distant dock hold a dark blue hue.  Thick and small rocks rise from the shore, making it impossible to bring any kind of water vessel onto the shore, and large signs along the edge of the dock mark the space as reserved for water taxis and ferries.  Lanterns strung from thin ropes between the pylons spill pools of light upon the dark waters below.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Water lazily ripples through the wide channel that passes between the two islands, its crystal clear hue augmented by the delicate touch of the pale moon.  Dark shapes move far beneath, though none rise close enough to the surface to make them identifiable.  In complete contrast to each other, one island displays beaches of black sand, while the other has only a small habitable beach of glittering white.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Sheer and formidable, the cliffs of the nearby island fall in a sheer drop to the ocean floor.  White-capped waves insistently spend their strength against their smooth faces, but the sturdy structure stoically ignores the mutable attempts of the bright blue water.  Just beneath the southern edge of the cliffs, a small dock can be seen stretching out into the water.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Rising dark and formidable to the south, Charl's Teeth are a smear of black against the crystal blue of the waterway's cool waters.  Razor sharp crags and jagged lines make the towering behemoths impossible to climb, and the close proximity that each ragged tooth has to the other makes them impossible to slip past.  Water bounces off of the natural constructs and splashes onto a long wooden dock to the west that provides access to the nearby island.

title: [Grishom's Island, Dock]
description: A wide driftwood dock rises above the water and stretches to a sandy beach where large palm trees sway with the ocean's breeze.  Meticulously carved wooden steps lead from the shore up to a high rolaren gate where a two-story manor lies beyond.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Courtyard]
description: Lanes of trimmed lush grass stretch across both sides of the courtyard, and tall rose bushes line each wall.  Polished riverstone fountains rise up on each side of a white pebblestone walkway that snakes from a high rolaren gate to a pair of dark mahogany doors.  Burnished wooden benches form half-circles around each fountain.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Atrium]
description: The manor opens up into a large circular chamber with a high glass dome ceiling.  A dark ironwood tree rises up from the center of the room, its branches bathed in moonlight from above.  Finely dressed servants bustle between a mahogany archway and a long hallway, while a wide stairwell ascends to the second floor.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Banquet Hall]
description: Posts of dark mahogany support the vaulted ceiling of the spacious hall, while some large paned windows allow the island moonlight to lighten the room.  A dark oak banquet table occupies the center of the hall, large enough to comfortably seat two dozen people.  Gold-framed paintings hang on each side of the entrance to a long hallway.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Grand Ballroom]
description: Rows of gold-wrought crystal chandeliers hang from the ceiling and reflect against the lacquered rosewood floor, which stretches the entire length of the ballroom.  Ornate ivory arches line the north and south walls, while the entire eastern wall is set with a wide-paned window.  A marble-topped bar occupies a corner of the room, and various refreshments decorate its surface.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Rock Garden]
description: Rows of verdant hedges extend along the back wall of the manor, while vibrant flowerbeds create a border along a spruced walkway that winds through the garden.  A stretch of pebblestone creates a circle in the heart of the garden where a dozen stones and rocks have been placed about.  An unseen bird makes its presence known with the occasional quiet chirp.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Upstairs Hallway]
description: A lavish navy blue carpet runs the span of the hallway, which ends at a pair of glass doors.  Various oil-painted portraits hang from each wall, broken up only by a dark mahogany double door.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Terrace]
description: A half-wall of stone surrounds the open terrace and affords an expansive view of the island at night.  The darkened sky blends in with the murky waters of the ocean that stretch off the coast.  The wavering image of the moon can be seen dancing on the waves.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Bedchamber]
description: Two corners of the bedroom hold tall arched windows, and beams of moonlight give their nearly opaque surface an eerie glow.  Two ivory-hued candles rest upon a great ebony desk, their flickering flames casting shadows across its surface.  Warm light radiates from a row of glaes orbs set into the ceiling above, their luminosity revealing a wide lacquered bookshelf near a dark mahogany double door.
location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Creating dark smudges to the southwest, Charl's Teeth rise ominously against the skyline and block passage to the open waters of the distant ocean.  Small bits of flotsam clank against the towering slabs of obsidian as the waves gently pull and push them back and forth.  Caught in one of the ragged gashes, a dark blue sail flutters forlornly in the light zephyr that pushes its way across the water.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Pinched between Charl's Teeth and the small island, the chaotic waves slosh back and forth in the thin channel.  Salty water slaps against the natural obsidian wall, only to explode into a fine mist that rains down on all nearby.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Moonlight glances off of the beaches of the small island, which sparkle beneath the silvery light.  In contrast to the dazzling beauty of the sandy shore, Charl's Teeth rise out of the southern water like a dark promise of silent destruction.  Cold water rushes through the small channel in a vain attempt to escape both the coast and the ragged obsidian wall.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Cast in the combined shadows of the small island's sheer cliffs and Charl's Teeth, the small channel dead ends at a waterlogged inlet.  Chaotically churning, the waves splash harshly against impenetrable stone and glossy obsidian that confines it.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Surrounded by bright tropical blossoms, a long wooden dock stretches out into the cool waters of the harbor and provides access to a small island.  Tall pylons surround the wooden structure, while bright white buoys line its edges and lightly bounce beneath the insistent push of the rolling waves.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Isle of Shells, Dock]
description: Coarsely textured to provide a sure footing, the whitewashed dock stretches outward from the verdant greenery of the island into the slightly choppy surf.  Pedal boats bob up and down at the edge of the structure in tandem to the delicate roll of the tide, their moorings clanking quietly from where they are anchored in place.  Covered in crushed, white shells, a small pathway winds its lazy way up a hill and deeper into the island.

title: [Isle of Shells]
description: Crushed white shells wind a sinuous path through the foliage to the distant docks, their pearly interiors glistening in the sunlight.  Cultivated vines twine up trellises along the northern edge of the island and provide a protective barrier that guards against the dangers of the cliffs beyond them.  Bushes, surrounded by small fences, produce a variety of berries that are ripe for the picking.

title: [Isle of Shells, Coastal Cliffs]
description: Bright white wrought iron railings curve around the edge of the cliff to create a protective barrier that prevents visitors to the island from tumbling over into the rocky shoals below.  Benches surrounded by brass lanterns rests against the contour of the railing and provide a comfortable space to recline around an enormous bonfire.  Public baking stoves and cutting boards are arranged along the eastern edge of the clearing.

title: [Isle of Shells, Orchard]
description: Spaced equidistant from each other, fruit-bearing trees pockmark the grassy landscape.  Stepping ladders stand next to the gnarled limbs of the verdant beauties, while baskets rest near their trunks.  Burning torches crafted of bamboo are spread throughout the orchard and are strategically placed to prevent accidental fires.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Isle of Shells, Garden]
description: Wooden planters are arranged in a checkerboard pattern across the glade, each supporting a different variety of cultivated vegetation.  Torches mark the grassy intersections between each box, their brightly burning tops dispelling the darkness.

title: [Isle of Shells, Muddy Bay]
description: Slopping gently downward, a small pathway connects the garden above to the secluded beach.  Large and small rocks pockmark the shore, the sharp edges of the shoals making it impossible to swim in the water.  Moist sand stretches to the east and west causing the ground to feel spongy and soft.

title: [Isle of Shells, Garden]
description: Railings surround the western edge of the clearing, the tall iron slats creating a protective barrier that prevents accidental, or purposeful, falls into the cliffs beyond.  Grassy pathways wind their way through the wide wooden planters that are stretch across the landscape, their soil filled interiors supporting a wide variety of verdant plant life.

title: [Isle of Shells, Muddy Bay]
description: Slopping gently downward, a small pathway connects the garden above to the secluded beach.  Large and small rocks pockmark the shore, the sharp edges of the shoals making it impossible to swim in the water.  Moist sand stretches to the east and west, causing the ground to feel spongy and soft.

title: [Isle of Shells, Beach]
description: Large flat stones are arranged along the perimeter of the beach, their smooth surfaces wide enough for easy reclining.  Rising and falling with the tide, the surf tumbles gently across the glittering sands and creates damp lines along the shore.  Bamboo torches are spread throughout the area, their brightly burning tops dispelling the dark of the night, while an enormous bonfire burns fitfully at the center of the clearing.

title: [Private Suite, Alcove]
description: Nestled away from the main suite, most of the small alcove is shrouded in darkness.  Two round silver sconces cause shadows to flicker across an array of wooden doors.  A few wisps of steam creep out from beneath a thick black velvet curtain.

title: [Stone Baths, Private Suite]
description: A soft murmur fills the room as a few patrons mill about, their footfalls dampened by the plush midnight green carpeting.  Bronze half-moon wall sconces project light towards the ceiling, bathing the room in a muted glow.  A white-robed elven attendant stands behind a dark maple desk, occasionally scribbling something on a small stack of parchments.  Spaced evenly around the room are number of large cabinets filled with towels.

title: [Stone Baths, Siren Suite]
description: The scent of lavender lingers in the air, the source being several dried stalks that have been placed in delicate blown glass vases set around the room.  The stone walls are covered with silken tapestries depicting various scenes of women in repose, while a tiled fireplace along the back wall serves as the focal point for a half ring of overstuffed sofas and divans.  Plush, pale violet carpeting rests beneath the furniture, and a curtained archway to the northeast exudes a floral aroma.

title: [Stone Baths, Patron Suite]
description: Rich grey-toned walls encompass the men's suite while midnight blue carpeting stretches across the entire floor.  A ring of high-backed chairs occupies the middle of the room with wooden drink stands positioned between each seat.  From behind a marble countertop, a burly human man greets guests while smoke trails up from his thick cigar.

title: [Blacksmith, The Forge]
description: Burly ogre zombies tower over the rows of forges, some of their skin melting from the heat as it rolls through the chamber.  The creatures groan eerily, constantly toiling away at their work.

title: [House Phoenix, Lockers]
description: A stone counter, chipped and scratched, fills half of this small cubicle.  A delicately scented candle cannot disguise the sour smell of mildew.  An airtight, waterproof locker awaits you on the counter.

title: [Savage Storm Table]
description: Mismatched chairs have been placed in an uneven circle around the lopsided mahogany table, the surface of which is so uneven, it threatens to spill any drink placed upon its surface.  A large painting covers the surface of this table, depicting, in breathtaking detail, a savage storm decimating the ships anchored in some unknown port city.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, House Clerk]
description: Centered in front of a circular stained glass window, a high-backed leather chair rests behind a mahogany desk crowded with letters and empty teacups.  A sparrow trills inside a brass filigree cage prominently displayed atop a bookshelf, the leather-bound volumes within embossed with gold lettering on the spines.  Across from an arched opening, an illuminated globe of Elanthia casts a radiant blue light across the pale white marble floor.

title: [Mikalmas's Armory]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Mikalmas's General Store]
description: Enclosed by mahogany paneled walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its mahogany floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the vaulted ceiling.  Right near the front is a vine-carved mahogany table and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Mikalmas's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a varnished golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Pemberley, Garden]
description: The garden teems with flickering fireflies and pale colored flora that encroaches on the path beneath the canopy of the surrounding dogwood trees.  White cobble walkways gleam faintly in the moonlight, leading the way towards a stately manor house to the north and a large lake that guards the eastern edge of the property.

Lush and crowded, this garden teems with numerous azaleas and rhododendrons that thrive beneath the protective canopy of flowering pink dogwood trees.
