Carefully planted and manicured, this garden still manages to look somehow wild and natural.  White cobble walkways lead through the brightly colored foliage to a stately manor house to the north and a large lake that guards the eastern edge of the property.

title: [Pemberley, Great Hall]
description: Polished villswood flooring stretches the length of this enormous room.  Soft golden teak paneling above pristine white wainscoting adds a warmth to the room.  Numerous paintings, depicting momentous events throughout history line the walls, lending their color to the grandeur of the hall.  A stately lor grandfather clock with beveled glass panels dominates the north wall next to a grand staircase that leads upwards towards a wide landing and the upper floors.

title: [Pemberley, Kitchen]
description: The exposed timber ceiling is centered with a gold chandelier hanging from a polished golden chain, while a smooth sandstone floor adds a touch of warmth and coziness to this large open room.  Two bay windows split the northern wall, allowing moonlight to spill across a low granite island in the center of the room.  Hammered into the grey stone wall is a polished veil iron rack, dangling a variety of pots and pans above a quaint cast iron stove flanked by granite topped cabinets that nicely offset the dark teak wainscotting.

title: [Pemberley, Dining Room]
description: Providing a stunning view of the western grounds, tall, narrow segmented windows allow moonlight to filter in.  Heavy ivory grape leaf-patterned drapes frame the windows, providing warmth to the pale grey stone walls.  A matching fringed rug lies centered on the villswood floor, gracing a smooth rectangular lor table and chairs, while a carved cherrywood hutch stands beside an opening in the north wall leading to the kitchen.

title: [Pemberley, Parlor]
description: Framed by rich velvet pumpkin-hued curtains, a pair of leaded pane windows dominate the far wall of this cozy setting.  Several tall wingback chairs are centered around a long low table in front of a pale grey granite hearth with a dark stone mantle.  Ornate teak moldings add a subtle elegance to the otherwise simple furnishings.

title: [Pemberley, Library]
description: The walls of this octagonal turret room stretch several floors upwards toward an intricate stained glass dome overhead.  Several softly glowing orbs float suspended at each landing, illuminating countless books lining the library's upper floors.  Rich mahogany bookcases encircle the ground floor, framing a carved lor archway leading out, while two deeply cushioned armchairs rest around a small round mahogany table upon a finely woven rug in the center of the area.

title: [Pemberley, Landing]
description: Flooding the area with moonlight, polished casement windows stretch from floor to ceiling along the northern wall.  A thick elven-crafted rug patterned in an intricate lor leaf design partially covers the villswood floor, while nicely complementing two window seats upholstered in a pale brocade, a delicate lor side table, and matching bookcase.  A carved lor archway leads east into the library, while a vaalin inlaid oak door leads west to the private living quarters.

title: [Pemberley, Bedroom]
description: Soft cream colored walls complement the chocolate toned crown molding, while tall segmented windows create a solarium like area in the northwest corner.  A pair of ivory couches are separated by a low-set rectangular lor table, set perfectly into the nook.  Tucked against the expansive southern wall is a four-poster mahogany bed with a cream and grey marble fireplace set into the western wall adjacent to it and opposite a vaalin inlaid wardrobe.  Recessed into the corner and facing out into the back gardens is a carved lor writing desk, its location providing a peaceful private getaway.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Brig]
description: Grimy copper-banded barrels, dented and scarred from misuse, stand to the side of a series of iron-barred cells.  Each barrel is filled to overflowing with tattered and rotting garments, most of which are so faded that it is hard to discern their original hues.  One barrel lies on its side, pinned between a cell wall and another container, its contents spilled in a heap across the stained decking.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Deep Passageway]
description: A passage widens slightly here, exposing blocks of undressed foundation stones on one side.  Passages branch off into darkness, with no apparent pattern or direction.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Bottom Deck]
description: Crammed with banded barrels and crates that are stacked up to the planking overhead, this small area reeks with the odor of rot and waste.  The sound of waves slapping against the outer hull drowns out all other noises.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Moist air laden with a mixture of rust, rot, and salt fills this section of the companionway.  A wide brush slathered with pitch lies on the floor next to a bucket of glossy black tar.  The ends of tar-soaked strips of oakum protrude from the hull where they have been crammed between planks, while even more gaps remain to be caulked.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Deep Passageway]
description: A passage widens slightly here, exposing blocks of undressed foundation stones on one side.  Passages branch off into darkness, with no apparent pattern or direction.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Kitchen]
description: Despite being large and spacious, this room's temperature is stifling, and bits of ash and dust skitter across the floor and float in the air.  A steel pot hanging from a cast iron tripod is suspended over a gash in the floor, a rush of burning air continuously gusting from it, keeping the metal pot heated.  Sealed containers of cooking supplies are scattered about the area, and a series of crudely made shelves containing food hangs from the wall.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Lapis Lounge]
description: The intricate mosaic tile floor depicts scenes from the history of Elanthia.  A gilt birdcage stands to one side.  Brightly colored native birds flutter about the cage, as though looking for a way back to their forest home.

wayto.33046: pull dwarvish tome in mistwood bookcase

title: [Annex, House Sovyn Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A green velvet pennant edged with silver hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [The Pie Shop]
description: Bright yellow paint coats the walls, which are bordered with grinning white skulls outlined in black.  The plank flooring is a mishmash of various unfinished wood types that creates a haphazard though artistic aesthetic, further enhanced by the dappling of spills of sunlight streaming through three large street-facing windows.  Filled with a variety of pies and topped with a small collection of jars, a broad, pristine display counter is surrounded by several wooden chairs and tables.

title: [The Pie Shop, Kitchen]
description: Spick and span, the kitchen is well-stocked with various baking paraphernalia, all organized in handily placed cabinets and wicker baskets, several of which are attached to the bright yellow walls.  Situated adjacent a swinging door and an open hearth, a spacious grey stone counter provides substantial ingredient preparation and dough-rolling space, and a wide chalkboard spans the wall above it.  Two large ovens and an oddly shaped machine share the back wall, opposite a basin, some wooden buckets, and a stone case of midding size.

title: [The Pie Shop, Backroom]
description: Stray rays of sunlight sneak in through two meager windows and splay through the room, creating pockets of luminescence in the otherwise dim surroundings.  Constructed of mismatched planking in a variety of hues, the floor's unfinished wood provides a distinct counterpoint to the bright yellow walls.  A large display counter takes up the majority of the room's space, nearly obfiscating a rickety stairway leading down.

title: [Shrine of Leya, Egan's Tomb]
description: Opening up into a vast circular chamber, the tomb is dominated by a simple black marble bier upon which rests an ornately-carved serpentine catafalque.  Rusted iron lamps mounted on the walls burn quietly, the faint aroma of their bdellium-scented oil filling the air.

title: [Shrine of Leya, Secret Passage]
description: Clay and shale walls glisten with a slight, damp trickle from the verdant forest above, sproutings of tangled roots run along the sides like skeletal fingers.  The gently sloping dirt floor leads down a torch-lit passage towards a flickering light glowing brightly at the far end.  Along the east wall, a long tapestry has been draped, illumination showing through where the edges warp and bow out.

title: [Shrine of Leya, Amazon's Vestry]
description: Slightly L-shaped, the clay walls here have been smoothed carefully, then panoramically-carved with many figures of armor-clad women bearing weapons.  A large black marble slab table paired with wooden benches extends the length of the room.  One silver iron oil lamp shaped to resemble the pool in the shrine above sits centered on the table, its single flame burning brightly.

title: [Solhaven, Caelyna's Boutique]
description: Pale green Vornavian silk covers the walls of the small, yet elegant cottage room.  A chandelier set with frosted globes hangs from the vaulted ceiling, shimmering rainbows paint the walls as sunlight from a pair of skylights catches crystal fragments accenting the piece.  Soft ivory velvet drapes frame the tall windows while matching wool carpeting underfoot muffles all sound.  Several small jewelry cases are displayed on shelves behind the glass front of a polished linden counter.

title: [Brickburn Hall, Laboratory]
description: A long granite-topped table stands as the focal point of the room.  A few work stations provide a place for practical instruction and research, while shelves and cupboards hold an array of seemingly unrelated items, tools, and ingredients.  In the corner, a box of alembics, mortars, and pestles stands next to a brass-framed mirror.

title: [Brickburn Hall, Corridor]
description: Ornate sconces spaced evenly along the walls illuminate the elegant doors on either side of the corridor.  At the end, a jalousie-topped doorway has been bolted shut, closing off the passage from the rest of the building.

title: [Brickburn Hall, Classroom Two]
description: Many desks sit in neat rows facing a large slate board at the front of the room.  A polished lectern has been erected off to the left of the board, diagonally opposite the door.

title: [Brickburn Hall, Classroom One]
description: Many desks sit in neat rows facing a large slate board at the front of the room.  A polished lectern has been erected off to the left of the board, diagonally opposite the door.

title: [Brickburn Hall, Antechamber]
description: Two pillars flank an arched hoarbeam door in the hall's formal entrance.  The side walls are adorned with portraits of august professors and headmasters, their attire formal, if antiquated.  Centered on the back wall, a large plaque in a gilded frame hangs with sconces on either side, the candlelight illuminating its elaborate script.  A westward corridor leads toward the classrooms.

title: [Summit Academy, West Ellipse]
description: A dusting of snow makes the stone path shimmer in the moonlight as it curves back toward the eastern commons.  Nestled in the tall fir trees is a pale stone edifice, its many windows shuttered against the night wind.

A dusting of snow makes the stone path glitter in the sunlight as it curves back toward the eastern commons.  Nestled in the tall fir trees is a pale stone edifice, its many windows unshuttered to let in the light of day.

title: [Summit Academy, South Ellipse]
description: A current of warm air flows from the walkway that winds south beneath an arched canopy of trees.  As it mixes with the frosty air, a constant breeze swirls through the area.  A narrow flagstone path splits as it leads to both a tile-roofed manor house and a thatch-roofed cobblestone cottage.

A current of warm air flows from the walkway that winds south beneath an arched canopy of trees.  As it mixes with the frosty air, a constant breeze swirls through the area.  A narrow flagstone path leads up to a tile-roofed manor house.

title: [Summit Manor, Parlor]
description: Curved, panelled walls enclose the spacious parlor, broken only by a banded wooden door.  The large upholstered furniture gives the room a permanent, solid feel, while the oversized stone fireplace provides warmth and ambiance, both day and night.  Recessed shelving holds hundreds, perhaps thousands, of books, and the windows are covered by heavy brocade drapes.

title: [Annex, Rone Academy Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A purple velvet pennant edged with silver hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Courtyard]
description: Patches of dewy clover dot the lush green lawn around the base of an ivy-covered tall stone tower, its pointed, conical roof rising toward the starlit sky.  Flickering candlelight illuminates the window at the tower's very top as it overlooks the courtyard.  A cobblestone path winds toward the garden, while a stone-framed lancet arch leads out through the curtain wall.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Garden]
description: Rows of nettle trees line the perimeter of the garden, their branches full of ripe honeyberry clusters.  Benches sit along the cobblestone path as it winds through the carefully tended cultivars that lend their perfume to the air.  Wrought iron shepherd hooks placed throughout the garden hold ornate lanterns, their soft flickers complementing the moonlight that weaves through the tree branches.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Great Hall]
description: The threshold of the tower leads into a circular room with a spiraling stone staircase as its centerpiece.  Behind an iron railing that follows the circumference of the chamber, the interior wall is lined from floor to ceiling with bookshelves, broken only by an arched heavy wooden door.  Tall iron candelabras form a semi-circle around the stairs, their candles filling the area with a warm glow.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Private Office]
description: Two tall wrought-iron candelabras stand on either side of a large oak desk, while a high-backed leather chair sits behind it.  Recessed shelving filled with scroll tubes and dozens of large tomes covers the entirety of the semi-circular wall.  Several round cushions have been scattered upon the floor in front of a grand oak bookcase brimming with pamphlets and journals.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Study]
description: A high-backed black leather sofa and several chairs provide comfortable seating for reading or sharing quiet conversation.  A small cedar chest of sticks sits next to a grey stone fireplace, while a long wooden sideboard holds refreshments.

title: [Sylinar's Spire]
description: The walls of the second level are bare, save for a few sconces and the open door that stands amidst its white stones.  The staircase spirals further upward to the third level of the tower.

title: [Sylinar's Spire]
description: A plum velvet curtain covers a third of the curved wall, while recessed shelving has been built along its remainder.  The staircase spirals further upward to the fourth level of the tower.

title: [Sylinar's Spire]
description: A white tallow candle drips in its holder atop a small writing desk.  The stool in front of it is covered with a thick layer of dust.  Several small nicks mar the frame of the door opposite the desk.  The staircase spirals further upward to the fifth level of the tower.

title: [Sylinar's Spire]
description: A dusty suit of platemail stands at rest, leaning against the dull greatsword held downward before it.  Across from the armor, a pocket of cold air enshrouds an open door.  A spiraling stone staircase spirals further upward to the sixth level of the tower.

title: [Sylinar's Spire]
description: An arched wooden door stands illuminated by tall pillar candles sitting on stone pedestals to either side.  The staircase has been blocked by a thick-linked iron chain, preventing further ascent.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Archives]
description: Hundreds of books and parchments fill the shelves that line the walls of the room.  While some are stacked neatly, arranged with nearly obsessive precision, others are in utter disarray.  Several crumpled scrolls lie scattered near a narrow hoarbeam lectern.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Alchemy]
description: Two tall black bookcases are filled to capacity with tomes.  Between them stands an intricate glass cabinet, its transparent doors closed and locked.  Four triangular tables have been arranged in the center of the room, their points facing outward in the cardinal directions.  A detailed chart hangs on the wall.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Creatures]
description: A tall minotaur skeleton stands guard between a set of velnalin antlers and a set of caribou antlers.  Behind the creature, the many volumes comprising the evolving Elanthian bestiary are arranged alphabetically on sturdy shelves.  An embossed placard sits atop one shelf.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Reference]
description: A long solid walnut table with scroll-cut carrels bisects the room.  Butting up against it is an intricate wood cabinet.  Shelving runs around the circumference of the room, stopping mid-way up the wall.  Atop the shelves are stacks of parchments, several small bottles of ink, and clay urns filled with quills.

title: [Summit Academy, Ellipse]
description: A ring of towering conifers grows out of the snow-covered, frozen ground.  In the center, a broad stone-ringed firepit is surrounded by several carved stone benches.  The brilliant blue sky possesses a clarity only realized in thin, frigid mountain air.  The peddler Zakabie stands near a small cart with an oiled canvas canopy.

A ring of towering conifers grows out of the snow-covered, frozen ground.  In the center, a broad stone-ringed firepit is surrounded by several carved stone benches.  The starlit sky possesses a clarity only realized in thin, frigid mountain air.  The peddler Zakabie stands near a small cart with an oiled canvas canopy.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Summit Academy, North Ellipse]
description: Snow-dusted firs grow along the curved stone paths that encircle the commons.  Smoke swirls from the chimney atop a two-story grey stone building, while its windows glow warmly as firelight shines from behind their frosted panes.

Snow-dusted firs grow along the curved stone paths that encircle the commons.  Smoke swirls from the chimney atop a two-story grey stone building, while its windows shine brightly as sunlight relfects off their frosted panes.

title: [Sebastian House, Sitting Room]
description: A roaring blaze crackles and snaps in a large stone fireplace, warming the large open room nicely.  An overstuffed horsehair settee and a few chairs provide a place to rest and socialize.  The curtain covering the entrance to the pantry holds in the heat, while opposite the hearth, a tall hoarbeam door leads outside.

title: [Summit Academy, East Ellipse]
description: Three tall pines stand clustered between a grey and white stone building and the winding path leading eastward into the trees.

title: [Groundskeeper's Yard]
description: Seated atop a wooded knoll is a modest stone and daub cottage.  To the north, the moon reflects off icy Lake Sasalis, its luminous glow shining between the trees.  A winding path leads back toward the openness of the commons.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Lobby]
description: Enclosed by elegant velvet drapery, the ornately framed entrance to the auditorium stands opposite the door leading to the main grounds.  Brass wall sconces hold deep red candles whose brilliance is reflected off the gilded cornice at the ceiling.  Completing the splendor of the foyer, a large bay window provides a stunning view of Lake Sasalis through an opening in the trees.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Auditorium]
description: The vast hall is filled with dozens of seats.  To the front, open velvet curtains frame a large stage perfect for performances, meetings, or lecturing large groups.  Overhead, crystal teardrops dangle from brass chandeliers.  The entrance to a small office stands discretely at the back of the hall.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Office]
description: A scribe's desk sits before a cushioned wooden bench in the center of the room.  Behind it, a long row of cabinets is topped by books, ledgers, and scrolls.  A tall door has been wedged open by a wooden block, though the boxes that threaten to spill out would likely be enough to keep the door from closing.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Storage]
description: The room is stuffy from the lack of air movement around the piles of boxes stacked high against the walls.  A wardrobe is wedged between two such stacks against the back wall, filled to capacity with dusty academic regalia, moth-eaten costumes, and frayed robes.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Stage]
description: Rich, burgundy velvet curtains hang on either side of the stage's arch.  The highly polished wooden floor extends onto the apron, in the center of which stands a darkly stained podium.  Six wide steps descend into the auditorium.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Dressing Room]
description: This spacious room houses a myriad of effects used to prepare for a theatrical production.  Costumes, makeup, and other accouterments of the profession lay in various levels of organization around the area.  The back wall is occupied by a large wardrobe, on either side of which hang faded handbills, highlighting theatrical productions of years gone by.  A burgundy velvet curtain leads back to the stage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Dressing Room]
description: A long wooden table stands along the western wall.  Before each table are several chairs, with a mirror hanging above the table before each seat.  Luminescent orbs glow brightly around each mirror.  A rack in the corner holds several cloaks and coats, ranging in size from halfling to human, while a single giant-sized cloak lies heaped on the floor.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Dressing Room]
description: A long wooden table stands along the eastern wall.  Before each table are several chairs, with a mirror hanging above the table before each seat.  Luminescent orbs glow brightly around each mirror.  On a rack in the corner hangs a lavender silk cloak with vertical slits in the back.

title: [Ostwicke Hall, Dressing Room]
description: A long wooden table stands along the western wall.  Before each table are several chairs, with a mirror hanging above the table before each seat.  Luminescent orbs glow brightly around each mirror.  A rack in the corner holds a mishmosh of items, including a vest, a feather boa, and a single sock.

title: [Groundskeeper's Cottage]
description: A heavy rug covers the majority of the knotted wood floor.  A large, bulky chair sits near a simple square table, above which hangs a neatly framed sign.  A single window lets the moonlight in, filtered though it is through the many trees surrounding the cottage.  The light casts shifting shadows upon the darkly stained door.

title: [Summit Academy, Lake Path]
description: Gaps between the trees grant glimpses of Lake Sasalis to the north.  The moonlight reflects off its icy surface, giving the surroundings a surreal glow.

title: [Summit Academy, Lake Sasalis]
description: Firs, cedars, pines, and spruce trees converge at the edge of the woods, sentries before the brilliant Lake Sasalis.  Its frozen surface is preternaturally smooth, affording a perfect reflected image of the surrounding mountains.  The snow is crisp with a crystalline coating of ice, marred only by a line of large pawprints near the treeline.

title: [Sebastian House, Pantry]
description: A heavy curtain separates this nook from the sitting room's heat, keeping its contents cool, while a small window provides enough light to see.  The back wall is lined with shelving to store dry goods and preserved foods.  A rhimar-lined box keeps a few perishable items fresh.

title: [Sebastian House, Corridor]
description: The hallway is warm but austere in design.  Simple iron sconces on the wall provide enough light to distinguish between a white door with a griffin knocker and a black door with a polar bear knocker.  A set of carpeted stairs leads down to the sitting room.

title: [Sebastian House, Dormitory Room]
description: Opposite the panelled door, a long carrel desk has been built into the north wall.  Two neatly made beds stand against each of the other two walls, completing the simple functionality of the room.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Alcove]
description: The absence of windows renders this small alcove almost completely dark, save a trickle of light that spills in through the exit hole.  Markings slightly representative of runic patterns and shapes have been scribbled in charcoal along the stone walls.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Restricted]
description: Large tomes are protected by the glass doors that cover each of the room's tall shelves.  A hexagonal wooden table stands in the center of the room before a single chair.  On top of the table, two large oil lamps provide the small room with ample light for reading.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: To the east, the surroundings become progressively less rocky.  Rose bushes perfume the air with their heavy scent.  Verdant vines surround a small shrine against the wall.  A few bouquets of maidenhair fern and roses are propped in front of the shrine, interspersed with several lit votive candles.

To the east, the surroundings become progressively less rocky.  Rose bushes, blooming riotously in a variety of colors, spring from the ground and creep tenaciously through the rocky outcroppings.  Verdant vines surround a small shrine against the wall.  A few bouquets of maidenhair fern and roses are propped in front of the shrine.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Festively colored flowers sprout in wild profusion in a loose circle around a limestone statue of a grinning man, illuminated by a trio of burning torches.  Tall stalks of gladiolus and larkspur grow beside sprawling bushes of showy begonias, while sheaves of snapdragon stalks in a variety of brilliant colors battle for space.  An abandoned bottle pokes out of the flowers, partially obscured by the edge of the statue.

Festively colored flowers sprout in wild profusion in a loose circle around a limestone statue of a grinning man.  Tall stalks of gladiolus and larkspur grow beside sprawling bushes of showy begonias, while sheaves of snapdragon stalks in a variety of brilliant colors battle for space.  An abandoned bottle pokes out of the flowers, partially obscured by the edge of the statue.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: A three-legged easel has been set up on the sedge green grass to the north of the pathway.  The canvas on the easel reflects the green, tan and hazy purple colors of the surrounding landscape.  Glimpses of brilliantly colored flowers can be seen to the west, but only the tiny purple heads of lavender plants lend their color and clean scent to the immediate area.

title: [Lich's Landing, Specter Lane]
description: Smoke rises from the roof of a large blacksmith shop in the distance, the black fog darkening the area even more.  The sound of metal bouncing against metal echoes all around, broken up only by a high-pitched scream that periodically pierces the air.

title: [Shade Square, Bone Field]
description: A small, dark field fills an old vacant lot behind a row of decrepit buildings.  The dim keening of the town's activity is muffled here, and deep shadows stretch across the ground.  Rising up from the field are large, jagged splinters of bone, like ashen fingers reaching for those who pass by.

title: [Shade Square, Southwest]
description: The corner of the square is filled with the wrenching cries of the living, as bone golems stomp down the lane, dragging a number of humans, kicking and screaming behind them.  The air is heavy with the overwhelming scent of decomposition.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Acorns litter the walkway, the bounty of the oak trees lining both sides of the path.  Squirrel's nests are plentiful in the oaks' branches, and other fauna have made themselves at home in this perfect pocket of woodland habitat.  A bench carved of fallen wood sits at the path's edge, allowing rest and the opportunity to observe the wildlife.

title: [Shade Square, Southeast]
description: Driftwood wagons full of mutilated bodies are pulled through the streets by hunchbacked ogre zombies, while two bone golem sentries stand guard outside of the general store.  Blackened cages, slick with fresh blood, hang from a number of tree branches nearby.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Dark drakes twist along the panels of the door where the path abruptly ends.  Power vibrates through the area, a tingling and tangy taste in the air.  Soft glows brush against the door, reflected from the votive candles lining the path to the north.  Each blade of grass, each crumble of soil, has been placed solely to draw the eye to the door blocking the path.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Golden votive candles line both edges of the path at regular intervals.  Vines of wisteria and honeysuckle sprout from small soil beds behind the candles, weaving around each other and framing the path both north and south.  Several sheer gossamer panels stretch overhead on tall iron poles from the rampart to the keep, creating a shifting canopy and holding the fragrance of the vines close to the ground.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Ancient lilac bushes crowd the pathway, their scent overwhelming and their height enough to close off the sky from view.  Small dreamstone cabochons have been hung by silver threads from the lilac branches, providing a restful, meditative atmosphere.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: An ebonwood gate, standing between the rampart wall and the path, draws a boundary between life and death in the surrounding area.  On the southern side of the gate, wildflowers thrive and greenery abounds.  On the northern side of the gate, the columns of names of the dead march inexorably across the black basalt wall.  A small pedestal holding a black and white marble offering plate stands at the base of the gate.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Flowers of every shade of gold, from pale lemon yellow to dark tawny red, surround a massive blue-flecked sunstone sundial that sits on a raised mound of grass on the southern side of the path.  A circular bench sits near the rampart wall, allowing contemplation of either the sundial or the procession of names.  Threading through a sunstone sundial, a walkway leads to an open air shrine next to the keep.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Shade trees are planted along the inner side of the path, offering a cool resting area for those who avail themselves of the small wrestling circle on the northern side of the path.  The pristine chalk line of the circle provides a sharp border between the deep red dirt and the well-manicured lawn.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: The flexible withes of a weeping willow droop down to the grass bordering the path to the north.  Within the protection of the leafy boughs, the glint of water can be seen reflecting the dapples of sunlight.  Deep croaking breaks the silence intermittently, indicating that the small pond houses at least one frog.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Splitting the path in two, a massive oak tree provides shade and shelter during the day.  Squirrels chitter overhead, cavorting in the playground of dried leaves and acorns.  A cornucopia wraps around the tree's base, overflowing with offerings themed to the harvest and to the bounty of nature.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Cobblestones in drab grey and tan form a swirl in the middle of the pathway, spiraling in towards a thin obsidian pedestal.  A cloudy crystal ball, polished into a perfect sphere, balances atop the pedestal.  Two yew trees, their bark grey and their branches pendulous with old needles, stoop like old men towards the ball.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: To the north of the path a modest stage has been constructed, not far from the rose gardens that lie just to the east.  A gentle hill rises to the south of the path, affording natural tiered seating to those wishing to watch a performance being enacted on the stage.  Diminutive lights have been set into the base of the stage, allowing for nighttime performances.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: A well-tended rose garden borders the north side of the pathway.  Raised beds of cultivated roses are arranged in an elegant tiered pattern, allowing passersby to admire the variety of hues displayed by the blooms.  Each bush holds at least one perfect bloom, and the fragrance of roses permeates the air.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Large, shallow wooden boxes hold blazingly white sand interrupted by large metal blocks.  Small stone columns sit alongside the path, just tall enough to sit on.  A scattering of golden asters and yellow buttercups dot the grass surrounding the path.

title: [The Forge, Backroom]
description: Sweltering heat emanates from the crimson forge in the corner of the room.  Two wide windows stand open over the forge in an unsuccessful attempt to cool the room.  A large bellows sits beside the forge, ready to fan the red hot coals even brighter.  Sitting in the center of the room is a massive iron anvil with a water trough beside it.  Various hammers and other tools hang from wooden pegs lining the walls.

title: [The Forge, Storage Room]
description: Constructed of rough hewn planks, the room stands empty but for a rough wooden counter and a door leading to the backroom.  A red glow radiates through the door, bringing with it a blast of heat from the back room.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Rushes and cattails cover both sides of the path as it dips into lower land after rising over the mounds to the east.  The wind whistles through the reeds, creating a susurration with every breath of wind.  Small animals and birds nest in the shelter of the tall canes, their calls adding to the noise.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Mounds have been made in this area, obviously not natural, yet blending in with the surroundings.  A dark stone walkway snakes along the rise, leading to a cavern hollowed out of the largest of the hills.  A white chalk crown is traced on the mound's side, large enough to be visible from every vantage within the bailey.  Below the mound, the grassy expanse of the bailey spreads out in verdant glory.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Small tables and chairs are scattered about a quaint portico area that shelters in the shade of the rampart wall.  Several scholars sit around the tables arguing in a friendly manner, while some sit by themselves with papers spread before them.  A long counter resting near the wall is stocked with rolls of parchment, ink sticks and other sundries, indicating that this area is frequently used by the studious.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Fel posts and lintels form a pergola over the path.  Benches made of the same wood are shaded within the structure by the draping vines of jasmine covering the columns and top.  The bright reds and oranges of poppies flank the corners of the pergola, and the combined scent of the flowers is thick and heady.

Fel posts and lintels form a pergola over the path, blending with the darkness of the night.  Benches made of the same wood are shaded within the structure by the draping vines of jasmine covering the columns and top, allowing only the barest trace of starlight to reach the path.  The heady, thick scent of poppies rise from the flowers at the corners of the pergola.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Chilling breezes pass through the area, rustling the piles of dead leaves that have formed drifts against the rampart wall to the east.  Tiny sprouts of spring green grass push their way through the leaves, a visible symbol of the renewal of life.  A small ebonwood plate stands in the center of the path, mounted on a stand shaped to resemble a double-arched black gate.  A single silver rattles in the bowl with every gust of wind.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: The blast of heat from a large fire with a sunburst-shaped reflector behind it is nearly visible in rippling waves in the air.  The grass itself is limp and brown, becoming greener as it retreats from the flames.  A small bench is the focus of the reflected heat, and seems a suitable to contemplate the power of Phoen.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Bordered to the southwest by a small watercourse, this manicured lawn contains a small area with wooden poles and bars for stretching muscles.  An octagonal structure stands at the end of a small walkway, the rampart wall rising behind it.  The names of heroes continue in columns behind the structure on the polished basalt.

title: [The Path to Enlightenment]
description: Twin pools of water lap gently at the soil on either side of the path, joined by a tiny trickle of water that cuts across the walkway.  Smooth stepping stones have been placed in the shallow water to allow easy passage over the watercourse.  Brilliantly colored koi swim lazily through the pools.

title: [Shade Square, West]
description: In the midst of the town stretches the main bazaar, spread out over rough and bumpy stones.  The serpentine lanes are abuzz with activity, from ghouls pushing carts of rocks through the street, to zombie soldiers performing their latest drill.  Disembodied eyes, all having red pupils, float through the area, scanning the surroundings as blood drips from their fleshy veins.

title: [Shade Square Central]
description: This is the heart of the main square of Lich's Landing.  A number of makeshift shops are clustered around the bazaar, with a strange and gruesome mixture of undead moving about in a mock display of the living.  To the north, an old well with grime-covered stones sits in the shadow of a gnarled, dark oak tree.  The oak is tall, its bark black and glistening with sticky blood.  Hanging from the branches of the tree are a dozen malformed bodies, each garbed in the uniform of the Wehnimer's militia.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Stone Baths, Office]
description: Faint light from outside barely shines through thick opaque windows set high into a wall, casting shadows into a corner.  Hanging brass lanterns emit a soft glow, distributing additional light throughout the office.  A great ebony desk stretches between a lacquered bookshelf and a tall brass-trimmed door.  Two cushioned armchairs rest in the center of the room and a massive woven tapestry covers an entire wall.

title: [Patron Suite, Oils]
description: The area is infused with a variety of aromas, ranging from musky colognes to flavorful perfumes.  Small windows above provide escape for the oily scents.  Two burnished dark mahogany tables run parallel in the center of the room, each holding a variety of oil pots.

title: [Patron Suite, Cold Bath]
description: Cold marble floors surround a row of circular pools of still water, their icy temperature chilling the entire chamber.  Tall wooden racks rest in each corner, holding a variety of towels and robes. Light from nearby brass lanterns cast a soft glow in the room.

title: [Patron Suite, Hot Bath]
description: An immense pool of steaming water dominates most of the room, easily accessible by flat limestone steps.  Long wooden towel racks are mounted on the walls and the air is muggy, yet holds the faint scent of sandalwood.

title: [Patron Suite, Steam Room]
description: Centered in the vaulted room is a black iron-wrought brazier, where thick steam rises up from hot rocks placed inside. The floor is made of smoothed grey marble and moisture clings to its surface.  A row of sturdy granite benches line each wall, broken up only by a dark mahogany door.

title: [Siren Suite, Oils]
description: Moonlight from the open windows set high above filters down to the soft emerald-hued rug that covers the stone floor with its luxuriously plush surface.  A long, rose-carved table wraps around three walls of the room, its surface laden with various jars.  Strong scents waft into the air, but a gentle breeze from above keeps the fragrance from becoming overpowering.

title: [Siren Suite, Hot Bath]
description: The room is almost entirely comprised of a large pool of steaming water, set into the warm stone floor.  Slate steps lead down from all four sides of the pool, while benches under the water's surface serve as comfortable places to relax.  Several glass-paneled oil lanterns hang from the stone walls, releasing a mild soothing fragrance.  Near an engraved wooden door, robes and clothes hang upon some metal hooks.

title: [Siren Suite, Steam Room]
description: Stone walls encapsulate this large room, and benches of the same material seem to reach up from the floor to beckon weary visitors to rest.  Steam rises from the circular stone pit in the center of the room, created from water poured over the blazing hot rocks inside.  Hooks and shelves on the wall near the engraved wooden door serve to hold the clothing and belongings of bathers, and floral scented oil lanterns hang high above the floor, bathing the room in a flickering glow.

title: [Siren Suite, Cold Bath]
description: This room holds a chill as the water from the bath evaporates into the air.  No steam wafts up from the surface of the water in the rounded pool.  Benches, both underwater and against the walls, serve as seating for the room.  Oil lanterns that hang from hooks in the wall release the aroma of rain and ozone, the subtle scents giving the room an energizing ambiance.  A shelf near the curved wooden door offers its surface for bather's belongings.

title: [Caelyna's Boutique, Private]
description: Resting in the center of the thick ivory carpet is a tall linden-framed mirror.  Several benches cushioned in deep green Vornavian silk are placed about the dressing chamber. The far wall boasts a large sea glass mosaic of a grand swan that glistens as warm tendrils of sunlight from the skylight above illuminate the beautiful creature.

title: [Private Suite, Steam Room]
description: A speckled marble floor extends across the room, enclosed by four smooth light wood-paneled walls.  Rows of black granite benches form a semi-circle around two large bronze braziers,  steam rising from the heated rocks within.

title: [Solhaven, Caelyna's Boutique]
description: Pale linden wood contrasts with dark forest green Vornavian silk that adorns the walls of the room.  A large wardrobe along one wall holds a variety of men's clothing, while a large copper rack displays an assortment of outer coverings.  A wide array of shoes and boots are laid out on a large wooden display.

title: [Solhaven, Caelyna's Boutique]
description: Crafted from frosted crystal, a trio of globes hanging from copper chains illuminate the room.  A large wardrobe of clothing covers one wall while a polished linden chest filled with shoes and boots covers another.  Centered on the thick ivory wool carpet is a hammered brass rack of coats, cloaks, and other outer garments.

title: [Caelyna's Boutique, Parlor]
description: Green specks add color to the thick ivory carpet that cushions the floor.  Centered in the room is a small linden table that holds a variety of refreshments.  A large sofa padded with dark green cushions and a pair of chairs are placed in a circular pattern about the room.  Standing next to a dressing room door is a polished gold-framed mirror.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Cobbled Walkway]
description: Pale interlocking stones are joined together to create a cobbled walkway that leads up to an ornate mistwood gate set into a low greystone wall.  Fragrant bushes of blooming alabaster roses line either side of the entrance, their light petals standing out against the dark background.

Diffuse moonlight illuminates the pale interlocking stones of a cobbled walkway  that leads up to an ornate mistwood gate set into a low greystone wall. Fragrant bushes of blooming alabaster roses line either side of the entrance, their light petals highlighted by the soft luminescence from above.

title: [Journey's End, Lawn]
description: Surrounded by a low grey stone wall, a rolling green lawn spreads out before a beautiful alabaster stone manor.  Both elegant and charming, the building's design synthesizes the beauty of the landscape.  A cobbled walkway separates a grove of apple trees and blossoming beds of colorful flowers.

wayto.26834: ;e if GameObj.inv.find {|obj| obj.noun == "key"};fput "go beechwood door";else;empty_hand;multifput "get my #{UserVars.journeys_end} from my #{UserVars.keysack}","go beechwood door","put my key in my #{UserVars.keysack}";fill_hand;end

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Western Dock]
description: The western dock houses a great deal of the trading vessels and cargo ships that drop anchor in port, and emits the gentle creaking of weathered wood that rocks atop nearby waters.  Broken only by an occasional ivory snow-dusted ridge, a shadowy curvature of murky grey cliffs stalks behind the entrance to a lengthy red cedar pier trailing out towards the horizon.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Lornon Pier]
description: In the distance, an appointed line of bristly evergreens separates the looming, mountainous territory from the sandy beach below a lengthy red cedar pier.  The dark, mercurial waves rise and fall, clamoring against the exposed bluffs to the west in a repetitive tidal lullaby.

title: [The Pie Shop, Basement]
description: Well-packed earth sends a loamy aroma floating through the chilly air and makes up the entirety of the capacious basement's walls and floor.  A small, disordered pile of crates and an exceedingly large mountain of crates are stacked near one another behind a rickety stairway.  Flickering lanterns hang from several hooks in the plank ceiling, casting three charcoal-hued couches, a dead root table, and a partially preserved cook's assistant corpse in a dappled mixture of light and shadow.

title: [Shield of the Shrickhen]
description: Bits and pieces of bone-inlaid armor adorn the walls, while shields hang upon another.  Scraps of metal and bone are littered across the floor, while a misshapen and grotesque shrickhen scrambles about, restocking the supply.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: Fitting to its namesake, the road here is twisted and its uneven cobblestones slick from blood.  Disfigured bodies are hoisted up on stakes, creating a ghastly border along both sides of the path.

title: [Journey's End, Sitting Room]
description: Tucked away in the back of the manor is an elegant sitting room.  A sliding glass door dominates the north wall, giving a peek at the bright sky and the verdant garden beyond.  Several cushioned chairs are placed around a small mistwood table, creating an intimate setting.  A small porcelain stove sits in the corner, a basket of supplies open beside it.  A buffet table decorates the east wall, atop it sits a small ceramic pot filled with thick greenery, its long tendrils of leaves creeping down the side.

title: [White Haven, Ice Garden]
description: Along the eastern border of the garden, creeping vines have forced their way through a snow-laden wall, the frozen tendrils not quite reaching a series of winterberry bushes glistening in a sheen of hoarfrost.  A maze of crystalline ice sculptures and dark shrubbery is embraced overhead by delicate crystal arches draped with curtains of iceblossoms and snow pansies.  Cutting through, a winding cobblestone pathway leads to a raised center dominated by a large bonfire encircled by cedar log benches.

title: [White Haven, Magical Workshop]
description: Steam rising from a dark cauldron is touched by prisms of color cast from the crystalline walls of the room.  A floating orb hangs above a long wooden table set with chairs upholstered in finely-tooled leather.  Bookcases lined with tomes of magic are placed against one wall while a low workbench graces another.

title: [Journey's End, Patio]
description: The enclosed garden is ringed by pale granite pillars supporting the gently sloping slate roof.  Across the way, a pale beechwood door leads to another portion of the manor.  A narrow bed of white gravel surrounds a silvery grey stone fountain which centers the garden.  Mixed with shades from viridian to sage, dense layers of moss cover the ground leading to a massive willow.  A woven silk hammock is stretched between two ivory posts that are covered with climbing white roses.

The enclosed garden is ringed by pale granite pillars supporting the gently sloping slate roof.  Across the way, a pale beechwood door leads to another portion of the manor.  A narrow bed of white gravel surrounds a silvery grey stone fountain which centers the garden.  Mixed with shades from viridian to sage, dense layers of moss cover the ground leading to a massive willow.  A woven silk hammock is stretched between two glowbark posts that are covered with climbing white roses.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Wehnimer's Cobbling Shop]
description: The interior of the small shop is rustic, without much decoration save for a few examples of local craftsmanship displayed in the front window.  A long wide counter runs the length of the room with numerous bolts of fabric chromatically stacked behind it.  Adjacent to the counter is a rack of glass drawers, each one revealing glimpses of colorful buttons and buckles.  A clerk moves casually near three stands, draping fresh hides over their surface.

title: [Isharn Enclave, Courtyard]
description: Sunlight seethes through the branches of a huge, spiraling black lor sprouting from a raised planter at the courtyard's center.  The old stalwart long ago overgrew its boundaries, its gnarled roots spreading out to crack the surrounding paving stones in their unfettered growth.  Leaves the color of molten silver gleam from the stygian branches while their duller, deader cousins scurry underfoot at the breeze's urging.  The courtyard is enclosed by a low villa with iron-riveted doors and sloped rooftops.

title: [The Last Enclave]
description: Beneath a jagged dome of opaque crystal, scarlet silk banners dangling heliodor tassels stretch from wall to wall overhead, brazenly displaying their grey tower sigils.  The crystal of the dome is suffused with magical energies, pulsing from sullen crimson to angry red before subsiding once again.  Steps lead up from a pair of iron-riveted doors so that a greeting host will always stand higher than newly-welcomed visitors.

title: [Isharn Enclave, Nook]
description: A carpet of silver-grey leaves softens the paving stones near the edge of a crystal-clear pond in the courtyard's corner.  Fed by a burbling fountain shaped like three elven maidens, the pool's music echoes off of the walls in an even, lulling manner.  Cushioned chairs ornate enough to be thrones laze by the waterside in a patch of cool shadows.

title: [Cloudberry Room]
description: The plain, light yellow walls complement the golden-orange marble tiles.  On the wall hangs a painting of a group of halflings happily feasting on a huge cloudberry pie -- their faces dripping with crumb-covered juices.

title: [Duskruin Warehouse]
description: Dingy walls rise upon the eastern and western sides of the room, their thick cobblestone faces devoid of window or furnishing, while the joining walls are made of rough oak slabs.  Crates and boxes, each labeled with rough slate and chalk signs, are pushed back from the open flooring to provide easy passage between a long iron and wood counter and a copper-bound door that leads to the alleyway beyond.  A pair of enormous wrought iron candelabras are positioned to provide the best possible light to the cramped space.

title: [The Glimaerstone Heel, Cobblers]
description: A counter, carved out of the surrounding stone, is overlaid with a slab of polished ultramarine glimaerstone.  Two matching wall-hung shelves, laden with shoe lasts and with sample pieces, stare each other down across an open space in the middle of the cavern.  A pair of chairs and a small table complete the collection of furniture.

title: [Greystorm Manor, Courtyard]
description: A tall mithril gate marks the threshold of a lush, verdant courtyard surrounded by a stately flagstone wall.  Moss, lichens, and lacy green fronds drape over the wall in a gentle welcome into a serene oasis shielded from the bustle of town.  A vine-covered alcove surrounds a marble statue.  Stone pavers traverse through the lawn and spiral around a beautiful marble fountain in the center of the luxuriant grounds.  The path continues toward an expansive grey stone manor, shadowed by the branches of an old knotted oak tree.
location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Greystorm Manor, Great Room]
description: The room is comfortably furnished and generous in size, with floors of polished oak and large windows that bathe the room in moonlight.  Several leather chairs and end tables have been casually arranged in small groups around the room, and a dark wood-paneled bar rests along a wall.  An imposing stone fireplace stands at the far end of the room, with a carved scarlet-plumed owl perched on the mantel and the Greystorm coat of arms hanging from a tapestry above.  Two overstuffed cognac leather armchairs sit angled before a bear skin rug and the stone hearth.  A curved dark-stained staircase leads up to a rune-inlaid archway.

The room is comfortably furnished and generous in size, with floors of polished oak and large windows that bathe the room in moonlight.  Several leather chairs and end tables have been casually arranged in small groups around the room, and a dark wood-paneled bar rests along a wall.  An imposing stone fireplace stands at the far end of the room, with a carved scarlet-plumed owl perched on the mantel and the Greystorm heraldry hanging from a tapestry above.  Two overstuffed cognac leather armchairs sit angled before a bear skin rug and the stone hearth.  A curved dark-stained staircase leads up to a rune-inlaid archway.
location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Greystorm Manor, Study]
description: The expansive study is lined with recessed bookshelves from the floor to the ceiling.  Several sliding ladders provide access to the tall shelves filled with books and scrolls.  A large oak work table occupies the center of the room, scattered with potions and scribble-filled notebooks.  The stars and moon in the night sky provide barely enough light to navigate the room.
location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Greystorm Manor, Banquet Hall]
description: The room has high vaulted ceilings and large arched windows that allow the moonlight to illuminate the room.  A polished oak credenza is filled with a bounty of freshly prepared fare.  In the center of the room is a long oak banquet table lined with rich velvet-upholstered chairs.  Elegant silk tapestries are mounted along the walls of the room.
location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Greystorm Manor, Gardens]
description: Rife with vibrant colored blooms, the garden has been designed and manicured with expert care.  Meandering paths weave between colorful flowerbeds and circle the trunks of flowering fruit trees.  Near the center of the garden, an ornately carved stone bench sits next to a small pond.  The surface of the pond is dotted with large water flowers, but occasional ripples reveal the presence of fish and other water-loving creatures.  A vine-covered carved stone stairway with flowering terraces leads to the moonlit rooftop.
location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Greystorm Manor, Terrace]
description: The rooftop terrace looks out over the luxurious gardens behind the manor and provides an expansive view of the town and the bay.  Large grey paving stones tile the terrace, which is dotted by beautifully groomed shrubs.  Carved stone benches are placed throughout the garden and around a large iron firepit.  A large arched trellis covered in green foliage and tiny purple flowers offers an inviting place to dance or relax under the stars.  In the far corner of the terrace sits a large brass-fitted telescope.
location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Burghal Enclave, Gem Passage]
description: Winding slightly, the passageway narrows and descends sharply, plunging deeper into the rock below the fortress.  The chalky white tufa walls funnel the faint violet glow in from the west, precluding the need for a light source.  The soft lighting and cool, earthy smell provide a calm alternative to the bustle of the fortress above.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Gem Passage]
description: Veins of violet glimaerstone glow faintly within the chalky white walls.  A series of wooden doors have been strategically placed to artistically enhance the beauty of the native gemstones.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Gem Passage]
description: The mouth of the tunnel opens into a wide crossing corridor running off to the east.  The rough ceiling of bedrock above descends into white tufa walls.  Sturdy brick arches bolster the tunnel's ceiling and are fashioned from unmortared stone bricks.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Shimeraern Var]
description: Terminating at a large, metal-banded door, a rough-hewn tunnel leads away, its further end hidden by several abrupt turns.  The passageway's ceiling plunges through the layers of bedrock in its descent and is periodically reinforced with bricked tufa arches.

title: [The Datum Line]
description: The stone walls are crowded with wooden bookshelves, their lacquered heights brushing the low, carved ceiling.  In the middle of the chamber sits a wooden table, unremarkable save for its top surface, which is a raised and plastered topographical map.  Similar maps, though of different areas, are piled in a corner of the room, underneath the tripod base of a brass alidade and compass.

title: [Burghal Enclave, King's Court]
description: Sloping downward sharply, the tunnel winds its way deeply through the bedrock into the white tufa beneath.  Running northward, the passageway cuts beneath Guardian Keep, the very heart of Ta'Vaalor.

title: [Gearheads, Parts]
description: Very little of the shop is actually given away, spatially, to commerce -- a small counter and a sign on one stone wall are about it.  Occupying most of the space is an immense furnace, which is connected to a set of pipes and an innumerable number of gears, cogs, wheels, and panels.  Sitting next to the contraption is a partially disassembled cog golem.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Vaalorn Tunnel]
description: A meandering vein of unmined vaalorn sparkles brightly in the soft glow from the west.  Tufa walls encroach drastically, and the ceiling is quite low in this tight corridor.  The occasional cluster of crystals along the floor provides a lighted path leading east.

title: [Stacked Vintners, Winery]
description: The shop is artificially divided into a front and back by means of a ceiling-high stack of oaken barrels.  A small counter sits in front of the wall of casks near an artistic gnomish wine press, further delineating the public and private space.

title: [The Oil and Press]
description: Several long, rough-hewn wooden tables are crowded together, surrounded by equally basic benches.  Simple, iron-chained chandeliers hang suspended from the high, domed ceiling, each set with thick beeswax tapers.  The floor and walls are unfinished tufa, though care has been taken on one wall to incorporate the undulations of several natural veins of glimaerstone into a larger fresco.  A stone grinding wheel and oaken press sit beneath the painting.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Vaalorn Tunnel]
description: A row of massive brick arches support the overhanging rock and flow seamlessly into the tufa walls.  Sporadic patches of darker blue ore near a deeply recessed niche mark a continued presence of vaalorn within the tufa walls.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Vaalorn Tunnel]
description: Water covers the floor of this cavern, swirling in nearly silent eddies before rushing away to rejoin the Mistydeep River.  Raised stepping stones have been artfully placed, creating a path from east to west with a branch that leads to several doors set into the wall.  The subtle lapping of the water against the stones provides a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

title: [Burghal Enclave, Caernaeas Var]
description: A streak of unmined vaalorn runs through the tunnel wall, making a long line of dusky cornflower that stands out sharply against a matrix of white tufa.  The brick arches that periodically support the ceiling are carefully arranged to avoid obscuring any of the metallic inclusion.  Past the last of the arches, the tunnel truncates at a large, metal-banded door.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Two female statues flank a simple limestone altar.  One hangs suspended upside down, her feet gracefully pointed toward the sky and her arms outstretched in a gesture curiously evocative of both embrace and denial.  The other, a fair but expressionless winged woman, gazes at nothing as though she were beyond either hope or concern.  A broken mirror behind the altar throws back the sunlight from arched windows in shards.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Bare of color or design, the blank grey walls are a sharp contrast to the gaudily painted dome.  The vivid hues on the ceiling compete for attention in an intricate spiral, each whorl detailed with smaller swirls of riotous color in a seemingly endless progression.  Long narrow mats on the floor invite not kneeling, but lying down, the better to contemplate the vibrant patterns above.  Simple white candles provide steady illumination.

title: [Cleric Guild, Meditation Room]
description: Mosaics formed from variegated chips of native stone line the walls, the stylized river motif seeming to ripple under the flickering torchlight.  The simply patterned prayer mats covering the bare rock floor are sumptuously soft and lightly dusted with beach sand.

title: [Cleric Guild, Prayer Room]
description: Statues of the pantheon of Others surround you, their carven marble features soft or stern according to their natures.  Narrow stained glass windows cast the room half in shadow, half in amber radiance.  Beach sand makes mats unnecessary and eases the long hours of prayerful kneeling, and a solitary oil lamp sheds enough light to permit reading.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: Large deep green tapestries flutter softly along the walls, each of the simple cloth banners stitched with a design of a different healing herb.  Narrow channels filled with rich soil house a collection of small plants and flowers, each basking in the sunlight that streams through two large windows overhead.  A statue of a man with a gentle-mannered expression on his face stands to the southwest, behind a wooden altar crawling with vines.

title: [Greys's Armory]
description: The broad sweep of the oak floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  Several white marble shelves and a Vornavian silk-lined display case are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Lessons]
description: Dimly lit by a mere few candles placed throughout the room, the walls of this small chamber feature bas-relief panthers and other cats crouched and ready to pounce.  A pair of luminous emerald green eyes to the southeast belong to a statue of a man reclining in a comfortable chair, his shadowed form recessed in a small alcove.  A claw-footed altar of deep red marble is set below the man's gaze, which seems almost indifferent.

title: [Greys's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a varnished golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  Some hammered copper display hooks and a heavy lead glass display case sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Greys's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by polished oak walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its oak floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the golden oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a heavy white granite counter and a gilded maple cabinet.

title: [The Falcon, Foredeck]
description: A bronze-beaked falcon figurehead juts from the prow of the vessel, its spread wings embracing the crimson-painted hull.  Wrought from verdigris bronze, a waist-high railing mimics vines twining around modwir saplings.  A carved redwood ship's wheel crowns a raised platform several paces behind the figurehead.
location: The Falcon, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [The Falcon, Amidships]
description: The golvern-edged propellers of the ship glow silver in the moonlight, casting a wavering blur of reflected radiance over the smooth-worn and polished planes of wood below.  Fanciful tracery forms golden vines that twine up the trio of cylindrical supports leading to the whirring blades.  A dark teak hatch fastened with a black iron ring lies to starboard.  Unmarked crates and wooden barrels have been stacked high and lashed down near the railings.
location: The Falcon, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [The Falcon, Belowdecks]
description: Dusky blue tubes plated with refined veniom stand as tall as a man and far wider, lining the interior hull of the ship.  The metal sparkles dimly in the half-light.  They resonate faintly with the constant vibrations twitching through the ship, releasing a high-pitched hum into the cool air.  Glass pipes full of rushing water direct their frothing current eastward toward a steadily pulsating light source.
location: The Falcon, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [The Falcon, Aft]
description: A long redwood bench sits far aft, backed by a railing that overlooks the squared stern of the ship.  Far enough away from the ceaseless drone of the main propellers to be almost quiet, the deck provides a view of the steering blades situated midway down the ship's hull.  Beyond them is a dizzying view of the night-darkened earth below.  A lustrous redwood sideboard has been bolted to one section of the railing.
location: The Falcon, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [The Falcon, Engineering]
description: Approaching the heart of the ship, the lengths of crimson-varnished wood give way to lightless blocks of crystal.  An enclosure of precious metals fans out around a pulsating hexagonal blue crystal, the source of an ethereal pulse bathing the chamber in blue-white luminescence.  Faint, haunting notes pour forth from the depth of the crystal in a strange and unending song.
location: The Falcon, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [The Nexus, Fixed Point]
description: Concentric swirls of interleaved gold and brass erupt outward from a pedestal standing at the center of an expanse of cavernous, featureless darkness.  Blacker than night and unalleviated save by the glow of the orb atop the pedestal, the emptiness encompasses all but the floor, which seems to spiral outward to the furthest vagaries of sight.  The air smells faintly of brine and pitch.
location: The Falcon, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Moonglae Inn, Upper Cloister]
description: A covered walkway paved with dark blue slate circles a skylit atrium in the center of the building.  A low greystone wall bolstered by a row of graceful black marble pillars ensures that inattentive guests will not step out into the empty space.  A large pane of stained glass framed in dark oak hangs between the pillars across from a heavy, black ash door on the opposite wall.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Upper Cloister]
description: A covered walkway paved with dark blue slate circles a skylit atrium in the center of the building.  A low greystone wall bolstered by a row of graceful black marble pillars ensures that inattentive guests will not step out into the empty space.  A large pane of stained glass framed in dark oak hangs between the pillars across from a heavy, black ash door on the opposite wall.

title: [Wyvern Keep, House Clerk]
description: The chamber's red marble floor is accented by a large inlaid medallion, which marks the center of the room.  A low desk sits well back of the decorative element and bookshelves line the walls.  The singular doorway leading in and out is framed in gilded gold wood.

title: [Dancing Dahcre, Kitchen]
description: Beautiful cream marble covers the counters of this large, spacious kitchen, and brightly painted crocks and bowls are scattered over the surfaces.  An enormous white brick fireplace is lined with dark tiles and set with cast iron fixtures.  Beautiful crimson porcelain dishes are stacked neatly in dark ebonwood cupboards, their edges trimmed with gold.  A deep pantry lined with shelves holds food of all variety.

title: [Eastern Waterway]
description: Bright tropical blossoms paint a picturesque scene as they spread across the coastal cliffs of the island that rises to the northeast.  Strong and persistent, foam-topped waves rush against the tall slate face and explode in a fine mist that rains down upon everything within its reach.

title: [Balgamar's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a long varnished counter and a lacquered wooden shelf.

title: [Drethron's Outfitting]
description: Rough plaster walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a polar bear rug hangs a fused sun and moon wall-hanging, and an oak beam ceiling completes the picture.  A heavy white granite counter and an engraved copper bin stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Balgamar's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A rough oak crate and a large brass-bound chest sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Balgamar's Outfitting]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A large brass-bound chest and a lacquered wooden shelf stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Mikalmas's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a varnished golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Mikalmas's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by mahogany paneled walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its mahogany floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the vaulted ceiling.  Right near the front is a vine-carved mahogany table and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Journey's End, Bedchamber]
description: Pale silk walls give way to a series of large, rounded windows that bathe the room in sunlight.  A massive canopy bed dominates the bedchamber, draped with alabaster gauze, its luxurious silk spread is a sapphire blue embroidered with a silver jacquard pattern.  Covering the floor is a thick shag rug woven with various shades of ivory and fitted into a deep recess on the far wall is a wide mistwood dresser.  Suspended from a silver chain is a beautiful crystal lamp, its surface etched with blooming roses.

title: [Unpredictable Outcomes, Barge]
description: Small mountains of what can only be termed debris litter the surface of this barge, each collection more random than the last.  Multicolored bits of fabric are interspersed with bits and baubles of every imaginable shape and size.  At the center of the chaos, you can see a ramshackle shop, its somewhat symmetrical shape making it stand out against the chaos around it.

title: [Gryphon Holding, Open Courtyard]
description: Designed to be used for training, the courtyard is ringed with several devices for improving combat skills.  In the center is an arena of sand for practicing skills against opponents.  A set of racks rests against the south wall, storing several items of weaponry and armor.  Near the western wall, a wide stone staircase leads up to the door, giving entrance to the tower.  A selection of refreshments wait on a nearby table.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Silver Gryphon

title: [Gryphon Holding, Stables]
description: Redolent of hay and horses, the stables are clean and well-tended.  Grooms and stable boys move about the numerous stalls, their efforts acknowledged by contented whickers echoing almost conversationally.  At one end twin destriers stand in adjacent stalls, their eyes bright and ears flicking alertly as they stamp to and fro, anxious to greet their riders.  Caparisoned barding of black, ruby, and silver is laid out on a stand next to each steed, along with a monogrammed leather saddle.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Silver Gryphon

title: [Gryhon Holding, Roof]
description: A battlemented walk wraps around the peaked, slate roof and gives an unobstructed view of the marsh stretching out in each direction.  Through a trapdoor in the northwest corner a wooden ladder leads to the chamber below.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Silver Gryphon

title: [Gryphon Holding, Great Hall]
description: A light draft stirs the banners draped overhead, each measure of silk representing a knight of the Order.  Dominating the room is a massive oak table with a dozen tall chairs around it.  Three smaller tables are set up in an alcove off the eastern wall for more private gatherings.  Elaborate figurines of former members line the mantle of a huge fireplace set at the far end of the room.  Flanking the hearth, floor-to-ceiling shelves hold a wide selection of reading material and ancient tomes.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Silver Gryphon

title: [Gryphon Holding, First Floor]
description: Unadorned stone walls and narrow windows leave this room rather stark and austere.  A fireplace fills most of the north wall, and the large table and benches that stand in the center of the room appear to be polished and new.  Against the south wall, two rearing ivory gryphons hold between them an ebony and crimson dart board with silver numerals.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Silver Gryphon

title: [Shrine of Transformation, Altar]
description: Waiting at the end of the slope is a chamber ensconced in curving walls of blackened, blistered glass.  The shrine resides in sullen dimness alleviated only by pulses of emerald light from deep within the translucent barrier.  An immense slab of stygian granite, chased in patterns of molten copper and gold, dominates the center of the room.  Deep channels are burned out of the stone of the floor, their exacting, sinuous routes weaving a radiating and serpentine pattern around the black altar.

title: [Sylvanfair, Wizard's Library]
description: What a clutter!  Stacks of odd baubles and weirdness abound.  A flame-red curtain hangs across one corner of the room, and odd pulses of light periodically flash across the ceiling.  A pillar of water flows perpetually into the tree from a strange contraption, bringing nourishment to the roots.  Exploring the rest of the library could take years, considering the sheer bulk of odds and ends scattered about.

title: [Sylvanfair, Magical Workshop]
description: You can feel the magic in the air in this room.  The walls are bare here, even of bark -- the ironwood walls have been blasted clean by past accidents.  A large workbench fashioned from the same ironwood as the walls contains all manner of vials, jars, and papers.

title: [Sylvanfair, Summoning Chamber]
description: Nestled deep below the trunk of the great tree, this extraordinary chamber exudes a tangible sense of living energy.  Enormous, gnarled roots hold back the sooty earth, glowing eerily with sparse pockets of phosphorescent lichen.  Shadowy nooks and crannies disappear between the roots into inky blackness, hinting at unseen secrets.  Intricate arcane runes have been painstakingly etched upon nearly every exposed surface of the chamber.

title: [Sylvanfair, Secret Passageway]
description: A roughly excavated tunnel ends here at the back of a heavy wooden bookcase.  Thick, tangled roots crisscross the earthen passageway as it spirals down into darkness.

title: [House Sylvanfair, Red Lair]
description: Stalactites and stalagmites are scattered about this cavernous chamber within the great trunk, and small glowing veins of mithril and ruby criss-cross the walls, floor and ceiling.  Dwarven-made tools hang suspended from a wooden rack fastened above a small forge.  A trickle of water spills from a hole in one wall, cascading down to disappear into a drain in the floor.  A rainbow of sparkling light reflects off of the miniature waterfall, rewarding your eyes with a dazzling display of color.

title: [DragonSpine Fane, Landing]
description: Stone benches line the remarkably smooth walls of the chamber.  Upon one bench, someone has left a pitcher of water for thirsty tourists, while upon another, there is a washbasin and some cloths that have been arranged for the hygiene-conscious.  Standing at opposite ends of the small landing, a pair of downward spiraling stairs affords passage below, while a large stone archway leads deeper into the mountain.

title: [DragonSpine Fane, Altar Chamber]
description: Illuminated from above, the triangular chamber's air is heavily scented with myrrh.  Matching the shape of the room, a small dais supports a three-sided stone altar crafted of smooth grey, white, and black tiles.  Three corridors exit deeper into the mountain, while the archway in the eastern wall leads to a landing and the stairs beyond.

title: [Chamber of the Light]
description: Smooth white stone rises from the even floor to create the curved walls of the circular chamber, their peaks disappearing into the shadows of the distant ceiling.
