Warm and bright light emanates from candles that are arranged in tiny alcoves around the archway that leads to the northeast, while to the southwest, a series of large obelisks dominates the chamber.

title: [Chamber of the Dark]
description: Smooth ebon stone rises from the even floor to create the curved walls of the circular chamber, their peaks disappearing into the shadows of the distant ceiling.  Warm and bright light emanates from candles that are arranged in tiny alcoves around the archway that leads to the northwest, while to the southeast, a series of large obelisks dominates the chamber.

title: [Chamber of the Grey]
description: Smooth grey stone rises from the even floor to create the curved walls of the circular chamber, their peaks disappearing into the shadows of the distant ceiling.  Warm and bright light emanates from candles that are arranged in tiny alcoves around the archway that leads to the south, while to the north, a series of large obelisks dominates the chamber.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Positioned each within the middle of the eastern, western, and southern walls are three murals illuminated by a cluster of candles that are neatly arranged upon a central bench.  Twin staircases lead away from the chamber, one leading up and the the other leading down.

title: [Ancient Passage, Niche]
description: Rising from the center of the chamber is an ornate stone throne fitted with emerald shards.  An enormous male statue sits upon the furnishing, his back straight and his gaze pointedly fixed upon the downward stairs.  Candles recessed into the enormous construction filter greenish light throughout the chamber and illuminate the large niche is fitted into the wall beside the upward spiraling stairs.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Four dogwood trees are carved into each of the chamber's walls, their four-petaled blossoms hollowed out to create petite shelves that house hundreds of tiny candles.  Tiled murals stand beneath the flower-laden boughs of the blooming beauties that occupy the eastern and western walls, while to the north, a set of stairs leads upward and to the south, another set leads down.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Housed within patterns that alternate between frenzied whorls and even, tidy lines, the three murals that occupy the walls in this chamber are wildly different from each other.  Where one is a study of order, another is rife with chaotic destruction, and the third bears a cold indifference in the lines of its imagery.  The warm illumination that spreads across the floor is borrowed from the stairs that leads upward, while only a faint reddish glow rises from the downward spiraling stairs.

title: [Ancient Passage, Niche]
description: Shadows jump across the wall, their forms created by the flickering candles that are recessed within fist-sized alcoves that ring the chamber.  Stylized flames carved into the wall appear to dance beneath the erratic patterns of the wavering light.  Standing at an angle so that her stony gaze rests upon both the upward and downward spiraling stairs, a female stone statue dominates the center of the chamber, while beyond her, a niche housing a large donation bowl basks in her silhouette.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Four large murals line the smooth stones walls, their images ranging in hues from sanguine to niveous.  Carved patterns, each transforming from one mural to the other, travel between the pieces and are illuminated by a tall pillar of candles that occupies the center of the floor.  Traveling in opposing directions, a pair of staircases provides twin exits from the chamber.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Dimpled craters stretch across the white stone floor which is rounded and slightly inclined at the center, while twin orbs, bearing the same indentation as the floor, rise out of the walls.   Occupying the entire expanse between the two pitted objects, one of which holds a red pigment and the other black, is a large mural crafted of glass tiles.  Sharing a wall, the downward stairs disappear into darkness, while a sanguine light spills down the well of the upward stairs.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Ambient light filters into the circular chamber from the downward stairs and the upward spiraling ones, its diffuse hues creating a soft illumination for the area.  Carved patterns rise out of the smooth floor to create a forested scene on the walls that stretch towards an enormous set of gates.  Twin murals, their faces limned in golden tiles, stand at opposite ends of one another, their broad expanses depicting wildly different scenes.

title: [Ancient Passage, Niche]
description: Decorated with small, intricate patterns, the western wall holds carved decorations, while the eastern houses a large niche.  Rising solemn and alone at the heart of the room, a beautifully carved stone statue is ringed by glass-shielded candles that bathe it in a gentle, greyish light.  Twin staircases, one leading up and one leading down, are the only exits from the chamber.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Rough and irregular, the floor of the landing is pitted with small and large holes.  Stalactites and stalagmites reach towards each other from their positions in the distant ceiling and on the uneven flooring, their coarse edges displaying the distinct patterns of a carver's chisel.  Murals, one upon the eastern wall and the other upon the western wall, stretch between the staircases, the images they house illuminated by the flickering light of nearby candles.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Faint light creates shadows on the walls which are carved with conflicting spiderweb patterns and archaic designs.  Nestled within the strange images upon the western wall is an enormous mural depicting an ancient throne room, while the eastern wall houses a mural that is fashioned largely of dark and sanguine tiles.  At either end of the corridor, stone staircases disappear into the southern and northern wall, one leading up and the other leading down.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Intricately carved patterns dance across the western wall as they travel from the downward spiraling stairs to the upward ones, their thick and thin lines are a combination of whorls and musical notes.  Dim light, created by four potted toadstools, illuminates the corridor and draws attention to the colorful murals that are housed within the eastern wall.  Faint and carefree, the sound of a fife playing a joyful tune fills the air.

title: [Ancient Passage, Niche]
description: Carved stone creates a forest glade of thick bushes, lush grasses, and tall trees.  Roughly textured, even the floor that is carved with tangled roots that spread outward from the thick tree trunks, and rendered tufts of grass and moss that make the ground uneven, but not unpleasantly so.  Nestled within a particularly ornate tree is a large stone niche that is surrounded by much smaller ones filled with candles.  At either end of the landing are staircases that lead up and down.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Three panels, two vibrantly tiled murals and one devoid of art, occupy the eastern wall, while the western wall has a bas-relief garden of herbs, plants, and flowers carved into its slightly curved surface.  Arranged in a neat row down the center of the corridor is a series of votives, their brightly burning wicks offering ample illumination for pilgrims as they make their way from the downward spiraling stairs to the upward ones, and back again.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Labyrinthine patterns stretch across the walls, their deeply incised lines illuminated by the potted toadstools that are arranged in a single line down the center of the corridor.  Tile-framed murals, their pigments bright and vibrant, interrupt the strange, scrolling designs at even intervals, though some appear to have sustained enough damage to make their scenes impossible to decipher.   At either end of the wide room are stone stairs, one leading up and the other leading down.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Vaulted ceilings disappear into darkness, their heights unfathomable by the dim light used to illuminate the landing.  The smooth floor transitions into textured walls that have had interwoven patterns of elliptical scrollwork carved into them.  Evenly spaced among the walls are tiled murals, the first starting near the set of upward spiraling stairs and the last near the downward ones.

title: [Ancient Passage, Niche]
description: Thin and wide, the corridor is a straight line that leads from a set of upward spiraling stairs to a set of downward ones.  Carved into the eastern wall is a mural of an enormous forge that is illuminated by crimson toadstools set before it, while the western wall houses a large niche.  Candles litter the floor beneath the alcove, many of which show eminent signs of expiring.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Created at the apex of two sets of stairs, one traveling downward and one upward, the corridor is carved out of the very stone of the mountain.  Potted toadstools follow the curve of each wall to create a circle of illumination for travelers and acts as a showcase for the tiled murals that are imbedded into the floor.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ancient Passage]
description: Faint light trickles into the area from the crack in the wall to the south, its dim illumination highlighting the smooth walls and floor of the circular chamber.  Grooves in the walls create ornate patterns that are shadowed in places where the ambient light is unable to reach its deeper sections.  Traveling upward, a set of stone stairs disappears into the wall, each step large, wide, and crafted of stone.

title: [Bloodforge, Workshop]
description: Encased in stacked slabs of ur-barath, this cold and damp chamber reeks of metallic-tinged aromas, as if it were a carnage-filled battleground in recent times.  Thin blades sharpened to a fine point jut out from the front of a crimson-tinged stone bloodforge, and droplets of what appears to be dried blood stain the floor surrounding the workspace.  Piles of crimson powder cover the floor beneath a large opening.  A dwarven blacksmith assistant stands in front of a narrow archway leading toward the smithy.  An unadorned staircase spirals toward the temple.

title: [Underground Temple, Hall]
description: No more than two-feet high, a wide wooden board carved with straight lines and curved shapes encircles the room.  At each corner, a crystalline moon hangs from the ceiling and spins with abandon.  An unadorned staircase spirals downward into a chamber illuminated by a deep amber glow.  Sculpted from heavily crimson-laced slabs of ur-barath, a pulpit stands in solitude in the center of the room.

title: [Underground Temple, Core]
description: Leaning precariously to one side, a massive stone altar dominates the southern end of the temple.  Webs of cracks and crevices mar the stone beneath and render ancient floor carvings nearly indiscernible.  Partially concealed by the altar, a small tunnel leads down into darkness.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, northwest, down

title: duplicate of 1491
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Tome Gallery]
description: Towering stone shelves have been formed into the very walls of the room, each one occupied by dozens of leather-bound tomes and thick volumes.  Attached to the corners of every book is a mithril chain, keeping the manuscripts never far from their respective spots.  Two slate-topped round tables are positioned in the center of the room, each brightly illuminated by a glowing glaes orb positioned in the ceiling above.

title: [Gold Wing Table]
description: Gold velvet cushions chased with metallic thread to create a raised diamond pattern line the seats gathered here.  Stylized wing sconces of golden silk are backlit with candles that illuminate the translucent fabric and cast a warm glow.  Plump peaches, apples, and pears rest within a large wicker basket at the center of the round table.  The ripe fruit fills the air with its sweet fragrance, mingling with the other tantalizing aromas from the tavern.

title: [Silver Wing Table]
description: A rubbing of silvered oil is buffed into the grain of the table, giving the ebonwood a touch of glimmer in this intimately lit setting.  Each chairback features a small pair of angel's wings carved to form a headrest glazed with the same metallic hue.  Hanging on the wall just above the round table is a brass-framed oil painting illuminated by a nearby iron lantern.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Laboratory]
description: Faint shimmering wards run along the black walls of this circular laboratory, while the dark ceiling stretches to a high apex of opaque glass windows which allow for a warm glow from the moon to bleed through.  Situated in one corner is a polished drakar-inlaid crucible, just opposite of a slate-topped workbench.  Two large bookshelves stand like wooden sentinels on each side of a rune-carved steel door.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Barracks]
description: Row upon row of bunk beds fills the large room.  Empty beds are neatly made while a few have sleeping Hendorans occupying them recovering from overnight patrols or guard duty.  Racks for armor and gear stand beside every set of beds offering ready access to their wearers.  At one end of the hallway is a letter writing station.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Lower Hall]
description: A narrow hallway, underneath the stairwell of the hall, runs north and south.  The sounds of a busy military barrack filter in from the south, while the savory scents of cooking float in from the north.  A single barrel of water is set against the wall.

title: [Outpost, Latrine]
description: A short wood bench takes up the majority of the space in this small building.  Two holes have been cut in the bench and a stack of old newspapers sits neatly by the entrance.  The smell of fresh hay fills the room.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Kitchen]
description: The kitchen is a place of constant movement as the Hendoran cooks and staff continues a dance of constant clean up and preparation for the meals to feed their armed counterparts.  Rich and savory smells flow from various boiling pots and several spits of meat slowly being rotated by small cogs in wheels built next to the kitchen's fires.  Occasionally, an auxiliary disappears with a large plate of food and returns later balancing a number of wooden plates.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Cellar]
description: Casks of wine and crates of food are stacked neatly in every corner of the large cellar, and more than a few old dirty footprints are scattered about the earthen ground.  A lit torch protrudes from a wall, throwing a cascade of light and shadows across the area.

title: [The Blue Phoenix Pub]
description: Grey brick walls comprise the foundation of the spacious tavern, where oak tables and chairs are set up around the common area.  A plump boar is set near a large red brick fireplace, the roaring flames roasting the pig and warming the tavern.  Mounted on a far wall is a huge silver tapestry depicting the image of a rising blue phoenix.  From behind a brass-railed countertop, a scar-faced bartender pours drinks for the guests.

title: [Chartreuse Wing Table]
description: Yellow-green hues, the color of a ripe pear, are predominant in this section, from the tufted seat cushions to the samite runner along the floor with its gold and chartreuse tassles.  A border of dragonflies runs along the outer edge of the table, each fitted with a mosaic of peridot, malachite, and aventurine shards.  In the center, several tiles help to keep serving vessels cold or hot, as needed.

title: [Sienna Wing Table]
description: A reddish maoral table dominates the setting, especially with its rather impressive handiwork displayed so elegantly.  A trio of thick wax candles are placed at the center, giving the immediate area a soft and intimate illumination.  Seat covers of sienna velvet stitched with gold threading cover each chair, leaving only the natural wood legs and arms visible.

title: [Teal Wing Table]
description: Arranged beneath a thick sheet of clear glaes covering the table are concentric rings of feathers, each a different shade of blue.  From the iridescent and rounded bull's-eye of a peacock to the slender taper of a bluejay, each wispy circle honors a different bird.  A blue-glazed vase etched with wings rests at the center and is filled with delicate hydrangea blooms.  Teal raw silk covers the seat of each chair, as does a matching neck rest at the top of the chairback.

title: [Ravenswood, Clearing]
description: A grove of old poplar trees lift graceful boughs in an attitude of spiritual meditation.  Cabins sit beneath the branches, graced by the eloquence of the trees.  The paths leading toward the buildings are carpeted in bright leaves, making the ways a patterned carpet of color, as subtle as it is beautiful.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, west, out

title: [Ravenswood, Mausoleum]
description: An overgrown mausoleum of flat grey stone dominates the area.  Shadows cling to it like terrified children to their mother, and a few brave plants climb up the walls in a quest to get closer to the sun.  Sitting atop the tomb is an immense raven, glaring down on everyone with unbiased irritation.

title: [Ravenswood, Spring]
description: A deep, cold pool sits in the middle of a clearing, like a spider in the center of her web.  Dense, lush banks of ferns stretch up from the banks to the feet of quiet residences, their facades as silent as the still water.  Birds occasionally wing through the still grotto, silent as if mindful of the shadowy ambiance.

title: [Ravenswood, Yew Garden]
description: The ancient trees populating the garden are obviously much older than the park itself.  Branches grow down to the ground, forming attendant yews around a central ancestor.  Legend holds that the yew grows a root into the open mouth of each corpse buried around it.  The garden's rampant growth is disturbing in that context.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Mess Hall]
description: Grime-covered portholes allow a modicum of light to sift in, revealing a fine haze of dust that drifts down through cracks in the warped deck overhead.  Wrought iron chains, each ending in black metal lanterns, dangle from exposed oaken beams over a long table that is bolted to the deck.  Flanking the table are two rough benches heavily scarred with claw marks.  Scattered upon every surface are half-eaten, moldy chunks of bread, fish, and eel.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Reim Base Camp, The Edge]
description: At the edge of the rocky cliff, a prismatic portal hovers, and at its center, a hazy silhouette of a colossal tower rises up out of the ground.  Nearby are the remains of a small rock fire pit and an empty guard post.  The gusting wind launches a passing swallow into the swirling gateway, and it quickly dematerializes.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Dust motes, dancing in the slanted rays of light with each creak of the gently rolling ship, drift down from the exposed oaken beams supporting the decking overhead.  Hanging from a hook on the splintered portside bulkhead is a single brass lantern, its flickering light casting odd shadows across the crooked deck planks.  Standing next to the lantern, in obvious need of repair, is a misshapen harpoon rack.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Warped planks give this section of the deck an uneven cant that is echoed in the fitted wooden boards of the bulkheads.  Tacked to the forward bulkhead by seven iron spikes is an enormous spotted walrus skin.  In one corner of the compartment, a large knot in the wood has been burrowed out by claw and fang to create a small rodent nest.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship]
description: Faded green paint peels from the wooden housing protecting the rough, square-shaped hatch that leads below deck, by way of some wooden stairs.  Tepid water forms a small puddle in the hatch cover, which lies discarded against the hemp stays of the main mast.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Empyrean Tower, Foyer]
description: Flanked by dark blue swags, a set of massive, steel-banded blackwood doors are thrown open, the inpouring moonlight catching golden flecks in the grey-black floor and striking a path across the tremendous foyer to some stone steps.  A dizzying spiral of colorful doors lining the steep ascension of the narrow staircase along the curved walls disappears out of sight in the ozone-scented darkness overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest, up, out

title: [Empyrean Tower, Reception]
description: Perched upon a tall stack of books, a pale wizened wizard peeks out from behind an elevated desk littered with unfurled scrolls, spilled ink pots, and broken quills.  Floating globes suffused with eldritch blue light throw sinister shadows across the stone floor and onto a glass display case.  In front of the desk, velvet-roped stanchions form a chaotic maze for those waiting in line.

title: [Empyrean Tower, Lounge]
description: Arranged off to the east side of the great foyer, leather sofas sit upon plush ornate carpets in varying patterns.  Plump silk pillows are tossed on the floor around a low blackwood table, the setting overshadowed by towering bookshelves crammed full of old texts, thick volumes, and odd mechanical contraptions.

title: [Empyrean Tower, Repository]
description: A forgotten cart loaded with leather-bound tomes and neatly rolled scrolls is parked between two openings in the expansive stone wall of the tower.  Glowing light emanating from within crystal-filled chambers floods the area with color, the beams drawn to the east, focused on a bulky metal contraption.  A humming noise echoes throughout the cavernous darkness above.

title: [Empyrean Tower, Antechamber]
description: A thin black cat with a long, singed tail reclines on an overturned metal bucket amidst a spreading puddle of murky black water, an abandoned mop lying nearby.  Vibrant light pouring from alcoves carved into the curving stone wall reflects off of the wet floor creating a wavy rainbow.

title: [Empyrean Tower, Observation]
description: Darkness looms overhead, the air thick with the sterile tang of ozone.  Crumbling arches in the curved wall give way to illuminated chambers, the prismatic light streaming from the stone cavities drawn to the east in colorful ribbons.  A pair of apprentices are bent over a long oaken worktable laden with alchemical supplies surrounding a detailed parchment chart, while several vials and beakers filled with glowing blue liquid bubble over a tabletop brazier.

title: [Empyrean Tower, Contraption]
description: The curve of the expansive, smooth stone wall of the tower is broken up by pointed arches leading to light-filled chambers.  A bulky contraption, partially concealed with a swathe of torn sailcloth, is installed on a raised wooden platform.  A magnificent glass lens mounted on the top of the contraption harnesses the colorful light spilling from the chambers and projects a beam upward, slicing into the darkness overhead.

title: [Empyrean Tower, Infirmary]
description: Buckets filled with ice sit alongside a row of large, copper, soaking tubs brimming with steaming hot water, with thick, woven reed mats laid out in front of each.  On the opposite wall, quilted sleeping pallets made up with soft, brushed wool blankets are separated by canvas screens.  A censer is seated atop a low counter stocked beneath with fresh linens and other supplies.

title: [Salmon Chamber of Light]
description: An enormous, glass-encased crystal formation fills the center of the chamber, the solid prisms aglow in soft, pulsating light which reflects off the low ceiling and smooth stone walls.  Across from the entrance, numerous uncommon runes and mystical symbols are carved into the stonework surrounding a distorted salmon portal.

title: [Reim Fortress, Entry]
description: Originating from a central portal, the immediate area is blanketed in an illuminating thick green haze that appears to flow like water across the ground toward the north.  Distant guttural growls and an ever-present clanking of metal chains resonate throughout the fortress.

title: [Reim Fortress, Sanctuary]
description: Timeworn meditation mats and prayer rugs lay scattered about the room, their woven threads only slightly less frayed than the tapestries that hang from the walls.  Though muted by the stone ceiling and walls, the howl of the wind can be heard within this sanctuary and what tendrils spill in from the door set the cobwebs and dust astir.

title: [Reim Fortress, South Corridor]
description: Wisps of viridian mist swirl through the air down this long north-south passageway and seem to grow more faint as they drift idly toward the south.  Crumbled stones lie in disarray along the floor, and wide shackles dangle from heavy chains draped along the walls.  An iron-braced door is set into the eastern wall.

title: [Reim Fortress, South Gate]
description: Guttering torches illuminate the narrow passage, their flames striving to maintain their girth and glow in the whipping winds that howl through the stones.  Charred scars mar the oak planks of what remains of the ceiling, though the oily stains upon its flooring are from something darker.  The pungent oils of the torches' flames and some other substance lend the passage a cloying and choking heaviness.

title: [Reim Fortress, Southern Parapet]
[Reim Fortress, South Parapet]
description: Biting winds crest the crenellation and howl through the roofless chamber causing the flames of a nearby fire to splutter and hiss.  Sitting upon the flame-wreathed logs and stones, an iron cauldron boils a sinister black liquid that fills the space with its noxious fumes.  An uneven bench occupies a space on the oak flooring that is near enough to the conflagration for warmth, but far enough for safety.

title: [Reim, Outer South]
description: Flanked by wall-mounted torches, the iron gates stand open and yawning from their place in the face of the dark granite fortress.  Ragged and faded banners dangle from the ramparts and flutter beneath the ethereal zephyr that taints and tickles their threads with its licking, viridian fingers.  A damp, hardened earthwork provides a modicum of defense from a direct attack on the entry, though its face is littered with attempted growth and wiggling worms.

title: [Reim, Outer South]
description: Billowing clouds glide past upon a persistent breeze that brings both a light chill and the scent of desiccated flesh to the air.  Whistling slightly in its passage, the zephyr dances around the defenses spikes recessed into the walls and along the deep cuts of the distant crenellation.   A roughly hewn oak tree insistently taps at a walnut shell it has wedged into the fitted stones of the bulwark.

Dark shadows play across the smooth face of the bulwark as the torches from the west begin to lose their friendly glow at this distance.  Biting winds whip through the air and lend their unearthly voice of that of the pained howls of some craven creature that prowls disturbingly close.  The ravaged remains of a tree that dared to grow too close to the fortress's walls lays discarded in the upturned cobblestones of the ground.

title: [Reim, Outer South]
description: Several short trees, their trunks reduced to splinters, block the path to the west and shed bark, leaf, and limb upon the nearby ground.  Piles of dirt, grit, and stone are scattered about the area, creating a mess of organic debris.  Small wren of standing water ripple as the wind passes through.

Billowing clouds glide past upon a persistent breeze that brings both a light chill and the scent of desiccated flesh to the air.  Whistling slightly in its passage, the zephyr dances around the defenses spikes recessed into the walls and along the deep cuts of the distant crenellation.   A lone wren insistently taps at a walnut shell it has wedged into the fitted stones of the bulwark.

title: [Reim, Outer South]
description: Chunks of mortar litter the ground, the gaps they once filled now offering a glimpse of the cloudy, star-spangled expanses beneath the fortress.  Smooth granite walls rise along the northern edge of the grounds, the deep crenellations playing court with the clouds and mists of the upper airs.  A pale sliver of light slips through the fortifications to illuminate a bright white lump wedged between uneven cobbles and the high bulwarks.

title: [Reim, Outer South]
description: Brambles choke the western edges of fortresses exterior, their thick limbs laden with finger-length thorns and shriveled russet leaves.  Untended cobbles have lifted where brown grass, once verdant and strong, has forced its way between the mortar and created an uneven ground to walk upon.  A series of wrought iron spikes affixed to the granite walls provide defense against would-be attackers.

title: [Reim Fortress, Heart]
description: The heart of the fortress is fed by four connecting passageways from the north, south, east, and west.  A glowing pylon perched on an elaborately carved stone platform emits a low hum that reverberates throughout the entire fortress.  Tendrils of viridian light spill from the crystal mechanism and snake through the air down all four corridors.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west
Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Reim Fortress, West Corridor]
description: Pushed against the edges of the corridor, the collapsed remains of the ceiling still bears signs of the explosive force used to destroy it.  Small and large chunks of mortar and stone litter a narrow rug that is too dirty and threadbare to reveal its original color.  The waxy remains of a candle lay forgotten upon a nearby cobblestone.

title: [Reim Fortress, West Gate]
description: Cool winds rush downward from the upper deck and carry a faint aroma of burning oil.  Dark stains soil both the sloped walkway and passage walls, and a long corridor continues east toward a large intersection.  A faint viridian glow illuminates the passageway toward the east.

title: [Reim Fortress, Western Parapet]
[Reim Fortress, West Parapet]
description: Pools of black liquid have accumulated along the floor beneath a massive black wooden bench that is filled with a thick, dark, bubbling liquid.  A blazing fire sits beneath the bench to keep its contents boiling, and doubles to provide warmth to those who gather in this roofless chamber.

Pools of black liquid have accumulated along the floor beneath a massive black iron cauldron that is filled with a thick, dark, bubbling liquid.  A blazing fire sits beneath the cauldron to keep its contents boiling, and doubles to provide warmth to those who gather in this roofless chamber.

title: [Reim Fortress, North Corridor ]
[Reim Fortress, North Corridor]
description: Exposed rafters and wrought iron fixtures are all that remain of the corridors ceiling.  Dust and debris are pushed about by strong winds that crash down upon the rug-covered floor as they crest the high granite walls.  An ornate table leg is lodged under a towering pile of mortar and broken stone, its curves illuminated by the dim light that trickles in from the north.

title: [Reim Fortress, North Gate]
description: Iron-caged torches flank the gate and are sheltered from the screaming winds by the high granite walls.  Large oak beams, charred and scarred from past battles, have been pushed against the eastern wall to create a long ramp that leads to some of the fortress's remaining rooms.  An odd series of stones imbedded into the wall disappear from sight as they climb the wall.

title: [Reim Fortress, Supply Room]
[Reim Fortress, Supply Closet]
description: Splintered wooden barrels containing a variety of broken weapons lie on their sides near the ramp that leads back to the main level.  A pile of dented mithril breastplates has been heaped into a corner beneath thick iron hooks where ripped and bloodstained robes hang lifelessly.

title: [Reim Fortress, Supply Room]
[Reim Fortress, Supply Closet]
description: Piled along each wall are massive slatted wooden crates with the words, "Reim Fortress" burned into the sides.  Faint glimmers from metal objects within hint at their contents, but the large boxes show no obvious point of entry.

Piled along each wall are massive slatted wooden crates with the words, "Reim Fortress" burned into the sides.  Faint glimmers from metal objects within hint at their contents, but the large boxes show no obvious point of entry.

title: [Reim Fortress, Northern Parapet]
[Reim Fortress, North Parapet]
description: Whipping winds rush through the crenellation that tops the walls on the northern edge of the platform, while the southern edge looks down upon the ravaged and roofless remains of a long corridor.  A fitfully burning fire, its flames casting about from the ever-changing directions of the air, is barely contained by a stone box that helps support the bubbling iron cauldron that rests upon it.

title: [Reim, Outer North]
description: Torches housed in wrought iron cages fitfully burn from their position to either side of the open gate, while ragged banners wave spastically in the undying winds.   Jagged stones and broken rafters have been cleared of the entry, their scarred faces bespeaking a past destructive force.

title: [Reim, Outer North]
description: Uprooted cobblestones clutter the exterior of the fortress amid the scattered remains of roofing tiles and scorched timber.  Sunburned grasses attempt to claim the forgotten pieces, but the insistent force of the wind in this location prevents them from making more than a cursory purchase in the dark soil.  A cracked wrought iron cauldron lays half-buried in the dirt near the northern edge of the path.

title: [Reim, Outer North]
description: Lichen and fungus appear to be at war with one another along the western expanse of the granite wall; their bright hues are a stark contrast to the dark of the stone.  Gyrating in the wind, ragged strips of fabric dangle from the wrought iron defensive spikes that protrude from the bulwark and cast strange, moving shadows throughout the area.  A series of tumbled cobblestones clutters the path.

title: [Reim, Outer North]
description: Creeper vines crawl across the ground occupying nearly every available space of dirt, their seeking tendrils gripping the granite wall but finding no purchase.  A solitary bird's nest fashioned of twigs manages to maintain its balance upon the wrought iron spikes driven into the nearby bulwark despite the efforts of the harsh winds.

Creeper vines crawl across the ground occupying nearly every available space of dirt, their seeking tendrils gripping the granite wall, but finding no purchase.  A solitary bird's nest fashioned of twigs manages to maintain its balance upon the wrought iron spikes driven into the nearby bulwark, despite the efforts of the harsh winds.

Heavy iron chains are scattered across the ground, their broken links impeded in the dirty cobblestones of the pathway.  Whistling and howling winds cause the clouds above to race through the moonlight at a quickened pace creating shadows that rise and fall at odd intervals throughout the area.  The sound of gravel skipping over metal fills the air.

title: [Reim, Outer North]
description: Heavy iron chains are scattered across the ground, their broken links imbedded in the dirty cobblestones of the pathway.  Whistling and howling winds cause the clouds above to race through the moonlight at a quickened pace, creating shadows that rise and fall at odd intervals throughout the area.  The sound of gravel skipping over metal fills the air.

title: [Reim, Outer West]
description: Thorn-like rods protrude from a double iron gate that leads deeper into the fortress.  Wall-mounted torches flanking the gate illuminate the immediate area and cast spectral shadows along the rough stone walls.

title: [Reim, Outer West]
description: Deep cracks in the granite floor give a brief glimpse of the starry expanse below the fortress.  Heavy clanking of thick metal chains reverberates throughout this narrow north-south corridor, only partially drowning the howl of relentless winds whipping through the fortress.

title: [Reim, Outer West]
description: Dark granite walls rise nearly twenty-five feet and converge into a dead end in this northern corner of the west wing.  Ornate spikes forged from blackened iron rise from the outer wall's edge and impale thick billowy clouds as they glide across the vast sky above.

title: [Reim, Outer West]
description: Craters large enough to comfortably sit in pockmark the area, while the displayed earth is splattered against the granite walls of the fortress.  Large stones and broken tree limbs protrude at odd angles from the ground and display the charred trademark of enormous, flaming projectiles.

title: [Reim, Outer West]
description: Dented wrought iron spikes stand out from the granite walls, their ends chipped and scarred from years of defense.  Twisting clods of uprooted earth near the base of the bulwark contains grass that grows at odd angles, the dips and divots housing wriggling grubs.

title: [Reim Fortress, East Corridor]
description: Dim light invades the space from the eastern and western edges of the passageway, its sources not strong enough to dispel the disfigured shadows that climb the stone walls.  Empty wrought iron rings dangle from one of the remaining rafters of the long-lost ceiling, their chains rattling and creaking at odd intervals, while below them stone and debris covered rugs dislodge dust into the air and muffle the sound of those that pass through.

title: [Reim Fortress, East Gate]
description: Sunlight trickles into the passageway from the partially collapsed oak ceiling, its golden illumination filling the dark space and highlighting the scars of past battles upon the stone walls.  Oily stains, thick and hardened from time, adorn the granite that frames the open east gate that offer egress from the dingy fortress's confines.

title: [Reim Fortress, Eastern Parapet]
[Reim Fortress, Parapets ]
[Reim Fortress, Parapets]
[Reim Fortress, East Parapet]
description: Brightly burning from its stone prison against the crenellation, a large fire supports a tripod housing an iron cauldron.  Waves of heat emanate from that section of the rampart and help to stave off the chill of the rushing winds.  A large rain barrel, charred from some past fire, sits near the ramp that leads to the floor below.

title: [Reim, Outer East]
description: Windowless lanterns frame the open gate, their vacant skeletons eerily dark and silent.  Destroyed barricades lay in scattered, scorched chaos about the area as if taunting would-be defenders with their uselessness.  Glinting in the moonlight are the half-buried shards of rainbow glaes panes.

title: [Reim, Outer East]
description: Bone white stones dot the area and are all that remain of the cobblestone pathway that once graced this side of the fortress.  Scraggly monkeygrass pushes up the black dirt in tangled knots along the edge of the granite bulwark, their lengths verdant and almost lush in the shade of the cool stone.  A small pool dangles from the crenellation.

title: [Reim, Outer East]
description: Short bushes huddle against the northeastern edge of the pathway, their twisted limbs intertwined and their leaves blending together in yellow, brown, and russet groupings.  Dark granite walls rise towards the sky and are capped with an exposed battlement that is devoid of its crenelation.  Elliptical leaves litter the hard-packed dirt.

title: [Reim, Outer East]
description: Howling winds crash against the granite bulwark of the fortress and sweep the area clean of any debris, which makes the ground smooth and vacant.  Deep gashes in the walls create jagged marks that mar the smooth, almost sterile atmosphere for the pathway.  A lone boulder, completely bare of grass, dirt, or lichen, gleams in the moonlight.

title: [Reim, Outer East]
description: Billowing clouds glide past upon a persistent breeze that brings both a light chill and the scent of desiccated flesh to the air.  Whistling slightly in its passage, the zephyr dances around the defenses spikes recessed into the walls and along the deep cuts of the distant crenellation.   A lone wren insistently taps at a walnut shell it has wedged into the fitted stones of the bulwark.

Several short trees, their trunks reduced to splinters, block the path to the west and shed bark, leaf, and limb upon the nearby ground.  Piles of dirt, grit, and stone are scattered about the area, creating a mess of organic debris.  Small pools of standing water ripple as the wind passes through.

title: [Genivie's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the beam ceiling.  Right near the front is a bamboo rack and a plain wooden table.

title: [Solhaven, House Clerk's Office]
description: Crown molding of pale linden circles the room, each length carved with a spiraling pattern of tiny blossoms.  Clean white walls contrast with colorful banners hung about that represent each unique House in the Cooperative.  Centered on a thick patterned carpet is a large desk covered with parchment and ledgers, behind which a house clerk stands.  A row of chairs rests near the ornate wooden door that leads to the hall beyond.

title: [Inside the Stump]
description: The ground is layered with fallen leaves and debris until the rugged surface curves abruptly to walls that frame the sky overhead.  The walls are rough with crevices and riddled with tiny holes like the inside of any hollow tree, though this one seems to be missing its top and is far larger than most ever reach.  A crevice on the north wall is deeper than the others with light visible beyond.

title: [Busy Beachcomber Table]
description: Scribbled across the top of the table are dozens of hastily laid out diagrams and crudely drawn maps of the surrounding beaches.  The drawings are sometimes drawn so closely together as to create a chaotic hodge-podge of lines that are almost unrecognizable as maps.  Bold X's here and there mark the spot for would-be treasure hunters.

title: [Glass Peach Pit Table]
description: Many dried peach pits have been incorporated into the thick slab of glass that forms the top of this table.  The peach pits have been arranged in an intricate flower design.  Wrought iron table legs fashioned to look like grapevines hold the slab up.  A small vase sits in the middle of the table, bursting with various colorful blossoms.

title: [Essence of the Forest Table]
description: This freshly scrubbed cedar-planked table sits amidst high-backed chairs carved with leaves.  A small earthenware vase rests in the middle, overflowing with eucalyptus sprigs.  The rich scent of the cedar blends with the herbal fragrance of the eucalyptus, bringing the lush scent of an overgrown forest to the indoors.

title: [Puffing Clouds Table]
description: This large pine table has been carved at the four major compass points with whimsical cloud faces.  Each of the carvings has wide eyes and big puffy cheeks, their lips pursed as they blow imaginary winds inwards towards the center of the table.  A small replica of the Isle in bas-relief rests there as an intricate focal point.

title: [Sand Castle Table]
description: Underneath a protective sheet of glass, a thin layer of sand has been glued onto the pine table in the shape of a majestic castle.  Tiny sandsilvers and shells have been imbedded into the wood, forming an alternating pattern just beneath the turrets of the castle.  Silken flags top the turrets, having been tacked to the table in a rippled pattern as if they were fluttering in a breeze.

title: [Lush Vineyard Table]
description: Intricate wooden cut-outs have been dyed and inlaid into the surface of this varnished oak table.  Clusters of grapes, ranging from deep purple to succulent red and topped with dark green leaves, adorn the outer edge.  Twining tendrils of vines connect each cluster to the next.  An etched silver bowl sits in the middle of the table, bearing several clusters of polished glass grapes in vibrant colors.

title: [Blue Table]
description: Whitewashed oak walls surround the booth on three sides, while the fourth is left open for an easy exit.  Tiny copper globes dangle from the yellowed sea thrak bones that support the ceiling and provide dim lighting for the plank table and matching benches.

title: [Red Table]
description: Painted bright red, the booth has a wide plank table covered with a blue and white checkered cloth and is flanked by two narrow benches.  A tiny brass lantern fitted with etched glass windows provides ample illumination by which to eat.

title: [Yellow Table]
description: Carved into the shape of a carp, the booth's plank table is painted yellow and surrounded by curving benches.  A pair of enormous bulging eyes stands out from the table's surface.  Magical globes that hum at odd intervals are fitted into the eyes, while tiny etch marks create three dimensional scales along the body.

title: [Grumpy Grouper Table]
description: The boards used to construct this table do not match at all, and are thrown together with no apparent regard for stability.  The joints groan in agony as they try to fit where they cannot.  Hanging on the wall is a picture of a fisherman.

title: [Merry Mermaid Table]
description: Several lanterns keep this table well lit, highlighting the light green shells overlapping the surface-like scales.  Two mermaid heads carved into the wall hold candles for lighting.

title: [Sickly Seathrak Table]
description: A threadbare cloth fails to cover the rotten wood underneath.  Somehow the table remains standing despite its pitiful condition, it appears ready to collapse under the weight of the tablecloth alone.  A couple of rickety stools are the only seating provided.

title: [Elusive Eel Table]
description: The cloth covering this table is sleek, almost slimy, and drapes over the edges in an unpredictable pattern.  A single candle in the center casts eerie shadows on the walls of the booth.

title: [Scrappy Scallop Table]
description: Scallop shells swirl out from the center of the table in a spiral pattern, but they haven't been set cleanly and sharp irregularities protrude.  Larger shells, several feet in diameter, are lined up on the booth's sides separating it from the others.  A sea scallop in the center of the table serves as a vase.

title: [Floundering Flounder Table]
description: The surface of the table is carved in the shape of a large flounder, with a pair of shells set in for eyes.  The same care apparantly was not taken in the creation of its base, which is completely uneven and causes the table to shift drastically.  The seats surrounding shift also, with no chair leg the same length as any others.

title: [Malevolent Marlin Table]
description: A stuffed marlin dominates the wall, caught in an eternal last leap.  A second marlin, but only the head, is set into the center of the table, as if rising from the surrounding wood.  A soft yellow light comes from a candle inside the head.

title: [Salivating Salmon Table]
description: The booth sits next to the kitchen doors, and the smell of cooking seafood is overwhelming.  A faded red cloth covers the table, which is lit by a lantern hanging from the ceiling.

title: [Ornery Octopus Table]
description: This octagonal table sits on eight legs, each carved in detail as an octopus tentacle.  A domed lantern in the center doubles as an ornamental head.

title: [Squirmy Squid Table]
description: The servers have not properly cleared this table, and drinks spill over the sides and on to the floor.  The soaked floor gives an audible squish when stepped on.

title: [Sturdy Sturgeon Table]
description: A ridged ring circles the edge of this round table.  The chairs, spread comfortably in a circle around it, have similar carved ridges on their arms and seats.  The carvings also decorate the walls surrounding the booth, carved in perfect detail for the look and feel of the ridged texture of a sturgeon.

title: [Lumpy Lobster Table]
description: A red cloth covers a lump-ridden tabletop, and the seats aren't much better.  It's almost as if the wood had been soaked in the bay until it was just warped enough to be uncomfortable.  A lantern hangs from a carved lobster claw set into the corner.

title: [White Whale Table]
description: A bleached white cloth covers this whale-shaped table, complete with a floral arrangement serving as a spout.  Carved ivory chairs sit scattered around the table, and ornamental ivory candleholders provide lighting.

title: [Wacky Wahoo Table]
description: Haphazard contruction makes this table awkward at best.  The table sits at an uneven tilt, and none of the chairs' legs seem to be the same length.  An unlit lantern hangs from the ceiling, out of reach to relight.  A window sits in the wall.

title: [Cozy Catfish Table]
description: Lavish padded chairs surround a cozy, well lit table.  The table is smaller than most, keeping the seats bunched closely together, yet not in an uncomfortable manner.  A shaded lantern hangs from the ceiling, bathing the table in a soft light.

title: [Pearly Oyster Table]
description: The tabletop is covered in a deep, dark finish, and the borders are set with milky-white stones.  There are scratches in the table where a novice thief almost pried loose one of the stones before realizing they are all fake.

title: [Swaggering Swordfish Table]
description: Old netting is draped around the entire booth, looped onto iron hooks every few feet that also hold small lanterns.  Underneath, amid the shadows and soft lighting, sits a sturdy haon table and matching chairs scattered around it.  A swordfish is mounted on the back wall, taking the entire width of the booth.

title: [Salty Sailfish Table]
description: Fishnets strung over a pair of mounted sailfish separate this booth from the others.  Old marine style lanterns hang in the corners, bathing the booth in a soft yellow light.

title: [Shrunken Shrimp Table]
description: The seating provided is nothing more than small blocks less then a foot tall.  The table itself isn't much higher, sitting perhaps a foot and a half up from the floor.  The resulting booth looks small even for the least imposing halfling.

title: [Clacking Clam Table]
description: This table is a simple yet strudy wooden platform.  Large clam shells are set on wooden legs around the table for seating, and smaller shells are set into the wall holding candles for lighting.

title: [Standing Starfish Table]
description: A giant petrified starfish sits in the center of the booth serving as the table, its five points having been bent down at right angles for legs.  The seats are made of smaller starfish much the same way, except four points are used for legs and the fifth is turned up for a back.

title: [Jolly Jellyfish Table]
description: A clear model of a jellyfish head sits in the center of the table, complete with a foolish grin.  A flame in its center allows it to double as a light source.  Wooden stools circle the table, carved jellyfish with flattened heads for seating and tentacles for legs.

title: [Skittering Sand Crab Table]
description: Carved out of modwir, this booth holds a giant crab.  The shell forms a smooth flat table surface, while its eight legs serve as seats.  At the crab's front end, two large pincers each hold a glowing lantern.

title: [Bare Bonefish Table]
description: Bits of fish and bone are still left on the hastily cleared, greasy tabletop.  Around the table there are at least as many scraps spread on the floor among the haphazardly placed chairs.  A ratty looking bin sits in the back corner.

title: [Bloated Blowfish Table]
description: Dried, hollow blowfish hang from the ceiling carrying small candles.  Shadows waver, dissappear, and reappear as the lanterns swing back and forth.  Beneath them sits a dimly lit table complete with ample seating.

title: [Tenacious Trout Table]
description: The smooth tabletop is finished in a dull silver-grey color with scattered black spotting, which seems to shift with the movement of an overhead lantern.  Matching polished chairs sit scattered around the table.

title: [Tarnished Tarpon Table]
description: A silver scaled tarpon, at least six feet in length, dominates the entire back wall of this booth.  The table and chairs underneath, though actually normal sized, are dwarfed in comparison.

title: [Hearty Halibut Table]
description: A glowing candle sits in the center of this oversized oak table, providing soft lighting.  Plush red curtains line the sides of the booth, separating it from the others and softening the noise of the surrounding room.  Carved oak chairs sit scattered around the table, with plenty of room to sit back and relax.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Main Mast]
description: Heavily wrapped trusses secure the lower yardarm to the tall, rough wooden mast.  Frayed hemp brails dangle from the unfurled mainsail and shift across the deck in the light, easterly breeze.  High above, nearly lost in the shadows of the topsails, is a dilapidated crow's nest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Ballista]
description: Bolted to the deck by thick iron pins is a sheet of blackened, wrought iron.  The long sheet extends from the 'midships stays to the wooden bulwarks, which are interrupted by a heavy wooden ballista.  Weathered copper plates cap the carved railing on either side of the ballistae, the corroded metal leaving a verdigris trail down the sun-bleached wood of the railing.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Bow]
description: Carved with intricate geometric patterns, the weathered oak railing stretches aft on both the port and starboard sides.  Carved to resemble fish bones are evenly spaced support posts that keep the warped railing at about six handspans above the deck.  Just beyond the bow, where the railings meet in a horizontal arc, is the top of a dusky blue figurehead.
location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Feywrot, Forest Path]
description: Heading north from an ebon gate, a dirt path, as well as a bridge beyond, are barricaded with fallen trees.  Charred trunks of varying girths lay crisscrossed atop one another like matchsticks dropped from their box.  Evidence of fiery devastation blankets the surrounding swampland.  In the darkness, only a faintly discernable path, more like an animal trail, remains passable and leads off toward the east.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Bank]
description: A tall counter stretches around the edge of a vault-like opening on the wall.  Several layers of wooden spikes are carved into both sides of the counter as if to keep things in or out; which, is unclear.  Standing behind the counter is a tall burly banker garbed in thick furs.

title: [Reim Base Camp]
description: The well-trodden, broad paths in this part of the camp are marked by scattered pieces of gravel with tufts of brown grass and patches of withered weeds poking out around them.  Here and there, a few boulders and assorted smaller rocks serve as makeshift monuments or provisional gravemarkers, while off to one side, a flimsy ramp leads up to a two-story wooden construction.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Store Foyer]
description: Aside from tools, mechanical bits, and numerous stacks of dark wooden crates, the foyer of this building is largely empty.  Near the eastern wall, a stack of lids lies toppled over beside a broken barrel.  To the west, a salesroom is visible, and a set of uneven stairs heads up to the second floor.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Wares]
description: In addition to serving as a hastily set up salesroom, this area also serves for quite a bit of equipment storage for the settlers of Reim.  Crude implements, discarded items, and assorted useless metallic shards have been piled into the various corners.  A series of chain loops hung from the ceiling displays a partial selection of the goods made available for sale to the public.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Wares]
description: The ground floor of the store is visible through precariously wide gaps in the planks of the floor.  The strong scent of freshly cut lumber emanating from a thin layer of chunks and grains of sawdust covering the platform pervades the room.  Thick wooden pegs protrude from a sloping beam, and a set of uneven stairs heads down to the first floor.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Outfitter]
description: Heavy, waterstained canvas of a nondescript grey color hangs over the open side of this small shelter and is decorated with pins, medals, and other small mementos.  Suspended from the ceiling by a thick chain, a glass-paned iron lantern sputters above a long metal rack crowded with wares.  The hard, dirt floor has been freshly swept and a few woven reed mats are scattered in front of a ragged flap in the corner.

title: [Feywrot, Animal Trail]
description: Hoofprints, pawprints, and the smoothed-dirt striations from large dragging tails show the path taken by native inhabitants fleeing the scorched landscape of the former festival grounds.  The trail heads due east, past burnt vegetation and a few rotting carcasses, before opening up near the eastern walkway, partially submerged in the fetid, black waters of the swamp.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Art Studio]
description: Circular stone steps lead into a room with picture windows set in ivory-painted walls which flood the room with light.  One floor-to-ceiling window opens onto a balcony overlooking a garden.  A large platform holding a velvet-draped divan and a carved teak chair sits before a frame which holds rolled up canvas backdrops.  Shelves holding finished works line the walls and a tall cabinet filled with painting supplies behind glass doors is shoved to one side next to a sturdy worktable.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Eastern Walkway]
description: Only a few scorch marks mar the splintered cedar planks of the walkway, whereas beyond to the north and west, the devastation is total.  Black water covers half of the planking where the charred supports have partly collapsed into the surrounding swamp.  The blackened branches of once lush vegetation makes for tricky navigation in the dim moonlight.

title: [Inside Weffinait's Wagon]
description: The inside of this large wagon is even more spacious than it appears from the outside.  A long wooden counter stretches the length of the interior, with packed shelves behind it, reaching from floor to polished wood ceiling.  Boxes upon boxes of wares are stacked neatly in the corners, each with its contents labeled by a clear hand.  A set of stairs leads back outside.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workshop Toolbench]
description: The worn weathered surface of the toolbench carries its history of generations of training craftsmen.  Small files and drills lay stacked neatly at one end, while blank scraps are piled at the other.  A small pattern of grooves and scratches leaves the evidence of its constant use.

title: [Greyvalen Goods]
description: The enclosing walls of the wagon are crafted of pale grey ash overlaid with a coat of lacquer with a matte finish, the effect softening the already subtle whorls of the woodgrain.  Mounted on the side wall is a small glass-doored cabinet, and directly beneath it is a set of square pegs.  On the opposite wall is a slender featureless mannequin that gazes sightlessly toward the glaes-windowed door, its back turned to the rear space of the wagon, which is roped off to bar further access.  Near the door, a black metal display shelf is bracketed to the wall.

title: [Gussy Up]
description: Swathes of opalescent satin drape from the tent supports to form the walls enclosing this small area, and the trio of silver-shaded lamps dangling overhead provide ample lighting.  Along the back of the tent is a long frosted glaes counter with a thin-limbed crystal tree and a mirrored square dish resting atop it.  Nearby, a three-tiered glass display table sits beneath a silver square-framed mirror securely bracketed to a pair of support poles.

title: [A Spacious Tent]
description: Rich layers of hunter green silk compose the airy walls of the expansive tent.  Several illuminated copper lanterns sit centered on oaken tree stumps, giving off a soft, flickering light throughout the area.  Nestled cozily at the back of the space, a lengthy cushioned bench piled with woven throws and linen pillows provides a resting spot for wandering visitors.  The toasty scent of burning firewood drifts lightly in the air, adding to the comforting warmth of the room.

title: [Secure Storage]
description: Thick tanik panels cover blackened iron along the walls of the wagon.  Displayed prominently along the back wall is a long black modwir shelf, its surface covered with an assortment of wares.  The center of the wagon is dominated by a large tanik display, its surface buffed to a polished gleam.

title: [The Motion Of The Potion]
description: An incredibly tangled assortment of copper pipes covers the ceiling of the wagon.  Some of the metal tubes pierce the sides and roof, vanishing through the wooden walls only to reappear in other places.  Many of the pipes connect to the glass cylinder in the middle of the wagon, feeding into its top, and dripping colorful liquid into various segments of the cylinder itself.  A large, polished mithril vat sits beneath the cylinder, containing an assortment of colorful liquids.

title: [Garden Pavilion, Meets]
description: Daylight filters in through the thin canvas of this large, festive tent.  Pieces of bright, multicolored cloth festoon the room from the peak to each corner.  Most of the area is wide open, allowing for a large gathering.  A tall glaes-framed mirror stands off to one side of a particolored flap.

title: [Garden Pavilion, Drinks]
description: A stained counter stands at the back of the tent, surrounded by a few stools.  A large sign, painted in bold, red letters, hangs behind a heavy wooden table.  A voluptuous dwarven barmaid mills about the room, overseeing the activities.

title: [Garden Pavilion, Eats]
description: Several torches light the room with bright, flickering light.  Beneath a brightly inked banner, decorated tables hold a variety of cuisine from the many towns of Elanthia.  Chairs are arranged in clusters around the room, offering places to rest and socialize.

title: [A Spring Affair]
description: The walls of the wagon have been painted in homage to a bright spring day, with green trees leafing out toward the ceiling and pastel flowers blooming beneath.  The floor underfoot is colored and textured to appear as grass.  On one side of the wagon, an ivory female mannequin and a green male mannequin are settled beneath the verdant overhang of a river willow with a picnic blanket beneath them.  Across the way, a violet female mannequin is seated on a swing mounted to an overhead beam, while a blue male mannequin seems frozen in the act of pushing.

title: [Dress the Dead]
description: All manner of clothes are piled high on a long flat table, each garment tattered, torn, frayed or mismatched.  Flies buzz around the head of the goblin zombie shopkeeper, who tends to himself in a corner, sewing patches on a pair of tattered pants.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: The rows of bloated and maimed corpses have no end in sight, and the smell of decaying flesh and blood is overwhelming.  Flies swarm near the bodies, their buzzing providing a constant hum nearby.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: The stomach of a spiked corpse has recently exploded, as fresh maggots and bugs crawl about in the cavity of its gut.  Pale, white fog drifts along the crooked road, obscuring much of the uneven stone.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: A small zombie goblin stands near a row of gnarled corpses, gnawing absentmindedly on some entrails hanging down from the bodies.  Disembodied eyes, all having red pupils, float through the area, scanning the surroundings as blood drips from their fleshy veins.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: A dark-haired sylvan lies skewered here on a wooden stake, his body having barely entered into decomposition.  Glowing-eyed crows perch on his shoulders, angrily pecking at his ears and face.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: A massive, putrefying ogre zombie trudges through the area, bits of ligaments and bones spilling out of his tattered backpack.  Shadowy black crows circle around the area, a few brave ones swooping down to snatch up some of the morsels.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: A trio of giantman zombies stand near the edge of the road, lifting bodies from an old wagon and hoisting them up onto wooden stakes.  A low, guttural growling reverberates off the blood-covered cobblestones.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: The gruesome road bends slightly here, stretching more to an angle.  Despite the curve, the ghastly display of horrific bodies remains intact.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: A whiff of decomposing flesh rises up from the narrow lane, as the high palisade walls loom to the west.  Swarms of flies still hover about the bodies decorating the road.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: Grisly zombies meander along the road, bits of flesh dangling loose from their pallid skin.  A black crow squawks from the edge of a broken wagon.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: A bald and lumpy ghoul moves along the row of corpses, his mottled fingers riffling through the pockets of the dead.  Every time he finds a silver coin, his dark eyes light up and he cackles wildly.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: Pus oozes from some of the bodies staked along the narrow road, the air thick and nauseating from their decay.  Black crows hop along the uneven ground, pecking at bits of flesh that have fallen from the corpse border.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: A few old and crumbling buildings break up the path here, their windows broken and doors missing completely.  The occasional rodent darts out of narrow alleyways, skittering through the shadows.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: The road passes beneath the shadow of the wooden palisade wall, before finally curving again towards the center of town.  Here, many of the staked corpses wear the tattered rags of old Wehnimer's militia uniforms.

title: [Lich's Landing, Corpse Row]
description: Pale fog hugs the ground, obscuring the road as you pass.  Wispy tendrils of white smoke coil up from the mist, snaking around the numerous corpses staked along the path.  Periodically, the shrill wail of a banshee can be heard from within a tall black crystal tower that rises up at the end of the lane.

title: [Banshee Tower, First Floor]
description: Smooth, crystal black walls form a circular chamber of the first floor of the tower.  The murky opaque, barely translucent surface of the walls allows only the slightest, yet blurred view of the road outside.

title: [Banshee Tower, Second Floor]
description: Ethereal images swirl about the room, fading in and out of existence as the undead replay their dying moments.  A chill lingers in the area, as beads of water drip down the crystal walls.

title: [Banshee Tower, Second Floor]
description: The piercing wail of a banshee reverberates through the tower, her cry sharp and forlorn.  Ghosts float about, their faces formed into silent screams.

title: [Banshee Tower, Third Floor]
description: Water glistens, like icy fingers trailing down the opaque walls.  The air is chillingly cold and the floor is almost slippery.

title: [Banshee Tower, Third Floor]
description: Dark apparitions move about, their shadowy forms insubstantial and misshapen. Cold, red eyes stare out from their featureless faces as they glide past.

title: [Banshee Tower, Third Floor]
description: Long tables run along the length of an entire wall, filled with rusted plates of rotten food.  Maggots crawl along the legs of the table and a small, lumpy zombie goblin perches near them, picking at his teeth with a tiny knife.

title: [Banshee Tower, Third Floor]
description: Old, torn banners hang from the ceiling here, their tattered fabric depicting the visages of ancient elven women with faces half in beauty, half in death.  Moving about the room, a host of pale ghosts moan eerily.

title: [Banshee Tower, Fourth Floor]
description: A well-dressed specter stands at the end of the room, his ethereal hands pressed against the opaque wall as he stares into its depths.  The forlorn cry of a banshee shrieks nearby.

title: [Banshee Tower, Fourth Floor]
description: Sharp, ear-piercing screams rattle the cold air, while dark shapeless forms fly about the room.  The shriveled form of an elf lays up against a wall, his face pale and drained of life.

title: [Banshee Tower, Fourth Floor]
description: Wailing banshees float about the room, their forms blinking in and out of existence as they move.  When they do appear, their forms are clothed in tattered rags and their eyes burn bright with a glowing red hue.

title: [Banshee Tower, Fifth Floor]
description: The air here is cold and heavy, thick with the scent of death and decay.  White mist floats about the area, dark shapes moving within.

title: [Banshee Tower, Fifth Floor]
description: Drained, lifeless forms of humans and elves are sprawled about the room, empty flagons scattered near their corpses.  Dark, red-eyed spirits float above their bodies, moaning as they flutter about.

title: [Banshee Tower, Fifth Floor]
description: Shadows and cold blanket the area, with the forms of dark spirits being periodically visible floating about.  A wide banquet table sits in the center of the room, where sits a large plate with a roasted halfling upon it.

title: [Banshee Tower, Fifth Floor]
description: Strange, glowing white orbs move through the air, tiny black forms shifting above inside of them.  The piercing shriek of a banshee periodically echoes through the chamber.

title: [Banshee Tower, Fifth Floor]
description: Pale fog circles the room, blanketing the chamber in a thick haze.  Features, shadowy forms glide about through the mist, emitting echoing cries of torment.

title: [Shade Square, Northwest]
description: The corner of the square is lively and hectic, with several of the town's undead denizens loitering about.  A trio of rowdy moldering dwarves play a game with jagged bone dice outside of the Darkness With Inn.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south

title: [The Darkness With Inn, Barroom]
description: A long and stained wooden bar occupies the whole north wall of the tavern here at The Darkness With Inn.  Hard wooden chairs, tables and benches are spaced liberally throughout the room.  A trio of rotting krolvin pirates sits at the bar, blood dripping from their mouths as they feast on plates of smoked flesh.

title: [Shade Square, East]
description: In the center of the dark and gloomy bazaar stands the towering black facade of a citadel, its shape looming large over the square.  Wisps of pale, white smoke swirl about the citadel's highest spire as eerie moans emanate from beyond its curved doors.  A group of ghastly figures kneel in a circle along the street, hauntingly chanting as they offer praise to the black fortress.

title: [Lich Citadel, Darkway]
description: The citadel opens up into a massive chamber, where shadows eerily shift from wall to wall.  A low, humming sound reverberates from somewhere close by.

title: [Shade Square, Northeast]
description: A heavy wooden door bounded by iron-barred windows serves as the entrance into a rock-lined weapon shop.  All manner of undead pass by, their rotting and grotesque forms shambling among a number of multistoried buildings.  Much of this corner of the square is gloomy, shrouded by the shadow of the looming citadel to the south.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west

title: [Weapons Wight Away]
description: The interior of the shop reveals all manner of bladed weapons, from daggers to twohanded swords.  Most of the weaponry is wrought of dark steel, each wrapped with old leather or sinew.  A gnarled zombie ogre weaponsmith shambles behind a long wood counter.

title: [Lich's Landing, Claw St.]
description: The patched street runs between the northern palisade and the central square to the south and east.  A number of undead travel through here, a mix of ghouls, zombies, wights and skeletons.  A nedum vereri leans in the doorway of a dilapidated bathhouse, seductively calling out to those passing by.

title: [Darkness With Inn, Trophy Room]
description: A blackened fireplace dominates the center of one wall, its surface charred and covered in cobwebs.  Stained animal skins lie before the hearth, flanked on either side by bone-inlaid couches.  Grisly, misshapen trophies, consisting of the heads of elves, humans, dwarfs and halflings line the discolored walls.

title: [Darkness With Inn, Front Desk]
description: A blood-stained wooden desk sits to the side of the staircase and bears a placard carved into the likeness of a red-eyed lich, a crown of finger bones upon his head.  Moldering zombies stagger about the area, some wandering mindlessly up and down the staircase rising to the second floor.

title: [The Darkness With Inn, Hallway]
description: The second floor hall is nearly engulfed in darkness, shadows creeping along the walls and seemingly moving with a life of their own.  The carpet of the floor has been torn up in many spots, and stained with blood in others.  A number of doorways line the hall, their doors completely missing.

title: [Darkness With Inn, Dining Room]
description: Loud and abusive noises emanate from the kitchen doors, accompanied by the scent of burnt flesh and hair.  Tapestries hang from the walls, depicting gruesome scenes of ghoulish creatures feasting on an old battlefield of bodies.  Hard wooden tables and chairs are placed evenly, allowing enough space for the zombie cook to pass by when delivering maggot-covered meals.

title: [The Darkness With Inn, Cellar]
description: The walls are cold and damp, water and blood dripping from the ceiling.  Crates, barrels and chests fill every corner of the cellar, maggots crawling along their lids.  An uneven ramp leads back up into the dining room.

title: [The Darkness With Inn, Nook]
description: The nook is small and smothered in shadows.  A hunchbacked undead kobold sits in one corner, carving out grayish brain matter from a half-decayed skull in his lap.

title: [Darkness With Inn, Blood Baths]
description: Two large, oval-shaped pools are set into the cracked wooden floorboards here.  The pools are filled with blood, and a dozen tiny black worms are seen crawling out of the crimson pits.

title: [Lich's Landing, Revenant Road]
description: Fresh trails of blood mar the jagged stones of the road here, the crimson tracks snaking off in many directions.  Glowing red eyes peer out of the shadows between buildings and the faint sound of grinding teeth can be heard nearby.

title: [Lich's Landing, Revenant Road]
description: The large, barn-like structure that dominates the north side of the block is the under city's stables.  A wide broken window reveals rows of wooden stalls where skeletal mares and nightmarish horses are sheltered within.

title: [Lich's Landing, Revenant Road]
description: Flatbed wagons carrying wood and rock lumbers slowly down the road, pulled by fiery-maned steeds and driven by ugly ghouls.  The path comes to an end near the wall of a tavern, where a number of grisly zombies and skeletons linger about.  A bone-inlaid stairway leads up to a elven hide curtain, which serves as an entrance to the tavern.

title: [The Spirits]
description: Swathes of elven, dwarven and human hides decorate the walls of this establishment like macabre tapestries.  A narrow bar shaped out of a giant ribcage stretches across the room, its top set with bleached bone plates as a makeshift counter.  Behind the bar roams an eyeless giantman zombie, spilling more drinks than filling them.  A row of hide-covered wooden stools provide a place to rest and drink.

title: [Lich Citadel, Darkway]
description: Tendrils of pale, white smoke drift throughout the chamber, snaking along the walls like ashen fingers.  Faint, ethereal forms glide through the darkness.

title: [Lich Citadel, Darkway]
description: The chamber is illuminated by broad lines of white light stretching along the walls.  A loud, humming noise originates from the glow.

title: [Lich Citadel, Darkway]
description: The white lines running along the black walls pulsate with energy.  The lines emit a sharp hum, as their light casts an eerie glow throughout the area.

title: [Lich Citadel, Darkway]
description: The very walls seem to shift, as if formed from liquid darkness.  Coils of white smoke twist and turn, drifting up and down the corridor.

title: [Lich Citadel, Darkway]
description: Thick white smoke blankets the floor of the chamber, the only light coming from the broad strips of energy running along the walls.  An eerie chill hangs in the air.

title: [Lich Citadel, Wide Hall]
description: The hall expands here, yet remains covered in darkness save for the light coming from the strips of white energy running down parallel walls.  A strange clattering sound echoes from further away.

title: [Lich Citadel, Ascent]
description: The citadel rises here, the sleek floor ascending sharply.  Strange, white lines of energy run along the walls, twisting to move up as the area shifts.

title: [Lich Citadel, Feast Yard]
description: The floor is sticky with blood and littered with the half-eaten corpses of humans, elves and dwarves.  Strange, malformed creatures move throughout the bodies, picking them up and gnawing on them absentmindedly.

title: [Lich Citadel, Ascent]
description: The floor continues to climb, stretching into darkness above.  Only dim lights illuminate the walkway, their source the white lines of energy running up the walls.

title: [Lich Citadel, Outer Chamber]
description: The walls of the citadel move like liquid darkness, shifting and drifting along.  Ethereal forms move through the shadows, their transparent forms appearing more like ripples in the air.

title: [Lich Citadel, Outer Chamber]
description: The faint, saddening tune of a flute drifts through the chamber.  Shadows dance along the wall, as if responding to the melody.  Set into the side of a wall is a pair of looming black ora doors.

title: [Lich Citadel, Throne Room]
