description: The area opens up into a huge expanse, where polished black marble floors stretch from wall to wall.  Bright red blood stains many spots along the marble, leaving little puddles along the way.

title: [Lich Citadel, Outer Chamber]
description: Bellowing cries rattle the chamber here, their tone deep and metallic.  Pale, unmoving humanoids line a segment of the wall here, their eyes dark and cold.

title: [Lich Citadel, Outer Chamber]
description: Tall death knights, bedecked in glistening black armor, march along the circular corridors, their eyes glowing with a hauntingly red glare.  Their footsteps are muffled, as if the shadows along the walls are absorbing their sound.

title: [Lich Citadel, Outer Chamber]
description: Shadowy, dark-winged creatures soar along the highest point of the chamber, drifting above as their bright yellow eyes hunt.  Tendrils of pale white smoke twist through the area.

title: [Lich Citadel, Outer Chamber]
description: Grotesque creatures seem to move within the shadows here, forming shifting lumps along the walls.  Periodically their gnarled faces appear, before emitting blood curdling moans.

title: [Lich Citadel, Outer Chamber]
description: The walls are blanketed in the deepest of shadows, save for a dozen of tiny beady red eyes moving along the ceiling. Ashen fog hugs the floor, obscuring the ground.

title: [Lich Citadel, Outer Chamber]
description: Haunting moans echo eerily throughout the hall as shadows shift along the sleek walls.  The air is heavy and crisp with a deep chill.

title: [Lich Citadel, Throne Room]
description: Lines of gnarled bone candelabras are set up throughout the throne room.  The light creates a soft amber glow to push against the encroaching darkness along the walls.

title: [Lich Citadel, Throne Room]
description: A pair of decomposing zombies lurch about, their putrid bodies covered in tattered motley garb.  They aimlessly toss juggling balls into the air, and flail their arms about as if dancing.

title: [Lich Citadel, Throne Room]
description: Nightmarish figures slip in and out of the shadows, their barbed forms misshapen and oily.  Even the darkness of the area seems to cling to them, obscuring their movements.

title: [Lich Citadel, Throne Room]
description: Dark, macabre tapestries hang from bone pillars, their embroidered images broken up by blood splotches and decay.  A sorrowful requiem drifts through the cold air.

title: [Lich Citadel, Throne Room]
description: A lone minstrel has erected himself on a platform of bones, ligaments and skulls.  The performer's skin is gaunt and patchy, his eyes dark golden.  A mournful dirge rises from his lute.

title: [The Lich's Throne]
description: A polished floor of deep black marble stretches up to an enormous cerulean dais.  Rising from the platform is a high-backed throne, constructed from a series blackened bones, all interconnected by bloody ligaments.  Surrounding the throne stand a half-circle of armored death knights.

title: [Lich Citadel, Feast Yard]
description: Corpses twitch on the slick floors, their bodies still shifting as hordes of ghouls move about.  Low, pitiful moaning fills the area with mournful noise.

title: [Lich Citadel, Feast Yard]
description: Deformed, hunched-over ghouls shift through a pile of bones and limbs, hungrily chomping on bits of flesh and ligaments.  Their feasting is sloppy and loud, and their red eyes dart about wildly.

title: [Lich Citadel, Feast Yard]
description: High-pitched shrieking bounces off the slick walls, as trails of pale white fog weave throughout the area.  Bones crunch as creatures move about in the darkness.

title: [Lich Citadel, Soul Pit]
description: The smooth, black floor comes to an abrupt end here, giving way to a gigantic pit below.  From all sides of the pit, ghoulish creatures climb forth, scrambling into the darkness.

title: [Lich Citadel, Soul Pit]
description: Deep, guttural moaning rises up from the recesses of the pit nearby.  The loud groaning echoes off the shadowy walls of the chamber.

title: [Lich Citadel, Soul Pit]
description: The floor is narrow here, as it winds around the huge pit beyond.  Gusts of wind spiral up out of the pit, twisting into the air and twirling about.

title: [Lich Citadel, Soul Pit]
description: Wraiths pass through the area, slipping in and out of the darkness looming high above the pit.  The stepping becomes more precarious here, as the floor winds around.

title: [Lich's Landing, Wraith Way]
description: The uneven road turns gradually here, as it forms the northwest corner of the underground city.  The path stretches south, moving between a number of squat, ghastly buildings.  The massive wooden logs of the city's palisade tower overhead.

title: [Lich's Landing, Wraith Way]
description: Dark, blood-splattered stones make for an uneven road that stretches along the northern palisade.  Just to the north, stands two large bone towers.  The gnarled forms of undead guards come and go through the main gates, hungrily eyeing everyone that passes.

title: [Quarrels and Quivers]
description: Panels of old, rotted wood covers the walls, stained with blood and gore.  Shelves seem to grow from the wood, their surfaces holding a number of merchandise.  An assortment of bows hang from hooks along a wall.

title: [Lich's Landing, Wraith Way]
description: A line of disfigured ghoul soldiers march along the lane, moving between the barracks and the guard towers at either end of the road.  Disembodied eyes, all having red pupils, float through the area, scanning the surroundings as blood drips from their fleshy veins.

title: [Lich's Landing, Gate]
description: A group of decaying, giant zombie trolls stand watch over the main gate into the underground city.  Two daunting towers, comprised of bone and bloody ligaments stretch up towards the cavern's ceiling, armored skeletal sentries marching upon their platforms.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: The cavern is deep and wide, shrouded in darkness and illuminated only by strands of spectral pale light.  Rising out among the stalagmites, is a huge wooden palisade wall, broken up by a pair of giant towers, comprised of bones and ligaments.  Between the ghastly towers is a barbed black iron gate.

title: [Lich's Landing, Wraith Way]
description: Worn and uneven paving stones broken by deep ruts cover most of the dirty, blood-splattered ground, making for treacherous footing.  A chorus of eerie wailing and ghostly moans hums from somewhere to the west.

title: [Lich's Landing, Wraith Way]
description: The wooden palisade running along Wraith Road has been darkened from the blood of the dozens of heads decorating their sharpened spikes.  A small, decaying halfling meanders down the street, holding his severed arm in his hands.

title: [Lich's Landing, Wraith Way]
description: An eerie quiet blankets the area like the deep shadow cast by the high palisade wall.  A bloated and one-eyed halfling kneels in front of a strange white tent, set back from the roadside.  The halfling skillfully carves into a slab of meaty flesh, separating it into tiny blocks.  The faint aroma of decay wafts out from the tent's flap.

title: [Lich's Landing, Wraith Way]
description: The broken, stained road continues here and ends at the town's barracks.  The building is two stories tall, with shattered windows lining its exterior.  Echoing from within the barracks is the sound of mournful wailing.

title: [Barracks, Entry]
description: The entrance hall of the barracks is wide and yet gruesome, its walls slick with blood.  Skeletal guardians stand at attention, their bony frames large and garbed in tattered armor, but their eyes cold and hollow.

title: [Barracks, Corridor]
description: The hallway splits three ways here, two paths stretching to either side, while another passage leading into complete darkness south of here.  From nearby, the sound of clanging metal reverberates loudly.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Barracks, West Hall]
description: Darkness creeps into the room, like a slow moving black fog.  The heavy sound of boots stomping echoes down the corridor.

title: [Barracks, Passage]
description: Spectral warriors march up and down the dark passage, their ethereal forms locked in an eternal cycle of drill sequences.  One ghostly figure appears to be leading them, shouting commands as they reach the end of the hall, forcing them to turn sharply and repeat their trek.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Map Room]
description: The room is shrouded in near darkness, the only light coming from a glowing white skull that rests on the edge of a long wooden table.  Next to the skull is a small rack filled with torn maps and stained parchments.  Occasionally the glowing skull cackles wildly.

title: [Barracks, Bone Pit]
description: The room is dark here, and the air is heavy with the scent of death.  A huge pit opens up in the middle of the room, where a large fleshy creature crawls about on all fours, chomping as it moves across a pile of old bones.

title: [Barracks, Interrogation Room]
description: The walls of this room are bathed in blood, its sticky crimson fluid dripping even from the ceiling.  Cold, stone slabs create a row of makeshift tables in the center of the area, while an assortment of limbs and other body parts have fallen to their sides.  A spectral figure floats about the room, giggling to himself as he moves through the shadows.

title: [Barracks, East Hall]
description: The sound of crunching bones echoes down the hallway, accompanied by the pitiful yelp of a dying creature.  Shadows hug the walls, moving about as if liquid darkness.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Dormitory]
description: The room is devoid of any ornamentation, save for old narrow cots that have rotted over time.  A skull-inlaid chest sits near a cot, filled with ratty and stained uniforms.

title: [Barracks, Mess Hall]
description: As bare bones as much of the hall, this area contains only rows and rows of old modwir tables and benches.  The charred husks of roasted halflings and animals litter some of the tables, while the scent of cooked flesh permeates from the kitchen.

title: [Barracks, Kitchen]
description: The vast barracks kitchen houses a number of cast-iron pots, each bubbling with a mixture of meat, blood, and ligaments.  Stoves line a far wall, where the bodies of halflings and gnomes have been skewered on a spit and spin to a slow roast.  Skeletal cooks stand at a row of worktables, chopping up meat with butcher knives and tossing them into the pots.

title: [Barracks, Armory]
description: Two weapons racks line parallel walls of this room, holding a wide variety of halberds, axes, and longsword, each weapon s steel rusted or covered in old bloodstains.  Rotted and warped shields hang from hooks near a cracked dresser, where ragged uniforms have spilled out of into a disarrayed pile.

title: [Barracks. Guardpost]
description: The largest room of the barracks, the walls stretch wide and the ceiling reaches high, providing ample room for the skeletal giants who stand guard here.  Bedecked in heavy black platemail and equipped with huge steel flails, the undead giants stare threateningly about.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Darkness]
description: The room is full of darkness, making it impossible to see.

title: [Barracks, Officer's Den]
description: Old, rust-covered footlockers run along a wall of the den, each set with tiny scratched and faded brass plates.  A splintered wooden desk sits in a corner, two broken windows rising up behind it.

title: [Barracks, Holding Pen]
description: Bent steel cages hang from the ceiling, suspended by rusted iron chains.  Rotted, decomposing bodies have been stuffed into the metal prisons, some of the corpses hacked into pieces in order to fit inside.  Dried blood cakes the cages, and old stains have discolored the wooden floor below.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Pale, ethereal forms waiver in and out of existence, floating about the cavern and moving among the shadows.  Threads of ghostly white energy snake through the air, originating from beyond a huge palisade wall in the distance.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: The darkness gives way to a massive cavernous chamber, where huge stalactites and stalagmites are formed along the jagged floor and ceiling.  Wisps of glowing, white energy drift through the area like smoke.

title: [The Darkness With Inn, Hallway]
description: Shadows cling to the walls like thick tapestries of night, obscuring the hallway mostly in darkness.  A few candles rest on some old stands, but their flames are weak and flicker constantly.  Half of a wall has crumbled, where once a door or two stood.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Darkness With Inn, Suite]
description: Heavy, blood red curtains are partially drown in this room, allowing a narrow view of the uneven street below.  Near the wall is a small sitting area containing a sofa, a chair, and a stained desk.  A full length mirror is hung on the wall, its glass shattered into a thousand pieces.

title: [Darkness With Inn, Meeting Room]
description: A long wooden table rests dead center in the room, surrounded by a number of old and discolored chairs.  A blackboard hangs on the far wall, depicting a crude sketch of two maps, respectively labeled as the layouts of Wehnimer's Landing and Lich's Landing.

title: [The Darkness With Inn, Hallway]
description: Wild cackling erupts from amongst the darkness, as a cold breeze threatens to snuff out the flames of some nearby candles.  A large, cracked window is set into a wall at the far end of the hallway, providing a view of the grim streets of Lich's Landing.

title: [Darkness With Inn, Narrow Room]
description: This narrow room contains all the basics of sleeping quarters, including a simple cot which rests against one wall, and a row of hooks covered in ratty garbs.  The heavy footfall of boots can be heard thumping nearby.

title: [Darkness With Inn, Comfy Room]
description: Tattered, cotton curtains are drawn open from a cracked window, providing a glimpse of the looming black citadel near the center of town.  A large, blood-stained bed is flanked on each side by a nightstand, near a warped wooden dresser stands ready to topple.

title: [A Dark Corner]
description: This dark corner is far enough away from the bustle of the courtyard to provide a little peace and quiet...perfect for reflection and training.

title: [The Gentlemen's Leaf, Smokeshop]
description: Antique tapestries, edged with amber tassels, are carefully hung on the grey stone walls, their woven design displayed on polished brass rods.  The rich, pungent smell of tobacco permeates the air of the tiny shop.  A clear glass case stands center in the room, its interior filled with a variety of items.  Set into the back wall is a large archway curtained with thick velvet.

title: [The Gentlemen's Leaf, Lounge]
description: A large sofa surrounded by smaller dark leather chairs fills the space in front of a rustic stone fireplace.  Pale crystal globes hang from dark silver chains, their muted light gently illuminating the dark paneled walls and thick burgundy carpeting.  A polished walnut dart board painted with alternating burgundy and ebon sections hangs above a small woven basket of sticks.  Draped with an elegant topaz-threaded runner, a sideboard is covered with a variety of refreshments.  A dartboard rack rests next to a large curtained archway.

title: [The Plume and Glove, Milliners]
description: The four walls are each comprised of floor-to-ceiling mirrors, casting reflections back upon each other and leaving no angle out of view.  A throw rug in the middle of the floor, a pair of flanking leather armchairs and a small table laden with shop samples all appear duplicated over and over.  Even the arched doorway leading in and out of the shop appears copied.

title: [Well-Heeled, Cordwainers]
description: The long, narrow building has an open floorplan, though a demi-wall, fashioned as an elongated ogee arch, separates the space into two chambers.  On the left side, a suite of chairs is arranged in a quatrefoil formation, forming a sitting area, and on the right side, sets of shelves display basic lasts and examples of custom pieces.  A mirror surrounds a small platform set in one corner and a gold-gilt door is set in another.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: Brightly colored banners have been draped across each stall, the twine-bound loops encircling the bamboo poles that frame the various booths from floor to open ceiling.  Small bits of ribbon and other knickknacks hang from the lengths of bamboo, tokens from other market attendees past.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: Overflowing baskets of spices and herbs line the walkway of the area, the melange of fragrances scenting the air about the market.   A pudgy cat drapes lazily around a flimsy basket of catnip, nudging it slightly with an extended paw as its tail flicks across the leg of a nearby table.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: The shouts of enthusiastic hawkers compete with the soft sounds of music playing somewhere within the market, the combination only amplified as it echoes against several large metal shields resting against a nearby booth.  The cacophony continues as a caged parrot imitates the environment, flapping its vivid wings in an attempt for attention.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: Dozens of flora-stuffed vases encircle the area of the market, the colorful displays frequently visited by a number of butterflies and bumblebees that glide across the air.  A stand of wax-lined sleeves and heavy twine spools flank the blossoms, providing a perch for a pair of lovebirds.

title: [Merchant's Hall, Open Market]
description: The scent of freshly baked breads and rolls waft from a nearby stand, the display dotted with fruit-filled tarts and pies.  A stack of silk-tied paper boxes lean against the stand, wobbling with any movement to its food-covered foundation.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: Swathes of brocade, paeline, and bourde are displayed across several rounded tables, each length meticulously folded and layered atop the next bolt.  Hemp-strung baskets full of buttons and pins hang high above the center of each table, swaying gently with the ambient breeze.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: Several half-circle benches are surrounded by flora in various stages of bloom, the open area dotted by smaller vendors selling less common wares.  The musical sounds of gently swaying windchimes tinkle across the market, the thin copper tubes dancing about as they swirl from gossamer threads.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: Fresh fruits and vegetables line a nearby stand, the bright-colored columns covered in a light veil of dewdrops.  Bundles of twine-bound herbs hang from the bamboo rafters alongside bags of dried oats and beans.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: Strands of faceted crystals fringe the awning of a nearby stall, the prisms casting thin flashes of rainbow colors along the ground.  Faint tendrils of incense smoke rise from a nearby censer, casting a soft haze throughout the area, the honeyed scent of fig and amber lingering long after.

title: [Merchant Hall, Open Market]
description: An expansive stand of armor and weaponry dominates this area of the market, the display barely concealing a makeshift forge further back from the crowds.  The sound of metal-on-metal clangs loudly through the air, the rhythmic echo followed by a shower of red-orange sparks that fade as quickly as they appear.

title: [Locks and Luck]
description: Shimmering beads of a variety of gemstones hang from the ceiling of this wagon, their surfaces capturing the light from nearby candles that line the walls.  A makeshift dart board has been drawn onto a patch of canvas that droops over an iron-banded coffer, partially concealing it.  Two featureless dwarf mannequins stand on either side of a polished glass display case.

title: [A Pile of Pig-Droppings]
description: The stench is quite overwhelming.  After you have managed to clear your eyes of the muck you look around and can see that you are in the large pile of pig droppings that sits next to the Hall.

title: [Lord Metaboculous' Room]
description: The first thing you notice about this room is a massive stone fireplace that fills most of the northern wall.  A long "L" shaped bookcase sits against the opposite wall surrounding a large stuffed chair.  In the center of the room, covered by thick sleeping furs, is a heavy mahogany bed with gleaming brass bedknobs on all four corners.

title: [Underground Cavern, Garden]
description: Bathed in shadows, an unusual garden encircled by seven trees spreads across this side of the long rectangular platform, which abutts the cavern wall.  The northern area of the platform is sectioned off, demarcated by a tall wall of woven roots that protrude up from the distinctively dark soil.  Clogging the air with its intensity, the stench of cruor and decomposition gleefully cavorts around weaker nectarous notes.  Descending down to ground-level is a stairway of small boulders, with a gate situated midway down.

title: [Underground Cavern, Orchard]
description: Sequestered from the main garden, the orchard accommodates four black trees, a dead white tree and a rotted dead white tree split down the middle far from the platform edge and a tall wall of woven roots.  To the left of the nearly mature trees and in front of four rows of stakes, small black saplings splay out of the soil at peculiarly bent angles.  The tiny wispy white strands of light floating about the cavern and illuminating the panoramic view of Lich's Landing seem to avoid wandering anywhere near the orchard, effectively couching it in a perpetual crepuscule.

Sequestered from the main garden, the orchard accommodates six black trees situated far from the edge of the platform and a tall wall of woven roots.  To the left of the nearly mature trees and in front of four rows of stakes, small black saplings splay out of the soil at peculiarly bent angles.  The tiny wispy white strands of light floating about the cavern and illuminating the panoramic view of Lich's Landing seem to avoid wandering anywhere near the orchard, effectively couching it in a perpetual crepuscule.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Eastern Walkway]
description: The air is hazy with twining plumes of smoke, as breezes from the eastern riverbank breathe life into pockets of smoldering ash, reigniting what little is left to burn in the area.  Shimmering, glaesine waves of heat rise from the obsidian-like smoothness of the black water below.  Through the pitch darkness of night and the haze-laden air, a newly constructed pine walkway can be glimpsed continuing eastward through a freshly whitewashed gate leading off into the distant wetlands.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Riverfront]
description: A thin strip of land meanders along the Locksmehr River, winding up and down in wide loops to follow the natural curves of the shore.  Dense vegetation obstructs movement inland, but a meager thinning of the greenery ahead reveals a sand-strewn dirt footpath leading to a rundown hovel.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Team Approach]
description: A circular hallway gathers around a wide arena entrance that is brightly illuminated by several torches.  An arena guard stands vigilantly awaiting groups of combatants to face off in the arena.  A ramp leads slightly upward to the solitary entrance.

title: [Bloodforge, Smelter]
description: Flickering shadows dance rigidly across the stone walls of this room where a small forge houses bright red coals wreathed in licking flames.  A wooden structure sits next to a trough of murky water and houses all manner of useful tools, including some ceramic crucibles.  Several mining apprentices wander in and out of the area.

title: [East Feywrot, Pine Walkway]
description: Fresh pine sap, sticky and golden brown, oozes from the cut ends of multiple lengths of newly planed boards laid diagonally across sturdy pilings buried in the waist-deep muck.  Rounded teak pegs affix each board in place, forming a sturdy walkway for egress through the darkest part of the swamp.  Colorful lanterns cast a silvery-grey light across the foliage-choked miasma, occasionally highlighting pairs of unblinking eyes staring up through the watery undergrowth.

title: [East Feywrot, Pine Walkway]
description: The raised pine walkway, supported by sturdy pilings buried in the waist-deep muck, traverses an east-west path through the swamp.  A respite from the overhead tangle allows some silvery-grey beams of moonlight to illuminate the otherwise dark, wooden walkway.  The still of the night is broken by the deep, persistent growling of some large cat.

title: [East Feywrot, Pine Walkway]
description: Thick patches of residue from pale golden sap make walking here a sticky proposition.  The walkway, suspended above the fetid mire below, wends both to the notheast and to the west with no end in sight in either direction.  Little moonlight reaches the ground through the dense foliage overhead, leaving the sturdy handrails as the only guide for travelers.

title: [A Steep Trail]
description: The icy air grows thin at this altitude, making any exertion difficult.  High above, the trail opens out onto a wide, snow-blanketed plain.  A lone fir tree climbs precariously to the trail side, bent close to the ground from years of pummeling by the deadly winter winds.  Nestled against the mountain, a dark tower stands within the shadow of the peak like a spectral sentinel watching the trail.
location: the Dark Tower, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Dark Tower, Great Hall]
description: The hall is circular, its polished dark walls stretching nearly thirty spans overhead.  Long tapestries hang from the walls, interspersed with iron braziers.  In the floor's center, inlaid into the grey granite tile, is a slit-pupiled eye rendered in vivid gold marble.  Around the room's circumference stand brass censers, from which smoke from exotic-smelling incense languidly curls upward.  A winding staircase disappears through the ceiling, and a black onyx door leads outside.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Hardy tundra grass clings to the rocky ground, the only life strong enough to survive on these plains.  High snow-covered peaks tower in the far distance, watching over all Elanthia.  A tight trail leads back down into the trees.

title: [A Steep Trail]
description: The icy air grows thin at this altitude, making any exertion difficult.  High above, the trail opens out onto a wide, snow-blanketed plain.  A lone fir tree climbs precariously to the trail side, bent close to the ground from years of pummeling by the deadly winter winds.  Nestled against the mountain, a dark tower stands within the shadow of the peak like a spectral sentinel watching the trail.

title: [East Feywrot, Pine Walkway]
description: A sturdy handrail guides travelers along the newly laid walkway, supported by raised pilings below.  The water below is darker and somewhat deeper than the surrounding areas.  Colorful lanterns cast a silvery grey light across the foliage-choked miasma, catching the occasional flash of scales and fins leaping up through the watery undergrowth.

title: [East Feywrot, Riverbank]
description: The swamp foliage is thinner here than that to the west, and a wide expanse of water can be seen to the east.  Tiny streams flow beneath the raised pine walkway, joining forces with others meandering in from the riverbank.  The noxious stench of swamp gas fades, replaced by the sweet smell of fresh air billowing in from the open waters.  Moonlight pierces the night cloud cover, bathing the swaying rushes in a pale silver glow.

title: [East Feywrot, Riverbank]
description: Swaying reeds and estuary grasses brush softly against the handrailing of the pine walkway, tickling the fingers of passersby as they traverse the dunes beside the swiftly flowing river.  The night air brings with it just a hint of salt as this part of the waterway widens on its journey towards the open bay beyond.

title: [East Feywrot, Dune's End]
description: A series of freshly whitewashed planks form a steep stairway connecting the far end of the pine walkway to a sturdy and spacious dock jutting out across a deep inlet at the river's edge.  Swirls and eddies in the current below indicate a somewhat greater depth to the river at this point than that found farther away from the main channel.  A luminous moon, high overhead, casts soft reflections of shimmering gold flecks across the rippling surface.

title: [East Feywrot, Deep Water Dock]
description: Brightly lit glass globed lanterns cast a soft glow across the surface of the dock and the rippling waters beyond.  Remnants of mooring lines are threaded through heavy iron rings at the edge of the dock, but no vessel appears in sight.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Main Deck]
description: A natural coating of rubbed teak oil leaves the decking planks gleaming in the moonlight, while encompassing brass railings have been polished to the point where one can see their own reflection at a glance.  The softer summer rings striating the teak planks have been worn ever so slightly, giving a natural no-slip purchase underfoot.  Though no deck chairs are present, there remains ample standing room along the railings, gifting an unfettered view of the moonlit waters below.

A natural coating of rubbed teak oil leaves the decking planks gleaming in the mid-day sun, while encompassing brass railings have been polished to the point where one can see their own reflection at a glance.  The softer summer rings striating the teak planks have been worn ever so slightly, giving a natural no-slip purchase underfoot.  Though no deck chairs are present, there remains ample standing room along the railings, gifting an unfettered view of the vast expanse of surrounding sea.

title: [Caligos Isle, Pier Terminus]
description: Brilliantly glowing lanterns of brass and glass sway frenetically as the fierce nighttime winds whip across the exposed far end of the pier, where a three-masted sailing vessel tugs against its secure mooring lines.  Despite the occasional deluge of salty spray, the surface feels sturdy and safe with a coarse coating of black coral dust giving purchase to the footing.  Beyond the railing, a dark and restless sea stretches outward, melding at the horizon with a star-encrusted skyline.

Unlit lanterns of brass and glass sway frenetically as the fierce winds whip across the exposed far end of the pier, where a three-masted sailing vessel tugs against its secure mooring lines.  Despite the occasional deluge of salty spray, the surface feels sturdy and safe with a coarse coating of black coral dust giving purchase to the footing.  Beyond the railing, the white-capped sea reaches out to touch the horizon in all directions.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Aft Deck]
description: Most of this expansive deck is navigable, save a large cypress mast mid-deck and its accompanying lanyards and mast stays.  A brass railing encircling the main deck of the vessel provides sufficient viewing space for those wishing to gaze out upon the waters.  A decorative, nautical motif is inlaid along the edges of the smooth teak planking underfoot.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Aftcastle]
description: Fanciful carvings decorate the edge planking around this raised portion of the upper deck at the stern of the sailing vessel.  Brass handrails aid passengers and crew alike when the sea swells exacerbate or the winds turn to gales.  One large cabin for the captain, and some smaller quarters for his mate, keep both in close proximity to the helm where a large ship's wheel is mounted firmly on the aftcastle decking.

title: [Captain's Quarters, Great Cabin]
description: A bank of large, grate-hatched windows provide invited guests a vantage point to gaze down and out upon the incoming swells surrounding the aftcastle deck.  A polished oak desk spread with quills, an inkwell, and logbooks sits to one side, and a high-backed, red leather chair is tucked neatly beneath it.  Tapestry-covered sofas provide additional seating and a pale woolen carpet cushions the teak planked flooring.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Fore Deck]
description: A line of blanket-draped, polished mahogany deck chairs await guests along the railing, some turned inward to facilitate conversation with fellow passengers, others turned outward, providing a view of the vast expanse of open seas.  Waves lapping against the hull of the large vessel provide a rhythmic accompaniment to the whistle of nightime winds through the sails and the muted chatter of ship-bound guests.

A line of blanket-draped, polished mahogany deck chairs await guests along the railing, some turned inward to facilitate conversation with fellow passengers, others turned outward, providing a view of the vast expanse of open seas.  Waves lapping against the hull of the large vessel lend a rhythmic accompaniment to the symphony of bird cries overhead and the muted chatter of ship-bound guests.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Forecastle]
description: Perched high above the main decking, the view offered from the polished brass railings of the forecastle stretches off many leagues toward the horizon.  A tall, cypress foremast dominates the space, while a long cylindrical bowsprit extends out over the choppy waters below.  To each side of the spacious decking, a set of coral-dusted stairs descends further into the vessel's depths.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Passageway]
description: Though some light streams down an open stairwell from the forecastle above, brass lanterns provide most of the illumination in the enclosed companionway.  Staterooms for traveling merchants and other distinquished guests punctuate the illuminated passage, each highlighted on either side with a pair of softly glowing wall sconces.

title: [Caligos Island, Pier]
[Caligos Isle, Pier]
description: In the wind-driven swaying of lantern light, a battalion of ghost crabs can be glimpsed nearby, overtaking the black sand beaches and staking claim to the pilings beneath the pier.  The planked decking underfoot creaks rhythmically in time with the incoming waves sent forth by the midnight black seas surrounding the harbor.

Squawking birds of all sizes wheel overhead, making strafing runs atop the water and plunging dives beneath it to secure a meal.  Successful hunters perch upon the handrails to devour their prize, mobbed by would-be meal thieves.  The planked decking underfoot creaks rhythmically in time with the incoming waves sent forth by the roiling, blue-green seas surrounding the harbor.

title: [The Fishing Shack]
description: Warped oak boards are fitted tightly together to form the walls of the shack, while the smooth floorboards are fashioned of teak and roughened up to prevent slipping.  Glass-fronted lanterns with rusted iron doors are suspended in the rafters of the low ceiling and provide illumination for the rack and counter that display a variety of fishing wares.  A painted sign displaying a cavern with indigo lights is tacked near the exit.

title: [Caligos Island, Pier]
[Caligos Isle, Pier]
description: The sturdy pier stands ready to accomodate visitors arriving from, or embarking to, the mainland.  Resting on raised pillars anchored firmly in the substrate below, the terminal end stretches far enough off shore to reach deep water at low tide.  A small grey shanty with pristine white trim is affixed near the stairs, held fast with heavy linked chains.

title: [Caligos Isle, Dockside Stairway]
description: Traversing the steep slope, either toward, or away from, the water is equally treacherous, with loose scree and jagged rocks to either side of the walkway.   Frantically swaying brass lanterns illuminate a large dock below, as it rises and falls in tempo with the waves.  Salt spray rhythmically buffets this section of the stairway, making the footing slick and vision even more difficult in the fog encumbered, nightime environs.

Traversing the steep slope, either toward, or away from, the water is equally treacherous, with loose scree and jagged rocks to either side of the walkway.   A large dock below rises and falls in tempo with the waves, straining against its mooring chains with each passing swell.   Salt spray rhythmically buffets this section of the stairway, making the footing slick and vision difficult.

title: [Caligos Isle, Dockside Stairway]
description: Climbing the perpetually slick stairway demands attention and care, as the fall from this height would surely end badly on the jagged, black rocks below.  A dusting of ground black coral, lacquer-sealed across each board, gives at least some purchase underfoot.  Swirling mists and thick, grey fog make ascertaining safe footing difficult, even with bright and colorful lanterns swinging wildly overhead in the fierce winds coming off the nighttime sea.

A dusting of ground black coral, lacquer-sealed across each board, gives at least some purchase underfoot.   Swirling mists and thick grey fog make ascertaining safe footing difficult, even with the help of the mid-day sun.

title: [Caligos Isle, Landing]
description: A naturally steep embankment connecting the island slope with the shoreline has been made safe for visitors with the addition of a sturdily constructed egress of pine planking and some carved stone steps leading down towards the sea.  Bright lanterns swaying in the sea breezes provide the only respite from the encompassing darkness.  Steep cliffs rise to the inland areas, though the blackness of night obscures what lies above.  Narrow, broken stone pathways to the east and west lead off toward the rest of the island.

A naturally steep embankment connecting the island slope with the shoreline has been made safe for visitors with the addition of a sturdily constructed egress of pine planking and some carved stone steps leading down towards the sea, complete with handrailings and lanterns for nightime travel.  Steep cliffs rise to the inland areas, though a heavy, silvery grey fog obscures what lies above.  Narrow pathways of broken stones to the east and west lead off toward the rest of the island.

title: [Caligos Isle, Southern Exposure]
description: Proximity to the water's edge on this exposed outcropping brings fierce gusts of wind with a decidedly salty and sulfurous tang that burns the nostrils.  The ground is obscured by a blanketing mist of deep indigo, sinuously twisting around the ankles of any passersby.  Rounded protrusions of scoria and jagged shards of obsidian poke up from the dark and swirling ground cover.  To the east, only the wind-driven swaying of bright lanterns pierces the fog, indicating the location of the southern pier.

The ground is obscured by a blanketing mist of deep indigo, sinuously twisting around the ankles of any passersby.  Rounded protrusions of scoria and jagged shards of obsidian poke up from the dark and swirling ground cover.  To the east, workers on a long wooden pier hustle to haul in heavy lines and repair pilings ravaged by recent storms.

title: [Island Finery, Boutique]
description: Silk in a variety of colorful hues wraps about thick tigerwood poles that form the frame for the large, elegant tent.  A tall driftwood mirror rests to the side of the shop against a wall of pale grey material.  Three mannequins occupy the center of the room, their forms resting atop a soft, brightly patterned carpet.

title: [Caligos Isle, Leviathans' Rest]
description: Three bloated and decaying orcas, likely a mama, papa, and baby, rest together in shallow pools between jagged peaks.  A putrid stench emits from each, as gases of decomposition seep through open wounds and deteriorating body cavities.  The baby's face and eyes have been picked clean by scavengers and, beneath the leathery exteriors, writhing hagfish can be seen devouring the choice flesh.  The treacherous nighttime path has been made moreso by a slick coating of blood, blubber, and a rancid, slimy ooze.

Three sun-bleached skeletal orcas, likely a mama, papa, and baby, rest together in shallow pools between jagged peaks.  Bits of leathery, black and white hide cling in scattered patches across each creature's bony structures, as if refusing to surrender its former identity.  The smallest skeleton is missing its head and much of its ribcage, and trails of bone shards litter the treacherous slope below.

title: [Caligos Carvings]
description: Pale blue carpets cover the abundant floor space in this spacious hollow carved into the granite cliffside.  Painted clay pots are set along the walls, brimming with hand-carved knick-knacks.  A small table, draped in blue cotton cloth, sits in the middle of the space, surrounded by stone pedestals holding various figurines, statues, and carvings.

Pale blue carpets cover the abundant floor space in this spacious hollow carved into the granite cliffside.  Painted clay pots, brimming with hand-carved knick-knacks, are evenly spaced along the walls.  A small table, draped in blue cotton cloth, sits in the middle of the space, surrounded by stone pedestals holding various figurines, statues, and carvings.

title: [Caligos Isle, Talus Slope]
description: Only the narrowest of pathways remains passable, and identifying safe egress in the inky blackness of night is treacherous at best.  The entire southwest corner of the mountain base has eroded here, forming a talus slope of loose, coarse debris leading down toward the water below.  A sharp angle of repose gives the accumulated scree a precarious hold on the steep incline; a single footstep could send an avalanche of detritus clattering into the dark sea below.

Only the narrowest of pathways remains passable, and identifying safe egress within the thick blanket of fog is treacherous at best. A sharp angle of repose gives the accumulated scree a precarious hold on the steep incline; a single footstep could send an avalanche of detritus clattering towards the tumultuous sea.

title: [Climate Change]
description: Within this stone enclosure, some light seeps in around the rock formation that partially blocks the opening to the cave.  The sandy ground is loose and easily stirred up, evidence that few travelers have visited this small, hidden cavern.  Some metal hooks hammered into the wall display various garmets for sale, protected from plunking drops of water by a thick, makeshift, fabric cover.  Patches of green lichen around the space pulsate in sync with the echo each whistling breeze or howling wind that pass outside.

The sandy ground is loose and easily stirred up, evidence that few travelers have visited this small, hidden cavern.  Some metal hooks hammered into the wall display various garments for sale, protected from plunking drops of water by a thick makeshift fabric cover.  Patches of green lichen around the space pulsate in sync with the amplified echo of each whistling breeze or howling wind that passes outside.

title: [Caligos Isle, Southern Slope]
description: The slope grows steep here, with a long stone bench carved into the cliffside.  Loose rocks give way underfoot for those journeying to or from the large wooden dock to the west.  The wind-whipped sway of dock-bound lanterns flash swathes of light sporadically across the blackened seas, displaying only briefly the deep swells from afar, as well as the roiling white caps closing in on the rocky shore.  The surrounding towering landforms are alternately illuminated and then plunged again into darkness on the whim of the powerful breezes.

The slope grows steep here, with a long stone bench carved into the cliffside.  Loose scree gives way underfoot for those journeying to or from the large wooden dock to the west.  Deep swells in the distance transition to roiling white caps closer to the rocky shore.  A steep, lichen-covered cliff face rises to one side of the narrow pathway, forming a mountain whose peak is shrouded into obscurity by a thick mantle of deep indigo fog.

title: [Signed, Sealed, Delivered]
description: Thick lengths of dark blue velvet cover the walls of the spacious wagon.  Gathered tightly, the drapery ripples as it cascades to the floor creating a puddle of rich material.  Crafted from thick oak, a large writing desk dominates the shop.  On one side of the polished top is a vase full of quills while on the other is a small wooden tray of wax.  In the center of the two is a pile of various parchments and paper.  Set back in the room is a small stack of boxes that rest underneath a pair of silk-lined shelves displaying a wide variety of rings.

title: [Caligos Isle, Southern Slope]
description: A single beam of diffuse, pale light reflects intermittantly off the surface of a large, stagnant pool as moonbeams valiantly attempt to pierce the dense, silvery grey fog.  A wet plop sounds from the direction of the water, followed by an odiferous assault of rotten egg stench.  Crystallized mineral deposits surrounding the pool glitter in bands of green, blue, and yellow, reflecting effervescently in the available light.

A stagnant, elongated pool makes traversing the area both nauseating and treacherous.  Thick steam, reeking of rotten eggs, is emitted each time a viscous bubble bursts free from the surface of the water.  Bands of green, blue, and yellow mark the deposits of crystallized minerals around the circumference of the pool's edge.  A quartet of sea stars and one enormous black slug lay dead on the path, clearly unsuccessful in their efforts to return to the sea.

A stagnant, elongated pool makes traversing the area both nauseating and treacherous.  Thick steam reeking of rotten eggs is emitted each time a viscous bubble bursts free from the surface of the water.  Bands of green, blue, and yellow mark the deposits of crystallized minerals around the circumference of the pool's edge.  A quartet of sea stars and one enormous black slug lay dessicated on the path, clearly unsuccessful in their long abandoned efforts to return to the sea.

title: [Deluge Debris]
description: Some type of tectonic or volcanic activity has formed this natural opening in the earth, a wide depression ending deep in the sticky sand of Caligos Isle.  The sinkhole is sloped and somewhat conical, albeit downward-facing in shape, with a smaller opening toward the center leading deeper into the ground.  Several petrified logs have been set out to display wares, while some sand has been formed into a mound in one corner, all serving as makeshift showcases for goods scavenged from around the island.

title: [Deluge Debris]
description: The sticky sand walls are sopping wet with the constant drip-drip-drip of pungent ocean water.  A small, still tidal pool, likely left over from a recent high tide, remains at the bottom of the depression with tiny, clear crabs crawling slowly around it, making their way toward a soft unevenly formed sandbar.  The putrid stench of decaying fish pervades the area, and soft sloshing and squishing sounds can be heard from nearby.  A large crack in one wall looks wide enough to pass through.

title: [The Broken Forge, Sales Room]
description: Bits of seaweed, clusters of black coral, and a few barnacles litter the ground inside the tent.  A rack is placed to one side of the tent, while a long table is set up in the center with some items for sale.  A large crate and a carved wooden box are near a flap that leads to another section of the merchant's tent.

title: [Caligos Isle, Beachview]
description: From this narrow precipice, tiny figures holding torches and lanterns can be glimpsed on the black sand beach below whenever the fog, mist, and pungent steam billow off in a brief, but welcome breeze.  A colony of black coral clings to the base of a rocky overhang.  The tiny lights on the beach, however, pale in comparison to those that can be seen overhead when the fog lifts, exposing the grandeur of the vast, inky black sky.

From this narrow precipice, tiny figures can be glimpsed on the black sand beach below whenever the fog, mist, and pungent steam billow off in a brief, but welcome breeze.  A colony of black coral clings to the base of a rocky overhang.  The sound of waves lapping at the shoreline is punctuated now and then by high-pitched calls of sea birds from above and excited shouts from the beachfront below.

title: [Caligos Isle, Bluff Head Trail]
description: Wisps of fog snake along the top of the plateau, sometimes obscuring the narrow path through short green bushes of salal and wax myrtle broken with patches of fragrant wild beach roses.  Small glass-encased lanterns light the way along crooked wooden stairs guided by a shaky rope handrail threaded through the eyes of iron posts.  Another layer of coastal marine mist wavers overhead, often hiding and revealing an indigo star-filled sky, mimicking the wave activity on the black sand beach below.

Lush green flora covers the top of the plateau, benefitting from the misty coastal fog that coalesces each day.  Short green bushes of salal and wax myrtle are broken with patches of bright pink wild beach roses basking in the sun, their delicate petals ruffled by a constant breeze.  A shaky rope handrail threaded through the eyes of iron posts assists along the crooked wooden stairs traversing to a black sand beach stretching as far as the eye can see.

Wisps of fog snake along the top of the plateau, sometimes obscuring the narrow path through short green bushes of salal and wax myrtle broken with patches of fragrant wild beach roses.  Small glass-encased lanterns light the way along some crooked wooden stairs guided by a shaky rope handrail threaded through the eyes of iron posts.  Another layer of coastal marine mist wavers overhead, often hiding and revealing an indigo star-filled sky, mimicking the wave activity on the black sand beach below.

title: [Caligos Isle, Toe of Bluff]
description: At the base of the bluff, various heights of the soaring basalt columns that form the base of the plateau have broken off to create seatings providing a commanding view of the dark beach.  Even faint starlight causes a winking glimmer along the length of black sand.  Tall iron stands buried deep into the soil and filled with oil-soaked, rag-wrapped torches light the way just above the high water line.

At the base of the bluff, various heights of basalt columns cluster and soar to form a jagged plateau, many of their once sharp hexagonal edges near-rounded from exposure to high tides, crashing waves, and the elements for eons.  Broken off pieces mound in the sand like fallen logs, littering the immediate beach with seatings providing a commanding view of the beach.  Cold, empty iron stands mark the high water line, their accompanying torches removed during the day.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: Aqueous rivulets of dark indigo sand seep down through tiny fractures in the rocky face of the high cliffs, as though the mountain is crying thick, purple-tinted tears.  Each oozing ribbon of silt joins with the others where the slippery path levels out, forming a wet mire of boot-sucking sludge.  Choosing a safe foothold in the enveloping darkness becomes a trecherous task not suited to the faint-hearted.

Aqueous rivulets of dark indigo sand seep down through tiny fractures in the rocky face of the high cliffs, as though the mountain is crying thick, purple-tinted tears.  Each oozing ribbon of silt joins with the others where the slippery path levels out, forming a wet mire of boot-sucking sludge.

title: [Northern Fortress, Armory]
description: Lining the walls are racks and stands with well-organized arrays of weapons and armor upon them.  Resting beside a well-used vice and an oaken worktable, a barrel of weapon oil stands in one corner of the room.  The room is dimly lit, its only source of light coming from an oil lamp in the far corner of the room.  Set into the southernmost wall next to a large locker is a small shelf.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: A long-abandoned lighthouse waits just offshore, silhouetted in the darkness against the silvery white, moonlit horizon.  Its carved, stone block walls rise sharply from its forgotten perch on a jagged, black shoal.  Centuries of buffeting winds and battering seas have not diminished the fortitude of this silvery grey sentinel to remain at its post, standing guard over no one at all.

A long-abandoned lighthouse waits just offshore, silhouetted against the eastern horizon.  Its carved, stone block walls rise sharply from its forgotten perch on a jagged, black shoal.  Centuries of buffeting winds and battering seas have not diminished the fortitude of this silvery grey sentinel to remain at its post, standing guard over no one at all.

title: [Wrap Yourself]
description: The dark rose stain on the glass windows complements the hue of the ebonwood frames while also muting what natural light filters in.  A series of darkened silver sconces hold flickering candles throughout the room, casting dancing shadows across the merchandise racks and a series of brass hooks.  Dark rose carpet embroidered with swirls of cream and ebony silk spreads across the hardwood floors, terminating at a large hallway.

title: [Wrap Yourself]
description: Forgoing carpet, the smooth ebonwood floors are left bare to complement the wood's natural beauty.  A collection of male mannequins are placed about the room and darkened silver sconces provide lightining for the variety of wares on display.  An archway leads to a parlor in the back.

title: [I Got This]
description: Shafts of moonlight seep through the windows, snaking through the miniscule spaces found between stacks of merchandise that fill the room.  Narrow shadowy walkways allow for navigation among the clutter and no specific organization is present in the chaos of the decor.  Shelves are interspersed in the mess, dotting the walls and peeking out from the haphazardly stacked towers of items.

title: [Savor Your Magic, Stick]
description: Sanded planks of blonde oak are branded with a variety of moons, stars, and celestial markings from one wall to the next.  Draping from a polished globe of brass in the center of the ceiling, swathes of sky blue chiffon billow down and connect in narrow strips to the four corners of the room.  A curved archway is nestled between dual brass racks displaying wares and a glass display case is centerpoint to the entry door.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: Sharp, dead branches from unseen trunks reach out to scratch and threaten any who venture quickly through their midst in the pitch black environs.  Avoiding their grasp could be easier away from the path, but the point of drop-off over the cliff is obscured by both blackness and a churning mantle of fog.

Bent and twisted trunks of long-dead trees reach their pointed branches across the pathway.  Serrated, finger-length thorns reach out threateningly toward any who dare tread too closely, while tiny crimson drops on the narrow path mark their victories against unwary souls who have recently passed this way.

title: [Fried and True, Display Room]
description: Mis-matched boards of various sizes and woods create the walls of the shack, more shipwreck salvation than original design.  The slight scent of wood smoke wafts in from the shuttered windows, rattling slightly with each gust, adding hints of hickory, maple, cherry, and other fragrant flavorings used for the varety of wares on display and for sale here.  One wall features a large yet faded diagram of porcine anatomy, the various cuts marked with dotted lines.

title: [Caligos Isle, Northern Ravine]
description: Constantly rushing air swirls about the ravine as it forcefully pushes its way out of a dark hole in the ground, its tenacious presence causing the miasmic mist and murk to vacate the area.  Deep, bone-jarring sounds, punctuated by an off-key whistle, reverberate off the shale making it difficult to hear anything in this confined space.  Despite the lack of mist, the darkness created by the high, black walls of the ravine make it difficult to see more than a hand's span away.

title: [Caligos Isle, Ravine's Heart]
description: Enormous wrought iron stakes are pounded into the smooth shale wall along the eastern edge of the ravine anchoring a rickety staircase of teak and steel that ascends into mist.  In contrast, the western wall is smooth and slick with water from an unseen force, it's unyielding face blotting out the moonlight.  Along this section of the ravine, the sound of rushing, swirling water collides with the howl of an unseen and unfelt wind.

title: [Caligos Peak, Twisting Inclines]
description: Rollicking mists, limned in silver moonlight, pour over granite shards that encircling the landing and pool in shadowed crevices that pockmark a gloom-filled landscape.  Wind howls through the area as it races past a rickety iron-bound staircase on its way to the inky black depths below.

Shards of blackened granite rise upon either side of an uneven landing, their glossy faces aiding the rollicking mist in shrouding a view of the world below.  Sunlight is stronger at this height, though the shadows run deeper as the golden light is unable to penetrate the various crevices of the pockmarked landscape.  Disappearing into the depths below is a rickety iron-bound staircase.

title: [The Tides That Bind]
description: The entry tunnel opens into a large, smoothly hewn room inside a plateau.  Orderly stone columns supported by wooden beams overhead line the sides of the chamber.  Veins of colorful gemstones line the floor in unorderly patterns, snaking from wall to wall.  Set between two supporting columns is an enruned archway with a carved sapphire keystone.

title: [Caligos Isle, Southern Ravine]
description: Rolling mist, limned with indigo and moonlight, tumbles down the shale walls of the ravine and fills the area with a blanket of dampness that slowly soaks everything it touches.  Gloom and shadows dance around a destroyed flagstone room that is partially fused with the mountain, its high walls and broken windows causing the passing wind to howl and moan.  The sound of running water filters towards a narrow water-slick tunnel in the ground that has a strange light filtering through it.

title: [Caligos Isle, Rockslide]
description: The sloping pathway abruptly ends in a pile of broken rock and sediment.  Barefly visible in the dim light, a rusty copper trident juts out of the debris, broken and mangled from the sheer force of the rockslide.  Where once there was a solid crag, there is now a steep and narrow gully that cuts into the mountainous terrain in a direct line upward.

Where once there was a solid crag, there is now a steep and narrow gully that cuts into the mountainous terrain in a direct line upward.

title: [Caligos Isle, Western Slope]
description: Pale moonlight highlights the abundance of muted grey veins of quartz that snake through the sloping gabbro path.  Emerging from jagged cracks in the uneven ground, plumes of acrid steam obscure much of the surrounding area, creating only a single path for reasonably safe passage.  The rhythmic sound of waves crashing on rocks below is broken only by the occassional shriek from somewhere in the encompassing darkness.

Muted grey veins of quartz snake through the sloping gabbro path.  Emerging from jagged cracks in the uneven ground, plumes of acrid steam obscure much of the surrounding area, creating only a single path for reasonably safe passage.  The cries of sea birds overhead and the crashing of waves upon the rocks below add an eerie musical score to the steam-enveloped slope.

title: [The Write Stuff]
description: Ink stains every available surface on the interior of the wagon.  Wall to wall ink blots, in an assortment of colors, shapes, and sizes, adorn the wooden panels.  The only clean area within the colorful composition is a long glass-topped case, resting proudly in the center of the floor.

title: [Fine Tuning]
description: The layout of the well-lit wagon is simple in design, with an elongated indigo marble case and a glass-faced black coral cabinet placed prominently under opposite windows.  High ceilings are softened by sumptuous fabrics that crown the monir walls, the burled wooden panels washed in jewel-toned hues of sapphire and emerald.

title: [Discreet Edge]
description: The sounds of the outside world are but a din within this dark and quiet tent.  Beside a candelabra thick with days of wax drippings, a pair of mannequins models rather nondescript clothing and armor accessories.  Atop a small leather-topped table, a tastefully scripted note invites your attention.

title: [Discreet Edge, Backroom]
description: Along the surface of a half-circle table, a variety of daggers sits on display.  Their sharpened edges catch the reflected light of the candelabra hanging above head, creating upon their glinting surfaces a chamber concert of metal and flame.
A half-circle table dominates this otherwise unremarkable little room.  A few wobbly boxes face the table, serving as an improvised form of seating.

title: [Caligos Isle, Western Slope]
description: Mostly obscure in the dark, the path solidifes into a hazardous, rocky incline winding its way to higher ground, as opposed to the chaotic mass of scree below.  Beneath the starlight, the mica flecks that so pervade the nearby rocks glitter like a reflection of the night sky.

Curving sharply like a hairpin, the path solidifies into a hazardous, rocky incline winding its way to higher ground, as opposed to the chaotic mass of scree below.  Scraggly weeds sprout from the dark spaces between rocks, drinking in the ample moisture from the humid air.

title: [The Champagne Seller]
description: Against the main wall of this stall, a tall wrought iron rack cradles bottle after bottle of fine champagne.  A tall table, topped with black velvet, displays a variety of accessories for sale, while to the side, a slender pedestal offers some light fare for browsing customers.

title: [Caligos Isle, Couloir]
description: Hemmed in by sheer cliff walls, the couloir is quite narrow, and in conjuction with the steep gradient, passage is harrowing at best.  Unfortunately, the tight space is completely cast in darkness, adding unnecessary degrees of difficulty in navigation.  The only sound audible in this deep mountain gash is the steady howl of rushing air from a windy vortex, punctuated by the occasional scream.

Hemmed in by sheer cliff walls, the couloir is quite narrow, and in conjuction with the steep gradient, passage is harrowing at best.  Unfortunately, sunlight has little reach into this gash in the mountain, casting the tight space completely in shadow.  The steady howl of rushing air from a windy vortex is punctuated by the occasional scream.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Silvery grey mist swirls around the dark shadows of slippery kelp, which produce fey curtains across the granite mountainside that only partially hide a plethora of looming shapes.  Off-kilter pillars, distorted by the moonlight, support a basalt stone lintel above a warped teak door whose edges are limned with golden light from within.  A railing at the edge of the path provides a view of mist-shrouded open air, and the only sound is that of the waves crashing on stone.

Curtains of dark, slippery kelp lay in ropy lengths down the dark mountainside, their constantly dripping, rubbery leaves parted to reveal sculpted architecture that is vaguely elven in origin.  Off-kilter pillars support a lintel that shows signs of recent scrubbing and fresh carvings, though the teak door beneath has clearly seen better days.  The short steps leading to the waterlogged entry fill most of the cobbled pathway and nearly reach the protective railing that borders the cliff's edge.

Silvery grey mist swirls around the dark shadows of slippery kelp, which produce fey curtains across the granite mountainside that only partially hide a plethora of looming shapes.  Off-kilter pillars, distorted by the moonlight, support a warped alder lintel above a warped teak door whose edges are limned with golden light from within.  A railing at the edge of the path provides a view of mist-shrouded open air, and the only sound is that of the waves crashing on stone.

title: [Caligos Pawnshop]
description: Water-warped oak boards run from floor to ceiling, their wavy faces are pockmarked with rusty nails and the seams between are filled with fresh tar.  Dust swings lazily back and forth from the rafters as an exterior breeze invades the shop from the open teak door, while golden light pools upon the distorted floorboards from lanterns hung to either side of a few crooked stone steps that lead into the backroom.  A hollow manatee skull hangs over the counter and creates shadows upon the smooth surface.

title: [Caligos Pawnshop, Stockroom]
description: Brightly glowing lanterns frame a few crooked stone steps that lead up into the main shop and do little to dispel the general gloom in the corners of this somewhat tidy room.  Four tables displaying armor, weapons, arcane items, and miscellaneous treasures are arranged neatly, but these are the only things new about the space.  The heavy, musty odors of age, mildew, and water damage fill the air.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Descending from high above and disappearing deep into the cobblestone path, a large ragged fissure cracks the black mountain's face and is filled with grooved brain coral that emits a soft glow in the silvery moonlight that pierces the pervading mist.  Protrusions of dark, spongy seaweed fingers spill forth from between the rock wall, its inhabitants completely blanketing the area in its prolific growth.

Descending from high above and disappearing deep into the cobblestone path, a large ragged fissure cracks the black mountain's face and is filled with grooved brain coral that emits a soft glow in the murky sunlight.  Protrusions of dark, spongy seaweed fingers spill forth from between the rock wall, its inhabitants completely blanketing the area in its prolific growth.

title: [Upsy Daisy's]
description: Silhouettes of passersby drift across a starburst glass-paned wall.  Glimpses of stars can be seen overhead, obstructed occasionally by passing swirls of mist.   Some planters and baskets holding various flora are arranged throughout, while a mud-splattered sign located on a small sales counter sits near the entrance.  A framed doorway leads to a conjoined space, perhaps a small work or storage area.

Light filters in through each glass-paned wall as well as from the ceiling overhead, obstructed occasionally by passing swirls of mist.   Some planters and baskets holding various flora are arranged throughout, while a mud-splattered sign located on a small sales counter sits near the entrance.  A framed doorway leads to a conjoined space, perhaps a small work or storage area.

title: [Upsy Daisy's, Potting Shed]
description: The interior of the small potting shed is awash in competing aromas...jasmine, gardenia, tea rose, loamy soil and even a bit of manure.  Some well worn wooden tables crowd the small space, each scattered with an assortment of gardening tools and plants in different stages of growth.  Several gardening texts and empty containers are stacked haphazardly beneath the tables.  A small wash basin rests in one corner.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Eerie green lights illuminate the silvery mist that flows through the area, the source a strange bioluminescent coral that climbs the side of the dark, shale mountain.  Wind howls through the area and brings with it the acrid scent of salt and the crushing sound of waves slamming into stone.

Wind whistles past the wrought iron railing that encircles the edge of the cliff, its ethereal tendrils bringing with it the salty scent of the ocean and the sound of crashing waves.  Mist darkens the view of anything more than a few feet beyond the edge and spirals about the cobblestone pathway in tiny, twisting swirls.  Bioluminescent coral, roughly resembling the shape and size of red lettuce leaves, climbs the face of the shale mountainside and lends the area a strange off-green hue.

title: [Faded and Desiccated]
description: The leather panels of a Tehir-styled pavilion hide the walls in this small building, complete with short strings of amber beads hanging from the roof.  A three-flamed oil lamp on a spindly brass stand fills the room with light and the scent of sandalwood, while a layer of furs covers whatever floor lies underfoot.  Near the oil lamp, a cedar display stand occupies the shop's center, a small table sits to one side, and an armor rack stands near the back wall.

title: [The Sorcerial Sartorial]
description: Large blocks of cut stone form the walls of this sizeable structure, their surfaces bearing the faint chisel-marks of recent attempts to remove every trace of enveloping coral.  Even the slate floorstones show signs of being newly renovated, with traces of fine white powder still evident in the deeper cracks and crevices.  Lit by several brass lanterns, the shop's wrought iron table and shelves look newly made and their placement almost arbitrary, while the back wall has been given over to a set of wrought iron hooks and a small brass display stand

Large blocks of cut stone form the walls of this sizeable structure, their surfaces bearing the faint chisel-marks of recent attempts to remove every trace of enveloping coral.  Even the slate floorstones show signs of being newly renovated, with traces of fine white powder still evident in the deeper cracks and crevices.  Lit by several brass lanterns, the shop's wrought iron table and shelves look newly made and their placement almost arbitrary, while the back wall has been given over to a set of wrought iron hooks and a polished brass display rack

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Thick and viscous, the mist strangles the area with its dank tendrils and its blanketing dampness.  Water drips from several bands of paddle weed that are imbedded in the cobbles of the path, their green leaves glimpsed briefly as the gloom sporadically parts to emit the moonlight from above.   Dark shadows play upon the crumbled remains of a crumbled flagstone tower in the distance, while a ragged shale outcropping is surrounded by echoing winds and voluminous darkness.

Ragged outcroppings of shale and flagstone swallow a wrought iron railing that encircles the pathway, their ragged protrusions blocking the view of the distant ocean and scenery.  Twining bands of paddle weed spread their dark green leaves through the area, their hairy roots clutching at the cobblestones to soak up any spare moisture they can find.  The crumbled remains of a tower, its base buried in the stone, rises roofless into the distance and creates darker shadows upon the mountain slag.

title: [The Third Eye]
description: Witch-balls, suspended from the ceiling by bits of twine, dangle at varying lengths, their candle-lit bodies spilling a golden glow upon the refurbished floorboards.  Recesses carved into the granite walls display a variety of wares under the watchful eye of a young giantwoman.  Near the back of the shop, a coin-edged velvet curtain provides entry to a backroom.

title: [Caligos Isle, Hollow Ridge]
description: Darkened sea caves rise like crookedly bent fingers from the gleaming waters that surround a wide expanse of mottled phosphorus rock.  Sections of the geographical lacework brood overhead, the arcing stippled curvatures touched with sheer moonbeams in their circular hollows.  Opaque silver-grey fog clings in heavy bands about the ridge, slowly drifting outward to the rippling ocean.

title: [Caligos Isle, Basin Caves]
description: The rocky landscape slopes downward into the belly of some high-appointed sea caves deeply eroded into the precipitous mountainside.  Pale salt striations paint tenuous, wavy designs upon the back walls, tattooed by fluctuating water levels through the ages.  An impressive view of the far-reaching blue-black ocean unravels before the eyes, winding its way free from the low-hanging trenches of dense silver fog.

title: [Caligos Isle, Overlook]
description: Lustrous black seawaters cradle the entire stone structure with harsh waves crashing against the craggy basin below.  Shards of phosphorite and flagstone have been stamped into a narrow pathway along the fractured ridges climbing the bowed back of the cave.  A particularly prominent circlet of gnarled rock caps the highest stony spire, filtering the ambient breezes that whip through the heartstopping viewpoint.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Twisted tangles of kelp are knotted around the ink black trunk of an ancient leafless oak, its slick face swollen from years of watery submersion.  Dimly glowing lanterns turn their eerily illuminated faces to the unevenly cobbled street that rings the mountain, while long shadows fall upon the railings that prevent a plunge into the depths below.  Disjointed pillars are pockmarked with thousands of dehydrated acorn barnacles, yet still manage to provide support for a slanted lintel that stands guard over a wrought iron-hinged door.

title: [Caligos Bank]
description: Arranged at an angle to two water-stained walls, a driftwood counter and a painted wooden sign beside it seem to be the focal point of the long, rectangular room that is cloyingly filled with an acrid scent of seawater and rotting vegetation.  Scrub marks are deeply gouged into the floorboards, evidence that someone attempted to reduce the stench and stains, and several lanterns dangling from above are arranged in close groupings in an effort to keep the bank's corners in shadows.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Parting from the mountain's face and rising high into the air, a grey and ivory flagstone tower casts its long shadow across the pathway and plunges the area into a murky darkness suffused with silvery moonlight.  Water streams down the face of the cliff, creating deep rivulets in the cobblestones and moves swiftly enough to carry bits of shale and sand with it.  Clumps of seaweed-infested ground display signs of erosion near the wrought iron railing that prevents passersby from tumbling over the edge.

title: [Glittering Sands]
description: Heavy velvet curtains have been hung over the windows and open doorway in an attempt to conserve what is left of the crumbling walls.  Large amounts of sand have infiltrated the neglected structure, covering the entirety of the floor.  A splintered door has been lodged into one of the more sizeable dunes creating a makeshift table.  Stray beams of light filter in through cracks in the ceiling illuminating the wares that have been displayed on a frayed net.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Dim light invades the mist-shrouded landscape, its source, several shuttered windows high up the dark face of the black shale cliff.  Sharp angles and severe lines lend depth to the imposing shadows that surround a carved stone tavern that is carved into the very mountainside.  The uneven pathway is slick with plant life that is partially hidden in the murk of the night.

title: [Siren's Call Tavern, Entry]
description: In rustic display, water-darkened beams brace the ceiling, and a brass-framed lamp dangles at each joint.  A crossed pair of ancient eel spears are mounted overhead, anchored against a backdrop of fishing nets draped in shallow swathes from the beams.  Underfoot, golden oak planks, buffed and highly polished, traverse the length of the tavern and reflect the illumination of the lamps in a gilded haze.

title: [Tricky Treats]
description: Bits of dried seaweed, black coral, and mollusk are still stuck to the walls, and a long counter made from various pieces of driftwood divides the room.  Shelving along the walls holds a variety of foodstuffs, while behind the counter is cooking space.  Tables, ovens, and stoves are staged behind the counter for the preperation of the wares.

Bits of dried seaweed, black coral and mollusks are still stuck to the walls, and a long counter made from various driftwood divides the room.  Shelving along the walls holds a variety of foodstuffs, while behind the a driftwood counter is cooking space.  Tables, ovens, and stoves are staged behind the counter for the preparation of the wares.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Built into the dark shale face, the corner of a building juts out from the mountain wall causing the cobbled pathway to circumvent its chipped steps.  Cage lanterns are anchored to either side of a pair of teak double doors that allow entry into the dark edifice, while the brown thatching above shows signs of new molds and lichens growing in their depths.  Goose barnacles cling in clusters to the manmade walls, the constant drip of their wriggling bodies filling the air.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Foyer]
description: A pair of sooted lanterns flank the entryway, casting amber illumination in puddles on the floor, though the high-arching ceiling remains in darkness.  Ahead, the path slopes upward, trailed by a carpeted runner that is threadbare in spots and faded in its entirety.  Several small niches are set into the walls at varying heights, and the uneven staggering gives the entryway a slightly off-balance feel.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Plateau]
description: Tendrils of chilly mist slip through the area and twine their way about the colonies of staghorn coral that stretch from varying heights in the shale wall and cast long shadows upon the pathway.  Dim lights attempt to part the gloom as they slip free of windows carved into the very face of the mountain.

title: [Siren's Call Tavern, Bar]
description: A mild hint of wood varnish lingers in the air, mingled with the aroma of dark ale, spirits, and the twang of cigar smoke.  Centered on the back wall is a carved teak bar, and over it hangs a tremendous circular mirror behind glass shelves illuminated in wan jewel-toned hues.  Suede-cushioned stools sit beneath the edge of the counter, which is topped with clean-shaded lamps at intervals.  A narrow stairway leads up to the mezzanine.
