title: [Siren's Call, Mezzanine]
description: Open to the tavern's interior on one side and the downward slope of the mountain on the other, the mezzanine is buffeted by cool, soft breaths of air stirred by waves breaking on the shore far below.  Half of the sheltering overhang is an outcropping of rock, while the rest is a retractable oilcloth canopy in a deep shade of blue.  Each of the canopy's supports are moored in sculpted stone planters carved out from the rocky floor.  A narrow stairway leads down to the bar.

title: [Siren's Call, Covered Portico]
description: From a reservoir seated in the chiseled stone floor, water rises through a smoky-hued sphere of crackled glass and courses over its smooth surface, burbling softly as it trickles into the pool at the base.  Shadows play within the depths of the sphere, light trapped, stirred, and sent dancing outward as the water continues in its ceaseless journey.  Tall iron braziers stand between each lancet window that rings this circular space, lending a touch of warmth to the cool bestowed by the stone and sea.

title: [Siren's Call, Mezzanine]
description: The faint lull of a melody drifts in from the tavern proper, and the small glaesine orbs strung beneath the canopy sway in time, set in motion by subtle sea breezes.  From the planter anchoring the canopy's support pole, clusters of coralbell splay upward, interspersed with delicate stalks of purple agapanthus.  Set near the carved stone railing of the mezzanine are a pair of granite benches.

title: [Siren's Call, Mezzanine]
description: Trailed along the railing of the mezzanine is a dark green-leafed vine, laden with clusters of coral honeysuckle blossoms, their deep crimson coloring stark against the grey of the stone.  The ambient noise of the tavern is but a whisper here, largely muted beneath the hushed roar of crashing waves.  In the distance, the note of a ship's bell tolls, though its source is lost within the mists shrouding the sea.

title: [Siren's Call, Covered Portico]
description: A truncated set of steps rises into the seclusion of this tower, which is ringed by stone benches and a trio of lancet windows that look out onto the sea.  In the center of the floor is a shallow pit heaped with a rounded pile of glowing embers, which impart a subtle warmth to the surrounding stone.  At the fringes of the smoldering heap are half-burned bundles of herbs and flowers.

title: [Caligos Isle, Harborview]
description: The view of the night sea appears somewhat calm from this vantage point, with a small protected harbor just below.  Upon its dark and glassy surface, tiny lights come into view with each lifting of the indigo fog.  Bobbing up and down with the incoming waves, they are swallowed back into obscurity as the fog descends yet again.

The view of the western sea appears somewhat calm from this vantage point, with a small protected harbor just below.  Upon its deep blue, glassy surface, small fishing vessels come into view with each lifting of the indigo fog.  Bobbing up and down with the incoming waves, they are swallowed back into obscurity as the fog descends yet again.

title: [Wench Wear]
description: Bundles of dried flowers cover the peeling walls, overwhelming the small space with the scent of jasmine and lavender.  The only reprieve from the stifling odor is a small hole in the ceiling that allows fresh air and natural light to filter in.  A rope ladder falls through the small hole and dangles above a low-set clothing rack.  Two mannequins, one male and one female, have been posed on the only seat in the wagon, their arms tangled together in an awkward embrace.

title: [The Hattery]
description: A thick oak beam runs high overhead supporting the roof of the pavilion, with burnished bronze lamps hanging from it on invar chains.  Rich burgundy ramie silks form the interior walls, appearing lustrous and sleek in the flickering lamp light.  A polished cherrywood table stands atop the plush velvet rug in the center of the room.

title: [Fantabulous]
description: Scratched tanik wood boards line the floor of the wagon, covered in part by a bright red rug.  A long linden table stands against one wall, while a heavy oak stand sits against the opposite wall.
Scratched tanik wood boards line the wagon's floor, covered in part by a bright red rug.  A long linden table stands against one wall, while a heavy oak stand sits against the opposite wall.

title: [Caligos Isle, Healer's Hut]
description: Cots of thick, dried grass lay close to the sandy ground in the confines of this thatchwork tent, providing makeshift respite for the infirmed.  From within a small, dug out firepit, wide bundles of sage release their wafting, pungent aromatics into the air.  A small driftwood cabinet off to the side is stacked with plates, cups, food, and brews.  A seeping indigo-grey mist continuously winds itself around every object in the hut, periodically gathering itself near a large bloodstain in one corner.

title: [Caligos Isle, Courtyard]
description: A desolate and withered garden occupies the entirety of the courtyard.  The air is stale and fetid, and the reek of standing water perfumes the air.  In the center of an otherwise stagnant pool, a single spring bubbles erratically several inches above the surface of the murky water.  Cracked and chipped walls are painted with faded seascapes, each prominently featuring a blackened coiled sea creature.

title: [Caligos Isle, Western Slope]
description: As steep as it is dark, this rocky slope is difficult to traverse without sending loose debris skittering off into the darkness.   The occasional distant *plop* is the only way to tell which steep side leads down to the black sea below.  Waves battering themselves against the rocky coastline drown out the rest of the area's prevalent nocturnal noises.

The steep climb inherent on this rocky slope is difficult to traverse without sending loose debris skittering off into the distance.   The occasional *plop* indicates yet another rock that has met a watery grave in the black sea below.  Waves battering themselves against the rocky coastline drown out all but the most insistent cries of sea birds and the bellowing of a group of male sea lions.

Perched roughly fifty feet above the water's surface and twenty feet out from the main path, this slender outcropping provides access to one of the few sections of the surrounding sea that is not hampered by hazardous rocks.  With no security barriers to prevent a fall, the precarious perch offers no protection from high winds or walking mishaps and is not for the faint of heart.

title: [Seaside Grotto]
description: A circle of boulders surrounds a small fire, the glow of which reflects off the gem-inset canvas wall coverings, causing radiant flashes of light to flit throughout the cave.  Posed atop the stones is a pod of colorful mermaids, each holding a large anemone blossom.  Despite the flowers, the cavern still holds the stale odor of decaying fish.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Promontory]
description: In those rare moments when the fog lifts from the area, the view of the western sea is nothing short of spectacular from this promontory outcropping of basalt.  Peering down, however, is ill-advised for the faint of heart, as the drop-off is steep and the surface of the churning water is a long way down.  A long length of knotted hemp rope dissappears over the side of the cliff, and a plank and chain ladder vanishes upwards, all but lost in the thick, grey mist rolling down from the higher peaks.

title: [Caligos Isle, Junder's Base]
description: Dark boulders edging the coastline far below appear like fragments of smoldering coal, and wisps of white fog curl upward to a thick cloud just above the towering obelisk's midpoint.  A piercing whistle trails in the wake of gusts through the ladder rungs above, leaving a hypnotic melody lingering in the dense fog.

title: [Caligos Isle, Junder's Midway]
description: Brisk winds coil around the basalt outcropping like a serpent around its prey, threatening to deplete the available air in an instant.  Thick fog sodden with sea spray veils the view, though the sound of immense waves crashing against the rocks below is good indication to hang on tightly to the ladder rungs.  Peeking through occasional breaks in the mist-laden cloud is a sloped ledge, though what lies beyond is not visible.

title: [Caligos Isle, Junder's Peak]
description: Bursting through a heavy blanket of mist and fog, the island's landscape emerges, a rare sight from one of the few outlook points on the island.  Deep indigo waters ring the island and lead to a vast sea beyond, with no landmarks or distant coastlines to guide travel.  Despite a thin middle section, a large platform lies at the top of this naturally formed tower, its trunk possibly diminished by unforgiving winds.

title: [The Hattery]
description: Large silk rugs woven with patterns of gold and white whorls cover the ground and provide a soft, yet firm, footing.  A golden oak table stands along one wall with a grey linen runner spanning its length.  Sitting flush against the far silk wall is a curved pearwood display.  An imflass chain curtain leads into the rear of the pavilion.

title: [Fantabulous]
description: A thick orange rug covers most of the battered tanik boards that form the floor.  A low heavy maoral shelf lines one wall, while a plain applewood rack flanks the other.  A battered invar hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [Caligos Isle, Boneyard Garden]
description: A solid wall of etched stone surrounds this derelict clearing.  Malignant, low hanging fog creates a ceiling of dripping miasma that coats everything in a noisome mist.  Beneath a malformed cocobolo tree lie the shards of tiny, broken headstones, inscribed not with names, but with crude, childlike drawings of small animals.

title: [Caligos Isle, Mire]
description: A cloying fog laced with deep indigo tendrils hovers over the rough terrain.  Jagged, lichen-covered boulders block descent to the sea below but create a sufficient breaker for unrelenting waves that threaten to overwhelm the surrounding land.  A crystal clear pool has formed in the shadow of towering rock, and underfoot, slurping sounds of fleshy muck is suggestive that one should not linger.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cliff Trail]
description: Several tenacious vines have taken hold in the uneven rock.  Moonlight highlights the rugged surfaces with its shadowy cracks and crevices, and they faintly resemble faces, their visages twisted as if trapped in eternal agony within the stone.  Three pairs of blinking eyes wink in and out of existence along the northern slope in the distance.

Several tenacious vines have taken hold in the uneven rock with its shadowy cracks and crevices.  Looking beyond the foliage, the rugged surfaces faintly resemble faces, their visages twisted as if trapped in eternal agony within the stone.  The remainder of the northern slope continuing into the distance is obscured by swirling silvery-grey fog.

title: [The Glass Slipper]
description: Swathes of silvery sea silk are draped from sunbleached driftwood branches forming an open-air pergola.  Moonlight filters through a tangle of verdant vines and tropical blossoms woven throughout a trellis overhead, the salt-scented breeze creating an intoxicating aroma as the sea air rustles the fragrant petals.  Wares are sorted into wicker baskets, and wooden trunks are thrown open, displaying the goods within.

title: [The Ramshackle Hen House]
description: Painted boards are haphazardly thrown together with bits of twine and a smattering of nails to form the walls of this cramped hen house.  Tiers of screen-covered coups rise upon the left and right, each filled with dirty bits of straw, feathers, and discarded egg shells.  The low ceiling provides scant illumination for the tight quarters, which is probably why a small mud-smudged sign has been left near the entrance.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cliff Trail]
description: A stagnant pool sits beneath a rocky overhang covered in a sickly orange-green slime.  The accumulated moisture oozes down the slime formation, leaving miscolored droplets underfoot.  The occasional unseen figures journeying in the darkness cause a strange crunching sound as they pass.

Large and small boulders, arranged in a haphazard pile and covered in a sickly orange-green slime, stand out along the edge of tenacious foliage that struggles for dominion over the area.  A stagnant pool sits beneath, its accumulated moisture oozing down the slime formation and leaving discolored droplets in its wake.  A collection of unoccupied snail shells litters the pathway, crunching underfoot as any pass by.

title: [Professional Courtesy]
description: The sheer size of this pavilion is staggering, its peaked canopy held aloft by a structured series of wooden support beams and poles.  Strings of multi-hued paper lanterns are draped overhead, the soft light filtering through the shades taking on a variety of jewel-toned hues.  From the apex of the center peak of the pavilion hangs a spoked directional guide, with each wrought iron arrow supporting a small sign.

title: [Quiver and Release]
description: A variety of feathers hang from hemp strings along the walls of the wagon, accounting for a vast array of bird species, while aging parchments pressed beneath glass offer instruction on various fletching methods.  A tightly woven wicker basket sits at the corner of one of the rugs cushioning the floor of the wagon, and a slim metal-framed case sits beneath a wall-length peg board.  Glass-shaded lamps filled with amber oil are lit to shed ample light across the wares.

title: [The Glass Slipper, Alcove]
description: Secluded behind a veil of turquoise silks, an airy alcove offers shade and respite.  A row of cushioned chairs partially conceals an open crate, while a dye-splattered tub peeks out from behind a curtain made from seashells strung on translucent silk strands.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cliff Trail]
description: The path narrows here, and beyond the edge lies a steep dropoff where tiers of hexagonal basalt columns present evidence of the dire consequences of falling.  Steam rises between the stone pillars in grey tendrils, the moisture collecting on the uneven rock face.  The bleached-white skeletal remains of a few sea birds scattered atop the black basalt columns have been picked clean and glitter almost picturesquely in the moonlight.

The path narrows here, and beyond the edge lies a steep dropoff where tiers of hexagonal basalt columns present evidence of the dire consequences of falling.  Steam rises between the stone pillars in grey tendrils, the moisture collecting on the uneven rock face.  Black-headed gulls circle overhead, dropping shells onto the the broken basalt columns.  Their piercing cries dissipate in the wind as they dive to retrieve their succulent prizes.

title: [At Face Value]
description: Thick, blue smoke hovers near the curved ceiling, the aroma of pipe tobacco clinging to the wares displayed in wire baskets suspended from large metal hooks affixed to the rafters.  Stocked shelves line the wall behind a heavily lacquered countertop piled high with unopened boxes and string-wrapped packages.  A small lantern sputters atop a low table next to an overstuffed chair in one corner, an ancient-looking tabby cat curled up on a worn footstool nearby.

title: [Quiver and Release]
description: On a stained and scarred workbench, a myriad of sharp tools sit in neat rows along one side, while small glass jars of paint line the other side.  A padded stool sits nearby, and hanging from the rafters in the back is an empty birdcage.

On a stained and scarred workbench, a myriad of sharp tools sit in neat rows along one side, while small glass jars of paint line the other side.  A padded stool sits nearby, and hanging from the rafters in the back is an empty birdcage.  Just beyond the workbench is a small round door with a brass knob set into the rear wall.

title: [Caligos Isle, Northern Passage]
description: A massive, distorted skull looms overhead, the steam vents lying beneath it lending an unearthly semblance of life as sulphorous vapor streams through its vacant eye sockets.  Stringy kelp dangles from its jagged teeth with a scattering of fish bones on the ground below, remnants of the creature's last meal.

title: [A Head Above Water, Showroom]
description: Thin frames of gilt-painted linen border vellum screens cut out with hundreds of minute stars, the celestial scene illuminated by small glass lanterns strewn about the wagon.  A circular crystal-covered case sits within the center of the room, the container encircled by a rack of silvered haon carved into a series of moons.

title: [Whimsical Wares, Showroom]
description: Ombre-dyed sheets of raw linen decorate the walls of the wagon, providing a colorful backdrop for a flora-carved bamboo rack and a matching bronze-riveted chest.  Vellum lanterns are hung at various intervals, each painted with a variety of calligraphic swirls and flourishes.

title: [Higher Thinking]
description: The main showroom of this quickly built shop is packed with goods for sale.  Near the interior of the door, a stack of unopened crates lies in wait to replenish the items as customers mingle and supplies grow low.  On a low-set rafter, a small tapestry is hung depicting in colorful detail various symbols of the pantheon of Elanthian Arkati.  A short glass display occupies the eastern wall, while a sturdy shelf has been built cater-cornered in the northwest part of the room.

title: [Caligos Isle, Northern Passage]
description: Lying along the edge of the plateau is the spine of some enormous sea creature, its monstrous ribcage resting on the debris-strewn path like an eerie ossified arcade.  The bones gleam a ghostly white in the moonlight, a faint echo of the life they once held.

Lying along the edge of the plateau is the spine of some enormous sea creature, its monstrous ribcage resting on the debris-strewn path like an eerie ossified arcade.  The bones gleam a ghostly white in the moonlight, a faint echo of the life they once held.  A winding sandy trail descends into a jungle of new growth, disappearing as it passes a felled tree darkened with necrosis.

Lying along the edge of the plateau is the spine of some enormous sea creature, its monstrous ribcage resting on the debris-strewn path like an eerie ossified arcade.  Giant petrels occasionally perch atop the ribs as a vantage point on opportunities to feed.  A winding sandy trail descends into a jungle of new growth, disappearing as it passes a felled tree darkened with necrosis.

title: [The Walrus and The Carpenter]
description: Displaying an obvious contrast in design, the canvas-covered room is divided in two along the lines of a large knotted oak support post.  Upon the western side, the room is filled with cabinets and carved tables that show a distinct artisan's touch, while the eastern side is riddled with barnacle-laced cupboards and counters that are waterlogged and warped.  A brightly illuminated flap leads northwest and stands opposite a plain, dimly light opening.

title: [Higher Thinking]
description: The smooth, unevenly spaced driftwood that comprise the walls of this poorly constructed shack give evidence in both sight and smell of ages spent in or near the swelling sea; indeed, bits of sand and dried muck cling desperately to the occasional dent in the wood of several of the logs.  Through gaps in the walls, you hear waves crashing eternally in rhythm with the unabating buzzing of big bugs.  The ground below is formed of a mixture of crushed seashells, sand, and other unidentifable substances.

title: [Higher Thinking, Loft]
description: Through wide gaps in the wooden planks of the floor, you notice patrons milling about and overhear their soft chatter as they examine their wares.  The walls of the room, comprised entirely of driftwood, are awkwardly shaped, the constant sea breeze occasionally wafting through the gaps in their structure.  A fine layer of sawdust, evidence of the building's recent construction, convers every surface in this space.

title: [Caligos Isle, Northeast Vantage]
description: A skeletal tree clings to a nearby ledge, a rotting ship's wheel lodged securely within the grasp of its spindly branches.  Beneath its distorted shadow cast through a radiant moon, a cave mouth gapes like an open wound in the rock face.

A skeletal tree clings to a nearby ledge, a rotting ship's wheel lodged securely within the grasp of its spindly branches.  Beneath its distorted shadow, a cave mouth gapes like an open wound in the rock face.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cavern Entrance]
description: The darkened tunnel opens up into an enormous cavern, the malformed limestone columns casting ominous shadows as their forms flicker against the iron-mounted torches scattered along the area.  Mirror-like pools conceal the true size of the area, flanking an uneven path that curves further down into the depths of the cavern.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cavern Tunnel]
description: Mismatched rows of stalactites drape diagonally along the rock-laden path, the icicle-like formations creating tapered conduits for the droplets of water that mix with the dusty floor below.  A small line of footprints has been imprinted into the muddy puddles, disappearing entirely before the trail ends.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cavern Split]
description: Various sounds amplify within the expansive chamber, the flap of unseen wings drowned out by the screech of grinding rock against rock.  Thin steam vents create a curtain of vapor that obscures the offshoots along the grey-cast cavern, each vent exploding into a crescendo of hissing.

title: [Caligos Isle, Dank Tidepools]
description: Black sands stretch across the cave floor, the soft grains incredibly fine and iridescent, while high above, the rough ceiling is covered in purple algae that is speckled with white.  Pacing between an iron-bound warped oak chest and a jagged-edged dark crevasse, a barefoot pale human child watches the ocean water that aggressively laps at the shore.  Dangling between torches set into the roughened wall, a knotted hemp rope provides access to the cavern above.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [The Carpenter's Cozy]
description: Braided rugs, slightly lumpy where the cover the sand, are spread throughout the small room that is encircled by pressed canvas walls.  Wrought iron lanterns, three in total, shed light upon the tables, that they are hung over, and the nearby chairs fashioned of broken ship's wheels.  Passage into the other areas of the pavilion are cleared for easy navigation.

title: [The Walrus' Whim]
description: Jagged shale rocks jut up from the sandy floor and create an uneven terrain to traverse, which is odd in this small space that is surrounded by thick canvas walls.  Bowls of oil and fire illuminate everything in sight, including the half-desiccated carcass of some forgotten sea creature near the eastern edge of the pavilion.  A large flat-topped boulder blocks the path between the western and southwestern egresses.

title: [The Proprietor's Backroom]
description: Disheveled sand meets tidy rugs along the backside of the pavilion, the two proprietors' personalities clearly clashing in this small space.  The eastern edge appears to be filled with storage boxes, discarded traps, and fishing nets, while the opposite side houses an orderly workbench with clean tools spaced at even intervals.  The southern wall of the pavilion plays host to a very large painting surrounded by a frame carved with decorative oyster shells.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: Eerie, high-pitched shrieks are carried in on chilled sea breezes from the blackened waters below, their clarity distorted as the vorteces of swirling winds collide with upcurrents of sulfurous steam.  Though the origin of the plaintive cries is impossible to determine, they at least to identify the direction of the steep dropoff toward the rocks below, hidden in the fog enshrouded darkness.

Black-headed frigatebirds circle overhead, gliding by on outstreched wings of enormous size.  Where the updraft from the eastern sea meets the fierce winds coming off the plateau, the turbulent gusts lend an extra touch of treachery to the steep and slippery slope of loose, wet rock.

title: [Witch Way]
description: A thick, rusted iron pole set deep into the ground in the middle of the area supports the torn, poor quality material comprising the tent's walls, which periodically buckle and sway under the pressure of the breeze outside.  The room itself is strangely dark, perhaps under the effects of some enchantment.  Near a narrow opening in the fabric of one wall leading out stands a single thin torch with a pale blue flame, scarcely illuminating the contents of the shop.  A scrawled note, barely visible in the gloomy room, is

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: Thin, jagged shards of broken rock mark the only egress here, with a steep slope nearly connecting the high plateau above with the encircling pathway below.  The melodic sounds of a distant lute drift downward from a covered portico above, but are nearly drowned out by the crashing of waves upon rock from the eastern exposure.  The nocturnal fauna lend an eerie accompaniment to the distant melody with croaking, chirping, and hissing.

Thin, jagged shards of broken rock mark the only egress here, with a steep slope nearly connecting the high plateau above with the encircling pathway below.  Sounds of clinking glassware and muted conversations drift downward from a covered portico above, but are nearly drowned out by the crashing of waves upon rock and the incessant squawking of seabirds on the wing from the eastern exposure.

title: [Down the Gullet]
description: Occasional swirls of silvery mist crawl across the dark rock ground, obscuring sandy footprints.  Ragged canvas sailcloth has been draped over an arched wooden frame.  Several wooden boxes and packing crates are stacked near the front area of the tent, while a large woven tapestry divides the space leading to a separate, more secluded area.

title: [Down the Gullet Toasting Room]
description: A large makeshift table surrounded by empty casks for seating takes up most of the space here.  A single lantern provides minimal light for a long and detailed notice that is posted on the back wall of the tent.  Swirls of silvery mist occasionally creep under the edges of the tent and tapestry to swim around the base of the table before fading away.

title: [The Old One-Two, Entry]
description: Whitewashed walls of polished oak encircle the tiny room, the north and south panels are interrupted by an unadorned exit and a curtained archway.  Silvery moonlight brightens the entries and creates a soft nimbus upon the brown rug and dark oak table that rest at the center of the space.  Brightly illuminated glass globes are hung within each corner, their cheery flames casting shadows upon the ceiling.

Whitewashed walls of polished oak encircle the tiny room, the north and south panels are interrupted by an unadorned exit and a curtained archway.  Sunlight streams through the openings and spills in circles upon the brown rug and dark oak table that occupy the center of the space.  At each corner, frosted glass globes lay dormant and forgotten.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eastern Slope]
description: Scattered fish skeletons, many with flesh still clinging to the bones and dorsal fins, litter the ground beside the steep and narrow path.  A pair of loggerheads can be glimpsed through the darkness, pinned between boulders a short distance away.   One remains upright, as though it might free itself and walk away, while the other is overturned, the scavenged plastron guarding its belly riddled with holes and oozing liquids.  A nauseating stench of decomposition lifts only briefly with passing night winds.

The nauseating stench of decaying vegetation lifts only briefly with each passing sea breeze.

title: [Savor Your Magic, Parchment]
description: Pale ivory chiffon is draped from corner to corner of each wall and affixed to the wall with tiny brass flowers.  A large carpet in dual tones of midnight blue and azure stretches across the oak flooring and an ornamental case stands in it's center.  Several ivory display cases dot one wall, while a sleek silvery silk settee takes up another.

title: [Savor Your Magic, Charms]
description: Swathes of ink black chiffon cascade from polished brass rods to drape over each wall.  Silvery pinpoints of crystal glitter on the ceiling in a display of constellations, each one winking in and out as flickering brass sconces illuminate the area.  A broad ivory rug cradles a trio of onyx cases as the centerpiece of the room.

title: [The Old One-Two, Handware]
description: Brass and glass display cases line the walls of the tidy room, their polished surfaces reflecting in the candlelight.  Bright blue walls provide a sharp contrast to the dark brown floor and ceiling, while standing candelabras hold court amongst stools in the corners.  A dark brown archway provides egress and allows fresh air to permeate the windowless space.

title: [The Old One-Two, Footware]
description: Chainsil curtains decorate the three windows within this small room, their sashes flung wide to allow the night air in.  Twin mannequins act as sentries upon either side of shelves, while a pair of divans provides seating for weary customers.  A brightly illuminated chandelier hangs from the ceiling, its delicate crystals reflecting the light in rainbow patterns upon the floor.

Twin humanoid forms act as sentries upon either side of shelves, while a pair of divans provides seating for weary customers.  A dormant chandelier hangs from the ceiling, its delicate crystal pieces chiming softly at sporadic intervals.

title: [Fried and True, Private Area]
description: Shuttered windows guarded with slats of naturally dark blue thanot hinged with iron fittings and pulls are closed to keep out the cold air and ensure the room is cozy.  A small, rusted iron, potbellied stove, warmth radiating through the closed grate through which fiery coals glow, features a petite indigo tin kettle hanging from a crude hook fastened to the smoke pipe disappearing out a hole in the roof.  A small, disassembled hammock drapes close to a wall, stuffed with a pillow and blanket.

title: [Caligos Peak, Twisted Pathways]
description: Twisting in and out of granite shadows where the mountain's peak blots out every ounce of moonlight, the incline of the pathway is treacherous, slippery, and overflowing with indigo-hued mists.  Gusting winds lash at the ground causing grit and sand to sting the eyes, while the ethereal tendrils of water vapor twist and turn like waves in a storm.

Gusting winds lash at the ground causing grit and sand to sting the eyes, while the ethereal tendrils of water vapor twist and turn like waves in a storm.

title: [Caligos Peak, Ravaged Entry]
description: Curving sharply away from the edge, the path suddenly opens up to a small landing that is blasted smooth by some elemental force.  Deeply stained marks trace their forgotten history along the granite, while pebbles clatter along the even floor before being hurled through the air by the raging winds.  Indigo and silver mist dominates the area and seems to emanate from within a ravaged stone entry.

title: [Ruined Structure, Entry]
[Reconstructed Temple, Entry]
[Temple, Entry]
[Granite Temple, Entry]
description: Holes in the structure's ceiling gape like yawning maws and offer glimpses of the sky, while what little remains appears precariously close to collapse.  To one side of the walkway is a tangle of iron that might once have been something decorative but now looks like little more than a knotted mass of petrified eels.  All around, the ruins are in a state of utter destruction and chaos.

Just over the threshold is a stack of crates with tufts of straw protruding from their seams, and an iron pry bar rests askew atop them.  Battered buckets of refuse and debris line the wall near the doorway, waiting to be removed and discarded.

The newly tiled floor of the temple is still hazed with a cloudy film grout dust, and the scent of heated iron hangs in the air.  Nearby, a circular chandelier peeks out of a straw-filled crate, and heavy chains dangle from the arched ceiling to accommodate the fixture.  Against the granite temple wall is leant a thick roll of narrow carpeting tightly bound with knotted cords of hemp.

The vestibule is lit from above by a myriad indigo candles perched upon a circular iron chandelier hung from the peak of the ogee arched ceiling.  Decorative wrought iron railings span the width between black granite pillars, allowing passage down the central aisle before lengthening to create a barrier around the perimeter of the sanctuary.   A narrow carpet trails down the aisle to the altar at the head of the temple.

title: [The Tides That Bind, Undertow]
description: This small chamber to the side of the entryway continues the column and beam architectural flourishes from the main cavern.  A long white modwir rack and a short shield stand are the only intentional decoration in the otherwise sparse chamber.  Veins of gemstones spiral across the floor in random patterns, occasionally interspersed with sparkles of shining metal.

title: [Ruined Structure, Interior]
[Reconstructed Temple, Interior]
[Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
description: This corner of the structure has been crushed, and the majority of the dislodged pieces of granite and stone have fallen back into the hollow between the inner and outer walls.  Buried deep within the trapped rubble appears to be a skeletal hand reaching out from beneath the debris.

One niche has been fully chiseled out of the granite wall, while the other has only been traced in with chalk.  A straw broom with an oaken handle leans into the corner, and a neat pile of dust and debris awaits collection beside it.

On a table erected just beneath the niches are a pair of pewter reliquaries, with every surface adorned with elaborate etchings and their latches secured with iron locks.  Beside them on the table is an ebonwood box of large indigo taper candles.

title: [Ruined Structure, Interior]
[Reconstructed Temple, Interior]
[Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
[Granite Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
description: Though this section of the wall is relatively intact, deep fissures score the surface and the occasional gust of air whistles through.  A battered and bent brazier lies overturned on the floor, the links on its attached chain oddly warped.

A small arch is marked out in chalk on the finished granite wall, and another of a slightly different shape is traced beside it as if the craftsman has not yet decided on a style.  A stubby piece of chalk rests discarded thoughtlessly on the floor.

Chisel marks in the wall have begun to take shape as cusp-arched niches, and the floor underfoot is littered with fine dust and discarded shards of granite.  A pair of wood-handled chisels are left abandoned on a worktable along with dark leather flask.

A pair of niches bite deep into the granite wall, their depths filled with an array of sundries artfully displayed on a hammered pewter charger.  Mismatched candlesticks topped with indigo candles set alongside the items offer fitful illumination as the candle flames flicker every few seconds, tickled by the fingers of unseen air currents.  Every breath pulls the chill of the air into the lungs along with the subtly sweet aroma of dogbane.

title: [Ruined Structure, Interior]
[Reconstructed Temple, Interior]
[Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
[Granite Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
description: The interior wall here has crumbled, the granite compacted and buckled beneath an immense stone shed by the outer wall.  A quick glimpse of the empty space between the walls offers a view of several small bundles tucked inside, each bound in leather cording and dusty.

Several whole and partial floor tiles are strewn at the base of the wall along with a pair of nippers, and a grout-covered sponge has been left soaking in a shallow basin of grey water.  Across the way, a section between pillars has been chalked out on the floor, a crude illustration indicating a future feature of the temple.

A few heavy crates packed with straw sit side by side against the wall, while a length of decorative wrought iron railing is propped against the pillar, awaiting installation.  A trio of iron brackets mounted high on the wall remain empty and awaiting items to display.

A bone-numbing chill haunts the outer edge of the temple sanctuary, and the only sound is the guttering of the candles set on a many-armed candelabra.  Two niches carved deep into the granite walls house a variety of ghezyte statuary, some bearing the damage of age while others seem newly sculpted.  From time to time, the candlelight catches on the metallic inclusion of the granite, giving the illusion of movement when glimpsed from the corner of the eye.

title: [Ruined Structure, Center]
[Reconstructed Temple, Center]
[Temple, Center]
[Granite Temple, Center]
description: Cracked and covered with dust, the granite floor is difficult to inspect, and its only readily identifiable feature is the fact that it is made of granite.  Huge boulders pepper the floor, with massive webs of shattered granite marking where each fell.

Crates of black granite and grey marble tiles sit on each side of the temple's central chamber along with wooden toolboxes of nippers, boar hair brushes, and sponges.  Small tubs of grout and water are scattered here and there next to each toolbox.

Underfoot, a tessellated pattern of squares begins to take shape as the floor moves toward the altar, as yet left only half finished by the craftsmen.  A ladder is braced against a pillar on the right side of the temple, and a bracket fixed with an iron change is mounted near the top.

The enclosing walls of the temple are black granite, smoothed and polished to a high gloss, while the floor is laid in tessellated squares of grey marble and granite in a dizzying pattern.  Pillars stand stoically at the edge of the sanctuary, and indigo-cushioned kneelers of ebonwood are arranged in diagonal rows to resemble a fringed arrowhead directing all attention to the altar.  Iron-chained ghezyte braziers mounted on pillars cradle smoldering embers that give off the sickly sweet scent of dogbane.

title: [Ruined Structure, Interior]
[Reconstructed Temple, Interior]
[Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
[Granite Temple, Outer Sanctuary]
description: The line of the wall is little more than an uneven stack of cracked granite blocks, leaving the interior of the structure open to the elements.  Deep fissures score the floor underfoot, and crumbled bits of rubble have collected along the wall's base.

Half-finished with seams of mortar visible between the blocks, the interior wall is just a tad higher than the average human.  Perhaps it is nothing more than a play of light on the stone, as only a single lantern lights this corner, but a vaguely skull-shaped discoloration contrasts with the darker surrounding stone.

The nearby pillar is half polished, its glossy sheen lost midway to its full height, and the surrounding walls are similarly affected.  Stout lanterns set here and there illuminate this dark area of the sanctuary.

Slivers of amber light pierce the dim in this area, cut by the pillars at the edge of the sanctuary as it spills past.  Centered on the wall within one slice of light is a fine silvery grey elesine tapestry embroidered with a chelioboros wrought in indigo silks.  A slow cadence of whispers wends through, the words indistinct and accompanied by a dark thread of energy that  causes hackles to rise.

title: [Ruined Structure, Interior]
[Reconstructed Temple, Dais]
[Temple, Dais]
[Granite Temple, Altar]
description: Crushed chunks of granite are loosely piled in a tall heap at the heart of the alcove, interspersed with foot-long shards of a dark, unrecognizable metal.  Dust in thick layers coats the floor underfoot, though cracks in the granite are easily felt.

Wedge-shaped blocks of granite sit at the center of this wide alcove, loosely arranged to form an elevated circle.  Two piles of slightly smaller blocks of the same shape are lined up next to the center aisle, and a bucket of freshly mixed mortar rests nearby.

Unpolished granite forms the lower tiers of a raised dais, while the uppermost tier is yet to be completed.  At regular intervals along the front curve of the middle tier are bored out holes lined with hammered pewter, and a box of silvery glaes shades sits off to the side.

Centered on the highest tier of the circular dais is an imposing ghezyte altar composed of stark lines and elaborate carvings.  Indigo candles ensconced by silvery glaes create a half-moon at the fore of the platform, leaving the rear of the dais shrouded in darkness.  The oscillation of each miniscule candle flame is complicit in creating an illusion on the surface of the ghezyte of twisted and distorted forms, trapped and writhing as if trying to escape.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Hall]
description: The upward slope of the hall ends at the base of a set of curved stairs carved directly into the stone wall.  On the opposite wall is a recessed niche that stretches from the floor to a trefoil arch near the ceiling.  Within the depression, dark scenery emerges in earthy pigments blackened by time and moisture.  Wan light trickles down the stairs, along with the faint scent of sea brine and ale.

wayto.26764: whisper scene beneath the waves lies a darkness not yet seen.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Landing]
description: The mouth of the stairway opens into a cavernous space hollowed out from the mountain, with deep crags and scars still visible in the stone.  Heavy iron sconces are bracketed to walls stained by soot and mildew, and the floor underfoot is a ridged span of age-darkened teak.  The chasmal void beyond is dimly lit by lanterns hung overhead, and the forms of stools and a bar sulk like lurking shadow beasts in the distance.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Great Room]
description: Dark iron spikes and lengths of chain secure mismatched lanterns to the high ceiling, each shaded flame shedding a corona of amber in an otherwise black headway.  The entirety of the back wall is dominated by multi-tiered shelving set behind a stained driftwood bar attended by a row of high-backed stools.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Hall]
description: The dusky illumination from soot-shaded lanterns and the pitted countenance of the walls create an elaborate play of shadow and light along the length of the brief hallway.  Water stains darken the floor and stretch toward the ceiling like dark, tendriled digits vainly searching for the light.  Brittle lengths of driftwood tangled in a mass of rigging line are mounted artfully on the wall, while underfoot, a threadbare carpeted runner leads the way.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Terrace]
description: Underfoot, the stone balcony has been textured by thousands of chiseled grooves, every square inch of the overhanging having been shorne from the mountain itself.  Beyond the border of the railing set with planters, the sea stretches out like a silver-stippled black canvas.  All the same, the soft whisper of waves exists at the edge of hearing, and just below, the wan light of torches flickers against the rocks.  A round wrought iron table is at the heart of the balcony, along with several wrought iron chairs.

Underfoot, the stone balcony has been textured by thousands of chiseled grooves, every square inch of the overhang having been shorn from the mountain itself.  The railing is laden with coralbell leaves that spill from oblong planters, while beyond, the sea stretches out in gilt-sheened ripples.  All around, the soft whisper of waves exists at the edge of hearing, and humid breezes waft over the terrace.  A round wrought iron table is at the heart of the balcony, along with several wrought iron chairs.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Hall]
description: An elaborately detailed map is framed and mounted on the wall, its warped and tattered edges pressed for protection beneath the glass.  Opposite, a series of small, irregular holes pierces the stone near the ceiling, allowing occasional breaths of fresh air to filter in.  A deep, round niche in the stone holds an oil lamp with a stormy blue-hued shade.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Lounge]
description: This room is both shabby and chic, the well-appointed furnishings obviously of high quality, though aged well past their prime.  An indigo circular rug occupies the center of the floor, its high pile irregularly patterned with depressions caused by long-sitting furniture.  Several mismatched tapestry-upholstered chairs are in attendance at the rug's edge, arranged in a semi-circle to face an indigo and grey damask settee with a dark ash wood frame, while the occasional side table interrupts the spaces between.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Great Room]
description: The immensity of this chamber belies the fact that it exists beneath and within a mountain.  In addition to those anchored by chains to the ceiling, myriad lanterns are mounted at intervals on the walls, and a warm amber haze suffuses the air.  Dark iron braziers piled with embers are interspersed among the tables to ward off the chill of the underground, and vents found in the floor beneath them draw the smoke out and away.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Terminus]
description: The pitch of the ceiling leading from the great room plummets to create something of a shallow and narrow passage that terminates in this confined circular space.  At the center is a tiered wooden table set with a variety of pleasantries for the nearby guestrooms, as well as a small dark metal sculpture that sits on the topmost shelf.  Several old paintings adorn the walls, their frames scuffed and tarnished and their faces cracked and chipping.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Piety Room]
description: The water stains at the base of the walls have been scrubbed, though not with any manner of determination as much of the discoloration remains.  Likewise, the air is haunted by the vague scent of mildew stirred by the occasional breath of sea salt.  Bereft of a bed, this room boasts only a seal skin rug and a circular teak bookcase.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Amity Room]
description: A bored out hole scores the ceiling at the rear of this room, and a steady stream of water trickles down the wall, staining its path with smeared deposits of minerals.  The water has collected in a small pool at the base, where smooth stones in somber oceanic hues rest.  Just to the side of the waterfall is a bed made of a rocky outcropping that is accompanied by a small nightstand upon which stands a soot-shaded lamp.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Augur Room]
description: Chisel marks are evident in the sloping walls enclosing this space, and the air is weighted with humidity and the scent of earth.  A wide platform carved from the far wall is padded by a plush mattress, with a folded satin-covered quilt laid at the foot.  In a niche nearby, an oil lamp burns dimly, issuing the scent of valerian, and an aged teak writing desk sits on the wall opposite.

title: [Climate Change]
description: Natural curvature in the stone walls serves as ledges for displaying wares in this part of the cave.   Near a bend in the passageway, an upright translucent glaes display stained with shimmering blue-green algae provides some illumination.  Intermittent drips offer an irregular rhythym to punctuate the silence of the cave.  A billowing, grey mist encircles clothing for purchase and perusers alike, seeming to squeeze them tightly before retreating into roiling pools on the ground.

Near a bend in the passageway, an upright translucent glaes display stained with shimmering blue-green algae provides some illumination.  Intermittent drips offer an irregular rhythm to punctuate the silence of the cave.  A billowing grey mist encircles both clothing for purchase and perusers alike, seeming to squeeze them tightly before retreating into roiling pools on the ground.

title: [Climate Change, Workspace]
description: This extremely tight room barely fits a handful of people comfortably, though it could hold more if packed together tightly like a mass of squirming fish caught in a net.  The room is dimly lit by patches of glowing moss which quiver at the occasional circulating breath of overpoweringly brine-scented air.  Drops of water plunk down from the ceiling to meet the lurking, grey mist undulating in thick pools on the sandy ground.  A rounded stone bench off to the side provides some seating.

title: [Island Finery, Boutique]
description: Resting against one pale silk wall, a trio of mannequins show off their elegant island finery.  Lengths of carved tigerwood form the frame of the large tent with a center pole, wrapped in swathes of colorful material, creating a peaked ceiling.  A beautiful mirror framed in carved driftwood is centered on the soft, vibrantly patterned carpet.

title: [Caligos Isle, Beach Scarp]
description: Here at the high water line of the berm crest, generally safe from any waves except the rogues pushed inward during severe storms, a line of torch-holds set with flaming torches mark off safety from danger.  Lighter, dry dark grey sand meets the edge of wet black sand just beyond here, indicating the height of the current tide.

Here at the high water line of the berm crest, generally safe from any waves except the rogues pushed inward during severe storms, a line of empty iron torch-holds mark off safety from danger.  Lighter, dry dark grey sand meets the edge of wet black sand just beyond here, indicating the height of the current tide.

title: [Caligos Isle, Sea Cave Mouth]
description: Once at sea level, now only entrenched at high tide, the wide mouth of a shallow cave is an open, jagged, teeth-like formation of broken basalt.  Black sand, a combination of the rock particles and ancient lava formations shattered when it reached the cooler sea, is deposited from one end to the other of this narrow beach.  Neither the moonlight nor a pair of larger flickering torches pierce beyond the dark opening, and a tumble of boulders prevents further access.

Sunlight does little to pierce beyond the opening and a tumble of boulders prevents further access.

title: [Caligos Isle, Black Sand Beach]
description: Crescent-shaped and sandwiched between two plateau headlands, this black sand beach sits slightly protected from strong winds and rough tides.  Waves are forced to merge as they enter the shallow bay and then spread outward in calm ripples normally, though high tides and extreme weather can make this a dangerous entrapment.  Several feet from the curving wall of basalt blocks jutting sharply, staked irons holding brightly burning torches run the crest of the berm.

title: [Caligos Isle, Black Sand Beach]
description: Polished volcanic granules from ancient lava deposits mix with the softer grey of basalt to create this slightly tonal beach.  Moon and starlight bring out the subtle sheen of the black sand, especially when damp from the tide and continual wash of waves.  The flames from rag-wrapped torches set into iron holds lining the berm crest add a fiery glimmer reflecting brightly.

Sunlight brings out the subtle sheen of the black sand, especially when damp from the tide and continual wash of waves.  Polished volcanic granules from ancient lava deposits mix with the softer grey of basalt to create this slightly tonal beach.  Tiny flecks of green from peridot and red from iron ore add depth to the hue.

title: [Caligos Isle, Black Sand Beach]
description: Charcoal black sand extends the length of the beach, changing from dark and richly hued where the waves constantly lap at the granules, to lighter and dull where untouched by water.  Iron bars stuck into the ground and set with flaming torches run midway between the sea and the cliff, leading the way for those seeking to dig.  A dingy outhouse sits at the base of the cliff face flanked by a pair of lit torches set into jagged basalt.

Charcoal black sand extends the length of the beach, changing from dark and richly hued where the waves constantly lap at the granules, to lighter and dull where untouched by water.  A dingy outhouse sits at the base of the basalt cliff face.

title: [Caligos Isle, Black Sand Beach]
description: Thanks in part to the evenly spaced torches rigged in iron bars buried deep along the berm, the signs of recent digging that interrupt the smooth black sand of the beach, can be avoided.  Broken pieces of shovels are discarded off to the sides, and every once in a while, a loud shout of excitement pierces the peaceful calm induced by the waves repeatedly lapping at the shore.

Signs of recent digging interrupt the smooth black sand of the beach, broken pieces of shovels discarded off to the side of a nearby berm.  Every once in a while, a loud shout of excitement pierces the peaceful calm induced by the waves repeatedly lapping at the shore, and the plaintive cries of sea birds wheeling overhead.

title: [Caligos Isle, Lower Berm]
description: Wet and dry merge here, where black sand beach and pebbled berm meet.  Digging holes exist on each side of this natural line, some filled with water post abandonment and others still mostly dry, often occupied by those seeking treasure.  Small iron torch holds set beside each depression steady rag-wrapped wood, lit and flickering in the breezy night air.

Wet and dry merge here, where black sand beach and pebbled berm meet.  Digging holes exist on each side of this natural line, some filled with water post abandonment and others still mostly dry, often occupied by those seeking treasure.

title: [Caligos Isle, Black Sand Beach]
description: Halfway between the two cliff headlands that shelter the beach, this crescent midpoint is peacefully quiet except for the muffled thunks of shovel blades hitting the sand.  Small piles of the fine black granules are mounded alongside deep holes, some of which are empty and abandoned, while flickering torches reveal only the heads of their occupants in the other holes.

Halfway between the two cliff headlands that shelter the beach, this crescent midpoint is peacefully quiet except for the muffled thunks of shovel blades hitting the sand.  Small piles of the fine black granules are mounded alongside deep holes, some of which are empty and abandoned, while others reveal only the heads of their occupants.

title: [Caligos Isle, Lower Berm]
description: Fine dark grey sand gives way to larger pebbles of softer hue as the berm rises up from the flat beach and stretches toward the cliff wall.  Steep in its sharp climb, and created by the power of strong waves pushed ashore during storms, the waterline is clearly established at this geologic point.

title: [Caligos Isle, Lower Berm]
description: Smooth grey pebbles mix with the darker black sand on the rise of the berm, making travel a bit treacherous for those not sure of foot.  Mixed in are bits of sea-worn seashells, their iridescence picked out by the moonlight, glittering pale white, cream, and pink, when the fog allows the beams through its mist.

Smooth grey pebbles mix with the darker black sand on the rise of the berm, making travel a bit treacherous for those not sure of foot.  Mixed in are bits of sea-worn seashells, their iridescence glittering pale white, cream, and pink amid the darker hues.

title: [Caligos Isle, Lower Berm]
description: Sand rolled up by storm-powered waves has built into a small berm featuring gravel-like grey stones washed and rounded by the sea.  Beyond is a thin landing and another berm of grass-tufted sand, or a hazardous hike back down the pebbles toward the beach.

title: [Caligos Isle, Black Sand Beach]
description: Fine black sand continues to stretch in a slight arc between the points of the cliffs, with the approaching sea a matching darkness that reflects the moonlight.  Streamers of kelp litter the beach and glisten in the glow produced by the line of flaming torches lighting the way for diggers.  A small white crab skitters along in a wavering gait avoiding the wash of waves.

Fine black sand continues to stretch in a slight arc between the points of the cliffs, with the approaching sea more green than blue in the sunlight.  Streamers of kelp litter the beach, its surface horizontally rippled from the changing tide.  A small white crab skitters along in a wavering gait avoiding the wash of waves.

title: [Caligos Isle, Black Sand Runnel]
description: Ridges created by the most recent storm disrupt the beach with tracing mounds edging a deep runnel.  Inside the pool, stars and moonlight are reflected along the surface of the dark still water barely revealing a colony of baby starfish.  A ring of torches helps direct diggers away from the large sunken depression.

Ridges created by the most recent storm disrupt the beach with tracing mounds edging a deep runnel.  Inside the pool, tiny crabs and baby starfish sparkle in the sun-warmed water.  Deep enough for wading and exploring, a few children accompanying the busy diggers frolic and squeal with each sea-life discovery.

title: [Caligos Isle, West Headland]
description: At this end of the beach, a tall headland comprised of basalt, shale, and limestone rises up from the ocean, a thin strip of black sand disappearing around the far edge to the other side.  Sand ripples are more pronounced here, giving a wavy texture to the fine black granules, resulting from the more violent waves crashing against the rocks.  Near the last of the torches a sign warns of the danger near the cliff.

At this end of the beach, a tall headland comprised of basalt, shale, and limestone rises up from the ocean, a thin strip of black sand disappearing around the far edge to the other side.  Sand ripples are more pronounced here, giving a wavy texture to the fine black granules, resulting from the more violent waves crashing against the rocks.

title: [Caligos Isle, Upper Berm]
description: A thin, horizontal landing separates the lower, sandier berm from the more established rise created over time and leading back toward the wall of the cliff.  Serving as a level path that runs the length of the beach, it is easier to navigate than slogging through wet sand or dune-like drift.

title: [Caligos Isle, Upper Berm]
description: Fine grey sand has mounded to create a berm providing some refuge from the waves.  A nice, dry place to sit and enjoy a small bonfire and the diggers as they toil, though the sand is cool at night, requiring a blanket for those who wish to rest for long.

Fine grey sand has mounded to create a berm providing some refuge from the waves.  A nice, dry place to sit and enjoy a small bonfire or watch the diggers as they toil, though the sand is cool at night, requiring a blanket for those who wish to rest for long.

title: [Caligos Isle, Upper Berm]
description: Long and sloping, the berm running along the basalt cliffs is lit with random torches warning of holes from digging along the more remote sand of the upper beach.

Long and sloping, the berm running along the basalt cliffs shows some signs of digging, more remote from the more popular and softer sand of the lower beach.  Small white-bodied terns with frilled black head caps skitter here and there, searching for their next meal.

title: [Caligos Isle, Upper Berm]
description: Cresting the slope of the berm, and at the farthest point from the waterline, hardy tufts of beach grass poke up through the dark sand, preventing storms and high winds from eroding the narrow shelf.  Close by, a bumbling aelotoi tourist mills about on a raised log platform loosely bound together by strands of torn, dirty cloth.

title: [Caligos Isle, Maze of Columns]
description: Unknown forms dart in and out of the haze-filled air, skittering across the eroded walls of the cavern and up the lopsided columns flanking the path beyond.  Frail strands of webbing lay smashed into the rocky floor creating glistening patterns that are highlighted by the torches perched at various intervals.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fish Pits]
description: Illuminated by torches that are set at even intervals, this section of cavern has an uneven floor that is pockmarked with rust-hued calcite deposits.  Perched upon a crate, a scrawny half-krolvin lad dangles one foot over the edge of a white stone-encircled pit that is filled with ocean water.  Behind him, an iron-bound warped oak chest sits with a large padlock on it, while just to his right is a knotted hemp rope that leads out of the cavern.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Caligos Isle, Blind Man's Rail]
description: Twin railings stand at either side of the narrow pathway, the broken wood frames hanging precariously over the darkness of the cavern depths below.  The intermittent echo of rocks colliding down the walls of the chamber breaks up the otherwise monotonous silence of the area.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eel Beds]
description: Low ceilinged and cramped, the cavern has uneven floors and walls that are striated with purple algae and off-white calcite.  Iron-caged lanterns dangle from the ceiling to illuminate a strange tubular contraption, which resides over a banded oak-slatted bucket.  Pacing between an iron-bound warped oak chest and a dark glaes aquarium, a plump-faced gnome child watches over the area with a look that is a mixture of curiosity and amusement.  A knotted hemp rope provides an exit from the cavern and entry to the floor above.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Caligos Isle, Drop Off]
description: The immense chamber provides an aerial view of areas further down the path, the cavern's fissures obscuring the finer details in a curtain of humid mist.  The surface below groans as the sound of rumbling echoes off each wall in turn, fading off as the vibrations cease as quickly as they began.

title: [Caligos Isle, Shadow Playground]
description: The air weighs heavily with the overwhelming scent of sulfur, the plumes of gas stabbing out from vein-like fissures covering the shadowed ground.  Loose rocks, jarred from the inward angled walls, become heated projectiles as they roll across the temperamental fissures.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cavern's Maw]
description: More vein-like fissures splay along the limestone walls, the ceiling pierced by disfigured stalactites like sharpened fangs threatening to rip apart a web-covered decline across the dusty floor below.  A dislodged stalactite lays shattered above a yellowed skull of dubious origin, a furry spider weaving an intricate web within its hollow eyesockets.

title: [Caligos Isle, Spider's Delight]
description: The blackened floor is covered in empty hulls of webbing, a variety of carcasses deteriorating into piles of sludge from the hot, muggy air.  The occasional rock tumbles down from high above the caverns, echoing off the narrow walls before being entangled in a thick, complex web.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Poop Deck]
description: Large and sturdy railings surround this aftmost and highest deck of the ship.  Fully exposed to the elements, the decking forms the ceiling for the aftcastle cabins below.  The view from the aft rails is of that of moonlit ocean swells, stretching out far astern.  Between the howls of gusting winds, all falls nearly silent, with only the sounds of waves lapping against the hull marking the passing of time.

Large and sturdy railings surround this aftmost and highest deck of the ship.  Fully exposed to the elements, the decking forms the ceiling for the aftcastle cabins below.  The view from the aft rails is that of ocean swells, stretching out far astern, porpoises surfacing nearby, and a few large birds, gliding past effortlessly on wide, outstreched wings.

title: [Captain's Quarters, Map Room]
description: A large, four-poster bed, amassed with corpulent pillows and covered in a nautical-themed quilt, peeks out beneath a draping of guazy fabric suspended from the ceiling.  The surrounding room is nearly entirely taken up by a heavily lacquered oak table, strewn with maps, star charts, and drawings on various slips of parchment.  A gold-trimmed telescope, mounted beneath a large, open, brass-rimmed porthole, provides views of the surrounding lands, seas, and sky.

title: [Wigged Out]
description: Reflective glass gleams from within an ornate filigreed golvern frame, the impressive mirror dominating the longest wall of the maple-floored cabin, giving a more open and airy feel to the space.  A line of marble displays presents elegantly styled wigs for browsing customers, directly next to a velvet-inset ebonwood case.  The back of the shop is occupied by a tiered mahogany cabinet that faintly glitters with miniature jewels.

title: [Baubles of the Sea]
description: Starlight shimmers in through the crosshatched grate-covered windows lining the back of this spacious cabin.  Muted bands of yellows, blues, and reds are refracted through the baubles here and shift slowly around the walls as the pale white moon meanders across the nighttime sky.  A straw-lined iron chest holds a collection of small sea glass jars, while a tall driftwood pedestal holds several larger jars and two very large bottles.  Beneath the window, a smooth mahogany table, polished to a mirror shine, displays other goods available to the disce

Light shimmers in through the crosshatched grate-covered windows lining the back of this spacious cabin.  Shimmering bands of yellows, blues, and reds are refracted through the baubles here and shift slowly around the walls as the sun meanders across the sky.  A straw-lined iron chest holds a collection of small sea glass jars, while an open glass display case displays fine glass shards from the seas.  Beneath the window, a smooth mahogany table, polished to a mirror shine, displays other goods available to the discerning patron.

A straw-lined iron chest holds a collection of small sea glass jars, while an open glass display case displays fine glass shards from the seas.  Beneath the window, a smooth mahogany table displays other goods available to the discerning patron.

title: [Stateroom, Sleeping Chamber]
description: No light filters in through the heavy, silk-lined curtain, leaving the room in darkness save for a few burning candles upon a silver tray on the floor.  No bed is present in this space, with only a sheet-draped, narrow pallet laid upon the floor at the base of a large enclosed glass fish tank.  Shards of sea glass are laid out in a sort of mosaic picture, but the work is unfinished and its subject indecipherable.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Passageway]
description: The wide passageway is well lit by swaying brass lanterns suspended from chains anchored in the teak panelling of the low ceiling.  Pale blue carpeting with a gold, nautical themed border provides plush footing between the various staterooms accessible through the illuminated passage.  A pair of softly glowing wall sconces mark the entry to each side room, beckoning guests to enter and browse the available wares.

title: [The Protected Coif, Salon]
description: Small, but cozy, this modest cabin offers little in the way of comfortable home amenities.  A small window rests above a neatly made bed, and a claw-footed dresser fits snugly against the wall beneath a teak-framed portrait.  Thin streamers of yellow silk have been hung from the ceiling in an obvious attempt to add some colorful decor to this otherwise crude dwelling.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Passageway]
description: Pale blue carpeting muffles extraneous noise between the staterooms lining the companionway, but sounds of dishes, glassware, and muted conversations drift in from a pair of heavy mahogany doors trimmed in brass which stand open at the aft end of the passage.  The swaying of brass lanterns suspended from the ceiling lends a rhythmic undulation of light back and forth across the teak panelled walls.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Galley]
description: A sturdy carved oak sideboard, laden with selections from the bounty of the sea, lines one wall of the spacious galley.  Beside it, a long table with some cushioned bench seating offers guests a relaxing spot to partake of the delectable morsels.  Along the far wall, a massive cast iron stove keeps the area toasty warm despite the gusting sea winds outside.  Mounted securely to the teak wallboards beside the stove is a tall whitewashed cupboard with twisted silver eel handles.

title: [Carved in Stone]
description: The spacious cabin is encircled by slender modwir panels that are artfully scorched with the dark silhouettes of floating aspen leaves.  Lengths of tawny doeskin stretch beneath a silver-traced faewood case and a carved white oak display on the eastern wall.  A tiered candelabra suspending a multitude of brilliant gem-tipped maoral rootlets hangs over a lacquered rowan cabinet at the back, its slow-burning beeswax candles illuminating the entire room.

title: [B. Witching]
description: The walls of this small cabin have been painted a matte shade of black, and thin stripes of dark violet stretch from ceiling to floor.  Silver-armed sconces supporting ebon satin shades spill pools of light on the floor, and a matching three-armed candlestick sits at the center of a round ebonwood table.  Nearby, a lavender velvet-lined tray sits atop a simple display, and a silver-inked black parchment sign is propped alongside.

title: [B. Witching, Sitting Room]
description: A large credenza occupies the back wall of this cozy room, its surface laden with a variety of herbs, florals, and oils all trapped within stoppered apothecary bottles.  A blackened skull on a violet lace doily sits amongst the glass, as does a black onyx mortar and pestle.  Perpendicular to the credenza is an arsenic grey velvet-cushioned couch with a high back and sculpted arms.

title: [Caligos Isle, Chamber of Tears]
description: The stifling humidity of the enclosed area makes it difficult to breathe, a result of the numerous spouts of steam rising up from the cracks along the darkened ground below.  The sharply angled walls drip rivulets of moisture, the murky waters flowing further down into a small hole leading to fresher air.

title: [Caligos Isle, Abandoned Pier]
description: The small rivulets of water leading from the hole join dozens of thin streams in a steep drop-off, the area barely lit by a single torch flickering with gusts of cold wind.  Across the spray-enshrouded divide is a wood-planked pier, its supports slowly swaying as the water beneath it flows into the blackness below.

title: [Caligos Isle, Chamber of Echos]
description: The cavern opens up into a larger area, the humidity ever present despite its size.  A striated drapery formation dominates the fissure-covered floor, the dark-colored rock reaching with finger-like protrusions to the ground below.

title: [Caligos Isle, Ivory Maw]
description: Bone white stalagmites thrust upwards from the fissured floor of the chamber, the tapered columns grasping towards the blackness of the ceiling above.  Set between a gap of the pale protrusions is a frayed rope bridge leading further down into the darkness of the cavern.

title: [Caligos Isle, Chamber of Vices]
description: Set below the frayed rope bridge is a still basin of water, the liquid casting mirrored reflections of the teeth-like stalactites that barely puncture the surface.  Concretions litter the water's edge, the small pearl-sized matter scattered between what appears to be submerged skulls of unknown origin.

title: [Caligos Isle, Shadowed Grotto]
description: A ring of dying torches flickers through the grotto, the flames casting elongated shadows over the pale greenish waters.  A crumbling curved stairway cuts alongside the underground pool, the ramp briefly concealed as the torches threaten to be extinguished by the rivulets of liquid dripping from the ceiling.

title: [Caligos Isle, Narrow Chamber]
description: The scent of an extinguished torch permeates the humid chamber, the tilted walls crowding the available space along the fissure-covered ground.  The outline of a large hole dominates the center of the cramped area, one side clamped with a rust-flaked iron hook.

title: [Caligos Isle, Wall of Despair]
description: Thin cracks beneath the rocky surface hiss and vibrate, releasing plumes of steam that surround a large sconce-flanked hole, the heavy haze making proper breathing difficult.  The layered walls of rock have been inscribed with illegible drawings, the dark sanguine ink bleeding down into a puddle of moistened dirt.

title: [Caligos Isle, Arachnid's Lair]
description: The chamber ceiling is pierced by dozens of stalactites, the uneven spears thrusting downwards toward the web-covered ground, creating a difficult obstacle course en route to a large sconce-flanked hole.  The faint sounds of skittering reverberate between a pair of banded stalactites, their origins enshrouded by plumes of steam escaping from the ground below.

title: [Caligos Isle, Hazy Chamber]
description: The planks of the pier are warped from the continuous spray of water, the rotting wood covered in a variety of pale-colored worms and slugs gripping tightly to the grains.  The immense drop-off looms along the edge of the pier, the distinct lack of light making any other direction difficult to discover.

Emitting an ethereal glow, a graveyard of modwir gondolas stand out against a murky haze-filled backdrop created by the lack of proper illumination, the consistent sea spray, and the invading mists.  Pale-colored worms and slugs dig into the planks of a warped pier that sits before the lapping waves of an inky black water devoid of light.  Stretching upward and away, an uneven limestone ramp provides egress from the relative gloom of the area.

title: [Outhouse]
description: The inside of the outhouse is a generally cramped and odorous affair.  The elevated seat occupies a majority of the lower interior and bears a wooden lid to cover the opening to the pit latrine below.  The gaps between and cracks in the driftwood plank walls admit some flickering torchlight, with pale moonlight filtering through the cut-out crescent shapes above the door.

The inside of the outhouse is a generally cramped and odorous affair.  The elevated seat occupies a majority of the lower interior and bears a wooden lid to cover the opening to the pit latrine below.  The gaps between and cracks in the driftwood plank walls admit some paltry shafts of sunlight, with more illumination filtering through the cut-out crescent moons above the door.

title: [The Subtle Rose, Winery]
description: Heavy curtains of jet-on-burgundy jacquard are gathered with silken rope, the long gilded tassels trailing down along the mahogany-planked floor.  A glass-topped bar displays a few rectangular decanters, the tall containers flanking a matte alum tray etched with a tangle of wild roses.

title: [The Subtle Rose, Apothecary]
description: A haze of rose-scented smoke rises from a trio of empty wine bottles, the sheer wisps wending upwards along the black velvet draped over a tall display dominating the room.  Nestled within the center of the display is a square ebonwood chest, the container entangled in strands of decayed vines.

title: [Darkness]
description: Hundreds of glassy eyes stare out from the dagger-like stalactites looming high above the chamber, the bats' compact bodies flickering in and out of view with the dwindling flame of a low-set torch.  As the light grows, the number of visible bats lessens, the sound of flapping wings growing closer and louder when visibility begins to wane.

title: [The Old One-Two, Back Alley]
description: Occupying the space between a high shale wall and the back of a hastily constructed shop, the small alley is a temporary shelter from the wind and is brightly illuminated by torches that help stave off the gloom of the island.  Crates and boxes are stacked high on three of the four sides of the alley, a sign tacked to one of them, while a small oak table and chair are arranged in the center.  Strung between the boxes, and anchored by more boxes, is a colorful braided wool hammock with a bright green tarp positioned over it.

Occupying the space between a high shale wall and the back of a hastily constructed shop, the small alley is a temporary shelter from the wind and sun of the island.  Crates and boxes are stacked high on three of the four sides of the alley, a sign tacked to one of them, while a small oak table and chair are arranged in the center.  Strung between the boxes, and anchored by more boxes, is a colorful braided wool hammock with a bright green tarp positioned over it.

title: [Made to Measure, Boutique]
description: The intimate boutique is papered an intense viridian hue on the walls, posing a striking contrast with the lustrous black fel flooring underfoot.  Delicate silver chimes strung with paper-thin nacreous shells hang above an ornate crystalline carousel holding jewel-colored bottles.  Faceted sea glass sconces diffuse a soft lotus scent in the air, while illuminating a dark-grained maoral wardrobe and a pale thanot bureau nestled in the back corner.

title: [Made to Measure, Haberdashery]
description: The color scheme of the haberdashery is reversed from the boutique, the walls paneled in rich ebon fel and the floors tiled in vibrant green malachite and jade.  The broad side wall is stacked with scroll-carved black willow shelves situated over a divided walnut chest.  Spherical crystal-domed lamps brighten a glass-inset ironwood case that rests next to a sleek marble archway.

The broad side wall is stacked with scroll-carved black willow shelves situated over a divided walnut chest.  Spherical crystal-domed lamps brighten a glass-inset ironwood case that rests next to a sleek marble archway.

title: [Steep Insights, Main Room]
description: Efforts to repair this ramshackle cottage have been attempted with marginal success.  Some of the stained wood walls and floorboards have been scrubbed clean of mud, scraped free of moss, and scoured of mold, but a mildewy scent still lingers.  Pale curtains in glassless windows flutter in the breeze, billowing out into the mottled sunlight diffused by the undulating fog that comes and goes.  Benches with cushions set beside small tables make for a cozy place to relax while sampling the wares.
