paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Steep Insights, West Alcove]
description: A slight alcove on the west side of the cottage holds a large rusted tin chest filled with colorful tea containers, a small square oak box holding several infusers, and a round woven reed basket of flavorings designed to enhance your beverages.  The repaired roof overhead is not perfectly done, with evident gaps between the boards stuffed with dried sphagnum moss.  The scent of earth almost overwhelms the other delicate fragrances here.

title: [Steep Insights, East Alcove]
description: A slight alcove on the east side of the cottage holds a small mottled steel chest filled with neutrally hued tea packets and a plain oak box of coffee-filled packets illustrated with descriptive icons.  The rotted roof overhead is covered with a stained tarp, designed to keep out the elements, though its musty odor almost overshadows the fragrance of the various brews.

title: [Steep Insights, Workroom]
description: Simply decorated with recipes tacked to what remains of the cottage walls, the handwritten notes are accompanied by painted illustrations of various herbs, spices, flowers, and leaves.  Half the ceiling is still intact, while the rest has given way to wood rot, with only a canvas tarp stretched taut and coated stiff with wax to ward off wind and rain.  Several braziers set with small pots are either roasting coffee beans or making essences for flavoring.

title: [Chisel, Peen and Chamfer, Esqs.]
description: This building's floor and walls lie hidden beneath the calcareous build-up left by generations of barnacles and sponges.  Revealed now by lantern light, the pale, skeletal remnants of the invasive wall-coverings have warped the outlines of the windows and left two sets of paired columns looking like the trunks of large, melted-wax trees.  In contrast, the newly added brass shelves, display rack, and brass table create an almost nightmarish mix of organic and manufactured that is unpleasant to the eye.

title: [Deluge Debris, Cramped Space]
description: This space, while extremely tight, is nearly spherical and looks to have been scooped out with great care.  The sticky-looking sand walls of the enclosure are barely visible in what little light seeps through a large crack.  Periodically, roils of creeping, silvery mist seep out of the walls and blanket the area, their thick tendrils pooling on the ground and clinging desperately to anything that touches them.  A handful of broken chairs, partly sunken into the sand, are available for seating.

title: [Master Chamfer's Pavilion]
description: The familiar texture of tent canvas covers the walls in this portion of the building, complete with a central tent pole and canvas roof to hide whatever ceiling exists.  A polished brass lantern hung from the pole fills the faux pavilion's interior with a warm golden glow, and a thick, woven rug provides a plush, if undeniably uneven, surface underfoot.  At the base of the tent pole stands a small wooden work table and a three-legged stool.

title: [The Broken Forge, Workroom]
description: A portable forge depicting the pantheon of Liabo, Lornon, and Neutral dieties of Elanthia sits in the center of the room.  A work bench is off to one side with forging tools and oils, while a trough is set up near the forge.  Bits of dried seaweed and molluscs are only stuck on a few rocks and in crevices on the ground as if someone had tried to clean most of it up.

title: [Fantabulous, Storage]
description: Wooden crates and boxes are stacked haphazardly along the walls of this storage area.  A large corner area remains vacant of clutter, save for a small lumpy cot and a padded fel bench sitting perpendicular to each other.  A large copper lamp hangs on the wall barely a foot above the cot.

title: [The Hattery]
description: Light filters through the imflass chain curtain to illuminate this portion of the pavilion, casting faint shadows and bright reflections throughout the area.  Soft silk rugs cover the ground with some plush blue velvet cushions strewn about, while a large leather couch covers the rear pavilion wall.

title: [I Got This, Workroom]
description: Devoid of windows, this small room is sparsely decorated with only a few chairs and a slender wooden desk.  A single flickering sconce is affixed near the slender opening in the wall.

title: [Island Finery, Salon]
description: Set back from the rest of the tent is a large, elegantly furnished workroom.  Soft pillows crafted from vibrant material are piled about the floor by a polished driftwood bench.  A rich carpet of bright silk covers the floor, a pattern of tropical feathers giving it a colorful texture.  Whimsical patterns of dancing dragonflies are carved into the frame of a wide tigerwood board that hangs next to a silk-draped archway.

title: [Made to Measure, Alcove]
description: Tiny iridescent tea lights paint the alcove in a dreamy pastel glow, the room predominantly cloaked in neutral matte raw silk to highlight the coloration.  At the center of the space, a tufted linen and satin divan sits behind a milky green jade table that is meticulously carved with flourishing wild roses.  Sheer gossamer panels softly frame a sleek marble archway, the egress carefully tucked away in a removed corner.

title: [Signed, Sealed, Delivered]
description: Tiny and cluttered, the small space is almost filled by a long wooden bench set into the wall with a small parchment sign nailed above.  Unopened crates in a wide variety of shapes and sizes are stacked about.  A single lantern is suspended from the ceiling, its copper frame and crystal panes kept pristine.

title: [The Old One-Two, Work Room]
description: Fabric-swaddled walls give the small room a cozy appeal, while propped-open windows in the ceiling provide a small amount of airflow and allow for a modicum of light to penetrate the area.  A long knotty oak workbench at the back is riddled with tools and materials.  Standing opposite one another, a curtained archway leads into the main room of the shop and an unadorned exit provides egrees.

title: [The Third Eye, Parlor]
description: Round and low, a small table rests upon a carpet in the center of the floor and is surrounded by plump cushions of plum, indigo, and silver.  Trinkets, totems, and charms dangle from twine in the ceiling, their smooth faces glittering in the ambient light provided by votives housed in niches within the surrounded granite walls.  The spicy scent of sandalwood and myrrh fills the air, while a coin-edged velvet curtain muffles sound from the showroom beyond.

title: [The Tides That Bind, Whirlpool]
description: Windows and columns carved directly into the far wall offer a stunning view of the waters below from the high vantage point within the plateau.  A number of benches, carved directly into the stone walls, line the outer edge of the room, each positioned between a pair of columns to provide a small seating nook.  Tiled with silvery mithril, a small platform is the main adornment in the center of the chamber.

title: [Weave and Wear]
description: Filtering through the skylight above, beams of pale light illuminate the small area inside the wagon.  Draped over the rafter above, bundles of colorful feathers swing to and fro.  Some shelves hang above a narrow wooden table, its surface covered with bits of leaves and flower petals.  Strands of ivy climb down a small painted door from a narrow box tacked to its surface.

Filtering through the skylight above, beams of bright sunlight fill the small area inside the wagon.  Draped over the rafters above, bundles of dried flowers fill the room with rich scents.  Some shelves hang above a narrow wooden table, its top covered with bits of leaves and flower petals.  Strands of ivy hang down a small painted door from a narrow box tacked to its surface.

title: [Caligos Isle, Daggertooth Quay]
description: Thin rocky protrusions tower overhead like skeletal fingers, surfaces pitted and worn from relentless wind and wave.  Broad, flattened stones form a series of benches surrounding a massive basalt slab.  A makeshift stage sweeps back to the shore's edge. The flash of foaming waves can be glimpsed as water crashes against the sharp stones below.  A winding path among the jagged, stony formations leads to the east, ending at an abandoned lighthouse.

title: [Northern Fortress, War Room]
description: Dominating this chamber is a long oak table that stretches the length of the room.  Upon the table is an oil lamp which burns steadily.  An ancient oak chair sits on a small rise at the far end of the table, while several oaken chairs of various sizes surround the remaining perimeter.  Opposite the entrance, three tall windows show a moonlit, snowy landscape.  The oil lamp dimly illuminate several maps and charts that are hung with care upon the walls.  A giant stone archway is set in the wall behind the great chair.

title: [Wench Wear, Workroom]
description: Moonlight glints off of long sections of steel railing that encircle the roof of the wagon.  A cool breeze musters up a slight scent of jasmine and lavender that filters into the open area from a small hole in the floor.  Piles of pillows have been stacked up in each corner, offering a nice spot to rest and enjoy watching the stars.

A cool breeze musters up a slight scent of jasmine and lavender that filters into the open area from a small hole in the floor.  Piles of pillows have been stacked up in each corner, offering a nice spot to rest and enjoy the warm sunshine.

title: [Wrap Yourself, Parlor]
description: Thick ivory carpeting spreads throughout the parlor and several chairs line the rose silk walls.  A pale damask silk couch with wide ebonwood feet occupies one corner near a tall, leafy plant in a brass pot.  A meticulously lettered ivory sign propped up on a silver stand rests near an archway leading back to the shop.

title: [Caligos Isle, Lighthouse Path]
description: A twisted, winding path is just discernible between the jagged rocks stabbing at the sky.  Silvery-hued mists settle between the rocks battling the constant crash of waves to claim domain here, leaving you coated in a salty mist.   A long-abandoned lighthouse stands at the point where shore meets sea, silhouetted in the darkness against the silvery white, moonlit horizon.

A twisted, winding path is just discernible between the jagged rocks stabbing at the sky.  The click-clack of crabs and the scuttle of small, jointed feet are barely heard over the constant crash of the waves against the spires.  A long-abandoned lighthouse stands at the point where shore meets sea, silhouetted against waves on the horizon.

title: [Caligos Isle, Rocky Recess]
description: Crushed rock and sediment cover the hard-packed ground.  A large flat boulder stands vertically amidst the rubble, creating a makeshift room while blocking most of the island wind.  Wedged into cracks in the rocks, a few crude torches cast flickering shadows that seem to lick at the rocky terrain.  A cracked piece of slate has been affixed to the surface of the boulder.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Moonlight pierces the shallow waters, sending delicate rays of silvery blue light through the plunging azure depths.  Twinkling black sand comprising an endless, sloping shoal below catches the moonlight, glinting shells and treasures peeking out from within it as far as the eye can see.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Refracted light from above dances like a thousand shimmering prisms cast across a long, black sandbar.  With a swoosh, energetic waves sweep over you and head off toward a nearby shore.  Pieces of broken coral mixed with bits of driftwood appear to swim away in tandem.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: From beneath, the surface of the water is a window of wrinkled, moving glass interspersed with foamy caps.  The ebb and flow of the churning current kicks up black sand that whirls about an eroded iron plaque half-buried in the sandbar.  In the refracted moonlight, a large pale red crab, its claws held wide open, scoots quickly along the sandbar, unaffected by the tide.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest, down

description: The bright viridian and dim indigo hues of the warm ocean water here sharply contrast the color of a nearby bright red starfish sprawled out upon a small black rock.  The endless ebb and flow of the waves pull and tug at some brilliant blue-green algae near the surface.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: The pitch black deep water beneath sends chillier waters washing over you.  Grainy black sand interspersed with small round rocks and other oceanic debris rises and falls from the sandbar with the rhythm of the tide.  A diminutive brown seahorse studies you closely, unaffected by the current's tug, while barely visible fields of vegetation undulate slowly off in the distance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west, northwest, up, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Visibility far into the distance is largely obscured by the indigo-hued waters, except for a smattering of silvery-gold rays.  The water itself is somehow thicker at this depth, enveloping and curling over everything it touches like a nebulous fog.  Buried in the sand, a skeletal arm draped with undulating seaweed clutches a silver coin in its bony hand.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, northwest, up, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Just beyond the black sandbar below, the murky deep spreads out like an endless, smooth, black blanket beneath the deep indigo waters around you.  Occasional bubbles emanating from an unknown source dance upward in unison in their quest to reach the surface.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, up, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Clumped strands of dark green seaweed float through the murky waters and appear as schools of fish until a glimmer of light from above shows their true form.  Occasional heaving surges in the ocean shift everything in a rhythmic back-and-forth motion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, west, northwest, up, down

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: The deep blue darkness pulses serenely, each hypnotic and steady *swoosh* of water bringing a new wash of warmness or coolness with it.  Some startled creature buried in the sandbar darts off, sending up a storm of black sand that creeps toward you like a thick, roiling mist.  Caught up in a riptide's spiraling vortex, a large half-open oyster tumbles end over end nearby.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: A solitary phosphorescent anglerfish swims casually about you, assessing you with its toothy mouth agape.  Its bright, fleshy, illuminated lure is akin to a yellow eye with a penetrating gaze.  In the vast, cold and empty stillness, you grow aware of the *whoosh* of your own breathing and the steady pounding of your heart.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west, up

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Chilling you to the bone, a steady rush of icy water pierces your skin.  Endless blackness is broken only by tiny indigo twinkling in a short black sandbar nearby, the grains and oceanic debris upon it somehow glinting of their own accord in this pitch darkness of the deep.  A sudden rush of warmth from somewhere over your head is countered by a return to near-arctic temperatures as the water surrounding you shifts and resettles.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, up

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Darker than the blackest of nights, the frigid waters suffocate nearly all light and make travel through the water an extremely perilous feat.  Indigo-stained colonies of black coral with fingerlike, razor-sharp tendrils jut out from the expansive black shoal below.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: A low, groaning, drawn-out vocalization echoes from some faraway point, followed by a shrill reply coming from somewhere nearby.  Freezing waves of water envelop you time and again with the back and forth rip of the current.  From within the black sandbar, part of an enormous cracked wooden treasure chest juts upward, but the lack of light makes it impossible to discern if there is anything inside.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west, up

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: The near-frozen abyss spreads out endlessly past the black sandbar.  Shafts of light from above, barely visible skirting the tops of this depth, cannot penetrate the congealed, deep blue liquid prison at this fathom.  A faintly luminescent bloated dead sawfish floats belly-up in the water surrounded by small fish delicately pecking away at its carcass.

In the vast, cold, and empty stillness, you grow aware of the *whoosh* of your own breathing and the steady pounding of your heart.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Darker than the blackest of nights, the frigid waters suffocate nearly all light and make travel through the water an extremely perilous feat.  Indigo-stained colonies of black coral with fingerlike, razor-sharp tendrils jut out from the expansive black shoal below.

title: [Main Deck]
description: A narrow walkway approaches the partially sunken stern, tapering down from the wide promenade that leads toward the rusted bow of the great ship.  The scalloped-edged, navy and white striped canvas that once covered the stern passageway now sags under the weight of algae and other sea debris.

title: [Main Deck, Stern]
description: Hanging limply, a tattered and faded blue flag is affixed to a long, corroded, steel pole mounted at the very stern of the sunken ship.  To the north, a stairwell spans from the middle of the forecastle into a large arcade, once filled with merchants and wares.  Built around the entrance to the stairwell, a cantilevered balcony overlooks the expanse of the Wavedancer's waterlogged main deck.

title: [Mid-ship Passage]
description: Partially concealed by a set of half-open double doors, a grand staircase sweeps down into the interior of the ship.  A multitude of overturned deck chairs, flaccid umbrellas, and tables have piled up in the passageway.  The current is strong here, and the water near freezing.

title: [Main Deck, Bow]
description: Partially sunken in the ocean floor, an elaborate monir figurehead set into the bow of the ship is eerily lit by a bed of luminescent green and blue coral.  Where the portside promenade joins the starboard, a glass door opens to the undersea ballroom, a splintered chandelier lying on the warped floor amidst rusty chains, spilled glass beads, and scattered teardrop pendants.  A lone lanternfish circles the wreckage of a raised stage at the far end of the ballroom, the watery hall's only performer.

title: [Main Deck, Portside Promenade]
description: Along the side of the deck, an alcove has been crafted into the bulkhead wall and made over into an elaborate shrine to Niima, Charl's gentle daughter.  Painstakingly pieced mosaic work, crafted primarily from the nacre of oyster shells and iridescent shards of abalone shell, forms a representation of the spirit as a young girl.  Strapped securely to the side of the ship is a small shore boat with a set of warped oars lashed across the benches and held by a fish-filled net and rigging contraption.

title: [Main Deck, Gangplank]
description: A wide break in the outer balustrade of the ship is strung with aged gold-linked chains dripping with barnacles, while the waterlogged gangplank lies rotting on the floor.  Opposite the gap, a set of stained glaes double doors hang open, the long ago, bustling market now an aquarium of tropical fish.

title: [Starboard Promenade]
description: To the west lies the mid-ship passageway and a gracefully curved glass wall supported by wooden beams surrounding the former sunbathing deck which overlooks a large pool.  A disproportionately large lantern is affixed to the stern bulkhead, the countless squares of differently colored glaes that form the fixture obscured by plankton.

title: [Starboard Promenade]
description: A set of enormous planed oak doors lead into the hull area, the top half of each door set with mullioned panes of glass etched with a stylized wave and anchor pattern.  A giant, cast iron replica of the Wavedancer is overturned in front of the doors, blocking passage.  Barely visible through the murky waters above, the crow's nest is still perched at the top of the submersed main mast.

title: [Starboard Promenade]
description: Surrounded by kelp, a silver-veined pale blue marble bench is set securely into the drowned decking, its visible surface clearly revealing its elven origins.  Extending in a well-defined and gracious sweep, the starboard promenade marches forward along the perimeter of the main deck toward the sunken bow of the ship, while shallow steps ascend to the forecastle at the stern.  Over the railing, a large anchor is buried in the sea floor alongside the Wavedancer.

title: [Mid-Ship Passage]
description: Sealife-carved railings frame the carpeted staircase of the ship, each wooden fish and mollusk tangled in nets of loose fibers and unfurled tassels waving gently within the chilled water.  A rusted chandelier looms haphazardly above, its glass globes cracked, casting sharp teeth-like shadows against the wooden planks of the area.

title: [Mid-Ship, South Hallway]
description: Gilt-framed paintings of verdant islands and beaches sit pinned beneath a collapsed support beam, the waterlogged splinters stabbing through the fibrous canvas like splayed claws.  Against the opposite wall, a long side table has become a refuge for several crustaceans, the residents slowly cracking their claws at one another in a show of dominance.

title: [Mid-Ship, Stern]
description: A rectangular mosaic lays broken upon the uneven parquet floor, pieces of oyster and abalone shell left in piles by the currents surging through the middle of the ship.  Scalloped awnings of striped canvas wave back and forth, possessed by the freezing cold waters of the depths below.

title: [Mid-Ship, North Hallway]
description: Tall blue and white doors line the narrow corridor, their barnacle-covered brass handles hanging loosely by bolts long corroded from water and age.  Wood of indeterminable origin clings to the ship's frame, leaving large fractured cracks in which various fish weave to and fro throughout the wreck.

title: [Mid-Ship, Bow]
description: A large jewel-toned lantern dangles from the hole-ridden ceiling, its once colorful panes left clouded from a build-up of algae and sand.  A cracked marble statue of Niima falls heavily upon the teak balcony, the girl's face left marred by time and other means.

title: [Mid-Ship, Starboard]
description: A trio of shark-wrought scuppers loom unscathed above a collection of broken oars and pieces of shore boats, the oceanic predators gazing down at the wreckage with sharpened iron teeth.  Further exploration of the deck has been blocked by a barricade of metal and wood, the labyrinth concealing large shadows swimming deep within the cold waters.

title: [Mid-Ship, Port Side]
description: A torn velvet chaise lays flipped over against the wall of the ship, its once elaborate design ripped into ribbons floating gently in the dark waters.  A single rusted bird cage teeters next to an unusually large hole in the floor of the deck, the inhabitant's remains a mystery.

title: [The Depths Below, Port Side]
description: The freezing waters below the ship create a dark-colored backdrop to a single polished oak table set in the middle of the deck, the furniture surrounded by a half-dozen canvas chairs.  In front of each seat is an elaborate place setting, the intact display an eerie juxtaposition to the chaos that has engulfed the rest of the ship.

title: [The Depths Below, Bow]
description: A chain-strung wagon wheel sways back and forth above the deck, the rusted chandelier occasionally colliding into the faded tile mural set against the wall.  Chips of tile loosen from their confines as they sink down into the darkness of the cold waters.

title: [The Depths Below, Starboard]
description: Very little light penetrates into the area, a pitted iron watchman's lantern sitting unlit against the broken railings.  A series of brass-framed portholes line the side of the ship, their circular glass windows concealing the secrets of the lower hallway.

title: [The Abandoned Waters]
description: Visibility far into the distance is largely obscured by the indigo-hued waters, except for a smattering of greenish-gold rays.  The water itself is somehow thicker at this depth, enveloping and curling over everything it touches like a nebulous fog.  Buried in the sand, a skeletal arm draped with undulating seaweed clutches a silver coin in its bony hand.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, northwest, up, down

title: [Warehouse, Alcove]
description: Tall, tightly arranged stacks of crates make walls to three sides, while a curtain keeps anyone from seeing your activity here in this alcove.

title: [Caligos Isle, Indigo Pools]
description: Softly glowing light issues from a pool in the center of the cavern, its indigo illumination warring for dominance over that of the shadows cast by stalactites anchored in the ceiling.  Crystalline structures formed of salt deposits line the porous walls of volcanic rock, their surfaces remaining slick from the constant draining of water from above.  A warped wooden bench rests at the front of a short wooden dock with its back to the steep incline that disappears into the darkness.
paths: Obvious exits: southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Caligos Isle, Fire-lit Caverns]
description: Recessed into the porous walls, a small fire cheerily parts the gloom of the cavern and sends its grey smoke up through a chimney fashioned of cracked stalagmites.  Smooth stones, some large enough to sit upon, dot the area, while fish bones gleam bright white in the dark.  A large rhimar-lined chest stands ready to use by local fishermen.

title: [Caligos Isle, Indigo Pools]
description: A heavy mist hangs in the air like a gathering storm, impeding visibility in this deep and humid cavern.  Disturbed by a multitude of sealife below its surface, a large pool ripples constantly, thin indigo-hued tendrils darting to and fro across its glassy top.  A makeshift pier, crafted from moss-covered planks, juts out from the grotto's rocky edge and provides a perfect fishing perch.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fire-lit Caverns]
description: Recessed into the porous walls, a small fire cheerily parts the gloom of the cavern and sends its grey smoke up through a chimney fashioned of cracked stalagmites.  Smooth stones, some large enough to sit upon, dot the area, while fish bones gleam bright white in the dark.  A large rhimar-lined chest stands ready to use by local fishermen.

title: [Caligos Isle, Indigo Pools]
description: Warm heat emanates from the southwestern wall causing the area to fill with a faint, clinging fog as the cold of the nearby pool clashes with the tepid air.  Hanging like pendulums, stalactites laced with mica reflect the light of nearby torches and illuminate the ceiling like a thousand, tiny shining stars.  A warped wooden bench rocks slightly on the uneven ground.

title: [First Mate's Cabin]
description: Smaller by half than the captain's quarters beside it,  the cabin of the first mate is still roomier than that of the average sailor aboard.  A quilt-covered bed with turned oak posts takes up one wall, while an inviting sitting area, a small desk, and a collection of map cases are spread throughout the rest of the space.  A soft, blue woolen carpet covers the floor boards with a perfectly porpoise-shaped hole cut completely out of the middle of the weave.

title: [Caligos Isle, Merchant Lounge]
description: Dark shale walls, slick from the extreme moisture in the air, glisten in the firelight that is produced by bamboo pole torches that are rooted into the dense, sandy ground.  Branching coral structures form a sort of canopy over the area, their orange, teal, and white limbs intertwined in a latticework of crystalline branches.  Warped benches form loose, social clusters in three of the four corners, while a small table offers a variety of local delicacies.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest, out

title: [Merchant Lounge, Extension]
description: Tiny rivers have bored their way through the shale walls forming divots and dips throughout the broad, ebony expanses.  Wrought iron shepherd's crooks are planted into the spongey ground, their curved tops holding glass and wire lanterns that fill the area with a bright light.  A row of pews, their backs to the entry, provides seating for visitors, while an open space in front of them has space for various activities to unfold.

title: [Merchant Lounge, Alcove]
description: Canvas sheets are strung across the ceiling of the small alcove, the bright indigo and silver fabric providing a protective screen against the elements.  Small pockets in the walls house candles that illuminate the area at all times of the day and night.  Several chairs are arranged in loose circles throughout the space.

title: [Wrong Turn Tavern]
description: Built into the rock face, the derelict tavern is relatively bare, with only a handful of slipshod tables and chairs tucked under funnel-shaped glass lamps hanging from the craggy ceiling.  Cluttered on one side with six tall stools, a rough-edged oak bar is covered in a milky film, and the other side is entirely bereft of clean glassware and -- perhaps the reason for the general lack of patrons -- liquor.  Middling circular holes that serve as windows are cut into the rock and offer a view of the seascape to the east.

title: [Savor Your Magic, Niche]
description: A pile of colorful silk pillows is scattered across the niche as a form of seating.  A flickering oil lamp rests on a glass-topped rounded table near a high-backed wooden chair with a wine silk cushion.

title: [Murk Manor]
description: Gritty grey stone walls, several sporting clusters of barnacles along the edges, make up the spacious entryway, which is graced with a crookedly hung painting.  A healthy handful of dark-glassed lanterns are scattered around the room, most on the ground, though several make their homes atop water-stained wooden side tables, the only furniture in sight.  Its pristine condition strikingly out of place in the dour surroundings, a wide white marble cart streaked with grey holds a collection of vials and other sundries.

title: [Murk Manor, Dining Hall]
description: Backing the far wall, a sizeable white brick hearth is bordered by elaborate verdigrised bronze railings that span outward in an ostentatious display.  Several paintings, their subject matter well past the point of familiarity due to the apparent water damage they have sustatained, decorate the dining room, which, fittingly, is short a dining table and all but two wooden chairs.  Just adjacent a heavy wooden door is a tall curio cabinet on tiny wheels.  An intermittently stiff wind gusts through broken windows along the eastern wall.

title: [Murk Manor, Rose Room]
description: Warped, rose-covered wallpaper peels off of the walls in long pieces, limp strips simply hanging loosely down in what can only be described as a sorry state of affairs.  Dominating the space is a wooden desk, squared on one side, ovular on the other.  Several verdigrised bronze-backed chairs that look more suited to a dining table than an office desk are scattered around the desk, and a stuffed owl-topped coat rack stands between a small window and a heavy wooden door.

title: [Caligos Isle, Descent]
description: Departing from the plateau above, a twisting and twining path descends towards a tangle of thick, new-growth foliage comprised of knotted vines and rope-thick creepers.  Bands of mist slip through the area, tumbling like dark clouds and pooling in thick banks towards the vegetation below, making it difficult to see with any certainty what lies within.  A cluster of decaying wood that is riddled with dried-out barnacles darkens the eastern edge and blocks all passage deeper into the jungle.

title: [New Escapes, Showroom]
description: Swaths of pale blue silk hang loosely from the wrought iron frame of this three-sided pavilion.  The abandoned lighthouse in the distance provides a stark juxtaposition to the pristine interior of the establishment.  Plush carpets of a deep indigo color cover the floor, while a long low table set against the far wall displays the shop's wares.  Small paper lanterns provide a warm ambiance and ample light in which to peruse the merchandise.

title: [Undertaker's Cottage]
description: Built directly into the side of the cliff, the cramped cottage appears to be owned by someone in the burial services.  Shims, planes, hammers, and nails are discarded upon the uneven floor, while various chisels rest beside marble and stone slabs on a long grungy worktable.  Long planks of planed oak rest against the stone walls at the back of the room, while piles of finished and unfinished burial devices are stacked near the door.  A copper-ringed oak barrel filled with shovels rests in the center of the space.

title: [Caligos Isle, Verdant Slope]
description: Draping between the rotted remains of ancient trees, thick rope vines display their verdant growth and intertwine to form a canopy that blocks all sunlight.  Dart frogs and cicadas vie for dominance as they issue their clicking and rattling sounds into the damp darkness of the surrounding jungle.  A small vine-covered crack in the foliage to the east darkens the pathway.

A small vine-wreathed crack in the foliage to the east provides egress from the descending pathway.

title: [The Glass Slipper, Studio]
description: A curtain made from seashells serves as a partition for this small studio complete with a lacquered mistwood worktable.  An open box filled with tools and a sturdy shoe form sit atop the long table which is littered with paper patterns and sketches.

title: [Hideaway Cavern]
description: Rocky walls consisting of dark shale in some areas and limestone in others spread all around in this cozy space.  A diminutive worktable, its surface covered in dust and ashes, holds a handful of blades sans hilts, some stained with sanguine and all wrought with cracks through their metal makeup.  Clearly ready for display and sale, a separate collection of blades, each finely crafted into a dagger and fully intact, dangles from a braided black rope that splays across the length of the area.

title: [Hideaway Cavern, Passage]
description: Damp and somewhat humid, with a small vent occasionally spurting out grey mist, the area is narrow.  More like a passageway than a proper room, it stretches a goodly length, with a slope leading steeply downward at the far end.  Black ropes are suspended against both of the longer cavern walls, one hung with varied daggers, the other supporting assorted small sheaths.  Fending off complete darkness, funnel-shaped glass lanterns droop down from above at unevenly spaced intervals.

title: [Hideaway Cavern, Skyfall]
description: Affording a spectacular view of the mist-filled darkness outside, the cavern wall falls away on one side of an upward slope, completely open to the elements and a precipitous drop-off.  The opposite wall expands outward, allowing ample room for the wares draped from multiple hooks and placed atop a long driftwood table.  Shoved against the walls are substantial piles of dead kelp, which exude the stench of rotting sea life.  Almost indiscernible in a shadowed niche, a warped door bears deep gashes.

title: [Siren's Call, Cellar]
description: A diamond-nooked cellarette spans the entire back wall of this small room, and the shoulders and necks of wine bottles peek out from its depths.  A sparse few of the nooks are bereft of bottles, but are filled all the same by webbed tunnels woven by spiders or random bits of miscellany.  Underfoot, the uneven stone floor is solid, and every sound, no matter how slight, rebounds endlessly.

title: [Hideaway Cavern, Cloud Niche]
description: Several funnel-shaped lanterns hang in the center of the small rock wall-enclosed chamber, but despite their steady glow, their light fails to crawl into the far corners of the chilly area.  Just under the lanterns, a small two-tiered fountain burbles quietly.  Two ash grey velvet couches sit next to each other in front of it, with a thick swirling red cloud floating between them.  The limestone walls are glossed over by dark, oily streaks in areas, which are especially prevelant around an oddly twisted door handle that sticks out of the rock.

title: [Murk Manor, Garden Path]
description: Clusters of trees bare of leaves find purchase along a meandering pathway, which is bordered by flower beds absent flora and instead filled with a muck of mud and pockets of sand.  An expansive manor rises up to the north, while a crumbling stone wall demarcates the property's border to the south.

title: [Murk Manor, Garden Courtyard]
description: Sprawling grounds radiate out from the courtyard past a ramshackle greenhouse to the west, while the eastern edge of the courtyard is backed by an expansive abandoned manor.  Scattered around -- and sometimes toppled over in -- overgrown hedges adorned with dried out seaweed and sea fans, rusted wrought iron benches provide ample viewing spots for a four-poster bed frame that partially covers the remains of a battered and broken fountain.  Shading a meandering pathway, several spindly trees spread their barren branches out overhead.

title: [Murk Manor, Greenhouse]
description: Rusted wrought iron inset with panes of glass rises up in a circular shape, gradually curving into a lofty dome crowned with an elaborate cupola.  Suffocating and darkening the rear half of the structure, wilted vines climb through the open spaces to hang down over rotted planters and crumbling pots that have been shoved up against the walls.  Dead leaves, plant matter, and ocean detritus litter the floor.  At the front of the greenhouse, a verdigrised bronze-backed chair sits next to a glass-set plain wooden case and a small dented wastebin.

title: [A Head Above Water, Work Room]
description: Smoky blue and indigo silks cover the walls of the room, the fabric sewn with tiny jeweled starbursts.  A wrought vaalin chandelier hangs down from the ceiling, illuminating the room through hazy glass spheres.

title: [A Head Above Water, Work Room]
description: Smoky blue and indigo silks cover the walls of the room, the fabric sewn with tiny jeweled starbursts.  A wrought vaalin chandelier hangs down from the ceiling, illuminating the room through hazy glass spheres.

title: [Grinding Gears, Interior Hull]
description: This dilapidated old ship hull appears to have once been a small fishing barge, the remnants now turned on their side and repurposed as an uneven lean-to.  The floor is covered in black sand from the nearby beach, while battered planks create a slanted wall, which once would have been the ship's deck.  A series of salt-encrusted hooks hang from the ceiling, while a large seaman's chest rests at the foot of a crooked wire stand.

title: [Grinding Gears, Under Deck]
description: What once was a cabin has been turned on its side nearly upside down, making the room awkward and a bit disorienting.  Despite the odd angles, a nearby sidebar appears to be well stocked.  Dim light seeps through uneven cracks from both the underside of the fishing barge and the uneven planks that once made up its deck.

title: [Ash Table]
description: Constructed from reclaimed wood, the table is bound by a continuous band of sturdy invar to hold the planks of the top together, while the legs are held by brackets of the same material.  Though obviously old and repurposed, the wood has been well-treated, having been sanded smooth and coated in a layer of thick lacquer.

title: [Wizards]
description: In the hue of a flawless sapphire, the walls are textured beneath the paint, with barely visible spirals traversing their lengths like coiling breezes frozen in time.  Tiny flames dance above the wicks of the azure candles perched on the many-armed silver sconces that dot the perimeter of the chamber, and in each of the four corners is an elemental orb nestled in a mithglin cradle.  Within the orbs, sands shift, water burbles, fire hisses, and air gusts with haunting howls.

title: [Wizard Raffles]
description: The curtained alcove of the pavilion is small and austere, utterly unadored save for a lantern glowing brightly overhead.  Underfoot is a thin layer of carpeting in a mottle grey hue, and a braided silver cord secures the curtained opening.  Several torn stubs of raffle tickets litter the carpet.

title: [Carved in Stone, Recess]
description: Dark-lined woodland scenes sweep over the paneled walls of the small recessed area, the gilded glow of flickering tealights housed in green amber lanterns adding warmth to the nook.  A sprawling rabbit fur and doeskin rug is draped over the center of the floor, and soft essences of acantha and lavender float lightly in the surrounding atmosphere.

title: [Underground]
description: Trailing from a heavy stone arch flush against the wall, a long stairway leads ever-downward to what seems an impossible depth, such that the ears pop and mild disorientation begins to tickle at the edge of the mind.  Though stale, the air is stirred by infrequent breaths that originate from a point of the passage further still.  At the base of the stair is a small landing flanked by iron-sconced torches.

title: [Underground]
description: The amber cast of the torchlight makes the damp, grey stones glisten with a green iridescence, giving the widening chamber a sickly countenance.  To one side, shelves have been carved into the rock, and they rise into an arch that shelters a carved granite altar.  On the other lies a seeming shrine of bones, stacked high and wide and arranged in configurations both mystical and profane.

title: [Underground]
description: Tapering to a lower pitch, the ceiling of the chamber is arrayed in dusky-hued lichen and fungus, the odd patch here and there luminescing with an errie cyan glow.  Shelves once attached to the walls hang now barely clinging to the stone, their contents discarded and broken.  A lone iron-sconced torch burns fitfully as the floor rises to an upward-inclined ramp.

title: [Underground]
description: A haze of wan cyan light filters into this chamber, washing over dark forms on shelves and crags in the wall, setting all aglow with a preternatural luminescence.  On a ledge shorn from the stone wall are a pair of heavy pewter chalices and pewter flare-lipped bowls, neatly arranged on a dusty drape of silvery grey velvet.  As the slight incline of a ramp leads further into the chamber, a heavy stone arch guards the exit.

title: [Farain's Shack]
description: Frail wooden planks are bound together with leather cording to form a makeshift wall that surrounds the room.  Shafts of light are filtered through the thick, rotting oak beams precariously balanced overhead.  A mauve rug stretches out across the uneven floor.

title: [Scallop Shell Table]
description: Framed in dark iron, tumbled-smooth stones and pastel seaglass set in enamel form the mosaic table top, the layer of enamel trapped beneath a surface of rippled glass.  A tulip-shaped candle holder sits at the center, with an indigo tea candle flickering brightly within.  From time to time, a subtle breeze stirs the air, carrying with it breaths faint with honeysuckle.

title: [The Subtle Rose, Chamber]
description: A half-circle of velvet-padded teakwood chairs surround a jet-lacquered table, the rectangular surface held aloft by a quartet of carved elven maidens.  The faint scent of bourbon and freshly lit cigars permeate the room, intermingling with traces of a light, floral perfume.

title: [Splintered Bow Table]
description: Even in the dim light which barely illuminates this small booth, it is impossible to miss the dense litter that covers the floor, especially around the table in the corner.  A very inept bowyer, or perhaps a very angry archer, has left behind splintered piles of what appear to have been bows of various types.  Pity.

title: [Flimsy Floorboards Table]
description: Warped floorboards covered with a thick layer of dust are the prominent feature of this cramped space.  The thin wooden planks creak and wobble with each step taken on them, making the short distance to the rickety table in the corner an uncomfortable one to traverse.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: Large rusted springs groan under the weight of the floor above.  The walls and ceiling here are all dirt and rock held in place with old wooden reinforcements, most of which are still in place.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: As you move past one of the walls you can barely make out several burrows here.  Evidently some poor animal calls this place home.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: Most of the supports have broken away here, littering the ground with their wooden remains as well as rocks of all sizes.  The few remaining beams still hold back enough of the surrounding tunnel to allow you to pass carefully.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The ceiling has collapsed around the remaining supports, blocking any further movement to the south.  As you look over the rocks and splintered beams, you can make out small scratchmarks that cover everything.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: This area intersects with another branch of the tunnel and looks to be structurally sound.  The floor is smooth and level except for a passage that slopes up to the north.  A thick layer of dust covers the room completely and there are no signs of any activity here.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: This section of the tunnel has caved in in several places forcing you to climb over mounds of dirt and stone to pass through.  Several pieces of the failed shoring protrude through a small mound along the south wall.  Many of the mounds contain holes that may have been dens for small rodents that have long since abandoned them.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: Light filters down from a large opening in the ceiling above but the room remains in darkness and shadow.  A wooden railing encircles the opening as it continues downward beyond your sight.  The railing has long since rotted in many places and broken pieces lay strewn across the floor.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The ramp continues around the outer edges of the shaft.  With each step the ramp groans under your weight and the sound echoes loudly up and down the shaft.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The area is dark but you can still make out several supports around the outer edges of the room.  A wooden ramp circles the entire room and spirals upward into the darkness.  Walking across the floor stirs up the dust making it difficult to see much of anything.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: This section of the tunnel has stood up remarkably well and no signs of decay are evident in the shoring.  Some of the timbers have been replaced recently and new torch sconces have been installed along the entire passage.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: This room has been well maintained and new timbers are evident in all the shoring.  Sconces with fresh torches are scattered about the room but remain unlit.  Several shovels and mining picks are set against the west wall but don't appear to have been used.  A loud clanging like metal against rock resonates throughout the chamber sending a chill down your spine.  Suddenly the sound fades to silence.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The tunnel narrows here and the ceiling slopes downward forcing you to duck your head.  The timbers that reinforce the tunnel here appear to be strong and give you a way to pull yourself through the passage in some of the tighter spots.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: This leg of the tunnel has been reinforced with oaken timbers that are only beginning to show signs of decay.  Along many of the walls you see large holes that disappear into the darkness.  The floor shows signs of being well-travelled but you are not sure whether the tracks were made by man or beast.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The dim light here makes it difficult to see very well.  Several rusty sconces dot the walls and broken torches lay scattered on the floor.  The air is thick and the scent of decay is evident with every breath you take.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: This branch of the tunnel ends abruptly with what appears to have been a cave-in.  Shattered timbers lie amidst the other rubble and debris in a sloped heap at the southernmost point.  Dripping water can be heard splashing on the floor in several places and for a moment you feel as if you are not alone.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The passage along this route straightens out and you are able to see that the tunnel ends towards the southeast.  All along the passageway you see small piles of rotting clothing and other debris that have been undisturbed for quite some time.  Hidden by one of the timber supports is a dried-out skull and several large bones.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The tunnel widens into a large circular room with the only exit being the passage you came through.  Large piles of rock have been formed along the walls in several places where the supports have given way.  Your attention focuses towards the center of the room where a large hole has been excavated but appears to serve no purpose.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The walls of this section of the tunnel are unusually damp.  The supports show severe signs of decay and they creak and groan under the weight of the ceiling.  Shallow pools of water have formed around the room with no evidence of their origin.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The tunnel has collapsed here, completely blocking passage to the east.  Rubble and broken timber supports are littered about the floor.

title: [Catacombs, Dark Tunnels]
description: The walls of the tunnel are still fairly intact here, with little sign of decay.  A draft of stale air wafts up from a shaft in the center of the floor.  The tattered remains of a rope cling to a small ring in the ceiling, poised directly over the shaft.

title: [Silvergate, Rovvigen's Room]
description: Overlapping rugs cover the floor, and sheer drapery canopies overhead flow down the walls in an ethereal haze.  Large cushions are arranged around a small, round table holding a softly glowing orb.  Above a carved stone fireplace that dominates one wall hangs a silver-gilt painting.  In one far corner, a silver scythe encased in a crystal sphere rests atop a stone pedestal.  A faewood curio cabinet's paned glass reflects the ambient light off tiny crystals strung among the canopy overhead.

title: [Artificer Tower]
description: Steps mark the middle of the chamber, spiraling both upwards to a higher floor and downwards into darkness.  The round room itself is walled in stone, its floors covered in layered sapphire carpets and its entirety lit by glass globes suspended from filamentous silver chains.  An arched door leads outwards.

title: [Artificer Tower]
description: Benches sit flush against the walls, forming a rounded ring of seating.  In the center of the room, steps lead both up and down.  The stone floor is covered with a thickly plush silver carpet, worked with a design of linear sapphire peacocks.

title: [Artificer Tower]
description: The topmost chamber of the tower benefits from the structure's domed roof, opening up the space to twice the height of the rooms below.  A ring of clerestory windows placed just beneath the cap of the dome itself let in a light tinged by their dark blue glass panes, a light which falls on the many banners and pennons hanging from the walls.  In the center of the chamber, a stairway spirals downward.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.

description: Crafted entirely of silvery grey stone, the blocks fit together seamlessly creating the smooth passage walls.  Set into a shallow recess is a narrow archway covered with a peacock blue silk curtain.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Locker]
description: You are standing in a tiny room whose facing wall is an array of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and is sitting on a small counter.

title: [Silver Moon Table]
description: The circular black oak table is polished to a high sheen, its surface glimmering with reflected light.  A set of high-backed chairs surrounds the table, each padded with deep red velvet upholstery.  The rounded edge of the table is bordered with inlaid silver, forming a pattern of moon shapes.

description: The circular black oak table is polished to a high sheen, its surface glimmering with reflected light. title: [Amber Bear Table]
description: The circular black oak table is polished to a high sheen, its surface glimmering with reflected light.  A set of high-backed chairs surrounds the table, each padded with deep red velvet upholstery.  The rounded edge of the table is bordered with inlaid amber, forming a pattern of placid bears.

title: [Bloodstone Lizard Table]
description: The circular black oak table is polished to a high sheen, its surface glimmering with reflected light.  A set of high-backed chairs surrounds the table, each padded with deep red velvet upholstery.  The rounded edge of the table is bordered with inlaid bloodstones, forming a pattern of lizard shapes.

title: [Silvergate, Golden Rose Spa]
description: Luxurious silk and velvet divans rest in a half-circle by a set of glass double doors.  White cedar shelves circle the room above gold-washed drawers.  Silk screens painted with golden roses upon wandering vines provide privacy in the treatment areas.  A padded table with pillows and a blanket rests beside a large white porcelain basin set atop a cabinet.  A full length tri-fold mirror with a small stool before it stands in the corner near a golden door, a dressmaker's mannequin waiting nearby.

title: [Icemule Hall, Great Room]
description: A large stone fireplace dominates this wide room, its stacked chimney stretching beyond the vaulted ceilings.  Overstuffed chairs of all sizes surround the hearth, their backs draped in warm fur throws.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, northwest, out

title: [Icemule Hall, Garden Room]
description: Lush green plants hang from the ceiling of this brightly painted room.  Rounded windows stretch the length of an entire wall giving an unobstructed view of the courtyard outside.  Wooden chairs etched in scrolling vine patterns sit around a carved wooden table.  A large pottery vase sits in the center of the glass surface, filled with lush moonflowers.

title: [Icemule Hall, East Hallway]
description: An intricately drawn map of Icemule hangs on one side of this small corridor.  A small table supporting a brass lantern is pushed up right up against the wall on the other side.  The entry to the hallway is flanked by two large pottery vases, each filled with a variety of native blossoms.

title: [Icemule Hall, Ice Room]
description: Plush white carpeting covers the floor of this wintry room, its surface reminiscent of snowfall.  Crystals carved into the shape of snowflakes hang at all lengths from the white-paneled ceiling.  A pristine white table sits in the center of the room, draped in a cover of pale blue brocade.  Wide armchairs surround the table, their plush seats covered in matching fabric.  Paintings of native arctic animals line the walls, their canvasses framed in gilt edged white wood.

title: [Icemule Hall, The Glacier]
description: A long wooden bar stretches the entire length of the far wall, and above it hangs a small painting.  A row of wool-covered barstools, crafted in various heights, sit before the polished counter.  Small tables and chairs cover the planked floor, each dimly lit by a single candle.  Off to one corner, a group of drunken halflings argue loudly over a game of cards.

title: [Icemule Hall, Loft]
description: Rows of bookshelves enclose this cozy hideaway, gleaming in the light of the brass torch sconces that are affixed to the walls.  Plush chairs sit off in one corner while cushions lie scattered about the floor, offering comfort to those wishing to thumb through the many tomes.  An arched bay window frames a plush padded window seat on the far wall, providing a bird's eye view of the snowy environs below.

title: [Icemule Hall, Pantry]
description: Rows of basket-covered shelves line the walls of this efficient kitchen.  A wide stone sink sits in an island counter of pristine marble, providing the means to prepare a variety of foods.  Shiny brass hooks hang above the center island, boasting a variety of cooking vessels and utensils.  Standing next to the door is a wooden rack, stacked high with polished serving dishes.

title: [Icemule Hall, Supply Emporium]
description: A wide glass counter dominates this small shop, taking up most of the space in the room.  Shelves line each of the plain wood-paneled walls, holding storage bins of yellow, blue, red, and green.  Brass lanterns flicker brightly, casting shadows on the many wares.

title: [Icemule Hall, West Hallway]
description: A long glass display case follows the length of one side of the hallway, various artifacts of importance to Icemule resting safely inside.  A crystal candelabra sits on the other side, lighting the way down this long corridor.  At the end of the hall rest two doors, one green, the other white.

title: [Icemule Hall, Wildflower Room]
description: Plush feather mats sit in a large circle on a planked wooden floor.  A polished writing desk is pushed up against the far wall, sheaves of paper and fresh plumes waiting for use.  A vase filled with colorful wildflowers sits by the doorway, the blooms releasing a sweet fragrance into the room.

title: [Icemule Hall, Rainbow Room]
description: A long padded bench occupies the floor, resting on a brightly woven rug that is spread from wall to wall.  A smaller bench sits on a raised platform at the head of the room, a colorful beaded tapestry hanging behind it.

title: [Huntress Chapel]
description: The chamber appears to be circular.  However, a stand of life-sized stone trees obscures the walls, rendering that determination uncertain.  Forming an ageless glade, the carven boles of the trees are lifelike, down to detailed bark and leaves.  Icicles drip from the rock leaves, and in the center of the frozen grove stands an altar.

title: [Ondreian's General Store]
description: Enclosed by glossy mistwood walls, the shop features an open-mawed greater vruul statue in the center of its plank floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the vaulted ceiling.  Right near the front is a heavy white granite counter and an elegant silver jewelry rack.

title: [Temple, Dais]
description: This dais sits at the end of the Hall of Sacrifice.  A large fountain has been built here which sits flush with the wall above a simple altar.  At the moment, the fount is quietly burbling while reflecting the bronze hues from the flickering candelabras stationed on either side of the fount and altar.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Armarium]
description: A triad of silver lanterns hangs from the blue-lacquered wooden ceiling, suspended on matching argent chains.  Below, the floor is polished silver stonework, which matches the simple, unadorned walls.  The only entrance or egress is through a single mistwood door.

title: [Sapphire Star Table]
description: The circular black oak table is polished to a high sheen, its surface glimmering with reflected light.  A set of high-backed chairs surrounds the table, each padded with deep red velvet upholstery.  The rounded edge of the table is bordered with inlaid sapphires, forming a brilliant pattern of twinkling stars.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Agate Lounge]
description: A pale marble statue of Tilamaire strumming a lute stands out clearly against the black marble tiled floor and dark velvet curtains which line the walls.

title: [Journey's End, Study]
description: Small and cozy, the intimate study is lined with shelves filled with various books and volumes.  A small basket of sticks rests next to a large stone fireplace adorned with a thick oak mantle.  Tucked into a corner is a mistwood writing desk, its surface cluttered with various inkwells, parchments, and quills with a matching mistwood chair placed in front.  A large dart board hangs over an oak dartboard rack, which sits caddy-corner to a small tiled bar covered with a varied selection of food and drink.

Beneath the vaulted ceiling, this lofty chamber feels open and spacious.  Sunlight floods the room through floor-to-ceiling windows that line the southern wall, where a large mahogany desk and a plush high-backed chair sit before them.  Stretching along the northern wall is a long metal workbench with a drawer-fitted equipment trolley parked nearby.  A large stone fireplace anchors the western wall, flanked by a mahogany sideboard offering provisions and an ironwood storage locker secured with a large padlock.

title: [Journey's End, Foyer]
description: Covered with stone tiles, the floor of the entryway is a colorful mosaic depicting a rose pattern.  A mirrored coat rack stands next to a carved beechwood door, a reflection of the room echoed in the smooth glass.  Suspended from a silver chain, a large candelabra hangs above, illuminating the area.

title: [Ondreian's Outfitting]
description: A pearl-handled filigreed mandolin hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  A brass flowerpot sits in one corner of a dappled celadon marble floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and a long mistwood counter on the other.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Wergild Way]
description: On either side of the crumbling cobblestone street stands a long row of three-story buildings, their brick facades covered with chipping plaster.  The occasional balcony, none appearing particularly stable, hangs along the upper floors.  Streetside posts dangle square iron cages, their candles extinguished, although the area remains full of shadows.  The otherwise unbroken line of buildings to the north is cleaved by a dark alleyway.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: The dense conifer forests to the west serve as backdrop to the three-story buildings lining the cobblestone road.  Torches stand in iron holders that are precariously mounted into the cracked plaster, their black smoke staining the facades.

The snowy conifer forests to the west serve as backdrop to the three-story buildings lining the cobblestone road, the faint trails of woodsmoke drifting far in the distance.  Torches stand in iron holders that are precariously mounted into the cracked plaster, each one hung with colorful glass ornaments.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Hushed Park]
description: Encircled by shadows and seedy brick buildings, the small park is a stark contrast with the vivid colors of solstice decorations.  Graduated couplings of well-trimmed trees nestle between bushes of holly while painted pillars filled with fragrant pinecones and cinnamon separate the road from the attempted cultivation.  A row of bright green hedges blends into the colorful scene, the flora hung with tiny bells.

Encircled by shadows and seedy brick buildings, the small park is more grey than green.  Thick tufts of crabgrass seem to battle the coarse monkeygrass for domination, while tangled knots of dark bushes separate the road from the attempted cultivation.  Rising in startling contrast to the surrounding area, a row of bright green hedges seems starkly out of place amid the unhappy expanse.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Hushed Park]
description: Encircled by bright hedges, the small park is oddly tidy in comparison to other sections of the town.  Clean, bright red bricks form a patio of sorts where a large grey stone fountain quietly burbles amid greyish-pink water lilies and daisies.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Wergild Way]
description: The cobblestones are almost buried in snow as they approach the Viridian Coil tavern.  The area in front of the entrance is hard-packed dirt from the near-constant foot traffic.  The entrance is filled with light from the many candles flickering inside of cages that hang from the mistletoe-strung posts flanking the door.  A row of seedy brick buildings looms behind the inn, silhouetted against the starlit sky.

The cobblestones are quite worn as they approach the Viridian Coil tavern.  The area in front of the entrance is dusty, hard-packed dirt from the near-constant foot traffic.  A post stands on either side of the entrance, each one supporting a square iron cage with several thick pillar candles inside.  The rear of the inn is cast in constant shadow by the row of seedy brick buildings looming behind it.
