The entrance is filled with light from the many candles flickering inside of cages that hang from the mistletoe-strung posts flanking the door.  A row of seedy brick buildings looms behind the inn, silhouetted against the star-lit sky.

title: [The Viridian Coil, Tavern]
description: The air hangs thick with the smell of booze and sweat and mingles with the dull roar of rowdy patrons.  A long black oak bar stretches one wall that is covered in colorful glass bottles below a large emerald-studded serpent and the railing of a loft.  Several stained tables and chairs are clustered about the room before a low stage, while others appear to have been pulled into the darker corners for dicing or privacy.  Behind the bar, a small pair of swinging doors leads to the kitchen.

title: [The Viridian Coil, Kitchen]
description: A massive black stove stretches the back wall, with a roaring fire visible within.  Large pots and pans cover the stove with serving wenches scurrying too and fro working on the stove or serving up a dish.  An equally enormous sink stands filled with murky water and dirty tankards, dishes and pots, with a pair of servant boys scrubbing away within the soiled suds.  Massive barrels of ales line a large pantry, foaming ale dripping from their spigots.

title: [The Viridian Coil, Loft]
description: A view of the tavern is visible though a rough oak branch railing that lines the edge of the loft, which has several tables and chairs set about the area for the patrons.  A battered dart board hangs from one wall, while flickering oil lanterns hang from pegs, providing some dim and dirty light to the area.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Blot Alley]
description: The narrow walkway is filled with shadows as the buildings on either side rise like overbearing lookouts.  A barrel sits rotting against the brick wall, bits of flaking plaster sticking to the disintegrating wood.

The snowy walkway is filled with shadows as the buildings on either side rise like overbearing lookouts.  A barrel sits rotting against the brick wall, the faint scent of cinnamon and stale whiskey permeating the disintegrating wood.

title: [Gamac's Goods, Front Room]
description: Faded velvet curtains heavy with dust are drawn over the windows at the front of the shop.  In the center, a few overturned crates are clustered around a makeshift table littered with the remains of a card game.  A pair of oil lamps sputter and spit atop a cracked display in the corner.

title: [The Veiled Purpose, Parlour]
description: A heavy curtain of pale smoke sweeps across the room, the rich fragrance of amber-saturated spice permeating the cloth-swaddled baskets lined up against the corners.  A carved wooden camel kneels before brocade tapestries comprising the back wall, the creature lacquered in vivid cobalt paint.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Lyswe Court]
description: Stretching along the interior stone wall is an expansive courtyard with a dilapidated stone fountain, spouting water from a crack in one side, at its center.  Tall brown stone buildings line the courtyard, while green weeds grow up out of the cracks in the uneven cobblestone road.  The walls meet at a tall black iron gate that exits the village.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Exterior]
description: A tall black iron gate stands as a lone entry beyond an uneven cobblestone wall that marks the border of the town, with a darkened bronze plaque set into the uneven mortar.  Sharpened tree trunks jut out of the top of the wall, providing some defense along an otherwise underwhelming line of protection.  Visible beyond the gate are rows of tall buildings with a mix of stone and metallic roofing, while the road itself is made up of uneven cobblestones.

title: [Dunh's Lab, Front Room]
description: Freshly painted white walls surround this stark room.  A strangely designed lantern at the center of the ceiling washes the room in a bright and remarkably steady light.  No dirt or other debris can be spotted anywhere.  A workbench, a sales table and a display stand have been crammed into one corner of the room, somewhat haphazardly.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Lyswe Court]
description: The stone wall curves along the left side of the road, its topmost edge littered with dry pine needles.  The path is well-traveled, though several of the cobblestones appear to have been recently replaced.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Mark Alley]
description: Tall, dented poles hold iron lanterns at the alley's entrance, though the narrow passage is by far more shadow than light.  The building on the south side bears only one balcony, upon which several pigeons roost.  A pile of rubble beneath the balcony is spattered with weeks' worth of bird droppings.

Tall, holly-spiralled poles hold iron lanterns at the alley's entrance, though the narrow passage is by far more shadow than light.  The building on the south side bears only one balcony, upon which tri-colored geese roost.  A pile of rubble beneath the balcony is covered in a fine dusting of snow.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: Blackened walls visibly wet with a strange fluid stretch in a full circle from the entrance of the shop.  Thick, tentacle-like appendages are hung from each like a curtain over each of the tunnels leading deeper into the temple.  Much like the walls, the floors are squishy and sticky with small sanguine colored pools strewn about.  A pair of black candles illuminate a rusted iron table in the center.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: Blood-soaked prayer mats are lined up evenly facing a section of the wall marred with claw marks.  Resting atop four tentacle-like appendages is a pink lace-accented display, its glass top shattered.  Sunken into the floor next to each prayer mat is an uninviting cot.  A tentacle-wrapped squat dilapidated bookshelf filled with stained books and other trinkets off to one side catches your eye.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: A small, blackened altar sitting upon a circular rug takes up most of the ornate alcove.  In front of the altar is an ebon locker, its hinges rusted and twisted into odd angles.  Atop the altar is the burnt outline of a humanoid being, strange snake-like outlines can be seen on either side of it.

title: [Temple of Tentacles]
description: Thick, tentacle-like cords are draped down from blackened iron spikes along the wall.  The surface of each cord is littered with small suction cups that are drained of life.  Thrown haphazardly against the wall is a large stitched sack, with a collection of assorted goods spilling out.

Thick, tentacle-like cords are draped down from blackened iron spikes along the wall.  The surface of each cord is littered with small suction cups that are drained of life.  Thrown haphazardly agains the wall is a large stitched sack, with a collection of assorted goods spilling out.

title: [Dark and Dangerous, Weapons]
description: Weathered planks of dark mahogany line the walls of this tiny, windowless space.  An immense iron rack displays weapons against the far wall, though discerning one from another is difficult in the dimly lit space.  A low oak table holding additional weapons threatens to deliver a blow to the shins of distracted shoppers.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Bailey Park]
description: The scent of pine is strong here, and the wall bordering the street is tacky with sap.  A gnarled tree trunk has pushed partly through the stone wall, its branches hugging the stones in an insistent embrace.  Beneath the canopy of needles stands the Bloodriven bank.

The scent of pine is strong here, and the wall bordering the street is tacky with sap, yet the cobblestones are slightly frozen over.  A gnarled tree trunk has pushed partly through the stone wall, its branches heavily laden with blown glass ornaments.  Beneath the canopy of glass stands the Bloodriven bank.

title: [Winter Rose Garden]
description: Enclosed by a tall wrought iron fence covered in frost, this small circular space is peaceful and quiet.  Bright winter roses in dozens of different hues are scattered around the perimeter of the circle, the plants crawling up the fence and surrounding the space in winding green vines and splashes of vibrant color.  A long modwir bench is placed in the center of the cobblestone circle, facing the entrance to the shrine.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Courtyard]
description: Large glaes orbs fixed along the walls cast a dim green-yellow light throughout the tunnel, and add a rich tint to the otherwise pale lichen that has formed along the stone.  Neatly placed cobblestones lead to the manor's carved haon door which is set directly into the solid stone wall.  A rough-hewn donation bin has been tucked into a small crevice in the rock, and a large gilded plaque is affixed to the front of the door.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Bailey Park]
description: An abandoned two-story building stands nearly against the stone wall, leaving only a small dark space between.  The tracks of small creatures, likely rats, lead toward the gap, while next to the door, a pile of hard, dry droppings litters the front step.

An abandoned two-story building stands nearly against the stone wall, the small space between the two occupied by a coal-eyed snowman.  The tracks of small creatures, likely rats, lead toward the gap, while next to the door, a pile of hard, dry droppings litters the front step, lightly dusted by snowfall.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Copper Road]
description: Crowded plaster buildings overlook the incredibly narrow road, their faces pockmarked with missing stucco.  Chipped bricks line the road but quickly transition to packed dirt as the street progresses away from the alley and to the west.  Bent at a funny angle, a single lamppost is planted amid the crumbling stonework.

Crowded plaster buildings overlook the incredibly narrow road, their faces pockmarked with missing stucco.  Chipped bricks line the road, but quickly transition to packed dirt as the street progresses away from the alley and to the west.  Bent at a funny angle, a single lamppost is planted amid the crumbling stonework.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Copper Road]
description: Thick oak poles form the framework and facade of a small tavern, while the rough boards of the walls still bear the greenish tinge of new lumber.  Trampled grasses attempt to maintain their claim on this once vacant lot, but the stamp of foot traffic proclaims it a lost battle.

Thick ribbon-latticed poles form the framework and facade of a small tavern, while the rough boards of the walls still bear the greenish tinge of new lumber.  Colorful spheres of thin glass dangle from ropes hoisted around the tavern, casting faint patterns with the ambient light.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Copper Road]
description: Sculptural holly bushes and fir trees line the side of the narrow road, their ribbon-wrapped pots startlingly bright against the ground of packed dirt and snow.  Overcrowded buildings swallow up the open air to the south and west, their slanted roofs nearly blotting out the sky.  From somewhere nearby, the scent of freshly cut wood is at odds with that of stale ale.

Clumps of excavated grass lie in browning piles upon the side of the narrow road, their white roots startlingly bright against the ground of packed dirt and grey pebbles.  Overcrowded buildings swallow up the open air to the south and west, their slanted roofs nearly blotting out the sky.  From somewhere nearby, the scent of freshly cut wood is at odds with that of stale ale.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: This section of road is almost entirely hard-packed dirt, although pits the size of small stones hold their shape here and there.  A nondescript building stands on the eastern side, its front porch leaning to one side, while an unstable pyramid of cobblestones stands adjacent.

This section of road is almost entirely hard-packed dirt, the surface covered in various clumps of snow left between deep footprints leading to and away from the area.  A nondescript building stands on the eastern side, its front porch decorated by fragrant wreaths, while an unstable pyramid of cobblestones stands adjacent.

title: [Autumnal Den, Outfitters]
description: Large bundles of ribbon-tied triticum wheat flank the entrance to this small shop, dimly lit by evergreen-scented candles whose wicks crackle and pop as they burn.  Few decorations adorn the bare walls save a small hollowed-out niche, and a cloth-draped table that displays a variety of armor is positioned diagonally in the corner.

title: [Crosswinds and Crosshairs]
description: Crude wooden planks make up much of the interior of this wagon, with large battered cogs and sheets of metal secured to the walls with uneven rivets serving as the only decoration.  One wall is covered with brass hooks in a haphazard fashion to display wares behind a worn counter.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Blot Alley]
description: Chipped cobblestones scattered along the alley conspire with the street's acclivity, challenging pedestrians to pass through with ankles untwisted.  A dusty pile of crumbled brick and mortar lies beneath a chipped-up section of the eastern brick wall.

Slush-covered cobblestones scattered along the alley conspire with the street's acclivity, challenging pedestrians to pass through with ankles untwisted.  An unidentifiable pile of material lies beneath a chipped-up section of the eastern brick wall, covered in a thick layer of snow.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Faida Lane]
description: The lane narrows noticeably as it slopes northwestward.  A building along the side of the road is streaked with a sticky, shiny substance that is slowly dripping from the pine that leans precariously over it.  A dark alleyway stands between two somewhat dilapidated buildings on the western side of the street.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Gamac's Goods, Back Room]
description: Steel-banded oak kegs are stacked against the far wall, creating a backdrop for a dicing game in progress.  A pair of glass-eyed forms are stationed by the door, their gaze seeming to follow you around the room.  An overturned bin and an opened crate provide makeshift seating in one dark corner.

Steel-banded oak kegs are stacked against the far wall, creating a backdrop for a dicing game in progress.  A pair of glass-eyed mannequins are stationed by the door, their gaze seeming to follow you around the room.  An overturned bin and an opened crate provide makeshift seating in one dark corner.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: Battered cobblestones line the muddy roadway, wispy weeds poking out between wide gaps.  Broken glass bottles have been swept haphazardly against the side of the battered stone wall marking the outer border of the village, thick forests blocking any visibility beyond.

Slush-covered cobblestones line the muddy roadway, heavy iron braziers poking out between wide gaps.  Tall holly bushes have been lined against the side of the battered stone wall marking the outer border of the village, thick forests blocking any visibility beyond.

title: [The Messy Alchemist]
description: Dozens upon dozens of colorful flasks and ampoules are strewn across the worktable and a counter spanning across a goodly portion of the low-ceilinged room.  The remainder of the room is filled with a scattering of benches and chairs, several of which are topped with various odds and ends.  Especially startling in the dim lighting, glowing stains of bright blues and greens are splattered across the black walls in a sort of artistically messy display and reflected in a series of tall mirrors.

title: [The Messy Alchemist, Hallway]
description: Black walls are lined with windows that are painted over so darkly that it's impossible to see out of them.  Brilliant glowing pink and blue paint marks up the walls in large splashes of color, illuminating a purple-painted archway and a threadbare rug with green hexagonal patterning on it.  A finely carved wooden desk sprawls out in the middle of the hallway, blocking part of the passage.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: The branches of a fragrant fir extend between two faded buildings on the western side of the road.  A small bird's nest sits on one of the higher limbs, bobbing in the breeze over the heads of passersby.

The snow-covered branches of a fragrant fir extend between two faded buildings on the western side of the road.  A small bird's nest sits on one of the higher limbs, bobbing in the breeze between long ribbons of green and red.

title: [High Spirits]
description: A round stained glass window patterned with brightly colored flowers appears oddly out of place on the far wall of this cramped space.  Dusty oak planks have been pried up from underfoot, the broken floorboards scattered about, the resulting pitfalls lying in wait for the unsuspecting ankle.  An overturned metal trunk and a cracked glass display case are the only remaining furniture, while a large rat's nest in the corner is quite crowded with various discarded treasures.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Gloam Pike]
description: The sharply angled intersection comes to a point at a giant pine tree easily higher than any giantman that may happen by.  The cobblestones are dusted with its needles, providing a slippery yet quietly fragrant path.  An arrow-shaped wooden sign points southeast.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Faida Lane]
description: Stretching high into the horizon to the east are the tall, white-capped peaks of the Dragonspine Mountains, sheer cliffs adorning the slopes like armor.  Battered cobblestones line the road, with tall buildings lining either side of the thoroughfare.  A crumbling stone wall is all that separates the town from the beginning of the mountain slopes.

title: [Spellbound]
description: With barely enough room to move around, this cramped space between the two buildings seems more like a trap than anything else.  A small pile of crumbled cement has gathered on the floor beneath a brick that protrudes slightly from the wall.  Trails of fresh rat droppings lead between a sigil-incised display case and a rune-covered wooden crate.

title: [Bolt From The Blue]
description: The narrow walls are painted in shades of midnight blue and stormy grey, the paler hues sweeping in spiraling arcs around a rectangular seascape painting at the back.  On opposite sides of the room, a dark-grained mistwood case and a carved white pine chest symmetrically mirror the position of a broad willow-planked hutch, each container illuminated by a solitary hanging silver lantern.

title: [A Mist Opportunity]
description: Dark mist covers the ground, completely obscuring the floorboards that are evident only by a faint creaking noise produced with each footstep.  Painted in deep crimson, a sturdy weapon rack sits off to the side, and a luminescent crystal orb, filled with a swirling black mass, has been affixed to the top of a black marble stand.  Additional weaponry has been carefully hung from mithril wall hooks.

title: [Spellbound, Crevice]
description: Collapsing cement blocks are surrounded by cascading dirt and debris that integrate into a filthy rubble at the base of the side wall.  Imposing upon most of the space, a dilapidated birch shelf, a hole-riddled plank, and a decaying oaken slab are haphazardly lodged in the cramped, dingy crevice.

Collapsing cement blocks are surrounded by cascading dirt and debris that integrate into a filthy rubble at the base of the side wall.  Imposing upon most of the space, a dilapidated birch shelf and a decaying oaken slab are haphazardly lodged in the cramped, dingy crevice.

title: [Bolt From The Blue, Niche]
description: A faint note of ozone hangs lightly in the air, aptly playing off the sky blue tones used in the niche's interior.  Finely honed woodworking skills are presented in the forms of a glossy mahogany counter and a lacquered oak table placed at the center of the space.  Stacked neatly at the back, some golden bramblespine crates sit next to an oversized iron-bound trunk that is incised with an array of silvery glyphs and symbols.

A faint note of ozone hangs lightly in the air, aptly playing off the sky blue tones used in the niche's interior.  Finely honed woodworking skills are presented in the forms of a glossy mahogany counter and a lacquered oak table placed at the center of the space.  Stacked neatly at the back, some golden spinewood crates sit next to an oversized iron-bound trunk that is incised with an array of silvery glyphs and symbols.

title: [Bolt From The Blue, Nook]
description: Ivory-swept dark grey silk walls wrap around the semi-circular nook area, providing a pleasingly stark backdrop for a pewter-set ivory stand and a beveled ironwood sideboard.  Tiny clusters of silvery lights are suspended in a gentle wave configuration from the ceiling, illuminating an ornate willow receptacle resting in the middle of the room.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Pell Square]
description: Unlike the village's typically narrow thoroughfares, the streets in either direction widen and join to form this comfortably spacious plaza.  The plaster-covered walls of the buildings are in better repair than in other neighborhoods, and the gates around a heavily wooded path leading toward Duskruin Arena are free of rust.

Unlike the village's typically narrow thoroughfares, the streets in either direction widen and join to form this comfortably spacious plaza, the space filled with colorful decorations and lights strung from side to side.  The plaster-covered walls of the buildings are in better repair than in other neighborhoods, and the gates around a heavily wooded path leading toward Duskruin Arena are free of rust, each one adorned with a large wreath.

title: [Duskruin Approach]
description: A well-traveled dirt path winds among the dense evergreens that grow tall despite the overbearing shadow of the Dragonspine Mountains.  Torches roar on either side of an enormous iron portcullis that ascends into the very mountainside.  A series of metal letters has been anchored to the rocky surface with metal spikes.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Faida Lane]
description: Scraps of paper litter the shadowy entrance to a dark alleyway.  From the southeast comes the faint sound of off-key tinkling, while any passing footsteps are muffled by the abundance of pine needles scattered on the cobblestone road.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Mark Alley]
description: The scent of decay is prolific in this narrow alleyway.  A pile of wet, rotting leaves is obviously partly responsible, though something hidden beneath it likely contributes.  A single broad cobweb connects two balconies on either side of the street, hanging only slightly higher than an average human.

The scent of cold air and decay is prolific in this narrow alleyway.  A pile of snow-layered, rotting leaves is obviously partly responsible, though something hidden beneath it likely contributes.  A single garland of unknown fauna connects two balconies on either side of the street, hanging only slightly higher than an average human.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Faida Lane]
description: The canted balconies of the buildings that line the street are in permanent shadow from the towering Dragonspine to the east.  A dented wind chime hangs from one such terrace, offering discordant clanking with every breeze.

title: [Cacographic Critters]
description: Rough-hewn planks form the walls of this cramped shed, and chilled drafts attest to the lack of skill in their assemblage into their current configuration.  In sharp contrast to the shack and the questionable nature of its continued existence, a polished brass lantern rests atop a glass-fronted case that stands in the middle of the floor.  Its glow illuminates the case, a small velvet-topped table to one side, and some free-standing shelves holding stacks of writing materials, each stack topped by a rock to keep the sheets off the floor.

title: [Black Hand, Old Warehouse]
description: The large double sliding doors open to a poorly lit warehouse with a thick cedar floor covered with dust and scuff marks.  Stacks of crates and boxes occupy several marked locations on the floor, designated for storage and delivery.  Near the rear wall is a simple wooden desk covered in piles of stained paper.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Pewter Road]
description: Opening slightly to the south, the narrow street transitions with great difficulty from dingy alley to an actual road.  Debris and refuse spill beyond the confines of the alley onto the crowded path, though someone has made an attempt at containing a portion of the mess by building a small dam of cobblestones in the middle of the street.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Pewter Road]
description: Perched at the apex of the narrow street is a small grey stone house with a slanted roof and a front garden of nightshade, monkshood, columbine, and wood anemone.  Grey and blue stones, mixed with crushed seashells, act as a segue between the solid oak door of the abode and the packed dirt road.  A painted wooden sign, anchored by wrought iron near the peak of the roof, creaks in an ambient breeze.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Pewter Road]
description: Slipping between terraces, the narrow street is littered with uneven cobblestones and copper-banded rain barrels.  Balconies, draped with an assortment of drying clothes, crowd the air above and do little to lighten the prevailing gloom.  The cloying scent of flowers wages war with that of the pervading mildew and moss.

Slipping between terraces, the narrow street is littered with slippery cobblestones and holly-strewn barrels.  Balconies, draped with an assortment of colorful scarves, crowd the air above and lighten the prevailing gloom.  The cloying scent of cinnamon wages war with that of the pervading woodsmoke.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Bailey Park]
description: The stone wall angles sharply as the road turns to the northwest.  Nestled in the corner, a neat brick building is shaded by the towering cedars and pines.

title: [The Best Tressed]
description: Heavily patterned curtains made from forest-motifed figury flank a wide bay window at the back of the shop, casting faint sunlight over the richly polished mahogany floors and maoral walls.  Ornately woodworked banisters leading toward the southern wing extend from a glass-housed case appointed at the middle of the room.

title: duplicate
description: The scent of oil mixes with that of pine in front of a narrow storefront.  The bear pelt mat before it is stained and matted.  From the east come sounds of clicking and clacking, so consistant as to almost be a chant.  The wall bordering the road is stained in one place with a few dark red-brown handprints.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Bailey Park]
description: The scent of oil mixes with that of pine in front of a narrow storefront.  The bear pelt mat before it is stained and matted.  From the east come sounds of clicking and clacking, so consistant as to almost be a chant.  The wall bordering the road is stained in one place with a few dark red-brown handprints.

The scent of oil mixes with that of pine in front of a narrow storefront.  The bear pelt mat before it has been matted from melted snow and salt.  From the east come sounds of off-key singing and musical instruments.  The wall bordering the road has been decorated by ribbon-wrapped wreaths of fragrant fir boughs.

title: [Abandoned Building]
description: Not a single piece of furniture is left in this dusty room.  A splintered crate filled with random litter sits against one wall, beneath a cracked and dirty window.  The air holds a foul, musty odor that emanates strongly from the piles of rat droppings located in the shadowy corners.

title: [The Best Tressed, Salon]
description: Lacquered floors of deep red mahogany and ruic parquetry fan outward from the entry banisters, the rich colors highlighted by simpler woodland tapestries hanging on the walls.  Positioned for browsing, a line of rounded glass displays and an elongated carved monir shelf boast a variegated plethora of ornately styled wigs and canisters.

title: [The Best Tressed, Studio]
description: The florid red-golden hues of dawn are showcased in a sprawling sunburst parquetry gracing the maoral flooring of the modest studio.  Occupying the majority of the furthest wall, an oval-shaped smooth glass mirror is attractively suspended above a tufted fine leather divan.

title: [Black Hand, Foyer]
description: The focal point of the expansive room is a swirled sanguine glaes chandelier, the dim candlelight illuminating the cavern.  Draped decoratively across the walls is tone-on-tone ivory bourde, the fabric framing a black willow sideboard.  Various tunnels allow further passage into the cave, and at each entrance, two large charcoal velvet armchairs sit opposite from each other.  Etched vaalin sconces line the winding slate stone steps as they continue downwards.
tags: meta:mapname:Black Hand Trading Company - Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Dark and Dangerous, Armor]
description: Weathered planks of dark mahogany line the walls of this tiny, windowless space.  Multiple iron hooks, each mounted within a grinning skull bracket, display armor against the far well.  Conducting a thorough examination of each piece could prove difficult in the dimly lit space.  A fungi-covered oak plank is propped up, right in the middle of the floor, waiting to trip the unwary shopper.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Exterior]
description: The cobblestones are crumbling on this stretch of the path.  Alongside the road, wagon wheel-sized ruts run deep in the dirt, and a broken wheel lays forgotten in the high weeds.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Exterior]
description: Mingled scents of tanik and cedar fill the air as dense fir trees crowd the remains of the cobblestone and dirt road, which ends abruptly at the dark waters of a wide river.  A wooden dock stretches into the river where a sailing vessel bobs in the rushing waters, while nearby a few benches sit near the stone wall amidst the remnants of an abandoned card game.

Mingled scents of tanik and cedar fill the air as dense fir trees crowd the remains of the cobblestone and dirt road, which ends abruptly at the dark waters of a wide river.  A dilapidated wooden dock appears to have rotted away almost entirely, while nearby a few benches sit near the stone wall amidst the remnants of an abandoned card game.

Mingled scents of woodsmoke and ozone fill the air as bare tree skeletons crowd the remains of the cobblestone and dirt road, which ends abruptly at the dark frozen waters of a wide river.  A wooden dock stretches into the river where a sailing vessel sits trapped in the unmoving waters, while nearby a few benches sit near the stone wall amidst the remnants of a lopsided snowman.

title: [Bloodriven Village, River Bank]
description: Feeding in through the Locksmehr River to the south, dark waters flow north from the wide watercourse.  The shore is narrow, and the only pathway is a muddy trail leading up the river bank.

Small tributaries feed into the Locksmehr River, creating a wide watercourse filled with swiftly flowing dark waters that eventually empty into Darkstone Bay.  The narrow shoreline follows the river's edge, the newly shorn grasses providing a rundown hovel in the distance, while nearer at hand a muddy trail provides the only pathway up the riverbank to the city gates.

Small frozen tributaries feed into the Locksmehr River, creating a wide solid watercourse filled with dark ice that leads into Darkstone Bay. The narrow shoreline follows the river's edge, the barren ground providing a rundown hovel in the distance, while nearer at hand a ice and mud-covered trail provides the only pathway up the riverbank to the city gates.

title: [Journey's End, Willow]
description: Careful cultivation made this willow into a functional platform.  The trunk and its adjoining branches grow right into the wood plank edges.  Silk pillows have been scattered about the lofty retreat to add a touch of comfort.  Looking out across the landscape, Seethe Naedal rises high to the west, its domed observatory aglow in the sunlight.  To the east, a pair of bridges, one light and one dark, hover in the air above the city, creating visual markers that lead directly to the Sapphire Gate far below.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Scrip Shop]
description: Luminescent green moss lines the slick stone walls of this small chamber and provides adequate lighting despite a lack of windows or candles.  Thin pathways between various sized containers and tables impede navigation to a beaded curtain.

Luminescent green moss lines the slick stone walls of this small chamber and provides adequate lighting despite a lack of windows or candles.  Thin pathways between various sized containers and tables impede navigation.

title: [Black Hand, Grotto]
description: A cool draft occasionally permeates the dark stone walls lined with torches, their disturbed flames casting sinister shadows against the barrel vault ceiling.  Some warcat skin rugs cover the cold stone floor to offer some semblance of comfort around a large obsidian table naturally formed out of the ground, the piece flanked by some dark ash chairs.

title: [Black Hand, Brewery]
description: The air is slightly damp, the silence of the rocky chamber broken by the quiet sound of water dripping far off in the distance.  A tremendous copper drum rises from the floor in the center of the room, tapering to a rounded peak near the ceiling to form a massive still.  Old, iron-banded vats line the walls, forming two rows of oak aisles among the space.  Off to the side, an ebonwood table holds some corked bottles of pale liquid, while a charcoal marble fireplace provides the only light in the space.

title: [Black Hand, Draccor's Haunt]
[Black Hand, Game Room]
description: The energy of the cavern echoes off the walls as patrons are camouflaged under a thick haze of hazelnut cigar smoke.  Sanguine leather bar stools line a sturdy ebonwood bar that curves outward to provide ample room behind the bar for shelves of various liquor from across Elanthia.  The expansive floor plan opens up to reveal a dart board, which receives the only splash of light in the grotto.  A dimly lit inlet in the rock houses a series of sleek cream leather booths creating an intimate atmosphere.

title: [Black Hand, Docks]
description: The dark cavern's cool air carries a musty scent of damp wood and stone.  Torches along the rough stone walls offer just enough flame to blacken the craggy ceiling above them.  Obsidian black water surrounds a pair of weathered wooden docks that terminate at large fel-framed doors crudely carved into the cavern wall.  An old, tethered rowboat facing the cavern mouth occasionally draws near its anchor post and knocks against it.

title: [Black Hand, Kitchen]
description: A swinging fel door affords entry into a spacious kitchen, its walls lined with rich mahogany cupboards filled with black glaes dishware, bottles and jars.  The black marble countertops are laden with heavy maoral cutting boards and razor-sharp knives.  Dominating one entire wall is a large bookcase with rows and rows of dusty and worn books.  A gilt-framed picture hangs slightly askew next to the bookcase.

title: [Black Hand, Supply Room]
description: A plush velvet charcoal sofa wraps around the cavern walls, and large pieces of aubergine ramie silk drape down from the ceiling providing a pop of color and texture to the room.  Spaced evenly in front of the long sofa are rounded glaes tables etched with a tessellated pattern.  Carved into the far wall is a huge steel vault, gems and coins scattered across the stone floor in front.  Silhouettes of different shapes fill the lounge, the shadows dancing in the warm flicker of some vaalin sconces.

title: [Black Hand, Botanist Lab]
description: The faint smells of tobacco, vanilla, and flora intoxicate the area.  Water tumbles down the eastern side of the cave's wall in a cascading miniature waterfall that forms into a pool surrounded by an array of wildflowers and moss.  A series of intertwining ivy stretches towards a single burst of moonlight that streams through a hole in the ceiling bathing the garden.  Shelves that have been carved into the rock hold an array of vials and flasks, while a burnished kakore table sits off to the corner.

title: [Black Hand, Pantry]
description: The closet is well lit, but so small that it leaves barely enough space to turn around.  An oversized trunk sits at the base of one wall, while shelves rise to the ceiling lining two more walls.

title: [Paupers, Vault]
description: This is a secluded alcove toward the rear of the vault.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and rests open on a stone counter.
