title: [Wiggim's Charms]
description: This sturdy wooden stand has been spruced up after several years of neglect.  Braided woolen throw rugs dot the well-swept floors, and a fresh coat of bright blue paint covers the walls.  The room itself is cluttered with a wide variety of tables, display cases, and other containers each bursting with odds and ends for sale.  A few light drafts of bitingly cold air enter through some holes spaced randomly about the floorboards.

title: [A Multi-Colored Wagon]
description: Darkly stained oak boards span the width of the floor and are polished to a high sheen.  Lengths of gauzy fabric in a multitude of colors drape from the pinnacle of the ceiling to attach various rings set into the walls.  Oversized pillows fill the corners, and a square mirror sits on a small stand.

title: [Fenog's Regulars, Encampment]
description: Staggered rows of densely packed coniferous trees block out the howling wind and snow to form a welcoming encirclement.  Twin guard towers stand to protect the entrance to this naturally formed palisade.  A few of the surrounding trees have been cut down to stumps which have been crudely carved into seating around a cozy, stone-lined fire pit.  Flanked by small patches of moonflowers, an ornate wooden bridge stretches across the half-frozen stream to a vast lodge.

title: [Inking Den, Annex Hallway]
description: Frosted globes nestled within decorative wall sconces provide a steady glow of welcoming light down the long corridor.  The walls are hidden behind bright ivory white silk drapery, the soft ends of which pool upon the thick cerulean and azure carpet.  Built into opposing walls, a lacquered beige door and a lacquered white door part the drapery and have a trio of brightly glowing globes directly above their pointed, cinquefoil frames.

title: [Fenog's, Assembly Annex]
description: A life-sized statue of a giantman wielding dual claidhmores guards the entrance to the hall.  A series of oil-lit chandeliers hang from the ceiling, brightening the area.  Dozens of cushioned high back chairs are arranged around a large circular hoarbeam table.  A display case housing battered elven armor stands along the eastern wall.  An enormous fireplace with a large polar bear rug arranged in front, and an eloquent faewood plaque hanging above it take up almost one wall.

title: [Fenog's Lodge, Dining Hall]
description: A long wooden table stands in the center of the room surrounded by high-backed chairs with crushed velvet seats.  Inviting smells of honey-sweet glazes, roasting vegetables, and an array of herbs waft from the kitchen beyond the swinging doors where a bustle of staff move in and out.  Beyond the doors, an occasional loud crash can be heard, followed quickly by a bellowing voice spewing profanities.  A small sturdy brass heating stove sits in the corner next to a slatted wooden bin.

title: [Fenog's, Celebration Hall]
description: Inlaid in the center of the circular room is a round parquet dance floor.  Several inviting crescent-shaped couches scattered with soft fur pillows are nestled along the walls.  An orb-shaped chandelier set with bits of mirrored stained glass reflects the light from surrounding sconces, setting a soft ambience.  A stately curved hoarbeam bar stands lined with a variety colorful glasses and trays.  A small, shield-shaped dart board hangs on the wall beneath a red banner of a great black wolf.

title: [Fenog's Regulars, Frozen Pond]
description: A small wooden dock juts out into the center of the frozen pond where a hole has been carved into the ice, providing access to the fish deep below.  A rhimar-lined chest sits beside a large fallen limb that is carved with a scene of two friends fishing from a dock.  A sizable slug appears to be making its way slowly across a large nearby rock.  A pair of lor trees guard a curved path of small snowberry bushes covered in a thin frost.

title: [Fenog's Regulars, Barracks]
description: Padded training dummies are placed beside the long weapons rack that covers the western wall.  The floorboards have been removed at the center to reveal a white sand sparring area.  A series of mannequins display armor of all types beside a long footlocker.  A narrow corridor leads back to a room full of plain cots.  Small alcoves lead to tunnels with life-sized archery dummies and various targets.  The rear wall is dominated by a scarlet banner stitched with a fearsome direwolf bearing large fangs.

title: [Fenog's Regulars, Hot Springs]
description: A natural rock formation catches the water from the spring before spilling over the far side, making the small basin deep enough for several giants to relax comfortably.  Lush greenery surrounds the rocks due to the high temperatures exuded by the water's surface.  On the eastern side of the bath is the nearest snow-capped mountain face, with a grand view of the back of the lodge to the south.  Local birds have settled in the surrounding trees, with sounds of offspring coming from the nests.

title: [Unpredictable Outcomes, Shop]
description: It's difficult to grasp the full size of this dilapidated shop from the inside.  Towering stacks of ephemera create narrow passageways through this treasure trove of novelties.  Dim lighting casts the dusty stacks in a macabre light, concealing more than it reveals.  An inexplicable display is prominently featured in the cramped space, dominating one entire wall.  The claustrophobic path winds its way towards a shadowy doorway.

title: [Unpredictable Outcomes, Aviary]
description: A panoply of unusual and eclectic items are stacked high against the walls of this gloomy room.  A wan light casts a feeble, flickering glow over dusty wares, leaving several heavy shadows mostly undisturbed.  The center of the room is dominated by a hulking wrought iron birdcage that stands within a wide circle notably free of debris.  An ornate sign at the base of the cage proudly proclaims, "The Aviary," elegantly etched in Common.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Eastern Dock]
description: The watchful moons wax and wane in the halcyon skies, allowing only the far-flung crystalline stars to pierce the weighty darkness alongside their presence.  Just enough light is present in the west to delineate the opaque silhouettes of numerous seaworthy vessels that sail upon distant waters, staggered at varying spots in the briny deep.  Granular beads of rime speckle the slender arm of a curving blonde oak pier that embraces the nearest shoulder of the beach.

title: [Adventurers' Rest, Ruby Lounge]
description: A warm glow from the massive fireplace to your left provides an abundance of heat and light.  A chaise covered in burgundy damask rests against the wall to your right, beneath a large painting in a heavy gilt frame.
tags: meta:locker annex:House of the Rising Phoenix

title: [Needle of Pentas, Apex]
description: Rising from a perfect hole in the granite floor, a spiral staircase spills into the room amid a halo of five golden mirrors that reflect the moonlight in all directions.  Alabaster, carnelian, aventurine, onyx, and azurite tiles form half circles upon the floor, their open-ends facing matching half-circle archways that lead towards illuminated balconies.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Order]
description: Providing egress to both the floor above and the one below, a golden linden spiral staircase dominates the center of this circular landing fashioned of alabaster stones.  Gauzy curtains of translucent white are bound in golden rings to create a cloudy-like halo that encircles a round west-facing window.  Five bright white globes dangle from the ceiling, their dormant interiors points of darkness in the sunlight.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Chaos]
description: Ebon tiles, speckled with rainbow-hued mica, are fitted amongst oddly shaped onyx slabs to form the floor and ceiling of this compact chamber.  Golden chains descend from the ceiling to support obsidian bowls that are filled with fire, their flickering light creating chaotic patterns upon the reflective walls.  Moonlight invades the space via a round east-facing window and casts its silvery light upon a golden linden spiral staircase that offers passage to the upper and lower chambers.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Elemental]
description: Verdant green tiles are fitted with moss-green stones in an alternating pattern that grows darker and more solid as it ascends to the chamber's ceiling.  Blown glass orbs, five in total, encircle a simple, spiral staircase, while a viridian and agate bench pays homage to a round southeast-facing window.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Spiritual]
description: Lapis lazuli bands traverse the icy blue granite walls, the inlay forming a spiraling effect that ascends from the high ceiling to the smooth floor.  Lidless jars, hung aloft by golden chains, house hundreds of fireflies, which create a soft glow of light at all times of day and night in the small chamber.  To the southwest, a round window is framed with blue opal cabochons, while the center is filled with an ascending and descending staircase.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Planar]
description: Large and small blocks of granite transition from rose to crimson within this small chamber, the gradient hues becoming pale enough to be nearly white in one section, while the opposite section is nearly black.  Star-shaped stained glass lanterns dangle from the ceiling around a golden linden spiral staircase that leads both up and down.  Beneath a southwestern-facing window, a cushioned bench of sanguine and mauve provides a comfortable resting place.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Foyer]
description: Fine-grained and weathered granite blocks, ranging in size from small and flat rectangles to thick and large squares, form the walls and ceiling of the circular chamber.  Towering archways, five in total, are evenly spaced throughout, their hazy openings glowing with a dim light.  Five teardrop-shaped lanterns dangle from golden chains around a central, spiral staircase that ascends to the floor above.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest, out

title: [Isle of Ornath, the Needle]
description: High travertine walls line the avenue before giving way to manicured cypress trees that stretch towards the star-spangled sky.  Quintuple rings, each overlapping the other, are inlaid into the smooth, glass-like walls that flank the open doublewide doors leading into the Needle of Pentas.  Brightly glowing frosted globes dangle over the entry, the fiery spheres dispelling the encroaching night.

title: [Garden of the Spirit, Entry]
description: Moonlight reflects off of the cobalt blue tiles of the garden pathway, its soft and luminous light lending the incredibly smooth, glass-like travertine walls of the Needle of Pentas a frosted appearance.  An arched awning of haon and glass provides the rounded entry with protection from the elements, while small white statues cupping brightly glowing orbs in their hands line the pathway.  Bushes of indigo butterflyweed occupy every bit of untiled ground and house tiny bowls of nectar in their depths.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Garden of the Spirit, Fountain]
description: Cobalt tiled pathways surrounded in bright yellow moss converge upon this small courtyard, which is filled with the soft sound of mechanical buzzing and purring.  At the heart of the space, a half-wall of metallic parrots lifts from the glass-like surface of a small pool of water recessed into the ground.  Rising from the aquatic depths, a beautiful copper statue greets a copper and carnelian sun that is brightly illuminated by some unseen source.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Garden of the Spirit]
description: Ambling down the hill-like incline of the northeastern section of gardens, a small brook lined with silvery-grey limestone pebbles passes beneath the cobalt blue tiles as it travels to the southeast.  In the higher reaches, long stalks of blue irises bend their curving limbs towards the cool waters as if paying homage to its passage.  Nearer at hand, the short-stemmed glory-of-the-snow blossoms dance around the edges of a mossy bank that sprouts indigo woodland crocuses.

title: [Garden of the Spirit, Lawn]
description: Encircled by a low travertine wall, the manicured lawn is pockmarked with tidy, dwarf mounds of verdant blue fescue and silvery blue oatgrass.  Smooth limestone boulders are arranged in evenly spaced, semicircular rows that face a copper and haon lectern in the southwestern section of the expanse.  High above and stretching from one end of the lawn to the other, a canopy of loosely woven netting dangle a plethora of frosted globes that dispel the darkness from the this section of the gardens.

title: [Garden of the Planes, Lawn]
description: Garnet sweetspire forms a decorative border to the lush lawn of cultivated and manicured grass, which spreads its luscious grass from the bright cobbled pathway to the low travertine wall at its far end.  Purplish-red fountain grass sprouts up in various locations, lanterns housed in their cascading depths.  Positioned beneath an umbrella of golden orbs, a small wooden lectern holds court over the lawn.

title: [Garden of the Planes, Entry]
description: Cream-hued travertine walls, incredibly smooth and glass-like in appearance, are interrupted by an ironwood portal wrought in the shape of a ring that is partially imbedded in bright red brick cobblestones.  Protecting the entry from the elements is an umbrella-like awning fashioned of lacquered wooden slates, its ends dangling bright lanterns that have eahnor rooves.  A blown glass hummingbird feeder rests to the north of the path, its wrought iron supports hidden amid a wealth of showy camelia bushes.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Garden of the Planes]
description: Bordered in travertine, cobalt, and pink soapstone, several tiered garden beds rise from the pathway's bright red cobblestones towards the garden's high walls.  Red sunflowers nod their dark heads from the upper tiers, while a bed of autumn-hued verbena holds the middle ground.  Coral-hued coneflowers give way to the ruffled spikes of canna buds upon the lowest basin.

title: [Garden of the Planes, Tree]
description: Towering over the garden walls, an enormous ironwood tree stretches its broad fingers towards the sky as if reaching for the apex of the Needle of Pentas.  Broad leaves of a pale green hue wreathe the arboreal giant, while small, blood red blossoms decorate its lower boughs, which are laden with tiny prismatic baubles.  A low stone bench rests within crimson gravel along the southeastern bend of the cobbled pathway.

title: [Garden of the Planes, Fountain]
description: Concentric bands of alternating cobalt, alabaster, and crimson-hued bricks spread outward from a shallow broad-basined fountain, the carefully crafted rings artistically blending with the various pathways that wend their way through the gardens.  Golden mirrors fitted with fitfully burning votives are positioned at various intervals within the foliage, the moonlight playing off of the prisms positioned before them.  Two wrought iron tables provide refreshments, while red geode benches offer space for repose.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Garden of the Planes, Trellis]
description: Thick vines are draped across a series of river-reed arbors, the linked structures forming a tunnel down this section of the brick cobbled garden pathway.  Shadows lay heavy upon the area, with faint glimpses of moonlight peaking between the verdant leaves and the burgundy blossoms that resemble bright red child's pinwheels.  Carefully placed amid the colorful mandevilla vines are tiny blown glass orbs that emit a warm, golden radiance.

title: [Garden of Order, Entry]
description: Sheltered from the elements, the entry to the Needle of Pentas is wreathed in an arched trellis arbor of bright white that is blanketed in ice white climbing roses.  Carefully hidden amid the verdant leaves, frosted globes shine brightly and dispel the encroaching darkness of the night.  Crushed sea shells line the pathway of the garden, the rainbow-hues of their nacre dazzling in the moonlight.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Garden of Chaos, Entry]
description: High travertine walls converge upon an enormous dome that completely seals the garden off from the outside elements.  Waves of hot, arid air radiate outward from the russet terracotta tiles that form the ambling pathways, while dimly glowing lights lend the area a feeling of perpetual twilight.  Two large, blackened stone boulders flank the entry like silent sentinels.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [Garden of the Elements, Entry]
description: Blankets of verdant moss surround the smooth limestones of the pathway, their rounded edges appearing like floating islands in a sea of green that stretch away from the glass-like travertine walls of the Needle of Pentas before disappearing into the garden.  Moonlight and shadows place across the sea glass panels of the awning above, its protective shelter affixed to the walls with brass and modwir supports.  A pair of large terracotta planters housing several spiky bougainvillea vines rest by the entry.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Pentas Avenue]
description: Brightly glowing globes of frosted glass stand upon high wrought iron pools, the distant spheres dispelling the darkness that wreathes the travertine spire to the north.  Carefully groomed cypress trees, grown incredibly close to the avenue, mimic the shape of the structure and block view of the landscape beyond.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Pentas Avenue]
description: Smooth gold-veined tiles line the narrow lane, their edges inlaid with red, blue, green, black, and white circles that overlap in labyrinthine designs.  Verdant cypress trees sway in a breeze that hints at the scent of the sea, heady roses, and delectable cuisines, while the star-spangled night sky enhances the soft glow of the distant travertine spire.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Isle of Ornath, Pentas Avenue]
description: Cultivated cypress trees line the gold-veined marble pathway that stretches from a pillar-sided gazebo towards a towering spire fashioned of smooth travertine.  Red, blue, green, and black reflect off the walls of the distant structure, which is pearly white against the dark of the night sky.  The distant sound of wind slipping through trees permeates the area.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Landing]
description: Smooth, white travertine walls painted with colorful murals are interrupted by pillars of gold-veined white marble, each of which helps to support the golden dome that caps this small room.  Tiles of red, blue, green, black, and white form concentric bands upon the ground, the center of which is a glowing ring of varicolored light.  An open archway, lined in arcane symbols, provides egress from the small structure.

title: duplicate of 17519
description: Someone messed up the mapdb with this room, which I am whiting out.

title: [Garden of the Spirit, Shelter]
description: Fashioned of haon, an arched tunnel trellis creates a connective corridor between the northern and southern ends of the garden.  Cobalt blue tiles surrounded by a thick, golden moss fill the pathway, while tiny statues fashioned of marble hold brightly glowing orbs aloft in their intricately carved hands.  Bands of amethyst, indigo, and niveous wisteria blossoms dangle between the slats like floral icicles that release their gentle, sweet fragrance in the air.

title: [Garden of the Spirit, Tree]
description: Verdant green moss forms an organic carpet along the northeastern edge of the pathway, the fuzzy blend terminating at a granite ring of smooth stones that create a border to small pools that house koi fish and lily pads.  Rising from the standing water, and seeming to glow in the moonlight, a towering and ancient haon tree stretches its limbs towards the sky.

title: [Garden of Order, Lawn]
description: Woven together like a tapestry, the lawn that stretches from the crushed seashell pathway to the travertine walls is comprised of various species of plant.  Yellow yarrow, manicured to remain short, mingles with carpet bugle and short daisies to form the higher tiers of the sprawling lawn, while closer to the ground dog fennel, ground ivy, and creeping violets add color and texture to the mix.  Despite the plethora of plant life, nothing is sturdy enough for cultivating but the air carries a rich aroma.

title: [Garden of Order]
description: Twisting its way in an ambling fashion through the gardens, the crushed seashell pathway glitters in the light of the moon and slips between rows of carefully cultivated roses.  Two different scents mingle in this area, the semi-sweet fragrance of the bright pink dog roses nestled in bushes and the heavy, heady scent of the black dragon roses that stand tall on their long stems.

title: [Garden of Order, Tree]
description: Towering over the surrounding lawns of manicured grass, an enormous mimosa tree has grown along the edges of the garden.  Spindled limbs, laden with feathery sprigs, bend away from the travertine walls as they stretch towards the star-spangled.  Large table-like boulder dimple the area, their surfaces covered with tablecloths, food, and fitfully burning candles.

title: [Garden of Order, Fountain]
description: Crushed seashells scatter across the circular court before trailing away to various places in the garden, their pathways lined with frosted lanterns and bright white pebbles.   Constructed of white birch, an ornate pergola occupies the center and is encircled by a ring of gently burbling water, it's source unknown.  Wisteria vines fashioned of enameled copper trail across the structure and twine with faenor-leafed rose vines, beneath which an alluring copper statue stands.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Garden of Order, Shaded Path]
description: Stretching from the Needle's entry to the eastern wall, a long series of arched trellis interconnect to create a tunnel through the gardens.  Vigorously rambling roses weave through the open lattice of the wooden structure, the lavender rosebuds and ivory blossoms adorned with verdant leaves.  Small glass lanterns illuminate the gold-veined marble pathway, while a smooth stone bench provides a place to rest.

title: [Garden of Chaos, Lawn]
description: Thick panes of glass separate the garden from the terracotta tiles of the pathway, the broad expanses protecting the denizens of the enclosure from escape and harm.  Dried-out, dead branches rest at angles against the travertine walls, their crossed limbs home to an enormous grey chuckwalla.  Dark, burnished brown sands litter the ground where flat stones provide sunning spots for an armadillo girdled lizard that is housed in the western section of the garden.

title: [Garden of Chaos, Boulder]
[Garden of Chaos, Fountain]
description: Encircled by towering shards of blackened granite, the large patio is formed of terracotta and illuminated by glazed ceramic torches that rest upon wrought iron tables.  Black sands fill a pit at the center where an enormous boulder is split down the middle, a male statue resting against its cracked face.  On the opposite edges of the sand, a copper female statue crouches.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Garden of Chaos, Tree]
description: Surrounded by a boulder garden of rough stones, an ancient dragon blood tree dominates the garden and provides shelter from the heavy, arid heat produced by the drakar rafters above.  Dozens of blue-flame agave plants grow just beyond the tree's shadow and under the bright glow of a decorative copper sun that is suspended high in the air.  Protected by a triangular glass enclosure, several thorny lizards bask in the heat from their perch upon various smooth stones.

title: [Garden of Chaos, Shadow]
description: Dry heat radiates outward from the drakar rods that are erected within the dark sands of the surrounding gardens, the air rippling with their intensity.  Fulgurite spires, tall and brittle, cast long shadows across the terracotta pathway, while squat barrel cacti form a pale screen of brown and crimson foliage against the travertine walls.  Zorchar disks, strung from thick rafters beneath the enormous domed ceiling, randomly flare with electrical sparks.

title: [Garden of Chaos]
description: Rising from the sand, several desert rose clusters dot the garden with their pale, crystalline heads and glint slightly in the dim light of false stars that are imbedded in the black glass of the garden's dome.  Small calcified shrubs burst from the black sands that surround a salty pond of bright pink, while the skeletal remains of a sea eagle is perched upon a dead log.  Soot, sulfur, and brimstone fill the air with their biting, acrid odor.

title: [Garden of the Elements, Earth]
description: Moss-encircled flagstones lead a sinuous path through the western planter that rise to the east and west of the simple, earthy pathway, while in the manicured lawns to the north, chocolate sunflowers nod their enormous heads in the moonlight.  White-tufted goat willow creates a decorative screen that hides the travertine walls of the garden, while burnished murkweed grows in loose rings around a dark brown statue.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Garden of the Elements, Water]
description: Floored in pale blue limestone, the high walls and domed ceiling isolate this section of the gardens from the rest.  Massive rhimar and glass pillars, five in total, stand at even intervals and exude an extremely cold air that causes nearby plants to be kissed in frost.  An enormous ice sculpture wreathed in pale frostflowers and azure iceblossoms rises at the heart of the garden, its outstretched fingers nearly touching the rhimar-framed roof.

title: [Garden of the Elements, Fire]
description: Moist, steamy air trickles in from the northwest and is heated by ironwood and drakar columns that flank the moss and limestone pathway.  Towering drakefern, larger than can usually be found in the wilderness, create a decorative screen of burnished green that almost completely obscures the travertine walls of the garden.  Crimson lava stones form barriers around a variety of bromelaids, their waxy leaves varied in color and shape, while an enormous red obsidian sculpture rises in the background.

title: [Garden of the Elements, Air]
description: Cold air from the southwest clashes with warm air from the southeast, the combination filling the lush garden with an odd mixture of mist that is enhanced by the travertine steam vents that rise in a curtain along the northern edges.  Verdant mistweed forms a bright groundcover, while pot-bellied pitcher plants and spotted cobra lilies encircle a series of glowing mineral pools that cascade down the garden's high slopes.  The humid air is alive with small and large jewel-toned insects, their zipping bodies and rapidly moving wings filling the air with a soft buzz.

title: [Garden of the Elements, Pool]
description: Yellowish green moss and granite flagstones converge upon the center of the garden where an enormous pool is recessed into the ground, its depths divided into equal quadrants that glow brightly.  Four painted boulders are arranged at various places around the body of water, their painted faces turned towards the statue that sits in its center.  Stone benches and a smattering of wrought iron tables line the edge of the area offering respite for visitors.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Fro-Zone, Interior]
description: A light chill fills the air of this spacious wagon.  Beads of condensation continuously well up and trickle down the rhimar reinforced walls.  Void of decoration, this space appears better suited for supplies than sales.  Several large, square blocks of ice and a large mithril pail rest near a small circular hatch in the opposing wall.

title: [Fro-Zone, Behind the Wagon]
description: A wide space has been cleared out behind the wagon, creating a comfortable area in the moonlight.  Several benches and tables have been set out next to a rickety clothing rack, providing ample seating for customers.  A bright yellow awning extends from the side of the wagon, just above a small circular hatch leading back inside.

title: [Balcony of Chaotic Knowledge]
description: Rising several handspans from the smooth floor, an onyx-tiled and travertine railing encircles the balcony that is exposed to the open air.  Stretching upon the horizon is a sprawling city, while nearer at hand and far below is the black glass dome of the Garden of Chaos.  An illuminated teleportation disk recessed into the ground flashes with a steady pulse and fills the air with a gentle humming sound.

title: [Liabo, Vorago of Kaas]
description: High walls cast the lunar basin largely in shadow, its only true light coming from the greyish-black glow of the energy shield that preserves the gold-tiled area.  White moon rocks, their ivory faces reflective and smooth, dimple the landscape but are heavily pockmarked by thousands of craters formed by the meteorites that seem to constantly bombard this area of Liabo.  In the distance, the soft sound of impact tremors can be heard and nearly overpower the gentle hum of the nearby teleportation disk.

title: [Liabo, Vorago of Kaas]
description: Fluttering like a butterfly in a jar, the weak light of a glass-lined ring casts indistinct shadows across the golden tiles and the high lunar walls of the basin.  Dust, the sound of it like sand trickling over an umbrella, rains upon the arcane dome that forms a protective shielding high above the area.  Flashes of light to the north and east mark the origin of the impact tremors that vibrate through the air.

title: [Liabo, Vorago of Kaas]
description: Loud thuds and dull explosions fill the air as meteorites explode across the dome above, each impact creating a lightning-like flash of silvery light that cast the area in startling, grey relief for brief moments of time before darkness floods back in.  Ivory walls rise high upon the enormous basin, their faces pitted and cracked where cosmic rocks have laid carnage to their natural beauty.  Pulsating at a steady, heartbeat-like pace, a nearby glass-lined ring offers a modicum of illumination to the golden tiles.

title: [Liabo, Vorago of Kaas]
description: Pressed against the ivory wall of the lunar basin, this section of Liabo is frigid and enveloped in the cold darkness of space without nary a shred of starlight breaking through the protective hemisphere of arcane energy.  Golden tiles, uneven and cracked, traverse the landscape in a sinuous trail that avoids the larger craters that pockmark the rough rock.  Faintly pulsing, the hum of a nearby glass-lined ring does little to mask the irregular thumps of meteorites striking nearby.

title: [Liabo, Vorago of Kaas]
description: Awash in tenebrous shadows, the landscape is in constant turmoil from the consistent bombardment of small meteorites that pummel the onyx energy dome above.  Lunar dust explodes in the air with each impact, the fine powder gently raining upon the protective shield and causing it to pulse with expanding rings before normalizing between each impact.  Grey and black light are at war for dominance, though the steady light of a nearby glass-lined ring keeps the golden tile path well illuminated.

title: [Balcony of Elemental Knowledge]
description: Rising several handspans from the smooth floor, a brown flagstone and travertine railing encircles the balcony that is exposed to the open air.  Stretching upon the horizon is a sprawling city, while nearer at hand and far below is the verdant Garden of the Elements.  An illuminated teleportation disk recessed into the ground flashes with a steady pulse and fills the air with a gentle humming sound.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Elementum]
description: Arcing high above, the verdant dome of the Vallis Elementum is fashioned of arcane energy that forms a protective shield over the lunar landscape.  Bright white stone, pitted from past impacts, is illuminated by the verdant green forcefield that thrums through the area and is punctuated by the heartbeat-like pulsing of a nearby teleportation disk.  Visible beyond the recondite enchantment, the endless void of space fills the horizon with its unyielding darkness.

title: [Balcony of Orderly Knowledge]
description: Rising several handspans from the smooth floor, an alabaster-tiled travertine railing encircles the balcony that is exposed to the open air.  Stretching upon the horizon is a thin avenue surrounded by cypress trees, while nearer at hand and far below is the verdant Garden of Order.  An illuminated teleportation disk recessed into the ground flashes with a steady pulse and fills the air with a gentle humming sound.

title: [Liabo, Basin of Tranquility]
description: Resembling the cold, austerity of a mountain range trapped in ice, the landscape is awash with hard lines, severe angles, and bright white light where the glow of an arcane dome reflects off of the lunar rock.  Dazzling starlight burns brightly just beyond the protective energies, the winter constellation of the Spire slowly slipping beyond the horizon.  The steady heartbeat-like pulsing of an illuminated teleportation disk fills the air with a low thrumming sound.

title: [Balcony of Planar Knowledge]
description: Rising several handspans from the smooth floor, a cinnabar and travertine railing encircles the balcony that is exposed to the open air.  Stretching upon the horizon is a sprawling city, while nearer at hand and far below is the bright crimson Garden of the Planes.  An illuminated teleportation disk recessed into the ground flashes with a steady pulse and fills the air with a gentle humming sound.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Cognitum]
description: Stretching in all directions, the horizon of Liabo can be seen beyond the film of reddish light that is generated by the protective dome high above.  Golden tiles, beautifully constructed and intricately painted with filigreed designs, stretch away from the landing towards craters that pulse with life.  The stars above seem brighter than they do on Elanithia and the inky blackness that they reside in seems overwhelmingly dark and expansive.

title: [Liabo, Basin of Tranquility]
description: Dipping beyond the edge of the western horizon, the bright red star of The Hammer is just barely visible as it prepares to leave the skies of Elanthia for another year.  The dim glow of the incarnadine celestial body tints the nearby lunar landscape in a soft pink hue, while the distant sound of an anvil being struck by a hammer rolls across the basin.  As if in accord with the out of place sound, a nearby glass-lined ring pulses in response.

title: [Liabo, Basin of Tranquility]
description: Scattered starlight slips across the translucent dome of arcane energy that protects the surface of Liabo from the void of space, its soft incandescence helping to dispel the chill in the air.  Distant nebulas paint a purple, pink, and saffron smudge across the eastern sky, while small meteorites become streaks of fire in the north.  Upon the unyielding, lunar stone, a glowing glass-lined ring fills the air with a gentle hum.

title: [Liabo, Basin of Tranquility]
description: Five brilliant stars dominate the constellation that spreads across the northern skyline, the other six barely visible beyond the rippling energy of the white dome that protects the quiet basin.  Lunar rocks, smooth and worn with age, reflect the light and seem to emit a similar radiance that is soft, yet persistent in its strength.  Interrupting the gold-veined tiles of the pathway, a glowing glass-lined ring add its light to the ambiance.

title: [Liabo, Basin of Tranquility]
description: Slopping slightly, gold-veined tiles slink across the smooth basin as they follow the circular path of the protective dome of energy that preserves the air and casts off the shroud of space.  Slipping across the horizon, dozens of meteorites disappear as they dance through the sky and leave brilliant tails of white in their wake.

title: [Balcony of Spiritual Knowledge]
description: Rising several handspans from the smooth floor, a lapis lazuli and travertine railing encircles the balcony that is exposed to the open air.  Stretching upon the horizon is a sprawling city, while nearer at hand and far below is the bright cobalt blue Garden of the Spirit.  An illuminated teleportation disk recessed into the ground flashes with a steady pulse and fills the air with a gentle humming sound.

title: [Liabo, Sea of Transcendence]
description: Soft and ethereal, the protective dome of energy that arcs above the enormous lunar basin ripples with pale blue energy as it rises from the golden tiles that encircle the area.  Beyond the tenebrous light of arcane forces, the sky is an infinite void that is interrupted by startlingly bright starlight that ranges in hue from pure white to yellow and orange.  Nearer at hand, the smooth tiles are interrupted by an illuminated teleportation disk recessed into their smooth bodies.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Elementum]
description: Strong viridian light pulses through the area, the source just out of sight to the southeast, while traces of Tilaok's fiery presence rush in from the north.  Cool white lunar rock rises around the edges of the valley and, though the terrain is rough and irregular, a pathway of gold-veined marble tiles allows for passage through the area.  A protective dome of arcane energy keeps the void of space from reaching this area, it's light reflected in a glowing glass-lined ring.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Elementum]
description: Visible in orbit above the northern horizon, the proximity of Tilaok casts long shadows upon the verdant arcane dome that protects the area from the void of space.  Radiant emissions decorate the black of space as it travels in colorful ribbons between the two celestial bodies and blankets the lunar valley in shades of azure, amethyst, and emerald light.  The steady pulsing of a nearby glass-lined ring does little to dispels the alluring spectacle.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Elementum]
description: Gathering light to its corona, Tilaok dominates the northeastern landscape and eclipses the valley's shadow with its fiery presence.  Faint traces of verdant green light filter through the area from their origins in the protective shield, the edges of which mingle with the colorful ribbons of the northern aurora.  Seeming almost white in the fluctuating light, a glass-lined ring pulses nearby.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Elementum]
description: Appearing larger in the northern sky, the fiery radiance of Tilaok dominates the landscape with its orangish-red brilliance as the celestial body reaches its azimuth.  A jewel-toned aurora shimmers above and stretches towards the fierce flaming sphere in the heavens, but it quickly transitions to a sanguine hue as it gains in proximity.  So, too, does the energy field that protects the golden tile-lined pathway, which is interrupted by a glowing glass-lined ring.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Cognitum]
description: Bands of rippling red energy rise from the golden tile floors, adding their light to that of the protective dome that shelters the small valley.  Expansive darkness stretches beyond the translucent field of arcane energy, the endless infinite void held at bay for the moment.  In stark contrast to the nothingness above, the bright golden tiles that line the moon's pathways are painted with decorative filigree designs that represent life and birth.  A glass-lined sunken crater ring stands waiting nearby.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Cognitum]
description: Pulsating red light baths the golden tiles in their ethereal glow, the source a protective hemisphere of arcana that flashes and ripples with contained energy.  Beyond the construct, darkness spreads its web across the sky and captures brilliant stars in its path.  Several steps lead into a sunken crater ring that is lined with brightly glowing red glass tiles.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Cognitum]
description: Reddish light mingles with purples and greens as the twin nebulas that rise to the north dominate the horizon, their bright lights strong enough to overtake the hue of the energy field of the protective dome.  Gently humming sounds herald a pulse of energy as the dome ripples with arcane power.  Dimpled craters are scattered just beyond the edge of the golden walkway, though only one is outlined in red-glass tiles and has a set of stairs leading to it.

title: [Liabo, Vallis Cognitum]
description: Whorls of purple and fuchsia invade the light of the red dome above, the glow bright enough to eclipse the area in its pulsating light.  High above, the source of the alien lights are twin nebulas that rise upon the northern horizon of Liabo and are encircled by seven brightly gleaming stars.  Nearer at hand, the terrain is smoothed by bright golden tiles that lead to a sunken crater ring encircled by red glass.

title: [Liabo, Sea of Transcendence]
description: Nebulous, ethereal light trickles from the pulsing arcane dome above, its protective shielding keeping the air cool, but clear and crisp.  Crystals of frost form along the golden tiles that are closest to the energy wall, their glossy faces limned in its pale blue glow.  Darkness spreads its tenebrous touch upon the horizon, lightening towards the north but deepening to the south, and displays the stars of the northern skies like tiny jewels lost in black silk.

title: [Liabo, Sea of Transcendence]
description: Pale mist, limned in starlight, stretches its ethereal tendrils across the landscape and touches upon everything with its icy cold fingers.  Fluctuating azure light from the energy that forms the walls and ceiling creates a steady, heartbeat-like pulse that echoes through the lunar sea.  A sunken ring recessed within golden tiles seems incredibly bright in the twilightesque haze.

title: [Liabo, Sea of Transcendence]
description: Hanging over the northern horizon of Liabo like a bright blue and green jewel, Elanthia sits with swirls of puffy white clouds dancing across her surface.  The startling radiance of the planet's larger than life presence keeps at bay much of the enveloping darkness of the space beyond the protective, azure-energy dome.  Several steps in the golden tile pathway descend towards a glass-lined sunken ring.

title: [Liabo, Sea of Transcendence]
description: Bright blue and green, Elanthia sits poised over the northern edge of Liabo's horizon and displays its entire southern continent.  The bright glow of the planet erases all other lights and colors from the area, its luminosity even eclipsing the starlight to the east and west of its swollen form.  Golden tiles imbedded into the dusty white ground take on an azure hue that darkens where they encircle a glass-lined ring.

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Triage Yard]
description: The open-air yard is enclosed by stone walls and the tall tower on the southern side.  At the center of the yard, a wood-burning brazier warms the injured.  Healers and clerics tend to those lying on canvas cots scattered throughout the yard.  The walls are inset with carved reliefs of healing herbs.  Hung near a narrow arch is a communal sack of herbs.  A stone stairway leads up into a hall that projects outward from the wall on corbels.  The stone tower projects a faint illumination over the yard from its glaesine windows.
location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Refuge Hall]
description: Rows of ebonwood tables set haphazardly with steins and mugs span the length of the hall.  Seated on adjacent long ebonwood benches are resting medics and recovering patients.  On one side are small-paned glaesine windows, and on the other a wide stone hearth capped with a solid mantle of walnut commands the focus of the hall.  Over the hearth is a silver-framed oil painting, and from exposed ceiling beams hang many unused drinking vessels.  A mithril-banded ebonwood door opens to a spiraling stairwell that leads further up into the tower.  A small basket of wooden sticks sits in the shadows against a polished ebonwood bar inlaid with ivory.
location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Stairwell]
description: The narrow stairwell fills the cylindrical body of the tower's spire.  The spiraling passage is so narrow that in order for two to pass, one must crouch into a window alcove.  Cold drafts of air stream through dark turret windows.  Wooden torches are hung from the exterior walls.  At the base of the stairwell is a mithril-banded ebonwood door.
location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Workshop]
description: The stairwell opens to a floor of obsidian and ivory tiles arranged in an arabesque pattern.  Upon the tile floor sits a series of walnut worktables.  One large central worktable supports an array of beakers, vials, flasks, mortars, and pestles.  A crystal alembic refracts the multi-colored rays of moonlight that filter through a gothic stained glass window.  Resting on another table are bandages, bowls, and a variety of blades.  Suspended from a ceiling beam is a wrought-iron rack holding jars of alchemical ingredients.
location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Library]
description: The stairwell terminates at this hexagonal shaped room.  Walls of stone are interrupted by tall, multi-paned glaesine windows that stretch from the floor to the ceiling.  Between moonlit windows, ebonwood bookshelves line the walls.  The floor is grey-stained ash inlaid with an ivory border and covered by a polar bear hide rug at the center.  An ebonwood desk sits to one side before a pair of wingback black suede chairs.  Six sconces on the walls and a large wrought-iron chandelier are hung to illuminate the library.  An ebonwood ladder leads up to a hatch in the ceiling.
location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Cupola]
description: At the peak of the tower, the cupola boasts panoramic moonlit views of Icemule rooftops, the eastern slopes, and mountain peaks to the north.  Cold air and flurries of snow infiltrate wide windows on each of the six sides of the tower.  The only heat comes from candle votives suspended by chains from the mithril roof of the cupola.  Seated at the center of the platform is a large golden telescope trained on a mountain range to the north.  A ladder in the floor provides passage back inside.
location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Lake of Fear, Southern Shore]
description: Ice crystals glitter in the sunlight all along the frozen shoreline.  An endless expanse of ice stretches into the northern distance, broken only sporadically by strange, dark shapes.

title: [Citizens' Tent, Reception]
description: Town citizens mill about the open space of the tent, weaving in between the support poles and engaging in idle chatter.  A few individuals cluster near a large announcement board, gossiping loudly.  The distinct smell of freshly baked tarts wafts from a snowflake-carved modwir refreshment cart in one corner of the room.  Near the rear of the tent, an icicle-engraved fel box stocked with tinder rests next to an iron brazier.  The atmosphere lends a potential respite from the cold just outside.

title: [Citizens' Tent, Meeting Area]
description: Thick, ornate rugs depicting a colorful history of Icemule Trace layer the floors of the softly lit room.  A masterfully crafted spherical metal stove commands attention in the center of the area surrounded by some plush velvet pillows.  A woven manroot stalk bench sits opposite the curtain leading back to the reception.  An occasional shadow from the stove dances across the tent walls.

title: [Citizens' Tent, Donations]
description: In this comparatively smaller room of the tent, several large containers with neatly printed labels line one tent wall.  A modwir bin labeled "Warm Stuffses" with partitions for numerous articles of clothing sits beside a scuffed balenite footlocker labeled "Fighting Stuffses" large enough to hold several weapons and pieces of armor.  Winterberry-stained handprints cover the outside of an off-white wicker basket labeled "Belly Stuffses," likely a space reserved for tarts and other snacks.

title: [Mooring Dock, Walkway]
description: The coastline of the island is still visible from this point on the dock despite the murky shadows that night brings to the island, its white sands greeting the steps jutting forth from the walkway further north.  Flickering lanterns cast light upon the planks of the dock as well as the post-tied boats bobbing slowly in the ocean's current.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Mooring Dock, Walkway]
description: Lanterns sway slowly in the ocean breeze, dotting the length of the walkway in intervals to provide illumination for the boats tied to the posts.  Moonlight glistens off of the wooden planks slick with ocean spray, the pallid shafts of light sparkling upon the mirror-like surface of the ocean stretching out endlessly to the south.
location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Silver forms dart back and forth beneath the ocean's surface, reflecting the moonlight.  The coastline of a large tropical island dominates the horizon with its moonlit white beaches and dark jungles clearly visible to the north.  A sturdy dock lies to the east, quiet in the dark night.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Dark forms glide quietly through the water towards the distant shoreline of a tropical island.  A large lagoon lies directly to the north, its moonlit white beaches curtained by dense jungle foliage.  Small boats navigate the waters to and from a well lit dock to the east, virtually deserted for the night.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Waves crash against the moonlit white sands of a large lagoon in the north.  Dense jungle vegetation covers the hillside behind it, a blanket of near perfect darkness.  A well-lit dock lies to the east, dwarfed by the sheer cliff wall behind it.  The white sails of small boats can be seen as they travel the nearby waters.

title: [Blue Wisteria Table]
description: Painted a soft blue, this table is faded from use and worn smooth along the rounded edge.  Faint stencil work depicting a twining wisteria vine with blue and purple blossoms is still visible on its surface.  Tiny bumblebees hover about the blossoms and a few butterflies rest upon the leaves.  In the center of the table is a crystal bowl filled with wisteria blooms that spill over onto the table in an artful arrangement.

title: [Arachne Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with five red starstones in the shape of an hourglass.

title: [Bat Table]
description: While the tables are spaced far enough apart to ensure some measure of privacy, they stand in the center of the skylit atrium.  Like all of the tables in the room, this one is round and spacious, its heavy cast iron base supporting a carved black marble top.  Set at an angle into the stone is a black steel plate inset with eight white starstones that suggest the wings of a bat.

title: [Sooty Surface Table]
description: Evidence of a contained fire abound in this tiny booth.  Not only does the presence of greasy soot seem to cover the table and every other existing surface, but also the lingering odor of charred hair confirms that something went awry for an unfortunate individual in the not-so-distant past.

title: [Squalid Splendor Table]
description: This cramped little area appears to have become storage for discarded junk, the jumbles of mismatched and decrepit furnishings strewn about.  A long, scarred wooden table and an old wine barrel surrounded by a couple of old stools offer an available, albeit claustrophobic, resting spot.

title: [Trailing Termites Table]
description: Several rough-hewn tree stumps in various states of decay have been set in an almost circular fashion around a warped plank of mildewed oak, creating a makeshift table arrangement.  Tiny mounds of whitish powder and small translucent wings are visible all around, a telltale sign of a massive termite infestation.

title: [Careless Cobweb Table]
description: Thick cobwebs drape over almost every surface, their spidery creators amassing a large cache of tender insect vittles for future consumption.  Sticky residue from torn webs will undoubtedly cling in disarray to the attire, equipment, or bodies of those who wander in to sit at the old table in this darkened corner.

title: [Benark's Magic Shoppe]
[Benark's Weaponry]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a gilded maple table on one side of the shop and a gilded maple cabinet on the other.

title: [Underground Tunnel]
description: Rough-hewn pine torches line the ice-sheened rock walls of the seemingly unending tunnel.  The firelight dimly illumines the way, casting a soft, amber glow within the glittering shades of cobalt and white from the ice.

title: [Benark's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a gilded maple table and a gilded maple cabinet.

title: [Zellyle's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Vtasia's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a mistwood beam ceiling, a midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a glass-topped mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while a tropical floral arrangement rests on an enameled hardwood floor.

title: [Shadowdragon's General Store]
description: Beneath a painted nightscape ceiling, an antique wall hanging hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls.  A wide faenor-trimmed table and a long mahogany rack sit in opposite corners while a small potted boxwood shrub rests on a polished marble floor.

title: [Shadowdragon's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Shadowdragon's General Store]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a large oak table on one side of the shop and a gold-trimmed ebonwood chest on the other.

title: [Daelinde's General Store]
description: A decorative linden branch wreath hangs on one of the painted emerald green walls, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling rises overhead.  A sphere-topped black marble fountain sits in one corner of a buffed cherrywood floor.  There is a large oak table on one side of the shop and a painted red cedar rack on the other.

title: [Remnants of Coraesine Field]
description: Towering trees and thick, verdant shrubbery crowd together along the shambling path, the arboreal giants casting shadows upon the patchwork ground of moss and clover.  Spindled limbs stretch towards the star-spangled sky above, the dappled leaves filtering the silver light and creating cool motes that sparkle in the air.  Crouching within the foliage of the gigantic hardwoods is a leafy vine-covered arch that is surrounded by the yellow blossoms of wood violets.

title: [Coraesine Forest, Wooded Trail]
description: Tangled together, creeping thyme and star-blossomed cypress vines drape across the crumpled structures of aged kiosks and tattered pavilions as they climb upon the moss and clover-covered ground in sweeping arcs towards a leafy vine-covered arch.  Thick-bodied magnolia saplings, laden with bright pink-edged blossoms, crowd the spaces between old, dilapidated structures.  Shining in the moonlight, an old string of bells lies half-buried in the verdant growth.

title: [Coraesine Forest, Stone Grove]
description: Thickly gnarled, the buttressed roots of beech trees pull open the dark earth to create a deep wound that is filled with pits and crags.  Moss clings to the damp ground, its feathery extensions rustling in the ambient breeze, while pale mint-hued lichen clings to the cracked rocks of an old mining site.  Ragged scars, left behind by pickaxes and other mining tools, dimple the rocks and seem almost insignificant compared to the greater destruction unleashed by the forces of nature.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Coraesine Forest, Sinistral Way]
description: Wooly thyme and tufted chamomile dance across the ground in a tangled mass that clogs the meandering game trail, their verdant leaves providing shelter for small shrews and hedgehogs.  Moonlight slips through the overlapping canopy formed by the twined limbs of cypress and oak trees, its long bands illuminating sun-bleached canvas squares that are pinned in place by overturned cobblestones.  A leafy vine-covered arch parts the tightly knit foliage to provide passage further into the forest.

title: [Coraesine Forest, Boreal Apex]
description: Chalky cobblestones are all that remain of a building, boulder-sized pieces resembling a child's collection of building blocks that have toppled into the moss-blanketed earth.  Game trails wend their way through ravaged threads of civilization and are shadowed by beech trees to the south.  Tangled vines and twining carob trees form a wall of foliage that is parted by a leafy vine-covered arch.  Thick thorny bramble grows through a dilapidated wain, imprisoning the wagon to the environment.

title: [Coraesine Forest, Dextral Path]
description: Protruding from the dark soil at odd angles, the shattered ruins of a cobblestoned courtyard rise like the exposed bones of civilization through the clover and wood violet groundcover.  Dank pools of peat moss form beyond a screen of red ferns, gnarled cypresses, and loosely tufted grasses that grow through and around the warped remains of wagons and stalls.  Ragged bits of fabric, half buried and ravaged by the elements, flutter from beneath the rooted structure of a leafy vine-covered arch.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Terminus]
description: A leafy vine-covered arch offers a break in the thick foliage surrounding the forest.  Fresh animal paw prints mar the soil and veer off the footpath leading deeper into the woods.  Tattered pennants and flags are tangled in the foliage, along with other debris from the celebrations that were once held here.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Terminus]
description: Thick, rope-like vines creep across the ground and coil around much of the vegetation on the forest floor.  A shovel head and rake are buried in a pile of dirt and leaves.  Shattered spokes of a wagon wheel litter the southern side of the footpath.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Terminus]
description: A lumberjack's axe is slammed into the side of a white monir at a height much higher than it should be.  A grassy patch of land is surrounded by smooth rocks, flowers, and mushrooms that form a circle.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Terminus]
description: An abandoned cultivator rests to the side of the widening trail with several branches growing through it.  It is mostly covered by choking weeds and thorny vines.  A set of rust-covered chains connect the decomposing wooden tiller to an equally rotted and neglected whippletree.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Fringe]
description: Breaks in the treetops above allow the moonlight to filter through and reach the forest floor, the silver light glittering in the night.  Wildflowers nod their heads in slumber from their beds upon the pathway and around several nearby trees.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Fringe]
description: Lending their croaks to the other sounds of the forest, a chorus of bullfrogs rises from a small pond that can be barely glimpsed through the trees along the northern edge of the path.  An enormous tree lies on top of a stone bench, neatly snapping it in half and scarring its own bark in the process.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Union]
description: Creepers and vines wage war for dominance within the thick foliage of the bog oak forest, their spindled limbs laden with thorn and leaves.  Shade and shelter keep the moonlight at bay, but hinder movement through area.  Small patches of grass manage to hold ground here and there, though large toadstools play court within their blades.  Colorful motes of light flutter through the air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Fringe]
description: High in the canopy, rusted lanterns have become permanent fixtures of the forest where the bark from the limbs they dangle from has overtaken their simple metal rings.  An enormous blue tanik tree rises out of the center of the pathway causing the trail to fork around its enormous trunk which is partially fused with the shredded remains of a tent's skirt.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Bog Oaks]
description: Old alchemic equipment is left strewn across the forest floor, the elements having ruined their functionality.  A small grove of taniks circles around a rusted sword planted into the ground.  A steep trail leads up a knoll.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Knoll]
description: The trail terminates into a nearly vertical slope, with very narrow places to climb up the knoll.  Lush green moss covers portions of the ground, with patches of grass poking through.  Roots from a tree farther up the hillock protrude from the soil.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Knoll]
description: The only feasible route up and down the knoll is difficult to traverse with ease.  Several roots dangle from overhead, their durable fibers offering places to grip while scaling the hillock.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Knoll]
description: A small recess in the knoll offers some minor protection from the elements and a place to rest.  A twisted iron spike juts out of the soil, which appears to be the remains of some old farm equipment.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Knoll]
description: Dense treetops surround the knoll from this distance, their canopies covering the forest below.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Fringe]
description: Towering over the surrounding area, exposed roots heavily clogged with moss and clumps of soil dominate the landscape where a forest titan has crashed to the ground.  Smaller saplings, bent and bowed by the girth of the arboreal giant, show the recovery of youth as new limbs and leaves begin to grow.  Spotted mushrooms find purchase in the sheltering shadows amid the rot and decay, their caps moist yet powdery.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Terminus]
description: Verdant succulents and feather-topped moss join beneath the shelter of the surrounding trees to create a thick carpet of patchwork green hues that completely covers the footpath.  Untouched by the lush growth, nine stones are arranged in a circle upon the nearby outcropping.  Tiny vines mask the details of a tarnished silver plaque that is perched upon a decorative stone.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Terminus]
description: Shadowed by arboreal giants in the distance, a coppice of rowan trees grows beyond the edges of the ambling pathway that cuts through the dense forest.  The distance between the softwoods is covered by a blanket of periwinkle and ivy vines, the purple, white, and pink blossoms forming a zig-zag pattern as they grow across the darker, heart-shaped leaves of the adjacent plant.  Withered cosmos and alpine poppies darken the soil as the creepers overtake their natural habitat.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Terminus]
description: Impassible thickets, comprised of the white bones of silver birch and the thorny limbs of wild briar, guard the narrow path that wends its way through the dense forest.  Moonlight dances upon metal in the distance, its source some old farming tools that are half-buried in the thick undergrowth.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Terminus]
description: Tree branches stretch over a leafy vine-covered arch, their laden limbs dipping towards the ground and nearly blocking the trail leading north.   An old wooden structure, savagely torn apart by the growth of several trees, dominates the western side of the forest.  Barely visible beneath the mossy vegetation, the remains of a door decorated with a violet sigil lies broken and forgotten.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Boscage]
description: Torn banners dangle from branches and lamp posts are weathered and ruined by a leafy vine-covered arch.  Several hollowed acorns are strewn across the footpath where bipedal hoof imprints are pressed into some of the exposed soil.  Motes of various colors drift in and out of the moonlight high above the forest.

title: [Wildwood of the Dryad, Regnancy]
description: The knoll peeks out from over the treetops, offering a view of the vast bog oak forest below.  A sovereign weeping willow tree encompasses the hilltop -- the warm sunlight shining down on the leaves that sweep over the hillock.  Red-veined ferns surround the trunk of the tree in the shape of a ten-pointed star.
