title: [A Winding Path]
description: Trimmed to the shape of a peacock, a pair of thick boxwoods flanks a pair of polished oak gates.  Thick vines of blooming white roses climb up the beautifully polished wood of the entrance and curl around a wooden sign.  Each letter and image has been expertly carved into the curved top of the meadow's double entry.  A flower-strewn path leads back to Sylvarraend Road.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Deep purple lavender crowds the borders of the walk, their open blossoms delicately scenting the air with a sweet essence.  Tiny crystal globes hanging from slender ironwork poles dimly light the path as it winds through the flower's tall stalks.  A large boulder rests beside the path, moss framing a painted wooden sign affixed to its worn surface.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Widening abruptly, the path meets the thick green grass of the meadow.  Occasional maple, oak, and walnut trees dot the landscape, their thick canopy casting shadows over the meadow in the bright moonlight.  A carved stone bench sits beneath a nearby rose-covered arbor, providing a quiet resting place from which to enjoy the shimmering night sky.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Surrounded by the tall meadow grass is a stone fire pit encircled by several benches carved from fallen logs.  A pile of sticks is neatly stacked to one side sorted by size.  Clusters of colorful peonies rest in the shade of tall stalks of lavender, their blossoms filling the clearing with a light scent.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Cutting across the meadow, a small brook runs near the path as it winds along.  The water gurgles merrily as it tumbles over smooth stones on its way to the nearby Mistydeep River.  A tarnished silver wind chime hang from the branches of a nearby guelder rosebush.  Leading away from the center of the meadow, a narrow path disappears into the tall grass.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Several tables skirted in various colors and festooned with multicolored ribbons fill the large clearing.  Wooden trays heaped with food cover a central stand.  Ribbons of silvery moonlight filter through the thick verdant canopy of several large oak trees growing tall along the edge of the meadow.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Speckled with bits of shimmering blue sapphire, a long grey granite slab rests atop a stack of smaller stones.  Numerous small candles burn atop the piece of rock.  Scattered amongst the candles, small nosegays and flowers adorn the austere makeshift altar.  A small parchment lies in the center of its flat surface.  Tucked off to one side among the tall grass is a vine-covered white oak arch.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Perched atop a small rise in the grassy meadow is a magnificent flowering linden tree.  Its delicate golden blossoms drift in the air, scenting the breeze with a faint fragrance.  A thick bed of pink and purple anemone surrounds the base.  Resting under the canopy is a small bench crafted from grey stone.  Tiny carvings of woodland creatures adorn the sides.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Cool moonlight blankets the area, illuminating the ground with its pale rays.  Small terra cotta pots overflowing with pale pink verbena line the worn path that meanders throughout the meadow.  Translucent crystal lanterns cast a pale light over the meadow, the flickering flame creating moving shadows.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Spreading a thick canopy over this part of the meadow, an ancient red oak tree towers above.  Its broad, gnarled trunk is decorated with beribboned garlands of roses, hydrangia, and blaestonberry blossoms.  A gentle breeze meanders through the shaded clearing, adding to the moist chill of the evening.

title: [Lumnea Meadow]
description: Centered in the meadow as a focal point is a large sapphire silk pavilion with several alabaster pennants bearing the Illistim crest flying above.  Large ceramic pots filled with blooming white rosebushes have been placed at intervals around the exterior.  A pair of crystal lanterns hanging from ornate iron posts flanks the entrance to the gathering space.  Lit candles shine from the interior of each, casting a bright glow over the clearing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Lumnea Meadow, Baerl Mystiaem]
description: Moonlight shimmers as it illuminates the surface of crystal droplets and covers the wide expanse of green with a silvery sheen.  A large area of the clearing, surrounded by beds thick with lavender, has been sectioned off for dancing.  A vine-covered white oak arch leads back out to the center of the meadow.

title: [Lumnea Meadow, Clearing]
description: Standing tall, an immense silvery oak covers the area with a thick canopy.  A sturdy wooden swing hangs from one of the tree's leafy branches.  Pale moonlight filters through, illuminating thick beds of wildflowers.  Their colorful blossoms are a bright contrast to the verdant grass.

title: [Lumnea Meadow, Glimaer Pool]
description: Formed by piles of smooth rocks, the brook tumbles into a large natural pool.  The water eddies and swirls about as it slips inexorably towards the tiny waterfall at the basin's far edge, where it finally spills over the rocks and continues its journey towards the river.  Moonlight shimmers across the surface, painting the landscape in a cloak of pale silver.

title: [Lumnea Meadow, Clearing]
description: Bits of foam flow over the surface of the water as it leaves the small waterfall and continues its journey to the river.  Tall grass mixed with fluffy cattails obscure the muddy, shallow bank of the brook.  A small wooden cabin is tucked between meadow grass and untamed shrubbery.

title: [Stylish Sights]
description: Burnished copper poles support the wide, overlapping swathes of vibrant marine-hued silk gauze that form this airy pavillion.  Near the center of the open space is a mother-of-pearl inlaid dark green faenor table with elegantly scrolled legs on a pale golden oak parquet floor.  Standing some distance away from the walls of lapis, turquoise, and celadon silk, an ornately carved teak screen effectively sections a portion of the space into another room.

title: [Fly Away, Showroom]
description: Brightly colored silk is draped over white oak poles, creating the walls of this small tent.  A soft wool carpet blankets the ground, its weave patterned with sapphire and alabaster diamonds.  Several wooden bins filled with paper shapes are scattered about the shop.

title: [Lumnea Festival Tent, Interior]
description: Several sturdy maoral poles support the silk structure, creating peaks and valleys in the ceiling.  Several chairs are scattered about a great sapphire wool carpet that covers the grass inside the large tent.  Hanging from the peaks of the ceiling are lanterns suspended on marbled faenor chains.  A vine and flower-patterned tapestry is draped across an opening in the silk walls.

title: [Festival Tent, Backroom]
description: Flecked with golden threading, a midnight blue wool carpet covers the ground in this smaller back section of the festival tent.  Some silk pillows of sapphire and alabster silk are scattered about the area providing a comfortable place to gather.

title: [Carry On, Showroom]
description: Swathes of pale blue satin drape from the tall crossbeams of the pavilion's ceiling to fall to the rug-covered floor in pools of cascading fabric.  Twin beaded curtains on the east and west walls of the main showroom lead into smaller areas of the tent.  A pair of iron-crossed racks displays pouches and sacks of various hues and embellishments.

title: [Send It Soaring]
description: Centered in the tent, a thick pole creates a sharp peak in the canopy, which slopes down to a white oak post at each corner.  The vermillion silk walls billow with the breezes moving through the meadow outside.  Lengths of silken rope travel across the ceiling, creating a tangled crisscrossed pattern and display a wide variety of kites.

title: [Poiret & Company, Perfumery]
description: Great care has been taken to lending this prim tent every accroutement of a standing boutique.  A plush argent rug rests over sturdy floorboards, while gilded candelabras stand at a protective distance from the tent's taut silk walls, basking the space in a pleasant golden candlelight.  An oaken display table dominates this area of the tent, its surface artfully carved and painted to resemble the streets and structures of Ta'Illistim.

title: [Poiret's Fine Goods, Winery]
description: Stacks of wine cases serve as creaky wooden walls in this back room of the tent, bits of protective straw peeking through the seams of their pine surfaces.  Atop a felt-surfaced table, individual champagne bottles sit on display, alongside flutes, glasses, and other accoutrements of wine-drinking.

title: [Poiret's Fine Goods, Workroom]
description: A low bronze brazier sits at the center of this small workroom, encircled by a smattering of soft seats and settees.  To the side, a small silver table offers a tasteful selection of champagnes.

title: [Keg of the Bloody Asp, Tavern]
description: Fresh rushes, comprised of dried chamomile, lavender, and wormwood, are strewn about the floors of the tavern, though their rich herbal fragrance does little to hide the scent of stale ale and vomit.  Chairs and benches are arranged in small groups in the open space, which is illuminated by torches set at even intervals upon the rough pine walls.  An iron-edged oak bar dominates one corner and stands guard over a thick wooden door that leads deeper into the establishment.

title: [Keg of the Bloody Asp, Storage]
description: Casks, barrels, and crates rise from the pine floorboards to the exposed rafter ceiling and occupy virtually every available space of the small store room.  Dim light spills through the door that leads into the tavern, while a bright glow spills on the uppermost steps of a rough pine staircase.  Several bundles of rushes bound together by wire are stacked in the center of the room.

Casks, barrels, and crates rise from the pine floorboards to the exposed rafter ceiling and occupy virtually every available space of the small store room.  Dim light spills through the door that leads into the tavern, while a bright glow spills on the bottommost steps of a rough pine staircase.  Several bundles of rushes bound together by wire are stacked in the center of the room.

title: [Lair of the Ophidian Cabal]
description: Three corners of the root cellar are fitted with yawning archways that lead deeper into the lair, while the fourth is filled with a rough pine staircase that disappears into the oak-raftered ceiling.  Caged torches are bolted to the nondescript walls and cast their flickering light upon a large round table in the heart of the room.  A gnarled ebonwood quarterstaff is mounted perpendicular to the floor and has a simple blue flag draping from its length.

title: [The Ophidian Cabal, Leader]
description: Illuminated by a single torch set into a far corner, the dimly lit room is riddled with discarded flagons and steins that clutter the area and make silent movement complicated.  Most of the containers seem to lay in circles around a large copper-spigoted barrel, though a few also decorate an oversized dark wooden desk.

title: [The Ophidian Cabal, Planning]
description: Bright firelight floods the area from no less than a dozen torches that hang from the rough oak walls in large wrought iron cages.  Scented rushes are thinly scattered across the floor and perfume the air with woodworm, hickory, and sage, the aroma nearly overpowering in the heat that falls off the surrounding walls in waves.  An oversized parchment map is stretched out upon the rooms only piece of furniture, which is a large knotted pine table.

title: [The Ophidian Cabal, Lounge]
description: Holding court amid both fresh and moldy rushes, a large throne-like chair fitted with a bright purple cushion sits at an angle to the room's far corner.  Smaller benches and stools pay homage to the monstrosity, which is gaudily decorated with copper asps.  Near to the entry, someone has taken a bench and nailed it to the top of another one to create a kind of high table where various drinks and food are displayed.

title: [Haunt of the Silent Investors]
description: Large cobblestone blocks, grey and slippery from years of water damage, form the walls of this circular section of sewer, their smooth faces interrupted by the placement of pipes and drains.  A long marble staircase follows the curve of the wall, providing egress for denizens, beneath which are pendant lanterns crafted of glowing witch-balls that are filled with bright white lights.  Two tunnels lead away from the area, each with a small black pennant that prominently displays an ivory raven skull with a bound beak.

title: [Silent Investors, Leaders]
description: Two tiers of niches encircle the curved walls of the sewer, the upper tier housing softly glowing stones and the lower filled with avian skulls, while beneath are copper pipes draped with grey fabric.  Sloping slightly, the floor is curved in a bowl-like shape with a shallow dip that culminates in an iron-gated drain.  Marble benches encircle the space and use the stones of the walls as their backing.

title: [Silent Investors, Lounge]
description: Transitioning from narrow tunnels to wide open spaces, this section of the sewer bears an egg-shape and a domed ceiling, the height of which is difficult to ascertain.  Glowing white stones are fitted into niches high above and provide a soft illumination for the water-dampened confines.  Strange blocks jut out of the wall at varying heights, some of which form odd stone tables while others provide functional seating.

title: [The Dented Phylactery]
description: Dark and dingy, the small shop is filled with cloying scents and a stifling heat that is produced by a bronze brazier that occupies an entire corner.  Wide shelves take up much of the wall space, while a long glass counter stands guard over a narrow oak door and a large worktable covered with a variety of devices.

title: [The Dented Phylactery, Storage]
description: Ringed by bookcases, the cramped storage room is cluttered with supplies for making draughts, potions, elixirs, and all manner of remedies.  Dried herbs dangle from the exposed rafters of the ceiling, while the floor is crowded with crates and boxes.  Various tools are housed upon the only free wall, which is bisected by a narrow oak door that leads to the front room.  An errant breeze from behind the furniture, perhaps from an unseen window, carries with it a hint of brimstone.

title: [Den of the Poisoned Heretics]
description: Packed dirt walls are supported by thick wooden posts that lend the large root cellar a hickory scent that is at odds with the choking scent of brimstone that rises from a central brazier.  Draped upon one wall is a bright blue banner, which is in far better shape than the garish rugs thrown upon the floors.  Three of the four corners open up into archways that lead deeper into the den, while the final corner houses a long rough oak table covered in wares.

title: [The Poisoned Heretics, Planning]
description: Thin sheets of plywood stretch between the thick hickory support posts of the walls and are anchored in place by large wrought iron nails.  Half-melted candles rests at the four corners of a large oak table that occupies the center of the room, their flickering light providing just enough illumination by which to view the maps that are on display.

title: [The Poisoned Heretics, Leader]
description: Coarse walls of stucco encircle the office, the irregular surface covered with a bright blue paint that almost completely obscures the off-white color underneath.  Lanterns hang from the exposed rafters of the ceiling and provide ample illumination for an enormous iron and wood desk that occupies the center of the space.  A simple linen flag is nailed to the wall near the exiting archway.

title: [The Poisoned Heretics, Lounge]
description: Garish rugs are haphazardly thrown upon the packed dirt ground, their overlapping lengths creating lumpy piles.  Overstuffed leather couches, some with stuffing clearly poking out of the ripped cushions, are scattered about the space, while a single low table sits in one corner covered with several dishes of food.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer]
description: The stone tunnel is aglow with bioluminescent fungus, generating an eerie reflection off the wet, sewage-covered ground.  The air is full of mephitic gasses that create a wavering haze.  Pieces of crumbling stone blocks, slick with sludge, make footing precarious.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This warehouse is absolutely packed with all manner of baubles and knick-knacks.  Despite the large number of displayed items, great care has obviously gone into organizing the shelves, for nothing seems cluttered or haphazard.  Attendants move through out the room, delicately adjusting and cleaning each piece, while responding to the needs of any potential customer.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This carefully cut warehouse is shaped into a near perfect square.  Pedestals of living rock have been sculpted at exact intervals throughout the entire area.  Each one is carefully adorned with the finest of collectible treasures that one can find.  Several attendants wait nearby, ready to serve the needs of any potential customers.

title: [Collectibles Shop]
description: This cluttered warehouse is nearly packed to the rafters with all manner of trinkets and collectibles.  Attendants busy themselves by sorting items into densely packed displays, following an organizational system apparently known only to themselves.

title: [Irreplaceable Items on Ice]
description: The scent of pine is strong here, but works in concert with the decor of this efficient store.  A dusting of snow covers every flat surface, falling off the edges in a frozen tableau.  Wide green shelves line the walls, festooned with nooks and crannies of every imaginable shape and size.  Despite the amount of storage, not a single space is unoccupied.  Halfling attendants scurry about, assisting customers as needed, but remaining busy with any number of small tasks.

title: [Mango Pavilion]
description: Swathes of mango silk form the wide octagon shape of the pavilion.  Along the wispy walls of the room, bejeweled sconces display softly glowing tropical orange-gold lights.  In the center of the pavilion, a gilded zebrawood table is nearly engulfed by a showy arrangement of coconut palm leaves, moonflowers, and plumeria.

title: [Summertide, Entry]
description: Smooth ivory walls deftly painted with metallic-thorned brambles create a vibrant, summery atmosphere inside the spacious wagon.  Several jade vases filled with casually arranged wildflowers are dotted about the room, their earthy scent filling the air with a mild sweetness.  A saber-legged rich maoral wardrobe is notably centered upon the narrow-planked heart of pine flooring.

title: [Summertide, Studio]
description: The largest section of the wagon is kept free of clutter and excessive adornments.  Elegantly appointed tulip poplar cabinets are displayed against the carved ivory walls, the glinting merchandise housed inside the sole feature of the elongated shopping gallery.

title: [Summertide, Salon]
description: The corner of the wagon opens to a salon exclusively dedicated to the fine art of tailoring.  Scraps of finespun muslin, spools of silken threads, and a few stray sketching papers are draped across a slender olivewood worktable at the back.  Situated nearby, an ebon rose-shaped pin cushion sprouting sharpened silver needles is poised atop a reserved collection of measuring tapes and ribbons.

title: [Now is the Write Time, Workroom]
description: Folded paper flowers are tacked to the walls amidst an abstract mural of stationery scraps scribbled with handwriting samples.  A square, cobalt glass inkpot lies overturned on top of a long oaken table, the spilled ink staining the wood and dribbling on to the polished hardwood floor.  A thick-legged oak stool has been claimed by a black cat with a fluffy, white-tipped tail.

title: [Rooted Notes]
description: Droplets flow from a knotted wood ceiling down to thick banyan roots that form the natural walls of the tiny cavern.  Numerous formations of multihued crystals sprout from the roots and wind along the floor in a pattern resembling musical notes that bend and twist around each other.  The atmosphere is saturated with moisture, and the scent of fresh, clean water and ozone is prominent.

title: [As You Wish, Weaponry]
description: Daggers and tridents cover the walls of the shop, hints of cherrywood peeking out from behind the metal.  Large barrels are scattered haphazardly on the floor, filled with bottles, herbs, and the occasional pieces of leather armor.  The scent of cinnamon lingers faintly in the air.  An ironwood desk sits at the far wall, next to an open ebonwood door.  On the desk you notice an enruned vaalorn coffer.

title: [As You Wish, Armory]
description: Large pieces of leather hang from the walls.  The back wall is hung entirely with partially finished hides, many of which still have their arms and legs attached.  Mannequins are scattered around the room, dressed in bits of partially finished armor.  The floor is covered in cedar chips and pine shavings, lending the room a pleasant smell just slightly undercut by the sharp tang of copper.

title: [Fit to be Tied]
description: Jewel-colored flowers and hummingbirds are painted with finesse on the slate grey walls of the small wagon.  Mossy green vines sprout from a few cracks in the wooden plank floors under an aged yew chest, the smaller tendrils winding their way around the bases of a gnarled modwir trunk and a woven black willow basket.  A shadowed corner in back houses a glass-paneled cedar cabinet topped with an ornately carved maoral case.

title: [Wooden Magic]
description: Carved from pale birch, a thick pole creates a sharp peak in the canopy of the tent.  Light breezes from outside cause the pale amethyst silk walls of the tent to billow to and fro.  A small cushioned box rests on a small counter next to a a polished tigerwood tray.

title: [Rank and File]
description: An array of bright, garish colors fills the inside of the tent, almost to the point of being distracting.  A polished crystal display case lies off to the side and a flap leads out.

title: [Carry a Big Stick]
description: Plain brown fabric serves to cover the wooden slats that connect the platform around this part of the circle of trees.  Dense foliage above encloses the area, making it a bit more private.  At the center of the room, a leaf-covered woven basket hangs on a trio of thick ropes from a sloping branch, a tiny, shimmering sprite flitting near the wares within it.

title: [Carry a Big Stick]
description: The edges of the platform here are open, allowing a gentle breeze to pass by, carrying with it a handful of fallen leaves and petals that dance across an assortment of wooden crates packed with goods.  Overhanging branches have been purposefully hung and evenly spaced with an array of colorful paper lanterns softly aglow with green and blue motes of magic.

title: [Carry a Big Stick, Workroom]
description: Bright green fronds crisscross a series of cleverly stationed metal poles to create a dense ceiling and enclose this space on three sides.  Except for a smattering of abandoned, dusty tools in the far corner, this part of the shop otherwise lacks in merchandise, materials, and displays.

title: [Weave and Wear, Flora]
[Weave and Wear]
description: Lining one wall of the spacious wagon is a narrow table covered with vases of various shapes and sizes, all filled with bright flowers.  Bunches of blossoms peek from inside baskets hanging from the rafters, their rich colors creating a brilliant canopy.  Standing to one side of a small painted door is a large wooden crate overflowing with a wide variety of gardening tools.

Bunches of blossoms peek from inside baskets hanging from the rafters, their rich colors creating a brilliant canopy.  Standing to one side of a small painted door is a large wooden crate overflowing with a wide variety of gardening tools.

title: [Bards]
description: Crimson walls enclose this room, each strewn with musical notes stamped in gold and silver pigments.  Framed beneath glass are time-darkened parchment music sheets, and a variety of finely crafted instruments are mounted in between.  Underfoot, a rug woven of scarlet and gild-hued threads cushions every step.

title: [Weave and Wear]
description: Smaller than the other areas of the wagon, the work area is cluttered with boxes and crates.  Various tools and materials are scattered over the surface of a worn, marble-topped table.  A large chalkboard dominates the wall above.   Pushed to the side is a small wooden bench, the floor underneath carpeted with bits of discarded blossoms and greenery.

A large chalkboard dominates the wall above.  Pushed to the side is a small wooden bench, the floor underneath carpeted with bits of discarded blossoms and greenery.

title: [Giantman Village, Clearing]
description: The surrounding flora has been cleared to create a sizeable space here.  Tents, lean-tos and other temporary structures cover the area, forming narrow streets through the miniature village.  Giantmen wander amongst the buildings on their way to daily tasks, some with their children in tow.  The children not pressed into labor play happily under the watchful eyes of their mothers.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Silvergate Inn, Garden]
description: An ivy-covered wall with a wrought iron gate encloses the garden.  Colorful flower beds border the wide expanse of close-cropped grass which surrounds a small lily pond spanned by a fanciful wrought iron footbridge.  Fireflies glimmer around a graceful wooden arbor covered with silver and white tea roses beside the water.  Several trees are scattered across the lawn, a particularly large one rising near the bridge.  Silvery lions mounted on the stone wall hold glowing, cut-crystal oil lamps.

Colorful flower beds border the wide expanse of close-cropped grass which surrounds a small lily pond spanned by a fanciful wrought iron footbridge.  A graceful wooden arbor covered with silver and white tea roses shades one side of the water.  Several trees are scattered across the lawn, a particularly large one rising near the bridge.  Silvery lions mounted on the stone wall hold cut-crystal oil lamps.

title: [Sunholm, Outward]
description: Vast lancet arches of uniform granite raise this wide platform far above the floodline of the Cairnfang River, its low stone walls lined with staggered crenellations.  Paved setts fan out from the barbican of a far higher rampart, while one embrasure of the wall hosts a long stone dock.  Past the wall, azure-on-white pennons soar above from the turrets of a tall sun-basked keep, made stark against the bright sky.  Yet, as if welcoming, a statue enshrined within a low stone garden before the gatehouse.

title: [Sunholm, Courtyard of the Keep]
description: Stretching below a tall stone keep and its pennon-streaming turrets is the inner ward, host to numerous smaller structures built upon its sett stones.  To the south is a low stone kitchen, smoke rising from its many small chimneys, with a short stone-ringed stove outside its wall.  At the center of the courtyard sits a series of sett stone benches that ring a grand weeping willow, their masonry matching the steps of the keep's doors.  Beneath the tall curtain wall to the north is an open training yard.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Azure Sun

title: [Sunholm, The Hall of the Sun]
description: Above the colossal hall, rows of argent banners blazoned by azure sunbursts hang from immense wooden trusses.  Tall stained glass windows set into stone arches stretch skyward, their mottled light illuminating the granite tiled floor, each flanked by wall-mounted arms of all types.  A vast round table surrounded by heavy wooden chairs dominates the center of the hall, and at its end an immense stone hearth regally occupies a dais below a grand azurite stone sun supported by numerous heraldic shields.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Azure Sun

title: [Sunholm, The War Room]
description: Lit by a huge wrought iron chandelier, the stone walls of this spartan chamber are lined with evenly spaced cresset-cast sconces.  Prominent and center, a great wooden table stands, completed by matching low-backed wooden chairs.  At the far end of the chamber, a huge iron-framed slate hangs opposite a vast imperial chart, and between them sits the long wooden desk of the Adjudicator of the Order, somberly at the head of the chamber.  Ravens flit in a gilded cage next to lancet windows behind the desk.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Azure Sun

title: [Sunholm, Stables of the Order]
description: The open, hay-strewn floor of the stable stretches from one end of the building to the other, running between many box stalls.  Hanging from hooks, racks, and various shelves along the walls are matters of tack and barding, and a small anteroom hosts far more storage for feed, tools, and armor.  A hayloft looms above, with bales of hay stacked alongside some barrels at the base of its ladder, and the occasional snorts and whinnies of horses create a subdued din in the air as they shift in their stalls.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Azure Sun

title: [Giantman Village, Tent]
description: Set off slightly from the rest of the camp in a quiet place, a large, faded green tent sheds a bit of shade.  Sitting in its shadow is perhaps the oldest giantman you have ever seen.  The years and elements have wrinkled and tanned his skin like shrunken leather, and his shaman's braids are thinned with age.  His brown eyes have filmed over, leaving him without vision, but the strong guard standing beside him sees to it that no harm can come to him.

title: [Giantman Village, Tent]
description: Fashioned of dark green walls, the room is small with a sloping ceiling of weathered leather and rawhide.  Near the entry flap is a simple basket-covered table and a plain wooden bench, while several sleeping furs are neatly arranged near the outer wall.  A hanging lantern casts odd shadows on the floor, which is covered by a thick patterned wool blanket.

title: [Giantman Village, Artisans]
description: Tents huddle closely about each other, leaning inward as if sharing trade secrets.  The gentle tink-tink-tink of a small hammer on metal rings through the area, echoing over the sounds of the village.  A blast of heat and the smell of burnt metal rises from one of the tents every time the breeze rises, but the open flap of the tent opposite it does seem inviting.

title: [Giantman Village, Jeweler]
description: Small baskets of handcrafted jewelry sit about the interior of this tent.  Torques, wrought belts, but most especially armbands glitter in the low light, all made by the hands of a master.  The proprietor of the shop sits behind a well-worn bench, painstakingly tapping out patterns on a band of gold.

title: [Giantman Village, Pavilion]
description: A large number of giantmen, both male and female, gather about a large pavilion.  While mostly warriors, there seems to be at least one member of every profession imaginable present, from housewife to guard.  Each holds a sizeable stein in his or her hand, drinking as they stand about, chatting comfortably.

title: [Giantman Village, Tavern]
description: The tent is large and airy, smelling strongly of good ale and honest sweat.  Giantmen chat with the barkeep, who seems perfectly happy to talk.  A large group clusters about a barrel in the corner.  As they drain their mugs they dip them into the keg, refilling them with good giantkin beer.

title: [Sunholm, The Drilling Yard]
description: Before the great stone barracks built alongside the keep, sunlight pours in from over the high, bastioned curtain wall of the ward, basking the open training yard in its glow.  Pells and training dummies are lined up along the wall, while nearby archery targets await their fate.  Rings line a long, oval course around the yard, its run broken by a few quintains.  Centered is a dais-raised practice ring, lined by low stone ashlars and racks of practice weapons.

Before the great stone barracks built alongside the keep, the night air eddies crisply within the bastioned curtain wall of the ward, cooling the training yard with a light breeze.  Pells and training dummies are lined up along the wall, while nearby archery targets await their fate.  Rings line a long, oval course around the yard, its run broken by a few quintains.  Centered is a dais-raised practice ring, lined by low stone ashlars and racks of practice weapons.

title: [Sunholm, The Battlements]
description: Protected by its crenellated parapet, the alure of the keep stretches between twin turrets, their azure-on-white pennons stark against the night sky.  Below, the inner ward and its guarded buildings fan out, illuminated within the bastioned curtain walls of the stronghold.  Beyond, the dark of the night swallows much of the countryside, save the dancing glows of caravansary campfires nestled below Vornavis' clifftop enceinte and the streetlights of the Freeport of Solhaven, dimly flickering in the night.

Protected by its crenellated parapet,  the alure of the keep stretches between twin turrets, their azure-on-white pennons streaming against the daylight sky.  Below, the inner ward and its guarded buildings fan out, and beyond the bastioned outer curtain wall the Cairnfang River stretches west towards the sea and Solhaven, opposite the east's vast plains and hills.  Southward, the tall blue granite walls of Vornavis' clifftop enceinte stand fast, while north lays an unending wilderness framed by mountains.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Azure Sun

title: [Sunholm, A Secluded Chapel]
description: The heady scent of incense smoke hangs serenely over the spartan chapel, its stone floors illuminated in mottled tones of rich color by arched stained glass windows that raise the ceiling.  A simple woolen prayer mat rests before an unadorned white marble altar.  Framing the chamber, plain candles line the flat tops of the stone wall's pilasters, casting a secondary golden glow over the shrine.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Azure Sun

title: [Sunholm, Hospital of the Order]
description: The trussed ceiling of this infirmary chamber hangs low, its granite tiled floor lined with rows of soft downy beds, spaced for easy maneuvering between their ranks.  Alcoves rest in the walls between the rows, each hosting medicines, bandages, medical instruments, and a cabinet.  Beside each bed rests a simple stone wash basin and short wooden stool.  Lit by cresset-cast sconces anchored into the stone walls, the chamber provides a solemn, but gentle respite.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Azure Sun

title: [Sunholm, Library of the Order]
description: The long chamber of the library is filled from front to end with tall wooden bookcases, their shelves brimming with tomes and manuscripts.  Cresset-cast sconces line the walls, each casting a gentle illumination over the the decor.  Some small alcoves play host to writing desks, while at the end of the chamber a stone column stands lionized.  A wrought iron chandelier hangs above several long wooden tables that sit dutifully in a central clearing of the chamber, complete with simple plush wooden chairs.
tags: meta:mho:The Order of the Azure Sun

title: [Opal Lounge]
description: A black wildcat leaps out at you as you enter!  Luckily, it is only a startlingly life-like statue, poised to greet visitors.  A sofa and loveseat upholstered in wildcat fur stand out against the pale draperies at the far end of the room.

title: [Opal Lounge, Cubbyhole]
description: This narrow, cramped space ends abruptly at a curtain.

title: [Syphaer's Combat Gear]
description: The broad sweep of the oak floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  Several white marble shelves and a Vornavian silk-lined display case are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Syphaer's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a varnished golden oak ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  Some hammered copper display hooks and a heavy lead glass display case sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Syphaer's General Store]
description: Enclosed by polished oak walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its oak floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the golden oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a heavy white granite counter and a gilded maple cabinet.

title: [Glacial Cavern]
description: A great expanse of glacial rock and ice rises up, the naturally domed structure braced in curved, polished pine beams designed to embrace the frozen stalactites pitching down in crystalline brilliance.  Thin paper lanterns float from glaes-linked suspensions, glowing with pale lilac and blue hues of the phosphorescent orbs nestled within.

title: [Arcane Studies, Training Room]
description: The surroundings are entirely obscured by an opaque purple mist, allowing you perfect peace and silence in which to practice your craft.  A narrow and constantly shifting passageway of mist leads out of the confines of the training room.

title: [Carnival, Entrance]
description: The pathway underfoot is cast in deep shadow, and the sound of buzzing insects reaches your ears.  Bright streamers decorate the lower limbs of the treees to either side, and the scent of honeysuckle is heavy in the air.  A light haze drifts through the area, rendering the entire area somewhat myopic.

title: [Carnival, Entrance]
description: A ramshackle booth stands to one side of the path, long since abandoned.  The wood of the booth is splintered with age, and it leans precipitously to one side.  The path underfoot is more gravel than dirt, and not all the rocks are rounded.  The sky overhead is dark and filled with stars seen through the treetops.

title: [Carnival, Entrance]
description: The trees to either side of the path are bunched together, their thick foliage overhead casting the path into total darkness.  The scent of smoke is recognizable on the air, acrid and sharp, and a faint twinkle of light can be seen in the distance.  The air is cool, and a slight breeze carries the faint sound of a jaunty flute to your ears.

title: [Carnival, Entrance]
description: The sky above is dark, and while a few stars are visible through the treetops, they are unfamiliar to the eye, and do little to light the path.  Large torches have been erected in the center of the travelway, interspersed in such a way that they provide some light, but not enough to be sure of the footing below.  The combination of the guttering torches and dim ambient light casts strange shadows to each side.

Filled with thick, low clouds, the sky does little to light the path through the trees.  Large torches have been erected in the center of the travelway, their guttering flames casting strange shadows to each side.

title: [Carnival, Entrance]
description: Smoky air combines with the insufficient light of free-standing torches and heavy foliage overhead to render the whole area inky black beyond the reach of the flickering torchlight.  To the north, a faint glow can be seen, as if from a fire of some sort, and the sound of carnival music is audible, though discordant.

title: [Carnival, Entrance]
description: Thick smoke and orange light rise into the starry sky from a ring of massive wagons that have been parked in a tight circle and lashed together, with an unhinged gate of black wrought iron guarding access.  Braziers atop the wagons cast flickering light on a sign above the gate proclaiming "CARNIVAL OF FREAKS" in stylized lettering.  Scents of sulfur and hot iron mix with earthy dust in the air.  Lanterns swing from wooden poles to create shifting shadows along the path lined with sparse some sparse bushes.

title: [Carnival, Entry]
description: Colorful streamers fly from the rooftops of tall wagons bordering the expansive entry to the carnival.  Lanterns on ribbon-wrapped poles shine light on the happy faces of the passing carnival goers.  Wafting scents of delicious foods mix with perfumes and colognes from the crowds.  Throngs of people moving about head towards various points of interest, some flocking around shouting street performers.  Minstrels conduct pleasant melodies to accompany the cacophony of the carnival.

title: [Carnival, Entrance]
description: Thick smoke and orange light rise into the starry sky from a ring of massive wagons that have been parked in a tight circle and lashed together, with an unhinged gate of black wrought iron guarding access.  Braziers atop the wagons cast flickering light on a sign above the gate proclaiming "CARNIVAL OF FREAKS" in stylized lettering.  Scents of sulfur and hot iron mix with earthy dust in the air.  Lanterns swing from wooden poles to create shifting shadows along the path lined with sparse bushes.

title: [Carnival, Creepy Corner]
description: Wagons border the carnival to the south and west as the main walkway circles around the central bonfire.  Coiled ropes fill the ground in the netted spaces between the wagons.  Boldly colored pennants and lanterns line the walkway.

title: [Carnival, Strange Street]
description: Light flickers across the wagons bordering the southern edge of the walkway from the bonfire to the northwest.  A tree stump remains to the side of the walkway, a stubborn reminder of the area before it was cleared for the carnival.  People pass by with looks of wonder and amazement.

title: [Carnival, Bonfire]
description: Dancing flames leap high into the air above a massive roaring bonfire, contained at the edge with a ring of small black stones, and filled with piles of painted effigies constructed of straw and wood.  Violent pops from the crackling blaze launch showers of sparks spinning into the air above.  Another outer ring of larger smooth black stones encircles the inferno providing comfortable places to rest and observe the spectacle as carnival goers come and go.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Carnival, Peculiar Path]
description: The wall of wagons closes off the eastern edge of the walkway.  Old baskets and trunks have been piled up in the spaces between to prevent escape.  Toffee and popcorn scents fill the air.  A brightly colored bench has been placed here off of the main path.

title: [Carnival, Wild Walkway]
description: Vibrant pennants are strung along the edges of the wagons bordering the walkway along the north and east.  Odd-sized crates and boxes, stacked haphazardly, fill the gaps between the wagons.  Children play with colorful streamers as lively carnival goers pass through in festive outfits.

title: [Carnival, Curious Court]
description: Carnival goers walk by, eyes wide at the various spectacles on offer.  This area of the walkway is clear of debris or litter.  Stacked barrels lashed together barricade the areas between the wagons bordering the walkway to the north, while it continues east and west.

title: [Carnival, Quirky Quarter]
description: Circling along the wagons parked to the north and west, the walkway continues around the outer edge of the carnival grounds.  Piles of debris lashed together with nets fill the gaps between the wagons.  Excited chatter from carnival goers fills the air.  Footprints circle a moist patch in the walkway.

title: [Carnival, Weirdo Way]
description: The crowds thin out here away from the carnival entry, the walkway headed north and south along the tightly parked wagons to the west.  A tower of discarded wooden chairs of all types prevents passage through the gap between the wagons.  The raging bonfire to the east can be glimpsed between the tents and stalls along this part of the walkway.

title: [Feets of Strength, Shop]
description: Pink canvas flaps line this room, making it a flimsy so-called shop littered with empty liquor barrels containing wares.  The dusty floor has a worn path leading from the entrance to the performance area in the back.

title: [Feets of Strength, Stage]
description: The walls of this canvas tent move with the breeze from outside.  Bare earth serves as the floor, and the ground underfoot is littered with peanut shells.  At one end of the room is a stage of sorts, built out of heavy stone sturdy enough to hold heavy props.  No seating has been made available, leaving only the meager space between the front of the stage and the tent walls for spectators to gather.

title: [Skinny Sipping, Showroom]
description: With a lacquer in its final days, the dark hardwood flooring appears dull under bright lantern light.  A display case, accompanied by a shoe rack and equipment hooks, clutters the front half of the room opposite a stage backdropped by a tall burgundy crushed velvet curtain leading to the backroom.  The pale yellow walls are embossed with ornate columns separated by top-fastened black velvet drapes, offering the appearance of windows.

title: [Skinny Sipping, Backroom]
description: White wooden planks, hastily covered with beige plaster, form walls whose color remains unbroken until meeting with a tall burgundy crushed velvet curtain.  At the rear, portraits of grotesque and disfigured people hang on the wall above a short cherrywood desk complemented by some round brown leather chairs.

title: [All Leathered Up, Antechamber]
description: Cold and dark, this small, windowless room serves as an entryway leading to a larger workspace.  Tanned hides and scraps of black leather are scattered across the dirt-covered flooring, while a wooden rack and a rickety table provide a rudimentary display for this shop's wares.  A heavy acidity lingers in the air, presumably from an overuse of tanning dyes and curing liquids.

title: [All Leathered Up, Workspace]
description: A dingy bedraggled blanket lies crumpled up in the corner of this cramped workspace.  Several wooden stools are set in the center of the workspace, forming a rough semi-circle.  Large shearing implements and pockmarked metal harvesting tools have been mounted to freshly cut pine walls.

title: [Tooth and Scale, Wares]
description: Small cages, nests, and piles of rodent bedding are littered throughout most of the tent, and near-constant rustling, scratching, and squeaking noises can be heard.  A path through the clutter leads to a makeshift table fashioned from a heavy linden door resting on slatted crates, a satin-lined checkered trunk thrown open on the floor beside it.  Opposite the entrance flap, a small archway is framed by thick black velvet curtains tied back with vermilion satin cords.

title: [Tooth and Scale, Ymantha's Lair]
description: Markedly different from the other room in the tent, this octagonal space is quite clean and free of the beastly chaos of the salesroom.  Thickly piled carpeting of a scarlet hue covers the floor, obscured in many spots by large, particolored black and white floor cushions.  A heavy black velvet curtain blocks the view of the rest of the tent, muffling the sound surprisingly well.

title: [Weighted Scales]
description: The darkness in this wagon is oppressive, and the few light sources struggle to illuminate most of the nooks and crannies.  A dark wardrobe stands open against one wall, and some hanging baskets dangle from the ceiling.  The floor underneath is cloaked in shadow, but creaks slowly whenever there is movement.  Hanging in a particularly shadowy corner is a tattered grey curtain.

title: [Weighted Scales, Workroom]
description: This narrow workroom is more brightly lit than the main part of the wagon.  Flickering torches cast constant shadows across the bare walls, and several barrels of varying sizes stand in one corner.  Dominating the cramped space is a small worktable with a high-backed chair placed behind it.  Scuff marks and gouges cover the floor, though they appear aged and dusty.

title: [Sight Unseen, Shop]
description: Smooth wooden walls encapsulate the room, their surfaces carved with vines.  Bundles of herbs hang from the ceiling, filling the room with a floral scent.  Along one wall is a set of shelves holding crystal balls.  Pendulums hang from a small wire rack, and boxes and bowls sit on a carved rosewood bench.  In the center of the room, a large table is covered in toy gnomes.  A tall oak stand with baskets hanging from it stands next to the door.  Above the stand is an exclamation point shaped sign.

title: [Sight Unseen, Living Area]
description: Bright yellow curtains drape over the glass panes of the windows, filtering the bright light of the bonfire and casting the room partially in shadow.  A large wooden bunk takes up one side of the room, a rainbow-colored quilt folded neatly at the end of the bed.  A large leather chair sits in the corner of the room next to a rosewood dresser.

title: [Spirit Servants, Boutique]
description: Flickering candles cast long shadows in this small room.  Jars containing various body parts sit on shelves around the room and rotted skulls hang from the ceiling with leather ties.  The pungent aroma of incense, laden with ginger, cinnamon, and peppercorns, lingers in the room.  Centered on the back wall is an altar adorned with a shimmering green table runner and three skulls situated around burning incense.  Clustered around a small round table are a wrought iron cage, a black wicker basket, and an oak chest.

title: [Phestor's Phishery, Showroom]
description: The inside of this wagon appears to be a surprisingly spacious, hastily cleaned, showroom floor for fishing supplies.  A compartmented tacklebox adorns the center of the room and is sandwiched between a tall basket filled with fishing rods and a pile of rhimar-lined crates.  A large fish tank rests inside of one of two cutouts in the back wall, the other of which is a conspicuously curtained archway.  A grimy oak door has writing hastily scrawled above it in dried blood.

title: [Phestor's Phishery, Workroom]
description: The centerpiece of this extremely unsanitary room is a large worktable and the accompanying workbench on either side.  Both the table and the floor are littered with eclectic debris consisting mostly of fish pieces, body parts in various states of decay, and other materials used in the construction of fishing rods, lures, and tackleboxes.  A cutout in the wall allows viewing of the backside of the fish tank, and a curtained archway leads back to the showroom floor.

title: [Knife To Meet You, Showroom]
description: The dimly-lit, expansive interior of this tent is centered around a large tent pole.  Dark gold tapestries depicting people being run through with various implements drape the length of the walls.  Several sanguine velvet benches are clustered together for an audience on one side of the tent, while the other side is open with a carpeted floor.  A single bright lantern illuminates a giant-sized board bearing numerous puncture holes that has been propped up to face the benches.

title: [Positively Fletching, Sales]
description: The musty interior of the shack smells like a combination of freshly cut wood and old glue.  Rows of yew shelving piled high with various wares line the otherwise bare walls.  A thick ironwood door pockmarked by years of being used for target practice leads to a tiny workroom.  Sitting next to the door is a small mesille stand.

title: [Positively Fletching, Workroom]
description: The sticky floor of the cozy, dimly lit workspace is strewn with wood shavings and feathers.  Hanging over a tiny steel table in the corner, a single flickering sconce casts dancing light off various fletching tools.  A small nook on the far side of the room is lined with a pile of cushions.

title: [The Hair of the Dog]
description: Small and bright, this space somehow manages to be cozy instead of cramped.  A sturdy oak sideboard sits adjacent to a battered mahogany bar, the surfaces of both covered in edible and drinkable wares.  A set of twisted iron hooks is nailed onto the wall next to a swinging door that leads back to the kitchen.  While the polished wood floors are smooth and unblemished, they seem to have gathered a perpetual layer of shed hair that blows around like miniature furry tumbleweeds.

title: [The Hair of the Dog, Kitchen]
description: Stuffy and slightly cramped, this space is filled with the smell of frying food.  A crackling fire burns within a round-bodied cast iron stove, the constant heat radiating from it causing the air to be heavy and moist.  A scarred wooden table is pushed up against one wall, the battered surface covered with knives and other cooking utensils.  Tucked into an out of the way corner is a roughly hewn stone wash basin with a chipped rim.  Tiny tufts of shed hair are just visible scattered across the wooden floor.

title: [Carnival, Midway Entrance]
description: The sound of a roaring bonfire and the loud din of various conversations filter in from a weed-filled dirt path.  Large signs, once gaily painted but now suffering from time and element, all indicate the lackluster promise of fun and prizes, with arrows pointing to the entrance of the midway.  The smells of old fish and blood mingle unpleasantly in the air.

title: [Carnival, Fish Bowling]
description: A skeletal bare-limbed tree looms over a towering glass-walled fish tank filled with murky water, its thin bone-like branches rattling against the sides of the tank whenever the wind gusts.  Several feet away, a bug-eyed scaly gnomish boy stands next to a crude line drawn into the dirt with a metal bucket of slimy eyeballs sitting at his feet.  The pungent scent of fish, some fresh and some past their prime, permeates the area.

title: [Carnival, Skullball]
description: Huge and imposing, a giant skull stands sentinal over this area on a section of cleared ground.  A curved ramp made out of various bones has been settled in front of it, one end pointing directly at the skull's gaping mouth.  A gangly four-armed man keeps watch from one side with a wooden bucket of knucklebone balls at his feet.

title: [Carnival, Blood Bath]
description: Most of the ground here is sticky and moist, the constant overflow of blood seeping into the dirt creating a red-tinged muddy slurry underfoot.  A line of vultite-braced cannons, connected at one end to a squat metal vat, stands several feet in front of a set of targets.  A brawny horned man stands watch to one side, his bare chest splattered with the blood mixture used in the game.

title: [Carnival, Delightfully Diverse]
description: This area of straw-covered ground is fenced in by planks of wood held together and upright by copious amounts of wire and twine.  The loud cracks and pops of a large bonfire can be heard through a wire-covered crooked gate, whereas the occasional sound of some vicious beast can be heard from the direction of a loose-swinging door.

title: [Carnival, Visibly Vicious]
description: The accessible area here is limited, surrounded on all sides by wire fences, save for one narrow gap occupied by a loose-swinging door.  Behind the fences are large animal enclosures, each containing various, though odd, inhabitants.

title: [Knife To Meet You, Workshop]
description: This area behind the partition is small yet cozy.  Lush tapestries depicting scenes from a royal bathhouse drape the walls.  Resting on the ground by the tent wall is a bed of nails with a small table posted nearby.  A three-legged stool sits near a sharpening wheel, while a standing mirror accompanies a small vanity that is covered with a multitude of lit candles.  Tucked behind the vanity is a wardrobe filled with garments of various colors.

title: [Hinklehorn's, Haggard Hookup]
description: Against the far wall, a doorless wardrobe is pushed up against one side of a three-legged table to keep it from falling over.  A collection of hastily hastily nailed boards serves as a makeshift rack, which looks nearly ready to fall from where it is hooked to the wall.  An odd set of muddy footprints leads from a dirt-caked oak door and seems to disappear amongst the rest of the dirt covering the floor.

title: [Hinklehorn's, Heavenly Horizon]
description: Nature scenes, in the form of murals, cover the walls in this cozy little room.  In the center of the room stands a large glass-covered counter, while a large mahogany armoire, painted to look like a tree stump, sits in a corner.  A lavender cedar shoe rack is nestled next to a sun-painted white oak door on the southern side of the room.

title: [Hinklehorn's, Hidden Hideaway]
description: Some colorful cushions are spread around the room near a small bar that is set in the far corner.  Hung between a misshapen hole in the wall and a lavender silk curtain is a gilded mahogany sign.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Riverbank]
description: A few modwir trees have taken root along the river, growing in between the houses.  A gentle breeze shakes their towering boughs, causing their needles to quiver with a whispering rustle.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Riverbank]
description: Wooden houses dot the plain, encroaching upon the river.  They would seem to be a hodgepodge of styles, some of them grand and elegant, others small and modest.  Many of them feature gardens splashed with a myriad of floral colors.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Riverbank]
description: The Locksmehr river sweeps lazily through the grasslands in a series of oxbows, its clear, spring-fed waters gently rolling on towards the sea.  Streamers of aquatic vegetation writhe hypnotically in the slow current, as if they were swimming against it.  A path parallels the western bank of the river, allowing travel towards a clutch of wooden buildings to the south.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Glade]
description: The sound of nature's symphony wells up around you.  Shoes clatter upon the cobblestones to provide a staccato rhythm to the river's roar, while the occasional birdsong rises above the din to provide a melody.

title: [Melgorehn's Crossing, Glade]
description: The river widens into a pool, marking the southern boundary of the glade.  Children play in the water, dunking one another gleefully.  Occasionally one will climb a large oak tree on the riverbank, swing out over the water by a rope tied to one of its limbs, and then let go to fall into the pool with a splash.

title: [North Shore, Beach]
description: Foamy waters lap at the stone jetty jutting out into the waves.  Near its end, a grizzled old dwarf squats on a small barrel.  With a fishing pole in his hands and a pipe stuck in his grin, he looks to be at peace.

title: [North Shore, Beach]
description: White sandy beach stretches out towards the ocean.  Powerful eddies swirl along the shore churning silt and seashells before rolling back to sea.  Playful seabirds flit through the sky.

title: [North Shore, Beach]
description: High-banked dunes of light colored sand provide beachgoers private little spots to escape prying eyes. Choppy waves splash against the shore.  Warm trade winds blow bits of sand back from the sea's edge.

title: [North Shore, Woods]
description: Large evergreens overlook the path leading to the beach below.  The hill continues upward to the east.  Despite the sandy ground and the steep incline, the trees seem to be thriving here.

title: [North Shore, Woods]
description: The undergrowth has begun to thin out here.  A few tall conifers have crowded out the smaller trees.  The trail continues onward east to west.

title: [North Shore, Woods]
description: Tall conifers with drooping boughs have flourished in the sandy soil.  Scattered pine needles and browning pinecones carpet the loamy ground.  Winding between the trees the path continues from east to west.

title: [North Shore, Woods]
description: The trees begin to thin out here.  Underfoot the earth seems sandier and less able to support the towering evergreens indigenous to the area.  Off in the distance, you can see where the tree line ends and dunes of sand begin.

title: [North Shore, Bluffs]
description: The cliffs overlooking the beach are formed from rainbow colored clay.  Bright colored streaks of pink, red, and blue can be spotted running down the face of the cliff.  Along the edge of the bluff, a few boulders provide places for sitting and watching the surf below.

title: [North Shore, Bluffs]
description: The cliff edge seems soft and brittle.  Chunks of multi-colored clay from the face have broken off and tumbled down to the beach below.  The ocean stretches outward toward the distant horizon.

title: [North Shore, Riverbank]
description: Two tall towers guard the river opening, standing ready to repel sea-raiders.  Shipping passes under the watch posts.  Fishing boats troll their nets off in the distance, and heavily laden cargo boats make their way up and down the river.

title: [North Shore, Bluffs]
description: The pounding surf below crashes up against the cliff, spraying water up the sides.  From up here the large waves rolling in below look small.  A few shrubs have managed to take root along the craggy clay edge.

title: [North Shore, Riverbank]
description: The river's current is much stronger here and not at all suitable for wading.  Boats moving upstream need to break out the oars or hope for favorable winds.  Fragrant wildflowers poke out of the thick green grass growing along the sides of the banks.

title: [North Shore, Riverbank]
description: Rich green grass grows on both sides of the river.  Pleasure boats and merchant shipping pass by going up and down stream.  Tall reeds and cottontails have sprung up in the shallow waters by the river's edge.

title: [North Shore, Beach]
description: Undulating swells pound the ragged shoreline.  Bright colored seashells dot the sand.  Long trails of algae and broken pieces of driftwood bob slowly in the water, floating in and out to sea with the changing tides.

title: [North Shore, Bay View]
description: The coast below seems to extend out for miles.  The ocean dances and sparkles as its deep waters constantly move governed only by the tides.  Off in the distance ships sail slowly across the horizon.

title: [North Shore, Sandspit]
description: At Lands End, a long narrow strip of sand curves out providing a natural breakwater for the bay.  Merchant ships pass by in either direction on their way to offload and barter precious cargoes.  Their sails whip in the constant wind blowing in from sea.

title: [North Shore, Tide Pool]
description: The pounding surf has cut deeper inland forming a tidal pool.  Starfish, scurrying crabs and tiny silvery fish can be found swimming in these clear swirling waters.  The water here looks deep enough for swimming.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest

title: [North Shore, River View]
description: The river below burbles merrily along.  A few seaside homes have been built along this vantage point taking advantage of the scenic river and ocean views.  Pleasure boats as well as cargo fluyts can be spotted making their way up and down river throughout most times of the day.

title: [North Shore, Tidal Pool]
description: Crisp clear water swirls all around you.  Schools of tiny silver-finned fish flit about through the deep waters forming the pool.  The sandy sea bottom underneath is covered with bright colored shells that look close enough to touch but are down so deep that you cannot reach them.

title: [Hinklehorn's, Hidden Hideaway]
description: Some colorful cushions are spread around the room near a small bar that is set in the far corner.  Hung between a misshapen hole in the wall and a lavender silk curtain is a gilded mahogany sign.

title: [Jahadeem's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by mottled grey marble walls, the shop features a scaled model of Hearthstone in the center of its mahogany floor.  A portrait of Darkstone Castle hangs under the fel panel ceiling.  Right near the front is a glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Jahadeem's Lockpicks]
description: A ruby-eyed grinning skull hangs on one of the varnished ebonwood walls, and an ebonwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  An open-mawed greater vruul statue sits in one corner of a speckled black marble floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and a glass-topped mistwood counter on the other.

title: [Jahadeem's General Store]
description: A pearl-handled filigreed mandolin hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls, and a mistwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  A bronzed drake sculpture sits in one corner of a dappled celadon marble floor.  There is a vine-carved mahogany table on one side of the shop and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on the other.

title: [The Harrows, Hanging Valley]
description: The valley is confined on three sides by a massif of dark, jagged peaks, their claw-like tines nearly drowning out sight of off-kilter peaks elsewhere in the mountain range.  A small stream snakes its way between gigantic black boulders, before spilling over the southern edge of the hung valley.  Nestled in the lee of the northern rim amid a maze of stunted hawthorn, a dark grey manor faces the open skyline.  A narrow slope leads down and out of the valley, its approach marked with an elaborate gate spiked with razern finials.

The valley is confined on three sides by a range of dark, jagged rocks, their claw-like tines reaching up to a faint light high in the west.  A small stream, snaking through a maze of stunted hawthorn, spills out of sight to the south, where a break in the massif yields only the abyss of night.  Facing the dark skyline stands a two-story dark grey manor, its windows shrouded by curtains.  Arching bronze cressets stand before a narrow escarpment leading out of the valley, its approach marked with an elaborate razern gate.
location: The Harrows, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [The Harrows, Atelier]
description: Dark grey granite pilasters, each set with a silver sconce, offset the concave foyer with its richly stained villswood doors from the rest of the atelier.  Clerestory rayonnant rose windows brightly illuminate the room and its three galleries, each recess framed with crimson curtains.  A lightly raised barbed trefoil dais of silver-blue granite showcases a glass-domed black pedestal at its center, while pale hide backstools are arranged on the lobes.  Between the north and east exhibits rests a pair of bleached haon credenzas on either side of a beechwood door.

Two dark grey granite pilasters, partially set into the ivory stucco walls, offset the rounded foyer and its richly stained villswood doors from the rest of the atelier.  Strapwork silver niello sconces alight three recessed galleries on display in the hall, each alcove drawn with plush crimson curtains.  Several pale hide backstools line the room, leaving empty the barbed trefoil dais of silver-blue granite and its glass-domed black pedestal in the center.  A pair of bleached haon credenzas on either side of a beechwood door are set along the northeast wall.
location: The Harrows, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [The Harrows, Veranda]
description: The patio is enclosed by a wicketed colonnade of black granite supporting a gently sloped portico of crimson-stained glaesine tile.  Patinated copper balustrades line the spiral staircase and second story gallery, with a frosted glass panel sided by many windows, lain open to capture the breeze.  Wrought iron chairs with velvet padding are set throughout the spongy creeping thyme groundcover, the earth speckled in motes of dusky violet and lemon yellow.  Across the way, a white gravel terrace surrounds an octagonal cerulean mosaic pool and its copper maiden water feature.

The patio is ringed by a wicketed black granite colonnade, each set with lanterns that cast wavering shadows across the ground.  Dense layers of creeping thyme encroach upon the white gravel terrace where several wrought iron chairs with velvet padding are positioned around an octagonal cerulean mosaic pool featuring a pale green copper maiden sculpture.  Placed back from the tile roof of the veranda, a patinated copper balustrade lines the spiral staircase to a second story gallery, its frosted glass panel entry and many windows enshrouded in curtains.
location: The Harrows, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [The Harrows, Hot Spring]
description: Leafless boughs of mangled hawthorn draped with amber lanterns arc over the surroundings, casting faint shadows across the wide pool of a steaming hot spring, its surface burbling with a bevy of bubbles.  Sinuous coils of a two-headed copper serpent statue wind their way through cinnabar slate rocks jutting up from the water, its moist, patinated scales reflecting in the scant daylight.  Low crops of bulrush are strewn around the water's edge, their vertical canes resplendent with drops of moisture.  To the north, a passageway through the haw leads to a glaes-bound mithril door at the face of the mountain.

Bare boughs of mangled hawthorn draped with amber lanterns arc over the surroundings, throwing dark shadows across a wide pool of a steaming hot spring, its surface gently roiling.  Sinuous coils of a two-headed copper serpent statue wind their way through the cinnabar slate rocks jutting up from the water, its patinated scales awash in a faint, warm glow.   Low crops of bulrush dot the edges, their vertical canes resplendent with drops of moisture.  To the north, a barely discernible route leads further into the haw toward a glaes-bound mithril door at the face of the mountain.
location: The Harrows, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [The Harrows, Dark Chamber]
description: A damaged cavern dome arcs overhead, its myriad of scarred glyphs interrupted by massive blue-black rock shards covered in helictites, thrust through the ceiling like abhorrent, metastatic stone fists.  Twin chains ending in vicious razern hooks dangle from the rock formations, set dead center.  Faint rays of sunlight peek through the shattered crown to illuminate a blackened rosewood bench inlaid with electrum damascene near the north wall, where a broken ivory statue of a man is bathed in crimson light from the large glaes orb perched upon a black altar at its feet.

The overhead cavern is splintered by dark geologic formations jutting through roof like claws, rife with malignancy.  Spiraled candelabras broadcast geometric shadows across the silvery inlaid granite floor where the light is interrupted by vicious razern hooks strung from above and a blackened rosewood bench inlaid with electrum damascene set just beyond.  Dominating the north wall, a broken ivory statue is stained by the light of a crimson glaes orb set upon a black altar at the sculpture's feet.  The effigy's crooked smile is horribly marred, and a single hand remains lofted above its head.
location: The Harrows, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [The Harrows, Apartment]
description: Tall glass panels along the eastern wall capture the breeze, while slender oriel windows of fengite line the clerestory above.  Several works of art in double-cased frames grace the ivory walls of the airy apartment.  Set nearer the entry, a stained rimu marquetry desk and some leopardwood curule chairs padded in raisin black velvet are situated upon a round crimson rug.  Elaborately worked damascened screens separate the space, the rear quarter containing a grand fireplace with a dark grey granite mantle between a four-poster mahogany bed canopied in scarlet silk and mahogany curios.

The ivory walls of the spacious apartment are filled with art in some double-cased frames.  Slender oriel windows ring the clerestory, each partnered with a punctured copper lantern.  Situated nearer the entry, a stained rimu marquetry desk and some leopardwood curule chairs padded in raisin black velvet are set upon a round crimson rug.  Richly damascened screens partition the private living quarters, where a four-poster mahogany bed canopied in scarlet silk and matching mahogany curios stand on either side of the grand fireplace with a dark grey granite mantle.  Crimson drapery shrouds the eastern wall, separated by a frosted glass panel.
location: The Harrows, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Three's a Crowd, Labels]
description: The large space is broken by a curtain that separates the front area from the rest of the tent.  Gold thread swirls through the forest green canvas, creating a marbling effect that catches the light from the torches stuck in the dirt floor at the corners of the space.  In the center of the area, a circular wooden display holds three sections of wares for sale.  A gap in the curtain leads deeper into the tent.

title: [Three's a Crowd, Shoes]
description: This section of the tent is bookended by curtains dividing the interior space.  One end sports a narrow gap leading to the front area, while opposite, a ragged slit that leads deeper into the tent.  The marbled canvas walls on either side are lined with narrow displays that house a variety of footwear, leaving a central aisle clear for walking.  A torch stuck into the dirt floor in each corner lends a flickering glow to the room, and illuminates the wares set up on the displays.

title: [Three's a Crowd, Containers]
description: The air in this area of the tent is stuffy and scented like smoke from the torches burning in each corner of the room.  The green canvas walls are marbled with gold thread that glints in the light.  A bin to one side contains several large containers, while a standing rack with hooks houses containers of a smaller nature.  At one end of the room, a ragged slit in the curtain divider leads out, while in the wall opposite, a break in the curtain leads deeper into the tent.

title: [Twilight, Tobaccos and Pipes]
[Twilight Tobaccos & Pipes]
[Twilight Tobaccos and Pipes]
description: Dark blue silk canopies cover this spacious shop containing couches and chairs, with a thick ornamental rug covering the floor.  Similar burgundy silks drape the walls and windows.  Opposite the door, a counter holds a silver tray and a glass case, behind which is a wood shelf attached to the wall beside a curtained alcove.  In one corner of the subtly smoke-scented space, a small fireplace continually circulates air through its chimney to the outside.

Dark blue silk canopies cover this spacious shop containing plush couches and comfy chairs, with a thick ornamental rug covering the floor.  Similar burgundy silks drape the walls and windows.  Opposite the door, a counter holds a silver tray and a glass case, behind which is a wood shelf attached to the wall.  In one corner of the subtley smoke-scented space, a small fireplace continually circulates air through its chimney outside.
