In one corner of the subtly smoke-scented space, a small fireplace continually circulates air through its chimney to the outside.

title: [The Betterment Boutique, Entry]
description: A combination of pale blues and dark blues spill down from the silver tent's ceiling, the lengths of fabric anything but asymmetrical in their placement and patterning.  Accenting the fabric and lighting the largely open tent are a plethora of lanterns lit with brightly burning flames, and the smoke rising out of them creates a dull haze that hangs in the air.  Tall unlit candles border walkways that lead farther into the tent.  Just beyond the entrance, a small plaque sits atop a black wood table.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, west, northwest, out
Obvious exits: northeast, south, west, northwest, out

title: [The Betterment Boutique]
description: Multiple hard-backed chairs of steel are scattered around the area, which is edged in gold-framed mirrors of varying sizes.  Placed in the spaces between the mirrors are warped wooden blocks with Elven alphabet letters painted on them in vibrant violets and yellows.

title: [The Betterment Boutique]
description: Alternating dark blue and pale blue panels of fabric cascade down from the tent's ceiling to partition this area off from the main entry.  Opposite a plain black bench are several tall metal devices, each built with a door decorated in poor quality etchings, as if a child drew them, of some figures being stretched apart into unnatural lengths and other figures being squashed down so that their chests sit just above their feet.  A gold-framed mirror is propped up adjacent the row of devices.

title: [The Betterment Boutique]
description: Gold-framed mirrors line the edges of the area, reflecting and refracting light from multiple curving, eel-shaped lanterns that hang down from above.  Smoke drifting up from the lanterns creates a haze that hangs in the air.  Hanging down from the ceiling, a twist of dark blue fabric is paired to each of several hard-backed steel chairs.

title: [The Betterment Boutique]
description: Dominating the space is a large, especially tall painting of an elf, his features bearing hints of Ardenai ancestry, with long, flowing hair formed from silvery eels.  As if mimicking the props in the painting, the black-cushioned chairs situated around the space here are similarly upholstered and appear to be exact replicas of the one the elf sits upon.  Suspended in the center of the area from above by a pale blue swathe of fabric is a gold-framed mirror.

title: [The Betterment Boutique]
description: Forming a ring around the area, with several hanging down at odd angles in between the ones that are standing upright on their own, multiple gold-framed mirrors add the illusion of space to the small space.  Several hard-backed steel chairs stand next to small tables topped with the accoutrements of styling hair, though some sets of scissors are twisted in ways that render them virtually useless.

title: [Flares of Interest]
description: Bright yellow and cobalt blue canvas sails are draped across each other to create a light protective awning over the small oak-sided stall.  Thick ropes of hemp secure the ceiling to the walls and even assist in binding various shelves into place using complex lashing knots.  A single oak counter stretches across the entry, while small wooden drawers hang under the shelves.  A wooden sign dangles precariously on the counter's edge.

title: [The Pleco, Dive Bar]
description: The prominent feature of this dim, compact space, is the short walnut bar lined with some squat bar stools bolted to the floor, providing beverages and respite along the far wall.  Behind it, shelves rise to the ceiling displaying an assortment of colored bottles in all shapes and sizes.  Rows of brass pipes run overhead and along the walls, punctuated by the odd knob or valve handle.  A half dozen ale kegs are strapped to the floor behind the bar, lashed together with thick leather belts.

title: [Familiar Things, Grounded]
description: Each of the walls within the cottage are lined with numerous paintings.  Sitting atop a long counter lie a glass-covered display case and a silk-lined cedar box, both displaying wares for sale.  A single swinging door leads back outside, while a sky blue silk drape leads further into the shop.

title: [Familiar Things, Flying High]
description: The floor is covered with a layer of tree bark, and the walls are painted with visions of sprouting leaves breaking away to blue sky and clouds.  A pair of jewelry trees rise up from the floor, each of their branch-like limbs displaying a number of items.  The only escapes from this arboreal mirage appear to be a sky blue silk drape and a white cotton curtain.

title: [Firio's Fancy Sheaths]
description: Old yellowed billets paper the walls of this colorful, if ragged, wagon.  Beside a lead glass curio cabinet, a coat rack dangles an assortment of weapon sheaths, with yet more merchandise available atop a pile of frayed pillows and an ink-stained desk.

title: [Idol Worship, Showroom]
description: Tiny crystal globes hang from the domed ceiling by slender bronze chains.  Standing in the center of the tent is a small wooden counter, its surface etched with a series of undecipherable runes.  Lengths of scarlet and ebon silk wrap about silvery mistwood poles that hold up the thick dark velvet creating the roof above.  A thick velvet flap partially hidden in the drape of the walls leads to another area.

title: [Noteworthiness, Entrance]
[Noteworthiness]
description: Swathes of striped linen partition the interior into several sections grouped by wares.  While the shop is slightly cramped, there is still adequate space to navigate between inventory displays and to reach other areas of the tent.  Some straw-stuffed crates have been stacked beside an open iron-bound chest on one side of the path, and a yellow cloth-covered table stands opposite them.

title: [Noteworthiness, Wind]
[Noteworthiness]
description: A thick bronze wire has been strung up between two tent posts, upon which hang a number of instruments.  Beneath the aerial display is a simple glass case illuminated by lit green and blue votive candles.  A ramshackle armoire doubles as a bookcase housing a number of bound musical compositions.  Nearby, a wide brass stand has been partially draped by a faded patchwork quilt, though most of its contents are visible from other areas of the tent.

title: [Noteworthiness, Coda]
[Noteworthiness]
description: Spanning several feet, a long wooden plank has been repurposed and painted into a blue and seafoam green shelf, supported by empty rum barrels.  A thin teakwood tray rests atop a wave-painted table along with a glass jug filled with seashells.  Beyond a rather plain-looking steel rack, a cuphea-edged layered linen curtain obscures what lies to the west.

title: [Bloodlet it Go, Triage]
[Bloodlet It Go, Triage]
description: A line of hard wooden chairs is set against one wall of this spacious tent, directly across from an embroidered tapestry.  One corner is occupied by a tall fireleaf cabinet, its battered fiery-hued doors open wide to display several items of hanging clothing.  The wind periodically causes the canvas walls of the tent to ripple, sending the coppery scent of blood flowing through the space.

A line of hard wooden chairs is set against one wall of this spacious tent, directly across from an embroidered tapestry.  One corner is occupied by a round wicker basket and a tall fireleaf cabinet, its battered, fiery-hued doors open wide to display several items of hanging clothing.  The wind periodically causes the canvas walls of the tent to ripple, sending the coppery scent of blood flowing through the space.

title: [Bloodlet it Go, Treatment]
[Bloodlet It Go, Treatment]
description: Bloodstains, some of them fresh and some old, cover the floor surrounding a padded black leather chair with wide arms and the stool settled next to it.  An iron-hinged wooden supply chest, its heavy lid thrown open to display the contents within, sits near a low mahogany table covered in medicinal teas.  An embroidered tapestry hangs prominently on one wall of the tent, the fabric swaying with every movement of the canvas.  Segmenting off a small section near the back of the tent is a bloodstained linen curtain, its edges slightly tattered from heavy use.

title: [First Comes Love]
description: You see a triangular space dramatically lit by numerous hanging glass globes, each one containing a single, flickering candle.  The olive colored walls and deep maroon ceiling have been fashioned of a sturdy fabric, cleverly draped to create an inviting space.  A hint of spice lightly scents the air.  Padded benches line two of the tent's three walls and are scattered with overstuffed cushions in a variety of sizes and shapes.

title: [First Comes Love, Chapel]
description: This triangular room is airy and light.  The space smells remarkably crisp and fresh for having no windows.  The tent walls and ceiling are made up entirely of layer upon layer of sheer white fabric.  With no discernable light source, the room still manages to be blindingly bright.  Intricately woven chains of verdant ivy have been used to lovely effect against the diaphanous material.  High-backed, white fabric covered chairs have been placed artfully throughout the room.

title: [First Comes Love, Nursery]
description: This generously sized triangular room's walls and ceiling have been fashioned with fabric in colors so pale they are difficult to identify.  Strings of tiny silver lights cover the ceiling, highlighting the shining, golden moon and stars appliques that cling to the walls in haphazard patterns.  A faint but sweet scent of powder seems to fade the longer you stay in the room.  In the far corner of the room stands a life-sized stuffed giraffe next to a white-washed wooden rocking chair.

title: [Beck and Call]
description: Sunbleached sailcloth walls billow in and out with every gust of wind, a salty seabreeze drifting in through an untied tent flap.  The hard-packed sand underfoot is littered with iridescent, broken shells and bits of smooth sea glass.  A piece of grey driftwood lays atop an empty wine barrel, a makeshift display table organized with vendibles.

title: [Higher Thinking]
description: The smooth, unevenly spaced driftwood that comprise the walls of this poorly constructed shack give evidence in both sight and smell of ages spent in or near the swelling sea; indeed, bits of sand and dried muck cling desperately to the occasional dent in the wood of several of the logs.  Through gaps in the walls, you hear waves crashing eternally in rhythm with the unabating buzzing of big bugs.  The ground below is formed of a mixture of crushed seashells, sand, and other unidentifable substances.

title: [Caligos Isle, Northern Passage]
description: Lying along the edge of the plateau is the spine of some enormous sea creature, its monstrous ribcage resting on the debris-strewn path like an eerie ossified arcade.  The bones gleam a ghostly white in the moonlight, a faint echo of the life they once held.  A winding sandy trail descends into a jungle of new growth, disappearing as it passes a felled tree darkened with necrosis.

title: [Dead Ringer, Showroom]
description: Swathes of black lace adorn the darkly stained wood of this small showroom.  The starry sky is visible through a circular opening in the ceiling, and several candelabra cast their flickering light upon an elegantly carved ebony coffin and a small gilded bell nearby.  A burnt velvet curtain partially obscures a doorway leading to the back of the wagon.

Swathes of black lace adorn the darkly stained wood of this small showroom.  Muted sunlight streams through a circular opening in the ceiling and onto a small gilded bell which stands beside an elegantly carved ebony coffin.  A burnt velvet curtain partially obscures a doorway leading to the back of the wagon.

title: [Good Mourning, Showroom]
description: The interior of the store has been carefully crafted to resemble a funeral parlor.  Miniature replicas of coffins, hand-carved from a variety of different woods, are centered on pedestals around the perimeter of the showroom.  A male display area adorns the left side of the shop, and some carefully posed female mannequins decorate the right side.  An accessory table has been meticulously placed in the exact center of the room.  A dark doorway leads to a room in the back, and some double doors lead back to the outside.

title: [Adventure Where, Smuggler's Hut]
description: Dark shadows stretch the length of this dusty hut, with half-rotted planks nailed haphazardly across the walls.  The entire structure appears to have been built with little care and great haste.  Along the back wall, an oversized black oak chest sits open and appears to have been stuffed haphazardly with various articles of clothing.  The faint outline of a trapdoor can just be made out in the dust piled in the back corner of the room.

title: [A Piercing Scream]
description: A subtle swirling pattern of gold and silver threads climbs the walls of this spacious, square tent.  A single golden pole in the center raises the ceiling high enough to fit even the tallest of giantkin, ornamented with a spiraling string of glittering crystal beads.

A subtle swirling pattern of gold and silver threads climbs the walls of this spacious, square tent.  A single golden pole in the center raises the ceiling high enough to fit even the tallest of giantkin, its polished surface ornamented with a spiraling string of glittering crystal beads.

title: [Look Sharp, Salesroom]
description: The walls of the shack are striped in thick black and red panels, and a long, low shelf runs the length of the one opposite the entrance.  The floor is littered with remnants of cork, and discarded peanut shells crunch underfoot.  An oversized dart board adorned with dull bronze numbers is painted on the paneling.

title: [A Wristed Development]
description: Lantern light flickers as salty, humid air drifts in from beyond a knotty pine half-door and lingers inside the half-circle room of reclaimed maoral.  A sandy stone floor offers a walking path around precious wares that shimmer from within a steel-framed glass display case supporting several mannequin legs, while more inventory dangles from a tiered platinum coil hanging from the ceiling.

Lantern light flickers as salty, humid air drifts in from beyond a knotty pine half-door and lingers inside the half-circle room of reclaimed maoral.  A sandy stone floor offers a walking path around precious wares that shimmer from within a steel-framed glass display case supporting some mannequin parts, while more shiny trinkets dangle from a tiered platinum coil hanging from the ceiling.

title: [Let's Be Blunt, Showroom]
description: The canvas walls of this dilapidated tent give very little refuge from the outside.  In fact, one wall has such a large tear in it that it probably shouldn't even be called a wall.  Near the corner, a small tunnel is protected by large crabs.  The floor is nothing but sand and rock and covered mostly with the blacksmith's supplies.

title: [Let's Be Blunt, Stockroom]
description: The room is haphazardly put together as this area primarily exists as a stockroom.  These walls are sturdier than those in the showroom due to large panels of riveted wood against the tent's frame.  Remnants of work lie everywhere on the floor from slabs of raw ores to small piles of metal shavings.

title: [Some Wear Over The Rainbow]
description: The area is decorated with deep reds, vivid oranges, and bright yellows.  Standing on either side of the exit are some varied wooden mannequins of varying shape and sizes, while a gold coin-carved table sits in the far corner.  Leading further into the wagon's compartments is a green paint-chipped archway.

title: [Some Wear Under The Rainbow]
description: Brilliant blues, iridescent indigoes, and vivacious violets seem to be the common themes in this compartment.  Colorful garments are stored on a low plum-colored counter while others are visible inside a short lilac-painted armoire.  Clashing with the rest of the room's theme, a painted black and white door leads towards the back of the wagon, and a green paint-chipped archway leads back towards the front of the wagon.

title: [Petti Little Knitpicker]
description: The six ramie silk walls of this tent cant outwards at a wide angle, opening up a large space that allows plenty of room for extensive examination of the garments for sale.  Tendrils of mist creep along the floor, nearly invisible except in the corners, where soft swirls of indigo gather.  Several large wrought iron stands hold trios of large candles that light the tent's interior from nearly every angle.

The six ramie silk walls of this tent span outward at a wide angle, opening up a large space that is divided only by strips of decorative, multicolored linen that hang down and disappear into a lurking, swirling, clinging grey mist.  Trios of large candles on curved stands, flames aglow but grazed and occasionally extinguished by the mist's finger-like tendrils, have been placed near ample clothing for sale herein.  The path through the tent continues to the north.

title: [For Your Protection]
description: A crimson and gold rug, woven with the image of a wyvern in flight, stretches across the floor of the wagon.  A low wooden bunk over a wooden drawer with a gear for a handle is built into the rear of the wagon, reinforced with two thick steel chains that secure it to the wall.  Brightly colored tapestries line the walls above neatly organized workspaces that hold bits of leather, assorted metal rings and plates, and other materials used in armor manufacturing.  Nearly hidden behind a diminutive armoire inlaid with copper sprockets is a small wooden hatch that leads outside.

title: [Idip Udip Wedip]
description: Crammed into the confines of this small space is a pair of armless maroon-on-jade jacquard silk upholstered chairs with a small oak table between them.  A long lacquered pine counter stretches from near the glass-paned door to the back wall, ending beside a skinny ladder leading up to the house's loft.

Crammed into the confines of this small space is a pair of armless maroon-on-jade jacquard silk upholstered chairs with a small oak table between them.  A long lacquered pine counter stretches from the near the glass-paned door to the back wall, ending beside a skinny ladder leading up to the house's loft.

title: [Petti Little Knitpicker]
description: The walls of the tent feel slightly more enclosed than to the south, where a larger collective of customers discusses the wares amongst one another.  Here, a handful of witch-balls provide lighting for the room, but from moment to moment cast what could be a montage of prophetic shadows with their flickering lights against the tent's silk walls.

The walls of the tent close in on this area, creating a slightly more intimate feel.  A handful of witch-balls provide lighting for the room as a whole, though they occasionally cast elaborate shadows against the tent's silk walls.  Small pieces of yarn litter the ground in this area, and most ambient noise is somewhat muted.  The indigo mist has crept into this space as well, and writhes slowly along the ground in nearly invisible tendrils.

title: [Anguillid Treasure, Ship Deck]
description: The deck of the ship is rotting away in some places, but is oddly pristine in others. Doubling as a hat stand, the bow area contains a miniature foremast. The main deck houses a table for accessories and a trunk for footwear, and the quarterdeck utilizes the ship's wheel as a clothing rack. Replica deck hands are seen fighting an intimidating dragon eel on the starboard side. Leading to the captain's quarters is an ornate wooden door, and moving to the stern of the ship reveals the exit.

title: [Imaera's Poem, Entry]
description: The wooden walls of the hut are covered with vines.  Vines hang from the ceiling, laden with strange fruits and flowers.  A low desk, formed entirely from a large tree stump, sits in the center of the room.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest, out

title: [Imaera's Poem, Felcour]
description: Mottled black and red vines cover the walls of the small hut.  The room stands empty except for a single set of shelves marked "Women" and a small rack marked "Men".

title: [Imaera's Poem, Greengair]
description: Verdant vines cover the walls of the small hut.  From the ceiling hangs umcor in the shape of raven feathers.  Colorful, multi-hued cornsilk dangles from the umcor.  A low wooden table sits to one side of the room with a small sign that reads "Women."  To the other side of the room is a set of vine-carved wooden shelves with a sign that reads "Men."

title: [Imaera's Poem, Angstholm]
description: Thick vines cover the walls of the small room.  Seashells have been strung from the ceiling alongside tawny owl feathers.  A low wooden table sits to one side of the room with a small sign that reads "Women."  To the other side of the room is a set of shell-carved wooden shelves with a sign that reads "Men."

title: [Imaera's Poem, Rosengift]
description: Bright purple vines cover the walls of the small hut.  Feathers of various sizes are hung from the ceiling, and in the corner sits a small water fountain.  A small wooden dresser sits in the center of the room, with a small sign on it that reads "Men."  Next to it is a tall metal rack which is hung with a sign that reads "Women."

title: [Imaera's Poem, Wendwillow]
description: Thick vines cover the walls of the small room.  Albatross feathers have been strung from the ceiling alongside strands of tiny shells.  A low wooden table sits to one side of the room with a small sign that reads "Women."  To the other side of the room is a set of shell-carved wooden shelves with a sign that reads "Men."

title: [Imaera's Poem, Basingstroke]
[Imaera's Poem, Basingstoke]
description: Thick vines and brilliantly colored flowers cover the walls of the small room.  Peacock feathers have been strung from the ceiling alongside tiny carvings of birds in flight.  A low wooden table sits to one side of the room with a small sign that reads "Women."  To the other side of the room is a set of shell-carved wooden shelves with a sign that reads "Men."

title: [The Master Key, Shop]
description: Smooth wooden walls encapsulate the room, their surfaces carved with vines.  Bundles of herbs hang from the ceiling, filling the room with a floral scent.  Along one wall is a set of shelves holding lockpicks.  A series of pendants hang from a small wire rack, and several small cases sit on a carved rosewood bench.

title: [The Jewelry Box, Salesroom]
description: Utterly square, the perimeter of the room has been lined with shelving.  Resting on each shelf is an array of glittering jewels.  A table near the rear of the room holds a silver jewelry tree that displays a variety of wearables.  A crystalline globe in the ceiling emits a fractured light that sends a rainbow of colors across the surfaces.  A soft, woven rug adorns the floor and leads from the front entrance to a doorway in the back.

title: [Forging Ahead]
description: As this small room's sole light source, a stove in the corner emanates heat as its flickering flames cast dancing shadows across drakar-lined walls.  An oval fog-streaked mirror rests in the corner.  Slender ironwood racks with mithril shelving are installed adjacent to a mithril-banded door.

title: [The Not-so-Sorcerial Annex]
[The Not-so-sorcerial Annex]
description: A patch of cut-stone blocks is visible in the center of the room's north wall, where several baldrics and yokes hang from a row of iron hooks, and a set of oak plank shelves are mounted to the blocks of the south wall.  The room is lit by several brass lanterns mounted in the corners among the horns and abstract shapes of the dead corals that still cover the stone.  Fortunately, the floor has been entirely cleared down to the slate floorstones.

A patch of cut stone blocks is visible in the center of the room's north wall, where several baldrics and yokes hang from a row of iron hooks.  A wrought iron rack stands centered in front of a similar patch on the east wall, and a set of oak plank shelves are mounted to the blocks of the south wall, while the room is lit by several brass lanterns mounted in the corners among the horns and abstract shapes of the dead corals that still cover the stone.  Fortunately, the floor has been entirely cleared down to the slate floorstones.

title: [An Evening Affair, Showroom]
description: A finely woven silk rug spans the hardwood floor, and a pair of pillow-laden couches upholstered in plush, cream velvet sit against opposing walls.  In the center of the room, ambient light twinkles off precious jewelry displayed on a large, oval glass-topped case.  Nearly hidden behind a full length mirror in one corner is a black velvet curtain.  Next to the entryway is an iron-reinforced oak trunk.

title: [Flesh and Bones]
description: Made of a plethora of sinew-tied bones, the rickety walls of this hut rattle and shake with every gust of wind from outside.  Reinforcing the structure at random intervals are some tall wooden poles studded with chips of bone, the surface of each one holding various wares for sale.  A mammoth skull looms in one corner, its long curving tusks festooned with various garments, while a line of hooks made from crossed rib bones have been attached to one wall.  A hanging bone curtain blocks off the back section of the hut, the strings of bone beads clattering together with every movement of air.

title: [Clouded Sundries]
description: Fresh azure paint covers the wood-paneled walls, and wispy white clouds are brushed onto the ceiling of this well-lit room.  Metal windchimes hanging near an open window clink together in a song of the breeze.  The shop's wares are neatly showcased on some villswood shelving against the walls and a silver display case in the center of the room.

title: [Oak Table]
description: Constructed from reclaimed wood, the table is bound by a continuous band of sturdy invar to hold the planks of the top together, while the legs are held by brackets of the same material.  Though obviously old and repurposed, the wood has been well-treated, having been sanded smooth and coated in a layer of thick lacquer.

title: [A Dark and Damp Grotto]
description: A middling amount of wan light slides in through the craggy fissure in the rock, affording just enough illumination to see the shadowy profile of juts in the earthen walls.  Underfoot, the ground slants sharply down within the first few steps, the incline deluged with streams of watery indigo sand from outside.  The way is treacherous, but at the base of the slope is a feeble violet glow that originates from points beyond.

title: [A Dark and Damp Grotto]
description: At the base of the slope, a moat-like trench encircles this claustrophobic chamber to collect the rivulets of watery sand that flow ever-downward from the head of the incline.  The stone floor at the center rises above the dregs, and it has been carved with a sigil composed of sinuous, coiling lines and a variety of indistinct symbols.  Concave niches chiseled out of the walls hold glowing violet orbs that shed modest light, but no heat throughout the space, and a narrow ward-carved crevice mars the rear wall.

title: [The Dragon Wagon, Maw]
description: Centered in the room, an oversized rolaren-framed lantern slowly sways above a slightly glossy, dark green floor that, despite the appearance of a tongue-like texture, is actually smooth and sturdy.  A black scaly curtain in the back is flanked on both sides by ironwood tabletops impaled on large, jagged mistwood teeth leading to the front.

title: [Caligos Isle, Outcropping]
description: Perched roughly fifty feet above the water's surface and twenty feet out, this slender outcropping provides access to one of the few sections of the surrounding sea that is not hampered by hazardous rocks.  With no security barriers to prevent a fall, the precarious perch offers no protection from high winds or walking mishaps and is not for the faint of heart.

title: [Once from a Soul, Entry]
description: Water drips in rivulets down the dark shale walls that are illuminated by the fitful burning oil-filled ewers that dangle from support rafters high above.  Echoing ocean sounds rumble down the passage, while a chill breeze tugs cobwebs and clinging dust from their perches in the various crags and cracks of the ceiling.  A broad shale ledge lines the eastern edge, its smooth surface covered with wares.

title: [Once from a Soul, Foci]
description: Perpetual and pervasive, the roaring sound of the ocean striking stone is thunderously loud as it tumbles over the shale walls and heralds an ambient breeze that plucks at the tattered fabric of tapestries draped from high rafters.  Wrought iron cages bind fitful torches in place, the constantly moving flames creating dancing shadows throughout the dank space.  Antiquated chairs surround a trivial firepit burrowed deep into the gravel and sand-covered floor, while a warped and waterlogged cupboard occupies a small space on the eastern wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Once from a Soul, Absent Shade]
description: Wind rushes over cracks in the ceiling, stealing the air from the small cavern with a whooshing force that sets loose fabric fluttering and torches guttering as they struggle to stay lit.  Wrought iron railings encircle a conical crystalline structure that dominates the pitted shale floor, while worn depressions in the floor carry tiny rivulets of salt water towards the back walls.  An ornate rack fashioned of ebonwood and steel is lifted by oak planks off the moist ground to protect it from rotting, as is a decorative black lacquer wardrobe.

title: [Once from a Soul, Vapor Shadow]
description: Billowing heat spills from pillar-shaped fumaroles that rise of out azure and aquamarine pools along the northeastern edge of the cavern, the air growing thick and noxious with moisture and sulfur-laced warmth.  Small barriers of rolled stones, many displaying dried out barnacles along their jagged surfaces, form a barrier to lapping waters.  Spears fitted with torch bowls pierce the gravel to provide illumination for the wares that are on display in a sturdy ironwood rack and several driftwood crates.

title: [Once from a Soul, Chill Spectre]
description: Several stark white chalk drawings decorate the shale walls, which glisten in the flickering torchlight as if covered in ice.  Indeed, a pervading chill further dampens the air while hoarfrost creeps along ivory-hued stalactites that dangle like icicles from the distant ceiling.  A frayed grey rug keeps an iron-bound driftwood rack and a stuffed cotton mannequin relatively protected from the moist floor but does nothing to lessen the sound of dripping water that bounces about the space.

title: [Caligos Isle, Unfettered Pass]
description: Grey and smooth, large standing stones tower over the area, their shadows elongated upon the black sands as the sun moves about the sky.  Tufts of new grass, some high and willowy while others are short and ungregarious, occupy the northern edge, where bone white foundation stones glimmer in the sunlight.  A faded pathway, slowly giving over to new growth, cuts a straight path through the grasses and into the north.

Grey and smooth, large standing stones tower over the area, their shadows elongated upon the black sands as the moon and stars move about the sky.  Tufts of new grass, some high and willowy while others are short and ungregarious, occupy the northern edge, where bone white foundation stones glimmer in the moonlight.  A faded pathway, slowly giving over to new growth, cuts a straight path through the grasses and into the north.

title: [A Head Above Water, Workshop]
description: The area is barely lit by a wrought filigree chandelier, illuminating various sketches and notes pinned up against the walls.  Rugs depicting phases of the moons and constellations are scattered randomly from wall to wall.

title: [Caligos Isle, Verdant Descent]
description: Sunlight slips through the thick foliage where the seeking vines have parted to allow the ocean breeze to taunt denizens as they pass through the steaming heat of dense jungle.  Indigo striations and veining touch upon the broad, speckled leaves of the nightsparkle that lines the twining black sand pathway.  Taunting its brethren, a lyrebird calls out a siren's song that sounds suspiciously like a string of curses issued by a sailor from the pier of Caligos proper.

Moonlight slips through the thick foliage where the seeking vines have parted to allow the ocean breeze to taunt denizens as they pass through the steaming heat of dense jungle.  Indigo striations and veining touch upon the broad, speckled leaves of the nightsparkle that lines the twining black sand pathway.  Chirping and cooing into the night, several nightjars lend their voice to the damp air.

title: [For Your Protection, Wagon Yard]
description: A gold-striped crimson canvas awning, supported by a pair of thin steel poles, stretches from the roof of the wagon, bathing the rocky floor in cool shadow.  Several wooden crates are stacked to one side of a small wooden hatch.  At the edge of the awning stands a tiny portable forge with an iron anvil and a low worktable nearby.

A gold-striped crimson canvas awning, supported by a pair of thin steel poles, stretches from the roof of the wagon, bathing the rocky floor in deep shadow.  Several wooden crates are stacked to one side of a small wooden hatch.  At the edge of the awning stands a tiny portable forge with an iron anvil and a low worktable nearby.

title: [Bloodlet It Go, Office]
[Bloodlet it Go, Office]
description: A polished wooden desk with clawed feet, a high-backed wooden chair sitting behind it, takes up most of the space in this small section of the tent.  A low brown leather couch sits opposite an embroidered tapestry that takes up an entire wall.  The smell of fresh blood permeates the still, humid air.

title: [Caligos Isle, Choked Descent]
description: Tendrils of creeper vines dangle from above, their trailing ends dangling moss amid their heart-shaped leaves.  Shadows and darkness play across the twisting path as it meanders upward and downward around rotted stumps overgrown with liana vines that are painted an odd indigo hue with silver veining.  With rotted roots exposed to the air, an enormous barnacle-covered tree lies upon the ground, a captive of strangler figs.

title: [Caligos Isle, Strangled Base]
description: Tunnels formed of strangler figs provide egress from this section of the slope towards the upper reaches, the plants' intertwining pale brown limbs bright in the darkened jungle.  Pools of stagnant water collect where the ground becomes level, while curtains of moss cling to splintered arboreal giants that are dark with decay and reek of dead fish.  Creepers wend their way over the black sand and through the puddles as they crisscross back and forth before disappearing deeper into the verdant landscape.

title: [Flesh and Bones, Workroom]
description: Cramped and musty, this space is cluttered and disorganized; scraps of leather lie in disarray on the floor amongst various bones.  A yellowed skull lantern with several missing teeth sits on a bone-braced wooden shelf, the flickering light from its eyesockets casting dim illumination across the room.  A rickety bone bench is set up against one wall, the surface surprisingly clear of debris.  The humid air is filled with the periodic rattle of the bone walls as the wind shakes the structure.

A yellowed skull lantern with several missing teeth sits on a shelf, the flickering light from its eyesockets casting dim illumination across the room. title: [Caligos Isle, Village]
description: Cutting a straight, wide line through the untamed grasses, the black sand pathway is lightened by bright white shells to the northwest and north, but darkens as it angles towards the sound of crashing waves.  Dried-out seaweed, splintered driftwood, and sturdy foundation stones lie scattered about the area indicating that habitats once stood here.  A heavy breeze passes through the area, carrying with it the dampness of the ocean.

Cutting a straight, wide line through the untamed grasses, the black sand pathway is lightened by bright white shells to the northwest and north, but darkens as it angles towards the sound of crashing waves.  Raked sand, disrupted on its northwestern edge by invading waves, surrounds a square bungalow built on sturdy foundation stones.  A heavy breeze, carrying with it the dampness of the ocean, passes through the area.

The black sand pathway cuts a straight, wide line through rows of decorated rocks and sea glass.  The road, highlighted by bright white shells, leads to the northwest and north areas of the village.  Makeshift lodgings, hung with lattices of dried seaweed and reinforced by sturdy foundation stones, dot the grassy field, the homes embellished with symbols and effigies carved from driftwood.  A heavy breeze passes through the area, carrying with it the salty brine of the ocean.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Caligos Isle, Village Edge]
description: Vines drape from the high granite wall that disappears into the sky, the stone's dark face and towering height looming ominously over the small village.  Cracked barrels, discarded wagon wheels, and piles of warped boards lie broken upon the ground and display signs of long exposure to water and other elements.  Cracked coral, dried-out seaweed, and tangles of kelp rest in huge piles throughout the area, the strange aquatic flora looking out of place in the jungle-like foliage.

Blooming vines drape from the high granite wall, the stone's towering height providing a modicum of respite for a group of villagers engaged in lively conversation.  Baskets of fresh vegetables sit snuggled between the rows of a garden, the produce receiving a surprise inspection by a pair of curious kittens weaving in between the containers.  A pair of tridents, held together with pieces of sinew-bound driftwood, solemnly stand guard along the village edge, each one strung with bits of tumbled sea glass.

title: [Caligos Isle, Village Center]
description: Roughly cobbled stones form a concentric circle around the crumpled remains of an old well, which issues a wide variety of gurgling and splashing sounds.  Dark sands and crushed shells are scattered upon the ground, which is riddled with tufts of grass, dried seaweed, and partially rotted fish carcasses.  At the edges of the small village center, broken timber and ancient beams lay forgotten in the new growth.

Roughly cobbled stones form a concentric circle around the crumpled remains of an old well, which issues a wide variety of gurgling and splashing sounds.  Dark sands and crushed shells are scattered upon the ground, which is riddled with tufts of grass and dried seaweed.  At the edge of the small village center, a modest abode is surrounded by newly cultivated gardens.

Flat stones, painted in a variety of oceanic hues, form a concentric circle around an old well, which issues a wide variety of gurgling and splashing sounds.  Tall tufts of willowy grass lay sporadically along the well-worn ground, the cover providing camouflage for a small group of children playing games and giggling loud enough to reverberate across the stone foundations.  At the edges of the village center, small tables and booths are occupied by merchants selling produce and wares.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Caligos Isle, Water's Edge]
description: Resembling gargantuan swords, craggy volcanic glass spikes rise out of the water in the distance, their sharp edges slicing the water and destroying the threatening waves before they reach the black sand shore.  Tangles of seaweed form a high-tide ring several feet back from the lapping water, while a driftwood and dried-up anemone ring is set several feet further back.  Smooth stones laid out in a squarish shape hint that once in the lone beach's past there may have been a house or two in residence.

Resembling gargantuan swords, craggy volcanic glass spikes rise out of the water in the distance, their sharp edges slicing the ocean and destroying the threatening waves before they reach the black sand shore.  Tangles of seaweed form a high tide ring several feet back from the lapping water, while a driftwood and dried-up anemone ring is set several feet further back.  Smooth stones laid out in a squarish shape flank a simple cottage and hint that once, there may have been more homes in residence here.

Gargantuan sword-like spikes of volcanic glass rise out of the water in the distance, their sharp edges slicing the water and destroying the threatening waves before they reach the black sand shore.  Garlands of sun-dried anemones lay draped across effigies of driftwood, each offering paired with a basket of baked goods, dried fish, and other bounties of the land and sea.  Wood and stone frameworks are scattered closer to the mainland, hinting at the beginnings of several small residences.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Caligos Isle, Quiet Fissure]
description: Naturally formed, a ragged scar provides egress from the small alcove and stretches from the rough granite floor to the distant, dripping ceiling.  Tangles of vines, rubbery kelp, and barnacles reflect the ambient light that spills in from the outside world, while tiny scratching sounds hint at tiny denizens amid the craggy rocks.  A splintered bit of driftwood is imbedded into the wall, its rough body too distant to reach.

title: [Caligos Isle, Village]
description: Cracked foundations are all that remain of single-room homes that once stood upon this sandy shore.  Splintered, warped, and shattered floorboards fill the rough square shapes, though the wooden lengths are waterlogged and riddled with barnacles.  To the northwest, large poles hint that a pier may once have stood there, but the timbers that allowed passage and access long ago rotted away.

A scattering of single-room homes have been erected along the sandy shore, their planks painted in a myriad of colorful tones and adorned with shells and bits of driftwood.  Large wooden poles, wrapped in a lattice of sun-bleached cotton ribbons, provide a foundation for a half-built pier, the remaining materials neatly stacked safely away from the day-to-day hustle of the residents.  The aroma of fish and vegetables emanates from one of the open windows, combining with the brininess of the oceanic air.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Caligos Isle, Dank Tidepools]
description: Black sands stretch across the cave floor, the soft grains incredibly fine and iridescent, while high above, the rough ceiling is covered in purple algae that is speckled with white.  Pacing between an iron-bound warped oak chest and a jagged-edged dark crevasse, a barefoot pale human child watches the ocean water that aggressively laps at the shore.  Dangling between torches set into the roughened wall, a knotted hemp rope provides access to the cavern above.

title: [Caligos Isle, Balloon-n-Darts]
description: Bright torches, housed in wrought iron cages, decorate the rough walls of the cavern, their flickering light illuminating a rough painted oak sign that hangs above a large colorful gaming board.  A rough clapboard counter bars guests from getting too close to the playing space and also holds a row of darts, which are watched over by a lanky human boy.  Surrounded by broken balloon bits and empty candy wrappers, a deep sand-filled crag occasionally gurgles or whistles as the mists roll through the space.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eel Beds]
description: Low ceilinged and cramped, the cavern has uneven floors and walls that are striated with purple algae and off-white calcite.  Iron-caged lanterns dangle from the ceiling to illuminate a strange tubular contraption, which resides over a banded oak-slatted bucket.  Pacing between an iron-bound warped oak chest and a dark glaes aquarium, a plump-faced gnome child watches over the area with a look that is a mixture of curiosity and amusement.  A knotted hemp rope provides an exit from the cavern and entry to the floor above.

title: [Caligos Isle, Whacky Eels]
description: Dangling above a craggy entry, a rough painted oak sign swings in the ambient breeze and is illuminated by caged torches anchored to the roughened walls.  Water splashes out of nine holes drilled into the uneven ground at the center of the chamber, the salty eruptions missing the nearby table, chest, and wooden stick.  Wandering to and fro, a small gap-toothed kid picks up broken bits of wood, debris, and other refuse from the area and drops them in a deep sand-filled crag near the back of the cavern.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fish Pits]
description: Illuminated by torches that are set at even intervals, this section of cavern has an uneven floor that is pockmarked with rust-hued calcite deposits.  Perched upon a crate, a scrawny half-krolvin lad dangles one foot over the edge of a white stone-encircled pit that is filled with ocean water.  Behind him, an iron-bound warped oak chest sits with a large padlock on it, while just to his right is a knotted hemp rope that leads out of the cavern.

title: [Caligos Isle, Water Cannons]
description: Wedged between a small copper-sided chest and a water-filled oak barrel, a rough painted oak sign provides information for the game that can played in the torch-lit cavern.  Various water cannons, some broken and others displaying signs of recent repair, are scattered about the uneven floor, though a few in working condition rest against a deep sand-filled crag and appear ready for use.  Splitting her attention between cannon and patrons, a mop-haired freckled girl collects coins and tinkers with jovial abandon.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fishing Jetty]
description: Sharp gusts whip salty spray over massive squares of arm-width granite, their surfaces roughly carved with palm-sized spirals, creating a stable walkway that snakes out into the obsidian ocean shrouded by viscous mist.  Sharp volcanic glass spires rise up to pierce the surface of the churning waters, as waves lap at the sheer drop-offs and black sandy beaches on either side of the walkway.  Flotsam gathers along the coasts that extend perpendicular to the jetty, into the grey mists that clutch at the island.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fishing Jetty]
description: On the jetty, between the shore and open sea, the surrounding mists swirl and thicken to obscure massive granite blocks, slippery with sea spray and tilting at awkward angles, winding out into the choppy waters.  Occasional waves burst up from the sides of the walkway, the wicked winds casting white foam across the weathered stones.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fishing Jetty]
description: Howling winds scatter sea spray in all directions from waves that crash violently into this ruined jetty.  Massive granite blocks that form the walkway here have been wrenched into dangerous angles, making the footing treacherous -- one wrong move meaning broken bones or a plunge into churning waters.  Waves deposit detritus of driftwood branches, bundles of seaweed, and ground shale in the narrow crevices between the upturned granite blocks before draining back into the turbulent ocean.

title: [The Favored Few, Showroom]
description: Four massive white columns stand at the corners of this raised pavilion.  Draped around and between them are large swathes of white silk.  Bright lights are carefully placed so as to be diffused by the silk, blunting their effect while still providing plenty of light.  A free-standing armor rack stretches across one wall of the pavilion, and a low marble table dominates the center of the space.  A scrollworked plaque is prominently mounted on one of the colums.

Four massive white columns stand at the corners of this raised pavilion.  Draped around and between them are large swathes of white silk.  Bright lights are carefully placed so as to be diffused by the silk, blunting their effect while still providing plenty of light.  A free-standing armor rack stretches across one wall of the pavilion, and a low marble table dominates the center of the space.  A scrollworked plaque is prominently mounted on one of the columns.  You also see some black marble steps leading back to the main grounds.

title: [Idol Worship, Workroom]
description: Small wooden benches are scattered about the secluded, yet spacious workroom.  Contrasting hues of a patchedworked rug add warmth to the area while creating a mosaic of color on the floor.  Bright crimson, gold, and indigo silk adorns the support beams before draping to the floor in elegant pools.

title: [The Jewelry Box, Workroom]
description: About half the size of the front room, this space is obviously a workroom.  A long oak table against the back wall is strewn with a variety of half-finished projects.  A dim globe of luminescence on the ceiling illuminates the space, shedding light on the rough wooden walls and bare boards of the floor.  A doorway leads out, while a white-washed sign is the only other furniture in the room.

title: [Let's Be Blunt, Backroom]
description: Supported by large wooden beams, this underground room was apparently built as a meditation room of sorts for the more worldly of people.  The walls and floor are barren save for a nearly empty bottle of whiskey in the corner.

title: [Look Sharp, Games]
description: The walls of this unassuming room are dotted with numerous tiny holes from errant dart throws.  Ripped and punctured black leather chairs line the walls, victims to the same fate as the pockmarked walls.  A black and red dart board stands opposite the door, bracketed on either side by pierced iron braziers.

title: [Noteworthiness]
description: Colorful, overlapping rugs conceal the uneven, rocky ground underneath.  Scattered around the area are half-finished instruments leaning against posts and spread out on work surfaces.  The smell of curing wood lingers in the air, mingling with the salty smell of the sea.

title: [Petti Little Workroom]
description: Though this room is typical in many ways for the private workspace of a tailor or seamstress, it is relatively dark, and the omnipresent mist of Caligos Isle seems to collect and writhe around itself very slowly in one corner.  In an opposite corner, a long table is covered with a disorganized collection of pins and strips of fabric.  Beside the table stands an antique dressmaker's dummy wearing only an unfinished scarf.  A single, large candle with a leaping flame dominates the center of the room.

title: [The Pleco, Control]
description: Dimly glowing orbs line the ceiling of this compact space that smells faintly of brine and polish.  Brass tubes run the length of the walls, parting at angles around a brass porthole window, then reconnecting on the other side, some ending at tanks bolted to the wall, others disappearing into the bulkhead.  Secured to the wall amongst the maze of tubing is a brass-framed portrait.  At the center of the space, a squared wooden chair swivels between a knob-covered wood control panel and a brass and walnut music box.  Descending from the ceiling is a shiny bronze tube ending with a glass eyepiece.

title: [A Dark and Damp Grotto, Den]
description: A raised rocky platform against the far wall is layered with ragged furs, blankets, and threadbare pillows, while a fraying rug covers the stone floor off to the side.  The walls are utterly bare save a pair of niches, one on each side of the crevice, that house small, hovering orbs of violet.

title: [A Wristed Development, Workshop]
description: Above a messy wooden workbench, salty fog enters through the back window until heat from a lantern's bright flame makes it cling as droplets to the half-circle wall of reclaimed maoral.  Though the stone floor inside the knotty pine half-door looks recently swept, you feel the grit of sand beneath your feet.

The half-circle wall of reclaimed maoral glistens with condensation from salty mist finding its way in through the back window, below it a messy wooden workbench.  A hastily swept stone floor is still gritty under your feet, as sand has inevitably found its way inside the knotty pine half-door.

title: [Adventure Where, Smuggler's Pit]
description: This room has been crudely dug out of the dirt below the hut, with crooked planks stretching overhead. The ground ramps upward at an awkward angle, allowing easy access to an overhead trapdoor which appears to be the only way in or out of the cramped space.

title: [An Evening Affair, Fitting Room]
description: Walls draped in maroon watered silk wrap around the small, yet cozy, room.  A black velvet settee runs the length of one wall, and an oval gold-framed mirror is mounted between a pair of glass-encased sconces.  Suspended from a brass rod on one wall is a black velvet curtain.

title: [Anguillid Treasure, Quarters]
description: Despite the half-rotted condition of the rest of the ship, the captain's quarters have been remarkably well kept.  Polished cherrywood paneling lines the walls, and a decadent mahogany desk is prominently featured in the center of the room.  Heavy, uncomfortable-looking, hand-carved chairs have been positioned in front of the desk.  An iron-banded mithril trunk is positioned against the back wall, and the wooden door leads back to deck.

title: [B. Witching, Sitting Room]
description: A large credenza occupies the back wall of this cozy room, its surface laden with a variety of herbs, florals, and oils all trapped within stoppered apothecary bottles.  A blackened skull on a violet lace doily sits amongst the glass, as does a black onyx mortar and pestle.  Perpendicular to the credenza is an arsenic grey velvet-cushioned couch with a high back and sculpted arms.

title: [Beck and Call, Behind the Tent]
description: A small recess in the rock face behind the sailcloth tent provides shelter from the gusting wind.  Offering a bit of respite, a few wooden chairs are arranged around a fire pit dug into the hard sand.

title: [Forging Ahead, Workshop]
description: Stacks of heavy metal slabs are scattered around the dust-filled workshop.  A long iron workbench piled with pieces of unfinished weapons spans the wall across from the mithril-banded door.  Hastily strewn across the floor are some cushions, disrupting the thick layer of soot that otherwise uniformly covers the ground.

Stacks of heavy metal slabs are scattered around the dust-filled workshop.  A long iron workbench piled with pieces of unfinished weapons spans the wall across from the a mithril-banded door.  Hastily strewn across the floor are some cushions, disrupting the thick layer of soot that otherwise uniformly covers the ground.

title: [Clouded Sundries, Workroom]
description: The airy workroom has a large yellow sun painted across the back wall.  Several soft white puma fur rugs are strewn across the floor, and some cozy cloud-shaped cushions are stacked in the corner.  Hanging from the high ceiling is a yellow curtain, its hemmed fabric suspended just above the ground.

title: [Dead Ringer, Workroom]
description: Pale greys and soft whites adorn the workshop in decorative counterpoint to the showroom.  The paneled walls and floors are made of whitewashed ash glossed to a high shine, reflecting the light from evenly spaced brass sconces.  A small worktable with neatly arranged tools has been covered with a clean linen cloth.

title: [The Dragon Wagon, Belly]
description: Walls of charred and decomposed animal bones stuck in dark plaster extend from the black scaly curtain, with sconces in each corner illuminating the dark, oddly damp wooden floor.

title: [Familiar Things, Summoning Room]
description: Nearly every surface in this nook of the cottage is marked with a jumble of runes, while candles are placed in elaborate holders at each corner.  Near a white cotton curtain, a small walnut sideboard offers a variety of items.

title: [Farain's Shack]
description: Ivory silk sheets are connected from the ceiling to the floor throughout the chambers.  An alternating colored, glass-paned window is suspended directly over the center splaying colored light in all directions.  In place of a floor is a collection of oddly shaped pillows, each of a different fabric and color.

title: [Firio's Workroom]
description: A patinated copper oil lamp dangles precariously from this small workroom's ceiling, casting its polished wooden walls in a warm, welcoming glow.

title: [First Comes Love, Office]
description: This room has been turned into an obvious office space with stiff, cream-colored canvas walls, and a large oak desk that dominates the far corner.  The triangular space is brightly lit and smells faintly of cheap cologne.  Two of the three walls have been used to showcase a collection of items; one features a large collage, and the other an ostentatious display of accreditation.  Stools have been strewn about in a disorganized manner.

title: [River's Rest, Dilapidated Pier]
description: This section of the pier is much closer to the water than that above, so close in fact that one might dip their feet in the river by sitting at the platform's edge.  Beneath the boards, the sound of water sloshing against the pilings can be heard, and silvery water striders can be seen skipping along the river's surface in the midst of the cattails and reeds.

title: [Maristin's Bait and Tackle]
description: Behind the counter that stretches from wall to wall in this modest shack is a bay window that offers a glimpse of the pier beyond.  Displays of fish hooks are mounted above the window, while ornamental fishing poles are arranged to frame either side.  On the opposite wall is a rhimar-lined bait box with a heavy lid set side-by-side with a tiered table stocked with a variety of lures and lines, while nearby is a fishing pole stand.

title: [Grifty Shades of Fae, Showroom]
description: Worn rocks and exposed roots form a domelike opening beneath a fallen banyan.  A twisted mass of roots covers part of the back area of the enclosure, while a hanging woven reed basket suspended from vines sways lightly from the ceiling.  A large strip of bark hangs from a gnarled protrusion of wood above a low hawthorn rack along one wall.  Near the exit, a cluster of thorny spines appears to be wedged between two rocks to provide a place for wares to hang.

title: [Good Mourning, Workroom]
description: Upon first glance, this workshop hardly looks like an appropriate place to do clothing alterations.  Coffins in various states of repair are draped across saw horses, and a thick layer of sawdust covers the floor.  On top of the coffins, however, are clothing patterns and fabrics tacked onto the wood for easier cutting and stitching.  Coffin lids have been fashioned into some makeshift benches.  A dark doorway leads back to the showroom floor.

title: [Quiver and Release, Raffles]
description: This cramped space is lit by a pair of oil lamps dangling from the rafters overhead, and the walls are lined with the parts and pieces of bows in various stages of completion.  On a toggled contraption mounted on the back wall, lengths of sinew and leather are stretched between wooden vise clips, and a rack beneath holds a collection of chisels, gouges, and mallets suited for wood carving.

title: [The End of The Rainbow]
description: The walls are painted black and textured to appear like cast iron, while the floor is comprised of fused gold-colored coin-like objects.  In the center of the room stands a white cloud-shaped table whereas a painted black and white door leads back towards the front of the wagon.

title: [Three's a Crowd, Workroom]
description: Stuffy and warm, this room is surrounded by canvas walls.  Gold thread weaves through the green fabric in a haphazard pattern, giving the walls a marbled look.  Low benches and woven rugs are scattered throughout the space.  A large wooden sign near the back of the room stands beside a single wooden chair.  Flickering in each corner, a lit torch adds the scent of smoke to the stale air.  A rectangular break in one curtain wall leads out of the room.

title: [Merchant Lounge, Alcove]
description: Canvas sheets are strung across the ceiling of the small alcove, the bright indigo and silver fabric providing a protective screen against the elements.  Small pockets in the walls house candles that illuminate the area at all times of the day and night.  Several chairs are arranged in loose circles throughout the space.

title: [Merchant Lounge, Alcove]
description: Canvas sheets are strung across the ceiling of the small alcove, the bright indigo and silver fabric providing a protective screen against the elements.  Small pockets in the walls house candles that illuminate the area at all times of the day and night.  Several chairs are arranged in loose circles throughout the space.

title: [Merchant Lounge, Alcove]
description: Canvas sheets are strung across the ceiling of the small alcove, the bright indigo and silver fabric providing a protective screen against the elements.  Small pockets in the walls house candles that illuminate the area at all times of the day and night.  Several chairs are arranged in loose circles throughout the space.

title: [Twilight Cavern, Approach]
description: Built into the southeast side of a hill, a massive earthworks structure looks out over the expanse of darkness.  A rounded scarlet maoral door lit by a small copper lamp in the center of the facade provides entrance to the building.  Cascades of icicles are illuminated by a small copper sconce above a mahogany cedar door set into the face of a hill nearby.  Past a pearlescent granite full moon, a well-cleared path curves up and around the hill.

Built into the western face of an icy hill, a glaes-faced earthworks structure with a rounded scarlet maoral door looks over the expansive plains.  A cascade of icicles forms a canopy above a mahogany cedar door set into the face of the hill near a gnarly mesille tree.  Curving back to the knoll above, an icy path serves as a questionable egress.  A pearlescent granite full moon is set upon the ground at a respectful distance from the glaes-faced cavern.

title: [Twilight Cavern, Ice Chapel]
description: Colonnades carved of the cavern's icy stone are complemented by a floor-to-ceiling wall of vibrantly colored glaes windows on the southern exposure.  At the apse, a massive, twisted spire of radiant ice juts from the floor and disappears through the chapel's rocky roof.  Standing just before the icy spectacle is an alabaster crescent moon altar.  The squared transept on the east wall is filled with tiny niches, each heavy with offerings.

title: [Twilight Cavern, Great Room]
description: A large, white-washed stucco hall is composed of a series of interconnected spaces separated by frosted crystal globes set upon ogee arches of exposed rough-hewn maoral, save for one with a colorful haon dart board.  The southern area contains a reading room, to the west is a curved maoral buffet near a kitchen, and to the east, a wall of artwork.  The center of the room features semi-circular wooden benches around a massive copper vent hood hanging above a stone fire pit.  A small door is set into the northeastern recess.

title: [Twilight Cavern, Lockers]
description: A pair of sconces decorate the richly stained cedar plank walls, affording a modicum of visual warmth to the otherwise chilly room.  A full-length mirror with a carved frame stands opposite an oversized oxblood leather tuffet, while the far wall is occupied by a long counter.
