title: [Wizard's Guild, Entrance]
description: Four towers rise about this cavernous central chamber.  White marble veined in deep cinnabar, brilliant viridian, soft cobalt, and somber grey makes up their walls.  Far above, the roof is a simple diamond shape set diagonal to the towers.  Flanking the entry door, ornate vases hold a variety of jungle flowers, their scents adding a lush perfume to the grand space.  A nondescript office, on the far side of the chamber, is the only other break in the chamber's walls.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Caligos Isle, Cliff Trail]
description: The already treacherous walkway becomes moreso as rising steam collects on the outcropping in a low-lying mist.  At points, any hope of viewing solid footing is lost beneath the grey, leaving only a miasma of haze that slithers over the edge and into the air.  The effect is bewildering, breaths of wind stirring spectral fingers in the air as if at any moment they could reach out and snatch away the ground underfoot.

title: [Enshrouded Temple]
description: The old abandoned temple appears to have been deserted for quite some time.  Several wrotwood trees have grown into the structure, shattering windows and destorying walls.  Dust-laden pews are the only remnants that resemble a place of worship, no other holy trinkets are recognizable in the debris.  Through several broken floorboards is a passageway leading down, surrounding by swamp water.  From outside, a powerful rift wavers around the structure.

title: [Necropolis, Apse]
description: Poorly lit lamps offer very little illumination at the entrance of the necropolis.  A recent cave-in has destroyed a stone bridge leading deeper within the undercroft, completely blocking off access.  A ruined black ora altar is tipped over by the passageway leading up to the temple.  The only hope of further progress is a stone ledge overlooking a chasm cloaked in darkness, which a splotchy goblin miner guards.

title: [Whimsical Wares, Backroom]
description: Vibrant silks drape across the room, the ends tightly knotted to a bronze-wrought chandelier hanging above the area.  Soft chainsil blankets and pillows line the fringes of the floor, stacked high against the walls of the room.

title: [Underground, Passageway]
description: No debris litters the hard-packed ground of this roughly hewn passage, though boot prints and scuffs betray the presence of former travelers.  At intervals along the arching walls, small oil lamps are set in iron fittings, and they cast a wan light through sooty glass shades in a feeble effort to brighten the path.

title: [Underground, Passageway]
description: From a distance, a weak cyan glow filters into the passage, joining the oil lamps in the sparse illumination of the walkway.  The contrast of dim gold against the blue creates curious shadows on the uneven walls, the grooves and cuts in the rock seeming to move under the inconsistent touch of light from the competing sources.  Moisture clings to the passage walls, in some places little more than dewy drops, though some spots darken the stone with more ominous shapes.

title: [Underground, Aperture]
description: The ceiling slants subtly toward the tunnel's end as its width narrows, and the passage terminates with barely enough room for two bodies to stand shoulder to shoulder.  Outlined in a wan cyan glow emanating from beyond, an uneven aperture cleaves into the stone abutting the walkway, its jagged edges blackened as if by soot or flame.  The sound of water drifts in through the opening.

title: [Underground, Cistern]
description: The dimensions of this chamber are breathtaking, such that it could only have been naturally wrought, and it echoes with the sound of water lapping against stone.  Evidenced by the scent of the sea, the cistern is fed from an underground channel, and its waters break in shallow waves chased by the cyan glow emitted by the crystals dappled across the arching ceiling and convex walls.  The effect is otherwordly and seems in sharp contrast to the mundanity of the furnishings haphazardly arranged throughout.

title: [Jahadeem's General Store]
description: A ruby-eyed grinning skull hangs on one of the varnished ebonwood walls, and an ebonwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  An open-mawed greater vruul statue sits in one corner of a speckled black marble floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and a glass-topped mistwood counter on the other.

title: [Jahadeem's Outfitting]
description: A ruby-eyed grinning skull hangs on one of the varnished ebonwood walls, and an ebonwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  An open-mawed greater vruul statue sits in one corner of a speckled black marble floor.  There is a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet on one side of the shop and a glass-topped mistwood counter on the other.

title: [Twilight Cavern, Sauna]
description: The warmth and humidity of the sauna is instantly discernable in sharp contrast to the weather outside.  Circling the room, slatted wooden benches provide ample respite in the luxurious heat that the room provides.  A copper basin of stones rests above a stone fire pit, dug shallowly into the ground in the center of the room.  A rope-handled wooden pail rests near the fire pit, with the handle of a ladle hooked on its lip.

title: [Laelithonel's Armory]
[Trinkets 'N Things]
description: Blue-speckled sea glass walls rise from a smooth slate floor.  Just above some puffed raw silk pillows hangs a carved whale tooth, and a glass-tiled vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A glass-topped mistwood counter and an aqua-hued seaglass display stand side by side in the middle of the room.

A colorful Icemule map hangs on one of the pale oak walls, and an oak-framed ceiling rises overhead.  A polar bear rug sits in one corner of a varnished oak floor.  There is a long varnished counter on one side of the shop and a dovetailed oak table on the other.

title: [Laelithonel's Outfitting]
description: A blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the thick slate walls, and a low skylight-set ceiling rises overhead.  A fragrant pink jasmine plant sits in one corner of a swirled sea glass floor.  There is a wide knotted oak counter on one side of the shop and a carved haon armoire on the other.

title: [Laelithonel's Outfitting]
[The Chubby Narwhal]
description: Enclosed by thick slate walls, the shop features some potted luminescent toadstools in the center of its sea glass floor.  A fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs under the skylight-set ceiling.  Right near the front is a large white wicker counter and some hammered copper display hooks.

Pale oak walls rise from a swirled sea glass floor.  Just above some potted luminescent toadstools hangs a fused sun and moon wall-hanging, and a low skylight-set ceiling completes the picture.  A narrow glass-topped table stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Annex, Silvergate Inn Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A silver velvet pennant edged with green hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [Peregrine Tavern, Great Hall]
description: Lustrous ebonwood beams frame the tavern.  Some of the walls are painted dove grey while others are dark crimson, lending an enclosed and intimate aura to the room.  A zebrawood dart board lies between ebon bourde tapestries.  The heady scent of malt mingles with a rustic fragrance of oak burning within the river stone fireplace.  Scattered throughout the tavern, a handful of ironwood trestle tables are surrounded by padded barrel chairs.  A glowing alabaster bar situated at the back beckons patrons to approach.
location: Peregrine Tavern, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Peregrine Tavern, Isolated Nook]
description: Tucked into a corner away from the tumultuous happenings within the tavern, the isolated nook affords a modicum of privacy and quiet.  A stained lor stump table is set squarely in the middle of the alcove, and the walls are composed of smooth hewn oak planks.  A matching oak bench with bronze rivets and leather padding offers a place to relax, while a compact beechwood shelf is nestled off to the side of the wall.  The air here is hazy with smoke, but a decadent aroma of peat and fig inundates the area.
location: Peregrine Tavern, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Peregrine Tavern, Cellar]
description: A myriad of crates and barrels containing hard liquors, ales, and beers line two of the walls, securely propped atop oak shelves reinforced with mithglin.  Some of the barrels are caked in dust and look to have not been touched for years, presumably to allow the contents inside to age appropriately.  The air is laden with an unmistakable scent of fermenting grain and fruit.
location: Peregrine Tavern, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Peregrine Tavern, Exiled Armory]
description: The armory is brightly lit with cast iron braziers placed in each corner.  A wide variety of weapons and armor kept in good working condition are hung across each wall with the sole exception of one.  A barren lor wall stands out and has a single ko'nag door.  Flanked to the right side of the door is an encased illthorn armor stand, whilst the left side holds a matching illthorn weapon rack.  The middle of the spacious armory is open, leaving room to spar or exercise on the polished ironwood floor.
location: Peregrine Tavern, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Peregrine Tavern, Falcon Nest]
description: Raspberry-hued walls extend corner to corner, the paint's vibrancy enhanced to produce a slight sheen.  The central focal point is a plush and ornate four poster bed with a crimson down comforter and silky golden pillows.  There is a maoral nightstand along the right side of the bed, while a large matching trunk rests at the foot.  Across the far wall, a river stone fireplace offers the rich scent of peat and cedar, further enhancing the comfortingly tranquil feeling of the bedroom.
location: Peregrine Tavern, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Peregrine Tavern, Research Lab]
description: The walls of the cramped lab are scorched and damaged beyond any ability to discern the original material or craftsmanship.  Crossed out glyph symbols and scrawlings of ruined pentagrams indicate obvious signs of past research projects gone awry.  A variety of curious instruments and tools are scattered across the marred oak table placed on one side of the room.  Along the opposite wall rests a blackened bookshelf, an intact lor cabinet, and sturdy looking steel hooks.
location: Peregrine Tavern, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Caligos Isle, Desolate Islet]
description: The landscape of the islet is entirely void of any vegetation and life.  The rocky surface is covered in old bones and small white shells.  A crumbling stone mausoleum is all that stands on the center of the island.  Waves wash up over the shoreline, slowly swallowing the remaining terrain of the islet.

title: [Caligos Isle, Lorn Mausoleum]
description: Torches with unnatural blue flames line the crumbling walls of the mausoleum, lending the plundered vaults a cold and lonesome air.  Nothing of value remains, and even the wooden floorboards have given up resistence, having shattered long ago under the weight of a vault lid to expose a tunnel leading further into the tomb.

title: [Warehouse, Receiving]
description: Positioned opposite an arched and curtained entry, a set of rickety stairs disappears into the ceiling above and is illuminated by the dusty glass lanterns that are anchored to the nearby rough maple wall.  Several pegs follow the slanting line of the stairs and house a variety of items over a long wooden bench that is cluttered with bric-a-brac.  An errant breeze, damp and heavy with the scent of decay, consistently tugs at the fabrics on display.

title: [Counting House, Hall]
description: Moonlight lends the dusty hallway a silver cast as it seeps through the greasy window that occupies a small space where the wall and roof meet.  Bookcases dominate the narrow causeway and are topped with oil lamps that flicker and sputter in the chilling draft that trickles down from some unseen fissure in the rafters.  A single staircase along the western wall provides access to the lower levels.

title: [Bundle Up, Entry]
[Bundle Up]
description: Cozy rather than small, this space is spotlessly clean and tidy.  Alternating strips of wood and copper set in a framework of brass make up the walls, each one regimentally precise in their placement.  A brass-framed wooden door, its surface sanded smooth, leads into a back room.

title: [Bundle Up, Backroom]
description: A slightly metallic scent mixes with the stagnant air of this boxy back room.  The walls, each one made of interlocking copper and wood, are bare and nondescript.  The only real decoration in the space is a glass-topped display case with a framework of mithril, which is set against a back wall.

title: [Just For Kicks]
description: In front of a long wooden counter, faded and threadbare rugs are scattered over a hard-packed dirt floor.  Various cobbling tools hang from nails and spikes driven into oaken walls, while an assortment of broken shoe forms are piled high in one corner beside an open battered trunk.  A broken crate sits at the foot of a narrow staircase leading to a small loft.

title: [Just For Kicks, Storage]
[Just For Kicks]
description: Crowded with broken furniture and discarded shoeboxes, a small space has been cleared around a dye-splattered tub.  A long-tailed sewer rat is perched on the edge of the tub, the rodent's feet stained an odd shade of blue.  Near a small window, a wire basket hangs from a low ceiling riddled with holes.

title: [Sigil Shop]
description: The solid walls of this room are barely visible through a fog that circulates about, yet brief glimpses reveal various sigils covering the walls, varied in color, shape, and vibrancy.  The haze is in constant in motion, forming tendrils which weave in and out of your presence.  An ironwood table and a glowbark display case are neatly centered in the middle of the room, causing any fog near them to dissipate.

The solid walls of this room are barely visible through a fog that circulates about, yet brief glimpses reveal various sigils covering the walls, varied in color, shape, and vibrancy.  The haze is in constant motion, forming tendrils which weave in and out of your presence.  An ironwood table and a glowbark display case are neatly centered in the middle of the room, causing any fog near them to dissipate.

title: [Hand-N-Hand, Parlor]
description: Heavy scuff marks mar the flooring in the few spots that remain visible through the blanketing layers of sand and dirt.  An iron-banded shipping trunk sits just inside the doorway, nearly blocking egress to the rest of the space.  Across the room, a short circular table draped in mildewed canvas holds merchandise on display beneath a grimy window.

title: [Hand-N-Hand, Storage]
description: Dark panelling covers the walls in this small and dimly lit space.  Two grimy, rectangular windows are nestled in the middle of the outside wall, neither clean enough to let in any appreciable light.  A walnut chest with broken hinges lies beneath one of the windows, while a shipping crate, its lid removed, lies beneath the other.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Entry]
description: Flickering candlelight creates more shadow than illumination in the cramped cobblestone room, which is deprived of windows and floored with packed dirt.  Thick wrought iron pegs line the eastern wall, each laden with a different mask, while wicker baskets are arranged upon the floor opposite an oak and copper door.  A coal-filled blackened brazier emits a warm, inviting orange light, though it does little to heat anything further than a handspan from its home on the eastern side of the room.

title: [Gallery, Reception]
description: The gallery is engirdled in sheer walls of carved glacial ice, and bright light emanates from behind them.  Ripples of power pass over the ice, keeping it frozen solid but maintaining a moderate room temperature.  A quartet of aquamarine marble colonnades close to the entrance serves as nothing more than decoration.  Though traffic through the wide arches dividing the wings is unimpeded, a towering crystal ice elemental statue and a void black glaes vaespilon sculpture guard the east and west wings, while a display of ancient halfling armor set on an oak stand is poised eternally on watch at the south.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, out

title: [Igerone Furryback's Wing]
description: In this eastern wing of the gallery, the sounds of visitors from the reception area to the west are somewhat muffled.  Lights from behind the sheer ice enclosures illuminate the contents of a whitewashed pine case with a worn brass plaque attached to it opposite a polished modwir sculpture in the shape of an inverted triangle, with a marble giantwoman effigy in the center of the room and several padded benches providing ample seating.

title: [Gallery, Reception]
description: The gallery is engirdled in sheer walls of carved glacial ice, and bright light emanates from behind them.  Ripples of power pass over the ice, keeping it frozen solid but maintaining a moderate room temperature.  A quartet of aquamarine marble colonnades close to the entrance serves as nothing more than decoration.  Though traffic through the wide arches dividing the wings is unimpeded, a towering crystal ice elemental statue and a void black glaes vaespilon sculpture guard the east and west wings, while a display of ancient halfling armor set on an oak stand is poised eternally on watch at the south.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, out

title: [Wing of Peace Accords]
description: Crimson curtains with pure white trim cover portions of the ice walls in this wing dedicated to the end of the Ice Giant War, simultaneously symbolizing both the snow and the peace that came after the conflict.  A prodigious onyx wolf's head placed high on the rear wall guards a low steel limb-cleaver just below it, with a gleaming bronze statue of two embattled figures standing off-center just a few feet away so as not to impede the view of this display of sacrifice, this stain on Icemulian history.

title: [Eilinora Willoby's Wing]
description: In this section of the gallery, multiple white globes of essence dance overhead, their light reflected by the walls of solid ice.  Waves of essence pulse periodically throughout the room, keeping the walls in their frigid state.  The soft voices of other guests echo as mere whispers from the west.  A mounted circle of ornaments hangs above a handwoven tapestry, while on the opposite wall, an immense oil portrayal of two women figures in a carved mistwood frame is displayed.  A series of larger-than-life portraits on snow white easels is featured in the center of the gallery.

title: [Clovertooth, Second Floor Hall]
description: Your attention here is immediately drawn to an ostentatious gallery entrance with a sizeable platinum plaque placed high above it, its surface reflecting brightly in the ambient torchlight.  Guests mill their way into, out of, and around the cultural attraction, and their voices are muted by countless alternating, multicolored velvet and silk drapes tied back with shimmering golden cords that frame the ingress.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Rotunda]
description: At this nexus of the eastern hall and the rotunda, the most prominent feature is a large blue-black rug with the symbol of Clovertooth Hall in the center.  Pages pass by at regular intervals, ensuring the rug stays in pristine condition despite heavy foot traffic.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Rotunda]
description: A glimpse over the railing reveals only a handful of citizens and visitors wandering about the hall at this hour.  A sleepy toddler, clearly ready for bedtime, waddles beside an older male human who looks perplexed as he speaks to a young halfling page.  On this level, the stark white wall here is interspersed equidistantly with thick cedar logs that support the structural integrity of the building and dome overhead.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Rotunda]
description: Quasi-circular in design, the rotunda-style walkway of this portion of Clovertooth Hall mimics the round shape of the frosted red and ice blue-hued glass dome far above you.  A candle and crystal chandelier adorned with pearlescent saber-tooth tiger incisors on a long, golden chain fills the area with the amplified glow of refracted candlelight.  Set back a few feet from the top of the stair, a tiny halfling child statue leaning casually against a decorative railing serves as a bit of conceptual installation art.  Younger visitors passing by stop to strike a pose beside it before their parents shoo them on.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Rotunda]
description: Clovertooth pages saunter by routinely, acknowledging guests with a casual greeting as they check to ensure the half-globe-enclosed torches are burning and have plenty of fuel.  To the north, the hallways appear to converge on a nexus, while to the southeast, a spiraling staircase descending to the first floor is visible.  From this view, the details of the dark marble statue in the center of the lobby below cannot quite be made out.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Rotunda]
description: Western, northeastern, and southern corridors conjoin here at the edge of the quasi-circular second floor rotunda, the walls reinforcing the dome above with strategically constructed wide cedar logs.  A recently cleaned, sprawling blue-black rug bears the symbol of Clovertooth Hall.  In the light emanating from torches on the walls, a small sign on a shiny metal stand directs visitors wishing to conduct business with the mayor's office and bureaucratic wing to the west.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Observatory]
description: Unnaturally dark, this northernmost part of the rotunda has a strange, empty essence, as if the flows of mana and magic are inhibited and do not reach here.  At eye level, the dome here has been divided into four large panes of clear glass separated by thin steel squares, distinctly setting them apart from the otherwise frosted material of the structure.  An array of telescopes stands near the dome, each pointed at a different pane.

title: [Clovertooth, Second Floor Hall]
description: In this portion of the corridor, the half-sphere-enclosed torches burn with multihued flames, casting bright and colorful shades that dance furiously with shadows upon the otherwise plain white walls.  The cedar floor beneath you creaks with each passing footstep.

title: [Office of the Aedile]
description: Disorganizedly colorful may be the only way to describe this celebrated mess of a room.  Banners and cloths of every color imaginable are strewn about, some hung from the ceiling, and others gathered around stacks of props in the corners ready to set up an event at a moment's notice.  Beneath a round window you notice a miniature display of figurines marching in a parade.  On a small, cluttered desk, a festival permit application rests beside a bright blue party hat.  A handwritten parchment has been tacked to the wall that reads, "Be back later.  I'm CREATING!"

title: [Clovertooth, Second Floor Hall]
description: Large grainy cedar double doors occupy the entire eastern wall of this room with a large silver plaque placed just above them.  A glance through the propped open doors yields a view of a spacious, modern auditorium, and voices from all along the westerly corridor echoing throughout the torchlit hallway seem to become diminished here.  Occasionally, someone passes through a small rounded door off to the side.

title: [Nihala's Auditorium, Backstage]
description: Nervous energy lingers in the small space, belied by cluttered vanity mirrors and disheveled costume racks shoved off to the edges of the room.  A stone chimney stretches proudly up the back wall through the darkened timbers of the ceiling, though the slightly smoky quality in the air suggests a less-than-perfect draw, even for the timid fire presently burning.  An elaborate painting of a halfling with caked-on makeup in a tutu has pride of place over the mantel.

title: [Nihala's Auditorium]
description: Massive logs of gnarled cedar perfume the air from the perimeter of the hall.  Living evergreen boughs contrast vividly against the geode-like, expansive, indigo-hued crystal ceiling as hundreds of tiny glowing spheres peek out from between the facets, their light refracted onto a few dozen rows of comfortably padded seats and rugs covering parts of the polished floor.  A central aisle delineated by two rows of braziers leads from some large grainy cedar double doors to a carefully constructed heap of jagged grey boulders cradling an expansive cedar and pine stage with a tall thick velvet curtain at its rear.

title: [Clovertooth, Second Floor Hall]
description: A masterfully painted floor-to-ceiling mural on the southern wall of this corridor is lit by a quintet of sphere-encased white motes of light maintained by some unseen source of power.  Pedestrians make their way around numerous white and gold edelweiss potted in a tall clay vessel, some stopping to enjoy their aroma.  The scuffed floor beneath your feet suggests increased traffic to and from the administrative offices of government.

title: [Formal Dining Room]
description: Subdued light provides the room with a warm glow as beeswax candles flicker in balenite sconces that line the honey oak walls.  A large umcor tapestry occupies one wall, while the others are adorned with smaller arras of varying cultural origins.  A long mahogany dining table lined with silk-cushioned high-back chairs dominates the room.  The scent of freshly baked bread wafts through a pair of white oak doors as they swing open for waitstaff delivering trays to a cherrywood sideboard.  A neat rubbish canister is tucked away in one corner.

title: [Clovertooth, Second Floor Hall]
description: Here, on the southern wall, evenly spaced half-globe-encased torches bathe the space in flickering golden light.  Directly opposite stands a very long cedar counter tucked into a recessed curving wall lit by numerous torches on either side.  The services offered at this counter seem to be in demand, as individuals periodically queue up to speak with the clerk behind it.

title: [Clovertooth, Second Floor Hall]
description: The corridor bends narrowly at this juncture, as the offices of two town functionaries reside beyond the northwest and northeast walls.  Some tall cedar double doors with limestone accents have as decor a pair of crossed short swords above them, and to either side a cracked glowbark crook, some sturdy spiked leather gloves, a sephwir composite bow, and a deep blue mithglin tower shield.  Bright ice blue motes enclosed in crystal on the wall between the offices provide more than enough light for this space.

title: [Praetor's Office, Town Defenses]
description: Wider than it is deep, this office of the magistrate for defense is painted in alternating navy blue and black patterns with white trim.  The walls are bare save rows of perfectly aligned bookshelves containing volumes on Icemulian law, battle strategies, and war crimes.  A case displaying medals and insignia is hung above a scale model of Icemule Trace and surrounding wilds, while the symbol of Clovertooth Hall has been worked into the pattern of the floor in front of a huge polished cedar desk trimmed in rhimar with a world map and a pair of snowglobes on it.

title: [Clovertooth, Second Floor Hall]
description: In this relatively quiet space, the hallway bends sharply to the northeast and northwest.  Opposite the passages, a steel-reinforced door and a stark white arch each lead into the offices of town officials.  Between the two entries, an antique silver coffer rests open on a marble stand, its interior lined with cerulean satin.  A single mint silver coin is held in place by some spell or mystical force, hovering just above the coffer's center.  Three bright ice blue motes trapped in crystal placed on the walls illuminate the area.

title: [Bureaucratic Wing, Entrance]
description: The sound of trickling water provides a bit of background noise echoing throughout the entrance to this wing, though its source is unseen.  In the exact center of the spacious, roughly triangular room is a towering tangle of iceblossoms, the native Icemulian flowers' aroma sporadically wafting about.  Across from a stout cedar and oaken door leading to a large conference room is a hazy oval watercolor painting.  A sleepy halfling guard watches over the area despite a prima facie lack of alertness.

title: [Mayor's Office, Reception]
description: Brightly lit by globe-encased candles on a caribou antler chandelier, this room is enclosed in lacquered pine walls that portray a series of artfully rendered sketches.  Crystal shards native to the Icemule underground reflect and refract the ambient light from above.  An overstuffed couch faces a blackened rock fireplace, while priceless artifacts gleam from within a prominent glass display case above the mantle.  An imposing angular oak desk in one corner, a curt aelotoi administrator seated behind it, conspicuously displays a roughly hewn pine statuette and holds papers, quills, and inkwells for penning notes to the mayor.

title: [Clovertooth, Conference Room]
description: The floor of the expansive chamber is crafted of dark, mahogany planks.  The center is dominated by a circular oaken table, burnished to an almost mirror-like sheen.  Some wide snowcat pelt armchairs surround the table, their plush seats covered in matching fabric.  Carved sideboards flank a small stone hearth under an embossed cedar carving depicting the mule statue found in Town Center with a tiny ancient halfling asleep at its base.  A colorful abstract oil painting in an electrum frame has been hung on the wall opposite the head of the table.

title: [Fizelgrauf Binnder's Alcove]
description: Several bouquets of winter roses in matching cerulean vases serve as the centerpiece for this quiet alcove named in honor of a retired Icemulian politician.  A trio of uncomfortable-looking wooden chairs sits before an aged and faded bookcase, while a portrait labeled "Fizelgrauf the Fine" is nailed off-center to one wall.  The lighting is low here, provided by a solitary torch, and the sounds from the bustling hall are a bit softer, providing a respite for discussion or rest.

title: [Clovertooth, Kitchen]
description: A pair of swinging white oak doors separates the kitchen and dining room, sealing off some of the noise from the bustling staff at work.  A large fel cupboard occupies one corner, its doors ajar, revealing shelves stacked with fresh fruit and prepared desserts.  The white marble counter is laden with cutting boards and a variety of knives and utensils.  A red-faced halfling chef threatens his assistants with a rolling pin as they scurry about the kitchen preparing dishes for the guests in the dining room.

title: [Inking Den, Annex Hallway]
description: Frosted globes nestled within decorative wall sconces provide a steady glow of welcoming light down the long corridor.  The walls are hidden behind bright ivory white silk drapery, the soft ends of which pool upon the thick cerulean and azure carpet.  Built into opposing walls, a lacquered white door and a lacquered beige door part the drapery and have a trio of brightly glowing globes directly above their pointed, cinquefoil frames.

title: [Diplomacy and Foreign Affairs]
description: Draped with rich blue tapestries and adorned with lavish gifts from officials, diplomats, and royals from across Elanthia, this office serves as the bustling hub for international issues and peacekeeping efforts.  An expansive cedar bookcase stands behind a sprawling polished desk, and a plush blue velvet wing chair for guests has been placed near a small scale model of the Icemulian temple.  A wide exit framed in soft silver curtains drawn back with deep blue cords leads out to the corridor.

title: [Icemule Bureau of Trade]
description: This tiny office looks to be under construction.  Crates, coffers, and sealed strongboxes have been left in organized stacks with parchments attached to them.  Various officials parade in and out making deliveries and removing existing goods.  A black-bordered list on one wall draws your attention, while the rest of the office is largely empty.

title: [Clovertooth, Comptroller]
description: This modest space is filled with an endless array of filing cabinets and has been sparsely decorated with a few odds and ends.  The walls are painted a light shade of violet, and a fir-framed vellum calendar hangs in the center of the western one.  Closer to the eastern wall, an antique wooden abacus occupies one corner of a neatly stacked plain desk, a comfortable-looking guest chair with dark violet cushioning placed just in front of it.

title: [Clovertooth, Wine Cellar]
description: Enclosed by stone walls, a cavernous room with arched ceilings opens at the foot of some extremely narrow spiral stairs leading up into the kitchen.  The cool, still air holds a faintly musty, earthen scent.  Wooden wine barrels sit in stacks, and built into the walls are latticed racks holding countless bottles of wine.  Iron chandeliers cast a twinkling glow over the bottles, setting their rich jewel tones alight, though the cellar is not without its shadowy corners.  Each footfall reverberates throughout the room, disturbing a light coat of dust.

title: [Shear Delight, Lobby]
description: Plank driftwood flooring extends out in a wide expanse, broken only by several standing aquaria filled with blue water and several saltwater fish in varying hues, from vivid orange to deep violet.  Several exits reside in the white wood-paneled walls, an ovular black metal doorway to the east, a curved brown arch to the north, a pale tan-striped curtain to the west, and a pale driftwood hallway leading back to the salon.   An oversized window allows in the natural light from outside, illuminating the room with golden sunshine.

title: [Shear Delight, Eye Accents]
description: Mellow yellow walls encapsulate this small room, and a lit fireplace in the corner casts a golden glow on the surroundings.  Soft dark gold carpeting muffles the room, further enhancing the cozy atmosphere.  In the center of the room, a sign on a black metal stand sits beside several chairs painted the same yellow as the walls, while two young erithian attendants mill nearby.  Set in the western wall an ovular black metal doorway leads back to the lobby, and a black-framed ovular mirror hangs adjacent.

title: [Shear Delight, Eye Coloration]
description: Hanging amber glass lanterns illuminate the room with a soft gold glow, while chestnut carpeting softens footsteps and eliminates any harsh reflection from the overhead lighting.   The soft, calming hues are mimicked in the warm golden walls and the muted tapestries that decorate them.  Centrally located, a sign on a marble pedestal and a full-length mirror on a tripod stand in a circle of golden light, while two young elven attendants linger, never straying far from the center of the room.

title: [Shear Delight, Show Some Skin]
description: Pale blue paint mimics the summer sky, and white-curtained windows add a touch of color to the sky-hued walls, along with a single full-length mirror.  Several sapphire blue oil lanterns burn in niches and release a saltwater scent into the air.  Near the windows and illuminated by sunlight, a sign rests on a white metal stand, while several attendants dressed in seafoam hues mill about the room.  A pale tan-striped curtain occasionally stirs in breezes let in through the windows.

title: [Shear Delight, Saving Face]
description: Walls papered with a twining ivy pattern meet a polished hardwood floor that is uninterrupted save for a sign that rests on a carved wooden pedestal and a leaf-shaped mirror on a carved oak stand occupying space in the center of the room.  Orbs of green glass hang from the white ceiling in a haphazard pattern, casting a green light on surfaces both above and below, creating a canopy of verdant light high above.  Several attendants wander around the room, chatting with each other and patrons alike.

title: [Shear Delight, Scents Of Self]
description: Sticks of incense rest in several carved wooden holders on a low counter that traverses the muted beige walls that surround this room.  The heady scents of sandalwood, lavender, and orange mingle in the air, offering a calming atmosphere to the area.  Several sofas against opposite walls offering a place to relax, and potted ferns add a touch of color.  A sign and a rectangular mirror stand upright on one of the counters, while several attendants loiter about.

title: [Shear Delight, Distinguished]
description: The lower half of the walls is paneled in dark ebonwood, while the upper half is painted a matte slate grey.  Candelabra attached to the walls cast flickering firelight on the room, and a mirror hangs between two of them.  Several sculptures in dark hues grace the pale grey marble floor and a tall ebonwood and metal device, along with a sign resting on a black marble pedestal, join them.  Several black-garbed attendants stand at attention, their hands clasped behind their backs.

title: [Shear Delight, With Style]
description: Wood-paneled walls in alternating mahogany and blonde coloration flank this portion of a long hallway.  Several brown leather sofas rest against the walls, offering a place to rest or wait.  In the middle of the room, a sign on an easel stands beside a row of metal chairs, while both attendants and barbers hover at the ready.  Set into the southern wall is a frameless full-length mirror and a curved brown arch, through the latter of which glimpses of the lobby can be seen.

title: [Shear Delight, Silky And Smooth]
description: The alternating wood-paneled walls give way to solid mahogany here, encapsulating the room in a dark cocoon.  Sconces line the walls of this portion of the long hallway, bathing the room in flickering candlelight, and a dark full-length mirror hangs between two of them, helping to amplify the light.  In the center of the space, a sign rests on an easel beside a pair of leather chairs, while both attendants and barbers linger nearby.

title: [Shear Delight, Do Or Dye]
description: The dark walls give way to white panels along this section of the hallway.  Vivid splashes of color festoon the walls as if someone stood in the middle of the room and tossed paint in all directions.  Hanging from the ceiling is a crystal chandelier which casts rainbows across nearby surfaces, creating even more chaotic color in this small space.  Beneath the chandelier is a sign and a rectangular mirror on a double-sided easel which is flanked by staff members, and odd stains mar the floor beneath their feet.

title: [Shear Delight, Quirks]
description: Dark walls surround this space at the end of a long hallway and a patterned area rug in muted browns and golds covers the floor.  On the far wall, a wide window faces the ocean, allowing sunlight to stream in through glass.  A stained glass turtle hangs in the window, catching the sun and casting green-colored squares of light over nearby surfaces.  A sign on a dark green pedestal, an ovular mirror on a metal stand, and a few chairs sit near the window, while several staff members wander between them.

title: [Mayor Tawariell's Office]
description: A breath of iceblossom and white tea mingles with the permeating cedar walls of the rounded room.  Sunlight washes over the room through a large bay window fixed with snowflake-stitched curtains pulled back on either side to frame the deeply inset cushion-strewn bench beneath.  A burnished antique desk and an ivory-stitched suede chair have been positioned so the warmth of a stone fireplace radiates toward them from behind.  Atop the frosted glass mantel is a striking portrait nestled in an arrangement of moonflowers.

title: [Mayor's Office, Meeting Room]
description: A stately stained glass standing oil lamp sets a warm, welcoming glow in this simple cedar-framed room which holds a long pale oak table at its center.  Some chocolate-hued velvet wingback chairs are placed evenly around the table's length, resting on a polished hardwood floor.  Creating the entire panel of the back wall is an extremely large pane of frosted glass that has been carefully etched with an elaborate mural.

title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
description: A small cross-hatched window looks out to the wilds beyond the gate, and a few torn, bloodied bandages hang along a series of nails hammered into its lower edge -- simple tokens testifying to the bravery of the local guard.  A long, winding staircase edges the round walls of the barbican tower, the shallow steps defended by an iron-barred gate.

title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
description: Shafts of faint light pierce the darkness of the tower from windows farther up the stairs, while torches illuminate the gloomy interior.  Soft echoes reverberate in the cramped space, from the faint chittering of rodents to the occasional gust of wind.

title: [South Barbican, East Tower]
description: The brisk winds of the north flow through the numerous windows that line the circular, stone walls.  Tattered bits of leather and cloth sit beneath the narrow slits, the stains on them a telltale sign of the many battles fought from these heights.  A particularly wide window opens up to the east, and a length of thick rope is tied to a grommet at its base.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: An immense barbican stands sentry over the wide South Gate of Icemule Trace, and the eastern tower stands high over this portion of the wall.  A small window provides the only means of entry, but it is far too high to access without some help from above.  To the north, the wall looks over Barter Alley to Tartifact's Bakery and the other shops of Trader's Way.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: Thick forests dominated by pine and spruce obscure the southern approaches to the city.  To the north, the wall looms over Barter Alley, which attracts a very respectable clientele among the halfling citizens of Icemule Trace.  The prevailing winds blow perpendicular to the South Wall, causing a tremendous buildup of frosty muck in the southern corner of the wall.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: The wide stone walls provide very little protection against the winds that blow night and day from the surrounding mountain heights against the city walls.  The stamping of militia guards' feet has compacted the snow beneath your feet, making this stretch of wall particularly perilous.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: This corner of the wall looks over the corner where Barter Alley meets Trade, and a steady stream of patrons visit the shops clustered around the entrance to the southeastern corner tower.  Beyond stands the grassy field of Giantman Path, which is dominated by an ancient oak tree almost as tall as the walls themselves.

title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
description: Small piles of pale white snow collect in the corners of the tower's doorway, the pale grey stone glistening with faint moisture.  A spiral of stairs slowly ascends the height of the barbican, and distant shafts of light pierce the gloom further upwards.  An iron-barred gate guards the base of the winding stairway, the metal bars encased in a thin shell of glistening ice.

title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
description: The stairway continues to spiral around the circular walls of the barbican, the dark grey stone incised with a trailing pattern along the shallow steps.  The sound of howling wind echoes along the tower, its chilly presence sending bits of dust and snowflakes tumbling through the air.

title: [South Barbican, West Tower]
description: The shallow steps of the winding stairway taper off at a round room marked by a group of narrow slitted windows.  Pale starlight shines through the narrow gaps in the stone, shimmering wanly against the bits of ice formed along their edges.  A steel grommet fixed beneath one of the wider windows holds a long length of rope.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: The wide South Wall looks down over the well-traveled confined of Bootlegger's Alley, which skirts between the wall and several of the most-patronized businesses in the city.  Across the alley to the north lie the grounds of House White Haven, while the view to the south is dominated by impenetrable forest.  Immediately to the east is the western barbican tower of the city's South Gate, which offers access only via an impossibly high window.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: Night and day, working-class halflings stream into the Honeybeer Inn, which stands across Bootlegger's Alley from this section of the wall.  Entering gaunt, tired, and hungry, they leave looking well-fed, rested, and restored to good spirits.  It was perhaps a feeling of envy for these patrons that led a lonely guard to carve a bees' hive and beer mug into the icy northern wall.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: The frosty arctic wind rushes through the forest to the south, filling the region with the noisy clash of air on needle and leaf.  An occasional birdcall or animal growl rises above this cacophony.  What was simple mystery now represents the threat of the unknown.

title: [Icemule Defenses, South Wall]
description: The blades of the windmill turn in time with the gusting of the winds above this corner of the wall.  Immediately below the wall, the sometimes unsavory patrons of Bootlegger's Alley make their way quietly among the frost-encrusted cobblestones and other less innocent perils of the narrow thoroughfare.

title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
description: A single steel shield hangs over the entryway, its edges trimmed with stained leather and its surface heavily scarred.  A winding staircase slowly ascends the length of the tower, an iron-barred gate set at the threshold to ensure that those who enter are well-protected.  A few hardy patches of weed have grown in the cracks along the floor, enjoying shelter from the cold outside in this safe haven.

title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
description: The deep blackness of the tower's interior is permeated only by the occasional soft ray of starlight from the outside, or the mellow orange and yellow tones of sparsely-placed torches.  A few rustling tapestries line the walls, their cloth far too faded and torn away to reveal any distinct imagery.  The shallow stairs continue to wrap around the circular walls in a spiraling fashion.

title: [East Barbican, North Tower]
description: A circle of windows looks out onto the surrounding landscape from the top of the tower, each offering as its view only a thin slice of the world as its view because of the arched, slit-like construction.  A few stick-like markings mar the otherwise smooth stone surface beneath the windows -- the arcane figures likely the handiwork of some rather bored guardsman.  A long, thick rope has been tied to a grommet beneath the widest of the windows, permitting access to the eastern wall below.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The wall to the south is dominated by the barbican over the East Gate of the city.  A tall barbican tower stands just south of this position, and a single window high above provides the only point of access from the wall.  The curious odor of medicinal tart-baking wafts from Ma Leaftoe's shop on the other side of Fear Alley.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The stone walls looking down past Hope Alley to Stumbleskink's cleric shop have been patiently carved with a wide variety of symbols invoking the attention of the Arkati and other immortals.  In the mountains to the east, the walls of the abandoned abbey glow in the moonlight.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: Immediately beneath the wall to the west is the narrow pathway known as Hope Alley.  Most of the customers move from shop to shop with their faces lit with good cheer, but some few move to the north with speed, purpose, and wary glances.  To the east, the landscape is split between night-black forests and moonlit snowfields.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The view to the northeast is dominated by the snow-capped mountains in the distance.  To the west, the neighborhood of Temple Burrow battles against the ice that flows from the glacier, across the north wall, and into the streets of Icemule Trace.

The view to the northeast reveals the darkened figures of mountains in the distance, their massive forms outlined in negative relief against the starlit sky.  To the west, the homes of Temple Burrow burn lights to keep the darkness at bay.

title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
description: The tower's interior is protected from both the elements and attack by a massive ironwood door further reinforced with dark steel.  A long, winding stairway spirals up the edge of the circular walls, ascending towards the very top of the barbican.  An iron-barred gate stands before the very first step, its bars glistening with a faint coat of ice.  A few simple glass vases rest at the foot of the gates, each filled to the brim with a collection of dried flower petals.

title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
description: Sawdust is scattered as an aid to traction, as militia guards and other visitors track melting snow and ice across the shallow steps leading from the lower rooms to the upper defenses of the barbican.  Shadows constantly shift in the faint torchlight, retreating with each momentary flare of the flames, then surging forward as the light wanes back into gloomy darkness.

title: [East Barbican, South Tower]
description: A variety of thick wooden planks provides a sturdy footing at the top of the staircase, the walls opening up into a variety of narrow slitted windows.  Various scuffs, nicks and scorches mar the otherwise smooth stone walls, a telltale sign of the many battles fought here.  A larger window harbors a long piece of rope tied to a grommet, the majority of its length arranged in long serpentine coils.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The wall ends in a tall barbican tower to the north, keeping watch over the East Gate of Icemule Trace.  A few adventurers wander through the gate at all times of day and night, some eager to test themselves against the wilds and some bearing the wounds and treasure that mark the relative success of their ventures.  To the west across the narrow Trade Alley stands the city jail.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: At night, this section of wall is dominated more by smells than sights.  From the west comes the smell of broiling meats and baking tarts, while from the east wafts the acrid smell of pine needles and decay.  Immediately below the wall, Trade Alley teems less-than-savory customers.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: A strident voice calling patrons to the rat races in the Bazaar rises up to the walls at every hour of the day.  The narrow lane between city wall and warehouses known as Trade Alley sees occasional foot traffic from adventurers and citizens alike.  To the east stands a thick forest that could be hiding any manner of threat to the peace of the city.

title: [Icemule Defenses, East Wall]
description: The view to the west reveals the businesses of Dwarven Circle, while the east is dominated by snow-covered pine trees.  To the south stands one of the sturdy corner towers, its fluttering flags proclaiming Icemule's defiance of weather and foes alike.

title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
description: A few scattered alum pebbles lie in a heap in the corner, their unusual roundness and shine hinting at their use to pass the guards' slow nights away.  Shallow steps whose surfaces are marred by many muddy bootprints ascend toward the top of the tower, the entrance guarded by an iron-barred gate.

title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
description: The small steps continue their winding pathway both up to the very top of the tower and all the way to the very bottom, the fairly nondescript walls punctuated by a crackling torch here and there.  A few shattered bolts and torn fletchings litter the otherwise smooth steps.

title: [West Barbican, North Tower]
description: A few simple tokens hang above each narrow slitted window, each marred by some faint scar, dent, or tear.  Dark planks harboring black stains in the wood make up the floor, their short railings ensuring that none will take a rather nasty plunge to the floor far below.  A length of knotted rope is gathered beneath a grommet set into the wall beneath one of the wider windows to allow access to the west wall.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: Off in the distance lie the high Ice Plains behind their sturdy rolaren gate.  In the opposite direction stands the impressive structure of Silverwood Manor.  The wall itself is empty except for the ubiquitous snow and ice, which seems determined to claim the structure as its own.

Both sides of the wall are similarly cloaked in darkness.  On the city side, the nearest visible lights come from Silverwood Manor on Cursed Street, almost in the center of town.  The winds howl down the near empty walls, filling the night with a mournful chill.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: To the east, Magical Burrow lies under a dense blanket of fog.  The narrow confines of Incantation Alley immediately beneath the wall are visible, as is the upper story of an abandoned manor house on Wraith Road.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: The western wall looks out over wide open fields of snow and ice.  The pale moonlight bathes the fields in silver, highlighting the walls and trenches which appear as flat black in the darkened landscape.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: The wall ends at the northwest corner of town, where a sturdy tower projects an image of strength and security to the citizens of Icemule Trace.  The view of Magical Burrow is completely obscured by a thick fog that fills the walls like soup lapping at the rim of a bowl.

title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
description: A simple wicker wreath hangs above the entryway, the thin twigs making up its body tied tightly with bits of twine and leather.  A pale white staircase slowly ascends in a spiraling fashion toward the top of the tower, the stone chipped and marred by stains in some places.  An iron-barred gate stands before the steps, ensuring a secure point to check those who would venture further.

title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
description: Bits of straw and other debris provide a slightly sturdy footing upon the shallow, smooth steps.  Wavering amber torchlight plays along the walls in lurid waves of crimson and orange, illuminating the rather nondescript passageway that leads further up towards the top of the tower.

title: [West Barbican, South Tower]
description: The stairs come to an end in this upper room, where a rough construction of planks and reinforced wood forms a small platform giving access to slitted windows in the walls.  A stunted little barrel stands between the gaps of the numerous slitted windows that encircle the area.  One wider window looks down upon the western wall of Icemule Trace, and a knotted rope is tied to a grommet securely fastened to its stony ledge.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: The wall comes to an end at the tall barbican tower rising over the West Gate of the city.  A window provides the only access to the tower, and that only from the most difficult height.  To the west can be seen the Warrior's Guild compound and the Nightowl Pub, while immediately beneath the wall a variety of unsavory types make their way down the narrow thoroughfare known as Brewer's Alley.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: To the east, Pilsner Avenue parallels the wall on the opposite side of Brewer's Alley.  A portion of the old city wall runs along this avenue, and the citizens use it as a memorial to lost loves.  In the distance lies the healer's cottage on Malt Road.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: Immediately beneath the wall to the east runs the narrow confines of Brewer's Alley, and a number of carters and brewer's apprentices run its cobbles night and day.  A few citizens and adventurers wander out of its shops at all hours as well, seeking bargains or the odd rare artifact.  In the distance, Barley Lane runs east toward an abandoned well.

title: [Icemule Defenses, West Wall]
description: The windmill towers over the city walls at the southwestern corner of town, and the gentle creaking of the mechanism competes with the whistling of the wind through the great western forest to fill the air with a constant din.  Off to the east stand the arms and armory shops, from which a great smoke and noise rises night and day.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: The glacial floe above this section of wall has been painstakingly carved over time into a sculpture of notable beauty.  Successive thaws and freezing has covered and recovered the bas-relief carving, giving the piece a multi-dimensional quality.  From the depths comes a horde of trolls, charging over a wide open field toward a small village.  An armed band of halflings stands in martial array ready to protect kith and kin from the invaders.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: The view to the east is blocked by the sturdy height of the corner tower, which is distinguished only by a window high above the wall.  Atop the tower, flags fly to signify the militia's occupation of the structure.  To the south, the streets of Temple Burrow twist and turn around the great temple, which stands like a beacon of hope and fear to the faithful of every denomination.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: Deep channels have been carved into the ice wall to the north, as meltoff ran down from the top of the glacier only to freeze on contact with the city walls.  If there is stone beneath your feet, thick blue ice hides it completely.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: This section of wall looks out over the Sorcerer Guild compound, and your night vision is threatened by the fiery smoke rising from a chimney-topped tower in its center.  To the north is nothing but icy darkness.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: Wide enough for halfling militiamen to stand five or six deep, these walls are so thickly encrusted with ice that only the most dexterous can keep their footing.  Along the northern battlement, some wag has carved a poem to help pass a lonely watch.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: At their northwest corner, the city walls are thick with ice.  A high tower rises to the west, its pennant flags declaring the city's proud defiance of its enemies, including the incessant frigid winds.  To the south is the rundown quadrant known as Magical Burrow, while the view to the north is completely dominated by the glacier.

title: [Teclys's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the tattered canvas walls, and a vaulted ceiling rises overhead.  An open-mawed greater vruul statue sits in one corner of an enameled hardwood floor.  There is a vine-carved mahogany table on one side of the shop and a bamboo rack on the other.

title: [Teclys's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a pair of crossed bones hangs on one of the tattered canvas walls.  An etched brass bin and a wicker basket sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Teclys's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a ruby-eyed grinning skull hangs on one of the tattered canvas walls.  A wicker basket and an engraved copper bin sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on an unfinished wooden floor.

title: [Black Rose Sanitarium, Study]
description: At one time a doctor's office, the room is in a state of chaotic disarray save for an obsessively organized oak desk centered in the room.  The desk is flanked on opposite walls by a lopsided corkboard and wide bay windows so caked in filth that moonlight barely penetrates them.  A tall slanted bookshelf spans another wall, its staggered shelves displaying various oddities.  The floor is covered in deliberately carved markings, concentrated near an oddly upholstered couch.  Hanging overhead is a swirling black void spanning the ceiling.

The desk is flanked on opposite walls by a lopsided corkboard and wide bay windows so caked in filth that sunlight barely penetrates them. location: Black Rose Sanitarium, outside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Black Rose Sanitarium, Parlour]
description: A dramatic room of dark burgundy bourde with golden accents, the parlour conveys a measure of classical Faendryl elegance contrasting with its idiosyncratic accents.  Centered across from the circular hallway is a sharply chiseled obsidian fireplace, its hearth formed of shallow steps leading to a distorted rift within.  Plush, heavy drapes nearly conceal the old iron bars across the moonlit arched windows of the room, while just above the fireplace hangs an odd oil painting.  Matching claw-footed bourde armchairs and a glass table are centered in the room.
