location: Black Rose Sanitarium, outside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Black Rose Sanitarium, Terrace]
description: A coastal breeze meanders over the rooftop, carrying with it the sounds and scents of the nearby sea.  Nothing but darkness can be seen at any angle, and the incessant crashing of waves against the rocky shore reverberates through the night.  Climbing ivy creeps over the lantern-lit granite balustrade encircling the open space, the leafy vines continuing up the columns of an extensive stone trellis overhead.  Beneath the trellis is a massive carved lor table with a variety of chairs gathered around it.  Smoked glass doors lead into a domed interior area.

A coastal breeze meanders over the rooftop, carrying with it the sounds and scents of the nearby sea.  Stunning views of the coastline can be seen at all angles, with seabirds floating above the sunlit rocky shore where foamy white waves crash incessantly.  Climbing ivy creeps over the dark granite balustrade encircling the open space, the leafy vines continuing up the columns of an extensive stone trellis overhead.  Beneath the trellis is a massive carved lor table with a variety of chairs gathered around it.  Smoked glass doors lead into a domed interior area.
location: Black Rose Sanitarium, outside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Black Rose Sanitarium, Solitude]
description: The most striking feature of the rooftop bedchamber is the bronze-framed glass ceiling, providing a marvelous view of the night sky.  The circular room's padded velvet walls are punctuated by curved bay windows paneled in smoked glass, offering a clear view out while simultaneously affording privacy from prying eyes.  A gossamer silk canopy bed is centered in the room with a lor-inset alabaster nightstand beside it.  Against the wall, an oversized clawfoot tub tempts relaxation, and an antique silver vanity set is nearby, supplying a perch for the day's preparation.

The most striking feature of the rooftop bedchamber is the bronze-framed glass ceiling, providing a marvelous view of the day sky.  The circular room's padded velvet walls are punctuated by curved bay windows paneled in smoked glass, offering a clear view out while simultaneously affording privacy from prying eyes.  A gossamer silk canopy bed is centered in the room with a lor-inset alabaster nightstand beside it.  Against the wall, an oversized clawfoot tub tempts relaxation, and an antique silver vanity set is nearby, supplying a perch for the day's preparation.
location: Black Rose Sanitarium, outside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Faire, Frozen Glade]
description: A jagged glacier looms over an open grassy knoll kissed with glistening frost and bordered by a dense coniferous forest capped in a thick layer of pure white snow.  The fresh scent of pine wafts on a chilled breeze as the surrounding trees sway, their snowy canopy bending to reveal a star-spangled sky.  Several makeshift log benches have been placed around a circular firepit, a crate of wood set into the snowy ground just beside it.

title: [Faire of the North, Footpath]
description: Off the western side of the trail lies an open shack primarily made of roughly hewn pine.  The hastily constructed shelter is covered with a patched tent, providing a makeshift roof for this bustling work area.  Groups of halflings move hurriedly in and out, carrying wood and supplies to the faire's various merchants.  A few carts await calls for supplies, while a youngster slides into the shack on one foot, narrowly missing an overladen worker rushing out the door.  Shouting and muttered curses ensue.

title: [Faire of the North, Footpath]
description: This bend in the path harbors hand-carved grey stone benches draped with shimmering ice.  Long, tapered icicles have formed at the bottom of each one in a near-perfect fringed pattern.  Evergreen firs dusted with sparkling mounds of fresh, powdery snow provide a shadowy shelter over the benches, while a pair of torches grants a bit of ambient light to the spot.

title: [Faire of the North, Footpath]
description: A massive mountain of tightly packed snow blocks the view of the town and surroundings from this vantage point.  The path continues in a wide, winding curve, with sparkling motes of blue light helping to guide the way.

title: [Faire of the North, Rime Wall]
description: The packed snow of the footpath ends here at a tall stone wall covered in hoarfrost.  Just in front of the wall, patches of icy, indigenous flowers are bordered by crisp-leafed teaberry and bearberry bushes.  Ice-glazed moonflowers in a rainbow of colors are clustered in round mounds of ice-frosted earth.  The occasional falling snowflake perches on a flower here and there, long enough to give a brief twinkle before fading away.

title: [Faire of the North, Footpath]
description: Small children slide gleefully along the packed down snow and ice-covered path, laughing as they collide and fall face first into the snowy eastern and western banks.  Their guardians follow closely, simultaneously scolding them softly and chortling at the childrens' silliness.  From time to time, an errant snowball goes flying overhead and smashes solidly into a coniferous tree, causing its branches to shudder.

title: [Faire of the North, Footpath]
description: Beside a mighty fallen log lies a rock-laden rivulet solidified into glassy ice that has expanded across the footpath, making it extremely slick.  Nearby, leafy verdant bushes clump together and bend under the weight of thick snow.  Each is colorfully dotted with clusters of lush berries that thrive in winter.

title: [Faire of the North, Icy Garden]
description: The pathway bends here in a smooth curve.  The foot traffic must be heavier as visitors pause to admire a small garden of flora native to Icemule.  An angular pattern of artic moss-covered rocks separates the northwest section of the path, where a snow-covered dirt garden boasts colorful calmintha interspersed with clusters of winter roses, bright ice tulips, moonflowers of varying hues, and the occasional sassafras leaf.

title: [Faire of the North, Ice Floe]
description: The footpath ends abruptly at the shore of a shallow lake, an immense, jagged ice floe covering most of its surface and seizing any ambient light in the area.  Several large blocks of ice coated in frozen crystalline specks have been arranged to provide makeshift seating.  Snow dusts the untrodden parts of the footpath with a sparkling, diamond-like sheen.

title: [Truefolk Devotion, True Love]
description: Frosted glass lanterns hanging from the ceiling glow with a soft pink light, reflecting off an assortment of pure and holy symbols and adornments strung from the walls.  Garlands of flowers in various stages of bloom adorn a small side table here and there, while a square cedar table bordered by miniature hearts takes up most of the center of the area.  The scent of early spring wafts about the room, coming from an unseen source.

title: [Forbidden Love]
description: Silken braided cords bearing the weight of tapestries depicting teasingly amorous scenes are dispersed among built-in wall hooks that display pious sigils and garments.  A solitary yellow-edged red banner hangs overhead, and a lone altar in the center of the room is decorated with yellow and red candlesticks wreathed in rings of golden smoke that drift lazily outward from several gold censers.

title: [Lost Love]
description: Wide swathes of plain black silk drape the walls from a central heliotrope ring suspended from the ceiling.  Crystal oil lamps give off a subdued light, illuminating notes of prayer tacked to the silk drapes, and casting shadows behind an ebonwood female mannequin and an ebonwood male mannequin.  A violet vase on a diminutive midway altar holds a single black rose.

title: [Elementary Elementals]
description: A cramped cavern opens up with a dirt floor and a slick, icy ceiling.  Patches of dirty, clumped snow that have escaped the drifts above or were knocked down the hole and through the shop's entrance have been trampled upon and muddied even further by the heavy feet of perusing shoppers, but remain frozen thanks to the freezing temperature within this concealed shop.

title: [Elementary Elementals]
description: This section of the cavern narrows to a point, though the walls that meet it are rounded and mostly smooth, perhaps evidence of excavation by hand.  Several stacks of wood occupy one area beside a small bonfire, providing a bit of warmth to ward off the occasional chilly breeze that intrudes upon the space.

title: [Running in Packs]
description: Boot prints in frozen mud lead in and out of the mid-sized shed.  The smell of freshly fallen snow rides on the crisp, cold air that occasionally blows through, stirring up the scent of oiled leather mixing with fresh linen from the containers for sale herein.  Several giantmen and one halfling huddle around an ancient, rusted stove propped on half-log benches near the back of the structure.  They share the latest town gossip whilst rubbing their hands together and taking swigs from small flasks for warmth

title: [Running in Packs, Workroom]
description: The smell of leather mixed with polishing wax lingers in the air.  Lacquered metalwork hangs from a nearby rack, and several bolts of dusty fabric rest on skewed metal shelves.  A few eager folks linger in the space, picking at the walls and kicking at the muddy snow, all the while muttering to each other about a merchant that should show up any time now.

title: [Winterberry Wonders]
description: Generously stocked corner shelves accommodate all manner of flowers and fragrant local flora, as well as a mass of cooking ingredients.  Underfoot, a meticulously woven rug blankets much of the floor space.  Heady floral and food aromas converge upon the olfactory sense.

title: [Winterberry Wonders]
description: A plump, gnomish woman adjusts the lenses on a gold and silver loupe as she scrutinizes a tiny, shiny ring in her hand.  She grunts and pulls a small metal tool from her belt, makes a few adjustments, and with a nod places it on a short silver jewelry tree before reaching for the next piece.  Elsewhere in the room, a makeshift birchwood mantel rests over a small stone fire pit, while other shelves display an assortment of bouquets and simple weaving materials for purchase.

title: [The Best Defense]
description: Straps of thick, tanned hides hang from a rope situated behind a work counter.  An array of newly oiled leathers, freshly sharpened blades, and carefully polished shields lines the walls.  A stout halfling with particularly hairy bare feet hammers rhythmically at the misshapen slab of metal placed on an anvil beside him.

title: [The Best Defense]
description: Rich panels of wood covering the walls are lit by faintly glowing orbs that dangle from crisscrossing overhead beams.  An elderly man sits on an uprooted, sawed-off fir stump vigilantly polishing a longbow, glancing up only momentarily to acknowledge your presence.  Just beside him rests a cracked mahogany coffer.

title: [The Best Defense, Workroom]
description: Plush, icy blue cushions are grouped together in giant piles through the room, providing a soft place of respite against the polished haon floor.  A tall ladderback rocking chair sits behind a long, cluttered desk at the back of the room, the chair moving of its own accord every so often.  A flimsy set of stairs leads back down to the main shopping area.

title: [Pavilion of Kisses]
description: This small tent is cramped and smells faintly of hard working troll.  Several creatures mill about or sit on crates, apparently waiting for something.  A large troll stands off to one side, occasionally scratching himself.  Coiled in an open cage, a cobra flicks its tongue desultorily, looking from side to side.  A cracked and peeling sign is propped up against the back of the tent partially hiding the recumbent form of a loudly snoring black bear.

title: ['Mule Momentos]
description: A bulbous-nosed Paradis halfling greets patrons through loudly chattering teeth as they drift near his wares and explore the goods for sale.  He glances around before ducking slightly and stealing a sip from a small silver flask before returning it to his coat pocket.  He straightens again and and smiles widely, rubbing his arms in an effort to stay warm.

title: ['Mule Momentos]
description: Freestanding wooden racks and shelves display an array of trinkets and toys, dividing the space into several aisles.  Along the outdoor path, various townsfolk browse the goods for purchase.  Vividly colored bolts of cloth are propped up against every available surface, some carelessly resting an edge in the snow.

title: [Brrr Necessities]
description: A wide hoarbeam table cluttered with richly dyed fabrics, pins, and a measuring tape is placed in the corner beside a tightly woven red and white basket.  A rosy-cheeked halfling woman wearing an iceblossom-adorned apron busies herself around the room, stopping only to shoo a small child with a chocolate-smeared face away from the assorted clothing.  Here and there, garments of various fabrics have been placed on display.

title: [Brrr Necessities]
description: Brightly colored vials and bottles line tiered shelves and counters placed strategically about.  Several lavishly dressed ladies huddle together, dabbing their wrists and offering them to one another for inspection as they giggle and whisper among their group.  The fragrance of night jasmine intertwined with winterberries wafts throughout the space.

title: [Brrr Necessities]
description: Brightly lit oil lamps reflect off an ironwood-trimmed full-length mirror situated near one of the tables.  Elsewhere, makeup-dusted display trays flank the tent's cloth walls.  Inkpots and jars are gathered on a central worktable next to flower petals and multicolored, ground herbs where a young assistant apothecary combines the ingredients in a large bowl.

title: [Tarts 'n Nothin' More]
description: The scent of warm berries and buttered crusts fills the room with memories of a warm hearth and a mother's kitchen.  Parents hold tightly to the hands of small children as they peruse the offered delights.  One child sits in the corner happily chowing down on a small tart with blueberry filling as his father observes the selection of foods offered.

title: [Zedarva's Weaponry]
description: The broad sweep of the wooden floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Arathis' Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by paneled mahogany walls, the shop features a small potted lemon tree in the center of its ceramic tile floor.  An ancient River's Rest map hangs under the broad-beamed ceiling.  Right near the front is a clawfooted cherrywood table and a tall oak and ivory cabinet.

title: [Ceriun's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Zedarva's Weaponry]
[Zedarva's General Store]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A badly scarred oak counter and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.
Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Zedarva's Weaponry]
[Zedarva's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Banthal's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a pearl-handled filigreed mandolin hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet sits in one corner while a brass flowerpot rests on the hardwood floor.

title: [Xecnephias' Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a dovetailed oak table on one side of the shop.

title: [Xecnephias' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the smooth white plaster walls.  A lacquered wooden shelf and a low wrought iron table sit in opposite corners while an iron candelabra rests on a varnished oak floor.

title: [Xecnephias' Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the pale ivory plaster walls.  A low wrought iron table and a lacquered wooden shelf sit in opposite corners while a stuffed grizzly bear rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Bard Guild, Foyer]
description: The surroundings walls are patterned with deep crimson mahogany, their surfaces wrought with delicate, swirling patterns that flow with the grain of the wood.  A variety of comfortable chairs are placed near several large bay windows, while a pair of arched doors stand to the north.  Several low-lit hallways branch off to the east and west.

title: [Bard Guild, Great Hall]
description: Panels of deep black ebonwood line the ceiling, their precise positioning contrasted by the intricate, swirled designs racing across their surface in a veritable whirlwind of beauty.  Rows of long arched windows line the walls, the sunlight filtering in casting a bright sheen upon the polished wooden dancing floor.  A long oak bar stands in a corner to the south, its top glistening with reflected light.

title: [Bard Guild, Bar]
description: Well-lit by a variety of amber-paned oil lamps, the bar appears to be quite generously stocked.  A variety of bar stools line the edge of the bar, each richly padded with ornately-trimmed velvet.  Several crystal musical notes dangle along the ceiling, their rainbow sheen warping the wavering light of the cozy room.

title: [Bard Guild, Courtyard]
description: Large well-trimmed green hedges mark the entrance to a maze-like garden, the pale white stones that mark the entrance swept with tiny chips of violet feystone.  A dark spiraled iron gate runs through the large hedges, its intricate twists and loops mirrored by the patterns cut meticulously into the living walls of green.  A few chairs and small tables are scattered across the area, offering a comfortable place for quiet discussion.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: The hallway ends in a small cul-de-sac that features a gold-framed painting, its exterior well-lit by a grouping of tall crimson candles.  A small arched door stands to the north, its well-polished surface chased with curls of lustrous silver.  A circle of large bay windows allows one to gaze out upon the cityscape, each window's cozy nook supplemented with dark velvet pillows.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: Sweeping silk curtains flank the long arched window to the north, casting a dim illumination onto the dark ashwood desk.  Soft plush seats are arranged in a comfortable grouping about the desk, each adorned with a variety of velvet pillows.  Piles of papers and writing implements cover the desk, nearly concealing a small silver flute.

title: [Bard Guild, Gardens]
description: Several varieties of trees grow at the edges of the garden, casting pleasant shadows across the ground with their sagging boughs.  Splashes of color decorate the ground around the white cobblestone path, and the sprawling garden is filled with many different types of flowers that lend their sweet fragrance to the quiet, peaceful surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Bard Guild, Gardens]
description: Fiery swaths of color cut through the vivid hues of the flowers to the sides of the path -- the lurid color of the cluster of flamestalks highlighting the arrangement of the garden.  A small bench crafted from pale ivory is set within a recessed niche amid the green hedge walls, the flickering flame within the wrought-iron lamps flanking it casting a rippling amber glow across its surface.

title: [Bard Guild, Gardens]
description: Twining vines of ivy creep along the cobblestones, their verdant hue interspersed among the lighter greens of the tall hedge walls that surround the area.  Clusters of bright purple flowers line the borders of the walkway, their deep hue contrasted by flowers of bright white, pale crimson, and sky blue.

title: [Bard Guild, Garden Center]
description: A large ivory fountain stands within the center of a large circle of cobblestones, its beautiful architecture sending forth a triad of trickling streams to gurgle in a pleasant, soothing fashion.  The swaying, shadowy boughs of many trees loom above, and half-moon benches form a circle around the fountain.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: A variety of dark crimson candles casts a dim illumination across the hall, and sweeping draperies shroud the many large windows set within a small cul-de-sac.  An arched vaalin-swept door stands along the southern wall, a gold-chased velvet rug leading beyond its threshold.

title: [Bard Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: A low-set round table spreads across the surroundings, its edges bordered by billowing tapestries traced with delicate silvery designs.  A variety of high-backed seats padded with velvet are placed around the table evenly, their surfaces stained a deep crimson.  Twisting feystone-chased candelabras are positioned throughout the room, casting a pleasant, flickering light throughout the large chamber.

title: [Greystorm Manor, Amphitheatre]
description: The enclosure of the leaf-covered arch suddenly gives way to an expansive, sloped clearing surrounded by a lush grove of towering oaks.  Natural stone benches are carved into the landscape and descend towards a low-rise wooden stage.  Moonlight filtering through the canopy of the trees places a natural spotlight onto the stage, and dozens of lanterns hang in the oaks that border the area.  To the right of the stage sits a beautifully carved oak lectern.
location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Lelqui's Armory]
[Lelqui's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a weathered dark birch ceiling, a painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the thick slate walls.  A long mistwood counter and a splintered cargo crate sit in opposite corners while an iron candelabra rests on a solid plank ebonwood floor.

title: [Lelqui's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by thick slate walls, the shop features a woven Vornavian silk rug in the center of its ebonwood floor.  A pair of cast iron sconces hangs under the dark birch ceiling.  Right near the front is a glass-topped mistwood counter and an elegantly carved oak armoire.

title: [Lelqui's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the thick slate walls, and a weathered dark birch ceiling rises overhead.  A pile of unmarked crates sits in one corner of a solid plank ebonwood floor.  There is an ora-bound large walnut trunk on one side of the shop and a dented iron footlocker on the other.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Wine Storage]
description: Huge redwood racks line the stone walls from floor to ceiling, each nearly full to capacity with colorful bottles.  Thin bands of icy blue rhimar are visible here and there on the racks, and a faint swirl of cool mist eddies around the chamber.  Sconces set at intervals along the wine racks support tiny globes of pale, steady light.  A heavy redwood door is set into the south wall, while a short stair on the east side of the room leads down to a similarly robust door.

title: [Cholen's Temple, East Hall]
description: The corridor is wide and slightly curved, terminating at a recessed door of redwood.  Brass lanterns line the walls, spilling golden light in pools across the long crimson rug that traverses the length of the hall.  Several nondescript doors line the east wall of the corridor, opposite a wide arch of ornately carved gold-veined marble.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Costume Hall]
description: Clothing of every size, shape, color and fabric festoons the long, wide room.  Heaps of cloth are piled beside worktables and benches, and garments overflow the trunks and racks used to store them.  Cabinets and chests of drawers line the walls and bright lanterns of myriad shapes and sizes dangle from the ceiling to contribute to the room's brilliant illumination.  A narrow staircase in the west wall is partially obscured by a spill of costumes, but the doorway in the east wall remains clear.

title: [Cholen's Temple, West Hall]
description: The corridor is wide and slightly curved, terminating at a large open arch that allows a glimpse of the circular narthex beyond.  Brass lanterns line the walls, spilling golden light in pools across the long crimson rug that traverses the length of the hall.  Soft voices keep up a constant chatter from beyond a doorway of golden oak in the west wall, opposite a wide arch of ornately carved gold-veined marble.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage]
description: The backstage is cluttered with more extra scenery, backdrops, scrims, stage furniture and miscellaneous props than seems possible.  A smell of dust, sweat, and paint lingers on the air.  Providing access to the stage are two arches.  A series of controls is located on the front wall, providing a means to open and close the indigo-colored velvet curtains.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Narthex]
description: Four slender columns stretch up from the marble floor of the round chamber, supporting a high domed ceiling.  Tall arched windows along the east curve overlook the courtyard below and illuminate the narthex with great bars of sunlight.  A line of tapestries decorates the west and southern curves, ending at a wide arch to the southeast.  Colorful cushions and long divans are scattered about the room, some occupied by solitary musicians and small groups engaged in animated discussion.

title: [Top of the Stair]
description: A wide stairway of pale gold marble fills the hall, disappearing around the sharp curve of the wall as it descends.  Scrolled golden oak banisters on brass posts flank the top of the stair, and a long scarlet rug spills down its center.  Along the curved walls, long floral tapestries alternate with the bright glow of gaily flickering lanterns.

title: [Base of the Stair]
description: A wide stairway of pale gold marble fills the hall, curving sharply along the wall as it ascends.  Scrolled golden oak banisters on brass posts flank the stairway, and a long scarlet rug spills down its center to pool just before the arched doorway leading into the antechamber.  Along the curved walls, long floral tapestries alternate with the bright glow of gaily flickering lanterns.

title: [Cholen's Temple, West Hall]
description: The wide corridor ends at an arched door adorned with a golden musical note set in a diamond of blue-stained wood.  Brass lanterns line the walls, spilling golden light in pools across the long crimson rug that traverses the length of the hall.  Three short steps lead up to an elevated door set in the east wall.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Choir Loft]
description: Flanked to the east and west by narrow doors, a spiraled balustrade separates the raised choir loft from the main floor of the great Chamber of Celebration.  The tiered loft curves with the convex south wall, backed by a line of narrow tapestries beneath rectangular stained glass windows.  The far wall to the north is a concave line of windows bleeding sunlight across the oak parquet floor.  Above, the vaulted ceiling is alight with painted frivolity.

title: [Chamber of Music]
description: Deep blue silk drapes the north and east walls of the small chamber, but the curving wall that sweeps from west to south is filled with arched windows open to the sea air.  Sunlight bathes the spiraled blue-and-gold oak parquet floor with warmth.  A pair of narrow tapestries flank the door to the north, while the east wall is given over to a glass-fronted cabinet full of sheet music.  A few spindly chairs of brass and wood are tucked into the corners of the room.

title: [Chamber of Celebration]
description: Colorful rugs and padded maoral chairs are scattered along the walls of the great chamber, leaving most of the intricate oak parquet floor bare.  Tall arched windows aglow with warm sunlight line the concave sweep of the north wall.  At the southern end of the chamber, a spiraled balustrade encloses the elevated choir loft, which curves with the convex south wall and is backed by a line of narrow tapestries and stained glass windows.  Ruddy wooden beams support a vaulted ceiling given over completely to painted frivolity.

title: [Cholen's Temple, East Hall]
description: The wide corridor ends at an arched door inlaid with a crimson-stained lute set in a circle of gold.  Brass lanterns line the walls, spilling golden light in pools across the long crimson rug that traverses the length of the hall.  Three short steps lead up to an elevated door set in the west wall, while an oak door draped with scarlet silk stands further down the corridor in the east wall.

title: [Meditation Chamber]
description: A handful of colorful cushions and woven prayer rugs are arranged on the hardwood floor of the chamber.  A single lantern illuminates the jewel-toned silks that drape the walls, and a pierced brass screen is centered on the north wall.

title: [Chamber of Laughter]
description: Bright crimson silk drapes the north and west walls of the small chamber, but the curving wall that sweeps from east to south is filled with arched windows open to the sea air.  Sunlight bathes the geometric red-and-gold oak parquet floor with warmth.  Two slim tapestries flank the door to the north, while the west wall is given over to a glass-fronted case of volumes and manuscripts.  A few spindly chairs of brass and wood are tucked into the corners of the room.

title: [Nonie's Weaponry]
description: A fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls, and a low skylight-set ceiling rises overhead.  A wooden ship's wheel sits in one corner of a colorful mosaic floor.  There is a dovetailed oak table on one side of the shop and an oversized sea chest on the other.

title: [Nonie's Outfitting]
description: The broad sweep of the mosaic floor is interrupted by an ornate bottled ship.  Halfway to the skylight-set ceiling, a peacock feather fan hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls.  A long carved oak counter and a floral-etched ceramic case are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Nonie's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a low skylight-set ceiling, a midnight blue rising phoenix tapestry hangs on one of the smooth mistwood walls.  A wide knotted oak counter and a narrow glass-topped table sit in opposite corners while a tropical floral arrangement rests on a colorful mosaic floor.

title: [Ice Gardens, Hollow Tree]
description: The massive tree is long since dead, but the hollowed-out interior is filled with a magical life of its own.  Moisture seeping through the cracks and branches has formed a fairyland of icicles that reflect every color of the rainbow, and a colony of glittering snow sprites has taken up residence among the lacy icework, their gossamer wings shimmering as they dance among the lattices of ice and the hanging branches that drape the entrance.

title: [Hale Hall, Socius' Office]
description: The scent of lavender fills your nostrils in this space, as a pair of stone pots containing large lavender plants in full bloom rest on either side of the wooden doors.  The walls are painted a pale green, and the carpet underfoot is a complementary, slightly darker green with an intricate pattern of interlaced deep blue woven throughout it.  A large writing desk stands in the middle of the space, and directly behind it stands a large picture window looking out onto the street.

title: [Journey's End, Lobby]
description: Smooth sandstone walls rise from a patterned hardwood floor.  Just above a verdant elderberry bush hangs a framed Ta'Illistim map, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling completes the picture.  A wide knotted oak counter and a heavy lead glass display case stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Journey's End, Showroom]
description: A framed Ta'Illistim map hangs on one of the smooth sandstone walls, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling rises overhead.  A small potted boxwood shrub sits in one corner of a patterned hardwood floor.  There is a heavy lead glass display case on one side of the shop and a narrow glass-topped table on the other.

title: [Journey's End, Office]
description: Smooth sandstone walls rise from a patterned hardwood floor.  Just above a verdant elderberry bush hangs a framed Ta'Illistim map, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling completes the picture.  A wide mistwood desk stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Journey's End, Arsenal]
description: Smooth sandstone walls rise from a patterned hardwood floor.  Just above a verdant elderberry bush hangs a framed Ta'Illistim map, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling completes the picture.  A massive granite chest stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Journey's End, Supply Depot]
description: Smooth sandstone walls rise from a patterned hardwood floor.  Just above a verdant elderberry bush hangs a framed Ta'Illistim map, and a cerulean cloud-painted ceiling completes the picture.  A massive granite chest stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Cave Garden]
description: Enormous stalactites droop from the high ceilings in this massive oval room.  The stalactites have been carved and adorned with various forms of glowing lichens, mushrooms, toadstools, and crystals that lend light to this dark expanse.  The surrounding walls flicker with life as cave moss and glowing lichen cast varying patterns of light across the room in hues of white to green.  Carved into the stone walls are a line of benches.  A detailed plaque is mounted high above the carved stone doors.
tags: meta:mapname:Wehnimer's Landing - Order of the Sphere and Scythe
meta:mapshortname:Order of the Sphere and Scythe

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Sentinels]
description: This sparsely decorated room is obviously designed with a martial theme.  Standing at the western archway of the hall are two sentinels guarding the entry, both clad in full plate armor with adornments and regalia representing Gosaena and Jastev.  The walls are lined with weapon racks which contain nearly every common type of weapon.  The floor itself is completely covered in padded, well-cured leather.  Four training mannequins are set in recessed alcoves in each corner of the room.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Cholen's Pub]
description: Music and laughter filter throughout the pub which is lit by glowing crystal globes hanging from the ceiling.  Leather club chairs and small cafe tables ring a stage to the south.  Behind the stage is a large curtain with the embroidered image of a smiling Cholen.  An expansive polished mahogany bar is centered in the room.  Above the bar is a silver-gilded mirror that reflects distorted, comical images of nearby patrons.  A clown face dart board hangs on the pockmarked west wall.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Archive Hall]
description: Walls fitted with sturdy oak shelves, scroll tubes, and glass-paned display cabinets line the perimeter of this rectangular room.  An arched entry looms to the south, while a bas-relief of Fash'lo'nae and Lumnis face off against each other in the northern wall, engaged in a spirited debate.  Positioned directly in front of the carving is a gem-inlaid Elanthian globe.  Long tables and chairs line the center of the room, offering ample space for scholars and historians to conduct their research.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Seer Hall]
description: Various statues stand in alcoves lining the smooth walls of this round room.  Eviscerating knives, decks of tarot cards, pouches of sand, and various bowls are carefully nested in the outstretched hands of stone seers representing all the races of Elanthia.  Each statue has been masterfully carved from a single piece of various types of marble and stone.  A large round table sits in the center of the room surrounded by plush high back chairs.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Memoriam]
description: This perfectly square room expands into the depths of the stone walls that surround it.  In the northern apex a recessed alcove is positioned above two folded wings cradling a perfectly formed crystal sphere.  Engraved above the alcove in detailed script are the words, "With undying love, we commit you to memory."  Three massive tapestries line the remaining walls.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Vision Room]
description: A massive silver-framed mirror dominates the southern wall of this small cozy room, the reflections across its surface twisting and writhing into smoke-like forms.  A large pillow is centered in the middle of the room, sized to accommodate a single person and placed directly in front of a small knee-high table.  Cushions are casually placed around the room to be easily moved for comfort and conversation.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Moon Room]
description: An expansive dome looms above the space, the curved ceiling reflecting the Winter Constellations marked by glowing green glimaerstones and thin veins of glowing lichen.  Makiri and Tilaok are set in close orbit around Liabo, whose bright glow provides ample lighting for the room below.  A smaller, yet quite substantial Lornon looms darkly in the stone sky above.  A reclining padded circular bench sits in the center of the room allowing visitors to gaze up at the dome above.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Jastev Hall]
description: Luxurious panels of black and grey flyrsilk completely line the walls of this small sanctuary.  A massive crystal sphere-shaped chandelier hangs directly over a statue of Jastev that is positioned in the center of the room.  Multiple small black candles inside the chandelier cast dancing patterns of light throughout the room.  A small grey altar painted with a black artist's brush is carefully placed just in front of the statue.  A padded black flyrsilk prayer rug sits at the altar.

title: [Sphere and Scythe, Gosaena Hall]
description: Luxurious panels of grey and white flyrsilk completely line the walls of this small sanctuary.  A massive scythe-shaped chandelier hangs directly over a statue of Gosaena that is positioned in the center of the room.  Feathered white candles adorn the perimeter of the chandelier, casting a soft glow throughout the room.  A small grey altar painted with a white feather is carefully placed just in front of the statue.  A padded white flyrsilk prayer rug sits at the altar.

Broad archways open to the east and west, and to the north, the corridor opens onto the dormitory.  A pair of golden wyverns is inlaid in the stone walls, flanking each archway, and a reinforced oak door to the south leads back to the courtyard.

title: [Vermilion Barracks, Armory]
description: The armory stretches to the left and right from the entry, the windowless space lit by lanterns hung at intervals along the walls.  Several steel weapon bins containing an assortment of weapons line the walls, while numerous sturdy leather dummies wearing various suits of armor stand single-file down the center of the room.

title: [Vermilion Barracks, Dormitory]
description: A dozen military-style cots fill the dormitory, each outfitted with a single, firm pillow and a coarse wool blanket.  A wide, flat footlocker lies at the end of each cot, leaving just enough space to walk comfortably between them.  The quiet snores of the few off-duty guardsmen drift through the room.

title: [Vermilion Barracks, Courtyard]
description: Pennants of crimson and gold adorn the fence which surrounds the single-story grey stone barracks.  The short-clipped grass is meticulously maintained, with nary a weed to be seen.  A wide, grey stone walkway leads from the gate to the barracks' reinforced oak door and precisely bisects the lawn into two practice yards, each filled with a number of soldiers practicing archery on targets or martial weapons on practice dummies.

title: [Annatto Barracks, Lounge]
description: A thick, crimson wool carpet spreads across the grey stone floor, anchored at its center by a wooden table with four sturdy chairs.  A low bookshelf stands beneath a half-open window, with an upholstered armchair nearby.  A few off-duty guardsmen mill about, playing cards, reading, or polishing their boots.

title: [Omens's General Store]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a long carved oak counter and a heavy lead glass display case.

title: [Sivacmar's Weaponry]
description: The broad sweep of the dark oak floor is interrupted by an oily black kraken statue.  Halfway to the light oak ceiling, a curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the knotty oak-paneled walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table is pushed to the back of the shop.

title: [Bloonk's General Store]
description: A fringed crimson silk banner hangs on one of the refurbished driftwood walls, and a domed white stucco ceiling rises overhead.  A woven Vornavian silk rug sits in one corner of a varnished dark oak floor.  There is a plain wooden table on one side of the shop and a slender driftwood counter on the other.

title: [Aramund's Magic Shoppe]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A set of carved felwood shelves and a plain wooden table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Kurut's Weaponry]
description: The broad sweep of the granite floor is interrupted by a miniature Solhaven Bay model.  Halfway to the white stucco ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls.  A beveled glass-covered case and a spacious grey slate counter are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Misun's Outfitting]
description: Refined oak-paneled walls rise from a varnished dark oak floor.  Just above a woven Vornavian silk rug hangs a fused sun and moon wall-hanging, and a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling completes the picture.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case and a painted white oak table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Twilight Gallery, Seasonal Art]
description: A trio-bladed mounted vellum fan hangs on one of the dark blue textured canvas walls, and a domed white stucco ceiling rises overhead.  A thin gold-edge black runner sits in one corner of a black-checked white tile floor.  There is a heavy white granite counter on one side of the shop and a Vornavian silk-lined display case on the other.

title: [Aramund's Magic Shoppe]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a heavy lead glass display case and a polished maoral table.

title: [Aramund's Weaponry]
description: Plain wooden walls rise from an unfinished wooden floor.  Just above a worn rug hangs a tattered merchant permit, and an uneven wooden ceiling completes the picture.  A steel-banded maoral rack and some hammered copper display hooks stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Underground Cavern, Chamber]
description: Affecting the appearance of a subterranean cathedral, the middling cavern chamber is supported by three natural columns and surrounded by intricate speleothem draperies.  Several of the formations partition an array of cases, opposite a smooth fused bone cabinet and an expansively long worktable.  Suspended over a glass terranium, an unusually subdued fire elemental is encased in a glass-like cube hanging from a stalactite.  Small motes of ghostly white light flicker in and out of existence, as if not able to maintain their glow here.

title: [Roughened Path]
description: Forming a wall to the southeast, rows of trees protect the pathways of Summit Academy from the brisk breeze that filters in off the surrounding mountains.  Dark brown mud creates a thin track that leads away from the traditional grounds and marches in a northeasterly direction towards a city of brightly colored tents and painted wooden structures.  A wall of thuja hugs the northwestern edge of the muddy pathway, the tall trees sculpted to resemble horses rearing up.

title: [Roughened Path]
description: Towering poles line the muddy track, their tops housing colorful pennants and banners that snap and ripple in the arctic breeze.  Wrought iron baskets are set between each colorful display, each filled with thistle, thatch, and wood.  To the east and southeast, the round faces of tree stumps seem oddly bright in the sunlight.

Brisk arctic winds whip through the open glade to the east and southeast, setting the colorful pennants that line the track to snapping and causing the illuminating fires to gutter and hiss.  Silvery moonlight paints the faces of the fresh stumps that dot the landscape to create a sea of mini-moons in the snow and grass.

title: [Poiret & Company, Salesroom]
description: Wainscoted panels of the highest quality have been pieced together to create this prim and airy boutique, almost indistinguishable from a standing shop in any fine city.  A gold-legged display case houses a variety of fine handkerchiefs, while an array of pillow-topped pedestals show off tasteful gloves.  A beautiful melange of tasteful and exotic scents meanders through the room.

title: [Poiret & Company, Old City]
[Poiret & Company, The East]
description: A large oaken table sits at the center of this small room, its surface carefully carved and painted to recreate the streets and structures of Old Ta'Faendryl at its height.  Colorful glass flacons sit atop the table on display, almost serving as monument markers.  A many-pronged chandelier casts the graven landscape in bright candlelight.

title: [Poiret & Company, The West]
description: A rich mahogany table dominates this beautifully wainscoted room, its surface intricately carved and painted to recreate the geography of the Turamzzyrian Empire.  An array of colorful glass flacons sit at different points on the table like monument markers.  A single candelabra shines a light across the table, casting shadows along its surface like a setting sun.

title: [Roughened Path]
description: Deep with mud and surrounded by snow-speckled grass, the track stretches between an open glade of tree stumps towards a tent city that is perched to the east of a colorful aspen glade.  Glaesine orbs reflect the sunlight in a prism that creates rainbow swirls upon the ground, while a brisk arctic breeze carries with it the sound of neighing and whinnying from the distance.

title: [What Remains]
description: Erected around a raised platform of smooth sycamore planks, the small tent is slate grey and illuminated by a single lantern strung upon the cross-section of the oak supports.  Copper and bronze griffins are painted upon the walls, the bright beasts fending off the advances of a herd of golden stags and a pride of platinum lions.  A small desk sits directly under the brightly burning lantern, its drawers missing and its inkwell empty.

title: [The Gallant Groom]
description: Constructed to the same specifications as a roomy box stall, this space contains no horses, but instead displays the tools of a horse groomer's trade.  An open crate set upon the clean straw floor holds various currycombs, and a sturdy shelf upon one wall displays a selection of fine brushes.  Entry to the next box stall, perhaps with additional wares, is provided through a latticed archway draped with a red woolen horse blanket.

title: [The Gallant Groom]
description: This detailed replica of a roomy box stall is complete with a hay rack, tack box, and a metal watering trough.  A hanging display of hoof picks has been tacked against one wall, while a selection of mane and tail combs have been splayed across some empty feedbags in the corner.  Additional wares can be seen on display through a crosshatched half-door in the back.

title: [The Gallant Groom]
description: Far smaller than the other rooms in this replicated barn, this stall is only large enough to house a pony.  A line of iron hooks along the panelled sides hold a variety of kits for proper storage of the horse owner's grooming tools.  A pair of large silver horseshoes tacked to the wall hold commemorative kits for this gala event.  A twine-tied bale of hay provides a resting spot for perusing the available goods.

title: [Rumor Woods, Junction]
description: Multiple game trails converge on this section of track, their winding tracks sending them deeper into the western and northern confines of the flame-topped aspen grove.  Westerly pathways flank the edges of an enormous jousting field surrounded by high viewing stands topped with colorful pennants.  The ringing sound of anvil strikes echoes from the northeast and is punctuated by the soft sound of neighing from the southeast.  A large wooden sign post laden with signs offers information on the area.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Newer stones give the low border wall to the south a mottled appearance, which is only enhanced by the dappled sunlight that filters through the spear-shaped leaves in the canopy above.  Tufts of alpine grass grow in verdant patches along the twisting game trails, while plum and gold crocuses grow between the roots of the surrounding aspens.  Tiny sumac saplings manipulated into looping arcs form the frame for a domed shelter woven with colorful ribbons and decorated with hawk and grouse feathers.

title: [Domed Shelter, Commons]
description: Long feathers tied with colorful ribbons decorate the thick natural wool that lines the inside of this domed shelter.  Centered on a large carpet woven with several saffron hues is a conical clay brazier, a narrow rattan basket filled with sticks resting just to the side.  Hanging by the opening is a series of eagle statues, each one a different stage of the bird taking flight.  Flanked by a pair of folding tables is a small wooden sofa lined with amber-hued cushions.

title: [Domed Shelter, Bedroom]
description: Hanging from the supports above and contrasting with the pale natural wool of the shelter lining are a trio of lamps.  Covering the ground is a large rug of braided saffron cotton, each ring wider than the last in a spiraling pattern.  Centered in the space is a rounded walnut bed covered with a thick down comforter.  The headboard is carved with a pattern of eagles in flight.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Blue and grey shale slabs form a low wall to the south that is riddled with a blanket of green alpine moss, the dark mounds giving the ancient structure a mottled appearance.  Zebra-stripped aspen trees stretch their spindled limbs to the sky, their branches laden with flame-hued leaves that are shaped like spear heads.  Positioned to the northwest to the converging trails, a hunter green geteld with bright white embroidery along its edges sits in a bed of wooly ice blue moss.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west

title: [Green Geteld, Commons]
description: Thick animal pelts cover the floor of the large geteld to keep in the warmth while thick green felt lines the oak-framed walls.  Crafted from stone, a brazier rests in the center of the space, its rounded surface and pedestal carved in the shape of a ram.  A woven wisteria basket filled with dry sticks and tinder is placed near the shelter opening.  Flanking the heat source are a pair of small pine chairs layered with warm sheepskin.

title: [Green Geteld, Bedroom]
description: Animal pelts and strips of forest green felt line the floor and walls of the spacious geteld.  Centered in the room is a large pine cot piled with layers of heavy sheepskin.  Hanging from the frame of the secluded sleeping nook are several brass lanterns, their glass panes etched with a pattern of wisteria blossoms.  Off to one side of the curtain is a wooden ram statue.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Flat and wide stone steps follow a winding trail up the side of the mountain, the sinuous path dotted with lanterns that dispel local shadows created by surrounding rocky outcroppings and the thick canopy of leaves.  White-flowered kelleria dot the edges of the smooth slabs, while rust-hued lichen darkens the surfaces.  A thin brook trickles down from above, disappearing in the nearby ground cover as it heads deeper into the aspen grove to the southeast.

title: [Rumor Woods, Hairpin Turn]
description: Smooth slate flagstones of rose and copper stretch outward to form a patio within the curve of the pathway's hairpin turn.  Shadows stretch upon the descending southeastern track, while moonlight illuminates patches of snow along the ascending eastern steps.  A low stone bench flanked by flickering lanterns provides a comfortable space to view the scenery.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Shadows dance across the area as the edge of the aspen grove brushes against the rocky outcroppings to the west.  Several game trails wander off in various directions, their edges covered in snow and their centers slick with mud.  Standing out starkly amid the bright white trunks of the nearby trees, a small dark blue yurt sits back from the path and is surrounded by several rows of fluttering pennants.

title: [Dark Blue Yurt]
description: Thick blue felt lines the walls of the spacious, yet small, yurt, while a warm woolen carpet whorled with a pale pink pattern covers the floor.  A thick quilt is draped over the frame of a small yellow pine bed placed against the far wall.  Copper lanterns hang from the slender rafters above, their crystal panes etched with tiny snowberry blossoms.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Sheltered in the shadows of the surrounding moutains, snow clings to the ground as it stretches across the mossy alpine landscape.  Three game trails converge within the center of the small clearing, though only one, which shows signs of recently being widened into a traversible path, continues upward towards the darker sections of Rumor Woods.  Colorful tents pop out of the aspen grove to the southwest, while shale and scrub brush occupy the northwesterly sections.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Steam wafts through the air as it takes leave of a blue and purple pavilion to the southeast, the scent of warm bread and hot clove-spiced teas mingling in its ethereal vapors. The sound of jovial voices filters through the air, though the particular conversations are muffled by layers of canvas and fleece.

title: [Aspen Tavern, Kitchen]
description: Oak barrels line the edge of the linden and teak platform that forms the pavilion's floor, the filled containers housing various liquids on tap.  Tiered baskets descend on chains from the wrought iron ceiling, the latter of which is used to support the heavy panels of blue and purple that form the ceiling and walls.  A long counter supported by modwir tree stumps is laden with various dishes and pitchers.

title: [Aspen Tavern, Commons]
description: Pleated and heavy, voluminous canvas walls of alternating azure and plum panels are held aloft by a thick frame of welded wrought iron.  Small nooks with tables and chairs are sheltered by painted screens of rice paper and bamboo and tucked against the edges of a large teak and linden floor.  Candles burn within glass jars that are suspended from the rafters, while dozens of pot-bellied ceramic stoves fill the space with cozy warmth.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Perched at the edge of a towering aspen glade, a blue and purple pavilion holds court in the snow-covered alpine grass.  Lilac alpine asters bloom amid the heavy iron support spikes that bind the structure's walls close to the ground, their pale heads nodding in the heat that permeates the canvas walls.  Moonlight illuminates the white bark of the surrounding trees, while glaesine globes bath the flame-hued leaves in prismatic hues.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Fluffy white catkins cling to one of the young aspens that grows to the southeast of the interlacing game trails that converge in this section of the grove.  Growing in clusters around the sapling are dozens of ghostberry shrubs, their thin branches laden with bright white berries and pale pink blossoms.  A rich plum-hued yurt fashioned of woven goat hair rests just off the snow-lined trail in a patch of sunlit alpine grass.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Rich Plum-hued Yurt]
description: Thick woolen rugs in various shades of violet cushion the floor of the small yurt.  Hanging from the rafters above are several copper lanterns with fruit-etched crystal panes.  Centered in the space is a small wooden bed, its headboard and bedding reflecting a fanciful theme of tarts and berries.  Standing to one side is a large ceramic statue of a beautiful truefolk lass carrying a basket of pastries.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Golden light and shadows dance across the high grasses of the small clearing where multiple trails scatter in various directions.  Twisting its way through the aspen roots and tumbling mounds of vegetation, a burbling brook bubbles up from beneath the damp ground and cuts a singular path to the southwest before disappearing again.  A conical tent of sky blue silk emblazoned with a silver ram sits in a flat section of ground that is free of mud and snow.

title: [Sky Blue Conical Tent]
description: Thick sky blue wool lines the interior of the roomy tent.  Several candles are perched on rounded wooden candleholders, their pillars carved with a series of tiny rabbits, chipmunks, and raccoons.  Colorful quilts are stacked near a pile of blue fleece pillows that are heaped to one side.  Crafted to be close to the ground is a small aspen table, its surface sanded and varnished for a smooth gleaming finish.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Perched just beyond the edges of the aspen grove, a stone-lined pond spreads to the north and east.  Large stepping stones lead to a tiny island that is surrounded by steaming water, though its edges are encased in frost and snow.  Holly, cut to be a low ground shrub, adds a splash of crimson to the pristinely white scene on the tiny piece of land.

title: [Island in the Steam]
description: Wreathed in steam from the hot spring that surrounds it, the small island is encircled by low holly bushes that are laden with bright red berries amid their verdant leaves.  Rhimar spacers set into the flagstone tiles promote the frost and snow that cling to the ground and lend the area an enchanted aspect.  A sumac gazebo rests at the center of the stonework, a brightly burning brazier housed within offering the promise of warmth.

title: [Gazebo]
description: Billowing in thick clouds, steam from the hot springs that surround the island obscures the forest beyond the gazebo's wide open windows.  Thick woolen pillows are scattered about the ground, offering a comfortable place to recline while enjoying the warmth that radiates from the brazier at the heart of the tiny structure.  A low oak table near the exit offers a small sampling of refreshments.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Uneven stones, greyed with age and smooth from exposure to the mountain winds, are haphazardly stacked to form a low wall along the eastern edge of the aspen glade.  Finger-thin branches from surrounding trees interlock above to create a decorative canopy of crimson, saffron, and golden leaves, which are sparse enough to permit the golden light to slip through.  Resting to the west of the pathway is a pristine white geteld that has a triangular entry framed in interlocking emerald green embroidery.

title: [White Geteld, Commons]
description: Pale white cotton is draped over the frame of the geteld, creating a warm, yet airy, structure.  A pile of beige and cinnamon cotton pillows is scattered about a rounded bronze brazier.  Woven carpets of wool dyed in various shades of greens are layered over the floor.  Resting to one side is a low red maple table with a small woven straw basket tucked beneath it.

title: [White Geteld, Bedroom]
description: Suspended from the supports of the large and airy geteld are a pair of bronze lanterns that sway as the canvas sides move with each errant breeze.  A large wooden cot draped with a thick pine green comforter rests upon a thick carpet of ambers and chestnuts hues.  A vine and leaf pattern is etched into the wooden panels of an iron-bound wooden coffer that is set to one side of the structure.

title: [Rumor Woods, Anvil Strip]
description: Dotted with freshly cut tree stumps, the path from the southwest spreads out to a rut-lined, muddy road running past newly constructed viewing stands.  Spectators mill about, animatedly chatting about their favorite teams.  Atop the stands, gold and hunter green pennants whip and snap as a breeze blows through, the rush of warm air from the northeast bringing the scent of hot metal.

description: Crowded with benches painted hunter green, the viewing stands look out over the lists and hopeful champions on their mounts.  Tavern wenches circulate through the seating area, each carrying wooden trays weighted with ale-filled tankards, skillfully dodging pinching hands.  A forgotten pennant lies draped over a straw bale near a short row of steps leading down to the road.

title: [Jousting Fields, Viewing Stands]
description: A heavy coat of fresh sawdust covers the aspen plank flooring, thrown down in an attempt to soak up pools of mud, dung, and spilled ale.  Rough-hewn boards laid across bales of straw provide temporary seating at the rear of the stands, while the front has been roped-off and arranged with cushioned benches and high-backed chairs, a menacing-looking guard posted at the entrance.  A red banner stitched with a platinum lion hangs overhead, the eye of the lion set with a polished onyx stone.

description: Available seating is scant in this area of the stands, the hastily constructed benches of aspen planks cracked and splitting under the weight of the enormous crowds.  Tree stumps have been pushed up against the front of the stands, creating makeshift high chairs for flag-waving children.  Oblivious to the fanfare, an old shaggy dog snores quietly in a pile of sawdust in one corner.

title: [Rumor Woods, Anvil Strip]
description: In the shadow of the viewing stands, a narrow road leads west through a maze of merchant stalls and tents.  Horses are tethered to posts along both sides of the road, some drinking from hanging buckets filled with icy cold spring water, while others graze on small tufts of wild grass not yet trampled into the mud.  The smell of roasting peanuts wafts in on a gentle breeze.

title: [Rumor Woods, Hammer Way]
description: A wagon filled with sawdust is parked in the middle of the road, its driver nowhere in sight.  A small group of children astride stick horses brandish aspen branches streaming jerboa banderoles, laughing and shouting as they charge at each other in turn.  A line of merchant stalls along one side of the road appear to have recently been afire, the scorched aspen wood still smoldering.

title: [Unfurling Battle]
description: Brightly lit by glowing glaesine orbs that are suspended from wooden rafters, the ebony tent is slightly chilled from the arctic air that threatens to invade through open flaps and unbound walls.  A series of round metal stands house colorful pennants on display, their ends unfurled and their staves polished to a lustrous sheen.  Sunlight spills into the entry and warms the ground to soft mud.

title: [Sweetie Pies]
description: Bright yellow canvas has been draped over rough aspen poles to create a cozy tent jam-packed with open crates and hanging baskets filled with fruit.  Crowded between sacks of flour and stacks of sugar tins, a wire cooling rack overflowing with hot pies sits atop a glass display case smudged with fingerprints.  The canvas flaps at the entrance have been tied back, allowing the aromas of freshly baked goods to waft outside, a mouthwatering advertisement of the wares on display.

title: [Rumor Woods, Hammer Way]
description: The shouts of the roaring crowd from within the viewing stands to the south compete with the noise of the ringing anvils to the north.  Over all of the din, merchants pitch their sales to passersby, whose uttered curses in return bemoan ankle-deep mud and horse dung.  On either side of the way, freshly cut tree stumps are splashed with hunter green paint, some bearing detailed golden roltons.

title: [Mount'N'Cloak, Foyer]
description: Heavy sections of burlap are sewn together with thick leather cords across the walls of the tent.  Each panel of burlap is painted an alternating red then blue fashion.  A raised, square section is elevated slightly higher than the rest of the ceiling atop longer poles.

title: [Irons in the Fire]
description: Parti-colored pennants flutter from carved aspen posts sunk in the soft ground, a tattered sailcloth overhead sheltering smoldering coals in a rock-lined fire pit.  Laid out on a stump-mounted anvil, a hammer and tongs await a smithy's arrival, leather bellows and water-filled buckets close-at-hand.  The distinctive smell of singed hair and burnt flesh lingers in the stall.

title: [Rumor Woods, Anvil Strip]
description: Straw has been scattered over the worst of the muddy road, and a few planks tossed down to provide footing through the deepest puddles.  Behind the viewing stands, merchants hawk their wares from haphazardly constructed stalls, their shouts barely heard over the ringing anvil to the northeast.  An overturned wagon filled with cooking supplies sits abandoned at the roadside.

title: [Container Yourself]
description: Mud stains the lower half of the long canvas panels that line three of the shop's four sides and darkens the red strips along the hemline to a ruddy brown.  Spear-headed display hooks dangle from the awning's support posts, while a wooden shield-ringed rack is erected within the center of the structure to allow visitors to move around it for a better view of the wares.  A lone clerk watches warily from the entry.

title: [Horse Of A Different Fashion]
description: Layers of thick wool line the frame of the canopy tent, locking the heat from a small copper brazier inside.  A tall polished brass rack of clothing makes a colorful wall along the back of the area.  Wooden planks cover the ground to create a makeshift floor.  Thick carpets give the space some semblance of elegance, their woven patterns creating the symbols of the six Dai.  Hanging from the pine frame is a small sign.

description: Stretched along the far wall, a beautiful tapestry depicting the symbols of the six Dai layers with the woolen walls to ward off the damp cold from outside.  A pair of brass lanterns hang from the rough pine framework of the tent.  Thick woven carpets cover the rough plank floor, their lengths buckling slightly under the weight of a small wooden counter.  Several crates are tucked to one side, their contents shadowed in the corner of the room.

title: [Rumor Woods, Anvil Strip]
description: Blasts of heat rush outside of a large, open-air forge, the thunderous sounds of hammer and anvil filling the area.  Beige and myrtle green pennants are tied to posts sunk into the soft ground, each surrounded by a diverse lot of saddled horses patiently awaiting their riders' return.  In between two canvas tents, a halfling perches on an overturned crate, polishing a pair of riding boots.

title: [Horsing Around, Showroom]
description: Scorch marks and soot stain the canvas near a small workbench in one corner of this modest shop.  An intricate contraption hangs from the ridgepole.  A confusing jumble of polished brass mirrors and gears, the contraption serves to magnify light from a single oil lamp and focus it on a single display case in the center of the area.

title: [Fanfare, Stall Front]
[Fanfare]
description: A hastily constructed open-air stall is draped with a sunbleached canvas awning, providing a small swath of protection from the elements.  Along the front of the stall, open wooden crates are turned facing toward the road to give passersby a preview of the merchandise on offer.  An old wine barrel sits at the end of a long counter along the back wall, upon which a fuzzy white kitten has taken up residence in a woven reed basket filled with scraps of cloth.

title: [Rumor Woods, Forge Stall]
description: Neat and tidy, the stall is partially walled off from the main forge by varied blacksmiths' tools that hang on ropes along the rear.  A much smaller hearth is situated next to the tools, a set of bellows, a slack tub, and two protrusion-ridden anvils gathered around it.  Horseshoes, nails, and horse armor make up the majority of the finished pieces that are visible in the stall, with a very select type of armor and gauntlets seemingly the only non-equine subject of interest to the proprietor, a petite copper-haired blacksmith.

title: [Rumor Woods, Forge]
description: Though clearly a makeshift setup in its underlying build, the open-air forging area is well-equipped, easily able to accommodate several blacksmiths at once.  The main hearth, which blazes with heat, is so large in scale that it is impossible to imagine it as a moveable.  Close to the hearth, block-shaped anvils with pentagonal footprints stand upright, and a plethora of forging tools hang from racks and ropes near the front of the space, separating the forge from several blacksmith stalls.

title: [Rumor Woods, Forge]
description: Heat shimmers in the air, undulating in waves from three small hearths scattered through this area, which is walled off in spots by crumbling brickwork that looks far older than any of the equipment here.  Common anvils, blocky in shape, are centered between the three hearths, alongside several slack tubs, and two blacksmith's apprentices bustle about, tending to the hearths.  Forging tools -- tongs, chisels, fullers, hardys, hammers -- hang from ropes suspended throughout the area.

title: [Rumor Woods, Forge Stall]
description: Three shining, nearly scintillating suits of armor hang at the front of the stall, clearly meant to draw attention.  Cramped and disorderly describes much of the rest of the stall, which is tented over the top with off-white canvas stretched out over thick wooden poles.  Near the rear of the stall, just before it opens up into a set of forges bustling with activity and sound, is a worktable set with exquisitely lacquered and gilded engravings.  Pieces of metal scrap litter the floor.

title: [Rumor Woods, Forge Stall]
description: Shields and swords of every shape and size -- some wood, though the majority of metal -- are situated around the interior of the partially tented blacksmith's stall, the majority of the work noticeably inferior in quality.  A light breeze trickles in from the front, though the heat wafting in from the collection of furnaces behind the stall, which is somewhat obscured by a virtual wall of forging tools that drip down in hanging formation from several lengths of rope, is nearly unbearable.

Kannalan style saddles hang along a railing near one wall, opposite a long, horizontal post topped with a row of Minstrel's style saddles.  Scattered throughout the room, lanterns constantly spit tiny flames, their smoke mingling with the scents of white oak and leather.

description: Cramped and dim, the display room shows signs of hasty construction, and the canvas eastern wall flaps from where it has torn free of its stakes.  A single lantern illuminates the wares for sale in a wide oak chest, while simultaneously casting shadows upon the items hanging from a series of display hooks suspended from the sycamore walls.  Despite the closeness, or perhaps because of it, there is a decided warmth to the air due to the work of a coal-filled brazier left in the center of the space.

title: [Rumor Woods, Hackney Row]
description: The ground trembles as horses charge across the arena behind the market, causing the occasional clay pot or glass jar to roll across one of the makeshift counters in front of the shops.  Elongated replica lances and gaudy renditions of shields lay against the back wall of the markets, each one depicting the image of a wolf painted in crimson and ebon hues.

paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Roundabout Racers]
description: Merrily decorated with miniature woodworked cutouts of knight, castle, sword, and shield models coated in garishly shimmering paint, the space is crowded but also bright and lively.  Small wooden pens and roofless barns sized at a low height are spread over the ground, each populated with lifeless mechanical toy equines and roltons, though a handful gallop around, respectively neighing and bleating plaintively and occasionally running into the sides of the pen, barn, and one another.

Small wooden pens and roofless barns sized at a height more appropriate to viewing for children than adults are spread over the ground, each populated with lifeless mechanical toy equines, though a handful gallop around, neighing plaintively and occasionally running into the sides of the pen, barn, and one another.

title: [Couturier's Retreat]
description: Framed in dark pine, the supports of the tent are lined with ivory wool.  Surrounded by cushioned benches, a small copper brazier is centered in the room, its hammered body polished to a brilliant gleam.  Tucked next to the opening is a narrow rattan basket full of dry tinder and wood.  Bits of material, needles, and spools of thread are neatly organized on top of a small birch worktable.
