Tucked next to the opening is a narrow rattan basket full of dry tinder and wood.  Bits of material, needles and spools of thread are neatly organized on top of a small birch worktable.

title: [Couturier's Retreat, Storage]
description: Half-full boxes and empty cartons line a large bookshelf that has been converted into a crude inventory management system.  Small cards are attached to each shelf and detail the contents of every container, while a small table rests in the center of the room, ready to assist in the sorting process.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Brisk with chill, an alpine breeze sets the saffron and gold leaves in the upper boughs of the nearby aspen trees to swaying.  Moonbeams win their way free of the foliage and dispel shadows that threaten a simple shale and glass windchime that hangs from a nearby white-barked limb.  Thin game trails, illuminated by several firefly-filled glass jars, disappear into the grove, meandering away from a canvas-woven domed enclosure.

Wane and tenebrous, an alpine breeze sets the saffron and gold leaves in the upper boughs of the nearby aspen trees to swaying and causes the sunlight to become dappled as it falls upon the snow-crested grasses.  Thin game trails disappear into the grove, meandering away from a canvas-woven domed enclosure that is surrounded by empty glass jars.  A simple shale and glass windchime sings a whimsical song as nearby movement sets it in motion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west

title: [Summit Academy, Sylinar's Way]
description: The paved walkway winds its way between rows of trees, pleached to form an arched canopy over the path.  The air is unseasonably warm along the corridor, and to the south, the opening in the trees is filled with radiant sunlight.

title: [Domed Enclosure, Commons]
description: Thick woolen carpets woven in patterns of green and brown are layered on the floor, creating a soft covering.  Some fluffy pillows covered with rabbit pelts are scattered about a rough hewn wooden table.  Centered in the room is a hammered copper brazier, its beautiful surface shimmering with the smallest light.  Tucked to one side of the enclosure is a small woven basket filled with sticks, while standing to another is a beautifully carved maple tree.

title: [Domed Enclosure, Bedroom]
description: Several clusters of large beeswax candles are placed about the edge of the enclosure, their various lengths and natural forms making them a beautiful work of art.  A copper-bound cedar chest dominates one area, the wood carved with whimsical forest creatures.  Heaped in the center of the room is a pile of soft furs in a wide variety of colors and from many different animals.

title: duplicate of 28087
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west

title: [Galieca's Brewer's Retreat]
description: A thick wool rug covers the wooden floor, a carved table resting in the center.  Several cushioned chairs are set about the intimate gathering space with a large sofa taking up much of the room.  A small wicker basket is tucked to one side of a cast iron stove that occupies a shadowed corner of the room.  Curtained with blue silk, a picture window looks out over the var below.

title: duplicate of 28005
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Valley of Gold]
description: Spreading out across the rest of the valley is a city of tents, hues of crimson to the west and sapphire to the east.  Trampled grass shows the large amount of people that passed this way.  Wagons filled with barrels of drink and crates of supplies can be seen traveling to one camp or the other.  The sounds of laughter, singing, and marching echo from both sides.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Grand Stable, East Wing]
description: On the northern side of the wide cobblestone alley, an area has been reserved for feed storage.  The space is filled with barrels of various grains, canvas bags of apples and carrots, and numerous leather feed bags awaiting deployment to the stable's residents.  On the south side of the alley, two stalls reside together, their lower doors latched with blued-steel hardware.

title: [East Wing, West Stall]
description: Freshly scrubbed and tidy, the stall has clean straw bedding strewn about the floor and a small lantern strung from the ceiling provides ample illumination.  An empty bucket and its companion, a long-handled brush, rests against the western wall.

title: [East Wing, East Stall]
description: Steam trickles down from the lantern above as its golden glow warms the air of the stall.  A thick bed of hay occupies one corner, while a rack leans against the stall's exit.

title: [Grand Stable, East Wing]
description: Numerous bales of freshly cut golden hay fill a large stall on the northern side of the spacious alley.  Red-handled pitchforks stand upright, spearing the hay bales, while a small green cart stands close by.  Stray stalks of hay weave themselves between the cracks of the dark grey cobblestones that make up the floor.  On the southern side of the wide alley are two stalls, their lower half-doors latched with blued-steel hardware.

title: [East Wing, East Stall]
description: Warm heat ripples through the air within the stall, while singed hay lays scattered about the floor.  Dark furrows in the ground bespeak repeated pawing by a hooved animal, while splintered wood displays evidence of a dark temper.

title: [Grand Stable, Center]
description: This large central area of the stable is bustling with activity.  Fresh pine struts rise from the cobblestone floors to support rafters that create a high peaked ceiling overhead, with large windows lining the walls above that allow fresh air and light into the busy space.  Traveling through the entire structure from east to west is a wide alley large enough to accommodate equine traffic.  A large chalkboard with bold yellow letters scrawled across it has been posted here, designating stall assignments and staffing.

title: [Grand Stable, Arena]
description: Rafters of fresh pine support a peaked roof high overhead with colored pennants hanging in neat rows from the struts.  Open windows allow air, and the occasional local avian, to circulate freely above.  The ground is a soft loamy soil over hard-packed earth with numerous hoofprints radiating in wide circles around the center of the arena.  You also see a young stablehand and a long wooden gate leading back to the stable

Open windows allow air, and the occasional local avian, to circulate freely above.  The ground is a soft loamy soil over hard packed earth with numerous hoofprints radiating in wide circles around the center of the arena.

title: [Grand Stable, West Wing]
description: High ceilings and propped-open windows allow the free flow of air to circulate above the wide alley that runs through the center of the stable.  On the northern side, an area has been built to store tack.  Reins, bits, and blinders hang from blued-steel hooks anchored to pine walls, while saddles and blankets are stacked on low shelves.  On the southern side of the alley, two stalls sit side by side, blued-steel latches securing their lower half-doors shut.

title: [West Wing, East Stall]
description: Wrought iron hooks hold various bits of tack and harnesses in place, the fixtures high enough in the air that the ends don't drag upon the smooth dirt ground.  A generous supply of grain spills from a nearby feedbag, while chilled water glistens in a low trough.

title: [West Wing, West Stall]
description: Warm heat ripples through the air within the stall, while singed hay lays scattered about the floor.  Dark furrows in the ground bespeak repeated pawing by a hooved animal, while splintered wood displays evidence of a dark temper.

title: [Grand Stable, West Wing]
description: On the north side of the wide alley running the length of the stable, a freshly-constructed low pinewood wall surrounds a damp grey flagstone floor to create a large stall.  Long-handled brushes stand at the ready next to white oak barrels filled with water that line the western wall, while horseshoe picks lay on the flagstones next to a simple red stool resting in the far east corner. Across the alley to the south, two stalls stand side by side.

title: [West Wing, East Stall]
description: Golden lamplight illuminates the small stall that is fashioned of new boards and thick wooden posts.  The sweet scent of cut grass and fresh hay fills the air of the small stall and mingles with the musky scent of equines.

title: [West Wing, West Stall]
description: Built from a combination of sycamore and mahogany planks, the tall stall has a striped appearance that is marked by fine green lines in the grains of both woods.  Parsley clippings and bits of barley mix with a generous helping of fresh hay near the back of the stall.

title: [Rumor Woods, Gateway]
description: The trees grow tall at the lake's edge, the distant mountain peaks barely visible behind their towering heights.  Heavy, snow-laden branches criss-cross to obscure what lies beyond the treeline.  Only a pair of dead pines breaks this wall of foliage, their bleak trunks making a gateway to the forest within.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The sounds of the outside world have all but vanished here within the depths of the woods.  The quiet hangs heavy like a fog in the air.  Other than the stray bird call or panicked flap of wings, all is silence.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The pines here are particularly tall and slender, with their branches stripped of most of their needles.  With little foliage to block the view, the vastness of the woods is more apparent.  The naked white pines seem to extend forever, a multitude of skeletal fingers stretching from a winter grave.

title: [Rumor Woods, Lodge]
description: Rough oak walls rise from dusty floorboards, their warped faces and roughened edges bespeaking their age and improper maintenance.  Copper and wrought iron lanterns swing from exposed rafters that support a thatched roof, while narrow windows lined with wool curtains struggle to keep the chill of the outdoors at bay.  A worktable occupies the center of the space, while two cots flank a pot bellied stove opposite the lodge's only door.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The trees begin their gradual creep up the mountainside at this branch of the forest.  The path north is twisted and rocky, bending out of sight behind a wall of crooked, snow-laden spruces.  To the west, fresh paw prints mark a gently downhill sloping trail away from the mountain and deeper into the woods.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: A sense of calm and peace pervades this branch of the woods.  Paw prints, broken branches, and distinctive deer tracks deep in the snow betray a livelier animal habitat, while birdsong is more frequent and cheerful.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Hundreds of tiny paw-prints criss-cross the powdery white snow dusting the forest floor.  A steady and lively feral chittering can be heard within random nooks and corners of the undergrowth.  A precarious shortcut through the woods appears possible to the northwest.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Tall and narrow spruces, mostly shed of snow, line the path through the woods.  The green of their needles provides an uncommon shot of color in an otherwise stark white landscape.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The body of a gray sparrow lies at the base of a fir tree.  The sparrow has been well-preserved by the cold, its distinctive chestnut-flecked plumage a rare dash of color amid the snow and ice.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Small bones, long striped of their flesh, litter the forest floor.  Amid smaller paw prints smattering the snow, one larger set dominates, crossing the path and vanishing into the thick of the woods.

title: [Rumor Woods, Dead Cedar]
description: A massive felled cedar dominates this bend in the path through the woods.  Long dead, the cedar's decaying husk has become a host for all other manner of woodland life, with lichen sprouting from its sides and rodent tracks leading into its underbelly.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The lone howl of a wolf sends the forest into silence for a moment.  The frantic scrambling somewhere in the undergrowth pays testimony to the life of the hunted within these woods.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Sunlight filters through the snow-dappled branches of the massive firs and spruces towering over this portion of the path, casting the forest floor in gold and shadow.  High above, a loud hoot followed by snow falling from a branch announces an owl taking its new perch.

Moonlight filters through the snow-dappled branches of the massive firs and spruces towering over this portion of the path, casting the forest floor in silver and shadow.  High above, a loud hoot followed by snow falling from a branch announces an owl taking its new perch.

title: [Rumor Woods, Talon Rock]
description: The path abruptly stops at a a massive rock formation amid the trees.  Thick with moss, lichen, and encroaching roots from the adjacent firs, the rock teems with forest life.  Though steep, the rock appears to have enough basic hand- and foot-holds to be traversable, with care.

title: [Rumor Woods, Small Cave]
description: The walls of the cramped cave are heavy with moss, lichen, and frost.  A smattering of small bones betray the cave's possible use as a den for a predator sometime in the past.  An array of delicate icicles hanging from the cave's mouth, while only darkness lies further in.

title: [Rumor Woods, Small Cave]
description: The light of the outside world barely reaches the cave's quiet, dank depths.  Aside from the frosty chill of the air and the damp touch of the walls, all is nothingness.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: A curtain of tangled roots hanging over a minor rocky outcropping nearly conceals what appears to be a a small cave.  The snow at the cave's mouth seems free of paw prints, or other potentially dangerous indications of animal life.

title: [Rumor Woods, Ascent]
description: The path up the mountain is gradual, the dense tree cover at both sides obscuring the scope of the ascent.  A gentle wind rattles the branches above, sending their ice-laden needles chattering against each other like teeth in the cold.

title: [Rumor Woods, Mountain Path]
description: A cluster of icy rocks marks a steep turn in the path up the mountain.  The scope of the ascent becomes more apparent as the trail ahead looms free of twists and turns, a long and craggy climb disappearing into the gentle haze beyond.

title: [Rumor Woods, Mountain Path]
description: Years of ice weigh on the trees at this stretch of the rocky path up mountain.  Their frozen branches bow under the burden, criss-crossing above head to form a kind of corridor of wintry glass.

title: [Rumor Woods, Mountain Path]
description: The white haze pervading the mountain path swells to a near white-out here.  Jutting tree branches permeating the haze are the only landmarks indicating the way upward.

title: [Rumor Woods, Dead End]
description: A small branch off the path leads to this cul-de-sac carved by time into the mountain itself.  Green moss and white snow fight for purchase along walls of granite stretching into the white gloom above.  The steep mountain walls are completely untraversable.

title: [Rumor Woods, Mountain Path]
description: The haze breaks at this sharp bend in the path.  The way forward is especially steep, and the ground underneath perilously icy.  Even the trees themselves barely seem to be able to hold on, their roots clinging to the rocky earth like desperate, knotted fingers.

title: [Rumor Woods, Mountain Path]
description: The trail up the mountain grows so steep it becomes a climb.  Large rocks, mercifully free of ice, jut from the rough path, making the ascent barely possible.  Thick and sinuous fir roots provide the only other hand and footholds up the mountain.

title: [Rumor Woods, Mountain Path]
description: The ground is suddenly level here, and free of any treacherous hazards.  A calm silence hangs in the air, the sounds of the world below only a whisper at these quiet heights.  The trail up the mountain appears to end at a rocky outcropping to the north.

title: [Rumor Woods, Rocky Peak]
description: The tree cover finally breaks at this rocky outcropping, laying bare the breadth of the frozen woodlands below.  A gentle white haze rolls down from the mountains and over the snow-capped trees, vanishing into a mist at Lake Sasalis' edge.  From these heights, the frozen lake catches subtle hues of violet and pink, rendering the vista reflected from its surface almost as a glassy, wintry dream.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The spruces and pines at this stretch of the woods are thick with downy snow.  The gossamer powder seems to cling to every needle in round, velvety puffs, lending the trees a dreamy, cloud-like quality.

title: [Rumor Woods, The Sisters]
description: Three massive spruces mark a split at the path through the woods.  Each spruce dominates a different branch of the path, laying claim to its own section of the forest.  Above head, the edges of the spruces' longest limbs barely touch, like outstretched arms yearning for contact.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Dense undergrowth gives way to what must have been, at one time, a functioning fire pit.  The fire pit is crude, dug a foot deep and supported by stray stones that seem to have been culled from the forest floor.  A thick ice glazes the fire pit, betraying the fact it hasn't been used in quite some time.  A shortcut through the woods, veering away from the main path, appears possible to the southeast.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, west

title: [Rumor Woods, Shortcut]
description: This shortcut through the trees is hardly convenient or inviting.  Sharp branches protrude from seemingly every direction, and the way is so rough and uninviting as to hardly deserve the distinction of being called a path.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: A cluster of fir trees clings for purchase at the edge of a massive rock formation.  Their thick roots grasp the rock's cracks and crags, like fingers clutching a precious jewel.  Though precarious, a climb down the formation appears possible, while an easier path through the woods continues to the northeast.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The tree cover is denser at these depths in the woods, with little to any snow reaching the undergrowth.  Bare rocks, dead needles, and fallen pine cones litter the barren forest floor.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Wind gently rattles the pine needles overhead, shaking loose tiny flecks of snow that fall softly to the ground.  Little other sound or light penetrates the dense walls of foliage, creating a palpable air of silence and isolation.

title: [Rumor Woods, Cleft Fir]
description: A massive fir has been split down the middle by a lightning strike some years ago.  Though nearly split to its roots, the fir has somehow managed to cling to life.  Its two halves grow apart from each other as if they were different trees, the details of the damage that split them apart obscured by ice and time.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: A low fog blankets the forest floor, completely obscuring it from sight.  Errant winds occasionally roil the fog and send it churning and eddying.  At times the fog resembles storm clouds, making the trees look as if they were springing from a squalling sky.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The fog pervading the woods swells to an almost complete whiteout.  Only the most vague tree shapes are visible within the all-enveloping haze.  Even sound itself seems to be lost in the pervasive white gloom.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The fog breaks at a clearing, where a decrepit stone hut stands.  Its stones are thick with ice and lichen, with its thatched roof collapsed under what must be years' worth of snow.  Thick walls of trees block progress in all directions except back.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The path ends at a creek that seems to have stopped in time.  Its waters, though frozen solid, still echo their natural flows downstream.  A felled log offers access, however dubious, over the creek's frozen surface to its north bank.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: The path through this dense expanse of trees is particularly difficult.  Walls of thick pines and firs loom in every direction, with branches jutting from all sides and angles.  The path's packed ice makes progress all the more painstaking.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: A cluster of fir trees competes for territory with a formation of rocks dominating this stretch of the path through the woods.  Their roots grow in snaking paths around and over the boulders, in places overtaking them completely.

title: [Rumor Woods, Raven's Circle]
description: The path stops abruptly at a circle of glowering tall cedars, where seemingly dozens of ravens have made their home.  The ravens caw back and forth at each other in a sort of dialogue, only to stop altogether at unpredictable intervals.  Violent wing flaps punctuate the cacophony, as the ravens take flight across the circle from one perch to another.

title: [Summit Academy, Ellipse]
description: Snow-topped firs stand guardian over much smaller junipers, their dark green boughs and dark blue berries providing colorful interest to the northeastern landscape.  Rounded stones of grey and brown peek through the snow-dusted grounds and lead a winding path through the dark foliage.

title: [Summit Academy, Thurgine Court]
description: Blown glass lanterns decorate the face of the off-white stone structure that has been built within the dark confines of a juniper grove.  Rainbow-whorled windows reflect the light from within, though the thick fog of steam that limns the panes makes it impossible to see the interior.  Slipping through the foliage, a winding path provides egress.

title: [Midnight Heron, Aftcastle]
description: Atop the mizzenmast, above crisp white sails, a large white flag bearing a midnight blue heron flies in the air.  Dark blue velvet-padded benches line the chrome-railed square back of the stern, surrounding a small marble-topped bar secured to the deck.  Standing at the center of the aftcastle, a waist-high chrome frame supports a crystal steerage globe.  A chrome-handled hatch offers access to the cargo hold below.

title: [Thurgine Hall, Foyer]
description: Redwood floors, polished to a brilliant gleam, stretch away from the entry into the eastern and western wings, while a roped-off stairway leads to a carpeted second floor.  Damp outer garments are hung from hooks to either side of the entry.

title: [Thurgine Hall, Lounge]
description: Rainbow-whorled windows, foggy with condensation created by the heat of a nearby fireplace, rise from the floor to the ceiling upon two of the lounge's four walls.  Tall golden linden bookcases frame passageways that lead out of the area, and a soft carpet of indigo and cobalt blue stretches across the floor.

title: [Thurgine Hall, Library]
description: Frosted globes dangle from the ceiling to provide ample illumination for the spacious library, while white pine bookcases laden with books line the walls from floor to ceiling.  A brass and oak lectern stands at the center of a double archway leading deeper into the structure, though a golden cord stretched across the entry prevents further passage in that direction.

title: [East Wing, West Stall]
description: Multiple horseshoes decorate the sycamore walls of the stall, their ends pointed towards the ceiling.  A small trough houses chilled water for the occupants to sip on, while an empty bucket lays on its side in the nearby hay.

title: [Midnight Heron, Cargo Hold]
description: Darkness dominates this cavernous, empty space below deck.  Oversized hinges connect the floor to the back wall securing a massive stern door.  Sturdy, midnight blue oak planks across the expansive floor show signs of wear.  Faint scents of sulfur, sawdust, and spices linger in the open space.  A hatch leads to the deck above, while a portal leads deeper into the belly of the galleon.

title: [Midnight Heron, Main Hall]
description: Lanterns housing eldritch flames illuminate this coffee and spice scented hallway that connects various areas of the galleon below decks.  Heavy midnight carpeting and a large tapestry muffle any noise of passers-by.  Similarly carpeted, a stairwell with chrome handrails rises to the deckhouse above.  A reinforced door on one wall bears the crest of House Illistim.  A dark portal leads aft towards the cargo hold.

title: [Valley of Gold]
description: Large beds of blooming flowers surround a giant silk-covered structure.  The golden material shimmers in the bright sunlight as errant breezes move the cloth in gentle ripples.  Alternating crimson and sapphire pennants flutter high above, suspended on smooth oaken poles.

Large beds of blooming flowers surround a giant silk-covered structure.  The golden material shimmers in the pale moonlight as errant breezes move the cloth in gentle ripples.  Alternating crimson and sapphire pennants flutter high above, suspended on smooth oaken poles.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Celebration Pavilion, Gathering]
description: Swathes of rich crimson and blue silk cover the walls of the pavilion, their shimmering lengths accented with bits of gold.  Several cushioned sofas and chairs covered in matching brocade are scattered about the area.  Hanging from the peaked ceiling are a trio of clear crystal lanterns suspended from a series of vaalin chains.  Placed in the center of the gathering space is an alabaster marble firepit, a copper urn of sticks sitting to one side.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Cleared of vegetation and lined with rocks, the path meanders through the field.  Flowering bushes give a burst of color to area.  Bright crimson banners emblazoned with a golden sunburst fly from varnished oak poles.  Their dazzling colors shimmer in the brilliant sunlight.

Cleared of vegetation and lined with rocks, the path meanders through the field.  Flowering bushes give a burst of color to area.  Bright crimson banners emblazoned with a golden sunburst fly from varnished oak poles.  Their dazzling colors shimmer in the pale moonlight.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Home Improvement]
description: Strong maple poles support the ceiling and walls of this spacious tent.  Shimmering crimson silk hangs from the frame and falls to the ground in a puddle of soft fabric.  Several lanterns hang from the supports shedding a warm light over the room.  A large ebonwood sign sits on the corner of a thick gold rug covering the ground.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Stone urns filled with crimson blooms are scattered about the area.  Branches from the tall shade trees twist together to form a thick, verdant canopy above.  A beautifully carved stone bench rests beside one of the thick trunks.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Mountain Path]
description: Newly created, the wide trail leads downward, guided by bright lanterns lighting the way with a soft glow.  A cool mist flows about, disturbed by a strong mountain breeze.  Bits of sparse shrubbery grow from small fissures in the hard ground.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Mountain Path]
description: Rocks have been pushed to the side to widen the trail.  Several lanterns light the way, their pale light hazy in the mist.  Bits of scrub brush grow about the area, their pale leaves contrasting with the bleak terrain.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Mountain Path]
description: Splitting as they meander down into the valley, lanterns light the trail as it moves in two different directions.  Bits of scrub grass grows in thick tufts between rocks that line the way.  Poles with golden ribbons split the distance between each light, their silken material sparkling in the misty light.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Mountain Path]
description: Bits of moss and lichen cling to the rocks and boulders that line the trail.  A damp mist covers the area with a thin layer of wetness.  Several lanterns light the way, poles of golden ribbons spreading out between.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold]
description: The misty path suddenly breaks free of the pale veil that covered it and gives way to a bright, sunlit field.  Colorful tents and pavilions fill the valley, their brilliant colored pennons fluttering in the air, crimson and gold to the west and sapphire blue and alabaster to the east.  A larger structure dominates the center clearing to the north.

The misty path suddenly breaks free of the pale veil that covered it and gives way to a bright, moonlit field.  Colorful tents and pavilions fill the valley, their brilliant colored pennons fluttering in the air, crimson and gold to the west and sapphire blue and alabaster to the east.  A larger structure dominates the center clearing to the north.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Mountain Path]
description: Curving around several boulders, the trail disappears into the mist as it moves downward.  Bronze lanterns throw a pale light that guides the way through the haze.  A small stand of stunted birch trees twist together, the bark peeling off the trunks in rough layers.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold]
description: Surrounded by logs, a colorful stone fire pit dominates the clearing.   Each stone has been hand painted with a variety of colors and designs.  A pile of sticks has been neatly stacked nearby.  Large red oaks surround the area, their thick trunks casting shade across the glade.

Surrounded by logs, a colorful stone fire pit dominates the clearing.   Each stone has been hand painted with a variety of colors and designs.  A pile of sticks has been neatly stacked nearby.  Large red oaks surround the area, their thick trunks casting shadows across the glade.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Brilliant crimson banners embroidered with a golden sunburst fly high above, glittering in the sunlight.  Matching ribbons wind down their varnished oak poles, ending in a bouquet of red roses.  Tall shade trees dot the landscape, their thick branches shading the ground from the heat of the sun.

Brilliant crimson banners embroidered with a golden sunburst fly high above, glittering in the moonlight.  Matching ribbons wind down their varnished oak poles, ending in a bouquet of red roses.  Tall shade trees dot the landscape, the moonlight filters through their thick branches to illuminate the area below in a soft, pale light.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [What Ales You]
description: A small, dusty room, although this does not mean that it is cramped, as everything is in its place and not all bunched together.  Sitting along the far wall is a long red oak table and a striped yellow pine door leads back out.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Oasis]
description: Scattered with pale white sand, the footing beneath the airy silk tent is warmed by the sun overhead.  Textiles are piled high on long wooden tables, while crowded beneath are open trunks packed with various sundries.  Baskets brimming with wares hang from the tent poles above wire cages filled with small animals, and a brass hanging censer fills the air with a smoky, exotic aroma.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Centered in this part of the clearing, a large oak tree reaches up to the sky and spreads its branches over the bazaar, a ring of wooden benches surrounding the wide trunk.  Bright sunlight trickles down from above, dabbing the ground with spots of warmth.  Newly planted beds of rose bushes add brilliant crimson color to the area.

Centered in this part of the clearing, a large oak tree reaches up to the sky and spreads its branches over the bazaar, a ring of wooden benches surrounding the wide trunk.  Cool moonlight trickles down from above, dabbing the ground with spots of pale light.  Newly planted beds of rose bushes add brilliant crimson color to the area.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Fired Up, Front Room]
description: Paneled in oak, the lofty walls are lined with shelves displaying a variety of collectibles and earthenware.  A beeswax candle-laden corona of brass is suspended from a thick monir beam overhead, illuminating an enormous totem pole laying on its side down the length of the wagon.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Arndell's Weaponry]
description: Royal blue covers every wall, both in painted wood and in the metal shelves that line the west and east wall.  The black walnut floor has clearly been recently polished, reflecting the gold racks.  To the north, a black door stands emblazoned with a gold sun in the center.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Arndell's Weaponry, Backroom]
description: Prevalently covering the entire front wall is a tattered map.  The walls are painted in blue and bronze horizontal stripes as if pointing at the map.  In the opposite corner of the room lies a hammered bronze anvil large enough to hold a myriad of items.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Thick branches fan out from the various trees scattered about, shading the clearing from the hot sun above.  Bright sapphire blue banners embroidered with an alabaster peacock fly high above.  Twined ribbons in matching colors wrap about each varnished pole ending in a bouquet of pure white roses.

Thick branches fan out from the various trees scattered about, allowing motes of pale moonlight to filter through.  Bright sapphire blue banners embroidered with an alabaster peacock fly high above.  Twined ribbons in matching colors wrap about each varnished pole ending in a bouquet of pure white roses.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Wine A Little, Laugh A Little]
description: Row upon row of clear crystal glasses varying in shape and size line the wall behind a long cherrywood bar, which is attended by a well-dressed elven wine attendant.  To one side of the bar is a scrollworked, dark wine rack which displays the vintages available.  Some soft colorful cushions provide a place to rest, enjoy the wines, and discuss their qualities.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold]
description: Twin staircases lead up to a large golden pavilion set high upon a dais.  The brilliant silk of the structure glimmers in the bright sunlight, its sides rolled up to give a view from all directions.  Ceramic urns of crimson blossoms and pure white roses fill the gathering space with their bright colors and heavy fragrance.  Sapphire blue and crimson pennants fly high above the building, capping the peaks of the roof.

Twin staircases lead up to a large golden pavilion set high upon a dais.  The brilliant silk of the structure glimmers in the bright moonlight, its sides rolled up to give a view from all directions.  Ceramic urns of crimson blossoms and pure white roses fill the gathering space with their bright colors and heavy fragrance.  Sapphire blue and crimson fly high above the building, capping the peaks of the roof.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Imperial Glade]
description: Flowering brushes and various greenery surround the giant oak trees that enclose the clearing.  Some carved wooden benches are arranged about the area, their surfaces carved with a variety of woodland creatures.  Bright ribbons crisscross back and forth from tree to tree, creating a canopy in bright hues.  Colorful crystal lanterns hang from the silken ceiling, throwing vibrant shades across the glade.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Flowering brush and shrubbery mark the path that leads throughout the bazaar.  Sunlight trickles down from above, filtering through thick treetops above.  Alabaster and sapphire blue ribbons are draped over the foliage decorating the clearing with their shimmering colors.

Flowering brush and shrubbery mark the path that leads throughout the bazaar.  Pale moonlight trickles down from above, filtering through thick treetops above.  Alabaster and sapphire blue ribbons are draped over the foliage decorating the clearing with their shimmering colors.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Scattered about the clearing are colorfully painted urns filled with bright blossoms.  Several carved stone benches are nestled into small alcoves created by the thick greenery that encircles the area.  Hanging from one of the tree branches high above are a series of windchimes crafted from lengths of copper.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Cultural Couture, Ladies]
description: A silver-gilded chandelier hangs high above the grey brocade walls, the soft light illuminating the ivory-colored patterns upon the armoire and mirror along the back wall.  Insignias of blown glass sit suspended upon the arms of the chandelier, each one inset with tonal jewels.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Lorsan's Weaponry]
description: The walls are draped with peacock blue curtains pooling onto the floor.  The black ceiling is dotted with silver paint that sparkles above, giving the illusion of the night sky.  Carved ivory columns stand in the corners of the room, lined with ivory shelves between them.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Lorsan's Weaponry, Backroom]
description: Lining the side walls are ivory statues of elven figures, each firmly placed onto the floor lined with gold rugs.  The walls behind the ivory statues are painted white, except for the wall opposite of the door, which is a deep crimson.  In the corner of the room is a hammered gold anvil large enough to hold a myriad of items.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Valley of Gold, Bazaar]
description: Brilliant alabaster and sapphire blue pennants flutter from atop several varnished oak poles.  Cleared of vegetation, the soft sandy path meanders throughout the bazaar.  Basins of blooming flowers adorn the clearing, filling the air with beautiful fragrance.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [There's No Place Like Home]
description: Panels of deep sapphire blue silk fall in soft folds across each oak-framed wall.  A pair of lanterns suspended from faenor chains illuminates the spacious interior.  Blanketing the floor is a soft alabaster woolen carpet woven with a sapphire rose pattern.  A small mistwood sign hangs from a central support.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [The Tailored Imperial, Entrance]
description: Polished monir floors are stained a light, golden hue to complement the painted dark blue walls of the wagon's entranceway.  To one side of the door, a wooden rack is crowded with outerwear, and on the other, a multitude of footwear is arranged beneath a padded bench.  An elaborately rendered map of the Empire is framed in gilt and hung above the bench.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [New Beginnings]
description: Haphazard piles of assorted armor and weaponry lay scattered around the edges of the large canvas tent.  Thick modwir poles hold the awning aloft, and a thin mithril beam runs the length of the structure, strung with lanterns.  A banner depicting a boar's head is hung on the rear wall.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [The Primrose Pavilion]
description: Draping layers of finespun gold silk linen compose the airy canopy of the tall-peaked pavilion.  Several illuminated bronze lanterns are suspended over a wide-curved dark oaken bench that spans across the back of the room, giving off steady, gilded light throughout the space.  The crisp scent of bergamot drifts lightly upon the air, adding a comforting warmth to the cordial ambiance.

title: [Valley of Gold, Elven Clearing]
description: Brightly hued ribbons wind up and down the massive oak tree trunks that encircle the clearing.  Some carved wooden benches are arranged about the area, their surfaces carved with a variety of blooming flowers.  Colorful crystal lanterns hang from varnished poles wrapped with vibrant silk.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Cultural Couture, Gentlemen]
description: Carved shields of lacquered wood are draped against the grey brocade walls of the room, each one framed in gilded filigree.  Set against the furthest panel are a dresser with an accompanying ebonwood mirror, each one inset with a mosaic of stained glass.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Home Improvement]
description: Strong maple poles covered with rich crimson silk form the walls of this spacious tent.  A small ebonwood sign hangs from one of the varnished supports.  A thick deep red carpet covers the ground, a golden sunburst pattern in the center.  A pair of lanterns hang from above, bathing the area in halo of bright light.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [The Tailored Imperial, Showroom]
description: A pair of glass-eyed mannequins stare across the room into a gilt-framed mirror hung on a deep blue silk-covered wall.  At the far end of the wagon, ceiling mounted racks create a colorful exhibit of garments, while fine jewelry is showcased beneath the glass of a gold-framed display case.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [The Tailored Imperial, Workroom]
description: Concealed behind a painted silk screen, a long workbench and padded dressform take up most of the partitioned area.  Sketches and fabric samples are tacked on the wall above wicker bins filled with textiles, hides, and trims.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Fired Up, Back Room]
description: An old woodstove takes up most of one corner, a pair of distressed leather chairs and a multicolored wool rug arranged in front.  Small clay figurines are crowded on a windowsill across from a curtained opening.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Fired Up, Potter's Corner]
description: A clay-spattered stool sits in front of a potter's wheel, an earthware jug filled with water and a bin of discarded, misshapen clay pieces to one side.  A workbench lined with sculpted pieces ready for firing sits beneath a small, round window covered with a tattered canvas tarp.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Oasis, Storage]
description: Behind haphazardly constructed wooden shelves laden with pottery, woven baskets and open crates cover much of the hard-packed sand floor.  Flowers and herbs are hung on drying racks overhead, and bundles of rare hides are neatly arranged on a low table beside a tent flap.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Oasis, Desert Garden]
description: Vibrant silks draped on symbol-carved, wooden poles create an expansive awning behind an airy gold tent.  Desert plants flower in large, beaten copper pots amid piles of brightly colored pillows and soft, goatskin rugs.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Midnight Heron, Main Deck]
description: Towering overhead, a massive mainmast supports wide white sails secured with white ropes and rigging against the backdrop of the sky beyond.  Midnight blue oak construction accompanied by chrome hardware embellishes the wide main deck of this galleon of the skies.  Presiding over the area is a stout deckhouse with a flat roof.

title: [Midnight Heron, Argent Cabin]
description: The only light in this room enters through the open door from the hallway outside, casting long shadows through the still, stale air.  The outline of a high-backed, stately throne sits in silence before an empty audience, against the backdrop of multiple banners along the wall that unfurl to the floor, and bear the standards of the Sapphire Guard.  Despite the preserved nature of the room's contents, no dust rests on any visible surface.

title: [Midnight Heron, Deckhouse]
description: Eldritch light from wall-mounted lanterns illuminates this cabin enclosed by thick dark blue velvet curtains that cover all possible sources of light from outside.  The walls are lined with bookcases filled with all manner of leather-bound volumes.  Covered with charts and maps, a large table surrounded by some cushioned chairs fills the center of the room.  Leading into the belly of the galleon is a darkened stairwell.

title: [Midnight Heron, Observation]
description: Plush midnight blue velvet encloses this comfortable observation gallery filled with some cushioned chairs facing a sizable viewing window.  The tiered floor steps upwards from the window allowing each row of seats an unobstructed view of the landscape outside.  Covering the opposite wall is a wide midnight and silver threaded tapestry.  Ascending to the deck above is a chrome-railed spiral staircase.

title: [Midnight Heron, Foredeck]
description: Square white sails fly high overhead along the thick mast at the center of this foredeck constructed of midnight blue oak with chrome finished hardware.  Taut white ropes secure the rigging above to chrome cleats, their loose ends laid into neat, flat spirals on the spotless deck.  Poised at the tip of the bow is a detailed figurehead depicting a young elven man with one hand outstretched towards the horizon.  Polished chrome handrails accompany a spiral staircase below.

title: [There's No Place Like Home]
description: Polished oak supports carved with a rose and vine pattern peak the tent ceiling in two places.  Lanterns hang from each slender pillar shedding a pale light over the room.  Brightly colored rugs line the floor creating a mosaic in a wide array of blues.  Standing in one corner of the space is a a large mistwood sign.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [A Touch of Class, Workroom]
description: The vivid colors scattered across the white vellum walls of the room are in stark contrast to the cooler tones of the previous.  A lattice-like blackthorn rack is diagonally fastened to the back wall alongside a pair of cupped blown glass hands, each filled with a variety of fabrics and dyes.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [A Touch of Class, Main Room]
description: The muted blue-violet vellum walls of the shop have been covered in shaded strokes of charcoal, creating a rendering of an unknown elven cityscape at twilight.  Standing alone at the center of the room is a ceiling-high stack of gilt-inset glass trays, each softly glowing from the illuminated chandelier hanging low like the late day sun.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Celebration Pavilion, Gathering]
description: Swathes of rich crimson and blue silk cover the walls of the pavilion, their shimmering lengths accented with bits of gold.  Several cushioned sofas and chairs covered in matching brocade are scattered about the area.  Hanging from the peaked ceiling are a trio of clear crystal lanterns suspended from a series of vaalin chains.  Placed in the center of the gathering space is an alabaster marble firepit, a copper urn of sticks sitting to one side.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Celebration Pavilion, Banquet]
description: Dominating the room are a pair of huge tables, one draped with sapphire blue and the other with crimson silk.  Their crystal-balled feet are cushioned by a white and gold patterned carpet.  Matching chairs surround the large pieces, the seats padded with rich golden velvet.  A large buffet stands off to one side, its cloth-covered surface piled high with rich dishes and drink.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Celebration Pavilion, Ball Room]
description: Panels of lacquered maple are fitted together in the center of the room, creating a large dance floor.  The placement of the wood tiles in various directions makes unique patterns and enhances the natural grain.  Banners of crimson and blue hang from the supports above.  Silver stands filled with candles encircle the space, their bright light casting shadows across the silk walls.  A variety of silk-cushioned chairs are placed about a thick carpet that surrounds the central area.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Unearthed Antiquities, Human]
description: The canvas ceiling is high overhead, and a series of bright banners descend down in gentle arcs, tying in at the top of each of the tent's walls.  A series of ornamental displays line the walls, and directly in the center of this area is a badly-damaged suit of armor set upon a pedestal, with a simple brass plaque at its feet.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Unearthed Antiquities, Human]
description: The walls of the pavilion bow outwards in this space, forming a spherical area with a sunken floor that is lined with sand.  In the center of the space, two figures are depicted back to back, their features stylistically muddled.  Each stands poised to fight, but vivid coloring implies grave wounds for the pair of them.  The canvas walls around the space are painted with vivid depictions of what can only be a demonic horde.  Directly in front of the two figures is a bright brass plaque.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Unearthed Antiquities, Human]
description: This portion of the enclosure is wide, though not particularly deep.  The back half of the space is covered in a rough sand and dirt mixture, and a variety of different sedimentary rocks are interspersed throughout it.  Here are there, however, exhibits are visible, each seamlessly integrated into the scenery.  A brass plaque is stationed directly in front of the exhibits.
location: between Wehnimer's Landing and Zul Logoth

title: [Solhaven Citizens' Tent]
description: Thick, lush rugs of Vornavian silk cover the ground, providing a firm yet comfortable footing.  A long linden table lines one wall of the tent, its top covered with refreshments.  The opposite side of the tent is covered by a large leather couch, while a pile of soft velvet cushions covers the corner in-between.

title: [Sylvanfair, Vestibule]
description: Square in shape, the vestibule is bathed in a shaft of muted gold sunlight streaming through the open top section of the front door.  A richly carved staircase rises from the terracotta-tiled floor, cantilevered against the four walls to provide a perfect viewing platform for the irregularly shaped table that dominates the center of the room.  Mismatched cabinets and battered trunks fill the asymmetrical spaces beneath the stairway, crammed with assorted timekeeping devices and navigational instruments.

title: [Sylvanfair, Loft]
description: Built into the sloping roof space, the galleried loft is naturally illuminated by open-shuttered windows set between narrow oak rafters.  Each pane offers an unimpeded view of the freeport and beyond with the use of an imflass telescope.  Brick walls on either side are filled with astral maps and cluttered shelves.  Clear of furniture, a deep blue woolen rug covering the floor provides a suitable blank canvas for four metal lanterns suspended overhead.

title: [Sylvanfair, Library]
description: Hundreds of books and scrolls fill the shelves that line the walls.  While some are stacked neatly, arranged with nearly obsessive precision, others are in utter disarray.  Several leather armchairs congregate around a low brick-arched fireplace over which hangs an odd assortment of pictures.  An antique crimson wool rug covers most of the slightly uneven floor, concealing the copper riven slate tiles beneath.  The room is lit by a single brass lantern suspended from a dark oak rafter overhead.

title: [Sylvanfair, Snug]
description: More of a store cupboard than a functional room, the snug alcove is filled with all manner of hunting trophies.  Mounted animal heads loom over distressed leather armchairs and dusty lepidoptera display cases.  The sidetables are cluttered with glass-domed stuffed birds and stacks of tattered leather books.  A beeswax candle casts a meager light over an antique counter in the corner on which sits a locker and a slate blackboard.

title: [Sylvanfair, Undercroft]
description: Located beneath street level, the cool ambient temperature of the cavern is perfect for the storage of wine.  The space is dimly lit by a series of indigo-glazed brass lanterns hanging from the low-vaulted ceiling.  Silvery blue light illuminates a series of wine racks lining the bare stone walls and a stack of pale linden crates.  The air is filled with the musty odor of dust and hint of acrid smoke.

title: [Annex, House Sylvanfair Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A black velvet pennant edged with silver hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [Town Barracks, Entryway]
description: The stone floor of the barracks entrance expands out in all directions, its smooth surface marred by numerous boot scuffs.  To the east, through an open archway, the glimmer of metal armor and weapons can be seen, while the clatter and chatter of the dining hall echoes in from the south.  A wide wooden stairwell dominates the western wall, rising up to reach the second floor.

title: [Town Barracks, Second Floor]
description: A wide wooden stairwell begins at the end of the second floor hall, an open banister overlooking the entranceway below.  To the south, a bookcase can be glimpsed through an archway, which stands opposite of a plain wooden door.  A narrow window provides an angled view of the city streets beyond.

title: [Town Barracks, Archery Field]
description: At the far end of the courtyard lies the archery range, where dozens of well-worn targets have been set into a section of the stone wall.  Near the practice area are a number of racks containing various bows and crossbows, and a small table holding a plethora of arrows and bolts.  Casting a long shadow across part of the area is a huge stone tower.

title: [Town Barracks, Ballista Tower]
description: From all four windows of the tower, the landscape of Wehnimer's Landing and its environs swell into view.  The palisade walls of the town, the rooftops of shops and homes, and the activity of townspeople moving about can all be seen from the tower's vantage points.  Down below, uniformed militiamen practice at the archery range, riddling the stationary targets with arrows.

title: [Town Barracks, Strategy Room]
description: Along the western wall stretches a wood-framed canvas map, its details and colors painstakingly illustrated.  Mounted above a thick oak door is a stuffed bluish-grey krolvin head, its mouth eternally pried open in a silent bark.  A wide slate-topped table rests perfectly center in the room, wooden chairs positioned around its edges.  A small shelf hangs in a corner, containing a pile of chalk and some map markers.

title: [Town Barracks, Training Grounds]
description: The cobblestones here are worn and faded from countless hours of training and weathered by the elements.  Wooden racks and tables clutter a corner of the grounds, providing a wide assortment of training weapons and armor.  Uniformed militiamen carry out practice drills nearby.  A thick oak door leads into a two-story brick building, and on the other end of the square resides a small grey sandstone edifice.

title: [Barracks, Command Center]
[Barracks, Captains Quarters]
description: A wide maoral-paneled window provides a sprawling view of the training grounds and courtyard beyond, the light of the moon bleeding through the glass to create a faint haze throughout the office.  A pronged wooden rack decorated with militia jackets and swordbelts rests in one corner, while a polished bar sits along the adjacent wall.  A few wooden desks and some warcat hide upholstered chairs have been positioned in the center of the room.

title: [Town Barracks, Armory]
description: Sturdy oak racks decorate an entire wall of the armory, their pegs holding an assortment of padded leather and suits of armor.  Long wooden tables and crates provide storage and convenience for piles of sharpened blades, spears, and arrows.  A series of featureless mannequins are propped up in a corner, one of them garbed in a brass-riveted tabard and an etched militia badge.

title: [Town Barracks, Dining Hall]
description: Two round oak tables dominate the center of the room, with wooden chairs and stools encircling each one.  Tin plates and utensils occupy a few spots along the tables, and uniformed militiamen move freely about, their chatter creating an interminable din of voices in the area.  Young orphan children dutifully carry bowls and cups back and forth between the hall and the kitchen just to the west, where the palpable scent of roasted boar originates from.

title: [Town Barracks, Kitchen]
description: The kitchen is aglow in a haze of orange light as the fires from the two large stoves in the back burn bright, their flames slow roasting the boars and quail turning on their spits.  A trio of curly-haired halflings shuffles back and forth between the cooking fires and some low countertops, feverishly preparing the next meal.  Above a stout wooden table, a long oak cabinet holds a range of bottles, cups and other refreshments.

title: [Town Barracks, Reading Alcove]
description: Decorated with little fanfare, this small room holds two round wooden tables and a handful of carved oak chairs.  A wide bookcase is guarded on both sides by two stuffed otter statues, and a few steel-incased lanterns for ample light when needed.  A large, tawny brindlecat hide rug is sprawled across the floor.

title: [Barracks, Sleeping Quarters]
description: Stout oak cabinets and shelves run a border around the chamber, many of them cluttered with boots, uniforms, small weapons, and linens.  Modest cots are setup in rows throughout the center of the room, some neatly tended and clean, others a disheveled mess, or occupied by a slumbering member of the militia.

title: [Town Barracks, Storage Hall]
description: The chamber narrows significantly, cluttered by rows and rows of unopened crates, barrels, and chests, each one labeled as food, ale, or supplies.  A low wooden shelf juts out from a far wall, its surface packed with folded clothing items, from tabards, to gloves, to boots and hats.  A few wooden tables have been stacked up in a corner, along with a number of unused cots.

title: [Earth Tower, Ground Floor]
description: Glazed mud-colored clay tiles lay themselves out in a diamond pattern across the circular tower floor.  Cushions sprout like mushrooms around the sawed-off tree trunk that serves as a low table in the center of the chamber, while wooden steps are bolted to the wall, leading to upper levels.

title: [Poet's Corner Table]
description: Well used and worn, this table has seen better days.  Bad poetry has been carved into the wood at various angles and places.  A small frosted globe housing a lit candle rests upon the long wooden table and lets off a warm glow.

title: [Minstrel's Retreat Table]
description: Long slabs of rich mahogany create this secluded table.  Tiny instruments have been carved into the top, an elaborate harp in the center.  A small wreath of flowers surrounds a slender candle that casts a tiny shadow over the area.

title: [Jester's Niche Table]
description: Inlaid with dark mahogany, the pale golden table has been varnished and polished to a gleaming shine.  Carved in the center is a jester balancing on one leg.  A tiny statue juggling five balls stands in the center, his head holding a thin candle.

title: [Troubadour's Hollow Table]
description: Surrounded by cushioned chairs, the top of the table is a mosaic of sea glass.  The colorful chips create a swirling circular pattern fanning out from the center.  A short fat candle stands as the centerpiece of the colorful artwork.

title: [Skald's Nook Table]
description: Fur-lined chairs encircle a crudely made table that is crafted of roughly hewn wood.  Nicks and gauges are chipped out of the table, and some past patron has left a deer-footed knife deeply imbedded into the unpolished surface.  A narrow, white pillar candle is crammed into the base of a flute, its flicking light reflecting off of the instrument's key pads, and provides a warm illumination for the area.

title: [Talador, The Bleaklands]
description: The land is desolate and broken, with an endless terrain of fragmented, grey earth that is caked in layers of ash.  The air is suffocating, with a thick, rancid odor and a faint heat still lingers in the area.  The sky is bleak, resembling an expanse of ink-whorled slate.

title: [Talador, The Bleaklands]
description: The great northern mountains rise up like a wall of jagged, icy fingers in the distance.  Their peaks are obscured by heavy black clouds, and the once fresh mountain air has been replaced by the stagnant, putrid odor of burnt flesh and scorched earth.

title: [Talador, The Bleaklands]
description: Rows and rows of crumbled, charred stones are strewn about the broken landscape where the towering walls of Talador once stood.  Even the wind is hot, swirling around and scattering ash and smoldering debris all about.

title: [Under the Moat]
description: Here the flying dust starts to give way to a damp and possibly even narrower space.  Tiny rivulets of brownish water ocassionally trickle in and puddle at the already muddy ground.  It is uncertain how much longer this dilapidated tunnel will hold before it collapses.

title: [Under the Moat]
description: The air within the musty tunnel is heavy, taxing your lungs even further.  Darkness fills the available space, making it impossible to continue in any direction without first palpating the surrounding wall surfaces.  The terrain, although still damp, appears to be heading upward.

title: [Under the Walls]
description: Dry dust floats about once again, the thick particles clinging to clothing, hair, and throat.  The tunnel has widened slightly, making it easier to push forward.  Darkness reigns still, but a lighter patch of space beckons from just a few more feet ahead.

title: [Wyvern Keep, Public Locker]
description: A lone candle in a brass candleholder, set on the walnut-paneled wall, softly illuminates this small room.  The thick, red woolen carpet underfoot effectively muffles the sound to provide a quiet place for contemplating the contents of one's locker.

title: [City Stables, Stalls]
description: Soft whinnying, snorting, and the stamping of hooves resounds throughout the stables.  Stablehands are constantly on the move, fetching fresh horses for the traveling merchants, messengers, or guards who board their steeds here.  The stalls are clean and well-tended, and the horses seem content with their lots in life here in the Landing.

title: [Guardian Keep, Chamber]
description: Its entrance jealously guarded by a small, unadorned door of blond wood, the cozy audience chamber's ceiling is obscured by drapes of carmine velvet that form an inverted dome over a a gold-bordered circular linden table.  Standing at the center of the room, the table is ringed by six oaken chairs.  A golden marble fireplace with two plush seats before it dominates the breadth of the southern wall, fed by sticks held by an adorned brass basket.

title: [House Sovyn Annex]
description: The floor, made of unglazed octagonal tiles, is partly covered with a thick carpet.  A window, screened with intricately carved wood, is set high on the wall.  Set beneath the window is a heavy terra cotta urn containing a flowering plant.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Planar Nexus]
description: The air bends and shimmers here, odd sounds popping and humming in the distance.  The cavern is huge, surrounded by smooth polished rock walls that constantly shift between shades of light and dark.  Descending from the tunnel above, rays of bright moonlight shine down, bathing the entire earthen floor in a pool of silver light.

title: [Hale Hall, Meeting Room]
description: A rectangular table stands in the center of this utilitarian room, with a number of wooden chairs along each of its longer sides.  Around the perimeter of the room are a series of padded benches, clearly meant for observers who are not participating directly.  Torches interspersed along the walls keep the space well lit, and also contribute a slightly smoky scent to the air due to the lack of ventilation.

title: [Lantern Table]
description: Centered on the table is a small lantern made from polished brass with glass windows.  Its flickering flame casts an unsteady glow across the table.  Small bits of pine tree branches ring the lantern's base.

title: [Circling Dragon Table]
description: Centered on the white table cloth are six small pewter dragon figurines circling a pair of candles.  Each figurine depicts the dragons with their wings banked as if turning in flight around the flames.  The candles give a red tint to the miniatures.

title: [Sleeping Dragon Table]
description: Pewter figurines of sleeping dragons ring a single candle in the middle of the table.  Each dragon is clutching a small colored crystal between two sets of claws.  A gold table cloth covers the wood, creating a stark contrast between the figures and the table.

title: [Rampant Dragon Table]
description: A statue of a rampant dragon resides in the center of the table.  It holds a blue ball that reflects light like a mirror.  A small candle burns in the winged beast's mouth.

title: [Watchful Dragon Table]
description: A statue of a slumbering dragon resides in the center of the table, its tail curled around a slender oil lamp that casts a pool of soft light over the recumbent beast's treasure.  The smell of freshly baked breads and the low murmur of conversations from surrounding tables are the only intrusions on your privacy.

title: [Green Marble Table]
description: The square marble table's top matches perfectly with the marble in the fifth tier of the huge fountain that looms to the southwest.  Thin golden strands course through the green marble, causing the surface to sparkle in the light.  The table's top has been buffed to a fine sheen, and the edges and supports are exactly chiseled.  An umbrella with a grey-and-green awning spreads out over the table in an attempt to shade the occupants from the sun.  A freestanding torch occupies a place near the table.

title: [Blue Marble Table]
description: The square marble table's top matches perfectly with the marble in the fourth tier of the huge fountain that looms to the north.  Thin silver strands course through the blue marble, causing the surface to sparkle in the light.  The table's top has been buffed to a fine sheen, and the edges and supports are exactly chiseled.  An umbrella with a grey-and-blue awning spreads out over the table in an attempt to shade the occupants from the sun.  A freestanding torch occupies a place near the table.

title: [Red Marble Table]
description: The square marble table's top matches perfectly with the marble in the third tier of the huge fountain that looms to the south.  Thin white strands course through the red marble, causing the surface to sparkle in the light.  The table's top has been buffed to a fine sheen, and the edges and supports are exactly chiseled.  An umbrella with a grey-and-red awning spreads out over the table in an attempt to shade the occupants from the sun.  A freestanding torch occupies a place near the table.

title: [Helgreth's Tavern, Parlor]
description: Memorabilia from successful military campaigns line the mahogany wainscoted walls, these mementos of glorious past victories routinely polished to keep them in perfect condition.  The deep, rich earthy tones of the parlor are highlighted by amber glaesine spheres housed within the brass wall sconces.  Fragrant cigar smoke lingers lightly in the air as soldiers relax and unwind, socializing amongst themselves at many of the tables available.

title: [Hammer Table]
description: In outstanding condition for its age, a gold-edged white ora hammer has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of a gold-traced glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Voulge Table]
description: In remarkable condition for its age, a long ebonwood-hafted voulge has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of a brass-studded glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Trident Table]
description: In wonderful condition for its age, a slender imflass-spiked trident has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of an aureate glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Longbow Table]
description: In extremely good condition for its age, a hand-carved golden ruic longbow has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of a smoky glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Hook-knife Table]
description: In impressive condition for its age, a silk-wrapped scarlet vultite hook-knife has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.
