title: [Broadsword Table]
description: In superior condition for its age, a burnished eahnor broadsword has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of a smooth glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Mace Table]
description: In fine condition for its age, a gilded faenor-spiked mace has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of a silvered glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Lance Table]
description: In near perfect condition, an engraved vaalorn lance has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of a jewel-toned glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Flamberge Table]
description: In immaculate condition, an ornate vaalorn flamberge has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of a honey-hued glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Crossbow Table]
description: In excellent condition for its age, a wyvern-etched glowbark crossbow has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of a prismatic glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Katar Table]
description: In splendid condition for its age, a polished mithglin katar has been mounted high upon the adjacent, deep crimson wall.  A golden beeswax candle emanates a warm glow from within the confines of an amber glaesine sphere set at the center of the cherrywood table.

title: [Candle Table]
description: A small iron stand on the table holds a rectangular block candle.  Seven wicks are spaced evenly along the top surface.  Each wick fuels a small flame, glowing a warm shade of orange.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Cellar]
description: This small room is utilitarian in design, clearly prizing function over form.  There are three very small windows, near the ceiling of the recessed space, and each is covered with iron bars.  The reinforced door has an iron plate covering most of its surface.  The one concession to comfort appears to be some comfortable chairs interspersed around the room.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Supplies]
description: The dark linenfold panelling that covers the walls gives the room a warm and intimate feel despite the staggeringly high ceiling.  A circular rosewood counter sits in the very center atop a silk rug in earthy, muted tones.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Grand Gallery]
description: The high vaulted ceiling, with its inset panes of thick tinted glass, allows muted sunlight to stream into the room far below.  The floor is made of polished black granite with a wide red carpet stretching down the center of the entire room.  Gold sconces are mounted on the massive marble support columns.  Grand paintings and portraits, in keeping with the scale of the room, hang on the walls.  Twin flights of stairs rise to the east and west of a large equestrian portrait at the far end of the room.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, West Hallway]
description: A large mural is painted on one wall.  The marble stairway meets a deep red carpeted hallway, its length punctuated with gold sconces.  A carved fel door with a gold knob is set into the west wall.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Red Room]
description: Several crimson leather club chairs are grouped around the room with small tables placed nearby.  A framed mirror hangs on the wall opposite a carved fel door.  The floor is covered with a dark red textured rug, and bookcases reach half way up the walls.  A pale rose-colored enamelled stove stands in the corner.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, East Hallway]
description: A short flight of marble stairs ends in a long, wide hallway.  Painted on one wall is a large floor-to-ceiling mural.  The floor has been covered with thick gold carpet and a display counter runs the length of the entire corridor.  Mounted to either side of a door made from seasoned haon are elegant silver sconces.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Green Room]
description: Several brown leather club chairs are grouped around the room with small tables placed nearby.  A framed mirror hangs on the wall opposite a solid haon door.  The floor is covered with a dark green textured rug, and bookcases reach half way up the walls.  An emerald green enamelled stove stands in the corner.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Kitchen]
description: This kitchen is so immaculate it is difficult to believe any real food preparation goes on here at all.  An ancient oak table sits under an arched window and a long shelf stretches across one entire wall.  A bundle of daffodils in a blue glass vase completes the elegant picture.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Conservatory]
description: In this inner sanctum, an arched ceiling of wooden beams and clear panes of glass allows the natural sunlight to be filtered down to the wooden boxes filled with flowers and herbs at the edges of a carefully maintained lawn.  Three bronze statues - one light, one dark, and one taller than the others - stand on granite pedestals placed around the room.  Stone tables and benches are placed amongst urns filled with tall, leafy plants and shrubs.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, West Hallway]
description: A large mural has been painted on one wall, and deep red carpet continues down the corridor to the far corner at the end.  A serving table has been set up against the other wall, within easy reach of all who pass by.  To the west is a polished maoral door with a brass doorknob.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Blue Room]
description: Several blue leather club chairs are grouped around the room with small tables placed nearby.  A framed mirror hangs on the wall opposite a polished maoral door.  The floor is covered with a royal blue textured rug, and bookcases reach half way up the walls.  A light blue enamelled stove stands in the corner.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, East Hallway]
description: Painted along the entire length of one wall is a large mural.  Covering the floor is a deep gold carpet that continues along the hallway to the far corner.  Against the far wall is a long ebonwood bar with a silver candelabra on it.  A golden oak door with a bronze knob is set into the eastern wall.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Yellow Room]
description: Several brown leather club chairs are grouped around the room with small tables placed nearby.  A framed mirror hangs on the wall opposite a solid oak door.  The floor is covered with a dark yellow textured rug, and bookcases reach half way up the walls.  A pale yellow enamelled stove stands in the corner.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Courtyard]
description: A sweeping curve of tall linden trees enclose the expansive estate of a pale sandstone manor house and provide shade over its immaculate lawns and gardens.  Bordered on one side by evergreen boxwoods and several grey granite benches, a wide gravel pathway wends its way around alabaster statuary and a shallow reflecting pool, leading all the way to the semi-circular portico of the residence.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Mirrored Hall]
description: Ornate gilt-framed mirrors line the ivory walls, reflecting back the neat arrangement of velvet-covered chairs and glass-topped tables around the room.  A mosaic of gold and silver moonstone tiles subtly outline a walkway in the center of the roseate marble floor, leading to the foot of a sweeping staircase.  Crystal candelabra cast a soft glow and each, by means of clever positioning, illuminates a discrete seating section.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Landing]
description: A thick mulberry carpet runner traverses the full length of the landing, connecting the west wing to the east.  The roseate tones in the marble-tiled steps of the staircase extend to the surrounding walls and blush velvet curtains framing the tall windows at each end.  Facing a solid linden door, a trio of oil-on-canvas portraits hangs above a cherrywood sideboard on which sits a slender glass vase filled with cream roses in full bloom.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Classroom]
description: Tall mullioned windows offer the perfect view of the courtyard and well-tended lawns surrounding the west wing of the house.  Swathes of mulberry velvet frame each window, the drapes pulled back and held in place by ropes of pearls.  Neatly arranged rows of silk-cushioned chairs face an arboreal linden wood lectern, with a large blackboard on the wall behind and a pair of dress forms in the nearby corner.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Studio]
description: Dove grey-colored walls provide a neutral backdrop for racks of clothes, all neatly organized by color and style.  Several linden workstations are spaced out on the floor, the silver veining in the cream marble tiles accentuating the cool tones of the other fixtures and fittings.  Hung on either side of the archway are a series of concept boards, each filled with a composition of ink sketches and fabric samples.  A pair of glass doors offer an inviting glimpse of a moonlit orangery beyond.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Orangery]
description: The glass doors open out into an expansive, green oak timber-framed space that runs the full length of the house.  Panes of glass make up the walls and vaulted ceiling, granting views of the low-walled rosarium beyond and allowing moonlight to flood the room.  Cup-shaped blooms encircling the area match the yellow and cream rose-printed cushions atop the wrought metal chairs, the seating paired around small mirror-topped tables and strategically placed potted mulberry trees.

title: [Black Void, Garden]
description: Bathed in shadows, an unusual garden encircled by seven trees spreads across this side of the long rectangular platform surrounded by darkness.  The northern area of the platform is sectioned off, demarcated by a tall wall of woven roots that protrude up from the distinctively dark soil.  Clogging the air with its intensity, the stench of cruor and decomposition gleefully cavorts around weaker nectarous notes.  Descending down to ground-level is a stairway of small boulders, with a gate situated midway down.

title: [Black Void, Orchard]
description: Sequestered from the main garden, the orchard accommodates four black trees, a dead white tree and a rotted dead white tree split down the middle far from the platform edge and a tall wall of woven roots.  To the left of the nearly mature trees and in front of four rows of stakes, small black saplings splay out of the soil at peculiarly bent angles.  The handful of tiny wispy white strands of light floating over the other side of the platform seem to avoid wandering anywhere near the orchard, effectively couching it in a perpetual crepuscule.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Quiet Garden]
description: The curved pathway of granite stepping stones wends its way through a natural archway of green bamboo towards an open space of powdery grey gravel.  Bordered by verdant mossy beds of ornamental japonica blossoms and weeping acers, the tranquil garden features a composed arrangement of glittering mica rocks around a cascading water fountain, close to which sits a large rattan floor mat.  The faint scent of jasmine and the gentle, smooth tone of bamboo wind chimes fills the air.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: Windowless walls rise high overhead before curving inward to form a complex ogive vault.  Hanging from the central boss from a long, vaalorn chain is a single crystal sphere, glowing brightly.  Centered below is a circular crystalline plinth, large enough to serve as an altar, but completely smooth and unmarked.  To one side, a shimmering portal stands at an odd angle.

title: [Wizard Guild, Balcony]
description: Poised high above the city of Ta'Vaalor, this narrow balcony offers sweeping vistas northward up the Mistydeep River.  The fortress at Ravelin is clearly visible, the standard of Ta'Vaalor whipping in the breezes from its topmost point.  At the northern horizon, a faint mistiness marks the location of the Lake of Fear.  A narrow stone staircase spirals up the side of the tower to its top.

title: [Wizard Guild, Observatory]
description: A narrow stone staircase winds its way up the side of the tower into this small, domed observatory.  The room is dominated by a vaalorn and coraesine telescope poised at the center, its polished fittings gleaming brightly in the sunlight coming through a slit overhead.  To one side, a large wooden crank is connected to some complicated rope-and-pully contraption.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Workshop]
description: In this amply sized workroom are mingled the chill of stone and the faint but acrid odors of sulfurous potions.  The unadorned walls transition smoothly into a perfect dome, pierced by a large crystalline skylight.  Directly beneath the skylight stands a pale grey marble workbench, on which rests an array of instruments and artifacts needed by an alchemist.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Workshop]

The unadorned walls transition smoothly into a perfect dome, pierced by a large crystalline skylight.  Directly beneath the skylight stands a black basalt workbench, on which rests an array of instruments and artifacts needed by an alchemist.

title: [Raspberry Room]
description: A soft, thick snowcat fur is hung over the fireplace.  Carved smoky topaz gems form the eyes of the snowcat, glittering with the light from the fire.  Leather sling chairs are grouped casually around small round tables on the pink marble floor.

title: [Raspberry Locker Room]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Raspberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Erenad Courtyard]
description: Surrounded by a pale grey stone wall, the cobblestone courtyard of the carriage house fans out in semi-circular pattern with the focal point leading to a white paneled house.  To the other side of the building is an archway that leads into the stable.  Pots of blooming flowers are set about decorating the area with their bright colors.

title: [Erenad House Stables]
description: Rows of white stall doors line the inside of the stables.  Tiny golden plaques embossed with a number are fixed to each one.  Bales of straw and are stacked against the far wall, while sacks of grain are piled nearby.  The floor has been swept clean, and the varnished wood beneath shines in the light shed by a trio of lanterns hanging from the ceiling.

title: [Aspis Embassy, Courtyard]
description: A lush green hedgerow extends from either side of a scrollworked wrought-iron gate to enclose the limestone tiled courtyard.  Small potted fruit trees decorate the corners while flowering trumpet vines climb up a free-standing pergola which bears a plaque and shades a cushion-covered lounge.  Directly across from the structure, a low table and several brightly colored chairs beckons one to relax and listen to the burbling of the nearby hot spring.

title: [Hall of the Dragon]
description: Green velvet chairs and sofas are scattered throughout a huge hall with a small stage at one end and an immense carved granite fireplace at the other.  Arches allow a cool night breeze into the room, while trees of polished petrified wood support a grand crystal-domed roof.  A waterfall bubbles into a small rounded pool in the center of the room.  Trophy cases line the wall opposite the arches and an antique bar fills a corner near the fire.

title: [Embassy, Kitchen]
description: The smell of fresh cookies baking wafts through the large service kitchen.  A spit turns in the fireplace at the narrow end of this room while a brick wall oven radiates warmth.  The heavy oak counters and center table are immaculate and provisions and utensils are stored neatly, poised for the next large feast preparation.  Several arched crystal windows provide ample light.  At the opposite end of the room from the ovens hangs a wall tapestry.

title: [Embassy, Master Suite]
description: A huge four poster bed with a carved canopy spans a plush multicolored tapestry rug in this tranquil and luxurious master suite.  From the crisply pressed linens to the arrangement of fresh lilacs, no comfort has been overlooked.  A carafe of chilled water and a crystal biscuit jar rests on a silvery haon nightstand.  An alabaster bathtub and a shelf of fluffy towels are tucked behind a curved screen.  Two wingback armchairs are drawn up near a marble fireplace with a small table set between them.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Observatory]
description: Spiraling stone steps open into a room with a glass-paneled dome overhead.  A massive steel-riveted telescope is mounted on a rotating plate controlled by a series of pulleys.  Long benches positioned before the paneled glass north wall afford a spectacular view of the town and surrounding environs.  A large teak table curves along the south wall beneath framed constellation images.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Pewter Road]
description: Opening slightly to the south, the narrow street transitions with great difficulty from dingy alley to an actual road.  Debris and refuse spill beyond the confines of the alley onto the crowded path, though someone has made an attempt at containing a portion of the mess by building a small dam of cobblestones in the middle of the street.

Heavy banks of snow spill beyond the confines of the alley onto the crowded path, though someone has made an attempt at containing a portion of the mess by building a small dam of cobblestones in the middle of the street.

title: [Be Warez, Shop]
description: The lopsided shack appears to have been crafted out of broken-down crates and torn wool, its form threatening to topple with even the gentlest of winds.  Resting within a splayed pile of straw is a small basket of wares nestled against a metal can with an open slit, the display being mindfully watched by a large greyish cat.

title: [The Librarium, Study]
description: The ground floor of this little structure resembles a study, its many shelves overflowing with aged tomes and scrolls.  Within a glass case, three books sit on special display, while on a shelf beside them rest sheaves of neatly organized papers.

title: [The Librarium, Sanctuary]
description: A small altar lends this sparse and serene space the air of a sanctuary.  Upon its surface rests a trio of books, while atop some pillows sit many sheaves of papers.

title: [The Librarium, Laboratory]
description: Beakers and vials of viscous fluid bubble atop a work table in what resembles a laboratory.  Within a summoning circle on the floor, three tomes sit on display, while sheaves of papers surround them atop some pedestals at all points.

title: [Madder Hats Tea Room]
description: A large table set with mismatched chairs takes up most of the available floorspace, save for a small iron stove and oak supply bin crowded into one corner.  Lining the walls, shelves are stocked with labeled jars and a variety of cups, saucers, and spoons.  An elaborate chandelier dangles precariously above the table, a complicated arrangement of repurposed sugarbowls and teapots set with glowing candles.

title: [Madder Hats, Stock Room]
description: Not much more than a closet, the floor is strewn with tea leaves, the heady herbal aroma overpowering behind the closed door.  Partially concealing the room's only window, a stack of wooden crates reaches nearly to the ceiling.  A soft meowing can be heard coming from behind a woven basket in the corner.

title: [Shield Thyself]
description: Built between two buildings, the narrow shop has a roof of overlapping canopies that are nailed into a series of boarded up windows on either side.  Cobblestones gleam in the ambient light where the smooth stones lining the ground have been scrubbed to a near luminous quality.  Despite the odd construction, the shop is tidy and utilizes old ale casks to create a sturdy table along the western wall.

title: [Shield Thyself, Extension]
description: Polished cobblestones, lined with chipped curbs, stretch across the floor of the narrow shop, while high above colorful canvas squares are layered and stretched taut to form a protective canopy over the wares.  Boarded up windows are fitted with hooks and pegs to display some of the wares for sale here, while a small woven basket on the ground holds other items.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: The rich cherrywood paneling of this long hallway is punctuated by polished brass sconces, whose steady glow reflects from the ivory coffered ceiling.  A thick wool runner, woven in jewel-hued shades of green and blue, muffles the footsteps of passersby from the scholars of the adjacent library.

title: [Bard Guild, Library]
description: Dappled sunlight filters through the tall leaded-glass windows that illumine the narrow corridors between the bookshelves that fill this long room.  Volumes fill each shelf, ranging from tiny part-books on the uppermost shelves to giant folios at the bottom.  By the door, behind an immaculately tidy desk, sits an old bespectacled elf who appears to be engaged in some obscure exercise in alphabetizing.

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: Small and tidy, this four-square room is furnished with only a few hard-back chairs gathered in a rough semi-circle.  In one corner are the remains of a few shattered music stands that appear to have been used in a brawl.  Panels of thick rolton wool cover the ceiling, though whether to keep sound in or out is anyone's guess.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: A gentle clink of glassware and the murmur of good-humored voices wafts into this long hallway from the nearby bar.  The polished brass sconces lining the hallway throw soft light onto the cherrywood paneling and ivory coffered ceiling.  Portraits of various guildmasters past are hung along the hallway.

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: A narrow half-window set high in the west wall allows some natural light to filter into this unadorned rectangular room.  Aside from a few hard-back chairs, the only furnishing is an enormous harp in the middle of the room, its strings smooth with hard use.

title: [Bard Guild, Scenery Shop]
description: The walls of this large, high-ceilinged room are hidden behind ranks of flats, their canvas painted in a wild assortment of scenes.  Splatters of every conceivable color dot the floor of the relatively small open area in the center.  Gargantuan shelves run along one side of the room, packed with sundry urns, statuary, bits of furniture, and other stage props.

title: [Bard Guild, Member's Bar]
description: Dim streetlight filters through this cozy room's thick curtains of loosely woven silk, casting a maroon-tinged glow over the scattered groups seated at the tables and private booths.  A magnificently carved mahogany bar runs the length of the west wall, its polished onyx surface reflecting the gleaming barware, bottles and brass of the trade.  An occasional raucous laugh or snippet of heated conversation filters through a heavy green velvet curtain on the north side of the room.

title: [Dorian Table]
description: Flanking either side of the richly carved wooden table are two benches, each divided into comfortable niches by ornate armrests.  The backrests, cushioned in full-grain leather, arch gently over the table, supporting small oils lamps of burnished faenor.

title: [Ionian Table]
description: Flanking either side of the richly carved wooden table are two benches, each divided into comfortable niches by ornate armrests.  The backrests, cushioned in full-grain leather, arch gently over the table, supporting small oils lamps of burnished faenor.

title: [Mixolydian Table]
description: Flanking either side of the richly carved wooden table are two benches, each divided into comfortable niches by ornate armrests.  The backrests, cushioned in full-grain leather, arch gently over the table, supporting small oils lamps of burnished faenor.

title: [Locrian Table]
description: Flanking either side of the richly carved wooden table are two benches, each divided into comfortable niches by ornate armrests.  The backrests, cushioned in full-grain leather, arch gently over the table, supporting small oils lamps of burnished faenor.

title: [Underground Temple, Passage]
description: Supported by newly constructed wrought iron brackets, torches decorate the uneven and craggy walls of the small chamber.  Fresh air whistles through a jagged fissure at regular intervals causing the flames to splutter and gutter, their erratic behavior casting long shadows upon the ceiling and floor.  Rising like a scar out of the dark earth, a ragged aperture bisects the opposing wall.

title: [Hypogeal Cavern, Entrance]
description: Torchlight, faint but warm and inviting, spills into the dusty chamber from the ruinous remains of a stone barricade.  Splintered stones, sediment, and dried-out dirt are scattered about the uneven ground that gently slopes upward as it spreads to the southeast.  Chalk, charcoal, and paint lend their pigments to the smooth walls at opposite ends of a ravaged aperture.

title: [Hypogeal Cavern, Dusty Passage]
description: Soft, rainbow-swirled light illuminates the southerly edges of the dark cavern giving the space an eerie light as if a candle had been placed behind a dark kaleidoscope to create a lamp or lantern.  Darkened with scorch marks, an ancient circle of soot mars the pale stone at the curve of the passage.  Painted along the gentle incline of the floor and stretching to the ceiling, the walls depict images of dwarves at work.

title: [Hypogeal Cavern, Cracked Veins]
description: Traversing the ceiling with their vibrant hues, spiderweb veins of minerals and gemstones wend their way through the stone.  Flickering lights, as if torches burned within the crystalline structures, dance beneath the surface and suffuse the room with a prismatic light that is consistent and sufficient to brightly illuminate the area.  Forming natural frames, fluorite columns poke their translucent heads out of the walls in a pattern of green, purple, and pink around painted images.

title: [Hypogeal Cavern, Ossuary]
description: Prismatic light scatters across the floor at the western edge of the chamber, its soft rainbow hues filling the air with an almost ethereal light.  Stabbing downward from the ceiling, a stalactite to the south nearly touches a bone-white pool filled with water, while clusters of debris darken the opposing corners.  Half-painted, a white and black mural spreads its imagery beneath a long stone shelf that is deeply carved into the stone wall.

title: [Arena of the Abyss]
description: Stained in an ethereal red light, the source of which is unlocatable, the arena is bordered by obsidian claws that stretch into a stormy sky.  Lightning flashes at irregular intervals, illuminating dehydrated corpses with mouths frozen in screams of horror and vacant eye sockets where their ocular tenants have rotted away.  Cracked and scattered with a clay-like sand, the ground is uneven and treacherous.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Hall]
description: A polished onyx floor inset with brilliant opaline moonstones stretches out of sight to either side of an enormous central area.  Wrought silver candelabras set at regular intervals cast pools of softly flickering light, creating prisms in the moonstones beneath your feet.  Directly opposite the entrance, a tall marble archway leads into a spacious auditorium.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Hall]
description: Dazzling moonlight streams in through a deep, narrow window cut high on the eastern wall, causing the moonstones set into the polished onyx floor to glitter and sparkle like stars against a nighttime sky.  A tall spiral staircase rises from the center of the chamber, each step inset with a single perfect white opal.  The clink of glassware and sounds of easy camraderie drift up a passageway to the southeast, and a marble arch leads down into a great chamber to the west.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Hall]
description: A set of stairs leads down into darkness, the silver and onyx elegance of the main hall giving way to rougher stone as they descend, curving with the outer wall.  A dark marble arch on the inner wall faces a narrow spiral staircase leading up to the balcony above.  A single black doomstone adorns the end of each polished rail of the staircase.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Hall]
description: Towards the center of this vast circular chamber, the gently curving granite wall is interrupted by a dark marble arch leading into an expansive auditorium.  A vast library is visible through a passageway to the north, and a narrow staircase spirals upwards, rubies inset all along the handrail.

title: [Tower of Tilaok, Balcony]
description: Several pewter sconces blaze along the red-veined marble wall of this semicircular landing.  Glinting in the light, a platinum railing stands at the balcony's edge, and a narrow spiral staircase twists down into the great hall, the single handrail studded with crimson rubies.

title: [Tower of Tilaok, Workshop]
description: Hundreds of potions, powders, and other arcane ingredients rest on maoral shelves placed haphazardly around the large room, which is faintly illuminated by several tall candles.  A clawfoot thanot table topped with a scorched glaes slab dominates the center of the room, with several matching chairs scattered near it.  Against the rear wall, an iron cauldron sits near some metal and glass display cases holding various vials and oddly shaped containers, as well as a few less recognizable items.

title: [Tower of Tilaok, Private Room]
description: Crystal wall sconces cast soft light upon the deep red velvet-covered walls, and a delicately filigreed cherrywood table accompanied by two matching chairs of dark cherrywood rests next to a sandstone fireplace.  Sitting regally in the corner is a handsome wrought iron featherbed covered with a satin crimson throw and dark red pillows, over which is hung an intricately woven tapestry.

title: [Tower of Tilaok, Roof]
description: Blocks of deep crimson marble shine eerily in the moonlight, grey veins winding across them sinuously.  Across the huge dome to the south, the opposing towers of Lornon and Liabo contrast sharply with each other, one a pale moonlit spire, the other barely visible against the nighttime sky.  A large altar crafted of the same type of marble stands in the center of the platform, a thick scarlet leather tome resting on its surface between two tall tall blood red candles.

title: [Great Hall, Auditorium]
description: The center of this vast bowl-shaped chamber is dominated by an enormous circular stage crafted of elegantly carved ironwood and completely encircled by a heavy brocade curtain.  Rows of plush velvet chairs radiate outward from the stage like crimson ripples, with four aisle ways leading through to the bottom.

title: [Tower of Lornon, Balcony]
description: Gleaming bricks of smooth black onyx reflect the light from a wall-mounted vaalin lamp.  No window disturbs the flame and the lamp's unwavering glow suffuses the air, which is noticeably heavy and still.  A narrow staircase leads back down to the main hall, and enclosed corridors stretch off to the north and southeast.

title: [Tower of Lornon, Roof]
description: A chill breeze whips across the summit of this narrow onyx tower, seeking every opening in your clothing.  Unwavering in the wind, two slender black candles rest atop an obsidian altar, on either side of a massive tome encased in polished ebonwood.  Dark forests wreathed in mist cover the hills like a verdant carpet in all directions, surely old when the abbey was built.

title: [Tower of Lornon, Private Room]
description: Deeply polished ebonwood walls and thick black carpeting offset a gleaming silver canopy bed with sheer black silk sheets.  Draped across the bed's frame are lengths of sheer black spidersilk, the ends of which are knotted off in intricately fringed patterns.  An ebonwood table placed at the foot of the bed holds two flickering candles that cast shadows across the walls and provide light sparingly, barely illuminating the painting that faces the bed, while an ebonwood bench rests against one wall.

title: [Tower of Lornon, Summoning Room]
description: A crescent-shaped stained glass window high on the wall allows a few stray moonbeams to filter in, but the soft glow that pervades the room comes from the red, white and black candles lining the top of an intricately-carved ebonwood table.  In the center of the marble floor is a summoning circle with points facing north, east, south and west, each clearly marked with a silvery imflass star.  Evenly placed around the edge of the circle are nine more stars.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Cellar]
description: None of the elegant splendor present in the rest of the abbey exists in this dank cellar.  Greenish-grey lichen flourishes on the damp fieldstone walls, barely visible in the light provided by a single sputtering oil lamp set in the south wall between a mithril barred door and a cracked modwir door.  A set of granite stairs curves upwards along the western wall, warm candlelight filtering down from above.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Dark Workshop]
description: Surprisingly clean and dry, this room has a utilitarian look, with obsidian counters and stone floors and walls.  The counters are piled high with dusty books and scrolls, spell ingredients, herbs, and sealed bottles and jars with liquids of varied colors and viscosity and dried creatures in them.  A big black cauldron effervesces gently in the center of the room, but there is no apparent source of heat under it.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Cell]
description: Loosely packed dirt crunches under your feet, some of it darkly stained by a viscous substance whose nature is better left undetermined.  A thick iron sconce mounted beside the mithril barred door holds a single pine torch, and eerie shadows play upon the rough walls behind various cruel-looking devices.  On the far wall, a pair of glaes shackles hangs menacingly, awaiting the next occupant.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Narrow Hall]
description: Antique tapestries depicting various woodland scenes decorate the rich red maoral walls of this hallway, whose parqueted mahogany floor is bisected by the soft black cotton carpeting that runs north down the center.

title: [Tower of Liabo, Balcony]
description: Moonlight streams through narrow windows, causing the alabaster walls to glow brilliantly.  A small set of crystal chimes suspended in one of the windows spin and sway in the chilly breeze, occasionally brushing against each other with clear ringing notes.  The huge circular main hall is visible over a simple wrought iron railing, and accessible via a narrow staircase that spirals down.

title: [Tower of Liabo, Private Room]
description: Sheer white curtains of dupioni silk drape along the sides of an elegant canopy bed covered with a matching white spread and plump pillows.  Silver shaded oil lamps rest unlit on a golden oak table and two chairs by the window, and a pale oaken desk rests against the far wall, overflowing with bound parchments.  Centered in the wall facing the door is a hand-carved marble fireplace, over which hangs a painting in a simple silver frame.

title: [Tower of Liabo, Roof]
description: Pale alabaster glistens everywhere atop this slender edifice, almost painful in its brilliance.  Directly south, a sparkling lake spreads across the shallow valley, patches of fog drifting across it like clouds sailing across a peaceful sky.  In the center of the tower rests a simple white marble altar, untouched by carvings or decoration, save for two slender white candles on either side of a large tome bound in silvery-white eonake.

title: [Tower of Liabo, Meditation Room]
description: Less than a hand width of natural monir flooring shows at the edges of this small room, the rest disappearing underneath a thick pad covered with light grey linen.  In the center of the room, a short jade pedestal provides a splash of color to the austere setting.  A tiny white porcelain fountain atop the pedestal bubbles with clear water, the soothing sound echoing lightly from the grey-veined marble walls.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Library]
description: Row after row of thick leather-bound tomes fill the huge black willow bookshelves that line the walls of this huge open chamber, surrounding the long oak tables which have been arranged in an orderly fashion in the middle of the room.  Plush light grey carpeting extends from the entryway to cover the entire floor of the library, muffling the occasional noises from those who come here seeking knowledge.  An immense portrait in a gilded frame rests on the wall above the entryway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Library]
description: Students of all disciplines of magic frequent this wing of the library, hoping to rediscover some long-forgotten secret of their predecessors.  Occasionally, a mumbled phrase can be heard as someone seeks to master an elusive pronunciation, but the room is largely silent, perhaps due to the conspicuously placed brass plaque that greets visitors.

title: [Second Floor, Hallway]
description: Richly textured brocade the color of fresh cream covers the upper part of the walls, giving way to waist-high dark felwood panels below.  Narrow border carpets travel the length of the corridor on either side, fading subtly from solid black at the southern end to a deep crimson as they reach the northern balcony.  A small round table at the midpoint holds a crystal vase filled with a mixture of mournblooms and roses, directly beneath a colorful tapestry.

title: [Second Floor, Ruby Room]
description: The dusky-colored stone walls of the room are cloaked with tapestries, all depicting a sunset.  Hung side to side, they create a vivid panorama.  On the middle one, the sun falls into a crimson sea, its dying rays reaching into the twilight.  Jumbles of cushions have been piled near a fieldstone fireplace, their complex patterns a match to the scarlet velvet curtains at the windows.  Opposite the hearth is a four-poster bed hung with vermilion drapes, creating a private nook when they are drawn.

title: [Second Floor, Hallway]
description: Onyx and white marble tiles form the floor, nestled together snugly in patterns that are too orderly to be random, yet too chaotic to be planned, like pieces of a shattered puzzle.  The deep crimson brocade covering the walls is home to narrow ebonwood shelves, each holding a perfect rose in a slender vaalin vase.  Thirteen snowy white blooms face an equal number of midnight black roses on the south wall.  A white marble sculpture sits on the floor beneath the centermost black rose.

title: [Second Floor, Sapphire Room]
description: The stone walls of the chamber are tinted a deep tone of azure, complementing the sapphire colored velvet drapes framing a large leaded-glass window.  On the wall opposite is a mosaic, its tiles masterfully designed to depict an ocean view.  Indigo patches of water alternate with cerulean waves, sunlight flickering from their dancing froth.  A pile of lapis-toned pillows is piled between the bed and a generous hearth.

title: [Second Floor, Hallway]
description: On either side of the soft ivory carpet running down the center of the hall, dark herringboned felwood complements the narrow panels of polished cherrywood that have been affixed to the lower half of the walls.  Above them, fine ebony brocade extends to the ceiling.  Halfway down the corridor, an elegant porcelain bowl filled with lily and rose petals sits on a carved ivory pedestal, lending a pleasant fragrance to the air.

title: [Second Floor, Emerald Room]
description: Tapestries of rich verdant green dominate the walls of the room, creating an illusion of a forest as they drape to the floor.  A jumble of cushions in jade and emerald are piled high before a fieldstone fireplace.  Several faceted crystal discs hang in the window over a simple teakwood table, spreading patterns of moonlight across the walls as they spin lazily.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Lounge]
description: A gleaming mahogany bar trimmed with polished brass runs the length of the south wall, tall stools lined up before it.  Halfway to the vaulted stone ceiling, an unusually large blackened fel dart board cabinet hangs on one of the paneled walls.  Facing the huge grey-streaked marble fireplace, a semicircular dark leather couch invites you to relax and put your troubles aside.  Soft burgundy carpet matches the thick velvet drapes that cover the windows, giving the room a comfortable dusky feel at any hour.

title: [Dusk Table]
description: A smoked-glass shade has been placed over the pewter candleholder mounted to the wall, spreading a dim light over the polished table.  A thin porcelain vase at the table's center holds several fragrant mournblooms.

title: [Moonbeam Table]
description: A translucent glaes orb suspended from a thin silvery chain emanates soft light, much like a miniature moon over the polished ebonwood table.  The glow casts cozy shadows on a gargoyle-shaped incense burner as fragrant smoke wafts about the room, adding to its tranquil atmosphere.

title: [Midnight Table]
description: A single thick black candle rests in an onyx bowl, giving off a pleasant aroma as the flame flickers and dances.  On either side of the table, black satin cushions line hardwood benches.

title: [Stardust Table]
description: A brightly polished platinum orb dotted with tiny star-shaped holes hangs above the table, and thin rays of light spear outward from it as it lazily spins back and forth.  Every so often, a ray strikes one of the hundreds of tiny crystals that decorate the smooth black tabletop, creating a momentary rainbow that pleases the eye.

title: [Dawn Table]
description: Carved from a single huge block of white monir, this table has been handpainted with fastidious care.  Bright yellow suns stretch their wavy tendrils towards the tiny flowers that lean towards them, petals upraised as though worshipping the life-giving orbs.  A frosted-glass oil lamp hanging above the table completes the cheerful scene with its comfortable glow.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Kitchen]
description: A huge fire pit dominates the center of this room, large enough to roast a wild boar.  To one side are a two oversized cast iron baking ovens, beside which hang large wooden paddles used to handle loaves of hot bread, and a blackened krodera-veined cauldron rests on squat legs.  Numerous pots and pans dangle from hooks overhead, and the large china cabinet holds enough tableware for a small army of hungry patrons.  There appears to be a small cage or pen built into the south wall, with a thick chain securing the door.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Library]
description: A witchwood library table, which is surrounded by straight-backed chairs, dominates the center of the room and is illuminated by several candelabra for those who enjoy late night reading.  Moonlight filters softly through silken curtains, causing them to glow slightly in contrast to the wooden bookshelves that line the walls.  Underneath each window is a maoral bench, the soft satin cushions providing excellent perches from which to read a favorite book.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Library]
description: Scores of candles rest atop long oaken tables, filling the room with light despite the hour, and weary-looking scholars mutter quietly to themselves as they sit entranced by the historical tomes they peruse.  High on the far wall, an enormous wrought iron and stained glass window glows with the moonlight pouring through it.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Narrow Hall]
description: A crystal and wrought iron chandelier throws gentle shadows against the intricate carvings on the maoral walls, and the soft black carpeting absorbs the sound of your footfalls, adding to the calm.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Narrow Hall]
description: Strategically placed near the dressing rooms and lockers, a large oval mirror that hangs from the wall rests next to a small oaken end table.  Pewter candleholders line the walls at the end of the hallway, giving optimal lighting for admiring one's reflection.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Courtyard]
description: Featuring a huge old sycamore tree, this section of the courtyard has been festooned with multiple mismatched banners.  Benches have been placed under the expansive tree in what appears to be an attempt at hospitality.  If one could ignore the malodourous ambiance and muddy straw-covered ground, this would be a nice place to rest.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Courtyard]
description: The courtyard stretches from east to west through this area with a number of stalls set up to house visiting merchants.  The construction is a bit shabby though attention seems to have been paid to the decorations, as there are any number of bright-painted tapestries adorning both the walls of the stalls and the inner walls of the keep itself.  The straw underfoot is thicker in this area but the added layers do nothing to hide the rather pungent aroma.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Courtyard]
description: The keep widens dramatically in this space, exposing a length of open ground with full view of the misty skies above.  Underneath is a heavy layer of straw which serves to reinforce footing and cut down on muddy conditions.  Dotting the courtyard are a variety of wagons and tents, many with signs proclaiming their wares.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Atrium]
description: The area just inside the wooden doors is grand, replete with large tapestries lining the walls, decorative columns topped with fearsome gargoyle statues, and brightly burning chandeliers dangling from the ceiling.  Every surface is formed of the same uniformly black stones which vary widely in size.  The resulting uneven texture produces an odd stillness as the normal reverberations of sound are greatly muffled.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Ledge]
description: Looming before you is a massive black stone structure, its upper reaches partially obscured by the swirling mist.  The structure appears to be some sort of a keep or possibly a small castle.  The stones forming it are irregularly sized but uniformly black.  Arrow slits dot the walls, and the crenellations at their apex are littered with a variety of fearsome-looking gargoyles.  Squarely in front of the rope bridge are two massive wooden doors.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Bridge]
description: Visibility here is drastically curtailed by a near-opaque mist.  You can just make out the center rope beneath your feet as the ragged fibers of the handrails keep you on track.  The sound of breaking waves is stronger here, and a darkness looms ahead, though it's impossible to make out any details.  Becoming far clearer as it stretches towards the mainland, the rope bridge all but vanishes in the direction of the mist.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Bridge]
description: Stretching before you into the mist is a particularly worn rope bridge.  The fraying fibers are knotted and weathered to varying degrees, and the whole structure sways beneath your feet with each gust of the sea breeze.  Nothing can be seen beyond the mists ahead but the sound of waves breaking against something solid can be clearly heard.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Greatroom]
description: The black stone walls in this space are joined by a similarly crafted staircase rising from the stones underneath in a rough circular trajectory hugging the internal walls of the tower.  At the center of this room is a massive sculpture depicting a trio of gargoyles artfully arranged in attack postures, their jaws open wide and wings flared.  Torches are placed around the base of the sculpture, providing both light for the room and dramatic shadows across the sculpture's surface.

title: [Windfellow Tower, First Floor]
description: The staircase flattens out here, winding almost completely around before climbing once more.  A large claw-footed brazier stands off to one side, though it is not lit.  The area is filled with ambient light whose source is unclear, and every noise echoes off the surrounding stone, reverberating around the area.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Second Floor]
description: Once again, the staircase ceases its rise and forms another flat platform.  Doors of various shapes and sizes litter the walls, and the floor in this area is heavily scratched, in direct contrast to the relatively smooth surfaces of the rest of the visible stone.  A blood red orb is perched on a metal stand against one wall, glowing just brightly enough to bathe the area in a sanguine hue.

The colorful staircase once again ceases its rise and forms another flat platform, this one oddly full of stuffed animals.  Doors of various shapes and sizes are blocked by the cotton and suede zoo, the floor littered by buttons and goose down in every nook and cranny.   A blood red orb is perched on a metal stand against one wall, glowing just brightly enough to bathe the area in a sanguine hue.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Third Floor]
description: The staircase on this level is not quite even with the floor, as a pair of the steps actually continue above the floor, creating an awkward step down.  Many signs of heavy impact can be seen on the protruding steps, as if someone or something had attempted to hammer them into place after they had been placed.  A staircase formed of the same stones found in the rest of the tower stretches upwards, though these particular stones are polished to a high sheen.

The staircase on this level is not quite even with the floor, evidenced by the uneven pool of tiny wooden toy gargoyles gathered in the corner of a lower step.  Colorfully painted arrows indicate that the tower stretches upward in a spiral of streamers and dried beetles.

title: [Windfellow Tower, First Floor]
description: This area has been converted into a storeroom of sorts and contains row upon row of wooden shelves lashed to stone walls.  The strong mineral odor of the surrounding walls and floor does not quite overpower the persistent scent of herbs and spices that emanate from a wall-mounted drying rack.  A few burlap bags half-filled with grain remain on one of the shelves.  Empty barrels dot each corner of the room.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Third Floor]
description: High placed narrow windows strategically line one wall of this large room, breaking up the otherwise unrelenting expanse of stone.  Cold and bare, this room's sole purpose seems to be defensive in nature.

Various vellum cut-outs are placed across the narrow windows of this large room, casting kitten and dragon-shaped shadows across the wax-splattered floor.  Dust bunnies tumble across the ground, the original intent of the room lost to a makeshift play room filled with dolls, blocks, and weaponry.

title: [Gemysteries]
description: Moonlight falling in through the high-set stained glass window casts an array of silvered jewel-toned colors across the bare floor.  In mimicry of the display, each candle on the iron sconces dotting the walls is encased by a bejeweled shade, and the flickering flames set the gemstones alight in a rainbow of color.  At the center of the room rests a tiered rowan table, its lower surface draped in heavy velvet, while the upper are left bare.  Beneath the table sits a small silver chest.

Sunlight falling in through the high-set stained glass window casts an array of jewel-toned colors across the bare floor.  In mimicry of the display, each candle on the iron sconces dotting the walls is encased by a bejeweled shade, and the flickering flames set the gemstones alight in a rainbow of color.  At the center of the room rests a tiered rowan table, its lower surface draped in heavy velvet, while the upper are left bare.  Beneath the table sits a small silver chest.

title: [Gemysteries]
description: At the center of this small alcove sits a sizeable boulder, its surface craggy and dark, with a silver-limbed jewelry tree perched atop it.  The twining roots of the tree spiral and twist down to embrace the boulder in such a way that belies the fact that silver is inanimate rather than a living substance.  From high above, moonlight falls in multihued shafts across the tree, tinged in silvery jewel-toned hues by the stained glass window.

At the center of this small alcove sits a sizeable boulder, its surface craggy and dark, with a silver-limbed jewelry tree perched atop it.  The twining roots of the tree spiral and twist down to embrace the boulder in such a way that belies the fact that silver is inanimate rather than a living substance.  From high above, sunlight falls in multihued shafts across the tree, tinged in jewel-toned hues by the stained glass window.

title: [Gemysteries, Atelier]
description: The floor in this section of the shop glitters mutely in a rainbow of hues beneath the moonlight filtering in through the small, plain window seated high in the wall above.  What appears to be sand scratches underfoot, though the reflective quality and coloring betrays the grains as gem dust instead.  A stout saddle-style stool with a broad seat sits in one corner behind a crescent-shaped worktable, and recessed nooks in the surface of the table house a variety of jewels in every color imaginable.

The floor in this section of the shop glitters brightly in a rainbow of hues beneath the sunlight filtering in through the small, plain window seated high in the wall above.  What appears to be sand scratches underfoot, though the reflective quality and coloring betrays the grains as gem dust instead.  A stout saddle-style stool with a broad seat sits in one corner behind a crescent-shaped worktable, and recessed nooks in the surface of the table house a variety of jewels in every color imaginable.

title: [Pick a Pocket]
description: The small stone chamber is crowded at best, crammed with a nearly endless supply of stone blocks, wooden crates, and overturned chests.  The room appears to be more of a forgotten storage area than any space worth residing in for long.  Cobwebs clutter the corners of the scrunched space and the floor is covered with dust, broken up only by some fresh footprints moving to and fro.

title: [Collarly Love]
description: Hazy moonlight filters in through the crude window cut into the mottled stone walls, dispelling shadows and illuminating the wares.  A rounded oak table is set up next to a rounded mahogany table, each one laden with inventory.   Near a thick cinnamon oak door, a large sign is propped upon a metal stand.

Muted sunlight filters in through the crude window cut into the mottled stone walls.  A rounded oak table is set up next to a rounded mahogany table, each one laden with wares.  Near a thick cinnamon oak door, a large sign is propped upon a metal stand.

title: [Collarly Love]
description: Moonlight fills the small room of stone, cutting through the shadows and bringing cool night air.  A few scarred oak chairs are scattered about, each one topped with colorful cloth cushions.  A placard is attached to a hook on one of the walls.

A cool breeze filters in through the window, bringing much needed freshness to the small room of stone.  A few scarred oak chairs are scattered about, each one topped with colorful cloth cushions.  A placard is attached to a hook on one of the walls.

title: [Accessories After the Fact]
description: Despite the best efforts of the pair of pierced iron braziers limning the entrance of this narrow alcove, shadows cling to the ironwood bookshelves tucked into its back corners.  A brass-hinged footlocker, its padlock still closed but attached to a battered and dangling lockplate, stands opened and resting on its side near a small puddle of indeterminate origin.

title: [Trouble Brewing]
description: Beeswax candles drip from ornate iron sconces, the glow of the tiny, flickering flames nearly absorbed by the surrounding black stone walls and floor.  An enormous cauldron fills a walk-in fireplace, the sickly green, bubbling brew within giving off a noxious odor.  A wooden rack and a spindly oak table flank a curtained opening in the curved wall.

title: [Trouble Brewing, Workroom]
description: A black raven perches on the sill of a small window set high in the curved wall, its eye turned toward a curtained opening in the black stone.  A single lantern glows atop a long worktable crowded with alchemical equipment, which is covered in dust and cobwebs.  The faint odor of sulphur and burnt hair lingers in this small space.

title: [Tricks and Quarrels]
description: Pale moonlight sifts in through the windows set high on the stone walls, giving this otherwise austere room a chilly countenance.  Heavy iron sconces bearing brightly flickering candles encircle the space, standing sentinel to the wares on display.  An arrow stand sits beneath one fixture, and a colorful arrow display rests against the opposite wall.  Between a pair of the sconces is a wall-mounted arrow rack, and a small gilt-framed sign hangs from its lowest rung.

Warm light falls in through the windows set high on the stone walls, giving this otherwise austere room an inviting countenance.  Heavy iron sconces bearing unlit candles encircle the space, standing sentinel to the wares on display.  An arrow stand sits beneath one fixture, and a colorful arrow display rests against the opposite wall.  Between a pair of the sconces is a wall-mounted arrow rack, and a small gilt-framed sign hangs from its lowest rung.

title: [Tricks and Quarrels]
description: Along the walls here are heavy iron sconces that comprise the entirety of the decor, and atop them sit brightly burning candles.  Moonlight tumbles in from a window high above, silvering the surface of the glass-walled case that sits against one wall.  On the opposing wall is a small table, a woven rowan basket set upon it, with a short stocky barrel placed alongside.

Along the walls here are heavy iron sconces that comprise the entirety of the decor, and atop them sit unlit candles.  Sunlight illuminates the space from a window high above, glaring harshly off the surface of the glass-walled case that sits against one wall.  On the opposing wall is a small table, a woven rowan basket set upon it, with a short stocky barrel placed alongside.

title: [Tricks and Quarrels, Backroom]
description: A midnight blue high-pile rug covers the majority of the floor in this diminutive room, and above the heavy iron sconces, the walls are sooted black in wavering patterns as if the flames of the candles burn ceaselessly.  In the fartherest corner, a few stray feathers are scattered, along with curled metal and wooden shavings.

title: [Forgotten Pleasure]
description: Tight fitting stones of various sizes meet seamlessly to form the slightly curved outer wall of this tower room.  Thick flagstones, in a chaotically jumbled pattern, comprise the cold and barren floor.  Devoid of any decorations, save a battered toque atop a simple stone shelf, the room appears lifeless and empty.

title: [A Rocky Start, Flint]
description: Thick clumps of beard moss drape from intersecting wood ceiling beams, with various bits purposely framing a makeshift teak door.  Pale moonlight creeps through a paneless window, casting long shadows from a pair of stone mannequins upon a shaggy bearskin rug.  Though subtle, the unmistakable odor of mildew poorly concealed by a bouquet of lemongrass and mint lingers in the air.

Thick clumps of beard moss drap from intersecting wood ceiling beams, with various bits purposely framing a makeshift teak door.  Sunlight pours through a paneless window, illuminating a pair of stone mannequins barely obscuring a shaggy bearskin rug.  Though subtle, the unmistakable odor of mildew poorly concealed by a bouquet of lemongrass and mint lingers in the air.

title: [A Rocky Start, Rubble]
description: Dust and dried bits of mud nearly cover the entire floor, with only the immediate area surrounding a pair of stone mannequins clear of debris.  Hung just above a crudely carved table displaying a variety of cracked and broken clay pots is a stretched rawhide painting of a giant spear-stuck rolton.  A carved soapstone lantern flickers occasionally, casting dancing shadows throughout the room.

title: [A Rocky Start, Quarry]
description: The gentle plinking sound of water droplets falling upon a haphazard pile of stones is softened by moss-covered walls meant to reduce ambient noise.  Jutting out from the ground are several feldspar benches that create a ring around a modwir tree serving as the room's central focal point.  A heavy curtain of lapis and chalcedony-beaded strands frames a poorly sculpted archway leading back towards the main shopping area.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Dungeon]
description: This space is completely flooded and the water is a few feet deep in every direction, though there is no apparent source for the water.  The light is sparse and appears to be emanating from luminescent fungi in the cracks of the stone walls.  Littering the walls are a variety of shackles, all of which are in various states of disrepair.

Luminescent fungi casts a glow within the cracks of the stone walls, the space completely flooded with water several feet deep in every direction.  Interspersed between the disrepaired shackles littering the walls are several wooden toy ducks floating in the water, followed by a small toy galleon.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Dungeon]
description: A low-hanging, rough, stone archway leads into a larger flooded chamber.  The meager amount of light provided by the fungi only highlights the unrelenting blackness of the water that covers the floor here.  Broken down torture equipment litters the room, appearing as little more than looming shadows.

A low-hanging, rough, stone archway leads into a larger flooded chamber, the surface chiseled with a variety of small animals of unknown origin.  The meager amount of light provided by the fungi only highlights the unrelenting blackness of the water that covers the floor here, flashing the stone eyes of a single wooden toy duck bobbing in the shadows.  Broken down torture equipment litters the room, serving as temporary housing for a family of plump mice.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Dungeon]
description: You find yourself in a wide, stone hallway that leads to a shadowy dead end.  A putrid odor permeates this part of the dungeon with such intensity that it's hard to draw a steady breath.  The strange, glowing light reveals barred cell doors lining either side of the hall.

The stone hallway leads to a shadowy dead end, the wall covered from floor to ceiling in extremely fluffy bunnies.  The faintly putrid odor permeating this part of the dungeon has been drowned out by dozens of dried lavender and sage bundles dangling from bars set above.  The strange, glowing light reveals barred cell doors lining either side of the hall, the floor before it chalked with large arrows.

title: [Turn It Around]
description: Rivulets of water flow down the pockmarked wall, following the smooth, timeworn channels in the hard rock.  A plethora of prayers, tally marks, names, and confessions have been etched into the stone surfaces, serving as a constant reminder of previous occupants.  Chunks of rocks lay scattered in the dirt, the edges on some showing extensive wear.  A stubby bit of candle sits crookedly on an excrescence in one corner.  Nearly hidden in a dim corner is an open trunk with its splintered lid propped against the wall nearby.

title: [Armory of Darkness, Parlour]
description: The thick stone blocks that comprise the walls and floor of the cell stifle the surrounding din of the area, their surfaces covered in blackened moss and a variety of decaying vines.  Rusted iron shelves and racks are haphazardly placed on each side of an unhinged door toward the back of the room, the center decorated by a circle of dimly lit candles bleeding wax through the cracks in the rock.

title: [The Jolly Geode]
description: The dark, musty cell is nearly barren with the exception of a small rusted shelf in the corner.  There is a distinct foul odor, which seems to emanate from a murky puddle pooling along the outer wall.

title: [The Jolly Geode, Workroom]
description: The cold workroom is sparsely furnished with a dusty wooden work table and an overturned dilapidated stool.  Strewn about the room are various rusty tools splattered with decades of paint.

title: [Driblet's Hollow]
description: The dreary hollow is littered with crumbling misty grey stonework, though the walls are fairly sound compared to the jagged, uneven flooring.  Sunrays pour through a corner opening onto an iron-bound leather chest, the brightness quelled by feathery tufts of errant cobwebs.  Shadowy rivulets of water blossom from glowing fungi that sprout from fragmented cracks surrounding a high-placed ledge.

title: [Stonefinger's Secrets, Nook]
description: This is a very large, partially flooded, stone room.  The uneven floor provides a mostly dry walkway to help visitors circumnavigates pools of stagnant water.  Primitive torches lining the walls provide nothing more than unhospitable light and menacing shadows.  Some signs are posted at intervals between ancient, empty wine racks.

title: [Stonefinger's Secrets, Cellar]
description: Though several feet below the main cellar, this sub-cellar has somehow managed to escape the flooding.  Dark and musty, this small, windowless room is disconcertingly tomblike.  A single oil lamp, atop a large battered desk, provides a meager light source.  Absent any air currents, the twin scents of sulfur and smoke linger.

title: [The Darker Path]
description: This cell is stone: stone walls, stone floor and stone ceiling.  There is a stone rack, a stone shelf, and a stone counter on one of the three full stone walls.  Water runs slowly down the wall in the corner and is slowly pooling on the floor, except for one area near the middle.

title: [A Dank Room]
description: Dark stone walls crowd the open space in this dank room.  The air is cold and damp, the room lit by a single candelabra that rests on a rickety table by the door.  A dusty set of shelves is the only other furniture, its contents shrouded in shadow.

title: [A Gneiss Gal, Showroom]
description: Black stone gives way to earthen walls as the surroundings shift from structured dwelling to natural grotto.  Near the edge of a large crystal-clear pool, a stone outcrop rises slightly above the water's surface.  A notice board hangs behind an old and pitted anvil in a darkened curve of the cavern.  A gentle moan is caused as air enters the shop via a stone-lined opening and through a yawning hole in the wall.

title: [A Gneiss Gal, Salon]
description: Glowing lichen provides a dim source of light in this damp section of cavern.  A stone-littered table rests close to one wall, while a low stone ledge lines two of the others.  A chilled air drafts in through a yawning hole in the wall.

title: [Grogiz's Sekrit Rume]
description: This "secret room" is almost identical to the one above.  It is made up of stone: stone walls, stone floor, and stone ceiling, save for the small opening into the room.  The only differences are the a crudely-made rug on the floor and a small purple thing in the corner.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Workshop]
description: This room is clearly utilitarian in design and usage.  Cluttered wooden tables line the walls, interspersed with bookshelves of various sizes and shapes.  Alchemical tools adorn some of the tables, while others hold flawed gems, or piles of parchment.  A large chandelier is suspended from the ceiling, lit with bright yellow flames that cast a bright light across the entire space.

The cluttered workshop has become a maze of wooden tables, bookshelves, and oversized alchemical tools, the potential shortcuts cut off by stacks of parchment covered in splatters of paint.  A battered wooden chest overflowing with flawed gems has been marked with a large arrow to indicate the correct pathways, the jewels casting fractured rays of light emanating from a barely dangling chandelier.  Small pockets of space interspersed between the stacks of books show evidence of hidden inhabitants.

title: [Metal and Stone]
description: This is a spacious room, though not highly decorated.  There are tools of weaponsmithing lined against the walls, as well as several swords on the walls displaying the weaponsmith's work.  In the far left corner there is a dark granite table.

title: [Pebbles With Power]
description: Bits of rock lay scattered about the floor of the small chamber.  Sunlight trickles through the cracked panes of a single grime-covered window, casting a pale glow upon the room.  Haphazardly tossed against a wall is a mold-caked wooden trunk, the lid hanging on by a single dented hinge.

Bits of rock lay scattered about the floor of the small chamber.  Sunlight trickles through the cracked panes of a single grime-covered window casting a pale glow upon the room.  Haphazardly tossed against a wall is a mold-caked wooden trunk, the lid hanging on by a single dented hinge.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Fountain]
description: The ceiling in this area is far overhead, making the already large room appear that much more spacious.  Dominating the center of the floor is an elaborate fountain, crafted of intertwined onyx and white marble, and depicting a mighty demon ensnared by tendrils emanating from the outstretched hands of a sorceror.  The water bends and bows in spellbinding patterns, leaping across the structure and cascading down towards a shallow pool.

The streamer-congested ceiling is far overhead, making the already large room appear that much more spacious with the inclusion of dozens of half-dead fauna.  Dominating the center of the floor is an elaborate fountain, crafted of intertwined onyx and white marble, and depicting a demon ensnared by tendrils emanating from the outstretched hands of a sorcerer, their miens overshadowed by the addition of rouge and lip cream.  The fountain waters cascade down towards a shallow pool serving as an oasis for several mice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south, west
Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, west

title: [Off the Beaten Trail]
description: Thick oak poles stand in each corner of the tent, holding the oilcloth canopy up overhead.  A round marble pedestal sits off in one corner of the tent, while a large mahogany map table occupies much of the central floor space.  An oilcloth flap hangs across the rear of the tent, concealing the back portion of the structure.

title: [Off the Beaten Trail]
description: A bright lamp juts out from the corner pole, providing illumination for this quiet space.  Beneath the lamp sits a padded stool with a an angled drawing table standing behind it.
A bright lamp juts out from the corner pole, providing illumination for this quiet space.  Beneath the lamp sits a padded stool with an angled drawing table standing behind it.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Entrance]
description: The staircase terminates in a small alcove recessed into the tower wall which contains a pair of sturdy iron doors.  Various sigils have been etched into the metal though they are of inconsistent quality, with some being very precise and deep and others appearing ragged and haphazard.  A rope is suspended from the ceiling to the right, and a small rug lies on the floor before the doors.

The confetti-strewn staircase terminates in an alcove recessed into the tower wall, the streamer-strung pair of sturdy iron doors poorly etched with a smiling gargoyle face and several arrows pointing inward.  A duo of stuffed straw gargoyles lay against the colorful walls, their hands attached to garishly painted maypoles that droop slightly at the entrance.  Hanging from the ceiling is a spindly human-shaped lantern, casting distorted rays of light through the various puncture wounds riddling its body.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Entry]
description: This room is a stark departure from the dark stone that comprises the rest of the keep.  The walls in this area are wooden, smoothly crafted and uniformly painted a neutral eggshell hue.  A small alcove sits to one side, containing a pedestal with an open book on it.  The light sound of a stringed instrument drifts through the area, though its source can't be seen.  Underfoot is a plush carpet tastefully coordinated with the color of the walls.

The once eggshell-colored walls of the room have been garishly covered by murals of various artistic skill, the thick globs of paint and remains of ripe fruit adding texture to the once smooth surface.  Stuffed into the alcove are haphazard piles of broken armor and weaponry forged into a makeshift throne, the seat covered in layers of downy-stuffed cushions that spill onto the rugs and floorboards.  A split mahogany harp dominates the center of the room, its strings cross-tied then nailed to the instrument.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Bedroom]
description: Jewel-toned tapestries on the walls and woven rush mats on the floor keep the stone chamber's cold at bay and hold in the heat of the fireplace that takes up most of the spacious room's west wall.  On the eastern wall, mullioned windows with ornamental stained glass rosettes open onto a commanding view of the castle's grounds.  A massive four-poster bed heaped with bolster pillows and furs holds pride of place in the center of the vaulted bedchamber.

Jewel-toned tapestries are covered with paper-cut hearts, and rush mats are sprinkled with similar confetti.  The stone chamber is heated by a wax-drizzled fireplace located by the room's west wall.  Along the east, mullioned windows with ornamental stained glass rosettes open onto a commanding view of the castle's grounds, partially obscured by the addition of more anatomical paper hearts.  A massive four-poster bed heaped with thick furs is centered in the vaulted bedchamber, the surface sprinkled with bright red rose petals.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Workshop]
description: This corner of the workshop is far darker than the others, and a musty smell suffuses the area.  Sounds are muffled here, as the plethora of books and tomes act as dampeners for any echo they encounter.  Bookshelves sag under the weight of various tomes, a desk is piled high with scrolls, and various crates lining the floor are stuffed full of paper.  There's a layer of dust over most things, though the sheer amount of books and various tomes makes this area feel rather crowded.

Remnants of a faint musty smell are quickly drowned out by an assault of dried flora and herbs, dozens upon dozens of bundles loosely tied to the ceiling above.  A cacophony of clicks and whirrs emanate from behind stacks of books and tomes, the occasional cog dropping down into the piles of junk, forever lost to the ether.  Slapdash stools and tables have been built from a number of tomes, their humidity-dampened spines sagging dramatically from alternate use.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Workshop]
description: This corner of the workshop is less cluttered than the rest, and there are intricate sigils etched into the floor in a circular pattern.  The chandelier overhead contains only a single candle, but its light is reflected towards the floor by a variety of large mirrors mounted to the edge of the chandelier, bathing the area in intense light.  Scorch marks can be seen marring the walls in various places, and there is what appears to be the imprint of a taloned claw on the ceiling.

The intricate sigils etched into the floor have been marred by childlike drawings of dungeons and dragons, the adventure following the circular pattern of the seals.  An abundance of candles heavily sway upon the chandelier overhead, causing searing arcs of light to focus across the haphazard scorch marks already marring the walls.  Each mark is met with similar measured horizontal lines set into the stone, and are annotated with a smudged name written in paint.

title: [Heartwarming, Entry Hall]
description: The high ceilings of this small room give the false impression of spaciousness.  Various shields, each sporting a completely different coat of arms, are displayed proudly over every wall.  Mismatched flags hanging from short, jutting poles are interspersed randomly among the shields.  Standing torches brightly light the room, and the air is heavy with the rich scent of chocolate.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Workshop]
description: This area of the workshop is clearly intended for alchemical research.  Everywhere you look there are beakers and globes of various colored liquid.  The air has a heaviness to it, and the combination of scents in the area are nearly overpowering.  An elaborate cupboard dominates one wall, replete with tiny cubbies, each of which is filled with a different small vial.  Skins filled with liquid hang from pegs on the other wall, each one labeled in a cramped, hard to read script.

This area of the workshop holds a plethora of alchemical research, the beakers and globes interspersed with wooden table legs and rusty horseshoes.  Overpowering scents hang heavily in air, casting a faint haze across the tiny toy-filled cubbies within the chalk-covered cupboard dominating the far wall.  Splatters of unknown origin litter the stone floor, and a small porcelain tea set sits centered within a circle of liquid.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Ballroom]
description: This chamber is clearly set up to facilitate dancing.  A large expanse of the floor is perfectly smooth stone, reflecting the light of the many torches along the walls.  Off to one side is a raised stage littered with musical instruments of various shapes and sizes.  Small circular tables with tall metal chairs are interspersed around the perimeter of the dance floor, and a small alcove near the entrance has some refreshments for sale.

The slightly chipped stone floor shows signs of frequent use, the divots and scapes emphasized by the comical oceanic scenes painted with blatant disregard of geographical location.  A plank-framed canvas portrait leans flanked by musical instruments littered on each side, their well-polished parts casting random beams of light towards the shattered mirror-inlaid candelabra hanging high above.  A neglected grouping of furniture and dishware sits off to the side of the room.

title: [Pebbles With Power]
description: Thin streams of water trickle down through claw-like marks that mar the cracked stone walls.  Bits of rotting debris and dust are scattered about a rotting wooden crate overflowing with bits of straw.  A single bronze sconce hangs crookedly from the wall, unlit and cold.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Dining Hall]
description: This room is far longer than it is wide and is completely dominated by an impressively long banquet table.  Ornate candelabras are aligned perfectly down the center of the table, and beautifully carved mahogany benches with dark red cushioned seats are positioned along both its sides in perfect symmetry.
