A junk-covered banquet table completely dominates the room, the piles of gadgets and miscellaneous armor leading towards the steel candelabra overloaded with colorful glass spheres.  Mahogany benches are pinned against the chalked walls, draped with faded banners of silk and brocade covered in dust.  A string quartet stationed in an unobtrusive corner blends in save for the garishly bright cravats adorning their stone necks.

title: [Heartwarming, Kitchen]
description: As you look around the darkened room, you're presented with a scene straight out of a massacre; you see complete chaos and disarray with rusty-looking splatters that cover every available surface.  As your eyes adjust to the dim lighting, you can make out a dark liquid pooling into several puddles on the floor.  After a moment you notice the piles of mixing bowls teetering on the main worktable, and your olfactory glands are assaulted with the overpowering scent of chocolate.

title: [Veiled Compliments]
description: An oval-shaped smooth glass mirror is centered upon the back of the spacious pavilion and delicately silhouetted by burnished onyx and jade rosettes.  The longest of the silken walls is home to a beveled ebonwood wardrobe that rests over a tassel-tied floral tapestry carpet.  An orb-footed dark myrtle chest and a damascened glaes cabinet flank a tiered crystalline carousel, each surface crowned with a vaalin candelabra cradling tapered bayberry candles.

title: [Cultivated Couturier, Showroom]
description: Dark violet silk drapes over twin poles of ebonwood placed at either side of the area, giving the tent a spacious interior.  A pair of velvet-covered trays rest upon a beautifully carved table.  Displayed on a polished copper rack, a wide variety of colorful garments hang above a small wooden stand containing a variety of sandals.  Several glaes orbs hang from the supports, illuminating the shop with a warm glow.

title: [Elementary]
description: The wooden walls bear numerous singe and scorch marks along with stains less identifiable.  The various hazardous materials inside the wagon are each secluded behind their own protective barriers and railings.

title: [Nishaye Accoutrements]
description: Twin drapes of coppery marbrinus frame the slightly arched doorway, their fluid lengths transitioning perfectly into walls of polished kakore.  Golden blazestar orbs set into bronze filigree sconces pulsate brightly, providing their unique illumination.  The floor is overlaid in a lush carpet of azure, and a heavy pleated curtain of merlot damask leads into the shop.

title: [Nishaye Accoutrements]
description: Dapples of sunlight filter through the panes of three floor-length windows to spill over a glistening lacquered floor of kakore.  Patterned with copper-painted fireleaf leaves, the textured cream walls are studded with brass candle sconces, contributing to the warm natural light.  Several fan-carved lacewood racks and an enameled azurite table act as homes for a variety of lush trappings.

Dapples of moonbeams filter through the panes of three floor-length windows to spill over a glistening lacquered floor of kakore.  Patterned with copper-painted fireleaf leaves, the textured cream walls are studded with brass candle sconces, contributing to the warm natural light.  Several fan-carved lacewood racks and an enameled azurite table act as homes for a variety of lush trappings.

title: [Nishaye Accoutrements]
description: Continuing from the western room, the kakore plank floor glows warmly beneath the sunlight that spills from a broad window of artfully distorted glass.  Marble tiles overtake the golden wood as it transitions northward, their soft creamy hue mirroring the textured walls and ceiling.  A framed spray of preserved fireleaf leaves is flanked by two bronze sconces above a glossed red maple trestle table.

Continuing from the western room, the kakore plank floor glows warmly beneath the moonlight that spills from a broad window of artfully distorted glass.  Marble tiles overtake the golden wood as it transitions northward, their soft creamy hue mirroring the textured walls and ceiling.  A framed spray of preserved fireleaf leaves is flanked by two bronze sconces above a glossed red maple trestle table.

title: [Nishaye Accoutrements]
description: Glass mirrors, set at angles to one another, cover the the textured walls nearly to the creamy ceiling, and the off-white marble flooring is touched with hints of gold and grey.  A gleaming staircase of highly polished kakore planks is supported by rigid spirals of bronze piping.  Leading upward to a second story cabin, the entrance is blocked by a thick golden satin cord.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Second Floor]
description: Exquisitely crafted heavy wool tapestries cover every wall in this generously sized room.  Each tapestry looks to be devoted to a different branch of the arcane arts and is filled with images and sigils that hint at hidden meanings.  Thick, colorful rugs cover the chilly stone floor, complementing the colors and patterns of the tapestries.  The well-lit room is devoid of furniture or any obvious light-source, and the unexpected fragrance of ozone permeates the air.

title: [The Petrous Parlor]
description: Finespun brocaded tapestries conceal the walls of the tower, splitting before a recessed archway at the rear of the room.  The ceiling is swirled with darkly iridescent jewel-toned pebbles, the sunlight streaming in from a small bay window enhancing their colors and splashing over a paneled faewood wardrobe and a velvet-lined mossbark case.  Book-filled nooks flank the back of the space, drawing the eye to a bas-relief antique copper curio standing at the center.

Finespun brocaded tapestries conceal the walls of the tower, splitting before a recessed archway at the rear of the room.  The ceiling is swirled with darkly iridescent jewel-toned pebbles, the moonlight streaming in from a small bay window enhancing their colors and splashing over a paneled faewood wardrobe and a velvet-lined mossbark case.  Book-filled nooks flank the back of the space, drawing the eye to a bas-relief antique copper curio standing at the center.

title: [The Petrous Parlor, Alcove]
description: A single back corner of the stony alcove is neatly organized and left primarily untouched, save for a plush nacre velvet settee placed behind a half-moon marble table.  Beeswax candles in domed glass lanterns are interspersed throughout the space, illuminating the recessed archway and furnishings with a soft, golden glow.

title: [Precious Stones, Entry]
description: The heavy wooden doors open into a large, austere room.  At regular intervals, elaborately carved sconces dot the walls.  Though plentiful, the wall-sconces' flickering lights provide poor illumination in the cool, dank room.  The macabre, chiseled designs of the candleholders cast frightful, looming shapes upon the smooth stone walls.  A large portrait of a rather small and unassuming man is the lone decoration adorning the walls of the room.

title: [Precious Stones, Antechamber]
description: Windowless and stuffy, this tomb-like room is clearly being used as a workroom.  A slab of granite serves as a worktable, and two wooden crates have been carefully stacked against an interior wall.

title: [Draped in Darkness, Shop]
description: Heavy curtains of pristine black velvet conceal the gold-framed windows of the room, the fabric allowing mere slivers of light to focus upon a thorn-carved ebonwood table set within the middle of the shop.  Set alongside the table is a tall alum-framed mirror, the piece barely illuminated by single twisted obsidian taper.

title: [The Ivory Mask]
description: Creamy white walls are inset along the borders with colorful gem shards, creating a clean, but soft, atmosphere.  Framed by lace curtains, several windows allow sunlight to pour in and glint off of several of the many decorative masks that hang from the ceiling.  Across from an armoire, a crystal case is crowded with items on display, and a gold-painted arch leads further into the wagon.

Creamy white walls are inset along the borders with colorful gem shards, creating a clean, but soft, atmosphere.  Framed by lace curtains, several windows allow moonlight to pour in, and a broad collection of flame-lit candles sitting in silver sconces illuminates various decorative masks that hang from the ceiling.  Across from an armoire, a crystal case is crowded with items on display, and a gold-painted arch leads further into the wagon.

title: [The Ivory Mask, Sitting Room]
description: Dim shafts of moonlight filter in through several glass-paned slits in the ceiling, combining with the luminary efforts of a lavish arrangement of candles to create a brightly lit area.  Several divans and couches sit against the walls, surrounding a gilt-edged mistwood table.  A large portrait hangs on the far wall in between two smaller pieces of artwork.

Shafts of sunlight filter in through several glass-paned slits in the ceiling, combining with the luminary efforts of a lavish arrangement of candles to create an intensely bright area.  Several divans and couches sit against the walls, surrounding a gilt-edged mistwood table.  A large portrait hangs on the far wall in between two smaller pieces of artwork.

Dim shafts of moonlight filter in through several glass-paned slits in the ceiling, combining with the luminary efforts of a lavish arrangement of candles to create an brightly lit area.  Several divans and couches sit against the walls, surrounding a gilt-edged mistwood table.  A large portrait hangs on the far wall in between two smaller pieces of artwork.

title: [Rahb's Wonderful Wagon, Den]
description: White satin drapes cover the gold painted walls that peek out from underneath.  The satin falls onto the floor that is completely covered in some soft blue satin pillows, creating a comfortable atmosphere that is accented by the corner table holding an ample supply of tea.

title: [Diamond and Carbuncle]
description: Golden-hued linden paneling encloses this cozy wagon, ending just above the thickly cushioned benches which line three of the four walls.  Pairs of rectangular windows stand on either side of the wagon's entry, each shuttered and draped with plush red and white striped velveteen.  On the opposite wall, a row of carved linden pegs displays some of the clothing sold in the wagon, and the remainder of the wares are piled haphazardly in a capacious ebonwood trunk.

title: [Cultivated Couturier, Salon]
description: Separated from the main room of the tent by a curtain of glaes-beaded strands, this small nook is filled with bolts of cloth and baskets of thread.  Various patterns, needles, and scissors cover the surface of a large worktable.  Several small benches are placed about a thick wool carpet covering the ground.

title: [An Affront to Fashion]
description: Smooth stone makes up the walls, while a large crimson rug covers most of the floor.  In the center of the room stands a large oak table, while a series of maoral hooks hang along one wall.  In the rear of the room a carved cherrywood door leads into the back chamber.

title: [An Affront to Fashion, Alcove]
description: One large lamp hangs from the ceiling providing illuminate for this small alcove.  Nearly the entire surface of the stone floor is covered by a thick, plush crimson rug.  A long wooden bench runs the length of the rear wall.

title: [Precious Stones, Nook]
description: The wooden crates creak underneath your weight, but you're rewarded by a bird's eye view of the workroom below.  In the dim lighting you can make out some small holes in the wall closest to you.

title: [Cutter Chaos, Workshop]
description: Tiny chains dangle from the ceiling, suspending several metal skeletons in various states of completion.  An extensive assortment of metalworking tools are haphazardly stored in steel trays set upon the stacks of boxes arranged around the workshop.  Hastily scrawled design sketches have been tacked along the walls, covering up most of the space.  Resting upon a wobbly, three-legged stool is a pile of sweat-stained rags.

title: [Pebbles With Power]
description: Loose rocks and stone lay haphazardly about the chamber.  Deep grooves mar the walls, creating a crisscrossed pattern.  A single candle sheds muted light across the room, making shadows dance while leaving the outer perimeter dark.

title: [A Gneiss Guy, Workroom]
description: Large and spacious, this underground room is cold and damp.  A granite leg leans at an angle against a large cracked chalk-dusted worktable.  The occasional drip of water can be heard from an iron rung ladder.

title: [Office of the Seneschal]
description: The floor is covered in a silver-on-blue patterned carpet, which hides almost all of the stone beneath its fine fabric, leaving only a small margin around the room's edges.  A fireplace takes up one wall, the space over its mantle occupied by a framed portrait.  Other paintings, each one suspended down a length of sapphire ribbon, hang alongside the frame of a silver doorway.  A cushioned settee and matching chair are positioned to take advantage of the hearth's warmth.

title: [Bromn's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a pearl-handled filigreed mandolin hangs on one of the smooth granite walls.  A gilded maple cabinet sits in one corner while a stuffed striped rolton rests on the celadon marble floor.

title: [Hale Hall, Administration]
[Hale Hall, Selbi's Office]
description: This small space is clearly intended for work, not leisure.  A simple wooden desk sits to one side, piles of parchment mounded high on its surface.  A many-paned window allows for a great deal of natural light, though the walls bear several unlit torches which stand ready, should their illumination be required.  Interspersed around the area are a collection of padded benches.

Stark and utilitarian, this room still carries the slightest hint of fresh paint.  The walls are a neutral beige color, and the carpet underneath is only the barest shade darker.  Unobtrosive candleabras are placed in each corner, and their combined light illuminates all four corners evenly.  A series of wooden benches are arranged neatly in angled rows, each facing a small mahogany desk which sits directly beneath a frosted glass window.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Mess Hall]
description: Clusters of fighters, mostly dwarves, but including a fair showing of elves and men, are seated at several long tables running down the center of this large, rectangular room.  Occasionally, a new group arrives and helps themselves to the provisions from the simple sideboard before taking their place at a table.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Armory]
description: Racks of weapons and armor are arrayed in tight formation in this ample, square room.  The light from several polished invar lanterns gleams brightly on the sharp edges of the forest of blades.  An elderly dwarf hums softly to himself as he moves among the smithwork, polishing each piece with a soft cloth.

title: [Public Baths, Annex]
description: Golden tracery runs along the edges of the vaulted ceiling, flowing downwards in a tight spiral along the numerous white columns supporting the room.  Pale, featureless ivory masks are set in niches along the wall, each wrapped in a warm glow by the small candles placed behind them.  A black-veined white marble arch leads west and an arch of golden hue leads east, while a long rich velvet carpet stretches on into a dark corridor.

title: [Public Baths, Annex]
description: A circular mosaic is inlaid upon the floor, its vivid colors bringing to life a scene of a large ship hurtling through a storm-tossed sea.  Sapphire blue knotwork twines across the perimeter of the expansive mural, its lustrous surface gleaming in the faint illumination.  Four doors, one each in verdant green, sky blue, deep blue or dark red, engraved with the faint impressions of gentle waves fill the gaps between the tall columns lining the walls and a bright light filters in from the north.

title: [Public Baths, Annex]
description: A wide, circular room opens up before you, its pale ivory walls reflecting the bright light cast by the numerous brass candelabras placed throughout it.  Golden shields adorned with thin looping patterns have been hung upon the twin rows of columns that mark a path to a closed door.  The same arcing designs flow across the varnished wood of the door, slightly obscured by a fine mist of water droplets that continually drip down its surface.

title: [Steam Room]
description: A massive golden sun is inlaid upon the ceiling, its wavy stylized flames radiating outwards in a beautiful pattern.  Droplets of water occasionally drip down from the rounded gleaming design, disappearing in a sharp hiss as they land upon a small pile of heated rocks in the center of the room.  Dark ash benches are stacked against the walls, each enshrouded by a hazy steam that pervades the chamber with its muggy heat.

title: [Fiery Bath]
description: Wavy crimson-hued flames of gold encircle the perimeter of a shallow pool upon the floor, their surfaces dappled with droplets from the steam continually rising up from the waters surface.  The encroaching walls are painted in soft shades of scarlet and textured slightly to resemble the swirls of a roaring inferno.  A bench trimmed with wispy patterns of graceful design sits next to a lustrous circular mahogany table, a collection of multi-hued pots set upon it.

title: [Oceanic Bath]
description: The surroundings are cloaked in mixed shades of light green and deep blue, only a few candles about you piercing the moody darkness settled over the area.  Water within a small pool upon the floor shifts and reflects the faint light in wavy cerulean flickers, its heat being more felt than seen amidst the rich hues of the room.  The warm glow of the candles causes a collection of pots resting upon a small table to glint softly as the tiny flames rise and fall continuously.

title: [Sky Bath]
description: Walls painted in muted shades of white and blue surround you, imparting the feeling of the expansive outdoors within the sparse confines of the room.  Steam rises in languid wisps from a small circular pool within the center of the room, the slight haze obscuring the puffy, swirling clouds rendered upon the ceiling.  A small pale white bench sits near the eastern wall, a table draped with a covering of the same hue positioned directly next to it.

title: [Ivy Bath]
description: Dark green ivy has been painted along the edges of the pure white walls, twining about each other in a gentle embrace upon the low ceiling.  A small pool bubbling with wisps of steam is set in the middle of the room, and a small wooden bench padded with verdant green leather is propped up against the wall next to it.  Rich, celadon-hued velvet drapes across a small russet wooden table, and a few pots filled with dark oils rest atop it.

title: [Cold Baths]
description: Gleaming silver tridents are set upon the wall, adding a touch of brightness to the swirling deep blue hue of the surrounding walls.  Many small pools are aligned in neat rows about the floor, their surfaces rippling with reflected light.  Faint wavy patterns flow along the dark tiles between the different pools, resembling the gently undulating waves of an ocean current.

title: [Hot Baths]
description: Serpentine gold-scaled dragons flank the sides of a large pool bubbling with heat stretching across the room.  Rearing out of the watery depths is a glittering drakes head statue, its maw open to gush forth a huge stream of steaming hot water high up into the air and back down with a splash.  Lustrous marble columns ringed with silver leaves mark the edges of the circular pool, their surfaces trailed with tiny droplets.

title: [Darkened Hall, Oculus]
description: This space is perfectly round, with a gently sloping ceiling that rises to a small opening at its peak.  Through this opening, the light outside comes through and strikes a deeply-flawed crystal mounted in the floor.  The floor underneath is firmly packed dirt, and the walls are sheer stone, but the room is curiously bereft of the echoes one would expect from such a space.

title: [Arv's General Store]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  An oval-shaped speckled marble counter and an engraved copper bin sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Mist Harbor, Peninsula]
description: The loam and silt of the recently-submerged earth that forms this peninsula is sporadically dotted with various forms of plant life, lying limp without the supporting waves.  On three sides, the water is held aside by unseen hands, forming an invisible wall that holds back the angry sea.  A decrepit rope bridge stretches from one end of the peninsula back towards the mainland, barely skirting the unnaturally stationary water beneath it.

title: [Mist Harbor, Peninsula]
description: The loam and silt of the recently-submerged earth that forms this peninsula is sporadically dotted with various forms of plant life, lying limp without the supporting waves.  On three sides, the water is held aside by unseen hands, forming an invisible wall that holds back the angry sea.  A decrepit rope bridge stretches from one end of the peninsula back towards the mainland, barely skirting the unnaturally stationary water beneath it.

title: [Bee-eater Table]
description: This circular wooden table is painted a jungle-green hue and decorated with leafy plants.  The chairs are colored the same green hue.  Hiding among the leaves on the table are several brightly colored bee-eaters, each one painted in a different pose.

title: [Toucan Table]
description: Circular in shape, this table is painted in concentric rings of color, beginning with yellow on the outer rim and moving to orange, blue, green, and finally red in the center.  Toucan feathers are lacquered onto the seats of the chairs, the array of colors bright against the black of the chairs.

title: [Macaw Table]
description: The yellow-painted, circular table is surrounded by blue and green chairs.  The colors are accented by brightly hued macaw feathers that are lacquered onto the table top in an alternating zig-zag pattern around the circumference.  A vivid macaw, with outstretched wings, is painted in the center of the circle of feathers.

title: [Broadbill Table]
description: This fawn-hued table is covered in overlapping and conjoining designs that, at first glance, appear to be geometric in origin.  Upon closer inspection, the pattern proves to be varying colors and sizes of broadbills, with outstretched wings, painted in rings around the table.

title: [Parrot Table]
description: Painted a solid, emerald green, this table is circular in shape and surrounded by pale golden-hued chairs.  On the seat of each chair, an emerald-green parrot has been painted in various poses.  Each parrot peers out from its perch with shiny black eyes.

title: [Turtle Table]
description: Painted with overlapping, variegated, brown and green rectangles, like those on a turtle's shell, this circular table sports matching, pale-green chairs.  At the places where the arms, legs, head, and tail would be, the table is indented and painted black, so that the overall piece resembles a turtle tucked into its shell.

title: [Underground, Atelier]
description: Though cramped, these small living quarters are as well appointed as any in an underground cavern might be.  Heavy iron sconces burning fragranced oil are mounted near the ceiling, invisible currents of air whipping the flames and teasing the smoke away through a crack in the stone.  A raised platform bed is tucked against the wall, pillows and an array of blankets and heavy furs layering the top.  Little more than an overturned ale cask and an accompanying stool serves as a small desk.

title: [Underground, Cavern]
description: Situated at a distance from the cistern, the balmy scent of the sea is faint here, barely present at all beneath the overriding stench of decay that hangs in the air like an ominous shroud.  Dark stains in thin trails and smeared handprints lead deeper into the area, most terminating at the edge of a discolored segment of stone in the cavern floor that stretches upward into the wall.  There is little else here save the odd oil lamp and bits of debris filling cracks and crevices in the stone.

title: [Idip Udip Wedip, Loft]
description: Low ceilings and tight quarters create a cramped workspace.  Several plush caramel devore pillows litter the floor in a haphazard fashion, the only area kept clear near a skinny ladder.  Twin potted ferns flank a squat table of lacquered pine that sits against the loft's short railing.

title: [Boneyard, Burial Mounds]
description: Rocky outcroppings rise before a narrow trail that ascends to the courtyard above, the water-smoothed faces of each housing fitfully burning candles that are losing the battle against staving off the gloom and mists that haunt this land.  Tall and dark, an enormous cocobolo tree dominates the grassy area forcing the trail to split and circumvent its looping roots.  The thick haze and salty air have turned the greenery sallow, which in turn creates the cloying scent of rot and stagnation.

Rocky outcroppings rise before a narrow trail that ascends to a courtyard above, the water-smoothed faces of each housing fitfully burning candles that are losing the battle against staving off the gloom and mists.  Tall and dark, an enormous cocobolo tree dominates the grassy area forcing the trail to split and circumvent its looping roots with some weed-covered graves scattered about either side.  The thick haze and salty air have turned the greenery sallow, creating the cloying scent of rot and stagnation.

title: [Boneyard, East Extension]
description: Stark white against the gloom of the area, stones leeched of color rise like jagged teeth along the north edge of the small clearing, their smooth faces providing a line of defense against a hazardous plunge into the waiting sea below.  Tufts of silky yellow grass spread across the gently sloping landscape as it ascends toward an enormous cocobolo tree to the southeast.  Wind slips through the porous rocks nearby to create an eerie, whistling tune that is punctuated by the steady rhythm of crashing waves.

Stark white against the gloom of the area, stones leached of color rise like jagged teeth along the north edge of the small clearing, their smooth faces providing a line of defense against a hazardous plunge into the waiting sea below.  Tufts of silky yellow grass spread across some dirt-covered graves dug into the sloping landscape as it ascends toward a giant cocobolo tree to the southeast.  Wind slips through the porous rocks nearby to create an eerie, whistling tune punctuated by the steady rhythm of crashing waves.

title: [Grifty Shades of Fae, Backroom]
description: Noticeably cooler than the area above, this area seems to be more recessed below the ground.  A bowl made of a large resin-encased leaf and a carved wooden tray stand side by side on a natural rock ledge from which a large strip of bark is hung.  Sitting on the ground, a hollowed out log is nestled close to the mass of roots that leads upwards.  In darkened corner, you can just make out the image of a braided vine ladder which leads through a narrow hole in the ground.

title: [Boneyard, West Extension]
description: Laying in the shadows of the island, the small clearing is dominated by mist and gloom.  Looping roots prevent light from falling upon the ascending pathway that climbs to the northeast, while large boulders rise like titans to shield the sea beyond.  Some past visitor has decorated the arboreal appendages of an enormous cocobolo tree with votives and tallows, but the insidious attention of the winds has robbed them of their flame.

title: [A Hidden Chamber, Overlook]
description: This asymmetrical alcove slants downward as it deepens, with the furthest edge of the ceiling cracked and sheared off by massive slabs of stone that have lanced through the earth as if dislodged at some point by a tremendous quake.  The effect is a staggered wall of stony plates, their uneven lengths creating windows into the open cavern that lies beyond.  Icily chilled gusts whistle through the cracks and up through a heavily warded doorway that leads to a downward set of steps, lending an almost frosty quality to the air.

title: [A Hidden Chamber, Nexus]
description: A stone pillar stands in the center of this chamber and is accessable only by a raised stone walkway that stretches over a series of concentric channels carved into the floor around it.  The channels are brimming with water, fed from an unseen source, and their surfaces roil constantly but softly, filling the area with a lulling whisper of the movement.  Several oil lamps mounted along the curve of the back wall offer fitful illumination to the narrow opening that leads deeper into the rocky surroundings.

title: [Underground, Sacrificial Altar]
description: The rough dimensions of this chamber suggest it was formed by some manner of calamity, with its rocky floor spanning only two-thirds of the depth from one wall to another before dropping off into a sheer chasm that echoes with the flow of water from somewhere below.  Near the edge is an elaborate altar of stone and ghezyte, and before it stands a raised stone slab and an imposing crossed timber rack, the stone around each stained ruddy and dark.  At the rear of the chamber is a heavily warded doorway that leads up a set of steps, and on the far end, imbedded in the wall, is a discolored section of stone.

title: [The Betterment Boutique]
description: Dozens upon dozens of chandeliers of multitudinous sizes and designs drip down from the ceiling at varying lengths, with several hanging so low that they brush the ground.  The majority of the chandeliers are fully aflame with light, save for the unlit handful suspended over the dead center of the area.  Interspersed between several of the larger, more elaborate pieces are several hard-backed steel chairs, with thin, jaggedly shaped mirrors and tiny steel grates imbedded into the floor around them.

title: [The Betterment Boutique]
description: The pale and dark blues of the tent swiftly transition to a deep scarlet color overhead, spreading all of the way down the walls to the floor.  Twists of especially dark fabric, arranged in noose-like configurations, peel down from above to drape over several hard-backed steel chairs.  Surrounded by a semi-circle of ivory candles, their wax pooling on the floor, a single gold-framed mirror reflects the wavering candlelight.

title: [Grifty Shades of Fae, Playroom]
description: Ambient light flickers through this subterranean alcove from a few scattered candles, illuminating a smooth stone table ringed by some soft piles of heather.  Barely noticeable, a braided vine ladder reaches up from the shadows through a hole in the ceiling.

title: [Verdant Slope, Blighted Tree]
description: Nicks and scratches in the ancient interior of the hollowed-out tree indicate that it was purposefully molded by mortal hands at some point in its history.  Thick slime, brought on by saltwater and decay, coats the walls, which are also dimpled by bone white barnacles that trace a sinuous track from the thick, dirt-covered ground towards the dark canopy where they disappear.  Strangely free of debris, a small stone circle rests in the center of the space and is surrounded by larger sitting stones.

title: [Underground, Atelier]
description: A natural spring bubbles up into a stone-edged basin in the floor, bringing both moisture and a balmy chill that is somehow more biting than that of the stone.  On iron brackets, a small shelf is mounted to the wall and draped with a sash of indigo elesine, and atop it are a variety of tools and implements with any number of purposes.  Beneath the shelf is a chest, scarred and aged, and a pickaxe propped against the wall behind it.

title: [Underground, Tunnel]
description: Though it cannot be seen beyond the slanted crevice that leads through the tunnel wall, the sea makes itself known in the salt scenting the air and the crashing sound of waves that reverberates through the stone.  The air that wafts in is fresh and cool, though heavy with humidity, a bright promise of what lies beyond the stone.

title: [Underground, Charnel Pit]
description: The stone walls that enclose this pit are bare save the inordinate amount of gore that clings to the rough-hewn stone, and the stench of rot and decay are so pervasive that breathing is a difficulty.  Underfoot, instead of stone, there are bodily remains, too numerous to count and in such a state as to defy ready identification.  All are in varying stages of decomposition, from bare bones scarred by obvious cut marks to nearly fresh corpses, bloated and distended with putrefaction.  Ankle-deep water covers the floor.

title: [Underground, Tunnel]
description: Fed from a source deep within the stone, water sluices along the channel, joined from the grate above by the drip, drip, plop of indeterminate fluids that smell distinctly of rot.  Though the curved floor of the tunnel is slick, it's large enough to crawl toward a faint light that distantly filters in.

title: [Underground, Tunnel]
description: Dark deposits coat the floor of the tunnel, slime and mold and other unnamable things that have taken root beneath the shallow run of water, making every inch crawled fraught with danger of slipping.  The fetid odor of rot is an undercurrent to the rising scent of stagnant sea water, and beyond the wan infusion of light, the sound of waves crashing can be heard.

title: [Underground, Tunnel's End]
description: The tunnel floor continues for only a few feet more before it sheers off sharply here, an open drop into a pool of water below.  Sheltered by an overhang of rock, the narrow crevice between is just large enough to squeeze through.

title: [On the Throne]
description: Tattered, sun-bleached canvas is draped over the wooden bows of the wagon frame, providing a makeshift shelter against the island winds.  The floor is littered with straw from unpacked crates that have been overturned and used as displays for merchandise, while unopened boxes are stacked at the far back of the wagon.  A short set of steps lead out of the wagon.

title: [Misfit Toys, Entry]
description: Various patchwork tapestries cover the ceiling and hang down the walls in an overtly garish display of color.  A short counter runs the length of one of the wagon's walls, while a tall oak table rests against the opposite wall.

title: [Rum-inations, Barroom]
description: The sounds of merriment and revelry fill the establishment, where a small number of stools line up before a long papaya wood bar carved with elaborate palm frond designs.  A faded driftwood sign hangs next to a bronzed palm frond shelf behind the bar, where a portly rosy-cheeked bar keeper provides service to potential patrons.

title: [Rum-inations, Not A Pint Less]
description: The sweet aromas of pineapple, coconut, and other tropical fruits lazily caress your senses.  Standing near a heavy driftwood table, a cheeky brunette barmaid casually toys with a bottle in her hand while waiting for a group of contestants.  Beside the table, a carved wooden sign hangs neatly on the wall.

title: [Rum-inations, Not A Pint More]
description: The faint odor of fermented fruit drifts lazily towards you.  Standing near a heavy driftwood table, a cheeky blond barmaid casually toys with a bottle in her hand while waiting for a group of contestants.  Beside the table, a carved wooden sign hangs haphazardly on the wall.

title: [The Greavery]
description: The sounds of the outside world are but a din within this dark and quiet tent.  A candelabra thick with days of wax drippings casts its flickering light on an imposing iron rack and a low iron table, both laden with arm and leg greaves.  Atop a small leather-topped pedestal, a tastefully scripted note invites your attention.

title: [Misfit Toys, Backroom]
description: A myriad of supplies including skeins of yarn, spools of thread, bolts of cloth and boxes of buttons are stuffed into every nook and cranny of this wagon's backroom.  Unadorned wooden boxes are stacked in the corner, and half-finished dolls rest upon a workbench against the far wall.

title: [So Eely in the Morning]
description: Gnarled tree limbs serve as support for the tent's canvas lining as it sags at various points.  A reclaimed wood trunk rests centered upon a muddied reed mat.  Several broken and empty boxes are strewn across the floor.  Towards the back of the tent, an armoire stands off-balance, propped up on one side by a pile of old and decaying books.

title: [Caligos Isle, Oyster Pools]
description: Kidney-shaped tidal pools pockmark the black sands that stretch to the north, while boulders and rocky formations create a barrier that protects the tranquil waters from the waves beyond.  Every now and again, moonlight breaks through the heavy mist that clings to the beach and dances upon the white sands at the bottom of the tiny pools.  A rack of racks and nets is built against a set of rough oak steps that leads to a canopy in the east.

title: [Snack Shack]
description: The interior of this tiny wagon is awash in primary colors.  Brightly colored shelves cover nearly every square inch of the walls, their gilded curves glinting in the ambient light.  Tantalizing aromas fill the small space, emanating from somewhere behind the laquered counter at the rear of the wagon.

title: [Draped in Death, Parlour]
description: Flowing curtains of oxblood and obsidian velvet cover the walls of the wagon, leaving lit black iron sconces to cast macabre shadows across the spire-framed rack set against at the back of the shop.  A tall jet marble altar, framed by sanguine-stained bowls, sits within the center of the room, carved with flora in various stages of decay.

title: [Of the Cloth]
description: Strategically placed furnishings are paired with unusual light sources within this wide tent, and are used to create a room that is cast half in shadow and half in light.  Polished white birch trunks stand open upon the eastern wall beneath the steady glow of hundreds of tiny votives, while the western side is furnished with ebonwood armoires and low benches that are illuminated by the dim red glow of frosted orbs.  A long cloth-covered table rests in the divide between sides, its surface splashed with an equal measure of shadows and light

title: [Wingsong]
description: Crenelated and pewter-edged, watered silk squares dip from the ceiling to form a decorative overlay that hides the tent's support posts and complements the dark marine blue panels of the walls.  Blown glass fisher's orbs dangle from the ceiling, their interiors filled with votive stubs that burn brightly and provide a warm glow of light to the cramped space.  A low round table surrounded by plump cushions sits in the center of the room, while a large cloth-filled chest rests near the rear wall.

title: [Rise and Shine]
description: The wagon is coated with a fresh lather of pale yellow and gold paint blended into a pattern resembling the glow of a sunrise cast across its wooden walls.  Various work satchels and bags hang from hooks along the wall while a number of tools lay scattered along a stained wooden bench.

title: [The Boneyard]
description: The small pavilion reeks of damp wood and mulled wine.  Tall skeletal candlebras are positioned about the room, casting flickering shadows along the rough floor which is littered with tiny misshapen fragments of bones.  Suspended from the ceiling of the tent are countless cords beaded with miniature ivory skulls and segments of finger bones, each one rattling and clacking with the slightest island breeze.

title: [Tiny Treasures, Entry]
description: Brilliantly aglow with a dazzling array of lanterns, this tent is spotless.  Long wooden shelves run the length of the east and west walls, displaying a magnificent assortment of expertly crafted dolls.  Below each of the meticulously displayed dolls is a wooden bin filled with the basic models.  A small display table sits just inside the doorway, while a deep crimson rug edged with intricate gold threading creates a wide central aisle from which patrons can browse the wares.  Hanging from the ceiling is an ornate gilt sign.

title: [Tiny Treasures, Attire]
description: Brilliantly aglow with a dazzling array of lanterns, the clothing section is spotless.  Some intricately carved oak stands line the east and west walls.  Serveral racks on either side display tiny articles of clothing.  The deep crimson rug edged with intricate gold threading continues in from the south, maintaining the central aisle from which to browse the accessories.  An ornately gilded mirror stands proudly against the north wall, oddly out of place.

title: [The Big Tipper]
description: Woven reeds cover the dusty floor and add a slight hint of mold to this stuffy, cramped space.  Raised on a slanted crate is a short mahogany hat stand, which leans haphazardly to one side.  Across the room, a tall brass hat rack occupies a small sphere of light under a tarnished brass lantern with a soot-choked globe.

title: [Snips and Snails]
description: Mingling smells of acrid smoke, rotten eggs, and burnt hair permeate this enclosed shack.  A huge cauldron sits in a tiny stone hearth at one end of the room, the ceiling above stained black with soot.  A scarred wooden work table is pushed into one corner, a stool sitting in front of it, while a long battered wooden shelf is mounted directly above it.  A warped metal cabinet with corroded acid stains marring the front, the interior filled with wares, takes up almost the entire back wall.  A discolored wooden door leads to the backyard, its surface littered with a plethora of pinned papers covered in cramped handwriting.

title: [On Wing and Prayer, Entry]
description: Large area rugs cover the floor from wall to wall, concealing both the dirt and the building's lack of proper wooden floorboards.  A nearby driftwood table prominently displays wares for sale, while a braided rug basket rests off to the side.  Along the back wall runs a well-stocked sturdy shelf with additional goods hanging from the multicolored hooks directly below it.

title: [On Wing and Prayer, Sales Nook]
description: Additional wares are tucked away in this nook, with furniture placed in an arrangement that mimics the shop's entry room.  A prominent stout wooden table, with a woven basket propped up against its side, rests atop an area rug covering the floor.  A driftwood shelf lines the back wall directly above a series of display hooks.

title: [On Wing and Prayer, Quiet Nook]
description: Simple tapestries depicting island scenery cover the walls and provide a pleasant backdrop for devout prayers.  Candle-filled votives line the wall, their flickering light creating shadows which gently dance across the room in response to even the most subtle breeze.

title: [Old Sage's Jewels of the Isle]
description: Bamboo poles, wedged into rocks, support an off-white canvas canopy that ripples and snaps in the ocean-borne breeze.  Fitfully burning torches rise along the edges of the small shop that consists of a single table fashioned of salvaged driftwood.  Dipping and rising, the uneven ground of black sands and large boulders descends towards a beach pockmarked with tidal pools.  To make passage between the shop and beach safer, someone has constructed a set of rough oak steps.

title: [Caligos Isle, Mysterious Crypt]
description: A lone stone sarcophagus rests in the center of the crypt, seemingly unscathed by time or abuse.  The creation of the passage through the northern wall has all but destroyed a series of runic dwarven scrawlings in the stone, whatever message had been carved there completely illegible due not only to the missing pieces but the cracks and crumbling of the scant remains.  All that is left of the once-telling stone lies in crumbled piles crowded in the groove between the crypt wall and floor.

title: [Caligos Isle, The Seal]
description: Colored dwarven symbols are scattered across the area, each a different shape and size.  An otherworldly aura radiates from the walls, causing ethereal blue flames to wink into existence and make odd trails in the air.  A pair of skeletons lay helplessly on the floor.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Influx]
description: The sky above is broken and stained a menacing crimson hue, with lightning spearing across at intervals to illuminate the massive, bruised clouds against the ruddy backdrop.  Nothing of the incongruous heavens is solid or sure, though the ground is stable enough, black sands scattered deep over hard-packed earth.  A portal stands at the rear of the arena, corkscrewing within a frame set directly into the wall, its viridian mists chased by violet arcs of energy that charge the air with the scent of ozone.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, northwest, up, out

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Atrium]
description: The rising steps level into a tiled floor sheltered beneath a velarium of heavy onyx-hued fabric on a latticed metal frame.  Unable to weather the unrelenting gusts that seige colosseum at times, the cloth is badly frayed at the edges, thin strings left loose and tangled, while rents in the canopy reveal the crimson sky above.  A trio of pillars support the velarium, while the rear slants back directly into the cradle of the stone wall.  This leaves the view from three sides almost entirely unfettered.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Famine]
description: Staggered and broken pillars rise against the sanguine horizon, and between their fractured silhouettes can be glimpsed the movement of tenebrous shadows.  Somewhere between the clouds in the forefront and the sky behind, these long, sinuous tendrils coil and sway, tremendous and grasping as if to pull down the heavens.  Each lash of shadow is chased by an inhuman utterance, not quite a scream, more guttural and resonate, causing the ground to tremble and the air to hum with an unpleasant static.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, War]
description: Sporadic eruptions of lightning paint the uneven columns of the arena in a stark, monochrome palette and causes them to throw fitful shadows across the black sand underfoot.  Across the field, the only deviation to the continuous black is the occasional flash of white.  Closer examination reveals a femur here, a jawbone there, and it is soon obvious that nothing that survives here leaves whole, evidenced both by the remains left in haphazard repose and the shattered sky above.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Atrium]
description: The rising steps level into a tiled floor sheltered beneath a velarium of heavy onyx-hued fabric on a latticed metal frame.  Despite the ill condition of the colosseum at large, this open air atrium is relatively unscathed, offering a secluded repose high above the arena.  Braziers of wrought iron stand beside each support pillar, and the embers within burn with an unnatural red-violet glow.  A small niche is recessed into the rear wall, while a few stone benches sit in the center of the floor.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Pestilence]
description: Arranged among the travertine risers, spectators are seated, a scattering of fleshless skeletons that sit, heads lolled back or forward or to the side, while some are missing entirely.  The tattered remains of clothing cling to their bony forms, whipped at by errant winds that for brief moments breathe some measure of life into the long-dead corpses.  They, like the arena itself, remain, persisting against the tumultuous elements that rule this place, weathering the chaos and disarray with perseverance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, up

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Atrium]
description: The rising some shallow steps level into a tiled floor sheltered beneath a velarium of heavy onyx-hued fabric on a latticed metal frame.  Situated in the center of the atrium is a massive stone throne, its facade weathered yet still impressive with its sheer size and elaborate carvings.  Squat wrought-iron braziers sit on each side, their red-violet embers caged behind an iron shield pierced by cutouts that throw unnatural light across the fabric overhead, each shape a yawning maw exhaling ghosts of crimson flame.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Death]
description: Tremblors strong enough to dislodge unsecured bits of the stone walls roil beneath the black sands underfoot, and a resonate groaning fills the air, tremendous and concussive.  Unrelenting, the clamor is reflected in the sky, where a gnarled finger of red-violet lightning stretches the length of the crimson skyline.  For just a moment, the formidable countenance of a towering spire is illuminated in the distance, but as the flash fades, it recedes into the darkness once more.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Liabo Pier]
description: A curving blonde oak pier awards a sweeping view of a rock-bound bight that dominates the western half of the bay dissolves into a thicket of mountain hemlock and blue cypress trees veiled in powdery, silver-white snow.  Ethereal tendrils of brume hover over the coastline and slowly wend their way down the shore, emphasizing the uninhibited sky that crowns even the furthest reaches of the starlit sea.

title: [Jangling Junker, Bow]
description: At the bow of this mid-sized ship, stacks of debris are not so high as to impede view of the actual horizon, but are still an impressive collection of junk otherwise.  A large tangled net hangs from the foremast that drapes over the bow, strewn with old bones, empty painting frames, and other unusual objects.  Some salt-crusted barrels fill the space along the bow with a collection of random discarded detritus.  Behind a headless masthead, which is also missing a left arm, a hatch leads down below the crowded deck.

title: [Jangling Junker, Stern]
description: Frayed hempen ropes cross overhead, lined with old cooking utensils and broken weapons that jangle as the ship rocks on the swell.  Some old wardrobes lean precariously along the starboard side of this mid-sized ship, while mounds of stained canvas bags line the port.  Stacked on edge horizontally, unhinged doors of faded colors line the very back of the stern.  Amidst the clutter a hatch can be seen that leads down into the depths of the hull.

title: [Jangling Junker, Forehold]
description: Broken chairs are stacked to fill the bow side of this forehold.  Discarded furniture litters the already crowded area.  Racks filled with miscellaneous objects line the winding yet clear walkway through the maze of junk.  Hooks line the starboard wall, hung with dusty old discarded garments.  The only observable exits are a hatch up to the deck and a path through the maze towards the rear hold.

title: [Jangling Junker, Rear Hold]
description: Dim lighting illuminates this sizable hold filled to the roof with crates of questionable contents.  The musty scent of old leather mingles with the brine of salt water in the still air.  While the cramped area is crowded with junk, the footing remains clear and steady.  A narrow aisle weaves its way through the maze of crates towards the forehold, and a hatch overhead provides a means to return to the fresh air and deck above.

title: [A Mismatched Canvas Shelter]
description: Patchworked and mismatched, the bright canvas of the shelter stretches from railing-to-railing while its roof hugs the mast.  Carefully arranged piles of clutter bridge the gap between the chipped wooden floor and the bottom of the tightly tacked fabric, though faint moonlight still peeks through.  Positioned at the exact center of the open space is an elaborately carved cabinet that is lashed to the mast.

title: [Starfish Table]
description: Framed in dark iron, tumbled-smooth stones and pastel seaglass set in enamel form the mosaic table top, the layer of enamel trapped beneath a surface of rippled glass.  A tulip-shaped candle holder sits at the center, with an indigo tea candle flickering brightly within.  From time to time, a subtle breeze stirs the air, carrying with it breaths faint with honeysuckle.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Cursed Pit]
description: Ominous clouds of colorless grey lacerate the sky, dark claw marks against a firmament already bathed in crimson and broken with riotous lightning.  Whether a trick of the eye or reality in motion, the opaque murk seems to crawl when observed directly, yet when glimpsed from the corner of the eye, it races by.  The effect is disorienting, and accompanied by the near-constant flashes behind their veil, it makes the world outside of this crumbling arena seem to spiral unchecked within the abyss.

title: [Snips and Snails, Backyard]
description: Rickety wooden boards have been clumsily nailed together into a makeshift fence that encloses this area into a private backyard.  The ground is covered in overlapping tiny pawprints, chewed bones, and randomly dug holes, leaving the footing over the mud treacherous in some places.  A lopsided shelter made of wooden planks is set in one corner, while a round steel bowl full of raw bloody meat sits next to a similar bowl of water in the opposite corner.  A discolored wooden door leading back into the shack is the only way out.

title: [Modest Abode, Living Room]
description: A short brown bookcase lined with books stands behind a large oak table that is surrounded with chairs.  Residing near a blackened iron stove, a blue wash basin perches on a pale red cupboard filled with various herb-filled jars.  A green couch spreads out underneath a red-framed window across from the entry door.  Covering the entire floor of the room is a rug fashioned from various types of knotted cloth.  A curved arch passageway leads to another room in this modest abode.

title: [Modest Abode, Bedroom]
description: Standing on either side of a curved arch passageway that leads to another room of this modest abode are a dark stained wood dresser and tall brown wardrobe.  A large multi-colored quilt covers a bed residing near a red-framed window on the far wall, while two smaller bunk beds dressed with green knit blankets occupy the space on the other side of the room.  In the far corner, a white porcelain bathtub joins a small driftwood table bearing a matching pitcher and wash basin.

title: [On Wing and Prayer, Backroom]
description: Colorful area rugs stacked with piles of sitting cushions cover the large open floor of this multipurpose backroom.  A stack of wooden boxes along one wall is clearly marked as backstock inventory, while a worktable along another wall is covered in various repair tools and spare supplies.

title: [A Piercing Scream, Parlor]
description: A floor-to-ceiling crushed velvet curtain partitions off this cozy parlor from the rest of the tent, muffling the sounds of shoppers browsing just on the other side.  Pillows are haphazardly scattered across the floor like stepping stones in a pond, their meandering path leading to a small steel wash basin for washing up.  A silvery mistwood armchair, its finish marred by a myriad of crescent-shaped indentations, stands next to a full-length mirror framed in tangled golden trumpetvines.

title: [Rangers]
description: Painted in various shades of green, the walls are patterned with an elaborate leaf design and set at intervals with oil lamps covered by avian-styled shades.  A collection of rare hides and pelts are scattered about, and tapestries woven to depict various herbs and plants are draped from the ceiling.  A massive white bear skin occupies the heart of the room, its fur pristine and plush.

title: [Monks]
description: Like the color of freshly turned earth, the walls of this chamber are a deep brown hue dry-brushed with swaths of bronze and copper.  Illustrations framed in gilt-leafed oak show the evolution of unarmed combat, with everything from stances to armor to weaponry diagrammed in detail.  Pairs of handwoven hemp rugs are aligned against each wall, while a circular one sits at the center.

title: [Sandsilver Table]
description: Framed in dark iron, tumbled-smooth stones and pastel seaglass set in enamel form the mosaic table top, the layer of enamel trapped beneath a surface of rippled glass.  A tulip-shaped candle holder sits at the center, with an indigo tea candle flickering brightly within.  From time to time, a subtle breeze stirs the air, carrying with it breaths faint with honeysuckle.

title: [Whelk Shell Table]
description: Framed in dark iron, tumbled-smooth stones and pastel seaglass set in enamel form the mosaic table top, the layer of enamel trapped beneath a surface of rippled glass.  A tulip-shaped candle holder sits at the center, with an indigo tea candle flickering brightly within.  From time to time, a subtle breeze stirs the air, carrying with it breaths faint with honeysuckle.

title: [Draped in Death, Sitting Room]
description: The walls of the room are covered in vivid sanguine chalk, the symbols and sigils highlighted by an unknown lacquer.  The faint scent of incense and metallic notes permeates the area, the fragrance emanating from a thorn-carved armoire concealed by the shadowy atmosphere.

title: [The Greavery, Backroom]
description: A half-circle table dominates this otherwise unremarkable little room.  A few wobbly boxes face the table, serving as an improvised form of seating.

title: [Clouded Sundries]
description: Fresh azure paint covers the wood-paneled walls, and wispy white clouds are brushed onto the ceiling of this sun-lit room.  Metal windchimes hanging near an open window clink together in a song of the breeze.  The shop's wares are neatly showcased on some villswood shelving against the walls and a silver display case in the center of the room.

title: [Simple Cottage, Cozy Room]
description: Precariously stacked with all manner of dishes, pots, and pans, a low sky blue cabinet towers over the oak table and its matching pair of chairs in the far corner of the home.  Overstuffed chairs of dusty mauve, each flanked by round side tables, face a large stone fireplace and form a privacy wall with their tall backs that separates the living and sleeping spaces.  An ample bed covered in a patchwork quilt of burgundy rests its headboard against the furthest wall from the entry and is companion to a brown lacquered dresser.

title: [Simple Bungalow, Quarters]
description: Bunk beds, footed with oaken lockers, are stacked three high and line the pine walls of this utilitarian bungalow.  A large central table covered with mugs, plates, and discarded utensils occupies the center of the room, while a cast iron wood stove, whose pipe exits through the ceiling, squats next to a blue cupboard filled with various cooking pans.  Standing by the entry, a yellow cubbyhole shelf and a sturdy wooden rack offer space for boots and fishing equipment.

title: [Ferocious Thrak Table]
description: Wood chairs are pushed haphazardly against the long wooden table.  A dagger with a carved bone hilt pins a dried-out apple to the table, providing an interesting centerpiece.  A picture of a thrak baring its teeth is drawn in fading paint.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Entry]
description: Sunlight streams from the low glaesine dome above, gently dancing off the water cascading from a granite fountain placed centrally in the room.  Overhead, a bright blue and silver banner shimmers softly in the light.  Large potted ferns sit on the green marble floors next to stone benches that have been set up for relaxation and reflection.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, West Alcove]
description: Light from a glaesine skylight casts triangular patterns on the smooth marble floors and cream walls of this small alcove.  Muffled voices can be heard coming from the closed doors and from the lobby to the east.  Between two doors, a small portrait hangs above a rosewood case.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Fireside Room]
description: Tall windows face the courtyard outside, allowing natural sunlight to enter the room.  An overstuffed leather divan sits sideways in front of the fireplace, with two armchairs facing it.  Between the chairs is a low table with several drawers.  A small painting hangs above the mantle.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Flora Room]
description: Overhead, a mithril chandelier casts soft light on the patterned tile floor and floral-painted walls.  Two large divans sit facing one another, providing a cozy and informal setting.  Lush ferns in ornate clay pots have been placed casually near the modwir door.  In one corner of the room, a palm tree nearly obscures an odd statue.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Boar Room]
description: A rectangular monir table sits in the middle of the room, surrounded by high-backed padded chairs. Extra chairs have been placed along the wall to provide additional seating if necessary.  The giant head of a black boar has been hung on the wall.  Its beady glass eyes seem to survey the area, while an impressive display of weaponry has been mounted opposite it.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Exile Bar]
description: Candlelight from a large overhead chandelier illuminates this cozy space. Quiet chatting and laughter mix with the smell of roasting rolton coming from a nearby doorway.  A carved bar commands the center of the room with its graceful, serpentine shape.  The entire west wall has been given over to a colorful fresco.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Kitchen]
description: The smell of roasting rolton hangs in the air.  An elderly elf checks on several pots placed in the ash of the open-hearth oven that is built into the north wall.  Near the doorway, a glaes-inlaid tanik larder cabinet has been set up to provide a resting place for the freshly prepared foods.  Empty buckets lie next to the cabinet, and large pots and pans are stacked on a nearby shelf.  A large table has been set up in the center of the room for the preparation of the day's meals.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, East Alcove]
description: Sunlight from the skylight overhead glistens on a suit of full armor that stands between two of the doors.  A beautifully crafted sword mounted on fine rosewood hangs on the opposite wall.  Low voices can be heard coming from the west, but they are drowned out by the sound of running water.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, The Night Sky]
description: Tiny golden stars appear to twinkle overhead, lit by the soft glow of wall sconces.  The entire arched ceiling has been painted in varying shades of blue and black, reminiscent of the night sky.  Wooden chairs surround a fair-sized round table with a small dome set in the center.  Ancient charts have been hung together on the wall to form a display.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Shop]
description: Beautiful alabaster wall sconces are set above a large glass display case, illuminating the contents within.  Next to the case, a large tanik chest sits opposite a wall tapestry.  In a corner of the small room, a potted palm crowds up against the ceiling.

title: [Ta'Illistim Hall, Drake Room]
description: Thick, deep-green velvet drapes cover most of the walls of this enormous room, helping to insulate against noise.  At the head of the room, a podium has been set up surrounded on three sides by rows of wooden benches covered with green velvet cushions.  Behind the podium, a bronze statue of a large winged drake looms ominously.

title: [Villa, Black Drake Table]
description: Stretched out before you is a dimly lit modwir table topped with smooth green felt, a magnificent black drake adorning its surface.  The eyes of the beast stare straight ahead, seemingly following any movement.  Resting atop the felt is a low-burning tallow candle, as well as three bone white ivory dice.  Behind the table stands an elegantly garbed dealer, his eyes blind and vacant.  His expression remains cold while his stick flashes out to scoop up the cubes.
