title: [Firefly Villa, The Azure Room]
description: Large and spacious, the room is bathed in soothing colors that range in hue from azure to dark blue.  Pale drapes of saffron silk frame the etched glass doors that lead to a balcony, while the eastern and western walls are lined with a trio of canopy beds in matching colors.  At the heart of the room is an oblong ebonwood table that is surrounded by six chairs.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Courtyard]
description: Surrounded by a low stone wall made of remnants from previous constructions, an oddly-shaped building is almost hidden by creeping rope-like vines adorned with verdant heart-shaped leaves.  Sunlight reflects off the blackened windows, barely visible through the thickly growing vegetation.  A canted doorframe slants at a dramatic angle, and the modwir door swings open occasionally with a slight creaking sound.  Piercing the door near its top is a small, crooked lunette.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Foyer]
description: A beam of light streams through a crooked lunette carved into a slanted modwir door, creating a large half-moon shape on the grey floor tiles.  The walls mimic the tilt of the entryway, creating the discomforting sensation of falling.  A silvery glow extends up from the stone stairs that lead down and further into the temple.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Descent]
description: Stone stairs start out wide and even, then become more erratic and twisting back upon themselves in hairpin turns, traversing this passageway.  Each landing created by the snaking steps features a small wooden bench, and yet walls lit with bright oil torches are devoid of any art or tapestries.  A tiny cluster of silver bells is suspended from a small hook set into one of the bench arms.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Journey Chamber]
description: Dangling from the ceiling by a confusing array of ropes and pulleys, a half dozen harnessed clergy thrash about at various distances between the floor and the chamber's high ceiling.  In sharp contrast, a single robed figure hangs motionless among the chamber's occupants.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Anteroom]
description: In the chamber's center, a large stone sculpture is suspended parallel to the floor and about four feet above it.  The statue depicts a humanoid female clutching at the hem of her tunic, bringing it up to hide her face.  The smooth curves of her bared legs and the folds of her garment are still unmarred, but her head and upper torso have been disfigured and reduced to hammered stone.  Squatting beneath the statue, a pair of elven gentlemen wearing false beards and loincloths hammer busily at its bosom.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Confessional]
description: Entering this typical confessional proves to be anything but normal, as when the door closes, the far panel slides aside to reveal another small room.  A mix of voices can faintly be heard, melding together in a confusing murmur.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Apse]
description: This semi-circular room at the east side of the temple features a large silver crescent moon inlaid upon a floor of black marble edged with white alabaster.  A fresco of an ocean teaming with wildlife has been richly painted upon the ceiling, yet the walls feature a cloud-filled sunny sky.  Compounding the topsy-turvy distortion, moisture overhead falls in occasional large drops, seeping from some hidden underground water source.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Oratory]
description: Six stalls line the walls here, and feature a misericord in each small open-fronted enclosure.  Several are occupied by preaching clergy, their sermons alternately overrunning each other as they rise shrill with delusion or sink quietly into stammered muttering.  The cacophony completely overwhelms the harpsichord being played in the background by a gossamer-robed giantwoman, whose lips curl in a lunatic grin.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Refectory]
description: Armed with a large butcher knife, a priest meticulously spreads what appears to be cockroach marmalade on a thick slice of bread.  Completing the task, he picks up the piece of bread and flings it across the room against the far wall!  The bread sticks to the wall for a moment before sliding down to the floor to join the slumped forms of its predecessors, where a sizable crowd of live cockroaches appear to be helping themselves to the gratuitous feast.

title: [Temple of Phoen, Entry]
description: Worshipers and clergy pass through this barrel-vaulted chamber on their way in and out of the temple.  Interwoven with metallic threads, the clergy's pale golden robes appear to almost glow even in the shadows of the entryway.

title: [The Divine Sun]
description: Shafts of sunlight spear through the glaes dome, warming the smooth matte of clay tiles set into the floor of this vast chamber.  Hand painted with soft muted colors, the tiles are patterned to mirror the cerulean blue sky above on a clear day.  A whirl of pale white streaks across the surface of the tiles, barely clouding the glorious gold of the sun, adding the final touch to the celestial mosaic.  Brightly lit halls fork from the side of the chamber, leading further into the majestic temple.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [The Divine Sun, Hall]
description: Rivers of watered silk cascade over the walls in lavish tapestries.  Long-forgotten tales of history and lore unravel throughout the beautiful hangings, in delicate weavings of fine gold thread.  Relics bejeweled with blue sapphires and lapis are set in front of the tapestries, as homage to those woven into the draping silks.  Lancing across the halls, dazzling glares of light are reflected and guided by a cleverly positioned mirror on the western wall.

title: [The Divine Sun, Hall]
description: An antique mirror, framed in gold filigree, graces the entire length of the eastern wall in this corridor.  Light streams in from above and dances across the reflective surface of the mirror, casting beams of light toward the center of the temple.  Ceramic urns lining the walls are painted in the earthy hues of amber, brown, and russet.  A brilliant display of yellow sunflowers in full bloom fills the glossy urns, and perfumes the warm, breezy air with their distinctive fragrance.

title: [The Divine Sun, Center Chamber]
description: The temple's facetted glaes cap arches overhead, supported by sandstone pillars.  Deeply carved with designs of winged pegasi, the imagery on the pillars depicts these mystical creatures in flight towards the clear, sky lit ceiling.  Light focused by the lens is absorbed into a crystal orb and reflected outward in a radiant sunburst of gold that suffuses the entire chamber.  Frothy waters, flowing into an ornate bronze fount, gently caress and uplift the brilliant orb with their white-capped waves.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [The Divine Sun, Rotunda]
description: Summer-graced foliage from brass laurel trees surrounds the rotunda, eclipsing it in a cool shade.  Dominating the rotunda with its elevated structure is a high dais, with a handsome statue resting upon it.  Handwoven rugs of a grassy green are spread at the foot of the dais, allowing worshippers to pray in comfort.  As wind breezes through the hollow forest, lilting and flute-like tones blend into a harmonious melody with the soft chiming of swaying honey beryl leaves.

title: [Chapel of the Twins, Entry]
description: Embraced by the mirror-image ascents of two curved stairways, the antechamber is a relic of good taste tarnished by the cruelties of time and abandonment.  The floor is a checkerboard of white and black tiles, though age has riddled both hues with impurities and the stones with spidering cracks.  A tiered golden corona lies, bent and warped, in the shadow of the upper balcony.  Light filtering through mud-caked windows breathes prismatic life into shards of crystal scattered over the tiles.

title: [Chapel of the Twins, Overlook]
description: The passage of time has eaten away at the finish of a pair of scarred double doors, revealing silvery, splintered wood beneath.  Framed by the curve of a wrought iron banister, the balcony is bare of adornments, but echoes of rich hue and make in the carpeting allude to past finery.  The balcony overlooks an antechamber with a checkerboard floor of black and white marble that is in comparable disrepair.  Each descending stairway is crumbling and caked in dust.

title: [Chapel, Chantry of Grief's Wake]
description: Shrouds of violet-tinged ebon velvet hang from the ceiling, blocking out the feeble luminescence filtering through indigo stained glass windows along the western wall.  A chill permeates the air, though no breeze stirs the dense draperies.  Grey gauze cloaks an austere ash altar like curtains of moonlight.  Blazing from a caged sconce of dark silver mournbloom vines, a violet flame casts feeble radiance over a dark tapestry spread across the wall behind the altar.

title: [Chapel, Chantry of Blessed Sins]
description: To either side of the entry arch, the flames of twin candles flicker softly through a pair of translucent red glaes honeycombs to bathe the room in gentle carmine light.  Sounds are muted by the plush carpeting, whose sunny shade complements silk-slashed velvet drapes enshrouding a bower of monir heartwood.  Within, its snowy edges undimmed by the shadows in which it rests, resides a smooth rosewood altar that is partially draped in golden satin.  A vast and intricate tapestry spans the ceiling from wall to wall.

title: [Viridian Meadows, Pasture]
description: The grass in this area is uniform in both length and hue, creating a breathtaking panacea of emerald green.  An ornate wooden fence encircles the meadow in dazzling white, and each span of the fence contains a different equestrian silhouette at its center.  Each post in the fence is topped with a brass lion, brightly polished and facing outward, placid and regal.  At the far end of the meadow, a wide white barn with deep umber accents can be seen.

title: [Viridian Meadows, Barn]
description: This barn is cavernous, but still very well lit via the combination of flickering flames emanating from delicate ivory sconces at regular intervals around the perimeter of the barn, and a discreet smattering of indirect lighting from various windows placed in the ceiling.  The floor underfoot is straw, but it is clean and sweet-smelling, and has been carefully raked to lie flat.  The center of the space contains a large number of chests and crates, each one placed directly across from a stall.

title: [Cavern, Entry]
description: Enormous black iron doors, their faces carved with labyrinthine whorls and bas-relief tunnels, stand as a formidable guard to the world beyond the cavern.  Wide bronze braziers, each set equidistant from their neighbor, line the long corridor, their brightly glowing coals casting shadows on the distant ceiling.  Painted onto the smooth walls are a series of bright blue, azure, and white murals.

Rough-hewn walls to either side and a similarly-crafted ceiling overhead form the entry to a large, well-worked cavernous space.  The floor underneath is perfectly smooth, and uniformly grey in color.  The slight scent of incense tinges the air, carried by the minutest hint of a breeze, drifting down the entryway towards the cavern proper.

title: [Cavern, Altar Room]
description: Vaulted and wide open, the cavern is illuminated by the numerous torches that are hung in large wrought iron rings anchored to the smooth stone walls.  High in the distant ceiling is a wide hole that allows sunlight to cast its golden glow upon a smooth round stone altar that has been placed in the center of the chamber.  Overlapping thick azure rugs ring the room's single piece of furniture, their faces decorated with interlocking whorls and geometric shapes.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Ziethsmet's Home, Entry]
description: Brilliant white walls give way on one end to a polished floor of interwoven teak and cedar, while the other end supports a stucco ceiling fitted with tiny frosted glass globes.  Decorative paintings are arranged along a solid wall that shares its space with an open stairway, while the other three walls are fitted with enormous floor-to-ceiling windows of painted glass.  A series of settees and chairs are scattered about the space, each positioned to face an extremely low linden table.

title: [Ziethsmet's Home, Patio]
description: Turquoise and saffron tiles create a checkered pattern through the small patio, which is surrounded by a bounty of brightly colored flowers and oversized plants.  White benches nearly disappear in the lush foliage of the tiny garden, while a pair of cupboards rest close to the outer walls of the cottage.  A small cooking pit, located directly opposite the cottage's entry, is surrounded by baking bricks and cast iron cookware, each stacked in neat and tidy rows.

title: [Ziethsmet's Home, Bedroom]
description: Fully open to the stairs, the tidy bedroom serves as both sleeping quarters and an artisan's crafting space.  While the right half of the room is filled with a small bed, a plain footlocker, and a simple armoire, the left is almost cluttered with a floor-to-ceiling bookcase that houses several porcelain pieces of artwork, various painting jars, and a collection of paintbrushes.  An easel, its canvas splattered with paint, sits in a lone corner and has a nest of frosted glass globes suspended over it.

title: [Tolby's Cottage, Hearth Room]
description: The strong aroma of cinnamon permeates from a wooden archway and fills the small living quarters.  A pink sandstone fireplace dominates one wall while a thick seagull-emblazoned rug spreads out before it.  A varnished rocking chair rests before a wide glass window, and a small driftwood table is angled in a corner.

title: [Tolby's Cottage, Kitchen]
description: The entire length of one wall has been turned into a baker's paradise, lined with numerous large brick stoves.  A broad table occupies the center of the kitchen while a short wooden rack sits near a wooden archway.  There rests a sturdy footstool next to a squat mahogany bookcase, and the strong scent of cinnamon hangs thick in the air.

title: [Tolby's Cottage, Bedroom]
description: Just off the kitchen, the bedroom is quaint and remains cooled by the tropical breeze drifting through an open window.  A tiny bed is pushed against a wall, and a carved wooden nightstand rests next to it.  A maoral-framed painting hangs crookedly above an untidy writing desk.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: Torchlight flickers across the polished surfaces from sconces carved into the walls at regular intervals.  The small circular landing in the stairs provides enough room for several doors and a bit of standing room to rest on before continuing up or down.

title: [Briggette's Room]
description: A hearth of twisted fel tree trunks takes up most of the wall opposite the door.  The fire within casts its ruddy glow about the room, adding an almost lifelike cast to the carving of the red fox guarding a basket of acorns near it.  Across from the fireplace stands a six-legged desk, the smooth front broken only by a single long drawer.  A travel-worn cloak lies strewn across the bed, partially obscuring the muted tapestry spread beneath.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Guest Room]
description: This bedchamber is lavishly and exotically decorated.  A velvet-covered couch sits in the front corner of the room behind a low mahogany table, looking on several Dhe'nar relics and weapons set into niches in the walls.  In the back corner sits a large canopy bed, the thick dark curtains promising rest safely tucked away from the light.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Guest Room]
description: This guestroom is modest but tasteful.  The walls are hung with several small tapestries depicting various Dhe'nar battles, and velvet curtains frame the glaes window.  A large bed with quilted covers and overstuffed pillows lies in the center of the room, with a matching nightstand sitting beside it.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: This plateau in the stairs is decorated with various Dhe'nar relics which provide a distraction to the vertigo-inspiring twist of stairs below them.  Stairs also lead upwards to a landing high above.  An odd electrical sensation makes your skin tingle, setting your hairs slightly on end.

title: [Dabu's Room]
description: A gentle, rain-scented breeze pouring in from the huge bay window ruffles your hair.  The leaves of the herbs growing in pots near various other windows in the room wave in the wind, nourished by the fresh air and the warmth from the still-glowing embers in the stone hearth.  Over the fireplace you notice a fine portrait of a dark elven empath and half-elven cleric kneeling over a slain body in a forest. In the center of the room is a huge, neatly made bed full of soft pillows.

title: [Otterex's Room]
description: The modestly elegant walls of this oak panelled room are lined with shelves holding leatherbound tomes of Dhe'nar history and magic.  Two stuffed chairs sit in front of a large stone fireplace, logs and kindling neatly stacked beside them.  The flames of a fire happily burn in the hearth.  A carved oak bed sits in the corner, covered with a quilted spread and edged with faint runes of ancient Dhe'nar legend.  A large window frames a massive oak desk whose legs are carved in the likeness of great drakes.

title: [Krynith's Room]
description: The deep obsidian walls are dominated by the large bas-relief on the wall opposite the door.  Runes surround the huge soaring dragon, covering the black stone about it as if attempting to contain the great drake.  A shattered mirror covers the ceiling, backlit by a mysterious glow.  In each of the corners stands a modwir bookshelf lined with ancient tomes.  A large gold bed occupies the center of the room.

title: [Yeesiuoler's Room]
description: This room is notably bare of furniture.  A bed, built high off the ground, has been pushed up against the south wall, opposite the old wooden bookcase to the north.  Various tomes of all shapes and colors fill the shelves, the spines decorated by golden inked runes.  Beneath the window in the east wall is a large table covered in papers and unrolled scrolls.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: Five glaes statues stand in alcoves that have been carved into the walls.  Four of the statues are crafted into the likeness of creatures formed from each of the elementals, while the fifth represents a large and powerful demon.  A large silver symbol is inlaid on the floor, the key points reaching the base of each statue.  Directly opposite the main stairs is a smaller staircase leading upwards through the ceiling.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Rooftop]
description: A thunderstorm rages disconcertingly close to this rooftop perch.  Peering through the battlements, the Sentoph mountains are visible, clouds obscuring the tops of their peaks.  Looking westward, you can make out the shape of a large castle set into a far mountainside, waiting at the end of a long trail.  A wide path winds between the battlements and a tall obsidian wall that follows the circle of the tower's curvature.  An enruned rolaren door serves as the only entrance into the high inner wall.

title: [Starshadow's Room]
description: Candles too numerous to count line the walls, filling the air with their heady and almost seductive scent.  A black wrought-iron four poster bed dominates the room, dark green silk tapestries hanging from the sides.  A fire burns quietly in the fireplace, and hung over the mantle is a portrait of Noi'sho'rah.  The floor is made of pure black obsidian, inset with a circle of copper.  Strange runes surround the circle, compelling to both the eye and the mind.

title: [Celtic's Room]
description: Something is distinctly out of place in this room.  Several gashes mar the furniture and the inside of the door, proving to be the claw marks of a powerful puma on closer inspection.  In the center of the room lies an oak-framed four poster bed with an enormous puma hide rug at the foot.  Sitting off to one side of the bed is a wooden box with a small sign above it.  A rolaren bastard sword hangs on the north wall, a small plaque mounted beneath it.

title: [Lochraven's Room]
description: Silver-inlaid black marble encompasses the walls and floor of this large room, thousands of tiny sparkling diamonds imbedded in the ceiling resemble the deep night sky.  Plush silver silk rugs and large pillows adorned with patterns of wild black roses cover the floor around an elegant fel table.  A large marble fireplace dominates the far wall, the constantly burning fire providing light and warmth in this dark room.

title: [Starsnuffer's Room, Reception]
description: A fireplace of blue flames burns silently in one wall, shedding a comfortable light over the tapestries and odd relics on the walls.  Two comfortable, high-backed chairs sit before the hearth, a small black varnished table between them.  Over the hearth hangs a magnificent dragon wrought from rolaren, the surface beaten to catch the reflection of the dancing flames.

title: [Starsnuffer's Room, Bedroom]
description: Four large black candles burn blue in the corners of the room.  The flames highlight the flecks of silver set into the perfect obsidian walls, ceiling and floor, giving the impression of a deep night sky full of flickering stars.  Set into the far wall is a beaten silver starburst, standing out amid the surrounding stars like the greatest of supernovas.  In the center of the room stands a black canopied bed, its heavy black curtains obscuring what lies within.

title: [Starsnuffer's Room, Bed]
description: Thick down comforters of black velvet sit atop fine spidersilk sheets.  Deep satin pillows lie against the headboard, obscuring several of the silvery runes carved there.  Hanging from the top of the bed are exquisite silver stars, moons, and other heavenly bodies, winking in and out in the dim light.  The air is filled with the dusky scent of amber, intoxicating to the senses and inspirational to the imagination.

title: [Starsnuffer's Room, Bathroom]
description: Candles cover every flat surface in this large bathing chamber.  Flecks of silver wink out from the walls, and from the depths of the huge obsidian bathtub, making the basin look like an endless night sky.  Thick rugs obscure the floor and provide a warm place to put wet feet.

title: [Starsnuffer's Room, Bath]
description: Water pools around you, caressing your skin like warm silk.  Bits of silver set into the tub walls flicker in and out in the candlelight, and the golden flames play across the water's surface like a sea of fire.  Sponges, scrub brushes and soap all sit within easy reach along the edge, and the back of the basin slopes gently, making a perfect place to lean and soak.

title: [Starsnuffer's Room, Study]
description: Shelves of black and dark purple tomes stretch from floor to ceiling, the spines of the books etched with spidery runes.  An immense desk of black wood rests at the end of the room, inlaid with silver runic symbols.  Scrolls and parchments are stacked neatly on the desk, next to a raven's quill and inkpot.  Behind the desk is a case of obsidian and clear glaes, full of various magical relics kept safely locked away.  In the center of the floor is a large scorched circle, blasted by some powerful force.

title: [Voln Tapestry Table]
description: The tapestry hanging behind the table depicts the god Voln, The Liberator.  He is dressed in black chain mail covered in a white surcoat.  In his hand is a white shield etched with faint images of souls floating upward, as if newly released from the rotting corpses beneath them.

title: [Koar Tapestry Table]
description: A tapestry of Koar hangs on the wall behind the table.  It depicts the king of the gods sitting upon a throne of stone wearing a golden crown and a flowing white robe.

title: [Phoen Tapestry Table]
description: Hanging on the wall behind the table is a tapestry that depicts Phoen, god of the sun.  You see a handsome muscular man dressed in a short golden tunic, suspended in mid-air against a sky blue background.  His flowing golden hair creates a bright halo around his face.

title: [Eonak Tapestry Table]
description: On the wall behind the table is a tapestry with the image of the god Eonak, his black hair and deep brown eyes reflecting the fire from his forge.  He is hammering a sword which is still red hot, and behind him you see other glorious weapons.

title: [Lumnis Tapestry Table]
description: Hanging on the wall behind the table is a tapestry that depicts the goddess Lumnis.  It shows a serene, tall and slender woman with ivory skin, dressed in a sweeping grey gossamer robe.  Her hair is black with a single shock of gray at her forehead.

title: [Sorsha's Tent, Inside]
description: This dimly lit tent is filled with carefully stacked piles of armor, clothing, and various other trinkets too numerous to mention.  A long table rests in the corner and behind it, an enruned veil which seems to be covering the back section of the tent, preventing any chance of seeing what lies beyond.

title: [Eirsei's Tent, Inside]
description: The strong delicious aroma of fresh baked goods fills this well lit tent.  You note two small stone ovens with a wood fire burning underneath.  Above, a smoke hole in the top of the tent allows smoke from the ovens to escape.

title: [Sylvanfair, Rime Hall]
description: The heat radiating from a firepit in the middle of the vast hall scarcely reaches the grey stone walls, leaving them cold.  Carved into the frosted surface is an ethereal forest of leaf-bare trees creating the image of perpetual winter in familiar deciduous groves.  Pools of pale wax mar the tiled floor where tiered candles set in cast iron chandeliers overhead have been left to drip.  Oaken benches circle the blazing fire with the added comfort of thick furs draped over their high backs.

title: [Sylvanfair, Gallery]
description: A dimly lit gallery, framed with grey stone walls, houses a single cloth-covered trestle table.  Hanging above are a series of gilt-framed paintings and hunting trophies, each festooned with evergreen boughs and spaced by candle-filled sconces.  A decorative carpet runner covers most of the bare stone floor, leading from a swinging door marked "Buttery" at one end to a narrow spiral staircase at the other, with a solid ironwood door visible at the top.

title: [Sylvanfair, Crypt]
description: A twisting staircase leads down into a stone-built underground chamber with a low, barrel-vaulted ceiling.  A series of pillars are paired two-by-two down its long, narrow length between which stand statues of Arkati and sepulchers of long-forgotten adventurers.  At the far end of the crypt is a deep pool sunk into the bare stone floor.  Candles set into an iron chandelier overhead cast a dim light through the steamy haze, illuminating a pair of oak benches and footlockers nearby.

title: [Sylvanfair, Buttery]
description: Naturally cool and in close proximity to the Hall, the buttery serves as a convenient storage space and food preparation area.  Barrels of wine and ale have been stacked against one wall and joints of meat and game hang from large iron hooks overhead.  A small, unglazed window is set high into the stone wall to allow for ventilation and a glimpse of the darkened landscape beyond.

Barrels of wine and ale have been stacked against one wall and joints of meat and game hang from large iron hooks overhead.  A small, unglazed window is set high into the stone wall to allow for ventilation and a glimpse at the spruce and fir trees beyond.

title: [Sylvanfair, Bower]
description: High in the watchtower, the bower's four mullioned windows face the cardinal directions and provide an unimpeded view of the surrounding forest and path below.  Sparsely furnished, with only a fur-covered large featherbed and two storage chests, the stone-walled chamber is comfortable but lacks the lavish adornments and hospitality of the accommodation below.  A basket of sticks sits next to a fireplace, over which hangs a silver gilt-framed mirror.

title: [Ilynov Manor, Dining Room]
description: Blonde oak flooring flows through an open doorway from the parlor, cheerfully reflecting the ambient light in warm, soft tones.  Four full-length windows, looking out onto the patio, flank a set of glass double doors centered in the north wall.  A massive lor dining table, surrounded by elegantly carved lor chairs, rests atop an intricately woven rug in the middle of the room.  A gilt-framed painting hangs above a stone fireplace, the southern wall's only adornment.

Blonde oak flooring flows through an open doorway from the parlour, cheerfully reflecting the ambient light in warm, soft tones.  Four full-length windows, looking out onto the patio, flank a set of glass double doors centered in the north wall.  A massive lor dining table, surrounded by elegantly carved lor chairs, rests atop an intricately woven rug in the middle of the room.  A gilt-framed painting hangs above a stone fireplace, the southern wall's only adornment.
location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Brutish's Armory]
description: A portrait of Darkstone Castle hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls, and an ebonwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  A bronzed drake sculpture sits in one corner of a glossy mahogany floor.  There is a gilded maple cabinet on one side of the shop and a gilded maple table on the other.

title: [Avignon's Magic Shoppe]
description: A tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls, and an uneven wooden ceiling rises overhead.  A worn rug sits in one corner of an unfinished wooden floor.  There is a gilded maple cabinet on one side of the shop.

title: [Berost's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Berost's Armory]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Berost's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Guardian Keep, Yeoman's Office]
description: Shelves and drawers line the walls of the office.  Along with a series of simple wooden desks, they form the bulk of the furnishings in the spartan chamber.  Each desk is supplied with a reading lantern, two bottles of dark ink, and a white quill pen.

title: [Coliseum Colonnade]
description: The wide, smooth white marble floor continues in a southern arc, flanked on the northern side by dozens of limestone columns.  The moonlit trees of the Siren's Wood can be seen through the columns.  Inset into the limestone of the southern wall are an ornate faenor arch etched with elven runes and a wyvern-etched vaalorn arch, above which hangs a banner displaying the crest of House Vaalor.

title: [Coliseum, Elven Lounge]
description: Seven silk tapestries adorn the polished limestone walls and an intricately woven rug covers the floor.  Rows of padded chairs occupy the center of the room and face a large viewing window.  A variety of refreshments sit on a low illthorn table next to an ornate faenor arch etched with runes.  Several polished brass sconces cast their illumination around the area.

title: [Coliseum, Citizen Lounge]
description: Swathes of crimson and gold silk hang from the limestone walls and an intricately braided rug covers the floor.  Thickly padded chairs line the stone risers facing a large vaalorn-framed window.  A low illthorn table holding refreshments sits along one wall near a wyvern-etched vaalorn arch.

title: [Gimme Shelter, Private Quarters]
description: Several crates are piled against the walls, bits of straw poking out from between the misaligned slats.  A straw pallet lies on the floor, the area surrounding it cleared of the sprockets and cogs that are scattered about the small space.  A small mobile, consisting of gears suspended from a series of wires, hangs above a squat steel door and idly twists with the slightest of movements.

title: [Protect and Serve, Wagon Yard]
description: A gold-striped crimson canvas awning, supported by a pair of thin steel poles, stretches from the roof of the wagon, bathing the thick grass in cool shadow.  Several wooden crates are stacked to one side of a small wooden hatch.  At the edge of the yard stands a tiny portable forge with an iron anvil and a low worktable nearby.

title: [Rockslinger's, Annex Corridor]
description: A long, wide corridor extends north and west, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  More corridor extends north and west.

title: [Rockslinger's, Annex Corridor]
description: A long, wide corridor extends north and west, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  More corridor extends east and west.

title: [Rockslinger's, Annex Corridor]
description: A long, wide corridor extends north and west, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot. More corridor extends east and west.

description: A long, wide corridor extends north and west, its length lit by a huge amber toadstool planted in a large stone pot.  Tightly woven, sapphire blue carpet covers the floor, muffling footsteps and providing a soft surface on which to walk.  Overhead, timbers spaced two feet apart hold up the grey granite ceiling, the timber ends disappearing into the light blue marble walls on either side of the corridor.  More corridor extends east, but to the west the corridor ends at a flat marble wall.

title: [Rockslinger's, Kitchen]
description: Roughly carved, the cavern is supported by beams of axe-hewn wood set at regular intervals.  A rocky fire pit is centered in the room, with the earthy smoke of burning cave moss rising from it.  Resting on a stone stand, a large wooden keg marked with several dwarven runes is tapped and ready for pulling, and a variety of mugs are piled to one side.  Crates of cooking supplies are stacked between barrels of salt pork and fish, and sacks of grain lie to one side.  Some makeshift stone shelves are carved into the walls, their surfaces covered with foodstuffs.

title: [Twilight Hall, Cemetery]
[Twilight Hall, Cemetary]
description: Surrounded by a short wall of stone topped with decorative wrought iron, an eerie grey-green fog rolls through a boneyard frozen in eternal autumn.  Branches of shade trees cast strange shadows over a collection of scattered stone benches, yet seem to avoid disturbing the stillness of the graves.  A small seating area which contains an ornately carved stone table is visible in the moonlight.  Beneath a great oak tree rests a handful of carved pumpkins and a lone grave.

title: [Ravenswood, Streambank]
description: The willows that line both sides of the stream bow over the burbling water, their hanging branches touching the moss-covered stepping stones that lead to the other side.  Filtered light flickers on the stream, reflecting patterns of shimmering light on the mossy banks.

title: [Ravenswood, Streambank]
description: Rounded stones half-buried in the mossy streambank mark the locations of ancient graves concealed by centuries of dirt and fallen leaves.  The forest is dark and impassable to the south, and candlelight flickers from the windows of small homes nestled among the willows.

title: [Tangled Tentacle Table]
description: There are deep grooves in the floor boards where the heavy wooden chairs have been dragged back and forth through the years.  The top of the wide wooden table has been colorfully painted with a scene of two large squids, tentacles tangled together, battling it out over a flowing tankard of ale.

title: [Tipsy Turtle Table]
description: The mahogany table wobbles a bit here, sloshing any drinks set down on it.  Painted upon the table surface is a fine rendition of a sea turtle lying on its back, a flagon of ale in flipper and basket of fried shrimp balanced upon its belly.

title: [Burnt Bass Table]
description: Mismatched wooden chairs are pushed haphazardly up against the long wooden table that has been darkened with age and use.  A painting of a large-mouthed sea bass can still be seen on the table surface, discernable through all the marks and stains.

title: [Crispy Cod Table]
description: The lamp on the wall behind the table casts a broad shadow onto the rough wood surface.  The picture of a blackened cod fish that has been painted on the surface of the table is so plump that it matches the round shape of the table.  Oddly, the wing-backed chairs set at the wooden table have no arms to them, making them appear smaller than they really are.

title: [Lavish Lobster Table]
description: The brass lamp, polished to a high sheen, casts a soft, warm glow over the long oak table.  Painted along the edges of the table with a lavish array of red colors are a dozen exquisitely detailed lobsters, the head of one resting on the tail of the next.

title: [Sizzling Shrimp Table]
description: A large painting hangs over this section of the table, picturing a pan full of cooking shrimp sizzling in butter.  The soft cushioned chairs pulled up to the mahogany table have been carved with a shrimp motif along the backs and down the arms.

title: [Giantman Village, Market]
description: A crowd of mostly women bustles about, talking and trading and bartering for daily staples.  Foods and goods of various purpose exchange hands, creating a makeshift market in the little town.  An open ramada shades a number of exotic foods and whatnots, the shopkeeper beckoning all passers-by to come and see.

title: [House Brigatta, Upper Hallway]
description: Dark oak railings climb to and from the two-story stairway, leading to this long hallway carpeted with a cerulean blue runner.  Pale walls and a series of skylights keep the upper part of the house brightly illuminated with sunlight.  An illustrative copper panel bears stylized images of constellations mixed with magical sigils and leads out to an observatory perched on the roof, and a little further along, a pale haon door heralds the library.  At the far end is a dark mistwood door braced with hammered black iron fittings.

Flickering oil-filled sconces mounted on the walls add a warmth of soft light to the upper part of the house.  An illustrative copper panel bears stylized images of constellations mixed with magical sigils and leads out to an observatory dome perched on the roof, and a little further along, a pale haon door heralds the library.  At the far end is a dark mistwood door braced with hammered black iron fittings.

title: [House Brigatta. Cozy Sanctum]
description: Dark woods and muted, cool hues predominate in this spacious bedroom.  Aside from the central four-poster bed facing a blue-grey riverstone fireplace, a full-length mirror, and a matching wash basin, the room is bare of other furniture.  Gracing the foot of the bed is a woven soft grey throw, and a plush carpet in shades of charcoal and antique gold adds notes of luxury in the otherwise austere chamber.  Soft sunlight filters through the sheer curtains that cover the only window, partially shaded by a large banyan tree.

title: [Selaesia's Weaponry]
[Selaesia's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the blonde oak floor is interrupted by a stuffed grizzly bear.  Halfway to the oak beam ceiling, a dwarven miner portrait hangs on one of the smooth white plaster walls.  A heavy white granite counter and a tall oak and ivory cabinet are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [House Brigatta. Bibliotheca]
description: Large mullioned windows and high, arched ceilings contribute to the open and airy feel of this comfortable salon.  A pair of tufted cream silk chairs on curvaceous legs flank the blue-grey riverstone fireplace, their celadon cushions a cool contrast to the golden hue of the overstuffed settee opposite them.  Bookcases lining the northern wall contain volumes of poetry and books on art, to accompany the easel near the windows, taking advantage of the ample light.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Atrium]
description: Moonlight filters in through a vaulted, glass-paned ceiling, sending motes of twinkling light to dance around the room from strands of crystal icicles strung overhead.  Beds of blooming winter roses are divided by a fountain-lined water rill leading to a magnificent conifer tree covered in ornaments placed atop a raised platform and surrounded by paper luminaries.  Parked nearby, a rolling ebonwood ladder is draped with ribbon-tied garlands and a low, parquetry bench holds a dark grapevine basket filled with evergreen sprigs of mistletoe.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Clumps of dirt make the travel here uneven and bumpy, and one lone torch provides only a small halo of light along the ground.  A stained steel ladder stretches up from a jagged rock wall.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Cracks snake up and down the tunnel walls, darkness creeping along them like veins of shadows.  The tunnel comes to an end at an uneven slab of rock and stone, the occasional loose dirt falling to the ground.  A stained steel ladder is set into the wall, leading up.

title: [Ryjex's Armory]
description: Beneath a smooth marble ceiling, a faded treasure map hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while a wooden ship's wheel rests on the marble floor.

title: [Ryjex's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a smooth marble ceiling, a tattered pirate flag hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while an ornate bottled ship rests on the marble floor.

title: [Ryjex's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a smooth marble ceiling, a wall-mounted blowfish hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while a colorful seashell collection rests on the marble floor.

title: [Ryjex's Private Home]
description: Mining equipment sits at the end of the tunnel, waiting for the next major digging effort.  Teeth biting into the wall, a huge bore remains where it was left after the construction of the mud baths was complete.  Although it is set off by barricades, children climb all over the machine, turning it into a makeshift playground.

title: [Arv's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the polished oak walls.  A gilded maple cabinet and an engraved copper bin sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a polished oak floor.

title: [Bromn's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a pearl-handled filigreed mandolin hangs on one of the smooth granite walls.  A gilded maple cabinet sits in one corner while a stuffed striped rolton rests on the celadon marble floor.

title: [Ryjex's General Store]
description: Beneath a smooth marble ceiling, a faded treasure map hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while a wooden ship's wheel rests on the marble floor.

title: [Ryjex's Combat Gear]
description: Beneath a smooth marble ceiling, a tattered pirate flag hangs on one of the gold-veined marble walls.  An oversized sea chest sits in one corner while an ornate bottled ship rests on the marble floor.

title: [The Hog's Pen, Citizens Lounge]
description: In a stark contrast with the dirt and filth above, this plush lounge is filled with luxurious amenities.  Diagonal black and alizarin stripes line the walls, while an iridescent triton hide rug covers the floor in front of a a glossy obsidian fireplace.  Adorned with golden golvern studs, a leather-edged hammered glaes bar stretches from one side of the room to the other, displaying a massive aged oak cask, while a supple black leather couch rests in the corner, ready to provide rest to the weary traveler.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Passage]
description: Dimly lit by tallows placed in wrought iron sconces, the small passage has rough wooden walls and a packed dirt floor.  Rickety wooden stairs ascend to the floor above along the western edge, while white-washed oak planks form a descending staircase that disappears below.  A faded curtain outlined in light is the only other means of exiting the space.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Basement]
description: Heavy and damp, the air is rife with the scent of packed dirt, herbs, and smoke.  Spidery white tendrils, the roots of some unseen plant, dangle from the ceiling between the thick oak beams.  Footsteps dully echo from above as patrons and denizens move through the passage above, the tremors setting the wrought iron basket of coals that hangs in the center of the room to swaying.  A rough wooden table rests against one earthy wall, its contents largely in shadow.

title: [Vambrace Yourself]
description: Brightly lit and well-organized, the interior of the shop has a welcoming ambiance.  Wedge-cut pieces of red oak are inlaid in the ironwood flooring and flare outward around a slightly dented bronze sales counter.  An ora-handled spruce chest rests next to a simple burled pine stand placed a few paces behind a grizzled dark wool rug at the back of the semi-circular room.

title: [Twilight Lodge, Lockers]
description: Across from a curtained opening, a cushioned bench rests in front of a long counter, its top a masterpiece of marquetry using glowbark, lor, and dark heartwood to depict a pair of elf owls hidden amidst a chaos of leaves.  A silvered glass mirror in one corner reflects a trio of graduated crimson orbs overhead which softly illuminate the polished wood floors.

title: [Company Lockers]
description: You are standing in a tiny room whose facing wall is an array of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and is sitting in a small counter.

title: [Company Lockers]
description: You are standing in a tiny room whose facing wall is an array of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and is sitting in a small counter.

title: [Lalena's Box Emporium]
description: Although small, the inside of the tent is organized and tidy.  Neatly piled boxes and trunks line the walls, leaving a clear path around a rough walnut table.  Tucked to one side of the opening is a large wooden crate, its surface painted with small stick figures.  A variety of toys can be seen nestled between the stacks.

title: [Locksmithery, Side Room]
description: Woven from colorful reeds, a circular carpet covers the polished wooden floor.  A wide ceramic canister rests beside a narrow oak archway that is draped in pale blue fabric.  The room is illuminated in warm, pale light by a series of rounded crystal globes that hang from the ceiling.  Stacks of boxes, crates, and trunks are neatly piled behind a tile-inlaid counter, each clearly labeled.

title: [Fat Jahck's]
description: The dark of the alley outside gives way to soft light coming from the lamps hanging overhead.  Neatly stacked crates line the side walls, leaving clear the central area of the room.  A long oak counter runs the length of the rear wall behind which the proprietor stands minding the establishment.

title: [Leafi's Confectionery Castle]
description: A cake-shaped gift box wrapped with a cherry-topped ribbon hangs on one of the polished oak walls, and a varnished golden oak ceiling rises overhead.  A brilliant red hibiscus plant sits in one corner of a polished oak floor.  There is a three-tray bakery display case with a colorful treat motif on one side of the shop and a smiling sylvan waitress statue presenting a serving tray on the other.

title: [Whisp's Outfitting]
description: Varnished ebonwood walls rise from a speckled black marble floor.  Just above a scaled model of Hearthstone hangs a portrait of Darkstone Castle, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and a vine-carved mahogany table stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Brave Battle-Axe Table]
description: Three thick beeswax candles set in a wooden wheel above cast a reddish glow over this table that resides near one of the whitewashed walls of the hearth room.  Across the surface of the mistwood table, colorful glaes has been arranged to create a detailed mosaic.

title: [Regalia and Restraint]
description: Enclosed by plain wooden walls, the shop features a worn rug in the center of its wooden floor.  A tattered merchant permit hangs under the wooden ceiling.  Right near the front is a sleek silver imflass altar draped in golden floral brocade and a silk-covered dress mannequin.

title: [Triumphs and Treasures]
description: Beneath a mosaic tiled ceiling, a painting of a sundress-clad songmaiden battling bandits hangs on one of the smooth granite walls.  A mithril treasure chest accented with a veniom music staff and a wide faenor-trimmed table sit in opposite corners while a tiered alabaster fountain rests on a glossy mahogany floor.

title: [Cleaving Claidhmore Table]
description: This table is close enough to the hearth to catch some if its radiant warmth and the reddish glow emanating from the fire within.  The dim illumination washes across a beautiful glaes mosaic set into the top of this sturdy mistwood .

title: [Dual Dagger Table]
description: This corner of the hearth room is illuminated by multiple beeswax candles in an elaborate iron sconce attached to the whitewashed wall overhead.  Glittering glaes chips embedded into the surface of the table form a mosaic that reflects the candle light from the wall above.

title: [Whisp's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by varnished ebonwood walls, the shop features a carved ebonwood dinghy in the center of its black marble floor.  A blue watered silk tapestry hangs under the vaulted ceiling.  Right near the front is a glass-topped mistwood counter and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet.

title: [Whisp's Weaponry]
description: Varnished ebonwood walls rise from a speckled black marble floor.  Just above a brass flowerpot hangs a blue watered silk tapestry, and a vaulted ceiling completes the picture.  A vine-carved mahogany table and a gold-leafed mistwood cabinet stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Fearsome Falchion Table]
description: Resting directly below a small open window in the wall high above, this table receives a steady flow of fresh air in the crowded public room away from the smoky hearth.  A trio of beeswax candles cast a flickering reddish glow on the surface of the table, the light reflecting off of a glittering glaes mosaic embedded within.

title: [Elegant Espadon Table]
description: This table sits near the center of the hearth room with a clear line of sight towards the wood and glaes door patrons pass through to enter.  A wooden wheel hanging overhead bears beeswax candles that drip wax onto a colorful glaes mosaic covering the top of this mistwood table.

title: [Golden Gladius Table]
description: This quiet table is tucked behind a low wall that offers some privacy from the other tables around the hearth.  A glaes mosaic embedded into the table's surface glitters in the light of beeswax candles that have been placed along the top of the wooden barrier.

title: [Hurling Handaxe Table]
description: Smoke from the crackling hearth drifts past this table, bringing with it scents of the meats roasting nearby.  Gently swaying overhead, a wooden wheel of beeswax candles offers a luminous glow to the detailed glaes mosaic decorating the spacious mistwood table below.

title: [Imposing Impaler Table]
description: Darker than the others, this isolated table sits far in the back of the hearth room.  Overhead, a lone candle flame flutters on a short wick, which causes a flickering light to dance across the glittering surface of a glaes mosaic inlaid into the table's surface.

title: [Armed Arbalest Table]
description: Hanging from the darkness overhead, a wooden wheel suspends candles that emit a soft reddish light, providing a sense of isolation amongst the other tables around the hearth.  The illumination above reflects off of an intricate glaes mosaic inlaid into the surface of the polished mistwood table.

title: [Icemule, Winterberry Park]
description: This expansive reserve is bordered by large snow drifts and lush with seasonal flora.  Of special note are the various rows of winterberry bushes beneath a dusting of snow, each plump red winterberry ripe for the picking.  An occasional rodent or bird sneaks in and snags a bite.  Barrels and crates have been arranged beside a set of contraptions, and in an opposite corner the foliage has been trimmed in the form of an open tome with a feather resting upon it.  A low stone pub peeks out of one of the drifts.

title: [Beacon Hall, Brewpub Taproom]
description: The heat of a large fire burning in the far wall warms this small, local pub.  The walls have been set with a rich, dark wood.  Small, round windows allow the sunlight to filter through.  Above the fireplace is an elaborately carved bleakstone mantle.  An array of pipes traveling up the walls and along the ceiling connect a large number of kegs to the taps behind a long mahogany bar, which dominates most of the room.

title: [Beacon Hall, Beer Garden]
description: This roofless room houses the smoldering remains of a bonfire, ringed by some blackened stone benches.  The walls have been raised here, tapering at the top like a lighthouse, to prevent snow drifts from becoming too troublesome.

title: [Beacon Hall, Brewpub Snug]
description: The narrow passage leading into this room opens into a much larger space.  Books are arranged in a series of darkly stained oak shelves that just seem to go on and on.  Volumes of every color, size, and binding are put together in some semblance of order that isn't immediately apparent.

title: [Brewpub, Royalty Suite]
description: Oiled black sconces cast a dim yet steady light upon the green and blue marble floor.  A series of connected, soft grey couches surround a quaint mosaic table.  The far wall is adorned with a richly woven tapestry.

title: [Beacon Hall, Brewpub Locker]
description: Stout wooden kegs, each banded with iron and stamped with a white lighthouse emblem, are stacked upon one another against the walls of this room.  A long silver mirror, somewhat burnt and warped at the edges, sits in a corner beneath a colorful round lantern, the flickering flame within casting long shadows around the cellar.

title: [Safe Haven, Entryway]
description: This room features a high, vaulted ceiling with carved stone trusses, creating a stark contrast to the cavern floor and rough-hewn passages.  Niches line the walls, the small spaces filled with trinkets and baubles that memorialize fallen defenders and the more noteworthy battles of Mist Harbor.  At one end of the room stands a large mithril-banded hatch which opens inwards.

title: [Safe Haven, Great Room]
description: This large cavern has been arranged as a multi-purpose room, providing shelter in times of need and a gathering or practice space for citizens and militia alike.  Flanked by an archway and a door, the entrance passageway stands opposite a large hearth, constructed of local materials and shadowed by a large tapestry featuring the Mist Harbor crest above it.  The modular nature of the room features some padded benches for meetings that can be pushed aside in times of need.

title: [Safe Haven, Infirmary]
description: This room is spacious and well lit, with smoothly hewn walls and a floor that can easily be scrubbed clean.  Folded cots line the walls, ready to be set up at a moment's notice to receive incoming wounded.  A spacious cabinet stands off to one side, directly next to a large work table covered with a swath of white linen.  Along the uppermost portion of the walls is a scrolling collection of images, depicting numerous stylized healing herbs intermingled with brightly colored, tropical birds.

title: [Safe Haven, Pantry]
description: A long wooden table with benches dominates the center of the space, the clutter of meals and snacks past strewn around it haphazardly.  Shelves have been carved into the cavern walls around the perimeter, stocked with various foodstuffs and supplies, rendering the air thick with the mingled odors of various spices.  A rhimar chest sits against one wall with a handwritten sign just above it.

title: [Safe Haven, Common Room]
description: This cavern serves as a casual gathering place as well as a work space for the militia.  It is cozy and comfortable, with some plush chairs strewn about the space in a somewhat haphazard manner.  In one corner is a large desk which can be used for daily paperwork or reports, or for strategy meetings.  A wide tunnel with the militia crest mounted on the wall above it leads back to the Great Room.

title: [Crypt Roof]
description: Weather beaten and covered in a fine layer of dirt and mold, the roof seems a island, as mist and shadows enclose it from all sides.  Amongst the crags and jagged edges of the ancient granite hide a myriad of small bird nests.

title: [Vaunt It and Flaunt It]
description: Panels made of a glossy silk, their surface rippling slightly with any passing breeze, enclose this small tent.  Set against one wall is a table with a branching metal jewelry tree and a velvet-lined ring box positioned neatly on top of it, while across from it is a glass-topped mahogany display counter.  Soft rugs made of textured cotton have been spread over the floor, muffling any footfalls within the space.  The subtle aroma of cinnamon and cloves permeates the air from a few discreetly placed candles.

title: [Kiriane's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-covered table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Ariyanaa's Weaponry]
description: Stark stone block walls rise from an ash grey granite floor.  Just above a fishscale blue mermaid figurine hangs a multihued Vornavian silk tapestry, and a domed white stucco ceiling completes the picture.  A heavy lead glass display case stands in the middle of the room.

title: [Zekraik's Magic Shoppe]
description: A cracked ceremonial mask hangs on one of the tightly-woven beige canvas walls, and a swirl-painted white stucco ceiling rises overhead.  A dusky blue cotton rug sits in one corner of a white limestone floor.  There is a white marble shelf on one side of the shop and a Vornavian silk-lined display case on the other.

title: [Kyaloria's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by painted white plaster walls, the shop features a glass-fronted bookcase in the center of its dark oak floor.  An oil-filled copper sconce hangs under the white stucco ceiling.  Right near the front is a narrow glass-topped table and a heavy lead glass display case.

Painted white plaster walls rise from a white limestone floor.  Just above an elegantly dressed maiden statue hangs an ornately rendered clan crest, and a viridian Vornavian silk ceiling completes the picture.  Some wrought-iron hooks and a hammered copper hanging rack stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Ordim's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A plain wooden table sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Tsfari's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a low skylight-set ceiling, a faded treasure map hangs on one of the textured sandstone walls.  A heavy white granite counter sits in one corner while an oily black kraken statue rests on the mosaic floor.

title: [Persephanii's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A cedar and oak footlocker sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Guarrin's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by stark stone block walls, the shop features a slender umbrella tree statue in the center of its granite floor.  A sphere-hilted mounted sword plaque hangs under the light oak ceiling.  Right near the front is a Vornavian silk-covered table.

title: [Beloran's General Store]
description: Beneath an uneven wooden ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the plain wooden walls.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the wooden floor.

title: [Persephanii's Weaponry]
