title: [Guarrin's Weaponry]
description: The broad sweep of the granite floor is interrupted by a woven Vornavian silk rug.  Halfway to the white cedar ceiling, a curl-edged vellum wall map hangs on one of the rough white stucco walls.  A plank-covered barrel table and a long brass clothing rack are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Guarrin's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath an exposed pine rafter ceiling, a fused sun and moon wall-hanging hangs on one of the refined oak-paneled walls.  An elegant silver jewelry rack and some warped driftwood shelves sit in opposite corners while a woven Vornavian silk rug rests on an ash grey granite floor.

title: [Irregulars Barracks, Garden]
description: This small garden is separated from the courtyard by the surrounding silvery haon trees.  A gently curved stone bench sits beneath the largest tree, scattered with fallen leaves and gently illuminated by a pale blue glass lantern on a silver post.  Across from the bench, a small dais supports a carved statue of a sleeping warcat, while the beginnings of a small flowerbed circles its base.

title: [Vardar Hollow, Approach]
description: Framed on either side by white spruce, birch, and berry-laden wintergreen bushes, a sinuous road of tightly packed cobblestones winds toward a quaint pine lodge and accompanying resort in the near distance.  Smoke rises from their chimneys, peppering the air with the alluring odor of burning wood and resin.  Fresh snow glistens in silhouetted banks to either side of the walk, a testament to the regularity of maintenance on the roadway.

title: [Vardar Hollow, Courtyard]
description: Ice sculptures depicting rampant mules guard the entrance of the courtyard, shaded by old maples with snow-heavy branches.   Across from an expansive pine-framed lodge, a genteel resort is framed by the forest beyond, its roof of blue slate aglisten with rime and graupel in the starlight.  At the center of the yard, a white marble statue of a halfling woman in a heroic pose dominates a cylindrical plinth of polished obsidian.  The contrast between the colors is striking.

title: [Williwaw Resort, Porch]
description: Tiny mosaic tiles in hues ranging from frosty blue to deep forest green cover the low stone pillars that border the porch of the resort.  Though expansive and quite exposed to the elements, the porch is kept meticulously free of snow and ice build-up, allowing guests to safely walk among the many ice sculptures displayed here.  A pair of massive polished haon doors with faenor handles allows entry to the building.

title: [Williwaw Resort, Lobby]
description: The lobby is lit by a massive copper fixture, suspended by chains from the vaulted wood beam ceiling and set with hundreds of burning candles.  Central and opposite the entry doors is a sweeping wood-and-stone staircase, flanked on the ground floor by some copper-framed glass panels and a pointed mahogany arch.  Elegant and rustic elements of design mesh gracefully in the large chamber, where walls with squared hunter green panels meet with a polished birchwood floor.

title: [Four Winds Lounge]
description: A massive black marble fireplace is set into the western wall, working hard to heat the large room.  Lacquered ebonwood floorboards are covered with dark green woolen rugs, and a low dark green granite table rests between a plush black sable couch and a soft umber velvet lounge.  Standing in one corner next to a square mahogany bar with gold inlay is a rose gold display.

title: [Williwaw Resort, Dreamwater]
description: The air is slightly humid, and the glass panels are opaque with fog.  Halfling attendants work busily, racing across a marble-tiled floor that has been strewn with soft linen rugs in various hues of green.  On the wall above a granite countertop is a large silver sign.

title: [Williwaw Resort, Upper Landing]
description: A sleek railing of polished pine with swirling electrum inlay encircles the upper landing, from which the entire lobby is visible.  Rich burgundy carpet is soft underfoot, stretching though the long hallways which lead away from the landing in three directions.  A leather chaise lounge upholstered in ivory suede sits near the railing, a perfect spot for watching the comings and goings below.

title: [Vardar Hollow, Lodge]
description: Heavy steps of sprucewood proceed up to the double-doored entrance to the rustic hunting lodge, a large, low building with a natural-cut pine facade and high rooftops crowned by slate shingles.  Each of the doors bears a sharp pyrograph of a charging mule accompanied by stylized gusts of wind, the device repeated in a mosaic of many woods laid into the raised porch.  Through the wide glass windows east of the entrance, a roaring hearth crackles, throwing back the cold dark of the night.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Antechamber]
description: A magnificent elk head watches over the spacious anteroom, black glass eyes tirelessly overseeing the comings and goings of guests.  A small black iron furnace sits to one side of a double-doored entrance, standing guard against the cold sneaking in through the open entry, but the promise of greater warmth roars from the east carried by the pops and crackling of a blaze that can be heard even over the din of nearby conversation.  Overhead, a chandelier made from interwoven antlers holds several dozen candles aloft.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Coatroom]
description: Silver hooks, polished and bright, adorn the walls of the large coatroom, many occupied by a variety of overwear, from shawls and longcoats to trapper's furs.  A series of narrow diamond-shaped windows high up on the southern wall lets in icy moonlight that cuts through the thin haze of woodsmoke in the air.  Several attendants stand at the ready to assist guests with their traveling garb, smartly dressed in attire accented with frost blue and pale silver flourishes.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Greatroom]
description: Warmed by a roaring hearth framed by a vast fireplace of rough-hewn marble, the greatroom has a high ceiling supported by beams of white pine.  A curving couch of rich mountain rolton leather is positioned to take full advantage of the fireglow.  Behind it, a polished white marble buffet table is laden with enough hors d'ouevres to feed a halfling village.  Huge floor-to-ceiling windows let firelight escape into the cold dark beyond the greatroom's confines, their edges traced with creeping rime.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Libations]
description: Mirrored diamond panels wink merrily from the wall behind the bar, reflecting the fire glow from the greatroom.  The refracted light gleams off of the edges of old bottles on a multi-tiered set of glass shelves, revealing glass in every color of the rainbow and more.  A tallish human bartender, Lenton, mans the station, his fastidiousness evident in the clean, neatly ordered bar he tends.  Shakers of herb bitters, vermouth, and other, more arcane concoctions line the backside of the bar in even rows.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Kitchen]
description: Beyond the kitchen door, the clang of pots and pans adds occasional percussion to the slow sizzle and simmer of dishes being prepared by several halfling chefs.  Raw ingredients are neatly separated along the surface of a hexagonal marble island at the chamber's center.  A few weary-looking serving staff are dedicated to cleaning up after the cooks, lending an industrious, even-paced bustle to the kitchen.

Beyond the kitchen door, the clang of pots and pans adds to the din of sizzling and popping food.  Several halfling chefs bustle about the kitchen, creating culinary masterpieces out of raw ingredients neatly separated along the surface of a hexagonal marble island at the chamber's center.  Just as many serving staff are dedicated to cleaning up after the cooks, lending an ebbing, flowing bustle to the kitchen that is reminiscent of a well-choreographed dance.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Hallway]
description: A tartan carpet with braided trim runs the length of the hallway, muffling footsteps on the polished pine floor.  Faenor sconces punched with a pattern of tiny snowflakes are affixed to the wall on either side of a glass-paned stained pine door.  The hallway is redolent with smells of pungent, herbal smoke that seem to be coming from the parlour just beyond the doorway.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Smoking Parlour]
description: Paneled walls with rich blue and silver insets frame the cozily close chamber.  The air within is dry and redolent with complex herbal notes, the odor arising from a polished cedarwood humidor positioned at one end of a sumptuous leather couch that stretches along most of one wall.  Moonlight gleams through a frosted glass window depicting prowling wolves and prancing bucks, feebly illuminating the outline of a luxuriant leather seat with a smoky halo.  A crystal snifter catches the light, sitting atop a patterned silver tray near the door.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Pantry]
description: Set off from the bustle of the kitchen, the pantry is a doorless chamber that is lined, floor-to-ceiling, with foodstuffs, with only a break for a sliding wooden panel in the southern wall.  Several barrels of pickled fish lend a salty, pungent aroma to the room that is not precisely unpleasant.  Nearby, a salted rolton carcass hangs from the ceiling beams, swaying slowly on creaking hanging lines.  Despite the proponderance of stored food, everything looks fresh or pristinely preserved.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Hallway]
description: Shining white frost beckons from the other side of a pale pine door with a frosted glass panel.  Heat bleeds from the hallway's dead end, hungrily leached from the air by the waiting outdoors.  On the walls, a series of bright-pigmented landscapes depict pastoral scenes that are green and refreshingly devoid of ice, framing the curve of a silver-inlaid smooth spruce archway that leads to the banquet hall.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Banquet Hall]
description: A sapphire-studded chandelier of carved pinewood blazes with dozens of candles, casting brilliant light down onto the parquet floor.  The flooring depicts a charging mule in interlocking lengths of pine, spruce, and cedarwood, each stained to maximize its color and gloss.  Banquet tables all around are prepared with settings of real silver and white porcelain.

title: [Vardar Hollow, Sculpture Garden]
description: Icicles hanging from the eaves of the lodge catch the starlight and spark with rainbowed refractions that spill onto the surrounding snow in tiny pools of prismatic color.  The treeline presses in on the small sculpture garden, with only a knobby fence of varnished cedarwood standing ward between the cultivated land and the wilds beyond.  A grim ice statue stands near to a pine door leading back into the warmth of the lodge.  It depicts a halfling figure wreathed in sculpted flames.

title: [Vardar Hollow, Sculpture Garden]
description: Sitting beneath a bower of vividly blue ice blossoms, a white pine bench embellished with carved mules holds court before sculptures of halflings and giants gathered over a treaty table of pale carved ice.  The nook is set off from the rest of the sculpture garden, and even the biting cold seems lessened, as the bend of the lodge's walls and the heavy growth of trees just beyond the property's fence conspire to shield the sanctuary from the bitter wind.

title: [Vardar Hollow, Sculpture Garden]
description: Recreated with painstaking detail in the snow is a small walled town.  The sculpture occupies nearly a third of the garden's space and is so intricate as to feature tiny townsfolk of carved ice within its cold streets.  Overhead, branches of towering sugar pines jostle with the lower tops of cedar trees, waving in the breeze as if beckoning garden visitors beyond the knobby fence forming the cultivated area's perimeter.  Far up in the branches of the sugar pine, a bony talisman clacks and clatters.

title: [Vardar Lodge, Banquet Hall]
description: Lining the walls, a series of serving tables frame a dance floor of radiating parquet tiles.  Chandeliers set with many candles overhead waken vibrant hues within the wood, from the white of pine to the distinctive ruddy glow of cedar.  A small bandstand crowds into one corner.

title: [Williwaw Resort, Lounge]
description: The lighting is low in the lounge, a spacious round chamber lined with private tables.  Patrons hold quiet conversations in hushed tones as the dignified staff glides gracefully about the area in pursuit of their duties.

title: [Resort, Winterberry Den]
description: Cozy and warm, the walls of the lounge are covered with rich burgundy brocade, and the western wall is adorned with a large portrait.  Riverstone set in gleaming copper framework composes a giant fireplace at the far end of the room, around which a tawny leather couch, a chocolate suede chaise, and an umber velvet divan are arranged in a rough semicircle.  A small polished mahogany bar curves away from the wall next to a pair of carnelian-set double doors.

title: [Williwaw Resort, Banquet Hall]
description: Fine lines of gleaming copper edge a massive refectory table of polished pine.  Arms of golden glaes twist outward from the walls, bearing natural beeswax candles.  The table is surrounded with long, wide benches of earth-colored suede.  At odds with the large size of the room is the cozy atmosphere created by the honey-colored wood beam ceilings and walls covered in smooth umber silk.

title: [West Wing Suites, Hallway]
description: A woven earth-colored carpet edged with metallic rust-hued knotwork runs the length of the hallway, muffling footsteps on the polished pine floor.  Eahnor scones punched with a pattern of tiny snowflakes are affixed to the wall on either side of a lacquered dark brown door.

title: [Chocolate Suite, Bedroom]
description: A luxurious featherbed rests against the western wall of this delightful room.  Next to the bed, a small pedestal table holds a crystal candy dish.  Set into the dark-stained paneled walls is a beaded ivory velvet curtain leading to the balcony.  Plush dark brown carpet keeps the room cozy, and a trio of chocolate-scented candles adorn the modwir fireplace mantle.

title: [Chocolate Suite, Soaking Tub]
description: Pale ivory marble scattered with flecks of gold is filled to the brim with steaming water.  A gilded faucet is nearly obscured by a froth of chocolate-scented bubbles.

title: [Chocolate Suite, Dressing Room]
description: A large ivory marble tub fills the far corner, and an ornately carved armoire sits across from it.  Pale brown ceramic tiles cover the floor, and flickering candles lend the room a welcoming air.

title: [West Wing Suites, Hallway]
description: A smooth ecru wool carpet trimmed with rose gold ribbon runs the length of the hallway, muffling footsteps on the polished pine floor.  Mithglin sconces punched with a pattern of tiny snowflakes are affixed to the wall on either side of a garnet-studded door.

title: [Cherry Suite]
description: Wide cherrywood floorboards, stained the hue of blood spilled on a moonless night, gleam mutely in the light provided by a quartet of iron-caged candles.  The faint light flickers over the bare crimson walls, creating long, deep shadows.  In the middle of the windowless room stands an enormous bed, the only piece of furniture in this stark space.

title: [East Wing Suites, Hallway]
description: A soft forest green runner threaded with glimmering gold runs the length of the hallway, muffling footsteps on the polished pine floor.  Copper sconces punched with a pattern of tiny snowflakes are affixed to the wall on either side of a glossy caramel-hued door.

title: [Caramel Suite]
description: Swathes of beige gauze surround the quilt-covered bed.  A painted porcelain box sits on the bedside table.  Clothing pegs of linden wood match the dresser, its top scattered with candles of various sizes and shades.  Brown and tan stripes decorate the walls, and a tan fringed rug tops the gleaming linden floors.  The gauze-covered window overlooks an expanse of white-tipped conifers.

title: [East Wing Suites, Hallway]
description: A cerulean carpet edged in soft silver ribbon runs the length of the hallway, muffling footsteps on the polishd pine floor.  Silver sconces punched with a pattern of tiny snowflakes are affixed to the wall on either side of a door painted a pale mint hue.

title: [Mint Suite, Sitting Room]
description: A small white marble fireplace burns merrily, warming the small space from wall to wall.  A couch covered in cream and mint-striped silk faces the fireplace, with a white willow table table in between.  Flurries of snow can be glimpsed through the sheer curtains covering the single rectangular window.

title: [Mint Suite, Bedroom]
description: In this mid-sized room, pale green silk covers the walls, and a slightly darker green carpet pads the floor.  A white lace coverlet lies atop a four poster bed.  A pot sprouting spearmint sprigs sits on the sill of a stained glass window.  Wrought iron wall sconces hold mint-scented candles to illuminate the room.

title: [Talondown Arena, Cashier]
description: Beneath a prominent golden maple sign, a grate of nigh-impenetrable vultite protects a box run by a pair of hunch-shouldered kobolds and a snooty green goblin.  Behind them are burlap sacks filled with coins in various denominations and precious metals.  Hanging from the ceiling is a glimaerstone-set chandelier of gold shaped into a firebird with its claws extended.

title: [Talondown Arena, Pit Boss]
description: The swirl of raucous activity in the dim, smoke-choked chamber centers around one elven woman, tall and pale and severe of face.  She stands amidst the rumbling throng as if untouched by its madness, her motions quick and precise as she directs the flow of activity.

title: [Talondown Arena, Gate]
description: Standing beneath the low-hanging and outstretched talons of a firebird sculpture, the wooden gate leading to the stands is a splintered confection of warped wood and rusted nails.  The deck underfoot is paneled in mismatched blond and dark wood planks.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Second Floor]
description: Exquisitely crafted heavy wool tapestries cover every wall in this generously sized room.  Each tapestry looks to be devoted to a different branch of the arcane arts and is filled with images and sigils that hint at hidden meanings.  Thick, colorful rugs cover the chilly stone floor, complimenting the colors and patterns of the tapestries.  The well-lit room is devoid of furniture or any obvious light-source, and the unexpected fragrance of ozone permeates the air.

The generously sized room is covered in heavy wool tapestries, each one slightly altered by less skilled hands.  Each tapestry, devoted to a different branch of the arcane arts, hangs covered in half-torn sigils repaired into hearts, stars, and horseshoes.  Thick cotton rugs, woven into the shape of a herd of extremely fluffy roltons, draped across the paint-splattered stone floor.  Devoid of furniture or an obvious light-source, the room contains a gigantic straw gargoyle, its head reaching the ceiling.

title: [Pebbley Playthings, Showroom]
description: Beams of dust-filled sunlight flow in from a small broken window high up on the wall, showering the room with a faint, pale light.  A splintered crate lays awkwardly atop a broken slab of granite.  Pieces of crushed rock partially obscure a small dented trunk.  Cracked along the frame, a stone archway leads deeper into the chamber, while a bunch of old toys are piled up to one side, forgotten in a corner.

title: [Windfellow Tower, First Floor]
description: This area has been converted into a storeroom of sorts and contains row upon row of wooden shelves lashed to stone walls.  The strong mineral odor of the surrounding walls and floor does not quite overpower the persistent scent of herbs and spices that emanate from a wall-mounted drying rack.  A few burlap bags half-filled with grain remain on one of the shelves.  Empty barrels dot each corner of the room.

Uneven wooden shelves are stacked with bouquets of dried flowers, some of the flora decaying slightly between bits of soft moss.  The surrounding walls are roughly covered in old fraying tapestries, their ropes swaying precariously against a wall-mounted drying rack.  Burlap bags full of coffee beans, painted with rudimentary lettering, threaten to spill over the shelving creaking slightly towards its demise.

title: [Temple Of Tentacles, Crypt]
description: Sanguine cobwebs drape from wall to wall across this dank, dark alcove.  Crumbling and decrepit on a raised platform in the center of the crypt is a crumbling black coffin with a rotting black table next to it.  The floor is stained a dark red with bits of decayed flesh and bone shards.

title: [Tunnel, Hope's End]
description: A horrible sarcous substance clings to the stone walls in places, weeping yellowish fluid that smells of copper and sickness.  Whatever it is, the material is raw and pinkish like fresh-scraped flesh.  Strings of it drip from the ceiling like a horrendous parody of hanging vines.  It culminates in a tumorous mass along the far wall, taking the form of a quivering pinkish portal suffused with bilious green light.

title: [Tunnel, Ring of the Dead]
description: A ring of corpses lays splayed across the ground, encircling a clear patch of rough rock as if they had been arranged there.  They are bathed in a source of bile green light that seethes from the south, where the low roof of the tunnel rises precipitously.  A spent lantern sits next to one of the bodies, its metal hood bent and its glass spiderwebbed with cracks.

title: [Tunnel, Coffinway]
description: Here and there, the hastily dug tunnel breaches into ancient burial plots.  The path is littered with silvery splinters of wood from old coffins.  Dessicated, bony body parts hang from the ruined caskets, along with trailing shreds of moth-eaten velvet that stir in any passing wind as if they are waving morbidly to passersby.

title: [Tunnel, The Breach]
description: Feeble torchlight from beyond a breached white brick wall holds the darkness of the tunnel at bay, but only barely, and its heat is a distant memory only paces away.  An oppressive, deep chill suffuses the air and moist walls of the tunnelway, and the entire place stinks of death and rot.  The walls are rough and crude, as if hastily dug, and are scored with claw marks.

title: [Wandering Eye Market]
description: Black, azure, and cerulean paint spreads across the cobblestones of the large market, the pigments converging upon an enormous sandstone fountain that has a towering bronze kraken statue rising out of it.  Firelight spills from lanterns clutched in four of the statue's arcing arms, each positioned over a different stone bench to create a small pool of light.  A thatched driftwood store, built just beyond the shadow of the nearby cliffs, has its doors thrown wide to the cool night air.

Black, azure, and cerulean paint spreads across the cobblestones of the large market, the pigments converging upon an enormous sandstone fountain that has a towering bronze kraken statue rising out of it.  Sunlight cascades off of the lanterns clutched in four of the statue's arms, causing rainbow whorls to dance across the surrounding stone benches.  Nearby, a thatched driftwood store, built just beyond the shade of the tower cliff, draws all manner of customers through its front door.

Black, azure, and cerulean paint spreads across the cobblestones of the large market, the pigments converging upon an enormous sandstone fountain that has a towering bronze kraken statue rising out of it.  Sunlight cascades off of the lanterns clutched in four of the statue's arms, causing rainbow whorls to dance across surrounding stone benches.  Nearby, a severe stone structure is encircled by heavily armed, brutish guards that pointedly ignore the catcalls and laughter of the surrounding market, while opposite a weathered oak building has a steady flow of visitors.

Black, azure, and cerulean paint spreads across the cobblestones of the large market, the pigments converging upon an enormous sandstone fountain that has a towering bronze kraken statue rising out of it.  Firelight spills from lanterns clutched in four of the statue's arcing arms, each positioned over a different stone bench to create a small pool of light.  Nearby, a severe stone structure is encircled by heavily armed, brutish guards that warily watching the darkened market.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Kraken's Fall Bank]
description: A small series of wide steps just inside the oak door lead down into a wide corridor.  Alcoves can be seen to either side, though they aren't well lit, and it's hard to make out their contents.  Several muscular guards patrol this area, their suspicious eyes constantly on the move.  The entire space is lit by some large braziers suspended from the stone ceiling, and the scent of hot wax is omnipresent.

title: [Baile Dragan, Lair]
description: A floor-to-ceiling ceramic tile stove anchors one end of the room, surrounded by piles of jewel-tone velvet pillows, beckoning residents to gather there.  Against the opposing wall sits an enormous iron-bound chest.  As candles cast their flickering shadows across the hall, members wander off to their sleeping niches singly or in pairs, drawing heavy silk curtains of deep emerald green for privacy.  The sound of soft snoring can be heard occasionally above the soft murmur of conversations.

title: duplicate of 2953
description: Seven broad, stone steps lead upwards, bracketed by ornate wooden bannisters.  The balusters are carved into the spearheaded shapes of irises, while the newels are shaped like frogs upon lilypads.

title: [Den of Rot, Portal]
description: Dominating a circular expanse of raised stone surrounded by a small plaza, a sculpted slick stone portal worked into the shape of twining bodies casts sickening radiance upon the surroundings.  The portal occupies the tallest plateau in a vast underground chasm.  Warm, moist air blankets the area heavily, stinking oppressively of mildew and old rot.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
description: The northwestern curve of the plaza ends in an irregular crack where several feet of stone have been shorn violently away from the plateau.  Veins of sickly green jade gleam from the rock exposed by the break.  Past the ledge, dark wooden scaffolding has been constructed to shore up the structural instability.

title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
description: Just paces away to the west, a wall of igneous rock breaches out of the swampy depths below and continues for another hundred feet before tapering toward a jagged point, like a talon pointing toward the cavern's distant ceiling.  That pace is an impossible one, as empty air and a drop into fathomless blackness separates the portal's plateau from the taller rock formation.

title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
description: A colony of bats nests overhead, as evidenced by a small scattering of guano that litters a section of the plaza.  The tiny, furry creatures swarm about a cleft in the ceiling, eyes glinting in the uneven light.  The surrounding stone is fastidiously clean, as if the area is otherwise regularly maintained.

title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
description: Cracks spiderweb through the floor of the plaza as if an immense object impacted the stone.  Overhead, one large stalactite looks like a broken fang, a jagged chunk missing from its tip, but there is no sign of the absent chunk.  The plaza ends, but a thin lip of raw stone stretches toward the south.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Den of Rot, Chasm]
description: A vine-covered wood suspension bridge spans the void between the plateau and another one nearby in the inky expanse of the cavern.  Though once comprised of wood and rope, creeping parasitic vines have trained themselves along the guide ropes, and in some places, appear to have replaced them entirely.  The green of the vines is peculiar in a lightless place, but no more so than the dramatically red, trumpet-shaped flowers blossoming along their length.

title: [Den of Rot, Chasm]
description: Twin stakes are driven into the hard, dark stone of the plateau, which rises many spans over the boggy floor of the cavern.  They anchor a vine-covered wood suspension bridge that sags between the plateau and another, slightly higher, in the distance.  Vines entangle the guide ropes to either side of the bridge's rickety planking.

title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
description: The southeastern curve of the plaza looks out onto the eastern rock face of a torchlit stone grotto far below.  Carved into the face are countless contorted bodies, sculpted as if caught in paroxysms of pleasure.  The features of its base are concealed by the curve of the surrounding rock formations.  Out on the waters near the grotto, the silhouette of a dock is barely visible in the darkness.

title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
description: Cut and smoothed from the waxy black stone comprising the spindly plateau on which it stands, the plaza slopes a bit toward its eastern extremity.  Beyond there is naught but open air and a long way down to a body of dark water that winds sinuously through the great cavern.  From such a distance, the water is mute and featureless.

title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
description: A huge stalactite hangs over the northeastern portion of the plaza, its base heavily eroded by seeping, milky water that steams along its mossy length, dripping to form a cloudy pool on the stones underfoot.  Mushrooms, black and banded with vivid orange stripes, have sprung up in the runnel worn by the constantly dripping fluid.

title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
description: The plateau occupied by the small plaza comes to a jagged end toward the north and looks out into pitch darkness.  Though oppressive, the sodden blackness is not complete.  Here and there, patches of moss glowing unsettling green or striking blue reveal swathes of boggy cavern floor or other vast rock formations in the extreme distance.

title: [Den of Rot, Plateau]
description: Stalactites hang low over the rough terrain of the subterranean plateau, their sharp, curved tips almost close enough to touch.  They are clad in eerie green and blue patches of fungus that wobble in the air like fleshy protuberances.  To the east, slick steps have been carved into the rising surface of the plateau, leading upward toward a towering, shadowed figure that is vague and featureless in the darkness.

title: [Den of Rot, Effigy]
description: Towering above the high point of the rocky plateau, an immense jade effigy stands atop a plinth of slick black stone heavily overgrown with fleshy fungi.  The smoothed stone before the great plinth is spattered with effluiva and littered with countless burning candles.  Dancing light from the candles makes it seem as if the statue's carved shift is stirring in the air currents of the cavern.  Stone steps proceed to the east and west, with steeper ones meandering down toward the low point of the ragged plateau.

title: [Den of Rot, Stone Steps]
description: Spongy, stinking earth, likely heaped ashore by occasional floods from the nearby subterranean river, leaves only occasional humps of solid stone to breach up from the marshy terrain.  Just to the north, a sliver of higher ground is joined to a tall, spindly plateau.  Meandering stone steps climb the wall of the formation, marching up to an indistinct but vividly feminine figure worked from green stone.  It stands with outstretched arms.

title: [Den of Rot, Plateau]
description: Carved into a rise in the stone of the subterranean plateau, crude steps ascend toward a great figure of green stone at the rock formation's peak.  Luminous fungi clinging to the cavern's far-off ceiling halo the figure in pale blue and green light, ominously silhouetting tentacles swarming around the great effigy.

title: [Den of Rot, Flood Barrier]
description: A long stone barrier stretches along the mucky bank of the wide underground river to the north.  Judging from the boggy, sucking ground, the low wall is not enough to prevent occasional flooding from the watercourse, but it keeps the lower terrain from being entirely underwater.

title: [Den of Rot, Rise]
description: A hump of rounded black stone breaches out of the swampy muck, bending into a pitch black path to the northwest.  Toward the south, the walkway retreats away from the river's edge, humid swampland giving way to moss-carpeted stone.  Torchlight glows in the southern distance, the source not visible but obvious from its reflection off of a moisture-sheened spot expanse of the cavern ceiling.

title: [Den of Rot, Lightless Path]
description: The stone rise is cragged and treacherous as it crests toward a slick gravel trail bending toward a crooked peninsula of stone that protrudes out into the tenebrous river.  Unleavened darkness presses in, hot and damp, transforming crevices in the stone into pits of unknowable depth.

title: [Den of Rot, Lightless Path]
description: Climbing raggedly toward the north, the stone walk cuts across the river.  Steaming water slaps at the land to either side, splashing and fizzing on the stones nearby, but unseen.  The sick sweetness of decay is like an oil slick on the heavy, wet air.

title: [Den of Rot, Training Yard]
description: Corroded steel weapons racks border a training area with a small, mucky pit in the center.  In lieu of training dummies, disease-blotched corpses have been strapped to several posts nearby, their skin scored with slashes from blades and whips.  Sickly green and wan red pennants festoon the top of each post, stirring occasionally in the cavern's air currents as if mocking the deceased.

title: [Den of Rot, Summoning Circle]
description: Etched crudely into the ground is a vast circle with runed edges, the attempts of its creator to follow the bend of the rocky ground resulting in a shape that is slightly oblong and malformed.  More shapes, from simplistic linework to complex runes, line the inside of the circle.  The edges are blackened and burnt, the surrounding stone smooth save where it is pocked with popped air bubbles.  There is a small break in the circle.

title: [Den of Rot, Village]
description: Small, sloping huts with roofing of mossy thatch dot either side of the stone roadway.  Light from unevenly spaced torches between them reveals decadent architecture, as if workers with an image of a home but no experience building one cobbled together a crude facsimile.  Incongruously, the doorless entrances of the huts reveal silken bedding strewn across the plank floors within, the colors riotous but the make uniformly fine.

title: [Den of Rot, Village]
description: Suspended between two doorless huts is a bloated disease-ridden body hanging from a quartet of ropes, one tied about each limb.  They are drawn so tight as to provide neither the body nor the ropes any slack.  To the northeast, the path bends toward a cavern wall, but flickering light along the moist stone betrays the existence of a tunnel in that direction.

title: [Den of Rot, Tunnel Entrance]
description: Dense stone walls curve to cut off the path leading from the decaying nearby village, but the path is undeterred.  It proceeds eastward through a narrow passageway that is lined with oily, gnarled torches.  Currents of air waft from the tunnel like heavy breaths, and carry a fetid odor of sodden earth.

title: [Den of Rot, Tunnelway]
description: A winding, well-trodden tunnel proceeds through solid rock, score marks to either side of the path suggesting that it is not a natural formation.  The air within is very hot and very moist, the mugginess of the surrounding cavern amplified by occasional torches jammed into crevices in the rock.

title: [Den of Rot, Tunnelway]
description: The tunnelway winds like a serpent through the rock, lit only by the occasional torch anchored in gashes and bends in the walls.  Their light shines strikingly on bands of rich green jade, the vivid hue of the semiprecious ore stark against the prevailing dingy black stone.  A torn shred of pale silk is caught on an outcropping nearby, fluttering in air coming through an opening to the east.

title: [Den of Rot, Grotto]
description: Torches light a noisome, boggy grotto.  Thick vines choke the walls, fleshy and fibrous, unhealthily pale from a lack of nourishing sunlight.  Wooden planks are raised out of the muck below to form a walkway, but it is an uncertain thing, most of the wood succumbing to some degree of decomposition.  Some lichen-clad dark wooden docks stretch out over the banks of the nearby river.

title: [Den of Rot, Docks]
description: Sprouting off of a torchlit overgrown grotto, the docks stretch out over the inky flow of black water.  The wood is decaying and heavily choked with lichen.  Protesting creaks, cracks, and groans rise from the overstrained timbers, rising above the rush of the river.

title: [Den of Rot, Grotto]
description: Tumorous growths defile the vines hanging overhead and cascading down the walls, adding to the blighted, sickly appearance they have developed from growing down in the dark.  The wood plank path bends eastward with the curve of a sheer rock wall that serves as the grotto's boundary.  Sculpted bodies, humanoid and at turns nubile and virile, are carved into the rock in a veritable bacchanal of intertwining forms.

title: [Den of Rot, Grotto]
description: Proceeding beneath a wall carved with images of unspeakable debauchery, the plank walk begins a steady bend toward the northeast.  To either side of the path are statues of pitted igneous rock that depict hideously contorted humanoids, their limbs twisted into tentacles and their teeth shark-like and sharp.  Were it not for their deformities, their forms would be avatars of perfection, each with immaculate musculature and elegant features.

title: [Den of Rot, Cache]
description: A bend in the stone walls fosters a small cache of crates.  Straw litters the ground and pokes from between their slats in a few places, but the crates seem intact.  Similarly, a round ironwood vat pushed to the back of the stockpile is meticulously sealed with pitch, the ironwood construction reinforced with bands of heavy steel.

title: [Den of Rot, Docks]
description: Barrels and crates are stacked high on the dock, redolent with the smells of salt and pickling spices.  A small barge is moored to the docks with dingy lines, its deck accessible via a warped oaken gangplank.  Sailless, the barge looks sleek and is painted a sharp green, though curls of flaking paint at the waterline suggest that the river has taken a toll on the vessel.

title: [Den of Rot, Barge]
description: Flat and sleek, the barge has no room for crew quarters and a small depression in the deck that suffices as its hold.  It sits low in the water, weighed down by crates and a reinforced ironwood barrel so heavy that it sets the deck at an uncomfortable cant.  Faint, sickly green light seeps from between the slats of the barrel.  Sagging and warped, a gangplank leads down to the bordering dock.

title: [Den of Rot, Temple Approach]
description: The plank walkway gives way to solid stone several paces before a pair of inlaid bronze doors.  Easily thrice the height of a man, the doors are paneled with solid jade that has been etched with bas-reliefs.  The torches closest to the entrance burn a vile shade of yellow-green and trail oily smoke, lending an unhealthy cast to the surroundings.

title: [Temple of Rot, Narthex]
description: A low, illuminated ceiling, bright with gilt and crowded with painted images of grotesque revelry, hangs over the entrance of the temple.  The air is close and still, and the fragrance of clinging, soporific smoke is thick.  The latter's source is a series of pierced metal censers set in wall niches to either side of the inlaid bronze doors leading out into the unevenly torchlit darkness beyond.

title: [Temple of Rot, Narthex]
description: Suspended from the illuminated ceiling, a chandelier takes the form of interlocking bodies, its bronze construction salaciously emulating supple, preternaturally beautiful forms.  All of its candles burn a blanched yellow-green, casting their dancing light upon a sculpted stone arch that leads further into the temple.  The narthex continues to the east.

title: [Temple of Rot, Nave]
description: Beyond the arch separating narthex from nave, the ceilings slope upward.  Far above, they glisten with ostentatious displays of copper leaf and inlaid jade, creating the illusion of swirls of green smoke against a reddish background.  A musky odor mingles with the cloying smoke leaking from countless censers along the walls.

title: [Temple of Rot, Narthex]
description: A heavy bronze door in the eastern wall is inlaid with wisps of smoke in yellowed jade.  In a niche next to the door, a single censer trails lazy curls of oily black smoke into the air.  The creeping smoke looks like grasping black tentacles as it coils up toward the ceiling of its niche.

title: [Temple of Rot, Nave]
description: The nave has a traditional layout, with its central walk proceeding toward a raised dais at the far end, but in lieu of seating, piles of silk cushions and soft, colorful cloth are everywhere.  Blankets and cushions alike are wrinkled and stained.  They occupy most of the floor before a bronze statue of a buxom, tentacled woman.

title: [Temple of Rot, West Transept]
description: Deep, short steps rise up from the nave toward the temple's chancel, curling away from an obscenely feminine statue of bronze.  Urns of pale jade are spaced along the outer steps, holding sirenflower, lavender, and lilac.  The plants are overgrown and seem almost too healthy, the green of their stems so vivid as to be unnatural.

title: [Temple of Rot, East Transept]
description: Steps gently rise from the nave toward the chancel, curving outward to avoid an outrageously provocative statue of bronze.  Along the outer steps, pale jade urns hold a bounty of lilac, sirenflower, and lavender.  The blossoms exude a thick, milky sap and the stems are too green.

title: [Temple of Rot, Chancel]
description: Leading up to a raised copper dais, the polished floor has a sickly greenish hue.  It is inlaid with tiles of reddish pink stone the color of raw flesh, each etched with a swirl of smoke.  Before the dais, a grisly bronze statue stands, glistening obscenely in yellow-green light flickering from hundreds of candles crowding the borders of the chancel.

title: [Temple of Rot, Altar of Lust]
description: A fortune in copper has been forged into a wide disc that rises over the rest of the chancel. At its center stands an altar of deep green jade, its surface patterned with whorls of stylized smoke.  Tentacles strain from the stone of the altar as if to embrace a supplicant before it, their muscular forms covered with dozens of ghastly suckers.  A single copper step descends back to the nave.

title: [Den of Rot, Lightless Path]
description: Once, lanterns might have lit the trail.  Their corroded remnants hang from the leaning poles of lichen-eaten wood to either side of the path, barely visible in the oppressive gloom.  Snatches of an overpowering, fetid stench ebb and flow on the musty air currents.  The rock floor is almost glassy smooth, as if worn that way by countless footsteps.

title: [Den of Rot, Lightless Path]
description: Cloying, sweet decay overwhelms any of the cavern's other odors, from the faintly metallic odor of the water to the ever-present bitterness of mold.  Its source is a jagged-edged pit, roundly uneven, that bores down into the stone of peninsula as it reaches its culmination.  Before the gash stands a tall pedestal with an ancient skin-bound enchiridion upon it.

title: [Den of Rot, Pit of Rebirth]
description: Hundreds of bodies are heaped into the pit, all of them female.  In life, each would have been possessed of surpassing beauty.  They lay heaped atop one another like broken dolls, eyes clouded over.  Together, theirs is an unbearable stench of old blood, death, and seething rot.

title: [Baile Dragan, Cellar]
description: A cool temperature makes the cellar at Baile Dragan an ideal storage area.  The room is filled with kegs of ale and cider and racks of bottled wines, some labeled with the finer vintages of decades past.  Neatly stored in the room are sacks of potatoes and root vegetables, armor and weapons, and other sundry goods necessary for the running of such an establishment.  A small niche is outfitted with a wooden table, a wash tub, and an iron brazier.

title: [Baile Dragan, Library]
description: The air in this dimly lit room carries the scent of parchment and leather.  Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves are packed tightly with thick tomes and parchment scrolls.  The most valuable volumes are located on a rack above a long study table, each fastened securely to a rod with a length of chain.  Oil lamps burn brightly on several reading desks equipped with inkwells and quill pens.  Two comfortable chairs and an overstuffed leather sofa create a cozy reading nook for more casual study sessions.

title: [Baile Dragan, Sky Watch]
description: Open to the elements, the roof of the Baile Dragan tower offers a good vantage point for watching the lights of town, as well as a superb place for observing the night sky.  A large telescope is prominently placed in the center of the rooftop, its brass fittings gleaming softly.  Affixed to the floor around the entire circumference of the area, is a brass plate that shows the constellations visible from each of four quadrants during every season.  A small garden is illuminated by moonlight.

title: [Abbey, Cloistered Walk]
description: Sheltered by an arching ceiling of tan and white stone, the cloistered walk ends before the heavily adorned doors of worked bronze, polished free of dust or the darkening of time.  They shine brightly in the creamy marble facade of the chapel beyond, framed on either side by a quartet of stained glass windows depicting the seasons.

title: [Kraken's Fall Bank, Teller]
description: A wide wooden counter spans the entire width of this room, and interspersed across its top are heavy iron bars a handsbreadth apart, securely fastened to both the counter and the stone ceiling overhead.  A glossy black placard inlaid with gold leaf text is prominently placed above a single gap in the center of the iron supports.  Three stern-looking guards stand at the ready, their hands near their weapons as they track every movement in the room.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, North]
description: Starlight illuminates the sky, though the moons never truly show their faces this close to the sheer cliff wall that stretches towards the sky.  Purple clover blossoms grow between the dark cobblestones, and tangled flaeshorn vines strive for the peak.  Smaller stalls, dark and secretive, have popped up in the shadow of the cliff, while an enormous iron-bound door is built directly into its craggy face.  A small oak and stucco shop rests on the far southern edge of the square.

Starlight bathes the cobblestone lane in a silver sheen, while dark shadows created by the looming presence of a high cliff vie for dominance.  A large two-story inn to the west lends its hulking form to the battle for darkness by looming over the smaller cottages built along the eastern edge.  Removed from the fight, a southern slip of road leads closer to the ocean and is the home of a sprawling stone-sided complex.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, Northwest]
description: Patterns of starlight dance across this section of the market, which is built against the pockmarked face of a natural slate wall that rises several stories high.  Fruit and vegetable stalls with cheerily decorated awnings create a maze of pathways that lead to and fro upon the painted cobblestones.  A striped pavilion spreads across the westernmost section, its back open to a small garden of herbs and local plants.

title: [Abbey, Prioress's Office]
description: A small, cozy office is set off from the rest of the dorter by a plain spruce door.  Other than a small silver snowflake charm hanging above the portal, twined with a bit of wild rose and sweetbriar, the chamber favors function over form.  There is a neatly kept writing desk and no chair, and the desk's letter trays have but a few pieces of parchment in each, as if the occupant fastidiously tends to incoming and outcoming work.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, West]
description: Still busy despite the hour, traffic trickles in from the northwestern road through the cobblestone courtyard.  Wagons, mules, and heavily burdened workers have worn away some of the painting upon the cobblestone of the market, though some of the edges still display the black, cerulean, and azure hues.  A large flat-roofed tent with an enormous wooden sign hanging over its entry stands open for business along the western edges, while opposite a weathered oak building is brightly illuminated from within.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Mantle's Landing]
description: Cliffs pockmarked with puffin burrows rise towards the sunlit sky, the rocky protrusions casting shadows upon the surrounding cobblestone streets.  Clotheslines stretch from anchors in the cliff face to the balcony of a nearby inn, their lengths laden with sheets, towels, and aprons that sway in the seaborne breeze.  Isolated and alone, a single lantern perched upon its wrought iron pedestal sits at the corner of the street where the road declines to the southeast.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Cranial Crawl]
description: Large and small totems, some stacked as tall as a giantman, decorate the lawn of a small shop set back from the edges of the cobblestone road.  Twin walruses fashioned of elm hold a pine mermaid aloft in their tusks, the grinning passenger lies on her back with one hand on her stomach and the other hanging limp with a white seashell-shaped sign clutched in hand.  Fitfully burning lanterns are strategically placed along the lane to provide the best possible illumination for visitors.

Fresh paint decorates a sprawling structure built within a white fence and manicured lawns, a painted sign above the entry proclaiming it as "Sailor's Solace."  Situated in the curve of a fork in the road is a dark-shingled white oak shop.

description: Ebbing and flowing, the lapping waves darken the glistening sands as they soak the edges of a beach illuminated by bamboo torches. Set back from the water, an enormous circular pedestal supports a large dolphin statue, the back of which is illuminated from light that spills out of a stone-lined angular archway built into the bluff.

description: Brightly reflecting the sunlight, frosted globes dangle from the gutters of a scrollworked purple wooden wagon that is parked upon the painted cobblestones of the sprawling market. title: [Kraken's Fall, Deadeye's Road]
description: Skirting the edges of an open-air market filled with colorful tents, the cobblestone road follows the edge of the coastline.  An oak railing supported by sturdy posts blocks a drop to the wave-tossed shoals below, while fitfully burning glaesine-doored lanterns provide bright illumination for the area.  High grasses sway in the light sea breeze that is laden with the scent of salt, the long blades clicking and clacking against a nearby warehouse.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Deadeye's Road]
description: Towering poles laden with heavy line stretch across the cobblestone pathway where thick panels of recently dyed sailcloth dry in the seaborne breeze.  Additional clotheslines are erected beyond the protective guardrail that separates the road from a steep incline of untamed beach grasses terminating in jagged rocks slick with sea spray.  Just beyond the patchwork of color, a bright white shop is the source of an acrid chemical smell that fills the air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west

title: [Kraken's Fall, Deadeye's Road]
description: Tiny houses dot the small incline to the southeast where dormitory style housing is built along the flat plane of a grassy knoll.  Crisscrossing crushed shell pathways form dizzying patterns amid the untamed blades until they converge into a solid path that spills into the cobblestone road.  Glaesine-doored lanterns line the northwestern edge, their flickering light spilling across a sprawling stucco academy.

title: [Kraken's Fall, South Arm Road]
description: Starlight spills across the roof of a tall oak warehouse that dominates the cobblestone road, the structure quiet and dark save for a single lantern that can be glimpsed from one of the windows.  Piles of wooden planks, oilcloth bundled packages, and various crates surround the building, though the entry is left clear and free of debris.  Morning glories enshroud a two-story whitewashed building and weave around a wrought iron lamppost whose lantern has been shattered by the invasion of the showy tendrils.

Hammering, buzzing, and loud voices spill from a tall oak warehouse that dominates the cobblestone road, the sound of industry blotting out all other sounds to the area.  Piles of wooden planks, oilcloth bundled packages, and various crates surround the building, though the entry is left clear and free of debris.  Flaeshorn vines mingle with morning glories around a wrought iron lamppost whose lanterns has been shattered by the invasion of the showy tendrils.

title: [Kraken's Fall, South Arm Road]
description: Arranged in tidy rows, vegetable gardens housed in sunken planter boxes dominate the southern slope as it gradually dips to the rocky shoal below.  A narrow winding trail follows along a cultivated path that leads to a small fishing pier and shack, while across the cobblestone road a wide-windowed coral-hued villa is surrounded by wandering chickens and geese.  The distant sound of bleating and mooing can be heard from beyond the structure, though the actual source is obscured from sight.

title: [Kraken's Fall, South Arm Road]
description: Cobblestones abruptly end as the road comes to its end as the finger of land slips always on the north, east, and south.  Bamboo torches, dormant for the moment, are planted along an oak railing that prevents visitors from a drop onto the ragged rocks below.  A sturdy oak catwalk bridges the gap between a small island-bound lighthouse and an interrupted section of the railing, while a small crenellated structure flanked by large wrought iron cannons faces the open sea.

title: [Kraken's Fall, South Arm Road]
description: Colorful pennants and banners snap and flutter in the consistent seaborne breeze from their position along the roof of a narrow log-sided hall, their colorful ends and metallic threading sparkling in the starlight.  Soft voices filter in from the west where the open-air market is quiet, while the sound easy conversation comes from the east.  A large sign post planted in the ground has several arrow-shaped planks nailed to it, each scribbled with tiny letters and images.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, East]
description: Perched upon the eastern edge of the painted cobblestone market, a two-story stone structure and a bright red brick-faced building sit in relative isolation from the hawker's stalls, awnings, and tents that occupy other portions of the market.  Twin stocks flank heavy marble stairs that lead inside the windowless structure, while evenly spaced lanterns, shedding illumination, stand silent guard over the building.  A small backless oak bench rests against a potted tree that seems out of place in the center of the market.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, Northeast]
description: Thick blue-green grass attempts to invade the painted cobblestones of the market, their tall blades swaying in the light seaborne breeze that carries with it the scent of dog roses and mulch.  Tanner's stalls and leatherworker's booths are evenly spaced from one another, each tilted at an angle to view the other.  Parked back against the towering cliff wall that stretches into the sky, a large wooden wagon painted black and silver has its door thrown wide open, while a chest-shaped calligraphed sign and a sturdy oak ladder are lashed to its side.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Kraken's Fall, Middle Arm Ave]
description: Starlight silvers the avenue as it stretches away from the open-air market towards the eastern edges of town.  Clapboard bungalows with thatched rooves are surrounded by wild thistle and scraggly beach grasses that sway in the persistent seaborne breeze.  A tall signpost dangling a pristine white sign sits at the top of a pathway lined with wild blueberry bushes that leads to a small single-story building.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Middle Arm Ave]
description: Empty lots filled with scraggly sea grass rise along the northern edge of the avenue amid small cabanas with terra cotta roofs.  A small store, flanked by empty clotheslines, rests in a manicured lawn by itself on the southeast corner of the cobblestone expanse.

Carried by the wind, the sound of hammering, buzzing, and voices trickles in from the south, though the voices are too soft to make out individual words and the other sounds are faint enough to not be an annoyance.  A small store, flanked by clotheslines of dyed fabric, rests in a manicured lawn by itself on the southeast corner of the cobblestone expanse.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Kraken's Fall, Middle Arm Ave]
description: Large roasting pits and domed brick ovens encircle a round shack with a peaked thatch roof, the white smoke billowing from them fragrant with the scent of roasting meats and spices.  Smooth, loose stones are scattered about the cooking vessels to prevent fires, though here and there tufts of grass still manage to grow.  A sprawling coral-roofed villa is built against the very edges of the cobblestone avenue, its white face dimpled with shuttered windows.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Middle Arm Ave]
description: Dusty portholes and a swinging front door are part of a weathered shack with a battered metal roof which is built in the center of a crushed seashell lot along one side of the narrow avenue, while small cottages and shacks reside along the sloping opposite side.  Dog rose bushes with bright pink blossoms lend their heady fragrance to the salty sea breeze that trickles through the area.  A broken lantern rests on its side in the dirt and dust.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Middle Arm Ave]
description: Dust hangs heavy in the air as the western avenue degrades into a dirty road as it curves sharply towards a grassy bluff.  Leafy bushes, laden with dog roses and thorns, form a barrier that prevents a sheer drop to the ocean below, their heady fragrance perfuming the air.  Perched upon the edge of the cliff, a weathered stone building with large windows interrupts the leafy profusions with its grey and white bulk.

title: [Kraken's Fall, North Arm Lane]
description: Sunlight slips past the edges of the high cliff that rises like a sheer wall to the north, the golden rays warming the cobblestone streets of the lane as it dips south but doing little to illuminate the eastern and western tracks.  A large two-story inn seems to be the source of the quiet music that filters through the air, while a sprawling stone-sided complex accounts for the sound of hammering.

Starlight bathes the cobblestone lane in a silver sheen, while dark shadows created by the looming presence of a high cliff vie for dominance.  A large two-story inn to the west lends its hulking form to the battle for darkness by looming over the smaller cottages built along the eastern edge.  Removed from the fight, a southern slip of road leads closer to the ocean and is the home of a sprawling stone-sided complex.

title: [Kraken's Fall, North Arm Lane]
description: Thatch-roofed buildings cluster together along the edges of the cobblestone road, which follows the eastern edge of a high cliff towards the sea.  Squatting amid smaller structures, a large inn painted with decorative seaweed along its balcony supports and front porch stands open for business.  Somewhere nearby, a group of musicians plays a lively tune on various wind and percussion instruments.

Thatch-roofed buildings cluster together along the edges of the cobblestone road, which follows the eastern edge of a high cliff towards the sea.  Squatting amid smaller structures, a large inn painted with decorative seaweed along its balcony supports and front porch stands open for business.  Somewhere nearby, someone plays a quiet tune on a shawm.

title: [Kraken's Fall, North Arm Lane]
description: Single-story cottages, their windows framed by dark shutters, spread across the lane, each with a small side garden and high grassy lawn encircled by picket fences.  Bamboo torches dot the cobblestone lane, the brightly burning sentinels standing guard over the seashell pathways that lead to each domicile.  A small glade of manicured grass with picnic tables encircles a crumbling stucco bar painted with a colorful keg-shaped sign.

Bamboo torches dot the cobblestone lane, the dormant sentinels standing guard over the seashell pathways that lead to each domicile.  A small glade of manicured grass with picnic tables encircles a crumbling stucco bar painted with a colorful keg-shaped sign.

title: [Kraken's Fall, North Arm Lane]
description: Ocean spray glistens on the cobblestone streets as they terminate to the east at the edge of a rocky shoal that circles around to the southern edge of the lane.  A small work house, surrounded by stacked logs, sits at the head of a worn path that leads to the water where workers use pike poles to pull logs out of the water.  Ramps ascend the cliff face, which is lower here than in other areas of the island, allowing other workers to reach the forest at the top.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Tufts of grass cling to the ragged track that follows the edges of a series of packed dirt ramps to the portside town below, while muddy pathways wend their way through a small logging colony that is built upon the cliff's edge.  Tapered logs form a sturdy barrier along the western expanses of the settled area, the sturdy defenses keeping the forested wilds at bay.  A perimeter of bamboo and hemp torches rises on the leeward side of a guardrail that stretches the length of the plunging precipice.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Rising dark and ominous into the sky, a large wooden guard tower overlooks the tapered points of the surrounding colony walls.  A hard-packed dirt road pushes through gates to the west, though it quickly turns to mud as it travels east.  Very little traffic makes its way through the town entry, which is bathed in bright starlight.  Cracked mud, soft and viscous at its center, fills the entry to a sprawling oak and pine barn that is built in the center of the lane.

Casting its shadow upon the area, a large wooden guard tower rises above the tapered points of the surrounding colony walls.  A hard-packed dirt road pushes through gates to the west, though it quickly turns to mud as it travels east.  Steady traffic from loggers skidding their daily haul keeps the bustling town entry busy.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Perched above the line of encroaching mud and surrounded by blue-green monkeygrass, an oak boarding house is built within the curve of the high timber fence.  Bright white shutters frame its rainbow glaes windows beneath a shingled roof of cedar and mahogany slats, while a bright blue door stands open and inviting on its first story.  An enticing aroma of fresh baked bread vies for dominance over the dampness and other earthy scents that fill the air.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Built against the rough stockade fence that encircles the colony, a set of stone reinforced stairs climbs to a parapet built along the top of the wall.  Water sluiced through gutters along the roof of a fortified tower spills upon the ground, creating a muddy mess that the locals avoid by making walkways of rough oak planks.  A large blackened fist painted within a canary yellow sun decorates the lowest floor of the tower.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Cracked and broken, a burbling water pump fills a nearby iron-bound oak barrel to overflowing and is undoubtedly the culprit that has turned the roadways to mud.  Some enterprising individual has created a makeshift boardwalk of rough oak planks over the muddy ground that leads from the town gates and fortifications in the west to a squat pub with a copper tile roof built nearby.  A cool seaborne breeze trickles through the area and carries with it the sound of rattling chains.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Heavy chains stretch across the open precipice to the south, where a large platform surrounded by rollways of loose timber sits quiet in the starlight.  Steel cables sway in the seaborne breeze, the bardon hooks on their ends clanking quietly as they move.  A single lantern illuminates a roofed workstation where barking irons are carefully stowed.

Towering frames hang over the southern precipice, where a large platform is surrounded by rollways of various timber logs.  Larger steel cables fitted with bardon hooks allow an assembly of workers to slowly lower each mammoth piece into the ocean below.  A secondary workstation is setup beneath a small awning, the workers within using barking irons to remove the barks and limbs of each log.

title: [Kraken's Fall, South Arm Road]
description: Swaying in the seaborne breeze, a sturdy rope and oak catwalk connects the mainland to the small island and is flanked by a pair of dormant torches.  Unkempt grass is divided by a thin dirt track that wends its way towards the stony steps of a brick and mortar lighthouse, while a white picket fence encircles the perimeter to create a safety barrier from treacherous footing at the edge of the cliff.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Entry]
description: Sturdy oak pillars support this structure, though they appear to have been added at some point, as the outer framework of the building seems far more weathered and salt-stained.  A large statue of a one-eyed dwarf dominates the center of the space, and a circular bench runs around the perimeter of its base.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Office]
description: This richly painted room is a stark departure from the construction and decor of the entry.  Each of the walls is painted a rich purple color with bright golden accents at both floor and ceiling level.  In the center of the room is a wide desk of gleaming mahogany, and underfoot, the oak floor has been polished to a high sheen.  Brass sconces line the walls, each one highly polished, allowing them to gleam from nearly every angle.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Taskmaster]
description: This room is excessively fragrant, due largely to the number of burning braziers interspersed about the space.  Each one appears to be emitting a slightly different hue of wispy smoke, and a purplish haze has accumulated along the ceiling, nearly obscuring the timber overhead.  A small desk sits against one wall, piled high with papers and scrolls of various sizes and shapes.

title: [Adventurer's Guild, Storage]
description: The most visually arresting feature of this room is the cabinets that line the entirety of the walls.  Beginning less than a handsbreadth from either side of the entryway, the cabinets stretch in an unbroken line around the entire perimeter of the space.  A small worktable stands in the center of the room, and a small chest is situated on the floor to one side of it, but the sheer volume of storage has left no room for visible decoration, leaving this space stark and utilitarian.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Thick oak planks stretch to the west, the smooth boards creating a walking space that traverse viscous mud that dominates that area of the colony.  Rough-cut railings, fashioned of smaller trees stripped of their bark, form a protective barrier along the edge of the cliff, terminating against the stockade fence to the north and a variety of logging machinery to the south.  A set of stairs descends to a small plateau in the cliff face, a large oak sign offering caution for descent.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Penitent Pass]
description: Carved directly into the cliff facing, long tunnels lead away from the railing-encircled, rough stony ledge.  Black-eyed yellow daisies peek out from a wall of bracken that prolifically grows around oak posts at the cliff's edge.  A set of stairs, narrow and cut directly into the bedrock, ascends to a logging colony surrounded by palisades.

title: [Guard Tower, Office]
description: Hanging from wrought iron wall anchors, pot-bellied glass and blued steel lanterns maintain a comfortable brightness throughout the tidy office during all times of the day and night.  Various papers, signs, notes, and maps are tacked to a large bulletin board that is hung over a simple wooden desk and its matching chair.  A cast iron stove, its chimney piped out of the southern wall, occupies one corner of the space, while a rough oak ladder leads to the second floor.

title: [Guard Tower, Armament]
description: Built beneath a conical shelter, the eastern side of the roof is devoid of a wall and has only a narrow railing that prevents a fall to the ground below.  The northern wall has an enormous opening, where a large ballista sits at the ready and is flanked by several narrow-framed openings that provide clear views of the road beyond the small colony's open front gates.  A small hatch is bolted open, providing access to a ladder that leads to the first floor.

title: [Bejeweled Booty]
description: Hazy moonlight filters through the entrance flap of the modest tent, assisting the dusty oil lamps set about the shop to provide some illumination against the night shadows.  The corners of the shop are filled with piles of exotic goods and a large expensive rug stretches across the ground.  A long glass counter serves as the focal point and a curtain of colorful glass beads offers access to the backroom.

Though some sunlight filters in through the entrance flap of the modest tent, the interior remains cool and shadowed.  The corners of the shop are filled with piles of exotic goods and a large expensive rug stretches across the ground.  A long glass counter serves as the focal point and a curtain of colorful glass beads offers access to the backroom.

title: [Bejeweled Booty]
description: A variety of statuary crowd one corner of the tent, with a pile of jewelry on a nearby table.  A tall vivid purple octopus bejeweled with glittery dust takes center stage, one engorged tentacle nestled within the side of a cracked crate holding armaments.  Near a curtain of colorful glass beads, crates filled with imbeddables and miscellaneous items are pushed to the side to make a path.

A variety of statuary crowds one corner of the tent, with a pile of jewelry on a nearby table.  A tall vivid purple octopus bejeweled with glittery dust takes center stage, one engorged tentacle nestled within the side of a cracked crate holding magical items.  Near a curtain of colorful glass beads sits an imbeddables crate and a miscellaneous crate that have been pushed to the side to make a path.

title: [Unburied Treasures]
[Unburied Treasure]
description: The salt-bleached floorboards of this wagon groan ominously underfoot, and a stuffed seagull eyes you suspiciously from a prominent perch directly over the driftwood countertop that dominates the space.  Small chests and crates litter the floor, stacked haphazardly atop each other in places, and each containing some manner of bauble or trinket.  The air is humid and dank in this place, combining with the small room to create a stifling ambience.

title: [Unburied Treasures, Smithing]
description: Leached of color, the driftwood walls curve to form a peaked roof that converge upon a single, thick oak beam.  Brass lanterns, shielded by rainbow glaes windows, hang from hooks over a leather-topped dark oak counter, their steady glow illuminating both the counter's surface and a nearby mahogany sign.  A low cloth-covered bench pressed against one wall looks to have served as someone's bed in recent history, and discarded clothing strewn about the space bespeaks a history of residence in this small room.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, Wagon Top]
description: Surrounded by a steel railing, the wagon's roof is spacious and affords a panoramic view of the Wandering Eye Market.  Positioned side-by-side, a large wastebasket and a sturdy wooden table rest along the eastern edge, the railing rising above them by several handspans.  A ladder bolted to one side provides easy egress to the cobblestones below.

title: [The Intoxicating Flora]
description: Tendrils of pale white smoke snake through the dense jungle of plants occupying most of the available shop, leaving the faintest whisper of dark amber to resonate throughout.  A resin-stained workbench sits entangled in vines along the back wall, the top covered in dusty tomes alongside a worn marble mortar and pestle.  A faint hiss and rattle echo within the walls, its origin obscured by leaves and blossoms.

title: [The Intoxicating Flora, Clinic]
description: Bundles of dried, fragrant herbs are scattered across the room, the appendage-like pieces obscuring the more macabre animal bones littered in between.  A pool of heavy grey wool engulfs a tall figure standing between a rough canvas cot and small wrotwood table, the second covered in deeply carved grooves.  Overlapped hemp mats cover the floor, the pieces concealing the deep red stains that have seeped into the dirt.

title: [Bushybrow's Collectibles]
description: Despite the chaos outside, the interior of this shop is still and quiet.  The ambient noise is muffled by the stacks and stacks of misshapen crates piled high against the outer walls, and the wooden plank floor underfoot is made of sturdy beams that don't make a sound when trod upon.  A large glass-topped table stands near the center of the space, remarkably clean given the constant bite of salt in the air.

title: [Bushybrow's Collectibles]
description: The relative quiet of the outer space continues in this room, but is somehow magnified.  The clutter that was evident has also vanished, leaving this area well-ordered and neat.  The walls of the tent are adorned with large swathes of brightly-colored cloth, and a rich mahogany sign hangs in a place of prominence amongst them.

title: [The Naked Fauna]
description: A small counter occupies the back wall, its backdrop a large glass tank housing a variety of colorful fish.  Stretched beneath a tall drying rack covered in stretched animal skins, a loosely-woven seagrass mat attempts to protect the wagon floors from scuffing but does little to hide the wear and tear.  A cheerful windchime of two pewter octopuses sways in the doorway of the shop.

title: [Mystigoggles Magicorium]
description: Weblike tendrils of smoke weave between the multitude of telescopes that line the walls of the shop, leaving only the faint fragrance of petrichor to linger in the air.  Various glass lenses have been set up across the canvas-draped counters, the convex and concave domes angled to highlight the wares in the dimly lit room.  A long-haired grey cat lounges lazily upon an old velvet chaise at the back of the shop, occasionally scanning the room before returning his nap.

title: [Mystigoggles Consignment]
description: A one-eyed wench warily glances about the shop, her hands placed firmly upon an elongated ebonwood counter situated at the center of the rug-covered floor.  The occasional spark of light flickers from a series of glass spheres flanking the counter, highlighting a pair of realistic leathery toad and frog figurines leaning against a brass-latched box.  Matching chests overflowing with a number of magical components line the brocaded walls, the contents clicking and twinkling together at various intervals.

title: [Mystigoggles Legal Wares]
description: A bronze-wired chandelier hangs high above a rounded velvet-draped table, each limb dangling an oddly shaped glass sphere filled with colorful lightning bugs.  Disjointed tinkling emanates from a tiny clockwork music box in a far off corner, the container occasionally releasing thin plumes of steam above a shelf of dark green foliage.  Set behind the table is a vibrant portrait of a massive galleon, the ship sailing towards a many tentacled shadow looming against the horizon.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Entry]
description: A colorfully-painted carved ship's figurehead styled as a happy sea hag welcomes one and all into this rustic yet upscale inn and tavern.  Woven ropes of fresh-cut flowers decorate the salvaged figurehead and fill the entry with the pleasant scent of hibiscus and ivy, mingling with ocean salt.  A polite murmur of carousing wafts in from the other side of some double doors to the west.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Front Desk]
description: A happy clerk in a smart blue uniform stands alert at a clean little desk.  A handful of freshly-buffed brass keys hang on the wall behind the clerk as he spins about his dominion in perpetual search for something to tidy up.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Landing]
description: A large brass sea hag figurine, handsomely tarnished by time and the ocean air, sits atop the banister as if to greet guests on their way to their rooms.  A smattering of sand has collected between the planks of this landing's otherwise tidy bare wood floors.  Clinking tankards, merry voices, and other muffled sounds of life drift in from downstairs.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Hallway]
description: The hallway's wooden planks creak gently underfoot, faintly reminiscent of the deck of a sailing ship.  The walls are nailed with all manner of small mementos of adventure at sea, each displayed in its own rustic driftwood frame.  A faint ocean dampness seems to linger in the air and cling to every surface.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Tavern]
description: Guests dine and carouse in close company at a single long table in this airy, well-appointed tavern.  Towards the corner, a collection of smaller tables allow guests to share a drink or word with a greater measure of privacy, and a small archway leads to a busy kitchen.  Large open windows dominate the tavern's southern wall, filling the space with the sights and sounds of the nearby sea.
