title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Kitchen]
description: As busy as this kitchen is, every effort appears to have been made to keep it as tidy as possible.  All manner of herbs, vegetables and fruit sit sorted into a variety of woven baskets and bowls stacked high to the ceiling.  Uniformed cooks tend to numerous pots and pans, while stoking and feeding the fires that keep them simmering.

title: [Dancing Hag Table]
description: A cluster of painted ceramic tiles at the center of this table portray a sea hag dancing hand-in-hand with a circle of drunken sailors.  A white ceramic lamp's flame casts a flickering light along the tiles' smooth reflective surfaces.

title: [Happy Hag Table]
description: This table's brass surface has been painstakingly etched to depict a beaming sea hag frolicking amid the ocean waves.  A trio of candles at the center of the table cast a flickering light on the hag's toothy grin.

title: [Angry Hag Table]
description: The carved surface of the oak table depicts a brigantine at sea, under assault by a sea hag who seems to have taken a bite out of its hull.  A candle splutters towards the end of its life in a jar thick with dried wax drippings.

title: [Sleeping Hag Table]
description: Flecks of oyster shell and colored glass have been carefully inlaid across the surface of this table to depict the inn's namesake sea hag in slumber.  A small brass lamp illuminates the table and casts a warm light over its ornate surface.

title: [Kissing Hag Table]
description: This table's face has been painstakingly inlaid with every shade of driftwood, to portray a sea hag puckering her lips in your direction.  A blue glass jar shelters a thick candle, casting the table in an ocean-hued light.

title: [Inking Den, Vestibule]
description: Glass-fronted lanterns dangle from wrought iron rings anchored to the ceiling to provide uniform lighting throughout the vestibule.  Several hallways branch outward from this point, each decorated with either navy blue or cerulean rugs that help to cut down on the echoing of voices and footsteps off of the stone walls.  An etched bronze sign is tacked to the lower half of the northern wall, while above it the towering image of a large black kraken being skewered by a bowsprit is painted in brilliant detail.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest, out

title: [Inking Den, Hallway]
description: Navy blue rugs bordered with braided gold rope and bright white anchors cushion the long hallway as it stretches to the east and west.  Wrought iron rings dangle from the ceiling and hold aloft glass-fronted lanterns that shed bright yellow light and dispel all surrounding shadows.  Standing opposite each other, a windowed blue door has the words, "Office of Employment," etched into its glass, while a windowed brown door has the words, "Office of the Debt Collector," etched on its glass.

title: [Inking Den, Hallway]
description: Navy blue rugs bordered with braided gold rope and bright white anchors cushion the long hallway as it stretches to the east and west.  Wrought iron rings dangle from the ceiling and hold aloft glass-fronted lanterns that shed bright yellow light and dispel all surrounding shadows.  Standing opposite each other, a windowed red door has the words, "Office of the Registrar," etched into its glass, while a windowed black door has the words, "Office of the Genealogy," etched on its glass.

title: [Inking Den, Hallway]
description: Navy blue rugs bordered with braided gold rope and bright white anchors cushion the long hallway as it stretches to the west.  Wrought iron rings dangle from the ceiling and hold aloft glass-fronted lanterns that shed bright yellow light and dispel all surrounding shadows.  Standing opposite each other, a windowed dark green door has the words, "Office of Citizenship" etched into its glass, while a windowed mustard yellow door has the words, "Office of the Cartwright", etched into its glass.

title: [Inking Den, Hallway]
description: Navy blue rugs bordered with braided gold rope and bright white anchors cushion the long hallway as it stretches to the east and west.  Wrought iron rings dangle from the ceiling and hold aloft glass-fronted lanterns that shed bright yellow light and dispel all surrounding shadows.  Standing opposite each other, a windowed black door has the words, "Office of the Cooperative Houses of Elanthia," etched into its glass, while a windowed red door has the words, "Office of Transportation," etched on its glass.

title: [Office of the Great Houses]
description: Wreathed by intricate cloth wall coverings, the small office has whitewashed walls and a thick rug of azure that stretches to completely cover the floor.  Positioned with a clear view of the entry, a decorative mahogany desk is covered with a variety of small embroidery hoops, a basket of various threads, and a cushion filled with darning needles.  Flitting between the desk and the wall coverings, a willowy sylvan clerk tends to the office.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Lower Platform]
description: High above, the open ceiling of the converted airship depot has been retrofitted with glass panes, each of which is set into a curving framework of verdigrised copper and coffered tiles.  The lower hall, with its branching chambers, sits largely open to a view of the windows, as well as to glimpses of the railings that line the elevated second story galleries.  Three steps lead downwards towards the glassed end of the building, and a half-moon shaped chamber set against it.

title: [Inking Den, Hallway]
description: Navy blue rugs bordered with braided gold rope and bright white anchors cushion the long hallway as it stretches to the east and west.  Wrought iron rings dangle from the ceiling and hold aloft glass-fronted lanterns that shed bright yellow light and dispel all surrounding shadows.  Standing opposite each other, a windowed blue door has the words, "Office of the Curator," etched into its glass, while a windowed brown door has the words, "Office of the Realtor," etched into its glass.

title: [Office of Transportation]
description: Cobalt blue rugs patterned with red and gold whorls stretch across the office floor, the metallic threads dancing as the swirling light of dozens of pendant-shaped frosted globes anchored to the ceiling pulse with a variety of hues.  A lacquered golden linden counter takes up most of the eastern wall and creates a protective barrier around a portly female agent, who watches the office's comings and goings with interest.

title: [Transportation Lounge]
description: Cobalt blue rugs cover the floor from wall to wall in the small lounge, while pendant-shaped globes dangle from copper chains in the ceiling and create a soft, twilight-hued light that suffuses the air.  Several quilted armchairs are scattered about the space, some in groups of two and three and others angled for the solitary visitor.  Shimmering energy dances within a cinquefoil archway, the static electricity rising out of it preventing anyone from entering, though nothing seems to be blocking an enruned golden arch.

title: [Transit Booth, Departures]
description: Smoothly hewn and perfectly circular, the small booth has an incredibly high ceiling which has a single frosted globe dangling from it.  Reddish light swirls throughout the compact space, the motion hypnotic and somewhat disorienting.  Fitted into the smooth stone floor is a series of cobalt circles that form interwoven patterns incised with runes.

title: [Office of the Curator]
description: An errant breeze ruffles the gauzy curtains that frame a picture of a frog sitting on a box.  Backlit by candles in wrought iron wall sconces, tiny motes ride the current, eddying around and over a wide assortment of baubles, curios, and statues.  A thick layer of fresh reeds supports a braided burgundy rug, and a well-used broom leans against a brass plaque affixed to the wall.  Mounted strategically above a windowed blue door is a brass bell.

title: [Office of Petitions]
description: Large oak beams stretch across the stone ceiling, the roughened lengths riddled with nails that hold aloft a variety of charms, talismans, and globes, while the corresponding pillars that provide their support are draped with fishing nets and strange carvings.  A long wooden plank lays across the top of two oak barrels to create a rustic countertop, which separates a ship name registrar from the public.  Open brass portholes ring the office, their windows thrown wide to display painted scenes.

title: [Inking Den, Courtroom]
description: Light from a myriad of frosted wall sconces reflects off of the stucco walls of the courtroom, the steady glow creating a warm and brightly lit space.  Navy blue rugs rest against the eastern and western walls, pews stretched out upon their faces, while leaving a central aisle of exposed stone.  An enormous copper kraken sculpture dominates the northern wall, looming over several chairs that surround a copper-edged ironwood podium.

title: [Office of the Debt Collector]
description: Mountains of ledgers, each labeled in a tidy script, are arranged numerically in ascending order on a counter that starts just to the east of a windowed brown door and wraps completely around the room to end just west of its start.  A hurricane lantern cranked up to its highest setting emits black smoke from its top and casts brilliant white light on a tidy oak desk where a weathered old clerk sits engrossed in his records.

title: [Office of Employment]
description: Bisecting the small office, a long oak counter with a swinging half-door in it keeps the business end of the office separated from the public end.  A bulletin board with job postings tacked all over it hangs to the right of the entry, while four large wrought iron lanterns dangle from rings affixed to the ceiling to provide light throughout the space.  Covered with flagons, inkwells, quills, and loose pages, a disorderly desk surrounded by chairs sits on the opposite side of the counter.

title: [Office of the Registrar]
description: Wall sconces decorate two of the four sky blue walls, their polished bronze backings reflecting the light in all directions for a nice, even illumination.  A navy blue rug with an enormous white anchor design is spread across the stone floor, the nearby bookcases, cabinets, and desk placed at an angle so as not to cover the image.  Wandering distractedly about, a bright-eyed young clerk peruses several papers from a standing position, seemingly ignoring the office's only chair.

title: [Office of Genealogy]
description: Basket lanterns dangle from the smooth stone ceiling to fill the room with a soft light that reflects off of the gold stitching of the anchor-patterned floor covering.  Stretched along the western wall of the small office is an enormous map of Kraken's Fall, its surrounding environs, and the stretch of the Tenebrous Cauldron.  Positioned to face the door, a small desk covered with a variety of papers, files, and quills has a small chair set behind it.

title: [Office of Citizenship]
description: A single brass lantern sways gently on its chain as it hangs from a low ceiling painted to resemble a cloudy sky.  Centered on a rustic orange rug covering the splintered hardwood floor is a pedestal carved into a spiral leading up to an oversized clam shell.  An oak planter nestled within a cluster of twisted bamboo stands off-kilter near the entry, with one side noticeably shorter than the other.

title: [Cartwright, Reception]
description: Painted crates, repurposed with quilted cushions, provide seating against a pine-paneled wall.  Fully parted drab linen curtains adorn a wide-framed window, tied back to allow soft moonlight to bathe the room.

Painted crates, repurposed with quilted cushions, provide seating against a pine-paneled wall.  Slightly parted drab linen curtains adorn a wide-framed window, somewhat shielding the room from the sun's harsh light.

title: [Cartwright, Office]
description: Small copper lanterns, hung from wrought iron chains, cast shadows that flicker gently against pine-paneled walls.  Flanked by two uneven stacks of sealed crates is a pocked cypress desk set at an angle near the far corner of the room.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Exterior]
description: Evenly spaced along the dusty road, fitfully burning bamboo and hemp torches stand at attention as they guide visitors towards large wooden gates built into the face of a towering stakewall.  Spindly saplings dot the northern edges of the area amid verdant shrubs laden with bright orange and red berries, while tufts of grass sprout along the southern edges where a long guardrail blocks access to the cliff's edge.  A dazzling aerial view of a portside town can be seen from this vantage point.

Evenly spaced along the dusty road, dormant bamboo and hemp torches stand at attention as they guide visitors towards large wooden gates built into the face of a towering stakewall.  Spindly saplings dot the northern edges of the area amid verdant shrubs laden with bright orange and red berries, while tufts of grass sprout along the southern edges where a long guardrail blocks access to the cliff's edge.  A dazzling aerial view of a portside town can be seen from this vantage point.

title: [Molskroen Hall, Entry]
description: Bright white stucco walls rise from the golden linden floor towards the exposed rafter ceiling, their stippled faces interrupted on the north by dark green shutters that flank glass-free windows.  Strings of frosted globes, each housing starflies and fireflies, attached to hooks on the rafters stretch in labyrinthine patterns throughout the room and provide a soft illumination.  Porcelain urns filled with flowers flank a pair of copper-bound benches along the southern wall.

title: [Molskroen Hall, Fortune Alcove]
description: Spread throughout the quiet alcove, several tables are illuminated by solitary candles placed on their dark green felt-covered surfaces.  Copper-legged bar stools with high backs and leather seats stretch out in front of a long mahogany bar that is laden with an assortment of snacks and beverages.  White whorls decorate the blue rug that fills the alcove, the thick cushioning muffling the sound of footfalls and muting the voices of visitors at the gaming tables.

title: [Molskroen Hall, Terrace Entry]
description: Starlight trickles in through a set of double glass doors, the silvery light pooling on the polished linden floor and illuminating the narrow hallway with its pale radiance.  White stucco walls stand opposite the entry, their dimpled faces pristine and unmarred by decoration or design.  The sound of laughter and general merriment trickles in from the northwest.

title: [Molskroen Hall, West Hall]
description: Framed in carved cocobolo, a long white parchment guide is mounted on the eastern wall, the starlight reflecting off of its glass-covered surface, while below it, fabric and wood dress forms stand on display.  Green shutters frame open, glass-free windows in the western wall, each providing a view of the streets beyond and bringing cool air into the narrow hallway.  Cushioned wicker armchairs are scattered about the golden linden floor, providing comfortable places for repose.

title: [Molskroen Hall, Nymph Alcove]
description: Mother-of-pearl is inlaid into an enormous seashell that acts as the backdrop to a copper and porcelain fountain that is built into the southeastern corner of the alcove.  Navy and cerulean blue hues blend together upon the surrounding walls to lend the space a wavy appearance, while frosted globes can be glimpsed from their position behind a gauzy midnight blue sheet tacked to the ceiling, their flickering lights reminiscent of sunlight dancing in water.  A faint scent of lotus blossoms dances through the air.

title: [Molskroen Hall, South Hall]
description: Stretching from east to west, a dark blue rug decorated with white whorls rests upon the golden linden flooring of the very wide hallway.  Oversized armchairs are scattered in a loose circle amid plush sofas, their focal point an ornate modwir podium inlaid with strips of silver.  Hurricane lanterns burn brightly from their wall mounts, the warm glow providing a cheeriness to the windowless space.

title: [Molskroen Hall, Dryad Alcove]
description: Bas-relief designs decorate the western wall to create the image of a storm-tossed sea complete with thrashing waves and bouncing boats along a narrow pier.  Opposite, a carved wooden sculpture dominates the wall and stretches towards the ceiling where its spindled limbs dangle frosted globes that provide a soft misty light throughout the space.  Plump dark green cushions encircle the feet of the art piece, their ends decorated in autumn-hued tassels.

title: [Molskroen Hall, East Hall]
description: Framed in mahogany, a polished sterling silver mirror is mounted on the western wall, the starlight reflecting off of its smooths surface, while below it copper and teak benches provide space for quiet repose.  Green shutters frame open, glass-free windows in the eastern wall, each providing a view of the streets beyond and bringing cool air into the narrow hallway.  A sterling silver serving cart rests in the middle of the golden linden floor, the sweet scent of pastries and the aroma of coffee rising from it.

title: [Molskroen Hall, Star Alcove]
description: Built at the junction where two hallways meet, the alcove is devoid of windows and swathed in midnight blue drapes that originate in a central ring anchored from the ceiling.  Frosted globes bind the silky fabric in place at the seam where the ceiling and wall meet, the combination of their soft glow and dark material creating a quiet, cozy space.  Small and large oversized floor cushions encircle a low table whose lacquered surface glistens in the ambient light.

title: [Molskroen Hall, North Hall]
description: Framed in ebonwood, a rectangular mirror is mounted on the southern wall, the starlight reflecting off of its smooths surface, while below it cushioned teak benches provide space for quiet repose.  Green shutters frame open, glass-free windows in the northern wall, each providing a view of the streets beyond and bringing cool air into the narrow hallway.  A small cloth-covered table filled with baubles and jewels also houses a driftwood log fitted with scented votives.

title: [Molskroen Hall, Transport Room]
description: No larger than a broom closet, the small space is occupied by a small table that is illuminated by the glow of a swirling seafoam green portal.

title: [Molskroen Hall, Garden Patio]
description: Glazed and bright, terra cotta tiles of lapis and white form a checkered pattern across the garden patio that stretches to the encircling flower beds.  Clustered together, some hummingbird feeders reflect the starlight in dazzling patterns upon the white stucco walls of the villa, as well as on the nearby wicker armchairs and glass-topped tables.  A set of double glass doors leads inside beneath an overhang of colorful roofing tiles.

title: [Grub, Gruel, and Grog]
description: Casks, crates, barrels, cages, and baskets line the walls from floor to ceiling, each labeled with a different destination or marked with a single word denoting their contents.  Large chalkboard signs dominate the northern wall, the left-hand section listing ships and cargo to be delivered and the right-hand side denoting the daily specials and shop offerings.  An incredibly long counter separates the storage and store space from the wall-hugging signs, while doors in the east and west lead out to yard beyond.

title: [Maritime Defenses]
description: Thick cobblestones stretch across the floor, while heavy blocks form the walls and climb towards a rough oak ceiling.  Heavy support posts stand out in each of the corners and also flank the doorways that lead deeper into the structure.  A wrought iron chandelier provides illumination for a cannon merchant that roams about the room providing assistance to various consumers.

title: [All Hands]
description: Large pillars stretch toward the ceiling and support enormous oak beams, as well as an exposed rafter ceiling.  Along the eastern and western edges, and closets to the various windows, planking stations are arranged where oak, mahogany, and maple boards are refined for use in ship flooring.  The central aisle is flanked by various collapsed hammocks in a wide variety of shapes, colors, and materials, while at its center sits an oak-paneled counter with hurricane lanterns suspended over it.

title: [Academy of the Bos'n]
description: Smooth stucco walls rise towards the peaked ceiling where evenly spaced support beams house lanterns that provide illumination throughout the day and night.  A discarded beam, left over from construction, rests beneath a shutter-flanked window, while coils of rope flank the entry.  Discarded steins, food platters, and eggshells are scattered across the top of a long wooden counter that sits kitty-corner to the north and west wall.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Foyer]
description: Heavy beams of dark timber, likely salvaged from the hulls of wrecked ships, stretch at a steep pitch to the near-darkness that lurks in the open space beneath the thatched roof.  Old fishing nets span the vacancy, artfully strung with branches of dried coral and a variety of shells, and candle-lit lanterns are scattered amongst them, contentiously placed to avoid the threat of fire.  A set of uneven steps lead down into the lobby, and a deep ocean green carpet runner follows in faded increments.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Lobby]
description: A deep ocean green carpet runner bisects the lobby, cutting an even divide between the check-in counter that sits to one side and an arch-inset wall on the other.  The end of the counter rounds to a gated entrance just short of the far wall, and a recessed staircase sits just beyond, leading to the second floor of the inn.  On the facing wall is a pastoral mural that spans from end to end in muted shades of grey and blue softened further by the diffuse light cast from the candle-lit lanterns overhead.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Lounge]
description: Massive ship wheel chandeliers hang from the sea salt-stained ceiling overhead, the wood of both dark with use and age, but glossy with a thick coat of lacquer.  The entire far wall of the lounge is occupied by a reclaimed wood bar, while half a dozen or so tables are arranged around a central mast erected at the center of the space.  A rope ladder leads up the mast to a crow's nest.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Crow's Nest]
description: From the high perch of the crow's nest, the entire lounge and bar below are visible, and the din of voices and glass clinking is muted.  A large, lumpy pillow covered in patched fabrics is smooshed against the curve of the railing as an impromptu seat, and atop the banister across from it sits an age-darkened spyglass on a bronze stand.  A dark bronze masthead lantern hangs from the mast at the center of the platform above a rope ladder leading down.

title: [Map Table]
description: A dark bronze masthead lantern sits at the center of the table, which itself is engraved with an elaborate map.  Not a single one of the surrounding chairs matches any other.

title: [Stormy Sea Table]
description: A dark bronze masthead lantern sits at the center of the table, which itself is carved with a bas-relief of two warring ships.  Not a single one of the surrounding chairs matches any other.

title: [Mosaic Table]
description: A dark bronze masthead lantern sits at the center of the table, which is inlaid with a variety of shells and sea glass to create an elaborate mosaic.  Not a single one of the surrounding chairs matches any other.

title: [Rowboat Table]
description: A dark bronze masthead lantern sits at the center of the table, which is painted with the image of a rowboat in the midst of an expansive ocean.  Not a single one of the surrounding chairs matches any other.

title: [Wreckage Table]
description: A dark bronze masthead lantern sits at the center of the table, which is branded with the likeness of a three-masted ship wrecked on a rocky strand.  Not a single one of the surrounding chairs matches any other.

title: [Ghost Table]
description: A dark bronze masthead lantern sits at the center of the table, which itself is adorned with ebonwood inlays that form a somber scene.  Not a single one of the surrounding chairs matches any other.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Hallway]
description: The hallway stretches out, long and dark, with walls covered in aged grey silk in a hue like that of an angry deep sea tempest.  A stenciled border trails near the ceiling and the floor, a repeating line of stylized waves in dark blue, and underfoot, a worn carpet runner in the same color cushions the wooden floor beneath.  Beside each door is a single candle-lit lamp, its scalloped shade made of age-discolored tin atop a sooted glass orb.

title: [Lean To]
description: Barred doors and high walls prevent passage deeper into the warehouse, which lends the entry a cramped feeling as the floor space is narrow and the ceiling is low.  A small wooden desk with a high-backed wooden chair behind it sits to one side of the entry, while large placards display the various types of work the shop offers for a ship's cargo hold.  Despite the small size, or perhaps because of it, the shop's single lantern provides a bright and cheery illumination.

title: [Chip n' Dwight's]
description: Cluttered with models, the shop has black walls, black ceilings, and black frames around the windows and door, though the floor is golden brown with a veneer that reflects the starlight as it streams in from outside.  Surrounded by bulletin boards that are overloaded with tacked parchments, a small long-legged desk with a tall stool behind it sits under the bright glow of a shielded lantern.

Cluttered with models, the shop has black walls, black ceilings, and black frames around the windows and door, though the floor is golden brown with a veneer that reflects the sunlight as it streams in from outside.  Surrounded by bulletin boards that are overloaded with tacked parchments, a small long-legged desk with a tall stool behind it sits under the dim glow of a shielded lantern.

title: [Fighting the Helm]
description: Echoing from floors above, the sound of industry is overly loud in the showroom as hammering, sawing, and the pounding of many feet reverberates through the ceiling.  Support posts flank the entry, with more evenly spaced down the length of the open space, each displaying a different style of ship's wheel fashioned of different woods.  A smooth mahogany counter sits in the center of the showroom beneath a large wrought iron chandelier.

title: [Jailhouse]
description: Exposed rafters hold iron-caged lanterns aloft and illuminate the small jailhouse with a bright light that is reflected in the polished oak floorboards.  Several chairs sit outside a white-edged cinquefoil archway, a board of wanted posters tacked above them, while a dented and scratched door occupies the eastern wall and has a small rainbow glaes window next to it.  Hooks and pegs flank the entry, some holding foul weather gear and others empty.

title: [Vexillology Visions]
description: Gleaming brass rods line the narrow, linden-paneled hall from entrance to the carved maoral counter opposite.  Pennants and bannerols of a multitude of hues and designs drape from the rods, nearly obscuring the walls.  The flags are illuminated by cylindrical glass lanterns, the flickering light dancing upon the soft sheen of their fabrics.

title: [The Soup Bone]
description: Sparse furnishings adorn the rough timber walls of the small restaurant.  A long counter crafted from a pair of oars occupies the majority of the back wall, where a giant copper octopus sculpture stands vigil.  Sunlight filters hazily in from the dusty porthole built near the swinging doors.  A few tables and chairs are scattered about.

Sparse furnishings adorn the rough timber walls of the small restaurant.  A long counter crafted from a pair of oars occupies the majority of the back wall, where a giant copper octopus sculpture stands vigil.  Moonlight filters hazily in from the dusty porthole built near the swinging doors and several lanterns provide illumination for patrons.  A few tables and chairs are scattered about.

title: [The Captain's Cup, Entry]
description: The shallow entryway unfolds into a plush sitting area that seems more elegant state room than pub.  Floors and walls of varnished mahogany gleam darkly beneath the flickering candles set within a pair of lofty chandeliers, and the air is filled with the scent of high-priced cigars and vintage spirits.  A sepia-toned globe guards a set of upward steps at the far end of the bar, and across the way, a curved brass handrail follows a stairway upward into the darkness.

title: [The Captain's Cup, Top Shelf]
description: Pendulum lamps with jewel-toned stained glass shades hang above the bar, illuminating the cherry wood and highlighting clusters of drink accoutrements, such as embossed coasters, napkins, and extra garnishes.  Swags of wine-hued velvet drape the ceiling and upper walls, subduing sound as well as the light from the candelabra scattered about.  The effect is close and intimate, with a pair of suede-covered couches and several upholstered chairs arranged around a modest fireplace with a stone hearth.

title: [The Captain's Cup, Lounge]
description: Carved mahogany frames the ceiling above, with an elaborate maritime mural spanning the entirety of the space within.  Wine-hued velvet hangs in scallops at the upper edges of the walls, while cherry wood wainscoting trims the lower half in a subtle, but stylish contrast to the mahogany walls.  A half-circle counter at the head of the room boasts a display showcasing a variety of glasses, and dark leather-cushioned chairs and side tables are spread throughout the lounge.

title: [The Threadbare Admiral]
description: This well-appointed boutique has a sheen of class and sophistication that shines through the roughness of Kraken's Fall.  Fanciful standing candelabras cast a flickering light against the lacquered wood panels decorating the boutique's walls, while two mannequins model the store's wares from within tall brass-framed glass cases.  A fashionable salesman dressed head to toe in the store's offerings tends to the needs of browsing customers.

title: [Bowsprit's Maiden]
description: Sunlight streams through twin brass-framed portholes, reflecting off a seaglass wave mosaic in shades ranging from pale green to deep ultramarine imbedded in white-plastered walls.  A driftwood collage of a mermaid caught within a net hangs from a wooden beam, partially hidden behind a a stained teak counter.

title: [Sailor's Solace]
description: Light and dark-stained bookcases line the western edge of the large shop, their various shelves housing a variety of nautical instrumentation, while the eastern wall is filled with several plush bunks that are adorned with heavy velvet drapes.  A gold and crimson knotwork carpet stretches across the floor, providing a colorful backdrop to the various chairs and tables on display.  Discretely placed to one side, a small counter has a ledger, an ink vial, and a quill resting upon its leather-bound ink blotter.

title: [Swabbing Starts]
description: Warm sunlight slips in through the glaes windows that dominate the southern section of the shop, the golden light shining off of the polished planks that are on display.  Signs over each grouping denote the types of wood and dyes available for purchase, while others denote which are for upper decks and which are for interior use.  A wide oak counter edged in brass railings sits upon a slate blue rug, while a sign above proclaims, "Order Here" in bold, blocky letters.

title: [Swabbing Starts]
description: Long wooden planks hang from the exposed rafters of the ceiling, each with a plaque tacked to the planed surface listing the type, color, and finish used in its creation.  Along the southeastern wall, a series of cubbyholes housing a variety of receipts, paperwork, and order forms stretches from floor to ceiling, while a wide oak counter separates the open space of the shop from the recordkeeping section.  Lenny, the shop's merchant, keeps a watchful eye from behind the counter.

title: [Widowmaker's Road]
description: Perched at the fork in the road, a rough wooden sign painted with arrows and thick blocky letters provides directions to various locales.  Rows of trees and neatly hewn stumps dimple the northwestern edge, while a sturdy wooden railing follows the opposite side.  Burlap sacks encircle the roots of small, new growth trees that are prepared for planting.

title: [Widowmaker's Road, Village]
description: Tangled and twisted vines ensnare local shrubbery in a cultivated method that forms an organic wall around a small mud and twig village.  Looming conifers shroud a dirt road framed in high blue-green monkey grass in deep shadows, their entwined limbs and thick foliage blocking most of the sunlight from filtering through.  A deep silence settles over the area, only occasionally broken by the sound of guttural squabbling.

title: [Widowmaker's Road]
description: Barrels, crates, and heavy chains are neatly arranged amid tree stumps at the edge of a forest where a bunch of trees are being harvested for lumber.  Deep furrows in the grass disappear once they meet the hardpacked dirt of the road, which has a sturdy fence on one side that blocks off the edge of a cliff.  A small wooden sign tacked to one of the stumps is wood-burned with a short message.

title: [Widowmaker's Road]
description: Sunlight slips through the dense canopy to illuminate the uppermost rungs of a railing that is following the southern edge of a packed dirt road.  Short shrubs dense with berries grow along the cliff edge on the far side, while a thick forest of mixed conifers and hardwoods grows on the opposing side.  A discarded horse shoe is in a small brook that has been encouraged to travel under the roadway via a buried iron pipe.

Starlight slips through the dense canopy to illuminate the uppermost rungs of a railing that is following the southern edge of a packed dirt road.  Short shrubs dense with berries grow along the cliff edge on the far side, while a thick forest of mixed conifers and hardwoods grows on the opposing side.  A discarded horse shoe is in a small brook that has been encouraged to travel under the roadway via a buried iron pipe.

title: [Widowmaker's Road]
description: Protruding from the face of the southern cliff, moss and bracken cling to fractured clasts of a conglomerate of deep red stone.  The bedding plane juts into the roadway at an angle that forces traffic around it, while also preventing the sturdy wooden railing from continuing westward.  Copper beech trees stretch their long limbs to the sky, casting irregular shadows throughout the area.

title: [Widowmaker's Road, Ragged Cliff]
description: Irregular boulders stab the sky, the water-smoothed stone leaning at angles against a slab of red stone bedrock with banded beige and terra cotta layers.  Quartz and chert pebbles fused within the eroded face of the bedding plane reflect the sunlight, causing dancing lights to flash in the forest that dominates the area beyond the hard-packed dirt road.  A small wooden sign sits beside a series of wrought iron grips that trail across the boulders.

Irregular boulders stab the sky, the water-smoothed stone leaning at angles against a slab of red stone bedrock with banded beige and terra cotta layers.  Quartz and chert pebbles fused within the eroded face of the bedding plane reflect the starlight, causing dancing lights to flash in the forest that dominates the area beyond the hard-packed dirt road.  A small wooden sign sits beside a series of wrought iron grips that trail across the boulders.

title: [Widowmaker's Road]
description: Curving away from exposed bedrock and warped boulders to the southeast, a hard-packed dirt road cuts through a forest of hardwoods on a westerly track.  Bubbling brooks, coaxed from their natural pathways, tumble down either side of the road in manufactured beds of black, grey, green, brown, and white pebbles.  A slant of sunlight pierces through the heavy canopy to illuminate the area.

Curving away from exposed bedrock and warped boulders to the southeast, a hard-packed dirt road cuts through a forest of hardwoods on a westerly track.  Bubbling brooks, coaxed from their natural pathways, tumble down either side of the road in manufactured beds of black, grey, green, brown, and white pebbles.  A patch of dazzling starlight pierces through the heavy canopy to bathe the area in a halo of silver illumination.

title: [Widowmaker's Road, Forest Trail]
description: Cutting through the area, a small brook erodes approximately two handspans of the hard-packed dirt road as it travels south.  Multiple layers of plant growth create a leafy congestion of trees as the deciduous forest sprawls along the climbing incline to the west.  Shadows play across local grasses, berry-laden shrubs, and exposed stones as they avoid the sunlight that cascades through the foliage to illuminate a nearby game trail.

Multiple layers of plant growth create a leafy congestion of trees as the deciduous forest sprawls along the climbing incline to the west.  Shadows play across local grasses, berry-laden shrubs, and exposed stones as they avoid the starlight that cascades through the foliage to illuminate a nearby game trail.

title: [Widowmaker's Road]
description: Shadows mark the edges of a deciduous forest that dominates the northern edges of a hard-packed dirt road as it curves around several standing stones.  Stratigraphic sections of limestone slowly rise to dominance in the west, while loose shale and tumbled gravel spread across the nearby grassy expanse.  A thickening band of moss splashes bright green along the tops of some of the larger outcroppings.

title: [Widowmaker's Road, Dark Ascent]
description: Rippling smooths out the stratum as it rises to gigantic portions along the westernmost edge of the hard-packed dirt road, while towering rocks provide access to a cave entrance worn into the bedrock above.  Loose gravel, shale, and silt scatter across the ground where mosses and grass attempt to find purchase.  The distant sound of crashing waves echoes faintly in the air.

title: [Yardarm's Skirt]
description: Exposed rafters are draped with long lengths of heavily dyed sailcloth in a variety of colors, the depth and grade of the dye highlighted by the plethora of frosted globes that provide illumination for the small shop.  Undyed bolts are neatly stacked along the western wall, while the eastern wall houses a floor-to-ceiling shelving unit laden with casks of various colored dyes.  A long white-washed counter, pristine and clean, separates the shop from an archway in the northern wall.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Second Pier]
description: Stretching like long fingers towards the ocean, the docking structure has five distinct piers that provide ample room for portage.  A large sign provides directions to the various berths, the instructions painted in several colors upon a black background, while a constantly burning lantern rests above.  Three tie pilings border the western edge of the platform, while two more are arranged upon the east.

title: [Kraken's Fall, First Pier]
description: Fanning out around the pentagonal-shaped end of the pier, five tie pilings provide a wide berth for ships to sit at anchor while still being bound to the platform.  Fresh tar is clearly visible along the edges of the platform, the gooey substance assisting in the longevity of the wood by helping to prevent rot.  An A-framed white sign that reads "Pier 1 - Slips 20-25" rests on the smooth wood.

title: [Kraken's Fall, First Pier]
description: Stretching outward to the west, a finger pier with high guardrails supports five docking slips that are evenly spaced and attached to the primary pier with short steps.  Rope is looped about the various support posts to create a simple railing that prevents falls into the deeper waters this far from the shoreline.  A light breeze tugs on a small white sign that reads "Pier 1 - Slips 16-20" from its hanging position in the middle of the rope railing.

title: [Kraken's Fall, First Pier]
description: Tie pilings, bound to the main body of the pier by large U-shaped brackets, line the western and eastern edges of the platform where cork bumpers protect the wood from incoming vessels.  Support posts tower over the pilings, their tops fitted with smooth platforms where local ospreys have built their haphazard nests, while a small white sign that reads "Pier 1 - Slips 11-15" is tacked to an oak barrel in the center of the walking space.

title: [Kraken's Fall, First Pier]
description: Coils of rope and discarded buoys spill out of a large oak barrel that rests upon the smooth boards of the pier, the container positioned beneath a large white sign that reads "Pier 1 - Slips 6-10."  Several steps lead down to a finger pier that has docking slips in it, each lined with cork buffer pads.  A gentle breeze filters through the air and carries with it the salty scent of the sea.

title: [Kraken's Fall, First Pier]
description: Rough oak boards spread across the framework of the pier, while painted white cork bumpers offer a buffer along the edges, to prevent damage to ships tied-off nearby.  Three tie pilings on the on the western side are evenly spaced to allow for ease of docking and stand opposite a pair on the southeast.  A large white sign that reads "Pier 1 - Slips 1-5" is nailed to a support post.

title: [Sloop, Main Deck]
description: Beneath a single mast the freshly swabbed wooden planking, stretching from the fore to the quarter deck, glints in the daylight.  Large coils of hemp rope are neatly stacked between some cannons on either side of the main deck, while a rectangular sail snaps in the salty seabreeze overhead.  A rusty knife protrudes from the railing next to a slender gangplank.

Large coils of hemp rope are neatly stacked between some cannons on either side of the main deck, while a rectangular sail snaps in the salty seabreeze overhead.  A rusty knife protrudes from the railing next to a slender gangplank.

title: [Sloop, Cargo Hold]
description: Copper-banded oak barrels, each branded with a black kraken, line the walls of this small holding area lit by wrought iron lanterns.  The warped oaken planks underfoot are gritty with sea salt and littered with bits of tattered canvas and frayed rope.  Lined up on wooden shelves, metal footlockers safeguard untold treasures.

title: [Sloop, Crow's Nest]
description: Not much more than a basket at the top of the main mast, a small opening in the railing gives way to a rope ladder leading to the deck below.  Crudely carved images deface the wooden surfaces of the nest, the most prominent a tentacled octopus that appears to be clinging to the top of the mast.  The remains of a tattered flag holding on by one corner flutters in the breeze.

title: [Sloop, Helm]
description: In the shadows cast from the thick canvas sails overhead, a grey-backed seagull perches atop a wooden wheel, noisily munching on a potato peeling scavenged from the crews previous meal.  Across from a wooden door leading to the Captains Quarter is a wooden capstan, the drum wound with thick, braided hemp rope.  Large nets cling to pegs on the ships railings, all empty save for a waterlogged boot with teethmarks on its toe.

In the shadows cast from the thick canvas sails overhead, a grey-backed seagull perches atop a wooden wheel, noisily munching on a potato peeling scavenged from the crew's previous meal.  Across from a wooden door leading to the captain's quarters is a wooden capstan, the drum wound with thick, braided hemp rope.  Large nets cling to pegs on the ship's railings, all empty save for a waterlogged boot with teethmarks on its toe.

title: [Sloop, Captain's Quarters]
description: Sunlight filters through a large, glass-paned window, illuminating a tattered map spread out on a wooden table in the center of the cabin.  A logbook lies open on a straw bed near a wooden chair piled with freshly laundered garments.  Nautical charts are tacked to the wood-paneled walls, all scribbled with illegible handwriting, one drawn with a giant sea monster.

Sunlight filters through a large, glass-paned window, illuminating a tattered map spread out on a wooden table in the center of the cabin.  A logbook lies open on a straw bed near a wooden chair piled with freshly laundered garments.  Nautical charts are tacked to the oak-paneled walls, all scribbled with illegible handwriting, one drawn with a giant sea monster.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Third Pier]
description: Blue and red arrows painted upon the smooth planks of the dock point to the northeast, while a solid green arrow points to the southeast.  A pair of sturdy steps leads down to a finger pier with five docking slips, a small sign next to them proclaiming "Slips 1-5," while heavy rope woven through holes in the support posts creates a flimsy railing.  Unseen in the dark sky, circling gulls lend their squabbling voice to the air.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Second Pier]
description: Black bands are painted onto the high pilings that flank the pier, two on the east and three on the west, while small signs with slip numbers on them are tacked just beneath.  A larger sign proclaiming "Pier 2 - Slips 5-10" is tied to an oak and copper barrel that is filled with thick cork panels and heavily corded tie-off ropes.  The sound of waves crashing against the shore echoes through the area.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Second Pier]
description: Wrapped from base to top, nearby support posts are decorated with black rope.  The same braided hemp pieces are stretched out between each to make a low railing that sways in the light seaborne breeze.  A small sign proclaiming "Pier 2 - Slips 11-15" is propped against a set of steps that leads down to a finger pier with five docking slips built against its smooth sides.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Second Pier]
description: Lapping waves create a rhythmic sound as they slap against the support posts of the pier, the resulting spray slicking the edges of the pier's wooden floorboards.  Black rope is woven tightly about the tall tie pilings that decorate the western and eastern sides, the U-shaped clamps used to bind them to the pier clinking and clacking with the sway of the tide.  Crisp white letters adorn a black board, the concise script proclaiming "Pier 2 - Slips 16-20.

title: [Muddy Village, Entry]
description: Deep, muddy ruts mark the pathways of narrow hand-pulled carts that seem to have traversed this road many times.  Tangles of twisted vines encroach upon the roadway, making passage to and from the village beyond difficult for more substantial means of conveyance.  Guttural sounds of alarm can be heard to the northeast.

title: [Basalt Cliff, Approach]
description: Towering above, a wide cliff face of exposed grey basalt columns stretches upwards to the blue sky, the top of which is barely visible.  While completely vertical, ample hand and footholds can be found for even the most novice of climbers.  Hexagonal blocks of basalt lay on the ground at the base, having fallen from the face over time.

This long barren slope of the volcano rises above the island, surrounded by a deep blue ocean.  The terrain is rocky and devoid of plant life, with the occasional boulder standing sentinel along the arduous climb.  Grooves in the earth from rainwater and lava flows branch out down the slope to meet the vegetation at the edge of the jungle below.
