title: [Muddy Village, Pathway]
description: The charred surround of a campfire takes a prominent position beside the muddy pathway through this area.  Blackened bones, tossed haphazardly nearby, have all been cracked open, perhaps to get at the succulent marrow within.  Tall trees surround the space, their verdant growth blocking the view of the lands beyond.  The incessant buzzing of insects forms a symphony with the guttural grunts in the distance.

title: [Widowmaker's Road, Animal Track]
description: Verdant green foliage and thick underbrush stand-off against boulders and rough dirt as the animal track slips through the area on its way to the nearby road.  Thick-bladed grass struggles for purchase on the southern edge, while its cousins to the north grow unhindered within the shelter of the Weald's trees.

title: [Animal Track, Weald Shadow]
description: Thickly canopied, the animal track slips between tall conifers and tangles of clinging, thorny vines.  Shadows dance through the area, their lively gesticulations matching the subtle breezes and sway of leaves.  Widening slightly to the northeast, the narrow dirt trail is littered with dried seedpods and dandelion puffs.

title: [Caligos Isle, Beached Ship]
description: Dented, rusting, and malformed, the central section of an enormous cruise ship is beached upon the rocky shoals.  Bamboo torches, bright spheres of light in the thick fog and indigo mist, flank a pair of waterlogged doors surrounded by glassless portholes.  Another series of torches provides dim illumination for a loose scree trail that leads back to the western slope.

title: [Animal Track, Weald Shadow]
description: Berry laden shrubs form a barrier between the curving animal track and the tall cypress trees of the Black Weald.  Large stones, roughly the size of a fist, thin out a babbling brook as it crosses the narrow animal track.  Thick shadows darken the area as the taller trees of the Weald block the light.

title: [Animal Track, Thistle Haven]
description: Brambles and briars stretch along the eastern edges of the animal track, the spindly arms and thick thorns snagging on anything that passes too closely.  Tall grasses give way to saplings that are surrounded by white-veined horehound and wild thistle with bright purple crowns.  Distantly, the sound of a babbling brook trickles in.

title: [Widowmaker's Road, Animal Track]
description: Cutting a winding route through the overgrown grass, the trail is thin and riddled with bright white pebbles.  Stumps of felled trees pop up throughout the area, their smooth faces grey with age.  To the south, a thin animal track straightens as it rejoins the main road.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Approach]
description: A jagged pathway from below winds through a series of towering rocks, ending abruptly at the open maw of an enormous cavern.  Tall trees draped with thorny vines grow to either side of the cave entrance.  Lush greenery, a cascading waterfall, and the red-orange glow of molten rock can be seen beside large promontories jutting from the mountain above the cave.  The earthy fragrance of the forest blends harmoniously with the gentle breeze of salty sea air.

title: [Yllira Sutara, Workroom]
description: Pale blue wool felt hangs the silvery beech frame of the spacious tent.  Occasionally they flutter as a cool breeze catches the material.  A small worktable covered with various tools sits to the back of the room.  Thick wool carpeting is scattered with large cushions that provide comfortable seating in the workroom.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Entrance]
description: At least some sun filtering through the wide entrance during the daylight hours has encouraged the growth of plants and grasses spreading beside the rocky walls.  Mosses and ferns thrive in the cool, moist environment provided by the cave entrance.  The constant temperature and high humidity provide a more stable environment for the plant life here, compared to their brethren out in the open.

Slivers of moonlight trickle through the wide entrance, illuminating the shadowy plants and grasses spreading beside the rocky walls.  Mosses and ferns thrive in the cool, moist environment provided by the cave entrance.  The constant temperature and high humidity provide a more stable environment for the plant life here, compared to their brethren out in the open.

title: [Muddy Village, Pathway]
description: Hoof prints, paw prints, and the barefoot prints of bi-pedal humanoids crisscross the boggy ground of this juncture.  Suspended from overhanging tree limbs, circular bone and bead talismans swing side-to-side with the occasional gusts of wind.  A few narrow beams of moonlight pierce the overhead canopy to illuminate the soggy ground.

title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
description: A sturdily constructed hut, the largest by far in the village, sits directly in the center hub of the surrounding pathways.  Its stacked-stone walls are mortared with mud and clay, and its roof is a conical configuration of white canvas.  An opening at the apex of the roof has clearly been configured to permit the escape of smoke from any fires built within.  A small vegetable garden beside the hut bears a few rows of corn, a smattering of cabbages, and a robust collection of weeds.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest, up

title: [Village, Chieftain's Hut]
description: A repurposed captain's chair sits upon a raised platform near the back of the hut.  Smaller chairs, a few barstools, and some woven grass mats are placed on the ground before it.  A large firepit, blackened with use, is positioned beneath an opening in the conical, white canvas roof.  A large, feather-stuffed mattress encased in patched sailcloth rests against a decoratively adorned side wall.

title: [Muddy Village, Altar]
description: An orderly arrangement of mismatched planks is supported on either side by two carved wooden figureheads set securely into the soil.  One of the busty maidens has deep blue, long-lashed, painted eyes and draping tresses of faded black hair; the other is more weathered, with only some peeling red paint where her locks used to be.  Upon the makeshift altar, bundles of herbs lend a fragrant air and rounded, glossy black stones surround candles set within bone-inset holders.

title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
description: Devoid of vegetation, the ground has been cleared surrounding a modest hut in the center of the space.  Its walls are a collection of mismatched lengths of planking, and its roof consists of a flat sheet of rusted metal.  Tiny clay pots flank the simple doorway, each brimming with a carefully tended collection of weeds.

title: [Village, Modest Hut]
description: Though the interior of this modest hut is sparse, the surfaces are clean and the mud floor is blanketed with a soft layer of straw.  Four woven mats are raised up on planks with stilted legs, each covered with a relatively clean swatch of fabric.  A few broken pots and an upturned brass bell hold a layer of soil and some fragrant, blooming herbs.

title: [Muddy Village, Pathway]
description: Deep holes lay in wait across the narrow pathway, their muddy margins slick with green and black slime.  The top of one abandoned leather boot peeks over the lip of one deep depression.  A set of humanoid footprints, one booted, one bare, fades away farther down the path.  An enclosing wall of briars surrounds the site, while verdant vines drape down from the treetops above, as if to offer aid to those entrapped in the sucking mud.

title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
description: Inside the tall boundary of impenetrable briars enclosing the village, a makeshift fence of lashed conifer boughs surrounds a simple stick and vine hut.  Panels of green and yellow canvas have been nailed across the doorway, and the roof and walls are fashioned from sawed-off saplings, bound with lengths of twisted vines.  A mound of discarded food scraps nearby draws the attention of a few scavenging rodents.

title: [Village, Stick and Vine Hut]
description: Simple layers of sticks, bound by dried vines, form the roof and sides of this small structure.  A circle of charred rocks provides a safe space for fires and a few grass and reed mats draped in soiled canvas provide mud-free spots for bedding down.  Scattered shoes, most one-of-a-kind, are lined up beside the entry.

title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
description: Tucked away from the rest of the village, one dilapidated hut sits close to Widowmaker's Road, which passes to the south.  Sounds filter in from travelers on the road, making this a less than desirable spot for a homestead.  Some overgrown weeds have invaded the doorless entry of the simple mud and stick abode, and tracks of animals leading to and from the structure suggest it is not completely abandoned.

title: [Village, Dilapidated Hut]
description: One mildewed and moth-eaten bedroll is the lone remnant of furnishings in this ramshackle hut.  Animal droppings litter the floor, and tufts of fur and feathers billow lightly with each incoming breeze.  Several fluffy bits of multicolored fur and a few downy feathers have been utilized for a collection of rodent nests along the back wall.

title: [Muddy Village, Dump]
description: A mound of debris covers much of the soggy ground, topped with a faded hand-lettered sign.  Pathways along the circumference of the mound mark the route taken by previous passersby.  Tangled vines and thorny brambles form an encircling barrier around the space.

title: [Muddy Village, Overlook]
description: Overgrown brush leaves only a narrow footpath upon which to travel.  To the north, a wall of tangled briars, several feet thick, blocks further passage, although breaks in the branching briars allow a view of Kraken's Fall and its surroundings.  Vines creeping along the boggy ground seem determined to trip any who relax their vigilance as they pass.  Clusters of wildflowers lend an incongruent cheeriness to the otherwise dreary environs.

title: [Muddy Village, Commons]
description: Low hanging vines, their sharp needles threatening harm to any who approach, drape downward to engulf the tops of some low, spindly shrubs.  Partially consumed by the voracious vines, a simple mud-walled hut cowers amid the encroaching greenery.  A large, fallen bird's nest lays broken on the ground, bits of shattered eggshells and a few tiny feathers stuck between the twigs and grass around them.

title: [Village, Mud Hut]
description: Few niceties adorn this simple, mud-walled hut.  Woven mats on the ground would seem to barely keep one up out of the muck, and a charred circle of rocks is utilitarian at best.  Scattered pots and dirty utensils rest on the damp, earthen floor, their unwashed surfaces caked in dried food and debris.  Swarms of insects provide music for the home, buzzing in and out of the open doorway both day and night.

title: [Muddy Village, Workspace]
description: Wooden planks provide drier walkways above the muddy ground.  Workstations are spaced about the area, some with wooden tanning racks drying pelts of foxes and hares, others with makeshift benches topped with rusty hammers, saws, and collections of nails.  Patches of moonlight stream randomly from above in this otherwise shadowed area beneath the trees.

title: [Muddy Village, Pathway]
description: Much of the area has been cleared of vegetation, its muddy ground a mixture of wet dirt, coarse sand, and slick clay.  Interspersed with a few sparse tufts of dead grasses, tracks from foxes, raccoons, and a host of small rodents crisscross the muddy ground.  One tall, yellow sunflower, its head brimming with tiny black seeds, stands sentinel over the area, the lone splash of color in this othrerwise dreary space.

title: [Muddy Village, Grassy Knoll]
description: Waist-high grasses obscure the narrow pathways, their waving green seedheads bulging with future generations.  Thick vines enclose the surrounding vegetation, encircling the perimeter of this small, impoverished village.  The open, grassy area is one of the few spaces enjoying the silvery bath of moonlight from the open skies above.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Pale grey rock lines the walls, ceiling, and floor in this tight space.  Sunight from the southeast filters in from the entrance, but its rays reach no further than halfway down the narrow tunnel.  A slight rut has been worn away down the middle, showing where the passing of many feet has eroded the surface of the floor.

title: [Boarding House, Foyer]
description: Exposed oak framework lends the entry a rustic look, while bright white stucco walls help to brighten the space.  Following the line of the eastern wall, an ascending staircase leads to the loft-like second story and has a small welcome mat placed before its bottommost step.  A polished copper mirror is affixed to the western wall, which leads to a small kitchen, where a half-circle wooden table filled with cleaning supplies rests.

title: [Boarding House, Loft]
description: Built into the attic and surrounded by exposed roof beams on either side, the long loft is filled with narrow cots covered in white sheets, woolen blankets, and knitted throws.  Footlockers rest at the foot of each, their edges perched upon a braided rug of black, brick red, and slate blue.  A single window allows the sunlight to filter into the space, while a descending staircase along the eastern wall leads to the floor below.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Rivulets of icy-cold water dribble down the angled rocks walls to form shallow, standing pools along the sides of the tunnel.  An abundance of hornwort carpets the damp space, its elongated, horn-like sporophytes reaching upwards as though trying to escape.  Wafts of fresh air deliver the occasional fragrance of the nearby woodlands and the faint scent of sea air.

title: [The Last Frontier]
description: Mounted taxidermy trophies encircle the rough oak walls, and the ears, horns, and antlers brush against the rafters that support the copper tile roof.  Stretching from one wall to the other, a long golden linden bar occupies a majority of the pub's available space, leaving very little room to maneuver around the cushioned bar stools.  A series of shielded lanterns help to dispel the dark caused by the lack of windows, though a general dimness prevails.

title: [Logging Colony, Parapet]
description: Surrounded by logs hewn to a point, the parapet stretches from the nearby tower to the top of the colony's gates in the west.  Bamboo torches fitfully burn from their perch along the southern railings that overlook muddy tracks below, while small barrels filled with arrows and bolts rest beneath.  A fortified door provides entry to a tower that casts shadows upon the stockade fence.

title: [Sunfist Tower, Office]
description: Utilitarian and sparse, the room smells strongly of cedar and pipe tobacco.  Maps are pinned to the rough oak walls, covering the space between a dark green chalkboard and a bulletin board filled with parchments.  A small desk and chair in the northeastern corner sit at an angle to take full advantage of the room's two windows.

title: [Logging Colony, Platform]
description: Built at the corner of the stockade fence, the parapet widens into a full circle with vantage points to view the cleared areas below.  Placed in the center of the smooth wooden platform, a long bench sits beneath the shade of a protective roof.  A rain barrel with a thin mesh screen over it collects runoff water from a large pipe connected to the shingled roof.

title: [Logging Colony, Parapet]
description: Roughly hewn logs protect the northern edge of the parapet, while also providing an unobstructed view of Widowmaker Road as it cuts its way along the edge of the Great Cliff.  Sturdy oak railings to the south offer protection from a spill into the mud below, their posts fitted with brightly burning torches.  A circular platform occupies a space beneath a shingled roof towards the east, while directly south is a sheltered ballista.

title: [Logging Colony, Ballista]
description: Boxy and open, the parapet widens into a three-walled shelter with openings that face the wilderness beyond.  A lone torch rests in the center, its fitfully burning flames present throughout the day and night.  Taking up a large amount of the floor space, a large ballista is strategically positioned in a way that allows it to be advantageously aligned.

title: [Sunfist Tower, Bunk Room]
description: Devoid of windows, the room is small and austere.  Hooded lanterns rest over a small writing desk in one cramped corner, while a large clothes press mounted in opposition sits partially ajar.  Bunk beds covered with lusterless grey wool blankets clutter the remainder of the space.

title: [Boarding House, Kitchen]
description: Airy windows with black lace valances dominate the northern wall of the small kitchen, while cupboards and shelves line the eastern and western sides from floor-to-ceiling.  Centered over a long oak table surrounded by rough pine benches, a wrought iron chandelier with burning tallows provides a uniform illumination that fills every corner of the space.  A round wicker basket rests on the striped floorboards.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: A sandy coating carpets the floor of the tunnel where crumbling walls have strewn their particulate debris.  Claw-tipped footprints crisscross the floor with long swaths between them marking the dragging of a tail.  A protrusion of roots from the world above has infiltrated through cracks and fissures in the ceiling.

title: [Brewmaster's Tap, Pub Room]
description: The air in this grubby run-down pub is thick with the scent of old ale, and the floor is sticky with it too.  The tables are little more than old beer kegs, and the seats merely smaller casks dropped next to them, but it matters little to the rough and hearty crowd.  A surly matron mans the many taps behind a rickety old bar, while a young boy excitedly dashes between her and the tables to take and fill patrons' orders.

title: [Brewmaster's Tap, Cellar]
description: While floor-to-ceiling beer kegs betray this space as a storage area, puddles of fresh ale show it's still a popular drinking spot in this bar.  Upright kegs and smaller casks serve as makeshift tables and seats, all illuminated by the unsteady flickering candlelight of an overhead cast-iron chandelier.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: A steady *drip-drip-drip* echoes off of every facet of the surrounding rock walls, lending a near-deafening reverberation to the cramped, enclosed space.  Directly overhead and continuing down one wall, a deep fissure  proves to be the source of the watery incursion.  A spiderweb of cracks spreading from it lend an air of impending danger to this part of the tunnel.
paths: Obvious exits: southwest, northwest, down, out

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Water Terrace]
description: A stunning backdrop of vertical limestone faces meet with a more substantial, horizontal plane of granite that form this spacious, above-ground terrace.  Rushing water cascades down in a frothy white display of force, pooling across the black granite surface in crystal clear sheets that sparkle with reflections of golden sunlight.  In the distance, the sound of waves against the shore provides a rhythmic melody.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: The sheer absence of light makes traversing this enclosed tunnel tricky for even the most experienced hunters.  While feeling along the walls could aid in navigation, the coating of mucilaginous slime may dissuade the squeamish from relying upon that method.  Echoes from nearby chambers provide intermittant distractions from the darkness.

title: [Irosah's Armaments]
description: Large and small practice dummies are arranged on the western wall, each displaying a different armor type in a variety of colors and metals.  Along the eastern wall, shields are suspending from long chains in the ceiling, their broad expanses block exterior light from entering the shop.  Set beneath the light of twin lanterns, a long wooden counter separates the showroom from the workrooms and has a welcoming sign on it.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Jagged rocks and boulders litter the floor, many strewn with the large, shed skins of lizards announcing their status as favored rubbing spots.  A small pool releases steam into the tunnel, making the air quite stifling and almost unbearably hot.  Fresh droppings beside the water lend a noxious odor to the moisture-laden air.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Heat pulses through the thick rock walls, as though the very earth beneath the tunnel is on fire.  Steam escapes in sporadic puffs from cracks and fissures in the floor.  Crackling sounds echo in the surrounding rock, hinting that perhaps one should not linger long in the space.

title: [The Knife's Edge, Show Room]
description: Crates, boxes, and shipping containers clutter the back of the shop.  The sturdy wooden structures create a wall that stretches to the ceiling.  Along the northern and southern walls, open shipping containers provide a view of the wares that are for sale.  A long glossy counter crafted of oak provides a centralized location to place orders, its smooth surface clean and tidy.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Cool air currents waft through the wide tunnel passage, making it a refreshingly pleasant environ compared to other parts of the underground tunnel nearby.  A small pool of clear, cold water draws many visitors, as evidenced by the tracks of skittering crabs and slithering lizards left in the sand beside the water.  Lichen, liverwort, and tiny ferms cling to small cracks and fissure along the pale limestone walls.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Green Room]
description: Painted green ivy meanders along the eaves of this cheery bedroom's whitewashed walls.  A green glass wash basin stands ready for use beside a large soft feather bed whose sheets have been embroidered to match the room's colorful eaves.  A delicate perfume of ocean salt and fresh flowers floats about the bedroom.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Red Room]
description: Painted red trim lends a splash of color to this otherwise whitewashed room.  The soft feather bed itself continues the theme, with linens embroidered with a motif of red hibiscus blooms.  A quaint red-trimmed window looks out on the town below.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Portico]
description: Thin rivulets run down the spiralled flutings of columns framing the vestibule's entry, the water flowing into seaglass-filled channels carved into marble floors leading toward a driftwood arch.  Petrified coral sconces with flickering cerulean candles accent a mosaic crafted from broken shells spanning rockface walls.  Cut into these same walls is an opening leading to a small nook.

Thin rivulets run down the spiralled flutings of columns framing the vestibule's entry, the water flowing into seaglass-filled channels carved into marble floors leading toward a driftwood arch.  Petrified coral sconces with flickering cerulean candles accent a mosaic crafted from broken shells spanning rockface walls.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Hallway]
description: The gentle scent of smoke wafts through the air as wisps dance above smoldering coals within wrought iron braziers.  A pathway, faintly painted spots of blue interspersed with white porcelain tiles, serves as a guide toward a small alcove.  From within channels carved into the floor along the edge of the hallway, the sound of water can be heard as thin streams trickle in through a driftwood arch.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Passage]
description: Scant light, cast from a single bronze torch thrust into a broken iron sconce, casts dim shadows against the passage's craggy walls.  Along with the sound of rustling fabric, footsteps from an unseen source echo up some shale steps.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Sky Terrace]
description: This open-air terrace juts from the mountain at a dizzying height.  A bird's-eye view of the town of Kraken's Fall spreads out below, its cobblestone streets basking in the warmth of the sun.  The rising and falling swells of the blue-green ocean stretch toward the distant horizon.  The gentle fragrance of the forest below dances lanquidly within the cool mountain breeze.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Slick with seepage, the walls and floor provide the perfect environs for the proliferation of blue-green hornwort.  Their flattened bases cling to the rocky substrate, while their horn-like protrusions branch upwards, waving as one with any stirring of the oppressively warm air.  Overturned shells of deceased crustaceans collect enough water to support thriving colonies of striped, brown snails.

title: [Rock Lobster]
description: This tiny restaurant only has a few seats, most of which are empty and waiting for customers.  Bright yellow paint and ocean views in blue frames adorn the walls, which are lined with windows that overlook the roiling waters on the horizon.  Floating between the cramped tables, a distracted waitress moves plates to and from a kitchen window that produces delectable aromas.  A blue mandolin has been mounted above the entrance of this establishment, while a sturdy chair has been placed nearby.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: The pale grey walls give the impression of closing in as this portion of the tunnel narrows to form a tightly confined space.  Passage is made more difficult by the presence of fallen rocks, obliterating what once may have been an accessible path.  A tremendous heat generating from the floor and walls makes them almost too hot to touch.  A reddish glow emanates from the edges of a nearby fissure.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Lava Terrace]
description: Bursts of molten, orange-red magma bubble up from the center of the ever-expanding terrace.  Once ejected from hidden tubes deep within the earth, the viscous lava flows across the black and crackled surface, adding additional depth to the cooled pathways along the terraced perimeter.  Steam rises in plumes from pockets of cooling crust near a porous lava rock fissure, and a fine-grained ash chokes the air before being wafted away by the incoming sea breezes.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: A narrow cave stream trickles lanquidly across the stone floor.  Roots from unseen flora outside the tunnel have breeched the walls and formed a stable root mat that floats upon the water.  The occasional *pop* of bubbles on the surface reveal the location of hidden amphibians below.  The stifling heat and humidity do little to encourage visitors to linger.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Tunnel]
description: Multihued minerals paint the surrounding rock walls in shades of green, yellow, and white.  Colorful crystals, only a few inches high, cling to the stone floor and attempt the mighty climb toward the ceiling.  Skittering noises and the clacking of claws filter in from a deeper part of the tunnel.

title: [Hornwort Cavern, Earth Terrace]
description: A substrate of igneous rock supports an earth-covered expanse just beyond the nearby cavern.  An abundance of plant life thrives in the open air.  Delicate ferns and mosses grow in and beside a ragged fissure, while grasses and arboreal specimens proliferate farther out toward the terrace edges.  The salty fragrance of sea air drifts lightly on the occasional breezes.

title: [Rising Pint]
description: Brightly-lit iron lanterns dangle from ceiling beams, competing with the moonlight streaming through the glaesine windows to illuminate the tables and chairs scattered about the pub.  A few barstools await patrons near the bar, and a small area near the back features a few musicians entertaining the guests.  The occasional whiff of ocean breeze eases its way in through the door as patrons come and go.

title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Ledge]
description: Barely as wide as a human's arm span, the mist-slicked ledge mocks any who try to move swiftly.  Loose pebbles of chert and quartz underfoot prevent a firm footing near the foreboding drop.  The pervasive scent of the sea lends a sharp tang to the winds whipping up from below.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Balcony]
description: This small balcony offers little else in the way of view except the cliff wall into which all of Kraken's Fall is built.  Clotheslines stretch from the balcony's edge to the face of the cliff, from which linens of all manner flutter in the sea breeze.

title: [Bank, Exchange Booth]
description: Smooth stone walls provide a sense of security to visitors and merchants that frequent the small exchange booth that is under the constant guard of burly officers.  Standing behind a tall desk, a bow-legged exchange clerk diligently works to help customers with their exchanges.  Occasionally, he pauses to indicate a gold-inlaid thanot sign that hangs on the wall.

title: [Cliffwalk, Craggy Descent]
description: A series of wrought iron grips, affixed to irregular boulders, provide the only assurance of safety for those brave enough to traverse the steep and rocky terrain.  Fierce ocean winds whip across the exposed cliff face, threatening to send both rocks and travelers into the frothing waves far below.  Flecks of mica imbedded within the white wall of rock reflect specks of brilliant, golden light as the sun passes across the sky.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Small habitats created by standing pools of water that dimple the thick velvet carpeting provide shelter for thumb-sized hermit and fiddler crabs.  Curtains of kelp hang from a hole in the northern wall where it meets the ceiling, their rubbery ends dangling in some of the smaller pools.

title: [Constable's Office]
description: White stucco clings to the walls of the tiny office, which is pristine and tidy despite the cramped size.  Most of the floor space is given over to an ebonwood desk, though a few chairs can be found nearby.  Dangling from the ceiling is the wheel of a ship, it's spindled appendages laden with frosted globes.

title: [Cliffwalk, Hairpin Turn]
description: Deep furrows in the loose gravel underfoot tell the tale of travelers who nearly missed the sharp turnaround.  Just beyond the edge, atop craggy outcroppings below, scattered backpacks and clothing lay among broken shards of shelfae scales and a few sun-bleached bones.  Half-sized pines struggle to maintain a grip in the loose soil of the crevices nearby.

title: [Cliffwalk, Shattered Tree]
description: Two halves of a large, rough-barked pine drape precariously across the trail, threatening to block further passage should they be completely torn asunder at the base of the shattered trunk.  Scorch marks mar the woody pulp of the interior where nodules of amber, glass-like resins have been tempered to a hardened state.  Loose, flat slabs of limestone, cleaved off from the cliff face above, litter the narrow trail.

title: [Storm Petrel's Wing]
description: Along this shop's timbered walls, bows of all makes and sizes hang like stuffed and mounted hunting trophies.  Feathers, paint splatters, and other evidence of arrow-making lightly litter the creaky wooden floors.  Behind a narrow leather-topped counter, the shop's wide variety of archery-related wares sit on display.

title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Ledge]
description: The treacherous trail hugs closely to the steep and rocky cliffside, making travel for groups a single-file affair.  Shattered shelfae scales lay broken upon the rock-strewn ground, marking the previous passage of hunters over this forbidding terrain.  The incessant pounding of waves far below is but a soft and rhythmic whisper at this height.

title: [Cliffwalk, Angled Loop]
description: About midway between the full height of the steep cliff above and the barely visible flatlands below, the trail is reasonably flat and wide through these surroundings.  Openings and outcroppings along the cliff wall provide secure spots where those who are prey can hide and predators can await their chance to ambush.  Relentless winds off the ocean howl loudly across the flat and rock-strewn terrain.

title: [Cliffwalk, Rocky Loop]
description: Overturned, overlapped, and oversized boulders make passage along the barely discernable path nearly impossible.  Broken and sheared-off surfaces across the cliff face immediately overhead suggest evidence of a recent rockslide.  The crushed skeletal remains of rodents and reptiles lay half-buried in the rubble, indicating not all escaped the path of the falling debris.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Ascent]
description: The steep rise brings with it brisk winds, drowning out the sounds of barking dogs and late-night revelers from the town below.  Tenacious beach grasses cling to the rocky embankment rising steeply to the northeast, while a gentler slope trails through the pebbled sands due west.  A moisture-laden mist carried on the breeze is saturated with the scent of the sea.

The steep rise brings with it brisk winds, drowning out the sounds of shoppers and merchants from the town below.  Tenacious beach grasses cling to the rocky embankment rising steeply to the northeast, while a gentler slope trails through the pebbled sands due west.  A moisture-laden mist carried on the breeze is saturated with the scent of the sea.

title: [The Melting Pot]
description: Diffuse light fills the dining room of this eatery, with the amber glow of the overhead lanterns struggling to pierce the humid smog that lurks in the air.  At least the haze is fragrant, warm with savory scents that in part originate with the copper pot fitfully bubbling amid the disarray of scattered tables.  Only the occasional shout from the kitchen disturbs the laid back ambience, leaving the scuffing of chairs and the murmur of customers and staff as neutral white noise in the background.

title: [Brewmaster's Tap, Back Porch]
description: This tiny porch overlooks a lane of tidy cottages leading to the ocean.  The bar noise is but a low roar here, easily overpowered by the crashing of waves nearby.

title: [Converted Weather Station]
description: Wide windows dominate the southern wall, their yawning expanses nearly touching the polished mahogany boards of the ceiling and the smooth stone blocks of the floor.  Shielded lanterns are anchored to flagstone pillars that mark the turning points of the corridors that stretch to the north.  Rough oak doors reinforced with blackened, wrought iron fixtures stand open and are filled with the dark of night, as well as the heady fragrance of wild dog roses.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest, out

title: [Office of the Registrar]
description: Unusual gadgets and gears dominate the southwestern wall of the corridor, each terminating in a clear glass tube filled with numbered glass orbs that bob up and down in a clear liquid.  To the northwest, a high-topped oak desk and a round-seated tall stool are positioned upon a soft rug of bright orange and teal.  An oak-framed chalkboard dominates the remaining wall, its dark surface riddled with instructions, patterns, and daily tasks for the facilities workers.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Blue, grey, and white flagstones form a checkered pattern upon the western wall, the worked stones smooth and unblemished by dust or cobwebs.  Uniformly grey cobblestones form the floor of the building, while polished warm red mahogany decorates the ceiling.  A single lantern decorates the railing of a pair of ascending stairs, its brightly glowing interior providing a blaze of light that reaches to the sill of a nearby window.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Knotty pine rafters are evenly spaced down the long hall, causing the ceiling to resemble the inverted ribs of a ship.  Starlight illuminates the panes of nearby windows, while lanterns crafted to look like tiny houses spill warm candlelight onto the mahogany floorboards.  Curving along the exterior wall, a set of descending stairs stands opposite a set of wide golden oak doors in the wide landing.

title: [Cobbler's Supply Corridor]
description: Heavy cabinets fashioned of steel encircle the short corridor, their steel faces reflecting the ambient light that filters from nearby lanterns.  A long counter, also fashioned of steel, stretches across the space acting as a barrier between the shop and storage area.  Crates, casks, bundles, and footlockers, each with bright white labels, are stacked in tidy rows beyond the counter.

title: [Tanner's Corridor]
description: Wide and windowless, the short corridor is cluttered with all manner of vats, workbenches, tables, drying racks, and frames.  Floor to ceiling shelves are filled with beakers, pumice stones, scrapers, pails, and coils of hemp cording.  A leathery old woman diligently works behind a long counter, splitting her focus between a hide curing frame and some nearby vats.

title: [Office of the Cobbler's Foreman]
description: Arranged near the opening of the short corridor, a long mahogany counter blocks entry into the foreman's working space.  Tidy cubbies dominate one wall, each meticulously labeled with manufacturer's name, while the opposite wall is filled with hooks that house wooden disks.  A small desk and chair complete the tidy area.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Floor to ceiling windows dominate the southern wall, the thick panes providing a view of the road beyond while also provide protection from the coastal winds.  A pair of doors, one inset with a whistle and the other engraved with a ship, stand on opposite sides of a northern corridor.  Tiny scratches in the mahogany floors hint that something large was dragged from this location, the sun-leached wood around it suggest it was square at the base.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Gizmos and gadgets stick out of the southern wall, each attached to a long tube that stabs the knotty pine ceiling.  A large metal cabinet rests beneath the contraption, its square base resting amid gauges in the floor that stretch to the west.  Nestled into the northern wall, a polished oak door etched with a first mate's badge and a polished oak door etched with a captain's hat rest beneath the warm glow of lanterns anchored to their lintels.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Facing each other over the glossy mahogany wall, a polished oak door etched with a storm petrel and a polished oak door etched with a monkey are built into the walls of the corridor.  Wrought iron lanterns dangle from the exposed, knotty pine rafters and are responsible for the small pools of light that illuminate the dark, windowless space.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Second Pier]
description: Capped with five docking slips, the pier is framed by support posts wrapped in black rope.  Copper-banded barrels, their lids removed and discarded, sit in a cluster along the eastern border, each housing a variety of gaffing hooks and rope bundles.  Swinging from the rope railing, a small sign proclaims, "Pier 2 - Slips 20-25."

title: [Kraken's Fall, Third Pier]
description: Stretching out into the ocean, the long pier stabs through the water on a southeasterly track and provides a panoramic view of the entire dock system from shore to sea.  Faded green rope is tightly woven around the tops of nearby tie pilings, the lower half of which is covered in mooring hitches that have been cut free of their ships.  A painted square of verdant green and bright white letters proclaims this section of the pier as "Pier 3 - Slips 6-10."

title: [Kraken's Fall, Third Pier]
description: Circles of paint decorate the smooth wood of the pier, each green dot filled with a bright white number ranging from 11 and 15.  Heavy ropes sway in the seaborne breeze from their anchoring points on the surrounding support posts, the looping cords forming a simple railing to prevent accidental slips into the ocean beyond.  Someone has tied various knots onto a mooring clamp, the frayed ends flitting in the air.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Third Pier]
description: Resting on their sides, a pile of bright green buoys is tied to one of the mooring clamps that trails along the southwestern edge of the long pier.  A single step, deeper than most along the wooden expanse, provides access to a finger pier that sits low in the water and has five docking slips spread out along its length.  White bordered, a freshly painted verdant square is filled with crisp white letters that proclaim "Pier 3 - Slips 16-20."

title: [Kraken's Fall, Third Pier]
description: Stretching like splayed fingers into the ocean, the pier terminates in five floating docks edged in thin steel.  Wrought iron U-shaped clamps affixed to heavy chains keep the bobbing platforms from floating away, while dark green rope tethered to pilings provides a guideline that assists visitors in climbing to and from the lower structures.  A hemisphere of verdant paint with bright white letters scrolled on it claims that "Slips 21-25" can be found nearby.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fourth Pier]
description: Dark and bright green algae clings to the floor boards of the pier along the northwestern edge where the shadows of the nearby rocky shoals prevent the sunlight from drying the accumulated dampness.  Two arrows that are painted side-by-side part ways at the heart of the pier's walking space, with a blue one continuing to the northeast and a red one dipping in a southerly direction.  An arching sign tacked to two pilings marks this section as the entry to "Pier 4."

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fourth Pier]
description: Tie pilings, ranging in height and painted red, flank the sides of the pier, which is comprised of flat oak and teak boards.  Evenly spaced posts woven with bright red rope through them create makeshift guardrail that runs the length of the walking space.  Painted triangles, their uppermost points angling towards the surrounding tie-pilings, have black numbers ranging from 6 to 10 drawn at their centers.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fourth Pier]
description: Discarded brushes and buckets filled with dried up paint are collected in a copper-banded barrel that sits between two tall support posts.  Triangles of red paint, three on the southwest and two on the northwest, have black numbers drawn within them that range from 11 to 15, while bold blocky letters beneath the shapes proclaim this area as "Pier Four."  A small fishing basket dangles over the edge of the water, its interior empty and bait-free.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fourth Pier]
description: Looping between support posts, heavily corded bright red rope forms a simple barrier between the open water and the edges of the wooden pier.  A pair of simple steps, with bright red letters painted in front of them proclaiming the area as "Pier 4 - Slips 16-20," leads down to a small finger pier with five docking slips built into its seaward side.  A light and insistent seaborne breeze slips across the water and carries with it the thick scent of salt.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fourth Pier]
description: Standing out from the end of the pier like the spokes of a wheel, five docking slips flanked with small boardwalks are painted with bright red hues and bordered by hefty rope railings in the same hue.  Wrought iron horn cleats provide tie-off spots for incoming ships, some of which trail the frayed remains of hemp lines.  An arching sign supported by nearby pilings greets visitors with its blocky text that reads, "Welcome to Kraken's Fall."

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fifth Pier]
description: Flanked by cork buoys, a large sign with blocky letters directs foot traffic to the southwest, while a painted blue arrow upon the floorboards of the pier curves to the southeast.  Large and small boulders prevent ships from drawing closer to the eastern edge of the pier, though five tie-pilings to the south provide ample space and depth of water to prevent damage to docking vessels.  A pile of neatly coiled rope rests at the ready next to a series of iron horn cleats.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fifth Pier]
description: Trios of wrought iron horn cleats are arranged down the length of the pier in alternating patterns between support posts fitted with thick cords of bright azure rope, the latter of which forms a barrier designed to protect against a fall into the ocean beyond.  Saltwater spray from the bouncing waves glistens in the ambient light, while dark blue diamonds painted onto the wooden floorboards label slips 6 through 10 as being nearby.  A discolored windsock flutters as the seaborne breeze tugs it.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fifth Pier]
description: Stacked crates, each stamped with a kraken crest, line the northeastern edge of the wooden pier, while off-white lead lines stretch between painted horn cleats and a quintet of tie pilings on the opposite side.  Dark blue lacquer forms a huge diamond in the center of the walking space, the translucent finish forming a protective barrier over the bright white message at its center proclaiming "Pier 5 - Slips 11-15."  From somewhere above, the piteous cry of a seagull fills the air.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fifth Pier]
description: Waves slap against nearby tie pilings, the salty spray turning to a drenching mist that causes the floorboards of the pier to glisten in the ambient light.  Bright white numbers are painted within dark blue diamonds, each positioned in front of a different piling and ranging from 16 to 20.  A section of the rope railing that trails the northeastern edge of the pier is torn and frayed, though someone has tied enormous knots at each end to prevent the piece from slipping out of its mooring.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Fifth Pier]
description: Descending to a pair of wooden steps, the southernmost section of the pier terminates in a lower finger pier that houses five docking slips.  Sturdy oak railings line the descent, while bright blue letters form a greeting to "Pier Five" on nearby pilings.  Diamonds of darker blue painted with numbers in their center are arranged in ascending order and range from 21 to 25.

title: [Basalt Cliff, Base]
description: Towering above, a wide cliff face of exposed grey basalt columns stretches upwards to the blue sky, the top of which is barely visible.  While completely vertical, ample hand and footholds can be found for even the most novice of climbers.  Hexagonal blocks of basalt lay on the ground at the base, having fallen from the face over time.

title: [Basalt Cliff, Face]
description: Halfway up the cliff face is a ledge wide enough to pause on safely.  It extends further east though the footing is treacherous.  The view from here is breathtaking, with Kharam Dzu appearing like a toy town below were it not for the tiny inhabitants moving about their daily routines.

title: [Basalt Cliff, Face]
description: This side of the ledge along the basalt cliff face allows a view above the waterfalls feeding the river Muagh.  The river splits the town of Kharam Dzu below.  Wedged between two basalt columns is an abandoned nest.  Progress upwards is impossible and there is no safe way down.  Little else is here.

title: [Basalt Cliff, Face]
description: Near the top of the cliff there are no footholds that allow progress upwards.  One may only climb the cliff face back down or perhaps try their luck and shimmy to the east across the basalt in search of a way up.  The wind here is relentless against the exposed rock and anything unlucky enough to be clinging to it.

title: [Basalt Cliff, Face]
description: A way to the crater rim can be seen above, but only the most careful and patient climbers may make it to the top.  Progress further east is hindered by an unclimbable rocky buttress, and downward is a fall so great it would surely kill the most hearty of adventurers.  Though the basalt is crumbling it may be possible to shimmy west across the exposed rock.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Rim]
description: This area of the crater rim is flat enough to traverse upon reliably, though the footing is deep with volcanic ash.  Progress can be made west or northeast as well as back down a cliff face to the volcanic slopes far below.  Sulfuric gasses billow from the crater to the north and to the south is an unfettered view of Kharam Dzu and the waters of the ocean surrounding Teras Isle.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Rim]
description: Running west-to-east along the crater rim, this trail is rocky yet flat enough to make easy progress.  Gasses billow up from the distant crater, and a dwarven settlement can be seen to the south amidst the mist-covered jungle at the base of the volcanic slope.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Rim]
description: This walkable trail continues along the rim of Stormbrow.  Avian nests can be seen both along the outer and inner sides of the volcano's crater. Though the path is steep the ash covered ground provides sturdy footing.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Rim]
description: The trail flattens out into a platform that runs east-to-west along the crater's rim.  To the southeast is a steep path that leads down to another east-to-west section of the trail.  Far to the south, the shimmering ocean reflects the sunlight shining from above, while to the north, orange clouds rise from the inhospitable cauldron of magma at the center of the crater.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Trail]
description: Rubble from past eruptions litters the ash covered path along this section of the rim.  From this vantage, nests can be seen dotting the outer slope of the volcano to the southwest, and the inner slope of the crater appears blackened and uninhabited.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Trail Split]
description: Along the crater rim the rocky path splits around a small peak covered with craggy rocks and blackened nests.  Ash covers the small spire, as well as a treacherous path that's dangerously close to a gaping crater of molten lava.  Clouds of noxious fumes drift from east to west overhead.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Ocean Overlook]
description: Passage around a small peak along the crater rim curves to the west, allowing a view of the open ocean stretching out as far as the eye can see.  Nests are lodged between rocks and crevices covering the rocky spire.  Even though the footing here is thick with ash, it is still manageable.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Ridge]
description: This plateau allows a view of the roiling magma lake in the blackened crater to the northwest.  A minor rock slide has fallen to the southeast that allows access to a rocky ledge looking out over Teras Isle.  The footing is relatively flat with ash covering the entire area.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Slide]
description: This rocky ledge sits below the rim of the volcanic crater along the top of Stormbrow's outer slope.  Kharam Dzu can be seen to the south and the coast of the Turamzzyrian Empire far to the east.  Access to the crater rim can be gained by climbing the slide to the northwest or by a short climb north.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Rim]
description: This flat path along the crater rim runs northeast to west.  Down the east side of the volcano's slope, ragged rocks of cooled lava coated with fine ash stand vertically like some great claws piercing through soil.  A rocky ledge can be accessed with a short climb south, while the ashy path continues to the northeast.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Rim]
description: This section of the crater rim has numerous obsidian peaks that flank the walkable path on either side.  Some of the shiny obsidian protrusions stand taller than a giantman, with sharp jagged edges honed over time after exposure to winds at this high altitude.  Fine ash mixed with smaller obsidian shards litter the path as it weaves between the peaks.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Slope]
description: The path winds through sharp jagged obsidian peaks turned upwards from volcanic activity.  Thick fumes rise from the crater to the east, while the west is treacherous with a long fall down the side of the volcano below.  Ash and rocks along the trail make it difficult to maneuver.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Ledge]
description: Leaning a little too close for comfort over the boiling magma lake in the crater to the west, the path snakes around large obsidian peaks to the east.  Noxious vapors thick with sulfur rise from the crater to cloak the area in a toxic haze.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Dropoff]
description: Any progress north is impossible due to a sheer drop-off caused by a cave-in along the trail.  Further to the north, the crater rim continues to wrap itself around the lake of magma.  To the east, the waters of Solhaven Bay sparkle in the sunlight, with ships dotting the coastline of the port town.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Overhang]
description: The vantage point here gives a full view of a glowing orange magma lake in a crater to the east.  The atmosphere is barely tolerable, with heavy gasses and sulfurous fumes impairing vision and breathing.  One misstep is a potentially hazardous plummet into the fiery heart of the crater below.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Crater Ridge]
description: Between a small peak to the south and a northern pinnacle, the footing here is flat and covered in ash.  Nests of blackened twigs and feathers dot the slopes down the side of the volcano to the west, and noxious gasses waft in from the crater to the east.

title: [The F'Eyrie, Pinnacle]
description: At the top of the tallest peak around the rim of Stormbrow the view is far and wide.  To the north a verdant isle rests on the surface of a surrounding ocean that spreads out as far as the eye can see to the west.  To the east, the blackened crater of Stormbrow cradles a roiling lava cauldron that hisses and spews sulfurous gas clouds obscuring a view of anything beyond.  Kharam Dzu can be seen to the south, split by the glittering river Maugh before it empties out to sea.

title: [The Bean and Leaf]
description: Crafted from white oak, the shiplapped walls of the shop contrast with darker wood trim that accents the room.  Shelves filled with packets and canisters of tobacco and coffee line the walls above a glass-inset oak counter.  Mugs and silverware are haphazardly stacked in a crate resting on the floor.  The scent of tobacco permeates the air, punctuated by the strong aroma of roasted coffee.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Black Stone Beach]
description: Glossy, rounded, ebon-hued stones, roughly the size of quail eggs, litter the beach in all directions.  A sheen of moisture across the surface makes for slippery footing, but as the slope levels out toward the shoreline, traversing the rocks becomes less treacherous.  Wind-whipped, black sand stings sharply upon any exposed skin, and the rhythmic sound of the ocean fills the air.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Black Stone Beach]
description: The crunch of gravel, stones, and coarse sand underfoot can barely be detected above the howling of the winds across the beachscape.  Broken and discarded crab shells proclaim the success of the hunters who came before you, and freshly dug holes mark the burrows of rodents who escaped the fate that awaits most prey.  Small black terns and other seabirds hover, swoop, and dive above the shallows blanketing a half-exposed sandbar off the eastern shoreline.

title: [Dark Side of the Piers]
description: Multiple paths veer off through the pebbled dunes where clumps of beach grasses cling to sparse soil, holding their own against the wind and salt spray.  Upturned coconut crab shell torches rest atop bamboo poles at several junctures, ready to light the way come nightfall for any venturing to or from the water's edge.  The bustle of dockworkers and merchants from the many piers in the distance brings the only relief from the incessant whistle of ocean winds.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Rocky Shoals, Pier One]
description: A circle of charred rocks surrounding half-burnt logs marks the location of a recent cookout in the shade of the overhead pier.  Coconut crab shells, now empty of their previous inhabitants, have been discarded in scattered piles upon the pebbled sand.  Stripes of sunlight paint the ground where gaps in the wooden pier walkway lets slivers of golden rays shine through.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Pier One]
description: Sounds of footsteps mingle with the calls of vendors from the wooden pier directly overhead.  Though the headspace is not abundant, the relative dryness of the sand and rocks makes the ground in this area relatively easy to traverse.  Tracks crisscrossing beneath the pier hint at the bounty that awaits a patient hunter.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Water's Edge]
description: Enormous, jet black boulders guard the waterline beneath the westernmost pier.  Standing as sentinels against the onslaught of crashing waves, each shimmers only briefly with the reflected rays of the sun before its slick, dark surface is awash yet again.  Gulls perched atop each jagged behemoth squabble over morsels, filling the air with their raucous cries.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Pier Two]
description: Charred rocks arranged in a circle form a makeshift firepit in the cool sand beneath the busy pier.  Clawprints are clearly visible in the moist brown sand, documenting the ravaging of a pile of discarded food by various crabs, reptiles, and rodents.  Sounds filter down from above, the squeak and screech of ships rubbing against the deep water end of the pier rising and falling in rhythm with the waves.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Water's Edge]
description: A buildup of yellow-topped foam does little to hide the bloated and mascerated bodies of dead fishes, floating belly-up among the rocky shallows.  While the pier above grants some protection from the winds, it also facilitates the pooling of the nauseating stench beneath the wooden structure.  Tracks of small animals abound here, marking this as a favored feeding area for predators and scavengers alike.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Pier Three]
description: The rocks here are jagged and sharp, unlike the rounded pebbles further up the beach.  Colored in shades of white, grey, brown, yellow, and tan, each rasp-edged stone seems to have been placed to inflict the most pain on the soles of one's feet, making heavy boots a must here.  Long tubules of bull kelp have wrapped themselves around the pilings, along with a few spiny-topped sea stars.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Water's Edge]
description: The battering of the sea against the shore is only slightly subdued beneath this middle pier, with the brunt of wave action being born by the outermost piers to either side.  Shredded ribbons of dark green kelp drape themselves as though sunbathing across the flat-topped rocks and boulders where the land meets the sea.  A few cracked shells lay empty upon the shore, while tiny tracks of crustaceans lead to and from the water's edge.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Pier Four]
description: All but the most diminutive of races are well advised to duck their heads while traversing the sodden sand beneath the low-to-the-ground pier.  The shallow footings of the short pilings struggle to support the weight of the walkway overhead.  Carcasses of wharf rats lay exposed upon the gravelly sand, inviting flies and scavengers to feast upon the corpses.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Pier Five]
description: The remnants of small campfires dot the cool, moist sand shadowed and shaded by the pier directly overhead.  Thin beams of golden sunlight dance across the pebbled soil, filtering through cracks in the boards above.  Massive weathered oak pilings support the walkway overhead and provide cover for hunters attempting to ambush unsuspecting prey.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Water's Edge]
description: Frigid blasts of sea water and foam launch themselves rhythmically against the outermost pilings of the pier above.  Ducking the spray proves a futile endeavor as each incoming wave disperses with force against the stalwart wooden obstacles.  Shallow, foam-topped pools empty and fill in the spaces between the largest, shore-hugging boulders.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Pier Four]
description: Halfway between the short pilings at the pier's entrance and the tall ones near the water's edge, this spacious area has overhead room to spare.  Bamboo-mounted torches stand ready to illuminate the area come nightfall, and several dormant firepits dot the sand.  Large, dark-grained rocks seem custom placed for seating and gathered piles of driftwood provide a ready source of fuel.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Pier Five]
description: The clang of bells and the shouting of dockworkers announce the arrival of each inbound vessel at the deep water end of the pier overhead.  Dark, dry sand filters through cracks in the walkway above as the heavy boots of the workers dislodge the accumulated grains and send them raining down atop the heads of those below.  Tiny rivulets of water seep from the moisture-laden ground and trickle outward toward the water's edge.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Water's Edge]
description: The narrow, rock-strewn strip between the high water line and the low leaves little room for navigation.  Patches of sea lettuce cling to the rocky shore, holding fast through the ceaseless assault of the waves.  Elongated, dark blue mussels are anchored to the intertidal rocks, clustered together as though afraid to face the sea's wrath alone.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Black Stone Beach]
description: Sharp rocks, loose pebbles, and deep, dry sand all conspire to make this a difficult climb.  Beach grasses have made incursions into the footpaths here, but the line of travel is still visible underfoot.  The view to the east is breathtaking, with a series of piers jutting out into the water, and a vast expanse of ocean stretching to the horizon.

title: [Limestone Cave, Bedrock Shelves]
description: With a steep passageway being the one way in or out, there is a sharp drop-off into this multitiered room of blackish grey rock.  Channels eroded into the surface of the bedrock have formed plateaus, both high and low.  Numerous flat outcroppings hold small coconut crab shells, upturned and filled with burning oil, to lend light, warmth, and a pleasant fragrance to the imposing space.  Stalwart granite formations give cover for either safety or for ambush, to predator and prey alike.

title: [Limestone Cave, Warped Corridor]
description: Some sections of this narrow passage twist so sharply, one must turn sideways to manuever through.  The smooth rock floor below, though sturdy, is tilted on a diagonal.  Handholds for security have been chiseled into the pale white walls, spaced evenly apart to aid in safe passage from one end to the other.  Stalactites glossed over with underground seepage hang precariously downward from the high, narrow ceiling.

title: [Limestone Cave, Warped Corridor]
description: The sides and low-hanging dome in this narrow tunnel seem to have undergone tectonic changes.  Patterns within the limestone stop and start as though each face was, at some point, wrenched away from its neighbor.  The light from the entrance to the south dims here.  Fortunately, someone had the forethought to leave a pile of resin-coated torches nearby.  A smoky grey helictite nearly blocks the narrow corridor, its helix shape arising from the twisting and curling of the calcium carbonate structure.

title: [Limestone Cave, Entry]
description: An open expanse welcomes visitors to this artificially illuminated cavity formed deep within the earth.  The sheer size of it illustrates the effect of centuries of dissolution of the porous limestone by acidic groundwater.  Scorch marks and a heavy layer of soot mar the faces of several naturally formed columns affixed with brightly burning sconces.

title: [Rocky Shoals, Black Stone Beach]
description: Flanked by two prominently displayed torches, the wide opening of a water-slicked cave looms large atop a rocky promontory.  To the east, an expansive view of the whitecapped ocean stretches toward the horizon.  The thunderous crashing of waves against the shoreline drowns out all but the loudest of sounds from the nearby town and the piers in the distance.  Overhead, gulls cry out and scan the surroundings in search of an easy meal.

title: [Limestone Cave, Stagnant Pool]
description: Only a narrow rim of traversable ground surrounds a massive underground lake of algae-blanketed, foul-smelling water.  Wide natural openings in the domed ceiling above permit the warm rays of the sun to permeate the shallow water.  White, yellow, and red crystals have formed a thick crust of mineralized rings around the circumfrence of the pool.

title: [Limestone Cave, Amber Gallery]
description: Striated among the layered beds of soft white to pale grey limestone are deposits of fossilized trees.  Interspersed within the layered mosaic are droplets and formations of ancient tree resins.  By torchlight, the amber glows from a soft yellow, almost white, to a brilliant golden hue dispersed across the walls and floor.  Hidden within a few tear-shaped droplets are tiny spiders and a couple of ants, trapped for all time as inclusions within the precious baubles.

title: [Limestone Cave, Slimy Descent]
description: One of the paths traversing this section of the cavern dips sharply to the south, disappearing into the darkened depths.  Little can be seen or heard from the sections further down, discouraging the timid from further exploring the lower environs.  A slick coating of algae from the seepage across the floor only increases the danger of venturing further.

title: [Limstone Cave, Slimy Ascent]
description: A nauseating stench permeates the fetid air in this section of the cavern.  Algae mats and a layer of black mold make the steep pathways here treacherous.  Only a few widespaced handholds carved into the limestone surround make the return climb to the higher levels possible.  A bright and glittering light to the southeast makes a vague promise of a more inviting environment.

title: [Limestone Cave, Slimy Descent]
description: One of the paths traversing this section of the cavern dips sharply to the south, disappearing into the darkened depths.  Little can be seen or heard from the sections further down, discouraging the timid from further exploring the lower environs.  A slick coating of algae from the seepage across the floor only increases the danger of venturing further.

title: [Limestone Cave, Mica Pools]
description: The air is warm here with tiny wisps of steam rising from shallow pools of placid water.  Flecks of mica reflect a scintillating light across the expansive cavern, an ever-dancing light bouncing off their surfaces from burning candles housed in niches carved into the walls.  Little outside sound reaches this depth, lending an air of serenity to the visually calming space.

title: [Limstone Cave, Stalactite Skies]
description: Narrow columns of light filter down from small openings in the ceiling where the corrosive acidity of the groundwater has eroded through the limestone.  Multiple stalactites have formed around each opening, where mineralization of the seepage leaves a buildup of calcite and gypsum slowly dripping downward.  The largest of the tapering formations is taller than five giantmen standing on each other's shoulders and the smallest hang like delicate icicles, no longer than a forest gnome's pinky.

title: [Cliffwalk, Crumpled Steps]
description: A series of cuts gouged into the rockface of the cliff offer a way to climb higher in the rocky terrain.  Piles of loose and crumbling boulders and stones bridge a steep descent towards a lower, and perhaps safer, part of the trail.  Beside the path, only a smattering of vegetation has managed to hold fast to the inhospitable ground.

title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Trail]
description: Sunlight reflects off of the red clay roof tiles atop several buildings in the town below the cliff side trail.  Shoppers scurry through the cobblestone streets, though from this height, most look to be halflings.  The trail, though narrow, is at least more level here than on the craggier faces directly above.

Silvery bands of moonlight reflect off of the red clay roof tiles atop several buildings in the town below the cliff side trail.  A few tavern-goers and late night revelers wander the cobblestone streets, though from this height, most look to be halflings.  The darkened trail, though narrow, is at least more level here than on the craggier faces directly above.

title: [Cliffwalk, Verdant Pass]
description: Though only a scattering of sand and loose soil covers the flat stones of this outcropping, a few hardy plants have managed to gain a foothold.  Waving grasses dance in rhythm to the fluctuating breezes, and small, spindly saplings hoist themselves up out of soil-laden crevices to spread their budding greenery.  Upright and overlapped shelfae scales have been fashioned into tiny garden borders around a patch of blooming yellow and pink flowers.

title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Ledge]
description: Carved directly into the side of the imposing cliff face is a monolithic sculpture of a reptilian being.  Its features are blurred from wind, rain, and the passage of time, but gangly, claw-tipped forelimbs and a thick, scale-carved tail clearly identify the figure as a native inhabitant of these lands.  Golden reflections undulate off mica flecks imbedded in the rock face, lending a life-like quality to the imposing figure.

title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Ledge]
description: A sheer drop-off punctuates any attempts at travel toward the west, while a narrow, rocky trail funnels off to the east.  Some craggy steps carved into the cliff appear to lead downward toward an open space filled with greenery below.  The cry of gulls echoes nearby, their location obscured by a rising fog from the sea.

title: [Cliffwalk, Verdant Pass]
description: A wide outcropping of flattened stones has accumulated enough sandy soil to support the growth of vegetation.  The verdant ground cover and emerald-leafed saplings stand in stark contrast to the white, vertical face of the bordering cliff.  A heavy mist rides the air currents drifting up from the ocean surface below.

title: [Cliffwalk, Verdant Pass]
description: Flowering vines tenaciously climb their way across the bordering white cliff face, digging tiny green tendrils into each crevice and crack to gain a secure hold.  Rounded petals of sunburst orange and brilliant red bloom along the length of each vine.  The ocean far below throws angry waves crashing against the shoreline, erupting into a frothy spray before subsiding once again.

title: [Cliffwalk, Ragged Outcropping]
description: Nothing except open air and a precipitous drop lays to the east where the rocky outcropping ends abruptly.  A few scattered scales and bits of bone bear the signs of a battle lost in the form of old, dried, darkened bloodstains.  Frequent gusts of wind whistle eerily as they force their way through large crevices in the rocky landscape.

title: [Cliffwalk, Narrow Trail]
description: The calls of shopkeepers hawking their wares arises from the town just below this narrow cliffside trail.  Minstrels wander through the visible streetscapes, lending the melodies of instruments and song to the sounds rising from below.  Accompanied by the ceaseless pounding of the ocean waves beyond, the cacophony echoes rhythmically off the surrounding, vertical cliff face.

title: [Cliffwalk, Rockslide Alley]
description: To the east, only a tangle of downed saplings half-buried in rocky debris marks the end of the narrow trail.  Gaily clad shoppers attired in finery mingle with sailors from the nearby piers, bustling through the busy streets of the town below.  The aroma of roasting meats drifts upward on the rising breeze, seducing the occasional hunter to abandon this harsh and near-barren terrain.

title: [Black Weald, Clearcut]
description: Deep ruts scored into the mud and heavily trampled grasses are all that remain of what appears to have once been pristine earth.  Circular stumps, some fairly large and others quite small, jut upwards in their severed stances.  A spindly game trail leads toward a road just visible to the south, and several small paths lead off in northerly directions for those venturing deeper into the forest.

title: [Black Weald, Sky Pond]
description: Far enough from the road to bring the respite of silence, this wooded glade is peaceful and serene.  A gently rippled pond provides fresh water for the forest dwellers, their hoof and paw prints leading to and from the water's edge.  Fallen logs, half-submerged along the shoreline, grant a safe sunning spot for yellow-bellied terrapins and a few spotted lizards.

title: [Black Weald, Spur Road]
description: A well-trodden pathway leads deeper into the forest to the northeast.  One set of paw prints, as large as a giantkin's hand, are layered atop the tiny hoof prints of a juvenile ungulate.  Thick foliage and brambled patches make the southeast spur appear as a less inviting option.

title: [Black Weald, Clearcut]
description: A circle of severed stumps dominates the landscape, with only some spindly saplings and ground-hugging shrubs lending traces of greenery to the space.  The average diameter of the stumps is over four feet, indicating true giants were felled here.  Overhead, a few semi-wilted vines drape from the narrow-trunked, immature trees along the perimeter.

title: [Black Weald, Western Aspect]
description: Dense forest growth along this western edge of the weald obscures all but a few narrow beams of golden sunlight from above.  An ancient sycamore proclaims itself ruler of this space, its six-foot diameter and tall, spreading crown keeping all but the hardiest of saplings from reaching for the sky.  A scattering of shed antlers marks this as a gathering place for herds of large ungulate natives of Kraken's Fall.

title: [Black Weald, Larkspur Meadow]
description: A riot of color greets those who reach this secluded meadow.  Reaching heights of one to two meters, cheery stalks of larkspur decorate the fertile ground.  Blossoms of blue and pink grow in abundance, with a smattering of purple and white lending variety to the scene.  Peeking through the blossoms is a verdant backdrop of foliage, with broad leaves divided into deep lobes.

title: [Black Weald, Western Aspect]
description: Scorched and disfigured trunks hold fast to their long-claimed patches of ground along the western edge of the weald.  Many of their past compatriots lay spawled across the earth, their scarred lengths felled by the forces of lightning strikes, fire, or wind.  A few young oaks, maples, and yews struggle to gain a foothold in the harsh, unforgiving terrain.

title: [Black Weald, Shadowed Glade]
description: A refreshing coolness pervades the air across this tiny glade, provided by the dense ceiling of foliage overhead.  An aromatic blend of moisture-laden leaf matter, resinous pine sap, and rich, loamy soil permeates the space with an organic and earthy fragrance.  Thick foliage and patches of thorny brambles mark the uninviting passage to the northwest.

title: [Black Weald, Spur Road]
description: Heavily trampled dirt makes for a dry and dusty road running between Widowmaker's Road and the depths of the forest beyond.  The shed antlers of several large stags are bleached white with age, and a massive skull of ursian origin rests half-buried beneath a fallen oak.  The lilt of songbirds lend a chorus to the caws of ravens overhead.

title: [Black Weald, Game Trail]
description: The pathway narrows here with the peripheral encroachment of gnarled hardwoods draped in vines.  Little light pierces the canopy above, with only narrow beams of sunlight reaching the shrub-tangled forest floor.  The entwined aromas of stale urine and fresh dung permeate the still air, threatening to precipitate a bout of nausea for those with delicate tummies.

title: [Black Weald, Game Trail]
description: The narrow and circuitous route rings the edges of the deeper, darker forest land.  To one side maples, elm, and hickory rise up in an intimidating wall to the interior.  To the other side, a steep cliff falls away along the back side of the island, presenting a precipitous drop to the ocean far below.  Small animal tracks can be glimpsed underfoot, partially hidden by the waist-high grasses.

title: [Black Weald, Softwood Stretch]
description: Evenly spaced rows of ancient spruce dominate this stretch of forest.  Like soldiers reporting for duty, each stands tall and straight beside its neighbor, bending little even when faced with buffeting winds.  Closely spaced needles cling to sturdy branches and thin, smooth-barked cones hang precariously high in each treetop.

title: [Black Weald, Softwood Stretch]
description: Stands of immature firs, spreading hemlocks, and stately pines are staggered throughout the open space.  A carpet of browning needles cushions the ground underfoot, and the husks of deceased beetles lend an iridescence to many of the standing trunks.  Downward draping boughs lightly kiss the tops of the waving grasses at their feet.

title: [Black Weald, Conversion]
description: A mixture of hardwoods and softwoods intermingles with verdant shrubs, thorn-laden vines, and a few hardy grasses.  Denuded stripes of yellow pulp deface the stately trunks where the antlers of large stags have stripped away swaths of protective bark.  Game trails crisscross the area, leading to and from the deeper forest.

title: [Black Weald, Spur Road]
description: Game trails, lightly trodden by both hooves and paws, snake sideways across the well-packed road.  Visibility lessens where the forest growth becomes denser in the distance, where broad and closely spaced trunks seem to huddle together for safety in the forest. The drone of buzzing insects presents a cacophonous symphony from the surrounding woodlands.

title: [Black Weald, Cypress Shrouds]
description: Tiny bubbles and squishy sounds are emitted from the moisture-laden soil with any passing footsteps of trespassers on this land.  The earthy aroma of decomposing organic matter hangs heavily in the still air.  Overhead, a lush canopy of cypress branches thrives on the nutrient rich miasma.  Narrow game trails nearby skirt the edges of the deepest pools of standing water.

title: [Black Weald, Cypress Shrouds]
description: Knobby knees of ancient bald cypress jut upwards sporadically through the brackish, standing water in this low-lying section of the Weald.  Long-legged insects, with pale-carapiced bodies splay cautiously atop the water, exploiting the surface tension to avoid an untimely demise.  The bloated carcass of a stiff-bristled boar lies half-submerged in the shallows, reminding the wise of the dangers lurking in the forest.

title: [Black Weald, Furrowed Clearing]
description: Small furrows run perpendicularly across the clearing, hinting at past attempts to cultivate the land.  Waist-high native grasses, their seed heads full and draping, cover much of the ground.  Interspersed with the grasses, colorful wildflowers with their red, orange, and purple petals announce their distain for the notion of regimented agriculture.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Ticketing]
description: One wall of the building is entirely glass, each pane placed into a framework of oxidized copper.  The doorway set into the wall is wide and slightly arched, part of a triad of equally spaced openings hung beneath a giant verdigris medallion.
