Beyond the half-moon shaped chamber, a flight of three steps leads into the open expanse of the museum.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Lower Platform]
description: A marble staircase cuts a diagonal across the back side of the building, leading upwards to the second story.  On one side of the staircase is a copper railing and on the other, an unobstructed view through the glass wall to the city outside.  Several arches lead off from the main platform floor, each one leading into a more contained chamber.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Upper Platform]
description: Copper railings line the inner edge of the high platform, providing a slatted view down onto the main floor of the museum below.  The exhibit space between the railings and the building's exterior wall is largely open, and identical to its mate across the platform -- the floors are basket weave patterned wood and the cases clear glass atop copper pedestals.  A walkway stretches between the two elevated halves of the building.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Upper Platform]
description: The long upper gallery truncates short of the glassed front wall of the building, stopping just at the boundary of the half-moon shaped ticketing area below.  Copper railings line the platform's edges, matching the metallic pedestals and hardware of the glass cases scattered throughout the exhibit space.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Upper Platform]
description: The length of the upper platform is lined with copper railings that separate the elevated space from the drop-off to the exhibit halls below.  Coordinating pedestals, their bases set with plaques, are scattered here and there, and a few glass cases dot the open area.  The wooden floor is worn shiny at the foot of a walkway leading from one side of the upper platform to the other.  An equally burnished patch of flooring is directly in front of a tiled copper arch leading outside.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Upper Platform]
description: A bumped out area at the connection between the interior and front-facing railings is festooned with verdigris vines and blown glass blossoms.  The small landing overlooks both the main nave of the building and the former ticketing office at its glass walled entrance.  Across the open space, the far platform appears similar in design and aesthetics.  Even the exhibit cases resemble one another.

title: [Museum Alerreth, History]
description: The marble walls are punctuated with several glass cases, each of which is set either above or below an inlaid copper strip.  The metallic band stretches from the right to the left side of a copper-plated arch, circumnavigating the room in the process.  A square tile of the same copper as the arch and timeline is inset into the center of the floor.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Airships]
description: Three model airships sit prominently on display in the middle of the room, each placed within a glass case.  Matching glass-fronted cabinets, fitted with copper, sit apart from the small vessels, their contents filled with larger pieces of airship parts, pieces and paraphernalia.  The floor underneath the exhibit is inset with a square tile, the patina of which matches the greenish finish of a verdigris arch.

title: [The Bean and Leaf, Brewing]
description: Several cushioned chairs are set about the room, two of them flanking a picture window facing out onto the street below and the dunes, beach, and sea beyond.  A small wicker basket is tucked to one side of a cast iron stove that occupies a shadowed corner of the room.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Rounded bite marks have removed sections of the wall in the northeastern corner, where some large seafaring animal attempted to bite its way into the submerged structure.  Scattered fish bones and discarded bivalves are strewn about the carpeting and hint at what the carnivore devoured.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Scattered patches of verdigris mar the surface of an old, full-length copper mirror that rests against the eastern wall, its greenish markings resembling a form of abstract artwork.  Broken slats from a teak deck chair have impaled the walls at various heights, their waterlogged surfaces housing dozens of brightly burning votives.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Scattered sand along the sodden floor, even with its fine granules, does little to nothing to absorb the abundance of moisture trapped in the thick velvet carpeting.  Holes in the walls are occupied with fitfully burning votives whose fluttering flames create both illumination and shadow.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Narrowing to the south where a beach boulder has cleaved through the wall, the corridor is eerily luminous, a sea of votives dripping hot, thick wax all over the grey stone.  Sand is predominantly underfoot, its tiny bits of mica and feldspar glittering in the sparse candlelight.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Piercing the eastern wall, a large beach boulder has forced a narrowing of the corridor but provides an excellent anchor for a bevy of off-white tallow candles whose flaming wicks dance before an invading mist.  Ribbons of paint, sluiced from their footholds during their sojourn in a watery grave, lay in blue and copper bundles upon the ground.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Partially corroded, a rusty bucket echoes loudly as water strikes its bottom before gushing out one of many holes.  Many of the area candles have been snuffed out, the hollows around their wicks immersed in accumulating saltwater.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Lacking any natural lighting, the corridor is riff with shadows that blink in and out of existence, and something nearby emits a rhythmic wheezing that is punctuated by a *drip-drop* sound.  The ceiling is unusually low, as if the walls are unable to support the sodden beams, threatening to cave in at any moment.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Crowded into a corner of the corridor are half-rotted remains of teak tables and chairs, which are stacked into unusual structures and crowded with various sizes of off-white candles.  Dripping water, almost hypnotizing with its rhythmic pattern, reverberates noisily throughout the area.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Commingling with the scent of rot and decay is the scent of roses, which can be tracked to a single pink candle that rests among off-white varieties clustered upon the sodden floor.  Leached of most of its color, a once-decorative mahogany frame holds a pictureless canvas that is dimpled with acorn barnacles.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Adequately brightened by candles to the east, west, and north, three corridors come together upon waterlogged velvet carpeting that is stained a shade darker than blood.  Shattered remains of a lounge chair, its once-decorative canvas long gone, rest against a bare wall.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Obscure bulges beneath the sodden carpeting make the terrain uneven, while a damaged ceiling provides an oppressive closeness in the mist-filled passage.  Pillar candles stand adjacent to the corridor's southern wall, their wavering light hissing and spluttering at random intervals.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Piled into a corner, a variety of brick-a-brack clogs the passage and fills the air with a musty scent mixed with rot and saltwater.  Tarnished copper mirrors scattered throughout the pile catch available light and reflect it towards both the north and the west, extinguishing any requirement for candles in the immediate area.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Blackened silt speckled with feldspar and mica stains the center of the waterlogged carpet, while its edges are covered with indigo tallow candles.  Numerous strands of inky black kelp hang from fractures in the ceiling, their limp bodies swaying obediently with the rolling mist.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Muted and persistent, the sound of waves crashing against reverberates throughout the corridor, which is damp and filled with a thick, silvery mist.  Tall clusters of tiny boulders are stacked against the western wall and serve as makeshift shelves, housing dozens of indigo votives.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Crashing against the corridor's western exterior, waves pound upon the structure, causing them to reverberate with the aggressive impact.  A breach in the ceiling permits thick curtains of mist to gain entry, and a light, but constant breeze, wreaks havoc on the flames of nearby candles.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: A steady stream of water flows in from the north and forms a tiny river down the center of the corridor, its rippling current illuminated by candles placed along a perpendicular wall.  Paint bubbles in the facing wall hold pockets of mist that are intermittently discharged into the air.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Warped and bulbous, the ceiling hangs considerably low due to several rusty nails that have lost their grip on the support posts.  A steady, but light flow of water spills from the punctured ceiling and creates a waterfall along the eastern edge of the corridor.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Mist pours into the corridor through a large rent in the corner of the room, and silvery vapors create a knee-high miasma that swirls and eddies throughout the area.  Inverted mop pails can be glimpsed beneath the haze, their tops dotted with lit candles that create halos of light.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Rhythmic and regular, waves crashing against the western wall echo throughout the corridor and jolt the unstable footing.  Small pools of water fill and empty with the ebb and flow of an unseen tide, its salty liquid threatening to drown candles placed along the eastern edge.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Bare walls and warped ceilings converge in this section of the hallway, which is rife with the echoing sounds of dripping water.  Algae and kelp clings to the floor, except where it has been cleared away to display a considerable collection of burning candles.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Resembling a whale's enormous fibrous teeth, the water-ravaged walls are filled with listless forms of kelp stalks that have colonized between the wall supports.  Mist tumbles through slim ceiling cracks and pools around thick column candles illuminating the path.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Squelching sounds echo through the corridor as water-sodden carpets are traversed, the noise oddly punctuated by dripping from somewhere nearby.  Half-imbedded into a wall is the skeletal form of a swordfish that is perfectly showcased by flickering candles beneath.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Rivulets of water streak the decomposing walls where paint has been stripped away by years of submersion.  Clustered in groups of three, off-white tallow candles provide a fair source of light in the area.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Imbedded barnacles appear luminescent in the candlelight, while shadows created by flickering flames add an eerie darkness to the seaweed piled on uneven flooring.  Blisters in the paint, half-filled with saltwater, have become natural prisons for hundreds of tiny minnows.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Complex coral structures have become anchored along the ship's wall, the black stony matter forming organic shelves which have recently been lined with candles.  Putrescent and salty, the air is thick with a foul scent of half-rotted seaweed and kelp.

title: [Crew Quarters, Corridor]
description: Shadows dance across a leaking ceiling where drips of salt water occasionally rain down and cause lit candles along the wall to splutter.  Rusted brass picture frames cling to the walls, in some places holding ribbons of paint that have sloughed free.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Crew Entry]
description: Supported by rusty nails at its four corners, a warped wooden sign with partially peeled off-white paint, is anchored to the wall and illuminated by a series of half-melted candles.  A dark portal leads out into darkness, while a series of steps decorated with a lit candle on each tread descends to the next floor.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Rotted Cabin]
description: Tangled vines of kelp descend from the cracked ceiling, the rotting vegetation filling the dank cabin with an unhealthy stench.  Haloed by an eerie green light, a fissure in the wall provides a means of escape, as does a brass-tacked ladder.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Rotted Cabin]
description: Shattered ceiling boards lay scattered across the soggy rug amid tangled kelp, coral colonies, and the bones of long dead aquatic creatures.  Eerie green light filters into the room, its source somewhere beyond the furthest rung of a brass-tacked ladder.  Moldy and mildewed piles of broken furniture are pushed against the slick walls, creating a path that leads to a fissure in the eastern wall.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Promenade]
description: A long, waterlogged velvet carpet runs the length of the hallway, guestrooms lined symmetrically along its breadth.  A pair of tarnished brass candelabra flank each door, the candles inside burning brightly and dispelling the pervasive darkness.  In the flickering light, a fissure can be seen in the western wall.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Promenade]
description: A waterlogged carpet continues through the hallway, darkened by barnacles and mold.  Water drips from the ceiling, the continuous *plip plop* echoing through the warped hallway filled with guestroom doors riddled with curls of peeling paint.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Promenade]
description: A tarnished golden plaque inscribed with a room number hangs off of each door, nearly every one crooked and dangling.  Hung upon a water-slicked wall, a lengthy mirror frame clings to the few remaining shards of reflective glass that bespeak its former glory.  Shadows darken the area.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Promenade]
description: Barnacles pockmark the soggy and moldy carpet before each guestroom door.  A series of tarnished brass-framed paintings depicting faded views of Ta'Nalfein hang upon the water-slicked walls.  The scent of rot, wafting from above, is heavy in the air.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Promenade]
description: A long, moldy carpet runs through the area, splitting at a fork in the hallway.  Several pairs of verdigris brass candelabra brightly light the area, causing erratic shadows to play on the water-slicked walls.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Coral Alcove]
description: Terminating in an alcove of splintered and rotted wood, the hallway sports coral structures and moldy velvet.  Two paintings depicting faded scenes in the jungle, one of a ruined temple and the other a raging waterfall, hang at tilted angles along the wall.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Coral Alcove]
description: Terminating in an alcove of splintered and rotted wood, the hallway sports coral structures and moldy velvet.  Two paintings depicting faded scenes of the Southron Wastes, one of a violent storm and the other a rare desert bloom, hang at tilted angles along the wall.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Deck]
description: Warped decking boards devoid of luster or shine stretch into the mist-filled air, the shattered southwestern edges decaying into darkness.  Verdigris brass railings blackened with decaying algae cling to the edge of the ship where pristine white deck chairs once rested.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Deck]
description: Slick with rot and decay, the flooring of the deck is warped in some places and completely missing in others.  Rust descends in uneven streaks down the greyish walls, the bright orangish-red stains making it look as if the port hole is bleeding.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Deck]
description: Clinging to the wall by one hinge, an off-white door with a glassless round window, hangs open and allows entry through a dark hole in the wall.  Half-melted candles are piled in waxen lumps that stretch from the tarnished railing in a half-circle to where one of the door's lower corners gouges the decking.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: Piled against the end of the hallway is the splintered remains of something that vaguely resembles a wooden table.  Mounted to the water-slicked wall is a verdigris mirror filled with shards of semi-reflective glass.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: Water-slicked walls, warped and riddled with barnacles, are illuminated by small orbs that rest upon the moldy carpet and issue an eerie green light.  The faded and scarred portrait of a human family smiling and waving from a sandy beach clings to the wall.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: Coral structures grow out of the shattered remains of porcelain vases, which are illuminated by dimly glowing orbs scattered across the moldy carpeting.  Every cabin door in the lengthy hall is covered with peeling painted and has a room number carved into it in a fine script.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: A series of tarnished, brass-trimmed lanterns separated by several feet, run the length of the hallway's ceiling, their rusted chains creaking as they sway in the fog.  Shadows dance across the eastern wall where rivulets of water cause the paint to bubble and warp.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: The lengthy hallway is covered with a waterlogged carpet that issues squelching noises every so often.  Casting eerie green light in all directions, tiny glass globes are impeded into the rotting walls.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: Despite the low-lying indigo mist, the long carpet that decorates the floor resembles a river of blood in the dim light of hanging lanterns.  Verdigris-framed paintings depicting faded shell-covered beaches and massive jungles are hung low to the ground and inverted.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: A moldy blood red rug runs the length of the waterlogged wooden floor of the hallway.  Guestroom doors, each displaying paint curls in blue and off-white tones, run symmetrically along its breadth.  A single candelabrum hangs precariously on the wall near each door, a tallow struggling to burn inside.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: Curling paint clings to the walls, largely due to barnacles imbedded in the wood, while clumps of seaweed create a slick walking space upon a moldy carpet with metallic cording.  To the east and west the passage is blocked by debris and a heavy, unpleasant odor.  A fissure in a northwestern corner is haloed in an eerie green light that spills from a frosted globe wedged into the floor.

title: [The Art Connection, Supplies]
description: Spacious and well-lit by lanterns, the walls of the wagon are covered with wooden paneling lined with lengths of ivory cotton.  Sunlight streams through a large clear crystal dome set into the roof.  A pair of carved mistwood tables are set to one side of the room, while a massive wooden chest sits on the other.  The floor is constructed from sturdy oak that is lacquered to a bright shine, its surface splattered with a rainbow of paint.  On the far side of the wagon, a small area has been sectioned off with a silk-draped archway.

title: [The Art Connection, Workroom]
description: Stacks of canvas covered in bright paints line the walls of the spacious workroom.  Several easels are set up displaying partially completed bits of art.  A pair of windows lines the walls helping a series of lamps to illuminate the space.  Splattered drop clothes cover much of the flooring and a small workbench sits at the back of the space.

title: [Twilight Incense and Lights]
description: This small space is lit with glowing lanterns that dangle from a rack that hangs from the ceiling.  An assortment of items have been placed atop a long, low mahogany table in the center of the room in front of a midnight brocade upholstered couch, both of which rest on a plush burgundy carpet that covers the floor.  Floral scents, spicy smoke, and soft luminescent light linger in the cozy confines of this intimate lounge.

title: [Caligos Clays]
description: A large, wood-fired kiln is set against the far wall in the back of this tiny space.  Tucked into one corner is a stone potter's wheel, splattered with paint and flecks of dried clay.  A broad driftwood shelf, affixed to one wall, displays the small, painted sculptures of life-like clay creatures.  A paint-smudged notice is tacked to one wall, beside a neatly lettered parchment list.

title: [Buried Tressures]
description: Once vibrant tapestries, their images now soiled and lost to mildew, cover the rotted oak floorboards partially submerged into swampy muck.  A series of modular cubbies leans against one wall, with a skeletal tree of sharpened bones beside it.  Hanging from a patinated copper rod is a shredded velvet curtain leading to the back office.

title: [Buried Tressures, Office]
description: Desiccated strips of scalp, with locks of hair still attached, hang on small hooks descending from the ceiling.  Some pillows of patchwork leather in varied tones lay scattered about the floor of broken and brittle oak boards.  A makeshift stand supports a gracefully posed, mummified carcass, with one hand pinned against its hip and the other glued against its cheek.  The sickeningly sweet smell of decay lingers in the air.

title: [What Suits Zoo, The Sea]
description: Walls of wavy streaks bear a vibrant gradient of marine colors, the lightest of which spans the ceiling with a hint of glinting sunshine.  The realistic coral reef painted along the floor never repeats as it encircles a large reef-framed glass exhibit and leads to an arch in the north wall.

title: [What Suits Zoo, The Land]
description: A small section of beach is painted underfoot before matching the ceiling and walls, which begin with bleak hues and open-sky tundra before blending into lush tones of prairie.  From there, earthy tones of clouds and rocky terrain transition to sun rays slicing into woodlands and forest, then terminate into rain-spotted jungle and tree canopy.  Past a large cedar-framed glass exhibit is an arch in the north wall.

title: [What Suits Zoo, The Air]
description: Underfoot is painted with massive branches of a tree canopy, the glimpses of the forest floor below showing detailed creatures and vegetation.  Halfway up the walls, depictions of trees rise before blending into clear skies that gradually turn cloudy, a bright sun barely peeking through from the ceiling above a large veniom-framed glass exhibit.

title: [What Suits Zoo, Backroom]
description: A sturdy cedar door anchors the bare, unpainted floor of smooth rock, which supports a large workbench bookended by heavy chests of tools and precious metals.  Various taxidermied birds of prey hang overhead from steel wire, while murals of woodland creatures, furry and scaly alike, wrap around the walls.

title: [Die Hard]
description: Slightly cramped, this whimsical shop boasts a colorful assortment of dice displayed via several trays, cases, and shelves.  The faint aroma of sandalwood wafts through the air, emanating from a simple brass censer tied to a tent pole.  A varnished walnut stand has been placed next to a canvas-covered table, upon which rests a small papyrus card in front of a large goldstone bowl.

title: [Mantle of the Elapid]
description: Plain and spartan, the lofty tent is fashioned of yellow-striped, olive green wool and supported by thick ironwood poles.  Overlapping yierka hair rugs, each woven with hypnotic patterns, cover the western side where a simple sleeping pallet rests, while the east has fine, black sand surrounding a large copper-bowled brazier.  Opposite the entry flaps, a bejeweled oak chest offers a smattering of items for sale.

title: [Delicious Magic]
description: A single lantern hangs from a hook upon the main support pole of the tent, providing illumination across the small interior.   Near the center of the tent stands a battered wood table.  A threadbare flax rug lies underneath in a halfhearted attempt to cover the rocky ground.

title: [A Modest Square Grey Linen Tent]
description: Pale ash poles lift the ceiling of the tent into four peaked corners, joined one to the other with slender framing beams, and are strung with webs of rough-spun twine between.  A narrow table sits toward the rear of the space, occupied by a row of small apothecary jars and mounted at one end by a well-used ash branch perch.  A mesh-domed cast iron brazier stands off to one corner, while a wide-lipped silver bowl cradled by a forked ash limb pedestal occupies the heart of the area.

title: [Tranquility Plaza]
description: Jungle vegetation has been cleared to reclaim this previously submerged and hidden plaza.  A half-ring of deteriorated white marble columns frames the back of a modest pool set in recently swept cobblestones and a pair of benches that provide a place for quiet contemplation.  Dense curling fern fronds enclose this restorative retreat from the bustle of the festivities outside.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cliff Trail]
description: The already treacherous walkway becomes moreso as rising steam collects on the outcropping in a low-lying mist.  At points, any hope of viewing solid footing is lost beneath the grey, leaving only a miasma of haze that slithers over the edge and into the air.  The effect is bewildering, breaths of wind stirring spectral fingers in the air as if at any moment they could reach out and snatch away the ground underfoot.

title: [Nooks and Crannies]
description: The heavy smell of leather is nearly overwhelming in the stagnant air of this small space.  A small desk and worktable sit near the rear of the store, both haphazardly covered with swatches and discarded pieces of leather.  A motley arrangement of guttering candles in simple wrought iron holders dots the walls at irregular intervals, allowing just enough light to peruse the wares for sale without revealing too much of what lies in the dusty corners.

title: [The Rakish Raven, Show Room]
description: The walls of the flannel-lined wagon are covered in well-rendered maps and spoils of war, the various items flanking a set of dark-lacquered antlers thrusting out from the fabric-covered surface.  Set below the antlers sits a tall haon-slatted desk carved with various woodland creatures, the simple writing surface covered with the faint smoke of a recently snuffed cigar.  Alternating planks of alder, blackwood, and linden cover the exposed floor, each piece burned with an artistic rendering of a vague foreign town.

title: [By Hook or By Crook]
description: Sparsely furnished, the showroom amounts to a glass display case topped with an alabaster-carved hand sculpture, the arrangement illuminated by a skylight directly overhead.  The long, thin fingers of the chiseled appendage are laden with jewelry, the mix of metals and precious stones on each ring a work of art in its own right.  A pair of straight-backed ebonwood chairs flank a door leading out back of the wagon.

title: [A Makeshift Pavilion]
description: A wide swathe of pale silks is draped from the back of a shuttered ebony wagon to the back of a pale linden wagon creating a makeshift pavilion amidst the caravan.  Underfoot, the hardpacked sand has been swept clean of all debris and plump floor cushions have been arranged atop woven jute rugs.  Tropical blooms in earthenware pots dot the perimeter, a salty seabreeze diffusing the scent of fresh hibiscus and passionflower.

title: [Promise of Winter]
description: Panels of black and white silk enclose the tent, loosely staked and left to ripple with the shifting air currents.  Sunlight filters through the gaps between them to stripe the shaded interior with light.  Wooden supports, sanded smooth but left unvarnished, frame a vaulted canopy hung with irregular droplets of frosted glass.  To one side rests a long and narrow table, while a thin, opaque curtain partially screens a shaded corner opposite the entry.

title: [Flotsam Frills]
description: Overlapping, salt-stained sailcloth panels line the high walls of the canopied area, the stony, sand-swept grounds littered with errant tendrils of curling seaweed.  A bleached driftwood case rests upon a knotted cotton carpet, behind a smaller area used for displaying wares that houses a dusky sandstone cabinet and a spindly smoky quartz rack.  Suspended overhead, an artfully tangled installation of ghostly white coral is hung at the center of the room.

title: [Burden of Beasts, Showroom]
description: A ring of black candles is evenly spaced in a circle at the edges of the tent, casting even but insufficient light over the interior.  Flickering, feeble luminescence plays over the edges of a polished altar of blue stone at the tent's center, its edges adorned with ornate carved scrollwork.  Heat from a steel brazier atop a heavy stone block holds back a chill in the air.

title: [Ancient Artifacts]
description: The hardwood flooring of this rustic wagon is comprised of nearly fully rotten beams.  A light coating of fresh straw has been strewn about haphazardly on top of the planks underfoot.  Centered in the middle of the room is a case stocked full of magical trinkets.

title: [Fashionably Belted]
description: Strewn about the wagon's innards are a variety of well-worn rugs used as flooring.  A strong smell of manure and rotting seaweed permeates the air as it wafts in from outside.  Sitting in the center of the room is a chest stocked full of belts.

title: [The Head Shop]
description: The floor is caked with undried mud while the surrounding walls are slick with soaked wet straw.  A strong smell of manure and rotting seaweed permeates the air.  Sitting in the center of the room is a chest stocked full of toys.

title: [Bags of Trrix, Entry]
description: Opposite the entrance, wallpaper patterned with draping tree branches is interrupted at irregularly spaced intervals by a plethora of polished silver hooks, most laden with a bag, pouch, sack, or other container like a ripening fruit.  A trompe l'oeil sky peeks through painted apple tree branches overhead, with clusters of tiny glowing spheres of frosted glass dotting the ceiling to mimic shafts of sunlight.  Unseen, a music box plays the tinkling notes of a drowsy aubade.

title: [Bags of Trrix, Parlor]
description: Dust obfuscates every surface in this faded room, rendering the formerly glossy dull.  A stray sunbeam bisects the room from window to door, its golden luminescence kindling motes of dust in the air into tiny flecks of swirling gilt, transmuting mundane into magic.  An overstuffed armchair rests next to an imposing tanik worktable littered with oddments and ephemera.  A precariously perched candlestick, its pricket drowned by a puddle of congealed wax that once proudly thrust its flame aloft, threatens to tumble off the worktable to an untimely demise.

title: [Fancy That]
description: The cozy cottage is furnished with aged, yet well-kept furniture and a luxurious ivory rug with a lotus flower pattern picked out in delicate blue threading.  A low mahogany settee with clawed feet is positioned near the dressing rooms and a large gown rack sits by a slender oval mirror.  An accessories table features several shoes and purses.

title: [Companion Canyon]
description: The tent is large and holds a musty, earthen smell in its partially discolored dark brown walls.  Huge wooden totems carved into the likenesses of fish-headed monsters form a half-circle in the center of the pavilion and a half-finished curtain of fish scales lies strewn over a long wooden workbench.  A few iron-bound cages are stacked in a corner of the room, each one currently empty.

title: [Ghost Sounds]
description: The bustle of the main thoroughfare presses on around three glowing ethereal music stands as a thin layer of dense fog churns underfoot.  Lingering in the air, an ethereal cittern plays an inspiring tune, though no one is there to strike its strings.

Torches and lanterns from the black sand beach below appear as tiny specks through three glowing ethereal music stands whenever the fog lifts to reveal the grandeur of the inky black sky.  Lingering in the cool, still air, an ethereal cittern plays an aimless tune, though no one is there to strike its strings.

title: [Switch Hits, Showroom]
description: Threads of ragged silk dangle from above like drifting spiderwebs.  Their slow unraveling has made a mockery of the tent's ceiling, which allows in ragged threads of sunlight to spill onto the hard-packed dirt floor below.  The fabric walls are lined with decaying shelves of burled wood, which boast a collection of incongruously well-tended wares.

title: [Flesh and Bones, Niche]
description: Created by bracing the large rib bones of some gigantic creature against the rickety walls of the hut, this secluded niche is cramped and tiny.  Shoved into one corner is an articulated dolphin skeleton, its bony body covered in draped pieces of clothing, while a squat bone armoire is crammed directly across from it.  Bones litter the floor in various places, some small and some large, while a few scattered candles in skull lanterns provide scant lighting.

title: [The Hair Apparent]
description: Constructed of stained oak panels that have seen better days, this squat building's low ceiling makes the space seem somewhat cramped.  Scattered on all of the walls are several dingy paintings, some of them hanging slightly crooked.  Taking up most of the room is a long display counter, its surface littered with wares for sale, while a swinging door leads further into the building.  The scent of strong cologne permeates the humid air.

title: [The Drunken Dagger]
description: The creaky wooden floor is covered in a putrid dark substance.  A candelabrum sits atop a large glass display case in the center of the room, showcasing several weapons that reflect the candlelight and throw shadows onto the wall.  Propped against the far corner of the room is a decaying, dagger-wielding cadaver.

title: [Dye Mad About It, Front Room]
description: Though several windows are set high on the walls of the wagon, they are rendered dysfunctional by the black paint smeared across them.  The only light comes from the mismatched paper lanterns overhead, and dangling among them is a garishly painted notice edged in tiny shiny gold pinwheels.  A shabby velvet-padded case boasting an eye-shaped sign sits on one wall opposite a dark cork head with a head-shaped sign staked in its cranium on the other.  Beneath the notice is a dingy ribbon-tied basket with a silver star-shaped sign on the handle.

title: [Dye Mad About It, Backroom]
description: One exceptionally large purple paper lantern hangs from the peak of the wagon's ceiling, with slashed vents in the orb allowing spears of light to streak across the area.  On the back wall is a glass case filled with rows and rows of glass eyes, all manner of colors accounted for, and beneath it is a table laden with bottles, bags, and beakers full of ingredients, reagents, and other indiscernible contents.  Pillows litter the floor, all shapes and shades and fabrics found among the scattered collectio

title: [The Ebon Eclipse]
description: Fine-grained dark wood spans the length of the brig's deck, highlighting a pale silken canopy suspended above half of the vessel to protect the wares for sale.  A wide, spacious forefront houses a rich black walnut cabinet and a lacquered fel marquetry wardrobe, the pair flanking a damask-motif leather trunk placed at the center.  Sleek ebon linen sails loom overhead, casting floating shadows upon everything below their cover.

title: [The Ebon Eclipse, Cabin]
description: Shadowy velveteen fabrics soften the starkness of the bare walls and darkened flooring in the modestly sized cabin.  Flickering lights rest in the hearts of vaalin-domed glass lanterns that are placed at the outer edges of the space, imparting a warm glow to the secluded atmosphere.

title: [The Lily's Grace, Deck]
description: An elaborate railing encloses the deck of the ship, and every inch of the vessel's timber construction has been polished to a high, flawless sheen.  Overhead, the mast balances the bundled weight of the striped buff and ultramarine sails, while a simple banner of the same colors flies over the crow's nest.  Set into the face of the upper deck, under the watch of the ship's wheel, is a sturdy round-windowed door leading down below.

title: [The Lily's Grace, Below Deck]
description: Gold-set oil lamps hang between the windows, casting the area with a warm light that gilds the oak of the walls and furnishings.  Set perpendicular to the windows and nestled against the wall is a long golden oak bar laid out with a variety of drinks and edibles, while a glass-framed wall case hangs opposite.  Beneath the case is an octangular oak pedestal table, and across the way, an archway leads eastward and further into the ship.

title: [The Lily's Grace, Below Deck]
description: A tiered oaken rack rests between a pair of cobalt-curtained windows that offer a view of the port outside, flanked to one side by a carved oak armoire and to the other by a set of golden oak hooks.  A deep blue carpeted runner extends from the archway to the west to an elaborately carved oak door across the way.

title: [The Lily's Grace, Lounge]
description: Against the back wall of this modestly sized cabin is a set of bookshelves that rise to the ceiling from the wall-to-wall cabinet upon which they sit.  Several richly cushioned chairs of golden oak and blue velvet are scattered throughout the remainder of the available space, all arranged so as to offer a comfortable view out of the cobalt-curtained bay window.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Market Gates]
description: Wayfarers transporting an exotic cornucopia of wares drift in from the port area, narrowing outside a set of towering rosewood gates that are flanked by wandering street vendors.  The wintry mix underfoot is trampled to icy slush on the silvered cobblestones that pave the way towards a lively marketplace bedecked in tiny, jewel-colored lights.

title: [Birds of Paradise, Parlour]
description: Thin slats of bamboo line the walls of the shop, the pieces occasionally curtained by trails of citrus-scented incense emanating from around a crystalline open palm.  Atop a driftwood table, a blue-speckled orange enamel hibiscus lays next to an ivory-carved alligator bowl, the creature's eyes inset with faceted cabochons of citrine.

title: [Decadent Dreams]
description: A rainbow canopy covers this open-air booth with great swathes of fabric dripping in a carnival-like display at each of the four corners.  There is a glass case filled with candy which serves as the focal point of the small structure.  A slight breeze keeps the air inside the booth moving, subtly tickling the senses with the fulsome scent of dark chocolate.  The floor underneath has been polished to an intensely bright white, and tasteful lamps supplement the natural lighting without overwhelming it.

title: [A Taste of Tranquility]
description: The inside of this cheerfully appointed wagon is surprisingly spacious.  The walls are painted a pale goldenrod and artfully decorated with framed paintings, in various sizes, of bucolic landscapes.  The sweet smell of fresh-cut flowers suffuses the wagon, mingling with the robust fragrance of various aromatic teas wafting deliciously on the air.  Small tables dressed in fine linen, set with silver, and hosting elegantly carved wooden chairs, are carefully situated in the middle of the space.

title: [A Taste of Tranquility, Kitchen]
description: The plain white walls of this cozy kitchen are lined with drying racks covered in a wide variety of fragrant herbaceous leaves.  A half-completed project clutters a sturdy wooden counter near the back of the room.

title: [If The Shoe Fits, Studio]
description: A sun-bleached mat of woven rushes, curling slightly at one corner, lies in front of a whitewashed mistwood counter stacked high with various fabrics.  To one side, some baskets spattered with bright colors are arranged next to a cabinet, its doors removed and tossed nearby in a corner.  A banana plant in a terracotta pot is framed by a small window with thick panes of tinted blue glass, the leaves of the plant reaching towards the light.

title: [If The Shoe Fits, Storage]
description: A faint tropical scent fills the air around a glass display case.  Atop the case is a centerpiece comprised of hollow coconut shells stuffed with potpourri.  In one corner, a rope net hammock, filled with colorful silk pillows and strung from large hooks in the ceiling, hangs over a salt-stained trunk, its lid cracked and handles missing.  Some shoes and sandals, badly in need of repair, are piled next to a low dark steel workbench with a leather-covered stool positioned in front.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Courtyard]
description: The advancing crowd thins out suddenly past the towering gates, providing ample room for an ornate half-moon courtyard plated in celestial blue tilework.  Tiered levels of curiously inventive ice-glazed sculptures are tiered along the edges of the wide-open space, abruptly ending at a lattice-gated veil iron portcullis.  Nestled between two tightly spaced wagons, a spirited patch of dark green leaflets has sprouted up through the heavy quilt of snow.

title: [Cavernhold]
description: The austere wagon has a perimeter of metal wall hooks displaying the general garments out for sale.  A crooked wooden rack rests near the entry door, surrounded by a scattering of dark liquidy stains and smudged footprints on the floor around it.

title: [The Pack Man]
description: Towers of various boxes stacked floor to ceiling create a winding maze that's been illuminated with glowing toadstools placed at even intervals along the path.  Some maoral coffers and iron chests are stacked to form opposing walls around a crowded toadstool-lit table strewn with leather items of all shades.  Drawers fill an entire wall down one path that stretches into the darkness.  Scents of old wood and musty carpet mingle in the mote-filled air of this cramped, gloomy labyrinth.

title: [Forging Ahead]
description: Black invar sconces are lit behind crimson-colored draped canvas near the top of the walls, giving the showroom a dim, red glow.  Displayed on the west wall are several hangers of goods and a trunk opened wide for curious customers.  On the north wall hangs a rack made of hammered steel, more than sturdy enough for its contents.  Almost hidden behind the drapes on the east wall is a curtain made of the same canvas, adorned with images of black hammers and anvils.

title: [Forging Ahead, Anvil Room]
description: A small forge set on the far end of the room heats the area to a toasty, but comfortable degree, the hearth glowing reddish orange from the coals within.  A variety of well-maintained swages, hammers, fullers, chisels, bits, and other assorted tools rest above the furnace in an organized fashion.  In the center of the room lies an anvil the size of a small table, its surface clearly used, but in otherwise good condition.  A draped anvil-stitched curtain hangs nearby as a ready exit.

title: [Mellow Mushrooms]
description: The dark oak-paneled walls glow faintly blue, the luminescence cast from fungi-filled earthenware pots stationed around the room.  Bushel-sized wooden baskets clutter a long counter to one side, while bundles of herbs dangle from the low ceiling on strings.  The air is rich with the scent of wet dirt and mushrooms.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Makiri Market]
description: At the edge of the bazaar the storefronts are squarer, and the architecture is much simpler in design, but showy finery prevails in the elaborate scrollwork and vibrant coloring of the window displays.  One central shop draws inspiration from the shore, brandishing iridescent mother-of-pearl and sea glass mosaic panels around the doorway.

title: [Sew Nice, Gallery]
description: An expansive braided rug of eggplant silk stretches across the oak floor to protect it from the feet of the various display racks and tables filling the area.  A shoe rack is carefully cradled beneath a linen-draped display table where several accessories are available to purchase.  Nearby, a curved brass display rack proudly displays several dresses.  A jeweled door leads back out to the market.

title: [Sew Nice, Alcove]
description: A broad leather couch takes up the majority of the back wall in the alcove, allowing for plenty of seating.  A variety of sewing tools occupy a small work table pushed off to one side.

title: [Grubbe Hub]
description: Chain-strung lanterns hang unlit above the earthen-walled dwelling.  A lopsided wooden table stands across the cramped room from a filthy glass-covered counter.  Floating in through a small round window, the salty air mingles with the scents of recently prepared dishes.  Nailed into the hardened dirt walls, a wrinkled folded notecard appears closely guarded by a heavily armored kobold.

title: [Mechanicool]
description: The constant ticking of gears reverberates faintly throughout the wide tent as the warm light from nearby candles dances along the polished metal-plated edge of a shelf.  A wide metal cabinet dominates a corner of the room and towers in comparison to the miniature crystal case beside it.  The faint aroma of oil hangs in the air.

title: [Survive and Thrive]
description: The shop is comprised of wood-paneled walls, their surface smooth and lacquered to a nice shine.  The air is infused with the mixed aroma of various musky fragrances and weapon oil.  Upon the wall is a series of mounted heads, each one carefully stuffed and preserved.  A low oak counter stretches across the shop, bordered by rows of driftwood shelves.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Makiri Market]
description: The piercing snaps of assorted shop banners peel in the volatile sea winds, coaxing the eye to some rear entrances that are kaleidoscopically painted in all manner of colors, languages, and implausible feats of anatomy, though no individual message is even remotely discernable.  Raucous shouts briefly punctuate a delicately lilting background melody, as one of the doors of a high-reaching gold and ivory lighthouse bangs open, then steadily sweeps the laughter away as it eases shut.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Lighthouse Pub]
description: Crescent-shaped tables and some curving birchwood benches fill the grand circular room at the base of the lighthouse.  Winding stairs climb the structure in a spiral to the top, while torch-bright sconces ring the space with cheerful light, supplemented by a brick-faced fireplace placed behind a lacquered walnut and mahogany bar.  Squeezed onto a small side stage, a disparate band of musicians circulates in and out of the pub, playing a boundless profusion of merry, foot-tapping music.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Lantern Room]
description: The cylindrical glassed-in structure is supported by vertical bars of gleaming vultite and crowned with an intricate cupola roof.  Dominating the majority of the space, an immense adamantine-framed crystalline lens is brightly illumined by a flock of glowing white gold lanterns.  Tucked into a narrow outer corridor, a rainbow glaes-paned door sits next to some winding stairs that descend back to the pub below.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Gallery]
description: Encircling the open platform is an elaborate veil iron cagework of celestial designs and patterns, backlit from the central glow of the lantern room.  Bracingly chilly winds whip through the airy, high-placed balcony, carrying with it the refreshingly mild scents of salt and snow.  Eye-catching moonlit waves unfurl like overlapping midnight blue petals across the all-encompassing sea that surrounds the coast.

title: [Nice To Be Hair, Showroom]
description: Black stripes have been painted upon the bright orange walls in a wavy pattern to elicit the appearance of a tiger's distinctive fur.  Cushions of bright, sunny yellow velvet add pops of color to otherwise simple wooden stands displaying this showroom's wares.  The heady fragrances of tuberose, chocolate, and amber drift in from every nook and cranny.

title: [Nice To Be Hair, Showroom]
description: A platinum chandelier with variegated pearl droplets illuminates this portion of the wagon, casting light upon the metallic-sheened cheetah print walls.  In one corner, a golden metal rack has been inset with a number of multi-hued crystals, while on the opposite side stands an unopened case of sparkling blush wine.

title: [Nice To Be Hair, Salon]
description: Vibrant fuchsia pillars are spaced regularly around this ostentatious salon which has been painted dark magenta with silver-lined leopard spots.  The stylized, butterfly-like eyelashes painted on the polished white floor are echoed in many mismatched argent mirrors suspended from the network of platinum chains criss-crossing the ceiling.  Slender pedestals of carved crystal display a menagerie of bejeweled cages.

title: [Moomph's Picklearium]
description: Golden oak walls enclose this space, brightening the decor, which is primarily composed of varying shades of dark green found in everything from the rugs underfoot to the curtains framing the windows.  The walkway is edged on both sides with floor-to-ceiling shelving that is, in turn, lined with lidded glass jars and dishes of all sizes and shapes.  Above the arch leading deeper into the shop is a gold-lettered banner that reads, "Welcome to Moomph's Picklearium!"

title: [Moomph's Picklearium]
description: Oak sideboards set with an arrangement of glass-covered platters and trays, along with some covered wide-lipped bowls, stand along the circumference of this small area, and the scent of vinegar lingers in the air.  A green-curtained window on the back wall stands open just a bit to let in a breath of fresh air.

title: [A Silver-Traced Ebonwood Wagon]
description: The enclosing ebonwood walls bear a coat of matte lacquer, dulling the gloss to a subtle but refined sheen under the touch of flickering lantern light cast from behind cut glass shades.  Underfoot, plush plum carpeting quiets every footfall, and warped shafts of pale moonlight are painted across it by the whorled crystal windows set near the ceiling.  Between the windows hangs a wall-mounted velvet-lined case with a small parchment note attached, and beneath it is a finely scripted parchment sign in a silver frame.

title: [A Silver-Traced Ebonwood Wagon]
description: Facing off from opposite sides of the wagon are a sturdy wall-bracketed stand housing a variety of polearms and a wide floor-to-ceiling sword rack laden with goods.  A finely scripted parchment sign in a silver frame stands sentinel beside the ebonwood door set into the rear wall, and distorted shafts of light snake across the plum carpeting from the whorled crystal windows set near the ceiling.

title: [A Silver-Traced Ebonwood Wagon]
description: This compartment is fairly spacious and well-appointed, with an aubergine velvet sofa sitting adjacent to a glass-topped ebonwood sideboard which is lined with open-faced shelves occupied by fine decanters and glasses.  The floor is covered wall-to-wall with thick plum-hued carpeting, and lanterns with cut glass shades are mounted periodically along the walls.

title: [Tunnel Vision]
description: The tent's domed roof is haphazardly reinforced with crossing wooden beams.  The floor is dusty, as is the dark invar trunk that sits off to one side of the area, beneath a pair of shrunken troll heads.  The top of a dented weapon rack is wedged between two of the overhead beams.

title: [Tunnel Vision]
description: A long pole holds the ceiling higher in this part of the tent, allowing for extra space for an elaborate runestaff lathe.  An oak-framed sign hangs crookedly from a hook on a wrought iron staff rack.

title: [Tunnel Vision]
description: A few carelessly tossed rugs cover the dirty floor, though they themselves are soiled by muddy footprints.  A dusty bin has been filled nearly to overflowing; some of the goods have been propped against a large shovel stuck in the ground next to it, and appear to be ready to topple out at any moment.

title: [Tunnel Vision]
description: The tent's ceiling slopes dramatically downward, ending at the point where a large spike holds the canvas firmly in the ground.  A lopsided workbench is covered with a layer of ash and dust, although the goods sitting upon it seem relatively clean.  Some long nails have been hammered into a large chunk of glaes-veined granite.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Makiri Market]
description: A jagged overhang crested with glittering ice shards is angled in such a manner that it casts a darkened canopy over several shops and wagons falling in its wake.  Slicing through a craggy lower shelf of rock recessed in the northern cliffs, a vivid blue-green channel of color reveals itself to be the feathery boughs of spruce trees peeking out from beneath the alabaster snow.

title: [Facing the Elements]
description: Constructed from frosted glass blocks, the interior of the wagon resembles an icy igloo.  Thick furs cover the floor in front of a small woodstove, the crackling fire within warming the air while giving off a crisp, smoky pine aroma.  A wooden rack stands next to a large iron hook sunk deep into the frosted glass block wall.

title: [Facing the Elements, Outfitters]
description: Behind a small privacy screen, racks of heavy clothing line the glass block walls.  To one side, a polished wood table has been ransacked, the once neatly folded textiles appearing now as a pile of laundry.  A selection of gowns has been carefully laid across a long glass display case.

title: [Halfway There]
description: The interior of the leather and cameline tent is hung with colorful stained glass lanterns that shine warm light into a small oak storage chest with wares for sale.  Toward the back, a brightly beaded suede flap is draped with cozy swathes of knitted purple wool and sashed with ribbons.

title: [The Down 'N Dirty, Cargo]
description: The inside of the wagon hosts an assortment of goods and minimal furniture arranged into organized chaos.  Windowless, the interior is lit by a pair of ceiling-mounted crystals, radiating enough illumination to see featured merchandise, but not enough to detail the messy perimeter.  Abutting a random pile of items stands a collapsible monir crate on a retractable mount, jutting out from a like-sized floor opening.  A couple feet above the crate, a braided hemp string dangles from a lightweight hook.

title: [The Down 'N Dirty, Compartment]
description: The walls of the crowded compartment resemble the compressible seals of a giant bellows.  A single translucent citrine-hued crystal dangles from a bronze hook, illuminating the cramped yet clutter-free workspace.

title: [Banish The Cold, Supply]
description: A blanket of warmth swaddles the dimly lantern-lit shop, emanating from braziers spaced across the smooth sandstone floor.  Oil lanterns and candles are concentrated to showcase an invar-pegged display and granite stand to the right of the entrance and a large metal rack to the left.  The occasional drip of falling water and subsequent sizzle of steam echo from the unlit periphery.

title: [Banish The Cold, Workshop]
description: Away from the periphery of darkness, a lone sandstone slab protrudes from the floor within the brightly lit center of the room.  High above the slab is an invar ventilation shaft surrounded by quartz and glaes lanterns.  A gust of rushing wind occasionally reverberates down from the invar shaft.

title: [Mysteries of Mana, Pavilion]
description: Multicolored silk with a texture like flowing water enshrouds a small space broken by a widowwood display case.  Suspended from the tent supports above, small pierced silver spheres hold beeswax votives that cast the surroundings in a hazy incandescence.  A circular Tehir rug, bright with bandings of red and gold and green, cushions the ground.  There are bright-colored pillows scattered about the edges of a small nook formed by a bend in the tent's fabric.

title: [Mysteries of Mana, Nook]
description: Flowing silk drapes over the area, vividly blue like the ocean on a clear day.  A few crates of wares and supplies are stacked heavily in the corner.  Otherwise, the area is oddly empty.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Makiri Market]
description: Glimmering multicolored lights scallop the shutters of the brightly painted shop facades running down the lane in oblong boxes, many of the decorated doors festively hung with intricately wovens knots of hemlock and pine.  Past the lot's outermost corner, a hedgerow of coral red flowering quince serves as a natural fence encircling a stone-inlaid courtyard.

title: [Ne'amyrana]
description: The spacious wagon's lofty walls are blanketed in smooth sheets of flyrsilk that are woven throughout with intensely pallid floral patterns, starkly contrasting with the deeply colored rosewood beams that peak overhead.  A fine-grained white monir reliquary emerges from the back, accented by a spiraling presentation of pale beeswax candles that washes the space in golden light and undulating shadows.

title: [Yllyc Flyr]
description: Only glimpses of the white velvet shell of the tent can be seen beyond the jewel-toned flyrsilk swathes that drape from the willow supports overhead to enclose this area.  Fresh winter roses are set in crystalline bowls here and there on tables, lending their heady scent to the air, which is warmed by a smokeless brazier in the center of the floor.  A tiered display sits on one side of the curtained archway that leads further into the tent and a slender willow cloak rack sits on the other.

title: [Yllira Sutara, Showroom]
description: Light from several crystal lamps bathes the spacious pavilion in a warm glow.  Brilliant amaranthine wool felt lines the walls helping to keep warm air inside.  Several racks of instruments placed about the shop show off their masterfully crafted wares.  Resting on a mistwood stand is an ivory parchment.

title: [Yllira Sutara, Showroom]
description: Walls of warm wool felt patterned in rich jewel tones of burgundy, emerald, and sapphire blue hang from a silvery beech frame.  Ornate crystal globes hang from the ceiling, each etched with a detailed pattern of roses.  A thick velvet curtain is flanked by a slender polished oak stand and an etched glass case.

title: [Flyr Tara, Indoor Garden]
description: Thick moss-hued wool felt lines the walls of this spacious tent.  Temporary beds have been set up about the perimeter, each filled with a variety of blooming flowers.  A carved wooden bench sits in the center of the area, its surface covered with a display of gems and beads.  Covered in clear waxed parchment, a skylight is set in the mistwood-framed roof allowing bright moonlight to filter in.

title: [Flyr Tara, Indoor Garden]
description: Centered in the room is a white marble water garden that surrounds a beautifully carved dragonfly with water spouting from its head.  A wide assortment of plants grow in the warm pool, their vibrant blossoms a kaleidoscope of color.  Several braziers are lit about the perimeter, filling the tent with warm, humid air.  A small wooden table is set to the side, its surface covered with a variety of metal wires.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Tilaok Terrace]
description: The arboreal crush of the hinterlands serenely blends a neutral palette of the deepest viridian with more subtle touches of chestnut, fawn, and umber.  Fierce, inbound gusts of sea air glide over impressive snowbanks that have accumulated around errant stone fragments, their untouched surfaces lightly glinting in a wash of glassy argent motes.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Tilaok Terrace]
description: Trussed in purple-tinged ivy, an eye-catching series of bowed yew trellises are encompassed by a dense copse of flourishing witch hazel trees that drip with spidery gold-crimson flowers.  The dramatic colorscape is intensified by the niveous slate of snow and ice blanketing the rough terrain.

title: [Carry On, Entry]
description: A thick, crimson rug stretches across the rough-hewn plank floor.  Bolted into the back wall is a polished brass rod, its contents held safely off the ground.  A trio of tall gold-framed mirrors occupy one corner, positioned at precise angles to allow for optimal preening.  A pair of eahnor-caged lanterns frame a polished oak door carved with dragonstalks, and a lacquered oak rack serves as the centerpiece for the room.

title: [Carry On, Lounge]
description: Inset into the westernmost wall is a small riverstone fireplace, a large pile of wooden sticks close at hand.  A comfortable distance away sits a plush crimson velvet sofa lofted on rounded, polished mahogany feet.  Taking up the entirety of the southern wall is a cushioned velvet bench, and a tall silver-framed mirror is nestled into one corner.

title: [Carry On, East Wing]
description: A pair of eahnor-caged lanterns frame the open doorway that leads back toward the main section of the cabin.  Centered along the easternmost wall is a glass-topped table supported by artfully carved spindly oak legs.  A glass showcase stretches along the northern wall, and a tall oak-framed mirror is pushed into a corner.

title: [Win Or Lose, Showroom]
description: Suits of matching plate armor stand sentry along opposing walls, each no taller than an elven child.  Centered along the back wall is a suit of burnished crimson field plate.  An elegant banner covers the wall behind the lone armor.  A long wooden shelf and a glass-paneled case flank the open walnut door.  Stretched across the polished walnut floor is a gold-edged deep crimson rug.

title: [Wine About It, Interior]
description: Soft light filters down from glowing orbs overhead, bathing the interior of the wagon in afternoon tones.  A long wooden counter has been stacked high with various bins holding a variety of grapes and other ingredients.  An artistic gnomish wine press rests at the end of the counter, the strange apparatus gleaming in the ambient light.  A woven reed basket nearby holds some finished wines.

title: [Over Yander, Goods]
description: The sides of the covered wagon have been folded down, providing a sturdy shelf on which goods are displayed.  Several crates, barrels, and tubs have been placed near the rear of the wain, and hold a variety of products for sale.  Twin brass braziers flank a series of wooden steps leading to the interior of the schooner, providing both light and heat for patrons.

title: [Over Yander, Interior]
description: Tawny canvas, stretched taut over metal ribs, keeps the interior of this covered wagon dry and comfortable.   A weapon rack and an armor stand dominate the cramped space, leaving little room for browsing.  A small wooden seat has been built into the far end of the schooner, providing a rough resting place for patrons.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Tilaok Terrace]
description: Outdoor copper braziers splutter and cough as their fires sink lower, expelling more noise from their kindling than warmth, but still adding a much needed luminosity to the drab, snow-packed environs.  Wreaths of heather grey smoke collect under the eaves of the stores, casually released by prying zephyrs before wafting off into the darkness.

title: [A Great Offense]
description: Stained fel boards line the floor of the wagon, covered by a deep emerald rug.  A large cottonwood cabinet stands along one wall, while a low pine shelf hangs along the middle of the opposite wall.

title: [A Great Offense]
description: The plush emerald green rug covers most of the fel wood that form the floor of the wagon.  Placed up against one wall is a long birch table, while a tall sycamore display and a thin pine rack line the opposite.  A scratched kelyn hatch leads into the rear of the wagon.

title: [A Great Offense, Storage]
description: Boxes and crates are stacked haphazardly along the walls of this storage area.  The area in one corner remains vacant of clutter, save for a padded beech bench and a small lumpy cot sitting perpendicular to each other.  A burnished bronze lamp hangs on the wall barely a foot above the cot.

title: [Of Sand and Sea]
description: The peaked ceiling of the pavilion is held aloft by a series of interlocking bracers and beams, from which dangle strings of hollowed glaes orbs illuminated from within by tiny candles.  Though each is small, the tiny candle flames have warmed the air, and the spicy-sweet scents of cardamom and vanilla waft throughout the area.  A brass-hinged trunk sits open off to one side of the walkway, while a crooked tree branch boasting bronze hooks is mounted along one linen wall, displaying a variety of goods.

title: [Of Sand and Sea, Workroom]
description: From a censer set upon a small altar at the rear of the pavilion, the scents of cardamom and vanilla fill the air with a smoky redolence, and the warm amber light from the glaes orbs dangling overhead is made soft and suffuse by the tendrils of pale incense.  Colorful rugs and pillows are scattered across the floor, and a variety of exotic skins and hides are draped across the support beams above.

title: [Everything Under the Sun]
description: A silk canopy hangs high overhead, supported by stained oak poles along the pavilion's perimeter.  Running the length of one wall stands a polished applewood table, its finely crafted wares on display.  A plush blue Vornavian silk carpet lays underfoot, providing comfortable footing, and extends along the ground into the other parts of the pavilion.

title: [Everything Under the Sun]
description: Several lanterns hang from above on the pavilion's support poles, providing illumination and casting pale light over everything.  Most of this area is open, with a carved mistwood display and a golden oak rack sitting several feet apart in the center.  Standing alone along one wall is a small faewood table.  A plush silk runner continues to lead deeper into the pavilion.

title: [Everything Under the Sun]
description: Flower pots are scattered along the silk walls, their floral blooms bringing their sweet scent and dashes of color throughout the area.  A heavy maoral table with thick round legs takes up a massive part of one wall, while opposite sits a large carved pearwood wine rack.  A blue and gold chain curtain hangs down from the ceiling and leads into the rear of the pavilion.

title: [Everything Under the Sun]
description: Light and noise faintly filters through the curtain into this quiet corner of the pavilion.  Comfortable green and white velvet cushions lay atop the plush Vornavian silk carpet, while some supple leather couches line the walls in a horseshoe pattern.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Tilaok Terrace]
description: The eastern landscape opens to an exhibition of softly sloping valleys and rolling hillsides, the eburnean snowfall dappled with charcoal and ashen pockets that resemble a falcon's coloring.  Sparking with an occasional pop of red-orange embers, a crackling maplewood bonfire burns with incandescent white hot flames, positioned as a barrier between the grounds and enclosing wilderness.

title: [Sister Olba's Wandering Wagon]
description: Affixed to the glossy, stained walls are blue shelves on one side, with green shelves on the other, all bracketed above large, sealed barrels.  The pathway connecting the rear of the wagon to the front door has been lined with a number of vibrant square rugs in greens and blues.

title: [Sister Olba's Wandering Wagon]
description: Moonlight filters in through a skylight in the wagon's ceiling, shining upon the wares on some wide wooden shelves.  Several charcoal renderings of foreign landscapes have been set into simple frames and hung upon the walls.  A gleaming gold horseshoe has been hammered into the lintel above a round wooden door.

title: [Sister Olba's Wandering Wagon]
description: Cozy, but not cramped, the backroom of the wagon features a plush oval rug patterned with stylized starbursts of azure, viridian, and amethyst.  A small antique table and chair have been set in front of a moss-curtained portion of wall.  Several small travelling chests occupy space along the other walls.  Fragrant incense drifts out of an ornate censer hung from the ceiling.

title: [Knead to Relax]
description: Pale shafts of sunlight filter in through the tent opening, allowing warmth into the small room.  A slate sign is displayed near  holding a variety of drinks.  A large woven basket filled with freshly made food is placed at the far end of the counter, near a polished silver tray.

title: [Borthuum Company Toy Shop]
description: Whitewashed rafters crisscross the ceiling of this clean squarish shop, terminating at similarly treated walls that enclose the neat space.  Centrally located, a sizable table displays a model volcano decorated with colorful pinwheels.  Above the display, cloud shapes hang from the rafters overhead with a variety of toy airships floating weightlessly between them.  A large window faces the plaza outside.  The shop is fairly quiet as few patrons come and go.

title: [Stomp Around]
description: The cramped quarters of this small market stall are stuffed chock-a-block with heavy boots of myriad sizing, which look to fit from the smallest of halflings to the largest of giantkin.  A makeshift counter, a heavy oak door laid across two splintering crates, appears ready to collapse under a mountain of footwear at any moment, and a sloppily scrawled sign hangs from a bent hobnail.

title: [Rose Couture, Show Room]
description: Moonlight highlights the stylized designs across the trefoil-arched windows, the stained glass casting muted colors across their surfaces.  A wrought alum filigree tray is flanked on either side by a tall flora-filled display and crystalline carafes, the items displayed upon a rectangular ebonwood table in the center of the circular room.  Caught high above the room is a tangled chandelier of faenor leaves and carved onyx roses, the fixture interspersed with softly glowing pillar candles.

title: [The Alabaster Rose, Display]
description: Rich sapphire wool hangs from the white oak frame of this spacious pavilion.  A chandelier set with frosted globes hangs from the peaked ceiling, each orb etched with a blooming rose.  Soft ivory velvet drapes frame an archway that leads deeper into the shop, while matching wool carpeting underfoot muffles all sound.  A dark iron rack filled with elegant gowns is displayed in the center of the space.

title: [The Alabaster Rose, Salon]
description: Dark sapphire motes add color to the thick ivory wool carpet that cushions the floor.  To one side of the entrance is a small white oak table that holds a variety of refreshments.  A woven basket of sticks rests next to an ornate copper brazier placed centrally in the room.  A large sofa padded with dark blue cushions and a pair of chairs are placed in a circular pattern about the room.  Standing next to an etched vaalin-framed mirror is a dressing room door.

title: [Flip It Around, Showroom]
description: Lining one wall of the spacious wagon is a series of marble-topped shelves elegantly displaying pieces of glittering jewelry.  Alabaster and sapphire silk bunting draped from the rafters above creates an elegant canopy.  Standing to one side of a carved mistwood door is a small table neatly stacked with a variety of jewelry pouches, while a small vaalin-framed sign hangs to the other.

title: [Flip It Around, Secluded Nook]
description: Filtering through the skylight above, beams of pale light illuminate the small area inside the wagon.  Various tools and materials are neatly placed on the surface of a clean, polished table.  Several cushioned benches are scattered around the thick wool carpet that covers the floor.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Lattice Archway]
description: Tucked in the nooks and crevices of a collapsed cavern wall that skirts the ascending rocky heights, spiny lichens dress the woodsy ground before a tapered path in hints of subtle yellow, grey-violet, and frosty emerald.  In an astonishing feat of artistry, the flexuous branches of aged ironwood trees are trained into a colossal interlocking archway of latticed knotwork.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Snow Shrines]
description: Rivulets of ice and frost-crested mosses pool in the clefts of a flinty precipice that extends over the briar-filled provincial lands past the settlement.  A pair of indentations are worked into the adjacent cavern's rubble as high-placed graduated shelves; the first a darker stone inset with sparkling grey-banded striations, and the second a lighter ashen cream fraught with pearlescent inclusions.  Shivering with silver-white flame, countless nacreous tealights dot each footpath beneath the twin shrines.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Bazaar]
description: The fragmented remnants of a fallen cavern wall skirt the edges of a tapered path with an austere, stony backdrop.  Hanging gilded lanterns cast a warm glow from beneath the variegated awnings that line a narrow-laned bazaar full of vibrant and engaging storefronts.  Floating intermittently on the swirling breeze, the smoky aroma of burning cedarwood punctuates the crisp chill in the air.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Bazaar]
description: Frost-crested stones are artfully positioned along the decorative perimeter of the curving path, flanking a swirling sea glass mosaic that is firmly pressed into the central walkway.  The ornamentation terminates abruptly at a dense thicket of cypress trees, and the lively market area ahead widens into a section with plentiful wares.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Bazaar]
description: Jewels and fabrics gleam against a bevy of other merchandise, the assortment of goods teetering on the brink of overwhelming the slightly confined passage.  Sapphire, emerald, and ruby lights are strewn cheerfully across every exposed portion of the shopping structures, their soft radiance dappling the icy street with hints of reflected color.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Bazaar]
description: Divided into two lanes of commerce that face each other in mirrored exuberance, the pathway tapers slightly and follows a subtle bend that closer approaches the craggy hillsides beyond.  Overflowing tables and shipping crates are stacked besides the storefronts, just behind the more eye-catching displays that are attractively arranged for passing customers.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Bazaar]
description: The bustling noises of the more populated areas in the strip quiet somewhat at the dead end of the market path.  A crackling bonfire of cedar and birch logs is highlighted at the center of the vicinity, encircled by citrine-caged globes that burn brightly from above with amber-hued flame.  Abundant piles of cavern rock and gravely debris are pushed back against the sides of a massive boulder that still stands in front of a jagged hillside.

title: [Vesiwith's Maps & Oddities]
description: In the dim light provided by a pale blue orb that flickers in and out of existence in the center of the room, it is difficult to make out much of your surroundings.  Unstable stacks of various boxes reach from floor to ceiling, threatening to fall upon those who dare to get too close.  Dilapidated wooden shelves sit empty and line the walls, while a wobbly oak case and a rickety haon table sit nestled against an antiquated and dusty counter; a faded handwritten sign hangs crookedly between them.

title: [Maps & Oddities, Study]
description: Unsteady wooden tables are haphazardly arranged throughout this chamber, each topped with varying amounts of assorted scrolls, tomes, drawings, and burning candles.  Many maps are hung along the cedar walls, each with detailed notes pinned around them.  A cherrywood display case and a small oak table rest off by themselves flanking one of the corners, each with two brightly lit candles allowing ample light to study what is within and on them.

title: [Maps & Oddities, Atelier]
description: Dissimilar to the rest of the shop, this area has been kept in great shape.  Sturdy shelves line two of the walls from floor to ceiling in this quaint space, stuffed with tomes, maps, notes, and drawings.  Several desks bearing various tinctures of colorful inks, assortments of parts, and half-finished maps are clustered together in the center of the room.  A makeshift bed that is neatly made sits against a wall decorated in depictions of various creatures; a pair of slippers rest at its base.

title: [Behind the Veil, Oddments]
description: Sputtering candles hanging from brass sconces provide scant light in the cluttered entrance to the pavilion.  Layered yierka hides covered with indecipherable chalk markings provide shelter from the wind, though some occasional snowflakes drift through the entrance flap.  A wooden plank resting upon overturned hay-packed crates forms an impromptu shelf against the back wall, and several wire baskets hang from the ceiling suspended by lengths of knotted rope.

title: [Behind the Veil, Storage]
description: Crates packed with colorful textiles litter the carpeted floor.  Gaps in the yierka hide walls allow for occasional muted light to play across ahmdir blue bolts of ridgeweaver silk and simple homespun linens.  An old wooden loom is set against the back wall, flanked on one side by a rickety wooden mannequin and the other by a hay-stuffed linen mannequin.

title: [Sweet Nothings]
description: This tiny hut is stuffed floorboards to rafters with whistling, spinning, clanging contraptions.  Sweet and savory smells collide in a cascade of appealing aromas as they billow from the myriad of pressure pots and steaming cauldrons.  Bronze pipes running along the walls rattle at regular intervals as streams of steam spurt from loose fittings.  A long counter boasts several large jars of interesting looking confections.

title: [Cutlass & Crewe's]
description: Several banners hang from the walls, which are also strung with festive garland dotted with flickering crystalline globes.  A matching weapon case and rack stand on either side of a small solstice tree, and a long cedar table displays its wares in orderly rows next to a sturdy sailcloth curtain.  Underneath, resting on the polished teak and cedar floor, is a large ebonwood trunk.

title: [Crewe's Quarters]
description: Sparse and tidy, the room is part living quarters and part workshop.  A small teak writing desk sits next to a bed inset into the back corner, and a single banner hangs near a dark plaid and sailcloth curtain leading back to the main shop.  The eastern wall is covered with precisely patterned wild briars wrapping themselves around a sturdy leather trunk embossed with an onyx kraken and twining across the ceiling to frame a small skylight.  Myriad blossoms are closed up tight against the night, but dotted amidst the sharp briars, brilliant white flowers gleam in the starlight.

title: [Seaside Seers, Amber and Agate]
description: Myriad racks and tables clutter the pavilion with wares spilling out everywhere.  Resting dangerously close to a tiny heated stove, a solstice tree brushes against a ragged and dangling banner.  Dozens of crystal balls teeter atop a stack of summoning tomes, and swathes of silk in various hues randomly decorate the canvas walls.

title: [Seaside Seers, Jasper and Jade]
