description: Large swathes of multi-hued silk and velvet cloth cover the walls, draped with mithril chains dangling an assortment of well-used wands and divination cards.  Hanging from the ceiling, a rickety wooden orrery with dusty gemstone moons casts a flickering shadow across a mahogany chest and a matching jewelry case.  Tucked into one corner is a salt-stained velvet and silk curtain adorned with hundreds of beads.

title: [The Bramble Staff]
description: Deep gold draperies edged in royal blue line the walls keeping any outside light from reaching within.  Several carefully placed sconces and candelabras fully illuminate the room, leaving no shadows and creating an ideal space for showcasing the array of wares filling the various tables and display cases.  A swirling green vortex churns between the oddly extended and bent sides of a sturdy cedar weapon stand and a cedar weapon rack, placed in such a way that the two points of each meet at an apex in the middle to contain the anomaly.

title: [The Bramble Staff, Workroom]
description: This small room is cast mostly in shadows with the exception being a brightly lit table covered in woodworking supplies that fills the middle of the room with a tall stool half-tucked under the edge.  The rest of the room is packed full of haphazardly stacked crates, cluttered shelves, and overflowing barrels containing every imaginable material needed to craft staffs.  Mounted on the wall just behind the worktable is an expertly crafted bramble runestaff that seems out of place in the chaotic workroom.

title: [Tenys' Trading, Frontroom]
description: The scent of green wood permeates the main room of this wagon.  Though sturdily crafted of excellent timber, its design is simple and rustic.  Two small windows adorn each side wall, their shutters shut tight against the cold.  A narrow table sits nearby displaying wares and two mannequins flank a small door leading to a back room.

title: [Tenys' Trading, Backroom]
description: This room is quite cramped, its tiny potbellied stove radiating a welcoming warmth.  Racks of neatly organized shelves housing wares dominate the space, and a hammock, worktable, and stool round out the room's furnishings.

title: [Seaside Seers, The Fishmongery]
description: Herbs in various stages of drying hang from the pavilion's wooden supports, and several decks of tarot cards and playing tiles are scattered amidst piles of velvet cushions.  A silk-draped table sits next to a particularly elaborate seating cushion, its colorful top covered with various sewing accoutrements and a cheery solstice snow globe.  A gold-framed sign is propped against the table.

title: [Zupal's Discounted Armaments]
description: Thin linen dyed in wide, alternating stripes of crimson and gold provides meager protection against the elements over a swept dirt floor scattered with battered wooden crates of varying sizes.  A nicked modwir weapon rack leans against the back wall next to a hay-packed barrel banded with rusted steel.  Sitting on a rough pine countertop is a glass-topped case fitted with brass hinges.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Snowy Path]
description: A long snowy pathway littered with chunks of ice winds its way along the edge of the cove.  Festival workers carrying large ice blocks move hurriedly past and disappear into a narrow gap between two large boulders.  An iron chisel juts out from one of the large rocks and is tilted toward the gap.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Chiseled]
description: Foot-wide blocks of ice are neatly stacked to form makeshift walls around a small rocky area at the edge of the seaside cove.  Vibrant blue hues of the bay's water bleed through the nearly translucent ice perimeter, and frequent gusts of brisk air from the ocean causes a string of multicolored flags to flap relentlessly against its fury.  A burly sailor dressed in blue and white stands behind a large rock-carved table displaying a basket of chisels.

title: [Sorrow's Edge, Foyer]
description: Thick granite walls rise on all sides, dotted by several reddish-yellow globes.  The ceiling is also granite, but mottled and rippled with waves, bubbles, and other inexplicable deformities.  The outline of a large, distorted pentagram has been traced into the polished floor with thick lines of reddish eahnor.  Placed in the center of the pentagram is some bronze lettering.  An irregular alcove proudly displaying a dark fel case engraved with miniature Igaesha has been hacked out of the wall directly across from a riveted steel door.
location: Sorrow's Edge, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Sorrow's Edge, Den of Solace]
description: A curved ironwood sofa covered by velvet cushions along the western wall faces the opposing side of the room, encompassing a long, oval ironwood table.  Hanging from the eastern wall are several sets of manacles, while oiled leather whips and flogs dangle from nearby hooks.  Another wall shows off a collection of wickedly curved daggers, sitting on metal spikes driven into the stone.
location: Sorrow's Edge, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Sorrow's Edge, Den of Sorrow]
description: The room, lit by a single central brazier, is filled with the strong smell of alcohol and blood.  Faded stains that color every visible surface in shades of red hint at many failed cleanup attempts.  A well-organized collection of metal tools lies on top of a small oaken table, while a set of bronze implements hangs from the side of the brazier.  A torturer's rack is propped up against one wall.
location: Sorrow's Edge, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Sorrow's Edge, Den of Memories]
description: An expansive carpeting made of tiny steel links occupies most of the room.  Out of a hole in its center rises a granite pedestal, and along one wall hangs a colorful tapestry depicting a battle scene.  Comfortably out of reach, some bloodied Faendryl armor has been affixed to the ceiling above the pedestal.  On a stone shelf are a pair of elaborate veil iron shackles and a crumpled battle flag.
location: Sorrow's Edge, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Sorrow's Edge, Den of Horror]
description: The air here is hot and suffocating, stinking of sulfur, sweat, and other strong odors.  A series of glowing red runes in the floor encircles a rough stone altar, and the granite of the ceiling has been carved into an explosion of thick sculptured tentacles.  Hanging from bronze hooks on one of the walls is an assortment of filthy blades, hammers, and tongs.
location: Sorrow's Edge, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Chamorr's Weaponry]
description: Enclosed by ribbed black willow walls, the shop features a claw-footed brazier in the center of its marble floor.  A painted silk wall panel hangs under the vaulted ceiling.  Right near the front is a narrow glass-topped table.

title: [Ponclast's Magic Shoppe]
description: A Four Winds Isle map hangs on one of the warped driftwood walls, and an etched seaglass ceiling rises overhead.  An ornate bottled ship sits in one corner of a scattered sand floor.  There is a shell-lined bamboo counter on one side of the shop and a fish hook rack on the other.

title: [Traiva's General Store]
description: Blue watered silk walls rise from a dark-stained oak floor.  Just above a bathing maiden statue hangs a pearl-handled filigreed mandolin, and a modwir beam ceiling completes the picture.  A jewel-inlaid caddy and a glass-topped mistwood counter stand side by side in the middle of the room.

title: [Chamorr's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, an ancient River's Rest map hangs on one of the ribbed black willow walls.  A Vornavian silk-lined display case sits in one corner while a mound of silk-covered pillows rests on the marble floor.

title: [Chamorr's Weaponry]
description: A painted silk wall panel hangs on one of the ribbed black willow walls, and a low skylight-set ceiling rises overhead.  A plush black bear fur rug sits in one corner of a gold-speckled marble floor.  There is a beveled glass-covered case on one side of the shop and a flexible willow woven basket on the other.

title: [Ponclast's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a sturdy bamboo-rafter ceiling, a glazed shark fin hangs on one of the warped driftwood walls.  A shell-lined bamboo counter sits in one corner while a salt-dried seaweed rug rests on the sand floor.

title: [Ponclast's General Store]
description: Beneath a woven seagrass ceiling, a wall-mounted blowfish hangs on one of the warped driftwood walls.  An aqua-hued seaglass display sits in one corner while a colorful seashell collection rests on the sand floor.

title: [Traiva's Weaponry]
description: A ruby-pommeled longsword hangs on one of the polished oak walls, and a mistwood beam ceiling rises overhead.  A young athlete statue sits in one corner of an enameled hardwood floor.  There is a jewel-inlaid caddy on one side of the shop and a glass-topped mistwood counter on the other.

title: [Traiva's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a modwir beam ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the mahogany paneled walls.  A jewel-inlaid caddy and a glass-topped mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while an elegantly dressed maiden statue rests on an enameled hardwood floor.

title: [Inking Den, Hallway]
description: Navy blue rugs bordered with braided gold rope and bright white anchors cushion the long hallway as it stretches to the east and west.  Wrought iron rings dangle from the ceiling and hold aloft glass-fronted lanterns that shed bright yellow light and dispel all surrounding shadows.  Standing opposite each other, a windowed dark red door has the words, "Office of Petitions" etched into its glass, while a windowed dark green door has the word, "Vacant" etched into its glass.

title: [Inking Den, Hallway]
description: Navy blue rugs bordered with braided gold rope and bright white anchors cushion the long hallway as it stretches to the east and west.  Wrought iron rings dangle from the ceiling and hold aloft glass-fronted lanterns that shed bright yellow light and dispel all surrounding shadows.  Fitted into the terminus of the expanse, a pair of maple double doors sits beneath an etched bronze sign that reads, "Courtroom."

title: [Earth Tower, Underground]
description: Soft grey marble swirled with dark mocha veins forms the walls of this circular subterranean chamber.  Small and cramped, a persistent dampness permeates the enclosed space, enhancing the earthy scent of the packed dirt floor.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Cavity]
description: Irregular angles have been carved through ebon granite deep below the DragonSpine in search of some unseen precious material.  Rocky debris litters the floor of this cavity as it twists deep below the surface increasing the treacherousness of its footing.  Claustrophobic darkness envelops the cramped area.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Twisting from the southeast to the southwest, this tunnel has awkward angled walls and a rocky floor.  Crevices in the surrounding strata have been picked clean of any valuable material.  No discernable light can be seen in any direction.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Signs of progress here stop at a large vein of vultite ore blocking any further access east.  The floor angles upward and over the vultite vein that slants through the rock.  The faintest glow of illumination and a whiff of something unpleasant can be detected coming from the area over the ore to the east.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Crossways]
description: Multiple tunnels cross into and out of this scarred granite junction.  Odd impressions appear in the granite along the ceiling.  The beginnings of a blue-grey vein can be seen in the rocky floor to the west that angles downward to another section of caves below.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, down

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: The path here is clear of rubble as it slants slightly against the odd geometry of the inner faces of solid rock.  Sharp cracks show where material was extruded from the surrounding stone.  A narrow crevice filled with jagged protrusions leads upwards at an awkward angle.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Bare granite walls show signs of aggressive excavation with a narrow crevice offering access to a lower level of this subterranean matrix.  Putrid air accompanies the thick inky darkness that obscures the surroundings.  Jagged rock juts out from odd angles from all directions, making progress difficult and dangerous.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Deep grooves along the southern wall have uncovered what appears to be a series of curved, dull white columns embedded into the granite.  As thick as tree trunks, they rise from floor to ceiling to cradle this section of the passage in their giant pale fingers locked within the stone.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: A ragged chimney allows for a way upwards as the tunnel continues through the pitch black darkness deep in the mountain depths.  Marred walls show no evidence of what has been stripped from the surrounding black granite.  The tunnel continues curving from northeast to northwest.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Crowded by a low ceiling, the ragged walls of the passage continue to wind their way through the permanent, dead-of-night darkness several leagues below the mountains.  A large crevice allows access to another section of tunnels below.  Something rotten fills the air but cannot be seen in the immediate area.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Winding deep into the earth, this tunnel is lined with ragged cracks throughout the strata.  The remnants of unwanted material left behind during excavation crowds the angled floor that winds southeast and southwest.  Inky darkness makes traversing through the area even more difficult and dangerous.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: A crude junction of angled walls curl around a central shaft that climbs into pitch black darkness above.  Crumbling slabs of excavated granite create dangerous obstacles to progress through the area.  No signs of any valuable material can be observed in the numerous crevices carved into the rock.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: The beginnings of an undisturbed layer of blue clay follows the southwestern end of this section of the passage.  No sign of what has been mined can be seen in the slanted walls of the excavated space many fathoms below the surface.  A narrow shaft shrouded in darkness allows access to the lower level of this complex.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: As the tunnel snakes its way through solid granite, angled marks cover the walls where any sought after material was shorn from the bedrock.  No sign of life inhabits the surrounding subterranean blackness.  Chunks of rock lay strewn haphazardly in the walking path.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Spiraling deep into the earth, the tunnel snakes around from northwest to northeast.  The lack of light is as oppressive as the thought of the entire DragonSpine mountain range weighing down overhead.  Despite the darkness shrouding the ceiling of this section of caves, a rounded shaft can be seen leading upwards.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: This shallow tunnel's low ceiling slants at an unusual angle making progress difficult.  As it proceeds east, the narrow walls close in claustrophobically.  A downward slope to the west delves into a pool of darkness.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Along the northern wall is what appears to be a giant, petrified ribcage locked in black granite.  Cracks throughout the curved pale grey bones belie the petrification they have undergone.  The tree trunk sized columns disappear into the ceiling and floor at the edge of the walkway.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Bare granite walls have been carved away, forming this crooked tunnel that exits northwest and northeast.  The ceiling slants at an awkward angle, but the footing here is flat and easily transversable.  This stretch of this tunnel is faintly rancid.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Gold deposits are visible along the quartz ceiling and northern wall, untouched by the miners of this irregular maze deep below the mountains.  This section of the topsy-turvy tunnel arcs from northeast and northwest.  While the vertigo-inducing geometry of the tunnel makes travel difficult, the floor is relatively clear of debris.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Darkness closes in on this narrow passage with scarred walls that offer little room for movement.  Foul air fills the area with no visible source.  A darker sliver in the shadows reveals a crevice leading upwards.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Twisting into the darkness, clusters of crimson crystals spiral around the curves of this passage carved from the black granite deep in the earth.  A narrow crevice filled with dagger-like protrusions to the west offers a hazardous descent to the level below.  Putrid aromas float in the still air.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: A huge pocket of malachite has been exposed all along the southern wall with the passage curving around it from southeast to southwest.  Navigating the area is difficult with the lack of adequate light.   The air reeks of an unidentifiable, sickly sweet scent.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Black granite dominates the gouged walls of this tunnel that ascends slightly to the east.  Tiny shards of crimson can be seen along the floor of this tunnel that ends at a small bore leading upwards to another section overhead.  Wretched air weaves its way through the darkness.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Rough rocky walls covered with sharp edges slant in haphazard angles around the length of this section of tunnel.  Traces of crimson crystals nestle in clefts throughout the dark stone.  The air is thick with the stench of sweet rot.  A small bore descends into the darkness of another lower level of this treacherous matrix.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Shelves of granite have been left behind from excavation, the rock shorn away in search of treasure locked away in time.  Remnants of crimson crystals can be seen in crevices that line the faces of the tunnel walls.  In the stillness, the darkness is oppressive with nasty smelling air that is disgusting to breathe.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Nexus]
description: Several tunnels crisscross through this jagged black granite nexus. Embedded into the rock, iridescent crimson crystals peek out of crevices like fireflies in a black forest.   A pool of thick bluish green goop occupies the center of the intersection, reeking strongly of decomposition and sewage.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: Dotting the walls, blooms of crimson crystals become more frequent as the tunnel travels east.  The low ceiling threatens egress with sharp, tooth-like formations.  A fetid stench lingers in the oppressive confines of this rocky passage under the weight of an entire mountain range.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: The southern wall has been picked clean with only scarred black granite remaining.  Along the eastern wall and ceiling, thick clusters of iridescent crimson crystal have been revealed from their stony prisons.  Nausea inducing scents mingle in the air.

title: [Czeroth Labyrinth, Tunnel]
description: From floor to ceiling the entire eastern wall is covered with the crimson crystals that line the tunnels to this point.  Harvesting has begun with smaller shards littering the ground mixed with black granite rubble.  The dreadful stench of decay hangs thick in the air.

title: [Retrone's General Store]
description: The broad sweep of the mahogany floor is interrupted by a worn rug.  Halfway to the vaulted ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the mottled grey marble walls.  A gold-leafed mistwood cabinet and an engraved copper bin are pushed close together in the back of the shop.

title: [Retrone's Outfitting]
description: Enclosed by painted white plaster walls, the shop features a woven Vornavian silk rug in the center of its limestone floor.  A multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs under the white stucco ceiling.  Right near the front is a vine-carved mahogany table and a wicker basket.

title: [Retrone's Weaponry]
description: Beneath a domed white stucco ceiling, a multihued Vornavian silk tapestry hangs on one of the painted white plaster walls.  A vine-carved mahogany table and a wicker basket sit in opposite corners while a woven Vornavian silk rug rests on a white limestone floor.

title: [Ketain's Catwalk]
description: Polished teak has been intentionally scuffed to reduce the hazards of the perpetually drenched catwalk.  A dark fel and stone shop sits kitty-corner from a slate and haon building, both on sturdy ironwood supports sunk deep into the waters below, and a wide ramp leads away from the catwalk and docking structure.  A string of several bright blue sea slugs carved of coral wind their way along the teak railing, with a giant pink pearl sea star inlaid prominently in the center of the catwalk.

title: [Maelstrom Dock, Dovesnail Pier]
description: Scuffed teak boards form the framework of the large docking structure, with five distinct piers providing ample room for portage.  Each docking slip is padded with canvas-wrapped cork bumpers, and several sturdy support posts are connected by thick hempen ropes.  A large driftwood sign reads, "Maelstrom Dock, Dovesnail Pier - Slips 1-5" and has a carving of a one-eared rabbit in the bottom right corner.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Upper Gallery]
description: Atop a white stone staircase, a circular gallery echoes the round shape of a frosted red and ice blue glass dome far overhead.  Suspended from the center is a rustic silver chandelier that fills the area with the amplified glow of refracted candlelight.  A small halfling child statue leans against a decorative railing at the top of the stairs, gazing downward with childlike wonder on her finely crafted face.

title: [Clovertooth, West Colonnade]
description: Extending from the east, the wide hallway is framed by high columns of white granite.  A carved grey stone bench covered with blackworked cushions sits low to the floor by the door to the town bondsman's office.  An old oil painting hangs on the south wall near a riverstone-framed arch that leads into the surveyor's suite.

title: [Clovertooth, Surveyor's Office]
description: Beneath the watchful eyes of a mounted brown bear head on the western wall, a weary claims clerk presides over a chaotic desk littered with parchments and scroll tubes.  A large illuminated map of Icemule Trace sprawls across the desk, lent unnatural topography by the heaps of paperwork underneath.  Hallways proceed to the north and south toward other offices that cannot possibly be less organized.

title: [Clovertooth, East Colonnade]
description: Lined with columns of carved white granite, the enclosed colonnade proceeds past an unobtrusive office door made of dark Olbin spruce.  The stone floor is broken by a polished mosaic of hoarbeam and modwir depicting a rampant mule.  Beyond the inlaid seal, an arched hallway proceeds toward the public lockers.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A bright blue curtain hangs on the south wall, masking the entrance to a locker booth.  The corridor branches off to the northeast and southeast, with more locker booths visible in both directions.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Registrar]
description: A pale blue rug softens the cold stone floor of the small room, spreading before a blond spruce desk with a parchment sign atop it.  Behind the desk sits a halfling clerk, her hands heavily stained with ink.  A door of Olbin spruce opens onto a well-trafficked colonnade.

title: [Clovertooth, Auditorium]
description: Raw cedar timbers perfume the air, comprising the walls of the expansive hall.  Living evergreen boughs contrast frame the southern entrance, brightly illuminated by faceted glimaerstone orbs set high into the ceiling.  The light scatters over a few dozen rows of comfortably padded seats and rugs covering parts of the polished floor.  A central aisle delineated by a quartet of braziers leads toward an expansive cedar and pine stage framed by silver-trimmed blue curtains.

title: [Clovertooth, Upper Gallery]
description: The western quadrant of the hall's upper gallery is dominated by a pair of Ossian pine doors with a quintet of silver stars above them.  Curving to follow the walkway, a blue wool runner with silver edges proceeds before the chamber.  Nooks along the walls hold snowflakes of azure glass, each resplendent and unique.

title: [Clovertooth, Council Chambers]
description: Lit by a quartet of heavy silver candelabras, the chambers are a spacious, windowless stone den with lush tapestries hanging from the walls.  The hangings muffle echoes in the chamber to a muted whisper.  Spaced around a paneled hoarbeam table are a number of patterned leather chairs, each well-maintained.  The sole means of egress from the chamber appears to be a pair of Ossian pine doors, each marked with a rampant mule in silver.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Upper Gallery]
description: From the eastern portion of the upper gallery, the features of the dark riverstone statue in the center of the lobby below are difficult to discern.  A broad runner of heavy blue wool with a silver border follows the curve of the pathway, proceeding past the cedar door to the town censor's office.  Nooks in the walls hold vases full of edelweiss and resting poppy, lending a splash of color to the pale stone walls.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Bar]
description: Crafted from mahogany, this curved bar has been lacquered, giving the dark wood a soft shine.  A beautiful mosaic pattern of colorful glass is set into the surface, their vibrant hues a sharp contrast to the darker shade.  A row of cushioned stools is set before the counter, welcoming travelers to sit and rest a bit.  Illuminating the room is a trio of crystal and copper lanterns that hang from the rafters above.

title: [Icemule Trace Censor's Office]
description: Floor-to-ceiling shelves fill every inch of wall space in this semicircular open office, and wheeled ladders stand ready for the clerk's use in reaching the higher shelves.  At the front of the office stands a spruce counter, its surface covered with a fine layer of dust that is undisturbed except in the areas surrounding a metallic instructional notice and a citizenship book.  Two torches burn on the walls, their light gilding the ubiquitous dust motes that float through the heavy air.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Upper Gallery]
description: Rising from a natural stone fountain set into northern wall, the sound of trickling water provides a backdrop of pleasant crystalline music to the bustling space, feeding an overgrown tangle of iceblossoms in a curved planter at the base.  Next to the burbling font, a chiseled marble arch leads into the mayor's office suit.  A stern halfling guard watches over the area, her posture tense despite the calming surroundings.

title: [Mayor's Office, Reception]
description: Brightly lit by crystal-globed candles atop a caribou antler chandelier, the room is enclosed in walls of lacquered pine.  Facing a blackened rock fireplace, a waiting couch of dark suede sits with its back to an imposing angular oak desk with neatly organized parchments atop it.  A prim sylvankind secretary is seated behind the desk, which is positioned so that she can watch the entrance, visitors, and a riveted hoarbeam door leading to the mayor's office.

title: [Clovertooth, Mayor's Office]
description: Walls paneled with ancient pinewood frame the low-ceilinged room, which is illuminated by starlight winking in through a large bay window with a fine-grained cedar bench beneath it.  Behind an antique spruce desk equipped with inks, quills, and scrawled papers sits an imposing chair of leather simply adorned with silver studs.  Hanging on the wall above the seat is a mounted rolaren knife affixed to an equally aged modwir board, the sole extraneous decoration to the office.

title: [Mayor's Office, Conference Room]
description: A stately stained glass standing oil lamp sets a warm, welcoming glow in the simple cedar-framed room, which holds a long pale spruce table at its center.  Some black leather wingback chairs are placed evenly around the table's length, resting on a polished stone floor.  The rear wall is a wide panel of frosted glass that has been etched with an elaborate mural.

title: [Clovertooth, Property Clerk]
description: Narrow as a closet and almost as dark, save for a lone oil lamp that emits a sooty wisp of smoke, the tiny office is as neat as possible thanks to several shelves stacked with piles of paper.  A small, battered desk has been pushed up against one wall and rests beneath a sign that simply says "Deeds."

title: [Clovertooth, Cartage]
description: Dirt and wood shavings litter the ground of the cramped office, which is crammed with neatly stacked crates, barrels, and multifarious other pieces of luggage.  A dour master porter oversees the proceedings, a grim look on his face.  Beneath an azure banner that loudly declares, "You buy it, we move it" is a prominent spruce sign listing a variety of stipulations and clauses.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A flashy azure curtain masks the entrance to a locker booth in the north wall.  The hallway branches off to the northwest and northeast, with more locker booths visible in both directions.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: The north wall of the hall is covered with a garish blue curtain marking the entrance to a locker booth.  The hallway branches off to the southwest and southeast, with more locker booths visible in both directions.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Lockers]
description: A stark black curtain covers the entrance to a locker booth on the north wall of the walk.  The hallway branches off to the northwest and southwest, with more locker booths visible in both directions.  An aged hoarbeam bookcase sits flush against the wall at the intersection.

title: [Inking Den, Annex Hallway]
description: Frosted globes nestled within decorative wall sconces provide a steady glow of welcoming light down the long corridor.  The walls are hidden behind bright ivory white silk drapery, the soft ends of which pool upon the thick cerulean and azure carpet.  Built into opposing walls, a lacquered beige door and a lacquered white door part the drapery and have a trio of brightly glowing globes directly above their pointed, cinquefoil frames.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through an ivory-edged crimson silk curtain.  A polished white birch counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [Fishing Pier]
description: Large clumps of marram grass sprout from the dunes on either side of a cultivated path as they slope toward the water.  Sea foam eddies and swirls among the rocks littering the beach, lapping at the edges of an overturned dinghy.  A rope-railed fishing pier extends from the sand out over the moonlit water, ending in a stack of crab traps leaning against a fishing shack.

title: [The Bait 'N Weight Shack]
description: Salt-stained fishing nets, in various stages of mending, cover the interior walls of the shack.  Woven throughout the lower section of each net is a series of lobsters, crabs, tuna, and other sea life, all masterfully recreated by a childlike hand.  A large piece of driftwood is mounted on the back wall and proudly displays a stuffed marlin.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Vestibule]
description: Rows of rust-hued brick line the walls of the repurposed entryway.  The spacious room is illuminated by several brass lanterns.  Set into the floor is a beautiful mosaic of colorful shells.  A silver filigree plaque hangs between a pair of small, dusty windows.  Placed just inside the room next to a curtained stone archway is a large notice board.

title: [Kelpie Beds, River Room]
description: This room is framed with dark blue walls that encircle a floor of tongue and groove ash planks.  A large bed fills the far corner, set with round, stone grey pillows, a heavy pewter and blue-green quilt, and a tasseled bedskirt of teal and brown velvet, creating a quaint semblance of a river running past thin river reeds.  On the wall directly across from the bed is a riverstone fireplace, with a hammered silver bucket of sticks atop the hearth, and beside it is an old, but handsome writing desk.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Sea Inlet Room]
description: Sandy-hued, high pile carpeting covers the floor from one wall to the other, its weft and weave bestowing the likeness of a water-darkened beach beneath an azure sky ceiling.  Two hammocks woven from thick braids of linen and raw silk hang catercornered against the far wall, lashed to metal fixtures mounted on opposing sides of each wall joint.  Between them is a forked driftwood stand beneath an oval mirror with a lithe siren-cast bronze frame, and a painted mural adorns the walls from the head of each hammock to the door.

title: [Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of iron that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point, the moonlight gently illuminating the interior of the tower.

Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point.

title: [Disbarring Dahcre Chamber]
description: The polished red sandstone floors and dark modwir wainscoting give this ample lounge a peaceful warmth.  Deep-cushioned chairs are drawn up around a white and red marble fireplace, above which hangs a beveled glass mirror framed in wrought iron.  A silver serving cart is stationed near the carved basalt arch that leads into this room, an ivory medallion set at its apex.

title: [Darkened Chamber]
description: A single glaesine sconce attached to the wall illuminates the small chamber, casting a fitfully flickering light across the room's few features.  Smooth, dark-veined granite walls rise into the shadowed darkness.  Dangling from a chain at one side of the room is a small mithglin ring.  At the far end of the chamber is a simple curtained opening.

title: [Beacon Hall Archive Annex]
description: Two huge toadstools in large stone pots illuminate a large, comfortable room.  Dusky brown granite benches line two of the marble walls, facing each other across the sapphire carpet.  On one wall, a brass arch allows exit to the corridor outside, while on the other wall a curtain provides entrance to the locker area.

title: [Beacon Hall Annex, Locker]
description: A small swarm of fireflies flit about in a cylindrical cage hung from the granite ceiling.  Their blinking green and yellow glows softly illuminate this small room.  Though the marble walls are unadorned and the granite floor is uncarpeted, the room still provides a quiet place for contemplating the contents of your locker.

title: [Memorial Cavern, Forge]
description: An iron anvil rests in the center of the small cavernous forge, surrounded by candles that keep the area dimly lit.  Tools of the trade lie scattered across the ground, covered in silt and mica.

title: [Mountain Forest, Steep Path]
description: Dense forest abruptly cuts off the trail leading up the mountainside, but a steep path can still be traversed through the lush greenery.  Small breaks in the canopy overhead allow sunlight to pour onto the forest floor.  The scent of wildflowers lingers in the air.

title: [Mountain Forest, Secluded Path]
description: Mossy vegetation covers everything in sight, from the trees to the forest floor.  Fallen leaves are strewn along the path, which leads eastward through a break in the mountain.  Rays of sunlight shine upon a lichen-covered boulder, highlighting odd markings in the stone.

title: [Mountain Forest, Pond]
description: A cherry tree stands guard over a small, shallow pond overlooking Halcyon Hills.  Forest creatures gather around the tranquil pond, some darting in and out of the area.  A leaf-covered wooden cabin has an open doorway, inviting adventurers inside.

title: [Annex, Willow Hall Lobby]
description: Simple, but elegant, the teakwood flooring of this room is polished to a lustrous sheen.  A black velvet pennant edged with green hangs near a heavy, white muslin curtain.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: Headstones flank both sides of the gravel path here.  Weatherworn, the headstones in this area are obviously older than those which follow the fence enclosing the cemetery.  The gravel path crunches underfoot, but provides an easy route to follow.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: Sunlight shines down upon a black marble marker, set into the ground amid a meadow of gently swaying flowers.  The marker is worn with age, but the inscription is still legible.  The sweet smell of wildflowers and the hypnotic humming of bees create a seductive setting.
tags: peer ne =~ /Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest/

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: Headstones flank both sides of the gravel path here.  Weatherworn, the headstones in this area are obviously older than those which follow the fence enclosing the cemetery.  The gravel path crunches underfoot, but provides an easy route to follow.

title: [Marshy Bank, Below Building]
description: The air is cool here.  The floor of a building overhead, supported by a dozen tall, barnacle-coated pilings, blocks out the sun.  The brackish water of the Tempest River flows sluggishly here.  The only sound is the quiet passing of the water through the thick tall river grasses lining the bank.

The night air is cool here.  The floor of a building overhead, supported by a dozen tall, barnacle-coated pilings, blocks out the light of the moon.  The brackish water of the Tempest River flows sluggishly here.  The only sound is the quiet passing of the water through the thick tall river grasses lining the bank.

title: [River Lily, Livery Stable]
description: As the path progresses, the carpet of grass at its borders lengthens from a short shear to a lush, thick pile where its conveyance ends at a wrought iron gate.  The verdure rises in full sprays at the base of each post of an age-darkened split rail fence that encloses a livery yard.  Beyond the barrier stands a rustic dark green stable with high, arched roofing and dark green walls that blend with the verdant surroundings.

title: [River Tunnels, Ancient Altar]
description: Having made it past the barrier guarding this room, you are treated to the sight of an ancient altar that dominates most of the available space here.  The magic of the barrier appears to have kept this room completely dry, as is evidenced by the musty, ancient smell of the air that has been trapped here for centuries.  You feel a bit unsettled here, as if someone is lurking in the shadows ready to strike at your back at any moment.

title: [Earth Tower, First Floor]
description: Comfortable ruddy leather chairs and sofas are flanked by small side tables surmounted by stacks of light reading materials, some quite worn.  The walls are decorated with tapestries portraying soothing woodland vistas, while the floor is covered in thick, richly colored bear hide rugs.  To the south, stretching across the expanse to the next tower is a walkway, while the western walkway heads off in another direction.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, northwest, up, down

title: [Fire Tower, First Floor]
description: Two arches lead to unevenly sized rooms at the western edges of the chamber.  Between the eastern walkway and the southern walkway connecting to the other towers, a stairwell winds itself upwards and downwards.  Red glaes, volcanic glass, and scorched metal stands as an abstract sculpture in the center of the area.
paths: Obvious exits: southwest, northwest, up, down

title: [Air Tower, First Floor]
description: A single large magelight shines on the desks, tables, and chairs of the common room.  To the southwest and southeast, arches lead into common sleeping areas.  On the table nearest the stairs that wind up and down the tower sits a bowl of ripe fruit.  A walkway stretches off to the east, and a perpendicular walkway heads north.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, up, down

title: [Water Tower, First Floor]
description: Stairsteps descend and ascend along the inward facing wall of the room, their dark blue wood in contrast to the light blue-green of the walls and marble floors.  The northern walkway and the western walkway lead off to other chambers on the outward side of the tower.  A few overstuffed chairs covered in garish sealife prints sit around a low table inset with a coral and mother-of-pearl pattern on its legs.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, up, down

title: [Fire Tower, Ground Floor]
description: Red marble veined in grey and gold tiles the floor of the circular antechamber.  Nestled in the crook of the staircase winding up the side of the tower is a bonfire of silk-covered pillows in shades of orange, red, and yellow.

title: [Fire Tower, Underground]
description: Soft grey marble swirled with dusty scarlet veins forms the walls of this circular subterranean chamber.  Small and cramped, a persistent dampness permeates the enclosed space, enhancing the earthy scent of the packed dirt floor.

title: [Fire Tower, Second Floor]
description: Tapestries in the colors of an autumn forest line the walls, their bottom edges fringed and beaded with amber beads that clink against the red marble floor whenever the air is stirred.  A large copper brazier sits between the doors to other rooms, and copper foil covers the stairway leading up the tower.  Built catty-corner to each other, the eastern bridge and the southern bridge lead to the nearby towers.

title: [Air Tower, Second Floor]
description: Caged in a net of silver wire, a magelight hangs suspended from the sky blue ceiling.  Soft, warm white paint coats the walls, while the floor is a glittering mosaic of white and grey glaes.  Two overstuffed chairs upholstered in white and grey toile flank a mistwood side table under the one window, which looks down into the great chamber below.  Crossing the expanse to the adjacent towers are the eastern bridge and the northern bridge, each meticulously maintained.

title: [Earth Tower, Second Floor]
description: Numerous round tables with place settings for a dozen crowd the chamber, the chairs around them tucked neatly under their tablecloths.  A rustic-looking sideboard with extra linens and flatware stands out of the way of the entrances to the dining room.  Atop each table sits a small potted plant.  The western bridge stands to one side, while behind it another bridge stretches to the south.

title: [Water Tower, Second Floor]
description: Where the driftwood stairsteps do not intrude on the blue-painted walls, trophies from the sea hang on marvelous iron hooks.  The curiosities extend onto pedestals on the floor and crowd the area in a manner resembling a shipwreck; items tumble at different heights in random abandon.  The northern bridge extends to the next tower, while a similar perpendicular bridge leads west.

title: [Fire Tower, Study Hall]
description: Several desks, tables, and chairs are scattered about the area, spaced far enough apart so as to not feel crowded, but close enough to be pushed together or rearranged easily for large groups.  The dark black of their ebonwood surfaces reflects the deep maroon of the enclosing walls.

title: [Fire Tower, Store Room]
description: Cupboards, shelves, and a large dust bin stand somewhat jumbled together around a wooden broom closet in this small space.  Although lit by a single coal-filled brazier set behind the counter, the room is cheery-looking, with several paintings of happy, firelit gatherings adorning the limited wallspace.

title: [Air Tower, Ground Floor]
description: Clad in gold-veined white marble, the antechamber to this tower is wreathed in a staircase leading upward.  Soft cushions in cloudy grey are strewn over the expanse of a carpet in the mottled hues of the sky at sunrise.

title: [Air Tower, Underground]
description: Soft grey marble swirled with sparkling white forms the walls of this circular subterranean chamber.  Small and cramped, a persistent dampness permeates the enclosed space, enhancing the earthy scent of the packed dirt floor.

title: [Workshops Center]
description: Five hallways lead to alchemical workshops, their openings resembling the blades of a fan.  Mist grey walls, veined in silver, reflect any ambient light in a sparkling, yet subdued, manner.  A large circular rug inlaid with images of the five elements is the area's only adornment.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Alchemical, Workshop]
description: Purely functional, the room is nearly drab in its unrelieved whiteness.  A single, curved workbench stands against the outer wall of the tower and holds a silver-inlaid pearly lens assembly, a clear glass alembic, a worn stone crucible, and mortars.

title: [Alchemical, Workshop]
description: Purely functional, the room is nearly drab in its unrelieved whiteness.  A single, curved workbench stands against the outer wall of the tower and holds a silver-inlaid pearly lens assembly, a clear glass alembic, a worn stone crucible, and mortars.

title: [Alchemical, Workshop]
description: Purely functional, the room is nearly drab in its unrelieved whiteness.  A single, curved workbench stands against the outer wall of the tower and holds a silver-inlaid pearly lens assembly, a clear glass alembic, a worn stone crucible, and mortars.

title: [Alchemical, Workshop]
description: Purely functional, the room is nearly drab in its unrelieved whiteness.  A single, curved workbench stands against the outer wall of the tower and holds a silver-inlaid pearly lens assembly, a clear glass alembic, a worn stone crucible, and mortars.

title: [Alchemical, Workshop]
description: Purely functional, the room is nearly drab in its unrelieved whiteness.  A single, curved workbench stands against the outer wall of the tower and holds a silver-inlaid pearly lens assembly, a clear glass alembic, a worn stone crucible, and mortars.

title: [Air Tower, Library]
description: Two lines of bookcases are formless lumps in the shadowy darkness, the aisle between them ending in a window overlooking a courtyard below.  The bookcases are stuffed with books, tomes, scrolls, and pamphlets in various stages of disrepair.

Two lines of bookcases march the length of the room, the aisle between them ending in a window overlooking a courtyard below.  The bookcases are stuffed with books, tomes, scrolls, and pamphlets in various stages of disrepair, and motes of dust hang listlessly in the air.

title: [Wizard Guild, Qita's Office]
description: Functional and sparse, this spacious office is vastly different than the rest of the castle, a testament to its occupant's humble nature.  A solid teak desk sits front and center atop a rattan mat amidst the bare white marble walls, a comfortable-looking chair its only companion.  Several low bookcases filled with tomes and loose scrolls and topped with a standard alembic, mortar, and pestle complete the remainder of the office's furnishings.  A soft light fills the area from no discernable source.

title: [Water Tower, Ground Floor]
description: Jellyfish-shaped cushions with long tentacles snaking out rest atop a clear glass floor.  Beneath the floor, several varieties of freshwater fish swim obliviously in a giant pond.  The pond itself is kept flowing and aerated by a large contraption that spans from pond to ceiling.  Water wheels and buckets scoop the liquid from the pond and tumble it back out over the sides, creating a slight mist in the air.  Occasionally, a fish flips its way through the buckets to the top and back down to safety below.

title: [Water Tower, Underground]
description: Soft grey marble swirled with cobalt blue veins forms the walls of this circular subterranean chamber.  Small and cramped, a persistent dampness permeates the enclosed space, enhancing the earthy scent of the packed dirt floor.

title: [Wizard's Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Soft grey marble swirled with each elemental color forms the walls of this austere chamber.  Uncomfortable-looking benches march in orderly rows concentrically outward from a raised dais at the back of the room.  Muted globe lights hover high above, providing an adequate amount of light to the area.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Water Tower, Guild Shop]
description: Near the door, a wirework shelving unit holds a variety of wares.  Wooden bins line the stone walls while a simple granite counter graces the center of the room atop a woven cerulean rug.

title: [Water Tower, Storage]
description: Tucked against the blue tile walls of this rather cramped storeroom, a teak shelf rests above a mosaic sapphire-inlaid table holding some stone mortars.  Rivulets of water trickle down the walls from a pair of open windows high up to collect in a meditation pool, giving the eastern wall an oddly sad resemblance to a crying face.

title: [Earth Tower, Elemental Masters]
description: Desks have been crowded together into this small room, each a working area for a master on duty.  Piles of neverending paperwork are stacked high on each desk, some more neatly than others.

title: [Earth Tower, Wood Storage]
description: Stacks of wood in a variety of hues stand against the wall near some large training cauldrons, all the individual pieces straight and devoid of branching.  A plain woodsman's hatchet rests next to a whetstone atop a small wooden bench nearby.

title: [Earth Tower, Third Floor]
description: Abstract tapestries in shades of green and brown line the granite walls of the chamber.  The floor is covered in scattered lion skin rugs.  An odd little shrine, devoid of decoration, stands next to the arched exit to the southwest.  It is composed of a single slab of highly polished basalt.  On either side of the strange shrine are two bridges, each offering a path to reach an adjacent tower.

title: [Water Tower, Third Floor]
description: Next to the arch to the northwest, a gnomish contraption rests as a shrine.  A yard-wide wheel has been filled with sand and water, while gears keep the wheel in constant back-and-forth motion.  The blue-dyed water and pristine white sand intermingle, creating a miniature storm within the wheel's confines.  Sitting unobtrusively to the north and west are two bridges offering access to the other towers.

title: [Air Tower, Third Floor]
description: Light fog dances through the area, diffusing the light from a colony of small magelights strung along the cloud-painted ceiling.  Arches to the south and west counterbalance the large, open vista of the rooftop to the northeast.  A small marble walkway spans the ten foot distance to the rooftop, sans railings or supports.  One mistwood bridge heads to the east, while a similar bridge leads north.

title: [Wizard's Guild, Workshop]
description: Four spindly platforms extend from each of the towers out to the floor of this workshop.  A flawless dome of clear crystal covers the area, protecting it from the vagaries of the weather.  Within this nexus, a nervous guild apprentice sits serenely amid four circles of red, white, green, and blue marble set into the floor.  Soft moonlight is enhanced by magical globes above each exit.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Fire Tower, Third Floor]
description: Next to the opening leading southeast, a small shrine covered in gold foil studded with lapis lazuli stands ready to catch the evening moonlight from the fretwork and glass conical rooftop.  The rest of the area's surfaces are covered in a cinnamon-colored paint, while a large red bear rug is centered on the floor.  Understated, yet clearly well-maintained, the eastern bridge and southern bridge offer access to other towers.

title: [Enlightenment Table]
description: A scattering of scrolls and quills suggests the oval modwir table is often used as a place of study and contemplation.

title: [Professions Table]
description: Carved along the edges of the long wooden table are symbols for each of the adventuring professions of the lands.

title: [Wanderer's Table]
description: Maps of areas, known and otherwise, have been carved into the surface of this round weathered black maple table over the years.  A large beeswax candle burns from within a large knothole near the center.

title: [Contemplation Table]
description: The round table has been made from a single piece of what must have been a very old modwir tree.  Students have carved a variety of sayings into the wood.

title: [Rone Academy, Theatre Backstage]
description: The cramped backstage room is dominated by a maze of line and scaffolding.  Dozens of ropes, levers, wheels, and other control devices turn the large but plain area into a miniature labyrinth.

title: [Rone Academy, Waterfall Bed]
description: Under the falls, the water is turbulent and deep, becoming calmer further in.  Lily pads torn from their mooring along the edges of the pool float freely, some with blossoms tightly closed to the night and often holding the occasional small green frog.  Large enough to hold multiple people comfortably, a rock bathed in moonlight rises from the depths of the pool.

Under the falls, the water is turbulent and deep, becoming calmer further in.  Lily pads torn from their mooring along the edges of the pool float freely, some still blossoming with pale pink, white, and the rare crimson blooms, often holding the occasional small green frog.  Large enough to hold multiple people comfortably, a sun-warmed rock rises from the depths of the pool.

title: [Rone Academy, A Large Rock]
description: Soft moonlight filters down upon this large, round rock set amidst the stream.  The rock itself is still warm from the afternoon sun, providing a comfortable and relaxing spot to dry off and watch the waters flow.
Bright sunlight streams down onto this large, round rock set amidst the stream.  The rock itself is warm, providing a comfortable and relaxing spot to dry off and watch the waters flow.

title: [Estate, Approach]
description: Half-timbered walls painted white and black in repeating patterns rise up to an elegant gray slate roof.  Tucked amongst the slate are several airy gables and five red brick chimneys, thrusting upward from the estate like the fingers of a massive hand.  A cobbled carriage path leads from the street to five salt-and-pepper granite steps on which is centered a pair of massive monir doors banded with iron straps and decorated with rose head nails.  The western side of the estate appears to have been reduced to rubble.

title: [Estate, Greatroom]
description: The greatroom boasts square mahogany paneling that climbs gracefully to hand-hewn beams pegged with thick treenails.  At the center of the room, a variety of trophies surmount a mantel, three thickly tufted couches arcing about its carved granite fireplace.  A burnished brass and oak sideboard stretches along the rear wall beneath arched windows with leaded diamond panes that suffuse the room with sunlight.  The hallway to the west terminates in a pile of rubble.
tags: meta:mapname:Kraken's Fall - Hand of the Arkati

title: [Estate, Destruction]
description: Once a fully functional wing of the estate, all that remains are piles of rubble and a clearing littered with craters.  A small path wends through the rubble to the east meeting up with the hallway leading inside.  Inside the largest crater at the center, a sturdy steel workbench juts up obliquely amidst scorched jumbles of stone and mahogany.  A jagged crack zigzags through the rubble on the western rim of the large crater.

title: [Estate, Athenaeum]
description: Lustrous white marble floors meet sky-blue walls which flow up to a dome of crystallized glass overhead.  Inset at the center of the ceiling is an ivory oculus carved with celestial symbols of Liabo.  Jagged tendrils of ivory jut forth from the oculus at haphazard angles, eternally grasping towards the sunlight.  Lor-accented bookcases carved to mimic trees line the walls, chaotically packed with tomes and scrolls.  Lor-inlaid double doors open to the west, and additional doors lead in various directions.

title: [Estate, Stables]
description: Smelling of dry hay and saddle soap, the stables are mostly unadorned.  A row of ten stalls with sliding wooden half-doors lines the far wall.  A massive pile of loose hay fills one end of the room, while the other sports a collection of saddles, tack, and one abused quintain.  Axe-hewn boards strewn with straw create a floor sturdy enough to stand the test of time against hooves and boots.

title: [Estate, Crypt]
description: The temperature drops drastically upon entering the crypt, the air hanging damp and heavy.  Several rectangular openings filled with coffins line the walls and stretch down tunnels in all directions, barring the northern tunnel which ends suddenly with a smooth, stone slab.  The ground is exposed soil, pristine save for a few distinctly feline prints.  Mosses and lichens cling to the walls in myriad shades of green.  Looming in the center is an impressive oak desk carved with a lor tree.

title: [Estate, Cavern]
description: The cavern is spacious, smelling of damp earth and saltwater.  Devoid of natural sunlight, a variety of bioluminescent mosses and lichens flourish underground, carpeting the sides and ground of the cave.  High above, a frothy blue-grey waterfall explodes from an opening, dumping into a deep pool teeming with life.  A crescent of agate and stone borders the rippling body of water.  At the center of the crescent is a stone pedestal and a chain-draped book with the remnants of a fused skeleton beneath.

title: [Estate, Dormitory]
description: Featuring an aesthetic best described as "built by a captive shipwright," the dormitory is an upside-down ship's hull.  Wooden ribs arch overhead, supporting overlapping exterior clapboards.  Neatly made bunks with footlockers march down each side, interspersed with hammocks hanging from iron chains.  At the narrow bow, repurposed gangplanks rest on cannons, forming a makeshift table.  Whalebone candelabra cast dancing patterns onto the curving walls, illuminating a sprawling mural of a naval battle.

title: [Estate, Ladies' Patio]
description: Flowers envelop this covered patio, their sweet scent undercut slightly by the smell of fragrantly rich olive oil and the faint hint of ocean air.  A black and white tiled path encircles the area, centered by a raised stone platform surrounded by soft, unnaturally gleaming grass.  Along the path are a variety of cushioned leather couches and a small serving table, and a glass-paneled door traced with silvery lor leads back inside.

title: [North Dock, Catwalk]
description: Varnished with crushed black coral to give purchase, the oak and teak catwalk gleams in the ambient light.  A glass and oak building and a teak and polished oak shop face one another on either side of the catwalk, each on several sturdy support posts sunk deep into the harbor.  A wide ramp leads down and away from the catwalk, while to the south, a large docking structure with ample portage is visible.
tags: meta:mapname:The Docks and Rusty Cutless - Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Estate, Map Room]
description: Contrasting with the rest of the manor, this room is constructed from white marble ashlar blocks and boasts only narrow windows, fortifying its position at the back of the house.  A chandelier made from fused sword blades hangs from the vaulted ceiling, glinting in the sunlight.  Centered below it, a charcoal-filled brazier surmounts a hexagonal table strewn with maps on a crimson rug shot with golden embroidery.  Several tapestries hang on the walls between rows of wooden bookshelves overflowing with books and scrolls.

title: [Estate, Supply Room]
description: Crammed into the tight space are several stacks of crates with ledgers spread out atop them.  A lantern hangs off the back of the door held by a simple steel hook.  Tucked between two crates is a wastebin holding some balled-up papers and a charred ledger with a giant letter "C" still visible on the spine.

title: [Rumor Woods]
description: Emblazoned with a white ram motif, a brown conical tent of chocolate brown with an inverted crenellated top of plum occupies a clearing to the northwest.  Pristine white aspens stretch their slender branches into the sky, while their vibrant hued leaves form a colorful canopy that fairly quakes at the hint of a breeze.  Patches of snow, half melted in the sunlight, assist in watering the tall beauties and play a part in producing the mud on the divergent trails.

Emblazoned with a white ram motif, a brown conical tent of chocolate brown with an inverted crenellated top of plum occupies a clearing to the northwest.  Pristine white aspens stretch their slender branches into the sky, while their vibrant hued leaves form a colorful canopy that fairly quakes at the hint of a breeze.  Patches of snow, half frozen in the nighttime chill, assist in make the divergent trails slick with ice.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Chocolate Brown Conical Tent]
description: Draped with beige felt, the interior of the tent is deceptively large.  A brass-banded wooden chest rests at the foot of a large wooden cot draped with a plum-hued comforter that dominates the center of the room.  The perimeter is dotted with a series of thick white candles, their wide wooden bases carved with a spiral of blossoms.

title: [The Tartan Cloth, Entry]
description: Conically peaked and crafted of umber canvas, the sprawling pavilion walls have heavy weights sewn into their lowest hem to prevent the wind from invading the space.  Lofted braziers are suspended between a pair of central posts, each filled with brightly burning coals that both illuminate and warm everything beneath them.  Tables and baskets are arranged away from the single entry, their wares easily visible in the flickering light.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Jousting Fields, Viewing Stands]
description: Sturdy aspen planks stained in green hues are set upon stumps unevenly stacked across the muddy grounds, creating a haphazard area to view the jousting grounds.  Bales of twine-bound hay provide additional seating, although handfuls of the dried grass have been plucked from numerous stacks by some unknown observer.  Tall poles frame the back of the area, each one decorated with a makeshift stag silhouette crafted from gold-dyed canvas.

title: [The Kindred Plaid, Entry]
description: Forest green oilcloth edged in canary yellow falls in unfettered folds from several support posts that are spaced equidistantly apart.  Bronze bowls suspended from matching chains house small, fragrant fires that help to illuminate the various wares that are on display.  Woven baskets decorate the center of the entry, the carefully arranged containers creating twin pathways opposite them that lead deeper into the tent, while a long quilt rack behind them houses a variety of folded plaid bundles.

title: [Jousting Fields, Viewing Stands]
description: Iron-banded barrels form both temporary dividers and seating in this area of the stands, each one painted with a gold stag rearing upon the surface of green-painted wood.  The mixture of muddied grass and straw clings tightly against the stacked planks and stone arranged in a semblance of horizontal rows, although a few of the pieces have been dislodged from use or perhaps an over enthusiastic observer.

title: [Jousting Fields, Viewing Stands]
description: Green-stained iron poles along the perimeter tether a variety of silk kites, each one embroidered with the image of a colorful stag rising high into the air.  The benches have been painted in a similarly vivid palette, the swirls of paint depicting a lion and stag locked in combat, each creature inset with eyes of polished stone.  The continuous barrage of color collides with the additional din of the market and joust, creating an almost overwhelming atmosphere.

title: [Jousting Fields, Viewing Stands]
description: The ceiling of the hastily erected structure has been strung with alternating pennants of gold and green, each piece embroidered with the simple image of a rearing stag.  The air is filled with the din of clashing metal, cheers of the crowd, and chatter of the market behind the wood-framed stands, the ruckus an orchestra of sound echoing throughout.  Tree stumps and benches provide seating for observers, although the trampled grass below suggests that most prefer to stand for the event.

title: [Holy Sheaths]
description: The smell of temple incense fills the air in this cluttered little shop.  Icons and sigils devoted to the gods and spirits, with accompanying candles burned in their tribute, clutter the tidy shelves that make up nearly every inch of the shop's otherwise unadorned walls.  A pedestal modeled on the the moon of Liabo and a plinth styled after Lornon display wares for sale beside a glass case with an oil-stained notice pinned to the wall above it.

title: [Born to Adorn]
description: Supported by a rough oak post, the floor of the canvas structure is hardpacked dirt with sprigs of grass that are yellowing where the heavy walls pool in loose folds.  Bright white lattices form a wall that stretches to the east, its face covered with a variety of metallic hooks and rough oak pegs, while a series of pine barrels create a line that trails to the south.  A small bench in the center of the space is filled with a variety of embossing tools, as well as a few small baskets of needles, thread, and embroidery hoops.

title: [The Galloping Gait]
description: Opaque panels of luxurious, sorrel-hued suede enshroud the pavilion, save for a folded curtain that allows in a substantial amount of outdoor light and an errant breeze.  Several upturned metallic horseshoes line the upper ridge of some lacquered mahogany shelves that are bedecked with an elaborate display of finely crafted footwear.  The rich, heady scent of leather goods pervades the well-kept shop, the fragrance strongest near a polished walnut countertop.

title: [Devout Alloy]
description: The spacious structure is draped in a pale-colored cordetum fabric that is faintly illuminated by a number of sturdy iron lanterns strewn about the area.  At the center, a rectangular white oak counter divides the space, separating a carved wooden cabinet from a gold-banded thanot chest.  A row of silver mithril racks sits in a tidy line against the back wall, flanked by a number of forging hammers ornamentally displayed in glass cases.  Diverging from the simply austere ambiance, the delicate, flowery scent of daisies lingers faintly in the air.

title: duplicate of 28083
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Tinkers Toys, Wagon Workshop]
description: Glass oil lamps affixed to the walls provide a soft light that illuminates the wagon's interior that smells of grease and solvents.  Much like the exterior, the walls of this enclosed wagon are covered, but with shelves that display all kinds of metal trinkets.  Across from the entrance, a tall workbench presides over the space, covered with metalworking tools and metal shavings.  In front of the workbench is a table upon which a doll-sized replica of this festival's list and stands has been built.

title: [Tortoise Holdings, Enclosures]
description: Draped with umber clothes embroidered with virescent images, a pair of open air enclosures flank the roofed corridor.  Heavily reinforced by pipes, the enclosures are largely circular expanses filled with dirt and hay.  A long, low steel trough is built between the two spaces for the occupants of both enclosures to share.

title: [Tortoise Enclosure]
description: Heavy wooden planks enclose the area, the walls dominated by long feeding troughs filled with wild grasses, weeds, and various bits of flora.  A pair of oversized boulders dominates the center of the room, the rocks covered in layers of dark green moss that spreads to the straw-covered ground below.

title: duplicate of 28071
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Deerner Time]
description: Woven from soft wool, a dark green carpet covers the ground.  Polished oak poles form the framework of the large tent with rich gold wool draped over to create the roof and walls.  A series of copper lanterns dangle from a braided rope, their bright lights fill the large space.  Several wooden bins are pushed to one side with a few woven baskets hanging from above.

title: [The Colorful Carapace]
description: A stout central pole of white oak supports the high canopy of this airy tent.  Canvas-draped tables have been neatly arranged around the shop to allow ample space between them to accommodate crowds.  Placed prominently in front, a whimsical tortoise sculpture greets would-be customers, crafted into the bulky bodies of three tortoises balancing atop each other, the topmost holding a large sign in its beak.

title: duplicate of 28050
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Cysaelotar, Ingress of Welcome]
description: Elevated above the bustle and noise of the Tourney Grounds, the grassy mound acts as a portal between the alpine world and that of the subalpine forests.  Bristle-headed sedge rushes north and westward towards the granite faces of nearby cliffs, while hemlock, juniper, and alder casually dot the lower elevation to the east and south amid colorful forbs and rushes.  A grass-edged narrow dirt track slithers down the hill, dodging clumps of snow and the odd boulder in its effort to reach the bottom.

title: [In the Loop]
description: Carefully shielded lanterns provide a soft illumination for the cramped tent, the flickering metal boxes highlighting the rough stitching of the patchwork walls.  Various leatherworking tools and an embossing kit are arranged in tidy rows near the head of a lumpy bedroll, while a small parchment tube is tangled in the blankets at its foot.  A series of wooden pegs in the center of the space, and in full view of the entry, provides passersby with a full view of the abode's wares.

title: [Gemstoned, Beings]
description: Scattered rugs of heavy wool stretch across the muddy ground, providing a layer of warmth that keeps the cold earth and subalpine breezes at bay.  Burning lanterns release spicy fragrances into the air and maintain a soft golden light throughout the spacious tent.  Woven river reed baskets are tidily tucked away beneath a low pine table that showcases a small display stand and a variety of wares.

title: duplicate of 28042
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [The Girlybird]
description: Uninhabited bird cages of assorted shapes and sizes dangle precariously overhead by varying lengths of frayed twine.  Stacked one atop another, colorfully painted birdhouses sit vacant in one corner of the canvas-draped tent, while a row of empty coops are lined up along a rickety counter.  A speckled, bright blue egg has pride of place snuggled in a large nest atop a glass display case.

title: duplicate of 28043
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: duplicate of 28033
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Flypaper Designers, Entry]
description: Colorful globes are suspended from an oilcloth ceiling, their warm glow filling the space with a multitude of bright colors.  Oak frames treated with glossy lacquer are suspended from the cloth walls, while wooden shelves stacked with paper rest upon a plush carpet of overlapping hides.  A large sign greets customers as they enter, its precise lettering bright white on the black canvas.

title: [Bank of Zul Logoth, Exchequer]
description: In the light radiated by a luminescent toadstool growing from a polished brass pot in the corner, polished brass fixtures gleam against the alcove's white marble walls, ceiling, and floor.  A gilded sign has been affixed beside a brass-barred window.  Well-dressed dwarven patrons wander into the alcove to conduct transactions with leather-bound portfolios and registers.

title: [Trim and Polish]
description: Plush carpets stretch across the hard ground beneath an oilcloth ceiling painted with mottled brown and red hues.  Brass and glaesine lanterns hang from the central support, providing ample illumination for consumers to view the wares that are neatly displayed throughout the structure.  A round table hugs the support post, its center cut out to accommodate the rough oak, while a series of river reed baskets lines the back wall and a knotty pine display case stands near the entry.

title: [Charmed I'm Sure, Entry]
[Charmed, I'm Sure]
description: Strings of beads hang from every wall of this small pavilion, accenting the colorful silk with gaudy pops of color at random intervals.  A long table, its surface home to a branching silver jewelry tree and a squat wooden box, takes up most of the room, while a wide glass display case is squeezed next to it.  Various rugs and pillows decorate the floor, each one a different fabric or texture.

title: duplicate of 28026
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west

title: [Rollin' In The Greens]
description: Carved haon poles form the framework of this spacious tent with rich verdant wool hanging to form the peaked roof and walls.  A single bronze lantern dangles from a thick chain, its warm light barely illuminating the large space.  Woven from river reeds, a dark umber carpet covers the ground.  Various crates and boxes line the walls, while several baskets hang from the rafters above.

title: duplicate of 28023
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Fanfare, Behind the Counter]
description: Beneath the counter, wooden shelves are neatly arranged with various goods, some in labeled boxes bearing markings from far-off provinces.  A green glass bottle lies empty on the temporary flooring, the rough aspen planks cobbled together to raise the shop wares a few inches off of the soft ground.  A pair of muddy boots sits in a corner.

title: [Robes of Resistance]
description: Bolts of various fabrics line makeshift shelves along the wagon's walls.  Coat stands displaying outerwear garments in different sizes and colors stand sentry beside a pine-framed papyrus beneath a brass lantern.  An embroidered curtain covering the wagon's entry wavers from an errant breeze.

Bolts of various fabrics line makeshift shelves along the wagon's walls.  Coat racks displaying outerwear garments in different sizes and colors stand sentry beside a pine-framed papyrus beneath a brass lantern.  An embroidered curtain covering the wagon's entry wavers from an errant breeze.

title: [The Silken Lotus, Repose]
description: Swathes of rich silks, velvets, and brocades drape across polished cedar supports, and various curtains of silk partition the pavilion into different areas.  This main area has high ceilings and several displays, serving more as museum and gathering spot than shop.

title: [Cysaelotar, Nodding Heads]
description: Slender pathways are barely visible beneath the blanket of alpine blossoms that nod their heads lazily in the sunlight.  Indiscriminately brushing against its neighbors, relatively short evergreen candytufts pay court to purple cowbells to one side and pale primula on the other.  Conversely, stubby yellow helmet flowers cling to the edges of a winding track that meanders up the incline of a nearby mound, while blue-eyed grass and white mountain phlox dominate the eastern landscape alongside lichen-covered stones.
