title: [Cysaelotar, Roar of the Stars]
description: Affording a view of the northern mountains, the southern tundra, and the western tourney grounds, the mound is covered in swaying grasses and sedge that are tugged and toyed with by an inconsistent arctic breeze.  Rust and mint-green lichen cling to granite boulders that, through some act of nature, form a ring across the flat expanses, in the center of which someone has built a large blazing bonfire.  Various pathways are visible as thin tracks that meander to the top, but only one pathway down is efficient and hazard free.

title: [A Pine and Canvas Enclosure]
description: Spacious and roomy, the domed tent has an exposed framework of bowed pine saplings that are joined together by canvas ribbons.  Waxed canvas is draped over the manipulated baby trees to create a protective shell against the elements, though a small opening in the ceiling allows smoke from a nearby cooking fire to escape.  Heavy wool and fleece blankets are scattered about the ground, some in comfortable piles for sleeping and others simply to muffle the chill that radiates from the ground.

title: [Cysaelotar, Mirror of the Sky]
description: Whorls of pure rhimar rise out of the ground, the clusters fused to dove grey granite in a wide half-circle that stretches northeast before disappearing over the cliff's edge.  Within the ore and stone ring sits a dazzling sky blue glacier that is perfectly smooth and exquisitely reflects the sky above with mirror-like precision.  Alpine black sedge and blue sow-thistle spill freely across a narrow dirt track that leads higher up the mound, while those plants closest to the ancient ice are stiffly rooted in place and coated in hoarfrost.

title: [The Spirits Within, Distance]
[The Spirits Within, Wild]
[The Spirits Within, Melancholy]
description: Frames of driftwood form the body of the structure, rising high to meet the faded flags of leather and canvas that drape across decorated alcoves set within recess of the pentagonal design.  Woven rugs of hemp muffle the ambient noises of the outside, leaving only the soft crackle of lanterns casting beams of light towards the northern recess.  Faint wisps of incense caress the offerings laid bare before a grey marble statue, fading as they reach the open air.

Frames of lacquered bamboo form the body of the structure, rising high to meet the lengths of pastel-dyed silks that drape across decorated alcoves set within recess of the pentagonal design.  Muted taupe rugs, crafted from soft wool, muffle the ambient noises of the outside, leaving only the soft crackle of lanterns casting beams of light towards the northern recess.  Faint wisps of incense caress the offerings laid bare before a grey marble statue, fading as they reach the open air.

title: [Channeled Affection]
description: A multitude of ribbons woven into a loose braid hangs in scalloped lengths along the upper tent frame, where the drape of the walls meet the ceiling.  At each point on the garland is a neatly arranged bouquet of flowers, each blossom in the bunch lending a sweet aroma to the air.  Diamond-shaped glass lanterns hang from the pavilion's supports, casting soft candlelight down on a central display and the blue parchment sign upon it, while leaving a small round table seated beneath a low shelf and a high shelf in the surrounding dimness.

title: [ImPressions]
description: Vibrant green grass provides a natural blanket that spreads from one end of the tent to the other, the long stalks tamped down in some areas due to foot traffic.  Various hanging shelves, tied to the rafters and anchored in the ground, house a variety of wares and are evenly spaced to prevent crowding.  Dormant lanterns, nothing more than glass jars with votives in them, capture the sunlight that spills into the entry and refract it to provide ample illumination.

Simple lanterns, nothing more than glass jars with votives in them, provide ample illumination throughout.

title: [Cysaelotar, Juniper Umbrellas]
description: Fist-sized round stones and large boulders dot the tundra, their wind-swept faces darkened by rust-hued kidney lichen and mist green reindeer moss.  Twisted and gnarled, the ropey trunk of a large juniper rises out of the mottled ground to spread its verdant limbs across the area, the bough clusters resembling clouds that cast similar shadows.  A smooth stone bench rests beneath the ancient tree, the granite it is carved from nearly a perfect match in shade to the berries above it.

title: [Cog & Zephyr]
description: A curious mixture of vivid green verdancy and gnomish gadgets pepper the tent's interior, lending an earthy, workshop coziness to the bustling sales environment.  Near the double-wide tent flap, which is tied open, a certificate-laden, gilded table sits next to a chalkboard informational sign and a giant cog and vine tortoise.  Several oak-inset fel displays circling the central tent pole offer wooden box contraptions fitted with stirrup irons, while the vine-wound racks ringing the outside present large, leaf-like constructs.

title: [Notcher Style]
description: Thickly woven wool blankets form the walls of the geteld, the bright blue cloth interlaced with overlapping red and yellow chevrons.  Grass green globes dangle from the fabric-covered ridge pole, providing a subtle, but ample light, for a lively and well-illuminated atmosphere.  A long display table stretches between ash support rails along the front and in clear view of the entry, while a large grind wheel occupies much of the space behind.

title: [Channeled Affection]
description: Soft floral scents linger in the air, bestowed by the bouquets perched at the peaks of the scalloped ribbon garland that decorates the upper reaches of the pavilion's walls.  On opposing sides of the space are a high shelf and a low shelf on one side and a small round table on the other.  A central display sits at the heart of the area, lit warmly by the diamond-shaped glass lanterns that hang above, with a pastel blue parchment sign in a simple silver frame set amongst its wares.

title: [Cysaelotar, Whispering Boughs]
description: Wind sweeps across the tundra as it departs from high granite peaks in the distance towards the low valley, its gossamer fingers causing a nearby strand of spindle-trunked birch to rattle and sway.  Colorful leaves of verdant and gold hues dapple the reed-thin boughs, generating a soft whisper that carries through the area.  Bristle-headed black sedge and wide-bladed alpine grass mingles together across the slight incline as it travels south, while a narrow track winds its way further up the mound to the north.

title: [Cysaelotar, Garden Descent]
description: Mist hugs the ground, creating tiny clouds that skip across mingling snow-dappled alpine grass and bristle-headed sedge that spreads throughout the area.  Granite walls are barely visible to the north, where the air thickens to a veritable fog of chilly, rolling and tumbling in the air in front of a set of descending natural rock steps.  Opposite, white rock cress climbs the grassy mound amid clumps of half-melted snow, the duo bringing a bit of brightness under the shadow of the nearby mountain peaks.

title: [Goin' Stag, Entry]
[Goin' Stag]
description: Lengths of wool hanging from the support beams above separate the large tent into several sections.  A makeshift floor of rough oak tiles covers the ground, creating an unorganized patterned floor.  Large window openings in the walls allow sunlight in to brighten the area.  Draped in plain burlap, a large archway is flanked by a pair of makeshift tables.

title: [Goin' Stag, Showroom]
[Goin' Stag]
description: Hanging from the support rafters above, a dented copper lantern brightens the small area.  Strips of burlap and canvas cover the floor hiding the bare dirt below.  A series of boxes and crates are placed about the room to show off the items for sale.

title: [Liraflyswn, Enclosure]
description: Flowers of every variety drape from the rafters, the colorful blossoms strung together with bits of string and anchored in place by tiny hooks.  Shielded lanterns spill a pale blue light over everything, while a tiny brazier in the center of the enclosure keeps the space cozy and warm.  A pair of cots are pushed to the back to make room for baskets of string, scissors, and various other baubles.

title: [On The Wing]
description: The spacious pavilion is cloaked in layered swathes of dark gold flyrsilk possessing a faint, nacreous sheen that glint underneath a vaalin-caged lantern suspended from the center of the room.  Glimmering carved crystal cases garlanded with sweet alyssum posies zigzag casually around the perimeter to encourage seamless browsing.  At the back, a prominent row of gossamer lace wing replicas partially conceals a thanot and haon marquetry platform that bolsters a stout jade cabinet.

title: [The Spirits Within, Defiance]
[The Spirits Within, Reckoning]
description: The lattice-framed linden has been interwoven with lengths of flyrsilk to allow ease of movement within the room, the well-brushed wool rugs set parallel to the planks that cover the floor.  The glass-inlaid metal lanterns stand in neat rows beneath an immaculate white marble statue, the lantern flames quietly burning alongside a similarly designed incense burner.  Wrought gold leaves encircle the recess, the filigree-like design laying stark against the pale stones.

title: [The Spirits Within, Venom]
[The Spirits Within, Caution]
description: The ebon-dyed bourde drapes against the high-arcing frames form shadowed veils across the room, the sounds of foot traffic muffled by the thick wool rugs littering the ground.  The dimly lit lanterns illuminate the deeply carved recess, partially obscured by the heavy haze of incense smoke obscuring the area.  Set within the recess is an ashen marble statue, the figure enshrouded by a cloak of black velvet.

title: [The Spirits Within, Worry]
[The Spirits Within, Mania]
description: The thick woven wools suspended from the ironwood frame fray slightly across the fur-lined rugs covering the dirt beneath the shop, whipping wildly as the wind stirs the room.  Steel-forged lanterns cast sharp, disjointed patterns across the body of a red-streaked marble statue, the scent of soil and sweat intermingling with the remnants of smoldering incense that litter the statue's feet.  Sketches of unknown adventurers are affixed across the surface of the recess, intermingled with stubs of long burned out candles.

Unintelligible markings and punctures mar the surface of the recess, the marks covered by hand-smeared clumps of ash.

title: [The Spirits Within, Confusion]
[The Spirits Within, Fervent]
description: Wood and paeline construct the framework of the room, the simplistic design centered upon a single lantern highlighting the carved stone recess against the far wall.  Overlapping leaves have been interwoven in raised threads across the cotton rugs,  the design echoed in the wood that surrounds the pale cerulean marble statue set within the niche, indiscernible from years and hands.  A small altar carved from riverstone sits below the statue, the incense set atop burning steadily as the smoke rises to the heavens.

title: [Cysaelotar, Giggling Stones]
description: Falling in a gentle arc, the granite face of the cliff transitions from lofty heights to craggy slag as it descends to the south.  Drakar spikes, anchored into the stone by an industrious individual, causing the snow above to melt in the manufactured heat and creating a gentle waterfall that babbles like the smallest of brooks before pooling within a cluster of flat stones.  Slipping away from the area, a grass-edged narrow dirt track ascends to the top of the nearby mound.

title: [ImPressions]
description: Bent and slightly bruised, tall grass grows along the edges of the tent, though the main walking space has been trimmed down to a lush carpet of cushy green.  Several low tables and a river reed basket are scattered about the space and covered with a variety of wares.  Shimmering glass trinkets dangle from the rafters, their edges softly clicking against each other to provide a delicate tinkling within the bourde-swaddled environment.

title: [House Annex, Beacon Hall]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, an ivory tome and quill mural decorates the western wall under the light of several frosted glaesine globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Plush crimson carpeting dappled with gold threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of an ivory crushed velvet settee.  A lacquered beige door leads to the hallway, while an ivory-edged crimson silk curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Pigments of Memory]
description: Aisles created by river reed baskets form clearly defined paths upon the overlapping grass green rugs to the north and south, while tall bookcases are angled towards the easterly and westerly sections of the pavilion.  Standing alone in the center of the space, a long oak table covered with a red cloth houses a pillar-like lantern that sheds illumination throughout.  From somewhere to the south, a light breeze tugs on the various scrolls that are for sale.

title: [Cervidae Corral]
description: Bright blue, green, and red canopies stretch across a slender corridor created between the various corrals that stretch across the mixed grass and sedge ground.  Shepherd's crooks are bolted to the tall posts that flank a copper and oak gate, the lanterns dangling from them dormant for the moment.

Bright blue, green, and red canopies stretch across a slender corridor created between the various corrals that stretch across the mixed grass and sedge ground.  Shepherd's crooks are bolted to the tall posts that flank a copper and oak gate, each dangling a lantern that spills golden light upon the area.

title: [Common Cervidae Paddock]
description: Unkempt and wide, the ground is covered in wild sedge and blue-green grass, which is lazily being munched on by the various animals that wander about the open space.  The corral stretches southward, providing ample space for grazing and herd mingling.

title: [Cysaelotar, Song of the Wind]
description: Dormant lacquered paper lanterns cling to a downy birch tree that grows just beyond the shadows of the granite ridges, its leafy limbs stretching towards the bright blue sky.  Twisted knots lend the boughs that extend from the trunk the look of gnarled knuckles, while exposed roots resemble thick coils of rope that have been exposed to the elements for too long.  Colorful yarn, ribbons, and hemp mingle amid the verdant leaves, their ends strung with tiny baubles and beads that glimmer in the sunlight.

Cheery lacquered paper lanterns illuminate a downy birch tree that grows alone beyond the craggy granite ridges, its leafy limbs stretching towards the star-spangled sky.  Twisted knots in the thick boughs are dark spots above the nearly luminous white bark, while exposed roots stand out starkly in the snow-dappled grasses.  Colorful yarn, ribbons, and hemp mingle amid the verdant leaves, their ends strung with tiny baubles and beads that glimmer in the moonlight.

title: [The Lesser of Two Weevils]
description: Terracotta pots and containers of dark green fauna cover the walls of the room, leaving vines to entwine along the lotus-shaped bronze hooks interspersed in a haphazard fashion.  Stray beams of light cast scattered shadows along the ebonwood-planked floor of the shop, highlighting the iridescent beetle carapaces that are inlaid into the wood.  Set within the middle of the room is a sigil-carved marble stand, upon which a leather-bound volume sits between two melted tapers.

title: [Ferocious Eyes]
description: Anchored by spikes hidden amid a ring of river reed baskets, a central support post rises from the center of the space to create a peak of mottled canvas.  Tiny glaesine orbs dangle from braided hemp coils that spiral out from the tall post towards the smooth walls, each blinking as if fireflies are trapped within them.  The dim lighting is just enough to make out the various parchments stored on a nearby oak table and within a towering oak bookcase.

title: [Can't Stop That Weaving]
description: Hanging from the rafters of this spacious tent is a series of woven baskets filled with flowers that create a fragrant canopy above.  A small counter covered with bits of leaves and petals rests under a set of wooden shelves.  Set to one side is a narrow table covered with vases, their slender necks filled with a variety of colorful blossoms.

title: [View From a Stag]
description: Alternating bark-heavy and fully sanded timber is tightly stacked to create makeshift railings, tables, and displays hung with a variety of kaajkur and kaajkur accessories.  The area immediately surrounding the wares is well-lit by blazing lanterns, several of which spout blue flames, but the heavy, dark velvet tent fabric seems to eat up the light closer to the shadowed walls.  Circling a silver cart near the entry, a collection of incense and candles fills the air with the heavy scent of vanilla and pine trees.

title: [The Greater of Two Weevils]
description: An assortment of mats is scattered over the tent floor, each made of bamboo slats painted with red poppies and sepia leaves.  Colorful paper lanterns strung overhead illuminate a series of wooden display racks poised atop a raised platform.  An unopened crate branded with strange markings has been pushed out of the way and partially concealed by a large earthenware pot.

title: [Pigments of Memory, Southeast]
description: Dominated by a peaked roof and mottled walls, the shop has a floor of overlapping rugs in a grass green hue bordered with goldenrod yellow flowers.  Dangling orbs of frosted glaes fill the space with a soft light that is ample enough to view the wares that are stored in a nearby oak bookcase.  Though the light does not fully reach a long oak table surrounded by river reed baskets, it still provides enough illumination to read the vellums found on and within them.

title: [Cervidae Corral]
description: Sunlight slips through haphazardly arranged canvas awnings that stretch across a corridor built between the various paddocks of the copper and oak corral.  Black sedge dapples the ground and sprouts up between the supports, the tufts left natural to allow the animals stored here something to munch on.  Dormant lanterns mark the entrance to a western paddock, where someone has tied colorful ribbons that flutter in the wind.

A southern paddock, accessed through a narrow gate, abuts the distant birch forest with its furthest railings.

title: [Goin' Stag, Showroom]
[Goin' Stag]
description: Dark gold and green wool enclose this small area.  A pair of wooden bins stand next to a small wooden table in the center of a torn canvas carpet.  The walls of the tent ripple as a strong breeze blows against them.

title: [The Beacon Lounge]
description: The polished red sandstone floors and dark modwir wainscoting give this ample lounge a peaceful warmth.  Deep-cushioned chairs are drawn up around a white and red marble fireplace, above which hangs a dramatic seascape flanked by a pair of sconces in which candles brightly gleam.

title: [North Dock, Drenched Thrak Pier]
description: Five distinct piers made of water-roughened oak and teak come together to create a large docking structure with ample room for portage.  Cork and canvas bumpers pad each docking slip, and the soft sound of waves slapping against wooden support posts fills the air.  A carved driftwood sign reads, "Drenched Thrak Pier - Slips 1-5."

description: Frosted globes nestled within decorative wall sconces provide a steady glow of welcoming light down the long corridor.  The walls are hidden behind bright ivory white silk drapery, the soft ends of which pool upon the thick cerulean and azure carpet.  Built into opposing walls, a lacquered white door and a lacquered beige door part the drapery and have a trio of brightly glowing globes directly above their pointed, cinquefoil frames.

Beneath the churning waves mermaids frolic with dolphins, while sea hags coax sailors from their ships.  A large wrought iron ring anchored to the ceiling holds a glass-paned lantern over a curtained opening and provides ample illumination over the navy blue and gold rug-covered ground.

title: [Ruol's Outfitting]
description: Beneath a vaulted ceiling, a blue watered silk tapestry hangs on one of the smooth granite walls.  A floral-etched ceramic case and a gilded maple table sit in opposite corners while a bronzed drake sculpture rests on a glossy mahogany floor.

title: [Hathus's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a mistwood beam ceiling, a portrait of Darkstone Castle hangs on one of the glossy mistwood walls.  A glass-topped mistwood counter sits in one corner while a worn rug rests on the oak floor.

title: [Ruol's Magic Shoppe]
description: Beneath a mosaic tiled ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  A gilded maple table and a glass-topped mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a glossy mahogany floor.

title: [Ruol's General Store]
description: Beneath a mosaic tiled ceiling, a tattered merchant permit hangs on one of the blue watered silk walls.  A gilded maple table and a glass-topped mistwood counter sit in opposite corners while a worn rug rests on a glossy mahogany floor.

title: [House Annex, House of Paupers]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, the western wall is painted royal blue and dominated by a mural depicting a trio of goblets, which is illuminated by the warm glow of several frosted glaesine globes anchored to the ceiling.  Plush silver carpeting dappled with dark blue threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of a plush blue velvet settee.  A lacquered beige door leads to the hallway, while a blue-edged silver silk curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Gemstoned, Beasts]
description: Fist-sized rocks anchor the off-white oilcloth panels of the tent's walls to the ground, preventing the subalpine breezes from invading the tent, while woolen rugs help provide additional insulation.  A long oak table displays a variety of wares and neatly bisects the space into two even aisles.  A pair of copper-edged lanterns with frosted-glass doors offers ample illumination for browsing guests.

title: [Robes of Resistance]
description: A wide burgundy and black screen creates a partitioned dressing area along a velvet-padded wall, opposite a series of burnished steel hooks beneath a brass-framed sign.  Open drawers hang precariously out of an oak cabinet, with hints of disarranged silks peeking from within.  Shoved within a corner is a pile of discarded shoes with torn vamps and broken soles.

title: [Flypaper Designers, Industry]
description: Splashes of soot-like hues decorate the upper edges of the canvas pavilion's walls, the dark smears resembling dirt clouds in a grey sky.  Lower along the off-white wall, grey, black and bright white speckles randomly appear.  Soft incandescent lighting illuminates the brick-hued carpets that line the floor, as well as a simple bookcase lined with art-covered shelves.

title: [Flypaper Designers, Floral Den]
description: Off-white canvas splattered with varied pigments form the walls and high ceiling of the labyrinthine pavilion which is illuminated by dusky orbs that shed flickering multicolored lights.  Thick carpets stave off the cold of the festival grounds, though a light breeze does trickle in beneath the unbound ends of the tent's flaps.  Plain and unassuming, a small bookcase lined with art-covered shelves rests against the western wall.

title: [Flypaper Designers, Artistry]
description: Painted in vivid colors and with lifelike realism, a mural decorates the northern wall of the pavilion and stretches into the ceiling.  Along the western edge, gnomish trinkets, baubles, devices, and mechanisms are depicted in garish grey, black, and mud brown hues as they encroach upon the verdant foliage of the eastern side that is redolent with fauna, organic growth, and vibrant elementals.  Pure white globes illuminate the space, while a smooth bench rests upon the thick carpeting.

title: [Flypaper Designers, Blank Slate]
description: Resembling a gnomish mechanism, the chandelier that hangs from the ceiling is wrought in the image of a mechanical octopus that is juggling frosted globes.  The beast's one eye is dominated by a monocle that is pinned to a wrought iron bowtie, while its head is topped with a jauntily-set tricorne.  Beneath, a carpet woven in a sea wave pattern stretches across the cold ground, a simple wooden table resting at its center.

title: [Hovel on the Hill]
description: Perched upon a barren hill surrounded by large stone outcroppings, a hovel of stone and slate rests half in shadows and sunlight.  A white birch door provides entry to the small structure and is flanked by stained glass windows that are cheery to the otherwise austere surroundings.  Flying high and proud, a banner of chocolate brown flutters in the alpine breeze.

Perched upon a barren hill surrounded by large stone outcroppings, a hovel of stone and slate rests half in shadows and moonlight.  A white birch door provides entry to the small structure and is flanked by stained glass windows that are cheery to the otherwise austere surroundings.  Flying high and proud, a banner of chocolate brown flutters in the alpine breeze.

title: [Hovel]
description: Lamb's wool panels of silver fall in gentle folds along the four walls of the hovel, their tailored ends pooling on the polished oak floorboards.  Plump cushions of bronze and ebon surround a bowl-shaped metallic brazier to the left of the entry, while a polished oak desk surrounded by porcelain urns rests to the right.

title: [The Weeping Isle]
description: Waves batter the island's shores relentlessly, sending curtains of salty water skyward.  A low wall encircles the grounds as the only measure of safety against the rocks and watery depths below.  Four rectangular pillars, each roughly two feet high and bearing a distinct rune, form the corners of a sand garden.  In the center of the garden stands a flickering blue portal.  A rope and plank bridge connects to a rune-covered tower to the west, while an arching catwalk leads north to a gilded, dome-capped spire that glitters in the sunlight.

title: [Isle of Wisdom, Grounds]
description: Extending from the base of an arching catwalk, meticulous sand and crushed shell paths wind their way through lush, well-tended flowerbeds toward the islet's ivory spire.  A dome of shining gold caps the tall tower, glistening in the bright sunlight.  The smell of salt permeates the area anew with each successive crash of the ocean against the small island's rocky shores.  A set of ironwood double doors affixed with a small plaque leads inside the tall tower.

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Rotunda]
description: Several potted ferns are scattered around the spacious entryway, and filtered sunlight slants in through tall stained glass windows.  A tiled marble walkway leads out to an expansive terrace.  A matching pair of carefully pruned ficus trees in dark bamboo planters flank a curtained archway.  Painted in bright red and blue, a gnome statue props open a set of ironwood double doors.

title: [Tower of Knowledge]
description: Smooth, pale stone walls encircle the spacious area, and evenly dispersed windows provide plenty of light.  A large portrait hangs next to a pale stone arch, and above the arch is an elegant sign.  Tucked into an alcove are some rough stone steps flanked by a gold-bound plaque and a highly polished gold sconce.  Rising through the center of the ceiling is a wrought-iron spiral staircase.  Accessible through an archway to the east is a rope and plank bridge.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Observatory]
description: Rising through a perfect circle centered in the smooth, pale limestone floor is a wrought-iron spiral staircase.  Five tall arches support a colorful stained glass dome overhead.  Sunlight streaming through the multicolored shards creates a slowly moving collage on the stone below.  A tarnished brass telescope sits on the balcony that encircles the structure.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Instruction]
description: A large chandelier hangs from the ceiling, its multicolored droplets casting colorful patterns on a pile of training cauldrons that are stacked in a corner.  A pair of potted ferns sit at the base of some rough stone steps.  A refreshment cart provides a focal point for idle staff and guests.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Office]
description: Stretching across the floor is a cerulean silk rug displaying a woven map of Kraken's Fall and its surroundings.  Training Administrator Caelisa sits behind an immense ironwood desk, which is centered in front of an extensive bow window.  Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves occupy all available wall space, each shelf containing perfectly shelved books, tomes, and scrolls.  A pair of wingback chairs with intricately scrolled arms and legs flank a pale stone arch.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Cauldron]
description: Tucked back in an alcove out of main view, an iron cauldron hangs from an iron arm protruding from a large hearth.  A small stack of wood sits nearby, along with a burnished copper dustpan and broom.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Nexus]
description: A crystal chandelier hangs from above, casting dim light on a rough ring of leather armchairs.  Vine-etched arches lead off in various directions, while their spandels depict wizards locked in battle with beasts from ages long past.  Nearly hidden behind a tapestry is a darkened alcove.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Alcove]
description: Various tools and implements, ranging from small pruning shears to a large saw, hang on a corkboard along one wall of the small space.  Built into a corner is a wooden broom closet with a large dust bin nearby.  A small candle sputters in a sconce near the egress.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Workshop]
description: Smooth slate tiles, cut into perfect hexagons, line the floor in a honeycomb pattern.  The floor is largely devoid of detritus and marks, save for a slight depression in front of a smooth driftwood workbench.  Through rune-etched glass, a large arched window provides a view of the sun sparkling on the ocean waves.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Library]
description: Centered along the back wall is a polished alder desk neatly laid out with fresh parchment and a full well of ink. Occupying the remaining wall space are floor-to-ceiling bookshelves overflowing with books, tomes, scrolls, and parchments.  Suspended from the ceiling is a polished brass chandelier.

Occupying the remaining wall space are floor-to-ceiling bookshelves overflowing with books, tomes, scrolls, and parchments.  Suspended from the ceiling is a polished brass chandelier.

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Meeting Hall]
description: A narrow aisle leads down a slight incline toward a dais containing a lectern and several blue velvet padded chairs.  To either side of the aisle, tiers of wooden benches offer adequate seating.  Colorful tapestries on the walls depict memorable moments in wizarding history.  A small band of light shines through a curtained archway, illuminating a strip of carpet.

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Terrace]
description: A sheet of crystal clear water cascades down the tower wall to splash into a shale-lined pool.  Keeping the pool from overflowing, a small stream meanders around meticulous flowerbeds before plunging off the far side of the ledge into the ocean below.  A nervous guild apprentice stands mostly hidden behind a topiary in the shape of a jumping dolphin.  A tiled marble walkway leads back into the tower through a shadowed arch.

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Substructure]
description: Torches blaze in the sconces on the walls, keeping a majority of the shadows at bay.  A threadbare red woolen runner spans the distance from a wide arch and a darkened alcove.

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Supplies]
description: The cramped space is immaculate, with not a single item out of place.  All available wallspace contains shelves packed with wares.  Light from several lanterns reflects off gems and phials in a plethora of colors.  Propped on a long wooden counter is a folded paper sign that simply reads, "ORDER."

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Storeroom]
description: Wrought iron lanterns hang from the ceiling, brightly illuminating the tidy room.  Dust cloth in hand, a store room clerk moves between a rough ironwood table and a driftwood shelf, keeping everything tidy and clean.

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Reception]
description: Beautiful paintings cover the walls, honoring wizards from all over Elanith.  From ancient, shriveled elves to scraggly haired gnomes, each picture is a masterpiece.  Some of the frames have small name plates to identify the subject, but most of the pictures leave the content forever anonymous.  In the center of the room sits a currently empty desk, adorned only with a cup of coffee.  Beyond the desk is a gold-banded ironwood door.

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Main Office]
description: A spotless blue silk runner leads from a gold-banded ironwood door to a large mahogany desk.  Stacks of parchments cover the desk, and a quill and inkpot sit close at hand.  Guild Master Qitrana stands behind the desk, enjoying the sunlight streaming through a wide window.

title: [Tower of Wisdom, Golden Dome]
description: A dozen classical columns rise overhead to support a dome of bright gold.  The view in any given direction is spectacular, whether it be the sun glittering on the open ocean or Kraken's Fall itself.  The sound of crashing waves competes with the cawing of seabirds for dominance.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Alcove]
description: Sea blue-robed acolytes, their arms laden with waterlogged scrolls, shuffle about while sorting their goods into small niches in the rockface.  Laid out in concentric circles, cerulean tiles wrap around a small pool in the center of the alcove, rippling outwards in a wavelike pattern.  Glass-covered channels guide water in from the hallway, flowing into the pool, only to continue towards a moss-covered opening in the southern wall.

title: [Willow Lodge, Clearing]
description: Cloaked in frost-covered moss, a low cobblestone wall separates tall snow-laden pine trees from a courtyard cleared of snow.  The area is sheltered from the howling winds by the surrounding conifers.  A well trodden path leads from within the trees, circuitously around a large fire pit ringed with smooth stone benches, and up to a sturdy wooden lodge.  Behind the lodge, a footpath leads down to a rickety fishing shanty at the end of a sagging, wooden dock jutting into an ice-covered pond.

title: [Willow Lodge, Fishing Shanty]
description: A low-hanging lantern sways from a rafter overhead, lighting the walls which are crafted from old, wooden planks.  A hand-carved oak rack and some low shelves have been nailed to the wall near a lopsided door.  In the middle of the room, the oaken floor has been cut away, revealing the frozen pond beneath with several holes chopped in the ice allowing access to the frigid water.  Stools have been placed around the opening in the floor, while thick furs are piled in one corner near a wood burning stove.

title: [Willow Lodge, Great Room]
description: Candles flicker in a tiered antler chandelier hanging from the rafters in this large, open room.  Smooth black walnut floors give way to an imposing dark stone fireplace opposite a pair of black willow doors.  A wide pine bench piled high with plush furs stretches beneath an expansive window along the western wall, providing a cozy respite and a magnificent view of the ice plains beyond.  To the east, a verdant woven silk tapestry hangs upon the wall between matching bone-carved sconces.

title: [Willow Lodge, Storage]
description: The walls are lined with alternating bleached pine and black willow paneling above rows of gleaming steel storage boxes.  A simple pine bench is stationed in the middle of the room upon a polished grey stone floor.

title: [Library, Meeting Hall]
description: A trio of wide stairs lead down from a wide archway into this brightly lit room.  A small podium stands atop a small dais opposite the archway, and several cushioned benches have been arranged throughout the space, each offering an excellent line of sight.  A number of elliptical windows line the walls of the hall, and a rich crimson-patterned carpet covers the entirety of the floor underfoot.

title: [Cloudberry Room, Cubbyhole]
description: The small room ends in a dark leather curtain which is drawn shut.  Remnants of old advertising slogans are painted onto the curtain.

title: [Cloudberry Room Locker]
description: The grey stone walls are bare, except for brass wall sconces with candles burning cheerfully.  A woolly, rolton fur rug stretches out on the floor of this small room.

title: [Sigil Shop, Storage]
description: Shifting fog swirls through the room in visible whorls and eddies illuminated by the dim glow of a hanging lantern.  Though nearly lost in shadow and haze, complex sigils etch the walls and flicker with faint color.  Dusty trunks and crates fill the room with a maze-like disarray, but an ornately carved wooden wardrobe stands open against the far wall and gleams with recent polish, a narrow table draped with white cloth nestled at its side.

title: [Sigil Shop, Armory]
description: Fog from the north continues to permeate every available space in the room, leaving no corner unobscured.  Small and large sigils of bright colors fade in and out of view along each wall, briefly illuminating previously unseen armor stands.

title: [The Yarrrpee Shoppe]
description: Planks of sun-bleached wood have been reinforced by iron rivets, the disorganized shop resembling the interior of a ramshackle ship.  Faded flags of unknown origin are draped against the walls, providing a backdrop for a cluttered stained wood wardrobe and a heavily notched wooden chest firmly wedged towards the back.  A chum bucket sits empty in the back corner, save for a bright yellow pineapple.

title: [The Yarrrpee Shoppe, Closet]
description: The haphazardly nailed closet is both narrow, yet oddly spacious.  An oversized steel birdcage stands guard over a number of rolled up maps, the scrawled renderings of mysterious locales laid bare between stains of ale and saltwater.  A torn hemp net decorates the back wall, dangling random props that sway with every movement of the wagon.

title: [Sparrow's Dance, Atelier]
description: Slender trellises of smoky haon and pale linden drape fragrant garlands of lavender grey roses, the vine work entwined along the tall lacquered pillars set into each corner of the shop.  Graduated pewter chains suspend starburst-shaped lanterns of vellum, the soft light illuminating a wrought pewter display against the back wall, the curio framed by charcoal-drawn renderings of various elven cites.

title: [Stay Vigilant]
description: At odds with the grungy exterior, the interior of the tent is gently glowing with a variety of lit candles casting a golden light over the sparse furnishings and large oval rug of silver-threaded linen.  Forming a centerpiece in the middle of the shop is a large polished silver candelabra, proudly displayed atop a wooden platform.  A tent flap flutters in the breeze, offering an exit to the village.

title: [Wild Instinct]
[Wild Instinct, Entry]
description: With much of the exterior structure partially buried in the ground, the cracked stone walls of this edifice are covered in a mixture of clinging dampness and dirt that stain them a murky brown.  Guttering candles, their flames a livid green, are scattered around a cracked stone altar and the armor stand next to it, the eerie light glinting off the items arrayed on top of them.  The air is stuffy and still, the accumulated dirt and mold creating a musty smell that clings to everything.

title: [Wild Instinct, Shrine]
description: Little light filters into this tiny alcove, making the only illumination the various green-flamed candles set into several nooks along the uneven walls.  There is not much room for anything besides a flat stone shrine, which stretches across the entire space.  Abandoned offerings of feathers and animal bones litter the floor, creating a narrow pathway of treacherous footing.  The overwhelming scent of moist earth, mixed with a faint aroma of incense, permeates the damp air.

title: [Untamed Spirit, Entry]
description: Dampness clings to the cracked stone walls of this lopsided hut, making the enclosed space perpetually moist and musty.  Guttering candles, their flames a sullen blue, are scattered around a central stone altar and the prayer rug laid out in front of it, the various items arrayed on top of them subtly reflecting the eerie light.  Wind constantly seeps into the area, sending the ragged animal hide over the door fluttering every so often.

title: [Untamed Spirit, Niche]
description: Hewn into the stone walls without much care for aesthetics, this niche is cramped and close.  Thin candles, their flames burning dull blue, are scattered around the space, lending scant illumination to a rickety shield rack in one corner and some rusted iron hooks set into the wall above it.  The musty smell of damp stone permeates the air.

title: [Untamed Spirit, Shrine]
description: Little light filters into this tiny alcove, making the only illumination the various blue-flamed candles set into various nooks along the uneven walls.  There is not much room for anything besides a squat stone shrine, which stretches across the entire space.  Abandoned offerings of feathers and animal bones litter the floor, creating a narrow pathway of treacherous footing.  The overwhelming scent of mold, mixed with a faint aroma of incense, permeates the damp air.

title: [Heady Spirits, Entry]
description: Cramped and musty, there isn't a whole lot of extra room within this small shed.  Burning candles, their flames a dull purple, are scattered around a low ivory shrine, which is pushed up against the back wall.  Sitting in one corner is a branching stand constructed from bleached bone, its tiered arms pressed flush to the stone behind it.  Tiny bones and feathers litter the dirt floor, making the footing precarious.

Burning candles, their flames a dull purple, are scattered around several stone figures sitting on the floor, which are decorated with various types of hats and headdresses.  Sitting in one corner is a branching stand constructed from bleached bone, its tiered arms pressed flush to the stone behind it.  Tiny bones and feathers litter the dirt floor, making the footing precarious.

title: [Mystic Phrases]
description: Several tented and rusted cauldrons are placed about the small room to collect the steadily dripping water that seeps through the sodden roof.  Tiny rivulets cascade down the northern wall, their passage causing the paint to blister and peel.  A small round table sits in the only dry section of both floor and ceiling, its contents illuminated by a flickering candle.

title: [Mystic Phrases]
description: Warped and uneven, the wall-to-wall pine floorboards display signs of water damage, which cause many of the copper nails to rise up from the seating within the wood.  Floor-to-ceiling bookcases are pristinely kept, their clean shelves a stark contrast to the utter gloom that hangs over the rest of the shop.  A lone candle rests upon a counter covered in cobwebs, its flickering flame threatening to consume the dusty gossamer strands.

title: [You're So Vain]
description: Pristine high quality rugs of finely woven wool line the ground beneath the silk tent.  A series of polished silver racks line the circumference and a pile of plush pillows is available to rest upon.  A table of refreshments are available near the tent flap and a large mirror is propped up near the racks for patron use.

title: [At The Ready]
description: Simply assembled planks of black oak and limestone compose the outer structure for the fairly spacious dwelling.  Dusty iron lanterns hang from the four cobweb-strewn corners of the squared space, emanating with a dreary, wavering glow that spreads over a high-backed aged teak chest and a rough-hewn white cedar rack.  Arranged at the back, a splintered mistwood case is bookended by a heap of discarded whittling tools and haphazard curls of lumber scraps.

title: [Covert Couriers, Basement]
description: Filth and grime cover every inch of the surfaces down here.  A small wet drip plinks somewhere off in the dark, and a musty stench permeates the air.  The only light to speak of glimmers through the warped floorboards above your head.

title: [Sprite Club, The First Rule]
[The First Rule]
description: Eclectic and cluttered, the dust-free shop has shelves filled with bric-a-brac and knickknacks that range in color, shapes, and sizes.  Frosted globes hover scant inches from the ceiling, their soft white glow casting eerie shadows that dance and flicker.  Short and tall armor mannequins create a maze of interestingly posed bodies throughout the center of the floor.

title: [Burning Twilight, Entry]
description: Pendulum lanterns of frosted glass dangle from the lofty ceiling of bright blue azure, each creating bright pools of golden sunlight.  Grass green floorboards, swept clean and left uncluttered, support a long, oak counter where weapons are displayed within the pools of light.  Stained glass decorates the edges of the large picture window that gazes out on the dirty thoroughfare, while a radiant sun in goldenrod and dandelion yellow fills the door's frame.

title: [Burning Twilight, Northern Ray]
description: Tall golden and crimson banners are hung by thick, braided rope along the walls from the ceiling.  A golden display case is raised on golden arms beneath which a sun-shaped rug sits.  Set in each corner are a collection of candles of varying heights, burning brightly of varying shades of a sunset.

title: [Burning Twilight, Eastern Ray]
description: Azure paints blend into the twilight hues of a dying day across the rafters of the ceiling, while star-shaped votive holders fashioned of stained glass dangle from above.  Pale grey dominates the walls, except for melon and amethyst-hued curtains that frame the windows.  Various weapon racks stand at even intervals about the space, their wares glimmering in the dim light.

title: [Burning Twilight, Western Ray]
description: Pale grey paints transform the ceiling from misty uncertainty to the west into a bright blue sky in the east.  Warm yellow hues fill the aisles with golden light that descends from blown glass orbs that are suspended from the rafters.  Gossamer drapery of wispy white flutter as the ambient air slips through the area, their ends occasionally catching on the weapon racks and their display of wares.

title: [Get Thee Behind Me]
description: Windows line the walls of the wagon, though each is rendered useless by a heavy layer of soot in addition to the shield rack that blocks an entire row itself.  On a small counter beneath one of the windows is a steel-framed note and a dingy oil lamp, and a tattered ivory vellum sign lined with faded script is hooked carelessly over one of the rack's supports.

title: [Get Thee Behind Me]
description: Sparse slivers of light peek in through clear streaks on the sooty windows by virtue of a cleaning job only half-done, and a wall-length shield rack occupies the rear of the wagon.  A tattered ivory vellum sign lined with faded script dangles from a broken peg on the side of the rack.

title: [Currents and Safeguards]
description: Utilizing nearby pine and cedar trees for support, a canvas awning is strapped to the arbors to form a ceiling for the airy shop.  Blue, green, red, and brown panels are tacked to the ground and around the trees used to anchor the roof to give the displays a unique trapezoidal shape, while the gap between panels makes it breezy.  Display racks, barrels, crates, and a series of rough haon pegs house the various wares, which are carefully watched over by the broody proprietor.

title: [Potation Parlor]
description: Cradled within the frame of an abandoned building, the shop features a scorched mural born from a past fire and shaped into art.  A dingy counter rests against one wall and several stools are available for seating.  An opening in a crumbling wall offers access to the outside.

title: [In Your Element]
description: The interior of the building is clearly divided into four quadrants, each one bearing striking symbols and pieces of artwork pertaining to a distinct element.  At the exact center of the room is a pedestal, itself divided into four equal segments.  Torches burn in each of the four quadrants, each illuminating their individual section while also serving to cast light on their neighbors.  Atop the pedestal sits a series of wrought iron hooks.  A heavy drape leads out of the shop.

title: [Metrognomies, Wagon Interior]
description: Golden candlelight warms the darkened interior of this wagon, casting flickering shadows along the tools hanging on the walls and stacks of metal bits stowed haphazardly within.  An oak worktable sits centered within the small open space, its surface meticulously clean in comparison.  A semi-circle of a dozen tall candles ring the backside of the table highlighting a red velvet runner carefully draped across the surface displaying the wares for sale.

title: [The Vaalin Rose, Cargo Hold]
description: Polished oak beams frame out the spacious cargo hold, their lengths carved with various symbols and images.  Several large iron racks displaying various pieces of armor line one side of the room while sealed boxes and crates are piled on the other.  The light from a trio of dark bronze lanterns casts a pale glow on the collection of items for sale.

title: [The Vaalin Rose, Cargo Hold]
description: Stacks of unopened crates, boxes, and barrels line the walls of the massive hold.  Tucked away in a corner is a small wooden table.  Several large iron stands are placed down the center showing off their wares.  Narrow beams of light, shifting through a grate above, shed fractured illumination over the area.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Landing]
description: Rough oak floorboards form a small, squarish landing that encircles a rickety set of wooden stairs that descends to the level below.  Whitewashed walls, newly painted and clean, lend a sterile and austere air to the small space that is only enhanced by the scent of medicinals in the air.  Wrought iron hooks flank a closed white door, their curved edges supporting various overcoats and smocks.

title: [Curved Cuts]
description: Narrow and ramshackle, the small shop is built in a small alley between more permanent structures.  Dirty oak planks are wedged between the left and right buildings to form a ceiling that is almost certainly too low for the average giantman.  Brass lanterns keep the wares displayed on several nearby hooks brightly illuminated throughout the day and night.  A coarse, striped blanket covers the ground as a sort of makeshift rug.

title: [Shadowed Light]
description: The subtle smell of old blood lingers in the air as dried pools of the sanguineous substance, along with various drips, mar the already damaged wood floors.  A series of hangers hang from rusted hooks protruding from soiled walls, with small oil lanterns between them.  Resting against a far wall is a pine table, its surface bare save for a few scraps of paper.

title: [Shadowed Light]
description: Sheer, black gossamer painted with small, silver moons and stars hang across loosely planked walls in a poor attempt to dress up the room.  Soft light from several mostly melted candles reflects upon the moons and stars on the fabric, creating the illusion of dancing fireflies in the dim room.  A leather-bound chest, its lid propped open by a pronged pole, sits off to one side of the area across from a pine closet with its door broken off the hinges.

title: [Shadowed Light]
description: Piles of muck, along with other questionable substances, are scattered about the area and corners of the room.  Seemingly out of place, a compartmented case sits beside a segmented armor stand in the middle of the room, both surrounded by ostentatious candelabras casting light into even the darkest corners.

title: [Fatal Afflares, Breach]
description: Much like a turbulent sky foretelling an impending storm, swirls of dark grey paint cover the lofty ceiling of this shop, and a multitude of wares are strewn about haphazardly as if they had been ravaged by a fierce whirlwind.  Crushed boxes and half-sealed containers are piled into one corner, while tumbled stacks of paper litter a crevice-laden floor.  An elaborate painting dangles on a thin wire and is partially supported by a damaged rain barrel that rests directly beneath.

Much like a turbulent sky foretelling an impending storm, swirls of dark grey paint cover the lofty ceiling of this shop, and a multitude of wares are strewn about haphazardly as if they had been ravaged by a fierce whirlwind.  Crushed boxes and half-sealed containers are piled into one corner, while tumbled stacks of paper litter the irregular floor.  An elaborate painting dangles on a thin wire along the back wall and is partially supported by a damaged rain barrel that rests directly beneath.

title: [Bloodbenders]
description: The pavilion's dark red, ridgeweaver silk walls are held up by slender, black oak poles, and they stir with the slightest breeze or movement, rippling like crimson liquid as they do.  Large piles of scarlet and black pillows are tucked neatly in each corner of the tent.  Two crystalline morduska statues stand as bookends on each side of a long, black velvet-lined case.

title: [Bloodbenders, North Vein]
description: The dark red walls of the pavilion are stretched tight by black oak poles, the slightest breeze causing the ridgeweaver silk to rustle faintly.  Along the back wall stands a dark bronze statue, depicting the image of a robed figure with his hands cupped outward.  Oddly, small rivulets of blood drip periodically from between the statue's curled fingers.  A long, red velvet-lined case rests near the northern end of the tent.

title: [On the Other Hand]
description: The oaken floorboards of the airship's decks slope sharply, making navigation difficult.  Most of the furniture is in a pile at the hull, except for a few trunks and chests that remain lashed to the bulkheads on either side of a narrow ladder leading below deck.  A large cabinet lies on its side, the doors smashed open, revealing a small cache of weapons inside.

title: [On the Other Hand, Below Deck]
description: Cramped and lit only by one small lantern with dingy glaes panes, the storage area is stacked with crates, boxes, and overturned casks.  Rope hammocks swing from the overhead, no longer beds for the crew, but filled with a variety of arms.  A row of ports on the starboard side are filled with dirt rather than sky due to the angle of the sunken airship.

title: [On the Other Hand, Storage]
description: The air is stale in the cargo hold, filled with a variety of unpleasant, moldy odors.  A wine barrel of unknown vintage lies on its side, releasing its sour contents onto the floor one slow drip at a time.  Overhead, rusty hooks protrude from a low wooden ceiling above a long shelf.

title: [Cultural Cuts]
description: The grey and blue canvas of the tent walls reeks of salt, fish, and blood.  A half-krolvin with one arm sits comfortably on a stool in the corner, picking his teeth with a thin bone shard as his eyes guard the contents along a driftwood counter and a rusty anchor-shaped rack.  Old flakes of blood stain the floor like shriveled, crimson petals.

title: [Out of the Bleak]
description: The small tent holds the faint odor of acidic rain, and pale yellow hazy smoke curls up from a talon-shaped lantern positioned directly in the center of the room.  A circular, dark oak table is covered with tattered, blue vulture feathers and various walking sticks.  Suspended from the pavilion's center pillar are a series of stained hooks that perch over a battered wooden vanity.  Several patchwork bear hide rugs surround a small glaes display case.

title: [The Essencetials]
description: The size of a small building, the cloth walls of the tent are pulled tight and dyed a dark indigo hue and hold a few scorch marks along their surface.  Some gilt-hued racks are suspended from the pavilion's apex and a long black marble-topped counter stretches along the farthest end of the room.  Small crystalline bottles line a high wooden shelf, each container filled with a myriad of colorful motes of energy.

title: [The Librarium Annex, Purple]
description: The same shade of rich, royal purple dominates nearly every surface of this chamber, from the plush woven rug underfoot to the rune-stitched pennants dangling overhead.  Bookcases and cabinets line the chamber's walls, their shelves padded with matching purple felt and piled high with sheaves of papers for sale.  A purple-carpeted spiral staircase leads up and out of sight.

title: [The Librarium Annex, White]
description: Every surface of this chamber is cast in white and glass.  Against pale walls, bleached wooden bookcases and cabinets hold shelf after shelf of tidy white pages and manuscripts on glittering glass-crafted shelves.  A painted white staircase connects the chamber to the floor above, while a hint of purple indicates the way to the stairs leading back down.

title: [The Librarium Annex, Red]
description: From the painted ceiling to the carpeted floor, this chamber has been rendered in the same, exquisite shade of red.  Carmine light dances off the lacquered surfaces of the red bookcases and cabinets that line the chamber's walls, their shelves displaying a collection of papers and pages.  A single staircase, rendered in red, descends into the chamber below.

title: [The Knifery]
description: This rickety little shack seems to serve as a dagger museum of sorts.  Small blades of all shapes and provenances sit on display in time-worn glass cases hanging from the shack's walls, while other weapons are available for sale atop a crescent leather-topped table.  Above a rough log pedestal, a notice is stuck to the shack's walls by a rusted knife.

title: [Alchemical Attraction]
description: The four corners of this brightly colored marquee are elevated upon spiraling glaesine poles, each polished to a gleaming perfection.  Scraggly crabgrass makes up the floor, and a steady trickle of customers has worn a goat path from the entrance to a halfmoon table piled high with a hoard of cloaks, bags, and other sundries.

title: [Make Your Mark]
description: Despite the worsening condition of the exterior of the tower, the inside is clean and neatly furnished with numerous bookshelves.  The grass making its way between the cracks in the cobblestone floor has been meticulously trimmed, and the walls behind the pewter-caged lanterns providing illumination have been scrubbed clean of soot.  A lacquered linden table has been carved to follow the gentle curve of the circular tower wall, its surface covered by a woven sapphire blue table runner.

title: [Locksmehr River, Dock]
description: New planks rest against old ones in an alternating pattern that suggests recent repairs to the yawning dock, while scrubbed pylons wrapped in fresh rope display signs of antiquity.  Freshly shorn grasses ring the eastern edge of the shoreline where benches rest on the side of a pathway that splits in twain, causing one section to lead to the river's edge and the other to the village of Bloodriven.  Bobbing at anchor, a vessel with a mast carefully wrapped in glacial blue sails has a lowered gangplank.

New planks rest against old ones in an alternating pattern that suggests recent repairs to the yawning dock, while scrubbed pylons wrapped in fresh rope display signs of antiquity.  Freshly shorn grasses ring the eastern edge of the shoreline where benches rest on a pathway that leads to the village of Bloodriven.  Bobbing at anchor, a vessel with a mast carefully wrapped in glacial blue sails has a lowered gangplank that is unattended and inviting.

New planks rest against old ones in an alternating pattern across the slush-covered dock, the scrubbed pylons buried in chunks of snow.  Wreath-hung iron lampposts ring the eastern edge of the snowy shoreline where benches rest on the side of a pathway that splits in twain, causing one section to lead to the river's edge and the other to the village of Bloodriven.  Steady at anchor in the frozen waters, a vessel with a mast carefully wrapped in glacial blue sails has a lowered gangplank.

title: [The Long Snow, Encampment]
description: Beneath a dark sky lit only by the ripples of a vast, shifting aurora, the small encampment huddles on a hill of windswept ice.  Sharp icicles drip from a long hitching post, around which cold-bitten reindeer, mules, and yaks congregate in shared misery.  Higher up on the hill, a vast bonfire holds the unrelenting frost at bay, but only barely.  It blazes, whipped to a wild fury by the screaming winds, in a pit dug before an oiled hide ger mounted at the hill's flat summit.

title: [The Long Snow, River's Edge]
description: The expanse of ice ends.  A frigid flow of water laps sluggishly at the icy shore, having eaten away the permafrost to reveal black earth beneath.  Fog sweeps low over the flowing water, obscuring all but the vaguest details of what awaits on the far shore.  The skeletal silhouettes of trees occasionally claw through the grey blanket where the river is at its narrowest.

title: [The Long Snow, Expanse]
description: A small hillock rises to the south, breaching out of an otherwise featureless expanse of white snow and dark sky.  Fireglow flickers at the summit, a lonesome beacon amid the oppressive gloom and bitter cold.  In the darkness, the sounds of barking sled dogs and muted chatter from up above travel strangely, carrying for unusual distances as hollow echoes.

title: [The Long Snow, Expanse]
description: The cold is intense and cruel, sharp enough to cut.  Carried on waves of violent wind, it sweeps low over the snowy flats, whipping the fresh snowfall in undulating waves.  All around is white and grey.  If bird or beast dwell in such an unforgiving clime, their cries are drowned out by the relentless shriek of the winds.

title: [The Long Snow, Expanse]
description: To the north, a thin ribbon of silver winks at the edges of eyesight.  The river stretches wide enough that its far shore is lost in the mist and sleet that drapes heavily upon the world.  Through the racing clouds overhead, an aurora ripples across the sky, gold and green and royal blue, and its colors shimmer off of the distant water's surface invitingly.

title: [Kalivan's Caravans, Tent]
description: The interior of the tent is redolent with the musk of unwashed bodies and fire-warmed hide.  Two huge braziers of plain clay are positioned at the entrance, standing guard against the invading chill, but its shrill screams drown out the crackle of the roaring flames.  Behind a spindly modwir desk sits a perfunctory-looking halfling heavily swaddled in furs.  The logbook before him is splotched with snowmelt in places and the pages are warped by the damp, but it is mostly legible.

title: [Cold River, Dock]
description: A grim black dock pokes out into the Issenflow, its warped planks glinting with ice in the aurora's light.  Two shipping boats and a dilapidated barge are tied to the dock poles.  The sound of the water slapping their hulls provides sullen percussion, accompanied only by the taunting babble of the river's sluggish flow.

title: [Cold River, Issenflow Banks]
description: A sluggish flow of crystal clear water laps languidly at snow-clad banks.  Though the river is ebon in the twilight, the ripples of the aurora reflect in distorted tangles over its waters, the colors dancing across a nearby a log-framed encampment.  The far shore is lost in a blanket of thick mist that prowls low over the river's surface.  Fishing poles lean against the rear wall of a nearby hut with a pine-and-pitch facade, though a nearby spruce drying rack is bare of fish.

Fishing poles lean against the rear wall of a nearby hut with a pine-and-pitch facade, though a nearby spruce drying rack is bare of fish.

title: [Cold River, Outskirts]
description: The outskirts of a small hamlet are sheltered by a curving palisade of pine stakes.  A narrow gap in the wall serves as the only means of egress from the settlement.  Dwellings of raw timber, with windows of glass or oilcloth, huddle around a hard-packed dirt road leading deeper into the heart of the small village.  Near one home, furs hang on a laundry line, flapping on the sharp-edged breeze.  Smells of woodsmoke and fresh fish flavor the crisp, frigid air.

title: [Cold River, Thoroughfare]
description: A ramshackle tavern of raw pine presides over the stretch of roadway, the space before its burled wooden doors heavily trodden by countless small feet.  Its swinging sign is painted with a blunt-looking fist.  Several spent ale barrels sit beneath the eaves of the low, sloping roof, tracings of rime glistening on the wood in the aurora's light.  The lazy laughter of rushing water from the west is almost drowned out by the noise from the village center nearby.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, west, northwest

title: [Cold River, Village Center]
description: Several timber dwellings encircle a wide, clear space beneath the shadow of an ancient pine tree.  The gentle behemoth scrapes at the sky, its vast boughs gravid with white snow.  Though the barren earth makes for a poor town green, the pine has showered the area beneath it with a thick carpet of needles, both verdant and brown.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Cold River, Market]
description: Palpable melancholy drapes the marketplace like a funeral shroud.  The bustle of business between residents is muted, and its pace languorous.  Following the example of a singed wooden store, most shops have their doors open to the interminable twilight, though the candles winking from their windows do little to light the thin thread of road weaving between the buildings.

Silence drapes the marketplace like a funeral shroud.  Shops have their doors shut against the interminable twilight, and only a few candles, mostly spent, lend their dying light to the thin thread of road weaving between the buildings.

Palpable melancholy drapes the marketplace like a funeral shroud.  The bustle of business between residents is muted, and its pace languorous.  Shops have their doors open to the interminable twilight, though the candles winking from their windows do little to light the thin thread of road weaving between the buildings.

title: [Cold River, Bend]
description: A gloomy shrine of hewn river stone stands aside from a bend in the frozen dirt roadway.  Tokens and trinkets litter the ground before the facade, and some have rested there long enough to meld with the dingy ice mass at the building's base.  Charms of scrimshawed bone hang from its low eaves, clacking incessantly in the gelid wind.  From within, candlelight flickers.

title: [Cold River, Outskirts]
description: A rickety watch tower looks out over the northern curve of the palisade wall as it disappears into the surrounding woodlands.  Built of old wood and possessed of a decided lean, the construction looks to have seen better days.  With feet firmly dug into the hardpack, a rough-hewn spruce ladder ascends to the nest at the top of the guard post.

title: [Cold River, Wooded Walk]
description: Dense woodland crowds in upon the trail as it meanders away from the heart of town.  The branches of snow-draped trees weave together into a dark blanket that is leavened only by the occasional flicker of candlelight from ramshackle dwellings in the woods.  The whistle of trees through the branches is an ever-present melody, haunting and cold.  Bending gradually toward the northwest, the path cuts under the shadow of a skeletal elm whose branches wait like snatching talons over the walkway.

title: [Cold River, Cemetery]
description: Time-worn stone markers breach up from the frigid earth, marking more than a dozen gravesites scattered unevenly across a clearing in the woods.  Pine and spruce and elder bend close overhead, as if in mourning, and the woodland is silent, devoid of the cries of bird or beast.  A ragged silk ribbon, faded with age, is tied about a low-hanging branch.  Its dangling threads whip in the whispering breeze.

title: [Sparkfinger's Alchemy, Workroom]
description: Uneven light from the aurora wavers through windows of brown glass, glinting off of bubbles in the panes.  Several glowing lamps supplement the weak lighting, awakening glints and gleams from multicolored bottles on lopsided shelves lining the walls.  Behind a steel-topped counter, bubbles froth feverishly within a collection of beakers and flasks filled with multifarious fluids.

title: [Rawknuckle's, Watering Hole]
description: Low eaves, stained black with smoke, do little to keep out the icy chill of the outdoors, though they have been sealed in many places with acrid pine pitch.  The floor is an artless mosaic of uneven planks, most badly warped, and the nails securing them are more rust than iron.  Behind a carved counter of time-silvered wood is a collection of racks holding dusty bottles in a variety of colors, the containers framing a fur-covered ironwood door.

The floor is an artless mosaic of uneven planks, most badly warped, and the nails securing them are more rust than iron.  Behind a carved counter of time-silvered wood is a collection of racks holding dusty bottles in a variety of colors.

title: [Hinterwilds, Palisade]
description: An old pine palisade leans precipitously toward the outgoing road, a meandering stretch of hardpack and rocky earth that wriggles into the encroaching woodland.  Despite their obvious age, each wooden spike has a tip sharp enough to draw blood.  The trail, such as it is, proceeds through a small gap in the palisade wall.  To one side, a bent iron post supports a smoky old lantern whose flame does little to throw back the twilight.  Both post and housing are spotted heavily with rust.

title: [Cold River, Shrine]
description: The small domed shrine is comprised of hewn blocks of river stone.  Pine tar between the narrow cracks keeps out the worst of the ubiquitous chill, but it lends the air an acrid bite that overpowers the odor of the dozens of tallow candles warming and lighting the chamber.  They illuminate a large effigy on the rear wall of the shrine that sits atop a black block of stone veined with silver.  Carved from a single great whale bone, it depicts a woman with sorrowful eyes holding a set of ornate keys.

title: [Cold River, Watch Post]
description: At the top of a rough-hewn spruce ladder, the nest of the watch post looks out over a sea of white-capped trees.  The timbers of the foundation creak and groan, and the makeshift building sways in the breeze.

title: [Rawknuckle's, Pipe Den]
description: A mottled grey warg pelt stretches across the plank floor before an uneven brick fireplace on the eastern wall.  Several frayed chairs form a loose semicircle around the hearth.  Decades of pipe smoke has seeped into the surroundings, leaving the air stale with its burnt herbal tang.

title: [Hinterwilds, Beaten Path]
description: A thin westward trail has been worn out of the dense boreal woodland.  Spruce and pine boughs bend low over the path as if resentful of its intrusion into their domain.  The trees are heavy-laden with white snow, the undersides of many branches sharp with icicles that gleam in the aurora's light.  A silvery river flows sluggishly past the trees clustered to the south of the pathway.

title: [Hinterwilds, Issenflow Banks]
description: The woodland thins along the banks of the Issenflow.  Icy water gurgles along, driven by the river's sluggish currents.  In places, it has worn away the dark earth of the bank to reveal the spreading roots of the surrounding trees, and the blanched wood looks like exposed bone protruding from a wound.

title: [Hinterwilds, Runestone]
description: The wavering path bends away from a silver-shot ancient black runestone, giving the ancient monolith a wide berth.  The black stone is shot through with veins of rich silver, and there is strange writing adorning each of the four faces.  Much of the base of the obelisk is buried beneath the impenetrable, hard-frozen dirt.

title: [Hinterwilds, Issenflow Banks]
description: Mist enshrouds most the sinuous body of the Issenflow.  The wide, slow river moves just swiftly enough not to have frozen in the intense cold, but thin ice congregates along the dark earthen bank.  Through the fog, glimpses of the far shore suggest an endless expanse of white proceeding into the darkness of sunless twilight.

title: [Hinterwilds, Issenflow Banks]
description: Trapped in the thin skin of ice clinging to the river's edge, a small wooden boat has been abandoned by its occupants.  Without sunlight to silver the wood, it is difficult to tell how long the boat has been locked in place, but a carpet of snowfall now resides within.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: A faint sound like chiming crystals comes in tantalizing snatches on the shrill wind blowing off of the Issenflow to the south.  Spruce, pine, and hoarbeam trees form an unusually thick canopy overhead, heavy enough to block view of the sky, though not quite enough to keep the driving snow from the earth.  The trail is littered with needles in every shade from emerald green to blanched brown.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: A stand of hardy tamarack grows thick along the western edge of the trailway, their vibrant golden foliage contrasting vividly with the white of the icy landscape and the green of neighboring fir and hoarbeam.  Needles from all manner of conifers commingle in a multicolored blanket on the frozen earth.  The heavy foresting serves as a bar to the screaming winds, but not the unrelenting cold.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Paw prints from some variety of small four-legged animal mar the pristine white snow in a clearing between two great stands of conifers.  The tracks vanish under a carpet of spent green needles.  With the trees serving as a wind break, the faintest tang of spoor colors the crisp, dry air, an earthy undertone to the clean odor of pine resin that fills the area.

title: [Hinterwilds, Issenflow Banks]
description: A cruel, driving gale blows in from across the river, scattering the mist enough to provide clear view of the unending ice flats beyond.  The strength of the wind appears to have been enough to drive the trees back from the river bank, leaving only barren earth to greet the water.  Trees close to the banks are stunted, their growth warped by battering from the elements.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: The trail is an uncertain, meandering string of dirt worn out of the frosty underbrush.  It bends away from the river's edge, plunging deeper into the woods.  Pine cones hanging from the boughs straining over the trail are aglisten with frost, but they still fill the air with the effervescent bite of their resin.

title: [Hinterwilds, Issenflow Banks]
description: Fir and tamarack trees near to the edge of the water shake and shiver in the gusting gales coming off of the river.  Near to the water's edge, an woven bark basket lies on its side, half-frozen into the ice.  The basket is great in size and would be extremely cumbersome even if it weren't partially imprisoned in unyielding frost.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: A crude symbol has been etched by an unskilled hand into the trunk of an Ossian pine.  Ugly and sinuous, the mark lends the tree an unpleasant cast.  The needles are brittle and yellowing at the tips, and the bark looks puckered around the marking, as if infected.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Near the collapsed mouth of a great burrow in the ground lays the corpse of an immense scaled worm.  The creature's scales are a rich blue like a summer sky at midday, but they have largely been cut away in the work of butchering the great beast.  Segments of flesh are missing, revealing shining white bone underneath.  The hardness of the scales and the toughness of the creature's meat are evident in the wear on a pile of huge notched axes lying, frozen over, to one side of the carcass.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: The gnarled roots of a white-barked hoarbeam breach up through the earth to stretch across the path like knobby, arthritic fingers.  Intense cold has caused the old stalwart's trunk to burst in several places, and crimson sap bleeds from the fissures, filling the air with its effervescent scent.  Far above, the tree's dusky purple cones sway on the omnipresent breeze.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Broken stones amidst the fallen needles and snow banks herald the presence of an ancient stone roadway.  Remarkably intact despite its obvious age, it drives, arrow-straight, into the northern woodland.  The composite blocks of stone are unusually well-fitted.  Each is a sheer and unsullied white in color, the hue so intense as to make the abounding snow look drab.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Two small, huddled forms rest in the crook of an old, tall spruce's roots, locked in an embrace.  They are unmoving and their rime-traced flesh is a terrible shade of blue.  There is an incongruous tranquility to the area as nature seems to observe the doomed pair in silence.  Even the raging of the wind is but a distant whistle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Hinterwilds, Crystalline Glade]
description: A shrouded glade rests beneath a vast heart tree aglisten with thousands of icicles.  Illuminated by the aurora's refracted light, the frigid baubles glisten in glow in resplendent colors, casting the snowy clearing in tremulous shards of cool color.  The tree, a hoarbeam of impossible age and girth, has been carved with a facsimile of a face.  Beads of frozen resin gleam golden from the corner of each graven eye.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Hardpack gives way to a well-worn dirt trail that bends toward the east, from whence the tantalizing promise of woodsmoke and cooking meat beckons.  To either side of the walk, great trees have been reduced to stumps too even to be the work of nature.  The divide in the canopy overhead provides a clear view of the aurora's radiant splendor.  Its regal blues, sunny golds, and alien greens bathe the surroundings in a wondrous display of gentle light.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Ojandhaart, Approach]
description: The dirt roadway proceeds beneath a monumental arch of white granite, the surface of which is roughly carved with an arcing spray of runes.
