Holly climbs the base pillars, its bright red berries a stark contrast to the pallor of the stone.  Beyond, smoke rises from the high roofs of buildings made from raw timber and rough-hewn stone.  All of the buildings are several times the height of a tall man.

title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
description: Underbrush and towering conifers alike seem unwilling to trespass onto the pale stone roadway.  The frost-laden wall of flora ends several paces from the pale stone walkway, but there is no sign that it has been cut back or cultivated in a way that would explain the stark delineation.  Unintelligible whispers play on the air, audible only in rare lulls of the screeching wind.

title: [Ojandhaart, Runed Arch]
description: A grand arch of carved granite towers over the wide dirt path leading into the village.  Spacious dwellings with roofs of thatched polar grass and walls of unfinished timber are scattered haphazardly throughout the village, leaving ample avenues connected by the winding path.  Nearby, an oversized cart piled high with goat dung rests in the shadow of one of the tremendous dwellings, filling the air with an earthy and not entirely unpleasant aroma.

title: [Ojandhaart, Smithy]
description: Smoke belches from the rounded chimney of a nearby smithy.  The stones comprising it are huge blackened blocks of ponderous weight.  Crossed axes and a round, notched shield hang over the high open doorway.  The quality of the work is exceptional, but the weapons and targe are too large to be wielded.

title: [Ojandhaart, Smithy]
description: The smithy's lofty ceiling is comprised of rough, smoke-darkened tinders.  The cavernous space holds a man-sized anvil and a forge fed by a low-burning flame that nonetheless fills the smithy with skin-searing heat.  Hafts for gigantic axes and a whalebone pommel meant for an immense sword sit atop a huge worktable of sturdy hoarbeam.

title: [Ojandhaart, Longhouses]
description: Imposing longhouses of unfinished timber tower over the roadside, thatched with dry yellow polar grasses.  The homes are far too large for most humanoids, easily thrice the height of a tall giantman.  There seems little reason or order to their spacing, and the crushed stone road that travels between them meanders and bends accordingly.

title: [Ojandhaart, Great Hall]
description: Built atop a craggy mount of granite, a huge hoarbeam longhouse looks out over the village.  Ornate carvings adorn the huge timbers that comprise its walls, while its roof is crafted from riverstone shingles and not the thatchwork of the surrounding huts.  Great steps, cut from the stone of the tor, proceed up to the wide arched entrance.  They are flanked to either side by a pair of colossal stone statues depicting warriors, one male and one female, each armed with twin scimitars.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Feasting Hall, Grand Chamber]
description: Rafters of raw pine stretch far overhead, lending the capacious hall a steepled roof.  Tall tables cluttered with earthenware plates and huge bone drinking horns crowd the plank floor, and beneath, the leavings of past meals exude a sour stink.  Both walls are adorned with hammered runes forged from bright copper, which glint and dance in the light of a monumental flame blazing from a dais to the east.

title: [Ojandhaart, Riverwalk]
description: The river swirls and eddies past the limb of icy land.  Huts congregating along its length find their reflections in the icy, slow-moving waters, which also twins the wildly dancing aurora above.  An abandoned fishing net is draped over the shore, empty of its catch.

title: [Ojandhaart, Riverwalk]
description: Smaller clusters of longhouses look out over the frigid waters of the Issenflow, which laps at the dark shores of the village.  Several serpent-headed boats are beached along the waterside, along with great oars made from spruce.  One close to the river is peppered with tiny arrows which, despite their small size, are buried deep into the wood of the hull.

title: [Ojandhaart, Mead Hall]
description: Past a long timber hall that smells heavily of honey and spirits, the frozen earth gives way to crude planking stretching out onto the river.  A garland of woven iceblossoms hangs from the open door, but the dark green leaves are beginning to brown.  The mead hall's open windows look out onto the lonesome dock to the southeast.

title: [Ojandhaart, Mead Hall]
description: Aglisten with a fresh coat of polish, a wide spruce bar with ko'nag accents runs along the far wall of the mead hall.  Behind it are fat casks full of mead, the heady odor of honey and alcohol rising from them to fill the capacious space.  High tables are arranged about the room in a rough semicircle, encircled by outsized stools comprised of wood and thick leather.

title: [Ojandhaart, Furrier]
description: Acrid fumes belch forth from the open windows of a huge hut with hides stretched across drying racks in the surrounding yard.  Bear and wolf pelts commingle with hides that are vivid blue and heavily scaled.  A worktable sits next to the tall doorway of the home, and a skinning knife with a blade nearly the length of a falchion's is jammed, blade first, into the wood.

title: [Ojandhaart, Furrier]
description: The stench of fermenting solution is almost overpowering within the hut despite the wide windows and open door.  Large stone vats of the stuff sit along the far wall, which is decorated with finished hides and a few crudely mounted animal heads.  The wooden planks of the floor are deeply stained.  A half-skinned white bear sits atop a stone table opposite the vats.

title: [Great Hall, Pyre of Visions]
description: A boundless flame roars from the vastness of a chasm running parallel with the eastern wall of the longhouse, the lowest verges of which are lost beyond sight.  Riotous in hue, the flames have blackened the timbers above, and their heat has left the stone brick hearth behind them pocked and dark.  Buckets full of sweet-smelling herbs burn in the fire, belching thick smoke with a cloying, honeyed aroma.

title: [Ojandhaart, Bonfire]
description: A roaring bonfire burns, started from a collection of stacked pine boles.  It fills the air with smoke and the bite of hot resin.  Light from the cavorting flames drives back the gloom of the sunless sky, casting the surrounding longhouses in radiance akin to daylight.  Several huge benches made from felled trees ring the flame, heedless of the overwhelming heat belching from the pyre.

title: [Ojandhaart, Pasture]
description: A tall fence surrounds a wide pasture bordered by several longhouses.  Goats the size of draft horses graze far off to the side of the road, their pale grey wool providing ample protection against the chill.  Leaning against the fence is a rough pinewood crook that looks nearly the size of a young tree.  The goats seem to be thriving while unattended, lazily foraging through the snowfall for shreds of hardy polar grass.

title: [Ojandhaart, Henge]
description: The gigantic longhouses thin toward the northern verges of the village, where an ancient stone henge is comprised of vast standing stones in a rough semicircle.  Granite braziers the size of boulders are positioned along the ring, and their leaping flames envelop the boulders in a dance of dark shadows and golden light.  A path of crushed rock marches toward a breach in the henge.

title: [Ojandhaart, Henge of Bloodlust]
description: Looming stones stand in a rough semicircle, their shadows long and dark in the enduring twilight.  At their center is an altar of ruddy stone primitively carved with scenes of battle and bloodshed.  An ugly, blade-shaped symbol of blackened metal is set into the flat of the altar.  Intense warmth washing off of encircling granite braziers wars with the chill of the unrelenting wind, which buffets the implacable standing stones in shrieking attacks.

title: [Ojandhaart, Issenflow Dock]
description: A dock of uneven planks strains creakily out over the frigid river, greying wood and dark water lit only by the ripples of the aurora above.  Several boats are tied to the dock by arm-thick lengths of twine, and even without their oarsmen, they are sleek in the water and carved in a way that suggests deadly grace.  Mist lies heavy over the water, obscuring most of the far shore and the expanse of white beyond.

title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
description: Not a single pine needle mars the pristine white of the even stone road.  There is a painstaking precision to the cut of every stone block comprising it.  Light from the rippling aurora plays off of the road in a ripple of chilly hues, making the pathway appear as if it is undulating slowly, almost imperceptibly.

title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
description: The road climbs gently to match the rise and fall of the land, flanked on either side by stands of starkly yellow tamarack that ceases to grow several paces from the road's edge.  Off to the side of the road, a leather pack sized for a halfling is stuck in a snow bank that has frozen solid.  The pack seems undamaged and undisturbed, but it is firmly lodged where it fell, the leather twined with fingers of rime.

title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
description: A wide pathway of packed river stones branches eastward off of the road.  Despite the scope of the path, which is easily wide enough for several wagons to travel side by side, it looks primitive and unimpressive next to the precise march of the road it crosses.  Needles of spruce and pine carpet the east-bearing way, not providing it the apparent deference they show the stark white stones.

title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
description: The white stone road is shattered by a great hump of disturbed ground.  Whatever broke the earth did so with force great enough to send spiderwebbing cracks out through the surrounding hardpack.  The jagged edges of the broken stones glint oddly in the aurora's light where they are not drowning in the fallen needles of fir and spruce and pine.  Remnants of the roadway dot the ground to the northeast.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: The trail grows thin and inconsistent as ancient pines intrude upon the navigable terrain.  Some of the tallest cast out long, snowy boughs that block all but the faintest glimmers of the sky in its perpetual twilight.  Off to one side of the road is a small rock cairn.  A young fir droops over it, having sprouted out of the earth near the head of the formation.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: A frozen stream cleaves across the pathway, glinting like fine crystal in the undulating radiance from above.  Spilling from a crook between two granite boulders, the solid water looks trapped in time.  The sinuous thread of ice disappears into the woods to the north, which form an impenetrable tangle of white-dusted greenery several paces from the trail's edge.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: The cries of owls and the rustle of rodents fill the air of the gelid woodland.  Nests rock in the boughs of several of the surrounding firs, cobbled together from twigs and bits of twine.  Marching beneath the wild dance of the aurora as it ripples across an unforgiving black sky, the little-trodden path verges on a crystalline briar to the southwest.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Fresh powder coats the hardpack at the middle of the pathway between stands of great sky-scraping firs, making for treacherous footing.  The radiance of the aurora reflects clearly off of the slick layer of frost on the ground.  Watery, refracted light makes the surrounding woods come alive with strange colors and languid, dancing shadows.

title: [Hinterwilds, Stone Dragon]
description: An enormous stone dragon slumbers amidst the woods, snow and underbrush encompassing much of its majestic shape.  Clusters of holly and white dryad have grown over the lifelike statue, blanketing it in incarnadine and niveous patches of flora.  Far more vivid, in jewel-bright colors, are the ice-slicked scales of the beast, a sea of blues and greens fading into burnished coppers.  Were it not perfectly still, it might be a living being.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Despite the intensity of the cold, life flourishes in small sanctuaries cradled by the boles of great conifers.  Patches of bright-berried holly grow despite rime caking their spiked leaves.  The trees themselves, spruce, pine, tamarack, and fir, are laden with cones and richly green, as if the cruel weather is little bother to them.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Several abounding trees have burst from the cold, leaving deep fissures down their tortured trunks.  Crystalline resin gleams from the wounds, looking like droplets of amber in a gem shop window.  The verdant needles above suggest that the injuries, while impressive, have done little lasting harm.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Paw prints in the snow cover the ground near the base of a stand of close-growing pine trees to the southern edge of the pathway.  From the pines comes an occasional clacking sound, its source dozens of small bone fetishes woven into the trees' boughs.  There seems little reason or rhyme to the placement of the grisly talismans, some of which are still marred by ragged hunks of dried flesh.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: A wide rift disturbs the ground.  It is surrounded by a fringe of broken, icy earth that points angrily at the sky.  No trees grow over the area of the disturbance, leaving the area unprotected from the raging elements.  Heavy snowfall has almost filled the chasm, leaving nary a hint as to its depth or scope, but it appears easily traversible.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Glistening crystals of frost cling to the branches of a lone spruce, weighing the branches down with their sheer numbers.  The tree is a splash of blue-green color in a domain of the woods gone brown and skeletal from the unrelenting cold.  The old stalwart seems little disturbed by the decay around it, glinting brightly in its icy garb.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Sprawled in a heap on the ground, empty eye sockets staring up into the unfeeling light of the aurora, is an immense humanoid corpse.  The stiff, icy body is of sufficient size to mostly block the walkway, and the snow around it is tinged a startling red.  Prints, both humanoid and lupine, encircle the corpse, but despite an arm that ends in a jagged stump, the body seems unmolested since death claimed it.

title: [Hinterwilds, Runestone]
description: Skeletal and greying conifers cast a heavy shadow over a weather-worn runestone just off the edge of the trailway.  The old monolith has been forced askew by the shifting of the chill earth, and it stands at a miserable angle, pointing into the dead trees.  A faint odor of death lingers on the bitter air, and the keening of the breeze is like a banshee's wail.

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Sickly sweet, the odor of rot is a nauseating pall upon the icy breeze wafting from the northwest.  Rough-hewn timber posts support lanterns meant to hold back the perennial twilight, but they are unlit and look as if they have not been tended in some time.  One of the lanterns has fallen free from its hook, and its broken shards glitter unsettlingly in the light of the aurora.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Approach]
description: A gigantic chunk of black stone in the middle of the path leads up to a mist-choked settlement with raw timber walls.  Its appears to have been the rune-carved keystone of a cracked black granite arch marking the road that climbs into the village.  Dead trees coated in a grim, murky frost lend the entire area an ill cast that is amplified by the sweetness of death on the bitter wind.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Broken Arch]
description: Mist creeps through the streets of the blighted settlement on cautious tendrils, as if reticent to disturb the sepulchral feel of the ruin.  Burnt out longhouses flank the once grand arch marking the entrance of the village, peppering the air with their charred odor.  The facade of one longhouse has collapsed backward, but the entrance to the other is merely blocked by burnt rubble.  A huge gigas corpse dangles precariously through one of the windows flanking its blocked entryway.

title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]
description: Great brambles grow to either side of the poorly marked path through the thick briar.  Their snatching thorns are brittle and coated with a sheen of ice that makes them look like fanciful confections of crystal, but their bite is as cruel as that of the knifing gale.  A few iceblossoms peek from within the tangled growth as if taunting from their spiked sanctuaries.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]
description: A few dreary tatters of homespun fabric waft from the talons of the brambles.  Several of the gnarled vines are snapped in places, as if crushed by a great weight.  Droplets of blood cling to the coiling flora, frozen into sanguine jewels that have their own odd, if frightful, beauty.

title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]
description: A frozen pile of spoor sits in the middle of the narrow passage through the briars, the stark bits of bone within suggesting that they are the leavings of a predator.  The sounds of wildlife, already thin and distant in such a forbidding clime, seem muted and distant.  Nearby, a dead fir's jagged stump is scratched and scored with claw marks where it protrudes from the briar.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]
description: A hare's tracks dart across the feeble trail through the tangled briar, pursued by the footfalls of something much larger and more predatory.  Both sets of prints vanish into the bloodthirsty underbrush, which gleams threateningly from beneath its coat of glassy ice.  A few clumps of niveous fur suggest that the aggressor was a hungry canine.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Hinterwilds, Cave Entrance]
description: A clearing spans the space before a craggy cave that delves into a hillock of stone at the briar's edge.  Scents of spoor and decay spice the otherwise pristine air, enduring despite the nasty gale that shivers through the bramble patch.  Great paw prints congregate around the cave entrance.

title: [Hinterwilds, Warg Den]
description: Gnawed bones and shed white hair form a treacherous carpet on the floor of the den.  The cave mouth is at an angle that shields the interior from the wind, and while still chilly, the little enclosure is spared the worst of the elements.  A low ceiling curves to form the rear wall of the cave, onto which primitive figures are drawn in old, flaking pigments.  The distinctive musk of canines suggests that the den is still very much in use.

title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]
description: The icy briar thins a bit, attenuating further as the passage between the bramble widens into a full-fledged clearing toward the south.  Canine paw prints mar the earth in abundance, made indelible by a slick coat of frost.  The persistent wind rustles through the thorny underbrush bordering the area with a low and mournful howl.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]
description: Patches of cerulean and sapphire iceblossoms peek out of the briar here and there, lending splashes of color to the commingling of grey and brown and white.  The mischievous little flowers seem to sprout up where the brambles are thickest, keeping themselves safe behind thorny walls that keep both the wind and clumsy intruders at bay.  One spray of blossoms is a rich violet that could rival the finest cut amethysts.
paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
description: Lazing beneath a drooping hoarbeam, the upper half of a silver-shot ancient black runestone pierces up through the stony permafrost.  A deeply graven glyph adorns each of its four faces.  Though there are signs of recent travel through the area, the snow and fallen evergreen needles around the obelisk seem largely undisturbed.

title: [Hinterwilds, Red Guardian]
description: Rearing out of the snow-capped trees at the end of a shattered road of white stone, a colossal stone statue stands guard over the woodland.  He cuts a severe figure, with his warrior's muscles and sullen features.  The stone scimitar the statue carries swoops threateningly low over the path where it cuts through a break in the trees.

title: [Angargreft, Approach]
description: Glimpses of a vast fane of stone glint through the a break in the monochrome of the snow-clad trees, its cyclopean architecture the color of dried blood in the twilight.  Above it, the aurora shimmers with tortured crimsons and jaundiced yellows.  There is a hush to the woodland, as if bird and beast are but distant memories.  A dirt path through the woods, hard-packed by the passage of countless travelers and aglisten with frost, winds northwestward on its way to the distant edifice.

title: [Angargreft, Henge]
description: The heads of immense stone monoliths breach through the white-crowned woods, looking like bloody fingers scratching at the shimmering sky.  There are nearly a dozen arranged in a rough semicircle, though one has toppled over and taken a number of surrounding trees with it, leaving a bald patch in the otherwise-even canopy.  The roadway winds through the center of the henge.

title: [Angargreft, Fallen Monolith]
description: The shattered tip of a fallen monolith lies scattered across the path, each individual chunk roughly the size of a man.  Most of its bulk lies in silent repose across the decaying corpses of trees killed in its fall, though molds and lichen growing in a thin carpet over patches of its surface suggest that time will see the woods reclaim the space.  A faint coppery smell lingers on the gelid wind.

title: [Angargreft, Wood's Edge]
description: Sharp on the frigid wind is a coppery stink that eclipses all other odors, from the crisp bite of pine to the dry aroma of frostbitten wood.  It wafts from the north, where the winding path rises to bisect a thicket heavily coated in clean white snowfall.  Beyond, an immense terraced structure of red stone is visible, its tremendous base tapering toward a narrower zenith.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Rising out of the cold earth, a sky-scraping pyramid of red stone overshadows the area, its cavernous entrance marked by a pair of colossal red stone pillars.  Traceries of rime glisten from its cyclopean walls, reflecting the dancing aurora in shimmering blues and wild greens, but it is a grim and beautiless place, a ruined echo of a monument built to evoke fear rather than wonder.  As if cowed by the display, the trees give the edifice a wide berth, leaving it in solitude amidst a grove cratered with steaming pools.

title: [Angargreft, Greatchamber]
description: The entrance stands, framed by a pair of colossal red stone pillars, at the apogee of a crescent-shaped walk that curves along the interior of the fane.  Towering gigas statues, male and female, stand with battleaxes in hand in alcoves along either wall.  Their faces are unwelcoming and their postures unmistakably aggressive.  Ruddy stone steps breach the wall to the north, heading precipitously downward into stygian shadow.

title: [Angargreft, Descent]
description: Huge, ruddy stone steps descend into unleavened darkness, framed on either side by high walls of the same rust-colored rock.  Dim light from the fane's entrance illuminates primitive paintings on the distant ceiling, revealing rudimentary scenes of battle and conquest.  The steps are slightly damp and tacky.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: A coagulating incarnadine pool mars the cold, hard-packed earth nearby, steaming in the frigid air, and it is not alone.  The earth to the west is pocked with craters similarly full of thick crimson fluid.  Their scent, like hot copper, is so thick in the air as to be choking.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: High overhead and toward the western extreme of the great fane is a spacious terrace.  The heavy snowfall cannot obscure the destruction that has consumed the terrace.  Jags of masonry are torn from the red stone walls above, and the space is cluttered with the wreckage.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Several jagged stones, each as large as a small building, have fallen from the terrace above, heavily scoring the western wall of the fane.  Amidst the rubble, one span of ruined stonework is twined with crude but intricate runes that depict an undulating aurora framed by stylized stars.  The rock is corroded and pitted as if eaten by a caustic substance.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: In the shadow of the fane, clusters of glistening ice crystals crowd around the edges of a thick crimson pond.  The basin is fed by a lethargic spill of crimson fluid trickling down the bordering wall, but its source is lost amidst the shattered ruin of the western terrace above.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Near the edge of the woods, a stone formation stands, towering over the neighboring trees.  Pine and spruce near the clearing are denuded of their needles.  The light of the aurora above filters through their branches, casting bleary shadows on the cracked white ground.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: An alcove to the east of the fane's entrance is cavernously deep.  A tall gigas statue stands wreathed in shadow, proud features ominously glaring down on the indurated earth below.  The ground before the statue is littered with offerings frozen into a clump of ice crystals.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: As the high-walled corridor curves toward the northwest, the statues give way to painted effigies along the walls.  Flaking and faded with time, the pigments mimic the colors of the aurora, unearthly greens and dazzling blues picking out scenes of death and battle.  A smear of brighter, newer red bisects the ancient paintings, marring their flow.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: A constant, sluggish flow of thick crimson fluid cascades slowly down the eastern wall.  It drips heavily between the ill-fitted stones of the ceiling, dried black and crusty at the edges.  Primitive painted figures on the wall's surface have surrendered to the crimson flow, leaving the remaining lines looking half-formed and obscene.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: The slabs of ruddy, iron-laden stone that comprise the floor slowly rise as the corridor bends to the northeast.  To either side of the walkway, alcoves that are many times a man's height are recessed into the walls, their edges rough and obviously the work of primitive architects.  They are denuded of whatever treasures they once held, but pottery shards and bits of broken bone swept to the corridor's borders hint at vases and ancient art.

title: [Angargreft, Descent]
description: A snarling visage has been carved into the stones of the northern wall with surprising skill, its vast maw a gaping sea of shadow.  The darkness beyond is all the more impenetrable for the flickering glow of two torches hanging in sconces to either side of the portal.  They are burning blue.

title: [Angargreft, Pit Nexus]
description: A crumbling red stone maw in the southern wall opens onto a vast nexus of cavernous catacombs.  Flickering blue torchlight beckons from the vast aperture, the distant light casting the intersection into starker shadow.  Wide tunnels branch off in each of the cardinal directions, suggesting that the construction is not natural, but the walls, ground, and ceiling are rough natural stone shot through with vast ruddy veins of ore.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Snatching roots stretch like talons from the high, rough-hewn walls bordering the corridor.  Snowmelt forms puddles on the slick stone floor, making the footing treacherous.  The moisture has eaten at iron sconces on the walls, grinding them down to rust and warped metal, and the torches within have long since mouldered past the point of uselessness.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Within niches along the walls slumber dozens of gigas corpses, clad still in the decaying remains of ancient burial attire: horned helms mottled with rust and armors that are more mold than leather.  Roots from above have grown down into the bodies in their blind search for sustenance, and some niches are choked entirely with the questing tendrils of the vast trees far above the subterranean catacomb.  A shattered drinking horn lies at the base of one rough wall, its shards aglisten in the moist air.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Primitive hieroglyphs form uneven lines on the walls, clustered heavily around the niches to either side of the walkway.  An old corpse has partially toppled from its resting place, leaving its sunken eye sockets to stare blankly down the corridor as it approaches a bend to the west.  Tantalizing flickers of light from that direction reflect in watery ripples off of the puddles on the uneven floor.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: At the corridor bend, a breach in the stone ceiling far above permits a glimpse of the aurora high in the sky.  Its tangle of radiance bathes the section of catacomb in wavering ghost-light and illuminates the features of a ponderous granite statue guarding the walkway.  Snow-clad trees sway in the howling breeze, but the climb to them is an impossible stretch of stone worn smooth by centuries of snowmelt.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: A primitive mural occupies most of the western wall as the corridor leans into a wide bend.  Opposite it is a small crater in the earth, as if something breached up through the ground.  Rivulets of meltwater have worn runnels into the stone on their quest for lower ground.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Cracks spiderweb across the uneven stone of the ceiling.  From a gash in the rock flows a sluggish fluid, so dark a garnet in color as to be almost black.  The fluid drips slowly down one wall and has eaten away at the pigments of the mural there, filling the air with a tang of bitter copper.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Beneath a low ceiling of hewn stone, the corridor proceeds southward past the empty eyes of crumbling stone statues of men and women in primitive armor.  One statue is missing half of its head.  The sundered portion lies in the shadowed crevice between the effigy's booted feet, its single eye open as if in fascination or horror.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: The porous stone to either side of the pathway has fallen away, leaving but a narrow ribbon of stone to bridge a fathomless abyss.  Along the distant walls are stationed the toppling remnants of a veritable army of stone statues, their eroded eyes watching and vigilant.  Above them, barely visible in the dimness, grim pigments depict scenes of battle and bloodshed.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: The sounds of sluggish liquid moving in the lightless pits to either side of the path is a constant, wet whisper in the darkness.  Bitter and coppery, the odor filtering up from the chasms is almost overpowering.  Along the eastern wall, skeletal bodies are draped half out of their niches.  Though still, they look as if stilled in the midst of crawling forth from their disturbed graves.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: As it bends toward the southeast, the corridor widens into a subterranean plaza lined with rows of copper figures.  Corrosion has eaten away at their features and spotted the statues with verdigris, but enough remains of their strong forms and proud bearing to suggest that they signify honored warriors.  Striking veins of citrine streak through the raw stone walls like bolts of crystalline lightning, arcing around painted ravens.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Urns and skulls line rough-edged niches in the walls pressing in on the tall, narrow tunnelway.  One skull, dislodged from its resting place, stares up from the earth, its sockets empty and accusatory.  The ground is rough and uneven, cratered where loose stones have been pried free by passersby.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Streaked here and there with veins of citrine, the reddish stone walls are honeycombed with hollows holding huge coffins of precious metal.  Gold and silver and platinum glint in the murky darkness, shining here and there with adorning jewels.  Ravens are painted on the walls in a vast black flock that veers toward the northeast.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: From niches in the walls glimmer hundreds of gigas skulls dipped in copper, silver, and other precious metals.  They are artfully adorned with chunks of ruby and seaglass here, or diamond and onyx there.  Each skull's eyes are empty ebon pits, though some are filmed over with spiderwebs or sprouting with hardy mosses.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Pocked here and there with potholes, the floor of the cavern descends sharply as it turns with the bend of the towering walls.  The niches in the walls are broken by an immense carving of a winged woman inlaid with gold and copper.  Light breaks through a narrow crack in the rock ceiling high above, casting the primitive mosaic in faint luminescence.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Towering feminine figures, carved and implacable, bend over the pathway from ornate pedestals, their wings spread wide as if they are about to descend upon intruders.  The floor transitions abruptly between untamed rock to stone that is smooth and even, if caked in dust and detritus.  From somewhere in the distance, the sound of water hitting stones plays a constant, tense drumbeat that echoes incessantly on the cold air.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: The ceiling has been hewn into a semicircular roof over a grand dais at the tunnelway's end.  Approaching steps are carved with feather patterns that culminate in etched ravens across the surface of the platform.  At the dais's center sits a broad altar of slick stone enfolded by carved wings, its looming presence starker black against the shadows of the pit.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Tangled in a blanket of gnarled roots that have breached through the near wall, a breached crypt stands atop a raised dais of ruddy stone that is marked with the flaking remnants of a golden sunburst.  Undermined by the root structure of the vast and ancient trees aboveground, the wall has begun to buckle, flooding the ground with cold earth and stone.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Fallen stones from the ceiling form a jagged hill that nearly occludes the passage to the northeast.  The ground underfoot is tacky and dark with a fluid that reeks heavily of copper.  The air is thick with its bitter odor.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: The corridor opens into a wide cavern with a sinkhole full of sluggish, frothing blood at its heart.  It is fed by a steady drip of sanguine fluid from the rock ceiling, a jagged snarl of red-smeared stalactites and cragged stone.  Despite the frigid air, the blood hisses and steams, filling the air with a vile tang and strange humidity.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: By the cracked stone bordering a blood-filled sinkhole awaits an arranged pile of corpses, from dusty skeletons to empty-eyed cadavers.  The grotesquerie is arranged in a horrific spiral that seems to hold neither purpose nor meaning.  Slick and tacky, the cavern floor is a spectacle of clotting red muck.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Staring out of small niches on the curving walls, hundreds of black stone ravens are perched to oversee the small alcove.  Candles of rendered tallow rest amidst the lifeless flock, wasted down to slumped piles of spent wax coated in a heavy layer of silvery dust.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: A flat plane of stone breaches out of the earthen wall to the north.  Its surface is unusually smooth, as if painstakingly worked by huge hands.  Archaic limnings on its surface stretch many times the height of a man, depicting a glowing woman of gold standing amidst a swarm of black ravens.  The artwork is marred by smears of drying red fluid that appear sourced from a blood-filled sinkhole dominating the cavern floor.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: On the far end of a blood-filled sinkhole, the rough-hewn wall is spattered with mad sprays of dried blood that form monstrous sigils and sinuous tangles.  The uneven earth is a wash of carnage that has gone crusty and black at the edges.  Radiating cracks streaking from the depression's edge suggest that the sinkhole is still growing, albeit slowly.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: The tunnelway grows narrow, high walls full of open graves looming monstrously over the dark path.  Dry timbers from shattered burial boxes lie scattered on the floor, accompanied by hanks of brittle hair and shards of dry bone.  Many of the hollows along the walls are empty and their edges scored with clawlike marks.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Stone effigies crudely fashioned into the shapes of hulking warriors line the portion of the lightless path.  In the oppressive gloom, their muddled features take on ghastly planes and hideous twists.  One statue among them stands apart.  Forged from golvern dulled by disrepair, it depicts a strong-looking winged woman shrouded by folded wings.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Snowmelt and the passage of years have conspired to make the ceiling a mass of dangling stalactites that drip icy wetness onto the path.  The rock formations bear down over the walkway like the fangs of a hungering beast in places, only adding to the claustrophobic press of the walls to either side.  A constant low moan fills the air, emanating from the south.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Craggy debris strewn across the path appears to have spilled from a breached red stone wall to the west.  The rush of wind through the pits solicits a ceaseless low moan from the breach that rebounds in the distance as a melancholic echo.  Paintings adorn the walls as high as the eye can see, depicting scenes of brutal triumph that likely provided little comfort to the resultant dead.

title: [Secret Tunnel, Dead End]
description: Grit swirls in the air, tossed by a whistling breeze that howls shrilly through a breach in the red stone wall to the east.  Flaking and ancient, paintings on the walls depict warlike figures in once-bright colors.  The wind is not quite enough to dispel the tang stale mead lingering in the area.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Atop a series of timeworn steps, a disintegrating altar of ruddy stone rests in shadow.  Above it, the cavern's ceiling is oppressively low, and sharp stalactites sprouting from the raw rock seem to bear down on the steps like serpent's teeth.  Handprints and accompanying smears of tacky, dark liquid mar the ground and walls.

title: [Secret Tunnel, Entrance]
description: Spilled mead, long since dried, has leaked through the floorboards that form the ceiling of the underground passage.  The liquid has left behind sticky patches on the walls and ground of the tunnel end and fills the air with a stale sourness.   Descending as it travels east, the tunnel swiftly moves beyond the feeble illumination creeping in through the slatted boards overhead.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Mead Hall]
description: The remains of a bar the height of a tall giantman bisect the cavernous hall.  Spattered with raven droppings, the bar is bared to the elements by the crumbling roof, and the aurora's ghostly glow plays over the hall's interior.  Sharply pungent, the tang of spilled mead fends off the odor of char, but it has left the floorboards tacky in places.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Mead Hall]
description: Soot rings the glassless windows of a huge mead hall at the end of the cobblestone walkway, making the apertures look like vast eyes, black and haunted.  Ravens have taken to the eaves, which are white and messy with the birds' droppings.  The corpse-birds' song is a raucous, taunting chorus over the whipping wind.

title: [Fjallarhart, Cooper's]
description: Splintered barrels mark the entrance to a battered turf house that must have been a cooper's shop.  Embergrass grows thick on the snowy rooftop, which has collapsed inward in places, leaving the dwelling's front door impassable.  Several unfinished staves lean next to the entrance as if waiting to be worked.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Ruins]
description: The buzzing of flies is a constant drone in the air.  Bodies of fallen gigas warriors are black with them and seem to move of their own volition as the shiftless swarms fight over the bodies.  Sickly sweet, the melange of rot and burnt flesh is choking despite the open air.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Monument]
description: Rising high into the sky, carved cloak unfurled in the breeze, a great stone statue stands grim watch over the death and decay that has consumed the village.  Chunks of its disembodied arms lay amidst the dry red embergrass and fresh-fallen snowbanks.  Before the statue is the cool remnants of a bonfire, with shattered earthenware and spilled blood the only hints to the grotesque bacchanals that must have transpired in its warmth.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Forest's Edge]
description: Snow-covered woodland invades the far reaches of the village and has begun to devour the shattered remnants of halls and longhouses.  A young spruce sapling sprouts out of the cobblestone road.  Its hungry roots have cruelly displaced the composite stones in their mindless quest for sustenance in the cold earth.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Ruins]
description: Larger by far than the surrounding structures, the village's great hall has a yawning entrance flanked by toppled statues that are defaced to the point of unrecognizability.  The rankness of decaying meat wafts like fetid breath from the mouth of the longhouse, cloying in its rancid sweetness.  Even the shreds of mist whispering over the ground seem to avoid the place.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Desecrated Hall]
description: Arched beams of yew struggle against the weight of the longhouse's collapsing roof.  A black stone statue, once heroic in scope and stature, has been thrown down from its place atop a raised dais at the rear of the longhouse, and it lies in shattered chunks across the wood panel floor.  Smears of dried blood adorn the walls, forming serpentine patterns, but there is no sense to the gibberish scrawlings.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Well]
description: Huge gigas bodies are splayed in the snowy grasses beside a black stone well, anointed with oils to keep away rot and scavengers.  Their filmy eyes are open to the sky and the reflected aurora dances across the clouded surfaces, lending a mocking parody of life to the empty orbs.  Mist eddies around the bodies, tugging carelessly at fingers that will move no more.

title: [Stone Well, Bucket]
description: Spared bleaching by the lack of sunlight in the sky, the bucket is brittle and dry, but still holds the color of new-cut pine.  It is sealed here and there with pitch.  Below, the well delves into inky darkness, the sole apparent denizen of which is the sluggish splash of water a long way down.  A thickly woven rope securing the bucket to the windlass provides means to climb out of the well.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Ruins]
description: Mist blankets the ground, muting sound and obscuring sight.  Corpses have been left to rot beneath the aurora's light.  Their jangled limbs poke out of the dense fog here and there.  They would be reminiscent of broken toys, were the corpses not many times the size of a man.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Ruins]
description: A rare stretch of the village is mostly clear of the surrounding carnage.  The cluster of homes is intact if stained here and there with soot, and the smell of decay is held at bay by the gelid breeze.  A trail of blood along the cobblestones ends in a pair of bloody handprints that shatter the illusion of normality.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Ruins]
description: Woodland has begun to wipe away the ruined extremities of the village.  Amidst the broken bodies of mouldering dwellings, the snow-laden boughs of fir trees cradle a cairn not yet deluged in snow.  Driven head-first into the grave, a ponderous battleaxe with a ragged strip of cloth around the haft jabs toward the unfeeling sky as if in accusation.

title: [Fjallarhaart, Shattered Henge]
description: The stones of the village's henge lay toppled amidst the encroaching greenery of the icy forest.  Some of the stones are cracked as if by great force, and many are smeared with gore and grime.  Graven into the frozen earth is a crude serpentine symbol with two heads.  Snow has covered it over in parts.

title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]
description: The broken point of an elk antler jabs out of the thorny thicket like a reproachful finger.  All around it, the brambles are trampled in a way that hints of struggle, the most cold-bitten among them having shattered like brittle glass.  A few beads of ruby red on the surviving vines suggest the altercation ended in a stalemate.

title: [Eldurhaart, Approach]
description: A crushed stone path leads toward a wide clearing in the wood, where a village with high walls of raw timber sits along the shore of a vast frozen lake.  The way is lined with tall, spindly humanoid shapes woven from bark, feathers, and bits of clacking bone.  The ominous constructs stare down with empty eyes of jewel and stone from either side of the path.

title: [Eldurhaart, Approach]
description: A pair of wicker figures flanks the base pillars of a rune-carved grey granite arch leading into a village of huge longhouses and tall dwellings of raw timber.  Incense and herbs pepper the air, carried on the whistling breeze from a huge circular building at the village center that is carved into the bole of an immense living hoarbeam tree.  Wreaths of pale blue iceblossom and darker violet resting poppies have been strung from the archway.

title: [Eldurhaart, Runed Arch]
description: Iceblossom and resting poppy festoon the grey granite arch looming over the entrance of the sprawling village.  Homes and businesses of raw timber are writ large, their doorways wide and tall enough to handle occupants far beyond the breadth of the widest dwarf or tallest giantman.  White stones pave the winding paths among the oversized dwellings and are kept free of debris and snowfall.  The air is laden with the huskiness of incense smoke.

title: [Eldurhaart, Wicker Guardian]
description: A rudimentary figure of wicker stands watch over the village's tall houses.  Flowers woven into its joints sway on the breeze in a soft susurrus, lending their perfume to the frigid air.  Earthenware jugs of rendered whale oil sit in formation by the guardian, hinting at the guardian's eventual fate.

title: [Eldurhaart, Village Lane]
description: Crushed white stones form a path between looming longhouses, their walls imposing and dark in the perennial twilight.  Garlands of hardy arctic flowers stream from the eaves high above.  Wind whistles through the space between the two great dwellings, carrying hints of a hot iron tang from the north.

title: [Eldurhaart, Rise]
description: One of the neighboring longhouses sits atop a tiered hillock ringed with concentric stones.  Braziers encircle the base of the hill, blazing bright in the aurora-lit gloom and filling the air with the huskiness of musky incense.  The crushed stones of the path rise laboriously toward a monstrous hoarbeam tree that dominates the skyline to the north, lanterns glimmering in its ancient branches.

title: [Eldurhaart, Heart Tree]
description: A huge hoarbeam tree has far outgrown the boundaries of its species, stretching its enormous limbs toward the sky.  Spherical lanterns are suspended from braided iron links woven through the old giant's gnarled branches.  Within a hollow at the base of the still-living colossus is a grand hall open to the elements.  A series of steps formed from the tree's twisted roots rises up to the hall's cavernous entrance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Eldurhaart, High Hall]
description: Arched beams of polished yew support the high peaked roof of the high hall, each carved with a pattern reminiscent of winding scales.  The air is warm and close and heavily tinged with char, and above, a colossal draconic head of carved spruce looks down over the entryway with cruelly narrowed eyes.  Rough-hewn stairs rise from the stone floor toward a dais in the north, which appears to be source of the heat and flickering firelight that casts the entryway in such ominous shadow.

title: [Eldurhaart, Village Center]
description: Longhouses crowd together more closely near the center of the gigas settlement.  Several bonfires burn at meetings of the white stone paths that wind between the outsized buildings, holding back the oppressive twilight of the sunless sky.  Lit by the winding aurora, the houses are monstrous silhouettes that cast nebulous shadows over the path, their raw timber facades forbidding and tall.

title: [Eldurhaart, Bonfire]
description: A raging inferno blazes from a stone-ringed pit dug into a basin within the village's perimeter.  Redolent with the smell of burning pine sap, the air near the blaze is choked with smoke and blistering hot, save when it is dispersed by a cutting gale swooping through the village.  Tree trunks are stacked high a safe distance from the fire, but several have intact roots, as if the boles were ripped from the ground whole in a feat of incredible strength.

title: [Eldurhaart, Blacksmith's]
description: Slag has burned a runnel into the frost-caked earth near the wall of an oversized blacksmith's hut.  Though cold and solidified, the acrid scent of the crude iron fills the air with its bitter bite.  Axe handles almost the thickness of a man's torso are propped up next to the open doorway.

title: [Eldurhaart, Smithy]
description: A hammered vultite rune hangs over the gaping entrance to the smithy.  Raw timber rafters rise high overhead, the blond wood nearly black with years of soot from the titanic forge opposite the door.  Tongs and hammers are suspended from the walls, sized for immense hands.

title: [Eldurhaart, Village Center]
description: Carved in a proud pose, a hooded stone statue presides over a cluster of longhouses near the heart of the village.  Offerings of whalebone and copper are heaped at the figure's feet, far beneath its implacable gaze.  Taller than the statue by far, a sprawling hoarbeam tree to the southwest claws at the sky, its grasping branches casting hazy shadows over the surrounding homes' sloping rooftops.

title: [Eldurhaart, Bridge]
description: A wide stone bridge spans a distributary of the Issenflow.  Curved wooden posts arc over the span from either side, and lanterns hang from them to hold back the oppressive twilight.  Below the bridge, the water's flow is sluggish and laden with chunks of glinting ice.

title: [Eldurhaart, Altar of the Dragon]
description: Gilt scales glisten from the far wall of the hollow, picking out the sinuously muscled curves of a golden dragon depicted above a primitive altar of wrought iron and gilt.  Flames from the braziers at the hollow's perimeter reflect off of the surface of the metal, making the beast look as if it is writhing in the ruddy light.  A pair of solid golden double doors proceed beneath the dragon's spread wings.

Gilt scales glisten from the far wall of the hollow, picking out the sinuously muscled curves of a golden dragon depicted above a primitive altar of wrought iron and gilt.  Flames from the braziers at the hollow's perimeter reflect off of the surface of the metal, making the beast look as if it is writhing in the ruddy light.  The fire's heat is blistering and cruel in stark contrast to the whistling, knife-edged gale outside the tree.

title: [Eldurhaart, Henge]
description: Looming black against the tenebrous sky, standing stones form a spacious henge, on which converge several of the crushed white stone walkways threading through the village.  Mist engulfs the base of the ominous stones, which are inlaid with jagged copper lightning bolts.  The stones stand taller than the surrounding spruces and firs, which press in on the village, clad heavily in pristine snowfall.

title: [Eldurhaart, Henge of Thunder]
description: The circular arrangement of standing stones scratches at the sky with tips worn smooth by the constant assault of wind and snow.  Each of the standing stones is inlaid with a stylized jag of copper lightning.  Mist pools in the center of the vast circle, strangely luminous in the aurora's dancing light.  Its eddies caress the base of a wide, flat altar carved with a pattern of draconic scales, the surface stained and matted with bits of pale fur that leave little doubt as to its purpose.

title: [Eldurhaart, Warg Pens]
description: Overpowering despite the scouring gale, the stench of canines and their leavings reeks from a set of pens along the side of the roadway.  The earth around the pens is a muddy slurry of damp earth and ordure.  Bones, picked clean of even the slightest scrap of meat, are heaped into a pile near the edge of the bordering woods.

title: [Eldurhaart, Lakeview]
description: Frigid waters lap at the shores of the village.  Gigantic longboats, overturned to keep out the snow, rest on the black sands leading up to the shoreline.  Several sport fresh pine pitch on the hulls, covering over axe wounds and arrow pocks in the cured wood.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Some deep-graven etchings decorate the edifice's wall, depicting scenes of strife and violence in a primitive technique.  Near to the wall, something has breached through the hard earth, leaving behind a collapsed tunnel that has sunk the surrounding ground.  As of yet, it has not challenged the integrity of the structure's facade.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Etchings along the eastern wall of the fane are broken by a pair of hideous symbols.  A deep-graven scimitar, colored black with smearings of char, is paired with a newer and sharper sigil that takes the form of a hand twined with a two-headed serpent.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Near to the mouth of one of the dirt-choked burrows is the frozen corpse of a gigas, locked in his last terrible moments by the glacial cold.  A muscled figure crudely carved into the wall of the fane stares impassively down at the preserved carnage.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: A broken runestone stands along the treeline, its shattered tip littering the ground around it.  Drawn amateurishly into the ground at its base, as if scratched there by fingers despite the solid layer of frost coating the earth, is a sigil that looks like a scimitar.  Blood, hardened and dried into little blackish crystals, stains the drawing.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Collapsed burrows honeycomb the surrounding earth.  Piles of disturbed dirt and stone are heaped around their clogged entrances, oddly pitted as if eaten by acid.  Small swathes of land have collapsed in places, giving the ground a jigsawed appearance and unforgiving terrain.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Pits and pocks mar the sloping face of the fane.  The caustic corrosion has undermined the stability of the snowy garden terrace above, causing a portion to collapse into an unsteady pile of rubble that impedes the pathway's progress to the north.  Cemented by frost, the fallen stones look like they could be climbed, but the way is treacherous.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Compromised by corrosion and great age, the easternmost verge of the tomb's terrace has given way.  The resulting pile of rubble is a treacherous mess of ruddy stone and snowfall, a terrifying jangle of sharp edges and false handholds that has spilled across the niveous grove below.  Wind claws ruthlessly at the remaining intact stone, as if desperate to tear it down as well.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Raised plots of soil once boasted saplings taller than a man, but they have dwindled to grey and frozen skeletons in the untended earth, which itself has caked over with murky frost.  The terrace extends to the east, but as it does, the stones become uneven and pockmarked with corroded pits that have undermined their integrity.  Runnels formed by the same substance have etched wide trails in the construction underfoot.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Beyond the jagged edge of the hanging gardens' ruins and far below, the snow-clad woodland spreads to the furthest vagaries of vision.  Here and there, the primordial forest is broken by dozens of sprawling settlements, but from such a distance they seem very small.  The wind is cold and cuts like glass, screaming over the crumbling edifice like a vengeful banshee.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: One of the huge earthen planters along the outer reaches of the terrace has burst open, unable to contain the frozen earth within it.  Brown, dead remnants of the flora within is scattered across the pocked red ground.  The cold black soil has scattered everywhere, leaving a grit that rattles like old bones whenever the wind screeches past.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Two huge copper urns filled with soil flank the soaring red stone arch leading from the cyclopean edifice onto the open-air terrace.  More planters march along the edges of the esplanade.  They are choked with vegetation that has traded verdure for greyness and bright blossoms for an armor of rime.  Runnels and pockmarks mar the surrounding architecture, which looks to be crumbling in places.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: Aurora-lit twilight pours in through the arch at the end of the walkway, a crumbling work of heavily pocked red stone.  The stones in the eastern wall have buckled, causing a small cave in, but the ceiling still holds.  A trailing bit of silvery, translucent goo hangs from the zenith of the archway, drifting sluggishly in the gale howling through the aperture.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Banks of snow cover the wide expanse of terrace, which looks out over a tall swathe of evergreens.  The snow is stark and bright against the ruddy stone of the mausoleum's exterior, looking like white linen against drying blood.  Ripples of light from the aurora make the banks glisten and gleam in ethereal fashion.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: A splash of incongruous greenery beckons from one of the planters in the form of a single fruit tree.  The sapling is heavily encased in ice, and appears to have been frozen swiftly enough to preserve a semblance of life to its graceful branches and spade-like leaves.  Spindly fruits with skins that glitter like spun gold hang from the branches, tantalizing but trapped in their frosty shell.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: The corpse of a huge winged creature with cloudy blue scales lies splayed on the stones, its silvery eyes filmed over in death.  Scavengers have picked meat away from its belly, leaving behind bleached bones.  A tremendous spear with an obsidian head protrudes from the fallen beast's side, having found purchase in a spot of thinner armor.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Several of the lifeless trees lay scattered across the terrace, their planters shattered as if by immense force.  Shards of stone ripple out from the point of impact, some thrown dozens of feet away.  The scattered earth from within has frozen into a layer of slippery grit.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: What remains of a pair of enormous stone doors lies in pitted wreckage to either side of a ragged acid-pocked gash leading deeper into the cyclopean mausoleum.  The ruddy stone of the floor is etched deep with smooth gullies formed by the same corrosive substance.  Over the doorway, a graven bar features a spray of ominous-looking runes.

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: Infestation has induced a terrible transformation in the wide hall, which looks to have been some sort of treasury.  The double doors are missing entirely and the aperture they guarded has corroded into a ragged acid-pocked gash.  Strings of ichorous gunk hang from the ceiling, dripping unsavory substances that smell vaguely of lizard.  The tang of it chokes the space.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Entire spans of the terrace have collapsed into the floors below, leaving only a fragile pathway to cling to the side of the great monument.  Cold, hard earth awaits at the end of a deadly drop to the ground below.  The treacherous thread bends toward the northwest, where immense stairs ascend to the zenith.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Framed by a pair of majestic runestones heavily inlaid with still-bright copper, some cracked red stone stairs ascend unevenly toward the zenith of the mausoleum.  The steps are each as tall as a man and are spiderwebbed with cracks, as if the center of the stairway was impacted with great force.  Save where they have been washed away with corrosion or erosion, the composite stones are heavily decorated with strange writing.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: Sized for an immense stride, some cracked red stone stairs ascend to the highest reaches of the gargantuan fane, proceeding beneath a series of crumbling arches that are a deeper and more intense red than the rest of the edifice.  Chunks of stairway are missing in places, leaving a teetering array of steps at the very top.  Beyond the stairs spreads a crescent-shaped plaza dotted with banks of fresh-fallen snow.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: Imposing runestones point toward the sky like adamant fingers, but the copper-filled sigils on the unyielding stone are defaced with smears of dried brown blood and black char.  The vile graffiti takes on snaking forms with cruel curves and violent strokes, marring the runework beneath.  Bodies are scattered in the snow drifts that have collected in the shadows of the stones, broken and mangled as if crushed by incredible force.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: Great steps ascend toward a humongous red stone dais, atop which is an immense bier shielded from the elements by a stone pavilion.  The pieces of a robed corpse are strewn across the steps in several parts, torn apart as if they were no more than the playthings of an ungentle child.  Underfoot, the ground is tacky with drying blood that, half-frozen, has merged in places with the snowfall into a vile pinkish slush.  There is far too much to have come from the sole corpse.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: Blood pools thick and dark on the dais, dripping from and oozing between the blocks of ruddy feldspar in a constant sluggish flow.  The source appears to be a monstrous figure draped across an equally behemothic bier of red-veined white marble.  A quintet of rounded stone pillars supports an ornate roof over the fallen gigas, and each pillar is deeply graven with a downturned scimitar outlined in smeared ash.  Wind barely whispers over the ground, as if even the brazen elements fear the place.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: The burnt remnants of a tremendous balefire sprawl across the wind-raked stonework.  Heaped bones, most reduced to brittle nubs from the heat of the blaze, appear to have been the predominant fuel for the pyre.  Crude symbols drawn in ash ring the burn site, largely nonsensical but obscene in shape.  Ashes fleck the nearby snow drifts, dusting their whiteness with spots of black and more diffuse grey.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: A slumped gigas corpse lies propped against one of the lofty runestones crowning the fane, her eyes still open in death.  No sign of her assailants remain in the area, but there are a half-dozen trails of dried blood and corresponding furrows in the snow heading to the west.  Chunks have been blown out of the stonework, leaving shards scattered everywhere and suggesting that the preceding battle was one of spells as well as arms.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: Pieces of the roof have collapsed into the chamber below, releasing the faint stink of lizard through the resulting gaps.  The unsteady wreckage is draped in slimy silk that fluoresces faintly in the light of the aurora.  Though the glimpses of the chamber below come through crevices too small to pass through, they offer tantalizing hints of glinting riches hoarded within.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: Along the southern verge of the fane's rooftop plaza, an enormous obsidian altar is framed by two tall runestones of feldspar and volcanic rock.  Shriveled viscera still drape it, desiccated to the point of mummification by the dry and icy air.  A pool of blood fills a crescent depression cradling the rear of the altar, frothing and sloshing as if alive.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: Much of the stonework comprising the southern portion of the fane's sprawling rooftop has collapsed into lower floors or the snowy earth far below.  What remains is a cracked precipice that juts out into the frigid air, a nauseating plummet to either side.  Below, the remains of several gigas and smaller robed humanoids lay amidst the wreckage, their limbs lolling at unnatural angles.

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: Stringy gunk clings to the walls in tangled, tumorous masses that exude a faint phosphorescence.  The light reveals priceless treasures of silver and gold lying in fused lumps on the uneven floor of the burrow, their pedestals broken and consumed by corrosion.  Droplets of the caustic stuff have eaten away at the floor in places, leaving holes ranging in size from pocks to potholes.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: The expansive hallway has been turned into a twisting warren of tunnelways by fallen rock and hanging wormsilk.  Its denizens seem to have little trouble moving through the debris, as the pitted tunnels they have left behind are everywhere, marked by liquid-smooth and undulating edges eaten out of the stone itself.  Strangely, a single untouched tapestry hangs from the far wall, depicting a luminous humanoid figure with long limbs and a dragon's wings.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: The fleshless remains of a gigas skeleton are scattered across the rough ground of the burrow, the bones eaten away in places and sucked clean of marrow.  Lengths of goopy wormsilk cling to the bones like a poorly made robe, their phosphorescence casting strange shadows around the remains.  Nearby, a huge spear with a broken obsidian tip lies tangled in the radiant gunk.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: Overhead, the ceiling of the hall is a twisted fusion of stone archway and draping, oozing silk.  The stuff drips down over a pile of dull scales that litter the ragged floor around a worm's shed husk.  Greying and brittle, the remnants are immense in length, hinting at a truly colossal source.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: Laying in a corroded depression within the floor of the burrow, an immense wormsilk cocoon casts waves of luminescence that outshines the surrounding gunk's phosphorescent light.  Filling the pit are the fused remnants of a small fortune in golden coins, joined into a heavy mass studded here and there with trapped gemstones.  Holes worn in the ceiling reveal winking threads of the aurora in the sky above the mausoleum.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: Collapsed stonework has left a large chunk of the burrow open to the sky and the cold.  Strips of wormsilk tangled about the broken support columns whip in the breeze.  Scattered treasures wink from the ruins, the trapped wealth brightly reflecting the writhing aurora in the twilit skies above.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: Strings of slimy silk twine down pillars that are so pitted with corrosion that they struggle to support the weight of the stone blocks above.  Icy wind whistles through chinks in the walls, making the silken threads whip and dance.  There is a musky, alien odor in the air that the constant onslaught of gelid air cannot entirely dispel.

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: A stunted, shriveled worm corpse lies in a pool of partially frozen muck amidst the wreckage of a fallen stone wall.  The creature is mostly buried in the rubble.  Heavy blankets of sticky, glowing silk drape over the fallen corpse and the surrounding stones like a funeral shroud, rippling in the cold air currents.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: A mostly untouched stretch of the once-grand hallway is free from infestation but for a few thick threads of silk clinging to the floor.  Beneath a tangle of copper inlay in the wall that resembles the dance of the aurora's wild light, a rounded pedestal rises out of the ground.  Sitting atop it, bathed in the faint luminescence of the chamber, is a crude golden chalice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Angargreft, Burrow]
description: The looming statue of a massive robed figure oversees the stretch of hallway, implacable features seemingly oblivious to the transmogrification of the corridor.  Spots of corrosion mar the work up to its knees, which stand nearly as tall as a full-grown man.  Luminous shreds of a substance, reminiscent of a spider's silk but vastly thicker and ragged at the edges, hang from the statue and drip from the walls.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: Atop a set of vast stone steps, the walkway curves toward the northwest, the path guided by long-spent torches in brackets of rusted iron.  One has been wrenched free from its setting, with a gaping hole in the stone left behind.  Cold gusts of air whistle along the sepulchral halls like a chorus of mourning cries.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: The western wall is partly consumed by a curtain of stringy goop and much of the stone is pocked and porous.  Its source appears to be a crack in the ceiling.  The rocked edges look to have been devoured by some caustic substance.   Some of the translucent threads cling to the westward edge of vast stone steps climbing toward the edifice's terraced second story.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: Cyclopean columns of stone support a high, uneven ceiling that is poorly fitted enough to let the muddled light of the northern sky filter into the hallway.  Icy wind, too, finds its way through the cracks with a constant shrill whistle.  Recessed alcoves bordering the walk hold naught but shadows and dust.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: The stone floor is tacky and red with the spillover from red fluid dripping down the eastern wall.  Due to the cant of the ground, the coagulating liquid has pooled at the feet of a carved figure recessed into the western wall.  The wild-haired female gigas statue looks little bothered by the flood.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: Part of the ceiling has collapsed into the hallway.  A fallen monolith, almost as wide as the corridor, supports what remains of the structure's integrity.  The monolith is scored with many claw marks that look to have pierced its hard stone with terrifying ease.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: Stairs climbing to the western terrace have collapsed under the weight of fallen rubble.  Glimpses of starry twilight, tinted with wild hues from the aurora, wink through cracks in the stone.  Wind screams through the clefts, filling the hallway with a sound like constant shrieking.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Uneven light from the aurora ripples across the sky, causing the fane's chill shadow to dance and waver ominously along the cold-hardened ground.  Far above the terrace, the highest tier of the structure is a blocky silhouette with a squared roof supported by high pillars.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Shining prismatically in the aurora's reflected light, a chunk of solid ice near the fane's wall is but the first of several gathered in a rough arrangement across the area.  Crystalline clusters spray out from a point nearby in an arc as if swept into being by a great gust of wind.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: The permafrost is stained a dark red-black.  Great claw marks score the frosty earth's surface and have left behind spiderwebbing cracks across it.  Chunks of cyclopean stone are torn out of the northern wall of the fane, revealing the wider, close-fitted blocks of its inner wall, which are darker in hue and with rougher surfaces than the wind-smoothed facade.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Tall, spindly cedars encroach upon the back of the fane.  Their gnarled roots have grown across the path and into the stones of the fane's facade.  Questing root tips have pierced the wall, causing several to slide from their places into a rocklide twice as tall as a man.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Droves of the dead lie in niches along the walls.  Weapons interred with them have turned to dust and rust, but still the desiccated corpses lie, wasted fingers clenched around the splintered remains.  The head of a huge metal greataxe, somehow spared the ravages of time, lies in the middle of the path, its edges notched and dull.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: The hallway veers around a gap where the rock has given way, leaving a pit that opens into endless blackness below.  The stone at the edge of the pit is scored and smeared with dried blood.

title: [Angargreft, Pits of the Dead]
description: Stark against the ruddy rock comprising the walls and floor, an archway of lightless black stone dominates the northern wall at the corridor's dead end.  Steps ascend to the archway, parting around a slick black stone altar.  The walls to either side are painted with patterns of golden wings, the pigments enhanced with metal powder that makes the artwork glitter strangely.

Stark against the ruddy rock comprising the walls and floor, an archway of lightless black stone dominates the northern wall at the corridor's dead end.  Steps ascend to the archway, but beyond it is just a wall of cragged stone.  The walls to either side are painted with patterns of golden wings, the pigments enhanced with metal powder that makes the artwork glitter strangely.

title: [Hinterwilds, Game Trail]
description: The distinctive tang of spoor is heavy in the air on the game trail, a hidden path forged out of the surrounding woodland by predators and prey.  Pine, spruce, and tamarack crowd in on the narrow passage, boughs full of their prickling needles poking out into the walkway at uneven intervals.  A cluster of holly bushes, their frozen berries glinting in the aurora's light, frame a path leading to more open woodland in the southeast.

title: [Hinterwilds, Game Trail]
description: Holly grows in iced-over patches along the edges of the game trail, lending bright splashes of crimson to the snowy surroundings.  Laying abandoned in one patch is a rough-carved hoarbeam staff adorned with raw bloodrubies, its owner's torn arm several paces away.  The fingers and knuckles have been gnawed on by creatures, but the hand is otherwise remarkably well preserved by the surrounding snow and ice.

title: [Hinterwilds, Game Trail]
description: The game trail widens into a shrouded path that meanders up to some snowy trees to the northwest, the stand of close-growing pines obscuring the trailway from the forest beyond.  Several bone fetishes are woven with twine around the boughs of the conifers.  The bones are sourced mostly from birds and small rodents, but there are a few larger ones that might be humanoid among them.

title: [Caligos Isle, Water's Edge]
description: Crates and bundles sit just outside of the waterline where the rollicking tide rushes towards the land with what equates to a roar at times and a whisper at others.  The rough, irregular stones of the jetty form a backdrop to the land and a break that keeps the rougher, larger storm-tossed waves at a bay.  A scattering of discarded building supplies, and long launch poles rest upon the sand.

title: [Caligos Isle, Water's Edge]
description: Curving into the ocean, the small protrusion of land is surrounded by water on three sides.  Long poles, used for launching a boat, stretch towards the water, their ends darkened by the lapping tide.  Scattered about the sodden sands, pearlescent seashells glitter in the ambient light.

title: [Caligos Isle, Estuary]
description: Sheltered by the rushing waters of an island-borne stream, the sodden sand is home to various construction sites and has several long poles used for the launching of boats decorating its irregular terrain.  The sound of glugging fills the air every time the lapping tide overtakes the waters of the small stream.

title: [L and G's Emporium, Studio]
description: A heavy brushed invar door allows access and privacy to this work chamber, which has been meticulously cleaned.  A few clippings, bolts, and rivets can be spotted on a long polished steel workbench with a bent corner, apparently left over from a recent tinkering.

title: [L and G's Emporium, Salesroom]
description: Elegantly organized, this spacious room is spotless, from textured invar flooring to sturdy modwir joists and ceiling.  A set of modwir racks stands in a dignified manner between some brass shelving and a hammered copper counter.  A heavy brushed invar door presents an air of both invitation and security, appearing to serve as a reliable barrier from unwanted incursion from either side.

title: [Rogue's Gambit, Entry]
description: Oil lamps with inverted conical shades hang directly over the merchandise displays situated about the interior of the pavilion, providing ample light under which the goods for sale can be examined, while leaving the rest of the space crowded by dim shadows.
