Tucked into the only well-lit corner is a small round table with a discreet vellum note card posted among the wares, and off to the side is a rack of dark metal hangers.

title: [Rogue's Gambit, Tools and Such]
description: All but one of the oil lamps in this section of the pavilion are concentrated along one wall, fully illuminating an open-faced wooden cabinet and a set of round pegs, beneath which sits a small round table with a discreet vellum note card posted amongst its wares.  The other lamp hangs directly above a heavy grey suede curtain that leads deeper into the shop.

title: [Rogue's Gambit, Backroom]
description: Several slate blue glass-shaded lanterns hang from the supports in this rear section of the pavilion, shedding light that is both easy on the eyes and adequate for detailed work.  A round ebonwood worktable sits near the far wall with a matching ebonwood stool, while several dark grey velvet-cushioned chairs are arranged haphazardly in the space beyond.  Centrally stationed among the seating is a glass-shelved wrought iron cart.

title: [Weave and Wear, Accessories]
description: Filtering through the skylight above, beams of pale light illuminate the small area inside the wagon.  Draped over the rafter above, bundles of colorful feathers swing to and fro.  Some shelves hang above a narrow wooden table, its surface covered with bits of leaves and flower petals.  Strands of ivy climb down a small painted door from a narrow box tacked to its surface.

title: [Weave and Wear, Workroom]
description: Smaller than the other areas of the wagon, the work area is cluttered with boxes and crates.  Various tools and materials are scattered over the surface of a worn, marble-topped table.  A large chalkboard dominates the wall above.   Pushed to the side is a small wooden bench, the floor underneath carpeted with bits of discarded blossoms and greenery.

title: [Conservation of Mask]
description: The interior of this tent has been painted with a starry night motif with scattered pale specks forming familiar constellations amidst a backdrop of deep blues and blacks. Several metallic contraptions have been set atop small stone pillars, their gears and joints clearly well-maintained, but their purpose unknown. The tantalizing aroma of fudge wafts in from somewhere.

title: [Wrenella's Wrappings, The Light]
description: Bearing racks and hooks, smooth black walls line this cramped room, its floorboards rickety and well-worn.  Generous amounts of light project from lanterns overhead as smells of new leather and cloth permeate the air.

title: [Wrenella's Wrappings, The Dark]
description: A lone lantern hangs in the center overhead and gently sways in the wake of the commotion below.  With dancing shadows cast upon them, racks and hooks line the room's smooth white walls, broken only by a matte grey door.

title: [Wrenella's Wrappings, Office]
description: Opposite a matte grey door, scraps of leather and textiles are scattered among hand tools around a workbench that extends from the wall's vertical wooden panels, which are seldom visible between the numerous clothing racks and half-open chests of fabrics that take up the rest of the room's perimeter.

title: [Steamed Up]
description: Patinated copper pipes line the walls in intersecting patterns, some wrapping around a single small glass window painted an opaque black.  A coat rack crafted of welded mismatched gears stands off-kilter beside a dark sepia trunk with a broken lid.  Stacks of crates in the back partially hide a broken metal door.

title: [Steamed Up, Backroom]
description: Scattered about the area are bits of scrap metal, rusted and tilted in odd angles with pointed ends sticking out here and there.  Odd benches made from copper pipes bent at odd angles line the walls beneath additional piping leading to a heavy stove with an angry face painted on it.  A metal door leads back to the front of the shop.

title: [Gonna Be Lit]
description: A plush carpet of green velvet covers the ground inside of the tent.  A central pole holds the canopy high overhead, with several glass lamps hanging from it to provide more than sufficient illumination.  A large mahogany display stands prominently before the center support.

title: [Macabre Masquerade, Atelier]
description: A web-like chandelier of blackened steel hangs above a many-horned glaes and ivory skeleton, casting fragmented shadows upon the ebonwood-planked floor.  The disjointed sounds of an onyx-framed musicbox plink randomly, the box nestled within a darkened corner with a pair of wire-framed mannequins.  A faint haze of incense smoke veils the air around the shop, the scent of absinthe and leather lingering as it dissipates.

title: [Island Sounds, Showroom]
description: Messy and cluttered, the wagon is piled with crates overflowing with various materials.  The interior of the wagon is crossed with a twisted labyrinth of piping that travels in and out of the walls.  Bits of jewelry and other items hang from the chaotic tangle of metal.  A small archway covered with a tattered blanket at the back of the space is barely visible through the jumbled mess.

title: [Island Sounds, Workroom]
description: Bits of metal and piping are scattered about the small area making it difficult to walk.  Boxes, crates, and barrels of various sizes are overflowing with springs, coils, bolts, and screws.  Piles of unfinished projects are stacked around a small archway covered with a tattered blanket.  A large metal sign is propped up against the jumbled mess.

title: [Beginner's Boo-N, Entry]
description: Imperfectly fastened modwir boards serve as walls in this room of a hastily erected shack, allowing the occasional draft and glimpse of movement from its exterior.  A multitiered alabaster rack, a multitiered blue ironwood rack, and a multitiered ebon ironwood rack are neatly arranged in staggered formation and rest securely on flat spots of the dirt floor.

title: [Beginner's Boo-N, Central]
description: It's slightly drafty in the central room of this shoddily constructed modwir shack.  The scent of ocean air and earthy tones emanating from the dirt floor allows a sense of serenity amongst an alabaster display, an ebon oaken display, and a blue oaken display.

title: [Beginner's Boo-N, North]
description: A northerly draft occasionally permeates unsealed walls and feels redirected as it travels around a monir shield stand and a tall modwir barrel.  Bare bedrock provides firmer footing here than the soft dirt which transitions to the south.

title: [Beginner's Boo-N, Tinkering]
description: The rustic modwir shack's extremity is settled on a complete slab of bedrock and seems to serve as a reliable work space.  A large oaken work table, which appears spotless and uncluttered aside from the assortment of organized tools it houses, sits close to the well-constructed and sealed eastern wall.

title: [The Issenflow, Currents]
description: Frigid water swirls around you, the current slow but relentless.  Illuminated by the light of the aurora overhead, the water is murky and stretches downward toward lightless depths.  Chunks of pure white ice bob by, ranging in size from mere shards to great bergs.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Mist Harbor Mail Office]
description: The bright sunlight which trickles in from the small dusty window along the far wall dances across the warped driftwood floorboards of this small mail office.  A hurried mail clerk rushes back and forth across the mahogany front counter, stuffing envelopes and packages in various awaiting cubbyholes, seemingly oblivious to the rest of the world.  In the corner of the room, a nearly featherless macaw sits in a tarnished silver cage releasing a shrill squawk with each new customer who enters the building.

title: [River's Rest Post Office, Lobby]
description: A floor of uneven planks tracked with river mud greets the eye of the visitor.  A waterstained bench rests against one wall and above it sits a portrait surrounded by a gilded frame.  In the corner sit several crates, the uppermost stained with a pattern of splattered dark crimson spots and decorated with a vase of gathered cattails and bright yellow marsh marigolds.  In an opposite corner rests a half-open sack of letters and scrolls.  The planks of the wall nearest to the door are covered in numerous carvings.

title: [Post Office, Finn's Office]
description: A heavily scarred desk is situated opposite of the entrance to the room, and behind it stands a grizzled half-elven clerk.  Strung along the walls is a length of thick rope hung with an odd assortment of items.  Leaning against the desk, in easy handreach of the clerk, is a large, armed crossbow.  The occassional squawk of a river bird passes through the poorly constructed walls of the room, along with the scent of wet earth.

Strung along the walls is a length of thick rope hung with an odd assortment of items.  Leaning against the desk, in easy handreach of the clerk, is a large, armed crossbow.  The occasional squawk of a river bird passes through the poorly constructed walls of the room, along with the scent of wet earth.

title: [Carrack, Main Deck]
description: A flock of seagulls whirls high above a wooden mast overhead, one occasionally diving towards the water below.  A constant breeze ripples both the sea and the fabric of a winter white flyrsilk sail, the riggings moving rhythmically back and forth above some cannons on either side of the deck.  An overturned bucket serving as a makeshift stool sits in front of a fishing pole abandoned against an obsidian mistwood gangplank.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Carrack, Helm]
description: A strong sea breeze rushes through, turning a winter white mistwood wheel slightly off course.  A wooden capstan sits scuffed and worn from repeated use.  Down a short flight of stairs, a pair of sconces brighten the area around a wooden door leading to the captain's quarters.

title: [Carrack, Forward Deck]
description: The cannons are mounted on the bulwarks are shadowed beneath a winter white flyrsilk sail billowing from a wooden mast towering overhead.  Crewmen dash back and forth attending to the riggings, while another team moves cargo below deck into the hold.  A crows nest can be spotted high up the mast, ratlines leading up from both sides of the ship to the lookout point.

title: [Carrack, Bow]
description: An overlong bowsprit, the wooden spar fitted with festooned stays attached to the foremast, holds up the figurehead at the front of the ship.  Occasional surf sprays douse the decking and crew with salty sea water which is quickly dried in the constant breeze.

title: [Carrack, Crow's Nest]
description: A repurposed rum barrel, the perch is filled with the sound of caws from a cage filled with inky black crows hanging from the top of the main mast.  Half of the barrel bottom has been removed to allow access to the rope ladders leading back down to the main deck.  A tarnished brass spyglass is mounted to the barrel.

title: [Carrack, Captain's Quarters]
description: A tattered map hangs above a mistwood bed with an ornately carved footboard situated near a window that runs the breadth of the stern, the view of the sea beyond superior to any painting hanging on the cocobolo-paneled walls of this well appointed cabin.  The nautical charts strewn across a shadowy black mistwood table tell the ship's history at sea, while the details are all recorded in the log books stacked on an ironwood throne finished with a glossy veneer.  A large sea chest occupies one corner, a lock securing its contents inside.

title: [Carrack, Cargo Hold]
description: Below deck, the cargo hold is fully stocked with supplies needed for a long journey at sea.  Oaken barrels and burlap sacks line the walls, while baskets swing from the ceiling teeming with dry goods and herbs.  Crates stamped with exotic ports of call sit under the stairs leading up to a hatch above.

title: [Carrack, Crew Quarters]
description: Countless hammocks, fashioned from lengths of sailcloth, are strung from the ceiling in this cramped space.  Makeshift tables have been pieced together from old barrels and warped planks, each set with mismatched tin cups and water pitchers.  A basket of fruit hangs from a post near the door, along with a community toothbrush.

title: [Carrack, Mess Hall]
description: Lanterns sway above an obsidian cocobolo table which runs the length of the hall, an obsidian cocobolo bench on either side providing ample seating for the ships crew.  Stacked in one corner, casks of hard cider, ale, and other assorted potations are on tap.  A scruffy dog lies sleeping beneath the table, a chewed bone tucked securely under one paw.

title: [Man O' War, Helm]
description: The mizzenmast towers over a wooden capstan, its large wooden drum wound with thick hemp rope and ready to be turned.  Some paces behind a shadowy black zebrawood wheel, the pathway leading to a wooden door is impeded by a jumble of fishing nets and an overturned launch boat.  A pair of fishing poles lean against a thick teak post on which hangs the recently polished ships bell.

title: [Man O' War, Captain's Quarters]
description: A tattered map hangs above a shadowy black mahogany bed layered with plush furs situated near a window that runs the breadth of the stern, the view of the sea beyond superior to any painting hanging on the mahogany-paneled walls of this well appointed cabin.  The nautical charts strewn across a smoky amber mahogany table tell the ship's history at sea, while the details are all recorded in the log books stacked on a mahogany throne set on tentacle-carved legs.  A large sea chest occupies one corner, a lock securing its contents inside.

title: [Man O' War, Main Deck]
description: Across a pitch black spruce gangplank, the main deck stretches out in both directions, from the bow to the stern of this massive warship, the wide oak planks gleaming in the sunlight a misty grey hemp sail billows from a wooden mast above the entrance to the cargo hold below, while a crows nest can be spotted high above.  The bulkheads are lined with cannons facing ports fitted with wooden hatches.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Man O' War, Mid Deck]
description: Attached to a yard on a wooden mast, a misty grey hemp sail billows overhead casting shadows on the wide-planked deck.  Ropes crisscross back and forth, the intricate arrangement reminiscent of a perfectly laid out spiders web.  Smaller launch boats hang in cradles above both port and starboard sides raised above rows of cannons.

title: [Man O' War, Forward Deck]
description: The shrouds rising up a wooden mast beyond the utmost a misty grey hemp sail pass a lookout post that appears minuscule from this vantage point.  A length of sailcloth hangs over the railing, while several mops and buckets are pushed out of the way against the bulkhead.  The complicated rigging is attached to elaborate belaying pins along the ships railing above some cannons.

title: [Man O' War, Bow]
description: Staring down from the foremost part of the ship, the prow gives view to the maidenhead fixed to the sharply slanted bowsprit.  A seagull sits perched on the railing, fixed with curious gaze.  Hewn from a single piece of timber, the foremast soars above the deck, a pennant fluttering at its peak.

title: [Man O' War, Crow's Nest]
description: Near the top of the foremast, a basket has been mounted between the topgallant sail and the fore topsail which serves as the chief observation post onboard.  Outfitted with a swivel-mounted spyglass on the brass railing, theres only room for one lookout.  Rope ladders lead through a hatch in the floor back down to the main deck.

title: [Man O' War, Crow's Nest]
description: Far above the main deck, higher than the top of the yards of fabric sails, a platform encircling the main mast looks out over the ship and to the sea beyond.  A spyglass hangs from a length of knotted leather cord tied to the narrow railing.  Carved into the wooden trapdoor in the platform is a detailed kraken, a broken ship wrapped in its suckered tentacles.

title: [Man O' War, Cargo Hold]
description: Ropes strung through staples in the deck hold kegs and barrels in place against the bulkhead, while shelves are stocked with sails, wood, and lines.  Chests filled with supplies are stacked tightly leaving just enough space to maneuver between rows.  Livestock pens are located beneath the ladder leading back up to the main deck.

title: [Man O' War, Crew Quarters]
description: Row after row of canvas hammocks threaded through hemp ropes sway from the low deckheads, while tightly stacked bunks line the walls.  Sea chests and metal footlockers are secured through staples set into the deck to ensure that they stay in place during the worst of storms.  A weathered driftwood writing desk sits in one corner next to a small wash basin.

title: [Man O' War, Mess Hall]
description: Sandwiched between a wooden bench and the bulkhead, a wooden table is littered with empty plates and overturned tankards.  A copper-banded barrel full of water sits in one corner, a wooden ladle hanging from the rim.  The smell of baking bread and roasting meats wafts in from the galley.

title: [Man O' War, Social Room]
description: Not much more than a raised wooden platform, a small stage lined with brass lanterns welcomes the next bardic performer.  Stools are lined up in front of a long bar crafted from polished teak, tapped barrels of ale and wine behind.  A small tip jar sits at one end of the bar next to a music box plinking out a jaunty tune.

title: [Brigantine, Captain's Quarters]
description: Wrought iron lanterns sway overhead, the dancing flames casting light on a wooden chair positioned behind a wooden table, laden with charts, logbooks, and a tattered map.  A straw bed is made up beneath an expansive window, the view interrupted by a dangling rope with bucket in hand to clean the glass panes.  An elaborate astrolabe hangs on the wood-paneled wall near the door.

title: [Brigantine, Helm]
description: Situated across from a wooden wheel and laced with coils of thick, braided hemp rope, a wooden capstan is prepared to weigh or drop anchor.  A viciously barbed harpoon is tangled in a mess of nets near a short flight of stairs with a wooden door at bottom leading to the quarters of the captain.  A dagger-pierced parchment on the door displays a skull and crossbones.

title: [Brigantine, Main Deck]
description: A rectangular sail hanging from a wooden mast casts a large shadow across a misty grey spruce gangplank, while rigging creates a dark, web-like pattern across the planks of the main deck. Along both sides of the ship, some cannons stand at the ready.  A lone gull circles overhead, its sonorous call a greeting to those on board.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Brigantine, Crow's Nest]
description: From high atop the main mast, a platform enclosed by a wooden railing serves as a lookout point.  Rope ladders attached to either side of the landing wind their way through billowy sails to the main deck below.  A brass spyglass dangles from a length of leather cord attached to the mast for safe keeping.

title: [Brigantine, Forward Deck]
description: A rectangular sail snaps in the breeze above some cannons lined up on each side of the deck, while a crewman swabs the deck, cleaning up loose powder and keeping the area shipshape.  High above a wooden mast, a crow's nest is visible through the moving sailcloth.

title: [Brigantine, Cargo Hold]
description: Crates and barrels fill the cargo hold, all the supplies a crew might need for a long journey.  A few treasure chests fastened with heavy locks are partially concealed underneath the stairs leading up onto the deck.  Piles of sailcloth and tangled nets have been left here for mending.

title: [Brigantine, Crew Quarters]
description: Countless hammocks, fashioned from lengths of sailcloth, are strung from the ceiling in this cramped space.  Makeshift tables have been pieced together from old barrels and warped planks, each set with mismatched tin cups and water pitchers.  A basket of fruit hangs from a post near the door, along with a community toothbrush.

title: [Brigantine, Mess Hall]
description: The remains of an earlier meal sits atop a wooden table, the tin cups dry, not a drop of rum left.  To each side of the table, a wooden bench is carved with names, dates, and a few crudely drawn maidens.  A rat scurries out from beneath a flour sack dumped in one corner, a one-eyed cat with a clipped tail chasing after it.

title: [Arakhor Estate, Entryway]
description: Rich ivory granite walls provide a stark contrast to the warm polished mahogany floor.  A tall intricately carved lor grandfather clock is set against the right wall, while a vibrant tapestry bearing the image of a crest hangs on the left.  A sweeping dual staircase leads to the upper floor, creating an alcove occupied by a carved lor table.  A clear glass dome centered in the ceiling allows sunlight to bathe the area.

title: [Arakhor Estate, Parlour]
description: Thick gold-tasseled crimson rugs cover the natural mahogany floor, complementing the gold-flecked ivory granite walls.  A pair of ebon leather wingback chairs flank an ornate cedar table in front of an expansive fireplace.  Tucked into the far corner is a modest lor bar complete with rows of liquor bottles on shelves behind it and a dark fel dart board nearby.  Heavily curtained windows allow some light to filter in, keeping the room cozy and cool despite its abnormally large size.  A glass-fronted case sits proudly beneath a stained glass window.

title: [Underground Cavern]
description: Hewn from the bedrock of the Ravelin plateau, this chamber sparkles with various gems and geodes within the stone walls.  The eastern wall of the cavern is simply missing, replaced by a magical barrier holding back the raging waters of the Mistydeep beyond and providing a unique glimpse of life beneath the river's surface.  A bluish white vein of unmined vaalorn meanders around a small pool and across the floor, ending at a natural rock shelf below several niches perfect for holding small ingredients.

title: [Arakhor Estate, Ballroom]
description: Stately columns of gold-flecked white marble support a massive frescoed dome.  A polished crimson marble dance floor, with similar gold flecks, gleams in the light of numerous elaborate chandeliers, providing an impressive setting for the carefully inlaid Arakhor family crest.  Several padded benches rest along the edges of the circular area, unobtrusive yet readily available for tired revelers.

title: [Arakhor Estate, Deck]
description: Propped on massive cabers sunk deep into the bed of the Mistydeep, this large teak deck stretches over the river and provides an impressive view of the valley below.  Several adjustable wooden chairs with padded crimson cushions surround a stone-lined firepit and a rhimar-lined chest.  A fishing pole sits in the corner, leaning casually against a colorful pot of tulips, sunflowers, and daisies.

Several torches spaced along the railing flicker in the darkness, casting dancing shadows around the area.

title: [Arakhor Estate, Bedroom]
description: Set along the east side of the expansive room is a pair of arched windows flanking a central set of nearly identical arched double doors.  Sunlight spills across the dark-stained mahogany floor, embracing an expansive cedar wardrobe.  Centered between a pair of lor nightstands, a cushioned back-panel bed rests against the wall opposite an elaborate fireplace.  Twin caramel-hued couches surround a modest oval glass table atop a rectangular dark ochre and ivory rug near the fireplace.

title: [Obsidian Acropolis, Propylaeum]
description: An extensive marbled obsidian stairway snakes its way up the sloping hillside before coming to an abrupt plateau peaked with spiraling pillars of chiseled obsidian.  Atop the prominence, an imposing gatehouse adjoins the colonnade and a massive exterior wall decorated with elaborate jade blind arcading.

title: [Obsidian Acropolis, Stoa Elan]
description: Worn by foot-traffic and the effluxion of time, a lengthy gold-flecked obsidian walkway stretches from the gatehouse and ends at a colossal portico toward the east.  Helical pillars extend the span of the walkway, while providing support for an expansive rainbow glaes canopy that arcs high overhead from the northern veranda.  From this picturesque vantage point, a sprawling amphitheater lies beyond the southern colonnade while the faint traces of Sylvarraend are visible in the far distance.

description: Vibrant crepuscular sunrays pierce through a large lor-framed bay window illuminating a cluttered glowbark desk alongside a stout mithril alloy footlocker.  Pulsating mana whirls throughout the workshop, inducing the prickling sensation of static on one's skin.  Resting atop a granite fireplace is a sephwir dart board surrounded by a pair of overstuffed bookcases and several shelves scattered with a myriad of colorful alchemical components.

title: [Obsidian Acropolis, Observatory]
description: The pleochroic fire obsidian walls of the observatory arc skywards to support a magnificent glass-domed ceiling that suspends an intricate whirling kelyn orrery.  Commanding the precise center of the spherical expanse, a towering veil iron telescope vigilantly surveys the eternal heavens above.  Etched along the barrel of the telescope are dozens of detailed star charts and elaborate constellation maps, while a complex clockwork astrolabe hangs from its extended black diamond eyepiece.

title: [Obsidian Acropolis, Lyceum]
description: An oblong semicircle of silver-streaked black granite steps descends inward toward a grandiose, open-air, polished obsidian stage.  Encompassing the predominant platform is a horseshoe-shaped, shallow dry moat lined with a series of evenly spaced dark lanterns and sanded lor rampways at either end.  Along the posterior of the stage, an ornate widowwood rostrum rests at the midpoint of a vast, crescent-shaped marble wall that serves to reflect and amplify the surrounding acoustics.

title: [Obsidian Acropolis, Oubliette]
description: Enveloping darkness floods the senses with only the faintest trace of visible light streaking from the narrow slits of the grated trapdoor high overhead.  Long forgotten bones dangle precariously from heavily corroded manacles that litter the mossy granite surroundings.  Breaching from a deep fissure in the northern wall, a torrential stream rushes into the cavernous chamber before branching off in a series of pitch-dark apertures.

title: [Sylvarraend, Aurora's Light]
description: Vibrant green grass grows within a meadow spotted with goldenrod, larkspur, and the occasional black-eyed daisy, while towering modwirs form a natural boundary to the wild growth.  Lined with smooth river stones, a narrow dirt track ambles between the edge of Mistglin Wey and a two-story stable with wide haon and birch doors.  A dormant lantern hangs from the widow's peak where a stained glass window glitters in the sunlight.

title: [Aurora's Light Stables]
description: Six evenly spaced, anchor beams of sturdy, whitewashed oak rest upon matching arcade posts down the length of the nave and create the framework that supports the stable's walls and roof.  Matching wind braces stretch from the scarred threshing floor of hard-packed dirt to the haon-planked ceiling, each crosspiece decorated with ornate meadowlark lanterns.  In the east is a turquoise stall door, while opposite stands a large rain barrel.
location: Aurora's Light Stables, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Aurora's Light Stables]
description: Long, whitewashed posts rise from the hard-packed dirt threshing floor towards a ceiling comprised of polished haon boards, which are supported by smooth wind braces at each joint.  Culminating in larger, white birch doors with oversized wrought iron fixtures, the expanse is spacious with plenty of movement space despite the stacks of hay and bundles of bedding.  Sunlight streams in through the iron grating above an amethyst stall door, its golden flecks dancing upon the neighboring storage chest.
location: Aurora's Light Stables, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Aurora's Light, Pasture]
description: Black-eyed daisies with bright yellow petals sprout from the long tufts of grass that grow around the posts of a whitewashed fence that encircles a grassy pasture.  Towering modwirs provide pockets of shade along the edges of the field, the reaching limbs brushing the roof of a nearby stable whose large stable doors gleam in the sunlight.  Twin lanterns clutched in the feet of rosin meadowlarks reflect prismatic light from their perch to either side of an angled staircase that leads to the stable's second story.

title: [Aurora's Light, Loft]
description: Brilliant blue, polished haon floorboards are covered by a smattering of wooly bright white rugs, the lush floor coverings creating cozy social circles along the sharply angled western wall.  Round, high-backed chairs encircle a small carved table near a mahogany writing desk, while an oversized bright white armchair sits katy-corner beneath the watchful gaze of several meadowlark lanterns.  Near the exit, a pot-bellied cast iron stove, a rhimar-inlaid polished white chest, and a series of hanging baskets create a cozy and organized kitchenette.
location: Aurora's Light Stables, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Loft, Bedroom]
description: Sunlight streams through a brightly colored, stained glass window built into the peak of one wall, the dappled light painting a silver-hinged white birch door in vibrant, dancing hues.  Wooly bright white rugs stretch beneath a four-poster ebonwood bed, the lavish pieces providing a contrast to the bright blue of the haon floor, while a variety of carved meadowlarks hold aloft snowdrops in their curved claws.  Towering over the scene, a carved armoire is flanked by a floor-length mirror on one side and a small table with a white ivory basin and cloth-covered shelves on the other.
location: Aurora's Light Stables, outside the elven city of Ta'Illistim

title: [Frigate, Main Deck]
description: A bronze bell hangs beneath a misty grey flyrsilk sail fastened to a wooden mast towering overhead.  Down a steep companionway, a collection of barrels are lined up in front of a pile of cannonballs to replenish the munitions alongside some cannons on deck.  A section of rigging has snapped loose above a shadowy black ironwood gangplank, the rope swinging back and forth in the constant breeze.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Frigate, Cargo Hold]
description: Steel-banded oak barrels are stacked one on top of the other and made fast against the bulkhead.  Bags labeled coffee, tea, and flour are secured in place with web-like ropes, one of the bags torn open at one corner and spilling its fragrant black leaves to the salt-encrusted planks underfoot.  A large driftwood chest is thrown open, the sunlight glinting off a handful of gold coins inside.

title: [Frigate, Crew Quarters]
description: Row after row of canvas hammocks threaded through hemp ropes sway from the low deckheads, while tightly stacked bunks line the walls.  Sea chests and metal footlockers are secured through staples set into the deck to ensure that they stay in place during the worst of storms.  A weathered driftwood writing desk sits in one corner next to a small wash basin.

title: [Frigate, Mess Hall]
description: Singed cook pots and blackened pans hang from stout pegs on one wall above a silver-hued willow table laid out with fresh water pitchers, tin cups, and mismatched silver cutlery.  A cook sits on a silver-hued willow bench peeling potatoes into a large stewpot, his apron stained dark with blood.  The smell of roasting meat wafts in from the galley.

title: [Frigate, Social Room]
description: A card game in progress sits atop a makeshift table fashioned from rum barrels and oaken planks, the seats around the table a collection of footlockers and overturned buckets.  At the center of the room, discarded crates have been lashed together to form a small performance stage.  A rosewood mandolin has been partially concealed on a shelf behind a low bar crafted from mahogany running along the bulkhead.

title: [Frigate, Forward Deck]
description: Towering above, a wooden mast is shadowed by a misty grey flyrsilk sail rippling in the wind.  A collection of lines drape from the crow's nest, dangling partway to the deck below.  A wheel from the carriage underneath some cannons lies on the wide-planked deck, awaiting repairs.

title: [Frigate, Bow]
description: Commanding the best view from the ship, the bow is filled with the sonorous voices of the crew joined in sea shanty while they polish the railing, check the rigging for wear, and swab the wide-plank decking.  A breeze blows in, rustling the sails overhead, the rippling fabric lending another voice to the crew's song.

title: [Frigate, Crow's Nest]
description: Mounted up high on the main mast, a small teak platform encircled by a slender brass railing serves as an observation deck.  Underfoot, a trapdoor opens up to a ladder of ropes, the ratlines a complicated maze of knotted hemp.  A swivel-mounted sypglass lays dormant, the brass instrument etched with a sinuous kraken.

title: [Frigate, Helm]
description: A woodworking masterpiece, a silver-hued zebrawood wheel is positioned behind a polished teak binnacle, the housing for the ship's compass, with a wooden capstan bringing up the rear of the deck at the ship's helm.  Stacked next to a wooden door are a collection of silver and gold serving platters with accompanying utensils.

title: [Frigate, Captain's Quarters]
description: Luxuriously appointed with plush carpets over a polished teak floor, the cabin is well lit by gilded brass sconces set with beeswax candles.  The curtains are drawn back from an expansive, glaes-paned window, allowing the sunlight to spill across a shadowy black cedar bed layered with plush furs and onto an obsidian ironwood table and a mahogany settee cushioned with plush velvet nearby.  A vanilla-hued papyrus map is stuck to an ironwood-paneled wall by a dagger driven in almost to the hilt.

title: [Galleon, Main Deck]
description: Accessible via a sea blue ironwood gangplank, the main deck is outfitted with some cannons on either side.  Ratlines ascend upwards to the crows nest attached to a wooden mast, a pennant fluttering above a storm grey flyrsilk sail.  An opening in the wide-planked deck leads to the cargo hold below, the faint aroma of mildew and livestock mingling with the sea breeze near the hatch.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Galleon, Forward Deck]
description: On both sides of the large, open deck, some cannons point toward ports, each fitted with a wooden hatch.  A wooden mast fitted with a storm grey flyrsilk sail extends from the bottom of the ship skyward, a crows nest near its top barely visible from this angle.  The sound of the ships bell echoes, signaling a change of watch.

title: [Galleon, Bow]
description: Up the ladder from the main deck, a beak-like projection from the bow fitted with a long, sharp bowsprit is visible looking over the railing at the foredeck.  The privy can be seen from here, under the shadow of the foremast.

title: [Galleon, Helm]
description: Bars for a wooden capstan are stacked neatly alongside heaps of coiled rope ready to be wound around its wooden drum and to the anchor beneath the ship.  Atop a small platform, a sea blue ironwood wheel takes pride of place at the ships helm below the mizzenmast, just a stones throw away from a wooden door leading to the captain's quarters.

title: [Galleon, Captain's Quarters]
description: A gold flyrsilk map hangs above a gold mahogany bed with a flyrsilk-draped canopy situated near a window that runs the breadth of the stern, the view of the sea beyond superior to any painting hanging on the mahogany-paneled walls of this well appointed cabin.  The nautical charts strewn across a gold mahogany table tell the ship's history at sea, while the details are all recorded in the log books stacked on a mahogany throne cushioned with plush velvet.  A large sea chest occupies one corner, a lock securing its contents inside.

title: [Galleon, Crow's Nest]
description: Situated high above the deck and the shrouds of the mast, a simple platform is afforded the best view on the ship.  Through an open trapdoor, rope ladders sway in the breeze, the only means of escape to the main deck below.  A shiny brass spyglass is swivel-mounted to the narrow railing surrounding the crows nest.

title: [Galleon, Cargo Hold]
description: Burlap sacks weighted with grains, coffee, and sugar are lashed to the bulkheads behind nets of hemp rope, keeping them dry and out of the way.  Oaken barrels are stacked to the ceiling, each branded with a makers mark identifying the various spirits within.  An assortment of crates waiting to be organized sits at the ramp leading up out of the cargo hold.

title: [Galleon, Crew Quarters]
description: Hammocks fashioned from sailcloth and strung on lengths of braided rope sway from the low deckhead of this cramped cabin.  Likewise, the oaken table tops are strung from cables overhead, allowing sea chests and foot lockers to be stored underneath, as well as provide makeshift seating.  A tarnished silver mirror is fixed to the bulkhead above a small wash basin replete with shaving supplies.

title: [Galleon, Mess Hall]
description: Nestled between a gold mahogany bench on either side, a gold mahogany table fills most of the space in the hall.  In one corner, a rocking chair has been haphazardly fashioned from wine barrel staves and its seat occupied by a one-eyed, scruffy ships cat.  Empty platters and dry cups are laid out on the tabletop awaiting the next meal.

title: [Galleon, Social Room]
description: A felt-topped table and a quartet of comfortable chairs welcome the next players to a game of cards or dice in this roomy cabin filled with the scent of aged cigar smoke.  A scroll-framed mirror hangs behind a polished mahogany bar fixed with a brass foot rail, a row of matching stools lined up in front.  An old seafarers tune plinks out from a glass-topped music box on the end of the bar.

title: [Northern Post, Mail Room]
description: Framed by windows of frosted glass, the front door of the post office allows wintry air to cut through the warmth of the close room.  Beeswax candles sit along the window sills, but they lend more light than heat and perfume the air gently with their honeyed smell.  The real heat source is a blazing coal stove behind the polished pine counter.

title: [Northern Post, Little Shop]
description: Shelves full of packing materials line the brick walls of the little shop, making it seem more cramped than its limited space would suggest.  Guarded by a carved statue of an emperor penguin, the counter has a small stand holding envelopes and stampbooks.  Crystal-globed candles occupy sconces on the walls, lending a pleasant beeswax scent to the air and brightening the surroundings.

title: [North 'Haven Quay, Green Pier]
description: Dominating the immediate view with five large piers, the docking structure is comprised of water-darkened fel and oak boards with ironwood support posts set at regular intervals.  Each docking slip has its own thick bumper of cork and canvas with a handful of unused buoys tied to a piling.  A large sign hanging from the rope and oak railings reads, "North 'Haven Quay, Green Pier - Slips 21-25," and shards of bright pectin shell are inset along the outer edges.

title: [North 'Haven Quay, Green Pier]
description: Dominating the immediate view with five large piers, the docking structure is comprised of water-darkened fel and oak boards with ironwood support posts set at regular intervals.  Each docking slip has its own thick bumper of cork and canvas with a handful of unused buoys tied to a piling.  A large sign hanging from the rope and oak railings reads, "North 'Haven Quay, Green Pier - Slips 6-10," and shards of bright pectin shell are inset along the outer edges.

title: [North 'Haven Quay, White Pier]
description: Water-roughened oak and fel piers jut out from a large docking structure.  Several rope-wrapped ironwood posts set at regular intervals are covered in barnacles and salt stains, and the constant susurrus of waves hitting the pilings fills the air.  A stack of unused buoys, each stamped with a green wisp, rests next to a large sign reading, "North 'Haven Quay, White Pier - Slips 1-5."

title: [North 'Haven Quay, Blue Pier]
description: Salt-stained oak and fel piers spread across the large docking structure, providing ample portage.  Each ironwood support post has been carved with the image of a peg-legged cat, and the powerful scent of salt water and seaweed drifts in the breeze.  Strung from the hempen railing, a large sign reads, "North 'Haven Quay, Blue Pier - Slips 1-5."

title: [North 'Haven Quay, Gold Pier]
description: Several coils of rope, thicker than an ogre's thigh, rest at the base of each ironwood support post on the oak and fel pier.  Numerous docking slips provide ample portage, their thick cork padding painted with ebon krakens wrapping myriad tentacles about them.  Strung from the driftwood and rope railings is a carved sign reading, "North 'Haven Quay, Gold Pier - Slips 1-5."

title: [North 'Haven Quay, Crimson Pier]
description: Comprised of saltstained boards of oak and fel, this large docking structure has five long piers extending from it and is dotted with oddly colored barnacles.  Several docking slips provide ample portage, each with a thick cork bumper padding the rough edges.  Ironwood support posts are set at regular intervals, and a carved oak sign inlaid with bits of ruby nassa reads, "North 'Haven Quay, Crimson Pier - Slips 1-5."

title: [North 'Haven Quay, Catwalk]
description: Water-darkened oak and fel have been intentionally scuffed to provide purchase on the perpetually slippery catwalk.  Set side by side along it are a polished oak shop and a glass-paneled oak building, both held up with several support posts of saltstained ironwood.  A wide ramp heads away from the catwalk and its large docking structure.

title: [Carelt's Carracks]
description: Numerous displays of ships rest on polished oak shelves lining the walls of this shop, each with a framed vellum sign providing extra details.  Carefully placed for optimum visibility are pedestals highlighting other ship-related paraphernalia, and inlaid upon the oak floor is a sea glass mural of a pitched battle.  Behind the fel counter hang various pennants and flags representing a variety of navies and other nautical organizations.

title: [Ardenys's Academy for Bos'ns]
description: Wide windows let in enough ambient light to brighten the entire room, and a polished teak counter is set just below the large skylight.  Neat stacks of canvas sails in a multitude of hues are displayed along one wall, and a variety of ropes are coiled along another.  Several examples of boatswain's chairs line the back wall, ranging from the impeccably made to a cobbled together item of light canvas and frayed rope.

title: [North Dock, Foggy Larton Pier]
description: Several large posts are situated at regular intervals along the teak pier, each carved with a striped warcat.  Cork and canvas bumpers pad each docking slip, and the soft sound of waves slapping against wooden support posts fills the air.  A carved driftwood sign reads, "Foggy Larton Pier - Slips 21-25."

title: [Greycil's Galleons and More]
description: Numerous displays highlight a variety of ships and ship customizations, presumably available in this brightly lit and pristine shop.  An entire wall is devoted to ships in glass bottles interspersed with antique sailing flags, and a large teak counter holds a single candle, its strong citrus scent dispelling the more pungent odors coming from the pier outside.

title: [Nexyn's Notables]
description: Several ship banners are strung along the upper walls just above the myriad green-tinged leaded glass windows, and neatly stacked along the floors are several brightly colored canvas sails.  Dozens of coils of rope in various thicknesses and weights line the back wall and are piled up behind the polished teak counter.  A glass display in the center of the shop holds dozens of different boatswain's pipes, many looking to be several hundred years old.

title: [West Docks, Firestone Catwalk]
description: Alternating glaes-banded planks stretch from one end of the catwalk to the other.  An oak and glaes shop and a saltstained teak building rest on stilts above the ocean water below, and marking the top of a wide ramp, a single sun-bleached flag rests atop a nearby wooden pillar, flapping in the ever-present ocean breeze.

title: [Andaske's Boatswain Academy]
description: Neatly folded sails and coils of thick hempen rope are stacked along the polished oak floor of the academy.  Along the back, organization has gotten a bit more erratic, sporting several tipped over piles of canvas in various bright colors with thick remnants of rope snaking between them.  Resting on a sturdy teak counter is a large candle emitting a blend of smoky vetiver and citrus that mingles with, but does not eradicate, the ocean smells of the pier.

title: [Valwen's Voyages]
description: Several intricate models of ships line the walls, each with an explanatory placard containing myriad details.  Behind the polished glaes counter are several ship flags and banners, some pristine and others in tatters, and scattered along the polished oak floors are various ship components and customizations, displayed so haphazardly as to pose a danger to the distracted customer.

title: [West Docks, Asterfire Pier]
description: A large docking structure with five piers dominates the immediate area.  Water-roughened oak boards are edged in darkened glaes for added longevity and strength.  Saltstained teak support posts are set at regular intervals along the pier, each carved with "BMC 4997."  Myriad docking slips provide ample portage, and every slip has canvas-wrapped thick cork bumpers.  A gem-encrusted sign strung between thick strands of hemp railing reads, "West Docks, Asterfire Pier - Slips 1-5."

title: [West Docks, Blue Geode Pier]
description: The glaes-strengthened oak pier is punctuated by teak posts set at regular intervals.  Neatly coiled piles of rope frame each docking slip, and thick cork bumpers protect the docking structure from errant ships.  A glaes-edged sign hangs between thick strands of hemp railing and reads, "West Docks, Blue Geode Pier - Slips 1-5," and underneath someone has scrawled, "Stormbrow is watching."

title: [West Docks, Dreamstone Pier]
description: A glaes-accented oak docking structure rises from the water with five piers jutting out in orderly fashion to provide numerous points of portage.  Every docking slip sports thick, canvas-wrapped cork bumpers and a dozen buoys painted with golden helms.  An oak sign strung between thick strands of hemp railing reads, "West Docks, Dreamstone Pier - Slips 1-5."  A severed kiramon mandible is haphazardly nailed to the bottom of the sign.

title: [West Docks, Dragonfire Pier]
description: Five piers of saltstained oak edged with darkened glaes form a large docking structure with ample portage.  Covered with myriad, tiny barnacles in a variety of colors, teak support posts frame each docking slip.  Thick cork bumpers are each painted with a chubby white goose, and a glaes-inlaid sign reads, "West Docks, Dragonfire Pier - Slips 1-5."

title: [West Docks, Sunstone Pier]
description: Dark glaes strengths the water-roughened dock structure and its five piers.  Tall support posts of saltstained teak rise from the waters below and are wrapped with thick coils of rope.  Each docking slip is equipped with several buoys and a thick cork bumper.  A glaes-edged sign strung between thick strands of hemp railing reads, "West Docks, Sunstone Pier - Slips 1-5," and has been inlaid with a brightly colored volcano mosaic.

Thick cork bumpers are each painted with a chubby white goose, and a glaes-inlaid sign reads, "West Docks, Dragonfire Pier - Slips 21-25."

title: [West Docks, Sunstone Pier]
description: Dark glaes strengths the water-roughened dock structure and its five piers.  Tall support posts of saltstained teak rise from the waters below and are wrapped with thick coils of rope.  Each docking slip is equipped with several buoys and a thick cork bumper.  A glaes-edged sign strung between thick strands of hemp railing reads, "West Docks, Sunstone Pier - Slips 11-15," and has been inlaid with a brightly colored volcano mosaic.

title: [West Docks, Sunstone Pier]
description: Dark glaes strengths the water-roughened dock structure and its five piers.  Tall support posts of saltstained teak rise from the waters below and are wrapped with thick coils of rope.  Each docking slip is equipped with several buoys and a thick cork bumper.  A glaes-edged sign strung between thick strands of hemp railing reads, "West Docks, Sunstone Pier - Slips 16-20," and has been inlaid with a brightly colored volcano mosaic.

title: [West Docks, Sunstone Pier]
description: Dark glaes strengths the water-roughened dock structure and its five piers.  Tall support posts of saltstained teak rise from the waters below and are wrapped with thick coils of rope.  Each docking slip is equipped with several buoys and a thick cork bumper.  A glaes-edged sign strung between thick strands of hemp railing reads, "West Docks, Sunstone Pier - Slips 21-25," and has been inlaid with a brightly colored volcano mosaic.

title: [Enemy Ship, Main Deck]
description: A flock of seagulls whirls high above a mastoverhead, one occasionally diving towards the water below.  A constant breeze ripples both the sea and the fabric of a sail, the riggings moving rhythmically back and forth above some cannons on either side of the deck.  An overturned bucket serving as a makeshift stool sits in front of a fishing pole abandoned against some debris.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Enemy Ship, Helm]
description: A strong sea breeze rushes through, turning a wheel slightly off course.  A Capstan  sits scuffed and worn from repeated use.  Down a short flight of stairs, a pair of sconces brighten the area around a wooden door leading to the captains quarters.

title: [Enemy Ship, Quarters]
description: A map hangs above a bed situated near a window that runs the breadth of the stern, the view of the sea beyond superior to any painting hanging on the cherry-paneled walls of this well appointed cabin.  The nautical charts strewn across a table tell the ships history at sea, while the details are all recorded in the log books stacked on a chair.  A large sea chest occupies one corner, a lock securing its contents inside.

At the head of a table strewn with sea charts, a chair is afforded an uninterrupted view out of a glass-paned window spanning the width of the stern to the seas beyond.  A map and a stack of logbooks lie on the freshly swept deck at the foot of a bed.  A driftwood trunk packed with clothing and books sits open next to an ornate ivory and gold music stand.

Freshly made with clean linens, a bed stretches out beneath a clear glass-paned window at the rear of the cabin.  A lantern flickers atop a table stacked with books, empty teacups, and nautical charts.  A map is framed upon a cherry paneled wall above a chair, its seat occupied by a three-legged tabby cat.

Luxuriously appointed with plush carpets over a polished teak floor, the cabin is well lit by gilded brass sconces set with beeswax candles.  The curtains are drawn back from an expansive, glass-paned window, allowing the sunlight to spill across a bed and onto a table and a chair nearby.  A map is stuck to a teak-paneled wall by a dagger driven in almost to the hilt.

Sunlight filters through a large, glass-paned window, illuminating a map spread out on a table in the center of the cabin.  A logbook lies open on a bed near a chair piled with freshly laundered garments.  Nautical charts are tacked to the oak-paneled walls, all scribbled with illegible handwriting, one drawn with a giant sea monster.

Wrought iron lanterns sway overhead, the dancing flames casting light on a chair positioned behind a table, laden with charts, logbooks, and a map.  A bed is made up beneath an expansive window, the view interrupted by a dangling rope with bucket in hand to clean the glass panes.  A forgotten astrolabe lies near the door.
tags: set desc on; peer out =~ /^A strong sea breeze rushes through,/

title: [Enemy Ship, Cargo Hold]
description: Below deck, the cargo hold is fully stocked with supplies needed for a long journey at sea.  Oaken barrels and burlap sacks line the walls, while baskets swing from the ceiling teeming with dry goods and herbs.  Crates stamped with exotic ports of call sit under the stairs leading up to a hatch above.

title: [Enemy Ship, Crow's Nest]
description: A repurposed rum barrel, the perch is filled with the sound of caws from a cage filled with inky black crows hanging from the top of the main mast.  Half of the barrel bottom has been removed to allow access to the rope ladders leading back down to the main deck.  A tarnished brass spyglass is mounted to the barrel.

title: [Enemy Ship, Forward Deck]
description: The cannons are mounted on the bulwarks are shadowed beneath a sail billowing from a mast towering overhead.  Crewmen dash back and forth attending to the riggings, while another team moves cargo below deck into the hold.  A crows nest can be spotted high up the mast, ratlines leading up from both sides of the ship to the lookout point.

title: [Enemy Ship, Bow]
description: An overlong bowsprit, the wooden spar fitted with festooned stays attached to the foremast, holds up the figurehead at the front of the ship.  Occasional surf sprays douse the decking and crew with salty sea water which is quickly dried in the constant breeze.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Peacock Couriers]
description: Dark blue tiles cover the floor of the spacious office, their hue matching those that line the single arch leading out of the building.  Pots of lush greenery are scattered about, contrasting with the darker decor.  A long marble counter divides the room in twain with a pierced mistwood screen resting atop.  Windows in the partition show the space beyond, which is lined with small, silver mailboxes, each one set with a tiny dial.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Airship Terminus]
description: At the center of the lofty ceiling overhead is a mosaicked medallion depicting one of the famous airships of Ta'Illistim in flight.  Its silver shape is placed against a background of sapphire blue, the hue of which is echoed in the similarly colored glaes tile floor.  The rectangular room is set on its longer faces with a pair of double doors and a lapis-tiled arch.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Grub Hall]
description: Burnished wooden planks curve out to form the massive hall of the tavern's entrance, with rows of sturdy oaken posts rising to connect with a network of rafters above.  Dozens of blackened oil lanterns hang from the ceiling, their light at times a haze behind wisps of smoke drifting in from the galley.  In the center rests a huge cast-iron pot surrounded by countless tables and barrel chairs.  A half-circle driftwood bar is nestled in the corner beneath a salt-stained crest.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, The Hold]
description: Faint light from the main deck above seeps in through tiny grates in the ceiling, just enough to illuminate part of the compartment's ballast in the form of piles of huge sandbags, wooden crates, and iron-banded barrels.  The rest of the hold is aglow from the fire of hanging lanterns which help to display a coral-ringed dart board hung firmly on a wall.  A large cloth hammock is pulled tight between two oaken posts in the far corner of the room.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, The Galley]
description: The back of the galley is dominated by an enormous red brick oven, its center set with a long oily grate above a glowing fire.  A high shelf almost droops beneath the weight of bags of flour, iron pots and pans, and nearly a hundred corked bottles of rum.  A wide worktable is suspended from the ceiling by heavy ropes and its surface is scattered with various meat cleavers, jars of spices, and old stains.  Several crates and iron-banded barrels occupy every corner of the kitchen.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Main Deck]
description: The main deck of the tavern looks to be untouched by the elements, but its wooden plank flooring is marred by countless scuff marks.  Guests linger and speak in hushed tones along the wooden railings, while the murmur of voices carries down from the quarterdeck above.  A thick rope ladder hangs on the side of the huge wooden mainmast as lights flicker in the breeze from several tiny lanterns dangling from the ship's netting above.  Two wide wooden stairs frame a tall iron-bound door.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Forecastle]
description: The surface of the forecastle rests in the shadow of the topsail and its wooden planks are a stark contrast to the main deck below.  Old stains from a mixture of blood, ale, and fish guts have discolored the flooring along every board near the railings.  A few wooden barrels sit in the center of the main railing, each one crowded with some tackle boxes, lures and tiny metal hooks.  Some carved wooden benches rest on each side of the sculpted bronze figurehead that faces out towards Darkstone Bay.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Gangplank]
description: A pile of weathered and faded pillows provides a measure of comfort near a wide wooden railing that looks out over Darkstone Bay.  The salty spray of the waters periodically splashes up to add to the stains along a copper-banded keg, while a narrow wooden gangplank juts out over the side of the deck, warped under the weight of time and use.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Crow's Nest]
description: The top of the main mast reaches its peak at the crow's nest, which has been crafted to resemble a huge wooden barrel held together by bands of sturdy iron.  From this vantage point more than half of Wehnimer's Landing can be seen, as well as far out onto the waters of Darkstone Bay.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Cabin]
description: Several high-backed chairs hug the side walls of the cabin while a long glass-topped desk that stretches out before a row of tall arched windows overlooks part of the town and the bay.  A huge rust-covered bronze bird rests in one corner, opposite of it stands a salt-stained bookcase cluttered with tomes and trinkets.  Hanging on one wall are a heavy oak placard and a polished wooden weapon rack.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Quarterdeck]
description: Two wooden stairs lead up to the expansive quarterdeck that provides a wide view of the deck and forecastle beyond.  A notched ship's wheel juts up from the center, while far behind it several tables and chairs for guests have been positioned about with each wooden leg nailed into the deck.  Several blued steel lanterns hang from a long wooden railing.

title: [Imperial Courier Office, 'Haven]
description: Faint light from the street outside filters into the room through the a large oak-framed window, providing scant illumination for a pair of paintings hanging upon one wall.  Numerous large sacks, packages, and crates are stacked and organized behind a long wooden counter that dominates the back and side walls.  A pair of glass hurricane lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting soft light across the room.

Sunlight fills the room as it pours in through a large oak-framed window and illuminates a pair of paintings hanging on one wall.  Numerous large sacks, packages, and crates are stacked and organized behind a long wooden counter that dominates the back and one side wall.  A pair of glass hurricane lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting additional light across the room.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Airship Terminus]
description: A constant stream of passengers flows through this long, narrow room, transmitting a nervous energy as they bustle on their way to or from the loading docks.  A small queue has formed in front of the ticket windows, where elves and sullen dwarves wait impassively, with a smattering of humans and other outlanders among them.  Those with tickets move intently up a wide staircase to one side.  At the other end of the room, porters come and go through a broad archway, bearing light cargo of various sorts.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Mail Room]
description: Tucked away from the bustle of the airship terminus, this small room is only slightly less crowded than the main lobby.  A steady flow of people come and go through a broad archway to pick up or drop off parcels with the mail clerk behind a heavily dented oak counter.  The stuffy air is filled with a light dust that smells of paper, burlap, and sweat.

title: [Zul Logoth Mail Depot]
description: Snaking its way around this cramped room is a long line of Zul Logoth residents awaiting service, most wearing impatience on their faces.  A uniformed clerk is stationed behind a dingy stone counter, next to a shiny grey glaes stand stocked with mailing supplies.  Occupying most of the western wall, a wide notice board has been tacked up with numerous papers.

title: [Cysaegir, Words on the Wind]
description: Several hanging baskets of wildflowers fill the room with rich floral scents.  A large ebony counter dominates the center, its surface covered with piles of journals and parchment.  The back wall is lined with rows of small cubby holes stuffed with various envelopes and papers.  Wooden crates are stacked beneath the mail slots, each filled with a variety of packages and parcels.

title: [Teras Postmaster]
description: The air is heavy with the scent of paper and dust.  A doddering dwarven postal clerk keeps watch from behind a sturdy counter, above which hangs a framed sign.  The portrait hung near a distressed leather curtain is the only thing resembling decoration in this small office.

title: [Wandering Kraken's Mail Shop]
description: Neat as a pin and cozy, the shop has several mail-related wares stacked on shelves behind a polished driftwood counter with crystalline sides, and red-bricked walls are painted with cheerful images of absinthe green krakens juggling packages, letters, and books of stamps in their many, ocean blue tentacles.  Several tropical plants in terracotta vases line the walls, and a bright red hibiscus shrub flourishes next to piles of stacked mail.

title: [Sea of Fire, Dunes]
description: Stretching to the horizon, cresting dunes dip and rise in rolling mounds of deep tawny sand.  Date palms grow in tight clumps to the south, sunlit azure water glinting between their scaled trunks.  Nailed to a sweet acacia tree, blossomed with sunny yellow puffs, a sun-bleached thick papyrus sign greets passersby on the newly trod path.

title: [Sea of Fire, Yuvi Qorit]
description: Swelling sands climb to a serpentine ridgeline that curves behind the sprawl of tents, stalls, and pavilions embracing the glistening oasis.  Looped around scattered palms, a twisted yucca rope pens off camels in a temporary pasture of white bursage shrubs and budding creosote bushes.  Loose grit sweeps across the arcing desert path, tumbling under the gentle persuasion of the wind.

title: [Yuvi Qorit, Sandy Path]
description: Shops dominate the small clearing cut into the foliage, lining either side of the path.  Backdropped by a sinuous ridgeline, a canvas draped pavilion nestles under several spiky yucca trees that lean over the walkway to the east.  A sapphire mohair wool tent stands opposite, sheltered beneath the intertwining leaves and fronds of tall date palms and a gnarled elephant tree.

title: [Yuvi Qorit, Sandy Path]
description: Nibbling on brittlebrush and leafy groundcover that creeps across the sand, goats graze beneath the shade of a cluster of palms between the glittering oasis and a tonal blue linen pavilion.  A well-trodden path, fraught with overhanging, magenta-swept prickly pear cacti, wends through assorted booths and stalls.  Warm breezes shift the beaded garlands hanging on a pebbled morduska hide tent, the rattling sound nearly inaudible over the din of chattering merchants and patrons.

title: [Yuvi Qorit, Palm Grove]
description: Sandy paths between the verdant undergrowth converge in a wide-open space just outside the perimeter of the water's edge.  Flames kept low, a firepit burns hot enough to cook with near the entrance of a large ornate pavilion that dominates the area between skyscraping palms and shorter yucca trees, and smaller structures to the north and south use the foliage for shelter from the relentless desert heat.  In stark contrast to the peacefulness here, a long sinuous ridgeline to the east hints at the dangers of the dunes.

title: [Yuvi Qorit, Sandy Path]
description: Bristly shrubs and short grasses edge a cleared pathway that naturally meanders through the area.  Towering palms arch over a small shaded stall and provide cool shelter from an overbearing sun.  Flowering cacti have been cut back and tied in place with brightly dyed ropes, the colors contrasting against a circular canvas tent painted in varying shades of ahmdir blue.

Cloaked in shadow from the night sky, a small shaded stall stands nearby, providing little light that manages to escape through its layered cloth to the area.  Cold, but gentle, winds cause the palms above to rustle, allowing twinkling stars to be seen between the blades of the fronds.  Sweetened incense smoke drifts through openings at the peak of a circular canvas tent, scented vapors coiling upwards before dissipating into the twilight.

title: [Yuvi Qorit, Sandy Path]
description: Winding around a group of palms, shrubbery pulls away and opens to a panoramic view of the neighboring oasis.  Huddling adjacent from some twining trees is a tethered palm-framed stall with a patchwork morduska hide canopy, the breeze causing the copper sign dangling from the building to swing.  Wind-rippled sand surrounds a faded blue domed canvas tent with a narrow entrance, creating soft mounds that press up against the obstruction, the desert attempting to reclaim its territory.

title: [Yuvi Qorit, Secluded Copse]
description: Soft and less traveled here, the desert trail splits around a disfigured palm tree that marks a definitive end to the market.  Heatwaves shimmer above the sand beyond, obscuring the contours of faraway yurts and tents rounding the western side of the brilliant oasis.  Armor-plated yierka, deceptively small at this distance, gather at the water's edge.  Hitched between two date palms, a linen rope hammock faces the lush, verdant paradise.

title: [The Desert Hare, Emporium]
description: Swaths of richly dyed sapphire mohair wool hang overhead, supported by burnished copper and acacia poles along the pavilion's perimeter, and pool along the edges of a rug-covered floor.  Hanging from the ceiling supports are a pair of bright lanterns that, when combined with the daylight spilling in from the tent flap, provide modest illumination of the airy space.  In the center of the room is a copper-banded acacia table flanked by an ironwood mannequin and an ebonwood mannequin, while off to the side is a woven reed screen.

title: [Oasis of Sole]
description: Sunlight slips through loose canvas draped across the four braced trunks of felled yucca that form the outline of the roof.  Magenta, lavender, and silver hues blend in a mosaic of colors behind a weathered jewelry case and the ironwood bins tucked underneath.  A thin layer of sand swirls along the floor, leading past a rattan bamboo table with a handwritten sign perched next to the wares.

Arid desert air blows through the seams of the canvas draped across the roof of the pavilion.  Flickering in the wind, small lanterns illuminate the muted shades of the colored walls.  Tucked under a weathered jewelry case, the ironwood bins offer embellishments for a variety of shoes.  A thick layer of sand rests atop the floor, marred only by faint footprints leading to a rattan bamboo table that holds a a handwritten sign.

title: [Entwined Finds, Flora]
description: Only slivers of sunlight pass through the gaps where the morduska hide panels are lashed tightly to wooden poles, protecting the delicate wares from the elements.  Floral festoons, intense in coloration, effuse a pervasive perfume that is exceptionally potent within the warm confines of the tent.  Securely nestled in the sand, yucca baskets mingle alongside rickety crates inked with weatherworn, barely identifiable Seareach crests.

Only slivers of moonlight pass through the gaps where the morduska hide panels are lashed tightly to wooden poles, protecting the delicate wares from the elements.  Floral festoons, cast orange from a hanging lantern, effuse a pervasive perfume that is exceptionally potent within the warm confines of the tent.  Securely nestled in the sand, spiral-woven yucca baskets mingle alongside rickety crates inked with weatherworn, barely identifiable Seareach crests.

title: [Yuvi Qorit, Water's Edge]
description: Rising above the wide variety of flora here at the water's edge, a soaring date palm with broad fan-like fronds stands guard over this secluded spot.  Smaller trees, a variety of hardy shrubs, and brightly colored flowers thrive under the protective shade of the mighty palm.  As the vegetation approaches the shore its makeup shifts, becoming less dense and making way for reeds and aquatic grasses.  It is here, hidden within these tall grasses, that a striated orange and red sandstone sits, providing a perfect view of turquoise waters bejeweled with shimmering light.

title: [Yuvi Qorit, Ornate Pavilion]
description: The large open air pavilion is crisscrossed by copper and silver roping, ahmdir blue and scarlet red tassels blended together to outline the form of a selshis in midair.  Atop a scrollworked rattan dais, the fossilized skeleton of a morduska stands guard over the area.  To each side, small tents have been erected to house the leaders of the respective families.

title: [A Shaded Stall, Front Partition]
description: Four wooden poles hold up the stall, while numerous layers of thick cloth are draped overhead to fend off the elements.  Multiple boards form a temporary floor while a few small tables and an overturned crate hold wares for purchase.  Several lanterns hang from above to help provide illumination.

title: [Jewel of the Trade, Front]
description: Billowing tan canvas towers high above, supporting poles set in place with sections of the tent tied securely to them.  Three sun-bleached tables centrally placed in a horseshoe shape have been set up to display many wares, while the heady scent of jasmine and honeysuckle permeates the area with coils of incense smoke.  Scarves of every fabric and shade weave around the various poles and create a wall partition, while matching their hues are the painted murals of tribal symbols on the exterior canvas tent walls.

title: [Potent Patinas, Stall]
description: Palms and shrubs near the edge of the canopy offer additional shade, a brief respite from the relentless heat of the desert.  In the center of this makeshift stall, a stone-ringed firepit takes up most of the workspace, a large bronze anvil sunken into the sand beside it.  Racks and cases are haphazardly scattered about the stall, the sand around the oasis already finding its way into every nook and cranny.

title: [Wind Wrapped]
description: A large, woven palm leaf mat covers nearly all of the otherwise exposed hardscrabble floor, keeping dust and kicked up sand to a minimum.  Steeply sloped, faded blue canvas walls and a low, domed ceiling enclose a vibrant space filled with lengths of bright and airy fabrics draped from brushed copper racks.  Bifurcating the tent, a natural raffia privacy screen stands behind a short well-oiled acacia table.

title: [The Desert Wind, Entrance]
description: Draping layers of tonal blue linen panels compose the airy canopy of the pavilion.  Copper lanterns are suspended from the tall crossbeams of the ceiling and over a large wooden table that hosts refreshments for guests.  A large fountain stands at the center, the burbling water serving to both cool and refresh the air.

title: [Icy Disposition]
description: The temperature in this space is unnaturally cold, though there doesn't seem to be any particular source for the chill that permeates the room.  Heavy furs are draped along the walls, in many cases with the horns or antlers still attached, and a large bearskin rug dominates most of the floor space.  A set of heavy oak shelves is situated against one wall just inside the entrance, and an oversized chest is tucked into the back corner.

title: [Beyond Barriers, Blades]
description: The silken walls of the massive crimson pavilion stir with an unseen, yet chilly wind.  Every corner of the tent is occupied by deep shadows that shift ever so slightly, like rolling waves of murky ink.  Eyeless scarlet despanal spiders crawl lazily along wooden posts, providing a warm, blood red glow to the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Beyond Barriers, Armor]
description: Pale red light illuminates from the small carved despanal forms of spiders crawling along the roof of the tent.  Shadows creep from each corner, slithering along the silken walls of the pavilion like spilled ink.  A long and gnarled ebony counter dominates the center of the room.

title: [The Modern Morph]
description: Ramshackle and rickety, the small shop smells of dust and mildew.  Dirty oak floors creak whether someone is moving across them or not, and the grimy windows cause even the smoky lanterns that light the area to seem dim and ineffective.  Open crates rest before a long oak-paneled counter, both housing wares that seem out of place in this back-alley structure.

title: [All You Knead, Entry]
description: Slighty leaning to the west, the small building has a bit of a disorienting cant to the walls.  None of the door jambs or window frames are perfectly squared, requiring a few moments for customers to adjust their perception.  At least the dim lighting helps, due to a lack of natural illumination, making it easier to adapt.  Though clearly on the dilapidated side structurally, the interior of the shop is well-maintained, its surfaces dusted and polished to a gleam, displaying wares for sale.

title: [All You Knead, Alcove]
description: Set within an alcove off to one side of the odd little shop is a short built-in oak counter set with three small displays.  The scents of caramel, cinnamon, and chocolate blend together in the close confines of the space.  Flickering candles offer just enough illumination to reveal the unique boxes for sale here.

title: [All You Knead, Pantry]
description: One fat candle adds light to the dark and narrow pantry, hardly dispelling the gloom in a many-shelved room stocked with all sorts of baking supplies.  Only a woven rectangular basket sitting close to the flickering flame offers anything for purchase.

title: [Locksmehr River, Muddy Track]
description: Tamped down from the steady passage of multiple feet, the nearby grass fronds that line the riverbank are splattered with mud and yet maintain their vibrant green hue.  Dormant torches are lashed to tall poles that jut out of the ground along a track that follows the river.  A gentle incline leads up the banks towards a sturdy dock.

Tamped down from the steady passage of multiple feet, the grass fronds that line the riverbank are splattered with mud and covered in piles of icy slush.  Brightly lit torches are lashed to tall poles that jut out of the ground along a track that follows the river, providing limited warmth from the cold.  A gentle incline leads up the banks towards a sturdy dock bedecked with wreaths and pelts of heavy fur.

title: [Locksmehr River, Encampment]
description: Wending its way along the river's edge, a muddy trail slips through trampled grasses and various wild, thorny bushes that grow in profusion.  Built across the trail is a wide palisade of rough-hewn saplings and narrow tree poles that are lashed together with rawhide and hemp.  To the east, a small encampment occupies a bend in the river.

Wending its way along the river's edge, a muddy trail slips through puddles of snowy slush and various wild, thorny bushes that grow in profusion, their blooms withered away with the cooler temperatures.  Built across the trail is a wide palisade of bare saplings and narrow tree poles that are lashed together with rawhide and hemp.  To the east, a small encampment occupies a bend in the river.

title: [Locksmehr River, Encampment]
description: Clusters of grass and boulders dominate the edge of the river where a muddy track provides egress in and out of a small encampment.  Beyond the track, exposed sinew stitching decorates the hide-covered exteriors of a domed tent built against the tangled shrubs.  A wrought iron basket filled with oiled rags and logs rests a safe distance from the tent, shrubs, and trail.

Piles of snow and boulders dominate the edge of the river where a slush-covered track provides egress in and out of a small encampment.  Beyond the track, exposed sinew stitching decorates the hide-covered exteriors of a domed tent built against the gnarled shrubs.  A wrought iron basket filled with oiled rags and logs rests a safe distance from the tent, shrubs, and trail.

title: [Locksmehr River, Encampment]
description: Carved benches depicting wild beasts ring a dwindling fire at the center of a clearing near the bend of the river.  A small awning to the southwest provides shelter for a communal kitchen and wooden larder that is filled with a variety of provisions and supplies.  Stacked firewood sits in a wrought iron cradle-like structure nearby.

Carved benches depicting wild beasts ring a dwindling fire at the center of a clearing near the bend of the river, the creatures subtly hidden beneath thin layers of frost.  A small awning to the southwest provides shelter for a communal kitchen and wooden larder that is filled with a variety of provisions and supplies.  Stacked firewood sits in a wrought iron cradle-like structure nearby, tented beneath a sheet of weathered oilcloth held down by steel hooks.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Locksmehr River, Encampment]
description: Situated at the very edge of the partially frozen river, the small clearing is a combination of gravel and tufts of broken grass blades.  A snow-lined gravel trail leads down to the water's edge where river reeds grow amid round stones worn smooth by the flowing water.  Set back from the walking space, a domed sinew and hide tent and a birch bark-sided hut have been built among the sassafras and hickory.
