title: [Locksmehr River, Encampment]
description: Thin curls of colorful wood, piles of sawdust, and various bundles of bright wire rest within the shelter of small awnings amid worktables and a variety of benches.  Bittersweet vines mingle with sapling sassafras along the edge of the small clearing and provide a bright orange color to the otherwise brown, green, and grey landscape.  Barely visible, a tight dirt passageway dips beneath the domed sinew and hide tent situated amid the workstations.

Thin curls of wood, piles of sawdust, and various bundles of bright wire rest within the weatherproof jars beneath of small oilcloth-covered awnings and worktables.  Vibrant spheres of colorful glass hang from ropes in overlapping patterns by each station, adding color to the otherwise brown, green, and grey landscape.  Situated amid the workstations is a domed sinew and hide tent decorated with bright ceramic tiles.

title: [Locksmehr River, Encampment]
description: Lashed frames rest upon either side of the small pathway that leads in and out of the area, their interiors strung with elk or caribou hides in various stages of tanning.  Barrels filled with noxious substances flank the entrance to a tilted driftwood lean-to, while to the east of its entrance a chalky, white substance stains the leaves of low-rising bushes, likely the result of discarded alum.

Lashed frames rest upon either side of the small pathway that leads in and out of the area, their interiors strung with elk or caribou hides dusted in snow..  Barrels filled with semi-frozen substances flank the entrance to a domed sinew and hide tent, while to the east of its entrance a chalky, white substance stains the muddy slush and half-dead bushes, likely the result of discarded alum.

title: [Locksmehr River, Encampment]
description: Nestled amid wild boxwood and blueberry bushes, a domed sinew and hide tent is flanked by a pair of dormant torches.  Wild river grasses stand out at odd angles along a single muddy track that leads to the center of the encampment, the tamped down and broken blades a testament to recent foot traffic.  Various colored tufts of fleece cling to nearby branches and sway as the breeze of the river moves them about.

Nestled amid the skeletons of boxwood and blueberry bushes, a domed sinew and hide tent is flanked by a pair of burning torches.  Dried out river grasses are broken at odd angles along a single slush-covered track that leads to the center of the encampment, the footprints left in the dusting of snow a testament to the foot traffic.  Various colored tufts of fleece cling to nearby bare branches and tangle themselves between pelts of thick fur and leather.

title: [Blades of Glory]
description: Woven walls of birch bark are supported by roughly hewn ash posts to create a tall and circular workshop with a smooth dirt floor.  Broad workbenches dominate the central space, while lashed shelves house various leatherworking and blade sharpening tools.  A lantern hung from the peaked roof provides amble illumination for a small river reed basket of parchments and an unfinished rough oak box of ice skates that rest near the entry.

title: [The Hide and Fur Depot]
description: Stretching across the center of the tent and bound to support poles in the ceiling, wooden racks of heavy garments occupy most of the traversable space.  Frosted globes in bright white provide an almost daylight-like illumination within the dark walls, while small braziers fashioned of tiny bowls set within piles of glittering sand provide a comfortable warmth.  A small wooden sign rests next to a small wicker basket near the exit.

title: [Knit One, Punch Two]
description: Frosted globes in bright white provide a soft incandescent light to the small tent, illuminating all visible surfaces and casting shadows upon the fur-covered ground.  Clusters of woven containers are either arranged along the edge of the walls or dangle from the support posts, their brightly colored contents spilling from them in a wild array of hues and textures.  A single loom sits under the highest point of the tent and is surrounded by tufts of fleece.

title: [Locksmehr River, Frozen Patch]
description: River water sloshes against a muddy shore riddled with gravel and smooth stones, the telltale tracks of small crafts evident in the mud.  Tall reeds obscure the land to the south but part to provide an almost panoramic view of the Locksmehr River with its steadily flowing current.  A fur-covered rough oak bench rests to one side of a snow-lined gravel trail, its legs managing to stay mud free despite its proximity to the river.

Icy slush sloshes against a half-frozen shore riddled with gravel and smooth stones, the telltale tracks of small creatures evident in the mud.  Tall dead reeds obscure the land to the south but part to provide an almost panoramic view of the Locksmehr River littered with frozen chunks of ice.  A fur-covered rough oak bench rests to one side of a snow-lined gravel trail, its legs covered in small piles of snow.

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Deck]
description: Dark-stained teak has been covered in a faint dusting of snow, the undisturbed flurries glinting in the ambient light across the wood.  Garland-strung copper fixtures outline the gangway where the gangplank descends to the dock below.  Hung along the solid railings to either side of the entry are a series of round shields, the armor adorned with ribbon-tied wreaths.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Deck]
description: Tumultuous storm clouds fashioned of dark-stained teak lazily drift across the frost-covered deck, the stylized spectres hidden beneath small piles of snow shoveled to the sides.   Copper lanterns are evenly spaced upon the railing, their frost-covered frames and supports stand at alternating intervals between the round shields attached to the short wall.  Long rows have incredibly long oars bracketed to their backs, each oar wrapped tightly in red-colored oilcloth.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Deck]
description: Rising from the icy slope of the wood decking, a curving staircase ascends to the forecastle where railings topped with holly-adorned copper lanterns.  High railings, each nearly a solid wall that is designed to prevent falls into the frozen waters beyond, are dotted with round shields protected by thick furs.  Pennants of madder red, gorse yellow, and lapis blue drape from the low roof created by the forecastle deck, the fabric strung between icicles formed across the hempen rope strung from wall to wall.

title: [Mainmast, Captain's Entry]
description: Sheltered by the overhang of the forecastle decking, an oak and glass door lays mostly in shadows as elliptical patterns of turbulent dark teak waves and puffy white birch clouds dance across the deck.  Ropes stretch from the main mast, which is encircled by a bronze ring, towards the distant railings where pulleys assist in the manipulation of the behemoth.  Just a few steps towards the bow, a companionway of inky black rises from the flooring.

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Deck]
description: Twin rows of fur-layered benches sit upon the mingled teak and white oak decking, the oars bracketed to their backings standing silent sentinels over their vacant seats.  Wreaths of fragrant fir dot the low wall of the railings, while a series of painted round shields are displayed upon its facing.  The creak and rattle of pullies fed with rope trickle through the area.

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Deck]
description: Lashed to the railings along the starboard decking, a trio of rain barrels sit covered in layers of frost and salt.  Spirals of teak peak out beneath the icy veil, the avian-carved silhouettes caught in clouds of ice.  Cast by the proximity of both the fore and aftmasts, shadows dance through the area as the ambient light slips around them.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Deck]
description: Narrowing perceptibly near the bow, the space beside the foremast is wide open and free of benches or barrels, leaving room for patches of snow and slush.  The dark-stained decking planks are meticulously reinforced for winter, the walls covered in wool and fur to prevent chill.  Short railings, solid save for a small window every few feet that allows sea and rain water to escape, are dotted with a series of some round shields with painted faces.

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Bow]
description: Sprawling across the icy oak decking, a gold and crimson-striped tent occupies the bow and utilizes two wrought iron hooks in place of stakes, the metal covered in a frosty sheen.  The consistent sound of hammering filters from between the canvas sheets, muffled by the snow.  Just beyond the peak of the tent, a stony arm rises into the air and is holding aloft a copper lantern.

Radiating from around the copper housing of the foremast, rays of birch are inlaid into the teak decking to create the image of a sun within a dark sky, the design shadowed by the dusting of snow across the ground.  Nearby, a shelter acts as a companionway to the floor below and is covered with weather-treated oilcloth to keep ice from slicking the stairs.  The muffled sound of rattling ropes and pulleys draws attention to the lashed and furled sails, the sky blue fabric dangling thin icicles from above.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Strength and Honor, Armor]
description: A metallic twang lingers in the air, and the sound of a striking forge hammer rings out somewhere just beyond the canvas of the tent walls.  A gold cloth-draped table and a wood-framed armor rack flank the walkway, ushering the path deeper into the tent.

title: [Strength and Honor, Shields]
description: The entire rear of the tent is lined with a wall-to-wall shield rack, while off to the side sits a worktable laden with a variety of capped paint jars and a cup of drying brushes.  A discarded, paint-strewn apron is draped over the stool pushed just under the lip of the worktable, beneath a fringed drape of dyed suede scraps that overflow the work space.

title: [Kraet Lengths]
description: Thin strips of sinew are threaded through lengths of canvas and stretched between carved wooden poles that create the framework of the shelter.  Bits of rope are wound about the supports and are adorned with various caved ivory charms.  Centered in the small space is a large stand crafted from several racks of antlers.

title: [Kraet Expectations, Showroom]
description: The interior of the shop has been reinforced by lacquered oak planks, the wood framed by circular recesses and knotwork-carved shelves displaying stacks of wares.  Long banners of richly dyed silks and wool line the available wall space, their designs echoed upon the braid-edged rush baskets set upon the hard ground.

title: [A Kraet Deal]
description: Crude lengths of wood have been cleaned and secured together, forming the supports of the off-sided structure.  Strips of rough leather are woven across the sides, creating various intricate patterns, while pieces of sailcloth are stretched and layered above, finishing the protective shelter of the lean-to.  Standing in the center of the space is a stick frame of interlaced vines which displays various weapons.

title: [Kraet and Barrel, Supplies]
description: Thin slats of linden and mahogany form the intricate walls of the shop, the latticework hung with a rack of lacquer-dipped antlers amidst a curtain of vivid dark green ivy.  The dense vines curl between the open gaps of each panel, tendrils gathering across a stone and pale marble display while lengths climb back up into the oak-planked ceiling.

title: [Kraet Aim]
description: Lengths of rough driftwood, lashed together with coarse sinew, form the supports of this small lean-to.  Pieces of various species' hide are layered over the supports enclosing the space.  An iron lantern spreads a flickering light over an iron stand filled with bows of various woods and adornment.

title: [Forecastle Deck]
description: Stylized flames of burnished teak are inlaid into the decking of the forecastle, the walls covered in layers of fur to shield from the winter winds.  Spindled railings are fitted with copper lanterns, the bright red windows within reflecting the ambient light.  Providing an excellent viewing point from which to admire the length of the boat, the forecastle's view is unobstructed as the sky blue sails of both the fore and aftmast are fully furled.

title: [Captain's Quarters]
description: Stained to resemble stone, four carved oak giants stand with their backs hunched in support of the low exposed rafter ceiling and their hands holding aloft bronze bowl-shaped braziers.  The heart of the room has an enormous desk-like table, though no chairs are present, where star charts, coastal drawings, and various maps are strewn about.  Round portals dot the walls, between which are housed a bed, armoire, chest, mannequin, and weapon rack.

title: [Below Deck, Corridor]
description: Portholes mark both ends of the long corridor, the verdigris copper standing out on the mahogany walls.  Shield lanterns sway as the boat gently rocks at harbor, casting shadows upon the sparse white oak planks that fashion the floor.  A teak and steel stairway leads to the deck above, while a glossy oak door with a bronze placard reading, "Pinned and Pleated" leads deeper inside.

title: [Below Deck, Corridor]
description: Portholes mark both ends of the long corridor, the verdigris copper standing out on the mahogany walls.  Shield lanterns sway as the boat gently rocks at harbor, casting shadows upon the sparse white oak planks that fashion the floor.  Sturdy doors to the east and west have angles cut into their tops as the boat narrows this close to the bow.

title: [Pinned and Pleated]
description: Exposed rafters line the roof of the cabin, the constant creak and roll of the ship causing various hangings to sway and the sound of creaking to slip through the balmy air.  Rolled and bound to a support post is an off-white and navy blue hammock, which leaves room for a trio of mannequins to be displayed between copper-ringed portholes.  Tidy shelves dominate the one solid wall and are filled with tidily folded pieces of fabric, bowls filled with pins, and baskets of cording.

title: [The Gilded Gladiator, Status]
description: The interior of this cabin is exceptional in its tidiness and organization, with naught a speck of dirt or dust anywhere to be seen.  Shelves arranged just so boast displays of fine goldsmithing along the walls, and decorative cut-glass jars of jewels sit amongst them.  On a centrally located marble-topped counter island is an oblong cobalt-patterned white pottery bowl, a knotwork-etched gold salver, and a lattice-carved beech tray.  A gold-framed vellum sign rises on a tall stand behind the island.

title: [The Gilded Gladiator, Protect]
description: Several half-bust displays stand tall on the counters flanking the walkway deeper into the shop, their shorn necks adorned with a variety of metals and gems of remarkably quality.  Over one counter is a row of yew pegs and a line of filigreed hooks over the other, while a silver-framed round mesh display sits on a pedestal atop the second marble top.  A gold-framed vellum sign stands stoically at the end of one counter.

title: [The Gilded Gladiator, Adorn]
description: A trio of feminine mannequins stretches the length of one wall, while a trio of masculine mannequins occupies the other, the figures posed as if in casual respite.  At the rear of the cabin is an ivory linen partition, and situated in front of it is a small table topped with a round gold-stroked ivory pottery bowl and a gold-framed vellum sign.

title: [Are You Not Entertained?]
description: Polished walls of tropical woods are draped with netting holding a variety of gladiatorial weapons and armaments but in miniature form.  One corner of the room is fashioned to resemble a small arena, with a variety of Kraet dolls posed in fighting stances.  A matching olive wood display and counter rest on either side of the arena, each cluttered with toy gladiators.

title: [Duskruin Arena, The Cheap Seats]
description: Dimly illuminated, the cold stone benches are cheaply made and house none of the warmth found in the polished seats of the upper levels.  Dangerously close to the combatants, as evidenced by the gouges in the stone and the stained blood, this section houses warped barrels and a dusty board covered in food items.  The din of combat from the nearby stands fills the air.

title: [New Bids On The Block, Showroom]
description: Elaborate ivory cornice moulding and an equally ornamented chair railing adorn the entire upper and lower perimeter of the shop and add an unabashed elegance to the showroom.  Displayed along a hard rock wall in an eye-catching arrangement is an extensive collection of musical instruments, each in varying stages of wear.  Positioned at one end of a long mahogany table is a gold-trimmed mahogany bucket, while a mahogany podium flanks the other end, the auctioneer standing attentively behind.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Abandoned Area]
description: The bare stone walls have been picked clean of any decor, and a large dusty glass window serves as the sole break in their unrelenting bareness.  Heavy footprints can be seen in the mica covering the floor, leading to and from a thick curtain.

title: [Sharth's Weaponry]
description: Beneath an oak beam ceiling, a pair of wooden snowshoes hangs on one of the smooth white plaster walls.  A brass treasure chest sits in one corner while a suit of silver-chased armor rests on the gold oak floor.

A pair of wooden snowshoes hangs on one of the smooth white plaster walls, and an oak beam ceiling rises overhead.  A suit of silver-chased armor sits in one corner of a honey gold oak floor.  There is a lacquered wooden shelf on one side of the shop and a large brass-bound chest on the other.

title: [Scrivener's, Mail Room]
description: The entire back wall of this utilitarian room is covered with wooden shelving to form a latticework of pigeonholes for mail.  Each of the side walls holds a similar set of shelves, though the openings are larger, some almost ample enough to accommodate an average-sized dwarf.  Separating the sparsely furnished reception area from the bustling activity of the mail center is a tall slate-topped counter.  Smaller display cases topped with thick glass bracket the entryway.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Meadow]
description: A soft breeze rustles the wide expanse of grass scattered with tiny wildflowers and enclosed by an ivy-covered stone wall.  Near a large meandering stream, a riverstone path leads to a large wooden dock.  Wrought iron tables and benches are spaced around a brick firepit amid clusters of tall evergreen trees, which provide pockets of shade.  Silvery lions mounted on the wall hold cut crystal oil lamps.  North of the path, bursts of color can be spied through the windows of a small copper-framed greenhouse.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Chapel]
description: Large picture windows, to either side of oak double doors, afford a view of a footbridge over a shaded pond in the garden.  Rows of modwir benches, carved to resemble tangled vines, face a dark green marble altar.  Behind the altar is a pair of trees, entwined with rose vines.  The trees grow up through an oculus at the far end of the chapel.  Floral garlands, tied with colorful ribbons, hang on stacked stone walls.  Cut crystal oil lamps festoon the walls as well, the ambient light reflecting off of their faceted sides.

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Distantly the barking of sea thraks can be heard coming from the east, echoing across the calm dark water.  The lights of a well-lit dock are visible, a towering cliff wall behind them.  Dark jungle vegetation makes a stunning contrast to the moonlit white beaches of a large lagoon that lies to the north.

The hull of a large ship lies abandoned on the beach, only the ribs left after the decay of time and weather.  Several red buoys dot the water as a no trespass zone.

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Pieces of palm fronds and driftwood float atop the water from a nearby landmass, the west coastline visible from this vantage point. title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Gentle waves rush towards the coastline, the southern tip of a large lagoon visible to the north and northwest. Distantly to the east, a well-lit dock with three piers is visible.

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Dark blue water extends as far as the eye can see, the silver moonlight glinting off the relatively calm surface.  Dark objects, perhaps patches of seaweed, float on the water in the distance.  The wind blows towards the east, causing the occasional swell of the ocean.

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: The dark jungle backdrop of a large lagoon is visible to the north and east, a moonlit beach before it.  Silver glints off a large waterfall that is surrounded by the dark vegetation.  The sound of waves crashing on the beach are audible in the distance, the only sound to break the tranquility.

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Silvery moonlight reflects off the enormous spires of shiny black rock thrust through the ocean's surface to dominate the horizon in the north, east, and south.  Waves crash against the rocks in the distance, throwing water high into the air and causing swells of ocean to come rippling back.  Rough water makes navigation a bit difficult due to the swells cresting in cascades of frothing spray.  Further passage in any direction but east is impossible due to the rocky barricades.

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Moonlight descends upon the white sandy beaches of the island coastline to the east as it gently rounds to the south.  Dark jungle covers the hillside that rises behind the beach, and the call of distant birds can be heard.  Silver glints off water in the darkness of the foliage, and a waterfall is barely visible to the south.

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Waves crash high against the rocky spires of obsidian that dominate the horizon to the south and west, spraying salt water high into the air.  Passage beyond the rock formation appears impossible, the water in the area a turbulent rush of crests and troughs.  The ocean here is much calmer except for the occasional surge of waves as the sea rebounds from the distant rocks.

Moonlight reflects off of tall black spires that dominate the horizon to the south and west, causing the appearance of silvery mountains in a sea of darkness.  Passage beyond the rocky formation appears impossible, the water in the area a turbulent rush of crests and troughs.  The ocean here is much calmer except for the occasional surge of waves as the sea rebounds from the distant rocks.

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Gulls glide on the air currents, calling to each other while lazy white clouds drift high overhead, casting shadows on the rough sea.  Large jagged spires of obsidian can be seen in the distance to the west, the sun reflecting on the black glass.  Waves crash against the rocks, sending the ocean swells eastward.

Shrill cries echo in the distance, while thin clouds drift overhead, casting shadows on the rough seas as they pass against the moon.  Dark mountainous figures can be seen in the distance to the west, moonlight reflecting off the shiny forms.  Crashing waves can be heard in the darkness, causing ocean swells to push eastward.

title: [Western Waterway, Saewehna]
description: Water smacks up against the crag-filled walls of this recess, occasionally causing a jet of seawater to shoot into the air, misting the surroundings.  A strong current makes navigation here difficult, constantly pushing towards the rock wall.  Moonlight shines down upon the water, glinting silver on the surface.

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Silvery moonlight glitters off of the rocks, which form a loose semicircle around this section of water.  Mother-of-pearl shards glitter in the depths, their rainbow hues rising from the inky blackness below as the moonlight reflects off of them.
