title: [Western Waterway, South Embrace]
description: Small waves gently rock across the water on their way to land.  A flock of seagulls float on the surface, feeding on a small school of fish.  With a loud cry they flap their wings and rise to the sky with chaotic precision.  They soar to the west, becoming tiny shadows against the night sky.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Vert Channel]
description: A rocky wall rises up along the sea channel.  Cracks mar the smooth sea-worn surface, giving roothold to various plants and vines.  A small pool collects at the base, its depths littered with a variety of colored shells brought in from the sea with the tides.  Various crustaceans move about, darting from place to place.

title: [Western Waterway, Vert's Pass]
description: Dense vegetation grows along the water's edge, making travel to the island's interior impossible.  Various trees and shrubs line the shore draped in a canopy of vine and moss.  Bushes decorated with bright flowers cover the area with their thick perfume.  Small monkeys sit high in the branches, chattering among themselves.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Sea foam gathers at the base of several large jagged peaks, the gaps between them giving a glimpse of the vast sea to the west.  A wide net of seaweed gives shelter to the creatures below.  Small bugs and crabs skitter across its tight surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Large waves rumble as the strong currents pull them with speed towards the distant beach.  A pair of slick, grey sea lions make a game of riding the waves only to be tossed off before swimming towards the ocean to try again.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, South Embrace]
description: Calmer than the waters just to the north, the waves here thin out, creating a gentle roll of white caps.  Schools of fish can be seen just below the surface, making an ideal fishing ground, which a lone thresher shark takes full advantage of.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, White Escape]
description: To the north, the white sand of the beach gleams in the moonlight.  Dark clouds make their way across the sky.  Waves tumble about themselves on their way to the shore.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Pitching to and fro, a jumble of smooth driftwood rides the currents towards the shore.  More can be seen on the ocean side of Charl's Teeth, caught between the tide and small gaps of rock.  The water is rougher here, at the mercy of unpredictable eddies and shifting currents.

title: [Western Waterway]
description: A lone cormorant cries out as it flies towards the northeast beach, its shadow rippling across the water.  A brilliant orange beak sticks out in strong contrast against the pale blue sky.  The faint sound of hammering echoes out across the water.
A lone cormorant cries out from the northeast beach as it settles in for the night.  The moons above create shadows across the water.

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Pushing towards the shore, waves crash upon themselves before hurrying back to sea.  A remote stretch of sand can be seen to the east.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Enclosed on three sides by spires of volcanic rock, this small cove is broken by a number of smaller rocky outcroppings, creating a vast rookery.  A large gathering of cormorants nest on a central rock, their dark heads bobbing shadows.  Smaller birds rest about in various nooks and ledges worn into the cliffs.

title: [Western Waterway, White Escape]
description: Creating a froth of foam, seawater swirls about, the dangerous water patterns making it impossible to reach the eastern beach.  Piles of building materials are scattered about the sandy haven.  Tiny lights flicker in the distance, the sounds of work carrying over the expanse of water.

title: [Western Waterway, White Escape]
description: Varying in level, the water's depth changes as the waves push towards the shore.  Moonlight glints off of the white sands of a beach to the southeast.  Swirling about, the currents make safe passage impossible.

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Pinched between the high cliffs of the isle and the sharp, angular sides of the Teeth of Charl, the narrow strait creates a small passage between the eastern and northern sides of the island.  As the two waterways collide the water becomes rough and frothy, though they calm greatly beyond the pinched channel.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Crying out, several seagulls float on strong air currents, searching the water for sea life taking refuge at the jagged base of Charl's Teeth.  Peeking through the water, several smaller boulders are scattered.  Seaweed caught in the rocks floats outward along the surface, veiling the ocean floor.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Flaring slightly, the channel widens, creating a calm respite and allowing the azure waters to spark beneath the glittering ambient light.   Thin waves ripple into one another, their progress unhampened by any obstacles in the immediate area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Tapering off towards the east, the water laps about a small sandbar that leads up to an ebon-hued cliff.  Tendrils of vine drape from the peak, blanketing much of the wall.  Worn away by eons of rain and wind, a narrow crack breaks the surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Silvery light casts its luminous net across the rippling waves of the ocean, its gently cresting edges pearly white with salty froth as they lap at the distant shore and the nearby Teeth of Charl.  Shadows rise from the depths, their angular heads briefly breaking water before the wide oval of their backs and reveal themselves to be a small migration of sea turtles.  They slowly sink into the depths, their geometric-patterned backs catching brief snatches of light before they silently disappear.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Jagged spires of obsidian stand tall against the sky, their uneven peaks a resting place for a variety of seabirds.  Waves crash against them as the sea makes its way towards shore.  White spray propels towards the sky only to come showering back down.

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Dark obelisks rise up from the water to the west, the open sea spreading out past them as it disappears into the horizon.  Large schools of blue-stripped fish crest through the waves and dart off to the distant crags with grace, their large fins webbed and bent beneath the speed of their passage.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Charl's Teeth ascend to full and dizzying height from a water-encased foundation.  One lower pinnacle of the crag appears like a broken bicuspid across the expanse of the series of cliffs.  A pool of water gathers in a deep indent in that pinnacle.  Flocks of sea birds congregate around the pool, plucking colorful fish deposited by the bounty of the ocean into the ready feeding pond.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Open Depths]
description: Green into teal into blue into grey, the water rushes east in a patterned current.  Sky meets sea, providing a further palette of blues and blacks and greys.  There is no calm, but the water is rhythmic in its quick movement, almost lulling into a false sense of peace.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Waves lightly roll towards the island, creating a gentle rhythm.  The clear water reveals another extension of the coral reef to the north.  A small school of red coris swims along the sandy floor.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Cliff's Face]
description: Creating a natural rim, lines of pale mineral deposits cling to the northern cliffs, a sharp contrast to the dark coloring of the towering walls.  Waves crash against the rock face, sending spray into the air.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Warm, salty breezes ripple the clear seawater as it gently presses towards the island.  Several water birds fly overhead on their way to the towering rocks in the west.  Almost translucent, a group of moon jellyfish float just beneath the surface, lightly swaying along with the current.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Sandbar]
description: A sandbar juts toward the southwest as the eastern shore beckons with hopes of safe harbor.  Rocks obstruct the surface of the coast and destroy all such hopes.  The blue of the sea contrasts with the black of the rocks, while the watery expanse of the western waterway is riddled with breakaway bits from the obsidian cliffs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: The trunk of a solitary fossilized tree pokes up from the ocean floor below through the surface of the blue-grey water.  Its height above the breakwater about that of two average giantmen and its girth approximately that of a sideways halfling, the grey stone hulk resembles nothing so much as a pillar intended to pierce the sky above and thus allow a fleeting glimpse to the unreachable stretch of ocean beyond the western boundary of Charl's Teeth.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: One long root of a fossilized tree snakes out over the water.  Its thin length seems fragile, as if it could snap easily upon the bouncing of the easterly current so strong here near the black stones of Charl's Teeth.  Liquid sluicing down the innermost surface of the obsidian crag batters the long-dead root with obvious force, belying this illusion.  The tenacious root, grey and strong as granite, remains ever unbowed and unbroken against the power of the tide.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: A tangle of roots from long since fossilized trees rises up from the shallow water to surround the shore like an elaborately styled fence.  Grey, menacing, unyielding in their perpetual stony state, those roots stand silent sentinel, preventing easy access to the waterway from the coast.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Mounded halfling-high toward the shore, sea glass of every color protects the coastline like a wall of jewels.  Glistening as water cascades over its surface, the sea glass belies the smooth edges of each individual piece by cohesively forming a whole of jagged magnificence both glorious and alarming to behold.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Beneath lapping blue waters powered by the strong easterly current, a rising mountain of sea glass glistens secretively.  Whatever force brought so much of the substance into this particular spot on the ocean floor, some combination of natural factors in this location set the glass in a pattern of substantive collection over uncounted centuries.  The jewel-tone glass presses against the black of Charl's Teeth, almost like gems laid upon a background of black silk.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: The southern edge of the coral reef slinks back into the ocean at this juncture.  Clinging to the sands below the pale blue water, the organic cluster stakes its last hold on the underground world of the bound waterway.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: The orange-pink coral hugging Charl's Teeth serves as far less an intense display from this vantage point.  Its height and density shrunken to but a small expense visible above the surface of the waves, the reef appears almost as if releasing its tenuous hold on the obsidian rocks in readiness to fully retreat back into the hidden recesses of the blue seas.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Crystal clarity permits the water to reflect strongly the orange-pink coloration of the coral reef beneath these ocean depths.  The easterly current, swift and sure as it is throughout the bound waterway, does not mar the sea here with the darkness abounding in the majority of the channel.  Though never quite calm, this stretch of water sways more rhythmically tranquil in its normal tidal movement.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Lopsidedly draped against the obsidian rock forming Charl's Teeth, the westward edge of the coral reef clings as if seeking protection from the wildness of the ocean beyond that imposing natural portal.  The orange-pink hue of the porous coral stands in sharp contrast to the glossy black of the obsidian cliff.  Bright against dark, rough against smooth, dead against living:  the slick crag and bumpy reef serve as testament to the intense environmental variation within this narrow watercourse.

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Jagged divots pockmark the rocky coast, those crevices providing secretive hiding places for several varieties of tiny sea creatures.  Without any respite of flat shoreline, the waters pound ceaselessly against the middling-sized stones that peak and pitch like irregular splints, protecting the eastern sands against the constant tidal pressure of the sea.

Silvery light glints off of the jaggy coastline, its pale glow illuminating a variety of glittering barnacles that cling to the dark rocks.  Splashing sounds rise and fall with the gentle flow of the tide, though its sources are hidden from sight by distance and the darkness of the waters.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: The shoreward side of the coral reef tends toward shorter stature, but equal density.  The result is a variable fence of rough hardness that closes in upon the beach, making any attempt to maneuver a vessel toward the shore a life-threatening undertaking.

title: [Western Waterway, Hidden Caves]
description: Though it levels sharply downward toward the shoreline, the opposite side of the coral reef rises unchallenged to an unexpected height and density.  Towering thick and solid above the roughened teal waters, the reef condenses on the ocean-ward western side into a veritable cave of spiny organisms.  A small parting of that impenetrable bulk, just large enough to accommodate the frame of a small boat, holds the promise of calmer depths within the cocoon of the reef's embrace.

title: [Western Waterway]
description: An underlying coral reef pokes up majestically through the clear green-blue water, its sheer size and scope providing unquestioned evidence of the danger of the sea here.  The coral is spiny and sharp, displaying its enormous height at various points as the slap of waves sporadically reveals some of its highest peaks from watery hiding.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Looter's Lair, Approach]
description: Large rocks and irregular-shaped reefs create a strange pathway that leads from the open water of the Western Waterway towards the eastern cliffs of the mainland.  Dim light flickers from within a jagged split in a sheer wall to the southeast, its yellow-orange light revealing the yawning mouth of a cave.  Waves crash upon every piece of land that rises from the watery depths and creates a fine, misting spray that dampens the air.

title: [Looter's Lair, Docks]
description: Built against the northern wall of the cavern is a sturdy dock crafted of thick, heavy timbers, which are covered with slick algae and tangled knots of seaweed.  Several boats are tied to the edge of the dock, while a long rough wooden ladder rises upon to its main platform.  Narrowing perceptively, the thin channel of water that leads further into the cave is blocked with large boulders, making passage via boat impossible.

title: [Looter's Lair, Depths]
description: Conical stalactites dimly glow with a faint greenish hue and have a sheen of water covering their rough surfaces.  Almost musical, the sound of the water dripping from the large rock formations echoes through the space.  Large and small puddles pock-mark the floor of the cave, whose southeastern edge drops off suddenly into a thin channel of water far below.

title: [Looter's Lair, Cache]
description: Torches fitted into iron brackets illuminate the cavern in a semi-circular pattern that reflects off of the dripping walls and moist ground.  Placed upon a raised platform is a series of oilcloth-wrapped rough wooden crates and several copper-banded rough wooden casks.  Distantly, the sound of dripping water creates an almost musical backdrop that is occasionally drowned out by the distant sound of crashing waves.

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Teal water scurries on its eastern path toward the inland shore.  Small whitecaps emerge here and there as occasional energetic spurts are funneled northeastward toward a whirlpool whose force is much diminished at this particular point in the sea surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Interminably tall obsidian cliffs rise sentry-like to the west.  Charl's Teeth, as they have been named by the inhabitants, rise dark, sharp and uncompromising.  Glistening with moisture, ridged and creviced with pointed peaks positioned at every angle, the rocky outcropping accepts the slap of the easterly current-fed waters as its due, standing unfazed as those animated waves touch and bow and scrape in homage to the sheer power of the glossy, black crags.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: As a result of the widening channel to the south, the water calms relative to the fury of its energy farther north.  Puffins, their beaks bright orange against their black and white feathers, nest on the ragged ledges of the Teeth's boulders, fast asleep.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Sharp, glossy obsidian reflects the moon's light off the Teeth, illuminating where a few shards have fallen into the water and now litter the sandy floor.  Daring the strong current, an anchored boat of gnomish design rocks back and forth precariously in the churning water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Crowding inward like the teeth in a shark's mouth, row upon row of tall basalt boulders march closer to the cliff.  Several smaller ones lie beneath the waves, creating rapids in this narrow channel between the cliffs and the Teeth.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Funneled between the Teeth and the cliffs, the water here is more turbulent than to the north.  Several species of fish have taken advantage of this, feeding voraciously on the churned up debris and plankton the agitation provides.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Several small craft, from rowboats to rafts, spread out through the area as they anchor for the evening.  Small pinpoints of light flicker from their lanterns, casting their light to penetrate the foggy mist coalescing upon the ocean's surface.  The occasional sound of a fish bursting forth from the water's surface interrupts the rhythmic background of gently lapping water against the sides of the vessels.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Foamy outbursts of white cap rough water that varies in hue from deep teal to midnight blue as a powerful whirlpool is forced upwards from the depths.  The vortex speeds up and slows down at random, but never loses entirely its dizzying energy.  Spinning and swirling in a clockwise direction determined by its own internal makeup, the strong eddy batters against any object with which it comes in close contact.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: The monstrous black obsidian cliffs to the west all but obscure the sky.  Seabirds circle the enormous heights, occasionally settling along the ragged edges of the stones.  Blue-green water splashes and sloshes below, never at rest, never at peace, its sound as insistent as the mournful cries of the aerial creatures that sail and glide overhead.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Saltwater-laden breezes stir the surface of the sea, battling with the easterly current for control of the foamy crest forming in front of the volcanic peaks of Charl's Teeth.  Beneath the pristine surface of the waves, a coral reef pokes up like an orange-pink jungle from the ocean floor.  Clearly visible beneath the remarkably transparent water, the vibrant forest-like cluster of living organisms teams with a generous population of many types of sea creatures.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Hidden Caves]
description: Jagged rocks about waist-high to a giantman part in a narrow cleft that shields entry into the interior of a rugged cave.  Tide-swept jetties of white water wash into the rocky opening, the fast-moving remnants of a whirlpool to the west.  The surrounding sea is rough and dark, almost midnight blue in coloration, with a pronounced easterly current that slaps against the cave-side rocks with steady regularity and uncompromising rhythm.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Water the brilliant blue of sapphires strikes the rock-laced island shore to the east even as it spirals foam-tinged toward a spinning whirlpool to the north.  The jagged shoreline holds all the safety of broken glass as the battering current crashes against it noisily, the sound itself serving as a cautionary warning to all but the most foolhardy.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Strands of uprooted seaweed, smooth pebbles, thin twigs, shells void of their natural inhabitants -- in short organic flotsam and jetsam churned up from the sea floor -- cycle hurriedly toward the white-capped waters of a powerful whirlpool to the east.  A combination of pristine clarity and muddied murk marks the water in an incongruous pattern of light and dark.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Charl's Teeth, menacing in their volcanic majesty, rise ever skyward to the west.  Torrents of water tear through the narrow crevices in the black obsidian barrier, and waves of enormous height pound relentlessly against the unseen side of those cliffs, the excess of the deluge cascading down over the rock face on this side.  Trembling with constant movement, the teal-into-blue water heaves easterly toward the outer shore of the encircled island.

title: [Western Waterway, Hidden Caves]
description: Fringing the cliff from north to south, a sandy white beach studded with cream-colored limestone boulders provides a possible mooring spot for small boats.  The wreckage of several attempts, though, litter the area, and the surf is both dangerous and deep.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Dark Caverns]
description: Tumbling over each other in their eagerness to expend their energy on the shore, waves pound at a small beach they have created at the foot of the cliffs over millennia.  A couple of dark openings near the base of the cliff at the beach's end contrast sharply with the white surrounding them.

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Cresting waves buffet any watercraft that dares come this way.  Chutes of white-flecked green and blue gather momentum as they crash eastward to the shore.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Small seagrass and beach plum plants cling to the side of the towering cliff, their leaves almost completely coated in salt spray.  Below, the water churns and froths against the limestone, creating unpredictable eddies and currents.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: One of the large teeth lays toppled across several others, barring an area that appears to have gone a bit further out at one time, but is now impassable.  Water flows quickly under the fallen rock, lapping at the rocks supporting it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Western Waterway]
description: Huge limestone cliffs rise abruptly at the shore.  No beach exists, only hard, unyielding rock.  The waves crash against the bluffs in a futile attempt to knock them down.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Gentle swells ripple from west to east, proto-waves making their way to the shore.  Above, the moonlight breaks through clouds, its pallid light shimmering on the water's surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Waves crash against the Teeth's glittering basalt rocks, breaking across shorter, worn rows in front of the massive rows behind.  A small gap in the rocks reveals only a view of yet more rocks.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Constructed of sturdy ironwood with solid stone piers, a dock juts out from the shoreline.  Rowboats, dories, and other small craft are tied to its side, and a few fishermen have assembled to one side in a lantern-lit conclave of nocturnal relaxation and storytelling.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Shoals of mackerel tumble through and above the water, their silver bodies breaching the water in small cascades.  Groups merge, break apart, and go through each other in what looks to be a random manner, yet the sizes of the shoals never seem to change.  Despite the shadows of night that darken the water, the scales of the silvery fish seem to catch any available moonlight.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: The vivid blue water flows to and fro between the distant island jetty and the equally distant pillars of Charl's Teeth.  An occasional fish disturbs the surface of the glittering water, a brief break from the endless expanse of ocean that stretches on seemingly forever.  Shadowy clouds pass overhead, alternatively obscuring and revealing the shafts of moonlight that illuminate the otherwise absolute blackness of night.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: The Teeth close around, encircling three sides.  A small whirlpool swirls near the intersection of the three massive rocks, pulling driftwood in spiraling circles around and around.

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: This close to the Teeth, the dark chill of their stone lends a cooling breeze.  Although there are gaps between individual rocks, the gaps are filled by second and even third rows of rocks behind them.  The quartz imbedded in their basalt glitters in the moonlight.

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Pieces of seaweed and other ocean vegetation drift past, caught on the foamy remnants of waves as the current relentlessly drags them along.  Not far away, the occasional sea otter breaks through the surface of the shadowy ocean water in a playful frolic as they take advantage of the cooler climate of nighttime.  Moonlight glistens from the surface of their slick forms, creating diamond-like shimmers that mimic the reflection they create on the rolling ocean surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Glittering wetly in the moonlight from the constant coating of sea spray it endures, a large mast sticks upright from the water, the galleon it is attached to immersed beneath the ocean's shadowy surface.  Tattered sails hang limply from the spars, providing a convenient sleeping perch for puffins, gulls, and one giant albatross as they rest.  Barely visible just beneath the water, a gash in the ship's hull disappears into the night-black, watery depths.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Moonlit water breaks lightly against the white limestone jetty, though it shows signs of having protected the harbor from much stronger forces in the past.  Visible beneath the surface of the water, the sea floor shimmers with golden specks resembling a collection of gold coins as their vivid light breaks through the shadowy depths.  An occasional silver fish darts through the murky water, its scales caught in a shaft of moonlight penetrating the liquid enough to briefly illuminate the tiny creature.

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: A flock of seagulls has taken up residence in the jetty's ten foot tall bulwark of tumbled stone to the east.  They perch quietly, beaks tucked securely into their breast and wing as they rest in the cooler night air as it drifts in from the ocean.  Seaweed strands cling to the limestone, their desiccated tendrils looking like extended fingers attempting to bring the jetty down into the murky depths of the water.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: The gap between the jetty's reach and the Teeth is at its most narrow here, lending more turbulence to this area than others to the north.  Small whirlpools form and dissolve quickly.  Schools of fish dart in and out of them, flashes of silver in the writhing water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: On a smaller scale, the manmade limestone jetty to the east reflects the great obsidian and basalt rocks far to the west.  Mirrored shades of black and white reflect off of one another and remain trapped in reflection across the expanse between the two barriers.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Moonlight glances off of the white froth of the surrounding sea as it bounces back and forth between the distant shore and the colossal heights of the Teeth.  Here and there, glittering luminous objects can be seen to spark beneath the depths of the nearly black waters.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Large chunks of the same limestone as the cliffs to the north tumble over each other to the southeast, thrusting a protective arm around the harbor.  Waves break against the weathered ivory of the jetty's surface, and a lone lantern flickers in the darkness of night, casting its pallid light over the rolling surf.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Shadows cast darkened patches through the nearly still, crystal clear water, partially obscuring the view of the sandy floor below.  Nestled securely within clumps of seaweed and ocean vegetation, giant crabs rest quietly in the lull of the ocean's current.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Up against Charl's Teeth and beyond sight of land, the water's expanse is a majestic and frightening sight.  The sound of the waves against the rocks is nearly deafening, yet limpets and mussels cling valiantly to the rocks at the waterline, along with a coating of bright green sea moss.

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Lanterns dangle from several small fishing boats occupying this area, their nets floating languidly in the water and glistening with moonlight as it reflects from the attached floats.  Occasionally, a crew member will appear and check on a net, but most of the boats are quiet as the fisherman sleep.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Anchored for the evening, a small boat bedecked with bright orange and yellow sails remains stationary in the gentle ocean current.  The sound of the water lapping against its sides is lulling, and the single lantern occupying the deck casts a pallid light across the darkened ocean surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Almost lulling in its rhythm, the sound of water lapping gently against the sides of anchored boats is constant.  Moonlight glistens upon the colorful variety of sails and painted decks as the fishermen rest and prepare for another day of work.  The flickering light of lanterns dots the area like twinkling fireflies, their brightness fading and resurfacing periodically in the misty fog that settles over the ocean's surface at night.

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Bereft of people, the harbor to the east is cluttered with empty sailboats and fishing boats docked for the evening.  Flickering lanterns dangle from their posts, casting their own illumination to mix with the moonlight glistening on the lapping water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: In the shadow of the tall basalt rocks, a school of jellyfish drift in the current.  Their tentacles dangle down below them as their bodies pulse lazily in near-transparent beauty.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: In the water's depths, a glint of moonlight strikes the untouched figurehead of a ship.  Barnacle and anemone-covered, the ship itself has become a refuge for barracudas who patrol its decks as the crew must have at one time long ago.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Not a single structure or piece of land is visible in any direction.  Only the western horizon is distinguishable, the rippling liquid of the ocean disrupted by a tall, unyielding and jagged line of rocks confining the island and its surrounding waters.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: To the north, a white cliff gives way to a tiny beach of creamy sand, evidence of the power of water.  Sea otters have taken residence on the beach, some frolicking and others lazily resting in the cool nighttime surf as the moonlight illuminates their forms.

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Darkening water indicates a change in depth from east to west, with the darkest rolling onto Charl's Teeth.  There are more dolphins here than typical, and few of the larger predators expected in such waters.  Although the water is as clear as glass, the bottom is not visible because the available light cannot penetrate the water's depth.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Shadows encase the base of the temple-topped cliff to the northeast, darkening the waters of a flourishing tidepool bound by coral reef.  A variety of sea creatures rest in the cliff's lee, taking refuge in the darkened water as night settles in.  Soft breezes carrying the scent of water lilies and wisteria float down from the temple's height.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: To the southeast, moonlight glistens upon a white cliff rising above the water to house an old temple of mellowed ivory marble.  The cool night air brings with it the smell of wisteria and jasmine mixed with the tang of salt air, and a few nocturnal creatures can be glimpsed frolicking in the surf.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Secluded Cove]
description: Though shadows encase the island, the vivid white hue of the pavilion and the equally white cliffs it is nestled against stand out in the glittering moonlight.  The shoreline of the cliffs features a pocket-sized sandy white beach, created by eons of waves washing in and out in the rhythm of the tide.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Shadows encase every nook and cranny of the Teeth of Charl jutting out above the murky waterline.  One such shard provides a shelf for an altar that is surrounded by hundreds of tiny carved ships and floral memorials.  The shafts of moonlight penetrating the night clouds seem to target the area, glistening against the sea spray that has accumulated.

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: This inlet's water is nearly perfectly still, the stronger currents of the rest of the bay muted here.  Occasional lines of bubbles rising from the murky depths of the ocean bottom reveal the presence of clams, while the shadowy forms of what appear to be anemones and corals gather in small colonies between fluttering fans of seaweed.

title: [Western Waterway, Harbor]
description: Bluffs of chalk dazzle in the moonlight, marking the southern edge of the island.  Patches of lighter water allow a deeper view of the ocean's depth as the liquid sparkles with the reflected light, revealing nocturnal fish of all sizes that dart above the shadow-encased floor.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Western Waterway, Broken Harbor]
description: Due to the narrow nature of this channel of water between the towering rocks in the west and the imposing cliffs to the east, the shadows seem prominent as night settles in.  Shafts of moonlight reflect like diamonds from the glistening surface of the ocean, creating ethereal illumination in the more shallow shoals near the shore.  Dotting the wall of the cliffs are several gull nests, occupied by the resting birds as they prepare for another day of hunting.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Less populated than their brethren to the north, the rocks look like veined marble as they continue the towering barrier.  The glossy black of obsidian and duller charcoal color of basalt are veined with the greyish-white of guano trailing down their faces.  A constant breeze brings the welcome scent of the sea, unfortunately tinged with the smell of hundreds of birds.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Broken Harbor]
description: Moonlight calls attention to the glistening cliffs towering above the ocean as a formidable barrier in the east.  Shadows dance across a small reef established from fan corals and branching corals near the shoreline, and dark liquid washes over the living structure in foamy waves as it laps against the island.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: In the shadowed nooks and crevices of a particularly high and craggy set of rocks rising proudly from the ocean's depths, seagulls sleep peacefully within their rookery.  The sound of the waves crashing against the teeth-like sentinels echoes loudly as the current churns, but unfortunately not even the strong scent of the sea can subdue the ammoniac smell of the guano left by the seagulls.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Glistening with moonlight and the spray of the ocean, the line of black teeth-like rocks continues to rise proudly from the depths of the shadowy water.  Clouds and patches of the starlit sky are visible through the gap between two of the dark sentinels, and the vast, featureless expanse of deep, blue ocean stretches to the horizon in an endless shimmer.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest

title: [Western Waterway, Broken Harbor]
description: Although shadows create darker spots within the shallows near the tall lighthouse, the moonlight still manages to pierce enough of the dark liquid to shimmer against the reflective scales of tiny fish darting around against the sandy bottom.  Clumps of kelp and sea urchins sway in the current as they cling to the dark rocks, seemingly waving to the fishes as they flit about.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Curving from the north to the west, an impassible line of natural monoliths glisten wetly in the moonlight.  Nighttime shadows enshroud the small area of relatively calm water the monoliths create, enhancing the darkness of the liquid.  Several hundred limpets cling to each of the tall, unmoving sentinels, their shells resembling a collection of rocks at the bottom of a stream.

title: [Western Waterway, Broken Harbor]
description: Shafts of moonlight break apart the shadows encasing the depths of a swirling whirlpool next to the rocks, where dark shadows bob up and down as they get caught in the swirling current.  Empty crab shells, the black eyes glistening in the dim light, move amongst the other debris, while seaweed caught in the rocks performs a chaotic dance on the surface of the water.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Western Waterway, Broken Harbor]
description: To the southwest, the lighthouse provides a reassuring bulwark, the foggy light it projects contrasting sharply with the jagged basalt teeth rising to the northeast and north.  Moonlight glistens upon the calm shallows, calling attention to the range of turquoise hues in the shadowy depths of the water.

title: [Western Waterway, Charl's Teeth]
description: Eddies swirl about the teeth-like basalt rocks rising from the depths of the ocean, the water foamy and green.  The only sign of the island visible, the distant lighthouse offers little safety this close to the "Teeth," which are so tall that the wind whistles around them in a harrowing wail.

title: [Looter's Lair, Approach]
description: Jagged rocks form the opening to the west, which leads through rushing, white-capped waters towards the open waterway, while to the east the cavern widens into a circular cove with a ceiling of glittering limestone.  A wide rough wooden dock, ringed by boats, offers a safe anchor for visiting vessels.

title: [Looter's Lair, Landing]
description: Rough and irregular, the walls of the cavern are slightly slick and speckled with strange glittering stones.  Torches, which are set within wide iron rings, are set at even intervals down the length to provide ample illumination for those entering and exiting the docks.  Warm heat trickles into the narrow space from somewhere to the northeast.

title: [Looter's Lair, Cache]
description: Warm and dry, the round cave has a narrow corridor leading to the southwest, where the gentle sound of lapping waves can be heard.  Bright and cheery, a large bonfire in the center of the chamber keeps the dampness of the salty sea air at bay.  Several crates, trunks, and casks are lined against one wall, their lids tightly sealed to ensure the safety and preservation of their contents.

title: [Barracks, Officer's Lounge]
description: Entering this warmly lit room, a mismatched collection of overstuffed leather armchairs frames the majority of the area, the pieces arranged in small cozy groups.  Amid one grouping, a low silvery haon table supports a tea service.  A tufted silk pillow here and a soft rolton-fleece blanket there add feminine touches to the otherwise masculine room.  Along the far wall, a birds-eye maple sideboard offers a variety of spirits and refreshments.  A burnished brass door leads back to the administrative offices.

title: [Transit Booth, Arrivals]
description: Smoothly hewn and perfectly circular, the small booth has an incredibly high ceiling which has a single frosted globe dangling from it.  Reddish light swirls throughout the compact space, the motion hypnotic and somewhat disorienting.  Fitted into the smooth stone floor is a series of cobalt circles that form interwoven patterns incised with runes.

title: [Bliss Island, Great Room]
description: Spacious and bright, the great room has been furnished with suede-covered seating tooled with a delicate green feather pattern.  Set inside a shallow recess along the northern wall is a peridot-inlaid door, while the west side has a glossy green door.  The golden bamboo floor has been inset with diamonds patterns wrought from maoral.  Suspended from the tall ceiling is an enormous wrought iron chandelier with green coral details, upon which numerous glass votives have been placed.

title: [Bliss Island, Master Bedroom]
description: Deep viridian walls contrast the pure white moldings in this airy bedroom, while the decor mimics the vibrant green in its fine detail.  A magnificent four-poster bed fitted with jade-hued sheets stands opposite an expansive watercolor painting.  The flanking teakwood nightstands each house a glass vase filled with freshly picked flowers.  Framing a tall open casement window are sheer, emerald-sheened drapes that flutter gently in the delicately scented tropical breeze.

title: [Bliss Island, Guest Bedroom]
description: Sunlight streams in through a window that affords a view of the beach and its blue waters.  The soft white walls have been painted with stylized jade vines that are repeated in the motif of the dresser and nightstand.  A large hope chest rests at the foot of the bed, and a full-length mirror stands in the corner.

title: [Bliss Island, Kitchen]
description: A massive stone hearth dominates the kitchen, its glowing embers radiating warmth along the floor.  The high ceiling has been fitted with viridian rafters, while open windows let in the slightly salty sea air.  Laid out upon a sea glass-inlaid countertop are several trays of food and beverages.  Alternating green and white tiles have been inlaid into a square teakwood table, which has been surrounded by four matching chairs.

title: [Malwith Inn, Patio]
description: Fresh air and sunlight filters through the overhead trellis, mingling with the prevailing scents of coffee, old leather, and rosemary in this intimate patio space.  Three small, oval tables are located in a loose semi-circle, each surrounded by several low-backed armchairs.  One of the seats is occupied by the Retired Airship Officer Tedrik, who, despite the alert expression in his eyes, appears to be in the firm grip of relaxation as he nurses a cup of coffee.

title: [Mistydeep, Swimming Hole]
description: Jagged cliffs melt into old-growth forest to the west, where tumbled boulders line the shore and jut their smooth-worn heads above the surface of the water.  The bank drops off sharply towards the east, where the swimming hole is at its broadest and deepest.  Not to be contained, the Mistydeep River spills out of its rocky confines, gamboling over natural stone terraces to flow in a southerly direction.  From nearby, the thunder of a waterfall can be heard.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Swimming Hole]
description: Clear blue-green water percolates outward from the falls to the north, gradually losing energy until it relaxes into this wide glassy mere.  Time has sculpted the depths of this not-quite-fathomless water hole, providing ample space for diving, as well as subaqueous swimming.  To the south, where the shore is a mix of jagged rocks and glittering grey sand, occasional surface calms provide brief glimpses of stolid shadowy forms far below.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Waterfall]
description: A constant roar drowns out all other ambient sound as the Mistydeep River cascades over a lofty, wide precipice into this rocky gorge.  Near the base of the massive falls, a fine spray fills the air above the roil.  Buoyant mist paints shimmering rainbows above the expansive basin that fills this horseshoe-shaped cleft in the forest.  Moving away from the falling torrent, the water settles into a smoothly rippled pool.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Swimming Hole]
description: A narrow sandy beach quickly gives way to throngs of trees at the eastern edge of the swimming hole, while the southern shore is dotted with fragmented boulders, rock slabs, and gravel.  Though shallower here than at the center of the pool, the water is still deep enough for swimming, with a few sections suitable for wading.  Gazing northwest, intermittent shifts of wind create gaps in the waterfall's screen, revealing a hollow in the cliff wall behind the deluge.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The sparking water of the Mistydeep River runs deep, dark, and fast over the clean sand.  Large gneiss boulders provide a refuge from the swift current for smaller denizens of the river, who dart in and out among the grasses that grow there.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The chilly waters of the Mistydeep run swiftly at this depth, scouring clean the pale sand below.  Dark piscene forms lurk at vision's edge, but they keep their distance, making identification impossible.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The deep, clear waters of the Mistydeep filter the bright sunlight into ever-changing ripples along the sand and rocks that line the riverbed.  An eel peers out from its rocky lair, poised to strike at any fish that has the misfortune to pass by.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The channel of the river runs very deep here, the sand at its bottom difficult to see even though the water is remarkably free of sediment.  A flick of motion deep below suggests that some of the larger fish on the river enjoy this benthic solitude.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: Several large boulders rising up from the sandy bottom dominate this stretch of the riverbed, rising far enough up to be a hazard to navigation without breaking the surface.  The algae and moss that have taken up residence there serve, in turn, as host to schools of minnows that nibble at their edges with dainty jabs.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, northwest, up
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The riverbed here is primarily sand and loose gravel, swept clean by the rapidly flowing current.  Dark boulders line the channel on the east, from which larger fish make forays, hunting for wayward minnows or other unfortunates.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The coarse sand of the bottom is nearly covered in some thick, dark weed that appears to have killed off any competing species.  The lack of any fish here suggests that they too find little of interest in the unwholesome plant.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: Shimmering light passing through the turbulent water overhead casts a dappled light and shadows over the sand.  The fat stems of a thicket of bulrushes stand like ranks of spears to the east, serving as home to countless small fish that dart about the safe haven.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, northwest, up
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: Massive boulders of dusky granite lie scattered like children's blocks along the bottom.  Deeply buried in the sand to the south, the boulders rise successively higher to the northwest, finally breaking the water's surface overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, up
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The Mistydeep seems particularly dark and deep at this point, its clear, cold waters flowing quickly by a few large boulders.  The shadowy forms of a few large fish making their way upstream are outlined against the sand below.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, northwest, up
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Mistydeep, Underwater]
description: The water here is turbulent, its deep blue-green suffused with the pale radiance of thousands of bubbles as the river tumbles through the rocky course.  Tiny freshwater crabs scuttle about on the sand below, while glossy fish slip effortlessly upstream.
location: the northern reaches of the Mistydeep River

title: [Hunter's Respite, Courtyard]
description: Well-worn cobblestones of ashen grey and taupe form a winding trail towards a wood-framed dark stone cottage encircled by a copse of full-grown apple trees, a thin trail of chimney smoke dancing between their sturdy branches.  A colorful garden of fruits and vegetables encloses either side of the trail, the faint sounds of buzzing and the occasional shuffle from its woodland occupants causing the fauna to rustle.  Resting next to a stag-carved mahogany bench are a variety of supplies, the gear protected by the slanted roof.
location: Hunter's Respite, outside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]
description: Reflections off of the ice dazzle your eyes.  Shivering with the cold, you can barely make out four passages leading out in different directions.  Nothing stands out to distinguish this chamber from dozens just like it.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Glatoph, Glacier]

title: [Silvergate Inn, Lockers]
description: Rows of lockers line the shelves along the walls of this compact space.  An old sturdy counter is centered between two sets of shelves, and appears to be capable of holding the contents of any of the lockers you can see.  Your locker has been removed from its assigned niche and sits ready for you.

title: [Silvergate Inn, Lockers]
description: Rows of lockers line the shelves along the walls of this compact space.  An old sturdy counter is centered between two sets of shelves, and appears to be capable of holding the contents of any of the lockers you can see.  Your locker has been removed from its assigned niche and sits ready for you.

title: [Silvergate, Member's Lockers]
description: Rows of lockers line the shelves along the walls of this compact space.  An old sturdy table is centered between two sets of shelves, and appears to be capable of holding the contents of any of the lockers you can see.  Your locker has been removed from its assigned niche and sits ready for you on an old sturdy counter.

title: [Vipershroud, Inside the Tree]
description: Pitch blackness eliminates vision, and progress must be made through the sense of touch.  The sound of small scurryings and scrapings echoes faintly in the tight confines of the log, and soft, wriggly bodies squish easily under hand and foot.  The odor of decay, rising from the damp, pressing walls adds to the discomfort from the steamy humidity.  No way forward is apparent in the darkness, although the way back out is readily remembered.

title: [Warrior Guild, Shaded Lawn]
description: Tucked beneath the spreading branches of oak trees, this secluded corner of the lawn seems a perfect place for quiet discussion.  A case filled with rattan weapons and a trampled circle upon the lawn suggests this may also be used as a sparring spot.

title: [Warrior Guild, Shady Lawn]
description: This is a quiet corner of the lawn and rather private as well, providing a good refuge from the din of the practice area--a perfect place for discussion, contemplation or simply escaping the crowd.

title: [Warrior Guild, Training Room]
description: This rough-hewn passage leads through a low opening from the gymnasium into a secluded chamber.  A bamboo mat is spread on the floor, defining the borders of the training area.

title: [Warrior Guild, Roof]
description: This is a quiet corner of the roof and rather private as well, providing a good refuge from the din of the practice area--a perfect place for discussion, contemplation or simply escaping the crowd.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Master's Room]
description: Tucked back in a corner of the room, the master takes you away from everyone for some privacy.  The area is clear of decoration, dents and scratches on the floor mark its purpose.  A weapons case is set against the wall, the rattan weapons inside are ready for use while training.

description: Grass and shrubs have been cleared away, leaving plenty of room for the elaborate machine that dominates this area.

title: [Private Training Room]
description: The room is ample, with high ceilings and only essential furnishings, obviously designed to keep one's mind focused on the matters at hand.  On the wall, the necessary accoutrements of warriors-in-training await.

title: [Warrior Guild, Training Grounds]
description: Separated from the rest of the open grounds by the colonnades, this space offers convenient solitude for more rigorous, one-on-one training with the guild instructors.  The occasional tropical breeze that blows past provides a welcomed respite from the arduous training regimen.

title: [Arcane Studies, Training Room]
description: The surroundings are entirely obscured by an opaque ultramarine mist, allowing you perfect peace and silence in which to practice your craft.  A narrow and constantly shifting passageway of mist leads out of the confines of the training room.

description: Hardly more than an alcove off the main chamber, this small cave has been fitted with the basics needed for alchemy.  A stack of cauldrons of various shapes and sizes sits at one end, and assorted herbs hang from the ceiling.  Small boxes are set along natural shelves and nooks in the rock walls, though their contents are a mystery.

title: [Masters, Private Instruction]
description: Rather tranquil and much less crowded than the anteroom, this workshop has a workbench with alchemical gear stored in a cabinet next to it and a tiny window providing soft moonlight.  A large potted geranium stands below the window reaching toward possible freedom.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Room]
description: Stacks of scrolls totally obscure the surface of a large desk, while behind it stands a comfortable chair covered in well worn chintz.  In contrast, a work table stands to one side, nearly devoid of clutter.  A shelving unit, attached to the large palm behind it, contains alchemical reagents of every type.  The palm's fronds, and those of its nearby brethren, shade the area from both too much sun and the occasional shower.

title: [Empath Guild, Master's Study]
description: Bundles of dried herbs and flowers are hung from a row of neat hooks driven deep into the ceiling.  Rows of golden oak shelves and cabinets, filled with silk-lined drawers, run the length of the room.  A sturdy worktable, its surface sectioned into marble, steel, and granite to accommodate a variety of uses occupies nearly all of the floor space.

title: [A Hidden Room]
description: Dark cherrywood paneling encloses the room, hung with gold-chased wall sconces and lit with dancing flames.  A detailed circle of runes dominates the center of the floor, worked in pearlescent white tile amongst the greater pattern of sinuous crimson shapes.  Tightly rolled sheaves of paper peek out from small niches in the numerous scroll racks that line the walls.

title: [A Quiet Corner]
description: Nestled among stacks of dusty tomes, this quiet corner of the library is a perfect place for quiet instruction and study.  Arrayed on a narrow shelf alongside some of the fatter volumes is a collection of alchemical instruments, amulets, wands, and crystals.

title: [Wizard Guild, Training Room]
description: Detailed diagrams of elemental relationships have been rendered on parchment and posted upon the smooth stone walls.  A metallic-threaded curtain leads back out to the main cavern.

title: [A Hidden Room]
description: Rich mahogany paneling encloses the room, polished to a deep ruddy luster.  A detailed circle of runes dominates the center of the floor, worked in pearlescent white tile amongst the greater pattern of muted geometric shapes.  Tightly rolled sheaves of paper peek out from small niches in the numerous scroll racks that line the walls.

title: [A Secluded Corner]
description: Pale mistwood paneling encloses the room, with a thin wash of silver lending a faint sheen.  A detailed circle of runes dominates the center of the floor, worked in pearlescent white tile amongst the greater pattern of azure waveform shapes.  Tightly rolled sheaves of paper peek out from small niches in the numerous scroll racks that line the walls.

title: [A Hidden Room]
description: Cleanly hewn and polished walls of sandy marble enclose the room, trimmed with boxy patterns of carved knotwork.  A detailed circle of runes dominates the center of the floor, worked in pearlescent white tile amongst the greater pattern of wispy cloud patterns.  Tightly rolled sheaves of paper peek out from small niches in the numerous scroll racks that line the marble walls.

title: [A Hidden Room]
description: Draperies of gauzy white silk enclose the room, swaying gently in a slight draft.  A detailed circle of runes dominates the center of the floor, worked in pearlescent white tile amongst the greater pattern of wispy cloud patterns.  Tightly rolled sheaves of paper peek out from small niches in the numerous scroll racks that line the silk-covered walls.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Room]
description: Spartan in its decor and furnishings, there is no distraction from the intense training undergone in this room.  Shards of crystal glimmer beyond a curtained stone archway.

title: [Courtyard]
description: A series of freestanding arches looms over a wide path of tightly interlocked stones.  The path runs straight and true from the polished silver gates to the north to a stairway that drops off to the south.  Outside the arches crushed red brick covers the ground inside the white limestone walls.  Cacti of different shapes and sizes reside in large earthenware pots, and here and there small stone rabbits sit rigidly still.  A brightly blazing torch extends from the side of each arch.

The path runs straight and true from the polished silver gates to the north to a stairway that drops off to the south.  Outside the arches crushed red brick covers the ground inside the white limestone walls.  Cacti of different shapes and sizes reside in large earthenware pots, and here and there small stone rabbits sit rigidly still.  An unlit torch extends from the side of each arch.

title: [Hub]
description: A placid dark lake extends to the south.  A sheltered island sits in the center of the lake, and a bridge arches over the lake's waters to reach the island.  Well-maintained paths of white stone wind through a stark landscape of crushed volcanic rock and strategically placed volcanic boulders.  Tiny grey lizards peek out from under some of the boulders while others scamper over the rocks in search of an insect meal.  A stairway rises to the north, and a stone building resides to the east.

A placid, crystal blue lake extends to the south.  A sheltered island sits in the center of the lake, and a bridge arches over the lake's waters to reach the island.  Well-maintained paths of white stone wind through a stark landscape of crushed volcanic rock and strategically placed volcanic boulders.  Tiny grey lizards sun themselves on some of the boulders while others scamper over the rocks in search of an insect meal.  A stairway rises to the north, and a stone building resides to the east.

title: [Infirmary]
description: Small windows mounted high on the walls allow dim illumination into this stone building.  Small cabinets nestle against one wall, each cabinet designed to contain an emergency supply of a specific herb.  Several cots await the injured, and a mannequin rests in one corner with piles of bandages, splints and tourniquets neatly stacked around it.  Although the walls and floors are constructed from rough granite, the entire area is immaculately kept.  A flickering light comes from an arch to the south.

title: [Aroma Therapy]
description: Stone walls encircle this small area, rising fifty feet or more straight up.  The ceiling appears to be some sort of latticework or mesh that barely allows any illumination through.  All along the expanse of wall a hundred misshapen shelves extend out to hold one long white candle apiece, creating a tunnel of flickering stars ascending toward a softly glowing moon.  On a wide pedestal in the room's center fifty candles of all shapes and sizes cluster, igniting and extinguishing one at a time.

title: [Library]
description: A small sheltered granite alcove hugs this side of the lake.  The western side is open to afford a colorful view of the lake's crystal blue waters.  Shelves, desks and small brass lanterns occupy the rest of the area.  The shelves are crammed full of parchments, books and scrolls.  Interestingly, the majority of the writings address the honing of one's will, meditation, martial arts and weaponry rather than healing arts.  The sandy floor effectively muffles the sound of passing footsteps.

title: [Relaxation Island]
description: A spacious white wooden gazebo offers rocking chairs, food, drink, and peaceful relaxation.  Around the gazebo four tall palm trees lean inward, shading the area.  Grey ice plant grows across the surrounding sandy beach, interspersed by patches of tall reeds.  Brass sconces mounted on the gazebo's beams flicker brightly, and a flock of geese honks noisily as its members splash nearby in the lake's waters.  An arching bridge leads north, while a tunnel leads under the lake to the west.

A spacious white wooden gazebo offers rocking chairs, food, drink, and peaceful relaxation.  Around the gazebo four tall palm trees lean inward, shading the area.  Light blue ice plant grows across the surrounding sandy beach, interspersed by patches of tall reeds.  Brass sconces mounted on the gazebo's beams await the coming of night, and a flock of geese honks noisily as its members splash nearby in the lake's waters.  An arching bridge leads north, while a tunnel leads under the lake to the west.

title: [Training Area]
description: Huge volcanic boulders interrupt the flat, sandy expanse of this vast area.  Training stations sit next to each boulder, and training in martial arts, weaponry and bodybuilding seems to be the main occupation of those gathered here.  Sandbags are piled haphazardly next to one nearby boulder.  Potted cacti next to standing, unlit torches and small stone figures of various creatures break up the monotony of the sandy flat.  A gate leads into a small walled compound.

title: [Potion Garden]
description: A number of long wooden tables occupy this small walled compound.  Stunted cacti grow in tiny earthen pots on several of the tables, and various instruments of horticulture lie scattered about the compound.  Bottles, powdered herbs, beakers, and mixing instruments reside on most of the tables, with piles of unused containers occupying the compound's four corners just below unlit torches.  There seems to be an elusive feeling of order in the disarray.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.  A polished arched wooden door stands in the exact center of the north wall.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemic Nexus]
description: This octagonal stone chamber is lit by eight flickering torches, one positioned at each corner.  A tunnel in the eastern wall leads upward toward the main training area.  A faint aroma wafts from each of six doorways, an unusual combination of ale and herbs.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, down, out

title: [Training Area]
description: Volcanic boulders pock the sandy area as if a huge hand dropped them haphazardly.  Various physical activities are conducted near each boulder with the occasional sound of weapon against weapon ringing through the area.  Tall cacti grow in small groups, and tiny lizards dart among the protective needle foliage.  Sconces affixed to each boulder light the area when night falls.  Two black obelisks stand a short distance away with a table beside each.  A wooden sign is affixed to a nearby barrel cactus.

title: [Empath Guild, Master's Hall]
description: Polished walls of honey and black oak inlaid in a pattern of interlocking chevrons define the hallway of the annex that leads to the cauldron practice rooms.  Water flows slowly over a sheet of glass overlaying the woodwork in the corner, with occasional ripples betraying the presence of etchings in the glass.

title: [Empath Guild, Storage Room]
description: Four bare, white walls enclose this small, square room.  A tall wooden cabinet stands against one wall next to a large dust bin.  The floor is hardwood, polished but uncovered, completing the room's overall austere appearance.

title: [Empath Guild, Dacra's Workshop]
description: This small room's walls have been painted a pale sage green.  A skylight in the ceiling gives access to the day's light and is likely the cause for the fading of a heavy wool rug on the floor.  A sturdy barrel-shaped workbench stands off to one side, its weight having formed a permanent circle in the rug beneath it.

title: [Empath Guild, Pantry]
description: One white half-circle wall encloses this room and its bare hardwood floor.  A sturdy wooden shelf hangs by itself on the wall.  A marble-topped table serves as a centerpiece, while a store room clerk monitors the room's goings-on.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldrons]
description: Several training rooms completely equipped with cauldrons, beakers, measures, and other supplies, are accessible around the perimeter of this room, their arched entryways carefully positioned so that no room looks directly into the entrance of another.  A bundle of dried herbs is hung above each archway.  Rippling in each entryway, the air wavers and dances, as if thicker in the archways than elsewhere.

title: [Empath Guild, Cauldron]
description: An enormous cast iron cauldron with thick, hinged ring handles dominates the training room.  Sturdy metal hanging arms attached to a trammel are positioned above the fire pit, ready to adjust the height of the cauldron.  Rough wooden stirring paddles, spyders, pokers, and hooks are neatly arranged along the wall, within easy reach.

title: [Guild Master Loblia's Office]
description: Warm oak paneling covers the walls of this small building.  Windows, one each mounted in the north, west and east walls, allow sunlight to brighten the interior.  The ceiling and floor are both composed of white limestone, reflecting the sunlight and adding to the illumination.  A carved walnut desk occupies a prominent position behind which a large, padded chair resides.  Two torches flank the silver door on the south wall.

The ceiling and floor are both composed of white limestone, reflecting the moonlight and adding to the illumination. title: [Meeting Coliseum]
description: A huge bowl has been excavated from the solid volcanic substrate here.  The rock has been chiseled to form long curving rows of backless stone benches.  Emerald cloth has been piled atop the benches to cushion the seats.  A tall, circular, white marble dais graces the center of the bowl.  Around the bowl's upper edges, huge rectangular stones tower with blazing torches sprouting up and down their sides, and an insignia has been carefully etched near the top of each massive stone.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Treetop]
description: A canopy of leaves blocking out most of the view of the sky and the ground below gives this treetop perch a feeling of privacy.  It is not exactly quiet here, but the bright song of birds and whisper of a breeze passing over verdant green foliage is pleasant and soothing.  The trunk of the oak descends to the ground below.

title: [City Stables, Stalls]
description: Soft whinnying, snorting, and the stamping of hooves resounds throughout the stables.  Stablehands are constantly on the move, fetching fresh horses for the traveling merchants, messengers, or guards who board their steeds here.  The stalls are clean and well-tended, and the horses seem content with their lots in life here in the Landing.
