title: [Clearing]
description: This wide clearing is covered in hay, though sections of black volcanic rock peek out from beneath.  Directly across from the entry arch is a large black barn trimmed in fiery red paint.  The handles on the door are glaes and forged in the shape of a horseshoe.

title: [Yander's Farm, Barn]
description: Dust motes float lazily in the air amid the redolent aroma of fresh hay in the barn's interior.  Heavy oak rafters high overhead span this large open area suitable for several gnomish threshing machines.  A newly painted baker's door stands open along the western wall, providing egress to the attached stables.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Paddock]
description: A long, weathered fence made of alternating pine and birchwood encloses a particularly large meadow and separates it from the surrounding wilds.  Snow has piled up in the four corners of this large paddock, while an oblong trail that has been shoveled nearly clean in the center, the exposed ground covered with hoof marks.  Near the back of the lot stands a well-constructed barn illuminated by several oil lamps near its doors.

title: [Snowflake Vale, Stable]
description: The interior of this large stable is warmed by several cast iron stoves strategically placed near the doors as well as just beside the spacious stalls.  Brushes, assorted contraptions, horseshoes, whips, and cleaning supplies adorn the walls.  The honeyed scent of fresh grain rises from wooden buckets, and the sound of rushing water comes from a trough connected to an unseen source of water through one wall.  A Malghavan family keeps busy around you, tending to the animals.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Corral]
description: Thick oak posts are securely anchored into the ground and linked with wooden rails to form a sturdy perimeter.  Hard packed dirt and gravel makes up the surface of the inner yard.  A wooden stable stands at the eastern end of the corral, where a pair of doors stand open to allow easy access.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, Stable]
description: Whitewashed wooden planks make up the walls of the stable, each fitted together tightly and secured with nails to protect the interior from the elements.  Racks and pegs covered in equipment and tack cover part of one wall with a small side door that leads out to the covered rick-yard.  Stalls rise up from the scuffed floors and line both sides and the back of the stable.

title: [Swirling Nexus, Transport Hub]
description: Warm wind rushes through the area in a constant cyclone, carrying with it the floral scents of each corner of Elanthia, all blending with the smell of ozone.  Eight gently pointed alcoves, spaced like the points of a star, spread out from this center room, each one painted a different hue.  A large black directional sign takes up residence in the center of the white marble floor, its bold white writing standing out against the dark background.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, down

title: [Kraken's Fall Room]
description: Painted blue walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus above.  The focal point of the space is a swirling seafoam green portal framed by an intricately carved albino kraken.  A collection of ships of all shapes and sizes have been etched between the tentacles that drape around the portal.  A tropical breeze swirls around the area, scented like oranges and coconuts.

title: [Icemule Trace Room]
description: Ice blue walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the south.  The focal point of the space is a swirling white and green portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Myriad snowflakes have been etched into the metal, each one different from the last, much like their icy inspirations.  A cold breeze swirls around the area, scented of the unique flora of Icemule Trace.

title: [Ta'Illistim Room]
description: Pale pink walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the southwest.  The focal point of the space is a swirling iridescent portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Sprawling cherry blossom branches have been etched into the metal, their flowering lengths mingling near the top, reminiscent of a garden bower.  A mild breeze swirls around the area, scented of the flora of Ta'Illistim.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Room]
description: Crimson walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the west.  The focal point of the space is a swirling red and gold portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Intricate wyverns have been etched into the metal, their sinuous lengths intertwined, creating a complex scrollwork pattern.  A mild breeze swirls around the area, scented of the flora of Ta'Vaalor.

title: [Zul Logoth Room]
description: Pale purple walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the northwest.  The focal point of the space is a swirling purple and grey portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Myriad toadstools have been etched into the metal, their various shapes and sizes creating a lush, fungal garden.  A cool, damp breeze swirls around the area, scented of the flora of Zul Logoth and the heady fragrance of raw earth.

title: [Kharam Dzu Room]
description: Stone grey walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the north.  The focal point of the space is a swirling black and red portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Clusters of stars have been etched into the metal, several of them spouting tails like comets.  A hot breeze swirls around the area, scented of the flora of Teras Isle.

title: [Solhaven Room]
description: Ocean blue walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the northeast.  The focal point of the space is a swirling seafoam white portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Seashells of many varieties have been etched into the metal, each one overlapping another to form a pattern reminiscent of the scales of a fish.  A warm breeze swirls around the area, scented of the flora of Solhaven and the salty fragrance of the sea.

title: [Wehnimer's Landing Room]
description: Dark green walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the east.  The focal point of the space is a swirling green and gold portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  Intricate foliage has been etched into the metal, the vines intertwining to form a complex lattice pattern.  A warm breeze swirls around the area, scented of the flora of Wehnimer's Landing.

title: [River's Rest Room]
description: Pale blue walls surround this small alcove off the central nexus to the southeast.  The focal point of the space is a swirling sunny yellow portal framed by an oval of wrought silver.  River reeds and water lilies have been etched into the metal, their shapes intertwined to form a complex pattern.  A warm breeze swirls around the area, scented of the flora of River's Rest and the fresh fragrance of rain.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Facing each other over the glossy mahogany wall, a polished oak door etched with a porpoise and a polished oak door etched with a nymph are built into the walls of the corridor.  Wrought iron lanterns dangle from the exposed, knotty pine rafters and are responsible for the small pools of light that illuminate the dark, windowless space.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Culminating in a rough stone wall, the corridor stretches to the south under the watchful gaze of wrought iron lanterns.  Smooth mahogany floors are polished to a high glossiness that reflects and defuses the resulting pools of light.  In the eastern and western walls, a pair of doors, a polished oak door etched with a sea hag and a polished oak door etched with a kelpie, provide entrance to the workrooms beyond.

title: [House Annex, Silvergate Inn]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, the western wall is painted verdant green and dominated by a rampant argent lion, which is illuminated by the warm glow of several frosted glaesine globes anchored to the ceiling.  Plush grass green carpeting dappled with silver threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of a straw yellow crushed velvet settee.  A lacquered white door leads to the hallway, while a silver-edged verdant green curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through a silver-edged verdant green curtain.  A lacquered green pine counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Built kitty-corner between a sun-crested stockade fence and a railing-guarded cliff, a two-story whitewashed shop sits within a field of shaggy grass.  Large windows of stained glass, comically depicting a colorful halfling baker, rest in the face of the white-washed structure, as does a bright red door that has been left partially open.  Just to the right of the building, a sturdy knotty pine staircase leads to the second story.

title: [Two-Story Shop, Landing]
description: Light reflects off of the polished copper underbelly of the roof's awning, which stretches protectively over the knotty pine landing.  Heading in a straight line to the grassy yard below, a sturdy knotty pine staircase is flanked by brightly illuminated lanterns fitted with bright cobalt blue windows.

title: [Copper Potts' Pies and Sundries]
description: Ambient light filters through the large stained-glass windows that dominate the face of the shop, the filtered light chasing red, amber, and copper colors across the knotty pine walls.  Floor-to-ceiling brick and stone ovens line the eastern wall and fill the air with a heavy, warm heat.  Several wrought iron chairs flank small round tables and are pushed far enough back to allow customers ample space to purchase wares at a long and low copper-edged counter.

title: [Private Instruction Alcove]
description: Tapestries cover the walls, giving this small alcove a more secluded ambiance.  A small lantern hangs from above, brightly illuminating the quiet space.

title: [Penitent Pass, Entry]
description: Frosted globes dangle from the distant stone ceiling, providing a warm glow that is reminiscent of sunlight.  Smooth walls stretch to the west, their faces decorated with cobalt blue paint.  A sturdy oak door provides entry to an office, while a large opening provides egress.

title: [Penitent Pass, Corridor]
description: Round area rugs with bright orange and yellow designs against a cobalt blue backdrop are scattered across the chamber's floor.  Above, frosted globes provide a warm glow that is reminiscent of sunlight.  Built into the southern wall, a set of double doors offer entry to a small barracks, while a peaked archway carved into the western wall leads to a small kitchen.  Several chairs encircle a round oak table that dominates the space.

title: [Penitent Pass, Barracks]
description: Tidy and spartan, the barracks have four sets of wrought iron bunks built into the walls.  Equally as many equipment lockers are scattered about the space, while foul weather gear for each guard hangs from pegs near the door.  A duty roster is tacked to the northern wall, the tidy writing listing the rotation schedule that is shared with the Kraken's Fall jailhouse.

title: [Penitent Pass, Kitchen]
description: Utilitarian at best, the small kitchen has neatly stacked speckled blue plates, cups, and bowls stored on its shelves.  Casks of fresh water have screens on them that prevent bugs from getting into the drinking supply, while thin sheets of cheese cloth protect the produce stored in baskets throughout the space.  Standing alone in one corner, a cast iron stove has an exhaust pipe that disappears into the stone ceiling.

title: [Penitent Pass, Gaol Burrow]
description: Frosted globes dangle from the distant stone ceiling, providing a warm light that is reminiscent of sunlight.  Smooth walls filled with wrought iron grates stretch to the west, while a tunnel opening in the east gives a glimpse of the sky.  Flanking each other, a painted sign over the left-hand cell proclaims it as "Gaol One," while the right-hand cell is labeled "Gaol Two."

title: [Penitent Pass, Gaol Burrow]
description: Frosted globes dangle from the distant stone ceiling, providing a warm light that is reminiscent of sunlight.  Smooth walls filled with wrought iron grates stretch both to the east and to the west.  Flanking each other, a painted sign over the left-hand cell proclaims it as "Gaol Three," while the right-hand cell is labeled "Gaol Four."

title: [Penitent Pass, Gaol Burrow]
description: Frosted globes dangle from the distant stone ceiling, providing a warm light that is reminiscent of sunlight.  Smooth walls filled with wrought iron grates stretch to the east, while the west terminates in a series of floor-to-ceiling shelves that are loaded with fresh linens, grey trousers, and white cotton shirts displaying an encircled kraken patch.  Flanking each other, a painted sign over the left-hand cell proclaims it as "Gaol Five," while the right-hand cell is labeled "Gaol Six."

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Landing]
description: Circular in shape, close-fitting brick forms the walls of the room creating the foundation of the lighthouse proper.  Light from a warped, stained-glass window bathes the space in beams of bright colors.  Set back from the entrance is a polished mahogany desk with bits of shell inlaid along the edges.  A spiraling staircase leads up into the tall building.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Corridor]
description: Wooden panels generously covered in whitewash line the walls of the curved hallway.  Protecting the corridor is a railing of thick cast iron chain links that thread through carved oak supports.  A smooth driftwood door carved with a leaping dolphin is set into the wall near a spiral ascending staircase.  Imbedded with bits of sea glass, a stone archway leads into a shadowed chamber.

title: [Pour Judgement]
description: Dominating the far wall of this slightly curved room is a pitted driftwood counter, its surface rough and unpolished.  Padded chairs, perched on tall legs, are scattered about the area.  Looking out over the city, a tall, narrow window gives a beautiful view of the docks.  A pair of bronze sconces illuminate the room with a pale light cast through filmy glass panes.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Larder]
description: Spacious and well lit, this kitchen is full of supplies and wonderful aromas.  A marble-topped driftwood counter is centered in the room with plates of food ready for any event.  Standing tall, a rhimar-lined porcelain chest dominates most of the back wall, while a polished oak table is tucked next to the entrance.  Hanging above is a brightly painted sign.  Bits of kindling and wood are stacked next to a large cast iron stove with its clean grate open and ready for cooking.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Corridor]
description: Whitewashed panels of wood line the corridor in a circular pattern.  A railing crafted of cast iron chain links encircles an open space that goes down to the main floor.  A pair of brushed copper lanterns hang on either side of a dark green door and a dark blue door that are set into the curved walls.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Ocean Room]
description: Shimmering lengths of silk hang from the walls of the chamber, the various shades of blues and greens create billowing waves as air flowing about the room seems to give them life.  A basket of sticks rests next to a small copper brazier that is perched on a trio of seahorse legs.  Centered in the room is a lacquered driftwood table that is surrounded by several matching chairs.  A series of bronze lanterns hang from the ceiling above.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Forest Room]
description: Beautiful murals of trees, plants, and various shrubbery are painted on the walls of the curved room giving the illusion of a thick forest.  Large potted ferns, bushes, and plants are stacked about, adding to the scene.  In one corner, a small iron stove is nestled within the greenery, a basket of sticks tucked nearby.  Central in the chamber is a polished white oak table flanked by two long benches.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Corridor]
description: Surrounded by a cast iron chain railing, the rounded chamber is lined with whitewashed paneling.  Looking over the metal barrier is a circular opening that allows a view of the bottom level of the lighthouse.  Set into the wall is a pale blue door and a light beige door, their painted, wooden surfaces protected with a clear lacquer.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Beach Room]
description: Plump linen cushions in various cooling shades are placed about a polished low driftwood table.  Soft, white sand covers the floor of the beach-like chamber.  Tucked about the room are plant-filled urns crafted from dark brass, the seagrass and colorful windflowers adding a tropical touch to the space.  Bright sea glass murals cover most of the walls, their shades ranging from golden yellow to dark blues and greens to recreate a beautiful coastal scene.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Water Room]
description: Rich shades of blue and green are woven into the wave-like pattern of a thick wool carpet that covers the floor of this curved room.  Several shell-shaped divans are placed about a lacquered low driftwood table.  A trio of crystal globes hang above a small stone-encircled pool with several colorful fish swimming at the surface.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Corridor]
description: Circular in shape, simple paneling covered in a thick layer of whitewash lines the walls of the open corridor.  Set into one part of the inner hall is a varnished oak door with a crude trident etched into the lintel above.  Along another section is an iron-bound oak ladder that leads higher into the lighthouse.  Looking over a cast iron railing, one can see into the lowest chamber below.

title: [Lantern Room]
description: Panes of clear crystal are set into brass framework to create this small light chamber.  Centered in the room is a hollowed-out stone filled with fish oil.  A ring of copper lanterns hangs from the top of the chamber centered above the depression with individual wicks leading from the light source down into the liquid below.  Looking out through the glass on one side is a perfect view of the town, while on the other a beautiful glimpse of the vast ocean.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Emporium]
description: Crystal globes hang from above, their filmy coverings shedding a pale light over the shop.  Bits of fishing net hang from rough-hewn rafters, their weaves holding a variety of items for sale.  Tucked to one side of the entrance is a worn copper-banded barrel overflowing with a wide array of wares.  A driftwood sign hangs above several chests lined up against the far wall.

title: [Landing Hall, Main Lobby]
description: Footsteps and hushed whispers echo off of the polished black-veined white marble floor, resounding throughout the room and amplified by the massive golden dome overhead.  A huge, polished gold chandelier dangles from the top of the dome from a thick mithril chain, dozens of candles providing ample light.  The sunlight streaming through the fanciful stained glass makes colored patterns upon the floor and the sweeping staircase that leads to the second floor.

title: [Landing Hall, Second Floor]
description: This landing offers a bird's-eye view of the main lobby, a polished gold railing keeping the unwary spectator from plummeting down.  Soft music can be heard from some fancifully-carved grand oak double doors, mixing with the echoes that float up from the lobby.  The walls and floors are bathed in multicolored light, the effects of the stained glass in the dome much more apparent from this vantage.

title: [Landing Hall, Ballroom]
description: Judging by the grandiose decoration and large size, this room seems to be intended for formal occasions.  An elegant crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, and gold and red tapestries cover the walls.  A dance floor is in the center of the room, surrounded by dinner tables.  Along the north wall, a stage has been set up for the band that is currently playing soft music.  The eastern wall is made entirely out of paneled glass, with two glass doors leading outside.

title: [Landing Hall, Balcony]
description: A refreshing breeze blows across the granite-railed balcony, offering a quick respite from the ballroom.  The high vantage point offers a clear view of the eastern part of Wehnimer's Landing, and hundreds of people wander the streets below, appearing as ants as they go about their business.  Two potted plants frame the glass doors leading back inside, and gold-stitched red banners are draped from the roof of the building.

title: [Landing Hall, Bar]
description: A large mahogany bar dominates the north end of this oak-paneled room, dozens of bottles lining the shelves behind it.  A few bar stools are bolted to the ground in front of the bar, while several plush lounge chairs line the walls.  The western wall bears a gold-framed oil painting, adding some decoration and color to this room, and a gold and red tapestry leads east.  Simple wooden tables are spaced several feet apart, offering patrons a place to sit with others and converse.

title: [Landing Hall, Hall of History]
description: Several small, flickering candles on the eastern wall provide light to this narrow hallway.  The western wall has been converted into an enormous mural, the dim light just bright enough to see every detail.  The hallway extends to the north, and some light can be seen at the end.  The noise from the main lobby has ceased completely, leaving the hallway in contemplative silence.

title: [Landing Hall, Passageway]
description: Four polished gold lanterns flicker lazily, providing ample light and drawing attention to a splendid watercolor hanging on the western wall.  Sounds from the main lobby are amplified here, echoing and reverberating in the spacious passage, providing the illusion that dozens of people are speaking at once.  In the north wall is an elegantly carved oak door, while the south wall contains a beveled arch.

title: [Landing Hall, Lounge]
description: A circular plush couch surrounds a large ivory carving in the center of this well-lit room.  Lining the walls are chairs of all shapes and sizes, offering a comfortable resting place for everyone, regardless of race.  Stretched from one corner of the ceiling to the other is a bright red banner stitched with golden thread.

title: [Landing Hall, Auditorium]
description: Sounds from outside barely penetrate the thick granite walls, leaving the large auditorium in a silent hush.  Sunlight streams in through the large bay window in the west wall, adding to the ambience provided by a small brass chandelier, casting the room in a soft glow.  Dozens of chairs have been set up in rows, all facing towards a large podium placed near the north wall.  The eastern wall is one large mural, the only decoration in this room.

title: [Landing Hall, Hallway]
description: This hallway ends in a small nook, with a small potted tree proudly defending its territory from the polished gold lantern fastened to the wall above it.  Loud laughs can occasionally be heard through an engraved granite arch in the north wall, while the sound of supplies being shuffled can be heard through the oak door in the south wall.

title: [Landing Hall, Supply Shop]
description: Several wooden shelves line each wall of this confined room, allowing for plenty of storage space.  Polished gold lanterns are bolted firmly to the walls, offering more than enough light to inspect the supplies that have been laid out.  Dominating the southern wall, behind a rough wooden counter, are two large iron bins, one painted red and the other gold.

title: [Landing Hall, Hall of History]
description: Light from the north floods into this room, but the candles on the eastern wall are still required to be able to see clearly.  A mural on the west wall draws attention, being the only thing in this nondescript room worthy of it.

title: [Landing Hall, Pantry]
description: Whitewashed walls and a stone floor enclose this small space.  It is kept perfectly clean, and the food all looks fresh and lovingly-prepared.  A vast stone sink in the corner still glistens from its last scrubbing.

title: [Landing Hall, Hall of History]
description: A gold chandelier provides the end of the hallway with abundant light from a cleverly recessed section of the ceiling.  It reveals a large circular room, and astonishingly, the walls have been painted in great detail with modern-day Wehnimer's Landing.  The illusion is effective, making it seem as if the room is placed strategically in the air above Wehnimer's Landing, offering a panoramic view of the entire city.  A large granite statue dominates the center of the room, gazing south.

title: [Solhaven Hall, Atrium]
description: Extending up through the open-air dome, a towering oak tree stands as a focal point in the courtyard, borders of foxglove and hydrangea delineating a path that encircles the keyhole-shaped indoor garden.  Fragrant orange and lemon trees flank the buildings that dot the area.  A two-story edifice looms over one end of the neatly trimmed lawn, and at its base a long pool shimmers in the sunlight.  A silver-gilt gate leads out, a weathered hut just off to one side.

title: [Solhaven Hall, Emporium]
description: Rows of velvet-lined sea chests, varnished rum barrels, and beaded fishing nets showcase a wide variety of goods, while behind rosewood counters, sturdy shelves await restocking.  Along one wall a row of crystal globes illuminate a long painting.  Bustling about the shop, clerks pause briefly to check inventory before returning to the back room.

title: [Solhaven Hall, Larder]
description: Marble counters stretch along two walls, copper cooking utensils littering their surfaces.  Beneath the counters a large circular shelf slowly turns, hiding then revealing an assortment of spice-filled jars, bags of food staples, and canned preserves.  Just above a large basin, rosewood cupboards with etched glass panels display various styles of dinnerware.

title: [Solhaven Hall, The Stumble Inn]
description: Looking more like a lounge than the typical pub, the room is furnished with low divans and thickly cushioned chairs assembled around tables in vague groupings.  Behind a scuffed bar, a mirror reflects the oddly shaped liquor bottles lining the shelves.  Dimly lit by scattered pillar candles, a long mural fills the wall nearest a tiled arch.

title: [Solhaven Hall, Balcony]
description: Extending above the atrium, the balcony provides fresh sea air and an excellent view of the property.  Mezereon shrubs with pale lilac flowers decorate the silver railing that encloses the area.  Marble tiles veined with silver create a spiraling nautilus shell mosaic traversing the length of the terrace.  Wrought-iron chairs huddled in small groups encourage quiet conversation.

title: [Solhaven Hall, Reflecting Pool]
description: Simple cobblestone paths framing a reflecting pool meander south through a sea of crisp, trimmed grass.  An immense structure with a carved obsidian dome looms over the pool.  Shimmering in the sunlight, the pond provides a haven for waterfowl, including the resident swans.

title: [Solhaven Hall, Auditorium]
description: Granite walls punctuated with bas-relief columns support the great obsidian dome.  Rows of chairs separated by an aisle fan out across the floor.  Glass-covered niches hold an array of artifacts, all of them illuminated by the soft light from a multi-tiered chandelier.  A wide, polished stage presides over the elegant space.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Lobby]
description: Streaming through cleverly constructed shafts, pale sunlight filters into the room, complementing the lobby's radiant torches.  Along two of the walls, benches have been masterfully carved from the rock and cushioned with several pillows.  Near each bench rests a stone stand with a flourescent toadstool on it.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Tunnel]
description: A half-dozen torches, some extinguished, line the tunnel walls.  Shadows dance and play along the path in a silent game of tag.  On each side of the tunnel stands a curtained arch, one draped in red and the other in grey.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Meeting Room]
description: A collection of lumpy, well-used cushions lie arranged in a circle atop a dingy rug in the center of the room.  A single torch has been mounted on the back wall, keeping the room dimly lit.  A serving tray, crowded with empty mugs and moldy bread, has been left in the corner.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Mithril Room]
description: Several pillars, carved from the mountain and plated with unpolished mithril, line this vast meeting room.  Heavy wooden benches have been arranged in rows to face a stage in one corner of the room.  Woven tapestries depicting the dwarven arts of forging, mining, and war have been hung with care along the walls.  Fluorescent toadstools have been strategically placed around the room in order to keep the area well lit.

title: [Ancient Passage, Damp Chamber]
description: Raw, unrefined walls ascend towards murk and a silver mist that shrouds the distant ceiling.  Echoing off the stone, the constant sound of dripping water fills the damp air, though its source and origin are difficult to determine.  Tiny tiles spread across the smooth floor to create a sprawling mural that is illuminated by the nearby luminescent toadstool.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Tunnel]
description: A few torches line the tunnel as it winds its way through the mountain.  Fluorescent toadstools have been placed as markers for the location of a dark oak door and a heavy pine door.  A rhythmic dripping sound echoes from deeper within the tunnel.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Tunnel]
description: To the northwest, the tunnel slopes down towards a dimly lit lake, while to the northeast it inclines gently upward.  A little more light can be seen to the south.  The walls are wet with the sheen of water, which flows towards the northwestern tunnel.  A round door is set into the east wall, a small sign hanging from it.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Store]
description: Smooth shelves have been carved into the wall behind a small desk.  Three large modwir chests have been placed along the northern wall, each sitting upon an oily rug.  Torches have been mounted near the store's entrance, keeping the room brightly lit.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Lake]
description: Fluorescent toadstools glow all around the lake, offering a dim view of the area.  Adding to the beauty of the pool, several gems located both in the walls and under the water sparkle in the light of the fungi.  Ripples appear and fade mysteriously across the water's surface.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Forest Room]
description: In this room, a deliberate effort has been made to satisfy elven tastes.  Purple cushions made from imported silk have been haphazardly heaped upon carved wooden benches.  Various forms of flora droop in pots scattered randomly about the room.

title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Iron Room]
description: Torches and toadstools alike have been placed around this meeting room in order to keep it well lit.  In each corner of the room rests a set of polished iron armor upon a stand, and expertly forged shields hang along the far wall.  A long, broad table covered with documents rises from the floor in the center of the room.  A large oak chair stands at the head of the table, while several shorter stone chairs have been neatly arranged along the sides.

title: [Zul Logoth, Brew 'n' Chew]
description: The smooth stone bar stretches across the length of the room.  Stools and chairs of various shapes and sizes line the bar, offering the perfect view of the rack holding the liquor selection.  A dark kitchen is just barely visible through a low doorway.

title: [Zul Lugoth Hall, Kitchen]
description: Given the lack of light in this kitchen, the quality of the food prepared here is somewhat suspect.  A stone counter runs the full length of one wall, with a sink cut into it at one end.  The floor is wet, though whether that is from recent washing or permanent dankness, it is impossible to tell.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Stairway]
description: Short flagstone steps curve east to north from the hall's entrance and widen significantly as they drop to the floor of an expansive refectory.  Four statues, depicting a sand devil, a siren lizard, a thrak, and a pyrothag, rest upon heavy bronze pedestals set back into the smooth, grey stone walls on either side.  Yellow-green light filters from above and below, dimly lighting the stairway as it reflects off the walls.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Refectory]
description: Occupants of the hall move in and out, tasting the many delicacies offered on a trio of massive, short-legged tables that extend the full width of this cavernous hexagonal room.  Four archways provide entrance to the meeting chambers, from whence the perpetual sounds of debate and discussion can be heard.  Drinks are served at a bar to the east and a small shop resides through a low passage under the main stairway.  To the west, an alcove has been cut into the rough, grey stone wall.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Commissary]
description: Walls of rough grey stone are lined with low, hardwood shelves filled with items for purchase.  A pair of softly glowing orbs keeps the shop adequately lit and draws attention to some invar-banded barrels placed against the back wall.

title: [Chamber of Polemics]
description: A multi-hued glaes floor spans the entire width of this room with the exception of two raised platforms carved from pure obsidian.  Blackened stone podiums rise from the platforms, facing each other from either side of the chamber.  Eight curved benches of solid ebonwood, padded with layers of siren lizard hide, have been positioned near the podiums so that audiences may listen and participate.  A heavy glaes footstool rests beside either podium.

title: [Chamber of Amity]
description: Numerous treaties, messages, journal entries and other artifacts of one culture meeting with another cover the four smooth stone walls of this otherwise undecorated meeting hall.  A vast hardwood table bound with heavy strips of glaes extends outward from the northern wall and ends near the chamber's entrance, resting upon thick legs of grey-blue marble.  Chairs and stools of every conceivable size are scattered over a fine carpet of woven glaes mesh.

title: [Chamber of Accordance]
description: Ornate thrones rest upon a semicircular platform of solid black glaes in the northwest corner.  Three concave walls of rough grey and black marble rise fluidly from the floor and meet at a point overhead, giving the room a rounded pyramid shape.  The dim light from the yellow-green orbs mounted on stands reflects off the polished marble floor.

title: [Chamber of Retention]
description: A massive mother-of-pearl sphere has been set halfway into the pentangular floor, which is formed from a fathomless slab of translucent black glaes that reflects the yellow-green light emanating from the clear glaes orbs mounted in each corner of the room.  Black, white and grey marbles intertwine to form the walls in a chaotic display.  Smooth seats with low armrests have been carved directly into the stone.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Alcove]
description: Chairs and benches are arranged around a pair of glowing orbs mounted on either side of the curved grey stone wall that forms this spacious alcove.  Intricate engravings have been carved into the wall, depictions of dwarven history from begining to present.  A section of wall remains blank, awaiting its time for the hammer and chisel.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Miner's Mug]
description: A stout bar of solid grey stone topped with a thick slab of dark basalt extends from one side of the room to the other.  The polished steel face of an enormous war hammer hanging over the bar gleams in the yellow-green light.  At the northern end of the bar, a swinging door leads to the kitchen.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Kitchen]
description: Dwarven cooks mumble curses at the fires they work with to finish the many entrees constantly being prepared.  One cook wipes his forehead with a damp towel and tells a fledgling chef to take over at the grill.  The combined smells of all the food being cooked here is nearly overwhelming.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Basalt Table]
description: A massive section of basalt, nearly half a foot thick, rests upon a squat silvery mithril pedestal.  The oval shape of the table is accented by a clear glaes edge that glows a tranquil yellow-green, complementing the light trickling through the curtained archway.  Stools crafted from native hardwood are stained black and reinforced with heavy strips of mithril.

title: [Sloop, Ocean Voyage]
description: Towering overhead, a cylindrical mast stretches into the sky, a collared iron brace resting every ten feet up its length.  The full, white sails are stained from top to bottom and bleached white again.  On opposite sides of the deck, waist-high wooden railings prevent crew members from spilling overboard.

title: [Wool Table]
description: A green, woolen tablecloth covers the table.  A small vase of fresh daisies sits in the center of the round table.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Cotton Table]
description: A blue, cotton tablecloth embroidered about the edges with a floral pattern covers the table here.  A fish bowl, the home to three goldfish, rests in the center of the oval table.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Canvas Table]
description: A gray piece of canvas covers this rectangular table.  The canvas is well weathered and shows the signs of many a sloppy dinner and many a spilled drink.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Felt Table]
description: Brown felt covers the top of this large, square table.  A clear glass decanter sits in the center of the table, filled with multi-colored sands.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Silk Table]
description: A beautiful piece of red silk covers this table, flowing almost elegantly over the edges of the round top.  Closer inspection reveals many snags and piling in the once fine silk.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Burlap Table]
description: A piece of burlap is thrown sloppily over the tabletop here.  Small burn holes and cuts from knives dot the burlap, showing the oak table underneath.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Fern Table]
description: A small, potted fern sits in the center of this round table.  The fern is lush and healthy, obviously very well looked after.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Hyacinth Table]
description: A vase of freshly cut hyacinths sits in the center of this round table.  The hyacinths are very fresh and healthy, obviously cut very recently.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Rose Table]
description: A vase of freshly cut red roses sits in the center of this square table.  The roses are very fresh and healthy, and the thorns have been removed.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Lilac Table]
description: A vase of freshly cut lilacs sits in the center of this oval table.  The lilacs are very fresh and fragrant, and a bee that has wandered into the common room buzzes from bloom to bloom.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Daffodil Table]
description: A vase of freshly cut daffodils sits in the center of this rectangular table.  The daffodils are very fresh and healthy, obviously cut very recently.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Cactus Table]
description: A small, potted cactus sits in the center of this round table.  The cactus is potted in sandy soil, requiring little water.  The thorns of the cactus bristle out menacingly, threatening to poke any careless patrons.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Apple Table]
description: A large, round bowl of big, red apples sits in the center of this oval table.  The apples are fresh and undamaged, obviously a local product from nearby.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Orange Table]
description: A large, round bowl of oranges sits in the center of this square table.  The oranges are very fresh and fill the area with the smell of citrus.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Banana Table]
description: A large, oval basket of bright yellow bananas sits in the center of this rectangular table.  The bananas are fresh and show no signs of browning, obviously a local product from nearby.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Lemon Table]
description: A deep, round basket of bright yellow lemons sits in the center of this round table.  The lemons are very fragrant, causing a pleasant, lemon scent to drift on the air.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Lime Table]
description: A deep, round basket of bright green limes sits in the center of this round table.  The limes are very fragrant, causing a tangy lime scent to drift on the air.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Strawberry Table]
description: A large, glass bowl of strawberries sits in the center of this square table.  The strawberries are very fresh and fill the area with their aroma.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Pebbles Table]
description: A sealed, glass decanter filled with hundreds of pebbles sits at the center of this round table.  The pebbles are of dozens of different sizes, shapes, and colors, making a very interesting centerpiece.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Marbles Table]
description: A sealed, glass decanter filled with hundreds of marbles sits at the center of this oval table.  The marbles are of dozens of different colors, some opaque and some clear with flecks or patterns of colors inside.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Sand Table]
description: A sealed, glass decanter filled with layers of different colored sands sits at the center of this square table.  The sands are layered, giving the illusion of a small desert landscape unfurling behind the glass.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Coins Table]
description: A sealed, glass decanter filled with hundreds of old coins sits at the center of this round table.  The coins are of different sizes, shapes, and metals, but are all out of use and basically worthless, making a very interesting, if not valuable, centerpiece.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Buttons Table]
description: A sealed, glass decanter filled with hundreds of buttons sits at the center of this rectangular table.  The buttons bring to mind visions of overstuffed halflings, bellies popping from their vests after a third dinner for the evening.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Clasps Table]
description: A sealed, glass decanter filled with dozens of clasps sits at the center of this oval table.  The clasps are of dozens of different sizes and colors, some being better for closing a cloak, and others better for fancy gowns.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Dog Table]
description: A carved, wooden dog has been nailed to the center of this otherwise unadorned oval table.  The dog is curled up in a ball, lying with a paw covering his nose.  The carving is so poorly done that the dog is only barely identifiable.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Rolton Table]
description: A carved, wooden rolton has been nailed to the center of this otherwise unadorned rectangular table.  The rolton is foaming at the mouth and a frozen snarl dominates the small wooden face.  The carving is so poorly done that the rolton is only barely identifiable.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Dragon Table]
description: A carved, wooden dragon has been nailed to the center of this otherwise unadorned oval table.  The dragon is perched on a small rock outcropping, surveying the surrounding area.  The carving is so poorly done that the dragon is only barely identifiable.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Kobold Table]
description: A carved, wooden kobold has been nailed to the center of this otherwise unadorned round table.  The kobold is brandishing a short sword menacingly, and a small crown can be made out on its tiny head.  The carving is so poorly done that the kobold is only barely identifiable.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

title: [Thing Table]
description: A carved, wooden...thing...has been nailed to the center of this otherwise unadorned square table.  The thing seems to have arms, but one could be a tail, or maybe an ear.  The carving is so poorly done that the subject is not identifiable.  Wooden chairs sized for all races surround the table.

Along the hallway, heavy golden velvet curtains allow entrance to private booths where one can access a personal locker.  Candles burn steadily in brass candleholders spaced evenly along the hallway's walnut walls, casting a dim but consistent illumination throughout the corridor.

title: [Sloop, Ocean Voyage]
description: The billowing white sail overhead has been patched and repaired so many times it resembles a quilt more than a singular piece of cotton canvas.  A narrow maoral railing fixed with intermittent steel handholds runs the length of the well-oiled deck, which is largely free from clutter aside from a pair of tarnished cannons, a pile of heavy cannonballs, and several rough maoral crates stacked near the bow.

description: Boxes bearing stamps from virtually everywhere are stacked to dangerous heights in a seemingly haphazard manner.  The boxes have been pushed aside here, making room to proceed both north and south.  To the east, a curtained opening occludes a small alcove.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workshop]
description: The surface of the workbench against the wall is covered with nicked and worn green baize.  Small files, golvern rasps, and metal drills are hung on racks on the rear wall.  A pair of oil lamps hung above the table provide bright, even illumination.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Locker Booth]
description: You are standing in a cramped room filled with short stacks of lockers.  One of these lockers has been removed for you and placed on a tiny wooden counter.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workbench]
description: You seat yourself at a nicked and scarred workbench lit by a pair of polished brass lanterns.  A shelf over the bench contains neatly arranged rows of highly crafted locksmithing tools and raw materials.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workbench]
description: A lamp suspended above the cleared workspace provides plentiful light, and an assortment of tools and materials are neatly arranged on the bench and wall racks.

title: [Rogue Guild, Toolbench]
description: A long maple bench fills the center of the room, stretching nearly from wall to wall.  A single stool sits on the far side of the toolbench, which is covered with a mix of scrap metals and a variety of half-completed tools.

title: [Rooftop, Cubbyhole]
description: Dozens of boxes lay stacked in this cramped interior.  Glancing over them you see they are labeled to different ports of call around Elanthia.  Dubiously diverted from their proper destination, they now sit in storage until the town constable has moved on to more pressing business, or at least accepted a few donations.

description: A single sconce illuminates the chamber, but doesn't provide much in the way of light.  This looks to be a very good spot to quietly reflect or ponder on things.

title: [Warrior Guild, Pugilist Arena]
description: At the center of this amphitheater is a pugilist ring.  Narrow steps lead between the benches, down to the ringside.  The benches here would give you the best perspective on the action in the ring.

title: [Warrior Guild, Pugilist Ring]
description: The ring is actually a square with short, padded pillars strung with gold-flecked ropes.  Fresh sand is scattered on the canvas floor to keep blood-stains to a minimum.

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Inlet]
description: A ruby-toned velvet runner protects the polished dark glaes hallway that transitions into a narrow stairway outfitted with an elaborately silverworked banister.  The steep ascension ends at a well-appointed landing decorated with some blooming bright sanguine geraniums in squared terracotta planters that frame an oversized ebony doorway.
location: Emberglaes Hearth, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Parlor]
description: Elevated, silver-grey stone walls encompass the spacious parlor, rising all the way up to an oak-beamed, vaulted ceiling.  Rainbow glaes panels hang from corner to corner on the back wall, the rich colors highlighting a veniom-inset glass case situated near a burnished vultite display plaque.  The heart of the room holds a tufted dark leather couch that rests before a wide-mantled pale limestone hearth adjacent to a pair of tall marble double doors.
location: Emberglaes Hearth, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Kitchen]
description: The warming aromas of drakefern tea and bittersweet chocolate add cozy appeal to the expansive eating area.  A round-bellied cast iron stove, a rectangular steel sink, and a sleek silver-woven bin are spaced evenly apart within the dark granite counters.  A tiger maple butcher block is securely bolted down in front of a hand-turned maoral dining table, allowing hosts the chance to interact with guests while cooking.  A narrow stairway nearly mirrors the same upward ascension of a flight of steps opposite of their placement on the back wall.
location: Emberglaes Hearth, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Bed Chamber]
description: Aligned directly across from an invar-framed picture window, an enormous four-poster feather bed is grazed with hints of moonlight that drift in through the wide glass panes.  Suspended from the ceiling, a six-tiered rainbow glaes chandelier casts kaleidoscopic colors across the fiery crimson damask bedding that is piled with satin cushions and thick furs.  Obscured on a far wall, a set of obsidian-inlaid stairs is fixed next to a roll-top carved mahogany desk.

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Vanity]
description: The modestly sized side room is accented by a trio of stained glass lancet windows that drench the pale mistwood floors in jewel-like colors.  Filigreed bronze sconces gently light a mosaic-inset ebony vanity that is partially concealed by a latticework black ash divider.  A carmine brocaded silk chaise sits on the adjacent wall next to a ruby-shelved tea cart, above which hangs a scrollworked crystalline mirror.
location: Emberglaes Hearth, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Solar]
description: An oversized oriel glass window brightly illuminates the room with moonlight, the silvery gold glow bathing the space in a suffused warmth.  The far corners are home to a luxurious sleighbed dressed in obsidian black silk linens and a claw-footed red cedar chest.  Arranged in a separate vignette, a milky white marble wash basin is cradled in a tall ebonwood stand, with some amenities within reach under a mirrored fel cabinet.

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Observatory]
description: Abruptly, the obsidian-inlaid stairs open to a wide-ranging room that has an austere design but is richly outfitted with finely wrought finishings.  Protected on an exceptionally well-lit side, a lustrous smoked glass worktable sits in front of some towering acacia koa bookshelves that are brimming with leather-bound books and study materials.  A gilded staircase leads up to a raised platform, haloed by a sheer, glass-domed cupola that is supported by thin beams of veil iron.

title: [Enemy Ship, Main Deck]
description: Across some debris, the main deck stretches out in both directions, from the bow to the stern of this massive warship, the wide oak planks gleaming in the moonlight a sail billows from a mast above the entrance to the cargo hold below, while a crows nest can be spotted high above.  The bulkheads are lined with cannons facing ports fitted with wooden hatches.

title: [Enemy Ship, Helm]
description: The mizzenmast towers over a captstan, its large wooden drum wound with thick hemp rope and ready to be turned.  Some paces behind a wheel, the pathway leading to a wooden door is impeded by a jumble of fishing nets and an overturned launch boat.  A pair of fishing poles lean against a thick teak post on which hangs the recently polished ships bell.

title: [Enemy Ship, Quarters]
description: A map hangs above a bed situated near a window that runs the breadth of the stern, the view of the sea beyond superior to any painting hanging on the cherry-paneled walls of this well appointed cabin.  The nautical charts strewn across a table tell the ships history at sea, while the details are all recorded in the log books stacked on a chair.  A large sea chest occupies one corner, a lock securing its contents inside.

At the head of a table strewn with sea charts, a chair is afforded an uninterrupted view out of a glass-paned window spanning the width of the stern to the seas beyond.  A map and a stack of logbooks lie on the freshly swept deck at the foot of a bed.  A driftwood trunk packed with clothing and books sits open next to an ornate ivory and gold music stand.

Freshly made with clean linens, a bed stretches out beneath a clear glass-paned window at the rear of the cabin.  A lantern flickers atop a table stacked with books, empty teacups, and nautical charts.  A map is framed upon a cherry paneled wall above a chair, its seat occupied by a three-legged tabby cat.

Luxuriously appointed with plush carpets over a polished teak floor, the cabin is well lit by gilded brass sconces set with beeswax candles.  The curtains are drawn back from an expansive, glass-paned window, allowing the sunlight to spill across a bed and onto a table and a chair nearby.  A map is stuck to a teak-paneled wall by a dagger driven in almost to the hilt.

Sunlight filters through a large, glass-paned window, illuminating a map spread out on a table in the center of the cabin.  A logbook lies open on a bed near a chair piled with freshly laundered garments.  Nautical charts are tacked to the oak-paneled walls, all scribbled with illegible handwriting, one drawn with a giant sea monster.

Wrought iron lanterns sway overhead, the dancing flames casting light on a chair positioned behind a table, laden with charts, logbooks, and a map.  A bed is made up beneath an expansive window, the view interrupted by a dangling rope with bucket in hand to clean the glass panes.  A forgotten astrolabe lies near the door.

title: [Enemy Ship, Cargo Hold]
description: Ropes strung through staples in the deck hold kegs and barrels in place against the bulkhead, while shelves are stocked with sails, wood, and lines.  Chests filled with supplies are stacked tightly leaving just enough space to maneuver between rows.  Livestock pens are located beneath the ladder leading back up to the main deck.

title: [Enemy Ship, Crow's Nest]
description: Far above the main deck, higher than the top of the yards of fabric sails, a platform encircling the main mast looks out over the ship and to the sea beyond.  A spyglass hangs from a length of knotted leather cord tied to the narrow railing.  Carved into the wooden trapdoor in the platform is a detailed kraken, a broken ship wrapped in its suckered tentacles.

title: [Enemy Ship, Mid Deck]
description: Attached to a yard on a mast, a sail billows overhead, casting shadows on the wide-planked deck.  Ropes crisscross back and forth, the intricate arrangement reminiscent of a perfectly laid out spiderweb.  Smaller launch boats hang in cradles above both port and starboard sides, raised above rows of cannons.

title: [Enemy Ship, Bow]
description: Staring down from the foremost part of the ship, the prow gives view to the maidenhead fixed to the sharply slanted bowsprit.  A seagull sits perched on the railing, fixed with curious gaze.  Hewn from a single piece of timber, the foremast soars above the deck, a pennant fluttering at its peak.

title: [Enemy Ship, Crow's Nest]
description: Near the top of the foremast, a basket has been mounted between the topgallant sail and the fore topsail which serves as the chief observation post onboard.  Outfitted with a swivel-mounted spyglass on the brass railing, theres only room for one lookout.  Rope ladders lead through a hatch in the floor back down to the main deck.

title: [Enemy Ship, Forward Deck]
description: The shrouds rising up a mast beyond the utmost a sail pass a lookout post that appears minuscule from this vantage point.  A length of sailcloth hangs over the railing, while several mops and buckets are pushed out of the way against the bulkhead.  The complicated rigging is attached to elaborate belaying pins along the ships railing above some cannons.

title: [Enemy Ship, Main Deck]
description: Beneath a single mast the freshly swabbed wooden planking, stretching from the fore to the quarter deck, glints in the moonlight.  Large coils of hemp rope are neatly stacked between some cannons on either side of the main deck, while the sail snaps in the salty seabreeze overhead.  A rusty knife protrudes from the railing next to some debris.

title: [Enemy Ship, Helm]
description: In the shadows cast from the thick canvas sails overhead, a grey-backed seagull perches atop a wooden wheel, noisily munching on a potato peel scavenged from the crew's previous meal.  Across from a wooden door leading to the Captain's Quarters is a capstan, the drum wound with thick, braided hemp rope.  Large nets cling to pegs on the ship's railings, all empty save for a waterlogged boot with teethmarks on its toe.

description: Not much more than a basket at the top of the main mast, a small opening in the railing gives way to a rope ladder leading to the deck below. The remains of a tattered flag holding on by one corner flutters in the breeze.

title: [Enemy Ship, Main Deck]
description: A sail hanging from a mast casts a large shadow across some debris, while rigging creates a dark, web-like pattern across the planks of the main deck. A dagger-pierced parchment on the door proclaims, "ENTER AT YOUR OWN RISK!"

description: Crates and barrels fill the cargo hold, all the supplies a crew might need for a long journey.  A few treasure chests fastened with heavy locks are partially concealed underneath the stairs leading up onto the deck.  Piles of sailcloth and tangled nets have been left here for mending.

title: [Enemy Ship, Crow's Nest]
description: From high atop the main mast, a platform enclosed by a wooden railing serves as a lookout point.  Rope ladders attached to either side of the landing wind their way through billowy sails to the main deck below.  A brass spyglass dangles from a length of leather cord attached to the mast for safe keeping.

title: [Enemy Ship, Forward Deck]
description: A sail snaps in the breeze above some cannons lined up on each side of the deck, while a crewman swabs the deck, cleaning up loose powder and keeping the area shipshape.  High above a mast, a crow's nest is visible through the moving sailcloth.

title: [Enemy Ship, Main Deck]
description: The main deck is outfitted with some cannons on either side.  Ratlines ascend upwards to the crows nest attached to a mast, a pennant fluttering above a sail. description: Burlap sacks weighted with grains, coffee, and sugar are lashed to the bulkheads behind nets of hemp rope, keeping them dry and out of the way.  Oaken barrels are stacked to the ceiling, each branded with a makers mark identifying the various spirits within.  An assortment of crates waiting to be organized sits at the ramp leading up out of the cargo hold.

title: [Enemy Ship, Crow's Nest]
description: Situated high above the deck and the shrouds of the mast, a simple platform is afforded the best view on the ship.  Through an open trapdoor, rope ladders sway in the breeze, the only means of escape to the main deck below.  A shiny brass spyglass is swivel-mounted to the narrow railing surrounding the crows nest.

title: [Enemy Ship, Forward Deck]
description: On both sides of the large, open deck, some cannons point toward ports, each fitted with a wooden hatch.  A mast fitted with a sail extends from the bottom of the ship skyward, a crows nest near its top barely visible from this angle.  The sound of the ships bell echoes, signaling a change of watch.

title: [Enemy Ship, Bow]
description: Up the ladder from the main deck, a beak-like projection from the bow fitted with a long, sharp bowsprit is visible looking over the railing at the foredeck.  The privy can be seen from here, under the shadow of the foremast.

title: [Enemy Ship, Main Deck]
description: A bronze bell rings out the half-hour of the watch beneath the sail fastened to mast towering overhead.  Down a steep companionway, a pair of crewmen roll barrels into the cargo hold, while a cabin boy emerges from below juggling an armload of cannonballs to replenish the munitions alongside some cannons on deck.  A section of rigging has snapped loose above some debris, the rope whipping back and forth in the constant breeze.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, down

title: [Enemy Ship, Helm]
description: A woodworking masterpiece, a wooden wheel is positioned behind a polished teak binnacle, the housing for the ship's compass, with a capstan bringing up the rear of the deck at the ship's helm.  A cabin girl slips out of a wooden door carrying a tray weighed down with with a gleaming silver tea service, and a few cookie crumbs are all that remain on the empty saucers.  The sound of the ship's bell signals the next watch change.
