title: [Enemy Ship, Cargo Hold]
description: Steel-banded oak barrels are stacked one on top of the other and made fast against the bulkhead.  Bags labeled coffee, tea, and flour are secured in place with web-like ropes, one of the bags torn open at one corner and spilling its fragrant black leaves to the salt-encrusted planks underfoot.  A large driftwood chest is thrown open, the sunlight glinting off a handful of gold coins inside.

title: [Enemy Ship, Crow's Nest]
description: Mounted up high on the main mast, a small teak platform encircled by a slender brass railing serves as an observation deck.  Underfoot, a trapdoor opens up to a ladder of ropes, the ratlines a complicated maze of knotted hemp.  A one-eyed black crow perches on a swivel-mounted spyglass, the brass instrument etched with sinuous kraken.

title: [Enemy Ship, Forward Deck]
description: A seated, cross-legged crewman dozes at the foot of the towering mast, shadowed by sail rippling in the constant seabreeze.  Far overhead, a tiny halfling clutching a brass spyglass in his teeth clambers up the rigging towards the crows nest for the next watch.  A wheel from the carriage underneath some cannons lies on the wide-planked deck, awaiting repairs.

title: [Widowmaker's Road, Rapids]
description: Freshly hewn logs speed down the waters as they splash against the edge.  A small slippery platform extends out over the waters offering a place to attempt to jump onto the speeding projectiles.  A large warning sign is set precariously next to the rapids.

title: [Rapids]
description: The rapids wrap sinuously down the embankments that contain it.  Small whirlpools churn alongside the sporadic rocks that line the shore, and a large tree looms over the rapids, its branches void of life.

title: [Rapids]
description: Small waves crash into jagged rocks protruding from the surface of the water.  The shore narrows, drastically increasing the pace of the water for short waterfall-like drops.  The foliage grows denser overhead, tropical fronds mixed with the dense trees.

title: [Rapids]
description: Crashing to the right and left, the water divides itself around a small sandbar.  Vines are visible in the distance hanging from a thick branch.  Broken logs line the sandbar, split asunder by the force of the rapids.

title: [Rapids]
description: The rapids careen toward the logging colony below.  Offering a glimpse of a tropical beach, an opening is visible to the side of the rapids.  A thick branch looms overhead with a single vine that may reach the opening.

title: [Widow's Beach, Seashell Path]
description: Lush tropical foliage fades into white sands edged with tall coconut trees, and a narrow, lightly trodden path lined with seashells curves down the beach.  Barely visible amidst the dense greenery, a small vine-draped opening provides the only penetration deeper into the verdure, the sound of rapidly running water emanating from the other side.

Lush tropical foliage fades into white sands edged with tall coconut trees.  A narrow, lightly-trodden path curves down the beach lined with seashells.  The sound of running water can be heard on the other side of a dense opening.

title: [Kraken's Fall, River]
description: Framing the cliff, stockade fences and a man-made dam collect the churning waters of the rapidly moving river and pool them into a deep reservoir.  Platforms stretch from the western banks, each fitted with long-armed hooks designed to collect the tumbling and spinning logs that bump up and down within the water.  Long ruts in the muddy track display the history of log removal, while splattered boards across the pathway provide firm footing.

title: [Widow's Beach, Driftwood's Rest]
description: Seashells tumbled smooth speckle the soft white sand of the expansive beach, and wavelets move rhythmically in and out along the shore.  Isolated just beyond the water's reach, a driftwood log rests next to a small pile of broken crab shells.
Seashells tumbled smooth crest the soft white sand.  Small waves move rhythmically in and out along the shore down the beach.  A driftwood log rests isolated just outside of the water's reach.

title: [Widow's Beach, Palm's Inlet]
description: Small inlets of crystal blue water run inland along carved troughs, vanishing into the tropical foliage, and pieces of driftwood pepper the white sands closest to the shore.  A lush green coconut palm arches over the beach until it is almost touching the water, anchored solidly by its thick, shaggy trunk.

Small inlets of crystal-blue water run inland along carved troughs, vanishing into the tropical foliage.  Small pieces of driftwood pepper the white sands below.  A lush green coconut tree arches over the beach until it is almost touching the water, its thick trunk the only thing holding it back.

title: [Widow's Beach, Sharks' Point]
description: A damp sandbar twists its way into the water heading out to a semiformed land mass, and the foliage of the shoreline juts outward, blocking the path further down the beach.  A collection of jagged rocks protrudes from the water, each sharper than the last.

A moist sandbar twists its way into the water heading out to a semi-formed land mass, and the foliage of the shoreline juts outward, blocking the path further down the beach.  A collection of jagged rocks protrudes from the water, each sharper than the last.

title: [Widow's Beach, Sandbar]
description: The sandbar continues outward, the way at times partially submerged and treacherous.  Attempting to thrive in their mostly moist environment, assorted plants thrust upwards toward the sky.  A large atoll crests the waterline in the distance.

The sandbar continues outward, sometimes partially submerged, sometimes above the water.  Assorted plants attempting to thrive in their mostly moist environment stand upright.  A large atoll crests the waterline in the distance.

title: [Widow's Beach, Sandbar]
description: The sandbar branches off in multiple directions, each path twisting and changing with the tide, the water no longer able to reach the centermost point of the sand.  Positioned in the center is a large ivory white boulder, its surface partially reflecting light.

The sandbar opens up into multiple directions, each path twisting and changing with the tide, the water no longer able to reach the centermost point of the sand.  Positioned in the center is a large, ivory boulder, its polished surface partially reflecting light.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Widow's Beach, Atoll Path]
description: Dark stones and white sands spread scross smaller rocks to create a path leading northerly toward the atoll, with the center point of the sandbar immediately to the southeast.  Barely discernible in the distance, the beach's bordering greenery is outlined against the sky.  The front of a small rowboat's skeleton rests at the edge of the water, its occupants long gone.

Dark stones and white sands spread across smaller rocks to create a path leading toward the atoll, the center point of the sandbar just ahead and the beach barely visible in the distance.  The front of a small rowboat's skeleton rests at the edge of the water, its inhabitants long gone.

title: [Widow's Beach, Sandbar]
description: The sandbar abruptly ends here, and piles of rocks loosely pushed together form a bridge continuing onward.  Waves snake through the rockpiles as they roll to and from the beach, creating tiny, white-capped swirls.  Strange, cylindrical pillars of carved stone are positioned as handholds along the uneven path.

The sandbar suddenly stops, and piles of rocks loosely pushed together form a bridge continuing onward.  The waves running down the beach snake through the rocks as they roll by.  Strange, cylindrical pillars of carved stone are positioned as hand holds along the uneven path.

title: [Widow's Beach, Rocky Bridge]
description: Loosely pushed together rockpiles form a narrow bridge between sandbar and shore.  Thick bands of amber-hued sand on the ocean floor act as braces for the rocky bridge, the water darkening visibly as it passes beneath.  At either end of the long and precarious pathway, white sands glimmer in the ambient light.

Thick bands of amber-hued sands are visible in the water, each acting as a brace for the rocky path.  The water darkens visibly as it passes through this part of the bridge.  White sands are visible just ahead.

title: [Widow's Beach, Atoll Path]
description: As the water flows in and out, the sand shifts, occasionally revealing glowing runes upon a hard surface.  The near-constant fluctuation of wave and sand make it impossible to determine the nature of either the material hidden beneath the sands or its lambent symbols.  A sandbar is visible to the southwest, and a precarious bridge of rockpiles leads southeasterly.  The sand levels out, creating a path heading straight for the atoll, the lush tropical foliage of the beach retreating in the distance.

As the water shifts in and out, glowing runes are visible along a much harder surface beneath the sand.  The sand levels out as the path heads straight for the atoll, the once lush tropical foliage of the beach now gone from view.

title: [Widow's Beach, Atoll Path]
description: The sea encroaches about the dark sand edging the pathway, each swirl of water unsettling loose sand to review glimmering runes upon an indeterminate surface.  In the distance, the atoll rises from the waters, an imposing jewel in the ocean's crown.

Dark sand leads up to a pile of rocks, offering a somewhat safe passage ahead.  Glowing runes are visible just beneath the edge of the path, and the atoll in the distance continues to grow in size as the path wends closer.

title: [Widow's Beach, Atoll Path]
description: Jagged dark rocks and compacted sand create a reasonably sturdy path, lined with tall, cylindrical pillars of even darker stone.  The sea collides against both sides of the path, dissipating impotently against the implacable basalt protection.  Far in the distance, a circular stone platform is visible, the atoll looming behind it.

Jagged black rocks form a makeshift bridge leading back toward the beach, and tall cylindrical pillars of even darker stone line the path.  The waves on either side of the path collide with the rocky surface.

title: [Widow's Beach, Atoll Path]
description: The path wends between the sea and a partial wall of jagged, salt-stained stones, a circular platform in the distance.  The sand along the path appears to be arranged in runelike patterns that shift ever so slightly with each wave.

The path twists toward a circular stone platform, and a partial wall made of jagged stones weathers the test of time and the ocean.  The sand appears to be arranged in rune-like patterns that shift ever so slightly with each wave.

title: [Widow's Beach, Stone Platform]
description: A raised stone platform carved into a circle bridges the final expanse between sandbar and atoll to the north.  The water churns maliciously about the platform, breaking across the basalt sides to form white-capped waves that froth back and forth before eventually calming.  A deep rumbling can be heard in the distance, with no source in sight.

A raised stone platform carved into a circle stretches toward the atoll.  The water ahead churns maliciously, each wave capped with white, blending into the water below.  Rumbling can be heard in the distance with no source in sight.

title: [Widow's Beach, Atoll Path]
description: White sand with a smattering of darker pebbles tangles its way into the rock bridge as it ends.  A single palm tree stands tall against the challenges of life and nature.  The path twists closer toward a large atoll.

title: [Atoll, Stone Platform]
description: Dark waters pool against the edges of the atoll and a stone platform, churning against the crystal blue sea further out.  The once white sands are now dark and stained with striations of burn marks.  The air shimmers in rainbow hues toward the center of the atoll.

Dark waters pool against the edges of the atoll, churning against the crystal blue waters further out.  The once white sands are now dark and stained with striations of burn marks.  The air shimmers in rainbow-hues toward the center of the atoll.

title: [Atoll, Ivory Path]
description: Pristine white sand spans the inner and outer rings of the atoll, while a collection of tropical trees rises high overhead, their trunks leaning on one another for support.  Flecks of darker sand glimmer in the pale sand leading to the choppy water of a small inlet.  Randomly placed stepping stones of ivory create an erratic path leading along the atoll's edge.

Pristine white sand stretches from the inner ring and outer ring of the atoll, while a collection of tropical trees rises high overhead, their trunks leaning on one another for support.  Flecks of darker sand accent the edges leading back to the inlet.

title: [Atoll, Ivory Path]
description: The outer ring of the atoll bends inward and upright to form a grotto, the natural stone encompassing its structure worn from repeated exposure to the elements surrounding it.  Ivory blocks edge the path leading around the grotto.

The outer ring of the atoll bends inward and upright to form a grotto.   The natural stone encompassing its structure worn from repeated exposure to the elements surrounding it.  Ivory blocks circle the outside of the path leading around the grotto.

title: [Atoll, Ebon Grotto]
description: A pile of stones operates as a platform for a black crystal embedded in the walls of the grotto.  Inlets of fresh water flow in and out with the ebbing of the tide, and hand-sized swaths spread blackened substance across the walls.

A pile of stones operates as a platform for a black crystal embedded in the walls of the grotto.  Inlets of fresh water flow in and out with the ebbing of the tide, and hand-sized swathes spread blackened substance across the walls.

title: [Atoll, Ivory Path]
description: Rune-carved ivory blocks rest in a neat stack facing the center of the atoll.  The air surrounding the waters within the atoll shifts with motes of alternating light.  Nestled into the side of the blocks is a pair of rodent skeletons, holding each other in death.

Rune-carved ivory blocks rest in a neat stack facing the center of the atoll.  The air surrounding the waters within shifting with motes of alternating light.  Nestled into the side of the blocks are a pair of rodent skeletons, holding each other in death.

title: [Atoll, Obsidian Pathway]
description: A thick gathering of dark trees with spiked branches lines the innermost edges of the atoll, obscuring it from view and blocking access.  Obsidian stepping stones dot the pathway with lackadaisical irregularity, and a long streak of amber-hued sand stretches from path to ocean, its glittering surface rent by enormous claw marks.

A small copse of dark trees with spiked branches blocks the center of the atoll.  Obsidian stepping stones stretch along a path in a lackadaisical fashion, while a long streak of amber-hued sand with large claw marks stretches out toward the ocean.

title: [Atoll, Obsidian Pathway]
description: Dark trees continue along the inward edge of the large atoll.  The terrain shifts upward with a path leading to a grotto cresting the shoreline.  A makeshift wall is built in front of the grotto, its damp surface beaded with fresh droplets of seawater.

The dark trees continue along the inward edge of the large atoll.  The terrain shifts upward with a path leading to a grotto cresting the shoreline.  A makeshift wall is built in front of the grotto, its surface recently wet.

title: [Atoll, Citrine Grotto]
description: Blankets of blackened moss line a small pool in the center of the grotto.  A single skull is nailed to the wall with large iron spikes, a yellow crystal in its mouth.  An abandoned rusted knife is stuck into a piece of driftwood near the entry.

title: [Atoll, Obsidian Pathway]
description: Obsidian stepping stones zig and zag along in a haphazard version of a path, some joined together by an even darker substance of unknown origins.  At the water's edge, a sun-bleached piece of driftwood rests next to shards of salt-stained, shattered obsidian.  A break in the copse of dark trees lining the inner atoll allows a view of the shimmering center point.

Obsidian stepping stones zig and zag along in a haphazard version of a path, with some joined together by an even darker substance, and a break in the copse of dark trees allows a view of the shimmering center point of the atoll.  A sun-bleached piece of driftwood rests against the shoreline.

title: [Atoll, Obsidian Pathway]
description: A collection of seaweed stretches down the almost aimless obsidian path, the water inside the atoll swirling to and fro with a mind of its own.  A humming noise of inexplicable origin can be heard in the distance, its volume rising and falling in counterpoint to the ocean's waves.

A collection of seaweed stretches down the almost aimless obsidian path, the water inside the atoll twisting to and fro with a mind of its own.  A humming noise can be heard in the distance, its origin unknown.

title: [Atoll, Obsidian Pathway]
description: The path widens to accommodate a grotto offering refuge to those who seek it.  A makeshift wall is fashioned out of driftwood, seaweed, and rocks in front of the grotto.  Growing off to one side, a dark tree sapped of life looms over the obsidian path.

The path widens to accommodate a grotto offering refuge to those who seek it.  A makeshift wall is fashioned out of driftwood, seaweed, and rocks in front of the grotto, and growing off to one side, a dark tree sapped of life looms over the obsidian path.

title: [Atoll, Vermilion Grotto]
description: Primitive shapes are carved into the wall, each accented with glowing fungus.  A red crystal rests within a small pool of water in the center of the grotto.  The surrounding air is damp and heavy, making it difficult to breathe.

title: [Atoll, Shattered Shell Shore]
description: Further out to sea, the ocean waters glow a crystal blue, a stark difference to the dark waters surrounding the atoll.  As the terrain widens along the ring of the beach, the obsidian path suddenly narrows, the sand below the consistency of fine gravel stippled with assorted fragments of strange shells.

Further out to sea, the ocean waters glow a crystal blue, a stark difference to the dark waters surrounding the atoll.  The obsidian path suddenly stops as the terrain widens along the ring of the beach, the sand below almost gravel-like with assorted fragments of strange shells.

title: [Atoll, Canopied Path]
description: Two paths converge into one here, ivory stepping stones from the southwest, obsidian from the southeast, creating a narrow, checkered path winding to the south.  The air surrounding the southern path shimmers with distortion, a copse of dark-thorned trees rising along either side to create a canopy overhead.  Skeletons of ships litter the waters of the ocean beyond, each worn from long exposure to weather.

A narrow path leads toward the atoll, the air surrounding it distorted.  A copse of dark-thorned trees crest either side of the path, creating a canopy overhead.  The skeletons of ships litter the waters of the ocean beyond, each worn from long exposure to weather.

title: [Atoll, Ivory Path]
description: Ivory blocks twist back and forth along the atoll, the sand below rough with assorted driftwood, shells, and rocks.  Small hills of sand topped with vibrant green nut grass bespeckle the landscape, a splash of contrast to the dark sands and water.
Ivory blocks twist back and forth along the atoll, the sand below rough with assorted driftwood, shells, and rocks.  Small hills of sand are crested with vibrant green grass.

title: [Atoll, Ivory Path]
description: Ivory blocks are stacked up around a grotto to form a provisional wall.  Tall tropical trees with far-reaching fronds offer shade throughout the area.  Dark and ominous, the ocean waters crash against the shore, and jagged rocks break the sea's surface in sharp, pointed clusters.

Ivory blocks are stacked up around a grotto to form a makeshift wall.  Tall tropical trees with far-reaching fronds offer shade for those nearby, the ocean waters dark and ominous with jagged rocks protruding from the surface.

title: [Atoll, Azure Grotto]
description: Cramped and damp, the grotto offers very little space for activities.  Inlets of water trickle in smaller pathways to the centermost point, forming a pool.  A blue crystal reflects blue light into its surroundings, the air around it humming with energy.

Cramped and damp, the grotto offers very little space for activities.  Inlets of water trickle in smaller pathways to the centermost point, forming a pool.  A blue crystal reflects blue light into its surrounding, the air around it humming with energy.

title: [Atoll, Ivory Path]
description: Several large ships split into multiple sections are crashed against a barely noticeable line of rocks in the water, alternating patches of dark blue and black water surrounding each jagged point.  The ivory path here is stained with an inky black substance.

Several large ships split into multiple sections are crashed against a barely visibly line of rocks in the water.  Alternating patches of dark blue and black waters surround each jagged point, and the ivory path below is stained with an inky black substance.

title: [Atoll, Inner Edge]
description: Ivory and obsidian stones alternate along a path leading up to a yellow barrier.  The air surrounding the barrier ripples and wavers, distorting the ruins just visible on the other side.  Hollowed out stones stained crimson line the barrier, each holding a humanoid skull as a warning to those who enter.

Ivory and obsidian stones alternate along a path leading up to a yellow barrier.  The air surrounding the barrier ripples and wavers, some type of ruins visible on the other side.  A line of humanoid skulls is nailed into the stones beneath them, a warning to those who enter.

wayto.30851: ;e color_moves = {'blue' => 'n,sw,sw', 'black' => 'n,sw,sw,sw,s,se', 'red' => 'n,se,se', 'yellow' => 'n,se,se,se,s,sw'};GameObj.room_desc.find { |o| o.name =~ /(blue|black|yellow|red) barrier/ };color = $1;move_order = color_moves[color].split(',');move_order.each { |w| move(w) };move('go grotto');fput 'touch crystal';move('out');move_order.reverse.each { |w| move(reverse_direction(w)) };move('go barrier')

title: [Ruins, Barrier Dais]
description: Seemingly floating just above the water, this circular dais contains assorted altars positioned around a yellow barrier, each with an offering placed on top.  A profusion of massive stone platforms covered in ruins spread out above the inner lagoon, while the yellow barrier shimmers with light, providing a way back to the atoll.

Massive floating stone platforms are connected by obsidian walkways.  Assorted altars are positioned around the barrier, each with an offering placed on top.  The yellow barrier shimmers with light offering a way back to the atoll.

title: [Ruins, Lower Platform]
description: Set off to one side of this lower platform, a pair of stone chairs rest on either side of a small table.  Tall, flameless torches glow with an eerie light, casting shadows across the obsidian walkways spiraling upwards to more ruin-dotted platforms.
A pair of stone chairs rest on either side of a small table.  Tall flameless torches glow with an eerie light.  The platforms continue upward, spiraling around the ruins.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Ruins, Stone Square]
description: High above the sparkling waters of the atoll, several circular platforms join together at an enormous square platform, each dotted with tiny wattle and stone hovels.  Central to the area sits an elevated stone box, its massive interior filled with rich soil.  A collection of benches surround the box, their dark stone surfaces polished clean.

Several circular platforms are joined together by a larger square platform, each with small hovels lining the edges.  At the center sits a large stone box, raised high and filled with soil.  A collection of benches line the raised box, their surfaces polished clean.

title: [Ruins, Stone Bridge]
description: This narrow stone bridge held aloft by iron-banded pillars offers a gently curving connection point between platforms, while thin rope railings span its entirety.  A carved circular platform rests below, partially submerged in the crystal blue water.

A narrow stone bridge held aloft by iron-banded pillars offers a connection point between platforms, while a thin rope stretches between one end of the bridge to the other.  A carved circular platform rests below, partially submerged in the water.

title: [Ruins, Fountain]
description: A tall stone fountain absent of water presides over the center of the circular platform.  Thin ropes accented with leathery pennants stretch from pillar to pillar.  Broken boxes plundered of their contents are scattered across the stone.

A tall stone fountain absent of water presides in the center of the circular platform.  Thin ropes accented with leathery pennants stretch from pillar to pillar.  Broken boxes plundered of their contents are scattered across the stone.

title: [Ruins, Terrace of Shells]
description: Empty planter boxes are scattered about the platform, stone and driftwood tools resting in piles by each one.  Innumerable shells, not all native to the atoll, line the terrace's edges, arranged by color into a variety of symbols.  Affixed to a sturdy wooden pole, a pristine conch stands ready for use, pointing roughly northeast toward the majority of the ruins.
Raised planter boxes void of soil are scattered throughout the platform, makeshift stone and driftwood tools placed by the edge of each.  A large conch sits on a stick, facing the rest of the ruins.

title: [Ruins, Statues]
description: Situated precisely at the center of the platform, a spacious structure of pristine stonework serves as the primary focal point for the area.  Guarding the structure's entrance are two humanoid stone statues, each brandishing an imposing naginata.  The stones centered between the statues are stained a deep crimson, creating a perfect triangle.

A larger stone hovel presides over a raised platform.  Guarding the entrance of the hovel are two stone statues, each brandishing a tall naginata.  The stones in the center are stained a dark red, creating a triangle on the floor.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south

title: [Ruins, Stairwell]
description: The stone of the pathways and platforms appears freshly cleaned here.  A stairwell leads down to the calm waters of the atoll below, coils of rope flanking either side.

The stone of the pathways and platforms appears freshly cleaned here.  A stairwell leads down into the calm waters of the atoll below, coils of rope stacked neatly on either side at the end of the stairs.

title: [Ruins, Altar Approach]
description: A series of arches lead north toward a slightly raised dais in the center of the ruins.  Originating with something unseen atop the platform, the ground here is stained an unsettling dark red, in stark contrast to the beach visible in the distance with its glistening, white sands.

A series of arches lead north toward a slightly raised platform in the center of the ruins.  Originating with something unseen atop the platform, the ground here is stained an unsettling dark red, in stark contrast to the beach visible in the distance with its glistening white sands.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Ruins, Feasting Terrace]
description: Stone tables flanked by low benches are engraved with intricate runes.  An iron trough runs down the length of every table, all devoid of any contents but bearing dark stains.  The atoll waters below shine a vibrant crystal blue accented with darker blue swirls.

Large stone tables are lined with low stone benches, each accented with intricate runes.  An iron trough runs down the length of each table, devoid of any contents but each bearing dark stains.  The atoll waters below shine a vibrant crystal blue accented with darker blue swirls.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Ruins, Graveyard's View]
description: A carved stone hut with shuttered doors and windows takes up the majority of this platform.  Resting against the hut's side is a pile of humanoid armor, each half-melted.  In the distance, the ship graveyard surrounding the atoll is clearly visible.

A carved stone hut with shuttered doors and windows takes up the majority of this platform.  Resting against the hut's side is a pile of humanoid armor, each half melted for scraps.  In the distance, the ship graveyard surrounding the atoll is clearly visible.

title: [Ruins, Stone Structure]
description: Seaweed placed atop carefully spaced columns creates a roof over a small, three-walled, stone structure perched on one edge of the platform.  Within the structure, a series of beds stacks one on top of the other along the sides, leaving ample room for activities in the center.

Seaweed placed atop carefully spaced columns creates a roof over a small, stone structure.  Within the structure, a series of beds stack one on top of another along the sides, leaving ample room for activities at the center.

title: [Ruins, The Sinuous Stones]
description: Carved stone blocks twine sinuously back and forth in every direction, creating a low-lying labyrinth of sorts.  Along the bottom of an overhanging dais on the north side, rune-incised pillars dangle like stalactites above a collection of fresh fish impaled upon a spear.  The blue-green water of the lagoon below is marred by a spiral of red-tinged debris.

Raised, carved stone twists sinuously back and forth in every direction.  Pillars carved with runes are visible beneath a portion of the platforms, and a collection of mostly fresh fish impaled on a spear sits on the floor.

title: [Ruins, Altar]
description: An altar covered in assorted bones stands imposingly at the center of the dais, undersized, knee-high stools arranged in a semicircle facing it.  Perched on a raised rectangle of stone with three steps leading up, a commanding chair flanked by diminutive tables overlooks the altar.  A stone mug rests on one table, and a pair of jagged stone knives sit on the other, their blades stained vermilion.

A raised altar covered in assorted bones is in the center of the circular platform.  Small, knee-height stools sit in a semi-circle facing its surface.  A larger stool overlooks the altar with small tables on either side of it.

title: [Ruins, Parapet Approach]
description: The edge of the platform is reinforced with tall, rectangular blocks, each carved with a different rune.  A set of stone steps leads north to a raised, circular terrace.  Set off to the side is an abandoned pile of wood.

The edge of the platform is reinforced with tall rectangular blocks, each carved with a different rune.  A set of stone steps leads north to a raised platform.  Set off to the side is an abandoned pile of wood.

title: [Ruins, Terrace of Runes]
description: Stained with a sticky red substance, the stone platform is covered in runes.  Terraced outer edges hold numerous racks of weaponry and armor, each level covered in chiseled symbols and markings.  A stone pillar sits at the exact center, its base wider than its top.

Racks of weapons line the edge of the platform paired with suits of armor.  The stone platform is covered in runes stained with red substance.  A stone pillar sits in the center of the platform, its base wider than its top.

title: [Ruins, Stone Parapets]
description: Parapetlike carved stone accents the edges of the circular terrace.  Small crystals are positioned on top of each parapet, humming with energy.  A pair of stone stools offer respite for those on watch.
Parapet-like carved stone accents the edges of the platform.  Small crystals are positioned on top of each parapet, humming with energy.  A pair of stone stools offer respite for those on watch.

title: [Ruins, Terrace of Cages]
description: Piles of cages strung with thick ropes border the platform, the rest of its expanse covered in petite huts.  Each hut is just large enough to fit a single bed, and some are adorned with odd bits of sinew, bone, seaweed, or shells.

A pile of cages affixed with thick ropes lines the edges of the platform, the rest of its expanse covered in small huts.  Each small hut is just large enough to fit a single bed, and some are adorned with odd bits of sinew, bone, seaweed, or shells.  The pathway widens as it returns to the central platform of the ruins.

title: [Guild Grounds, Clearing]
description: Rising high into the verdant canopy, an enormous mangrove tree occupies the center of the area, causing the crushed cinnamon bark path to bow out and around its girth.  Spindled roots rise away from the monstrosity and create looping arches through which trailing vines cling.  The faint scent of loam mingles with cinnamon to create an earthy, fresh aroma.

title: [Ranger Guild, Teak Tree Grove]
description: Abundant varieties of fruit trees, from figs to guavas to bananas to carambola, jumble themselves together, their branches intertwining in a slow arboreal dance.  Taller than their productive cousins, wide teak trees break through the crowd and tower over the area in glorious branching crowns.

title: [Ranger's Guild, Entrance]
description: Huge and hollow, the inside of the tree is also almost entirely empty.  A simple small table constructed from an old tree stump sits in the center of the trunk.  Spiraling around the inside of the trunk, a narrow staircase leads upwards further than the dim light reaches.

title: [Ranger's Guild, Entryway]
description: Round and spacious, the wide spiral staircase ends at a large wooden landing high inside the tree.  Below, the faint glow of a lantern can be seen only as a small point of light.  Roughly cut openings to the northwest and southwest lead to rope bridges and further into the guild.

title: [Ranger Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Centered against the northern wall, a small podium stands alone.  A collection of small carpet squares, woven from a variety of materials, cover the floor through the rest of the room, providing comfortable seating for meetings.

title: [Ranger Guild, Master's Office]
description: Four thick boards edge the floor, creating a box in the center of the room.  Neatly trimmed grass grows inside the large square, providing a uniform, green flooring.  Centered on the turf, a low teak table sits with various office accoutrements scattered atop it.  Two hexagonal slate tiles sit between the entryway and the front of the table, protecting the grass from visitor's feet.  A woven reed mat rests on the other side of the table, providing a clean spot to sit and work.

title: [Ranger Guild, Trophy Room]
description: High walls are filled with a variety of trophy mountings.  Beneath each, a small brass plaque details the species, captor, and date of preservation.  A tall podium stands in the center of the room with a thick leather-bound book atop it.

title: [Ranger Guild, Library]
description: Numerous small cubbies are carved into the thick walls of the tree.  Scrolls, books, and various other archival records are neatly tucked away, each organized by a general category.  A tall teak bookshelf stands in the center of the room with a variety of artifacts displayed upon it.  A dozen padded chairs are arranged to provide comfortable reading spots.  Opposite a series of small teak desks stands a large iron door.

title: [Ranger Guild, Workshop]
description: Contrasting with the surrounding areas, the walls here are lined in thick lead and iron plates.  Several plates on the walls are dented or severely scorched.  A collection of tables with various glassware, tools, and containers upon them are scattered through the room.  A large sign on the far wall is severely dented in its center.  A series of racks on one side of the wall hold stretched skins in the process of tanning.

title: [Ranger Guild, Den]
description: Massive cedar planks stretch wall to wall, covered in places by various tanned hides.  Portals cut into the tree walls, some perhaps old knots, allow light to filter in from outside.  A basalt fireplace and chimney rest in the center of one wall.  A large metal grate rests horizontally across the fireplace, forming a grill for some impromptu cooking.

title: [Ranger Guild, Dining Hall]
description: Two polished cherrywood sideboards cover the wall adjacent to the kitchen door, each covered with a variety of foods and drink.  Large teak tables fill the remaining area, each lined with a bench on either side of it.

title: [Ranger Guild, Kitchen]
description: Six cast iron stoves line the far, outer wall of the room, each resting atop a thick ceramic slab and housing a thick stovepipe exiting through the wall.  A long teak work surface extends through the center of the room with a collection of various preparation tools scattered across it.  Various sounds of chopping and stirring fills the air, along with the savory scents of a cooking meal.

title: [Bard Guild, Dressing Room]
description: The dressing room is little bigger than a crowded closet.  A small dresser fitted with a mirror occupies one corner, opposite a makeshift clothes rack.  A small trunk and a chair complete the room's furnishings.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Large and acoustically well proportioned, the stage opens expectantly to the auditorium -- lights and curtains, tabs and borders, all are cleverly placed to entice the audience's eye.  A semitransparent scrim hangs at the back from the grid of metal framework above.  A wide apron at the front of the stage completes the space, from which every seat in the house can be seen.

title: [Bard Guild, Green Room]
description: A long table surrounded by well-worn chairs provides comfortable seating for thespians hearing last minute instructions or just waiting to go onstage.  The west wall supports overflow storage of miscellaneous flats and large props clustered in untidy and dusty groups.  The air is scented with a delicious mix of dust, paint, stage makeup, and that indefinable scent of drama just waiting to unfold.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage]
description: Backstage at the Icemule Auditorium is a crowded affair.  Tall scenery flats vie for space with a miscellany of props while ropes on pulleys create a jungle-like backdrop.  The smell of the place is unmistakable though, creating a surreal atmosphere tinged with excitement.

title: [Bard Guild, Dressing Room]
description: The dressing room is a cluttered chamber with small space and too much furniture.  A couple of chairs sit around a dressing table with a large mirror.  Across the back wall, a row of pegs provides a place to hang clothing and costumes, lower and upper shelves are mounted to the side for miscellaneous paraphernalia.  A lantern sitting on the dressing table offers most of the light in the chamber, and a ceiling fan overhead slowly moves the close atmosphere in a paltry attempt at a cooling breeze.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Tatters of old spiking - strips of tape to indicate where pieces of scenery are to be placed - mark the worn black floor.  Dark blue velour tab curtains hang to right and left, creating offstage wings.  Large overhead lamps light the stage, hidden from the audience by blue velour border curtains.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: The Guild Hall's office is a roomy chamber paneled and furnished in gleaming mahogany.  Bright tones woven into the intricacies of an antique Illistim area rug enliven the dark wood, providing an attractive color contrast.  Where bookshelves filled with manuscripts don't claim the wall space, a number of beautiful lutes are hung from hooks made especially for the purpose, much like paintings would be displayed in other establishments.

title: [Bard Guild, Music Library]
description: Inside the Music Library, shelves stretch from floor to ceiling on every wall.  Polished mahogany mahogany ladders fitted with rollers on the feet give access to the higher shelves.  A single chandelier provides the sole illumination.  Its impressive size and intricate branches hold innumerable candles, casting a soft, yet thorough light well suited to poring through the most poorly scribbled of hand-written musical manuscripts.

Inside the Music Library, shelves stretch from floor to ceiling on every wall.  Polished mahogany ladders fitted with rollers on the feet give access to the higher shelves.  A single chandelier provides the sole illumination.  Its impressive size and intricate branches hold innumerable candles, casting a soft, yet thorough light well suited to poring through the most poorly scribbled of hand-written musical manuscripts.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Smooth and inviting, the boards of the stage floor stretch evenly from upstage to down.  Overhead, booms and battens rub elbows with the light bridge - the narrow platform behind the teaser curtain, from which lighting instruments are hung.  Framed in velvet curtains, the opening across the proscenium and into the auditorium fairly calls with expectancy.

title: [Bard Guild, Entrance Hall]
description: Lush, ametrine-hued velvet banners fringed in gold line the polished marble walls of the entrance hall.  The arched ceiling has been inlaid with a bevy of multicolored crystal shards, sparkling against the dark stone like stars in the night sky.  Inset with a burnished plaque, a thick, black granite pillar rises between a pair of mottled, giant glowing toadstools.

title: [Bard Guild, Iron Gateway]
description: A massive iron and stone gateway leads deeper into the expansive atrium bordered by wide, arched walkways.  Raucous laughter and merriment echo throughout the open area, dampened only slightly by the wall of giant, luminescent toadstools that partitions off the corridors from the tavern.

title: [Bard Guild, Corestone Tavern]
description: Glowing moss dangles in thick clumps from the iron-worked trellis overhead, though glimpses of the crystalline dome ceiling are visible through gaps in the vegetation.  Tables are occupied by bards in the midst of riveting stories, drinking songs, hilarious jokes, or friendly chatter, though all are neck deep in steins of ale and other strong spirits.  A balding dwarf serves up drinks from behind a polished brass and corestone bar.

title: [Bard Guild, Limestone Walk]
description: Embroidered crimson runners offset the deep, greyish blue hue of the smooth limestone floor.  Colorful, glaes-chip mosaics depict scenes of bards performing to rapt audiences among a variety of backdrops.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: Imported Terasian glaes statuary stands stoically behind the brass-accented desk of the Guildmaster.  A wrought-iron rack lined in velvet houses several precious instruments while the stone shelf behind it contains numerous tomes and manuscripts.  Displayed on the deep blue granite walls are a series of detailed oil paintings and illuminated scrolls from famous dwarven writers.

title: [Bard Guild, Quartz Walk]
description: Aged bronze statues line the quartz-flecked walkway on one side, while towering, glowing toadstools run along the other.  The clamor from the tavern is softened by the embroidered crimson runners and velvet banners that cover some of the stone.

title: [Bard Guild, Hall of Inspiration]
description: Small alcoves run along the golden limestone walls of the hall, each containing replicas of cherished artifacts from bardic history.  A slow, deep hum resonates through the area, originating from beyond a carved granite archway to the south.

title: [Bard Guild, Cavern of Sound]
description: A giant tiered platform rises from the center of the floor, watched over by the pale stalactites that loom above.  Massive crystals jut out from the rocky walls of the subterranean area, the source of the unique acoustic qualities of the cavern.  They resonate with a low thrum, the result of absorbing the noise of training and instruction.  Simple archways run along the entire perimeter, leading to private guild training areas.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage]
description: The backstage area is crowded with scenery flats and miscellaneous props and furnishings.  Overhead, a lattice of catwalks, from which hangs a number of ropes and pulleys, crisscrosses in a dizzy pattern.  Along one wall, beside the fly gallery and the pin rail, an oversized sliding panel leads deeper into the guildhall.  A painted door with a sign on it proclaiming it to be the dressing room nestles in the corner.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Large and acoustically well proportioned, the stage opens expectantly to the auditorium -- lights and curtain, tabs and borders, all are cleverly placed to entice the audience's eye.  A semitransparent scrim hangs at the back from the grid of metal framework above.  A wide apron at the front of the stage completes the space, from which every seat in the house can be seen.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Stage]
description: The stage lighting -- created by evenly spaced oil lamps hung over the proscenium -- illuminates the wide-planked stage.  A new coat of polish is unable to hide the scuffs and marks left by decades of actors.

title: [Bard Guild, Antechamber]
description: An open anteroom offers entrance to the Teras Isle Bard Guild through a stone arch covered with clinging vines dripping with flowers.  The anteroom is less a traditional room than it is a patio, and it features a splendid view of the town sprawling below with its red clay tile roofs and colorful foliage.  Wide stone tiles provide flooring that is as cool as it is attractive.

title: [Bard Guild, Hall of Melodies]
description: The Hall of Melodies is aptly named, as strains of music float in periodically on the breezes playing through the tall, open windows of the chamber.  These windows line the entire western wall, and through them, one can see an expansive panorama of Kharam Dzu and the moonlit ocean beyond.  Overstuffed chairs covered in tawny leather are positioned in comfortable groupings here and there, and accompanying them are a few music stands and some small tables crafted of teak.

title: [Bard Guild, Open Walkway]
description: The open-air walkway -- in truth a bridge -- spans a deep chasm between the Bard Guild sitting on the edge of the cliffs and the spectacular Aerie Auditorium poised upon a single pillar standing out from the ramparts.  The column tapers as it descends and from the height of the walkway it gives an illusion that the structure perched on top is floating on the head of a pin.  All along the low, moonlight-sparkled stone walls grow a tangle of wisteria vines with their fragrant cascades of blue flowers.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage Entry]
description: Narrow walkways thread between bulky props and scenery flats.  A variety of lanterns hangs overhead, offering different ways to manipulate the light shining down on a stage.  The green room is at the western end of the tunnel-like corridor, with an open door that reveals a collection of chairs and small tables.

title: [Bard Guild, Green Room]
description: The Auditorium green room is an area nestled amid the curtains and scenery flats.  Ropes and pulleys hang down from a couple of catwalks overhead that span the expanse of the stage, tantalizingly just on the other side of the heavy aquamarine curtains.  An additional array of ropes is contained in an intricate wooden frame, controlling the curtains.  Their operation appears to be a complex affair, judging from the array of ropes and anchors.

title: [Bard Guild, Dressing Room]
description: The dressing room is spare in furnishings.  A couple of chairs are provided, one sitting before a dressing table with a large mirror.  Across the back wall, a row of pegs provides a place to hang clothing and costumes, and a couple of shelves are mounted to the side for miscellaneous props and paraphernalia.  A lantern sitting on the dressing table offers the only light in the chamber, tucked away on the stage's back wall with no window.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage]
description: The backstage area of the Aerie Auditorium is cluttered with scenery flats and props, with ropes, pulleys and accompanying switches adding to the confusion.  The lighting is soft, so as not to spill over onto the stage, which is out of sight just beyond banks of aquamarine stage curtains.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: A hallway winds through walls decorated with bas-relief carvings of a variety of instruments.  The floor is covered with large tiles, and a plush runner twists along the meandering curves, precisely following the twists and turns of the hall.  The rug matches the light-toned stucco walls, and a series of conch shell lanterns are suspended overhead.  An arch opens on the South Wall, revealing a pub beyond and admitting mouth-watering aromas and the distinctive clink of plate and mug.

title: [Bard Guild, Aerie Pub]
description: The Pub is a comfortable chamber, open on the west to a view of town and sea, as well as an imposing outlook of the Aerie Auditorium floating at a similar altitude.  A number of tables offer seating, each with distinctive design echoing that of the Aerie and its supporting column.  Across the south wall of the Pub is a long bar, crafted of polished teak and rolaren hardware shined to a high gloss.

title: [Aerie Pub, Aria Table]
description: The Aria table rises from its narrow foot with elegance, the pedestal carved in fine detail.  Beginning with a narrow circumference, it flares as it lifts, until it finally concludes at the carved, circular top.  Across the teak tabletop is another masterful carving, depicting a complex series of interweaving musical staffs with accompanying notes and accents.  A large conch shell has been converted into a lantern, which sits at the table's center.

title: [Aerie Pub, Counterpoint Table]
description: The Counterpoint table is heavily carved and crafted of polished teak.  Across its surface, interweaving musical staffs drift in a complicated pattern resembling ribbons.  Notes dot the lines in a merry dance.  A single large nautilus shell has been converted into a lantern, which sits at the table's center.

title: [Bard Guild, Hallway]
description: The hallway is wide, allowing plenty of room for carrying large instruments along its length.  To the east, it ends at three teak doors.  To the north and south, signs on the doors announce they are entrances to practice rooms.  To the east, large block letters on the door read 'Guild Office.'  Strains and snippets of music escape from behind the three doors, mixing in a muffled tangle of melody.

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room's decor is spare, with only a chair, small side table and music stand for furnishings.  Overhead, the blades of a ceiling fan make a soft swish as they turn.  Facing the door is a single window offering a view of the brightly lit Aerie Pub in another wing of the Hall.  And just past that, one can glimpse the sparkle of moonlight shining on the deep indigo blue of the ocean.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: The Bard Guild office is a circular chamber sitting on the back of the main building.  It features tall, narrow windows that offer an expansive view of the rocky cliffs surrounding the Guild.  Outside, moonlight bathes the crags in its silvery caress, giving them a stark appearance.  A large teak desk occupies the room's center, beneath the lazily turning blades of a ceiling fan.

title: [Bard Guild, Practice Room]
description: The practice room is small, with only a chair, small side table and music stand for furnishings.  A window opposite the door offers a view of the craggy Teras cliffs in which the Bard Guild is nestled.  Soft moonlight streams in, adding to the light cast by a lantern sitting on the table.

title: [Bard Guild, Music Library]
description: Nestled between the circular room housing the Guild Office and the main building, the Music Library is a nondescript room with one small window set high on its southern wall.  Every inch of remaining wall space is claimed by floor-to-ceiling shelves crafted of teak and polished to a high luster.  The shelves are packed with reams of parchment, all apparently covered with the tight scrawl of musical notation.

title: [Bard Guild, Aerie Auditorium]
description: The Aerie is a monumental construction, possessing a vast interior that captures the essence of floating within a cloud.  Cantilevered sections of the ceiling cascade down toward a stage at the far end of the chamber, naturally amplifying any discourse occurring there.  Rows of seats crafted of light-toned teak are set in descending rows, and the floor and stage curtains are tinted a soft tone of aquamarine, completing an overall schema of airiness and light.  Three vaulted arches provide exits.

title: [Bard Guild, Stage]
description: Framed with aquamarine curtains and tabs, with a wide proscenium and tapered wings, the stage provides easily accessible space for any type of performance.  Footlights and lanterns hung overhead provide lighting to heighten the effect.

title: [Redwing Spire, Planning Room]
description: A stained cherrywood door opens out onto a spacious terrace shielded from the open air by an enclosure of beveled crystal, the edges of which are brought alive with golden flame by the sun's radiance.  Just past a faenor-traced ebonwood table with some leather-covered ebonwood chairs clustered around it, a small aperture in the glass forms a halo about a walk of stone that juts into the open air to the northwest.

title: [Teras Isle, Jungle]
description: A couple of large umbrella plants force the path to wind and turn back on itself.  Nearby, a host of smaller plants of the same variety stand in a group, as if watching their bigger brethren commandeer the trail.  A log juts out from under one of the pair, its deteriorating trunk playing host to a score of bright, red-speckled mushrooms.  They look like tiny fairie-folk peeking out from beneath the gigantic parasol-shaped leaves.

title: [Jungle, Clearing]
description: The thick jungle growth is held at bay by a huge banyan tree, its trunk a wall of smaller boles all melded into the one tree.  Ferns sprout around its foot and orchids create a riot of color, clinging to crevices in the tree's branches with their curling roots.  A thick wall of buttress roots shields the tree, preventing a close approach to it.

title: [Ranger Guild, Glade]
description: A glade surrounds the huge bole of a banyan tree, shielded by its leafy canopy high above as well as surrounding curtains of buttress roots.  The jungle floor is remarkably clear at the tree's base, although the curling fronds of ferns and broad-leafed sheffleras accent the clearing here and there with their verdant emerald tones.

title: [Ranger Guild, Greatroom]
description: An expansive greatroom has been fashioned within the heart of the banyan tree, its sloping walls betraying their organic origin.  Every wood surface within the chamber has been polished to a high luster, including a collection of beautifully crafted chairs that sit in groupings here and there.  Tall, slitted openings serve as windows, and are covered with netting to allow light and air into the chamber while denying entrance to insects and other manner of jungle life.

title: [Ranger Guild, Jungle]
description: The path skirting the base of the banyan tree halts at the foot of a small pond.  Water trickles from a three-tiered waterfall ingeniously fashioned from moss-covered boulders.  Water lilies send up huge, fragrant blossoms from the pool's surface, and dragonflies as big as birds hover above on wide, brilliantly colored wings.  A curtain of buttress roots lift from the back of the pond, orchids clinging to the wood in a riot of blooms.

title: [Ranger Guild, Balcony]
description: A balcony is perched atop a projecting elbow of thick buttress roots, its railing fashioned of interwoven vines.  It overlooks the first tier of the jungle canopy, a seemingly never-ending ocean of trees stretching into the emerald distance.  Brightly colored birds are everywhere, their plumage and raucous songs providing a vibrant punctuation to the foliage.  From the ground below, the soft whisper of falling water interjects a peaceful undertone to the energetic serenade in the boughs.

title: [Ranger Guild, Den]
description: The den is an airy chamber, graced with wide expanses of openings created by the growing walls of the banyan tree.  Netting, so fine it is almost transparent, provides a covering to the natural windows, and small tree frogs cling to its exterior here and there like vivid green ornaments.  Against one wall, a small fire burns within a heavy pottery container, its smoke cleverly vented through a flue to the outside.

title: [Ranger Guild, Office]
description: The office is rather Spartan in design, its chief ornamentation being the lustrous polished finish of the wooden walls.  A single teak desk sits in the center, and one bank of bookshelves stretches around a section of wall at waist level.  Windows on all sides give an expansive view of the jungle canopy, the panorama more vibrant than any painting could be.

title: [Ranger Guild, Walkway]
description: A short hallway stretches from an arch at either end.  Its roof is peaked, created by a juncture of buttress roots.  The floor is finished with flagstones, the grouting between tinted a bright shade of green from moss growing there.  Along each side, the growing wood of the tree parts in places, providing views of the foliage outside, and birds have built nests here and there in handy crevices of the window openings.

title: [Ranger Guild, Banyan Bar]
description: The tavern is dominated by an expansive bar stretching in an arc around the circular chamber.  Stools are arranged in groups around the curve, upholstered in tawny-colored leather.  A couple of ceiling fans hang from above, empowered by a clever system of pulleys and cranks, and to one side, the walls open to a patio where a few tables stand beneath green umbrellas.

title: [Ranger Guild, Tree Frog Table]
description: The open patio offers an expansive view of the jungle canopy stretching away into the distance.  Bright color is everywhere, tinting flowers, birds and insects.  A curtain of fragrant honeysuckle vines grows near the table, and small tree frogs can be glimpsed within its protection, their ruby-red eyes an intense contrast to their lime green coloration.

title: [Ranger Guild, Windsong Table]
description: A soft breeze flutters the scalloped edges of the green umbrella shielding the table from debris falling from the lively canopy overhead.  Birds and monkeys play among the boughs surrounding the patio, and clouds of butterflies languidly drift by.  The view of the surrounding jungle tier is expansive, revealing a world inhabited by denizens who rarely, if ever, touch the jungle floor.

title: [Ranger Guild, Workshop]
description: Unlike other chambers within the huge banyan tree, this one is totally enclosed.  The lustrous glow of the sloping wooden walls provides a warm, golden glow, illuminated by hanging globes of amber-colored glass suspended from the irregular ceiling above.  A single worktable rises in the center of the room, fashioned from the wood of the tree itself.  Its expansive top is carved and inlaid, depicting a map of Teras Isle.

title: [Ranger Guild, Overlook]
description: The overlook is a dizzy perch positioned on a narrow outcrop of buttress roots, which plunge down from the precarious ledge in a steep descent to the jungle floor below.  A railing of interwoven vines encloses the aerie, however the barrier doesn't appear to be sturdy enough to sustain much more weight than the baskets of flowers hanging from it.  In the distance, Greymist can be seen, with clouds of mist shifting across its expanse like ghost ships on an emerald sea.

title: [Arboretum, Passage]
description: A floor of dark grey marble tiles streaked with lighter swirls echoes your footsteps in this dim hallway.  Several paintings adorn the walls, each lit by a soft glow whose source you cannot determine.  While all the art is of the highest caliber, one of the largest, a rendering of an intricate hedge maze, looks so lifelike that you can almost see people running amongst its verdant walls.

title: [Arboretum, Passage]
description: A wide open window grants a view into the magnificent atrium within the grounds.  Brightly colored songbirds flit about in the trees, some evidently tame enough to settle on the shoulders and hands of the folks tending to the great variety of flowering bushes and saplings in the gardens.

title: [Arboretum, Passage]
description: Rows of thin white marble columns lead up to a mirrored door at the end of the hallway.  Each column is encircled by tarnished brass cleverly hammered and wrapped to look like climbing ivy.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel here is almost entirely engulfed in darkness, and the walls are jagged and stained.  An old, musty smell hangs heavily in the air.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel here is almost entirely engulfed in darkness, and the walls are jagged and stained.  An old, musty smell hangs heavily in the air.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The tunnel here is almost entirely engulfed in darkness, and the walls are jagged and stained.  An old, musty smell hangs heavily in the air.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, The Bilge]
description: The deepest pit of the tavern is heavily cramped, with large rocks stacked about that once kept a measure of buoyancy for the ship when it was once at sea.  There is little room for anything else, save for a narrow walkway crossing from the back of the room to the ladder leading up.

title: [Silver Knave Table]
description: A stout ceramic vase filled with dark purple wolfsbane flowers sits in the center of the table, surrounded by several detailed images etched into the wooden table.  The carvings depict ships floating on a bay, toppled bags of coins, and the corpse of a lion in the depths of an open grave.

title: [Golden Zealot Table]
description: The image of a broken crown has been sloppily carved into the surface of the round table, each groove stained with old wine.  Around the table's edges show more etchings of a group of faceless adventurers standing triumphant over a pile of bald armored crusaders.

title: [Rooftop Rook Table]
description: Near the edge of the ship's railing, this table overlooks the murky waters of Darkstone Bay.  Etchings of eyeless rooks in flight spread out over the center of the table, each bird carrying a torch and dagger in its talons.

title: [Blue Baystone Table]
description: A small baystone vase rises from the center of the table, its light and dark blue surface polished to a sheen.  The small yellow flowers of bur-clover peek out from within the vase, almost hiding a small crack in the base.

title: [Blood Marble Table]
description: A curved blood marble platter dominates the center of the table, its red-speckled white depths serving as a home to an assortment of fresh fruit such as apples, pineapples, plums, and starfruits.  A few of the chairs surrounding the table are shorter than others.

title: [Dark Bleakstone Table]
description: A ring of dark red hydrangea reaches out from inside a gold-whorled dark bleakstone vase, which resembles more of a block than a true container.  The table is otherwise unadorned, save for a few splotches of dark green paint splattered on the wooden surface.

title: [Darkness Below]
description: You find yourself floating in a river of energy and drifting out of your control.  Ethereal beings lurk beneath the current all around you, the shapeless forms of light with shifting faces grasping at your lifeless flesh as you pass by.

title: [The River of Life]
description: Your body is surrounded by a blackened vessel drifting down with the flow of energy.  It dawns on you that you are not alone, as opposite from your body is a hooded figure.  Ethereal flames burn from where there would be eyes; his arms hold a slender pole pushing the vessel onward.

title: [The Cavern of Life]
description: Illuminating the chamber overhead are a countless number of ethereal bolts of energy, swimming effortlessly across the sky.  On either side of the ethereal river are humanoid shapes, their eyes burning with hatred towards you.  Helpless on your quest along the river, a strange tingling sensation fills your body from within your core.

title: [Energy Falls]
description: The thunder of a waterfall of energy booms throughout the chamber as it narrows.  The figure once in the vessel with you stands to the side, the sleeves of its baggy robe folded across its chest.  Your vision swimming in a sea of light, you submit to your end.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Secluded Nook]
description: Curving about the garden, the pond arcs out, creating a secluded swimming hole.  Several varieties of water grass grow along the banks, cattails swaying with the slight current.  Pale sand and small river stones pad the bottom with tiny fish darting back and forth under the surf.  Several weeping willows fan out, their draping branches sway with the slightest breeze and allow sunlight through warming the area.

Curving about the garden, the pond arcs out, creating a secluded swimming hole.  Several varieties of water grass grow along the banks, cattails swaying with the slight current.  Pale sand and small river stones pad the bottom with tiny fish darting back and forth under the surf.  Several weeping willows fan out, their draping branches sway with the slightest breeze and allow moonlight through basking the area in a pale glow.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Bedroom]
description: Softly flickering candles illuminate a massive carved mahogany bed and a narrow writing desk topped with a variety of quills and scrolls.  A cream-colored sylvan rug lines the rosewood floor beneath an exposed beam ceiling.  A pair of cushioned cross-frame chairs is positioned at the foot of the bed and an embroidered tapestry lit by frosted pendant chandeliers hangs behind it.  The far wall is dominated by an imposing marble fireplace, with a basket of sticks placed nearby.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Kitchen]
description: A small wicker chest is tucked under a large cupboard that stands next to a porcelain sink.  Thyme, basil, and other herbs grow in pots along the deep sill of the multi-paned window above.  A massive cookstove covers the far wall, kettles and pots warming on top.  Dominating the center of the kitchen is a well-used butcher's block piled with utensils, knives and baskets of food ready for preparation.  Shelves of food can be seen through the glass front of a wooden ice chest that is built to one side of a pantry door.

A small wicker chest is tucked under a large cupboard that stands next to a porcelain sink.  A massive cookstove covers the far wall.  Shelves of food can be seen through the glass front of a wooden ice chest that is built to one side of a pantry door.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Pantry]
description: Crates of supplies are stacked neatly against the back of the pantry.  Several shelves filled with jars, bags and packets hang from the walls.  Sacks of dry goods are neatly arranged on the floor their contents carefully labeled.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Basement]
description: Numerous crates and barrels of non-perishables are stacked uniformly around the dimly lit basement.  A hard, cooled stone surface lies underfoot, causing any notable sound to reverberate fiercely.  Two sconces adorning the far wall are the lone light sources, flickering in shades of blue and green.  Frequent streams of air waft into the area from the kitchen above, causing the flames to shift and dance as they distribute their magical light.

title: [Forsythia Table]
description: The smooth wooden planks of this round table bear the pale hue of cypress that is now and again broken by vibrant splashes of color where tiny columbine and speedwell blossoms have been preserved beneath a thick varnish.  A tall, slender vase of translucent sepia glass is set to one side and displays slender forsythia clippings, each bearing dozens of the tiny golden flowers.  Offset slightly is a small white votive.

title: [Thistle Table]
description: Nestled against one wall, the atmosphere here is cozy and private.  A ceramic pitcher rests on top of the smoothly-hewn pale sycamore table and is filled to the brim with clippings from a thistle bush.  Warm red and golden glazes flow together to form a striated pattern reminiscent of a sunset over the ocean, and they provide a warm counterpart to the pale violet blossoms.  A small white votive is nestled within a russet glass jar, offset slightly from the pitcher.

title: [Windflower Table]
description: Set back from the other tables, the noise of the area is hushed here.  A cluster of windflowers is displayed prominently from within a wide spun glass vase, their star-shaped white blossoms offset by the splash of pale pink from several dog roses.  Resting in the center of the cherrywood table is a short lilac votive.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Entry]
description: Curving down and to the west, marble steps cut through the travertine planters that line the pathway that trails away from Pentas Avenue.  Concentric bands of gold-veined tiles form overlapping knotwork patterns upon the broad expanse, as twinkling lights spill out of blown glass orbs that reside at various places amid succulent plants and white ground-covering pebbles.  Dappling the ground with mottled shadows, starlight filters through nearby cypress trees cooling the area.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Promenade]
description: Travertine pavers, surrounded by brightly colored, elfin creeping thyme, decorate the promenade, which hugs the cliff side and gently slopes downward away from some curved marble steps that lead to the avenue above.  Cypress trees dot the edges amid railings that offer a view of the ocean, while several shops stand opposite one another with open and inviting doorways.  A carved marble bench provides a quiet place for respite.

Travertine pavers, surrounded by brightly colored, elfin creeping thyme, decorate the promenade, which hugs the cliff side and gently slopes downward away from some curved marble steps that lead to the avenue above.  Cypress trees dot the edges amid railings that offer a view of the ocean, while two shops stand opposite with open and inviting doorways.  A carved marble bench provides a quiet place for respite.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Promenade]
description: Viridian, periwinkle, canary, and citrine-hued elfin thyme spreads across the ground, providing a colorful backdrop to the stark white travertine pavers.  Enormous frosted globes rest within baskets that are perched upon incredibly tall wrought iron poles, their incandescent light illuminating the flapping pennants hung beneath.  Window-dotted storefronts hung with bright white signs line the western edge of the promenade.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Courtyard]
description: Thinning out as it descends from the promenade, elfin thyme grows in sparse, mottled patches, as the travertine cobbles are fitted more tightly together at the entrance to the sprawling courtyard.  Ornate facades with etched pillars and wide windows are carved into the cliff face, the peak of which is dominated by the shadow of the Tower of Pentas.  Bright light spills from the open entrances of various shops, their cheery glow inviting in the cool night.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Courtyard]
description: Gold veining creates decorative designs upon the smooth pavers that stretch across the courtyard, the tightly fitted pieces free of vegetation or debris.  Large brackets anchored to the cliff face dangle incandescent globes over the quiet streets, producing a soft illumination that dispels the dark of the island night.  Several shops dapple the northern edge of the courtyard, their wide-open doors facing a series of stone steps that lead southward towards a central fountain.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Fountain]
description: Separating the promenade from the courtyard is a low white stucco wall, which is bisected by a series of stone steps that is flanked by ropey bougainvillea vines housed in enormous terracotta planters.  Concentric bands of ebon, white, green, red, and blue travertine pavers surround a burbling fountain under the watchful eye of illuminated frosted globes.  Rising in a spiral from within the fountain's water is a copper sculpture depicting a pandemonium of parrots.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Courtyard]
description: Resting in planters against the railings that stretch across the western edge of the courtyard, cultivated lantern trees are filled with flickering orbs that illuminate the immediate area.  Fragrant aromas drift free of a cornflower blue pavilion, whose tied-down sides keep the cool night breeze from invading.  Cajoling the stars, the ocean tide lyrically rolls across the rocks far below and fills the night with a soft lullaby.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Courtyard]
description: Nestled against the bright white wrought iron railing, a small table of filigreed metal is flanked by blue-cushioned chairs with high backs.  Fragrant bee balm, sweet marjoram, and sage grow in wide profusion along the cliff edge that resides just beyond the railing, the thick vegetation providing a verdant foreground to the ocean view.  Filling the air with its lyrical chorus, the sound of the fountain to the south trickles in.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Courtyard]
description: Cobalt blue cushions are scattered about this semi-circular section of the courtyard and surround a large black glass rectangle that is filled with glowing charcoal bricks.  A short wall creates a backrest to the southern cushions and separates the cliff's edge from the travertine cobblestones.  Ocean sounds mingle with that of the fountain to the south, their varied notes playing counterpoint to one another.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Courtyard]
description: Scattered herbs tiptoe into the courtyard from just beyond the wrought iron railing that guards the cliff's edge, their fragrance filling the sea-born air.  Starlight plays upon the metal of a small table surrounded by blue-cushioned chairs that is perfectly positioned to take in the panoramic ocean view.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Courtyard]
description: Edges fluttering in the soft, sea-born breeze, a bright white pavilion built upon the travertine cobblestones has its sides pinned down against the cool night air.  Large terracotta planters housing shrubs offer points of interest amid the guard railings that overlook the ocean far below, while clinging cushion moss creeps at the courtyard's edges.  Distant, yet insistent, the rhythmic sound of the tide brushing the shore rolls through the area.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Courtyard]
description: Tiny brightly hued blossoms dapple the emerald green elfin thyme that creeps into the courtyard from the northeast, the verdant greenery growing sparser the closer the travertine pavers get to each other.  Trellises woven with luscious peony plants dominate the northwestern edge of the courtyard, their colorful blossoms offering a sweet, yet heady fragrance upon the cool air.  Ornate facades provide decorative entries to the shops built into the cliff walls, their inviting marbled entries lit from within.
