Trellises woven with luscious peony plants dominate the northwestern edge of the courtyard, their colorful blossoms offering a sweet, yet heady fragrance upon the cool air.  Ornate facades provide decorative entries to the shops built into the cliff walls, their inviting marbled entries lit from within.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Promenade]
description: Travertine pavers weave through the bright green creeping thyme, their smooth faces glistening in the moonlight like tiny ponds in a mossy plain.  Window-dotted storefronts are evenly spaced along the western edge of the promenade, their open windows spilling inviting light into the night.  Topped with glowing frosted globes, immensely tall poles decorated with flapping pennants are spaced at even intervals between the eastern guardrails.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Promenade]
description: Forming crisscrossing patterns in the thick creeping thyme, travertine pavers sinuously wend their away through the promenade and terminate at some curved white marble steps that lead to the tower above.  Splashes of white pink, rose, and lilac blossoms cling to the woolly groundcover, providing colorful interest from cliff face to guardrail before disappearing over the eastern edge.  Severe and utilitarian, a pillar-framed postal exchange house crafted of marble is flanked by a pair of brightly burning lanterns, while window-dotted storefronts dapple the lane.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Entry]
description: Curving down and to the east, marble steps cut through the travertine planters that line the pathway trailing away from Pentas Avenue.  Concentric bands of gold-veined tiles form overlapping knotwork patterns upon the broad expanse, as twinkling lights spill out of blown glass orbs that reside at various places amid succulent plants and white ground-covering pebbles.  Dappling the ground with mottled shadows, starlight filters through nearby cypress trees cooling the area.

title: [Let's Make a Seal, Entrance]
description: Numerous silver lanterns are suspended from the ceiling in this room, their flames illuminating the shop with a warm white glow while a textured glass door remain shut to keep the cold night air at bay.  The walls have been largely left unaltered and the coarse, roughly hewn surface stands in stark contrast to the polished floor below.  Throughout the room, plush white wool carpets have been arranged to provide customers with a comfortable place to stand while examining the wares contained in a brightly illuminated jewelry case and a brightly illuminated jewelry display.

title: [Let's Make a Seal, Engraver]
description: The backroom of the store is far more muted and austere than the brilliantly lit entrance.  Small workbenches line both sides of the room while the back wall has technical diagrams mounted in silver frames.  In the center of the room, a small wooden table sits atop a plush wool rug with several lanterns above it providing a dull, steady illumination.

title: [Natural Permeations, Entry]
description: Pale light from the moons streams through multi-paned windows flanking the shop's ash-framed doorway, washing the shop in a gentle glow.  Large, circular polished hoops of white macrame alternate between unlit oil sconces, partially obscuring pine walls.  Several piles of neatly stacked woods litter the floors, with one serving as a makeshift pedestal.  Just out of the way, in a far corner of the room, rests a mahogany-framed sign hanging above a well-tended hole.

title: [Natural Permeations, Essence]
description: Stacks of wood planks, ranging from ash to zebrawood, are confined within decorative cages of filigreed bronze wire scattered along the floor.  Heavy oak shelves equally stacked high with supplies line the pine walls, some slightly off-kilter and threatening to fall,  above which hangs a mahogany-framed sign.  Weeping willow branches drape strategically from the ceiling, their leaves shifting almost imperceptibly from the slightest touch.  Arranged within the branches and leaves are tiny lanterns shaped like fireflies.

title: [Natural Permeations, Essence]
description: An aromatic, yet pungent, scent wafts throughout the area, its source the clusters of bugleweed in terracotta planters lining the shop's moss-embraced pine walls.  Secured above one of the planters with a burnished stake-shaped treenail is a mahogany-framed sign.  Along the floors are extra supplies of neatly bundled tiger grass and grapevines, secured by cotton twine.  Exposed cypress beams span across the room, their lengths dangling bronze lanterns caught by ivy-woven chains.

title: [Arboreal Afterlife, Lobby]
description: Smooth, pale yellow sandstone walls are interrupted by green jade-carved ivy leaves that crawl across the trim of the ceiling until it opens up to the second floor.  Arches chiseled into the sandstone texture the walls at equally spaced intervals with tiled murals inside each of them.  Dual pillars break up the room and open up additional space further into the shop, while at the front of the small boutique is a marbled desk that takes up the front and center of the lobby.

title: [Arboreal Afterlife, Storage]
description: Shelves line the right side of the room from floor to ceiling; some are lined with half-opened cards, while others have some sculpted glass vases upon them that hold an assortment of quills and styli.  The wall straight ahead has a mural of colored tiles resembling a waterfall and has been framed with stacks of colored paper and parchments.  A set of stairs that leads to the floor above is against the left corner of the room, while the remaining wall has bouquets of various flowers hanging upside down to dry.

title: [Arboreal Afterlife, Upstairs]
description: The smell of ink and perfumed parchment radiates throughout the area, while a kaleidoscope of various shapes, sizes, and colors of cards is a vivid splash of hues against the otherwise plain and pallid surroundings.  Silken streamers dangle from the ceiling and droop down enough to have cards hang on them at their crease.  Built into the far-right wall is an old oak apothecary cabinet that's been refurbished, its drawers labeled with tiny golden plaques.

title: [Present Company, Till]
description: Moonlight pouring in from two huge bay windows blankets every surface in this spacious shop, rendering the burnished imflass sconces along the walls merely helpful but not necessary for navigation.  Anchored between them, towering hazel shelves crowded with boxes of all shapes and sizes stretch to the back of the room where a narrow mica-topped counter houses a sturdy haon cashbox.

title: [Present Company, Mill]
description: Waist-high racks radiate outward from a central pedestal like spokes of a wheel, each stacked high with square trays holding sheaves of brightly colored sheets of wrapping paper.  An oversized violet candy dish of violet blown glass rests on the axial pedestal, filled to near-overflowing with a kaleidoscopic hoard of sweets.

title: [Present Company, Frills]
description: The back wall of the shop is carved directly from a massive vein of unblemished rose quartz, its tones ranging from a pale blush to a deeper salmon shade.  The rest of the room is cluttered with whitewashed hazelwood display cases and tables, each topped with myriad small baskets, bowls, and bins filled with coils of ribbon in polychromic hues.

title: [Little Things, Storefront]
description: Golden knotwork runners trim the top of the yellow sandstone walls, interspersed with glowing frosted orbs that light up the interior.  Pewter creepers, crafted to resemble olive vines, outline a pair of ivory-handled teak doors, flowing down to the floor and decorating the walls with a variety of jade and onyx olives.  To one side, a set of smooth shelves carved into the yellow sandstone provide a stark contrast to a glass-paned polished oak cabinet pushed up against the far wall.  At the rear of the shop, an iron-wrought spiral staircase ascends to the floor above.

title: [Little Things, Studio]
description: Gold latticework lined with silver rope rings the sandstone walls of the small studio.  Opposite an iron-wrought spiral staircase, a small window opens out over the courtyard letting the salted exterior air mix with the scent of mulberry and jasmine incense.  To the side, a juniper display case with a polished teak counter stands below a small white marble shelf.  A large oil painting, flanked by two brass lanterns, occupies the otherwise barren wall across from the workstation.

title: [More Ore Less, Entry]
description: Fine grit covers the shale grey floor, the particulates a result of the products housed in the lofted ceiling shop.  Work stations surrounded by tidy high-sided water troughs form neat columns down the lane, while a network of honeycomb cubbies houses a variety of paperwork near the egress.  Unwavering lights built into the ceiling keep the space brightly lit at all times.

title: [More Ore Less, Display Room]
description: Covered in overlapping rugs in sage green and saffron hues, the display room has soft lighting and a sense of quietude.   Floor-to-ceiling white shelves occupy the entirety of the northern wall and house a variety of minerals and ores in their natural state.  Arranged completely opposite of a storage table is a low display case covered in rich velvet, its sides glassless and its legs fashioned of bronze.

title: [The Last Chapter, Display]
description: Slabs of polished alabaster marble line the walls of the shop, veins of gold glistening in the pale light of a trio of silver lamps that hang from the domed ceiling.  A pair of cushioned velvet-covered chairs rest on a thick carpet of woven silk that covers the elegant stone floor.  Some dark mahogany shelves that are filled with various books, tomes, and volumes line the side of the spacious room.  Hanging by the entrance is a polished wooden plaque.

title: [The Last Chapter, Display]
description: Pale beeswax candles perch atop silver stands that are scattered about the room.  Large mahogany bookshelves cover most of the walls almost fully obscuring the pale marble that encloses the space.  Woven carpeting of silk captures a mosaic of cool blues and greens while covering the floor and cushioning any sounds of movement.

title: [The Last Chapter, Display]
description: Small silver sconces set with panes of frosted crystal decorate the gold-flecked alabaster marble of the walls.  Set between the candelabra are dark mahogany bookcases, each filled with volumes in a wide range of shapes and sizes.  Thick carpeting of rich blue silk covers the stone floors adding elegance and warmth to the space.

title: [Sojourn Scents, Trivia]
description: Painting adorns the walls to create a three hundred and sixty degree landscape, with golden grain fields rising from the floor and a pristine azure sky sinking from the ceiling to meet at a horizon dotted with trees and limned with the amber-magenta shades of a summer sunset.  Shelves with a few golden hooks beneath have been chiseled into the walls within the outline of the trees and painted to match, while an archway is set into the center of the setting sun, its pigments in harmony with those surrounding it.

title: [Sojourn Scents, All The Rest]
description: Dark shades of indigo and grey dapple the floor of this room, with the vague outline of buildings and trees rising from the base of the walls to reach toward a sky that is inky black and dotted with stars.  The sliver of a crescent moon hangs in one corner of the room, and pale silver paint outlines the dark forms that line the room, with chiseled shelves with a few golden hooks beneath found imbedded in the shapes of the houses and buildings.

title: [Crown Jewels]
description: Taller than it is wide, the lofty shop is papered in a golden cream damask pattern that leads to a broad oval-shaped mirror that dominates the back wall.  A few paces back from the looking glass, a solitary dark acacia case sits atop a lush burgundy wool rug and is illuminated from within to better display the wares inside.  Hanging from the ceiling, a round crystalline chandelier glints iridescent patterns throughout the shop when touched by ambient light.

title: [Etched Memories]
description: Dividing the elongated room into different browsing sections, a narrow dark koa table stretches across the center of the marble-tiled floors.  The eastern wall supports a gold-framed shelf, an iron-banded trunk, and a notched maoral ledge, while the western wall stores a carved rowan case and a heavy walnut jewelry box.  Numerous pots of wild greenery are scattered throughout the area, and an elusive, slightly metallic charred scent winds through the air.

title: [Room With A Hue]
description: Painted in gradient hues from niveous to virescent, the walls of the tidy little shop resemble a rainbow if its hues slowly transitioned one handspan at a time.  Crisp white shelves are arranged beneath strategically placed orbs of light and hung at approximately midway between floor and ceiling around the room, while short display counters house gnomish devices just below them.  A stack of rolled parchments stick out of a hexagonal cubby near the exit.

title: [Blue Myth Eatery]
description: Rolled down to both trap lantern light in and keep the cool night air out, the walls of the tent are a gradient blue that grows lighter the closer it gets to the travertine cobbles.  Scattered pillows surround low tables at the back of the pavilion, offering quiet respites for tourists and locals alike.  Covered in racks and seagrass mats, a long counter near the exit is laden with a wide variety of delectable foods.

title: [Starry Aster Table]
description: Nestled against one section of the gradient blue pavilion, the small round table is incredibly low to the ground and surrounded by large white cushions.  Decorative starry asters are painted onto a privacy screen that surrounds three quarters of the space, their violet hues blending with an azure and white background.

title: [Aubergine Bat Wing Table]
description: Surrounded by an off-white screen, a low round table sits in the middle of the travertine floor and is surrounded by large cushions.  Painted upon the paper and teak screen is an exotic bat wing flower, its long aubergine whiskers and dark purple flowers depicted in every detail.

title: [Autumn Sedum Table]
description: Dusky rose and coral, tiny star-shaped flowers are painted into the teak and parchment privacy screen that encircles the area.  Matching cushions are scattered around a low round table within the space, their plump tops standing out on the travertine floors.

title: [Azure Snow Salvia Table]
description: Ranging in hue from periwinkle to azure, the salvia stands upright like brushes in a jar on the painted privacy screens that range around the area.  Off white and sky blue cushions, pillows, and mats surround a low round table at the heart of the space.

title: [Blue Eryngium Table]
description: Yellowish green tassels dangle from the corners of steel blue cushions, which are scattered upon the travertine floor in a haphazard fashion around a low round table.  Painted screens separate the western edges of the space from the rest of the pavilion, their bright white faces painted with blue eryngium, while the gradient blue walls keep the exterior at bay.

title: [The Impressed Olive, Entry]
description: Lowered to maintain warmth, the satin walls of the pavilion are bright white.  Brass lanterns with decorative red, orange, and green windows shed bright light throughout the space, banishing the shadows and aiding the workers in maintaining a cheery space.  Display cases, wire racks, and a couple of brass trays range about the entry, offering treats for those seeking solace at the nearby tables.

title: [Pandemonium Table]
description: Set upon a smooth teak floor, a low round table sits within a halo of red, green, white, and orange hues cast by the brass lanterns that are attached to the ceiling.  Enormous cobalt blue and white cushions are scattered about the table, offering comfortable sitting space.

title: [Structured Table]
description: Set upon a smooth teak floor, a low round table sits within a halo of red, green, white, and orange hues cast by the brass lanterns that are attached to the ceiling.  Enormous cobalt blue and white cushions are scattered about the table, offering comfortable sitting space.

title: [Essentials Table]
description: Set upon a smooth teak floor, a low round table sits within a halo of red, green, white, and orange hues cast by the brass lanterns that are attached to the ceiling.  Enormous cobalt blue and white cushions are scattered about the table, offering comfortable sitting space.

title: [Ethos Table]
description: Set upon a smooth teak floor, a low round table sits within a halo of red, green, white, and orange hues cast by the brass lanterns that are attached to the ceiling.  Enormous cobalt blue and white cushions are scattered about the table, offering comfortable sitting space.

title: [Interdimensional Table]
description: Set upon a smooth teak floor, a low round table sits within a halo of red, green, white, and orange hues cast by the brass lanterns that are attached to the ceiling.  Enormous cobalt blue and white cushions are scattered about the table, offering comfortable sitting space.

title: [Scrollworthy, Showroom]
description: Elaborate works of art, colorful and vivid, executed upon magical scrolls festoon the bright white walls of the shop.  Sitting atop glass-shelved displays that border the airy room, deep blue glass vases frame scroll-cutting devices of various shapes and are matched in color to the small rugs arranged over the smooth, stone tile flooring.  An occasional zephyr winds in through the arched windows, ushering in soft floral scents that linger in the air.

title: [Scrollworthy, Workshop]
description: Cheerfully welcoming, two settees sit opposite each other, with a low, wide table separating them, at the workshop's entry.  Well-lit scroll artwork and tall, potted ferns offer tasteful decor, and the gentle babble of a stream originates from an ovaline water sculpture.  Spread across the stone tiles of far side of the room, tidily kept workbenches display sectioned boxes filled with the various parts and pieces of scroll cutting devices.

title: [Dye Me A River]
description: Like pennants from a washer woman's nightmare, swathes of fabric in various stages of dying dangle from the rafters in a pageantry of mismatched colors.  Dye splatters mark every surface, including the white shelves that hold vials of dye and the short display counters filled with gnomish contraptions.  A curved umbrella shields the area where an attendant stands next to a parchment-filled hexagonal cubby.

title: [Skin Deep, Cheeks and Lips]
description: Separated by a silk screen offering a modicum of privacy, a pair of rosewood vanity tables sit along the northern wall.  Plush, velvet-cushioned benches are arranged in front of each table facing a row of beveled glass mirrors, their reflection capturing a series of display cases on the opposite wall.  A shop attendant mills about, offering facecloths and color advice to patrons.

title: [Skin Deep, Face and Eyes]
description: An artistic splash of paint brightens a neutral toned wall behind a long counter featuring a display of cosmetics in a vast array of colors.  A potted lemon tree stands next to a comfortable leather sofa piled with bright silk cushions.  Strung overhead, a series of luminous glass globes bathe the room in natural light.

title: [Shears Leatherworks, Showroom]
description: Tall ceilings rise above this spacious, rounded showroom containing a rack, a table, and shelves of leather goods for sale.  Stained glass windows stretch up the eastern wall framed by long white gauze curtains that drape all the way down to touch the floor.  Bright light from the plaza outside shines through the kaleidoscopic glass.  A curtained archway in the west wall offers a glimpse into a busy workroom beyond.

title: [Shears Leatherworks, Workroom]
description: Buzzing with activity, this huge room houses a few tall tables surrounded by workers engaged in various activities.  Clusters of frosted globes above each provide bright light for the detailed leather work being done.  Around the darkened walls, shelves are stocked with numerous supplies.  Leather scraps litter the stone floor around woven mats for the workers to stand on.  A lone marble workbench has been positioned in a way to greet an arch in the east wall while overseeing the entire operation.

title: [In Print Condition]
description: Quiet as a library and illuminated better than one, the incredibly tidy shop smells of newly pressed pages.  Incredibly smooth white walls are covered in several framed instructions on the art of making paper.  Standing alone in a halo of light, a pedestal displays several mechanisms, while tucked against the wall near the exit is a small hexagonal cubby housing a few parchments.

title: [The Final Touch, Color]
description: Twilight blue paint adorns the walls and ceilings of this small room, while the floor underfoot is a slightly paler shade.  Stars and constellations in silver, gold, and white span the space overhead, and gazing upward is akin to viewing the sky on a cloudless night.  At intervals, dark sconces blend into the walls but for the tea candles that burn within, accenting the stars here and there, and an archway leading deeper into the shop hides almost invisibly in the wall.

title: [The Final Touch, Quirks]
description: Twilight blue paint adorns the walls and ceilings of this small room, while the floor underfoot is a slightly paler shade.  In the far corner, a full silvery white moon stares down on the merchandise, while the rest of the sky is starless.  The only other celestial body in the painted sky is a streaking comet, stroked with shades of violet, magenta, emerald, and sapphire.  Miniature orbs of light are inlaid along the comet's streaked tail, brightening the dark sky.

title: [Ornathian Postal Services]
description: Stark white and austere, the service building is chiseled into the very bedrock of Ornath's south-facing cliff.  Thousands of niches stretch from a gold-veined marble floor to the curved ceiling and are filled with pillar candles in shades of white, black, red, blue, and green.  With every candle lit, the entire area is filled with a warm golden glow that illuminates a copper and teak front counter behind which an albino half-krolvin clerk works.

title: [Lockers, Antechamber]
description: A simple wooden chair and a short square table are the only furnishings in this bare room.  The open ceiling shows the warehouse roof high above.  The sounds of workers moving crates in the warehouse below can be easily heard through the thin floors.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Warehouse, Lockers]
description: The far wall of this small room is filled with an array of small, locked doors.

title: [Solhaven, Wedding Hall]
description: Sunlight streams in through the windows, illuminating the blue rug trimmed in gold that runs the length of the hall.  A large oak desk sits before the rear windows, surrounded by planters full of lush roses.  The faint sounds of ships and birds in the Vornavis Canal echo in through the windows.  A flower-carved arch is set into a side way, while a rosewood door leads back outside to the Esplanade.

title: [Concourse, Main Entry]
description: Smooth, onyx-swirled white marble walls enclose this large, rectangular space.  The ceiling houses three evenly spaced domes, and the center dome contains a cupola with a gold-framed oculus.  Sunlight pours through the oculus, glistening off the waters of the elegantly carved marble fountain directly below it.  The edge of the fountain is lined with brightly colored flowers, adding their heady scent to the entire area.  Spiraling columns line tiled walkways, which radiate outward from the centralized fountain.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Concourse, West]
description: A tall marble statue rests in the center of this large room, and an elegantly carved alabaster sign takes up most of the eastern wall.  Silver sconces, complete with oval dome reflectors and hurricane shades, cast a brilliant glow across the onyx-swirled white marble walls.  A tiled walkway leads westward toward the main entry, while a decorative golden archway leads into a shop with a large plaque over it that proclaims it to be "The Rice of Life."

title: [The Rice of Life, Entry]
description: Streamers in bright colors stretch across the ceiling, their unfettered ends falling down the walls to pool in a jumble upon the lacquered floorboards.  Tiny pieces of paper and discarded streamers drift across the reflective planks in the slight breeze that trickles in through the partially open door.  They collect against a lower counter that separates a pleasant shopkeeper from the front of the shop.  A trio of pillars support the weight of a wide blue glass bowl, a deep ruby red glass bowl, and an opaque grey glass bowl, respectively.

title: [Concourse, South]
description: Rows of planters line the concourse, each brimming with brightly colored plants surrounded by broad leaves, while elegant brass sconces cast a soothing light upon the smooth, onyx-swirled white marble floors and walls.  A golden arch rests next to a frosted window proclaiming "Two of a Kind" opposite a rounded arch next to a plaque that ascribes its entry to "Calm, Cool, Scented, I'm Yours."

title: [Calm, Cool, Scented, I'm Yours]
description: Sunlight streams through glass panels in the ceiling, creating pools of dappled luminescence on several ornately carved oak tables.  The tables contain dozens of fragile glass jars, each jar holding numerous slender sticks of varying colors.  Interspersed among the tables are potted palms in clay planters, and a marble bench rests against one wall.  A young clerk stands behind a glass counter, attentive and at the ready to serve customers.

title: [Two of a Kind, Entry]
description: Inset with glass panels, a narrow display case, a wide display case, and a tall display case line the eastern and western walls.  A vast assortment of fabrics, leathers, and other adornments are displayed on velvet-draped shelves inside the cases.  Several wooden forms, complete with custom-cobbled footwear, sit on the tops of a short display case and model a variety of shoes using the shop's wares.

title: [Concourse, Southwest]
description: Elegant brass sconces cast soothing light over smooth, onyx-swirled white marble walls.  Massive gold planters, brimming with brightly colored exotic plants, fill each corner.  A neatly engraved plaque reading "After All is Wed and Done" hangs over a carved arch, which is set into the eastern wall.

title: [After All is Wed and Done]
description: Sunlight streams through the large sections of glass set into the ceiling, glinting off brass sconces that are set into the onyx-swirled white marble of the back wall.  Centered beneath one of the skylights, and positioned to take full advantage of the natural light, is an onyx marble workbench.  An assortment of tools is neatly arranged on the small workbench including a stack of polishing cloths and a set of spectacles with convex lenses.

title: [Concourse, Southeast]
description: Elegant brass sconces cast soothing light over smooth, onyx-swirled white marble walls.  Massive gold planters, brimming with brightly colored exotic plants, fill each corner.  A neatly engraved plaque reading "With This Jewel, I" hangs over a carved marble arch, which is set into the eastern wall.

title: [With This Jewel, I]
description: Glass counters line the eastern and western walls, boasting a wide variety of rings and bands.  A talented jeweler bustles around behind the counters, stopping occasionally to peruse an order book.  Bright sunlight pours through clear glass panels in the ceiling, creating a glimmering effect off the precious stones and metal.  Small tables, stacked with a multitude of ring boxes, stand to either side of the marble arch that leads back to the concourse.

title: [Concourse, East]
description: A tall marble statue rests in the center of this large room, and an elegantly carved alabaster sign takes up most of the western wall.  Silver sconces, complete with oval dome reflectors and hurricane shades, cast a brilliant glow across the onyx-swirled white marble walls.  A tiled walkway leads westward toward the main entry, while a filigreed golden arch leads into a shop with a large plaque over it that proclaims it to be "Crave Dining."

title: [Crave Dining]
description: Checkered tiles of white and black porcelain stretch across the floor, the contrasting pieces pristinely clean and polished to a high shine.  Scattered throughout the area are some small round tables covered in white linen cloths and flanked by matching chairs that create a cozy eating environment.  A large sign is positioned at the center of the entry, offering instructions for diners.
paths: Obvious exits: southwest, west, northwest, out

title: [Concourse, North]
description: Rows of planters line the concourse, each brimming with brightly colored plants surrounded by broad leaves, while elegant brass sconces cast a soothing light upon the smooth, onyx-swirled white marble floors and walls.  A carved arch rests next to a frosted window proclaiming "Bespoke Tailors," which is opposite a curved arch next to a plaque that ascribes its entry to "Ever After Boutique."

title: [Ever After Boutique, Couture]
description: The walls are lined with dresses and gowns hanging from curved silver hooks set into the onyx-swirled white marble.  A well-dressed seamstress stands behind a wide marble counter with an order book on it.  Overhead, a large crystal chandelier casts its radiance over several impeccably dressed mannequins.  Two fragrant potted gardenias frame the curved arch leading back to the concourse.

title: [Bespoke Tailors]
description: Matching jackets and trousers hang from curved silver hooks, lining the aromatic cedar walls.  Several low tables on either side of a carved arch hold an impressive display of neatly pressed dress shirts in a variety of colors and styles.  Rows of warmly glowing orbs nestle discreetly near the ceiling, offering their bright light to this elegant shop.

title: [Concourse, Northwest]
description: Elegant brass sconces cast soothing light over smooth, onyx-swirled white marble walls.  Massive gold planters, brimming with brightly colored exotic plants, fill each corner.  A neatly engraved plaque reading "Trim and Proper" hangs over a rounded arch, which is set into the western wall.

title: [Trim and Proper]
description: Three carved oak stands, each supporting a sizable mirror, rest against the western wall.  Scattered atop tables near the stands are a variety of brushes and bottles filled with all manner of concoctions.  Positioned to face each mirror is a cushioned chair, while a matching oak bench is set along the eastern wall for brides and grooms to rest while waiting for their turn.  Several hair artisans huddle together as they peruse a stack of parchments filled with the latest drawings of hairstyles.

title: [Concourse, Northeast]
description: Elegant brass sconces cast soothing light over smooth, onyx-swirled white marble walls.  Massive gold planters, brimming with brightly colored exotic plants, fill each corner.  A neatly engraved plaque reading "Leaf an Impression" hangs over a rounded arch, which is set into the eastern wall.

title: [Leaf an Impression]
description: Flowers of every color imaginable fill the area with their pleasant, fresh scents.  Several large, glass cases protect the more fragile flowers, while hardier flowers fill vases and planters on various tables spread around the circumference of the room.  A tiered oval table takes up the center of the room and displays bouquets, floral assortments, and an order book for custom orders.  Florist Leylana flits around, tending to the blooms.  A rounded arch, recessed into the western wall, leads back to the concourse.

title: [Crave Dining, Eatery]
description: Delectable scents fill the air as cozy heat tumbles through the space.  Bright lights illuminate the various dishes that are stored on tables, meat platters, and a seafood counter, while various clay soup pots warm on the many stoves at the back of the eatery.  Rhimar-lined cases house a cheese plate and a fruit bowl on one side of the entry, while drakar-lined cases keep several bread baskets and a large vegetable terrine warm.

title: [Crave Dining, Bakery]
description: Brightly colored posters and fanciful sketches decorate the white stucco walls of the small baker's shop.  Clustered globes of light spill their bright illumination everywhere, while stainless steel tables form a barrier between customers and the many ovens that line the back wall.  Filled with a variety of decorated cakes, a glass-front display case displays the various offerings of the bakery.

title: [Crave Dining, Barroom]
description: Brass torches sit in large rings upon the walls of the linden-paneled bar, their crystalline flames flickering with an inner light that fills the space.  A long bar topped with a tray full of hot drinks separates diners from the workspace where a lanky bartender bustles about.  Flanked by a cool drink caddy and a wine rack, a long liquor cabinet stretches across the wall behind the bar, while several copper-bound oak kegs with easily accessible taps rest beneath.

title: [Two of a Kind, Fitting]
description: Three small cushioned benches, each with its own floor-length mirror, are evenly spaced along the western wall.  A small potted palm sits between each bench and offers a bit of privacy.  In the ceiling above, square panes of glass allow moonlight to stream down, and brass sconces cast a bright glow across the benches.  Dozens of shelves along the eastern wall hold a series of bins filled with adornments, dyes, and trims in a vast array of colors.

title: [Viewing Room]
description: Whitewashed walls and rainbow-whorled windows dominate the tidy room, while a painted panoramic of Solhaven, complete with street names and shop fronts, sprawls across the polished floor.  Preserved flower samples housed in tiny glass frames are arranged upon either side of a tall bookshelf, their buff faces reflecting the various titles of the tomes held on each shelf.  A pristine white pedestal also occupies the space, though it has been carefully moved out of the path of foot traffic.

title: [House Annex, House Brigatta]
description: Devoid of nearby furnishings, the western wall is painted sky blue and dominated by a majestic pure white unicorn, which is illuminated by the warm glow of several frosted glaesine globes anchored to the ceiling.  Plush azure carpeting dappled with white threads lends the otherwise austere space a coziness that is enhanced by the presence of a soft blue crushed velvet settee.  A lacquered beige door leads to the hallway, while a blue-edged pure white silk curtain provides access to the storage facilities.

title: [Annex, Booth]
description: Ivory drapes hang upon the walls, their overly long lower edges pooling upon the soft rug that stretches from wall to wall.  The drape's silken lengths are unfettered except where they are parted to provide egress through a blue-edged pure white silk curtain.  A white-edged blue haon counter sits in the center of the circular chamber, beneath the light of an enormous seaglass orb that is held aloft by a woven hemp basket.

title: [Lockers, Antechamber]
