title: [Annex, Booth]
description: You are standing in a secluded alcove facing a wall of small, locked doors.  One of the lockers has been removed for you and placed on a marble counter.

title: [Brindlestoat's, Gem Shop]
description: The low eaves of the shop are smoke-stained and adorned with hanging sashes in a variety of faded colors.  A few pieces of old jewelry glint sullenly from beds of threadbare black velvet near the windows, but they are of low quality and luster.  Behind the smooth wooden counter, protected from the rest of the room by an old steel grate, is a more impressive trove of baubles and trinkets in a variety of metals and jeweled hues.

title: [Brindlestoat's, Moneylender]
description: A crooked wooden desk dominates the small nook to the eastern end of the jeweler's shop.  A tattered green banner above is stitched with piles of glinting coins.  At the desk sits a wizened halfling moneylender who pores over his ledgers with squinting eyes.

title: [Bramblefist's Tanning, Furrier]
description: A snarling warg head stares down from over the doorway leading into the small shop, watchful eyes taking in the collection of tanning racks and barrels of stinking liquid.  Beyond the crowded foyer is a counter of spruce draped in elk hide.  Wreaths of pine and other woven evergreens hang on the walls amid trophies of the hunt, but the fresh woodsy scents do little to ameliorate the sour odor of the business.

title: [Dwindleberry's Herbs, Parlor]
description: Dusty bottles in a variety of deep blues, vivid greens, and bloody reds clutter the shelves that line the walls of the small shop.  Hanging from the low rafters are wrinkled nosegays that sweeten the stale air with a shadow of spent perfume.  A curved counter separates the parlor from the rear of the shop, though glimpses of a small and cluttered bedchamber are visible through a round door behind the counter space.

title: [Cold River, Fisherman's Hut]
description: The rancid stink of fish is almost oppressive, enhanced by the heat pouring off of a river stone hearth that dominates the northern wall of the hut.  Windows look out onto an anemic marketplace, but the sole door opens out onto the banks of a slow-moving and crystal clear river framed by drifts of snow.  Across from a small bed is the source of the stink: a stained table piled high with gutted fish.

title: [Abbey, Landing]
description: Framed by artwork in gilded frames, a rose gold and marble arch opens out of the stony eastern wall.  Occasional flashes of greenish-gold light flicker within, and the air on the landing carries a bitter and unnatural cold.

title: [Abbey, Teleportation Chamber]
description: Beyond a rose gold and marble arch rests a small chamber with a low, rough ceiling, the floor composed of concentric blocks of stone.  Attended by several robed acolytes, a luminous sliver is suspended at the center of the room.  It crackles occasionally, bathing the surroundings in green and gold light.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Trail]
description: Rough and uneven, the path splits away from the plateau and begins to traverse upward.  Either side is lined with green shrubbery surrounded by a frond of spindly fern.  A few sparce fir trees jut out of the ground at odd angles, breaking up the terrain.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Trail]
description: Moving up away from the main trail, the path meanders back and forth between stony outcrops and large boulders.  The foliage begins to thin out, the ground covered with rocks and dirt layered with fallen needles from the sparce stands of fir trees.  Several piles of debris gather at the bottom of the eroding mountainside.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Trail]
description: Climbing up higher, the trail winds its way up the mountainous terrain.  The pine and fir trees scattered about the rocky pass sway slightly as the wind picks up noticeably, chilling the air.  Piles of stone and dirt are scattered about bits of rock and boulders that line the narrow path.   Here and there, bits of sparce greenery try to etch out a place in the harsh environment.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Trail]
description: Opening out to a narrow stretch, the natural landing is flat and clear of debris.  Off to the west is a stunning view of the observatory set into the walls of the mountain.  Several rocks have been stacked one atop the other to one side of the path creating a natural work of art.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Trail]
description: Tall spindly pine trees grow along side the narrow trail as it twists about through a series of hairpin turns.  The air is noticeably colder with the wind picking up speed as it blows across the mountainside.  Bits of rock and stone mar the way creating unsteady footing.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Rocky Trail]
description: Climbing at steep angle, the rocky path disappears from view as it curves around a large boulder that rolled down the mountainside.  Other clear signs of weathering are evident in the awkward position of trees and shrubs clinging to the rocky wall.  Bits of dust and debris blow about as the cold wind continues in sharp, stinging gusts.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Way Station]
description: Standing to the side of a small wooden cabin is a large corral of mules, their braying echoing across the mountainside.  Drifts of snow brush up against a crude log building tucked against the rocky hillside.  A chill wind blows about the plateau, swirling snowflakes throughout the air with icicles hanging from most surfaces.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Tavern]
description: Hanging above a worn oak counter is a huge mirror that covers the length of the wall.  Various bottles and glasses are stacked on a shelf below, while barstools line the front.  Chairs are scattered on a thick wool carpet in front of a large stone fireplace with a small basket of sticks resting to one side.  Placed next to the doorway is a large brass spittoon.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Transportation]
description: Rough wooden paneling lines the walls of the cabin, the tight knots in the slabs creating natural patterns.  Several wrought iron lanterns hang from the ceiling, shedding a soft light across the room.  Centered on the floor is a thick, wool carpet with a large padded chair resting behind a wide maple desk.  A pair of maps are hung by the door with details of various trails and tracks.

wayto.29860: ;e UserVars.mapdb_hinterwilds_location = 'EN';multifput 'inquire','order 1','order confirm';waitfor 'With a groan and a creak, the caravan comes to a stop.'

title: [Seethe Naedal, Teleportation]
description: Layers of thick woolen carpets cover the floor of this small nook.  A pair of attendants move about tending to a luminous sliver that is suspended in the center of the room.  Its light dances across the rough wooden walls sending brilliant green and golden pattens throughout the space.

title: [Subterranean Siegecraft]
description: A blackened ironwork spiral staircase descends from a wood-paneled ceiling into this luxurious showroom.  Polished mahogany cases with glass windows stand sentinel around the walls, each well lit with brass sconces.  A rich woven carpet rests along a marble floor on which a small desk and chair sit in the center of the room.  Between two of the cases, a marble arch leads to another well-lit chamber of this basement boutique.

title: [Subterranean Battle Arena]
description: This round room is well lit with a blazing brass chandelier hovering high above a reflective polished marble floor.  Lacquered wood paneling extends along the ceiling and down the walls, provoking an atmosphere of austerity.  Plush velvet-cushioned mahogany chairs have been arranged around the edges of the room to provide seats for spectators.  A plaque in iron framework has been placed by the arch, and a deep circular groove in the marble floor designates a siegery battle area in the center of the room.

title: [Drift Cottage, Pathway]
description: Harbored within silver-kissed sea holly and tall, blue-green seagrass, a tiny bungalow fashioned of white-washed grey driftwood glitters in the sunlight.  Sanded planks of pine traverse the distance between the beach and front door, while yellow-eyed fleabane and tangles of delicate sea lavender blossom around the support posts.  A thin stream dips beneath the wooden walkway, its salty water feeding into a tidal pool with rhythmic abandon.  Hugging the northeastern curve of the bungalow, a pearly white shell-lined pathway ending at an iron gate disappears into the structure's shadow.
location: Drift Cottage, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Drift Cottage, Backyard]
description: Perfectly manicured and vibrant green, a small lawn of dense centipede grass stretches from a driftwood bungalow to a short picket fence fashioned of narrow white slats.  Departing from the shadows at the eastern edge of the bungalow is a pearly white shell-lined pathway ending at an iron gate that forks to connect a red teak and silver birch stable at one end and a pale silver driftwood door at the other.  A small patio of glazed terracotta tiles offers a place to relax, the many bright white lounge chairs scattered upon it forming a loose circle around a tidy firepit.
location: Drift Cottage, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Drift Cottage]
description: Wheat-hued rattan woven into a herringbone pattern stretches across the ceiling and is supported by bright white pillars of pine.  Conical-shaped fishing baskets hang upon the pale green walls, the bottles within reflect the sunlight in prismatic patterns about the space.  Plump floor cushions of beige and cream encircle a wood-framed low square table at the heart of the grass-green bamboo floor.  A thin sheet of linen opposite a slanted greyish door provides a modicum of privacy for the bedroom beyond.
location: Drift Cottage, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Drift Cottage, Kitchen]
description: Flanked by windows in the eastern and western walls, the remaining wall is dominated by low cabinets, high shelves, and a sturdy rhimar-lined cupboard.  Piping in one corner allows smoke from a pot-bellied stove to exit the bungalow, while an oversized soapstone basin beside it is fed by exterior pipes that conveniently draw water into its deep recesses.  A butcher block table surrounded by tall stools sits in the center of the room.
location: Drift Cottage, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Drift Cottage, Stable]
description: Silver-hued driftwood planks form the finished facing of the stable's walls, while thick ship ribs provide structural support.  Lanterns are bolted to the inverted keel at even intervals, the bright illumination dispelling shadows and highlighting a tidily swept birch floor.  Tacked to a central post is a crisp vellum chore list outlining the duties of any proper horse owner, the lone lantern above it shedding light upon the east-facing door just beyond.
location: Drift Cottage, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Drift Cottage, Bedroom]
description: Wide, glassless windows wreathe the semi-circular room filling it with golden sunlight and gentle seaborne breezes that cool the heat of the day.  Anchored to the conical ceiling, fine bug netting encircles a four-poster white birch bed draped in silky beige sheets and a down-filled chocolate brown comforter, while an ornate and carved mahogany armoire rests against the southern wall near a thin sheet of linen that leads to the cottage's commons.
location: Drift Cottage, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Cellar, Slickwink's Hideaway]
description: Near the rounded doors that are the sole means of egress from the cellar, frozen roots dangle like daggers from the ceiling, aglisten with bitter crystals of frost.  Amidst hanging carcasses and sacks of seed are the obvious signs of habitation, from a pile of rumpled clothes to some rusting cookware near a ramshackle wicker wastebin in one corner.  Several candles atop crates and uneven shelves do their best to hold back the cold, but mostly they just infuse the air with the odor of hot tallow.

title: [Abandoned Manor, Remains]
description: What may once have been a fine house now lies hollow and guttered.  All that is left standing is the rickety skeleton of the structure, heavily blackened with char in some areas.  A mixture of dust, dead leaves, and decaying pieces of wood form the debris that nearly covers the floor.

title: [Dusty Tunnel]
description: Dust hangs heavily in the air, lending it a musty scent tinged with ash.  The western end of the tunnel terminates in a rough rockface, while more smoothly hewn stone walls extend away from it in the opposite direction.  Inset into the ceiling is a wooden trapdoor with no visible means of opening.

title: [Dusty Tunnel]
description: A faint breeze drifts in from the tunnel mouth, bringing with it a fresh scent and helping to dispel any lingering must in the air.  What began as a few patches on the rocky ground slowly turns into a packed dirt fully covering it.  A large opening stands at the far end of the tunnel leading to the outside.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Trail]
description: A grass-covered knoll rises up to the west with a dark tunnel leading into its interior.  Thick bushes cover the ground, growing wild in both shape and direction.  Extending out from the hillside is a rough dirt path which cuts through the shrubbery with a series of hearty weeds taking hold along its route.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
description: Meandering through the thickly grown bushes and grasses, the path crosses a small dilapidated bridge over a weed-filled creek.  Now dry, the creek bed has been covered with many tall grasses, while some flowering bushes have encroached down from the former banks.  The dirt of the path becomes more packed as it continues north.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
description: The dirt footpath forks towards both the northwest and northeast, and gives way from packed earth to a mix of smooth stones and ragged grass springing from the ground.  Running alongside the path is a low cracked stone wall, with numerous stones laying fallen along its base.  A series of weeds entangle those stones, while some thicker vines cling to their surfaces.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
description: Several tall trees line one side of the path, with their thick swollen roots breaking through cobblestones.  At the convergence of the three pathways sits a tall narrow tree ringed with large rocks.  A series of flowering bushes have grown rampant across from the trees, making it hard to tell where one bush ends and the next begins.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Hedge]
description: Composed almost completely of cobblestones and only a few patches of exposed dirt, the path becomes more well defined as it continues northward.  To the west a large hedge rises up high above the ground, its encroachment east seemingly kept in check by the tightly packed stones of the pathway.  One section of the hedge is less verdant than the others, though, and bears clear signs of fire damage.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
description: Rough dirt is all that makes up the path here, with a jumble of mud-covered stones off to the side the evidence of a mudslide at some point in the past.  A fallen tree lies atop a misshapen swath of earth, heavy with rot and various forms of brightly colored fungus.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
description: A veritable wall of thorns and greenery form a massive patch of bramble to the west.  Growths and sprouts creep up from the dirt and mud of the path and dislodge some of its few remaining stones.  Looming above and beyond the bramble is a thick canopy of trees and the forest they belong to.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Columns]
description: Four stone paths converge into a large stone-paved open space broken up by the shattered and crumbled remains of several columns standing in the middle.  Three are nothing more than weathered stone bases, but one column remains partially intact.  Each column stands at a right angle to its neighbors to form a rectangular shape.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Pool]
description: The path ends here in a circle around a raised circular pool, its walls made from the same cobblestones underfoot.  Filled with heavily brackish water, the surface of the pool is further marred by large growths of fungus.  A series of cracked stone steps lead up to a decrepit gazebo that overlooks the water.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Gazebo]
description: Once large in size, the gazebo is only a shell of its former self as a fallen tree has destroyed the rear half of the structure.  The remaining wood planks make the footing treacherous due to the trauma from the tree and passage of time.  The stone steps remain mostly intact, but still bear numerous cracks across their surface.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
description: The path bends here around a wide low stump, while the cobblestones grow more sparse and missing as it continues to the west.  Old roots from the stump are visible, causing the ground to lay uneven.  Thick bushes grow along the path, their mix of leaves, vines, and thorns entwined in a dangerous tangle.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Bramble]
description: The thick bramble surrounds and extends across the roughly cut path.  Thick, sharp thorns cover the branches and vines that lay in every direction.  Despite having been cut back, the bramble gives the impression of only being temporarily pushed back.

title: [Overgrown Ruins, Overlook]
description: The stone path widens into a wide cobblestone square atop this short bluff overlooking an expansive overgrown vineyard.  Though no longer capable of offering seating, a series of broken stone benches stand sentinel over the area.  The remnants of a once large lattice hang overhead, some portions having rotted away completely, while others still hold dried-out and long-dead grapevines.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Divergence]
description: Large cobblestones lie mostly embedded in the soft soil underfoot, but still manage to provide enough stability to traverse.  To the north, a small trail winds through what remains of a rose garden, and to the west there are rows upon rows of overgrown grapevines.  The sour scent of rotting fruit wafts through on a slight, sullen breeze.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Rose Garden]
description: The trail continues through the garden, though wildly overgrown rose bushes encroach drastically in spots, their thorns poised to rend whatever they come into contact with.  The unmistakeable scent of roses suffuses the area, but it is tainted by the hint of rotting vegetation in the damp areas beneath the bushes themselves.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Rose Garden]
description: A particularly robust rose bush has spread to cover the trail entirely in this area, its flowers heavy with condensation and the sheer length of each stem.  The earth underfoot is marshy, with stagnant pools of brackish moisture dotting the area.  Weeds are thick in the area outside the path, their thistles and thorns poised to grab at any fabric or flesh that brushes against them.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Rose Garden]
description: The trail terminates here at a badly scorched rose bush.  Nearly three-quarters of the foliage has been burnt away, and the roots on one side are completely exposed.  The remaining roses are a crimson hue, but their beauty serves only as a jarring counterpoint to the extreme damage visible across the rest of the bush.  A wide furrow of earth has been dug out, as well, in the area just around the heart of the damage, the exposed earth likewise blackened from extreme heat.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: The ground underfoot is largely overgrown, though a slick game trail winds its way north along the rotting grape trellises.  In this area, the trellises are largely intact, though the vines wound around them have long since died, hanging loosely in limp disarray.  Here and there, a single grape can be glimpsed, itself half-covered in rot and hanging on by the thinnest of threads.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: The nearest trellises on either side of the path have all but collapsed, with most of the crossbars missing entirely.  The posts still remain, and the undergrowth has sprung up all around them, creating an impenetrable semi-natural barrier.  The trail continues through this area, largely unmarred save for the occasional presence of an odd-shaped footprint.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: The remains of a campfire lie in the middle of the trail, and the undergrowth seems to have been cut back to a degree.  The small pit that holds the charred branches has weeds sprouting from its heart, testimony to the fact that this site hasn't been used in a long while.  The trellises in this area are intact and scoured clean, with no evidence of any vines.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: One of the trellises has fallen across the trail, and now lies half-buried in the swampy earth underfoot.  The trail shows evidence of several heavy footprints, though their edges are far from clear, making it hard to discern their source.  A dead oak tree stands opposite the trail from the trellis, its bare, splintered branches overhanging the area entirely.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: A single white rose decorates the end of this row, affixed to the last trellis in the line.  All along the other side of the trail in this area, a steep earthen wall prevents any further movement.  The rose itself is startling in its beauty, a stark contrast to the verdant greenery all around.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: The trail splits here, continuing along the outside of the rows to the northeast and northwest, as well as to the south between two trellis rows.  A large hole has been dug to one side of this area and lies partially full of murky water.  The skeletal remains of a tiny humanoid figure lie next to the hole, largely intact.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: A large beehive lies half-sunken into the earth at this point, clearly long since abandoned.  The trellises on either side are in relatively decent repair, though any hopes of fruit from them have long since been choked away by invasive vines and encroaching undergrowth.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: One entire section of trellis in this area is completely missing, to include the posts.  In the space it once occupied is a wide oak stump, evidence of a once-mighty tree long since felled and taken away.  The cut on the trunk is clean, but clearly old, as the wood underneath is heavy with rot and fungi.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: The trail here is remarkably clear and wider than in other places.  The exposed ground is slick and hard-packed, making footing a little tricky.  The undergrowth at the perimeter of the road is incredibly thick, obscuring any sign of trellises or grapevines.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: A single white rose decorates the end of the trellises here, startling in its hue and apparent health.  All around, the underbrush grows wild, with a few particularly large bushes sporting radii of a dozen feet or more.  All throughout, the underbrush is a tangle of various weeds and vines, each fighting for survival while choking off everything around them.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: A single black rose is affixed to the end of the trellises here, almost invisible against the dark emerald foliage surrounding it.  The rotting carcass of a strange four-legged beast lies to one side of the trail, large chunks of its flesh, to include its head, completely missing.  The buzzing of flies fills the air, as small clouds of the things feast on the still-glistening innards of the creature.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: A large boulder dominates this space, and a cursory examination of the area reveals the path it took to arrive at this spot.  The large earthen wall to the west is badly marred by a large gouge that traverses in a straight line through a missing section of trellis and terminating at the boulder itself.  The large chunk of rock is covered in moss and lies partially buried in the soft ground below.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: The trellises here are still largely intact, and a cursory glance shows that they were reinforced at some point, metal rods lashed to each post for support.  The ropes used to affix the rods have long since rotted away, but the wood of the posts has swollen slightly to partially envelop the metal rods.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
description: An uprooted tree lies across the trail in this area, its trunk badly decayed.  The trellis in the area where the tree fell is completely missing, likely smashed to bits upon impact.  The hole beneath the tree's roots is half-filled with water and sports several odd-colored long-stalked mushrooms.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Casks]
description: All through this area, the remains of dozens upon dozens of wine casks litter the ground.  Through the brush to either side of the trail, evidence of more casks can be seen, themselves badly splintered and broken.  A great many footprints can be seen in the soft earth, but the sheer number of them makes it impossible to glean any details.

title: [Derelict Vineyard, Supply Shed]
description: A dilapidated wooden shed slumps to one side of the trail, its walls long since caved in under the weight of its rotting roof.  The wood has splintered in several places, causing the walls to buckle, and the undergrowth has long since moved in, obscuring large chunks of the shed with heavy green foliage.

title: [Cysaegir, Beacon Clearing]
description: Rough stone blocks stacked in a cylindrical pattern create a grey stone beacon tower that climbs up out of the wilderness.  Wood is piled high in a triangular pattern under the conical roof.  A strong iron ladder gives access to the fuel above and next to it is a bin of torches.  Hanging from a hook imbedded in the wall is a lit copper brazier.  A wild tangle of fragrant blossoms gives way to a smooth sandy path that leads back to the main trail.

title: [House Aspis, Foyer]
description: Panelled in dark, aromatic hardwoods, this arched hallway conveys so well the authority and strength of Wehnimer's most ancient House.  Its marble floor is inlaid with tiles reflecting all the professions and races of Elanthia.  Muted candelabra lend an air of soft stateliness, and twin staircases spiral upwards to the next floor.  In the center of the room, a marble fountain effervesces with the gentle music of dancing water, and beyond it reposes an impressive oil painting of Aspis' founding members.

title: [House Aspis, Trophy Room]
description: The rich, musky aroma of puma leather hangs heavily in the air.  There is a fireplace for warmth on chilly nights with a buckler above it, and a well-stocked bar that lends warmth upon all occasions.  Many trophy heads line the dark maplewood walls, testament to the successful hunting efforts of Argent Aspis' fearless membership.  A swinging door on the room's north side leads to the kitchen.  Next to a wide bay window is a banner with a bronze plaque surmounting the case containing Aspis' charter.

title: [House Aspis, Dining Room]
description: Several ornate brass candelabras illuminate this spacious room in which several tables have been arranged.  The tables are elegantly covered with white linen tablecloths, and on each is a small silver dragon candleholder. The candlelight is reflected by the polished white marble floor, and heavy red velvet curtains cover the glass windows.

title: [House Aspis, Kitchen]
description: As you walk into this warm and homey place, the aromas of many meals past invade your senses.  Feasts of old have made their mark upon this room, from the large brick oven designed to roast whole roltons, to the pouches of herbs and spices strewn about the countertops.  A rack of burnished and well-used pots hang above your head, within easy reach of the stove top.  Next to the wastebin, sits a deeply-scarred and stained butcher block.  A hallway leads to the formal dining room.

title: [House Aspis, Grand Hall]
description: Polished maplewood floors sweep forward dramatically in this spacious formal dining area.  It is a gathering place House members use upon formal occasions.  Nearly spanning the length of the room is a polished table made of inlaid dir wood.  A smaller table sits joined to it at one end, reserved for Aspis officers and their distinguished guests.  To the west, a short hall leads to kitchens.

title: [House Aspis, 2nd Floor Balcony]
description: This balcony overlooks the main entry hall of the house.  It runs along two sides of the building and several doors open off of it.  Twin stairways descend to the main floor and a smaller staircase leads up to the next landing

title: [House Aspis, 2nd Floor Hall]
description: This end of the hall shows a lighter touch in the decor.  Pastel colors and light woods replace the heavier, darker colors elsewhere.  A curtained window open to the cool air allows a refreshing breeze to enter.  The door into Sincerity's room is finished in a light oak and carved with scenes of spring and summer.

title: [House Aspis, 2nd Floor Hall]
description: The entrance to Garret's room is here along this stretch of hallway.  The passage continues to the south and the east along the balcony.

title: [House Aspis, 2nd Floor Hall]
description: This end of the hallway leads to Nyte's room.

title: [House Aspis, Nyte's Room]
description: A tiny fireplace burns brightly in the far wall of this small cluttered room, casting dancing shadows upon the high four-poster bed that sits invitingly in the corner.  A matching table of modwir rests under the unadorned window.

title: [House Aspis, Garret's Room]
description: Garret's room is a haven of peace and tranquility.  The walls and floor are soft shades of grey with here and there some furniture of dark polished mahogany.  A small fire burns in the hearth spreading a comforting warmth that drives away the damp chill of the Bay.  Hanging above a tidy desk is an ancient greatsword bearing an elaborate crest engraved upon the blade.

title: [House Aspis, Dremerie's Room]
description: The walls are painted a pale golden hue with portraits of family and friends on all.  A cushioned bench sits opposite of a large soft feather bed, its head and footboards made of intertwined haon branches.  Various instruments hang from pegs, with a golden concert-sized harp taking pride of place before a window.  Bookcases line one wall, stuffed with music books and volumes of collected lore.

title: [House Aspis, Sincerity's Room]
description: Crystal mobiles hang before open windows sending rainbows skittering across sky blue walls.  Countless hastily-penned musical scores, half-finished limericks and just-begun stories cover the floor and furnishings.  What little can be seen of the actual decor reveals a twig canopy bed from which hang lengths of trailing white silk that stir in the breeze, a small unadorned vanity containing but a single hair brush, and a writing desk which seems to be the source of the parchment explosion.

title: [House Aspis, 3rd Floor Landing]
description: This floor holds the rooms of the House Officers and other senior members.  It is richly panelled in fine woods, and thick woven rugs cover the floor.  A staircase leads down to the lower floors.  A row of multi-paned windows gives light during the day, and a small table holds brass oil lamps and candles for use at night.

title: [House Aspis, 3rd Floor Hall]
description: At this end of the hall, an unused room waits for a new tenant.  Soft carpeting muffles your footsteps and polished woodwork covers the walls.

title: [House Aspis, 3rd Floor Hall]
description: Cemb and Sieglinde's room is along this part of the corridor.  Woven rugs of ancient design cover the stone walls and their patterns are echoed in the carpeting underfoot.

title: [House Aspis, Erebor's Room]
description: This room is sparse and simple, reflecting the stoic nature of its occupant.  On one side of the room is a bed with a simple wooden frame and headboard.  On the other side of the room stands a mahogany cupboard for storage.  Looking down, you see the room's one concession to luxury, a delicate mosaic of small tiles set into the floor forming an abstract pattern of colors and textures.

title: [Cemb and Sieglinde's Room]
description: Clean, white plaster walls are lit by sunlight streaming in through an airy window that overlooks the town.  All the furniture is made of a light, plain wood that has been carefully worked to show the grain.  A large bed occupies one side of the room.  The opposite wall contains a small fireplace with a black bearskin rug on the hearth, and a small painting of a mountain peak above the clouds hanging over it.  Flanking the window is a low, beautifully made wooden sword stand and a small shrine.

title: [House Aspis, 3rd Floor Hall]
description: The hallway ends at Dmitri and Tala's room.  Thick tapestries cover the walls to either side of a simple, but well-made wooden door.

title: [Aspis, Dmitri and Tala's Room]
description: This room is decorated in silver and black.  It is neat and tidy with nothing out of place and no dust to be seen anywhere.  There is a bed along one wall with an ebony wardrobe next to it.  A desk and a glass-fronted bookcase stand under a window across the room and a small, well-stocked bar completes the decor.

title: [House Aspis, 3rd Floor Hall]
description: The hall ends here at the room of Aurien and Lyrista.

title: [Aurien & Lyrista's Room]
description: This room glows with a cheery warmth from the fireplace at one end.  As you enter, you feel a great sense of peace and serenity here that relaxes you and makes your cares dwindle.  A huge fur rug covers the floor in front of the fireplace and an equally large fourposter bed occupies much of the room.  Next to the bed sits a handsomely carved nightstand and beneath the leaded glass windows sits a plush love seat.

title: [House Aspis, Entryway]
description: The overhanging stonework of Aspis' outer wall offers protection from the wind and rain.  Its darkly-veined red marble has been shaped into miniature columns and gargoyles - the latter seeming to follow your progress with their eyes.  An oaken door is carved to represent a top-down view of the city.  Very sturdy, it appears easily able to keep out all but Aspis members and their lucky guests.

title: [Liraflyswn, Entrance]
description: Brightly shining torches illuminate the darker confines of the tunnel, the flames fitfully dancing as they are tugged by the wind that slips past the opening that leads to a subalpine glade.  Flecks of mica, feldspar, and quartz respond to the light, the granules winking like stars in the sky with each flicker of the torches' flames.  A gently sloping incline to the south leads deeper into the cavern.

title: [Liraflyswn, Corridor of Stone]
description: Natural light slips through cracks in the ceiling where trailing vinca dappled with periwinkle flowers add a splash of color to the granite.  Cool and temperate, the air along the northerly descent is filled with a rich, earthy scent, as well as a touch of moisture.  Slanting at an angle, a half-rotted modwir is wedged in amid some rocks, its surface covered in vibrant yellow-orange hen-of-the-woods.

title: [Liraflyswn, Corridor of Stone]
description: Juniper bushes stretch across the northern edge, the blue-berried foliage providing a natural barrier between a sinuous pathway that heads in a southerly direction and the edge of the cliff.  Vinca drapes in a curtain of periwinkle flowers over the mouth of a cave, while spongy sheet moss grows between the loose stones that dot the ground.  A dormant lantern hangs from a large iron ring that is conveniently hammered into the granite wall.

title: [Liraflyswn, Cliffwalk]
description: Granite walls draped in coral honeysuckle rise upon the southwestern edge of a pathway that is dotted with ages-old boulders and blanketed with spongy sheet grass.  Beyond the natural barrier, the outline of a colorful garden growing upon an upward slope can be seen.  A series of tall and wide juniper, their trunks twisted and turned about, keeps guests from nasty falls over the edge.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Descending as it makes its sway northwest, a natural wall of granite, feldspar, and slate blocks any southern view of your surroundings, while to the north the pathway opens up to provide a broader view of the mountains.  Low-lying bushes form small clusters in the moss-covered ground, which parts slightly for a trickling stream to slip through.  A light breeze, cool and fresh, tiptoes through the air.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Descending sharply into a grass-covered plain riddled with divergent game trails, the western wall of granite distinctly arcs downward to meet the sedge-covered ground.  Plump black and red elderberries ripen on several nearby bushes, which also are laden with white star-shaped flowers that have yet to start the transition to fruit.  Cool temperatures prevail here, though the occasional breeze brings a bit of chill from the surrounding mountains into the area.

title: [Liraflyswn, Cliffwalk]
description: Ornamental evergreen shrubs densely pack around the western edge of the trail before descending down a crowded slope towards the forest below.  Spreading beneath the vibrant green foliage are clusters of ivory sedge that are dappled with whitish-green flowers.  A colony of map lichen surrounded by black fungal hyphae spreads across a family of boulders, the green tendrils prolific but never advancing to the windward side.

title: [Liraflyswn, Mineral Spring]
description: Cozy warm moisture fills the air as a blanket of low-lying steam hides the footpath and surrounding grass from sight, its source a bubbling hot spring whose blue-green waters feed a small calcium-ringed pool to the south.  Clustered close to the heat and dampness of the spring are agglomerations of sundews that have bright red rosettes upon yellow-green stalks.  Fountaining out of the ground to the west, bright white and burgundy sweetspires fill the air with their subtle fragrance.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Sheltering within the shade of the curving granite walls, feathery and starburst clematis blossoms spring from vines that cling to the stone face to create a cascade of vibrant color.  Green, white, or yellow eyes dot the center of each blossom, which blooms in hues ranging from pale pink to rich burgundy and every shade in between.  A fuzzy carpet of moss phlox paints the ground in purplish-red hues amid low-lying steam that filters in from the east.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Creeping myrtle spills across the pathway, its violet and white pinwheel-style flowers clinging to their waxy vine amid shiny green leaves on long arching stems.  Clusters of plum and citron-hued hellebore shelter in the shadows of the high cliff wall upon the west, their dark blue-green, leathery foliage complementing the charcoal grey of the granite.  Opposite, bright white flowers decorate a pale green bunchberry bush that is dappled with scarlet berry clusters.

title: [Liraflyswn, Hydrangea Bower]
description: Cultivated by a delicate hand, a sea of hydrangea encircles the grassy lane on three sides and are sheltered by the high granite walls from direct sunlight.  The optimal combination of shadows, cool temperatures, and fertile soils causes the plump bushes to be packed with brightly colored flowerheads and emerald green, heart-shaped leaves.  Ranging in color from violet to fuchsia, periwinkle to blue, pink to coral, and white to green, the showy flowerheads are of both the mophead and lacecap variety.

title: [Liraflyswn, Mineral Pool]
description: Thermal-heated water bubbles up out of the ground, filling a calcium-ringed pool with its steamy blue-green water and warming the air.  Vibrant yellow and fuchsia azaleas stretch their flower-laden limbs in all directions, while tiny snow star and pink witch hazel trees with tufted flowers spread their shade to the southeast.  A series of bright white boulders collects rust-hued lichen on their smooth faces.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Snuggling up against the granite cliff-face is a stand of autumn-hued trees riddled with nannyberries and in various stages of growth with the smaller specimens crowding around the taller tree.  Smaller bushes sprout out of the ground-hugging mist that tumbles in from the slightly elevated northwest, while taller species with lustrous foliage stretches its flower-laden limbs skyward.  Round blue-black fruit, resembling flat pebbles, sprout from each species with abandon.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Warm steam tumbles down the gently inclined slope, the starlight dancing off the moisture particles in its composition to lend the air a silvery hue.  Cultivated and carefully pruned, dark green leaves dominate the deciduous shrubs that grow between the various pathways that slip through the area.  Bright red chokeberries cling to the underside of the sprawling bush.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Tufted grass and ivory sedge vie for dominance over the northern slope that has a thin game trail leading to a ring of blueberry bushes around a pair of beech trees.  Nearer, blue-green juniper bushes dapple the landscape where a gentle, yet persistent, breeze bobs the heads of black-eyed yellow daisies.  Ovoid boulders rest on the western edge, their windward sides smooth and unblemished.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Steam rises out of ancient lava columns, creating a heavy mist that blankets the ground and fills the air with warm heat.  Pointed tips from wild grasses and ivory sedge peek through the cotton-like blanket of moisture that eddies and swirls with the slightest of nearby movement.  Firewood, bright yellow arnica, and oxeye daisies grow in proliferation along the eastern edge of the glade.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Starlight filters through the heavy mist that permeates this section of the mountainside garden.  Ancient and decaying, a lone ironwood rests upon the western edge of the area, its surface riddled with dryad's saddle mushrooms.  The tips of high grass can barely be seen above the low-rolling bank of mist.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Trickling in from the west, scattered shrubs and trees of nannyberries bring their burnished hues and showy flowers to grasses that grow clusters of knee and calf-heights.  Bright white, star-shaped flowers with bursts of pale pink stamen grace other bushes to the east, the delicate flowers touched with a bleed of dusty rose hues amid glossy palmate leaves.  A thin trail of sheet moss darkens the ground as it staves off more invasive crab grasses.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Cresting the gentle incline, blue-green grass mingles with the tendrils of warm mist that trickles in from the west.  Wildflowers of the bright yellow and purple variety bring splashes of color to the meadow, while twin conifers rise tall and proud near the center.  A thin stream slips through the area, its moving waters carrying leaves and grass blades northward.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Wispy and thin, mist trickles in from the west with ethereal tendrils that slip through the high blue-green grasses before dissipating in the breeze.  Traveling along the gentle decline to the north is a small stream that cuts several tracks through the ground before tumbling out of sight.  Goldenrod and yellow-eyed asters dot the landscape with their splashes of color, while bright tangerine-hued, paprika rose bushes mingle with flowering maples.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Sheet moss gives way to blue-green tufted grass as several pathways meet upon either side of an enormous weeping willow that grows upon the edge of a small pond.  Peat moss fills the air with its rich, loamy fragrance, while bright purple mountain laurel stretches lazily to one side of the northern pathway.  A trio of smooth boulders, free of moss and lichen, rest within the shelter of the willow's limbs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Tufted blue-green grass trails down a slope to the northwest, the tall blades providing a splash of green coloring amid the grey rocks and beige bulrush that surrounds a nearby pond.  Gravel and loose stones line the short shoreline where the water laps, while large boulders mottled with rust-red lichen watch on.  Patches of mountain laurel trickle in from the south.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Liraflyswn, Hillock]
description: Sheltered from the wind by a pair of beech trees, blueberry bushes crown the hillock that is covered in a combination of sedge and tufted grasses.  To the north, the incline is steep with the greenery becoming more scattered amid the rocks, while to the west the wind has swept the cliff's edge bare except for a few pernicious shrubs.  The scent of fresh water rises on a fragile breeze out of the east.

title: [Liraflyswn, Cliffwalk]
description: Offering an unobstructed view of the valley below, the precipice is comprised of granite and sandstone in contrasting hues.  Rust-colored lichen scrabbles across the uneven ground, finding purchase for its roots within cracks and crevices.  A lone juniper bush huddles close to a bright green fir shrub, the pair taking root against a gently sloping incline.

title: [Liraflyswn, Cliffwalk]
description: Ivory sedge speckled with greenish-white flowers reside beneath the bright green boughs of ornamental shrubs that tumble into the area and abruptly stop at the cliff's edge.  Wind whistles as it passes by, the passing zephyr's fingers stealing loose flowers, gravel, grass, and leaves and carrying them down the side of the mountain.  An enormous crack in the granite reveals a small stream that bubbles up from under the ground only to disappear over the edge.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Converging upon one another, blue-green grasses share space along the slightly descending trail with dwarf pampas grass that is festooned with bright white flower plumes.  Lemon and crimson bottlebrush extend their vibrant heads from along the southerly trails, their long flowers bouncing and swaying with the slightest movement near their leaves.  A thin birch tree stretches towards the sky, its distant limbs offering a modicum of shade to the area.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Gazing over a small pond, the pathways split in a multitude of directions with some rising to the south and others descending in a vaguely northerly direction.  Dwarf pampas grass with its showy, white flower plumes sways gently at the slightest passage of wind, animal, or guest, its bright green blades fanning outward to touch upon small, manicured grasses in the intervening lanes.  A coral-hued butterfly weed trickles westward as it plays host to a variety of lepidopterans.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west, northwest

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Spilling down from a slight incline to the southwest, dark sheet moss blankets the ground to provide a cushioned step that is springy and airy.  Creeping vines of patchwork-colored woodbine drape across boulders to either side of the path, while lavender, pink, and white rhododendron bushes lend a touch of softness to the dark hues that paint the landscape.  Partially covered by the foliage, a slender birch trunk with most of its bark peeled off rests amid red and orange fiddlehead ferns.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Perched upon the edge of a decline to the north, blue shale and pink feldspar boulders dapple the landscape upon a carpet of dark green sheet moss.  Green-tipped astrantia nod their elegant heads from amid their thrones of shiny palmate leaves, yet despite their elegance the air is darkened by their less than savory fragrance.  Slipping and sliding down the cliff face is a series of thin rivulets fed by the ice above.

title: [Liraflyswn, Woodbine Waterfall]
description: Starlight cascades across the granite cliff-face to the south, the feldspar, mica, and quartz granules within its upper reaches glittering in the silvery light.  Boulders, evidence of an ancient rockslide, form a semicircle barrier against the edge of the cliff, while tufts of emerald green grass grow at uneven heights throughout the space.  Resembling a roaring waterfall, woodbine tumbles down the cliff-face prominently displaying its ruby red, flame-hued tangerine, and burgundy compound leaflets.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Crowded with dwarf pampas grass and fragrant lilacs, the small alley is framed by shattered and discarded birch trees that lay partially rotted in the shorter grass that covers the ground.  Stripped by industrious fingers or claws, ribbons of bright white bark are scattered about and resemble tightly wound corkscrews.  Though sheltered by granite walls from the wind, the distant sound of its whistling passage fills the air.

title: [Liraflyswn, Cliff's Edge]
description: Tangled together, wild blueberry bushes fill the spaces between each of the towering pine trees at the edge of a deciduous forest that marches down the eastern slope.  Marsh grasses and cattails sway in the breeze that slips through the air, their ends rustling or clacking together discordantly.  Several boulders ring the edge of a large pond whose waters ripple gently as a stream in the south feeds into it.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Clouds drift by, pushed by a breeze that slips through the area and sets the pine trees to the east swaying and causes the water upon the nearby pond to ripple.  Shrubs laden with blueberries grow in the spaces between the dark trunks, while tiny rivulets of water break off from the pond to slip between them.  Several hollow reeds clack against one another at the water's edge.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Towering boulders meet the edge of a pine forest to the east and block the cliff to the north, their faces smooth from exposure to the elements and pock-marked with rust-hued lichen.  Huckleberry bushes huddle against the edge of a small pond, their bright green, rounded leaves mottled with reddish hues.  A pair of stepping stones leads from the water's edge into the pond where a floating mat of collected moss resides.

title: [Liraflyswn, Cliff's Edge]
description: Clustered around the cliff's edge, large and small boulders make a protective barrier that would require climbing to circumvent.  Water, however, has little to no difficulty slipping through the eroded soil at their base and easily flows out of the nearby pond before tumbling over the edge.  A partially rotted wooden plank stretches through surrounding cattails and bulrush to a floating island.

title: [Liraflyswn]
description: Bobbing gently in the pond, the floating mat of moss is spongy and sways with the littlest of movement.  It is anchored to the northern edge of the shore by bulrush and sedge, which prevents it from floating free.  Flanking it, a pair of stepping stones provides access to the eastern shores of the pond, while a partially rotted wooden plank leads to the west.

title: [Quit Stallin', The Shell Game]
description: Low to the ground fixtures are placed throughout the space, nestled within some shredded cypress mulch bedding.  A claw-footed carved oak hay rack rests upon the corner floorboards, beside a porcelain produce pail.  A display table resting in the fragrant mulch shows off the appearance of a hammered steel watering trough.  Prominently nailed near the entrance is a large parchment notice.

A display table resting in the fragrant mulch shows off the appearance of a virescent steel watering trough.  Prominently nailed near the entrance is a large parchment notice.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: Cold emanates from the looming eastern cliffs, the pale grey granite marbled with sparkling spirals of frosty rhimar.  Glacial ice is wedged in the sparse cracks fracturing the craggy rock face.  Their tapered tips drip slowly, pooling into a shallow puddle over the lightly trodden path.  Ringed by plushly folded goat hides, a fire blazes in a circular clearing surrounded by mountain brome, offering a contrasting respite from the persistent chill.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: The terrain is rough with pockets of rimy rocks, alpine clubmoss sprouting from between the cracks like verdant, clustered fingers.  Ground cedar grows in abundance on scattered patches of flat land, creating an ideal cushion for selectively placed morduska hide tents.  Tan camel furs, extra protection against the brisk air, drape over the peaked shelters.  A trail wends by the pyramidal saxifrage lining the base of a towering granite escarpment.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: Echoing the vibrant coloration patterning the cliffside it dislodged from, an enormous chunk of granite blocks the winding trail, mottled with elegant sunburst lichen.  A freshly trampled path detours around the boulder, blanketed by bristly grass laid flat over earth pocked with cloven hoofprints.  Incongruous to the frost-dusted landscape, camels graze nearby on the silver posie flourishing around an assortment of wagons covered with selshis skin tarps.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: The narrow path abruptly ends where the high cliffs sharply veer to the northeast, widening the view of rock-strewn bluegrass hills gently rolling toward the snowy mountains.  Yurts are arranged in semicircles around small fires, each cozy grouping flanked by either myrtle green or copper banners.  A thin layer of hoarfrost, glittering in the sunlight, clings like flock to the needles of the scant whitebark pines peppering the landscape.

Yurts are arranged in semicircles around small fires, each cozy grouping flanked by either plum or cobalt banners.  A thin layer of hoarfrost, glittering in the sunlight, clings like flock to the needles of the scant whitebark pines peppering the landscape.

A thin layer of hoarfrost, luminous in the moonlight, clings like flock to the needles of the scant whitebark pines peppering the landscape.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: Growing with wild abandon, firewitch dianthus brightens the alpine tundra with shocks of vibrant pink.  Backed by a rock-dotted slope lush with grasses and cushions of moss campion, short brass braziers warm the tigerwood pavilions at the base of the northerly hillock.  Long swaths of shimmering, richly dyed silk, veiled in ebon lacebark, drape from the ornately carved frames and undulate like water under the constant coercion of crisp breezes.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: Frozen dew clings to the southern verdure, evocative of shattered crystal sprinkled over the swelling vista.  Rife with loose granite stones, the uneven path snakes between gilt-washed wagons adorned with obsidian cabochons, scaly wastesdragon skins pulled taut over their arched tops.  Little plum bitterroot thrives in the surrounding grasses, its salmon-brushed blossoms cradled by compact rosettes of thick evergreen leaves.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: Slipping through a red-speckled carpet of bearberry shrubs, a serpentine track follows the wide curve of the northeastern hillock.  Peaked tents draped in jewel-toned bourde are staggered along the verdant slope amid sunlit sprays of blooming snow gentian.  Shielded baskets filled with fire shed a comfortable heat throughout the area, the flames within hissing and snapping in defiance to the ever-present alpine winds.

title: [Rumor Woods, Caravan Trail]
[Caravan Trail]
description: Creating a semicircular barrier, a rich mountain hemlock grove casts shadows upon the burgeoning shoots of frost-kissed lupine that rise above more delicate chocolate lilies.  Bristle-headed sedge trails across the steep slopes of Cysaelotar to the northeast, while a narrow track winds through the fragrant, ungroomed puffs of alpine grass.  Banners in myrtle green and beige snap in tugging breezes, their emblazoned faces difficult to discern in the constant movement.

title: [Purls of Wisdom]
description: Lightweight willow poles curve across the domed ceiling in support of the heavy canvas used to create the domicile.  Glowing orbs rest within a fishing net strung above the entrance, their soft white light illuminating the wares displayed in various containers scattered about the fur-covered ground.  Hollowed-out and hardened by fire, dried gourds form a line of bowls down the center aisle.

title: [Been Shanked Lately?]
description: Sturdy oak beams frame the lean-to and its roof, while heavy taupe oilcloth hangs in weighty lengths over the top and down the sides.  Expertly tanned hides and pelts line the interior, adding insulation to protect the heat rising from the small wood heater tucked into the corner.  A single, double-sided knife display sits directly in the center of the space, with each end adorned with an anatomical dissection chart, detailed with artist renderings of various animals.

title: [Horn and Mane, Adorn]
description: Pale watercolored gossamer drapes from the crystal display, the airy curtains billowing across the unlit silver sconces wrought into the shapes of thin horns, the spirals traced with electrum filigree.  A lacquer-glazed counter stands upon a circular platform of checkered haon, the silver-toned wood inlaid with a similar filigree design.

title: [Bugs on Parade]
description: Supported by a towering tripod of roughly hewn oak poles, the peaked canvas tent has a single oil-filled lantern for light that is hung from an s-hook wedged into the tight cotton lashing.  Small, dimly lit orbs provide concentrated lighting close to the ground, where a geometric llama wool blanket supports specimen boards that rest against the beige walls and display a variety of insects.  Glass jars dangle from a series of stainless steel hooks by their handles near the exit.

title: [Woodn't Yew, Entry]
description: Aged rugs, their floral patterns long since faded and covered in patches of dirt, overlay each other with small tufts of grass peeking through in sporadic spots.  Lining the fabric-paneled walls are thick furs meant to insulate the shop from the outside elements, though a slight chill remains in the air as occasional gusts of wind disturb the tent's open flap.  Makeshift blackwood tables supported by unopened crates line the edges of the room, their wares displayed across a stained white velvet runner.

title: [Tempered Threads]
description: Glimmering tendrils of opalescent silk and black satin hang down from the ceiling, each toward the midpoint of its nearest wall, shrouding the source of the blue-tinged glow illuminating the wagon.  Thin panels of stone decorate the rest of each wall, their colors haphazardly transitioning from one vivid hue to another.  Silver racks and black metal racks opposite each other line the carpeted path to the ornately sculpted table at the wagon's far end.

title: [Purls of Wisdom]
description: Strung from the willow wood supports that dominate the curved ceiling, frosted orbs create a soft but powerful illumination that is pristine and white.  Paints, brushes, and pincushions fill the various baskets that are tucked beneath nearby display tables, which are in turn pushed against the canvas walls.  Forming a trail that spreads to the west, a row of fire hardened gourd vessels is filled with tiny items for purchase.

title: [Horn and Mane, Clothe]
description: Checkered haon and linden walls enclose the area of the shop, the wood covered in a faint silver lacquer.  A pastel-colored rack has been affixed along the far wall, framed in a vibrant display of stained glass flowers, the flora interspersed with leaves carved from smooth jadewood.

title: [The Lizard Nest]
description: Rich plum-hued wool hangs from a dark walnut framework that creates the peaked roof and walls of this large tent.  Boxes and bins are piled up against the walls, their lids open with contents spilling out.  A thick carpet of animal skins covers the ground.  Hanging above the center is a trio of dark bronze lanterns, their frosted crystal panes illuminating the shop with a muted, pale light.

title: [Lizard Vivarium, Entrance]
description: Thick iron mullions and wooden trusses support the large sheets of glass that separate the cold alpine air outside from the warm and oppressively humid air inside this vivarium, made all the more intense by the sunlight streaming through the glass ceiling.  Throughout, lush plants and vines have been woven around the wooden posts and beams that form the walls of the pens located at the center of the enclosure.

Throughout, lush plants and vines have been woven around the wooden posts and beams that form the walls of the pens located at the center of the enclosure.  Lit lanterns have been placed along the posts to provide illumination.

title: [Peaked Interest]
description: Plain and austere, the small tent is tidy, unassuming, and well spaced out beneath fragrant sandalwood posts that support an off-white canvas exterior.  Shielded lanterns provide ample illumination while also keeping the flames sheltered from accidental flare ups without diminishing or overwhelming the space with unwanted heat.  Carefully unpacked crates display the tents that are for sale, small images of their painted exteriors adorning the sides of their containers.

title: [Crafter's Hearth, Workroom]
description: The faint sounds of crackling logs emanate from a small pot-bellied stove in the corner of the tent, the ascending trails of smoke escaping from a series of star-cut holes into the air beyond.  A branch-tied leather cot has been haphazardly stacked with a number of bolts and scraps of fabric, the pile threatening to spill over into a tartan-lined basket of reeds nestled in soft blankets.  A pair of yellow eyes and long whiskers peek out between the various bric-a-brac, blinking slowly before slinking off.

title: [Of Sand and Rain]
description: Large tapestries stretch from wall to wall on each side of the tent.  One displays sweeping dunes in a variety of golden shades against a horizon of aquamarine.  Colorful caravans file one after the other, bright beneath the saffron sun above.  The other tapestry depicts a sweeping landscape that transforms from lush, verdant rainforests at one end to ashen wastelands on the other.  In the space between the tapestries, a circular mirror-topped table sits in the center on a circular rug, and on the table is a small electrum-framed case.

title: [Common Weaves, Clothing]
description: Chilled air seeps in through the tent's linen walls near the ground, while the upper reaches are protected by thick, furred hides hung from the wooden supports.  Lanterns with squat, ovular shades in hues ranging from amber to crimson dangle overhead, giving off warmth as well as a scent that is spiced though subtly sweet.  At the center of this area is a tiered wooden display table, with a row of copper hooks fixed on one of the larger supports, and a low-profile wooden shoe rack set neatly beneath.  A multi-hued linen runner leads further into the tent.

title: [Common Weaves, Sundry]
description: A woven runner bisects this area of the tent, with a set of sturdy wooden pegs mounted over to one side, while a many-armed rack of wooden head displays is arranged on the other.  The scent of spiced smoke is heavier here, with incense burning in one corner in addition to the lamps hanging overhead.

title: [Common Weaves, Jewelry]
description: Several pillows of brightly hued silk are heaped in the corners of this rear nook of the tent, with small tables set beside them bearing peaked copper incense burners and bowls of various gemstone beads, carved bone adorments, and flat skeins of metallic wiring.  Sitting side-by-side in the center of the area is a thin-limbed bronze jewelry tree and a wood-framed glass jewelry case.

title: [Obsidian Raiment]
description: Lengths of dark plum brocade are suspended from thin, dark wooden beams, creating elegant walls for the large pavilion.  A hexagonal crystal lantern hangs from a thin metal chain in each corner of the area.  Woven flax mats threaded with pale grey hues cushion the floor.  Filling the shop are racks and stands displaying a wide variety of items.

title: [Obsidian Raiment]
description: Brocade rugs in shades of ebon, grey, and plum are centered on the floor covering the hard ground and giving a soft cushion for walking.  Stands and racks holding a wide variety of items are arranged against one wall.  Hanging from dark bronze chains are a trio of crystal lanterns that are positioned over a small ebonwood table.

title: [Leaping Leezards]
description: The tanned hide-covered walls of the tent are covered in a myriad of lizard-themed artwork, the paintings, sketchings, and mosaics displaying reptiles in a variety of colors.  A cylindrical dark wood display is flanked by a series of twine-wrapped hooks shaped like upside down lizards, their long tails fraying from years of use.  A small cat, comically dressed in a lizard costume, glares from behind a pyrographed wooden counter, skitters around behind several boxes.

title: [Charmed I'm Sure, Supplies]
description: Trunks and crates fill most of this cramped space, the stacks of supplies making it difficult to find an uncluttered section.  Crammed in one corner amidst the jumbled containers is an intricate wooden table, its surface covered in various contraptions.  Tucked just underneath it are a copper-framed box and a bronze-hinged chest, their lids open wide.  The stuffy air sometimes stirs, sending the beads of the exit curtain to clattering.
